viṣayānukramaṇikā

ekalasañcikā (varḍa)


lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 1
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 002 →

anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyanamaḥ
śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ
oṃśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā
dvitīyaḥ ।। tretāyugasantānaḥ ।।
śrīrādhikā uvāca-
oṃ namaḥ śrīparabrahmapareśaparamātmane ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyā'kṣaraśāsine ।। 1 ।।
tretāsantānasatpitre rādhākāntāya yogine ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāya śrīmāṇikyāvāhine namaḥ ।। 2 ।।
svaprabhāsvāmine mañjulālakāyātmavāsine ।
īśāpāravatīśāya namaḥ saguṇamūrtaye ।। 3 ।।
haṃsajyotisvarūpāya śaktyaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛte ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraprakaṭāya namo namaḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarvadhāmā'dhipeśāya namo'ntaryāmiṇe muhuḥ ।
svargamokṣādidātre te namaḥ śrīharaye namaḥ ।। 5 ।।
niravadhisamaiśvaryaguṇavaibhavaśāline ।
asaṃkhyamuktasevyāyā'kṣarādhipataye namaḥ ।। 6 ।।
eko'pi bahudhā dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādimān ।
īśeśānyādirūpaśca tasmai śrīsvāmine namaḥ ।। 7 ।।
paravidyādhidevāya brahmapriyā'dhiśāyine ।
gītopaniṣatpataye jayantīpataye namaḥ ।। 8 ।।
ekādaśīpriyāyā''rādhanākāntāya śārṅgiṇe ।
mahālakṣmīśvarāyāpi bhaktīśāya namo namaḥ ।। 9 ।।
mukteśāya rameśāya gaṃgeśāya namo namaḥ ।
pativratādhipataye rukmiṇīśāya te namaḥ ।। 2.1.10।।
kāmadughādhināthastvaṃ pṛthvīśastvaṃ ratīśvaraḥ ।
vibhūtīśo'si saṃjñeśaḥ śaṃ karotu prasevinām ।। 11 ।।
kamalākānta devīśa mohinīdhava siddhipa ।
urvaśīśvara buddhīśa pārvatīśa vidhehi śam ।। 1 2।।
dīkṣādhīśa ca līleśa nārāyaṇīpate prabho ।
virajākānta bhagavan vṛndānātha vidhehi śam ।। 13 ।।
sarasvatīpriya svarṇarekhāpriya sitāpate ।
devikeśvara tulasīvihāra pravidhehi śam ।। 14।।
vibhāvaryadhināthastvaṃ mūrtīśvaro jayeśvaraḥ ।
gomatīśo mauktikeśo bhavān bhavatu rukmadaḥ ।। 15।।
premasakhīpate godāvarīśa kapileśvara ।
dhātrīpate svarṇagaurīpate sarvaprado bhava ।। 16।।
laliteśvara raṃbheśa kumudvatīpate prabho ।
śītalādhipate umākānta vidhehi śaṃ sadā ।। 17।।
hemanteśvara nandeśa śāntisvāmin kalāpate ।
nandinīnātha durgeśa vijayeśa vidhehi śam ।। 18।।
sandhyādhinātha kastūrīpriya dhanyā'dhināyaka ।
sāvitrīvara dolādhiroha puṣpāsugandhabhāk ।। 19।।
savitādhipate citralekheśvara namo'stu te ।
pūrṇimādhipate brahman śāradākānta mādhava ।।2.1.20 ।।
mañjarīśvara yoginīcakrakānta vidhehi śam ।
preyasīśa śreyasīśa vikuṇṭheśā'ruṇāpate ।।।21 ।।
joṣṭrīśvara śabarīśa pampeśa gālavīpate ।
yājñasenīpate vasumatīśa vijayo'stu te ।।22।।
sudughānātha ca padmāvatīpālaka keśava ।
bhārgavīpāṇisaṃgrāha padminīvara cā'cyuta ।।23 ।।
śrīmatīśa jaratkārvīpate līlāvatīśvara ।
kalāvatīprāṇanātha kadalīśa jayo'stu te ।।24।।
kāntimatīpate kālindīśa revāpate prabho ।
vardhinīśa sumitreśa puṇyanaidheyikāpate ।। 25।।
banduleśa suśīleśa mānaseśa janārdana ।
śarmavatīśvara kṛṣṇa mādhavīśa namo'stu te ।। 26 ।।
karṇotpaleśa dīrghikāpate'kṣamālikāpate ।
udumbarīpate ṛtambharādhīśa jayo'stu te ।।।27।।
badarīśa ca kubjeśa haimīśa maṃgalāpate ।
mahāvedīpate kṛṣṇāpate tvāṃ cintaye hṛdi ।।28।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
yaścā'sti divye'kṣaradhāmni divyo
hyanantamuktā'bhisusevyamānaḥ ।
pare'kṣarāddhāmni virājamānaḥ
so'yaṃ pṛthivyāṃ samavātatāra ।।29।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmadheyo
hyanādikṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraśca ।
golokavaikuṇṭhanivāsibhiśca
prage'rcane vai hṛdi cintyamānaḥ ।।2.1.3 0।।
so'yaṃ kṛpābhiḥ pṛthivītale
kuṃkumākhyavāpyāṃ hi surāṣṭradeśe ।
śrīkambharālakṣmisatīgṛhe'tra
gopālakṛṣṇātmajatāmavāpa ।।3 1 ।।
yasmādahaṃ pūrṇatamo'pi kṛṣṇo
rādhāpatiścāpyabhavaṃ purāṇaḥ ।
lakṣmīpatiścāpyabhavad yato vai
vaikuṇṭhadhāmādhipatirmahātmā ।।3 2।।
kailāsavāso'pi yato'bhavaccā-
mṛtādhivāso'pi yato'bhavacca ।
avyākṛteśo'pi yato'bhavaccā
hiraṇyagarbho'pi yato'bhavacca ।।3 3 ।।
śrībadrikeśo'pi yato'bhijātaḥ
kṣīrodavāsī ca yato'sti jātaḥ ।
śvetākhyadhāmeśa narāyaṇo'pi
yato'sti jātaḥ kamalāpatirvai ।।34।।
asaṃkhyadhāmādhipareśvarāśca
yato bhavantyeva harestu rādhe ।
tasyā''tmadevasya guṇānukīrtiṃ
vadāmi rādhe parameśvarasya ।।36।।
tvayā stutaḥ śrīpuruṣottamo yaḥ
parātparaḥ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ ca ।
sarvāvatārādhipatiḥ purāṇaḥ
smarāmi taṃ śrīpuruṣottameśam ।।36 ।।
dviṣaṭkayuktaṃ kathitaṃ ca yat śataṃ
tvayā pareśasya tu mukhyayoṣitām ।
divyāṃganānāṃ caraṇānyahaṃ sadā
namāmi tāsāṃ pataye namo namaḥ ।।37।।
ahaṃ purodbhāvya vilokitastvayā
sākaṃ pareśena nivāsanāya vai ।
golokasaṃjñaṃ mama dhāma cārpitaṃ
rādhe vihārārthamanena te namaḥ ।। 38।।
tataḥ paraṃ yena narāyaṇaḥ kṛto
lakṣmyā suyuktaśca vilokitaśca saḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ pradadau ca dhāma yat।
tasmai pradātre paramātmane namaḥ ।।39।।
athāpi rūpaṃ ca vidhāya śāṃbhavaṃ
satyā samaṃ yatpravilokitaṃ punaḥ ।
kailāsasaṃjñaṃ pradadau ca dhāma yat
nivāsadātre guṇadhāriṇe namaḥ ।।2.1.40 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kṛṣṇa kānta dayāsindho parameśvara śāśvata ।
parameśvarasaṃjño yaḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ ।।41 ।।
guṇaiśvaryavibhūtyādikāntāpārṣadabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
sevito yatra mahyāṃ vai hyavātatāra dharmadhṛk ।।42।।
tanmūrtiṃ tadguṇāँstasya rūpamaiśvaryamityapi ।
līlā mokṣapradāḥ sarvā vada lokahitapradāḥ ।।43।।
ahaṃ golokasaṃsthaiva śrotumicchāmi taṃ prabhum ।
yatrā''vayośca jananaṃ bhaviṣyati bhuvastale ।।44।।
tad brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tallokaṃ tatsthalaṃ pāvanaṃ param ।
sarvābhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śrotumicchāmi tadvada ।।45।।
śrīharestasya patnīnāṃ tanmūrtīnāṃ prasevinām ।
āvirbhāvasvarūpāṇāṃ kathā mokṣāya dehinām ।।46।।
svaṃ rūpaṃ yo vijānāti mūlaṃ jānāti naiva ca ।
na sa kiñcid vijānāti tasmāttaṃ vada kānta me ।।47।।
ahaṃ māyāsvarūpā'smi tava dehā'rdhadhāriṇī ।
tvayyadhiśāyinaṃ kṛṣṇa vad me puruṣottamam ।।48।।
tava mūrtau sadā prātastaṃ paśyāmi pareśvaram ।
hṛdye te nivasantaṃ hasantaṃ te'tiśāyinam ।।49।।
mānasaṃ me vikarṣantaṃ rūpasaundaryavāridhim ।
tvayi kṛṣṇe śvetavarṇaṃ vada me puruṣottamam ।।2.1.50।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe! pravakṣyāmi śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।
koṭikṛṣṇā mādṛśā yatsvarūpe'ntarbhavanti hi ।।5 1 ।।
koṭinārāyaṇā yasya mūrtau līnā bhavanti ca ।
tādṛśaḥ śrīmahārājādhirājaparameśvaraḥ ।।52।।
abjarādhāramādyāśca yadromāt prabhavanti hi ।
asaṃkhyā avatārāśca yanmūrteḥ saṃbhavanti ca ।।53 ।।
anantā vyūhasaṃjñāśca līnāstiṣṭhanti yaddharau ।
bhūmānaścāpyanantāśca yadaiśvarye vasanti ca ।।54।।
yasya tejasi dhāmāni golokādīni rādhike ।
vasanti ca samānābhihāra kṛtāni sarvadā ।।।55।।
yasyaikakiraṇātsarve prāvirbhāvā bhavanti ca ।
tadrūpaṃ kimahaṃ rādhe varṇaye'kṣiprasākṣikam ।।56।।
yasyaikamukto'pi ca me dhāmni cāyād yadṛcchayā ।
mayā sākaṃ ca golokaṃ sarvaṃ tejohataṃ bhavet ।। 57।।
tasyaikā lalitā patnī jayā vā muktamāṇikī ।
prabhā lakṣmīḥ pārvatī vā samāyāttava sannidhau ।।58।।
tasyāstejasi me patnyo yūyaṃ syustejasā hatāḥ ।
tādṛśaṃ rūparūpāṇāṃ rūpātirūparūpiṇam ।।59।।
kiṃ varṇaye rādhike'tra cakṣuścaraṃ na vākcaram ।
maṇiryasya mukuṭasya svenaivodbhāvitastanoḥ ।।2.1.6 0।।
eka eva samartho'sti tejo dātuṃ hi dhāminām ।
tamahaṃ cintaye nityamanādikṛṣṇamacyutam ।।61।।
anye dhāmanivāsāśca cintayanti hi taṃ prabhum ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam ।।62।।
rādhe'haṃ taṃ cintayāmi mahānandapayodadhim ।
pitaraṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ parātparam ।।63।।
yasyaikanetrakoṇe tu kaṭākṣe vauṣṭhamadhyame ।
sarve rasāḥ sarvakāmāḥ sarvānandā vasanti ca ।।64। ।
yasya kukṣau tu dhāmāni parameśā maheśvarāḥ ।
vyūhā vibhavā āveśā nivasanti sukhāśrayāḥ ।।65।।
guṇā niravadhayaśca niratiśayaśāyinaḥ ।
samūrtā yasya vai mūrtau vartante hṛdayādiṣu ।। 66।।
sṛṣṭistu pannakhe yasya mahāmāyā nakhāntare ।
īśvarāḥ karagā yasya cintayāmi hariṃ ca tam ।।67।।
cintaya tvaṃ sadā rādhe kāntādhikāntameva tam ।
mama kāntastava kāntaḥ sa eva bhagavān patiḥ ।।68।।
dhyātvā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saubhāgyadā bhava ।
saṃsevya taṃ pareśaṃ cā'khaṇḍasaubhāgyadhā bhava ।।6 9।।
prapūjya taṃ ca saṃsevya nijarūpabudhā bhava ।
tvaṃ tasyā'syakṣaraṃdhāma paradhāmātmako'smyaham ।।2.1.70।।
mayi vāsaḥ sadā tasya tena dṛṣṭastvayā mayi ।
sa eva hṛdye me'sti te hṛdi nivasāmyaham ।।71 ।।
tvaṃ cecchā śāśvatī rādhe sarveṣāṃ hṛdayeṣvasi ।
tasmātsarvamayī tvaṃ vai procyase tvanmayo'pyaham ।।72।।।
manmayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nādiśca varṇyate ।
ekaṃ tattvaṃ parabrahma dvaidhā caivaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।।73 ।।
tredhā cāpi caturdhā vā'nantadhā'pi pratiṣṭhitam ।
tantunā tena devena grathitaṃ nātiricyate ।।74।।
nāsti tasya pṛthagbhāvaścāntarātmā yato hi saḥ ।
vyatireke pare dhāmni pṛthagbhāvastu sarvarāṭ ।।75।।
evaṃ jñātvā bhajed dhyāyet prāpnuyāttaṃ pareśvaram ।
bhagavatāṃ bhagavantaṃ devānāṃ cāpi daivatam ।।76 ।।
īśvarāṇāṃ mahaiśvaryamavatārā'vatāriṇam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ rakṣākaramātmānamātmanām ।।77।।
sraṣṭṝṇāṃ sargiṇaṃ rakṣakāṇāṃ paramarakṣakam ।
saṃhartṝṇāṃ hārakaṃ ca dhyātṝṇāṃ dhyeyameva tam ।।78।।
prāpyāṇāṃ paramaṃ prāpyaṃ sarvajñānāṃ ca saṃvidam ।
prabhūṇāṃ prabhavaṃ nāthaṃ dayālūnāṃ kṛpā''layam ।।79।।
prasannānāṃ prasannaṃ ca nirmalānāṃ ca nirmalam ।
viśadānāṃ ca viśadaṃ divyānāṃ divyamīśvaram ।।2.1.80।।
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmamuttamam ।
śāntānāṃ paramaṃ śāntaṃ modānāṃ ca pramodanam ।।81।।
utsavānāmutsavāgryaṃ priyāṇāṃ paramaṃ priyam ।
kāntānāṃ paramaṃ kāntaṃ premāḍhyānāṃ śubhāspadam ।।82।।
dhāryāṇāṃ paramaṃ dhāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ sādhusattamam ।
vibhūṣāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇāgryaṃ siddhīnāṃ siddhamuttamam ।।82 ।।
śīlānāṃ paramaṃ śīlaṃ vratināṃ vratamuttamam ।
arthānāṃ paramārthaṃ ca samiṣṭānāṃ pareṣṭakam ।।84।।
satyānāṃ paramaṃ satyaṃ satāṃ santaṃ vicintayet ।
akṣayāṇāmakṣayāgryaṃ satīnāṃ sattvamagragam ।।86।।
vedānāṃ paramānnaṃ ca japānāṃ japamuttamam ।
dānānāṃ paramaṃ pātraṃ homānāṃ havanaṃ param ।।86 ।।
tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapatāṃ ca yajñānāṃ yāgamuttamam ।
pitṝṇāṃ praprapitaramṛṣīṇāmārṣamujjvalam ।।87।।
svacchānāmacchatattvaṃ śrīpuruṣottamamarcayet ।
rādhānāṃ paramaṃ rādhaṃ smṛddhānāṃ sampadaṃ parām । ।88 ।।
dhanānāṃ cā'vyayaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ śāśvatālayam ।
staṃbhānāṃ śāśvatādhāraṃ bījabījaṃ tamarcayet । । 89 ।।
nāvāmakṣayyanāvaṃ taṃ khanīnāmakṣayāṃ khanim ।
balānāṃ balamugraṃ ca netrāṇāṃ cakṣuruttamam ।। 2.1.90 ।।
bhāvanānāṃ paraṃ bhāvaṃ vyāpakānāṃ samāpakam ।
sarvajñaṃ svāminaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ saṃsmaret sadā । । 91 ।।
vīryāṇāṃ paramaṃ vīryaṃ prabhāvāṇāṃ ca bhāvanam ।
ākarṣaṇānāṃ sarveṣāmākarṣaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।। 92 । ।
śaraṇyānāṃ śaraṇadaṃ kṣantāraṃ ca kṣamāvatām ।
dhairya śauryaṃ cāpradhṛṣyaṃ dhīraśūrā'dhṛṣāṃ tathā । । 93 । ।
mātrāṇāṃ paramaṃ mātraṃ jananīṃ janmadāyinām ।
mātaraṃ poṣakāṇāṃ ca śrīhariṃ prabhajet sadā ।। 94।।
pralayānāṃ pralayaṃ taṃ kośānāṃ kośamuttamam ।
saṃyamināṃ saṃyamaṃ ca bhaje'haṃ rādhike sadā । । 95 । ।
yasmājjāto mahākālaḥ paricchedavidhāyakaḥ ।
prakṛtipūruṣo yasmātsamutpanno hi līlayā ।। 96 । ।
mahāpūruṣanāmā'pi purā yasmātpravartate ।
vāsudevaḥ sa vasanād yataḥ samupajāyate ।। 97।।
aniruddho janayitā pradyumnaḥ puṣṭido yataḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ karṣayitā yatastaṃ naumi matpatim ।। 98 ।।
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni saṃkarṣaṇavaśāni vai ।
sarvasṛṣṭiḥ kare yasya saṃkarṣaṇasya puṣpavat । । 99। ।
sṛṣṭyadhikaṃ dehamānaṃ yasyā''ste yatkṛpāvaśāt ।
gadāgrakośavat sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā yasya vibhāti hi । । 2.1.100 ।।
tādṛggadādharo yasya dāsadāsapradāsakaḥ ।
taṃ pareśaṃ ca sarveśaṃ bhajāmi rādhike patim ।।1 01 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccā'sya smaraṇātkathanādapi ।
paradhāmanivāsī syāttaṃ sadā bhaja rādhike! ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasvāminaḥ sārvabhaumamahimavarṇananāmā prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 001 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 2
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 003 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi śāntidaṃ māṇikīśvaram ।
yataścāhaṃ tataśca tvaṃ tvatto hiraṇmayaḥ pumān ।। 1 ।।
mahāviṣṇuḥ samutpannastato virāḍajāyata ।
aṣṭāvṛttiyutāṇḍāni vairājāt saṃprajajñire ।। 2 ।।
vairājasya nābhideśānnālaṃ viśvasṛjā yutam ।
samutpannaṃ jale tatra brahmaṇe cāṇḍamarpitam ।। 3 ।।
pañcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyākayojanaṃ tvekamaṇḍakam ।
pīṭhayuk kānakaṃ tejovyāptaṃ śubhāspadaṃ bahiḥ ।। 4 ।।
antarlokāṃstato brahmā kalpayāmāsa yogataḥ ।
caturdaśaprasaṃkhyātān hyuparyupari saṃsthitān ।। 5 ।।
madhye merurmahāśailaścādhārastaṃbha ityapi ।
kṛtavāँstaṃ svayaṃ brahmā yadādhārāstarā matāḥ ।। 6 ।।
pṛṣṭhadaṇḍo yathā dehe brahmāṇḍe merurāṭ tathā ।
vairājasya ca dehād yajjalaṃ tatra vyajāyata ।। 7 ।।
tasmiṃstu kamalaṃ nābherjātaṃ brahmātra sā'ṇḍakaḥ ।
vavṛte sarvathā pūrvaṃ divyavarṣasahasrakam ।। 8 ।।
svotpanne ca jale śiṣye vairājo'bdasahasrakam ।
atha yasmātsvayaṃ jāto vairājaḥ sa hiraṇmayāt ।। 9 ।।
so'pi hiraṇmayaḥ kośo dvedhā madhyād vyajāyata ।
dvau tau jātau kūrcabhāgau sthitau tau tu mahājale ।। 2.2.1 0।।
yathā śakunibālaṃ ca pakvaṃ sampūrṇagātrakam ।
aṇḍaṃ bhittvā bahiryāti bahistasmāttathā virāṭ ।। 11 ।।
niryātyeva jale tatra vidyamānaḥ svapityayam ।
tadā'ṇḍakośabhāgau dvau kūrcau sthitau tu yau jale ।। 12।।
klidyamānau jalapakvau bahuvarṣasahasrakam ।
kūrcābhyāṃ jalapakvābhyāmutpannāvasurau tadā ।। 13 ।।
hiraṇyakūrcanāmā ca hiraṇyāṇḍābhidhaḥ paraḥ ।
vairājatulyadehau tau brahmāṇḍā'dhikavarṣmaṇau ।। 14।।
kṣudhitau balagavāḍhyau gadāvarmānvitau dṛḍhau ।
nardantau sumahānādān bhrāmayantau gade nije ।। 15।।
jalānyāloḍayantau ca sphoṭayantau sa sakthinī ।
garjayantau diśaḥ sarvāstrāsayantau maheśvarān ।। 16।।
hasantau tvaṭṭahāsāँśca muñcantau līlayā'nvitau ।
paśyantau cābhitastatra bhakṣyāṇi vāridhau tadā ।। 17।।
dhāvamānau ca parito dṛṣṭvā chāyāṃ jalādiṣu ।
bhrāntyā bhakṣyāṇi matvaivā'lābhe nirāśatāṃ gatau ।। 18।।
mārgaṇe'pi na labdhvā tau bhakṣyaṃ jalasamudbhavam ।
tadā suptaṃ tu vairājaṃ bhakṣayitumupāgatau ।। 1 9।।
ekena saṃdhṛtaścāyaṃ vairājo mastake tadā ।
apareṇa dhṛtaścāyaṃ pādayorjalamadhyataḥ ।। 2.2.20 ।।
uttolya ca tataḥ sthānād gantumudyamitāvubhau ।
tau vilokya tu vairājaḥ svasadṛśau mahāsurau ।।21 ।।
apradhṛṣyau bhakṣaṇārthamudyantau tāmasāvubhau ।
sasmāra svajanakaṃ ca mahāviṣṇuṃ śaraṇyakam ।। 22।।
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā karṣayadbhyāṃ prapīḍitaḥ ।
vairājastau gadācakraistāḍayāmāsa vai tadā ।।23 ।।
pallatābhirmuṣṭibhiśca tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ ।
tathā'pyagaṇayantau tat jahratustaṃ jalāntare ।।24।।
tadā paravaśaḥ so'yaṃ vairājaḥ pitaraṃ nijam ।
ekāgramānaso bhūtvā dadhyau rakṣārthameva ca ।।25।।।
brahmaṇaḥ kamalaṃ nālaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sarvameva ca ।
jale vilulitaṃ tatrā'bhavat pralayakālavat ।।26।।
brahmā'pi bhayamāpanno rakṣārthaṃ parameśvaram ।
sasmāra prapitaraṃ svaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ hiraṇmayam ।। 27।।
kāvimau bhagavan daityau mahāvārṣu vināśakau ।
rakṣa rakṣa mahāviṣṇo śīghraṃ nāśaya tāvubhau ।।28।।।
evaṃ smṛto virājena brahmaṇā'pi muhurmuhuḥ ।
mahāviṣṇuḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmā'siśaktimān ।।29।।
nārācamudgaraśūṇḍīśataghnīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
divyaṃ yānaṃ samāruhyopatasthe daityasannidhau ।।2.2.30।।।
dṛṣṭau tena samutpannau śakalābhyāmubhau dṛḍhau ।
hantuṃ samicchukau putraṃ vairājaṃ jalaśāyinam ।।3 1 ।।
śakhanādaḥ kṛtastena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ।
īśalokānabhivyāpya golokaṃ vyāptavān dhvaniḥ ।।32।।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tadā vyāpto'vyākṛta dhāma sarvaśaḥ ।
amṛtākhyaṃ tathā dhāma saṃvyāpto yuddhabodhakaḥ ।।33।।
dhvanistena mahārājaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ pratāpavān ।
yuddhaṃ jñātvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā brahmāṇḍarakṣaṇāya saḥ ।। 34।।
vairājasya mahāviṣṇorbrahmaṇo rakṣaṇāya ca ।
smṛtamātraṃ divyadeho yayau divyagadānvitaḥ ।।35।।
yatra daityau mahāviṣṇurvirāḍapi jale sthitāḥ ।
mahāviṣṇuḥ sṛṣṭipālaṃ saṃhārakaṃ durātmanām ।।36।।
tuṣṭāva namanaṃ kṛtvā'rthayāmāsa prarakṣaṇam ।
saṃkarṣaṇastadā rūpaṃ vikarālaṃ samātanot ।।27।।।
sahasradaśakaṃ yasya bāhūnāṃ vartate tadā ।
śikhāḥ yasya tu vaikuṇṭhamabhivyāpyordhvamāgatāḥ ।।38।।
sahasradaśakaṃ tasya pādānāṃ tu mahājale ।
kacchapasyā'pyadho yātaṃ madhye brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ ।।3 9।।
karakandukatulyāstāḥ śilāḥ śastrāṇi cā'bhavan ।
kṣepayitvā karaistāni brahmāṇḍāni parasparam ।।2.2.40 ।।
yuyudhuste'surābhyāṃ vai saṃkarṣaṇādayastadā ।
anekā'ṇḍāni naṣṭāni prakṣiptāni parasparam ।।41 ।।
gadābhistāḍyamānāni babhañjuścūrṇavattadā ।
daityāvapi ca tānyeva samādāyā'ṇḍakāni vai ।।42।।
cikṣipāte mahāviṣṇau saṃkarṣaṇe dṛḍhau dṛḍhau ।
saṃkarṣaṇastu gadayā nijaghāna ca tānyapi ।।43।।
vyomamārge tathā yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ tābhyāmajāyata ।
hiraṇyakūrcenotplutya mahāviṣṇurlalāṭake ।।44।।
pratāḍito'gamanmūrchā hiraṇyāṇḍena mastake ।
tāḍito gadayā roṣaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo jagāma ha ।।45।।
hiraṇyāṇḍakaṭinimne jaghāna gadayā ruṣā ।
hiraṇyāṇḍaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa punarutthitaḥ ।।46।।
svastho babhūva ca yāvat tāvatsaṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
gadayā tāḍayāmāsa hiraṇyakūrcakaṃ hṛdi ।।47।।
bhagnaṃ vai hṛdayaṃ tasya mamāra gadayaikayā ।
hiraṇyāṇḍastadā mūrdhni mahāviṣṇuṃ jaghāna ha ।।48।।
mahāviṣṇuḥ samutplutya hiraṇyāṇḍaṃ jaghāna ke ।
utplutya sa vidudrāva saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu pṛṣṭhake ।।49।।
tāḍayāmāsa gadayā saṃkarṣaṇastadā'suram ।
gadayā tāḍayāmāsā'suro'pi gadayā tadā ।।2.2.5 0।।
tāḍanaṃ tat pratigṛhya cāṭṭahāsaṃ mumoca vai ।
bhrāmayitvā gadāṃ vyomni daśabrahmāṇḍasadṛśīm ।।51।।
prāhiṇoddhastamuktāṃ tāṃ saṃkarṣaṇajighāṃsayā ।
mahāviṣṇuḥ svagadayā madhye tatāḍa tāṃ gadām ।।52।।
babhañja sā gadā tatra jale vai śatadhā'bhavat ।
saṃkarṣaṇo gadāyukto dudrāva cā'suraṃ prati ।।53।।
asuraḥ svasya rakṣārthaṃ jagrāhā'ṇḍaṃ mahattamam ।
ṣaṭpaṃcāśatstarayuktaṃ cikṣepa karṣaṇaṃ prati ।।54।।
gadayā cūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ saṃkarṣaṇasya tattadā ।
tataḥ paraṃdhāvamānojagrāhānyanmahāṇḍakam ।।55।।
mahāviṣṇośca gadayā hataṃ tacchatadhā'bhavat ।
tataḥ paraṃ dhāvamānastṛtīyāṇḍaṃ kare tadā ।।56।।
gṛhītvā prākṣipattūrṇa saṃkarṣaṇasya vai hṛdi ।
hṛdi lagnaṃ bibhedā'pi cūrṇatāṃ cāgamaddhi tat ।।57।।
atha saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ kruddhaḥ sṛṣṭivināśakam ।
hantuṃ vai prāṇatastatra samaicchad gadayā prabhuḥ ।।।58।।
pṛṣṭhaṃ daityasya tu saṃkarṣaṇo'dhāvanmahājale ।
daityo'pi ca pradudrāva gṛhītvā'ṇḍaṃ samīpagam ।।।59।।
brahmanālasthitaṃ yattat sāvaraṇaṃ samerukam ।
sā'ṇḍakaṭāhakaṃ padme brahmaṇā saha yat sthitam ।।2.2.60।।
sarvāṃ pṛthvīṃ gṛhītvaiva saṃkarṣaṇabhayāt sa ca ।
dudrāva vyomamārgeṇa saṃkarṣaṇo'nvagāttadā ।।61 ।।
athā'suraḥ praviveśa mahājalatale tadā ।
saṃkarṣaṇo'pi ca pṛṣṭhalagno viveśa vai jalam ।।62।।
saṃkarṣaṇena ca dhṛto keśeṣu ca mahāsuraḥ ।
tāvat sūkṣmaṃ tadā rūpaṃ dhṛtvā'suro mahājale ।।63।।
bhayād yuddhaśramāñcāpi sāhāyyarahitaḥ khalu ।
aṣṭāvaraṇamāviśya brahmāṇḍasyodare'gamat ।।64।।
tatra saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ sūkṣmarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ saha nītvaiva kṣaṇamātre samāyayau ।।65।।
brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa satyaloke parastare ।
saṃkarṣaṇastadā raudraṃ rūpaṃ dadhāra līlayā ।।66।।
mahāviṣṇustadā sūkṣmaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ dadhāra ha ।
atha te ca trayastvatra brahmāṇḍāntarnivāsinaḥ ।।67।।
asuraṃ mārgayāmāsurmerāvadṛśyatāṃ gatam ।
hiraṇyā'ṇḍo'ṇḍarūpaḥ sanmerukaṭyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ ।।68।।
dṛśyate naiva dehena mṛgyamāṇo'pi vai tadā ।
yogaṃ cakāra vai viṣṇurdadarśa channavigraham ।।69।।
merukaṭyāṃ guptabhāge sthitaṃ bhītaṃ mahāśramam ।
atha saṃkarṣaṇo rudro dhṛtvā sūkṣmāṇurūpakam ।।2.2.70।।
viveśa merukaṭyāṃ sa yogāstreṇa ca taṃ tadā ।
prajagrāha mahādaityaṃ pracchannavāsakāriṇām ।।7 1 ।।
asuro māyayā tatra śīghraṃ sthūlo babhūva ca ।
vinirgatya karāt tasya saṃkarṣaṇasya śūlinaḥ ।।72।।
meruṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā palāyanaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇo'pi ca tasya pṛṣṭhe dudrāva vegataḥ ।।73 ।।
asurastvāśrayaṃ meruṃ matvā babhrāma cakravat ।
śatottarāṇi ca tadā kṛtāni bhramaṇāni vai ।। 74।।
tenā'tyatīva śrāntena martukāmena vai tadā ।
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ parāvṛttya mudgalena pratāḍitaḥ ।।75।।
saṃkarṣaṇo'pi ca gadāṃ prāhiṇot karamuktagām ।
hiraṇyāṇḍaṃ prati hantuṃ tāvad daityo balena vai । ।76।।
sākarṣaṇīṃ gadāṃ dhṛtvā saṃkarṣaṇamatāḍayat ।
punardudrāva ca meruṃ babhrāma bhayatastathā ।।77।।
saṃkarṣaṇo yayau pṛṣṭe yatra yatra sa dhāvati ।
saṃkarṣaṇo gadāṃ dhṛtvā tasya pṛṣṭhe'pyatāḍayat ।।78।।
evaṃ pradhāvamānābhyāṃ merukampo vyajāyata ।
pṛthivī saptalokāśca divaḥ pātālakānyapi ।।79।।
hyakampayan padanyāsairgadāśabdaiśca ghoṣaṇaiḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇasya sa gadā nītvā cakre palāyanam ।।2.2.80।।
saṃkarṣaṇo mahāviṣṇorgadāṃ jagrāha kānakīm ।
meroḥ kaṭyāṃ gadābhyāṃ tau yuyudhāte parasparam ।।8 1 ।।
dvayorgadāprahananānmeruścukṣobha śailarāṭ ।
meroḥ pārśvāni sarvāṇi cukṣubhire samantataḥ ।।।82।।
bhūkampo merukampaśca śṛṃgakampo vyajāyata ।
niṣphalaṃ hananaṃ meroḥ kaṭyāṃ yadā pravartate ।।83।।
tadā viśīryate khaṇḍo meroḥ kaṭyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
evaṃ viśīrṇabhāvena vahnistatra ca gharṣaṇāt ।।84।।
samutpanno lokadāvānalo jajvāla vai divam ।
gadāhananasañjātā'nalapravāharaśmayaḥ ।।85।।
yāvatkaṭāhamāyānti brahmāṇḍaṃ paritastadā ।
savimānaṃ ca devānāṃ prajajvāla samantataḥ ।।86।।
mahāviṣṇuścāmṛtena śamayāmāsa cānalam ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt sarvalokanivāsiṣu ।।87।।
gadāpātaistadā meroḥ pārśvakhaṇḍāḥ samantataḥ ।
pṛthag vyomni nipetuśca tāḍitāśca viyojitāḥ ।।88।।
lakṣayojanadīrghāśca keciccā'yutayojanāḥ ।
anye viṃśatisāhasrayojanā dviguṇāstataḥ ।।89।।
pañcaviṃśatisāhasratriṃśatsāhasrayojanāḥ ।
catvāriṃśatsahasrayojanāḥ khaṇḍāstathā'pare ।।2.2.90।।
kecit ṣaṣṭisahasrayojanā''yatāstadā'bhavan ।
kecid dīrghāśca pañcāśadsāhasrayojanāḥ pare ।।91।।
prasaptāśītisāhasrā babhūvurāyatā hi te ।
evaṃ bhinnā grahāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā meroḥ samantataḥ ।।92।।
svarlokasya nimnadeśe smoḍḍayante'ntarīkṣake ।
kecit khaṇḍā jale kecid vāyau vartanta eva te ।।93 ।।
ākarṣaṇena vai sarve tūḍḍayante vyavasthayā ।
tārakāvat grahāḥ sarve ketavaścā'bhavaṃstadā ।।94।।
merorvai dakṣiṇe bhāge hiraṇyāṇḍaṃ mahāsuram ।
jaghāna vakṣasi pārśve mastake patitaṃ tadā ।।95।।
saṃkarṣaṇastu gadayā prāṇato hi jaghāna tam ।
tadā gadāprahāraiśca gadāmārairanekadhā ।।96।।
prabhinno dakṣiṇo bhāgaḥ pṛthvyā meroravā'kṣarat ।
lakṣakrośamitaḥ khaṇḍo yuto lāvaṇavāribhiḥ ।।97।।
yatra haimaśca māhendra uralaścāmrikācalaḥ ।
abriktaśailarājo'pi cānye śailāḥ prasantyapi ।।98।।
dhruvākarṣaṇayogenā'ntarīkṣe tadadhaḥ sthitaḥ ।
yatrottarāḥ kuravaśca kiṃpuruṣāḥ pradeśakāḥ ।।99।।
naranāmāstathā deśā dakṣiṇe lāvaṇe jale ।
paścime tatra vai bhāge cābriktāśca pradeśakāḥ ।। 2.2.10 0।।
dvīpā lāvaṇamadhyāśca daśasāhasrayojanāḥ ।
sahasrayojanāścānye svalpāstvanye sahasraśaḥ ।। 101 ।।
trayo dākṣiṇakhaṇḍāste puṣṭyā meroḥ pṛthaktatāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭisāhasrakakrośāyato lāvaṇavāridhiḥ ।। 1 02।।
catvāriṃśatsahasrakrośātmā bhūtalabhāgavān ।
evaṃ lakṣakrośamāno graho'ntarīkṣake'bhavat ।। 1 03।।
tatra kālena ca vāristhalayoḥ paryayānmuhuḥ ।
madhyasāmudrakakhaṇḍāḥ paryāvartanta kālataḥ ।। 1 04।।
jalaṃ sthalaṃ sthale vāri vane vāso gṛhe vanam ।
evaṃ kālena jāyeran bhvāṃ parivartanāni vai ।। 1 05।।
khaṇḍamadhye samudrāśca bhavanti kālayogataḥ ।
jalamannaṃ cājanābhaṃ pṛthak karoti paścimam ।। 106 ।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ jalamagnaṃ cābriktaṃ viyunakti ca ।
śukla_ kururjalamagnaścottaraṃ kinnarīyakam ।। 1 07।।
vibhajate kiṃpuruṣaṃ rāśanīṃ jāpanīṃ bhuvam ।
madhye nimnā'khātadeśā avāntarapradeśakān ।। 1 08।।
vibhajante yatra loke haime pārthivagolake ।
naranārāyaṇo yatra himādrau rājate priye ।। 1 09।।
tadetasmin mama rādhe cānartamaṇibhūtale ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre saurāṣṭre puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2.2.11 0।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ।
prāvirbabhūva ca śrīkambharālakṣmīsamudbhavaḥ ।। 11 1।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
tatra yāhi priye rādhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī bhava ।। 112।
yena dattā ca yasyā'si taṃ prasevya sukhaṃ labha ।
punaryāsyasi me dhāma golokaṃ tadanujñayā ।। 113 ।।
hiraṇyāṇḍo mṛto merau saṃkarṣaṇakareṇa vai ।
hiraṇmayī tu sā bhūmiraṇḍamadhye vyajāyata ।। 1 14।।
hiraṇyakūrcanāmā ca lokālokācalād bahiḥ ।
jale mṛtaśca taddehājjātā bhūstatra kāñcanī ।। 1 15।।
ityetat kathitaṃ rādhe prāgākhyānaṃ bhuvastava ।
pratyayārthaṃ tathā'ṇḍasya paricayārthamatra vai ।। 1 16।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra tu golake ।
prāvirbabhūva bhagavānnaranārāyaṇāśraye ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'kṣaraparadhāmādhipaterbahudhā vaṃśavistāre hiraṇyāṇḍakośakūrcajanyayorhiraṇyakūrcahiraṇyāṇḍayorasurayoḥ saṃkarṣaṇadvārā nāśaḥ, pṛthvīgolakasya tu merordakṣiṇakhaṇḍātmakasyaivā'vaśeṣatayā rādhikāyaiśrīkṛṣṇasya paricayadānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 002 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 3
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 004 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi kathā divyā manoharāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā''nandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 1 ।।
sṛṣṭvā śrībhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
īśalokānagaṇitān vairājāँścāpi koṭiśaḥ ।। 2 ।।
bhūmnaśca koṭiśaḥ sadāśivāँścāpi ca koṭiśaḥ ।
brahmāṇḍānāṃ tu saṃkhyā vai vidyate naiva naiva ca ।। 3 ।।
devān daityān rākṣasāँśca munīn ṛṣīn sataḥ satīḥ ।
sūryacandrān grahānnāgānnagānnadīḥ sarīsṛpān ।। 4 ।।
sthāvarān jaṃgamāँścāpi lokān lokaprarakṣakān ।
dhāmāni dhāmapālāँśca dhāmeśvarāँśca dhāminaḥ ।। 5 ।।
brahmāṇḍānāmīśvarāँśca rakṣakān vāsabhūmikāḥ ।
sarvaṃ sṛṣṭvā parabrahmāntaryāmī tatra yadyapi ।। 6 ।।
vartate sarvathā devastathāpi dṛṣṭyagocaraḥ ।
yāvannaiva vibhātyeṣāṃ tāvacchāntirna jāyate ।। 7 ।
evameva vicāryaivā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
prārthayāmāsurevaite'vatārā īśvarāḥ surāḥ ।। 8 ।
svasvadhāmasu lokeṣu naijeṣvapi ca bhūmiṣu ।
pratyakṣadarśanārthāya tadā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
pare dhāmni sthitaścāpi prārthito'kṣaradhāmibhiḥ ।
akṣarādhipatirbhūtvā dvibāhuścākṣarādhipaḥ ।। 2.3.1 0।
akṣarākhye mahāsiṃhāsane dvitīyarūpavān ।
vartate tvakṣare dhāmni cākṣareṇa prapūjitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
akṣare vartamānānāṃ muktānāṃ bhāvanānugaḥ ।
tatkṛtārcanabhojyādi gṛhṇāti tvakṣarādhipaḥ ।। 12।।
divyarūpaḥ sa bhagavān rājate'kṣaradhāmani ।
naijadvitīyarūpeṇā'kṣaravāsiprakāmyayā ।। 13 ।।
bhaktānandapradānārthaṃ muktānugrahakāmyayā ।
akṣareṣu ca mukteṣu rājate puruṣottamaḥ ।। 14।।
atha rādhe mayā tvatrā'rthitaḥ sa bhagavān prabhuḥ ।
goloke rājate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo madicchayā ।। 15।।
mayā prapūjyate nityamanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
mama devagṛhe rādhe paśya mūrti sanātanīm ।। 16।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
itijāpaṃ karomyeva smarāmi puruṣottamam ।। 17।।
madarthe ca tvadarthe ca gopyarthe puruṣottamaḥ ।
gopārthaṃ mama dhāmārthaṃ tṛtīyarūpadhārakaḥ ।। 18।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvatra hi vartate ।
golokavāsibhaktānāṃ pūjāsaṃgrahaṇāya saḥ ।। 1 9।।
darśanasya pradānārthaṃ virājate pareśvaraḥ ।
eṣa śrībhagavān sākṣāccaturtharūpadhārakaḥ ।।2.3.2 0।।
vaikuṇṭhe rājate lakṣmīnārāyaṇasamarcitaḥ ।
nārāyaṇena pūjārthaṃ prārthitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
taddhāmavāsī bhavati sahānandapradāyakaḥ ।
matsyadhāmni tathā kūrmadhāmni vārāhadhāmni ca ।।22।।
kapilasyāpi dhāmnyeṣo rājate pūjitaḥ svayam ।
hareravyākṛte dhāmni vāsudevasya dhāmani ।।23 ।।
saṃkarṣaṇagṛhe pradyumnasya gṛhe virājate ।
aniruddhagṛhe cāpi mahāpuruṣapattane ।।24।।
mahākālālaye māyādhāmni sadāśivālaye ।
viṣṇoḥ samālaye svāmī mahāviṣṇostathā''laye ।।25।।
virājate ca prakṛtipūruṣasya gṛhe'pi ca ।
pradhānapuruṣā''gāre bhūmno dhāmnyapi rājate ।।26 ।।
mahāviṣṇostathā dhāmni vairājadhāmni rājate ।
taistaiḥ samprārthitaścāyaṃ pareśvaranarāyaṇaḥ ।।27।।
pūjito vanditastaiśca sevito harirasti saḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ lokeṣu bhavaneṣu ca ।।28।।।
jaloparyapi vaikuṇṭhe rājate śrīhariḥ svayam ।
prārthitaḥ sa tu bhagavān ṛṣibhiḥ pitṛbhistathā ।।29।।।
dvibhujo rājate teṣāṃ lokeṣvapi gṛheṣvapi ।
suraiścendrādibhiścāpi muhuḥ samprārthitaḥ prabhuḥ ।।2.3.3 0।।
pṛthordhāmni tathā dattātreyadhāmnyapi rājate ।
haṃsadhāmni nṛsiṃhasya dhāmni ṛṣabhadhāmani ।। 31 ।।
vāmanasyālaye parśurāmadhāmni virājate ।
yajñadhāmni rāmadhāmni sanatkumāradhāmani ।।32।।।
hayagrīvāśrame nāradasya loke virājate ।
rājarājasya ca rājadhānyāṃ saṃrājate prabhuḥ ।। 33।।
vyāsadhāmni buddhadhāmni ceśadhāmni virājate ।
vāruṇe pattane vāse kaubere cendradhāmani ।।34।।
yamadhāmni ca nairṛte loke'nilasya dhāmani ।
vahniloke sūryavāse cāndraloke virājate ।। 35।।
dhruvadhāmni tathā śukrālaye ca maṃgalālaye ।
budhālaye bṛhaspaterāśraye śanimaṇḍale ।।36 ।।
grahaistvārādhitastatra nakṣatrairarthitastathā ।
tārābhirvanditaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate ।।37।।
merau dvipeṣu sarveṣu sāmudradvīpakeṣu ca ।।
alokeṣu ca lokeṣvantarīkṣe vyomavāsiṣu ।।38।।
nagavāsiṣvapi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate ।
tītheṃṣu toyapūrṇeṣu pārthiveṣu gṛheṣvapi ।।3 9।।
caityeṣvāyataneṣvīśaḥ sthānibhistvarthito muhuḥ ।
āhūtaḥ pūjanārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ sadā gṛhe ।।2.3.40।।
vāsaṃ karoti bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
tattatsthānālayavāsapattanasthalabhūmiṣu ।।41 ।।
mūrtirūpo mahārājo dvibhujaścātisundaraḥ ।
kiśorabhāvamāśritya prodbhinnayauvano'pi ca ।।42।।
yathābhaktāstathā bhūtvā''nandaprado virājate ।
rājānaṃ ca lokeṣu tathā svargādidhāmasu ।।43।।
vasūnāmāśrameṣvevā''dityānāṃ maṇḍaleṣvapi ।
rudrāṇāmāśrameṣvevā'śvinīkumāradhāmani ।।44।।
dhanvantarergṛhe cābdhau kṣīrasāgarake'pi ca ।
śvetadvīpe badaryāṃ ca māhendre raivate girau ।।45 ।।
dvibhujaḥ sa sadā''ste śrībhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
divyakṣetreṣvaraṇyeṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣvapi ।।46 ।।
bhaktaiḥ samprārthitaḥ so'yamavatīrya virājate ।
pātāle sutale loke nāgeṣvapyasureṣvapi ।।47।।
atale vitale cāste talātale rasātale ।
mahātale'pi tatratyaiḥ prārthyamāno virājate ।।48।
bhuvarloke harikṛṣṇo bhūtapretapiśācakaiḥ ।
yakṣarākṣasakūṣmāṇḍavināyakaiḥ samarthitaḥ ।।49।
tathā'nyairvallikādyaiśca drumaiḥ stambaistṛṇādibhiḥ ।
prārthitaḥ paramātmā'yaṃ rājate tadgṛhe hariḥ ।।2.3.50।
śeṣagṛhe kamaṭhasya gṛhe dānavadaityayoḥ ।
gṛhayoḥ rājate svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'rcitaḥ ।।51 ।।
bhaktānāṃ bhavane rādhe! bhaktānāṃ hṛdayeṣu ca ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī virājate ।।52।।
muktānīnāṃ bhavaneṣu dāsīnāṃ bhavaneṣvapi ।
īśanīnāṃ ca rājyeṣu devīnāṃ bhavaneṣu ca ।।53।।
pativratānāṃ saudheṣu sādhvīnāṃ cāśrāmeṣu ca ।
ālayeṣu gṛhiṇāṃ ca gahvarā suṃdarīṣvapi ।।54।।
yogināṃ ca satāmāśrameṣu gṛheṣu rājate ।
kumārīṇāṃ hṛdayeṣu yoginīnāṃ gṛheṣvapi ।।55।।
mātṝṇāṃ ca nivāseṣu sakhīnāṃ maṇḍapeṣvapi ।
śayaneṣu priyāṇāṃ ca kāntaḥ svāmī virājate ।।56।।
tattallokīyavasatiprārthito bhagavān hariḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ samīhayā ।।57।।
teṣāmiṣṭaprapūrtyarthaṃ dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
yathā bhaktābhilaṣitarūpaśīlaguṇāśrayaḥ ।।58।।
divyarūpadharo devo rājate śrīmahāprabhuḥ ।
sarvairupāsyate so'yaṃ sarvairārādhyate ca saḥ ।।59।।
sarvaiḥ saṃsmaryate prātaḥ sarvaiḥ sampūjyate sadā ।
sarvaiḥ samarthyate tasmin sarvaṃ naijaṃ yadarthitam ।। 2.3.60 ।।
sarve tasmāt samicchanti ṛddhivibhūtisampadaḥ ।
taṃ vinā nānyasaṃyattaṃ ceṣṭaṃ bhavati kasyacit ।।6 1 ।।
smṛtaḥ sa eva viṣame same samupatiṣṭhati ।
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau samutpannā īśāḥ surāśca mānavāḥ ।।62।।
prārthayanti sma rakṣārthaṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ mahāpadi । ।
teṣāmāpadvināśārthaṃ tadā tatrā'bhijāyate ।।63।।
kadācit kṛpayā loke bhaktādhīnaḥ prajāyate ।
kṛpā tu kāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ jīvānāṃ svasya yogadaḥ ।।64।।
kṛpayā yāti bhātyeva sākṣād bhavati dehinām ।
evaṃ kṛtvā kṛpā sarvabrahmāṇḍeṣu pumuttamaḥ ।।65।।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe samāyāti brahmāṇḍasthitasadṛśaḥ ।
kvaciddeve kvacittvārṣe mānave ca kule kvacit ।।66।।
kvacit pāśavasañcāre kāmarūpadharaḥ kvacit ।
sthale jale divi caitye'raṇye gṛhe nabhastale ।।67।।
bhavane ca raṇe vāpi yatheṣṭaṃ saḥ prajāyate ।
vāsaṃ karoti kāryārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhāvanā yathā ।।68।।
rādhe yatra yamunā'sti yatra gaṃgā pravartate ।
yatra raivataśailaśca naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ ।।6 9।।
yatra khaṇḍatrayaṃ cāste golake khaṇḍite purā ।
tatrā'yaṃ kṛpayā svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।2.3.70।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
ādye yuge janiṃ lebhe gopālakaṃbharāgṛhe ।।7 1 ।।
ahaṃ yatra samutpanno vasudevagṛhe tathā ।
tvaṃ ca yatra samutpannā vṛṣabhānukalāgṛhe ।।72।।
śatasāhasrakrośātmā golakaḥ khaṇḍagolakaḥ ।
pāvitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenā'nādinā hi saḥ ।।73।।
māsyūrje cādyapakṣe ca kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine prabhuḥ ।
prāstatra samutpannaḥ kaṃbharāśayane hariḥ ।।।74।।
sarvarakṣaṇakāryārthaṃ sarvasaubhāgyasiddhaye ।
yāvanmāṃgalyadānārthaṃ pāvanārthaṃ ca dehinām ।।75।।।
yadeyeṣa haristatra kṛpayā gantumīśvaraḥ ।
ānartaṃ pārṣadaṃ svasya preṣayāmāsa bhūtale ।।76।।
mahyaṃ cājñāpayāmāsa maṇerdānārthameva saḥ ।
mayā'rpito maṇistasmāyānartāya mahātmane ।।77।।
tena divyaḥ kṛto lokaḥ saurāṣṭraḥ paścime bhuvaḥ ।
patnīvrato dvijastatra kṛṣṇo'haṃ preṣitastadā ।।।78।।
mahālakṣmīḥ preṣitā ca mahāviṣṇuśca vai tathā ।
tvaṃ ca rādhā mahālakṣmīrūpiṇī saṃbabhūvitha ।।79।।
pativratā mahābhāgā bahuvarṣatapasvinī ।
ahaṃ patnīvrataścāpi gopālakṛṣṇasaṃjñakaḥ ।।2.3.8 0।।
jātastatra divyavipro vedaśāstrapravartakaḥ ।
mayā garbhaḥ pradattaste kambharāyai tadā priye ।।8 1।।
divyaṃ tadgarbhadānaṃ vai vāyupūraṇamātrakam ।
dṛśyamātraṃ garbhavāsaṃ dadhāra kambharā tadā ।।82।।
saṃkalpamātrajā sṛṣṭistasmin yuge babhūva ha ।
kā kathā garbhavāsasya rītivad varṇanaṃ mama ।।83।।
hariḥ saṃkalpitastatra tvājagāma sa sundari ।
nivāsamācarat pitṛhṛdi mātṛprakukṣike ।।84।।
darśanaṃ prādadād bālo yathā janma samālabhet ।
śayyā samujjvalā tatra jātā diśaḥ samujjvalāḥ ।।85।।
avatārāḥ samāgatya yatpramukhyāḥ pravarṣaṇam ।
puṣpāṇāṃ candanānāṃ ca lājānāṃ cakrurādarāt ।।86 ।।
dhāmadhāmanivāsinyaḥ sakhyastatra tadā''gatāḥ ।
gītīścakrurmiṣṭakaṇṭhairgīyamānāḥ pramīlitāḥ ।।87।।
vardhayāmāsurīśeśaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahmapatiṃ prabhum ।
devyaśca kanyakāḥ sṛṣṭeḥ sarvaśastatra cāgatāḥ ।।88।।
dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ harestāśca prasannahṛdayā muhuḥ ।
daduścāśiṣa evā'smai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tāḥ ।।89।।
īśvarā lokapālāśca muktāḥ sureśvarāḥ surāḥ ।
brahmasarasastathā cāpsarasaḥ sarvā āyayuḥ ।।2.3.90 ।।
namaskṛtya prabhuṃ kāntaṃ nartanaṃ cakrurādarāt ।
gāndharvyo devagāndharvyaścāraṇyaḥ kinnarīgaṇāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vidyādharyaḥ samāyātā gopyo muktānya ityapi ।
vādyāni vādayāmāsurjahṛṣurvīkṣya taṃ prabhum ।।92।।
bhūvāsinyaḥ samāyātā mānavyaḥ kṛtamaṃgalāḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā yuyujuḥ saumyābhirvāgbhistaṃ puruṣottamam ।।93।।।
nāginyaścānyadevyaśca tiryaṅmānavayonijāḥ ।
anyā divyā adivyāśca tṛṇādisthāḥ samāgatāḥ ।।94।।
vīkṣya kāntaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ bālarūpaṃ mahāprabhum ।
ānandaṃ lebhire sarvā vardhayāmāsurakṣataiḥ ।।95 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ tadutsavastatra sarvatrā'bhūnmahojjvalaḥ ।
khyātaḥ sarvatra bhuvane brahmāṇḍe'nyāsu sṛṣṭiṣu ।।96।।
anantamastakā lakṣamastakāḥ koṭimastakāḥ ।
śatāyutasahasrādimastakāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ।।97।।
viṣṇavaśca tathā rudrāstatpatnyaścāpi koṭiśaḥ ।
vīkṣaṇārthaṃ cāyayurvai prabhoḥ kuṃkumavāpikām ।।98।।
kṛtvā te darśanaṃ prāpya cāśiṣaḥ sukhamāvrajan ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavāँstadā ।। 99।।
paramākṣaradhāmasthaṃ darśayāmāsa vai janān ।
divyarūpaṃ paradhāmasthitaṃ dvibhujamuttamam ।। 2.3.10 0।।
koṭikṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca koṭinārāyaṇātmakam ।
koṭivairājarūpaṃ ca mahāviṣṇusahasrakam ।। 101 ।।
anantaśaktisāmarthyaguṇajuṣṭaṃ manoharam ।
dvibhujaṃ ca kiśoraṃ ca darśayāmāsa ceśvarān ।। 1 02।।
rādhe! caivaṃ divyarūpaṃ pradarśya bālarūpatām ।
punaśca darśayāmāsa pupūjustaṃ maheśvarāḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasya sarvasṛṣṭiṣu samūrtatayā vartamānatā saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛpayā prākaṭyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇānāmā tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 3 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 003 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 4
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 005 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kambharāyā gṛhe tatra mahotsavaḥ ।
sañjātaḥ sumahān saurāṣṭrasthānāṃ ca gṛheṣu ca ।। 1 ।।
jñātvā brahmāṇḍapālāśca dikpālā īśvarādayaḥ ।
mānavāśca surā devyo vimānairvyomamārgataḥ ।। 2 ।।
darśanārthaṃ samāyātāḥ sarve vyomapracāriṇaḥ ।
ākāśaṃ cābhavacchannaṃ vimānairdivyabhāsvaraiḥ ।। 3 ।।
kambharāyā gṛhe puṣpavṛṣṭiścandanavarṣaṇam ।
divyadhāmagatānāṃ cā'kṣatānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt ।। 4 ।।
nipetuśca tadā vyomno divyakuṃkumabindavaḥ ।
jayaśabdā vādyaśabdā gītayaścā'bhavaँśca khe ।। 5 ।।
yathā'paraṃ ca golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cā'paraṃ ca vā ।
avyākṛtaṃ dvitīyaṃ vā'kṣaraṃ dhāmā'paraṃ yathā ।। 6 ।।
tathā kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ kāmasamaṃ hyabhūt ।
avatārā īśvarāśca surāḥ stavanamādadhuḥ ।। 7 ।।
upadāśca nyadhurnatvā kṛtvā darśanamuttamam ।
vayaṃ yasmātsamutpannā yadaiśvaryaprabhoginaḥ ।। 8 ।।
yanniyamyāḥ sarvadā smo namāmastaṃ pareśvaram ।
satsvarūpaṃ pararūpaṃ sarvadhāmasu vāsinam ।। 9 ।।
kṛpayā lokarakṣāyā dharmavantaṃ parātparam ।
bālaṃ ca kambharālakṣmīnandanaṃ ca numaḥ prabhum ।। 2.4.1 0।।
yasyaiśvaryavibhūtīnāṃ naiva pāro hi vidyate ।
satvaṃ saṃkṣipya sañjātaḥ kṛpayā tvāṃ numaḥ prabhum ।। 11 ।।
mokṣadaḥ sarvalokānāṃ dhāmadaḥ puṇyaśālinām ।
svargado rāgayuktānāṃ yastaṃ numaḥ pumuttamam ।। 1 2।।
daitye deve rākṣase ca mānave ca piśācake ।
nāge nage munau nāryāṃ tiryakṣu ca drume tṛṇe ।। 13।
samadṛṣṭyā ca cāṇḍāle vartase tvaṃ kṛpāvaśaḥ ।
samānapitaraṃ taṃ tvāṃ vandāmahe narottamam ।। 14।।
bhāviyugeṣu cānyāni kṣetratīrthāni vai bhuvi ।
bhaviṣyanti tathāpyetatsadṛśāni na tāni vai ।। 15।।
matsyādyā avatārāśca bhaviṣyanti hyataḥ param ।
etatkṣetraṃ samāsādya nivatsyanti tavā'ntike ।। 16 ।।
yatrā''sse tvavatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
tatkṣetraṃ sarvadhāmnāṃ ca vandyaṃ sadā bhaviṣyati ।। 17।।
anyā'ṇḍebhyaścā'dhikaṃ vai svastimaccā'ṇḍaka nvidam ।
yadatra khaṇḍake'khaṇḍapūrṇaprabhurvirājase ।। 18।।
tavā'nugrahahīno'pi samrāṭ dīnataro mataḥ ।
tavā'nugrahayuktastu hīno'pi bhūbhṛtāyate ।। 19।।
tava patkajahīnā tu divyā bhūrapi kalmaṣā ।
tava patkajayuktā tu kṛṣṇā bhūrapi bhāsvarā ।।2.4.20।।
dhanyeyaṃ kambharālakṣmīrdhanyo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
dhanyaḥ surāṣṭrako deśo dhanyā kuṃkumavāpikā ।।21 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro dhanyaṃ dhanyāstā vṛkṣavallikāḥ ।
dhanyā narāḥ striyaścātra hyapi kīṭapataṃgikāḥ ।।22।।
yāsāṃ yeṣāṃ nityayogo'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।
jaya svāmin jaya cā''dya jaya deva namo'stu te ।।23।।
iti stutvā prabhuṃ sarve rādhike! maunamāsthitāḥ ।
hasan śrībhagavāँstāँśca devān devīstathā'parān ।।24।।
varaṃ vṛṇutetyuvāca bhagavān karuṇālayaḥ ।
vakraḥ sarve namaskṛtya janma kuṃkumavāpike ।।25।।
kṣetre deśe surāṣṭre ca yatra tatpādapaṅkajau ।
dhāmadhāmanivāsinyo devyo vavrustathā varam ।।26।।
tava pārśve nivasāmo gṛhītvā janma kanyakāḥ ।
koṭyo'rbudāni tāsāṃ ca saurāṣṭrādau pralebhire ।।27।।
prākaṭyaṃ ca tathā devāḥ kumārāhyabhavaँstadā ।
saṃkalpamātrajanmāno gṛhe gṛhe ca devatāḥ ।।28।।
vṛkṣā vallyaśca tāḥ sarvā anantā devya eva tāḥ ।
gāvo vṛṣāstathā cānye kariṇo vājinastathā ।।29।।
mṛgāśca medhyapaśavo divyadehāstadā'bhavan ।
kalpadrumāḥ kalpalatāḥ kalpastambāstadā'bhavan ।।2.4.3 0।।
cintāmaṇayaḥ satataṃ kāmadughāśca koṭiśaḥ ।
haṃsasārasamenākokilakīramayūrakāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
devatāstatsvarūpāścā'bhavan kuṃkumavāpike ।
yatayo munayaścānye ṛtavaḥ sādhavo'pare ।।32।।
babhūvustatra vṛkṣādau śakunāni samantataḥ ।
nadā nadyaśca tīrthāni vāsaṃ cakrustadantike ।।3 3 ।।
mūrtā'mūrtāni tattvāni kīṭapataṃgarūpiṇaḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre bhūtvā cakrurnivāsanam ।।34।।
gāndharvā gāyikāścānyā devyaśca nāgakanyakāḥ ।
tatra jale nivāsaṃ ca divyadehā vyadhurmudā ।।35।।
svarṇasthalaṃ ratnapūrṇaṃ divyatāṃ prāpa tatsthalam ।
yāni ratnāni cābdhau vai yāni svargādike sthale ।।36।।
yāni mervādiśaileṣu devānāṃ tvāśrameṣvapi ।
siddhānāṃ sampado yāśca bhūmipānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ ।। 37।।
tāḥ sarvāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāmāgatā haripādayoḥ ।
raivatācalataḥ pūrvaṃ śatruṃjitāyāḥ paścimam ।।38।।
bhadrānadyā dakṣiṇaṃ ca pañcāśatkrośavartulam ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ paraṃdhāma virājate ।।39।।
haristatra bālabhāvaiḥ rājate parameśvaraḥ ।
brahmā tatra samāyātastasmai śrīhariṇā'rpitam ।।2.4.40 ।।
parameṣṭhipadaṃ cādye janmano divase svake ।
viṣṇave lokarakṣārthaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jalopari ।।41 ।।
arpitaśca tathā śvetadvīpo nārāyaṇāya ca ।
kṣīrodaścārpitastena śeṣanārāyaṇāya ca ।।42।।
aryamṇe cārpitaṃ pitṝājyaṃ śrīhariṇā tadā ।
tena sanatkumārāyā'rpitaṃ cārṣaṃ padottamam ।।43।।
nāradāya tadā dattaṃ devarṣitvaṃ ca mānasam ।
māhendraṃ ca padaṃ dattamindrāya divi rājasam ।।44।।
dharmarājāya ca yāmyaṃ padaṃ tena samarpitam ।
kuberāya dhanāḍhyatvaṃ vāruṇaṃ varuṇāya ca ।।45।।
vāyave cāgnaye īśānāya nirṛtaye tathā ।
dikpālatvaṃ pradattaṃ ca sūryāya taijasaṃ sthalam ।।46।।
somāyauṣadhināthatvaṃ tathā nakṣatrarājatā ।
merave parvatarājyaṃ saridrājyaṃ ca sāgare ।।47।।
tattvānāṃ paramaṃ rājyaṃ tattattattveṣu cāhitam ।
evaṃ tena kṛtā loke vyavasthā paramātmanā ।।48।।
ratnasiṃhāsane sthitvā mukuṭānyārpayat prabhuḥ ।
te ca sattāśāsanāni gṛhītvā harimārcayan ।।49।।
janmamadhyāhnapūrvaṃ vai vyavasthā lokadhāriṇī ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena racitā purā ।।2.4.50 ।।
tadā janmanimittāni rājyanimittakāni ca ।
pitā devāḥ pradaduśca dānānyasaṃkhyakāni ca ।।51।।
rudraḥ sahārakṛddhiṣṇya labdhvā dānāni sandadau ।
gopālakṛṣṇo dānāni gavāṃ lakṣāyutāni ca ।।52।।
ratnāni svarṇapātrāṇi maṇīn gṛhāṇi sandadau ।
ramyāṇi bhavanāni śrīmanti dāne dadau hi saḥ ।।53।।
yānāni svarṇavarṇāni savitānāni sandadau ।
vyomayānāni divyāni gajāśverethavanti ca ।।54।।
kanyādānāni viprebhyo dadau dravyāṇi vai mudā ।
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi sumṛṣṭāni ghṛtāni ca ।।55।।
śarkarā divyavastrāṇi vibhūṣā hīrakāñcitāḥ ।
śārīrasādhanalepān viṣṇutailādikān dadau ।।56 ।।
ūrmikāḥ kaṃkaṇān divyān śayyāparyaṅkavalkalān ।
kalaśān sthālikā kamaṇḍalūnāstaraṇāni ca ।।57।।
pūjāpātrāṇi divyāni pātrāṇyakṣayakāni ca ।
vāhanāni vṛṣān yogyānannānāṃ sañcayān dadau ।।58।।
kalpavṛkṣān kalpakalmān kalpavallīrdadau mudā ।
cintāmaṇīn dāsadāsīḥ sevakān kiṃkarān dadau ।।59।।
svarṇapadmāni cāndrāṇi pāṣāṇāni jvalanti ca ।
prakāśakapradīpāँśca svarṇapeṭīścaṭīrdadau ।।2.4.60 ।।
āsanāni svarṇarūpyatantujanyāni sadbṛsīḥ ।
kaṭāni dhotrakañcukādīnyasaṃkhyāni vai dadau ।।61 ।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni cā'mṛtānyakṣayāṇi ca ।
maṇḍapān savitānāँśca suvarṇaśakaṭīrdadau ।।62।।
uṣṭrānajānāvikāśca ghoṭakān gavayān dadau ।
jalayānāni sāmudrāntaḥsañcārīṇi sandadau ।।63 ।।
gaumukhīrjapamālāśca mṛgacarmāṇi vai dadau ।
āsanāni vicitrāṇi kambalāni ghaṭīrdadau ।।64।।
kālavedhakayantrāṇi viṣahāramaṇīnapi ।
kāyākalpakararasān daṃśāvaraṇakāni ca ।।65।।
dhruvavīkṣakayantrāṇi vahnikāntamaṇīn dadau ।
mahiṣīścāmarīgāśca tadā kṛṣṇāmṛgān dadau ।।66।।
upaskarāṇi sarvāṇi gṛhayogyāni vai dadau ।
yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi viprebhyo brahma vai dadau ।।67।।
mokṣapātrāṇi divyāni devamūrtīrdadau mudā ।
tathā cā'bhayadānāni santoṣāँśca dadau tadā ।।68।।
ramyayajñopavītāni dūradarśakayantrakān ।
dūraśravaṇayantrāṇi śītahāramaṇīn dadau ।।69।।
sūryakāntānayaskāntānasaṃkhyān vai dadau tadā ।
cintāmaṇīn bhogyamaṇīn saṃhārakṛnmaṇīn dadau ।।2.4.70।।
pauṣpabāṇān vilāsāँśca phalapatrāṇi gandhakān ।
vṛṣṭivāhān bhūgadaṇḍān camatkāradravān dadau ।।71।।
divyamantrān siddhabhāvān kāmarūpadharān dadau ।
kalpajālacamatkārān brāhmasaṃkalpakān dadau ।।72।।
ujjvalāśca śubhā vidyā śāradāḥ kanyakā dadau ।
viprebhyo viprayogyāni ṛṣiyogyāni yāni ca ।।73।।
kṣatriyebhyaḥ kṣātradharmapuṣṭidāni dadau tadā ।
dhvānayantrāṇi ca vāyuyantrāṇi gūṭikāstathā ।।74।।
vaiśyayogyāni ca sarvakaraṇāni tadā dadau ।
sevakānāṃ ca yogyāni vargāṇāṃ niyatāni ca ।।75।।
yāni yāni yadiṣṭāni tāni tāni tadā dadau ।
adeyaṃ na tadā tasya kiñcidāsīnmahotsave ।।76।।
siddhijaṃ yogajaṃ divyaṃ mānasotthaṃ ca tattvajam ।
bhautikaṃ mātrikaṃ bauddhaṃ mantrajaṃ cātmajaṃ ca vā ।।77।।
yat kiñcid yena yacceṣṭaṃ vāñchitaṃ vai tadā tadau ।
mayā dattaṃ cā'kṣayaṃ vai yasmādakṣayameva tat ।।78।।
sarveṣāṃ lokavāsānāṃ tantuścā'kṣayatāṃ vrajet। ।
iti matvā sampadāṃ vardhakaṃ sampatpradaṃ dadau ।।79।।
kalpaputtalikā ramyāḥ sarvakāmadughā dadau ।
kalpāṅgulīyakānyapi maṇiyuktāni vai dadau ।।2.4.80।।
evaṃ hyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanerdine ।
dānānyārātriṃ pradadau śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kambharā ca mahālakṣmīrdadau dānāni vai hṛdā ।
śāṭikāḥ kaṃkatīścāpi darpaṇāni ca kañcukīḥ ।।82।।
ghargharīścolikāścāpi kuṃkumā'laktakāni ca ।
tailāni ca sugandhīni kaṃkaṇāni ca śṛṃkhalāḥ ।।83।।
yoṣidbhyaḥ kanyakābhyaśca bālikābhyaśca baṃgiḍīḥ ।
balayānaireyakāँśca natthīścibūkabindvikāḥ ।।84।।
candrakāraśanā hārānūrmikā nūpurāṇi ca ।
kauśeyakāni vastrāṇi saubhāgyasya dravāṇi ca ।।85।।
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi bālakrīḍanakāni ca ।
bālāsanāni dolāśca preṅkhā hindolikāstathā ।।86।।
ghoṭikāḥ khaṭvikāḥ paryaṅkikāśca camacāni ca ।
mṛdūni bālavastrāṇi kanyāvastrāṇi sandadau ।।87।।
kalaśān gargarīścāpi droṇān hāṇḍāni bhāṇḍakān ।
pātrān darvīn sruvān sthālīḥ pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ।।88।।
kiṃkiṇījālasannaddhaprakoṣṭhabhūṣaṇāni ca ।
hastidantajaramyābhūṣaṇāni sandadau satī ।।89।।
kṣetrāṇi vāṭikā grāmānudyānāni vanāni ca ।
sasyānyuttamadhānyāni mṛṣṭānnāni dadau tadā ।।2.4.90।।
sindūrān patrikāḥ sūtrāṇyapi kānakacīpiṭān ।
svarṇahārān maṇinaddhān hīrakāñcitamālikāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
keyūrakāँśca mukuṭān cūllikā vrellaṇāni ca ।
tāmrapeṭāstālikāśca cāmaravyajanāni ca ।।92।।
kaśipugendukaguptadorakādīni sandadau ।
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtamājyaṃ miṣṭaṃ miśraṃ dadau tadā ।।93 ।।
peyaṃ svādyaṃ ca sammṛdya sugandhadravyamādadau ।
piṣṭaṃ śālīnakṣatāँśca jārikā barjarān dadau ।।94।।
godhūmān mudgamāṣāँśca rājamāṣādikān dadau ।
yavān vrīhīṃścaṇakāँśca kaṇān kulatthikān dadau ।।95।।
guḍān madhūni ca tilān madhuparkāṃstadā dadau ।
sarpihaiyaṃgavīnaṃ ca pāyasāni tadā dadau ।।96।।
yad yadāsīt smṛtau tatra tattat dānaṃ tadā dadau ।
devā daityā ṛṣayaśca mānavā vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।।97।।
īśvarā lokapālāśca dṛṣṭvā jagmuśca vismayam ।
suvarṇarasavallīśca - sandhinyādyauṣadhīrdadau ।।98।।
gṛhītvā divyavallīśca divyabījādigūṭikāḥ ।
kāmarūpapradāḥ sarvā gṛṭikāḥ prāpya yoṣitaḥ ।।99।।
mumuduścāpyatīvāti dadurāśiṣa īśikāḥ ।
mahotsavo mahān jāto bhojyadānā'bhinandanaiḥ ।। 2.4.100 ।।
caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ śrīhariṃ vīkṣya vāsinaḥ ।
upadāḥ sampradāyaiva gṛhītvā ca pratigrahān ।। 101 ।।
bhuktvā pītvā ca saṃbhūya tṛptimāsādya śāśvatīm ।
nītvā prāptaṃ dānamānaṃ sāyaṃ lokān yayuḥ svakān ।। 1 02।।
janmottaraṃ darśitaṃ ca nālacchedādikaṃ tadā ।
mahāmāyā mahāpuṃsaḥ patnī svayaṃ cakāra ha ।। 1 03।।
snānasaṃskārakān śuddhiṃ vahnisevanamityapi ।
devavallokavat sarvaṃ sūtikāgṛhamāntaram ।। 1 04।।
snānādi yogyamevāpi cakāra janako'pi ca ।
bhagavān bālavajjātaḥ suṣvāpa yoganidrayā ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne parameśvarasya janmadine'vatārā īśvarā lokapālāḥ prajāḥ samāgatāḥ, vividhadānāni ceti-
nirūpaṇanāmā caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 4 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 004 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 5
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 006 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe pareśasya sevāṃ devī tu mānasā ।
ṣaṣṭhīnāmnā prasiddhā yā bālarakṣākarī matā ।। 1 ।।
sā tu sannihitā nityaṃ karoti divyarūpiṇī ।
rādhikāsadṛśī rūpe lakṣmīsadṛśī poṣaṇe ।। 2 ।।
pārvatīsadṛśī premṇi ramāsadṛśī rāmaṇe ।
kamalāsadṛśī sparśe snehe vai mātṛsadṛśī ।। 3 ।।
cikitsāyāṃ dhanvantarisamā sā sevate harim ।
bālabhāvena ca vartamānasyā'śaktakasya ca ।। 4 ।।
asamarthasyeva tasyā'vanaṃ bhūtāditattvataḥ ।
mūrtā'mūrtātmakād vighnād rakṣāṃ karoti ṣaṣṭhikā ।। 5 ।।
avighnasya kuto vighnaṃ tathā'pyanukaroti sā ।
lokarītiṃ bhagavata icchayā mānasā satī ।। 6 ।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīpūjanaṃ ca kārayāmāsa vāḍavaiḥ ।
rakṣāṃ ca kārayāmāsa pitā vai lomaśarṣiṇā ।। 7 ।।
dānāni bhojanānāṃ ca svarṇānāmapi dakṣiṇāḥ ।
dadau gopālakṛṣṇaśca parakṛṣṇanimittajāḥ ।। 8 ।।
grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ devapūjanaṃ viprapūjanam ।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa vāḍavaḥ ।। 9 ।।
saurāṣṭrīyā vāḍavāśca bhuktvā cānantatṛptidam ।
āśīrbhiryājayāmāsurbālaṃ prāpya dhanāni ca ।। 2.5.1 0।।
utsavaṃ cakrire ṣaṭhyāstrayodaśyā dine śubhe ।
rātrau devyo nartanaṃ ca cakruḥ śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 1 1।।
bhagavān divyarūpaśca kaiśoraṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ ।
nṛtyaṃ sevāṃ gītikādyā lokayāmāsa vai hasan ।। 12।।
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prātarbālo babhūva saḥ ।
śayane māturevā'yaṃ svapiti nityajāgaraḥ ।। 13 ।।
ṣaṣṭhī rakṣati kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
divase dugdhapānenā'tarpayajjananī sutam ।। 14।।
kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrātrau svāpayāmāsa pārśvake ।
svarṇaparyaṃkake candrojjvale divyamanohare ।। 15।।
ṣaṣṭhī jāgarti rakṣārthaṃ mātā svapiti nidrayā ।
atha rātrau samāyātā daityāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ।। 16।।
kāmarūpadharā nārīsvarūpaiḥ kanyakā yathā ।
devyo divyāśca tā bhūtvā bālaṃ ramayituṃ yayuḥ ।। 17।।
janmotsave samāyātaiḥ pratigataiśca daityakaiḥ ।
bodhitā bhagavadrūpaṃ prati pātālagāśca ye ।। 18।।
mantritā bhayayuktaiste niveditāśca vai tadā ।
bho bho daityeśvarāḥ sarve vitta pṛthvyāṃ mahāprabhuḥ ।। 1 9।।
sarvāvatārahetuśca dhāmnāṃ pare sthitastu yaḥ ।
jagrāha sa ca janmaiva nivāsārthaṃ sadā bhuvi ।।2.5.20।।
asmadbalavināśārthaṃ kāle kāle sa vai hariḥ ।
yatiṣyate dhariṣyati cāvatārān punaḥ punaḥ ।। 21 ।।
asmatkuṭumbanāśaśca tadveśena bhaviṣyati ।
devarakṣāṃ daityanāśaṃ bhūtalādau kariṣyati ।।22।।
sa eva mūlahetuśca sarvā''virbhāvakāraṇam ।
tadvināśe bhavennāśaḥ sadā daityavirodhinām ।।23।।
mūlanāśe kutaḥ śākhāstasmānmūlaṃ nikartayet ।
vidyate bāla evā'yaṃ tāvannikṛntanaṃ bhavet। ।।24।।
rogaḥ śatruranalaśca hantavyā bālataḥ khalu ।
kṛtamūlā durādharṣāstrayo vināśakārakāḥ ।।25।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'smacchatrukāraṇam ।
śatravo nastvavatārāstasya puṃsaḥ parātmanaḥ ।।26।।
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ mūlaṃ cāyaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
pratikalpaṃ bhavatyeva rāmakṛṣṇādikāraṇam ।।27।।
asya nāśe rāmakṛṣṇanṛsiṃhaparśurāmakāḥ ।
hayagrīvo vāmanaśca vāsudevādayastathā ।।28।।
kadāpi na bhaviṣyanti tasmāddhantavya eva saḥ ।
yadyapyamoghasāmarthyo hantavyo'pi na hanyate ।।29।।
tathāpi kṛtayatnānāṃ phalaṃ kiñcid bhavecchubham ।
matvaivaṃ taṃ mārayituṃ kartavyo yatnakastathā ।।2.5.3 0।।
yathā śākhā na jāyeta na naśyed daityamaṇḍalam ।
ityevaṃ kṛtasaṃkalpāḥ kalmaṣaḥ kajjalastathā ।।3 1 ।।
kaccaraśca malaścāpi kardamaḥ kledanastathā ।
mehanaśchikkanaścāpi kṣuvanaḥ pardanastathā ।।32।।
lālano haṃganaścāpi ṣṭhīvano meṣanastathā ।
mardano nodanaścaiva kampanaḥ sphurjathustathā ।।33।।
khañjanaḥ śoṇaghoṇaśca kudarśaśca kucelakaḥ ।
khātanāso durgajaṃgho'raṇyaromā darīśravāḥ ।।34।।
giryaṅguṣṭhau'yutahasto rasātalodarastathā ।
ete cānye mahādaityā mantrayitvā parasparam ।।35।।
yatra paścāt sthito'driḥ raivatastadvivareṇa te ।
āyayuḥ karaśastrāśca sotsāhā yuddhadurmadāḥ ।।36।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sabhayā nirbhayā iva ।
pātālayānayuktāśca śastraśarendrajālinaḥ ।।37।।
māyāmantradaityavidyākṛtasainyātisaṃkulāḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaste paścime'raṇyake'vasan ।।38।।
pracchannāśca samāgatya bālaṃ ghātayituṃ muhuḥ ।
paśyanti sma ca chidrāṇi caturdaśyā niśā''ntare ।।39।।
kokilārūpamāgṛhya kecid ghūkasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
gomāyūrūpamāpannāścānye sārasarūpiṇaḥ ।।2.5.40 ।।
kurarīrūpakāścānye pare mārjārarūpiṇaḥ ।
sarparūpāstathā'nye ca ghorakhananarūpiṇaḥ ।।41 ।।
citraparṇasvarūpāśca cibarīrūpadhāriṇaḥ ।
nakulādisvarūpāśca saramārūpiṇastathā ।।।42।।
kaṃsārikāgṛhagodhādaṃśamaśakarūpiṇaḥ ।
āyayustatra bhagavānanādiśrīpumuttamaḥ ।।।43।।।
sūtikāyā bhavanābhyantare pracchannavartanāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jānāti tānapi ।।44।।
karoti bālavannidrāṃ ṣaṣṭhī jānāti tānapi ।
daṃśamaśakagodhādyā mārjāranāgakukkurāḥ ।।45।।
ṣaṭhyā tatraiva ca hatā rātrau nārāyaṇecchayā ।
mṛtāste tu mṛtā eva manasāyāḥ parākramāt ।।46।।
ghūkakokilagomāyūsārasādyāstu cāmbare ।
āgatā ye hariṃ hantuṃ te'pi ṣaṣṭhyā prabhāritāḥ ।।47।।
anye vilokya tānnaṣṭān rātrāveva tu tacchavān ।
nītvā yayustadāraṇyaṃ yatra teṣāṃ nivāsanam ।।48।।
prātarvai sūtikāgāre cihnāni raktajāni ca ।
dṛṣṭāni tāni saṃśuddhya dine dīpotsave prage ।।49।।
gopālakṛṣṇakādyāśca śāntipāṭhānakārayat ।
atha te duḥkhamāpannā mṛtamitrakuṭumbinaḥ ।।2.5.50 ।।
dīpotsavatitheḥ rātrau samājagmuśca śastriṇaḥ ।
pracchannāḥ śrīprabhuṃ hantumasamarthāstu vai ruṣā ।।।51।।
ninyurdevīṃ manasāṃ tāṃ ṣaṣṭhikāṃ nijaghātinīm ।
sāpi kāntaṃ mahākāntaṃ svāminaṃ śrīpumuttamam ।।52।।
jajāpa hṛdaye tatra nīyamānā mahāsuraiḥ ।
athā'syā vidadhe rakṣāṃ tadātmani sthitaḥ prabhuḥ ।।53 ।।
mahākālā'nalaiśvaryaṃ dāhakaṃ bhasmakārakam ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ mumoca bhagavān tena dagdhāśca te'bhavan ।।54।।
tāṃ devīṃ te samutsṛjya dūraṃ sarve palāyitāḥ ।
tadā devyā svadehādvai devīsainyaṃ prakāśitam ।।।55।।
kanyakānāṃ tu lakṣāṇāṃ sainyaṃ vimānagaṃ tathā ।
haṃsasthānāṃ lakṣasainyaṃ vyāghrasthānāṃ tu koṭikam ।।56।।
siṃhasthānāṃ cārbudaṃ ca śarabhasthaṃ daśā'yutam ।
śaktitomarapāśādiśastrayantrādiśobhitam ।।57।।
asurān hantumevaitāḥ kumāryaścaṇḍavikramāḥ ।
akṣatā'ṅgāstadā śastrairdivyāścakruḥ prayodhanam ।।58।।
tābhistatra mahāraṇye daityeśā bahavo hatāḥ ।
vivare te mṛtāḥ kṣiptā athā'nye daityapuṃgavāḥ ।।59।।
mukhe tṛṇāni saṃgṛhya nemuḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ mahāsatīm ।
śaraṇaṃ te prapannā vai te tadā naiva ghātitāḥ ।।2.5.6 0।।
te tu tatra vane jagmurnatakandharamānasāḥ ।
atha devyaḥ koṭiśastā muhustatra praśaṃsitāḥ ।।61 ।।
ṣaṣṭhyā vijayakāriṇyo varayogyā hariṃ prati ।
ānītā darśitāḥ sarvā bālakṛṣṇāya vai tayā ।।62।।
svāminā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena varadānakam ।
vṛṇutetyabhisaṃproktā vakrastāḥ sarasastaṭe ।।63।।
vāsaṃ sevāṃ tathā muktiṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tathā patim ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha tatastāśca kumārikāḥ ।।64।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cakrurnivāsamanvaham ।
tāsāṃ śrībhagavānnāma dīpāvalītiśobhanam ।।65।।
divyatejomayarūpaṃ cakāra nijayogyakam ।
kṛtvā tāsāṃ ca rūpāṇi dvedhā divyāni dhāmani ।।66।।
preṣayāmāsa cānyāni rarakṣa lomaśā''śrame ।
lomaśarṣirhariṃ prāha natvā'tidayayā muniḥ ।।67।।
etā devyastava patnyo bhaviṣyanti tavecchayā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tiṣṭhantu tā madāśrame ।।68।।
lomaśasyā''śrame tāstu cakrurvāsaṃ praharṣitāḥ ।
dīpotsavaṃ svargatulyaṃ cakrustāstatra cāśrame ।।69।।
athorjaśuklaprathame divase prātareva ha ।
cakrurmahotsavaṃ tatra navānnānāṃ gṛhe gṛhe ।।2.5.70।।
pakvānnāni vicitrāṇi kṛtvā divyasvarūpiṇe ।
arpayāmāsurīśānyo vādyaṃ cakruśca nartanam ।।71 ।।
prasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsuścakruḥ rātrau mahotsavam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamānarcureva tāḥ ।।72।।
rātrau suptāstadā sarve ṣaṣṭhī rakṣati bālakam ।
atha daityāḥ samāyātāḥ punarhantuṃ hariṃ tadā ।।73।।
ṣaṣṭhyā vidrāvitāḥ sarve punastatra harerbalāt ।
atha te sūtakaṃ daityaṃ yayurnītvā nijāśrayam ।।74।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ko'yaṃ vai sūtako daityo yaścā'vartata kutra ca ।
kiṃ jātaṃ ca tataḥ kṛṣṇa! vada kautuhalaṃ hi me ।।75।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
sūtako'yaṃ mahādaityo rādhike'suravaṃśabhūḥ ।
yathotpannaḥ śṛṇu yatra vasatyeṣo varāttathā ।।76।।
purā hiraṇyakūrcasya yuddhaṃ saṃkarṣaṇena tu ।
samaṃ hyabhūt yadā tatra kamalaṃ brahmaṇo muhuḥ ।।77।।
akampata dhṛtaṃ tenā'sureṇa ca tadā hyajaḥ ।
kampamāno'bhavad bhīto brahmaṇo hṛdayāttadā ।।78।।
kampākhyaścā'bhavat putro bhayanāmā dvitīyakaḥ ।
svedanāma tṛtīyaśca śokanāmā caturthakaḥ ।।79।।
vihvalākhyaḥ pañcamaśca hāhākārastu ṣaṣṭhakaḥ ।
nirāśrayaḥ saptamaśca parāyattastathā'ṣṭamaḥ ।।2.5.80।।
ta ete saṃparivṛtya brahmāṇaṃ prāhurīśvarāḥ ।
kathaṃ vayaṃ samutpannāḥ pitastvatto'tra vāridhau ।।81 ।।
vada no'tra tu kartavyaṃ śīghraṃ kurmo'tra tattathā ।
brahmā prāha tadā putrān brahmakūrcaṃ mahāsuram ।।82।।
valgataitadvināśārthaṃ dhairyahīno yato bhavet ।
ityājñaptāstadā putrā drutaṃ gatvā mahāsuram ।।83।।
vavalgurbrahmakūrcaṃ taṃ tadā saṃkarṣaṇāddhi saḥ ।
gadayā mṛtyumāpannastasya dehamalāni tu ।।84।।
niḥsṛtānīndriyebhyaśca māravihvalatāvaśāt ।
vīryamehanajastasya janmākhyaḥ samabhūnnaraḥ ।।85।।
mūtramehanajastasya sūtakākhyo'bhavannaraḥ ।
malāpasaraṇāttasya nidhanākhyo'bhavannaraḥ ।।86।।
karuṇā''krandanāttasya garjanākhyo jale'bhavat ।
pardanācca tadā tasya durgandhākhyo'bhavannaraḥ ।।87।।
kukṣestasyā'bhavadraktanāmā putrastadā'śubhaḥ ।
śavākhyastu ca malinaḥ pūyākhyaśca tato'bhavat ।।88।।
aniṣṭā dhātavaścaite'surā babhūvuruddhatāḥ ।
śubhāstu dhātavastasya kanakānyabhavaṃstadā ।।89।।
ta ete'surato jātāḥ kumārā vai bhayānvitāḥ ।
śaraṇyaṃ śrīmahāsaṃkarṣaṇaṃ nemuśca tuṣṭuvuḥ ।। 2.5.90।।
rakṣa rakṣa mahāvīra sarvasaṃhārakṛdbalin ।
vayaṃ smaste gadāputrā jīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ ।।91।।
tadā saṃkarṣaṇastāँścā'bhayadānaṃ samādadāt ।
vāsasthānaṃ bhojanaṃ cā'rthayadbhyastebhya uttamam ।।92।।
saṃkarṣaṇo dadau janmanarāya divasān daśa ।
yā nārī sūyate tasyā gṛhe tiṣṭhatu sūtakaḥ ।।93।।
raktadurgandhapūyebhyo dadau vāsāya sūtikām ।
janmā ca sūtako rakto durgandho pūya eva te ।।94।।
sahavāsā nivasanti sūtikāyāṃ tataḥ sadā ।
daśāhottaramevaite yānti jālena sāgaram ।।95।।
evaṃ janmasūtakādyā āsurāḥ santi duḥkhadāḥ ।
ayaṃ sūtakanāmā'sau kambharāyā gṛhe tadā ।।96।।
lokarītyā nivāsaṃ cākarod daśadināni vai ।
athā'nye nidhanākhyaśca śavo malinakastathā ।।97।।
āsaiṃstadā'rthayāmāsurnivāsaṃ bhojanādikam ।
saṃkarṣaṇaśca tān sarvān dadau vai mṛtyave tadā ।।98।।
tadā ca kālaputrāya mṛtyuryatra ca tatra te ।
nidhanaśca śavo mṛtyurmalinaḥ sūtakastathā ।।99।।
ete tiṣṭhanti tatraiva yatra kālanideśanam ।
tadete tvāsurāḥ sarve bhayadā duḥkhadāstathā ।। 2.5.10 0।।
athā'nye brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ kampādyāste'pi vai tadā ।
yatra mṛtyuḥ samāyāti tatra gatvā purā hi te ।। 101 ।।
nivasanti śave jāte niḥsaranti tataḥ sthalāt ।
evamete kathitāste sutā pañcatvadāyinaḥ ।। 1 02।।
atha śrāddhākhyapuruṣastatrā'pi brahmaṇā kṛtaḥ ।
yatra vai nidhanaṃ tasya kuṭumbe vāsamācarat ।। 1 03।।
niminā svasya putrasya ātreyasya vināśane ।
śrāddhaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhastato loke sthiro'bhavat ।। 1 04।।
evaṃ rādhe kathitaste sūtakākhyo'suro hyayam ।
vartate sūtikāsaudhe bhrātṛbhiśca samanvitaḥ ।। 1 05।।
tamenaṃ sūtakaṃ kṛṣṇagṛhe sthitaṃ tu daityakāḥ ।
ninyuḥ śibiraṃ naijaṃ ca daśame divase balāt ।। 1 06।।
śrīhareste vināśārthaṃ mantrayāmāsurugrajāḥ ।
ājñāṃ cakruḥ sūtake te śīghramānaya bālakam ।। 1 07।।
pātālaṃ saṃpravekṣyāmo nītvā taṃ śrīhariṃ prabhum ।
tatraiva mārayiṣyāmo ghātayiṣyāma ātmataḥ ।। 1 08।।
anyathā ghātayiṣyāmastvāmeva sūtakottama ।
yāhi śīghraṃ kuru kāryaṃ rātrau bālaṃ samānaya ।। 1 09।।
daityānāṃ tu ca sāhāyyaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ vṛṣastava ।
ityuktaḥ sa sūtakaśca sūtikāgṛhamāgataḥ ।। 2.5.11 0।।
ardharātre vyatīte ca nidrāṃ yātaḥ sakhījanaḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhī cāpi kṣaṇaṃ tatra yoganidrāmavāpa ha ।। 111 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmīcchayā tu saḥ ।
sūtakaḥ śrīhariṃ śayyāsthānājjahāra tāmase ।। 112।।
andhakāre nināyainaṃ śiviraṃ daityavāsitam ।
daityā jahṛṣurbahudhā cakruḥ kilakilāyitam ।। 1 13।।
utthāpya śibiraṃ sarvaṃ yayuḥ pātālamākṣaṇāt ।
mārayituṃ ca te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।। 1 14।।
ninyurghātakaśālāṃ ca tāvad yamādhipasya yaḥ ।
śrāvaṇākhyo mahādūtaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvago'tidṛk ।। 1 15।।
śeṣanārāyaṇāyaitad vijñāpayitumāgataḥ ।
nāthanātha jagannātha jagadādhāra keśava ।। 1 16।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo daityairvihanyate ।
pātāle bālako nīto ghātakīkuṭikāṃ pratiṃ ।। 1 17।।
rakṣa rakṣa mahārāja sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
evaṃ vijñāpito devo kṣīrode śeṣaśāyanaḥ ।। 1 18।।
tūrṇaṃ kṣaṇācca pātāle sa cakrabalavāhanaḥ ।
samāyātastadā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ tīvraṃ pratāpavān ।। 1 19।।
dhmāyamānena śaṃkhena kṛtaśabdaistadā striyaḥ ।
garbhānamuñcan daityānāṃ karṇasphoṭāstathā'bhavan ।। 2.5.120।।
nāgāḥ sarve ca śeṣeṇa militā raṇagāminaḥ ।
daityairyuddhaṃ tadā kartuṃ niryayurdhṛtasādhanāḥ ।। 121 ।।
daityā api tadā bālaṃ tyaktvā yoddhaṃ+u samāgatāḥ ।
sūtako rakṣati bālaṃ bālabhakto dayāvaśaḥ ।। 1 22।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'gre lakṣmīḥ sudarśanaṃ tathā ।
garuḍo nandasunandau pārṣadā pārvatī prabhā ।। 123 ।।
rādhā ramā ca māṇikyā mañjū haṃsā tathā'parāḥ ।
saguṇā lalitā muktā jayā haimī ca devikā ।। 124।।
dayā campā mauktikā ca śāntiḥ śāntā manustathā ।
anyāḥ sakhyastathā muktāḥ śrutvā śaṃkhaninādanam ।। 125।।
āyayustatra pātāle yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
sūtako dīnavajjātastvaparādhakaro yataḥ ।। 1 26।।
kintu rakṣati saṃchanno yato bhakto harerhi saḥ ।
prasahya daityabhītestu nītavānna nijecchayā ।। 1 27।।
tenā'yaṃ rakṣitastatra pumuttamena līlayā ।
icchā'pyevaṃ harerāsīt kastāṃ vārayituṃ kṣamāḥ ।। 1 28।।
sūtakena ca pṛṣṭhena kathitaṃ haraṇaṃ yathā ।
kṛtaṃ surakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyādyāstena toṣitāḥ ।। 129।।
dhanyavādṃ dadustasya kāntaṃ cāṃ'ke dadhustadā ।
sevayāmāsurevainaṃ rātrau kṣaṇāntare tadā ।। 2.5.13 0।।
daityānāṃ śeṣanāthena yuddhaṃ cā'bhūdbhayānakam ।
cakreṇa bheditā daityā anutthānapunarbhavāḥ ।। 131 ।।
mṛtā ye te gatāḥ sarve tvaindrajālikayā saha ।
yamarājapuraṃ prāptāḥ śeṣāḥ sarve palāyitāḥ ।। 132।।
sūtakaśca hariṃ nītvā sahalakṣmyādibhiryayau ।
yatra śeṣapriyo nātho viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 13 2।।।
dadau nārāyaṇāya śrīviṣṇave bālakaṃ prabhum ।
śeṣanātho yayau natvā kṣīrodaṃ ca ramādikāḥ ।। 1 34।।
sūtakena saha jagmuḥ sūtikābhūtalagṛham ।
tāvatprātaḥ prasañjātaṃ jaguśca kṛkavākavaḥ ।। 1 35।।
nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca bubudhurbālaṃ hariṃ tu nidritam ।
bodhayāmāsurevaite mātrādyāḥ parameśvaram ।। 1 36।।
naiva jānanti te kṛṣṇacaritraṃ rātrijaṃ yataḥ ।
lakṣmyā niveditaṃ sarvaṃ sūtakasya ca vartanam ।। 137।।
tadā śāntiprapāṭhāँśca kārayāmāsa vai pitā ।
putraṃ punarnavaṃ jātamamanyanta kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 1 38।।
sūtakāya ca bhaktāya dine tvekādaśe prage ।
varaṃ dadau hi bhagavān divyāṃ pūjāṃ sulapsyase ।। 139।।
ekādaśe dine tvāṃ vai lokā divyaviśeṣakaiḥ ।
snānapānasubhojyādyaistoṣayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ ।। 2.5.140।।
divyo mama kathākāraḥ sūtarūpo bhaviṣyasi ।
yatrā'haṃ tatra te vāso'nyarūpeṇa bhaviṣyati ।। 141।।
sarvaprajāsu te vāso bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
vilayaṃ yāsyati te'dyadinādāsurabhāvanam ।। 142।।
ityuktaḥ so'bhavad bhaktaḥ sūtako'pi harervaśaḥ ।
sūtatāṃ ca gato gāthāḥ śrāvayan mokṣado'pi ca ।। 143।।
ityevaṃ kathito rādhe camatkāro hareryathā ।
daśame divase jāto nāmakarma vadāmi te ।। 144।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālarūpaprabhoḥ ṣaṣṭhīkṛtarakṣaṇaṃ, daityaiḥ kṛtaṃ pātāle sūtakapūruṣadvārā'paharaṇaṃ, sūtakādyutpattiḥ, śeṣanārāyaṇakṛtarakṣaṇaṃ, sūtakasya bhaktatvaṃ, sūtatvaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 5 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 005 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 6
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 007 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
prāpte tvekādaśe cāhni lomaśādyā maharṣayaḥ ।। 1 ।।
śīlavratāḥ sādhavaśca brahmavidyāparā janāḥ ।
pitrā''hūtā āyayuste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagṛham ।। 2 ।।
nāmakaraṇasaṃskāraṃ cakruste tu vidhānataḥ ।
ādyaṃ grahārcanaṃ cakrurdevatāpūjanādikam ।। 3 ।।
gāṇeśārcanamīśādipūjanaṃ cakrurādarāt ।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ cārṣaṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ।। 4 ।।
ūrjā'ṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe mithune candrake sthitau ।
janmā'sya tena nāmā'sya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti hi ।। 5 ।।
yasya nā''dirnacaivā'nto'nādinārāyaṇastataḥ ।
avatārapatiḥ so'yamavatārī nigadyate ।। 6 ।।
sarvaduḥkhaharaścā'yaṃ harirityabhidhīyate ।
duḥkhānāṃ karṣaṇāt kṛṣṇo narasthatvānnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
nārastho'sti yataścā'yaṃ nārāyaṇo'pi gadyate ।
akṣarādhipatiścā'yamakṣarātīta ucyate ।। 8 ।।
puruṣeṣūttamaścāyaṃ puruṣottama ucyate ।
puṃsāmuttama evā'yaṃ pumuttamaḥ sadocyate ।। 9 ।।
bṛhatvād vyāpakatvācca paratvāt sarvatastathā ।
parabrahmetyabhidhānaṃ kṛṣṇavallabhate yataḥ ।। 2.6.1 0।।
śriyā juṣṭaḥ sadā tasmācchrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ svayam ।
īśvarāṇāmīśvaro'sti parameśvara ucyate ।। 1 1।।
māyānāmīśvaraścāyaṃ dhavo mādhava ucyate ।
sarvātmanāmataṃ svāmī svāminārāyaṇo yataḥ ।। 12।।
ghanaśyāmastathā chatraśālyācāryo'sti sarvadā ।
jayāramālalitāmāṇikyālakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
prabhāpāravatīmaṃjūhaṃsāsaguṇikāpatiḥ ।। 13 ।।
dvādaśottaraśatasurājñīnāṃ parameśitā ।
anyāsāṃ koṭyarbudānāṃ patiścāyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 14।।
asya haste dhanurmatsyo dhvajaḥ svastirvirājate ।
vajraṃ śarastriśūlaṃ ca pādayoḥ śikharādikam ।। 15।।
ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca cihnānāṃ rekhāḥ santi śubhāḥ sphuṭāḥ ।
lalāṭe kānakī rekhā tilakasya virājate ।। 16।।
netrakoṇeṣu ca raktā rekhāḥ santi vimohikāḥ ।
ākarṇānte tathā netre candrakoṭyānanojjvalaḥ ।। 17।।
oṣṭhau svabhāvato raktau kaṇṭhe tilaśca vartate ।
vakṣasi cāsya romṇāṃ ca dakṣāvarto'pi vartate ।। 18।।
kānakī ca śubhā lakṣmīrekhā maṇipralekhikā ।
asūtrahāraḥ sauvarṇo vartate hṛdaye'sya ca ।। 19।।
nakhāścandrasamāḥ santi karapādatalāni tu ।
padmagarbhanibhānyeva catuścakrāṇi santi ca ।।2.6.20।।
śaṃkhacihnaṃ svakaṃ cāsya vartate śobhanaṃ hareḥ ।
sakthimūle kṣatacihaṃ vartate vāmasaṃjñite ।।2 1।।
vāmajānvopari sakthni pāṇḍuraścandramā api ।
vartate koṭipatnīnāṃ svāmitvabodhako hi saḥ ।।22।।
jaghane nābhyadhobhāge strīcihnaṃ cāsya vartate ।
ardhanārīśvaraścāyaṃ patipatnīsvarūpavān ।।23।।
ājānulambabhūjau ca vartate'sya prabhostathā ।
ghūṭikātrayamastasya pratyeke caraṇe'sti vai ।। 24।।
dakṣiṇe sakthini madhye rathacihnaṃ hi vartate ।
garuḍastiṣṭhati tatra rekhayā'to narāyaṇaḥ ।।25।।
sahasrabhujavānnā'yaṃ bhavatyeva pareśvaraḥ ।
liṃge cāsyopari cāste tilaḥ kṛṣṇo hi pārśvake ।।26।।
vāme sakthimūlake ca tato'sau vīryavān bahu ।
catvāraścāsya vṛṣaṇā dvau pārśve dvāvadhaḥsthitau ।।27।।
tato'sau koṭinārīṇāṃ tṛptido'skhalito balī ।
asyodare tu nābhervai hyupari kuṃbhalekhikā ।।28।।
vidyate kuṃbhavad rekhā prāṇāyāmanirodhikā ।
tato'sau yogirāṭ naikarūpadhārī bhavedapi ।।29।।
netre'sya cāndhakāre'pi sūryavattu prakāśate ।
tato'sau divyadarśī ca vartate parameśvaraḥ ।।2.6.30।।
jihvāgraṃ raktamasyā'sti liṃgāgraṃ raktamityapi ।
aṃgulyagrāṇi raktāni vidyante'sya svabhāvataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tataścāyaṃ bhaved rājādhirājaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
romāgrāṇi svarṇavarṇasamānāni laghūni ca ।।32।।
prakāśante cāndhakāre vidyullatā yathā sthitāḥ ।
tato'sau paradhāmastho bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।33।।
danteṣvasya ca dhāvalyaṃ camatkṛtikaraṃ tathā ।
kāntipradaṃ ca hāsyādau dṛśyate'to narāyaṇaḥ ।।34।।
paśya gopālakṛṣṇa'sya bāhvormūle karāvubhau ।
svarṇarekhāmayau divyau rājete'to narāyaṇaḥ ।।35।।
ujjvalā trivalī cāsya madhyanābhau pravartate ।
lalāṭaṃ connataṃ netre dīrghe nāsāgravakratā ।। 36 ।।
vidyate dantakalikāḥ samānāḥ pūrṇasaṃkhyayā ।
sugandhaścāsya ca pārijātakusumavat sadā ।।37।।
mūrtau saṃvartate śvāse kaisaro vāsa ityapi ।
svede śaityaṃ ca dhāvalyaṃ nairmalyaṃ ca sugandhitā ।।38।।
mehanādāvapi cāsya daurgandhyaṃ na manāgapi ।
aujjvalyaṃ cāntare bhāge kukṣau kukṣau ca raktatā ।।39।।
śyāmatā romamadhyeṣu kṛṣṇatā mūlakeṣu ca ।
vakratā nāḍikāḥ śyāmā raktāḥ piśaṃgikāstathā ।। 2.6.40 ।।
marmāṇi dhavalānyasya ramyatā ca manoharā ।
sthalapadmasamaṃ cāsya saukumāryaṃ pravidyate ।।41 ।।
vāṇī vedamayī gītiḥ svarā ghoṣāśca śāradāḥ ।
sarvajñānanidhiścāyaṃ paramātmā pareśvaraḥ ।।42।।
nāmānyasya tvanantāni guṇāścā'saṃkhyakāstathā ।
aiśvaryāṇyapyanantāni gaṇanārahitāni vai ।।43 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'yaṃ sarvadā bhuvi ।
khyātimāpsyati ṛṣibhiḥ saṃhitābhiśca sarvathā ।।44।।
kathābhirbahubhiścāpi patnīnāṃ cārbudaistathā ।
avatārairanekaiśca kāryaiścamatkaraistathā ।। 45।।
evamuktvā virarāma lomaśo munisattamaḥ ।
ṛṣayo'pi tadā cānye śubhāśīrvādamādaduḥ ।।46।।
kumārikā api kāntaṃ sevayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
atha nāmāni ca pitā śrāvayāmāsa cā'cyutam ।।47।।
vādyāni vādayāmāsurgāpayāmāsuruttamāḥ ।
gītikā nartayāmāsurnṛtyavetryaḥ satālikāḥ ।।48।।
vardhayāmāsurāśīrbhirdevyaḥ sarvabhuvāṃ tadā ।
ramayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kṛṣṇanāmamahotsave ।।49।।
prajā janāśca bhojyāni bhojayāmāsuratyati ।
dadau dānāni ca tadā śrīmān gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।2.6.50 ।।
pūjayāmāsurīśāścā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
upāyanāni ca daduḥ svargadhāmā'bhijāni ca ।।51 ।।
evaṃ nāmavidhaṃ kṛtvā lomaśādyā yayurgṛhān ।
devāḥ sarve yathāsthānaṃ yayuḥ prajājanā yayuḥ ।।52 ।।
śṛṇvatra rādhike nāmamahotsave'suro mahān ।
draṣṭuṃ devaṃ samāyāto vyāghrāraṇyanivāsakṛt ।।53।।
sāṇanāmā'suro girergahvare kṛtaketanaḥ ।
yatra sāṇo vasatyeva girayo'pi tadā ca te ।।54।।
sāṇasya girayaścaivaṃ khyātimāptāstadā'bhavan ।
sāṇo'yaṃ tu purotpanno hiraṇyāṇḍasya mehataḥ ।।55।।
asurasya mṛteḥ kāle saṃkarṣaṇasamīpataḥ ।
sa ca vilokya saṃhārakāraṇaṃ karṣaṇaṃ balam ।।56।।
tuṣṭāva bhayasampannaḥ śaraṇaṃ samiyeṣa ca ।
tadā saṃkarṣaṇastaṃ tu jīvanaṃ dānamādadau ।।57।।
sāṇaḥ pṛthvīṃ khaṇḍabhūtāṃ viyuktāṃ ca vilokya vai ।
tatra vāsaṃ tadā kartuṃ cāyayau samaraṇyakam ।।58।।
araṇyaṃ cāyataṃ vṛkṣān nibiḍān śatayojanam ।
vīkṣya tatra śatakrośakṣitau parvatakocchrayān ।।।59।।।
sāṇaścakāra vasatiṃ cāsurastatra nirbhayaḥ ।
sa ca tatra samāyāto nāmasaṃskārake dine ।।2.6.6 0।।
yatrā'nādiḥ prabhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gṛhe'sti vai ।
sāṇo viprasvarūpeṇa cāgatya prāpya bhojanam ।।6 1।।
dakṣiṇāṃ vividhāṃ nītvā yayau sāṇādrigahvaram ।
dvādaśe divase tasya matirjātā'titāmasī ।।62।।
sasmāra pitṛvairaṃ ca mārakaṃ bālakaṃ ca tam ।
saṃkarṣaṇātmakaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ niścitya mādhavam ।।63 ।।
astraśastrāṇi nītvaiva sannaddhaścāgato'suraḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ nāśayituṃ rādhe vairiṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam ।।64।।
divā vipro hi sa bhūtvā'tithirūpeṇa vartate ।
mārgayan hartumevainaṃ chidraṃ dine na labdhavān ।।65।।
ṣaṣṭhīkanyāḥ kumāryastāḥ saṃbhūya kāntamacyutam ।
rāmayanti ramayanti ramante smā'virāmataḥ ।।66।।
rātrau tāstaṃ vihāyaiva lomaśasyā''śramaṃ yayuḥ ।
tadā chidraṃ paraṃ prāpya vyāghrarūpadharo'suraḥ ।।67।।
rātryardhe vigate bālaṃ bhakṣituṃ krūrarūpavān ।
krūrakarmā krūranetraḥ krūrarāvo'bhavatkṣaṇam ।।68।।
sūtikāgṛhamāgatya garjanāṃ pracakāra ha ।
cakārā'nyā garjanāśca vanaṃ kampayutaṃ tadā ।।69।।
bhūḥ sarvā kampitā lokāstrāsaṃ yayuśca vihvalāḥ ।
mātā ca vihvalā trastā pitā bhītiṃ jagāma ha ।।2.6.70।।
janā vyāghrabhayāttatra nililyuśca gṛheṣvapi ।
hāhāvyākrośa evā''sīt kṛṣṇaśayyāsthale tadā ।।71 ।।
aho vyāghro vanād yāto mṛtyurūpo'rbhakasya vai ।
rakṣantu devatā devaṃ devyaśceti jagurjanāḥ ।।72।।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rakṣantu rakṣakāḥ ।
iti mātā'vadattatra sākrośaṃ vai muhurmuhuḥ ।।73 ।।
vyāghrastāvatsamutplutya sūtikāśayanaṃ dadau ।
bālaṃ kareṇa jighṛkṣuryāvad yatate śvāpadaḥ ।।74।।
tāvat kṛṣṇo'bhavattatra kiśoraḥ sasudarśanaḥ ।
mātā mūrchāṃ gatā vīkṣya matvā vyāghrahṛtaṃ sutam ।।75।।।
sudarśanaṃ paraṃ cakraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।
aṅgulimadhyato muktaṃ vahnivyāptaṃ mahojjvalam ।।76 ।।
bhramatsahasrārayukta śatasūryātiśāyi tat ।
tadā cogramabhūd vyagraṃ yāvad vyāghraṃ jighāṃsati ।।77।।
tāvanmṛtyubhayād vyāghraḥ samutplutya gṛhād bahiḥ ।
vinipatya pradudrāvā'raṇyaṃ jīvitumutsukaḥ ।।78।।
cakraṃ pṛṣṭhe tasya lagnaṃ taṃ dadāha punaḥ punaḥ ।
kvacitkvacit pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ spṛṣṭvā cakarta bhāgataḥ ।।79।।
vyāghro nihanyamāno'sau plavate smāti vegataḥ ।
ākrośati sma dīnārto vācā bhībhṛtayā tadā ।।2.6.80।।
krośamātraṃ gato yāvad dakṣiṇāṃ diśameva saḥ ।
sudarśanena nihataḥ sāṇaḥ savyāghradehabhṛt ।।8 1।।
vyāghrahaṇaṃ ca tattīrthaṃ sudarśanakṛtaṃ sthalam ।
prakhyātaṃ kuṃkumavāpyā dakṣiṇe'śvasarovarāt ।।82।।
sāṇo naṣṭo yojanocchraṃ śarīraṃ prājvalattadā ।
sudarśanāgninā bhasma jātaṃ puṇyena tena vai ।।83।।
sāṇātmā tadvinirgatya bhūtvā caturbhujastadā ।
divyo vai pārṣado bhakto dhautātmā pāpavarjitaḥ ।।84।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetimukhato vadan ।
sudarśanasya vaśago'nādikṛṣṇaṃ prati drutam ।।85।।
vyomnā samājagāmātha prabhau vilīnatāṃ gataḥ ।
athā'kṣarasya muktāstaṃ netuṃ vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।।86।।
āyayuḥ śrīhareḥ kṣetre tadā'yaṃ kṛṣṇamūrtitaḥ ।
vinirgatya yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ sāṇastu śāśvatam ।।87।।
sudarśanaṃ tadā śāntaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgulau layaṃ gatam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'pi nidritaḥ sukham ।।88।।
anye mātrādayo yoganidrāṃ kṛtvā prage tadā ।
vighnaśāntikriyāṃ cakrurlomaśādyā apīśvarāḥ ।।89।।
vyāghrāsuro hataśceti śrutvā niścikyurīśvaram ।
sādhāraṇā janā bālaṃ devāścakruḥ prapūjanam ।।2.6.90।।
śrutvā ca kanyakāḥ sarvā rurudurvighnamulbaṇam ।
rakṣaṇaṃ ca balaṃ śrutvā jahṛṣuścāgatāḥ puraḥ ।।91 ।।
darśanaṃ ca samācakruḥ kāntasyā'tīva bhāvataḥ ।
śubhāśiṣaḥ pradaduśca menire navamāgatam ।।92।।
pitā vighnasya śāntyarthaṃ homaṃ japaṃ cakāra ha ।
sādhvādīṃstarpayāmāsa bhojyānnapānasaddhanaiḥ ।।93।।
vastrabhūṣādidānāni kanyakābhyo dadau satī ।
gobhyo dadau ca ghāsāni miṣṭānnānyapi bhūriśaḥ ।।94।।
pipīlikādisūkṣmebhyaḥ piṣṭakaṇādikaṃ dadau ।
evaṃ śāntiṃ kārayitvā ramayāmāsa mādhavam ।।95।।
mātā pitā tathā cānyavargaḥ kumārikāgaṇaḥ ।
ityetat kathitaṃ rādhe bālakṛṣṇaparākramam ।।96।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi mokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ param ।
putradaṃ dhanadaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ rogavināśakam ।।97।।
śokavighnaharaṃ ramyaṃ rakṣākarasukhāvaham ।
nārīṇāṃ śokaharaṇaṃ śubhaṃ saubhāgyavardhanam ।। 98।।
avaidhavyakaraṃ kṛṣṇacaritraṃ pāvanottamam ।
śrotavyaṃ satataṃ caitadaiśvaryārthibhirādarāt ।।99।।
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare śroturupatiṣṭhanti siddhayaḥ ।
aṇimādyā divyaguṇā divyāḥ samṛddhayastathā ।। 2.6.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne parameśvarasya nāmakaraṇasaṃskāravidhiḥ, sāṇā'surasya vyāghrarūpadharasya hariṃ hantumicchataścakreṇa vināśanaṃ śāntikaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 6 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 006 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 7
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 008 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe kṛṣṇakāntasya cādbhutam ।
camatkāraṃ dvādaśe'hni preṃkhāyāṃ yo vyajāyata ।। 1 ।।
gopālakṛṣṇako devo nāmakaraṇake dine ।
putrasyārthe śubhāṃ dolāṃ kārayāmāsa candanaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
mṛdulāṃ śāyanīṃ śayyāṃ klṛptayāmāsa tatra ca ।
sadratnasāramauktikahīrakādisamañcitām ।। 3 ।।
svarṇadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ dhāmacitrāpyalaṃkṛtām ।
svarṇamayūrakīrādyaiḥ śobhitāṃ sucatuṣpadām ।। 4 ।।
caturgāruḍamūrtisthāṃ caturhaṃsamukheṣu ca ।
hīrasūtrālambitāṃ ca mauktikadaṇḍikāśritām ।। 5 ।।
sukhasparśakusumānāṃ divyavallīcatuṣṭayām ।
pīyūṣakiraṇasrāvimadhyavitānachatritām ।। 6 ।।
naisargā'nilayogena veṇugītimanoharām ।
vinaivākarṣaṇaṃ bālecchayā rakṣitasañcarām ।। 7 ।।
kvacidvyomni kvacidbhūmau kvacinnimnāṃ kṣitispṛśām ।
kvacidūrdhvāṃ ca dhavalāṃ kvacitsuvarṇarūpiṇīm ।। 8 ।।
kvacidāndolanaṃ yāti kvacit svabhāvataḥ sthirā ।
kāmāvasāyitāyuktāṃ prāptisiddhisamanvitām ।। 9 ।।
evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ dolāmupaskaravilāsitām ।
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya kārayāmāsa vai pitā ।। 2.7.1 0।।
nāmavidhānadivase kṣaṇe śreṣṭhe hariṃ sutam ।
preṃkhāmārohayanyātā putraṃ prākśirasaṃ prabhum ।। 11 ।।
śobhitāyāṃ tu dolāyāmasvāpayatpumuttamam ।
atha dolā nūtanāśca devā nītvā samāyayuḥ ।। 12।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śayanāya vai ।
rādhe yayitha tatra tvaṃ preṃkhāṃ golokajāṃ parām ।। 13।।
divyāṃ nītvā mahāmūlyāṃ vimānavaraśobhitām ।
lakṣmīstatrā''jagāmā'pi preṃkhāṃ vaikuṇṭhajāṃ śubhām ।। 14।।
divyāṃ vibhūtitattvāḍhyāṃ vyomamārgasthirāṃ parām ।
akṣarasya tathā patnyaḥ preṃkhāṃ paramaśobhanām ।। 15।।
divyasiṃhāsanākārāṃ samādāya dadustadā ।
īśvaryaśca mahāviṣṇuvairājapatnikāstathā ।। 16।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ patnyo vai divyaśobhanāḥ ।
preṃkhā dadurhi vividhā bālakṛṣṇāya tāḥ striyaḥ ।। 17।।
catuṣkoṇā vartulāśca kamalākāranirmitāḥ ।
matsyākārāḥ kūrmākārāḥ śaṃkhākārāstathā śubhāḥ ।। 18।।
hastyākārā ghoṭikāśca paryaṃkikāśca khaṭvikāḥ ।
dolākārāścaikastambhā dvistambhā bahupādikāḥ ।। 19।।
cakrādhārāḥ padādhārā dāravīḥ svarṇanimitāḥ ।
rājatīstaijasīścāpi cāndrīrmāṇikyamauktikīḥ ।।2.7.20।।
śacī tatra samāyātā caikaśṛṃkhalayā'nvitām ।
dhruvākarṣaṇakādhārā'ntarīkṣasthāyinīṃ śubhām ।।21।।
āndolanikāṃ nītvaiva vajrasāramayīṃ parām ।
dadau ca kambharādevyai pārijātasugandhinīm ।।22।।
amṛtasrāviṇīṃ bhadrāṃ vimānavad vihāriṇīm ।
tārā ca rohiṇī menā siddhirvasundharā satī ।।23।।
vividhāścānayāmāsuḥ preṃkhāḥ kṛṣṇamanoharāḥ ।
divyadravyasamopetā divyasaṃkalpajāstathā ।।24।।
yatraikaike pradeśe vai svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhamityapi ।
golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma dṛśyate bhūmimaṇḍalam ।।25।।
yatraikaikamaṇau tatra sasāgaravanānvitā ।
kṣitiḥ sandṛśyate tatra mervādyāḥ parvatāstathā ।।26।।
kvacinmaṇau tadā sūryaḥ kvacinmaṇau sudhākaraḥ ।
kvacid vibhāvasurbhāti kvacid vilokyate divam ।।27।।
kvacid vilokyate satyaloko brahmasabhā tathā ।
kutracittu maṇau tatrā''lokyate gopikāgaṇaḥ ।।28।।
kutracid dṛśyate tatra viśālaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।
kutracicca maṇau vilokyate sāgarasaptakam ।।29।।
araṇyāni vilokyante maṇyantare tathā pare ।
maṇau cālokyate śubhraṃ nandanaṃ ca vanaṃ mahat ।।2.7.3 0।।
pātālāni vilokyante cānyeṣu maṇiṣu priye ।
kutracit kṣīravārdhiśca kutracinnāgamaṇḍalam ।।3 1 ।।
vimānāni vilokyante sarvaṃ devagṛhādikam ।
kutracid dṛśyate dvādaśādhikaṃ śatamuttamam ।।22।।
paradhāmasthapatnīnāṃ nijasevāparāyaṇam ।
saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ dhruvamaṇḍalaṃ ca grahādikam ।।33।।
āścaryāṇi vilokyante hīrakeṣu tu keṣucit। ।
udyānāni vilokyante keṣucid vimalāni vai ।।34।।
ityevaṃ divyatāyuktapreṃkhāścādāya yoṣitaḥ ।
samāyātā dadustāśca bālakṛṣṇārthameva tāḥ ।।35।।
cāraṇyaścāpi gāndharvyaḥ kinnaryaścāpi kanyakāḥ ।
nṛtyagītiparāḥ kṛṣṇapreṅkhādānārthamāyayuḥ ।। 36।।
kambharāyai dadustāśca gopyo daduśca khaṭvikāḥ ।
mānavyo'pi dadustasyai samāndolanaghoṭikāḥ ।।।37।।
hīraraśmisamāyuktāḥ kiṃkiṇījālarāvitāḥ ।
vādyamiṣṭasvaraśrāvāḥ vastragranthanakāritāḥ ।। 38।।
evamāsādya sā mātā prasannā'ti babhūva ha ।
kṛṣṇastāsu ca sarvāsu yugapatkṛtaketanaḥ ।।39।।
yāvatsaṃkhyāśca tā dolāstāvadrūpadharo hariḥ ।
bālarūpaḥ svayamāndolanaṃ cakre hasan muhuḥ ।।2.7.40।।
dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ camatkāraṃ mahāścaryaplutāḥ striyaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā dadhyū rūpaṃ patiṃ prabhum ।।41।।
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmānanādirbhagavānayam ।
sarvāsāṃ kāmanāpūrṇakaraḥ kā citratā'tra vai ।।42।।
tadā taṃ paramabrahma dṛṣṭvā tejasvinaṃ harim ।
premapūrṇahṛdayāstāḥ svasvapālanagaṃ prabhum ।।43।।
āndelayitvā gṛhṇanti yāvad rāmayituṃ harim ।
tāvad dolānaddhamaṇiṣvanekarūpatāṃ gataḥ ।।44।।
pratyekāyāṃ ca dolāyāṃ bahurūpamayaṃ prabhum ।
vilokya yāvad gṛhṇāti pratibimbaṃ ca tad bhavet ।।45।।
naiva hastagataḥ kṛṣṇo bhavatyāścaryakārakaḥ ।
tadā nivṛttimāpannā jaḍeva tiṣṭhati priyā ।।46 ।।
evaṃ sarvāsu dolāsu bahurūpaṃ hariṃ ca tāḥ ।
agṛhṇantyo'bhavanmugdhāḥ kathaṃ kṛṣṇo na labhyate ।।47।।
tadā tu lalitā lakṣmīḥ prabhā pāravatī jayā ।
māṇikyā nityayoginyastāsāṃ pratyayahetave ।।48।।
sarvābhyaḥ prāha śṛṇuta bhaginyaḥ satyamādhavam ।
grahītuṃ cecchatha yadi vadāma pratyayaṃ hareḥ ।।49।।
tasya dakṣe kare santi mīnaśūladhanurdhvajāḥ ।
bimbe dakṣakare te syuḥ pratibimbe tu vāmake ।।2.7.50।।
sacihnaṃ vāmahastaṃ mā spṛśata pratibimbakam ।
sacihnadakṣahastaṃ taṃ gṛhṇata śrīharim ṛtam ।।51।।
ityuktāstāstathā dhṛtvā samuttolya pareśvaram ।
hasanti hāsayanti śrīkāntaṃ kaṭyāṃ niṣādya ca ।।52।।।
cūmbayitvā prabhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālaṃ kāntaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
karatalayordolāvat kṛtvā tvāndolanaṃ muhuḥ ।।53 ।।
utkṣepayitvā gṛhṇanti rāmayanti sma tatparāḥ ।
evamānandamāsādya cakrurdolāgataṃ harim ।।54 ।।
tāvadrūpāṇi saṃhṛtya tvekarūpo'bhavatprabhuḥ ।
riktā dolāśca yā jātāstāśca tābhyaḥ prasādajāḥ ।।55।।
kambharāśrīrdadau sarvāḥ pratyarpaṇavidhānataḥ ।
ekā preṃkhā'kṣararūpā gopālakṛṣṇakāritā ।।56।।
bālayuktā śiṣyate sma cāndanī dāravī śubhā ।
tāstu prasādarūpāśca divyāḥ preṃkhāḥ supāvanīḥ ।।57।।
gṛhītvā kanyakā devya īśānyo harṣamāgatāḥ ।
athaikā taladaityasya siṃhāraṇyanivāsinaḥ ।।।58।।
putrī kanyā talājākhyā talaparvatavāsinī ।
āgatā cotsavaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā rūpadvayaṃ tadā ।।59।।
ekā sā kanyakārūpā yathendrasya kumārikā ।
sarvāvayavaśobhāḍhyā divyarūpavilāsinī ।।2.7.6 0।।
sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃśobhatsvarṇavastrādidhāriṇī ।
divyahastisamārūḍhā divyāmbālikasaṃsthitā ।।6 1 ।।
dvitīyaṃ cākarod rūpaṃ dolākhyaṃ bahuhīrakam ।
bahucitrasamāyuktaṃ bahuratnasumauktikam ।।62।।
asaṃkhyamālikāhāraśakuntavrātaśobhitam ।
antarīkṣagatau dīpau vidyete cordhvayāyinau ।।6 3 ।।
tadādhārā ca sā preṃkhā nirādhārā'ntarīkṣagā ।
dīpoṣmakṛtasañcārā divyakauśeyagendukā ।।64।।
evaṃvidhā ca kamalapuṣpākārā suvartulā ।
madhyaklṛptasuśayanā komalā kṣīravarṇagā ।।65।।
talājayā'vatīryaiva hastito bhūtalaṃ prati ।
vyomacārā tu sā dolā śanaiśca karaceṣṭayā ।।66 ।।
apyavatāritā bhūmau tathāpi sā tadā'mbare ।
hastamātraṃ bhuvastūrdhvaṃ sthirā'bhavanna bhūgatā ।।67।।
evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ dolāṃ dṛṣṭvā devastriyastadā ।
mumuhuśca jahṛṣuśca praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।68।।
talājā tu hariṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumā'kṣatapūjitam ।
arpayāmāsa dolāyāṃ kambharāsannidhau sthitā ।। 6 9।।
hariṃ ca cāndanīdolāsuptaṃ dhṛtvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
svadolāyāṃ dhṛtavatī manomālinyasaṃbhṛtā ।।2.7.7 0 । ।
talena preṣitā śatruṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mārayituṃ tathā ।
tādṛgrūpadharā duṣṭā preṃkhāsthaṃ bālakaṃ śanaiḥ ।।7 1 ।।
uttolya vyomamārgeṇa śīghraṃ dudrāva cāmbare ।
aṣṭayojanadūraṃ sā gatā'raṇyaṃ nijāśramam । ।72 । ।
hariṇaiṣā ca viditā hantumicchāvatī tadā ।
talājāyā gahvare sa prabhuścaturbhujo'bhavat ।।73 ।।
dvitīyaṃ bālarūpaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikāgatām ।
āśritya cāndanīṃ dolāṃ vartate cetyadarśayat ।।74।।
tatra devyo rāmayanti dolāyāṃ parameśvaram ।
yato nā'sāṃ bhavecchokaḥ preṃkhotsave tathā'karot ।।75 । ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo'pi bālarūpavān ।
atyujjvalaḥ sa bhagavān hāsayāmāsa rākṣasīm ।।76 ।।
hāsyairvividhaiśceṣṭābhirbālakampanakaistadā ।
candratulyaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā sā tu mumoha rākṣasīm ।।77।।
mārayituṃ mayā''nīto bālo'yaṃ komalāṃgakaḥ ।
kathamenaṃ mārayāmi rāmayituṃ suyogyakam ।।78 । ।
na cāyaṃ mārayitavyo rāmayitavya eva ha ।
vṛddhiṃ gato mama svāmī bhaviṣyati yuvā dṛḍhaḥ ।।79 ।।
iti sā cintayitvaiva gahvare śayane śubhe ।
phalaiḥ sumadhubhiścainaṃ rasairdugdhādibhiḥ sadā ।।2.7.8 0 ।।
poṣayati sma tatraiva rakṣati smāti nityadā ।
bālo'pi ceṣṭate nityaṃ yathā sā rañjitā bhavet ।।8 1 ।।
kṛṣṇapatitvasaṃkalpaḥ puṇyaṃ tasyāstadā'bhavat ।
tena śuddhāṃ nijabhaktāṃ matvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।82 । ।
pāpinyāḥ sevayā pāpadhvaṃsaṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ।
sevāṃ jagrāha satataṃ premadugdhaṃ papau muhuḥ ।।83 । ।
evaṃ dināṣṭakaṃ yātaṃ talaḥ pratīkṣate sutām ।
anāyātāṃ tadā'raṇye talasyā''śramamityataḥ ।।84।।
jñātavān sa mṛtā seti yadvā kṛṣṇagṛhe sthitā ।
yadvā'nyena valiṣṭhena dharṣitā ca hṛtā ca vā ।।85 ।।
mārgayāmīti kṛtvaivā''śramaṃ tyaktvā vanaṃ vanam ।
vṛkṣaṃ śṛṃgaṃ talaṃ cādriṃ paśyan yāti yadā tadā ।।86 ।।
dṛṣṭavān pādavinyāsān gahvarasya mukhe striyāḥ ।
āhvayāmāsa tāṃ nāmnā sā śratvā bhayamāgatā ।।87।।
māraṇārthaṃ mayā''nīto rakṣyate ceti kāraṇāt ।
pitā māṃ krodhamāpanno sabālāṃ mārayiṣyati ।।88।।
iti sā bhayamāpannā tuṣṭāva maunamāsthitā ।
kṛṣṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ kāntaṃ sarvayā śaraṇāgatā ।।89।।
rakṣa rakṣa hare kānta parameśvara keśava ।
tvayi me mānasaṃ lagnaṃ pitā māṃ ghātayiṣyati ।।2.7.90।।
iti stutvā ca taṃ bālaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi bhāminī ।
aśrupātaṃ cakārā'tha kṛṣṇo yuvā dṛḍho'bhavat ।।9 1 ।।
puṣṭo dānavanāśārthaṃ dhṛtacakro babhūva ha ।
talājā taṃ vilokyaiva kṣaṇaṃ cucumba taṃ patim ।।92।।
bhagavāँstu kṣaṇānandaṃ dattvā divyāṃ vidhāya ca ।
kṛtvā līnāṃ nijadehe śyāmarūpo babhūva ha ।।93।।
ājagāma guhāyāstu bahiryatra talaḥ sthitaḥ ।
talo gadāyutaścāpi jīvane śaṃkito'bhavat ।।94।।
śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau haristatra talo dudrāva bhītitaḥ ।
pṛthivyantastale līno'bhavat tatra haristadā ।।।95।।
tyaktvā taṃ ca svayaṃ kanyāyutaḥ kuṃkumavāpikām ।
samājagāma satataṃ lomaśasyā''śrame hariḥ ।। 96।।
vidhāya kanyakārūpadvayaṃ caikāṃ tadaiva saḥ ।
haṃsayānena ca naijaṃ dhāma cāpreṣayat priyām ।।97।।
dvitīyaṃ kanyakārūḥpa lājākhyaṃ samarakṣayat ।
lomaśasyā''śrame cānyakanyābhiḥ samameva saḥ ।। 98।।
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ gatā sā ca talājā divyarūpiṇī ।
lājārūpābhavat sarvapūjāyāṃ maṃgalātmikā ।।99।।
śrīhariṃ lājayā nityaṃ vardhayanti surastriyaḥ ।
evaṃ talājā preṃkhā sā lājārūpā'bhavattathā ।। 2.7.10 0।।
preṃkhārūpā tathā cāste kṛṣṇasyā'nugrahāt sadā ।
kanyārūpā kṛṣṇapatnī kumārikādiṣu sthitā ।। 101 ।।
tathā divyasvarūpā ca pare dhāmni virājate ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogāccaturdhārūpadhāriṇī ।। 1 02।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāsthitā'bhavat ।
lājā preṃkhā kanyakā ca muktarūpetibhāminī ।। 103 ।।
yathā gaṃgāmbuno yogād rathyāmbu yāti gāṃgatām ।
tathā'nādikṛṣṇayogād rākṣasī yāti muktatām ।। 1 04।।
kimatra tu mahāścaryaṃ rādhe vadāmi vai hareḥ ।
tvādṛśī sā hareḥ patnī vivāhena bhaviṣyati ।। 1 05।।
atha śrībhagavān mātṛsannidhau bālake punaḥ ।
bālarūpaḥ samāgatya cāntarlīno'bhavattadā ।। 1 06।।
talājayedaṃ kathitaṃ lomaśāya maharṣaye ।
lomaśena ca kathitaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ daivataṃ ca tat ।। 1 07।।
sarvairjñātaścamatkāro yāte dināṣṭake tadā ।
menire te mahāścaryaṃ śāntipāṭhān pracakrire ।। 1 08।।
athotsave samāyātā devā devyaśca bhojitāḥ ।
vanditāścā'rpitā dānairgamitāḥ śaṃ nijagṛhān ।। 10 9।।
trayodaśe dine gatvā gṛhānaṣṭadinottaram ।
jñātvā kṛṣṇapratāpaṃ ca camatkārabharaṃ param ।। 2.7.110 ।।
paramparayā te devā devyo mumudurāntare ।
nemuḥ prasasmaruḥ svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi ।। 111 ।।
ityevaṃ kathito rādhe! preṃkhotsavo mahān śubhaḥ ।
