camatkāraśca kathitaḥ śrotṛvaktroḥ pramuktidaḥ ।। 1 12।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ preṃkhā''rohaṇotsave talaputryāstalājārākṣasyāḥ kāpaṭyenā''gatāyā api harau mohitāyā muktyādicamatkāravarṇananāmā saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 7 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 007 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 8
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 009 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ subhage rādhe kathāṃ pumuttamāśritām ।
preṃkhotsavottaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
duhitṛhārakaścetimatvā talākhyarakṣasā ।
pradviṣṭo bahudhā bālakṛṣṇo vai kambharāgṛhe ।। 2 ।।
nā'sya kleśaḥ pareśasya phalaṃ kleśastu rakṣasaḥ ।
talena gatvā cārjantāṃ guphāṃ tatra sthitāstu ye ।। 3 ।।
rākṣasā nijajātīyā bodhitāste ca mantritāḥ ।
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāśayituṃ mudā ।। 4 ।।
sarve cākarṇya vṛttāntaṃ talājā''haraṇādikam ।
talena saha cāgatya siṃhāraṇye sthitā hi te ।। 5 ।।
bhramanto niśithe grāmān randhrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ ।
ghātayituṃ hariṃ te vai prayatante sma nityadā ।। 6 ।।
pracchannāste samāyānti cā'nāsādya kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
viyanti ca nirāśāste prabhoścakrād bhayaṃ gatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ māsaḥ prathamastu bālakṛṣṇasya cā'bhavat ।
janerdvitīyamāsasya prathame vai dine tataḥ ।। 8 ।।
mātā pitā lomaśaśca prabhuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
icchanti sma divyadugdhaṃ pāyayituṃ tadā hariḥ ।। 9 ।।
mārgakṛṣṇanavamyāṃ ca prātarutthāya caiva saḥ ।
ramate sma hasati sma preṃkhāyāṃ jñāpayan kṛpām । । 2.8.10 । ।
mātā cātiprasannā'sti dugdhaṃ pāyayituṃ harim ।
dudoha maṃgalāgaurīnāmnīṃ kāmadughāṃ tu gām । । 11 । ।
uṣṇaṃ kṛtvā śarkarāktaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ kambusandhṛtam ।
vastrapūtaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ kambunā'pāyayaddharim । । 1 2। ।
jñātvā dugdhotsavaṃ gāvaḥ kāmarūpadharāḥ śubhāḥ ।
divyalakṣaṇasampannā mānavīvāgvivecikāḥ । । 13 । ।
jagadurmātaraṃ cāsmaddugdhaṃ pāyaya gopatim ।
gosahasrasyā'rthanāṃ saṃśrutvā mātā''ha gāstadā । । 14। ।
bālo'yaṃ syātkathaṃ nvarhaḥ sarvadugdhātipānakṛt ।
apathyaṃ tad bhavet sarvaṃ kiṃ karomi hi śaṃsata । । 1 5 । ।
gāvaḥ prāhuḥ kimabhāgyamasmākaṃ tādṛśaṃ bhavet ।
vayaṃ gāvo bhavatyāḥ sma hareḥ sevāṃ na cāpnumaḥ । । 16 । ।
gavāmabhyarthanāṃ mātā yāvacchṛṇoti tāvatā ।
vyomamārgād gavāṃ lakṣaṃ golokādāgataṃ tadā । । 1 7। ।
akṣarāccāpi vaikuṇṭhādavyākṛtād divastathā ।
bhūmeścāpi vṛṣāraṇyāt koṭayastvāyayurgavām । । 18 । ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā samāyayuḥ ।
vyomni vimānagāḥ kācidantarīkṣagatāḥ parāḥ । । 1 9। ।
jalasthāḥ kṣitigāścānyāstasthurnemurhariṃ mudā ।
dugdhasrāvān pracakruśca dugdhasarit tato'bhavat । । 2.8.20 । ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva dugdhaṃ jale ca miśritam ।
dugdhatīrthaṃ tu tajjātaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam । ।21 । ।
harirjñātvā gavāmicchāḥ mātaraṃ prāha tatkṣaṇam ।
mātaḥ kathaya sarvāstāḥ kṣīraṃ pāsyati me sutaḥ । ।22 । ।
gāvaścakruḥ stutiṃ taṃ ca piba naḥ kṣīramacyuta ।
brahmāṇḍodara viśvātman sāphalyaṃ no vidhehi ca । । 23 । ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatprārthanāṃ tadā ।
svīkṛtyā'nugraheṇaiva koṭirūpo babhūva ha । । 24।।।
pratidhenuṃ tu bālo'sau dugdhadohakavat sthitaḥ ।
pratidhenustanaṃ prāpya dugdhadhārāṃ nisargajām । । 25 । ।
snehajāṃ cātimiṣṭāṃ ca hariḥ svasya mukhe'grahīt ।
papau payāṃsi cā''tṛptiṃ gobhyaḥ stanyamapāyayat । । 26 ।।
prāsādikaṃ ca devebhyaḥ kanyābhyaḥ pitṛbhyastathā ।
dadau paścādekarūpo'bhavat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 27।।
dhenavastāstadā kṛṣṇaṃ prārthayāmāsa satpatim ।
sadā rakṣaya no nātha tavā'gre sevanāya vai ।। 28 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha tathā'stviti hasan prabhuḥ ।
dhenūnāṃ ca tadā devo rūpadvayaṃ cakāra ha ।।29।।
ekaṃ dhenusvarūpaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ kanyakātmakam ।
kanyāstā lomaśā'gre ca rarakṣa bhagavān hariḥ ।।2.8.3 0।।
gāvaḥ sarvā divyadehā yayuḥ svasvasthalāni vai ।
enaṃ mahotsavaṃ vīkṣya devā devyaḥ smayaṃ yayuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
athā'surāste samayaṃ dugdhotsavaṃ vilokya ca ।
dhenurūpāstadā bhūtvā stanyadānārthamāyayuḥ ।।22।।
arjantādyāstathā teṣāṃ nāryo gorūpadhārikāḥ ।
kapilāḥ piṃgalā raktāḥ śyāmāḥ śabalikāḥ parāḥ ।।33 ।।
bhūtvā śrībālakṛṣṇasya sannidhāvāyayustadā ।
odhaḥsu saṃbhṛtaṃ kṣveḍaṃ śvetadugdhanibhaṃ tadā ।।34।।
jñātvā vasundharā devī kṛtyaṃ tad rakṣasāṃ tathā ।
gauśca bhūtvā svayaṃ cāyāt prathamaṃ śrīhariṃ prati ।।35।।
prāha gosvāminaṃ bālaṃ nātha piba payo mama ।
yathā tṛptiryatheṣṭaṃ ca piba sarvaṃ payo mama ।।36।।
imā gāvo'raṇyavāsā āgatā mokṣakāṃkṣayā ।
tāsāmākaṇṭhamāpīya stanyaṃ mokṣaṃ pradehi tāḥ ।।37।।
śrutvaitad bhagavāँstasyā vasumatyāstu bhāvabhṛt ।
omityuktvā śatarūpo babhūva līlayā punaḥ ।।38।।
tāsāmodhāṃsi bhagavān karābhyāṃ dṛḍhamādadhe ।
stanāni cānane kṛtvā papau kṣveḍapayo'tigam ।।39।।
kṣveḍaṃ tvamṛtatāpannaṃ bhagavanmukhamāgatam ।
saprāṇaṃ sarvathā stanyamapibat tāḥ prasahya saḥ ।।2.8.40।।
evaṃ kṛte tu te daityā daityanāryaśca vai tadā ।
trāhi trāhi kṛpāsindho muñca muñceti pāhi ca ।।41।।
kṣamāṃ tadā'rthayāmāsurāsan daipyasvarūpagāḥ ।
mātā pitā kumāryaśca bhayamudvegamāgatāḥ ।।42।।
tresurdaityakukṛtyena kṛṣṇaghātakakarmaṇā ।
daityān vilokya rurudurlomaśastā asāntvayat ।।43।।
arjantādyā rākṣasāste tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।
namaste devadeveśa parameśa namo'stu te ।।44।।
kṛpālo tava putrāḥ sma dāsikāste imāḥ striyaḥ ।
vṛścikānāmavinaye roṣaṃ yāti na sajjanaḥ ।।45।।
āsurāṇāṃ nisarge tvaṃ mā yāhi roṣamacyuta ।
prāṇān rakṣaya mukteśa kṣveḍaṃ tvayā'mṛtaṃ kṛtam ।।46।।
kṣveḍāśrayāँstathā cāsmānamṛtān saṃvidhehi ca ।
avatārāstathā muktā īśvarā munayaḥ surāḥ ।। 47।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro martyāḥ piśācā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ।
kinnarāścāraṇāḥ sūtāḥ kiṃpūruṣā yamānugāḥ ।।48।।
tiryañcaḥ paśavo vṛkṣā vallyaḥ sarīsṛpā mṛgāḥ ।
gulmāstṛṇāni pakṣyādyāḥ kīṭā maśakajātayaḥ ।।49।।
daityāśca dānavā varṇasaṃkarā asurāḥ śaṭhāḥ ।
nāgāḥ sarpā jaḍāścaityā narā nāryastvadātmajāḥ ।।2.8.50।।
tava putrāḥ prabho sarve sattvarajastamoyutāḥ ।
sarveṣveva samā prītistava kṛṣṇa bhavediti ।।5 1 ।।
piturmātuḥ samā prītirbāleṣu viṣameṣvapi ।
rakṣa rakṣa mahārāja mā prāṇebhyo viyojaya ।।।52।।
vayaṃ pitṛhano jātā garadāḥ pāpacetasaḥ ।
mā gaṇayā'parādhān no hyajñānāṃ krūrakarmiṇām ।।53।।
vāraṃ vāraṃ praṇamāmastṛṇānyādāya vai mukhe ।
rakṣa jīvaya no nātha mā prāṇebhyo viyojaya ।।।54।।
ityabhyartha hariṃ daityā nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ ।
mokṣayiṣye haristāँścā'vat pṛthvīsamīpataḥ ।।55।।
śrīkṛṣṇasya suyogena teṣāṃ pāpāni jajvaluḥ ।
arjanto daityavaryastu rākṣasīyonikāraṇam ।।56।।
varṇayāmāsa śuddhena jñātvā vai hṛdyena ha ।
vayaṃ pūrve marusthāne gālavasyā''śramasthitāḥ ।।57।।
viprā vedādhyāyavantaḥ śuddhayajñaparāstathā ।
aparigrahadharmāṇaḥ kandamūlaphalāśinaḥ ।।58।।
kalpavṛkṣakalpavallīkalpamaṇiprajīvinaḥ ।
kāmarūpadharā vyomnā yāyinaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ।।59।।
tīrthayātrākarāścāpi parigrahavivarjitāḥ ।
āsma tathāpi śūdrasya tapasā marubhūtale ।।2.8.60।।
anāvṛṣṭirabhūttena dhvastāḥ kandaphalādayaḥ ।
bhūtvā ca bhikṣukāḥ sarve hyabhūma saparigrahāḥ ।।61।।
dānagrāhāścānnalubdhāḥ prasahya dhanahāriṇaḥ ।
abhakṣyabhakṣakā jātā bubhukṣitā hi pāpinaḥ ।।62।।
vṛkṣā naṣṭastathā naṣṭā vallayaḥ kāmadāstu yāḥ ।
tato vane vicarāmo yathākāmaṃ vidharmiṇaḥ ।।63 ।।
yaḥ kaścin milati mārge taddhanaṃ cāmbarādikam ।
tadannaṃ ca tatsalilaṃ harāmastasya tattadā ।।64।।
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ pañcadaśakuṭumbinām ।
sannidhāvekadā viprayugalaṃ samupāgatam ।।65।।
dharmayuktaṃ dayāyuktaṃ brahmamārgaparaṃ tathā ।
vedadhyāyanasampannaṃ ṣaṭkarmasaṃparāyaṇam ।।66।।
patnī pativratā cāsīt svāmimātraparāyaṇā ।
patisevākarī sādhvī snānapūjādikāriṇī ।।67।।
ekabhuktavrataṃ dvayorvrateṣu jāgarastathā ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ pūjane tau prasannau sarvasampradau ।।68।।
śraddhābhāvasamāyuktau gurupitṛparāyaṇau ।
tāvāgatyāśrameṣveva viśrāntau naḥ samīpataḥ ।।69।।
tayoragre pakvasaktūnyāsan yavāstathā'kṣatāḥ ।
asmābhiste tvapahṛtā bhojyaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ tayoḥ ।।2.8.70।।
vastrāṇyavaskanditāni dhanaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ tathā ।
dvayoḥ kaupīnayogyaṃ ca vastraṃ tadā'vaśeṣitam ।।71 ।।
patirhariṃ smaratyeva hriyamāṇe'pi taddhane ।
sādhvī sāpi na ca vakti japatyeva hariṃ muhuḥ ।।72।।।
evaṃ tau luṇṭatau tatrā'smābhirdayāvivarjitaiḥ ।
prasahya caurarūpairvai brāhmaṇairbrāhmaṇau tadā ।।73।।
dharmiṣṭhau pīḍitau vīkṣya bhūkampaḥ samajāyata ।
aśmavṛṣṭirabhūtpāṃsuvarṣaṇaṃ cābhavattadā ।।74।।
dvāvetau vṛkṣamāśritya tiṣṭhataśca harismṛtī ।
pativratā sā manvānā sarva harīcchayeti ca ।।79।।
patiṃ saṃvāhayāmāsa mardayāmāsa varṣma ca ।
satyāṃ pāṣāṇavṛṣṭau ca pāṃsūnāṃ varṣaṇe'pi ca ।।76।।
cakraturna ca śokaṃ tau rakṣecchāṃ cakraturna ca ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।।77।।
iti jāpaṃ prakurvantau sasmaraturhariṃ gurum ।
tāvattatra samāyātaḥ sachatravastrabhojanaḥ ।।78।।
brāhmaṇo'nyaḥ satilako hṛdi śrīvatsaśobhitaḥ ।
ujjvalaścandrasadṛśo dadau pṛṣṭvā subhojanam ।।79।।
vastrāṇi ca tathā chatraṃ dadau tadyugalāya saḥ ।
asmābhistadvīkṣitaṃ ca vartamāne tu varṣaṇe ।।2.8.80।।
tatra gatvā ca tadapi punarhṛtaṃ samastakam ।
tadā dātā tiro'bhūcca divyadevo'thavā ṛṣiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
śaśāpā'smān brahmaputrā bhavantaḥ krūranirdayāḥ ।
svajñātikhādakā yasmāt tasmād bhavantu rākṣasāḥ ।।।82।।
yeṣāṃ nāsti dayāleśo nāryāṃ nare'pi vai dvije ।
prāptaṃ pūrvaṃ tu tatprāptaṃ yavavastrādikaṃ tu tat। ।।।83।।
deśakālapravaiṣamyāt kṣāntaṃ pāpāpavartanam ।
punaḥ prāptau punarhṛtaṃ nirdayaiśca durātmabhiḥ ।।84।।
tasmāt pāṣāṇavarṣaiśca mṛtiṃ gatvā hi rākṣasāḥ ।
bhavantu marudharmāṇo vasantu śūṣkaparvate ।।85।।
paśvāhārāśca māṃsādā bhavantu sukhavarjitāḥ ।
iti śaptā hi tenaiva vyomavāṇyā tadā vayam ।।86।।
śapantaṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ kṣamāṃ mokṣaṃ sukhaṃ punaḥ ।,
tadā vyaktasvarūpaḥ sa ṛṣirvai gālavaḥ svayam ।।87।।
āsītpūrvagururnaśca jagāda dayayā punaḥ ।
saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca parātmanaḥ ।।88।।
yogena bhavatāṃ muktirbhaviṣyati vrajantu tam ।
tato'smābhirvanditaśca munistadyugalaṃ tathā ।।89।।
kṣamārthaṃ yācitaṃ dravyaṃ cārpitaṃ pratipūjitam ।
pratyarpitaṃ ca vastrānnaṃ tato vayaṃ tu vṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।2.8.90।।
śāpena vai mṛtāstatra rākṣasīṃ yonimāgatāḥ ।
arjantādyā vayaṃ sarve rākṣasā vai kuṭumbinaḥ ।।91 ।।
parvatādau nivāsaśca kṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
cintayāmaḥ kadā muktipradaḥ śrībhagavān bhavet ।।92।।
jātismarā vayaṃ sarve talasya kathanāt khalu ।
jñānavanto parabrahma mokṣadaṃ cātra rājate ।।93 ।।
tad vayaṃ kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma daityabhāvād vimocitāḥ ।
tava yogena deveśa pāpaṃ prajvalitaṃ tu naḥ ।।94।।
pāpātmāno vayaṃ nātha tāritā brahmarākṣasāḥ ।
kṣveḍaṃ tvasmatkṛte jātaṃ hyamṛtaṃ tvaparādhinām ।।95।।
pāraḥ kṛpāyāste nāsti nāsti pāraḥ kṣateśca naḥ ।
pārakṛt prakarotveva pāradhīn bhavapāragān ।।96।।
ityuktvā rurudurdaityā jātismarā muhurmuhuḥ ।
praṇemurdaṇḍavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagurjayam ।।97।।
bhagavāँstān karuṇayā lokayāmāsa satvaram ।
tyājayāmāsa dehāँstān kārayāmāsa devatāḥ ।।98।।
rūpadvayayutāstāśca kanyakāstāstadā'bhavan ।
kumāryaḥ śatasaṃkhyākā rakṣitā lomaśāśrame ।।99।।
divyā devyo divyayānaiḥ preṣitā brahmadhāmani ।
evaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ talayogāt prayoginām ।। 2.8.1 00।।
kṛpayā vai kṛtā muktiḥ pṛthvīgaustu tiro'bhavat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālo babhūva ha ।। 10 1।।
reme rañjanadolāyāṃ kanyakābhiḥ sulālitaḥ ।
āveditaṃ gosvarūpapṛthivyā tatra cotsave ।। 1 02।।
mātre pitre kanyakābhyo jñātaṃ kṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam ।
mayā te kathitaṃ rādhe pāṭhe śrave'pi muktidam ।। 1 03।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya dvitīyamāsārambhe kṣīrapānotsave naikarūpairdivyagavāṃ dugdhapānaṃ, gorūpadhāriṇāṃ kapaṭināṃ rākṣasānāṃ patnīnāṃ gorūpāṇāṃ saprāṇadugdhadhāvane nāśo muktiśca bhagavatā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭamodhyāyaḥ ।। 8 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu cānyaccaritraṃ ca rādhike paramātmanaḥ ।
māse yāte dvitīye ca tṛtīye śuklapakṣake । । 1 । ।
gṛhād bahirniṣkramaṇaṃ cakre mātā sutasya vai ।
puṇyāhavācanaṃ tatra nāndīśrāddhādikaṃ tathā । । 2 ।।
akārayat pitā viprairāśīrbhiḥ samayojayat ।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ gatvā hyanāmayacca pādayoḥ । । 3 । ।
gurustasya hi tilakaṃ bhāle kuṃkumacandrakam ।
kṛtvā ke svakarau datvā dadau mantraṃ ca karṇake । । 4 । ।
'anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyāṇo me śaraṇaṃ namaḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ' । । 5 । ।
bālaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca mantraṃ vāratrayaṃ punaḥ ।
lomaśarṣistathā mātā janakādyā mudaṃ yayuḥ । । 6 । ।
kaṇṭhīṃ dvirāvṛtāṃ kaṇṭhe taulasīṃ sa nyadhārayat ।
puṣpahāraṃ dadau kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya lomaśo muniḥ । । 7 । ।
mukhe kaṇaṃ śarkarāyā dadau hastena lomaśaḥ ।
dugdhaṃ cāpāyayat kṛṣṇaṃ muhuḥ pasparśa pāṇinā ।। 8 ।।
dadau mātā tadā bālaṃ khelanārthaṃ tadāśrame ।
sthitābhyaḥ kanyakābhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakāntābhya eva ca ।। 9 ।।
tāścucumburmuhuḥ kānta hāsayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
ninyurudyānakaṃ pārśve puṣpavallīnikuṃjake ।। 2.9.10 ।।
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamityāsa kalahastadā ।
kāntaṃ caikaṃ rāmayitu kanyakānāṃ ca yoṣitām ।। 11 ।।
koṭīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca vilokya bhāvanā prabhuḥ ।
koṭirūpāṇi ca cakrū tadudyāne viśeṣataḥ । । 1 2।।
bālacandro yathā tāsāṃ sukhadaḥ saṃbhavet tathā ।
prāvartata sadā tāsāṃ tvadhīnaḥ kṛṣṇakāntakaḥ ।। 13 । ।
kācitkṛṣṇaṃ ramayati cumbayati muhurmuhuḥ ।
kācittu vakṣasi kṛtvā datvā snehabharaṃ vacaḥ । । 14।।
hāsayati svakaṃ kāntaṃ bālarūpaṃ manoharam ।
kācidaṃke nidhāyainaṃ gaṇḍayoḥ karaśākhayā ।। 15।।
spṛṣṭvā muhurmuhuḥ kāntaṃ cittaṃ rañjayati sthiram ।
kācittanmastake datvā haiyaṃgavīnamuttamam ।। 1 6। ।
śanairmardayati hastatalena bālarūpiṇam ।
kācicchalākayā bindvīṃ dadāti bhālake'ruṇām ।। 17।।
kācit karoti tilakaṃ raktaṃ svarṇaśalākayā ।
kauṃkumaṃ rājasaṃ manoharaṃ cākarṣakaṃ prabhum । । 18 । ।
kācid bālaṃ gaṇḍake ca cibuke ca manoharām ।
bindvīṃ karoti raktāṃ ca mānasasya sukhāvahām । । 19 । ।
kācittu sthalapadmānāṃ dalānāṃ mālikāṃ navām ।
mṛdvīṃ kṛtvā gale tasya dadāti śāntagandhinīm ।।2.9.20।।
anyā tu netrayostasya ghṛtajaṃ kajjalaṃ śubham ।
añjayati pratejo'rthaṃ rūpārthaṃ raṅgamādinī ।।21 ।।
anyā bālaṃ kare procchālayatyeva tadā'mbare ।
aparā vakṣasi tvenaṃ tathodare muhurmuhuḥ ।।22।।
mukhenoṣṭhena prāṇena bhaṃbhaṃbhaṃbhaṃ karoti ca ।
vādayate śanairgālaṃ kilkilāyati cāparā ।।23।।
kācit svavakṣasi pādau tasya dhṛtvā pramodate ।
kācit kaṭyāṃ tu saṃsthāpya bāhunā taṃ dhṛtaṃ prabhum ।।24।।
nṛtyantaṃ ca mayūraṃ vai darśayatyeva ceṣṭayā ।
itarā pādayostasya karayośca manoharam ।।।25।।
manāk saṃrañjanadravyaṃ yojayati sudarśanam ।
anyā kūjantamevainaṃ kokilaṃ tvāmrasaṃgatam ।।26।।
darśayati pratikūjayati hāsayate harim ।
kācit kṛṣṇasya vaiṃ nāsāṃ saṃskarotyambareṇa ca ।।27।।
kācicca vāyunā lagnaṃ rajo mārjayati drutam ।
anyā'ṅgulyā śākhisaṃsthaṃ markaṭaṃ darśayatyapi ।।28।।
tathā'nyā śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ gucchān dhṛtvā navānnavān ।
saugandhyaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya samarpayati sādaram । ।29।।
tamanyā gadgadaṃ śabdaṃ śrāvayate ca modate ।
aparā tu rasaṃ miṣṭaṃ manāgdadāti vai madhu ।।2.9.3 0।।
tathā'nyā gāyati gītiṃ kācinnṛtyati bhūtale ।
aparā cakravad bālaṃ bhrāmayati bhramatyapi ।।3 1 ।।
kācit saugandhikaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ sammardayatyapi ।
tathā'nyā vallikādolāmāruhyā''ndolayatyapi ।।।32।।
dvitīyā śītanāśārthaṃ kambalikāṃ dadātyapi ।
anyā vahniṃ jvālayitvā pārśve tiṣṭhati tadyutā ।।33 ।।
aparā mṛgapṛṣṭhe taṃ samārohayati priyā ।
tathā'nyā mṛgaśāvāgre nītvā sthāpayati priyam ।।34।।
gavāṃ vatsān prati nītvā tāṃśca darśayati priyān ।
śaśakarṇau parā dhṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ darśayate tu khe ।।35।।
darpaṇe ca mukhaṃ tasya tathā darśayati priyā ।
parābhyaḥ saṃśrāvayanti tvanyāścihnāni yāni ca ।।36।।
nūtanāśca samāgatya paśyanti tāni vai mudā ।
śrīkṛṣṇaścāmbaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kilkileti karoti ca ।।37।।
kāँścinmukhaṃ svamudghāṭya brahmāṇḍaṃ darśayatyapi ।
anyā golokamādyaṃ cākṣara vaikuṇṭhamityapi ।।38।।
svatanau bhagavāँstatra nijābhyo darśayatyapi ।
evaṃ sarvāḥ kumāryaśca modante kṛṣṇalīlayā ।।39।।
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo labdhvā babhūvuḥ kṛtavāñcchitāḥ ।
tataḥ śrībhagavāँstāni rūpāṇyantarjahāra ca ।।2.9.40।।
eka evā'bhavallakṣmīkarago vai caturbhujaḥ ।
māṇikyāyāstathā cāṃ'ke dvibhujo hi tato'bhavat ।।41 ।।
tataḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīkaṭyāmekalako'bhavat ।
sarvā vilokya sāmarthyaṃ tṛptā jātāstataḥ pitā ।।।42।।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā lomaśaṃ ca guruṃ munim ।
candanenā'rcayāmāsa lalāṭaṃ tilakānvitam ।।43।।
candrakaṃ kārayāmāsā'kṣatairlājāsupuṣpakaiḥ ।
hāraiśca pādukābhiśca phalaiḥ patraiḥ sukandakaiḥ ।।44।।
mūlairmṛgājīnavaryairdugdhairghṛtaiśca tandulaiḥ ।
vastraiśca valkalaiḥ kratāvupayuktasuvastubhiḥ ।।45।।
lomaśaṃ toṣayāmāsa jagṛhustasya cāśiṣaḥ ।
. kanyakābhyaśca saubhāgyadravyāṇi jananī dadau ।।46।।
vastrāṇi valayāँścāpi tathopakaraṇāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni mṛṣṭānnāni ghṛtāni ca ।।47।।
dadau mātā ca keśānāṃ prasādhanāni vai tadā ।
anantāni tadiṣṭāni sarvavastūni vai dadau ।।48।।
mātā rakṣati kaumāre sarvāstāḥ putrikā yathā ।
svargaṃ dvitīyaṃ vai tatra brahmacaryāśramaṃ mahat ।।49।।
vaikuṇṭhamiva māyādiśūnyaṃ hareranugrahāt ।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ tvāsīnmuktakanyāvirājitam ।।2.9.50।।
aharniśaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo'tra cintyate ।
nārāyaṇapriyāḥ sarve sarvāścāsan na cetare ।।51।।
lomaśo vartate nityamukto māyāvivarjitaḥ ।
akṣaro'vyaya evā'sau muktātmā brahmapāragaḥ ।।52।।।
yadāśrame na kāmo'sti na ca krodho virājate ।
na lobho naiva moho'sti madādyāstu kathaṃ tadā ।।53।।।
yatra liṃgavikāro na yatra yonikriyā na ca ।
yatra kāmo na vai cā'sti lomaśasyā''śramastathā ।।54।।
līnamūrdhvaṃ mahatsthānaṃ śāntiryatra tu śāśvatī ।
lomaśaścā''kṣarāṇāṃ vai catuṣṭayaṃ śubhārthakam ।।55।।
etādṛśaṃ brahmavidaṃ yadā pūjayate pitā ।
tadā prabhābhidhā kanyā bālakṛṣṇaṃ priya prabhum ।।56।।
rantuṃ ramayituṃ nītvā yayāvudyānajaṃ drumam ।
rājacampakavṛkṣaṃ taṃ samāśritya priyā sakhī ।।57।।
niṣasāda dadau bālā vṛttīḥ sarvā harau kila ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto vyomnā krodhanako'suraḥ । ।68। ।
yastu rudralalāṭādvai jalamadhye vyajāyata ।
brāhmaṇā svalalāṭādvai yadā rudraḥ prakāśitaḥ । ।59। ।
uktaḥ sṛṣṭyarthamevā'tha sa vai vyākulamānasaḥ ।
jalā'ntaḥstho'bhavat tatrodvegaṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ smaran । ।2.9.6 0 ।।
tena jāto lalāṭe'sya rudrasya svedabindukaḥ ।
tadbindujo'bhavat krūro devadveṣṭā suretaraḥ । ।61 ।।
krodhano'yaṃ balavāँśca tapastepe'tidāruṇam ।
tapasā siddhimāpanno vyomagaḥ kāmarūpadhṛk । ।62। ।
so'yaṃ yogena vai jñātvā kuṃkumavāpikābhuvi ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ daityavirodhinam ।।63 ।।
udyāne vartate kanyākare matveti vai tadā ।
jighṛkṣurbālakaṃ tatra tvāyayau rabhasā'suraḥ । ।64।।
kanyārūpadharo bhūtvā rāmayituṃ samāgataḥ ।
prabhāhastagataṃ kṛṣṇamanāpṛcchya tadā''dade । ।65।।
bālakṛṣṇo viditvaiva tasya vai duṣṭabhāvanām ।
hastau kṛtvā lambamānau tasya vināśanāya ca । ।66 ।।
muktidānāya ca devastasyā hastagato'bhavat ।
prabhā jñātvā sakhī kāṃcid dadau tasmai tu bālakam । ।67।।
krodhanā kanyakā sā tu bālaṃ nītvā kṣaṇāntare ।
vṛkṣavallīṣu ca tūrṇamadṛśyabhāvatāṃ gatā । ।68।।
prabhā na paśyati tvenāṃ samājuhāva tāṃ tadā ।
krodhanā tvambare nītvā yayāvabhrapathaṃ drutam । ।69।।
mārayituṃ ca taṃ bālaṃ kṛtayatnā muhurmuhuḥ ।
gale pāśaṃ dadātyeṣā kintu sā hastayostadā ।।2.9.70 ।।
vahninā dahyamānā ca bālakaṇṭhaṃ pramuñcati ।
ākāśasthā vahnidagdhā śikhāvyāptā'bhavattadā । ।7 1 । ।
śrīkṛṣṇadehajād vahnerjvālābhirdagdhadehikā ।
hāhetyavocat kṛṣṇaṃ saṃprākṣipad bhūtale tadā ।।72। ।
kintu kṛṣṇaśarīrottho vahnistāṃ naiva muñcati ।
vahnirjvalaṃśca bahudhā dhūmraketuryathā ca khe । ।73 । ।
tāṃ kanyāṃ dahati krūro vahnistrāṇaṃ na vidyate ।
tadā sā kṣipramutplutya bālamanu hyavātarat । ।74।।
bālastu prabhayā gatvā dhṛtaḥ śīghraṃ kareṇa ha ।
prabhā prāptaṃ hariṃ dhṛtvā dudrāva lomaśaṃ prati । ।75। ।
tāvat sā krodhanā prāha svasame'gniṃ praśāmaya ।
jvalāmi karmaṇā me'tra rakṣa duṣṭāṃ tu pāpinīm । ।76।।
ityuktvā cāgrato mārgaṃ ruddhvā tuṣṭāva bālakam ।
nātha kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho māṃ tvaṃ tāraya kaṣṭataḥ ।।77।।
śaṃkarasya tu putro'haṃ nāmnā krodhanako'smi ca ।
surāṇāṃ dveṣakartā'haṃ tālanāmnā'sureṇa ca । ।78 । ।
preṣitastava nāśārthaṃ pāpaṃ copārjitaṃ mayā ।
aghātye yanmama buddhirghātanārthamupāsitā । ।7 9 । ।
tadahaṃ ca kṣamāṃ yāce rakṣa māṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuru ।
ityukto bālakṛṣṇo'sau karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ । ।2.9.8 0 । ।
naisargikakṛpāpūrṇaḥ krodhanaṃ prāha vai tadā ।
kathaṃ tvaṃ kanyakā jātā mama nāśāya mānini! । ।8 1 । ।
naiva jānāsi māṃ sarvāntarātmānaṃ pareśvaram ।
nāḍīprāṇā mama haste sṛṣṭermukterbhavanti ca । ।82।।
vada tvaṃ cāparādhaṃ me kṛtavatyasi śobhane ।
kaṃ daṇḍaṃ nirmame te'rtha vadā'tra tat karomi te । ।8 3 । ।
krodhanā prāha taṃ kṛṣṇa kāntaṃ manoharaṃ prabhum ।
uvāca me gātradāhaṃ praśāmaya prabho tathā । ।84। ।
kānto me bhava deveśa kanyā tvāṃ pravṛṇomyaham ।
mānasaṃ me tvayi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pradhāvati ।।85 । ।
mokṣaṃ dehi tathā cānte tvāsuratvaṃ vināśaya ।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stvetat tava sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati । ।86 । ।
mama sparśāt tava gātraṃ divyaṃ sadā tu kānyakam ।
madarthaṃ jāyatāṃ ramyaṃ lomaśāśramavṛtti ca । ।87। ।
kanyāsu ca tvayā stheyaṃ kanyārūpeṇa bhāmini! ।
dvitīyaṃ te tathārūpaṃ mokṣaṃ yātvakṣaraṃ padam । ।88। ।
tṛtīyaṃ te tathā rūpaṃ pauruṣaṃ vahnisadṛśam ।
krodhanaṃ sarvathā krūraṃ krodhanākhyaṃ bhuvastale । ।89। ।
munirūpaṃ bhavatveva krodhanastvaṃ sadā bhava ।
evaṃ rūpatrayaṃ kṛṣṇo dattavān krodhanāya vai । । 2.9.90 । ।
janmāntare ca durvāsāḥ krodhano'yaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
sarvadā vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭho nārāyaṇasamo guṇe । । 91 । ।
nārāyaṇā'vatāreṣu nimitto'yaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā bhagavān rādhe krodhanāṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām । । 92। ।
kṛtvā śaśvatkanyakāṃ surūpāṃ tasyāstatheṣṭakam ।
dvitīyaṃ kānyakaṃ rūpaṃ cāpi tasyāḥ sumokṣagam ।। 93 ।।
kṛtvapvipreṣayad dhāmā'kṣaraṃ vimānataḥ kṣaṇāt ।
tṛtīyaṃ pauruṣaṃ rūpaṃ tāmasaṃ ca tatpā'bhavat ।। 94।।
tapaścacāra paramaṃ lomaśāśramasannidhau ।
krodhanākhyaṃ paraṃ tīrtha cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।। 95।।
jātaṃ taditi vijñeyaṃ rādhe mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
atha prabhā tathā kanyā krodhanā bālakṛṣṇakam ।।96।।
nītvā lomaśapūjāyāḥ sthānamāyayatustadā ।
navīnā kanyakā keyaṃ ceti pṛṣṭā prabhā'vadat ।।97।।
nārāyaṇacamatkāraṃ śrutvā''ścaryaṃ yayurhi te ।
lomaśasya pūjanaṃ ca kṛtvā mātā pitā hariḥ ।।98।।
yayurgṛhaṃ kanyakā sā kanyāsu harivāñcchayā ।
sadā nivāsamakarot kṛṣṇakāntapriyā'bhavat ।।99।।
atha pradoṣasamaye vidhivacchaśino'rcanam ।
akārayat pitā mātā vāmadevyamagāpayat ।। 2.9.10 0।।
putrasyā'kārayanmātā saumyaṃ vai vidhudarśanam ।
candrapatnyastathā candro jahṛṣurvīkṣya mādhavam ।। 101 ।।
hariścandraṃ vilokyaivā'ṅgulyā''ha mātaraṃ tadā ।
candramānaya mātarme sannidhau ceti vai hṛdā ।। 1 02।।
candro jñātvā harerbhāvaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃyutaḥ ।
saptaviṃśatipatnīnāṃ rathairyuktaḥ samāyayau ।। 10 3।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāndramaṇḍalasadṛśam ।
abhavat sarvathā divyaṃ yadā candro'gamat tadā ।। 1 04।।
candreṇa tu samānītā maṇayo vividhāstathā ।
mālikā divyatejaḥsaṃbhṛtāḥ śītā'mṛtāvahāḥ ।। 1 05।।
haraye tvarpitāstatra mātrā candramasastathā ।
tatpatnīnāṃ svāgatādisatkāraśca kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 1 06।।
pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ dattaṃ bhojanapānakam ।
pūjayitvā hariṃ candra āśīrvādān prayujya ca ।। 1 07।।
yayau svabhavanaṃ svarge śrīkṛṣṇo mudito'bhavat ।
atha sarve'pi pitrādyā lomaśaṃ munisattamam ।। 1 08।।
kṛtvā ca daṇḍavadbhaktyā samarpyopāyanāni ca ।
suprasādaṃ gṛhītvāpi gṛhītvā''śiṣa eva ca ।। 1 09।।
kanyābhyaścāśiṣo datvā yayuḥ svaṃ bhavanaṃ prati ।
evaṃ vai rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya hi ।। 2.9.110 ।।
saṃskāraṃ pāvanaṃ camatkārayuktaṃ sukhāvaham ।
śrotṝṇāṃ muktidaṃ tasya smartṝṇāṃ sampadāṃpradam ।। 111 ।।
lokaputradhanecchūnāṃ svargā'patyadhanapradam ।
vidyaiśvairyādivāñchānāṃ vidyāsiddhipradaṃ param ।। 11 2।।
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ cāpi saubhāgyadaṃ tu yoṣitām ।
āveditaṃ ca te rādhe! bālarūpasya pāvanam ।। 11 3।।
sarvatīrthaphalā'vāptirasya vai cintayā bhavet ।
sarvakratūnāmavabhṛthajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhettathā ।। 1 14।।
sarvadānaphalaṃ cāpi sarvayogaphalaṃ tathā ।
prāptau śrīkṛṣṇakāntasya samāpyate tu rādhike ।। 1 15।।

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇaprabhostṛtīye māsi śukladale bahirniṣkramaṇasaṃskāre yoṣidbhiḥ kārite lālanaramaṇe bahurūpatā, divyadarśanam, lomaśāśrame prabhā kṛṣṇakāntaṃ nītvā yayau, tatra krodhano'suraḥ krodhanā kanyā bhūtvā harimaharat । vyomni sā hariṇā dagdhā taṃ mumoca, tāṃ divyāṃ trirūpāṃ kṛtvā lomaśāśrame, mokṣe, durvāsobhāvijanmani cetinyarūpayat । vidhudarśanaṃ camatkāraścetyevamādinirūpaṇanāmā navamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 9 ।।
