adhyāyaḥ 10
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 011 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
aparaṃ cāpi caritaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya parātmanaḥ ।
śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi brahmānandarasapradam ।। 1 ।।
pañcame ca pitā māsi cakre putrasya vai kṣitau ।
upaveśanasaṃskāraṃ dadau dānāni vai tadā ।। 2 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe prātarutthāya vai pitā ।
snātvā ca naityakaṃ kṛtvā saudhāṃ'ganasamīpataḥ ।। 3 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa kadalīdalaśobhitam ।
aśokā'bhrādipatrāṇāṃ toraṇāni śubhāni ca ।। 4 ।।
bandhayāmāsa kalaśān sthāpayāmāsa copari ।
dhvajamārohayāmāsa veṣṭayāmāsa cāmbaraiḥ ।। 5 ।।
ullocaṃ yojayāmāsa babandha ca patākikāḥ ।
kuṇḍastambhīṃśca paritaḥ klṛptayāmāsa vallikāḥ ।। 6 ।।
phalapuṣpitavṛkṣāँśca calānasthāpayattadā ।
maṇḍape dīpakācāँśca maṇīn prakāśakāँstathā ।। 7 ।।
nidadhe khacitān sthāne mālāsu mauktikīṣvapi ।
tathā'valambayāmāsa citrāṇi ca vitānake ।। 8 ।।
stambheṣvapi ca madhye ca koṇeṣvapi manoharāḥ ।
devīṃ surān mūrtirūpān naddhayāmāsa rūpiṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kānakībhirvālukābhirmṛdvībhistadadhastalam ।
kṛtvā hṛdyaṃ niṣādya cāsanānyanuttamāni ca ।। 2.10.1 0।।
citraraṃgāni ramyāṇi tvaurṇakauśeyakāni ca ।
āstīrya paritastatra bṛsīḥ svalpāśca dīrghikāḥ ।। 1 1।।
siṃhāsanāni ca śreṣṭhaḥ paṭṭikāṃ nidadhe pitā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya bhuvi cāsanam ।। 12।।
divyaṃ sauvarṇasārāḍhyaṃ sthāpayāmāsa madhyake ।
bhūmiṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikāmayīṃ maṇḍape'pi ca ।। 13 ।।
bālaniṣādanārthaṃ ca rakṣayāmāsa śobhanām ।
vedikā kārayāmāsa pavitrāṃ caturasrikām ।। 14।।
sauvarṇapaṭṭikāṃ dīrghāṃ sadratnasārakāñcitām ।
nidhāya tatra ca kṣaumamaurṇaṃ vastraṃ ca pāṇḍuram ।। 1 5।।
raktaṃ cāmbaramevā'pi godhūmeṣu nidhāya ca ।
sajalaṃ kalaśaṃ pārśve taṇḍulān kuṃkumādikam ।। 16।।
puṣpaṃ candanaṃ karpūraṃ mālikāḥ kajjalādikam ।
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ peyaṃ tāmbūlailādikaṃ tathā ।। 17।।
pañcapātraṃ sthālikāṃ cācamanīṃ ca phalāni ca ।
sarva pūjopakaraṇaṃ taulasīdalajāni ca ।। 18।।
dānavastūni sarvāṇi sthāpayāmāsa vai pitā ।
dharādevyāḥ suvarṇasya varāhasya prabhostathā ।। 1 9।।
kārayāmāsa ca mūrtidvayaṃ sarvāṃgaśobhanam ।
sabhūṣaṃ sāmbaraṃ saumyaṃ divyaṃ devasvarūpiṇam ।।2.10.20 ।।
pṛthvīṃ devīṃ surūpāṃ ca lakṣmīrūpāṃ suśobhanām ।
samāsīnāṃ prakṛtvaiva svastikāsanadarśanām ।।।2 1 ।।
pādau tasyāstu pātālaṃ jaṅaghe tasyā rasātalam ।
jānū mahātalaṃ tasyāḥ sakthinī ca talātalam ।।22।।
sakthimūle sutalaṃ ca śroṇyubhe vitalaṃ tathā ।
jaghanaṃ cā'talaṃ tasyā garbhastu bhūtalaṃ tathā ।। 23।।
udaraṃ bhuvarevāsyā hṛdayaṃ svaḥ śubhāvaham ।
kaṇṭho maho mukhaṃ janaścakṣūṃṣī tapa uttamam ।।24।।
lalāṭaṃ satyalokaśca mūrtāviti tathā'karot ।
sākṣādvai dṛśyate yatra sā'bdhiparvatakānanā ।।25।।
vārāhasya tathā mūrtiṃ dvipādāṃ ca samāsane ।
samāsīnāṃ śubhravarṇāṃ dṛḍharomasamujjvalām ।।26।।
lambaghoṇāṃ piṅgakeśāṃ sūkṣmanetrāṃ sakeśarām ।
vakrīkṛtya ca pādo dvau nitambābhyāṃ bhuvi sthitām ।।27।।
hastābhyāmagragābhyāṃ ca gadācakradharāṃ varām ।
vanamālādharāṃ dantottamoddhṛtadharāṃ tathā ।।28।।
samukuṭāṃ sakaṭakāṃ sakuṇḍalāṃ sasūtrikām ।
sadhautrāṃ sakaṭisūtrāṃ jalopari vyavasthitām ।।29।।
evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ ramyāṃ kānakīṃ ca varāhikām ।
pratimāṃ kārayāmāsa gopālakṛṣṇa eva ca ।।2.10.30।
tatpūjādyupacārāँśca sthāpayāmāsa maṇḍape ।
atha prāpte śubhe ramye kṣaṇe pitā tu lomaśam ।। 31 ।।
maharṣiṃ vādyaghoṣādyairāhvayāmāsa sādaram ।
ānāyya cāsane nyasya pūjāṃ tasya cakāra ha ।। 32।।
tataḥ pravartitāḥ svastivāco giraśca yoṣitām ।
kīrtanāni ca vādyāni tadāvādyanta cābhitaḥ ।। 3 3।।
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ toyaṃ śarkarāṃ nūtanaṃ madhu ।
pañcāmṛtaṃ samānīya pitā cāsthāpayat puraḥ ।।34।।
putraṃ śuddhiṃ kārayitvā mātā cānāyya maṇḍape ।
aṃke kṛtvā sthitā tatra riktabhūbhāgakottame ।।35।।
lomaśena gaṇeśasya mātṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ śubham ।
kāritaṃ ca surāṇāṃ bhūdevānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।।36।।
atha vaidikamantraiśca lomaśo bhūvarāhayoḥ ।
pūjanaṃ kārayāmāsa dampatībhyāṃ śubhāvaham ।।37।।
kanyakā bālakṛṣṇasya guṇān gāyanti gītikāḥ ।
pṛthvī devī divyakanyā samāgatya tato harim ।।38।।
natvā svasyāḥ pratimāyāmāvāhane sthirā'bhavat ।
hariścā''vāhane jāte caturbāhusvarūpavān ।।39।।
samāgatya tato deve varāhe'ntaḥ sthito'bhavat ।
lomaśastau tathā''vāhyā''camanaṃ pradadau priyam ।।2.10.40 ।।
arghaṃ dadau ca pādyaṃ cā''sanaṃ dadau śubhāvaham ।
pañcāmṛtena ca snānaṃ snānaṃ śuddhodakena ca ।।41 ।।
vastraiḥ sammārjanaṃ kṛtvā saugandhikaṃ dadau tataḥ ।
vastrāṇi dhātusūtrāḍhya'mūlyāni pradadau bhūṣāḥ ।।42।।
upavītaṃ dadau candra tilakaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ।
kajjalaṃ sindūrakaṃ ca viṣṇutailaṃ tato dadau ।।43।।
alaktakaṃ kaisaraṃ candanaṃ puṣpadalāni ca ।
tulasīpatrakaṃ mālā hārān manoharān dadau ।।44।।
śṛṃgāraṃ cārpayat sarvavidhaṃ saubhāgyasaddravān।
dadau ca śṛṃkhalāḥ saumyakaṭakānūrmikādikān ।।45।।
kuṃkumaṃ cā'bīrakaṃ cā'kṣatān gulālakādikam ।
datvā dhūpaṃ tathā dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadau ।।46।।
sarvadhānyasumiṣṭānnaṃ jalaṃ śārkaramiśritam ।
pānārthaṃ pradadau tāmbūlakaṃ cailālaviṃgakam ।।47। ।
phalaṃ saugandhikadravyaṃ śobhanaṃ kānakāsanam ।
dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇarūpyādi pradadau lomaśo muniḥ ।।48।।
dharādevyāśca devasyā''rārtrikaṃ pracakāra ca ।
namaḥ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇamāśiṣaḥ kusumāñjalim ।।49।।
daṇḍavat prārthanāṃ kṣamāyācanāṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
evaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vaidikān brāhmaṇāँstadā ।।2.10.5 0 ।।
āsīnān sannidhau sampūjayāmāsa pitā tadā ।
vādyāni ca tadā'vādyantātīva nartanaṃ śubham ।।51 ।।
devyaścakruśca kinnaryoṃ hyagāyanta sugītikāḥ ।
mātā putraṃ pūjanānte lomaśoktavidhānataḥ ।।52।।
pūjitāyā dharāyāśca sannidhau prokṣite sthale ।
arcite vandite kṣamāyācite sanyaṣādayat ।।5 3 ।।
tadā devī dharā mūrtimatī prāvirbabhūva ha ।
aṃke kṛtvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāśiṣā ।।54।।
kuṃkumādyaistathā miṣṭapāyasenā''dayat harim ।
anyā devyaḥ pupūjuścānarcuśca kanyakāstadā ।।55।।
dharādevyā śrīharaye duḥkhavāraṇakāñjaliḥ ।
mastake nihitaḥ svasyā mastake cāvatāritaḥ ।।56।।
vārāhaśca svayaṃ viṣṇurdivyastadā caturbhujaḥ ।
samabhūt sarvapratyakṣo bālakṛṣṇaṃ nanāma ca ।।57।।
svarṇasihāsanaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya sūkaro dadau ।
svarṇaśayyāṃ vasumatīṃ dadau dharā tu śāśvatīm ।।58।।
tābhyāṃ tatra sthāpitaśca bālakṛṣṇaṃ kramādatha ।
visarjanaṃ ca pūjāyāścakāra lomaśo muniḥ ।।59।।
tadā vai kambharālakṣmīrbhojayāmāsa lomaśam ।
brāhmaṇānṛṣimukhyāँśca sataḥ sādhvīśca kanyakāḥ ।। 2.10.60।।
dakṣiṇāḥ sarvaśo datvā natvā kṛtvā ca vandanam ।
sarvān visarjayāmāsa śāyayāmāsa vai sutam ।।61 ।।
evaṃ bhūmyupaveśasyotsavaṃ pitā cakāra ha ।
parihāraṃ tataścakre putraḥ svapiti śāntimān ।।62।।
athā''gatā tadā tatra bhikṣukī bhojanecchayā ।
dīnaveṣā dīnaravā divyarūpā'timāninī ।। 63 ।।
adṛṣṭapūrvā kācit sā putraṃ draṣṭuṃ samicchati ।
mātrā pṛṣṭā ca kā'si tvaṃ kimicchasi dadāmi te ।।64।।
sā prāha yadi satyā'si dehi me'tra sutaṃ tava ।
kandarā siṃhikā nāmnī dharāputrī kumārikā ।।66।।
asmi vasāmi śaileṣu viharāmi vaneṣvapi ।
mama mātā dharādevī pūjitā'dya dine tvayā ।।66 ।।
jñātvā'haṃ tvatra cāyātā darśanārthaṃ sutasya te। ।
ayaṃ manoharo bālaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।67। ।
dṛṣṭamātro hṛdaye me vāsaṃ cakāra duḥkhahā। ।
ahaṃ tapāmyaraṇyeṣu kāntārthe tamasā''vṛtā ।।68।।
nirāhārā ca nistejaskodarā cāpyasaṃskṛtā।
anyā api bhaginyo me santyadriṣu sahasraśaḥ ।।6 9 ।
kumārikā hi tāḥ sarvāstapanti kāntalabdhaye ।
yadi tvaṃ manyase mātardehi me putrakaṃ tava ।।2.10.70 ।।
rāmayiṣye sutaṃ te'tra labdhvā śāntiṃ pramodanam ।
tapaḥphalaṃ paraṃ prāpya datvā sutaṃ tu te punaḥ । ।71 । ।
yāsyāmi kāntanirdiṣṭaṃ sthānaṃ syāsyāmi tatra ca ।
mātaste'nugnahaścenme vad dehi sutaṃ tava । ।72 ।।
satyaṃ śape dharāputrī cāsmi kāntavimarṣiṇī ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhikṣuko mātā kandarā prāha kanyake । ।73 ।।
yadyevaṃ ced dharāputri! ramayainaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।
śrutvā tu kandarā tuṣṭā prasannā modasaṃbhṛtā ।।74।।
śīghraṃ jagrāha suptaṃ taṃ bālaṃ gamayituṃ kare ।
spṛṣṭvā cucumba taṃ premṇā nidrāsthaṃ vīkṣya sā muhuḥ ।।75।।
mātrā dattaṃ bhojanaṃ ca bhakṣayāmāsa kanyakā ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca dolāyāmāropyā''ndolanaṃ ca sā ।।76।।
karoti sma darśanaṃ ca muhuḥ karoti bhāminī ।
atha svasṛsnehavaśā sunatvā kambharāṃ satīm । ।77।।
ājñāṃ gṛhītvā tvānetuṃ gatā svabhaginīstadā ।
mervādiśailavartinyo yā yā yatrā'bhavaँśca tāḥ ।।78।।
tāpasīḥ sā samāhūya sambhūya punarāgatā ।
tāpasyo gahvarāḥ sarvāḥ kandarā'grasarāḥ śubhāḥ ।।79।।
āgatyā'yutasāhasrakanyakāḥ parameśvaram ।
sandraṣṭuṃ kuṃkumavāpyadhiṣṭhātrīṃ mātaraṃ satīm ।।।2.10.80।।
kambharāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ premṇā prārthayāmāsuracyutam ।
dehi no mātarityevamarthayāmāsuracyutam ।।81 ।।
śrutvā miṣṭasvarān bālo bubudhe śīghrameva tu ।
mātā dugdhaṃ pāyayitvā dadau tābhyaḥ kṛpānidhim । ।82।।
tāvattāsāmāgraho'bhūnmama pūrvaṃ mameti ca ।
tasyāstasyā grahaṇe'yaṃ dvitīyarūpavān muhuḥ । ।83 ।।
bhavatyevaṃ bāladātryā dayite yāvadeva na ।
tāvad dvitīyarūpeṇa grahitryā hastago'bhavat ।।84।।
kandarāṇāmayutaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇānvitaṃ tadvā ।
hyabhavacchāntimāpannaṃ ramate sma ca tena tāḥ ।।82 ।।
menire janusāphalyaṃ sarvāstāḥ kanyakāstadā ।
pūjayāmāsuretāstaṃ manogaṃ bālamohanam । ।86।।
harirhasaँśca tāḥ prāha varadānāya tāstadā ।
arthayāmāsurasyaiva prabhoḥ sevāṃ sadā'naghām ।।87।।
kaiṃkarya ca yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ satsevāṃ kṛṣgākāntatām ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha vāsaṃ ca lomaśāśramam ।।88 ।।
dadau tāsāṃ kanyakānāṃ punaḥ prāha hariśca tāḥ ।
kandarāsu ca sarvāsu kāryarūpāsu sarvadā । ।89।।
sādhavo me yogijanā nivatsyanti virāgiṇaḥ ।
satāṃ samāgamo nityaṃ bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 2.10.90 । ।
yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ satāṃ sevā sadā vaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
satāṃ bhaktyā ca me bhaktiḥ pāvitryaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।। 91 । ।
yuṣmākaṃ mama yogaśca sadā'tra kandarāsu vai ।
sthitānāṃ nityaṃ bhavatu muktiṃ dāsyāmi śāśvatīm ।।92 ।।
ahaṃ ca kandare sādhvi vatsyāmi tava gahvare ।
siṃhagahvarasaṃjñaṃ tad gahvaraṃ saṃbhaviṣyati । ।93 ।।
yatraikādaśikā kanyāḥ janma prāpsyati gahvare ।
tadvrataṃ tava putryāścaikādaśyāḥ sarvathā prajāḥ ।।94।।
kariṣyanti gahvarāṇi tīrthāni kandarāṇi ca ।
bhaviṣyanti tārakāṇi mamā'nugrahataḥ sadā ।। 95।।
evamuktvā ca bhagavān svamātṛsannidhau ca tāḥ ।
ābhāṣyā''hūya ca guruṃ lomaśāya dadau tu tāḥ ।। 96। ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā bhuktvā pītvā''śramaṃ yayuḥ ।
kṛṣṇaścaikasvarūpo'bhūnmātā''ścaryaṃ jagāma ca । ।97।।
kṛtapuṇyāśca tā mene kṛtakṛtyā nijātmasu ।
labdhavye parame labdhe kimanyattvavaśiṣyate ।। 98। ।
kṛpānāthaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā milatyeva hi rādhike ।
kṛpānugrahalābhārthe prākaṭyaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।।99। ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ kāntaṃ labheta ca ।। 2.10.10 0। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya prabhorbhūmyupaveśanasaṃskāre bhūmerayutaputrīṇāṃ siddhikādikandarāṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatiprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 10 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 010 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 11
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 012 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu vai rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
mātrādipoṣito nityaṃ vardhate bālacandravat ।। 1 ।।
nityaṃ tābhiśca kanyābhiḥ sevyate puruṣottamaḥ ।
nirmalaḥ svacchahṛdayaḥ paramātmā nirāśrayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
mātrānandakaraḥ pitṛpratibimbāmbakojjvalaḥ ।
taṃ vīkṣya bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvarūpānurūpiṇam ।। 3 ।।
prajā darśanakāriṇyo nijapuṇyaṃ hi menire।
enaṃ ca yogino dṛṣṭvā parameśaṃ hi menire ।। 4 ।।
lomaśaṃ tvekadā''hūya pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
māse ṣaṣṭhe karṇavedhaṃ raupyasūcyā'pyakārayat ।। 5 ।।
dviguṇena tu sūtreṇa puṣṭyāyuḥ śrīvivṛddhaye ।
asmin dine prage snātvā pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
lomaśasya tu hastenā'śvinīkumārapūjanam ।
kārayāmāsa tanmūrtiṃ kārayitvā tu rājatīm ।। 7 ।।
tatrā''vāhya tadā devavaidyaṃ pitā yadārcayat ।
tāvatra sākṣāt samāyātaḥ sūryatulyaḥ sakuṇḍalaḥ ।। 8 ।।
gṛhītvā sa kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ pasparśa pāṇinā hareḥ ।
karṇau sukomalo ramyau śaṣkulīcakraśobhanau ।। 9 ।।
sarvaśravaṇasiddhyādikṛtaśāśvatikā''śrayau ।
nairugṇyena rasenā'dau praliptau ca śravāvubhau ।। 2.11.1 0।।
tataśca pūjitā sūcī sūkṣmā navā ca kānakī ।
dṛḍhayā ca tayā karṇo viddhau yathāsthalaṃ tadā ।। 11 ।।
devavaidyena tu śanairlāghavena sukhena ca ।
sūcīsparśo'ti bālena na jñāto rasavaibhavāt ।। 1 2।।
atha viddhau yathāpekṣaṃ karṇau sūcī tadā'bhavat ।
kanyā mūrtimatī devī divyāmbaravibhūṣaṇā ।। 13।।
sarvāvayavaśobhāḍhyā candrojjvalā ca komalā ।
uvāca sā tadā devī mātaraṃ pitaraṃ mudā ।। 14।।
yasyā nārāyaṇasparśastasyā māyākṣayo dhruvam ।
mama māyā vinaṣṭā'dya rakṣa māṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 15।।
mātā śrutvā ca tāmāha kasya tvaṃ vidyase sutā ।
vadā'tra kānaki! devi! taveṣṭaṃ- saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 16 ।।
sūcī śrutvā''ha ca naijaṃ vṛttāntaṃ vai yathodbhavam ।
ahaṃ vai mānasī kanyā brahmaṇo'smi samudbhavā ।। 17।।
mama kāryaṃ pāragatvaṃ chidrīkaraṇamityapi ।
ekalāyāstathā kaṇṭakādidaityavināśanam ।। 18।।
tunnavāyaḥ śvaśuro me viśvakarmasutaśca saḥ ।
tunnavāyasya putrāya dorakāya samarpitā ।। 19।।
sakāntāyā mama kāryaṃ sandhānaṃ vai viyuktayoḥ ।
jaḍā'haṃ dhāturūpā'smi cetanā'smi ca devatā ।।2.11.20।।
kuṭumbaṃ me tathā dvedhā kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ sadā ।.
kāraṇaṃ devatārūpaṃ kāryaṃ bhautikamityapi ।।21।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te'tra dorakasya priyā'smyaham ।
mātaścā'haṃ tava putrabhaktā jātā'smi cādyataḥ ।।22।।
divyā divyasvarūpā ca kṛtvā viśeṣato'tra vai ।
sevāyāṃ tava putrasya rakṣa nārāyaṇasya mām ।। 23।।
śrutvaivaṃ kambharālakṣmīstāmuvāca tadā punaḥ ।
svāminā saha deveśi! vasā'smiṃllomaśāśrame ।। 24।।
svāmikuṭumbasahitā cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
vasā'tra nirbharā kṛṣṇaṃ sevituṃ hṛṣṭamānasā ।। 25।।
ityuktā sā prajaharṣa natvā'śvinīkumārakam ।
mātaraṃ śrīhariṃ tūrṇaṃ śvaśurasya gṛhaṃ gatā । । 26।।
vā? sammantrya ca śīghraṃ sakuṭumbā samāyayau ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca tīre pūrvasthale tu sā ।। 27।।
vartate sakuṭumbā vai kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ।
kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇamādāya vihartuṃ yānti tatsthalam ।। 28 ।।
tunnavāyāśramaṃ tīrthaṃ pūrvatīre tato'bhavat। ।
athaikadā tu sā kṛṣṇaṃ kaṭyāṃ nidhāya modate ।। 29।।
vicārayati nātho me bhagavāँstu kadā bhavet। ।
jñātvā manogataṃ tasyāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prāha hasaँśca tām ।। 2.11.30 ।।
vitarāmi ca te siddhiṃ bahurūpadharātmikām ।
bhava kanyāsvarūpā ca vasa vai lomaśāśramam ।। 31 ।।
mama prāptiryathākāle bhaviṣyati tavā'naghe ।
ityuktamātre sā devī divyarūpā hi kanyakā ।। 3 2।।
cārucampakavarṇābhā dvitīyarūpadhāriṇī ।
babhūva śrībālakṛṣṇasannidhau sarasastaṭe ।। 33 ।।
sā yayau kṛṣṇakāntena saha vai lomaśāśramam ।
dorakasya gṛhiṇyākhyā dorakasya gṛhe sthitā ।। 34।।
sā ca kṛṣaṇārpitasiddhyā koṭirūpadharā'bhavat ।
jagatsu sūcikārūpā samavyāpnot prasandhinī । । 22।।
evaṃ sā'nugrahalābhāt kṛṣṇakāntaṃ sadā'labhat ।
aśvinīputrakau vaidyau varadānāya sūcitau ।। 36 ।।
tāvapyārādhanārthaṃ ca yayācāte nivāsanam ।
tathā'stviti ca tau prāha kṛṣṇaḥ prasannamānasaḥ । । 37।।
tattīrthaṃ cāśvinīputrārāmanāma babhūva ha ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasastu pūrve tīre drumeṣu ca ।। 38।।
evaṃ kṛṣṇaprabhurvāsaṃ tābhyāṃ tasyai ca vai dadau ।
svayaṃ kanyādhṛtaścāyāt svasaudhaṃ pārameśvaram ।। 3 9।।
lomaśo'pi munistatra karṇavedhākhyasadvṛṣe ।
pūjanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ lebhe gopālakṛṣṇato bahu ।।2.11.40। ।
yayau nijāśramaṃ divyo lomaśo munirāṭ tataḥ ।
caitraśuklasya pūrṇāyāṃ tithau māse tu ṣaṣṭhake ।।41 ।।
samāgatāyāṃ tatraiva samāhūya ca lomaśam ।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā pitā'nnaprāśanaṃ śubham ।।42।।
dadhyājyamadhumiśraṃ ca bālakṛṣṇasya vai prabhoḥ ।
maṃgalasnānamevādau saṃkṛtvā mātṛkārcanam ।।43।।
pratiṣṭhāpya śuciṃ vahniṃ caruhomaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
brahmādipūjanaṃ cakre sadannānyapyabhojayat ।।44।।
brāhmaṇebhyastathā sadbhyo dīnāndhebhyaśca vai tathā ।
satībhyaḥ kanyakābhyaśca kumārebhyo'pyadād dhanam ।।45।।
gobhyo mṛgebhyo grāsāँśca kīṭakādibhyaśca piṣṭakam ।
jalaukaḥ kūrmamatsyebhyaścāpi kaṇān dadau tadā ।।46।।
kākapārāvatādibhyaḥ kaṇān dadau tadā pitā ।
vṛkṣavallītṛṇādibhyo jalāni pradadau tadā ।।47।।
pitṛbhyaśca surebhyaśca mānuṣebhyo dadau tadā ।
yatheṣṭāni ca bhojyāni tathopakaraṇānyapi ।।48।।
kumārikābhyaḥ sarvābhyo dravyabhūṣāmbarāṇi ca ।
dehayogyāni śṛṅgāravastūni sādhanāni ca ।।49।।
bhojanāsanayānāni pattrāṇāvaraṇāni ca ।
vidyāsādhanagranthāṃśca bhaktisādhanakāni ca ।।।2.11.50 ।।
dadau pitā tu divyāni bhogyāni vividhāni ca ।
athauṣadhayo bhūmisthāḥ sasyarūpāḥ kaṇapradāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
havyadāḥ phaladā kandamūladā godhūmādidāḥ ।
rasadā madhurā gundrasāradāḥ śarkarāpradāḥ ।।5 2 ।।
patradāḥ puṣpadā bhakṣyabhojyalehyakacoṣyadāḥ ।
rogahantryaḥ puṣṭikartryā vṛkṣagulmalatādikāḥ ।। 53 ।।
svasvajanyā''svādyavastūnyādāya kanyakātmikāḥ ।
sthāleṣu sannidhāyaiva navānnādīni sarvaśaḥ ।।54।।
savāditrakīrtanāni kurvantyaśca vibhūṣitāḥ ।
vahnivarṇojjvalāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhojayituṃ samāgatāḥ ।।55।।
kuṃkumavāpikodyāne paścime yojanāyate ।
sthālāni rakṣayitvaiva sasmaruḥ śrīpatiṃ prabhum ।।16 ।।
kalpodyāne cāgatāstā jñātvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
lakṣarūpadharo bhūtvā pratyekāṃ'kagato'bhavat ।।17।।
pratyekayā suvarṇasyā''sane saṃsthāpya vallabhaḥ ।
bhojitaḥ pūjito modito muhuścumbitaḥ prabhuḥ ।।58।।
bhagavānapi kaiśorarūpāṇi prāpya vai tataḥ ।
bhojanāni sumṛṣṭāni cakhāda snehatastadā ।।59।।
sarvābhyaḥ svaprasādaśca pradattaḥ sthālapūritaḥ ।
yadyad bhuṃkte ca tatsarvaṃ śrīhareryogatastadā ।।2.11.60।।
lakṣmyā saṃvardhitaṃ nyūnaṃ na kiñcidapi dṛśyate ।
tāḥ sarvāḥ karakamalairbhojayanti patiṃ prabhum ।।6 1।।
bhagavāँśca punarbhuṃkte tāsāṃ bhāvānubandhanaḥ ।
vāraṃvāraṃ bhojitaḥ pāyitaḥ prapūjitastathā ।।62।।
tāsāṃ ca pūrayāmāsa saṃkalpān divyarūpadhṛk ।
annaprāśanake cādyadine'nnāni cakhāda yat ।।63।।
aiśvaryaṃ vīkṣya tatsarvaṃ mumuhustatra keśave ।
bhagavāँśca jalaṃ pītvā bālarūpo babhūva ha ।।64।।
udgāraṃ tṛptidaṃ punaḥ punargṛhṇāti modate ।
atha tābhirharistatra vanditaḥ sevanāya ca ।।65।।
yathā sevāṃ tava kurmo nityaṃ vayaṃ tathā kuru ।
tvamātmā tvaṃ parātmā ca tvaṃ rasastvaṃ balaṃ ca naḥ ।।66।।
tvaṃ phalaṃ tva dalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvaṃ garbhastvaṃ ca mañjarī ।
tvaṃ mūlaṃ madhyamastambhastvaṃ śākhā'ṅkura ityapi ।।67।।
tvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ jīvanaṃ ca khādyaṃ tvaṃ khādako'pi ca ।
bhoktā tvaṃ bhojyamevā'si cā'ntarātmā'si nastathā ।।68।।
sraṣṭā pātā rakṣitā poṣayitā layabhūstathā ।
tvamevā'si parabrahma svāmī prāṇapriyaḥ patiḥ ।।6 9।।
asmākamāntaraṃ hṛdyaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama ।
sevāyāṃ rakṣaya nātha kurmaḥ sevāṃ yathā tava ।।2.11.7 0।।
ityuktaścāṃ'kago viṣṇuḥ prahasyā''ha ca devatāḥ ।
vanadevyo bhavatyo'tra vasantu lomaśāśrame ।।7 1 ।।
kanyārūpāstathā vṛkṣavallīrūpā api dhruvam ।
vallīrūpā drumarūpā udyānāvāsamaṃgalāḥ ।।72।।
tiṣṭhantu phalapuṣpādyaiḥ sevārthaṃ mama sarvadā ।
ityuktāstāḥ paraṃ prema jñātvā nārāyaṇasya vai ।।73 ।।
gṛhītvā'nugrahaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ babhūvurdvisvarūpikāḥ ।
vṛkṣavallīsvarūpāstāḥ kalpodyāne vasanti ca ।।74।।
atha kanyāsvarūpāstā yāvat paśyanti keśavam ।
punaḥ punaścāṃkagaṃ taṃ tāvat saṃhṛtya lomaśaḥ ।।75।।
rūpāṇi caikarūpo'bhūt śrīvallīkanyakāṃ'kagaḥ ।
hasan sasmāra ca muniṃ lomaśaṃ śāśvataṃ gurum ।।76।।
drāgeva smṛtamātro'sau divyadeha upasthitaḥ ।
tuṣṭāva parameśaṃ ca kā tvājñā vad māṃ prabho ।।77।।
haristasmai kanyakāstā vanadevīrdadau mudā ।
lomaśastā namaskṛtyā''śramaṃ nināya devatāḥ ।।78।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparā brahmarūpāstu sevikāḥ ।
haristato'bhavallupto yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ tadā ।।75।।
lomaśenā''veditaśca pitā putraparākramam ।
aiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ sarvaṃ jñātavān mudamāptavān ।।2.11.8 0।।
atha vai lomaśaṃ prāha gopālakṛṣṇakastadā ।
bālo'yaṃ vidyate bālo vastuto bālako na vai ।।8 1 ।।
camatkārā bhavantyasya divyapuruṣaceṣṭitāḥ ।
tasmād bhāvyo'pratarkyaśca kaścit sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।।82।।
vṛttirmukhyā kriyā mukhyā kā'sya vai saṃbhaviṣyati ।
rājā vā devavaryo vā gururvā tyāgavānapi ।।83 ।।
vad kā'sya niścitaikā vṛttirbhāvyā śubhāśrayā ।
ityukto lomaśaḥ prāha vastrapātradhanādikam ।।84।।
nidhehi purataścā'sya yad gṛhṇīyāttu viddhi tat ।
ityukto vai pitā śīghraṃ vṛttiṃ jñātuṃ puro'sya ca ।।89।।
vastraṃ pātraṃ cāyudhaṃ ca dhanaṃ granthaṃ ca lekhinīm ।
yaṣṭiṃ darbhaṃ hīrakaṃ ca mālikāṃ kaṇamuṣṭikām ।।86।।
sruvaṃ pūgīphalaṃ tantuṃ phalaṃ śaṃkhaṃ kapardikām ।
jalapātraṃ darpaṇaṃ ca sasyaṃ kṛtrimahaṃsakam ।।87।।
dīpaṃ chatraṃ ca pāṣāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ tathauṣadham ।
puṣpaṃ loṣṭhaṃ pādukāṃ ca sūcīṃ kalgiṃ nyadhāt punaḥ ।।88।।
dvātriṃśattāni vastūni vilokya bhagavānapi ।
dvātriṃśadbhujavān bhūtvā pasparśa yugapat prabhuḥ ।।89।।
sarvāṇyapi ca vastūni jānātyeva kalānidhiḥ ।
sarvavṛttimayo yo'sti kimavedyaṃ parātmanaḥ ।।2.11.90।।
kimasādhyaṃ kimakāryaṃ kimajñātaṃ hareḥ khalu ।
āścaryaṃ prāpa ca pitā harirjahāsa vai tadā ।।9 1।।
lomaśaḥ prāha ca kalāścatuḥṣaṣṭiranuttamāḥ ।
vartante'traiva deveśe purāṇapuruṣe gurau ।।।92।।
sarvakartā sarvavṛttidātā poṣṭā bhaviṣyati ।
sarvakāryakaraścāyaṃ paramātmā'sti śāśvataḥ ।।93 ।।'
mātā jaharṣa saṃśrutvā dṛṣṭvā sutasya vaibhavam ।
paśyatāṃ yāvatāṃ tāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hasan ।।94।।
pustakaṃ mālikāṃ dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ lekhinīṃ kuśam ।
anyābhyāṃ ca karābhyāṃ tu dhṛtvā caturbhujo'bhavat ।।95।।
mālāṃ ca pustakaṃ dhṛtvā dvibhujaśca tato'bhavat ।
aṃke kṛtvā pustakaṃ ca kṣiptvā kaṇṭhe ca mālikām ।।96 ।।
kalgīṃ cādāya hastena hasan nyadhāt svamastake ।
kusumaṃ samajighracca harirbālasvarūpavān ।। 97।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo'dṛśyata vai tadā ।
bāla eva svayaṃ taistairdhṛtairviśeṣatastadā ।। 98।।
jñāpayāmāsa pitrādyān tattadviśeṣavṛttikam ।
lomaśo'pi prasannaśca pūjāmādāya satkṛtim ।।99। ।
yayau nijāśramaṃ nityaṃ bhajate taṃ narāyaṇam ।
rādhike! te'nādikṛṣṇacamatkāro mayā muhuḥ ।। 2.11.100 ।।
kathito bhaktagamyaḥ sa pāṭhaśravācca mokṣadaḥ ।
mayā divyena tā līlāḥ pratyakṣamavalokitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya prabhoḥ karṇavedhasaṃskāraḥ, sūcyai camatkāra- darśanam, aśvinīkumāratīrtham, annaprāśanasaṃskāraḥ, vanadevatākāritaprāśanaṃ, vanadevatābhyo bahurūpaiścamatkāraḥ kāntaprāptiḥ, hare vṛttijñānārthaṃ purodhṛtavastraśastrādivastūni grahītuṃ bahurūpatā divyatā ceti nirūpaṇanāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 011 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 12
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 013 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike pāvanīṃ ramyāṃ samākarṇaya cāparām ।
śrīhareraiśvaryayuktāṃ kathāmaṣṭamamāsajām ।। 1 ।।
saurāṣṭre dakṣiṇe bhāge vyāghrāraṇyaṃ paraṃ mahat ।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tato'vācyāṃ tato'bdhirdvīpaśobhitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dvīpasyā'syā'bhavad rājā damanākhyo'tidāruṇaḥ ।
paścimādabriktadeśādāgatyā'surabhāvanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vāsaṃ rājyaṃ prasahyaiva karoti smā'tidāruṇaḥ ।
na manute baliṣṭho vai dharmaṃ svargaṃ punarbhavam ।। 4 ।।
balaṃ dharmo balaṃ rājyaṃ balaṃ svargaṃ balaṃ sukham ।
balena bhujyate rājyaṃ svargaṃ balena labhyate ।। 5 ।।
nā''huto'gnirdadātyanyadghṛtakṣayaṃ karoti ca ।
na japālabhyate rājyaṃ śastrād rājyaṃ tu labhyate ।। 6 ।।
na smṛddhirgamyate stutyā yuddhena śrīravāpyate ।
na kanyā labhyate dainyāt haraṇāt kanyakā'pyate ।। 7 ।।
nā'nuyāti prajā sāmnā'nuyāti daṇḍajād bhayāt ।
devāstu kalpanāmātrā na cā''yānti na bhānti ca ।। 8 ।।
vṛthā bhojyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vṛthā'rcanaṃ satāṃ tathā ।
mṛṣā jñānaṃ kathakānāṃ satyaṃ tu puruṣārthiṃnām ।। 9 ।।
balinaṃ lambate pṛthvī dāsā dāsyaḥ śrayanti ca ।
puruṣārthavihīnasya na dārā na gṛhaṃ dhanam ।। 2.12.1 0।।
balena labhyate yattat svīyaṃ naitikameva ca ।
balahīnamadharmāḍhyaṃ tasmāt kuryād balaṃ param ।। 1 1।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca balameva ca netarat ।
pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ nā'nyo'rthastasya vidyate ।। 12।।
balinaḥ sukhinaḥ santi nirbalāstu daridrakāḥ ।
balinaṃ copatiṣṭhanti calā lakṣmīśca sampadaḥ ।। 1 3।।
alasasya kṣudhitasya mukhe nāyāti bhojanam ।
viharatastu siṃhasya vane sampadyate'danam ।। 14।।
ime hiṃsyā ime neti dharmo loke vyavasthitaḥ ।
na tu mukhyaḥ sa śūrāṇāṃ mukhyatve balavān kṣayet ।। 15।।
vividhāsu prajāsvatra balavānagrago bhavet ।
paśupakṣipataṃgānāṃ balavānūrjito bhavet ।। 16 ।।
bhuṃkte svargaṃ balavāँśca bhāgyaṃ bale vyavasthitam ।
śrūyate balavānatra bhuvi saurāṣṭramaṇḍale ।। 17।।
susamṛddho'tibalavān nāmnā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre pitā kṛṣṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।। 18।।
bālakṛṣṇo'tra bālatve sthito'pi vartate prabhuḥ ।
anekabalasāhasro lomaśasyā''śraye'sti ca ।। 19।।
talā'rjantādikanyāśca santi lomaśakāśrame ।
rakṣasāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca vanināṃ kanyakāstathā ।।2.12.20।।
yuvatyaścātirūpāḍhyā bālakṛṣṇabalena vai ।
rakṣitāstatra vidyante mama yogyā hi tā yataḥ ।।2 1।।
mayā vai lomaśaṃ hatvā hatvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ tathā hatvā''netavyā me vaśe tu tāḥ ।।22।।
iti vicārya damano mahāsuro nijān bhaṭān ।
samāhūya sabhāyāṃ sa prakāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ nyadhāt ।। 23।।
mārtaṇḍaṃ ca pracaṇḍaṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bhāṇḍakaṃ tathā ।
duṣṭāṇḍaṃ ca kaṭāhāṇḍaṃ gartāṇḍaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ tathā ।।24।।
bhaṇḍaṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ kubhāṇḍaṃ ca śailāṇḍaṃ bhramarāṇḍakam ।
harjāṇḍaṃ cāpi garjāṇḍaṃ jaṭhrāṇḍaṃ gṛdhrakāṇḍakam ।।25 ।।
gokrāṇḍaṃ ghurghurāṇḍaṃ ca māyāṇḍaṃ sainyanāyakān ।
sarvān vīravatīṃ vāṇīmuvāca dānaveśvarān ।।26 ।।
lakṣasainyasamāyuktāḥ sannaddhā bhavatā'tra vai ।
saurāṣṭre vīrakanyāśca koṭiśo lomaśāśrame ।।27।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthe santi rakṣitāḥ ।
talājā tiṣṭhati tatra tathā'nyāśca sahasraśaḥ ।।28।।
ānetavyā balāttāśca balaṃ vai rājyamucyate ।
tāsāmiṣṭatamo bālo'ṣṭame māse pravekṣyati ।।29।।
śrūyate sa mahaiśvaryayuto nityaṃ na bālakaḥ ।
tasmāt sāvadhānabhāvā bhavatā'strādiyoginaḥ ।।2.12.30।।
caturaṃgaṃ balaṃ sarvaॆ sannahya yāta cā'grataḥ ।
vimānaiḥ kamalākārairvāhanairvyomagāmibhiḥ ।।3 1।।
sarvā''yudhaiḥ saha yāta cāgre kuॆkumavāpikām।
kāryaॆ trayaṃ prakartavyaṃ sādhyaṃ prāṇapradānakaiḥ ।। 3 2।।
āhartavyāḥ kanyakāstāḥ prāṇairapi dhanairapi ।
lomaśena samaṃ yuddhaṃ kartavyaṃ tadvināśakam ।।3 3 ।।
yadi kṛṣṇo vālarūpo mahān bhūtvā raṇaṃ caret ।
ghātayitavya evā'yaṃ kāryaॆ caitanmahattaram ।। 34।।
evaṃ kāryatrayaṃ kāryaṃ pratijñāṃ yāta matpade ।
ipyuktāstatra kūṣmāṇḍaḥ prāha vinayagarbhitam ।। 35।।
bhṛtyoktaṃ hitakṛdvākyaṃ mantavyaṃ kaṭu vā bhavet। ।
ahaṃ kūṣmāṇḍakeṣveva gaṇeṣu śaṃkarasya ca ।। 36।।
sthitvā vai śrutavān pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
paramātmā'surahāśca daityahā dānavakṣayaḥ ।।37।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vartate divyavigrahaḥ ।
hiraṇyakūrcaprabhṛternāśakānāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 38।।
yasyaikaromṇi padmāni daśakoṭyayutāni vai ।
vartante devatāḥ sarvā balavaddaityanāśikāḥ ।।39।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā rudrā vidyādharādayaḥ ।
nāgāḥ sarpāḥ pattalasthāḥ kiṃkarā yasya vai matāḥ ।।2.12.40।।
tasya cecchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhanameva tāḥ ।
kanyakā yadi vartante mā spraṣṭavyāstu tāḥ kvacit ।।41।।
śaraṇaṃ maraṇaṃ tatra paśyāmi netarat param ।
nā'tilobhaḥ prakartavyaḥ śāśvataṃ sukhamicchatā ।।42।।
paradravyaṃ na hartavyaṃ dīrghaṃ jīvanamicchatā ।
yat svasya bhāgyataḥ prāptaṃ tanna kaiścidviyujyate ।।43।।।
yatparārthaṃ samutpannaṃ tannātmārthaṃ hi jāyate ।
kṛte tatra puruṣārthe vaiparītyaṃ prajāyate ।।44।।
striyo dravyaṃ kṣitiśceti poṣayanti nijāśrayam ।
yadi puṇyena labdhāśced viparītāstu nāśakāḥ ।।।45।।
āyuryaśo balaṃ dravyaṃ santānaṃ rājyamityapi ।
viparītā yadi te syurnāśayanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।46।।
tava rājan bahu cāsti patnyo dravyaṃ prajājanaḥ ।
dāsā dāsyo gajāśceti kathaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ na muñcasi ।। 47।।
tṛṣṇāyā bahavo naṣṭāḥ padmabhramaravanniśi ।
santoṣeṇa tu bahavo modante nijavastuṣu ।।48।।
mayoktaṃ kaṭu cāpyasti kintu miṣṭaṃ tu bhāvini ।
saṃkṣepānnāyayuktā'nyad duḥkhadaṃ ceti vedmyaham ।। 49।।
tathāpi manyase rājan kartavyaṃ cānugā vayam ।
avaśyaṃ hi kariṣyāmo maraṇārthaṃ tavehitam ।।2.12.50।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau kūṣmāṇḍaśca tataḥ param ।
mārtaṇḍādyā api tattvaṃ vimṛśyocurnijādhipam ।।51।।
vahnau ratnaṃ ravau puṣpaṃ ratnākaratale maṇim ।
hṛdayasthaṃ ca raktaṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇakāntāḥ samicchasi ।। 52।।
labdhaṃ cāpi na sukhadaṃ labdhavyaṃ ca durantakam ।
bhṛtyaistathāpi nopalaṃghyā rājājñā pārameśvarī ।।53।।
javrāṇḍaśca tadā vṛddho maghrāṇḍaśca sahāyakaḥ ।
ubhau balena tān satyān śauryābhaṃ prāhatustadā ।।54।।
manorasthāstu jāyante pravartante janāstathā ।
śūrā nirmālyavalloke bhavanti yadi niṣkriyāḥ ।।55।।
pravṛttiṃ ke kariṣyanti parīkṣārhe tu vastuni ।
śūrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ yuddhe nimittaṃ strīdhanādikam ।।56।।
vijaye sati cāyānti parājaye vināśanam ।
paralokapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maraṇaṃ raṇamadhyataḥ ।।57।।
ityevameva matvaiva yatra ratnāni santi ca ।
tatra gatvaiva śūraiśca prāptavyāni samarpaṇāt ।।58।।
tasmād yuddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ prāptavyāḥ kanyakāśca tāḥ ।
lomaśo bālakṛṣṇaśca tathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।59।।
anye teṣāṃ sahāyāśca hantavyā vighnadā hi naḥ ।
iti śrutvā jāgṛtāṇḍo vicāryā''ha sabhājanān ।।2.12.60।।
harirbālo vidyate ca rudrādyā nahi bālakāḥ ।
trayastriṃśatkoṭidevā na bālāḥ kṛṣṇapūjakāḥ ।।6 1।।
akāṇḍaṃ pralayaṃ draṣṭuṃ yadicchatha praśūrakāḥ ।
kuruta vijayaṃ gantuṃ dharmarājā''titheyakam ।।62।।
damanastu tadā śrutvā sarveṣāṃ nirbalātmakam ।
eṣo'haṃ prathamaṃ yāmītyuktvā'siṃ dhṛtavān kare ।।63।।
ye jīvalubdhā gacchantu naijaṃ gṛhaṃ vihāya mām ।
raṇaśūrāḥ samāyāntu śīghraṃ sainyasamanvitāḥ ।।64।।
rājā damanakaścaivaṃ krudhā śauryeṇa jalpavān ।
amanaskāḥ samanaskāḥ sarve sajjāstadā'bhavan ।।65।।
gamane cā'śakunāni jātānyeṣāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
kṛṣṇasarpā'valokaśca ghūkadarśanamityapi ।।66 ।।
mukuṭānāṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ pātanaṃ yānabhañjanam ।
dāridryadarśanaṃ riktapātrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ tathā ।।67।।
agre yāti rajako nāpitastamanugacchati ।
śuṣkakāṣṭhe rauti kāko bhūkampo'pi vyajāyata ।।68।।
teṣāṃ strīṇāṃ ca keśebhyaḥ srastāni kusumāni ca ।
akāle'pi rajobhāvo gṛhaṃ vahnirdadāha ca ।।69।।
paśupakṣivirāvāśca trāsadāścā'bhavaँstadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapreritameva hi ।।2.12.70।।
kāle sarvaṃ bhavatyeva damanasya tu kā kathā ।
ityevaṃ cā'paśakune jāyamāne'pi rādhike! ।।71 ।।
kanyakālālasāvyāpto damanaḥ sainyasaṃyutaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tvāgato lomaśāśramam ।।72।।
cakāra śaṃkhanirghoṣaṃ vādayāmāsa dundubhim ।
raṇatūryāṇi bahudhā tāḍayāmāsa tajjanaiḥ ।।73।।
dūtaṃ svaṃ preṣayāmāsa lomaśaṃ prati kharvaṭam ।
kharvaṭastu samāgatya nanāma pādayoḥ ṛṣeḥ ।।74।।
sandeśaṃ kathayāmāsa damanasya nayena ha ।
ṛṣe! rājā damanakaḥ sāmudrakṣitirājyavān ।।75।।
āvedayati mānyasya pūjyasya pādayornaman ।
kanyakāḥ koṭiśo rājayogyāḥ santi tavā''śrame ।।76।।
dehi naḥ kṛpayā śāntyā vinayena raṇena vā ।
lomaśastaṃ kharvaṭaṃ ca prāha nemā dhanaṃ mama ।।77।।
bālakṛṣṇasya tu dhanaṃ kathaṃ dātuṃ samutsahe ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।।78।।
tasya śāśvatanikṣepaḥ kathaṃ dīyeta vai mayā ।
yātaca bālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kurutā'thavā ।।79।।
ityuktaḥ sa kharvaṭastu natvā yayau nṛpaṃ prati ।
uvācā'nupūrvikāyugvākyaṃ śrutvā damastadā ।।2.12.80।।
prairayat kanyakā hartuṃ sarvān daityān bhayaṃkarān ।
sainyaṃ lomaśabhūbhāgaṃ samāvṛṇot samantataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
dharṣayantu cāharantu mardayantu ca kanyakāḥ ।
nītvā nītvā samāyāntu tvevaṃ sainyabhaṭāstadā ।।82।।
ākrośanto dudruvuśca garjayantaḥ parasparam ।
yatra tāḥ kanyakāḥ santi dṛṣṭvā dudruvurantikam ।।83।।
kolāhalaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā bhītāstu kanyakā harim ।
sasmarurlomaśaṃ nivedayāmāsurmahābhayam ।।84।।
dhyānastho lomaśastatra bālakṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।
smṛtvā vai stambhanamantraṃ prākṣipat kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।।85।।
tāvat sainyaṃ jaḍībhūtaṃ vṛkṣastambā yathā tathā ।
sarvaṃ niśceṣṭamevā''sīt kāṣṭhaputtalikā yathā ।।86।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīd damanasya bhaṭeṣu ca ।
nāyakāścāti santrastā mṛtyumukhe gatā iva ।।87।।
atha bālaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jñātvā'tidāruṇam ।
priyāṇāṃ ca tadā kaṣṭaṃ cāgacchat kanyakāḥ prati ।।88।।
lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ natvā śaṃkhacakradharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
saumyadṛṣṭyā priyā vīkṣya hasaṃstasthau kṣaṇaṃ puraḥ ।।89।।
lomaśena pradatte tvāsane vai niṣasāda saḥ ।
bhayodvignāḥ kanyakāśca rakṣa nātheti vai jaguḥ ।।2.12.9 0।।
atha te jaḍatāṃ prāptā damanādyāḥ śilā iva ।
manasā śaraṇaṃ jagmurlomaśaṃ parameśvaram ।। 91 ।।
aparāddhaṃ yuddhabalairnātmabalaiḥ kṛpāṃ kuru ।
ātmabalāṃśaleśena balaṃ no vilayaṃ gatam ।।92।।
nirbalāścā'balāstulyāstato naścā'balājanān ।
jaḍabhāvāt pravicāvya jīvanaṃ dehi naḥ prabho ।।93 ।।
ityevaṃ te hṛdā munerlomaśasya tu pādayoḥ ।
śaraṇaṃ nemuratyarthaṃ tadā'nugrahavān muniḥ ।।94।।
jaḍabhāvaṃ stambhanaṃ mocayāmāsa hare puraḥ ।
atha duṣṭasvabhāvena damanena niyojitāḥ ।।95।।
punaḥ kanyāḥ samākraṣṭuṃ nipetuḥ śyenavattadā ।
dṛṣṭvā'parāddhaṃ bhagavān sudarśanaṃ mumoca ha ।।96।।
vahnijvālāmayaṃ naikarūpadhṛk sarvatodiśam ।
ciccheda sasyavad daityān lakṣaśastatra raṃhasā ।। 97।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa sainyaṃ tat nāyakā damakastathā ।
sarve chinnāstadā dvedhā naikaḥ śeṣo'pi vidyate ।। 98।।
dagdhāḥ sarve'pi tatraiva saudarśanena vahninā ।
sudarśanaṃ harerhaste nītvā''tmanaḥ samāgatam ।। 99।।
kṛṣṇamūrtau layaṃ yātā lakṣātmānastu rādhike।
bhagavāँścakramādāya natvā ca lomaśaṃ munim ।। 2.12.10 0।।
vīkṣyā''bhāṣya priyāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakā hi muhurmuhuḥ ।
bālarūpaṃ vidhāyaiva paryaṃkikāṃ samāyayau ।। 10 1।।
ityevaṃ bhagavāṃścakre daityalakṣapraṇāśanam ।
kṣaṇādvai kimasādhyaṃ śrīpateḥ śrīrādhikāpateḥ ।। 1 02।।
yatrā'surā vinaṣṭāste cakreṇa nihatāstadā ।
cakrakhātā'bhavatprakhyā bhūmiḥ sā sarasastaṭe ।। 103 ।।
cakratīrthaṃ tu tajjātaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
evaṃ bhagavatā tatra bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ kṛtam ।। 1 04।।
śrotuḥ śrāvayituḥ smarturvācayituścamatkṛteḥ ।
mokṣaḥ syādeva vā smṛddhirbhavet sukāma ityapi ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dakṣiṇodadhisthadamanakadaityasya kanyakā hartuṃ lomaśāśramamāgatasya lomaśena kṛto jaḍībhāvo bālakṛṣṇena sudarśanena kṛtaḥ sasainyasya dhvaṃso mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 12।।


← adhyāyaḥ 012 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 13
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 014 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe hyasurāṇāṃ pāvakaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
sarvān daityān nijalīnān kṛtvā dhāmni svako'nayat ।। 1 ।।
adhamoddhāra evaṃ śrībhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ rakṣasāṃ dviṣāṃ virodhinām ।। 2 ।।
śaraṇaṃ svaṃ prapannānāmārttihā mokṣado hi saḥ ।
anugraho'yaṃ kṛṣṇasya śrīpateḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kṛpāsādhyo hyayaṃ mokṣaḥ pāritoṣikavanmataḥ ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike daityā mokṣaṃ gatā mṛtā iti ।। 4 ।।
śrutvā damanapatnī ca śīlahākhyā tathā'parāḥ ।
mārtaṇḍādipradhānānāṃ vīraśmidyuhanādikāḥ ।। 5 ।।
dhībhakṣyā vānasī śauṇḍī mātīryā kaṇḍikā hṛti ।
kuṇṭhā kāluṣikī dhūmrā pādhūlī ca rajo'ṇḍikā ।। 6 ।।
karaṃdhamī ca vikaṭī datkaṭī dāmanī rukhā ।
dāminī tālajaṃghā ca dīrghikā daṇḍikā ghaṭī ।। 7 ।।
horā āyā damā diṣṭiḥ piṣṭiḥ pāmpī prakuṇḍikā ।
karaṇḍikādyāśca tathā pradhānānāṃ priyāstu tāḥ ।। 8 ।।
samākarṇya tu daityānāṃ mṛtyuṃ rurudurutsvarāḥ ।
hā hatāḥsmeti cukruśurvyastakeśā vimūrchitāḥ ।। 9 ।।
vinaṣṭasarvaśṛṃgārāḥ sarvasaubhāgyavarjitāḥ ।
prāṇahīnā iva lakṣādhikā vaidhadhyapīḍitāḥ ।। 2.13.1 0।।
athā''yāt tatra vai tāsāṃ gurvī vai śukrajīvanī ।
sāntvayāmāsa bodhena vairaniryāpanaṃ tathā ।। 1 1।।
vayaṃ sarvā gamiṣyāmo haniṣyāmaśca lomaśam ।
bālaṃ hatvā kariṣyāmo vināthāḥ sarvakanyakāḥ ।। 12।।
sajjābhavatha sarvāśca patyarthaṃ prāṇadāyikāḥ ।
svāmimārgaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā vairasya tarpaṇam ।। 13 ।।
yā na patyuḥ kṛte naṣṭā jīvitā'pi mṛtā hi sā ।
patirdhanaṃ hi nārīṇāṃ tadgate vigataṃ dhanam ।। 14।।
patirdaivaṃ patirbhāgyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ patireva ca ।
svāmī mānaṃ patiḥ śobhā pratiṣṭhā svāmini sthitā ।। 15।।
keśāḥ kaṃkaṇamābhogāḥ śobhante patijīvanāḥ ।
teṣāṃ nāśe jīvanaṃ tu naṣṭaṃ strīṇāṃ tato januḥ ।। 16।।
nirarthakaṃ bhavet paścānmaraṇaṃ sārthakaṃ bhavet। ।
satīrūpeṇa martavyaṃ vairaniryāpanaṃ vinā ।। 17।।
nirarthikā mṛtiḥ sā'tra na sā patyuḥ praśāntaye ।
vairaniryāpanaṃ kṛtvā sṛtiḥ patyuḥ praśāntidā ।। 18।।
tasmādāyāta sarvāśca sambhūya kṛtaniścayāḥ ।
sannahya sarvā yotsyāmo haniṣyāmaśca kanyakāḥ ।। 19।।
lomaśasya jaṭājūṭān troṭayiṣyāma eva ca ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ hariṣyāmo mārayiṣyāma eva vā ।।2.13.20।।
ityāmantrya tadā daityapatnyo lakṣā'tilakṣakāḥ ।
śīlahādyāḥ śastrayuktāḥ samutpeturvihāyasā ।। 21 ।।
śaktitomarakhaṅgā'sibhūśuṇḍīmudgarā''yasān ।
cipīṭakān muśalāṃśca daṇḍān dantrān triśūlakān ।।22।।
kuntān sitāḥ kṛpāṇāँśca cakrāṇi paṭṭiśān śarān ।
kuntalān churikā vedhān dṛṣado yaṣṭikāḥ kaśān ।। 23।।
śaṃkūnaṃkuśakān bhallān vaṃśānagnimukhān karān ।
kṣepaṇān bandhanān pāśān raśmīn pannigaḍān kaṭān ।।24।।
kuṭhārān paraśūn kāṣṭhopalāḥ pādāँśca śṛṃkhalāḥ ।
evaṃ bahuvidhān śastrahetīn dhṛtvā'surastriyaḥ ।। 25।।
varmayuktāścarmayuktāḥ sthālīgopitamūrdhajāḥ ।
sakacchā baddhakaṭikāḥ sudṛḍhāmbarabandhanāḥ ।। 26।।
satrāṇasādhanā yānairvyomnā vāditraniḥsvanaiḥ ।
trāsayantyo jagatsarvaṃ cāyayurlomaśāśramam ।। 27।।
madyapānāraktanetrā māṃsādanapramādikāḥ ।
unmattavatpralāpinyaścāvaterurbhuvaṃ prati ।। 28।।
kṛṣṇakajjalaśṛṃgādikṛtacitrānanāstadā ।
stanayoḥ raktacandrābhicakrādibhirbhayaṃkarāḥ ।।।29।।
chindhi māraya bhindhīti khādayainaṃ ca mardaya ।
carvaya prāṇataścainaṃ pracūrṇaya madādibhiḥ ।।2.13.30।।
āntrāṇyāsāṃ karṣayantu peṣayantu śilātale ।
mastakāni sphoṭayantu pibantu rudhirāṇi ca ।।3 1 ।।
carvayantu ca māṃsāni kanyakānāṃ harestathā ।
lomaśaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ sakhyaḥ kurvantu bhavatīvrajāḥ ।।32।।
anenā'smatsvāmino vai hatā bhasmā'tra vidyate ।
lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ cātra mārayantu prahārakaiḥ ।।3 3 ।।
karṣayantu tato mūtrakardame malamiśritam ।
kardamaṃ cāsya ca mukhe nikṣipantu ca cakṣuṣoḥ ।।34।।
netre cotpāṭayantvasya śūle cāropayantu ca ।
dvedhā padbhyāṃ viniṣpīḍya dvidalaṃ kārayantu ca ।। 35।।
evaṃ tā vadamānā vai lomaśasyā''śramaṃ gatāḥ ।
parito vanavṛkṣādyān nāśayāmāsurugragāḥ ।। 36।।
vallīrvināśayāmāsurgrāhayāmāsurutkarāḥ ।
mayūrādīn śukān haṃsān hariṇān jaghnurulbaṇāḥ ।।37।।
lomaśarṣiryoṣitāṃ tān gaṇānnaivā'valokayat ।
strīṇāmabhibhavaḥ puṃsā naiva kāryaḥ kadācana ।।38।।
tatrāpi muninā naivaṃ vicāryeti dadau na hṛt। ।
tāvattāstu samāyātāḥ saśastrā dhartumeva tam ।। 39।।
ṛṣiṃ sarvāḥ kanyakāśca nāśayituṃ prarebhire ।
vilokyaitattu ṛṣiṇā jalamādāya sarvataḥ ।।2.13.40।।
svasya rakṣā kanyakānāṃ tathā rakṣā kṛtā tadā ।
kṣiptaṃ jalaṃ vahnirūpaṃ vyajāyata dadāha tāḥ ।।41।।
vahniḥ prākārarūpeṇā'vyāpnot saṃparitastadā ।
daityastrīṇāṃ mahat sainyaṃ vartulākāravahnirāṭ ।।42।।।
ūrdhvaṃ vitānarūpaśca bhūtvā rurodha rākṣasīḥ ।
dadruvurdahyamānāstā bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ prati ।।43।।
atha kanyā api sarvā lomaśo munirāḍapi ।
mitho jagurimā rākṣasyo vai yānti hariṃ prati ।।44।।
mārayiṣyanti taṃ bālaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ ca vā ।
atha strībhirna yoddhavyaṃ puruṣaiḥ sarvathā yataḥ ।।45।।
strībhiḥ sākaṃ suyoddhavyaṃ strībhireva hi dharmataḥ ।
bhavatyaḥ kanyakāḥ sarvā dhārayantu hi varma ca ।।46।।
śastrāṇīmāni sarvāṇi dhārayantu yathāyatham ।
mantrān divyān dhārayantu nāśayantu ca tā drutam ।।47।।
ityuktvā lomaśaḥ śīghraṃ patyarthaprāṇarakṣikāḥ ।
kanyakāḥ śrāvayāmāsa śrīsvāmikavacaṃ tadā ।।48।।
trirācamya hariṃ dhyātvā prāṇānāyamya tristathā ।
mastake me harerastu mastakaṃ ca mukhe mukham ।।49।।
netrayorme'sya netre stāṃ śravasorme'sya vai śravau ।
mamakaṇṭhe hareḥ kaṇṭho hastayorme hareḥ karau ।।2.13.50।।
vakṣasi stanayorme ca harervakṣaḥstanau tathā ।
udare me hare rastūdaraṃ kaṭyāṃ hareḥ kaṭiḥ ।।।51।।।
pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaṃ nitambayorme nitambau harestathā ।
gupte guptaṃ tathā sakthnoḥ sakthinī pādayoḥ pade ।।52।।
sarvā mūrtirharerastu mayi sarvāṃgamūrtike ।
itinyāsān vidhāyaiva svāmikavacamuccaret ।।53।।
om anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvaprahetimān ।
divyavimānamārūḍhaḥ sarvarakṣāṃ karotu naḥ ।।54।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacarmāsicāpapāśavān ।
dhanustriśūlaśaravān śastrebhyo'vatu no hariḥ ।।55।।
vyomni divyakramo'vyānno'nale kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
vāyau prāṇapatiḥ pāyājjale svāmī parātparaḥ ।।56।।
pṛthvyāmavyād bālakṛṣṇo yuddhe'vyātpuruṣottamaḥ ।
śastrāstramantrapātebhyo'vyānnaḥ patiḥ phalasthitaḥ ।।57।।
indrajālādimāyābhyo'ntarātmā'vyāt śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
priyasvāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'vyātkālavegataḥ ।।58।।
rākṣasībhyaḥ kṛṣṇakāntaścāvyādanavadhānataḥ ।
mṛpyurogā'cintyabhībhyaḥ pātu na kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।59।।
bhautikebhyo vikārebhyaḥ pātu no'kṣaradhāmapaḥ ।
sarvāvasthāsu sarvebhyaḥ pātu tvantaragaḥ prabhuḥ ।।2.13.6 0।।
saṃhara rākṣasīsainyaṃ rakṣaya kanyakākulam ।
ānandaya tato naśca jayaṃ dehi pareśvara ।।6 1 ।।
omanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'sya devatā'vatu ।
lomaśāya namaḥ svāmikavacasyarṣaye sadā ।।62।।
kambharāśrīmahālakṣmyai rakṣākartryai namo'vatu ।
nārāyaṇāya gopālakṛṣṇāya ca namo'vatu ।।63।।
ityuccāvitamevaitat kavacaṃ koṭirūpadhṛka ।
kṣaṇādajāyata koṭisūryavarculamujjvalam ।।64।।
kanyāstā dhārayāmāsū rādhike ca tvayā saha ।
mañjulā pārvatī lakṣmīḥ prabhā haṃsā ca māṇikī ।।65।।
koṭikoṭyaḥ svarṇavarṇaṃ dadhyustacchedavarjitam ।
avṛṇaṃ cā'viyuktaṃ ca varma varṣmasu pūritam ।।66।।
komalaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ cāpi sukhasparśaṃ ca rakṣakam ।
dhṛtvā jalena sākaṃ ca śastrāstramantrakān papuḥ ।।67।।
kanyakāvarmamantrāḍhyā yugapat kṛpayā'bhavan ।
'grasatvetat kṛṣṇakāntaḥ kāntārthamoṃ kṣaḥ phaṭ svāhā' ।।68।।
jajapustā mantramevaṃ cāṣṭottaraśataṃ tadā ।
yuddhe sarvatra cānyatra yaḥ smṛto rakṣako'sti vai ।।69।।
mantraścāyaṃ dhṛtastābhirjaptaścāpi tataḥ param ।
lomaśaḥ pradadau tābhyo'ṇimādyāḥ siddhayastathā ।।2.13.70।।
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni cā'pradhṛṣyāṇi yānyapi ।
sandhinīyojinīkṣatavāriṇīśūlahāriṇīḥ ।।7 1।।
jalā''camanasārdhaṃ vai dadau vidyāḥ sahasraśaḥ' ।
anekarūpabhavanaṃ mṛṣāsatyavidhāraṇam ।।72।।
antardhānaṃ punarbhāvaṃ sarvavidyā dadau tadā ।
koṭyarbudānāṃ kanyānāṃ sainyaveṣāँstadā drutam ।।73।।
jalabindvabhyukṣaṇena kṛtavān lomaśo muniḥ ।
tūryavāditrayānāni gajasiṃhā'śvakāni ca ।।74।।
haṃsagaruḍayānāni kṣaṇājjalena cā'karot ।
tāvat tūryāṇyavādyantotpeturvyomni kumārikāḥ ।।75।।
yatrā'ste bhagavān kṛṣṇo bālaḥ svāmī gṛhāntare ।
kṣaṇadhyānena gatvaitāścā'mbaraṃ prāpya cāgrataḥ ।।76।।
rākṣasīnāṃ tu sainyānāṃ vāraṇārthaṃ vyavasthitāḥ ।
rādhā lakṣmīḥ ramā śrīśca pārvatī māṇikī prabhā ।।77 ।।
maṃgalā manasā revā bhārgavī ca sarasvatī ।
gaṃgā ca mañjulā bhaktirmuktirekādaśī ratiḥ ।।78।।
haṃsā saguṇā tulasī kamalā virajā satī ।
mūrtiśca gomatī svarṇarekhā jayā ca nandinī ।।79।।
durgā lalitā sāvitrī dolā puṣpā kalāvatī ।
badarī mādhavī pampā ṣaṣṭhī prītiḥ ṛtadhvajī ।।2.13.80।।
mauktikā lāḍakī devī manuḥ kastūrikā sitā ।
haimī śāntiḥ praśāntā ca campā godāvarī yamī ।।8 1।।
ojasvatī ca savitā ratnā miṣṭā'mṛtā dhaniḥ ।
caturā vajrikā muktā suśīlā śyāmikā'malā ।।82।।
santuṣṭā candrikā kāntiḥ kuṃvarī ca śivādikāḥ ।
etāścānyāḥ śataṃ cāpi catvāriṃśattadgragāḥ ।।83।।
saināpatye'bhavannagragatāḥ koṭyo balātmikāḥ ।
harṣanādāँstadā cakrurjayakṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।।84।।
jaya kānta mahākānta parameśvara vai jaya ।
jaya svāmin jaya nātha, lomaśo'pi jayatviha ।।85।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
evaṃ mantraṃ raṭantyaśca rodhayāmāsurāsurīḥ ।।86।।
'grasatvetat kṛṣṇakāntaḥ kāntārtham oṃ kṣaḥ phaṭ svāhā' ।
mantrajāpaṃ tadā'kurvan vārayāmāsurāsurīḥ ।।87।।
ākasmikaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ sainyaṃ cāmbaramārgataḥ ।
samāyātaṃ vīkṣya mātāpitarau vāsino'pare ।।88।।
bhayaṃ prāpustadā bālakṛṣṇo bhūtvā kiśorakaḥ ।
pitṛbhyāmāha bhetavyaṃ naiva naiva ca naiva ca ।।89।।
niryātuṃ vidhavā vairaṃ rākṣasyo yoddhumāgatāḥ ।
striyo naiva prahantavyā mayā kvāpi nareṇa yat ।।2.13.90।।
lomaśenāpi hantavyā naiva naiva kadācana ।
vahninā''śramarakṣāṃ sa cakāra gururāḍ yataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
tā bhītāśca tato'trāpi māṃ hantuṃ cāgatāḥ khalu ।
lomaśapreṣitāstābhiryuddhyantāṃ kanyakāstvimāḥ ।।92।।
sannaddhā mantraśastrāstrayuddharmodibṛṃhitāḥ ।
koṭiśastā imāḥ sainyarūpeṇā'mbarasaṃsthitāḥ ।।93।।
yuyutsantīcchayā me'mba! nā'tra citraṃ kathaṃcana ।
iti kṛṣṇe pravadite garuḍān haṃsavājinaḥ ।।94।।
gajān yānāni divyāni brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
dadurvyomni kanyakābhyo rathān vimānakāni ca ।।95।।
vīrakanyāmahāsainyaṃ vāhanairupaśobhitam ।
yāvat tāvattu rākṣasyaḥ samutpetuḥ samantataḥ ।। 96।।
tāḍayāmāsuratyugraṃ vīrakanyāgaṇaṃ tadā ।
kanyakā raṇacaṇḍyastāḥ pratitāḍanamācaran ।। 97।।
gajānāṃ vājināṃ haṃsagaruḍānāṃ ninādanam ।
siṃhānāṃ devayānānāṃ garjanaṃ cāṇḍamāvṛṇot ।।98।।
gardabhānāṃ tathoṣṭrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca rakṣasām ।
śunāṃ ca jambukānāṃ cā'krośāstatrā'bhavan prati ।।99।।
hetīnāṃ cā''yudhānāṃ ca śarāṇāṃ pātanāni vai ।
hantrīṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ cānyonyaṃ deheṣvabhavan muhuḥ ।। 2.13.100 ।।
nijaghnustomaraiḥ kāścit kāścijjaghnuḥ kṛpāṇakaiḥ ।
kāścit keśān pragṛhyaiva cikṣipuḥ pṛthivītale ।। 10 1।।
anyā jaghnurgadābhiśca tathā'parāstu mūśalaiḥ ।
bhindīpālaiścetarāśca nijaghnuścā'sibhiḥ parāḥ ।। 1 02।।
khaḍgaiścānyā upalābhiḥ pāṣāṇaiḥ kṣepaṇaistathā ।
śṛṃkhalābhistathā daṇḍairnārācaiśca śaraiḥ parāḥ ।। 1 03।।
hanyante tatra rākṣasyo jīvato na tu kanyakāḥ ।
śaktibhirmudgaraiścānyā bhūśuṇḍībhistathā'parāḥ ।। 1 04।।
ghnanti krodhānaladagdhā oṣṭhacarvaṇaroṣitāḥ ।
daṇḍairdantaistriśūlaiśca cipīṭakaiśca paṭṭiśaiḥ ।। 1 05।।
mūḍhamārāṇyapatan vai sitābhiśca kṛpāṇakaiḥ ।
kuntaiḥ kuntalakaiścāpi śaraiścakraiśca mūśalaiḥ ।। 1 06।।
churikābhirdṛṣadbhiśca yaṣṭikābhiśca vedhanaiḥ ।
bhidyante brahmarandhrāṇi chidyante sakthibāhavaḥ ।। 1 07।।
śaṃkubhiḥ kuśakairbhallairvaṃśairagnimukhaiḥ karaiḥ ।
vidīryante hṛdayāni stanāni mastakāni ca ।। 1 08।।
baddhyante raśmipāśaiśca kṣipyante kaṭakādibhiḥ ।
kuṭhāraiḥ paraśubhiśca vibhidyante kabandhakāḥ ।। 1 09।।
śṛṃkhalābhiḥ pratāḍyante jvālyante cānalaistadā ।
rākṣasyaḥ kanyakā hanyante'ndhatāḍanakairmithaḥ ।। 2.13.11 0।।
evaṃ vai tumulastatra saṃgrāmaḥ samajāyata ।
na kasyāścicchrūyate'tra śabde yuddhapragarjanaiḥ ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rākṣasīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsannidhau tumulayuddhāraṃbho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 13 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 013 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 14
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 015 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ rādhike yuddhaṃ nārīṇāṃ caṇḍayoṣitām ।
pherurājagṛhiṇīnāṃ rākṣasīnāṃ bhayānakam ।। 1 ।।
dāruṇaṃ sarvathānāśakaraṃ prāṇārpaṇātmakam ।
patayo'tra mṛtā yasmānmartavyaṃ tatra bhasmasu ।। 2 ।।
iti kṛtvā yuyudhustā maraṇāṃkagatā yathā ।
bhayaṃ tyaktvā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā hanyatāṃ hanyatāmiti ।। 3 ।।
khaṇḍaśaḥ kūrcabhāgāśca vidhīyantāṃ pracukruśuḥ ।
samudrasya yathā pūrapravāhaḥ pūrṇimādine ।। 4 ।।
tathā sainyaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ bālakṛṣṇagṛhe'patat ।
kanyakānāṃ mahāsainyaṃ miśritaṃ na tadā pṛthak ।। 5 ।।
bhāti yataśca tāḥ krūrā mṛtvā'pi bālakṛṣṇakam ।
uddhartuṃ pūravaccāpi prasahyāpi yathākatham ।। 6 ।।
dhartavyo mārayitavyo jīvato nā'sumān bhavet ।
ityeva maraṇaṃ cā'gre kṛtvā hantuṃ pradhāvitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
pralaye śalabhā vyomno yathā patanti bhūtale ।
tathā patanti tāḥ sarvā rākṣasyo bālamandire ।। 8 ।।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ vaiparītyaṃ tu bālakṛṣṇastadā prabhuḥ ।
prahasan kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ līnaṃ cakāra ha ।। 9 ।।
rākṣasyastatra ha gṛhasthale vane jalātmakam ।
sarvaṃ cākasmikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāśā yayurambaram ।। 2.14.1 0।।
kanyakābhirmahāyuddhaṃ cakraḥ roṣātisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
kanyakā divyadehāstā vadhyante śastrakoṭibhiḥ।। 11 ।।
na ca tāsāṃ śarīrāṇi bhidyante vahnipiṇḍavat ।
na ca duḥkhāni jāyante chedanāni bhavanti na ।। 12।।
svāmivarmasamāvṛttā rakṣāmantrābhirakṣitāḥ ।
na mriyante kṛṣṇapatnyo mriyante daityayoṣitaḥ ।। 13।।
chidyante bahudhā śastraiḥ kanyakānāṃ tadolbaṇaiḥ ।
dvedhā bhūtā rākṣasī yā sā naikā punarasti vai ।। 14।।
hatā sā jīvato yātā gatā nāyāti vai punaḥ ।
ākāśaṃ yuddhasaṃvyāptaṃ raṇacaṇḍīvibhūṣitam ।। 15।।
abhavanmodamāpannaṃ cāvakāśān dadau bahūn ।
sahasrakrośapāre vai yuddhākāśo'bhavattadā ।। 16।।
samantataḥ surāṣṭre vai koṭyabjārbudayoṣitām ।
eko'pi vidyate nā'tra pumān raṇaglahe tadā ।। 17।।
rākṣasīnāṃ kabandhāśca śirāṃsi bāhavaḥ stanāḥ ।
sakthīni ca nitambāśca vyomno nipeturambarāt ।। 18।।
raktavarṣaṃ māṃsavarṣaṃ piṇḍavarṣaṃ babhūva ha ।
keśavarṣaṃ śastravarṣaṃ śavavarṣaṃ babhūva ha ।। 1 9।।
aṃgavarṣaṃ candranibhakhaṇḍavarṣaṃ babhūva ha ।
navanītasamā dehā vidāryante'tikomalāḥ ।।2.14.20।।
pātyante patidevārthaṃ parasparaṃ priyāgaṇaiḥ ।
yamarājaḥ kṣaṇaṃ yuddhaṃ draṣṭuṃ śrutvā samāgataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
devā ākāśagā yuddhaṃ lokayanti na bhūtajam ।
yadā daityastrīgaṇaiśca vijñātaṃ nijanāśanam ।। 22।।
kanyakāśāśvatikatvaṃ tadā mantraiḥ pramantrya ca ।
muktānyastrāṇi divyāni bhūtasaṃhārakāṇi vai ।।23 ।।
rākṣasībhiḥ prathamaṃ ca bāṣpāstraṃ prahitaṃ tadā ।
bāṣpaṃ cā'bhūdambareti nā'jñāyata tṛṇādikam ।।24।।
lakṣmyā muktaṃ kiraṇāstraṃ bāṣpanāśo babhūva ha ।
atha mumoca vai śukrajīvanī dhūmramastrakam ।।25।।।
ambaraṃ dhūmrasaṃchannaṃ netrayorjvalanaṃ hyabhūt। ।
añjanī ca tadā dhūmrapānaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya ca ।।26।।
mumoca tatra vahnyastraṃ rākṣasīlayakārakam ।
śukrasañjīvanī tatra meghāstraṃ pramumoca ha ।। 27।।
vṛndā tadā pramumoca śālagrāmāstrakaṃ mahat ।
ākāśe śālaśailā vai tāḍayanti tu rākṣasīḥ ।। 28।।
koṭarā rākṣasī śālagrāmāstraṃ tvagilat tadā ।
pāṃśvastraṃ pramumocā'tra dhūlyāḍhyaṃ śukrajīvanī ।।29।।
añjanī tu tadā vāyumantrāstraṃ pramumoca ha ।
nāgāstraṃ ṣaṇḍhikā tatra prerayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।।2.14.3 0।।
gāruḍāstraṃ ca kamalā pramumoca sukhāvaham ।
vṛścikāstraṃ pramumoca vikhātā rākṣasī tadā ।।3 1 ।।
cillikāstraṃ pramumoca garutmatī tadā punaḥ ।
vahnyaṇuvṛṣṭimakarot prāṇahā śukrajīvanī ।।32।।
śāradā vahnivṛṣṭiṃ ca jagrāsa līlayā tadā ।
atha rākṣasapatnyastā māyāyuddhaṃ tadā vyadhuḥ ।।33।।
pāṣāṇān maruto vṛkṣān māṃsalohitapūyakān ।
sasṛjurmadyadhārāśca bāṇān śastrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।।34।।
varṣayāmāsuratyugrān sphoṭacūrṇān savahnikān ।
hetīn samantatastīkṣṇān malamūtrādikāँstathā ।।35।।
hāhākārastadā jāto bhūtale kanyakāgaṇe ।
tadā tu yoginīcakraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭigaṇātmakam ।।36।।
vidhāya nijarūpāṇi dharādharasamāni vai ।
jagrasustāḥ samastāśca māyā mṛṣodbhavā muhuḥ ।।37।।
āmūlāllayamāpannā yoginībaladharṣitāḥ ।
māyā vṛṣṭisvarūpāstā layaṃ yātāstadā punaḥ ।।38।।
pherucitākhyākṣasyā śavānāṃ varṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ।
koṭiśo vai śavā vyomno nipeturyoṣitāṃ tathā ।।39।।
kukkuṭīnāṃ ca gṛdhrīṇāṃ kākīnāṃ śukayoṣitām ।
śyenīnāṃ bhāsanārīṇāṃ kapotīnāṃ śavāstathā ।।2.14.40।।
kravyādīnāmulūkīnāṃ śyenīnāṃ cibarīśavāḥ ।
nipeturambarāttatra bhūtalaṃ channatāṃ gatam ।।41।।
tadā vilokya vai śaṃbhorbhairavī hi mahāsatī ।
rūpaṃ cakāra vai naijaṃ daśayojanamāyatam ।।42।।
lakṣabāhuyutaṃ lakṣarākṣasī śavasarjinīḥ ।
jagrāha yugapatsarvā mardayāmāsa tāstataḥ ।।43।।
lakṣapādairmūḍhmāraistadā cakruśurulbaṇam ।
śavasṛṣṭirlayaṃ yātā mṛṣā māyā layaṃ gatā ।।44।।
atha tadā tu bhairavyā hastagā daityayoṣitaḥ ।
pratārayituṃ hastebhyo nirgantuṃ yatnamācaran ।।45।.।
ekaikāstāḥ kare cakru rūpāṇyasaṃkhyakāni hi ।
kāścid daśa tathā kāścit pañcāśaccāparāḥ śatam ।।46।।
yathā haste mamurnaiva tathā tā vyacarat kalāḥ ।
bhairavī nijahastānāṃ vardhanaṃ tvakarottadā ।।47।।
tathā tā api rākṣasyo vṛddhiṃ naijāṃ dadhustadā ।
evaṃ bhāre tu mahati tvasaṃkhyadehasarjane ।।48।।
bhairavīkaratastā vai vinirgatya vimuṣṭikāt ।
jagarjurvyomamārgasthā bhairavīṃ mastake muhuḥ ।।49।।
tāḍayāmāsuratyarthamasaṃkhyā rākṣasastriyaḥ ।
prāṇaglahe sthitāstābhirmṛtyubhīrnaiva gaṇyate ।।2.14.50।।
atha dṛṣṭvā mahālakṣmīrasaṃkhyā rākṣasīstadā ।
koṭyasaṃkhyasvarūpāstā anantarūpadhāriṇīḥ ।। 51 ।।
svayaṃ mātā mahālakṣmīḥ smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
dadhāra rūpaṃ brahmāṇḍatulyaṃ koṭibhujāyutam ।।52।।
grahanakṣatratārādyā lambante mūrdhajeṣu vai ।
yasyāḥ sā tu mahāghorā sarvaśastraprahāriṇī ।।53 ।।
mārayāmāsa saṃgṛhya saṃgṛhya rākṣasīrmuhuḥ ।
anyā lakṣmyaścaturhastā aṣṭahastāstathā'parāḥ ।।54।।
ṣoḍaśahastikāścānyā dvātriṃśaddhastasaṃyutāḥ ।
catuḥṣaṣṭibāhuyuktāḥ śatasāhasrasatkarāḥ ।।55।।
daśasāhasrahastāśca mahālakṣmyā vinirmitāḥ ।
ghnanti tā rākṣasīrvyomni samutplutya punaḥ punaḥ ।।56।।
bahvyastatra hatā naṣṭā vyasavaḥ peturarditāḥ ।
mṛtāstāstu mṛtā eva punarutthānavarjitāḥ ।।57।।
tadātmāno mahālakṣmyāmantarbhāvaṃ prapedire ।
balaṃ tvardhādhikaṃ sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ rākṣasayoṣitām ।।58।।
mahālakṣmīrbhīrulakṣmīranyā lakṣmyastataḥ kṣaṇam ।
vilokya vijayaṃ naijaṃ raṇatūryāṇyavādayan ।।59।।
kanyakāḥ śrībālakṛṣṇayutā modamathā'labhan ।
athaikā rūḍhikā tatra rākṣasī śailarūpiṇī ।।2.14.6 0।।
bhūtvā papāta vai vyomno bālakṛṣṇopari drutam ।
tāvattalājā hyabhavanmahacchailagṛhopamā ।।6 1 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ talājāśailarakṣitam ।
abhavat kanyakā garbhaṃ bhayaṃ dūraṃ tato gatam ।।62।।
rūṇḍhikā vegato yāvattalājāparvate'patat ।
chinnā bhinnā ca śikharairvidīrṇā ca mṛtā'bhavat ।।63।।
athā'parā bhūmitalaṃ praviśya kṣitijātmikā ।
hyabhavad dīrgharūpā vai śatayojanamāyatā ।।64।।
dardūṃrīrūpamāpannā daśayojanamucchritā ।
adharoṣṭhaḥ kṛtaḥ pṛthvyāstalarūpaḥ suśobhanaḥ ।।65।।
ūrdhvoṣṭhaśca kṛtaḥ svargasamastārāmbarānvitaḥ ।
yatra naiva hi kāsāñcid vibhramo bhayado bhavet ।।66 ।।
kāpaṭyena tathā kṛtvā sarvāstu kanyakāstathā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।67।।
lomaśasyā''śramaścāpi mukhamadhye cakāra sā ।
tāvannārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo jñātvā duśceṣṭitaṃ tadā ।।68।।
rākṣasyāstu vināśārthaṃ tathā kautukasṛṣṭaye ।
svayaṃ vai kanyakārūpaṃ dadhāra kanyakāsu vai ।।69।।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ divyaṃ kare kṛtvā gale sthitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇānāmakanyā vyarājata kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।।2.14.70 ।।
sudarśanaṃ mahātejovahniyuktaṃ mumoca saḥ ।
vahniyuktena cakreṇa tasyā galamukhodaram ।।7 1 ।।
cakarta khaṇḍaśastāṃ vai maṇḍukīṃ rūṇḍhikāṃ kṣaṇāt ।
tasyā medā'sthito jātāścākacakyaciroṭikāḥ ।।।72।।
athā'nyā dāminīnāmnī rākṣasī vīkṣya vai mṛtām ।
dardūrikāṃ svayaṃ tejomayaṃ rūpaṃ dadhāra ca ।।73।।
vyomavyāptaṃ mahāvidyujjvālāmālākulaṃ tataḥ ।
sudarśanamagilat sā mukhaṃ vyādāya vaiṣṇavam ।।74।।
tāṃ ca bhittvā viniryātaṃ drāgeva tat sudarśanam ।
yathā vidyullatāṃśāśca nipateyuḥ kṣitau tathā ।।75।।
dāminī rākṣasī khaṇḍamayī papāta bhūtale ।
athā'nyā dyuhanā tatra vapurnirmāya sūryavat ।।76।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ mukhe nyasyotpapāta khaṃ divaṃ prati ।
vīraśistāvadevā'tra saṃvīkṣya lomaśaṃ munim ।।77।।
mukhe nyasyotpapātordhvaṃ yayau dūraṃ yadā'mbaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālo lomaśo'pi ca yogirāṭ ।।78।।
vahnirūpāvubho tatraudare jātau hi dāruṇau ।
vahninā jajjvalatuśca rākṣasyau mamratustathā ।।79 ।।
udare ca viniṣpāṭya nirgatau lomaśā'cyutau ।
athā'nyā dāminī vahnirūpā'bhavat tadāśrame ।।2.14.80।।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikam ।
dadāha vahninā yāvat kiñcinmātraṃ tadā drutam ।।81 ।।
bālāhakī mahālakṣmīrvṛṣṭirūpā babhūva ha ।
vahniṃ ca rundhayāmāsa śāntayāmāsa varṣaṇaiḥ ।।82।।
dhṛtvā tu dāminīṃ tatra jaghāna prāṇataḥ satī ।
mṛtā sā dāminī tatra prasārya pādahastakau ।।83।।
athā'parā ca dhībhakṣyānāmnī rākṣasakāminī ।
devīṃ tu kambharālakṣmīṃ skandhe nidhāya khaṃ yayau ।।84।।
dṛṣṭvā tadā tu sā sādhvī muṣṭyā jaghāna dhīmakhīm ।
brahmarandhre mṛtā dhībhakṣiṇī tūrṇaṃ papāta ha ।।85।।
śauṇḍī vyāghrīrūpadharī bhūtvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
jagrāha pitaraṃ yāvattāvat pārvatī kārabhī ।।86।।
bhūtvā vyāghrīṃ cakhādaināṃ pitā svastho'bhavattadā ।
athā'nyā raṇacaṇḍībhiḥ kanyābhiḥ sarvatobalaiḥ ।।87।।
hatāstatramṛtāḥ sarvāḥ śatamātrā'vaśeṣitāḥ ।
tāstadā śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ kuṇṭhādiṣṭidamādikāḥ ।।88।।
kanyābhistā nigaḍeṣu dhṛtāḥ śastravihīnakāḥ ।
vidhavāstāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā praṇemire ।।89 ।।
rurudurbhayamagnāśca prārthayāmāsurīśvaram ।
hatā nāthā hi naḥ kṛṣṇa vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ।। 2.14.90।।
uddhāraya mahāduḥkhāt parātpara mahāprabho ।
lakṣalakṣapralakṣāṇāṃ mūlakṛtrimayoṣitām ।। 91 ।।
rākṣasīnāṃ mṛtānāṃ tvaṃ samuddhāraṃ samācara ।
vayaṃ tu cā'balāḥ kṛṣṇa tava priyā hatāḥ khalu ।। 92।।
kva gacchāmaḥ kṛpāsindho talājāvat nijāḥ kuru ।
yathālakṣmīḥ ramā rādhā śrīḥ satī pārvatī prabhā ।। 93 ।।
māṇikyā maṃjulā tāsāṃ dāsīnaiṃjāḥ kuru prabho ।
yadvā tāsāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ dāsīrvidhehi mādhava ।। 94।।
tvāṃ vinā na gṛhaṃ cānyat sukhadaṃ tvāyatau matam ।
vayaṃ tūbhayatobhraṣṭā labhāmo vai kathaṃ sukham ।। 95।।
tasmānnaijāḥ kuru kṛṣṇa kṣamāpyā'smatsudāruṇam ।
karmaprajvālya rakṣatvaṃ divyabhāvaṃ pradehi naḥ ।। 96।।
surāśca bhogino daityā dānavā rākṣasāḥ khagāḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayo martyā vṛkṣādyāste prasūtayaḥ ।। 97।।
tava vaṃśa samutpannāstava yogamupāgatāḥ ।
kathaṃ pāpena jīvāmo'labhyakāntamupāgatāḥ ।। 98।।
kuru naḥ pāvanīḥ sarvā rakṣobhāvavivarjitāḥ ।
ityevaṃ tvarthitastābhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।99।।
tāḥ sarvā divyadṛṣṭyā ca divyā''pprokṣaṇakena ca ।
dveṣabhāvena ca svasya satatasmaraṇena ca ।। 2.14.10 0।।
dhūtapāpā gatarakṣobhāvāśca tā vyadhāttadā ।
kāmadhenugavāmāsyairantaḥkṛtvā gavodarāt ।। 101 ।।
mūtradvāreṇa tatraiva lomaśena nikāsitāḥ ।
brahmayogyā abhavaँstā divyadehā ramā yathā ।। 1 02।।
visasmarustadā naijān janmasaṃskāravigrahān ।
divyā devyo yathā tadvajjātāścandrakalā yathā ।। 103 ।।
sarvāstāḥ kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāñcchayā ।
saumyā dvādaśavārṣikyo vaiṣṇavyastilakānvitāḥ ।। 1 04।।
anyathākartṛkṛṣṇasya prabhāveṇa hi rādhike! ।
atha yāśca mṛtāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtau līnā raṇe tadā ।। 1 05।।
tāśca sarvāḥ kṛṣṇamūrternirgatā divyakanyakāḥ ।
lakṣasaṃkhyāśca tāḥ sūryojjvalāmbarāśca nirmalāḥ ।। 1 06।।
kaṭakamukuṭacakrakuṇḍalaraśanānvitāḥ ।
ajāyanta kṣaṇāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇehayā priyāḥ ।। 1 07।।
'oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
mantraṃ śrīlomaśastābhyo dadau śrīharisannidhau ।। 1 08।।
havanaṃ kārayitvā ca tābhyo'nyābhyaśca lomaśaḥ ।
dadau yajñopavītāni pītāmbarāṇi mālikāḥ ।। 1 09।।
taulasīrjapamālāśca kaṇṭhīścāpi dadau tadā ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacihnānyapi dadau tadā ।। 2.14.11 0।।
bhojitā dīkṣitāḥ sarvā rakṣitā lomaśāśrame ।
yāśca yuddhe'bhavaँstatra ramādyāḥ koṭikanyakāḥ ।। 111 ।।
tābhyaḥ kṛṣṇapatistatra parātparasukhaṃ dadau ।
bāhūbhyāṃ tāḥ parigṛhya nipīḍya nijavakṣasi ।। 11 2।।
dhanyā''śīrvādaśabdāँśca cumbanāni dadau prabhuḥ ।
yuddhaśramo'straśastrādisparśaśramādikaṃ tadā ।। 11 3।।
kṣaṇāt sarvaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca romamātrā'pi na kṣatiḥ ।
sarvāsāmabhavattatra jayakāro mahānabhūt ।। 1 14।।
bhojitāḥ pūjitāḥ sarvāḥ parirabdhā dayālunā ।
cumbitā vakṣasi svasya pīḍitāścāmṛtīkṛtāḥ ।। 1 15।।
mahotsavaḥ kṛtastatra jayanimittajo'tra ca ।
devādyāśca samājagmuḥ pūjitā bhojitāśca te ।। 116।।
yathāgataṃ gatāste tu lomaśo munirāṭ tataḥ ।
nāmāni lakṣakanyānāṃ vidadhe tu navāni vai ।। 1 17।।
suśīlā susahā vidyut kiraṇā candrikā dyutiḥ ।
ityādiśubhanāmāni kṛtavān lomaśo muniḥ ।। 1 18।।
āśramaṃ nītavān sarvāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā ।
atha pṛthvī samāhūtā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena tu ।। 1 19।।
yuddhasthalīṃ svayaṃ bhūmiḥ samīcakāra vai tadā ।
aśuddhiṃ lopayāmāsa śuddhāṃ bhūmiṃ cakāra sā ।। 2.14.1 20।।
vṛṣṭyā cāpi kṣālitā sā devenāpi tataḥ śubhā ।
bhūmiḥ sā lakṣatīrthākhyā hyabhavat kṛṣṇavanditā ।। 121 ।।
śastrāṇi bhagavānnaije saudhe rarakṣa yāni ca ।
yuddhe tatra patitāni divyāni bhautikāni ca ।। 1 22।।
evaṃ vai rādhike yuddhaṃ purā tatra babhūva ha ।
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyacca strīṇāṃ divyagatipradam ।। 123 ।।
lakṣāṇāṃ kanyakānāṃ tu rūpadvayaṃ harīcchayā ।
vyajāyata ca pratyekaṃ tatraikaikaṃ vimānagam ।। 1 24।।
bhūtvā ca pārṣadairnītaṃ paramākṣarasatpadam ।
kanyārūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca lomaśāśramasaṃsthitam ।। 125।।
ityevaṃ rādhike te'tra kathitaṃ paramā'dbhutam ।
kathānakaṃ harerdivyaṃ nārīyuddhamayaṃ param ।। 126।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya cintanāccārpaṇāttathā ।
kṛṣṇapriyātvamāsādya brahmaloke gatirbhavet ।। 1 27।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'saṃkhyakanyakābhiḥ yuddhasamarthābhiḥ saha rākṣasīnāṃ yuddhe rākṣasīnāṃ vināśābhimukhaparājaye'nte śaraṇāgatirmuktipadaṃ kanyakāpadaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇakṛpayetinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 14।।


← adhyāyaḥ 014 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 15
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 016 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu vai rādhike tāsāṃ kathāṃ paramapāvanīm ।
śrīkṛṣṇasvāmisaṃyogād ramātvaprāptayoṣitām ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena lomaśāya tāḥ ।
tadāśrame nivāsārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ prasamarpitāḥ ।। 2 ।।
prāptadivyasvarūpāstāḥ prāptā''navakumāratāḥ ।
apyaprāptajñānadīpā ata eva kathānake ।। 3 ।।
vyākhyāne vā rasavarjyā anāviṣkṛtabuddhayaḥ ।
maunībhāvena vartante mugdhā iva hi saṃsadi ।। 4 ।।
ātmajñānaṃ na jānanti na jānanti vṛṣaṃ tapaḥ ।
ajñātā mokṣadharmeṣu tā āsan channadīpavat ।। ।9 ।।
kintu mumukṣābhāvāḍhyā jñānodayaparāyaṇāḥ ।
papracchuḥ rādhike sarvā lomaśaṃ jñānabhāskaram ।। 6 ।।
kīṭān bhramarī bhramarīva karoti naijadaṃśataḥ ।
jñānī jñānapradastvandhān cakṣuṣmataḥ karoti ca ।। 7 ।।
jñānaṃ dehi guro'smabhyaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpmaśāntidam ।
nārīrūpaṃ sadā jñānavarjitaṃ vāsanā''śrayam ।। 8 ।।
doṣāśrayaṃ -bhavatyeva mokṣastasmānna jāyate ।
yathā mokṣo bhavennaśca doṣanāśo yathā bhavet ।। 9 ।।
yathā kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāttathā vai saralān vṛṣān ।
kartavyārthabhṛtānasmān praśādhi cā'balājanān ।। 2.15.1 0।।
ityarthito lomaśastu jyeṣṭhe caikādaśīdine ।
upādideśa sarvābhyo vratadharmān śubhapradān ।। 11 ।।
ekādaśīvrataṃ putryaḥ! sarvapāpaharaṃ param ।
nirjalaṃ ca nirāhāraṃ kṛtaṃ sajāgaraṃ tathā ।। 12।।
saśrīkṛṣṇārcanaśrāddhaṃ sakṛṣṇārādhanānvitam ।
sasatsaṃgendriyadamaṃ pāpahaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi tat ।। 1 3।।
kṛṣṇaprasannatādaṃ ca bhuktimuktipradaṃ tathā ।
prātaḥ pūjāṃ vrate tvadya bālakṛṣṇasya vai hareḥ ।। 14।।
gatvā kuruta puṣpādyaiḥ phalairjalaiśca candanaiḥ ।
ātmārpaṇaiḥ pradakṣiṇairhṛdbhavaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 15।।
bhojyadānaiḥ pānadānairdolā''ndolanakairapi ।
nṛtyagītairhāvabhāvai rañjanaiḥ sevanairmuhuḥ ।। 16।।
indriyāṇāṃ nigrahaiśca maunairviṣayavarjitam ।
vrataṃ kuruta kṛṣṇasya prasannatārthameva vai ।। 17।।
ityuktāstānūtnakanyā vrataṃ tu nirjalodbhavam ।
jyeṣṭhaśuklaikādaśyāḥ saṃcakruḥ sajāgarānvitam ।। 18।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ prasannaśca tāstu vaikuṇṭhadarśanam ।
kārayāmāsa ca naijaṃ darśanaṃ sucaturbhujam ।। 19।।
naikapārṣadalakṣmyādivibhūtisevitaṃ dadau ।
tāścātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ menire śrīharipriyāḥ ।।2.15.20।।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakruḥ prātaścakrurhi pāraṇām ।
āsīnaṃ lomaśaṃ tāśca papracchurdharmasaṃgraham ।।2 1 ।।
kiṃ sevyaṃ sarvadā pāpanāśakaṃ puṇyadāyakam ।
mokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ cāpi yāmyakaṣṭanivārakam ।।22।।।
lomaśastāstadā prāha sevyā gāvastathāvidhāḥ ।
sarvadevamayā gāvo devyaścāmṛtavārdhayaḥ ।।23।।।
tārikāstīrtharūpāśca pavitrāḥ puṣṭidāyikāḥ ।
tāsāṃ sevā prakartavyā sarvalābhapradā sadā ।।24।।
sakṛt gavyapradattena prīyante devatādayaḥ ।
dadhnā hi tridaśāḥ sarve kṣīreṇa ca maheśvaraḥ ।।25।।
ghṛtena pāvako nityaṃ pāyasena pitāmahaḥ ।
gāṃ datvā gopayaḥ pītvā prīto medhyaḥ pumān bhavet ।।26।।
pañcagavyaṃ paraṃ medhyaṃ vājimedhaphalapradam ।
maruto dhenudanteṣu jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī ।।27।।
khuramadhye ca gāndharvāḥ khurāgreṣu tu pannagāḥ ।
sarvasandhiṣu sādhyāśca candrādityau tu locane ।।28।।
kakude sarvakṣatrāṇi lāṅgūle dharma āśritaḥ ।
apāne sarvatīrthāni prasrāve jāhnavī nadī ।।29।।
staneṣu sāgarāḥ romakūpeṣu tu maharṣayaḥ ।
lakṣmīrāste gomaye goḥ romeṣu sarvaśaktayaḥ ।।2.15.30।।
dhairyaṃ dhṛtiśca śāntiśca puṣṭirvṛddhistathā smṛtiḥ ।
medhā lajjāṃ vapuḥ kīrtirvidyā matiśca santatiḥ ।। 31 ।।
dharmapatnyo bhaktimūrtī goṣu tiṣṭhanti sarvadā ।
paretamanugacchanti dattā gāvaḥ supātrake ।।32।।
yatra gāvastatra lakṣmīrdharmo jñānaṃ ca devatāḥ ।
amarā api gobhiśca pradattābhirvinirmitāḥ ।।33 ।।
tasmāt putryaḥ kāmadhenūḥ prapūjayata cāśrame
ayaṃ dharmo mahānatra vane prokto mayā śubhaḥ ।।34।।
śrutvaivaṃ tā nūtnakanyā gosevāṃ vidadhuḥ śubhām ।
athā'nyamapi papracchurdharmabhṛtaṃ śubhāvaham ।।35।।
gosevāsadṛśī kācidanyasevā'sti vā na vā ।
yayā bhuktiśca muktiśca nārīṇāṃ śubhadā bhavet ।।36।।
lomaśastu tadā prāha patyuḥ sevā'sti tādṛśī ।
svāmiśuśrūṣayā svargaṃ mokṣaḥ sukhaṃ hi labhyate ।।37।।
patyuḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā brahmaloke mahīyate ।
patireva parabrahma patirdānaṃ vrataṃ kratuḥ ।।38।।
patyājñā paramo dharmastena muktirhi yoṣitām ।
sarvadevāśca vidhayaḥ patyuvākye vasanti hi ।।39।।
yāsāṃ tuṣṭaḥ patirdevastāsāṃ tuṣṭaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
prasupte yā prasvapiti jāgarti jāgrati dhruvam ।।2.15.40।।
bhuṅkte tu bhojite putryaḥ! sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ।
maune maunā bhaved yā tu sthite sthitā tu yā svayam ।।41।।
sā mṛtyuṃ jayate putryo! nānyanmṛtyujayāvaham ।
ekadṛṣṭirekacittā bhartṝvacanakāriṇī ।।42।।
tasyā bibhyati yāmyāśca sā sādhvī pūjyate suraiḥ ।
bhartrā cābhihitā premṇā na pratyākhyāyinī bhavet ।।43।।
nānyaṃ vai daivataṃ yāti patyuranyaṃ patipriyā ।
sā na mṛtyumukhaṃ yāti lakṣmītulyā pativratā ।।44।।
eṣa mātā pitā bandhureṣa me daivataṃ param ।
evaṃ śuśrūṣayate yā sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ।।45।।
bhartāraṃ dhyāyamānā ca bhartāramanuvartanā ।
bhartāraṃ cintayamānā na yāmyaṃ paśyati kvacit ।।46।।
snāne tathā''sane yāne keśaprasādhanādiṣu ।
nānyaṃ yā manasā paśyet sā yamaṃ naiva paśyati ।।47।।
devatā arcayantaṃ vā bhuñjānaṃ sukhaśāyinam ।
tyajati svāminaṃ yā na mṛtyuṃ kālaṃ jayettu sā ।।48।।
bhānau cānudite yā strī gṛhaṃ mārjayate sadā ।
svāmisevāparā syācca yamalokaṃ na paśyati ।।49।।
śaucācārasamāyuktā bharturmukhāgradarśanā ।
vartate ca hi te bharturmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।।2.15.50।।
pativratāḥ satyavākyā ajitā svāmisevikāḥ ।
hiṃsāhīnā na vai yānti yāmyalokaṃ kadācana ।।51।।
brahmacaryaparāḥ kanyā vidhavā dharmasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
harerbhaktāḥ satāṃ dāsyo na yānti yamapattanam ।।52।।
jñānāśrayāstathā vidyāṃ parāṃ prāptāḥ samāhitāḥ ।
svāmyarthe prāṇadātryaśca na yānti yamapattanam ।।53।।
dātryaḥ śuśrūṣikā mātāpitroḥ patyuśca sadguroḥ ।
tilagosvarṇadātryaśca na yānti yamapatanam ।।54।।
cāturmāsyavratakartryo gurucittānupālikāḥ ।
nityakathāśravaṇāśca na gacchanti yamālayam ।।55।।
tapasā prāpyate svargaṃ yaśaścāyuḥsukhādikam ।
jñānavijñānamārogyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyasampadaḥ ।।56।।
prāpyante tapasā bhogā bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।
payobhakṣyā divaṃ yānti dhanadā draviṇāḍhyatām ।।97।।
guruśuśrūṣayā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dhyānāt prayānti ca ।
śrāddhena santatiṃ yānti svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ bhavet ।।58।।
phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ mokṣo gosevināṃ bhavet ।
rasānāṃ sampradānena saubhāgyamanujāyate ।।59।।
annapānīyadānena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ।
saugandhikapradānena kāmabhogaiḥ pratṛpyate ।।2.15.60।।
phalaistu labhate putraṃ puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyamuttamam ।
abhayasya pradānena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ।।61।।
abhayasya pradātā yo'bhayaṃ dadāti dehine ।
pātreṇa dehinā bhāvyaṃ tadoddhāro bhaved dvayoḥ ।।62।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiprasaṃgataḥ ।
satāṃ ca sevayā yāti kṣayaṃ tvaśubhamityataḥ ।।63 ।।
mokṣadā cātmaphaladā śubhā buddhiḥ pravartate ।
kleśakṣayaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubhaṃ karmā'pi jāyate ।।64।।
svargaḥ śubhaphalaprāptirnirayaḥ pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ।
arjayettu sadā śreṣṭhaṃ phaladaṃ nā'śubhaṃ kvacit ।।65।।
ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛṣṇākrodhavivarjitā ।
apāpakāriṇī sārvabhaumā tārayati dhruvam ।।66।।
anāśā yā sadā tiṣṭhediṣṭārtheṣu na lolupā ।
savairāgyā harau lagnā nārī tarati sāgaram ।।67।।
śraddadhānā'nasūyā ca guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratā ।
akṣudraśīlā dharmāḍhyā nārī tarati sāgaram ।।68।।
praśastāni ca yā kuryādapraśastāni varjayet ।
maṃgale vartamānā ca mucyate sarvapāpataḥ ।।69।।
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ tīrthaṃ sevate śuddhamānasā ।
sādhuṃ ca sevate nityaṃ sā yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।2.15.70।।
śrīnūtnakumārikā ūcuḥ-
alpopāyakaraṃ caiva sukhopāyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
karmaṇāmaśubhānāṃ ca vividhotpattijanmanām ।।7 1।।
yat samartha sphoṭayituṃ tanno brūhi tapodhana ।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
mokṣaprade harau prāpte prāpte sādhujane gurau ।।72।।
sevāṃ kuryāttu yā tasyā viśuddhenā''ntarātmanā ।
sā sevā saralopāyo hyasatkarmapraṇāśanaḥ ।।73।।
dṛṣṭvā sādhūnnamasyed yā sā pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।
manasā karmaṇā vācā yat kiñcit kaluṣaṃ kṛtam ।।74।।
kṛṣṇakāntāya cārpayya śuddhā mokṣagatā bhavet ।
sūrye kṛṣṇaṃ candramasi kṛṣṇaṃ goṣu janārdanam ।।75।।
gurau kṛṣṇaṃ prapaśyed yā sā pramucyeta bandhanāt ।
sādhuṃ patiṃ guruṃ devaṃ gāṃ pitarau satīṃ dvijam ।।76।।
dṛṣṭvā praṇamed dhyāyecca yā ca kuryāt pradakṣiṇam ।
drāgeva duṣkṛtān hitvā mucyate sā prabandhanāt ।।77।।
gāvaḥ pavitrā maṃgalyā devānāmapi devatāḥ ।
yā tāḥ prasevate bhaktyā sā pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।।78।।
saumye muhūrte saṃyukte pañcagavyaṃ tu yā pibet ।
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpāt tatkṣaṇādeva mucyate ।।79।।
lāṃgūlenoddhṛtaṃ toyaṃ mūrdhnā gṛhṇāti yā satī ।
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya sā pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।।2.15.8 0।।
dhenustanādviniṣkrāntāṃ dhārāṃ kṣīrasya yā satī ।
śirasā pratigṛhṇāti sā pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।।81 ।।
sādhuṃ saṃsevya vidhivad bhojayitvā prapūjayet ।
tasyāstu kilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati ।।82।।
prācīnāgrān kuśān kṛtvā sthāpayitvā vṛṣaṃ puraḥ ।
tatpucchajalasaṃsnātā śuddhā bhavati sarvathā ।।।83 ।।
dakṣiṇāvarttaśaṃkhasthajalenā''plāvya śuddhyati ।
kṛṣṇatilā'nvitajalaiḥ snātvā śuddhyati tatkṣaṇāt ।।84।।
acchidrapadmapatreṇa sarvaratnodakena ca ।
sādhupādodakenā'pi snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।85।।
kārtike bodhinīṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca dvādaśīṃ tathā ।
janmakoṭikṛtapāpānyāśu nāśayati vratī ।।86।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpate prabho ।
māṇikyeśvara haṃseśa kīrtanāt tallayaṃ vrajet ।।87।।
janmāntarasahasreṣu samārādhya pareśvaram ।
vaiṣṇavītvaṃ labhet kācit sarvapāpakṣaye sati ।।88।।
bhavatībhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'nugrahaṇena tat ।
durlabhaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ vai labdhaṃ kṛpālabhaṃ sutāḥ! ।।89।।
vaiṣṇavyo hi mahābhāgāḥ punanti sakalaṃ jagat ।
saṃsmṛtaḥ kīrtito vā'pi dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭo'pi vā sutāḥ! ।।2.15.90।।
punāti bhagavān drāk ca sahasrajanmapāvanaḥ ।
etajjñātvā bhavatībhiḥ pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।। 91।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālasvarūpavān ।
ityuktvā''camanaṃ datvā datvā''tmajñānamujjvalam ।।92।।
lomaśo virarāmā'pi tā api nūtnakanyakāḥ ।
tyaktvā dharmamadharmaṃ ca śāśvatīṃ dhiyamāsthitāḥ ।।93।।
jagṛhurniyamāँstāँstān bhayahīnānaninditān ।
prītyā paramayā yuktāḥ kṛṣṇemā'nvacintayan ।।94।।
lomaśo'pi sadā sāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ।
kathāstāḥ śrāvayāmāsa pātivratyādibhaktidāḥ ।।95।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ ca sarvāṃ samantataḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa tāḥ sarvāścāturmāsye vratasthitāḥ ।।96।।
nūtnakanyā lakṣakanyāstathā'nyā api sarvadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jepuḥ samādarāt ।।97।।
jāgrati cāpi nidrāyāṃ suṣuptāvapi tā harim ।
patiṃ śrīsvāminaṃ hṛtsu dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।98।।
kambharānandanaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdbhiḥ pravavrire ।
bhejustaṃ cātmani cātmāntarātmānaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ।।99।।
evaṃ tā rādhike divyā jātāstāmasajā api ।
parameśvarayogena kimāścaryaṃ vadāmi te ।। 2.15.10 0।।
kṛpāmātradhṛtajanmā kṛṣṇo'nugrahavānayam ।
pāpipāpāni cogrāṇi nāśayitvā'karonnijān ।। 10 1।।
narānnārīḥ paśūn vṛkṣān vallīdaityādikāँstathā ।
pāṭhakān śrotṛvargāṃśca naijān karoti vai tathā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nūtnakanyakānāṃ lomaśadarśitaikādaśīvratapātivratyagogurvādisevanamāhātmyanirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 15।।
