adhyāyaḥ 16
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 017 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike na tvayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ divyakathānakam ।
kathayāmi camatkāraṃ sāvadhānā nibodha me ।। 1 ।।
āṣāḍhe kanyakāḥ sarvāścāturmāsyavratāni vai ।
cakrurlomaśadiṣṭāni bālakṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ।। 2 ।।
āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ prātareva tāḥ ।
snātvā dhyātvā kṛpānāthaṃ natvā samarcya lomaśam ।। 3 ।।
candanā'kṣatapuṣpāṇi kuṃkumā'mbaramālikāḥ ।
gokṣīraṃ śarkarailākesarāḍhyaṃ kvāthitaṃ tathā ।। 4 ।।
nītvā bhūṣāmbarahāraśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ prabhum ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭumupāgatāḥ ।। 5 ।।
gāyanti gītikā miṣṭasvaraiḥ śrīsvāmimānasāḥ ।
mauktikanaddhahindhānīdhṛtakalaśamastakāḥ ।। 6 ।।
hastadhṛtaphalapūjāpātrā netrāgramādhavāḥ ।
hṛdayeṣu dhṛtakṛṣṇāḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ ।। 7 ।।
smaranti śrīpatiṃ cāhamahamikayā tvagragāḥ ।
camatkārastadā prātarbālakṛṣṇena darśitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
mama pūjākṛte koṭikanyāścāyānti me gṛham ।
sammardo'tra mahān bhāvī mayā gamyaṃ sarastaṭe ।। 9 ।।
grāhyā pūjā ca yugapat sammardo na yathā bhavet ।
iti nirṇīya bhagavān koṭirūpāṇi tatkṣaṇam ।। 2.16.1 0।।
dhṛtvā hasan kiśorātmā tāsāmabhiyayau pathi ।
ekayā dṛśyate tveko nānyayā dṛśyate'paraḥ ।। 11 ।।
ekā jānāti māmeva hasannāyāti māṃ prati ।
nānyāḥ prati yayau nātho mama premṇā'tirekiṇā ।। 12 ।।
anyā jānāti māmevābhiyāti netarāḥ prati ।
parā paśyati cāyāntaṃ svāṃ pratyeva kṛpākaram ।। 13 ।।
evaṃ sarvā hi pratyekaṃ kāntaṃ paśyanti vai nijam ।
matvā saubhāgyamatulaṃ drutaṃ milanti vakṣasi ।। 14।।
lomaśaṃ śrīharirneme lomaśo'pi hariṃ mudā ।
atha tatkoṭiyugalairbhūtalaṃ dyaurivā'bhavat ।। 15।।
kṛṣṇo vārtāṃ kuśalāḍhyāṃ pṛcchan prayāti cāgrataḥ ।
pārśve pārśve manāk pṛṣṭhe vāme prayāti kanyakā ।। 16।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre viśāle bahuyojane ।
meghacchatrasamacchāye puṣpitadrumavallike ।। 17।।
śubhakomalasasyā''se śītagandhyanilā'nvite ।
pūjāpātrāṇi sannyasya kāntaṃ kṛtvā''sane puraḥ ।। 18।।
sarvāḥ sampūjayāmāsurbhāvabhṛddravyavastubhiḥ ।
lalāṭe patrikāścakruścandanena sugandhinā ।। 19 ।।
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadustilakaṃ ca lalāṭake।
dakṣagaṇḍe raktabindvīṃ datvā cucumburutsukāḥ ।।2.16.20।।
mastake puṣpamukuṭaṃ mayūrapatrakalgikam ।
karṇayoḥ puṣpagucchau ca śekharān vividhān daduḥ ।। 11 ।।
puṣpahārān taulaseyān kaṭakān raśanāstathā ।
puṣpapracchadavastrāṇi dhārayāmāsurīśvaram ।।22।।
alaktakuṃkumaṃ tasya pādayoḥ karayordaduḥ ।
sakiṃkiṇīnupūrau ca pādaprakoṣṭhayordaduḥ ।।।23।।
pītāmbarāṇi kṣaumāṇi kauśeyakāni tā daduḥ ।
muralīṃ cāpyaṃkurāṇi karṇayorgucchakau daduḥ ।।।24।।
padmapatraṃ kare dakṣe sugandhiprokṣaṇaṃ daduḥ ।
śītaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ rasān payo daduḥ ।।25।।
elālavaṃgabījāni mukhaśuddhiṃ dalaṃ daduḥ ।
evaṃ sampūjya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 26 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ kambujalaṃ vastramārjanamādadhuḥ ।
namaḥ stutiṃ daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।।27।।
ātmanāṃ cārpaṇaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣamā'rthanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
pādayoḥ kṣālanajalaṃ papurnyadhuśca mastake ।।28।।
vakṣaḥsu kṛṣṇacaraṇau nidhāyā''nandamāgatāḥ ।
prasannāḥ prārthayāmāsurvratāni nijanāthataḥ ।।29।।
kāciccaturṣu māseṣu yayāce phalabhojanam ।
kācitkandā'danaṃ kācitpatrādanaṃ payo'danam ।।2.16.3 0।।
kācidekānnabhakṣyaṃ ca kācinmunyannabhakṣaṇam ।
kācidyavādanaṃ kācidgodhūmādanamātrakam ।।3 1 ।।
kācit taṇḍulakavalān kācidrasavivarjitam ।
kācidakṣārabhojyaṃ ca kācinmiṣṭavivarjitam ।।32।।
kācit tiktavihīnaṃ ca kācit kaṭuvivarjitam ।
kācidanagnipakvaṃ ca kācicchuṣkaṃ tu bharjitam ।।33 ।।
kācinnirannamevā'pi kācicchākavivarjitam ।
kācittu dvidalāvarjyaṃ kācidanāranālakam ।।34।।
kācittakravihīnaṃ ca kāciddugdhavivarjitam ।
kācidadhṛtabhojyaṃ ca kācidatailamityapi ।।35।।
anyā naktaṃ caikabhuktaṃ kācitkālacaturthakam ।
ṣaṭkālādanamityanyā saptāhādanamityapi ।।36 ।।
pakṣādanaṃ tathā māsādanaṃ cāndrāyaṇādikam ।
kṛcchraṃ bahuvidhaṃ cāpi ekadvitridinādijam ।।37।।
evaṃ vratāni jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇaprasannatecchayā ।
śrutvā śrīlomaśaḥ prāha śṛṇuta kanyakā! hitam ।।38।।
yena kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāt tadvrataṃ cottamottamam ।
vratena tapasā vāpyārādhanena yamādibhiḥ ।।3 9।।
toṣaṇīyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sādhanakoṭibhiḥ ।
avrate'pi prasannaḥ syādavrataṃ vratameva tat ।।2.16.40।
vrate nāsti prasannaśced vrataṃ cā'vratameva tat ।
tasmāt putryo! hariryena tuṣyet praṣṭavyameva tat ।।41 ।
jñātvā toṣapradaṃ cāturmāsye kuruta tadvratam ।
ityuktāḥ sukumāryastā hariṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।।42।।
papracchuḥ sukhamāsīnā yena tuṣyasi tad vad ।
śrutvā hasan hariḥ prāha bhaktyā tuṣyāmi nānyathā ।।43।
na vratairnaiva dānaiśca na yamairniyamaistathā ।
na yajñairdakṣiṇābhiśca na dehakṣapaṇaistathā ।।44।।
na vicārairna ca dhanairna saukumāryabhāvanaiḥ ।
kintu premṇā prasannaḥ syāṃ nirvyājenā'nivartinā ।।45।।।
premavataṃ madarthaṃ ca kāryaṃ yuṣmābhireva yat ।
premṇā pūjyo vandanīyaḥ premṇā smartavya eva ca ।।46 ।।
premṇā dāsyaṃ prakartavyaṃ kaiṃkaryalakṣaṇaṃ mayi ।
snāne dhyāne bhojanādau dehakārye'pi sarvathā ।।47।।
ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prayoktavyastadvrataṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet ।
abalānāṃ balaṃ cāhaṃ bālānāṃ balabhāgaham ।।48।।
kanyānāṃ kaṃ sukhaṃ kurve nārāyaṇo'smi mokṣadaḥ ।
cāturmāsye madarthaṃ vai pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskriyā ।।49।।
mama mālājapo dhyānaṃ mama nāmnāṃ sukīrtanam ।
mama gāthā mama kathā madarthaṃ jīvanaṃ priyāḥ ।।2.16.50।।
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tadvai vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mayā kṛtam ।
bhavatīnāṃ kṛte divyaṃ sākṣānmadyogasaṃbhṛtam ।।51 ।।
naitattulyaṃ vrataṃ tvanyattena mokṣasukhaṃ bhavet ।
vrateryaḥ khalu cāptavyaḥ so'haṃ prāpto'smi sarvathā ।।52।।
tadvrataṃ kiṃ vrataṃ cānyat tiṣṭhataivaṃ vrate mayi ।
ityuktvā bhagavāँstāsāṃ jagrāhārcanavastukam ।।53।।
darśasparśasukhaṃ tābhyo dadau koṭisvarūpabhāk ।
tāḥ sarvāśca hariṃ natvā tadocuḥ parameśvaram ।।54।।
nātha nityaṃ tava pūjāṃ kariṣyāmo'tra saṃgatāḥ ।
evameva sukhaṃ dehi pūjāgrahaṇānugrahāt ।।55।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha tāvadāścaryamatra yat ।
jātaṃ tad rādhike te'tra kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।।56।।
śatrūñjayākhyaśailo vai vartate tvagnidigbhavaḥ ।
saurāṣṭre tatra daityā vai samāsan kaṃkatālakāḥ ।।57।।
sahasraśaḥ kaṃkatālā madyamāṃsaparāyaṇāḥ ।
adriśṛṃgasamākārā halavaddantamūrdhajāḥ ।। 58।।
taptatālocchrayā meghamārgamastakasaṃspṛśāḥ ।।
sāmudramatsyabhakṣāśca naramāṃsādanāstathā ।।59।।
vanāraṇyapaśubhakṣāḥ pakṣiprāṇiprabhakṣiṇaḥ ।
āyayuste tadā jñātvā kṛṣṇapūjanakotsavam ।।। 2.16.60।।
vrataghnāste'surāḥ sarve khalāḥ śastrāstradhāriṇaḥ ।
nipetturvyomamārgātte haṃtuṃ bālanarāyaṇam ।।61 ।।
mārayainaṃ ghātayainaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ virodhinam ।
asurāṇāṃ mahāśatruṃ lakṣāṇāṃ ghātakaṃ param ।।62।।
tatpatnīnāṃ hārakaṃ ca mārayata drutaṃ prabhum ।
lomaśaṃ nāśayata kṣipraṃ badhvā rajjvā gale punaḥ ।।।63।।
viprāṇaṃ tvatra kuruta dhvaṃsadhvaṃ ca tadā śrayān ।
ityuktvā tvambarād yāvannipeturhananāśayāḥ ।।64।।
lomaśaḥ stambhayāmāsā''kāśe tān vai tathāvidhān ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।।65।।
naijāni sarvarūpāṇi saṃgṛhya kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
vairājarūpamāsthāya babhau girivaropamaḥ ।।66।।
sasmāra garuḍaṃ divyaṃ samāyayau kṣaṇāddhi saḥ ।
pakṣābhyāṃ vivṛtābhyāṃ ca kanyakāścāśramaṃ tathā ।।67।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi sa rarakṣa vitānavat ।
daśayojanavistāraṃ kṣetraṃ saṃrakṣya pakṣirāṭ ।।68।।
vyāttapakṣaśca tasthau sa nirbhayaścācyutājñayā ।
bhagavān drāk tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ samāruroha hetimān ।।69।।
sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ mumoca līlayā vadan ।
śatrūñjayāḥ kaṃkatālāḥ kathaṃ tiṣṭhatha niṣkriyāḥ ।।2.16.70।।
prayatyantāṃ prāṇaglahairbhavadbhirnaṣṭabhālakaiḥ ।
eṣa cāste lomaśo'tra jaḍabhāvaṃ vikarṣati ।।7 1 ।।
evamukte jaḍabhāve saṃhṛte te'surāstadā ।
śrīkṛṣṇamāyayā dagdhā hatabhāgyā punarbalam ।।72।।
cakruḥ kṛṣṇavināśārthaṃ dudruvurvegato hyabhi ।
śrīkṛṣṇe garuḍe yāvat śastrāṇi prathamaṃ tu te ।।73।।
yojayanti prahārārthaṃ tāvaccakraṃ sudarśanam ।
pralayāgnisamākāraṃ bhramattīkṣṇāraduḥsaham ।।74।।
kaṃkatālāsurāṇāṃ tu mastakānyabhyakartayat ।
nipetuścārdhabhinnāstaddehā vyomnaḥ samantataḥ ।।75।।
śirāṃsi cāpi galataśchinnānyapi tadā'patan ।
hastau pādau kaṭibhāgā nyapatan bhūtale'bhitaḥ ।।76 ।।
hastaśastrā api cakrakartitā nirbalā yathā ।
hantuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ garuḍaṃ vā lomaśaṃ nā'śakaṃstadā ।। 77।।
sahasraṃ tu tadā teṣāṃ śastracchinnaṃ layaṃ gatam ।
śeṣā vidudruvustāँśca gadā kaumodakī svayam ।।78।।
mūrtimatī cādritulyā bahuśastrakarānvitā ।
mārgamāruddhya parito dhāvamānā hyupasthitā ।।79।।
yatra yatra diśi daityā dudruvustatra taddiśi ।
gadā naikasvarūpā sā bhayaṃkarī mahāsatī ।।2.16.80।।
samutplutya purastasthau mamārā'ti tu tāँstadā ।
gadayā te hatāścānye pañcaṣaścāvaśeṣitāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kanyārūpāṇi dhṛtvaiva garuḍasyāśrayaṃ gatāḥ ।
kanyakāsu praviśyaiva rakṣaṇaṃ cakrurīśvarāt ।।82।।
atha nārāyaṇaścakraṃ gadā ca garuḍastathā ।
daityān hatvā ca naijaṃ vai sūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ dadhustataḥ ।।83 ।।
garuḍaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra samarcya parameśvaram ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ sudarśanaṃ karāgatam ।।84।।
bhagavānapi caikaikaḥ kanyādhairyapradastadā ।
jahāsa lomaśaṃ prāha nūtnāḥ kanyāstu paṃcaṣaḥ ।।85 ।।
vartante kanyakāstvatra paśya guro! mṛterbhayāt ।
daityāḥ samabhavan prāṇahetoḥ kapaṭayoṣitaḥ ।।86 ।।
tāsāṃ prāṇaparitrāṇaṃ kāryaṃ mayā dayālunā ।
ityuktāstā ruruduśca praṇemuśca yayācire ।।87।।
rakṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi nityaṃ dāsīpadaṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tathā'stvetannārīrūpaṃ sadā ca vaḥ ।।।88।।
śāśvataṃ kanyakārūpaṃ bhavatvatra mamā''laye ।
lomaśasyāśrame tāsāṃ vāsaṃ tvakārayaddhariḥ ।।89 ।।
lomaśaśca dadau mantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ galamālikām ।
taulasīṃ tilakaṃ nāmamantraṃ ca divyarūpatām ।।2.16.9 0।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
jagṛhurmantramavyagrāḥ sādhvyaḥ kanyāstu nūtanāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vaiṣṇavyastāśca sañjātā bhejire śrīhariṃ tataḥ ।
prārthayāmāsurīśeśaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mṛtayodhinām ।।9 2।।
daityā yuddhe mṛtā ye te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ।
sahasraśaḥ samāyātāḥ sūkṣmadehā vikalmaṣāḥ ।।93 ।।
āsuratvaṃ vināśyaiva śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā ।
divyatvaṃ tu tadā datvā vimānairdivyapārṣadaiḥ ।।94।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpitāḥ sarve śatrūñjayanivāsinaḥ ।
evaṃ muktiṃ prapannāste caikādaśyāṃ hariśritāḥ ।। 95।।
atha tāḥ sarvakanyāśca nītvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।
nijāśramaṃ yayau kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo babhūva ha ।।96 ।।
tattīrthaṃ kaṃkatālākhyaṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasarovare ।
jātaṃ khyātaṃ dakṣapārśve yatra pūjā hareḥ kṛtā ।।97।।
bālakṛṣṇo vidhāyaivamānandaṃ vratiyoṣitām ।
tiro'bhavat kṣaṇānte vai gṛhaparyaṃkikāṃ gataḥ ।।98।।
etaccaritraṃ subhagaṃ rādhike! devadevinaḥ ।
jñātvā śrutvā paṭhitvā'pi smṛtvā muktiṃ labhed dhruvam ।।99।।
dhanavān putravān śrīmānanantasvargavān bhavet ।
nārī saubhāgyakīrtyāḍhyā vaṃśasantānadā bhavet ।। 2.16.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya prabhoḥ kanyakākṛtapūjanaṃ bahurūpadhāraṇaṃ vratāni, śatrūñjayaparvatasthakaṃkatālānāṃ daityānāṃ yuddhaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, śeṣāṇāṃ kanyārūpadhāriṇāṃ lomaśāśrame vāsaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 16 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 016 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 17
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 018 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe ca te daityā yadā gṛhaṃ na cāyayuḥ ।
tatpatnyo daityasainyasyā'nveṣaṇārthaṃ samāyayuḥ ।। 1 ।।
ayutaṃ śrāvaṇe māse varṣānvite sthale tadā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre jalādisaṃplute śubhe ।। 2 ।।
samāgatya hi daityānāṃ patnyo vyomapradeśataḥ ।
vyapaśyan ramaṇīyaṃ cāraṇyasthaṃ mahadāśramam ।। 3 ।।
koṭikanyāśrayaṃ cāpi lomaśarṣiniṣevitam ।
kecid vaikhānasāstatra kecidāsannirāsanāḥ ।। 4 ।।
yāyāvarāstathā cānye vānaprasthāstathā'pare ।
śālīnāśca tathā kecit kāpotīṃ vṛttimāśritāḥ ।। 5 ।।
tathā cānye śritā vṛttiṃ sarvabhūtadayāṃ śubhām ।
śilocchāśca tathaivā'nye kāṣṭhapātrādanāḥ pare ।। 6 ।।
apākapācinaḥ kecit pākinaśca kvacitpunaḥ ।
nānāvidhidharāḥ kecijjitātmānastu kecana ।। 7 ।।
sthānamaunavratāḥ kecittathā'nye jalaśāyinaḥ ।
tathordhvaśāyinaścānye tathā'nye mṛgacāriṇaḥ ।। 8 ।।
pañcāgnayastathā kecit kecit parṇaphalāśinaḥ ।
abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca tathā'nye śākabhakṣiṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
ato'nye'pyatitīvrāṃ vai tapaścaryāṃ prapedire ।
yatrāraṇye sādhavaśca sādhvyo vasanti koṭiśaḥ ।। 2.17.1 0।।
yatrā''śrame hareḥ patnyaḥ koṭikanyā vasanti ca ।
yatra mokṣapradā tvāste divyā kuṃkumavāpikā ।। 11 ।।
yatra divyaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ pravartate ।
sa deśo divyatāsampādako yatra harermahān ।। 12।।
prāsādo vidyate ramyo golokādadhikojjvalaḥ ।
yatra śrīkambharālakṣmīryatra gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 13।।
rājante śrībālakṛṣṇānvitāḥ samantataḥ prajāḥ ।
tādṛśaḥ sa mahādivyo nandanopavanadyutiḥ ।। 14।।
pradeśo vīkṣitastābhirdaityābhirvyomamārgataḥ ।
vajrasphaṭikapāṣāṇaḥ pravālāṃkuraśarkaraḥ ।। 15।।
nīlā'malamṛttikāḍhyo jalanirjharaśobhitaḥ ।
vicitrakusumopetairlatāmañjarīdhāribhiḥ ।। 16।।
reje yaḥ prāṃśubhirvṛkṣairullikhadbhirivā'mbaram ।
sthalyastatrā'dhikaṃ rejurnānādhātuparisravaiḥ ।। 17।।
vicitrakusumopetāścitritā iva sarvataḥ ।
tāsu ketakikhaṇḍāśca kundaṣaṇḍāśca puṣpitāḥ ।। 18।।
unmīlitā ivā''bhānti dhātakīvanarājibhiḥ ।
bhinnendranīlavimalairdhautaiḥ prasravaṇāmbubhiḥ ।। 19।।
citraiḥ kusumasaṃchannairdhātuprastaravistaraiḥ ।
krīḍadbhirdevamithunairnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ ।।2.17.20 ।।
kūjadbhiḥ śikhibhirmattaiḥ śobhito deśa ujjvalaḥ ।
kalhārakusumopeto haṃsasārasasevitaḥ ।।21 ।।
prasannasalilākīrṇaḥ sarobhiḥ phullapaṃkajaiḥ ।
siṃhayūthānukīṇābhirjuṣṭābhirmṛgapakṣibhiḥ ।।22।।
sevitābhirmunigaṇaiḥ sthālībhirupaśobhitaḥ ।
kinnarodgītalalitaḥ parapuṣṭānināditaḥ ।।23 ।।
vidyādharaśatākīrṇo devagandharvasevitaḥ ।
dhārāpātaiśca meghānāṃ visphulliṃgaiḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।24।।
prakāśito muhurmṛduramyaharitaśādvalaḥ ।
sarvartukavanodyānaḥ puṣpākarasuśobhitaḥ ।।25 ।।
yajñakimpuruṣāvāso guhyakānāmathāśrayaḥ ।
muktānāṃ pārṣadānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ vāsaśobhanaḥ ।।26।।
varado yatra bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sarvāmaragururdevo nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ ।।27।।
bhaktānukampī sa śrīmān cādhyāste pārṣadaiḥ saha ।
vimānayāyinaḥ sarve yaṃ devaṃ parameśvaram ।।28।।
āyānti sevituṃ devā vareṇyamajamacyutam ।
anye devanikāyāśca sevituṃ prapatanti yam ।।29।।
tadadhiṣṭhānarūpo'yaṃ deśaḥ strībhirvilokitaḥ ।
daityābhirvīkṣito deśaḥ śrāvaṇe'timanoharaḥ ।।2.17.3 0।।
vṛkṣaśākhāsu kanyābhiścāndolito hariḥ patiḥ ।
pratidrulambidolāyāṃ vīkṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।3 1।।
āścaryaṃ tā gatā dṛṣṭvā patināśakaraṃ harim ।
cukrudhuścāti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hantuṃ peturdrume drume ।।32।।
yadyaddrumasya śākhāyāṃ preṃkhā kṛṣṇasya lambate ।
sa sa vṛkṣo'bhavad devo vṛkṣarūpī prasevakaḥ ।।33।।
sa sa vṛkṣo'bhavat drāk ca śastradhṛk devapūruṣaḥ ।
rakṣituṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ hantuṃ tā daityayoṣitaḥ ।।34।।
ākāśe eva rākṣasyo yuddhaṃ devairvyadhustadā ।
bhindīpālaistomaraiśca mūśalairasthihetibhiḥ ।।35।।
vṛkṣaśākhābhirugrābhirvaṃśaiḥ prastarakaṇṭakaiḥ ।
pāṣāṇairyaṣṭibhiścāpi keśākeśi tataḥ punaḥ ।।36।।
devā vṛkṣā rākṣasībhiryuyudhurna ca jīvataḥ ।
na jaghnurmarmabhāgeṣu komalāṃgeṣu naiva ca ।।37।।
strījātiṃ na vihanyādvai matvaivaṃ prāṇato na tāḥ ।
nāśayāmāsurugrāstāstataḥ kanyābhireva ca ।।38।।
smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaprabhurjñātvā nārīryuddhapramardinīḥ ।
drāgeva bhagavāँstatra dvedhā bhūtvā samāgataḥ ।।39।।
kālalakṣmīrūpadharaḥ sarvaśastrānvitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sahasrabhujavān hastisthito vyomnā samāyayau ।।2.17.40।।
śveto hastiḥ pakṣayukto jagarja tvambare yadā ।
pratidhvanyā sphuṭakarṇā rākṣasyo vihvalāstadā ।।41।।
mūrchāmavāpurākāśe nipeturvanabhūtale ।
anyāstu dudruvurhastinaṃ tu nāśayituṃ hariḥ ।।42।।
kālalakṣmīsvarūpastā jaghāna jīvatastadā ।
mriyamāṇā dvidhā chinnā bhinnāḥ peturmṛtāḥ striyaḥ ।।43 ।।
tāsāmātmā kālalakṣmyā layaṃ yāto muhurmuhuḥ ।
kiśoraścāpararūpaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ।।44।।
kanyakāmadhyavartī ca vireje lomaśāśrame ।
kāścid daityayūthapatnyo hastinā śuṇḍhayā hatāḥ ।।45।।
anyāḥ śastrairhatā lakṣmyā niḥśeṣā naṣṭatāṃ gatāḥ ।
mṛtāstā divyatāṃ prāptā yathā devyo virejire ।।46।।
mubhuhuḥ śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiśorakam ।
arthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ parameśvaramīśvaram ।।47।।
kānto bhava sadā'smākaṃ hyanāthānāṃ prarakṣakaḥ ।
mṛtā daityaguṇairhīnā jātāstava pratāpataḥ ।।48।।
kanyakāsu ca no vāsaṃ dehi lomaśasannidhau ।
sevāṃ kartuṃ samīhā naḥ sadā te'sti kṛpākara ।।49।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāhā'yutadivyāstu kanyakāḥ ।
ūnadvādaśavārṣikyo'bhavan kṛṣṇapratāpataḥ ।।2.17.50।।
rūpānurūpāvayavā priyā rādhāramāsamāḥ ।
tābhyo dadau lomaśaśca mantraṃ śrīvaiṣṇavottamam ।।51।।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
taulasīṃ mālikāṃ kaṇṭhe lalāṭe tilakaṃ śubham ।।52।।
pītaśāṭīrdadau haste mālikāṃ japasādhanīm ।
jñānaṃ vidyāṃ dadau tābhyo vāsaṃ dadau nijāśrame ।।53।।
tāśca sarvā bālakṛṣṇacaraṇau dugdhadhārayā ।
prakṣālya ca papustasya prasādānnaṃ phalādikam ।।54।।
bhakṣayāmāsuratyāptapremṇā dāsyena tāstadā ।
lomaśaśca tatastābhyaḥ sarvābhyaḥ śaraṇāgatim ।।55।।
bodhayāmāsa vai ṣoḍhā sarvasamarpaṇātmikām ।
kanyāḥ! śṛṇuta sarvā vai kṛṣṇārthakṛtaniścayāḥ ।।56।।
nārīdehaḥ parārtho'sti paraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
tadarthaṃ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ nārībhiḥ patibhaktibhiḥ ।।57।।
patireva parabrahma tārako mokṣadāyakaḥ ।
śatajanmakṛtapuṇyāt kanyā bhavati dhārmikī ।।58।।
sahasrajanmapuṇyaistu bhavet kṛṣṇārpitā tu sā ।
lakṣajanmārjitapuṇyaiḥ kṛṣṇapatnī bhavet satī ।।59।।
yūyaṃ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ kṛpayā stha na saṃśayaḥ ।
kasmāt kutaśca tāvadvai puṇyamupārjitaṃ bhavet ।।2.17.60।।
hareryogātpuṇyavārdhiḥ śevadhiriva vardhate ।
kāmāt krodhācca saṃyogāllobhānmohādapi prabhau ।।61 ।।
tallīnāstadadhīnāścet sarvaṃ puṇyamupārjitam ।
evaṃ yūyaṃ cādya jātā lakṣmīhastagatāḥ striyaḥ ।।62।।
vaireṇāpi hareryogāt puṇyaṃ prāptā hi śāśvatam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'nugrahānmama ।।63।।
āśrame parito māyā naivā''viśati kācana ।
māyāparo'yaṃ deśo'sti lomaśasya mamāśrayaḥ ।।64।।
kāmakrodhādidoṣāstu doṣiṇāṃ prajvalanti vai ।
ye mamāśramabhāgasyopari vyomni prayānti tu ।।65।।
uparito'pi gacchanti teṣāṃ naśyanti vai hṛdaḥ ।
doṣā rāgādayaścāpi paśūnāmapi pakṣiṇām ।।66।।
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca daityānāṃ cāpi yoṣitām ।
saṃsāriṇāṃ ca saṃsāro mithyāvidvāsanātmakaḥ ।।67।।
āmūlato layaṃ yāti mamāśramaniṣevaṇāt ।
atrāśrame kṛtavāsā divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ ।।68।।
śāntisteṣāṃ sadā dāsye śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ ।
yūyaṃ sarvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajathā'tra tadāśritāḥ ।।69।।
hareḥ prāptiṃ vinā nānyad vāñcchanīyaṃ viśiṣyate ।
tasya bhaktiṃ hi kuruta dhyānaṃ carata tasya vai ।।2.17.70।।
sevāṃ labhadhvaṃ tasyaiva nityaṃ nityamatandritāḥ ।
gataṃ pāpaṃ gato bhāvo daityatā vṛddhatā gatā ।।7 1 ।।
gatā bhīrmaraṇaṃ cāpi gataṃ yuṣmākamārttidam ।
sarvaṃ labdhaṃ ca labdhavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ prāptamityapi ।।72।।
kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ ca yāvadvai nā'to'nyadavaśiṣyate ।
sevadhvaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ dāsyaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā tu kanyakāḥ ।।73।।
viśvāso mādhave kāryo yathā'patyasya mātari ।
varadānaṃ varaṇaṃ ca tasmin kāryaṃ tvameva me ।।74।।
sannyāsaḥ sarvathā tasmin kṛṣṇe dehasya dehinām ।
kārpaṇyaṃ cāpi kaiṃkaryaṃ bhṛtyavat paramātmani ।।75।।
sadā sthairyaṃ sukhe duḥkhe pātivratyaṃ na cetarat ।
mama kāntasyā'nukūlyaṃ tadicchecchā tu māmakī ।।76 ।।
prātikūlyaṃ na me tasya tadaniṣṭaṃ tu neṣyate ।
ityevaṃ svāmisaukhye svasaukhyaṃ manyeta māninī ।।77।।
svāmiduḥkhe tu yā'śāntā duḥkhinī bhavati dhruvam ।
svātmavad vartate tasmin kānte deve parātmani ।।78।।
sarvaṃ tasmai pradātavyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yā samicchati ।
sa evā'tra pitā pātā sa eva jananī januḥ ।।79।।
kṛṣṇa eva mahān bandhurbhrātā svasā hariḥ svayam ।
kṛṣṇa eva kaniṣṭho'pi cānujo duhitā'pi saḥ ।।2.17.80।।
kṛṣṇa eva patiḥ patnī snuṣā vadhūrharirmama ।
kṛṣṇa eva śvaśuraśca śvaśrūrnanāndā cātmajā ।।81 ।।
putraḥ putrī sakhī mitraṃ kṛṣṇa eva sadā mama ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhrātā rājā bhatyaśca kiṃkaraḥ ।।।82।।
sevakaśca guruḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śikṣakaśca purohitaḥ ।
darśakaḥ sārtha evā'yaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhapatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।83।।
āśrayaḥ phaladaścāpi mama śreṣṭhoṃ sa mādhavaḥ ।
mama kṣetraṃ vāṭikā ca mama dravyaṃ hariḥ svayam ।।84।।
sambandhī me keśavaḥ sa bālaḥ sa bālikā mama ।
mama hṛdyo mahīmānaḥ prāghūṇiko mama prabhuḥ ।।85।।
sapatnī me sadā kṛṣṇaḥ sapatno māyike mama ।
mayi draṣṭā mayi śrotā mayi spraṣṭā janārdanaḥ ।।86 ।।
ghrātā rasayitā kṛṣṇo mayi mantā hariḥ sa vai ।
gantā mayi grahitā sa vaktā''nandayitā mayi ।।87।।
visarjayitā kṛṣṇaḥ sa boddhā cintayitā mayi ।
nirṇetā saḥ prāpayitā vettā vidvān sa vai mayi ।।88।।।
tarpayitā modayitā ratnā mayi hariḥ sa ca ।
goptā cākarṣayitā ca garbhe kukṣau sa me hṛdi ।।89।।
prāṇayitā jīvayitā'ntarātmā me pumuttamaḥ ।
sākṣī cetā patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvā'haṃ tanmayī vadhūḥ ।।2.17.90।।
tasya sarvaṃ mayi cāhaṃ tasmin śrīparamātmani ।
ityevaṃ putrikā! yūyaṃ bhavatā'sminniveditāḥ ।।9 1।।
yanmiṣṭaṃ yacca me hṛdyaṃ yanmādhuryaṃ yacchītalam ।
tatsarvaṃ me bālakṛṣṇaścaivaṃ bhavata dāsikāḥ ।।92।।
gopāyanti yathā gopyaṃ prabhurgopyatamo hariḥ ।
kāntaḥ so'yaṃ gopanīyaḥ kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।।93।।
kāntārthaṃ gopanaṃ sarvaṃ kāntāgre naiva gopanam ।
kāntavad bhāvyate kṛṣṇastataḥ kāntāyate hi saḥ ।।94।।
kāntāyate yathā kāntā kāntaṃ pratyabhikāmukī ।
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāyate kṛṣṇāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratyabhikāmukīm ।।95।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yuṣmāsu vartate ।
abhinnastiṣṭhati dravyaṃ śāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ hi saḥ ।।96।।
sa eva militaścā'tra gopālakṛṣṇamandire ।
kambharāśrīnandanaḥ sa prāpto yuṣmadvrataṃ hi saḥ ।।97।।
bhojane śayane snāne dhyāne yāne samāsane ।
vihāre ramaṇe pāne viśrāme ca pravartane ।।98।।
vikṛtau sukṛtau saumye juṣadhvaṃ taṃ viṣādane ।
nivartane ca nidrāyāṃ juṣadhvaṃ taṃ priyaṃ patim ।।99।।
evaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ svaṃ samarpayata tatra vai ।
etāvacchāstravistāraścaitāvattvanuśāsanam ।। 2.17.10 0।।
oṃ śāntirastuviratirbhavatīnāṃ narāyaṇe ।
sarvakāmalayaścā'stu bhavatīnāṃ parātmani ।। 101 ।।
ityupādiśya munirāṭ māyākṣālanasadbalaḥ ।
kanyābhyaḥ sa ca saṃvāsān dadau parṇālayeṣu vai ।। 1 02।।
svayaṃ dhyāne nimagno'bhūt kanyābhirbhojitāśca tāḥ ।
pūjitā vanditāḥ svāgatādibhiścā'bhiyojitāḥ ।। 103 ।।
tatastā api nityaṃ vai śuśruvuḥ paramāḥ kathāḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ dine dine ।। 1 04।।
prātarnityaṃ pūjayanti sma śrīkṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ priyam ।
janmanaḥ saphalatvaṃ ca kurvantyeva divāniśam ।। 1 05।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! te'tra kathitāṃ divyatāpradām ।
patyarthaṃ prāṇadātrīṇāṃ kathāṃ kṛṣṇanivedinīm ।। 1 06।।
yāsu nāsti sadācāro yāsu nāsti ca sevanam ।
bhaktirārādhanā yāsu nāsti kṛṣṇasya bhāvanam ।। 1 07।।
tāsāṃ tuṣṭo hariścāyaṃ tvanugrahaparāyaṇaḥ ।
kṛpāsādhyo mahārājo vavarṣa sīmato'tigaḥ ।। 1 08।।
kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ parātparaḥ ।
daityajātīn devajātīn brahmajātīn karoti vai ।। 1 09।।
pāpātpāpatamaścāpi paṭhanācchravaṇādapi ।
devavanmuktavat kṛṣṇapatnīvat saṃprajāyate ।। 2.17.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kaṃkatāladaityapatnīnāṃ yuddhe kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛṣṇakāntātvaṃ lomaśakṛtabālakṛṣṇātmaniveditopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 17 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 017 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 18
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 019 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe bhādrapade pitṛpakṣe harergṛham ।
aryamādikapitṝṇāṃ haraye'rpayituṃ sutāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kanyāḥ samāgatā miṣṭapāyasānnatilānvitāḥ ।
phalapuṣpā'gurukastūrikākuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
karpūrādyairyuktasauvarṇādipātrasamanvitāḥ ।
purāṇadevapūjārthaṃ sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vimānairdivyasāmagrīsaṃbhṛtaiḥ premasaṃplutāḥ ।
amāvāsyādine sarvāścāyayurlomaśāśramam ।। 4 ।।
lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā guruṃ ca pitaraṃ param ।
sasmaruśca hariṃ tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hi tāḥ ।। 5 ।।
tāvattatra bālakṛṣṇaścāyayau lomaśāśramam ।
kanyāpradattapūjādigrahaṇārthaṃ dayāvaśaḥ ।। 6 ।।
pitṛkanyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāyāntamujjvalam ।
manoharaṃ kiśoraṃ ca vilokyotthāya satvaram ।। 7 ।।
abhijagmuḥ pramodena nemurlājā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ ।। 8 ।।
abhibhāṣya ca kuśalaṃ parasparamanāmayam ।
puṣpahārān dadustasya gale sahasrakanyakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
padrajo mastake dhṛtvā mūrtiṃ nyadhuśca mānase ।
nyadhū rūpaṃ netrayośca snehaṃ nyadhustadantare ।। 2.18.1 0।।
svayaṃ nyadhuścārpaṇe'tha militvā''śramamāyayuḥ ।
brahmasarobhiḥ kanyābhiḥ satyalokīyamuttamam ।। 1 1।।
divyamarpitamevādau haṃsāsanaṃ vimānavat ।
śatacandrābhinaddhaṃ ca svarṇavarūthaśobhitam ।। 12
amṛtasrāvi paritaḥ sugandhanirjharānvitam ।
svayaṃ dolāyamānaṃ ca gītisvaramanoharam ।। 13।।
yathākāmaṃ ca gatimaccaitanyastambabhūṣitam ।
maṇisopānasaṃrājat sphāṭikapārśvaghaṭṭitam ।। 14।।
mṛduvibhūtigaddīkātulikāpaṭṭarājitam ।
adhyāruroha bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tat ।। 15।।
siṃhāsanācchataguṇā śobhā harestadā'bhavat ।
athā'psarobhiḥ kanyābhirupānahau sukomale ।। 16।।
makhamallakṛte mṛdvyau vidyuccandrikatārakaiḥ ।
svarṇarājatasantānairbharatena virājite ।। 17।।
indragosannibhe ramye cārpite pādayorhareḥ ।
niryātaste yathākāmaṃ yathākāmaṃ dhṛtikriye ।। 18।।
kṛṣṇena ca pramodena dhṛte tūpānahau yadā ।
ākṣaraṃ divyamevā''bhyāṃ tejaḥ prakaṭitaṃ bahu ।। 19।।
yadavyāpnod digantāṃśca koṭicandranibhaṃ tadā ।
athā'ryamādisūryāṇāṃ kanyābhiśchatramarpitam ।।2.18.20 ।।
suvarṇakaṭavastrāḍhyaṃ rājatīkiṃkiṇīyutam ।
suvarṇakalaśaṃ ratnadaṇḍaṃ bhāsuramujjvalam ।।21 ।।
kauśeyamañjarīyuk ca ādityacitrarājitam ।
atha kuberakanyābhiḥ pādapīṭhaḥ samarpitaḥ ।।22।।
mṛdusuvarṇakhacitaścandanadrumanirmitaḥ ।
siṃhapādasuśobhāḍhyaścāṣṭakoṇasamanvitaḥ ।।23।।
padmapatramiva svacchaḥ śītalastejasānvitaḥ ।
ādarśakhacitaḥ pārśve madhye candravirājitaḥ ।।।24।।
tatra nyadhāccaraṇau śrīpatiḥ svāmipumuttamaḥ ।
atha śailasya kanyābhiścāmarau śvetagobhavau ।।25।।
ratnasuvarṇadaṇḍau cārpitau kṛṣṇāya tuṣṭaye ।
athendrakanyakābhiścārpitaṃ vetraṃ tu kānakam ।।26।।
vedhomastakasaṃśobhaṃ kambukaṇṭhaṃ ca vakṣasi ।
valayairvividhairyuktaṃ tato vallyudaraṃ śubham ।।27।।
pītapaṭakabaddhaṃ ca prānte śeṣaphaṇāyutam ।
madhye mauktikahīrakamaṇinaddhaṃ samantataḥ ।।28।।
atha ca dharmarājasya kanyābhiryaṣṭirarpitā ।
kānakī saṃhṛtiśaktimastakā jīvanīpadā ।।29।।
samādhiśaktimadhyā ca dharmamūrtimukhānvitā ।
madhye yāmyasabhāyuktā prānte dūtagaṇānvitā ।।2.18.3 0।।
atha vāyośca kanyābhirvyajane ratnayaṣṭike ।
sauvarṇakaṭakairnaddhe kauśeyaprāntajhallare ।।3 1।।
sauvarṇapaṭavākṣepe sūryacandrobhayānvite ।
vartule taijasamaṇinaddhe rautyanisargaje ।।32।।
athartukanyakāḥ kṛṣṇe daduḥ śekharagucchakau ।
puṣpāṇāṃ kandukaṃ hārān torān sugandhisaṃbhṛtān ।। 33।।
amlānān divyarūpāṃśca miṣṭasveṣṭasugandhikān ।
atha viśvakarmakanyā dadurmukuṭamujjvalam ।।34।।
ābhūṣaṇāni ca svarṇanirmitāni ca mālikāḥ ।
ūrmikā raśanāścāṅgulīyakāni ca mekhalām ।। 35।।
kaṭakānaṃgadān śṛṃkhalāśca nupūrakiṃkiṇīḥ ।
kaṇṭhabhūṣā vicitrāśca dadurnārāyaṇāya tāḥ ।।36।।
atha drukanyakāstasmai dadurvastrāṇi bhāvataḥ ।
aṃgarakṣakaṃ dhautraṃ cottarīyakaṃ śiraḥpaṭam ।।37।।
skandhavastraṃ kaṭipaṭaṃ sauvarṇatārasaṃhitam ।
naktakaṃ karavastraṃ ca paṭṭakaṃ satpaṭīṃ daduḥ ।। 38।।
atha śravaṇapitṝṇāṃ kanyāḥ śrāvaṇya ityapi ।
daduḥ śrīharaye vāribhṛtān svarṇaghaṭān śubhān ।।39।।
atha saṃvatsarapitṛkanyāḥ pakvānnapūrikāḥ ।
pāyasāni ca śākāni bhojyāni haraye daduḥ ।।2.18.40।।
kālakanyā dadurdivyaṃ kare tvabhayacakrakam ।
vahnipitṛkanyakāśca daduḥ pātrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ।।41 ।।
sthālīśca vaṭakīścāpi kalaśān tāpalīnikāḥ ।
camacān jalapāँścāpi sauvarṇān rājatādikān ।।42।।
atha pretapitṛputryo dadustāmbūlakāni ca ।
khanijanmapitṛkanyā dadurmāṃgalyavastukam ।।43।।
dravāँśca vividhān dhātuvikārotthān suraṃgiṇaḥ ।
evamanyāśca pitryaśca nyadhuryogyaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।।44।।
vārkṣyo daduścaṭanyādi tiktāmblakaṭumiśritam ।
evaṃ bhādre hyamāyāṃ tu pitryaḥ sarvā hariṃ prabhum ।।45।।
arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ naijā'sāmānyavastubhiḥ ।
tarpayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhojayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।।46।।
pāyasādīni cānnāni phalāni vividhāni ca ।
miṣṭapānāni śītāni svādyāni rasavanti ca ।।47।।
viśvaṃbharo hi bhagavān bubhuje bahurūpadhṛk ।
sarveṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ lakṣakanyānāṃ bhāvanānugaḥ ।।48।।
lakṣarūpo harirbhūtvā śrāddhaṃ jagrāha tatkṛtam ।
atha śrībhagavān tatra sasmāra pitṛdevatāḥ ।।49।।
brahmādi mukhyadevāṃśca brahmordhvaretaso'pi ca ।
munīnṛṣīn surāँścāpi lokapālān digīśvarān ।।2.18.50।।
śrāvaṇān yāmyapitaँśca pretapitṝँśca kālikān ।
sāmvatsarikapitṝँśca khāneyāँścāpi sarvaśaḥ ।।5 1।।
ājyapān somapāँścāpi barhiṣadāँstathā pitṝn ।
agniṣvāttān karmavaśān sarvānatarpayaddhariḥ ।।52।।
jalaistilaiḥ phalairājyaiḥ pāyasairmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ ।
śākairmadhubhirdadhyannairvividhairbhojyavastubhiḥ ।।53 ।।
annavastravāripānairmukhacūrṇādibhistathā ।
āgatān sarvapitṝँśca tarpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।।54।।
koṭiśaḥ pitṛdevān sa tarpayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।
prāsādikaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।55।।
tato dānāni ca dadau koṭiratnāni vai tadā ।
kanyābhyaḥ koṭyarbudebhyaḥ sarvābhyo bhagavān svayam ।।56।।
bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pāyasādīni sarvathā ।
miṣṭānnāni ca bahūni peyāni vividhāni ca ।।57।।
svaprāsādikatāmbūlādīnyapi pradadau prabhuḥ ।
tṛptāstāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ prācyo'vācyaśca pitṛjāḥ ।।58।।
atha sāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pupūjurādarāt ।
ārārtrikaṃ tataścakrurvandanaṃ ca yathepsitam ।।59।।
arthayāmāsuretā yāḥ pitṛkanyāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
kṛṣṇasevanalābhaṃ vai dātuṃ yāvacca jīvanam ।।2.18.60।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha tathā'stviti ।
sarvāstāstasthurautsukyāllomaśasyā''śrame sadā ।।6 1 ।।
bālakṛṣṇājñayā kṛṣṇasevāparāḥ sadā'bhavan ।
pitaro ye ca tṛptāśca gatā naijaṃ svarādikam ।।62।।
bhagavān bālarūpaśca lomaśaṃ susamarcya ca ।
bhojayitvā pūjayitvā tvekarūpo hariryayau ।।63।।
naijaṃ saudhaṃ kaṃbharāśrīnivāsaṃ sampadāśrayam ।
atha sandhyāsamaye śrīhariḥ sasmāra sūryajam ।।64।।
nārakiṇāṃ tu jīvānāṃ vimokṣārthaṃ hi pāpinām ।
tathā pramuktaśeṣāṇāṃ bhujyamānaśarīriṇām ।।65।।
dharmarājyasya yāmyānāṃ tvabhayaṃ kartumeva ca ।
dharmarājaḥ samāyātastatkālaṃ harisannidhau ।।66।।
jarayā vyādhibhiścāpi mahākālena mṛtyunā ।
citraguptena sahito dvitīyarūpadhṛk nayaḥ ।।67।।
etānāha prabhuścā''dya pitṝṇāṃ divaso mahān ।
tṛptipradastataścā'haṃ tvājñāpayāmi sarvathā ।।68।।
yamalokagatāḥ sarve bhojanīyāstu pāyasaiḥ ।
mama prasādaśākādyaiḥ pāvanīyā madicchayā ।।69।।
sarve śuddhā bhavantvadya yāta svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।
ityuktvā pradadau kṛṣṇastebhyaḥ prasādapāyasam ।।2.18.70।।
yamādyā jagṛhustatra bhakṣayāmāsurādarāt ।
jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyān hi menire ।।71 ।।
atha kṛṣṇo dadau tebhyaḥ pāyasānnaṃ supuṣkalam ।
yāmyebhyaśca pradānārthaṃ yamādyā jagṛhuśca tat ।।72।।
śrīharerājñayā dharmarājādyāḥ paripūjya tam ।
natvā stutvā pādayośca patitvā ca yamakṣayam ।।73।।
yayuḥ samyak prasannāśca yāmyānāhūya nāṭakān ।
yathājñāṃ bhojayāmāsuḥ prasādaṃ pāyasaṃ hareḥ ।।74।।
bhuktvā pāpāni tūrṇaṃ te kṣālayitvā''ntarāṇyapi ।
nirmalāste ca sañjātā dharmarājājñayā tataḥ ।।75।।
svargaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ mokṣaṃ cāpi yayustadā ।
hareḥ pratāpādevaṃ vai pretādyāḥ pitaro gaṇāḥ ।।76।।
tāritā hariṇā lokapitaraḥ karmavartinaḥ ।
avagatiṃ gatāścāpi tāritāste dayālunā ।।77।।
anugrahārthaṃ jīveṣu yato janmā'sti bhūtale ।
evaṃ vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ ।।78।।
paraṃ dhāma janān jīvānnayatyeva kṛpāvaśaḥ ।
nijayogaṃ dadātyeṣa bhaktasaṃkalpatatparaḥ ।।79।।
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya pitṛmokṣo bhaveddhruvam ।
tathaiva yoṣitaḥ pitryo muktiṃ prayānti vai śruteḥ ।।2.18.80।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
pitarastu śrutā devapitaraḥ śrāvaṇāstathā ।
pretā yāmyāḥ sāmvatsarāḥ kālā khāneyakāstathā ।।8 1।।
agniṣvāttā bārhiṣadā ājyapāḥ somapāstathā ।
aryamādyā ṛṣirūpā ūrdhvaretasa aiśvarāḥ ।।82।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca mānavā rākṣasāḥ khagāḥ ।
yakṣā dūtāḥ piśācāśca bhūtāḥ kūṣmāṇḍakāstathā ।।83।।
vaināyakāśca vetālā adhogatiṃ gatāśca ye ।
ta ete pitaraḥ sarve śrutāstvattaḥ prasaṃgataḥ ।।84।।
kintu putryastvayocyante yāstu kṛṣṇena tarpitāḥ ।
kāstāḥ pitryo bhavantyatra śrāddhabhojanavāsanāḥ ।।85।।
rāseśvara kṛpāsindho tanme kṛṣṇa pradarśaya ।
yāstā nāryo pitryībhūtāḥ kva kathaṃ nivasanti tāḥ ।।86 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rādhe lokānugrahakāmyayā ।
tvaṃ tu jānāsi vai sarvaṃ nibodha kathayāmyapi ।।87।।
nārīvargo mayā sṛṣṭo goloke mama vāmataḥ ।
rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī gaṃgā sarasvatī tathā'parāḥ ।।88।।
virajā śrīryamī durgā sāvitrī ca tathetarāḥ ।
tāḥ pitryaḥ pūrvajāḥ śrāddhe bhuñjate tarpitāḥ priyāḥ ।।89।।
pitāmahī tu sāvitrī śrīśca vai prapitāmahī ।
praprapitāmahī durgā śrāddhe cāyānti tāstadā ।।2.18.90 ।।
mātā lakṣmīśca vai mātāmahī sarasvatī tathā ।
satī pramātāmahī ca śrāddhe cāyānti sarvathā ।।91 ।।
yāśca vadhvaḥ snuṣā bālā vidhavā vā kumārikāḥ ।
adhavā'pyadatī cā'kṣatā jaraṭhāḥ savāsanāḥ ।।92।।
vicittāḥ kṛtavāgdānā vivāsitāḥ svatantrikāḥ ।
nirvaṃśā niṣkuṭumbāśca nirādhārā nirāśrayāḥ ।।93।।
akṛtodakaśrāddhāśca tathā'pradattavahnikāḥ ।
atīrthavāhikā yāśca'sambandhispṛṣṭayacchavāḥ ।।94।।
akālamṛtyumāpannā ākasmikamṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।
garbhaprasūtidoṣeṇa mṛtā yāścābhicārikāḥ ।।95।।
abhicāramṛtāścāpi prasahyā'pi ca yā mṛtāḥ ।
prasahya maithune mṛtā yakṣarākṣasasaṃhṛtāḥ ।।96।।
yoniduṣṭā mṛtā yāśca vaidhavyadharmavarjitāḥ ।
bahuyogaṃ gatā yāśca parādhīnamṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।।97।।
bhūtapretapiśācādicchāyāvaśamṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।
paścātpuṇyavihīnāścā'kṛtapuṇyavratotsavāḥ ।।98।।
etā nirvaṃśajāḥ sarvāḥ pitryo bhavanti rādhike ।
yāmye vasanti nirvaṃśāḥ kumāryaḥ satyalokake ।।99।।
maharjanatapassveva tadanyāścāpamṛtyujāḥ ।
svarge puṇyakṛtāścāpi nirvaṃśā apsarogaṇāḥ ।। 2.18.100 ।।
bhūvarloke nivasanti bhūtī pretī piśācinī ।
ḍākinī śākinī kūṣmāṇḍinī vaināyakī tathā ।। 101 ।।
vaitālī bhairavī raṇḍā kṛtyā ṣaṇḍhā ca sūtakī ।
śavī citā nanāmnī ca śmaśānī ceti rādhike ।। 1 02।।
etāḥ pitryo bhavantyeva bhuvarbhūlokasaṃsthitāḥ ।
nāginī bhikṣukī pipīlikā matsyī ca rākṣasī ।। 1 03 ।।
kākī gṛdhrī ca makarī pātāle ca jale sthitāḥ ।
etā nirvaṃśamṛtijāḥ pitryo bhavanti rādhike ।। 1 04।।
mātaro devatā yāśca sāttvikyastā api striyaḥ ।
krūradṛśo'thavā vaṃśayutā api mṛteḥ param ।। 1 05।।
bhavanti pitryaḥ pāpena yathākarmanivāsikāḥ ।
tābhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ pradātavyaṃ jānatā viduṣā sadā ।। 1 06।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena tābhya eva ca ।
jalānnādi tadā dattaṃ viśvaṃbhareṇa tṛptaye ।। 107।।
tāḥ sarvā api saṃgṛhya prasādamadhigamya ca ।
yayuḥ svargādikaṃ saukhyānandasthalaṃ vṛṣānvitāḥ ।। 1 08।।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra camatkāro mahānabhūt ।
niśithe rākṣasā gurormandiraṃ samupāyayuḥ ।। 1 09।।
śirohīnasteṣu caiko'paro netravihīnakaḥ ।
tṛtīyo nāsikāhīnaścaturthaḥ karṇaśūnyakaḥ ।। 2.18.110 ।।
pañcamaḥ pādahīnaśca ṣaṣṭhaḥ kaṭitṛṇopamaḥ ।
saptamaḥ pādapṛṣṭhaścā'ṣṭamaḥ pṛṣṭhānanastathā ।। 111 ।।
navamo'ndho badhiraśca paṃgurmūkaśca kuṣṭhavān ।
caturdaśo vātarogī jalodarī napuṃsakaḥ ।। 1 12।।
saptadaśo malinaśca parito lagnamakṣikaḥ ।
aṣṭādaśo galapāśaḥ saśūlaśca tathetaraḥ ।। 1 13।।
viṃśaḥ śvaphāṭitaḥ kroḍatroṭitaśca tathā'pare ।
evamādyā gaṇāścā'śvapaṭṭasaraḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 1 14।।
krośanto bahudhā''krośān nivedayanto duṣkṛtān ।
annahīnā jalahīnāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ ।। 1 15।।
channodarāśca vai pretāścāyayurbahudhā tadā ।
rurudurlomaśasyā'gre svoddhārārthaṃ bhṛśaṃ tataḥ ।। 1 16।।
lomaśaḥ paripapraccha kathaṃ vai pretatāṃ gatāḥ ।
tatraikaḥ prāha ca mayā chinnaṃ dvijaśiraḥ purā ।। 1 17।।
tena pāpina vai jātaḥ śirohīno'tra rākṣasaḥ ।
aparaḥ prāha ca mayā cauryakārye gṛheśituḥ ।। 1 18।।
netre prasphoṭite tena netrahīno'bhavam ṛṣe! ।
tṛtīyaḥ prāha ca mayā patnyāśchinnā tu nāsikā! ।। 1 19।।
tenā'haṃ nāsikāhīnaḥ preto bhavāmi duḥkhavān ।
caturthaḥ prāha ca mayā karṇau chinnau dvijasya vai ।। 2.18.120।।
bhūṣāyuktau bhūṣaṇānāṃ mayā'paharaṇaṃ kṛtam ।
tena jātaḥ karṇahīnaḥ preto bhavāmi duḥkhavān ।। 121 ।।
pañcamastu tadā prāha mayā pravāsinaḥ purā ।
hatau pādau vane dravyaharaṇārthaṃ tato'pyaham ।। 1 22।।
pādahīnaḥ samabhavaṃ gacchāmyadhomukhaḥ sadā ।
ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāha mayā yaṣṭyā māreṇa ghātitā kaṭiḥ ।। 1 23।।
goḥ pūrvaṃ tena pāpena bhagnakaṭirbhavāmyaham ।
saptamaḥ prāha ca mayā pādau badhvā mama striyāḥ ।। 124।।
kleśitā sā vinā doṣaṃ tena doṣeṇa rākṣasaḥ ।
pṛṣṭhapādo bhavāmyatra gatiśaktivihīnakaḥ ।। 125।।
aṣṭamaḥ prāha ca mayā tvajābālāsya kaṇṭhataḥ ।
mastakaṃ mroḍitaṃ paścānmāritaṃ cājabālakam ।। 126।।
tena doṣeṇa jāto'smi pṛṣṭhānanaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ।
navamaḥ prāha ca mayā mṛgayākaraṇe purā ।। 1 27।।
cakṣuḥ prasphoṭitaṃ caikamṛgasya jīvatastataḥ ।
jāto'smi tena doṣeṇa jātyandho duḥkhaduḥkhitaḥ ।। 128।।
daśamaḥ prāha ca mayā nindā viṣṇoḥ purā śrutā ।
tenā'haṃ janmabadhiraścaikādaśo'pyuvāca tam ।। 129।।
mayā pāde hataḥ śvā ca tenā'haṃ paṃgutāṃ gataḥ ।
dvādaśaḥ prāha sādhūnāṃ nindayā mūkatāṃ gataḥ ।। 2.18.13 0।।
agamyāgamanāt kuṣṭhī trayodaśo'vadattadā ।
caturdaśo vātarogī viśvāsaghātako'bhavam ।। 131 ।।
matsyādo'yaṃ jalodarī nāto'stīti jagāda ca ।
ṣoḍaśo'yaṃ vyavāyī ca napuṃsako'ṇḍanāśakaḥ ।। 1 32।।
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ tato jātastathā caṇḍālakarmakṛt ।
makṣikāsamabhivyāptaḥ saṃjāto'yaṃ tathā'vadat ।। 1 33।।
galapāśapradaścāyaṃ galapāśo'bhavattathā ।
śūlapradaśca jīvānāṃ śūlarogī tato hyayam ।। 134।।
viṃśaḥ prāha mayā pūrvaṃ śaśādyāḥ śvāpadādibhiḥ ।
vidāritā bahupāpo bhavāmyadya vidāritaḥ ।। 135।।
atikaṣṭaṃ ca bhuñjāmo bhojanaṃ nopalabhyate ।
tṛṣitā duḥkhitāḥ smo'dya kṛpālurbhagavān yadi ।। 136।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uddhārayettu naḥ ।
muktiṃ gatā bhaviṣyāmo vipra! muktiṃ pradāpaya ।। 1 37।।
ityukto lomaśastebhyo dadau mantraṃ jalānvitam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 1 38।।
sasmāra bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇo drāk tatra cāyayau ।
nijapādajalaṃ tebhyo pāyayitvā hariśca tān । । 139।।
vidhāya divyadehāँśca caturbhujasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
vimānaiḥ preṣayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।। 2.18.140।।
evaṃ muktiṃ pradatvaiva harirnaijālayaṃ yayau ।
pāpināṃ muktidātā'yaṃ jayate parameśvaraḥ ।। 141 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pitruddhāro bhaveddhruvam ।
yaśaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gāvaścārogyamityapi ।। 142।।
putraḥ pautrāḥ sutāḥ svarṇaṃ mokṣo lakṣmīrvibhūtayaḥ ।
bhaveyuḥ sampadaḥ sarvāḥ śroturvakturna saṃśayaḥ ।। 143।।
namastasmai bhagavate sarvoddhāradayālave ।
karmāṇi pāpināṃ cā'vigaṇayya mokṣadāyine ।। 144।।
daityadānavapāpānāṃ rakṣasāṃ pāvanāya ca ।
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ mokṣakartre namonamaḥ ।। 145।।
dayāloḥ śrīharernāsti dayāyāḥ pāra ityapi ।
pāpināṃ tu kvacinnāsti doṣāṇāmanta ityapi ।। 146।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
jñātvā bhajanti satataṃ te mokṣasthā na saṃśayaḥ ।। 147।।
citte kṛṣṇo hṛdi kṛṣṇaścakṣuṣoḥ kṛṣṇa ātmani ।
brahmarandhre yasya kṛṣṇaḥ sa bhavenmokṣago dhruvam ।। 148।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛpakṣe pitṛkanyākṛtaharipūjanaṃ, harikṛtapitṛtarpaṇādi, nārakāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, pitṛstrījātiparicayaḥ pretānāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 19
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 020 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athā'sya vatsare yāte dvitīye vatsare śubhe ।
prārabdhe kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ janmotsavaṃ pitā ।। 1 । ।
pracakāra tadā gurorlomaśasyā'pi pūjanam ।
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 2 ।।
sarva tad rādhike tubhyaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapumuttamasya vai ।। 3 ।।
saptamyāṃ prātarutthāya śrīmadropālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ rādhe! snātvā prapūjya keśavam ।। 4 ।।
patrikāṃ lekhayāmāsa vārṣikādyamahotsave ।
varṣaṃ me nandanasyaurjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprage śubham ।। 5 ।।
pūrṇa prajāyate cātha dvitīyavatsarakṣaṇe ।
śubhe dine ca tatraiva mahotsave mudāvahe ।। 6 ।।
kriyamāṇe mayā''gatya bhavadbhirupabṛṃhite ।
svātmā'yamiti matvaiva śobhāvṛddhirvidhīyatām ।। 7 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāśīrnidhiḥ svayam ।
nīyantāṃ cāpi dīyantāṃ yathāsnehaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 8 ।।
matvā gṛhaṃ svakīyaṃ cā''gantavyaṃ prārthayāmi vaḥ ।
kuṭumbabhṛtyasujanasuhṛtsambandhisaṃhitān ।। 9 ।।
devarṣipitṛvṛddhānāṃ satāṃ brahmānuśīlinām ।
pativratānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ brahmayoṣitām ।। 2.19.10 ।।
vipradharmavatāṃ bhaktasatsaṃgakāriṇāṃ tathā ।
śubhāśīrbhiḥ śiśuḥ śyāmo ghanaśyāmo harirbhavet ।। 11 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
saurāṣṭre bhūtale sarvairāgantavyaṃ mama gṛhama ।। 12 ।।
bhadrā yasyottare cāsti pūrvaṃ śatrujitā nadī ।
dakṣiṇe vartate vyāghrāraṇyaṃ ca paścime giriḥ ।। 13 ।।
madhye sarovaraṃ divyaṃ daśakrodhādivartulam ।
madhye dvīpo mahānasti prāsādo lomaśāśramaḥ ।। 1 4। ।
tatra gopālakṛṣṇasya mamālayo virājate ।
āgantavyaṃ mahābhāgairdvitīyavārṣikotsave । । 1 5 । ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ bhaviṣyāmyāgamāttu vaḥ । । 16 । ।
vaikuṇṭhena sameyaṃ bhūrbhaviṣyatyāgamāttu vaḥ ।
putrasya janmasāphalyaṃ bhaviṣyatyāgamācca vaḥ । । 17। ।
vāraṃ vāraṃ praṇamyā''mantrayāmyāgamanāya vaḥ ।
caturdaśastarasthānāṃ samājo'tra bhaviṣyati । । 18 । ।
parasparaprasaṃgena lābho'labhyo bhaviṣyati ।
seviṣye ca yathāśakti mahīmānān samāhitaḥ । । 1 9। ।
kṛpaṇo'yamiti matvā'nugrāhyo dāsa eva yat ।
kambharāśrīstathā cānugrāhyā nārībhirāgamāt ।। 2.19.20 । ।
sarvamānasayuktāṃśca tattvāni cārthayāmyapi ।
dravyaguṇakriyājātisaṃsargānarthayāmyapi । । 21 । ।
cetanācetanān sarvānāmantrayāmi bhāvataḥ ।
mama putro bhavatputro vardhanīyaḥ śubhāśiṣā ।। 22। ।
anāgame tu cintā me sarvadā'nāgamātmikā ।
utthitā syācca sā mābhūt kṛpā mā khaṇḍitā bhavet ।। 23। ।
śāśvatikatā saṃrakṣyā śāśvatikamahotsave ।
ityabhyarthya virame'tipratikṣan ṛtayācanām । । 24। ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! pitrā prabhoḥ kuṃkumapatrikā ।
likhitā bhāvagarbhā ca preṣitā vai digantare ।।25 । ।
kṛṣṇāyudhāni sarvāṇi yayurnītvā divaṃ prati ।
īśalokān guṇā yayurdhāmānyaiśvaryamaṇḍalam ।।26। ।
pātālādau bhūṣaṇāni yayurnītvā ca patrikāḥ ।
rādhike! mūrtimantaste kṛṣṇadūtā yathā yayuḥ । ।27। ।
āmantritāśca te yātuṃ prayāṇe cakrire mudā ।
svasvalokasyavastūni śreṣṭhapreṣṭhāni sarvathā ।।28।।
divyānyupadāyogyāni sauvarṇarājatāni ca ।
tāntavāni rāsanāni vimānādau dadhuśca te ।। 29। ।
ānandaṃ menire kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahotsavam ।
iṣṭaṃ bhāgyaṃ samāyātaṃ matvā babhūvurutsukāḥ ।।2.19.3 0 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gopālakṛṣṇalomaśau ।
saptamyāmeva sāmagrīsamavāyaṃ pracakratuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā guḍakulyāśca śarkarāḥ ।
madhūni ca vicitrāṇi miṣṭānnānyapi sarveśaḥ । ।32 ।।
peyāni mukhacūrṇāni kārayāmāsaturmudā ।
kāndivikāśca devānāṃ tayā lakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kanyakāśca harerbhaktāścakrurmāhānasīyakam ।
pātheyaṃ jāṭharārpyaṃ ca yatkiñcidbhinnajātikam । ।34 ।।
sarvaṃ vyañjanasāhāyyaṃ cāranālādibṛṃhitam ।
lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ bhojyamiṣṭaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bharjitamityapi ।। 35।।
kvāthitaṃ pācitaṃ pratāpitaṃ cārdrīkṛtaṃ tathā ।
pepitaṃ kūrcitaṃ dagdhaṃ sārīkṛtaṃ prapecetam । ।36 ।।
chūṃkāritaṃ vāṣpitaṃ ca miśritaṃ mathitaṃ tayā ।
yadyad yogyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ cakrurvai niśi sarvathā । । 37 ।।
darvī cullī kaṭāhī ca sthālī kuṃbhī mahānasī ।
cipiṭī gargarī bhrāṣṭrī cāgaminī ca vardhinī । । 38 ।।
mūśalī vallarītyādyā devyaḥ pākasahāyadāḥ ।
kuśalinyo ramādīnāṃ kaiṃkaryaṃ cakrurādarāta ।। 39 ।।
dvādaśa rāśayaścāpi tadā sarvapradeśataḥ ।
niyojitāḥ samānetuṃ vastūnyāninyurādarāt ।।2.19.40 ।।
rāśīnāṃ yatra saṃcārā yatra yatra vasanti ca ।
tattadvastūni cādāya samāyayustadotsukāḥ ।। 41 ।।
meṣī rāśirnivasati dhānyaratnākarādiṣu ।
navaśādvalasaṃchannavasudhāyāṃ na sarvaśaḥ ।। 42।।
nityaṃ carati phulleṣu sarasāṃ pulineṣu ca ।
ajāvikadhanādau ca sasyeṣu vividheṣu ca ।।43 ।।
sā ca naijanivāsebhyo dhānyāni rasavanti ca ।
ratnāni mīktikādīni hīrakāṃśca maṇīṃstathā ।।44।।
pādatrāṇe śirastrāṇaṃ varma caurṇaṃ samujjvalam ।
hastatrāṇaṃ kaṭitrāṇaṃ kambalikāśca kambalān ।।45 ।।
vasūn vamumatīgarbhāt śākapatrāṇi sarvataḥ ।
phullapuṣpāṇi hārāँśca pakvā''makaṇikāँstathā ।।46 ।।
phalakandān mukhacūrṇānānināya supuṣkalān ।
divyā ca meṣadevī sā'rpayāmāsa tu śārṅgiṇe ।।47।।।
atha rāśirvṛṣīnāmnī carate gokulādiṣu ।
nivāso vartate tasyāḥ kṛṣīvaladharādiṣu ।।48।।
śaṃkarasya gṛhe cāpi dharmadevīsvarūpiṇī ।
goloke vartate cāpi sāpi divyā tadutsave ।।49 ।।
ānināya ca golokāt kāmadhenūḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
dhānyānyakṣatagodhūmādīni dugdhājyakāni ca ।।2.19.50 ।।
bhūrīṇi navanītāni dadhitakrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
yānavāhanaśibikā bhogyavastūni yāni ca ।।51 ।।
ānināya ca kailāsādasaṃkhyaratnakāni ca ।
dadau śrīharaye tatrotsavārthe vastupuṣkalam ।।5.।।
mithunīnāmikā rāśirgītanartanaśilpiṣu ।
vartate cāpi dampatyoḥ śayyāsanaparigrahe ।।।53 ।।
vīṇāvādyādiṣu cāpi krīḍāyāṃ ca ratau tathā ।
adhvādau ca vihāro'syā vartate gṛhamedhiṣu ।।54।।
rāśi gurau mahāloke mahājane ca sarvathā ।
sāpi divyā divyavastūnyānināyopadātmikāḥ ।।55।।।
gītikānṛtyaśilpādikalāścatuḥpraṣaṣṭikāḥ ।
kanyakāḥ sā samānīyotsave śrīharaye dadau ।।।56।।
dugdhaphenanibhāḥ śayyāścāsanāni dyumanti ca ।
gṛhasāhāyyasāmagrīḥ sarvāścānāyya vai dadau ।।57।।
vīṇāvādyāni sarvāṇi rājabhogyasuvaibhavān ।
guruyogyān devayogyānānāyya vaibhavān dadau ।।58।।
martyayogyāँstathā sarvadehiyogyāँśca vaibhavān ।
nijāśramasthalebhyaścānāyya śrīharaye dadau ।।।59। ।
karkināmnī ca yā rāśiḥ kṛkalāsī hi devatā ।
salilasthā ca kedāravāpipulinavāsinī ।।2.19.60 ।।
viviktā'vanisaṃsthā cā''nināya jalamauktikān ।
kamalāni vicitrāṇi rasāṃśca vividhāँstathā ।।6 1 ।।
nūtnakedārasasyānāṃ supakvāḥ śimbikāstathā ।
ānināya dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cotsave ।।62।
siṃhī tu parvatāraṇyadurgakandarabhūmiṣu ।
vasati vyādhapallīṣu gahvareṣu guhāsu ca ।।63।।
sā ca naijāvāsabhūmerānināya sucāmarau ।
kastūrīdhātusaugandhyaṃ karpūracandanāni ca ।।64।।
kauśeyakāni vastrāṇi gajamauktikakāni ca ।
aurṇakambalavastrāṇi mṛduni śītahāni ca ।।65।।
mṛgacarmāṇi ramyāṇi siṃhacarmāṇi vai tathā ।
vyāghrahastipracarmāṇi karidantāँśca hīrakān ।।66।।
svargarasān kupyarasān khāneyakān rasāँstathā ।
gūṭikāścauṣadhīn divyastambānakṣayakṛllatāḥ ।।67।।
divyagandhān divyaphalānyapi kalpadrumāँstathā ।
divyapradīpapatrāṇyānināya haraye dadau ।।68। ।
atha vai kanyakārāśiḥ sarvasaubhāgyasundarī ।
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyā svarṇacampakasūjjvalā । ।69।।
kalpakanyāsvarūpā ca bhāvanāphaladā sadā ।
vrīhipradīpakakarā vasati dampatīśaye । ।2.19.7 0 । ।
tāmbūladā ganadharasasāradā''nandadāyinī ।
naḍvaleṣu cāmareṣu puṇyeṣu kalikādiṣu ।।71 ।।
nagareṣu ca devānāṃ gṛheṣu vasati tathā ।
svarge satye martyaloke pātālādau harergṛhe ।।72। ।
sarvatra vasati kanyā cānināya śubhadravān ।
kuṃkumā'kṣatasaubhāgyavibhūṣā ratnajhullarīḥ ।।73।।
kaṃcukān candrasannaddhān ṭopīṃ cāndrīṃ ca śāradīm ।
hiraṇyagarbhopaskārān pātrāṇi kaṭakāँstathā । ।74। ।
asaṃkhyānantapātrāṇi kānakāni mahotsave ।
kalaśān gargarīrhāṇḍān vaṭikāḥ sthālikāstathā ।।75। ।
hārān vicitrān pramaṇīn sūryakāntān manoharān ।
candrakāntān vahnikāntān devakāntān nināya sā ।।76 ।।
cāmarān ratnadaṇḍāँśca chatrāṇi kānakāni ca ।
vetrān yaṣṭīn vellaṇādīn vardhanīḥ kaṇḍanīstathā ।।77। ।
tāmbūlāni vicitrāṇi gucchān cāmpakakaisarān ।
kādambakāँśca kaundāँśca kalpayaṣṭīṃśca kānakīḥ ।।78। ।
miṣṭānnasthālikā dīrghā naisargikapradīpakān ।
gandhān rasān gandhasārān nināya haraye dadau ।।79।।
tulārāśiśca vai divyā tulānāmnī tu sundarī ।
bīthyā''paṇakrayaśālānagarādhvagṛhādiṣu ।।2.19.80 । ।
dhanāḍhyavyāpṛtisthāne vasati carate tathā ।
sā'pi divyā kṛṣṇakāntakṛte nināya cotsave ।।81 । ।
annānāṃ veṣavārāṇāṃ pauṣkalyaṃ hrāsavarjitam ।
tulāṃ divyāṃ dadau yatra dhṛtaṃ tvakṣayameva hi ।।82। ।
dhanāni svarṇaraupyāṇi mudrāḥ pāśān dadau tu sā ।
kuberabhavanānnītvā bahvīḥ smṛddhīrdadau tadā ।।।83 ।।
vṛścikī yā ca vai tīvrā rāśiḥ śvabhre ca bhūstare ।
valmīke gomaye dīrṇe sthale bhūgarbhake tathā ।।84।।
pāṣāṇādau ca vasati carati drutvagādiṣu ।
gṛhabhittau vane kṣetre'raṇye kaccarake truṭau ।।85।।
divyakanyā ca sā kṛṣṇakṛte nināya śailajān ।
śilārasān drumarasān bhūmikandāँśca mūlakān ।।86।।
raṇajanyān bhūmijanyān rasān lāvaṇasaṃjñitān ।
kaṭvamblamadhurāँścāpi viṣahāँśca rasān dadau ।।87।।
dhanūrāśirdivyakanyā turaṃgarūpadhāriṇī ।
dhanuryuktā śaratūṇā śūrā'straśastravidvarā ।।88।।
gaje rathe turage ca yāne vimānake kṣitau ।
śakaṭe śibikāyāṃ ca tiṣṭhati carate tathā ।।89।।
tattatsthalāni yānāni gajavājirathādikān ।
vyomayānāni divyāni vyomodyānayutāni ca ।।2.19.90 ।।
haṃsaturagahastyādiśobhitāni navāni vai ।
vimānāni dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cotsave ।। 91 ।।
makarīnāmato rāśirmṛgāsyā divyakanyakā ।
nadīṣu vasati vārdhau mahāsarovarādiṣu ।। 92।।
khāteṣu devaparikhādiṣu sañcarate tathā ।
tattatsthānaprajātāni ratnāni haraye dadau ।।93 ।।
kuṃbhikārāśirityākhyā puruṣaskandhavāsinī ।
riktakuṃbhātmikā kanyārūpā śauṇḍikasadmasu ।। 94।।
dyūtagṛheṣu śālāsu vasati carate tathā ।
sā ca dadau koṭikuṃbhān sauvarṇān haraye tadā ।। 95।।
mīnarāśiryugalaṃ saprema tīrthābdhisañcaram ।
vasati puṇyatīrtheṣu devabrāhmaṇasadmasu ।। 96 ।।
mīnī kanyātmikā divyā cāgatya haraye dadau ।
pūjāpātrāṇi sarvāṇi pūjādravyottamāni ca ।। 97।।
upacārān ṣoḍaśa saṃpradadau haraye mudā ।
evaṃ rāśirdvādaśātmā divyakanyāgaṇastadā। ।। 98।।
satyapātālaparyantān sārān śrīharaye dadau ।
viśvakarmā''hūta evā''gato maṇḍapamadbhutam ।। 99।।
cakāra śatabhaumaṃ ca kṣetragarbhaṃ digantagam ।
vyomavāṭaṃ yānavāṭaṃ samudyānasuśobhitam ।। 2.19.10 0।।
dharmasabhā cendrasabhā sabhā cāpi bṛhaspateḥ ।
śukrasabhā brahmasabhā sabhā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca ।। 101 ।।
yatra vai maṇḍape tatra samāveśagatāstadā ।
siṃhāsanāni divyāni ketavaḥ kānakāstathā ।। 1 02।।
kalaśāḥ svarṇanirmāṇāḥ śataikasaṃkhyayā sthitāḥ ।
sahasraikaśikharāḍhyo naisargikadivākaraḥ ।। 103 ।।
naisargikaśaśibhrājattejaḥpuñjavirājitaḥ ।
vidyuddīpārbudaśobhaḥ koṭitārakarājitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
vāpīkūpataḍāgādigṛhasādhanamaṇḍitaḥ ।
bhośrayapānapramṛdyādidivyadravyavirājitaḥ ।। 1 05।।
divyamaṇḍanamālādyairdivyamāṇikyabhittikaḥ ।
divyamauktikamaṇyādyairhārakādyaiḥ subṛṃhitaḥ ।। 1 06।।
naikagopuravāṭaiśca sahasradhruvaśāśvataḥ ।
madhyevedīmahādivyānalanaisargikājyavān ।। 1 07।।
lakṣalakṣātilakṣāṇāṃ stambhānāṃ rājirājitaḥ ।
sarvadevarṣimunibhirjagatāṃ pālakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।। 1 08।।
stambhoparikṛtasthāno divyakīramayūrakaḥ ।
divyaśravaṇavīkṣādidivyabhojyagṛhādibhiḥ ।। 109 ।।
divyārāmavihārādidivyabhojyagṛhādibhiḥ ।।
divyāplavanabhāgaiśca varāṃgaṇairvirājitaḥ ।। 2.19.11 0।।
vyomagaḥ kāmagaḥ koṭyarbudakanyābhiśobhitaḥ ।
divyapradarśanavyāpto divyamallaraṇāṃgaṇaḥ ।। 11 1।।
divyagāndharvavidyaśca divyanāṭakarañjitaḥ ।
daivīvādyakṛtālāpasvaramiṣṭādyamaṇḍitaḥ ।। 1 12।।
gajasiṃhādipratimaḥ sarvadevavirājitaḥ ।
brahmāṇḍe caiśvare loke dhāmni nāsti ca yat khalu ।। 1 13।।
tattatra nāsti vai viśvakarmanirmitamaṇḍape ।
jīvasṛṣṭau ceśasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭau pare sthale ।। 1 14।।
yat kiñcid vidyate khyātaṃ tadatra maṇḍape kṛtam ।
viśvakarmā'karocchailpyaṃ brahmā'karod vidhānakam ।। 1 19।।
vāsudevo'karod vasturūpāṇi khyātimanti ca ।
akṣaraṃ brahma rūpāṇāṃ vyaktatāmakarottadā ।। 1 16।।
rādhike tvaṃ mahāmāyā nyūnatāmaharaḥ svayam ।
lakṣmīḥ pūrṇatvamātiṣṭhajjayā jayamakārayat ।। 1 17।।
ityevaṃ saptamīsāyaṃ maṇḍapaḥ śobhano'bhavat ।
rātrirna dṛśyate tatra śāśvate dhāmni cāgate ।। 1 18।।
nidrā kuṃkumavāpyāśca kṣetrāt krośagataṃ gatā ।
ānandinī mahābrāhmī śaktiḥ saurāṣṭrake sthitā ।। 1 19।।
sūryasyodayanaṃ pūrvaṃ bimbadarśanamātrakam ।
rātryāgamo digantānāṃ kārṣṇyamātrābhiveditaḥ ।। 2.19.1 20।।
vigamaśca digantānāṃ prabhādhāvalyaniścitaḥ ।
bālakhilyāgamenaiva sūryodayastu tarkitaḥ ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣārambhotsave sarvalokeṣvāmantraṇapatrikāpreṣaṇaṃ rāśikṛtavastūpasthāpanaṃ mahāmaṇḍapanirmāṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 19 । ।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evaṃvidhe kṛte tatra maṇḍape kuṃjalakṣakaiḥ ।
śobhite raṃgaraṃgolīsvastikavallarīyute ।। 1 ।।
dadhyaṃkuśakṣatalājāstambamaṇḍanamaṃgale ।
parito jhallarīmadhye nyastaślokābhibodhake ।। 2 ।।
kammānikoparinyastamukhyadevābhidhānake ।
tattaddhvajeṣu vinyastatattatpradhānavāhane ।। 3 ।।
tattadgopurapālānāmambare kaṃdhraveṣṭane ।
tattatpradhānadevānāṃ nāmabhiścittarañjane ।। 4 ।।
saptarūpābhirūpāḍhyāmbaraveṣṭitayaṣṭike ।
divyasauvarṇavastraiśca veṣṭitastambhamaṇḍale ।। 5 ।।
divyadevīpratimābhiḥ stambhaśiromanohare ।
sthale jalaṃ jale sthalaṃ cobhayoranalekṣaṇe ।। 6 ।।
anale nalavadrājaccāmarairupaśobhite ।
vidyullatābhiḥ paritaḥ pāradarśananirmale ।। 7 ।।
madhyolloceṣu vartule rāsamaṇḍalarājite ।
ajñātamūlato niryannavaraṃgasukāntike ।। 8 ।।
vidyutpaṭeṣu nāṭyānāṃ navadarśanarañjane ।
vyūhāvatāradevānāṃ camatkāraiḥ sucitrite ।। 9 ।।
kṛṣṇakāntārbudānāṃ ca līlālalitatāmaye ।
sarvasmṛddhe kāmayāne kāmage kāmagahvare ।। 2.20.10 ।।
kāmopasthitasatye ca satyasaṃkalpamaṇḍape ।
etādṛśe'ṣṭamīprātaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
candanādijalairbhūmiṃ secayāmāsa śītalaiḥ ।
dhūpaiḥ sugandhayāmāsā''modairvividhajātikaiḥ ।। 12।।
svastikān sarvatobhadrān cakrāṇi vartulāni ca ।
maṇḍalāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa raṃgakaiḥ ।। 13 ।।
akṣataiḥ kusumaiścāpi kuṃkumairdadhipallavaiḥ ।
bhadrāँstān śobhayāmāsa gopurāँścāpi toraṇaiḥ ।। 14।।
āmrā'śokādipatraiśca kadalīstambhapatrakaiḥ ।
saphalaiḥ kadalīstambhaiḥ śākhāprāntaiḥ phalāñcitaḥ ।। 15।।
puṣpitaiḥ stabakaiścāpi śobhayāmāsa vāṭagān ।
dhvajānārohayāmāsotsavabodhakaśabditān ।। 16।।
patākāścāpi sarvatra bandhayāmāsa maṇḍape ।
divyakācādiyantrāṇi vidyuddīpādibhistathā ।। 17।।
samyak prabhāsayāmāsa maṇḍapādau samantataḥ ।
maṇḍapasyā'tiramyasya stambhe stambhe'ṣṭasiddhayaḥ ।। 18।।
iṣṭāpūrakarūpiṇyaḥ pūrayāmāsurīhitam ।
dhruvayantraṃ kālayantraṃ vedhayantraṃ mahattaram ।। 19।।
dūradarśanayantrāṇi dūraśrāvaṇakāni ca ।
pratibimbaprayantrāṇi pratisthalaṃ pratigṛham ।।2.20.20।।
pratistambhaṃ ca naddhāni vidyante divyamaṇḍape ।
sudīrghaurṇāstaraṇāni śādvalādinibhāni vai ।।21 ।।
bṛsyaḥ kaṭāni cāsyāni siṃhāsanāni vedikāḥ ।
gajāsanāni haṃsāsyā gāruḍāsyāni catvarāḥ ।।22।।
suvarṇavālukādīni maṇinaddhāsanāni ca ।
dolā bahuvidhāścāpi mañcā dīrghāḥ samantataḥ ।। 23।।
vidyante bahumūlyāni tathā sopānatūlikāḥ ।
svarṇaratnamaṇismṛddhāḥ śobhante ca samantataḥ ।। 24।।
mṛnmayāstatra kedārāstūlasīdrumaśobhitāḥ ।
anagaśārṅgasañjātā jātyādipuṣpajātayaḥ ।।25।।
campakādyāḥ śubhāḥ kharvā drumāstiṣṭhanti maṇḍape ।
suvarṇavālukābhūmiḥ kāśate vai samantataḥ ।।26 ।।
mṛdvī mṛdukumārīṇāṃ pattalā'rhā'tikomalā ।
yajñavāṭāḥ khaṇḍarathyāḥ sṛtayaśca pradakṣiṇam ।।27।।
mārgāḥ pallavavallyādyaiḥ śobhante yatra maṇḍape ।
darśakānāmāsanāni paryaṅkamañcavanti ca ।।28।।
paritaścordhvamūrdhvaṃ ca klṛptāni vyomagāni vai ।
bhṛtyacāraṇabhāṭṭānāṃ bhaṭamāgadhabandinām ।।29।।
vipravidvadviduṣīṇāṃ kavivācālagāyinām ।
śobhante cāsanānyuccasthāni vidyullatā yathā ।।2.20.3 0 ।।
manuṣyāṇāṃ tataścāntarbhāgeṣvāsanapaṃktayaḥ ।
parito bahuvistārāḥ śobhante candrikā yathā ।।3 1 ।।
tato'ntaḥsthā yakṣarakṣobhūtapretapiśācakāḥ ।
kūṣmāṇḍā vaināyakāśca vetālāḥ kinnarāstathā ।।32।।
kiṃpuruṣāśca vidyādhrā yoginīnāṃ gaṇāstathā ।
tato'ntaḥsthā divyadehā mukuṭakaṭakojjvalāḥ ।।33 ।।
devā devyo devapālā deveśvarāḥ surānugāḥ ।
sthale sthale catuṣkaśca paṭṭikā nihitāstathā ।।34।।
catuṣpādyaścāṣṭapādyastathā ṣoḍaśapādukāḥ ।
tatra tiṣṭhanti devānāṃ mūrdhanyā devabhūbhṛtaḥ ।।35।।
atha siṃhāsanānyāsan saphaṇāchatrakāni ca ।
sauvarṇānyatidivyāni hyadhiṣṭhitāni pitṛbhiḥ ।।36।।
athāntaḥ ṛṣayaścāsan jāpakā brahmacintakāḥ ।
vedapāṭhakarā lakṣmīsaṃhitāpāṭhakāstathā ।। 37 ।।
rudrasya brahmaṇaścāpi saṃhitayoḥ prapāṭhakāḥ ।
agastyasya saṃhitāyāḥ pāṭhakāścāpi kecana ।।38।।
aurṇāsaneṣu paṭṭikānihiteṣu sthitāstadā ।
tato'ntarmaṇḍapasyā'dhaḥpīṭhikāyāṃ maharṣayaḥ ।।39।।
satyalokanivāsā ye tathā vairājavāsinaḥ ।
brahmacaryaparāścāsan brahmajāpaparāyaṇāḥ ।।2.20.40।।
yajñakarmaparāścāsan ṛtvijo brahmavittamāḥ ।
brahmā hotā tathodgātā'dhvaryuśceti pratikramāḥ ।।41 ।।
sāmagā gītigāścānye mantraprayogiṇastathā ।
āsan svakarmakuśalā bhārgavādyāḥ saśaktikāḥ ।।42।।
yajñapātrāṇi caravaḥ sruksruvādyāstathā dravāḥ ।
yajñiyāni ca kāṣṭhāni vrīhyādīnyabhavat sphiram ।।43।।
ājyaṃ havyaṃ samagraṃ ca vividhaṃ vartate tadā ।
yajñakuṇḍo viśālaśca vaiṣṇavo yajñadevatā ।।44।।
vahniśca vaiṣṇavo yatrāhavanīyo virājate ।
svastivācanapūrvaṃ ca yajñakarma pravartate ।।45।।
mātā śrīkambharālakṣmīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
yajamānasthale tatra rājete lomaśāgrataḥ ।।46।।
lomaśo vidhivattatra nārāyaṇasya pūjanam ।
kārayāmāsa ca tato havanaṃ sampravartate ।।47।।
dakṣiṇe kuṇḍatastatrā'kṣaramuktāḥ sthitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
pārśve golokamuktāśca pārśve vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।48।।
tato'nye vaikuṇṭhavāsāḥ kṣīrodaśvetavāsinaḥ ।
badrīsthāścāpi kailāsasthāścānyadhāmagāstathā ।।49।।
tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe bhāge pūrṇabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
vedikāyāṃ parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।2.20.50।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sākṣādvirājate bālaḥ svāmī kiśorarūpadhṛk।।51 ।।
yadyapyāste lokarītyā dvitīyavarṣasañcaraḥ ।
tathāpi dhāmarūpāḍhyo rājate parameśvaraḥ ।।52।।
vedyāṃ siṃhāsane ramye vimāne bhagavān svayam ।
tatpārśve rādhike cāhamāsaṃ kṛṣṇastava priyaḥ ।।53।।
matpārśve śrīpatiścāste tatpārśve nṛnarāyaṇaḥ ।
tatpārśve śvetavāsī ca kṣīravāsī tatastathā ।।54।।
bhūmādyā vāsudevādyāḥ kapilādyāstataḥ param ।
āsate vedikāsiṃhāsaneṣu ca vimānake ।।55।।
tatpatnyastatkumāryaśca tanmuktā vetradhāriṇaḥ ।
chatradhrāḥ pārśvavāsāśca tiṣṭhanti tatsamantataḥ ।।56।।
avādyanta ca tūryāṇi vedikāyāśca pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
koṭidevyo virājante samanyūnāsaneṣu ca ।।57।।
gāyanti gītikā ramyā kṛṣṇamahotsavapriyāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇalīlāgarbhā divyamanoharāḥ ।।58।।
homo vai jāyate tatra tṛpyanti ceśvarādayaḥ ।
devāśca pitaraḥ sarve'vatārā muktakoṭayaḥ ।।।59।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇenārpitaṃ havyaṃ navaṃ navam ।
sākṣād gṛhṇanti te sarve vahnivyājena vai punaḥ ।।2.20.60।।
pāyasāni vicitrāṇi phalapuṣpamadhūnyapi ।
hūyante vrīhayaścāpi nārikelānyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।।6 1।।
parihāre kṛte cātha pūrṇāhutau tathotthitaḥ ।
samājo maṇḍape tatra juhoti divyasadrasān ।।62 ।।
rudro viṣṇustathā brahmā grahā gaṇapatistathā ।
mātaraḥ kalaśaścāpi dikpālā devateśvarāḥ ।।63।।
ye ye saṃsthāpitāstatra tattadāyatanātmakāḥ ।
pūjitā mūrtimantaste havane samavāyinaḥ ।।64।।
sākṣātkṛtvā havanaṃ ca gṛhṇantyagnimukhaistadā ।
tṛptirjātā yajñakāryaṃ samāptaṃ dakṣiṇāyutam ।।65।।
anantadakṣiṇādānaistṛptāste brāhmadevatāḥ ।
athā'nādibālakṛṣṇapūjanaṃ kartumudyatāḥ ।।66।।
avatārāstathā muktā brahmarṣayo maharṣayaḥ ।
tattallokanivāsāśca sopadāḥ sampratasthire ।।67।।
vāditrāṇi ca tūryāṇi tārapāvanakāni ca ।
mṛdaṃgapaṭahādyāścā'vādyanta jalayantrikāḥ ।।68।।
sutantryo murajāḥ śaṃkhā ghaṇṭā jhallarikāstathā ।
vīṇā bheryaśca śṛṃgāṇi tvavādyanta ca tumbirāḥ ।।69।।
gālavādyāḥ svaravādyāḥ phudvādyāḥ sparśavādanāḥ ।
avādyanta tadā miṣṭānyaśrutāni purā yathā ।।2.20.70।।
svarā vaidikamantrāṇāṃ pravartante dvijaistadā ।
āśiṣāṃ ca pravāhāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe'vahan ।।71 ।।
abhyukṣito hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāmudratīrthavāribhiḥ ।
brahmahradajalairgaṃgāvirajāyamunājalaiḥ ।।72।।
sarasvatīsvarṇarekhāgaṇḍakīsalilaistathā ।
kiśoro rājate kṛṣṇastadā tejobhirudyataḥ ।।।73 ।।
mastake rājate yasya mukuṭaḥ koṭisūryavat ।
koṭicandraiḥ praṇaddhaśca kalgidharmavirājitaḥ ।।74।।
divyamāyūrapicchānāṃ pāridheyapramaṇḍitaḥ ।
kuṇḍale śravaṇākāre sauvarṇe naddharatnake ।।75।।
virājete karṇayośca bālakṛṣṇasya śobhane ।
tailena sādhitakeśajaṭāgranthiyutaṃ śiraḥ ।।76 ।।
lalāṭaṃ cordhvapuṇḍreṇa kaisareṇa virājitam ।
candanena tathā candraḥ kuṃkumena śubhāvahaḥ ।।77।।
virājate tathā bhāsvatkajjalaṃ netragolayoḥ ।
candanenā'kṣatenā'pi carcanaṃ lambadaṇḍitam ।।78।।
surekhaṃ madhyabindvībhiḥ śobhate'sya lalāṭake ।
dakṣagaṇḍe sūkṣmabinduḥ pāṇḍuro'tidhruvāyate ।।79।।
cibuke tilabinduśca kaṇṭhe'pi tilabindukaḥ ।
rājate tejasā yuktaḥ kapolau vartulau śubhau ।।2.20.80।।
rājīvabhāvamāpanne premapūritanetrake ।
raktapravālarekhābhiḥ śobhete sumanohare ।।8 1 ।।
ākarṇāntāyatakoṇe, karṇau dūraśravau samau ।
kambukaṇṭhakṛkāṭaśca raktāvoṣṭhau pramohakau ।।82।।
dhanuḥkammānikākārāvanudbhūtaruhānvitau ।
rājete ratibījau tau hṛdākarṣaṇakau hareḥ ।।83।।
puṣṭaskandhau pūrabāhū baliprakoṣṭharājitau ।
viśālatalasampannau trisandhiśākhaśobhitau ।।84।।
akṛtālaktakaraktau sūkṣmacandrāgrarājito ।
cakramīnadhanuḥśūlaiḥ svastikavajrarājitau ।।85।।
anāmikā''rūḍhadhārā''yuṣyarekhāmanoharau ।
ādarśavat sadā svacchau pratibimbā'bhidhāyakau ।।86।।
uparyupari romṇāṃ vai sūkṣmagrāmāṃgulipriyau ।
bhujau pārśvābhimukhataḥ pāṇḍurau śāradopamau ।।87।।
pārśvau kāmanivāsau ca vakṣaḥ śrīvāsi śobhanam ।
madhye romṇāṃ dakṣiṇāvartena kāntena rājitam ।।88।।
svarṇarekhāparicañcanmaṇiśreṣṭhavirājitam ।
asūtrahāratatibhyāṃ kāmalībhyāṃ prakāśate ।।89।।
nīladvitārakaśobhaṃ rājate hi stanadvayam ।
suvarṇatanturomālistabakena yutaṃ tathā ।।2.20.90।।
akāpaṭyaguṇā''vedi romodyānaṃ virājate ।
ubhayornalayormadhye sandhau dīrghā ca kānakī ।।9 1 ।।
romāvalī jaghanagā lakṣmīcitrapraveśitā ।
rājate yasya nābhestu nimrageya kamaṇḍaloḥ ।।92।।
liṅgaṃ sūjjvalaṃ vāme tilaśobhāvirājitam ।
sakthinī candrakadalīgarbhaśobhau ca romabhiḥ ।।93।।
prāntasvarṇasvarūpaiśca rājete'kṣarayāyinau ।
cārucampakavarṇābhau puṣṭau vīryabharau śubhau ।।94।।
pārṣṇito piṇḍikāṃ vyāpya sakthnoḥ pṛṣṭhe tathordhvage ।
vilakṣaṇe romarekhe jaghanaśrāntimāgate ।। 99।।
vartete golokavaikuṇṭhayoḥ sṛtī manohare ।
vāmasakthno mūlabhāgādaṃguladvayanimnagam ।।96।।
kīlakakṣatacihnaṃ ca vartate'ṅgulato'dhikam ।
vāmajānūparibhāge sakthni pāṇḍuravarṇakam ।। 97।।
cihnaṃ śrīkamalāvāsaṃ kamalaṃ cāṣṭapatrakam ।
vartate bahuśobhāḍhyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kamalāśrayam ।।98।।
akṣayavīryakośau dvau maṇī bāhyau vṛṣāśrayau ।
anyau cāntarnigūḍhau dvau liṅgapārśvasthitāvapi ।। 99।।
triguṇāvalisaṃrājannābhikūpaḥ praśobhate ।
nitambau candradhavalau komalau navanītavat ।। 2.20.1 00।।
kariḥ sauvarṇaraśanānibhacarmavirājitā ।
pṛṣṭhaṃ devālayaṃ cāgraṃ kāmālayaṃ prakāśate ।। 101 ।।
jaṃghe vartulagole ca kānakī romaśobhite ।
dakṣāyāṃ nalikāpārśve jaṃghāyāṃ kṛṣṇabindukaḥ ।। 1 02।।
dakṣabhuje tathā binduḥ rājate ghūṭikātrayam ।
kammānikākṛtitale pādayoḥ kamalaspṛśe ।। 1 03।।
ūrdhvarekhānvite saudhaśikharādripracihnite ।
padmakalaśavajrādiyavādibhiralaṃkṛte ।। 1 04।।
ṣoḍaśadvātriṃśadaṣṭacihnarekhā'bhirājite ।
nakhacandrāśritamṛdvaṃgulikāśobhite śubhe ।। 1 05।।
puṇḍarīkanibhe saumye koṭidevaprapūjite ।

madhyāṃgulimūlataścā''prakoṣṭhaṃ lambate tu sā ।

sauvarṇamaṇiratnādimauktikamālikādibhiḥ ।
tathā śṛṃgārabhūṣābhirvirājate'tisundaraḥ ।। 11 1।।

cakṣuṣāṃ viṣayaścāsīnmanasāṃ ca hṛdāmapi ।
antarbahiḥ sa evā''sīd yathā brahmapade'tige ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāmaṇḍapasya śobhāvarṇanaṃ samājāsanāni śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhormūrtiśṛṃgārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā
viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 20 ।।
