śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike dhāmni pare yathā virājate ।
paramātmā'vatārī sa tathārūpo'bhavaddhariḥ ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇā'rbudā'dhikaḥ ।
rūpānurūparūpāḍhyaḥ sarvoparisvarūpavān ।। 2 ।।
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ cakṣurviṣayaścaika eva saḥ ।
mano'haṃbuddhiviṣayaścātmaviṣaya ekalaḥ ।। 3 ।।
divyarūpadharo nyūnaṣoḍaśābdo yuvā yathā ।
bhrājamāno'titejasvī bhrājadvahnisamāmbaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
kacchanī svarṇavarṇā'sya mañjulaṃ kaṭikañcukam ।
svarṇabuṭṭābharatāḍhyaṃ tathā dhautraṃ ca kaisaram ।। 5 ।।
svarṇatārāvalivyāptaṃ kāṭeyaṃ paṭamuttamam ।
sthitaṃ kaṭyāṃ tathā skandhe cottarīyaṃ sutaijasam ।। 6 ।।
mukuṭo mastake tvasya sthitaḥ śrīparamātmanaḥ ।
sarvasaugandhyasaṃvyāpto divyāmodasamanvitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
maṇḍape nijayogye sa niṣasādocchraye śubhe ।
mahāvedīsthitāstatra candanānāṃ supaṭṭikāḥ ।। 8 ।।
catasro dṛḍhapādāḍhyāḥ svarṇakuṃbhīpadāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sahasramallasantolyā hyekaikā paṭṭikā hi sā ।। 9 ।।
gāruḍī nārasiṃhī ca śārabhī kācchapī tathā ।
pādeṣu śaktayastāsāṃ rājante balamaṇḍitāḥ ।। 2.21.1 0।।
catuṣpaṭṭyaścaturhastyadhiṣṭhitāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ ।
kariṇastatra śobhante cotthitāścāmbaraspṛśaḥ ।। 11 ।।
sarvabhūṣāmbaradharā dyotante svarṇavarṇijaḥ ।
śvetodarāḥ śvetaśuṇḍhāḥ śvetadantāḥ payonibhāḥ ।। 1 2।।
hastipṛṣṭhe sthitāḥ siṃhāḥ kānakā bhūṣitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
catvāraḥ kesariṇaste saśuṇḍhā gaganaspṛśaḥ ।। 13 ।।
catuḥkesariṇāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśeṣu kacchapo mahān ।
rājate ca haridvarṇāṃ lambavartulamaṇḍalaḥ ।। 14।।
tatpṛṣṭhe māṇikī śaktiraśvinī divyavigrahā ।
sarvopaskaraśobhāḍhyā niṣaṇṇā samapṛṣṭhikā ।। 15।।
tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhe svarṇavarṇaṃ mṛdu cāstaraṇaṃ śubham ।
tulikā rājata tatra kauśeyī citravarṇinī ।। 16 ।।
pārśvapṛṣṭhasthitadivyakaśipūttamasundarī ।
makhamallāstaraṇaiḥ śobhitā sāptapadī śubhā ।। 17।।
upari vartate chatraṃ śeṣabhogiphaṇātmakam ।
ṭivyahīrakacakṣurbhirdivyatejaḥpradaṃ śubham ।। 18।।
tulikāyāṃ haristatra pādau pīṭhe nidhāya ca ।
niṣasāda mahārājo rājarājādhirājakaḥ ।। 1 9।।
śrīkṛṣṇo'haṃ tathā nārāyaṇaḥ pārśve sthitāvubhau ।
cāmarābhyāṃ ca sahitau pādāgre cākṣaraḥ sthitaḥ ।। 2.21.20 ।।
lomaśaḥ pādapārśve ca pūjāsthālīkaraḥ sthitaḥ ।
mātā pitā niṣaṇṇau ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam ।। 21 ।।
evaṃ sthite tadā vyomni vimānānāṃ tu koṭayaḥ ।
draṣṭuṃ devabhṛtā divyā vartante yugalāśritāḥ ।। 22।।
pūjārthaṃ bhūmitalataścāroḍhuṃ śobhanocchritā ।
niḥśreṇikā kṛtā sopānānāṃ paramparāyutā ।।।23 ।।
bhūmibhāge tu paṭṭīnāṃ kṛtaṃ sopānasaptakam ।
tato hastilambaśuṇḍhādvayaṃ paṭṭīspṛśaṃ ca yat ।। 24।।
sopānādhāratāprāptaṃ niḥśreṇīdaṇḍavat sthitam ।
śuṇḍhayoḥ kuṃbhaparyantaṃ klṛptānyāruṇakāni ca ।।।25।।।
sopānāni śṛṃkhalābhirbaddhāni sudṛḍhāni ca ।
kuṃbhasthalayostatraiva klṛptā viśrāmaśālikā ।।26 ।।
tata ūrdhvaṃ kesariṇoḥ śuṇḍhayordaṇḍabhāntayoḥ ।
sopānāni suramyāṇi klṛptāni cāparāṇyapi ।।27।।
kesarimastakaṃ yāvat sā niḥśreṇī kṛtā tataḥ ।
catuṣkī siṃhaśirasordhṛtā kacchapalagnikā ।।28।।
kacchapasya galapārśve sthitaṃ haṃsadvayaṃ śubham ।
tayorantarbhujayośca klṛptā niḥśreṇikā parā ।।29।।
māṇikīmukhasaṃsparśā pārśvayorgaruḍadvayam ।
pakṣābhyāṃ vivṛtābhyāṃ ca haṃsapṛṣṭhe tu picchikāḥ ।।2.21.3 0।।
spṛṣṭāḥ kramād yathā sopānāni pakṣātmakāni vai ।
māṇikīpārśvayorlagnānyeva copari picchake ।।3 1 ।।
sthitvā pūjā hareryatra nirvartyate surādibhiḥ ।
evaṃ divye cāyate cocchrite ramyāsane prabhuḥ ।।32।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ sarvaiḥ prapūjyate ।
na śrutaṃ nāpi sandṛṣṭaṃ cāsanaṃ śrīprabhoḥ purā ।।।33।।
tatra taṃ rājamānaṃ śrīrājādhirājaśobhayā ।
pūjayituṃ kambharāśrīḥ prathamaṃ samupasthitā ।।34।।
dhṛtvā haste svarṇapātraṃ kuṃkumā'kṣatacandanaiḥ ।
kastūrikā'biradravyaistulasīmañjarīyutaiḥ ।। 35।।
gulālāṃ'kuralājābhiḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
phalairjalaiḥ śarkarādyairgandhasāraiḥ prapūritam ।। 36।।
lomaśaḥ prāha vai cāśīrvacanāni tadā kṣaṇe ।
oṃ svasti bālakṛṣṇasya muktāḥ svasti carantu ca ।।37।।
karotu cākṣaraṃ brahma svasti dīrghāyureva ca ।
oṃ svasti taṃ vitanvantu śrīśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ ।।38।।
vāsudevādayaḥ svasti svasti kurvantu ceśvarā ।
svasti kurvantvavatārā deveśāḥ śaṃkarādayaḥ ।।39।।.
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhāḥ sādhavaḥ sāṃkhyayogikāḥ ।
svasti kurvantu bālasya harerdevāśca mānavāḥ ।।2.21.40।।
sarvatīrthāni cādityā rudrāḥ svasti bhavantu ca ।
vasavo nidhayo vaidyo svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।।41 ।।
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ kumāryaśca pativratāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
devatā vanavāsinyaḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।। 42
vṛkṣā vallyaścāraṇāśca kinnarādyāśca sūtakāḥ ।
bhṛtyā dāsā nadā nadyaḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।।43।।
yakṣāḥ ṛkṣāśca gandharvā māgadhāḥ kimpumaṃśakāḥ ।
vidyādharāstathā sādhyāḥ svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।।44।।
parvatāḥ khanayo yūpāḥ khātā raṇā vanāni ca ।
pātālāḥ sarpadaityāśca dānavā āsurāstathā ।।45।।
rākṣasā bhūtakūṣmāṇḍāḥ pretāḥ piśācakāstathā ।
mātaraḥ kṛtyakāścāpi jaleśayāḥ sthaleśayāḥ ।।46 ।।
vaneśayā viśayāśca svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।
caityā mantrā divyadehāḥ śastrā'strādyā vibhūtayaḥ ।।47।।
bālāśca bālikāvargā vṛddhā viprā jarāyujāḥ ।
aṇḍajāḥ svedajāścāṃkurajāḥ svastidharāśca ye ।।48।।
vināyakā gaṇeśādyā hanumān garuḍastathā ।
pārṣadā nandamukhyāśca svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ ।।49।।
rādhā ramā ca lalitā padmā jayā sarasvatī ।
māṇikī śrīḥ kamalā ca pārvatī ca prabhā ratiḥ ।। 2.21.50 ।।
śāradā virajā gaṃgā lakṣmīḥ satī ca narmadā ।
sāvitrī maṃjulā haṃsā'mṛtā durgā ca maṃgalā ।।51 ।।
saguṇā dvādaśa svasti śataṃ kurvantu supriyāḥ ।
anyāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrāḥ koṭyarbudābjaśaktayaḥ ।।52।।
sūryacandragrahādyāśca svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ ।
tattvāni bhūtajā bhāvā māyā māyāpare sthitāḥ ।।53।।
yogino brahmacaryasthā vairājā guṇamūrtayaḥ ।
ābhūṣaṇāni divyāni svasti bhavantu vai hareḥ ।।54।।
śṛṃgārā vividhākārāḥ svarāśca gītayastathā ।
divyavādyāni vai svasti kurvantu śrīhareḥ sadā ।।55।।
saṃkarṣaṇo'niruddhaśca pradyumno dharmarājakaḥ ।
dharmadevo bhaktiyuktaḥ svasti kurvantu te hareḥ ।।56।।
janakaḥ kambharāsvāmī svasti karotu vai hareḥ ।
antarātmā paramātmā svasti svasya karotu saḥ ।।57।।
muktā campā jayā haimī ramā śāntā vrajā dayā ।
bhānurdīpāvalī corjā svasti kurvantu vai hareḥ ।।58।।
oṃ suśāntiḥ sadā cāstu dīrghāyuścāntavarjitam ।
ārogyaṃ nityasaukhyaṃ ca śāśvataṃ cāstu vai hareḥ ।।59।।
ityevaṃ lomaśaḥ svastivāgbhiḥ prokṣya jalādinā ।
yavāṃkuraiśca kusumaistilakaṃ candrakaṃ śubham ।।2.21.60।।
mātrā saṃkārayāmāsa pūjana sāṃgakarmabhiḥ ।
miṣṭaṃ mukhe dadau mātā duḥkhahā cāṃjaliṃ muhuḥ ।
śirasyāvātārayaccāśīrvaco jananī dadau ।।6 1 ।।
śāśvatāyuryutastvaṃ vai bhava sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
ityuktvā divyapuṣpāṇāṃ kalpamālāṃ gale dadau ।।62।।
vikīrya mastake tasyā'kṣatān nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau mātā natvā svāsanamāgatā ।।63 ।।
pitā pūjāṃ cakāraivaṃ svastimān bhava putraka ।
santānatantusandhātā śāśvatāyuryuto bhava ।।64।।
atha śrīlomaśo deveśvaraṃ samarcayanmudā ।
sarvopacārakairmantrairāśīrvādṃ dadau śubham ।।65।।
buddhyā guṇairvicāraiścātmanā bhaktyā ca vidyayā ।
dharmairyogaiśvaryavaryaiḥ śāśvatā'bhyudayo bhava ।।66।।
āyuṣā'caraṇairdivyaistejasā ca balena ca ।
kāruṇyena virāgeṇa śāśvatā'bhyudayo bhava ।।67।।
mātāpitroḥ sevayā śrīguroḥ śuśrūṣayā tathā ।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ।।68।।
brahmamārgaparo nityaṃ mānaseṣṭaprapūrakaḥ ।
samadṛṣṭirmahāśreṣṭhī dānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
sarvasantoṣadātā ca śāśvatābhyudayo bhava ।।6 9।।
ityāśīrbhirlomaśena vardhito bālanandanaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lājāvikīritaḥ ।।2.21.70।।
athā'nyebhyastataḥ pūjā'vasaraḥ sampradāpitaḥ ।
paradhāmagatāḥ patnyaḥ pūjārthaṃ śrīharipriyāḥ ।।71 ।।
divyasādhanasampadbhirgandhacandanavāribhiḥ ।
ratnahārasumālābhiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃhṛdayaistathā ।।72।।
pūjāṃ cakrustata ārārtrikaṃ cakruśca duḥkhahām ।
añjaliṃ śiraso nītvā caraṇodakamityapi ।।73 ।।
pītvopadāḥ samarpyaiva dhṛtvā prasādakuṃkumam ।
gāle spṛṣṭvā muhuḥ premṇā nirīkṣya prāṇavallabham ।।74।।
yayurnaijavimānāni tatastatrā'kṣarādayaḥ ।
akṣarasthāstathā muktā muktānyo'pyarcayan patim ।।75।।
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyuktaḥ śrīyuktaśca narāyaṇaḥ ।
golokavāsinaḥ sarve tathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।76।।
caturvaikuṇṭhavāsāścā'mṛtā'vyākṛtavāsinaḥ ।
anyadhāmanivāsāśca muktā vyūhāstathā pare ।।77।।
avatārā īśvarāśca sadāśivaprabhūttamāḥ ।
mahāviṣṇusamakakṣā māyāpradhānapūruṣāḥ ।।78।।
vairājā brahmadeveśā munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā ।
pitaraḥ surakoṭyaśca bhuvarlokanivāsinaḥ ।।79।।
bṛhaspatipurogāśca śukrācāryapurogamāḥ ।
nadā nadyo mānavāśca parvatā drulatādayaḥ ।।2.21.80।।
stambāstīrthāni caityāśca mānavāḥ sūtabandinaḥ ।
tṛṇāni raṇavāsāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ।।8 1 ।।
nāgā gandharvavaryāśca saurāṣṭrā bhūnivāsinaḥ ।
sāmudrā vyomayānāśca koṭyarbudāśca kanyakāḥ ।।82।।
lokapālāstathā sarve diśāmagresareśvarāḥ ।
rājāno divyarājāśca brahmakṣatrā divaukasām ।।।83 ।।
sarve pupūjuratyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam ।
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ cakrurdaduścopāyanāni ca ।।84।।
bhava śāśvatajīvaścetyāśīrvādān dadurmuhuḥ ।
sarvabrahmāṇḍadevyaśca militvā koṭivartikam ।।85।।
ārārtrikaṃ hareścakruḥ śataikavārabhrāmitam ।
puṣpāñjaliṃ daduścātha pādavāri papustataḥ ।।86।।
duḥkhahāṃ cā'ñjaliṃ prāpya yayurnaijavimānakam ।
evaṃ vai pūjane cāśīrvacane vinivartite ।।87।।
lomaśaḥ sarvasatkāraṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ vidadhe tataḥ ।
svāgataṃ śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ karoti vaḥ śubham ।।88।।
bhavatāṃ śrīmatāṃ sarvapūjyānāṃ cāśiṣā'pyaham ।
śāśvatā'bhyudayaścāsmīpyevaṃ cārthayate hariḥ ।।89।।
kṛtakṛtyo'smi sañjāto bālakṛṣṇo bhavatsutaḥ ।
punaścāpi nibhālyo'haṃ pratyabdaṃ ca prativratam ।।2.21.90।।
pratyutsavaṃ prakarṣeṇa yojanīyaḥ śubhāśiṣā ।
eṣo'haṃ vālaputro vai namaskaromi sādaram ।। 9 1।।
kṣatiḥ tvāgatakarmādau kṣantavyā mama vai pituḥ ।
lomaśasya maharṣeśca māturme'pi tatheśvarāḥ ।। 92।।
ityuktvā lomaśaḥ prāha bhojanasya kṣaṇaḥ śubhaḥ ।
vartate bhojanaṃ yuṣmannivāseṣvāgamiṣyati ।। 93।।
sadasaḥ parihāraśca jāyate vijayo'stu vaḥ ।
ityukte protthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samājo'pi tadotthitaḥ ।। 94।।
yayurnaijānnivāsāँste bhojanaṃ tattadarhakam ।
naikarūpaṃ tathā pānaṃ kanyāḥ parārdhasaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 95।।
naikarūpadharā dāsyo bhūtvā ninyustadālayān ।
tarpayitvā samājāँśca viśrāntiśayanāni ca ।।96।।
daduḥ sevāṃ tathā cakrurmadhyāhnottaramuttamām ।
vidāyaṃ prāpya ca yayurnaijadhāmāni sotsukāḥ ।। 97।।
pitā dadau tadā viśvakarmaṇe pāritoṣikam ।
kalpahāraṃ kalpasūtraṃ kalpavallīṃ trayaṃ tvidam ।। 98।।
anyebhyaḥ karmacārebhyo dadāvupāyanāni ca ।
lomaśāya dadau kalpakanyāṃ śāśvatasūtrajām ।। 99।।
hareḥ prasādaṃ sarvebhyo dadau yāsyadbhya uttamam ।
maṇḍapasyopasaṃhāraṃ kārayāmāsa vai tataḥ ।। 2.21.100 ।।
vastūni yāni sarvāṇi tvavaśiṣṭāni tatra tu ।
tāni dattānyanāthebhyo bhikṣukebhyaḥ samantataḥ ।। 101 ।।
nṛtyantībhyaścāpsarobhyo dadau śṛṃgārakottamam ।
hārān bhūṣāḥ kalpavṛkṣādīnyamūlyāni yāni ca ।। 1 02।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca saṃhṛtya sāyamutsavam ।
rātrau śāntiṃ parāṃ lebhe bhagavān bālarūpadhṛk ।।1 03।।
āste dolāsamārūḍho lokarītyanusārataḥ ।
lomaśaḥ kanyakāścāpi lomaśasyā''śramaṃ yayuḥ ।। 1 04।।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
kṛto mahotsavo divyo dvitīyavatsarādyake ।। 1 05।।
divase sarvasaubhāgyavardhano mokṣadastathā ।
smartṝṇāṃ pāṭhakānāṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ cāsya bhāvataḥ ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣārambhe mahotsave maṇḍape mahadāsanavarṇanaṃ sarvakṛtapūjāśīrvādāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 21 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 021 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 22
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 023 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike tvekadā pūrve mahān vai tapasāṃ nidhiḥ ।
ṛṣivaryaścyavanākhyo bhārgavendro mahātapāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kurvan tīrthāni pātālaṃ yayau yadṛcchayā svayam ।
tato rasātalaṃ prāpa tatra dadarśa śobhanam ।। 2 ।।
mahat puraṃ dānavānāṃ praviveśa sa tatpuram ।
cacāra nāgakanyābhiḥ pūjyamānaḥ samantataḥ ।। 3 ।।
tamenaṃ cyavanaṃ vīkṣya prahlādākhyo rasādhipaḥ ।
bhṛguputrasya sampūjāṃ cakre tvagryāṃ yathārhataḥ ।। 4 ।।
parasparaṃ sukuśalaṃ papracchaturnirāmayam ।
upaviṣṭaṃ muniṃ natvā prahlādaḥ prāha bhārgavam ।। 5 ।।
adya te darśanādasmi samprāptaḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ।
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyapradaṃ śubham ।। 6 ।।
sādhavastvādṛśā lokāँstārayanti ca mādṛśān ।
kṛpālavaḥ paryaṭanti pāpināṃ tāraṇāya te ।। 7 ।।
maduddhāraparaḥ sādho tvamatra yadupāgataḥ ।
pāvito'smi ṛṣe cā'haṃ daityadānavamadhyagaḥ ।। 8 ।।
vasā'tra cara dharmaṃ ca kratuṃ cāpi japādikam ।
tavaivedaṃ mama rājyaṃ sevayiṣyāmi dāsavat ।। 9 ।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tava bhakta śobhate vaiṣṇavo yataḥ ।
tvayi śāsati bhaktendre devabrāhmaṇapūjake ।। 2.22.10 ।।
makhān bhūmau nṛpatayo yajante vidhivat sadā ।
brāhmaṇādyāstapo dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ yātrāṃ ca kurvate ।। 11 ।।
devāḥ santi ca niścintāḥ santi dharmāḥ prajāsu ca ।
tvayi rājye sthite daitya dharmasthe tiṣṭhate vṛṣaḥ ।।12।।
rasātale'thavā bhūmau svarge vā samatā mama ।
yatra bhaktastatra sarvaṃ svargaṃ me sammataṃ nṛpa ।। 13 ।।
tavecchāpūraṇārthaṃ vai sthāsyāmyatrottarāyaṇam ।
tato yāsyāmi vai darśanārthaṃ bālaprabhordhruvam ।।14।।
prahrādastu tadā prāha yadyapyetanmayā śrutam ।
daityamukhāddharistatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 15।।
pṛthvyāṃ saṃrājate bālastathāpi vada me'dhikam ।
kaḥ kathaṃ kīdṛśaścā''ste pāvanaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 16।।
draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ tvenamanādipuruṣottamam ।
camatkārān vada tasya tīrthānyanyāni me vada ।।17।।
śreṣṭhāni kāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ kāni cāmbare ।
rasātale ca kāni syuretad vada tato'pyaham ।। 18।।
tīrthayātrāṃ gamiṣyāmi kartuṃ kartuṃ ca darśanam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।।19।।
cyavano hi tadā prāha prahlādaṃ bhaktapuṃgavam ।
saurāṣṭre paramaṃ tīrthaṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।2.22.20 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ cāntarīkṣe tu puṣkaram ।
rasātale cakratīrthaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ।।।21 ।।
parvate badarītīrthaṃ cāraṇye nārasiṃhakam ।
jale kṣīrodaśāyi svarge ca merau harergṛham ।।22।।
ityevaṃ santi tīrthāni pāvanāni tu pāpinām ।
śratvaivaṃ bhārgavavākyaṃ daityarājastu rādhike ।।23।।
tīrthāni gantukāmo'bhūd dānavānidamabravīt ।
uttiṣṭhadhvaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ snātuṃ tīrthāni vai bhuvi ।।।2।।।
drakṣyāmaḥ paramātmānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
ityuktā dānavā daityā āsurā rākṣasāstathā ।।25।।
cakrurudyogamatulaṃ nirjagmuśca rasātalāt ।
sahitāste cyavanena yayuḥ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ।।26।।
vidhinā snānapūjādi kṛtvā śrīhāṭakeśituḥ ।
pātālādūrdhvamāyātāḥ saurāṣṭre vivarairbhuvam ।।27।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cā'śvapaṭṭasarovare ।
lomaśasyā''śramapūrve snānaṃ cakrurmudānvitāḥ ।।28।।
sa cyavanaḥ sa prahrādaḥ sarvadaityasamanvitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ।।29।।
sarvāvatārasaṃjuṣṭaṃ muktakanyādisevitam ।
dadarśa pūjayāmāsa dadhyau sarvamanoharam ।।2.22.30।।
tataḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ natvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
lomaśaṃ pūjayitvā ca saro vai puṣkaraṃ yayau ।।3 1।।
sarasvatīṃ cāvagāhya dharmāraṇyaṃ gato'bhavat ।
meroḥ kṛtvā sutīrthāni tataḥ śrībadarīṃ yayau ।।।32।।
naranārāyaṇau yatra tepāte tapa uttamam ।
samunnatajaṭābhārau tapasyāsaktamānasau ।।33।।
atisaumyastharūpau ca kṛṣṇājinadharau munī ।
dadarśa vimalau devau pupūjā'tīva bhāvataḥ ।।34।।
snātvā gaṃgāṃ śālavṛkṣaṃ naimiṣāraṇyasannidhau ।
yayau daityendra evāsau dadarśa tatra tau punaḥ ।।35।।
śāladrumakṛtāvāsau tāpasā tau narottamau ।
tayośca pārśvayordivye dhanuṣī lakṣaṇānvite ।।36।।
śārṅgamājagavaṃ cāpyakṣayyāvapi maheṣudhī ।
śālavṛkṣaṃ mahāśākhaṃ śaraiścitaṃ ca hetibhiḥ ।।37।।
dadarśa bāṇānaparān mukhe lagnān parasparam ।
tatastānadbhutākārān bāṇānnāgopavītakān ।।38।।
dṛṣṭvā'tulaṃ ruṣaṃ cakre daityo dvirūpadarśanāt ।
tāpasau tau saśastrau ca dṛṣṭvā'manyata dāmbhikau ।।39।।
balagarveṇa ca vyāptaḥ provāca puruṣottamau ।
kiṃ bhavadbhyāṃ samārabdho dambho dharmavināśanaḥ ।।2.22.40।।
kva tapaḥ kva jaṭābhāraḥ kva cemau pravarāyudhau ।
athovāca naro daityaṃ kā te cintā parakṛte ।।41।।
sāmarthye sati yat kuryād ghaṭate tasya tattathā ।
āvāṃ vai tāpasau rakṣākarau daityaniṣūdanau ।।42।।
ubhayaṃ kurvo daityendra yāhi mā vaha garvakam ।
athovāca ditīśastau kā śaktiryuvayoriha ।।43।।
daityanāśakarī dharmarakṣake mayi tiṣṭhati ।
naraḥ prāha ca daityendra āvābhyāṃ śaktirarjitā ।।44।।
na kaścicchaknuyājjetuṃ naranārāyaṇau yudhi ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmānau pareśvarau ।।45।।
prahlādastu tato garvāt pratijñāmakarot puraḥ ।
yathākathañcid jeṣyāmi naranārāyaṇau raṇe ।।46।।
cyavanastaṃ tadā prāha mā vocaḥ śrīhariṃ prati ।
nā'yaṃ jayyo hi bhagavān kṣayyena tu tvayā kvacit ।।47।।
daityaḥ prāha pratijñā sā mayoktā nānyathā bhavet ।
kariṣye sarvathā yatnaṃ vijeṣyāmi dhruvaṃ hi tau ।।48।।
ityuktvā cyavanaṃ natvā sajyaṃ cāpaṃ vitatya ca ।
cakāra garjanaṃ jyāyāstaladhvaniṃ cakāra ca ।।49।।
saṃkṣiptaṃ svabalaṃ sthāpya vane yuddhārthamudyataḥ ।
tato narastvājagavaṃ cāpamānamya vai śarān ।।2.22.50।।
mumoca tān pṛṣatkaiśca ciccheda daityapuṃgavaḥ ।
chinnān samīkṣyā'tha naro bāṇān daityena tatkṣaṇam ।।51।।
mahābāṇān mumocāpi kramaśo daityanāśakān ।
naraścaikaṃ ditijo dvau narastrīn caturo'suraḥ ।।52।।
naraḥ pañca ditijaḥ ṣaḍ bāṇān mumoca nāśakān ।
naraḥ sapta ditijo'ṣṭau naro mumoca trīṇi ṣaṭ ।।53।।
daityo daśa naraścaikādaśa daityaśca ṣoḍaśa ।
naro dvātriṃśatpṛṣatkān daityaḥ ṣaṣṭiśarāँstadā ।।54।।
śataṃ naro mumocā'pi daityaḥ śatadvayaṃ punaḥ ।
naraḥ śatatrayaṃ daityaḥ ṣaṭaśatāni sasarja vi ।।55।।
naraḥ sahasraṃ daityaśca pāresahasramāhinot ।
evaṃ cā'saṃkhyabāṇāँstau mitho garvānmamocatuḥ ।।56।।
naroṃsakhyaśaravrātairavāstarat khadigbhuvaḥ ।
daityo'pyasaṃkhyabāṇaistān chiccheda bahuyatnataḥ ।।57।।
tadā varāstrairyudhyetāṃ samantrernaradānavau ।
vahniṃ naro jalaṃ daityo vāyvastraṃ parvatāstrakam ।।58।।
nāgāstraṃ gāruḍāstraṃ ca dhūmāstraṃ taijasāstrakam ।
nāryastraṃ ca narāstraṃ ca ṣaṇḍhāstraṃ yauvanāstrakam ।।59।।
evaṃ parasparaṃ tau ca cikṣipaturjighāṃsayā ।
brahmāstraṃ daityavaryaḥ sa mumocātibhayaṃkaram ।।2.22.60।।
nārāyaṇā'stramagraṃ ca naro mumoca tatkṣaṇam ।
saṃhṛte te hyubhe cātha pralhādaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ।।6 1।।
gadāṃ pragṛhya tarasā pracaskanda rathottamāt ।
nārāyaṇaśca taṃ vīkṣya samāyāntaṃ gadāyutam ।।62।।
naraṃ svapṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā yoddhumagragato'bhavat ।
daityo bhrāntvā gadāṃ vegānmūrdhni kṛṣṇamatāḍayat ।।63।।
tāḍitasya harernetradvayād vāryapatad bahu ।
gadāpi śatadhā bhinnā nyapatad bhuvi khaṇḍaśaḥ ।।64।।
daityastūrṇaṃ rathe sthitvā kārmukaṃ prasamādade ।
bāṇān śilīmukhān tīkṣṇān mumocārdhaśaśiprabhān ।।65।।
harivicched tān bāṇairnirbibheda ca dānavam ।
dānavo'pi hariṃ bāṇairvivyādha ca śilīmukhaiḥ ।।66।।
evaṃ parasparaṃ cāvidhyetāṃ marmasu roṣataḥ ।
tadā'mbare didṛkṣūṇā devānāṃ dehināṃ tathā ।।67।।
sannipāto'bhavad vyomni dundubhayo mahāsvanāḥ ।
avādyanta tathā puṣpavarṣaṃ cābhūt tayoḥ kayoḥ ।।68।।
athaivaṃ balamāpannau daityanārāyaṇāvubhau ।
babandhatustadā''kāśaṃ sutīkṣṇaśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।69।।
sarvadiśo'cchādayatāmayudhyetāmasuglaham ।
nārāyaṇastu daityaṃ taṃ śarairbibheda marmasu ।।2.22.70।।
daityo bibheda hṛdaye bāhvormukhe narāyaṇam ।
nārāyaṇo'rdhacandreṇa ciccheda daityakārmukam ।।71 ।।
dānavaścāparaṃ sajyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarairharim ।
vavarṣa tān hariśchitvā daityaṃ bāṇairavākirat ।।72।।
kārmukaṃ ca kṣurapreṇa ciccheda cāparaṃ tataḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca ciccheda pañcamaṃ dhanuḥ ।।73 ।।
atha daityo lohamayaṃ jagrāha parighaṃ dṛḍham ।
bhrāmayāmāsa yāvattaṃ ciccheda bhagavān śaraiḥ ।।74।।
prahlādo mudgaraṃ bhrāntvā cikṣepa ca narāyaṇe ।
harirdaśabhirnārācaiściccheda mudgaraṃ yadā ।।72।।
daityaḥ pāśayutastūrṇaṃ dudrāva śrīhariṃ prati ।
hariḥ pāśaṃ tu bāṇena ciccheda bahukhaṇḍaśaḥ ।।76।।
daityaḥ śaktiṃ saptatāladīrghāmādāya mādhavam ।
prati cikṣepa ca haristāṃ ciccheda kṣuraprakaiḥ ।।77।।
daityaśca parvataśṛṃgaṃ cikṣepa mādhavopari ।
hariḥ śaktyā vidāryaitad dānavasya tu vakṣasi ।।78।।
śūlaṃ śaktisamaṃ vegāt prāhiṇod dānavastadā ।
prabhinnahṛdayo rādhe papāta rathamadhyagaḥ ।।79।।
visaṃjñaṃ sārathirjñātvā tamapovāha vai raṇāt ।
nārāyaṇo viśaśrāma tāvat saṃjñānvito'suraḥ ।।2.22.80।।
sudṛḍhaṃ cāpamādāya bhūyo yoddhumupāgataḥ ।
tāvat sāyaṃ harirdṛṣṭvā pratyuvāca mahāsuram ।।8 1 ।।
gaccha daityendra yotsyāmaḥ prātastvāhnikamācara ।
evamukto yayau natvā naimiṣaṃ cāhnikaṃ vyadhāt ।।82।।
evaṃ nityaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ pravavṛte tayordine ।
rātrau viśrāntisamaye cintayatyapi dānavaḥ ।।83 ।।
kathaṃ jeṣyāmi taṃ vīraṃ dāmbhikaṃ sādhyamīśvaram ।
athaivaṃ dānavastenā'yudhyata bahuvatsarān ।।84।।
na cā'jayat tadā varṣasahasrānte'jitaṃ harim ।
nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyetya dānavo vākyamabravīt ।।85।।
kimarthaṃ devadeveśa tvāmahaṃ sādhyamīśvaram ।
vijetuṃ nātra śaknomi tasya me kāraṇaṃ vada ।।86 ।।
nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha durjayo'haṃ surā'suraiḥ ।
api koṭyastraśastrādyairbalaiḥ sarvavidhairapi ।।87।।
prahlādastu tadā prāha yadyasādhyaśca durjayaḥ ।
pratijñātaṃ mayā jetuṃ tadasatyaṃ bhavediha ।।88।।
khyāto hatapratijño'haṃ kathaṃ jīveyamīśvara ।
tasmātte sannidhau viṣṇo santyakṣye jīvanaṃ mama ।।89।।
ityuktvā niṣasādā'gre gṛṇan brahmasanātanam ।
hariḥ prāha kṛpāluḥ svaṃ bhaktaṃ śraddhānvitaṃ param ।।2.22.90 ।।
gaccha jeṣyasi bhaktyā māṃ na yuddhena kadācana ।
prahlādaśca tadā prāha trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ mayā ।।9 1 ।।
paraṃ na vijito'si tvaṃ lokarakṣākaro yataḥ ।
dharmapravartanārthāya tapaścaryāṃ samāsthitaḥ ।।92।।
tattvāṃ jetuṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣye jayadāṃ śubhām ।
śuśrūṣāṃ tava deveśā''rādhanāṃ sevanādikam ।।।93 ।।
kariṣye yena yuddhena tvaṃ parājayamāpnuyāḥ ।
tad yuddhaṃ vai pratijñātaṃ phaladaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।।94।।
śastraṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ kṛṣṇe yojayiṣye hyataḥ param ।
ityuktvā daityavaryaḥ sa hiraṇyākṣasutā'ndhakam ।।95।।।
samāhūyā'bravīt hṛṣṭaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayituṃ vratī ।
daityāśca dānavāścāpi paripālyāstvayā'ndhaka ।।96 ।।
mayotsṛṣṭamidaṃ rājyaṃ pratīccha paripālaya ।
ahaṃ yuddhena tapasā bhaktyā''rādhanayā tathā ।।97।।
vijeṣye śrīhariṃ deveśvaraṃ dāmbhikamīśvaram ।
ityukto'ndhakadaityaśca jagrāha rājyamuttamam ।।98।।
prahlādaḥ prayayau puṇyaṃ harerbadarikāśramam ।
yāvāstāṃ naimiṣe kṣetre śālagrāme ca yau prabhū ।।99।।
tāveva vīkṣya devau sa naranārāyaṇāvubhau ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭo -bhūtvā vavande caraṇau tayoḥ ।। 2.22.100 ।।
nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha māmajitvā mahāsura ।
kimarthaṃ praṇato'syatra vada yatte samīhitam । । 101 ।।
prahlādaḥ prāha bhagavan kastvāṃ jetuṃ prabhuḥ pumān ।
kastvatto'sti pumān śreṣṭhastvameva puruṣottamaḥ ।। 1 02।।
tvameva tapasā dyotajjaṭājūṭadhanurdharaḥ ।
tvāṃ yoginaścintayanti cārcayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 103 ।।
japanti snātakāstvāṃ ca yajante tvāṃ ca yājñikāḥ ।
rāmayanti ca rāmāstvāṃ pūjayanti pativratāḥ ।। 1 04।।
aindriyikastaparyanti tvāmeva parameśvaram ।
tvamamartyo hṛṣīkeśaścakrapāṇirdharādharaḥ ।। 1 05।।
mahāmīno hayaśirāstvameva kacchapākṛtiḥ ।
kroḍarūpaḥ kesarī tvaṃ brahmā śrīśaḥ satīpatiḥ ।। 1 06।।
kubero varuṇastvaṃ ca samīro bhāskaraḥ śaśī ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtastvaṃ kastvāṃ jeṣyati mādhava ।। 1 07।।
bhaktyā cet tvaṃ vaśaṃ yāhi bhaktiṃ kartuṃ samāgataḥ ।
ityuktvā ca punastasya pādayoḥ praṇanāma saḥ ।। 1 08।।
nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha ।
bhaktyā tvananyayā cāhaṃ tvayā cādya parājitaḥ ।। 1 09।।
parājitaśca puruṣo jetre daṇḍaṃ prayacchati ।
daṇḍārthaṃ te pradāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu yamicchasi ।। 2.22.110 ।।
prahlādaḥ prāha me pāpaṃ śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca vā ।
vāgbhavaṃ nāśamāyātu yanmayā yudhyatā kṛtam ।। 111 ।।
yā yā jāyeta me buddhiḥ sā sā viṣṇo tvadāśritā ।
devārcane'tiniratā tvaccittā tvatparāyaṇā ।। 11 2।।
tvatpādapadmayornityaṃ ratiścāstu parā mama ।
nārāyaṇaśca taṃ prāha tathaivā'stu sadā tava ।। 11 3।।
aparaṃ cāstu bhaktendro nityamevā'kṣayo'vyayaḥ ।
ajaraścāmaraścāpi matprasādādbhaviṣyasi ।। 1 14।।
ito gaccha paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre yatrā''ste puruṣottamaḥ ।। 1 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā nidhāya hṛdi taṃ prabhum ।। 116 ।।
lomaśācca mahāmantraṃ gṛhītvā pāvanastataḥ ।
gaccha tvaṃ bhaktaśārdūla svamāvāsaṃ kriyārataḥ ।। 1 17।।
praśāsayan sarvadaityān rājyaṃ pālaya śāśvatam ।
svajātisadṛśaṃ dambhaṃ kuru bhaktiṃ ca śāsanam ।। 1 18।।
na karmabandho bhavato maccittasya bhaviṣyati ।
hitopadeṣṭā daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ gururbhava ।। 11 9।।
evamukto hariṃ natvā kṣamāpya śrīhariṃ naram ।
yayau cyavanasaṃyuktaḥ saurāṣṭre lomaśāśramam ।। 2.22.120।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre dadarśa puruṣottamam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarovārisnānaṃ kṛtvā''rcya keśavam ।। 121 ।।
auṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
mantraṃ prāpya māsamātramuṣitvā prayayau gṛham ।। 122।।
aśmakaṃ nāma nagaraṃ śaśāsa ca rasātalam ।
dṛṣṭaḥ sabhājitaścāpi dānavairandhakādibhiḥ ।। 123 ।।
bhaktiṃ cakāra navadhā dhyānamārādhanādikam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ prapūjayan ।। 1 24।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe bhaktyā jayyo janārdanaḥ ।
daityenāpi parābhaktyā vijitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 25।।
dvitīye'bde harerdaityaścyavano mārgaśīrṣake ।
nyūṣatustanmahattīrthaṃ cyāvanaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe ।। 126।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraso vai prāhlādikaṃ tathocyate ।
prahlādo daityadanujān bodhayāmāsa tanmanum ।। 127।।
rasātalamatāste'pi bhaktā babhūvuraiśvarāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhejuraharniśam ।। 128।।
ityetat kathitaṃ rādhe sarvapātakanāśakam ।
paramaṃ sādhanaṃ daityoddhārakaṃ cākṣayaṃ dṛḍham । । 129 । ।
jayadaṃ śāntidaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ śāśvatamodadam ।
hareścaraṇadaṃ pāṭhaśrutibhyāṃ mokṣadaṃ param ।। 2.22.130 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cyavanayogena prahlādasya rasātalāttīrthārthaṃ bhūmāvāgamanaṃ naranārāyaṇena saha yuddhaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇaparājayaḥ, prahlādacyavanayorlomaśāśramāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 22 । ।

adhyāyaḥ 23
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 024 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha te dānavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭumicchanti satvaram ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālaṃ hi rādhike ।। 1 ।।
yatpratāpādayaṃ daityeśvaro jigye hariṃ prabhum ।
tāṃ bhaktiṃ kartumicchanti prahlādenopabodhitāḥ ।। 2 ।।
śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ tāṃ ca yathā te dānaveśvarāḥ ।
samāgatā harerbhaktā jātāścārādhanānvitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
andhakasya ca vaṃśīyāḥ prahlādasya ca vaṃśajāḥ ।
kujambhasya ca jambhasya śaṃkukarṇasya vaṃśajāḥ ।। 4 ।।
mayasya vaṃśajāścāpi dundubheḥ śambarasya ca ।
ayaḥśaṃkośca vṛtrasya vaṃśajā dānavādayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
sasmaruścyavanaṃ vipraṃ prahlādamārgadarśakam ।
cyavanaḥ śīghramevaiṣāṃ purataḥ samupasthitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
vanditaḥ pūjitaścāpi pṛṣṭaśca śreyasaṃ prati ।
vidyutkeśisuto jyeṣṭhaḥ sukeśiḥ samuvāca tam ।। 7 ।।
praṣṭumicchāmi bhavataḥ saṃśayo'yaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ ।
kiṃsvicchreyaḥ pare loke kimu ceha dvijottama ।। 8 ।।
kena pūjyo bhavet satsu kenā'sau sukhamedhate ।
iti pṛṣṭaścyavanastān daityasantānajāँstadā ।। 9 ।।
vimṛśyovāca śreyo'rthamiha loke paratra ca ।
śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ tathā dharmaḥ paratreha ca sarvathā ।। 2.23.10 ।।
dharme samāśrite satsu pūjyaḥ sukhī sadā bhavet ।
dharmaḥ svasya sadācāraḥ parātmaśāntidaḥ sukhaḥ ।। 11 ।।
svātmaśāntipradaścāpi puṇyaṃ tatsukhadaṃ sadā ।
mānavānāṃ paro dharmaḥ sadā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ ।। 1 2।।
svādhyāyastattvaveditvaṃ viṣṇupūjanamityapi ।
kenā'rjitena manujāḥ sukhino'mutra ceha ca ।। 13 ।।
devānāṃ bhaktarakṣā ca pūjāgrahaṇamityapi ।
prajāpālanamityādi tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 14।।
daityānāṃ bāhuśālitvaṃ yuddhaṃ vandanamityapi ।
nītirbhaktiḥ prapattiśca tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 15।।
siddhānāṃ yogasiddhiśca svādhyāyo brahmacintanam ।
bhaktiścopāsanā śāntistenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 16।।
gāndharvāṇāṃ gītanṛtye vādyaṃ vāṇī madhusravā ।
upāsanaṃ ca mahatāṃ tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 17।।
vidyādhrāṇāṃ śubhā vidyā vijñānaṃ pauruṣaṃ matiḥ ।
nārāyaṇyāṃ sadā bhaktistenārjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 18।।
kinnarāṇāṃ sūryabhaktīrgāndharvaṃ gāyanādikam ।
kauśalyaṃ hāsyabhāvādau tenārjitena te sukhāḥ ।। 19।।
śilpināṃ śilpakauśalyaṃ nārāyaṇā'bhicintanam ।
paropakāraśālitvaṃ tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।।2.23.20।।
pitṝṇāṃ cendriyavṛttinigraho mānahīnatā ।
parameśe sadā bhaktistenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।।2 1।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ śīlatā satyaṃ japyaṃ jñānaṃ kṣamā dayā ।
nirmalā'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ ca tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।।22।।
tyāgināṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ svāmisevanam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇamarāgitā ।।23।।
harerbhaktiḥ sadā kāryā tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।
dhanarakṣā bhogadānaṃ sevakatvaṃ parārthakam ।।24।।
harau bhaktirguhyakānāṃ tenā'rjitena tai sukhāḥ ।
parāvamarṣitā pārakyārthe laulyaṃ hi rakṣasām ।।25।।।
harau bhakte ca vā bhaktistenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।
avivekaḥ piśācānāṃ śaucahānirasatyatā ।।26।।
bhaktaprasādibhakṣyaṃ ca tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।
tiraścāṃ parasevitvaṃ tenā'rjitena te sukhāḥ ।।27।।
ityevaṃ kathitāḥ puṇyā dharmāḥ ṣoḍaśa mokṣadāḥ ।
svasvajātyanusāreṇa dharmasthāḥ sukhinaḥ sadā ।।28।।
sarvadharmeṣu cotkṛṣṭāḥ sarvasādhāraṇā vṛṣāḥ ।
tīrthayānaṃ prabhoḥ pūjā paropakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।29।।
ahiṃsanaṃ ca santoṣo nītilabhye japo hareḥ ।
etān dharmān samāśritya ye ke'pi syuśca dehinaḥ ।।2.23.3 0।।
avaśyaṃ brahmaśaraṇā muktimāyānti śāśvatīm ।
nyāyyacaraṇāḥ sukhino duḥkhinasvapanītayaḥ ।।3 1।।
śrutvaivaṃ cyavanasyā''rthī vācaṃ daityāḥ sukhārthinaḥ ।
prahlādapādasaraṇāstīrthaṃ śreyo hi menire ।।3 2।।
cyavanaṃ te papracchuśca sarvatīrthottamottamam ।
cyavanastāँstadā prāha tīrthaṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ।।33।।
tīrthottamaṃ ca badarīvanaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kṣetraṃ śrīgaṇḍakītīrthaṃ māthuraṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā ।।34।।
tīrthottamottamaṃ tvāste cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyā''śramastathā ।। 35।।
saurāṣṭraṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ parameśvaraśobhitam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālasvarūpavān ।।36।।
vartate bhagavān yatra parameśaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।
sarvadhāmā'dhipasvāmī sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।।37।।
sarvā'vatāranāthaśca sarvalakṣmyādisatpatiḥ ।
sarvamokṣarddhidātā ca sarvatulyadayālayaḥ ।।38।।
tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ tīrthāttamottamottamam ।
yatkṛtvā sveṣṭamāsādya modate sarvaśāntiṣu ।।39।।
etacchrutvā cyavanasya daityāstīrthecchavastadā ।
cyavanaṃ saha nītvaiva cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayuḥ ।।2.23.40।।
daityāśca dānavāścāpi teṣāṃ nāryaḥ sutādayaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tīrthārthaṃ prayayurmudā ।।41।।
cyavanasya prasaṃgena prahlādādyupadeśataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭumupāgatāḥ ।।42।।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ vyomnaścāvatīrya ca dānavāḥ ।
cyavanena samaṃ nemurlomaśaṃ te kuṭumbinaḥ ।।43।।
dānavānāṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ saṃvīkṣya lomaśo muniḥ ।
cyavanena saha teṣāṃ svāgataṃ kṛtavān param ।।44।।
madhuparkaṃ cāsanādi jalapānādikaṃ dadau ।
āvāsān pradadau ramyān kalpitān kalpavṛkṣajān ।।45।।
aśmakākhyanagaryāśca śatottarān suśobhanān ।
susmṛddhān sarvavastvāḍhyān prāsādān candramonibhān ।।46।।
snānabhojanaśayyāḍhyān sabhāśālāvirājitān ।
udyānakuṃjasaṃvyāptān śītaramyasukhānilān ।।47।।
candanāgurukastūrīgandhāmodapramoditān ।
sarvopakaraṇādyuktān sevābhaktān dadau muniḥ ।।48।।
cyavanaḥ suprasanno'bhūllomaśasyā'rtibhāvataḥ ।
daityāँśca dānavānāha ṛṣayastvaparigrahāḥ ।।49।।
pakṣapātādiśūnyāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ ।
sarvajīvahitāḥ śāntā mocayanti hyaghājjanān ।।2.23.50।।
yasya śatrau ca mitre ca samabhāvo vilokyate ।
sa eva mokṣado bodhyaḥ pāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।।51।।
lomaśasya prasādena vāriṇā pūrvajanmajāḥ ।
ghorapātakapuñjā vai layameṣyanti vo'khilāḥ ।।।52।।
tasmācchrīlomaśaṃ vipraṃ prasevadhvaṃ mudānvitāḥ ।
kaṃcitkālaṃ vasatā'tra samarjayata deśanām ।।53।।
sthāvarebhyastu tīrthebhyo jaṃgamaṃ drāg viśodhakam ।
sādhavaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaॆ sparśanāt pāpanāśakam ।।54।।
vandanāt sevanāt pādasaṃmmardanāt pratoṣaṇāt ।
yayeṣṭavastudānācca tārayantyapi pāpinaḥ ।।55।।
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ dāhakaṃ sādhusevanam ।
bhojanīyā vandanīyā darśanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ।।।56।।
sparśanīyā namanīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ ।
sarvārpaṇena ca paricaraṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ ।।57।।
saṃgatiḥ sulabhā sarvā durlabhā sādhusaṃgatiḥ ।
kāyena manasā vaicā toṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ ।।58।।
dhyānaniṣṭhāparāḥ puṇyaśevadhayastapaḥprabhāḥ ।
parabrahmaparāḥ śiṣyaśreyaḥparāyaṇāḥ priyāḥ ।।59।।
sarvakalyāṇadāḥ santaḥ sevanīyāḥ svamuktaye ।
dānavatvaṃ ca daityatvaṃ mānavatvaṃ sureśatā ।।2.23.60।।
na naityikī cātmanāṃ vai dehajanmādijaṃ hi tat ।
dehasya vigame sarvaṃ cāgantukaṃ vinaśyati ।।61।।
mamedaṃ ca kuṭumbādi rājyaṃ me mama bāndhavāḥ ।
sutāḥ patnī patiśceti cāhaṃkārakṛtaṃ mṛṣā ।।62।।
ahaṃkārātmake bīje yāte yāsyati vāsanā ।
karmāśayavināśe ca kva daityatvaṃ kva śiṣyatā ।।63।।
ātmā tu māyikavarṣmayogānnāmaniruktimān ।
diterjāto yato daityo danorjātastu dānavaḥ ।।64।।
ajāto yaścetanaḥ sa jātena jāta ucyate ।
jātaṃ dehaṃ na vai cātmā tataścātmā na nāmabhāka ।।65।।
yatra sthāne tu yo jātastatraivā'sya prajāyate ।
mūṣā tvabhiniveśo'tra māyāyāṃ mamatāvaśāt ।।6 6 ।।
tasmād yūyaṃ na pātālarasātalādivāsinaḥ ।
na ca daityā na vai śūrāstatsarvaṃ dehabhāg yataḥ ।।67।।
satāṃ yogena ca santo jātāścātra sarovare ।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ cātra lomaśasya rajodharāḥ ।।68।।
pūtāḥ stha tīrthayogena manuṃ gṛhṇata cottamam ।
pūjayata guruṃ cainaṃ paścāt kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।69।।
yāsyāmo darśanārthaṃ vai śreyaḥ prāpsyatha niścitam ।
ityuktā dānavā daityā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।2.23.70।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe snātvā prāhlādikaṃ sthalam ।
natvā ca lomaśaṃ vipraṃ pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।।7 1 ।।
pādapūjājalaṃ pītvā nemustaṃ lomaśaṃ munim ।
candanādyaiḥ puṣpahārairarcayāmāsurādarāt ।।72।।
jagṛhuśca mahāmantraṃ pāvanaṃ sarvasaukhyadam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।73 ।।
enaṃ gṛhītvā mantraṃ ca gṛṇanto vaiṣṇavāśca te ।
mālāṃ ca taulasīṃ bhāle sabinduṃ tilakaṃ tathā ।।74।।
gṛhītvā paṃktiśo bhūtvā lomaśā'rpitamuttamam ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca coṣyaṃ bhojanamuttamam ।।75 ।।
pānaṃ miṣṭaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jagṛhurlomaśāśrame ।
cyavano'pi kṛtasandhyāvandano bubhuje mudā ।।76 ।।
tataḥ sarve nijāvāsān yayurviśrāntilabdhaye ।
atha sāyaṃ tu te sarve gṛhītvopāyanāni vai ।।77।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।
yayuḥ śrīkambharālakṣmīprāsādaṃ saptabhūmikam ।।78।।
yatra śrībālakṛṣṇo'sau dolāyāṃ rājate prabhuḥ ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca pitā putraṃ kare svake ।।79।।
dhṛtvā siṃhāsane cāyāt niṣasāda tadocitaḥ ।
lomaśaścyavanaścobhau śiṣyadaityagaṇānvitau ।।2.23.80।।
āyayatuśca tābhyāṃ vai dattāsanaḥ pitā svayam ।
daityānāmapi satkāraṃ svāgataṃ kṛtavāँstadā ।।81 ।।
dattāsanāstu te daityāḥ prahvībhāvapariplutāḥ ।
ātmano menire dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyān prabhuṃ harim ।।82।।
kṣaṇaṃ sthairyaṃ prajagmuste sthiranetrāḥ sthavṛttayaḥ ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ te ca lokayāmāsuraiśvaram ।।83।।
kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tataḥ kiśorarūpiṇam ।
divyarūpānurūpābhirūpamujjvalamuttamam ।।84।।
tatra mūrtau ca prahlādaṃ śukrācāryaṃ tataḥ param ।
tataśca kaśyapaṃ ditiṃ dānu dakṣaṃ prajāpatim ।।85 ।।
hiraṇyākṣaṃ ca hiraṇyakaśipuṃ ca pitāmahān ।
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ tataścaturbhujam ।।86।।
tato vairājarūpaṃ ca caturdaśa ca bhūmikāḥ ।
tatra rasātalaṃ tatrā'śmakapattanamuttamam ।।87।।
tatra naijanivāsāँśca tatra naijakuṭumbinaḥ ।
naijarūpāṇi ca sarve lokayāmāsuraḍutam ।।88।।
tatra pañcasahasrāṇi kanyānāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
varaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ ca kiśoraṃ vavrire patim ।।89।।
evaṃ vilokayāmāsustataśca bālarūpadhṛk ।
harirjātaḥ punaścātra kaiśoraṃ rūpamāptavān ।। 2.23.90 ।।
ityevaṃ te vilokyaiva paramāścaryasaṃplutāḥ ।
pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagatpatim । । 91 ।।
upadāḥ sannyadhustvagre pādaprakṣālanāmbu ca ।
papuḥ sarve tadā daityadānavāstatstriyo'pi ca ।। 92 ।।
teṣāṃ kanyā divyarūpāḥ pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
mumuhuḥ śrīharau lagnā dhyānamagnāstadā sthirāḥ ।। 93 । ।
babhūvuśca tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ varayāmāsuricchayā ।
tava pādāmbuje dehi bhaktiṃ dehi jagatprabho ।। 94।।
muktiṃ dehi śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ dehi jagatprabho ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha tathā'stu vaḥ ।। 95।।
dattaṃ padaṃ pradattā ca bhaktirmuktiḥ sukhaṃ tathā ।
ityuktastā divyarūpāstadā jātā hi tatkṣaṇam ।। 96।।
pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyāstā patnyo jātā drutaṃ hareḥ ।
pādau dhṛtvā tatra tasthuḥ patiṃ prāpya prabhuṃ harim ।। 97।।
lomaśasyā''śrame tasthuḥ śrīkāntarakṣitā hi tāḥ ।
lomaśaścyavanaścobhau sampūjya śrīhariṃ tataḥ ।। 98 ।।
kanyāḥ saṃrakṣayāmāsaturvai naijāśrame mudā ।
śrīharerājñayā tāścā'rbudakanyāsu saṃsthitāḥ ।। 99 ।
daityā daśādhisāhasrāḥ śrīhareḥ kṛpayā drutam ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ gantumicchanto vavrire dhāma tatra ca । । 2.23.100 ।
hariṇā prāpitāste tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyarūpiṇaḥ ।
athopadāḥ samastā yāḥ kanyābhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ । । 101 ।।
ṛṣibhyāṃ ca dadau yogyavastūni śrīhariḥ svayam ।
tato bālasvarūpaḥ sa bhūtvā datelāgato'bhavat ।। 102 ।
cyavano lomaśaṃ natvā kanyābhyaśca śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
datvā yayau tīrthayātrāṃ puṣkarāraṇyamuttamam ।। 103 ।
prahlādaścirajīvī vai rasātalamupāyayau ।
ityevaṃ rādhike tasya pareśasya jagatkṛtaḥ ।। 1 04।
atīva divyamāvedyaṃ caritaṃ śrāvaṇe'bhavat ।
varṣe dvitīyake pāṭhācchravaṇānmokṣadaṃ param ।। 105 ।
smṛddhidaṃ cāyuṣyadaṃ ca putrapautradhanapradam ।
akhaṇḍasaubhāgyakaraṃ kṛpāsādhyo yato hariḥ ।। 106 ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rasātalādisthitadaśasāhasradaityadānavānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pañcasāhasrakanyakānāṃ bālakṛṣṇavaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 23 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 023 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 24
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 025 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe tṛtīye'sya varṣāraṃbhe mahotsavam ।
pitā cakāra vidhivat śreṣṭhaṃ dvitīyavarṣavat ।। 1 ।।
mārgaśīrṣatrayodaśyāṃ caulasaṃskāramācarat ।
kṛtvā tu maṃgalasnānaṃ mātṛkāpūjanādikam ।। 2 ।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ svastipāṭhaṃ homaṃ sabhyā'nale tathā ।
pātrāsādanamādhatya vahnestu dakṣiṇe sthale ।। 3 ।।
śubhaikaviṃśatidarbhapiñjulīrnyasya vai tataḥ ।
vahnervāmasthale nyasya raktagogomayādi ca ।। 4 ।।
kṛśarasthālikāpākaṃ nyadhāt pitā tataḥ param ।
kṛtvā vyāhṛtihomādi kṣuramādāya cā''yasam ।। 1 ।।
dakṣiṇottarabhāgasthasvalpaśikhā'vatāraṇam ।
kṛtvā pitā tato garbhakeśānāṃ muṇḍanaṃ śanaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
saśikhaṃ kārayāmāsa nāpitena sutasya ca ।
godānādi dadau viprān bhojayāmāsa yoginaḥ ।। 7 ।।
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ tarpayāmāsa vāsinaḥ ।
lomaśaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ।। 8 ।।
sādhūn sādhvīścātithīṃśca bhojayāmāsa taddine ।
gogrāsān dāpayāmāsa jantubhyaḥ piṣṭakaṃ kaṇān ।। 9 ।।
evaṃ vai caulasaṃskāraṃ cakārā'ghavināśanam ।
yadyapi śrīhareḥ pāpanāśakasya kathaṃ hyagham ।। 2.24.10 ।।
tathāpi lokarakṣārthaṃ vedamārgasya guptaye ।
saṃskāraṃ tādṛśaṃ yogyaṃ kṛtavān vai pitā śubham ।। 11 ।।
rādhā śrutvā tadā kṛṣṇaṃ papraccha vinayānvitā ।
bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ vā prodbhūyā'cchaṃ hi vartatām ।। 1 2।।
viśuddhānāṃ nātividāṃ svacchadarpaṇavaddhṛdām ।
kāmacārakāmabhakṣyakāmavihārasañjuṣām ।। 13 ।।
kinnāma pātakaṃ teṣāṃ yaccaulena vināśyate ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha bālānāṃ rādhike tvamaghaṃ śṛṇu ।। 14।।
pūrvakṛtādi pāpāni janmāntare'bhiyānti vai ।
svargādvā narakādvāpi śeṣaliptiḥ prayāti tam ।। 15।।
garbhe mūtrāśaye vahneḥ pātātmake rajo'nvite ।
dhātau vāsaścātmano yaḥ sa evā'ghena jāyate ।। 16।।
śarīrodbhavanaṃ tatra puṇyapāpena jāyate ।
mūrchāyāṃ ca jale vāsaḥ pāpāyaiva prajāyate ।। 17।।
janmadukhaṃ mahadvai yat pāravaśyaṃ ca pāpataḥ ।
jīvanaṃ dugdhapānādi puṇyapāpena jāyate ।। 18।।
malamūtrādisaṃsargā daṃśādidaśanaṃ tathā ।
avāktvaṃ cāpyaśaktatvaṃ pāpamātreṇa jāyate ।। 19।।
ityetāni tu pāpāni tena pūrvakṛtāni vai ।
janmabhāve prapadyante duḥkhadānyeva sarvathā ।।2.24.20।।
yeṣāṃ pāpaṃ na vai cāsti sa cātmā rudravat priye ।
sanakādisamaḥ syānmānaso vijño na garbhajaḥ ।।21 ।।
athā'śuddheḥ parihāraḥ saṃskāreṇaiva jāyate ।
asaṃskṛtaśarīrasya śuddhiḥ kāryā svabhāvataḥ ।।22।।
pūrvajanmanaḥ pāpāni hyaśuddhyā saha mastake ।
rohanti romarūpaistu kṛṣṇavarṇāni tāni vai ।।23 ।।
garbhakeśāḥ pāparuhastannāśe pāpanāśanam ।
tasmādvai bālakānāṃ tu caulasaṃskṛtiriṣyate ।। 24।।
cūṃ pāpaṃ līyate yena caulaṃ tanmuṇḍanaṃ smṛtam ।
athā'nyacchṛṇu rādhe tvaṃ keśā vai kṛtachedanāḥ ।।25।।
jaṭārūpāḥ pravardhante vegādityasti kāraṇam ।
nūtaneṣu ca keśeṣu mūlāni kāraṇāni vai ।।26।।
punaśca karmaṇā śuklasaṃjñena sā jaṭā bhavet ।
tasmājjaṭā sadā rakṣyā śikhā vā śuklasaṃhitā ।।27।।
yathā yathā ca bālo vai vardhate tu tathā tathā ।
karmaṇā jāyate puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vā miśrakarma ca ।।28।।
āpañcavarṣaṃ bhogyaṃ tatpituḥ samprocyate'tra vai ।
pañcottaraṃ svabhogyaṃ tad romasveva niṣīdati ।।29।।
tasmātkeśāśca romāṇi pāpāśrīṇi bhavanti hi ।
kaccarasya pitrāḥ sarve vyarthakardamaśodhakāḥ ।।2.24.3 0।।
tīrthe vai vapanaṃ tasmāt kāraṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
pāpā'vatāraṇaṃ tadvai boddhavyaṃ keśakartanam ।।3 1 ।।
evaṃ keśāvapanīyāstṛtīye vatsare tataḥ ।
yatheṣṭaṃ vapanīyāste brahmarandhraṃ vinā'bhitaḥ ।।32।।
yadvā puṇyā jaṭā rakṣyā saṃskṛtā śobhanā'naghā ।
kṛṣṇāḥ keśā janānāṃ tu yāvad dṛśyanta eva te ।।33 ।।
tāvat pāpāni viṣayāḥ kārayanti tu dehinaḥ ।
ākarṇaśuklaromāṇo vṛddhā lipyanta eva na ।।34।।
tasmād vṛddhasya naivā'sti tvāmnāyaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ ।
madhyāvasthasya tat sarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa nigadyate ।।35।।
ityevaṃ rādhike caulasaṃskāraḥ śodhakaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
rādhikā prāha bhagavan pūrvajanmā'ghasañcayaḥ ।।36।।
kathaṃ romasu garbhasthabālakasya pratiṣṭhati ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha ca rādhe! śṛṇu tatkathayāmi te ।।37।।
purā hyadharmaḥ puruṣo brahmapṛṣṭhasamutthitaḥ ।
hiṃsāpatnīsusaṃyuktaḥ pāpaputrastato'bhavat ।।38।।
pitṛbhaktaśca pāpaḥ svaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā ।
na muñcati kṣaṇaṃ dūraṃ sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā ।।3 9।।
yatrā'dharmaśca hiṃsā ca tatra pāpaḥ pravartate ।
yatrā'dharmo na hiṃsā na tatra pāpo na vartate ।।2.24.40।।
ātmāno ye tu garbhasthā apakvā niṣkriyā vaśāḥ ।
aguṇāścolbasaṃvṛttāsteṣāṃ nā'dharmahiṃsane ।।41 ।।
kathaṃ pāpena vai tatra stheyaṃ pūrvakṛtādhini ।
pāpinaṃ cet parityajya pāpaṃ vinā'vamarṣaṇam ।।42।।
dūraṃ yāti tadā tena kutra stheyaṃ vinā''śrayam ।
anyakṛtaṃ na cānyatra tiṣṭhatyeva ca gacchati ।।43 ।।
yena kṛtaṃ tu tat tasminneva tiṣṭhati sarvathā ।
bhogottaraṃ vināśaḥ syād yāvattvena vinirṇayaḥ ।।44।।
itinyāyāt pāpasaṃjñaḥ sutaḥ pitre nyavedayat ।
yatra garbhe gate bāle nā'dharmo na ca hiṃsanam ।।45।।
tābhyāṃ vinā mayā tatra kathaṃ stheyaṃ tadātmani ।
adharmastaṃ ca pāpākhyaṃ sutaṃ prāha vicārya vai ।।46।।
putrā''gaccha mayā sākaṃ cārthayāmi pitāmaham ।
sa tadā te nivāsārthaṃ yad dadet tatra saṃvasa ।।47।।
ityuktvā taṃ sutaṃ nītvā sahā'dharmo hyajaṃ yayau ।
pitaraṃ ca namaskṛtya niṣasāda purastataḥ ।।48।।
brahmā papraccha taṃ putraṃ saputraṃ cāgame kṛtim ।
kathaṃ kimarthamāyātaḥ saputro vada me'ciram ।।49।।
adharmaḥ prāha bhagavan putro'yaṃ pāpasaṃjñakaḥ ।
yatra hiṃsā tathā cā'haṃ tatra vāsaparaḥ sadā ।।2.24.50।।
garbhasthānāṃ tu jīvānāṃ vidyete na tu tābubhau ।
tatra teṣāṃ pūrvapāpaiḥ kathaṃ stheyaṃ vadā'tra me ।।5 1 ।।
brahmā vicārya ca tathā prāha garbhagatasya vai ।
keśarūpeṇa pāpena sthātavyaṃ vai mamā''jñayā ।।।52।।
tataḥ pāpaḥ parāṃ tuṣṭiṃ jagāma svāśraye sthitaḥ ।
vināpi pitarau tatra varṣatrayaṃ pratiṣṭhite ।।53 ।।
atha brahmā svasaṃkalpān putrān ṣoḍaśa pāvanān ।
saṃskārān janayāmāsa pāpanāśanahetave ।।54।।
tatra caulaśca saṃskāraḥ keśātmā'ghavināśanaḥ ।
vihitaścaivamevā'nye pāpanāśakarāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।55।।
ityevaṃ rādhike sṛṣṭipālanāya tu vedhasā ।
pūrvasṛṣṭyanurūpeṇā'nuṣṭhitaṃ varṇitaṃ tathā ।।56।।
tathārītyaiva lokānāṃ śikṣaṇārthaṃ harerapi ।
pitrā caulākhyasaṃskāraḥ sampāditaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ।।57।।
atha tatra camatkārastadā jāto vadāmi te ।
adṛṣṭaścā'pyaśrutaśca pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraistathā ।।58।।
mayā gatavatā rādhe tadānīṃ tatra vīkṣitaḥ ।
nāpitena tu ye keśā mastakādavatāritāḥ ।।59।।
te sarve'śvapaṭṭasarojale kṣiptā yadā tadā ।
divyāḥ sahasraśo nārāyaṇāścaturbhujāḥ śubhāḥ ।।2.24.60 ।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharā bhukuṭaśobhitāḥ ।
suvarṇakuṇḍalā vahnivastrā ramāniṣevitāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
vinatātanujā''rūḍhāḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhāḥ ।
sakaustubhāḥ satilakā bhagavanto virejire ।।62।।
sarve samānāḥ sadṛśāste'dṛśyanta tadā tataḥ ।
aṣṭabhujāstata eva tataḥ ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ।।63।।
dvātriṃśadbāhavaḥ paścācchatasāhasrabāhavaḥ ।
sahasraśo divyarūpā adṛśyanta narāyaṇāḥ ।।64।।
evaṃ lakṣaṃ śiroromṇāṃ nārāyaṇātmakaṃ hi tat ।
adṛśyata tadā hrasvāḥ keśāścaturbhujā hi te ।।65।।
adṛśyanta tato lambā aṣṭabhujā narāyaṇāḥ ।
tato lambatarāḥ keśā ye te ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ।।66।।
tato lambatamāḥ keśā dvātriṃśadbāhavo hi te ।
evaṃ dīrghātidīrghāśca keśāḥ śatādibāhavaḥ ।।67।।
sahasrabāhavaśceti vyadṛśyanta narāyaṇāḥ ।
taiḥ saha yāḥ śriyastāśca vyadṛśyanta tathābhujāḥ ।।68।।
yugalāste lakṣasaṃkhyāstuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।
tava mūrtau sthitā nārāyaṇā vayaṃ śiroruhāḥ ।।69।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaro bhavān ।
aprasaṃkhyāvatārāṇāmavatārī parātparaḥ ।।2.24.70।।
vayaṃ līnāstava mūrtau vasāmastava vācchayā ।
nirgacchāmaśca vai kāle kāle brahmāṇḍarakṣakāḥ ।।71 ।।
bhavāmo bhagavantaśca yāvattava nideśanam ।
layecchayā ca te kṛṣṇa hyupasaṃhāramāpnumaḥ ।।।72।।
pūjayāmo namāmastvāṃ vahāmaste nideśanam ।
pṛthag jātā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa tava mūrtirataḥ prabho ।।73 ।।
kva gantavyaṃ coṣitavyamasmābhirdehi deśanām ।
tathā kurmo hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'kṣarādhipa ।।74।।
tava mūrtau ca ye tvanye hyapi romagaṇā hi te ।
anādino hi te muktāstathā cāgantukā api ।।75।।
muktā bhavanti muktānyo brahmāṇyo brahmapūruṣāḥ ।
tava mūrtau ca ye divyā guṇā vasanti te hare ।।76 ।।
sarve ca viṣṇavaḥ santi lakṣmīdāsīniṣevitāḥ ।
tava mūrtau ca ye bhūṣāḥ santi te tava śaktayaḥ ।।77।।
rādhāramājayālakṣmīpārvatīlalitāprabhāḥ ।
māṇikīmañjulādyāstāḥ premarūpā vasanti hi ।।78।।
ābhūṣaṇasvarūpāstā muktā muktānya eva ha ।
tava śṛṃgāratattvāni vāsudevādayaśca te ।।79।।
vyūhāḥ santi hare kṛṣṇa nakhādyā īśvareśvarāḥ ।
tvadabhinnā avatāryapṛthagasiddhaviśeṣaṇāḥ ।।2.24.80 ।।
tava mūrtyātmakāḥ sarve nigūḍhā nivasanti te ।
vayaṃ keśasvarūpāste pṛthagbhūtāstavecchayā ।।8 1 ।।
caulasaṃskāramāsādya te'vatārasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
tata ājñāṃ nivāsāya dehi naḥ kurmahe tathā ।।82।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścaivaṃ prabhāṣitaḥ ।
prārthitaścājñayā'rthaṃ ca prasannastānnijāntike ।।83 ।।
samāhūya ca tilakān bindūn kuṃkumakaisarān ।
teṣāṃ bhāleṣu kṛtvaiva samuvācā'kṣareśitā ।।84।।
yūyaṃ mamā'vatārāśca mamaiśvaryabharāḥ śubhāḥ ।
nibodhata mayā nityamutpādyante'ṇḍarāśayaḥ ।।85।।
adyotpāditagoleṣu lakṣeṣu caikadeśiṣu ।
yāta madājñayā tatra bhavata śrīnarāyaṇāḥ ।।86।।
caturdaśatalāṇḍeṣu tathā yāta caturbhujāḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatibhūgoleṣu tathā yātā'ṣṭabāhavaḥ ।।87।।
ṣaṭapañcāśatstarāṇḍeṣu yāta ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ।
śatāṣṭrabhūmikāṇḍeṣu yāta dvātriṃśabāhavaḥ ।।88।।
śatādibāhavo yāta pañcaśatastarāṇḍake ।
sahasrabāhavo yāta sahasrabhūmikāṇḍake ।।89।।
ekaikāṇḍe mayā caikaika evā'trā'dhikriyate ।
tathā tathā navaṃ nūtnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ yāta caikaśaḥ ।।2.24.90 ।।
paśyata svakaredakṣe yasya yad dṛśyate'ṇḍakam ।
sa ca tattad viśatveva mama yogapratāpataḥ ।।91 ।।
ityuktāste yayurnatvā śrīnārāyaṇamūrtayaḥ ।
svasvabrahmāṇḍamālokya yāvadāyurviśaśramuḥ ।।92।।
teṣu gateṣu sarveṣu lomaśaḥ prāha keśavam ।
mahyaṃ darśaya tānyeva brahmāṇḍāni ca yeṣu te ।।93।।
śrutvā vihasya ca harirlomaśaṃ netrayostadā ।
aṃgulyā jalayogenā'spṛśad divyo'bhavattadā ।। 94।।
divyanetro dadarśaitānavatārāँśca golakān ।
paramāścaryamāpanno mahimānaṃ viveda ha ।।95।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yādṛśaṃ tataḥ ।
caulākhyasaṃskāravidheḥ parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।।96।।
datvā dānāni bahūni prāsādaṃ harirāyayau ।
pitā mātā camatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvopāyayaturmudam ।।97।।
lomaśaḥ kanyakāvṛndasahitaścāśramaṃ yayau ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe'nādikṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam ।। 98।।
agamyaṃ sarvathā lokairdivyānugrahavedyakam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradāyakam ।।99।।
paśuputrapradaṃ dhānyadhanadaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
kṛṣṇabhaktipradaṃ nārāyaṇapadapradaṃ tathā ।। 2.24.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhoścaulasaṃskāre romasu pāpānāṃ kathānakaṃ hareḥ romṇāṃ tu nārāyaṇarūpatetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 24 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 25
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 026 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakathāṃ prapāvanīm ।
tṛtīyavarṣe sañjātā phālgune pratipattithau ।। 1 ।।
phālgunasya śuklapakṣe puṣpadolamahotsavam ।
cakāra kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vasante tatra samprāpte kiṃśukā jvalanaprabhāḥ ।
niṣpatrāḥ satataṃ rejuḥ śobhayanto dharātalam ।। 3 ।।
śiśiraṃ nāma mātaṃgaṃ vidārya nakharairiva ।
vasantakesarī prāptaḥ palāśakusumaiḥ priye ।। 4 ।।
kundā hasanti satataṃ kalikādantakaistadā ।
vanāni karṇikārāṇāṃ puṣpitāni virejire ।। 5 ।।
raktā'śokavanā bhānti puṣpitāḥ sahasojjvalāḥ ।
bhṛṅgavṛndāḥ piñjaritā rājante gahane vane ।। 6 ।।
mañjarībhirvirājante nadīkūleṣu vetasāḥ ।
raktā'śokakarā tanvī rādhike kiṃśukāṃ'ghrikā ।। 7 ।।
nīlāśokakarā śyāmā vikāsikamalānanā ।
nīlendīvaranetrā ca madhyabilvaphalastanī ।। 8 ।।
protphullakundadaśanā mañjarīkaraśobhitā ।
bandhujīvādharā śubhrasinduvāranavāṅkurā ।। 9 ।।
puँskokilasvanā divyā kaṃkolavasanā śubhā ।
barhivṛndakalāpā ca sārasasvaranūpurā ।। 2.25.1 0।
prāgvaṃśaraśanā ramyo mattahaṃsagatistathā ।
putrajīvāṃśukāsaṅgaromarājivirājitā ।। 1 1।।
vasantalakṣmīḥ samprāptā cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
padmāni jalacakṣūँṣi paśyanti premavanti ca ।। 1 2।।
taraṃgā jalahastāścā''hvayanti snāyino muhuḥ ।
jalasya garjanāhāsyaṃ vedayanti pramodanam ।। 13।।
śukāḥ pārśvacarāḥ kṛḍhagāgamaṃ cāvedayanti ca ।
śītaśīkarapavanāścākarṣayanti mānasam ।। 14।।
jalahaṃsāstārakāḍhyāṃ nimantrayanti dyāmapi ।
matsyāśca rohiṇāḥ sādhūn smārayanti jalaplutān ।। 15।।
ṭiṭṭibhadhvānamevātra bālān snānābhilāṣukān ।
karoti rañjayatyapi nṛtyaṃ māyūramuttamam ।। 16।।
kokilāḥ puṣpaśākhāsu kūjanena muhurharim ।
snānārthaṃ cāhvayantīva prāpte vasantayauvane ।। 17।।
evaṃvidhaṃ prasannaṃ ca vanaṃ vikasitaṃ ca tat ।
vilokya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।। 18।।
sahasraśastadā bālā bālikāśca striyastathā ।
puṣpadolotsavaṃ kartuṃ yayuścotsukamānasāḥ ।। 19।।
kadambānāṃ ca śākhāsu dolā baddhvā sukhāvahāḥ ।
āndolayanti bālāṃśca bālikāḥ kanyakādikāḥ ।। 2.25.20।।
kesaraiśca tathā pālāśakaiḥ pītaiśca raktakaiḥ ।
haritaiḥ kapiśai raṃgairbhṛtvā gargarikādikāḥ ।।21।।
raṃgaiḥ saṃremire setau narā nāryo vasantake ।
dhūlīkṣepairjalakṣepai raṃgakṣepairgulālakaiḥ ।।22।।
kuṃkumai raktacūrṇaiśca remire sarasastaṭe ।
prātaḥ parasparaṃ dhṛtvā prasahya vinipātya ca ।।23।।
gargarīraṃgasalilaṃ siñcantyabhīkṣṇamutsukāḥ ।
saraso mṛttikāṃ puṇyāṃ lepayanti mukhādiṣu ।।24।।
jaladhārāḥ prasiñcanti śirasyupari yantrakaiḥ ।
puṣpagucchān karṇayośca dhṛtvā nṛtyanti kecana ।। 25।।
pragāyanti kṛṣṇagītīḥ kāścana modasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
anye kadarmitaṃ dehaṃ veṣaṃ prakṣālayanti ca ।। 26।।
vidhunvanti śiraḥkeśān rajodhūlitadhūsarān ।
pramṛjanti netradhūlīḥ praviśanti sarojale ।। 27।।
taranti naikataraṇaiḥ sambhūya snānti vāriṣu ।
vastrāṇi raṃgaraktāni kṣālayanti narāḥ striyaḥ ।। 28।।
stabakānāṃ nikuñjeṣu ramante bālabālikāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ svayūtheṣu ramante varṣayanti ca ।। 29।।
vādyāni vādayitvā ca vasantaṃ prārcayantyapi ।
pratimāṃ kānakīṃ kṛtvā pītāmbaravibhūṣitām ।।2.25.3 0।।
raktapuṣpairañcitāṃ ca sakalgimukuṭānvitām ।
raśanāmañjīrayutāṃ sakañcukāṃ suśobhanām ।।3 1 ।।
kiśorabhāvamāpannāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ manoharām ।
puṣparathasthitāṃ saumyāṃ mañjarīkṛtaśekharām ।।।32।।
gucchastabakakarṇāḍhyāṃ sugandhadravacarcitām ।
keśajūṭalasatskandhāṃ svarṇachatravirājitām ।।33।।
naddhasūryamaṇiprāntamadhyacandrottarīyakām ।
hīraratnasumauktikā'ñcitamukuṭaśobhitām । ।34।।
puṣpottaṃsāṃ puṣpakaṭiṃ puṣpāvaraṇasaṃbhṛtām ।
kadambapuṣpamālāḍhyāṃ cāmpakeyalalāṭikām ।।35।।
karṇikāraprakoṣṭhāṃ ca pālāśabāhuśobhitām ।
japāpuṣpauṣṭhalalitāmaindīvāraśmaśrūlikām ।।36 ।।
citrakusumanetrāntāṃ kundadantavirājitām ।
tilapuṣpasunāsāḍhyāṃ kādambagaṇḍamaṇḍitām ।।37।।
kadalīpuṣpabhālāḍhyāṃ kadalīstambhasakthinīm ।
kālhārajaghanabhrāmāṃ kāmalābhasunābhikām ।।38।।
hastiśuṇḍhasamajaṅghāṃ padmapādatalānvitām ।
candrasūkṣmākṛtinakhāṃ pāṇḍurāṃ mandahāsinīm ।।39।।
mūrtiṃ vasantadevasya pupūjuḥ sarvamānavāḥ ।
supuṣpaiḥ kuṃkumādyaiśca sasyaśukaiḥ suśigrubhiḥ ।।2.25.40।।
kuṃkumā'bilacūrṇaiśca gulālairvimaladyubhiḥ ।
mañjarībhiḥ raktapatraiḥ phalairvividhakaistathā ।।41 ।।
dugdhapākaiḥ sudravaiśca pupūjuḥ śrīvasantakam ।
ragairbahuvidhaiścāpi saṃsnāpya śrīvasantakam ।।।42।।
vāsantikairambarādyairbhūṣābhiḥ puṣpapaṭṭakaiḥ ।
puṣpahāraiśca pupūjurvasantaṃ kalikāpatim ।।43।।
mañjarīpallavānāthaṃ cāṃkurādhipatiṃ prabhum ।
puṣpādhipaṃ nālikeśaṃ kāṇḍikādhipatim ṛtum ।।44।।
śādvaleśaṃ sukiśoraṃ pupūjuḥ sarasastaṭe ।
vasantasya priyāścānyāḥ kokilāṃ haṃsikāṃ tathā ।।45।।
sārasīṃ sumanāṃ menāṃ māyūrikāṃ ca bhāsikām ।
śukīṃ ca gāruḍīṃ caiva pupūjuḥ ṣoḍaśapriyāḥ ।।46।।
sarvā lakṣmīsvarūpāstā vicitraraṃgaśobhanāḥ ।
kanyakāḥ kāñcanabhāsāścandrakāntibharānanāḥ ।।47।।
śvetāmbarāḥ piṃgavastrā haritāmbaradhārikāḥ ।
kapiśāmbarayuktāśca citrāmbaradharāstathā ।।48।।
kānakābhāmbaradharāḥ kapiśāmbaradhārikāḥ ।
nīlāmbarāḥ payovastrāḥ karburāmbarādhikāḥ ।।।49।।
kaisarāmbarayuktāśca pāṇḍurāmbadhārikāḥ ।
yāvacchṛṃgāraśobhāścā''narcurvasantayoṣitaḥ ।।2.25.50।।।
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumākṣatavāribhiḥ ।
dugdhapākādibhiścāpi tāmbūlakairapūjayan ।।।51 ।।
atha śrībhagavāँstatrā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
kaiśorarūpamāsthāya cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।।52।।
dolāyāṃ śrīvasantākhyaṃ ṣoḍaśā''ryāyutam ṛtum ।
saṃsthāpayitvā vividhairupacārairapūjayat ।।53 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ ca kṛtavān tatastatra vasantakaḥ ।
bhāryāṣoḍaśayuktaḥ saḥ pratyakṣo hyabhavattadā ।। 54 ।।
yathāvarṇitarūpaśca jagād pūjakaṃ prabhum ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ।।55।।
parameśvara pūjāṃ me laukikīṃ rītimāśritaḥ ।
karoṣi sarvadevādyaiḥ pūjyatvaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।।56।।
adyā'haṃ pāvano jātaḥ sastrīkastava sevakaḥ ।
tvāmarcayitumicchāmi niṣīda tvaṃ varāsane ।।57।।
ityuktvā śrīvasantaśca sapriyo hi nijāsanāt ।
avatīrya bhuvi sthitvā svāminaṃ puruṣottamam ।।58।।
dolāyāṃ prasamāropya pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ sarvabhāryābhiḥ sahitaḥ ṛtuḥ ।।59।।
ānarca śrīhariṃ tatra kaiśoraṃ rūpamāsthitam ।
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ vilokya puruṣottamam ।।2.25.60।।
mumuhurdivyarūpe te vasantādyā janāstathā ।
vasantayoṣitaḥ sarvā mugdhā babhūvurīśvare ।।6 1।।
ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣipatnyaśca mumuhuḥ parameśvare ।
evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ ca niśceṣṭāḥ stabdhāḥ samabhavan sukhāḥ ।।62।।
śrīkṛṣṇasya kaṭākṣeṇa hāsyaprasannatābhṛtā ।
atha kṣaṇānte bubudhurnaijātmānaṃ ca te tadā ।।63 ।।
tuṣṭuvuḥ śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ parameśvaramiṣṭadam ।
tvameva bhagavānāsse sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ ।।64।।
sarvaiśvaryayutaḥ sākṣādanādipuruṣottamaḥ ।
dehi padṃ sadā nātha sevārthaṃ caraṇaṃ tava ।।65।।
vinā tvāṃ sarvamevāsti niṣphalaṃ sukhavarjitam ।
ityuktvā ca janā nāryo nipetuścaraṇe hareḥ ।।66।।
hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
tataḥ punaścamatkāraṃ darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।।67।।
vasantadehe naijaṃ cābhivyāptaṃ rūpamaiśvaram ।
sarvavasantakāntābhirdṛśyate śrīhariḥ svayam ।।68।।
vasante svāmini nāthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tadā mumuhustaṃ dṛṣṭvā kalikādyāḥ patiṃ prabhum ।।69।।
varayāmāsurevainaṃ kiśoraṃ puruṣottamam ।
priyāḥ ṣoḍaśa evaitāḥ pupūjustuṣṭuvuḥ punaḥ ।।2.25.70।।
mālāḥ samarpayāmāsurvidadhuścandrakaṃ tataḥ ।
ātmārpaṇaṃ harirjñātvā mānaseṣṭaṃ subhāvitam ।।71।।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha kiśorarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ ।
ṣoḍaśakanyakānāṃ śrīprabhuścaivā'karottadā ।।72।।
rūpadvayaṃ tu pratyekaṃ divyaṃ cā'divyamityadaḥ ।
adivyaṃ devatulyaṃ yat ṣoḍaśaṃ rūpameva tat ।।73।।
vasantāya dadau cātha divyaṃ ṣoḍaśarūpakam ।
kanyakānāṃ surūpaṃ tat nijapriyāsvarakṣayat ।।74।।
lomaśāya dadau tatrāśrame kanyāsu koṭiṣu ।
nivāsārthaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇo bālarūpo babhūva ca ।।75।।
raṃgaklinnaṃ hariṃ snāpayituṃ mātā sarastaṭe ।
yayau tāvanmahādaityo mīnarūpo jalasthitaḥ ।।76।।
jagrāha bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ triṃśaddhastapramāṇavān ।
mātā'tra vihvalā jātā putranāśā'bhiśaṃkayā ।।77।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ko'sau kṛṣṇa! mahāmīno daityarāṭ tatra cāgataḥ ।
yo'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhakṣayituṃ sthitaḥ ।।78।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
sālamālo mahādaityo hiraṇyakūrcacarmajaḥ ।
sālemālavane tiṣṭhannāsīllokabhayaṃkaraḥ ।।79।।
saurāṣṭrapūrvadigbhāge vanyabhakṣyo mahāsuraḥ ।
saptatālocchrayaścaikatālāyato'driśṛṃgavat ।।2.25.80 ।।
gadāmudgaradhārī ca pitṛvairaṃ smarannaṭan ।
aśvapaṭṭasaromadhye timirūpo'bhavattadā ।।8 1 ।।
kāmarūpadharo daityastriṃśaddhastatimiḥ sa vai ।
pucchena pracakarṣainaṃ bālaṃ snāntaṃ taṭe tadā ।।82।।
mātṛpārśve ca sopāne sthitaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam ।
bālo jñātvā kṛpāvārdhirāsuraṃ damanocitam ।।83।।
hantuṃ samāgataṃ śīghraṃ nayantaṃ ca jale talam ।
bālakṛṣṇastadā dvedhā'bhavad bālaśca nakrakaḥ ।।84।।
bālo bhūtvā drutaṃ sarastaṭe sopānamāsthitaḥ ।
nakro bhūtvā jalamadhye pañcāśaddhastamānavān ।।85।।
mahāmatsyaṃ grasituṃ vai śīghraṃ pṛṣṭhe babhūva saḥ ।
maraṇasya bhayānmatsyo dudrāva jalabhūtalam ।।86।।
nakro jagrāha taṃ matsyaṃ matsyarūpaṃ vihāya saḥ ।
sālemālo mahādaityo naro bhūtvā gadākaraḥ ।।87।।
nakraṃ jaghāna tarasā nakrastāvallayaṃ gataḥ ।
gadādhārī tu puruṣaḥ saptatālo'pi so'bhavat ।।88।।
sālemālasya ca nārāyaṇasya samaro mahān ।
balātibalinostatra gadābhyāṃ samajāyata ।।89।।
sālena tu harermūrdhni tāḍitā balato gadā ।
babhaṃja śatakhaṇḍā sā harirvajradṛḍhastadā ।।2.25.90।।
pratijaghāna taṃ daityaṃ gadayaiva mahāprabhuḥ ।
vakṣasyeva hataḥ śīghraṃ nipapāta vimūrchitaḥ ।। 91।।
punarutthāya ca naijaṃ mudgaraṃ prāhiṇod balāt ।
gadayā hariṇā tattu muṣṭidaṇḍe prabhañjitam ।।92।।
aśastraḥ sālamālo'sau khamutpapāta śṛṃgavat ।
mudgalāgraṃ samādāya pātayāmāsa ke hareḥ ।।93।।
bhagavāṃśca svagadayā pothayāmāsa mudgaram ।
sudarśanaṃ mumocainaṃ nāśayituṃ mahāprabhuḥ ।। 94।।
śatasūryasamaṃ vahnijvālāmālākulaṃ bhramat ।
śīghraṃ nyapatat śālasya mūrdhni cakarta tacchiraḥ ।।95।।
hāhākāro'bhavattatra prasannāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।
sālemālo mṛtaścāyaṃ krośadehapramāṇavān ।।96।।
nyapatad bhūtale vṛkṣān nāśayan kampayan mahīm ।
ātmā tasya hareścakrayogena muktatāṃ gataḥ ।।97।।
vimānena sudivyena vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpa sālakaḥ ।
garuḍastasya dehantu cāśvapaṭṭasarovarāt ।।98।।
padbhyāṃ dhṛtvā nināyainamatyajad vyomamārgataḥ ।
yaśodānottaraṃ śaile sālemālāhvaye vane ।।99।।
tatra ye daityavaryāḥ saṃvartante tasya jātijāḥ ।
prāpuḥ śokaṃ paraṃ tasya nāryo'pi śatamipyapi ।। 2.25.10 0।।
rurudurvai bhṛśaṃ vyomnaḥ patitaṃ vīkṣya vallabham ।
aurdhvadaihikamevā'sya cakrurjātyanusārataḥ ।। 10 1।।
pañcaśatāni daityānāṃ śataṃ ca tasya yoṣitām ।
sahasraṃ cāpi putrāṇāṃ sukhaṃ na lebhire śucā ।। 1 02।।
satataṃ cintayāmāsuste sarve vairayāpanam ।
athā'tra bhagavān bālo bhūtvā'śvapaṭṭasannidhau ।। 1 03।।
puṣpadolotsavaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyāṃ gṛhamāyayau ।
kanyakāḥ śrīlomaśasyāśramaṃ yayustadājñayā ।। 1 04।।
ṛṣayastallalanāśca svasvālayān yayustataḥ ।
pitā hareḥ kare rakṣāsūtraṃ babandha caurṇakam ।। 1 05।।
evaṃ dolotsave nārāyaṇena paramātmanā ।
rādhike darśitaścamatkāro daityo niṣūditaḥ ।। 1 06।।
paṭhanācchravaṇādvāpi sarvasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।
naro nārī kanyakā vā bālo yatiryuvā'pi vā ।। 1 07।।
prāpnuyāt paramaṃ dhāma śrutvā bhāvena tatkathām ।
kṛpāsādhyahareḥ rādhe pāravatīśituḥ priye ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vasantavikāsaḥ, puṣpadolotsavaḥ timiṃgilarūpasālamālāsurasya harirnāśārthamāgatasya harikṛtanāśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 25 ।।
