śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ākarṇaya vṛṣabhānusute camatkṛtiṃ hareḥ ।
anyāṃ tṛtīyavarṣotthāṃ kathayāmi sukhapradām ।। 1 ।।
śrāvaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kuṃkumavāpikāśrayāḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre brahmasūtrakratūtsave ।। 2 ।।
militā brahmasūtrasya nava saṃskāraśuddhaye ।
sahasraśaste ṛṣayo lomaśādyāḥ sadarbhakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
sapātrā havyakavyādisahitā dehaśodhanam ।
saṃcakruḥ pañcagavyādyaiḥ snānaiḥ pitṛpratarpaṇam ।। 4 ।।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi cakruśca havanādikam ।
navaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhārayāmāsurujjvalam ।। 5 ।।
tannimittaṃ mahārudraṃ viṣṇuyajñaṃ ca naityakam ।
cakrurmahotsavaṃ tīre gītavādyapranartanaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathopadeśanaiḥ ।
āndhasikāḥ sarastīre vaṭā'dhastānmahānase ।। 7 ।।
cūrṇamauktikalaḍḍukān pūrikā'pūpapāyasān ।
śrīkhaṇḍakvathikāphullavaṭīvyañjanabhājikāḥ ।। 8 ।।
sūpodanāni ca tathā miṣṭatiktadravāṇi ca ।
rājikārāddhacaṭanīścāranālāni polikāḥ ।। 9 ।।
pācayāmāsuratyarthaṃ koṭyarbudadvijārthakam ।
pakvānnānāṃ parvatāśca ghṛtānāṃ payasāṃ hradā ।। 2.26.1 0।।
takrāṇāṃ saritaścāpi pāyasānāṃ sarāṃsi ca ।
kṛtāni karitānyeva kalpavṛkṣairmaharṣibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
madhyāhne havane tatra pravartite makhānale ।
tāvad vyomnaḥ samāyātaṃ sainyaṃ daityajanātmakam ।। 1 2।।
krośamātraṃ tu tad dūramabhavad yajñabhūmitaḥ ।
tāvadākrośanaṃ teṣāṃ śrutvā vai lomaśo muniḥ ।। 13।।
śīghraṃ cālokayāmāsa divyadṛṣṭyā tu dānavān ।
dānavībhiḥ sahitāँśca dhṛtaśastrā'strabandhanān ।। 14।।
sālemālasya tu vairaniryātanārthameva tān ।
samāgatān mahākrūrān yoddhukāmānavasthitān ।। 15।।
eṣaḥ pradeśaḥ śatrornaḥ kṛṣṇasaudho'yameva ca ।
dvijāgryo lomaśaścāyaṃ ghnantu tānmārayantu ca ।। 16।।
anena bālakṛṣṇena mārito'smatpitā prabhuḥ ।
mardayantu bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpitarau ca lomaśam ।। 17।।
eṣa āśramagrāmaśca brāhmaṇānāṃ drumeṣvapi ।
bhidyatāṃ chidyatāṃ prajvālyatāṃ vināśyatāṃ kṣaṇāt ।। 18।।
sālaputrāḥ sahasraṃ ca bhṛtyā nāryaśca dāsikāḥ ।
bāndhavāḥ sālamālasya nipetuḥ sarasastaṭe ।। 19।।
anye cākāśamārgeṇa samāpatanti vegataḥ ।
kanyakā daityapatnyaśca bālā vṛddhāḥ suyauvanāḥ ।। 2.26.20।।
yāvadyajñakṣitiṃ naite cāyātāstāvadeva ca ।
lomaśaḥ staṃbhayāmāsa tvātharvaṇairvihāyasi ।।21 ।।
taṭasthān taṭapārśve ca stambhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ।
pakvānnāni tathā yajño yathā gacchenna bhraṣṭatām ।।22।।
tathā vai lomaśaḥ kṛtvā sasmāra śrīpatiṃ prabhum ।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ kiśoraḥ sannupāyayau kṣaṇāt kratum ।।23।।।
vipraiḥ sammānitaḥ kṛṣṇo'rcitaḥ sudarśanānvitaḥ ।
prārthitaḥ sagaruḍaśca daityā'nīkanivāraṇe ।।24।।
śīghraṃ natvā ṛṣibhyaśca śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।
āruhya garuḍaṃ śīghraṃ vyomamārgaṃ jagāma ha ।।25।।
sainyasya sannidhau gatvā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
lomaśaścātharvamantrān vārayāmāsa tāvatā ।।26।।
sainyaṃ sacetanaṃ yoddhuṃ nyapatat śrīhariṃ prati ।
gadayā śrīhariḥ sainyaṃ pothayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।।27।।
pakṣābhyāṃ ca nakhābhyāṃ ca cañcvā ca garuḍastadā ।
tāḍayāmāsa bahudhā pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।।28।।
drāvayāmāsa śeṣāṃśca rakṣayāmāsa yoṣitaḥ ।
atha vidrāvitā daityā dhṛtvā śilā drumāँstathā ।।29।।
pratyāvṛttya nijaghnuśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
tataḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ mumoca bhagavān svayam ।।2.26.3 0।।
kartayāmāsa tān sarvānasurān sālavaṃśajān ।
teṣāṃ tejāṃsi ca harau samāgatya viśaśramuḥ ।।3 1।।
nāryasteṣāṃ kanyakāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।
vaṃśavaṭe sthitāḥ sarvā vavuśca varadānakam ।।32।।
eteṣāṃ kṛṣṇa daityānāṃ mokṣaṃ kuru tathā ca naḥ ।
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho śaraṇaṃ te pradehi naḥ ।। 33।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīgaruḍasthitaḥ ।
cakrasya tejasā tāsāṃ pāpānyadāhayattadā ।।34।।
kāyākalpān vidhāyaiva divyarūpadharāśca tāḥ ।
śaraṇyo bhagavāँstābhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ svaṃ dadau mudā ।।35 ।।
lomaśasyā''śrame sthātuṃ niyuyoja pareśvaraḥ ।
lomaśastā jalenāpi saṃprokṣyā''plāvya vāribhiḥ ।।36 ।।
pañcagavyena ca śuddhiṃ kārayitvā tataḥ param ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।37।।
datvā mantraṃ ca tulasīsrajaṃ ca tilakādikam ।
tāḥ sarvā dīkṣayāmāsa vaiṣṇavīḥ pracakāra ha ।।38।।
tatastā bhojayāmāsa śataṃ pañcaśatāni ca ।
mātṝśca kanyakāścāpi preṣayāmāsa cāśramam ।।3 9।।
lomaśādyā ṛṣayaśca kṛtvā kratuvidhiṃ tataḥ ।
yajñasūtrāṇi sandhṛtvā'ntimaṃ homaṃ vidhāya ca ।।2.26.40 ।।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kanyakāḥ koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ ।
kuṭumbinastathā'tithīn bhojayāmāsuraiśvarāḥ ।।41 ।।
dadurdānāni ca tathottamāni vividhāni ca ।
gokṣetrāraṇyaratnāni vastrabhūṣāgṛhāṇi ca ।।42।।
sopaskarāṇi yānāni vāhanā'nnajalānyapi ।
evaṃ dānāni datvaiva yajñakāryaṃ samāpya ca ।।43 ।।
vadantaḥ paramāścaryaṃ svasvagṛhaṃ yayurmudā ।
gopālakṛṣṇakaścāpi bālakṛṣṇayutastataḥ ।।44।।
nijālayaṃ yayau pakṣī vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau tataḥ ।
lomaśādyā yayurnaijāśramān sukhānvitāstadā ।।45।।
evaṃ vai rādhike sālemālīyā daityapuṃgavāḥ ।
hatāḥ śrīhariṇā sarve yayurvaikuṇṭhameva te ।।46।।
tatkanyakā hariṃ vavrurlomaśasyāśramasthitāḥ ।
tanmātaro daityapatno yāśca vaidhavyamāśritāḥ ।।47।।
ātmaśreyaḥ papracchustā lomaśaṃ munipuṃgavam ।
kenā'tra karmaṇā vidvan śreyaḥ syādubhayatra naḥ ।।48।।
tadvadā'tra daityapatnīḥ kṛpayā munipuṅgava ।
lomaśaśca tadā tābhyastatsutābhyaśca sarvathā ।।।49।।
sadāśreyaskarān dharmānuvācā'bhyudayapradān ।
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ dānaṃ kṣamā damo dayā ।।।2.26.5 0।।
amānitvaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca tapaśca brahmacāritā ।
śubhā vāk sādhusevā ca paraśreyaḥpradāyakāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
trayodaśāṃ'śo dharmo'yaṃ naranārīprapālitaḥ ।
aihikaṃ sukhadaṃ śreyo dadāti śāśvataṃ hyapi ।।52।।
śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ cāgnisevanaṃ snānamityapi ।
bhikṣādanaṃ guroḥ sevā guroḥ prītyupapādanam ।।53 ।।
aihikaṃ sukhadaṃ śreyo dadāti hyapi śāśvatam ।
gurorgehe vasennityaṃ tatpatnīṃ tatsutādikam ।।54।।
devānmatvā tathā devīrmatvā saṃpūjayet sadā ।
śuśrūṣayecca nirmānā sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ।।55।।
ātmabhāvanayā sādhvī pitṛdevā'tithīnapi ।
samyaka samprīṇayed bhaktyā sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ।।56।।
sadācāraḥ sadā rakṣyo daityairdevaiśca mānavaiḥ ।
na cā''cāravihīnāyā bhadramatra paratra ca ।।57।।
yajñadānatapāṃsīha sadā bhavanti bhūtaye ।
sadācāravihīnāyā niṣphalānyeva tānyapi ।।58।।
durācārā hi vāmāṅgī neha nāmutra nandati ।
kāryāṃ yatnaḥ sadācāre sa tvabhadrasya nāśakaḥ ।।59।।
sadācārastaruścāsti nārīdehe hi vartate ।
sa cāpatyaśarīre'pi hyavātarati saukhyakṛt ।।2.26.60 ।।
dharmo mūlaṃ tarostasya hyarthaḥ śākhāḥ susampadaḥ ।
kāmaḥ puṣpāṇi ramyāṇi mokṣaḥ phalaṃ rasānvitam ।।6 1 ।।
so'yaṃ prasevito nāryā bhadrado'tra paratra ca ।
brāhme muhūrte prathamaṃ budhyedanusmareddharim ।।62।
devānṛṣīn satīścāpi vadet prabhātamaṃgalam ।
śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaścoktavān maṃgalaṃ param ।।63।।
prabhāte yat paṭhanmartyo mucyate pāpabandhanāt ।
prābhātikaṃ maṃgalaṃ tatkathayāmi nibodhata ।।64।।
śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।
etanmaṃgalaraṭanād bahavo mokṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ ।।65।।
sarvāvatārajanako'kṣarataḥ paraścā-
'nādiścakṛṣṇabhagavān parameśvaraśca ।
muktāstathā'gaṇitasṛṣṭiṣu vartamānāḥ
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।66।।
rādhāyuto'gaṇitagopasugopikābhiḥ
saṃsevito hṛdayapadmagataśca kṛṣṇaḥ ।
lakṣmīramāpatirathā'sya ca pārṣadādyāḥ
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।67।।
śrīvāsudevasahitāḥ parameśvarāśca
nārāyaṇā vividhadhāmagatāśca muktāḥ ।
māṇikyapāravatikākamalāprabhāśca
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।68।।
hairaṇyagarbhahariśaṃkarasūryacandrāḥ
pṛthvīsutaḥ śaśisuto guruśukradharmāḥ ।
ārṣāḥ śaniḥ pitara aiśagaṇeśvarāśca.
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।69।।
raibhyaśca gautamapulastyamarīcayaśca
bhṛgvaṅgiraḥpulahalomaśagālavādyāḥ ।
vāsiṣṭhabhārgavaribhucyavanādikāśca
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।2.26.70।।
śrīpārṣadāḥ sanakanandanasatkumārāḥ
saujātapiṅgalasanātananāradādyāḥ ।
indrādayo digadhipāḥ surakoṭayaśca
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।7 1 ।।
saptasvarāḥ kṣititalāśca susūkṣmabhūtāḥ
sthūlāśca tattvanikarā girivārdhayaśca ।
tīrthāni cāpagavarāśca pativratāśca
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।72।।
rukmāgado dhruvasuyajñakapuṇḍarīka
prahlādasūtaśatasuvratakā'mbarīṣāḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhadivodaśukādikāśca
kurvantu mokṣaphalakaṃ mama suprabhātam ।।73।।
itthaṃ prabhāte paramaṃ pavitraṃ śṛṇuyātpaṭhet ।
smared bhaktyā suprabhātaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।74।।
hariṃ smṛtvā dehaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā snātvā vidhānataḥ ।
tarpaṇaṃ ca tathā sandhyāṃ kuryācchrīharipūjanam ।।75।।
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ kuryād devapūjanamityapi ।
sūryāya namanaṃ kuryāt praṇamet pitarau patim ।।76 ।।
guruṃ natvā satīṃ natvā gāṃ natvā homamācaret ।
paśyet prātardadhi dūrvāṃ sarpirdhenuṃ savatsikām ।।77।।
udakuṃbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ suvarṇaṃ svastikaṃ madhu ।
gomayaṃ cā'kṣatān lājā mṛdaṃ brāhmaṇakanyakāḥ ।।78।।
śvetapuṣpāṇi sasyāni vahniṃ candanamarkakam ।
aśvatthaṃ sādhupuruṣaṃ darpaṇaṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ।।79।।
atithiṃ pūjayedbhāvāt sādhusaṅgaṃ samācaret ।
arke'bhyaṅgaṃ na vai kuryānmaṃgale kṣīrameva na ।।2.26.80।।
budhe na yoṣitaṃ gacchen patiṃ gacchenna parvaṇi ।
udakchirāḥ svapennaiva pratīcīmastako na ca ।।8 1 ।।
devālayaṃ caityataruṃ vidvāṃsaṃ ca catuṣpatham ।
guruṃ vṛddhaṃ prakuryāttu pradakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣapradam ।।82।।
anyadhṛtaṃ ca malinaṃ vastraṃ naiva hi dhārayet ।
snāyānnityaṃ grahādau ca devadānādikaṃ caret ।।83।।
satsu vasenna tvasatsu puṇyadeśeṣu saṃvaset ।
baddhavaire vasennaiva dharmahīne jane'pi ca ।।84।।
abhojyāḥ sūtikāḥ ṣaṇḍo mārjārākhū ca kukkuṭāḥ ।
patitā'paviddhanagnāścāṇḍālā adhamāśca ye ।।85।।
brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇaścāpi bhikṣukau vyabhicāriṇau ।
tāvubhau sūtiketyuktau tayorannaṃ vigarhitam ।।86।।
na juhotyucite kāle na snāti na dadāti ca ।
pitṛdevārcanāddhīnaḥ sa ṣaṇḍaḥ parigīyate ।।87।।
daṃbhārthaṃ japati yaśca tapati paṭhatītyapi ।
na paratrārthamudyukto mārjāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।।88।।
vibhave sati naivā'tti na dadāti na juhoti na ।
tamāhurākhu tasyānnaṃ bhoktavyaṃ naiva dharmiṇā ।।89।।
sabhāgatānāṃ yaḥ sabhyaḥ pakṣapātaṃ samāśrayet ।
tamāhuḥ kukkuṭaṃ tasya jalānnaṃ bahu garhitam ।।2.26.90 ।।
svadharmahāḥ paradharmagrāhakaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
devapitṛgurutyāgī goviprastrīvighātakaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
apaviddhastadannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pāpadūṣitam ।
yeṣāṃ kule na vedo'sti na kathā naiva ca vratam ।।92।।
te nagnāḥ kīrtitāsteṣāmannaṃ saṃskāradūṣitam ।
āśārttānāmadātā ca dātuśca pratiṣedhakaḥ ।।93 ।।
śaraṇāgatasantyaktā sa cāṇḍālo'dhamo janaḥ ।
teṣāmannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ doṣabhāganyathā bhavet ।।94।।
yaccāpi kurvato nātmā jugupsāmeti sarvathā ।
tatkartavyamaśaṃkena yat syāt kalyāṇadaṃ param ।।95।।
evamācāravatyāśca satyā gṛhe vane'pi vā ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣā vai bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।96 ।।
bhūmau śayyā brahmacaryaṃ tapobhiścātmadarśanam ।
sarvasaṃgaparityāgaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ sadā ।।97।।
sarvārpaṇaṃ harau kṛṣṇe gurau sarvāntarātmani ।
yayā kṛtaṃ na lipyeta dehajaiḥ karmabhiḥ kvacit ।।98।।
bhavatyaḥ sarvathā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
bālarūpaṃ prasevantām paro mokṣo bhaviṣyati ।।99।।
atra cātmaniveditvaṃ kṛtaṃ yayā tu yoṣitā ।
tasyā dhāmni parā muktirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.26.10 0।।
nidrāyāṃ jāgrati svapne sthūle sūkṣme hṛdantare ।
rājase tāmase satvabhāve smarantu mādhavam ।। 101 ।।
ātmanā cendriyairvāpi dehena sevayā harim ।
antaḥkaraṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ prasādayantu taṃ patim ।। 1 02।।
ityuktāstāśca jagṛhurnāmamantraṃ hi lomaśāt ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।। 1 03।।
ityasya raṭaṇaṃ cakrurdivārātramatandritāḥ ।
śataṃ tā divyatāṃ prāptāḥ satataṃ japakāraṇāt ।। 1 04।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bālo vimānagaḥ ।
śatena tu vimānānāṃ sahitaḥ samupāyayau ।। 1 05।।
tāḥ samārohayāmāsa vimānāgryeṣu mādhavaḥ ।
nināya tāḥ paraṃdhāmā'kṣarādapyuttaraṃ hi yat ।। 1 06।।
atha yāḥ kanyakāstāstu gṛhītvā lomaśād guroḥ ।
upadeśaṃ ca taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālaṃ matvā patiṃ nijam ।। 1 07।।
bhejustatraiva kanyāsu sthitvā sahasraśastadā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bālakṛṣṇaṃ labhet satī ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrāvaṇyāṃ sarasastaṭe yajñasūtrotsave sālamālavaṃśīyadaityānāmāgamanaṃ yuddhaṃ prabhuṇā teṣāṃ nāśo mokṣadharmā lomaśopadiṣṭāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 26 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 026 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 27
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 028 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu vai rādhike devā daityā dānavakoṭayaḥ ।
mānavāḥ ṛṣayaḥ santo hareḥ putrāḥ samānakāḥ ।। 1 ।।
nā'priyo na priyaḥ kaścittasya bhavati rādhike ।
bhaktaḥ priyo na tvabhakto bhaktipriyo hi mādhavaḥ ।। 2 ।।
ātmano nā'surā devā daityā vā mānavāḥ priye ।
svabhāvā guṇajā daityā devā'suśca mānavāḥ ।। 3 ।।
svabhāvāścāgamāpāyāḥ prayojanavaśānugāḥ ।
prayojanaṃ sukhaṃ tacca dehajātyanusāragam ।। 4 ।।
deho nārī naraśceti ṣaṇḍhaśceti tridhā mataḥ ।
bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca gṛhī tyāgī vratī vanī ।। 5 ।।
kriyā dehānukūlā ca vāñcchā dehānusāriṇī ।
bālye krīḍati vārdhakye śamaṃ yāti yuvā tu na ।। 6 ।।
nārī narāśrayā sarvā naraḥ svātantryayantritaḥ ।
brāhmaṇo bhikṣukaḥ kṣattraṃ prasahya balavat sadā ।। 7 ।।
śvādau sahanatā nityā sarpe sā naiva vidyate ।
vṛkṣe paropakāraśca vānare svārtha eva ca ।। 8 ।।
sādhau dayā dhanāḍhye tu garvo raṃke tu namratā ।
mātari vatsalo bhāvaḥ śatrau nirdayatā sthitā ।। 9 ।।
caure nirghṛṇatā vidyāvati vicāryakāritā ।
lajjā yuvatīvarge ca bālāyāṃ doṣahīnatā ।। 2.27.1 0।।
digambaratvaṃ vairāgye sarāge navavastritā ।
vyomavad vidyate cātmā dehaḥ sandhyā divā niśā ।। 1 1।।
āyānti ca viyantyasya guṇavegāḥ prayojanāt। ।
tadguṇā māyikī māyā jaḍā karmamayī sadā ।। 12।।
sā na cātmani saṃlagnā nātmā tatra ca janmitaḥ ।
dvayoḥ panthā vibhinno'sti nityabaddhā'timuktayoḥ ।। 13।।
ityevaṃ rādhike jñātvā pumānnaiva vilupyate ।
ajñāne jāyate rāgo dveṣaścetyubhadūṣaṇe ।। 14।।
rāgādbhavati pravṛttirvāsanāpracurā dṛḍhā ।
dveṣānnivartate yadvā pravartate'tidāruṇam ।। 15।।
aniṣṭaṃ vahate ceṣṭacchannaṃ cāsurabhāvanam ।
ta ete daityadehāśca viyanti paramātmanaḥ ।। 16 ।।
abhiyanti yadā te ca surā bhavanti daivinaḥ ।
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyasaṃyamaḥ ।। 17।।
dānaṃ dayā ca kṣāntiśca brahmacaryamamānitā ।
śubhā satyā ca madhurā vāṅ nityaṃ sakriyāratiḥ ।। 18।।
sadācāraniṣevitvaṃ dharmā daivatvadāyakāḥ ।
sukeśyabhūt purā daityo lomaśasyā''śramaṃ gataḥ ।। 1 9।।
dharmān papraccha kuśalān śrutvā caitān trayodaśa ।
lomaśāttu maharṣeḥ sa yayau naijaṃ puraṃ tataḥ ।।2.27.20।।
samāhūyā'bravīt sarvān rākṣasān dhārmikaṃ vacaḥ ।
ahiṃsādyānmahādharmān pālayantu sadā'surāḥ ।।21।।
so'hamājñāpaye sarvān kriyatāmavikalpitam ।
tataḥ sukeśivacanāt sarva eva niśācarāḥ ।।22।।
trayodaśāṃśato dharmaṃ cakrarmuditamānasāḥ ।
tataḥ pravṛddhiṃ sutarāmagacchaँste niśācarāḥ ।।23 ।।
prāsādavāṭikākṣetrodyānayānamaharddhayaḥ ।
putrapautrārthasaṃyuktā hyabhavan sukhasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।24।।
niśācarāṇāṃ nagaraṃ tejomayaṃ hyabhūttu khe ।
yatra sūryasya candrasya tejo''pekṣā na cā'bhavat ।।25।।
tatastu tejasā teṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām ।
gantuṃ nā'śaknuvan sūryā nakṣatrāṇi ca candramāḥ ।।26।।
evaṃ dharmaprabhāvo'sti rādhike tejasorjitaḥ ।
tatastribhuvane dīptaṃ niśācarapuraṃ hyabhūt ।।27।।
divā sūryasya sadṛśaṃ rātrau candrasamaṃ hyabhūt ।
yatra sūryasya candrasya tejo'pekṣā na vidyate ।।28।।
pratyuta tatpureṇaiva pṛthvyāṃ sarvagraheṣu ca ।
divasaḥ sarvadā cāste tejovaibhavakāraṇāt ।।29।।
na jñāyate gatirvyomni bhāskarasya tato'mbare ।
candrasyāpi gatirnaiva jñāyate'nyagatiḥ kutaḥ ।।2.27.3 0।।
kauśikādyāstu mumuhurvinā rātriṃ niśācarāḥ ।
gṛhasthā duḥkhamāpannāḥ strīdharmā rātrimantarā ।।3 1 ।।
tarkayanti tadā kecinnūnaṃ rātrau suduḥkhitā ।
patiyogaṃ vinā kāntā satī pativratā sakhī ।।32।।
paradeśagate kānte viyogaduḥkhitā hi sā ।
tapasā sūryāstamanaṃ rurodha yāvatā bhavet ।।33।।
priyasya darśanaṃ yogastāvatā''yānna vai niśā ।
yajvāno homaśālāsu sahartvigbhirathā'dhvare ।।34।।
prāvartayanta karmāṇi rātrāvapi ca rādhike ।
mahābhāgavatāḥ pūjāṃ viṣṇoḥ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ ।।35।।
raveḥ śaśinaścāpyanye brahmaṇo'nye harasya ca ।
kurvanti pūjanaṃ matvā divā rātrāvapi prajāḥ ।।36।।
vivekinastu jānanti vikasitairhi paṅkajaiḥ ।
sūryasyodayanaṃ candrodaye tu kumudotkacaiḥ ।।37।।।
evaṃ pratāpamāpanne niśācarapure vṛṣaiḥ ।
sūryastvasahamānastat tadvighātamacintayat ।। 38।
sa bhānunā tadā dṛṣṭaḥ krodhādhmātena cakṣuṣā ।
sukeśī grāmasahitaḥ prajajvāla tadā'mbare ।।3 9।
sūryaścakraṃ ca sauraṃ svaṃ mumocā'smai drutaṃ ca tat ।
cakraṃ vai bhedayāmāsa puraṃ niśācarasya tat ।।2.27.40।
nipapātā'mbarād bhraṣṭaṃ keśinā saha rākṣasaiḥ ।
sukeśī śaṃbhave nama idamuccairudairayat ।।41।
tadākranditamākarṇya kailāse śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
jñātvā dhyānena sūryeṇa pātitaṃ bhaktapattanam ।।42।
kruddhastṛtīyanetreṇa sūryaṃ śaṃbhurapaśyata ।
sūryo vyomnaḥ paribhraṣṭo nipapāta bhuvastalam ।।43।
yogiśāyinamārabhya yāvatkeśavadarśanam ।
prayāgāt keśavaṃ yāvat vistṛtaṃ bhūtalaṃ śubham ।।44।।
etat kṣetraṃ hareḥ puṇyaṃ nāmnā vārāṇasī purī ।
varaṇāyāstathaivā'syāstvantare nipapāta saḥ ।।45।।।
bhānurdahan kṣaṇaṃ cāsyāṃ lulan hrade tataḥ punaḥ ।
varaṇāyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ lulan lolārkanāmavān ।।46।।
abhavaccā'tha sūryaḥ sa kṣamāṃ harādayācata ।
haro'pi bhānumādāya pāṇinā''ropayad ratham ।।47।।
sukeśinaṃ puraṃ cāpyāropayad diviṃ daivavat ।
evaṃ dharmeṇa balavān jāyate rākṣaso'pi hi ।।48।।
śaṃbhuryasya sahāyo'bhūt sūryo'vāpa ruṣaḥ phalam ।
evaṃ vai lomaśo daityakanyābhyastu vṛṣān śubhān ।।49।।
prāha śreyaskarān tāśca punaḥ papracchurādarāt ।
kasya pūjā kathaṃ kāryā vada no gururāṭ prabho ।।2.27.50।।
lomaśastāḥ samuvāca nārāyaṇaḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ ।
āṣāḍhaikādaśīprātarbhogibhoge svapityataḥ ।।51 ।।
śeṣā'hibhogaparyaṃkaṃ kṛtvā sampūjya keśavam ।
prāsvāpayedanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṣaṇam ।।52।।
trayodaśyāṃ svapityaiva kāmaḥ svaśayane śubhe ।
kadambānāṃ sugandhānāṃ kusumaiḥ parikalpite ।।53।।
tatra tadā suśṛṃgāraiḥ kāmaḥ prītiratiprabhuḥ ।
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇamūrtau sukhapradaḥ ।।54।।
caturdaśyāṃ tato yakṣāḥ svapanti sukhaśītale ।
sauvarṇapaṅkajakṛte sukhāstīrṇopadhānake ।।55।।
yakṣeśo yakṣayuktaśca maṇibhadrādibhiryutaḥ ।
pūjanīyo'nnapānādyaistarpaṇīyo viśeṣataḥ ।।।56।।
pūrṇamāsyā svapityumānāthaḥ svacarmasaṃstare ।
vaiyāghre ca jaṭābhāraṃ samudgrathyā'nyacarmaṇā ।।57।।
śaṃbhustatrā'rcanīyaśca dhattūrasya sumādibhiḥ ।
tato divākaro rāśiṃ samprayāti tu karkaṭam ।।58।।
tenāmarāṇāṃ rajanī bhavate dakṣiṇāyanam ।
brahmā tataḥ pratipadi nīlotpalamaye priye ।।59।।
talpe svapiti lokānāṃ śubhacintanakāmyayā ।
viśvakarmā dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu pārvatī ।।2.27.60 ।।
vināyakaścaturthyāṃ ca pañcamyāmapi dharmarāṭ ।
ṣaṣṭyāṃ skandaḥ prasvapiti saptamyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ ।।6 1 ।।
kātyāyanī tathā'ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ kamalālayā ।
daśamyāṃ bhujagendrāśca svapanti vāyubhojanāḥ ।।62।।
ekādaśyāṃ tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ sādhyā devāḥ svapanti ca ।
tattattithau tatsurāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ prācaret satī ।।63।।
tena śreyaḥ sarvavidhaṃ tvānuyād vratinī satī ।
dvitīyāyāṃ prasvapiti viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ ।।64।।
tasya mūrtirvidhātavyā yadā lakṣmyā yuto hariḥ ।
sauvarṇasya vidhātavyaḥ śrīvatsāṃkaścaturbhujaḥ ।।65।।
paryake taṃ samaṃ lakṣmyā gandhapuṣpādibhiryute ।
śayyāyāṃ pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ prakṣipet satphalāni ca ।।66।।
surabhīṇi nivedyetthaṃ prārthayet śrīyutaṃ harim ।
aśūnyaśayane nātha yathā tvaṃ rājase śriyā ।।67।।
tathā cā'śūnyaśayanaṃ rakṣa me sarvadā'stu ca ।
lakṣmyā yuktaṃ śayanaṃ te yathā śūnyaṃ kadāpi na ।।68।।
tathā mamāpi bhagavān gārhasthyaṃ mā'stu śūnyakam ।
lakṣmīdharaḥ prasanno'stvityuccārya vratamācaret ।।69।।
cāturmāsye prabhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam ।
lakṣmīdharaḥ prīyatāṃ me ityuccārya dvijātaye ।।2.27.70।।
phalaṃ svarṇaṃ vastraśayyāṃ gāṃ dānaṃ vitared vratī ।
vratinastena puṇyena gārhasthyaṃ modate sukham ।।71 ।।
ravirāṣāḍhamāsādya mithunā'bhimukho bhavet ।
tata ārabhya yāvatsa vṛścikastho vibhāti hi ।।72।।
cāturmāsyaṃ cāntare vai kāle bodhya vratārthinā ।
surāstato vibudhyante kramaśastatra rādhike ।।73।।
tulāsthe ca ravau pūrvaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prabudhyate ।
tasya pūjā prakartavyā mahādānārpaṇādibhiḥ ।।74।।
kāmadevastatra tataḥ prabudhyate tamarcayet ।
dvitīyāyāṃ suvarṇasya mūrtirlakṣmīdharasya tu ।।75।।
śayyā cāstaraṇopetā yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ ।
dātavyaitadvratenā'tra dampatyorna viyogitā ।।76 ।।
atha bhādrapade kṛṣṇāṣṭamī kālāṣṭamī matā ।
yuktā mṛgaśireṇā'syāṃ liṃge svapiti śaṃkaraḥ ।।।77।।
gomūtreṇa jalenā'pi snāyāt saṃsnāpayecchivam ।
tataḥ sampūjayetpuṣpairdhattūrasya ca candanaiḥ ।।78।।
dhūpaṃ kesaraniryāsaṃ naivedyaṃ madhusarpiṣī ।
prīyatāṃ me virūpākṣastviti kuryāttadarthanām ।।79।।
āśvine snāpayet snāyād gomayenā'tha pūjanam ।
paṃkajairdhūpayet sarjaniryāsairmadhumodakān ।।2.27.80।।
bhojayet prīyatāṃ hiraṇyākṣo me ceti cārthayet ।
kārtike payasā snānaṃ karavīreṇa cārcanam ।।8 1 ।।
dhūpaṃ śrīvāsaniryāsaṃ naivedyaṃ madhupāyasam ।
prīyatāṃ sthāṇuruccārya deyaṃ rajatadānakam ।।82।।
mārgaśire dadhisnānaṃ naivedyaṃ madhunaudanam ।
dhūpaṃ śrīvṛkṣaniryāsaṃ prīyatāṃ śarva ārthayet ।।83।।
pauṣe snānaṃ tu haviṣāṃ pūjā bilvaistathā phalaiḥ ।
dhūpo madhukaniryāso naivedyaṃ madhusaktukaiḥ ।।84।।
prīyatāṃ tryambaka ityabhyarthayenmudrikāṃ dadet ।
māghe kuśodakasnānaṃ kumudena śivārcanam ।।85।।
dhūpaḥ kadambaniryāso naivedyaṃ satilaudanam ।
prīyatāṃ me mahādeva ityabhiprārthayennamaḥ ।।86 ।।
evaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ caitadvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ sadā ।
atha ca phālgune pañcagavyasnānaṃ prakārayet ।।87।।
pūjayet kundakusumairdhūpayeccandanena ca ।
naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadyāttāmrapātre guḍaudanam ।।88।।
prīyatāṃ rudra me procya vastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet ।
caitre caudumbarajalaiḥ snānaṃ mandārakārcanam ।।89।।
dhūpaṃ ca guggulakṛtaṃ modakān vinivedayet ।
mṛgacarmapradānaṃ prīyatāṃ nāgeśvaro mama ।।2.27.90।।
vaiśākhe gandhakusumaiḥ snānaṃ pūjā''bhrapuṣpakaiḥ ।
dhūpaḥ sarjasya niryāso naivedyaṃ saphalaṃ ghṛtam ।।9 1।।
śālaghnaḥ prīyatāṃ ceti jalakuṃbhapradānakam ।
jyeṣṭhe snānaṃ cāmalakaiḥ pūjā'rkakusumaistathā ।।92।।
dadhisaktūbhojanaṃ ca chatropānatpradānakam ।
dhūpaṃ tu cāndanaṃ bhaganetraghnaḥ prīyatāṃ mama ।। 93।।
āṣāḍhe śrīphalaiḥ snānamarcanaṃ kānakaiḥ sumaiḥ ।
dhūpayet। sallikayā ca pūpā naivedyamuttamam ।।94।।
prīyatāṃ dakṣayajñaghno dānaṃ yavakaṇādikam ।
śrāvaṇe bhṛṃgarājena snānaṃ śrīdrudalārcanam ।।95 ।।
agurudhūpanaṃ naivedyaṃ dadhi modakāstathā ।
svarṇagovastradānaṃ me gaṃgādharaḥ prasīdatu ।।96।।
ebhiḥ ṣaḍabhistathā māsaiḥ pūjana vratapuṣṭidam ।
navamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ ।।97।।
dvādaśakṛṣṇapakṣīyā'ṣṭamyupavāsanaṃ sadā ।
tata udyāpanaṃ kuryānmaheśvaravaco yathā ।।98।।
akṣayaṃ labhate saukhyaṃ dampatī puṇyakavratāt ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣakṛt tattathā na tadanyathā ।।99।।
padmaṃ prajāpaternābhyā niryātaṃ cāśvine yataḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ pūjane padmaṃ deyaṃ prītivivardhanam ।। 2.27.1 00।।
kāmakare kadambaśca yakṣakare vaṭadrumaḥ ।
dhattūraśca śivahṛdi vedhomadhyāddhi khādiraḥ ।। 10 1।।
viśvakarmamadhyadehāt kaṇṭakī samajāyata ।
girijāyāḥ karatale kundagulmastvajāyata ।। 1 02।।
gaṇādhipasya kuṃbhastho rājate sinduvārakaḥ ।
yamasya dakṣiṇe pārśve pālāśo vai vyajāyata ।। 103 ।।
yamasya dakṣiṇottare jātaḥ kṛṣṇa udumbaraḥ ।
skandasya bandhujīvaśca raveraśvattha eva ca ।। 1 04।।
kātyāyanyāḥ śamī jātā bilvo lakṣmyāḥ kare'bhavat ।
nāgamukhe śarastambā dūrvā vāsukipṛṣṭhake ।। 1 05।।
sādhyahṛdi candanaśca vyajāyata ca rādhike ।
kalpāntarakathā ceyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau samajāyata ।। 1 06।।
taiḥ pūjane tatsurāṇāṃ prītiḥ sarvā'dhikā bhavet ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca dīyante taiḥ prasāditaiḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne daityanārīṇāṃ dharmopadeśe sukeśisamākhyānam, aśūnyaśayanavrataśivapuṇyakavratādi, devānāṃ bhinnatithiṣu svāpāḥ, pūjā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśati-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 27 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 027 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 28
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 029 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evaṃ vai rādhike daityakanyābhyo lomaśo muniḥ ।
upādideśa ca vṛṣān vratāni vividhāni ca ।। 1 !।
tāśca cakrurvṛṣācārān vratācaraṇamityapi ।
aśūnyaśayanaṃ cāpi cāturmāsyavratāni ca ।। 2 ।।
vatsarīyaṃ śivakālāṣṭamīvrataṃ ca puṇyakam ।
cakruḥ śrīgurusevāṃ ca bhejuḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 3 ।।
bhūtvā pāvanadehāśca pāvanātmāna ityapi ।
vimānaiḥ pārṣadavarairvāhitairdhāma cākṣaram ।। 4 ।।
gatvā dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāścāyayurlomaśāśramam ।
prapūjya kanyakāḥ sarvā lomaśaṃ ca guruṃ hareḥ ।। 5 ।।
jñātvā pūrṇaṃ mahimānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
paraṃ kāntaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ bhejustaṃ patimīśvaram ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ tu vatsare yāte tṛtīye sumahotsave ।
caturthavarṣārambhe ca kṛtajanmamahotsave ।। 7 ।।
pitā subhojayāmāsa koṭiśo dehinastadā ।
dānāni dāpayāmāsa ratnasauvarṇajāni ca ।। 8 ।।
tatrā'bhūdekamāścaryaṃ rādhe śṛṇu vadāmi te ।
pātālānnāgadehaśca tathā mānavamastakaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛtahastāñjalirnāgastālamāno'tiduḥkhitaḥ ।
svastikākhyo rudan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamīpataḥ ।। 2.28.1 0।।
trāhi trāhītyarthayaṃścāyayau kuṭumbaśūnyakaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāste gajāsane ।। 11 ।।
tatrāgatya ca patitaḥ pādayoḥ śrīharermuhuḥ ।
uvāca bhagavaँstrāhi māṃ nāgaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 12।।
tvāṃ vinā rakṣako me na vidyate bhuvanatraye ।
śrīhariḥ prāha kiṃ duḥkhaṃ tvāgataṃ te nirūpaya ।। 13 ।।
nāgaḥ sarveṣu śṛṇvatsūtsave samāgateṣu ca ।
varṇayāmāsa duḥkhaṃ svaṃ pātāle yuddhajaṃ yathā ।। 14।।
pātāle bhagavannāgā vasanti bahujātayaḥ ।
śeṣasya jātimanto ye te rājāno bhavanti ca ।। 15।।
vāsukerjātimantaśca mantriṇaste bhavanti ca ।
takṣakasya ca jātīyā rājamānyā hi nāgarāḥ ।। 16।।
ahaṃ svastikajātīyo brāhmaṇo'smi gurukriyaḥ ।
dhṛtarāṣṭrāḥ kṣatriyāste karkoṭakā bhaṭakriyāḥ ।। 17।।
kuhakasya tu jātīyā vyāpāriṇo bhavanti ca ।
suṣeṇasya tu jātīyāḥ śākādikṛṣikāriṇaḥ ।। 18।।
hāritā vanavāsāścāraṇyarakṣākarā hi te ।
kārburakāḥ sadā dāsyaṃ kurvanti rājamaṇḍale ।। 1 9।।
kṛṣṇajātīyanāgāśca sainyādhipatyabhoginaḥ ।
puṇḍīkāstathā nāgā bhavanti vāṭikākarāḥ ।।2.28.20।।
ambarīṣāḥ sūtakāryakarā vāhanarakṣiṇaḥ ।
godhūmīyāśca te nāgāścāraṇā vaṃśabodhakāḥ ।।21।।
bhadrajātīyanāgāśca paṇḍitā brāhmaṇā ime ।
vācayanti kathākāṇḍān bālānadhyāpayanti ca ।।22।।
kumudā bhogino dāsā bhavanti pāravaśyagāḥ ।
piśaṃgāḥ sūdakarmāṇo bhṛtyā bhavanti sarvathā ।।23।।
keśīyā nāṭyakuśalāḥ śailūṣā nṛtyakāriṇaḥ ।
āmṛtikā gītikārā ḍāṃḍikā vṛddhasammatāḥ ।।24।।
bhūphālāstu samudyānakarāḥ śukāḥ kathārthinaḥ ।
kapardajātīyakāste grāmaśuddhikarāḥ sadāḥ ।।25।।
evamanye bahusaṃjñā bhavanti tatra vāsinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ rājā vartate'dya nāmnā kāraṇḍavo mahān ।।26।।
mantrī tasya sumadhvākhyo vidyate sarpamaṇḍale ।
mānyaḥ pūjyo buddhimāṃśca mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। 2 7।।
anyāyī svārthamātre'pi parārthakṛddhi vartate ।
prajānāṃ hitakartā'sti śaraṇāgatamānakṛt ।।28 ।।
ataḥ prajāstu ta samyaṅmānayanti yathā nṛpam ।
rājā mahotsavaṃ tatra hāṭakeśvaraśūlinaḥ ।।29।।
karoti śrāvaṇe māsi bilvādibhiḥ prapūjanam ।
dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ dadāti dvijatṛptaye ।। 2.28.3 0।।
asmin varṣe sumadhunā mantriṇā tannṛpasya vai ।
āhūtā brāhmaṇāstatra śatarudrīyajāpane ।। 31 ।।
sahasraśo'bhavaँstatra jāpakāḥ pāṭhakāstathā ।
pūjakā homakartārastatrā'haṃ jāpako'bhavam ।।32।।
mama putrāḥ śataṃ santi kanyakā viṃśatistathā ।
te ca tatra pāṭhakāścā'bhavan mantrikṛpāvaśāt ।।33 ।।
kanyakā brāhmaṇaputryaścāyānti yānti nityaśaḥ ।
hāṭakeśasya pūjārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ viyanti ca ।। 34।।
mama viṃśatikanyāśca surūpāḥ prāptayauvanāḥ ।
ekagarbhaprasūtāśca sarvā urvaśīrūpitāḥ ।। 35।।
vilokitāḥ sumadhunā sarvāvayavaśobhanāḥ ।
rūpe campakavarṇābhāḥ śrītulyādīrghalocanāḥ ।।36।।
piṃganetrāśca śirasaḥ paritaḥ kāntimaṇḍalāḥ ।
pāradṛśyā'cchadehāśca tejomaṇinakhānvitāḥ ।। 37।।
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarvāstanumadhyāḥ sukeśikāḥ ।
vahnivastradharā miṣṭakaṇṭhā mādhuryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।38।।
sugandhapūrṇadehāśca pavitrā dvijakanyakāḥ ।
padminīlakṣaṇāḥ sarvā vilokya sumadhuśca mām ।। 39।।
provācā''hūya nilayaṃ dehi viṃśatikanyakāḥ ।
mama yogyā rājayogyā bhavantyetāḥ pradehi me ।।2.28.40।।
mayā vicārya tu tadā prokto mantrivaraḥ prabho ।
kanyakā me yadīccheyurdāsyāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।41 ।।
tāsāṃ mānasamiṣṭaṃ yat kartavyaṃ tanmayā sadā ।
tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā sarvāstanmātrā cāpi bodhitāḥ ।।42।।
varayogyā bhavatyo vai vadantvicchanti kaṃ varam ।
tāḥ prāhurvai śrutaṃ tāta mātarmānavabhūtale ।।43 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvapatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
vartate śrīkambharāyā gṛhe gopālabālakaḥ ।।44।।
rūparūpānuvayavaścātikāntamanoharaḥ ।
śrutaṃ cāsmābhiratraiva sakhībhya sarvathā hi saḥ ।।45।।
varayogyo'si bhagavān śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
anyā api ca nāgānāṃ kanyakāstaṃ pareśvaram ।।46।।
vivāhena patiṃ kartuṃ samicchanti sahasraśaḥ ।
tato vayaṃ śeṣapatiṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīdharaṃ vinā ।।47।।
nānyaṃ varitumicchāmo yadi naḥ śreya icchasi ।
ityuktaḥ kanyakābhiśca svastiko'haṃ ca tatpitā ।। 48।।।
mantriṇe coktavān kanyābhiprāyaṃ mantrirāṭ tataḥ ।
kruddhā''ha māṃ pituḥ kanyāstvadhīnā na svatantrikāḥ ।।49।।
tvaṃ dehi me vadāmyevaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpsyase ।
no ced duḥkhaṃ bhavette'tra sarvasvaṃ te hṛtaṃ bhavet ।।2.28.50 ।।
yadvā rākṣasavidhinā hariṣye tava kanyakāḥ ।
tato namratayā kanyāścānusarantu māṃ tava ।।51 ।।
vada tā yadi necchanti śvo hariṣye śubhe dine ।
ityuktavānahaṃ paścāt punastā mama kanyakāḥ ।। 52।।
akathayaṃ ca tatsarva tathāpi tā na menire ।
tato'haṃ gatavān bhūpaṃ pratyanivedayaṃ ca tat ।।53 ।।
bhūpo'pi tatpakṣapātītallābhaṃ prajagāda me ।
dehi tvaṃ kanyakāstasmai mantriṇe prasukhī bhava ।।54।।
mama śrutaṃ na vai rājñā me'numodanamāhitam ।
mayā śrutvā punaḥ sarvaṃ kanyakābhyo niveditam ।।55।।
tāḥ prāhuḥ sapratijñaṃ vai varayāmo hariṃ prabhum ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ।।56।।
anyathā maraṇaṃ tāta cāśrayāmastathaiva tat ।
mayā niveditaṃ tattu jñātivargāya sarvathā ।।57।।
jñātijanaiścāpi tathā dehīti cānumoditam ।
na rājñā tajjanenāpi virodhaḥ śreyasāṃ padam ।।58।।
tasmād deyā mantriṇe vai kanyakā vighnanāśanam ।
athā'haṃ prāvadaṃ sarvaṃ mama patnyai tadā tu sā ।।5 9 ।।
provāca māṃ na vai deyā mantriṇe kuṣṭhine tvayā ।
yad bhavet tad bhavatveva na deyāḥ kuṣṭhine pate ।।2.28.6 0 ।।
mayoktaṃ sa kathaṃ kuṣṭhī jñāyate tu tvayā priye ।
priyā provāca māṃ dāsī tasya nāmnā karaṇṭikā ।।6 1 ।।
sumadhoḥ sevikā bhṛtyā tasya sevāṃ karoti yā ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ snānaṃ tailamardanakādikam ।।62।।
karoti nityaśo mantrivaryaṃ paśyati sā rahaḥ ।
taccharīre guptabhāge vartante raktakuṣṭhakāḥ ।।63 ।।
rogavārtāpralāpe sā mantrikuṣṭhānavarṇayat ।
tato na kanyakā deyāstasmai vai kuṣṭhimantriṇe ।।64।।
ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ bhāvikaṣṭaśucaṃ gatā ।
svastiko'haṃ śokamāpto vaiparītyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।65।।
sahitavyaṃ ca tatkaṣṭaṃ daivāccet samupāgatam ।
daivaṃ tu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।66।।
yasmāccāyaṃ hāṭakeśaḥ samutpannaḥ sa cā'vatu ।
evaṃ vicārya cā'haṃ vai dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya ca ।।67।।
gṛhaṃ gato'pi nidrāṃ na lebhe na strīrna kanyakāḥ ।
prātarjātaṃ tadā mantribhaṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ।।68।।
viṃśatikanyakāḥ sarvā mantriṇā vāñchitā yataḥ ।
ārohantu rathān divyān udvāhārthaṃ hi mantriṇā ।।69।।
ityevaṃ rājavacasā mantrivākyena vai vayam ।
rājabhaṭāḥ kathayāmo'nyathā neṣyāma āgrahāt ।।2.28.70।।
kanyāḥ pitā ca mātā ca putrā dīnajanā yataḥ ।
ruruduśca punaryoddhuṃ kṛtādarāstadā'bhavan ।।7 1 ।।
praharaṃ tatra yuddhena bhaṭaiḥ sarvairdhṛtā vayam ।
pāśitāḥ kanyakāḥ putrā nītvā kārāgrahe dhṛtāḥ ।।72।।
mocito'haṃ mama patnyā sahito bhādramāsi vai ।
kanyā necchanti varituṃ kārāgrahe vasanti tāḥ ।।73।।
trāhi vai bhagavan patnyā preṣito'tra samāgataḥ ।
tvadarthaṃ kṛtajīvāstāḥ samuddhāraya keśava ।।74।।
ityukto bālakṛṣṇastaṃ cābhayaṃ pradadau hasan ।
prasasmāra ca garuḍaṃ bhayānakasudarśanam ।।75।।
tāvubhau drāk samāyātau koṭisūryasamakramau ।
ājñāpitau yayatuśca nītvā svastikameva tam ।।76।।
pātālaṃ yatra te sarpāḥ kṛtarājyā vasanti ca ।
garuḍaḥ prāha rājānaṃ nyāyaṃ karotu sarparāṭ ।।77।।
prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ mantriṇā dharmaviplavaḥ ।
kṛto rājan viprakanyāḥ prayaccha svastikāya vai ।।78।।
sāmnā sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ vairaṃ durantameva yat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena bhūtalādiha ।।79।।
preṣitaścāgato'smyatra garuḍaḥ sarpabhakṣakaḥ ।
nārāyaṇena me dattaṃ prāyudhaṃ vai sudarśanam ।।2.28.80।।
yadi no muñcasi kanyā yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha ।
ityevaṃ bodhito rājā kāraṇḍavo ruṣā jvalan ।।8 1 ।।
mantriṇaṃ ca samāhūya yuddhārthaṃ tatparo'bhavat ।
śeṣā vāsukayaścāpi takṣakāḥ kuhakāstathā ।।82।।
dhṛtarāṣṭrāḥ suṣeṇāśca hāritāḥ karburādikaḥ ।
kṛṣṇāśca puṇḍarīkāścā'mbarīṣā bhadrakāstathā ।।83 ।।
kumudāśca piśaṃgāśca keśīyāścāmṛtāstathā ।
śailūṣāśca kapardāśca bhūphālā ḍāṇḍikāḥ śukāḥ ।।84।।
ete'nye nṛpatervākyāt sainyānyādāya saṃgaram ।
kartuṃ samāyayuḥ sarve mṛdhe śastrāstrahetibhiḥ ।।85।।
jñātvā tu pakṣiṇaṃ svalpaṃ cakraṃ svalpabalaṃ tadā ।
kintu śrīgaruḍastatra sasmāra parameśvaram ।।86।।
rūpaṃ dadhāra vipulaṃ digantavyāptimattadā ।
pakṣābhyāṃ sarvapātālaṃ cacchāda picchakairatha ।।87।।
dehenāpūrayad vyoma padbhyāṃ pātālakaṃ talam ।
cañcvā nakhābhyāṃ pakṣaiśca saṃhāramakarottadā ।।88 ।।
yuddhārambhaṃ prakartṝṇāṃ nāgānāṃ hetighātinām ।
cañcvā rājā dhṛtastūrṇaṃ bhakṣito mantriṇā saha ।।89।।
sainyāni ghātitānyasya tīkṣṇatuṇḍena pakṣiṇā ।
tīkṣṇanakhaistathā pakṣairghātitānyapi lakṣaśaḥ ।।2.28.90।।
anye pradudruvuḥ pāre kṣīrodasya taṭasya vai ।
śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsuranantasaṃjñakaṃ mṛdham ।।91।।
śeṣastatra samāyāto dṛṣṭavān garuḍaṃ tathā ।
sudarśanaṃ vilokyeva neme paramabhāvataḥ ।।92।।
sarpānnivārayāmāsa yoddhṝn tathāpi te yadā ।
na nyavartanta vai cakraṃ mumoca garuḍo mṛdhe ।।93।।
prajajvāla ca pātālaṃ sarvasarpakulānyapi ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt sammardo'bhūnmahāँstadā ।।94।।
śeṣastuṣṭāva taccakraṃ garuḍaṃ cātibhāvataḥ ।
garuḍena kṛtaṃ śāntaṃ cakraṃ śeṣasya tuṣṭaye ।। 15।।
samarpyā'nantaśeṣāya pātālarājyamityapi ।
svastike tanmantripadaṃ sannyasya garuḍastataḥ ।।96।।
svastikasya sutān putrīrmocayāmāsa bandhanāt ।
śeṣasvastikagaruḍāścakraṃ sasmarurīśvaram ।। 97।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ।
tāvat kiśorarūpo'yaṃ bhūtvā śrībhagavān hariḥ ।।98।।
brāhmaṃ gajaṃ samāruhya pātāle cājagāma ha ।
svāgataṃ kṛtavantaste bhaktāḥ kṛṣṇasya vai tataḥ ।।99।।
hariṇā tilakaṃ tatrā'nantaśeṣakapālake ।
kṛtaṃ pātālarājyābhiṣecanaṃ tasya sarvathā ।। 2.28.1 00।।
mantriṇā svastikenāpi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai ।
arpitāḥ kanyakāḥ svasya mudā viṃśatisaṃkhyikāḥ ।। 10 1।।
cakraṃ ca garuḍaṃ nītvā gajasthāḥ kanyakāstadā ।
nītvā śrībhagavān śīghraṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasarovaram ।। 1 02।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ yogataḥ prasamāyayau ।
snāpayitvā kanyakāstu cā'śvapaṭṭasarovare ।। 103 ।।
lomaśasyā''śrame sthātuṃ samādideśa taṃ munim ।
tābhyo mantrān dadau mālā lomaśaścāśrame tathā 1 04।।
rarakṣa garuḍaścājñāmāpya vaikuṇṭhakaṃ yayau ।
cakraṃ śāntaṃ harerhaste kanyāstasthustathāśrame ।। 1 09।।
evaṃ śrībhagavāँścakre camatkāraṃ hi rādhike ।
caturthavatsarārambhe divyasadguṇaśevadhiḥ ।। 1 06।
atha pātālake tatra śeṣapatnī sunandinī ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prasasmāra kārtike darśanāya vai ।। 1 07।।
śrīharistanmano jñātvā yayau kiśorarūpavān ।
tayā sampūjitaścā'yaṃ dadau tasyai manuṃ nijam ।। 1 08।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
mālāṃ ca tilakaṃ prādād bhaktā'bhajaddhariṃ tu sā ।। 1 09।।
mṛtānāṃ bhogināṃ kanyāḥ sahasrāṇi daśā'bhavan ।
tābhyo manuḥ sunandinīṃ dadau mālādikaṃ dadau ।। 2.28.11 0।।
tāḥ sarvā vaiṣṇavīśreṣṭhatamā jātā hareḥ priyāḥ ।
śrīhariṇā samaṃ sarvāścāyayurbhūtalaṃ śubhāḥ ।। 111
anantenā'rpitā vyomayānasthāḥ sopadā hi tāḥ ।
lomaśasyā''śrame tāśca rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā ।। 1 12।।
dhanyāstā yoṣito rādhe yāḥ kṛṣṇāya prakalpitāḥ ।
parabrahma svayaṃ yāsu ramiṣyate sumuktikṛt ।। 1 13।।
sarvasvaṃ yatra vai deyaṃ dātavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
avāptavyaṃ ca yat proktaṃ tena ced yadi gṛhyate ।। 1 14।।
ko lābho'smātparo loke tanvā prīṇāti ceddhariḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyā''nandaprado bhavetprabhuḥ ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoścaturthavarṣārambhotsave pātālanāgasya svastikasya garuḍadvārā pātālarājamantriṇaḥ sumṛdhoḥ sakāśādāgatakaṣṭamokṣaṇam , nāgakanyānāṃ lomaśāśramānayanaṃ
cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 28 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 028 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 29
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 030 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike varṣe caturthe māghamāsi ca ।
niyamaṃ jagṛhurmāghasnānasyā'śvasarojale ।। 1 ।।
brāhmaṇā ṛṣayaḥ kanyāstathā'nye tatra vāsinaḥ ।
brāhmamuhūrtamārabhya janāḥ snānti sarovare ।। 2 ।।
nityaṃ jale nimajjanti pañcaṣo bālabālikāḥ ।
akasmātte na dṛśyante snānakṛdbhirjalasthitaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
janairapīti tīrasthairvīkṣyate naiva kāraṇam ।
kalpayanti janāstatra makarāḥ santi ghātakāḥ ।। 4 ।।
anye vadanti ca grāhā vidyante'tra samāgatāḥ ।
pare tu tarkayantyevaṃ piśācāḥ santi vāsinaḥ ।। 5 ।।
rākṣasā bhakṣayantyetān bālān ghātakinaḥ khalu ।
kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ tattu pratyakṣaṃ jñāyate nahi ।। 6 ।।
ākrośo'bhūttadā deśe saurāṣṭre sarvatodiśi ।
aśvapaṭṭasarovāri jīvān grasati pañcaṣaṭ ।। 7 ।।
snānaṃ tatra na kartavyaṃ mriyante bālakā yataḥ ।
kenacidvai jale bālā hriyante'śvasarovare ।। 8 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ko'yaṃ bālaprahartā vai jale tatrā'bhavattadā ।
vada me kāraṇaṃ tasya bālānāmabhavacca kim ।। 9 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tad rādhike sarvaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।
paścime āraktadeśe rājā'bhūt śāvadīnakaḥ ।। 2.29.10 ।।
śave dehe bhavaścātmā śāvastatraiva dīnavat ।
vartate jñānavṛttyeti śāvadīnā'bhidhānavān ।। 11 ।।
tasya bhāryāśataṃ cāsīt kintu putro na cā'bhavat ।
putryastasya sahasraṃ vai vidyante putra eva na ।। 12।।
tataḥ śokaṃ gato rājā papraccha svaguruṃ yatim ।
kathaṃ putraḥ prajāyeta kāraṇaṃ me vadā'tra nu ।। 13 ।।
yatidīno gurustasyovāca dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ ca tam ।
ṛṇānubandhanātputro jāyate ṛṇakāmyayā ।। 14।।
anirvṛtte ṛṇe mṛtyuryasya loke prajāyate ।
ṛṇaṃ dātuṃ gṛhe tasya putro vṛṣo'śva eva vā ।। 15।।
uṣṭro'jaḥ khara evā'sau jāyate karmabandhanāt ।
adhamarṇagṛhe yadvā uttamarṇaḥ suto bhavet ।। 16।।
pūrvaṃ dattaṃ dhanaṃ nītvā mṛtyuṃ gacchati nirṛṇaḥ ।
rājaँstvaṃ kasyacinnā''sse hyadhamarṇaḥ purā bhave ।। 17।।
tena ko'pi tava nā''sīduttamarṇo dhanapradaḥ ।
tadṛṇaṃ te ca naivā'sti kaste suto'tra saṃbhavet ।। 18।।
ānṛṇyaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ ceṣṭaṃ muktipradaṃ bhavet ।
tathāpi cettavecchā'sti putrārthaṃ kuru pūjanam ।। 19।।
śāvadīnā mahākālī pūjitā balidānataḥ ।
putraṃ te dāsyati sārvabhaumaṃ ciraprajīvinam ।।2.29.2 0।।
śāvadīnāmahākālyai bālasya balidānataḥ ।
bālalābho bhavettatra baliḥ śreṣṭha udāhṛtaḥ ।। 21 ।।
pañcamād vatsarānnyūno bālaścecchubhalakṣaṇaḥ ।
dīyeta yadi śāvinyai tadā sāpi dahet sutam ।।22।।
rājā prāha kathaṃ kīdṛglakṣaṇo bālako'rpyate ।
vad tallakṣaṇaṃ yena sārvabhaumo bhavet sutaḥ ।।23।।
yatidīno'vadattaṃ ca śṛṇu rājan vadāmi tat ।
yasya haste matsyarekhā dhanuṣyaṃ jyāśarānvitam ।।24।।
dhvajaḥ śūlaṃ svastikaṃ ca cakraṃ yavo bhavecca vā ।
yasya pāde trigulphāni ca vā prāsādalekhanam ।।25।।
yallalāṭe tvekarekhā kaṇṭhe śyāmatilaśca vā ।
yadrūpaṃ campakābhaṃ ca netraprānte dalāyate ।।।26 ।।
yajjaghane puttalī ca rekhārūpā virājate ।
yadvā vāme sakthini yat pāṇḍuraṃ kamalaṃ bhavet ।।27।।
sa bālo vai mahākālyai deyo baliṃvidhānataḥ ।
tena te bhavitā putraścakravartīmahānṛpaḥ ।। 28।।
yatidīnāttathā śrutvā śāvadīno nareśvaraḥ ।
tādṛgbālānveṣaṇārthaṃ siddhayatīn yuyoja ha ।।29।।
vyomagāḥ siddhayatayo hastarekhāparīkṣakāḥ ।
nīlāmbaradharā urvyāṃ vicerurbālalabdhaye ।।2.29.3 0।।
paśyanti bālarekhāste tathā jyotirgrahādikān ।
sarvakhaṇḍeṣu yatayaścaranti sma tadā priye ।।3 1।।
tatraikaḥ kāsadīnākhyaḥ saurāṣṭraṃ tvāyayau tadā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ cāyayau lomaśāśramam ।।32।
uktalakṣaṇabālaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāhvayam ।
śrutavān lomaśāt so'pi kambharānandanaṃ tadā ।।33 ।।
vīkṣya lakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvarekhānvitaṃ śubham ।
yayau vyomnā drutam āraktadeśe nṛpatiṃ prati ।।34।।
uvāca vidyate deśe saurāṣṭre bālakastathā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre gopālakṛṣṇaputrakaḥ ।। 35।।
śrutvā sveṣṭaṃ tadā rājā yataye grāmapañcakam ।
dadau cātha yatīn pañca tvindrajālavidastadā ।।36।।
preṣayāmāsa saurāṣṭraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
māghe snānaparā lokā yatra snānti jale śubhe ।।37।।
tatra te yatayo nityamacakṣurgocarāstaṭe ।
bhramanti sma ca tadbālaṃ hartuṃ yatnapuraḥsarāḥ ।।38।।
pañcaṣaḍ bālakān nityaṃ jale'ntarbhāvayanti te ।
nayanti tān drutaṃ cāraktadeśaṃ bhūmipālaye ।।39।।
jīvatastān prarakṣanti rājabhṛtyāḥ sukhapradāḥ ।
yatayo'śvapaṭṭataṭe kurvantyevaṃ divāniśam ।।2.29.40।।
rekhānvitasya bālasya lābhārthaṃ cā'vido hi te ।
rekhā'nabhijñāste sarve haranti bahubālakān ।।41 ।।
yatidīnastu rekhāṇāṃ vīkṣaṇaṃ prakaroti hi ।
dṛśyate naiva rekhā sā tāvannaiva vimuñcati ।।42।।
hriyante bālakāstatra hāhākāro hi vartate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ snāti gṛhāntare ।।43।।
yatīnāṃ karago nā'bhūdaśṛṇod bālanāśanam ।
tato'sau bhagavān mātrā samaṃ prasahya vai gṛhāt ।।44।।
vinirgatya yayau tvaśvapaṭṭasaro'vagāhitum ।
mātā snāti taṭe bālo vartate sannidhau yadā ।।45।।
taṃ jighṛkṣuryatistatrā'dṛśyaḥ śīghramupāyayau ।
jalamānavarūpo'sau bhūtvā jagrāha bālakam ।।46।।
rūpadvayadharo bālastasya hastagato'bhavat ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa ramate mātṛsannidhau ।।47।।
māँ māँ māī paśya ammāँ jalamānuṣamulbaṇam ।
bālakaṃ pratigṛhṇantaṃ māṃ paśyantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।।48।।
aparaṃ bālakaṃ nītvā yāntaṃ jalatalaṃ ca māँ ।
paśya paśya sabālaṃ taṃ jale viśantamāyatam ।।49।।
tritālamānaṃ candrābhaṃ piśaṃgakeśamastakam ।
siṃhacakṣuḥsamabhrājaccakṣuḥpiśaṃgatārakam ।।2.29.50।।
rajjuvaddīrghikāḥ sarvāṃgulayo bhujayordvayoḥ ।
śākhāvallambamānau ca bhujau pīnau ca śuṇḍhavat ।।51।।
mukhaṃ vānaratulyaṃ ca raktaśmaśrusamanvitam ।
daṃṣṭrācatuṣṭayaṃ pārśve dṛśyate barhirulbaṇam ।।52।।
śṛṃgaṃ cāṃkuśavattasya kapālordhve ca vidyate ।
skandhe pucchadvayaṃ pucchadvayaṃ tasya nitambayoḥ ।।53 ।।
rajjucatuṣṭayatulya vidyate'sya sudīrghakam ।
hṛdye pṛṣṭhake cā'sya dīrgharogāḍhyatā'sti ca ।।।54।।
hastapādāṃgulimadhye jālacarmāṇi santyapi ।
nābhau cāsya pataṃgo'sti dīpavadvai prakāśate ।।55।।
sajālapādā'ṅgulikā dīrghā vidyanta eva ca ।
udare koṣṭalī cāste bālaśālāsamā'sya tu ।।56 ।।
pādau kurutaḥ karayoḥ karau kāryaṃ ca pādayoḥ ।
astanaścāpyakarṇaśca vahniromā bhayapradaḥ ।।57।।
ciṃciṃhuk ciṃciṃśabdaṃ kurvan jalatale gataḥ ।
paśyainaṃ bālakānatra harantaṃ daityasannibham ।।58।।
paśyantu ca janāḥ sarve mārayantu ca taṃ yataḥ ।
ghātinaṃ hiṃsakaṃ śīghraṃ nāśayet sarvayatnakaiḥ ।।59।।
ityuktvā taddhastagato harirviniryayau jalāt ।
darśakāśca janāstatra narā nāryaśca saṃhatāḥ ।।2.29.6 0।
abhavan trāsamāpannāḥ śuśucurbahubālakān ।
hṛtān bālāṃśca saṃsmṛtya hananopāyamācaran ।।6 1 ।
śataghnī rakṣitā tīre kṛtrimābālaputtalāḥ ।
netuṃ tān puttalāँścāyād yadā tīre jale'pi ca ।।6 2।।।
śataghnyā nāśayitavya ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
athā'yaṃ vāyurūpeṇa jhaṃjhāvāte vidhāya ca ।।63।।
siddhadīno'haradvegāt śataghnīṃ puttalīstathā ।
trastāśca divase lokāḥ svasvagṛhamupāyayuḥ ।।64।।
puttallyaśca śataghnī ca sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
āścaryaṃ hi janāḥ prāptā lomaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।।65।।
jalamānavanāśārthaṃ ki kāryamṛṣisattama ।
bālān harati duṣṭātmā saṃhāro'yaṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।66 ।।
śrutvā vai lomaśaḥ prāha saṃvicārya kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi ।
ete cāraktadeśīyāḥ yatayaḥ pañca santi te ।।67।।
indrajālamahāvidyā bahurūpadharāstathā ।
mlecchā mlecchakriyā mlecchanṛpā''jñayā'tra cāgatāḥ ।।68।।
āsurāḥ kārmaṇakāśca hiṃsakā nirdayāstathā ।
teṣāṃ vināśanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva kariṣyati ।।69।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jānāti tadvidhām ।
āsurāṇāṃ vināśārthaṃ prākaṭyaṃ śrīhareryataḥ ।।2.29.70।।
rākṣasānāmauṣadhaṃ ca svayameva kariṣyati ।
evamuktvā lomaśo'tra sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam ।।71 ।।
harirhasan samāyācca prabhuḥ kaiśorarūpadhṛk ।
garuḍasthaḥ sacakraśca provāca lomaśādikān ।। 72।।
kathaṃ saṃsmṛtavānasmi vadantu śīghrameva me ।
lomaśādyāstadā natvā prāhurbālādyupadravam ।।73 ।।
jalamānuṣarūpeṇa rākṣasānāṃ saraḥsthitim ।
śrutvā sarvaṃ hariḥ prāha matsyaśūladhanurdharam ।।74।।
sadhvajaṃ bālakaṃ te ca mārgayanti jale sthitāḥ ।
madarthaṃ te yatante ca śāvadīnāprapūjane ।।75।।
arpaṇīyo bālakaḥ samatsyaśūladhanurdhvajaḥ ।
balidānena rājā ca sutaṃ vai tādṛśaṃ labhet ।।76।।
ahaṃ hastagatasteṣāṃ nā'bhavaṃ cā'ta eva te ।
vyāpārayanti bālānāṃ haraṇe śikṣayāmi tān ।।77।।
ityuktvā bhagavān bālo yayāvaśvasarastaṭam ।
tāvat sa dhṛtavān kṛṣṇaṃ jalamānuṣarūpadhṛk ।।78।।
sahasreṣu ca lokeṣu paśyatsveva hi rādhike ।
atha hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cāsīt tatra sarastaṭe ।।79।।
harirjale sacakraśca praviṣṭo divyarūpavān ।
asureṇa dhṛtastena yuyudhe ca jalāntare ।।2.29.80 ।।
cakreṇa bhagavāँstasya rajjubandhacatuṣṭayam ।
chedayitvā śiraḥśṛṃgaṃ hastapādaprakoṣṭhakān ।।81 ।।
tālatrayasamaḥ kṛṣṇaścābaddhya taṃ ca rajjubhiḥ ।
ānayāmāsa ca bahirjalājjīvantameva ca ।।82।।
tālatrayapramāṇaṃ ca śvetaṃ taṃ jalamānuṣam ।
dṛṣṭvā janā mahāścaryamavāpurvismayaṃ gatāḥ ।।83।।
athā'nye yatayastatra catvāro ye jale sthitāḥ ।
te'pi vārimanuṣyāṇāṃ rūpairbahiḥ samāyayuḥ ।।84।।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇahetave ।
bālakā māritā naiva sarve jīvanti te jaguḥ ।।85।।
ānayiṣyāma evā'tra prāṇadānaṃ tu dehi naḥ ।
ityukto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।86।।
jīvadānaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ samuvāca prabhuḥ punaḥ ।
āgacchantu mayā sārdhaṃ vyomnā garuḍagāminā ।।87।।
yatraite bālakāḥ santi rakṣitā jīvinaḥ khalu ।
mlecchā vārimanuṣyāste śrutvā kṛṣṇavacastadā ।।88।।
vyomnā yayurhariṃ nītvā deśamāraktamujjvalam ।
raktavarṇaṃ raktajalaṃ raktamānavamaṇḍalam ।।89।।
yatrāste sarvamāraktaṃ prāyaśo bhūstaraṃ tathā ।
śāvadīno mahārājo yatidīno gurustathā ।।2.29.90।।
śāvadīnā mahākālī yatrāste bhūmipālaye ।
tatra kṛṣṇo yatayaste yayuḥ rājñā susatkṛtāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
bālakā darśitāstatra pañcāśat sukhino'vyathāḥ ।
sundaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nṛpādayaḥ khalu ।।92।।
jñātvā siddhayatibhyaśca camatkāraṃ paraṃ śubham ।
rājapatnyo rājakanyāḥ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।।93।।
sammṛdya cottaratailaiḥ sugandhicūrṇakaistathā ।
snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kavoṣṇairvāribhistadā ।।94।।
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ mīnaśūladhanurdharam ।
sadhvajaṃ ca karaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhurmumudustathā ।।95।।
aho'yaṃ baliyogyo'sti sa diṣṭyā'tra samāgataḥ ।
evamāvedayāñcakruḥ rājānaṃ satvaraṃ striyaḥ ।। 96।।
rājā vicārya tūrṇaṃ hi bhaṭān senāpatīṃstathā ।
kārāgāre tu taṃ dhartumājñāṃ dadau prahasya vai ।। 97।।
rūpamugdhāśca tāḥ kanyā necchanti maraṇaṃ hareḥ ।
rājñyaḥ putrecchayā tatra balimicchanti vai harim ।।98।।
bālarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo dhṛto bhaṭaistu tatkṣaṇam ।
avādyanta ca vādyāni rājā mene kṛtārthatām ।।99।।
sudarśanaṃ ca garuḍo bālau bhūtvā śubhāsyakau ।
bāleṣu ca militvaiva dhairyaṃ dadatuḥ rakṣakau ।। 2.29.1 00।।
atha kṛṣṇo nigaḍasthaḥ kārāgāre kṛto bhaṭaiḥ ।
kanyakā mohamāpannāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā ।। 10 1।।
śāvadīnāmahākālīniyamaṃ jagṛhurmudā ।
yadi bālo vimucyeta bhaveccāsmatpatistadā ।। 1 02।।
kariṣyāmo vrataṃ māsaṃ kevalaṃ hi payovratam ।
śāvadīnāpūjanaṃ ca kariṣyāmo divāniśam ।। 103 ।।
adyatastyajyate miṣṭaṃ madhu śṛṃgārakādikam ।
śāvadīnādevikāyāḥ kurmo mālādvipañcakam ।। 1 04।।
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ tāśca jagṛhurbālarakṣakam ।
atha rātrau prasuptāśca prajā rājā bhaṭādayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
śrīharirbandhane supto lokalīlāpradarśakaḥ ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa vartate svagṛhe prabhuḥ ।। 1 06।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sarvānandakaro hariḥ ।
vakti cāraktadeśotthāṃ vārtāṃ śrīlomaśarṣaye ।। 107।।
śṛṇvanti sarve sāścaryaṃ manvate dūrabhūmijam ।
evaṃ rātrirvyatītā ca prabhātaṃ samajāyata ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āraktadeśīyarājñā putrārthaṃ śāvadīnākālyai bālabalidānārthakabaddhabālānāṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ śrīharestatra gamanaṃ sahasrakanyakānāṃ harau mugdhatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 29 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 029 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 30
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 031 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ rādhike vṛttaṃ tatratyaṃ prātarāgate ।
yajjātaṃ tadvadāmyatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।। 1 ।।
śāvadīno nṛpa udghoṣayāmāsa prajājane ।
putrārthaṃ balidānārthaṃ bālaḥ prāptaḥ sulakṣaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kare mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlacakrādirekhitaḥ ।
māghyāṃ ca pūrṇimāyāṃ ca balidānaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 3 ।।
pañcadaśadinānyatra vartante śuklapakṣake ।
pratipattaḥ samārabhya nityaṃ devīprapūjanam ।। 4 ।।
kartavyaṃ putrakāṃkṣārthijanairnityaṃ mahotsavam ।
śvaḥ pratipaddine prātarbālamādāya mandiram ।। 5 ।।
ahaṃ rājā gamiṣyāmi devyagre guruṇā saha ।
apākasya ca bālasya devyagre pākatāṃ guruḥ ।। 6 ।।
mlecchakāṇḍairmadyadānaiḥ surāsaṃskārakaistathā ।
kariṣyati vidhānena bālo devīpaśustataḥ ।। 7
prajāyate devarūpastasya sevā janaiḥ sadā ।
bhojanaiḥ sevanairvastrairjalaiḥ pānaiḥ pramardanaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
yānakhelanakrīḍābhiḥ kartavyā sarvamānavaiḥ ।
bālārcane mahādevī prasannā saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 9 ।।
tasmāt paśuḥ pūjanīyo dānamānā'rhaṇādibhiḥ ।
evamudghoṣitaṃ rājñā prajāsvaprasarat kṣaṇāt ।। 2.30.1 0।।
prātaḥ pratipadi kṣmeśaḥ snātvā sainyena śobhitaḥ ।
sotsavo bālamādāya svāṃke devīgṛhaṃ yayau ।। 1 1।।
mlecchamantraistu guruṇā bālo devīpaśuḥ kṛtaḥ ।
saṃskṛtaḥ pūjitaścāpi mahānmahotsavaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 1 2।।
śāvadīnā mahākālī dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
lajjāmavāpa śīghraṃ sā mūrterdūraṃ gatā'bhavat ।। 1 3।।
śuśoca paramaṃ devī sarvān hantuṃ samicchati ।
kintu kṛṣṇasya kartavyaṃ pālanīyaṃ bhavediti ।। 14।।
vicāryā''jñāṃ vinā naiva kiṃcit kartuṃ samicchati ।
iti maunā'bhavaddevī yāvatpūjā nivartitā ।। 15।।
atha dānāni bahūni rājā prādānmahotsave ।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi paravat pāravaśyo'bhavattadā ।। 16।।
prākṛto bālasadṛśo bālo'bhavannijecchayā ।
devīgṛhe dṛṣṭisaudhe rakṣito niśi kevalaiḥ ।। 17।।
bālakaiḥ kanyakābhiśca saha tatra prasannahṛt ।
bhavet tathā sevyate ca sarvairapyupacārakaiḥ ।। 18।।
ardharātre gate sarve nidrāmāpustataḥ satī ।
śāvadīnā mahākālī śrīhareḥ sannidhau śubhā ।। 19।।
kanyā bhūtvā cājagāma vepamānā ca kiṃkarī ।
pādayormastakaṃ dhṛtvā vimuñcyā'śrūṇi jihvayā ।।2.30.20।।
pravilihya hareḥ pādau kṣamasveti jagāda sā ।
neme muhustathā''jñāṃ cārthayāmāsa harerhi sā ।।21।।
nāthā'parādhinaścaite rājādyāḥ putralālasāḥ ।
hantavyāste mayā sarve dehyājñāṃ me karoti tat ।।22।।
yatidīno gurustasya śāvadīnaśca bhūpatiḥ ।
kāsadīnaśca saurāṣṭrasarovārṣvavamārgakaḥ ।।23।।
mlecchāśca siddhayatayo hantavyāste mayā prabho ।
anye'pi cet sahāyasthā hantavyāste mayā'tra vai ।।24।।
omityāha haristasyai śāvakālyai pumuttamaḥ ।
khaḍgaṃ bhallaṃ tathā śaktiṃ paraśuṃ pāśamityapi ।। 25 ।।
daṇḍaṃ vajraṃ carmāsiṃ mudgaraṃ gadāṃ triśūlakam ।
aṃkuśaṃ mūśalaṃ cakraṃ saśaraṃ dhanuṣaṃ tathā ।। 26।।
śaṃkhaṃ ceti tadā hetīnaṣṭādaśakareṣu sā ।
dhṛtvā prātarnṛpagehe praviveśa ruṣānvitā ।।27।।
kesaristhā krūrarūpā vahninetrā viṣolbaṇā ।
nṛpaṃ jagrāha keśeṣu śiraściccheda cāsinā ।।28।।
guruṃ dvedhā vibhidyaiva śūlena ca tataḥ param ।
hatvā kāsaṃ siddhayatīn mlecchāṃśca tatsahāyadān ।।29।।
kārāgṛhapatīn hatvā mocayāmāsa bālakān ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīdantaḥpurajaneṣu vai ।।2.30.30।।
kupitā rājapūjyā sā kuladevīti vai jaguḥ ।
nāśayāmāsa rājānaṃ guruṃ yatīn tathā'parān ।। 31 ।।
bālānāṃ vadhapūrvaṃ vai pāpaṃ rājñaḥ samāgatam ।
bālā naiva kadācidvai pīḍanīyā yato janaiḥ ।।।32।।।
bālatrāsapradātṝṇāṃ sarvanāśo bhavediha ।
bālā nirdoṣapuṣpāṇi na hantavyāni vai hṛdā ।।3 3 ।।
bālā īśanivāsāste jvālanīyā na vai kvacit ।
kāyādidoṣahīnāste brahmasādhusvarūpiṇaḥ ।।34।।
arcanīyā rañjanīyāstoṣaṇīyā hi bālakāḥ ।
dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ teṣāṃ sarvadā'bhayadānakam ।। 35।।
dātavyastvāśrayasteṣāṃ mā dātavyaṃ mṛterbhayam ।
apakvaphalarūpāste parādhīnaprajīvanāḥ ।।36।।
mātāpitṛsamādhārā na hantavyāḥ kadācana ।
bālodvegaphalaṃ tatra maraṇaṃ jāyate hi tat ।।37।।
udvejayitā bālānāmapahartā jano'dhamaḥ ।
rājā'vāpa phalaṃ tūrṇaṃ maraṇaṃ dharmaghātakaḥ ।।38।।
atha kesaripṛṣṭhasthā yayau bālagṛhāṇi sā ।
yatra kārāgṛhavāse te hi tiṣṭhanti bālakāḥ ।।39।।
yatrāste garuḍaścakraṃ tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
tatreyaṃ sahasā yātā yuddharūpadharā satī ।।2.30.40।।
krauryaṃ tyaktvā'tisaumyā'bhūd dvibhujā kanyakā śubhā ।
hasamānā ca tān bālānāha paśyata māṃ prati ।।।41।।
bālaistvālokitā sā'pi svasvamātṛsvarūpiṇī ।
drāgeva tadgalaṃ dhṛtvā remire'ṅke hi bālakāḥ ।।42।।
ati prasannatāṃ prāptā menire rakṣaṇaṃ nijam ।
atha sā bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai neme kṣamāmayācata ।।43।।
payaḥ phalāni pradadau sarvabālebhya aiśvarī ।
arbhakā bhakṣayāmāsurbabhūvuḥ sukhinastathā ।।44।।
atha śmaśānayātrāṃ ca prajāścakrurnṛpasya vai ।
rājñastu vidhavāḥ sarvā devīmāgatya cukruśuḥ ।।45।।
kanyāstā ruruduḥ sarvā gurvādīnāmapi striyaḥ ।
devī mūrtervinirgatya kanyārūpā vyajāyata ।।46।।
sākṣād bhūtā hi sarvāsāmuvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ ।
mā śokaṃ kuruta śreṣṭhāḥ rājñā prāptaṃ phalaṃ nijam ।।47।।
ahaṃ bhavāmi yatpatnī taṃ rājā hantumudyataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kānto'sti me prabhuḥ ।।48।।
mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlacakradhārī janārdanaḥ ।
bālarūpo bhavatyeva kārāgāragato'tra saḥ ।।49।।
me patirmatpaśuḥ rājñā kṛtaḥ putre hayā'pi tu ।
tatphalaṃ maraṇaṃ tasya mayā dattaṃ mahāghine ।।2.30.50।।
bhavatīnāṃ mahāśreyo bhaviṣyati harikṛtam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ stuvantu muktaye ।।5 1 ।।
ityuktā rādhike sarvā yayurnārāyaṇaṃ prati ।
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā pāpamokṣaṇahetave ।।52।।
haristābhyo nijaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa dhāmagam ।
pārśve lakṣmī svarūpā ca śāvadīnāṃ satīṃ priyām ।।5 3 ।।
garuḍaṃ bālakaṃ cāpi cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ tathā ।
tato vai darśayāmāsa cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।54।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ tathā ।
koṭyarbujā'bjakanyāśca divyatāṃ pārameśvarīm ।।।55।।
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptā mātaraḥ kanyakāstathā ।
yayācire varaṃ śīghramasmākaṃ tvaṃ patirbhava ।।56 ।।
atha kṛṣṇastu sarvābhyo yatheṣṭaṃ vai varaṃ dadau ।
garuḍaṃ prāha yāsyāmaḥ śrīmadbadarikāvanam ।।57।।
sudarśanaṃ saha nītvā garuḍastho haristadā ।
sasmāra divyayānaṃ ca yojanāyatamujjvalam ।।58।।
sauvarṇaṃ nijadhāmasthaṃ śīghraṃ copasthitaṃ hi tat ।
sapārṣade vimāne ca sarvāḥ strīḥ kanyakāstathā ।।59।।
śāvadīnāṃ mahākālīṃ niṣādya śrīhariḥ svayam ।
prātaḥ rājamukuṭaṃ ca bhaktaṃ jallāuddīnakam ।।2.30.6 0।।
tṛtīyāṃ cārpayitvā vyomnā badryāśramaṃ yayau ।
gaṃgāyāṃ snāpayitvā ca dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ।।6 1।।
sarvābhyaḥ pāyayāmāsa śrīhareścaraṇāmṛtam ।
naranārāyaṇapūjāṃ kārayitvā tato hariḥ ।।62।।
kurukṣetraṃ tvāyayau ca daśakrośaviśālakam ।
pāvanaṃ paramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ himādreḥ pādamāśritam ।।63।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kurukṣetraṃ kadā kena kṛtaṃ tad vistarād vada ।
kathaṃ vai pāvanaṃ taddhi praśastaṃ gaṇyate sadā ।।64।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
somavaṃśodbhavo rājā ṛkṣo nāma mahābalaḥ ।
kṛtasyādau samabhavad ṛkṣātsaṃvaraṇo'bhavat ।।65।।
sa tu pitrā nije rājye'bhiṣikto bāla eva saḥ ।
bālye'pi dharmanirato madbhaktaḥ sa sadā'bhavat ।।66।।
purohitastu tasyā''sīd vasiṣṭho varuṇātmajaḥ ।
sa taṃ tvadhyāpayāmāsa sāṃgānvedānudāradhīḥ ।।67।।
anadhyāye dine rājā yayau vanāni vīkṣitum ।
vaibhrājaṃ suvanaṃ ramyaṃ viveśa bahuvistaram ।।68।।
dvaitavanaṃ viveśā'sau ruḍrāgau dvau gatau yataḥ ।
sa vanāntaṃ dadarśā'tha phullakokanadāvṛtam ।।69।।
tatra dadarśa devānāṃ kanyakāstāsu madhyagām ।
sūryaputrīṃ tapatīṃ sa dadarśa sarvato'dhikām ।।2.30.70।।
tatra lagnamanā rājā yayau meruṃ prati prabhuḥ ।
pratiṣṭhānapuraṃ ramyaṃ tiṣṭhatyeva ca tāṃ smaran ।।71 ।।
yadā nā'yaṃ gṛhaṃ pratyāyātastathā purohitaḥ ।
jñātvā taṃ merusaṃsthaṃ ca tapatīlagnamānasam ।।72।।
samutpatya vasiṣṭhaḥ prāyayau bhāskaramaṇḍalam ।
nanāma bhāskaraṃ sūryo nanāmainaṃ pupūja ca ।।73।।
papracchā''gamane hetumṛṣiḥ sūryamuvāca ha ।
samāyāto'smi deveśa yācituṃ tvāṃ mahādyute ।।74।।
sutāṃ saṃvaraṇasyārthe tvaṃ tāpīṃ dātumarhasi ।
tāpīṃ pṛṣṭvā tataḥ sūryo dadau tāpīṃ jaharṣa ca ।।75।।
ṛṣirnītvā rājyamāyāt samvaraṇo'pi cāyayau ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame tāpī tasmai maharṣiṇā'rpitā ।।76।।
tasyāṃ putro'bhavat kāle kururnāmnā sa vai kṛtaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśābdaḥ samuvāha sudāmno nṛpateḥ sutām ।।77।।
kīrtināmne dhuraṃ datvā rājyasya vanamāviśat ।
saudāmnyā saha patnyā vai tepe dvaitavane nṛpaḥ ।।78।।
tatra devīṃ harijihvāṃ sa dadarśa sarasvatīm ।
sudarśanasya jananīṃ brahmaputrīṃ ca plakṣajām ।।79।।
snātvā tatra jalaṃ pītvā brahmavedīmupāyayau ।
uttarā sā brahmavedirucyate yajñabhūmikā ।।2.30.80 ।।
madhyamā brahmavedistu prayāgarāja ucyate ।
prāgvedikā gayāvedirvirajā dakṣiṇā tu vai ।।8 1 ।।
pratīcī puṣkarā vedistribhiḥ kuṇḍairalaṃkṛtā ।
syamantapañcakaṃ dharmasthānaṃ cottaravedikā ।।82।।
āsamantād yojanāni pañca pañca ca sarvataḥ ।
tadamanyata rājarṣiḥ kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ mahāphalam ।।83।।
hradaṃ kṛtvā parṇaśālāṃ vidhāya vāsamācarat ।
kṛtvā sīraṃ rudravṛṣaṃ yamasya mahiṣaṃ tathā ।।84।।
voḍhāraṃ saṃvidhāyaiva svayaṃ kṛṣṭuṃ samudyataḥ ।
karṣantaṃ taṃ mahendraścāgatya papraccha kāraṇam ।।85।।
rājan kimidaṃ kārṣeyaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ ।
rājā'bravīt tapaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dānaṃ dayā kṣamā ।।86।।
yogaśca śīlavṛttiścetyaṣṭakaṃ cātra vidyate ।
indraḥ prāha tathā rājan bhūyāttavā'bhivāñcchitam ।।87।।
indre gate tu rājā'sau karṣati sma nirantaram ।
saptakrośādhikāṃ bhūmiṃ sīrakṛṣṭāṃ cakāra saḥ ।।88।।
tato'haṃ rādhike vipro bhūtvā'gacchaṃ nṛpāntikam ।
apṛcchaṃ ca tvayā rājan kathaṃ vai kleśa uhyate ।।89।।
tadā'ṣṭāṃgo mahādharmaḥ samākhyāto nṛpeṇa me ।
tato mayā'sya gaditaṃ nṛpa bījaṃ kva vartate ।।2.30.90।।
sa cā''ha mama dehe'tra mānasaṃ bījamasti hi ।
tamabruvaṃ dehi mahyaṃ bījaṃ niṣkāsya dehataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vāṭikāṃ khalu vapsyāmi sīraṃ karṣatu vai bhavān ।
tato nṛpatinā bāhurdakṣiṇaḥ prasṛtaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।92।।
mayā cakreṇa chinnaḥ so'bhavattatra sahasradhā ।
evaṃ vāmabhujaḥ pādau kaṭitaśca dvidhā kṛtāḥ ।।93।।
tāni bījāni jātāni koṭyadhikāni sarvataḥ ।
atha sa me śiraḥ prādāt tena prīto'smi tasya ca ।।94।।
varado'smītyathetyukte kururvaramayācata ।
yāvadetanmayā kṛṣṭaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ tadastu te ।।95।।
snātānāṃ ca mṛtānāṃ ca mahāpuṇyaphalaṃ tviha ।
upavāsaśca dānaṃ ca snānaṃ jāpyaṃ ca pūjanam ।।96।।
homayajñādikaṃ sarvamatrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet prabho ।
tathā bhavān suraiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmaṇā śaṃbhunā tathā ।। 97।।
vasā'tra puṇḍarīkākṣa mannāmavyañjake'tra vai ।
ityevamuktastenā'haṃ tadā bāḍhamuvāca tam ।। 18।।
tathā ca tvaṃ divyavapurbhava bhūyo'pi svastimān ।
antakāle cirakāle layameṣyasi mattanau ।। 99।।
śāśvatī tava kīrtiśca bhaviṣyati madāśrayāt ।
atra tvaṃ yājako yajñān yajiṣyase sahasraśaḥ ।। 2.30.10 0।।
kṣetrasya rakṣakān candrayakṣaṃ pannagavāsukim ।
vidyādharaṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ sukeśaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathā ।। 10 1।।
ajāvanaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ mahādevaṃ ca pāvakam ।
dadāmi te'tra balino'ṣṭasahasrāṇi dhanvinām ।। 1 02।।
kurujāṃgalamadhye ca pṛthūdakaṃ saro mahat ।
nadī sarasvatī cāpi vartate pāvanī śubhā ।। 103 ।।
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyorantare kurujāṃgale ।
brahmasaraḥ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ samantādardhayojanam ।। 1 04।।
ādyaiṣā brahmaṇo vedistato rāmahradaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ hi pāvanam ।। 105 ।।
tarantukārantukayorantaraṃ yattu vidyate ।
rāmahradapañcakācca yadantaraṃ hi vidyate ।। 106 ।।
kurukṣetraṃ viśālaṃ tat samantapañcakā''hvayam ।
tatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vyomnā samāyayau ।। 1 07।।
sarasvatyāṃ dṛṣadvatyāṃ brahmasarasi yoṣitaḥ ।
snāpayitvā ca yānena kṣaṇamātreṇa rādhike ।। 1 08।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre lomaśāśramamāyayau ।
bālakāḥ kanyakā nāryo devī ca garuḍo hariḥ ।। 1 09।।
avateruḥ kṣitiṃ tatra jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
avādyanta ca vādyāni devīśaṃkho'pyavādyata ।। 2.30.11 0।।
lomaśādyā ṛṣayaśca prajāḥ śīghraṃ samāyayuḥ ।
ābhāṣya maṃgalācāramakurvan brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।। 11 1।।
sasnuḥ sarovare bhuktavanto bhojyāni sarvaśaḥ ।
ārāmaṃ kṛtavantaśca pravāsādāgamaśramāḥ ।। 1 12।।
jayotsavaḥ kṛto rātrau rājño nāśaḥ pravarṇitaḥ ।
bālakā nijapitṛbhyaścārpitā hariṇā tadā ।। 11 3।।
kanyakā yoṣitaḥ sarvā lomaśāya niveditāḥ ।
āśrame rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca mantradānārthamityapi ।। 1 14।।
lomaśaśca pavitrābhyo dadau matraṃ ca mālikāḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।। 1 15।।
vaiṣṇavyastā divyarūpā abhavan brahmatejasā ।
mātarastā bhajanaṃ ca cakruḥ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt ।। 116।।
divyadehā vimānaiśca yayurvaikuṇṭhameva tāḥ ।
kanyakāstatra tasthuśca śrīharericchayā sadā ।। 1 17।।
ityevaṃ rakṣitā bālā mlecchā vināśitāstathā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargamokṣaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1 18।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ rājakṛtadevīpaśusaṃskāraḥ, devyā rājādisaṃhāraḥ, badrīṃ kurukṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikāṃ pratyāgamanam, bālakānāṃ tajjanakebhyo'rpaṇam, mātṝṇāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 30 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ rādhike devī śāvadīnā tu kālikā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre divyovāsa vaṭāśritā ।। 1 ।।
kṣetrarakṣāṃ karotyeva cāṣṭādaśabhujā priyā ।
siṃhavāhanayuktā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃganā ।। 2 ।।
kanyakānāṃ sadā rakṣāṃ karoti divyavigrahā ।
pratyakṣā dṛśyate lokaiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ।। 3 ।।
tattīrthaṃ kālikātīrthaṃ vartate'śvasarovare ।
paścime tatra setau vai kṛtaprāsādasannidhau ।। 4 ।।
māghasnānasamāptau ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajā viprāśca kanyakāḥ ।। 5 ।।
mahotsavo mahān jāto divyo mokṣaprado hi saḥ ।
atha sarvatra vārtā sā prāsarad vāyuvegataḥ ।। 6 ।।
jalamānavavīkṣārthaṃ janāstvāyānti dūrataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ manyante śrīharerbalam ।। 7 ।।
hariṇā sa vārinaro vāriṇā prokṣitastadā ।
divyarūpo hastapādāvayavaḥ samapadyata ।। 8 ।।
tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ sevāmārthayatpādayoḥ sadā ।
śrīharistaṃ sarasyeva kṣetrapālaṃ vyadhātsadā ।। 9 ।।
tava vaṃśo mānasaśca sarvatra prasariṣyati ।
jalamānuṣasṛṣṭiḥ sā bhaviṣyatīti cāha tam ।। 2.31.1 0।।
jaḍadehaṃ tadā tasya jalamadhye vyasarjayat ।
tato divyā jalanarā jalanāryo'bhavan śatam ।। 1 1।।
atha lokā mahākālīṃ paśyantyatha vrajanti ca ।
kathayanti pratāpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।। 1 2।।
bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।
muktiṃ yānti bahavaśca śrīśasvāmipratāpataḥ ।। 13।।।
payovrataṃ tāḥ kanyāśca cakrustatrāśrame yataḥ ।
hariḥ kāntaḥ prabhuḥ prāptastadarthaṃ mānitaṃ tu prāk ।। 14।।
rādhike vratapuṣṭyarthaṃ gāvaḥ kāmadughāstadā ।
payo dadati nityaṃ vai vrataṃ kurvanti kanyakāḥ ।। 15।।
śrīhariṃ nirmaladugdhaiḥ snapayanti prage ca tāḥ ।
paścādvārbhiḥ snāpayitvā vastrabhūṣādibhiḥ prabhum ।। 16।।
śṛṃgārayanti bhāvena sugandhayanti saddravaiḥ ।
mardayanti prabhordehaṃ rañjayanti sugītikaiḥ ।। 17।।
hāsayanti sumādhuryaistoṣayanti sunartanaiḥ ।
ānandayanti susparśaistarpayanti subhojanaiḥ ।। 18।।
stuvanti vardhayantyeva nīrājanakṣamāpanaiḥ ।
evaṃ kṛṣṇavratakartryaḥ pibanti dugdhameva tāḥ ।। 1 9।।
māsapūrṇaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā cakruḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ ca tat ।
dānahomotsavamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā ca pūrṇatām ।। 2.31.20।।
tasthustatraiva saṃbhejuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāṇapatiṃ prabhum ।।2 1 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mleccharākṣasakanyakāḥ ।
jātinikṛṣṭabhāvotthā jagrāha pāvanaḥ prabhuḥ ।।22।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi mama divyāṃ kathāṃ tava ।
pareṇa brahmaṇā cāhaṃ purā svāṃśaḥ prakāśitaḥ ।।23।।
mayā rādhā tadaṃśā ca patnīrūpā kṛtā tadā ।
sāhaudaryaṃ rodhate na tejasvināṃ tadatra vai ।।24।।
pareṇa brahmaṇā nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
parabrahmasamutthā ca lakṣmīstena priyā kṛtā ।।25।।
sāhaudaryaṃ bādhate na nārāyaṇāvatārake ।
brahmaṇā svasya vaṃśīyā sāvitrī saṃvivāhitā ।।26।।
gāyatrī vaṃśajā putrī brahmaṇā svapriyā kṛtā ।
sarasvatī tathā putrī patnītvena sumānitā ।।27।।
brahmapautrasya putryaśca dakṣajāḥ kulajāśca tāḥ ।
brahmaputraiḥ praputraiśca sarvā eva vivāhitā ।।28।।
kaśyapena purā tiryagjātīyāḥ svapriyāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
danuśca ditireveme rākṣasyau kaśyapastriyau ।।29।।
arundhatī śvapacī ca vasiṣṭhena vivāhitā ।
kālī ca bhairavī durgā tāmasyaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ ।।2.31.3 0।।
vṛndā tulasī daityasya patnyau viṣṇuvivāhite ।
mlecchā goromato jātā gavāṃ vaṃśāstu te smṛtāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
samartho bhagavān sarvān pavitrayati tatkṣaṇāt ।
na tasyāgre jātibhāvo noccatā nīcatā na ca ।।32।।
bhāvagamyo hi bhagavān bhāvito bhāvayatyapi ।
sarvaṃ tasya saḥ sarvasmin tadātmakaḥ sa eva ha ।।33।।
sarvabhoktā sarvakartā sarvapatiḥ patīśvaraḥ ।
tasyā''jñayā purā brahmā yugalāni samasṛjat ।। 34।।
tadyugalaṃ bhrātṛsvasṝūpaṃ sahasramāsa ha ।
tataḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtayuge bhavatyeva na dūṣaṇam ।। 35।।
tadā kanyāḥ parasmai vai dātuṃ .prathā na cā'bhavat ।
atha kanyāvihīnānāṃ vaṃśasantānasiddhaye ।।36।।
kanyādānaṃ pradātavyamanyasmai niyamo'bhavat ।
paragotre pradātavyā kanyeti niyamastvanu ।। 37।।
asapiṇḍe pradātavyā sājātye niyamo'bhavat ।
evaṃ sarvairlabhyate vai kanyā vaṃśapradā tataḥ ।।38।।
anye dharmāḥ purā sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe'pi cāparāḥ ।
anye dharmāḥ kṛte tvādye tretādāvapare vṛṣāḥ ।।35।।
kalau dharmā adharmāste tadānīmabhavan priye ।
kṛtadharmāḥ kalau sarve na tu dharmatayā matāḥ ।।2.31.40।।
tejobhedād bhinnadharmāḥ pravartante yuge yuge ।
tasmāt kṛṣṇasya doṣo na tatkriyā dharma eva saḥ ।।41 ।।
tatkṛtaḥ saḥ parāmnāyaḥ śāsti sarvaṃ jagat sadā ।
sa cāmnāyo naiva kṛṣṇaṃ śāsituṃ kṣamate kvacit ।।।42।।
āmnāyasya mahāmātā kriyā kṛṣṇasya vartate ।
tasmāt kṛṣṇakriyāḥ sarvā ātmāmnāyasvarūpiṇī ।।43।।
na saḥ kāmo na saḥ krodho na vyavāyo na hiṃsanam ।
na taccauryaṃ na sāṃkaryaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtaṃ tu yadbhavet ।।44।।
kāmo divyastathā krodho vyavāyo divya eva saḥ ।
hiṃsā cauryaṃ ca sāṃkaryaṃ divyaṃ kṛṣṇakṛtaṃ sadā ।।45।।
rādhā divyā ratirdivyā divyā vaibhavabhogyatā ।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ parabrahmamayaṃ tatra na dūṣaṇam ।।46।।
yatrā'sti tejasāṃ rāśistamastatra na vidyate ।
tamastu dūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ tejasviṣu na saṃbhavet ।।47।।
alpadṛṣṭyā vilokyante dūṣaṇāni tamo'dhikaiḥ ।
brahmadṛṣṭyā tu tānyeva bhūṣaṇāni bhavanti hi ।।48।।
yādṛk snehaḥ striyāṃ putre sutāyāṃ janakādiṣu ।
sa eva sādhuṣu kṛto mokṣaṃ dadāti nirguṇaḥ ।।49।।
satsu sādhvīṣu ca doṣā bhasmatāṃ yānti yogataḥ ।
hareryogād divyabhāvāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo bhavanti hi ।।2.31.50।।
yathā rādhe tava putrāḥ kṣārodā api sarvathā ।
pāvanāstīrtharūpāste divyarūpā bhavanti hi ।।।5 1 ।।
yathā liṃgaṃ kāmamūlaṃ doṣātmakaṃ jagatsu vai ।
śaṃkarasya tu yogena brahmavatpūjyate hi tat ।।52।।
pāṣāṇādyā brahmayogāt pūjyante pratimātmakāḥ ।
tyā sarvaṃ tvayā rādhe pūjanīyaṃ madanvayāt ।।53।।
mlecchatā kṛṣṇayogena vrajatyevā'cchatāṃ priye ।
bhagaṃ vai brahmayogena yajñakuṇḍe pradṛśyate ।।।54।।
patnīhaste tvaśvaliṃgaṃ tvaśvamedhe pradīyate ।
sarvatra brahmayogena pāvitryaṃ kalpate priye ।।।55।।
tasmācchaṃkā na kartavyā mlecchakanyāḥ kathaṃ priyāḥ ।
yatpriyaṃ śrīharestattu śuddhameva na saṃśayaḥ ।।56।।
atha tvidaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmatattvaṃ nibodha me ।
prāgbhavam ṛṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ dharmavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ ।।57।।
anāvṛtāḥ purā kila striyastvāsan varānane ।
kāmacāravihāriṇyaḥ svatantrāścāruhāsinī ।।।58।।
tāsāṃ vyuccaramāṇānāṃ kaumārāt subhage patīn ।
nā'dharmo'bhūd varārohe sa hi dharmaḥ purā'bhavat ।।59।।
taṃ caiva prācīnadharmaṃ tiryagyonigatāḥ prajāḥ ।
sarvadā'nuvidhīyante ṛtudharmamanusṛtāḥ ।।2.31.60।।
pramāṇadṛṣṭo dharmo'yaṃ pūjyate ca maharṣibhiḥ ।
uttareṣu ca deśeṣu kuruṣvapi pravartate ।।61।।
parvatīyaprajāsveṣaḥ dharmo bahupatitvakaḥ ।
devīṣvapi ca svargādau vartate dharma eva saḥ ।।62।।
dāsīṣvapi ca sarvatra vartate dharma eva saḥ ।
strīṇāmanugrahaprāptaḥ sa vai dharmaḥ sanātana ।।63।।
athoddālakaputreṇa kadācit śvetaketunā ।
maryādā sthāpitā tena kopāttāmapi saṃśṛṇu ।।64।।
śvetaketoḥ kila purā samakṣaṃ mātaraṃ pituḥ ।
jagrāha brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇau gacchāva iti cābravīt ।।65।।
ṛṣiputrastadā kopaṃ cakārā'marṣanoditaḥ ।
mātaraṃ tāṃ nīyamānāṃ balād dṛṣṭvā pituḥ puraḥ ।।66।।
kruddhaṃ putraṃ pitā dṛṣṭvā śvetaketumuvāca ha ।
mā putra kopaṃ kārṣīstvameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।67।।
anāvṛtā hi sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmaṃganā bhuvi ।
yathā gāvaḥ sthitāḥ sve sve bhoktari pramadāstathā ।।68।।
śvetaketustu taṃ dharmaṃ sarvathā vai na cakṣame ।
cakāra caiva maryādāmimāṃ strīpuṃsayorbhuvi ।।69।।
mānuṣeṣveva nānyeṣu śṛṇu tāṃ rādhike priye ।
vyuccarantyāḥ patiṃ nāryā adyaprabhṛti pātakam ।।2.31.70।।
bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ ghoraṃ bhaviṣyatyasukhāvaham ।
bhāryāṃ tathā vyuccarataḥ kaumārabrahmacāriṇīm ।।71।।
pativratāmetadeva bhavitā pātakaṃ bhuvi ।
patyā niyuktā yā caiva patnī putrārthameva vā ।। 72।।
na kariṣyati tasyāśca bhaviṣyati tadeva hi ।
uddālakasya putreṇa dharmyā vai śvetaketunā ।।73 ।।
maryādā sthāpitā tasmāt sa vai dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ।
ṛtau ṛtau striyā bhartā nātivartavya eva ca ।।74।।
śeṣeṣvanyeṣu kāleṣu svātantryaṃ strī kilā'rhati ।
saudāsena nijapatnī niyuktā putrajanmani ।।75।।
madayantī jagāmarṣiṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ gurumeva tu ।
tasmāllebhe ca sā putramaśmakaṃ nāma viśrutam ।।76।।
athotathya iti khyāta āsīddhīmān ṛṣiḥ purā ।
mamatā nāma bhāryā''sīttasya paramasaṃmatā ।।77।।
utathyasya yavīyāँstu purodhāstridivaukasām ।
bṛhaspatirmahātejā mamatāmanvapadyata ।।78।।
uvāca mamatā taṃ tu devaraṃ vadatāṃvaram ।
antarvatnī tvahaṃ bhrātrā tava tasmāttu devara ।।79।।
amogharetāstvaṃ cāpi dvayorgarbhe na saṃbhavaḥ ।
evamukto'pi sa kāmaṃ niyantuṃ na śaśāka ha ।।2.31.80।।
reme sārdhaṃ tayā cāthotsṛjantaṃ reta eva tam ।
abhyabhāṣata garbhastha autathyo'tra na saṃbhavaḥ ।।8 1।।
dvayoḥ kṛte nāvakāśo na pīḍāṃ kartumarhasi ।
aśrutvaiva tu tadvākyaṃ garbhasthasya bṛhaspatiḥ ।।82।।
śukrotsargaṃ cakāraiva tacchukraṃ garbhaśabālakaḥ ।
padbhyāṃ hataṃ papātorvyāṃ tataḥ kruddho bṛhaspatiḥ ।।83।।
śaśāpa garbhaṃ mūrkha tvaṃ tamo dīrghaṃ pravekṣyasi ।
sa vai dīrghatamā ṛṣirjātyandhaḥ samajāyata ।।84।।
kintu vidvānataḥ patnīṃ pradveṣīṃ nāma labdhavān ।
sa putrān janayāmāsa gautamādīn tapasvinaḥ ।।85।।
dīrghatamā vṛṣavacca prakāśe maithunakriyām ।
janānāṃ sannidhau cakre maryādānāśakṛd yathā ।।86।।
ṛṣayastaṃ tiraścakrurbhinnamaryādameva ca ।
pradveṣī taṃ sevate na tatastāmabravīnmuniḥ ।।87।।
bhārye tvaṃ māṃ kathaṃ naiva sevase vada kāraṇam ।
pradveṣī tu patiṃ prāha bhartā tu bharaṇānmataḥ ।।88।।
patiśca pālanāccāpi tvayi dvayaṃ na vidyate ।
pratyutā'haṃ bharaṇe te sasutā kleśabhāginī ।।89।।
bhavāmyaśaktā ca tato bhartrantaraṃ karomi ca ।
yatheṣṭaṃ kuru viprendra gacchāmyahaṃ janāntaram ।। 2.31.90।।
dīrghatamā uvāca-
adyaprabhṛti maryādā mayā loke vitanyate ।
eka eva patirnāryā yāvajjīvaṃ parāyaṇam ।।9 1 ।।
mṛte jīvati vā patyau nā'paraṃ prāpnuyānnaram ।
pare prāpte patitā sā bhavediti niyamyate ।।92।।
śrutvā kopayutā putrānuvāca pitaraṃ prati ।
badhvoḍupe kṣipantvenaṃ cāndhaṃ vipriyavādinam ।।93।।
putrā badhvā pitaraṃ taṃ coḍupe samavāsṛjan ।
gaṃgāyāṃ sa cānusrotaḥ plavamānaḥ pravāhake ।।94।।
naukā pravāhapatitā dūradeśaṃ gatā yadā ।
naukāsthamekalamandhaṃ śrīśanāmajapānvitam ।।95।।
apaśyadvai baliḥ rājā jagrāhainaṃ nināya ca ।
gṛhaṃ jñātvā ṛṣiṃ patnyāṃ niyuyoja sutārthakaḥ ।।96।।
sudeṣṇā rājapatnī sā na svīcakāra taṃ munim ।
svāṃ tu dhātreyikāṃ tasmai vṛddhāya prāhiṇottadā ।।97।।
tasyāṃ kākṣīvadādīṃścaikādaśa putrakān muniḥ ।
janayāmāsa ca tataḥ sudeṣṇā taṃ hyarocayat ।।98।।
tato jātāḥ sudeṣṇāyāṃ kumārāḥ pañca tatsutāḥ ।
aṃgo vaṃgaḥ kaliṃgaśca puṇḍraḥ suhmaśca te balāḥ ।।99।।
teṣāṃ deśā bhaviṣyanti tattannāmabhireva te ।
evaṃ baleḥ purā vaṃśaḥ prakhyāto vai maharṣiṇā ।। 2.31.10 0।।
parāśaro mapsyagandhāṃ dhīvarīṃ samapadyata ।
evaṃ pūrvataro dharmo nārāyaṇasya kā kathā ।। 101 ।।
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇabhogyaṃ nārāyaṇasya varṣma ca ।
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇapatnīrūpaṃ patirnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 02।।
mā śaṃkāṃ tvaṃ kuru rādhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।
māyāyāṃ garbhado yaḥ sa māyikyāmapi garbhadaḥ ।। 1 03।।
sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā sa eva parameśvaraḥ ।
sarvakanyāśca gṛhṇīyād yogyaṃ tasya sadā hi tat ।। 1 04।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya dharmatattvaṃ purābhavam ।
jñāyeta ca vilīyeta saṃśayaḥ puṇyabhāg bhavet ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kanyakānāṃ payovrataṃ, purādharmatattve śvetaketukṛtamaryādā, saudāsapatnyāṃ vasiṣṭhaputre'śmakaḥ, utathyabhāryā bṛhaspatispṛṣṭā, dīrghatamā balerdāsyāṃ rājñyāṃ ca putrānutpādayāmāsa, tato maryādākaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 31 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 031 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 32
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 033 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike māghe jātavighnanimittakam ।
grahādipūjanaṃ cakre svayaṃ gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 1 ।।
phālgune viṣṇuyāge ca kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ।
kṣetravighnapraśāntyarthaṃ grahaśāntyarthamityapi ।। 2 ।।
saurāṣṭravartibālānāṃ yogakṣemau yathā śubhau ।
bhavetāṃ ca yathā dānānyasaṃkhyāni hyadāttadā ।। 3 ।।
devānāṃ ca vibhinnānāṃ pūjāṃ pitā hyakārayat ।
mātrādīnāṃ tathā pūjāṃ baliṃ śreṣṭhamadāpayat ।। 4 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
grahā bālagrahāḥ ke te ye'rdayantīha bālakān ।
kathaṃrūpā grahā hyete vadātra kṛṣṇakānta me ।। 5 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
purā skando'bhavatputro rudrasya vīryasaṃbhavaḥ ।
pārvatyāśca tathā vahneḥ gaṃgāyā darbhakasya ca ।। 6 ।।
ṣaṇṇāṃ ca ṛṣipatnīnāṃ bālaḥ skandastadā'bhavat ।
devasenāpatirjāto lakṣmīstamāśrayattataḥ ।। 7 ।।
śrījuṣṭaḥ pañcamīṃ skandastasmācchrīpañcamī smṛtā ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtārtho'bhūd yasmāt tasmāt ṣaṣṭhī mahātithiḥ ।। 8 ।।
śriyā juṣṭaṃ mahāsenaṃ devasenāpatiṃ kṛtam ।
saptarṣipatnyaḥ ṣaḍdevyastatsakāśamathā'gaman ।। 9 ।।
ṛṣibhiḥ samparityaktā ūcuḥ putraṃ tu kārtikam ।
vayaṃ putra parityaktā bhartṛbhiścālpakāraṇāt ।। 2.32.1 0।।
asmābhiḥ kila jātastvamiti brāhmyamudāhṛtam ।
tena doṣeṇojjhitāḥ sma tasmānnastrātumarhasi ।। 1 1।।
svargasthānāccyutāḥ praśaṃkitā vai ṛṣibhirvayam ।
tadakṣayo bhavet svargastvatprasādāddhi naḥ kuru ।। 12 ।।
tvāṃ putraṃ cāpyabhīpsāmaḥ kṛtvaitadanṛṇo bhava ।
etatkāle mahendraśca skandaṃ prāha mahāmatiḥ ।। 13 ।।
abhijinnāmabhaginī tapastaptuṃ vanaṃ gatā ।
rohiṇyāstu kaniṣṭhā sā jyeṣṭhatāṃ tapasecchati ।। 14।।
tatsthānaṃ vartate riktaṃ skanda pūraya tatsthalam ।
kṛttikābhiśca nakṣatrasaṃkhyāpūrtiṃ vidhehi vai ।। 15।।
skandastāḥ kṛttikārūpā mātṝḥ ṣaḍ paryayojayat ।
nakṣatraṃ kṛttikākhyaṃ tad bhāti vai vahnidaivatam ।। 16 ।।
nanu ṣaṭkṛttikāstatra saptaśīrṣāmatā katham ।
iti cecchrūrayatāṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ tadvadāmi ca ।। 17।।
vinatā cābravīt skandaṃ māmapi tatra sannaya ।
skando dadau saptamaṃ ca sthānaṃ tasyai tadā śubham ।। 18।।
evaṃ tat kṛttikānakṣatraṃ mataṃ saptaśīrṣakam ।
atha tāḥ kṛttikāḥ procuḥ skandaṃ punaryathepsitam ।। 1 9।।
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva vaiṣṇavī ca narāyaṇī ।
gāyatrī durgikā māyā yāścaitāḥ saptamātaraḥ ।। 2.32.20।।
anādikālataḥ pūrvaṃ yā lokasya prakalpitāḥ ।
asmākaṃ tu bhavet sthānaṃ tāsāṃ caiva na tadbhavet ।।2 1 ।।
bhavema pūjyā lokasya na tāḥ pūjyā hi kārtika ।
tābhiścoktvā viyogo naḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ kārito yataḥ ।।22।।
icchāma āsāṃ mātṝṇāṃ prajā yāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ ।
tā asmākaṃ bhogakartryo bhavantu ṛṣivat sadā ।। 23 ।।
skandaḥ prāha pradattaṃ taccandrapatnyo bhavantu vai ।
parirakṣata cānyāṃśca putratulyān sadā tu naḥ ।।24।।
kṛttikāśca tadā prāhuḥ putra kurmastathā vayam ।
kintu ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā bhavanti taruṇā prajāḥ ।। 25 ।।
bhoktuṃ dehi ca no martyaprajā rūpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
skandaḥ prāha tathā'stvetat sukhayuktā bhavantu ca ।। 26 ।।
ahaṃ tu vaḥ pradāsyāmi raudramātmānamavyayam ।
paramaṃ tena sahitāḥ sukhaṃ svarge vasantu vai ।। 27।।
ityuktvā kārtiko dehāt puruṣaṃ pāvakaprabham ।
utpādya graharūpaṃ taṃ dadau tābhyaḥ sukhāptaye ।।28।।
taṃ nītvā raudrarūpaṃ tā yayuścāndramasīṃ bhuvam ।
skandāpasmāramityāhurgrahaṃ taṃ tattvavedinaḥ ।। 29 ।।
vinatā tu mahāraudrā kathyate śakunigrahaḥ ।
pūtanāṃ rākṣasīṃ prāhustaṃ vidyātpūtanāgraham ।।2.32.3 0।।
kaṣṭāṃ dāruṇarūpeṇa ghorarūpāṃ niśācarīm ।
piśācī dāruṇākārā kathyate śītapūtanā ।।3 1 ।।
garbhān sā mānuṣīṇāṃ tu harate ghoradarśanā ।
aditiṃ revatīṃ prāhurgrahastasyāstu raivataḥ ।। 32।।
so'pi bālān mahāghoro bādhate vai mahāgrahaḥ ।
daityānāṃ yā ditirmātā tāmāhurmukhamaṇḍikām ।। 33।।
atyarthaṃ śiśumāṃsena saṃprahṛṣṭāṃ durāsadām ।
kumārāśca kumāryaśca yā jātāḥ skandasaṃbhavāḥ ।।34।।
tāste garbhabhujaḥ sarve krūrakāryā mahāgrahāḥ ।
kumārāṇāṃ striyo yāśca kumārīṇāṃ narāśca ye ।। 35।।
te jāyamānān gṛhṇanti bālakān raudrakarmiṇaḥ ।
gavāṃ mātā tu surabhiryā vidyate surālaye ।।36।।
śakunistāmathā''ruhya saha bhuṃkte śiśūn bhuvi ।
saramā nāma yā mātā śunāṃ devī tu rādhike ।।37।।
sāpi garbhān samādatte mānuṣīṇāṃ sadaiva ha ।
pādapānāṃ tu yā mātā karañjanilayābhidhā ।। 38।।
saikā tu varadā rakṣākarī bhūtānukampinī ।
tāṃ karañjadrume putrārthino'rcayanti mānavāḥ ।। 39।।
athā'pyanyā mātaraśca grahā māṃsamadhupriyāḥ ।
divā ca rātrau tiṣṭhanti satataṃ sūtikāgṛhe ।।2.32.40।।
kadrūḥ sūkṣmavapurbhūtvā garbhiṇīṃ praviśatyatha ।
tatra bhuṃkte ca taṃ garbhaṃ nāgatulyaṃ prasūyate ।।41 ।।
gandharvāṇāṃ ca jananī garbhaṃ nītvaiva gacchati ।
tena vilīnagarbhā ca mānuṣī dṛśyate janaiḥ ।।42।।
apsarasāṃ janitrī tu garbhamāste pragṛhya tu ।
upanaṣṭo garbha iti janā vadanti tādṛśi ।।43 ।।
raktodadhestu yā kanyā dhātrī skandasya yā smṛtā ।
sā lohitāyanī nāmnā kadambe pūjyate janaiḥ ।।44।।
puruṣeṣu yathā rudrastathā''ryā pramadāsu sā ।
āryā mātā kumārasya pṛthakkāmārthamijyate ।।।45।।।
ete sarve kumārāṇāṃ bhakṣakā vai mahāgrahāḥ ।
yāvatṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi śiśūnāmaśivā hi te ।।46।।
ye tu mātṛgaṇāścāpi ye ca naragaṇā grahāḥ ।
sarve skandagrahā nāma loke bodhyā duḥkhapradāḥ ।।47।।
teṣāṃ praśamanaṃ kāryaṃ snānaṃ dhūpamathā'ñjanam ।
balikarmopahārāśca skandasyejyā viśeṣataḥ ।।48।।
evamabhyarcitāḥ sarve āyurvīryabalapradāḥ ।
athordhvaṃ ṣoḍaśādvarṣād ye bhavanti nṛṇāṃ grahāḥ ।।49।।
tān vadāmi śṛṇu rādhe māheśvarā hi te matāḥ ।
yaḥ paśyati naro devān jāgrat vā śayito'pi vā ।।2.32.50।।
unmādyati tadā kṣipraṃ taṃ tu devagrahaṃ viduḥ ।
āsīnaśca śayānaśca yaḥ paśyati naraḥ pitṝn ।।51 ।।
unmādyati tadā kṣipraṃ sa tu pitṛgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
avamanyate yaḥ siddhān śaptaḥ krodhena sādhubhiḥ ।।।52।।
unmādyati ca kṣipraṃ yaḥ sa tu siddhagrahaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
sañjighrāti ca yo gandhān rasāँścā''khādayatyapi ।।53 ।।
samunmādyati kṣipraṃ ca sa jñeyo rākṣaso grahaḥ ।
gandharvāścāpi yaṃ divyāḥ saṃviśanti naraṃ priyam ।।54।।
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ graho gāndharva eva saḥ ।
adhirohanti yaṃ nityaṃ piśācāḥ puruṣaṃ prati ।।।55।।
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ grahaḥ paiśāca eva saḥ ।
āviśanti ca yaṃ yakṣāḥ puruṣaṃ kālaparyaye ।।56।।
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṃ jñeyo yakṣagrahastu saḥ ।
doṣo grahaśca vaiklavyaṃ bhayaṃ ca ghoradarśanam ।।57।।
kaścit krīḍitukāmo vai bhoktukāmastathā'paraḥ ।
abhikāmastathaivā'nya ityeṣaḥ trividho grahaḥ ।।58।।
yāvadvārdhakyasaṃveśo bhavantyete grahā nṝṇām ।
ataḥ paraṃ dehināṃ tu grahatulyo bhavejjvaraḥ ।।59।।
saṃyamitendriyaṃ bhaktaṃ śuciṃ nipyamatandritam ।
āstikaṃ śraddadhānaṃ ca varjayanti grahāḥ sadā ।।2.32.60।।
na spṛśanti grahā bhaktān satīḥ sādhūn praśīlinaḥ ।
atha svāhā'bravīt skando mama putro'si vai priyaḥ ।।।61।।
dehi me śāśvataṃ vāsaṃ vastuṃ putra sahā'gninā ।
skandaḥ prāha dvijairmantraiḥ stutaṃ havyaṃ ca kavyakam ।।62।।
hoṣyatyagnau sadā svāhetyuktvā vāsaḥ sadā'stu te ।
yatra gṛhaṃ na havanaṃ tatra tvaṃ graharūpiṇī ।।63।।
bhaviṣyasi na sandehaḥ pañcake pañcakhādinī ।
ityuktā vahninā sārdhaṃ svāhā vasati nityadā ।।64।।
ityevaṃ te grahāḥ proktā vināśakāḥ kvacit kvacit ।
tasmātte pūjanīyā vai santuṣṭāḥ sukhadāḥ smṛtāḥ ।।65।।
gopālakṛṣṇaḥ phālgunyāmaṣṭamyāṃ tatsamarcanam ।
kārayāmāsa mantraiśca tattadbalipradānakaiḥ ।।66।।
pāyasaiḥ polikābhiśca śākairbharjitasatkaṇaiḥ ।
havyaiḥ kavyairgrahān sarvān tarpayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।67।।
atha skandastathā kṛtvā vinatā pūtanādikāḥ ।
dityaditipiśācyaśca surabhiḥ śakunistathā ।। 68।।
saramā kadrukī gandharvāpsarasāṃ ca mātaraḥ ।
dhātrī raktāyanī devapitṛsiddhagrahāstathā ।।।69।।
paiśācarakṣogāndharvā yakṣāḥ kāmā jvarāstathā ।
svāhāścetyapare vaṃśāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatigaṇāśca te ।।2.32.70।।
pratyakṣāścāyayurvyomnā cā'vateruḥ sarovare ।
yatra pūjā bhavatyeṣā saumyarūpadharāśca te ।।71।।
pūjāṃ prāpya baliṃ dugdhapākādi prāpya sarvathā ।
tṛptāśca tuṣṭuvurnārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।।72।।
vayaṃ nārāyaṇa viṣṇo duṣṭakāryakarā grahāḥ ।
pāpapāraṃ na yāsyāmastathaiva nirmitā yataḥ ।।73।।
tarema tu yathā māyāsāgaraṃ tatkṛpāṃ kuru ।
kṣamasva duṣṭabhāvānāmaparādhān sadā hi naḥ ।74।।
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastatra nā'smatprapīḍanam ।
nātra kṣetre praviśāmaḥ pīḍanārthaṃ kadācana ।।75 ।।
kurvasmānpāvanān kṛṣṇa caraṇāmṛtadānataḥ ।
tvaṃ grahāṇāṃ graho devo niyāmakaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।76।।
vāsaṃ tvaccaraṇe dehi pāvayitvā sadā śubhān ।
prapannāḥ smastava cāṃke gṛhāṇa naḥ svakiṃkarān ।।77।।
ityabhyarthya nipetuste pādayoḥ śrīharestadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenā'dbhiḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ ।।78।।
prokṣitāḥ pāvitāścāpi jalapānena tarpitāḥ ।
spṛṣṭāśca bhojitāḥ sarve divyabhāvaṃ tadā gatāḥ ।।79।।
ujjvalā devarūpāste yathā vai pārṣadā hareḥ ।
tataḥ prāha haristāँśca divyarūpaiḥ sarastaṭe ।।2.32.80 ।।
nityaṃ vasantu cātraiva nirātaṃkā nirāmayāḥ ।
nirupadravarūpāśca sadā śreyaskarāḥ surāḥ ।।8 1।।
grahatīrthaṃ dakṣiṇe'tra taṭe khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
sadā vaḥ pratimāścātra pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ ।।82।।
deśāntarasthitānāṃ vai teṣāṃ vaṃśajabālakāḥ ।
mā pīḍyantāṃ bhavadbhirvai deśāntaragatairapi ।।83 ।।
atha dvitīyarūpaiśca vicarantu mahīmimām ।
yathākāryaṃ prakurvantu grahakṛtyaṃ niyāmitam ।।84।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ daśayojanavistṛtam ।
vihāyā'nyatra vai chidre sati kurvantu dharṣaṇam ।।85।।
tatrāpi mama bhaktānāṃ mā kurvantu pradharṣaṇam ।
brahmaśīlavratānāṃ ca mā kurvantu pradharṣaṇam ।।86।।
satāṃ satīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ brahmiṣṭhānāṃ na dharṣaṇam ।
kurvantu tapatāṃ cāpi vratināṃ puṇyakarmaṇām ।।87।।
gobhūdevasatāṃ sevāṃ prakurvatāṃ ca nāpi vai ।
śucīnāṃ yogināṃ cāpi bhaktijuṣāṃ kuṭumbinām ।।88
pradharṣaṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ vā kurvantu naiva sarvathā ।
nāstikānāṃ nindakānāṃ piśunānāṃ tu dharṣaṇam ।।89
hiṃsakānāṃ matsariṇāṃ duṣṭānāṃ tvācarantu tat ।
adaivānāṃ cāpitṝṇāmanagnīnāṃ pradharṣaṇam ।।2.32.90
caurāṇāṃ madyapānāṃ ca paraduḥkhapradāyinām ।
khalānāṃ dharmahīnānāṃ kurvantu dharṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।।9 1
anyāyināṃ paranyāsabhakṣiṇāṃ bhedināṃ tathā ।
bhavatyo dharṣaṇaṃ kurvantu satkāryavirodhinām ।। 92
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ mahādivyaṃ sukhātmakam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyaṃ puṇyapāpavivarjitam ।।93
brahmārpaṇamayaṃ mokṣabhūmikaṃ mannivāsanam ।
tatra muktasvarūpāśca nivasantu madāśraye ।।94।
gururme lomaśastvatra mantraṃ dāsyati me tu vaḥ ।
yāntu tatra manuṃ prāpya tiṣṭhantu vaiṣṇavā grahāḥ ।। 95।
ityuktāste grahāḥ sarve dvedhārūpāḥ śubhāśubhāḥ ।
babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasaṃkalpāt chāyātmāno hyasaukhyakāḥ ।। 96।।
mūlarūpāstu te divyāḥ prayayurlomaśāśramam ।
lomaśaḥ pradadau mantraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam ।।97।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ kaṇṭhe dadau tebhyaḥ supuṇḍrakam ।। 98।।
evaṃ te vaiṣṇavā bhūtvā tasthuścā'śvasarastaṭe ।
chāyātmāno yayurdeśāntarāṇīṣṭāni yāni vai ।। 99।।
ityevaṃ bhagavān sarvagrahaśāntiṃ cakāra ha ।
bhaktānāṃ sukhadāste ca muktāḥ śreyaskarāḥ sadā ।। 2.32.10 0।।
ityevaṃ rādhike divyaścamatkāra udāhṛtaḥ ।
śṛṇuyāttaṃ paṭhedvā yastasya mokṣo bhavet sukham ।। 10 1।।
dhanadhānyapaśupakṣidhanāni ca bahūnyapi ।
putrapautrasutāputratadvaṃśāśca nirāmayāḥ ।। 1 02।।
bhaviṣyanti devatulyāḥ sarvānandapariplutāḥ ।
sarvetivarjitā dvandvavarjitāḥ svargavigrahāḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālagrahādīnāṃ pūjane teṣāṃ pratyakṣā''gamanaṃ teṣāṃ nāmarūpādibhirvarṇanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 32 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 33
