śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
caturthe vatsare bhādrapade'ṣṭamyā dine kṛtam ।
rādhike śrīharikṛṣṇacaritraṃ kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikānāryaḥ kanyakāścāpi koṭiśaḥ ।
vrataṃ ca ṛṣipañcamyāścakrurvai ṛṣipūjanam ।। 2 ।।
rājasvalyasthitau sparśadoṣasaṃsargahānaye ।
vratāṃgaṃ pūjanaṃ dānaṃ cakruḥ sarvāstataḥ param ।। 3 ।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ gaurīvrataṃ cakrurāvāhya pupujuśca tām ।
saptamyāṃ bhojayāmāsuḥ pāyasādinivedanaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
aṣṭamyāṃ dūrvayā gaurīṃ pūjayāmāsureva ca ।
aṣṭavarṣīyakanyānāṃ gaurīrūpeṇa pūjanam ।। 5 ।।
candanādyaiḥ kuṃkumādyairakṣatādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।
śṛṃgārairvividhairvastrairalaṃkārairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca miṣṭānnaiḥ pānaistāmbūlakaistathā ।
iṣṭavastupradānaiśca cakrurnīrājanādikam ।। 7 ।।
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tathā cakruratha gaurīvisarjanam ।
kartuṃ sarvāḥ striyaḥ kanyā yayuścāśvasarovaram ।। 8 ।।
gauryāḥ pratimā sarvābhirvṛtā skandheṣu pārthivī ।
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā divyakesaripṛṣṭhagā ।। 9 ।।
divyāyāṃ śibikāyāṃ ca dhṛtā cāmaracchatriṇī ।
evaṃ nītvā pratimāṃ śrīgaurīṃ gāyanti yoṣitaḥ ।। 1 0।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca bhavantyutsavabodhakāḥ ।
darśakāśca narā nāryo yayuḥ sahasraśaśca tām ।। 1 1।।
gaurīṃ cānte vīkṣituṃ vai tvaśvapaṭṭottare taṭe ।
yayau sākaṃ gopikābhiḥ kambharāśrīrhareḥ prasūḥ ।। 12।।
hariṃ bālaṃ saha nītvā gaurīvisarjanotsave ।
tīre gatvā striyo gaurīṃ sthāpayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 13।।
nāvyāropya tadā pūjāṃ pracakruḥ prārthanāṃ tathā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śaṃkaravattu naḥ ।। 14।।
taveva kāntimān kānto bhūyāditi prasīda naḥ ।
evaṃ samprārthya ca puṣpāñjaliṃ dadustataḥ param ।। 15।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādeṣu cakrurjale visarjanam ।
jayaśabdāstadā svargadvāramāsādya yoṣitām ।। 16।।
devān saṃharṣayāmāsuḥ pitṝँścarṣivarāँstathā ।
kṛte visarjane gauryāścamatkāro'bhavattadā ।। 17।।
vyāghraḥ kaścinmahāpuṣṭo vaṭavṛkṣocchrayāyataḥ ।
akasmādāgatastatra yatra śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 18।।
netre prasphārya ca mukhaṃ vyādāya vāsanāṃ sṛjan ।
karṇāvutthāpya pucchaṃ ca dhunvan romāṇi carma ca ।। 19।।
krodhaṃ pradarśayan pūrvapādāgreṇa mahīṃ likhan ।
kūrdanaṃ kṛtavān śīghraṃ dhartuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ।। 20।।
stabdhāḥ sarvā narā nāryo niśceṣṭā bhītito'bhavan ।
garjanayā'ntarīkṣaṃ ca kampamānaṃ tadā'bhavat ।। 21 ।
vṛkṣāścakampire vāyuḥ kṣaṇaṃ nirgatiko'bhavat ।
kṣitiḥ kampamayī jātā hṛdayāni cakampire ।। 22।
hāhākāro mahān jāto vyāghre cotpatite tadā ।
dudruvuḥ parito lokā mṛpyurūpavilokanāḥ ।। 23।
mātā tu kambharālakṣmīḥ prāha gaurī prarakṣatu ।
anyāśca kanyakāstatra cakrurvai niyamaṃ tadā ।। 24।
rakṣite kṛṣṇakānte'tra pūjāṃ kurmo niśāmukhe ।
gauryāścāpi ca durgāyāḥ punaḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ ।। 25।
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ cakrurjepurvai śrīnarāyaṇam ।
tasthurnetre karābhyāṃ ca prāvṛtya draṣṭumakṣamāḥ ।। 26 ।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ka āsīt sa mahāvyāghraḥ sāyaṃ kasmāt samāgataḥ ।
anyān tyaktvā hi taṃ bālaṃ dhartumeva samudyataḥ ।। 27।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ṛaktadeśajaścāsīt śāvadīnasya cānujaḥ ।
mleccho vai rākṣaso bhrāturvairaniryātanecchukaḥ ।। 28 ।।
kāmarūpadharo vyomni jale pragatimānapi ।
araṇye'pi kṛtāvāso vyāghrāyate kvacit kvacit ।। 29 ।।
janāyate manuṣyeṣu pakṣiṣu vihagāyate ।
evaṃvidho hi malino malināśaya eva saḥ ।। 30 । ।
yadā śrīhariṇā tasya bhrātā cāraktadeśake ।
hatastadā samudre'yaṃ gata āsīt pravāsakṛt ।। 31 ।।
abriktadeśe sarito nāvilāyāstaṭādati ।
viprakṛṣṭe sthale kretuṃ suvarṇādikhanimṛdaḥ ।। 3 2।।
svarṇamṛdaḥ samādāya svagṛhaṃ sa samāgataḥ ।
śrutavān svāgrajamṛtyuṃ kanyānāṃ haraṇādikam ।। 33 ।।
gurormṛtyuṃ viplavaṃ ca rājyaṃ jallāvaśaṃ tathā ।
bālotsavād vaiparītyaṃ balyutsave'pyanarthadam । । 34।।
vilokya vaiśasaṃ sarvaṃ cukrodhātiśuśoca ha ।
rājyaṃ sainyaṃ vyomagatirgururdevī yatiprathāḥ ।। 35 ।।
samartheṣu satsu nāśo balīyo bhālalekhanam ।
samarthe bhrātari dravye vipule'bdhiprarakṣite । । 36 ।।
deśe bhaṭairyute nāśo gṛhe eveti śocanam ।
asainyo'pi samāgatya hatvā videśajo janaḥ ।। 37।।
pakṣiṇā nāśayitvā cākṣatasya tasya sarvathā ।
kanyakāmātṛharaṇaṃ yatkāryaṃ taddhi śocanam ।। 38 । ।
aho śrutvā na me mṛtyurna vā śauryaṃ pravardhate ।
kiṃ vṛthā jīvanenaivaṃ parābhūtasya dehinaḥ ।। 39।।
ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ śatrumānayiṣyāmi putrikāḥ ।
yadvā prāṇān pradāsyāmi dhigbalaṃ yad vṛthābalam ।।40 ।।
vicintyaivaṃ svarṇanāvaṃ parityajya gṛhādikam ।
saha nītvā janān naijān bahurūpadharān yatīn । । 41 ।।
saurāṣṭre cāyayau hantuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram । । 42 ।।
viśālaṃ ca dadarśā'sau lomaśasyā''śramaṃ śubham ।
sarvaṃ dadarśa ca muhuśchidraṃ hantuṃ samīkṣate ।। 43 ।।
nityaṃ carati drugulme vasatyapi drumeṣu ca ।
sagaṇo bhramati kṣetre naikarūpadharaḥ khalu । ।44 । ।
tatra kecana vṛkṣeṣu kākāyante kvacit kvacit। ।
gṛdhrāyante tathā cānye vṛkāyante saro'ntike ।।45।।
śukāyante cāpare tu gavāyante tathetare ।
kecittu vṛṣabhāyante mārjārāyanta ityapi ।।46 ।।
maśakāyante kecicca chidraṃ draṣṭuṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
labdhuṃ cā'vasaraṃ hantuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhum ।।47।।
mīnāyante jale tvanye bālāyante ca kecana ।
kanyārūpadharāścānye bhavante tatsahāyinaḥ ।।48 ।।
evaṃ kṛte'pi kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ hantuṃ chidraṃ na cā''pnuvan ।
tadā nirāśāḥ satataṃ bhūtvā rājānujaṃ krudhā ।।49 ।।
prāhurnaiva hi labhyeta chidraṃ varṣaśatairapi ।
tasmāt prasahya hantavyo yadbhavet tadbhavediti । ।।50 ।।
evaṃ tu saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā tvāyayuḥ sarasastaṭe ।
śataṃ vīrā militvaiva hanmastaṃ rājaghātinam ।। 51 1 ।।
ekaikena kramād bhāvyaṃ vyāghrarūpeṇa vai śanaiḥ ।
prathamaṃ kanyakārūpairviśantu strījaneṣu hi ।। 52 ।।
ityevaṃ tu śataṃ kanyāḥ kanyāsu viviśustadā ।
hantuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ sandhyāyāṃ krūravṛttayaḥ । । 53 ।।
dṛṣṭvā hantuṃ susāralyaṃ strīṣu madhye narāyaṇam ।
ekalaṃ cā'rakṣakaṃ ca matvā rājā'nujaḥ svayam ।। 54।।
vairaniryātanārthāya vyāghraḥ sa prathamo'bhavat ।
utplutya bālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvaddhartuṃ gato'suraḥ ।।।6 5 । ।
tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra śarabho'bhūjjanārdanaḥ ।
jagrāha vyāghrarūpaṃ taṃ vallīdīnaṃ nṛpānujam । । 66 । ।
gale dhṛtvā harirvyāpādayāmāsā'suraṃ drutam ।
jayaśabdā harestatrā'bhavan puṣpapravarṣaṇam ।।57।।
devaiḥ kṛtaṃ duḥkhahānaṃ strībhiḥ śiro'vatāritam ।
śāvadīnā mahākālī kanyā gaurīsvarūpiṇī ।।58।।
svayaṃ śarabhacaraṇe samāgatya nanāma tam ।
bhagavāँstu tadā bālo'bhavat strīṣu yathā purā ।।19।।
vyāghro vyāghrān samutpādya tato mamāra tatra ha ।
tattīrthaṃ śārabhaṃ tatra jātamaśvasarovare ।।2.33.6 0।।
yatra snātaṃ ca kṛṣṇena hatvā taṃ tvasuraṃ tadā ।
atha devī mahākālī kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva kiṃkarī ।।6 1 ।।
mayā jñātaṃ na bhagavan vighnaṃ te yadupasthitam ।
kṣetrapālena na jñātaṃ kathaṃ kasmādidaṃ nviti ।।62।।
śrīhariḥ prāha subhage madicchā''sīttathāvidhā ।
hantavyo'yaṃ mayā duṣṭo jānīyānna yathā satī ।।63।।
kṣetrapālo na jānīyāttathā kāryaṃ mayā yataḥ ।
tvayā ca kṣetrapālena na jñātaṃ tatpraveśanam ।।64।।
idānīṃ paśyataṃ kanyāścaitāḥ śataṃ sunūtanāḥ ।
tatsahāyā asurāste channarūpā bhavanti vai ।।65।।
hantuṃ māṃ tvāgatāste'tra kramād vyāghrabhavecchavaḥ ।
hato'yamagraṇīstena trastāśchannā bhavanti te ।।66।।
devyā ca kṣetrapālena yāvad dṛṣṭāśca kanyakāḥ ।
abhavan vyāghrarūpāste militā vyāghrajeṣu ca ।।67।।
devīṃ kanyā hariṃ hantumutpeturyugapattadā ।
martavyaṃ vā māraṇīyāśceti kṛtvā viniścayam ।।68।।
tāvat kṛṣṇo yuddhaśaṃkhaṃ dadhmau śīghraṃ bhayaṃkaram ।
siṃho devīvāhanaśca drāgeva prasamāgataḥ ।।69।।
vyāghrāṇāṃ ninadāstatra babhūvurviśvabhañjakāḥ ।
vyāghrāraṇyaṃ samagraṃ tu ninādaiścābhipūritam ।।2.33.70।।
grahāḥ prakampire vṛkṣā bhūścacāla sarastathā ।
siṃho'pi garjanāṃ cakre phenāni nyapatad bhuvi ।। 71 ।।
uḍḍīyante sma ca vyomni phenajālāni garjanāt ।
tebhya siṃhā vyajāyanta kṣaṇāt pañcaśatāni hi ।।72। ।
siṃhān dṛṣṭvā balivyāghrāḥ kecit siṃhāstadā'bhavan ।
siṃhānāṃ vai tadā tatra saṃgrāmo'bhūd bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।73 ।।
siṃhasainyobhayayośca ghātanaṃ mukhapannakhaiḥ ।
āntrāṇāṃ karṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhacoṣaṇaṃ bahvajāyata ।।74।।
nārī naiva hi hantavyā cetyabhūd dharmasaṃgaraḥ ।
siṃhāḥ patanti saṃgrāme hanyante kṛtrimāśca te ।।75।।
mūlabhūtāstu hanyante śātravāḥ keśarāśrayāḥ ।
nyūnā bhavanti saṃkhyāyāṃ mṛtāste sarvathā mṛtāḥ ।।76 ।।
vardhante ca tadā devīsiṃhā mṛtodbhavāḥ punaḥ ।
vīkṣituṃ siṃhasaṃgrāmaṃ nṛsiṃho bhagavānapi ।।77।।
tvāyayau dhāmatastatra garjayan svargamaṇḍalam ।
krośāt krośaṃ samutpatya vyomni yuddhyanti siṃhajāḥ ।। 78 ।।
dadarśa bhagavāँścāpi jagarjā'mbarasaṃsthitaḥ ।
devīsiṃho yayau cābhi cakre svāgatamambare ।।79।।
siṃhajāstu tadā siṃhā nijaghnuḥ śeṣato'surān ।
nipeturvyasavaḥ sarve mṛtāḥ śataṃ puro hareḥ ।।2.33.8 0 ।।
tadātmāno hareścānugrahācchrīnṛsiṃhātmani ।
prayayurvilayaṃ tatra niṣpāpā kṣetrayogataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kṛtrimāścā'kṛtrimāśca mṛtāste narasiṃhake ।
layaṃ yātā yayurdhāmni nṛsiṃhena samaṃ tadā ।। 8 2।।
ye devīsiṃhajāścānye śiṣṭāḥ phenodbhavā api ।
śrīharistannivāsārthaṃ dadau dakṣiṇagaṃ vanam ।।8 3 ।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tu tajjātaṃ siṃhavāsamayaṃ sadā ।
vaṃśastvavicalasteṣāṃ bhavediti harirdadau ।। 84।।
varadānaṃ tathā bhojyaṃ vanyaṃ paśukulaṃ dadau ।
atha vyāghro mṛto yaśca vallīdīnastadā tataḥ ।।85।।
jātā vyāghrā hyabhavan ye siṃharūpā'vidhārakāḥ ।
hatā api mṛtā naiva tebhyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।86 ।।
stuvadbhyaḥ pradadau jīvadānaṃ svāsthyaṃ nirāmayam ।
vāsāraṇyaṃ dadau nityaṃ vyāghrāraṇyaṃ tu taddhyabhūt ।।87।।
vyāghrāṇāṃ vanayogyānāṃ vaṃśāḥ siṃhairhi miśritāḥ ।
vyāghrāraṇye tathā siṃhāraṇye syustaddharirdadau ।।88 ।।
varadānaṃ ca saurāṣṭre'raṇye vasanti te'niśam ।
vyāghrāste cā'surā mlecchāḥ siṃhāstu daivikā hi te ।।8 9 । ।
evaṃ vasanti saurāṣṭre dakṣiṇāraṇyakeṣu vai ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre siṃhavyāghramahāmṛdham ।। 2.33.90 । ।
yatrā'bhūnnarasiṃhaśca vyomno yatrā''yayau tadā ।
siṃhavyāghramahātīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tatprakathyate । । 91 । ।
yuddhottaraṃ niśārambhe babhūva vṛṣṭiruttamā ।
bhūtalaṃ svacchatāṃ prāptaṃ sarve svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ । । 92 ।।
kanyakāstāstataścakrurvrataṃ pūjāṃ ca jāgaram ।
durgāyāśca tathā gauryā kṛṣṇarakṣānimittakam । । 93 । ।
rātryante pūjitāṃ durgāṃ gaurīṃ kṣamāpya vai jale ।
cakrurvisarjanaṃ durgāgauryostato hariṃ prati ।। 94।।
yayuḥ sarvā darśanārthaṃ menire kṛtakṛtyatām ।
atha dānāni dattvaiva sampūjya lomaśaṃ gurum । ।95 ।।
pitarau pūjayitvā ca cakrurvai pāraṇāṃ tataḥ ।
yayau kālī svanilayaṃ siṃho'pyadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।96।।
svasthaṃ cābhūttu saurāṣṭraṃ nirbhayaṃ rādhike tataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiṣā camatkṛtiḥ ।। 97।।
śrūyate paṭhyate yena tasya śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet ।
aihikaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ bhavet santānatantujam ।। 98।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gaurīpūjanavisarjane, vallīdīnākhyavyāghrāsurasya śatena vyāghrasiṃharūpadhāriṇā'suravrajena saha vināśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 33 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 34
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 035 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ākarṇaya mahāprājñe rādhike pañcamābdikam ।
camatkāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā''tmā''tmanaḥ param ।। 1 ।।
pañcame vatsare prāpte prabhorjanmotsavaṃ pitā ।
kārayāmāsa vidhivat sarvadevaprapūjanam ।। 2 ।।
gāndharvāṇāṃ samājaṃ ca yojayāmāsa gāyane ।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa sauvarṇāmbarabhūṣitam ।। 3 ।।
naikaputtalikāśobhaṃ sarvadṛśyavirājitam ।
viśvakarmā svayaṃ tatra racayāmāsa devatāḥ ।। 4 ।।
mayaśca śambaraścāpi dadhatustatsahāyatām ।
jale sthalyāḥ sthale cā'pāṃ pṛthvyāṃ cābdheśca darśanam ।। 5 ।।
bhittau sabhāsadāṃ cāpi parṣadi yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
vyomni starasya koṇeṣūdyānānāṃ darśanaṃ yathā ।। 6 ।।
rājamārge nadīnāṃ ca niḥśreṇyāṃ gartadarśanam ।
gopure dīrghakoṣṭhānāṃ koṣṭhe gopuradarśanam ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ vilokane bhrāntā api vaijñānikeśvarāḥ ।
aśaktāścā'bhavan gantuṃ mārgadarśakamantarā ।। 8 ।।
praveśe gamane sthāne niṣadane vilokane ।
kuṇṭhitavṛttayaścāsan sabhyā vinā tu darśakān ।। 9 ।।
evaṃvidhe maṇḍape'tra bālakṛṣṇaṃ niṣādya ca ।
divye siṃhāsane ramye pupūjuḥ parameśvarāḥ ।। 2.34.1 0।।
upadāste dadurdivyāḥ pitā tāḥ pratigṛhya ca ।
prāsādikaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ putrotsave'tiharṣitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ samarcanaṃ kṛtvā pūruṣāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ ।
atha devyaḥ samāyātāḥ pūjanārthaṃ harestataḥ ।। 1 2।।
kuṃkumā'kṣatagandhādyaiḥ puṣpadarbhādibhistathā ।
aṃkurairvividhaiścāpi navadhānyādibhistathā ।। 13 ।।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādyaiḥ rāmaṇīyakavastubhiḥ ।
nīrājanairdukhahārā'vatāraiḥ samapūjayan ।। 14।।
upadāḥ pradadustāśca bhojyasthālīrnyadhuḥ puraḥ ।
śarkarāphalabījāni nyadhuḥ rasān purastriyaḥ ।। 15।।
atha pattanavāstavyāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
pupūjuḥ kanyakāścāpi hyāśīrvādān dadurdvijāḥ ।। 16।।
yatayo munayaścānyāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
āśīrvādān dadustasmai kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 17।।
atha pūjottaraṃ tatra tasthire gāyakā janāḥ ।
gāndharvā vādakāścāpi devamānavajātijāḥ ।। 18।।
hāhā hūhūrnāradaśca parvataścitradarśanaḥ ।
sudarśanastumburuśca viśvāvasuḥ parāvasuḥ ।। 1 9।।
meghasvanastāranādo dharaṇidhro'nugālavaḥ ।
vaṃśadharastaraṇiko jalaghoṣaśca vaiṇikaḥ ।। 2.34.20।।
āmramañjuścālaṃbuṣo rāṃbheyaḥ śaṃkhakarṭakaḥ ।
ityete devagāndharvāścūḍavarmapurogamāḥ ।।21 ।।
cakrurvai gāyanaṃ tatrotsave maṇḍapavartinaḥ ।
savāditraṃ tālamānagrāmamūrchādiśobhitam ।।22।।
athaibhyo bhagavāṃstuṣṭo hīrakamauktikasrajaḥ ।
dadau tato manuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvā āyayuḥ sabhām ।। 23 ।।
citrarathaḥ pratolaśca sāraṃgo maṇirañjakaḥ ।
tāramerustānasainyo jagannātho harītakaḥ ।। 20।।
bāṣpavarṣī dhūmramedhā śaśakundaḥ kapardakaḥ ।
ete cānye ca gandharvāścakrurgāyanavādane ।।25।।
tebhyo harirdadau ramyaṃ vibhinnaṃ pāritoṣikam ।
svarṇarūpyābhūṣaṇāni svarṇamudrā'mbarāṇi ca ।।26।।
atha dānavadaityānāṃ gāndharvā āyayuḥ sabhām ।
kambukīrtirgālavādo nassvano bhujaghoṣaṇaḥ ।। 27।।
khātadhvāno golabhūpaścaite cakruḥ pragāyanam ।
tebhyo dadau harirmuktāmaṇipravālamālikāḥ ।।28।।
atha nāgāścāraṇāśca sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ।
brahmabhaṭṭāśca vidyādhrāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpumaṃśakāḥ ।।29।।
āyayuḥ kāvyaracanaiḥ sahitāḥ parṣadi drutam ।
kauśalyaṃ darśayāmāsuḥ svasvakṛteḥ samājake ।।2.34.30।।
varṇayāmāsuratyartha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
pitā tebhyo dadau yogyaṃ pāvitoṣikavastukam ।।3 1 ।।
nartakyo gāyikāścāpi sagītinṛ×Vr̤M×tyavartanam ।
cakrurhareḥ pratoṣārthaṃ haristuṣṭo dadau dhanam ।। 32।।
bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārapātrāṇi dravyāṇi vividhāni ca ।
mālā'mvarāṇi divyāni strīyogyaṃ pāritoṣikam ।। 33 ।।
evaṃ santoṣitāstatra janmotsave'rthino janāḥ ।
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu muktā dhāmanivāsinaḥ ।। 34।।
akṣarā'mṛtagolokavaikuṇṭhādinivāsinaḥ ।
āśīrvādān dadustasmai sveṣṭāya paramātmane ।। 35।।
tān sarvān śrīharikṛṣṇaḥ utthāyotthāya cāsanāt ।
kṛtvā vakṣasi yugapannaikadhā pariṣasvaje ।। 36 ।।
bahurūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo jagrāha puṣpamālikāḥ ।
candanā'kṣatacandrāṃśca pūjāṃ taiḥ paritaḥ kṛtām ।। 37।।
tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ datvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।
sabhāyāḥ parihārānte pitā tebhyastu bhojanam ।। 38 ।।
dadau naikavidhaṃ pānaṃ tāmbūlaṃ toṣikaṃ tathā ।
sarve tadutsavaṃ kṛtvā yayurnaijaṃ sthalālayam ।। 39 । ।
evaṃ mahotsave jāte jayakāro'bhavanmahān ।
sarvalokeṣu jayatāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'rbhakaḥ ।।2.34.40 ।।
ityevaṃ janavācastvaśrūyanta sarvato bhuvi ।
mahādāneśvarastvāste śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
arthināmarthanāṃ cātikramyā'rpayati cepsitam ।
annaṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dravyaṃ vastraṃ ca vāhanam ।।42।।
yadyadiṣṭamādatte'rthī śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇataḥ ।
ityevaṃ bhuvane jātaṃ yaśo vyāptaṃ janeṣu ca ।।43 ।।
śrutvā himagirau dālbhyo bako gavāyanastathā ।
sālāyanaḥ svastidharmā ṛṣayo vanavāsinaḥ ।।44।।
sahasraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tat tapatāṃ vedapāṭhinām ।
sādhudharmasthitānāṃ tvagjaṭāvalkaladhāriṇām ।।45 ।।
siṃhavyāghramṛgahasticarmāmbarapradhāriṇām ।
āgataṃ tīrthayātrārthaṃ kṛtvā kurusthalāplavam ।।46 ।।
puṣkaraṃ siddhabhūmiṃ ca kṛtvā saurāṣṭramāyayau ।
kecanā'trā'bhavan divyāḥ sādhavo brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।47।।
vānaprasthāstathā'nye ca gṛhasthāḥ sādhusadṛśāḥ ।
tapodharmaratāḥ śāstraviśāradāśca yoginaḥ ।।48 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tvāyayuḥ pāvanaṃ param ।
viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu mokṣadaṃ bhagavatsthalam ।।49 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro ramyaṃ naikakrośasuvistaram ।
devakhātaṃ mahāmiṣṭajalaṃ ramyaṃ śaśiprabham ।। 2.34.50 ।।
sarvatīrthanivāsaṃ ca viśvaṃbharasamāśritam ।
vilokya sundaraṃ pūrve vanaṃ puṣpaphalānvitam ।।5 1 ।।
sarvartusmṛddhamamlānaṃ śāntiṃ te lebhire sthirām ।
lomaśasyā''śramadeśe māyā yatra na vidyate । ।।5 2।।
āmravaṇe tu ṛṣayaḥ svāsanāni pracakrire ।
sasnuḥ pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā bubhujire phalāni ca ।।53 ।।
atha pradakṣiṇaṃ cakruraśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
āyayurlomaśaṃ draṣṭuṃ mahābhāgavataṃ munim ।।54।।
āśrame sthitavantaṃ ca jambūvṛkṣatalāśrayam ।
natvā sahasramunayaścātmānaṃ dhanyamāpnuvan ।।55 ।।
lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre'rghyā''sanavandanādibhiḥ ।
phalaiḥ pānaiḥ svarṇakadalyādiphalaiḥ subhojanaiḥ ।।56 ।।
evamṛṣikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ svāgataṃ jagṛhuśca te ।
athā''yayurhareḥ saudhaṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīparameśvaram ।।57।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bālasvarūpiṇam ।
sahasrarūpadhṛk kṛṣṇo yugapattān suṣasvaje ।।58।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurdālbhyādyāḥ ṛṣayastadā ।
caturbhujaṃ tathā cāṣṭabhujaṃ sahasrabāhukam ।।59 ।।
dadṛśuḥ kecana bālaṃ brahmadhāmagataṃ prabhum ।
pūjanaṃ pādasalilaṃ vandanaṃ saṃvidhāya te ।।2.34.6 0।।
yayuḥ pūrvadiśāṃ naijāsanaṃ tvāmravaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
atha dvitīyadivase bhikṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇamandiram ।।6 1 ।।
āyayuste tu ṛṣayastadā śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
ghṛtapātraṃ godhūmānāṃ piṣṭapātraṃ ca śarkarām ।।62।
vyañjanāni tathā tailapātraṃ ca veṣavārakam ।
dvidalāṃ taṇḍulāँścāpi pārśve nyasya haristataḥ ।।63 ।।
svahastābhyāṃ dadau tebhyo vipulaṃ ca yatheṣṭakam ।
ekaikasmādapi pātrād dattaṃ na nyūnatāṃ gatam ।।64।।।
sahasrādhikasādhūnāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhojanāya ca ।
tadāścaryaṃ tu te jagmuḥ kṛṣṇapratāpavedinaḥ ।।65 ।।
gatāste saṃgṛhītvā cāmānnāni subahūnyapi ।
pācayitvā bubhujire śāntimāpustadā''mṛtīm ।।66 ।।
atha sāyaṃ hariḥ pitrā sākaṃ sādhusamājakam ।
draṣṭuṃ tatra gato yatrarṣayaḥ kesaricarmasu ।।67।।
kṛtāsanā virājante brahmadhyānaparāḥ śubhāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaśca pitaraṃ samuvāca tadā haṭhāt ।।68।।
sihacarma ca tāta pradāpayā''sanāya me ।
ityuktvā cāṃguliṃ dīrghā kṛtvā tātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 69 ।।
siṃhacarmaṇaḥ prāptyarthamanurodhaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tad dṛṣṭvā ca ṛṣirdālbhyaḥ pitaraṃ prāha vai hasan ।।2.34.70 ।।
kimayaṃ cecchati bālaḥ kiṃca vakti punaḥ punaḥ ।
pitā prāha vṛthā bālaḥ karoti haṭhameva vai ।।71 ।।
icchatyayaṃ siṃhacarma yatprāpyaṃ naiva jāyate ।
dālbhyaḥ prāha kumāra! tvaṃ siṃhamāroḍhumicchasi ।।72।।
siṃho'yaṃ vidyate nainamāroḍhuṃ śakyate'nyakaiḥ ।
kumāraḥ prāha ca ṛṣe dehi me tvāsanāya tat। ।।73 ।।
dālbhyaḥ prāha vanasthānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yogyameva tat ।
nānyayogyaṃ tataḥ putra dātavyaṃ naiva vidyate ।।74।।
śrutvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha pradehi me ।
naitad deyamṛṣiḥ prāha tadā śrīmannarāyaṇaḥ ।।75।।
siṃhaśabdaṃ cakāroccaigarjinārūpamulbaṇam ।
tacchrutvā carmarūpāste siṃhā vyāghrā mṛgādayaḥ ।।76 ।।
sarve sajīvatāṃ prāptāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ।
carmoparisthāḥ ṛṣayo nipeturbhūtale'bhitaḥ ।।77।।
trāsaṃ prāpuḥ satyasiṃhān vyāghrān dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃkarān ।
dudruvuste tu parito vyāghrāstu garjanādibhiḥ ।।78।।
araṇyaṃ cāntarīkṣaṃ ca pūrayāmāsurucchritam ।
āsamudrāntamevaiṣāṃ śabdāścākampayan mahīm ।।79।।
dhāvamānāḥ śataśaste siṃhāstathā mṛgādayaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ yeṣāmabhavaँśca carmāṇyete sajīvakāḥ ।।2.34.80।।
bhūtvā kṛṣṇapade natvā'raṇyaṃ siṃhādayo yayuḥ ।
dālbhyādyāḥ ṛṣayo yogaistānniroddhaṃ na śekire ।।81 ।।
ityevaṃ tu tadā vīkṣya camatkāraṃ hareḥ punaḥ ।
prapannāḥ pādayorviṣṇornārāyaṇasya te'stuvan ।।82।।
ekamevā'dvitīyaṃ yad brahmottamaṃ pracakṣate ।
taṃ tvāmātmeśvaraṃ viṣṇo praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।83।।
ekarāṭ saddharmasindho'nādisaṃbhava hṛtsthita ।
viśvaksena vṛṣāvarta praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।84।।
śuciśravo'mṛtavārdhe sanātanā'kṣayā'kṣara ।
havyabhuṅ mañjukeśā'ja praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।85।।
hṛṣīkeśā'graja puṣpahāsa bāla janārdana ।
carācaraniyantastvāṃ praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।86।।
savitustvaṃ vareṇyo'si hiraṇyagarbhasaṃsthitaḥ ।
vāsudeva kṛpāsindho praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।87।।
anantā''syā'nantapādā'nantaśaktiguṇāśraya ।
hotaḥ potarhomaheto praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।88।।
nārāyaṇa parabrahma śrīmadgopālabālaka ।
kambharāśrīgṛhajanma praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।।89। ।
puruṣottama viśvātmannūrdhvakarmana divaspate ।
sarvasākṣin surāṣṭreśa praṇatāḥ sma prasīda naḥ ।। 2.34.90 । ।
sarvebhyaḥ śreyasāṃ dātā devānāṃ daivataṃ mahat ।
trātā bhartā ca poṣṭā ca śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ prabho ।। 91 ।।
yaṃ na paśyanti paśyanto'smādṛśāḥ ṛṣayo'pi ca ।
tān paśyan bālarūpastvaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava naḥ prabho ।। 92।।
bhūmādistambaparyantaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram ।
māyājālaṃ kṛtaṃ yena namāmastaṃ śubhārbhakam ।। 93 ।।
yasyā'kṣiṇī sūryacandrau yadbāhū bhūmaśaṃkarau ।
yatpādau kṣīraśukleśau namāmastaṃ kṛpā'rbhakam । । 94। ।
āsanāni vinaṣṭāni kesariṇo vanaṃ yayuḥ ।
āsanārthaṃ bālakṛṣṇa pūryantāṃ no manorathāḥ । ।95। ।
evaṃ stuto'tha bhagavān rādhike prāha vai ṛṣīn ।
āgacchantu mahābhāgāḥ spṛśantu mama pannakham ।। 96 ।।
bhavatāṃ tvāsanānyā''virbhaviṣyanti dadhatviha ।
ityuktāste ṛṣayastu dālbhyabakādayastadā ।। 97 ।।
paspṛśuḥ śrīharervāmapādāṃguṣṭhaṃ kramāttataḥ ।
aṃguṣṭhasya nakhāttatra siṃhacarmādi yasya yat ।। 98 ।।
tattadāvirbabhūvaitajjagrāha munirāṭ tu tat। ।
sarveṣāṃ tāni carmāṇi śrīhariṇā'rpitāni vai ।.। 99।।
tataḥ sarve hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayan mudā ।
jagṛhuśca manuṃ tatra gopālakṛṣṇato'khilāḥ । । 2.34.100 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
tilakaṃ tolasīṃ mālāṃ nāma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 101 ।।
vaiṣṇavāḥ ṛṣayo bhūtvā divyadṛṣṭiyujastataḥ ।
tīrthayātrā samāpyaiva himaśailaṃ punargatāḥ ।। 10 2।।
tattīrthaṃ dālbhyatīrtheti nāmnā pūrvataṭe'bhavat ।
śrāvaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ pañcamā'bdike mahotsave vividhagandharvāṇāṃ gāyanāni dālbhyabakādisahasrarṣīṇāṃ siṃhavyāghrādicarmabhyaḥ siṃhādīnāṃ sajīvīkaraṇaṃ aṃguṣṭhāttattaccarmāvirbhāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 34 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 034 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 35
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 036 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanām ।
camatkāramayīṃ līlāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinīm ।। 1 ।।
ekadā tu naṭāstatrā''yayuḥ kailāsadeśajāḥ ।
naikanāṭyakriyāvijñāḥ samājastabdhatākarāḥ ।। 2 ।।
bahusādhanasampannāścaindrajālikabodhinaḥ ।
sahasramānavāstatra pañcaśatāni kanyakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
śataṃ gajāḥ śataṃ cāśvāḥ śataṃ ca gavayāstathā ।
śatamuṣṭrā gardabhāśca śataṃ kesariṇo daśa ।। 4 ।।

āyātā nāṭayavidhaye tuṣṭo hariḥ svayaṃ tataḥ ।। 11 6।।
dadau vāsaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarasyevottare taṭe ।
divyadehān pracakre tān sarvān naṭān naṭīḥ prabhuḥ ।। 117 ।।
pāritoṣikamiṣṭaṃ ca paradhāmagatiṃ dadau ।
tīrthaṃ tannaṭanāṭyākhyaṃ sarvoddhārakaraṃ param ।। 118 ।।
pāpināṃ tārakaṃ svargapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate ।। 11 9।।
parihāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā hariḥ svasyā''layaṃ yayau ।
saurāṣṭramānavā devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ।। 2.35.120 ।।
anye ca darśakāḥ sarve yayuḥ svasvālayān mudā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! kṛtvā nāṭyaṃ śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam ।। 1 2 1 ।।
nivāsamakarottatra gaṇaiḥ paśupatattribhiḥ ।
prāṇibhiḥ sarvathā cāśvasarasaścottare vane ।। 1 22।।
vaṭabilvakadambānāmaraṇye vāsamācarat ।
yāvat pṛthvī sthirā syācca tāvat tatra nivatsyati ।। 123 ।।
kṛṣṇaveṣastvayā sākaṃ rādhike'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
kṛtrimo nāṭyasaudhaśca tadānīṃ vilayaṃ gataḥ ।।1 24।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīśaṃkarāya vai ।
jagādā'nugrahaṃ kurvan nāṭye ye dehino'tra ca ।। 1 25।।
bhavān gaṇā narā nāryaḥ kanyakāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ।
sarve bhavantu ca dvedhā kṛpayā mama sarvathā ।। 126 ।।
divyarūpā mama muktā mama dhāmnyakṣarābhidhe ।
divyayānaiḥ prayāntyeva caturdhāmuktimāsthitāḥ ।। 127 ।।
etad dadāmi kṛpayā pāritoṣikamuttamam ।
anyarūpairvasantvatra vaṭabilvavane sadā ।। 1 28।।
ityevaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha nyūṣurharādayaḥ sadā ।
vasati śrīhariḥ saudhe śaṃbhoḥ saudhaṃ ca nirmame ।। 129 ।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaro devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
toṣayituṃ kṛtavāṃśca divyaṃ nāṭyotsavaṃ param ।। 2.35.130 । ।
bhagavānapi sarvātmā śaṃbhuṃ toṣayituṃ tadā ।
bhūtvā tu darśakastatra nāṭyabhūmau sthito'bhavat ।। 131 ।।
pūrayāmāsa bhaktasya śaṃbhormanorathaṃ hariḥ ।
bhaktādhīno yataḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'sti rādhike ।। 1 32।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kailāsīyā'rdhanārīśvaranāṭyamaṇḍalena kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṣetre kṛtā'laukikānekanāṭyaiḥ prabhuḥ santuṣṭaḥ san śaṃkaragarvagañjano mokṣadaścā'bhavat, naṭanāṭyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 35 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 36
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 037 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athā'nyatte pravakṣyāmi camatkāraṃ hareḥ śṛṇu ।
pañcame vatsare māghe gurorbalaṃ vilokya tu ।। 1 ।।
gatvā śrīlomaśasyāgre bālakṛṣṇasya śobhanam ।
pitā hi vidhivad vidyāraṃbhaṃ tenā'pyakārayat ।। 2 ।।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sarasvatīṃ vedānapūjayat ।
gaṇeśasyā'rcanaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtahomaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 3 ।।
viprān saṃbhojayāmāsa godānāni cakāra ca ।
sarasvatī prasannā vai sākṣāttadā samāgatā ।। 4 ।।
mayūrāsanaśobhāḍhyā haste vīṇāṃ nidhāya ca ।
caturdaśasvarūpābhirvidyākanyābhirarcitā ।। 5 ।।
sarvābhūṣaṇavastrālaṃkāraśobhāsamanvitā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samarcya śāradā ।। 6 ।।
bālakṛṣṇe'dṛśyabhāvamupāgatā hareḥ priyā ।
tatastasyāstu yāḥ sakhyaḥ śrutayaḥ smṛtayastathā ।। 7 ।।
ākhyāyikāśca kavitāstarkaśaktiśca kāṇḍikāḥ ।
mimāṃsāśca samādhiśca viviktiśca kathāstathā ।। 8 ।।
māntrikī tāntrikī cāpi yāntrikī bhautikī tathā ।
kalāśca gaṇanāścāpi vinyāsāśca kriyāstathā ।। 9 ।।
rāsāyanī kalpanā ca sāṃgrāmikīndrajālikā ।
jyotirmayī ṛcaḥ sāmnī cātharvī ca yajurmayī ।। 2.36.10।।
śābdī chāndasī nairuktī kārṣeyī lekhinī tathā ।
sāmudrī vāyavī cāpi svāpnī mohinī śākunī ।। 1 1।।
śārīrikī mānasī ca jaiveyī sāmarī tathā ।
sañjīvanī ca vaivartī cārtavī dhātavī tathā ।। 12।।
cikitsā'stramayī divyā saṃhāriṇī ca poṣaṇī ।
śilpinī bhūstarī tattvaśodhinī khanimārgiṇī ।। 13।।
vaidyatī bahubhavanī sīvanī garbhavedinī ।
drāviṇī mūrchinī caivamādyā vidyāśca kanyakāḥ ।। 14।।
dhāvalyakāntidhāriṇyaścampakābhāḥ kiśorikāḥ ।
sarasvatīmanu kṛṣṇe viviśuḥ pratimātmikāḥ ।। 15।।
evaṃ bāle gurodvārā vidyāprāptirabhūttadā ।
tathāpi lokarītyaiva rekhā'bhyāsaṃ tadā'karot ।। 16।।
akṣarāṇāṃ ca śabdānāmabhyāsaṃ ca tathā'karot ।
vedaśāstrādividyānāṃ nidhānaṃ dṛśyate janaiḥ ।। 17।।
atha tāḥ kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ sevante bahireva tam ।
antarhitāstu vartante sevante cāntare sadā ।। 18।।
prāvirbhūtāśca vartante sevante kāntameva tam ।
śāradāyāstu tāḥ sakhyo vavrire śrīnarāyaṇam ।। 1 9।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇabālaṃ parameśaṃ patiṃ prabhum ।
samūrtāstāḥ sadā nyūṣurlomaśasyāśrame śubhāḥ ।। 2.36.20।।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivā''jñayā vidyāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।
nityaṃ bālaḥ prayātyevābhyasanārthaṃ guruṃ prati ।।।1 ।।
lomaśastaṃ sadā prātaradhyāpayati sārthakam ।
gṛhṇāti lokavat kṛṣṇo gurustutoṣa cāpyati ।।22।।
sevāṃ gṛhṇāti kanyāyāṃ tato yāti gṛhaṃ nijam ।
athaikadā devaguruḥ samāyāllomaśāśramam ।।23 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo nanāmainaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sureḍitam ।
vṛhaspatistadā buddhiparīkṣārthaṃ hareḥ khalu ।।24।।
sannidhau lomaśasyaiva papraccha tarkasammitam ।
guñjābhārasuvarṇasya kati mūlyaṃ bhaved vada ।।25।।
bālaḥ prāha sthiraṃ cet syād guñjaikamātramūlyakam ।
yadi syān naikadhā nityaṃ krayavikrayayojitam ।। 26।।
svatvāni parivartante yāvatsaṃkhyāni tatra tu ।
tāvadguṇaṃ dadātyeva vastu bhinnaṃ vibhinnakam ।। 27।।
lakṣavarṣaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ yāvaddhastagataṃ bhavet ।
tāvadguṇaṃ bhavenmūlyaṃ tasmādanantamūlyakam ।। 28।।
guñjāmātraṃ suvarṇaṃ tat tadeva parivartate ।
tatkrītaṃ nūtanaṃ vastu nūtanaṃ nūtanaṃ milet ।।29।।।
evamanantamūlyaṃ tat suvarṇaṃ mīyate guro ।
śrutvaivaṃ cottaraṃ gurustutoṣa tārkikaṃ ca tam ।।2.36.30 ।।
āśīrbhiryojayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvavid bhava ।
kaumāraṃ pañcāmā'bdāntaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatu puṣṭidam ।। 31 ।।
vidyodayayutaṃ stātte paugaṇḍaṃ daśamāvadhim ।
kaiśoramāpañcadaśānmahodayaparaṃ tava ।।32।।
tataḥ paraṃ yauvanaṃ te tvanantānandabhṛd bhavet ।
śāśvataṃ jīvanaṃ te'stu sanātanasvarūpatā ।।33।।
ityevamāśiṣo datvā prāpya pūjāṃ tadā kṛtām ।
papraccha śrīhariṃ yāsyan varāṭakaṃ mahāsuram ।। 34 ।।
paścimābdhitaṭasthaṃ ca tapantaṃ tapa uttamam ।
ahiṃsantaṃ vadan satyaṃ vratamasteyamāsthitam ।। 39।।
brahmacaryaparaṃ sarvaparigrahavivarjitam ।
śocānvitaṃ ca santuṣṭaṃ svādhyāye ca rataṃ sadā ।। 36 ।।
brahmaparaṃ samicchantaṃ rājyaṃ saurāṣṭrabhūmayam ।
samudrotthaṃ sālamālāsuraputraṃ balādhikam ।। 37।।
bhagavannatra saurāṣṭre paścimābdhitaṭāntike ।
tapatyugraṃ rājyalabdhyai sālaputro varāṭakaḥ ।। 38 ।।
pañcāgnīँstapati grīṣme śiśire tiṣṭhate jale ।
varṣāsveva tathā cāste vāyvāhāro nirantaram ।। 39।।
śiro bhūmau cāmbare ca pādau kṛtvā divāniśam ।
omitivyāharannāste rājyārthaṃ sa mahāsuraḥ ।। 2.36.40 ।।
indreṇaitattapo jñātvā preṣito'haṃ vrajāmyataḥ ।
upadekṣyāmi taṃ tādṛg yatastapo nivartate ।।4 1 । ।
upadeśaya māṃ tādṛk tannivṛttiryathā bhavet ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'si parameśvaraḥ ।।42।।
devānāṃ rakṣakaścā'si daityānāṃ damanapradaḥ ।
tadyathā devaśūlo'yaṃ rājyaṃ nā''sādayettathā ।।43 ।।
śādhi māṃ bhagavan gatvā kariṣyāmi ca tattathā ।
śrutvaiva bhagavānāha śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 44 ।।
icchāmyahaṃ ca daityasya taporodho yathā bhavet ।
sāmnā daityo vāraṇīyo guro tadyogyabodhinā ।।45।।
kathayāmi daityadharmān daityajñānakriyādikam ।
tvayā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa hyupadeśaḥ pradīyatām ।। 46।।
prāyo daityā āsurāśca dānavā indriyatṛpāḥ ।
dehātmavādamāśritya vartante kāmakārataḥ ।।47।।
daityānāṃ tu balaṃ dharmo yuddhātsampatsamarjanam ।
prasahya haraṇaṃ kṛtvā svāyattīkaraṇaṃ tathā ।।48 ।।
parākramaṃ daityadharmastapo dharmo virāgiṇām ।
tasmāttapasaḥ pracyāvya dehadharmānnibodhaya ।।49।।
devadharmavirodhaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ pāpaśūnyatām ।
hiṃsanaṃ ca puraskṛtya daityadhamānnibodhaya ।।2.36.50 ।।
pratyakṣaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ vai paraloko na vidyate ।
tapaḥphalaṃ sadā phalgu tathā taṃ vai nibodhaya ।।5 1 ।।
īśvaraḥ pakṣapātī ca devānāṃ hitakārakaḥ ।
daitye kāpaṭyamādāya viruddho'stīti bodhaya ।।52।।
varadāne'pi rājye'pi cānte daityavināśakaḥ ।
parameśaśca daityena ghātya eveti bodhaya ।।53 ।।
ityevaṃ ca samādiṣṭo gururvṛhaspatiḥ svayam ।
natvā kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā lomaśaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca ।।54।।
yayau varāṭakaṃ daityaṃ paścimā'bdhitaṭasthitam ।
vipro bhūtvā'mbarādevā'vatatāra mahāmuniḥ ।।55।।
tejasā prajvalan saumyaḥ prasādena samanvitaḥ ।
dhyānamagno'bhavad daityo bhūmiko'mbarapādavān ।।56।।
vipro vilokayāmāsa śraddhākaṣṭasahaṃ kṣaṇam ।
tataḥ śanairjagādainaṃ varāṭaka! prapaśya mām ।। 57।।
tava kāmaprapūrtyarthaṃ samāgato'smi cā'mbarāt ।
paśya varaya bhadra te kimicchasi vadā'dhunā ।।58।।
tvayi sarvaṃ balavati vartate paśya māṃ dvijam ।
kimanena mahāghorakaṣṭadena tava priyam ।।59।।
kartavyaṃ tapasā taddhi yadasādhyaṃ balāt kila ।
balasādhyaṃ balenaiva cāptavyaṃ baladharmiṇā ।। 2.36.60।।
ityuktaḥ sa dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā praṇanāma ha ।
uvāca vada me sarvaṃ dehi tathepsitaṃ varam ।।6 1 ।।
vṛhaspatistadā taṃ tu rādhike samabodhayat ।
kimicchasi vada kaṣṭaṃ kathaṃ samuhyate nvidam ।।62।।
āgato'smi varaṃ dātuṃ brāhmaṇo'haṃ sanātanaḥ ।
śrutvā varāṭakaḥ prāha svāgataṃ dvija te'stu vai ।।63।।
rājyārthaṃ tu karomyetattapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
śādhi māṃ pratapantaṃ ca varaṃ dehi tathāvidham ।।64।।
yathā saurāṣṭrarājyaṃ ca pravindāmi sukhapradam ।
śrutvā bṛhaspatiḥ prāha śṛṇu daitya balī bhavān ।।65।।
kathaṃ kaṣṭaṃ hi sahase tapo dharmo virāgiṇām ।
rājñāṃ dharmastu samaro nirbalānāṃ vṛṣastapaḥ ।।66।।
sabalastvaṃ tapastyaktvā samācara parākramam ।
udyamena prasiddhyanti balināṃ vai manorathāḥ ।।67।।
tapasā nirbalānāṃ ca dharmeṇa yajvināṃ tathā ।
sainyena tu nṛpāṇāṃ vai vidyayā viduṣāṃ tathā ।।68।।
rodanena tu bālānāṃ mohanena tu yoṣitām ।
kṛcchreṇa tu parādhīnavṛttīnāṃ sevanādibhiḥ ।।6 9।।
prāyopaveśanenaiva prajānāṃ nṛpatiṃ prati ।
śatrūṇāṃ ghātanenaiva siddhirbhavati vai dviṣām ।।2.36.70।।
evaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya yatnaṃ tvaṃ balavān kuru ।
anyaḥ kaścitpradātā me tapaseti matiṃ tyaja ।।7 1 ।।
bhūtvā vai balināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛcchraṃ sahase yadvṛthā। ।
śarīraṃ balahīnaṃ syād bhogayogyaṃ na vai bhavet । ।72।।
paradattaṃ prabhuñjānaḥ praśasyate na sarvathā ।
kṣudhayā tvindriyagrāmaḥ śaithilyaṃ vindati drutam ।। 73 ।।
vārdhakyaṃ jāyate śīghraṃ yadvā nāśo'pi jāyate ।
tasmāt kṣudhāṃ parityajya dehapuṣṭiṃ vidhatsva vai ।। 74। ।
puṣṭireva paro dharmo bhogā mokṣaḥ paro'tra vai ।
ānandaḥ sukhavaipulyaṃ svargaṃ vai jīvataḥ smṛtaḥ । । 75 ।।
bhogahīnaṃ gataṃ cāyurdinaṃ vā vyarthameva tat ।
dehanāśe kathaṃ saukhyaṃ vigataṃ na hi lābhakṛt । । 76 ।।
mṛtyuttaraṃ na cāyāti vāṅmātrakalpitaṃ phalam ।
anena yanna vai dṛṣṭaṃ pareṇa dṛśyate katham ।। 77।।
atra yogye'pi bhuktaṃ na cāyoge bhujyate katham ।
grahakāle parityāgaṃ mūrkho mukhyaṃ samīhate ।। 78 ।।
śarīraṃ cendriyaṃ jīvamanādṛtya svakaṃ sukham ।
kaṣṭaṃ sahate pāpātmā svaghātī sa tu gīyate ।।79।।
sukhaghātaścātmaghāto narakaṃ duḥkhavedanam ।
narakaṃ tvaṃ parityajya nivartasvātmaghātanāt ।।2.36.80 ।।
kenā'yaṃ dorakaste'tra pragrāhitastapomayaḥ ।
ātmahiṃsāmayo vyarthaḥ pāpodvegā'dyaśevadhiḥ ।। 81 ।।
dehinā dehasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ mantavyaṃ satyameva ca ।
dehasaṃsargahīnaṃ tu sarvamasatyameva yat ।।82।।
rāgotsavāśca bhogāśca dehe satyeva santi hi ।
bhogābhāvastapastattu jaraṭhānāṃ svabhāvajam ।।8 3 ।।
balena prāpyate lakṣmīḥ pṛthvī yuddhena cāpyate ।
bhāgyena cāpyate nārī sampadudyamato matā ।।84।।
janmato maraṇāntaṃ ca jīvanaṃ na punarbhavaḥ ।
dṛṣṭaḥ kenāpi tasmāt tvaṃ tapo hitvā sukhaṃ vraja ।।85।।
janmato jīva ityukto maraṇe mokṣa ucyate ।
dvayormadhye sukhaṃ svargaṃ dehaścātmāśrayo mataḥ ।।86 ।।
vividhā viṣayāstatra bhoktavyā nityadā'sura ।
vinā bhogaṃ gataṃ cā'hastadeva hānikārakam ।।87।।
gataṃ tattu gataṃ naitat punarāyāsyati kvacit ।
abhuktaṃ ca gataṃ dāne gataṃ tad viphalaṃ nijam ।।88।।
nijasaukhyapradaṃ yattatsaphalaṃ svasya saukhyadam ।
na karoti svayaṃ yatnaḥ ko'nyastasmai pradāsyati ।।8 9।।
tasmāduttiṣṭha dukhāttvaṃ yatnaṃ kuru varāṭaka ।
puṇyaṃ tu sukhadaṃ karma bhogātmakaṃ ca tanmatam ।। 2.36.90 ।।
kuru karma sukhadaṃ vai mā tapo duḥkhadaṃ kuru ।
prasuptasya mukhe naiva kavalaṃ jāyate svataḥ ।।91 ।।
prayatasya kare'vaśyaṃ samāyāti dhanādikam ।
nahi kaścitphaladātā na ca kaścitpareśvaraḥ ।।।92।।
ātmano na paraḥ kaścit kaṃ paraṃ tvaṃ pratīkṣase ।
tyaja sarvaṃ cendrajālaṃ kuru sannāhamulbaṇam ।।93 ।।
bahusainyānvito bhūtvā svāyattīkuru medinīm ।
ko nijaḥ kaḥ paraśceti yadbhogyaṃ tannijaṃ matam ।।94।।
yadabhogyaṃ paraṃ tattu tad balādarjayed budhaḥ ।
abhyudaye'nukūlā ye te dharmā vastuto matāḥ ।।986।।
tatra ye pratikūlāste parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ ।
anukūlān daityavaryān saṃgṛhya rājyamarjaya ।।96 ।।
sukhaṃ bhukṣva paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ daityāँśca sukhinaḥ kuru ।
yadi te rocate vākyaṃ damanaṃ daitya cintaya ।।97।।
śukrācāryaṃ tathā cānyān militvā balamāpya ca ।
īśamanyān vijayasva dānavīyaṃ vṛṣaṃ cara ।। 98।।
mṛṣā pūjā mṛṣā dhyānaṃ saṃyamo'pi mṛṣaiva ca ।
mṛṣā vrataṃ mṛṣā pāpaṃ mṛṣā svānupayogi ca ।।99।।
mṛṣā ceśo mṛṣā cā''sthā mṛte sarvaṃ mṛṣā mṛṣā ।
mṛṣā cā''śā niṣphalā yā mṛṣā vāṇī hyanarthikā ।। 2.36.100 ।।
mṛṣā balaṃ vinā śauryaṃ mṛṣā śauryaṃ vinā matim ।
mṛṣā matirduḥkhaphalā mṛṣā sarvaṃ napuṃsake ।। 10 1।।
yadi cettvaṃ pumānāsse maitanmṛṣā'nugo bhava ।
yatnasādhyaṃ kuru śīghraṃ mā mṛṣā madvacaḥ kuru ।। 1 02।।
pipīlikāśca kīṭāśca yatante ṛtumāśritāḥ ।
kaṇān saṃgṛhya balato bhuñjate śītapīḍitāḥ ।। 1 03।।
siṃhā vikramamāsādya labdhvā vanyagajādikam ।
balena bhuñjate medaṃ medinīṃ bhuṃkṣva tattathā ।। 1 04।।
bhūmirnārī ca sampacca yatnaṃ vinā na labhyate ।
yaśaḥ śaucaṃ sādhutā ca tapo vinā na labhyate ।। 1 05।।
anyasādhanata tattvaṃ sādhanāntarato na vai ।
vicārya tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai kuru dānavapuṃgava ।। 106 ।।
haṃsā mānasarastyaktvā samudraṃ yānti yatnataḥ ।
mauktikānāṃ bhojanāni labhante ca viyanti ca ।। 1 07।।
kākā api paryuṣitaṃ labhante yatnanoditāḥ ।
nīḍe gatā nāpnuvanti cālasā iva mānavāḥ ।। 1 08।।
karṣukā yatamānāstu labhante sasyajaṃ phalam ।
nahi tattapasā labhyamannaṃ rājyaṃ ca kāmanā ।। 10 9।।
mukhe dhṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭarasaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadāti hi।
nahi vahnau ghṛta tṛptiṃ dadāti bhasmatāṃ gatam ।। 2.36.110 ।।
tvaṃ kathaṃ yauvanaṃ vīryaṃ balaṃ śūnye juhoṣi vai ।
kiṃ phalaṃ lapsyase tatra coṣare tapāatmani । । 111 ।।
tasmāduttiṣṭha vijñānaṃ mayā dattamupāśraya ।
dharmaṃ dānavavaryāṇāṃ gṛhāṇa tyaja rogiṇām ।। 112 ।।
ityukto dānavastena guruṇā rādhike kṣaṇam ।
vicārya ca tapastyaktvā kṛtārtho'smītyabhāṣata ।। 113 ।।
yadahaṃ bodhitaḥ satye nirāśāparipanthini ।
varaṃ dehi yathāhaṃ syāṃ bhūbhṛt tathā kṛpāṃ kuru ।। 114 ।।
tathā'stviti guruḥ prāha tapastatyāja dānava ।
vipro bṛhaspatistuṣṭastaporodhanasatphalaḥ ।। 115 ।।
jagāda dānavairyuktaḥ samārabhasva medinīm ।
svāyattīkartumevā'smāt sthānād rājyaṃ yathā bhavet । । 116 ।।
śubhaṃ bhūyācca sarveṣāṃ tava bhūyād yatheṣṭakam ।
mama varānusāreṇa bhūbhṛttvaṃ te bhaviṣyati । । 117 ।।
ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ pūjāṃ nītvā divaṃ prati ।
varāṭako'pi daityendrān saṃgṛhya mantraṇāṃ vyadhāt । । 118 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhorvidyārambhe sarvavidyāprāptiḥ, buddhiparīkṣā, bṛhaspatikṛto varāṭakadaityāya yatnaśīlatopadeśaḥ, daityasya tapastyāgaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 36 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 036 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 37
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 038 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha daityastato rādhe! daityānāha mahattamān ।
pāvadurgaṃ makhkhanaṃ ca saiṃhikeyaṃ ca coṭilam ।। 1 ।।
dhāreyaṃ ca viśvasanaṃ yoddhṛmukhyānmahābalān ।
airakaṃ thūrakaṃ nīmbaṃ cairakaṃ barburaṃ tathā ।। 2 ।।
śālmaliṃ jhimpaṭaṃ kūrciṃ karkaśaṃ gṛñjakaṃ tathā ।
tamalākaṃ ca laśunaṃ palāṇḍukaṃ ca bhaṃgakīm ।। 3 ।।
ahiphenaṃ mahājihmaṃ vatsanāgamaphenakam ।
hirakaṃ viṣakandaṃ ca hyetān daityadhurandharān ।। 4 ।।
saurāṣṭrarājyalabdhyarthaṃ yuddhārthaṃ samuvāca saḥ ।
karkaṃ ca kṛkalāsaṃ ca śillakaṃ godhakaṃ tathā ।। 5 ।।
ghorakhādaṃ vṛkaṃ dvīpaṃ śītadhāraṃ ca nāyakān ।
mantrāṇārthaṃ ca yuddhārthaṃ prāha varāṭako balī ।6 ।।
vipraḥ kaścittu māṃ prāha tapaḥ kaṣṭaṃ mahattaram ।
niṣkiñcanānāṃ dharmaḥ sa nirbalānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 7 ।।
sabalānāṃ tu samaro dharmo rājyaṃ yato labhet ।
tasmāt saurāṣṭradeśānāṃ svāyattīkaraṇaṃ yathā ।। 8 ।।
asmākaṃ daityavaryāṇāṃ tathā syāt kuruta drutam ।
vinā raṇaṃ na vai bhūmirvinā yūthaṃ na vai jayaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vinodyogaṃ na vai sampad yūthodyogaraṇāḥ sukhāḥ ।
asmābhiśca prakartavyaṃ haraṇaṃ sampadāṃ balāt ।। 2.37.1 0।।
saurāṣṭrasya tu deśasya tathā rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
sarve prāhustadā magnā oṃ bāḍhaṃ vijayo'stu te ।। 11 ।।
atha paścimavārdhestu samārabhyā'surāstu te ।
grāmasthān pīḍayāmāsurjahruśca gṛhasampadaḥ ।। 12।।
grāmāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ vai paścimodadhisannidhau ।
prasahya daityaiḥ svāyattīkṛtaṃ bhūśca tathottarā ।। 1 3।।
khāḍikāsannidhau svāyattīkṛtā prāyaśaśca taiḥ ।
śuśrāva rājā khaṭvāṃgaḥ sārvabhaumo'suraiḥ kṛtam ।। 14।।
prajānāmardanaṃ sampaddharaṇaṃ brāhmaṇārdanam ।
rājyasaṃsthāpanaṃ ceti vijñāya nṛpatīśvaraḥ ।। 15।।
vyomamārgeṇa tu sainyaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūri saḥ ।
parito vyūhamāracya yuyudhire ca tadbhaṭāḥ ।। 16।।
daityā api tadā vyomni yuyudhire ca taiḥ saha ।
astraiḥ śastraiḥ śaraiḥ kuntairbhallaistomaraśaktibhiḥ ।। 17।।
prāsairbāṇaiḥ khaḍgavaryairasibhirmudgarādibhiḥ ।
parighaiśca gadābhiśca vahnigolaiḥ suraṃgakaiḥ ।। 18।।
jalagolairviṣagolairaśrubāṣpairviṣā'nilaiḥ ।
kṣveḍā'nalaiḥ śītavṛṣṭyā vidyudvṛṣṭyā vihāyasi ।। 1 9।।
jhaṃjhāvātairdhūmavātaiḥ śilāvṛṣṭyā ca pāṃsubhiḥ ।
parasparaṃ subahvībhiḥ kṛtendrajālasṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।2.37.2 0।।
māyāprayogakairvyomakṛtrimaputtalaistathā ।
kṛtrimayānagabhaṭaiḥ sainyāni yuyudhustadā ।।21 ।।
naṣṭāstatrā'surāścā'nye mānavā bahudehinaḥ ।
parājitā asurāste nirāśā abhavan yadā ।।22।।
abdhiṃ praviṣṭuṃ cecchanti dhāvamānā itastataḥ ।
kintu khaṭvāṃgadasainyānyabhitaḥ paritastathā ।।23 ।।
bhūmau vyomni jale kṛtvā prākārāṇi samantataḥ ।
vidyante'to na nirgantuṃ śekurdeśād bahirhi te ।। 24।।
atha mugdhā hi te daityā jīvanecchāparāstadā ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ viśālaṃ cāpyagādhakam ।। 25।।
vicārya sampradhāvyaiva viviśustajjale talam ।
manasā te tu rakṣārthaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।।26।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kambharānandanaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇabālakam ।।27।।
karuṇāśevadhiṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum ।
uddhārārthaṃ jagatyasmin prādurbhāvagataṃ harim ।।28।।
dinā'nātha kṛpāsindho duḥkhoddhārakara prabho ।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛjjīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ ।।29।।।
khaṭvāṃgadasya sainyāni nāśayantyabhito hi naḥ ।
aparādhaprakartṝṃstannaḥ prapannānava prabho ।।2.37.3 0।।
yuddhadharmaṃ samāśritya baladharmaṃ tathā'parām ।
daityadānavarītiṃ ca rājyamāptuṃ kṛtodyamāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tatraiva yadyaparāddhaṃ tava keśava rakṣaya ।
kṣamāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho śādhi daṇḍaṃ vidhehi ca ।।3 2।।
ityevaṃ jalamadhyasthāḥ stutiṃ cakruryadā'surāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇastadā śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau svasya raṇā'ṅgaṇe ।।3 3 ।।
koṭirūpo'bhavattatra vyomni bhūmau jale'pi ca ।
vīkṣya sainyāni tatraiva vigarvā hyabhavan kṣaṇāt ।।34।।
atha senādhipatayo vyomnā taṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।
hariścā''jñāpayat tāँśca, mā ghātyāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ ।।35।।।
jīvagrāhān gṛhītvaiva dāsyāmyetānahaṃ bhaṭāḥ ।
yathāparādhadaṇḍaṃ vai kariṣyāmi prayāntu śam ।।36 ।।
svāgataṃ cāpi satkāraṃ bhojanaṃ pānamityapi ।
gṛhṇantu lomaśāttvatra guroryogivarācchubhāḥ ।।37।।
ityuktāste tu sainyānāṃ parihāraṃ vyadhurdrutam ।
lomaśena yathājñaṃ ca satkṛtā bhojanādibhiḥ ।।38।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
iti mantrapradānena vaiṣṇavāste bhaṭāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 39 ।।
atha teṣāṃ sannidhau ca lomaśasyā''śrame śubhe ।
niśi daityān samāhūya bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।2.37.40।।
cakre'parādhavaddaṇḍaṃ teṣāṃ vai rādhike yathā ।
tatra varāṭakaṃ daityaṃ daṇḍaṃ giriṃ vyadhāddhariḥ ।।41 ।।
paścime tvabdhitīre sa varāḍo nāma parvataḥ ।
samabhūcchrīharṣadevīsevitaśca bṛhaspateḥ ।।42।।
varadānād bhūbhṛdayaṃ parvataḥ samajāyata ।
pāvadurgaṃ hariścāpi pāvādurgaṃ tu parvatam ।।43 ।।
nirmame daṇḍarūpaṃ tatsaurāṣṭrapūrvato diśi ।
makhkhanaṃ parvataṃ cāpi nirmame makhkhanābhidham ।।44।।
saiṃheyakaṃ ca siṃhādriṃ coṭilaṃ cāpi parvatam ।
coṭīlakaṃ nirmame ca dhāreyaṃ dhārarūpiṇam । ।45। ।
viśvasanaṃ ca vai viśvāmitraṃ nāma tu parvatam ।
cakre śrībhagavāँsteṣāṃ tīrthāvāsena puṇyatā ।।46। ।
śrīnārāyaśaraṇāgateḥ prāptaṃ śubhaṃ phalam ।
yatra vai munayaḥ santaḥ sadvā vasanti pāvanāḥ । ।47।।
atha yāsyanti muktiṃ te kalpānte brahmaṇā samam ।
atha ye'nye'pi daityā vai yoddhārastebhya ityapi । । 48 ।।
dadau daṇḍaṃ vadāmyatra rādhike tūdbhidudbhavam ।
airakaṃ tu samudre vai stambaṃ patrānvitaṃ tadā । । 49 ।।
kṛtvā dadau varaṃ kuṣṇaprāptiḥ kvacidbhaviṣyati ।
cairakācāpi 3 vārdhau vāsaṃ stambātmakaṃ dadau । ।2.37.50 ।।
thūṭakaṃ kaṇṭakaṃ hastānvitaṃ prākāravad bhuvi ।
rakṣākaraṃ cakārāpi cirajīvitvamipyapi । । 51 ।।
nimbaṃ kaṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ taṃ rarakṣa nṛpāṃgaṇe ।
barburaṃ kaṇṭakavyāptaṃ dantadhāvanapādapam । । 52 ।।
nadīśailāditīrtheṣu nyavāsayacchubhāśrayam ।
śālmaliṃ parvate'raṇye mṛduruphalabhūṣitam ।।53 । ।
vṛkṣaṃ kṛtvā dadāvasmai ruphalaṃ caupadhānikam ।
tūlairbhavati sarvatra sukhadaṃ śreṣṭhināṃ hi tat ।।54।।
atha vai jhimpaṭaṃ stambaṃ śalākāḍhyaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
dīrghā mārjanikā yeṣāṃ bhavanti hyupakārikāḥ । ।55।।
kūrciṃ kharjanikāvallīṃ cakāra bhagavān vane ।
karkaṭaṃ cātikaṭukaṃ vallīrūpaṃ vyadhātprabhuḥ ।।।56।।
gṛñjakaṃ ca tamālaṃ ca dhūmrapānārthakaṃ vyadhāt ।
laśunaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ ca kandarūpe vyadhātprabhuḥ ।।57 । ।
ahiphenaṃ mahājihmaṃ bhaṃgāṃ ca vatsanāgakam ।
viṣarūpān vyadhāt kṛṣṇo'phenakaṃ kṣārakaṃ vyadhāt । ।58 ।।
hīrakaṃ khanijanyaṃ tu viṣāktaṃ kaṃkaraṃ vyadhāt ।
viṣakandaṃ bhūmigarbhaṃ vyadhātkandaṃ vināśakam ।। '99।।
kṛkalāsaṃ śillakaṃ godhakaṃ karkaṃ sarīsṛpān ।
ghorakhādaṃ vṛkaṃ dvīpaṃ śitadhāraṃ paśūn vyadhāt ।। 2.37.60 ।।
tānsarvānasurān kṛṣānārāyaṇaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।
āvāsayad vane bhūmau jale vṛkṣe ca bhittiṣu ।।6 1 ।।
ete sarve hyasurāśca vaṃśavistāravardhitāḥ ।
tīrthayogena tu muktiyogyāḥ kṛtā hi śārṅgiṇā । ।62 । ।
tataḥ prajānāṃ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ ca vyajāyata ।
bṛhaspatirmahendraṃ ca yayau prāha varāṭakaḥ । ।6 3 । ।
tāpasā cyāvito yuddhabuddhimāropitastadā ।
yuddhaṃ cakāra rājyārthaṃ prāpitaḥ śailatāṃ sa hi ।।64।।
anye'pi ca tathā daityā daṇḍena yamitā dṛḍham ।
śrutvā śāntiṃ jagāmā'tha saurāṣṭramabhavat sukham ।।65।।
evaṃ prabhoḥ śubhaiśvaryaṃ rādhike! kathitaṃ tava ।
satāṃ tīrthaprasaṃgena te vai yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।।66। ।
athā'nyatte kathayāmi caritraṃ pāpiśodhakam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya rādhike śṛṇu ।।67। ।
mlecchā ḍaphpharajātīyā aṭavīmanusṛtya ca ।
samudrayānamārgaiśca nyūṣurgatvā surāṣṭrake ।।68।।
pāpāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ paśumāṃsādanāstathā ।
pakṣimatsyāśanāḥ patnīpatidharmavivarjitāḥ ।।69।।
pāśavīṃ vṛttimārūḍhāḥ parasampatprajīvanāḥ ।
cauryakarmakarāḥ śaśvat dānadharmādivarjitāḥ ।।2.37.70।।
yatra kvāpi nivāsāśca parakṣetrānnahārakāḥ ।
astraśastradharāḥ śvādikrūraprāṇiprapoṣakāḥ ।।71 ।।
vyādhadharmaparāḥ śaśvadaṭavyāṃ vāsinaḥ khalāḥ ।
luṇṭakā mārakāḥ sarvahārakāḥ krūracāriṇaḥ ।।72।।
śakaṭoṣṭrakharavāhāḥ parabhāgyodaraṃbharāḥ ।
sasyavināśakāḥ kṛṣikarmakāraprapīḍakāḥ ।।73।।
sahasramānavāḥ sākṣād yamadūtabhayaṃkarāḥ ।
madyapānakarāḥ kvāpi manuṣyajñātināśikāḥ ।।74।।
nirdayā dhūrtatāyuktā devadharmādinindakāḥ ।
saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ sarvān pīḍayanti sma sarvataḥ ।।75।।
hāhākāro'bhavad deśe dikṣu vidikṣu tatkṛtaḥ ।
janāstu pīḍitāstaiśca svaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।76 ।।
āyayurnijarakṣāyāḥ prārthanārthaṃ hariṃ prati ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।77।।
nyavedayan svakāṃ pīḍāṃ tajjātāṃ sarvaghātinīm ।
śrutvā śrībhagavānāha karomi tasya cauṣadham ।।78।।
ityuktvā sa prasasmāra cakraṃ svasya sudarśanam ।
tathā tatkṣetrapālāँśca kālīṃ mlecchavināśinīm ।।79।।
ardhanārīśvarasainyaṃ sarvaśastrāstramaṇḍitam ।
garuḍaṃ ca gajaṃ divyaṃ prasasmāra haristadā ।।2.37.80।।
āyayuḥ śīghramevaite nemuśca pādayorhareḥ ।
jñāpayāmāsurājñārthaṃ śrīharistānuvāca ha ।।8 1 ।।
mlecchā daphpharajātīyāḥ pīḍayanti surāṣṭrakam ।
corayanti dhanānnāni kṛṣivastūni sarvathā ।।82।।
kṛṣeścā'pyupakaraṇānyaṭavīsthāni yāni tu ।
chedayanti suvallyādi vṛkṣān stambān latādikāḥ ।।83 ।।
gulmān puṣpaphalāḍhyāँśca śākakandān haranti ca ।
patrasasyādidhānyāni cārayanti paśūn nijān ।।84।।
pakvakaṇiśaśūkāँśca haranti kṣetrasasyataḥ ।
ghnanti kvacinmanuṣyāँśca haranti vṛṣagodhanam ।।85।।
hariṇāँśca śaśādīँśca mārayanti hi pāpinaḥ ।
prajājanān prasahyā'pi badhvā nayanti vai kvacit ।।86।।
narān nārīrbālakāँśca pīḍayanti prajājanān ।
sahasraśo'tra vartante hyaṭavyāmita uttarām ।।87।।
diśaṃ yāntvaparādhibhyo daṇḍaṃ dadatu tān yathā ।
yathā naivaṃ punaḥ kuryuryadvā ghnantu samantataḥ ।।88।।
ityuktā mūrtimat cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ ca kālikā ।
ardhanārīśvaraṃ sainyaṃ garuḍaśceti sevakāḥ ।।89।।
militvā prayayuḥ śīghraṃ dikpharān śāsituṃ tadā ।
dikpharāste vilokyaitān śikṣakān hantumudyatāḥ ।।2.37.90।।
prāsatomarabhallaiśca gadāmudgarakhaḍgakaiḥ ।
bandhūkībhiḥ śaraiścāpi cakrādibhirvyadhurmṛdham ।।91 ।।
tadā sainyaṃ tvardhanārīśvarasyaitān jaghāna ha ।
prāsaistomarabhallādyairgadādaṇḍā'simudgaraiḥ ।।।9 2।।
śarairbāṇaiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca prastarairgolikādibhiḥ ।
śaktibhiḥ pāśabhedaiśca yuyudhe daphpharaiḥ saha ।।9 3 ।।
prāṇaglahaṃ samabhavad yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam ।
ubhayoḥ pakṣayorvirā nidrāṃ gacchanti śāśvatīm ।।।94 ।।
vilokyaivaṃ tadā cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ svayaṃprabham ।
vahnicakraṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā ḍaphpharā'nīkamāpatat ।।95।।
kabandhebhyo mastakāni nikṛntati sma vegataḥ ।
yasya yasya gale lagnaṃ dvedhā kṛtvā pragacchati ।।9 6 ।।
ḍaphpharāste bahavo vai hatāstvanye vidudruvuḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ te śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।।9 7 ।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣā saṃkartavyā prabhuṇā yataḥ ।
jīvato na hatāḥ śeṣā deśapāraṃ nivāsitāḥ ।। 98।।
śatāni pañca jīvanto yayurnatvā'nyataḥ sthalam ।
kintu svakṛtapāpaiste samudre nauprabhañjanāt ।।9 9 ।।
jale magnā yayurmṛtyuṃ dapaphanā mlecchajātayaḥ ।
saurāṣṭraḥ sukhavānāste śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ ।। 2.37.100 ।।
pīḍāḥ sarvā gatā lopaṃ prajāḥ saukhyaṃ samāśritāḥ ।
sudarśanādyāstatkāryaṃ kṛtvā śrīharisannidhau ।। 10 1।।
sajīvanāḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā divyā ye yuddhamarditāḥ ।
te'pyāgatya namaścakrustato mūrtau layaṃ gatāḥ ।। 102।
ardhanārīśvarasainyaṃ sarastīre tiro'bhavat ।
jayakāro'bhavat pṛthvyāmāyudhānāṃ harerapi ।। 103 ।।
ityetad rādhike bālakṛṣṇasya caritaṃ tava ।
kathitaṃ śrāvapāṭhābhyāṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham ।। 104 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne varāṭakākhyā''surasainyādiparājayadaṇḍādikā ḍaphpharajātīyamlecchanāśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 37 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 037 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 38
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 039 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi pañcame ।
varṣe vaiśākhamāse ca dhavale pūrṇimātithau ।। 1 ।।
sāyaṃ brahmavāṭikāyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃyayau ।
kundakusumasaugandhyā'nilodyāne vayasyayuk ।। 2 । ।
itastato viharati ramate yāti bālakaiḥ ।
prāyaḥ sāyaṃ samayasya sannidhau parameśvaraḥ ।। 3 । ।
vāṭikāyāṃ samudbhūtāṃ makāyīṃ jārikāṃ tathā ।
paśyan haridrasapatrāṃ ḍoḍikākaṇaśobhanām ।। 4 ।।
gṛhṇana taḍḍoḍikāstāsāṃ vahnau sekaṃ vidhāya ca ।
bālakaiḥ saha saṃbhukte ḍoḍikānāṃ kaṇāँstadā ।। 5 । ।
atha pārśve pavanaiśca pakvānyāmraphalānyapi ।
patitāni samādāya bhuṅkte vayasyakaiḥ saha ।। 6 ।।
nāraṅgisantarāmiṣṭamusambikharjurādakān ।
bhuṃjate bālakāḥ sarve vāṭikāyāṃ mudā'nvitā ।। 7 ।।
athā''yayustadā tatra trayo ve rākṣasāḥ khalāḥ ।
bālarūpā babhūvuste sahacoṣyaṃ pracakrire ।। 8 ।।
remire bubhujustatra vahante vāhayantyapi ।
dhāvanti cāpi kūrdanti hasanti hāsayanti ca ।। 9 । ।
dhyenādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hantuṃ samicchukaḥ ।
eko vai rākṣasastatrā'bhavacchakaṭarūpadhṛk ।। 2.38.10 ।।
vāṭikāyāṃ plakṣavṛkṣasyā'dho vāsaṃ vidhāya saḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ nāśayituṃ samīkṣate'tirāgataḥ ।। 11 ।।
dvitīyo rākṣasastatra vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ।
bālakā yatra vai kṣetre krīḍāṃ kurvanti tatpuraḥ ।। 1 2।।
gatvā dantaṃ viniṣkāsya ghūṇaṃ krūraṃ pradarśayan ।
pucchaṃ vidhunvan naijāṃ sa garjanāṃ sampravartayan ।। 1 3।।
dhāvaँstataścātivegānmārayituṃ samāyayau ।
bālāste vikarālaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā gantrīṃ vilokya ca ।। 14।।
plakṣaṃ pratyeva śīghraṃ tu dhāvanti sma bhayānvitāḥ ।
cakruśuḥ śīghramevaitāḥ śakaṭaṃ prāpya vai drutam ।। 15।।
cakrād dhurād yathāmārga gantrī tvāruruhustadā ।
kṛṣṇastatra prasasmāra kālīkesariṇaṃ drutam ।। 16।।
kālyāḥ śrīkṣetrapālinyā vāhanaṃ siṃha eva saḥ ।
tūrṇaṃ tatrā''yayau divyo diśo ninādayan dṛḍhaḥ ।। 17।।
garjanāṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā śakaṭasthān praṇamya ca ।
utplutya sūkara taṃ ca rākṣasaṃ dhṛtavān balāt ।। 18।।
sūkaro'pi tu siṃhena yuyudhe balatastadā ।
siṃharūpaṃ dadhārā'tha kṣaṇena garjayan muhuḥ ।। 19।।
ninādayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ pūrayan yuyudhe bhṛśam ।
kṛtrimasyā'sya siṃhasya kiṃ balaṃ kṛtrimaṃ mṛṣā ।। 2.38.20 ।।
kālīsiṃhena sahasā līlayā vidhṛto gale ।
kaṭyāṃ ca nakharaistīkṣṇairudare bheditastadā ।। 21।।
vyāpāditaḥ samantāccā''krośanmṛtaḥ kṣaṇādanu ।
tadātmā śrīkālikāyāḥ siṃhe cābhinnatāṃ gataḥ ।। 22।।
athā'trāvasare jñātvā śakaṭaṃ ca nirāśrayān ।
svādhīnān bālakān sarvānambare cocchritaṃ hyabhūt ।। 22 ।।
ākāśapathamāśritya bālānnāśayituṃ tadā ।
prakṣiptuṃ bhūtale vyomacaraṃ bhūtvā yayau drutam ।।24।।
tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇena gurutvaṃ svasya vardhitam ।
atibhāreṇa śakaṭaṃ bhūtalaṃ pratyavātarat। ।। 25।।
yathā bālā na naśyeyuḥ kṛṣṇastathā'vatārayat। ।
bālakāścā'vatīryaiva plakṣamūlaṃ samāśritāḥ ।। 26।।।
bālakṛṣṇastato gantryāstriveṇīmūlataḥ kṣitau ।
pādaṃ vāmaṃ pralambaṃ ca kṛtvā'tha dakṣiṇaṃ padam ।। 27।।
triveṇyupari saṃsthāpya karābhyāmavalambya tām ।
yāvat samāvatarituṃ yatate tāvadeva tu ।। 28।।।
śakaṭākhyā'sureṇā'dhastriveṇyāḥ kīlako mahān ।
śaṃkuvad vardhitaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prahantuṃ tūdarāntare ।। 29।।
triśaṃkukīlakaścātitīkṣṇo dīrgho hariṃ prati ।
lambamānastīkṣṇadhāro dṛṣṭo vai bālakaistadā ।।2.38.3 0 ।।
hariṃ prāhustu te bālā bālakṛṣṇo'pi līlayā ।
nā'vātarad yato yāvadudaraṃ svaṃ rarakṣa vai ।। 31 ।।
lambamāne vāmapade sakthinī mūlasannidhau ।
śaṃkustīkṣṇaḥ śakaṭena prasahya sampraveśitaḥ ।।32।।
sakthimadhyāttadā raktadhārā susrāva rādhike ।
bālakṛṣṇastadā śīghraṃ samutplutya tu gantrikām ।। 33 ।।
punaścāvā''rurohā'tha jñātvā duṣṭaṃ mahāsuram ।
hantuṃ punargurutvaṃ ca śailatulyaṃ dadhāra ha ।। 34।।
tena bhāreṇa namitaṃ śakaṭaṃ bhagnameva ca ।
patitaṃ condhikā ceṣā coṣṭraścakre dharo'rditāḥ ।।35।।
adṛśyaśailabhāreṇa śakaṭaścūrṇatāṃ gataḥ ।
visismire'rbhakāḥ sarve'suraśca jīvato hataḥ ।। 36।।
tattejo niḥsṛtaṃ gantryā bālakṛṣṇe tiro'bhavat ।
athaivaṃ śakaṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ vīkṣya naṣṭaṃ ca sūkaram ।। 37।।
tṛtīyo rākṣaso bālasvarūpastrāsamāvahat ।
maraṇaṃ tvantikaṃ jñātvā'vicārayaddharermṛtim ।।38।।
kathaṃ bālaḥ prahantavyaścaivameva mayā'tra vai ।
vinā śailasvarūpaṃ na bālasyā'sya vighātanam ।। 3 9।।
tasmācchailo bhavāmyeva nipatāmi drutaṃ tathā ।
ityadhyavasya sahasā vyomamārgaṃ gato'bhavat ।।2.38.40 ।।
tatra śailasvarūpo'bhūd yāvatpatitumicchati ।
tāvat kṛṣṇo garuḍaṃ svaṃ prerayāmāsa vegataḥ ।।41 ।।
garuḍo divyarūpaśca saprakāśaṃ vihāyasā ।
uḍḍyamānaḥ padbhyāṃ taṃ śailaṃ jagrāha yatnataḥ ।।42।।
tāvaddhariṇā cakraṃ svaṃ sudarśanaṃ bahūlbaṇam ।
jvālāmālābharaṃ śailadāhakaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ।।43।।
muktaṃ bhūbhṛdadhobhāge śailastena drutaṃ mahān ।
vidyujjvālānibhacakravahninā dagdhatāṃ gataḥ ।।44।।
tadbhasma bhūtale vahniyogāt sahāyivāyunā ।
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya patitaṃ viprakīrṇāsu bhūmiṣu ।।45।।
gauramṛd sā babhūvā'pi pāṇḍurā bhūtalasttare ।
garuḍaḥ sūkṣmatāṃ prāpya cakraṃ bhūtvā ca śītalam ।।46।।
svasthānaṃ tu samāyāte kṛṣṇo bālā nirāmayāḥ ।
nirvighnā: sukhinau jātā bālakṛṣṇasya sakthini ।।47। ।
raktaṃ ca niḥsṛtaṃ yattu tatra pṛthvyāṃ svayaṃ tadā ।
nīrujīkaraṇāyāścoṣadhyāḥ patraraso'rpitaḥ ।।48।।
śīghraṃ śāntistadā jātā śaṃkucihnaṃ tu sarvadā ।
dhyānināṃ dhyānayogārthaṃ kṣatarūpaṃ prarakṣitam ।। 49।।
sarvadā rādhike bālakṛṣṇasakthnaḥ śubhāvaham ।
cihnaṃ tad vidyate mūrtau dhyānāya netravanmahat ।।।2.38.50।।।
ārdhanārīśvarabhāvavyañjakaṃ vāmasakthijam ।
cihnaṃ vai śāśvataṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyā devyastadarcayat ।।5 1।।
pṛthvī pūjāṃ cakārā'sya cihnasya candanādibhiḥ ।
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca dhyāne cihnaṃ dadhustataḥ ।।52।।
bālāḥ sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ yātāḥ kālī siṃhādisevitā ।
svasthānaṃ cottarabhūmau sarasastatra saṃyayau ।।5 3 ।।
kālikātaśca bālebhyaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaghātanam ।
pitrādyā vismitāḥ sarve vighnaśāntiṃ vyadhustadā ।। 54।।
dadṛśuḥ sūkaraṃ gantrīcūrṇaṃ ca gaurabhasma ca ।
rākṣasāste mṛtā yatra tatra gatvā hi mānavāḥ ।।55।।
āścarye lebhire sarve krośadehaṃ tu sūkaram ।
gantrīcūrṇaṃ krośalagnaṃ gaurabhasma dviyojanam ।।26 ।।
mahāsāmarthyavān bālaḥ kṛṣṇo yena mahāsurāḥ ।
vighātitāstrayastvete ghātakā bālaghātinaḥ ।।57।।
samyakkṛtaṃ nihananaṃ tveteṣāṃ bāladehinā ।
putrāstu rakṣitā naśca vardhantāṃ bālakāḥ sadā ।।58 ।।
evamāśīrvacaḥ prāhuḥ prasannā bhejurīśvaram ।
rādhikā prāha bhagavan rākṣasāḥ ke trayo'pi te ।।59।।
āsan yairiha cāgatya harernāśo vicintitaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha rāśeśi! śṛṇu tāṃ puṇyapāvanīm ।।2.38.6 0 ।।
kathāṃ dharmavatī ramyāṃ devadrohotthitāṃ parām ।
pūrvaṃ cintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmaṇastvaṇḍajanmanaḥ ।। 61 । ।
vālakhilyāḥ samutpannā mānasāḥ śuddharūpiṇaḥ ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi babhūvuścordhvaretasaḥ ।।62।।
tatra vanaspatirnāma sarvaśreṣṭho'bhavanmuniḥ ।
punaścintayatastasya prajākāmasya vedhasaḥ ।।63।।
sahasraṛṣayo jātā gṛhasthāḥ skannadharmiṇaḥ ।
sadārā vanavāsaśca rāgadveṣādimānasāḥ । ।64।।
tatra nabhaspatirnāma gṛhiśreṣṭho'bhavanmuniḥ ।
punaścintayatastasya rajasā mohitasya tu ।।65।।
vālakhilyāḥ punarjātāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
sarve vai dārasahitāstapaḥsvādhyāyatatparāḥ ।।66 ।।
kāmakrodhādihṛdayāḥ snānapūjāparāyaṇāḥ ।
mahāraṇyanivāsāśca kailāsaśailasannidhau ।। 67।।
ārādhayanti trinetraṃ kṛśā dhamanisantatāḥ ।
vratopavāsaniratāḥ sahasravarṣatāpasāḥ ।।68।
teṣu saraspatirnāma vrataśreṣṭho'bhavanmuniḥ ।
gṛhidharmaparaścāpi yajñasvādhyāyatatparaḥ ।।69।।
tān samārādhayato'pi naiva tuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ।
tadā śrīpārvatī devī sadayā prāha śaṃkaram ।।2.38.7 0 ।।
teṣāṃ kleśakṣayaṃ śaṃbho vidhehi kuru me dayām ।।7 1 ।।
kathaṃ na dīyate siddhirgate'pyabdasahasrake ।
śuṣkasnāyvasthidehānāṃ tapatāṃ gṛhadharmiṇām ।।।72।
tacchrutvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha dharmasya gahanāṃ gatim ।
devi tvaṃ naiva jānāsi na te kāmavivarjitāḥ ।।73 ।।
na ca krodhena nirmuktāḥ kevalaṃ mūḍhatāpasāḥ ।
naite dharmaṃ vijānanti tato na dīyate phalam ।।74। ।
satī prāha kathaṃ hyete kāmakrodhādidūṣitāḥ ।
me pradarśaya tacchaṃbho paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ।।75। ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati! cātra tiṣṭha paśya kutūhalam ।
ahaṃ gacchāmi tapatāmāśrameṣu kuceṣṭayā ।।76।।
ityuktvā vastrarahito nagno bhūtvā hi śaṃkaraḥ ।
vanamālāsugandhāḍhyo yuvā sarvāṃgasundaraḥ ।।77। ।
bhikṣākapālabhṛd dehi bhikṣāmuktvā''śramān yayau ।
taṃ vilokyā''śramaprāptaṃ yoṣito brahmavādinām ।।78 ।।
surājasasvabhāvaistaṃ nagnaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramohitāḥ ।
nītvā mūlaṃ phalaṃ bhikṣāṃ gṛhāṇetyantikaṃ yayuḥ ।।79।।
śaṃbhurbhikṣākapālaṃ tatprasārya bahusādaram ।
datta bhikṣāṃ śivaṃ vo'stu bhavatīnāṃ tapaḥpriyāḥ ।।2.38.8 0 ।।
muhurhasan ceṣṭamānaḥ kurvāṇo liṅgajāgratim ।
manāṃsi prajahārā'sau babhūvustāḥ smarāturāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
nāryaḥ prāhustvayā ko'yaṃ vratadharmaḥ prasevyate ।
nagnena bhikṣuveṣeṇa hṛdyo'si tva subhikṣuka ।।82।।
ehi tvasmadgṛhān kurmaḥ sevanaṃ mardanaṃ tava ।
ityūcustāḥ śivaḥ prāha rahasyaṃ me vrataṃ khalu ।।83।।
na prakāśyaṃ vrataṃ me'tra yūyaṃ yāta gṛhānnijān ।
nāryaḥ prāhurgṛhānasmākamehi rañjano'si yat ।।84।।
ityuktvā taṃ jagṛhustāḥ sakāmāḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ ।
kāciddhaste'parā kaṇṭhe'nyā jānvoritarā hanau ।।85।।
parā keśeṣu kaṭyāṃ ca pādayoḥ pārśvapṛṣṭhayoḥ ।
evaṃ viceṣṭitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ tathā kṣobhaṃ ca yoṣitām ।।86 ।।
dhyāne te tāpasā vīkṣya tapo vihāya dudruvuḥ ।
hanyatāmiti saṃbhāṣya kāṣṭhapāṣāṇayaṣṭayaḥ ।।87 ।।
nijaghnurvarṣmaṇi śaṃbhostatra trayastu mūrdhajāḥ ।
vanaspatirmaharṣistu kāṣṭhamādāya satvaram ।।88।।
nabhaspatistu pāṣāṇaṃ samādāya tadā drutam ।
saraspatistu saṃgṛhya loṣṭhasya dātrakaṃ drutam ।।89 ।।
liṅgaṃ śaṃbhorjāgrataṃ tatpātayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
anye darbhaistathā yaṣṭyā nijaghnuḥ kaṭipārśvataḥ ।। 2.38.90 ।।
liṅge tu patite śaṃbhustvantardhānaṃ jagāma ha ।
satīṃ prāpya tadā tasthāvadṛśyaḥ śaṃkarastataḥ ।। 91 ।।
liṅgaṃ tūtpatya tūtpatya jagatkṣobhaṃ cakāra ha ।
brahmāṇḍaṃ kṣobhamāpannaṃ śrīśaṃbhurduḥkhito'bhavat ।। 92।।
satī liṅgavihīnaṃ saṃvīkṣya śaśāpa tān dvijān ।
vanaspatiḥ kāṣṭhabhāvaṃ nabhaspatiḥ śilātmatām ।। 93 ।।
saraspatirdatrarūpaṃ prāpnuvantu hi nirdayāḥ ।
mama patyustvaparāddhaṃ bhavadbhistvatiniṣṭhuram ।। 94।।
tato yūyaṃ rākṣasāḥ svaliṅgahīnā bhavantvapi ।
iti śaptāstrayaste hi pradhānāḥ ṛṣayo drutam ।। 95।।
vanaspatiḥ sarjavṛkṣo'bhavattatra vanāntare ।
kāmarūpadharaḥ kāṣṭharūpavān rākṣaso'pi saḥ ।। 96।।
nabhaspatirbabhūvāpi śailo dāruvane tadā ।
kāmarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇaśilārūpo'pi rākṣasaḥ ।। 97।।
saraspatistadā jāto datrayukto hi sūkaraḥ ।
liṅgahīno rākṣasaḥ saḥ kāmarūpadharo'pi hi ।। 98।।
trayaste rākṣasā jātā dārudrumavanāntare ।
anye śaptā vālakhilyāḥ stabakāste jalopari ।। 99।।
samūlā api nirgranthāḥ patramātrasamṛddhayaḥ ।
aliṅgā jalavāsāste babhūvurjalamastake । । 2.38.100 ।।
apṛthvībhojanāḥ sarve brahmaputranadādiṣu ।
vālakhilyāḥ stabakāste jalamātraprajīvinaḥ ।। 101 ।।
śāpakāle duḥkhamagnā manasā tuṣṭuvuḥ satīm ।
samuddhāro yathā'smākaṃ bhavettat saṃvidhīyatām ।। 102 ।।
na vayaṃ vidmaḥ sadbhāvaṃ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।
aparāddhaṃ tato'smābhiḥ śāpānto no vidhīyatām । । 103 ।।
ṛṣipatnyastu rurudustuṣṭuvurmātaraṃ satīm ।
tadā prāha satī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।। 1 04।।
saurāṣṭre paścimedeśe kambharāśrīsutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ ।। 1 05।।
vartate tasya yogena va uddhāro bhaviṣyati ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ prasamuddhāraṃ sa prabhuḥ saṃkariṣyati ।। 106 । ।
ityuktvā'dṛśyabhāvaṃ sā gatā suduḥkhitā satī ।
atha ye ṛṣiputrādyā aparādhavivarjitāḥ ।। 1 07। ।
anye'pi carṣayastatra darśakā brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।
te tu dṛṣṭvā mahākṣobhaṃ brahmāṇḍasya layapradam ।। 1 08। ।
brahmāṇaṃ sasmarustatra brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।
devādyāḥ prārthayāmāsurliṃgavahnipraśāntaye ।। 1 09।।
brahmaṇā bodhitāste ca brahmadharmaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
tejasvinaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ brahmarūpaṃ sanātanam ।। 2.38.110 ।।
kāmadharmairabaddhaṃ te vijñāya grāmyadharmiṇam ।
aparāddhaṃ kṛtavantastataḥ kṣobho mahānayam ।। 111 ।।
liṃgapūjanadharmeṇa śāntimeṣyati nānyathā ।
aho mugdhāḥ ṛṣayaste krodhasya vaśatāṃ gatāḥ ।। 112।।
dehe cātmani yadbrahma niyataṃ nirmalaṃ ca tat ।
tapasā karmaṇā vāpi śuddhahṛdo'pi cīyate । । 113 ।।
kāmakrodhādibhāvānāṃ niṣkāsanaṃ hi śuddhatā ।
tanmanaḥ śodhayeddhīmān jñānayogamupakramaiḥ । । 1 14।।
śuddhimāpnoti puruṣaḥ saṃśuddhe yasya vai manaḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ krodhakāmābhyāmabhibhūtā''śrame sthitāḥ ।। 115 ।।
kāmakrodhābhibhūtānāṃ yajño dānaṃ vṛṣastapaḥ ।
vrataṃ kṛcchra dhṛtirdhyānaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalatāṃ vrajet । । 116 ।।
tasmāt prayāntu tatsthānaṃ kāmakrodhau vihāya ca ।
ārādhayantu taṃ devaṃ śaṃkaraṃ kāmabhāsinam ।। 1 17।।
liṃgaṃ prapūjayantveva tataḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve liṅgaṃ pupūjurādarāt ।। 1 18।।
yathāsthānaṃ ca tallagnaṃ saliṃgaḥ śaṃkaro'bhavat ।
yatraitat patitaṃ tatra jyotirliṃgāni jajñire ।। 11 9।।
dvādaśadhā tu tadbhinnaṃ divyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ hi tat ।
ityeva śāntimāpede jagat sarvaṃ hi rādhike ।। 2.38.12 0। ।
atha te'pi trimunayaḥ śāpajā rākṣasāḥ khalu ।
jātismarāḥ svamokṣorthe saurāṣṭraṃ tvāyayustataḥ ।। 121 ।।
vanaspatiḥ kāṣṭharūpaḥ śakaṭātmā vyajāyata ।
nabhaspatiḥ śilārūpaḥ parvataḥ samajāyata ।। 122 ।।
saraspatirdantamāँśca sūkaraḥ samajāyata ।
hareḥ kṛṣṇasya yogena muktāḥ śāpāttadā'bhavan ।। 123 ।।
astuvaँste hariṃ divyāḥ ṛṣayo vai tapodhanāḥ ।
śeṣarṣīṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmuddhārārthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 24।।
tadā śrībhagavānāha yāntu tatrā'pyahaṃ śubham ।
dāruvanaṃ samāgatyoddhārayiṣyāmi śāpataḥ ।। 125।।
garuḍaṃ tu samāruhya bhagavān bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
vālakhilyastambarūpānuddadhāra hariḥ svayam ।। 1 26।।
sarve te dāruvanajāstapaḥ kurvanti rādhike ।
tataḥ śāntārayaḥ sarve'bhavan ṛṣisvarūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 27।।
tadvaṃśā vālakhilyāśca stambā bhavanti vāriṣu ।
hariruddhārayitvā tān prāpya pūjanamādarāt ।। 1 28।।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ svaṃ garuḍānvitaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe śāpapāpaṃ praśāmyati ।। 129 ।।
āścaryaṃ bhaktiyukteṣu rākṣasatve hyupasthite ।
dveṣabhāvena muktirvai devamāyā hi tādṛśī ।। 2.38.13 0।।


iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vanaspatinabhaspatisaraspatimaharṣīṇāṃ satīśāpād rākṣasabhāvamāpannānāṃ vāṭikāyāmupadravaḥ, prabhuṇā śāpamokṣaṇaṃ, nagnaśaṃkarasya tāpasāśrameṣu bhramaṇaṃ ṛṣikṛtāparādhaḥ liṃgapātanaṃ śāpakāraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 38 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 038 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 39
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 040 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike jñānaṃ tapo yasmānna śiṣyate ।
pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame ।। 1 ।।
bṛhadaṇḍamabhūdekaṃ prajānāṃ bījasaṃbhṛtam ।
mahāviṣṇoḥ samudbhūtaṃ yasmin virāḍ virājate ।। 2 ।।
aṇḍaṃ vibhidya bhagavān vairājaṃ bahirānayat ।
vairājāt triguṇā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 3 ।।
sattvavān vai tadā brahmā śūnyaṃ lokamapaśyata ।
tato rājasabhāvena pravṛttiṃ svīcakāra ha ।। 4 ।।
sasmāra darśakaṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇamatīndriyam ।
guṇātītaṃ bhagavantaṃ vyāpakaṃ puruṣaṃ param ।। 5 ।।
yenedaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ sthiracetanasaṃjñitam ।
yastaṃ veda mahātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ ved niścitam ।। 6 ।।
guṇātītaṃ ca puruṣaṃ parabrahma sanātanam ।
yastaṃ veda parātmānaṃ sa sarvaṃ veda mokṣavit ।। 7 ।।
kiṃ teṣāṃ sakalaistīthaiṃrāśramairvā prayojanam ।
yeṣāṃ tvanantakaṃ cittamātmanyeva vyavasthitam ।। 8 ।।
ātmā nadī śīlatīrthā satyajalā śamānvitā ।
tatsnātaḥ śuddhyati puṇyo vāriṇā''tmā na śuddhyati ।। 9 ।।
śreṣṭhaṃ janasya kartavyaṃ cātmavodhasukhe sthitiḥ ।
jñeyaṃ satāṃ tadevā'sti yatprāptau kāmanākṣayaḥ ।। 2.39.1 0।।
naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ vittaṃ brahmalagnasya vidyate ।
samatā satyatā śīlaṃ cārjavaṃ viratistathā ।। 11 ।।
tallābhe brahma paramaṃ prāpnotyeva na saśaṃyaḥ ।
viditvā taṃ prabhuṃ rādhe! dharmasya phalamāpnuyāt ।। 1 2।।
yo'sāvāpmani dehe'smin vibhurnityo vyavasthitaḥ ।
so'nādiḥ śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ ।। 12 ।।
kambharāśrīnandanaḥ saḥ śrīmadgopālabālakaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre vartate bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 14।।
pañcame vatsare pūrṇe yāvastaṃ vīkṣituṃ priye ।
ityuktā rādhikā devī sotsāhā veṣamujjvalam ।। 1 5।।
dadhāra sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ svarṇamāṇikyasaṃbhṛtam ।
mauktikairhīrakaiḥ ratnaiḥ khacitaṃ śobhanaṃ śubham ।। 1 6।।
śṛṃgāraṃ vividhaṃ dhṛtvā sugandhasāramiśritam ।
bindvīpatrīraṅgarekhā'laktakajjalabṛṃhitam ।। 17।।
tantutantīśṛṃkhalormikāmbarābhūṣaṇā'nvitam ।
svarṇacūrṇapuṣpagucchakabarībhāraśobhitam ।। 18 ।।
sanaktakārcanavastubhatapātrakarā patim ।
kṛṣṇaṃ śṛṃgārayāmāsa suśobhaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ śubham ।। 1 9।।
vimānaṃ vṛṣayānaṃ ca vāhayāmāsa satvaram ।
phalapuṣpaiḥ svādubhojyairamṛtairbhṛtapātrakam ।। 2.39.2 0 ।।
svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sārathiśca śrīrādhā rathinī svayam ।
śrīmadgolokadhāmnastāvīśalokān vilaṃghya ca ।। 21 ।।
brahmādistaramullaṃghya bhūtale tu surāṣṭrake ।
vyomno'vataret rādhākṛṣṇau kuṃkumavāpikām ।। 22।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre bālakṛṣṇā''layā''ṅgaṇe ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya rathasyādau brahmāṇḍe vyāpa tanmahaḥ ।। 23 ।।
sūryacandrau na dṛśyete tejasā'bhibhavaṃgatau ।
rādhāyāstejasā pṛthvī diśaścātyupabṛṃhitāḥ ।। 24।।
lomaśasyāśramaścāpi cāndraloka ivā'bhavat ।
sarvāśca kanyakā rādhārūpā'tirūpakānvitāḥ ।। 25 । ।
rājante rādhikāṃ dṛṣṭvā śatarādhā'dhikaikakā ।
rādhā dṛṣṭvā tu tāḥ kanyā garvahīnā babhūva ha ।। 26।।
galitaṃ rūpasaundaryamānaṃ tasyāstadā kṣaṇāt ।
uttha kṛṣṇaṃ prati prāha bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya sā ।। 27।।
aho me vyaktisāphalyaṃ kāritaṃ hi tvayā prabho ।
mayā'sya darśanaṃ prāptaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yat ।। 28 ।।
ṣaṣṭhavarṣasamāraṃbhe prātaraṣṭamikātithau ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ rā dhikā saṃpūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ ।। 29 ।।
golokapayasā bālaṃ snāpayāmāsa rādhikā ।
sarvatīrthādisalilairabhiṣekaṃ cakāra sā ।। 2.39.30 ।।
candanā'gurukastūrīrasasāradravādibhiḥ ।
sampūjyā''bharaṇairvastrairalaṃkārairaśobhayat ।। 31 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'tha mayūrapicchaśobhanam ।
mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya mastake ।। 3 2।।
muralīṃ sā dadau haste dakṣabāhuṃ dadau gale ।
hāsayitvā sutilakaṃ candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ śubham ।। 32 ।।
bhāle datvā rādhikā sā nīrājanavidhiṃ vyadhāt ।
puṣpāñjaliṃ pradatvaiva namaskāraṃ cakāra sā ।। 34 ।।
āśīrvādān dadau kāntakānta tvaṃ kāntavadbhava ।
duḥsahāṃ cāñjaliṃ rādhā samuccārya ca mastakāt ।। 35।।
dadau bhojyaṃ ca golokādānītaṃ pāyasādikam ।
dugdhapiṇḍān baraphīṃśca dugdhasārasya pūrikām ।। 36 ।।
miṣṭāṃ divyāṃ dadhi śreṣṭhaṃ dadau nānyat tadiṣṭakṛt ।।
bhojayitvā tato ramyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadau śubham ।। 37 ।।
athaivaṃ samprapūjyaiva virarāma tataḥ svayam ।
śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pupūja sādaram ।। 38 ।।
suravālaṃ pītapaṭaṃ kañcukaṃ svarṇatārakam ।
śirastrāṇaṃ sakalgiṃ cāvataṃsakau kausumau śubhau ।। 3 9।।
puṣpahārān pārijātakṛtān dadau gale'rbhakam ।
upānahau svarṇasādhyau komalau pradadau tathā ।।2.39.40 ।।
chatraṃ sucāmare ramye raśanāṃ kuṇḍale dadau ।
maṇiṃ kaustubhajātīyottamaṃ mālāṃ ca mauktikīm ।। 41 ।।
dadau śrībālakṛṣṇāya vaṃśī dadau mṛdusvarām ।
yaṣṭiṃ siddhimayīṃ cāpi dadau siṃhāsanaṃ varam ।।42।।
evaṃ bālaprabhuṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjayitvā stutiṃ vyadhāt ।
sarvasākṣinnamaste'stu sarvāvatārakāraṇa । । 43 ।।
puruṣottama mukteśa paradhāman namo'stu te ।
vartamānaṃ ca bhūtaṃ ca bhaviṣyatsarvathā yataḥ ।।44।।
anvitaṃ rājate saumyaṃ suvyavasthaṃ kramānugam ।
ananvitaḥ praśāstā tvaṃ tasmai devāya te namaḥ ।।45।।
anantāḥ śaktayaste'tra kuṣṇanṛsiṃharūpiṣu ।
rādhāramāśrīsvarūpāstaṃ namāmi pareśvaram ।।46 ।।
ahaṃ me dhāma golokastathā nārāyaṇo ramā ।
śrīrvaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ satpadaṃ yasmātpravartate ।।47 । ।
akṣaraṃ dhāma yasyā'gre samūrtaṃ sevakaṃ sadā ।
īśvarā avatārāśca yadaṃśaguṇabhūṣaṇam ।।48।।
vyūhāśceśvarapālāśca lokapālā maharṣayaḥ ।
kratūcchrayāḥ surā yasya guṇaikaikāṃśamūrtayaḥ ।। 49।।
bhavantīha tu saṃsāre taṃ namāmi pareśvaram ।
antarātmannanantātmanmadātmaँste namo namaḥ ।।2.39.50।।
tvaṃ parātman lokasākṣinnananteśa namo'stu te ।
sarvajña tvaṃ parameṣṭhin jñānajñeya namo'stu te ।।5 1 ।।
ādideva durārādhya parameśvara te namaḥ ।
mahāyogeśvara sādho dayālo te namo namaḥ ।।52।।
parajyotirvaṣaṭkāra svāhākāra namo'stu te ।
sarvadarśana savartā'gniṣomātmannamo'stu te ।।53।।
mahārājika siddhārcya hiraṇyavāha te namaḥ ।
mañjukeśin bālakeśin dayādeśinnamo'stu te ।।54।।।
vibho yājñika yajñeśa bhaktānukampa te namaḥ ।
prasīda śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।55।।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇadevo natvā rādhā tathā prabhum ।
yayatuḥ śrīkambharāyāḥ sannidhau bhuvanāntare ।।56।।
natvā tāṃ ca tathā natvā śrīmadropālakṛṣṇakam ।
tatkṛtaṃ svāgataṃ prāpya putrotsavaṃ praśasya ca ।।57।।
vimānena yayatuśca golokaṃ kṛṣṇarādhike ।
athā''yayau ca vaikuṇṭhānnārāyaṇo ramāpatiḥ ।।58।।
garuḍasthaḥ prabhurbālakṛṣṇapūjārthamityatha ।
vāsudevastathā bhūmā cāyayaturmudānvitau ।।59।।
mahāviṣṇustathā nārāyaṇo naraḥ samāyayuḥ ।
śeṣanārāyaṇaścāpi matsyaḥ kūrmaḥ samāyayuḥ ।।2.39.60 ।।
vārāhaśca kapilaśca hariḥ pṛthuḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dattātreyastathā haṃso nṛsiṃhaśca samāyayuḥ ।।61।।
ṛṣabhaśca vāmanaśca parśurāmaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
yajño rāmaḥ kumārāśca hayagrīvaḥ samāyayuḥ ।।62।।
nārado rājarājaśca parameśāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jayeti te jaguḥ ।।63।।।
pañcāmṛtairamṛtaiśca bālā'ṅguṣṭhā'bhiṣecanam ।
cakruḥ paścād darbhajalairamṛtaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।64।।
candanaṃ sā'kṣataṃ bhāle tvarcayāmāsurādarāt ।
tilakaṃ kukumāḍhyaṃ ca cakrurdaduḥ sugandhakam ।। 65।।
puṣpahārān daduḥ kaṇṭhe mukuṭaṃ puṣpamālikāḥ ।
dadustulasīpatrāṇi vibhūṣaṇāni cāmare ।।66।।
chatraṃ copānahau divye'mbarāṇi vividhānyapi ।
karpūrādyairvartikābhirnīrājanaṃ pracakrire ।।67।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ cāmṛtānnaṃ phalāni ca ।
daduḥ sarve'vatārāśca jalaṃ tāmbūlakāni ca ।। 68।।
arpayāmāsuratyarthaṃ svasvalokabhavāni ca।
ityevaṃ pūjanārthaṃ taddhāmavāsāḥ striyo'pi ca ।।69।।
āyayurbahubhirvastūttamaiḥ pupūjurīśvaram ।
evaṃ samarcayitvā tāḥ prayayurnijadhāma te ।।2.39.70 ।।
tato devāśca pitaro munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā ।
mānavā brāhmaṇādyāścā''yayuḥ kṛṣṇārcanāya vai ।।71 ।।
divyavimānamāruhya cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
abhito vyomamārgeṣu viśramya kṛṣṇamandiram ।।72।।
āyayuḥ pūjayāmāsurvividhaiścopadādibhiḥ ।
rañjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।73 ।।
tato'nye bhūmayaḥ śailā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi sāgarāḥ ।
tīrthāni devataravo vallikāḥ stabakāstathā ।।74।।
vanadevyaśca gulmāśca tattvāni vividhānyapi ।
āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ cārhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ।।।75।।
tato yakṣā guhyakāścāraṇā kiṃpuruṣāstathā ।
bhāṭāśca kinnarāścāpi gandharvā devayoṣitaḥ ।।76।।
māgadhā bandinaḥ sūtā vidyādhrāḥ pannagādayaḥ ।
āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇotsave pūjārthameva te ।।77।।
pūjanaṃ te pracakruśca nartakā nṛtyamācaran ।
avādyanta suvādyāni gāyakāḥ saṃjagustadā ।।78।।
kathakāstatkathāṃ cakrurnāṭyadhrā nāṭyamācaran ।
yājñikāścācaran yajñaṃ sādhavo japamācaran ।।79।।
satyo nāryo daduścāśīrvādān vṛddhāḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca lomaśo'pi munistadā ।।2.39.80।।
tathānye ṛṣayastatra sthitāśca brahmakanyakāḥ ।
śrīhareḥ pūjanaṃ cakruryojayāmāyurāśiṣā ।।8 1 ।।
tataḥ pitā tu tān sarvān mahīmānān samantataḥ ।
dugdhapākādisadbhojyaistarpayāmāsa laḍḍukaiḥ ।।82।।
bhojayitvā ca tān sarvānāgatān tatparaṃ hariḥ ।
dāpayāmāsa dānāni viprān dāsīśca sevakān ।।83 ।।
pātrebhyaśca yathāyogyaṃ yathābhikṣukabhikṣitam ।
ratnaṃ hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ miṣṭānnaṃ cāmbarāṇyapi ।।84।।
mudrikāśca vibhūṣāśca pātrāṇyapi dhanāni ca ।
dadau yatheṣṭaṃ sarvebhyaścāgatebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।85 ।।
tato gateṣu sarveṣu svasvadhāmagṛhāṇi ca ।
lomaśaḥ kanyakāyukto yathā naijāśramaṃ mudā ।।86।।
athā'nye kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrīyā brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।
premṇā pupūjurāgatya parameśaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।।87।।
yayuḥ svasvagṛhaṃ paścānmahāścaryaṃ vabhūva ha ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra yugalaṃ caikamāgatam ।।88।।
nārī kajjalavarṇīyā naraḥ kuṣṭhāḍhyavigrahaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā''ha bālaka ।।89।।
pāpoddhāraṃ kuru kṛṣṇa patitayorvivaṃśayoḥ ।
harirjānannapi tau tu papraccha dīnamānasau ।।2.39.90 ।।
kau yuvāṃ vadata pāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ ca kathaṃ ca ruk ।
naraḥ prāhā'bhavaṃ vipro devāyano hi nāmataḥ ।। 91 ।।
gaurjare śrīpattane ca tatreyaṃ mama bhāminī ।
devapūjāparau cāvāṃ nityakarmaparāyaṇau ।।92।।
śaityābhipīḍitau snānaṃ vinā pūjanatatparau ।
samabhūva tato doṣādāyuṣyaṃ tvantatāṃ gatam ।।93 ।।
mṛtau jvareṇa ca śīghraṃ sahaiva śvapacagṛhe ।
jātau tatraiva nagare vivāhitau punastathā ।। 94।।
jātismarau kuṣṭhikṛṣṇau duḥkhitau pāpanāśaka! ।
jñātvā svapnaprabhāveṇa nārāyaṇo'si mādhavaḥ ।। 95 ।।
pāpaṃ vidhūya nau mokṣaṃ kuru nārāyaṇaprabho ।
adya te divaso nātha baddhamuktipradāpane ।। 96 ।।
pāpināṃ pāpahartā tvaṃ vartase ceti lokataḥ ।
samākarṇya ca vai padbhistvāyātau śaraṇaṃ tava ।।97।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā dayāparaḥ ।
tāvuvāca kṛpāsindhū rādhike pāpanāśanaḥ ।।98।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā pītvā jalaṃ ca tat। ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pibataṃ caraṇāmṛtam ।।9 9 ।।
śuddhau bhūtvā brahmalokaṃ vrajiṣyatho'timānavau ।
evaṃ śrutvā tatastābhyāṃ yathoktaṃ cānuvartitam ।। 2.39.10 0।।
drāg bhūtvā divyadehau tau divyayāne sthitau punaḥ ।
lakṣātilakṣayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpya gatau divam ।। 101 ।।
śrīpattanāt samārabhya kuṃkumavāpikāvadhim ।
yāvanti caṃkramaṇāni tāvad yajñaphalaṃ hyabhūt ।। 10 2।।
evaṃ śrīkāntasādhūnāmapyabhigamane phalam ।
jāyate ki punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhau ।। 1 03।।
rādhike śrīhariḥ sevyaḥ sevyāśca sādhavo'sya ca ।
tīrthaṃ kṣetraṃ vrataṃ sevyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam ।। 1 04।।
pade pade'śvamedhasyā'bhigame jāyate phalam ।
ityevaṃ tau kṛtau muktau nārāyaṇena śārṅgiṇā ।। 1 05।।
ṣaṣṭhavarṣasamārambhāṣṭamīdine śubhotsave ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi mokṣo muktistathā bhavet ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ ṣaṣṭhavatsarasyā'ṣṭamyāṃ śrīrādhākṛṣṇā'vatāravyūhadevamānavādikṛtamahotsavapūjanaṃ devāyanadvijasya tatpatnyāśca śvapacajanmamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 39 ।।
