adhyāyaḥ 40
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 041 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapūjyaiva nivāsaṃ prabhusannidhau ।। 1 ।।
pracakruḥ sarasastīre paścime setukocchraye ।
dattātreyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā vārāhatīrthakam ।। 2 ।।
kūrmatīrthaṃ matsyatīrthaṃ kapilaṃ tīrthamityapi ।
haritīrthaṃ pṛthutīrthaṃ vāsudevābhidhaṃ tathā ।। 3 ।।
haṃsatīrthaṃ dattātreyatīrthaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthakam ।
tīrthamṛṣabhasaṃjñaṃ ca yogeśvarākhyatīrthakam ।। 4 ।।
tīrthaṃ ca vāmanaṃ parśurāmatīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tataḥ ।
yajñatīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ hayaśiro'bhidham ।। 5 ।।
sanatkumāratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ nāradasaṃjñakam ।
vyāsatīrthaṃ kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ buddhatīrthaṃ tathā param ।। 6 ।।
tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
mahāviṣṇukṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ naranārāyaṇābhidham ।। 7 ।।
ardhanārīśvaratīrthaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ paraṃ śubham ।
rādhike ca tvayā sākaṃ snātaṃ yatra mayā ca tat ।। 8 ।।
rādhātīrthaṃ kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
pāpatāpakṣayakaraṃ mokṣadaṃ dhāmavāsadam ।। 9 ।।
evametāni tīrthāni jātāni tatra rādhike ।
atha ṣaṣṭhe mārgamāse mahākālavanasthitāḥ ।। 2.40.1 0।।
ṛṣayastvāyayuścā'śvapaṭṭakṣetre hi tairthikāḥ ।
samīraṇaḥ pavamānaḥ santāraṇaśca barburaḥ ।। 1 1।।
voḍhuśca ghanabhedaśca dyuviśrāmaśca paṅkilaḥ ।
nīlakarṇastathā'larkaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ kalāyanaḥ ।। 12।।
vītihotraśca camasaḥ parṇakutso'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
bhāllaveyaścorjavrataścāśvalāyana ityapi ।।13।।
pārṣṇiradaḥ sumantuśca hyaśokākṣo'bhayā'kṣakaḥ ।
brahāstambaḥ kūpyavālaścetanabrahma ityapi ।। 14।।
devyaḥ śrīḥ kamalā pṛthvī rāṇikā'maraputrikā ।
dhanyeśvarī satīśā ca devānikī ca kṛṣṇikā ।। 15।।
pampā nārāyaṇī gaṅgā yamunā gaṇḍakī kuśā ।
sarasvatī hiraṇyā ca svarṇarekhā ca gomatī ।। 16।।
gautamī vallayo vṛkṣāstattvānyapyāyayustadā ।
mārgamāse site pakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ samāhitāḥ ।। 17।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsnānaṃ cakruḥ prātaśca devatāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nemurgṛhaṃ gatāḥ ।। 18।।
lomaṣarṣiṃ tato nemurnemustebhyo'pi kanyakāḥ ।
sakṛtā bhojitāḥ sarve vanditāḥ pūjitāstathā ।। 19।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ paścimaṃ kundaśobhitam ।
kuñjanikuñjarahitaṃ viśālasthalagauravam ।।।2.40.2 0।।
pārijātavanāḍhyaṃ ca sugandhidrumamañjulam ।
yayurmadhyāhnakāle te nityakarmaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 21 ।।
tatra gundrakadāḍīmatintiḍīdrumaśobhite ।
chāyite bhūtale ramye bālakṛṣṇālayāntike ।।22।।
viśrāmaṃ paramaṃ cakruḥ sāyaṃ kathāmavācayat ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā ūrjavrato muniḥ ।। 23 ।।
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ kālajitaḥ pañcaśikhaśca lomaśaḥ ।
āsurirjamadagniśca hanumān jāmbavāँstathā ।।24।।
vibhīṣaṇaśca vyāsaśca prahlādaśca baliḥ ṛbhuḥ ।
gālavaśca kṛpaścā'nye śatakalpāyuṣaśca ye ।।25।।
saptakalpajīvanāścā'yutakalpaprajīvanāḥ ।
kathāśravaṇamūrdhanyā niṣeduḥ sadasi sthitāḥ ।।26।।
kambharānandanastatra pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
madhyāsane brahmavidbhirniveśito virājate ।।27।।
devāḥ surāḥ sagandharvāḥ savidyādharamānavāḥ ।
devīsamūhasahitāḥ śṛṇvanti sma kathāṃ śubhām ।।28।।
ūrjavrato maharṣiśca lakṣakalpāyurīśvaraḥ ।
prapyakṣasya harerādyaṃ maṃgalaṃ prajagāda ha ।।29।।
nāsīdakṣaramekalaṃ nahi gavāṃ
dhāmā'pi cā''sīd yadā,
vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yadā'pi nāmṛtapadaṃ
dhāmā'pi nā'bhūd yadā ।
jīveśādikasarjanaṃ ca tu yadā
nāsīttadāsīcca yaḥ,
so'nādirharikṛṣṇabālasurūpo
me stānnamo bhūmikā ।।2.40.30।।
yo naije paradhāmni muktapuruṣaiścānyeṣutacchaktibhi-
mūrtairgrāhyaguṇairvibhūtibhirajaiḥ saṃsevyate cārthibhiḥ ।
yo dvedhā'bhirato'pi caikala iha prālokyate bālava-
cchrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇo'stu mama vākprasthānabhūmiḥ prabhuḥ ।।3 1।।
yadiha ṛṣikathāyāṃ vartate tvantarātmā,
manutanujanibho'yaṃ bālakaḥ kaṃbharāyāḥ ।
akalakalavilāso viśvabhārodaro'yaṃ,
saphalayatu janān gopālakṛṣṇālayasthaḥ ।।32।।
sa jayatu bhuvi ramyā kuṃkumī vāpikeyaṃ
jagadaghaharamagryaṃ cāśvapaṭṭaṃ saraśca ।
vijayatu munimānyo lomaśaḥ sādhuvaryaḥ
pravijayatu ca lakṣmīsaṃhitā mokṣadātrī ।।33 ।।
ādau madhye cāvasāne'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
gīyate'tra parabrahma so'yaṃ tanotu maṅgalam ।।34।।
jyeṣṭho bhrātā ca bhagavān santuṣṭā ca svasā satī ।
śuko bhrātā tato vijño'nujaḥ śrīvallabhastathā ।।35।।
mātā ca kaṃbharālakṣmīḥ pitā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
śataṃ dvādaśa kāntāśca vijayantu sabālakāḥ ।।36।।
svayaṃprakāśaḥ śiṣyaśca mūrdhanyaḥ śiṣyamaṇḍale ।
koṭiśiṣyagaṇāścānye koṭyarbudā'bjayoṣitaḥ ।।37।।
lomaśo gurumukhyaśca ṛṣayo'nye hariṃvidaḥ ।
namasyāmo brahmavaṃśyā jaṃgamāstairthikārcitāḥ ।।38।।
aparokṣaḥ parokṣo'yaṃ bālo'bālabṛhatparaḥ ।
karotu śreya iṣṭaṃ naḥ śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।39।।
lakṣmīśo māṇikīśaśca pārvatīśaḥ prabhāpatiḥ ।
śrīrādhārukmiṇīkāntaḥ karotu maṃgalaṃ sadā ।।2.40.40।।
jānantu ṛṣayaścainaṃ parameśaṃ parātparam ।
anādinidhanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ parameśvaram ।।41।।
anena hi purā vedā uddhṛtāḥ sāgarāttathā ।
uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī dantāgreṇa purā tathā ।।42।।
anena pṛṣṭhabhāge ca śeṣo dhṛto hi vidyate ।
anena nijaparyaṃke dhṛto nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।43।।
anena sāṃkhyavijñānaṃ svaprakāśāya cārpitam ।
anena brahmaṇe jñānaṃ purā śrīhariṇā'rpitam ।।44।।
daityā niṣūditāścāpi vāsudevena śārṅgiṇā ।
janmarakṣālayāँścakre so'yaṃ vyūhātmako hariḥ।।45।।
pṛthvī prapālitā'nena rājarājo'pyayaṃ hyabhūt ।
tapastaptaṃ tathā'nena haṃsaḥ so'yaṃ purābhavat ।।46।।
keśarī so'yamevā''sīt hiraṇyakośakāntakaḥ ।
sādhuceṣṭo vanyavāso'bhavat so'yaṃ dayāparaḥ ।।47।।
hrasvarūpo bhūmihartā mahendrā'nuja eva ca ।
atrātāraḥ kṣatāḥ parśughātenā'nena sūriṇā ।।48।।
vahnāvājyapibo'yaṃ vai vṛṣṭiyogaprado'pyayam ।
dakṣiṇāpathagān daityān yāmyaṃ prāpayitā hyayam ।।49।।
brahmaputraḥ sādhuśreṣṭho bālarūpaḥ purā tu yaḥ ।
sa evā'dya bālaveṣo vartate'tra narottamaḥ ।।2.40.50।।
vīṇāmagno maharṣiśca vedavidyāvibhājakaḥ ।
rādhākāntaḥ satīsevyo bodhavārdhirayaṃ hi saḥ ।।51।।
svāmī kāntaḥ patiḥ pātā rakṣako janakaḥ pitā ।
rājā draṣṭā'ntarātmā ca bālo'yaṃ ṛṣisammataḥ ।।52।।
bhajadhvaṃ bhāvato bhaktyā śāśvatālayado yataḥ ।
prapadye parameśānaṃ taṃ hyajaṃ vaiṣṇavapriyam ।।53।।
parabrahma mahātmānaṃ viśvasya jagataḥ patim ।
namastasmai devadaityeśvaramuktādisevine ।।54।।
sarvākṣāya sarvavyāptātmane'ntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ।
gāyanti yaṃ gāyatriṇo'rcayantyenaṃ samarpitāḥ ।।55।।
yatra sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca kāryaṃ kriyā ca sādhanam ।
daivataṃ sadasaścāpi namastasmai vilāsine ।।56।।
namaḥ śāntāya variṇe śaṃkhacakradhvajābjine ।
śūline śārṅgiṇe cāpi vajriṇe śariṇe namaḥ ।।57।।
svastimate mīnavate namaste prabhaviṣṇave ।
namo'stvapratirūpāya svarūpadhvajadhāriṇe ।।58।।
namo nānābhirāmāya namaḥ paṭutarāya ca ।
namaḥ sāṃkhyapravaktre te yogavaktre ca te namaḥ ।।59।।
namaḥ śrutipravaktre te nyāyavaktre namo namaḥ ।
namo muktipravaktre te namaḥ śikṣāpradāya ca ।।2.40.60।।
namo mīmāṃsanavaktre namo'mṛtapradāya ca ।
namo hiraṇyavapuṣe namaścampakavarcase ।।61।।
namaḥ stutyāya mantrāya sarvabhūtaśarīriṇe ।
namo hotre namaḥ śīlavratasthāyā'tirūpiṇe ।।62।।
namo dīrghākṣiṇe tubhyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyine ।
nabhaścāntaranetrāya sarvanetrāya te namaḥ ।।63।।
bhedā'bhedaprabhinnāya namaste vyatirekiṇe ।
chāyātapanarūpāya śāntasattvāya te namaḥ ।।64।।
yajñabhāgapriyāyaikamūrtaye brahmaṇe namaḥ ।
pañcālaputrīrakṣāya bhaguputrīpravāhine ।।65।।
anaraṇyasuteśāya namo nārāyaṇīśine ।
annadāyā'nnapataye kośātmakāya te namaḥ ।।66।।
bālānurūpagotre ca bālalīlāvilāsine ।
namo bālāya vṛddhāya mañjukeśāya te namaḥ ।।67।।
namaḥ ṣaṭkarmatuṣṭāya sahasrābharaṇāya ca ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmāśrayāya ca te namaḥ ।।68।।
namo'nantaguṇaiśvaryavibhūtyāśrayiṇe namaḥ ।
meghaśobhāya candrārkatārāprabhāya te namaḥ ।।69।।
tvamannamannabhoktā ca pakvabhuk pāvano'nalaḥ ।
vāri tvaṃ tvaṃ tathātṛptiḥ sukhamānanda te namaḥ ।।2.40.70।।
jarāyujā'ṇḍajāścāpi svedodbhijāstvayā kṛtāḥ ।
tvameva cāvatāreśa bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ ।।7 1।।
sraṣṭā carācarasyā'sya pātā hantā tvameva ha ।
tvāmāhurbrahma vidvāṃsaḥ paraṃ brahmavidāṃ gatiḥ ।।72।।
manasaḥ paramaṃ jyotirjyātistvaṃ jyotiṣāmapi ।
haṃso vṛkṣo madhukaraḥ prāhustvāṃ brahmavādinaḥ ।।73 ।।
yajñeṣṭakṛt phalanaratvaṃ tvāmāhurmunayastathā ।
paṭhyase stutibhirnityaṃ vedopaniṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ ।।74।।
narā nāryaḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāstiryañca ityapi ।
tvameva vidyase kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ।।75।।
tvameva meghasaṃghāśca vidyuto'śanigarjitam ।
saṃvatsarastvamṛtavo māso māsārdhameva ca ।।76।।
yugānimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā ।
tvaṃ śarī tvaṃ gadī cakrī khaḍgī vajrī śarāsanī ।।77।।
chettā bhettā prahartā'si mantā netā sanātanaḥ ।
samudrāḥ saritaḥ śailā vṛkṣāḥ sarāṃsi bhūstarāḥ ।।78।।
latātṛṇauṣadhivallīpaśavo mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ।
pṛthukarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālaḥ puṣpaphalodayaḥ ।।79।।
madhyaṃ bījaṃ cāṃ'kuraṃ ca patraṃ kāṇḍaṃ ca granthikā ।
nālaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cāpi raso gandhastvameva ca ।।2.40.80।।
piṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ sadeṣṭaṃ ca tvameva parameśvara ।
pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ।।8 1।।
udayānāmudayāgryaṃ tvameva paramā gatiḥ ।
prāṇā nimeṣā jṛmbhaśca kṣutaṃ cā'bhyāhatistathā ।।82।।
brahmakālayamāgnīnāṃ śāstā bodhayitā bhavān ।
canuryugaścanurvedaścātuhotrapravartakaḥ ।।83।।
cāturāśramyanetā ca cāturvarṇyakarastathā ।
praśilpī gaṇako mātā sarvaśilpapravartakaḥ ।।84।।
svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro namaskāraḥ stutistathā ।
prārthanā prārthanīyaṃ ca tvameva te namonamaḥ ।।85।।
gūḍhavrato guhyatapāstārako bhūmisandharaḥ ।
dhātā vidhātā sandhātā tvameva te namonamaḥ ।।86।।
brahmā śaṃbhustathā viṣṇurvirāḍ bhūmā tvameva ca ।
tapaḥ satyaṃ brahmacaryamārjavaṃ tvaṃ pratoṣaṇam ।।87।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaṃ jīvasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭistvameva ca ।
brahmasṛṣṭiḥ ṛtaṃ dīkṣā damanaṃ tvaṃ janārdanaḥ ।।88।।
kāntaḥ priyaḥ patiḥ svāmī nārāyaṇastvameva ca ।
bindurnādo dhvanirbrahma vimarśaḥ sphoṭa ityapi ।।89।।
paśyantī ca parā madhyā viśiṣṭā vāk tvameva ca ।
gaurbhūmirbrāhmabhaktaśca sādhuḥ satī ca kiṃkarī ।।2.40.90।।
vaśyaḥ sarvaṃ tvamevā''sse tvāṃ vinā nāsti nāstyapi ।
śaśāṃkā'nalaśītoṣṇakṣuttṛṣāśca jarāmayāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
ādhayo vyādhayaḥ śāntirbheṣajaṃ tvaṃ janārdana ।
somapāstvaṃ ca mādhuṃrya marutpatirjagatpatiḥ ।।92।।
amṛtāśī jagannāthāḥ kuṃkumeśastvameva ca ।
akṣateśo gaṇeśaśca mukteśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।। 93।।
viṣāgnipāḥ somapāśca kṣīrapā navanītapāḥ ।
ājyapā madhupāḥ sarvabhoktā tvaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ।।94।।
hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣaśreṣṭhastvameva caikalaḥ ।
tvaṃ strīpumān tvaṃ tṛtīyo bhāvadvayavivarjitaḥ ।। 95।।
bhāvatrayātigaścāpi bhāvatraye pravartase ।
bālo yuvā sthaviraśca jīrṇadaṃṣṭro'si viśvakṛt। ।।96 ।।
candrādityau cakṣuṣī te jihvā te ca sarasvatī ।
ahorātre nimiṣobhe ātmānaste gṛhālayāḥ ।।97।।
na brahmā na śivo viṣṇuḥ paurāṇā ṛṣayo na te ।
māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yāthātathyena bālaka ।।98।।
puṃsāmīśeśvarāṇāṃ muktānāṃ koṭyarbudāni ca ।
tiṣṭhase tvaṃ samāvṛtya cāntarbahistvameva saḥ ।। 99 ।।
mahatastamasaḥ pāre'kṣarasyā'pi pare sadā ।
pare dhāmni pareśastvaṃ rājase so'tra mūrtimān ।। 2.40.10 0।।
yaṃ vinidrā jitaprāṇāḥ sattvasthā brahmavartinaḥ ।
paraṃ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ ।। 101 ।।
yā yā mūrtayaḥ sūkṣmāste śakyā darśayituṃ na tāḥ ।
tābhyaḥ sarvābhya evā'tra tvadrūpābhyo namo namaḥ ।। 1 02।।
bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhakteṣu vartase sadā ।
keśā meghā yasya nāḍyo nadyaḥ kukṣau mahābdhayaḥ ।। 1 03।।
śayānāya jale haime tapasyate ca te namaḥ ।
ye'ṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣāścidaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।। 1 04।।
ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca ।
vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca ।। 1 05।।
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca ।
hastyaśvarathaśālāsu jīrṇodyānālayeṣu ca ।। 1 06।।
ye'pi pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca ।
candre sūrye satyaloke vaikuṇṭhākhyacatuṣṭaye ।। 1 07।।
rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃgatāḥ ।
tava bhaktāstava dāsāḥ kiṃkarāstava keśava ।। 1 08।।
dāsyaḥ satyastava bhaktāḥ kiṃkaryastava mādhava ।
namastebhyo namastābhya ubhābhyāṃ ca namo'cyuta ।। 109 ।।
yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṃkhyāḥ pramāṇaṃ rūpameva ca ।
asaṃkhyāste muktagaṇā namastebhyo'stu nityaśaḥ ।। 2.40.11 0।।
prasīda bālarūpa tvaṃ svakaṃ bhāvaṃ pradarśaya ।
tvayi no hṛdayānyatra bhavantu satkathāphalam ।। 111 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! tena stutaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
kathārambhe prasannaḥ sannātmano darśanaṃ dadau ।। 11 2।।
divyakoṭyarkabhāpūrṇaṃ romaikaikaṃ tu yasya vai ।
sarve'vatārā yanmūrtau sarvadhāmāni yatra ca ।। 113 ।।
sarveśvarāḥ ṛṣayaśca devā mānavakoṭayaḥ ।
daityā brahmāṇḍasannāhā yadromṇyeva caranti ca ।। 1 14।।
koṭimuktāḥ koṭikāntāḥ koṭipālā maheśvarāḥ ।
yatkukṣau bhāsamānāśca sarvatejāṃsi yatra ca ।। 1 15।।
sarve vai pralayā yatra yatra sarvāśca sṛṣṭayaḥ ।
yatra sarve ātmavargā bhāsante divyadṛṣṭitaḥ ।। 116 ।।
tādṛśaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ mūrtaṃ kaiśoraśobhanam ।
darśayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 1 17।।
vihasyā''bhāṣya kuśalaṃ divyadṛṣṭiṃ ca sandadau ।
vilokya ṛṣayaḥ sarve tathā'nye śravaṇe ratāḥ ।। 1 18।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāste dadṛśuḥ prabhum ।
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nyadhurhariṃ hṛdi ।। 1 19।।
evaṃ pradarśya ca punaḥ parihāraṃ cakāra ha ।
yathā bālo vartate'tra tathā bālo'bhavatpunaḥ ।। 2.40.120 ।।
tathā dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyān matvā svān munipuṅgavāḥ ।
ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ śaśvannirvāṇagā yathā ।। 121 ।।
evaṃ sākṣāt saṃhitāyāḥ pātraṃ śrīparameśvaram ।
sākṣātkṛtya tato nityaṃ śṛṇvantyeva kathāmṛtam ।। 122।।
evaṃ māsatrayaṃ jātaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ śubham ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre rādhike mokṣadaṃ tadā ।। 1 23।
kathānte phālgunīṃ kṛtvā''sthāpya tirthāni sarvathā ।
svasvanāmnā ṛṣayaśca vāsaṃ tatraiva cakrire ।। 124।।
tadetat saṃhitātīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ pragīyate ।
ṛṣitīrthaṃ kathātīrthaṃ divyatīrthaṃ tadeva ca ।। 125।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśīrṣe ūrjavratarṣikṛtāyālakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāyāḥ śravaṇaprasaṃge prabhordivyadarśanam, ṛṣīṇāṃ stavanāni, ṛṣīṇāṃ nivāsāttīrthāni cetinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 40 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 040 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 41
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 042 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
kathāṃ divyāṃ pāvanīṃ ca camatkāramayīṃ parām ।। 1 ।।
āsīd rājā dhārmikaśca bhaktaṃ kanthādharā'bhidhaḥ ।
saurāṣṭre vai naijarājye śāsanaṃ pracakāra ha ।। 2 ।।
sa hi rājā śaṃbhubhakto'bhavat sthāṇuprapūjakaḥ ।
siṃhāraṇye vasan koṭīnārādhipaḥ pratāpavān ।। 3 ।।
śaṃbhuṃ prasādya tapasā kāladaṇḍamavāptavān ।
daṇḍo yatra bhavettatra yāmyapāśo na vidyate ।। 4 ।।
yamadūtastathā kālo daṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ।
nityaṃ sahasrakamalaiḥ pārthivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 5 ।।
pūjayitvā prage caikapādena śatamālikāḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ kālakālāya saṃkarṣaṇāya śaṃbhave ।। 6 ।।
mṛtyave yāmyavārāya nirbhayaṃ padamarpaya' ।
evaṃ japati mantraṃ sa āvartayati nityaśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tata ekāvartanena juhotyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
parāhṇe tu phalaṃ śākaṃ pakvaṃ nirbījameva saḥ ।। 8 ।।
gṛhṇāti dehayātrārthaṃ rātrau bhūśayanaḥ sadā ।
satyapi yauvane bhāve nārīṃ vāñchati naiva saḥ ।। 9 ।।
ityevaṃ vartamānasya pratāpinastu bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
rājye cauryaṃ bhayaṃ vyādhiḥ pāradāryaṃ na cā'bhavat ।। 2.41.10।।
madyamāṃsā'bhakṣyavarjyaṃ havyaṃ prajā'nusevate ।
trayodaśyāṃ cobhayāyāṃ somatīrthasya sevanam ।। 11 ।।
bhavanāthasya ca tathā darśanaṃ sevanaṃ śubham ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca snānaṃ lomaśadarśanam ।। 12।।
yātrāṃ karoti cetyevaṃ tato gṛhaṃ prayāti saḥ ।
tīrthayātrājalaṃ koṭīnārīyajanatāsu saḥ ।। 13।।
prāpayatyaiva ca prajākalyāṇārthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।
māse māse pūrṇimāyāṃ prajābhyo miṣṭabhojanam ।।14।।
dadātyābālavṛddhebhyaḥ paśupakṣibhya ityapi ।
matsyakīṭapataṃgebhyo vṛkṣebhyaḥ salilaṃ tathā ।। 15।।
evaṃ dharmaparasyā'sya rājyaprajā ca nirbhayā ।
svayamanyatra tu gate bhayaṃ rājye na vidyate ।। 16।।
akālamaraṇaṃ nāsti nāsti cetibhayaṃ tathā ।
evaṃ kāle gate tvasya vāñcchā'bhūt puṣkaraṃ prati ।। 17।।
tīrthaṃ kartuṃ yayau cāpi māsastatra gatastadā ।
vasiṣṭhaṃ tatra rājā cā'prasādayat susevayā ।। 18।।
cirañjīveti tenoktaṃ tathāstvityāha vai nṛpaḥ ।
dīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ paraṃ labdhvā śreyo labdhvā'pyanantakam ।। 19।।
tīrthadānāni sandatvā snātvā sampūjya vedhasam ।
tataḥ sarasvatīṃ snātvā siddhān sampūjya bhūpatiḥ ।।2.41.20।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ snātvā śīghraṃ svagṛhamāyayau ।
svapne sa dṛṣṭavān mārge vipraputrastu nīyate ।।21।।
kenacit kṛṣṇavarṇena rakṣayāmīti bhūpatiḥ ।
vicārya yāvat tvarayā dhāvatyenaṃ prarakṣitum ।।22।।
tāvannidrā vilīnā ca kiñcinnāstītyalokayat ।
śaṃkitaḥ sa śīghrameva rājyaṃ prati samāyayau ।।।23।।
grāmasīmā''gate sarvaṃ svapnaṃ satyaṃ vyajāyata ।
yato'sya rājye viprasya grāmapurohitasya tu ।।24।।
putro mṛtyuṃgataścāyuṣo'nte pitari jīvati ।
yāmyadūtairdhṛto nīto yāmyalokaṃ kṣaṇāntare ।।।25।।
tāvad rājā tvāyayau vai yātrāṃ kṛtvā'tra tatkṣaṇam ।
rodanaṃ śocanaṃ jñātvā rājā duḥkhamavāpa ha ।।26।।
udantaṃ samparijñāya jñātvā mṛtyumṛtaṃ tataḥ ।
daṇḍaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ nītvā samāśvāsya ca taṃ dvijam ।।27।।
yayau pṛṣṭhe mṛtaṃ putraṃ vipraṃ cānetumiṣṭakṛt ।
daṇḍaṃ nītvā yatra yāti tatra mārgo'sya vidyate ।।28।।
pṛthvyāṃ jale'nale vāyau cāmbare tamasi grahe ।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu sadaṇḍasya gatiryataḥ ।।29।।
vinā daṇḍaṃ tu naivā'sya gatiḥ syādbhūtalaṃ vinā ।
śivadaṇḍena rājā'sau yayau vyomnā yamālayam ।। 2.41.3 0।।
niruddho mānavadeho yamadūtena vai yadā ।
daṇḍena rājñā saṃspṛṣṭo yāmyo dūraṃ papāta ha ।।3 1।।
vinipatya samutthāya bhayavyāpto yamānugaḥ ।
dadhāva yamarājānaṃ jagāda svaparābhavam ।।32।।
āyāto'sti yamapūryāṃ kaścinmānavadehavān ।
sadaṇḍo vartate deva mayā ruddho'tivegataḥ ।।3 3।।।
tathāpi naivaruddho'bhūt sa māṃ pasparśa daṇḍataḥ ।
tāvatparājitaścāhaṃ yathā vajrahato'bhavam ।। 34।।
pṛthvyāṃ nipatya cotthāya tvāyāmyatra yameśvara ।
nivedayituṃ tadvṛttaṃ ko'yaṃ kasmāddhi cāyayau ।।35।।
na jānāmi mahārāja yatheṣṭaṃ tatra cintaya ।
ityukto yamadūtena dharmarājastadā'nugam ।।36।।
mṛtyunāmānamāhūya vivāsayituṃ cādiśat ।
mṛtyurgatvā kareṇainaṃ nṛpaṃ dadhāra vegataḥ ।।37।।
yāhītyuvāca rājānaṃ na cenmṛtyustavā'tra vai ।
śrutvaivaṃ nṛpatirdaṇḍaṃ yojayāmāsa mṛtyave ।।38।।
mṛtyuḥ papāta bhūbhāge samutplutya yayau drutam ।
balaṃ nivedayāmāsa yamarājāya mānavam ।।39।।
tato yamo mahākālaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।
ko'yaṃ kasmāt samāyāto mamāntikaṃ samānaya ।।2.41.40।।
ityuktaśca svayaṃ kālastasyā'ntikaṃ samāyayau ।
natvovāca bhavān ko'tra dharmarājo jijñāsati ।।41 ।।
nṛpaḥ prāha ca saurāṣṭre koṭīnārasya bhūpatiḥ ।
asmyahaṃ tu samāyāto viprabālaṃ pravīkṣitum ।।42।।
sa tu kvā''ste kathaṃ cātrā''nīto'sti yamacāriṇā ।
iti jijñāsituṃ tvatra samāyāto'smi mānada ।।43।।
kālaḥ prāha samāgaccha yamarājaṃ nivedaya ।
sa te dāsyati pratyuktiṃ nā'haṃ yogyo'smi tatra vai ।।44।।
ityuktvā saha nītvā ca yamarājaṃ prati nṛpam ।
kāla āvedayāmāsa yamarājo'pyamānayat ।।45।।
papraccha svāgataṃ kṛtvā kimāgamanakāraṇam ।
rājā nanāma dharmaṃ ca provāca viprabālakam ।।46 ।।
mārgayituṃ samāyātaḥ kvāste sa dvijabālakaḥ ।
pitā tasyā'tikaruṇaṃ rauti putrasya kāraṇāt ।।47।।
eka evā'sya putro'sti mṛtyustasyā'bhavattathā ।
tacchokaṃ tvapanetuṃ ca mayoktaṃ bhūsurāya vai ।।48।।
tasya bālaṃ punarnītvā dātumicchāmi dharmarāṭ ।
tacchavaṃ rakṣitaṃ cāste yāvaccāhaṃ na yāmi tam ।।49।।
tasmād dehi dvijaputraṃ yāñcāṃ me pratipālaya ।
yamaḥ prāha ca tatrasthaṃ dūtaṃ yamaṃ ca satvaram ।।50।।
citraguptaṃ salekhaṃ ca brāhmaṇārthe samāhvaya ।
ākāritaścitraguptaḥ salekhastatra cāyayau ।।51 ।।
paśyā'sya viprabālasya kiyadāyurbhavediti ।
citraguptaḥ pūrṇamāyuḥ samāptaṃ sa mṛto yataḥ ।।52।।
vipradehe'sya nāstyeva bhogāyurvai manāgapi ।
yamarājastu tacchrutvā rājānaṃ cābhyavedayat ।।53।।
nāstyāyustasya taddehe sthātuṃ bhoktuṃ tato nṛpa ।
mṛto'yaṃ lapsyase naiva karmanyāyo'tra vidyate ।।।54।।
yatkṛtaṃ yena vai yādṛk yaṃ yasmai yasya vai yataḥ ।
yatra yadarthaṃ tatsarvaṃ tathaiva syānna cānyathā ।।55।।
rājā prāhā'sya bālasya kiṃ karma pāpakṛddhyabhūt ।
yenā'sya prāṇavāhaśca yamadūto hyajāyata ।।56।।
citraguptastadā prāha yamarājānudeśataḥ ।
vipraścāyaṃ pūjakaśca devasyā''sīnnirantaram ।।57।।
mandire vāsudevasya śaitye snānaṃ vinā hyayam ।
devamutthāpayāmāsa tena pāpena cāsya vai ।।58।।
yamaloko niścito'sti daṇḍaṃ vinā na śuddhyati ।
puṇyaṃ nāsti mānavārthe āyurnāsti tathottaram ।।59।।
kathaṃ neṣyasi rājendra vinā karma dvijārbhakam ।
rājā prāha dadāmyasya tvāyurme nūtanaṃ, mayā ।।2.41.60 ।।
vasiṣṭhasyā''śiṣā labdhā puṣkare cirajīvitā ।
tanmadhyato'yutavarṣaṃ dadāmyasya tu mānavam ।।61।।
ityuktvā salilaṃ hastāddvisṛjya jīvitaṃ dadau ।
citragupto lilekhā'sya varṣā'yutaṃ sujīvanam ।।62।।
dharmarājau dadau bālaṃ cāyutābdaprajīvanam ।
tataḥ papraccha rājānaṃ balaṃ labdhaṃ kutastvayā ।।63 ।।
yadatra naradehena samāyāto vihāyasā ।
yamo mṛtyustathā kālo'pradhṛṣyo dharṣitastvayā ।।64।।
vada kena pratāpena prāptamaiśvaryamuttamam ।
śrutvā rājā tadā prāha śaṃkarasya pratāpataḥ ।।65।।
prāptaṃ balaṃ dharmarāja yenā'haṃ cā'tra vīkṣitaḥ ।
bālo'pi ca mayā prāpto mahatāṃ kṛpayā nvidam ।।66।।
dharmarājastadā prāha yaṣṭiṃ me dehi bhūpate ।
rājā prāhā'tra vai yaṣṭyāṃ sarvaṃ tattvaṃ mamā'sti hi ।।67।।
yaṣṭilope na me cāsti gatirvaihāyasī vṛṣa ।
tasmād yaṣṭiṃ na dāsyāmi yaṣṭiḥ sāṃkarṣiṇī nviyam ।।68।।
kālasaṃhāriṇī tvāste tadā'nyasya tu kā kathā ।
tvayi ced yojaye yaṣṭiṃ tava nāśo bhaved dhruvam ।।69।।
ityuktvā dharmarāje tāṃ yaṣṭiṃ yojayituṃ nṛpaḥ ।
hastaṃ svaṃ lambayāmāsa tāvat kṣobhaṃ yayau vṛṣaḥ ।।2.41.70।।
kṣubdhaṃ tasyāsanaṃ cāpi dharmo nanāma taṃ nṛpam ।
balaṃ devabalaṃ dīrghaṃ sattābalaṃ na vai balam ।।71 ।।
mene tadā dharmarājastatastvasāntvayat nṛpam ।
mā maivaṃ kuru rājendra mānyo'si devadarśitaḥ ।।72।।
kālakālasya kṛpayā sarvaṃ te vartate kare ।
tasmād dadāmi rājendra kanyāṃ me hṛḍḍakāyinīm ।।73।।
yauvanodbhinnasarvāṃgāṃ ramaṇīṃ dehasundarīm ।
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā cecchamānāṃ saṃgṛhāṇaināṃ tava priyām ।।74।।
ityuktvā ca balaṃ jñātvā pradadau hṛḍḍakāyinīm ।
kanyāṃ patnīsvarūpāṃ tāṃ tathā viprārbhakaṃ nṛpaḥ ।।71।।
nītvā vaihāyasā dharmā'rpitena vāhanena vai ।
samāyayau sa saurāṣṭe koṭīnārākhyapattanam ।।76।।
vimānamambarāttasya dvijasyaiva gṛhāntikam ।
avātārayacchanakaiḥ sūryatulyaṃ samṛddhimat ।।77।।
divyanārīyutaṃ divyopaskaraṇasuśobhitam ।
anekaiśvaryasiddhyādivāsitaṃ yamanirbhayam ।।78।।
dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ satīṃ patnīṃ tathā viprasya bālakam ।
nṛpaṃ prati harṣanādān jayanādān vyadhurmudā ।।79।।
rājā putraṃ dadau tasmai viprāya praṇanāma ca ।
sa vai nāmnā'bhavattatra vṛṣaparvā ṛṣistadā ।।2.41.80।।
vṛṣaparvā samuttasthau mṛte dehe viveśa ha ।
vipraḥ prajāḥ prasannāścā'bhavaँstasyā''śiṣo daduḥ ।।8 1।।
vipraputraḥ samattasthau neme vṛddhān punaḥ punaḥ ।
pitarau nṛpatiṃ cāpi rājā yajñaṃ cakāra ha ।।82।।
yamaputrīṃ nijarājñīṃ kṛtvā'gre hṛḍḍakāyinīm ।
homaṃ dānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca bhojanāni dadau nṛpaḥ ।।83।।
yadyad dattaṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā prajajvālā''ntare nṛpī ।
tāmasī garvamanyā ca svārthamātraparāyaṇā ।।84।।
svavarcasvā'tilubdhā paropakāravirodhinī ।
dāne prabhojane home rājānaṃ hṛḍḍakāyinī ।।82।।
punaḥ punaḥ samuvāca mā vidhehi vyayaṃ nṛpa ।
tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ cāste tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।86 ।।
tvaṃ viṣṇu×Vr̤M×stvaṃ śivo brahmā tvaṃ prajāpatirasyapi ।
tvaṃ bhoktā tvaṃ vidhātā ca tvamagnistvaṃ divaspatiḥ ।।87।।
tvaṃ pātraṃ tvaṃ paraḥ śāstā tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ parāyaṇam ।
tvaṃ svāheśaḥ svadheśaśca tvaṃ vaṣaṭkārabhūmikā ।।88।।
tvaṃ hotā tvaṃ yajamānaḥ ko'nyo devastvaduttamaḥ ।
tasmātsarvaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tvameva vidyase prabho ।।89।।
prabhuṃ pratyakṣamevā'tra tvādṛśaṃ ca vimānagam ।
yamarājasya ca putryāḥ patimaiśvaryavardhitam ।।2.41.90।।
parityajya ca ko loke yajanīyo maheśvaraḥ ।
tasmāttvaṃ tvāṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vijānīhi makheśvaram ।।9 1 ।।
kālaṃ hantuṃ tathā hantuṃ mṛtyuṃ tvaṃ śaktimānasi ।
mṛtaṃ jīvayituṃ tvaṃ ca samartho vidyase prabhuḥ ।। 92।।
nendro varuṇaḥ pavanaḥ kubero'gniśca nirṛtiḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālā vā tvādṛśāḥ kānta santi na ।।93।।
sarvaṃ te saṃvaśe loke copāsse cetare tu kam ।
tyaja yajñaṃ tathā dānaṃ tyajā''sthāṃ pāralaukikīm ।।94।।
bhaja svaṃ ca sukhaṃ viddhi mayā dattaṃ hi sevayā ।
puṇyaṃ nijātmasevā ca pāpaṃ nijātmapauḍanam ।।95।।
miṣṭaṃ svakāntāvacanaṃ viddhyanyat kaṭu nāśakṛt ।
evaṃ jñātvā paraṃ rājyaṃ kuru svamānasaṃbhṛtam ।।96।।
evaṃ nityaṃ rādhike sā vakti taṃ hṛḍḍakāyinī ।
so'pi tasyāḥ saṅgadoṣācchanairnāstikatāṃ gataḥ ।। 97।।
śayane bhojane yāne sparśe śvāsagrahe tathā ।
vilokane ca karaṇe pārśvaste kramate guṇaḥ ।।98।।
sahavāse ca vārtāyāmadhyayane ca cūmbane ।
śiṣṭabhakṣye manuṣyāṇāṃ pāpaṃ saṃkramate jane ।।99।।
upari vāyugrahaṇe dhṛtavastrasya dhāraṇe ।
pradattajalapāne ca vrajet tadguṇitāṃ matiḥ ।।2.41.10 0।।
kṣudhāyogāt krūratāṃ ca śatruyogād vināśitām ।
kāntāyogād bhogyatāṃ ca yāyād buddhirvivartinī ।। 101 ।।
sādhuyogāt sattvabhāvaṃ śāstṛyogāttu dīnatām ।
bhṛtyayogāt svāmibhāvaṃ vrajatyeva matiḥ sadā ।। 1 02।।
evaṃ vai rādhike rājño matiḥ samaparyavartata ।
svārthamātraparā jātā yathā''ha hṛṅkukāyinī ।। 103 ।।
'itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyāgīyasaṃhitātā dvitīye tretāsattāne kaṃthādharanṛpateḥ śaṃkarabhaktyā kālayaṣṭiprāptiḥ, tataḥ puṣkare sevayā vaśiṣṭhāśīrvādena cirajīvitā, vipraputrasya yamapuragatasyā''nayanam, svāyurdānam, yamarājaputryā hṛṅkukāyinyā vivāhaḥ, tatprasaṃgena nāstikatā cetinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvā-
riṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 41 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 42
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 043 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! rājā kanthādharo hi nityaśaḥ ।
nārīyogādabhavacca nāstikaḥ svārthatatparaḥ ।। 1 ।।।
ghoṣayāmāsa nagare durātmā vedanindakaḥ ।
na dātavyaṃ na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ kadācana ।। 2 ।।
ahameko'tra vai vandyaḥ pūjyo'haṃ bhavatāṃ sadā ।
mayā vai pālitā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ prajāḥ sukhe ।। 3 ।।
tanmatto'nyo na devo'sti yuṣmākaṃ ya-pparāyaṇam ।
mahyaṃ deyaṃ ca havanaṃ havyaṃ dānaṃ ca dakṣiṇā ।। 4 ।।
rājā'haṃ lokapālo'haṃ prajāpālo'hameva ca ।
dātā dhātā vidhātā ca prajānāmahameva ca ।। 5 ।।
prāṇadātā sasyadātā dhanyadātā'hameva ca ।
sukhado daṇḍadaścāpi rakṣāprado'hameva ca ।। 6 ।।
manmukhaṃ vahnirevā'sti deyaṃ tatraiva nā'natṭhe ।
matkara1 pātramūrdhanyau dānaṃ tatraiva yujyate ।। 7 ।।
karo dānaṃ na tu bhikṣā karo deyo hi nītijaḥ ।
vastrāṇi paśavo gāvo mahiṣyo'jā'vikādikam ।। 8 ।।
dhanaṃ sarvaṃ pradeyaṃ me yatpunaśca prajākṛte ।
durbhikṣādau prayujyeta prajānāṃ sukhahetave ।। 9 ।।
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmadarśinaḥ ।
prajāvṛddhāśca vidvāṃso vedanetrā viduttamāḥ ।। 2.42.1 0।।
parasparaṃ susambhūya rājaśikṣārthamāyayuḥ ।
praṇipatya ca rājānaṃ satkṛtā vākyamabruvan ।। 1 1।।
śrutiḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmasya tato yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
yajñairvinā priyante na devāḥ sasyapradā divi ।। 12।।
aprīteṣu ca deveṣu durbhikṣaṃ samprajāyate ।
prajānāśo bhaved rājan deśaviplava ityapi ।। 13 ।।
tasmād rājan bhūtaśāntirgrahaśāntistathā sadā ।
devatṛptiḥ pitṛtṛptirvidhātavyā mahādhvaraiḥ ।। 14।।
yajño naiva niroddhavyaḥ śrutimūlo yato makhaḥ ।
vahnimukhāḥ sadā devāstarpaṇīyāḥ sukhapradāḥ ।। 15 ।।
ityukto'pi nṛpaḥ kanthādharo'manyata naiva ca ।
vedān vininda bahudhā pratāraṇaparā iti ।। 16 ।।
viprāḥ svārthaparā dhūrtakalpitā vedarāśayaḥ ।
dvijā miṣṭānnalubdhāśca vahimuddiśya devatāḥ ।। 17।।
kiṃcitprakṣipya vahnau ca svayaṃ miṣṭāni bhuṃjate ।
dakṣiṇādhanapātrāṇi govājikariṇaḥ svayam ।।18।।
gṛhṇanti tannimittena tasmātsvārthaparā hi te ।
mūrtistho naiva devo'sti na bhuṃkte nā'sya rocate ।। 1 9।।
vipro devastu pratyakṣaḥ sarvaṃ yadasya rocate ।
devaṃ nimittamudbhāvya miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭavāri ca ।।2.42.20।।
ābhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpāmālāṃ bhuṃkte gandhaṃ ca bhūsuraḥ ।
godānaṃ dugdhapānaṃ ca śayyādānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।।2 1 ।।
vāṭikā devatārthaṃ yā bhuṃkte sarvaṃ ca bhūsuraḥ ।
yānaṃ pātrāṇi ramyāṇi chatraṃ cāmaravāhanam ।।22।।
mṛdvāstaraṇaṃ bhogyāni bhuṃkte sarvaṃ tu bhūsuraḥ ।
rasān phalāni pakvānnānyuttamāni ca ।।23 ।।
dāsān dāsīśca bhṛtyāँścopabhuṃkte pūjako dvijaḥ ।
tasmāt svārthaparā viprā makhamuddiśya bhuñjate ।।24।।
ato naiva hi yaṣṭavyaṃ dātavyaṃ naiva naiva ca ।
ityājñā hṛḍḍakāyinyā rājñyā me vartate dṛḍhā ।।25।।।
ullaṅghyaitā kāmakāro maddaṇḍabhāgbhaviṣyati
ityevaṃ ḍiṇḍimā rājñā rāṣṭre sarvatra kāritā ।।26।।
tata ārabhya devānāṃ pūjā makhā na cā'bhavan ।
durbhikṣaṃ cā'bhavattena prajāśca duḥkhapīḍitāḥ ।।27।।
prasahya prabalā dravyaṃ nirbalānāṃ haranti ca ।
rājā ca viṣayāsakto rakṣākāryaṃ karoti na ।। 28।।
kālavegāt tadā rāṣṭraṃ viparītamabhūt khalu ।
daṇḍaḥ siddhipradaḥ śaṃbhostyaktvā bhūpaṃ tiro'bhavat ।।29।।
tadā rājā śuśocā'ti mama naṣṭaṃ hi jīvanam ।
aiśvaryaṃ vigataṃ cāpi devānāmavamānanāt ।। 2.42.30 ।।
prajā ruṣṭāśca dhānyārthaṃ rurudhurbhūbhṛdaṅgaṇam ।
dhānyaṃ gṛhītvā prayayustato dravyaṃ gavādikam ।।3 1 ।।
rājyasmṛddhiṃ prajahruśca prajāścātīva nirdhanāḥ ।
atha kanthādharastasya patnī ca hṛḍḍakāyinī ।।3 2।।
ubhau bhayāt prayayaturaraṇyaṃ cātiduḥkhitau ।
tayoścāsīt kumārastu varṣamātro'tikomalaḥ ।। 33 ।।
brāhmaṇāstaṃ prajahruśca rakṣaṇārthaṃ nijālayam ।
vimānaṃ divyadaṇḍaśca divyopakaraṇāni ca ।।34।।
vigatāni nijaṃ sthānaṃ rājyaṃ śūnyamabhūttadā ।
puṇyapuñje vardhite tu vardhante vai vibhūtayaḥ ।।35।।
puṇyanāśe vinaśyanti devānāmasya kā kathā ।
rādhike sa nṛpo'raṇye kāladharmamupāgataḥ ।।36।।
annaṃ jalaṃ parityajya mṛtā'pi hṛḍḍakāyinī ।
vārdhestīre mlecchajanmā'vāpatustau ca nāstikau ।।37।।
nikaṭe tau bhāgyayogādutpannau duḥkhabhāginau ।
kumāro dvādaśavarṣo'bhavad raṇaṃgamā'bhidhaḥ ।।38।।
sopavīto vipravākyairjñātvā pitṛviceṣṭitam ।
asadgatiṃ vane cāpi cintayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ।।39।।
vidyābhyāsaṃ vidhāyaiva rājyabhāravaho'bhavat ।
taṃ yogyaṃ ca paraṃ matvā dharmakāryaparāyaṇam ।।2.42.40 ।।
abhyaṣiñcan brāhmaṇāstaṃ rājānaṃ bhūmipālakam ।
tataḥ sa rañjayāmāsa prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।।41।।
yajñaṃ cakāra dharmātmā devapūjāmavartayat ।
tato brāhmaṇamadhyastho jagāda praṇipatya tān ।।42।।
pitā mama tathā mātā yajñavicchedakārakau ।
mṛtau vane kriyā tayoḥ kathaṃ kāryā mayā dvijāḥ ।।43।।
āvedayata ityevaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau ।
tejasā bhāsamānaśca svayaṃprakāśanāmakaḥ ।।44।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣyo vihāyasā ।
somakṣetraṃ prayāsyan vai koṭīnāramavātarat ।।45।।
viprān vilokya sahasā tānpratyabhyājagāma ha ।
tasmai te tvāsanaṃ datvā papracchuḥ praṇipatya ca ।।46।।
dhanyā vayaṃ samaye ca prāptā maharṣidarśanam ।
lokānāṃ duḥkhanāśārthaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ caraṇaṃ tava ।।47।।
bhagavan sarvalokasya jānāsi tvaṃ śubhāśubham ।
sākṣādanādikṛṣṇasya śiṣyo'si hṛdayaṃgamaḥ ।।48।।
pitā'sya rājño duṣṭātmā devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ ।
svadharmarahitaḥ patnisahito'raṇyamāśritaḥ ।।49।।
vane mṛtyuṃ gato bhāti kvāste vā pāpakarmaṇā ।
kathaṃ tasya bhavenmuktirvada bālo'sya pṛcchati ।।2.42.50।।
svayaṃ prakāśo divyātmā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā ।
kuṃkumavāpikāsthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā'bravīdidam ।।5 1।।
paścimā'bdhitaṭe cāste rājā rājñīyutaḥ khalu ।
mlecchamadhye samutpannaḥ kṣayakuṣṭhasamanvitaḥ ।।52।।
tasyoddhāraśca kartavyaḥ putreṇā'nena sarvathā ।
putraḥ sa kathyate loke yaḥ pitṛँstrāyate bhayāt ।।53।।
gacchatu tatra putro'yaṃ mlecchaṃ nītvā sabhāryakam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrite ।।54।।
tasya dehaṃ tīrthajale karotu nirmalaṃ tataḥ ।
niṣpāpaḥ sapriyo muktiṃ prayāsyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।55।।
svayaṃprakāśavacanaṃ śrutvā viprā prajājanāḥ ।
raṇaṃgamaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ prāhuryāhīti taṃ prati ।।56।।
kumāraḥ sa ca vipraiśca parimeyapuraḥsaraiḥ ।
sahitaḥ prayayau cābdhitaṭaṃ yatra pitā sthitaḥ ।।57।।
sa gatvā paścimaṃ sthānaṃ mlecchāśrayaṃ drumānvitam ।
makarālayanāmāḍhya mārgayāmāsa kiṃkaraiḥ ।।58।।
dadṛśuḥ kiṃkarāstaṃ ca kuṣṭhinaṃ kṣayarogiṇam ।
dadṛśustāṃ hṛḍḍakinīṃ sakuṣṭhāṃ kṣayarogiṇīm ।।59।।
ubhau jātismarau cāstāṃ pratīkṣamāṇau putrakam ।
uddhārakaṃ cāgataṃ saṃśrutvā'timuditau tadā ।।2.42.6 0।।
mleccho mlecchī sotsukau ca kiṃkaraiḥ saha satvaram ।
āyayaturyatra cāste kumārastu raṇaṃgamaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
rurudatuśca taṃ vīkṣyoddhāraṃ prati punaḥ punaḥ ।
prārthayāmāsatustatra tasthatustasya sannidhau ।।62।।
putrastau kuṣṭhinau vīkṣya tathā kṣayasamanvitau ।
svayaṃ śokena mahatā santapto vākyamabravīt ।।63 ।।
ājñāṃ pitrostu yuvayoḥ samādāya nayāmyaham ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ kariṣyāmi nirāmayau ।।64।।
athā'nayoḥ pitṛvarge gatvā rājā'bravīdidam ।
hā mlecchā naumi vaścātra kuṣṭhinau dvāvimau janau ।।65।।
cikitsārthaṃ kṣayasyāpi svagṛhaṃ ca nayāmyaham ।
tatrā'hametau nirujau kariṣye, ced bhavanmatam ।।66।।
tatheti sarvato mlecchāḥ kumāraṃ taṃ dayāparam ।
ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṃgā yathā jānāsi tat kuru ।।67।।
tata ānīya puruṣān śibikāvāhanānvitān ।
dvau pūrvapitarau rājā śivikāyāṃ nyaṣādayat ।।68।।
rājā cānucarāścāpi viprāśca prātareva ha ।
prayayuḥ satvaraṃ sāyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayuḥ ।।69।।
ṛṣiḥ svayaṃprakāśo'pi cāśvapaṭṭāśramaṃ yayau ।
nṛpādyāstu nijaṃ sthānaṃ vidadhurvaṭasannidhau ।।2.42.70।।
paścime tu taṭe cāsya saraso vāyudigbhuvi ।
rātrau sarve tīrthabhūmau cakrurviśrāntimuttamām ।।71।।
rājā viprāśca tau prātaḥ snāpayituṃ sarovare ।
samudyatāstadā vāyurantarīkṣe'bravīdidam ।।72।।
mā rājan sāhasaṃ kārṣīstīrthaṃ rakṣa prayatnataḥ ।
imau pāpena ghoreṇa sarvavidhena veṣṭitau ।।73।।
vedanindākarau devadrohiṇau yajñanāśakau ।
dharmanāśakarau pāpau pāpānto naiva vidyate ।।74।।
pāte sarasyanayostu saraḥ śuṣkaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
imau snātau mahattīrthaṃ nāśayiṣyata ulbaṇau ।।75।।
tasmānnaitau sarastīre jale samavagāhaya ।
etad vyomavacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhena mahatā'nvitaḥ ।।76।।
uvāca śokasantapto vyomavāṇīṃ prati prabho! ।
yadyetau ghorapāpiṣṭhau snānārhau naiva naiva ca ।।77।।
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye'haṃ tayorarthe vada prabho ।
tato vāyuśca devāśca tīrthānyapi samantataḥ ।।78।।
abhilakṣya ca rājānaṃ sarve vacanamabruvan ।
snātvā snātvā ca tīrtheṣu aśvasaraḥsthiteṣu ca ।।79।।
muhustvamabhiṣiñcasva tīrthakalaśavāribhiḥ ।
āgasāṃ lumpanaṃ yāvat tayoḥ syāt tāvadeva ha ।।2.42.80।।
svārthapoṣayiturdevadūṣayiturjanasya vai ।
sakṛt snānena śuddhirna jāyate kutracitkvacit ।।8 1।।
tasmādetau samuddiśya snātvā tīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ ।
abhiṣiñcasva toyena muhuḥ pūtau bhaviṣyataḥ ।।82।।
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā tatrāśramaṃ tataḥ ।
tīrthe tīrthe muhuḥ snātvā samānīya ghaṭe jalam ।।83 ।।
dine dine ca tīrtheṣu kṛtvā cāplavanaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
abhyaṣiñcat svapitarau tīrthatoyena nityaśaḥ ।।84।।
evaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ sarvairabhiṣiktau punaḥ punaḥ ।
aśvatīrthasya māhātmyāt tau putreṇa ca pāvitau ।।85।।
niṣpāpau tu yadā jātau tīrthānyāhustadā nṛpam ।
etau pavitrau paramau sarasi cāvagāhaya ।।86 ।।
ityukto raṇago rājā vaiśākhe tāvagāhayat ।
niyatau tatkṣaṇājjātau divyadehasamanvitau ।।87।।
mlecchatā layamāpannā divyaprabhā pravardhitā ।
kanthādharo vimānastho sastrīko devatā'bhavat ।।88।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā vimānastho'tiharṣitaḥ ।।89।।
parabrahma paroddhārakṛpānugrahavigraha ।
tava śiṣyeṇa ṛṣiṇā tāritau pāpinau prabho ।।2.42.90।।
putreṇa tāritau cāpi tvayā'pi tāritau hare ।
toyaiśca tāritau duṣṭau paropakṛtiśālibhiḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vipraiśca tāritau ghorāttamaso'jñānavaibhavāt ।
nārakī tāritau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tavā''śrayāt ।।92।।
pareśvarāya hṛtsthāya viprasthāya ca te namaḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśarūpāya tīrthātmakāya te namaḥ ।।93।।
namaḥ śaraṇyadevāya pāpiprāṇahitāya ca ।
śritamokṣāya bālāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।94।।
tvappratāpāt tarantyeva yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ।
daityāśca dānavā duṣṭā āsurāstāmasāstathā ।।95।।
māyikā vāsanāyuktā garviṣṭhāścābhimāninaḥ ।
vyavāyinaḥ piśitādāḥ stenā āsavapāyinaḥ ।।96 ।।
varṇasaṃkarakārāśca gostrīhatyākarāstathā ।
tvatpratāpāttarantyeva kṛpānugrahaśevadheḥ ।।97।।
āvāṃ ca tāritau yāmastava dhāmā'mṛtaṃ prabho ।
ityuktvā praṇipatyaitau putra svasti tavā'stu ca ।।98।।
datvā''śiṣo yayatuśca lomaśasyā''śramaṃ prati ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।99।।
itimantraṃ lomaśācca gṛhītvā tulasīsrajam ।
paramau vaiṣṇavau bhūtvā yayaturvaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।। 2.42.100 ।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptāstairthikāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।
yadatra snānamātreṇa muktirjātā hi śāśvatī ।। 101 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyeyaṃ dayā parā ।
rādhike prabalecchā ca karuṇā prabalā hareḥ ।। 1 02।।
yatra muktāvabhavatāṃ kanthādhro hṛḍḍakāyinī ।
kanthādhraṃ tatparaṃ tīrthaṃ khyātimāpaddharātale ।। 103 ।।
rūpadvayaṃ dadhārā'tha devī sā hṛṅḍakāyinī ।
chāyārūpā yayau naijaṃ pitaraṃ yamarājakam ।। 1 04।।
yamarājā''jñayā sā cā'bhavat hikkāsvarūpiṇī ।
sarvaprajāsu niyatāvāsaṃ cakāra yoginī ।। 1 05।।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa divyā hṛcchāyinī satī ।
muktimārgaṃ gatā divyapatinā sākameva sā ।। 1 06।।
muktibhāvaṃ gatā sā'pi pitṛmārgānugāminī ।
hikkārūpā vāsanayā chāyārūpā babhūva ha ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne
kanthādharasya hṛḍḍakāyinīpatnīyogena nāstikyaṃ, vedakarmādinirodhenaiśvaryanāśe vane maraṇaṃ mlecchajanma, putreṇa raṇaṃgamenā'śvapaṭṭasarastīrthe kṛtoddhāraścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 42 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 43
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 044 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bhaktakathāṃ paramapāvanīm ।
tato'yaṃ nṛpatiḥ raṇaṃgamastīrthe'tra nityaśaḥ ।। 1 ।।
cakāra vidhivattūrdhvadaihikaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam ।
bhojayāmāsa viprāṃśca sādhūn sādhvīśca kanyakāḥ ।। 2 ।।
bālān ṛṣīṃśca devāँśca bhikṣukān kiṃkarāँstathā ।
dadau dānāni bahudhā svarṇarūpyāṇi bhāvataḥ ।। 3 ।।
jagrāha lomaśānmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ drutam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 4 ।।
vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat tīrthavidhiṃ cakāra ha ।
jagrāha tulasīmālāṃ pratimāṃ pārameśvarīm ।। 5 ।।
bheje kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ lomaśasyā''śrame tataḥ ।
uvāsa paramaprītyā viprabhṛtyādibhiḥ saha ।। 6 ।।
samāgamaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ karotyeva divāniśam ।
saṃsmṛtya pūrvajāँstatra yajñaṃ kartumiyeṣa ca ।। 7 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ko'yaṃ rājā kasya vaṃśe'bhavat ke tasya pūrvajāḥ ।
kathaṃ yajñaṃ cakārā'sau kadā kutra vadātra me ।। 8 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
candraputro'bhavadṛkṣo'rbudāyurdharmayogavit ।
tasya putraḥ saṃvaraṇo babhūva sārvabhaumapaḥ ।। 9 ।।
sūryaputrīṃ sa tapatīṃ samudvāha sukanyakām ।
tābhyāṃ kālāntare jātaḥ kururājā virāgavān ।। 2.43.10 ।।
pitṝājyaṃ tvagrajebhyo pitrā dattamato hyayam ।
svabhāgaṃ prāpya ca dvaitavane gatvā kṛṣiṃ śubhām ।। 11 ।।
cakāra paramāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ brahmadṛṣṭyā halena vai ।
viṣṇuṃ sākṣāt kratau kṛtvā mokṣalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। 1 2।।
kuroḥ kaniṣṭho bhrātā yaḥ kanthādharā'bhidhaḥ śubhaḥ ।
saṃvaraṇasutaḥ so'pi dāyabhāgaṃ surāṣṭrakam ।। 13।।
āptavān khaṇḍarājyaṃ vai jīvanārthakamātram ।
siṃhāraṇye koṭinārapattane samuvāsa saḥ ।। 14।।
evaṃ so'pi candravaṃśastasya putro raṇaṃgamaḥ ।
sasmāra pūrvajānaśvapaṭṭasarasi tairthikaḥ ।। 15।।
brahmāṇaṃ ca marīciṃ kaśyapaṃ candraṃ ca ṛkṣakam ।
saṃvaraṇaṃ ca kanthādhraṃ tilavārbhiratarpayat ।। 16।।
sāvitrīṃ ca kalāṃ cāpyaditiṃ tathā ca rohiṇīm ।
ghaṭikāṃ tapatīṃ hikkāṃ tilādbhiḥ samatarpayat ।। 17।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpārśve paścime bhūstare kratum ।
kartuṃ ceyeṣa nṛpatiḥ raṇaṃgamo'tidhārmikaḥ ।। 18।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ṣaṣṭhavarṣake ।
cāturmāsye vaiṣṇavaṃ sa mahāyāgaṃ cikīrṣati ।। 1 9।।
nijarājyāttu sāmagrīrānayāmāsa satvaram ।
kuśān sampādyāmāsa samidhaśca pṛthagvidhān ।।2.43.20।
maṇḍapāgryaṃ maṇḍapāँśca racayāmāsa śobhanān ।
parṇaśālā vāsayogyāḥ kārayāmāsa śilpibhiḥ ।।21 ।।
kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍān vedikāśca paṭṭikā āsanāni ca ।
yajñapātrāṇyuttamānyaudumbaraṃ pātramuttamam ।।22।।
kauśeyāni suvastrāṇi kārayāmāsa satvaram ।
rasaśālāḥ pākaśālā bhojyaśālā drumādiṣu ।।23।।
klṛptayāmāsa subhagāḥ peyaśālāḥ prapādikāḥ ।
gauśālā hayaśālāśca patnīśālā vratasthalīḥ ।।24।।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā tvānayāmāsa cākṣatān ।
godhūmakān yavān vrīhīn tilān phalāni śarkarāḥ ।।25।।
havyadravyāṇi sarvāṇi raṅgadravyāṇi yāni ca ।
pūjādravyāṇyuttamāni dakṣiṇā bhūyasīstathā ।। 26।।
japajāpyopakaraṇānyakhilānyambarāṇi ca ।
kalaśān raṅgapaṭakān patrāṇi pañcadhā tathā ।।27।।
ghṛtapātrāṇi ca caruṃ devānāṃ sthāpanāni ca ।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā svastivācyāni maṃgalam ।। 28।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ ca saṃskārān śuddhiṃ prokṣaṇakādikam ।
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ cātha sahasraṃ brāhmaṇāstathā ।।29।।
yājñeyāḥ samatiṣṭhanta brahmādyāścāpare tathā ।
hotodgātā pratyudgātā sāmajñā yantravedinaḥ ।।2.43.3 0।।
āhartā pratihartā ca yajamānāśca jāpakāḥ ।
pāṭhakā brahmacintāśca guṇakāryakarāstathā ।।3 1 ।।
mṛgaśṛṃgādiyuktāśca nyadīṣan maṇḍapeṣu ca ।
prāvartata kratukāryaṃ vahnirnyadhāyi havyabhuk ।।32।।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
caturviṃśatyavatāraiḥ sahitaḥ pūjitaḥ puraḥ ।।33।।
brahma muktā rādhikādyā muktānyo viṣṇuyoṣitaḥ ।
pārvatī ca prabhā lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ satī kamalādikāḥ ।।34।।
haṃsā paramahaṃsā ca saguṇā mañjulā priyāḥ ।
pūjitāḥ mātaraścāpi śaṃbhurdevā gaṇādhipaḥ ।।35।।
brahmacarāḥ ṛṣayo'nye pārṣadāḥ śaktayastathā ।
paṭṭakanyāśca durgādyā grahā devāśca kṣetrapāḥ ।।36।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca siddhayo yoginīgaṇaḥ ।
sāttvikāḥ pitṛvargāśca sthāpitā devamaṇḍale ।।37।।
brahmasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirjīvasṛṣṭirvarīyasī ।
maṇḍape pūjitā tatra yajñabhāgārthinī ca yā ।।38।।
rājasāstāmasāścāpi devakiṃkaravādinaḥ।
pūjitā lomaśenā'tra viṣṇuyajñe mahotsave ।।39।।
raṇaṃgamo yajamāno gururvai lomaśo muniḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yajñāgryadevatā ।।2.43.40।।
sarvaṃ tatra susampannaṃ cāturmāsye'nvahaṃ kratau ।
vidhivannityamevaitadādyantaṃ karma puṣkalam ।।41 ।।
āṣāḍhe tu samāraṃbhaḥ kārtike'sya samāpanam ।
nityaṃ ca havanaṃ tatrā'yutavipraprabhojanam ।।42।।
anyeṣāṃ naiva pāro'sti koṭikanyādibhojanam ।
koṭibālādibhojyāni vastradānāni nityaśaḥ ।।43।।
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
rasakulyā madhukulyā madhuparkādivaibhavāḥ ।।44।।
miṣṭapānāni miṣṭānnottamānyagaṇitānyapi ।
dīyante bhojane tatra tṛptā bhavanti dehinaḥ ।।45।।
vahnirnityaṃ mūrtimān svakarābhyāṃ grasate haviḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān juhoti ghṛtadhārayā ।।46।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vahnirgṛhṇāti mukhapaṃkaje ।
yajñātmānaḥ parāṃ tṛptiṃ prāpnuvanti kratūttame ।।47।।
koṭidānāni dīyante raṇaṃgamena nityaśaḥ ।
evaṃ nityaṃ jāyamāne yajñe trailokyavāsinaḥ ।।48।।
darśanārthaṃ havanārthaṃ samāyānti viyanti ca ।
nityaṃ sahasrakamalaiḥ pūjayanti surā harim ।।49।।
yatra sā kambharā lakṣmīstathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
virājete ca janakau pūjopakaraṇapradau ।।2.43.50।।
yajñadravyapradau cāpi tatra kā nyūnatā khalu ।
patnīvrato maharṣiśca sarvādhyakṣo'tra vartate ।।5 1।।
tatra kā nyūnatā sarvasatkāre pānabhojanaiḥ ।
ityevaṃ rādhike yajñaḥ prāvartata dine dine ।।52।।
vṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate nityaṃ modante sasyajātayaḥ ।
kanthādharanimittena kṛto yajñaḥ sutena vai ।।53।।
kanthāṃ vinā sarvamadād dāne raṇaṃgamaḥ sutaḥ ।
kṛṣṇastuṣyatu pratyakṣaścetyuktvā'dāt supātrake ।।54।।
devāḥ svargāt samāgatya ghrātvā dhūmān ghṛtasya vai ।
śukarūpāścābruvaँśca divyavāṇyā parasparam ।।55।।
dhanyo raṇaṃgamo loke dhanyaḥ kanthādharo'pi ca ।
dhanyaścandrādayo vṛddhā yadvaṃśe yajñavistaraḥ ।।56।।
yatkratau viṃśatitamo'kṣaro lupto'nunāsikaḥ ।
sarvaṃ pradīyate yatra kanthāṃ kaupīnamantarā ।।57।।
kṣudhā devī yatra yajñe parājayaṃ gatā'sti vai ।
tṛptirvijayate cātra dhanyo vai lomaśo muniḥ ।।58।।
dhanyaḥ patnīvrato vipro dhanyaḥ svayaṃprakāśakaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yeṣāṃ sahāyakṛt ।।59।।
cāturmāsye sadā devā! vastavyaṃ tvatra sarvathā ।
gamanāgamane nityaṃ vṛthā yatno na ceṣyate ।।2.43.6 0।।
durlabhaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ durlabhā satsaṃgatistathā ।
durlabhaṃ cā'rhaṇaṃ nityaṃ durlabhaṃ śaraṇaṃ hareḥ।।6 1 ।।
durlabhā puṇyakīrtiśca durlabhaśca kathāśravaḥ ।
durlabhaṃ priyamitrāṇāṃ nityamevā'nudarśanam ।।62।।
durlabhā śrīharerbhaktirdurlabhaṃ caraṇāmṛtam ।
durlabhaṃ tatprasādasya nityamevā'śanaṃ tathā ।।63 ।।
durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ sarvaṃ dhanyā kuṃkumavāpikā ।
dhanyaṃ tvaśvasarastīrthaṃ yatra yajñaḥ pravartate ।।64।।
trailokyatṛptido devāḥ sākṣācchrīpatisannidhau ।
nedṛg brahmasaraścāpi nedṛgvai puṣkaraṃ saraḥ ।।65।।
saraśca mānasaṃ nedṛṅ nedṛṅ nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ ।
nedṛṅa pampāsaraścāpi na yatra parameśvaraḥ ।।66।।
atra vṛkṣāśca vallyaśca muktāḥ sarve vasanti hi ।
stambā gulmāstṛṇātmānaḥ sarve muktā vasanti hi ।।67।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vāricarāḥ pataṃgajātayaḥ ।
pārthivāḥ kīṭamaśakāḥ sarve muktā vasanti vai ।।68।।
dhanyaṃ rajo'sya deśasya yatsparśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ।
dhanyaṃ jalaṃ ca saraso yadbindurmokṣadāyakaḥ ।।69।।
vayaṃ yajñabhujo dhanyā yeṣāṃ lābho'yamuttamaḥ ।
raṇaṃgamo'yaṃ dhanyaśca devadeho bhavatvayam ।।2.43.70 ।।
devasiddhiyutaścāstu devasmṛddhibharo'stu ca ।
devo devagatimāँśca bhavatvayaṃ raṇaṃgamaḥ ।।71 ।।
ityāśīrbhiryojito'yaṃ raṇaṃgamo hi bhaktarāṭ ।
tāvat smṛddhaṃ divyayānaṃ smṛddhaṃ tadarthamāgatam ।।72।।
kāmadaṃ kalpalatikāyuktamānandasaṃbhṛtam ।
saṃsthitaṃ nityasevāyāmindrārpitaṃ sasārathi ।।73 ।।
dāsadāsībhṛtyayuktaṃ bhojyā'mṛtahradā'nvitam ।
saprakāśaṃ sarvaśayyābhogyavastusamanvitam ।।74।।
evaṃ raṇaṃgamo rājā devānāṃ suprasādataḥ ।
prāpyā'kṣayaṃ vimānaṃ tvakṣayavastupradaṃ sadā ।।75।।
dadau dānāni saṃkalpya nityaṃ koṭyarbudāni ca ।
āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ śambaraṃ ca mayaṃ tathā ।।76 ।।
kārayāmāsa tattīrthe tvaśvapaṭṭasarontike ।
parito devavāsanāmayutaṃ sāptabhaumakam ।।77।।
svargavacchobhayāmāsa devānasthāpayattathā ।
pūjanārthaṃ ca viprebhyo gṛhadānāni vai dadau ।।78।।
kalpavallīṃ ca pratyekabrāhmaṇāya dadau tadā ।
sarvaṃ phalati vallyāṃ ca bhogyamiṣṭaṃ ca nityaśaḥ ।।79।।
na kṣetrasya na sasyānāṃ gavāṃ nāpi prayojanam ।
dhānyārthaṃ ca kaṇārthaṃ ca vasārthaṃ ca tadā'tra vai ।।2.43.80।।
alparājyo'pi rājā'sau cāndrīṃ kāntiṃ sunirmalām ।
kīrtiṃ cāpyabhajalloke sārvabhaumādikāṃ tadā ।।8 1 ।।
rādhike! mama bhaktasya nā'pūrṇaṃ vidyate kvacit ।
mahyaṃ dadāti sarvasvaṃ tasmai sarvaṃ dadāmyaham ।।82।।
evaṃ yajñe jāyamāne devālayā'yuteṣu ca ।
jāyamāneṣu ca tato raṇaṃgamo divaṃgamaḥ ।।83।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saptame śubhe ।
āgate vatsare'ṣṭamyāṃ harerjanmotsavaṃ vyadhāt ।।84।।
tatra ratnāsane'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
upāveśayā'rcayat tu naikadivyopadādibhiḥ ।।85।।
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa lakṣaśo bālakānapi ।
surān saṃpūjayāmāsa gāpayāmāsa gītikāḥ ।।86।।
maṃgalāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
sādhūnṛṣīn satīḥ sādhvīḥ pūjayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ ।।87।।
dānāni dāpayāmāsa svarṇarūpyakahīrakān ।
vastrabhūṣāgomahiṣīrgajāśvarathakiṃkarān ।।88।।
atha rātrau kathāṃ ramyāṃ vācayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dvitīyakhaṇḍagām ।।89।।
kathānte koṭikanyābhiḥ kṛtaṃ kāntasya pūjanam ।
niśāyāṃ rāsaramaṇaṃ koṭirūpairhariḥ svayam ।।2.43.90।।
kāntābhiḥ koṭibhiḥ sākaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ ।
sthalapadmavāṭikāyāṃ vistṛtāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ।।9 1 ।।
parihāraṃ cakārā'tha sukhayitvā sakhīgaṇān ।
prātaryajñe havanaṃ ca rājā cakāra nityavat ।।92।।
āgatānāṃ ca devānāṃ janmotsavajuṣāṃ nṛpaḥ ।
sevāṃ cakāra bahudhā visarjanaṃ cakāra ca ।।93।।
kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yajñahomottaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।
parihāraṃ cakārā'sya kratordadau ca dakṣiṇāḥ ।।94।।
ratnahīrakamāṇikyasvarṇaraupyavibhūṣaṇam ।
vastrānnayānavāhādīn dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ।।95।।
avabhṛthaṃ cakārā'sau saharṣibhiḥ sarovare ।
avatārāstathā muktā muktānya īśvarāstathā ।। 96।।
devāśca pitaro martyāḥ sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।
yajñānte prayayurnaijaṃ naijamālayamutsukāḥ । । 97 ।।
rājā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajan sanātanam ।
viprairbhṛtyaiśca sahito divyayānasthito'bhavat । । 98 । ।
ṛṣīn kṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devān surālayān ।
tīrthāni vṛkṣavallīśca praṇamya prayayau gṛham ।। 99 ।।
koṭīnārākhyanagaraṃ prajābhirabhivanditaḥ ।
viveśa nagaraṃ naijaṃ viśaśrāma nijālaye । । 2.43.100 ।।
atha yakṣaścitramālābhidhaḥ śuśrāva taṃ nṛpam ।
pratāpinaṃ mahābhaktaṃ kīrtimantaṃ suyauvanam ।। 101 ।।
ājagāma ca saurāṣṭraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
dadarśa bhūpatiyajñabhūmiṃ prāsādavaibhavān । । 102। ।
nṛpeṇa kāritān jñātvā jñātvā māhātmyamuttamam ।
kṛtamālāṃ nijakanyāṃ dātuṃ yayau raṇaṃgamam ।। 103 ।।
raṇaṃgamena ca kalpavallyā navīkṛtaṃ puram ।
nagaraṃ devanagaraṃ dadarśa yakṣapuṅgavaḥ । । 1 04।।
avātarad vimānācca rājño nivāsamambarāt ।
kanyāṃ dāsīstathā dāsān dadau raṇaṃgamāya saḥ ।। 1 05।।
rājā vivāhavidhinā pāṇigrahaṃ cakāra ha ।
jāmātā yakṣavaryasya devavad rājate bhuvi ।। 106 । ।
yakṣaḥ putrīṃ pradāyaiva yayau kauberapattanam ।
rādhike! jāyate śrotā vaktā'sya bhuktimuktibhāk ।। 107 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raṇaṃgamakṛtayaśaḥ, prabhoḥ saptamo janmotsavaḥ, yakṣakanyayā raṇaṃgamavivāho vimānādilābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ । । 43 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 043 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 44
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 045 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! paścād rājā siddhisamāśritaḥ ।
pattanaṃ racayāmāsa somavelāhvayaṃ mahat ।। 1 ।।
yatra sauvarṇasaudhāँśca daśasahasrasaṃkhyakān ।
raupyasaudhāँstāvataśca maṇisaudhān sahasraśaḥ ।। 2 । ।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi vāṭikāḥ padmasārasīḥ ।
kārayāmāsa bahudhā vāsayāmāsa devatāḥ ।। 3 ।।
kalpavallīṃ dadau tatra pratyeke cālaye tataḥ ।
yakṣān kiṃpuruṣān bandīn cāraṇān bhūsurāṃstathā ।। 4 ।।
mānavān vāsayāmāsa koṭiśo devasadṛśān ।
evaṃ kṛtvā somavelābhidhaṃ dvādaśagopuram । । 5 ।।
nagaraṃ paścime bhāge somatīrthānmanoharam ।
tataḥ śrīsomanāthasya sauvarṇaṃ mandiraṃ punaḥ । । 6 ।।
kārayāmāsa jīrṇaṃ cottārya vai nūtanaṃ mahat। ।
sahasrahastocchrāyaṃ ca sāptabhaumaṃ ca gopuram । । 7 ।।
pañcāśaddhastavistāraṃ śikharaṃ parvatopamam ।
tatra devaḥ somanātho vyomastho rājate'śritaḥ ।। 8 ।।
suvarṇaśṛṃkhalābodhyo ghaṇṭo yatra virājate ।
daśayojanasaṃśrāvaḥ śatabhāragurutvavān ।। 9 ।।
śatamānavasaṃbodhyo yantramātreṇa śabditaḥ ।
yasya śikharakalaśaḥ sauvarṇaḥ saptabhāgavān ।। 2.44.10 ।।
pañcāśaddhastakocchrāyaḥ sūryasannibhabhāsuraḥ ।
pañcāśaddhastakadhvajo daṇḍo'sya śatahastakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yatrā'bhrāṇi pratiṣṭhanti cāturmāsye nirantaram ।
yatra sthito manuṣyaśca haṃsavat pravilokyate ।। 12 ।।
tatra bhogān brāhmaṇāँśca yojayāmāsa pūjane ।
viśeṣataśca rājā'sāvannasatraṃ babandha ha ।। 13 ।।
yatrā'yutaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ narāṇāmayutaṃ tathā ।
pañcāyutāni bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 14।।
bhuñjate miṣṭamiśrāṇi ghṛtānnāni ca nityaśaḥ ।
evaṃ raṇegamo rājā yajñapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ।। 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyopāstivaibhavāt ।
lokapāla ivāsīdvai pṛthvyāṃ vimānago'bhavat ।। 1 6।।
athāyaṃ pauṣapūrṇāyāṃ yayau vai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।
pāresamudraṃ yānena vaihāyasā pravīkṣitum ।। 1 7।।
dakṣiṇaṃ tu dhruvaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayau cāgre mahābalaḥ ।
bhojyapānaṃ dāsavargaṃ veṣaṃ kalpalatāṃ tathā ।। 18 ।।
sādhanāni saha nītvā yayau vimānago'mbare ।
saurāṣṭrād dakṣiṇaṃ deśaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ vilokya ca ।। 1 9।।
śatayojanakaṃ deśaṃ krāntvā cāgre yayau nṛpaḥ ।
samudraṃ ca dadarśā'sau dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritam ।। 2.44.20 ।।
tatra dadarśa ca lākṣādīpadvīpaṃ suśobhanam ।
tataścāgre yayau vyomnā māladvīpaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 21 ।।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau vyomnā sveṣṭadvīpaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
taṃ vilokyā'bhitaḥ paścānmuraśeṣābhidhaṃ śubham ।। 22 ।।
dvīpaṃ cālokayāmāsa yatrā'bhavanmurā'suraḥ ।
sa ca yoddhuṃ samāyāto vyomnā raṇaṃgamena vai ।। 23 ।।
kalpavallyā samutpādya vāruṇaṃ pāśamulbaṇam ।
rājñā cā''baddhya ca daityaḥ prakṣiptaḥ sāgare tadā ।।24।।
yathākañcit prāṇena sahitaḥ svālayaṃ yayau ।
atha rājā yayau cāgre dvīpe kurujaṭaṃ tadā ।।25।।
dadarśa paritastatra jaṭāyūmānavān tataḥ ।
yayāvagre vimānena dadarśā''ntarabījakam ।।26।
dvīpaṃ śītamayaṃ yatra makarāsyā hi mānavāḥ ।
prāyaśo jalavāsāśca rājñā tenāvalokitāḥ ।।27।।
tato yayau vimānena vaihāyasena dakṣiṇām ।
diśaṃ tatra dadarśā'yaṃ pṛthvīṃ śvetāṃ suvartulām ।।28।।
apkarakāṃ saśaivālāṃ rūpavacca prabhānvitām ।
yatra cāpomayībhūśca dehinaḥ śvetabhāsvarāḥ ।।29।।
apkarakādanāḥ sarve jale śailanivāsinaḥ ।
narā nāryo jhaṣākārā jalapāṃśusahāḥ sadā ।।2.44.30।।
pibantaśca jalaṃ śītaṃ khādanto jalaśarkarām ।
śaivālaṃ jalapākāँśca bhuñjanto nirvahanti te ।।3 1 ।।
gṛhāṇi jalapāṣāṇaiḥ kṛtānyatra vasanti ca ।
śītacandrasamābhāsā jalotthā'mṛtabhojanāḥ ।।3 2।।
evaṃvidhān janān paśyan dadarśa dakṣiṇaṃ dhruvam ।
prathamaṃ kārakīṃ bhūmi tato draṣṭuṃ vyavartata ।।33।।
vimānasthena rājñā sā vartulā vīkṣitā kṣitiḥ ।।
jalarūpyamayī sarvā vṛkṣahīnā vasundharā ।।34।।
yatra meghāḥ sadā santi sūryatāpo na vidyate ।
sāmudraprastarāḥ santi dhātavaḥ karakāmayāḥ ।।35।।
rasaścāmṛtamiṣṭo vai jalīyaḥ karakodbhavaḥ ।
jalaṃ śaivālapuṭikā jalapatrāṇi vallayaḥ ।।36।।
śvetavarṇāḥ śvetaphalācandrakhaṇḍanibhāśca tāḥ ।
jalaśākāni bhojyāni jalapāṣāṇajā gṛhāḥ ।।37।।
sāmudrakṣārakarakā jalānāṃ miṣṭaśarkarāḥ ।
jalapāṣāṇakandāśca bhojyāstanmānavaiḥ sukhaiḥ ।।38।।
etat sarvaṃ vilokyaiva vāruṇaṃ bhavanaṃ tathā ।
dakṣiṇadhruvagolasya madhyabindvāśrayaṃ sthalam ।।39।।
vilokya punarāyācca rājā raṇaṃgamastaṭam ।
tatra kampapradeśaṃ ca tataḥ kaṭisaraṃ puraḥ ।।2.44.40।।
vilokya sarvataḥ paścād rājasaṃ ca pradeśakam ।
dadarśa cāgrato gatvā deśaṃ tu kanyakālayam ।।41 ।।
tataścāgre dadarśā'sau kāṇākṣaṃ supradeśakam ।
tato'pyagre dadarśā'yaṃ sagrīvaṃ deśamuttamam ।।42।।
adrighnaṃ ca tato deśaṃ dadarśa jalaśailajam ।
yātadeśaṃ ca vīkṣāripradeśaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।।43।।
grīṣmaśūnyakadeśaṃ ca kusthadeśaṃ tataḥ param ।
dhruvabinduṃ vilokyaiva dadarśā'ntārkivartulam ।।44।।
evaṃ bhūgṛhyadeśaṃ taṃ śītamātrakṛtāspadam ।
śītalaṃ saṃvilokyaiva tasmād yāvannivartate ।।45।।
tāvad bhūtalagarbhācca śvetaparvatasadṛśaḥ ।
pumān kaścit samāyāto rādhike vyomamārgagaḥ ।।46।।
anantavīryo brahmāṇḍodaravāsaḥ kuṭumbavān ।
śvetavarṇaḥ śvetavastraḥ śvetatejaprabhānvitaḥ ।।47।।
śvetaśmaśruḥ śvetarasaḥ śvetaśailagadāyutaḥ ।
yanmastake'lagan meghāḥ pādayoḥ śvetaparvatāḥ ।।48।।
yatkaṭyāṃ śvetaśaivālā yanmukhe stanayitnavaḥ ।
yacchabdo dakṣiṇadhruvamabhivyāpya pravartate ।।49।।
vidyudvegā gatiryasya śvāsaḥ samudrakampanaḥ ।
aṭṭahāsaṃ diśāmanteṣvabhivyāpya nivartate ।।2.44.50।।
raṇaṃgamaśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃ cāvāpa vai kṣaṇam ।
tāvatsa śuklapuruṣaścā''juhāva raṇaṃgamam ।।51 ।।
ehyehi divyadeva! tvaṃ vaihāyasavihārakṛt ।
kiṃ te bhayaṃ nu matto'sti kalpavallīśritasya vai ।।52।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yasya hṛdi sthitaḥ ।
tādṛśastvaṃ mahābhakto balavān rājase bhuvi ।।53।।
dhanyo'si rājanparameśvarāśraya-
stvaṃbhautiko'pīśvaranāthadṛṣṭitaḥ ।
virājase devavadīśvaraḥ svayaṃ
pāraṃgatastvaṃ bhavasāgarasya yat ।।54।।
āgaccha maddhāma punīhi māmakaṃ
gṛhaṃ sadā bhūmisugarbhavāsitam ।
mayā sadā''rādhyata eva yastvayā
raṇaṃgamā''rādhyata īśvareśvaraḥ ।।55।।
ahaṃ hi śeṣasya suvaṃśajo jano
vasāmi garbhe'tra hi lakṣmaṇābhidhaḥ ।
anādinārāyaṇakṛṣṇabālakaṃ
bhajāmi nityaṃ sasamastabāndhavaḥ ।।56।।
gṛhāṇa satkāramanuttamaṃ mayā
kṛtaṃ tathā cārpaya darśanaṃ tava ।
nivedayiṣye'rcanayogyakopadā-
stābālakṛṣṇāya ca dātumarhasi ।।57।।
namo namaste mama nāthabhakta namo namaste paramātmavedin ।
namo namaste parameśabhakta mahākratukṛd bhavate namo'stu ।।58 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike tena lakṣmaṇena susatkṛtaḥ ।
vāgbhirviśvāsamāpanno raṇaṃgamaḥ sthiro'bhavat ।।59।।
tāvacchrīlakṣmaṇastatra rūpaṃ kṛtvā tu mānavam ।
saumyaṃ surūpaṃ bhaktasya viśvāsyaṃ tilakānvitam ।।2.44.60।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ tulasīyuktaṃ gṛṇantaṃ kṛṣṇanāma ca ।
nanāma parayā prītyā raṇaṃgamo'tibhāvataḥ ।।61 ।।
lakṣmaṇaścāha paśyātra viśvāsārthaṃ ca me hṛdi ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate prabhuḥ ।।62।।
raṇaṃgamo dadarśā'sya hṛdaye parameśvaram ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāśvasaraḥsthitam ।।63।।
rādhāpatiṃ prabheśaṃ pāravatīśaṃ sumañjulam ।
lakṣmīśaṃ haṃsanāthaṃ ca śrīmadgopālanandanam ।।64।।
saguṇeśaṃ kambharālālitaṃ bhaktavinodakam ।
divyakaṭakamukuṭormikāhāravibhūṣitam ।।65।।
koṭikandarpaśobhādhirūparūpānurūpitam ।
ujjvalaṃ mandahāsyasthaṃ paśyantaṃ tu raṇaṃgamam ।।66 ।।
evaṃvidhaṃ taddhṛdaye vilokya sveṣṭamādhavam ।
raṇaṃgamo mahābhakto viśvāsamagamatpunaḥ ।। 67।।
tataḥ sa lakṣmaṇaṃ nāgaṃ naramānavarūpiṇam ।
vimāne hastamādāyā''rohayāmāsa satvaram ।।68।।
tena darśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ vāhitaṃ nijam ।
prāptaṃ pṛthvīguptabinduṃ jalapāṣāṇabhūgatam ।।69।।
dakṣiṇadhruvagolasya mukhasya sannidhau mahat ।
vivaraṃ tatra cāyātaṃ bhūgarbhaṃ gantumeva ca ।।2.44.70।।
vartulaṃ yojanamānaṃ śvetanāgaiḥ surakṣitam ।
śītapāṣāṇasopānaṃ śītaprākārarakṣitam ।।71 ।।
lakṣmaṇā''diṣṭamārgeṇa vimānaṃ vivarāntare ।
viveśa kṣaṇato yatra jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।।72।।
dvārapānāṃ mahāśabdairbhūgarbhe cāntarāmbare ।
vidyunmaṇiprakāśānāṃ candraprabhāsamujjvale ।।73 ।।
kanyābhirvardhitaṃ lājaiḥ pūjitaṃ puṣparatnakaiḥ ।
vimānaṃ cāntare deśe gatvā pṛthvyāmavātarat ।।74।।
tatra vai pṛthivī ramyā śvetā kṛṣṇā ca pāṇḍurā ।
oṣadhayaśca vividhā drumāḥ phalasuśobhitāḥ ।।75 ।।
sasyānāṃ smṛddhayaścāpi svarṇavarṇā vilokitāḥ ।
nadyo nadā vāṭikāśca dīrghikā jalapūritāḥ ।।76 ।।
amṛtaiḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ kūpā raṇaṃgamena lokitāḥ ।
gāvaḥ śvetāḥ pāṇḍurāśca sapakṣā vyomagāstathā ।।77।।
kāmarūpadharāścānye paśavo dugdhadāstadā ।
vilokitā narā nāryaḥ sarve bhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ।।78।।
ujjvalāścandrasadṛśā maṇihāravirājitāḥ ।
śītāścandranibhāḥ sarve padmapatranibhekṣaṇāḥ ।।79।।
surūpāḥ piṅganetrāśca raktanakhoṣṭhapattalāḥ ।
vahiśuddhāṃ'śukāḥ sarve dṛḍhāḥ śvetānnabhojanāḥ ।।2.44.80।।
yathā bhūpari bhāge'smin vartate sarvathā'tra ca ।
tathā tatrā'pi rājā sa vibhūtīn sandadarśa ha ।।8 1।।
prāsādāḥ śvetavarṇāśca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ।
nagarāṇi surājyāni parvatā jalabhūmayaḥ ।।82।।
śvetāḥ sarvā manuṣyāścetyālokya vismayaṃ gataḥ ।
lakṣmaṇena vimānaṃ tanmahānagarasammukham ।।83।।
cālitaṃ yatra puṣpāḍhyodyānāni subahūnyapi ।
paritaḥ santi saudhāśca prāsādāḥ parvatopamāḥ ।।84।।
tatrā'syocchrayabhūbhāge prākārāntaraśobhitaḥ ।
lakṣmaṇasya tu rājño vai prāsādaḥ parvatopamaḥ ।।85।।
lakṣmaṇābhidhavarṇā'ṅko'ntarīkṣe dhvajaśobhitaḥ ।
śatabhaumo rājate yo dṛṣṭo raṇaṃgamena vai ।।86 ।।
vimānaṃ lakṣmaṇenātrodyānāṃgaṇe'vatāritam ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta rājarītyā hi rādhike ।।87।।
jayaśabdāḥ sainyapālā rājyavaccopatasthire ।
rājadhānī svargasamā raṇaṃgamena lokitā ।।88।।
bhūgolasyāntare bhāge sṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā'timānuṣīm ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpa raṇaṃgamo jaharṣa ca ।।89।।
atha vai lakṣmaṇo ninye raṇaṃgamaṃ sabhāntare ।
yatra vai śatarājñyaśca kanyakādvisahasrakam ।।2.44.90।।
kumārāḥ pañcasāhasrā vartante lakṣmaṇasya ha ।
lakṣmaṇena sabhāmadhye puṇye siṃhāsane sthitaḥ ।।91।।
pratiṣṭhito devaharmye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
svarṇapratimāsvarūpo darśito bhagavān hariḥ ।। 92।।
raṇaṃgamāya ca tato'rghyaṃ madhuparkamuttamam ।
dadauvamṛtapānaṃ supuṣpahārādikaṃ dadau ।।93।।
atha siṃhāsane saumye nyaṣādayacca taṃ tataḥ ।
kanyaikā puṣpamālāṃ saṅgṛhya tatra nideśataḥ ।।94।।
samāyātā dadarśainaṃ raṇaṃgamaṃ śubhāspadam ।
svāgatārthaṃ lalāṭe'sya kuṃkumā'kṣatacandrakam ।।95।।
cakre dadau puṣpamālāṃ kaṇṭhe'sya ca kare dadau ।
gucchaṃ sugandhapuṣpāṇāṃ cakre sugandhakokṣaṇam ।।96।।
yuvānaṃ vaiṣṇava raktavarṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca sundaram ।
dṛṣṭvā sā kanyakā nāmnā mālinī yauvanodbharā ।। 97।।
mumoha manasā śreṣṭhaṃ varaṃ mene'nurūpakam ।
athā'yaṃ lakṣmaṇo jñātvā dadau raṇaṃgamāya tām ।।98।।
sāpi bhaktaṃ patiṃ labdhvā mumude hṛdi sarvathā ।
athā'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ jagāda tām ।।99।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
lakṣmaṇāryastadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punarmudā ।। 2.44.10 0।।
prasasmārā'tibhāvena dhanyaṃ matvā nijaṃ gṛham ।
tāvacchrībhagavāँstatrā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 90 1।।
viditvā bhaktasadbhāvaṃ pratyakṣaḥ saṃbabhūva ha ।
divyakiśorarūpaśca sarvalāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ ।। 1 02।।
yugapatsūryasāhasrādhikatejovirājitaḥ ।
rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ sabhāyāṃ prakaṭo'bhavat ।। 102 ।।
utthitāḥ sahasā sarve nemurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
tejasā channanetrāste kṣaṇaṃ tasthurjaḍā iva ।। 1 04।।
śīghraṃ tejovimalatve dattāsanaḥ prabhurhariḥ ।
lakṣmaṇāryakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jagrāha divyavastubhiḥ ।। 1 05।।
niveditānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।
jagrāha suhasan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu tatkṣaṇam ।। 1 06।।
svastītyuktvā kuśalaṃ te kalyāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ tava ।
vadaँstiro'bhavacchīghraṃ kanyakāstu sahasraśaḥ ।। 1 07।।
mugdhāstaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā vavrire manasā patim ।
abhiprāyaṃ pitā jñātvā manasā haraye'rpayat ।। 1 08।।
atha yātrā nimittena prayāṇaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
lakṣmaṇāryaḥ kumāraiśca kanyābhirmātṛbhiḥ saha ।। 1 09।।
gṛhītvā koṭiratnāni svarṇarūpyadhanāni ca ।
maṇimāṇikyamuktāśca raṇaṃgamavimānakam ।। 2.44.11 0।।
adhyāruroha sukhataḥ kṛtvā rājyamamātyasāt ।
kāmage saṃkalpamātrād vistṛte yojanāyate ।। 111 ।।
bhūdvāranirgamayogye raṇaṃgamo ruroha ca ।
sabhāsthānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yatra śrībhagavān svayam ।। 1 12।।
pratyakṣo'bhūtparaṃ tīrthaṃ natvā tūrṇaṃ vihāyasā ।
deśaṃ visṛjya bhūdvārānnirgamyā'ntā'rkivartulam ।। 113 ।।
jalapāṣāṇadeśaṃ taṃ samullaṃghyā'ntarīkṣake ।
samadropari dīrghaṃ tadvimānaṃ vegavaddhyabhūt। ।। 1 14।।
yathā sūryaḥ samāyāti yadvā candraḥ prayāti ca ।
dṛṣṭaṃ jalasthalāvāsaiḥ rādhike dyotayad diśaḥ ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raṇaṃgamasya dakṣiṇadhruvadarśanārthaṃ vimānena gatasya antārkivartuladeśamadhye bhūvivare praviṣṭasya lakṣmaṇāryakṛtasvāgataṃ prabhordarśanaṃ lakṣmaṇasya rājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya tadvimānena yātrārthaṃ pṛthvyāgamanaprayāṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 44 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 044 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 45
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 046 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike tadvimānaṃ ca samudropari cottarām ।
diśaṃ prati prayātaṃ kampayaccānilamaṇḍalam ।। 1 ।।
jalaṃ cukṣobha sāmudraṃ dṛṣṭvā candranibhaṃ tadā ।
ghaṭikāmātratastattu dvīpaṃ kurujaṭātmakam ।। re ।।
samullaṃghya samāyātaṃ dvīpaṃ rūpyāyanāhvayam ।
tathā pārśvasthitaṃ dvīpaṃ muraśeṣaṃ parākramīt ।। 3 ।।
śrutvā tu paścime daityo mātrāgaskaranāmakaḥ ।
śailatulyaḥ svagadayā sahitaḥ sanmukho'bhavat ।। 4 ।।
kruddho mlecchasvarūpaśca kaṭimātrasamudrakaḥ ।
mā'jā'mbikāyā rākṣasyāḥ putrastimiṃgilāśanaḥ ।। 5 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ cāsīdayaṃ mātrāgaskaro rākṣaso mahān ।
ko'parādhaḥ kṛtastena māturme vada mādhava ।। 6 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
saurāṣṭre tu talājāyā rākṣasyāḥ kiṃkarī śubhā ।
moṃ ajā nāmataḥ khyātā kāmarūpadharā satī ।। 7 ।।
āsīdaraṇyavāsā cāraṇyavihārakāriṇī ।
paśvadā ca phalādā ca surūpā dṛḍhayauvanā ।। 8 ।।
ekadā sā mahāraṇye bhakṣyārthaṃ samupāgatā ।
paścime somatīrthe'syā gatiryadṛcchayā'bhavat ।। 9 ।।
sā hi tatra pavitrāँśca tairthikān vīkṣya śobhanān ।
tairthikaiḥ saha saṃgatya mānavīrūpadhāriṇī ।। 2.45.1 0।।
samuvāsaikadivasaṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva pāvanīm ।
kathāyāṃ rādhike cādhyātmikaṃ tattvaṃ samāgatam ।। 1 1।।
jaḍānāṃ cetanānāṃ ca rakṣako'sti pareśvara ।
paramātmā pare dhāmni divyairmuktaiḥ prasevitaḥ ।। 12।।
sarvānandanidhiḥ sarvasaukhyasamṛddhibhājanaḥ ।
tasya nārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanena sukhaṃ bhavet ।। 13 ।
sa tu nārāyaṇanāmno bhaktyā tuṣyati sarvadā ।
nārāyaṇeti satataṃ japanīyaṃ tato'niśam ।। 14।।
kīrtanīyaṃ ca satataṃ nārāyaṇa hare prabho ।
prāṇasvāmin sukhadātaḥ sarvasaubhāgyado bhava ।। 15।।
evaṃ vai bhajitaḥ samyak sarvaṃ dadāti vāñchitam ।
nāryaḥ saukhyaṃ susaubhāgyaṃ rājyaṃ dhānyaṃ dhanādikam ।। 16 ।।
patiṃ yaśasvinaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ putrapautrādikaṃ tathā ।
āpnuvanti na sandeho vimānavāhanānyapi ।। 17।।
jagat sarvaṃ tasya vaśe sa ca samrāṭ virājate ।
tasya rājyaṃ hi trailokye tadāśrayī sukhī bhavet ।। 18।।
kaiṃkaryaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā ।
yadicchet paramaṃ svargaṃ kāmabhogasamanvitam ।। 1 9।।
tasyāśrayeṇa sadbhāgyaṃ vardhate nityamuttamam ।
durbhāgyā subhagā syācca rājñī syād dāsikā hyapi ।।2.45.20।।
pṛthvī ca nirmitā yena jalaṃ yena kṛtaṃ tathā ।
agniryena kṛtaścāste vāyuryena vinirmitaḥ ।।21 ।।
tebhyo dehāḥ kṛtā yena yenātmā varṣmaṇi dhṛtaḥ ।
yena vṛkṣaphalānyatrotpāditāni ca bhuktaye ।।22।।
annāni śarkarā dugdhaṃ rasā yena vinirmitāḥ ।
yena nārī kṛtā ramyā yena vai nirmito naraḥ ।। 23 ।।
indriyāṇi prabhogārthaṃ kṛtāni yena dehinām ।
yena buddhiḥ pradattā ca vicāro yena nirmitaḥ ।। 24।।
yena nidrā virāmaśca kṛtā yena divā niśā ।
yena kṣudhā tṛṣā tṛptiḥ kṛtā yena sarasvatī ।।25 ।।
snehaḥ putraḥ sutā lakṣmīḥ smṛddhiryena divaṃ kṛtam ।
svargaṃ bhūstārakāḥ sūryaścandro yena vinirmitāḥ ।।26 ।।
samudrāḥ ṛtavo meghāḥ suvarṇaṃ yena nirmitāḥ ।
taṃ bhajeccet prasannaḥ sa jāyeta parameśvaraḥ ।। 27।।
dadāti bhajate nityaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ priyaṃ sukham ।
mumukṣavo bhajantyenaṃ śrīpatiṃ bahudhā muhuḥ ।। 28।।
bubhukṣavo'pi naijārthaṃ bhajantyenaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ।
nārāyaṇe bhavet snehaḥ puṣpaistu bahujanmanām ।। 29 ।।
snehavanto bhaveyuśca devāścānye tu rākṣasāḥ ।
madyamāṃsapriyā hiṃsāparāḥ paravighātakāḥ ।। 2.45.30 ।।
sukhino na bhavantyete nātihīnāḥ parārtidāḥ ।
ātmā na rākṣasaḥ kaścinna vā devo bhavatyapi ।। 31 ।।
karmaṇā rākṣaso devaḥ kathyate viśado'pi saḥ।
nārīdehaḥ sadā mlāno duḥkhadaḥ paravaśyagaḥ ।।3 2।।
nārāyaṇāśrayātpāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ tarati bhāminī ।
udarasya tu poṣārthaṃ pāpaṃ kvacinna cācaret ।।33 ।।
na vai mokṣasya janmedaṃ punaḥ punaravāpyate ।
kathaṃ tatra samunneyā pāpadā pāśavī kriyā ।।34।।
pāpī cātmā yadārabhya parameśaṃ samāśrayet ।
tata ārabhya evā'sau puṇyavān saṃprajāyate ।। 35।।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenā'sya saṃkalpaśca śubho bhavet ।
tato matiśca satsaṃge jijñāsā mokṣadāyinī ।।36।।
tataścāsya daivaguṇāḥ sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ।
dharmakāryaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ parakāryaṃ śubhapradam ।।37।।
svabhāvājjāyate tena yaśaḥ kīrtiḥ pravardhate ।
śāntiśca vardhate nityaṃ bhāgyarekhā prakāśate ।।38।।
paropakāro dānaṃ ca satyaṃ cā'hiṃsanaṃ vratam ।
śīlaṃ santoṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ tapo vṛddhasya sevanam ।।39।।
antaryāmiśravaṇaṃ cā'steyaṃ cānindanaṃ tathā ।
guṇāstvasya bhaveyurvai bhāgyarekhāpraṇoditāḥ ।।2.45.40।।
taistu lakṣmīrdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ suvāhanam ।
kuṭumbaṃ sutapautrādi sarvaṃ svargaṃ pravartate ।।41 ।।
śāśvataṃ susukhaṃ loke pare loke prajāyate ।
tasmādvai mānavaṃ dehaṃ labdhvā mā rākṣaso bhavet ।।42।।
karmaṇā rākṣasaḥ paścād dehe'pi rākṣaso bhavet ।
deharākṣasakarmā'sau kadāpi naiva mucyate ।।43 ।।
rākṣaso'pi tyajeddhiṃsākarma cānyāyabṛṃhitam ।
tena śuddhiḥ śanaistasya jāyate sattvagāminī ।।44।।
dehaḥ śuddhyati tīrthena satsamāgamatastathā ।
antaḥ śuddhyati tapasā ātmā guṇaiḥ suśuddhyati ।।45।।
daihyaṃ rākṣasabhāvaṃ sa vihāya mānase'pi ca ।
viśārado bhavecchīghraṃ tataścātmā'pi śuddhyati ।।46।।
nityaśuddho'pyasatsaṃgapāśaṃ tyajati śuddhyati ।
tena daivo bhavetpaścānmokṣamārge prayāti vai ।।47।।
tasmātpāpāni sandahya gurvāśrayaṃ samācaret ।
gurvāśrayeṇa ca hareḥ prāptirbhavati naityikī ।।48।।
tasmānnaro'thavā nārī pāpaṃ tyaktvā prabhuṃ śrayet ।
daśajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naradehaṃ dadāti vai ।।49।।
śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nārīdehaṃ dadāti vai ।
punaḥ pāpaṃ punarjanma nārī vai nārakī vyathā ।।2.45.50।।
malamūtrabharā śaśvanmalamūtrakriyāguṇā ।
malamūtrā'patyavatī malamūlarajasvalā ।।51 ।।
malamūtrāśrayagarbhā malamūtrādivāṭikā ।
malamūtraphalotpādā malamūtrāvahā sadā ।।।52।।
kathaṃ pāpād vimucyeta yadīśaṃ bhajate na sā ।
tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhajanīyaḥ sadaiva ha ।।53।।
yadā jñānaṃ gurorlabdhaṃ tadaiva gurumāśrayet ।
gataṃ dinaṃ kṛtaṃ karma na cā''yāsyati vai punaḥ ।।54।।
gataṃ kṛtaṃ sarāgaṃ yajjñāne sati tataḥ param ।
virāgāya bhavatyeva śocyaṃ tyaktvā śubhaṃ śrayet ।।55।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
japenmantraṃ sadā yaḥ sa pāpāya naiva kalpate ।।56।।
gṛhṇāti tulasīmālāṃ sarvapāpāt pramucyate ।
sevate sādhuvaryān sa muktaye jāyate sadā ।।57।।
bhajate śrīhariṃ yaḥ sa śāśvatānandamṛcchati ।
śvaḥ kartavyaṃ caredadya cādyatanaṃ kṣaṇe'tra ca ।।58।।
kālo naiva vipaśyettu kāryaṃ yadasya śiṣyate ।
sā hāniryo gataḥ kālaścātmaśreyo vinā kṣaṇaḥ ।।59।।
sa lābho yaḥ kṛtaḥ kālaḥ svātmaśreyo'rthakaḥ kṣaṇaḥ ।
śāstraṃ dadāti panthānaṃ yāntu śreyo'rthakā janāḥ ।।2.45.60।।
nityaṃ prāptastathā madhye sāyaṃ niśi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
mriyante cātha jāyante kīravanmānavādayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
jīvantaste prapaśyanti garbhe nāśaṃ mṛtodbhavam ।
jīvodbhavasya māse vā nāśaṃ varṣe vināśanam ।।62।।
bālye kaumārake nāśaṃ kaiśore yauvane layam ।
vārdhakye nirjane nāśaṃ naṣṭe kiñcinna śiṣyate ।।63 ।।
naṣṭe śreyaḥ kathaṃ syācca jīvanneva prasādhayet ।
janmahāniṃ ca maraṇaṃ mṛtyuśūnyaṃ ca jīvanam ।।64।।
arjayantu mahābhāgāḥ kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ tyajantu ca ।
kālakālādhikālaṃ ca parameśaṃ śrayantviha ।।65।।
svārthamātraparā lokāḥ paralokanirodhakāḥ ।
mṛṣā snehaṃ pradarśyaiva śreyovighātakāḥ sadā ।।66।।
mātā mokṣe janmadātrī pitā śreyaḥprapālakaḥ ।
patnī patitaṃ rakṣecca patiḥ pātīndrajālataḥ ।।67।।
bhrātā bhāsāṃ harerdadyānputraḥ pūtastu tārayet ।
svasā supuṇyaṃ dadyācca śvaśuraḥ śāntimarpayet ।।68।।।
yadyete na guṇāsteṣu te mṛṣāsnehadarśakāḥ ।
sambandhaḥ sarvathā loke pratāraṇaphalodayaḥ ।।69।।
jñātvā caivaṃ mṛṣā sarvaṃ cāniṣṭaphaladaṃ tathā ।
vicāryaiva hariṃ śritvā bhajeta kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।2.45.7 0 ।।
dehena manasā vācā karmaṇā snehatastathā ।
saṃsevya śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ gatiṃ labhet ।।7 1 ।।
ityādikāṃ kathāṃ rādhe! śrutvā mumukṣutāvatī ।
māँ-ajā-rākṣasī bheje kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।72 ।।
somanāthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā bhaktā'bhavattadā ।
tasyai sonāyanarṣirvai dadau mantraṃ ca tūlasīm ।।73 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
iti jagrāha mantraṃ sā tato yātā nijālayam ।।74।।
talājāyāśca sā dāsyaṃ sakhyaṃ karoti nityadā ।
vane ca parvate nityaṃ vanyaphalārthayāyinī ।।75 ।।
bhramate nirbhayā nāmajapaṃ karoti sarvadā ।
atha tāṃ nirjane dṛṣṭvā surūpā yauvanānvitām ।।76 ।।
sāmudro rākṣaso ninye nāmnā jhāṃjhīvaro nṛpaḥ ।
nairṛtyāṃ vai dvisāhasrakrośebhyo'ti murālaye ।।77 ।।
muraśeṣo jhāṃjhīvaro bhrātarau dvau babhūvatuḥ ।
dvīpatraye murasyaiva rājyaṃ hyabhūttadā'lpakam ।।78 ।।
tato sākṣīvaro naije rājye tasmāttu paścime ।
pṛthvyāṃ cābdhitaṭe mo'jā ninye mahotsavāt nṛpaḥ ।।79 ।।
tasyāṃ jātaḥ suto daityaścotatpannamātrayauvanaḥ ।
kāmago vyomagaścāpi māyāchālādivedanaḥ ।।2.45.8 0 ।।
sarvanāśakaraḥ sarvadveṣī lokārttivardhanaḥ ।
sadodvegakaro mātuḥ pituvīkye tvanādaraḥ ।।8 1 ।।
parakanyāharo naijaṃ rākṣasaṃ dhārpamāśritaḥ ।
paradravyaharo yuddhe rucimān nityayodhanaḥ ।।82 ।।
ekadā sa samudrasyarajalamānavaputrikām ।
prasahya cānināyā'tha patnīṃ tāṃ vidadhe nijām ।।8 3 ।।
jalasthāyāḥ sthale vāso rogārtha hi vyajāyata ।
rogagrastāṃ durbalāṃ ca jvaravyāptāṃ kṣayānvitām ।।84।।
iti tenā'ramamāṇāṃ paśumāramamārayat ।
ākrośanaṃ tu sā cakre kranditaṃ jananī tadā ।।85 ।।
mī'jā śrutvā samāyātā dayayā bhatamānasā ।
śikṣayāmāsa putraṃ svaṃ mā putra hiṃsanaṃ kuru ।।86।।
abalāyā balaṃ nāsti rugṇāyāstu viśeṣata ।
nirbalā tāḍyate tatte śreyo naiva bhaviṣyati ।।87।।
patnyāṃ pratāraṇaṃ patyustathā krodhena tāḍanam ।
prasahya bhogakaraṇaṃ patyāyuṣyavināśakam ।।88।।
sagarbhāyāṃ ca rugṇāyāṃ śramitāyāṃ tathā suta ।
skanditāyāmaraktāyāṃ na gāntavyaṃ kadācana ।।8 9।।
akālagamane hānirlābho naiva ca naiva ca ।
patnī svāṃgaṃ nijātmā ca kathaṃ tāṃ pīḍayet sudhīḥ ।। 2.45.90 ।।
ahiṃsāṃ kuru śaucaṃ ca dayāṃ rakṣa sukhāya vai ।
satye vartaya cāsteye vrate tiṣṭha sukhāya vai ।। 91 ।।
guṇe śīle ca santoṣe niyame saṃyame vraja ।
parameśe bhava bhaktaḥ śraddhāvān viṣayāँstyaja ।। 92।।
ātmā pāpairyadā channastadā rākṣasatāṃ gataḥ ।
parātmaduḥkhakāritvaṃ rākṣasatvaṃ sphuṭaṃ suta ।। 93 ।।
madyamāṃsādanaṃ nītivarjyaṃ rakṣaṣṭvameva tat ।
nītiḥ pavitrabhojyaṃ ca parasantoṣavartanam ।। 94।।
vrataṃ śāntiprayogaśca daivatā''pādakaṃ hi tat ।
tasmād daivo bhava putra! mā guṇānāsurān vraja ।। 95।।
mṛte dehe punarnaiva śubhalābho bhaviṣyati ।
tasmācchreyaḥ pare loke yathā syāttatprasādhaya ।। 96 ।।
bhajā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ svātmani saṃsthitam ।
mayā kathā śrutā pūrvaṃ tenā'haṃ sukhinī sadā ।। 97।।
rājyasampatsamṛddhyādyaiḥ paripūrṇā'smi putraka ।
tvaṃ nītyā kṛtakarmā san puṇyaṃ vardhaya śāśvatam ।। 98।।
mātraivaṃ tu samādiṣṭo rākṣaso duṣṭamānasaḥ ।
krodhena yaṣṭimādāya mātaraṃ cā'pyatāḍayat ।। 99।।
evaṃ nityaṃ tu putreṇa tāḍyate jananī tathā ।
patnī ca śātravī ceti matvā santāḍyate muhuḥ ।। 2.45.100 ।।
nahi vai śarkarāvāri nimbe karoti miṣṭatām ।
kupātre sūpadeśo'pi kāluṣyamupagacchati ।। 101 ।।
jananī jalakanyāyāḥ pakṣaṃ karoti nityaśaḥ ।
rākṣaso jananī tena tāḍayatyeva nityaśaḥ ।। 10 2।।
athā'yaṃ janakenāpi bodhito'pi na cādade ।
sūpadeśaṃ ca janakaṃ tāḍayituṃ samudyataḥ । । 103 ।।
ekadā mātaraṃ patnīṃ rajjubhyāṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sa ca ।
babandha cāpi cikṣepa samudre puṇyavarjitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
mātrā smṛtastadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
śīghraṃ tatra samāgatya rarakṣa karayośca te ।। 109 ।।
uddhṛtya mātaraṃ cāpi snuṣāṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
bhaktāṃ svagaruḍe nītvā tadgṛhaṃ pratyapādayat ।। 1 06।।
tāvad deśāntaraṃ yāto jhaṃjhīvaraḥ samāyayau ।
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca vṛttāntaṃ krodhaṃ tvavāpa duḥsaham ।। 1 07।।
muraśeṣaṃ bhrātara sa samāhūya tato'nayam ।
putrasyā''vedayāmāsa bhrātā bodhayituṃ yayau ।। 1 08।।
bhrātaryevamanayena vartanaṃ sa samācarat ।
tataḥ kruddho muraśeṣo jhaṃjhīvarastathā'nugāḥ ।। 1 09।।
matvā duṣṭaṃ ghātanīyaṃ ghātayituṃ samudyatāḥ ।
mātrāgaskaraduṣṭo'yaṃ pitrādidveṣakārakaḥ ।। 2.45.11 0।।
mṛtyubhayena dudrāva sāmudre tu jalāntare ।
tatra vai dharṣayāmāsuḥ jāmātāraṃ tu taṃ ripum ।। 111 ।।
krūraṃ duṣṭaṃ cā'nayasthaṃ sarve'pi jalamānavāḥ ।
dvīpe nikṣipya taṃ sarve paśumāreṇa roṣataḥ ।। 1 12।।
pitrādyairmilitā daityaṃ tāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।
tatyajurdayayā taṃ ca tatra dvīpe ca te janāḥ ।। 1 13।।
tatra vivāsitaścā'yaṃ vāsaṃ namraścakāra ha ।
mātrāgaskaranāmā''sau yatra dvīpe uvāsa ca ।। 1 14।।
so'pi balī ca mahatā valena cā'nayena ca ।
asthāpayannijaṃ rājyaṃ tato dvīpaḥ samudrake ।। 1 15।।
mātrāgaskaranāmnaiva khyātiṃ jagāma laukikīm ।
jhaṃjhīvarasya rājyaṃ ca jhaṃjhīvārābhidhaṃ hyabhūt ।। 116 ।।
māँjā ca rakṣitā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sasnuṣā ।
bhaktā sā kīrtimāpannā nārāyaṇapratāpataḥ ।। 1 17।।
māँ'jā'mbiketināmnā sā prasiddhimagamattataḥ ।
tannāmnā rājyabhūmiśca māṃjāmbiketi cā'bhavat ।। 1 18।।
tannāmnā tvālayastatra devī tatra ca rājate ।
daityā mlecchā rākṣasāśca dānavāstāmupāsate ।। 1 19।।
ityetatkathitaṃ rādhe mātrāgaskaraceṣṭitam ।
mātrāgaskaradaityo'yaṃ raṇaṃgamavimānakam ।। 2.45.120 ।।
lakṣmaṇāryakuṭumbena saṃyuktaṃ vyomnyarodhayat ।
aṭṭahāsaṃ muhuḥ kṛtvā yoddhuṃ samupacakrame ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne madhye rodhayato mātrāgaskararākṣasasya svastrīmātṛprabhṛtitāḍanātmakaduṣṭavṛttāntaḥ, māṃjāmbikāyāḥ sasnuṣāyāḥ samudre kṣiptāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtarakṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 45 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 045 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 46
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 047 →

ṣaṭpadāḥ
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadvṛttaṃ tadvadāmyaham ।
vimānaṃ staṃbhayāmāsa khe mātrāgaskarastadā ।। 1 ।।
lakṣmaṇāryasya ca raṇaṃgamasya sannidhau sthitaḥ ।
gadayā tau vijetuṃ ca kartuṃ vimānamātmasāt ।। 2 ।।
aicchanmadāvaliptaḥ sa garjanā bahudhā vyadhāt। ।
galitāstena meghāśca vārdherjalāni cukṣubhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
sahasrayojanānte ye sthitāte'pyāvahan bhayam ।
cakampe pṛthivī vāyurvimānaṃ kampamāvahat ।। 4 ।।
kanyakāśca kumārāśca trāsamāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।
athā'yaṃ bhagavadbhakto raṇaṃgamo mahābalaḥ ।। 5 ।।
sāntvayāmāsa sarvāṃśca sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam ।
drāgeva tu haristatra vimāne prādurāsa ha ।। 6 ।।
yuddhaṃ kuru vijayaste cetyuktvā sa tiro'bhavat ।
vaimānikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tadā dhairyamabhūnmahat ।। 7 ।।
athā'suraḥ punaḥ prāha vaimānika vihaṃgama ।
dehi yuddhaṃ ca vā datvā vimānaṃ svagṛhaṃ vraja ।। 8 ।।
raṇaṃgamastu taṃ prāha yuddhaṃ dadāmi vīra te ।
bāhuyuddhaṃ gadāyuddhaṃ śarayuddhaṃ dadāmi te ।। 9 ।।
śastrayuddhaṃ mantrayuddhaṃ prāṇayuddhaṃ dadāmi te ।
omityuktvā rākṣasaḥ sa gadayā taṃ raṇaṃgamam ।। 2.46.10 ।।
nijaghāna vimānasthaṃ muktayā vegatastadā ।
raṇaṃgamaḥ samutplutya padbhyāṃ gadāṃ pratāḍya ca ।। 1 1।।
adhaḥpatantīṃ daṇḍe tāṃ bāhubhyāṃ jagṛhe tadā ।
tāṃ gadāṃ śatabhārāṃ saṃgṛhya raṇaṃgamo nṛpaḥ ।। 12।।
bhūtvā vyomni mahāśailanibho jaghāna taṃ hṛdi ।
utplutya rākṣasastāmāpatantīṃ vyomamārgataḥ ।। 13 ।।
jagrāha pāṇinā yāvat tāvad raṇaṃgamena vai ।
prahitā śatabhārā ca gadā'nyā tvanalānvitā ।। 14।।
lagnā skandhāgrabhāge sā kaṇṭhajatruṃ babhañja ha ।
atha kruddho mahāśailo bhūtvā sahasrabhārikām ।। 15।।
gadāṃ dhṛtvā mahāvegānmumoca raṇagopari ।
raṇago'pi mahāśailo bhūtvā sahasrabhārikām ।। 16।।
kalpavallīsamutthāṃ ca gadāṃ dhṛtvā kṣaṇāntare ।
tayā''patantīṃ śatadhā cūrṇayāmāsa vai balī ।। 17।।
atha mātrāgaskaraśca vīkṣyā''ścaryamavāpa ha ।
kruddho dudrāva raṇagaṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhṛtavāँśca tam ।। 18।।
raṇagaśca mahadrūpaṃ dadhāra taccaturguṇam ।
bāhubhyāṃ rākṣasakaṇṭhaṃ dadhāra pāśavattadā ।। 1 9।।
rākṣaso'pi tadā sūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā'pyapāsarat ।
raṇaṃgamastadā vyomni sthito'bhūnnirbhayaḥ kṣaṇam ।। 2.46.20।।
tāvad daityo vyomamārgānmahāśaktiṃ pragṛhya ca ।
raṇaṃgamasya śirasi prāhiṇodanalānvitām ।।21 ।।
raṇaṃgamastu tvarito lohākarṣaṇakāriṇīm ।
śaktiṃ naijāṃ mumocaināṃ samākṛṣyā'surodare ।।22।।
lagnā'bhavattu sā bhittvā''ntreṣu sthirā'bhavattataḥ ।
asuro balavān bhinnamudaraṃ śṛṃkhalādinā ।।23।।
baddhvā śaktiṃ viniṣkāsya kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ha ।
vyomnyeva saṃsthito vidyunmantreṇa dīrghasāyakam ।।24।।
abhimantrya prāhiṇocca nāśayituṃ raṇaṃgamam ।
raṇagaḥ preṣayāmāsa vajraṃ kalpalatodbhavam ।।25।।
śaraṃ vināśya daityasya hṛdi lagnaṃ viveśa ha ।
daityo mūrchāṃ gato vyomno vārdherjale papāta ha ।।26।।
kaṭidaghnaḥ samudro'syā'bhavanmūrchānvitasya vai ।
atha śaityaṃ samāsādya vimūrchaścā'bhavattadā ।।27।।
namrāsyo lajjayā bhūtvā dhikkāraṃ svātmane dadau ।
tato vai racayāmāsa māyāṃ ghorāṃ tu rākṣasīm ।।28।।
sahasradhā'bhavad daityaḥ sainyaṃ raṇaṃgamaṃ tataḥ ।
abhitastāḍayāmāsa bāṇairdaṇḍaiśca mudgaraiḥ ।। 29।।
gadābhirmūśalaiḥ prāsaistomaraiḥ prastarādibhiḥ ।
śaktibhiścā'sibhiścāpi hetibhirbahurūpibhiḥ ।। 2.46.30 ।।
raṇaṃgamastadā kalpalatābalāt kṣaṇāntare ।
adṛśyatāṃ gato madhyād vimānāgre sthito'bhavat ।।3 1 ।।
daityo ruṣānvito bhūtvā tyaktvā raṇaṃgamaṃ tadā ।
dharṣayituṃ vimānaṃ lambayāmāsa karau yadā ।।32।।
tāvatkalpalatotthavahninā dagdhau hi tatkarau ।
dagdhahasto'suro yānaṃ grahītuṃ na śaśāka ca ।।3 3।।
hetīṃścāpi grahītuṃ na śaśākāpi tu garvavān ।
jvālāmukho'bhavacchailo vahnidāvasamākulaḥ ।।34।।
raṇaṃgamaṃ pradagdhuṃ sa mano'karottathāpi vai ।
kalpalatā'mṛtavarṣī raṇaṃgamo vimānakam ।।35।।
rarakṣa ca nijātmānaṃ vimānasthān sudhājalaiḥ ।
prajvalatyasurastatra vimānaṃ naiva dahyati ।।36।।
lakṣmaṇaḥ svīyarakṣārthaṃ svastipāṭhān jajāpa ha ।
yat tatsvastyayanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvamāṃgalyamaṃgalam ।।37।।
oṃ svasti kurutāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo brahmā svasti naḥ kurutā'cyutaḥ ।।38।।
svasti naḥ śaṃkaraścāpi śivāyuktaḥ karotvapi ।
īśvarā lokapālāśca grahā maharṣayastathā ।।39।।
viśve'śvinau sādhyamarudgaṇā'gnayo divākarāḥ ।
yakṣāśca vasavaḥ svasti kurvantu kinnarādayaḥ ।।2.46.40।।
nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi cā'bdhayastathā ।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ mantrā āyudhāni harestathā ।।41।।
bhaktāśca pitaro muktā rādhāramādiśaktayaḥ ।
bhūtāni svasti kurvantu tejasvino'nalādayaḥ ।।42।।
svasti dvipādikebhyaśca catuṣpādebhya ityapi ।
svasti no bahupādebhyastvapādebhyastvanāmayam ।।43।।
vimānasya svasti cā'stu svasti raṇaṃgamasya ca ।
vaimānikānāṃ kalyāṇaṃ svasti cā'stvapi maṃgalam ।।44।।
jvālāmukhebhyaḥ svastyastu māyājvālebhya ityapi ।
āsurebhyastathā svasti cāntarātmā karotu naḥ ।।45।।
ityevaṃ lakṣmaṇastatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
sasmāra svastimāṃgalyapradaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।46।।
pratyakṣo'bhūdbālakṛṣṇo vihasyā'nalaparvate ।
śāntiḥ śaityaṃ vimānasyā'nāmayaṃ vo'stviti bruvan ।।47।।
asurasya tu bhasmārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ājñāpayanmahātejaḥpuruṣaṃ pārṣadaṃ nijam ।।48।।
mahātejaḥpuruṣo'sau jvālāmukhaṃ hi dānavam ।
prā'jvālayat prasahyaiva pataṃgaṃ tvanalo yathā ।।49।।
vimānaṃ bhaktasahitaṃ rarakṣa bhagavān svayam ।
bhasmīcakāra ca daityaṃ jvālāmayaṃ mahānale ।।2.46.50।।
daśayojanavistīrṇo bhasmadeśo'bhavattadā ।
daityasya tatra vai dvīpe mātrāgaskaranāminaḥ ।।51।।
evaṃ vināśya daityaṃ ca vimānena surāṣṭrakam ।
āyayuḥ śrīharilakṣmaṇāryaraṇaṃgamādayaḥ ।।52।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
vilokya lomaśaṃ cāpi nagaraṃ svargasadṛśam ।।53।।
avateruḥ pṛthivyāṃ te nārāyaṇayutāḥ sukhāt ।
lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā yayurgopālamandiram ।।54।।
satkṛtāstatra ca pitrā bālakṛṣṇena vai mudā ।
mātrā kambharayā cāpi mudamāpuḥ supūjitāḥ ।।55।।
dattāsanāḥ kṛtāvāsā kṛtabhojanaviśramāḥ ।
kṛtābhāṣāptavṛttāntāstato vai lakṣmaṇādayaḥ ।।56।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
pūjayituṃ copadābhirāyayuḥ kambharāgṛham ।।57।।
siṃhāsane harirbālo vyarājata tadicchayā ।
prathamaṃ cāmṛtavārbhiścaraṇau sukhadāyinau ।।58।।
pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ sarvāḥ kanyakā divyavigrahāḥ ।
lakṣmaṇasyājñayā tāśca jagṛhuścaraṇāmṛtam ।।59।।
puṣpahārān ratnahārān mauktikīrmālikāstathā ।
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale kalgiṃ candanā'kṣatahīrakān ।।2.46.6 0।।
kaṭakān raśanā bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi samārpayan ।
phalāni cāmṛtapānānyapi pātrāṇi kaisarān ।।6 1 ।।
padārthān vividhāँścā'smai bālakṛṣṇāya tā daduḥ ।
ārārtrikaṃ tathā cakruścakruḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ namaḥ ।।6 2 ।।
caraṇau vakṣasi kṛtvā''vāpuḥ parāṃ sunirvṛttim ।
evaṃ kanyāḥ prasaṃpūjya śrīkāntaṃ hṛtsu sandadhuḥ ।।6 3 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kāntastāsāṃ hṛtsu viveśa ha ।
svasmin jahāra sarvāsāṃ hṛdayāni ca mādhavaḥ ।।64।।
jñātvā śrīlakṣmaṇo bhāvaṃ kṛṣṇe kānte tu kānyakam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pradadau ca tāḥ ।।65 ।।
yautakaṃ bahuratnādi dadau kṛtārthatāmagāt ।
tataḥ kumārāḥ sarve ca kṛṣṇapūjāṃ samācaran ।।66।।
lakṣmaṇāryastataḥ pūjāṃ cakāra pārameśvarīm ।
raṇaṃgamo mālinī ca cakraturharipūjanam ।।67।।
tataḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ te pracakrire ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasyā'rcanaṃ divyaṃ pracakrire ।।68।।
yayuḥ śrīlomaśaṃ vipraṃ tatpūjāṃ ca pracakrire ।
bālakṛṣṇo dadau kanyā rakṣituṃ lomaśāya ha ।।6 9।।
lomaśaḥ svāśrame'rakṣad vaiṣṇavīḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।
evaṃ kṛtārthatāṃ sarve prapedire hareḥ puraḥ ।।2.46.70 ।।
pānabhojanasatkārairānandaṃ lebhire'tigam ।
atha tīrthavidhiṃ cakrurmāghapūrṇāprage ca te ।।7 1 ।।
dadau dānāni divyāni svarṇaratnāmbarāṇi ca ।
parihāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā lakṣmaṇo nijarāṣṭrakam ।।72।।
gantumiyeṣa ca tadā raṇaṃgamo'vadattu tam ।
lomaśo'yaṃ mahāyogī kumārebhyo dadātyapi ।।73 ।।
mantraṃ mokṣakaraṃ rājan pradāpaya tadagrataḥ ।
lakṣmaṇāryastato mantraṃ dāpayāmāsa putrakān ।।74।।
lomaśaḥ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā pañcaśatakumārakān ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।75।।
mantrapūtān prasampādya cakre tulasīsragyutān ।
divyaṃ jñānaṃ dadau tebhyo vāsanākṣayakārakam ।।76 ।।
putrāḥ śṛṇuta loko'yaṃ karmabandhanajo mataḥ ।
satāṃ sevā śubhaṃ karma śrīharerbhajanaṃ śubham ।।77।।
ātmaśreyaḥ śubhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tṛṣṇānāśaḥ paraṃ sukham ।
dehendriyādiprābalyaṃ vāsanodbhāvakaṃ matam ।।78।।
jñāne baliṣṭhe gauṇaṃ tajjāyate nigrahātmakam ।
nigraho vāsanādāhakaro bhavati yoginām ।।79।।
dehendriyabalaṃ tasyā'kiñcitkaraṃ prajāyate ।
deho nārī tadantaḥstho jīvo naro bhavatyapi ।।2.46.80 ।।
bhuṃkte dehaṃ naro jīvo bhogo'sya sukhaduḥkhadṛk ।
tasmājjīvena vai bhāvyaṃ brahmarūpeṇa sarvathā ।।8 1 ।।
parabrahmāśrayaścā'sya brahmatāpādako mataḥ ।
parabrahma svayaṃ cāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'tra ha ।।82।।
tadyogo bhavatāṃ jātaḥ kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
koṭijanmā'rjitapuṇyairayaṃ kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate ।।।83 ।।
satāṃ samāgamenātra tatprāptirjāyate drutam ।
sādhurūpo hyayaṃ rājā raṇaṃgamo bhavatsuhṛt ।।84।।
ānīyātra ca vaḥ śreyaḥ paramaṃ pratyapādayat ।
tato bhaktiṃ cāsya nārāyaṇasya kurutā'naghāḥ ।।85।।
sarvārpaṇātmakaṃ tatra naiṣkarmyaṃ kurutā'naghāḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ tu vinā naiva siddhyantyatra pumarthakāḥ ।।86 ।।
paraḥ pumartho yuṣmākaṃ siddhaḥ prapyakṣayogataḥ ।
yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇe parā bhaktiryathā kṛṣṇe tathā gurau ।।87।।
teṣāṃ sarve pumarthāśca siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
te brahmajñāḥ paraṃ preyurbhuktvā bhogān supuṣkalān ।।88।।
sarvārpaṇaṃ ca viśvāso māhātmyaṃ bhāvanā smṛtiḥ ।
ātmīyasnigdhatā ceti ṣaṭ parabrahmadāyakāḥ ।।89।।
śāntirāstikyamatṛṣṇā'nudvego nirbhayā sthitiḥ ।
apāravaśyaṃ ca ṣaṭ te mahānandapradāyakāḥ ।।2.46.90 ।।
vṛddhābhivandanaṃ sevotsāhaḥ kartavyadharmatā ।
nyāyābhisaraṇaṃ mamatārāhityaṃ ca mārdavam ।।9 1 ।।
ṣaḍete sarvathā loke janānāṃ puṇyavardhakāḥ ।
