sahanaṃ sarvathā rujāṃ dehābhimānavarjanam ।।92।।
kīrtyādyananusandhānaṃ cā'parigrahavartanam ।
alālasā kutracicca rāgakriyāvivarjanam ।।93 ।।
ṣaḍete sarvathā loke jīvanmuktivivardhanāḥ ।
devānāṃ darśanaṃ nityaṃ tathā vivekadarśanam ।।94।।
lakṣyabindordarśana ca phalgupradarśanaṃ tathā ।
avighnadarśanaṃ cāpi darśanasya ca darśanam ।।95।।
ete ṣaṭ muktidāḥ santi vijayasya pradāstathā ।
akāmāśca tathā'svārthāḥ ātmasvārthāḥ parārthakāḥ ।।96।।
avinaṣṭasadācārā vijñāḥ ṣaṭ te hyanandhakāḥ ।
guṇamātragrahā ye ca guṇamātrapradāśca ye ।। 97।।
guṇadṛṣṭiprayoktāro guṇeṣvanyān prayuñjate ।
tattvajñānapramodāśca udāsate guṇetarāt ।। 98 ।।
ta ete ṣaṭ nirmalāśca videhāḥ santi varṣmasu ।
garbhaṃ bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ ca vārdhakyaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ।। 9 9।।
pretatvaṃ ca samaṃ yeṣāṃ te muktā guṇavarjitāḥ ।
deho gṛhaṃ dhanaṃ kṣetraṃ bhūṣāmbaraṃ ca bhojanam ।। 2.46.100 । ।
ṣaḍete'tithivad yasya tasya pādo'kṣare'sti vai ।
putraṃ nārī pitā mātā sutā dāsī gavādayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
satāmarthe prabhorarthe kṛtā yairmānavairiha ।
teṣāṃ pādadvayaṃ cāsti prabhoścākṣaradhāmani ।। 101 ।।
ātmārthe yatpriyaṃ cāsti tadvai dadet satāṃ kṛte ।
jīvaṃ dadet patiṃ dadet priyāṃ dadet sa mokṣabhāk । । 103 ।।
dhanaṃ dadedātmano'rthe ātmano'rthe dadet priyām ।
ātmano'rthe daded rājyaṃ mokṣārthe sarvamarpayet ।। 1 04।।
lomaśenetyupadiṣṭāḥ kumārā labdhacakṣuṣaḥ ।
divyajñānayutāstaṃ ca lomaśaṃ praṇipatya ca । । 1 05।।
svasṝḥ sarvāḥ praṇamyaivā''bhāṣya snehamayaṃ vacaḥ ।
vimānaṃ ca samāruhya pitrā śrīlakṣmaṇena ca ।। 106 ।।
rāṇaṃgamasya nagaraṃ koṭīnāraṃ yayurmudā ।
someśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ kṛtavanto'tibhāvataḥ ।। 1 07।।
raṇaṃgamā'rpitapūjāṃ gṛhītvā vyomamārgataḥ ।
vimānena samaṃ sarve yayurantārkivartulam ।। 108 ।।
bhūgarbhaṃ tāँśca prāpayya tadrājyaṃ ca raṇaṃgamaḥ ।
vimānenā''yayau naijaṃ koṭīnārapuraṃ punaḥ ।। 10 9।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe! bhagavadbhaktavartanam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śroturvaktuḥ śubhāvaham ।। 2.46.110 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raṇaṃgamamātrāgaskarayoryuddhaṃ, raṇaṃgamasya vijayaḥ, kuṃkumavāpikā''gamanaṃ, prabhoḥ pūjanaṃ, lakṣmaṇena dvisāhasrakanyārpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaganāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 46 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 046 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 47
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 048 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kanyā lakṣmaṇasya hareḥ priyāḥ ।
sahasre dve lomaśaśca bodhayāmāsa tattvataḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ vittaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ varṣmajīvanam ।
kṣaṇikāścāpi saṃkalpāścā'kṣaṇiko hariḥ prabhuḥ ।। 2 ।।
ātmā tasya gṛhaṃ proktaṃ cātmanyeva sthito hariḥ ।
gṛheśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ pātā patirhi saḥ ।। 3 ।।
jalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ kalalaṃ ca karkandhuḥ peṣikā tataḥ ।
puttalaṃ ca tataḥ pūrṇāvayavaṃ tena nirmitam ।। 4 ।।
bālyaṃ ca yauvanaṃ cāpi tainaiva nirmitaṃ sutāḥ! ।
vārdhakyaṃ ca viyogaśca pañcatvaṃ tena nirmitam ।। 5 ।।
nirmeyānāṃ tu mātāraṃ samāśrameddhi meyagaḥ ।
tadā cāmeyayogāddhi bhavatyātmā'pyameyavat ।। 6 ।।
ameyo dṛśyate cātra meyavad bālavat sutāḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ hṛdaye yaḥ kṛtāvāso virājate ।। 7 ।।
sa vai sevyaḥ sa vai pūjyaḥ sa vai dhyeyo nirantaram ।
prāptaḥ prāptavya evā'sau prāptavyo nāvaśiṣyate ।। 8 ।।
anityena śarīreṇa nityaṃ mokṣaṃ prasādhayet ।
anityābhiḥ kriyābhiśca kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ prasādayet ।। 9 ।।
vrataṃ kṛṣṇo japaḥ kṛṣṇo dānaṃ kṛṣṇe prakārayet ।
tapaḥ sevā harereva saṃyamo niyamo harau ।। 2.47.10 ।।
yajñaḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śāśvataṃ dhanameva saḥ ।
samādhiḥ kṛṣṇarasatā yogaḥ kṛṣṇena yojanam ।। 11 ।।
bhajanaṃ tana cālāpaḥ kīrtanaṃ tadguṇānuvāk ।
darśanaṃ tasya sākṣādvai sparśanaṃ tatsuyojanam ।। 12 ।।
tadicchayānusaraṇaṃ nigraho mokṣado mataḥ ।
tasya prasannatā puṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ netarat sutāḥ! ।। 13 ।।
śravaṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ mananaṃ cāpi vai hareḥ ।
svapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ prabodhanaṃ sadā harau ।। 14।।
ramante yogino yasmin ramaṇaṃ rāma eva saḥ ।
śramitānāṃ virāmo'yaṃ virāmo'nyo nirarthakaḥ ।। 15 ।।
rasikānāṃ rasaścātra rasayatyāniśaṃ hariḥ ।
tadvinā rasanaṃ cānyannirarthakaṃ suputrikāḥ! ।। 16 ।।
putrībhiḥ sarvathā bhāvya bālābhiḥ pañcavarṣake ।
śiṣyābhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ bālābhirdaśavarṣake ।। 17।।
kumārībhistato bhāvyaṃ caturdaśasamāntare ।
patnībhiśca tato bhāvyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhau । । 18।।
tatra śṛṇuta putrītvaṃ śiṣyātvaṃ ca yathārthakam ।
kumārītāṃ tathā yogyaṃ patnītvaṃ sārthakaṃ sutāḥ ।। 19।।
punnāmno narakāt trātrī puttrī teneha gīyate ।
śeṣapāpaharā śiṣyā śirṣṇaḥ pāpaharā hi sā ।। 2.47.20 ।।
pañcavarṣādūrdhvamasyāḥ pāpaṃ saṃkramate kṛtam।
pitroḥ śirasornaivā'sti yadabhūtpañcapūrvajam ।।2 1 ।।
kuṃ-sūtraṃ, māṃ- ca gāyatrīṃ, rāti, yā sā kumārikā ।
sūtraṃ yajñopavītaṃ gāyatrīṃ vidyāṃ tu tattvajām ।।22।
sampādayati yā kanyā kumārikā prakīrtitā ।
vidyāsnātā ca saivoktā saivoktā brahmacāriṇī ।23।।।
patiṃ nīyate garbhaṃ yā garbhātmānaṃ tu patnikā ।
patidharmeṇa yā nītā sā patnī pannamaḥpriyā ।।24।।
śṛṇuta punnāmakāni narakāṇi ca yāni vai ।
anapatyasthitāvudvejanaṃ yad dampatīgatam ।।25।।
tadduḥkhaṃ narakaṃ cādyaṃ sāpatyatve vilīyata ।
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi jalatarpaṇamityapi ।।26।।।
anapatyakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kavoṣṇamupajāyate ।
tad duḥkhaṃ narakaṃ pitṛbhogya dvitīyamucyate ।।27।।
sāpatyatve tu pitṝṇāṃ tadduḥkhaṃ vai vilīyata ।
anapatyagṛhe naiva saṃskārāścotsavāstathā ।।28।।
ṣoḍaśādyā na jāyante tṛpyanti devatā na ca ।
ṣaṣṭhyādyā naiva pūjyante dānāni na bhavanti ca ।।29।।
tadidaṃ devatāduḥkha puṇyapratinirodhanam ।
tṛtīyaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartata ।।2.47.3 0।।
anapatyasya samṛddhirvaṃśadāyādavarjitāḥ ।?
lakṣmīrviśvāsavihatā nirutsāhā na modate ।।3 1।।
tadidaṃ kamalāduḥkha saubhāgyapratirodhakam ।
caturtha narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ।।3 2-।।
anapatyagṛhe naiva jāmātā na tathā snuṣā ।
maṇḍapo na ca māṇikyastaṃbho nāgnipradakṣiṇam ।।3 3।।
gārhapatyo na vai tuṣyed vahnistadaṃgadevatā ।
tadidaṃ yajñaduḥkhaṃ vai vaṃśavistārarodhakam ।। 34। ।
pañcamaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ।
anapatyagṛhe nāsti kāmadharmaphalaṃ manāk ।। 3 5। ।
ṛtudharmaphalaṃ nāsti ṛtudānaphalaṃ na ca ।
aphalaṃ bījahananaṃ pāpasampādakaṃ bhavet ।। 3 6। ।
pāpaṃ duḥkhapradaṃ syācca puruṣārthanirodhakam ।
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tannarakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ।।37। ।
anapatyagṛhe naiva tuṣyantyatithayo'pi ca ।
anapatyamukhaṃ naiva prātaḥ paśyanti mānavāḥ ।।38।।
anapatyanivāsaṃ ca pārśve necchanti putriṇaḥ ।
etadvai mānavaṃ duḥkhaṃ janatā''dararodhakam ।। 39।।
saptamaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ।
anapatyau priyākāntau pretāvivātigarhitau ।।2.47.40 ।।
jīvantāvapi tau pretau viśeṣo nātra vidyate ।
maraṇe parahastena yayorvai aurdhvadaihikam ।।41 ।।
yadbhavenna gatidaṃ ca pretagatinirodhakam ।
aṣṭama narakaṃ proktaṃ sāpatyatve nivartate ।।42।।
anapatyagṛhe doṣāśceme bhavanti bodhata ।
anyeṣāṃ saṃkramastatra pāpināmupasevanam ।।।43।।।
pāruṣyaṃ dānadharmādau nirarthakamapārjanam ।
asantoṣaḥ sadā cāste bhavabhūtivināśanam ।।44।।
bhraṃśanaṃ nijadharmāṇāṃ māraṇaṃ bhayamityapi ।
miṣṭaikāśanamevā'pi mithyābhiśaṃsanādikam ।।45।।
parajāyāparapuṃsaṃsevana lubdhatā tathā ।
lolupatvaṃ putravatāṃ nindanaṃ śiṣṭalaṃghanam ।।46।।
śiṣṭācāravināśaśca satkriyādivilopanam ।
saṃskāraparihīnatvaṃ paranāśe prasannatā ।।47।।
hānirdharmārthakāmānāmapavargasya dūratā ।
sarvasya cātatāyitvaṃ narakāya nigadyate ।।48।।
etaiḥ punnāmakaiḥ pāpairnarakairāvṛtaḥ sadā ।
anapatyo jano ghorān narakān vai niṣevate ।।49 ।।
apatyaṃ narakaṃ ghoraṃ vināśayati sarvaśaḥ ।
etasmāt kāraṇāt putrīputravattvaṃ divaṃ matam ।।2.47.50।।
śiṣyaḥ śiṣyā ca pāpāni haratyeva ca tadyathā ।
śiṣṭānāṃ tu bhavecchiṣyo dāso bhṛtyaśca sevakaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
yadvā śiṣyā sakhī dāsī bhṛtyā vā sevikā tathā ।
śiṣṭānāṃ vā gurūṇāṃ sā sa ca sāhāyyakārakau ।।52।।
devasevā pitṛsevā ṛṣisevā'titherapi ।
sevanaṃ chidyate kvāpi vinā śiṣyamupaplave ।।53 ।।
tadvighnaṃ pāpakṛtproktaṃ śiṣyastasmāddhi tārayet ।
agṛhasthasya ca śiṣyavarjitasya janasya tu ।।54।।
sarvakāryāṇi naiveha siddhyanti narakaṃ hi tat ।
vidyā kalāśca kauśalyaṃ mantro rītiśca śāśvatī ।।।95।।
śikṣaṇaṃ ca kramaścāpi paddhatiśca paramparā ।
sājātyaṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ vinā śiṣyaṃ vilīyate ।।56 ।।
tannāśo narakaṃ proktaṃ saśiṣyatve nivartate ।
vijñāne yujyate śiṣyo dāyabhāge tu putrakaḥ ।।।57।।
ardhakāryakarī patnī narakasya vināśakāḥ ।
vinā patnīṃ na kutrāpi sthitirmānyaṃ gṛhādiṣu ।।58।।
na viśvāso nā'vakāro na śāntirnarakaṃ hi tat ।
na homādi na vai śuddhistatpāpaṃ narakaṃ sadā ।।59।।
neha loke ca kācidvai siddhiḥ paratra naiva ca ।
narakaṃ tatsarvadṛśyaṃ sapatnītve nivartate ।। 2.47.60 ।।
ajñānaṃ narakaṃ proktaṃ sarvadā'nakṣarajñatā ।
savidyatve vinaśyattu kumārabrahmacāriṣu ।। 61 ।।
saṃsāro'yaṃ kṛtastādṛg yatra sāhāyyamantarā ।
kāryaṃ siḥddhyati naiveha varṇeṣu cāśrameṣvapi ।।6 2।।
asāhāyyaṃ ca narakaṃ kāryahānikaraṃ yataḥ ।
sasāhāyyaṃ tu ca svargaṃ kāryasiddhikaraṃ yataḥ ।।6 3।।
putro hi bahukāryeṣu bahukāryeṣu śiṣyakaḥ ।
vahukāryeṣu patnī ca narakatrāḥ sahāyadāḥ ।।64।।।
kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi mānasaṃ ca svabhāvajam ।
asahāyakṛtaṃ cāpi pāpaṃ bahuvidhaṃ ca yat ।।65।।।
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sutaśiṣyapriyādibhiḥ ।
tasmācca putraśiṣyau hi vidhātavyau vipaścitā ।।66 । ।
dāyādā bāndhavāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca prajāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
śiṣyāstrayastathā patnyastisraśceti prakīrtitāḥ ।। 67। ।
patayaśca trayaḥ proktā yathākarmānubandhinaḥ ।
śṛṇuta putrikāścātra saṃkṣepāt tān vadāmi vaḥ ।।68।।
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścāpi dattaḥ kṛtrima ityapi ।
gūḍhotpannastathā''nīto dāyādā bāndhavāstu ṣaṭa ।।69।।
amīṣu ṣaṭsu satsveva ṛṇapiṇḍadhanakriyāḥ ।
gotrakhyātiḥ kule vṛttiḥ pratiṣṭhā vaṃśavistaraḥ । 2.47.70 । ।
tatrauraso nijajātaḥ pratibimbaṃ nijātmanaḥ ।
patnyāmanyena sañjātaścājñayā kṣetrajastu saḥ ।।7 1 ।।
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yo dattaḥ dattakaḥ sa hi gīyate ।
mitrādiputraṃ putraṃ yo manyetā'yaṃ tu kṛtrimaḥ । ।72। ।
na jñāyate gṛhe kena jātastviti tu gūḍhakaḥ ।
bāhyato yaḥ samānītaścānīto gadyate hi saḥ । ।73 ।।
kānīnaśca sahoḍhaśca krītaḥ paunarbhavastathā ।
svayaṃdatto nimnavarṇājaścaite nāmadhārakāḥ ।।74। ।
kanyājātassu kānīnāḥ sagarbhoḍhaḥ sahoḍhajaḥ ।
mūlyairgṛhītaḥ. krīto vai punarbhvāstu punarbhavaḥ । ।75 ।।
dattā'pyekasya yā kanyā bhūyo'nyasya pradīyate ।
sā punarbhūrnārī ceti paunarbhavastu tatsutaḥ । ।76 ।।
durbhikṣādau svayaṃprāpto'raṇye tyakto'thavā svayam ।
arakṣako vane prāptaḥ svayaṃdatta udāhṛtaḥ ।। 77।।
śreṣṭhavarṇanarānnimnanārījo nimnavarṇakaḥ ।
amīṣām ṛṇapiṇḍādikathā nāstyeva vaṃśajā ।।78 ।।
śiṣyāstrayo dīkṣitaśca sevako bhṛtya ityamī ।
dāyādastatra yo yasyā''jīvanaṃ cātmasātkṛtaḥ ।।79 ।।
patnyastridhā ca vidhyūḍhā punarvyūḍhā nigūḍhikā ।
vyavahāre cottamā madhyamā'dhamā kramāddhi tāḥ ।।2.47.80 ।।
patayastraya ūḍhaśca dvyaḍhūścopapatistathā ।
uttamo madhyamo'dhamo vyavahāre kramādamī ।।8 1 ।।
upadeśo yajñasūtraṃ dātavyaṃ tebhya eva ca ।
saṃskārāścāpi kartavyā anapatyatvahānaye ।।।82।।।
dāyādā bāndhavā yadvad bāndhavyo'pi tathāvidhāḥ ।
kānīnādyā yathā putrāḥ putryaścāpi tathāvidhāḥ ।।83 ।।
śiṣyā narāstrayo yadvat tisrastathaiva kanyakāḥ ।
vyavahāro'pi tatrā'sti cottamo madhyamo'dhamaḥ ।।84।।
bhavatyo mama śiṣyāśca bhavantyatra hi mantrataḥ ।
śiṣyapatnyaḥ snuṣāścāpi jñānapātryo bhavanti ca ।।85।।
tasmājjñānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dāyabhāgātmakaṃ mama ।
guruto dāyabhāgo vai prāptavyaḥ śiṣyakoṭibhiḥ ।।86 ।।
jñānaṃ muktistathā bhaktiḥ sevā devārcanādikam ।
ātmayogo hareḥ prāptiḥ puṇyaṃ tīrthādisevanam ।।87।।
ityete dāyabhāgā vai śiṣyavargasya pāvanāḥ ।
athā'nyacca pravakṣyāmi ṣoḍaśāraṃ sudarśanam ।।88।।
yajjñātvā na paraṃ kiñcijjñātavyamavaśiṣyate ।
sudarśanaṃ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।89।।
bhavatīnāṃ hṛdayastho bahiḥsthaḥ kānta uttamaḥ ।
kāntātmakaṃ paraṃ yogaṃ svadehe pravadāmi vaḥ ।। 2.47.90 ।।
āgacchantu jalaṃ haste gṛhṇantu kanyakottamāḥ ।
mantraṃ gṛhṇantu sarvāśca kṛṣṇakāntasya manmukhāt ।।9 1 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
iti tā rādhike! mantraṃ jagṛhurlomaśā''nanāt ।।92।।।
tadarthe ca tataḥ prāha yogaṃ ṣoḍaśapatrakam ।
oṃkāro vartate keśeṣvayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 93 ।।
nakāro brahmarandhre ca nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
makāro mukhamāpanno māṇikyāpatirīśvaraḥ ।। 94।।
śrīkāraścakṣuṣorāste śrīpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ ।
kṛkāraḥ kṛṣṇa evāsau kṛkāṭikākṛtasthitiḥ ।। 95।।
ṣṇakāro hṛdaye cāste bālakṛṣṇo'yamīśvaraḥ ।
makāro vartate nābhau naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।।96।।
rākāro vartate romasthāneṣu rādhikāpatiḥ ।
yakāro vartate yonipīṭhe yogajalāśayī ।।97।।
ṇākāro vartate nāḍīmaṇḍale hi narottamaḥ ।
yakāro vartate iṅgitārthado mānase hariḥ ।।98।।
pakāraḥ pādayorāste prabhuḥ pāravatīpatiḥ ।
takāraḥ piḍikāsaṃsthaḥ prabhākāntaḥ prabhuḥ svayam ।।99।।
yekāro vartate jānvoraiśvaryādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
svākāraḥ sarvagātre me mañjulātmā virājate ।। 2.47.1 00।।
hākāro haṃsajātmā ca kaiṃkarye homamāptavān ।
saguṇeśaḥ pañcadaśasvahaṃ vai ṣoḍaśī kalā ।। 10 1।।
kalāvān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvakalāpatiḥ ।
mama nāthastvevamarthaṃ paraṃ jñātvā na janmabhāk ।। 1 02।।
evaṃ tāḥ kanyakā rādhe! jagṛhurmantramālikāḥ ।
jepurbhejuḥ patiṃ kāntaṃ nijā'bhinnapareśvaram ।। 103।।
imaṃ tvarthaṃ paraṃ jñātvā svadehe śrīnarāyaṇam ।
virājamānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ye bhajanti narāḥ striyaḥ ।। 1 04।।
te paraṃpadagāścā'nte bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam ।। 1 05।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lakṣmaṇakanyakābhyo lomaśakṛtaputraśiṣyapatnyādirūpopadeśādi- nirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 47 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 047 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 48
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 049 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike ramyāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām ।
caitre śrībālakṛṣṇasya pūjātmikāṃ vadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
pitāmahasutā nityayauvanā vratasaṃsthitāḥ ।
brahmacaryaparā nityaॆ sāmavedasya pāṭhikāḥ ।। 2।।
sūryavadrūpasampannāḥ suṣumṇeḍā ca piṅgalā ।
tisraḥ kanyāḥ kumāryaścā'nujñayā vedhaso bhuvi ।। 3 ।।
mānasyastā manovegāścāyayustīrthavāñcchayā ।
śrutaṃ tābhiḥ purā satye nāradasya mukhānnanu ।। 4 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo rājate kamalāpatiḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpārvatīpatiḥ ।। 5 ।।
tato jijñāsayāmāsuḥ papracchurnāradaṃ tu tāḥ ।
kīdṛgguṇaḥ sa bhagavān yatpraśaṃsāparo bhavān ।। 6 ।।
nārado hi tadā prāha bhaginyo! bhagavān hi saḥ ।
asmatpituḥ pitā yaśca vairājastasya yaḥ pitā ।। 7 ।।
mahāviṣṇustasya pitā pradhānapuruṣastu yaḥ ।
tasya pitā prakṛtīśastatpitā śrīhariḥ svayam ।। 8 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'sti kumārakaḥ ।
pṛthvyāṃ śrīkambharāputraḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।। 9 ।।
asmallokaḥ sapyalokastatparo dharaṇistaraḥ ।
tasmātparaṃ jalasyāstyāvaraṇaṃ ca tataḥ param ।। 2.48.1 0।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ rājate tasmātparaṃ tejaḥkaṭaṃ matam ।
vairājā nāma lokāśca yatra vairājanāmakaḥ ।। 1 1।।
īśvaro rājate tasmād yanmahāvaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
mahāviṣṇustatra cāste cātha pradhānadhāma vai ।। 1 2।।
tatrā'vyākṛtasaṃjñaṃ ca yatra bhūmā virājate ।
tadvai vaikuṇṭhamaparaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇāśritam ।। 1 3।।
tataḥ prakṛtisātloke dhāmagolokamuttamam ।
śrīkṛṣṇo'tra, vāsudevo'vyākṛte, rājate prabhuḥ ।। 14।।
tatparaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma yatra brahma virājate ।
anantamuktasahitaṃ divyaiśvaryavirājitam ।। 15।।
tasmātparaṃ bṛhatproktaṃ paraṃ dhāma hareḥ śubham ।
śāśvataṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvadhāmaparaṃ mahat ।। 16।।
paradhāmasthito'nādiśrīkṛṣṇaśrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yo bhagavān svayam ।। 17।।
yasmād bhavanti vai vyūhā vāsudevādayastathā ।
avatārā īśvarāśca devā ṛṣivarāstathā ।। 18।।
anantāḥ śaktayo yasya rādhāramāprabhāśriyaḥ ।
lakṣmīpāravatīhaṃsākṛṣṇāvṛndājayādikāḥ ।। 19।।
śataṃ ca dvādaśa caiva śreṣṭhāstatrāpi pārśvagāḥ ।
prabhāpāravatīrādhālakṣmyaścatasra eva tāḥ ।।2.48.20।।
sadā svamūrtyabhinnāstā rādhā hṛdantare sthitā ।
lakṣmīḥ rekhāsvarūpeṇa vakṣasyupari saṃsthitā ।।21 ।।
prabhā kṛṣṇānane tejaḥparidhirūpiṇī sthitā ।
pāravatī padmacihnātmikā vāme'sya sakthini ।।22।।
vartante evamanyāśca śarīrāvayavātmikāḥ ।
koṭyarbudāśca yāstvanyāstāstu romasu sarvaśaḥ ।।23।।
tanmūrtau saṃsthitā devyo mugdhā bhajanti taṃ patim ।
sarvalāvaṇyasaundaryā''nandasaubhāgyaśevadhim ।।24।।
bhajante brahmavāsinyaḥ koṭyarbudakumārikāḥ ।
nālamedhyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi bhajanti tam ।। 25।।
dīpāvalyaḥ koṭiśaśca ṣaṣṭistatkanyakāstathā ।
talājā daityakanyā ca gokanyāścārcayanti tam ।।26।।
ārjantyādyāḥ śatasaṃkhyā bhajante taṃ pareśvaram ।
kanyā krodhanikānāmnī bhajate taṃ narāyaṇam ।। 27।।
kandarāḥ kanyakāścāpi bhajante koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ ।
brahmaputrī tathā sūcī vanadevaśca lakṣakam ।।28।।
rākṣasīkanyakā lakṣasaṃkhyā bhajanti taṃ patim ।
kaṃkatālīyajātīyāḥ paṃcaṣāścāyutaṃ tathā ।।29।।
brahmasaraso'psarasaḥ kanyakā devakoṭikāḥ ।
aryamṇaḥ kanyakāścāpi kuberakanyakāstathā ।।2.48.3 0।।
indrakanyā yamakanyā vāyukanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
ṛtukanyā viśvakarmakanyāśca drumakanyakāḥ ।।3 1।।
daityadānavakanyāśca pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
bhajante śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ taṃ parameśvaram ।।32।।
vasantasya tathā patnyo bhajante taṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ।
pañcaśataṃ sālamālakanyakāśca bhajanti tam ।।33।।
nāgakanyāyutaṃ śāvadīnakanyāsahasrakam ।
aindrajālikaraudryaśca kanyāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।34।।
ṣaṣṭikanyāḥ kiśoryaśca vidyātmikāścaturdaśa ।
vahneḥ putryaḥ śravaṇānāṃ putryaḥ saṃvatsarā''tmajāḥ ।।35।।
vārkṣīkanyāśca khanijāstaṃ bhajanti pareśvaram ।
dvesahasre kanyakāśca lakṣmaṇasya bhajanti tam ।।36।।
yogīśaṃ cā'saṃkhyarūpaṃ kiśoraṃ śāśvataṃ prabhum ।
tasya yogena muktiścā''nandavārdhisamarjanam ।।37।।
sarvadā vartate yasmāttaṃ bhajanti mumukṣavaḥ ।
ahaṃ taddarśanaṃ kartuṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ prayāmi ca ।।38।।
tasya guṇān pragāyāmi gāyatyenaṃ sarasvatī ।
ityuktā nāradenaitāḥ svasārastisra eva tu ।।39।।
tadgatamānasāḥ satyād vimānena samāyayuḥ ।
mandākinyā panthānaṃ tvanusṛtya himālayam ।।2.48.40।।
avateruḥ śrībadarīpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā prapūjya ca ।
kurukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudaṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā ।।41।।
dṛṣṭvā catuṣṭilādriṃ ca aśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
āyayustā vimānena kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ ।।42।।
ākāśamārgād bhāminyo dadṛśurujjvalāṃ kṣitim ।
caitrasya pūrṇimāsāyaṃ candrodayakṣaṇe hi tāḥ ।।43।।
vyomnā tat kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ sūryamivā'param ।
bhrājamānaṃ vyapaśyaँśca timiraṃ na manāgapi ।।44।।
tatastāstarkayāmāsuḥ kṣetraṃ tatpauruṣottamam ।
sarovaraṃ ca nagaraṃ viśālaṃ dadṛśuśca tāḥ ।।45।।
madhye tu kānakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāsādaṃ sūryavarculam ।
sūryabimbamivā''tmānaṃ khyāpayantaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ ।।46।।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi devapuṣpamayāni ca ।
devagṛhāṇi ramyāṇi ṛṣyāśramān sahasraśaḥ ।।47।।
divyāśca devatāścāpi dadṛśurvanadevatāḥ ।
avatārāśramāँścāpi tatheśvaragṛhāṇi ca ।।48।।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ divyaṃ śubhaṃ candravadujjvalam ।
divyauṣadhipravitataṃ dadṛśuḥ kanyakāśritam ।।49।।
tīrthasetuṃ ca parito dadṛśuśca vihāyasā ।
catuḥpradakṣiṇānyasya kṣetrasya saṃvidhāya tāḥ ।।2.48.50 ।।
pratarkya sūryasadṛśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayam ।
jayaśabdena sahitāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।।51 ।।
jayaśabdastu devīnāṃ vyomno'vyāpnot samantataḥ ।
śrutvā śabdān jayamiśrān lokā vyomni vyalokayan ।।52।।।
candravatkaumudīvyāptaṃ cākṛtyā padmasannibham ।
netrānandakaraṃ gandhasugandhāḍhyaṃ vimānakam ।।53।।
tejobhūtaṃ vicitraṃ ca raṃgānuraṃgaśobhitam ।
antaḥpraviśya ca cakṣurdṛśyaṃ kanyāśritaṃ śubham ।।54।।
samṛddhaṃ divyavastvāḍhyaṃ vastratoraṇavardhitam ।
sauvarṇakalaśairyuktaṃ triśṛṃgaṃ tryāsanānvitam ।।55।।
dadṛśurmānavādyāśca paramāścaryamāgatāḥ ।
vimānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadevālayopari ।।56।।
sthiraṃ cābhūdambare ca tatra tisrastu kanyakāḥ ।
śuśruvuḥ sarvato jātān nīrājanasamudbhavān ।।57।।
ninadānnaikasaṃghoṣān stotrottamānasaṃkhyakān ।
tallīnāstāstadā jātā āpuḥ śāntiṃ parāṃ tadā ।।58।।
atha jñātvā śrīkṛṣṇastā bhaktā brahmasutā ratāḥ ।
svayaṃ kiśorarūpaśca vimāne prādurāsa ha ।।59।।
divyadarśanajaṃ saukhyaṃ sparśānandaṃ parātparam ।
dadau kṣaṇaṃ ca tābhyaśca saṃśleṣajaṃ mahāsukham ।।2.48.60।।
vimānaṃ śrīharistatrā'vatārayat nijālaye ।
adṛśyo'bhūttadā yāne svarṇasaudhe gato'bhavat ।।61 ।।
kanyakāstā vimānāccā'vateruḥ kṛṣṇamandire ।
candraśālopari kṣaṇaṃ tasthurvimānasannidhau ।।6 2।।
upadāstā vimānācca saṃgṛhya divyabhāsurāḥ ।
candraśālopari nyadhuḥ pratīkṣantyo'bhimārgadam ।।63 ।।
kiṃkaraṃ kiṃkarīṃ cāpi jānatī cāvarohaṇam ।
antaḥpraveśanārthaṃ ca pratīhārīpratīkṣakāḥ ।।64।।
tasthustāścandraśālāyāṃ tāvacchrīkambharāsutā ।
santoṣānāmikā tūrṇaṃ sakhyā suśīlayā saha ।।65।।
bhrāturbhagavataḥ pratnyā'mṛtayā ca sahā''yayau ।
candraśālāsthitā divyāḥ kanyāstejaḥśarīriṇīḥ ।।66।।
nemurvilokya ca śīghraṃ svāgataṃ jagaduḥ sukham ।
āgacchata mahābhāgāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।।67।।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi saptamabhvāṃ virājitam ।
ityuktāstāḥ suṣumṇā ca iḍā ca piṅgalā tathā ।।68।।
puṣpahārān candanāni karpūraṃ cā'kṣatāँstathā ।
kuṃkumaṃ gandhasārāँśca kaisarāṇyuttamāni ca ।।69 ।।
ratnahārān ratnabhūṣā makuṭaṃ kuṇḍale tathā ।
divyatāmbūlakaṃ divyaphalānyapyavalepanam ।।2.48.70।।
divyaṃ ca kajjalaṃ ramyaṃ tailaṃ brāhmaṃ samattamam ।
saugandhikavārisārān vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca ।।71 ।।
sadratnahīrakahārān pātrāṇi kānakāni ca ।
ādarśān divyadṛśyāँśca divyasammardacūrṇakān ।।72।।
divyanaivedyayogyāँśca miṣṭabhojyānnapācitān ।
amṛtān dugdhasārāँścā'saṃkhyabījaphalāni ca ।।73 ।।
divyapeyāḍhyapātrāṇi samādāya tathā punaḥ ।
divyaśayyāstaraṇāni divyadhāryāmbarāṇi ca ।।74।।
gṛhītvā pātrahastāstāścāvateruḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
bhavyasopānā'varohamārgairbhūmyantaraṃ ca tāḥ ।।75।।
santoṣā kanyakā cāgre madhye tisro'jakanyakāḥ ।
pṛṣṭhe cā'pyamṛtā bhrātṛjāyā suśīlikā tataḥ ।।76 ।।
ekāṃ bhūmimavatīrya viśāle bhūmisaṃstare ।
viviśuḥ saptamabhūmau yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।77।।
tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīrmātā virājate satī ।
mātaraṃ tāḥ sampraṇamya bālakṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca ।।78।।
divyāsaneṣu datteṣu niṣedustā yathocitam ।
ābhāṣitāśca tā mātrā maṃgalaṃ kuśalaṃ prati ।।79।।
prayojanaṃ tathā tāsāṃ janakaṃ jananīṃ prati ।
ūcuḥ paricayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇastu sutā vayam ।।2.48.80।।
suṣumṇā ca iḍā cāpi piṃgalā nāma kanyakāḥ ।
kumārikā nijabhrāturnāradasyopadeśataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
vijñāya śrīmatīputraṃ tvanādiparameśvaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cainaṃ kiśoraṃ kāntamacyutam ।।82।।।
draṣṭuṃ vayaṃ samāyātā dhanyāḥ smo'syā'dya darśanāt ।
adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma kaumāryaṃ saphalaṃ ca naḥ ।।83
devītvaṃ saphalaṃ cāpi mātaste'pi ca darśanāt ।
ityuktvā cā'mṛtāṃ pṛṣṭvā santoṣāṃ ca suśīlikām ।।84।।
pūjāṃ cakruḥ keśavasya bālakṛṣṇasya sammatāḥ ।
prathamaṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇau pupūjurgāṃgavāribhiḥ ।।89।।
nyadhurmukhe ca śirasi śrīkāntacaraṇāmṛtam ।
tataścandanabindvādi bhāle cakurharestataḥ ।।86।।
sugandhilepanaṃ cakrurdaduḥ sugandhavāri ca ।
gandhasārāndaduścāpi kajjalaṃ kuṃkumādikam ।।87।।
puṣpahārān ratnahārān vibhāṣā mukuṭaṃ tathā ।
kaṭake kuṇḍale cāpi daduścānyavibhūtikam ।।88।।
ambarāṇi śayanāni phalānnapeyakāni ca ।
upadāśca nyadhustasya purataścāmarādikam ।।89।।
naivedyāni daduścāpi miṣṭapeyāni yāni ca ।
tāmbūlakaṃ daduścāpi cakrurnīrājana tataḥ ।।2.48.90।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca mālikāṃ mahatīṃ gale ।
daduścāntarabhāvānāṃ jñāpayitrīṃ tu śāśvatīm ।।9 1 ।।
kāntaḥ kāntākṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā ca tāḥ ।
pasparśa tatkarān kṛṣṇo bhāvajño bhāvi bodhayan ।।92।।
vihasan lokayan tāsāmānanāni muhurmuhuḥ ।
tāścāti jahṛṣuḥ rādhe bālakṛṣṇāptihetunā ।। 93।।
atha tā mātaraṃ tadvat santoṣāṃ cāmṛtāṃ tathā ।
amlānāḥ puṣpamālāścārpayāmāsurgalāntare ।।94।।
nemustābhyo vinamrāśca bhojitā viśramīkṛtāḥ ।
pāyitāḥ śāyitāścāpi saṃvāhitāśca varṣmasu ।।95।।
sakhībhiḥ kiṃkarībhiśca sevitā nidritāśca tāḥ ।
prātarutthāya ca snātvā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।।96।।
tīrthavidhiṃ paraṃ kṛtvā gatvā śrīlomaśāśramam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।97।।
mantraṃ mālāṃ taulasīṃ ca gṛhītvā vīkṣya koṭyarbudam ।
kanyakānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca prasannāḥ pūjyabhāvataḥ ।।98।।
natvā śīghraṃ punaḥ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ prati samāyayuḥ ।
darśanaṃ prāpya tṛptāstāḥ kṛṣṇavaśyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 99।।
atṛptā iva paśyanti hṛdi kṛtvā patiṃ prabhum ।
śrīkṛṣṇena hṛdā cāṃgīkṛtāstāḥ svagṛhaṃ prati ।। 2.48.10 0।।
gantuṃ necchāṃ yadā cakrustadā prāha narāyaṇaḥ ।
punarājñāṃ piturnītvā samāyātā'tra satvaram ।। 101 ।।
bhavatīnāṃ mānasāni pūrayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityuktāstā hareragre samarpya sarvavastukam ।। 1 02।।
vimāna vastuśūnyaṃ ca kṛtvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
pūjayitvā tato natvā''gṛhyā''jñāṃ bhojanottaram ।। 1 03।।
prasādya śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ natvā rādhe punaḥ punaḥ ।
prasādajaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ prāpya vimānamāsthitāḥ ।। 1 04।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro natvā natvā kuṃkumavāpikām ।
kāntadevālayaṃ natvā vyomnā yānena cāmbare ।। 1 05।।
tiro'bhavan kṣaṇānmuktvā jayaśabdān punaḥ punaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya kṛṣṇasaubhāgyavān bhavet ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vedhasastisraḥ putryaḥ suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalā vimānenā''gatya prabhuṃ patiṃ matvā saṃpūjya yayurityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 48 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 048 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 49
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 050 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ kānta! suṣumṇādyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।
lomaśasyā''śrame sthātuṃ nājñaptāḥ svīkṛtā api ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi kanyāścānyāstu vedhasaḥ ।
tā mānasyaḥ samicchanti kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaram ।। 2 ।।
satyaloke vasanti sma pratīkṣante sma bhāvataḥ ।
tisro'grajāḥ sameṣyanti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 3 ।।
vayaṃ tābhiḥ samaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmo vilokitum ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ seviṣyāmahe'nādimādhavam ।। 4 ।।
itipratīkṣamāṇānāmānayanārthameva tāḥ ।
na niruddhā idānīṃ vai sthātuṃ śrīlomaśāśrame ।। 5 ।।
brahmaṇā preṣitāḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣayiṣyati tāḥ punaḥ ।
atha tāḥ svavimānena paścimāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।। 6 ।।
samudraṃ ca tathā dvīpānabriktān supradeśakān ।
paśyantyo vyomamārgeṇa pradakṣiṇecchayottaram ।। 7 ।।
yāntyaḥ pradadṛśurdeśaṃ cābriktaṃ sumahattaram ।
punaḥ punaḥ parāvṛtya vyomnā yānena nirbhayāḥ ।। 8 ।।
ārabījaṃ mahādvīpaṃ raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato'grataḥ ।
raktaṃ ca vāridhiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūmau nārāyaṇīṃ nadīm ।। 9 ।।
vīkṣya dakṣiṇabhāge ca rudrabāṣpaṃ sarovaram ।
tathā vijñaturīyākhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śreṣṭhaṃ sarovaram ।। 2.49.1 0।।
tuṅgānīkasaraścāpi tathā nyāsasaro'pi ca ।
dṛṣṭvā liṃgarasādriṃ ca drākṣābījaṃ ca parvatam ।। 1 1।।
kālahariṃ raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā umāśaṃbhugiriṃ tathā ।
karmāṅgīṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā karmaghnaṃ parvataṃ tathā ।। 12।।
caṇḍasarastato dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya naṣṭajarāṃ nadīm ।
sahariharasaṃjñaṃ ca raṇaṃ vilokya vai tataḥ ।। 1 3।।
ataleṣṭaṃ parvataṃ ca tanmukhaṃ parvataṃ tathā ।
trirāśiparvataṃ dṛṣṭvā līlābījaraṇaṃ tathā ।। 14।।
śrīramāyā raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tururājyaṃ vilokya ca ।
kaśyapāyanavārdhi ca dṛṣṭvā coralaparvatam ।। 15।।
paścime ca kukeśādriṃ nīlābdhiṃ pravilokya ca ।
nīparāṃ ca nadīṃ kārpanthāyanaṃ cāpi parvatam ।। 16।।
dīnayūpāṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca ailaparvatam ।
īpīnāsanaśailaṃ ca śāradīdvīpamityapi ।। 17।।
madhyavādhiṃ vilokyaiva pitṛnijaṃ ca parvatam ।
tegirāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya deśān samudramadhyagān ।। 18।।
lukvārāṃ ca nadīṃ senānadīṃ vīkṣya ca khāḍikām ।
jarāmaunapradeśaṃ ca bālayamapradeśakam ।। 1 9।।
īṅgadvīpaṃ tathā cāyadvīpaṃ vilokya khāḍikām ।
koṭadvīpaṃ svedadvīpaṃ phenadvīpaṃ tataḥ param ।। 2.49.20।।
piṣṭavargān vilokyā'tha girīnapṛthivīṃ tathā ।
ālīśāmṛtapṛthivīṃ divonadvīpakādikān ।।2 1 ।।
vilokya khāḍikādvīpān vikturīyabhuvaṃ yayuḥ ।
khāḍīmuttīrya ca tato viviśuścottarān kurūn ।।22।।
teṣu mahābṛhatsaro mahatsulvabhidhaṃ saraḥ ।
ayābāṣkaṃ saro dṛṣṭvā vinipāgacchakaṃ saraḥ ।।23।।।
haṭṭāsanaṃ samudraṃ ca dviphenadvīpamityapi ।
lambodarādipṛthivīṃ sūparyuparikaṃ saraḥ ।।24।।
santaluyīpradeśa ca atalāntapradeśakam ।
mākṣikā'khātamullaṃghya kyubādvīpaṃ vilokya ca ।।25।।
vargidvīpān vilokyā'tha grīyānāmapyalokayan ।
āmārjunāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya śāntārāmapradeśakam ।।26।।
brāhmīlāṃ pṛthivīṃ vīkṣya samaikṣanta parainasām ।
ārjayantīpradeśāँśca kokadvīpau vyalokayan ।।27।।
grāhāmaṃ cārakoṭaṃ ca vīkṣya cāntārkivartulam ।
jalaprastaradeśāँśca vīkṣya bhūguhyabindukam ।।28।।
parāvṛtya tirodevaṃ paṭṭogānāṃ vyalokayan ।
cīllikāṃ perukāṃ pṛthvīṃ pannāmnīṃ nirjharāṃ tathā ।।29।।
mākṣikaṃ bhūtalaṃ vīkṣya nimnaphornāṃ vilokya ca ।
kvīṭanādriṃ rokiśailam ilāsanaṃ ca parvatam ।। 2.49.30 ।।
raṅgilaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya alāṃśukāṃ ca bhūmikām ।
dviriṅgaṃ cābdhimuttīryā'lokayan kāmacāṭakam ।।3 1 ।।
kālimāṃ saritaṃ yāmāṃ bīnāṃ tandrāpradeśakān ।
yāneśīṃ ca nadīm obīṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param ।।32।।
uralaṃ parvataṃ vīkṣya nāvadvīpaṃ vilokya ca ।
phiyojānāsanadvīpān sphītavargān vilokya ca ।।33।।
skandanābhamahāśailaṃ śvetavārdhiṃ vilokya ca ।
devīnāṃ saritaṃ valgāṃ nadīṃ valgākhyaparvatān ।।34।।
uralaṃ ca saro dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇasarastathā ।
śvetaraktapradeśāṃśca dṛṣṭvā sāvariyāraṇam ।।35।।
dṛṣṭvā kimpuruṣaṃ deśaṃ dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ।
vīkṣya prabhālunādriṃ ca stenāvāsaṃ ca bhūbhṛtam।।36।।
akṣoḍhāvārdhimālokya jalapānādibhūmikāḥ ।
piśaṅgavārdhimālokya akṣigaṃ parvataṃ tathā ।।37।।
gopīraṇaṃ vilokyā'tha āpatāyikaparvatam ।
triyānāsanaśailaṃ ca kunalīnaṃ ca parvatam ।। 38।।
kārukoraṃ parvataṃ ca cipiṃgadeśamujjvalam ।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgasaritaṃ vīkṣya śikṣāṃgikāṃ nadīm ।।3 9।।
phullipānadvīpān dṛṣṭvā dvīpāँśca vāraṇīyakān ।
vīkṣya dvīpaṃ navagītiṃ vīkṣya dvīpān samudrajān ।।2.49.40।।
uṣṇālayā'bhidhāṃ pṛthvīṃ vyalokayan vihāyasā ।
cāṭadeśaṃ divādikparvatān vīkṣya tataśca tāḥ ।।41।।
okadvīpaṃ navajīvadvīpaṃ vīkṣya samudragau ।
vīkṣya dvīpaṃ trāsamānam uṣṭrālaye murānadīm ।।42।।
turunadīm aitanadīṃ mekadāneyaparvatam ।
maśakagrīvaśailaṃ ca mahāraṇaṃ vanaṃ tathā ।।।43।।.
pañcasarāṃsi ca dṛṣṭvā dārāliṅgaṃ ca parvatam ।
bālādriṃ hemaśālā'drim ārnahemapradeśakān ।।44।।
dṛṣṭvā yāvān sumātrāँśca malāyāṃ pṛthivīṃ tataḥ ।
annadāmadvīpān śyāmadeśān mikāṃganāṃ nadīm ।।45।।
īrāvatīṃ nadīṃ cārākarṇādriṃ brahmadeśakān ।
sundarākhyavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā hutalīnāṃ mahānadīm ।।46।।
gaṃgāṃ ca brahmaputrāṃ ca khāsīnāparvatāṃstathā ।
patatkāryamahāśailaṃ himālayapradeśakān ।।47।।
dṛṣṭvā mānasaraścāpi śrīdeśaṃ ca trivartanam ।
sindhum indukuśaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā kṛpāluparvatam ।।48।।
thararaṇaṃ ca kacchaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sābharakaṃ saraḥ ।
āravallībhūbhṛtaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mahīṃ ca narmadām ।।49।।
saptapuṭākhyaśailaṃ ca tapatīṃ ca mahānadīm ।
mahābaleśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā ca malayaṃ girim ।।2.49.50।।
sahyādriṃ saṃvilokyaiva dakṣiṇāँśca pradeśakān ।
samudrasthaṃ siṃhalākhyaṃ dvīpaṃ vīkṣya parāvṛtāḥ ।।51 ।।
kāverīṃ saritaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ godāvarīṃ mahānadīm ।
jagannāthapuraṃ kṣetraṃ kapilāśramamityapi ।।52।।
vaṃgaṃ cāṃgaṃ vihāraṃ ca bhūtānaṃ nipalaṃ tathā ।
gaṇḍakīṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gaṅgādvāraṃ vilokya tāḥ ।।53 ।।
rādhike! badarīṃ gatvā nyūṣustatra niśāṃ sukham ।
nārāyaṇaparāsevāṃ kṛtvā sampūjya taṃ prabhum ।।54।।
gaurīśṛṃgaṃ śivaśṛṃgaṃ vilokya svardhunīṃ tathā ।
vyomagaṅgānumārgeṇa svarlokāt satyalokakam ।।55।।
yayuḥ śrībrahmaṇaḥ pārśve mahānandapariplutāḥ ।
vavanduḥ pitaraṃ ceḍā suṣumṇā piṃgalā tathā ।।56।।
mahāharṣaplutāstīrthavidhiṃ prāhuryathākṛtam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇāmṛtam ।।57।।
puṣpahārān daduścāpi mantraṃ jaguḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
nāradasyopakāraṃ ca samūcuśca parasparam ।।58।।
āgatāḥ kanyakāścāpi tisraḥ śrutvā'nyakanyakāḥ ।
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi vṛttāntaṃ vedituṃ tathā ।।59।।
svāgatārthaṃ cāyayuśca brahmaṇaḥ sannidhau tadā ।
yaśasvinī hastijihvā pūṣā viśvodarā kuhūḥ ।।2.49.60।।
alambuṣā ca gāndhārī śaṃkhinī ca payasvinī ।
sarasvatī vāruṇī ca tejasvinī ca raktinī ।।6 1।।
purītat vīryavāhā ca prāṇavāhā tathā''rdrikā ।
ityādyāśca dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hyupasthitāḥ ।।6 2।।
kanyakāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣanyūnā divyāḥ kumārikāḥ ।
svāgataṃ snehataścakrustisṛṇāṃ vai muhurmuhuḥ ।।63 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ papuḥ ।
prasādamālāpuṣpāṇi jagṛhuścādarānvitāḥ ।।64।।
śuśruvuḥ śrīharervārtāṃ rūpasaundaryamāśritām ।
camatkāramayīṃ sarvāṃ tathā vai pattanasya ca ।।65।।
lomaśasyāśramasyāpi bālakṛṣṇālayasya ca ।
koṭyarbudānāṃ kanyānāṃ sevābhāvaṃ ca śuśruvuḥ ।।66।।
yaśasvinyādikā nāḍīsaraso brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।
dadṛśustisṛsvasṝṇāṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamuttamam ।।67।।
divyatāṃ kṛṣṇakāntena dattāṃ tathā ca laukikīm ।
cintayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamuttamam ।।68।।
amanyanta nijā'bhāgyaṃ darśanaṃ na vyajāyata ।
darśanārthaṃ gatā naiva kuto vai darśanaṃ bhavet ।।69।।
pitrājñayā hyavaśyaṃ vai gantavyaṃ draṣṭumacyutam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaram ।।2.49.70 ।।
ityevaṃ cintayāmāsuḥ pitaraṃ prāhurutsukāḥ ।
pitaścāsmān darśanaṃ tvaṃ kārayā''bhiryathā kṛtam ।।71।।
variṣyāmastameveśeśvareśvaraṃ pumuttamam ।
ityuktaṃ brahmaṇe tābhirbrahmā tutoṣa mānase ।।72।।
ko'nyo lābhaḥ paraścāsmād yajjāmātā harirbhavet ।
dhanyāstāḥ kanyakā loke kaumāryaṃ saphalaṃ tathā ।।73।।
pitā dhanyo jananī ca dhanyā dhanyaṃ kuṭumbakam ।
dhanyo bhṛguḥ samudraśca kedāraścānaraṇyakaḥ ।।74।।
sūryo nārāyaṇo nānyo yatputryaḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।
dhanyā loke bhaviṣyanti te janā yatsutāḥ śubhāḥ ।।75।।
kṛṣṇapatnyo bhaviṣyanti rādhālakṣmīprabhādivat ।
bhaktyā jñānena tapasā vairāgyeṇa makhādibhiḥ ।।76।।
yaḥ prāptavyaśca kṛcchrairvā yogairdānādibhistathā ।
sevayā vā satāṃ cet sa snehena yadi labhyate ।।77।।
mohena yauvanenāpi vāsanayecchayā'tha vā ।
rūpeṇendriyavegena mileccetpuruṣottamaḥ ।।78।।
sa moho yauvanaṃ cecchā vāsanā rūpamindriyam ।
sarvaṃ dharmātmakaṃ bodhyaṃ kāmaḥ krodho'pi tanmayaḥ ।।79।।
kṛṣṇe kāmastathā lobho moho mokṣakaraḥ sadā ।
mokṣastu śāśvatānandaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।।2.49.80।।
garhyaṃ stutyaṃ ca vā kiñcit kṛtaṃ cet kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ।
sarvaṃ vandyaṃ hi tad bodhyaṃ pāvanaṃ tārakaṃ hi tat ।।81 ।।
aho putryaḥ sadā dhanyo bhāgyavān vai bhavāmyaham ।
yat kṛṣṇāya pradāsyāmi dānaṃ pātrāya śārṅgiṇe ।।।82।।
kṛṣṇecchā kīdṛśī cāste jñātvā dāsye śubhaṃ bhavet ।
ityuktvā ca svayaṃ brahmā sasmāra nāradaṃ munim ।।83 ।।
upatasthau kṣaṇāttatra praṇamya cāsane sthitaḥ ।
brahmā prāha bhaginyaste tisro yatra narāyaṇam ।।84।।
suṣumṇādyāḥ pūjayitvā punaratra samāgatāḥ ।
tatraitāścaparāḥ kanyā draṣṭuṃ gantuṃ samutsukāḥ ।।85।।
vidyante'tastvayā tatra netavyā vai vimānakaiḥ ।
samāyāte'vasare'haṃ dāsye kṛṣṇāya kanyakāḥ ।।86।।
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi draṣṭumicchanti keśavam ।
yaśasvinyādikāḥ sarvā nāḍikāsarasaḥ śubhāḥ ।।87।।
daśabhaumaṃ sahasraikaśikharaṃ kāmacāri ca ।
gṛhāṇaitanmahāyānaṃ yojanāyatavartulam ।।88।।
kāmavallīḥ kāmavṛkṣān cintāmaṇīn dhanapradān ।
amṛtamiṣṭabhojyādipradānatra niveśaya ।।89।।
śastraśālāḥ sainyaśālā bhojyaśālāstathā'tra vai ।
mantraśālāścauṣadhādisamūhāḥ santi cātra vai ।।2.49.90।।
rasaśālā vastraśālā rakṣāśālāstathā'tra ca ।
siddhayaḥ śaktayo dāsyaḥ kiṃkaryaḥ santi lakṣaśaḥ ।।91 ।।
astrāṇi cāpyanekāni vedāścatvāra ityamī ।
maraṇādiprayogāśca samūrtāḥ santi cātra vai ।। 92।।
indrajālavināśārthaṃ māyānāśārthamityapi ।
daityadānavanāśārthaṃ santyatra mantramūrtayaḥ ।। 93।।
antato'haṃ svayaṃ brahmā śaṃkaro'pi narāyaṇaḥ ।
mūrtyātmakā yathā sākṣānnivasāmo'tra cetanāḥ ।।94।।
acchedyaṃ cāpyabhedyaṃ cā'vilepyaṃ cā'pyanāśyakam ।
adāhyaṃ śāśvataṃ caitadvimānaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।।95।।
suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalābhiḥ sahitābhiḥ svayam ṛṣe ।
dvāsaptatisahasrābhiḥ kanyābhiḥ saha putraka ।।96।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhūsthaṃ prayāhi vai ।
upadā vividhā nītvā kanyeṣṭān divyavaibhavān ।।97।।
śṛṃgārahārabhūṣādyānupakārakarān śubhān ।
nayasva saha yāne'tra sukhaṃ cārpaya śārṅgiṇe ।।98।।
ityukto nāradastatra sanatkumāramārthayat ।
sādhurūpaṃ brahmarūpaṃ rakṣakaṃ brahmavarcasam ।।99।।
tathā rudraṃ dharmarājaṃ cārthayad rakṣaṇāya vai ।
brahmā sanatkumāraṃ ca rudraṃ dharmaṃ dadau tadā ।। 2.49.1 00।।
divyavastubhṛtaṃ yānaṃ cāruruhuśca kanyakāḥ ।
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā jayaśabdān pracakrire ।। 101 ।।
maṅgalānyabhavaँstatra yātrārambhe punaḥ punaḥ ।
sāvitrī cāhvayāmāsa gamane pṛṣṭhatastadā ।। 1 02।।
yāta putryaḥ! sāvadhānāḥ pātheyāni srajastadā ।
gṛhṇateti dadau tābhyaścaitanmaṃgalamuttamam ।। 103 ।।
devaśivā tadā vāme susvareṇā''vahajjayam ।
devahārītamevāpi parāṅmukhaṃ puro'bhavat ।। 1 04।।
yānasya gamane vīṇā nāradasyā'patat karāt ।
amaṅgalaṃ tu tajjātaṃ dvedhā bhinnā'bhavaddhi sā ।। 1 05।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
ityevaṃ nāradaḥ prāhā'maṃgalasya praśāntaye ।। 1 06।।
vimānaṃ satyalokāt tat lokālokācalaṃ hyanu ।
avātarat paścimāyāṃ diśi bhuvaṃ prati kṣaṇāt ।। 107 ।।
kāñcanyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpya ca ।
pūrvābhimukhamābaddhya digbhāgaṃ vyomamārgataḥ ।। 1 08।।
śanaiḥ śanai samāyāti kanyāḥ paśyanti bhūstarān ।
abdhin deśān vicitrāṃśca modante'nyonyamityapi ।। 1 09।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! yānaṃ cābriktopari cāgatam ।
paśyanti sūryatulyaṃ tad rākṣasāḥ krūramānasāḥ ।। 2.49.1 10।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suṣumṇādikā vimānena pṛthvīkhaṇḍān vilokya satyalokaṃ yayuḥ, punardvāsaptatisahasrakanyakā vimānena vyomnā śrīharyarthaṃ prasthitāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 49 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 049 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 50
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 051 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! divyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestathā ।
vīṇābhaṃgasya ca phalaṃ yānasthāsvabhavattadā ।। 1 ।।
abriktadeśavāsā ye mlecchā rākṣasayonayaḥ ।
āraṇyakāśca grāmasthā vanaparvatavāsinaḥ ।। 2 ।।
sahasrayojanasthāste vyalokayan tadāmbare ।
śatasūryasamaṃ tattu vimānaṃ bhāsvarāmbaram ।। 3 ।।
sūryatejo'titejobhirdaśaguṇān prabhāvataḥ ।
kiraṇān vyasṛjad vyomni anuṣṇāśītasaṃsahān ।। 4 ।।
sudṛśyān suspṛśaścāpi maṣṭāmodabharāँstathā ।
ānandotpādakān śāntipradān vicitrabhāsurān ।। 5 ।।
brahmaṇā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthaṃ cārpitaṃ tu yat ।
ki nyūnaṃ tatra vai rādhe! vimāne mānavad bhavet ।। 6 ।।
ghṛtadugdhadadhikulyā amṛtavārisaddhradāḥ ।
gandhasāradravasāracūrṇasārādigūṭikāḥ ।। 7 ।।
rasasārā''modasāracarvaṇottamavīṭikāḥ ।
vidyante yatra satataṃ kalpastambeṣu śāśvatāḥ ।। 8 ।।
ratnadvīpā darśanārhā naikaraṅgādibhāsurāḥ ।
svarṇacampakavarṇābhakanyakāhṛdayaṃgamāḥ ।। 9 ।।
hāratoraṇakuñjādiharidvarṇanikuñjakāḥ ।
ramyastheyodyānamadhyāsanaśādvalarājitāḥ ।। 2.50.1 0।।
sthalyo yatra prabhāsante candrabhūmisamāḥ śubhāḥ ।
vimānarūpaṃ kanyānāṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ ca cāndrikam ।। 1 1।।
prabhārūpaṃ ca sarvaṃ vai rūpapradīpajaṃ tathā ।
maṇiratnādirūpaṃ ca bhinnaṃ cāpi paramparam ।। 12।।
anyonyotkṛṣṭatāṃ prāptaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vyabhāsata ।
keṣāṃ manāṃsi lokānāṃ sasparddhacaṃcalāni vai ।। 13।
nākṛṣṭāni bhaveyurvai divyaitādṛśaraśmibhiḥ ।
divyābhiḥ kanyakābhiśca divyasmṛddhibhireva ca ।। 14।।
tābhiruttejitā mlecchā daityā cābriktavāsinaḥ ।
māyāmantrakarā vyomni rurudhustadvimānakam ।। 15।।
āśāvahālābhavahā iṣṭaṃmanyāśca veginaḥ ।
avicārya patantyugrā prāṇāntaduḥkhade'pi ca ।। 16।।
dṛṣṭvā'nalaṃ pataṃgāśca gṛhṇīma iti vāñcchayā ।
patanti rūpabhogārthaṃ prajvalante'titejasā ।। 17।।
apātrāṇyapi kurvanti prayāsaṃ bahule phale ।
aśaktigamye nikṣipyātmānaṃ mṛtiṃ prayānti ca ।। 18।।
asurāste kālasīdā mlecchā matvā balaṃ nijam ।
adhikaṃ tvaritaṃ ruṣṭāḥ sannahya raṇamāgaman ।। 1 9।।
raktavārdhiḥ raudrabāṣpo vijñaturīyakastathā ।
tuṃgānīko nyāsasāro liṅgaraso'tidāruṇaḥ ।।2.50.20।।
dhvākṣabījo mūśalāmbaḥ karmāṃgaḥ karmahāstathā ।
caṇḍasāro naṣṭajaraḥ sahāraścātaleṣṭakaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
tuṅgamukhastrirāśaśca līlābījo bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
phalgubījo gambikāyaḥ senāgolaḥ sphuṭārdanaḥ ।।22।।
jīvalaśca kedaṇḍaśca kumeruḥ sthānalistathā ।
tumbāsuro'tha līnāpaścāliviṣṭaḥ kimūṣakaḥ ।।23।।
tūnāyaśca tathā''bālo rukvāsanaśca māvuraḥ ।
bāṃgivalirdinolūkaḥ kuvaṃśajaḥ kurenṛkaḥ ।।24।।
dhodhasādā bahavaśca ambikāsaśca śirvamaḥ ।
deṣalaśca kakralaśca ījyāpāto nabījakaḥ ।।25।।
sudānaśca sumāliśca kāṇimaśca trigoṇikaḥ ।
rudraśirāśca triṣvālaḥ pilipaśca namākuvaḥ ।।26।।
dinameraścāṅgulādaḥ phenagaḥ kāmanāruṇiḥ ।
nimnajharo lālavāro hrīyoḍho mārakarkaśaḥ ।।27।।
alijīraśca roṇḍegaḥ śāhudaḥ phakarāṇakaḥ ।
pārṣṇiḥ kṛkāṭakaḥ piṇḍanalo randhrapramoṣakaḥ ।।28।।
bhujahā jatruśamano lāmako mūrddhabhāmakaḥ ।
prakoṣṭhakaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśo nitambaveṇukastathā ।।29।।
āsavāpaścāmīṣapaḥ kukkuṭāśaḥ kṛkāśakaḥ ।
ityete balavantaśca māyayā vyomacāriṇaḥ ।।2.50.3 0 ।।
vidyudvegena vai sarve sannahyopasthitā raṇe ।
tatra rājā jumāsemlā dūtaṃ vai raktavārdhikam ।।3 1 ।।
preṣayāmāsa ca vimānāgre vaktuṃ nijeṣṭakam ।
rājā prāha vimānāgre gatvā''vedaya raktaka! ।।।3 2।।
vimānaṃ tvastu naścātra kanyā bhavantu naḥ striyaḥ ।
vimānasthā narāḥ svargaṃ yāntu cānyatra vai sukham ।।33।।
anyathā tu prasahyaiva hariṣyāmastu kanyakāḥ ।
haniṣyāmaśca vastasmād yatheṣṭaṃ kurutā'tra yat ।।34।।
dūto natvā vimānāgre gatvā prāha tathaiva tat ।
nāradaḥ prāhaḥ taṃ dūtaṃ vadā'suranṛpaṃ mama ।।35।।
yāścātra santi kanyāstā brahmaṇaḥ putrya eva tāḥ ।
yūyaṃ ca brahmapautrasya kaśyapasya hi vaṃśajāḥ ।।36।।
daityo hiraṇyacakṣuryastasya putrāḥ sukālikaḥ ।
añjanaḥ kālameghaśca jāsuśeṣo malīnasaḥ ।।37।।
hāvuko bhāvukaścāpi dāuko dhāvukastathā ।
kvāśmakaścājamālaśca saireyādyāḥ śatādhikāḥ ।।38।।
hiraṇyākṣe hate daitye viṣṇunā sūkareṇa ha ।
tadbhayād dravamānāste cābriktaṃ raṇaparvataiḥ ।।39।।
vyāptaṃ deśaṃ samāgatyā'kurvan nivāsamatra te ।
tadvaṃśyā vai bhavantaśca bhavantyeva gatavṛṣāḥ ।।2.50.40।।
asaṃskṛtā mlecchavṛttā mama bhrātrādivaṃśajāḥ ।
ahaṃ ca nāradaścāsmi tathā'trāste sanat-ṛṣiḥ ।।41।।
dharmarājastathā cātra virājate hi daṇḍadhṛk ।
rudro'tra rājate lokasaṃhārakṛtparaḥ prabhuḥ ।।42।।
aputreṇa purā rudro hiraṇyākṣeṇa vai vane ।
ārādhito haro devaḥ putrārthāya purā kila ।।43।।
tatpratāpena sāpatyo'bhavad bhavatpitāmahaḥ ।
taṃ rudraṃ mā'tra rundhantu mā rundhantu yamādhipam ।।44।।
kanyakā mātaraḥ sarvā bhavatāṃ tā bhavanti vai ।
ajitvā tu yamaṃ rudraṃ bhavatkāmo hi durlabhaḥ ।।45।।
yastaret sāgaraṃ dorbhyāṃ pātayed bhuvi bhāskaram ।
merumutpāṭayedvāpi sa jayed yamaśaṃkarau ।।46।।
kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā rājan pūrve vai cā'ndhakāsuraḥ ।
pārvatīkāmanāmūḍhaḥ sadaityo nāśamāptavān ।।47।।
mahīṣaśca tathā jambhaḥ kujambho nāśamāgatāḥ ।
śaṃkhacūḍastathā jālaṃdharo'pi nāśamāgatau ।।48।।
bhasmo murastathā cānye vinaṣṭā mohamāritāḥ ।
parastrīkāmanāmūḍhaḥ purā daṇḍo mahīpatiḥ ।।49।।
śukraputryāṃ ratiṃ kṛtvā sarāṣṭro nāśamāptavān ।
śṛṇu dūta! tataḥ śrutvā śrāvaya tvaṃ narādhipam ।।2.50.50।।
daṇḍo rājā mahānāsīt prabhūtabalavāhanaḥ ।
īje sa vividhairyajñairnṛpatiḥ śukrapālitaḥ ।।51 ।।
śukraścā'syā'bhavad yajñe purohitaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
śukraḥ kadācidagamat pātālaṃ daityamantritaḥ ।।52।।
śukrasyāsīttu duhitā arajā nāmato gṛhe ।
ekākinī parṇakuṭyāṃ śuśrūṣantī makhā'nalam ।।53।।
rājā tu darśanaṃ kartuṃ cāyāto parṇaje gṛhe ।
agniṃ praṇamya ca kanyāmekākinīṃ surūpiṇīm ।।।54।।
sandṛṣṭvā kāmasantaptastatkṣaṇādeva pārthivaḥ ।
neme tāṃ tu guroḥ putrīṃ pūrṇayauvanaśālinīm ।।55।।
sāpi tamāgataṃ kanyā pratyutthāya tapodhanā ।
bhrātṛbhāvena satkṛtya mālāṃ prāsādikīṃ dadau ।।56।।
tatastāmāha nṛpatirbāle kāmāgnitāpitam ।
māṃ samāhlādayasvā'tra svapariṣvaṃgavāriṇā ।।57।।
sā taṃ prāha tadā me tu pitā tvāṃ nirdahecca mām ।
yaḥ samartho jīvayituṃ devān mārayituṃ hyapi ।।।58।।
bhavān bhrātā dharmato'sti śiṣyo yataḥ piturmama ।
tvaṃ maivaṃ mānasaṃ rājan ekānte kartumarhasi ।।59।।
so'bravīd bhīru māṃ śukraḥ kālena paridhakṣyati ।
kāmāgnistvadya māmatra dahatyeva praśāmaya ।।2.50.60।।
sā prāha daṇḍaṃ nṛpatiṃ muhūrtaṃ paripālaya ।
guruṃ tameva yācasva sa te dāsyatyasaṃśayam ।।61 ।।
daṇḍo'bravīt arajo! me kālakṣepo na vai kṣamaḥ ।
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe nu vighnānāṃ paṃktiḥ sarvatra vidyate ।।62।।
virajā prāha nātmānaṃ dātuṃ śaktā narādhipa ।
kāmabhoge tu sutarāmasvatantrā hi yoṣitaḥ ।।63।।
kiṃ vadāmi tava rājannevamutpathavartinaḥ ।
rāṣṭraṃ rājyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca svayaṃ cānyacca yat tava ।।64।।
sarvaṃ tvayā yutaṃ nāśaṃ śukraśāpena yāsyati ।
maivaṃ vahnau pata rājannaitad dharmyaṃ hi vidyate ।।65।।
rājā prāha balāttvāṃ vai bhokṣye cennaiva manyase ।
arajā yajñavahniṃ svahaste kṛtvā nṛpopari ।।66।।
cikṣepa gaccha duṣṭātmannito vibhraṣṭamānasa ।
ityuktvā parṇaśālāṃ ca tyaktvā gantuṃ bahirhi sā ।।67।।
yāvaddhāvati tāvattāṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।
kāmopahatacittātmā vyadhvaṃsayata mandadhīḥ ।।68।।
tāṃ kṛtvā cyutacāritrāṃ niścakrāma yayau gṛham ।
sāpi śukraplutā bālā arajā rajasā plutā ।।69।।
āśramādatha nirgatya bahistasthāvadhomukhī ।
cintayantī svapitaraṃ rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ ।।2.50.70 ।।
asnānā cā'bhojanā ca tasthau vṛkṣaṃ samāśritā ।
praharānte pitā tasyāḥ śukraḥ prāgamadāśramam ।।71।।
dadṛśe kanyakāṃ naijāṃ sandhyātulyāṃ rajasvalām ।
papraccha putri! kenā'si dharṣitā vā kathaṃ nvidam ।।72।।
kva sa duṣṭo yayau pāpī vidhvaṃsayati kanyakām ।
rudatī sā vrīḍayā svapitaraṃ prāha cārajāḥ ।।73 ।।
rājñā daṇḍena cāgatya vāryamāṇena cā'sakṛt ।
balādanāthā rudatī nītā'hamīdṛśīṃ daśām ।।74।।
etacchrutvā hyupaspṛśya śuciḥ śukraḥ śaśāpa tam ।
yasmāttenā'vinātena mamā''jñāṃ mama gauravam ।।75।।
tiraskṛtya śubhācārā cyutadharmā'rajāḥ kṛtā ।
tasmāt sarāṣṭraḥ sabalaḥ sabhṛtyo vāhanaiḥ saha ।।76।।
saptarātrāntarād bhasma daṇḍo bhavatu sānugaḥ ।
śukraḥ putrīṃ tataḥ prāha śuddhācārāṃ tapasvinīm ।।77।।
māsānte tvāgate rājasvalye śuddhā bhaviṣyasi ।
tāvat tapaḥ kuru putri yatheṣṭaṃ cocitaṃ tava ।।78।।
na te doṣo'sti vai putri garbhaste na bhaviṣyati ।
piba coṣṇaṃ pañcagavyaṃ mā bhayaṃ kuru putrike ।।।79।।
atha daṇḍo'pi nṛpatiḥ sarāṣṭrabalavāhanaḥ ।
bhasmībhūto'bhavat śāpātsaptarātrāntare'sura ।।2.50.80 ।।
evaṃ bhasmasthalaṃ jātaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamulbaṇam ।
evaṃ parakalatrāṇi dharṣayanti tu ye janāḥ ।।81।।
bhasmībhavanti te sarve sarāṣṭrabalavāhanāḥ ।
dharmaśīlā vinītāśca nyāyamārgā hi nirbhayāḥ ।।82।।
prasahya paradārasthāścehā'mutra na nirbhayāḥ ।
dharmānvito ravirdharmaḥ patnīvrataśca bhūsuraḥ ।।83।।
agastyaśca manuḥ svayaṃprakāśo'nye munīśvarāḥ।
tejasvinaḥ śāpamokṣavarakṣamāḥ surā'rcitāḥ ।।84।।
adharmasthāścandradevendrāndhakā duḥkhino'bhavan ।
tasmāddharmo na santyājyo dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ ।।।85।।।
tāraṇaṃ paramo dharmaḥ patanaṃ tvanayād bhavet ।
tasmāt tyājyaṃ balānnityaṃ paradāropasevanam ।।86।।
nayanti paradārāstu mahāpattīrhi dāruṇāḥ।
parārthaparadārasthā narakārhā sadā matāḥ ।।87।।।
tasmādvai dūratastyājyāḥ paradārā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।
paradārahataprajñā na bhavanti vibhūtaye ।।88।।
śṛṇu dūta kathāṃ cānyāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।
ityuktvā nāradaḥ prāha kathāṃ divyāṃ purātanīm ।।89।।
viśvakarmasutā sādhvī nāmnā citrāṃgadā'bhavat ।
rūpayauvanasampannā kamalā padminī yathā ।।2.50.90 ।।
sā snātuṃ naimiṣe kṣetre sakhīyuktā jagāma ha ।
snāntī dadarśa surathaḥ sudevatanayo nṛpaḥ ।।9 1।।
sā'pi tvabhūt sakāmā'ti svapradānamiyeṣa ca ।
sakhyastāmabruvan bāle naitad yogyaṃ hi jāyate ।।।92।।
asvātantryaṃ tavā'styatra pradāne svātmanaḥ pare ।
pitā kuryāt sutādānaṃ sutā pitṛvaśe yataḥ ।।93।।
na te yuktamihātmānaṃ dātuṃ narapateḥ svayam ।
etasminnantare rājā surathaḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ ।।94।।
uvācenāṃ madirākṣi! mugdhe mohayasīva mām ।
tanmāṃ kucatale talpe'bhiśāyayitumarhasi ।।95।।
tataḥ sā kāmasantaptā prārthitā bhūbhṛtā muhuḥ ।
vāryamāṇā sakhībhistu prādādātmānamātmanā ।।96।।
ātmā pradattaḥ svātantryāt tatastā tādṛśīṃ sutām ।
pitaraṃ cāvamanyaiva kāmagāmaśapat pitā ।।97।।
yato dharmaṃ parityajya śrībhāvāt mūrkhabhūbhṛte ।
ātmā pradattastasmātte vivāho na bhaviṣyati ।।98।।
vivāharahitā naiva sukhaṃ lapsyasi bhartṛtaḥ ।
na ca putraphalaṃ naiva patinā yogameṣyasi ।।99।।
utsṛṣṭamātre śāpe tu hyapovāha sarasvatī ।
akṛtārthaṃ narapatiṃ yojanāni trayodaśa ।। 2.50.10 0।।
apakṛṣṭe narapatau sā'pyanirvṛttakāmanā ।
mūrchāyāṃ patitā tatra tadā sakhyo jalena tām ।। 10 1।।
siṣicuḥ śaityamāpannā kṣaṇāntare'tiduḥkhitā ।
mṛtakalpā hatotsāhā saṃjñāṃ lebhe śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।। 1 02।।
apaśyantīṃ narapatiṃ dudrāva vegatastadā ।
nipapāta sarasvatyā muhyamānā taraṃgakaiḥ ।। 103 ।।
nirgatā sā mahāraṇye siṃhavyāghrasamākule ।
tāmapaśyad guhyakaśca ninye śrīyamunātaṭe ।। 1 04।।
tatra cikṣepa ca bhuktvā jale śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau ।
sā nirgatya śironamrā madhyāhne saṃsthitā'bhavat ।। 1 05 ।।
dadarśaināṃ tāpasastu ṛtudhvajābhidhānakaḥ ।
tāṃ prāha putri! kasyā'si sutā kathaṃ samāgatā ।।1 06 ।।
tataḥ sā sarvavṛttāntaṃ yāthātathyamuvāca vai ।
śrutvā ṛṣi krudhā tasyāḥ pitaraṃ śilpināṃ varam ।। 1 07।।
aśapad yattvayā tvaṣṭardānayogyā'pi pāpinā ।
yojitā naiva patinā tasmācchākhāmṛgo bhava ।। 1 08।।
iti śāpād viśvakarmā drāgeva vā naro'bhavat ।
nyapatanmeruśikharād bhūpṛṣṭhaṃ śāpakāraṇāt ।। 1 09।।
aṭan pṛthvīṃ samāyātaḥ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ vai ṛtudhvajam ।
prārthayanme mahāghoro dattaḥ śāpo nivartyatām ।। 2.50.11 0।।
citrāṃgadāyāḥ pitaraṃ māṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ vibhāvaya ।
mayā vānararūpeṇa pāpānyapi kṛtāni hi ।। 111 ।।
tāni me saṃkṣayaṃ yāntu kṛpāṃ kuru ṛtudhvaja ।
ṛtudhvajastataḥ prāha śāpasyā'nto bhaviṣyati ।। 1 12।।
samutpādya ghṛtācyāṃ vai tanayaṃ sumahābalam ।
tāvat saumyāṃ ghṛtācīṃ so'paśyat tatkāmito'bhavat ।। 1 13।।
dadau garbhaṃ kāmayānāṃ sāpi godāvarītaṭe ।
prāpte kāle balavantaṃ prāsūta tanayaṃ nalam ।। 1 14।।
vānaraḥ kapitāṃ tyaktvā viśvakarmā'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
citrāṃgadā saptagodāvaraṃ tīrthaṃ gatā'bhavat ।। 1 15।।
hāṭakeśvarapūjāyāṃ sadā magnā'bhavad yataḥ ।
tatrā'yaṃ vānaro viśvakarmarūpo'bhavat tadā ।। 1 16।।
sarvaṃ jñātavatī putrī svātantryaduḥkhamīdṛśam ।
viśvakarmā tatastatra rājānaṃ surathaṃ punaḥ ।। 1 17।।
samāhūya dadau tasmai citrāṃgadāṃ sutāṃ nijām ।
tataḥ sā sukhinī jātā bhuktvā kaṣṭaṃ śataṃ samāḥ ।। 1 18।।
tasmād dūta mahādūta raktavārdhe subuddhiman ।
jumāsemlākhyanṛpatiṃ nivedaya mayoditam ।। 1 19।।
sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ vidhivad yāhi gṛhaṃ sukhaṃ vasa ।
ajitvā tu vimānaṃ vā kanyakā nahi lapsyase ।। 2.50.1 20।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne abriktadeśīyanṛpatinā svasenādhipaiḥ sarvakāmavimānaṃ ruddhaṃ, dūtoktiḥ, nāradasya pratyuktiśca, tatra śukrā'rajādaṇḍānāṃ viśvakarmacitrāṃgadāsurathānāṃ kathā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 50 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 050 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 51
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 052 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike dūto raktavārdhirmahāsuraḥ ।
yayau cābriktadeśasya jumāsemlānṛpaṃ prati ।। 1
kramaśastu yathoktaṃ vai śrāvayāmāsa sarvathā।
nānvamanyata duṣṭātmā bhāvināśapraṇoditaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kruddhau sannahya sarvāṃśca svayaṃ vyomni mahābalaḥ ।
gadāmādāya ca puro vimānasyā'grato'bhavat ।। 3 ।।
garjanāṃ pracakārā''dau nādayan rodasī hyubhe ।
vāyustarān kampayaँśca jagād kālabhāṣitam ।। 4 ।।
ko'yaṃ vimānanetā''ste tvagrato bhava matpuraḥ ।
parihāya vimānaṃ ca yāhi dūraṃ jijīviṣuḥ ।। 5 ।।
yadīṣṭaṃ jīvanaṃ te'sti kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ।
yāścā'tra kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ pradīyantāṃ drutaṃ ca naḥ ।। 6 ।।
ko'sti rudro'thavā dharmarājaḥ sanatkumārakaḥ ।
ka ete bhikṣukāścātra prāṇanāśārthamāgatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhūtvā vai tāpasāḥ sarve vimānabhogamāsthitāḥ ।
kanyakāgaṇasaṃlubdhāḥ kapaṭācāravartanāḥ ।। 8 ।।
abhogyabhogamadhyasthāḥ pāpamiṣasya bodhakāḥ ।
gotrabhinnā bhaved bhāryā bhikṣukāṇāṃ gṛhe bhavet। ।। 9 ।।
dugdhabhinnā bhaved bhāryā mlecchānāṃ dharmavartinām ।
kṣetrabhinnā imāḥ patnīrgrahīṣyāmo hi kanyakāḥ ।। 2.51.1 0।।
hiraṇyākṣasya vai bhāryāśatamāsīcca tāsu vai ।
kanyāḥ sahasraśo jātāḥ kumārāśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 11 ।।
hiraṇyākṣasya bījena samutpannāśca tāśca te ।
bhinnadugdhāḥ parasparaṃ vivāhitāstadā'bhavan ।। 12।।
ekamātrudbhavā naiva dampatītāṃ vrajanti vai ।
ekapitrudbhavā bhinnagarbhāḥ santi vivāhitāḥ ।। 1 3।।
asmatkulaprasūtānāṃ rītiśceyaṃ sadā matā ।
brahmaputryo'thavā cānyā amātṛjāḥ priyā hi naḥ ।। 14।।
nāradaḥ prāha jitvaiva lapsyase kuru yaddhitam ।
tacchrutvā dānavapatiḥ krodhadīpekṣaṇo'nugam ।। 15।।
sānnāhikīṃ raṇabherīṃ tāḍayituṃ śaśāsa ha ।
bhṛtyastu tāḍayāmāsa bherīṃ balena bhūyasā ।।16।।
sasvāna bhairavān śabdān sonmattā rāsabhī yathā ।
tathā tannādamākarṇya lakṣasaṃkhyā mahāsurāḥ ।। 17।।
samāyayuḥ raṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ sannaddhā yuddhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।
pūrvoktāḥ sainyapāścāpi gajairuṣṭrairhayaiḥ rathaiḥ ।। 18।।
yānaiḥ svalpavimānaiśca yoddhuṃ nānāyudhaistathā ।
vimānaṃ parito vyūhairvyomni pṛthvyāṃ samantataḥ ।। 19।।
śīghraṃ saṃrodhayāmāsurgarjayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
rudraḥ sasmāra caḥ tadā vahniṃ cāpyatha nandinam ।।2.51.20।।
āgatau tāvubhau śīghraṃ śāsanaṃ dehi cāhatuḥ ।
haro vahniṃ prāha cāgne kṛtvā prākāramujjvalam ।।21।।
vahnijvālāmayaṃ vyomni rakṣa yānaṃ sthiro bhava ।
vahnirvimānamabhito rakṣati sma tathoditaḥ ।।22।।
rudraśca nandinaṃ prāhā''mantrayā'tra gaṇān drutam ।
nandī jalamupaspṛśya sasmāra gaṇanāyakān ।।23।।
sahasraśo gaṇā gaṇādhipāḥ śastrāstraśobhitāḥ ।
āyayuḥ rudrajātīyāḥ sahasrāṇi daśātra ca ।। 24।।
ṣaṇmukhāśca samājagmuḥ ṣaṭṣaṣṭiśatasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
gaṇeśvarā hastimukhāḥ ṣaṭsāhasrāḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 25 ।।
kālānanā gaṇāścānye khaḍgāṃgayodhinastadā ।
digvāsasaḥ kajjalābhā daśalakṣāṇi cāyayuḥ ।।26।।
kālānanebhyaḥ śaṃbhustu yoddhumājñāṃ dadau drutam ।
caturnetrāścaturhastāḥ śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasaḥ ।।27।।
samāyātāḥ khagā''rūḍhāścakraśūladharā dṛḍhāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāśca gaṇāstatra lakṣāṇi tvekaviṃśatiḥ ।। 28।।
caturmukhā brahmagaṇā daśalakṣāptasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
āyayurvyomamārgeṇa te'straśastrādivedinaḥ ।।29।।
atha yuddhaṃ paraṃ ghoraṃ pravavṛte samantataḥ ।
kālānanā mahāghorā nijaghnurmlecchajātikān ।। 2.51.30।।
bhidyamānāśca balibhirgaṇāgryairdaityadānavāḥ ।
pravṛttāste gaṇān hantuṃ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ ।।31।।
tato vyomni smṛtā devāḥ sendraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ ।
sūryacandravaruṇādyāḥ samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ ।।32।।।
atha kālānanāḥ sainyaṃ nighnanti dānavīyakam ।
caturaṃgabalaṃ mlecchajātīyaṃ marditaṃ hyabhūt ।।33।।
mlecchāḥ śmaśrudharā golairmahāgolaiśca tūpakaiḥ ।
dhūṣkṛtībhirvajraghātairbhūśuṇḍībhiśca chūrakaiḥ ।।34।।
asibhiḥ khaḍgacarmādyairbhallaiḥ śaktibhirityapi ।
prāsaiśca tomaraiścāpi jaghnuḥ kālānanān krudhā ।। 35 ।।
kālānanāścāndrabāṇairgolakairvahnijālakaiḥ ।
śaraiśca tūpakābhiśca dhūṣkṛtībhiśca sarvathā ।।36 ।।
kṣepaṇairbahuyantraiśca jaghnuḥ kālānalāँstadā ।
kālānanā vyomamārgaiḥ patitvotpatya vegataḥ ।।37।।
mleccheṣu galapāśān sandaduḥ śmaśruṣu cānalam ।
lakṣabhaṭāstu te naṣṭāḥ senāgryā dudruvustadā ।।38।।
bigulān vādayāmāsurnavasainyāhvanāya ca।
daśalakṣāṇi sainyāni tvasurāṇāṃ punastataḥ ।।39।।
āgatānyabhitastatra vyomayānagamāni vai ।
dārudāhaistadā cūrṇairāpūryā''pūrya golakān ।।2.51.40।।
cikṣipurdaśalakṣeṣu tadā brahmagaṇeṣu vai ।
brahmagaṇāstadā vidyudbāṇairjaghnuśca dānavān ।।41 ।।
dānavā api śailaiśca vṛkṣairvāriśilādibhiḥ ।
vāyuprahārakeścāpi nijaghnurbrāhmadaivatān ।।42।।
raṇadeśe nipetuste dānavā vigatāsavaḥ ।
vidyutprahāraiḥ sarvatra gataprāṇā mṛtiṃ yayuḥ ।।43।।
kukkaṭapicchamūrdhanyāḥ śaṃkhaśṛṃkhalabhūṣaṇāḥ ।
ghorakhātīcarmavastrā nīlāñcalakaṭibhramāḥ ।।44।।
haridvarṇapaṭakāḍhyā daśalakṣāṇi te mṛtāḥ ।
atha dṛṣṭvā mahatsainyavināśaṃ dānaveśvaraḥ ।।45।।
rājā tvakārayad bherīninādān vyomagarjanām ।
vidyunnalīnajākrośān koṭisainyāgamāya vai ।।46।।
sa śabdo vyānaśe catuḥsamudrānto mahāmbare ।
abriktadeśīyasainyaṃ parito vāyuvegataḥ ।।47।।
ekatritaṃ madhyadeśe parito vai vyajāyata ।
vijayasya dīrghanādā vimānayantrato'bhavan ।।48।।
śrutvā mumudire devā mlecchāstrāsaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ ।
sainyāni paritastatra devānāṃ vicaranti hi ।।49।।
viśrāmyantyaṇimādyaiśca sūkṣmā vimānamastake ।
etasmin samaye vyomno yathā śalabhakoṭayaḥ ।।।2.51.50।।
tathā daityāḥ sarvadigbhyo vimānamabhi cāyayuḥ ।
mārayantu nāśayantu khādayantu vimānagān ।।51 ।।
apaharantu gṛhṇantu kanyakāstaddhanānyapi ।
vinaśyantu nāśayantu pradhvaṃsayantu daivatān ।।52।।
chedayantu bhedayantu vighnantu sanmukhān bhaṭāḥ! ।
vimānaṃ kanyakā divyā yasya hastagatā tu yā ।।53 ।।
tatsarvaṃ tu bhavettasya vijeturiti niścayaḥ ।
ityevaṃ nadamānāste koṭisaṃkhyā mahāsurāḥ ।।54।।
vividhairyantramārākhyaiḥ śastraiśca golikākṣipaiḥ ।
nijaghnuḥ paritastatra vimānaṃ vahnirakṣitam ।।55।।।
agnideśaṃ samāgatya golikā vidravanti ca ।
rasarūpāstu tā bhūtvā prajvalanti ghṛtaṃ yathā ।।56।।
daityāstannaiva jānanti jānantyeva tu kṣepaṇam ।
golikānāṃ vṛṣṭirūpaṃ vimānaghātasiddhaye ।।57।।
tūpiyantrairmārayanti śataghnībhistathā'pare ।
ātaṃkayantrairnighnanti tryūrupīḍān kṣipanti ca ।।58।।
evaṃ catuḥpraharāntaṃ cakruste māramātrakam ।
daityā vimānamālakṣya niścūrṇā naṣṭadārukāḥ ।।59।।
vinaṣṭagolikāścāsan vahniḥ sarvaṃ vyanāśayat ।
vimānaṃ susthiraṃ cāpyakhaṇḍitaṃ vyomni vartate ।।2.51.60।।
atha sainyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāmekaviṃśatilakṣakam ।
cakrapāśagadāprāsamudgarādisuśobhitam ।।61।।
rudrājñayā nyapatacca daityasainyasya koṭiṣu ।
sudarśanāni cakrāṇi lakṣāṇi tvekaviṃśatiḥ ।।62।।
avyāhatāni roṣādvai prayuktānyabhavaँstadā ।
dvidhā chinnaṃ hi daityānāṃ sainyaṃ koṭyekameva tat ।।63।।
kāँścid galeṣu cakrāṇi skandhayoḥ kaṭipṛṣṭhayoḥ ।
sakthnoḥ kāṃściddhastayośca jānvoḥ prakoṣṭhayostathā ।।64।।
pādayormadhyayordakṣavāmayorvāmadakṣayoḥ ।
ardhanikṛntayordvedhābhūtayorvidadhurvyasūn ।।65।।
vyomno nipetuḥ pṛthvyāṃ te koṭyaikasainyamityapi ।
śalabhāstu yathā vārdhau tathā yayurhi te layam ।।66।।
atha śokāturo rājā kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ha ।
bahūnāṃ ca hatānāṃ vai smṛtvā nirnāthayoṣitaḥ ।।67।।
yoddhumāyānti ye teṣāṃ madhyādeko'pi naiva ca ।
saprāṇo raṇaparjanyānnaivā''yātīti duḥkhitaḥ ।।68।।
atha kṣaṇāntare saṃjñāmavāpa prāha sainyapān ।
yuddhānnaivā'pasartavyaṃ rājadharmo vilupyate ।।69।।
ajayo vā jayo vā'stu maraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ ca vā ।
raṇāpāsaraṇaṃ tvatra nikṛṣṭaṃ neṣyate mayā ।।2.51.70।।
athā'nyat koṭisaṃkhyākaṃ sainyaṃ samājuhāva saḥ ।
niśāyāmapi yuddhasya virāmo naiva vidyate ।।71 ।।
vyāghracarmadharāḥ śūrā loharakṣaṇarakṣitāḥ ।
vahnividyutkarayantrā vyomayānavihāriṇaḥ ।।72।।
koṭisaṃkhyākayodhāraḥ saptatālocchrayā hi te ।
āyayuḥ paritastatra vimānaṃ yatra vidyate ।।73।।
dudruvuste vimānaṃ vai nāśayituṃ ca sannidhau ।
vahninā rakṣakenaite jvalamānāḥ parāyayuḥ ।।74।।
asāmarthyaṃ tadā taistu jñātaṃ naijaṃ mahattaram ।
pakṣiṇo'pyambare yānti vayaṃ cā'pyatra tādṛśāḥ ।।75।।
yato vahnikṛtaṃ dāhaṃ soḍhuṃ śaktā na vai manāk ।
kathaṃ jayamavāpsyāma iti sandehamāgatāḥ ।।76।।
tathāpi nṛpaterājñā yoddhavyaṃ sarvathā bhaṭaiḥ ।
ityevaṃ dūrataste'pi vidyudgolairvimānakam ।।77।।
lakṣyīkṛtya nijaghnuśca dravantyagnau tu golakāḥ ।
āścaryaṃ hi dvitīyaṃ tad dṛṣṭvā vimānakopari ।।78।।
ūrdhvaṃ sthitā vavṛṣuśca golakān nāśakārakān ।
te'pi golā dravantyeva jvalantyeva vihāyasi ।।79।।
vahninā rakṣakenaiva vimānaṃ tvakṣataṃ sadā ।
atha tāँśca tadā hantuṃ ṣaṭasahasragaṇeśvarān ।।2.51.80।।
hastiśuṇḍhamayān devān pāśaparśudhanurdharān ।
śaktiprāsā'ṇugolāḍhyān mantrāktakuśavajriṇaḥ ।।8 1।।
preṣayāmāsa rudraśca kṣaṇātte tebhya ūrdhvagāḥ ।
antarīkṣe yayuḥ śīghraṃ jaghnuḥ śastraiśca golakaiḥ ।।82।।
koṭisaṃkhyān mlecchadaityān daityāḥ petustadā'nale ।
hanyamānā na vai śaktāḥ samantācca gaṇeśvaraiḥ ।।83।।
dhāvituṃ prābhavaँstena vahnau petuḥ prarakṣake ।
pātamātreṇa bhasmākhyā vyomnyeva te'bhavaँstataḥ ।।84।।
nāmaśeṣāḥ punardraṣṭuṃ rājānaṃ cāpi nā''gatāḥ ।
ityevaṃ koṭiyoddhāro yayustatra kṣayaṃ punaḥ ।।85।।
asthiśeṣaṃ na ca prāptaṃ mahānalena bhakṣitāḥ ।
aho āśā balavatī garviṇāṃ kṣayakāriṇī ।।86।।
saiva kālasya duhitā jarāyā agrajā tviva ।
jñāte sarvavināśe ca rājā dhairyaṃ mumoca ha ।।87।।।
gantuṃ svabhavanaṃ tasmāt sthānād yāvat samicchati ।
tāvat senāpatiryo'bhūd raktavārdhistathā'paraḥ ।।88।।
raudravāṣpo hyubhāvetau rājānaṃ prāhatuḥ kṣaṇam ।
na gantavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ rājñā yuddhānnivṛtya vai ।।।89।.
yāvadvai vidyate sainyaṃ yāvadbalaṃ ca pārśvayoḥ ।
yāvadbalaṃ ca bhujayoḥ sainyapāḥ santi cā'kṣatāḥ ।।2.51.90।।
yāvat tāvanna gantavyaṃ raṇād gṛhaṃ kathaṃcana ।
atha yuddhaṃ kariṣyāmo jeṣyāmo yānakanyakāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
ityuktvā raṇatūryāṇi nādayāmāsurugragāḥ ।
vidyudvādyāni cogrāṇi vidyudvaṃśāँśca bhūriśaḥ ।।92।।।
vādayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sainyā''vāhanabodhakān ।
śrutvā sainyaṃ daśakoṭisaṃkhyākaṃ parito'bhavat ।।93 ।।
ekatritaṃ kṣaṇāttatra madhyadeśe saro'bhitaḥ ।
karmaghnaparvatādagre yāvaccanḍasarastathā ।।94।
karmāṃgoṃ ca nadīṃ yāvat yāvacchvetanarāyaṇīm ।
trirāśiparvataṃ yāvad daśakoṭibhaṭāśrayam ।।95।
sthalaṃ yuddhamahābhūmistadā vai samajāyata ।
tuṃgānīkasarasaśca yāvannyāsasarastathā ।।96
koṭisainyaṃ bhasmasādvai jātametpurā'mbare ।
tasya prāka ca kālahariraṇādāsāmbaparvatam ।।97।।
vijñaturīyasaritastīre tu daśalakṣakāḥ ।
hatāstatra tataḥ prāk ca drākṣābījādripaścime ।।98।।
vālanadyāstaṭe lakṣaṃ hatā daityā hi rādhike! ।
evamete daśakoṭibhaṭā vidyutkṛtā'strakāḥ ।।99।।
vahnimantravidaścāpi nāśaṃ yātuṃ samāgatāḥ ।
yuyudhuste vahniyantrairvidyudgolaistathā'strakaiḥ ।। 2.51.1 00।।
mantrakṛtaiḥ puttalaiśca vyomni vimānasannidhau ।
vahnidevena te sarve kṛtrimā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ ।। 10 1।।
athaite preṣayāmāsurvimānāni dyumanti ca ।
yatra vidyunmahāgolā yantraputtalikāstathā ।। 1 02।।
yantrāśvā yantravāhāśca yantrarathāśca tāmrajāḥ ।
yantrāṇāṃ hetayaścāpi vidyuttāmrakṛtāstathā ।। 1 03।।
taiḥ kṛtaiḥ sādhanaiścaitā bhaṭānāṃ daśakoṭayaḥ ।
yuyudhurnirbhayā vahnervahneḥ prākāramadhyamāḥ ।। 1 04।।
vahnimullaṃghya ca gatāstadā tatra vimāniṣu ।
hāhākāro hyabhūt tāvacchaṃbhurutthāya vāḍavam ।। 1 05।।
analaṃ prāha gacchaitān bhasmasātkuru sattama ।
tāvatpralayakālīnasadṛśotthastu vāḍavaḥ ।। 1 06।।
śikhāḥ prasārya paritaḥ koṭirūpadharo'bhavat ।
lelihyamānaḥ sarvāstān yoddhṛँśca puttalāँstathā ।। 1 07।।
cakāra bhasmasāt sparśād daśakoṭibhaṭān kṣaṇāt ।
jvālāmukho yathā vyomni parvato vā ravirgrahaḥ ।। 1 08।।
nāśaṃ prāpto yathā jvālāmayo brahmāṇḍasadṛśaḥ ।
viśālaḥ syād vahnimayastathā dṛśyamadṛśyata ।। 1 09।।
daśakoṭibhaṭāstatra dagdhā vāḍavavahninā ।
dudruvuśca bahistasmāt prāṇarakṣaṇakāmyayā ।। 2.51.11 0।।
tadā teṣāṃ nirodhārthaṃ kārtikeyaṃ mahābalam ।
sārdhaṣaṭkṛtasāhasraṃ nāgapāśairnyarodhayat ।। 11 1।।
anirgamāśca te tatra bhasmībhūtāstato'bhavan ।
yeṣāmasthi na vā keśā na śirāṃsi na nāḍikāḥ ।। 1 12।।
gamyaṃ labhyaṃ ca kimapi tatra dāhe tvabhūt kila ।
evaṃ vinaṣṭā yoddhāro rādhike! vīramāninaḥ ।। 1 13।।
prātarjātaṃ tato rādhe! māyārūpadharāḥ punaḥ ।
rājājñayā susajjāśca yoddhuṃ mantrairupāyayuḥ ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne abriktadeśe brahmavimānena yodhināgaramlecchāścaikādaśakoṭayaścaikādaśalakṣāṇi ca naṣṭāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 51 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 051 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 52
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 053 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! tvevaṃ daśakoṭyasurakṣaye ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīdasurāṇāṃ kuleṣu vai ।। 1 ।।
deśeṣvapi durādharṣastrāsastadā vyajāyata ।
rājā no dharmahīno vai nyāyavarjyaṃ pragṛhya ca ।। 2 ।।
nāśaṃ nimantrayatyajño deśarāṣṭrakuṭumbinām ।
dhanaṃ rājyaṃ dvayaṃ tvāste garvasthānaṃ hi dehinām ।। 3 ।।
nyāyena garvaḥ sukhadaścānyāyajastu nāśakaḥ ।
aho māyā hi devasya vaicitryaṃ kīdṛśaṃ yayā ।। 4 ।।
padmāvadhidhane rājye cāsamudrāntavartini ।
satyapyajñasya nṛpateḥ satīṣvapi priyāsu ca ।। 5 ।।
paradāradhanasampadgṛdhnā tasya vivardhate ।
śaktirvā balamaiśvaryaṃ vastutaḥ śatruvanmatam ।। 6 ।।
duḥkhadāḥ śatravo bodhyāḥ śaktyādyāstādṛśā yadi ।
garvaḥ kālasya dūto'sti putro dhanasya vartate ।। 7 ।।
balasya dattakaścāsti śiṣyaḥ parijanasya ca ।
dhanaṃ balaṃ parijano vartante yatra vai sthale ।। 8 ।।
tatra garvāḥ samāyānti kālasya kāryasiddhaye ।
jano jānāti garveṇa jeṣyāmi sakalānapi ।। 9 ।।
kālaḥ paśyati garviṣṭhe sāntatvaṃ satvaraṃ kṣaṇāt ।
anyāyo garvapārśvastha uttejayati mānavān ।। 2.52.1 0।।
parastrīdravyaharaṇe tato nāśe juhoti ca ।
śvā svarathyāgṛhasthairhi dattā'nnabhojanādinā ।। 1 1।।
tṛpto'pi tṛṣṇayā cānyarathyāyāṃ yāti garvataḥ ।
tataścānyaiḥ śvabhirdantaiḥ pāṭhyate'bhita ulbaṇaiḥ ।। 12।।
mahiṣaḥ kṣetrabhūmyādau labdhvā tṛptiṃ tṛṇādibhiḥ ।
tṛṣṇayā cāpi garveṇā''raṇyadanecchukaḥ ।। 13 ।।
vidāryate vane siṃhaistṛṣṇāgarvau hi nāśadau ।
garvāndhastārakairhīnastaraṇaṃ naiva vettyapi ।। 14।।
madāviṣṭaḥ pravāhe ca kṣipatyātmānamekalaḥ ।
nimagno bhramaraistūrṇaṃ mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 15।।
bhojanaṃ vasanaṃ chāyā jalaṃ bhogyaṃ hi dehinām ।
tadādhārā prāṇayātrā sā ced gacchati saukhyataḥ ।। 16 ।।
vṛthā''yāsaḥ kathaṃ vijñaḥ kuryānmṛṣā'vamohitaḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ vittaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ kṣamaṃ gṛhaṃ ca bāndhavāḥ ।। 17।।
kṣaṇaṃ rājyaṃ jīvanaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ dehavirāgitā ।
vijñāyaivaṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ sādhayenna patedadhaḥ ।। 18।।
patanaṃ jāyate garvāt tṛṣṇayā bhogalipsayā ।
aśaktyārabdhabhāvācca tāँśca tṛptyā parityajet ।। 1 9।।
rādhike! bahavo naṣṭā nāśameṣyanti cāpare ।
naśyantyapi vartamānāḥ kṣitirnaibhiḥ samaṃ yayau ।।2.52.20।।
dhanaṃ sampad gṛhaṃ dārāḥ patiḥ putraḥ kuṭumbakam ।
nāsti vāstaviko bandho bandhastu teṣu vāsanā ।।21।।
bhoktuḥ sā vartate nityamaśāntasyā'virāgiṇaḥ ।
rāgo'śāntiśca jāyete vardhete jñānahīnake ।।22।।
yatra jñānasya vai śūnyaṃ rājate tatra sarvadā ।
kāmakrodhādisaṃkhyā prapūryate vasatiṃ gatā ।।23।।
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho madaśca garvakaḥ ।
ta ete bhrātaraḥ sarve gṛheśasyāpi bhakṣakāḥ ।।24।।
anyeṣāṃ bhakṣaṇe tatra kā kathā khalu rādhike ।
māṃsānāṃ piṇḍikāḥ sarvā gṛdhrāstudanti cañcubhiḥ ।।25।।
samāṃsa gṛdhrān balinastudanti ca haranti tāḥ ।
piṇḍikāḥ sarvalokeṣu tulyā devena nirmitāḥ ।।26।।
svaparyāptāśca devena pradattāstoṣalabdhaye ।
asantuṣṭāstatra ye te naśyantyagnau pataṃgavat ।।27।।
śuddhāhāravivekānāmayaṃ sañjāyate śubhaḥ ।
vicāraḥ śāntiphaladastāmasānāṃ na sā kathā ।।28।।
tamo'dhikā hi asurā daityā mlecchāśca dānavāḥ ।
tāmasīṃ vṛttimāśrityodvejayanti jagat sthiram ।।29।।।
udvegāgnau prahutāśca mṛtyumāmantrayanti te ।
rādhike! rājyamityuktaṃ yatra dharmeṇa rājate ।।2.52.30।।
prajā yasya sadā śāntāḥ sukhā annadhanādibhiḥ ।
yuddhetayo na vidyante deśe varṣati sadvasau ।। 31 ।।
parehāḥ pāpamevoktaṃ phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca tanmatam ।
yuddhaṃ kāryaṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ na parāskandanāya tu ।।3 2।।
pārakyaṃ yuddhamūlaṃ ca yuddhaṃ vināśakārakam ।
dharmo'rthaḥ kāma evaite mokṣadāścet pumarthakāḥ ।।3 3।।
yadi śreyaskarāste na nārakāste gṛhe sthitāḥ ।
yeṣāṃ patnyāṃ ca patyau vā santoṣo nāsti te gṛhe ।।34।।
nārakā eva mantavyā asantuṣṭāḥ sadā''tapāḥ ।
yeṣāṃ vāṭyāṃ gṛhe kṣetre dhane sampadi godhane ।।35।।
anne vastre yathālabdhe dehanirvāhakāriṇi ।
nāsti santoṣaṇaṃ te tu tṛṣṇāvaitaraṇīsthitāḥ ।। 36।।
jīvatsvapi na śāntyāsthā mṛtā kā śāntireṣyati ।
rasanāyāṃ ca vā sparśe yeṣāṃ tṛṣṇā vivardhate ।।37।।
teṣāṃ vai narakaṃ dehe kṛtasthānaṃ virājate ।
kāmatṛṣṇā yugalākhye nigaḍe kṣipati drutam ।।38।।
lobhatṛṣṇā prayāsākhye pravāhe kṣipati drutam ।
mohatṛṣṇā cā'rjanākhye pravāse kṣipati drutam ।।39।।
krodhatṛṣṇā vivādākhye kleśe kṣipati prāṇinam ।
madatṛṣṇā'haṃmamatvakleśe kṣipati dehinam ।।2.52.40।।
janakīṭapataṃgānāṃ viṣayāḥ sarvathā samāḥ ।
adhikāyāsamagnā ye te vināśāya yanti vai ।।41 ।।
dūtī rājānamāsādya naijaṃ jayaṃ samicchati ।
dūtā dūtyaḥ samā bodhyāḥ sadehā vā'pyadehinaḥ ।।42।।
naijaṃ jayaṃ samicchanti parābhavaṃ tu bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
mūrkho mugdho na jānāti nijā'ntā''mantraṇāvimān ।।43।।
śreṣṭhī jānāti vai lābhaṃ kusīdātmakamuttamam ।
śaṭho jānāti ca dhanaṃ mūla deyaṃ na vai kvacit ।।44।।
kusīdaṃ cāpi ca mūlānnyūnaṃ deyaṃ na vai samam ।
tato nādānatā khyāpyā''gṛhya cāpi punaḥ punaḥ ।।45।।
evaṃ śaṭhastu jayati śreṣṭhī saṃhriyate sadā ।
śaṭhā vai bhuñjate śraiṣṭhyaṃ śreṣṭhī śaṭhāँśca lambate ।।46।।
lambamānaḥ patatyeva nirlambe patanaṃ kutaḥ ।
dhāvamānaḥ patatyeva niṣaṇṇe patanaṃ kutaḥ ।।47।।
yoddhā naśyati yuddhyaँśca bhogān kṛtvā mṛṣāsamān ।
magnaḥ prāṇān vimuñcet santaran prāṇānna muñcati ।।48।।
yadarthaṃ yuddhyate yadvā yadarthaṃ ca nimajjanam ।
yadarthaṃ patanaṃ tadvai kiyanmameti cintayet ।।49।।
evaṃ vivekaḥ kartavyo rājñā vā prajayā priye ।
svadehendriyarājyasya rājā kroḍo'pi vartate ।।2.52.50।।
kīṭādyāḥ sarva evaite rājānaḥ svakṛtau matāḥ ।
gṛhe tiṣṭhanti manujāstānanādṛtya kīṭakāḥ ।।51।।
kurvanti nilayaṃ bhittau lūtāḥ koṇeṣu jālakān ।
cakravākā nalikādhobhittichidreṣu cā''layān ।।52।।
mūṣakā gṛhanāleṣu bhūmau kīṭā vasanti ca ।
kākāḥ pārāvatāścordhvaṃ gṛhocchraye vasantyapi ।।53।।
kasyedaṃ vai gṛhaṃ jñeyaṃ yatsarvairbhujyate samam ।
manyante tu balāt svān vai te sarve gṛhasvāminaḥ ।।54।।
mugdhāścāpi bhavantyeva gṛhanāśe tu te'khilāḥ ।
yasya yādṛṅmamatvaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ tādṛk tadīyakam ।।55।।
ahaṃmamatāhīnasya paragṛhādhivāsinaḥ ।
mūṣikāgṛhavāsasya nirbandhasya ca bhoginaḥ ।।56।।
gṛhanāśe'pi śokāṃśo nāgasyeva na jāyate ।
evaṃ jānāti ced rājā kathaṃ nāśāya vai svayam।।27।।
miṣamudbhāvya jāyeta rājadharmaṃ mṛṣā vidan ।
rādhike! sarvathā sarvaṃ mṛṣā vai kleśadaṃ matam ।।58।।
mṛṣā tu parihartavyaṃ satyaṃ grāhyaṃ suvedinā ।
vināśārthaṃ na yoddhavyaṃ yoddhavyaṃ śāśvatārthakam ।।59।।
viṣayārthaṃ ca dehārthaṃ yuddhyanti paśavo'pi tu ।
ajñānā jñānināṃ yuddhaṃ tadarthaṃ tu samaṃ bhavet। ।।2.52.60।।
jñānino jñānamāsādya yuddhyanti viṣayāya cet ।
jñānaṃ tat tuṣatulyaṃ vai kaṇahīnaṃ ca niṣphalam ।।61 ।।
rājā yadvā prajā vāpi devo vā mānavo'pi vā ।
viṣaṃ yātīti viṣayaḥ ātmā tatra viṣāyate ।।62।।
visinvantīti viṣayāḥ sveṣu badhnanti ye matim ।
tādṛṅmatyāśritaścātmā viṣayīti nigadyate ।।63।।
citraketoḥ purā koṭistriyastvāsaṃstathāpi saḥ ।
tṛṣṇāṃ bhogena siñcanvai tṛptiṃ nā'vāpa cāntataḥ ।।64।।
koṭyarbudāni me patnyo madviyogaṃ na sehire ।
koṭyarbudasvarūpaiśca bhogastābhyo'rpito'niśam ।।65।।
mayaivaṃ dīyamāne'pi sarvadā''nandaśevadhau ।
na tāstṛptā mayā jñātāḥ kadācit kṣobhayogataḥ ।।66।।
yayātirnahi santṛpto vavre tu yauvanaṃ sutāt ।
nahuṣo'pi na santṛpto paulomyāmakaronmanaḥ ।।67।।
naranārāyaṇau tṛptau sadā''sete tapaḥsthitau ।
dattātreyaśca kapilo lomaśaḥ sanakādikāḥ ।।।68।।।
nityatṛptā na vāñcchantīndriyasāhāyyamalpakam ।
satī tṛptā sadā śaṃbhuṃ vinā nā'nyaṃ samicchati ।।69।।
santaḥ sādhvyaḥ sadā tṛptā harau muhyanti netare ।
yadarthaṃ yatate dehī sa deho yadi naśyati ।।2.52.70।।
yatnaḥ kīdṛk sa vai prokto vṛścikībālasadṛśaḥ ।
yenā'yaṃ śobhate rājā tadrāṣṭraṃ yadi naśyati ।।71।।
kīdṛg rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena kārpāse'gnikaṇādivat ।
divyāstārāḥ patantyeva paśyanti nityamakṣibhiḥ ।।।72।।
sveṣāṃ pātaṃ na paśyanti śākhāsthā mūlaghātinaḥ ।
deyaṃ dūraṃ kṛtaṃ yena leyaṃ yena dhṛtaṃ puraḥ ।।73।।
iṣṭaṃ svalpaṃ bahvaniṣṭaṃ leyaṃ dvedhā sa eṣyati ।
leyaṃ dūraṃ kṛtaṃ yena deyaṃ yenāgrataḥ kṛtam ।।74।।
iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tu vipulaṃ tasyāgre svayameṣyati ।
rādhike! tvekadā viśvāvasuḥ kanyāśatatrayam ।।75।।
svayaṃprakāśaṛṣaye'rpayitu sa samāyayau ।
nanāma parayā prītyā sūryābhaṃ munisattamam ।।76।।
avāpya svāgataṃ viśvāvasuḥ prāha manogatam ।
ṛṣe bhavān mahāyogī vartate'nekarūpadhṛk ।।77।।
ūrdhvaretāstathā cāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugaḥ ।
etatkanyāśatānyatra tava yogyāni santi hi ।।78।।
gṛhāṇa tāsāṃ paramaṃ śreyaḥ syād yadi manyase ।
tejasvināṃ na durdharṣaṃ lālanaṃ pālanādikam ।।79।।
svayaṃprakāśastaṃ prāha satyaṃ te mānasaṃ tu yat ।
kanyāśreyo vidhātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dharma eṣa vai ।।2.52.80।।
yogyāya tu pradātavyā tadicchāśāline sadā ।
anicchave tu taddānaṃ kanyākleśāya jāyate ।।8 1 ।।
ahamanicchuḥ kanyānāṃ dehyanyasmai maharṣaye ।
ahamātmā dvandvahīno dveho dvandvabharo'dhikaḥ ।।82।।
prātaḥ sāyaṃ madhyasūrye madhye ca praharādike ।
mūtraṃ malaṃ tathā lālāṃ liṭrūpaṃ svedamityapi ।।83।।
ṣṭhīvanaṃ chikkanaṃ vāyusaraṇaṃ mehanādikam ।
akasmāt prakaṭītya svavaśaṃ māṃ karoti hi ।।84।।
tasya sevā praśuddhyarthaṃ mayā nirvartyate sadā ।
pariśramasya śāntyarthaṃ prasvāpo dīyate mayā ।।85।।
yāne ca bhojane pāne home jape tathā''sane ।
pārśvabhāve sthitau vakrībhāve vā gamanādike ।।86।।
pariśramaṃ paraṃ prāpya gururbhavatyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।
tacchāntyarthaṃ na me kālaścādhikaḥ samapadyate ।।87।।
bhavattriśatakanyānāṃ kṛte gāndharvarāṭ kutaḥ ।
samayaṃ prāpya sevādyaiḥ prīṇayeyaṃ sukhārthinīḥ ।।88।।
ekadehasya sevāṃ vai kartuṃ na pārayāmīha ।
śatatrayaikadehānāṃ sevanaṃ pāraye kutaḥ ।।89।।
tasmānmayā na ceṣṭavyā dātavyā na tvayā'nagha ।
apūrṇaṃ brahma tad bodhyaṃ yadanyasmāt sukheṣaṇā ।।2.52.90।।
pūrṇaṃ brahma tu tad bodhyaṃ yadātmānandapūrṇatā ।
parebhyaḥ sukhalaulyena pravartante tadāptaye ।।91।।
madhye eva vinaśyanti sāmudramauktikehukāḥ ।
tato viśvāvasuḥ kanyāśatatrayaṃ tu śārṅgiṇe ।।92।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pradadau tadā ।
nirañjanāya kṛṣṇāya pumuttamāya bhāvataḥ ।।93।।
tāḥ sarvāḥ śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇo dadau lomaśakālaye ।
rakṣituṃ cājñayā divyo lomaśastā rarakṣa ha ।।94।।
tasmājjñānayutā naiva sajjante kleśamūrtiṣu ।
rādhike! dhanadāraśrīrājyādyāḥ kleśamūrtayaḥ ।।95।।
tatrā''saktasya tu rājño jumāsemlābhidhasya vai ।
sarvanāśaḥ samutpannaḥ pratīkṣate kṣaṇāntaram ।।96।।
kadā vimānaṃ gṛhṇāmi spṛśāmi kanyakāḥ kadā ।
kadā vimānamāruhya pṛthvīṃ vaśe karomyapi ।।97।।
ityabhūd bahudhā tṛṣṇā sā na jīryati jīryataḥ ।
bhūtvā yuvatī rājānaṃ pracakarṣa pramantraṇe ।।98।।
rājā cājñāpayāmāsa sainyādhipāँstadā muhuḥ ।
vicārārthaṃ vināśasya vimānasya vaśasya vā ।।99।।
mantraṇābodhakaṃ śīghraṃ bigulaṃ samanādayat ।
nirdhāritāśca vai sainyā'dhipāstūrṇaṃ samāyayuḥ ।। 2.52.1 00।।
yānaṃ nāśayitavyaṃ vā vaśīkartavyameva vā ।
tadupāyān racayantu rakṣakā'nalanāśakān ।। 10 1।।
antimo raṇasaṃgrāmaścā'yaṃ kāryo hitā'hitaḥ ।
vayaṃ smo vā, na vā smo vā, bhetavyaṃ nātra dhīvaraiḥ ।। 1 02।।
ityuktā mantrayāmāsuḥ raktavārdhyādayo'surāḥ ।
dvyaśītisaṃkhyakāḥ śūrā ye yuddhe na hatāśca te ।। 1 03।।
dūrataḥ sainyavāhāśca sainyayodhanadarśakāḥ ।
saināpatyapadabhūṣā vicāraṃ tvācaraँstadā ।। 1 04।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīkṛṣṇarādhikākṛtavivekāvivekādivijñānavarṇananāmā dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 52 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 052 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 53
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 054 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! paścādasurāṇāṃ tu mantraṇām ।
jumāsemlā svayaṃ rājā raktavārdhyādiyūthapān ।। 1 ।।
dvyaśītisaṃkhyakān prāha śokamānasabhṛdgirā ।
sainyāni sarvathā yāni yoddhuṃ gatāni tāni tu ।। 2 ।।
sarvaśo'pi vinaṣṭāni naiko'pi tu nivartate ।
na śavaṃ dṛśyate vā'pi bhasmamātraṃ tu dṛśyate ।। 3 ।।
vimānasyā'bhito vahnistādṛśo'gamya ulbaṇaḥ ।
vimānaṃ rakṣyate tena kriyate'nyattu bhasmasāt ।। 4 ।।
vimānaṃ prati cāsmākaṃ yantragolakaputtalāḥ ।
gantumevā'kṣamā vahnau bhasmībhavanti vai bhaṭāḥ ।। 5 ।।
tatkathaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ yad vimānaṃ vināśyate ।
vaimānikā vimānasthā nāśyante yena te yathā ।। 6 ।।
tadvicāryaiva vaktavyaṃ raktavārdhe tvayā mama ।
raudrabāṣpaprabhatayo yathānyāyaṃ vadantviha ।। 7 ।।
tadā te tu nṛpaṃ natvā bahutarkabhṛto giraḥ ।
yuddhārthaṃ prājagaduśca phalaṃ tu nāśa īkṣyate ।। 8 ।।
kecidāhurmahāmāyāmāsurīṃ viracayya tu ।
mahāvṛṣṭyā mahāvahniṃ śāntayantu tataḥ param ।। 9 ।।
śailavṛṣṭyā vimānaṃ tannāśayantu kṣaṇāntare ।
anye prāhurmahāvṛṣṭiṃ mahāśailānapi dhruvam ।। 2.53.10 ।।
yadi stabdhān kariṣyanti mahāmāyākṛtaiśca taiḥ ।
tadā ki syāt tataścānya upāyaḥ parimṛgyatām ।। 11 ।।
tadā kaściccanḍasāraḥ prāha vai racanāṃ navām ।
vayaṃ vāyusvarūpāśca bhūtvā yāmastu tatsthale ।। 1 2।।
yena yathā vimānaṃ taditastād yāsyati kṣaṇāt ।
asmāsu vāyurūpeṣu madhye yāvatprayāsyati ।। 13 ।।
tāvad vāyusvarūpaiśca jhaṃjhāvātairmahograkaiḥ ।
vimānaṃ kṣepaṇīyaṃ vai hyakasmānnāśameṣyati ।। 14।।
sarvāvayavakanyādīrviyujya ca vibhajya ca ।
bhaṅktvā'vayavaśaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmo layānvitam ।। 15।।
athā'smai cottaraṃ prāha vijñaturīyakastadā ।
yīgyametattathāpyeṣo vimānastho maheśvaraḥ ।। 1 6।।
śvāse cāsmān samastāँśced grasiṣyati hyagastyavat ।
tadā daśā kā cāsmākaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cintyatām ।। 17।।
tadā'taleṣṭakaścāpi prāha yatra pragacchati ।
yānaṃ taddeśarūpaṃ ca dharantu rāmaṇīyakam ।। 18।।
madhyesamudraṃ ramyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā matvā nijaṃ sthalam ।
viśvāsādavatāraṃ ca kariṣyati sukhaṃ tadā ।। 19।।
tatrā'smābhiśca tadrūpairbhāvyaṃ teṣāmabhīṣṭakaiḥ ।
rātrau suptavyakālordhvaṃ layaḥ kāryo bhaviṣyati ।।2.53.20।।
taduttaraṃ nyāyasāraḥ senāpatiruvāca ha ।
sarvasminnirmite cāpi devā nidrāvihīnakāḥ ।।21 ।।
yadi nidrāṃ na yāsyanti tadopāyaśca ko hi naḥ ।
atha rudraśirādaityo yuktiyuktaṃ jagāda ha ।।22।।
sarvathā śaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ śaraṇyāḥ santi devatāḥ ।
viśvāsinaśca jāyante tāpase śaraṇāgate ।।23।।
varadānasya dātāro bhavantyapyavicārataḥ ।
tasmād grāhyaṃ śaraṇaṃ ca bhāvyaṃ teṣāṃ praśiṣyakaiḥ ।।24।।
tanmantrāstatpradattāśca dīkṣā grāhyā kuṭumbibhiḥ ।
āmantraṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ gṛhapāvanahetave ।।25।।
gṛhe gṛhe ca gamanaṃ pūjanaṃ kāryamityapi ।
vimānaṃ bhūtale nyasya sevā'smābhiḥ śubhā parā ।।।26।।
kartavyā dāsabhaktyā ca yathā viśvāsamāpnuyuḥ ।
antaḥpraviśya kālena viṣavad balamācaret ।।27।।
tadā tu samakālena kanyābhiśca kumārakaiḥ ।
vṛddhairbālaiśca yuvabhiḥ samakālaṃ hi yodhanam ।।28।।
kartavyaṃ cāpi yadvā'tra ye ye mukhyabalāśca te ।
vimāneṣudharā bhūtvā nāśaṃ kurvantu vai tataḥ ।।29।।
yadvā ye mantrakartāro devānāmagragā matāḥ ।
ta eva pūrvaṃ hantavyāstataḥ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 2.53.30 ।।
vijayākhyena kālena viśvāsahetibhistviha ।
kartavyaṃ vai balaṃ tatra pārakṛnno bhaviṣyati ।। 3 1।।
ityuktiṃ nidadhuḥ sarve svāntareṣu jayapradam ।
tathāstviti vicāryaiva rājā senādharāstathā ।।32।।
anye ca sammatāḥ sarve śaraṇāgatibodhakam ।
dhvajamārohayāmāsurgagane hetiśūnyatām ।।33।।
bodhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nemuḥ pṛthvyāṃ śaṭhāśayāḥ ।
nāradastu tadā prāha śaṃbhuṃ kimidamuttamam ।।34।।
vijayaṃ te dattavantaḥ sampragṛhya parājayam ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha niṣekād ye'surāste na surāḥ kvacit। ।। 35।।
kāryasiddhyarthamevaite samayārthaṃ namanti vai ।
kintu śaraṇamāptānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharma uttamaḥ ।।36।।
asmābhiḥ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vaiparītye tu daṇḍanam ।
sattvānāṃ sāttviko dharmo rākṣasānāṃ tu tāmasaḥ ।।37।।
agatau tāmasā yānti vaśaṃ, gatau tu śatravaḥ ।
undururhaṃsapakṣastha iva kṛntati pakṣakam ।। 38।।
svabhāvād rākṣasaḥ śiṣyo vātāpiriva bhakṣati ।
kāle prāpte bhavecchīghramāśīrviṣa ivolbaṇaḥ ।। 39।।
tasmād bhāvyaṃ tu guruṇā jānatā cetanena ca ।
kāṇaṃ prati dvikāṇaḥ syāt trinetro dvyakṣikaṃ prati ।।2.53.40।।
śaṭhaṃ prati dviśaṭhaḥ syāt sādhuṃ prati dvisādhukaḥ ।
tasmācchaṭhe'pi śiṣye na viśvasitavyamatyati ।।41।।
kadācit sa chalaṃ kuryād dugdhapālitasarpavat ।
yadi te śaraṇaṃ yātāstatrāpi vidyate chalam ।।42।।
vidyuddaṇḍābhighātena siṃho'pi śaraṇaṃ vrajet ।
svārthakāryaprasiddhyarthaṃ mleccho'pi śiṣyatāṃ vrajet ।।43 ।।
ditergarbhavināśārthamindraḥ śiṣyo'bhavatpurā ।
rājyacārāḥ kāryasiddhyai bhṛtyāḥ śiṣyā bhavanti ca ।।44।।
bako matsyārthamevā''ste mārjāro mūṣakārthakaḥ ।
vyāghro'śvārthaṃ maunamāste prāpte chidre tu ghātakāḥ ।।45।।
cauraḥ svārthaprasiddhyarthaṃ sahāste sevako yathā ।
kulaṭā svārthasiddhyarthaṃ śrayate gṛhiṇī yathā ।।46।।
mūṣako daṃśanārthaṃ vai phutkṛtyā'ṅgaṃ spṛśatyapi ।
kāko māṃsecchayā cañcvā śanairvṛṣaṃ viṭaṃkate ।।47।।
vyādho mṛgārthamugre'pi deśe tiṣṭhati dīnavat ।
krūro'pi sahate vākyaṃ marmabhiccāpi mūkavat ।।48।।
rājā'pi sahate hāniṃ dyūtajāṃ neṣṭakāmapi ।
śūro'pi sahate gāliṃ nigaḍasthaḥ samānataḥ ।।49।।
śuddhā'pi sahate nārī ṛtujanmādyaśuddhatām ।
iyamaśuddhirasmābhiḥ sahanīyā hi pakṣake ।।2.53.50 ।।
mlecchān śiṣyān vidhāyaiva kāryaṃ śreyo yathā bhavet ।
cetayitavyameṣvatra jāgaritavyameṣu ca ।।51 ।।
vahniseke jāyamāne svapato jvalanaṃ dhruvam ।
tatheme vahnayo mlecchā naiṣu suptavyamityalam ।।52।।
sāvadhānaireva bhāvyaṃ na kuryurnaḥ parābhavam ।
iti śrutvā haravākyaṃ sanatkumāra āha ca ।।53 ।।
yathā vakti harastattu yogyaṃ sarvaṃ hi vidyate ।
na hi tejasvināṃ nāśo hīnatejā vinaśyati ।।54।।
dharmaḥ prāha śaraṇyā hi vayaṃ pāpanivārakāḥ ।
rakṣaṇīyāḥ śaraṇasthāḥ pātratā ca yathā tathā ।।55।।
gajasiṃhastenapālāḥ sāvadhānā vaśeṣvapi ।
dharmarājajanarājau sāvadhānau vaśeṣvapi ।।56।।
hastipakā'gnipākasthau sāvadhānau vaśeṣvapi ।
tathā bhāvyaṃ sāvadhānairvaśyeṣvapi ca pākiṣu ।।।57।।
itikṛtvā'numananaṃ tvaikamatyena nāradaḥ ।
prāha tān kiṃ vaśaṃ yātā brūta vaśaṃgatā iti ।।58।।
te'bruvaँśca vaśaṃ yāmo yathecchasi tathā kuru ।
nāradaḥ prāha tān śastravihīnān vai vimānakam ।।5 9।।
ambare sthāsyati cātra brūta kīdṛṅ kimiṣyate ।
rājā prāha vimānaṃ tu bhūtale spṛṣṭamastu ca ।।2.53.6 0।।
vayaṃ dāsā bhavāmo'tra dīkṣārhā nityasevakāḥ ।
ityukte sati rudreṇa vimānaṃ tvavatāritam ।।6 1 ।।
nemuḥ rājā tathā bhṛtyāḥ sainyasya nāyakādayaḥ ।
nārīṇāṃ ca gaṇāścāpi prajāgaṇāḥ samantataḥ ।।6 2।।
draṣṭuṃ tatra samāyātāste praṇemuśca sarvaśaḥ ।
rudraḥ spṛṣṭvā triśūlena pāvanān kṛtavāँstadā ।।6 3।।
jalena prokṣaṇaṃ sanatkumāraḥ pracakāra ha ।
nāradaśca jalaṃ brāhmapātrasthaṃ tebhya ārpayat ।।64।।
taiḥ pītaṃ pāvanārthaṃ ca kṣamā'pi yācitā muhuḥ ।
yamarājaḥ svayaṃ teṣāṃ śastrāṇi dūtasaṃghakaiḥ ।।65।।
ekatra kārayāmāsa svāyattāni tadā kṣaṇāt ।
atha te prārthayāmāsurasurā dīkṣaṇāya ha ।।66।।
nāradastebhya evā''dau dīkṣāmantraṃ dadau tadā ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।67।।
itimantraṃ dadau paścāt pradadau tulasīsrajaḥ ।
kṛtvā nijāśritān gantumiyeṣā'śvasarovaram ।।68।।
tatastairāsurairnaijaṃ gṛhaṃ kartuṃ tu pāvanam ।
deśaṃ kṣetrāṇi ca kartuṃ pāvanāni samantataḥ ।।69।।
mṛtānāṃ sadgatiṃ kartuṃ yācitā nāradādayaḥ ।
tathāstvityāha devarṣistathā śrīsanakādayaḥ ।।2.53.70।।
vimāne rakṣakānnaijān bhaṭān gaṇeśvarādikān ।
vahniṃ yamān kārtikeyān rakṣayitvā maharṣayaḥ ।।71।।
yayusteṣāṃ gṛhāṇyeva pāvanārthaṃ tu vāhanaiḥ ।
rājā naijaṃ mahāsaudhaṃ nināya prathamaṃ tadā ।।72।।
rājadhānyāṃ mahādānābhidhāyāṃ sa pupūja ha ।
nimbakaṭuṃ cālahomaṃ śāvānnaṃ cāladāmakam ।।73।।
āmedaṃ ca yugāntaṃ ca nīrabījaṃ ca kaṃgukam ।
tuṅgā'nīkaṃ pratārakaṃ supālaṃ vīrakesaram ।।74।।
evamanyāni rājyāni khaṇḍagāni ca yānyapi ।
tattadrājyapradhānaṃ tannagaraṃ ninyurādarāt ।।75।।
senānāṃ patayo ye te ninyurvijagṛhāṇi ca ।
phalāni dugdhapākāni bhojanāni daduśca te ।।76।।
bahuratnāni cānyāni dāsān dāsīrdaduśca te ।
otaprotāśca te jātā miśritāḥ śāṭhyasaṃvṛtāḥ ।।77।।
atha yānena te ninyurdūraṃ sāhasrayojanam ।
sahāraraṇapāraṃ tu murārkanagaraṃ prati ।।78।।
nāradaḥ śaṃkaraścāpi sanatkumāra ityapi ।
yamarājastathā dūtā murārkanagaraṃ yayuḥ ।।79।।
jumāsemlābhidhabhūpastathā viṃśatisainyapāḥ ।
yayurmurārkanagaraṃ paścāttasthustu dānavāḥ ।।2.53.80।।
taiḥ śīghraṃ tu vimānasthaiḥ senādhipaiḥ kṣaṇāntare ।
sainyaiśca nūtanairnārīnarātmakaistu rākṣasaiḥ ।।81।।
upaplavāḥ samārabdhā vimānanāśakārakāḥ ।
kṛtrimā golakāstatra prakṣiptā nāśanāya vai ।।।82।।
agniḥ prajvālitaścāpi kutracittu vimānake ।
pāṣāṇaparvatavṛṣṭirjhaṃjhāvāto'pi bhāvitaḥ ।।83।।
vastūnāmapaharaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra kṣaṇāntare ।
yuddhaṃ vimānake jātaṃ gaṇairdevādibhiḥ saha ।।84।।
atha smṛtāśca rudrādyāstathā kalpalatātmajāḥ ।
koṭiśo'tha gaṇāstatra prāvirbhūtā mahābalāḥ ।।85।।
gaṇāstaddānavaṃ sainyaṃ nighnanti sma sukopitāḥ ।
kārtikāśca tathā rudrā gaṇanāthā vināyakāḥ ।।86।।
kalpavṛkṣasamutpannā daśasāhasrarudrakāḥ ।
nijaghnurdānavā'nīkaṃ dānavā nāśamāvrajan ।।87।।
phalgubījaṃ dānavendraṃ gadayā śrīgaṇeśvaraḥ ।
pothayāmāsa śirasi tāḍayitvā vyasuṃ vyadhāt ।।88।।
gambikāyaṃ kārtikeyaḥ śaktyā prāṇaṃ jahāra ca ।
senāgolaṃ gaṇapatiḥ kuṭhāreṇa vyasuṃ vyadhāt ।।89।।
sphuṭārdanaṃ paridhena rudraścaiko vyasuṃ vyadhāt ।
keḍaṇḍaṃ jīvalaṃ rudraścānyaḥ śūlena tatkṣaṇam ।।2.53.90।।
viprāṇaṃ cākarot tadvat kumeruṃ rudrako'paraḥ ।
tumbāsuraṃ sthānaliṃ ca śaktyā jaghāna vighnarāṭ ।।9 1 ।।
bhinnahṛdau vyasū jāto līnāpo mudgarānmṛtaḥ ।
vīrabhadro gaṇastatra gadayā parito ripūn ।।92।।
cūrṇayāmāsa kaṇaśaścāliviṣṭaṃ kimūṣakam ।
tūnāyaṃ ca tathā''bālaṃ rukvāsanaṃ ca māvuram ।।93 ।।
ekaikayā ca gadayā cakre cūrṇaṃ ca bhadrakaḥ ।
kālabhairavarudraśca daṇḍena vajrapaṭṭinā ।।94।।
bāṃgivaliṃ dinolūkaṃ kuvaṃśajaṃ kurenṛkam ।
dāhayāmāsa daṇḍotthavahninā yānamadhyagān ।।95 ।।
dhodhasādā dudruvuśca dṛṣṭvā rudrān maholbaṇān ।
yamadūtā vilokyaitānanududruvurūrdhvagāḥ ।।96।।
nipatyotpatya tān sarvān jagṛhurmastakeṣu ca ।
śailaprāyā yamadūtā gadābhirjaghnurambarāt ।।97।।
śailaśṛṃgairmudgaraiśca bhāracakraiśca vajrakaiḥ ।
