dhodhasādā mṛtāḥ sarve sahasraśo'bhisārakāḥ ।।98।।
eko'pi nāvaśiṣṭo'bhūnnipetuste sarovare ।
śailādiḥ śaktimādāya ambikāsaṃ ca śirvamam ।।99।।
deṣalaṃ kakralaṃ cāpi ījyāpātaṃ nabījakam ।
jaghāna bahudhā mārairnandinā vahninā saha ।। 2.53.100 ।।
anye rudrāḥ śailatulyāḥ pralayānalaśūlinaḥ ।
vahniśūlairnirjaghnuśca sumāliṃ ca sudānakam ।। 101 ।।
triṣvālaṃ rudraśirasaṃ pilipaṃ ca namākuvam ।
svarirakṣiṣayā rudraśirā rudreṣvalīyata ।। 1 02।।
bhakto'smi ca prapanno'smi nā'parāddhaṃ mayā manāk ।
ityāha sa gaṇāँstatra rarakṣustaṃ gaṇāstataḥ ।। 1 03।।
anyān sarvān vyasūṃścakruvahniśūlairbhayaṃkaraiḥ ।
dinamero'pi rudrāṇāṃ bhakto'bhūnnāparādhavān ।। 1 04।।
taṃ rarakṣustadā rudragaṇe rudrā dayālavaḥ ।
athāṃgulādaprabhṛticaturviṃśatināyakāḥ ।। 1 05।।
vimānaṃ ca raṇaṃ cāpi parityajya samantataḥ ।
kṛtvā prākārarūpāṃ ca bandhikāṃ bahuyuktitaḥ ।। 1 06।।
abhicāraistathā cendrajālikairbahuvistaraiḥ ।
samutpādya mṛṣāsainyasamūhān vyomavartinaḥ ।। 1 07।।
śastrāstramantrasahitān bahusamānarūpakān ।
yodhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ rudraiḥ saha samantataḥ ।। 1 08।।
jalapāṣāṇakairvṛkṣairvahnibhṛtparvataistathā ।
hastibhirvājibhiścāpi rathairyānairvimānakaiḥ ।। 1 09।।
rudrāḥ sarve tadā daśasahasrāṇi vimānataḥ ।
bahirgatvā ca māyābhiḥ pratihantrībhireva te ।। 2.53.11 0।।
nijaghnurdānavīṃ māyāṃ śastrāstramantrarūpakaiḥ ।
vidyudastrāṇi vidyudbhirmeghāstrāṇi tu vāyavaiḥ ।। 111 ।।
anyastrāṇi ca meghādyairīśvarāste nyavārayan ।
atha kalpalatāvṛkṣamaṇyutthā yamapārṣadāḥ ।।1 12।।
hiraṇyakaśiputulyāstato'pi balino hi te ।
aṭṭahāsāँstu mumucurbrahmāṇḍaṃ taiśca pūritam ।। 1 13।।
śrutvā brahmāṇḍabheryutthanādatulyaninādakān ।
jumāsemlākhyanṛpatistathā tasya ca sainyapāḥ ।। 1 14।।
nāradādyāśca ṛṣayo viditvā yuddhamugragam ।
palamātreṇa tu tatra vimānaṃ prati cāyayuḥ ।। 1 15।।
dṛṣṭvā daityamahāsainyaṃ naṣṭaṃ māyānale'pi tu ।
rudraiḥ saha prayudhyanti māyendrajālino'pare ।। 1 16।।
śaṃbhustatrā'karonnaijaṃ brahmāṇḍasadṛśaṃ vapuḥ ।
mastakasya jaṭāpāśairdaityasainyaṃ babandha ha ।। 1 17।।
mṛṣā sainyaṃ jaṭāyāṃ saṃlīnaṃ sarvaṃ vyajāyata ।
anyat sainyaṃ paraṃ trāsaṃ tvāpamāhātmyavedanāt ।। 1 18।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāpaṭyapūrvā daityānāṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ, śaṃkarādīnāṃ tadrājadhānīṃ prati gamanaṃ svāgatam, pṛṣṭhato vimāne yuddhaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 53 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 54
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 055 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatrā'vasare daityayoṣitaḥ ।
lakṣaśo yuddhavettryaśca vyomamārgānumārgagāḥ ।। 1 ।।
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya vai krūrāḥ saśastrāśca samantataḥ ।
saptamyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ tā viviśuryatra kanyakāḥ ।। 2 ।।
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi vartante kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।
cukruśuḥ kanyakā vīkṣya rākṣasīścāṃjanojjvalāḥ ।। 3 ।।
sakhaḍgāḥ sā'sayaḥ kāścit karāgrakṛtachūrikāḥ ।
saśūlāḥ sakṛpāṇāśca satomarāḥ samudgarāḥ ।। 4 ।।
sasītāḥ sopalāścānyāḥ samusalāḥ śilānvitāḥ ।
sphāranetrā raktajihvā dṛśyadaṃṣṭrā bhayapradāḥ ।। 5 ।।
chindhi bhindhīti vādinyaḥ khādacarvayaśabditāḥ ।
dāhaya jvālaya sarvāḥ pramāraya pracūrṇaya ।। 6 ।।
pramardaya jahāhīti vadantyo yuddhadurmadāḥ ।
kīrṇakeśā hetiyuktā dudruvuḥ paritastu tāḥ ।। 7 ।।
yāvadvimānamāruhya mārayituṃ prayānti tāḥ ।
tāvattatra suṣumṇādyāḥ spṛṣṭvā kalpalatādrumān ।। 8 ।।
kṛtyāsainyāni daityānāṃ yoṣitāṃ nāśahetave ।
samudbhavantu paritaścetyasaṃkalpayanmuhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛtyāstatra latābhyaśca sahasrāyutasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
samudbhūtā mahāraudryaḥ kālānalasamākṣikāḥ ।। 2.54.1 0।।
vyomānugāḥ sūkṣmahṛsvāḥ sthūlāḥ śailanibhā api ।
ekaikāṃ parisaṃmṛgya keśākeśi ca hetubhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
daṇḍādaṇḍi ca vividhaṃ yuddhaṃ tāsāmabhūttadā ।
kṛtyābhidaityanārīḥ saṃgṛhyagṛhya pramarditāḥ ।। 12।।
bhagnāśca cūrṇitāścāpi bheditā nāśitā api ।
mūtritāścānane tāsāṃ hṛdayeṣu vidāritāḥ ।। 1 3।।
staneṣu bheditāstāśca marmasvapyarditāḥ śaraiḥ ।
karcaritā bhasmitā vahnijvālābhiśca māritāḥ ।। 14।।
daśalakṣāṇi nārīṇāṃ kṛtyābhirnāśitāni hi ।
sasmaruḥ kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhuṃ priyam ।। 15।।
sadyaḥ samājagāmā'sau garuḍastho mahāprabhuḥ ।
sākṣād babhūva tāsāṃ vai yuddhāraṃbhe samāgataḥ ।। 16 ।।
vimāne tiṣṭhate nātho hṛdayeṣu ca tiṣṭhati ।
yuddhāraṃbhe sthito'dṛśyo vilokayati saṅgaram ।। 17।।
pratyakṣaṃ tvāgataṃ nāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāḥ susaṃbhramāḥ ।
pupūjuścanipetuścā'ślikṣan premabharotsukāḥ ।। 18।।
hariḥ siṃhāsane cāste kanyakāmaṇḍalāntare ।
tathā śrīśaṃkarādīnāṃ maṇḍaleṣvapi bhāsate ।। 19।।
śaṃkarādyairgaṇādyaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
niṣasādā''sane ramye śreṣṭhe yogye prabhāsure ।।2.54.20।।
nāradaḥ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ yuddhajaṃ tathā ।
rājñaḥ paricayaṃ cāpi dadau mānuṣalīlayā ।।21 ।।
rājā ruroda bahudhā prārthayacca kṣamāṃ tadā ।
tathā tatsainyapā ye ca dūraṃ gatāḥ sahā'bhavan ।।22।
abhayaṃ pradadau tebhyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
rājādyāḥ dadṛśuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇodare ।।23 ।।
bhuvanārṇavapātālān sthitān sthāvarajaṅgamān ।
ādityavasurudrāँśca viśvedevagaṇāँstathā ।।24।।
yakṣān kiṃpuruṣāँścāpi gandharvā'psarasāṃ gaṇān ।
munīnmanujasādhyāँśca paśukīṭapipīlikāḥ ।।।5।।
sarīsṛpān vṛkṣagulmaphalamūlauṣadhāni ca ।
jalasthāँśca sthalasthāँścā'nimeṣān nimiṣānapi ।।26।।
avyaktāँścaiva vyaktāṃśca dvipado'tha catuṣpadaḥ ।
daiteyān dānavāṃścaiva rākṣasānuragāँstathā ।।27।।
brahmāṇḍā''varaṇāँścāpīśvarāṃśca parameśvarān।
muktān muktanivāsāँśca lakṣmyādikāśca patnikāḥ ।।28।।
pārṣadān śrīhareścāpi tvanyarūpāṇi vai hareḥ ।
rājā deśaṃ nijaṃ rājyaṃ svaṃ vimānaṃ ca yodhanam ।।29।।
sarvaṃ dadarśa ca tadā bhaktinamro babhūva ha ।
uvācāpi nijān bhāvān smṛtvā karmāṇi tāni ca ।।2.54.30।।
aho nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātparamātmā parātparaḥ ।
tadbhaktāśca mayā naiva jñātāḥ saṃsāralobhinā ।।3 1।।
sadā'karavaṃ pāpāni mahāpāpāni yāni ca ।
teṣāṃ yatra bhavennāśastatrāpi kṛtravānagham ।।32।।।
vajrīlepena pāpena kathaṃ kadā vimocanam ।
naiva syāditi devejya! pāpāduddhara mādhava! ।।33।।
daityānāṃ tu svabhāvo'yaṃ sampadyoṣitpralubdhatā ।
madyamāṃsāśanaṃ cāpi tasmāduddhara mādhava ।।34।।
koṭipuṇyārjitenā'tra mānuṣeṇa tu varṣmaṇā ।
labhyate muktirevā'tra yatprapattipratāpataḥ ।।35।।
tatprapattirmayā labdhā yuddhādeśena mādhava ।
pāpaṃ ca kṛtavān yuddhaṃ phalaṃ puṇyasya me'bhavat ।।36।।
yaduddhārakṛtāṃ yogo bhagavatāṃ ca darśanam ।
adya māṃ mama deśeṣu yuddhe prahatadehinām ।।37।।
uddhāraṃ prakarotveva vihṛtya bhagavān svayam ।
uddhāraṃ ca bhavatsevāṃ vṛṇe nānyad vṛṇomyaham ।।38।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau jumāsemlānareśvaraḥ ।
sanatkumāro bhagavānupādideśa taṃ tataḥ ।।3 9।।
śārīraṃ mānasaṃ vāpi duṣkṛtaṃ durvicintitam ।
tathā te dānavo bhāvo vyapayātu narādhipa ।।2.54.40 ।।
susthirā tava sadbhaktiḥ parameśe'stu nityadā ।
mūkto'si daityabhāvāttvaṃ bhaja kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।41 ।।
śṛṇu rājān dhruvaṃ sādhyaṃ nā'dhruvaṃ tu kadācana ।
calāḥ śriyaḥ sadā bodhyāstābhiḥ sādhyaṃ tu śāśvatam ।।42।।
purā prasanno bhagavān lakṣmyā rūpacatuṣṭayam ।
dhartuṃ dideśa tāṃ sā'pi catūrūpā babhūva ha ।।43।।
śvetāmbaradharā caikā śvetasraganulepanā ।
śvetagajasamārūḍhā sattvāḍhyā śvetavigrahā ।।44।।
raktāmbaradharā cānyā raktasraganulepanā ।
raktavājisamārūḍhā raktāṃgī rājasī hi sā ।।45।।
pītāmbarā pītavarṇā pītasraganulepanā ।
sauvarṇasyandanārūḍhā tāmasaṃ guṇamāśritā ।।46 ।।
nīlāmbarā nīlamālyā nīlagandhā'lisaprabhā ।
nīlavṛṣasamārūḍhā miśrā sā triguṇātmikā ।।47।।
śvetā candraṃ vedhasa ca sāttvikān pratyabhisthitā ।
raktā cendraṃ ca rājānaṃ manūn nṛpānupasthitā ।।48।।
pītā prajāpatīn yātā vaiśyavarṇān sudhārmikān ।
nīlā tu dānavān daityān śūdrāँśca rākṣasādikān ।।49 ।।
viprādyāḥ śvetavarṇāṃ tu sarasvatīṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ।
yajñaṃ mantrān pūjanādi daivakāryaṃ śubhapradam ।।2.54.5 0।।
kṣatriyā rājasīṃ raktāṃ jayaśriyaṃ subhejire ।
vaiśyā vṛttisvarūpāṃ tāmaṅgīcakruḥ samantata ।।5 1 ।।
śūdrā nīlāṃ dāsyarūpāṃ sevādevīṃ prajagṛhuḥ ।
evaṃ vibhaktā sā lakṣmīryāvadbhāgyaṃ hi vartate ।।52।।
etāsāṃ tu svarūpāṇi bhavanti nidhayo'vyayāḥ ।
vedāḥ kathānakādyāśca saṃhitāḥ śāstrasatkriyāḥ ।। 53 ।।
catuḥṣaṣṭikalāḥ śvetā mahāpadmo nidhiḥ sthitaḥ ।
ratnāni svarṇarajate gajāśvarathabhūṣaṇam ।।54।।
śastrā'strādikavastūni raktā padmo nidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
gomahiṣyaḥ kharoṣṭrāśca suvarṇāmbarabhūmayaḥ ।।55 ।।
oṣadhyaḥ paśavaḥ pītā mahānīlo nidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
sarvāsāmapi jātīnāṃ sevā nityā pratiṣṭhitā ।।5 6 ।।
sukhaduḥkhātisaṃvyāptā nīlā śaṃkho nidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
etābhiḥ svīkṛtā ye ye mānavādyā nijāśritāḥ ।।57।।
teṣāṃ bhavanti rūpāṇi bodhārthaṃ saṃbravīmi te ।
sattvalakṣmīyutāḥ saumyāḥ satyaśaucādipālakāḥ ।।58।।
surūpā dharmakartāro darśanāhlādadāyakāḥ ।
dīrghanetrā dīrghabhujā hāsyatṛptyādiśālinaḥ ।।5 9 ।।
avikhaṇḍitadehāśca avikhaṇḍakuṭumbinaḥ ।
avikhaṇḍānnapānādyā avikhaṇḍayaśo'malāḥ ।।2.54.6 0 ।।
satyaśocābhisaṃyuktā baladānotsave ratāḥ ।
āstikyadānanairmalyaparopakṛtiśālinaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
bhavanti rājan subhagā mahāpadmāśritā janāḥ ।
yajvinaḥ subhagā dṛptā mālino bahudakṣiṇāḥ ।।62।।
bahubhogā bahurūpā bahurājasavartinaḥ ।
sarvopaskaratejobhiḥ prabhāsino'tikīrtayaḥ ।।63।।
yāvadvastubhiḥ sukhino rājyakṣetrādibhoginaḥ ।
mānyā mānapradā hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭā dīrghaśarīriṇaḥ ।।64।।
madanetrā garvabhālāḥ śmaśrulā varṣmakeśinaḥ ।
raktanakhā raktavarṇā janāḥ padmāśritāḥ sthitāḥ ।।65।।
satyā'nṛtasamāyuktā dānā'śaraṇayajvinaḥ ।
nyāyā'nyāyavyopetāḥ sarvasantoṣakārakāḥ ।।66।।
dānadharmā nātirūpā nātivastrā naśobhanāḥ ।
rūkṣadehā madhyapuṣṭā mahānīlāśritā janāḥ ।।67।।
nāstikāḥ śaucarahitāḥ kṛpaṇā bhogavarjitāḥ ।
steyā'nṛtakathāvādāḥ paraduḥkhakarāḥ śaṭhāḥ ।।68।।
svārthamātraparāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kadrūpā bhāvihīnakāḥ ।
agandhāḥ kusvabhāvāśca makṣikākṛtamitratāḥ ।।69।।
mālinyavāsasahanā janāḥ śaṃkhāśritā nṛpa! ।
tasyāṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ nare nāryāṃ napuṃsake ।।2.54.70।।
samāśrayanti taṃ cānyā hriḥ kīrtirdyutirityapi ।
prabhā gatiḥ kṣamā bhūtirvidyā nītirdayā matiḥ ।।7 1।।
śrutiḥ smṛtirbalaṃ kīrtirdhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ kriyā kṛtiḥ ।
puṣṭistuṣṭistathā cānyā mukhyaśriyā'nujīvitāḥ ।। 72।।।
sā śrīrlekhāvaśā rājan yāvad rekhā hi vartate ।
rekhāyā vigame śrīśca sarvaśrībhirnivartate ।।73 ।।
śriyaḥ sarvāḥ samāyānti pūrvakarmavidhānataḥ ।
sukhaduḥkhāni daityendra sahanīyāni tāni vai ।।74।।
putramitrakalatrārthe rājyabhogadhanāya ca ।
āgame nirgame prājñe viṣādo nāviśet kvacit ।।75 ।।
āpadāmāgamaṃ dṛṣṭvā na viṣaṇṇo bhaved vaśī ।
sampadaṃ ca suvistīrṇāṃ prāpya no phulito bhavet ।।76।।
dhanakṣaye na muhyanti na duṣyanti dhanāgame ।
dhīrā ta eva tu proktā jñāninaḥ puruṣottamāḥ ।।77।।
tathā'nyacca mahābāho hitaṃ śṛṇu mahārthakam ।
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi tamenaṃ puruṣottamam ।।78।।
ye śrayanti hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।
te taranti bhavābdhervai śataikakulavanditāḥ ।।79।।
tanmanā dānavaśreṣṭha tadbhakto bhava sarvaśaḥ ।
sa eva bhavatāṃ śreyo vidhāsyati narāyaṇaḥ ।।2.54.80।।
sarvakarmāṇi tatraiva śubhānyapyaśubhāni ca ।
rāgadveṣaprajātāni samarpayā'tra mādhave ।।8 1 ।।
nā'bhuktaṃ śrīyate karma kalpakoṭigame'pi hi ।
nārāyaṇe'rpitaṃ cet tad bhoktavyaṃ na hi śiṣyate ।।82।।
cauraścauryādidoṣeṇa daṇḍaṃ yāti yathā kṛtam ।
yadi rājā prasannaḥ syād daṇḍaṃ dadāti naiva ca ।।83।।
kṣamate tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ punaḥ kartuṃ niṣedhati ।
evaṃ śrībhagavānatra pāpināṃ prāṇadhāriṇām ।।84।।
kṛtapāpāni vijñāya daṇḍaṃ dadāti sarvathā ।
yadi kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ syād daṇḍaṃ naiva dadāti hi ।।85।।
kṣamate tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ punaḥ kartuṃ niṣedhati ।
prasannatā'sya cāptavyā sādhanairvividhairapi ।।86।।
pratyakṣe vartamāne tu yad vadet tat samācaret ।
atrāyaṃ vidyate śrīmān pratyakṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।87।।
ehi taccharaṇaṃ yāhi yadvadet tatsamācara ।
ityuktvā nṛpatiṃ mlecchaṃ muniḥ sanatkumārakaḥ ।।88।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapāde nināya tam ।
rājā prāha dayāsindho samuddhara yatheṣṭakam ।।89।।
pāpo'haṃ pāpakarmā'haṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ।
pāpiprasaṃgakartāraṃ samuddhara kṛpālaya ।।2.54.90।।
vihasya śrīhariḥ prāha śuddho jāto'si sarvathā ।
sākṣāt satāṃ prasaṃgena daityabhāvena mocitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
yūyaṃ bhṛtyāstathā senāpatayo narayoṣitaḥ ।
sarve matsādhuyogena pāvanāḥ stho na saṃśayaḥ ।।92।।
tava deśo nagarāṇi taḍāgāni tathā''pagāḥ ।
girayo raṇabhūbhāgāḥ pāvanāḥ satprasaṃgataḥ ।।93।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
nāradaśca hariṃ natvā dhṛtvā kalpalatāṃ kare ।।94।।
vimāne saptabhaumeṣu vicacāra muhurmuhuḥ ।
yuddhayogena vai yatra kvāpi kaccaravat tathā ।।95।।
bhagnaṃ truṭitamābhagnaṃ viparītaṃ parāvṛtam ।
sarvaṃ saṃkalpya tūrṇaṃ hi yathāvat samakārayat ।।96।।
jalena prokṣya ca śuddhiṃ cakāra sarvabhūmiṣu ।
samāyayau hareragre tasthau namro mudā yutaḥ ।।97।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vimāne saptamabhūmikāyāṃ daityanārīkṛtayuddhaṃ, kalpavallyutpāditakṛtyābhidaiṃtyādīnāṃ nāśaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanaṃ, rājñaḥ prārthanā, upadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 54 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 054 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 55
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 056 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! rājā parameśaṃ tadā''rthayat ।
mṛtānāṃ tu yathā muktistathā kuru dayāṃ kuru ।। 1 ।।
vimānena samāgatya yatra yatrā'bhavad raṇaḥ ।
tatra tatra vihṛtyaiva kuru tīrthāni keśava ।। 2 ।।
bhaviṣyāṇāṃ ca lokānāṃ bhūrbhavenmuktibhājanā ।
evaṃ kṛpāṃ parāṃ nātha pāpināṃ kuru tāriṇīm ।। 3 ।।
śrīkṛṣaganārāyaṇa uvāca-
dhanyā te vimalā rājanmatistvadya pravartate ।
abriktaṃ sarvathā deśaṃ kariṣye tīrtharūpiṇam ।। 4 ।।
nadyastā brahmaṇaḥ putryo daityayogena daityatām ।
tūpagatāḥ pāvanāstāḥ pāvayiṣye'dya vai punaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ityuktamātre nadyaśca sarāṃsi parvatāstathā ।
mūrtimantaḥ samāyātāḥ prārthayituṃ prabhuṃ tadā ।। 6 ।।
ūcurnātha kṛpāsindho pāvayā'smān samantataḥ ।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stvevaṃ pāvayiṣye drutaṃ hi vaḥ ।। 7।।
atha sampūjya tā nadyo draṣṭuṃ ca brahmakanyakāḥ ।
svabhaginīrdraṣṭumeva vimāne cordhvabhūstare ।। 8 ।।
yayustatra militvā tā āmantryā''bhāṣya vai muhuḥ ।
yayuścā'dṛśyatāṃ drāk ca tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vimānena yayau kartuṃ tīrthāni pāvanāni ca ।
uddhartuṃ ca mṛtātmanaḥ pradakṣiṇakrameṇa vai ।। 2.55.1 0।।
prathamaṃ śrīharistatra vimānena tadottaram ।
yayau pāvayituṃ yuddhakṣetrāccaṇḍanadīṃ śubhām ।। 11 ।।
caṇḍanadyāṃ tathā snātvā caṇḍasarasi vai hariḥ ।
vaimānikāstathā sarve narā nāryo mahattamam ।। 12।।
tīrthaṃ vidhāya ca tatastrirāśiparvataṃ yayuḥ ।
parvataṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā jalādiṣu ।। 13।।
tīrthaṃ tatparvataṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇyā dvitīyake ।
dhodhe snātvā tṛtīye ca dhodhe snātvā caturthake ।। 14।।
dhodhe snātvā pañcame ca snātvā dhodhe tataḥ param ।
antavairāsaṃgame ca snātvā ca ṣaṣṭhadhodhake ।। 12।।
śvetanīlasvarūpiṇyornārāyaṇyośca saṃgame ।
snātvā tūyānasarasi tīrthāni vyadadhāt prabhuḥ ।। 16।।
ābālākhyataḍāgeṣu snātvā cakre tu mokṣadān ।
taḍāgānnirmalajalān caturaśca tataḥ param ।। 17।।
ukteṣu tīrthavaryeṣu ye ye mṛtā mahāhave ।
tāँstān pretān samāhūya teṣāṃ mokṣaṃ vyadhātprabhuḥ ।। 18।।
divyayānaistu te sarve svargaṃ yayurhi śāśvatam ।
apārakaruṇāsindhurmokṣado yatra vai hariḥ ।। 19।।
tatra kā karmasāpekṣā gatiḥ kā kṛpayodbhavā ।
jubvāṃ nadīṃ tataḥ spṛṣṭvā rudrabāṣpasarovaram ।। 2.55.20।।
snātvā mārkiśanadhodhe ālāvartasarovare ।
antāvartataḍāge ca snātvā kimusarovare ।।21 ।।
vijñatūrīyasarasi nyājāsarovare tathā ।
tuṃgānīke taḍāge ca snātvā rukvasarovare ।। 22।।
raphijyāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā rovumāyāṃ samāplavat ।
nyājāsarovare snātvā śivāsarovare tataḥ ।।23।।
jāmbūjāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā baṃgavyālīsarovare ।
māvūrasarasi snātvā kaṅgūsnānaṃ tato'karot ।।24।।
tatra tatra ca nidhanaṃ gatān pretān kṛpālayaḥ ।
amokṣayat tathā tāni tīrthānyapyākarot prabhuḥ ।।25।।
tato yayau dinolūkataḍāgaṃ bhagavān hariḥ ।
vijñaturīyadhodhe ca jñātvā kubaṃgikātaṭe ।।26।।
tajje sarovare snātvā limpāpagāyāṃ cāplavat ।
bālanadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā dakṣiṇāvargaparvatam ।।27।।
vimānenordhvamullaṃghya kāruvārdhiṃ jagāma ha ।
vimānādavatīryā'tha sarve sasnuśca sāgare ।।28।।
tataste yānamāruhya orañjāsaritaṃ yayuḥ ।
snātvā raṇe mṛtān uktasthāneṣvapi mṛtāsurān ।।29।।
amokṣayacchrībhagavān kālahariraṇāttataḥ ।
yayau kunayanāṃ snātvā kurenṛkyāṃ samāplavat ।।2.55.3 0।।
gatvā kuvaṃśajāṃ snātvā sthānalyākhye jalāśaye ।
karmāṅgyāṃ ca mahānadyāṃ snātvā mahāsamāgame ।। 31 ।।
limpāsarovare snātvā tumbāsarovare tathā ।
sthānalyādhodhabhāgeṣu snātvā āruvamījale ।। 32।।
karmāṅgyāṃ ca tathoveṇyāṃ snātvā tayoḥ samāgame ।
sāmudrasaṃgame snātvā koṭipretapramokṣaṇam ।।33।।
cakāra śrīharistatra mṛtānāṃ śāśvatārthakṛt ।
tāni vidhāya tīrthāni āgīvyāṃ prayayau tataḥ ।।34।।
karmaghnaṃ parvataṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā venajayātaṭe ।
snānaṃ ca saṃgame tasyā naṣṭajarāsamāgame ।। 35।।
keḍaṃḍāyāṃ tathā nadyāṃ tathā caṇḍasarovare ।
phegavipīnasarasi snātvā saritsamāgame ।।3 6।।
gambikāyāṃ sphuṭāyāṃ ca senāgolasaritsu ca ।
phalgubīje tathā snātvā raṇamullaṅghya vai hariḥ ।। 37।।
raṇe sarovare snātvā ataleṣṭaṃ ca parvatam ।
alajālisaraḥpañcasvāplavanaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 38।।
tanmukhaṃ parvataṃ gatvā trirāśiparvataṃ tataḥ ।
līlābījaraṇaṃ gatvā kṛtvā tīrthāni vai jale ।।39।।
bhūmadhyābdhau tataḥ snātvā nārāyaṇīyasāgare ।
samudrasaṃgameṣveva snātvā''dye dhodhasārake ।।2.55.40।।
navabījaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā raktasamudrakam ।
kṛtvā sarvāṇi ca tāni pavitrāṇi jalāni tu ।।41।।
nadīrnadāँstaḍāgāँśca saro vāpīḥ pravāhakān ।
deśān raṇān parvatāँśca mahāpagāśca nālikāḥ ।।42।।
tattatpradeśajān grāmān nagarāṇi gṛhāṇi ca ।
rājadhānīrjaladhānīrvanadhānīśca bhūmikāḥ ।। 43।।
pavitrīkṛtya ca tīrthīkṛtya śrīmannarāyaṇaḥ ।
koṭigaṇaiḥ pārṣadaiśca devībhiḥ sādhubhiḥ saha ।।44।।
dharmarājaskandaśaṃbhuvināyakādibhiḥ saha ।
sthale ca vihṛtya pretoddhāraṃ vidhāya ca ।।45।।
abriktaṃ sumahākhaṇḍaṃ tīrthībhūtaṃ vidhāya ca ।
daśasāhasrakrośātmabhūmiṃ kṛtvā supāvanīm ।।46।।
jumāsemlānṛpaṃ prāha bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
rājan manorathaste'tra jāto vai saphalaḥ khalu ।।47।।
adhunā ca vayaṃ yāmo raivate'śvasarovaram ।
śrutvā rājā''ha bhagavan muktimicchāmi śāśvatīm ।।48।।
mokṣadātā miled yāvad yadi mokṣaṃ na vindati ।
saṃsārastasya śirasi dhruva eva sthito bhavet ।।49।।
mayā bhuktaṃ bahu rājyaṃ daśalakṣasamāntaram ।
mama pūrvaṃ gatā daityāḥ koṭivarṣopajīvinaḥ ।।।2.55.5 0।।
naitāḥ kaiścit samaṃ yātāḥ pṛthvī sampat prajāstathā ।
na yāsyanti mayā sākaṃ tato me bhagavan prabho ।। 51 ।।
kurūddhāraṃ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā lapsye yacchāśvataṃ padam ।
pāvitaṃ tu kuṭumbaṃ me pāvitā pṛthivī mama ।।।52।।
pāvitāśca prajāḥ sarvā pretā uddhāritāstathā ।
nadyādīni ca tīrthāni pāvanāni kṛtānyapi ।।53।।
ahaṃ patnyā samaṃ yāmi tava dhāma sanātanam ।
tathā me kuru jīvendra kṛpāṃ prasannatodbhavām ।।54।।
imāśca kanyakā me vai sahasraṃ ṣoḍaśābdikāḥ ।
santi sarvā varārohā varo bhava suhṛdgamaḥ ।।55।।
anye santi kumārā me teṣāṃ yatheṣṭakaṃ kuru ।
kuṭumbināṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ kṛṣṇa yatheṣṭakaṃ kuru ।।56 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā'tibhāvukam ।
rājānaṃ prāha rājendra pāpapuṇye gate tava ।।57।।
mokṣayogyo'si te mokṣaṃ karomi kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
ityuktaśca tadā dhīmān tatkṣaṇaṃ kanyakā nijāḥ ।।58।।
haste jalaṃ gṛhītvaiva datvā śrīpatihastake ।
sahasrakanyakāḥ kṛṣṇa! te dadāmi, tava striyaḥ ।।59।।
bhavantu sarvasaubhāgyayuktā matsantatiḥ sukhā ।
ityuktvā pradadau divyaṃ yautakaṃ koṭi cārbudam ।। 2.55.60।।
sauvarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ mauktijālaṃ hīrakaratnakam ।
bhūṣāmbarāṇi divyāni yānavāhanakāni ca ।।6 1 ।।
dāsān dāsīrdadau tāvat sahasrasaṃkhyakā api ।
hastivājyuṣṭragavayān gomahiṣyādikaṃ dadau ।।62।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nītvā vimānake ।
kanyāśca yautakaṃ yāne dhṛtvā prāha nṛpaṃ tadā ।।63।।
rājan śrīnāradādatra gṛhāṇa caraṇāmṛtam ।
tava rājñyastriśatāni gṛhṇantu caraṇāmṛtam ।।64।।
tava putrāśca gṛhṇantu kuṭumbaṃ caraṇāmṛtam ।
ityuktāste nāradādvai jagṛhuścaraṇāmṛtam ।।65।।
śrīhareḥ pādadhautaṃ tajjalaṃ papuśca te mudā ।
drāk samādhau gatāḥ sarve brahmaṇi līnanāḍikāḥ ।।66।।
dvirūpāḥ sarva evaite tadā kṛṣṇecchayā'bhavan ।
chāyārūpā devaloke'bhavan marutsurāstu te ।।67।।
anye divyavimāneṣu bhūtvā divyavapurdharāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāma yayustadā ।।68।।
athaitāḥ kanyakāstasya śavakhātān pracakrire ।
bhūsamādhiṃ kārayitvā tathottarakriyādikam ।।।69।।
sarvaṃ ca vidhivat kṛṣṇaḥ kārayitvā yathocitam ।
nīlaśvetanarāyaṇyornadyordhodhe tu ṣaṣṭhake ।।2.55.70।।
sarvaṃ samāpya vidhivad dvirājyaṃ vyabhajatprabhuḥ ।
adanākhātage tīre jīmūtīnagarāttataḥ ।।71 ।।
paścime tūnāyavāridhānīmembāgapattanam ।
uṣṇāṃgyākhyanadīmūlaṃ karmāṃgādreśca paścime ।।।72।।।
buyāparyantamevāsya khaṇḍasya madhyabhāgataḥ ।
sīmāṃ pradarśya collikhya dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ tathā ।।73।।
dakṣiṇaṃ pradadau rudraśirase bhaktayogine ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāya keśavaḥ ।।74।।
uttaraṃ ca tathā rājyaṃ dinamerāhvayāya ca ।
dadau nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānnijabhaktāya keśavaḥ ।।75।।
rudraśirādinamerābhidhau senāpatiprabhau ।
yuddhe cāstāṃ nirmanaskau bhaktau nārāyaṇasya tau । ।76।।
tābhyāṃ rājye pradatte ca hyabhiṣiktau svayaṃ tadā ।
hariṇā devasadṛśo kṛtā mukuṭamarpitam ।।77।।
dakṣiṇe ca mahārājye rājadhānī kṛtā tadā ।
rudraśiretivikhyātā vijñaturīyapārśvagā ।।78।।
pūrvasyāṃ ca daśayojanāyatā tvatiśobhitā ।
uttare ca tathā khaṇḍe dinamereṇa nirmitā ।।79 ।।
rājadhānī caṇḍasaro'ntike paścimabhūtale ।
nāmnā sā dinamereti daśayojanavistṛtā ।।2.55.80।।
tasyāṃ devālayaṃ kṛtvā sahasradhanurucchrayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mūrtiruttamā ।।8 1।।
kānakī sthāpitā tena hareṇa sahitā śubhā ।
sanatā nāradenāpi dharmadevena śobhitā ।।82।।
evaṃ rudraśirasā'pi sahasradhanurucchrayam ।
kārayitvā''layaṃ ramyaṃ parvataśṛṃgasadṛśam ।।83 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mūrtiruttamā ।
sanatā śaṃbhunā dharmadevena nāradena ca ।।84।।
sevitā sthāpitā tatra kānakī bahuśobhanā ।
evaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ datvā bhaktābhyāṃ rājadhānike ।।85।।।
bhaktadattāṃ divyapūjāṃ gṛhītvā puruṣottamaḥ ।
sarvaśubhāśiṣo datvā vimānamadhiruhya ca ।।86।।
kanyāvargeṇa ca dāsīdāsavrātaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ।
bhūpābhyāṃ dāsadāsyādīrdatvā kṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।87।।
brahmakanyā dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi sahasrakam ।
rājyakanyāstathā naijānpārṣadāndevasevakān ।।88।।
sarvameva samādāya vyomnā jagāma pūrvataḥ ।
pūrvasyāṃ raktavārdhiṃ ca samuttīrya haristataḥ ।।89।।
ārabījaṃ mahādeśaṃ dadarśa vyomamārgataḥ ।
tatrāha dharmarājaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।2.55.90।।
paśya rājan mahādaityaṃ deśeṣvatra prasahya saḥ ।
nṛpo bhūtvā mahārājyaṃ karoti dānavānugaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
raktabījaścārabījo balavān lokanāśanaḥ ।
sumahāvālukāvyāptaraṇottarapradeśake ।।92।।
badhīrāyananagaraṃ kṛtvā vasati nirbhayaḥ ।
śrīnāyiparvataṃ ramyaṃ bahuśobhitakandaram ।।93।।
latāvimānasaṃchannaṃ mattasattvasamākulam ।
vividhaiḥ kusumaiścāpi sugandhitānilāśrayam ।।94।।
dṛṣṭvā ramyaṃ raktabījo tathā'nye dānavādayaḥ ।
daśasahasrasaṃkhyāste ārabījā vasanti hi ।।95।।
ūrdhvaretasīsaritaṃ tvabhivyāpya hi vartate ।
teṣāṃ rājyaṃ viśālaṃ vai mlecchācārajuṣāṃ yama! ।।96।।
devānāṃ sa virodhyeva daityo'sya dānavādayaḥ ।
bakadānaṛṣestatrā''śramaṃ vināśya te'surāḥ ।।97।।
vartante sa ṛṣistatra tāyigrāsanadīṃ prati ।
gatvā jalatale sthitvā tapaḥ karoti dāruṇam ।। 98।।
tamenaṃ prathamaṃ natvā tato'surān vināśaya ।
dūtān yāmyāँstathā raudrān saha nītvā prayāhi ca ।।99।।
tān sarvān nāśayitvā vā vidrāvya vā rasātalam ।
ṛṣyāśramaṃ punarbhītivarjyaṃ vidhāya dharmarāṭ! ।। 2.55.10 0।।
tava dūto maunadharmā aravo nāma nāmataḥ ।
vartate yoganipuṇastasmai rājyaṃ samarpaya ।। 101 ।।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hāraṃ dadau gale ।
yamarājasya ca sainyaṃ dadau kalpalatāṃ tathā ।। 1 02।।
yamastvājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva sasainyo vyomamārgataḥ ।
yayau taṃ dānavaṃ tūrṇaṃ raṇamullaṅghya yatnataḥ ।। 1 03।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ śrīlomaśāśramam ।। 1 04।।
jayatūrṇaṇyavādyanta jayaghoṣāstadā'bhavan ।
aśvapaṭṭasarorāṣṭraṃ brahmānandabharaṃ hyabhūt ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne abriktadeśeṣu śrīharirvihṛtya tīrthāni vidadhe, mṛtānāmuddhāraṃ ca vidadhe, rājyaṃ dvedhā vibhajya
bhaktābhyāṃ dadau, rājakuṭumbasya mokṣaṃ cakre cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 55 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 56
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 057 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
kaḥ sa rājā jumāsemlāhvayastvāsītpurā prabho ।
ke tatsenāpatayaśca yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇāśrayo'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tāṃ rādhike pūrvāṃ kathāṃ daivasuyoginīm ।
avadhānaṃ paraṃ datvā mayoktā pāpanāśinīm ।। 2 ।।
svāyaṃbhuvasya putro'bhūnmanurnāma priyavrataḥ ।
tasyā''sīt savano nāma putrastrailokyaviśrutaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sa cā'napatyo nidhane sati pretagatiṃ gataḥ ।
tasya bhāryā'rudat tatra suvedā śokavihvalā ।। 4 ।।
na dadāti śavaṃ dagdhuṃ samādhṛtya sthitā patim ।
nāthanātheti bahuśaḥ savilāpā tvanāthavat ।। 5 ।।
tāmāha vyomavāṇī mā rudihi tvaṃ śucaṃ tyaja ।
yadi cāste tava snehaḥ satyaṃ cāpi vrataṃ mahat ।। 6 ।।
tadā satīvṛṣaṃ dhṛtvā vrajā'gnau patinā saha ।
suvedā''śrutya tāṃ vāṇīṃ satī pratyuttaraṃ dadau ।। 7 ।।
nā'haṃ śocāmi māṃ deva mandabhāgyāṃ nijārthikā ।
kintvenaṃ putrahīnaṃ vai śocāmi gativarjitam ।। 8 ।।
aputrasya gatirnāsti noddhāro narakādapi ।
na ca śrāddhā'bhilāṣā'pi tena vai rauravaṃ dhruvam ।। 9 ।।
aputrasya tu kāntasya kāminyapi tathāvidhā ।
gatihīnā rauravārhā tasmātputrasamicchayā । । 2.56.10 ।।
śocāmi śreyaicchārthaṃ deva śreyaḥ kuru prabho ।
vyomavāṇī tataḥ prāha rājñi rudihi mā śucā ।। 1 1।।
svāminaste saptaputrā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।
vahnimāroha śīghraṃ tvaṃ śraddadhasva satī bhava ।। 12।।
rājñī prāha vinā dehaṃ mama me svāminastathā ।
mānavā vai kathaṃ putrā bhaviṣyanti vadā'dhunā ।। 1 3।।
vyomavāṇī tadā prāha tava satyena sundari! ।
dāhe satyeva ca dvayoratra dehau punarnavau ।। 14।।
mānasau divyatattvau ca kṣaṇāntare bhaviṣyataḥ ।
rājñā datto'tra garbhaste dhāturūpo bhaviṣyati ।। 15।।
dhātordvārā tava patyurbhaviṣyanti suputrakāḥ ।।
ityuktā sā satyadharmaṃ tvālambya pativarṣma tat ।। 16।।
dadau kāṣṭhe sthāpayituṃ tataḥ svayaṃ citāṃ prati ।
yayau hutāśamāsādya citte dhyātvā patiṃ sutān ।। 17।।
prapannā jvalanaṃ sādhvī divyadehā babhūva ha ।
rājā divyaśriyā yuktaścotthitaḥ saha bhāryayā ।। 18।।
yutaḥ sunābhaputryā sa utpapāta tadā tu kham ।
vimānaṃ tvambare sarvaidivyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ suvarculam ।। 1 9।।
tatra sā mahiṣī tūrṇaṃ rajasvalā hyajāyata ।
itijātaṃ mahāścaryaṃ yathā matistathā gatiḥ ।।2.56.20।।
yadyapi divyadehe ca devīṣu vahnijāsu ca ।
tātkāliko rajodharmo nocitastatra vai kṣaṇāt ।।21।।
tathāpi vāsanāyogād bhāvanāvaśatastathā ।
āśīrvādena ca vyomavāṇyā rajasvalā'bhavat ।।22।।
vimānaṃ cāmbare tatra pañcarātraṃ sthiraṃ hyabhūt ।
iṣyamāṇamapi gantuṃ divaṃ yātuṃ śaśāka na ।।23।।
sarvairvilokitaṃ vyomni dṛśyate candrasūjjvalam ।
tarkyate kathametadvai svargaṃ yāti na tiṣṭhati ।।24।।
meghacchannamabhūdūrdhvaṃ cāntarīkṣagataṃ punaḥ ।
meghopari bhramannāste tadūrdhvaṃ naiva gacchati ।।।25।।
rājā bhāryāsahāyaśca pañcadināni khe sthitaḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhe'hani ṛtau dānaṃ dadau patnyai sutecchukaḥ ।।।26।।
kintu daivānmahiṣyāstu bhāgye nā''san sutāḥ khalu ।
śukraṃ garbhe sthiraṃ nā'bhūt tena prācyavatā'mbarāt ।।27।।
śukrapātottaraṃ rājā mahiṣyā bhāryayā saha ।
jagāma ca vimānena brahmalokaṃ hi rādhike! ।।28।।
śukraṃ yatrā'patad bhūmau ṛjyāvasathamaṇḍale ।
saptadhā bhedamāpannaṃ cojjvalaṃ jalabudbudam ।।29।।
ekaḥ kaṇo mahānebhyaḥ śīghraṃ bhūmau papāta ha ।
anye kaṇāstu ṣaṭ vāyuhatāḥ pratyekasaptadhā ।।2.56.3 0।।
punaḥ pratyekaṃ ca sapta, te ṣaṭnyūnaṃ śatatrayam ।
kaṇāste vahnivarṇā vai rājataṃ varṣaṇaṃ yathā ।।3 1 ।।
sūryakaraiścākacakyamāpannāstārakā iva ।
maṇayo vā kimete ca kiṃ vā cāmṛtabindavaḥ ।। 32।।
iti matvā ṛṣipatnyaḥ kaṇān dhartuṃ karairnijaiḥ ।
dadruvuḥ patanāgre ca tāvatte vahnisadṛśāḥ ।।33।।
ākṛṣṭā daivagatyā ca deheṣvadṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ ।
yathā śvāsena sākaṃ tu vārikaṇāstathā ca te ।।34।।
mahān kaṇo'pi ca maṇerbhrāntimudbhāvayaँstadā ।
saṃgrahītuṃ drutaṃ yāntīṃ sumādāṃ samapadyata ।।35।।
nalinī puṣyatī citrā viśālā haritā'nilā ।
evamādyāstu tā garbhayuktāḥ samabhavaँstataḥ ।।36।।
brahmatejovihīnāstā jātāḥ patnyastapasvinām ।
ṛṣayo vṛttamājñāya brahmatejovihīnatām ।।37।।
dṛṣṭvā jñātvā'nyagarbhāḍhyāstatyajurvarṣamātrakam ।
anyagarbhā hi tāḥ sarvā himaśailaṃ vihāya ca ।। 38।।
vyomnā paścimavārdhiṃ saṃyayuḥ putraprasūtaye ।
nārāyaṇīṃ nadīṃ prāpya abriktaṃ sthalamuttamam ।।39।।
nyūṣuryathāvakāśaṃ ca phalamūlā'nilā'śanāḥ ।
suṣuvire sutāँstatra samakālān hi yoṣitaḥ ।।2.56.40।।
rudanti sma ca te sarve bhairavaṃ daivayogataḥ ।
teṣāṃ ruditaśabdena sarvaṃ cāpūritaṃ jagat ।।41।।
atrā''jagāma bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
samabhyetyā'bravīd bālān mā rudata mahābalāḥ ।।42।।
maruddeśe'mbare garbhadānāt kṣatriyaputrakāḥ ।
kṣatriyāyāṃ praviśyaiva nirgatā vāyuvegataḥ ।।43।।
marutāṃ sparśayogena brāhmaṇīṣu praveśitāḥ ।
brāhmaṇaiḥ samparityaktāḥ prāptāḥ stha janma cātra vai ।।44।।
evaṃ pitṛparityaktāḥ pitṛvairakarāḥ sadā ।
viprakṣatriyavairāḍhyā bhūtale'tra bhaviṣyathaḥ ।।45।।
evaṃ vai vairabhāvena yadyapi brahmakṣatriyāḥ ।
mālinyaṃ vairamāsādya mlecchā daityā bhaviṣyatha ।।46।।
asaṃskārāstathā viprakriyāśūnyā bhaviṣyatha ।
marutāṃ cāmbare śukrotsargeṇa marutāṃ gaṇāḥ ।।47।।
kadācid ditijā yūyaṃ punardaityā bhaviṣyatha ।
daityā api sajīvāśca mahendreṇa punaḥ punaḥ ।।48।।
garbhe vajreṇa nikṛttā devā api bhaviṣyatha ।
devatve kāraṇaṃ tatra śṛṇutā'tra vadāmi vaḥ ।।49।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
mahāyuddhanimittena deśe'trā'pyāgamiṣyati ।।2.56.50।।
taddhastajalalābhena caraṇāmṛtapānataḥ ।
pāvitryaṃ bhavatāṃ śīghraṃ tadā tvatra bhaviṣyati ।।51।।
tena puṇyena ca yūyaṃ devatvaṃ samavāpsyatha ।
maruto nāma devā vai yūyaṃ khyātā bhaviṣyatha ।।।52।।
evamuktvā tu tān bālān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
rakṣituṃ ca poṣayituṃ triśataṃ yoṣitāṃ tadā ।।53।।
svapṛṣṭhotpāditaṃ dugdhapradaṃ mlecchasvabhāvajam ।
dadau tatra tathā dāsān śatāni trīṇi sandadau ।।54।।
pṛṣṭhān kṛṣṇavarṇāṃśca krūrasvabhāvavartinaḥ ।
dharmakarmavihīnāँśca saṃskārakṛtivarjitān ।।55।।
kalpanāmātrakāryasthān datvā tebhyaḥ śiśūँstataḥ ।
amātṛjā narāste cā'mātṛjābhiḥ sahā'vasan ।।56।।
dampatītvaṃ sadā prāptā nyavasaँśca sukhena te ।
tebhya ārabhya evā'tra dugdhabhinnā prabhujyate ।।57।।
asahodaravaivāhyaṃ tadārabhya pravartate ।
evaṃ brahmā tu sarvebhyo datvā śiśūn tataḥ param ।।58।।
viprapatnīḥ samagrāśca sūtakā'nte'tinirmalāḥ ।
śuddhāḥ kṛtvā saha nītvā yayau hemādrimuttamam ।।59।।
yatra te ṛṣayaḥ santi brahmacaryavratasthitāḥ ।
vyomamārgeṇa ca brahmā vimānāgryādavātarat ।।2.56.60।।
haste kamaṇḍaluṃ kṛtvā vedāśīrvādamuccaran ।
ṛṣayo brāhmaṇā dṛṣṭvottasthurmagnāḥ pitāmaham ।।6 1 ।।
nemuśca daṇḍavat pṛthvyāṃ sambhūyā'pyāsanaṃ dadau ।
pūjāṃ cakruryathārhā ca brahmā tata uvāca tān ।।62।।
viprāḥ sarvaṃ bhavatyeva parameśasamicchayā ।
utpattiḥ pralayaśceti poṣaṇaṃ ca harīcchayā ।।63।।
īśastajjñānayatnecchāḥ kālo'dṛṣṭaṃ svakarma ca ।
yatraikatāṃ samāyānti tatra kāryaṃ bhavet tadā ।।64।।
manoḥ putrasya viprā vai savanasya tu dhātutaḥ ।
bhavatāṃ vai priyāsveva jātāḥ triśataputrakāḥ ।।65।।
pañcanyūnā hi te sarve mayā saṃrakṣitāḥ sadā ।
paścimāyāṃ bhuvi dṛptā yuṣmaddharmavivarjitāḥ ।।66।।
tā etā yoṣito vaśca śuddhāḥ saṃskārakarmabhiḥ ।
samānītā mayā yuṣmatsevāyāṃ śuddhabhāvanāḥ ।।67।।
vimāne tāstu vartante gṛhṇataitāḥ punaḥ svakāḥ ।
ityuktā brāhmaṇāḥ patnīnāmānyāśrutya harṣataḥ ।।68।।
bāḍhaṃ bāḍhaṃ tathā kurmo gṛhṇīmo vaidhasīṃ śrutim ।
ājñāṃ bhavanmukhotpannāṃ samānaya pitāmaha ।।69।।
brahmā śrutvā vimānaṃ taccāmbarāt pṛthivīṃ prati ।
āhvayattvāgataṃ śīghraṃ patnyastasmādavātaran ।।2.56.70।।
tāḥ sarvā brahmavākyena nipetuḥ svāmipādayoḥ ।
svāmino jagṛhustāśca premṇā kuśalapūrvakam ।।7 1।।
mahotsavaṃ tadā cakrurhavanaṃ janabhojanam ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tato'jaṃ te vyasarjayan ।।72।।
brahmā vimānago naijaṃ dhāma jagāma satvaram ।
ṛṣipatnyo brahmatejomayyaḥ śuśubhire hyati ।।73।।
evaṃ te daityarūpā vai jātā āsan hi rādhike ।
tatra kaṇo mahān yastu jumāsemlābhidhānakaḥ ।।74।।
rājā'bhūdabriktānāṃ tu deśānāṃ sarvato balī ।
janmato yuddhavettā'straśastrabodhabharo'suraḥ ।।75।।
ākāśe śukrayoge ca marutāṃ sparśasaṃbhavāt ।
vyomagaḥ so'bhavad vāyutulyaścātipratāpavān ।।76।।
anye te'pi kaṇāḥ sarve sarve marutsamāśrayāt ।
vyomagāścā'bhavan daityāste nṛpasya hi sainyapāḥ ।।77।।
astraśastravidaḥ sarve balino'suravartanāḥ ।
tataḥ prajāḥ samabhavan koṭiśaḥ kālavegataḥ ।।78।।
bhrātaraśca bhaginyaśca asahodarajā yadi ।
parasparaṃ hi yujyante vivāhavidhinā tataḥ ।।79।।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ paścimaṃ vai yānaṃ prathamato'bhavat ।
mātṛṇāṃ paścimaṃ yānaṃ tena paścimanamrakāḥ ।।2.56.80।।
paścimaṃ sarvameveme vṛṣaṃ gṛhṇanti sarvadā ।
sumādāyāṃ samutpanno jumāsemlā'bhavannṛpaḥ ।।8 1।।
anye tu sainyapā jātā bahuśastradharā hi te ।
atha mṛtā vimānena saha yuddhe tu te tadā ।।82।।
svargaṃ gatvā punastatra mahāmaroḥ kṣitau punaḥ ।
ṛtadhvajasya putrāṇāṃ putrāste masataḥ surāḥ ।।83।।
bhaviṣyanti jale grāhījaṭhare dhātupānataḥ ।
ṛtadhvajasutāḥ merau kariṣyanti tapaḥ param ।।84।।
tapovighnārthamindraśca preṣayiṣyati pūtanām ।
apsarasaṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā snāntīṃ surūpayauvanām ।।85।।
mandodavāhinīnadyāṃ kṣariṣyanti ca tāpasāḥ ।
taddhātuṃ pāsyati grāhī tatputrā jalajāśca te ।।86।।
marutākhyā bhaviṣyanti vyomamārgānugāḥ surāḥ ।
atha punaḥ pṛthivyāṃ te vapuṣmanto nṛpasya tu ।।87।।
jyotiṣmānnāmakaḥ putrastatpatnyāṃ dharmayoṣiti ।
devācāryasutāyāṃ vai suśroṇyāṃ marutastu te ।।88।।
bhaviṣyanti putrarūpā devā vyomavihāriṇaḥ ।
tataḥ punardantadhvajānmānuṣāttapato bhuvi ।।89।।
homaṃ prakurvato vahnau svaśarīrasya sarvathā ।
vīryabhāgāttato vahneḥ samudbhūtāḥ sutāstadā ।।2.56.90।।
bhaviṣyanti marutaste devā vyomavihāriṇaḥ ।
tataḥ punaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca ripujinnṛpatergṛhe ।।9 1।।
sūryaputryāṃ suratyāṃ ca bhāryāyāṃ maruto hi te ।
mṛtāyāṃ ca citāvahnau bhaviṣyanti surāḥ sutāḥ ।। 92।।
sarve vyomavihārāśca devā daivatayoginaḥ ।
tataḥ punarmaṃkaṇakaṛṣerdhātoḥ prapātanāt ।। 93 ।।
tuṣitāṃ pitṛkanyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā snāntīṃ suyauvanām ।
saptasārasvate tīrthe bhaviṣyanti marudgaṇāḥ ।। 94।।
sarasvatījalebhyaste maruto devatāstadā ।
vyomavihāriṇaḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti ca rādhike ।।95।।
tataḥ punaḥ kaśyapasya patnyāṃ dityāṃ ca te surāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti cendravajrahatāste marutaḥ surāḥ ।। 96।।
daityā api hareryogādevaṃ daityasamudbhavāḥ ।
devavāsā devakāryā devabhāvāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।97।।
bhaviṣyanti tathā sṛṣṭyantare'pyevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ityevaṃ kathito rādhe te'tra marutsamudbhavaḥ ।।98।।
yathā cāsurabhāvāśca yathā devasvabhāvinaḥ ।
ta ete maruto devā uddhṛtāḥ kṛpayā tadā ।। 99।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena paramātmanā ।
abrikte tu pradeśe vai miṣeṇa saṃgarasya ha ।। 2.56.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maruddevānāṃ daityarūpeṇotpattiḥ, punardevatvaprāptiḥ, janmāntarādikathanam, abriktīyamukhyadaityajanmavṛttānta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 56 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 056 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 57
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 058 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
ārabīje gato yastu yamarājaḥ pratāpavān ।
kiṃ cakāra tatastatra kathāṃ kathaya keśava ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ārabīje yamarājo gatvā vyanādayanmuhuḥ ।
bherīṃ raṇakṛtotsāhāṃ vādyāni vividhāni ca ।। 2 ।।
raṇatūryāṇi ca dūtā vyanādayanmuhurmuhuḥ ।
śabdāste dhvanayo vyomni rodasyubhe samāpṛtāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vyomamārgeṇa yamarāṭ ninādayan diśo muhuḥ ।
ājuhāvā'surān deśe'raṇye'drau saṃsthitāँstadā ।। 4 ।।
te ca śrutvā'valokyā'pi saśastrāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
niryayurdaśasāhasrā raktabījo'graṇīstathā ।। 5 ।।
vyomagā jalagāḥ kecit kecidvimānayāyinaḥ ।
kecittu kukkuṭārohāḥ kecitkuñjaravāhanāḥ ।। 6 ।।
kecittu gardabhārohāḥ keciduṣṭrakṛtā''sanāḥ ।
kecidgavayapṛṣṭhasthāḥ kecinmeṣavṛṣāsanāḥ ।। 7 ।।
kecit khaccaravāhāśca kecidghoṭakavāhanāḥ ।
ajapṛṣṭhe sthitāścā'nye mayūrapṛṣṭhasaṃsthitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
kecinmahiṣavāhāśca kecid genḍakapṛṣṭhagāḥ ।
anye ca makarārohā gomāyūrathasaṃsthitāḥ ।। 9 ।।
vṛkavāhāstathā cā'nye sūkarārohiṇaḥ pare ।
gṛdhragarjanapṛṣṭhasthāstathā'nye vāhavarjitāḥ ।। 2.57.1 0।।
sagadāḥ sakṛpāṇāśca sadhanuṣkāḥ sasāyakāḥ ।
samudgaraparighāśca sāsikhaḍgāḥ saśaktikāḥ ।। 1 1।।
satomarāḥ savarmāṇaḥ saśūlāḥ golakā'nvitāḥ ।
sadhūṣkṛtītūpayantrāḥ sakuntāḥ pāśavedinaḥ ।। 12।।
sayaṣṭikāḥ sānalāśca vidyattāraprajālinaḥ ।
māyāpāśadharāścāpi kṣepaṇādisamanvitāḥ ।। 13।।
śarajālayutāścānye dhanurdharā mahābhaṭāḥ ।
niryayuḥ raṇaśabdān vai śrutvā daityāḥ samantataḥ ।। 14।।
apaśyad dānavān sajjān yuddhagān yamarāṭ svayam ।
athā''juhāva ca punaryamarājo'bhidhānakaiḥ ।। 15।।
bho rakta bho ārabīja bho marka bho madānaka ।
bho asīraka bho pegan bho adīna parīmaka ।। 16।।
bho heḍemṛtyo viharina bho hasan vaśarāsura ।
bho irāka damā tuṣka līlābīja trirāśika ।। 17।।
yuddhaṃ kuruta vā yāta pātālaṃ tu nijālayam ।
kathaṃ dattha mahākaṣṭaṃ bakadānarṣisādhave ।। 18।।
phalaṃ dadāmi tūrṇaṃ vo yadīto na prayāsyatha ।
ityuktāste mahāgarvā mahābalaparākramāḥ ।। 19।।
madyamāṃsāśanā duṣṭā matsyakukkuṭabhakṣiṇaḥ ।
vadantaḥ kaṭuśabdāँśca kirantaśca śarotkarān ।। 2.57.20।।
sarve cāyayuravyagrā yamadūtopamāḥ khalāḥ ।
tānāgatān bāṇajālairyānastho'dbhutavikramaḥ ।।21।।
yamaḥ saṃchādayāmāsa svadūtaiḥ saha rādhike ।
evaṃ bāṇairavacchādya sarvāstān dānavān yamaḥ ।। 22।।
pākāsurān jaghānāpi tīkṣgāgrairmārgaṇairyamaḥ ।
tathā'nyān dīnanāmnaśca daityān jaghāna sarvaśaḥ ।।23।।
daityā api mahāśūrā vijaghnuryamapārṣadān ।
nārācaistomarairvidyudyantraiḥ śaktyādibhistadā ।।24।।।
ṛṣṭibhirbhindipālaiśca parighaiśca gadādibhiḥ ।
golakaiḥ parvataiścāpi vṛkṣaiḥ śṛṃgaiḥ śilādibhiḥ ।।25।।
hastibhirghoṭakaiścāpi nijaghnuryamakiṃkarān ।
dūtāḥ śailasamā daityān jaghnuścātyati jīvataḥ ।।26।।
raktabījo jaghānorau gadayā tvativegataḥ ।
śṛṃgavantaṃ yamadūtaṃ vyanadacca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 27।।
dūto'pi tāṃ gadāṃ dhṛtvā raktabījaṃ ca mastake ।
jaghāna cātivegena daityo mūrchāmavāpa ha ।। 28।।
dvitīyāṃ ca gadāṃ dhṛtvā bahubhārāṃ yamānugaḥ ।
āvidhya cāmbare gurvī mumoca raktabījake ।। 29।।।
tāvadvai raktakastāmāyāntīṃ saṃgṛhya cāmbare ।
śṛṃgavantaṃ prati śīghraṃ mumoca līlayā yathā ।।2.57.3 0।।
dūto dhṛtvā gadāṃ naijāṃ śatabāṇairhi raktakam ।
bhedayāmāsa bahudhā kṣurapraiśca śilīmukhaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
śuśubhe raktakastatra palāśaḥ puṣpavān yathā ।
raktabījastu tāvadvai samutthāya nijāyudham ।। 32।।
śaktiṃ śatapraghaṇṭāṃ ca prāhiṇot śṛṃgakaṃ yamam ।
śailapādo yamaḥ śaktimutplutya drutamambare ।।3 3।।
haste dhṛtvā mumocaiva raktabījasya vakṣasi ।
śṛṃgavāँśca gadāṃ tasya mumoconmathya mastake ।।34।।
yugapattvāgate roddhuṃ samartho nā'bhavad yataḥ ।
śakteḥ rarakṣa cātmānaṃ tāvad gadā mahattamā ।।35।।
śailasamā brahmarandhre papātā'tīva vegataḥ ।
dvedhā'bhavat kaṭāhaṃ ca śirasaḥ so'patadbhuvi ।।36।।
daityā ninyurhi taṃ dūraṃ raktabījaṃ mahābalam ।
ārabījastadā śaktiṃ mumoca śailapādake ।। 37।।
vahnibhāṃ śataghaṇṭāṃ ca svarṇapaṭṭābhibhūṣitām ।
śṛṃgavān tāṃ parigṛhya gadāṃ mumoca āyasīm ।।38।।
śailapādo mahāśaktiṃ mumoca vegatastathā ।
gadayā tāḍito mūrdhni śaktyā bhinnastathorasi ।।3 9।।
ārabījo mamārā'tra vyasuḥ krandan kṣaṇāntare ।
atha markastathā madānakaścetyubhayā'surau ।।2.57.40।।
śṛṃgasyāpi vināśāya dudruvatuśca raṃhasā ।
tadā dūtaḥ śailapādaścārkahanustadāvubhau ।।41।।
dudruvaturgade dhṛtvā vyanādayatāṃ rodasī।
sānnidhye ca gadāyuddhaṃ prāvartata parasparam ।।42।।
brahmāṇḍakṣayakārāśca ghātaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
candrakarṇo'pi dūtastaṃ madānakamamārayat ।।43।।
arkahanustadā markaṃ daityaṃ śaktyā vyapothayat ।
śailapādaśca nārācairandhracandraiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ ।।44।।
kṣurapraiścātitīkṣṇaiśca śarairbibheda dānavān ।
markahastau skandhabhāgāccicched bahulīlayā ।।45।।
madānakasya ca pādau ciccheda sakthimūlataḥ ।
karapādān vinā jāto markamadānakāvubhau ।।46।।
tau parityajya ca tadā jayaśabdān jaguryamāḥ ।
asīrako mahādaityo badhīrakeṇa yāminā ।।47।।
pegan daityaścāgnimālābhidhena tu yamena ca ।
yuyudhāte hi nārācaiḥ vavṛṣatuḥ śarān bahūn ।।48।।
ākāśaṃ chāditaṃ bāṇaistadā nārācavṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
daityānāṃ dhanurāmuktaiḥ sahasrāyutakoṭibhiḥ ।।49।।
agnimālo badhīraśca dūtau vyomacarau tadā ।
vahnimutpādya bāṇaughān jvālayāmāsaturdrutam ।।2.57.50।।
badhīrako mahāśailo'bhavadvai pañcayojanaḥ ।
papātāsīrake peganyapi tau cūrṇito mṛtau ।।51 ।।
adīnāsurakastatra dhṛtvā tomaramujjvalam ।
vikaṭāsyaṃ yamaṃ vegājjaghānorasi dūrataḥ ।।52।।
parīmako'suraścāpi nāḍīghātaṃ yamaṃ tadā ।
madgalenā'bhisampadya tāḍayāmāsa nirbhayaḥ ।।53 ।।
heḍemṛtyuḥ kāladaṃṣṭraṃ yamaṃ tatāḍa vai balāt ।
parighena mahāśailaśṛṃganibhena corasi ।।54।।
ākāśe uḍḍayāmāsustrayaste tu mahāsurāḥ ।
vegenoḍḍīya ca dūtān mārayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।।55।।
tadā tvete trayo dūtāstathā'nye ṣaṭ mahābalāḥ ।
militā nava cākāśe jaghnustryasurakān śaraiḥ ।।56 ।।
gadābhirmudgaraiścāpi mahādaṇḍaiśca parvataiḥ ।
nipetuste trayo bhagnaśirogrīvoruvakṣasaḥ ।।57।।
vyasavaḥ samajāyanta dūtāstatrā'nadaँstadā ।
atha daityo vihārī ca hasā ca vaśarāsuraḥ ।।58।।
militvā te trayo jaghnurlambanāsaṃ yamaṃ tadā ।
sahāyā rodanaścāpi narmakaścādrimālakaḥ ।।59।।
gadāḥ śaktīstathā ṛṣṭīrdhṛtvotpetustadāmbare ।
daityān trīn pothayāmāsurnipatyotpatya mārataḥ ।।2.57.6 0।।
lambanāso yamaḥ pāśairvihāriṇaṃ babandha ha ।
gadayā mārayāmāsa vyasuṃ kṣaṇāttadā'karot ।।6 1।।
rodano gadayā mūrdhni tatāḍa vaśarāsuram ।
triśūlaṃ mārayāmāsa vakṣasyeva balādati ।।62।।
protaṃ pṛṣṭhe jagāmedaṃ vaśaro'pi mṛto'bhavat ।
hasānaṃ narmakaścāpi dūto mamāra bhallakaiḥ ।।63 ।।
hasā kaṇṭhe vibhinnaśca pādo kṣiptvā mamāra ha ।
ilākasya tato yuddhaṃ cā'drimālayamena ca ।।64।।
damanasya mahāyuddhaṃ mohapāśayamena tu ।
tuṣkadaityasyāpi yuddhaṃ kālakarṇayamena vai ।।65।।
līlābījasya daityasya mardahastayamena ca ।
bahubhirhetibhiścāsīd bhayānakaṃ ca nirdayam ।।66।।
daityāstaṃ muśalairjadhnuryamān yamāśca mudgaraiḥ ।
muśalā mudgarā bhagnā vajralepanibheṣu vai ।।67।।
tataste gadayā vyomni yodhayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।
cūrṇībhūtā gadāstatra gadābhireva tatra ca ।।68।।
atha śaktīḥ samādāya nijaghnuste mahāruṣā ।
anyonyaśaktīrāgṛhya bhaṃktvā cikṣipurambare ।।69।।
atha parvataśṛṃgaiśca nijaghnurdānavāstadā ।
yamā vajraiḥ śailaśṛṃgāṇyadārayaँśca līlayā ।।2.57.70।।
atha bāṇaiśca bhallaiśca triśūlairbahuvegibhiḥ ।
nijaghnurmāraṇārthāste parasparaṃ ghṛṇāṃ vinā ।।71 ।।
dhṛtvā saṃgṛhya hetīṃśca bhaṃktvā bhaṃktvā parasparam ।
cikṣipurbhūtale sarve bāṇairbāṇāँśca cicchiduḥ ।।72।।
atha śastrāṇi santyajya mūḍhamārairamārayan ।
muṣṭāmuṣṭi nijaghnuśca kaṇṭhākaṇṭhi hyamardayan ।।73।।
pādāpādi tathā keśākeśi yuddhamabhūttadā ।
adrimālayamaḥ pṛthvyāmilākaṃ saṃnipātya ca ।।74।।
mohapāśo damanaṃ cāsuraṃ nipātya vai bhuvi ।
kālakarṇastuṣkadaityaṃ nipātya bhuvi cāmbarāt ।।75।।
mardahasto'pi ca līlābījaṃ nipātya bhūtale ।
vāyutulyabalairdaityān niṣpīḍyorassu jānubhiḥ ।।76 ।।
vakṣo'sthnāṃ te pracakruśca cūrṇāni kaṇaśastadā ।
ākruśyā''kruśya ca prāṇāँstatyajuḥ raṇadurmadāḥ ।।77।।
yatra niṣpīḍitā dūtaiḥ pṛthvyāṃ tatrā'bhavan bharaiḥ ।
gartā yojanavistārā yāmyaghātairmuhurmuhuḥ ।।78।।
nadā raktapravāhāśca jalaṃ raktaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
śailābhadaityadehānāṃ rudhirairbhūstadā'ruṇā ।।79।।
samajāyata raktābhā rādhike hi raṇāṃgaṇe ।
athā'nye daityavaryāśca pāko dīnastrirāśikaḥ ।।2.57.8 0 ।।
alīthakaḥ śirodhāśca piṇḍitāyaśca vāyujaḥ ।
trithuko baṃsuraścordhvamīnaśceti tadagragāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
yuyudhuśca yamaiḥ sārdhaṃ bindumālādibhistadā ।
garvagaṃjo yamastaṃ tu bindumālo vibhūtikaḥ ।।82।।
gaḍeḍaḥ khañjanaścāpi haḍeḍo bhaṣakānanaḥ ।
śārdūlo dhaḍaghātaśca kaṭakaṭo dahanāśanaḥ ।।8 3 ।।
ityevamādyāḥ saṃjaghnurdaityān dāruṇagarvakān ।
uddhatyoddhṛtya ca pṛthvyāṃ tāḍayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।84।।
bhedayāmāsurevaitānāsurān sakthimadhyataḥ ।
pāṭayāmāsurevaitān dvedhā nitambamadhyataḥ ।।85।।।
mṛtāste ye hastagatā yamānāṃ sarva eva ha ।
anye dūrād vaidiśāsyā dudruvurjīvanārthakāḥ ।।86।।
daityasainyamabhūd raṃkaṃ hatotsāhaṃ vināyakam ।
khaṇḍitaṃ chinnabhinnaṃ ca jitaprāyaṃ samantataḥ ।।87।।
tadā dadhmuryamadūtāḥ śaṃkhān bherīn bigūlakān ।
vijayena tu sarve te vītaklamāḥ sukhānanāḥ ।।88 ।।
nṛtyantaśca hasantaśca hāsayanto'bhavan sukhāḥ ।
raktabījo vilokyaivaṃ vijayaṃ yāmyabhāgagam ।।89।।
parājayaṃ nijaṃ vīkṣya vrīḍānamro'bhavat kṣaṇam ।
atha sainyaṃ dhāvamānaṃ rurodha raṇavādyakaiḥ ।। 2.57.90 ।।
raṇasaṃketaśabdaiśca vārayāmāsa sainyapān ।
svayaṃ gajaṃ samāruhya yuddhārthaṃ cā'grago'bhavat ।। 91 ।।
tāvat sainyaṃ sainyapāścāpyabhyadhāvan suroṣiṇaḥ ।
yamarājaṃ cāmbare te vimānasyā'bhitaḥ kṣaṇāt ।। 92।।
parivavrurvināśārthaṃ jagṛhuryamarājakam ।
yathā pataṅgakoṭyaśca śukakoṭyaśca pañjaram ।। 93 ।।
tathā dānavayūthāni dadhruryameśvaraṃ kṣaṇāt ।
vimānaṃ dṛśyate naiva daityābbhrācchāditaṃ tadā ।। 94।।
yamarājaḥ svayaṃ krodhāt kāladaṇḍaṃ mumoca ha ।
daṇḍād daṇḍā vyajāyanta śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ । ।95। ।
yaṃ daityaṃ spṛśati drāk ca daṇḍayogāt sa naśyati ।
bhasma bhavati tatraiva nā'sthi cāpyavaśiṣyate ।। 96 ।।
evaṃ vai bahusāhasrā hatā daityāstadā'mbare ।
yamadaṇḍena saṃdagdhā yayuryāmyagṛhāṇi te ।। 97।।
ye jijīviṣavaste tu dṛṣṭvā nāśaṃ kṣaṇāntare ।
dudruvuśca yayuḥ sarve tyaktvā pātālameva ca ।। 98 ।।
putrapautrān sutān patnīḥ paśūn pakṣiṇa ityapi ।
naijāṃ susampadaṃ yogyāṃ nītvā pātālamāviśan ।। 99।।
raktabījo mṛtaścāpi punaḥ kālāntare hi saḥ ।
dhundhurnāmnā mahādaityo bhaviṣyatīti rādhike ।। 2.57.100 ।।
anye daityāstatsahāyā bhaviṣyanti yugāntare ।
atharṣirbakadānaśca jñātvā cāsuranāśanam ।। 101 ।।
jalādbahirvinirgatya dharmarājaṃ samāgamat ।
satkāraṃ tvakaroccāpi praśaṃsāmakarottathā ।। 1 02।।
rakṣārthaṃ tvarthayad dūtaṃ dharmarājo dadau yadā ।
aravaṃ nāma dūtaṃ svaṃ dadau dūtīṃ tathā'ravīm ।। 103 ।।
śatadāsān śatadāsīrdadau rakṣārthameva ca ।
bakadānāśrame te ca tāśca vāsaṃ samādadhuḥ ।। 1 04।।
āravā nāma putrāśca yuge'yutāstato'bhavan ।
ayutāśca tataḥ putryo'bhavan dūtīprasaṃgajāḥ ।। 1 05।।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ prajāstatrā'bhavan koṭyadhikāstataḥ ।
evaṃ vai rādhike tatra yamo vināśya dānavān ।। 1 06।।
rājyaṃ datvā svadūtāya muneḥ rakṣāṃ vidhāya ca ।
yayau vimānamāruhya cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।। 1 07।।
yamarājo dvitīyena svarūpeṇa bhaṭaiḥ saha ।
vaiṣṇavairvaiṣṇavo bhūtvā nyavasat kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 1 08।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā saṃsnāpya kiṃkarān ।
mahāprāsādamākṛtvā tīrthāvāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 1 09।।
rudro rudragaṇaiḥ sākaṃ nāradaḥ sanatā saha ।
svasvā''vāsān pracakruste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā ।। 2.57.110 ।।
dvāsaptatisahasrakanyakāḥ snātā harergṛhe ।
natvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ satkṛtā bhojitāstataḥ ।। 11 1।।
kāntājñayā lomaśasyāśrame. tasthurnirantaram ।
vimānaṃ sarvadā cāste yautakānvitameva ca ।। 11 2।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasyodyāne divyaṃ divaṃ yathā ।
kanyāstāḥ pūrvakāmāśca jātā dṛṣṭvā harergṛham ।। 113 ।।
yasya koṇe vimānaṃ tat parilīyeta tādṛśam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādetaccaritraṃ puṇyavān bhavet ।। 1 14।।
vighnanāśo bhavettasya mālinyaṃ parinaśyati ।
dharmarājasya dūtebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yamarājadvārā raktabījādidaśasāhasradaityānāṃ vināśaḥ, aravākhyadūtāya rājyadānaṃ bakadānaṛṣirakṣā
āravavaṃśodbhavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 57 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 58
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 059 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
ko'yamāsīd raktabījo'suraḥ kṛṣṇa purā bhave ।
kathaṃ punaḥ sa sañjāto dhundhuḥ kaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu vai rādhike pūrvasṛṣṭyutthāṃ sukathāṃ śubhām ।
pūrvakalpe gate rātrau mahāmatsyo narāyaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
jale śṛṃge svake kṛtvā nāvaṃ satyavatā yutam ।
bījāni lokarakṣārthaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭyarthamityapi ।। 3 ।।
nāvi dhṛtvā vicacāra prāleyajalamastake ।
tatra prātarjalotpanno mahāmatsyo'bdhijastadā ।। 4 ।।
nārāyaṇena matsyena yoddhuṃ tatra samāgataḥ ।
nausthān bījān bhakṣayituṃ samicchan yuyudhe tadā ।। '9 ।।
nārāyaṇena matsyena dhṛtaṃ sudarśanaṃ tadā ।
muktaṃ matsyasya śirasi dvedhā matsyo babhūva ha ।। 6 ।।
tasya raktakaṇājjātā matsyā jale tu koṭiśaḥ ।
cakravidāryamāṇasya cābdhimatsyasya vai tadā ।। 7 ।।
raktasya bindavo dehāduḍḍīya nāvamāgatāḥ ।
keṣucitteṣu bījeṣu lagnāste bhūbhṛtā tadā ।। 8 ।।
prātareva ca naukāto bahiḥ kṣiptā jale yadā ।
daśasāhasrasaṃkhyāste raktabījā hi rākṣasāḥ ।। 9 ।।
drāgeva tu jale tatra samutpannā nisargataḥ ।
matsyaputrāstu te sarve sāmudrajalavāsinaḥ ।। 2.58.1 0।।
dvīpaṃ ca mārgayāmāsuḥ śāśvatāvāsamucchrayam ।
tāvajjalaṃ tu prāleyaṃ prātaryātaṃ hi śuṣkatām ।। 1 1।।
saśailā pṛthivī tatrā'dṛśyatā'pāṃ sumadhyagā ।
matsyāvatāro bhagavān satyavantaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ।। 1 2।।
bījānāṃ vapanaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kurvityājñāpya vai kṣaṇāt ।
tirobabhūva sahasā rājā'pi bījaśevadhim ।। 13।।
pṛthvyāṃ jale'mbare vāyau nicikṣepa ca tejasi ।
prakṣipya sarvabījāni nāvaṃ tatyāja vai jale ।। 14।।
naukāyā aranaddheṣu kāṣṭheṣu ca vraṇeṣu ca ।
yāni sūkṣmāṇi bījāni lagnānyāsan hi tāni tu ।। 15।।
bhakṣayituṃ dudruvuśca raktabījā hi rākṣasāḥ ।
nāvamāruhya te sūkṣmabījānyabhakṣayaṃstadā ।। 16।।
tadbhakṣaṇāt samutpannā bālakā ārabījakāḥ ।
bālikāśca tathā jātā ārabījyaḥ suyauvanāḥ ।। 17।।
teṣu sarveṣu jāteṣu naukā'pyadṛśyatāṃ gatā ।
raktabījaprajāḥ sarvā ārabījāhvayāśca tāḥ ।। 18।।
kāmarūpadharā vyomavihārāśca nirāśrayāḥ ।
uḍḍīya jaladheḥ pṛthvyāṃ nivāsāँścāpyamārgayan ।। 1 9।।
yatrā'smākaṃ bhaved vāso jalaṃ ca parito bhavet ।
tatparitaśca pṛthivī bhaveccāpi vanādikam ।।2.58.20।।
raṇamaraṇyamanujā bījapuṣpaphalāni ca ।
gahvarāṇi vicitrāṇi bhaveyuryatra sarvataḥ ।।21 ।।
tatra vastavyamasmābhiriti matvā ca tādṛśam ।
bhūtalaṃ raktabījairhi tatprajābhiśca sarvathā ।।22।।
ārabījaiḥ svīkṛtaṃ sadbhūtalaṃ dvīpakalpakam ।
raktabījo mahān rājā matsyabījodbhavaḥ purā ।।23 ।।
tatprajānāṃ tadā jātastatastadudbhavo nṛpaḥ ।
ārabījo mahān rājā'bhavad devavirodhakṛt ।। 24।।
taṃ hatvā yamarājastu rājyaṃ nijānugāya vai ।
aravāya dadau samyagṛṣīṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।।25।।
raktabījo hato yuddhe yamalokaṃ jagāma ha ।
tatra karmabhogān kaśyapasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ ।।26।।
danorgabhasamudbhūto dhundhunāmā bhaviṣyati ।
brahmāṇaṃ tapasā''rādhya surā'vadhyatvameṣyati ।।27।।
svargaṃ vijeṣyati drāk ca svayaṃ śakro bhaviṣyati ।
āsuraṃ tu tadā rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati triviṣṭape ।।28।।
tridaśā brahmalokaṃ ca gamiṣyantyasya vai bhayāt ।
dhundhurvakṣyati daityāँśca bho daityā hi kathaṃ vayam ।। 29।।।
vrajema satyalokaṃ saṃvijetuṃ tridaśādikān ।
daityā niśamya vakṣyanti na no gatirhi tatra vai ।।2.58.3 0।।
ito loko mahaścāste maharṣigaṇasevitaḥ ।
yoṣāṃ dṛṣṭryā ca dahyanti daityāḥ saroṣakekṣaṇaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tataḥ paro janaloko janā devā vasantyatha ।
tatastapastataḥ satyo yatra brahmaparā sthitāḥ ।।32।।
yoṣāṃ vedadhvaniṃ śrutvā vikasanti surādayaḥ ।
saṃkocamasurā yānti ye ca teṣāṃ sadharmiṇaḥ ।।33।।
tasmānmā tvaṃ mahābāho tatra gantuṃ samādadhaḥ ।
vairājyabhavanaṃ kṣubdho durārohaṃ tu dānavaiḥ ।। 34।।
teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā dhundhurdaityān pravakṣyati ।
gantukāmaḥ sa sadanaṃ brahmaṇo jetumīśvarān ।। 39।।
kena tu karmaṇā, kathaṃ gamyate, tatra dānavāḥ ।
indraḥ kathaṃ prayātyeva daivāḥ prayānti vai katham ।।36 ।।
vadatā'tra ca me daityāḥ kurmā vayaṃ tu tattathā ।
tato daityaguruḥ śukraḥ kathayiṣyati sādhanam ।।37।।
sahasrākṣaḥ śataṃ caikaṃ yajñānāmayajat purā ।
śreṣṭhānāṃ vājimedhānāṃ tena brahmasadogatiḥ ।।38।।
śukravākyaṃ niśamyātha yajñān sa vai kariṣyati ।
śukramāmantrya ca daityān dānavān vasudhāṃ prati ।।39।।
gamiṣyati saricchreṣṭhā devikāṃ siddhidāṃ tataḥ ।
saṃvidhāsyati yajñāṃśca bhārgavaiḥ śukraśiṣyakaiḥ ।।2.58.40।।
yajñabhāgabhujastatra svarbhānupramukhāstadā ।
bhaviṣyanti hayatrātā'gnidhūmā'sura eva ca ।।41।।
vicariṣyati pṛthvyāṃ ca gandho yāsyati vai divam ।
ghrātvā devā viṣaṇṇāśca pravakṣyanti tu vedhasam ।।42।।
savedhaso gamiṣyanti kṣīrasthaṃ parameśvaram ।
vijñaptiṃ ca kariṣyanti śrūyatāṃ vai janārdana ।।43।।
dhundhunāmā'surapatirbalavān balasaṃvṛtaḥ ।
trailokyādhipatiścāste nastrātā naiva vidyate ।।44।।
sāmprataṃ brahmalokasthānapi jetuṃ samudyataḥ ।
śukrasya matamādāya yajate ca śatakratūn ।।45।।
āroḍhumicchati satyalokaṃ jetuṃ ca vedhasam ।
tasmādakālahīnaṃ ca cintayasva pareśvara ।।46 ।।
upāyaṃ yajñanāśe ca yena syāma sunirvṛtāḥ ।
śrutvā vakṣyati bhagavān yūyaṃ gacchatha ketanam ।।47।।
gacchāmyahaṃ vijetuṃ tamityuktvā ca gamiṣyati ।
bhagavān vāmano bhūtvā snāsyati devikājale ।।48।।
patiṣyati devikāyā jale yajñasya sannidhau ।
kṣaṇānmajjaँstathaunmajjan jalaceṣṭāṃ kariṣyati ।।49।।
yajñīyāśca nimajjatītyevaṃ matvā drutaṃ ca tam ।
uddhartuṃ ca prayāsyanti samuddhārya taṭasthitam ।।2.58.50।।
vāmanaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca prakṣyanti dhundhuṛtvijaḥ ।
kastvaṃ kasmāt samāyātaḥ kathaṃ kiṃ te prayojanam ।।5 1 ।।
tadā vakṣyati vipraḥ sa duḥkhyahaṃ gṛhavarjitaḥ ।
mama pitā prabhāsākhyo gotreṇāpi tu vāruṇaḥ ।।52।।
mama bhrātā netrabhāso gatibhāso'hameva ca ।
ramyaṃ cāvasathaṃ tyaktvā pitā nau ca mṛtastataḥ ।।53।।
varṣānte cāgrajaścokto vibhajāma gṛhaṃ ca nau ।
tenoktau naiva bhavato vidyate bhāga ityaham ।।54।।
kubjavāmanakhañjānāṃ klībānāṃ śvitriṇāmapi ।
unmattānāṃ tathā'ndhānāṃ dāyabhāgo na vidyate ।।55।।
priyaṃ vākyaṃ gṛhe vāso bhojanācchādanādikam ।
etāvad dīyate tebhyo dāyabhāgaharā na te ।।56।।
tataḥ kleśena mahatā niṣkāsito'smi tadgṛhāt ।
yajñaṃ śrutvā samāyāto snātuṃ jale praveśavān ।।57।।
nimajjito yataścāhaṃ na jāne hyavatāraṇam ।
ke bhavanto'tra samprāptāḥ sasnehā bāndhavā yathā ।।58।।।
ko'yaṃ śakrapratikāśo yuṣmanmadhye vibhāsate ।
anukampāṃ prakurvantu yadyāśrayo'tra labhyate ।।59।।
iti vai vāmanavākyaṃ śrutvā viprāśca dhundhukam ।
pravakṣyanti ca dānārthaṃ dhundhurdāsyati śobhanam ।।2.58.60।।
śrīmadāvasathaṃ dāsī ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
sarvopaskarayogāँśca dāsān gā vāhanāni ca ।।6 1 ।।
hiraṇyaṃ syandanānaśvān gajān tathāpi vāmanaḥ ।
na grahīṣyati vibhavān sādhudharmaṃ vadaँstadā ।।62।।
dāsīrdāsāँśca bhṛtyāँśca gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ paricchadān ।
tyaktvā padatrayaṃ bhūmyāsanaṃ setsyati vai tadā ।।63।।
dhundhurdāsyati bhūbhāgaṃ padatrayaṃ yadā tataḥ ।
vairājarūpamāsthāya padaikena mahīmimām ।।64।।
dvitīyena kaṭāhaṃ ca tṛtīyena ca dānavam ।
grahīṣyati haristaṃ ca pātāle'dho nayiṣyati ।।65।।
devebhyaśca nijaṃ rājyaṃ datvā'dṛśyo bhaviṣyati ।
punarbalervardhitasya rājyaṃ kharvo hariṣyati ।।66।।
atha dhundhurandhakasya sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyati ।
andhakasya mahāyuddhaṃ śaṃkareṇa bhaviṣyati ।।67।।
śukrācāryaṃ tadā śaṃbhurmukhe prakṣipya codare ।
dhṛtvā punaśca śiśnena tadā niṣkāsayiṣyati ।।68।।
śukrarūpaḥ śukranāmnā śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati ।
athendhakena yoddhu ca mahendro'pi gamiṣyati ।।69।।
mūrdhni vajraṃ paribhrāmyā'ndhakaṃ yadā haniṣyati ।
andhakasya śirasyeva vajraṃ cūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।2.58.70।।
vahnistasmai tadā śaktiṃ dāsyatyeva bhayaṃkarām ।
tathā ca devagandharvā rathaṃ dāsyanti svastikam ।।71।।
śamīkasya ṛṣeḥ patnī bālaṃ tadā tu bhūtale ।
pṛthivyāṃ kampamānāyāṃ sthāpayiṣyati vai tadā ।।72।।
bālau dvāvekataścaiva bhaviṣyatastadā tayoḥ ।
eko vai mātalirnāmā gamiṣyati mahendrakam ।।73।।
tadā sa sārathirbhūtvā sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyati ।
rudrastadā mahendraśca tathā'nye devatāḥ saha ।।74।।
mārayiṣyantyaṃdhakaṃ ca śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
śaṃkarasya lalāṭordhvād gadāghātena bindavaḥ ।।75।।
raktasyāpi patiṣyanti bhaviṣyanti ca bhairavāḥ ।
vidyārājo rudrarājaścaṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍa ityapi ।।76।।
kapālyekakapālī ca tathā lalitarājakaḥ ।
vighnarājo'ṣṭamaścāpi bhairavāste tadodbhavāḥ ।।77।।
lalāṭaphalakācchaṃbhoḥ kanyāścaikā bhaviṣyati ।
carccikā nāmataḥ sādhvī hiṅgulādrinivāsinī ।।78।।
athā'ndhakaṃ mārayitvā bhṛṃgināmagaṇaṃ svakam ।
kariṣyati śaṃkarastaṃ tato dhundhurbhayānvitaḥ ।।79।।
pātālaṃ yāsyati śīghraṃ tataḥ kālāntare punaḥ ।
baleḥ sāhāyyatāṃ yadā kariṣyati tadā hariḥ ।।2.58.80 ।।
sudarśanena ca dhundhuṃ mārayiṣyati jīvataḥ ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe raktabījakathānakam ।।8 1 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ kṛṣṇa jalamatsyo viṣṇucakreṇa ghātitaḥ ।
pavitratāṃ gato naiva yadvaṃśe rākṣasā yataḥ ।।82।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
viṣṇucakraparicchinno jalamatsyastu rādhike ।
gatapāpo'bhavacchīghraṃ svarge mahendratāṃ gataḥ ।।83।।
ādyaḥ sa eva saṃkalpajanyo'bhūd devatāpatiḥ ।
ādyayugapravṛttyarthaṃ tataḥ pṛthvyāmavātarat ।।84।।
viṣṇubhakto'bhavalloke suvarṇāṃgadaviśrutaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'timānavaḥ ।।85।।
tato dhāma yayau divyaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇasya rādhike ।
atha ye raktabījāśca ārabījādayastathā ।।86।।
te sarve bījahantāraḥ sṛṣṭyādau cā'bhavan yataḥ ।
satyavratasya śāpena rākṣasatvamapāgatāḥ ।।87।।
ādibījaprahantāraścā'labhyavastunāśakāḥ ।
mahāpāpā'tipāpāste yato vaṃśavināśakāḥ ।।88।।
vicāryetthaṃ tadā rājā śaśāpaitān vighātakān ।
bījaghātaprakartāraścāsurā vai bhaviṣyatha ।।89।।
ityevamāsurā jātā yataścāsurabhāvanāḥ ।
pakṣyaṇḍānāṃ kalalāderbhakṣakā rākṣasā hi te ।। 2.58.90।।
paśubījaprahantāro rajovīryavināśakāḥ ।
bījakośaprahantārastāmasāste'surā matāḥ ।।91।।
alabhyabījaghāte tu mahat pāpaṃ prajāyate ।
prathamaṃ pārvatī devī śaṃkarasya samāgame ।।92।।
bījalabdheravasare devairvighnavatī kṛtā ।
śaśāpa dayitā sādhvī duḥkhitenā'ntarātmanā ।।93 ।।
devā me garbhavāñcchāyā ghātakāḥ svārthasiddhaye ।
bījadāne ghātakā vai yato jātā haraṃ prati ।।94।।
aputrā'hamagarbhā'haṃ kṛtā yuṣmābhirityataḥ ।
bhavanto'pi hyaputrāśca bhavatpatnyo'pyagarbhikāḥ ।।95।।
anapatyāḥ sadā santu iti devān śaśāpa sā ।
tasmādvai rādhike pāpaṃ prathamaṃ bījaghātanam ।। 96।।
tato'pyadhikapāpaṃ ca striyā vai ṛtughātanam ।
tato'pyatyadhikaṃ pāpaṃ garbhahatyā prakathyate ।।97।।
sarvebhyaścolbaṇaṃ pāpaṃ bālakasya vināśanam ।
sadyo vivāhitayośca ghātanaṃ pāpakoṭikam ।।98।।
sagarbhāghātanaṃ pāpaṃ pāpakoṭyarbudā'dhikam ।
asamāpte tu mithune ghātanaṃ sṛṣṭighātajam ।।99।।
pāpaṃ vai jāyate tasmād bījaghnā noddharanti vai ।
brahmacārivrataṃ tasmāt puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam ।। 2.58.100 ।।
yatra bījaṃ na hanyeta rakṣyate tu svabhāvataḥ ।
rakṣaṇasya mahatpuṇyaṃ dharmeṇā'pi pradānakam ।। 101 ।।
mahat puṇyaṃ svayaṃ brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivo jaguḥ sadā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike coktaṃ rākṣasatve hi kāraṇam ।। 1 02।।।
bījaghnānāṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭeḥ pathaṃ prayāti na ।
yamadvārā vināśaśca teṣāṃ karitavān prabhuḥ ।। 1 03।।
ṛtudānaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ suroditam ।
vaṃśadānaṃ cātipuṇyaṃ vaṃśakṛtāṃ prakīrtitam ।। 1 04।।
nirvaṃśā noddharantyeva saṃsārā'bdhi taranti na ।
savaṃśāḥ pitarastṛptāḥ samuddharanti sāgarāt ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne raktabījā''rabījādyasurotpattirdhundhudaityotpattirbījanāśātmakapātaka-
mityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। ।58 ।।
