adhyāyaḥ 59
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 060 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike caitre vyatīte'tha dvitīyakam ।
caritraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva pramokṣadam ।। 1 ।।
bhālladeśa iti khyāto deśo vaiṣṇavasatkṛtaḥ ।
dhavalaṃ nāma nagaraṃ khyātaṃ sthānīyamuttamam ।। 2 ।।
tasmin vipaṇivṛttistho godhanākhyo'bhavad vaṇika ।
dhanapūrṇo buddhimāँśca kalākauśalyapāragaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sa kadācinnijād rāṣṭrāt saurāṣṭraṃ gantumudyataḥ ।
viśālasārthasampanno bahupaṇyādisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 4 ।।
gacchatastasya vai rātrau caurāṇāṃ saṃgamo'bhavat ।
jalahīne śuṣkabhāge jālikaikatarau sthale ।। 5 ।।
tataḥ sa hṛtasarvasvo vaṇik śokāturaḥ sadā ।
bhramannitastato yāyājjālikāvṛkṣasannidhau ।। 6 ।।
mṛgaiśca pakṣibhiḥ kīṭairvarjitāṃ vīkṣya jālikām ।
kṣāntaḥ kṣuttṛṭśuṣkakaṇṭho vṛkṣapārśvamupāgamat ।। 7 ।।
upāviveśa ca supto viśrānto viśramo'bhavat ।
madhyāhne cotthito yāvattāvat pretaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 8 ।।
śataiḥ pretairvṛtaṃ pretairuhyamānaṃ sukhāsane ।
āgacchadbhirjālikāyāstaruṃ pretaiḥ samantataḥ ।। 9 ।।
yatrā''sīt sa vaṇikputrastaṃ ca vṛkṣaṃ samāgataḥ ।
pretarājo dadarśainaṃ vaṇikputraṃ sthirāntaram ।। 2.59.10 ।।
svāgataṃ kṛtavān preto vaṇik cāpi tathā'karot ।
kuśalaṃ sarvamābhāṣya cābhivādya parasparam ।। 11 ।।
vaṇikpretau copaviṣṭau chāyāyāṃ sukhatastataḥ ।
pretādhipatinā pṛṣṭaṃ kuta āgamyate vaṇik ।। 1 2।।
kva vāso vidyate kutra gamiṣyasi sthalāditaḥ ।
kathaṃ cedaṃ nirjanaṃ ca sthalaṃ tvayā samāśritam ।। 1 3।।
itipṛṣṭo vaṇik prāha dhanayukto'pyahaṃ vane ।
caurairhṛtadhano jātaḥ paryaṭāmyatiduḥkhitaḥ ।। 14।।।
vaṇigduḥkhena tu pretaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vai duḥkhito'bhavat ।
svabandhumiva vaṇijaṃ prāha śokaṃ tu mā kuru ।। 15।।
bhūyo'pyarthā bhaviṣyanti yadi bhāgyabalaṃ tava ।
bhāgyakṣaye'rthāḥ kṣīyante bhavantyabhyudaye punaḥ ।। 16 ।।
kṣīṇasyā'sya śarīrasya cintayā nodayo bhavet ।
abhyudayaśca patanaṃ ravernityaṃ prajāyate ।। 17।।
vṛkṣāṇāṃ śuṣkatā cāpi punaḥ pallavitā'pi ca ।
pakṣe tejasvitā candre pakṣe tejaḥkṣayastathā ।। 18।।
nadīnāṃ śuṣkatā grīṣme varṣāyāṃ jalapūrṇatā ।
kṣetrāṇāṃ sasyasampattiḥ kvacit sasyavihīnatā ।। 1 9।।
netraṃ mlānaṃ sanidraṃ tu kvacitpadmadalotsavam ।
gaganaṃ cā''vilaṃ kāle kāle nirmalamujjvalam ।।2.59.20 ।।
pradīpo rātrau jvalati divā tejaḥ karoti na ।
kvacid rājā kvacicchreṣṭhī kvacit kaiṃkaryavān bhavet ।। 21 ।।
kvacicchāstā kvacicchāsyaḥ kvacit koṭidvayojjhitaḥ ।
kvacillakṣmīpatiḥ śrīmān kvacillakṣmīvivarjitaḥ ।। 22।।
bālye tu dehinaḥ sarve naisargādaparigrahāḥ ।
yauvane tṛṣṇayā vyāptā vārdhakye śaktivarjitāḥ ।।23।।
kālavegena jāyante karmaṇā prāktanena ca ।
pūrvaṃ yasmād dhanaṃ prāptamṛṇātmakaṃ yato yataḥ ।।24।।
tebhyo dattaṃ na paścādvai tadṛṇaṃ saha gacchati ।
dātāraste sutāḥ putrāḥ patnyaḥ kuṭumbinastathā ।।25 ।।
rājā bhṛtyāḥ sevakāśca bhavantyevarṇabandhanāt ।
caurarūpāśca vā bhūtvā prasahya praharanti ca ।।26 ।।
na dattaṃ na ca bhuktaṃ vai paryāptaṃ cāpi cārjitam ।
vardhayate prayatnena tadvilopaṃ samīhate ।।27।।
dravyaṃ hasati dravyeśaṃ mṛṣā dravyeśatā tava ।
yogye vinimayaḥ sattā sā kṛtā na tvayā yataḥ ।।28।।
maraṇaṃ sannidhau cāste śreṣṭhin tyaktvā gamiṣyasi ।
tatastaveśatā dravye dravyeśatā na vai tvayi ।।29।।
aho lobhasya māhātmyaṃ saptavaṃśottaraṃ dhanam ।
vidyate yasya keśe'pi punaḥ sañcetumicchati ।।2.59.30।।
arjane tu paraṃ duḥkhaṃ kaiṃkaryādisamudbhavam ।
rakṣaṇe'pi paraṃ duḥkhaṃ cintā vyāghrī pravalgati ।।3 1 ।।
vyaye'pi kṣayaduḥkhaṃ ca bhoge duḥkhaṃ ca rogitā ।
garve duḥkhaṃ ca yuddhādi mṛtyurdravye prajāyate ।।32।।
tasmād duḥkhaṃ dhanaṃ proktaṃ yad dharmārthaṃ na yujyate ।
dhane dharme niyukte tu dharmāt sukhaṃ na duḥkhitā ।।33 ।।
dharmācchāntirdharmayogāt tṛṣṇānāśo vivekitā ।
yathālabdhe ca santoṣo devasevādivartanam ।।34।।
kuṭumbe sattvabhāvaśca rāgadveṣādiśūnyatā ।
caurādibhayaviraho nidrā'pi sukhato bhavet ।।35।।
evaṃvidhā guṇāḥ śreṣṭhin nirdhanatve sukhāvahāḥ ।
sadhanatve duḥkhadoṣāḥ prajāyante punaḥ punaḥ ।।36।।
tatra nāsti mahāścaryaṃ gatā''gatā'bdhivārivat ।
dhanaṃ tu cañcalaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmīḥ sadā hi cañcalā ।।37।।
jīvanaṃ cañcalaṃ cāpi mā śokaṃ kuru vaibhave ।
bhāgyāt sarvaṃ punaścāpi yatato vai bhaviṣyati ।। 38।।
ityuccārya samāhūya preto bhṛtyān samabravīt ।
adyā'tithirayaṃ śreṣṭhī gṛhesmākamupāgataḥ ।।39 ।।
bālamitraṃ mama pūjyaḥ sahajo deśajo mama ।
asmin dṛṣṭaṃ ca manye'haṃ dṛṣṭavānnijabāndhavān ।।2.59.40 ।।
asmin samāgate jātā prītirmamā'tulā'dya vai ।
ityuktvā ca prasasmāra preto bhojanamuttamam ।।41 ।।
tāvattasya samāyātā sthālī navā dṛḍhā śubhā ।
miṣṭānnena tu sampūrṇā dadhyodanayutā'pi ca ।।42।।
śākasūpā''ranālādisampūrṇā bhojanāya vai ।
tathā navā dṛḍhā śītajalabhṛtā ca hāṇḍikā ।।43।।
vāridhānīṃ tathā sthālīṃ vīkṣya preteśvarastadā ।
prāhottiṣṭha vaṇigvarya prakṣālaya karau mukham ।।44।।
ityuktvā salilaṃ dattvā nyaveśayacchubhāsane ।
pretarājo dadāvasmai miṣṭānnaṃ dadhi vāri ca ।।45।।
odanaṃ cā''ranālaṃ ca śākaṃ ca bubhuje vaṇik ।
prektebhyaḥ sa dadau sarvavidhaṃ pātreṣu patriṣu ।।46।।
pretā miṣṭānnamādyaṃ ca bhakṣayāmāsurādarāt ।
jalaṃ papustataḥ preteśvaro'pi śeṣameva tat। ।।47।।
bubhuje ca papau vāri tṛptāḥ sarve'bhavaँstataḥ ।
sthālī ca vāridhānī ca śeṣānnamapi sarvathā ।।48।।
adṛśyatāṃ gataṃ tūrṇaṃ paśyato vaṇijastadā ।
etadadbhutamāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha vai vaṇik ।।49।।
eṣā sthālī cānnapūrṇā vāridhānī ca pūritā ।
araṇye'tra kathaṃ prāptā vada me pretapuṃgava ।।2.59.50।।
tathāpi tava bhṛtyāstu kṛśāḥ kathaṃ hi sarvathā ।
tvaṃ tu naivā'tipuṣṭo'si kathaṃ durbalatā vada ।।91 ।।
tāvat tatra śvetavastraṃ samāyātaṃ śubhaṃ navam ।
tadattaṃ ca vaṇije'tra pretena bhāvatastadā ।।52।।
āścaryaṃ cāpi tad dṛṣṭvā kuto vastraṃ samāgatam ।
papraccha ca vaṇik pretaṃ pretaḥ prāha yathātatham ।।53।।
ahamāsaṃ purā śreṣṭhin nagare dhavalāhvaye ।
vipro nāmnā prabhānāthaḥ sūpakāro'bhavaṃ sadā ।।54।।
mamā'sti ca vaṇik śreṣṭhī dhanāḍhyo dharmavardhanaḥ ।
viṣṇubhakto yajamānaḥ svāmī dhanaprado mama ।।।55।।।
dharmavardhananāmā'sau dharmakārye sadā sa mām ।
ājñāpayati dharmārthe vyayārthaṃ ca yathepsitam ।।56।।
dānārthaṃ copakārārthamakuṇṭhā''jñāṃ dadāti ca ।
so'haṃ kadaryo lubdhātmā dhane'pi sati puṣkale ।।57।।
na dadāmi tu devebhyo na viprebhyo na dānakam ।
nopakāraṃ kasyacicca karomyanāthadehinaḥ ।।58।।
yatīn sādhūn dharmaniṣṭhān gaṇayāmi na sarvathā ।
na cā'śnāmi tṛptipūrṇaṃ lubdho'nyasya tu kā kathā ।।59।।
apuṇyasya hi nāśā'ntā vaibhavā iti niścitam ।
mamā'pi na tathā puṇyaṃ tadāsīd bhuktavānnahi ।।2.59.60।।
pramādād yadi bhuñje'haṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādikam ।
miṣṭānnaṃ vā miṣṭajalaṃ tadā śokaḥ prajāyate ।।6 1 ।।
aho'dya tu mayā vyartho vyayaḥ kṛto hi hānikṛt ।
nidrā rātrau na cā''yāti vyayacintāparasya me ।।62।।
prātarbhavati caivaṃ me yadvā tadvā kathaṃcana ।
evametādṛśo lobhī nivasāmyatitṛṣṇakaḥ ।।63।।
tandūlatilapiṇyākatuṣaśākādibhojanaiḥ ।
kṣapayāmi kadānnādyairātmānaṃ kālanirgamaiḥ ।।64।।
evaṃ dravyayutasyā'pi vinā dānaṃ ca puṇyakam ।
mahān kālo gato me tu sūryagrahaṇamāgatam ।।65।।
śravaṇadvādaśī prāptā māsi bhādrapade tathā ।
lokāḥ prayānti tīrthārthaṃ sābhramatyāṃ dine dine ।।66।।
ahaṃ ca śreṣṭhinā sākaṃ hyekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ।
gatavān sābhramatyāṃ tu snātuṃ tvekādaśīdināt ।।67।।
yāvat sūryagrahaḥ syācca tāvat tīrthe sthiro'bhavam ।
ekādaśīdināttena śreṣṭhinā koṭiśo dhanam ।।68।।
vastrāṇi śreṣṭhapātrāṇi gāvaścetyapi dānakam ।
dattaṃ yathābalaṃ tatra mayā dṛṣṭvā'tilajjayā ।।69।।
dhautraṃ caikaṃ navaṃ dattaṃ viprāya vedavedine ।
navā sthālī cānnapūrṇā miṣṭapūrṇā samarpitā ।।2.59.70।।
dadhyodanāranālādyaiḥ śākena saṃyutā tathā ।
jaladhānī tadā dattā yānaṃ dattaṃ tu kāṣṭhajam ।।71।।
chāyārthaṃ tu tadā chatraṃ dattaṃ viprāya vai tadā ।
śreṣṭhino bhṛtyavargāśca viprārthaṃ yojitā mayā ।।72।।।
etāvanmātrakaṃ mayā vaṇigvarya tadārpitam ।
nānyat kiñcit pradattaṃ tu mayā'yutasamāsvapi ।।73 ।।
atha kālāntare mṛtyugato'haṃ pretatāṃ gataḥ ।
amī cā'dattadānā vai maddattā'nnopajīvinaḥ ।।74।।
bhṛtyāstasya godhanākhyavaṇijo madvaśānugāḥ ।
kāṣṭhayānamidaṃ prāptaṃ prāptā bhṛtyāśca te mayā ।।75।।
prāptā miṣṭānnasaṃyuktā sthālī jalasya hāṇḍikā ।
dattaṃ tadidamāyāti madhyāhne'pi dine dine ।।76।।
yāvannā'haṃ tu bhuñje'nnaṃ na tāvallayameti ca ।
mayi bhukte ca pīte ca sarvaṃ līnaṃ prajāyate ।।77।।
chatradānādayaṃ vṛkṣo nityaṃ prāpto'sti vai mayā ।
vāsārthaṃ nivasāmyatra pretāḥ kurvanti sevanām ।।78।।
idaṃ tavoktaṃ sarvaṃ ca dāne nirodhakṛd yathā ।
ahaṃ purā'bhavaṃ tena pāpena pretatāṃ gataḥ ।।79।।
lobhena tṛṣṇayā cā'pi vipro'haṃ pretatāṃ gataḥ ।
ekavārapradattena jalānnena hi bhujyate ।।2.59.80।।
pratyahaṃ tvekavāraṃ hi datvā bhuñje hi nityadā ।
nityadānapradātustu svargaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet ।।81।
atha śreṣṭhin tava me'pi hitaṃ karomi sarvathā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।।82।।
lomaśasyā''śrame tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye ।
yāhi śīghraṃ vaṇik tatra snānaṃ ca havanaṃ kuru ।।83।।
mama nāma samuddiśya piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuru ।
tatra piṇḍapradānena pretabhāvādahaṃ kṣaṇāt ।।84।।
muktaḥ san dāna kartṝṇāṃ prayāsyāmi salokatām ।
tithistvekādaśī puṇyā śuklā bhādraprade śubhā ।।85।।
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā sā'tiśreyaskarī mama ।
athavā kartikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kuruṣva me ।।86।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyavāsare ।
avaśyaṃ ca tadā mokṣo mama bhāvī vibhāvaya ।।87।।
ityuktvā pradadau tasmai suvarṇaṃ hīrakādikam ।
skandhe kṛtvā vaṇijaṃ taṃ tatyāja ca surāṣṭrakam ।।88।।
ekādaśyāṃ bhādrapade yayāvaśvasarovaram ।
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tatra pretānāmanupūrvakam ।।89।।
cakārā'tha svabandhūnāṃ pitṛṇāṃ tadanantaram ।
ātmanaśca tathā samyaṅ mahacchrāddhaṃ tilairvinā ।।2.59.90।।
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ cakre tathā'nyānapi gotrajān ।
mokṣayāmāsa sarvān vai śrāddhadānādibhirvaṇik ।।9 1 ।।
karmamuktāstu tai sarve āyayustatra sannidhau ।
divyarūpā divyaveṣāḥ sūryatejo'tivarculāḥ ।।।92।।
vaṇik tebhyo jalaṃ tatra dadau miṣṭānnabhojanam ।
tatastān divyadehāँśca nināya lomaśāśramam ।।93।।
lomaśastāँstadā mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa vaiṣṇavam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।94।।
dadau tebhyaśca tulasīsrajaśca ca caraṇāmṛtam ।
tato vaṇig yayau nītvā saha sarvān pramocitān ।।95।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaudhaṃ sukānakam ।
te'pi sarve natā nārāyaṇaṃ pupūjurādarāt ।। 96।।
kṛṣṇapādajalaṃ pītvā babhūvurmuktakoṭikāḥ ।
divyayāne samāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā''jñayā ।। 97।।
yayurgolokasaṃjñaṃ ca tato dhāmā'kṣaraṃ param ।
athā'yaṃ tu vaṇig rādhe nijasthānaṃ tato gataḥ ।।98।।
dhavalākhye pure tatrā'bhajat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
bhaktiṃ tu navadhā kṛtvā kāladharmamupeyivān ।। 99।।
devo bhūtvā ca gandharvo guhyakaścāpi vai tataḥ ।
virāḍ rājā tato bhūtvā paro bhāgavato hi saḥ ।। 2.59.100 ।।
bheje'nādiparabrahmaśrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
dehānte sa harerdhāma yayau stutvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 10 1।।
ityevaṃ kathito rādhe! camatkāro hareryathā ।
darśanānmuktimāpannāḥ pretā divyaśarīriṇaḥ ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bhādraikādaśyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovare śrāddhena pretānāṃ muktiḥ pretavaṇiksaṃvādaścetinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikapañcā-
śattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 59 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 059 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 60
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 061 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
api rādhe śṛṇu tvanyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestadā ।
udayākhyo'bhavad rājā dhārmiko devapūjakaḥ ।। 1 ।।
aravalyadribhūbhāge rājyaṃ yasya mahattamam ।
udayākhyaṃ pattanaṃ ca rājadhānī hyabhūcchubhā ।। 2 ।।
rājā vrataṃ paraṃ cakre cāturmāsyaikabhojanam ।
nityaṃ dānaṃ viprasādhubhojanaṃ dhenusevanam ।। 3 ।।
anāthabālasādhvībhyaścānnavastrasamarpaṇam ।
vidyādāne tathā dravyaṃ devālayeṣu saddhanam ।। 4 ।।
havanaṃ sarvadā prātarbrāhmaṃ sāyaṃ jalāplavam ।
evaṃ vrate sukurvāṇe śrāvaṇe māsi sarvathā ।। 5 ।।
icchā tasyā'bhavat snātuṃ māsamekaṃ sarovare ।
yathāvāṣāḍhamāse'sau dhīravīrasarovaram ।। 6 ।।
parimeyā'nugo rājā āryāyanaṛṣervane ।
āśrame ca nijāvāsaṃ cakāra saritastaṭe ।। 7 ।।
śrāvaṇe nityamevā'sau prātarutthāya satvaram ।
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya dhyātvā śrīviṣṇumacyutam ।। 8 ।।
snātvā sampūjya ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhāpatim ।
pārvatīsvāminaṃ rādheśvaraṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ ।। 9 ।।
tataścāryāyanaṛṣeḥ pūjāṃ karoti nityaśaḥ ।
atha paścāt sadāyāti tīrthāni draṣṭumeva saḥ ।। 2.60.1 0।।
satītīrthaṃ śaṃbhutīrthaṃ cakratīrthaṃ tataḥ param ।
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ svāmitīrthaṃ mañjulātīrthamityapi ।। 11 ।।
sūryatīrthaṃ cendratīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ tataḥ param ।
muktatīrtham ṛṣitīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ jalāśrayam ।। 12।।
evamādīni tīrthāni kṛtvā sarovare'bhitaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ saraḥ kṛtvā datvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 3।।
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ cāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ।
bhojyāni cānnadānāni tato yāti nijāśrayam ।। 14।।
evaṃ kṛtvā tato homaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ karoti ca ।
viprānṛṣīn satīḥ sādhvīḥ sādhūn bālānanāthakān ।। 15।।
vibhajyā'nnānyatithīँśca bhojayitvā'nugānapi ।
tato bhuṃkte svayaṃ rājā natvā tvāryāyanamṛṣim ।। 16।।
evaṃ puṇyapratāpena rājñaḥ pūrvakṛtāni ca ।
yāni kānyapi pāpāni dagdhānyeva samantataḥ ।। 17।।
puṇyapuñjo'piṃ ca mahānasya kṛṣṇe'rpitastataḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva prasannatā'sya śiṣyate ।। 18।।
prasannatā mahat puṇyaṃ nānyat puṇyaṃ sa manyate ।
harikṛṣṇaḥ prasanno'bhūdāryāyanarṣihṛdgataḥ ।। 1 9।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ rājannehi mamāntike ।
gṛhāṇa paramaṃ mantraṃ yaddevaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2.60.20।।
rājā tadā ṛṣeragre upāviveśa tam ṛṣiḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 21 ।।
iti mantraṃ dideśāpi srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ tathā ।
tato'nugānapi mantramāha cāryāyano muniḥ ।। 22।।
mantraṃ labdhvā ṛṣiṃ natvā rājā sahānugo gṛham ।
yayau tatra nadītīre svoṭajāyāmupāviśat ।।23 ।।
tāvat tatrāgato bālo muralīkaraśobhitaḥ ।
rādhayā prabhayā lakṣmyā pāravatyā ca sevitaḥ ।।24।।
rūparūpānurūpādhimūrtiḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
hasan muhustathā kāntā hāsayan raṅgapūritaḥ ।।25।।
divyo divyasvarūpābhiḥ patnībhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
mayūrapicchakalgyāḍhyahaimamukuṭaśobhitaḥ ।। 26।।
vahniśuddhāṃśukadharo divyabhūṣāvirājitaḥ ।
kare mīnadhvajasvastidhanuḥśūlādilakṣitaḥ ।। 27।।
tatpārśve ca manāk dūraṃ lakṣmīśrīkambharā satī ।
pārśvāntare manāk dūraṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 28।।
anyā dāsyastathā dāsāḥ parṇakuṭyāṃ samāgatāḥ ।
koṭikoṭayarkabhātulyaṃ tejastatra babhau sukham ।।29 ।।
rājā vilokya ruciraṃ mūrtau tatra sthiro'bhavat ।
neme netre ca sammilya tejovyāhataraśmiṇī ।।2.60.3 0।।
kṣaṇāntare samuddhāṭya yāvat paśyati keśavam ।
tāvadeko'bhavat kṛṣṇastanmūrtau śrīhariḥ svayam ।।3 1।।
darśayāmāsa saurāṣṭraṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi tathā śrīlomaśāśramam ।। 3 2।।
tathā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ tathā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
koṭyarbudābjakanyāśca tīrthānyapi ca sarvaśaḥ ।। 33 ।।
evaṃ pradarśya bhagavān sarvaṃ līnaṃ cakāra ha ।
tataḥ svapādayostasmai darśayāmāsa vai kṣaṇāt ।। 34।।
pātālaṃ ca tadūrdhvaṃ ca rasātalaṃ tataḥ param ।
mahātalaṃ jaṃghayośca jānvostalātalaṃ tataḥ ।। 35 ।।
sutalaṃ corvadhobhāge sakthnośca vitalaṃ tataḥ ।
sakthimūle cātalaṃ ca tatratyān daityadānavān ।। 36 ।।
sarpānnāgānanyajīvān nadīparvatabhūstarān ।
vibhūtīn darśayāmāsa śeṣaṃ ca kacchapaṃ tathā ।। 37।।
kaṭyāṃ bhuvaṃ jaghane ca bhuvarlokaṃ tataḥ param ।
nābhyāṃ svargaṃ maharlokaṃ hyudare hṛdaye janam ।। 38 ।।
tapolokaṃ mukhe satyaṃ lalāṭe'smai vyadarśayat ।
carmaṇi saptakānyevāvaraṇāni vyadarśayat ।। 39 ।।
evaṃ pradarśya ca kṣaṇāllīnaṃ cakāra tattadā ।
athainaṃ darśayāmāsa vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamātmanaḥ ।।2.60.40 ।।
sahasraśirasaṃ ramyaṃ sahasrakarapādakam ।
tatra vai pādayorenaṃ darśayāmāsa vai jalam ।।4 1 ।।
tejo vāyuṃ cāmbaraṃ ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ।
pādayorjalavaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ jaṃghayostathā ।।42 । ।
jānvoścātha mahāviṣṇuṃ sakthnorbhūmānamityapi ।
sakthimūle pradhānaṃ ca puruṣaṃ śiśnake tathā ।।43 ।।
prakṛtiṃ jaghane nābhau vāsudevamadarśayat ।
kaṭyāṃ kālaṃ ca puruṣaṃ pārśve saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।44।।
pārśvāntare ca pradyumnaṃ hyudare tvaniruddhakam ।
kukṣyorvaikuṇṭhagolokau vakṣasyanantadāsikāḥ ।।486 । ।
rādhāramādiśaktīśca darśayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।
kaṇṭhe brahmasvarūpāँśca muktān koṭyarbudābjakān ।।46 ।।
mukhe tvamṛtalokaṃ ca netrayorakṣaraṃ tathā ।
brahma pradarśayāmāsa lalāṭe tejasāṃ cayam ।।47।।
tatra śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
brahmarandhre paraṃ dhāma naijaṃ prādarśayaddhariḥ ।।48 ।।
tatra siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ sthitaṃ tasmin hariṃ tathā ।
sevamānaṃ ca taṃ tatra svaṃ rājā saṃvyalokayat ।।49 ।।
tataḥ punaśca tatsarvamadṛśyaṃ samajāyata ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sthitaṃ taṃ bālarūpiṇam ।। 2.60.50 ।।
dadarśa rājā śrīmantaṃ sevitaṃ koṭidehibhiḥ ।
tatrātmānaṃ nṛpaḥ punardadarśa nikaṭe sthitam ।।5 1 ।।
atha sarvaṃ kṣaṇāt līnaṃ nṛpastvāścaryamāptavān ।
tataḥ kṣaṇāntare naijoṭajāṃ dadarśa śobhanām ।।52।।
svastho bhūtvā diśo natvā tuṣṭāva dhyānasaṃsthitaḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīnivāsāya mūlaprakṛtiyāmine ।।53 ।।
ajitāya ca devāya mahātmane namo'stu te ।
anāśritāya śāntāya niḥspṛhāya namostu te ।।54।।
nama ādyāya devāya sarvadevamayāya ca ।
ārṣāyā''disvarūpāya śrīkṛṣṇāya ca te namaḥ ।।55।।
anantarāya caikāya sadā vyaktāya te namaḥ ।
namo guptāya kāśāya guṇeśvarāya te namaḥ ।।56।।
atarkyāyā'prameyāya cātulāya ca te namaḥ ।
niścintāya ca pūrvāya sanātanāya te namaḥ ।।57।।
purāṇāya namastasmai nirguṇāya namo'stu te ।
namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya brahmaniṣṭhāya te namaḥ ।।58।।
padmanābhāya yogāya govindāya namo namaḥ ।
namo'stu sāṃkhyavedyāya viśveśvarāya te namaḥ ।। 59 ।।
haraye śivarakṣāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ।
parātmane'mitadātre'mitakramāya te namaḥ । ।2.60.6 0 ।।
śārṅgacakragadāpadmaśāline te namo namaḥ ।
mahoragāya siṃhāya namo'stu vedavāsine ।। 61 ।।
mahāmatsyāya kāntāya kacchapāya ca te namaḥ ।
vāmanāya ca dīrghāya caturbhujāya te namaḥ । ।62 ।।
siddhacāraṇagandharvasaṃstutāya namo namaḥ ।
acyutāya sakalāya nāgendraśayanāya ca ।।6 3 ।।
dugdhavarṇāya kṛṣṇāya hemābhāya namo namaḥ ।
pītāmbarāya daityādināśanāya ca te namaḥ ।।64।।
akṣarāyā'kṣareśāya nābhipadmāya te namaḥ ।
caturmukhāya devāya pañcavaktrāya te namaḥ ।। 65 ।।
kṣīravāsāya yaśase kāntaye varadāya ca ।
sarveśvarāya kāntāya kāminīśāya te namaḥ ।।66।।
vareṇyāya vighnahartre bhaktipriyāya te namaḥ ।
padmāyatasunetrāya śukanāsāya śārṅgiṇe ।।67।।
yogeśvarāya vṛkṣāya śākhine te namo namaḥ ।
devāyanāya munaye sādhave te namo namaḥ ।।68 ।।
mohinīrūpabhāsāya jīvavāsāya te namaḥ ।
vārāhāya nṛsiṃhāya śarabhāya ca te namaḥ ।।69।।
kūṭasthaṃ sarvahetuṃ ca puruṣaṃ ca purātanam ।
māyākāntaṃ ceśakāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ namāmyaham ।। 2.60.70 ।।
kṣetrajñaṃ kālamāyeśaṃ vyūheśaṃ muktajīvakam ।
vāsudevaṃ satīkāntaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।7 1 ।।
kambharānandanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālakṛṣṇabālakam ।
paradhāmanivāsaṃ taṃ pumuttamaṃ namāmyaham ।।72।।
brahmarṣayo brahmarūpaṃ yaṃ vadanti sanātanam ।
akṣareśaṃ ca mukteśaṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ harim ।।73 ।।
śrīvatsā'ṅkaṃ śvetapadmarekhaṃ viguṇahārakam ।
ṣoḍaśādicihnaśobhaṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ patim । 74।।
yatra viśvaṃ yaśca viśve sarvaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhate ।
prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ divyaguṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।75।।
prapadye muktasaṃgānāṃ sādhūnāṃ paramāṃ gatim ।
bhagavantaṃ cātmavāsaṃ strīvāsaṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam ।।76।।
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktyā prapadye bhaktavatsalam ।
antakāle samāgatya pradarśyātmānameva yaḥ ।।77।।
naijaṃ dhāma nijaṃ bhaktaṃ nayatyeva prabhuḥ paraḥ ।
taṃ namāmi paraṃ devaṃ mokṣadaṃ puruṣottamam ।।78 ।।
pātālāntaṃ ca satyādi sarvaṃ māti tu yatra vai ।
mahāmāyāntakaṃ sarvaṃ yasmin māti janārdane ।।79।।
dhāmāni muktakoṭyaśca yasmin mānti pareśvare ।
taṃ prapadye paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।।2.60.8 0 ।।
na tvāṃ stotuṃ tathā vedmi yathā tvaṃ vartase prabho! ।
svarūpaṃ na yathārthaṃ ca vedmi vedmi taṭasthakam ।।8 1 ।।
tvayā yat kṛṣṇa kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakam ।
rūpaṃ pradarśitaṃ mahyaṃ tapaḥ phalaṃ kṛpāphalam ।।82।।
dhāma pradarśitaṃ cāpi tathā kuṃkumavāpikā ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi darśitaṃ lomaśāśramam ।।8 3 ।।
sarvaṃ punaḥ punarnātha draṣṭumicchāmi sevayā ।
prasannatāṃ samicchāmi tathā me varado bhava' ।।84।।
ityevaṃ saṃstuto'nādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
sānnidhyaṃ cājagāma drāk cakrapadmadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।।85।।
prītimān puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ ।
provāca madhuraṃ tasmai udayāya mahātmane ।।86।।
tava stotreṇa ca rājan prasanno'smi punaḥ punaḥ ।
sarvamiṣṭāṃ ca te rājan āryāyanaprasaṃgataḥ ।।87।।
bhaviṣyatyacirāt kṣetre mama vāso'pi te bhavet ।
sanneṣye tvāṃ mama kṣetraṃ vāruṇena pathā nṛpa ।।88 ।।
te yogānmama yogācca nadītīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
idaṃ stotraṃ tu ye rājan paṭhiṣyanti gṛhe vane ।।89।।
prāpsyanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ mama prāptisvarūpiṇīm ।
atra tīrthe dhīravīrasarovare tu ye janāḥ ।।2.60.90।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭā vṛkṣavallyādikāstathā ।
jalapānaṃ kariṣyanti muktiṃ yāsyanti pāvanīm ।।9 1।।
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ jalam ।
ye'tra dāsyanti vidhinā teṣāṃ muktirbhaviṣyati ।।92।।
ityuktvā bhagavān bhūpaṃ cādṛśyabhāvamāsthitaḥ ।
rājā jajāpa bahudhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।93।।
jagau nanarta dadhyau ca jahāsa ca ruroda ca ।
tasthau siṣeve pupūja dadarśa taṃ yathā tathā ।।94।।
bhṛtyān vai preṣayāmāsa naijamudayapattanam ।
nāgadevaṃ sutaṃ rājyadānaṃ samādideśa ca ।।95।।
sādhuvadvartate smā'tra rājā bhāgavatottamaḥ ।
rātrau suptaḥ śrāvaṇasyā'ṣṭamyāṃ vavarṣa megharāṭ ।।96।।
sarovaraṃ nadī kūpā jalākārāḥ samudravat ।
ativṛṣṭyā tadā jātā parṇaśālā jalāntare ।।97।।
layaṃ yātā janāścāpi jale magnāḥ śatā'dhikāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmaruratyati ।।98।।
drāgeva rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dayānidhiḥ ।
yayau rakṣaṇakartā sa nāvamādāya śāśvatīm ।।99।।
sahasrarūpadhārī ca yatra yatra jale janāḥ ।
nimagnā bālavṛddhādyā narā nāryaḥ paśūttarāḥ ।। 2.60.10 0।।
sarvānuddhārayāmāsa naiko'pi mṛtimāptavān ।
āryāyanaṃ maharṣiṃ ca samādhisthaṃ gataṃ jale ।। 10 1।।
udgṛhya nāvi bhagavān dadhāra karuṇālayaḥ ।
nadyāṃ mahyāṃ tu sā naukā sthāpitā paramātmanā 1 02।।
śatadvayā'dhikān tasyāṃ magnān dhṛtvā rarakṣa saḥ ।
paśūn pakṣigaṇāँścāpi rarakṣa jīvatastadā ।। 10 3।।
rājā ca mānavā sarve jīvantaḥ śrīnarāyaṇam ।
bhejire'nanyabhāvāśca naurāste jalamastake ।। 1 04।।
jalopari vahatyeva śanaiḥ kṛṣṇena vāhitā ।
rādhike rakṣitā kṛṣṇastatra kā nāma vedanā ।। 1 05।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne udayapuranṛpateḥ cāturmāsye dhīravīrasarovarataṭasthitasya prabhordarśanaṃ cātivṛṣṭyā jalamagnatvaṃ prabhuṇā nāvā rakṣā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 60 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 060 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 61
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 062 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! nauśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇānvitā ।
śatadvayamanuṣyā'dhivāsitā ca mahījale ।। 1 ।।
pūravegena vahati bhagavāँstāṃ prarakṣati ।
śanaiḥ śanairmahānadyāṃ militāni jalāni ca ।। 2 ।।
saṃgame tu mahānadyā bhramareṣu tu naustadā ।
majjanapravaṇā jalopari kṛṣṇena rakṣitā ।। 3 ।।
gurjare sā nadī dīrghā hyagādhā ca bhayaṃkarī ।
pūravegena ca yātā śatakrośaṃ gatā tadā ।। 4 ।।
lūnāpaṭākhyanagaraṃ nātidūre hi cāgatam ।
dadṛśurnaugatāḥ sarve mahāścaryaparāstadā ।। ।9 ।।
vanaṃ cāgre tu dadṛśustato nauḥ pūravegataḥ ।
pañcāśat krośadūraṃ ca uhyamānā gatā yadā ।। 6 ।।
devīkoṭamahattīrthaṃ dadṛśurnaugatā janāḥ ।
bhadrāyanaṃ ca pañcāśatkrośadūre tataḥ param ।। 7 ।।
samāyātaṃ tataścā'gre kaṭhinaṃ pattanaṃ tathā ।
stambhapuraṃ mahātīrthaṃ kāvyatīrthaṃ ca sannidhau ।। 8 ।।
madhye samudrasadṛśī rājate sunadī mahī ।
tatra nauḥ sā janairyuktā jale yātā tvakhātake ।। 9 ।।
śrīhariṇā rakṣyamāṇā sābhramatīmahījale ।
miśrite'khātavārdhau sā samudraṃ prati yāti ca ।। 2.61.10 ।।
akhāte cāgragā naukā dardurikā'bdhisaṃgamam ।
ullaṃghya paramaṃ dvīpaṃ prāptā tadā tu sā'bhavat ।। 11 ।।
viśālā śrīprabhoḥ śaktyā sahasramānavāśrayā ।
narmadā'khātamullaṃghya saurāṣṭrataṭamāgatā ।। 12।।
śatrujitānadīsaṃge samudre sā sthirīkṛtā ।
tatra bhojyānnapānāni cakruḥ sarve sukhena vai ।। 1 3।।
athāgre gopanāthaṃ ca yayau nauḥ kṛpṇavāhitā ।
tataścāgre mādhukaṃ ca yayau jāphalitaṃ tataḥ ।। 14।।
tato divaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāvatīṃ purīṃ yayau ।
tato yayau somanāthaṃ makarālayamapyataḥ ।। 15।।
bhadrābdhisaṃgamaṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇavatīṃ purīṃ yayau ।
kacchā'khātaṃ praviśyā'tha camatkārapurāntikam ।। 16।।
yayau tatastu sā naukā vimānarūpatāṃ gatā ।
ākāśe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā samauḍḍayat ।। 17।।
vyomnā śīghraṃ samāyātā cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
divyaṃ candrasamaṃ yānaṃ sūryaprabhāsubhāsuram ।। 18।।
suvarṇajaḍitaṃ devaiḥ pūjitaṃ kṛṣṇarakṣitam ।
śatadvayajanairyuktaṃ cā'vātarat saro'ntikam ।। 1 9।।
jayaśabdāḥ svastiśabdāstanā'bhavan muhurmuhuḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ sotsāhaṃ samadṛśyata ।।2.61.20।।
sarvairvilokitaṃ kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ca kānakālayam ।
mahābhāgavataṃ śṛṃgaṃ mandirasyocchritaṃ śubham ।।21।।
dṛṣṭā ca kambharālakṣmīrdṛṣṭo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
lomaśarṣistathā dṛṣṭo nagaraṃ ca vilokitam ।।22।।
vimānādavateruśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'nvitāḥ ।
udayākhyastathā cānye bhaktā nārīnarātmakāḥ ।। 23।।
tāvadvimānaṃ ca tiro'bhavat kṛṣṇavinirmitam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi tiro'bhavattu sārthagaḥ ।।24।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā cādṛśyarūpatām ।
yātrākarāśca te sarve janān pṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 25।।।
yayurdevā yatra bālakṛṣṇo virājate ।
kṛtvā saṃdarśanaṃ sarve kṛṣṇenā'nena rakṣitāḥ ।। 26।।
smṛtvaivaṃ harṣanibhṛtāḥ premā'śrūṇi hyavāsṛjan ।
bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyo nivāsārhaṃ mahālayam ।। 27।।
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ dāsadāsīvirājitam ।
sarve tīrthāni vidhivaccakruścā'śvasaro'bhitaḥ ।।28।।
tato miṣṭānnapānāni dadau śrībhagavān svayam ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni coṣyāṇi ca rasāँstathā ।। 29।।
mukhavāsādicūrṇāni upamṛdyāni yāni ca ।
dāpayāmāsa bhagavān kṛpayā bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 2.61.3 0।।
rarakṣa bhagavān sarvān cāturmāsyāntameva ca ।
lomaśo'pi dadau tebhyo mantraṃ srajaśca taulasīḥ ।। 3 1।।
prāpya te vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ tejaḥ śrīpatisannidhau ।
divyā divyaguṇopetā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇavīkṣitāḥ ।। 32।।
jñātvā pratyakṣamevainaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ mahāprabhum ।
parabrahma sukhāvāsaṃ bhejustaṃ parameśvaram ।।33।।
lomaśastān pratyahaṃ copādideśa muktaye ।
prāha śṛṇvantu ruciraṃ śreyaḥsādhanamuttamam ।। 34।।
sarvaṃ yasyāsti śarīraṃ sarveṣu vartate ca yaḥ ।
tasya stotreṇa saṃsārād rakṣā bhavati śāśvatī ।।35।।
tamenaṃ kathayāmyadya stavaṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam ।
'bālakṛṣṇo'stu me prācyāṃ cakrahetiḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।36।।
gadādharo bālakṛṣṇo dakṣiṇe me'stu sarvadā ।
paścime śārṅgadhṛka kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu me sadā ।। 37।।
uttare khaḍgadhṛk kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu me sadā ।
koṇeṣvastu hṛṣīkeśo madhye madhye janārdanaḥ ।।38।।
pṛthvyāṃ varāharūpo'stu vyomni narahariḥ prabhuḥ ।
kṣuradhārā'titīkṣṇaṃ ca sudarśanaṃ samantataḥ ।।39।।
pretabhūtān prahantveva rākṣasāँśca niśācarān ।
gadā sahasradhārordhvaṃ hantu vṛkān piśācakān ।।2.61.40।।
śārṅgaṃ dhanurharestiryakkuṣmāṇḍādīn prahantu ca ।
yakṣān daityān jṛmbhakāँśca khagān krūrān vināyakān ।।41 ।।
śaṃkho viṣṇorninādena hantu duṣṭāँśca pannagān ।
siṃhān vyāghrān śarabhāँśca dandaśūkān paśūँstathā ।।42।।
viṣṇoḥ padmaṃ mama śatrūn saumyān dadhātu gandhataḥ ।
cittavṛttiharān smṛtyāharān balaujasāṃ harān ।।43।।
sampadbhogaharāँścāpi śubhalakṣaṇahārakān ।
strīputradhanasadanaharān praśāmayatvapi ।।44।।
hareḥ saṃkīrtanāccā'stu svāsthyamaindriyakaṃ mama ।
buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ dehasvāsthyaṃ sukhāvaham ।।45।।
pṛṣṭhe cāgre pārśvayośca koṇeṣvastu harirmama ।
śikhāyāṃ me nakheṣveṣaḥ carmasvastu harirmama' ।।46।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! rakṣāstotraṃ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।।47।।
dadau sarvebhya evādau tataḥ prāha nidarśanam ।
vaṭāsīnapure rājā krūrasiṃho'bhavatpurā ।।48।।
devadvijasatīdrogdhā piśunaḥ kṣatriyādhamaḥ ।
parapīḍākaraḥ kṣudro naisargeṇa ca nirdayaḥ ।।49।।
dharmadānavihīnaśca satāṃ sevāvivarjitaḥ ।
āyuḥkṣaye sa vai jajñe vane ghoraniśācaraḥ ।।।2.61.50।।
yo yo milati cāraṇye paśuḥ pakṣī ca mānavaḥ ।
bhakṣaṇīyo māraṇīya iti krauryaṃ karoti saḥ ।।51।।
yaṃ yaṃ paśyati paśvādiṃ taṃ tamādāya sa drutam ।
khādatyeva dayāhīno bāhugocaramāgatam ।।52।।
evaṃ yāte dīrghakāle vārdhakyaṃ samabhūttataḥ ।
aṭamānasya duṣṭasya narmadāyāstaṭe kvacit ।।53।।
tasya dṛṣṭyāṃ tāpaso vai ṛṣiryogaparāyaṇaḥ ।
nāmnā jitaśravā vipraścā''gataḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ ।।54।।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ khādituṃ tūrṇaṃ dudrāva rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।
uktāṃ rakṣāṃ dvijastūrṇaṃ samuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ।।55।।
śrutvā stabdho'bhavattūrṇaṃ jaḍībhūto hi rākṣasaḥ ।
nā'gre yātuṃ cā'pasartuṃ śaśāka stotradharṣitaḥ ।।56।।
nirdhūtavegaḥ sahasā tasthau tatraiva rākṣasaḥ ।
yāvad dvijasya japato dināntaḥ samapadyata ।।57।।
tato japyāvasāne ca taṃ dadarśa niśācaram ।
dīnaṃ hatabalotsāhaṃ kāndiśikaṃ hataujasam ।।58।।
kṛpāpūrṇo dvijo daityaṃ samāśvāsya punaḥ punaḥ ।
papraccha kāraṇaṃ rakṣobhāve cāgamane tathā ।।59।।
rākṣasaḥ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ rakṣobhavanamityapi ।
bhakṣaṇārthaṃ cāgamaścetyevaṃ sarvamuvāca ha ।।2.61.60 ।।
prasīdetyabravīd vipraṃ nirviṇṇaḥ sukhavarjitaḥ ।
bahupāpāni kṛtavān hatavāँśca bahūn sataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
bahvīrnārīḥ prasahyaiva bhuktavān vidhavā api ।
anāgasāṃ ca sattvānāṃ prakṣayaṃ kṛtavān bahum ।।62।।
madyamāṃsāni bahudhā bhuktavānapi sarvadā ।
tasmāt pāpādahaṃ mokṣamicchāmi tvatprasādataḥ ।।63 ।।
tatpāpapraśamāyā'laṃ kuru me dharmasādhanam ।
pāpasyā'sya kṣayakaraṃ mokṣadaṃ kuru satvaram ।।64।।
niśāṭasya vacaḥ śrutvā jitaśravā uvāca tam ।
mama rakṣā kṛtā cā'tra mayā te'pi pavitratā ।।65।।
mumukṣutā kṛtā rakṣo yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām ।
saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'śvasarovare ।।66।।
snātvā śrīlomaśaṃ gatvā prārthanāṃ kuru sarvathā ।
uddhāraṃ te lomaśo vā vipraścānyaḥ kariṣyati ।।67।।
evamuktvā yayau vipro rākṣaso vyomamārgataḥ ।
āgataḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāmravaṇe'vasat ।।68।।
kathaṃ mokṣo bhavenme'tra cintayā dīnamānasaḥ ।
na cakhāda sa sattvāni kṣudhāsaṃbādhito'pi san ।।69।।
daśame daśame kāle jantumekamabhakṣayat ।
vyāghrāraṇye hyaṭitvā ca punaścāmravaṇe'gamat ।।2.61.70।।
sa kadācinmahāvṛṣṭau vane'ṭan kṣudhito'bhavat ।
dadarśa phalalābhārthamāgataṃ brahmacāriṇam ।।71 ।।
brahmaprakāśanāmānaṃ dharṣayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ ।
brahmacārī tadā tvenaṃ rākṣasaṃ prāha sāmataḥ ।।72।।
vada kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tvatra dharṣaṇe me vanecara! ।
rākṣasaḥ prāha bhojyaṃ me kāle bhavati cā'ṣṭame ।।73।।
sa tvaṃ prāptaḥ kṣudhitasya niṣṭurasyā'tra me vane ।
brahmacārī tu taṃ prāha śṛṇu me vacanaṃ śubham ।।74।।
phalāni gurave dātuṃ gacchāmyahaṃ niśācara! ।
taddatvācāgamiṣyāmi bhakṣyaścedasmi te nvaham ।।75।।
sa tvaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ māmatraivā'nuprapālaya ।
nivedya gurave yāvadihā''gacchāmi bhakṣaya ।।76।।
niśācarastadā prāha yāhi kintu hitaṃ śṛṇu ।
gurave vada me mokṣo yathā syāt tat karotu cet। ।।77।।
tvāṃ na vai bhakṣayiṣye'haṃ yadartho'haṃ samāgataḥ ।
guroryanna viruddhaṃ syānna ca dharmoparodhakam ।।78।।
yanna vrataharaṃ te'pi tathā manmokṣaṇaṃ kuru ।
mayā nisargato brahman jātidoṣādviśeṣataḥ ।।79।।
viṣayāḍhyena cittena pāpakarma sadā'rjitam ।
ābālyānmama dharme tu mana āsīnna vai manāk ।।2.61.80 ।।
adhārmikāni karmāṇi kṛtānyeva viśeṣataḥ ।
narmadāyāstaṭe prāptavipreṇa preṣito'tra vai ।।8 1।।
pāpakṣālanakāmārthaṃ samāgato'smi bhāvataḥ ।
tatra tvaṃ milito me'tra pāpānmokṣaya me'nagha ।।82।।
ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ prāha guroryogādahaṃ tava ।
prajvālya sarvapāpāni kariṣye mokṣaṇaṃ dhruvam ।।83।।
yadi śuśrūṣito vahnirguroḥ śuśrūṣūṇādanu ।
vratāni vā sucīrṇāni mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ।।84।।
yadyahaṃ pitaraṃ devaṃ guruṃ ca mātaraṃ harim ।
gauraveṇā'bhivandāmi mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ।।85।।
yadyahaṃ manasā vācā karmaṇā ca guruṃ harim ।
nā'vamāne yojayāmi mokṣo bhavatu rakṣasaḥ ।।86।।
japa rākṣasa deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
harikṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam ।।87।।
praṇato'smi jagannāthaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ।
carācaraguruṃ nāthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।88।।
śaṃkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ śārṅgadhāriṇaṃ dhvajinaṃ harim ।
praṇato'smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ।।89।।
dāmodaraṃ puṇḍarīkanetraṃ ca śeṣaśāyinam ।
praṇato'smi ca govindaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ।।2.61.90।।
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ pṛthvīdharaṃ dhāmādhivāsinam ।
praṇato'smi prabhānāthaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ।।91।।
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ śrīśaṃ śrīmatpāravatīpatim ।
praṇato'smi ramākāntaṃ sa ca mokṣaṃ dadhātu me ।।92।।
yatayo yaṃ cintayanti rādhā rañjayati prabhum ।
samastālambanamūrtiṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।93।।
parabrahmā'saṃkhyagopīpatiṃ śrīkambharāsutam ।
sarvādhāraṃ sarvagaṃ ca tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।94।।
paramātmānamātmasthaṃ karmakṣālanaśaktikam ।
punarbhavaprabhettāraṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।95।।
īśān devānṛṣīn pitṝn mānavāँśca sarīsṛpān ।
pādapān jalajān svedodbhavān sṛjati rakṣati ।।96।।
brahmarūpadharaṃ jagadyoniṃ trātāramacyutam ।
gopālakṛṣṇabālaṃ ca tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।97।।
yajñeśa cāntakaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
yasmānnānyatparaṃ kiñcit tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।98।।
śubhā'śubhāni kāryāṇi janmāntarakṛtāni me ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni vyapohatu ।।99।।
yanniśāyāṃ ca yatprātaryanmadhyāhnā'parāhṇayoḥ ।
sandhyayośca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tanme sarvaṃ praṇaśyatu ।। 2.61.1 00।।
yat tiṣṭhatā yad vrajatā yacca śayyāgatena vai ।
kṛtaṃ duḥkhakaraṃ karma kāyena manasā girā ।। 10 1।।
ajñānato jñānato vā madāt calitacetasā ।
tat kṣipraṃ vilayaṃ yātu bālakṛṣṇasya kīrtanāt ।। 102।।
paradāraparadravyavāñcchādrohodbhavaṃ ca yat ।
mahātmanāṃ pranindāṃ ca kurvatā paraduḥkhadām ।। 103।।
kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ marmabhedivacasā tat praṇaśyatu ।
yacca bhojye tathā peye bhakṣye coṣye vilehane ।। 1 04।।
yadvālye yacca kaumārye yatpāpaṃ yauvane mama ।
vayaḥpariṇatau yacca yacca janmāntare kṛtam ।। 1 05।।
tadanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇetijapakīrtanāt ।
prayātu vilayaṃ sadyo mokṣadasya prabhāvanāt ।। 1 06।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya haraye namaḥ ।
kambharāśrīnandanāya bālakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 1 07।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya bālakāya namo namaḥ ।
etadbhadra mayā''khyātaṃ tava pātakanāśanam ।। 108।।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ divyaṃ stotraṃ yadguruṇoditam ।
anena bālakṛṣṇaṃ tvaṃ samārādhaya rākṣasa! ।। 1 09।।
pratyahaṃ tvaṃ stavenā'nenā'pi smṛtvā ca lomaśam ।
guruṃ tathā parabrahma śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ।। 2.61.11 0।।
stutvā bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pāpāt pramokṣyase ।
stuto bhaktyā bhaktavaśaḥ sarvapāpaharo hariḥ ।। 11 1।।
śrutvaivaṃ rākṣasaḥ prāha naya māṃ lomaśāśramam ।
pradarśaya guruṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pramokṣadam ।। 1 12।।
ityukto brahmacārī taṃ krūrasiṃhāya rakṣase ।
dadau rakṣākaraṃ stotraṃ tena pāpavivarjitaḥ ।। 11 3।।
jātastato yayau sākaṃ tenaiva brahmacāriṇā ।
mamāśramaṃ lomaśākhyaṃ cātrāgatya sa rākṣasaḥ ।। 1 14।।
pāpahīno hyabhūt tūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam ।
gatvā ca darśanaṃ labdhvā prapītvā caraṇāmṛtam ।। 1 15।।
kṛtvā tīrthāni sarvāṇi divyadeho babhūva ha ।
divyaṃ yānaṃ samāruhya yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ ।। 1 16।।
yūyamāryāyanādyāśca jalapralayarakṣitāḥ ।
bhajata śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 1 17।।
maraṇāttāritā yena saṃsārāt tārayiṣyati ।
tārakaṃ cāśrayatāsmācchrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।। 1 18।।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā maunaṃ tasthau hi lomaśaḥ ।
āryāyanodayādyāśca śāntiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sulebhire ।। 1 19।।
stotrapāṭhaśravaṇādyairbhuktiḥ rakṣā''padāṃ kṣayaḥ ।
mokṣaśca rādhike śāntiḥ sarvaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.61.120।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jalamagnān śatadvayamānavān nāvi gṛhītvā prabhurmahīnadīdvārā staṃbhākhātamullaṃdhya somanāthaṃ svarṇapuraṃ camatkārapurādi ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya naukātmakavimānadvārā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ prāpayāmāsa, lomaśopadiṣṭarakṣāstotraṃ, krūrasiṃhasya rakṣaso vipradvārā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptyā muktiścetinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 61 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 061 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 62
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 063 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike te narā nāryaḥ dveśate vai śrīlomaśam ।
natvā sampūjya bhāvena koṭyarbudā'bjakanyakāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛṣṇakāntāśca sampūjya yayurvāsālaye śubhe ।
bhejuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 2 ।।
koṭikanyāpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ।
sarvapate sadā pāhi nirādhārān tvadāśritān ।। 3 ।।
ityevaṃ tu militvaiva bhajanaṃ tā vyadhurmudā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa prabhāpate ।। 4 ।।
rādhālakṣmīpate mañjūpate śrīpārvatīpate ।
evaṃ satāladhūnyaṃ ca cakruste nauprarakṣitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
cāturmāsyaṃ tatra cakruḥ kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitāḥ ।
athorjakṛṣṇapakṣīyā'ṣṭamī samāgatā tithiḥ ।। 6 ।।
iṣṭadevasya prākaṭyotsavaścāṣṭamavarṣajaḥ ।
devairīśaiśca munibhiḥ kṛtaḥ svargātiśobhitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
vīkṣya taṃ harṣamāpannāḥ pūjāṃ cakrurharestu te ।
tadāścaryaṃ paraṃ jātaṃ rādhike śṛṇu vacmi te ।। 8 ।।
rājādhirājo bhagavān prātareva prapūjitaḥ ।
dadau dānāni bahūni svajanmāṣṭamavarṣake ।। 9 ।।
bhojayāmāsa viprāँśca sādhūn sādhvīśca bālikāḥ ।
bālān kanyāśca dīnāँścā'nāthān kumārakāँstathā ।। 2.62.10।।
khañjān kāṇāँśca badhirān vṛkṇānandhān jaḍāँstathā ।
vicittān kuṣṭhinaścāpi deśebhyo tīrthamāgatān ।। 11 ।।
rogiṇo dehino vīkṣya dayālurbhagavān svayam ।
prāha khañjādikān vyaṃgān madhyāhne bhojanottaram ।। 1 2।।
āyāntu vyaṃgadehāśca rogiṇo duḥkhinastathā ।
āyāntu cāṃgavikalāścendriyairvikalā api ।। 1 3।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'haṃ me janūtsave ।
apūrvaṃ sukhadaṃ vo'dya dadāmi pāritoṣikam ।। 14।।
ityuktvā śarkarādroṇīṃ pārśve kṛtvā tu kānake ।
gajāsane niṣasāda pradātuṃ śarkarāstataḥ ।। 15।।
āyayuḥ khañjalokāśca tebhyo datvā suśarkarāḥ ।
khañjabhāge harikṛṣṇaḥ pasparśa vāmapāṇinā ।। 16।।
khāñjyaṃ teṣā gataṃ tūrṇaṃ babhavuḥ pūrṇapādinaḥ ।
atha kāṇāḥ prāyayuśca tebhyo datvā tu śarkarāḥ ।। 17।।
netre pasparśa vāmena pāṇinā''ndhavimuktaye ।
kāṇatvamāndhyamālpyaṃ dṛgdoṣā naṣṭā drutaṃ tadā ।। 18।।
pūrṇaraśmibharāṇyeva cakṣūṃṣi vartitāni vai ।
athā''yayurbadhirāśca tebhyo datvā ca śarkarāḥ ।। 1 9।।
karṇe pasparśa hastena samājuhāva nāmabhiḥ ।
bādhiryaṃ vigataṃ teṣāṃ babhūvuḥ śrutiśaktayaḥ ।।2.62.20।।
atha vṛkṇāḥ samāyātāstebhyo datvā ca śarkarām ।
kuṇikāsu prakoṣṭheṣu cāṃgulīṣu narāyaṇaḥ ।।21 ।।
pasparśa pāṇinā teṣāṃ vṛkṇatvaṃ vyanudat kṣaṇāt ।
yathānisargahastāste'bhavan prasannamānasāḥ ।। 22।।
atha jaḍā vicittāśca samāyayuśca sannidhau ।
tebhyo dattā śarkarā ca spṛṣṭā dehāḥ kareṇa vai ।। 23।।
mastakāni tathā spṛṣṭvā jāḍyaṃ vaicityamityapi ।
vātarogādikaṃ cāpi vainidryaṃ nāśitaṃ kṣaṇāt ।।24।।
athā''yayuśca kanyāśca kuṣṭhinaśca samāyayuḥ ।
tebhyo datvā śarkarāśca tathā ca caraṇāmṛtam ।।25।।
jalena prokṣya cāṃgāni rogān kuṣṭhān vyanīnaśat ।
athā''yayuśca pakṣādighātino bhagnadehinaḥ ।। 26।।
tebhyo datvā śarkarāśca pasparśa ca kareṇa tān ।
ghātarogaṃ kṛpayā ca nāśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।।27।।
bhagnabhāgaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ saṃrohayāmāsa yogataḥ ।
galatkuṣṭhāstato lokāścāyātāḥ parameśvaram ।।28।।
haristebhyaḥ pradāyaiva śarkarā jalasecanam ।
galatkuṣṭhapradeśe ca svayaṃ cakāra tena vai ।।29।।
galadbhāvo gataḥ sarvaḥ śvaityaṃ śvaitryaṃ gataṃ kṣaṇāt ।
arogāste tu sañjātāḥ prasannāḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ।।2.62.3 0।।
atha ṣaṇḍhāstadā prāhurbahupāpena ṣaṇḍhatā ।
jātā'smākaṃ kṛpāsindho bhavān śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
kartumakartuṃ cā'nyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ pravartate ।
bhagavadyogamāptānāṃ cenno'smākaṃ sabījatā ।।32।।
jāyeta bhagavaँstarhi ko lābhastava darśanāt ।
śrutvā tebhyaḥ pradāyaiva śarkarāḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।।33।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātumājñāṃ dadau tataḥ ।
sarve ṣaṇḍhā yayustūrṇaṃ sasnuścā'tha viniryayuḥ ।।34।।
naraprakhyā narāḥ puṃstve nārīyogyā balānvitāḥ ।
naracihnā narāḥ pūrṇāḥ sabījā babhūvustadā ।। 35।।
nārīprakhyāḥ striyaḥ strītve narayogyā rajo'nvitāḥ ।
nārīcihnāḥ striyaḥ pūrṇā babhūvuśca rajobharāḥ ।।36।।
evaṃ vai kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaśaktibhiḥ ।
ṣaṇḍhāni vidadhe puṃso yoṣitaśca sadhātukāḥ ।।37।।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā camatkāraṃ paramāścaryamāgatāḥ ।
yatra snātāśca tat tīrthaṃ ṣaṇḍhoddhāraṃ samucyate ।।38।।
atha nāryo narāḥ stotraṃ sarve cakrurharestadā ।
premapūrṇahṛdayāśca sthiramānasavṛttayaḥ ।।39।।
namo'stu te pare dhāmni rājate vai parātmane ।
namo'saṃkhyasatīsādhvīsādhumuktābhiśāsine ।।2.62.40।।
namo'kṣarā'dhipataye'kṣaramuktā'bhiśāsine ।
namo golokavāsāya gopagopyabhiśāsine ।।41 ।।
gavāṃ nāthāya kṛṣṇāya śrīrādhāpataye namaḥ ।
namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya śrīramāpataye namaḥ ।।42।।
bahuvaikuṇṭhanāthāya lakṣmīśrīpataye namaḥ ।
śrīprabhāmaṃjulāhaṃsāsaguṇāsvāmine namaḥ ।।43।।
vṛndātulasīkamalāpārvatīpataye namaḥ ।
namaste'stu jagannātha vāsudeva namo'stu te ।।44।।
śrīnivāsa namaste'stu viśvaksena namo'stu te ।
garuḍadhvaja gopīśa viṣṇo vaikuṇṭha te namaḥ ।।45।।
puruṣottama deveśa sarveśvara namo'stu te ।
anādyādyantamadhyānta namaste padmajapriya ।।46।।
sṛṣṭigarbha namastubhyaṃ śatruñjaya namo'stu te ।
namo hiraṇyarūpāya kālanetrāya te namaḥ ।।47।।
mahānābha mahāmūla mūlāvāsa namo'stu te ।
dharmāvāsa hṛdāvāsa śuciśravaḥ pṛthuśravā ।।48।।
dharmādhyakṣa prajādhyakṣa kālādhyakṣa namo'stu te ।
gadādhārin padmadhārin śrutipraśna namo'stute ।।49।।
śriyodhara vanamālādhara kṛṣṇa namo'stute ।
puruṣṭata mahākalpa sarvātmaँste namo vibho ।।2.62.50 ।।
dvādaśātmaka kālātman sāmātman parameśvara ।
vyomārkātmaka candrātman sarvasūkṣma namo'stu te ।।51 ।।
nīlakeśa guḍākeśa mahākeśa namo'stu te ।
mañjukeśa hṛṣīkeśa sarvakeśa namo'stu te ।।52।।
śveta rakta tathā pīta citra kṛṣṇa namo'stu te ।
kuśeśaya prītikartargovinda haṃsa te namaḥ ।।53।।
namaste dharmanetrāya sahasrāṃgāya te namaḥ ।
namaste viśvarūpāya dhāmarūpāya te namaḥ ।।54।।
nyagrodhāya pippalāya mahāśākhāya te namaḥ ।
skandhapatrāṃkuralatāpallavāya namo'stu te ।।55।।
tvaṃ vai vedamayo viṣṇustīrthadevamatī vibhuḥ ।
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpastvaṃ yajñabhāgabhuje namaḥ ।।56।।
parabrahma namaste'stu śabdabrahma namo'stu te ।
vidyā tvaṃ vedyarūpastvaṃ vandanīya namo'stu te ।।57।।
nārīvāṇīsvarūpastvaṃ nare dayāsvarūpakaḥ ।
putre vātsalyabhāvastvaṃ tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ।।58।।
uddhāraṃ kuru saṃsārād bhagavan parameśvara ।
ityuktvā maunamāsedustataścāryāyano muniḥ ।।59।।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā śrīkāntaṃ puruṣottamam ।
matsyaṃ namasye kūrmaṃ ca namasye hayaśīrṣakam ।।2.62.60।।
trivikramaṃ namasye ca namasye mādhavaṃ prabhum ।
īśānaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ namasye ca kumārilam ।।61 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ namasye'haṃ namasye garuḍadhvajam ।
narasiṃhaṃ namasye ca namasye kāmapālinam ।।62।।
puṇḍarīkanibhanetraṃ namasye śrīnarāyaṇam ।
namasye dhvajacakrā'bjadhanurmīnasuśūlinam ।।63 ।।
gopatiṃ kambharāputraṃ vibhuṃ gopālanandanam ।
namasye ca gadāpāṇiṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthitam ।।64।।
ardhanārīśvaraṃ nāthaṃ nārīvṛndasukhapradam ।
namasye padmahastaṃ ca padmasakthinamityapi ।।65।।
namasye padmakiraṇaṃ tathordhvarekhapattalam ।
lakṣmīpratimajaghanaṃ namasye vanamālinam ।।66।।
namasye dharaṇināthaṃ namasye'haṃ śriyaḥ patim ।
anāthanātha naukāstha vimānastha ca te namaḥ ।।67।।
hṛtstha bhaktavihārastha dīnarakṣāstha te namaḥ ।
triṇāciketaṃ brahmāṇaṃ namasye ca mahaujasam ।।68 ।।
sarvāmayavināśaṃ ca namasye ghrāṇatarpaṇam ।
namasye rukmakavacaṃ namasye puruṣottamam ।।69।।
vanaspatiṃ madhupatiṃ namasye ca sudhāpatim ।
vāsudevaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ namasye ca yaśodhanam ।।2.62.70।।
sarvabhūtagataṃ śāntaṃ dharmamūrtiṃ pareśvaram ।
namasye mokṣadaṃ nāthaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje ।।7 1 ।।
evaṃ tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ śrīmān āryāyano muniḥ ।
tataḥ pūjāparihāraṃ cakruḥ sāyaṃ surā narāḥ ।।72।।
āryāyano munistatra samuvāca taṭe sadā ।
nāvā cottaritā ye ca narā nāryaśca te harim ।।73।।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nijadeśān vilokitum ।
kārtikānte haristatra sasmāra yānamuttamam ।।74।।
divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ vimānaṃ tatra cāgatam ।
niṣādya tatra sarvāṃstān vyomnā kṣaṇena vegataḥ ।।75।।।
prāpayāmāsa bhagavān dhīravīrasarovaram ।
aravallīśailabhūmau yatra yatra ca janmabhūḥ ।।76।।
tatra tatra prāpitāste narā nāryaḥ sukhāttadā ।
svasvagṛhaṃ gatāḥ sarve kuṭumbaṃ jagadurvṛttam ।। 77।।
sāścaryāste hariṃ bhejuranādiśrīnarāyaṇam ।
atha śrībhagavāँstūrṇaṃ tiro'bhavat sayānakaḥ ।।78।।
samāyayau cāśvapaṭṭasaro naijālayaṃ śubham ।
udayākhyaśca rājarṣiraśvapaṭṭasarovare ।79।।।
japayajñaṃ cakāraiva harernāmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāha hṛdā punaḥ ।।2.62.80।।
mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho śāśvataṃ padamāpnuyām ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha rājā dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ।।81 ।।
līnanāḍīprāṇavegaḥ śanaiḥ prāṇān jahau tadā ।
divyamukto babhūvā'tha vimānena suvarcasā ।।82।।
yayau śrīmatparaṃ dhāma saccidānandalakṣaṇam ।
evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastānuddhadhāra ha ।।83।।
khañjabadhirakāṇādyā ye ye jātāḥ sudehinaḥ ।
te te gatvā nijaṃ deśaṃ gṛhaṃ sukhena saṃsthitāḥ ।।84।।
tān dṛṣṭvā''ścaryamāpannāḥ prajā janāśca darśakāḥ ।
pratāpaṃ paramaṃ matvā bhejire puruṣottamam ।।85।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parabrahma śriyaḥ pate ।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ svāmin rakṣaya sarvadā ।।86।।
śrīharistān dūragāṃśca svapne svaṃ samadarśayat ।
kiśoraṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ dadṛśuste'tibhāsuram ।।87।।
tatra līnāḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ cā'bhavaँste tataḥ punaḥ ।
prabuddhāḥ sasmarurnārāyaṇaṃ gopālabālakam ।।88।।
āyayurdarśanārthaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikālayam ।
sahasraśo narā nāryaḥ samājagmuḥ samantataḥ ।।89।।
dadṛśuryādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapne rūpaṃ tu tādṛśam ।
arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sarvabhāvena śrīpatim ।।2.62.90 ।।
tīrthaṃ vidhāya bahudhā prāpya mantraṃ ca lomaśāt ।
yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ ।।91 ।।
cāturmāsyavratino ye tatrā''yānti sarovaram ।
snātuṃ tebhyo hariḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ svaṃ dadāti vai ।।92।।
vṛddhān pūrṇāyuṣo divyān kṛtvā vimānasaṃsthitān ।
prahiṇoti nijaṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ ca paramaṃ padam ।।93।।।
evaṃ vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rakṣitāḥ ।
prāpitāśca nijān deśān jalamagnoddhṛtā janāḥ ।।94।।
nirugṇāśca kṛtāḥ puṣṭadehāḥ ṣaṇḍāḥ savīryakāḥ ।
pratāpaścātulaścaivaṃ khyāpitaḥ pṛthivītale ।।95।।
kīrtanāt smaraṇādasya camatkārasya śaṃsanāt ।
śravaṇādapi duḥkhāni bhavanti vigatāni vai ।।96।।
rogā naśyanti śīghraṃ ca naśyantyapi mahāpadaḥ ।
āpatkālāḥ praṇaśyanti sadā kṛṣṇakathāśravāt ।। 97।।
stotrāṇāṃ vācanād rādhe rakṣā bhavati sarvathā ।
tīrthasya karaṇād rādhe cābhīṣṭaṃ prāpyate janaiḥ ।। 98।।
aniṣṭaṃ līyate sarvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca vivardhate ।
dhanadhānyaprajāputraparīvārādimān bhavet ।।9 9।।
bhuktiṃ prāpyā'tra ca svarge tato mokṣe mahīyate ।
parabrahmaṇo bhaktasya kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।। 2.62.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jaloddhṛtajanaiḥ kṛtā stutiḥ, rugṇavyaṃgādīnāmaṣṭamavatsarotsave svāsthyakaraṇam, tatkṛtastavanam, āryāyanakṛtastotram, jaloddhṛtānāṃ svadeśaprāpaṇam, udayananṛpasya mokṣaścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 62 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 062 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 63
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 064 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam ।
bhaktarakṣākaraṃ cānyadaṣṭame'bde samudrajam ।। 1 ।।
revātaṭe tu nagaraṃ candrodayāhvayaṃ śubham ।
sarvabhaktāśritaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaprajāśritam ।। 2 ।।
āsīttatra mahāśreṣṭhī dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān ।
vasumedha itināmnā vaiṣṇavo manasā śuciḥ ।। 3 ।।
satāṃ sevāparo nityaṃ devapūjāṃ karoti ca ।
sūryaṃ viṣṇuṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca satīṃ śaṃbhuṃ śriyaṃ harim ।। 4 ।।
prātaḥ snātvā copacāraiḥ sampūjayati sādaram ।
vibhajya bhuṃkte satataṃ dānaṃ dadāti nityaśaḥ ।। 5 ।।
gavāṃ sevāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ karoti ca ।
vyāpāraḥ paṇyaviṣayo bahulābho'sya vardhate ।। 6 ।।
putrāḥ pañca ca kuśalāḥ patnī dharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
suśīlākhyā caikabhuktaṃ vrataṃ carati sarvadā ।। 7 ।।
śālagrāmaṃ samabhyarcya tulasīdalamiśritam ।
patipādodakaspṛṣṭaṃ bhuṃkte bhojyaṃ prasādajam ।। 8 ।।
putrāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve mālādhyānajapārthinaḥ ।
mokṣabhilāṣukāḥ samyak kṛtaśāstrakathāśravāḥ ।। 9 ।।
atha tatra maharṣiśca śatānandābhidho'bhavat ।
uddālakasya putraḥ sa vane kṛtāśramo'bhavat ।। 2.63.1 0।।
śatānando nātidūre candrodayasya sannidhau ।
viprāśrame sadā sāyaṃ samāyāti yadṛcchayā ।। 1 1।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ ca vācayati prage ।
kathāṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā ca bhikṣāṃ yāti nijāśramam ।। 12।
grāmaṃjanāḥ samāyānti kathāṃ śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ ।
tatra śrutaṃ tu saurāṣṭre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।। 13 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kambharāśrīgṛhe hariḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gopālanandanaḥ ।। 14।।
vartate bālarūpo vai bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamīnadhvajatriśūlavān ।। 15।।
dhanuḥsvastikavajrādicihnacihnitahastavān ।
pratyakṣo vartate sarveśvaraḥ śrīpatiravyayaḥ ।। 16।।
koṭikoṭyabjagopīnāṃ prāṇeśaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ ca kathāṃ citrāṃ śrutvā śrīsomatīrthakam ।। 17।।
śrūtvā svarṇapurīṃ puṇyāṃ camatkārapuraṃ tathā ।
tīrthārthaṃ kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ sahānugaḥ ।। 18।।
annavāriphalakandakaṇādikṛtasaṃgrahaḥ ।
viśālāṃ nāvamāruhya dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān ।। 19।।
triṃśadvyaktikṛtasārtho narmadāsalilānugaḥ ।
nāvikaiścālyamānāyāṃ naukāyāṃ sa sthito yayau ।।2.63.20 ।।
yātrārthaṃ tvāyayau nāvā revāsāgarasaṃgamam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parabrahma pareśvara ।।2 1 ।।
kīrtayati satataṃ sasārtho japati mālikām ।
māghe viśramya revāyāḥ saṃge sasnau sahā'nugaiḥ ।।22।।
dadau dānāni vastrānnasvarṇarūpyāṇi bhāvataḥ ।
atha nāvaṃ samāruhyā'khātaṃ vārdheḥ samāgamat ।।23।।
kiṃnadīsaṃgame snātvā'khātamullaṃghya cāyayau ।
śatruñjitābdhisaṃyoge sasnau tu vidhinā'tra saḥ ।।24।।
tasmād yayau gopanāthaṃ tīrthaṃ hariharāśritam ।
tato mūlāṃ yayau svarṇapurīṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇīm ।।25।।
somanāthaṃ yayau snātvā sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame ।
hiraṇyāsaṃgame snātvā kṛtvā tīrthavidhiṃ tataḥ ।।26।।
makarālayatīrthaṃ ca kṛtvā bhadrābdhisaṃgamam ।
yayau tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasvarṇapurīṃ yayau ।।27।।।
dvīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ kacche nārāyaṇasaro yayau ।
parāvṛtya ca naukāyāṃ camatkārapuraṃ yayau ।।28।।
tatastvakhātamārgeṇa parāvṛtya ca sāgare ।
svarṇapurīṃ parityajya jalamārgeṇa gacchati ।।29।।
somanāthaṃ tadā madhye sāmudraṃ vighnamāgamat ।
jhaṃjhāvāto'tivegācca vavau kṣobhakaro mahān ।।2.63.3 0।।
sāmudralaśobhaśca prāleya iva cābhavat ।
nauḥ samākṛṣyate madhye pratikūlena vāyunā ।।3 1 ।।
taraṃgair vīcikallolaistālavṛkṣocchrayaistadā ।
bahvyo naukā nimagnāśca bhagnā naṣṭāśca mānavāḥ ।।32।।
vasumedhasya naukā'pi samutpatati vakragā ।
pārśvayoḥ patamānā ca kallolairjalapūritā ।।33।।
abhavat nāvikāścāpyaśaktā vai rakṣaṇe'bhavan ।
vasumedho vaṇigvaryastatpatnī ca sutādayaḥ ।।34।।
sasmaruḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
śokaṃ cakruśca bahudhā yadarthaṃ vayamāgatāḥ ।।35।।
śrutvā śatānandakathādvārā taṃ bālakṛṣṇakam ।
avilokya mṛtāḥ syāma sāmudre'tra jale'balāḥ ।।36।।
naukāyāṃ pūryate vāri niṣkāsā'dhikamatyati ।
vāyunā hanyate cāpi jalena tāḍyate muhuḥ ।।37।।
pārśvabhāvena cāvartān karoti jalatāḍitā ।
imāścānyā jananāvo vyāpāriṇo layaṃ gatāḥ ।। 38।।
asmannaukā'pi sānnidhye talavāsaṃ samicchati ।
smarantu taṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।। 39।।
yadarthaṃ vayamāyātāḥ sa no rakṣatu hṛcchrayaḥ ।
naukāvyāptaḥ sa bhagavān naukā sthirīkarotu ca ।।2.63.40।।
jhaṃjhāvātagataḥ kṛṣṇo vātaṃ śāmayatu kṣaṇāt ।
jalasthaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo jalasthairyaṃ karotu ca ।।41 ।।
yadvā cenmṛtyumāpannān svātmānaṃ darśayatviha ।
sarvathā vai vayaṃ nātha te smaḥ śaraṇamāgatāḥ ।।42।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa gopālanandana ।
kambharāśrīkumāra tvaṃ rakṣa gopīpate prabho ।।43।।
evaṃ kṛṣṇaparāḥ sarve hatotsāhāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ।
nirāśā jīvane jātā naukāyāṃ vāyuvegataḥ ।।44।।
jalaṃ prapūritaṃ bhūri vāyutāḍanavakritā ।
gatā jalatalaṃ tūrṇaṃ tāvacchrībhagavān svayam ।।45।।
drāgeva tatra cāyātastale kūrmasvarūpataḥ ।
pṛṣṭhe cakāra naukā tāṃ jalopari samānayat ।।46।।
dvitīyena ca rūpeṇa naukāvāho'bhavat prabhuḥ ।
anyairdaśasvarūpaiśca jalaniṣkāsako'bhavat ।।47।।
anyairviṃśatirūpaiśca jale magnāँstu mānavān ।
uddhṛtyoddhṛtya ca naukāmadhye sarvānavāsṛjat ।।48।।
naukāgatāni vastūni jalāntaḥpatitāni ca ।
yāni tānyapi hastaiścoddhṛtya nāvi samākṣipat ।।49।।
jhaṃjhāvātaśca kṛpayā ruddho jalaṃ sthiraṃ hyabhūt ।
naukā sthirā'bhavaccā'pi bhaktā bhagavatā'vitāḥ ।।2.63.50।।
jhanjhāvātena ye cānye bhaktā naukāntare'pi ca ।
āsan magnāśca salile tānuddadhāra līlayā ।।51।।
evaṃ rakṣāṃ svabhaktānāṃ kṛtvā bhūtvaikarūpadhṛk ।
kiśoraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tiro'bhavat ।।52।।
nāvikaiḥ sā śanaiḥ śanaiścālitā tvagragā yayau ।
prāptā śrīsomanāthaṃ sā tatra pakṣasthirīkṛtā ।।53।।
nauvāhāँstatra saṃsthāpya vasumedhaḥ sasārthakaḥ ।
śakaṭaistvarito bhūtvā prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ yayau ।।।54।।
tatra snātvā pitṛdevāँstarpayitvā tataḥ param ।
arkatīrthaṃ tathā balimakhasthalaṃ yayau śubham ।।55।।
tataścāgre vāmanasya sthalīṃ vastrāpathaṃ tathā।
svarṇarekhākṛtasnāno yayau rāṣṭrasarovaram ।।56 ।।
vaṭasthalīṃ yayau paścād yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ।
dūrād vilokya tatkṣetraṃ cakāra bhuvi daṇḍavat ।।57।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro gatvā snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ tathā ।
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sarvatīrthāni sampraṇamya ca ।। 58।।
mahāsaudhaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
kānake mandire divyasiṃhāsanagataṃ harim ।।59 ।।
madhyasūryaprabhaṃ candrānanaṃ śītalakāntikam ।
rūpā'nurūpāvayavaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ।।2.63.6 0।।
sauvarṇamukuṭaṃ ratnahīramauktikamālinam ।
devamānavagāndharvaiḥ stutaṃ saṃpūjitaṃ janaiḥ ।।61।।
natvā tuṣṭāva ca premṇākuṭumbasahito vasuḥ ।
netrāśrūṇi pramuktvā vihvalo gadgadayā girā ।।62।।
bahujanmā'rjitapuṇyaiḥ prāpyate puṇyaśālibhiḥ ।
yaḥ pareśaḥ sa mayā''pto rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ।।6 3।।
yogibhiryogayatnaiśca prāpyate bahuvatsaraiḥ ।
sa mayā'dya prabhurlabdho rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ।।64।।
bhaktaiḥ samprāpyate bhaktyā sarvasvārpaṇayā tu yaḥ ।
so'yaṃ śrīkāntabhagavān mayā''pto rakṣa māṃ hare ।।65।।
tapatāṃ cirakāle'pi kaṣṭasādhyo haristu yaḥ ।
prāpto mayā'dya jīveśo rakṣa māṃ puruṣottama ।।66।।
tārito'bdhau pramajjan vai kuṭumbasahitastvayā ।
samuttāraya deveśa saṃsārābdheśca māṃ punaḥ ।।67।।
tvāṃ vinā jīvanaṃ nāsti santi prāṇā na śāśvatāḥ ।
tvāṃ vinā sampadaḥ sarvā vipadaḥ sambhavanti vai ।।68।।
tvaṃ hṛdi tvaṃ cakṣuṣośca tvamātmani virājase ।
tvaṃ kuṭumbe ca naukāyāṃ jale sthale virājase ।।69।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ tīrthacāraṇam ।
saphalaṃ me kuṭumbaṃ ca sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ gatam ।।2.63.70।।
yadarthaṃ tu gṛhaṃ tyaktvā nirgatastīrthavāñcchayā ।
tāni tīrthāni sarvāṇi nirvṛttānyatra te pade ।।71।।
prāptaṃ prāptavyamevā'tra kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
rakṣa nātha kṛpāsindho tavā'smi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।72।।
ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa papāta caraṇe muhuḥ ।
ratnabhūṣāmbarādyaiśca sugandhacandanādibhiḥ ।।73।।
kuṭumbaṃ tasya sarvaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa taṃ harim ।
tiṣṭaṃśca śrīhareragre nīrājanamathā'karot ।।74।।
śrīharerājñayā miṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ phalajalādikam ।
arpayāmāsa ca tatra sthālyāṃ tvagre harestataḥ ।।75।।
bhagavān bubhuje premṇā prasādaṃ śeṣamamṛtam ।
dadau ca vasumedhāya kuṭumbine'tyanugrahāt ।।76।।
vasumedhādayaḥ sarve bubhujire papurjalam ।
nyūṣurviśrāntisaudhe ca datte bhagavatā tataḥ ।।77।।
evaṃ te daśadivasān yāpayāmāsureva tu ।
ekādaśe dine prātarvasumedhastathā priyā ।।78।।
suśīlā prātarevainamapaśyatāṃ narāyaṇam ।
svapne vimānamāruhya dhāma netuṃ samāgatam ।।79।।
athā'sau dharmamedhastu suśīlā ca drutaṃ tadā ।
putrādīṃśca samudbodhya svāpnaṃ vṛttāntamuttamam ।।2.63.80।।
tebhyo'kathayatāṃ sarvaṃ mokṣalābhātmasūcakam ।
putrā harṣaṃ paraṃ prāptāḥ snātvā sampūjya devatāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tūrṇaṃ yayuśca te sarve bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ tadā ।
haristebhyo dadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ nijagāda tān ।।82।।
lomaśādvai pragṛhṇantu mantraṃ dīkṣāṃ srajaṃ tathā ।
tato'dya sāyaṃ pitrorvo mokṣagatirbhaviṣyati ।।83।।
ityuktāste satvaraṃ ca yayuḥ śrīlomaśāśramam ।
jagṛhuśca manuṃ dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ taulasīṃ srajam ।।84।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
gṛhītvā ca manuṃ bhojyaṃ dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ daduḥ ।।85।।।
āyayuśca nijāvāsaṃ bhejuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ।
aparāhṇe dhyānamagnau tvabhūtāṃ pitarau tadā ।।86।।
putrāḥ kṣamāmayācanta sevāṃ cakruryathocitām ।
kṣaṇāntare samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ divyapārṣadam ।।87।।
vasumedhaṃ suśīlāṃ ca divyadehau vidhāya ca ।
nītavacca brahmadhāma putrā dhanyaṃ vyadhustadā ।।88।।
aurdhvadaihikamevāsya kṛtavantaḥ samāhitāḥ ।
evaṃ mokṣagatiṃ prāptau bhaktau nārāyaṇāśritau ।।89।।
putrāścakruḥ śrāddhakarma tathā'nyacca yathocitam ।
yayuḥ śakaṭamārgeṇa yatra naukā pravartate ।।2.63.90।।
nāvamāruhya ca sarve naijaṃ deśaṃ yayurhi te ।
prāpya deśaṃ camatkāraṃ prāhurnārāyaṇasya vai ।। 91 ।।
śrutvā janā hariṃ bhejuḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam ।
evaṃ te kathitaṃ rādhe caritraṃ pāvanaṃ hareḥ ।। 92।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ śroturvaktuḥ rakṣākaraṃ sadā ।
tīrthaphalapradaṃ svargapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ śubham ।।93।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne candrodayapattanavāsino vasumedhaśreṣṭhino narmadādvārā naukayā tīrthārthaṃ saurāṣṭrasamudre yātasya jhaṃjhāvātena jalamagnasya sakuṭumbasyottāraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena kṛtaṃ, muktidānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 63 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 063 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 64
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 065 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
parabrahma kṛpāsindho gopanāthāhvayaṃ śubham ।
tīrthaṃ saurāṣṭrasāmudratīre proktaṃ tvayā hare ।। 1 ।।
kathaṃ kadā tu tajjātaṃ kathaṃ tannāma sārthakam ।
vada mahyaṃ yathāvattu kṛṣṇa kānta pareśvara ।। 2 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyāṃ kathāṃ tu mama gocarām ।
pūrvapūrveṣu kalpeṣu śrīkṛṣṇā bahavo'bhavan ।। 3 ।।
pūrvāhṇe brahmaṇastatra prātarevā''dyavatsare ।
ādye dine tu golokādahaṃ rādhe tvayā saha ।। 4 ।।
utpannaṃ tvetadaṇḍaṃ vai prārthanayā tu vedhasaḥ ।
draṣṭuṃ samāgatastatra yatra mayā maṇirmama ।। 5 ।।
nikṣiptaścātra gole sa saurāṣṭraviṣayo'bhavat ।
tatrāgatya mayā divyavimānaṃ svarṇanirmitam ।। 6 ।।
gopagopīgaṇairjuṣṭaṃ gobhiryuktaṃ manoharam ।
vistṛte ca maṇerdeśe vyomno mayā'vatāritam ।। 7 ।।
gopā gopyaśca rādhe tvamahaṃ nyūṣurjalāntikam ।
bhuktavantaścāmṛtāni dugdhāni ca gavāṃ tathā ।। 8 ।।
gāvastatra viharanti gopāḥ krīḍanti tadvane ।
gopyo gopā ramante ca divye mannirmite sthale ।। 9 ।।
tatrā'haṃ tu tvayā sākaṃ rādhe vṛkṣeṣu sarvataḥ ।
gobhirgopairgopībhiśca vyacaraṃ vāsamācaran ।। 2.64.1 0।।
tadā sanatkumārādyāḥ ṛṣayastatra cāyayuḥ ।
jñātvā śrīśaṃkaro bhakto viṣṇuścāyayatustadā ।। 11 ।।
gopairmayā tvayā cāpi gopībhistau susatkṛtau ।
pūjitau vandito miṣṭaṃ bhojitau sevitau mudā ।। 12।।
yatra sthāne kṛtāvāsau śrīviṣṇuśaṃkarau surau ।
gopaiḥ sampūjitau tatra surau hariharātmakau ।। 13।।
tāvat tatra samāyāto brahmā vijñāya satvaram।
so'pi saṃpūjito gopairmayā tvayā ca satkṛtaḥ ।। 14।।
athā'nye pārṣadā jñātvā viṣṇorharasya vedhasaḥ ।
devyo dāsyaḥ samāyātāstasthustatra same sthale ।। 15।।
tato'haṃ pṛṣṭavāँstebhyo mayā pṛthvyāṃ śubhe sthale ।
prākaṭyamiṣyate śīghraṃ lokakalyāṇahetave ।। 16।।
tāvat tatra samāyātau dharaṇimeruparvatau ।
prārthayāmāsatustau māṃ putrārthaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām ।। 17।।
mayā tathā'stviti proktaṃ tau tadā brahmaṇaḥ śubham ।
mānasaṃ yugalaṃ jātaṃ mānavaṃ tu surāṣṭrake ।। 18।।
nāmnā merudharo gopaḥ kṣamādevī ca gopikā ।
somanāthasamīpe tau divyaṃ vāsaṃ pracakratuḥ ।।19।।
gopā gopyastathā gāvaḥ sampūjya tu hariṃ haram ।
yayuḥ sarve kṣamādevyā sākaṃ ca meruṇā saha ।।2.64.20।।
siṃhāraṇye kṛtāvāsāstiṣṭhanti sma ca moditāḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ śrīgopanāthaśca viṣṇurgopīśvarastathā ।।21 ।।
yatsthāne pūjitau tatra mūrtyātmānau babhūvatuḥ ।
tatra gopāśca gopyaśca nityamāyānti yānti ca ।।22।।
gopanāthaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ jātaṃ hariharātmakam ।
pāvanaṃ paramaṃ rādhe! tava me pādapāvitam ।।23 ।।
yatra meruḥ svayaṃ cāste kṣamā ca jananī mama ।
tatrā'haṃ rādhike! jātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ।।24।।
tvaṃ mayā saha gopyaśca mānasyaścetarā api ।
vyajāyanta ca tatraiva merukoṭītipattane ।।25।।
hiraṇyā vidyate yatra yatra prācī sarasvatī ।
someśo vidyate yatra sā bhūmirmerukoṭikā ।।26।।
pradeśaḥ sa ca me līlāmayaḥ pūrvaprage'bhavat ।
rādhe! tvaccaraṇavyāpto mokṣadvāramapāvṛtam ।।27।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān gururme tatra cā'bhavat ।
gopā gopāṃganā gāvastatra nyūṣuḥ sadā mama ।।28।।
gopālo'haṃ tadā cāsaṃ mūlamādyaṃ sthalaṃ mama ।
mūlā sā dvārikā me'tra merukoṭītiviśrutā ।।29।।
pūrve śatruṃjitā yāvat paścime tu sarasvatī ।
uttare tu mahābhadrānadī kṣetraṃ purā mama ।।2.64.3 0 ।।
kṛtasmaraḥ parvataśca siṃhāraṇyaṃ mahadvanam ।
vyāghrāraṇyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaraśceti ca bhūrmama ।।3 1 ।।
vihārasya parā bhūmiścāsīd rādhe vinodinī ।
yatra gopāśca gopyaśca gāvaśca vyomamārgagāḥ ।।32।।
viharanti sma nityaṃ vai merudevapratāpataḥ ।
tatra me pārṣadā devā devyaśca kṛtaketanāḥ ।।33।।
nyūṣuḥ sthale sthale sarve mama sevecchayā sadā ।
saurāṣṭraṃ kṛṣṇabhaktābhirgopībhiḥ pūritaṃ tadā ।।34।।
āsīd rādhe ca gopaiśca golokaṃ dhāma tattathā ।
gāruḍī saṃhitā cāsīnmamaiśvaryavivecinī ।।35।।
madhuvatyāstaṭe tatra mamāsīt kuñjabhūmikā ।
siṃhāraṇyasya madhye ca divyālayaḥ purā mama ।।36।।
parikhāveṣṭitaścāsīdakhātamadhyaśobhitaḥ ।
yojanadvayavistārodyānamadhye vyavasthitaḥ ।।37।।
yatra patnyo mama sarvā rājñyaścāsan suśobhanāḥ ।
vaihāyasā vimānena sarvayātrākarāḥ priyāḥ ।।38।।
pārṣadā mama vai sarve saurāṣṭre vividhe sthale ।
devā devyastadā nyūṣurmamājñayā ca rādhike ।।3 9।।
ādityā dvādaśa rudrā ekādaśā'śvināvubhau ।
vasavo'ṣṭau nidhayo'pi navā'ṣṭasiddhayastathā ।।2.64.40।।
saptarṣayo daśabāṇā manavastithidevatāḥ ।
kalāstattvāni nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ guṇakoṭayaḥ ।।41।।
maruto yoginīcakraṃ kalā nāḍyaśca dāsikāḥ ।
vālakhilyāḥ pūrvasṛṣṭibhavā nyūṣurmamāśraye ।।42।।।
virajā kamalā gaṃgā ramā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।
durgā rādhā padminī ca pārvatī mañjulā prabhā ।।43।।
saguṇā śāradā haṃsā suśīlā subhagā śriyaḥ ।
ityādyā mama golokādāgatya ca mamālaye ।।44।।
vāsaṃ cakrustathā nadyastīrthāni divyabhūmikāḥ ।
kalpavṛkṣāḥ kalpavallyaḥ kalpastambatṛṇādayaḥ ।।45।।
kalpayānāni ca kalpamaṇayaḥ kalpamālikāḥ ।
kalpapātrāṇi ca kalpopaskaraṇāni yānyapi ।।46।।
kalpapāvaṭikāḥ kalpagūṭikāḥ kalpakaṇṭhikāḥ ।
kalpormikāśca divyāstā mūrtimatyo vasanti hi ।।47।।
evaṃ vai rādhike! tubhyaṃ smāritaṃ prāgudantakam ।
gurjare ca marau kacche dakṣiṇe cottare tathā ।।48।।
pūrve'pi mama janmāni hyanantāni bhavanti hi ।
kvacid deve kvacit। tvārṣe kvacicca mānave kule ।।49।।
dvije vā'nyakule cāsmi saṃjātaḥ kāryakāṃkṣayā ।
tvaṃ māṃ naiva kadācicca tyajasyeva hṛdi sthitā ।।2.64.50 ।।
yatra kvāpi sthitaścā'smi tvayā sahaiva rādhike! ।
goloke gomaṇḍale ca gopījane'pi sarvadā ।।51 ।।
gopeṣvapi ca rādhe tvāṃ jahāmyeva na karhicit ।
yathā''tmā'haṃ tathā tvaṃ ca mama śaktiḥ parā matā ।।52।।
evaṃ māṃ bhajamānāstu saśaktikaṃ pareśvaram ।
yānti dhāma tu golokaṃ mama pārśve vasanti te ।।53।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe! mama janmādi prāgbhavam ।
smaraṇācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ prajāyate ।।54।।
jīrṇoddhāraṃ kariṣyanti kārayiṣyanti matsthale ।
te malloke mama pārśve nivatsyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।55।।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gopanāthamāhātmye saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇasya sarvādikṣetratīrthakṣetranirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 64 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 064 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 65
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 066 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athāpi tvaṃ śṛṇu rādhe! sarvapāvanapāvanam ।
ārṣaṃ vidhānaṃ kṛṣṇasya lokaṃ cānusṛtasya ha ।। 1 ।।
svayaṃ vedapraṇetā yo brahmāṇaṃ śāsti vai purā ।
so'yaṃ lokaṃ samāśritya pālayitvā vidhiṃ nijam ।। 2 ।।
gṛhṇāti brahmasaṃskāraṃ prākṛto brahmapā yathā ।
dvijatvaṃ yena sṛṣṭyādau nirmitaṃ śreyase sadā ।। 3 ।।
sa tu sūtraṃ samagṛhya dvijo bhavati cā'dvijaḥ ।
yasya saṃsparśanānnāryo narā vṛkṣāśca vallayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
paśupretapiśācādyāḥ śuddhyanti cātmadarśinaḥ ।
yasya yogena kāmādyā bhajante divyatāṃ sadā ।। 5 ।।
yadyogaṃ prāpya yakṣā vā rākṣasā mlecchayonayaḥ ।
divyā bhavanti ca kṣaṇāt so'yaṃ brahmagraho'bhavat ।। 6 ।।
rādhike lomaśaḥ prāha pitaraṃ mātaraṃ hareḥ ।
yajñopavītayogyo'yaṃ vartate yajñapāvanaḥ ।। 7 ।।
deyaṃ cāsmai brahmasūtraṃ sūtrayitre parātmane ।
śrutvaivaṃ śobhanaṃ vākyaṃ lomaśasya mukhāttataḥ ।। 8 ।।
prasannau pitarau yogyaṃ praṇematurmuniṃ tadā ।
bhaktyā gopālakṛṣṇaśca divyaṃ gajāsanaṃ dadau ।। 9 ।।
madhuparkaṃ dadau hārān miṣṭānnaṃ salilaṃ dadau ।
tāmbūlaṃ pradadau cāpi phalaṃ vastraṃ śubhaṃ dadau ।। 2.65.1 0।।
uvāca lomaśaṃ śubhotsavakṣaṇaṃ kuru prabho ।
vaiśākho'yaṃ samāyāti bhavate rocate yadi ।। 11 ।।
kartavyaścotsavastatra mama bhātyeva sarvathā ।
yajñopavītayogyaṃ ca dinaṃ śasyaṃ pradarśaya ।। 12।।
lomaśastu tataḥ prāha śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
akṣayā cottamā cāste tṛtīyā'kṣayadāyinī ।। 13।।
candrarkṣabalaśuddhyādi sarvaṃ śubhaṃ pravartate ।
āmantraṇaṃ ca trailokye sarvebhyo dehi tattathā ।। 14।।
saṃbhārān divyabhogāṃśca sañcinuhyatidurlabhān ।
bhinnalokanivāsānāṃ yogyān sevyottamottamān ।। 15।।
lomaśasya vacaḥ śrutvā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
preṣayāmāsa sarvatra divyā maṃgalapatrikāḥ ।। 16।।
aśvapaṭṭasarovāsaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ sevakaistathā ।
vimānasthairdivyayānaiḥ preṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।। 17।।
janmā'ṣṭame'bde vaiśākhe śukle'kṣayatithau mama ।
putrasya śrīhareryajñopavītaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ।। 18।।
avatāraistathā muktairmuktābhirdhāmabhiḥ saha ।
brahmabhiḥ pārṣadaiḥ pārṣadānībhiḥ saha sarvathā ।। 19।।
satībhiḥ sevikābhiścā'vatāriṇībhirityapi ।
īśābhirīśvaraiścāpi ṛṣibhiśca kuṭumbibhiḥ ।।2.65.20।।
sādhubhiryatibhiścāpi bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ saha ।
bhāgavatābhirbhaktābhiḥ samāgantavyamādarāt ।।21 ।।
pitṛbhiḥ patnikāyuktairdevairdevīsamanvitaiḥ ।
dikpālairlokapālaiśca grahanakṣatramaṇḍalaiḥ ।।22।।
tārābhiśca tathā tattvairbhuvarvāsibhirityapi ।
mānavairdrumavallyādyaiḥ kalpapādapavaṃśajaiḥ ।।23।।
tṛṇaiḥ stambaiḥ samudbhijjairaṇḍajairgāyakairjanaiḥ ।
vidyādhraiḥ kinnaraiścāpi kimpuṃbhirnṛtyavedibhiḥ ।।24।।
nartakībhiścāraṇaiśca dharmā'dharmādivaṃśajaiḥ ।
surā'surakuṭumbaiśca digīśvaraiḥ samantataḥ ।।25।।
āgantavyaṃ yajñasūtrotsave madbālakasya vai ।
tīrthairnadanadībhiścā'raṇyairvanaiḥ sarovaraiḥ ।।26।।
samudrā'khātakūpādyairnagaiḥ khagaiḥ samantataḥ ।
vasundharāsthitaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ ca pakṣibhiḥ ।।27।।
guṇairguṇāśrayaiścāpi mūrtā'mūrtaiḥ samādarāt ।
kālaiḥ ṛtubhirādyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sahavatsaraiḥ ।।28।।
kāmadhenubhirevāpi vasubhiḥ siddhibhistathā ।
nidhibhirviṣṇurudrādyairbrahmādyairbahumastakaiḥ ।।29।।
indrādirājavaryaiśca mānavairmunibhistathā ।
vipraiḥ kṣatriyavaryaiśca vaiśyaiśca sevakaistathā ।।2.65.3 0।।
sāttvikaiḥ rājasaiścāpi tāmasairmāyikaistathā ।
māyābhiḥ prakṛtibhiścā''gantavyaṃ copavītake ।।3 1 ।।
atalādisthitairdaityairdānavaiścāsurairapi ।
nāgaiḥ sarpaiḥ sahabandhumitrakuṭumbidehibhiḥ ।।3 2।।
āgantavyaṃ vāhanaiśca sādhanaiśca rasaistathā ।
divyā''divyābhirevā'tra vidyābhiśca kalādibhiḥ ।।33 ।।
bhavatāṃ tejasā sārairāśīrbhirmama bālakaḥ ।
vardhito yajñavat puṇyarāśiḥ sampatsyate dhruvam ।।34।।।
ityevaṃ preṣayitvā ca patrikāḥ sevakaistataḥ ।
śuddhasattvavibhūteśca yāni bhojyāni dhāmasu ।।35।।
pare brahmaṇyakṣare ca goloke ca vikuṇṭhake ।
amṛte ceśvaraloke satyaloke'mṛtāni ca ।।36।।
brahmajalāni divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yānyapi ।
teṣāṃ ca sañcayāँstatra kārayāmāsa satvaram ।।37।।
bhuvarmaharjanalokādiṣvapi yāni yāni ca ।
khādyapeyopakāryāṇi teṣāṃ ca sañcayāँstathā ।।38।।
svarge tapasi mervādau pṛthvyāṃ pātālasaptake ।
bhojyakhādyaprapeyāni copakāryāṇi yāni ca ।। 39।।
mṛdyasevyopabhogyāni dehiyogyāni yāni ca ।
calasthāvarayogyāni mūrtā'mūrtā'rthakāni ca ।।2.65.40।।
teṣāṃ sarvapravastūnāṃ sañcayānavyayāँstathā ।
kārayāmāsa bahudhā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।41 ।।
brahmahadān kalpahradān kalpavṛkṣarasādikān ।
akṣayāṇi ca pātrāṇi āpūrakadalāँstathā ।।42।।
avyayān kośapadmāँśca siddhipātrottamāni ca ।
sañcayāmāsa paritaḥ siddhayaṣṭīśca gūṭikāḥ ।।43।।
sahasrapradapātrāṇi cintāmaṇīn bahūँstathā ।
camatkārakṛtāँścāpi brahmapuṣpottamāni ca ।।44।।
devamāyāprakāṇḍāni devīsūtrāṇi yāni ca ।
aindrajālikapāśāँśca maṇikān lakṣadāँstathā ।।45।।
mantrayantrāṇi tantrāṇi camatkārakaṇāँstathā ।
yogaiśvaryā'mṛtanālīḥ sañcayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।।46।।
yogacullīryogadarvīryogakaṭāhavāṭikāḥ ।
yogasthālīryogadīpān sañcayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।।47।।
yogāsanāni sarvāṇi sārvabhaumā'mṛtāni ca ।
kalpartūn kalpakaṇṭhīśca kalpavalayakormikāḥ ।।48।।
sañcayāmāsa bahudhā yāvadātithyahetave ।
bhautikāni ca bhojyāni peyāni bhautikāni ca ।।49।।
sūkṣmabhūtajabhojyāni peyāni sūkṣmajānyapi ।
vyaktajanyāni bhojyāni peyāni vyaktajāni ca ।।2.65.50।।
avyaktajāni bhojyāni peyānyavyaktajāni ca ।
māyājanyāni sarvāṇi tathā brāhmāṇi yāni ca ।।51।।
ākṣarāṇyapi divyāni ātmamayāni yāni ca ।
snehajānyapi sarvāṇi puṇyatattvodbhavāni ca ।।52।।
sarvāṇyapi ca bhogyāni sañcayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।
rasakulyā ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā manoharāḥ ।।53।।
madhukulyā guḍakulyāḥ śarkarākhaṇḍikāhradān ।
ikṣukulyā amṛtānāṃ hradān miṣṭasarāṃsi ca ।।54।।
sañcayāmāsa paritaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
upahārasahasrāṇāṃ parvatān pracakāra saḥ ।।55।।
ratnānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca mauktikānāṃ samucchrayān ।
suvarṇānāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ ca parvatān ।।56।।
māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ vibhūṣāṇāṃ ca parvatān ।
vastrālaṃkārarāśīṃśca kārayāmāsa vai tadā ।।57।।
cūrṇānāṃ gandhasārāṇāṃ tailānāṃ ca sugandhinām ।
lepānāṃ kajjalānāṃ ca raṃgānāṃ sañcayāँstathā ।।।58।।
candanānāṃ kuṃkumānā kesarāṇāṃ ca saṃcayān ।
kastūrīṇāṃ cauṣadhānāṃ rāśīn cakāra cāvyayān ।।59।।
darpaṇānāṃ kaṃkatīnāṃ śuddhidravyamṛdāṃ tathā ।
śayanānāṃ ca dolānāmāsanānāṃ ca cakriṇām ।।2.65.60।।
yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ cā'saṃkhyasañcayakān vyadhāt ।
evaṃ sarvopabhogyādau sampanne pūrṇatāṃgate ।।61 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sasmāra vai kramāt ।
paradhāmasthamuktāँśca muktānīrapi sarvaśaḥ ।।62।।
akṣarasthān muktavargān muktānīrapi cākṣaram ।
avatārānavatāriṇīśca pārṣadapuṃgavān ।।63।।
pārṣadānīśca vai bhaktān bhaktānīrapi sarvaśaḥ ।
caturviṃśativiṣṇūँśca caturvyūhāँstathā kramāt ।।64।।
parameśānīśvarāँśca īśvarāṇīśca sarvaśaḥ ।
vairājān brahmaśaṃbhūँśca rudrān viṣṇūn ṛṣīṃstathā ।।65।।
sādhūn sādhvīḥ satīḥ patnīḥ priyā devī ramādikāḥ ।
rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ pārvatīṃ ca prabhāṃ haṃsāṃ ca māṇikīm ।।66।।
dvādaśottaraśatamukhyāśca patnīrnijāḥ parāḥ ।
koṭidāsīstathā dāsān golokasthān gavādikān ।।67।।
caturvaikuṇṭhasaṃsthāँśca badaryāśramavāsinaḥ ।
satyasthān svargavāsāँśca parasvargagatāँstathā ।।68।।
pitṛn siddhān cāraṇāँśca munīndrān suramānavān ।
sasmāra ca diśāṃ pālān nṛpatīn surapālakān ।।69।।
bhuvaḥsthān pṛthivīsthāँśca saptapātālavāsinaḥ ।
jalasthalasthitān sarvān sthāvarān jaṃgamāँstathā ।।2.65.70।।
brahmasarasastathā cāpsarasaḥ kanyakottamāḥ ।
bhāṭacāraṇagandharvān kiṃpuṃkinnaramāgadhān ।।71।।
cāraṇān vādakāँścāpi gāyakān nartakāṃstathā ।
naṭān nāṭakakartṝṃśca nāṭyasaṃghapradarśakān ।।72।।
mallān kalākarāँścāpi mahendrajālikāँstathā ।
svādakarāँstathā sūdān pākinaḥ pariveṣakān ।।73।।
yajñīyān yajñavetṝँśca karmakāṇḍaparāँstathā ।
brāhmaṇāँśca maharṣīṃśca kṣetradvārādipālakān ।।74।।
sasmāra divyatattvāni divyā'mūrtikamānavān ।
jalasthalanivāsāँśca daityadānavarākṣasān ।।75।।
dīnān raṃkān sataḥ sāṃkhyayoginīśca pativratāḥ ।
kanyā devīśca kulajāḥ kulapūjyāśca yoginīḥ ।।76।।
kailāsabadarīvāsān kṣīraśvetanivāsinaḥ ।
pṛthvīsthakhaṇḍavāsāँśca sasmāra śrīharistadā ।।77।।
bhaktān gopān gopikāśca koṭyarbudābjaśevadhīn ।
sasmāra vālakhilyāँśca yatīn jñānāśrayān nijān ।।78।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāminarāyaṇaḥ ।
sasmāra divyamanasā bhaktāṃśca bhaktavatsalaḥ ।।79।।
akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ।
brahmavadgatikā yānairvaihāyasaiśca mānasaiḥ ।।2.65.80।।
ātmayānairyogayānaiḥ samādhivāhanaistathā ।
vāyuvāhaiścāmbarātmavāhanaiśca samāyayuḥ ।।8 1 ।।
garuḍaiśca tathā haṃsaiḥ śukairmayūramūṣakaiḥ ।
vināyakā gaṇeśāśca vighneśāstatra cāyayuḥ ।।।82।।।
gajairaśvairanalaiśca kuṃjakaiḥ sārasādibhiḥ ।
meghairgrahaistathā vidyullatābhiḥ kiraṇaistathā ।।83।।
sūryacandrādayastūrṇaṃ tejovāhāḥ samāgatāḥ ।
manovāhāḥ kalpavāhā vegavāhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।84।।
muktāścāpyavatārāśca vyūhāścāpīśvarāstathā ।
brahmadhāmagatāḥ sarve īśadhāmagatāstathā ।।85।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīrādhāramādikāstathā ।
koṭikoṭyarbujābjādiśevadhiśrīsakhīyutāḥ ।।86।।
koṭikoṭyarbujābjādisevakaiḥ sahitāstathā ।
rāmamādhavagovindā gopālā gopikāstathā ।।87।।
viṣṇavo vaiṣṇavīśaktipramukhā bhūmadevatāḥ ।
vairājā brahmarudrādyāḥ śatakoṭipramastakāḥ ।।88।।
satyasthāḥ sādhavo devā yataya brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
vedā vidyāstathā mantrā yajñā havīṃṣi yāni ca ।।89।।
samāyayurdivyarūpā vahnayo marutastathā ।
tejāṃsi cāpi sarvāṇi pitaraḥ ṛṣayo'marāḥ ।।2.65.90।।
pramunīndrāḥ satpuruṣāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
brahmapriyāḥ kṛṣṇapriyā devapriyāḥ samantataḥ ।।91।।
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājñyo rājāna ityapi ।
brahmakanyāḥ ṛṣikanyā jalakanyāḥ samudrajāḥ ।।92।।
devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca koṭiśaḥ ।
kumārikāśca gāndharvyo vidyādharyaśca sarvaśaḥ ।।93।।
vādikā vādakāścāpi yaśogāyāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
bhāṇḍakāścāraṇādyāśca bhāṭā naṭāśca nartakāḥ ।।94।।
caiṣṭikā aitihikāḥ kathakā hāsakā api ।
brāhmaṇā bhikṣukāḥ sanyāsārthā muṇḍadharāstathā ।।95।।
avadhūtā brahmacārā yogacārāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
svastrībāndhavabālādyairyutā dvitīyaviśramāḥ ।।96।।
patnīvratasya vaṃśāśca pativratākuṭumbinaḥ ।
bandhubāndhavayogāśca tadyogāstatsuyoginaḥ ।।97।।
naikakṣityudbhavāḥ sarve varṣmadhrā hi samāyayuḥ ।
viṣṇugaṇā rudragaṇā brahmagaṇā asaṃkhyakāḥ ।।98।।
dīpāvalyo nālamedhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevyastalājikā ।
gokumāryastathā'rjantyā yuvatyaḥ śatakanyakāḥ ।।99।।
koṭiśaḥ kandarā kanyāstathā krodhanikā satī ।
lakṣaṃ ca rākṣasīkanyāḥ kaṃkatālyaśca pañcaṣaḥ ।। 2.65.10 0।।
kaṃkatālikakanyāśca sahasraśo hyupasthitāḥ ।
brahmakanyā jalakanyā'ryamakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 10 1।।
kuberakanyakāścendrakanyā yamasutāstathā ।
vāyukanyāḥ ṛtukanyā viśvakarmasutāstathā ।। 1 02।।
drumakanyā dānavādikanyāpañcasahasrakam ।
vasantasya tathā patnyaḥ ṣoḍaśāpi hyupasthitāḥ ।। 1 03।।
vahnikanyāstathā sālamālakanyāsahasrakam ।
śravaṇakanyakāḥ śāvadīnakanyāsahasrakam ।। 1 04।।
aindrajālikaraudryaśca sahasrakanyakāstathā ।
vidyākanyāḥ kiśoryaśca ṣaṣṭikanyā hyupasthitāḥ ।। 1 05।।
samvatsarasya kanyāśca vārkṣyaḥ kanyā asaṃkhyakāḥ ।
khanijāḥ kanyakāścāpi sopakuṃbhā hyupasthitāḥ ।। 10 6।।
upasthitā lakṣmaṇasya sahasradvayaputrikāḥ ।
upasthitā viśvāvasostadā triśataputrikāḥ ।। 107 ।।
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi vedhaḥkanyā upasthitāḥ ।
jumāsemlānṛpasyāpi tasthuḥ sahasrakanyakāḥ ।। 1 08।।
kārṣṇyaḥ kumārikāḥ śatottaradvādaśasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
māgalyārthaṃ harestasya kāntasyā'rthamupasthitāḥ ।। 1 09।।
cakrustāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kīrtanāni vai ।
āgatebhyaśca saṃghebhyaścāvāsān pradadau pitā ।। 2.65.11 0।।
satkārān madhuparkādi yathārhaṃ bahudhā dadau ।
athāpi rādhike! tatra samāyānti maharṣayaḥ ।। 11 1।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoraṣṭame varṣe vaiśākhe yajñopavītamahotsave āmantraṇapatrikādvārā sarveṣāmāgamanādinidarśananāmā pañcaṣaṣṭi-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 65 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike divyamaharṣayaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
samīraṇaḥ pavamānaḥ santāraṇaśca barburaḥ ।। 1 ।।
voḍhuśca ghanabhedaśca dyuviśrāmaśca paṃkilaḥ ।
nīlakarṇastathā'larkaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ kalāyanaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vītihotraśca camasaḥ parṇakutso'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
bhāllaveyaścorjavrataścā''śvalāyana ityapi । । 3 ।।
pārṣṇiradaḥ sumantuśca hyaśokākṣo'bhayākṣakaḥ ।
brahmastambaḥ kūpyavālaścetanabrahma ityapi ।। 4 ।।
mṛtadaṇḍaścopatasthustatratyāstanmahotsave ।
sadāraputrakanyādyāḥ sabhṛtyadāsadāsikāḥ ।। 5 ।।
kauṇḍinyaḥ kauśikaḥ pautimāṣyo gaupavanastathā ।
