vedaḥ sarvātmakaścaikaḥ sāmaḥ śrīmukhanirgataḥ ।
śākhā patnīvratīyā ca śākhī tvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 17।।
ityevaṃ rādhike karma samāpya mahīmānakān ।
saṃsadaḥ parihāraṃ ca cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 118 ।।


iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yajñopavītapradānavidhipūjādi- nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 66 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 066 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 67
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 068 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrīmatkṛṣṇasya ca rādhe yajñopavītakottaram ।
mahīmānā nivāseṣu yayustasmāt sabhāsthalāt ।। 1 ।।
tato gopālakṛṣṇo vai tathā śrīkambharāsatī ।
guṇātītāstathā muktāstathā kanyā hyasaṃkhyakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
ṛṣayastannivāsāśca tīrthāni mūrtavallayaḥ ।
tattvānyapi ca divyāni śrīmukhyāḥ śaktayastathā ।। 3 ।।
bhojanāvasare jāte dvārapaṃ brahmanādakam ।
sūcayāmāsurevā'tra āhvānārthaṃ kṣaṇācca saḥ।। 4 ।।
brahmaghaṇṭāṃ miṣṭaravāṃ sṛṣṭitrayāptanādinīm ।
nādayāmāsa madhurasvarāṃ bhojanabodhikām ।। 5 ।।
avatāreśvarāṇāṃ ca bhagavatāṃ ca paṃktayaḥ ।
muktānāṃ dhāmasaṃsthānāṃ muktānīnāṃ tadā'bhavan ।। 6 ।।
vāsudevaprabhṛtīnāṃ vairājāntakadehinām ।
divyānāmīśvarīṇāṃ ca paṃktayaḥ śataśo'bhavan ।। 7 ।।
divyā'rbudā'bjapadmāni kanyānāṃ vidadhustadā ।
dhāmānītātmabhojyādyamṛtānāṃ pariveṣaṇam ।। 8 ।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni divyāni lehyacośyāni tattathā ।
miṣṭapeyāni cānyāni pākaśākāni tāni ca ।। 9 ।।
rasān divyān cāranālān dravān divyān tathāvidhān ।
yogyān brahmahradodbhūtān brahmavāṭīsamudbhavān ।। 2.67.1 0।।
brahmapriyābhiḥ pakvāśca tābhiḥ susaṃskṛtān śubhān ।
apārāṇi ca tāḥ pariveṣayāmāsurādarāt ।। 11 ।।
sthāleṣu svarṇapātreṣu copapātreṣu vai śubham ।
ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo dugdhapākaṃ madhu ca śarkarām ।। 1 2।।
odanāni dvidalāśca sūpaṃ miṣṭānnakāni ca ।
pāyasānnāni sarvāṇi meśubhānyapi sarvathā ।। 13।।
mohasthālāni miṣṭāni tathā'pūpāni mauktikān ।
sūtraphenīṃ laḍḍukāँśca catuṣkān śaṣkulīṃstathā ।। 14 ।।
śāṭakān ghṛtapūrāँśca miṣṭāntaḥpolikāstathā ।
phulavaṭīḥ rājatṛptān kvathikā bharjikāstathā ।। 15 ।।
kalikā sevikāścāpi saṃyāvaṃ bhājikāstathā ।
caṭanīrvividhāścāpi tiktalāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtān ।। 16 ।।
rukṣasaṃskṛtabhakṣyāँśca bhojayāmāsurādarāt ।
jalāni miṣṭapeyāni takrāṇi navanītakam ।। 17।।
phalāni phalabījāni saugandhikadalāni ca ।
dadustato'timagnāśca cakrurbhājanamīśvarāḥ ।। 18।।
īśvarāṇyatha tā muktā muktasya parameśvarāḥ ।
brahmasakhyaḥ prasahyaiva dadurbhojyādikāni tu ।। 19।।
ākaṇṭhaṃ bhojayāmāsustṛptāśculukamādadhuḥ ।
jalapānaṃ pracakruśca tāmbūlāni ca jagṛhuḥ ।। 2.67.20 ।।
mukhamiṣṭāni cūrṇāni jagṛhuste tataḥ param ।
yayurnaijanivāsāँśca brahmasṛṣṭīśasṛṣṭikāḥ ।।21 ।।
atha brahmāṇamārabhya viṣṇuśaṃkaratatprajāḥ ।
devā devyaḥ pitaraśca satyādibhuvarāntakāḥ ।।22।
sādhyā viśve ca dikpālā sureśvarādayastathā ।
surāṇyaḥ kanyakā sarvā niṣedustatra paṃktiṣu ।।23।।
tebhyastābhyo brahmakanyāḥ kārṣṇyaścāpi mudā muhuḥ ।
āsanāni daduḥ pariveṣaṇaṃ vidadhurmuhuḥ ।।24।।।
satyodbhavāni miṣṭānnapānapātrāṇi vai daduḥ ।
miṣṭānnānyamṛtānnāni bhakṣyabhojyāni tāni ca ।। 25।।
lehyacoṣyāṇi sarvāṇi svādyapeyāni vai tathā ।
annaśākarasacūrṇaprabhṛtīni dadau muhuḥ ।।26।।
bhuktavantaśca te devā jalaṃ papustataḥ param ।
tāmbūlādimukhā''vāsaṃ jagṛhuścā''layaṃ yayuḥ ।।।27।।
atharṣayo manuṣyāśca pārthivāsanadehinaḥ ।
catuḥkhanisamutpannā niṣeduḥ paṃktiṣu drutam ।।।28।।
divyā'divyāstathā mūrtā'mūrtāścarā'carāstathā ।
niṣedurbhojanapaṃktivartuleṣu mudānvitāḥ ।।29।।
lomaśāśramakanyāśca pātrāṇi cāsanāni ca ।
dadustebhyo'pi pariveṣayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ।।2.67.3 0।।
aṣṭakalpasya daivasya sargasya kanyakāstadā ।
aṣṭadaivaprasargāśca cakrurbhojanamutsukāḥ ।।3 1।।
amṛtāni hyanantāni miṣṭānnāni dyumanti ca ।
rasān bhojyān bhakṣyacoṣyānlehyān peyān rasānvitān ।32।
tattaddevanikāyebhyo yogyān daduśca tāstadā ।
tṛptā bhuktvā tu te pānaṃ papuśca mukhavāsakam ।।33।।
tāmbūlakādi jagṛhuryayuścā''vāsamutsukāḥ ।
athā'talādilokānāṃ vāsināṃ paṃktayastadā ।।34।।
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā ।
nāgānāṃ bhogināṃ jaleśayānāṃ paṃktayo'bhavan ।।35।।
tattallokārhabhojyāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ।
lehyānyapi ca coṣyāṇi āsvādyānyapi sarvathā ।।36।।
vyañjanāni ca peyāni rasasārāṇi kanyakāḥ ।
yogyapātrādiṣu pariveṣayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।37।।
mūrtānāṃ cā'mūrtatattvottamānāṃ guṇaśālinām ।
guṇānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanārthinām ।।38।।
dīnā'ndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca naranārīnapuṃjuṣām ।
śreṇyaścarā'carāṇāṃ cā'bhavan yogyāśca dāsikāḥ ।।39।।
dāsā viprāśca tān pariveṣayāmāsuratyati ।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ peyaṃ daduḥ suśītalam ।।2.67.40।।
vanasārān jalasārān vahnisārān kṣiteḥ rasān ।
dhenusārāँstṛṇasārān kandasārān pramedakān ।।41।।
dehasārān paṃkasārān puṣpasārān rasādikān ।
patrasārān mūlasārān kṛtisārān samudbhavān ।।।42।।
jarāsārān kośasārān bījasārān phalottamān ।
mañjarīsārakān stambasārān nālodbhavāँstathā ।।43।।
khanisārān vyomasārān meghasārān ṛtūdbhavān ।
vṛṣṭisārān puṇyasārān śraddhāsārān hṛdudbhavān ।।44।।
svāpnasārān kālasārān dravyasārān guṇodbhavān ।
karmasārān yogasārānaiśvaryakṛtavigrahān ।।45
sarvavidhān bhojyasārān yogyebhyaḥ kanyakā daduḥ ।
lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kamalā haṃsā ramā yatra pradāyikāḥ ।।46।।
tatra kā nyūnatā rādhe bhojyapānopakāriṣu ।
satrī yatra svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ lakṣmīryatrābhidāyinī ।।47।।
kalpavallyaḥ samāhartryastatra kā nāma nimnatā ।
sarvadhāmāni lokāśca mūrtā bhajanta eva ca ।।48।।
yatra tattvāni tiṣṭhanti tatra kā nāma nimnatā ।
yatra vahniḥ svayaṃ paktā tṛptiryatpariveṣikā ।।49।।
amṛtā'kṣarabhojyāni tatra kā nāma nimnatā ।
nityānandamahātṛptā yanmahe parameśvarāḥ ।।2.67.50।।
sarvaiśvaryacamatkārasiddhayaḥ kalpapādapāḥ ।
cintāmaṇayo vartante tatra kā nāma nimnatā ।।51 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! bhojyaparihārottaraṃ svayam ।
lomaśo bhojanaṃ cakre tataśca bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।52।।
sūdāśca pariveṣādikartryaśca bubhujustataḥ ।
kārṣṇyastato'tha bubhujustato gopālabāndhavāḥ ।।53।।
bubhoja ca tataḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa eva tu ।
tataśca bubhuje śrīmatkaṃbharāśrīḥ sutānvitā ।।54।।
dāsebhyaḥ pradadau mātā bhojanānyuttamāni ca ।
kīṭamatsyapataṃgebhyo bhāgyajīvibhya ityapi ।।25। ।
aniścitā'danebhyaśca dadau bhojyāni kambharā ।
suvarṇarūpyaratnāni koṭiśo dakṣiṇā dadau ।।56।।
kṣaṇaṃ viśramyā'parāhṇe sabhā tu mānavardhinī ।
parameśvaradevānāṃ samastadehināṃ hyabhūt ।।57।।
suvarṇāsanasaṃdiptā koṭiktavādipūritā ।
madhye śrīśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate'mbare ।।।58।।।
ucchraye gajaśobhāḍhyāsane pārśve pitā tathā ।
mātā kṛṣṇastathā rādhā śrīśca nārāyaṇastathā ।।59।।
hemanto bhagavāँścobhau sthitau dhṛtvā'sya cāmare ।
avatārā avatāriṇya īśā īśanīgaṇāḥ ।।2.67.60।।
devā devyaḥ pitaraśca pitryo munaya ārṣikāḥ ।
asurā asurāṇyaśca mānavā yoṣitastathā ।।61।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ stambā nāgā daityāśca tastriyaḥ ।
rājante sā sabhā dīrghā viśālā jaḍacetanaiḥ ।
tattvairuccāvacairyuktā divyā'divyaiḥ sudehibhiḥ ।।62।।
tato nṛtyaṃ nartakīnāṃ prāvartata suśobhanam ।
apsarasāṃ gītayaśca gandharvāṇāṃ suvādanam ।।63।।
prāvartata śubhaṃ gandharvīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ samuttamam ।
nṛtye parihṛte mallā yuddhakauśalyamāvahan ।।64।।
darśayāmāsuratyarthaṃ samarāṃgaṇabhūmikāḥ ।
tato dṛśyā naṭānāṃ ca nāṭyayogena khelitāḥ ।।65।।
prāvartantā'mbararajjukauśalyālambanādayaḥ ।
uḍḍayanaṃ svargayuddhaṃ cendrajālikadarśanam ।।66।।
vidyudvaibhavadṛśyāni nirvartitāni vai tataḥ ।
gāyanāni samabhavan kṛṣṇayaśobharāṇi ca ।।67।।
vidyādhrāṇāṃ samabhavan vyākhyānānyuttamāni ca ।
siddhānāmupadeśāścā'bhavaँstatrātihṛdgamāḥ ।।68।।
bhāṭacāraṇabandijñāḥ praśaṃsakāḥ kaviprathāḥ ।
varṇayāsurevainamutsavaṃ prajaguḥ striyaḥ ।।69।।
nāradaḥ śrīsanatkumārājñayā praśaśaṃsa ha ।
utsavaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ na bhūtaṃ bhāvi naiva ca ।।2.67.70।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra pareśvaraḥ ।
yajñasūtrasya pātraṃ cā'vatārā mahīmānakāḥ ।।71 ।।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ yanmahe'sti sambhūtaṃ satkṛtipradam ।
sarvarasāḥ sarvagandhā yatrā''nandāśca sarvaśaḥ ।।72।।
sarvasatyo yatra santi śrībhūlīlāvibhūtayaḥ ।
naitādṛśo maho bhāvī maho'yaṃ sarvato'dhikaḥ ।।73।।
kartavyaṃ smaraṇaṃ cā'sya śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ tathā ।
nididhyāsanamasyaiva sākṣānmuktirhareḥ pade ।।74।।
tadeva loke kartavyaṃ yatkṛte mokṣamāviśet ।
kṛtena yena saṃsāre bandhanaṃ naiva jāyate ।।75 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaite mahotsavāḥ ।
kartavyāḥ sarvadā bhaktairyena bandhād vimucyate ।।76 ।।
bhavajaladhimagnānāṃ kuṭumbibhāramajjatām ।
śaraṇaṃ śrīhareratra tārakaṃ nausvarūpakam ।।77।।
saṃśritā ye hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ guruṃ pareśvaram ।
kamaleśaṃ na te yānti dharmarājapradeśakam ।।78।।
sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ mādhave'rpitam ।
tau ślāghyau tu karau bodhyau yau śrīkṛṣṇārcane ratau ।।79 ।।
anyathā stambaśākhākhyau śuṣkau sevāvivarjitau ।
kaṇṭhaḥ sa jambukakaṇṭho yo na gāyati mādhavam ।।2.67.80 ।।
rogo mahān sa evā'sti yatra nāsti hareḥ smṛtiḥ ।
sa eva śocyaḥ sajīvo na yo'rcayati keśavam ।।81 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'yaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
sarvā'vatārapūjyo'yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।।82।।
pūjakā nahi śocyāste mṛtā api hi muktigāḥ ।
sarvaṃ carācaraṃ cātra bālakṛṣṇe virājate ।।83।।
asya pūjā kṛtā yena tenā'rcitaṃ carācaram ।
ratnākaraguṇā yadvadasaṃkhyāḥ śrīharerguṇāḥ ।।84।।
rādhāprabhāpāravatīlakṣmīpatiṃ śriyaḥ patim ।
samāśritā na saṃsāre duḥkhitā mokṣagā yataḥ ।।85।।
śūladhvajadhanurbāṇamīnasvastikacakravān ।
pūjyate yena bālo'yaṃ kare saptakacihnitaḥ ।।86।।
ūrdhvarekhā'dhikaiścihnaiḥ ṣoḍaśākhyaiḥ padābjayoḥ ।
sahitaḥ pūjyate yena bālakṛṣṇo'yamīśitā ।।87।।
sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvakalākauśalyavāridhiḥ ।
pūjyate yena bālo'yaṃ mokṣabhāk sa na saṃśayaḥ ।।88।।
yadantaḥkaraṇe kṛṣṇo yadātmani narāyaṇaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavyāpto na mṛtyorbhayavān kvacit ।।89।।
parāyaṇaṃ prapannānāṃ bālakṛṣṇajuṣāṃ kvacit ।
nimnāyanaṃ na caivā'sti paradhāmno'dhikāriṇām ।।2.67.90।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāḥ parātparam ।
satāṃ mokṣaṃ cāpnuvanti rādhāramādiśaṃsitam ।।91 ।।
saṃgrāmiṇāṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ sāttvikānāṃ mahātmanām ।
gateḥ parā gatiścāste bhagavadvedināṃ śubhā ।।92।।
sūkṣmaṃ sarvagataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktāḥ paśyanti netare ।
tathā paśyanti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mahātmānaḥ kṛpālayāḥ ।।93।।
sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛṣṇaparā yasya bhavanti cārpitāḥ ।
sarvakartā'pyakartā sa na badhyate pramucyate ।।94।।
hariryeṣāṃ priyo nityaṃ te priyāśca hareḥ sadā ।
hariṃ dhyāyecca yastaṃ dhyāyati hariḥ padāśritam ।।95।।
kalyamutthāya bhaktyā'yaṃ smartavyo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
śravaṇīyaḥ śrāvaṇīyo durgāṇāṃ tārako hi saḥ ।।96।।
asya kṛṣṇasya tu kathāmṛtapānāstaranti hi ।
atra śrībālakṛṣṇe ye bhaktiravyabhicāriṇīm ।।97।।
kariṣyanti gamiṣyanti te yatrā''ste hariḥ svayam ।
kṛṣṇasevāprasaktānāṃ yā gatiḥ paradhāmani ।।98।।
sā tu janmasahasreṇa tapobhirnahi labhyate ।
kiṃ japaiḥ kiṃ mantravāgbhiḥ kimāśrayaiḥ prayatnakaiḥ ।।99।।
kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ pradānaiśca kiṃ dharmaiḥ kīrtibhiśca kim ।
kiṃ tasya bahubhiścā'nyairyenā''ptaḥ śrīhariryadi ।। 2.67.10 0।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
mantraḥ sarvārthadātā cejjaptaḥ kiṃ tasya vidyayā ।। 101 ।।
hariryeṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ mokṣasteṣāṃ parātparaḥ ।
lābhasteṣāṃ ca māṃgalyaṃ yeṣāṃ hṛtsthaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 02।।
tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi dānakoṭiśatāni ca ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanateḥ kalāṃ nā'rhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 1 03।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānād yogito gatiruttamā ।। 104।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāṃ kurvanti jalamātrataḥ ।
te'pi yāsyanti sādhūnāṃ sthānaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ param ।। 1 05।।
trisandhyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaranti yāḥ patim ।
tāsāṃ dehasthitānāṃ ca mokṣa eva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 106 ।।
narā nāryaḥ surā devā īśā īśānya ityapi ।
sevamānā bālakṛṣṇaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpsyatha ।। 1 07।।
dhanyā rādhāramādyāśca dhanyāḥ kāruḥ kumārikāḥ ।
dhanyā kuṃkumavāpī ca yatkānto bhagavān svayam ।। 1 08।।
dhanyā vayaṃ mahīmānā yanmahe'sya samāgamaḥ ।
ityukatvā nāradaḥ śrīmān praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 09।।
bhagavantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śukaṃ śrīvallabha tathā ।
mālā ratnamayī kaṇṭheṣvārpya nanāma nāradaḥ ।। 2.67.11 0।।
punarvilokya ca sabhāṃ dirghakaṇṭhena nāradaḥ ।
hastamutkṣipya ca prāha śṛṇvatāṃ yāvatāṃ punaḥ ।। 111 ।।
mahīmānāḥ praśvṛṇvantu satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ।
loke kṛṣṇāvatārāstu bhaviṣyanti sahasraśaḥ ।। 1 12।।
paraṃ tvetādṛśaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvara ।
avatārī paripūrṇatamottamottamaḥ kvacit ।। 11 3।।
adya jātaḥ samārambhe punarnaiva bhaviṣyati ।
anye kṛṣṇā asya līlāmāśrayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ ।। 1 8।।
ānaravāttu śikhāṃ yāvat asya mūrtau sthale sthale ।
sahasraśastu cihnāni vidyante paramātmanaḥ ।। 1 15।।
śataikaṃ pādayorasya daśake jaṃghayostathā ।
viṃśakaṃ ca tathā sakṣmolige ca pañcakaṃ tathā ।। 1 16।।
triṃśattu jaghane cāsyodare tu pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।
vakṣasi śatakaṃ cāsya pṛṣṭhe pārśve śatatrayam ।। 1 17।।
kaṇṭhe skande dviśataṃ ca mukhe śataṃ gale trayam ।
hastayoḥ śatacihnāni pachāśattalayostathā ।। 1 18।।
prakoṣṭhe daśakaṃ cāpi netrayoḥ pañcaviṃśakam ।
gaṇḍayoḥ ṣoḍaśa bhāle pañca ṣaṭ karṇayostathā ।। 1 19।।
jihvāyāṃ coṣṭhayoścāsya kramād daśa ca viṃśatiḥ ।
nāsikāyāṃ daśarekhā bhrukuṭī śatasadguṇāḥ ।। 2.67.120।।
keśeṣu viṃśatiścāpi cibuke tu catuṣṭayam ।
romasu sarvataḥ santi hairaṇyaguṇarāśayaḥ ।। 121 ।।
yāvadguṇāḥ svabhāvāśca rekhāstilāśca sandhayaḥ ।
saṃyogāścāpi saṃsthānā ghaṭanāḥ suvyavasthitiḥ ।। 122।।
ekaikāṃgasya ca mayā varṇayituṃ na śakyate ।
sarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ vidyate'tra samantataḥ ।। 123।।
etanmūrteḥ samādāya khaṇḍāṃśān mūrtayaḥ parāḥ ।
bhaviṣyantītare devā īśvarāḥ parameśvarāḥ ।। 124।।
nā'smānmayā'dhikaṃ vācyaṃ pramāṇaṃ sadasi sthitāḥ ।
avatārāstathā muktā bhavantaḥ parameśvarāḥ ।। 125।।
vāmane viśvarūpe tu madhye romṇordvayordvayoḥ ।
koṭicihnāni tiṣṭhanti naiṣāṃ syād gaṇanārhatā ।। 126 ।।
sṛṣṭitrayasvarūpaṃ hi mūrtau bhagavataḥ sthitam ।
sarvasṛṣṭestu cihnāni vartante'syaiva varṣmaṇi ।। 127।।
kaṇṭhopari cottamāṃge sūkṣmasūṣṭiḥ pratiṣṭhitā ।
kaṇṭhādadhaḥ karerūrdhva kāryasṛṣṭirvyavasthitā ।। 128।।
kaṭeradho nikṛṣṭā ca ānakhāntaṃ vyavasthitā ।
koṭyarbudā'bjacihnāni vartante'sya tu varṣmaṇi ।। 1 29।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau nāradaḥ sanadājñayā ।
rādhike ca tataḥ pāritoṣikānyarpayat pitā ।। 2.67. 13 0।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahīmānānāṃ bhojanadānaṃ, tataḥ sabhāyojanā, nāradokta- parāvidyopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭi-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 67 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
kubero vasavaḥ kalpapādapā medinī ramā ।
nidhayaścintāmaṇayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrataḥ ।। 1 ।।
tasthustu rādhike dātuṃ sampāritoṣikāṇi vai ।
muktebhyo mālikā divyā dadurdivyavibhūtijāḥ ।। 2 ।।
avatārebhya evaite dudurmukuṭakuṇḍale ।
divyahārānīśvarebhyo daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tadā ।। 3 ।।
brahmādibhyo daduḥ siṃhāsanāni kānakāni hi ।
pitṛbhyaścā'kṣayāṇyeva pātrāṇi pradadustadā ।। 4 ।।
ṛṣibhyo yajñapātrāṇi pradaduścāsanāni ca ।
surebhyo ratnahārāँśca daduryogyān yathāyatham ।। 5 ।।
dānavebhyo'surebhyaśca daityebhyo'pi dadustadā ।
yānavāhanabhūṣāśca mānavebhyo dhanaṃ daduḥ ।। 6 ।।
nāgebhyo maṇayaścāpi paśubhyo bhojanāmṛtam ।
pakṣibhyo phalapuṣpādirasadravyāṇi te daduḥ ।। 7 ।।
mūrtā'mūrtacidacidbhyo yathāyogyaṃ dhanāni ca ।
viprebhyaḥ svarṇarūpyādi rājabhyo hīrakādikam ।। 8 ।।
sādhubhyo vastrakanthādi satībhyo bhāgyavardhanam ।
bhūṣāmbarādi śṛṃgāraṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tadā daduḥ ।। 9 ।।
ātṛpti saṃdadustatra dehīti nocyate punaḥ ।
daduryathā ca te voḍhuṃ śekurnaiva yatheṣṭakam ।। 1 0।।
yad yeṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ tattattatra drāgeva cārpitam ।
naśabdo yujyate naiva gṛhṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ vai dakṣiṇāścātha pāritoṣikamityapi ।
dadustebhyaśca yogyebhyo viprādibhyo dhanaṃ bahu ।। 12।।
sūdebhyaścāndhasikebhyo dadurdhanaṃ vipūlakam ।
karmacārebhya evāpi hārahīrakamityapi ।। 13 ।।
bhāṭebhyaścāraṇebhyaśca śilpibhyaśca dadurdhanam ।
mallebhyo nartakebhyaśca nāṭikābhyo dhanaṃ daduḥ ।। 14।।
gāyikābhyo dāsikābhyo hārabhūṣāmbarādikam ।
dāsebhyo'nāthadīnebhyo vastrabhūṣādikaṃ daduḥ ।। 16।।
sṛṣṭitrayasya kanyābhyo bhūṣāmbaradhanāni ca ।
svarṇarūpyakapātrāṇi daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tadā ।। 16।।
yāsāṃ yeṣāṃ yathā yena paritoṣo'bhijāyate ।
tattat tadā pradattaṃ ca saṃkoco naiva vidyate ।। 17।।
sādhvībhyaśca satībhyaśca pativratābhya ityapi ।
adhavābhyaśca vṛddhābhyo mātṛbhyaścāpi sarvathā ।। 18।।
svasṛduhitṛkanyābhyo devībhyaśca yathāyatham ।
bhūṣāmbaradhanānyeva daduḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tataḥ ।। 19।।
mahīmānebhya ityeva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
dāpayāmāsa ca pāritoṣikānyuttamāni ca ।।20 ।।
kuberavasukalpā''didvārā'narghyāṇi sarvathā ।
kaṃbharāśrīrdadau sarvayoṣidbhyo bhūṣaṇāni vai ।।21 ।।
kānakāni ratnahīramaṇihārān dadau tathā ।
gopālaśca dadau sarvajanebhyo hāṭakātmakam ।।22।।
dhanaṃ sadratnahārādi yathāpekṣaṃ tathorjitam ।।
evaṃ sarvamaharṣibhyastadā śrīlomaśo dadau ।।23।।
kalpātmagūṭikā yasyā jāyeteṣṭaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
santoṣā bhaginī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cāgrajā ।।24।।
dadau saubhāgyasūtrādidravyarañjanakaṃkatīḥ ।
kānakīśca vibhūṣāśca kañcukī śāṭikāstathā ।।25।।
ghargharīścolikādyāśca dadau natthīśca baṃgiḍīḥ ।
raśanā valayāँścāpyūrmikāḥ santoṣadāyikāḥ ।।26।।
evaṃ dānāni ca pāritoṣikāṇi pradāya ca ।
anugrahaṃ mahe samāgatānāṃ prāha vai pitā ।।27 ।।
śrīgopālakṛṣṇa uvāca-
mama putrasya kṛṣṇasya yajñasūtramahotsave ।
samāgatānāṃ bhavatāṃ śobhāvṛddhijuṣāṃ sadā ।।28।।
ṛṇyahaṃ svāgataṃ kurve dhanyavādān dadāmi ca ।
vinayena vadāmyatra nyūnasevā mayā kṛtā ।।29।।
bhavet kṣantavyaviṣayāṃ matvā kṣamyo'hamīśvaraḥ ।
muktānāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ brāhmīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।।3 0।।
īśānāmīśvarīṇāṃ devānāṃ ca devayoṣitām ।
mānavānāṃ mānavīnāṃ daityānāṃ daityayoṣitām ।।3 1 ।।
nāgānāṃ nāgapatnīnāṃ jaḍacetanadehinām ।
dikpālānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ carṣīṇām ārṣīprayoṣitām ।। 36।।
sānnidhyenā'bhavatkāryaṃ cotsavīyaṃ subṛṃhitam ।
sarveṣāṃ yaśasāṃ pātraṃ kṛto'haṃ bhavadāgamaiḥ ।।33।।।
putro me vardhitaścāpi tejobhirnijagocaraiḥ ।
punarevā'vagantavyaṃ kṣantavyā ca kṣatirmama ।।34।।
ityuktvā kāryakartṛbhyo dhanyavādān dadau muhuḥ ।
āśīrvādān samicchāmi sakuṭumbaḥ samārthayat ।।35।।
tadānīṃ jayakāraśca sabhājanakṛto'bhavat ।
atha rādhākṛṣṇa ādau bālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā ।।36 ।।
pūjārthaṃ tvāyayau divyopacāraiḥ samapūjayat ।
mukuṭaṃ gopaveṣādi vaṃśīṃ cintāmaṇīn dadau ।।37।।
kāmadhenūrdadau cāpi candanādyairapūjayat ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaścā'thā'pūjayacchrīhariṃ tadā ।।38 ।।
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ tathā'bjakam ।
garuḍaṃ ca vimānaṃ ca divyakaustubhamālikāḥ ।।39 ।।
dadau śrībālakṛṣṇāya kesarādyairapūjayat ।
vāsudevastathā cānye'vatārāḥ prakṛtīśvaraḥ ।।40।।
pradhāneśastathā bhūmā mahāviṣṇurvirāṭpumān ।
sadāśivastathā teṣāṃ śaktayaścāyayurmudā ।।41 ।।
tilakaṃ kajjalaṃ binduṃ datvā ca mukuṭāni vai ।
karṇabhūṣāḥ kaṇṭhahārān muktāmauktikanirmitān ।।42।।
urmikā raśanā yaṣṭīn daduste tā dhanānyapi ।
svasvadhāmakṛtān divyān haṃsasiṃhagajātmakān ।।43।।
āsanottamabhaumāँśca dadurbālāya dehine ।
aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃsthāśceśvarāḥ saptarṣayastathā ।।44।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
svarṇahārān puṣpahārān svarṇapātrāṇi pāduke ।।45।।
kamaṇḍalūn kalaśāँśca prāvaraṇānyanekaśaḥ ।
daduḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya dhanaṃ divyaṃ navaṃ navam ।।46।।
pitaro munayo devāśchatraṃ ca cāmare tathā ।
vimānāni ca yānāni haṃsān dāsāँśca dāsikāḥ ।।47।।
yaṣṭiṃ sauvarṇavikṛtiṃ darpaṇaṃ śukamenakāḥ ।
vāditrāṇi vicitrāṇi cāmṛtānāṃ ghaṭāँstathā ।।48।।
kāmakalpalatādīṃśca sūryacandramaṇīँstathā ।
digīśvarādiveṣāँśca vibhūṣā ratnamālikāḥ ।।49।।
daduḥ śrībālakṛṣṇāya divyānyapi dhanāni ca ।
daityāśca dānavāścāpi asurā vaibhavān daduḥ ।।2.68.50 ।।
nāgāḥ sarpā bhoginaśca maṇīn māṇikyamauktikān ।
hārān vibhūtivaiśeṣyaṃ dadurdravyāṇi vai tadā ।।।5 1 ।।
ratnākarāstu ratnāni mauktikāni dadustadā ।
nadyo nadā varuṇādyā dadurdravyarasānapi ।।52।।
parvatāḥ khanayaścāpi dadurmaṇiviśeṣakān ।
ratnāni vajramaṇikān muktāśca padmarāgakān ।।53 ।।
mārakatānindranīlān vaidūryān puṣparāgakān ।
karketanān bhīṣmakāँśca pulakān rudhirākhyakān ।।।54।।
sphaṭikān vidrumān puṃkharājān dadurviśeṣataḥ ।
mānavāstu dadustasmai svambarāṇi śubhāni vai ।।55।।
dyumataḥ kambalāँścāpi pātrabhūṣopavārtikāḥ ।
gajāśvavṛṣabhāँścāpi dhenūśca mahiṣīstathā ।।56।।
dravyāṇi svarṇarūpyāṇi dadurbālāya bhāvataḥ ।
vṛkṣavallyo madhurasān dadurmālyādipūjanam ।।57।।
paryaṃkān subṛsīścāpi kaṭān catuṣkikādikāḥ ।
khaṭvā yantrīstathā gantrīrdaduḥ peṣaṇikāstathā ।।58।।
cullikāḥ kaṇḍanikāśca jalakumbhīrdadustathā ।
mārjanikā guptadoradhānīśca pradadurmudā ।।595।।
muśalaṃ tantucakraṃ cānarghyapeṭimañjuṣāḥ।
vāridhānīścātha payodhānīstakrapramanthanīḥ ।।2.68.60।।
droṇaśca dadhidhānīśca kusulāni karṇārdinīḥ ।
piṣṭikāṃ ca śilāṃ ghaṇṭīṃ rasayantrīṃ dadurmudā ।।61 ।।
dolāṃ preṃkhāṃ ghoṭikāṃ ca catuṣpādāṃ ca khaṭvikām ।
kauśeyānyambarāṇyeva aurṇānyapyambarāṇi ca ।।62।।
buṭṭāḍhyaveṣavaryāṇi daduśca śarkarādikāḥ ।
phalāni phalahārāँśca śuṣkailādisrajastathā ।।63 ।।
candanāni vicitrāṇi śītalāni dadustadā ।
pattrāṇāni varṣmatrāṇān śirastrāṇāni vai daduḥ ।।64।।
pātrāṇi yugahāṇḍīśca sthālīśca kalaśādikān ।
bhaṃgārakāṇi pātrāṇi puṭapātrāṇi yāni ca ।।65।।
jalasecanapātrāṇi sthālāni bhojyavāṭikāḥ ।
paṭṭiśaṃ pāṭhikāścāpi śastrā'strāṇyapi saṃdaduḥ ।।66।।
dhanāni svarṇarūpyāṇi cāsaṃkhyāni dadustadā ।
candanā'bīrakuṃkumā'kṣatagulālakairdravaiḥ ।।67।।
puṣpaiśca kesarairgandhaiḥ kastūrikābhirityapi ।
karpūrairvividhaiḥ raṃgaiḥ rañjanairhārapatrakaiḥ ।।68।।
tulasyā mañjarībhiśca dalaiśca kundaketakaiḥ ।
campakairmṛdyatailaiścā'rcayāmāsuḥ prabhuṃ patim ।।69।।
ekottaraśataśreṣṭhopacārairdevatādikāḥ ।
avatārā īśvarāśca cakrurārārtrikaṃ hareḥ ।।2.68.70।।
āśīrbhiryojayāmāsuḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakrire ।
tuṣṭavuśca praṇemuśca niṣeduścā''saneṣu ca ।।71 ।।
tato'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nugrahavān kṣaṇāt ।
darśanaṃ naijamūlātmasvarūpasya dadau tadā ।।72।।
prathamaṃ paramaṃ dhāma dadṛśuśca sabhājanāḥ ।
tanmuktāँścāpi muktānīstatraiva dadṛśuśca te ।।73।।
brahmadhāmā'kṣaraṃ tasya muktān muktānīrityapi ।
bālakṛṣṇasya vai mūrtau mastake dadṛśuśca te ।।74।।
avatārān harerbhāle sahasraśaśca dadṛśuḥ ।
golokaṃ dakṣiṇe netre vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāmacakṣuṣi ।।75।।
amṛtaṃ nityakailāsaṃ karṇayoścāpi dadṛśuḥ ।
mahāviṣṇuṃ nāsikāyāṃ bhāle kālaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ ।।76।।
bhālasya prāntayoḥ pradhāneśaṃ ca prakṛtīśvaram ।
vāsudevādikān vyūhān nāsāmūle pradadṛśuḥ ।।77।।
vairājaṃ mukhamadhye ca dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ ।
daṃṣṭrāsvasya dadṛśuśca śatānanādivedhasaḥ ।।78।।
śatanetrādirudrāँśca danteṣvasya pradadṛśuḥ ।
śmaśrurekhāsthitān sahasrādihastakaviṣṇukān ।।79।।
oṣṭhe cordhve mahāmāyāṃ pradhānaṃ cādhare tathā ।
śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ cibuke tvasya dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ ।।2.68.80।।
hanūromasu dadṛśurmāyā'ṣṭāvaraṇeśvarān ।
kapolayośceśvarāṇīrdadṛśuḥ koṭiśaḥ satīḥ ।।8 1 ।।
keśamūleṣu vai satyaṃ lokaṃ brahmādyadhiṣṭhitam ।
keśamadhyeṣu ca svargān keśānte cātalādikān ।।82।।
śiraḥpṛṣṭhe mānavāँśca dadṛśuste sabhājanāḥ ।
evaṃ sarvāṃ brahmarūpāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vai kāraṇātmikām ।।83 ।।
sūkṣmāṃ ca śāśvatīṃ nityāṃ bījarūpāṃ hi dadṛśuḥ ।
atha kāraṇasṛṣṭeśca samudbhūtāṃ ca vaikṛtām ।।84।।
sthūlāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kaṇṭhabhāgādadhaḥ punaśca dadṛśuḥ ।
kaṇṭhe'sya paramaṃ brahma hṛdaye brahma cā'kṣaram ।।85।।
stanayoścā'pi golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ ।
amṛtaṃ nityakailāsaṃ skandhayośca pradadṛśuḥ ।।86।।
mahāviṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhe kālaṃ pradadṛśuḥ ।
kakṣayośca pradhāneśaṃ prakṛtīśaṃ pradadṛśuḥ ।।87।।
vāsudevādikān vyūhān hṛdayordhve pradadṛśuḥ ।
vairājaṃ hṛdayā'dhastāt pārśvāsthiṣu ca vedhasaḥ ।।88।।
agrasandhiṣu viṣṇūँśca rudrāँśca pṛṣṭhasandhiṣu ।
udare ca mahāmāyāṃ nābhau pradhānameva ca ।।89।।
śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ pārśvayornābherjaghaneṣṭā''vṛtāni ca ।
jaghanā'dhaśceśvarāṇīrliṃgamūle satīstathā ।।2.68.90।।
romasu satyalokādīn guptā'dho'talaprabhṛtīn ।
tattatsthāneṣu cābdhīṃśca parvatān dadṛśuśca te ।।9 1 ।।
athāpi ca tataḥ kaṭyāṃ śeṣaṃ ca kacchapaṃ tathā ।
dadṛśuḥ sīvanīnāḍyāṃ mahājalaṃ ca dhātuṣu ।।।92।।
liṃgāgre kāmadevaṃ ca sakthnordaityāँśca dānavān ।
romasu ca ṛṣīn pitṝn devān dadṛśureva ca ।।93।।
jānvośca mānavān jaṃghādvaye'surān pradadṛśuḥ ।
pādayornāgasarpādīn dadṛśuḥ punareva ca ।।94।।
sṛṣṭitrayātmikāṃ mūrtiṃ bālakṛṣṇātmikāṃ punaḥ ।
vilokyaitanmahāścaryaṃ jñātavantaḥ svakāraṇam ।।95।।
sarve'vatārā yasmāt saṃbhavantyeṣaḥ pumān paraḥ ।
matvā cakrustato dhyānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya te kṣaṇam ।।96 ।।
atha sabhāsamāpteśca ghaṇṭānādo'bhavattadā ।
jayaśabdaiḥ saha sabhyā uttasthuḥ svālayaṃ yayuḥ ।।97।।
miṣṭapānādibhistāmbūlakairmadhurabhāṣaṇaiḥ ।
satkṛtāśca vimānādyairmahīmānāstu sarvaśaḥ ।।98।।
yayurnaijān gṛhān deśān paradeśān sukhānvitāḥ ।
tattvāni dehinaścaityā jaḍā guṇā rasādayaḥ ।।99।।
anye'pi dāsavargādyā yayuḥ sammānitā gṛham ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaite svargādikaṃ yayustataḥ ।। 2.68.100 ।।
parameśā brahmalokān īśā īśanivāsakān ।
daityāśca dānavā naijān pātālādīn yayustataḥ ।। 101 ।।
parvatā vṛkṣavallyaśca nadāstīrthāni cāpagāḥ ।
sarāṃsyapi ca kṣetrāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca ।। 1 02।।
yayuḥ praṇamya ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
maṇḍapasya mahāprāsādasya kalpakṛtasya ca ।। 1 03।।
upasaṃhāramakarot kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sanatkumāro bhagavānnārado'pi praṇamya ca ।। 1 04।।
badarīṃ yayatuścātha kanyakā lomaśāśramam ।
evaṃ ca rādhike brahmasūtrotsavo mahattamaḥ ।। 1 05।।
sampannaścāṣṭame varṣe vaiśākhe paramātmanaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya smaraṇānmuktibhāgbhavet ।। 1 06।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahimānebhyaḥ pāritoṣikadānaṃ, prabhoḥ pūjanam, upadārpaṇam, divyadarśanaṃ, parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇa-
nāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 68 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 068 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 69
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 070 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ kṛṣṇa! tava sevā kartavyā''rādhanā tathā ।
kenā'rcanena te kṛṣṇa prītiḥ samupajāyate ।। 1 ।।
kāni dānāni deyāni prīṇanāya harestava ।
kāni puṇyāni śastāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭikarāṇi ca ।। 2 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
sarvadānāni śastāni śrīkṛṣṇasya pratuṣṭaye ।
bhaktyā samarcanenā'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parituṣyati ।। 3 ।।
yapsveṣṭaṃ tatpradeya vai kṛṣṇāya prīṇanārthakam ।
puṇyaṃ tatrā'rpaṇaṃ sarva kṛṣṇatuṣṭikaraṃ priye ।। 4 ।।
śraddadhānairbhaktiparaiḥ samuddiśya śriyaḥ patim ।
dīyante yāni dānāni tāni yānti na vai kṣayam ।। 5 ।।
tā eva tithayaḥ śreṣṭhā yatra kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate ।
yāsu satāṃ kṛtā sevā tadnyāstithayo'dhamāḥ ।। 6 ।।
pūjiteṣu ca sādhuṣu pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
yastān dveṣṭi sa hīnātmā hīnāṃ yoniṃ prayāti ca ।। 7 ।।
sato'rcayan jano bhaktyā nārī vā kṛṣṇatatparā ।
māmakī sā tanuścāsti hyahaṃ vaiṣṇavadehavān ।। 8 ।।
sādhavo nā'vamantavyā budho vā'pyabudhā api ।
santo divyāstanavo me tatastānarcayet sadā ।। 9 ।।
karmaṇā manasā vācā'rpaṇena sevayā'pi vā ।
bhojanenā'rcanenāpi santoṣaṇīyāḥ sādhavaḥ ।। 2.69.10 ।।
prātarutthāya māṃ smṛtvā snātvā ca śubhavastubhiḥ ।
manmūrteḥ pūjanaṃ kuryāt satāṃ sevā hi pūjanam ।। 1 1।।
ārādhanā tu me bhaktirdāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā'dhikam ।
dhyānaṃ me mama sādhūnāṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣahetave ।। 12।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ sarvadā priye ।
tadindriyeṣvahaṃ tvasmi tattuṣṭau toṣaṇaṃ mama ।। 1 3।।
rasagandhayutaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanīyāsta eva tu ।
campakaḥ kunda āmraśca dhavalaḥ khadirastathā ।। 14।।
śatagoṭastathā'śoko bakulaḥ karavīrakaḥ ।
tilakaśca japā jātī yūthikā padminī tathā ।। 15।।
kamalī sthalapadmā ca tulasī kaumudī tathā ।
sūryamukhī cammilikā pārijātaḥ sukesaraḥ ।। 16।।
ketako hāraśṛṃgāraḥ kadambo devadārukaḥ ।
sarjataruḥ kalpavallī caitatpuṣpāṇi rādhike ।। 17।।
pūjāyāṃ me pradeyāni varjayitvā tu ketakīm ।
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ bhṛṃgapatraṃ ca taulasam ।। 18।।
tamālamālatīpatraṃ praśastaṃ mama pūjane ।
vīrudhāṃ supravālaiśca darbhaiḥ samarcayecca mām ।। 1 9।।
pravālairbīsatantvādyairdurvāṅkuraiḥ samarcayet ।
kuḍmalaiścandanaiḥ kuṃkumośīrakesaraistathā ।। 2.69.20।।
sugandhakāṣṭhadhūpaiśca pṛṇomyahaṃ sadā priye ।
haviṣā saṃskṛtā ye ca yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ ।।21 ।।
tilamudgādayo māṣā vrīhayaśca priyā mama ।
godānāni pavitrāṇi bhūmipradānakāni ca ।।22।।
vastrānnasvarṇadānāni prītaye mama rādhike ।
māghe tilāścendhanāni deyāni priyatāṃ hariḥ ।।23।।
phālgune vrīhayo vastraṃ mṛgacarmādi śasyate ।
caitre susūkṣmavastrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca ।।24।।
vaiśākhe gandhayuktāni deyāni surabhīṇi ca ।
udakumbhāḍhyadhenuśca tālavṛntaḥ sucandanaḥ ।।25।।
deyāstena bhavetputro dhanaṃ bhāryā sutā ca gauḥ ।
śṛṇuyācca kathā nityaṃ bhaktyā saṃpūjayeddharim ।।26।।
tasyā'śvamedhayajñasya dakṣiṇāsahitasya ca ।
suvarṇabhūmidānasya'śvagonāgarathasya ca ।। 27।।
dānasya puṇyamagryaṃ vai jāyeta nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
nārī naraḥ pādamekaṃ kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyāt hareḥ ।। 28।।
sa śuciḥ puṇyavān loke sarvatīrthāśrito hi saḥ ।
gaṃgāyāṃ naimiṣāraṇye puṣkare mānase tathā ।। 29।।
nārāyaṇe'śvapaṭṭe ca kokāmukhe prayāgake ।
māghe yatpuṇyamagryaṃ ca tat kathāśravaṇād bhavet ।।2.69.3 0।।
rājasūyaphalaṃ yacca svarge yacca mahat phalam ।
bhūmiloke phalaṃ yattat kathāyāḥ śravaṇād bhavet ।। 31 ।।
sautrāmaṇeḥ phalaṃ yacca miṣṭānnadānajaṃ ca yat ।
sūryacandragrahe ratnapradānasya ca yatphalam ।।32।।
durbhikṣe rakṣaṇād yacca phalaṃ jñāterjanasya ca ।
devāgnisādhuviprāṇāṃ pālane rakṣaṇe ca yat ।।33।।
pitroḥ śvaśurayoḥ sevādharme bhrātuśca yatphalam ।
jyeṣṭhe'patyau gavi sevājanyaṃ yacca phalaṃ bhavet। ।।34।।
tatphalaṃ rādhike me'tra kathāyāḥ śravaṇe bhavet ।
upānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ lavaṇāmalakādikam ।।35।।
jyeṣṭhe jalaṃ praśītaṃ ca sūkṣmāmbaraṃ ca takrakam ।
dadhi copānahau chatraṃ deyaṃ me prītaye priye ।। 36।।
āṣāḍhe vyajanaṃ dugdhaṃ śarkarā cāmbarāṇi ca ।
deyāni rādhike yānaṃ vāhanāni harergṛhe ।।37।।
śrāvaṇe sarvadānāni dadyānmatprītaye priye ।
annavastropakaraṇarasādīni samantataḥ ।।38।।
bhādre dadyātpāyasāni lavaṇaṃ saguḍaudanam ।
navakaṇāँstathā me prītaye ca madhusarpiṣī ।।39।।
āśvine navadhānyāni vṛṣaṃ cāśvaṃ suvarṇakam ।
tāmrapātrāṇi vastrāṇi dīpādīni samarpayet। ।।2.69.40।।
kārtike svarṇarajate maṇimuktāphalādikam ।
dīpān navānnamiṣṭānnaṃ dadyādvai prītaye mama ।।41 ।।
mārgaśīrṣe vāhanāni kharoṣṭrā'śvatarān dadet ।
nāgānajāvikān gantrīṃ śakaṭān prītaye mama ।।42।।
pauṣe deyaṃ prabhaktyā ca gṛhaprāvaraṇādikam ।
prāsādanagarādīni cānnaṃ ṣaḍrasasaṃyutam ।।43।।
dāsīdāsamalaṃkārān dadyādvai mama tuṣṭaye ।
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiñcit yacchakyaṃ ca gṛhe śuci ।।44।।
puruṣottamatuṣṭyarthaṃ deyaṃ tat sārvakāmikam ।
yaḥ kārayet śrīkṛṣṇasya mandiraṃ so'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।।45।।
dadetpuṣpaphalāḍhyāँścārāmān yaḥ so'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।
pūrvajāni paścimāni kulānyaṣṭotarāṇi saḥ ।।46।।
tārayedātmanā sārdhaṃ viṣṇormandirakārakaḥ ।
imāśca pitaro devā gāthā gāyanti sādhavaḥ ।।47।।
api naḥ svakule kaścit kṛṣṇabhakto bhaviṣyati ।
harermandirakartā yaḥ sukhaṃ dāsyati no hi saḥ ।।48।।
api naḥ santatā syād vai kṛṣṇālayavilepakaḥ ।
mandire mārjanakartā bhakto yenoddhṛtā vayam ।।49।।
api naḥ santatau jāto dhvajaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamandire ।
dāsyati ca pradīpaṃ sudhūpaṃ puṣpānulepanam ।।2.69.50।।
api naḥ sa kule bhūyādekādṛśyāṃ kariṣyati ।
udyāpanaṃ mama pūjāmupavāsaṃ ca dānakam ।।51 ।।
mahāpātakayukto'pi kṛṣṇāvasathacitrakṛt ।
vimuktapāpo bhavati dhanyaṃ janmā'sya yo'sti me ।।।52।।।
dhanyo rājā manuḥ pūrvo yo loke mānavān vṛṣān ।
pravartayāmāsa nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktiparān parān ।।53।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre devālayānakārayat ।
vibhūtibhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya nārāyaṇasya cālayān ।।54।।
citrayāmāsa śucibhiḥ pañcavarṇaiḥ sucitrakaiḥ ।
dīpapātrāṇi satataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye ।।55।।
sauvarṇāni ca pātrāṇi ghṛtapātrāṇi vai dadau ।
nānāvarṇā vaijayantīrmālā hārān dadau mudā ।।56।।
srajaśca kaṇṭhikā divyā mahāraṃjanarañjitāḥ ।
mañjiṣṭhā navaraṃgīyāḥ śvetapāṭalikāśritāḥ ।।57।।
ārāmān vividhān ramyān puṣpāḍhyān phalaśālinaḥ ।
latāpallavasaṃkhyāptān devadārubhirāvṛtān ।।58।।
hradān manoharān divyāsanakuṃjavirājitān ।
kārayāmāsa parito mandirāya dadau ca tān ।।59।।
mañcānalaṃkṛtāँsteṣu kuśalaiḥ samadhiṣṭhitān ।
gandharvavidyārāgajñaiḥ ratnajaḍitakāsanān ।।2.69.60।।
kārayāmāsa subhagān divyān devālayopamān ।
yeṣu nityaṃ prapūjyante yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
śrotriyā vipravaryāśca ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo'malāḥ ।
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyaśca brahmaparāḥ striyaḥ ।।62।।
itthaṃ tenaiva manunā kṛtā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।
bhaktiśca bhāryayā sārdhaṃ yayāvante hareḥ padam ।।63।।
evaṃ rājā jyāmagho'pi kṛtavān manuvad bhuvi ।
pareśasya parāṃ bhaktiṃ yayau brahmapadaṃ param ।।64।।
tasmādvai rādhike tvaṃ ca kuru devālayaṃ mama ।
māmarcayasva yatnena sādhūn sādhvīrmadāśritāḥ ।।65।।
sadācārān kathāvaktṝn lokakalyāṇakārakān ।
mama bhaktipradān samyaksaṃprapūjaya rādhike ।।66।।
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiḥ ratnairgobhirbhūkanakādibhiḥ ।
bhojanairjalapānādyairaṃgasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।।67।।
vibhave sati devasya prīṇanaṃ kuru sarvathā ।
ityuktā rādhikā cāpi kṛṣṇadevālayaṃ param ।।68।।
kārayāmāsa goloke mandiraṃ candraśobhanam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pratimāṃ śubhām ।।69।।
sampratiṣṭhāpya ca rādhā cakāra sevanādikam ।
sammārjanaṃ lepanaṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ bhojanādikam ।।2.69.70।।
śarkarādipradānaṃ ca dīpaṃ dhūpaṃ pradakṣiṇam ।
nīrājanaṃ cotsavaṃ ca cakāra rādhikā svayam ।।71।।
āyatākṣī pātrasammārjanaṃ kṛṣṇālaye'karot ।
gītaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ cāpi svayaṃ rādhā hyavākarot ।।72।।।
evaṃ rādhā'karod bhaktiṃ patyurvākyena sarvadā ।
patyurvākyaṃ vṛddhavākyaṃ satī cet prakaroti vai ।।73 ।।
duruktaṃ vā samuktaṃ vā snigdhaṃ tad ghṛtavad bhavet ।
āpadbhujaṃgadaṣṭasya mantrahīnasya sarvathā ।।74।।
vṛddhavākyaiṣadhānyeva kurvanti viṣaśūnyatām ।
vṛddhavākyāmṛtaṃ pītvā taduktānyanumanya ca ।।75।।
yā tṛptirjāyate puṃsāṃ somapāne na vai tathā ।
yeṣāṃ vṛddhā na śāstāraste jīvanto'pi vai mṛtāḥ ।।76।।
śocyāsta eva naṣṭāśca bhaviṣyanti pade pade ।
āpadgrāhagṛhītānāṃ vṛddhā yatra na mārgadāḥ ।।77।।
na vā mocayitāraśca teṣāṃ śāntirna vidyate ।
āpatsamudramagnānāṃ majjatāṃ vyasanormiṣu ।।78।।
vṛddhavākyairvinā teṣāmuddhāro na kathaṃcana ।
tasmād yo vṛddhavākyāni śṛṇuyād vidadhāti vā ।।79।।
sa sadyaḥ siddhimāpnoti vṛddhāśīrbhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
rādhike yena tuṣṭaḥ syāṃ tathā kāryaṃ tvayā sadā ।।2.69.80।।
ahaṃ dhyāyāmi me mūlasvarūpaṃ puruṣottamam ।
māṃ dhyāyanti kapilādyāḥ kapilaṃ mānavāḥ pare ।।81 ।।
vāsudevādayo vyūhā dhyāyanti puruṣottamam ।
vāsudevaṃ vikuṇṭhastho dhyāyatyapi narāyaṇaḥ ।।82।।
nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyati śrīviṣṇurviṣṇuṃ prajājanaḥ ।
evaṃ pravartitaṃ dhyānaṃ guroḥ paramparāgatam ।।83।।
gurau viṣṇurvartate ca viṣṇau bhūmā virājate ।
bhūmni bṛhad bṛhatyeva parabrahma virājate ।।84।।
evaṃ svātmavicāreṇa dhyāyet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
seveta taṃ pareśānaṃ vandetā''rādhayedapi ।।85।।
sarvaṃ samarpayedasmai parātmane'ntarātmane ।
māyikātmā'ntarātmāno yogena syāt parātmavān ।।86।।
māyāyāṃ sthitajīvasya dīrghakālena tadguṇāḥ ।
māyākṛtā bhavantyasya kāmakrodhādayo malāḥ ।।87।।
janmajanmāntarā''yātāstairmalino'yamucyate ।
svabhāvo māyayā vyāpto bahujanmagateṣvapi ।।88।।
anvavartata ātmānaṃ satāṃ yogena jīryati ।
parameśāśrayeṇāpi jīryatyeva tataḥ prabhoḥ ।।89।।
kṛpayā mokṣamārgasya bhaktyātmakasya cārjanam ।
tena yāti parabrahma jyāmaghastu yayau yathā ।।2.69.90।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi ।
svargamokṣau bhavetāṃ vai rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।9 1।।
yathā rādhā tathā nārī kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।
yathā ca garuḍastadvannaro dāsyamavāpnuyāt ।।92।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ sevā'rcanadānapūjādiphalamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 69 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 069 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 70
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 071 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ rājā jyāmaghastu pūrvasvabhāvapūritaḥ ।
paścādārādhanalābhānmuktimavāpa tadvad ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ purātanīṃ vairāgyadāyinīm ।
jyāmaghasya kathayāmi bahujanmasamudbhavām ।। 2 ।।
dhanurmaghasya tu ṛṣeḥ putro'bhūt kauśikābhidhaḥ ।
tasya putro'bhavannāmnā jāḍyamagho jaḍākṛtiḥ ।। 3 ।।
na brūte mūrkhavaccāsau nāsau paśyati cā'ndhavat ।
enaṃ mātā gṛhadvāri dyoṭikāyāṃ prarakṣya ca ।। 4 ।।
yayau jalaṃ samāhartuṃ grāmakūpāt tadā khalu ।
kākākṣī rākṣasī bālaṃ preṃkhāto vijahāra ha ।। 5 ।।
surūpaṃ komalaṃ bālaṃ nītvā svarakṣase dadau ।
rākṣaso vīkṣya papraccha kimānītaṃ tvayā priye ।। 6 ।।
sā'bravīt bālakaścā'yaṃ kauśikasyā''hṛto mayā ।
rākṣasaḥ prāha ca bhadre tvayā bhadraṃ na vai kṛtam ।। 7 ।।
samarthaḥ kauśikaścāsmān tūrṇaṃ śapsyati kūpitaḥ ।
tasmādenaṃ tu dolāyāṃ tadgṛhe prāpaya drutam ।। 8 ।।
yadvā jalāharaṇārthaṃ tanmātrā yatra gacchati ।
tatra sthāpaya gatvaiva mātā dṛṣṭvā grahīṣyati ।। 9 ।।
rākṣasī tūrṇamevainaṃ gṛhītvā vāpikāṃ yayau ।
tatrāgatāṃ satīṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ tvavāsṛjat puraḥ ।। 2.70.1 0।।
sā'pi satī sutaṃ prāpya jalaṃ bhṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau ।
bhāgyaṃ matvā sutasyeyaṃ grahapūjāṃ vyadhāpayat ।। 1 1।।
vighnaśāntiṃ ca dānāni kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
rākṣasīkarayogena rākṣasīdugdhapānataḥ ।। 12।।
bāle vai rākṣasabhāvo vartate sparśatastataḥ ।
vardhito bālakaścāyaṃ yajñasūtramavāpa ha ।। 13।।
vedādhītyai jāḍyamagho pitrā gṛhe niyojitaḥ ।
mūrkhatvānna papāṭhā'sau pitā śikṣāṃ karoti ca ।। 14।।
tāḍanādibhayenā'sau kūpe sīmni papāta ha ।
tatrā'styāmalakīvṛkṣaḥ poṣāya phalito'bhavat ।। 15।।
bhakṣayitvā''malakāni kūpe gatvā jalaṃ śubham ।
pibatyeva sadā vṛkṣamūlenā''yāti yāti ca ।। 16।।
vṛkṣavallīsamāchanne kūpe mūlāvarohaṇe ।
sukhenā'yaṃ vartate ca bālako'jñātavartanaḥ ।। 17।।
evaṃ puṣṭo'bhavaccāpi rātrau sasyādijānyapi ।
kaṇakandaphalādīni bahirgatvā'tti nityaśaḥ ।। 18।।
pitrādibhistato jñātaṃ mṛto vā naṣṭa eva ca ।
kintu mātā kadācidvai yajñakāṣṭhā'bhilāṣukī ।। 19।।
yayau tvāmalakīkāṣṭhānyānetuṃ sīmni tatra vai ।
vṛkṣaśākhāḥ samāgṛhya tīre karoti sañcayam ।।2.70.20।।
tāvat kūpe mūlamadhye kṣuto'kasmāddhi bālakaḥ ।
kṣuvanaṃ mānuṣaṃ śrutvā yāvad draṣṭumupāyayau ।।21।।
tāvat putraṃ nijaṃ vīkṣya cātiharṣamupāgamat ।
kūpā'ntaḥsthaṃ sutaṃ mātā vihvalā tvājuhāva ha ।। 22।।
sutaḥ premṇā mātaraṃ saṃdṛṣṭvā gadgadatāṃ gataḥ ।
kūpāduttīrya mūlaiśca mātuḥ pādau vavanda ca ।। 23।।
sā svaputraṃ samāsādya nītvā kāṣṭhāni satvaram ।
putrayuktā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ patiṃ nanāma ca ।।24।।
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ svasutasya tu।
tato'pṛcchacca vipro'sau prasannaḥ prāpya putrakam ।। 25।।
kathaṃ tvaṃ nirgato gehāt kathaṃ cā'dyāpi jīvasi ।
kathaṃ na vadasi putra hetuṃ kathaya sarvathā ।।26।।
jāḍyamaghastataḥ prāha vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajaṃ nijam ।
śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tāta yena mūkatvamāśritam ।।27।।
andhatvaṃ ca jaḍatvaṃ ca kathayāmi yathātatham ।
pūrvamāsamahaṃ vipro jyotirviddhastarekhavid ।। 28।।
nārīṇāṃ hastarekhāṇāṃ parīkṣayā prasaṃgataḥ ।
mohamāptaḥ paradāraruciścā''saṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।29।।
kadācicca janaiścāhaṃ kaṭubhāṣātiraskṛtaḥ ।
mṛto hyu'dbandhanenā'haṃ yamapurīṃ tato gataḥ ।।2.70.3 0।।
tasmād varṣasahasrānte bhuktaśiṣṭe tadāgasi ।
araṇye prāptavān janma vyāghrasya naradehavat ।। 31 ।।
rājñā tu bālato dhṛtvā pañjare pūritastataḥ ।
baddhasya pañjarasthasya vyāghratve'pi sthitasya ca ।।32।।
pūrvajñānaṃ na me naṣṭaṃ kāmanā'pi vyavardhata ।
vyāghro'haṃ na ca hiṃsāmi na ca krauryaṃ karomyapi ।। 33 ।।
rājñā rājñyā samaṃ nityamudyāne viharāmi ca ।
siṃhāsanā'gre tiṣṭhāmi cānugacchāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ ।।34।।
ramayāmi bālavacca tadudyāne vasāmi ca ।
evaṃ yāte dine cā'haṃ yauvanaṃ prāptavān yadā ।।35।।
śānto bhūtvā niṣīdāmi rājñyāḥ snānahradāntike ।
rājā rājñī yadā snātastadā paśyāmi bhāvataḥ ।।36।।
rājñī snāntīṃ viharantīṃ vivastrāṃ ca jale muhuḥ ।
tena me kāmanā pūrvasaṃskārotthā hyabhūnmuhuḥ ।।37।।
rājā sudarśanaḥ snātvā rājyakāryārthameva tu ।
yayau svanagare rājñīmudyāne parihāya ca ।।38।।
sakhībhiḥ sahitā ceyaṃ māṃ vyāghraṃ ruciraṃ śubham ।
pālitaṃ putrasadṛśaṃ rāmayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ।।3 9।।
udyāne'haṃ vyacaraṃ ca tābhiḥ sākaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ārohanti sma tāḥ kvāpi mama pṛṣṭhopari drutam ।।2.70.40।।
ahaṃ kadācit pārśvastho mukhena sakthicumbanam ।
karomyevaṃ kāmanā me rājñyāṃ vyavardhata drutam ।।41।।
rātrau sakhīṣu sarvāsu nidritāsu tadālaye ।
rātryāḥ paryaṃkapārśvasthaścintayāmi nṛpapriyām ।।42।।
tāṃ prati vavṛdhe citte pūrvābhyāsānmanobhavaḥ ।
tasyā api mama sparśād rajobhāvo vyavardhata ।।43।।
mayoktā rājaputri tvaṃ navayauvanaśālinī ।
cittaṃ harasi me rājñi vada kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ ।।44।।
sā'bravīttu manuṣyāyāṃ paśudehasya te priya ।
kathamatrā''vayorvyāghra ratiyoga upaiṣyati ।।45।।
tato'vocamahaṃ rājñi! kauśalyena bhaviṣyati ।
atha sā māṃ samāśliṣya pravṛttā rantumeva ca ।।46।।
tāvat kayācid sakhyā cā'valokito'hameva ca ।
dvārapālān śanairgatvā saśastrān sā śaśaṃsa ha ।।47।।
evaṃ pravartitāṃ vārtā śrutavān nṛpatiḥ svayam ।
rājñā tu māritaścā'haṃ yamalokaṃ gato'bhavam ।।48 ।।
tato varṣaśatānte'haṃ tvabhavaṃ śvetagardabhaḥ ।
bhāravāhī janānāṃ tu kuṃbhakāreṇa yojitaḥ ।।49।।
tatrāpi pūrvavijñānaṃ sarvaṃ me pratyabhāsata ।
ekadā tu mahīmānāḥ kuṃbhakārasya cāgatāḥ ।।2.70.50।।
kanyāḥ striyaḥ surūpāśca dinadvayaṃ sthitāstataḥ ।
tāsāmekā surūpā ca yuvatī ca gṛhe pituḥ ।।5 1 ।।
gantumaicchatpārśvasaṃsthe grāme krośavidūrake ।
tāmuvāca patirgaccha āruhyainaṃ sugardabham ।।52।।
śva evā''gamanaṃ kāryaṃ na stheyaṃ paratastataḥ ।
ityevamuktā sā bhartrā tanvī tvāruhya gardabham ।।53।।
yayau śīghraṃ tvardhapathi nadī tatra samāgatā ।
sajalā tatra sā snātuṃ matpṛṣṭhāt samavātarat ।।54।।
kuṃbhakāro'pi ca sārthaḥ śaucārthaṃ prayayau taṭam ।
sarvairaṃgaiḥ rūpavatīṃ caikalāmārdravastrikām ।।95।।
dṛṣṭvā'haṃ jalapānasya miṣeṇa sannidhau gataḥ ।
snāntīṃ tāmupari gatvā patitvā''śliṣya kāmataḥ ।।56।।
pūrvasaṃskāravaśagoliṅgasparśamakārayam ।
dṛṣṭo'bhavaṃ tadā tasyāḥ sārthajanena vai tadā ।।57।।
tāḍitaśca bhṛśaṃ yaṣṭyā patito'haṃ jalāntare ।
kṣaṇādutthāya ca bhayāt pradruto dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।।58।।
tato'bhidravataḥ kaṇṭhe rajjudārḍhyaṃ gatā bahu ।
galapāśenā'rdharātrādabhūnme jīvitakṣayaḥ ।।59।।
tato'smi narake bhūyastasmānmukto'bhavaṃ śukaḥ ।
mahāraṇye tato baddhaḥ śabareṇa durātmanā ।।2.70.60।।
pañjare nyasya vikrīto vaṇikputrāya tatra ca ।
gṛhe vasāmi satataṃ yuvatīnāṃ samīpataḥ ।।6 1।।
tāstaruṇyaḥ poṣayanti phalaudanādibhiḥ sadā ।
ekadā tu vaṇikputrī yuvatī candrikā'bhidhā ।।62।।
karābhyāṃ māṃ prajagrāha reme vācā punaḥ punaḥ ।
śayane vakṣasi kṛtvā māṃ vācayati gītikām ।।63।।
tato'haṃ stanayoḥ sparśāt pūrvasaṃskāravegataḥ ।
kāmabhāvena tāṃ guhye pasparśoḍḍīya vai muhuḥ ।।64।।
pannakhaiḥ kṣatamāpannaṃ jaghanaṃ sā cukopa ha ।
tatāḍa māṃ sūkṣmayaṣṭyā bhayācca pradrutastataḥ ।।6 5।।
daivāttasyā dṛḍhaṃ nīvīdorakaṃ me gale'bhavat ।
granthirjātā dṛḍhā tena kṣaṇānmṛto'bhavaṃ tataḥ ।।66।।
yamaloke mahākaṣṭaṃ bhuktvā tu vṛṣabho'bhavam ।
cāṇḍālasya gṛhe tvāsaṃ kāṣṭhaśakaṭavāhakaḥ ।।67।।
vane kāṣṭhāni cānetuṃ dampatī yayatustadā ।
madhyāhne jalamānetuṃ cāṇḍālastu nadīṃ yayau ।।68।।
cāṇḍālī yuvatī cāste chāyāyāṃ śakaṭāntike ।
ahaṃ tāmalihaṃ kāmāt pūrvasaṃskāravegataḥ ।।69।।
nadītīre sadā tvevaṃ kāṣṭhā''dānārthameva tau ।
prayātaḥ pratiyātaśca varṣartustatra cāgataḥ ।।2.70.70।।
ekadā tu jvaravyāpto'bhavaccaṇḍālako gṛhe ।
cāṇḍālī tadvane yātā kāṣṭhā''nayanahetave ।।71 ।।
pūrvasañcitakāṣṭhāni bhṛtvā gantryā tatastu sā ।
jalaṃ pāyayituṃ māṃ ca nadyāṃ tatrā'nayat tataḥ ।।72।।
sā snātā rūpasampannā mayā dṛṣṭā digambarā ।
pūrvasaṃskārabhāvena kāmo me hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ।।73 ।।
sā vastrāṇi paridhāya baddhaṃ raśanayā ca mām ।
dhure śakaṭyā yuyuje yoktreṇā''badhya yāvatā ।।74।।
dhurasyā'gre sthitā cāste kṣaṇaṃ tāvadahaṃ tadā ।
uḍḍīya sadhuraścā'haṃ tasyā upari cāpatam ।।75।।
sā madagrapadā''ghātāt patitā dūratastadā ।
ahaṃ yoktreṇa saṃyukto gantryā nimnena karṣitaḥ ।।76 ।।
cakrābhyāṃ nimnagābhyāṃ ca prakṣipto gartake tadā ।
śakaṭyā saha patito'gādhe gartevaśastataḥ ।।77।।
yoktreṇa baddha evā'smi pañcatvamagamaṃ tataḥ ।
sā'pi cotthāya tu śanairgṛhaṃ gatā hi bhāminī ।।78।।
tato nimagno narake dharmarājānuśāsanāt ।
jātastava gṛhe tāta jātismaro'smi sarvathā ।।79।।
tāvantyevā'dya janmāni smarāmi tvānupūrvaśaḥ ।
pūrvābhyāsācca duḥkhāni prāptānyati mayā tataḥ ।।2.70.80 ।।
janmanyatra na vai vacmi na śṛṇomi na kāmaye ।
yena pāpaṃ bhavet tattu nācariṣye kathaṃcana ।।81 ।।
mūkatve ca badhiratve hetuḥ pūrvasmṛtirmama ।
jaḍatve'pi ca vijñānaṃ heturevā'sti netarat ।।82।।
pāpāni ghorarūpāṇi manasā karmaṇā girā ।
śubhaṃ vā'pyaśubhaṃ vāpi bandhanaṃ vā vadho'pi vā ।।83।।
pūrvābhyāsena jāyante kāmanādikamityapi ।
tasmādvijñānavān jānan tatra muhyati naiva tu ।।84।।
paurvikīṃ tu yadā jātiṃ smaratyatra tu mānavaḥ ।
tadā sa tebhyaḥ pāpebhyo nivṛttiṃ hi gamiṣyati ।।85।।
dānaṃ tapo'dhyayanaṃ ca steyaṃ pāpaṃ yaśo vṛṣaḥ ।
artho jñānaṃ cāgnidāhaḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ।।86।।
ahiṃsā bhagavadbhaktiḥ sthairyaṃ śāntiśca kāmanā ।
kleśastāpo mithunāptiḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ।।87।।
snehaḥ prakṛtirāstikyaṃ sevā vidyā kalā dhanam ।
kuṭumbitā guruḥ śiṣyaḥ pūrvābhyāsavaśā hi te ।।88।।
tasmād yāmi vanaṃ tāta śubhārthaṃ pāpanuttaye ।
ityuktvā ca yayau natvā vanaṃ jāḍyamaghastataḥ ।।89।।
kurukṣetraṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ tato badarikāśramam ।
tapaścakāra bahudhā rādhike pāpanuttaye ।।2.70.9 0।।
kālena nidhanaṃ prāpto gaṃgāyāṃ tu tadā punaḥ ।
tapobhiḥ kṣīṇapāpaḥ sa puṇyavārdhiḥ savāsanaḥ ।।9 1।।
gaurjare śrīnagare'yaṃ rajiputro'bhavattataḥ ।
karkamaghasya rājñaḥ sa jyāmagho dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ।।92।।
paśujātīyasaṃskārāstāpasī prakṛtistathā ।
nārāyaṇasya bhaktiśca jyāmaghe'pi tadā'bhavan ।।93 ।।
jātismaro'bhavad rājaputro vakti na kiṃcana ।
na śṛṇoti na hasati na cittaṃ vidadhāti ca ।।94।।
nirmanasko bhojanaṃ ca bhuṃkte pāti jalaṃ tathā ।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi dhatte nirmānaso yathā ।।95।।
rājyaṃ ca rājyabhogāśca dravyaṃ bhṛtyāśca kiṃkarāḥ ।
dāsā dāsyo gajāśvāśca sarvaṃ tvasya samaṃ hyabhūt। ।। 96 ।।
śayyā puṣpamayī cāpi pṛthvī rūkṣā'sya vai samā ।
miṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ bhojyaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca vā samam ।।97।।
praśaṃsā cā'prasaṃśā vā mānaṃ tiraḥ samaṃ tathā ।
namaskāro'thavā pṛṣṭhakāro'sya samatāṃ gataḥ ।।98।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya yauvanaṃ samupāgatam ।
pitrā suyojitaścāyaṃ vivāhena gṛhāśrame ।। 91।।
kā patnī kaḥ patiśceti jijñāsā'sya na vidyate ।
kaḥ kāmaḥ kaśca saṃkalpaḥ kā ratirviratistathā ।। 2.70.100 ।।
samaṃ cā'syā'bhavat sarvamekadā dayitā patim ।
prapaccha kāraṇaṃ tasmai audāsīnye niśāntare ।। 10 1।।
tataḥ sa rādhike smṛtvā patnīṃ jagāda śāntitaḥ ।
yatka rtavyaṃ bhavedatra mānave durlabhe śubham ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pūrvasvabhāvānuvartanaṃ jāḍyamaghadṛṣṭāntena ṣaḍbhirjanmabhirvivecitamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 70 ।।

[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 072 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike yacca jyāmaghaḥ prāha bhāminīm ।
sarvamokṣapradaṃ jñānaṃ yatkṛtvā nāvaśiṣyate ।। 1 ।।
jyāmaghaḥ svapriyāmāha śṛṇu devi dhanālase ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya parā śaktirmāyā mohakarī matā ।। 2 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇī māyā yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ।
anayaiva jagat sarvaṃ sadevā'suramānuṣam ।। 3 ।।
sṛjati poṣayatyeva grasati śrīpatiḥ svayam ।
asyāstvaṃśānadhiṣṭhāya śaktimanto'bhavan surāḥ ।। 4 ।।
brahmeśānādayaḥ sarve'nayā śaktyā sureśvarāḥ ।
saiṣā sarvajagatsūtiḥ prakṛtistriguṇātmikā ।। 5 ।।
nā'laṃ devā na pitaro mānavā vāsavo'pi ca ।
māyāmetāṃ samuttartuṃ ye cānye bhuvi dehinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
tadāśīstannamaskārastanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ ।
ārādhayan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tarati tāṃ janaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ekadā paramo bhakta indradyutiśca bhūsuraḥ ।
sadā viṣṇuparo bhūtvā māyāṃ draṣṭuṃ mano'karot ।। 8 ।।
tasyaivaṃ cehamānasya kadācitparamā kalā ।
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ nārāyaṇodbhavam ।। 9 ।।
dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā nārāyaṇapriyāṃ satīm ।
tuṣṭāva tu tato devīṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ ।। 2.71.1 0।।
kā tvaṃ mātarviśālākṣi viṣṇucihnāṃkite śubhe ।
yāthātathyena rūpaṃ svaṃ vadedānīṃ kṛpāmayi ।। 11 ।।
śrutvā'sya sā'vadallakṣmīḥ śrīrahaṃ śrīhareḥ priyā ।
na māṃ paśyanti munayo na devā mānavāḥ kutaḥ ।। 1 2।।
nārāyaṇātmikā tvekā māyā'haṃ tanmayī parā ।
na me nārāyaṇād bhedastanmayyahaṃ parameśvarī ।। 1 3।।
sa ca sarveśvaraḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
tanmayāstatkṛtārhāśca puruṣottamasevakāḥ ।। 14।।
jñānena karmayogena ye bhajanti pareśvaram ।
te tasya paramā bhaktā na teṣāṃ prabhavāmyaham ।। 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvasamarpaṇaiḥ ।
jñānenā''rādhayan bhakto'vaśyaṃ mokṣamavāpsyati ।। 16।।
śrutvā papraccha ca punarindradyatiḥ śriyaṃ tadā ।
kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśo jñātavyaśceti me vada ।। 17।।
evamuktā tu sā māyā karābhyāṃ taṃ tu bhūsuram ।
saṃspṛśyā''ha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vakṣyati te'nagha ।। 18।।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe cāntaradhīyata ।
vipraḥ sa śrīhariṃ draṣṭuṃ tasthau tatra samādhinā ।। 19।।
tadbhaktyā'nugrahaṃ kurvan sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ ।
prādurāsīt pītavāsāḥ kiśoraśca jaganmayaḥ ।।2.71.20।।
indradyutirhariṃ vīkṣya neme tuṣṭāva taṃ prabhum ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo puruṣottama keśava ।।21 ।।
anādiśrīhare svāmin hṛṣīkeśa ca te namaḥ ।
viśvātman sṛṣṭikṛtkṛṇānantaśakte ca te namaḥ ।।22।।
nirguṇā'nantadivyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pūrṇamūrtika ।
jñānagamya kṛpālabhya puruṣottama te namaḥ ।।23 ।।
anantamūrtaye tubhya namo'spvānandarūpiṇe ।
namasta parameśāya brahmaṇe paramātmane ।।।24।।
tvaṃ pitā sarvabhūtānāṃ mātā bandhuḥ suhṛt sakhā ।
tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma cinmātraṃ vyoma 3 bṛhat ।।25।।।
sarvatyā''dhāramavyaktamanantaṃ tamasaḥ param ।
tvāṃ paśyanti parātmānaṃ jñānadīpena sevakāḥ ।।26।।
prapadye taṃ bhavedrūpaṃ saccidānandavigraham ।
yatrāste bhagavaustadvai śrīhareḥ paramaṃ pakṣa ।।27।।
tvameva nayasi śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।
śānaṃ dehi padaṃ dehi tvanmāyā mā pradehi me ।।28।।
ityuktvā prapatantaṃ taṃ pādayoḥ svakareṇa ha ।
pasparśa prahasan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।29।।
spṛṣṭamātro bhagavatā divyacakṣustadā'bhavat ।
yathāvapparamaṃ tattvaṃ jñātavāँstatprasādataḥ ।।2.71.30।।
uvāca tvatprasādānme cā'saṃdigdhaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
jñānaṃ brahmaikaviṣayaṃ jātamānandasiddhidam ।। 3 1।।
śādhi māṃ bhagavannatra kathaṃ sevyo'si sarvathā ।
kiṃ kārya ca mayā loke tvadbhaktena pareśvara ।। 32।।।
śrutvā bhaktaṃ hariḥ prāha bhaktānāṃ dharmaśālinām ।
jñānena bhaktiyogena pūjanīyo'hameva tu ।।33।।
vijñāya māṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vibhūtiṃ kāryakāraṇam ।
pravṛttiṃ me parāṃ jñātvā mokṣārthī māṃ samarcayet। ।। 34।।
sarvasaṃgān parityajya jñātvā manmāyikaṃ jagat ।
ekaṃ māṃ svātmani dhyāyet sa paśyenmāṃ parātparam ।। 3 6।।
trividhāṃ bhāvanāṃ kṛtvā bhaja māṃ tvaṃ sadā dvija ।
ekā madviṣayā tatra parabrahmasugocarā ।। 36 ।।
vyatirekeṇa bhagavān pare dhāmni virājate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 37।।
svarāṭ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaśaktimān ।
dvitīyā bhāvanā tatra sarvā'cicciccharīriṇī ।। 38 ।।
jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaṃ śrīparamāpmanaḥ ।
adhīnaṃ ca niyāmyaṃ ca sarvaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ।। 39 ।।
teṣu sarveṣu tattveṣu cāntarātmā virājate ।
so'yaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 2.71.40 ।।
tadvinā'ṇurapi nāsti tadātmakaṃ ca tanmayam ।
taṃ vyatiricya na cāsti jaḍaṃ cetanamityapi ।।41 । ।
tasmāt sarvā tasya mūrtirmūrtimānata eva saḥ ।
divyo divyo yathā cāste tathā jaḍe'pi divyakaḥ ।।42।।
nirbaddho niṣkalaṃkaścā'saँgo'ntaryāmisaṃsthitaḥ ।
tvayi mayi tathā'nyatra sarvatrā'yaṃ virājate ।।43 ।।
ityevaṃ māṃ sarvatattve vilokya parisevaya ।
tṛtīyā bhāvanā cātha naije brahmasvarūpiṇī ।। 44।।
brahmasvarūpaḥ svayaṃ cā'smītyevaṃ manyeta dehavān ।
sā brāhmī nijarūpasya guṇātigā pravartate । ।45।।
ahaṃ brahmāsmi jīvātmā jīvatvaṃ karmayuktatā ।
karmāṇi brahmaṇi naiva santi brahmātmatā hi sā ।।46 ।।
sarvaṃ karma prakartavyaṃ brahma tena na lipyate ।
evaṃ tredhā bhāvayitvā paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt ।।47।।
aśakto mūḍhavaccāpi hareḥ śaraṇamāśrayet ।
tataḥ sarvaprayatnena tanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ ।।48 ।।
ārādhayet parabrahma tena mokṣo bhaved dhruvam ।
tasya śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।।49।।
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni nityā vibhūtirucyate ।
prabhvārādhanayā bhakte vibhūtiḥ pratipadyate ।। 2.71.5 0 ।।
kārye jagati cā'vyakte vyaktā'vyaktātmake'pyaham ।
kāraṇaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ brahma viśiṣṭaṃ cā'smi sarvathā ।।5 1 ।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇastatrā'ntaryāmīśvarapūjitaḥ ।
sargasthityantakartā'smi vijñāyaivaṃ bhajasva mām ।।52।।
tatastvaṃ jñānakarmabhyāṃ māmupaiṣyasi yogataḥ ।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī pūrvamāsaṃ mahān virāṭ ।।53।।।
caturmukhastato brahmā mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pitāmahaḥ ।
rudraḥ sṛṣṭastathā viṣṇustato mayā mamāṅgataḥ ।।54।।
sṛṣṭā śrīrviṣṇuśaktiśca kamalāyatalocanā ।
surūpā saumyavadanā mohinī sarvadehinām ।।55।।
śucismitā suprasannā divyakāntiḥ suśobhitā ।
divyamālāmbarabhūṣādhāriṇī mahimāspadā ।। 56।।
nārāyaṇī mahāmāyā mūlaprakṛtivaiṣṇavī ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tadā brahmā māmuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ।।57।।
mohāyā'śeṣabhūtānāṃ niyojaya surūpiṇīm ।
yeneyaṃ vipulā sṛṣṭirvardheta mama keśava ।।58।।
tathokto'haṃ śriyaṃ devīmavocaṃ prahasaँstadā ।
devīdamakhilaṃ viśvaṃ sadevā'suramānuṣam ।।।59।।
mohayitvā mamā''deśāt saṃsāre vinipātaya ।
kevalāṃ tvāṃ ye bhajeran tān tvayi sannirodhaya ।।।2.71.6 0।।
jñānayogaratān dāntān brahmiṣṭhān brahmavādinaḥ ।
akrodhanān satyaparān dūrataḥ parivarjaya ।।6 1।।
vedavijñānavedāntajñānaśamitasaṃśayān ।
brahmayajñaparān viprān dūrataḥ parivarjaya ।।62।।
ye yajanti japairhomairbhajanaiḥ parameśvaram ।
svādhyāyenejyayā dūrāttān prayatnena varjaya ।।6 3 ।।
bhaktiyogasamāyuktānīśvarārpitamānasān ।
mayi sarvārpaṇakartṝn dūrātpariharā'malān ।।64।।
mannāmā''saktamanaso manmūrtidhyānaparāyaṇān ।
matsādhusevakān bhaktān dharmiṣṭhān parivarjaya ।।65।।
bahunā'tra kimuktena sādhūn sādhvīrvivarjaya ।
madārādhanasaṃmagnān manniyogānna mohaya ।।66 ।।
evaṃ mayā mama māyā preritā mama vallabhā ।
yathādeśaṃ karotīyaṃ na badhnāti mamā'nugān ।।67।।
tāṃ madbhaktaḥ pūjayecca lakṣmīṃ śriyaṃ samarcayet ।
śriyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ puṣṭiṃ medhāṃ yaśo balam ।।68।।
arcitā bhagavatpatnī dadāti sampadaḥ śubhāḥ ।
kṛṣṇasevāṃ dadātyeṣā tasmāllakṣmīṃ samarcayet ।।69।।
vinā karma na vai dehī tiṣṭhate ca nisargataḥ ।
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma jāyate ।।2.71.70।।
jñānapūrvaṃ nivṛttaṃ syāt pravṛttaṃ yadato'nyathā ।
nivṛttaṃ sevamānastu yāti tatparamaṃ padam ।।71 ।।
kṣamā damo dayā dānamalobhastyāga ityapi ।
ārjavaṃ cānasūyā ca tīrthānusaraṇaṃ tathā ।।72।।।
satyaṃ santoṣamāstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ ।
devatābhyarcanaṃ pūjā sādhūnāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ।।73।।।
ahiṃsā priyavāditvamapaiśunyaṃ sunamratā ।
sarvamanuṣyajātīnāṃ dharmo'yaṃ mokṣado bhavet ।।74।।
prājāpatyaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ svargasthānaṃ kriyāvatām ।
sthānamaindraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathādharmaiḥ pravartatām ।।75।।
vaiśyānāṃ mārutaṃ sthānaṃ tathādharmeṣu vartinām ।
gāndharvaṃ śūdrajātīnāṃ tathādāsyeṣu vartinām ।।76।।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇāṃ yatīnāmūrdhvaretasām ।
yatsthānaṃ tattu vairājaṃ sthānaṃ vai gurusevinām ।।77।।
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yatsthānaṃ tat sadharmivanaukasām ।
prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ tathādharmeṣu vartatām ।।78।।
yatīnāṃ nyāsināmūrdhvaretasāṃ tyāgināṃ satām ।
satīnāṃ brahmasādhvīnāṃ vairājaṃ sthānamucyate ।।79।।
yogīnāmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ bhūmnaścāvyākṛtaṃ tu yat ।
bhaktānāṃ tu tadūrdhvaṃ ca vyomākhyaṃ paramakṣaram ।।2.71.80 ।।
ānandamaiśvaraṃ dhāma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpitātmanām ।।8 1 ।।
paramaṃ dhāma evāsti parameśvararājitam ।
sarvaibrahmamayairyuktaiḥ saccidānandalakṣaṇaiḥ ।।82।।
śṛṇu cānyat pravakṣyāmi mokṣadaṃ jñānamuttamam ।
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ tu dvaividhyaṃ cāntare matam ।।83।।
brahmacāryupakurvāṇo naiṣṭhiko brahmatatparaḥ ।
yo'dhītya vidhivad vedān gṛhasthāśramamāviśet ।।84।।
upakurvāṇako jñeyo naiṣṭhiko maraṇāntikaḥ ।
sādhakaścā'pyudāsīno gṛhastho dvividho mataḥ ।।85।।
kuṭumbabharaṇāyattaḥ sādhako'sau gṛhī bhavet ।
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya niḥsaṃgaḥ syādudāsavān ।।86।।
vānaprasthastāpasaśca maukṣikaśca dvidhā mataḥ ।
tapohomayajanasvādhyāyaniṣṭhastu tāpasaḥ ।।87 ।।
tataścāgre dhyānaniṣṭho kṛṣṇasevastu maukṣikaḥ ।
sannyāso jñānabhāk cādyo dvitīyo bhaktibhāgapi ।।88।।
jñānāya vartate bhikṣurdehātmanorvivekavān ।
ātmaratiścātmatṛptaḥ sanyāso jñānabhāgayam ।।89।।
samyagdarśanasampannaḥ kṛṣṇasevāparāyaṇaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaratiḥ kṛṣṇatṛptaḥ sanyāsau maukṣikaḥ sa hi ।।2.71.90 ।।
yogī tu cāśramaḥ sarvāśrameṣu vidyate sadā ।
gṛhe'nāsakta evā''dyo vivekī sa tu yogirāṭ ।।9 1 ।।
ahaṃ brahmā'kṣararūpo nirlepaḥ sa tu yogirāṭ ।
parabrahmaṇa evā'haṃ prapannaḥ sa tu yogirāṭ ।।92।।
evaṃ tredhā bhaved yogī mokṣamārgānuyogavān ।
evaṃ mayā prajābhyaścārpitaṃ vai mokṣasādhanam ।। 93।।
brahmaṇe śikṣitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmā dadau tataśca tat ।
ṛṣibhyo nijaputrebhyastairmārgairmokṣamāpnuvan ।।94।।
guṇāstrayo gṛhītāśca mayaiva jagato hitāḥ ।
anyonyamanuraktāste hyanyonyamapajīvinaḥ ।।95।।
anyonyapraṇatāścaiva līlayā pārameśvarāḥ ।
sattvarajastamoyogānmamaiva paramātmanaḥ ।।96।।
tisrastumūrtayaḥ proktā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
ahaṃ brahmā, mahādevo, na bhinnāḥ paramārthataḥ ।। 97।।
vibhajya svecchayā''tmānamantaryāmī sthito'pyaham ।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vandyastredhā'pi mādhavaḥ ।।98।।
yadīcchedacirātsthānaṃ yattanmokṣākhyamavyayam ।
varṇāśramasya dharmeṇa bhaktyā māṃ sevayet dvijaḥ ।। 99।।
pūjayed bhāvayuktena yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā ।
āśrame vaiṣṇave brāhme śāṃbhave vā sthito'pi mām ।। 2.71.10 0।।
taccihnadhārī niyatastadbhaktajanavatsalaḥ ।
dhyāyenmāmarcayed devān parāvidyāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 101 ।।
yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ prapannaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ।
dhārayedūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tu lalāṭe candanādibhiḥ ।। 102।।
agre śaṃbhurmadhye viṣṇurmūle brahmā pratiṣṭhati ।
prapanno yā jagadbījaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।। 1 03।।
dhārayet sa mahābinduṃ lalāṭe bhālamadhyagam ।
ūrdhvarekhā śāṃbhavī ca madhye viṣṇurvyavasthitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
adhorekhā tu sā brāhmī tridevāḥ santi tatra ca ।
śaṃbhuṃ prapanno bhaktastu bhasmanā vai tripuṇḍrakam ।। 1 05।।
lalāṭe candramastulyaṃ cārdhabhāgena dhārayet ।
upari vartate śaṃbhurmadhye viṣṇuradho hyajaḥ ।। 1 06।।
saṃvartate tataścaitad brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam ।
sūryatulyaṃ rudrabhālaṃ candratulyaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ।। 1 07।।
vahnitulyaṃ brahmabhālaṃ tilakenojjvalaṃ sadā ।
bhavatyeva surasthānamaiśvaraṃ tilake kṛte ।। 1 08।।
evaṃ cihnaṃ paraṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā vivekamātmanaḥ ।
datvā''tmānaṃ prabhoḥ pāde śāśvataṃ padamāpnuhi ।। 1 09।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā''śrayam ।
jñānaṃ vijñānasampannaṃ svapatnyai jyāmagho dadau ।। 2.71.11 0।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī purendradyutaye dadau ।
mokṣadaṃ sarvamevaitad vijñānaṃ karmiṇāmapi ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jyāmaghanṛpaḥ svapatnyai dhanālasāyai bhagavatā indradyutiviprāya pūrvamuktaṃ sarvamuktavānityādinirūpaṇanā-
maikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 71 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 071 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 72
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 073 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
nibodha rādhike! caitad vijñānaṃ paramādbhutam ।
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā ।। 1 ।।
āśramāḥ kramasampannāḥ kāraṇādanyathā'pi te ।
utpannajñānavijñānī vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।। 2 ।।
pravrajed brahmacaryāttu gṛhasthādvā yathocitam ।
dārānāhṛtya vidhivad yajecca vividhairmakhaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
dharmeṇotpādayet putrān vairāgye sati sannyaset ।
atha vairāgyavegena sthātuṃ notsahate gṛhe ।। 4 ।।
vānaprastho bhavet pūrvaṃ paścāt sanyāsamāśrayet ।
ativairāgyavegastu sanyāsameva cāśrayet ।। 5 ।।
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā yadvā sanyāsamityapi ।
punarna gṛhamāgacchet na viśed dārasaṃgame ।। 6 ।।
sarveṣāmeva vairāgyaṃ sanyāse tu vidhīyate ।
aviraktastu sanyāsāt patatyena na saṃśayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ekāśrame'thavā samyag vartetā''maraṇāntikam ।
taddharmijñānibhaktastu so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ।। 8 ।।
dharmārthaṃ dattasarvasvo brahmavidyaḥ praśāntimān ।
jñānavijñānasampanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ।। 9 ।।
brahmaṇyarpayya karmāṇi kāmasaṃgādivarjitaḥ ।
prasannā'raktamanasā kurvāṇo yāti tatpadam ।। 2.72.1 0।।
brahmaṇā dīyate deyaṃ brahmaiva dīyate hi tat ।
dīyate brahmaṇe dānaṃ brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param ।। 11 ।।
nā'haṃ kartā sarvametad brahmaiva kurute tathā ।
etad brahmārpaṇaṃ karma brahmaṇi paridhīyate ।। 12।।
pṛṇotu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī svakarmaṇā ।
evaṃ matvā kriyate tad brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param ।। 13 ।।
phalānāṃ cāpi sanyāsaṃ prakuryātparameśvare ।
evaṃ phalapradānaṃ ca brahmārpaṇamanuttamam ।। 14।।
kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ saṃgavarjitam ।
kriyate viduṣā karma tadbhavedapi mokṣadam ।। 15।।
karmaṇāṃ phalasannyāso yadi brahmaṇi neyate ।
tadā phalena badhyeta mokṣarodho bhavettataḥ ।। 16।।
arpaṇāt kṣīyate pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ vā mokṣabodhakam ।
aihikaṃ paurvikaṃ vāpi manaḥprasannatā bhavet ।। 17।।
ātmavittvaṃ bhaveccāpi brahmavijjāyate tataḥ ।
karmaṇā sahitāj jñānāt samyag yogo'bhijāyate ।। 18।।
yogāt śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasānnidhyamīyate ।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ ।। 1 9।।
karmāṇīśvaratuṣṭyarthaṃ kuryānnaiṣkarmyamāpnuyāt ।
samprāpya brahmavijñānaṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tatprasādataḥ ।।2.72.20।।
nijātmātmaparabrahmānande magno jitendriyaḥ ।
ekākī nirmamaḥ śānto jīvannapi samuktavat ।। 21 ।।
vīkṣate paramātmānaṃ parabrahma pareśvaram ।
nityānandī nirupādhiḥ śrīharau līnatāṃ vrajet। ।।22।।
tasmāt seveta ca rādhe naiṣkarmye tvarpaṇātmakam ।
tṛptaye parameśasya tena yāyāt paraṃ padam ।।23।।
evaṃ kṛtā tu yā niṣṭhā siddhiṃ dadāti śāśvatīm ।
na tvetāṃ samatikramya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ।।24।।
evaṃ sarvaṃ jyāmagho'pi vicārya cātmano hitam ।
uktvā patnyai samastaṃ tu vijñānaṃ jñānapūrvakam ।।25 ।।
kṛtvā jñānena ca nijāṃ kāntāṃ tu brahmarūpiṇīm ।
datvā rājyaṃ svānujāya śrīmaghāya haripriyaḥ ।। 26 ।।
jyāmaghaḥ strīsahitaśca pitroḥ pādau praṇamya ca ।
bhrātaraṃ ca samāśliṣya kṣemamāvedya sarvataḥ ।।27।।
prajāśīrvādamādāya sābhramatīnadītaṭe ।
āśrame tu satāṃ nityaṃ satsaṃgaṃ pracakāra ha ।।28।।
bhrātrā svanāmasahitaṃ tacchrīnagaraṃ khyāpitam ।
jyāmaghastu tato yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ śubham ।।29।।
kārayāmāsa svabhrātṛdvārā sābhramatītaṭe ।
tadbhaktyā homasamaye śrīyutaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।।2.72.3 0।।
mūrtimāँstatra cāyāto yajñamaṇḍapamacyutaḥ ।
vahniḥ svayaṃ mūrtimāँśca brahmā śaṃbhustathā''gatāḥ ।।3 1।।
devatā bubhujarhavyaṃ jyāmaghena samarpitam ।
śrīḥ prasannā ca taṃ prāha tava bhaktyā janārdanaḥ ।।32।।
prasanno māṃ tava rājye sthātuṃ cājñāṃ karoti hi ।
nāhamekākinī vāsaṃ kariṣye prattane tava ।।33।।
yajñatṛptā'smi sañjātā sākaṃ matpatinā suraiḥ ।
kārayā'trā''layaṃ ramyaṃ yatra vasāmi nityadā ।।34।।
śrutvā ca jyāmagho bhrātrā saha mumoda bhaktarāṭ ।
evamuktvā punaḥ prāha yāhi kuṃkumavāpikām ।। 35।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ tatra vasāmi nityadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāparāyaṇā ।।36।।
dampatyostatra tu punaḥ sevayā dāsyayuktayā ।
darśanaṃ me svāminaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।37।।
ityuktvā ca tirorāsa sadevā sanarāyaṇā ।
yajñaḥ samāptimagamannagare śrīrvyavardhata ।।38।।
śrīmaghaṃ pitarau natvā jyāmagho dattadakṣiṇaḥ ।
sābhramatyāṃ naukayā ca sapatnīko viniryayau ।।3 9।।
śrīmaghaḥ kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ saptabhūmikam ।
meghasparśaṃ saśikharaṃ nārāyaṇākhyaghaṭṭake ।।2.72.40।।
tatra lakṣmīyuto nārāyaṇo vaidikakarmabhiḥ ।
pratiṣṭhāpita evādau rājñā'smai vāṭikā'rpitā ।।41 ।।
pūjānaivedyaśṛṃgārotsavāścāpi niyojitāḥ ।
evaṃ bheje śrīmagho'pi śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।42।।
lakṣavarṣaṃ tu tadrājyaṃ bhuktvā dhāma paraṃ yayau ।
jyāmagho'pi nadīmārgādāyayau staṃbhavāridhim ।।43।।
tataḥ śrīgopanāthaṃ ca kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataḥ param ।
nāvaṃ visṛjya yānena yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ।।44।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya śrīlomaśāśramam ।
bhūmikāṃ divyaśobhāḍhyāṃ vīkṣyā''nandaṃ paraṃ yayau ।। 45।।
dṛṣṭvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāsādamucchritam ।
vyomacumbiśikharāṇi dhvajān vīkṣya sagadgadaḥ ।।46 ।।
daṇḍavat praṇanāmādau pradakṣiṇaṃ cakāra tam ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto vipro bālasvarūpavān ।।47।।
ramaṇīyaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ sarvasaundaryabhājanam ।
padmapatrāyatanetraḥ sūkṣmacakrānvitā'ṅguliḥ ।।48।।
vakṣodhṛtojjvalamaṇistejaḥparidhiśobhitaḥ ।
svāgataṃ pracakārā'sau tīrthasthalāni darśayan ।।49।।
nināya mandire yatra śrīkāntaḥ saṃvirājate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gajāsanasthitam ।।2.72.50।।
darśayāmāsa vipraḥ sa tatra cāntaradhīyata ।
jyāmaghastasya rājñī ca paramāścaryamāgatau ।।5 1।।
sākṣānmānavanāṭyasya darśanaṃ prāpya tatparam ।
bālakṛṣṇasya ca tatra darśanaṃ prāpya vai punaḥ ।।52।।
dvayoraikyaṃ svarūpe ca svabhāve guṇavartane ।
mūrterapīti vijñāyā'manyatāṃ ca kṛtārthakau ।।53 ।।
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ jyāmaghasya ca tatstriyāḥ ।
sākṣād viprabaṭurūpo bālakṛṣṇo'bhavattadā ।।54।।
ānināya gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bālakṛṣṇe tiro'bhavat ।
anekajanmapuṇyānāṃ sevayā tatprasannatā ।।।55।।।
jāyate yena bhagavān svayaṃ svagṛhamāyayau ।
tato gopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca mātaraṃ kambharāsatīm ।।56।।
bhagavantaṃ ca santoṣāṃ dadṛśatustataḥ param ।
śukaṃ dṛṣṭvā vallabhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vai suramaṇḍalam ।।57।।
mumudatustāvatyarthaṃ pupūjatū parameśvaram ।
candanākṣatakuṃkumośīragulālavāribhiḥ ।।58।।
puṣpatulasīkalhārapuṇḍarīkasukesaraiḥ ।
hārabhūṣāmbaradravyaiḥ pūjayāmāsaturhi tau ।।59।।
upadāḥ svarṇapātrādi nyadhātāṃ puratastadā ।
miṣṭapakvānnapātrādi tāmbūlakaṃ jalādikam ।।2.72.6 0।।
dadatustau śrīharaye mātre ca janakāya ca ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakratuśca daṇḍavacca namaskṛtim ।।6 1 ।।
bālakṛṣṇastu papracchāgamane kṣemamityapi ।
kuśalaṃ ca pravāse'pyapīḍāṃ sukhāgamaṃ tathā ।।62।।
tata ātithyakāryārthaṃ nināya dampatī hariḥ ।
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa jalaṃ tāmbūlakādikam ।।63।।
nivāsārthaṃ svatantraṃ ca saudhaṃ hariḥ samārpayat ।
dampatībhyāṃ dāsadāsīrdadau vastūni sarvaśaḥ ।।64।।
viśaśrāmātha rājā'sau sāyaṃ tvaśvasarovaram ।
snātuṃ prayayau vidhinā snātvā sandhyāṃ cakāra ha ।।65।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca tīrthakoṭyanvitasya ca ।
aṣṭottaraśatavartiyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ।।66।।
jalaṃ pītvā nijaṃ saudhaṃ samāyayau ca sānugaḥ ।
rātriṃ nināya sukhataḥ prātaḥsnānottaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।।67।।
pūjayitvā svāminaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni sarvaśaḥ ।।68।।
svarṇabhūṣāmbaradravyamuktāmaṇīn dadau bahūn ।
bhojayāmāsa tīrthasthān viprān ṛṣīn sukanyakāḥ ।।69।।
sarveṣāṃ cāpi devānāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ cakāra ha ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau ।।2.72.70।।
dhanyo vai gundrako vṛkṣo dhanyā tintiḍikā śubhā ।
dhanyo dāḍimavṛkṣaśca dhanyau jambudvayadrumau ।।71।।
dhanyā sā badarī yatra bhagavān saṃvirājate ।
dhanyā sā kuṃkumavāpī tīrthottamottamottamā ।।72।।
dhanyo'haṃ jyāmaghaścāpi dhanyā dhanālasā priyā ।
yeṣāmanādidevaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśraye ।।73 ।।
vāso vai vidyate te tu brahmaloke vasanti hi ।
evaṃ cintayamānaṃ taṃ rājñī prāha tvarānvitā ।।74।।
mandiraṃ śrīdarśitaṃ tat kārayā'tra mahattamam ।
yatra nārāyaṇo devaḥ sadā naḥ pūjyatāṃ vrajet ।।75।।
śrutvā rājā mandiraṃ ca kīdṛg viśālamucchritam ।
kārayitavyamevetyacintayat kṣaṇamātrakam ।।76 ।।
tāvattejaḥ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dadarśa cāyatam ।
tatra dadarśa śikharaṃ caikaṃ viśālamantare ।।77।।
tatra madhye śubhāṃ mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmikām ।
vāme rādhāṃ śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ pāravatīṃ prabhāṃ tathā ।।78।।
māṇikīṃ ceti patnīstā dadarśa divyadarśanāḥ ।
dakṣe pitaraṃ jananīṃ santoṣāṃ bhaginīṃ tathā ।।79।।
bhagavantaṃ śukaṃ cāpi vallabhaṃ haribāndhavān ।
dadarśa maṇḍalaṃ caitat svaṃ rājñīṃ pradadarśa ca ।।2.72.80 ।।
sevāyāṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ tataścāntaradhīyata ।
rājā śilpivaraṃ tatra cāhūyā'kathayattadā ।।81 ।।
śilpivaryaścitrapaṭaṃ cakāra tadyathoditam ।
tato vai mandiraṃ ramyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasya paścime ।।।82।।
kārayāmāsa sampūrṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhinā'pi ca ।
trayodaśapratimānāṃ kārayāmāsa bhūsuraiḥ ।।83 ।।
svasaudhaṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya ca lomaśam ।
dīkṣāṃ jagrāha ca sāṃkhyayogadharmānvitāṃ śubhām ।।84।।
nijasaudhe mandire taṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
bheje bhaktyā sapatnīkaścottamo vaiṣṇavo mahān ।।85।।
pūrvajanmasvabhāvān sa kṣapayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।
vratena tapasā nityaṃ dhyānena dāsyabhāvataḥ ।।86।।
mahābhāgavato bhūtvā sarvaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ।
caturviṃśatitattvāni haryarthaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।।87।।
nṛpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadevāya cārpayāmāsa cetanam ।
sattvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevasya prakāśane nyayojayat ।।88।।
rajastasya pravṛttyarthaṃ yathā tuṣṭo bhaveddhariḥ ।
tamo bhūtau pralayārthaṃ nyayuṅkta śrīharestadā ।।89।।
mahattattvaṃ buddhirūpaṃ tannirṇaye nyayojayat ।
cittaṃ tu cintane cāhaṃ tasyā'bhimānane'karot ।।2.72.90।।
manastu manane tasya śrotraṃ kathāśrave hareḥ ।
tvagasya sparśane'rakṣat cakṣustaddarśane'karot ।।9 1।।
rasanā tatprasādasya svāde jihvā'sya kīrtane ।
nāsā tatpuṣpasaugandhye vāgasya guṇavarṇane ।। 92।।
hastau dāsye ca kaiṃkarye sevāyāṃ sarvadā'karot ।
pādau tamabhigamane prādakṣiṇye'karottathā ।।93 ।।
pādyaṃ cāsanabandhe'sya liṃgamānandane'sya ca ।
balaṃ tadbhāravahane kalāstatsevane'karot ।।94।।
daihikaṃ sarvamevā'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya samārpayat ।
rājñī cāpi tathā sarvaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya cārpayat ।।95।।
tanmātrāṇi viṣayāँśca śubhaṃ cāśubhamityapi ।
sarvaṃ dadau tu haraye svayaṃ prāghūrṇikā'bhavat ।।96 ।।
kriyā sarvā varṣmaṇastu śrīkṛṣṇāya tathā''rpayat ।
pūjanaṃ smaratāṃ tasya vandanaṃ stavanaṃ sadā ।।97।।
pādasammardanaṃ viṣṇorarcanaṃ dāsyamityapi ।
sakhyaṃ kelirnarmavākyaṃ hasanaṃ hāsyamityapi ।।98।।
kīrtanaṃ cārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇe'karot sadā ।
rājñī cāpi mahābhāgavatī bhaktā babhūva ha ।।99।।
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ pakvanaivedyakaraṇaṃ tathā ।
jalāharaṇamevāpi vastrāṇāṃ kṣālanādikam ।। 2.72.10 0।।
pātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ cāpi puṣpānayanamityapi ।
mālikāgrathanaṃ cāpi tulasyānayanaṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
vāyorāndolanaṃ cāpi dolā''ndolanamityapi ।
sarvaṃ cakāra hastābhyāṃ śayyāstaraṇamityapi ।। 1 02।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sarvadā ।
kiṃkarīva vidadhāti sarvā''rpaṇaṃ tadā'karot ।। 1 03।।
evaṃ saṃsevamānau tau divyapuṇyāśritau śubhau ।
prakṣīṇakalmaṣau jātau bālakṛṣṇābhyanugrahāt ।। 1 04।।
lomaśena prāpito ca mantraṃ śrīvaiṣṇavaṃ param ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ' ।। 1 05।।
labdhvā mantraṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ cāṣāḍhaśuklake ।
ekādaśyāṃ ravyudaye dhyānamagnau sthirau kṣaṇam ।। 1 06।।
abhavatāṃ tadā divyaṃ vimānaṃ tvakṣarācchubham ।
sapārṣadaṃ samāyātaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham ।। 1 07।।
dehau tyaktvā jyāmaghaśca dhanālasā vimānake ।
pārṣadānāmājñayā cārohatāṃ divyavarṣmaṇau ।। 108।।
yayau vimānaṃ tvaritaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam ।
jayaśabdāścā'bhavaँśca śrīnārāyaṇamandire ।। 1 09।।
ityevaṃ rādhike tau tu bhaktyā mokṣamavāpatuḥ ।
pāṭhako vācakaḥ śrotā'pyasya mokṣapadaṃ vrajet ।। 2.72.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jyāmagharājñastatpatnyā dhanālasāyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tvātmaniveditabhaktyā mokṣaṇamitinirūpaṇanāmā
dvāsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 72 । ।

adhyāyaḥ 73
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 074 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham ।
gaurjare vartate ramyā nadī dhrādharasaṃjñikā ।। 1 ।।
tattaṭād dakṣiṇe cāste āmodanagaraṃ śubham ।
bahuśreṣṭhijanāvāsaṃ devasevāparāyaṇam ।। 2 ।
vyavasāyaparairloṃkairadhiṣṭhitaṃ dhanānvitaiḥ ।
mānavā bahudhā yatra dhrādharātīravāsinaḥ ।। 3 ।
nyūṣurbhaktāstatraśaṃbhoḥ śaṃbhubhaktiparā varāḥ ।
dhrādharāyāstaṭe cānye pūjāpāṭhaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 4 ।
yāntyāyānti ca nagaraṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhośca darśanam ।
vaiṣṇavaṃ mandiraṃ tatra dhrādharāyāstaṭe śubham ।। 5 ।.
śriyā yukto hariryatra nārāyaṇo virājate ।
pratimārūpadhārī sa pūjyate cārcyate janaiḥ ।। 6 ।
vandyate sevyate cāpi vaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvadā prage ।
mandirasyā'bhitastatra vasanti sādhavo'malāḥ ।। 7 ।
tatprasaṃgādabhavacca vaiṣṇavaḥ sudhano vaṇik ।
sudhanākhyo nityamādau snātvā samarcya devatāḥ ।। 8 ।
natvā ca vaiṣṇavān sādhūn yāti śaṃbhvālayaṃ tataḥ ।
udyānavaryasaṃkulaṃ vṛkṣavallyādirājitam ।। 9 ।
phalapuṣpādisaṃśobhattaruvaryavirājitam ।
jalavāpīyutaṃ stambasasyasmṛddhisuśobhitam ।। 2.73.1 0।
nirābādhaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ śāntidaṃ darśanādapi ।
āmodeśvaraliṃgaṃ ca tadudyāne mahālaye ।। 11 ।
virājate susphaṭikadyuti divyaṃ manoharam ।
tatsevāyāṃ vipravaryo maharṣirvarcakāyaniḥ ।। 12।
brahmacaryaparo yajñahomakāryaparāyaṇaḥ ।
phalamātrāśano vyomaśayano divyadṛṣṭimān ।। 13 ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramaḥ śaṃbhau sevādharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
vedavedāṅgavidyādhiḥ kathākhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 14
vratena kṛtakārśyāptiśuṣkanāḍīkadehavān ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।
nityaṃ sāyaṃ śivodyāne tarumaṇḍapasaṃśritaḥ ।
kathāṃ karoti devāstāṃ śṛṇvanti mānavādayaḥ ।। 16 ।।
narā nāryaḥ pakṣiṇaśca dehinastannivāsinaḥ ।
tacchrotuṃ nityadā yāti sudhano bhaktibhāvanaḥ ।। 17।।
tatra vai śrutavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre śrīkambharāsutam ।। 18।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma gopālakṛṣṇabālakam ।
sarvasāmarthyayuktaṃ śrīrādhāramādisevitam ।। 1 9।।
virājantaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro'ntikaṃ mahālaye ।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ cāpi tīrthāni ca bahūnyapi ।।2.73.20 ।।
tato'sya vaṇijo jātā sudhanasya śubhāśrayā ।
sākṣādanādidevasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tu ।।2 1 ।।
dhṛtamānavanāṭyasya didṛkṣā mokṣadāyinī ।
nityaṃ cintayate ramyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ divāniśam ।।22।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
mantraṃ jagrāha ca tasmādṛṣeḥ śrīvarcakāyaneḥ ।।23।।
jajāpa taṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ dadhyau mūrtiṃ hṛdantare ।
satyāṃ cāpi didṛkṣāyāṃ dūradeśaṃ vicārya saḥ ।।24।।
gṛhe'rcāyāṃ tu santoṣaṃ hyamanyatā'rcanādibhiḥ ।
nityaṃ pūjayate'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।25।।
naivedyaṃ dadate prātarmadhyāhne ca niśāmukhe ।
ārārtrikaṃ ca dadate stavaṃ jāpaṃ karotyapi ।।26।।
utsavān kurute cāpi nyāyāgatadhanaiḥ śubhān ।
tatpatnīputrapautrādyā vaiṣṇavāḥ śrīhariśritāḥ ।।27।।
devasevāparā hyāsan sādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
kathāśravaparāścāsan kṛṣṇārpaṇātmabuddhayaḥ ।।28।।
sevante satataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sādhūn sādhvīrdhanādibhiḥ ।
yānavāhanabhojyādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।।29।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya sudhanasya gṛhe sadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtau hariḥ svayam ।।2.73.30।।
prakaṭībhūya sākṣāttu gṛhṇātyannādi cārpitam ।
prasādaṃ dadate cāsmai bhaktāya prahasaṃstataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
bālakṛṣṇastiro yāti mūrtau nityaṃ tathā'karot ।
ekadā sudhanaḥ śreṣṭhī pautravivāhakāraṇāt ।। 32।।
svavāhinīṃ pariṣkṛtya dhanabhūṣāmbarādibhiḥ ।
naranārīvararājayuto gantryādivāhanaiḥ ।। 33 ।।
āmodāttu yayau kanyānagaraṃ jāmbusārasam ।
nāvānadīṃ samuttīrya gatvā ca jāmbusārasam ।।34।।
vidhiṃ vaivāhikaṃ kṛtvā pratyāvartata vai yadā ।
dhrādharākhyanadītīre taskarā viṃśatiprathāḥ ।।35।।
āpeturugrarūpāstu saśastrā vṛkṣasaṃkule ।
tāḍayāmāsurugrāste śakaṭīvāhakāँstathā ।।36।।
vāhinīrakṣakāँścāpi nijaghnuryaṣṭikādibhiḥ ।
suvarṇaṃ ca vibhūṣāśca rūpyaṃ tathā'mbarādikam ।।37।।
śreṣṭhaṃ dhanaṃ samājahruścāśvavārā hi taskarāḥ ।
bhojyādikaṃ cāpi jahruḥ sudhano duḥkhito'bhavat ।।38।।
kuṭumbaṃ cāpi tatsārthastadā'bhavad dhanojjhitaḥ ।
bhūṣāhīnā yoṣitaśca śṛṃgārāmbaravarjitāḥ ।।39।।
abhavan śokasaṃmagnāḥ sambandhibāndhavāstathā ।
mahīmānā dhanahīnā nistejaskā ca vāhinī ।।2.73.40।।
śokodvegaparo jāto vadhūjanaḥ sakhījanaḥ ।
snuṣā cā'maṃgalagrastā vivāhe sati cā'bhavat ।।41 ।।
lakṣmīnāśo'bhavadbhāvidāridryasūcakaḥ khalu ।
evaṃ vicārya sudhanaḥ kṛtvā sthairyaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ ।।42।।
ātmanā''tmānamālambya sasmāra bālakṛṣṇakam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sveṣṭaṃ pareśvaram ।।43।।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā sveṣṭadevaṃ pumuttamam ।
kṛpānātha dayāsindho saṃsārārṇavatāraka ।।44।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt rakṣayātra vanāntare ।
tvayā gajasya vai pūrvaṃ kṛtā rakṣā jalāntare ।।45।।
tvayā prahlādarakṣā ca kṛtā dānavamaṇḍale ।
tvayā ca marutāṃ rakṣā kṛtā garbhagṛhāntare ।।46।।
tvaṃ pātā tvaṃ vidhātā ca paramātmā sanātanaḥ ।
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāvārdhe caurāṇāṃ trāsataḥ prabho ।।47।।
sarvasvaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ caurairjīvanaṃ gṛhamedhinām ।
svarṇarūpyavibhūṣādi tataścoddhara duḥkhataḥ ।।48।।
gṛhasthānāṃ dhanaṃ dravyaṃ bhūṣā dravyaṃ tu yoṣitām ।
śāntirdravyaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ bhaktadravyaṃ hariḥ svayam ।।49।।
vinā dravyaṃ tu loke'tra pratiṣṭhā naiva vidyate ।
dhānyaṃ vastraṃ vyavahāro nātha! dravye pratiṣṭhati ।।2.73.50।।
dravye doṣā bahavo'pi guṇā jīvanasampradāḥ ।
dravye bhavanti satataṃ tataścālambanaṃ dhanam ।।51 ।।
tatrāpi vaṇijāṃ kṛṣṇa suvarṇabhūṣaṇādikam ।
sarvasvaṃ vidyate tacca caurairhṛtaṃ samastakam ।।52।।
tava bhaktimatā nātha parābhavo'yamutkaṭaḥ ।
abhaktānāṃ hāsyapātratāyā āspadatāṃ gatāḥ ।।।53 ।।
āpadbhyaścoddhara kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvara ।
bhaktarakṣākaraśceti nāmasārthakamāvaha ।।54।।
anyathā tu janā āśābhaṃgena tvāṃ janārdana ।
tyakṣyanti bhajanaṃ te te matvā cā'rakṣakaṃ prabhum ।।।55।।
ārtā ārtiharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvadārtā bhajanti vai ।
arthārthī cārthadaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yāvadarthaṃ bhajanti ca ।।56।।
jijñāsavaśca yāvat syājjijñāsā tāvadeva ha ।
bhajante śrīhariṃ jñātuṃ jñāte te viramanti hi ।।57।।
teṣā svārthaparāṇāṃ tu yathoddhāro bhavedapi ।
yathākathaṃcidāśāvān tvāṃ yathā cā'valambate ।।।58।।
tathā nātha svabhaktānāṃ vāñcchāṃ prapūrya cāpi vai ।
bhaktiṃ kārayituṃ cāpi mama rakṣāṃ kuru prabho ।।59।।
ityabhyarthya vane tatra mumocā'śrūṇi duḥkhitaḥ ।
śrutvā tvabhyarthanāṃ svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।2.73.60।।
vipraveṣeṇa vai śīghraṃ yatra caurāḥ samāyayau ।
caurā nadyāstaṭe vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ sanniṣadya ca ।।।61 ।।
bhāgān cakruḥ suvarṇasya rūpyasya ca dhanasya ca ।
bhūṣādīnāṃ vibhāge tu jāyamāne'tha bhikṣukaḥ ।।62।।
vicitto brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bālakṛṣṇaśca dīnavat ।
aṭan dhūlisamavyāptadeho digambaro yathā ।।63।।
kaupīnamātravasano bhojanaṃ yācituṃ yayau ।
bhikṣati bhojanaṃ me'tra bubhukṣitāya rocate ।।64।।
bhavanto bhāgyavanto me dadantāṃ śreṣṭhinaḥ śubhāḥ ।
na me dravyaṃ vāñcchanīyaṃ bhojanaṃ samapekṣyate ।।65।।
caurāḥ prāhurdravyamatra vartate tadgṛhāṇa bhoḥ ।
yadi te rocate tarhi dadmaste rūpyakaṃ vada ।।66।।
bhikṣukastu tadā prāha na me dravyaprayojanam ।
dhane doṣā hi bahavo duḥkhadā vairakārakāḥ ।।67।।
dhanaṃ tyājayate dharmaṃ hiṃsāṃ kārayati drutam ।
ākasmikī cāpadaṃ ca samāhvayati vai dhanam ।।68।।
dhanārjane prayāso'pi rakṣaṇe cintanaṃ mahat ।
bhoge kṣayasya tu cintā caurahāryādidūṣaṇam ।।69।।
tasmāddhanaṃ na ceṣṭavyaṃ bhikṣukeṇa sukhaiṣiṇā ।
bhavanto dhanavantaśca dadantāmatra bhojanam ।।2.73.70।।
rūpyako'pi yadagre'sti sukhaṃ nidrāṃ na yāti saḥ ।
yena kena nimittena viyogasya bhayāt sadā ।।7 1 ।।
dhanahīnāḥ pakṣiṇaśca phalamātrasya bhikṣukāḥ ।
bhuktvā śākhāsu tatraiva vibhramanti nirāmayāḥ ।।72।।
bālāśca bhojanaṃ bhuktvā sukhaṃ svapanti bhūtale।
cintā tu grasate vṛddhān yūno dhanina ityamūn ।।73।।
ratnāni mauktikādīni hīrakādyāḥ svabhāvataḥ ।
pāṣāṇā api mṛtyostu nimantraṇakarā hi te ।।74।।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ bhūṣāścāmbarāṇi dhanāni ca ।
pārthivāstaijasā vā'pi cintodvegakarāḥ sadā ।।75।।
ahaṃmamatvabaddhāśca rāgadveṣavidhāyakāḥ ।
janmamṛtyupradāścānte vāsanālobhabhāvakāḥ ।।76।।
tanmayā neṣyate dravyaṃ paradravyaṃ vināśakṛt ।
kasmāddhane'tra bahulaṃ dravyaṃ labdhaṃ mahājanāḥ ।।77।।
iti pṛṣṭāstathoktāśca yāhi yāhīti roṣataḥ ।
prāhuste tatra kaścittu yaṣṭimādāya cāyasīm ।।78।।
tāḍayituṃ protthitaśca bhikṣukaṃ dīnavat sthitam ।
tāvattu bhikṣukastasmāt sthānādadṛśyatāṃ yayau ।।71।।
vilokya caitadaiśvaryaṃ vismayaṃ te paraṃ yayuḥ ।
kintu bhūtaṃ piśācaṃ vā menire māyayā hatāḥ ।।2.73.80।।
tāvat kākaḥ samāgatya drumopari jagāda ha ।
śuṣkaśākhāsthitaścaitadamagalaṃ tadā'bhavat ।।81 ।।
atha te saṃvibhajyaiva svarṇadravyāṇi vai tataḥ ।
hāramālādiratnāni vibhajante yadā tadā ।।82।।।
śrīhariśca turagasthastathā'nye rājasevakāḥ ।
aśvavārāḥ saśastrāśca pañcāśatsaṃkhyakā drutam ।।83 ।।
rājadūtādiveṣāste paritastatra cāyayuḥ ।
kurvanto dhūṣkṛtīśabdān dharṣayantviti vādinaḥ ।।84।।
mārayantu pragṛhṇantu caurā ime bhavanti ca ।
ityevaṃ vadamānāste cakruḥ prākāravat tadā ।।85 ।।
parito vyūhabandhaṃ ca tadā'śvavāraśobhitam ।
caurā bhayamavāpuste dudruvuḥ paritastadā ।।86।।
svarṇarūpyāmbarahīrahārān vihāya tatkṣaṇam ।
kintu mārgamanāsādyā'śaktāśca vyūhamabhyataḥ ।।87।।
nirgantuṃ te hastagatā bhaṭānāmabhavan khalu ।
paravaśā hastakaṭā rajjupāśāḥ kṛtāśca taiḥ ।।88।।
yaṣṭibhistāḍitāḥ kecit kecit kaśābhirāhatāḥ ।
kecid daṇḍena hastena pallatābhiśca tāḍitāḥ ।।89।।
kṛtadaṇḍā bhaṭaiste ca prārthayāmāsurīśvaram ।
tṛṇānyādhāya danteṣu bhūsparśīkṛtamastakāḥ ।।2.73.90।।
dīnā gadgadahṛdayā doṣakṣamā yayācire ।
dayālurbhagavāँstebhyaḥ punardoṣanivṛttaye ।।91
upādideśa te sarve pratijñāṃ ca tadā vyadhuḥ ।
vayaṃ cauryaṃ kadācinna kariṣyāmo'dya kālataḥ ।।92।।
kuru kṣamāṃ mahārāja vimocaya ca bandhanāt ।
ityevaṃ yācamānān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।93।।
haste jalaṃ pradāyaiva pratijñāṃ stenakarmaṇaḥ ।
stainyaṃ naiva hi kartavyaṃ kārayāmāsa tādṛśīm ।। 94।।
tatastān dhrādharānadyāstaṭe ramye manohare ।
mocayāmāsa bhagavān jagrāha cāhṛtaṃ dhanam ।।95।।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnāmbarabhūṣādi yaddhyabhūt ।
tatsarvaṃ ca gṛhītvaiva sudhano yatra tiṣyati ।।96।।
sasaṃghastaṃ samāsādya sāśvavāraśca keśavaḥ ।
sudhanāya dadau sarvaṃ caurahastāhṛtaṃ dhanam ।।97।।
sudhanastasya sārthāśca jahṛṣurdhanalābhataḥ ।
rājabhaṭā daduḥ sarvaṃ sārthāya svarṇarūpyakam ।।98।।
bhūṣaṇānyambarādīni ratnamauktikahīrakān ।
yeṣāṃ yānyabhavaँstāni tebhyo dadurharerbhaṭāḥ ।।99।।
sudhanaśca dadātyebhyo dhanaṃ tu pāritoṣikam ।
bhaṭādhipastadā prāha dharmo'sti pāritoṣikam ।। 2.73.10 0।।
bhaktiṃ kuru sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mokṣadām ।
pāritoṣikamevā'tra vidyate na tato'nyathā ।। 101 ।।
sudhanaḥ saṃśayaṃ prāptaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।
bhagavāneva rakṣārthaṃ tvāyāto vidyate kimu ।। 102।
iti sandihya cotthāya papāta pādayoḥ khalu ।
anye'pi ca praṇemurvai gatānugatikā iti ।। 1 03।।
aśvavāraiśca sahito bhaṭādhipastu vāhinīm ।
saha nītvā nadīpāraṃ kārayāmāsa nirbhayām ।। 1 04।।
prāpayāmāsa ramyaṃ tamudyānaṃ śaṃkarasya vai ।
tataścā'dṛśyatāṃ prāptā bhaṭādhipabhaṭāstadā ।। 105 ।।
na aśvā no rājabhaṭā nāsti bhaṭādhipastathā ।
sudhanaśca janāstasya paramāścaryamāgatāḥ ।। 106 ।।
sudhanastu tadā śīghraṃ samājuhāva taṃ prabhum ।
vyomanādaṃ mahāntaṃ vai kṛtvā sarvabalena ha ।। 1 07।।
he hare he kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin dayādhara ।
kṛtā rakṣā tvayā'raṇye madbhāgyaṃ tvadya vardhate ।। 1 08।।
te didṛkṣā'sti me kṛṣṇa darśanaṃ dehi me punaḥ ।
ityevaṃ vyāharan pṛthvyāṃ dhūlikṣetre'luṭhanmuhuḥ ।। 1 09।।
nṛtyan tālī vādayaँśca punardhūlyā samāluṭhat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhaktiṃ vilokya ca ।। 2.73.110 ।।
bālakṛpṇo'bhavacchīghraṃ divyamūrtiḥ surūpavān ।
koṭisūryāgnicandrāditejo'dhikaprabhāsvaraḥ ।। 111 ।।
divyasvarṇavibhūṣaśca divyamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ ।
divyamālāmbaradharo divyavimānavāhanaḥ ।। 112।।
rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ kaustubhādivirājitaḥ ।
śrīrādhāmāṇikīpāravatīprabhādisevitaḥ ।। 113 ।।
mañjulāsaguṇāhaṃsālalitāsujayārcitaḥ ।
evaṃ bhūtvā'bhavat sākṣāddarśanīyo hariḥ svayam ।। 1 14।।
sudhanādyairvīkṣitaścovāca yūyaṃ vimānake ।
tiṣṭhatātreti tān kṛtvā vimāne kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।। ( 15।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ prāsādaṃ pitarau ṛṣim ।
sarastīrthāni sarvāṇi pradarśya kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।। 1 16।।
vimānenā'prāpayacca tamudyānaṃ tiro'bhavat ।
sudhanādyāḥ sukhaṃ prāpuḥ parameśvarayogataḥ ।। 1 17।।
divyadṛṣṭimayā jātā divyabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।
bhādre śukle kṛtāḥ sarve kṛtārthā hariṇā hi te ।। 1 18।।
ekādaśyāṃ madhyadine dhrādharāyāstaṭe śubhe ।
atha kālāntare tebhyaḥ paraṃdhāma dadau prabhuḥ ।। 1 19।।
ityevaṃ rādhike bhaktarakṣā śrīhariṇā kṛtā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvā ।। 2.73.120 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āmodanagarasthasudhanākhyabhaktasya varcakāyanimaharṣiyogena prāptabhāgavatabhāvasya caurebhyo rakṣā bhagavatkṛtā, prabhordivyadarśanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 73 ।।
