adhyāyaḥ 74
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 075 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rāseśvari śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇotsave ।
navame vatsare'ṣṭamyāṃ samājo'bhūt trilokinām ।। 1 ।।
muktāstathā'vatārāśca muktānyo'dhīśvarāstathā ।
īśvariṇyaḥ surā devyaḥ pitaro munayastathā ।। 2 ।।
ārṣyaḥ kāśyapavaṃśāśca kāśyapyo mānavāstathā ।
nāgā daityādayo vṛkṣā vallayaḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
jalajāḥ sthalajāścāpi sthāvarā jaṅgamā api ।
āyayuḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyaḥ kalā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ ।। 4 ।।
ṛtavo vasavaścāpi parvatāstīrthakoṭayaḥ ।
digīśvarāśca rājāno dīnāndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
samāyayurbālakṛṣṇaṃ pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।
āśīrvādān daduścāpyupadā nyadhuḥ puro hareḥ ।। 6 ।।
lomaśena kṛtā pūjā tathānyairmunibhiḥ śubhā ।
āgatānāṃ ca satkāraṃ cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
dadau miṣṭāmṛtabhojyabhakṣyalehyāni kambharā ।
pānāni madhuparkādi jalatāmbūlakāni ca ।। 8 ।।
sarvairnīrājanaṃ cāvartitaṃ śataikavartibhiḥ ।
stutaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī pareśvaraḥ ।। 9 ।।
dadau prasādametebhyo viśramyāśīrvidhāya ca ।
yayurvimānakairnaijān deśān lokān digantakān ।। 2.74.1 0।।
athā''ścaryamabhūt sāyaṃ śṛṇu nīrājanottaram ।
gurjare kimanadyāstu taṭe cottarataḥ śubhā ।। 1 1।।
kuśāmbānāma nagarī cāturvarṇyajanāśritā ।
āsīd yatra maharṣiśca kauśikāmbo mahāmuniḥ ।। 12।।
devadhyānaparo yajñaparo yogakriyāparaḥ ।
ākāśagatimāँścāpi kumbhakāyāmaniṣṭhitaḥ ।। 13।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparaḥ sa tu ।
dadāti mokṣajñānaṃ ca śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ ।। 14।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścāntyajajātayaḥ ।
ye kecittu samāyānti svāśramaṃ tānabodhayat ।। 15।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
iti mantraṃ sadā prāptaśiṣyebhyaḥ pradadāti ca ।। 16 ।।
ekadā tvantyajo nāmnā tryaṣṭakārustu nirdhanaḥ ।
strīsaṃyuktaḥ samāyāto darśanārthamṛṣeḥ prage ।। 17।।
anapatyo'bhavaccāpi jalodaraprapīḍitaḥ ।
patnītasyā'bhavat kuṣṭharogavyāptā'tiduḥkhitā ।। 18।।
kauśikāmbo maharṣiśca kathāṃ nityaṃ karoti hi ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā yatra sabhāsthale ।। 1 9।।
tatra gatvā'ntyajo vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ niṣasāda ha ।
kathāṃ śṛṇoti tatraiva bhāryayā saha bhāvataḥ ।। 2.74.20 ।।
śrutaṃ tatra tu saurāṣṭre'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
paradhāmapatiḥ sarvasvāmī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।21 ।।
vartate bālarūpeṇa śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre parabrahma pumuttamaḥ ।।।2।।
yasya vandanamātreṇa nāmamantragraheṇa ca ।
rogā dainyaṃ ca dāridryaṃ cānapatyādikaṃ tathā ।। 23।।
sarvaṃ layaṃ prayātyeva saubhāgyaṃ ca vivardhate ।
iṣṭaprāptirbhavecchīghraṃ taccharaṇāgatasya vai ।।24।।
iti śrutvā kathānte ca prayāte śrotṛvargake ।
āmadhyāhnaṃ cāśramānte vaṭo'dhaḥsaṃsthito'bhavat ।।25।।
cintayatyeva tadvākyaṃ kathaṃ pṛcchāmi taṃ munim ।
antarveditvaśaktyā vai jñātvā tanmānasaṃ muniḥ ।।।26।।
kauśāmbikastvantyajaṃ tam āhvayāmāsa cāstikam ।
brahmabhaktaṃ sujijñāsuṃ jñātvā svāśramamāgatam ।।27।।
tīrthāgataṃ dadau tasmai bhojyaṃ jalaṃ phalādikam ।
svāgataṃ cāpi satkāraṃ kṛtavān sarvamitrakaḥ ।।28।।
viśrāntaṃ taṃ tvantyajaṃ ca papraccha kuta eva ha ।
kathaṃ cātrāgato bhakta vada yanmānase sthitam ।।29।।
bhaktaḥ sa tryaṣṭakāruśca prāha vinayamāvahan ।
kṛtvā'tha daṇḍavat gṛṇan maharṣervijayo'stu vai ।।2.74.30 ।।
kṣemaṃ cāstu kuśalaṃ ca saukhyamṛṣeḥ sadā'stu vai ।
ciraṃ jīvatu cittajña dayālo devadevate ।।।3 1।।
bhavādṛśaḥ sādhavo'tra tārakāḥ pāpināṃ guro ।
pāpakṣālanakāryārthaṃ yadahaṃ cātra saṃgataḥ ।।32।।
kāryaṃ me saphalaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ me paramaṃ tathā ।
sākṣād devasvarūpasya darśanāt kṛtakṛtyatā ।।33।।
kathālābhena me janmasāphalyaṃ tvadya vartate ।
anugraheṇa bhavato bhāgyaṃ me'dya vivardhate ।। 34।।
ahaṃ pāpī cāntyajo'smi tārito'haṃ tvayā guro ।
ityuktvā cāśramadhūliṃ mastake dhṛtavān muhuḥ ।।35।।
paścāduvāca ca muniṃ yadyājñā bhavato'sti cet ।
pracchāmi mānasaṃ yatra ramate me kathāśravāt ।। 36।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha sukhaṃ pṛccha te jānāmi mumukṣutām ।
nā'yamāpmā'ntyajaḥ kvāpi śuddhaḥ sattvamayaḥ sadā ।।37।।
śarīraṃ cāntyajaṃ pūrvakarmaṇā jāyate'sya vai ।
evaṃ śrutvā'ntyajaḥ prāha kathaṃ cāhaṃ tathā'bhavam ।। 38।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kathamavāpyate ।
kiṃ mayā mokṣasiddhyarthaṃ kartavyaṃ cātra daivikam ।। 39।।
anapatyatvanāśārthaṃ roganāśārthamityapi ।
kiṃ mama syādanuṣṭheyaṃ vada me kṛpayā prabho ।।2.74.40।।
iti pṛṣṭho muniḥ prāha śṛṇu cāntyaja karma te ।
purā tvamabhavo vipraḥ saptapurādrivāsakṛt ।।41 ।।
nāmnā devapriyaśceyaṃ patnī te dyumatī tadā ।
tatra viṣṇormandiraṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitam ।।42।।
vartate tatra pūjāṃ tvamakarordāsavat sadā ।
patnī te pākaśālāṃ ca naivedyārthaṃ tadā'karot ।।43।।
śaitye snānaṃ vinā tvaṃ ca malino malināmbaraḥ ।
mamārcanaṃ sparśanaṃ cā'karostvaṃ ca tava priyā ।।44।।
agālitasalilena pākādikaṃ tadā'karot ।
asnātā cā'dhautavastrā naivedyaṃ cārpayattadā ।।45।।
agālitaṃ jalaṃ cāpi matpānārthaṃ samārpayat ।
aśuddhadehā māṃ nityamaspṛśadbhāminī tava ।।46।।
rājasvalyādikaṃ ceyaṃ tadā nātīva manyate ।
evaṃ tvaśuddhijaṃ pāpaṃ bhuktavantau yuvāṃ ciram ।।47।।
yamaloke vaitaraṇyāṃ tato mārjāratāṃ gatau ।
tataścāntyajadehasthau stha idānīṃ daivasevayā ।।48।।
puṇyaśeṣeṇa ca sādhusaṃgatiṃ kurutho'naghau ।
kālāntarakṛtā sevā pitrordevasya vā guroḥ ।।49।।
janmāntare tu sā śreyaskarī samupatiṣṭhati ।
hutaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ yāti bhavāntare ।।2.74.50।।
hiṃsā pīḍā kṣatirnindā kāpaṭyaṃ chalamugratā ।
vañcanā ghātanā sarvaṃ pratyāyāti bhavāntare ।।51 ।।
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ svabhāvaśca saṃskāro vāsanā manaḥ ।
indriyāṇi dveṣarāgau prayāntyeva bhavāntare ।।52।।
abhyāso japanaṃ bhaktiḥ sevā paropakāritā ।
śīlaṃ vrataṃ prapattiśca prayāntyeva bhavāntare ।।53।।
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ viveko devapūjanam ।
āśīrvādastathā śāpaḥ prayāntyeva bhavāntare ।।54।।
ṛṇaṃ pativratā patnī patiḥ patnīvratastathā ।
śatravaścātirūḍhāśca prayāntyete bhavāntare ।।55।।
bhāgyaṃ ca sañcitaṃ karma paścād dattā jalāñjaliḥ ।
śrāddhaṃ tapaśca santoṣaḥ prayāntyeva bhavāntare ।।56।।
yuvābhyāṃ tu kṛtā sevā bhaktirmālinyasaṃbhṛtā ।
kālāntare phalaṃ tasyā labdhaṃ yajjanma mānuṣam ।।57।।
mālinyadoṣajaṃ janma cāntyajaṃ cābhavattataḥ ।
rājasvalyādidoṣasya phalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi yoṣitaḥ ।।58।।
agālitā'mbhasaḥ pānaṃ yadarpitaṃ tu mādhave ।
jalodaraṃ tava jātaṃ sadā duḥkhataraṃ tava ।।59।।
asaṃskṛtānnanaivedyaṃ yadarpitaṃ tvayā harau ।
tatphalaṃ tava loke'tra dāridryaṃ cātivartate ।।2.74.60।।
aśraddhāyāḥ phalaṃ pāpaṃ nāstikyamupajāyate ।
nāstikyena ca te tatra śrāddhādihīnatā'bhavat ।।6 1 ।।
tena te'trā'napatyatvaṃ vartate cāntyajottama ।
kathitastava vṛttāntaḥ pūrvago'trāpi saṃśṛṇu ।।62।।
antyajo'pi satāṃ sevāṃ tīrthayātrāṃ karoṣi yat ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ cāpi bhajanaṃ ca karoṣi yat ।।63।।
tena puṇyapratāpena gurvāśīrvādatastathā ।
rogo'napatyatā cāpi dāridryaṃ duḥkhitā tathā ।।64।।
pīḍāścānyā drutaṃ nāśameṣyanti śrīpateḥ smṛteḥ ।
āśrayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kuruta drutam ।।65।।
rājate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāśvasarastaṭe ।
kambharāśrīgṛhe bālaḥ kṛṣṇo gopālanandanaḥ ।।66।।
sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
sarveśānāṃ niyantā ca sarvāntaryāmisaṃsthitiḥ ।।67।।
sarvakarmaphalānāṃ sa pradātā mokṣadāyakaḥ ।
kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ samartha eva saḥ ।।68।।
jñānaśaktikriyāśaktikāryakāraṇaśaktimān ।
rādhālakṣmīprabhāpāravatīmāṇikyaśaktipaḥ ।।69।।
saguṇāmañjulāhaṃsālīlābhūdharaṇīśvaraḥ ।
vṛndātulasīpadmeśaḥ śaktyaiśvaryavibhūtipaḥ ।।2.74.70।।
nandanāradaśaṃkarasanakādisatāṃ prabhuḥ ।
dhātā nidhātā saṃhartā jagatāṃ bhaktamokṣakṛt ।।71 ।।
sarvakāmaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ samastadṛk ।
sarvānandaḥ sarvapātā sarvapatiḥ satīpriyaḥ ।।72।।
sādhvīnāthaḥ sādhumitra tyāgivaryo gurorguruḥ ।
śāśvataṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ parabrahma sanātanaḥ ।।73।।
brahmacaryaparā devā nyāsino yoginastathā ।
saṃyamino nirodhācca yaṃ prapaśyanti sūrayaḥ ।।74।।
taṃ prabhuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ tvaṃ bhaja patnyā sahā'nvaham ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīsvāminaṃ patim ।।75।।
ādyaṃ vai mānavaṃ rūpaṃ pārameśvarasaṃjñitam ।
yuge yuge jāyamānaṃ tato bahusvarūpiṇam ।।76।।
kṛpārūpaṃ cograrūpaṃ jñānarūpaṃ vṛṣātmajam ।
vidyārūpaṃ rājarūpaṃ śāsakaṃ tāpasaṃ ca vā ।।77।।
vyūharūpaṃ vibhavaṃ vā prātimaṃ cāntarasthitam ।
svarūpaṃ sādhurūpaṃ vā bhaja taṃ puruṣottamam ।।78।।
aṃśarūpaṃ kalārūpamāveśātmakamityapi ।
vibhūtiṃ vā pūrṇarūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।79।।
avatāraṃ caiśvaraṃ vā viṣṇuṃ mahāpraviṣṇukam ।
ākṣaraṃ vā parabrahma paripūrṇāttamottamam ।।2.74.80।।
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ cainamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam ।
bhaja patnyā sahitastvaṃ tato nirvāṇameṣyasi ।।81 ।।
ehyāgaccha gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ taccaraṇāmṛtam ।
piba dhāraya śirasi dehe prokṣaṇamācara ।।।82।।
pāpāni te vinaśyeyuḥ sastrīkasyātra satvaram ।
evamuktvā dadau vāri pūjāprasādajaṃ śubham ।।83।।
tryaṣṭakāruḥ papau tasya bhāryā papau ca kuṣṭhinī ।
jalapānādṛṣerātmabalāt kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt ।।84।।
jalodaraṃ ca dāridryaṃ kuṣṭhitā cānapatyatā ।
catvāraste mahārogā niṣkrāntā dehato'bhavan ।।85।।
pārśve sthitvā ruruduste nemustaṃ kauśikāmbakam ।
kva yāsyāmo vayaṃ vipra jīvanaṃ dehi cā''rthayan ।।86 ।।
ṛṣirjalodaraṃ pṛthvyai kadalyai śrīphalāya ca ।
dadau vibhāgataścā'pyapeyapānakṛte'pi ca ।।87।।
satṛṣṇakāya lubdhāya dānasnānaviyogine ।
dadau vyasanine cāpi dāridryaṃ lampaṭāya ca ।।88।।
viyonisaṃgalubdhāya varṇasāṃkaryakāriṇe ।
dharmavidveṣiṇe stainyakāriṇe kuṣṭhitāṃ dadau ।।89।।
parā'patyādihantṛbhyo garbhapātādikāriṇe ।
śāpitebhyo'napatyatvaṃ dadau śrāddhavilopine ।।2.74.90।।
ityuktāste caturdoṣā yayustādṛśapātrake ।
antyajo nirmalo jātaḥ sastrīko rogavarjitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
ṛṣistasmai dadau mantraṃ pāvanaṃ pārameśvaram ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।92।।
japaṃ kurvan tatastasthāvāśrame sevako yathā ।
yathāyogyaṃ mārjanādi cakārodyānasevanam ।।93।।
kathāṃ śrutvā babhūvā'sau prakṣīṇakleśavāsanaḥ ।
cāndre tu kārtike māse tadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamītithau ।।94।।
ṛṣirjanmotsavaṃ cakre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
tatra divyaṃ vimānaṃ tu śatasūryasamaprabham ।।95।।
samāyātaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate ।
pārṣadāstatra divyāśca rādhādyā yoṣitastathā ।।96।।
virājante haristasmāt sahasā samavātarat ।
ṛṣikṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ jagrāha bhagavān svayam ।। 97।।
dadau prāsādikaṃ tasmai tryaṣṭakāruṃ ca tatstriyam ।
ṛṣiṃ dhṛtvā vimāne ca kuṃkumavāpikāṃ yayo ।।98।।
hariścā'dṛśyatāṃ prāpto vimānaṃ vyomamaṇḍale ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsibhiḥ samalokitam ।।99।।
avā'tarad vimānaṃ taccāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
sāyaṃ snānaṃ cāvatīrya tryaṣṭakārustadā'karot ।। 2.74.10 0।।
tatpatnī cāpi vai snānaṃ sarasyeva tadā'karot ।
tayordehau tu patitau, divyadehau caturbhujau ।। 101 ।।
babhūvatustau tatkālaṃ divyālaṃkārabhūṣaṇau ।
divyadṛṣṭī divyagatī divyavijñānasaṃbhṛtau ।। 1 02।।
tūrṇaṃ tau śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā ।
lomaśaṃ ca muniṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā pūjāmalaukikīm ।। 103 ।।
yayatustadvimānena brahmalokaṃ paraṃ padam ।
ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇecchayā tasthau kārtikāvadhimatra ca ।। 1 04।।
paścāt kṛṣṇājñayā yātaḥ kuśāmbāṃ kimasannidhau ।
bhaktānupadiśan lakṣavarṣāṇi vāsamācarat ।। 1 05।।
pratisamvatsaraṃ cakre harerjanmotsavam ṛṣiḥ ।
kimanadyāstaṭe gatvā tattīrthe śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 106 ।।
ṛṣikṛtāṃ samarhāṃ ca gṛhītvā tu sarijjale ।
snātvā cāyāti divyena vimānena kṣaṇāntare ।। 1 07।।
evaṃ tīrthaṃ kauśikāmbaṃ kimanadyāṃ virājate ।
rādhike! śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvataraṇodbhavam ।। 1 08।।
ṛṣistato yayau dhāma paramaṃ pārameśvaram ।
akṣarātparataścāpi paraṃ muktajanāśritam ।। 109।।
ityevaṃ kathito rādhe camatkāro harestava ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 2.74.110 ।।
apatyadhanadārādeḥ phalaṃ mokṣo mahottamam ।
tallabdhaṃ tena bhaktena kimapatyādibhiḥ khalu ।। 11 1।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kimanadyāstaṭe kuśāmbāpattanasthakauśikāmbarṣiyogenā'ntyajasya rogiṇastryaṣṭakāro sastrīkasya prabhorbhaktyā muktipadalābha ityādinirūpaṇanāmācatuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 74 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 074 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 75
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 076 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evamanyaṃ camatkāraṃ kathayāmyapi rādhike ।
sūryaputryāstapatyāstu taṭe kāmapure purā ।। 1 ।।
āsīt santāpano nāma daityo daityagaṇeśvaraḥ ।
mahābalena yukto'sāvaṭate tapatītaṭe ।। 2 ।।
saptapaṭṭādrivāsaṃ ca kṛtavān māṃsakhādakaḥ ।
prāṅdiśi dūraparyantaṃ gatvā gatvā ca bālakān ।। 3 ।।
tāpīmūlāvadhiṃ gatvā haratyalpatarānapi ।
daityā mānuṣamāṃsādā militvā'danti sotsavāḥ ।। 4 ।।
bhūśāvālayapūrve tu tāpītīre'bhavan mahān ।
vidyālayo'bhavattatra munirhiraṇyakeśakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇayajurvidāṃśreṣṭhaḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro'bhavat ।
tasyā''śrame kṛtā''vāsā vidyābrahmacarāstadā ।। 6 ।।
viprā hiraṇyakeśīyaśāstrīyāstu sahasraśaḥ ।
āsaँścānye'pi hiraṇyakeśākhyagurusannidhau ।। 7 ।।
āśramasthāśca te brahmādhyetārastapatījale ।
snātuṃ yānti brāhmakāle tatra santāpano'suraḥ ।। 8 ।।
supracchannaḥ samāgatya harate viprabālakān ।
nityaṃ dvau vā pañca vā ṣaṭ kadācid daśa vā nava ।। 9 ।।
sahasreṣu tu bāleṣu kṣayaṃ yānti tu ye'rbhakāḥ ।
na jñāyante cāśramasthaiḥ kva prayāntīti vai tadā ।। 2.75.1 0।।
yatra vai gaṇanā nāsti tatra na jñāyate kṣayaḥ ।
evaṃ yāte bahutithe kāle pañcaśatāni vai ।। 11 ।।
brāhmaṇānāmapatyāni kṣayaṃ nītāni rākṣasaiḥ ।
śatā'patyāni cānyāni kṣatraviṭdāsajāni ca ।। 12।।
evaṃ kumārabāhulye kṣayaṃ yāte taduttaram ।
bhojanā'dhyayane saṃkhyā nyūnā vijñāyate janaiḥ ।। 13।।
bālā hrāsaṃ nityameva yānti tāpītaṭe khalu ।
jale majjanti makarairhiyante'vaśyameva ca ।। 14।।
evaṃ sandehamāpannāḥ saha snātuṃ prayānti te ।
rākṣasā bālakā bhūtvā viśanti bālakeṣu hi ।। 15।।
śaucārthaṃ yānti ye dūraṃ tān gṛhītvā prayānti te ।
na cāyānti parāvṛttya tadā jñātaṃ janaiḥ khalu ।। 16।।
haranti makarā naiva kintu haranti rākṣasāḥ ।
śokastvatitaraścāsīdāśrame bālakeṣu ca ।। 17।।
hiraṇyakeśanāmarṣiḥ śuśoca bahudhā tadā ।
aho me bālakā naṣṭā adhikāḥ ṣaṭśatādapi ।। 18।।
na jñātaṃ tvadyaparyantaṃ pitṝṇāṃ kā gatirbhavet ।
tatsambandhijanānāṃ ca kāḥ śrotavyā duruktayaḥ ।। 19।।
aho dhyānaṃ mayā dattaṃ naiva tvadyāvadhiṃ kṣaye ।
kathaṃ jīveyurevaite māritāḥ syurhi rākṣasaiḥ ।।2.75.20।।
bhakṣitāḥ syuraho daivaṃ durbalānāṃ vighātakam ।
iti dhṛtvā mastake dvau karau ruroda raudrakam ।।21 ।।
anye tadāśramavāsā ruruduścātikaṇṭhataḥ ।
āśramaḥ kaśmalo jāto mānavāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ ।।22।।
nistejāstu ṛṣirjātaḥ śoko druṣvapyajāyata ।
paśapakṣigaṇāścāpyarudanta jñātatatkṣayāḥ ।।23 ।।
mṛgādyā nā'grasan ghāsaṃ śukā nādadire phalam ।
api pipīlikā naiva kaṇān jagṛhurucchucaḥ ।।24।।
vallikā na papurvāri kedāreṣvarpitaṃ hyapi ।
vavau vāyurna subhago vahniḥ kuṇḍe na cā'jvalat ।।25।।
mayūrā nā'vadan kekāmṛṣayo'pi śavā iva ।
abhavannāśrame nāryo vidhavā iva niṣprabhāḥ ।।26।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīdāśrame deśamaṇḍale ।
daityāḥ saptapuṭādristhā haranti viprabālakān ।।27।।
mārayanti ca khādanti hā kaṣṭaṃ kālanoditam ।
aho trātā na cāsmākaṃ ghātayitā na rakṣasām ।।28।।
kaścidāste vinā kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇastiṣṭhati kutra vā ।
śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ kathāyāṃ vai cāśvapaṭṭasaro'ntike ।।29।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre rājate bhagavān svayam ।
kauśikāmbarṣimukhataścāpi śrutaṃ tathaiva ca ।।2.75.3 0।।
tathā'nyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śrutaṃ kṛṣṇo virājate ।
mūrtimān mānavo bhūtvā śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ śruto hariḥ svayam ।
rājate'nādidevaḥ sa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।32।।
sa kuryād rakṣaṇaṃ nastu mahāpatkālataḥ khalu ।
ityevaṃ śokasammagne hiraṇyakeśakāśrame ।।33 ।।
tatra tāvat samāyāto maharṣiḥ kauśikāmbakaḥ ।
yogadharmeṇa vijñāya cārtanādān ṛṣikṛtān ।।34।।
pauṣamāse tu pūrṇāyāṃ hiraṇyakeśakāśrame ।
ādṛtaḥ satkṛto madhuparkādyairarcanairmuniḥ ।।35।।
dattāsano nyaṣīdacca papraccha rodanodbhavam ।
hiraṇyakeśakaḥ prāha rākṣasairviprabālakaiḥ ।।36।।
brahmādhyāyaparāstāpītaṭe brāhmamuhūrtake ।
snātuṃ yātāśca bahavo rākṣasaiḥ saṃhṛtā mune ।।37।।
ṣaṭśatāni hatāścaivaṃ jñāyate hi vicārataḥ ।
daśasāhasravipreṣu guroḥ kule vasatsu vai ।।38।।
āsurāṇāṃ mahānevamupadravo vyajāyata ।
kiṃ kurmaḥ kva prayāmaśca kimabhūt kva gatāśca te ।।39।।
yadyevaṃ viprabālānāṃ hrāsatantuḥ pravartate ।
kā gatiścāśramasyā'tra bhavediti vipannanu ।।2.75.40।।
yadi kaścidupāyo'tra vināśarodhako'sti cet ।
bālānāṃ labdhihetuśca vada yogin prakurmahe ।।41।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau hiraṇyakeśako muniḥ ।
kauśikāmbaśca taṃ prāha rādhike saṃsmaran harim ।।42।।
mā viṣādaṃ yāhi vipra sarvaṃ jānāmi yogataḥ ।
pūrvaṃ mamāśrame'pyeṣāmupadravo mahānabhūt ।।43 ।।
mayā tu rākṣasā daityā nāśitā vai muhurmuhuḥ ।
punaste nūtanā jātāstāṃ diśāṃ na prayānti te ।।44।।
tavāśrame prakurvanti tāpītaṭe hyupadravam ।
mānavānapi khādanti saptapaṭṭādrivāsinaḥ ।।45।।
ahaṃ yogabalenaiva jñātvā tadvaiśasaṃ mahat ।
smarāmyanādidevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।46।।
vasantaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre sarvahṛdi sthitam ।
gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ tasya rakṣaṇaṃ sa kariṣyati ।।47।।
kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ tasya hastagaṃ vartate ca naḥ ।
vinā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śakto na cā'paraḥ ।।48।।
avituṃ duḥkhasaṃsārādāpadbhyaśca bhavāmbudhau ।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā vyomamārgeṇa yogirāṭ ।।49।।
nītvā hiraṇyakeśaṃ ca sahaivā'śvasaro yayau ।
sūryacandrasamau jyotsnāgolakāviva bhāsurau ।।2.75.50।।
vyomamārgāllomaśasyāśramāgre cāvateratuḥ ।
prathamaṃ lomaśaṃ natvā prasampūjya parasparam ।।51 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā kuṃkumavāpikām ।
gatvā tajjalapānaṃ ca kṛtvā natvā ca devatāḥ ।।52।।
yayatuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikaṃ tu mandire ।
rājate yatra bhagavān parameśaḥ parātparaḥ ।।53 ।।
gajāsane tu sauvarṇe maṇiratnasamañcite ।
tīrthaiśca munibhirdevairlakṣmyādibhiḥ prasevitam ।।54।।
divyatejomayaṃ divyabhūṣāmālāmbarānvitam ।
pūjitaṃ cārusaugandhyaiḥ prasannavadanāmbujam ।।55।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma dṛṣṭvā praṇematurmuhuḥ ।
sāśrū snehabharau saumyau pracakratuśca daṇḍavat ।।।56।।
satkṛtau hariṇā tūrṇaṃ prāpitau madhuparkakam ।
dattāsanau sukhaṃ pṛṣṭau niṣedatuḥ samīpataḥ ।।57।।
āgame kāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭāvūcatuḥ parameśvaram ।
vipragodharaṇisādhusādhvīdharmaprapālaka ।।58।।
dīnārttakṛpaṇā'nāthanirāśrayasamāśraya ।
brāhmaṇā bahavo naṣṭā vidyārthibrahmacāriṇaḥ ।।59।।
rākṣasairnīyate nityaṃ yadyaddhastagato bhavet ।
tebhyo rakṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma vidhehi naḥ ।।2.75.60।।
mṛtānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛṣṇa tava saṃkalpajaṃ bhavet ।
yathāsaukhyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ bhavet tat tvaṃ tathā kuru ।।6 1 ।।
rākṣasānāṃ paraṃ daṇḍaṃ vidhehi pratipālaka ।
tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ vidhātā ca tvaṃ durdhātā pumuttama ।।62।।
tvadāśrayā vṛṣo yajño vedo vidyā ca bhūsurāḥ ।
āśramā yogayatayastvadadhīnaprajīvanāḥ ।।63।।
śrutvaivaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaścakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nijam ।
sasmāra śaṃkaraṃ devīṃ pārvatīṃ vīrabhadrakam ।।64।।
mṛtasañjivanīṃ vidyāṃ sandhinīṃ prāṇadāyinīm ।
kalpavallīṃ vimānaṃ ca vaihāyasaṃ sadā'vyayam ।।65।।
lakṣmīṃ siddhiṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ te samupasthitāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nemuśca daṇḍavat ।।66।।
prabhuḥ prāha mahādeva gaṇeśa siddhi pārvati ।
lakṣmi vidye kalpavalli vīrabhadra sudarśana ।।67।।
hatā bālāstu bahavaḥ santāpanādirākṣasaiḥ ।
vartante rākṣasāḥ saptapuṭṭakādrau sahasraśaḥ ।।68।।
hantavyāste'dya yuṣmābhirjīvanīyāśca bhūsurāḥ ।
tadarthaṃ ca vayaṃ tatra gacchāmo hetibhiryutāḥ ।।69।।
ārohantu bhavanto'tra vimāne vai mayā saha ।
ityuktāste cāruruhuḥ sākaṃ śrīpatinā tathā ।।2.75.70।।
kauśikāmbena sahitā hiraṇyakeśinā yutāḥ ।
vimānaṃ dhyātamātraṃ tad gataṃ tatra vihāyasā ।।71।।
saptapaṭṭakaśailordhve vyomni bhramaṇamāvahat ।
tad dṛṣṭvā divyayānaṃ tu rākṣasā niryayurbahiḥ ।।72।।
hartuṃ vimānaṃ divyaṃ ca saśastrā vyomagāminaḥ ।
kecidvai parvataprāyāḥ kecidgahvaranāsikāḥ ।।73।।
kecittāḍasamāṃ'guṣṭhāḥ kecittaṭākakarṇakāḥ ।
kecidvidyunnibhanetrāḥ kecitsūryanakhāstathā ।।74।।
apare vaṃśavatkeśā abbhrabāṣpānanāḥ pare ।
naikarūpadharā naikaveṣā māyāpravedinaḥ ।।75।।
nirjagmurdaśasāhasrāḥ śailagahvaravāsinaḥ ।
tān dṛṣṭvā śrīharistūrṇaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau sudāruṇam ।।76।।
yuddhasyā''vedakaṃ dhvānaṃ prāduścakāra bhīpradam ।
tāvatte parito vṛttvā mumucuścāṭṭahāsanam ।।77।।
vimānaṃ dhartumudyuktā vineduḥ prabalonmadāḥ ।
tāvacchrībhagavānāha kalpavallīṃ satīṃ priyām ।।78।।
samutpādaya sainyāni yuddhārthaṃ śaktimanti vai ।
śrutvā kalpalatā yoddhṛn daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān ।।79।।
prāviścakāra sahasā yoddhāro yuddhamācaran ।
vimānānniryayuḥ sarve'bhito rākṣasasannidhau ।।2.75.80।।
kālpānāṃ rakṣasāṃ vyomni yuddhaṃ ghorataraṃ hyabhūt ।
parasparaṃ vihanyante vijayārthaṃ raṇāndhakaiḥ ।।81 ।।
gadābhirasibhiḥ khaṅgaistomaraiḥ parighaistathā ।
staṃbhairvṛkṣaiśca pāṣāṇairmuśalaiḥ śūlaśaktibhiḥ ।।82।।।
nārācaiḥ paṭṭiśairbhallairnijaghnuste parasparam ।
akasmādvai samāpannaṃ yuddhaṃ tad rakṣasāṃ bhuvi ।।83 ।।
śirāṃsi rakṣasāṃ tatra pṛthvyāṃ patanti vṛṣṭivat ।
bhinnānyaṃgāni daityānāṃ patanti śṛṃgavad bhuvi ।।84।।
keciddhastavihīnāścā'pare pādavivarjitāḥ ।
kaṭicchinnāḥ pare dvedhā skandhacchinnāstathā'pare ।।85।।
nipeturbhūtale ghorā rākṣasāḥ prāṇato hatāḥ ।
vihatebhyastu dehebhyo jāyante nūtanā navāḥ ।।86।।
te samāgatya cākāśe yodhayanti mahābalāḥ ।
evaṃ sainyaṃ rakṣasāṃ tu vardhamānaṃ hi koṭibham ।।87।।
vyadṛśyata tadā vyomni bhayaṃkaramasīmakam ।
kalpabhaṭāśca tān dhṛtvā dhṛtvā keśeṣu cāsibhiḥ ।।88।।
dvedhā kurvanti bhinnāँścāskandhāccākaṭi pāragaiḥ ।
nipatanti śirohīnā yuddhyanti cotthitāśca te ।।89।।
koṭiśo vyāhatāḥ kalpalatotthaiḥ raṇamūrdhani ।
hastapādādayasteṣāmutthāyotthāya roṣataḥ ।।2.75.90।।
tāḍayanti kalpabhaṭān vyomni coḍḍīya jīvavat ।
hanyante kālayoddhāro divyāścidyanta eva na ।।91।।
śastrāṇi yeṣu cākāśe yathā rodhaṃ na yanti hi ।
atha daityāstataścakrurmāyāṃ pārvatasarjinīm ।।92।।
parvatāścā'bhavan vyomni nipetuścoparisthitāḥ ।
vimānopari vegādvai vināśārthaṃ tathāpi ca ।।93।।
vimānaṃ divyamevā''sīd devā divyāśca devikāḥ ।
aspṛśyā vyomavat sarve tān dharṣituṃ na śekire ।।94।।
vimānaṃ vyomavad vyomni yathāvasthaṃ sthirāyate ।
patanti parvatāstasmād abhivyāpyā'pi bhūtale ।।95।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā daityāśca rākṣasāḥ ।
naitaddhartuṃ ca vā hantuṃ yogyaṃ vimānakaṃ nu vai ।।96।।
naite devāśca yoddhāro hantuṃ yogyā bhavanti hi ।
iti matvā'pareśauryavarjitā dudruvū raṇāt ।।97।।
te hatāścāpi nārācaiḥ kālpayoddhṛpramuktakaiḥ ।
bhinnadehāśca te bhinnamastakāḥ prāṇavarjitāḥ ।।98।।
nidhanaṃ hi tadā prāptā utpannā api sarvaśaḥ ।
anye mohācca yuddhyanti kālpabhaṭaiḥ samantataḥ ।।99।।
kalpalatotthavahnistān bhasmīcakāra sarvaśaḥ ।
koṭikoṭyātmakaṃ sainyaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhasmatāṃ gatam ।। 2.75.10 0।।
mūlāstu pañcasāhasrāḥ kṣayaṃ yātā hi rākṣasāḥ ।
pañcasāhasramātrāśca praśiṣṭā yuddhakāriṇaḥ ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hiraṇyakeśarṣigurukulasthānāṃ ṣaṭśatabālānāṃ rākṣasairnāśe kṛte śrīhariṇā rākṣasānāṃ nāśārthaṃ kṛtodyamayuddhādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 75 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 075 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ākarṇaya tato rādhe! tvavaśiṣṭāni yānyapi ।
pañcasahasrarakṣāṃsi mahābalāni vegataḥ ।। 1 ।।
vyomayuddhaṃ pracakruśca tarupāṣāṇaparvataiḥ ।
prajagmuḥ rākṣasāste ca vimānaṃ paritastadā ।। 2 ।।
śaṃbhuṃ gaṇapatiṃ sudarśanaṃ ca vīrabhadrakam ।
vimāne sampraviśyaiva prajaghnustomarādibhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
tato vīro gaṇeśaśca sudarśanaṃ śivastathā ।
vimānāntargatān daityān dhṛtvā dhṛtvā triśūlakaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
nijaghnuḥ prāṇataḥ sarvān vīrabhadro mukhe ca tān ।
nikṣipya carvayāṃcakre jīvato rakṣasāṃ gaṇān ।। 5 ।।
mṛtebhyo ye ca jāyante mṛṣārūpāśca tān haraḥ ।
mahāmāyotthavaḍavānalairbhasmīcakāra ha ।। 6 ।
catuḥsahasradaityāste naṣṭā vai bhasmatāṃ gatāḥ ।
atha sahasrasaṃkhyāste dudruvurvyomamārgataḥ ।। 7 ।
viviśuḥ saptapuṭake parvate gahvarādiṣu ।
kalpalatāsamutpannā yoddhārastadanukramāḥ ।। 8 ।
viviśurgahvarādau ca jagṛhustān samantataḥ ।
sudarśanaṃ mahācakraṃ kakarta kaṇṭhadeśataḥ ।। 9 ।
agnistān parito vīkṣya bhasmīcakāra sarvathā ।
evaṃ hatā mahādaityāḥ saptapaṭṭādrivāsinaḥ ।। 2.76.10 ।
tato bhītā daityapatnyaḥ sāpatyāḥ śaraṇaṃ hareḥ ।
āyayurvai rudantyastāḥ prāṇarakṣārthamityatha ।। 11 ।
dayāluḥ śrīharistatra cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ svakam ।
vārayāmāsa tābhyaśca dadau jīvapradānakam ।। 1 2।
mṛtānāṃ viprabālānāṃ khāditānāṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ ।
asthīni darśayāmāsurgartakṣiptāni tāstadā ।। 1 3।
ṣaṭśatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca tathā sahasrayoṣitām ।
daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākapuruṣāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām ।। 14।।
paśūnāṃ bālakānāṃ ca nā'sthisaṃkhyā pravidyate ।
krośasaṃsthe mahāgarte tāni vīkṣya samantataḥ ।। 15।।
lakṣmīmājñāpayāmāsa tatrasthāṃ kalpavallikām ।
sañjivanyādividyāśca jīvayituṃ tadasthitaḥ ।। 16।।
tato lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādajalaṃ śubham ।
jagrāha svaghaṭe svarṇanirmite tvakṣaye svayam ।। 17।।
haṃsasthā'tha vimānāt sā sā'mṛtakalaśā yayau ।
gartaṃ sarvaṃ bhramitvā tu vyomnā'sthīni punaḥ punaḥ ।। 18।।
cakre saṃprokṣaṇaṃ tasya jalasyāmṛtabindubhiḥ ।
asthīnyāpyāyitānyeva saprāṇāni tadā'bhavan ।। 19।।
kalpavallī tato yātā rasān bhṛtvā ghaṭe'kṣaye ।
cakre saṃprokṣaṇaṃ tasya rasasyā'mṛtabindubhiḥ ।।2.76.20।।
tena dehāḥ samutpannā māṃsamajjātvaganvitāḥ ।
bālakāśca narā nāryaḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ।।2 1।।
ye ye mṛtā bhakṣitāśca lakṣādhikā hi dehinaḥ ।
tān sajīvān tataḥ kartuṃ vidyā saṃjīvanī svayam ।।22।।
ājñaptā vṛṣṭirūpā sā papāta sarvadehiṣu ।
vṛṣṭikaṇā jīvarūpāścetanā viviśustataḥ ।।23।।
utthitā ghoranidrātaḥ sarve gartā'sthisaṃbhavāḥ ।
yathā dehasvabhāvāśca yathāvatsaraśālinaḥ ।।24।।
yathāyonisvabhāvāśca narā nāryo'nyayonayaḥ ।
sañjātā jīvavantaste tadāścaryamabhūnmahat ।।25।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve yayurvanāntaraṃ prati ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā muhurmuhuḥ ।।26।।
mānavāśca narā nāryo bālā kanyāśca te tataḥ ।
gartānnimnoccadeśena niryayurbahirāyayuḥ ।। 27।।
śrīharistatra vai deśe vimānaṃ cāvatārayat ।
dadau bhojyaṃ tatastebhyo jalaṃ sutṛptikārakam ।।28।।
vastrāṇyapi dadau tebhyo'pekṣyavastūni yāni tu ।
pradadau smaraṇaṃ tebhyo yajjanmagrāmabāndhavāḥ ।। 29।।
yeṣāṃ yatra bhavantyeva teṣāṃ prasphuritaṃ tu tat ।
śrībhagavānāha kauśāmbikāya yogine ।।2.76.30 ।।
ebhyaḥ pradehi me mantraṃ paramaṃ vaiṣṇavam ṛṣe ।
kauśāmbiko dadau mantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya tadājñayā ।।3 1 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
hiraṇyakeśo mantraṃ taṃ jagrāha ṛṣitastadā ।। 32।।
atha śrībhagavān sarvān samagṛhya vimānake ।
viśāle śaṃkaraṃ prāhu śaṃbho hyetān nijaṃ sthalam ।।33 ।।
anenaiva vimānena prāpaya kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
śabhurdhyānaparo bhūtvā dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ tu bhūmikāḥ ।।34।।
lakṣagaṇān samutpādya tattadvyomavicāriṇaḥ ।
sarvān vai kṣaṇamātreṇa prāpayāmāsa tadgṛhān ।। 35।।
kuṭumbinaśca te jātā hṛṣṭāḥ svajanalābhataḥ ।
camatkāraṃ paraṃ śrutvā jātāste vaiṣṇavāstataḥ ।। 36।।
hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāśca prāpitā vai tadāśramam ।
āśramaḥ sukhito jāto vaiṣṇavo bhagavanmayaḥ ।। 37।।।
atha rākṣasakanyāśca pañcasāhasrakanyakāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya vavrire tadrapamohitāḥ ।।38।।
tanmātṛbhiḥ pradattā sañjagrāha bhagavāँstu tāḥ ।
rakṣasāṃ bālakān dārān mantramaśrāvayanmuniḥ ।।39।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
tataścāsuradārāṇāmājñāṃ cakre svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।2.76.40 ।।
adyaprabhṛti kasyāpi hiṃsanaṃ kāryameva na ।
kṛṣiṃ kṛtvā'tra vai kṣetre jīvantu nivasantu ca ।।41 ।।
dātā'haṃ bhavatīnāṃ vai jalānnāmbarasampadām ।
ityuktvā cā'bhayaṃ datvā nītvā kanyāstadarpitāḥ ।।।42।।
snātvā tatra tapatyāṃ ca kṛtvā tīrthaṃ taduttamam ।
yayau tīrthanimittena śrīharirdakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।।43 ।।
pūrṇāyāṃ tvakarot snānaṃ cāmbikāyāṃ tataḥ param ।
sahyādrau tu vimānena bhramitvā vai tataḥ param ।।44।।
mahābaleśvaraṃ gatvā bhīmāyāṃ snānamācarat ।
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu tataḥ sasnau tuṃgabhadrājale tataḥ ।।45।।
paścimaghaṭṭake vārdhau snātvā śrīparvataṃ yayau ।
nīlagiriṃ vilokyā'tha elādriṃ vai tato yayau ।।46।।
akhāte'pi tataḥ snātvā siṃhalaṃ dvīpakaṃ yayau ।
tatra puṣpanadīṃ spṛṣṭvā kāveryāṃ snānamācarat ।।47।।
kaṭunadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā pannārīsnānamācarat ।
droṇācalaṃ tato gatvā kṛṣṇāyāṃ snānamācarat ।।48।।
kolārasarasi snātvā tato godāvarīṃ yayau ।
mañjirāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā tataścandrāvatīṃ yayau ।।49।।
indrāvatyāṃ tataḥ snātvā tataścilasaro yayau ।
mahānadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā huhūgalyāṃ tato yayau ।।2.76.50।।
gaṃgānadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā brahmaputrāṃ tato yayau ।
snātvā kaṃcanagaṃgāyāṃ kuśyāṃ snātvā tataḥ param ।।51।।
gṇḍakyāṃ vai tataḥ snātvā gogarāsnānamācarat ।
nandāyāṃ tu tataḥ snātvā yamunāyāṃ tataḥ param ।।52।।
cambalāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā snātvā sarasi śaṃbhare ।
śatalājājale snātvā rāvyāṃ snātvā tataḥ param ।।53।।
cīnāpāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā jhelamāsnānamācarat ।
kābilāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā sindhusnānaṃ samācarat ।।54।।
luṇīsnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gatvā nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ ।
akhātaṃ samatīpyaiva gomatīsnānamācarat ।।55।।
bhadrāvatyāṃ tataḥ snātvā cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyā''śrame hariḥ ।।56।।
vimānaṃ sthāpayāmāsa guruṃ natvā tataḥ param ।
gṛhaṃ gatvā svapitarau praṇamyā''bhāṣya yatkṛtam ।।57।।
nivedayāmāsa kanyāḥ pañcasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa tāścopakaraṇāni hyadāpayat ।।58।।
lomaśasyā''śrame tāstu sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
śaṃkaraśca gaṇeśaśca vīrabhadro nijālaye ।।59।।
yayuḥ sudarśanaṃ cāpi vimānaṃ ca tiro'bhavat ।
lakṣmyādyāḥ śrīhareḥ kṣetre tīrthe naije ca mandire ।।2.76.60 ।।
yayuḥ prasādamābhuktvā bālakṛṣṇo nijālaye ।
viśaśrāma sukhaṃ rādhe sarvabhaktaiḥ prasevitaḥ ।।61 ।।
cāndre māghe kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthyāṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
rakṣayitvā jīvayitvā kṛtvā tīrthāni bhūtale ।।62।।
ājagāma nije kṣetre sarvaprāṇapradaḥ prabhuḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ।।63।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne santāpanadaityamāritānāṃ hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāṇāṃ sajīvīkaraṇaṃ, daityānāṃ nāśaḥ, dakṣiṇanadīnāṃ tīrthīkaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 76 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe tathā cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ parātmanaḥ ।
bhaktānāṃ devasādhūnāṃ gavāṃ trātuśca sūtriṇām ।। 1 ।।
purānaṅgapure rājā bṛhadvarcā babhūva ha ।
devasevāparo nityaṃ sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dharmakāryaparo yajñasatrahomaparāyaṇaḥ ।
jñānavijñānasampannaḥ kathākīrtanatatparaḥ ।। 3 ।।
anāthadīnakṛpaṇopakārī dānaśīlanaḥ ।
bhāryā pativratā sādhvī sādhusevāparāyaṇā ।। 4 ।।
bhaktisevāparā nityaṃ sāṃkhyasatyabhidhānikā ।
putrāstasyāṃ nṛpasyā''san buddhimantaḥ śatatrayam ।। 5 ।।
kanyāḥ śatadvayaṃ cāpi sarvāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
rājā'sau tapatītīre gatvā parvaṇi parvaṇi ।। 6 ।।
tīrthasnānavidhiṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dadāti cottamam ।
suvarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ tāmraṃ dhanaṃ dravyaṃ ca mudrikāḥ ।। 7 ।।
ratnāni mauktikādīni hīrakān vidrumādikān ।
maṇīn māṇikyavarṇāṃśca gajānaśvān gavādikān ।। 8 ।।
ajāvīn vāhanayānaśibikāśakaṭīstathā ।
vimānāni vicitrāṇi bāṣpayānāni vai tathā ।। 9 ।।
dvicakrāṇi tricakrāṇi bahucakrāṇi yānyapi ।
vaihāyasāni yānāni śreṣṭhadānāni parvaṇi ।। 2.77.1 0।।
dadātyapi yathāyogyaṃ viprebhyaḥ pūjanottaram ।
atha sūryagrahaṇe ca phālgune tapatītaṭe ।। 1 1।।
yayau rājā''plavanārthaṃ bahudravyasamanvitaḥ ।
tatrāyayustapatyāṃ saṃsnātuṃ vai lakṣaśo janāḥ ।। 1 2।।
brāhmaṇā grāmavāsāśca pañcayojanabhūmigāḥ ।
yajñakarmakarāścāpi vedādhyāpanakāriṇaḥ ।। 13।।
satpātrāṇi tapovidyāvratadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
sastrībālā hi te sarve tvāyayuḥ snānahetave ।। 14।।
sūryoparāgasaṃsnātā japaṃ cakrurnadītaṭe ।
rājā dānaṃ pradātuṃ ca viprebhyaścopacakrame ।। 15।।
gajān dadau ca saudhāni kṣetrāṇi vāṭikā maṇīn ।
mauktikān hīrakān gāśca dogdhrīśca mahiṣīstathā ।। 16।।
aśvān yānāni cānnāni māṣān tāmrasya puttalīḥ ।
āyasaṃ puttalaṃ naijaṃ dadau carmāmbarāṇi ca ।। 17।।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ mudrā yānāni vāhanānyapi ।
dāsīrdāsān dadau cājāvikān grāmān gṛhāṇyapi ।। 18।।
kṛṣṇavastrāṇi ca kṛṣṇakaṇān kṛṣṇadravāँstathā ।
kṛṣṇahārān maṇinaddhān kṛṣṇasūtraiḥ sughaṭṭitān ।। 1 9।।
kṛṣṇapuruṣadānaṃ ca koṭimudrāsamanvitam ।
dadau pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā hastacatuṣṭayam ।।2.77.20।।
lobhena vipravaryāste jagṛhurdānamuttamam ।
bhārayuktaṃ mahādānaṃ lakṣādhikadhanānvitam ।।21 ।।
pratyekaṃ jagṛhurviprāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā ।
eko hastī tathaikāśvaścaikā gaurvṛṣabhadvayam ।।22।।
ekā ca mahiṣī dogdhrī gṛhaṃ caikaṃ nivāsadam ।
kṣetraṃ caikaṃ vāṭikaikā maṇiḥ kṛṣṇaśca mauktikam ।।23 ।।
hīrakaścaikayānaṃ ca māṣāstāmrasya puttalī ।
āyasaṃ puttalaṃ naijaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ carma tathā'mbaram ।।24।।
kṛṣṇaṃ sūtraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇo dāso dāsyapi kṛṣṇikā ।
kṛṣṇā'jā kṛṣṇahāraśca kṛṣṇā madrā sakajjalā ।।25।।
kṛṣṇamāṣā lakṣamūlyaṃ svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ ca lakṣakam ।
pratyekāya tu viprāya tatsarvaṃ pradadau nṛpaḥ ।।26।।
sahasrabrāhmaṇā lubdhā gṛhītavanta eva tat ।
sūryaśuddhau punaḥ sasnustapatyāṃ te tu bhūsurāḥ ।।27।।
dānalabdheścātituṣṭāścātiprasannamānasāḥ ।
bahupremṇā jale sasnuryāvattu niryayurbahiḥ ।।28।।
tāvatte dānadoṣeṇa kṛṣṇāḥ kadrupiṇo'bhavan ।
kṛṣṇavarṇasya tu pratigrahe doṣo'bhipadyate ।।29।।
rādhike tacchṛṇu vacmi yena yaddoṣatā bhavet ।
hastidānena vai rājño yuddhe tvanyāyadūṣaṇam ।।2.77.3 0।।
pāpāpmakaṃ bhaved yadyat kāpaṭyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ mahat ।
strībālānāṃ tvaparādhavarjitānāṃ vighātanam ।।3 1।।
sārathīnāṃ paśūnāṃ ca vāhānāṃ dūtakarmiṇām ।
hananaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ hastidānena śuddhyati ।।32।।
etatpāpaṃ hastidānagrahiṇaḥ śirasi vrajet ।
aśvadānasya tu rājño'śvavāraistu kṛtaṃ mahat ।।33।।
saṃgrāme dūṣaṇaṃ cāśvamāraṇādinivartanam ।
phalaṃ rājño bhaved dānagrahītā doṣabhāg bhavet ।।34।।
godānāttu vṛṣādīnāṃ yuddhādau māraṇaṃ tu yat ।
rājye muṣkacchedanaṃ ca govṛṣādestu yadbhavet ।।35।।
tatpāpaṃ nṛpaternaśyed dānagrāhiṣu gacchati ।
vṛṣabhadvayadānena pretā yuddhe mṛtāstu ye ।।36।।
aśūrāḥ pṛṣṭhadhāvāśca prasahyā''gatikā mṛtāḥ ।
teṣāṃ hatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ rājño naśyati tatpunaḥ ।।37।।
vṛṣadvayapratigrāhiṣveva gatvā sutiṣṭhati ।
mahiṣyāstu pradānena pāśaśūlāvaropaṇāt ।। 38।।
yatpāpaṃ jāyate rājño'nyāyajanyaṃ hi daṇḍataḥ ।
kṛṣṇavastradharaiḥ pāśo dīyate pāśakārakaiḥ ।।39।।
taddhatyājaṃ nṛpatestu pāpaṃ naśyati tatpunaḥ ।
mahiṣīdānasaṃgrāhakartaryeva prapadyate ।।2.77.40।।
gṛhadānena ca rājño rājye pṛthvyāṃ prajājane ।
śilpinirmitasaudhādigrāmamārgādijaṃ ca yat ।।41 ।।
asaṃkhyajīvahatyā'ghaṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ nivartate ।
grahagrāhiṇi sarvaṃ tallagnaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ।।42।।
kṣetravāṭīpradānena kṛṣeḥ pāpamanantakam ।
prajānāṃ yad bhaved rājñastannivṛttiḥ prajāyate ।।43।।
kṣetravāṭyudyānagrāhiviprādau tatpravartate ।
kṛṣṇamaṇeḥ pradānena khanyādikhanane tu yat ।।44।।
rājyapāpaṃ bhaved rājñastatsarvaṃ vinivartate ।
maṇigrāhiṇi khātānāṃ pāpaṃ sarvaṃ pravartate ।।45।।
mauktikasya pradāne sāmudrajantuvināśane ।
mauktikotpādane yacca lavaṇotpādane ca yat ।।46।।
tathā matsyādijantūnāṃ māraṇe yantravāhane ।
sāmudrādisamutthaṃ ca pāpaṃ rājño nivartate ।।47।।
mauktikagrāhiṇi sarvaṃ pravartate'tiduḥsaham ।
hīrakasya pradānena viṣajanyamaghaṃ tu yat ।।48।।
viṣauṣadhādijanyaṃ ca grīṣmatāpaviṣodbhavam ।
viṣavāyūdbhavaṃ pāpaṃ prāṇināṃ nāśasaṃbhavam ।।49।।
rājño nivartate tacca tadgrāhiṇi pravartate ।
yānadānena yānasthacakrairyatprāṇighātajam ।।2.77.50।।
pāpaṃ rājño nāśameti yānagrāhiṇi gacchati ।
māṣadānena ca varṣe grahapīḍā nṛpasya yā ।।5 1 ।।
dīnā'nātha kṛpaṇānāmarakṣājaṃ tu pātakam ।
rājño nivartate tacca māṣagrāhiṇi gacchati ।।52।।
tāmraputtalikādānapradānena tu bhūpateḥ ।
gaṇikāsaṃgajaṃ pāpaṃ tādṛśaṃ ca nivartate ।।53 ।।
puttalīgrāhiṇi lagnaṃ jāyate ghoraduḥkhadam ।
āyasasya puttalasya dānena nṛpatestu yat ।।54।।
ṣaḍītijanyajaṃ rājye pāpaṃ prajājanotthitam ।
rājñastajjāyate naṣṭaṃ puttalagrāhake bhavet ।।55।।
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭiḥ śalabhā mūṣakāḥ śukāḥ ।
bhūkampaviplavaścaitāḥ ṣaḍītayaḥ samīritāḥ ।।56।।
kṛṣṇacarmapradānena mṛgayājamaghaṃ mahat ।
rājño nivartate carmagrāhake ca pravartate ।।57।।
kṛṣṇāmbarapradānena vastrayantrodbhavaṃ mahat ।
pāpaṃ tvasaṃkhyajantunāṃ nāśotthaṃ nṛpatestu yat ।।58।।
naśyatyevā'mbaragrāhiṇyaghaṃ tacca pravartate ।
kṛṣṇasūtrapradānena rājye rajjūdbhavaṃ hyagham ।।59।।
ūrṇājanyaṃ tathorṇārthaṃ kauśeyārthaṃ ca yat kṛtam ।
pātakaṃ jīvaghātākhyaṃ rājye tannṛpaterbhavet ।।2.77.60 ।।
sūtradānena tad rādhe rājñaḥ sarvaṃ nivartate ।
sūtragrāhiṇi viprādau tatsarvaṃ sampravartate ।।61।।
kṛṣṇapūruṣadānena bālahatyodbhavaṃ tu yat ।
garbhahatyodbhavaṃ cāpi vṛthāhatyodbhavaṃ tathā ।।।62।।
prajāpāpaṃ tu yad rājñastatsarvaṃ vinivartate ।
dāsadānagrāhake tu tatsarvaṃ sampravartate ।।63।।
kṛṣṇādāsīpradānena kanyāhatyodbhavaṃ tathā ।
strīhatyāvidhavāhatyāprabhṛtyutthaṃ hyaghaṃ tu yat ।।64।।
paradāraprasaṃgotthaṃ pāpaṃ rājño nivartate ।
dāsīgrāhiṇi viprādau tatsarvaṃ tu pravartate ।।65।।
ajādānena rājye yattvajāmāṃsādanodbhavam ।
pāpaṃ cāvikabhakṣotthaṃ sarvaṃ rājño nivartate ।।66।।
ajāgrāhiṇi cāyāti ghātakiśālikodbhavam ।
kṛṣṇamālāpradānena krūraṃ pracchannapātakam ।।67।।
nivartate ca tad rājño mālāgrāhiṇi gacchati ।
kṛṣṇamudrādidānena dhanajanyaṃ prajājane ।।68।।
kośajanyaṃ ca yatpāpaṃ karajanyaṃ ca yad bhavet ।
prasahyā''haraṇairjanya hyaghaṃ daṇḍanimittajam ।।69।।
rājño nivartate tacca dravyagrāhiṇi gacchati ।
kṛṣṇamāṣapradānena rājñaḥ śanikṛtaṃ tu yat ।।2.77.70।।
pīḍanaṃ tanmāṣagrāhiṇye va saṃkramate'khilam ।
suvarṇadānataḥ pitṛprasannatvaṃ sureṣṭatā ।।71 ।।
rajatasya pradānena lakṣmīḥ sattvamayī bhavet ।
evaṃ dānaphalaṃ rājñaḥ pāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu pātrake ।।72।।
vastubhiḥ saha cābhyeti rājā doṣānnivartate ।
pratigrāhī pīḍyate tu tejohīnaḥ prajāyate ।।73।।
yadi cenna sa puṇyāḍhyaḥ samartho brahmabhāvanaḥ ।
puṇyabalavihīnastu tūrṇaṃ pāpaiḥ prapīḍyate ।।74।।
nyūnapuṇyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā jāyante grahamātrataḥ ।
kadrūpā jñānahīnā vā śāpadoṣād yathā janāḥ ।।75।।
vicittā vā dīrgharogā bhagnāṅgā bhagnabhūtayaḥ ।
bhagnavīryāḥ prajāyante bhagnakauṭumbikāstathā ।।76।।
sukhahīnā duḥkhapūrṇā jāyante dānasaṃgrahāt ।
tasmād ghorataraṃ dānaṃ na grāhyaṃ puṇyarakṣiṇā ।।77।।
dānasya grahaṇārthaṃ yo hasto dakṣa pralambate ।
puṇyaṃ dātuṃ lambate saḥ pāpamādātumityapi ।।78।।
tasmād dānaṃ tu gṛhṇīyād yo bhavet puṇyaśevadhiḥ ।
dānadoṣavināśārtha cared devārpaṇādikam ।।79।।
anyathā pāpabhug yāti duḥkhabhogasthalaṃ punaḥ ।
yāmyaṃ daihyaṃ ca gārbhaṃ ca yaduddhāro na vai drutam ।।2.77.80।।
ityevaṃ rādhike viprā dānaṃ jagṛhurutsukāḥ ।
kṛṣṇavarṇāśca kadrūpāścāntyajā iva vai kṣaṇāt ।।81।।
cāṇḍālā iva te jātā vivarṇāśca vitejasaḥ ।
yathā kajjaladehā vā vahnidagdhā yathā ca vā ।।82।।
tathā jātāḥ kṣaṇamātrāt tāpīsnānottaraṃ hyapi ।
ghoradānaphalaṃ tvetad durnivāryaṃ hyabhūttadā ।।83।।
grahaṇasnānapuṇyaṃ tu ghorapratigrahāntike ।
nā''bhūt trātuṃ samarthaṃ ca brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ ।।84।।
athaivaṃ pāpasampannān dṛṣṭvā śrīsuratāyanaḥ ।
maharṣiścandanavṛkṣakṛtāvāso'titāpasaḥ ।।।85।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'tivaiṣṇavaḥ ।
siddhaścaiśvaryapūrṇaśca jñānadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।।86।।
pūrvaṃ varṣasahasraṃ yaḥ samādhau samatiṣṭhata ।
yasyoparyabhavan vṛkṣastambā valmīkamūlakāḥ ।।87।।
tapatyā jalavegena cātivṛṣṭikṛtena ca ।
mṛttikākṣālane jāte nigaracchanmahāmuniḥ ।।88।।
candanasya tarormūle grathito yasya vigrahaḥ ।
tasthau tatraiva mūle ca samādheḥ sa bahiryayau ।।89।।
cetanāṃ prāpya tadvṛkṣe nyavasanbhagavanmanāḥ ।
samādhinā''lokayacca bhagavān dhṛtavigrahaḥ ।।2.77.90।।
idānīṃ vartate pṛthvyāmaśvapaṭṭasaro'ntike ।
kṣetre kukumavāpyāṃ ca śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।।91।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī pumuttamaḥ ।
śrīpatiḥ kamalākānto haṃsārādhāramāpatiḥ ।।92।।
māṇikīpārvatīmañjulāprabhāsaguṇāpatiḥ ।
anantamuktadevyaśca koṭyarbudasatīpriyaḥ ।।93।।
kambharāśrītanayo'sau bālakṛṣṇo virājate ।
nityaṃ jñātvā prayātyeva prātardarśanahetave ।।94।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa tu samādhinā cāyāti candanam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajati nityaśaḥ ।।95।।
śrīharistaṃ nijaṃ mantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa sakṛpaḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।96।।
sa ca mantraṃ japannāste candanā'dho nadītaṭe ।
tena dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇāste sahasrasaṃkhyakāstadā ।।97।।
gṛhītadānakṛṣṇā ye sañjātāḥ kalmaṣānvitāḥ ।
saśokā doṣanāśārthaṃ cintayānāḥ parasparam ।।98।।
te sarve taṃ mahāyogeśvaraṃ śrīsuratāyanam ।
yayuḥ śaraṇamāsādya sāśrunetrāstadā'bhavan ।।99।।
doṣaśāntyarthamevainaṃ prārthayāmāsurantike ।
niṣedurdaṇḍavat kṛtvā maharṣiḥ śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 2.77.10 0।।
dadau jñānaṃ pāpaśāntipradaṃ copāsanāśrayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradaṃ tadā ।। 101 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bṛhadvarcānṛpāt tāpītīre gṛhītaghorapratigraheṇa kṛṣṇakadrūpatā gatānāṃ sahasraviprāṇāṃ suratāyanarṣiyoga ityādinirūpaṇanāmā
saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 77 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 077 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 78
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 079 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
yajjñānaṃ pradadau śrīmatsuratāyanayogirāṭ ।
brāhmaṇebhyastu tajjñānaṃ rādhe te kathayāmi ca ।। 1 ।।
rādhe pūrvaṃ mayā dattaṃ suratāyanayogine ।
tadeva te'tra saṃvacmi lokānāṃ hitakṛd yataḥ ।। 2 ।।
suratāyanaviprarṣiḥ prāha śṛṇuta bhūsurāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmīśvareśvaraḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre saurāṣṭramaṇḍale ।
yo vai sākṣātparabrahma paramātmā pareśvaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarvaśaktisamāyuktaḥ pāpināṃ pāpanāśakaḥ ।
taṃ devaṃ parameśānaṃ yāta śaraṇamuttamam ।। 5 ।।
bhaktyā tvananyayā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇamarcayata dhruvam ।
dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva saḥ ।। 6 ।।
prāpyaḥ śrīparameśāno yāta taṃ śaraṇaṃ dvijāḥ ।
dānadharmātmakaṃ karma yadyadvarṇāśramātmakam ।। 7 ।।
adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye bhavati dvijāḥ ।
mayā dharmaḥ purā prokto brahmavidyātmakaḥ paraḥ ।। 8 ।।
sarvārpaṇe mayi kṣipte kartā kvacinna lipyate ।
dharmo jñānaṃ dāsyabhaktiḥ paraṃ brahma prakāśayet ।। 9 ।।
sarvasaṃgān parityajya tameva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ।
upāsate sadā bhaktyā yogamaiśvaramāsthitāḥ ।। 2.78.1 0।।
sarvasaṃgavinirmuktāḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ ।
amānino harau sarvasamarpaṇāstadarthakāḥ ।। 1 1।।
taccittāstadgataprāṇāstajjñānakathane ratāḥ ।
sarvanyāsā harau nāryo narā vā bālayauvanāḥ ।। 12।।
teṣāṃ bandhanahartā vai parameśo hariḥ svayam ।
te sunirdhūtatamaso jñānenaikena tanmayāḥ ।। 13।।
sadānandāstu saṃsāre na jāyante punarbhavāḥ ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā yāntu taṃ śaraṇaṃ dvijāḥ ।। 14।।
bālyaṃ tu sarvadā rakṣyaṃ garbhāvasthā ca yoginā ।
yathā bālye ca vā garbhe vāsanā vāñcchanā tṛṣā ।। 15।।
īhā tṛṣṇā rāgitā ca vartante naiva śākhivat ।
tathaiva yauvane cāpi vārdhakye stheyameva ca ।। 16।।
yathā suṣupto vijño'pi jñapteḥ phalaṃ na caiti hi ।
tathā viprāḥ sadā stheyaṃ jñāne'pi munitā yathā ।। 17।।
yathā tvanyamanaskasya nendriyagrāhyavedanam ।
tathā kṛṣṇamanaskasya vṛttirviprasya muktaye ।। 18।।
yathā bālaḥ pṛthivyāstu mṛdamādāya limpati ।
na śokaṃ vā'pi harṣaṃ ca bahu tatraiva manyate ।। 19।।
tathā sarvāṇi vastūni kriyā vyāpāragocarāḥ ।
tasmin deve viniḥkṣipya mṛttikāpiṇḍavad budhaḥ ।।2.78.20 ।।
saṃgṛhyā'pi na śokaṃ vā harṣaṃ nindeta tatrahi ।
tadā tatphalaveditvaṃ nā'syā'tīva pravartate ।।2 1 ।।
aveditve na bhoktṛtvaṃ kaśmalaṃ nopajāyate ।
nityaśuddhasya yā niṣkalmaṣatā muktireva sā ।।22।।
viṣayāśca śarīraṃ ca tathendriyāṇi mānasam ।
vijñātavyaṃ pṛthak cāpi tata ātmā nivartate ।।23 ।।
kartā vai bandhanaṃ yāti yadi teṣu prasajjate ।
asaṅgaḥ sajjate naiva bandhanaṃ naiva yāti ca ।।24।।
viṣayāstu yathā dūraṃ vartante vasturūpiṇaḥ ।
na te santi sahalagnā na cedātmā'tra sajjate ।।25।।
udyānasthāni puṣpāṇi madhuvantyapi ṣaṭpade ।
na bhavanti pralagnāni madhoḥ sthānaṃ na yānti te ।।26।।
tathā te viṣayāḥ sarve nā''vṛṇvanti pravedinam ।
ātmānaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmād bandhayitavyameva na ।।27।।
śūlikāgṛhamābadhya kīṭī vasati tadgṛhe ।
gṛhaṃ cā''kṛṣya nityaṃ sā yatra tatra prayāti hi ।।28।।
ante gṛhaṃ śarīraṃ ca sarvaṃ nāśaṃ prayāti vai ।
ityeṣā jñānahīnā tadgṛhaṃ nītvā tu bhūtale ।।29।।
baddhā sarvatra aṭati tadvad dehasya bandhanam ।
ajñā baddhā cā'pyaṭanti dehaṃ nītvā sthale sthale ।।2.78.30।।
tajjaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi pratikṣaṇaṃ pravartate ।
yoginastu prabhāvajñāḥ saṃyamena śarīrakam ।।3 1 ।।
ekatrāpi vihāyaiva lokāntare'bhiyānti hi ।
na teṣāṃ bandhanaṃ kvāpi dṛḍhaṃ dehasya vartate ।।32।।
punarāgatya ca tatra vāsaṃ kurvanti cecchayā ।
pakṣiṇo vṛkṣaśākhāyāṃ vasanti vāsamātriṇaḥ ।।33।।
na śākhā bandhanaṃ teṣāṃ viyantyapi vihāya tām ।
tathā dehe nivāso'pi pakṣivanmuktavat kṛtaḥ ।। 34।।
bandhanāya na jāyeta jīrṇacarmeva bhoginaḥ ।
indriyāṇi bhavantyeva dehāśrayāṇi sarvathā ।।35।।
samanaskāni bandhāya nirmanaskāni muktaye ।
mānasaṃ yojayitavyaṃ bhaved yāvatprayojanam ।।36।।
pratyāhartavyamevaitanniṣprayojanakaṃ yadā ।
tadendriyāṇi naiva syurbaddhāni bandhadāni ca ।।37।।
pratyāhṛtaṃ manaścāpi nirbaddhaṃ bandhakṛnna vai ।
buddhiryā sākṣiṇī sā'pi patiṃ cātmānamāśrayet ।।38।।
na tu putraṃ manaścāpi putratulyendriyāṇyapi ।
navā dāsān viṣayāँśca kadāpi sādhvikā''śrayet ।।39।।
buddhernairmalyamevaitad yadatrā'pratibimbanam ।
evaṃ pravāharodhe ca svayamātmā prakāśate ।।2.78.40।।
avraṇaścā'naghaścāpyakalmaṣaḥ pāpavarjitaḥ ।
phalabhāvā'pralubdhaścā'saṃgo mukto na duḥkhabhāk ।।41 ।।
nirdvandvaṃ mānasaṃ yatra buddhistatra hi nirmalā ।
gṛhiṇī nirmalā yatra gṛheśastatra modate ।।42।।
svasampatsu sadā tṛpto nānyasampadamicchati ।
kasmācchokaśca mohaśca tato'sya natu jāyate ।।43 ।।
ātmatṛptasya tu sadānandatṛptasya yoginaḥ ।
atyantatṛptasaṃyogaḥ svabhāvādvai pravartate ।।44।।
tenā'yaṃ mokṣavannityaṃ yāti tiṣṭhati modate ।
ānandapūrṇatāṃ jñātvā pareśvarasya sarvathā ।।45।।
tatraiva sajjate samyaṅnānyasaktiṃ samicchati ।
vṛttayaḥ kuṇṭhitā yasya buddhistṛptyātmikā'bhavat ।।46।।
gṛhiṇī sukhadā yasya tasya mokṣo gṛhe sthitaḥ ।
gṛhiṇī duḥkhadā yasya tasya vai narakaṃ gṛhe ।।47।।
tasmāt sā gṛhiṇī buddhiḥ sarvanairmalyasādhanaiḥ ।
samprasannayitavyā'tra yayā rājā prasādavān ।।48।।।
nityaprasādalābhārthaṃ yateta paramātmani ।
yatra karma na caivā'sti na cā'sti bhogyabhoktṛtā ।।49।।
tadyogena tathā syācca ghoratāvarjito bhavet ।
nityānandahrade magnaḥ kiṃ tasya kardamena vai ।।2.78.50।।
śvetā'śvataranāmā vai āsīd brahmarṣisattamaḥ ।
tasya śiṣyaḥ pṛthoḥ pautraḥ putraḥ sa tu śikhaṇḍinaḥ ।।51।।
suśīlanāmā cābālyād vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ।
matiṃ cakre bhāgyayogāt sanyāsaṃ prati dharmavit ।।52।।
guroḥ sevāṃ karotyeva himavatpṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaḥ ।
dharmavane sthito yatra naranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।53 ।।
yatra mandākinī nāma supuṇyā vimalānadī ।
padmotpalavanopetā siddhasādhuniṣevitā ।।54।।
tasyāḥ sa salile snātvā tarpitvā pitṛdevatāḥ ।
arcayitvā narayuktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ supuṣpakaiḥ ।।55।।
śvetāśvatarasaṃjñaṃ tu guruṃ natvaikadā''ha ca ।
aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ tapāṃsi saphalāni me ।।56।।
yanme bhavādṛśaḥ sākṣāt sarvajña iva sadguruḥ ।
jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ ca naiṣkarmyaṃ sanyāsaṃ dehi me prabho ।।57।।
ityuktaḥ sa gururdevo dadau sanyāsamuttamam ।
samyaṅnyāsaḥ karmaṇāṃ yo'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।।58।।
sarvasamarpaṇaṃ prādāt prapattyātmakamityatha ।
ācacakṣe mahāmantraṃ kṛṣṇasya sarvasiddhaye ।।59।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvasāraṃ pramuktidam ।।2.78.60।।
jñānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ cāpi dadau suśīlabhūbhṛte ।
mayi nārāyaṇaścā'sti nārāyaṇe'pyahaṃ sthitaḥ ।।6 1।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaśceti nārāyaṇo'hameva ca ।
evaṃ brahmasthiterjñānaṃ dadau tu prathamaṃ guruḥ ।।62।।
tataḥ prāha na dehastvaṃ deho nendriyarūpavān ।
indriyāṇi mano naiva mānasaṃ na mahat tathā ।।63।।
mahattattvaṃ na cātmā vai nātmā māyātmakaḥ kvacit ।
māyā nātmasvarūpā ca tvadātmā pārameśvaraḥ ।।64।।
nārāyaṇastvadātmā ca tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇo mataḥ ।
nārāyaṇo hi nirlepaḥ karmabandhanavarjitaḥ ।।65।।
nityaṃ śuddhastathā buddho mukto māyāvivarjitaḥ ।
evaṃ matvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ bhaja śrīparameśvaram ।।66 ।।
prātaḥ snānaṃ nije dehe pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya ।
vastrādhānaṃ nije dehe pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya ।।67।।
bhūṣādhānaṃ candanādi pareśānaṃ vidhāpaya ।
ārārtrikādidānaṃ ca svadehe tasya vartaya ।।68।।
naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhi ca ।
svadehe taṃ pareśāna sampādaya śarīriṇam ।।6 9 ।।
upānatpādukāchatrapradānaṃ svasya varṣmaṇi ।
tasmai parātmane sarvayānādyarpaya bhāvataḥ ।।2.78.70।।
darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāpi sparśanaṃ rasanādikam ।
kāmanaṃ snehanaṃ dehe prabhave pratipādaya ।।71 ।।
śayanaṃ gamanaṃ vārtā bodhanaṃ mananaṃ tathā ।
hasanaṃ rodanaṃ codvejanaṃ tasmai samarpaya ।।72।।।
viśramaṇaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ skhalanaṃ mādanaṃ tathā ।
ramaṇaṃ dhyānakaraṇaṃ dehe devāya cārpaya ।।73 ।।
jṛmbhaṇaṃ drāvaṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ kāryaṃ vicāraṇam ।
vivekaṃ śvasanaṃ bhaktiṃ dehe śrīpataye'rpaya ।।74।।
evaṃ kriyākalāpaṃ te bhautikaṃ sūkṣmamātrikam ।
karaṇotthaṃ bhāvanotthaṃ tasmin kṛṣṇe samarpaya ।।75।।
ātmodbhava kalāpaṃ ca parameśe samarpaya ।
so'yaṃ sannyāsa evā'sti nirbandho muktiśabditaḥ ।।76।।
tatphalaṃ ca tvayā naiva bhoktavyaṃ haraye'rpitam ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya karma divyaṃ samastakam ।।77।।
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca tṛṣṇā prītiḥ ratiḥ kṣatiḥ ।
ghṛṇā krauryaṃ ca mālinyaṃ divyaṃ haryarpaṇaṃ yataḥ ।।78।।
ayaṃ sannyāsa evā'sti vaiṣṇavaḥ pāramārthikaḥ ।
tatrasthaṃ kalmaṣaṃ puṇyaṃ nainaṃ vā paribādhate ।।79।।
evaṃ suśīlaḥ kṛtavān badaryāṃ tapa ācaran ।
bhajan devamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।2.78.80।।
āyuḥkṣaye paraṃdhāmā'vāpa vigatakalmaṣaḥ ।
divyanārāyaṇarūpo babhūvā'yaṃ caturbhujaḥ ।।81।।
tathaiva tu dvijā yūyaṃ bhajatainaṃ narāyaṇam ।
tāpītaṭe vaiṣṇavena yajñena vigatajvarāḥ ।।82।।
ityayaṃ bhagavāṃstuṣṭo haniṣyatyapi kalmaṣam ।
evamuktāstu te viprāścakruryajñaṃ suvaiṣṇavam ।।83।।
tapatyāḥ sattaṭe tatra candanadrumasaṃkule ।
saptame divase homāvasāne bālarūpakaḥ ।।84।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt samāgataḥ ।
prasanno'smītyuvācaitān varaṃ vṛṇuta bhūsurāḥ ।।85।।
viprā vilokya mukteśaṃ koṭisūryaprabhāsvaram ।
nemustaṃ tuṣṭuvurvavrurdānaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam ।।86।।
ante dhāma paraṃ dehi darśanaṃ cāśvasārasam ।
dāsyaṃ dehi sadā cetyarthayitvā maunamādadhuḥ ।।87।।
tathā'stviti prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hasan hariḥ ।
sasmāra cāśvinīputrau vaidyau rūpapradau prabhū ।।88।।
sūryaputrāvakasmācca tatrā''gatau suvarculau ।
surūpau yauvanopetau bhūṣāmukuṭamaṇḍitau ।।89।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇau kaustubhānvitau ।
śrīramāsevitau kṛṣṇaṃ nematustau narāyaṇam ।।2.78.90।।
vavandāte śrīhariṃ ca kiṃ kurvaḥ śādhi nāviha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha kṛpābharaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
viprā ghorapratigrahādime kalmaṣatāṃ gatāḥ ।
yathā niṣkalmaṣā syuste kurutaṃ vai tathauṣadham ।।92।।
śrutvaiva cāśvinībālau praṇamya parameśvaram ।
āhaturbhagavan sarvaṃ kartuṃ cāsi svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।93।।
avatāraiḥ prapūjyastvaṃ vartase parameśvaraḥ ।
saṃkalpe te mahāsṛṣṭisthitikṣaiṇyādyavasthitiḥ ।।94।।
tathāpi kṛpayā sevāṃ kārayituṃ smṛtau ca nau ।
nānyadatrauṣadhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tava pādāmṛtaṃ vinā ।।95।।
kādrūpyaṃ kalmaṣāṇyeṣāṃ layameṣyati pajjalāt ।
ityuktvā ca tato'śvinyā bālau naijaṃ kamaṇḍalum ।।96।।
tāpījalena saṃbhṛtvā śrīhareḥ pādapaṃkaje ।
prakṣālyā'nyakalaśe taddhṛtvā tatrauṣadheḥ rasam ।।97।।
cikṣipatuḥ svalpamātraṃ pāyayāmāsaturdvijān ।
prokṣayāmāsatuścāpi yāvattāvattu te dvijāḥ ।।98।।
pānāt pāpavihīnāśca sañjātā bhāsvarā drutam ।
kṛṣṇavarṇo gato nāśaṃ svarṇavarṇāstadā'bhavan ।।99।।
saṃprokṣaṇāttu kādrūpyaṃ naṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇāntare ।
pūrvavadrūpavantaste sañjātā brahmavarculāḥ ।। 2.78.1 00।।
devavaddivyavadanāḥ pūrvato'bhyadhikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
ityevaṃ hariṇā teṣāṃ pāpaṃ prajvālitaṃ kṣaṇāt ।। 10 1।।
tāpītaṭe kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tīrthaṃ divyaṃ vyadhāddhariḥ ।
yatraite pāvitā viprāstattīrthaṃ paramaṃ śubham ।। 1 02।।
babhūva khyātamaśvinīkumāratīrthamuttamam ।
śrīhariryatra vai tasthau sasnau tapatīvāriṣu ।। 1 03।।
haritīrthaṃ ca tajjātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।
anye devā darśanārthaṃ tatrāyātāstathā jale ।। 1 04।।
sasnustatra ca tīrthāni sañjātāni hyanekaśaḥ ।
tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā mṛtā'sthikṣepaṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 05।।
kṛtvā muktimavāpyeta mahāpāpo'pi mānavaḥ ।
atha viprā hareḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ kumārayoḥ ।। 106 ।।
vavanduśca kṣamāṃ tatra yayācire muhurmuhuḥ ।
niṣkalmaṣāḥ sthāpayitvā tvaśvinībālakau tadā ।। 1 07।।
śrīhariṃ saṃpratiṣṭhāpya yayurgehān hi rādhike ।
ityevaṃ phālgune tatra viprarakṣāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 1 08।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpanāśo dhruvaṃ bhavet ।
tapatīsnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhecchrutvā'pi mānavaḥ ।। 1 09।।
aśvinībālakau devā adṛśyatāṃ tato gatāḥ ।
śrīhariḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ kṣaṇāt samāyayau ।। 2.78.11 0।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suratāyanarṣikṛtopadeśaḥ, prabhoḥ prāvirbhāvo'śvinīkumārayorāgamanaṃ viprāṇāṃ niṣkalmaṣīkaraṇaṃ sannyāsaspaṣṭatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 78 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 078 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 79
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 080 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike viprāḥ svasthālayaṃ gatā api ।
camatkāraṃ divārātrau cintayanti sma taṃ prabhum ।। 1 ।।
darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ yacca tajjātaṃ sulabhaṃ yadā ।
suratāyanayogena tāvadārabhya caiva te ।। 2 ।।
paśyanti paramātmānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ dṛgantike ।
svapne paśyanti satataṃ suṣuptau na nivartate ।। 3 ।।
ekavāraṃ hi dṛṣṭasya divyā mūrtiḥ ramāpateḥ ।
satataṃ hṛdaye'gādhe nihitā na nivartate ।। 4 ।।
bahukālābhyāsalabdhā dṛḍhā yathā prakāśate ।
iyameva kṛpā tasya vinā'bhyāsaṃ pradarśanam ।। 5 ।।
athā''yāte puṇyakāle cāturmāsye tu bhūsurāḥ ।
tāpīnīre tu tattīrthe snātuṃ cāyayurutsukāḥ ।। 6 ।।
te sarve militāḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
sasmaruḥ svarakṣakaṃ taṃ mahākalmaṣanāśanam ।। 7 ।।
sammilitvā devaśayanyekādaśyāṃ ca bhūsurāḥ ।
pracakrurvai nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ nārāyaṇasya ha ।। 8 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa cāntarātman hare parabrahma śriyaḥ pate prabho ।
sarvāvatāreśvara bālakṛṣṇa gopālakṛṣṇātmaja kambharājane ।। 9 ।।
rādheśa lakṣmīśa rameśa padmāpate prabhākānta ca tūlasīpate ।
vṛndāpate pāravatīpate śrīpate jagatkānta ca māṇikīpate ।। 2.79.1 0।।
haṃsāpate mañjulikāpate śrīdayāpate śrīlalitāpate pate ।
ūrjāpate śrīsaguṇāpate kasturīpate śāntipate jayāpate ।। 1 1।।
jaya cākṣarapara puruṣottama jaya mukteśvara sarvottama ।
jaya parameśvara ātmottama jaya sākṣinnavatārottama ।। 12।।
jaya bhagavan jaya ātmārāma jaya nirguṇa jaya vai niṣkāma ।
pāhi sadā tava bhaktajanān kalmaṣanāśaka śrībhagavān ।। 13।।
evaṃ te kīrtanaṃ cakrustapatyā dakṣiṇe taṭe ।
tallīnāḥ sambabhūvuśca tālavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ ।। 14।।
tāvattatra prakāśo'bhūt madhye vimānamuttamam ।
tatra saṃrājate śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ prasevitaḥ ।। 15।।
ṣoḍaśapārṣadaiḥ sarve dadṛśustaṃ pareśvaram ।
sadratnanaddhahārālīrājadvakṣaḥsthalottamam ।। 16।।
sauvarṇamaṇiratnādinaddhamukuṭamaṇḍitam ।
makarākārasauvarṇakuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitam ।। 17।।
prānte cañcatsūkṣmapiṅgakeśaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ suśobhitam ।
viśālabhāle vahnyābhakauṃkumatilakānvitam ।। 18।।
koṭikāmakṛtā''vāsabhrakuṭidvayarājitam ।
mīnacañcalaraktāntāyatanetravirājitam ।। 19।।
mandahāsojjvalakāntiparidhyakṣaraśobhitam ।
praphullatilasumanonāsikā'bhyatiśobhitam ।।2.79.20।।
kṛṣṇabiddhīkṛtasthānadakṣagālātisundaram ।
tejaḥsaratprabhābhāsigolagaṇḍavirājitam ।।21 ।।
suvarṇasūkṣmasattantunibhaśmaśrusurekhakam ।
dhanuḥkammānikākārākṛtyūrdhvauṣṭhātikarṣakam ।।22।।
miṣṭāmṛtātisaṃbhṛtaraktā'dharamanoharam ।
susūkṣmakṛṣṇabindvyāḍhyacibukahanūsaubhagam ।। 23।।
viśālabhālasaṃrājaddīrgharekhaikasaubhagam ।
śaṣkulīcakravadramyakarṇadvayātibhāsuram ।।24।।
sūryacandrātisaṃśobhipremaśevadhinetrakam ।
sarvasaundaryaśamaśrīsamāśritamukhottamam ।।25।।
koṭyaiśvaryakṛtasthānabhramaradvayarājitam ।
kundakalipayaḥphenanibhadantātimohakam ।।26।।
viśālaprāntahāsyāḍhyānanakoṇahṛdaṃgamam ।
sūkṣmagartikayā gaṇḍe mātṛvātsalyadarśakam ।।27।।
śvetacakṣurjanyatejo'bhibhūtānyāvalokanam ।
śaṃbhuryasya sthitaḥ kaṇṭhe śaṃkhaḥ kṛkāṭikāsthitaḥ ।।28।।
kaustubho hṛdaye yasya vanamālāsahāyakṛt ।
kṛṣṇabinduśca vai yasya kaṇṭhamadhye prabhāsate ।।29।।
kaṇṭhakūpe vāyucakraṃ samvatsarāśritaṃ sthitam ।
kaṇṭhasya valaye yasya tvakṣaraṃ brahma bhāsate ।।2.79.3 0।।
hṛdaye guṇaśūnyo vai hāraścarmaṇi cāmpakaḥ ।
bhramaraḥ śrīnivāsākhyo dakṣāvarto'sya rājate ।।3 1।।
śārdūlaskandhasadṛśadṛḍhaskandhau hareḥ śubhau ।
bhogibhogasamo pīnau mṛdulau subhujau hareḥ ।।32।।
kaumudīpaṭasaṃchannāvujjvalau netra hārakau ।
kukṣau kṛṣṇapiśaṃgābhau stabakau romasaṃkulau ।।33।।
dṛṣṭau darśakabhaktasya janyete snehabhāvanām ।
svarṇavarṇau bhujau ramyau campakābhe bhujāntare ।। 34।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacihnāni bāhujāni ca ।
prakoṣṭhayostrirekhāśca kare dakṣe śubhāni ca ।।35।।
matsyatriśūlanārācaketusvastidhanūṃṣi ca ।
rekhācihnāni ramyāṇi aṣṭacakrāṇi santi tu ।।36।।
vajraṃ cāpi śatrunāśakaraṃ vidyata ityapi ।
paṃkajābhe karatale virājete samujjvale ।।37।।
nakhā bhānti yathā candrāḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ ।
udaraṃ trivaliśobhaṃ nābhirvijñānaśevadhiḥ ।।38।।
jaghanaṃ śrīpratimāḍhyaṃ liṃgaṃ kāmasamāśrayam ।
kaṭirnakṣatramāleva rājate paritaḥ śubhā ।।39।।
nitambau projjvalau ramyau sakhīmānasarañjanau ।
sakthimūle śubhravarṇe tejovyāpte'tisundare ।।2.79.40।।
raśanā kaṭibhāge ca vartate svarṇanirmitā ।
ūrmikā aṃgulisthānāḥ śṛṃkhalā bhujabandhane ।।41।।
kaṭake kānake cāpi prakoṣṭhe bāhubhāgayoḥ ।
sakthnormadhye'kṣarabrahmojjvalaṃ tejaḥ pravartate ।।42।।
vāme sakthini mūlācca hyadhaścihnaṃ tu kailakam ।
sakthnaścopari lakṣmyāśca cihnaṃ pāṇḍuravarṇakam ।।43।।
hastatalāyataṃ ramyaṃ yatra muhyanti yoginaḥ ।
jānū ramyau vartulau ca ramaṇīyau hareḥ śubhau ।।44।।
jaṅghe padmaprabhe ramye romāvalisamanvite ।
kadalīkandasaṃśobhe sakthinī śītale śubhe ।।45।।
pādau kammānikāsaṃsthau kamalodarasannibhau ।
ṣoḍaśādicihnayuktau tathordhvarekharājitau ।।46 । ।
śikharaṃ kalpavallī ca cakraṃ ca yānamityapi ।
saudhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hastīśca turagaścandrakastathā ।।47।।
garuḍo haṃsaityādicihnitau pādapaṃkajau ।
svarṇaromāvalirājatpādordhvabhāgaśobhitau ।।48।।
ājānubāhuyugalaṃ pādāṅgulī pralambinī ।
saumyamūrtistathā tejovyāptā divyā hyabhūcchubhā ।।49 ।।
etādṛśo mandahāsyaṃ vimuñcan bhagavān hariḥ ।
avātatāra viprāṇāṃ madhye vimānato hariḥ ।।2.79.50।।
viprā nemuḥ pādayośca tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।
prasannamānasāḥ sarve babhūvurdarśanādati ।।51।।
suratāyanasaṃjño'pi maharṣiḥ śrīhariṃ tadā।
āgatya candanavṛkṣāt pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।52।।
aho bhāgyaṃ punarnastu yaddharerdarśanaṃ gṛhe ।
ityuktvā''luṇṭhanaṃ cakre pādayoḥ śrīharestadā ।।5 3 ।।
pupūjurbhāvapūrṇāśca viprāḥ sarve'pi vai muhuḥ ।
te sarve kṛtakāryāśca tīrthavidhānavedinaḥ ।।54।।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ śrīhariṃ sannidhau sthitāḥ ।
darśanaṃ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrasya kāraya prabho ।।55 ।।
iti stuto hariḥ prāhā'śvinīkumāratīrthake ।
punaḥ snātvā mayā sākaṃ vimānamadhiruhya ca ।।56 ।।
samāgacchantu me kṣetraṃ bhavanto mama sevakāḥ ।
tataste hariṇā sārdhaṃ snātvā'śvinīkumārake ।।57।।
suratāyanamukhyāśca niṣedustadvimānake ।
hariḥ sarvān saha nītvā pathā vaihāyasena tu ।।58।।
pañcasāhasraviprādyairāyayau dinamātrataḥ ।
akhātaṃ tu samullaṃghya śatruñjitānadīmukham ।।5 9 ।।
tatra tān snāpayitvā ca prayayau gopanāthakam ।
tattīrthe kārayitvā ca mūlasvarṇapurīṃ yayau ।।2.79.6 0।।
tattīrthaṃ tu vinirvartya somanāthaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
bhadrābdhisaṃgame snātvā camatkārapuraṃ yayuḥ ।।6 1 ।।
devikāyāṃ kṛtatīrthā vanasthalīnivāsinaḥ ।
prārthayāñcakruratyarthaṃ pāvayituṃ vanasthalīm ।।6 2।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svīkṛtya cārthanām ।
cāndre tu śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇe pañcamyāṃ ravivāsare ।।6 3 ।।
vanasthalīṃ yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ svayam ।
bhaktān sarvān pāvayitvā bhojayitvā prasādakam ।।64।।
dadau tebhyaścopadeśaṃ bhavapārakaraṃ param ।
śṛṇvantu mama bhaktā ye sarvārpaṇaṃ vinā mayi ।।65 ।।
pāpapuṇyādibhogānāmanto nāyāti vai kvacit ।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇasteṣāṃ sarvārpaṇavidhāyinām ।।66 ।।
svayaṃ karomi nairmalyaṃ nayāmi mama dhāma tān ।
naro nārī bālakaśca bālā vā ṣaṇḍha ityapi ।।67।।
mamā'nugrahaleśena bhavanti mokṣiṇo drutam ।
tasmād bhajantu māṃ prītyā kurvantvatra sumandiram ।।68।।
matpratimāṃ sthāpayantu bhajantāṃ satataṃ ca mām ।
ahaṃ coddhārakṛccāsmi bhavatāṃ śaraṇārthinām ।।6 9 ।।
ityuktvā''diśya bhūmiṃ ca pradatvā caraṇāmṛtam ।
nāśayitvā bhavarogān rogāṃśca rogiṇāṃ tathā ।।2.79.70।।
vanasthalīṃ pāvayitvā narān nārīḥ śubhāśiṣā ।
yojayitvā svabhaktau ca datvā caraṇavāri ca ।।71।।
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ datvā pādasevāṃ pragṛhya ca ।
kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya samāruhya vimānake ।।72।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa ca yayau śubhaṃ saurāṣṭrapattanam ।
yatrā'yaṃ vartate śrīmallakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।73।।
svayaṃ svarāṭ mahāśobhe prāsāde suviśālake ।
rājate dugdhaśuklābho yuvā hāsyabharo hariḥ ।।74।।
saurāṣṭrīyaprajānāṃ ca pratimārūpavān prabhuḥ ।
bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo yogināṃ narayoṣitām ।।75।।
divyasuvarṇakalaśaiḥ śobhamāne mahālaye ।
vartamānāṃ nijāṃ mūrtiṃ saṃspṛśyā''bhāṣya ca priyām ।।76।।
lakṣmīṃ jagatāṃ jananīṃ dharmaṃ bhaktiṃ vilokya ca ।
sūryaṃ śeṣapraśāyaṃ ca dattātreyaṃ śivaṃ vidhim ।।77।।
hanudāsaṃ gaṇadāsaṃ samāśliṣya tato hariḥ ।
yayau vaihāyasā śubhravimānena kṣaṇottaram ।।78।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
udyāne cāndane tatra vimānaṃ sthāpya mādhavaḥ ।।79।।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ ramyaṃ vimānasthānadarśayat ।
aśvataṭākasalile snāpayitvā ca tairthikān ।।2.79.80।।
lomaśasya guroḥ ramyaṃ kārayitvā ca darśanam ।
koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ kārṣṇānāṃ cāpi darśanam ।।81 ।।
kārayitvā yayau kṛṣṇo naijaṃ prāsādamuttamam ।
darśayāmāsa jananīṃ kambharāśrīṃ mahāsatīm ।।82।।
tathā svapitaraṃ devaṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
sāptabhaume nijyaṃ hastyāsanaṃ prādarśayat prabhuḥ ।।83 ।।
ātithyaṃ kṛtavāँsteṣāṃ bhojanaṃ vāsanaṃ tathā ।
athā''tithyottaraṃ sarve viśaśramuśca te tadā ।।84।।
viśāle tadvimāne tu niśāṃ ninyuḥ samutsukāḥ ।
prātaḥ snānavidhiṃ kṛtvā vavanduḥ parameśvaram ।।85।।
kanyāśataṃ daduste tu śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmane ।
lomaśasyāśrame tāśca rakṣayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।।86 ।।
tato yātā mānitāśca tairthikāste nijaṃ gṛham ।
vimānena samaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇena vai saha ।।87।।
prāpayya tān harirdeśān ṣaṣṭhyāṃ punaḥ samāyayau ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ divyaṃ cākṣarabhūpadam ।।88।।
ityevaṃ darśanaṃ datvā kārayitvā ca tīrthakam ।
vimānena nijān deśān prāpayitvā kṛpāmayaḥ ।।89।।
bhagavānakarod rādhe bhaktamānasapūrṇatām ।
kṛpāsādhyaḥ svayaṃ tasmādanādipuruṣottamaḥ ।।2.79.90 ।।
na vratairna ca vā dānairna vā havanakarmabhiḥ ।
kintu sādhyapremabhaktyā nāmabhaktyā samarpaṇaiḥ ।।91 ।।
bhajatāṃ sevakānāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vartate svayam ।
rādhike ca yathā varte sevāyāṃ tava sarvadā ।।92।।
goloke sevikā nānyā tvādṛśī me'sti bhāminī ।
sevikāyāstu sevāyāṃ kānto bhavati dāsavat ।।93 ।।
tathā śrībhagavāँścāpi sevakānāṃ kṛte sadā ।
bhūtvā'kasmāt sevakaśca rakṣaparaḥ prajāyate ।।94।।
sarvapūjā'dhikā pūjā sevā tanvā vidhīyate ।
tataḥ sevā mānasī ca dravyajā tu tataḥ parā ।।95।।
sarvātmanā'rpaṇaṃ sevā hyatulyā rādhike yataḥ ।
prasannatākarī bodhyā cānukūlyena vartanam ।।96।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastuṣyati dāsyataḥ ।
paraṃdhāma dadātyeva cānte śāśvatasaukhyadam ।।97।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ kāntāṃ patiṃ kuṭumbavardhanam ।
ārogyaṃ sampado lakṣmīṃ sutāṃ gāṃ mahiṣīṃ gajān ।। 98।।
aśvān dāsīḥ prajā dāsān pautrān svargān dadāti ca ।
ityetat kathito rādhe camatkāro harestava ।।99।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇātsmaraṇādapi ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavedante bhagavaccaraṇaṃ labhet ।। 2.79.1 00।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suratāyanādipañcasāhasraviprāṇāṃ kuṃkumavāpītīrthāgamanaṃ śubhopadeśaścetinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 79 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 079 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 80
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 081 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe camatkāro hareḥ paraḥ ।
tāritā duḥkhato bhaktā bhīmāsarittaṭe purā ।। 1 ।।
dakṣiṇe pauṃḍrakasaṃjñe pattane kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ ।
nāmnā baleśavarmā'bhūd rājā khaṇḍadharāpatiḥ ।। 2 ।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto yogakriyāviśāradaḥ ।
kapilasyā'bhavacchiṣyaḥ sāṃkhyajñānavivekavān ।। 3 ।।
bhīmātaṭe nātidūre parvate kapilāśrame ।
sāṃkhyānāṃ yogināṃ yogaṃ samāgamaṃ karoti saḥ ।। 4 ।।
yadāśrame purā devaḥ kapilastīrthayogakṛt ।
daśavarṣāṇi tatraiva tasthau ramye vane śubhe ।। 5 ।।
adribhāge'tiśubhage śāntide nirjane'male ।
tadā baleśavarmā'sau saṃsevya kapilaṃ munim ।। 6 ।।
prāptavān sāṃkhyayogau ca paramaiśvaryasampadaḥ ।
siddhīścā'dṛśyabhāvaṃ ca bahurūpabhavādikam ।। 7 ।।
kapilastu tathaiśvaryaṃ datvā yayau sthalāntaram ।
rājā nityaṃ samāyāti tadāśramaṃ vilokitum ।। 8 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā padaṃ tacca guruṃ saṃsmṛtya vai muhuḥ ।
prapūjya pīṭhametacca tato yogijanān parān ।। 9 ।।
sādhūn vane sthitāँścāpi natvā yāti nijaṃ gṛham ।
evaṃ karoti nityaṃ sa sāṃkhyayogaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 2.80.1 0।।
athaikadā vrataṃ kartuṃ rājā śrīkapilāśrame ।
samāyayau sapatnīkaḥ kārtike nyavasad bahiḥ ।। 1 1।।
vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya bhūśayānaḥ phalāśanaḥ ।
brahmacaryaparaḥ kṛcchravratasthitā ca tatpriyā ।। 12।।
ātithyadharmanirataścānnasatraprabandhanaḥ ।
nityaṃ homaparaścāpi sahasradīnabhojanaḥ ।। 13।।
dānadharmaparaścāturmāsyāntavratatatparaḥ ।
bahavaḥ sādhavastatra siddhāḥ sādhyaśca yoginaḥ ।। 14।।
yātriṇo vanavāsāśca samāyānti sadāvrate ।
annārthibhyo dadātyannaṃ vastrārthibhyastathā'mbaram ।। 15।।
pātrārthibhyaśca pātrāṇi dhanārthibhyo dhanāni ca ।
yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhaved yasyā'rthinastasmai tadiṣṭakam ।। 16।।
dadātyeva baleśaḥ sa dakṣiṇāṃ pradadāti ca ।
kārtike dhṛtavān śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ yo yatprayācate ।। 17।।
tattasmai sampradeyaṃ vai nakāro vācya eva na ।
rājñaḥ putro'bhavattatra dvādaśābdo'tikomalaḥ ।। 18।।
rājñī śīlavatī nāmnā pātivratyaṃ prarakṣati ।
putraśca puṇḍrako nāmnā brahmabhaktiṃ karoti hi ।। 19।।
trayaste lokasādhūnāṃ sevāparā bhavanti vai ।
tārakāyananāmā ca maharṣirvaiṣṇavo mahān ।।2.80.20 ।।
tatraiva vasati yogī yogadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।
vaihāyasagatirdivyaḥ kāmarūpadharo yatiḥ ।।2 1।।
aṣṭasiddhyāśrayaścāste sarvakāmānyavarjitaḥ ।
sa munirdhyānayogena jñātvā kuṃkumavāpikām ।। 22।।
sākṣādanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamāśritām ।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ gatvā kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇadarśanam ।। 23 ।।
gṛhītvā ca manuṃ mokṣapradaṃ śrīpatimādhavāt ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।24।।
jajāpa nityadā naijāśrame sthitvāntare sthale ।
nityaṃ vyomnā prage yāti cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।। 25।।
kṛtvā harerdarśanaṃ ca punaḥ prayāti cāśramam ।
tārakāyanasaṃjño'yaṃ maharṣirvyomato bhuvam ।।26।।
avātarat tadā rājā darśanārthaṃ yayau drutam ।
papraccha vinayī bhūtvā praṇatārtiharaṃ munim ।। 27।।
gamyate kva ṛṣe! nityaṃ prātaḥ kalyāṇakṛd yadi ।
jijñāsitaṃ tu me vācyaṃ yadi rodho na vidyate ।। 28।।
sādhūnāṃ saṃgatiḥ svargapradā mokṣapradā tathā ।
duḥkhanāśakārī cāpadvināśinī matā sadā ।।29।।
yogināmīśvarāṇāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ ca satāmapi ।
vihāro yatra tatrā'sti nārāyaṇo hi gocaraḥ ।।2.80.3 0।।
sādhūnāṃ caraṇaḥ pūjyo jalaṃ peyaṃ padāmṛtam ।
bhojyaṃ prāsādikaṃ teṣāṃ grāhyaṃ vaco mukhodbhavam ।।3 1 ।।
satāṃ sevā hareḥ sevā satāṃ saṃgo harerhi saḥ ।
satāṃ deho harerdehaḥ santo vai harimūrtayaḥ ।।32।।
santo dhyeyāḥ sadā dhyāne santo dhāryā sadā hṛdi ।
santaḥ sevyāḥ sarvadānaiḥ satsu harirvirājate ।।33।।
satāṃ dṛṣṭirharerdṛṣṭiḥ satāṃ sparśo harerhi saḥ ।
satāmāśleṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇāśleṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśakam ।।34।।
satāṃ pādarajo dhāryaṃ mastake hṛdi cānane ।
satāṃ pādajalaṃ dhāryaṃ mukhe śirasi vigrahe ।। 35। ।
satāṃ prasannatā prāpyā dehagehasutādibhiḥ ।
dhanasampatpradānaiśca svātmārpaṇena sarvathā ।।36।।
anityaḥ sarvathā deho rakṣito'pi vinaśyati ।
tena sevā sadā kāryā grāhyā prasannatā satām ।।37।।
yatrendriye ca viṣaye ruciḥ svasyā'tivegitā ।
tatrendriye hi kartavyā sevā tūbhayatuṣṭaye ।।38।।
sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye sākṣātparamātmā virājate ।
śubhāstasmāt kriyāḥ sarvāḥ satāmindriyadehajāḥ ।।39।।
santo divyāḥ kriyā divyā divyo dehaḥ satāṃ sadā ।
divyaścendriyavargaśca satāṃ divyā hi dhātavaḥ ।।2.80.40।।
satāṃ vicāro divyaśca buddhirdivyā satāṃ sadā ।
satāṃ svapnaṃ ca śayanaṃ ramaṇaṃ divyameva tat ।।41 ।।
satsu māyākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ vidyate naiva sarvathā ।
satsu puṇyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ parameśvaramāśritam ।।42।।
lepahīnaṃ sadā divyaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam ।
puṇyānāṃ khanayaḥ santaḥ pāpaleśo na yatra vai ।।43।।
tādṛśastvaṃ mune divyo vartase tārakāyana ।
yathā viṣṇustathā tvaṃ vai tārako'si bhavārṇavāt ।।44।।
vada te saṃgamāptebhyo naśca bhāgyaṃ hi no mahat ।
ityuktvā nṛpatistasthau pratikṣaँstadṛṣervacaḥ ।।45।।
taṃ tārakāyanaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan baleśvara ।
yo loke prathitaścāsti bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।46।।
parabrahma ca vede'sti sarvāvatāradhṛk prabhuḥ ।
paradhāmasthito yaḥ saḥ saurāṣṭre kambharāgṛhe ।।47।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre kuṃkumavāpikābhuvi ।
śrīmadgopālabālaḥ sa lomaśabhvāṃ virājate ।।48।।
yatra brahmapriyāḥ koṭyarbudābjapadmasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
sarvāśca śaktayastīrthakoṭayaḥ santi dehinaḥ ।।49।।
mānave pādape tārṇe tairyañce bhautike'pi ca ।
sarge brahmapriyā yatra tiṣṭhanti brahmalālasāḥ ।।2.80.50।।
muktā dhāmagatāścāpi bahudhāmanivāsinaḥ ।
pracchannā bhinnavarṣmāṇo yatra tiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ ।।5 1।।
taṃ prabhuṃ paramātmānaṃ draṣṭuṃ gacchāmi nityaśaḥ ।
prātaḥ sampūjya taṃ devaṃ pītvā taccaraṇāmbujam ।।।52।।
tatastīrthāni kṛtvaiva samāgacchāmi cāsanam ।
ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāha kadā taddarśanaṃ mama ।।53।।
bhaviṣyatīti me brahman vada sādho kṛpāṃ kuru ।
muniḥ prāha gṛhāṇainaṃ mantraṃ japaparo bhava ।।54।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
ityenaṃ rādhike mantraṃ datvā ca taulasīṃ srajam ।।।55।।
mahāvaiṣṇavasevyaṃ ca datvā hareḥ padāmṛtam ।
ṛṣiryayau nijāvāsaṃ rājā rājñī sutastataḥ ।।56।।
jepustaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ dhyāne babhūvurāsthitāḥ ।
sasmarustamanādiśrīkṛṣṇasvāminarāyaṇam ।।57।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇastu parīkṣārthaṃ hi bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
ājagāmā'tithirūpo madhyāhne bhojanottaram ।।58।।
saptame'hni kṛṣṇavarṇo lohavalayadhārakaḥ ।
raktākṣaḥ kaupīnamātravasano jaṃgalī yathā ।।59।।
prāha rājā tu taṃ vīkṣya samāyāhi vanecara ।
gṛhāṇa bhojanaṃ vāri tato yāhi yathāsukham ।।2.80.60।।
jaṃgamī prāha nocchiṣṭaṃ mayā vai bhujyate kvacit ।
nānyapakvaṃ ca bhuṃje'haṃ kathaṃ dadāsi bhojanam ।।6 1 ।।
ahaṃ vai jaṃgalī cāsmi bhojanaṃ tāmasaṃ mama ।
anyaprāṇisamutthaṃ tu nā'haṃ bhuṃje kadācana ।।62।।
yadi satyapratijño'si nakāro nocyate tvayā ।
dehi me bhojanaṃ rājan priyaṃ yacchāntidaṃ bhavet ।।63।।
nṛpaḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ te dātuṃ śakto'smi bhojanam ।
vada svaiṣṭaṃ dadāmyatra nā'deyaṃ me'tra vidyate ।।64।।
sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ vā'pi tāmasaṃ te'tra rocate ।
anyotthaṃ neṣyate cedve svotthaṃ vada dadāmi te ।।65।।
yacchaktaṃ tad dadāmyeva kārtikeyaṃ vrataṃ mama ।
dātavyameva labhyaṃ ced vada vanin dadāmi te ।।66।।
vanī prāha śṛṇu rājan māṃsādo'smi vane vasan ।
kārtike'pi mayā tvetadvrataṃ pālitameva ha ।।67।।
rājñaḥ putrasya māṃsaṃ vai mayā bhakṣyamayācitam ।
rājā yadi svayaṃ dadyāddhṛdayasyaiva netarat ।।68।।
ityevaṃ me vrataṃ tvāste raktaṃ peyaṃ ca hṛdgatam ।
naiva vāri prapeyaṃ ca vrataṃ me tāmasaṃ yataḥ ।।69।।
nā'haṃ yāce nṛpa tvatto vrataṃ mayā prakāśitam ।
yācanā naiva kartavyā vratabhaṃgakarī yataḥ ।।2.80.70।।
ityuktvā sa tataḥ sthānād vanaṃ prati vilokya ca ।
gantuṃ padakramān cakre yathā yāñcākaro na vai ।।71 ।।
rājñī prāha vilokyaiva vanin tiṣṭha sthiro bhava ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kurve cātitheḥ paramātmanaḥ ।।72।।
kṣaṇāntare dadātyeṣaḥ rājā tvadiṣṭabhojanam ।
āsanaṃ svīkuru tvetat kāmbalaṃ tiṣṭha śāntitaḥ ।।73 ।।
vanī prāha vrataṃ me'sti stheyaṃ vai kārtike sadā ।
kumārīkanyakāsakthi vivastraṃ cettu labhyate ।।74।।
tasyā ūrau mayā cāsītavyaṃ na tvanyathā kvacit ।
rājñī putrīṃ tadā prāha bhava putri śubhāsanam ।।75।।
kanyāḥ kṛṣṇā tathā bhīmā tuṃgabhadrā ca nāmataḥ ।
tisra āsaँśca tadrājñastisrastatra hyupasthitāḥ ।।76।।
kṛṣṇā vastraṃ parityajya dadau sakthi yathāsukham ।
niṣasāda vanī tatra dhyānamagno babhūva ha ।।77।।
putraḥ prāha pitaraṃ tu rājan śīghraṃ hi hṛnmama ।
bhittvā dehi pareśāyā'tithaye muktaye bhavet ।।78।।
kṣaṇād rājā tu khaṅgena dvedhā skandhāt kaṭiṃ prati ।
vibhidya putrahṛdayaṃ dadau raktaṃ hi tatkṣaṇe ।।79।।
tāvat kanyā dvitīyā'pi bhīmā vastraṃ vinā nijam ।
sakthi dadau vanine'tra vanī māṃsaṃ nidhāya ca ।।2.80.80।।
vubhuje ca papau raktaṃ tāvacca tuṅgabhadrikā ।
vivastrā vanino hastamūrau saṃskṛtya vai muhuḥ ।।81 ।।
mukhaṃ saṃskṛtya sakthnā ca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ muhuḥ ।
dehasammardanaṃ cāpi cakrustadvaninastadā ।।82।।
athotthāya pragantuṃ ca vanī yāvat samīhate ।
tāvadrājā dakṣiṇārthaṃ dadāti vacanaṃ śubham ।।83।।
vanī prāha vrataṃ me'sti yanmāṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ bhavet ।
tanmātā dakṣiṇāyāṃ vai grāhyā nānyat kadācana ।।84।।
vaninītyuktavatyeva rājñī śīghramupasthitā ।
eṣā'haṃ tava dāsyāsmi dakṣiṇāṃ svīkuru prabho ।।85।।
vanī tāṃ tvambaraśūnyāṃ kṛtvā vṛkṣatale'bhavat ।
ramaṇaṃ kṛtavān vyomni pṛthvīṃ caivā'spṛśan kṣaṇam ।।86 ।।
ākāśe tāṃ dhṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā vyatarkayat tadā ।
aho me paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ putrasya yoṣitastathā ।।87।।
kanyakānāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ haryarthe yojitā vayam ।
vanī vā syād vānaprastho vanecaro'vanecaraḥ ।।88।।
antarātmā haristṛpto'nityadehādito mama ।
anityaṃ nāśamāyāti parārthaṃ saphalaṃ yadi ।।89।।
kimasmātparamaṃ bhāgyaṃ yairhi tṛpyati mādhavaḥ ।
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ sarvaṃ me saphalaṃ kṛtam ।।2.80.90।।
āgatya vaninā cātra vratārthaṃ bhautikaṃ mama ।
nakārasyā'tra vai sthānaṃ na jātaṃ mama cānane ।।91।।
matpatnyā vā sutānāṃ vā putrasyeti jayo mama ।
dhanyāstāḥ putrikāścāpi dhanyaḥ putro'pi me priyaḥ ।।92।।
dhanyā rājñī ca me tvatra vrate naṃ nahi jagṛhuḥ ।
tārito'haṃ kuṭumbena satyaṃ kuṭumbakaṃ mama ।।93।।
atithyarthaṃ copayoge svīkāritaṃ svayaṃ śubham ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣā me vratenā'dya kare sthitāḥ ।।94।।
jitaṃ jaganmayā tvadya cātitheḥ kṛpayā khalu ।
evaṃ dhanyaṃ manyamānaḥ prasannamānaso'bhavat ।।95।।
tāvad rājñīṃ prabhuktvaiva vanī vṛkṣādayaḥ sthitaḥ ।
vanitvaṃ pravihāyaiva śrīlakṣmīrādhikāyutaḥ ।।96।।
dvibhujo'tha mahālakṣmyā yuto'dṛśyata vai tadā ।
mahāviṣṇudhṛtacchatro viṣṇudhṛtānnapātrakaḥ ।।97।।
bhojanaṃ saṃgrasan tatrā'dṛśyata pareśvaraḥ ।
koṭikandarpaśobhāḍhyaḥ koṭisūryasamojjvalaḥ ।।98।।
anantamuktasaṃstutyo devapitṛpravanditaḥ ।
īśvarairavatāraiśca pūjito bhūṣaṇairbhṛtaḥ ।। 99।।
koṭibrahmapriyāsevyaḥ paramākṣaravanditaḥ ।
divyavyomapare dhāmni rājamāno vilokitaḥ ।। 2.80.100।।
divyavimānamadhyasthagajāsanavirājitaḥ ।
divyaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāḍhyo hasan prema pradarśayan ।। 101 ।।
vīkṣate parito bhaktān rājānaṃ tatpriyāṃ satīm ।
kanyāstisro'tibhāvena mohayan mānasaṃ muhuḥ ।। 1 02।।
śrīhareḥ sannidhau tatra rājaputraḥ sthito'bhavat ।
divyo divyavibhūṣāḍhyo yathāpūrvākṛtiḥ śubhaḥ ।। 103 ।।
puṇḍrakaḥ prahasan pārśvāddhareḥ svapitaraṃ prati ।
samājagāma sahasā suptotthita ivā'malaḥ ।। 1 04।।
devā muktā īśvarāśca cakruḥ kusumavarṣaṇam ।
rājā tuṣṭāva bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne baleśvararājñaḥ kapilabhagavadyogena paramabhāgavatatvaṃ, tārakāyanamaharṣiyogena kārtikavrate parīkṣārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya
vanecararūpeṇā''gamanaṃ, rājñaḥ putraputrīstrīkuṭumbārpaṇena prabhordarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 80 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 080 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 81
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 082 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā yathā tuṣṭāva mādhavam ।
baleśvaro'tibhāvena śrīpatiṃ parameśvaram ।। 1 ।।
tvaṃ devadevo'si sadā parātmaँ
stvaṃ cākṣare dhāmni pare sthito'si ।
tvaṃ vai parabrahma pareśvaro'si
muktaikavandyo'kṣaravandya eva ।। 2 ।।
sarvā'vatārai itipūjanīyaścārādhanīyo'si yato'vatārī ।
sarvairapīśairabhivandanīyo vyūhaiḥ samārādhanatatparaiśca ।। 3 ।।
viṣṇusvarūpairapi pūjanīyo maheśavedhaḥprabhṛtiprathaiśca ।
suraistathā pitṛbhirarcanīyo diśāṃ prapālairmanujaiśca siddhaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
daityaistathā dānavapuṃgavaiścā'suraiśca rakṣobhirabhiṣṭutaśca ।
nāgaiścaraiścācaraprāṇibhiśca dhyeyo'sigupto'sihṛdisthitaścā। 5 ।।
tvaṃ vāmano'bhūrnarasiṃhako'bhūrnārāyaṇo'bhūrvṛṣaputrako'bhūḥ ।
tvaṃ viṣṇurūpo'pi ca haṃsarūpastvaṃ matsyarūpaḥ kamaṭhastathā'bhūḥ।। 6 ।।
tvaṃ kroḍarūpaḥ kapilasvarūpastvaṃ dattarūpaḥ paraśudhrako'bhūḥ ।
tvaṃ yajñarūpo ramaṇasvarūpaḥ kumārarūpo'śvamukhasvarūpaḥ ।। 7 ।।
devarṣirūpo'pinṛpasvarūpo vyāsasvarūpo'pi ca rādhikeśaḥ ।
jñānasvarūpaśca harisvarūpaḥ svāmisvarūpo'si patisvarūpaḥ ।। 8 ।।
pracchannarūpo'si baṭusvarūpo
gārhasthyarūpo'si vanastharūpaḥ ।
sādhusvarūpo'si satīsvarūpo
viprasvarūpo'si ca bāhujo'si ।। 9 ।।
tvaṃ vaiśyarūpo'sicasevako'si pativratādharmasurūpako'si ।
tvaṃ bhaktarakṣākaravatsalo'si tvaṃ mohinīrūpadharo'si nātha ।। 2.81.1 0।।
tvaṃ koṭirūpo'si guṇāśrayo'si
divyābhirāśīrbhirabhiprato'si ।
tvaṃ divyadeho'si parīkṣako'si
hyuddhārakartā'si ca naḥ prapāhi ।। 1 1।।
tvaṃ yācakastvaṃ sutabhakṣakaśca
tvaṃ rakṣako jīvada īkṣyate'tra ।
tvaṃ bhogyabhoktā ca vihārakartā
tva lepaśūnyo bhagavānihā'si ।। 1 2।।
kathaṃkṛtaṃ kiṃkṛtamatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena dyumatā tvayā vai ।
mayā'rpitaṃ tatsaphalaṃ tvayīha mayi prasanno bhava viśvamūrte ।। 13।।
dhanyā satī śīlavatī priyā te
tisro'pi dhanyāśca kumārikāste ।
dhanyaḥ kumārastava pauṇḍrakaśca
dhanyo baleśastava kiṃkaro'ham ।। 14।।
dhanyaṃ svarūpaṃ vanavāsinaste
dhanyā ratirvyomagatasya te ca ।
dhanyaṃ sutorau tava bhojanaṃ ca
dhanyaḥ kumārastava bhojyarūpaḥ ।। 15।।
dhanyo gurustārakayogivaryo
dhanyā ca bhīmātaṭabhūmikeyam ।
dhanyā kriyā 3 divyatamā tvadīyā
dhanyaṃ ca dhairye tava sevakānām ।। 16।।
samarpaṇaṃ dhanyatamaṃ sutasya
vrataṃ ca dhanyaṃ kumudasya māsaḥ ।
anādilakṣmīpatikṛṣṇanārā-
yaṇo'si dhanyo'tra ca kambharājaḥ ।। 17।।
gopālabālo'si ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhāpatiḥ pāravatīpatiśca ।
rādhāpatirmāṇikikāpatiśca śriyaḥ patirbhūpatirīśvareśaḥ ।। 18।।
haṃsāpatirmañjupatiḥ sureśo
māyāpatirvai saguṇāpatiśca ।
rūpaṃ tavedaṃ bahukoṭisūryaiḥ
samaṃ nirīkṣya sukhato na yadvai ।। 1 9।।
koṭyarkabhāsvadbahumuktayuktaṃ tathā'vatārairbahubhiḥ sametam ।
īśeśvaraiḥ pitṛsurādibhiśca daityaiśca nāgaiḥ parivāritaṃ ca ।।2.81.20।।
lakṣmyā śriyā rādhikayā yutaṃ ca yutaṃ tathā cakrapaviṣṇunā ca।
tathā mahālakṣmikayā yutaṃ ca tathā mahāviṣṇusupūjitaṃ ca ।।21 ।।
netre na me vīkṣitumīśvare'tra tato'patejaḥ kuru darśanārham ।
prasīda jīveśa tava svarūpaṃ bālasvarūpaṃ subhagaṃ vidhehi ।। 22।।
namo namaste bhavatāraṇāya namo'stu te brahmaparāyaṇāya ।
śrībālakṛṣṇāya narāyaṇāya bhūyo'pibhūyo'pi namo namaste ।।23।।
anantarūpāya visaṃkhyavaktre hyasaṃkhyanetrāya namo namaste ।
asaṃkhyanāmne parameśvarāya koṭyabjakanyāpataye namo'stu ।।24।।
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ te'rpitameva kṛṣṇa yathāprasanno'si kuru tathā tvam ।
prāptaṃ mayā''ptavyamamutra cātra varārthakaṃ śiṣyata evanā'dya ।। 25।।
ityevaṃ rādhike stutvā virarāma nṛpaḥ kṣaṇam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha bhuvaḥ patim ।।26 ।।
ayaṃ yo dṛśyate rājan mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ bhavān ।
mahālakṣmīśca yā tvāste seyaṃ śīlavatī tava ।।27।।
śrīriyaṃ tava bhīmā'sti lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇā'sti te sutā ।
rādhikā tuṃgabhadrā te putrītrayaṃ nibodha vai ।।28।।
ayaṃ viṣṇustava putraḥ pauṃḍrakaḥ svayameva ha ।
tārako'yaṃ guruste'smi rājan mokṣapradaḥ prabhuḥ ।।29।।
divyairnetraiḥ pradattaiśca yūyaṃ paśyata māmiha ।
sarvarūpaiḥ samāyuktaṃ naijarūpāṇi yānyapi ।।2.81.3 0।।
mamāvatārarūpāṇi prapaśyata tato hṛdi ।
putro'yaṃ tava rājendra na mṛto māyayā mama ।।3 1 ।।
darśitaṃ ca parīkṣārthaṃ sarvārpaṇavidhau tava ।
vrate'tra kārtike neti vaktavyaṃ nā'rthine kvacit ।।32।।
gṛhāṇa rājan putraṃ tvaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathā'sukam ।
bhāryā bhuktā mayā naiva parīkṣārthaṃ pradarśitam ।।33 ।।
kanyā nagnāḥ kṛtā naiva parīkṣārthaṃ tu tatkṛtam ।
prasanno'smi ca sañjātaḥ prasannatama ityapi ।।34।।
yūyaṃ mamā'vatārāḥ stha jñānaṃ tadvai bhaviṣyati ।
sarvadā cādyataḥ sarve bhavatā'tra sudevatāḥ ।।35।।
uddhārārthaṃ mayā loke kalāṃśāṃśādibhistviha ।
avatārāḥ saṃdhṛtā vaḥ kuṭumbarūpiṇo bhuvi ।।36।।
rūpadvayaṃ kurutā'tra matpratāpena ṣaṭ praṣaṭ ।
ṣaḍrū'pāṇyatra tiṣṭhantu praṣaḍrū'pāṇi matsamam ।।37।।
āyāntu kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre tiṣṭhantu tatra ca ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe tiṣṭhantu kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ।।38।।
ityuktvā divyarūpaṃ svaṃ tiro'bhāvayadīśapaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpo'bhūd darśanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।। 39।।
lāvaṇyaparipūrṇaśca sarvasaundaryabhājanaḥ ।
ākarṣakaśca netrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭeḥ sthairyasya bhūmikā ।।2.81.40।।
campakābhaḥ kānakābho vahniśuddhāṃ'śukā'nvitaḥ ।
sadratnā'ñcitabhūṣaśca koṭikandarpasundaraḥ ।।41 ।।
navīnabalapūrāḍhyo dhātupūrṇā'ṅgasudṛḍhaḥ ।
sarvāṃgaśobhanaścittākarṣakaśca manoharaḥ ।।42।।
saumyahāsyalasatkāntiḥ premadhārāpradāyakaḥ ।
snehaśevadhisamprāpyaḥ karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ ।।43 ।।
evaṃ bālasvarūpo'bhūt padmakiñjalkakomalaḥ ।
puṇḍarīkāyatanetradvayenā''karṣayan muhuḥ ।।44।।
jagāda varadānārthaṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbameva tat ।
rājā'bhūt pūrṇakāmaśca kuṭumbaṃ tuṣṭameva ca ।।45।।
sākṣāt prāptiḥ prabhorjātā ko'nyo varo'tra śiṣyate ।
vicāryetthaṃ tu te prāhuryatheṣṭaṃ no niyojaya ।।46।।
harirhasaँstadā prāha tisraḥ kanyā nijāśritāḥ ।
śrīśca kanyā tu yā bhīmānāmnī bhīmā''pagā'stu sā ।।47।।
mama tīrthasvarūpā'tra bhīmāyāṃ vāsametviha ।
lakṣmīryā kanyakā kṛṣṇānāmnī kṛṣṇā''pagā'stu sā ।।48।।
mama tīrthasvarūpā'tra kṛṣṇāyāṃ vāsametviha ।
rādhā tu kanyakā tuṃgabhadrākhyā saridastu sā ।।49।।
mama tīrthasvarūpā'tra tuṃgabhadrāsvarūpiṇī ।
evaṃ kanyātrayaṃ tatra nadīṣvevā'bhavat sthitam ।।2.81.50।।
lokoddhāravidhānārthaṃ kṛpayā vyadadhattathā ।
prabhuḥ svayaṃ tīrthakartā svayaṃ tābhiḥ sahā'vasat ।।51 ।।
bhīmātaṭe haristatra bhīmākṛṣṇo virājate ।
kṛṣṇātaṭe hariḥ kṛṣṇā nivāsākhyo virājate ।।52।।
tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tuṃgabhadrānātho virājate ।
evaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtavān bhagavān svayam ।।53 ।।
tataḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ tvaṃ tu mahābaleśvaraḥ ।
mahāviṣṇusvarūpo vai śaṃkareṇa samaṃ sadā ।।54।।
vasa rājan tīrtharūpo mama tīrthaphalapradaḥ ।
mahālakṣmyā sahitastvaṃ śīlavatyā tu yoṣitā ।।55।।
evaṃ tīrthaṃ mahālakṣmīyutaṃ mahābaleśvaram ।
kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena vāsaṃ vai datvā tābhyāṃ tadā śubham ।।56।।
rājā rājñīṃ sthitavantau mahābaleśvare sadā ।
atha viṣṇuṃ puṇḍakaṃ tu sutaṃ prāha hariḥ svayam ।।57।।
tvaṃ sadā divyarūpeṇa puṇḍrake nagaraṃ kuru ।
viśvasthalasvarūpaśca sadā puṇḍrapure vasa ।।58।।
āśritānāṃ janānāṃ ca muktido bhava sarvadā ।
evaṃ viṣṇuṃ puṇḍrapure sthātumājñāpya tatparam ।।।59।।
tattattīrthāni saṃsthāpya teṣu teṣu praviśya ca ।
viśeṣataḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'khileśvaraḥ ।।2.81.60।।
praṣaḍrūpāṇi divyāni yāni dhṛtāni cājñayā ।
nītvā divye vimāne sve tatastaṃ tārakaṃ gurum ।।61 ।।
āhūya tārakaṃ puṇyaṃ divyāśramaṃ samārpayat। ।
tvayā satārake puṇye sthātavyaṃ tīrtharūpiṇi ।।62।।
mama mantraḥ pradātavyaḥ śaraṇāgatadehine ।
ityuktvā sthāpayāmāsa tārake tārakāyanam ।।63।।
dvitīyaṃ cāpi tadrūpaṃ nītvā divye vimānake ।
datvā''śiṣo'pi sarvebhyaḥ prasanno bhagavān hariḥ ।।64।।
kṛtvā tīrthāni saptaiva mūrdhanyāni bhuvastale ।
snātvā tīrtheṣu tatrāpi tattatsthaleṣu mādhavaḥ ।।65।।
tīrthottamottamānyeva vyadhāt trailokyanāyakaḥ ।
divyāni tāni rūpāṇi saptasaṃkhyāni vai yadā ।।66।।
vimāne śrīharirdivye dadhāra ca tadā surāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ।।67।।
sādhyāḥ siddhā vasavaśca īśvarā mānavottamāḥ ।
āyayustatra sahasā jayaśabdān vyadhurmuhuḥ ।।68।।
harṣanādān pracakruśca vardhayāmāsurakṣataiḥ ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca siṣicuścāndanaṃ jalam ।।69।।
lājābhirvardhayāmāsurharṣayāmāsurīḍanaiḥ ।
praṇemurmānayāmāsuḥ satkāraṃ cakrurātmabhiḥ ।।2.81.70 ।।
arpitairvividhairdravyairdhanyavādān dadustathā ।
prāhuḥ śrīparamātmānaṃ nātha! bhaktasya te kvacit ।।71।।
nā'deyaṃ vidyate te'tra nidarśanaṃ baleśvaraḥ ।
naitādṛśī parīkṣā tu kartavyā'nyatra kutracit ।।72।।
apakvānāṃ vratahantrī bhavet kvaciddhi māyayā ।
amāyikasya te kṛṣṇa! parīkṣaṇaṃ hyamāyikam ।।73।।
māyālubdhena durdharṣaṃ māyāhīnena pāryate ।
ityuktvā puṣpahārādyaiḥ pūjayitvā pareśvaram ।।74।।
sapta tāँstu mahāmuktān samabhyarcya punastataḥ ।
adṛśyatāṃ yayurdevāḥ sarve'nye devasārthakāḥ ।।75।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānamambare ।
prerayāmāsa tacchīghraṃ cāyayāvāśvasārasam ।।76।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśramasannidhau ।
koṭisūryābhatejovat mūrtyaṣṭakasamujjvalam ।। 77।।
avātatāra ca sāyaṃ bhramitvā daśayojanam ।
kadambānāṃ vanamadhye udyāne sumanohare ।।78।।
avateruśca te pṛthvyāṃ narā nāryastadā'bhitaḥ ।
darśanārthaṃ dudruvuśca dadṛśuḥ parameśvaram ।।79।।
saptadivyamahābhāgavatabhaktasamanvitam ।
