vimānaṃ cā'dṛśyabhāvaṃ prāptaṃ kṣaṇājjanā api ।।2.81.80।।
jayaśabdāँstadā cakruḥ praṇemuścāṣṭakaṃ śubham ।
harirnināya cā''vāse mātaraṃ pitaraṃ prati ।।8 1 ।।
darśayitvā tataḥ śrīmallomaśaṃ praṇināya ca ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ paścāttīrthāni praṇināya ca ।।82।।
kudambāya dadau saudhaṃ sadāvāsāya cottamam ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tārakāyā''śramaṃ dadau ।।83 ।।
satkāraṃ bhojanaṃ pānamupaskāraṃ ca vastu ca ।
apekṣitaṃ dadau sarvaṃ divyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।84।।
hariḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ vrataṃ te kārtikasya vai ।
sarvaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ prāptaṃ mama yogena sarvathā ।।85।।
yaśo dānaṃ cānnasatraṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ dhanādikam ।
japo homo'titheḥ sevā māsaṃ phalāśanādikam ।।86।।
sarvaṃ mama kṛpāleśāt tava sampūrṇatāṃ gatam ।
kartavyaṃ nāsti te rājannavaśiṣṭaṃ tathetarat ।।87।।
atra sevāparo bhūtvā mayyarpaṇaṃ samācara ।
kārtikānāṃ ca koṭīnāṃ vrataṃ te pūrṇatāṃ gatam ।।88।।
evamuktavate tasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane ।
rājñā kanyātrayaṃ tatrā'rpitaṃ kāntāya śārṅgiṇe ।।89।।
āśrame lomaśamuneḥ preṣayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ।
śrīharistārakaṃ baleśvaraṃ śīlavatīṃ satīm ।।2.81.90 ।।
puṇḍrakaṃ ca sutaṃ yatra kārayāmāsa cāplavam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva tāni tīrthāni cā'bhavan ।।9 1 ।।
tattannāmnā prasiddhāni divyāni tārakāṇi vai ।
tataḥ svayaṃ viśaśrāma nijālaye'tikomale ।।92।।
rātrau nidrāṃ cakārā'tha prātaścorjāṣṭamīprage ।
śrīharerjanmadivase pūjāṃ cakāra tārakaḥ ।।93।।
mahābaleśvaraścāpi kanyātrayaṃ ca kanyakāḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhā mānavā devatādayaḥ ।।94।।
īśvarā devikā sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
daśame vatsarārambhadivase maṇḍape hariḥ ।।95।।
niṣasāda mahādivye gajāsane paraḥ pumān ।
īśapālā lokapālā rājyapālāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।96।।
pupūjuścātipremṇaiva lomaśo'rcanamācarat ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāthopadā daduḥ surādayaḥ ।।97।।
bhojayāmāsa ca pitā mātā satkāramācarat ।
devadevīkuṭumbānāṃ bahumānadhanādibhiḥ ।।98।।
tataścakre parihāraṃ sāyaṃ cakre mahotsavam ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ vidyādharyo'nyāḥ kuśalastriyaḥ ।।99।।
tābhyo dadau pāritoṣikādikaṃ ca pitā svayam ।
haristvāśīrvādasaukhyaṃ dadau subhojanādikam ।। 2.81.100 ।।
evamutsavamutkṛṣṭaṃ nirvartya daśavārṣikam ।
bhojayāmāsa viprādyān kuṃkumavāpikāsthitān ।। 101 ।।
dadau dānāni ratnānāṃ gavāṃ cārthipratuṣṭaye ।
evaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā yayurdevādayo divam ।। 1 02।।
anye lokānnijān sarve yayurgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
viśaśrāma sukhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'pi mandire ।। 1 03।।
lomaśaḥ kanyakāyuktaḥ pūjāṃ prāpyā''śramaṃ yayau ।
mahīmānā yayurnaijaṃ deśaṃ śaṃsanta utsavam ।। 1 04।।
atha svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevārthamutsuko ।
hemantabhagavantau dvau divyau śrīharipārṣadau ।। 1 05।।
sevāyāṃ dāsavannityaṃ sthitau sarvātmanā prabhoḥ ।
rājopacārakaiḥ siṣevāte kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 1 06।।
paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe'nādikṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam ।
bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhrovyā prabhākāntapratāpataḥ .।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlasmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne baleśvararājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya śrīharistutiḥ, dvedhā divyadehādiprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 81 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 081 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 82
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 083 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi pratyakṣapuruṣottamam ।
viśvāmitreṇa sandiṣṭaṃ jayadhvajāya vai kratau ।। 1 ।।
candravaṃśo'bhavadrājā sahasrārjunasaṃjñakaḥ ।
sahasrabāhurdyutimān dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tasya sutāḥ pañcaśatānyāsan sarve mahārathāḥ ।
kṛtāstrā valinaḥ śūrā dharmātmānaḥ surārcakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
kecid rudraṃ pūjayanti kecit sūryaṃ pare kratum ।
anye vahniṃ pūjayanti viṣṇumanye satīṃ pare ।। 4 ।।
ajaṃ cānye gaṇeśaṃ ca pare'rcayanti candrakam ।
jayadhvajaḥ kaniṣṭhaśca sarvā'varaja eva yaḥ ।। 5 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiparo'bhavat ।
nityaṃ sa matimān devaṃ nārāyaṇahariṃ prabhum ।। 6 ।।
tiṣṭhate śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ daivataṃ brahmataḥ param ।
tamūcuritare putrāḥ śṛṇu cānuja dhārmikam ।। 7 ।।
pitā'smākaṃ vahnideva śivaṃ dattamuniṃ tathā ।
abhajat tān bhajasvā'tra mā bhajasva narāyaṇam ।। 8 ।।
jayadhvajo'bravīttāँstu mama dharmaḥ paro mataḥ ।
viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtā rājāno'tra mahītale ।। 9 ।।
rājyapālayitā teṣāṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ।
pūjanīyo'jito viṣṇuḥ pālako jagatāṃ hariḥ ।। 2.82.1 0।।
śrīharirhi bhavadbhistu pūjanīyo'pi sarvathā ।
sṛjed brahmā rajomūrtiḥ saṃharet tāmaso haraḥ ।। 1 1।।
sattvātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sampoṣayati sarvadā ।
tasmānmahīpatīnāntu rājyaṃ pālayatāmayam ।। 12।।
ārādhyo bhagavān viṣṇurnārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
sattvena mucyate jantuḥ sattvātmā bhagavān hariḥ ।। 13।।
sattvadharmaḥ sadā śreṣṭho yogibhiśca viniścitaḥ ।
sarvaśuddhau sattvaśuddhirvaiśāradyaṃ viśadyate ।। 14।।
viṣṇau sā sāttvikī śuddhirvaiśāradyaṃ hi śāśvatam ।
śaṃbhau vahnau tathā sūryaṃ tamomātrā viśeṣitā ।। 15।।
kratau satyāṃ gaṇeśe'je rajo'dhikaṃ ca candrake ।
sattvaṃ deveśvare viṣṇau nārāyaṇe viśiṣyate ।। 16।।
sa pūjyaḥ sarvadā yuṣmadbhiścāpi bhrātaraḥ! sadā ।
viṣṇuḥ sampoṣakaḥ śāstā rājadharmo'pi tatra hi ।। 17।।
svadharmo muktaye yukto nānyo rājñāṃ pramuktaye ।
nārāyaṇīṃ mahāśaktiṃ nṛpāṇāṃ dadhatāṃ sadā ।। 18।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārādhanamuttamam ।
śrutvaivaṃ tvagrajāḥ prāhuḥ piturdharmaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ ।। 19।।
pitrā tvārādhito vahniḥ śaṃbhurdattaḥ prabhustathā ।
ta evā''rādhane grāhyāḥ pitṛdharmeṇa mokṣaṇam ।। 2.82.20।।
jayadhvajaśca tān prāha yuktamuktaṃ mamā'grajaiḥ ।
pitṛdharmo rakṣaṇīyo yathāpekṣo ca cā'dhikaḥ ।।21 ।।
parantvatra kratau kārye sarvejyasamavāyake ।
kaḥ pūjyaśca samārādhya ityatrottaramacyutaḥ ।।22।।
pramāṇavṛṣayo hyatra yad brūyuste tathaiva tat ।
athā''hūtā ṛṣayaśca vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ prajāvṛṣāḥ ।। 23।।
pṛṣṭhā dharmavivāde tu devārādhanarūpiṇi ।
kratau vā cānyadā kaścārādhyo devo vadantu naḥ ।। 24।।
tānabruvaँste ṛṣayo vaśiṣṭhādyā yathārthataḥ ।
yā yasyā'bhimatā puṃsaḥ sā hi tasyaiva devatā ।।25।।
kintu kāryaviśeṣeṇa pūjyate ceṣṭadā'pi ca ।
devatā bahulāḥ santi brahmaṇaḥ pratimā hi tāḥ ।। 26।।
bhinnārthinaśca vidyante yathārtho devatā tathā ।
kāryavaśāt kālavaśānniyogācchāsanāttathā ।। re7।।
rājñā kāryavaśāt kvāpi kiṃkaraḥ samupāsyate ।
kiṃkaraḥ kiṃkaraṃ cāpyupāste kāryavaśādapi ।। 28।।
śreṣṭhāḥ kāryavaśāccāpi kaniṣṭhān samupāsate ।
bhinnāstu jātayaḥ santi dehasaṃsthānayogataḥ ।। 29।।
yatkāryaṃ jāyate yasmāt tattadarthamapāsyate ।
śreṣṭhamiṣṭaphalādyarthaṃ khādyaṃ sasyānyupāsate ।।2.82.3 0 ।।
rasaprāptyarthamevātha pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ hyupāsate ।
rasānāṃ pakvatārthaṃ ca sūryaṃ candraṃ hyupāsate ।। 31 ।।
nṛpāṇāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca purandaraḥ ।
viprāṇāmagnirādityo viṣṇubrahmaśivāḥ surāḥ ।। 32।।
devānāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇurdānavānāṃ haraḥ sadā ।
gandharvāṇāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ daivataṃ soma ucyate ।।3 2 ।।
vidyādharāṇāṃ vāgdevī siddhānāṃ bhagavān hariḥ ।
rakṣasāṃ śaṃkaro devaḥ kinnarāṇāṃ tu pārvatī । ।368।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ daivataṃ brahmā śivaḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ surāḥ ।
raviragniśca viśve ca devāstathā janārdanaḥ । ।35।।
strīṇāṃ ca daivataṃ lakṣmīsamā ratiḥ pativratā ।
patiḥ pareśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ saubhāgyaśrīrapīti ca ।। 26 ।।
gṛhasthānāṃ yathāpekṣaṃ devā devyaśca daivatam ।
parabrahma svayaṃ devo yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 37।।
sādhūnāṃ tu kṣamā devī daivataṃ śīlamityapi ।
bālānāṃ janakau daivaṃ paśūnāṃ pālakaḥ suraḥ ।।38।।
gaṇānāṃ śaṃkaro daivaṃ bhaktānāṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
īśvarāṇāṃ vāsudevo vṛkṣāṇāṃ daivataṃ jalam ।। 39।।
sarvoṣāṃ daivataṃ cāntaryāmī śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
rogiṇāmoṣadhaṃ daivaṃ caurāṇāṃ daṇḍa ityapi ।।2.82.40।।
evaṃ jaḍaṃ cetanaṃ vā daivaṃ sveṣṭaṃ bhavatyapi ।
sarvatra vartamānaḥ śrīhariḥ sarvasya daivatam ।।41 ।।
ato jayadhvajo nūnaṃ viṣṇavārādhanamarhati ।
harau rudrasya viṣṇośca tādātmyaṃ brahmaṇo'pi ca ।।42।।
budhvā hariḥ sadā pūjyaḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ ।
tatra sarve'vatārāśca vāsudevādayastathā ।।43 ।।
mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtayo vairājā aṃśarūpiṇaḥ ।
āveśā vā kalāścāpi vibhūtayaḥ surādayaḥ ।।44।।
samanvayaṃ pragacchanti śrīharau paramātmani ।
devā devyo guruḥ santo viprā gāvaḥ pativratāḥ ।।45।।
ityuktvā ṛṣayaḥ sarve kratuṃ tasya hi cakrire ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo yajñaḥ saptāhakṛtasatkriyaḥ ।।46।।
yatreśvarāḥ samastāśca ṛṣayo devatāstathā ।
samastāḥ svarganilayā grahamānavabhūsurāḥ ।।47।।
bubhujurbahupakvānnapāyasānnāni sarvathā ।
tṛptiṃ prāpuḥ parāṃ somāmṛtabhojanapānakaiḥ ।।48।।
vahnayo marutaḥ sarve tatra yajñe'tibhāvataḥ ।
bubhujurdattahavyādi trailokyaṃ tṛptimāvahat ।।49।।
bubhuje divyamūrtiśca sākṣād vahnau samutthitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।2.82.50 ।।
evaṃ yajñe suniṣpanne dakṣiṇādānakarmaṇi ।
śeṣe ca havane cāpi sampanne'vabhṛthāplave ।।21।।
bhojanaṃ cakrire sarve paṃktiśo bhūsurādayaḥ ।
tāvattatra samāyāto videho nāma rākṣasaḥ ।।52।।
daṃṣṭrākarālo dīptākṣaḥ śūlabhṛnnādayan diśaḥ ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dudruvurmartyā bhayenā''raṇyakaṃ prati ।।53 ।।
athā'rjunasya satputrāḥ sarve yattā mahābalāḥ ।
yuyudhurdānavaṃ śaktigirikūṭā'simudgaraiḥ ।।54।।
prājāpatyaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca raudraṃ vāyavyamastrakam ।
kauberamaindramāgneyaṃ cikṣipustatra bhūmipāḥ ।।55।।
dānavaḥ śūlamādāya sūryābhaṃ parito bhraman ।
bhrāmayan bhañjayāmāsa tānyastrāṇi samantataḥ ।।56।।
śūlasthavahninā tānyākarṣayāmāsa sarvathā ।
tato bhūpā gadābhistaṃ tāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।।57।।
spṛṣṭamātrā gadāḥ sarvā bhagnā loṣṭādrivarṣmaṇi ।
na dānavaṃ cālayituṃ śekurgadābhirīśvarāḥ ।।58।।।
tataste bhayamāpannā dudruvurvīkṣya pauruṣam ।
bhagnotsāhāḥ samabhavan dṛṣṭvā tasyā'tipauruṣam ।।59।।
atha pañcaśatānāṃ tu kumārāṇāṃ palāyanam ।
vīkṣya sasmāra ca jayadhvajo nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।2.82.60।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam ।
dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ jajāpainaṃ rakṣa rakṣa pumuttama ।।61 ।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣa tvaṃ samāyāhi pareśvara ।
evaṃ vai smaryamāṇaḥ sa bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ।।62।।
tūrṇaṃ tatrāyayau cakraśaṃkhapadmagadāyudhaḥ ।
viṣṇurjayiṣṇurlokādiścāprameyo nirāmayaḥ ।।63।।
bhaktatrātā śrīhariryaḥ pūrvapūruṣa uttamaḥ ।
dadau jayadhvajāyaiva cakraṃ svasya sudarśanam ।।64।।
jagrāha śrīhariṃ natvā rājā haste sudarśanam ।
prāhiṇottu videhāya rākṣase skandhayostadā ।।65।।
tūrṇaṃ tanmastakaṃ skandhāt pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।
rākṣaso vihatastatra śailatulyaśarīravān ।। 66।।
iti jñātvā ṛṣirviśvāmitro draṣṭuṃ samāyayau ।
bhrātaraśca prasannāstaṃ praśaśaṃsurjayadhvajam ।।67।।
viśvāmitrāya munaye daduścottamamāsanam ।
niṣasāda munistatra kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭhavāṃstataḥ ।।58।।
jayadhvajo muniṃ prāha prasādād bhavato'suraḥ ।
nipātito'tra cakreṇa videho dānavo mahān ।।69।।
tvadvākyānnityadā cā'hamabhajaṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ।
nyapataṃ śaraṇaṃ tasya prasādastena me kṛtaḥ ।।2.82.70।।
yakṣyāmi rākṣasahatyāpāpanāśārthamityataḥ ।
kathaṃ kena vidhānena sampūjyo harirīśvaraḥ ।।71 ।।
ko'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ kimprabhāvaḥ kratāviha ।
sarvametat samācakṣva prasādayāmi taṃ prabhum ।।72।।
jayadhvajasya vacanaṃ śrutvā manirjagāda tam ।
parameśasya bhaktā'gryaṃ prapannaṃ ca jayadhvajam ।।73 ।।
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yasmin sarvaṃ yato jagat ।
tamanādiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yaja pareśvaram ।।74।।
yamakṣarātparatarātparaṃ prāhurguhāśrayam ।
ānandaṃ paramaṃ vyoma pare dhāmni sthitaṃ prabhum ।।75।।
parātparaḥ parabrahma paranārāyaṇātparaḥ ।।
akṣarādhipatirmuktiprado muktapatirhi saḥ ।।76।।
avatārasahastrāṇāṃ heturyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
caturvyūhadharaścāpi cā'vyūhaśca nirañjanaḥ ।।77।।
paramātmā paraṃdhāma paraṃvyoma paraṃpadam ।
tripādamakṣaraṃbrahma yasyā''hurbrahmavādinaḥ ।।78।।
vāsudeveśvaro yogisiddhaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
yasyāṃ'śasaṃbhavā īśā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।।79।।
vairājaśca mahāviṣṇurbhūmā kālo yadaṃśajāḥ ।
pradhānasya patirmāyāpatiryaḥ puruṣo'pi ca ।।2.82.80 ।।
mahāpūruṣa ityeṣo yasyāṃ'śo vidyate tathā ।
sarveṣāṃ ca bhagavatāṃ yaḥ paro bhagavān svayam ।।8 1 ।।
niṣkāminyā prapattyā sa cārādhyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
yajñaṃ taṃ tu punā rājan prasādaya pareśvaram ।।82।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।
rājñā kratuḥ samārabdhastatra nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।83।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ viśvāmitraḥ sabhūsuraḥ ।
yājayāmāsa sarveśaṃ parameśaṃ parātparam ।।84।।
yajñe samāptimāpanne tatra sākṣāt svayaṃ hariḥ ।
āvirāsīt sa bhagavān punaḥ punarhavirgrasan ।।85।।
varaṃ vṛṇu kṣiternātha yatte manasi vartate ।
ityevaṃ ca hariḥ prāha rājovāca padaṃ tava ।।86।।
śāśvataṃ paramaṃ dhāmaṃ divyaṃ naya dayādhara ।
hariḥ prāha samīcīnaṃ cā'rthitaṃ te tathā'stu vai ।।87।।
ityuktvā'dṛśyatāṃ yātastāvattatra catuṣṭayam ।
tāpasānāṃ samāyātaṃ bhikṣāṃ dehīti vādi ca ।।88।।
rājā bhikṣāṃ dadau tebhyo bhojanaṃ pāyasodbhavam ।
jagṛhuste ca bubhujuḥ rājā sa dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।।89।।
kṛṣṇavarṇāstu te rūkṣā bhikṣavo romaśāstadā ।
kāmarūpadharāścāsan vanecarāḥ kurūpiṇaḥ ।।2.82.90।।
bhuktvā jalaṃ papuścātha niṣedurvṛkṣamāśritāḥ ।
yathā mūḍhā hi catvāraḥ śāntāḥ śāntaghanā iva ।।91।।
yajñakārye sunirvṛtte'vabhṛthasnānahetave ।
narmadāyāṃ yayuḥ sarve catvāro'pi yayuḥ saha ।।92।।
snātāḥ sarve'pi ṛṣayo devā bhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
mahīmānā mānavāśca viprāḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ ।। 13।।
nimnabhāge tu catvāraḥ snātāste kṛṣṇavarṇakāḥ ।
snānapuṇyapratāpena jātāste śvetavarṇakāḥ ।।94।।
sūryacandrasamābhāśca mahendrasamarūpiṇaḥ ।
viṣṇutulyasuvarṣmāṇo divyāḥ svargasurā iva ।।95।।।
tān dṛṣṭvā'vabhṛthasnātāḥ papracchustān kulaṃ prati ।
te prāhuḥ svasvanāmāni śrīśailaḥ prathamo hyayam ।। 96।।
nīlagirirdvitīyo'yam elādriśca tṛtīyakaḥ ।
droṇācalaścaturtho'yaṃ vayaṃ merukulodbhavāḥ ।। 97।।
kāmarūpadharāḥ śailāḥ smo'tra snātuṃ samicchavaḥ ।
pāpakṣālanakāmāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ smaḥ sthirādrayaḥ ।।98।।
asmāsu hiṃsakāḥ sarve'raṇyeṣu ca guhāsu ca ।
kurvanti yāni pāpāni tairthikā api vāsinaḥ ।। 99।।
teṣāṃ pāpāni datvā naḥ śuddhāste vai prayānti hi ।
taiḥ pāpaiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ smo jātāḥ snānena cārjunāḥ ।। 2.82.100 ।।
atrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
āyayau yajñabhāgārthaṃ snānārthaṃ cāpi tena tu ।। 101 ।।
vaiṣṇavānāṃ prasādena pāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ samastakam ।
atha śailā gamiṣyāmo nijāvāsān namo'stu vaḥ ।। 1 02।।
yatra śrībhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tasya bhaktā jale sasnustīrthaṃ caitaddhi nārmadam ।। 103 ।।
jayadhvajaśca tān prāha kariṣye'tithisatkriyām ।
mama gṛhe'tra vāsaṃ vai prakurvantu nagottamāḥ ।। 1 04।।
ityuktvā rādhike śailān svarṇavarṇasamān nṛpaḥ ।
avabhṛthānte nilayaṃ nināya bahubhāvataḥ ।। 1 05।।
anye sarve mahīmānā bhuktvā samprāpya pūjanam ।
yayurnaijān gṛhān lokān viśaśrāma jayadhvajaḥ ।। 1 06।।
prajā bhuktvā'nāthadīnāḥ kiṃkarā dāsadāsikāḥ ।
tutuṣuścātibhojyena kīṭāḥ pipīlikādayaḥ ।। 1 07।।
enaṃ saśṛṇuyādbhaktyā pāṭhayecca paṭhecca vā ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya nārāyaṇakṛpābalāt ।। 1 08।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayadhvajasya rājño viśvāmitropadiṣṭaparabrahmopāsanābalād yajñe śrīhariprāptiḥ, videharākṣasavināśaḥ, catuḥparvatānā-
mavabhṛthasnānādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmādvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 82 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 082 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 83
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 084 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evaṃ rādhe nṛpatiḥ sa jayadhvajaḥ suvaiṣṇavaḥ ।
droṇailānīlaśrīśailān caturo'pi nijālaye ।। 1 ।।
susatkṛtyāsanādyaiḥ saṃcakāra svāgataṃ param ।
dadau bhojyāni ramyāṇi peyānyebhyo vidhānyapi ।। 2 ।।
bhogyāni copakaraṇaprāsādikajalāni ca ।
śrīhareḥ pūjanavastūnyapi dadau jayadhvajaḥ ।। 3 ।।
parvatāste kṛtakṛtyāḥ papracchustaṃ jayadhvajam ।
kathaṃ pāpāni naśyanti tīryate prakṛtiḥ katham ।। 4 ।।
kathaṃ pāpyabhiyoge'pi nirlepatvaṃ bhavet sadā ।
keṣāṃ samāgamānmuktiḥ kasmācchāntiśca śāśvatī ।। 5 ।।
kaḥ svārthaḥ kaḥ parārthaśca kā pravṛttiḥ śubhāvahā ।
jaḍatā divyatā vāpi prāpyate kena karmaṇā ।। 6 ।।
bhavānāste mahārāja sarvajña iva bhaktarāṭ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahaleśataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tasmānno vada paramaṃ śreyo yenāpi labhyate ।
śrutvā jayadhvajaḥ prāha mamāraṇye maharṣayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
vasanti bahavo divyā ye vijñānasamṛddhayaḥ ।
teṣāṃ nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ prayāmi jñānalabdhaye ।। 9 ।।
tebhyaḥ śrutaṃ mayā yadyat kathāprasaṃgalābhataḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāśrave'pi ca । । 10 ।।
ātmanā'pyanubhūtaṃ ca kathayāmi nibodhata ।
tīrthe pāpāni naśyanti tīrthaṃ sthiraṃ ca jaṅgamam ।। 11 ।।
tārayitvā vāsanākhyasāgarāt śaraṇāgatam ।
prasthāpayati dhāmā'pi paramaṃ pārameśvaram ।। 1 2 ।।
tīrthaṃ tat sarvathā bodhyaṃ jaḍaṃ vā cetanātmakam ।
jaḍaṃ jalāni caityāni vastūni bhautikāni ca ।। 13 ।।
nirguṇāni ca divyāni divyayogādbhavanti hi ।
pāpinastārayantyeva tīrthāni tāni sarvathā ।। 14।।
ātmā tīrthaṃ mahat proktaṃ kṛṣṇastīrthottamottamam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastīrthaṃ parottamam ।। 15।।
tasya tīrthasya yogena bhaktāstīrthasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
bhavanti tārakāḥ sarve santaḥ sādhvyaśca yoginaḥ ।। 1 6।।
brahmaśīlā gṛhaśīlā vanaśīlā virāgiṇaḥ ।
nyāsaśīlā dhyānaśīlāḥ kṛṣṇatīrthā hi te matāḥ ।। 17 ।।
kṛṣṇadāsyaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktāstathā kṛṣṇasya pārṣadāḥ ।
kṛṣṇasambandhamāptāśca tīrthā jaḍāśca cetanāḥ ।। 18 ।।
kṛṣṇaguṇāḍhyapuruṣaḥ satī kṛṣṇakṛpāmayī ।
paśuḥ pakṣī vṛkṣalatāḥ kṛṣṇayogā hi tārakā ।। 1 9।।
vāṭikā grāmaśālāśca dharmaśālāḥ sarittaṭāḥ ।
sarastaṭā vanasthalyaḥ śailāḥ araṇyabhūmayaḥ ।। 2.83.20 ।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi tīrthāste kṛṣṇayoginaḥ ।
grāmaḥ purī pattanaṃ ca nagaraṃ ghoṣa ityapi ।। 21 ।।
pallyaścāvasathāścāpi yatra kṛṣṇo virājate ।
tat sarvaṃ tīrthameveti tārakaṃ divyatāṃ gatam ।। 22।।
yatspṛṣṭaṃ hariṇā sākṣāt tat tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ bhavet ।
yathā haristathā tasya santastīrthāni santi hi ।। 23 ।।
santārayanti satataṃ janān jñānapradānakaiḥ ।
ajñāna nāśayitvā ca samarpayanti divyatām ।। 24।।
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca madaṃ mānaṃ ca matsaram ।
tṛṣṇāṃ ca vāsanāṃ nāśayitvā kurvanti śodhanam । । 25 ।।
tadyogāttīryate māyā satsu nauṣu sthitairjanaiḥ ।
santo bhavanti cakṣūṃṣi santo dīpā bhavanti ca ।। 26 ।।
santo naukāścārṇavasthā dāvasthā amṛtasthalāḥ ।
viṣolbaṇeṣu vai santo viṣaghnāḥ kṣveḍahāriṇaḥ ।।27।।
hālāhalābdhisaṃsāre nīlakaṇṭhā hi sādhavaḥ ।
mahārogābdhisaṃsāre dhanvantarisvarūpiṇaḥ ।।28।।
viṣayānaladagdhānāṃ santo mānasavṛṣṭayaḥ ।
vāsanājālabaddhānāṃ kartanīrūpiṇo hi te ।। 29।।
santastīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ paramātmavinirmitam ।
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmūrtimān vartate sadā ।। 2.83.30।।
haryarthaṃ yaiśca gārhasthyaṃ tyaktaṃ tyaktaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
bandhanaṃ śrīharau baddhāstīrtharūpā hi sādhavaḥ ।। 31 ।।
haristīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrtha tīrthaṃ tatsādhavastataḥ ।
sādhvyastīrthaṃ sādhuvacca taranti pāpinaśca taiḥ ।।32।।
etattrayaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caturthaṃ vipramaṇḍalam ।
gurustīrthaṃ sarvatīrthottamaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sadā ।। 33।।
mātā tīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ pitā patistathā ।
satī tīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ tīrthāstu dhārmikā janāḥ ।।34।।
putrastīrthaṃ dharmavacca kanyā tīrthaṃ vṛṣānvitā ।
svasā tīrthaṃ dharmayuktā patnī tīrthaṃ satī yadi ।।35।।
kuṭumbaṃ dhārmikaṃ tīrthaṃ tārayet tīrthamuttamam ।
devastīrthaṃ mandiraṃ ca tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ kathāmṛtam ।। 36।।
vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ tīrthaṃ śāstraṃ tīrthaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
godānaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ svarṇānnadānakam ।।37।।
satyaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣamā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ rāgavihīnatā ।
dveṣarāhityamevā'pi tīrthaṃ nairmalyakārakam ।।38।।
kṛṣṇasevā paraṃ tīrthaṃ bhaktistīrthaṃ tathottamam ।
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ tu tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthamucyate ।।39।।
dīkṣā bhikṣā samīkṣā ca tīrthatrayaṃ vivekataḥ ।
evaṃ śailāstu tīrthāni hareryogād bhavanti vai ।।2.83.40।।
kiṃ bahunā'tra vacasā santastīrthāni sarvathā ।
sarvapradāste jīvānāṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣiṇām ।।41 ।।
satāṃ śaraṇamāpannastaratyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
kāṣṭhādhāraṃ samāpannastaratyeva jalārṇavam ।।42।।
kāṣṭhe laghutvamevā'sti satsu harirvasatyapi ।
yatra haristatra sarvaṃ yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ।।43।।
kalpavallī satāṃ haste cintāmaṇiḥ satāṃ mukhe ।
kalpavṛkṣaḥ saddhṛdaye kāmadhenuḥ satāṃ matau ।।44।।
aṇimādyāḥ siddhayastu luṭhanti pādayoḥ satām ।
aiśvaryāṇi satāmoṣṭhe vasanti sukhadāni vai ।।45।।
pāvitryaṃ tu satāṃ dṛṣṭau vākye dharmo vasatyapi ।
muktiṃ satāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vartate śaraṇaṃ gatā ।।46।।
prakṛtiḥ procyate māyā'bhyāso viṣayavastuṣu ।
saṃskāraḥ sthitisaṃstho'yaṃ kṛṣṇābhyāsena jīryati ।।47।।
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti nārāyaṇeti sarvadā ।
raṭaṇena hi saṃskārā bhāvanākhyā bhavanti vai ।।48 ।।
kṛṣṇayogena divyāste nāśayanti tu māyikān ।
prākṛtān nāśayitvaiva śodhayanti hṛdantaram ।।49।।
sā māyā bhramarūpā vā'vidyā'haṃmamatātmikā ।
rāgadveṣātmikā vāpi saṃśayo vā mṛṣātmikā ।।2.83.50 ।।
yāthārthyena vidhānena layaṃ yāti harerbalāt ।
āmṛtyukṣaṇamāsādya kṛṣṇe matirna ced bhavet। ।।5 1 ।।
yatra nāryāṃ nare putre dravye'nyatra matirbhavet ।
sā māyā bandhakartryeva kṛṣṇasmṛtyā vinaśyati ।।52।।
evaṃ śailāḥ saṃśṛṇvantu kṛṣṇayogo hi tārakaḥ ।
satāṃ yogastārako'pi māyā tena nivartate ।।53।।
yathā lauhaṃ kāṣṭhayoge taratyeva jalopari ।
tathā pāpī satāṃ yoge taratyeva bhavopari ।।54।।
yathā padmaṃ svabhāvācca jale'pi nahi lipyate ।
tathā jñānī bhaktiyuktaḥ pāpe'pi nahi lipyate ।।55।।
yathā tailaṃ jalamadhye kṣiptaṃ tarati mūrdhani ।
tathā jñānī pāpimadhye sthitastarati pāpataḥ ।।56।।
jñānaṃ dahati karmāṇi bhaktiḥ karmaphalāni ca ।
dahatyevaṃ dvayaṃ cānyat kṛṣṇetarat kṛtaṃ tu yat ।।57।।
ātmā yena dhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe parātmani ।
sa cātmā vartate cāntaḥkaraṇebhyo viyogavān ।।58।।
āntaraṃ karaṇaṃ tena bhinnaṃ prayatnamantarā ।
nendriyairśayate śaktiśūnyaṃ rūkṣaṃ patiṃ vinā ।।59।।।
nendriyāṇi tato yānti viṣayān kṛṣṇavarjitān ।
viṣayeṣu gata pāpaṃ nopasaṃkrāmati hyataḥ ।।2.83.60 ।।
indriyāṇyaviṣayāṇi yadā bhavanti yoginaḥ ।
mānasaṃ cā'viṣayaṃ ca jāyate sarvadā'sya tu ।।61 ।।
ātmā viṣayaśūnyaśca kṛṣṇamātreṇa saṃmataḥ ।
bhavatyeva tadā pāpānnivṛtto mokṣago yathā ।।62।।
evaṃ bhūtvā śarīraṃ cendriyāṇyasya karoti cet ।
kriyāṃ yāṃ kāṃ, na caiṣā syād bandhanāya tu yoginaḥ ।।63।।
vidhikriyā'thavā vidhivivarjitā'pi kā'pi vā ।
loke matā'thavā naiva matā lokavivarjitā ।।64।।
vivekena kṛtā vā na kṛtā vivekavarjitā ।
pāpā vā pāpaśūnyā vā lokadṛṣṭyā tu yādṛśī ।।65।।
yādṛśī tādṛśī vāpi kriyā yā syāttu yoginaḥ ।
nisargajā na sā tasya bandhanāya prajāyate ।।66।।
yasya nāsti sukhe rāgo na dveṣo duḥkhavastuṣu ।
harṣāharṣarahitātmā na sa pāpena lipyate ।।67।।
yasya nāsti sukhaṃ me syād duḥkhaṃ mā syāditi pradhīḥ ।
īhāśūnyasya kartavyaṃ nirīhaṃ nahi lumpati ।।68।।
iṣṭaṃ tathāpyaniṣṭaṃ ca tyaktaṃ yenā''tmataḥ sadā ।
guṇatrayā'bhibhavanaṃ tasya naiva hi jāyate ।।69।।
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ yasya bhogyaṃ bhogaśca bhoktṛtā ।
kriyākṛṣṇārpitā yena dehendriyatadīyajā ।।2.83.70 ।।
tatpāpaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ vā phalaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ tathā ।
sa tu sarveṣu lipto'pi lipyate na manāgapi ।।7 1 ।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya kṛṣṇārthakṛtakarmaṇaḥ ।
prasādhitaprasādhyasya sadā sādhusvabhāvinaḥ ।।72।।।
nirlepasya prasaṃgena muktiḥ syād bandhanāśinī ।
bandho vai vāsanā proktā cāhaṃmamatvakāritā ।।73 ।।
mithyājñānajaniryā ca vāsanā jaḍatātmikā ।
sa saṃsāro bandhanaṃ vai kṛṣṇayogena naśyati ।।74।।
satāṃ kṛṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ samāgamena naśyati ।
tato muktirjīvato vai bhūtabandhanavarjitā ।।75।।
nirdvandvā ca nirīhā ca vitṛṣṇā rāgavarjitā ।
sthitirnityātmasaṃsthā ca nityānandapariplutā ।।76 ।।
sadā śāntasya kṛṣṇasya yogena śāntiracyute ।
ātmanā cātmani dhrauvyā yā śāśvatyanubhūyate ।।77।।
sā śāntiḥ śāśvatī kṛṣṇāt parameśāt prajāyate ।
iyaṃ muktiḥ parā muktiryataḥ śāntirna vai parā ।।78।।
asaṃkhyānandasandohe magnatā paramātmani ।
sa svārthasvātmano hyarthaḥ paraṃ prayojanaṃ hi tat ।।79।।
mokṣo'rtho jīvalokasya mumukṣoḥ svārtha eva ha ।
jñāto'rthaḥ svātmani precchet svārthaḥ sa cātra mokṣaṇam ।।2.83.80 ।।
kṣaṇikaḥ sukhadaḥ svārtho nāpekṣyo vai mumukṣubhiḥ ।
śāśvatānandabhṛtsvārthaḥ samapekṣyo mumukṣubhiḥ ।।81 ।।
evaṃ svārthaṃ pralakṣyaiva pravṛttiḥ śubhadāyinī ।
śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ svargalokaḥ satyamaiśvaradhiṣṇyakam ।।82।।
vināśayogi tat proktaṃ prakṛteḥ kṛtasarjane ।
avināśaṃ śubhaṃ mokṣaḥ kṛṣṇapādābhilaṃbhanam ।।83।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptiḥ śubhaṃ sarvottamottamam ।
kṛṣṇo divyaḥ sadā cāste yādṛśastādṛśo'pi vā ।।84।।
tādātmyakarmabhirdivyabhāvaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ।
śarīrendriyakarmāṇi jaḍānyapi harergrahāt ।।85।।
bhavanti divyabhāvāni jaḍatā yāti divyatām ।
evaṃ śailā! bhavanto'pi jaḍā bhaktiprayogataḥ ।।86।।
jāḍyaṃ bhāvaṃ parityajya bhavantu divyarūpiṇaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprabhuḥ ।।87।।
vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cāśvasarontike ।
tadyogaṃ tadbhajanaṃ ca kurvantu tena divyatām ।।88।।
prayāsyathaiva śīghraṃ ca nārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt ।
ityevaṃ procyamāneṣu jayadhvajena cā'driṣu ।।89।।
catvāraḥ puruṣāścānye śāntāstatra samāyayuḥ ।
jayadhvajādikān natvā tasthuḥ pṛṣṭhāstato hi te ।।2.83.90 ।।
kuta āgamyate kutra gamyate kiṃ prayojanam ।
te procustaṃ vinatāśca vayaṃ śrutvā tava kratum ।।91।।
āgatā harṣataścātra gacchāmo'śvasarovaram ।
snātuṃ draṣṭuṃ pareśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।92।।
yātrikaiḥ sampradattāni pāpānyasaṃkhyakāni tu ।
kṣālayituṃ pragacchāmaḥ kuṃkumavāpikāsthalīm ।।93।।
kolārasara evāyaṃ nāmnā khyāto'sti tīrtharāṭ ।
dvitīyo vartate nāmnā hyayaṃ cilasarovaraḥ ।।94।।
tṛtīyaḥ śaṃbhalasaro'bhidho'yaṃ tīrtharājakaḥ ।
caturtho'haṃ pumānasmi nārāyaṇasarovaraḥ ।।95।।
vayaṃ tvadya militvā tu yātā abhūma mānasam ।
saro divyaṃ haimaśaile darśanārthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।।96।।
śrutvā cātra samāyātā yajñaṃ te'tha tato vayam ।
gacchāmastatra yatraiva parameśo virājate ।।97।।
etacchrutvā ca te śailā jayadhvajo'pi bhūpatiḥ ।
vyomnā kuṭumbasahitaḥ sarve yayurhareḥ purīm ।।98।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
vyomnā te cā'vateruśca sasnuścāśvasarovare ।।99।।
tato divyasvarūpāśca dṛṣṭvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 2.83.10 0।।
gṛhītvā paramaṃ mantraṃ bālakṛṣṇāntikaṃ yayuḥ ।
sampūjya vidhivat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca te tataḥ ।। 101 ।।
pītvā'mṛtaṃ caraṇayorniṣeduḥ satkṛtāḥ puraḥ ।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ dehi mokṣaṃ paraṃ padam ।। 1 02।।
śrīhariḥ kṛpayā tāँśca trirūpān saṃvyadhāpayat ।
tīrthabhaktamuktarūpān tīrthānyapreṣayattadā ।। 1 03।।
naijaṃ naijaṃ nivāsaṃ ca pāvanārthaṃ hi dehinām ।
bhaktarūpāँstatra cāśvasarasyeva nyavāsayat ।। 1 04।।
nijāśraye mahābhaktān saṃvidhāyaiva sevakān ।
tata ārabhya tattīrthe tīrthāṣṭakaṃ tato'vasat ।। 105।।
kolāṭatīrthaṃ ca tathā cilatīrthaṃ tathottamam ।
tathā śaṃbhalatīrthaṃ ca nārāyaṇasarastathā ।। 1 06।।
droṇatīrthaṃ nīlatīrthaṃ śrītīrthaṃ cailatīrthakam ।
divyarūpā virājante śrīkṛṣṇapādapaṃkaje ।। 1 07।।
muktarūpān vimānenā'kṣaraṃ cā'preṣayat prabhuḥ ।
dhāma muktanivāsākhyaṃ rādhike karuṇānidhiḥ ।। 1 08।।
ityevaṃ taccamatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā jayadhvajo'pi ca ।
sthitvā māsaṃ mārgaśīrṣaṃ yayāce mokṣaṇaṃ hareḥ ।। 1 09।।
cakre tasya harirmuktiṃ vimānena yayau sa tu ।
dhāmā'kṣaraṃ padaṃ divyaṃ śāśvatānandapūritam ।। 2.83.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayadhvajena pradattaṃ jñānaṃ, droṇailanīlaśrīparvatānāṃ kolāṭacilaśaṃbhalanārāyaṇasarasāṃ divyarūpatā mokṣaṇaṃ jayadhvajasya muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।83।।



← adhyāyaḥ 083 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 84
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 085 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike camatkṛtiṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ।
brahmaputrapulastyasya bhāryāyā bhaktigocarām ।। 1 ।।
pulastyasya priyā bhāryā tṛṇabindoḥ sutā śubhā ।
ailavilā'bhavannāmnā tasyāṃ vai viśravāḥ sutaḥ ।। 2 ।।
abhavad bahuśāstrāṇāṃ jñātā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
pulastyaṃ tvekadā cailavilā'pṛcchad vṛṣān prati ।। 3 ।।
yugadharmāḥ purā cāsan kīdṛśā vada me pate ।
pulastyastu tataḥ prāha sarvān saṃkṣepato vṛṣān ।। 4 ।।
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam ।
dhyānaṃ tapaḥ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamadhvaraḥ ।। 5 ।।
dvāpare yajña eveti dānamekaṃ kalau yuge ।
brahmā kṛtayuge devaḥ sarvatra gatimānabhūt ।। 6 ।।
tretāyāṃ gatimān sūryaścā'bhavanmelanakṣamaḥ ।
dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ sākṣācca gatimānabhūt ।। 7 ।।
kalau kālasvarūpaśca devo rudraḥ pravartate ।
yatra tatra mahān kleśaḥ kalau vināśako yataḥ ।। 8 ।।
kṛte tu samasaṃkhyākāḥ kanyāścātha kumārakāḥ ।
āsan samānayugalā vṛttisteṣāmalolupā ।। 9 ।।।
prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sarvānandāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ ।
uttamā'dhamatā nāsti nirviśeṣāḥ purandhrikāḥ ।। 10 ।।
tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ balaṃ tuṣṭiḥ sthirā matiḥ ।
viśokā jñānabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā ।। 11 ।।
dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhāḥ parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
sadā niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ ।। 1 2।।
parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketāḥ kṣitiśrayāḥ ।
saṃkalpajanyabhojyāśca saṃkalpotthajalādanāḥ ।। 1 3।।
saṃkalpajanyasurasāḥ sadā śāntā yatheśvarāḥ ।
sarvamāsāmātmalabhyaṃ tadāsīd brahmasātkṛtam ।। 14।।
rasollāsāḥ sadā hyāsan kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛte yuge ।
catuḥsahasravarṣāṇāṃ vigame sandhirāgataḥ ।। 15।।
aṣṭaśatābdastatraiva rasollāso na vegavān ।
rāgaścāpi vilāsaśca samudbhavati vai śanaiḥ ।। 16।।
satyasiddhau prakṣīṇāyāmanyā siddhiḥ pravartate ।
apāṃ saukhye hirīsamāpte tadā meṣātmanā'mbarāt ।। 17।।
meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam ।
sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃpṛkto pṛthivītale ।। 18।।
jalaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃśca vartate sma sthalabhṛtam ।
tatra vṛkṣā vallikāśca prādurāsan rasabhṛtāḥ ।। 19।।
sarve pratyupabhogāśca tadā tebhyo bhavanti vai ।
vartayanti sma kalpākhyavṛkṣādibhyastadā prajāḥ ।।2.84.20।।
vṛkṣāstadā prajānāṃ ca nivāsāḥ ketanāni ca ।
āsan bhittivihīnāni sarvāṇyapi gṛhāṇyapi ।।2 1 ।।
vṛkṣāśritāḥ prajāḥ sarvā rāgalobhādidharṣitāḥ ।
svakīyatve ca pārakye vivādamāśrayan kvacit ।। 22।।
rāgalobhodbhavaḥ kleśastadā sthānamavāptavān ।
tena daivāstu te kalpadrumā nāśamatho gatāḥ ।।23 ।।
tatasteṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntāḥ śokitāḥ prajāḥ ।
kalpadrumān balahīnān sevājanyaphalapradān ।।24।।
avāpuḥ pṛthivītastā bījādyudbhavagocarān ।
vastrāṇi valkalākhyāni phalāni bhojanāni ca ।।25।।
puṣpāṇi tvābharaṇāni prasūyante sma yatnataḥ ।
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gṛdhno raso'tha bhojanam ।।26।।
amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu ।
phalebhyaḥ prasravantyeva rasā miṣṭāśca dhārayā ।। 27।।
taiḥ prajā vartayanti sma duṣṭāstuṣṭā gatajvarāḥ ।
atha tretottare kāle prajā lobhāvṛtāstadā ।। 28।।
viśeṣataḥ samabhavan balāt kṛtvā nijān drumān ।
paryagṛhṇanta ca madhu mākṣikaṃ ca phalādikam ।। 29।।
evaṃ kleśo nirbalānāṃ madhulābhe vinā'bhavat ।
vṛkṣā vilokya tu pakṣapātaṃ prajākṛtaṃ tadā ।। 2.84.30 ।।
praṇaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ bījodbhavā api drumāḥ ।
tadā śītātapavarṣābhiḥ pīḍā jāyate nṛṣu ।। 31 ।।
dvandvaiḥ sampīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni hi ।
gṛhabhittīḥ parṇakuṭīrvārtopāyānacintayan ।। 32 ।।
vṛṣṭijanyajalānyeva nimnagāni tu yatra ca ।
srotaḥsthāneṣu tiṣṭhanti garteṣu ca saraḥsu ca ।। 33 ।।
tatra vāsān pracakruśca vṛkṣasasyādijīvikāḥ ।
apāṃ bhūmeśca saṃyogādoṣadhayastadā'bhavan ।। 34।।
akṛṣṭapacyā api tāścānuptāśca kvacit kvacit ।
kvaciduptāśca sakaṇāḥ saphalāśca tadā'bhavan ।। 35।।
ṛtupuṣpaphalāstatra vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire ।
tretānte rāgalobhāḍhyāścāhaṃmamatvasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 36।।
avaśyaṃbhāvitārthena prajāścāsan sakalmaṣāḥ ।
prasahya sattayā paryagṛhṇanta sasyavāṭikāḥ ।। 37 ।।
vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścāpi prasahya tu yathābalam ।
naijāँścakruḥ prajā rāgānnadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān ।। 38।।
tatrāpi prabalā jātāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣakāḥ purā ।
brahmaṇā vai niyuktāste dīnarakṣākriyādiṣu ।। 39 ।।
varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavānajaḥ ।
maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ daṇḍaṃ tadā samasṛjat ।।2.84.40 ।।
yajñapravartanaṃ cāpi paśuhiṃsāvivarjanam ।
tretānte tāṃ vyavasthāṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyānvitāḥ ।।4 1 ।।
samarakṣan yathāyogyāṃ materbhedastato'bhavat ।
rāgo lobhaḥ pakṣapāto yuddhaṃ sampadviluṇṭhanam ।।।42।।
dvāpare tvāgate sarvaṃ prāvartata prajāsu vai ।
nagarāṇi ca rājyāni sīmakṣetrāṇi vāṭikāḥ ।।43 ।।
kṛṣṭapacyāḥ kaṇāścāpi prāvartanta tadā priye ।
avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vyādhyupadravāḥ ।।44।।
vāṅmanaḥkāyajāḥ kleśā abhavaँśca gṛhe gṛhe ।
prajāśca mithunotpādyāstretārdhottarakālataḥ ।।45।।
kvacit kvacittu saṃkalpaprajāścāsaṃstadā priye ।
dvāpare sarvathā kāmabījodbhavāḥ prajāḥ khalu ।।46।।
sāśrayāśca mṛṣāvīryā mṛṣāphalāstathā'bhavan ।
vāsanābalasaṃvyāptāścātmavīryavihīnakāḥ ।।47।।
siddhiśūnyāḥ prajāḥ sarvā vyavardhanta madārditāḥ ।
duḥkhānāṃ dvāpare cākasmikatā maraṇasya ca ।।48।।
tadbhayājjāyate tāsāṃ duḥkhamokṣavicāraṇā ।
vicārāccāpi vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ bhaktiśca mokṣaṇam ।।49।।
evaṃ dvāparadharmāśca varṇānāmabhavaँstadā ।
āśramāṇāṃ tathā dharmāḥ pṛthak pṛthak tato'bhavan ।।2.84.50।।
prāpte kalau kleśalābhe kleśavyākulitāḥ prajāḥ ।
tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ cāpi tapasvinām ।।51 ।।
sādhayanti janā nityaṃ tamasā madagarvitāḥ ।
kalau prabhārako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayaṃ tathā ।।52।।
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ ।
adhārmikā anācārā mahākopā'lpatejasaḥ ।।।53।।
anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhāstiṣye janāḥ suduṣprajāḥ ।
duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ ।।54।।
viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam ।
na dharmo vedadharmo hi kintu kalpita eva saḥ ।।55।।
śūdradharmāścaikavarṇāḥ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ ।
bhavantyeva prajāḥ sarvā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ ।।56।।
rājānaścaurakarmāṇo viprāḥ kāpaṭyabhoginaḥ ।
guravaḥ śiṣyahārāśca bhavantyeva kalipriyāḥ ।।57।।
bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā nārīhatyā nareśvare ।
sādhuhatyā satīhatyā dharmahatyā prajāsu ca ।।58।।
snānaṃ homo japo dānaṃ surārcanaṃ hareḥ smṛtiḥ ।
tyajyante mānavaistiṣye kāmalobhaparāyaṇaiḥ ।।59।।
devānsādhūn vṛṣān mokṣaṃ nindantyapi śriyaḥ patim ।
kurvantyanyāyakarmāṇi nikṛṣṭācārapanthinaḥ ।।2.84.60।।
kuśīlacaryāḥ pākhaṇḍairvṛthācāraiḥ samāvṛtāḥ ।
bahuyācanakāḥ sarve bhavantyeva kalau janāḥ ।।6 1।।
deśā rūkṣā aṭavīvat grāmā rūkṣāstu ghoṣavat ।
narā nāryastathā rūkṣāḥ premahīnāḥ parāśrayāḥ ।।62।।
sasyacaurāḥ kaṇacaurā vastracaurāḥ prahāriṇaḥ ।
caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhantā tathā'paraḥ ।।63।।
duḥkhabahulā rugṇāścotsādāścālpāyuṣo janāḥ ।
adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovyāptāḥ kalau prajāḥ ।।64।।
uccanīcāsanabhedo yogyatā pūjyatā nayaḥ ।
naranārīgauravādi naśyatyeva kalau yuge ।।65।।।
rājā prajāḥ kapaṭasya nartakā iva tiṣyake ।
dvijāḥ śūdrā bhavantyeva śūdrāścāṇḍālakāstathā ।।66।।
sarvadharmastveka eva bhojyānnavāsalagnake ।
peyāpeyavibhāgo na bhogyābhogyavihīnatā ।।67।।
satyā'satyaviveko na grāhyāgrāhyātilaṃghitā ।
kalpanākuladharmāṃśca kāmānukūlayoṣitaḥ ।।68।।
mohānukūlakāntaśca yatayo dhūrtadharmiṇaḥ ।
lokagānairdevatānāṃ kīrtanaṃ dharmavarjitam ।।69।।
jñānaṃ karma vinaṣṭaṃ ca bhavatyeva kalau sadā ।
kīṭamūṣakasarpāṇāṃ daṃśā bhavanti tiṣyake ।। 2.84.70।।
sarve duṣṭavratācārāḥ svārthamātrasuyoginaḥ ।
mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni hi ।।71 ।।
mantrakarmakarāścābhicārakā mārakāstathā ।
nirdayāśca śaṭhā dhūrtā ghātakā mānavāḥ kalau ।।72।।
māṃsādā madirāpāśca yonisambandhamātrakāḥ ।
liṃgasambandhamātrāśca dhanārthakṛtaghātakāḥ ।। 73 ।।
veṣācārasamāścāpi netrasatkāravarjitāḥ ।
viśvāsaghnāśca mitradhnā āśritaghnāḥ kalau yuge ।।74।।
gṛhaghnāśca kuṭumbaghnāḥ svīyaghnāśca kalau yuge ।
dharmaghnāścāpi dharmighnā mātṛghnāḥ pitṛghātakāḥ ।।75।।
snuṣāghnāḥ kanyakāghnāśca svasṛghnā bhrātṛghātakāḥ ।
ṣoḍaśādikasaṃskārairhīnāḥ sūtakavarjitāḥ ।।76।।
śaucahīnāḥ snānahīnā vratahīnāḥ kalau yuge ।
sūtrahīnā vivāhādividhivarjyā narāḥ striyaḥ ।।77।।
agnihīnā maṇḍapādihīnā homavivarjitāḥ ।
sadācāravihīnāśca gṛhācāravihīnakāḥ ।।78।।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇāḥ sarve sarvabhakṣāḥ kalau yuge ।
rākṣasā brāhmaṇā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ surāḥ ।।79।।
śvapacāśca piśācāśca samā bhavanti vai kalau ।
anyonyabhayakartāro'nyonyanāśavidhāyakāḥ ।।2.84.80।।
alajjāścāpi nirlajjāḥ sarvagauravavarjitāḥ ।
yatheṣṭabhogavantaśca kumārāḥ kanyakāḥ striyaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
keśayonistanadarśakā'mbarāḍhyāstu kanyakāḥ ।
kartryaścāpi ca kartāraḥ prakāśe guptakarmaṇām ।।82।।
hastamātraśarīrāśca romapaṭalavastrakāḥ ।
pañcahastadrumāścānte bhavantyeva kalau yuge ।।83।।
na rājā na prajābhāvo na śāsyaḥ śāsako na ca ।
na gṛhāṇi nivāsā na na śālāḥ pākasiddhaye ।।84।।
na gṛhe tvannacayitā na gṛhe vāripeyitā ।
na gṛhe śayanaṃ nāryā na patyurgṛhavāsitā ।।85।।
patipatnīkṛto yogo nahi tiṣṭhati vai kalau ।
aṣṭavarṣā madhyavegā dvādaśānte mṛtiḥ kalau ।।86।।
pañcottaraṃ sagarbhāśca vinā grāmaṃ nivāsitā ।
vānarīva tadā nārī sūtikā dūtikāṃ vinā ।।87।।
vinā khaṣṭvāṃ sūyate ca pṛthivyāṃ bālakaṃ tadā ।
varṣadvaye tadā gaurī dvivarṣānte tu rohiṇī ।।88।।
varṣatraye bhavet kanyā caturvarṣā rajasvalā ।।
ata ūrdhvaṃ sagarbhā ca māsaṣaṭke prasūyate ।।89।।
varṣe dve vai prasūtī ca rajaḥ sakṛt kṣaṇasthiram ।
maraṇaṃ ghaṭikākāle prāṇo naiva cirāyate ।।2.84.90।।
apatyāni mṛgaśāvādivaccaranti bhūtale ।
sasyarasaiḥ prapuṣyante pakṣadugdhāstu mātaraḥ ।।91।।।
pitṛnāma na caivāsti māturnāma kvacit kalau ।
dīkṣālopo gurorlopo mantralopo na cotsavāḥ ।।92।।
devānāṃ mānavānāṃ vā samājo na kalau yuge ।
idṃ kulamiti khyātiḥ kalau nāsti kuṭumbakam ।।93।।
pitṛśabdo guruśabdaḥ kalāvante na tiṣṭhati ।
na rājā rājyaniyamā daṇḍā vā śāsakastadā ।।94।।
na devo mandiraṃ sampradāyaḥ śāstraṃ purāvratam ।
brahmacaryaṃ na vai tatra yatitvaṃ gṛhasammatam ।।95।।।
sanyāso vidyate naiva śīlaṃ dharmo na vai tadā ।
vaidhavyaṃ vā vidhuratvaṃ dharmo naiva kalau yuge ।। 96।।
sādhvītvaṃ ca satītvaṃ ca dharmo naiva kalau tadā ।
kāmadharmaḥ paro dharmaḥ pākhaṇḍastatra saṃyamaḥ ।।97।।
narā nāryaḥ samarūpāḥ samaveṣāḥ samakriyāḥ ।
samapradhānabhāvāśca samadāyādabhāginaḥ ।।98।।
na tadā varṣagaṇanā na cāṃkagaṇanā'pi ca ।
na vidyābhyāsa evāpi tamovṛttijanāḥ kalau ।।99।।
kalāvante hi bhagavān prādurbhavati svāmirāṭ ।
kalerbalaṃ vināśyaiva kṛtasthitiṃ karoti saḥ ।। 2.84.10 0।।
evamuktā mayā patni dharmā yugacatuṣṭaye ।
yathā bhavanti te sarve kālayogena dehiṣu ।। 101 ।।
divasānte vedhasastu dhṛṣyamāṇo hi golakaḥ ।
svalpatāṃ yāti vegācca bhramaṇena ca pārthivaḥ ।। 1 02।।
divasā rātrya evāpi hrasvatāṃ yānti vai tadā ।
ghaṭikāśca kalāḥ kāṣṭhā māsāḥ kālā hrasanti ca ।। 103 ।।
sarvaṃ hrasvagatikaṃ ca kṣīṇāyuḥ parivartate ।
tato hrāsaḥ pralayaśca sampadyate dinātyaye ।। 1 04।।
ailavile! vayaṃ yāmastadā satyaṃ tvajā''śrayam ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! prāha pulastyo nijabhāminīm ।। 1 05।।
ailavilā tu tān dharmān śrutvā prāha patiṃ satī ।
yatra sarve yugadharmā vidyante pautramīdṛśam ।। 1 06।।
draṣṭumicchāmi cātraiva caturyugāśrayam ṛṣe! ।
pulastyaḥ prāha ca tathāstvityeva yoṣitaṃ nijām ।। 1 07।।
pautrasyāpi prasaṃgena bhagavān sammiliṣyati ।
lābhamevaṃ viditvaiva sutaṃ viśravasaḥ satī ।। 1 08।।
kṛṣṇayogapradaṃ vavre yaṃ so'bhūd rāvaṇastathā ।
ailavilā tapastepe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇopari ।। 1 09।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
ailavilātapo draṣṭumāyayau sahyaparvate ।। 2.84.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pulastyoktacaturyugadharmāḥ, ailavilāyai varadānaṃ, tapaścaryā cetinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 84 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ailavilā pulastyasya patnī tapaścacāra ha ।
dustaraṃ putraputrārthaṃ caturyugavṛṣānvitam ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīsvāminārāyaṇakṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
sahyādriśikhare tasyā āśrame viprarūpadhṛk ।। 2 ।।
jaṭāvalkalabhasmāḍhyo mālājapaparāyaṇaḥ ।
tasthāvāgatya nikaṭe drumā'dhaśchāyite sthale ।। 3 ।।
kandamūlaphalāhāro nityaṃ triṣavaṇastathā ।
bālarūpaḥ ṛṣiputro yathā kaścin manoharaḥ ।। 4 ।।
āgatya tiṣṭhati tatra kvacit prayāti līnatām ।
kvacid vṛkṣe śuko bhūtvā bhūtvā kokilakastathā ।। 5 ।।
mayūraścāpi haṃsaśca hariṇaḥ kvacideva vā ।
kvacidrūpamagastyasya dhṛtvā paśyati tattapaḥ ।। 6 ।।
kvacid bhūtvā viśravāśca kvacit pulaspyayoṣitām ।
pulastyasya sutānāṃ ca dhṛtvā rūpāṇi vai kvacit ।। 7 ।।
tapo nirīkṣate svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo muhuḥ ।
rādhikovāca he kṛṣṇa kiṃ puṇyaṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।। 8 ।।
kathaṃ vai bhagavāँstasyāḥ sannidhau vividhāni ca ।
rūpāṇi dhṛtavān svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha vai rādhe! brahmā putraṃ pulastyakam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te svāhā' ।। 2.85.1 0।।
ityārpayanmahāmantraṃ tataḥ so'pi nijāṃ priyām ।
ailavilāṃ cārpayattaṃ mantraṃ jajāpa sā'niśam ।। 1 1।।
tajjāpā''kṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
bhaktivaśyaḥ samīpe'syāstathārūpo'bhavaddhariḥ ।। 12।।
rādhike sa mayā dṛṣṭastadā kṛṣṇamṛgātmakaḥ ।
aṭamāno harikṛṣṇo vallabhaḥ śrīpatiḥ patiḥ ।। 1 3।।
ailavilātapaḥ paśyan śṛṇvan jāpaṃ virājate ।
sāpi pulastyapatnī vai jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇī ।। 14।।
parameśvaralabdhyarthaṃ yatate tāpasī satī ।
ākāśavāsinī pṛthvyāṃ kṛtvā tu vedikāṃ mṛdaḥ ।। 15।।
vahniṃ tatra nidhāyaiva prātaḥ pūjāṃ karoti sā ।
tato rudraṃ satīṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ cājaṃ savitṛjām ।। 16।।
sūryaṃ prabhāṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca sādhvīṃ sadvastubhiḥ surān ।
nityaṃ prapūjya ca mālājapaṃ karoti vai śatam ।। 17।।
tataḥ phalādi cāhṛtya madhyāhne haraye svayam ।
naivedyaṃ sajalaṃ cārpya tapaḥ karoti tiṣṭhati ।। 18।।
ekapādena vai sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthirā pratiṣṭhati ।
āsāyaṃ ca tataścārārtrikaṃ snātvā karoti ca ।। 19।।
rātrau karoti bhajanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ।
ardharātrottaraṃ nidrāṃ ghaṭikāmātramṛcchati ।।2.85.20।।
samutthāya hariṃ dhyātvā brāhme snātvā'rcanaṃ hare ।
nityavat prakarotyeva kandamūlaphalāśanā ।।21 ।।
varṣamātraṃ tathā kṛtvā tato vāryaśanā'bhavat ।
sūryodayaṃ samārabhyā''sāyaṃ tiṣṭhati nityadā ।।22।।
aṅguṣṭhaikasthirā caivaṃ varṣamātraṃ tapo'karot ।
tato divāniśaṃ sthairyaṃ samālambya sthitā'bhavat ।।23।।
vāyvāhārā hṛdayena pūjikā śrīharestadā ।
śarīraṃ varṣamātreṇa jaḍavat kāṣṭhatāṃ gatam ।। 24।।
pakṣiṇo yatra tiṣṭhanti kīṭāḥ kurvanti mṛdgṛham ।
evaṃ valmīkachannā sā varṣe catuṣṭaye'bhavat ।।25।।
varṣe tu pañcame tasyā mastake stambarohaṇam ।
tṛṇodgamaśca sañjāto dṛśyate sā na mānavī ।।26।।
tato brahmā haro viṣṇuḥ sūryo gaṇapatiḥ striyaḥ ।
āyayurdevadevyādyāḥ satītapaḥprakarṣitāḥ ।।27।।
devyaḥ stambatṛṇādīni dūrīcakrurmṛdāṃ cayāt ।
gaṇeśaścāpi sūryaśca mṛdo dūrīpracakratuḥ ।।28।।।
brahmā jalaṃ dadau tatrā'ñjalinā prokṣaṇaṃ śubham ।
rudraḥ prāṇapracāraṃ cā'kārayat prokṣaṇena tu ।।29।।
viṣṇustasyāścetanaṃ cā''vāhyat sarvavarṣmaṇi ।
tataḥ sā tūtthitā bodhaṃ prāptā'namat surān puraḥ ।।2.85.3 0।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te svāhā' ।
uvāca sādhvī cā'vyagrā rakṣantaṃ svāṃ nijaṃ prabhum ।।3 1 ।।
sasmāra devadeveśaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
devā ūcurvada sādhvi kiṃ te manasi vartate ।।32।।
dadmaste'bhīṣṭamatraiva varaṃ vṛṇvadya mā ciram ।
ityuktā sā prajagāda varaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt ।।33।।
vṛṇomyeva na cānyasmād devāḥ svastyastu vaḥ sadā ।
bhavantaḥ pūjitā nityaṃ mayā dharmo yato hi saḥ ।।34।।
lokasaṃgraharakṣārthaṃ svati vo'stu yadāgatāḥ ।
devyaḥ svasti ca yuṣmākaṃ sadā'stu kuśalaṃ tathā ।।35।।
ityuktvā svāgataṃ cakre hṛdayena sutuṣyatā ।
jajāpa śrīsvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।।36।।
tāvacchrībhagavāँstatra ya āsīt stambasaṃsthitaḥ ।
vṛkṣarūpaḥ sa valmīke prāvirāsa hariḥ svayam ।।37।।
dvibhujaścampakavarṇaḥ svarṇabhūṣāvirājitaḥ ।
koṭikoṭyarkatejobhirvyāpto divyākṛtiḥ patiḥ ।।38।।
divyasauvarṇabhūṣāḍhyo divyāmbaravirājitaḥ ।
divyaratnālimālābhiḥ śobhamānaḥ śrīvallabhaḥ ।।39।।
divyakaṭakaśobhāḍhyo divyamukuṭakuṇḍalaḥ ।
divyakaustubharaśanormikāyaṣṭivirājitaḥ ।।2.85.40।।
rādhāramāprabhāpārvatīhaṃsāmañjulā'rcitaḥ ।
saguṇāmāṇikīśāntāvijayālalitārcitaḥ ।।41 ।।
hemantabhagavaddevaprakāśakeśavādibhiḥ ।
pārṣadaiḥ sahitastatra suyuvā saṃsthito'bhavat ।।42।।
rūpānurūpā'vayavaḥ kare naktakamādadhan ।
tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ kurvan hasan hariḥ sthito'bhavat ।।43।।
karābhyāṃ sa spṛśaँstasyā mastake cāśiṣaṃ vadan ।
varārthaṃ ca prayuñjaँstāṃ devān prati vyalokayat ।।44।।
devaiḥ sākṣāddharirdṛṣṭaḥ stutaḥ stotraistu sāmagaiḥ ।
pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā tatastasthuḥ sureśvarāḥ ।।45।।
pupūja sā svāmikṛṣṇaparabrahmapareśvaram ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ bhāvaṃ dadau śrīpataye satī ।।46 ।।
varaṃ samārthayat tasmāccaturyugaguṇāśrayāḥ ।
pautrā me santu bhagavan yena yogo bhavettava ।।47।।
pautrāṇāṃ ca kuṭumbasya bhaktyā cānanyalabdhayā ।
yugadoṣeṇa doṣaiśca dveṣeṇāpi drutaṃ tava ।।48।।
bhaved bhaktiḥ smṛtirnityā snehādapyadhikā yataḥ ।
tava yogaṃ vinā mokṣo naiva bhavati dehinām ।।49।।
ānyopāyaiściraṃlabhyo dveṣairlabhyo drutaṃ bhavān ।
tava hastena maraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ niścitaṃ bhavet ।।2.85.50।।
ityevaṃ matkuṭumbārthe samicchāmi varaṃ prabho ।
dehi me ceti śrutvaiva tathā'stvityāha keśavaḥ ।।5 1।।
atha haryājñayā devāḥ satkṛtā prayayuśca te ।
ailavilā tapastyaktvā prasādaṃ bubhuje hareḥ ।।52।
jalaṃ phalaṃ rasaṃ madhu snātvā śuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ।
svāmikṛṣṇaṃ samapṛcchat pulastyasya priyā satī ।।53।।
ailavilovāca-
bhagavan saṃśayānme'tra chettumarhasi sarvavit ।
nāryāstu saṃśayān kaścidanyaśchettuṃ na cārhati ।।।54।।
kecid dhyānaṃ vṛṣaṃ cānye vivekaṃ yogasādhanām ।
brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ pātivratyaṃ patnīvrataṃ pare ।।55।।
satyaṃ tyāgamahiṃsāṃ satītvaṃ sanyāsamityapi ।
dānaṃ dayāṃ cādhyayanaṃ praśaṃsanti tathetare ।।56।।
tīrthayātrāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ nigrahaṃ satsamāgamam ।
sarvārpaṇaṃ prapattiṃ vā gurvarpaṇaṃ virāgitām ।।57।।
jñānaṃ brahmamayaṃ caiṣāṃ kiṃ śreyo brūhi me prabho! ।
yadi vā vidyate cānyad guptaṃ tadvaktumarhasi ।।58।।
śrutvā cailavilāvākyaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
prāha divyaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ parātparam ।।59।।
hitāya sarvajīvānāṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ sṛtam ।
avācyaṃ sarvagūḍhārthaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam ।। 2.85.6 0।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyuvāca-
paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ paradhāmapradaṃ param ।
mamā'kṣarāhvayaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra kuṃkumavāpikā ।।6 1 ।।
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ vāsāt saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī ।
aśvapaṭṭasaroramyā lomaśāśramaśobhitā ।।62।।
tatra bhaktā ailavile! madīyaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ ।
nivasanti mahātmānaḥ parāṃ bhaktiṃ mamāśritāḥ ।।63।।
uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ ca yat ।
sthānānāmuttamaṃ sthānaṃ kṣetraṃ me'kṣarasaṃjñitam ।।64।।
bhūtale naiva saṃlagnaṃ cidākāśasthitaṃ hi tat ।
adivyā nahi paśyanti muktāḥ paśyanti tad hṛdā ।।65।।
sthānaṃ priyatamaṃ me tad guptaṃ śīghraṃ pramuktidam ।
madbhaktā yatra vartante māmeva ca bhajanti vai ।।66।।
tatra yānti narā nāryaste'pi prayānti matpadam ।
anyadhāmāni dṛṣṭvaiva māmeva praviśanti te ।।67।।
dattaṃ japtaṃ kṛtaṃ ceṣṭaṃ taptaṃ dhyātaṃ hutaṃ śrutam ।
sevitaṃ bhojitaṃ jñātaṃ sarvaṃ tatrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ।।68।।
janmāntarasahasreṣu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tu sañcitam ।
kṣetre'kṣare praviṣṭasya sarvaṃ drāg yāti saṃkṣayam ।।69।।
mānavāstu narā nāryaḥ saṃkarāścātipāpinaḥ ।
pāpayonigatā duṣṭāḥ striyaḥ saṃkīrṇayogajāḥ ।।2.85.70।।
mlecchāścaṇḍālajāścāpi kīṭāḥ pipālikā mṛgāḥ ।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarīsṛpāstṛṇāni pādapāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
vallayo jaḍajātāśca yadi kṣetre'kṣare mṛtāḥ ।
te tu sacandratilakā mahāhastyādivāhanāḥ ।।72।।
ramye mamā'kṣare divyāste prayānti pramokṣaṇam ।
akṣare tu mṛtaḥ kaścinna yāti narakaṃ hyaghī ।। 73।।
mamā'nugrahamāptāste sarve yāntyakṣaraṃ padam ।
kiṃ vaktavyaṃ bhavedatra cailavile mama sthale ।।74।।
mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ jñātvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam ।
gatiṃ jñānena hatvā'pi vaset kṣetre'kṣare mama ।।75।।
yatra tatra vipannasya gatistvatra hi mokṣadā ।
prasādād dahyati pāpaṃ vāsāttu divyatā bhavet ।।76।।
darśanānmama muktiśca jāyate tvakṣare pade ।
mama yogānmahāmuktirjāyate me pare pade ।।77।।
apuṇyā nahi paśyanti māyāpaṭalacakṣuṣaḥ ।
tamovṛttā na paśyanti divyaṃ kṣetraṃ mamā'kṣaram ।।78।।
te tu viṇmūtraretobhṛddehe viśanti vai muhuḥ ।
hanyamāno'pi yo dehī viśed vighnaśatairapi ।।79।।
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasaro'bhitaḥ ।
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yatra gatvā na śocati ।।2.85.80।।
janmamṛtyujarāmuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ mamāspadam ।
apunarmaraṇānāṃ tad gaditaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām ।।8 1 ।।
na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñairnāpi vidyayā ।
prāpyate gatirutkṛṣṭā yā'kṣare labhyate parā ।।82।।
nānāvarṇā vivarṇāśca caṇḍālādyā jugupsitāḥ ।
kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehāśca nikṛṣṭaiḥ pātakairyutāḥ ।।83।।
teṣāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ cākṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ paraṃ padam ।
akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ jñānamakṣaraṃ tatparaṃ padam ।।84।।
akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ vattvamakṣaraṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
dhṛtvā vai naiṣṭhikīṃ dīkṣāmakṣare ye vasanti te ।।85।।
matto labdhvā paraṃ jñānaṃ yānti me paramaṃ padam ।
prabhāsaṃ svarṇanagarī vastrāpathaṃ ca narmadā ।।86।।
nārāyaṇasaraccāpi puṣkaraṃ kauravaṃ sthalam ।
gaṃgā badarikā śālagrāmaṃ śrīśaila ityapi ।।87।।
himālayaśca kedāro gayā gokarṇamityapi ।
kṛṣṇā godāvarī sindhurgomatī brahmaputrikā ।।88।।
nārāyaṇīsariccāpi vijñaturīyakaṃ saraḥ ।
tūṃgānīkasaro nyāsasaraścaṇḍasarastathā ।।89।।
naṣṭajarānadī raktavārdhirnīlābdhirityapi ।
nīparā dīnayūpā ca senā mahābṛhatsaraḥ ।।2.85.90।।
antārkivartulaṃ cāpi sūparyuparikaṃsaraḥ ।
pannāmnī kālimā cāpi yāneśī śvetavāridhiḥ ।।9 1 ।।
uralādrirmānasaṃ ca saro brahmasarovaram ।
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarastathā ।।92।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgikā cāpi murānadī turunadī ।
aitānadī mikāṃgā ca irāvatī nadī tathā ।। 93 ।।
hutalīnā ca gaṃgā'pi sābharākhyaṃ mahat saraḥ ।
etāni puṇyasthānāni pṛthivyāṃ viśrutāni tu ।।94।।
tāni tvāyānti satataṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
tanmṛtāḥ paramaṃ mokṣaṃ na yānti te yathā'kṣare ।।95।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sākṣādahaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
brahmahradaṃ samādāya vartāmyeva nirantaram ।।96।।
brahmahrado'nantajanmakṛtapāpāni nāśayet ।
anyatra sulabhā gaṃgā śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ japo vratam ।।97।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tatsarvaṃ tvatidurlabham ।
yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi tvadhārmiko janaḥ ।। 98।।
akṣaraṃ tatpadaṃ prāpya punāti kulasaptakam ।
yajeta juhuyānnityaṃ dadātyarcayate tathā ।।99।।
kṣetre'kṣare tu māṃ bhaktastasyā'nantaguṇaṃ phalam ।
tatra gatvā tu ye bhaktā arcayanti stuvanti mām ।। 2.85.10 0।।
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste jñeyā mama pārṣadāḥ ।
anyatra yāgājjñānādvā sanyāsādatha yogataḥ ।। 10 1।।
prāpyate tatparaṃ sthānaṃ sahasreṇa tu janmanām ।
akṣare ye vasantyete vindantyekena janmanā ।। 1 02।।
tatra yogastapo jñānaṃ vrataṃ cāhaṃ nirantaram ।
māṃ samāsādya bhaktānāṃ gantavyaṃ nā'sti cā'param ।। 103 ।।
tadeva guhyaṃ guhyānāṃ paraṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ matam ।
jñānadhyānaniviṣṭānāṃ paramānandamicchatām ।। 104।।
tatra dadāmyahaṃ mantraṃ tvakṣare kṣetrake mama ।
yattatparataraṃ tattvaṃ so'haṃ kṣetraṃ ca tanmama ।। 1 05।।
bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye ca hṛdaye'pi ca mūrddhani ।
yasmāt kasmād yāti cā'sustvakṣare'tra pramucyate ।। 1 06।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī vasāmyaham ।
māmāsādyā'tipāpāśca prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।। 1 07।।
nārāyaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭho'haṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
nārāyaṇāstathā cānye śaṃbhvādyā vaiṣṇavā api ।। 1 08।।
dhāmānyapi ca sarvāṇi dhāmasthā muktakoṭayaḥ ।
brahmāṇḍeśvaravaryāśca devādyāstīrthakoṭayaḥ ।। 1 09।।
vasāmastatra me kṣetre'kṣare cāśvasaro'bhitaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikā brahmarūpiṇī muktasatpurī ।।2.85.1 10 ।।
pāpopahatamatayo naiva paśyanti divyatām ।
na teṣāṃ vīkṣituṃ śakyaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ mama bhūtalam ।। 11 1।।
puṇyavāsāḥ smarantyenāṃ purīṃ divyena cakṣuṣā ।
paśyanti yogasiddhā ca lokāntare'pi vāsinaḥ ।। 11 2।।
āgacchatāmidaṃ sthānaṃ sevituṃ mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām ।
mṛtānāṃ pathi cetteṣāṃ punarjanma na vidyate ।। 113 ।।
yogī vā'pyathavā'yogī pāpī vā puṇyakṛttamaḥ ।
na lokavacanāt pitrorna cāpi guruvādataḥ । ।1 14।।
matiṃ cotkramayet sākṣādakṣarakṣetragāṃ śubhām ।
kuṃkumavāpikāvāsaṃ cā'śvasarojalāplavam ।। 1 15।।
rādhike! bhagavānevaṃ cailavilāṃ prabodhya ca ।
virarāma kṣaṇaṃ sā'pi śrutvā''ścaryamavāpa ha ।। 116 ।।

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminā ailavilāyai kathitamakṣaramāhātmyamitināmā pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 85 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 085 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 86
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 087 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! paścādailavilā'vadaddharim ।
bhagavanme'sti jijñāsā tat kṣetrā'kṣaramīkṣitum ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ sahyaparvatāt ।
āropya garuḍe caitre vyomnā'kṣaraṃ samāyayau ।। 2 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ divyamakṣarasaṃjñitam ।
saccidānandadhāmābhaṃ nityānanditamānavam ।। 3 ।।
divyadehisamavyāptaṃ devapitrādisevitam ।
brahmahradodasanmiśrā'śvapaṭṭakasaro'nvitam ।। 4 ।।
sahasrarṣigaṇaiścāpi kṛtāvāsaṃ samujjvalam ।
pāvanaṃ pāvanānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam ।। 5 ।।
mokṣadānāṃ paraṃ mokṣapradaṃ sarvāghanāśakam ।
śatasāhasraprāsādaiḥ śobhitaṃ vanavallibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
divyadrumaiḥ samudyānaiḥ sahasraiḥ parivāritam ।
jalāśayaiḥ śubhārāmaiḥ phalipuṣpisugandhitam ।। 7 ।।
kalpadrumaiḥ samṛddhaṃ ca cintāmaṇiprabhāsitam ।
vardhitaṃ munibhirnityaṃ yajñā'dhyayanabhaktibhiḥ ।। 8 ।।
āśritaṃ cātithibhiśca brahmadhāmagamaiḥ priyaiḥ ।
priyābhiḥ śrīhareryacca kṛtakautukamaṃgalam ।। 9 ।।
amṛtānāṃ hradairyuktaṃ yāvatsṛṣṭiniṣevitam ।
gīrvāṇabhāṣākuśalairvaidikairdhārmikairyutam ।। 2.86.1 0।।
sauvarṇadaṇḍasaṃrājaddīrghadhvajasahasrakam
sāptabhaumāḍhyanilayaiḥ śṛṃgasaudhairvirājitam ।। 1 1।।
vyomayānairyatra muktā uḍḍayanti narāḥ striyaḥ ।
svargagāḥ pakṣiṇo yatra saṃskṛtajñāḥ śukādayaḥ ।। 1 2।।
vadanti vaidikīṃ bhāṣāṃ gohastyādyā api dvijaiḥ ।
agnayo yatra vartante pradīptā vedikāsthale ।। 13।।
dānāni yatra dīyante sṛṣṭipālairdivāniśam ।
yātrikā yatra vartante lakṣaśo mokṣabhāginaḥ ।। 14।।
śrotṛṇāṃ kathakānāṃ ca sabhāsthalasahasrakam ।
devapratimāprāsādāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ।। 15।।
vidyante kānakaivyomni kalaśaiḥ śṛṃgaśobhanaiḥ ।
vanaspatayo dṛśyante nikuñjā gṛhamedhinām ।। 16।।
āśramāḥ ṛṣivaryāṇāṃ śobhante svargiṇāmiva ।
tāpasā yatra vidyante koṭiśo'śvasaro'bhitaḥ ।। 17।।
sādhavo yatra lokānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prakurvate ।
sādhvyo brahmapriyā yatra brahmavrataparāḥ sadā ।। 18।।
vasanti kṛṣṇasevārthaṃ kṣetrā'kṣarakṛtāśrayāḥ ।
jñānayajñā brahmayajñā dānayajñā bhavanti ca ।। 19।।
sevāyajñā mokṣayajñāstṛptiyajñā bhavanti ca ।
kathāyajñāḥ satataṃ ca viprarṣayo vasanti ca ।।2.86.20।।
vratayajñāḥ satrayajñā udyāpanavidhiprathāḥ ।
tīrthayajñā harernāmnāṃ kīrtanakratavaḥ sadā ।।21।।
vartante satataṃ yatra devārādhanarītayaḥ ।
divyapāvanahṛdayā vasanti yatra dehinaḥ ।।।22।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin parabrahmetivādinaḥ ।
kambharānandanakṛṣṇa gopālātmaja mādhava ।।23।।
śrīpate rādhikākānta sarvātman bhava me priya ।
ityevaṃ bhajamānāstaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vasanti te ।।24।।
vairahīnāstiraścopi dadarśailavilā''śrame ।
lomaśasya ramaṇīye brahmapriyādyadhiṣṭhite ।।25।।।
mūrtayastannivāsinyastejaḥpracuraśobhanāḥ ।
tayā vyomnā vīkṣitā vai yānasthayailayā tadā ।।26।।
bhramaṇaṃ tadvimānena kṛtvā kṣetrapradakṣiṇam ।
avātatāra prāsāde kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā ।।27।।
saha śrīsvāminā sārdhaṃ yayau śrīkambharāṃ prati ।
dadarśa pūjayāmāsa vavande ca nanāma ca ।।28।।
tato gopālakṛṣṇaṃ sā yayau nanāma pādayoḥ ।
tato gajāsanaṃ gatvā svāminaṃ sahayāyinam ।।29।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛtapariśramam ।
bālarūpaṃ parabrahma siṣeve dehamardanaiḥ ।।2.86.30।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre dāsīva śrīharestataḥ ।
tīrthānyaśvasaraḥsthāni yayau sasnau vidhānataḥ ।।3 1।।
jalaṃ kuṃkumavāpyāśca papau dadhāra mastake ।
tataḥ śrīlomaśaṃ natvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ।।32।।
brahmapriyāḥ sarvakanyā militvā mandiraṃ yayau ।
bālakṛṣṇastvailavilā bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ।।33।।
pāyayāmāsa madhuraṃ vāri svacaraṇāmṛtam ।
pāvayāmāsa bhaktāṃ svāṃ rañjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।34।।
tataḥ sā'kṣarabhūmiṃ tāṃ vilokya sthātumānasā ।
prārthayatparamātmānaṃ sadā vāsaṃ satī yadā ।।35।।
caitre harirdadau tasyai rūpadvayaṃ samaṃ śubham ।
chāyāṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa pulastyaṃ prati vai tadā ।।36 ।।
ailavilāṃ divyarūpāmarakṣat svāntike sadā ।
brahmavratadharāṃ sādhvīṃ sādhudharmānvitāṃ satīm ।।37।।
atha tasyā varadānaṃ saphalaṃ samajāyata ।
viśravaso'bhavanpatnyaścatasraḥ kulavardhikāḥ ।।38।।
puṣpotkaṭā ca vākā ca kaikasī devavarṇinī ।
jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ yakṣaṃ suṣuve devavarṇinī ।।39।।
kaikasyajanayat putraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam ।
kubhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam ।।2.86.40।।
puṣpotkaṭā'pyajanayat putrān viśravasaḥ śubhān ।
mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā ।।41 ।।
kuṃbhīnasīṃ tathā śṛṃgīmanyāśca śatakanyakāḥ ।
vākājāstriśirāścaiva vidyujjihvaśca dūṣaṇaḥ ।।42।।
krūraṃ kanyāśataṃ cāpi paulastyavaṃśajā daśa ।
rakṣobhāvayutāḥ sarvayugadharmāśrayāstathā ।।43।।।
tapoyuktā dānayuktā rāgayuktāḥ sakalmaṣāḥ ।
satyā'satyobhayayuktā baladarpasamanvitāḥ ।।44।।
kalidharmāśritāścāpi yannāśārthaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
rāmarūpaṃ vidhatte ca prahanti rākṣasāँstataḥ ।।45।।
pāpāni kṣālayitvā te yānti vaikuṇṭhavāsitām ।
ailavilāvaradānapratāpena tu vaṃśajān ।।46।।
sabalān rākṣasān kṛṣṇacakraṃ hanti yuge yuge ।
rādhike mama cakraṃ vā jalaṃ vā tulasīdalam ।।47।।
padaṃ vā yena samprāptaṃ mukto bhavati ko'pi yaḥ ।
yakṣo vā rākṣaso vā'pi dānavo daitya ityapi ।।48।।।
viśravāḥ siṃhale dvīpe yayau vaṃśayutastataḥ ।
ailavilā tapaḥ sthāne cakre yatra hariḥ svayam ।।49।।
tadrakṣāṃ ca tapaso'pi parīkṣāṃ pracakāra ha ।
tattīrthaṃ cailavaileyaṃ śṛṃgaṃ sahyādribhūbhṛtaḥ ।।2.86.50।।
sajalaṃ jalakuṇḍena prasravaṇena rājitam ।
pāvanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādarajonvitam ।।51।।
sañjātaṃ mokṣadaṃ yatra vṛkṣastambātmako hariḥ ।
samabhūd varṣamātraṃ vai varṣamātraṃ śukādayaḥ ।।52।।
hariṇā dhṛtarūpāśca tadvaṃśā vaiṣṇavāśca te ।
sahyādrau sahyapakṣistrījanyāste harivaṃśajāḥ ।।53 ।।
divyā divyasvarūpāśca vasanti susukhānvitāḥ ।
yatra vṛkṣāḥ pāvanāśca harivaṃśodbhavāstathā ।।54।।
yatrā'vagrahaleśo'pi sahyādrau na kadācana ।
yatrā'naladavo nāsti na hiṃsropadravastathā ।।55।।
śvetavarṇāśca kariṇaścaturdantā mahocchrayāḥ ।
harivaṃśodbhavā yatra vartante devavāhanāḥ ।।56 ।।
śarabhāścocchritā yatra harivaṃśodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ ।
śubhravarṇā vasantyeva dviśuṇḍāḥ siṃhajātayaḥ ।।57।।
śvetāḥ svastikayuktāśca bhujagāḥ pāvanāstathā ।
niḥkṣveḍā harivaṃśotthāḥ śvetā mayūrajātayaḥ ।।58।।
vartante divyarūpāste harervaṃśodbhavā hi te ।
sahyādriḥ sarvathā tīrthottamaṃ tasya vanāni ca ।।59।।
pañcavarṣāṇi vai hareryogāt pāvitryavanti ca ।
paṭhanācchravaṇād rādhe bhuktimuktipradāni ca ।।2.86.60।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ailavilāyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāgamanaṃ rūpadvayaṃ, harivaṃśīyaprajāyāḥ sahyādrau vāsaścetinirūpaṇanāmā
ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 86 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 086 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 87
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 088 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca -
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bhaktā harergṛhṇanti sadguṇān ।
duṣṭā guṇeṣu doṣāँścāropya gṛhṇanti durguṇān ।। 1 ।।
viśravasastu putrasya kharasya rākṣasasya vai ।
khacaryāmabhavat putro hyadharmajīvasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kaṭyāṃ vakro bhagnapṛṣṭho gaṇḍe godhākhyadūṣaṇaḥ ।
kapardākṣaḥ sadā śvāse durgandhāḍhyaḥ śiśupriyaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sakalmaṣo'tikāpaṭyācāro viśvāsaghātakaḥ ।
janmanā tāḍitā padbhyāṃ mātā mṛteti mātṛhā ।। 4 ।।
ghūkasvaraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ picchatulyaśiroruhaḥ ।
pṛṣṭhaliṅgī kuṇṭhakarṇo bahirdaṃṣṭro'timatsaraḥ ।। 5 ।।
utpannamātraduḥkhakṛdbālānāṃ dharṣako'bhavat ।
ekadā sa yayau nadyāstaṭe rantuṃ sabālakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
carmakārasya vāseṣu cāntyajānāṃ gṛheṣu ca ।
rikteṣu bālarakṣeṣu jyeṣṭhāstu karmaṇe gatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
tatra bālāṃstāḍayitvā bhakṣayāmāsa tadgṛhe ।
śvamāṃsaṃ madyapānaṃ ca pracakāra papau jalam ।। 8 ।।
tadā bālairmilitvā ca dhṛtvā baddhvā'ntyajairbalāt ।
kṣārakuṇḍe vinikṣipto durgandhe svalpakardame ।। 9 ।।
śilayā chāditastatra kuṇḍyāṃ kṣārapaṭasya saḥ ।
divāniśaṃ sa vai kuṇḍyāṃ kuṇḍīgandhaṃ samagrahīt ।। 2.87.10 ।।
māsārdhaṃ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ ubhukṣitastṛṣākulaḥ ।
carmakṣālanajaṃ vāri cārmakardamamityapi ।। 11 ।।
sūkṣmakīṭodbhavaṃ kuṇḍyāṃ bhakṣayāmāsa pāpakṛt ।
rākṣaso jātijo yaśca cāṇḍālagṛhabhojanaḥ ।। 12।।
carmakuṇḍakṛtāvāsaścarmakardamabhakṣakaḥ ।
mātṛhāḥ śiśumāraśca ko'smātpāpataro bhavet ।। 13 ।।
rādhike! tādṛśo'dharmajīvo nāmnā mahāsuraḥ ।
antyajaiścarmakāraiśca āvalīrañjanāmbaraḥ ।।14।।
niṣkāsya kuṇḍito duṣṭastāḍitaḥ ṣaṇḍhitastathā ।
siṃhale dvīpake tasthau raṇānte vanibhakṣakaḥ ।। 15।।
paśūn pakṣigaṇāँścāpi kvacit kuṭumbajā'rbhakān ।
dhṛtvā karoti tadghātaṃ bhakṣayatyeva tānapi ।। 16 ।।
ekadā bhaktarāṭ tatra vibhīṣaṇo hareḥ priyaḥ ।
gṛṇan rāmeti kṛṣṇeti nārāyaṇeti sañcaran ।। 17।।
vihartuṃ tena mārgeṇa yayau vanāni vīkṣitum ।
tatrainaṃ vīkṣayāmāsā'dharmajīvaṃ mahāsuram ।। 18।।
uvāca tvaṃ kathamatra vartase nirjane suta ।
ehi gṛhaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sukham ।। 1 9।।
mā duḥkhaṃ vaha śuṣke'trā'raṇye raṇe tu nirjane ।
śrutvā vibhīṣaṇaṃ prāha pitṛjyeṣṭhaṃ sagarvakaḥ ।।2.87.20।।
ko hariḥ kaśca kṛṣṇo'sti nārāyaṇo'pi ko'sti vai ।
nainaṃ jānāmi kaścāste kasmād bhaje'vicāritam ।। 21 ।।
bhakto vibhīṣaṇaḥ prāha harirduḥkhaharo'sti saḥ ।
parabrahma svayaṃ divyo divyākṣaranivāsakṛt ।।22।।
rākṣaso'dharmajīvastu prāha dhanāpahārakaḥ ।
dravyāpahārako nāryādyapahāraka eva saḥ ।।23।।
hārakastvanyasamṛddheścauraḥ kaścid bhavet hariḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ pāpaṃ duṣṭakarma tatkṛt kṛṣṇo bhaveddhi saḥ ।। 24।।
nārāsvapsvayanaḥ kaścit nadīstho dhīvaro bhavet ।
jalahārakabhṛtyo vā kiṃkaraḥ kasyacidbhavet ।।25।।
jale vāsakaro vā'yaṃ sarpo matsyo'thavā bhavet ।
paraḥ śatrurbrahma mahān mahāśatrurbhaveddhi saḥ ।।26।।
divyo dhūrto dyūtavettā vyasanī kaścideva saḥ ।
akṣaiḥ pāśaiḥ ramate ca rāti gṛhṇāti nāṇakam ।।27।।
dyūtagṛhe nivāsī ca bhavet kaścidaghātmakaḥ ।
vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ prāha paramātmā pareśvaraḥ ।।28।।
puruṣottama evā'yaṃ bhagavānīśvareśvaraḥ ।
muktā'dhipaḥ pare dhāmni rājamāno'sti putraka ।।29।।
rākṣaso'dharmajīvaśca prāha nā'yaṃ tathā pitaḥ ।
paṃ pānaṃ madyajaṃ tatra ramate tvātmanā svayam ।।2.87.3 0।।
madyapānādilubdhaḥ sa madyapaḥ paramo bhavet ।
parasya dīnalokasya duḥkhakṛcceśvaro bhavet ।।3 1।।
puru sinoti pāpāni cā'dhikaṃ tamasā''vṛtaḥ ।
tāmasaḥ pāpakṛccā'yaṃ bhavet। sa puruṣottamaḥ ।।32।।
bhagaṃ guhyaṃ ca vā tasya nārīcihnaṃ bhavet khalu ।
bhagavān guptanārī sā bhavet puruṣaveṣiṇī ।।33।।
īśvarāṇāṃ mādṛśānāṃ yoddhṝṇāmiśubhirhataḥ ।
na rakṣituṃ svayaṃ śaktaḥ svaṃ bhavedīśvareśvaraḥ ।।34।।
muktā yāḥ patibhirnāryo gṛhānniṣkāsitāśca yāḥ ।
tāsāmadhipaḥ sa bhaved vyabhicāriśiromaṇiḥ ।।35।।
pare dhāmni gṛhe nityaṃ vasati parabhūsthitaḥ ।
gṛhadvāravihīnaḥ sa bhavedvā bhikṣukaḥ pitaḥ! ।।36।।
vibhīṣaṇaśca taṃ prāha putra! vyūhasvarūpadhṛk ।
sarvāvatārahetuḥ sa sarvaśaktidharaḥ prabhuḥ ।।37।।
golokeśaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhadhāmeśo vai paraḥ pumān ।
yogigamyo'ntarātmā ca mokṣadaśceti taṃ bhaja ।।38।।
adharmajīvarakṣo'pi prāha manye sa vañcakaḥ ।
vañcanārthaṃ tu lokānāṃ vyūhya vyūhya tu veṣadhṛk ।।39।।
kvacinnaṭaḥ kvacidgopaḥ kacidrājakumāravat ।
kvacidvipro bhavatyeva vañcako vyūhavān bhavet ।।2.87.40।।
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ loke vai nimnakarmaṇām ।
hetuḥ kartā nimnavarṇo bhavet kaścid vivarṇajaḥ ।।41 ।।
sarveṣu prāṇiṣu śastraśaktyākhyasya prayojakaḥ ।
bhavet sa ghātakī kaściditi manye pitaḥ khalu ।।।42।।
prasahya bhavati kaṣṭapradaḥ kaścid bhavedaghī ।
gavāṃ sa vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vai loke samūhake mahān ।।43।।
mahāvṛṣabho vā kaścid bhavedvā vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।
kuṇṭhitaṃ dhāmavāsādi gṛhakuṭyādivarjitaḥ ।।44।।
paraḥ śatrusvarūpo vā pumān bhaveddhi rakṣasām ।
samaśīlairyogavadbhirgamya_ sāptapadīnakam ।।45।।
tasmādasajjanaḥ kaściditi manye pitaḥ khalu ।
antaraṃ bhinnatā yasya kāme manasi cātmani ।।46।।
vāci vā bhinnatā tasmād viśvāsaghātako bhavet ।
mokṣaṃ sarvaṃ samācchidya durbalasya vināśanam ।।47।।
manye karoti kaścit sa hiṃsro durbalaghātakaḥ ।
kastaṃ bhajedasantaṃ vai guṇāgryaiśca vivarjitam ।।48।।
vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ prāha sa tu vidvān guṇāśrayaḥ ।
vedavid vedaśāstrādikartā śīlavratādimān ।।49।।
sarvadharmāśrayaḥ sādhukarmakaḥ śāntisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
adharmajīvo rakṣo'tha prāha vidvānna cāsti saḥ ।।2.87.50।।
na raṃbhaṇaṃ vijānāti gītiṃ jānāti naiva ca ।
abhicārānna jānāti māyāṃ jānāti naiva ca ।।51 ।।
ato naiva bhavedvā sa vidvān pitaḥ kadācana ।
guṇo rajjurgavāṃ dohakāryārthaṃ yasya vidyate ।।52।।
skandhe tasmād bhaved gopo guṇāśrayaḥ pitaḥ khalu ।
vedaṃ vā vedikāṃ grāmacatuṣke nirmitāṃ janaiḥ ।।53।।
pāṣāṇānāṃ mṛdāṃ vā tāṃ kartuṃ jānāti kuṃbhakṛt ।
kubhakāro bhaved vā'yaṃ vedikāśilpavit khalu ।।54।।
śaṃ śātanaṃ hi keśānāṃ karotyastreṇa mastake ।
nāpito'yaṃ bhavedvā ca romaśatrupraśastravān ।।55।।
śīlaṃ cā'skhalanaṃ dharmo vrataṃ kṛcchrādi yattapaḥ ।
atti khādati cobhaṃ tat tādṛgdharmavighātakaḥ ।।56।।
śīlavratādanaścāyaṃ bhavet kaściddhi bhāṇḍakaḥ ।
sarve dharmāḥ paśudharmāstadvān vā sa paśurbhavet ।।।57।।
sādhoḥ karma gṛhasthānāṃ viruddhaṃ gṛhabhañjanam ।
sanyāsādisvarūpaṃ tatkārako'yaṃ yatirbhavet ।।58।।
jaḍo vā syād vicitto vā śāntisaṃbhṛta ekalaḥ ।
vibhīṣaṇaśca taṃ prāha putra vipro'sti mādhavaḥ ।।59।।
yajñopavītasandhartā kleśatāpapraśāmakaḥ ।
mahāvidyāśrayaḥ śāstraracanākārakaḥ svayam ।।2.87.60।।
eka evā'dvitīyo'yaṃ tīrthayātrākaro'cyutaḥ ।
adharmajīvo rakṣastu prāha vipro bhavenna saḥ ।।6 1।।
viṃ pakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ prāti gṛhṇāti mṛgayūryathā ।
tasmād vyādho bhavet kaścit pakṣimāro'thavā paśuḥ ।।62।।
mādhavo mātṛgāmī vā bhavet kaścit paśuprajaḥ ।
yasya niyāmako nāsti yasya nāsti dhavastathā ।।63।।
mātṛhīnaḥ pitṛhīno bhavet kaścid vanecaraḥ ।
itaḥ prāptaśca viḥ pakṣī taṃ yajñasyaiva sannidhau ।।64।।
san dhārayati bhakṣyārthaṃ śakunādo bhaveddhi saḥ ।
kleśaistāpaiḥ prakarṣaiśca śāmako lokanāśakaḥ ।।65।।
tasmād viplavakartā sa bhavet kaścittu ghātakī ।
mahāvidyāḥ kāmavidyāścoccāṭanīṃ vināśinīm ।।66।।
māriṇīṃ mohinīṃ cedvā jānātyayaṃ tadā pitaḥ ।
śvapāko vā'tha cāṇḍālo malino vā bhaveddhi saḥ ।।67।।
śāstreṣu racanāṃ cāyaṃ pratāraṇasya kārakaḥ ।
pratārako bhavet kaścit nahi śāstrasya kārakaḥ ।।68।।
ekākī tu vane'raṇye bhraman kuṭumbahīnakaḥ ।
advitīyo vidhuro'yaṃ tīrthamuṇḍī ca vā bhavet ।।69।।
na cyavate dhanaṃ dāne daridraḥ sa bhavet pitaḥ ।
sādhudharmavihīnaśca kapaṭī nindakaḥ khalaḥ ।।2.87.70।।
pracchannacauro nārīṇāṃ cāñcalyasya pravardhakaḥ ।
asaṃkhyavāranārīṇāṃ bhrāmako veṣadhārakaḥ ।।71।।
gopīnāmadṛśyakartā siddhamantrakaro bhavet। ।
kāminīnāṃ kāmanāyāḥ pūrako'nyāyakārakaḥ ।।72।।
dharmaloptā kulaloptā hyāsakto grāmyadarśane ।
krodhalobhādidoṣāṇāmākaro'jñānaśevadhiḥ ।।73 ।।
vyavahāravidhuraśca buddhihīno'titāmasī ।
paśupāśo bhavet kaścit kanyāharaḥ śiśupriyaḥ ।।74।।
yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi bhavenme kiṃ prayojanam ।
tadguṇānna sahe divyānadivyān vā kathañcana ।।75।।
nāsti kaścit tato dhyeyo bhajanīyo'pi me pitaḥ ।
ahaṃ śreṣṭhastataścā'smi nāsti śreṣṭho'pi kaścana ।।76।।
vibhīṣaṇastataḥ prāha mā putra taṃ vimānaya ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkamalāpatiḥ ।।77।।
sarvapatiḥ parameśaścāntaryāmī niyāmakaḥ ।
kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śaktaḥ sa vai hariḥ ।।78।।
vartate bālarūpastaṃ bhaja sarvātmanā suta ।
divyāḥ santi guṇāstasminnekaiko mokṣado hi yaḥ ।।79।।
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣāntistyāgaḥ santoṣa ārjavam ।
śamo damastapaḥ sāmyaṃ titikṣoparatiḥ śrutam ।।2.87.80 ।।
jñānaṃ viraktiraiśvaryaṃ śauryaṃ tejo balaṃ smṛtiḥ ।
svātantryaṃ kauśalaṃ kāntidhairyaṃ ca mārdavaṃ tathā ।।8 1।।
prāgalbhyaṃ praśrayaḥ śīlaṃ saha ojo balaṃ bhagaḥ ।
gāṃbhīryaṃ sthairyamāstikyaṃ kīrtirmāno'nahaṃkṛtiḥ ।।।82।।
kṛtopakāraścādroho'nīhā'kiñcanatā tathā ।
maitrī sārvajñyamevaite guṇāḥ santi parātmani ।।83।।
adharmajīvano rakṣaḥ prāha manye na tān guṇān ।
ahaṃ napuṃsakaṃ manye kāryotsāhavivarjitam ।।84।।
dhamārthakāmanāhīnaṃ niṣkriyaṃ nirbalaṃ ca tam ।
parabhāgyopajīvitvaṃ parasampadvikarṣaṇam ।।85।।
amārgavāhitā cāpi manye tatraiva santi hi ।
tasmāt pitarna me vaktuṃ guṇānarhasi tasya vai ।।86।।
rādhike evamevāyamadharmajīvano'suraḥ ।
śatādhikān harau doṣān jagāda pitaraṃ prati ।।87।।
vibhīṣaṇastu taṃ kruddho jaghāna gadayā tadā ।
amṛtaśca vidudrāva siṃhaladvīpatastataḥ ।।88।।
kapaṭī mānavo bhūtvā saurāṣṭre cājagāma saḥ ।
śatrujayānadītīre trivaṭākhye bhuvastale ।।89।।
uvāsa kṛtaketaśca dviṣan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
yativeṣadharo bhūtvā satāṃ vidveṣakaḥ khalaḥ ।।2.87.90।।
duṣṭo dharmadhvajo bhūtvā'pratārayan janān bahūn ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīparameśvare ।।91।।
vairaṃ kurvan vacobhiśca loke nāstikyamādadhan ।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ naṣṭāyureva saḥ ।।92।।।
lomaśasyā''śrame gatvā nininda parameśvaram ।
tadā śrīśaṃkaraḥ śrutvā bhairavaṃ prāha sevakam ।।93।।
yāhi bhairava duṣṭaṃ tamadharmajīvanā'suram ।
ghātayainaṃ piśācaistvaṃ nārakiṇaṃ hi karmaṇā ।।94।।
ityukto bhairavaḥ śūlaṃ dhṛtvā gatvā piśācakaiḥ ।
jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ baddhvā cārmaṇarajjubhiḥ ।।95।।
nicikṣepa malasthāne viṣṭāvyāptakṣitau tadā ।
tanmakhe mūtrayāmāsurviṣṭhāṃ cakruḥ piśācakāḥ ।।96।।
mūḍhamāraṃ dṛḍhaṃ sarve mārayāmāsurāsuram ।
aṅgāni chedayāmāsuścikṣipurlāvaṇaṃ jalam ।।97।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadveṣiṇameva te ।
tato rajjuprabandhena gṛdhravāsadrumāntare ।।98।।
śākhāyāṃ bandhayāmāsurlambate so'pyadhomukhaḥ ।
gṛdhrakākādiviṣṭhā ca patatyeva tu tanmukhe ।।99।।
evaṃ māsadvayaṃ daṇḍaṃ cakre śrībhairavo'sure ।
tataḥ kṣudhātṛṣāvyāpto mamāra prāṇato hi saḥ ।। 2.87.100 ।।
yayau yamālayaṃ so'yamasuro'dharmajīvanaḥ ।
kuṃbhīpāte'patattatra sahasravatsaraṃ hiṃ saḥ ।। 10 1।।
athā'tra bhairavo devaḥ sasnau cāśvasarovare ।
tasya saṃsargadoṣotthapāpaprakṣālanāya vai ।। 1 02।।
evaṃ vināśamāpanno'suro'dharmaprajīvanaḥ ।
śiśupriyaḥ svapāpena mṛto'sadgatimārgagaḥ ।। 1 03।।
rādhike me'parādhasya kartṝṇāṃ nāsti sadgatiḥ ।
yadi syāccharaṇāpannastadā gatiṃ dadāmyaham ।। 1 04।।
atha śaraṇaṃ nā''yāto mṛto'pi parameśvaram ।
tataḥ koṭyarbudavarṣerapyasya sadratirna vai ।। 1 05।।
āṣāḍhe sa mṛto daityasamo rakṣo'tinindakaḥ ।
atha vibhīṣaṇaḥ śrutvā'dharmajīvamṛtiṃ tataḥ ।। 1 06।।
nītvā tanmātaraṃ tatra saurāṣṭre vyomamārgataḥ ।
āyayau cārthayāmāsa sadgatiṃ parameśvarāt ।। 1 07।।
harirjanmāntare prāha tasya gatirbhaviṣyati ।
mama hastena mṛtyuṃ sa labdhvā yāsyati sadgatim ।। 1 08।।
tasya mātre dadau mantraṃ lomaśarṣistataḥ param ।
vibhīṣaṇāya mantraṃ sa dadau śrīpārameśvaram ।। 1 09।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
māsaṃ sthitvā yayatustau rādhike vai nijālayam ।। 2.87.110 ।।
bhejāte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
vibhīṣaṇaśca khacarī tvante divyau babhūvatuḥ ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kharaputrasyā'dharmajīvanasya nāstikyaṃ, harerguṇeṣvaguṇakalpanāḥ, harau dveṣo'sadgatistataḥ kālāntare sadgativaradānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 87 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 88
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 089 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ rādhike divyaṃ camatkāraṃ punarhareḥ ।
prayāge kuṃbhayoge tu koṭiśo dehino yayuḥ ।। 1 ।।
mānavā nāgadaityāśca surāḥ ṛṣigaṇāstathā ।
pitaro munayaḥ siddhāḥ śrāvaṇe tatra cāyayuḥ ।। 2 ।।
daśakrośeṣu sarvatra nagaraṃ nūtanaṃ hyabhūt। ।
tadbahirdevavṛkṣāśca vallikā ūṣurutsukāḥ ।। 3 ।।
divyānyapi ca tīrthāni divyānyapi sarāṃsi ca ।
saritaḥ sarvato divyāḥ kūpā vāpyaśca dīrghikāḥ ।। 4 ।।
āyayustatra vai snātuṃ kuṃbhayoge tu saṅgame ।
gaṃgāyamunayoryoge sarasvatyāḥ samāgame ।। 5 ।।
śrāvaṇe ca tathā bhādrapade sasnuśca tīrthake ।
tairthikairnijapāpāni triveṇyāṃ kṣālitāni vai ।। 6 ।।
atha tatra mahātyāgī sādhuḥ sanatkumārakaḥ ।
brahmaputraḥ pañcavarṣabālarūpaḥ samāyayau ।। 7 ।।
divyā'ṇuvyomayānastho'yutabhāskarasannibhaḥ ।
dyotayan bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ diśo'mbaraṃ samantataḥ ।। 8 ।।
āścaryaṃ dehinaḥ prāpurdevādyāstoṣamāyayuḥ ।
vimānaṃ sūkṣmarūpaṃ tadvikāsamagamat punaḥ ।। 9 ।।
yatra divyasvarūpaḥ sa yogī bālo hyadṛśyata ।
śanairavātarad bhūmāvakṣayavaṭasannidhau ।। 2.88.1 0।।
tatra tasthau mahāyogī śīghraṃ cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
prāvirāsa triveṇyāṃ saḥ sasnau śīghraṃ hariṃ smaran ।। 1 1।।
tiro bhūtvā kṣaṇād yatra vimānaṃ tatra cāyayau ।
vaṭasparśaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nanāma vaṭaśāyinam ।। 12।।
pupūja divyakusumairvavande vedasaṃstavaiḥ ।
tāvattatrā''yayurjñātvā devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।। 13।।
darśanārthaṃ samāgatya puṣpādyaistamapūjayan ।
svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā parasparaṃ ca te tataḥ ।। 14।।
tasthuścāpi niṣeduśca viśāle bhūtale divi ।
tāvattatra tu tīrthāni nadā nadyaḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 15।।
prayāgo mūrtimāँścāpi sarāṃsi kūpavāpikāḥ ।
pūṣā kaṭvī ca pannārī candrāvatī ca mañjirā ।। 16।।
indrāvatī kuśī mahānadī huhūgalī tathā ।
gaṇḍakī kañcanagaṃgā śatalājā ca gogarā ।। 17।।
cambalā cīnapā nandā jhelamā kābilā nadī ।
luṇī sindhustathā cānyā militvā brahmaṇaḥ sutam ।। 18।।
sanatkumāraṃ papracchurnatvā pāpavināśakam ।
ṛṣi+e dvādaśavarṣeṣu yāni pāpāni dehinām ।। 19।।
asmāsu tu samāgatya kṣālitāni bhavanti vai ।
tāni tiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi dvādaśavatsarāṇi ca ।।2.88.20 ।।
kuṃbhasnānaprasaṃgena tyaktānyatra prayāgake ।
tadā vayaṃ sukhaṃ śāntiṃ prāpnumaḥ pāpavarjitāḥ ।। 21।।
kintu varṣe vatsare ca prativarṣaṃ kathamṛṣe ।
pāpanāśo bhavennastu yena śāntirbhavet sadā ।।22।।
māse māse tathā pakṣe ghorapāpadine tathā ।
yatra gatvā pāpaśāntiryathā bhavet pradarśaya ।।।23।।
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ jvalanaṃ yatra jāyate ।
tatsthalaṃ dāhakaṃ vipra pradarśaya ca naḥ prabho ।।24।।
prayāgaśca haridvāraḥ puṣkaro nāśikastathā ।
kuṃbhe pāpaharāḥ sarve pāpavanto bhavanti te ।।25। ।
tataste pāpanāśārthaṃ yānti śrīkṛṣṇagomatīm ।
ityevaṃ nāradāt pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ godāvarītaṭe ।।26।।
tatra yāmo'thavā śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthottamaṃ bhaved bhuvi ।
kathayā'tra ṛṣe sarvaṃ viditaṃ te'sti mānase ।।27 ।।
iti pṛṣṭo brahmaputraḥ sanātanahariḥ svayam ।
sanatkumāranāmā'sau prāha tirthāni tādṛśam ।।28।।
śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sadyaḥ pratyahaṃ pāpadāhakam ।
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ yāvadbrahmāṇḍavartinām ।।29।।
īśvarāṇāmīśvaro yaścāvatārādhipaḥ prabhuḥ ।
paramātmā? mahākṛṣṇo'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।2.88.3 0।।
parabrahmā'kṣaramuktapatiḥ paratarātparaḥ ।
paradhāmanivāsaśca svāmī svāminikeśvaraḥ ।। 21 ।।
bhagavatāṃ yāvatāṃ yo bhagavān yasya no samaḥ ।
adhikastu bhavennaiva yatra kāṣṭhā parā gatiḥ ।।32।।
so'yaṃ rājā'dhirājaśca svamūrteḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
rādhāpatiṃ śrīpatiṃ ca lakṣmīpatiṃ satīpatim ।।3 3 ।।
āviścakāra vasituṃ tebhyo dhāmāni saṃdadau ।
dadāvaiśvaryasiddhīśca dadau nijaguṇāँstathā ।। 34।।
so'yaṃ śrīkambharāputraḥ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।
sṛṣṭyādau yatra prathamaṃ prāvirbabhūva bālavat ।। 35।।
vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre muktaprasevitaḥ ।
muktānībhiḥ sevitaśca brahmapriyāprasevitaḥ ।।36।।
munibhirlomaśādyaiśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ ।
avatāraiḥ sevitaśca sahasrabhujaviṣṇubhiḥ ।। 37।।
lakṣamastakavedhobhirvāsudevādibhistathā ।
sevito vandito yatra bhūmāvakṣarasaṃjñake ।।38।।
kṣetre'śvapaṭṭasaraso'bhitaḥ krīḍati mādhavaḥ ।
lomaśasyāśramasyāpyantike sarvatra vartate ।।39।।
yatra muktā vṛkṣarūpā surapatnyaśca vallayaḥ ।
muktāḥ stambasvarūpāśca vartante darśanecchayā ।।2.88.40 ।।
yatprasādecchukā devā bhūtvā pipīlikātmakāḥ ।
api haṃsacaṭakādyāścarantyaśvasaro'bhitaḥ ।।41 ।।
daśayojanakaṃ kṣetraṃ cākṣarabrahma tanmatam ।
yadrajasā parivyāptāḥ kīṭā yānti parāṃ gatim ।।582।।
pratyaṇubhūtalaṃ tattu divyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
parameśvarayogena pavano'pi pramokṣadaḥ ।।43।।
vallayaścāpi vṛkṣā vai lokān pavitrayanti hi ।
aśvapadrṛsarasyeva bhagavān nityameva tu ।।44।।
snāti khelati bhaktaiśca brahmahrado'tra vartate ।
gaṃgādyāni sutīrthāni vartante tajjalādiṣu ।।45।।।
amṛtākhyo hradaścāpi virajā yamunādikāḥ ।
vartante tatra sarasi śrīhareryogalālasāḥ ।।46 ।।
tādṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ loke svarge satye rasātale ।
vaikuṇṭhādau ca vā nadyo vartante nādhikaṃ tataḥ ।।47।।
puruṣottamayogāt tat saro'kṣarasvarūpatām ।
prāptaṃ sarvokṛṣṭatāṃ ca pāpatāpanivārakam ।। 48।।
nityaṃ gatvaiva tatraiva snātavyaṃ sāyamityapi ।
divājātāni pāpāni dahyanti tatprasaṃgataḥ ।।49।।
prātargatvā''plavanaṃ ca kāryaṃ tena niśodbhavam ।
pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyeta snātuścā'śvasarovare ।।2.88.5 0 ।।
pratiparva pragantavyaṃ snātavyaṃ tatra dehibhiḥ ।
divyā'divyairātmabhiśca vāsanākalmaṣāpahe ।।51 ।।
māse māse ca vā varṣe ṛtau vā cāyane'pi vā ।
snātavyaṃ tatra gatvaiva sarvapāpaṃ daheddhi tat ।।52।।
tatrā''ste kuṃkumavāpī yasyā jalaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
sadā pibati naivedyaiḥ saha vāpyā jale tathā ।।53।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ nityaṃ snāti prage hyage ।
seyaṃ kuṃkumavāpīti śrīharerhṛdayaṃ matam ।।54।।
tatparaṃ nāsti tīrthaṃ vai dhāmalokeṣu kutracit ।
devalokeṣu vā nāsti nāstīśvarādidhāmasu ।।55।।
kutaḥ pṛthvyāṃ tu labhyeta vinā kuṃkumavāpikām ।
kuṃkumavāpikātulyā kuṃkumavāpikā svayam ।।56।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatulyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
kaṃbharāśrīsatītulyā kaṃbharāśrīsatī svayam ।।17।।
gopālakṛṣṇatulyaśca gopālakṛṣṇa eva saḥ ।
akṣaraṃ cākṣaratulyaṃ paraṃ tulyaṃ na vidyate ।।58।।
etadbrahmāṇḍatulyaṃ ca etadbrahmāṇḍameva hi ।
yatrā'nādiḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'sti hi ।।59।।
tatra nadyo bhavatyastu gatvā kurvantu cāplavam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarodivyavāriṇi prātareva ca ।।2.88.60।।
pibantu kuṃkumavāpījalaṃ haripadāmṛtam ।
pratyakṣaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca prasevantāṃ divāniśam ।।6 1।।
vasantu devyastatraiva mūlarūpaiḥ sadā sukham ।
kāryarūpairviharantu deśeṣu jalarūpikāḥ ।।62।।
bālakṛṣṇasya yogena yūyaṃ prāpsyatha satsukham ।
lānirdeśyamavarṇyaṃ cā'sīmātyānandalakṣaṇam ।।63।।
yanmūrtisthaḥ parānando'kṣare brahmaṇi nāsti ca ।
anyatra tu kutaḥ syādvai tat sukhaṃ lapsyatha dhruvam ।।64।।
sarvātmanā'rpaṇenaiva bālakṛṣṇasya sevane ।
sarvaṃ sukhaṃ haristuṣṭo dāsyatyeva nijapriyam ।।65।।
yatrā'ntaraṃ manāk cāste tatrā''nande'pi cāntaram ।
yatrāntaraṃ na tatrāsti tatrānande na cāntaram ।।66 ।।
dvayoraikye pravāhāśca sukhasyā''virbhavanti vai ।
sacchrīkṛṣṇo naraśreṣṭhaḥ, cit bhavatyastu sevikāḥ ।।67।।
tayorānanda evāyaṃ tatra duḥkhasya kā kathā ।
pāpāni kṛṣṇayogena vilīyante kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।।68।।
puṇyānāṃ parvatāstatra prodbhavanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
ānandānāṃ pravāhāśca sāmudrā iva sarvaśaḥ ।।69।।
jāyante śrīhareryogāt sevantāṃ yāntu taṃ harim ।
ityevaṃ kathyamānānāṃ nadīnāṃ romamaṇḍalāt ।।2.88.70।।
niryayuḥ sūkṣmakīṭā vai kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ samantataḥ ।
tebhyaḥ pṛṣṭaṃ tadā tābhiḥ ke bhavanto'tra niryayuḥ ।।71 ।।
ūcuḥ kīṭā vayaṃ pāpānyaghināṃ pāparūpiṇaḥ।
bhavatīṣu samutsṛjya pāpino yānti vai gṛham ।।72।।
vayaṃ tāni nirgatā vo dehebhyo'śvasaraḥsmṛteḥ ।
gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ nadyastvanyatra parvatādiṣu ।।73।।
anyathā vastatra gatvā snānamātreṇa naḥ kṣayaḥ ।
ityevaṃ bhayamāsādya nirgatānyatra jīvataḥ ।।74।।
ye smṛtvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetramakṣaraṃ yānti tatprati ।।75।।
taiḥ kṛte saṃkrame śīghraṃ naśyantyaghāni sarvaśaḥ ।
tasmādvayaṃ jīvanecchāvanto yāmaḥ sthalāntaram ।।76 ।।
maraṇājjīvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapasā vā kṣudhā'pi vā ।
kvacidavaśyaṃ jāyeta jīvata bhadradarśanam ।।77।।
puruṣārtho'pi jāyeta labhyeteṣṭaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ityuktvā niryayuḥ sarvāghāni saridgaṇāttadā ।।78।।
tīrthāni cāpurāścaryaṃ yasya śravaṇataḥ khalu ।
pāpāni yānti vai dūraṃ tattīrthaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ।।79।।
tasmād gatvaiva sevyaṃ tat vastavyaṃ tatra caiva nu ।
iti niścitya ca muniṃ praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।2.88.80।।
pupūjuścātibhāvena samūcuśca muniṃ muhuḥ ।
sanatkumāra bhagavan prāpaya kṣetrameva naḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tvayā sahaikavāraṃ tvamupakāraṃ vidhehi naḥ ।
omityevaṃ jagādā'sau munistīrthāni tatkṣaṇam ।।।82।।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānyeva jahṛṣuścāti sarvaśaḥ ।
śīghraṃ vārtā prakāśaṃ sā'bhavat kuṃbhā''gateṣu tu ।।82 ।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati prayāti vai ।।84।।
sarvatīrthāni cādāya saha kuṃkumavāpikām ।
yatra sākṣāddhariścāste bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvara ।।85।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatrāste lomaśo muniḥ ।
kuṃbhaṃ kṛtvā tu gacchāmo divyatāprāptaye khalu ।।86 ।।
ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvopakaraṇāni ca ।
tīrthayātrāvidhānārthaṃ tīrthāni niryayustadā ।।87।।
sarvakhaṇḍasthanadyastu sarvakhaṇḍasarāṃsi ca ।
sarvakhaṇḍagatāḥ kūpā vāpyo'khātāśca sāgarāḥ ।।88।।
nirjharaṇāni sarvāṇi taṭākā dīrghikāstathā ।
saṃgamāni nadīnāṃ ca samudrasaritāṃ tathā ।।89।।
jalatīrthāni cālokya pṛthvītīrthāni yānyapi ।
pārvatāni sthalāni gahvarāṇyucchrayāṇi ca ।। 2.88.90।।
vanānyaraṇyavaryāṇi ghāṭāni saritastathā ।
dvīpānāṃ saritaścāpi tīrthayātrārthamāgatāḥ ।।91।।
mimiluḥ sahayoginyaḥ sahayogā yathāyatham ।
parvatāḥ śṛṃgaśailāśca taddevā devikāstathā ।।12।।
hradā hadinyaḥ sarvāstu padbhiryātrāṃ vyadhurhitām ।
lakṣasaṃkhyāni tīrthāni tathā'nye lakṣaśo'pi ca ।।93।।
vādyairvāditrakairvaṃśaistrāsakaiḥ karatālakaiḥ ।
mṛdaṃgairdvimṛdaṃgaiśca bherībhiḥ svaravādyakaiḥ ।।94।।
tāratantrībhirevāpi tumburādyaistathetaraiḥ ।
suvādyaiḥ saha gāyantaḥ kīrtanāni harestu vai ।।95।।
āśvīnamāsamāsādya prayāgānniryayuḥ sukham ।
mārge te puṣkaraṃ kṛtvā gatvā siddhāśramaṃ tathā ।।96।।
satīṃ bahucarāṃ natvā catuṣṭilakaparvatam ।
dṛṣṭvā tīrthāni devāśca siddhā maharṣayastathā ।।97।।
pitaraḥ parvatādyāśca divyarūpadharāḥ khalu ।
āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrasīmāntikaṃ mudā ।।98।।
sanatkumārasahitāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahārṣayaḥ ।
tathā'nye divyadehāśca yogino'pi samāyayuḥ ।।99।।
viśaśramustu te kṣetrāduttarāt śāṃkarīṃ diśam ।
kramavyūhaṃ tataścakruḥ samājotsavabodhakam ।। 2.88.10 0।।
rādhike svargavāsinyo devyo gāndharvya ityapi ।
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ samājagmustīrthadarśanalālasāḥ ।। 10 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīsanatkumārarṣipradarśitā'śvapaṭṭasaromāhātmyena sarvatīrthānāṃ prayāgataḥ kuṃkumavāpīṃ prati yātrānirdeśa-
nāmā'ṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 88 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 088 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 89
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 090 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye prāgbhāge rādhike śubham ।
amarāṇāṃ nivāsārhaṃ vanaṃ vai pārijātakam ।। 1 ।।
viśālaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ tataśceśānadigbhavam ।
vanaṃ kādambamutkṛṣṭaṃ yojanatrayavistṛtam ।। 2 ।।
tataścottarato bhadrānadī divyā virājate ।
yasyāṃ sthale sthale sasnau svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
tasyāstīre suviśramya snātvā saṃbhakṣya pāyasam ।
tato yātrāsamājo vai sasārā'gre gṛṇan harim ।। 4 ।।
bhūmāvarttagajaścāgre svarṇacitrādirañjitaḥ ।
gairikāśailatulyaḥ sa bherīṃ jīmūtasadṛśīm ।। 5 ।।
udvahan yāti cāgre vai saśabdā garjanāvatīm ।
tatpaścāccharabho yāti vairājāvarttanāmakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
paṭahadvayamucchabdaṃ pṛṣṭhe vahan samucchrayaḥ ।
tatpaścānmāṇikīpṛṣṭhe dhvajaṃ śatakarāyatam ।। 7 ।।
kauśeyaṃ svarṇatārādipañcadevavirājitam ।
udvahan yāti vindhyādrirabbhrāṇi karṣayan dhvaje ।। 8 ।।
tatpaścācchaṃkhanādaśca daśadikṣu ninādavān ।
maruddevakṛto bhāti bhūyate svargavāsibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
tatpaścād rodasī cāpi ninādayat sudhātujam ।
vigalaṃ bhagavān dhṛtvā vāmano yāti hāsayan ।। 2.89.10।।
tatpaścācchrīnṛsiṃhaśca svayaṃ vai garjayan diśaḥ ।
divyasiṃhacchaṭāśobhaḥ prayāti piṃganetrakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
tatpaścādaśvinīdevau sūryacandrasamāvubhau ।
surūpau turagārūḍhau kurvāte jayaghoṣaṇām ।। 1 2।।
tatpaścācchvetavārāho dhunvan digantakān balī ।
garjayan yāti tīrthārthaṃ śvetavarṇo'tirūpavān ।। 13।।
tato yānti ca gandharvā vādakā vādyavedinaḥ ।
vādayanti ca jhaṃkārān karatālān mṛdaṃgakān ।। 14।।
vīṇāṃ mayūrakāṃścāpi tantrīṃ jalaninādakān ।
prāṇapāśān gālaśabdān tālikātālapaṭṭakān ।। 15।।
vṛttabherīḥ paṭahāँśca veṇunālān sṛjihvikāḥ ।
trāṭakān citraghoṣāँśca śalākān rāgiṇīstathā ।। 16 ।।
evaṃvidhāni vādyāni hyavādyanta tataḥ param ।
tato vai kīrtanakārāḥ puṃtīrthāḥ saṃprayānti hi ।। 17।।
divyāḥ siddhāstato yānti satyaḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ ।
kīrtayanti harernāma savādyaṃ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।। 18।।
tato yānti pitaraśca jayaśabdaiśca kīrtanaiḥ ।
tato vai devatā yānti surāḥ sarve dyuvāsinaḥ ।। 1 9।।
tato yānti ca ṛṣayaḥ satyasthā bhūgatāstathā ।
kīrtayantaśca vedānāṃ mantrān sāmastavāँstathā ।। 2.89.20।।
tato'pi cāraṇā bhāṭā gandharvā gāyakāstathā ।
prayānti vādyaghoṣaiśca nāmakīrtanakāriṇaḥ ।। 21 ।।
tatpaścācca surarājāḥ prayānti lokapālakāḥ ।
tatpaścāt saritaḥ sarvā nadyaḥ prasravaṇāni ca ।।22।।
sarāṃsi ca taḍāgāśca prayānti kīrtayanti ca ।
tato yānti ṛṣipatnyo devyastataḥ surastriyaḥ ।।23।।
kīrtayantyo bālakṛṣṇapadyāni premapūritāḥ ।
tato yānti vanāraṇyaśailabhūtīrthamaṇḍalam ।।24।।
tato dāsāstathā dāsyastato yānti ca mānavāḥ ।
evaṃ yātrāpravāhaśca samājo yojanāvadhim ।।25।।।
dīrghāṃ'bhavattadā divyaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā ।
mahīmānāni tīrthāni tvāgacchantīti vīkṣya ca ।। 26।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāgatavāñcchayā ।
agragobhūccātiharṣāt tathā gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।27।।
kapilādyāḥ sādhavaśca lomaśādyā maharṣayaḥ ।
rādhāramādyāḥ satyaśca śaṃkarādyāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।28।।
viprā vedavidaścāpi kanyāḥ koṭyarbudārbudam ।
brahmapriyāḥ kambharāśrīstathā sarvāśca vallikā ।। 25।।
tīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpī ca tathā'nyā dīrghikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
kṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastathā''śramasya pādapāḥ ।।2.89.30।।
kṣetrapālāśca tīrthāni sarvāṇyaśvasarastaṭe ।
yāni vasanti ye devā nadyo nadāśca parvatāḥ ।।3 1।।
