sarve te dhṛtamālāśca madhuparkādisaṃyutāḥ ।
gītavāditrayuktāśca tairthikānabhisaṃyayuḥ ।।32।।
brahmahṛdo'śvataṭākastathā kuṃkumavāpikā ।
agre yayurhareḥ pārśve virajādyāstato yayuḥ ।।33।।
āgatāste mahīmānā vilokya harimandiram ।
prāsādaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ ca śātakauṃbhaṃ tathā'param ।।34।।
namaścakrurdaṇḍavacca dhūliṃ nyadhuśca mūrddhasu ।
jayaśabdān jagaduśca pūrṇotsāhapariplutāḥ ।।35।।
viviśuḥ kṣetrapīṭhaṃ te dūraṃ tu yojanaṃ yadā ।
mimiluścakrurālokaṃ jayadhvanīn punaḥ punaḥ ।।36।।
parasparaṃ sukhavādān papracchuḥ svāgataṃ tathā ।
cakrustīrthātmanāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrī bhagavān svayam ।।37।।
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ tīrthānāmāgamo mama ।
ityuktvā śrīharistebhyo madhuparkādikaṃ dadau ।।38।।
puṣpahārān candanāni puṣpamālā daduḥ pare ।
militvā kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā samāśliṣya yathocitam ।।39।।
tairthikāstīrthakāmāśca kṛṣṇakīrtanatatparāḥ ।
āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīsannidhāvāśvasārasam ।।2.89.40।।
luluṭhuḥ kṣetramārgasya dhūlyāṃ tīrthāni vai muhuḥ ।
mahadbhāgyaṃ manyamānā devā devyastatharṣayaḥ ।।41।।
kecinnṛtyanti gāyanti vādayantyapare tadā ।
dhārayanti rajo mūrdhni dehe sammardayanti ca ।।42।।
namanti mastakaiḥ kecit kecidañjalinā harim ।
kecid vakṣaḥsu ca rajo yojayanti pare mukhe ।।43।।
svayaṃkumāro bhagavān luloṭha kṛṣṇapādayoḥ ।
kecid vijñāya māhātmyaṃ bhaktānāṃ padrajāṃsi ca ।।44।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ dhārayanti ca mūrdhasu ।
kecit patrāṇi puṣpāṇi śalākāśca tṛṇānyapi ।।45।।
gṛhṇanti tu mukhe dhṛtvā manvate kṛtakṛtyatām ।
jalaṃ prasravaṇotthaṃ ca matvā pāpapraṇāśakam ।।46।।
ghaṭukaṃ ghaṭukaṃ pītvā manvate kṛtakṛtyatām ।
kecit tvaśvasarovārispṛṣṭaṃ vāyuṃ samāgatam ।।47।।
mukhe pītvā muhuryānti nirvṛttiṃ paramāṃ tadā ।
kecit smaranti dhāmāni kecittadavatārakān ।।48।।
kecinmuktān tadaiśvaryasiddhīḥ smaranti taddhṛdaḥ ।
āyudhāścakraśaṃkhādyāḥ pārṣadāḥ sevikāstathā ।।49।।
mahīmānān yadiṣṭaṃ tad dāpayanti pathi drutam ।
evaṃ vādyaiḥ kīrtanaiśca vāhanaiḥ premapūrakaiḥ ।।2.89.50 ।।
jayanādaiḥ saha sarve prāpuḥ saro'śvasaṃjñakam ।
yeṣāṃ vajrasamānyāsan pāpāni dehināṃ tadā ।।51 ।।
tīrthe tyaktāni sarvāṇi tānyapyasaṃkhyakāni vai ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasastu darśanāt haridarśanāt ।।52।।
dagdhānyeva drutaṃ tatra śeṣamātraṃ na vidyate ।
anyatīrthe kṛte snāne yāni prayānti dūrataḥ ।।53 ।।
tāni dagdhāni sarvāṇi cāśvasaro vilokanāt ।
aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate mahat ।।54।।
yadrajo yajjalaṃ yasya kṣetrasya patramityapi ।
dāhayanti ca pāpāni kiṃ vaktavyaṃ harau tadā ।।55।।
evaṃ praśaṃsamānāste mahīmānāḥ sarastaṭe ।
uttare'tiviśāle ca śāṃkare supradeśake ।।56।।
viśaśramustathā sasnuḥ papurjalaṃ vavandire ।
tīrthavidhiṃ pracakruścākṣālayan pāpamātrakam ।।57।।
athā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ saṃsnāpya tajjalaiḥ ।
cakruḥ snānāni tīrthādyāḥ papurvāri prasādajam ।।58।।
divyavārbhirdivyarūpā muktarūpāśca te'bhavan ।
evaṃ cāśvasarastīrthaṃṃ kṛtvā vidhānatastataḥ ।।59।।
yayuḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīṃ viśālāṃ dhāmarūpiṇīm ।
tajjalaṃ vai papuḥ sarve sasnurjalairmuhurmuhuḥ ।।2.89.60 ।।
tadā sārṣṭi tu te prāptāstīrthādyā harivāñcchayā ।
tato brahmahradaṃ gatvā sasnuḥ papuśca tajjalam ।।6 1।।
tataḥ sārūpyabhāvaṃ ca prāptāste mahīmānakāḥ ।
vālakṛṣṇasamāḥ sarve guṇarūpasamṛddhibhiḥ ।।62।।
sañjātā muktiyogyāste punarjanmavivarjitāḥ ।
athottaraṃ yayuḥ sarve lomaśasyāśramaṃ śubham ।।63।।
lomaśaḥ svāgataṃ cakre miṣṭānnaphalavāribhiḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa tīrthādyān sarvān vai mahīmānakān ।।64।।
brahmadhāmānītadugdhasārairbhojyaiśca tarpaṇaiḥ ।
tṛptiṃ prakārayāmāsa mukhavāsān samārpayat ।।65।।
yayustīrthāni sarvāṇi devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।
nadā nadyaḥ parvatāśca vanāraṇyāni yānyapi ।।66।।
mahīmānāśca te sarve bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ śubham ।
divyaṃ divyavibhūtyāḍhyaṃ divyamuktaniṣevitam ।।67।।
apratarkyānantaśaktisevitaṃ ceśvarāśrayam ।
avatāraiḥ sadā juṣṭaṃ sāyujyamuktidaṃ śubham ।।68।।
tatrānādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasnātajalahrade ।
divye brahmahradaśreṣṭhe prasasnurmahīmānakāḥ ।।69।।
divyadehā divyadṛṣṭiyuktā divye pare'kṣarāt ।
dhāmni sthitān nijān sarve hyapaśyanta hi śāśvatān ।।2.89.70 ।।
tadā pūrṇaṃ mahimānaṃ vividurmahīmānakāḥ ।
sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ cātra santi vai ।।71।।
pāpamuktiścānyatīrthe tvaśvasaro'ghadāhakam ।
sārṣṭidā kuṃkumavāpī brahmahradaḥ svarūpadaḥ ।।72।।
sālokyadaṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ divyaṃ hi vartate ।
bālakṛṣṇālayaścāyaṃ sāyujyamuktido'sti hi ।।73 ।।
aho kṛṣṇapratāpena sarve tvekaikataḥ khalu ।
vardhante cātisāmarthye mokṣadāḥ sarvathā'pyaho ।।74।।
atra vāsaḥ prakartavyo'thavā gantavyamakṣare ।
parabrahmaṇi samprāpte ko'nyatra saṃvasedaghī ।।75।।
evaṃ vai kathayantaste vyadhurmahotsavaṃ niśi ।
cāndre tu kumude māse saptamyāḥ kṛṣṇake dale ।।76।।
gāyanaiḥ kīrtanairnṛtyairbhajanaiḥ stavanaistathā ।
dhyānaiḥ kathāśravaiścāpi ninyurniśāṃ sukhaṃ tu te ।।77।।
prātaḥ snātvā'śvasarasi kṛṣṇārcanārthamāyayuḥ ।
sarve tvekādaśe janmadine'ṣṭamyāṃ mahotsave ।।78।।
nirmite maṇḍape rātrau viśāle viśvakarmaṇā ।
madhye gajāsane tatra vyarājata hariḥ svayam ।।79।।
anyānyapyāsanānyatra siṃhāsanāni sarvaśaḥ ।
sthāpitāni ca teṣvatreśvareśvarāḥ pareśvarāḥ ।।2.89.80 ।।
avatārāstathā muktā muktānyaḥ sādhvya ityapi ।
sādhavo brahmaśīlāśca devā devyo maharṣayaḥ ।।81।।
brahmādyāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi pitaro devakoṭayaḥ ।
vyarājanta ca tīrthāni nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca ।।82।।
lokapālā rājyapālāḥ śailā vanāni bhūmayaḥ ।
araṇyāśca drumā vallyastṛṇāni dīrghikāstathā ।।83।।
jaḍacetanatattvāni vyarājantā''saneṣu ca ।
devavādyānyavādyanta māṃgalyānyabhavaँstadā ।।84।।
vedaghoṣāhyajāyantā'bhavatkusumavarṣaṇam ।
lomaśo munirāṭ māyāvarjito'pūjayaddharim ।।85।।
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle'kārayatparamātmanaḥ ।
mukuṭaṃ nidadhe tasya mastake mālikāṃ śubhām ।।86।।
kānakīṃ taulasīṃ cāpi pauṣpīṃ rātnīṃ dadau gale ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau cāpi durvāṃkurāṇi karṇayoḥ ।।87।।
haste śrīphalamagryaṃ ca dadau phalāni cāgrataḥ ।
candanaṃ pādayoścāpyavardhayaccākṣataistataḥ ।।88।।
ārārtrikaṃ hareścakre āśīrvādān dadau śubhān ।
atha śrīkaṃbharādevī pupūja bālakṛṣṇakam ।।89।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca hāraṃ kṛṣṇagale nyadhāt ।
bhagavān śukadevaśca vallabhādyā daduḥ srajaḥ ।।2.89.90 ।।
hemanto bhagavāścāpi haimyupadāḥ samuttamāḥ ।
santoṣā cāmṛtā dugdhā jīvantyādyā daduḥ srajaḥ ।
tilakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ cakrurbhāle binduṃ harestataḥ ।।91 ।।
atheśvarā avatārā muktā muktānya īśikāḥ ।
pūjayitvā''rārtrikaṃ ca pracakruḥ śrīharestadā ।।92।।
brahmavratāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaraḥ suramānavāḥ ।
devā devyo nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsyupajalānyapi ।।93।।
śailāśca bhūmayo'khātāstīrthāni ca vanāni ca ।
araṇyāni ca tattvāni pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।94।।
ārārtrikaṃ tathā puṣpāñjalīn tathopadā daduḥ ।
ābhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi tathopakaraṇānyapi ।।95।।
ūrmikāḥ phalapuṣpāṇi ratnāni hīrakāṇi ca ।
yānāni kalpavṛkṣāँśca dadurdivyāni pūjane ।।96।।
evaṃ pūjottaraṃ sabhāparihārottaraṃ hariḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānān gṛhīyakān ।।97।।
āgantukānatithīṃśca sarvān dehina ityapi ।
dadau tu dakṣiṇāstebhyaḥ prāsādikāni bhāvataḥ ।।98।।
tadā tīrthaiḥ kṛtā tatrā'bhyarthanā śrīhareḥ puraḥ ।
labdhvā mokṣapradaṃ lābhaṃ cānyaṃ lābhaṃ ka icchati ।।99।।
tasmānmokṣaṃ kṛpāsindho dehi naḥ śāśvataṃ sukham ।
hariḥ kṛpayā teṣāṃ vai vyadhād rūpatrayaṃ tadā ।। 2.89.1 00।।
mūlaṃ divyaṃ tathā chāyāṃ mūlarūpāṇi dhāmasu ।
vimānaiḥ so'preṣayacca pārṣadaiḥ saha keśavaḥ ।। 101 ।।
divyānyatha svarūpāṇi svasannidhāvarakṣayat ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatheṣṭaṃ nyavasaँśca te ।। 1 02।।
tīrthātmakāḥ samūrtāśca viśvakarmakṛteṣu ca ।
yogyālayeṣu santuṣṭā hareḥ sevābhilāṣukāḥ ।। 103 ।।
chāyārūpāṇi tīrthānāṃ yāni tatrā'bhavaँstadā ।
tebhyaḥ prāha prabhurlokapāvanārthaṃ śubhaṃ vacaḥ ।। 1 04।।
madicchayaiva tīrtheśā yuṣmajjanmā'sti bhūtale ।
lokānāṃ pāvanārthaṃ vai tasmādgantavyamīśvarāḥ! ।। 1 05।।
kāryarūpeṇa tatraiva sthātavyaṃ yatra saṃsthitiḥ ।
mayā kṛtā'sti loke'tra nadīnadasarāṃsi ca ।। 106 ।।
tattathaiva hi vastavyaṃ pāpipāpadahāya vai ।
āgantavyaṃ prativarṣaṃ janmāhe mama sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 07।।
parvaṇyekādaśīkāle kuṃbhe māghe ca kārtike ।
saṃkrāntau śrāvaṇe cāpi vaiśākhe puruṣottame ।। 1 08।।
ityuktāste samūrtāśca tīrtheśvarāḥ praṇamya ca ।
yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca mahīmānā yayustathā ।। 1 09।।
brahmapriyā hariṃ kāntaṃ prapūjya lomaśāśramam ।
yayuśca rādhike sarve svasvasthānāni mānavāḥ ।। 2.89.11 0।।
rātrāvapyutsavaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛto nartanagāyanaiḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiprado bhavet ।। 11 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarvatīrthadevādīnāṃ kuṃkumavāpīyātrāgamanaṃ, śrīharerjanmadinotsavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikā'śīti-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 89 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 089 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 90
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 091 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe camatkāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
anyaṃ te saṃkathayāmi lokarakṣākaraṃ param ।। 1 ।।
naranārāyaṇau devau dharmaputrau himālaye ।
badaryāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmaratuḥ purā ।। 2 ।।
ūrjakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tau tāpasau svodbhavaṃ prabhum ।
gaṃgātīre dadhyatuśca svāśrame darśanotsukau ।। 3 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ paścime prānte saurāṣṭre cājanābhaje ।
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye kambharāśrīgṛhe hariḥ ।। 4 ।।
yastvāste bālarūpo'sau parabrahma paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
sarvāvatārahetuḥ saḥ kadā dāsyati darśanam ।। 5 ।।
ityevaṃ smaratorbhrātrornaranārāyaṇātmanoḥ ।
saṃkalpaṃ sampūrayituṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 6 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetragatān bhaktān prabhāṣya ca ।
yayau yānena dityena haimādribadarīvanam ।। 7 ।।
lomaśaṃ saha nītvaiva śeṣān saṃsthāpya tatra ca ।
rakṣaṇārthaṃ kathayitvā harāya kṣetrapāya ca ।। 8 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ gataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu bāndhavau ।
pupūjaturjalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ kārtikapakṣake ।। 9 ।।
sevanaṃ tau cakratuśca dharmabhaktī tatharṣayaḥ ।
tāpasā api cakruśca sevanaṃ pratyahaṃ prabhoḥ ।। 2.90.1 0।।
mārgaśīrṣaṃ śreṣṭhamāsaṃ yajñīyaṃ vīkṣya tāpasāḥ ।
pracakre vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ badaryāṃ te maharṣayaḥ ।। 1 1।।
parṇaśālāṃ dadau nityaṃ nivāsārthaṃ yathocitām ।
lomaśāya tathā bālakṛṣṇāya śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 2।।
mārgaśīrṣe babhūvā'yaṃ yajñotsavo mahān śubhaḥ ।
tatra devo hariḥ sākṣātparamātmā pareśvaraḥ ।। 13।।
yajñeśvaro'nale sthitvā havyāni vubhuje tadā ।
sākṣād divyākṣaramuktāstathā golokavāsinaḥ ।। 14।।
vaikuṇṭhavāsimuktāśca tathā'nyadhāmavāsinaḥ ।
samāyayuḥ kratau tatra prasādalālasā hareḥ ।। 15।।
surā maharṣayo devyastīrthāni pitarastathā ।
siddhāścāraṇagandharvā bhūsurā vyomagāminaḥ ।। 16।।
bhaktā daityā dānavāśca samāyayuḥ kratau tadā ।
evaṃ hi bhagavāँstatra rājate parameśvaraḥ ।। 17।।
etasminneva samaye kārtike tu surāṣṭrake ।
śaṃbhordūtī mahāmārī śaṃbhornideśato niśi ।। 18।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ sīmni sthitā prarakṣati ।
tadā vai siṃhaladvīpāt smṛtvā vai bhrātṛputrakam ।। 19।।
kubhīnasī tathā śṛṃgī rākṣasyo'nyāḥ śatadvayam ।
vyomagāḥ kāmarūpiṇyo māyājālaviśāradāḥ ।।2.90.20 ।।
jñātvā tvadharmajīvasya maraṇaṃ vai surāṣṭrake ।
vairaṃ niryāpayituṃ śastrā'strayuktāḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 21 ।।
siṃhāraṇyāni collaṃghya vyomnā saurāṣṭramāyayuḥ ।
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ kārtikasyā'site dale ।।22।।
dīpotsavāt pūrvarātryāṃ cāvaterustadā'mbarāt ।
ulmukān darśayantyaśca vahnijvālāstathā mukhāt ।।23।।
mūrdhajebhyastriśūlāँśca darśayantyo hi vahnimān ।
mārayaitāḥ khādayaitāḥ śatroḥ priyāḥ kumārikāḥ ।। 24।।
bhedayaitāścarvayaitā nayaitā rākṣasārthakam ।
jvālayaitā dharṣayaitāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapriyā balāt ।।25।।
nāstyāsāṃ rakṣakaścā'tra samayo vijayasya naḥ ।
ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇāstā lomaśasyā''śrame drutam ।।26।।
nipeturdharṣaṇārthaṃ vai rākṣasyaḥ krūrayoṣitaḥ ।
sīmarakṣākarī dūtī mahāmārī hi bhairavī ।।27।।
jñātvā''kasmikasaṃgharṣa yuddhopadravamityapi ।
sahasrarūpiṇī bhūtvā saśastrā tvabhyadhāvata ।।28।।
kanyāvāseṣu sarvatra rātrāvākrośa ulbaṇaḥ ।
abhavat trāsakṛt tatra rākṣasīnāmupadravāt ।। 29।।
bhairavī pāśamādāya sammantrya nāgabandhanaiḥ ।
mumoca rākṣasīsaṃghe rākṣasyo vandhanāntare ।।2.90.30।।
nāgairbaddhāścā'bhavaँśca nigaḍaiścauravattadā ।
hasteṣvapi tathā kaṭyāmudare ca galeṣvapi ।।3 1।।
sarvā eva tu nāgānāṃ pāśairnaddhā viceṣṭitāḥ ।
abhavannyapatan bhūmau viṣadagdhāstathā'bhavan ।।32।।
atha sā bhairavī śaṃbhuṃ suptaṃ cāgatya saṃstavaiḥ ।
bodhayāmāsa śīghraṃ cā''vedayāmāsa gharṣaṇam ।।33।।
śrutvopadravamīśāno lomaśāśramamāyayau ।
dṛṣṭvā nāgāstrasannaddhā rākṣasīstuṣṭamānasaḥ ।।34।।
prāhaināṃ bhairavīṃ dūtīṃ kurvetā gatabandhanāḥ ।
yuddhaṃ kṛtvā tu tāḥ sarvā vināśāya vilokaye ।।35।।
ityājñaptā bhairavī sā natvā śaṃkarapādayoḥ ।
rākṣasīstā bandhahīnāścakāra śaṃkarājñayā ।।36।।
uvācaitā raṇaṃ kartuṃ rākṣasyo balagarvitāḥ ।
yuddhaṃ cakruḥ śastradhartryo vividhairyuddhatarkaṭaiḥ ।।37।।
śaktibhirmudgaraiścāpi yaṣṭibhiḥ prastaraistathā ।
khaḍgairasibhiśchurikāmuṣṭyādyaiḥ pādatāḍanaiḥ ।।38।।
parvataprāyadehāśca vṛṣṭibhiścābhicārakaiḥ ।
yuyudhustā vyomagā hi bhairavībhirnirantaram ।।39।।
bhairavyo rudrabalato vajradehāstadā'bhavan ।
saṃkalpajā bahurūpā yuyudhustatra hetibhiḥ ।।2.90.40।।
kṛpāṇaiḥ paraśubhiśca kuṭhāraiśca triśūlakaiḥ ।
cakrairbhallaistathā stambhairvajrairdaṇḍaiśca jālakaiḥ ।।।41।।।
śalākābhiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca sphoṭagolaiśca śākhibhiḥ ।
nijaghnuścātiruṣṭāstā bhairavyo rākṣasīstvati ।।42।।
citkṛtyotplutya cākāśe nipetustāḥ parasparam ।
rākṣasyo māyayā naikarūpiṇyo jaghnurīśvarīḥ ।।43।।
īśānyo jaghnurīśasya mantrayukśūlaśaktibhiḥ ।
sītābhirbhallakairjaghnurbibhidurhṛdayāni hi ।।44।।
rākṣasīnāṃ mahāsainyaṃ kṛtrimaṃ samajāyata ।
kṛtrimā bhairavīyoṣā vidyatpāśaistu tāstadā ।।45।।
babandhurjvālayāmāsuravacitya ca mūlinīm ।
evaṃ yuddhe mahāghore jāyamāne sahasraśaḥ ।।46।।
nipetustatkabandhāśca śailaprāyā vihāyasaḥ ।
kuṃbhīnasī tathā śṛṃgī dudruvaturbhayād bahiḥ ।।47।।
tadanyāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca bhairavībhistu bhakṣitāḥ ।
śatasaṃkhyāḥ parāstatra bhinnā mṛtāśca jīvataḥ ।।48।।
bhairavīnāṃ tadā jāto vijayaḥ śāṃkarād balāt। ।
śaṃbhustābhyaḥ prasanno'bhūt kṣetrarakṣā yataḥ kṛtā ।।49।।
lomaśasyāśramasyāpi kanyakānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam ।
kṛtaṃ rātrau mahāyuddhaṃ kṛtvā vacaḥprapālanam ।।।2.90.50।।
prasannaḥ sannuvācaitā mahāmārīrvarapradaḥ ।
prasanno'smi varadānaṃ yācadhvaṃ pradadāmi vaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
mahāmāryastadā prāhurnatvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ tathā ।
mūlāṃ tāṃ bhairavīṃ pūjyāṃ mātaraṃ jananīṃ parām ।।।52।।
yadi śaṃbho prasanno'si yadi deyo varo'sti naḥ ।
tadā kṣudhāsamavyāptā vayaṃ tṛṣā''kulāstathā ।।53।।
tannivṛttikaraṃ bhojyaṃ pariśramavināśakam ।
puṣṭidaṃ baladaṃ peyaṃ tāmasaṃ dehi naḥ prabho ।।54।।
tamojanyā vayaṃ sarvāstāmasyo yuddhadurmadāḥ ।
yuddhajaṃ māṃsaraktādi bhakṣayantyo'tipuṣṭidam ।।55।।
tadeva bhojanaṃ peyaṃ samicchāmo dadāsi cet ।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ prāha dharmakṣetre surāṣṭrake ।।56 ।।
parabrahmanivāse'tra taddānaṃ cātiduṣkaram ।
kathaṃ kṛpālunāthasya deśe'tra taddhi saṃbhavet ।।57।।
tadā prāhustu tāḥ sarvā harerbhaktān vihāya vai ।
tāmasān pāpinaḥ krūrānnāstikān bhaktivarjitān ।।58।।
anācārān durācārān pūjāpāṭhavivarjitān ।
asnātān tīrthayātrādivarjitān dāṃbhikān śaṭhān ।।59।।
hareḥ prasādahīnāँśca tulasīsragvivarjitān ।
aśāṃbhavan sattvahīnān avaiṣṇavān parārtidān ।।2.90.60।।
paradravyādyapahārakārakān puṇyavarjitān ।
yamayātrārthayogyāँśca bhakṣayiṣyāma eva tān ।।61।।
tādṛśīśca malināśca nārīrdharmavivarjitāḥ ।
upāsanāvihīnāśca bhakṣayiṣyāma eva tāḥ ।।62।।
evaṃ kṛte bhagavāँstu na roṣaṃ samupeṣyati ।
adhārmikāṇāṃ pāpānāṃ daṇḍārthaṃ yamapattanam ।।63।।
kṛtaṃ tenaiva sa kasmād duṣṭānāṃ bhakṣaṇe kṛte ।
santuṣṭo na bhavennātho vayaṃ taṃ prabhumīśvaram ।।64।।
pratoṣitaṃ vidhāsyāmaḥ sevayā kiṃkarīstriyaḥ ।
ityuktvā tā viremuśca śaṃbhuḥ kṛpāparastu tāḥ ।।65।।
prāha tathāsviti bhojyaṃ pānaṃ duṣṭaprajāsvadāt ।
mahāmāryastu taṃ natvā natvā cāpi haripriyāḥ ।।66।।
natvā ca kuṃkumavāpīṃ natvā'śvapaṭṭasārasam ।
natvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ natvā gopālakṛṣṇakam ।।67।।
smṛtvā gopālatanayaṃ śrīpatiṃ svāminaṃ prabhum ।
daśayojanataḥ kṣetrād bahistāḥ prayayurmudā ।।68।।
mṛtānāṃ rākṣasīnāṃ tu dehān utthāpya paścime ।
mahāgarte viniḥkṣipya mānaveṣu drutaṃ ca tāḥ ।।69।।
viviśuścā'vaiṣṇaveṣu śaivabhinneṣu vai drutam ।
abhakteṣu ca duṣṭeṣu daṃbhiṣu nāstikeṣu ca ।।2.90.70।।
śaṭheṣu dharmahīneṣu bāhyataścihnadhāriṣu ।
āntareṣu tu mālinyasaṃbhṛteṣu janeṣu ca ।।71।।
bhaktanibheṣu khyāteṣu bāhyato'ntaśca pāpiṣu ।
nareṣu tādṛśīṣu strīṣvapi praviviśuśca tāḥ ।।72।।
mahāmārīsahasraṃ tat sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrakam ।
saurāṣṭre gaurjare cāpi mahārāṣṭre ca dakṣiṇe ।।73।।
madhye pūrve cottare ca paścime sarvabhūmiṣu ।
mahāmāryo'bhavan vyāptā adṛśyā vāyuvigrahāḥ ।।74।।
tūrṇaṃ praviśya deheṣu tiṣṭhanti hṛdayeṣu ca ।
māṃsaṃ raktaṃ drutaṃ hyuṣṇaṃ khādanti ca pibanti ca ।।75।।
narā nāryo bhavantyeva kṣaṇānte prāṇavarjitāḥ ।
āsamudrāntamevaitā gatvā gatvā prajājanān ।।76।।
pāpiṣṭhānnaranāryādīn prabhakṣayanti lakṣaśaḥ ।
grāme grāme narā nāryā mriyante pratyakṣaṃ tadā ।।77।।
viṃśatyaṃśāḥ prajānāṃ vai pratisāhasrameva ha ।
mahāmāryastadā krūrā gaṇayanti na bālakān ।।78।।
kanyakā na vadhūṃścāpi yūno vṛddhānna garbhiṇīḥ ।
anāthānnāpyatithīँśca mahīmānānna deśikān ।।79 ।।
na rājño na tathā rājñīrna dhanāḍhyānna nirdhanān ।
na kaṣāyadhṛgaścāpi na vā sūtakasaṃsthitān ।।2.90.80।।
na yajñahomakarmāḍhyān na pūjāpāṭhakāriṇaḥ ।
pāpayuktān vilokyaiva bhakṣayanti narān striyaḥ ।।81 ।।
mriyante pratyahaṃ nāryo narāśca bhuvi lakṣaśaḥ ।
ekaṃ dhṛtvā bahiryānti mṛtastāvatparo bhavet ।।।82।।
paraṃ mṛtaṃ viniṣkāsya yāvadāyānti vai gṛham ।
tāvadanye mṛtāḥ santi pañca sahaiva tatkṣaṇe ।।।83 ।।
pañca niṣkāsya ca yāvadāyānti grāmagopuram ।
tāvadanye daśa santi mṛtā vā ca tato'dhikāḥ ।।84।।
keṣāñcid gṛhavartyeva kuṭumbaṃ nidhanaṃ gatam ।
keṣāñcittvardhabhāgena mānavā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ।।85।।
kutracicchiṣyate bālaḥ kutracittu navā vadhūḥ ।
kutracid vṛddhajaraṭhaḥ kutracitpaśumātrakam ।।86।।
kutracinnagare lakṣe sahasraṃ tvavaśeṣitam ।
kutracid grāmabhāge tu grāmārdhaṃ sarvaśo mṛtam ।।87।।
kutracinmānavaiḥ śūnyā grāmā jātā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
mriyamāṇaprajānāṃ ca jaladātā na vidyate ।।88।।
kuto'nnadātā labhyeta yatra nāstyeva darśakaḥ ।
evaṃ nāśo mahānāsīnmardanaṃ bahuśo'pyabhūt ।।89।।
māsamadhye tu lokānāmardhe pṛcchāṃ mṛtaṃ hyabhūt ।
koṭiśastu mahāmāryo'bhakṣayan pāpino janān ।।2.90.90 ।।
rākṣasā api daityāṃśca dānavānāsurāँstathā ।
śaṭhānnaiṣkṛtikāँścāpi nāstikān dharmavarjitān ।।9 1 ।।
abhakṣayan hi māsānte hāhākāro digantare ।
abhavad vai tadā lokāstyaktvā grāmān gṛhāṇyapi ।।92।।
pattanāni nagarāṇi yayurbhayādaraṇyakam ।
vaneṣu vanivad vāsān cakruḥ kālabhayārditāḥ ।।।93।।
araṇyāni nagarāṇi nagarāṇi vanāni tu ।
vaiparītyena jātāni mahāmārībhayāttadā ।।94।।
aśvapaṭṭākṣarakṣetre daśayojanavistṛte ।
mahāmārībhayaṃ nā'bhūd bhakteṣveva tadā priye ।।95।।
abhaktā ye'pi tatrasthāstattadbhāgyena deśitāḥ ।
yayurbahirhi ye kṣetraṃ tyaktvā te nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ।।96।।
trāhi trāhi prajāścocuḥ sasmaruḥ parameśvaram ।
rogasyā'sya vināśārthaṃ prajāścakrurhi mānatām ।।97।।
naivedyāni vividhāni dāsyāmo devatāgṛhe ।
vastrabhūṣāmbarasvarṇaṃ dāsyāmo devasannidhau ।।98।।
kariṣyāmo'nnasatrāṇi pārāyaṇāni sanmakhān ।
dharmakāryāṇi dharmāśca kariṣyāmaḥ prasevanam ।। 99।।
harestadīyasādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ devasevanam ।
bhajanaṃ saṃkariṣyāmaḥ saṃtyakṣyāmo'ghapātakam ।। 2.90.1 00।।
sūryaṃ śivaṃ satīṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayiṣyāma īśinīm ।
gaṇeśaṃ ca mahākālaṃ mātṛkāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ ।। 101 ।।
tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣyāmaścāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
yatra nāsti mahāmārī bālakṛṣṇaprabhāvataḥ ।। 1 02।।
prajāḥ sarvatra ca bhayānmaraṇasyātivihvalāḥ ।
pratijñāṃ saṃpracakruśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।। 1 03।।
bhījaṣyāmo yadā jīvipprāṇāḥ sthāsyāma eva tu ।
bhairavi! te mahāmāri! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।। 1 04।।
śapatho'sti yadi māṃ tvaṃ spṛśasi tatra mā spṛśa ।
āṇaṃ daduḥ prajāstvevaṃ hāhākāro'bhavad bhuvi ।। 1 05।।
śaṃkarasya śapathaste pitroste śapathastathā ।
mā spṛśā'smān mahāmāri! dadmaḥ saṃyāvamatra te ।। 1 06।।
ityevaṃ rādhike lokā mānatāḥ saṃpracakrire ।
satyaḥ sādhvyo dvijāḥ santo vyomnā śrībadarīṃ yayuḥ ।। 1 07।।
sadyojātamahādevāya te cāstu namo muhuḥ ।
mahākālāya ca kālabhairavāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1 08।।
ajāpālāya ca vīrabhadrāya te namo muhuḥ ।
mṛtyuṃjayāya ca mahākālyai cāṇḍyai namo muhu ।। 1 09।।
durgāyai nama ityeva dīnaprajāstadocire ।
śrīharirjñātavān sarvaṃ pūrvamenamupadravam ।। 2.90.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhorbadaryāṃ gamanaṃ, rākṣasīnāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāmāgamanam, mahāmāryā rākṣasīnāṃ nāśanam, tataḥ pāpiprajāsu
bhakṣaṇārthaṃ vyāpakatā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 90 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 090 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 91
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 092 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike saṃśṛṇu sādhvi! gatvā śrībadarīṃ dvijāḥ ।
satyaḥ sādhvyastathā santo vyomnā sasnuḥ sarijjale ।। 1 ।।
gaṃgāyāṃ ca kṛtasnānā nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।
cakruḥ saha militvaiva yayuryatra narāyaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā natvā maharṣimaṇḍalam ।
tatratyakṛtasatkārā labdhasvāgatapūjanāḥ ।। 3 ।।
svīkṛtamadhuparkāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।
parṇakuṭīṃ yayuḥ pṛṣṭvā yatrāste lomaśo'pi ca ।। 4 ।।
lomaśo vīkṣya bhaktāँścāgatān śokitamānasān।
papraccha kuśalaṃ śīghraṃ cāgame'pi prayojanam ।। 5 ।।
dattāsanāstu te sarve jagadurlomaśaṃ munim ।
darśanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā prapūjanaṃ tathā ।। 6 ।।
tato vakṣyāma evā'smadgamane tvatra kāraṇam ।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ sthitaṃ ca lomaśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
drāgevā'ntargṛhaṃ gatvā cāvedya svajanāgamam ।
snehabhṛtaṃ hariṃ nītvā sahaiva sa bahiryayau ।। 8 ।।
āgataṃ śrīhariṃ śālāṃ'gaṇe śrībadarītale ।
daṇḍavacca namaskārān cakruste yātrikāstadā ।। 9 ।।
premṇā haristu papraccha kuśalaṃ svāgataṃ sukham ।
tadā cāśrūṇi muktvaiva jagaduḥ śrīhariṃ ca te ।। 2.91.1 0।।
mahāmārī bhairavī yā sīmarakṣaṇakāriṇī ।
tayā siṃhaladvīpasya rākṣasyo'saṃkhyakā hatāḥ ।। 1 1।।
yā'śvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yuddhārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ ।
adharmajīvadaityasya vairaniryāpanakṛte ।। 12।
kanyakā rakṣitāścāpi rakṣitaṃ cāśramaṃ tathā ।
mahāmāryā tathā rātrau tasyai śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ tadā ।। 1 3।।
prasanno varadānārthaṃ prāha sā'pi tadā''rthayat ।
mahāmāryo madutpannā yuddhakartryaḥ kṣudhārditāḥ ।। 14।।
tāmasyaśca samicchāmo naramāṃsāśanaṃ śiva! ।
śaṃbhunoktaṃ na tad yogyaṃ tataḥ prāha tu bhairavī ।। 15।।
bhaktānnaiva grahīṣyāmaḥ śrīhareḥ śaraṇāgatān ।
śivabhaktān harerbhaktān tyaktvā ye pāpinaśca tān ।। 16।।
nāstikān dharmahīnāँśca devadrohiṇa eva tān ।
śaṭhān vinindakān tīrthadrohiṇaḥ kapaṭānvitān ।। 17।।
snānapūjājapabhaktihīnānnarāँśca yoṣitaḥ ।
bhakṣayiṣyāma evā'tra bahirvai daśayojanāt ।। 18।।
tathā'stviti haraḥ prāha mahāmāryo'yutā'yutāḥ ।
bhakṣayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bālān vṛddhān janān drutam ।। 1 9।।
sagarbhā jaraṭhā nārīryuvatīryūna ityapi ।
evaṃ vai viplavo jāto grāmā mānavavarjitāḥ ।। 2.91.20।।
vidyante kākavāsāśca janāḥ kuṭumbavarjitāḥ ।
ardhā vasatayo jātā nirvaṃśāścāpi kecana ।।21 ।।
ayaṃ tūpadravo nātha balamāsādya vartate ।
mahākālasya vegena mriyante mānavāḥ prabho ।।22।।
saṃkhyā nāsti mṛtānāṃ vai vāhakā na milantyapi ।
araṇyaṃ pattanaṃ jātaṃ jātā grāmā vanāni ca ।।23।।
śīghramāgatya rakṣāṃ naḥ kuru tatpralayātprabho।
ityuktvā ruruduḥ sarve dayālustu dayāvaśaḥ ।। 24।।
bhūtvotthāya tataḥ śīghraṃ susasmāra narāyaṇam ।
naranārāyaṇau parṇakuṭyāṃ tvāyayatustadā ।।25।।
agre niṣedaturnatvā parameśaṃ parātparam ।
papracchatustadājñāṃ ca kimevaṃ vyagratā prabho ।।26।।
hariḥ prāhā''janābhe tu khaṇḍe pṛthvyāṃ vyajāyata ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ mahāmāryā vināśo pāpināṃ bahuḥ ।।27।।
mriyante tatra bhaktāśca svalpadoṣā api śritāḥ ।
saṃhāro'yaṃ samajani cādharmajīvarakṣasaḥ ।।28।।
vināśena pulastyasya vaṃśe kharasutasya vai ।
kharasya yā bhaginyastu rākṣasyastābhireva tu ।।29।।
upadravaḥ kṛto naśca kṣetre tatpratikārikā ।
bhairavī ca mahāmārī śaṃbhordūtī ca tāmasī ।।2.91.30।।
pāritoṣikarūpeṇa bhakṣayatyeva pāpinaḥ ।
pāpināṃ saṃgame svalpapāpāḥ supuṇyaśālinaḥ ।।3 1।।
bhaktāścāpi prabhakṣyante tadrakṣārthaṃ mayā drutam ।
gantavyaṃ tatra bhaktaiśca sākamebhiḥ surāṣṭrake ।। 32।।
ityuktaḥ śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ prāha kṛpānidhe ।
svatantrasya pareśasya yathecchā tadbhavet khalu ।। 33।।
mayā nityaṃ pūjanārthaṃ kārtike bhagavān smṛtaḥ ।
pañcavāraṃ pratyahaṃ sampūjitaḥ kārtike mayā ।।34।।
vanditaḥ sevito nityaṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।
phalaiḥ saṃbhojitaścāpi bhaktidharmādibhistathā ।।35।।
toṣitaścāpi ṛṣibhiḥ pāvitaṃ badarīvanam ।
pāvitāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve pāvitaśca himālayaḥ ।।36।।
pāvitā devagaṃgā ca pāvitā parṇaśālikā ।
sadā tīrthasvarūpeyaṃ sthāsyatyeveyamāśrame ।।37।।
saṃkalpāḥ pūritāḥ sarve darśitā tāpasī sthitiḥ ।
rītiśca saṃyamalabhyā tvatto nātha samarjitā ।। 38।।
sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ mama jātaṃ sveṣṭo makho vyajāyata ।
kratuḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ pūrṇo vidhivat parivartate ।।39।।
parameśāstatheśāśca surā maharṣayastathā ।
pitarastoṣitā nātha tvayā yajñe pratiṣṭhatā ।।2.91.40।।
gṛhṇatā ca haviḥ sākṣād vahnimukhena bhāsvatā ।
kiṃnyūnaṃ me vartate'dya muktāḥ santoṣitāstathā ।।41।।
sarvaṃ prapūritaṃ nātha mānasaṃ bhavatā mama ।
sārdhamāsottaraṃ cātroṣitvā badarī pāvitā ।।42।।
ityuktvā śrīnaranārāyaṇau bhaktirmaharṣayaḥ ।
gharmastathā'nyadevāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।43।।
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca pradakṣiṇaṃ sumāñjalim ।
kṣamāmapyarthayāmāsustataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।44।।
āśīrvādān dadau tebhyaścāha naraṃ narāyaṇam ।
bhaktiṃ dharmaṃ maharṣīṃśca samāgacchantu madgṛham ।।45।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
lomaśasya guroścāpyāśramaṃ paśyantu pāvanam ।।46।।
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ kurvantu pāvanaṃ mama ।
haimasthānāṃ bhavatāṃ tu darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ kṣitau ।।47।।
ityuktavān, naranārāyaṇādyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।
mārgaśīrṣasya pūrṇāyāṃ snātvā yātrāṃ pracakrire ।।48।।
ṛṣayo vyomamārgasthāḥ kuṃbhakena yayustadā ।
naranārāyaṇau santo dharmo bhaktiśca lomaśaḥ ।।49।।
sādhvyo haristathā muktā vimānenā''yayurgṛham ।
sāyaṃ prāpuśca saurāṣṭraṃ kālaśokitamānavam ।।2.91.50 ।।
naṣṭabhraṣṭagṛhācāraṃ naṣṭārdhamānavojjhitam ।
satejasko yathāpūrvaṃ cāsīnnāsīcca tādṛśaḥ ।।5 1।।
saurāṣṭraśca yathā tadvanmārge deśā vilokitāḥ ।
kuravaḥ śūrasenāśca maravo gaurjarāstathā ।।52।।
naṣṭaprajādhanāḥ śuṣkā nistejaskā gṛhā iva ।
mahāmārībhakṣitāśca kālavegena nāśitāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
mānavā vanavāsāśca gṛhavāsāḥ piśācakāḥ ।
śavā mṛtyunivāsāśca tiryagvāsaṃ ca jīvanam ।।94।।
āgārāṇi śmaśānāni mṛtyudūtāśca mūṣakāḥ ।
vilokyante nagareṣu hyatarkyaḥ pralayo yathā ।।।95।।
etatsarvaṃ viditvaiva bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ vicārya yānācca tadā sasmāra śaṃkaram ।।96।।
kṣetrapaḥ śaṃkarastatra cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
upasthito'bhavattūrṇaṃ nanāma parameśvaram ।।97।।
śaṃkaraṃ śrīhariḥ prāha mahāmārībhireva yat ।
vināśyate jagatsarvaṃ mahāmārīṃ nivāraya ।।98।।
drāgeva śaṃkaro naijaṃ galanādaṃ cakāra ha ।
kampitaṃ sarvamaṇḍaṃ ca bhuvanāni caturdaśa ।।59।।
kampitānyabhavattūrṇaṃ mahāmārī samāhvayat ।
digbhyaḥ sarvābhya evaitāḥ koṭirūpadharāḥ striyaḥ ।।2.91.60।।
bhakṣikā madyamāṃsānāmāyayurharasannidhau ।
śaṃkarastāstataḥ prāha nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।6 1 ।।
dayālurbhagavānatra lokarakṣaṇakārakaḥ ।
niṣedhati svayaṃ śrīmān pāpipāpavināśakaḥ ।।62।।।
mā bhakṣayantu pāpīśca bhakṣyante pāpisaṃgataḥ ।
bhaktāścāpi ca bhaktānāṃ kuṭumbānyapi sarvaśaḥ ।।63।।
teṣāṃ rakṣā mayā kāryā tyajantu tadvināśanam ।
ityuktāstā mahāmāryāṃ nivṛttā bhayato hareḥ ।।64 ।।
yayācire kṣamāṃ cāpi hareścaraṇasevanam ।
haristāḥ prāha vai sarvā yāntu sarvatra bhūtale ।।65।।
tilakaṃ candrako me syād bhāle kaṇṭhe ca mālikā ।
yeṣāṃ tān sampradāyaiva prāṇān śaktiṃ ca cetanām ।।66।।
jīvaya devajīvān bhaktimārgapravartakān ।
tatastāḥ prāha bhagavan na śaktā hi vayaṃ tathā ।।67।।
cetanaṃ jīvanaṃ dātuṃ kiṃ kurmo'tra tavā''jñayā ।
harirdadau tadā tābhyaḥ kalpalatā sujīvanīḥ ।।68।।
tā gṛhītvā yayuḥ sarvā jīvayāmāsurīṣṭakān ।
bhaktān sarvānardhapāpāna śrīharestu nideśataḥ ।।69।।
tadā''nandaḥ punarjātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mānaveṣu vai ।
yeṣāṃ vai tilakaṃ kaṇṭhī te bhavanti sajīvanāḥ ।।2.91.70।।
ityudghoṣe pravṛtte ca mṛtānāmapi tajjanāḥ ।
kaṇṭhyā yuktaṃ śavaṃ kṛtvā vilokayanti jīvanam ।।71 ।।
kecit kurvanti tilakaṃ bhāle śavasya vai tadā ।
kaṇṭhe'rpayanti kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ jīvanāya vai ।।72।।
evaṃ deśeṣu sarvatra śavāstilakasragdharāḥ ।
sajīvā utthitā bhūmau sāścaryaṃ cā'valokayan ।।73।।
vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā mānavāścājanābhake ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiviṣṇo mṛtyornivāraka ।।74।।
rakṣa rakṣa sadā caivaṃ tvārthayacchrīhariṃ prati ।
tadā śrīśaṃkaraḥ prāha sarvāstā bhairavī satīḥ ।।75।।
'o namaḥ śrīkṛpṇakarāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
mantramimaṃ bhavapyaśca gṛhṇantu matta eva ca ।।76।।
jīvitān mānavān karṇe śrāvayantvapi sarvaśaḥ ।
evamuktāḥ kṣaṇāt sarvā manovegāḥ sugṛhya tam ।।77।।
mantraṃ bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇas-yo dadurmantrān tu sarvaśaḥ ।
kalpavallosamutthebhyaḥ kārayitvā tu vaiṣṇavān ।।78।।
jagadujjīvayāmāsurbhaktaśokān prajahrire ।
cakruścaitādṛśaṃ loke na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।।79।।
parabrahma vinā tādṛk kartumarhasi ko'paraḥ ।
nāḍīprāṇā yasya haste tena kartuṃ hi śakyate ।।2.91.80।।
brahmāṇḍe cotsavā jātā grāme grāme gṛhe gṛhe ।
mṛtāścojjīvitāḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।।8 1 ।।
tīrthārthaṃ tvāyayuḥ sarve prāptanūtanajīvanāḥ ।
kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpīṃ tu tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।82।।
mahāmārīsamūhāँśca dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ prapedire ।
pauṣe māghe phālgune ca caitre'pi tvāyayurjanāḥ ।।83।।
bhūtvā sarve kṛtakṛtyā yānti sma nijamandiram ।
narā nāryaḥ koṭisaṃkhyā jīvitā hariṇā tadā ।।84।।
atha tā rādhike devyo mahāmāryo'pi mādhavāt ।
vavruḥ śrībālakṛṣṇādvai sevanaṃ nijapādayoḥ ।।85।।
haristābhyo dadau vāsaṃ tataḥ saurāṣṭrake vane ।
bhavatyo badarīvṛkṣā bhavantu divyarūpiṇaḥ ।।86।।
kṣetreṣu cāpyaraṇyeṣu svalpā vai cirajīvinaḥ ।
kaṇṭakadvayayuktāśca tāmasaiḥ kaṇṭakairyutāḥ ।।87।।
saurāṣṭre maccaraṇayoḥ rajobhiḥ saṃpariplutāḥ ।
pādasevātulyalābhā bhavantvākalpasaṃsthitāḥ ।।88।।
ahaṃ rāmasvarūpeṇa bhakṣayiṣye phalāni vaḥ ।
śabarījātikā me'tra dāsyantyapi phalāni vaḥ ।।89।।
ityevaṃ tāḥ kṛtā bhaktāḥ stambarūpā bhuvastale ।
kṣudrikāstā badaryaśca drāgjātāścirajīvanāḥ ।।2.91.90।।
naranārāyaṇādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhaktidharmayoḥ ।
svāgataṃ śrīhariścakre mātā pitā ca lomaśaḥ ।।91।।
vāsaṃ naije cālaye'pi kānake pradadau hariḥ ।
bhojanaṃ tāpasebhyaśca havyādi pradadau prabhuḥ ।। 92।।
viśaśramustataḥ sarve prātastvaśvasarovare ।
sasnustato yayuḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ śrīlomaśāśramam ।।93।।
vistīrṇaṃ divyarūpaṃ ca brahmapriyābhirujjvalam ।
yatra māyā na caivāsti divyā'kṣarasamaṃ śubham ।।94।।
tatastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā pūjanaṃ tataḥ ।
tīrthadevān militvā ca dhṛtvā rūpadvayaṃ ca te ।।95।।
tīrthe tīrthasvarūpeṇa sthitvā'pareṇa te tataḥ ।
ājñāṃ labdhvā hareḥ sarve yayuḥ śrībadarīvanam ।।96।।
dharmatīrthaṃṃ bhaktitīrthaṃ naratīrthaṃ tathottamam ।
nārāyaṇasya tīrthaṃ ca ṛṣitīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tathā ।।97।।
badarītīrthamityetajjātaṃ cāśvasarovare ।
evaṃ vai rādhike tatra camatkāro mahānabhūt ।।98।।
bhuktimuktipradaścāpi smaraṇānmṛtyuhārakaḥ ।
kanyārakṣānimittena jagadvai vaiṣṇavaṃ kṛtam ।।99।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāmārībhirbahumānavanāśe sādhvīsādhuviprarṣigaṇo badarīṃ gatvā prabhave nivedayitvā harimānayāmāsa, hari-
mṛtān jagajjīvān jīvayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 91 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 091 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 92
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 093 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇādayaḥ ।
traya īśeśvarā jñānaṃ papracchurbrahmabodhakam ।। 1 ।।
jñānaṃ jīveśvarāṇāṃ tu bhaktikṛd vada cāgraja ।
ko vā tvātmā ca kā muktiḥ saṃsāraḥ kinnimittakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kaḥ saṃsārastathā brahma kiṃ tat parataraṃ tataḥ ।
tvaṃ vetsi paramaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaṃ vai bhagavan prabho ।। 3 ।।
nārāyaṇa svayaṃ sākṣātpurāṇā'cintyapūruṣa ।
na hyanyo vidyate vettā tvāmṛte puruṣottama ।। 4 ।।
evamuktvā'niruddhaśca pradyamnaḥ saṃprakarṣaṇaḥ ।
dadhyuḥ svasvahṛtsu taṃ kaṃcitparamaṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum ।। 5 ।।
tāvad vilokayāmāsuḥ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।
vihāya vāsudevākhyaṃ rūpaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ param ।। 6 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmaparaṃ harim ।
vibhrājamānaṃ muktaiśca sevitaṃ divyamadbhutam ।। 7 ।।
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ kāntaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।
sarvāyudhadharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhiyā yutam ।। 8 ।।
nityānandaguṇaiśvaryabhūtiśaktisukhāśrayam ।
dvibhujaṃ koṭimuktābhirmuktaiḥ sevitapatkajam ।। 9 ।।
hasantaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca koṭikandarpasundaram ।
kiśoraṃ divyaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvasṛṣṭimanoharam ।। 2.92.1 0।।
ujjvalaṃ saumyabhāvena saṃbhṛtaṃ cāyatekṣaṇam ।
pare dhāmni divyagajāsanasthaṃ. parameśvaram ।। 11 ।।
tato'kṣaraṃ brahmadhāma dadṛśuḥ sīmavarjitam ।
koṭimuktān dadṛśuścākṣarasaṃjñān manoharān ।। 12।।
tataste dadṛśuḥ śīghraṃ golokaṃ gopasaṃśritam ।
gopīgaṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ śrīrādhākṛṣṇā'bhyadhiṣṭhitam ।। 13।।
tataste dadṛśū ramyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmasadṛśam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāvāsaṃ koṭipārṣadasaṃśritam ।। 14।।
tato divyaṃ sukailāsaṃ sadāśivaśivāśritam ।
dadṛśuste ca bhūmno'thā'mṛtākhyaṃ dhāma śobhitam ।। 15।।
tataste dadṛśurviṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrasāgaram ।
śvetadvīpaṃ badarīṃ ca vāsudeve'graje tadā ।। 16।।
tatra tatra harermūrtiṃ yādṛśīṃ tādṛśīṃ tu te ।
vāsudeve dadṛśurhi sarvāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca māyikīm ।। 17।।
atha tiro'bhavat sṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇānte tejasāṃ cayam ।
dadṛśustatra ca divyaṃ saurāṣṭraṃ vai yathāsthitam ।। 18।।
tatra kṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro'bhidhaṃ subhāsvaram ।
tatra kuṃkumavāpīṃ ca tathā śrīlomaśāśramam ।। 1 9।।
tatsarvaṃ paramaṃ dhāma divyamuktādirājitam ।
brahmapriyābhisaṃvyāptaṃ sāṃkhyayoginyadhiśritam ।।2.92.20।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktādhivāsitam ।
divyaśrīkambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇaśobhitam ।।21 ।।
prabhāpāravatīlakṣmīmāṇikīrādhikāśritam ।
mañjulāsaguṇāhaṃsāvijayālalitāśritam ।।22।।
śatena dvādaśabhiśca priyābhiradhivāsitam ।
anantakoṭayabjakānādhiṣṭhitaṃ divyabhūtikam ।।23।।
dadaśurdivyakalaśaiḥ prāsādānapi śobhitān ।
mahāprāsādametasyā'nādikṛṣṇasya dadṛśuḥ ।।24।।
svātmādhāraṃ paraṃ divyaṃ yatra śrībhagavān svayam ।
kiśorapratibhaścāste bālakṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ।।25।।
nārāyaṇānāṃ paramaḥ pumān śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
īśvarāṇāṃ ca paramaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।26।।
avatārasamūhānāṃ kāraṇaṃ cā'vatārī yaḥ ।
kṛṣṇānāṃ cāpi yaḥ kṛṣṇo vyūhānāṃ vyūhakṛtprabhuḥ ।।27।।
taṃ hariṃ dadṛśū rādhe vāsudeve harau tu te ।
vibhrājamānaṃ vimale gajasvarṇāsane harim ।।28।।
yadantarā sarvametad yato'bhinnamidaṃ jagat ।
savāsudevaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahānandaṃ prapedire ।।29।।
tataḥ kṣaṇāntare sarvaṃ līnaṃ dadṛśire puraḥ ।
vāsudevaṃ dadṛśuste praśāntamanaso'bhavan ।
evaṃ pratyakṣavijñānaṃ kārayitvā tu tāँstataḥ ।।2.92.3 0।।
vāsudevaḥ samuvāca guhyaṃ jñānaṃ sanātanam ।
yanna devā vijānanti yajamānā dvijātayaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
taṃ jñātvā parameśānaṃ brahmībhūtā maharṣayaḥ ।
saṃsāraṃ na prapadyante pūrve'pi brahmadhāminaḥ ।।32।।
ātmā'yaṃ sukhavān svacchaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
tadantare tu yaścāste sarvāntaraḥ parātparaḥ ।।33।।
so'ntaryāmī sa puruṣaḥ sa prāṇaḥ svāmisaṃjñakaḥ ।
asmāt sañjāyate viśvaṃ tasya dhāmni pralīyate ।।34।।
sa māyāṃ chāyayā gṛhṇan karoti vividhāstanūḥ ।
nā'sya bandho na tadbhāvo nāyaṃ māyāguṇāśrayaḥ ।।35।।
yathā prakāśatamasostādātmyaṃ nopapadyate ।
tadvadaikyaṃ na sambandhaḥ prapañcaparamātmanoḥ ।।36।।
chāyātapau yathā loke parasparavilakṣaṇau ।
tadvat prapañcapuruṣau vibhinnau paramārthataḥ ।।37।।
ātmā śuddho nityabuddho muktarūpaḥ svabhāvataḥ ।
paramātmā'tiśuddhaśca sarvajñaścātmasusthitaḥ ।।38।।
vikārahīnau nirdvandvau sadānandapariplutau ।
ātmatadantarātmānau sayujau divyasadguṇau ।।39।।
nityayuktau ca suhṛdau draṣṭārau ca niyāmakau ।
ātmā karma kṛtaṃ bhuṃkte'ntaryāmī bhogavarjitaḥ ।।2.92.40।।
diśatyeva yathākālaṃ niyāmya śreṣṭhine phalam ।
ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī kṛśaḥ sthūlaśca mānavān ।।41 ।।
ahaṃkāreṇa tadbhoktā bhavatyajñānavaibhavāt ।
ajñānādanyathājñānānmanasā saha yujyate ।।42।।
prākṛtaṃ guṇasaṃsargaṃ yojayitvā mano'sthiram ।
svadharmāḍhyaṃ tadātmānaṃ sampādayati vai muhuḥ ।।43।।
ahaṃkārā'vivekena kartā'haṃ ceti mānayan ।
svātmānaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ brahma vismaratyeva kalmaṣī ।।44।।
anātmanyātmavijñānī sarvaduḥkhapraśevadhiḥ ।
rāgadveṣādayaścāpi bhrāntijāstatra yanti ca ।।45।।
tairdoṣaiḥ puṇyapāpe'yaṃ bhuṃkte svabhāvaje yathā ।
bhrāntināśe tu doṣāṇāṃ vigame niṣprapañcakaḥ ।।46।।
ekaḥ santiṣṭhate deve kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe'rpitaḥ ।
saccidānandayogena saccidānandavān sadā ।।47।।
vartate parameśasya kṛpayā ceśvaro yathā ।
yathā vai dhūmasamparkānnākāśo malinaḥ kvacit ।।48।।
tathā mānasadoṣaiśca nirlepo'kṣarasaṃjñitaḥ ।
upādhivarjitaḥ śuddho vimalātmā prakāśate ।।49।।
jñeyaṃ tyaktvā tato jñaptiṃ jñaptisaṃskāramityapi ।
tyaktvā tvātmaprakāśaḥ syād yathā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।2.92.50।।
tasmādātmā'kṣaraḥ śuddho nityaḥ śrīharisaṃśritaḥ ।
upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaśca mumukṣubhiḥ ।।5 1 ।।
yadātmani parabrahma bhāti sarvatra sarvadā ।
śraddadhānasya bhaktasya tadā sampadyate svayam ।।52।।
yadā sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ svasminnevā'bhipaśyati ।
kāryajāte nijātmānaṃ tadā sampadyate hariḥ ।।।53।।
yadā sarvaṃ samādhistho nātiriktaṃ prapaśyati ।
ekībhūtaḥ pareṇā''tmā tadā muktaḥ prajāyate ।।।54।।
yadā'sya mānasā bhāvā vilīyante pare harau ।
tadā'yamamṛtībhūto mokṣaṃ yāti hareḥ padam ।।55।।
yadā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ tasminneva vilokyate ।
tataścāpi ca vistāraṃ tadā'sya brahmayogyatā ।।56।।
yadā paśyati cātmānaṃ tadātmānaṃ ca kevalam ।
tadā'sya brahmasampattirnivṛttirmāyikī tadā ।।57।।
yadā janmajarāduḥkhavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam ।
ātmātmabrahmavijñānaṃ tadā'yaṃ śāśvataḥ śivaḥ ।।58।।
yathā nadīnadā yānti sāgareṇaikatāṃ tathā ।
ātmā'kṣareṇa taccāpi pare brahmaṇi caikatām ।।59।।
vrajettadā bhavet sākṣādaparokṣānudarśanam ।
viśeṣā'dvaitā'dvaitaṃ tad śrutibhiḥ sannirūpitam ।।2.92.60।।
tadvijñānaṃ paraśreyaḥpradaṃ copāsanābhidham ।
yatra tajjāyate tatra na prapañco na vāsanā ।।61 ।।
ajñānaṃ vartate yatra tatra mohaśca vāsanā ।
tasmānmohaṃ parityajya dagdhvā sarvāstu vāsanāḥ ।।62।।
sarvaśrutisunistāraṃ brahma bhūtvā tared budhaḥ ।
vijñānaṃ bhagavadbhaktiṃ yogaṃ saṃsādhya vai dhruvam ।।63।।
brahmarūpaṃ vibhāvyaiva paraṃ harimavāpnuyāt ।
eṣa ātmā'hamavyakto brahmedaṃ dhāma bhaktimat ।।64।।
brahmaṇyayaṃ paraḥ svāmī so'kṣare puruṣottamaḥ ।
viśeṣā'dvaitā'dvaitaṃ tad yo hariḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।65।।
sarvarasaḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvagandho'jaro'maraḥ ।
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaśca sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ ।।66।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'ntaryamano'pi saḥ ।
apāṇipādo javago grahītā sarvasaṃsthitaḥ ।।67।।
acakṣurapi caṣṭe'so karṇaśūnyaḥ śṛṇotyayam ।
vedā'hamenaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ parameśvaram ।।68।।
pare dhāmni sthitaṃ cāpi kambharāśrīsutaṃ śubham ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīśaṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ ca tam ।।69।।
vāsudevaṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ sarvāntarasthitam ।
paśyanti ṛṣayastaṃ tu tadanugrahaśālinaḥ ।।2.92.70।।
tāpasā naiva paśyanti paśyantyenaṃ hi sevakāḥ ।
nirguṇo'malarūpasya yadaiśvaryā'kṣarābhidham ।।71 ।।
upāsakāḥ prapaśyanti sūkṣmatattvādidarśinaḥ ।
yanna devā vijānanti mohitāstasya māyayā ।।72।।
kā kathā jīvalokasya śṛṇudhvaṃ bhrātaro mama ।
aniruddha! tvayi tvāste sarjanaiśvaryamuttamam ।।73 ।।
akṣarasyaiva tadboddhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam ।
pradyamna! tvayi yaccāste poṣaṇaiśvaryamityapi ।।74।।
akṣarasyaiva tad bodhyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam ।
saṃkarṣaṇa! tvayi cāste saṃhāraiśvaryamityapi ।।75।।
akṣarasyaiva tadbodhyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ koṭibhāgajam ।
mayi cāste yadaiśvaryaṃ vasatirdīvyatistathā ।।76।।
akṣarasyaiva bodhyaṃ tad yatprāptaṃ tena vai hareḥ ।
ahaṃviśeṣaṇaṃ tatrā'kṣare'dvaitasvarūpiṇi ।।77।।
viśeṣādvaitametadvai cā'kṣaraṃ brahma vidyate ।
tadekaṃ tvakṣaraṃ nānyat samaṃ cākṣarasaṃjñitam ।।78।।
viśeṣyaṃ tvakṣaraṃ yatrā'dvaite śrīparamātmani ।
samanveti sa viśeṣādvaitādvaitaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।79।।
māyātītaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca tadatītaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
māyāṃ vihāya jīvāścākṣaraṃ yānti hi tatpadam ।।2.92.80।।
praviṣṭāstasya sāyujyaṃ labhante bhaktiyoginaḥ ।
ye hi māyāmatikrāntāḥ sarvā viśvasvarūpiṇīm ।।81 ।।
labhante te'kṣaradhāma tatra me paramaṃ padam ।
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiraiśvarī cāpi māyikī ।।82।।
prasādāttasya kṛṣṇasyā'kṣareśasya hareḥprabhoḥ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyetyanuśāsanam ।।।83।।
tatputraśiṣyasādhubhyo dātavyaṃ brahmayoṣite ।
pradātavyaṃ na cānyebhyo'pātrebhyo'pathyameva yat ।।84।।
ityetad rādhike tubhyaṃ mayā jñānaṃ prakāśitam ।
vāsudevena yatpūrvaṃ cānujebhyaḥ prakīrtitam ।।85।।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāsudevaḥ gītāyāṃ parabrahmavijñānena viśeṣādvaitā'dvaitena tatpadaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 92 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 092 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 93
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 094 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrīvāsudevastvāha saṃkarṣaṇādikān ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 1 ।।
sthitisthāpakaśaktyākhyaḥ kālaḥ putro layaṃkaraḥ ।
harate sarvamevaiṣo māyāvaiṣamyamityapi ।। 2 ।।
kṣobhaṃ karoti caivaiṣastadā māyā pramāthinī ।
prasūte viṣamāvasthāṃ mahāpūruṣayogataḥ ।। 3 ।।
māyā kālaḥ pūruṣaśca parameśvaraśaktayaḥ ।
tābhyaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tasmāttā brahmarūpikāḥ ।। 4 ।।
tajjātaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca jagat sarvaṃ tu tattanu ।
tatra sarvatra evā'syākṣarasya brahmaṇaḥ khalu ।। 5 ।।
pāṇipādākṣiśravaṇānanamastakanābhayaḥ ।
ataḥ sarvaṃ samāvṛtya tiṣṭhatyakṣarameva tat ।। 6 ।।
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ divyendriyasamanvitam ।
sarvādhāraṃ mahānandaṃ pramāṇātītagocaram ।। 7 ।।
sarvopamānarahitaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ parāmṛtam ।
abhinnaṃ bhinnasaṃsthānaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvamakṣaram ।। 8 ।।
nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ jyotirnirvikalpamasīmakam ।
sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ sthitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tatrāste sarvagaḥ śāntastadātmā parameśvaraḥ ।
tena vyāptamidaṃ viśvaṃ jīveśamuktavāsitam ।। 2.93.1 0।।
tasyecchayā'pyahaṃ jāto vāsudevaḥ pareśvara ।
matto yūyaṃ mūrtayaśca traya eva japoṣalāḥ ।। 11 ।।
tato bhūmā mahāviṣṇustato virāṭ ca viśvasṛṭ ।
tato maharṣayo devā jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ।। 12।।
jaganmātā mahāmāyā tasyecchā mūlarūpiṇī ।
amṛtākhyā doṣakartrī pāragā pūrikā tathā ।। 13।।
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ samprasūte'khilaṃ jagat ।
sā yā prakṛtiriṣṭaiva kāntāvanmohinī priyā ।। 14।।
mohāpannastu puruṣaḥ sa ātmā jīva īśvaraḥ ।
ahaṃkārakṛtamaitryo mahattattvātibāndhavaḥ ।। 15।।
mānase kṛtaviśvāso janmalābhāya kalpate ।
prakṛtau nāsti yasyeṣṭaṃ mohastasya na vidyate ।। 16।।
ahaṃkāre na vai maitrī mahattatve na bandhutā ।
mānase na ca viśvāso mokṣalābhāya kalpate ।। 17।।
tasyaite'nukūlabhāve vartante hyupakāriṇaḥ ।
māyā kālaśca puruṣasta ete'pyupakāriṇaḥ ।। 18।।
prāpayantyakṣaraṃ divyaṃ yasyeṣṭaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paramadhāmagaḥ ।। 19।।
tadyogāttvasya jāyante bhaktasya divyavigrahāḥ ।
jñānecchākṛtayaścāpi sukhaduḥkhādibhāvanāḥ ।। 2.93.20।।
dharmādharmādikośāśca mano'haṃbuddhivedanāḥ ।
jāyante divyarūpāśca sattvaṃ rajaśca kalmaṣam ।।।21।।।
tanmātrāṇīndriyavargaḥ ṣaṭkośā bhūtapañcakam ।
tadvikārāstathā sarve jāyante divyaghaṭṭanāḥ ।।22।।
tatkriyāstadvyavahāraśceṣṭā vartanamityapi ।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca jāyate brahmanirguṇam ।।23।।
kālo nātra prabhuryo vai sṛjate harate prajāḥ ।
sarve kālasya vaśagāḥ kālo bhaktasya vai vaśe ।।24।।
bhakte'kṣaraṃ tvakṣare ca sarvajñaḥ svāmivallabhaḥ ।
sarvajñānna paraḥ kaścit taṃ bhajitvā pramucyate ।।25।।।
nityaṃ nāstīti jagati kiñcit sthāvarajaṃgamam ।
ṛte śrīparamātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।26।।
nā'yaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā ।
śakyo vai dehibhirjñātuṃ vinā bhaktiṃ parāśrayām ।।27।।
śrīhariṃ sarvabhūtānāmantastiṣṭhati sarvataḥ ।
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ lokā na jānanti pareśvarāḥ ।।28।।
yasminnantaḥ sarvamidaṃ yaśca sarvāntare sthitaḥ ।
so'yaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca kālo'gnirviśvatomukhaḥ ।।29।।
na taṃ paśyanti munayo rājasāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ ।
brahmā virāṭ tathā bhūmā ye cānye tatpare'pi ca ।।2.93.30।।
yathākathañcit tannāthaṃ jānāmyarthaṃ tato'varam ।
muktā nāntaṃ nā'kṣaraṃ ca tadā'nyeṣāṃ tu kā kathā ।।31।।
nityaṃ tadvigrahe vyāptā naiva jānāti māṇikī ।
tadā'nyāsāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ kā kathā'sya vijānane ।।32।।
gṛṇanti satataṃ vedā tamekaṃ parameśvaram ।
yajanti vividhairyajñairbrāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ।।33।।
dhyāyanti yoganiṣṭhāśca yatante pāramīkṣitum ।
vinā'nugrahamevā'sya naiva paśyanti kāṣṭhayā ।।34।।
sa eva sarvahaviṣāṃ bhoktā cāpi phalapradaḥ ।
sarvadevatanuḥ so'yaṃ sarvātmā śreyasāṃ padam ।।35।।
taṃ tatkṛpayā paśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ santa eva tu ।
teṣāṃ sannihitaḥ so'yaṃ ye taṃ nityamupāsate ।।36।।
tebhyo dadāti tatsthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam ।
uttamā madhyamāścāpi nikṛṣṭāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ।।37।।
tasya bhaktyā pramucyante tenaiva saṃgatā yadā।
tadbhaktā na vinaśyanti nimnaṃ yānti na vai padam ।।38।।
tanmārgasthāstasya yogaṃ kārayanti hi sādhavaḥ ।
yo vai nindati tān mūḍho bālakṛṣṇaṃ sa nindati ।। 39।।
yastān pūjayate bhaktyā sa taṃ pūjayati prabhum ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ bhojanaṃ cāmbaraṃ dravam ।।2.93.40।।
tasmai dadāti yo bhaktyā sa syāt tasya priyaḥ sadā ।
sa pūrvaṃ bhaktavargasya duḥkhanāśārthameva hi ।।41।।
śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa rādhikāṃ nijavāmataḥ ।
tayā'rthitaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo babhūvā'kṣaradhāmani ।।42।।
goloke nyavasat tasyā bhaktigrahaṇahetave ।
sa pūrvaṃ bhaktavargasya sampaddānārthameva tu ।।43।।
śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa śrīlakṣmīṃ nijavakṣasaḥ ।
tathā'rthitaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇo babhūva ha ।।44।।
sa pūrvaracanārthaṃ vai sṛṣṭiṃ sasmāra pūrvavat। ।
śaktiṃ prakāśayāmāsa jaghanāt prakṛtiṃ parām ।।45।।
tayā'rthitaḥ sa bhagavānnavyākṛte'kṣarāśraye ।
vāsudevo'hamabhavaṃ prakṛteścetanāpradaḥ ।।46 ।।
tenā'rthitā mahāsṛṣṭirjanisthairyāntadharmiṇī ।
tanmūrtyātmakamaddehādbhavantastraya eva ca ।।47।।
aniruddhaśca pradyumnaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo'tivaibhavāḥ ।
prāvirbhūtā guṇakāryakarāḥ śrīparameśvarāḥ ।।48।।
tenā'rthitastato nyāyaḥ sa bhūmā taddhṛdudbhavaḥ ।
īśvarāṇāṃ nyāyakartā'mṛte dhāmni virājate ।।49 ।।
tenā'rthitastato māyāvikāro'ṅkurakāraṇam ।
muktastasya bhrakuṭestu samutpannaḥ sa pūruṣaḥ ।।2.93.5 0।।
prakṛteḥ puruṣaḥ so'yaṃ ramate māyayā tadā ।
tasmājjātaṃ ca yugalaṃ buddhyā mahatsamākhyayā ।।51 ।।
sevitaśca pumān tasyāḥ kānto ramaṇarañjanaḥ ।
pradhānapuruṣau deho hareḥ khyātāvubhau sadā ।।।52।।
tattvaṃ tābhyāmahaṅgarvābhidhānaṃ samajāyata ।
mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vai jātaḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ śrīniṣevitaḥ ।।53 ।।
tasmājjāto virāḍākhyastato devā harādayaḥ ।
tebhyaḥ pitṛpraṇālyā vai vedānaprāpayaddhariḥ ।।54।।
sa eva parame dhāmni rājamānaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
tapo'rthaṃ kalpayāmāsa naranārāyaṇaṃ tanūm ।।55 ।।
jīvalokasya śāntyarthaṃ duḥkhanāśārthamityapi ।
āsurāṇāṃ praśāntyarthaṃ lakṣmīśaḥ kṣīrasāgare ।।56।।
śvedhāmni ramākānto virājateṃ'śamātrataḥ ।
yogināṃ ca satāṃ sādhvīyoṣitāṃ paramo guruḥ ।।57।।
dhārmikāṇāṃ sa goptā ca nihantā vedavidviṣām ।
māyikānāṃ ca māyāyā nihantā sa pareśvaraḥ ।।58।।
sā māyā ca parā śaktiryadā vidyeti gīyate ।
sā māyā cā'parā śaktiryadā'vidyā hi sā matā ।।59।।
nāśayet sa ca tāṃ māyāṃ mokṣaprado hi mādhavaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartako nivartakaḥ ।।2.93.60।।
ādhārabhūtaḥ sarvāsāṃ nidhānamamṛtasya ca ।
ekā śaktiḥ keśavasyā'kṣaraṃ brahma ca dhāma yat ।।61 ।।
anyā śaktirvipulā yā saṃsthāpayati vai jagat ।
tatrāntaryāmitā tasya cāparā śaktireva sā ।।62।।
jñānabhaktiprapakṣābhyāṃ samārādhayati prabhum ।
sa yāti vai harerdhāma vyatikramya tu kilbiṣam ।।63।।
sarvāḥ śaktīrvyatikramya māṃ prayāti madiṣṭakṛt ।
mamopāsanayā kecid bhavantyapi narāyaṇāḥ ।।64।।
mama bhāvaiḥ saṃbhṛtāśca tārayanti ca dehinaḥ ।
kecid bhavanti lokeśā viṣṇavastatkṛpāvaśāt ।।65।।
kecit harādayaścāpi kecid brahmādikeśvarāḥ ।
teṣu sarveṣu bhagavān prerakaśca nivartakaḥ ।।66।।
so'yaṃ brahmavidāṃ brahmā svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ ।
māyāvināmayaṃ devaḥ purāṇo hariravyayaḥ ।।67।।
yogināmastyayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ strīṇāṃ devī girīndrajā ।
ādityānāmayaṃ viṣṇurvasūnāmasti pāvakaḥ ।।68।।
rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraścāyaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāmayam ।
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmayam ।।69।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vaśiṣṭho'yaṃ devānāṃ ca śatakratuḥ ।
śilpināṃ viśvakarmā'yaṃ prahlādaḥ suravidviṣām ।।2.93.70।।
munīnāmapyayaṃ vyāso gaṇānāṃ ca vināyakaḥ ।
vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadro'yaṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ ।।71।।
parvatānāmayaṃ merurnakṣatrāṇāṃ tu candramāḥ ।
vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyameva saḥ ।।72।।
ananto bhogināṃ so'yaṃ senānīnāṃ ca pāvakiḥ ।
āśramāṇāṃ gṛhasthaḥ sa yugānāṃ satyameva saḥ ।।73।।
kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ nirvṛtiḥ sarvarakṣasām ।
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaśca mṛgendrāṇāṃ mṛgādhipaḥ ।।74।।
vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca japyānāṃ praṇavastvayam ।
sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ manurnītimatāṃ hi saḥ ।।75।।
vidyānāmātmavidyā saḥ tattvānāṃ cetano hi saḥ ।
gatīnāṃ muktirevā'yaṃ bandhanānāṃ tu vāsanā ।।76।।
patnīvrato dvijānāṃ tu satīnāṃ kambharā satī ।
sampadāṃ ca mahālakṣmīrūpaḥ saḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।77।।
evaṃ vai bhāvayettatra tatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
tena nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī tatra phalati sarvathā ।।78।।
sa ca mūrtisvarūpo'sti sarvalokeṣu cānujāḥ ।
tathaivācāryarūpo'sti guruḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।।79।।
sādhurūpaḥ sa evā'sti divyadehaḥ sa pāvanaḥ ।
pitṝūpaḥ sa evā'sti mātṝūpo'pi mādhavaḥ ।।2.93.80।।
satīrūpaḥ patirūpaḥ sa evā'sti narottamaḥ ।
aṣṭāvete hi guravastārakā divyabhāvitāḥ ।।81।।
teṣāṃ pratyupakāro hi na kathaṃcana vidyate ।
teṣāṃ nityaṃ priyaṃ kuryāt karmaṇā manasā girā ।।82।।
ta evaite'nādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāḥ ।
matvaivaṃ ye bhajante tān yānti te paramāṃ gatim ।।83।।
so'yaṃ sākṣātparabrahā'nādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sarvāvatāraśāstā ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।84।।
bhagavāँścā'kṣarātītaścāntaryāmīśvareśvaraḥ ।
bālarūpaḥ kambharāśrīgṛhe cāste'vatīrya ca ।।85।।
śrīmadgopālabālaḥ saḥ lomaśāśramasannidhau ।
prāsāde kānake cāste'kṣarakṣetre'śvasārase ।।86।।
tīrthe kuṃkumavāpyākhye bhūtale divyavigrahe ।
vartate mānave rūpe brahmapriyābhisevitaḥ ।।87।।
kṛpayā jīvamokṣārthaṃ brahmāṇḍarakṣaṇāya ca ।
vartate mānave rūpe mānavarjyo'pi mādhavaḥ ।।88।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānām bhavatāmaṃśarūpiṇām ।
dṛndṛśyo vartate bhāgyād yo nā'smaddṛkpragocaraḥ ।।89।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau vāsudevaḥ prabhuḥ kṣaṇam ।
dadhyuścitte trayaste'pi divyamānavamacyutam ।।2.93.90।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāsudevagītāyāṃ prabhoḥ prāptisādhanavibhūtīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 93 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 093 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 94
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 095 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevavākyaiḥ prabodhitāḥ ।
māhātmyajñānavantaste trayo'ṇḍastadagrajam ।। 1 ।।
pūrvotsaveṣu kṛṣṇasya darśanārthaṃ vayaṃ gatāḥ । [
idānīṃ taddarśanārthaṃ māhātmyajñānasaṃyutāḥ ।।2 ।।
jigamiṣāmo bhavatā sārdhaṃ bālasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
līlākaivalyavīkṣārthaṃ tadvijñānena rañjitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
ityevaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ prokto vāsudevo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha tallokād brahmāṇḍodaramāyayau ।। 4 ।।
vāsudevasya lokātte vairājasadṛśāṇavaḥ ।
bhūtvā vairājalokāँścāviviśuśca tato'pi ca ।। 5 ।।
bhūtvā cāṇutarāḥ satye loke cāviviśustataḥ ।.
tato'pyaṇava evaite bhūtvā divaṃ samāyayuḥ ।। 6 ।।
tato'pyaṇutamā bhūtvā mānavaṃ lokamāyayuḥ ।
yatpūrvaṃ śrīvāsudevamūrtirvai svasya dhāmani ।। 7 ।।
tasyā romṇastu pārārdhyabhāgo'tra mānuṣe sthale ।
tasyāpi koṭibhāgena mānuṣaṃ dehamāsthitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
tejasā bhāsurāste ca catvāro vyūhasaṃjñakāḥ ।
bālakāḥ sadṛśā bhutvā cā'śvapaṭṭasaro'mbare ।। 9 ।।
āyayurdivyahaṃsānāṃ vimāne cātibhāsurāḥ ।
vāsudevo'bhavattatra caturbhujo'tibhāsuraḥ ।। 2.94.1 0।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetimān mukuṭojjvalaḥ ।
anye trayo dvibhujāścā'bhavaँścakragadāyudhāḥ ।। 11 ।।
kiśorā divyarūpāśca vāsudevasamāḥ śubhāḥ ।
anekasūryasaṃkāśāḥ svarṇakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇāḥ ।। 12।.
vanamālākaustubhādidharā mukuṭaśobhanāḥ ।
divyadehā divyasiddhyaiśvaryasāmarthyarājitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
sahasnakoṭidevānāṃ tejāṃsi bhāsurāṇi ca ।
yeṣāṃ romasu vidyante tādṛśāste vimānake ।। 14।।
vyadṛśyantā'mbarasthe te sāyaṃ madhyāhnavaddhyabhūt ।
saurāṣṭrasya prajāḥ sarvā vilokya divasādapi ।।15।।
cātipramāṇatejāṃsi vyatarkayan prabhuḥ svayam ।
vimānena vihārārthaṃ vyomnā yāti sthalāntaram ।। 16।।
yadvā devāḥ samāyānti pūjanārthaṃ harermuhuḥ ।
tathaivete samāyātā bhaveyuścetyatarkayan ।। 17।।
atha kuṃkumavāpyāśca prajā bhāgavatāstadā ।
niryayuḥ svagṛhebhyaśca tūrṇaṃ darśanahetave ।। 18।।
tāvad vimānaṃ ruciraṃ hyavātatāra cāmbarāt ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre lomaśāśramasannidhau ।। 1 9।।
catvāraste vyūhakṛṣṇā vimānādvahirāyayuḥ ।
koṭicandrojjvalakāntivyāptāmṛtābdhimūrtayaḥ ।।2.94.20।।
padbhyāṃ vihṛtya ca śanairaśvapaṭṭasarojale ।
sasnurmānuṣarūpāste prayayurlomaśāśramam ।। 21 ।।
ṛṣiścakāra satkāraṃ svāgataṃ mānanādikam ।
madhuparkaṃ dadau pūjāṃ cakāra candanādibhiḥ ।।22।।
divyadṛṣṭyā vyūhatattvaṃ jñātvā cakāra daṇḍavat ।
ārārtrikaṃ tataścakre vyūhānāṃ lomaśo muniḥ ।।23।।
brahmapriyāḥ ṛṣayaśca cakrarnamaḥkriyāṃ tataḥ ।
utthāya te ṛṣīnnatvā bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 24।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ pitarau ca prāha vyūhāgamaṃ tadā ।
sotsāhau pitarau tūrṇaṃ mānārthaṃ cābhijagmatuḥ ।।25।।
śrutvā tvanye surāścāpi munayaśceśvarā api ।
tīrthāni tattvasaṃghātāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo maharṣayaḥ ।।26।।
sanmānārthaṃ cābhijagmuryatraite vyūhamūrtayaḥ ।
akṣataiścandanaiḥ puṣpairjayaśabdaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 27।।
vardhitāḥ satkṛtāste ca bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayuḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇastadā naijaṃ rūpaṃ dadhāra dhāmagam ।।28।।
vāsudevasamūhāstu yanmūrtau yānti līnatām ।
koṭigolokavaikuṇṭhādhipāḥ prayānti līnatām ।।29।।
tādṛśaṃ paradhāmasthaṃ divyarūpaṃ dadhāra saḥ ।
divye gajāsane'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।। 2.94.3 0।।
koṭimuktagaṇairjuṣṭaḥ tatsthamūrtirvyarājata ।
tadā vyūhān vihāyā'nyacakṣūṃṣi śrīharau kṣaṇāt ।। 31 ।।
na prāvartanta vai parābhūtāni haritejasā ।
parābhūtākṣikamalāḥ surādyā niryayustataḥ ।। 32।।
svasvasthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve tato vyūhān haristathā ।
pitarau svāgataṃ premṇā cakraturbhavanāṃgaṇe ।। 33 ।।
bālakṛṣṇasya bhavane viviśuste sadīśvarāḥ ।
gajāsanasthitaṃ sveṣṭaṃ vavandire ca nemire ।। 34।।
kṛtvā ca daṇḍavad bhūmau pūjanaṃ cakrire mudā ।
vāsudevo dadau divyaṃ mukuṭaṃ mastake hareḥ ।।35।।
lalāṭe candanaṃ tailasāraṃ saṃkarṣaṇo dadau ।
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ gandhasāraṃ pradyumna ārpayat ।। 36।।
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ ramyaṃ rañjanādi samārpayat ।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale gucchau karṇapūrā'vataṃsakān ।।37।।
vāsudevo dadau kaṇṭhe sauvarṇamālikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
hārān hīrakamāṇikyamuktāñcitān sakaustubhān ।।38।।
dadau saṃkarṣaṇo ramyān kaṭakān śṛṃkhalāstathā ।
ūrmikāṅgūlīyakāni prakoṣṭhaśṛṃkhalāstathā ।।39।।
raśanāṃ ca sumañjīre dadau svarṇe'niruddhakaḥ ।
pāduke divyamṛdule cāmare cātapatrakam ।।2.94.40।।
yaṣṭiṃ ca kānakīṃ ratnanaddhāṃ kare tu naktakam ।
saugandhaṃ puṣpapatrādigranthiṃ saṃkarṣaṇo dadau ।।41 ।।
pradyumnaścārpayāmāsa sauvarṇasthālikāṃ śubhām ।
miṣṭānnāmṛtasampūrṇaphalabījādisaṃbhṛtām ।। 42।।
aniruddho'mṛtapānaṃ dadau tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'sau vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।43।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat cakrurīśvarāḥ ।
puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvarāḥ ।।44।।
tvamanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
rājamānaḥ pare dhāmni dvibhujo'kṣarasevitaḥ ।।45।।
tanmuktaistava muktaiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
parabrahma paramātmā parastvaṃ bhagavānprabhuḥ ।।46।।
tvatto muktāḥ prakāśante līyante vigrahe tava ।
tavāntike ca tiṣṭhanti tavānandātinanditāḥ ।।47।।
asaṃkhyā brahmabhāvāśca brahmapriyā bhavatsamāḥ ।
aiśvaryaśaktayaste ca tava vigrahajā hi tāḥ ।।48 ।।
tava sevāṃ prakurvanti muktānyo brahmavigrahāḥ ।
tvatto jātā vayaṃ vyūhā avatārāstatheśvarāḥ ।।4 9।।
īśvarāṇyastathā māyā pūruṣāḥ kālavatsarāḥ ।
vairājā vaiṣṇavāścāpi brāhmaṇāḥ śāṃbhavāstathā ।।2.94.50 ।।
vigrahāstava mūrtervai samutpannā maharṣayaḥ ।
pitaro munayaḥ siddhāḥ sādhavaḥ śīlayoginaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sāṃkhyayogavratinyaḥ kāntayoṣitaḥ ।
pativratā tathā patnīvrato lakṣmīrnarāyaṇaḥ ।।52।।
pitaro divyavāsāśca naro nārāyaṇastathā ।
pātālasthābhūgṛhāśca kṣīre śeṣo narāyaṇaḥ ।।53।।
śrīrlīlā bhūḥ satī padmā gaṃgā prabhā sarasvatī ।
māṇikyā saguṇā premā pāravatī ca mañjulā ।।54।।
vibhūtiḥ rādhikā sītā'mṛtā santoṣikā ramā ।
haṃsā ca duḥkhahālakṣmīrdayā jayā ca tūlasī ।।55।।।
haimī śāntā ca sāvitrī vṛndāstvetāstu śaktayaḥ ।
campā lalitā kastūrī ojasvatyādikāstathā ।।56 ।।
kapilo datta īśāno nṛsiṃho vāmano hariḥ ।
haṃso matsyastathā kūrmo varāho jiṣṇurityapi ।।57।।
hariḥ pṛthuśca gopālo haṃsaḥ ṛṣabha īśitā ।
rāmaḥ paraśurāmaśca balaśca bhagavān śukaḥ ।।58।।
vallabhaścāpi hemanto devaprakāśa ityamī ।
yajñaḥ kumārayogāśca tavaivāṃśavibhūtayaḥ ।।59।।
tattvāni tattvacaitanyaṃ guṇaśaktirasādayaḥ ।
tavāṃśā bhagavan sarve yeṣu tvamota eva ca ।।2.94.60 ।।
tvayi protaṃ tathā sarvaṃ tvameva patiruttamaḥ ।
tava darśanalābhārthaṃ bālaṃ vīkṣitumutsukāḥ ।।61 ।।
darśanaṃ prāptavantaśca kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ prabho ।
ityuktvā praṇatāḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā sukhasthitāḥ ।।62।।
bālakṛṣṇastu taṃ rādhe tadā''hā'rthayituṃ varam ।
vāsudevastadā prāha vāsaṃ te caraṇe sadā ।।63।।
dehi nātha kṛpāsindho vyūhecchāṃ samprapūraya ।
tathāstviti prabhuḥ prāha cakāraiṣāṃ tanudvayam ।।64।।
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vāsārhaṃ vyūhatīrthe'vasaddhi tat ।
dvitīyaṃ mūlarūpaṃ ca vyūhacatuṣṭayaṃ tu yat ।।65।।
śrīharerājñayā tattu yayau dvīpaṃ sitaṃ tataḥ ।
tasmād yayau satyalokaṃ tato'vyākṛtadhāma ca ।।66।।
evaṃ te vāsudevādyā vyūhasaṃjñā maheśvarāḥ ।
jīveśasṛṣṭiśāstāro rādhike śrīhareḥ puraḥ ।।67।।
sarvadā vāsamācakruścāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
tīrthatoyataṭe teṣāṃ mandiraṃ paramaṃ śubham ।।68।।
vāsudevālayākhyaṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।
śrīharerājñayā tatra rājante bhrātaraśca te ।।69।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paṭṭaśiṣyake ।
svayaṃprakāśe līnāśca vartante vyūhasaṃjñakaḥ ।।2.94.70।।
bhagavantaśca catvāraścaitanyamūrtirūpiṇaḥ ।
vyūhasyaivā'vatāraḥ sa svayaṃprakāśa īśapaḥ ।।71 ।।
vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ cāste caturguṇasamanvitaḥ ।
divyaṃ caturbhujaṃ cainaṃ svayaṃprakāśaṃ mānavāḥ ।।72।।
ye'rcayiṣyanti te puṇyaṃ lapsyante vyūhajaṃ phalam ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike vāsudevaṃ svayaṃ prakāśakam ।।73।।
pūjanārthaṃ sadā prātaḥ prayāntyeva ca tatpriyāḥ ।
vāsudevasya vai patnī lakṣmīrmā hariṇī tu yā ।।74।।
saṃkarṣaṇasya yā patnī sunandā sā mahāsatī ।
pradyumnasya priyā dhīśca sarvapoṣaṇakāriṇī ।।75।।
aniruddhasya suśīlā catasrastāḥ striyaḥ khalu ।
catuḥśriyo vimānena nityaṃ yānti ca rādhike ।।76 ।।
paśyā'yaṃ samayaścāste brāhmastāsāṃ pravāsayuk ।
tāvattāsāṃ vimānaṃ ca niryātaṃ rādhikāpuraḥ ।।77।।
rādhikā tāḥ pravīkṣyaiva vimānādavarohayan ।
rādhikā tu samutthāya natvā cāśliṣya bhāvataḥ ।।78।।
prasannā svāgataṃ cakre madhuparkaṃ tathāsanam ।
dadau pūjāṃ pracakārā''tithyaṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra ca ।।79।।
kuśalaṃ paripapraccha tā api rādhikāṃ tathā ।
rādhā''ha kva prayāṇaṃ vaḥ prātaḥ sañjāyate priyāḥ ।।2.94.80।।
tāḥ prāhurnaḥ patiḥ śrīśaḥ svayaṃprakāśanāmataḥ ।
vyūhāvatāro bhagavān vartate'śvasarovare ।।81।।
anādiśrīkṛṣaganārāyaṇaśiṣyo mahāprabhuḥ ।
asmatpatīnāmaṃśāśca catvārastatra santi hi ।।82।।
vartate mānave bhāve bālabrahmavratānvitaḥ ।
kumārastasya pūjārthaṃ gacchāmo nityameva vai ।।83।।
tvayā smṛtāstato rādhe tvāgatāstvatra harṣitāḥ ।
ityuktvā rādhikāṃ tāstu pūjayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।84।।
sarvaśṛṃgāradravyāṇi rādhikāyai dadurhi tāḥ ।
ājñāmādāya ca tūrṇaṃ yayuścāśvasarovaram ।।85।।
hariṇī ca sunandā ca dhīḥ suśīlā ca tā imāḥ ।
patyaṃśaṃ samprapūjyaiva kusumākṣatacandanaiḥ ।।86।।
patyaṃguṣṭhajalaṃ pītvā bhojayitvā ca taṃ tataḥ ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā prasādamāpya tasya ca ।।87।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śrīkaṃbharāśriyam ।
natvā sammilya ca pūjāṃ datvā prāpya śubhāṃ giram ।।88।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati yayustataḥ ।
pūjayitvā pareśeśaṃ natvā stutvā punaḥ punaḥ ।।89।।
ārārtrikaṃ hareḥ kṛtvā tasthurdadhyuḥ kṣaṇaṃ harim ।
prabhuḥ prāha prasanno'smi varaṃ vṛṇuta cepsitam ।।2.94.90।।
tadā tāḥ prāharasmākaṃ vāsastvatra yathā bhavet ।
pātivratyaṃ prarakṣyeta tathobhayatra sevane ।।91।।
vāñcchāpūrtiṃ sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa vidhāpaya ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rūpadvayaṃ vidhāya ca ।।92।।
tīrtharūpāṇi catvāri vyūhatīrthe nyavāsayat ।
mandire pratimāsvāsāṃ vāsaṃ cākārayat prabhuḥ ।।93।।
yathā divyasvarūpairhi svayaprakāśasevanam ।
bhavettathā kṛtaṃ tābhiḥ kṛte nārāyaṇena vai ।।94।।
anyāni mūlarūpāṇi cājñāmādāya vai tataḥ ।
yayustvavyākṛtaṃ dhāma vāsudevādisaṃśritam ।।95।।
ityevaṃ rādhike duṣṭaṃ bhavatyā cākṣigocaram ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyasyaiśvaryamadbhutam ।। 96।।
kimahaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi pratāpaṃ parameśituḥ ।
yadguṇānāṃ kīrtanena bhuktirmuktirdhruvā sadā ।।97।।
yatraiśvaryāṇi satataṃ vartante divyavigrahaiḥ ।
yatreśvareśvarāścāpi vartante divyavigrahaiḥ ।।98।।
yatrāvatāraharayo vartante divyavigrahaiḥ ।
yatra sṛṣṭīśvarāḥ sarve surāśca divyavigrahaiḥ ।।99।।
yatra brahmapriyā muktā vartante divyavigrahaiḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprasannatāptaye ।। 2.94.10 0।।
tasya kṣetrasya mahimā varṇayituṃ na śakyate ।
jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tad vyūhatīrthaṃ sarasyabhūt ।। 101 ।।
āṣāḍhadvitīyāyāṃ ca śrīcatuṣṭayatīrthakam ।
svayaṃprakāśatīrthaṃ ca pāvanaṃ tadabhūt tadā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vyūhacatuṣṭayaśrīcatuṣṭayayoḥ kuṃkumavāpītīrthāgamanaṃ svayaṃprakāśatīrthaṃ vyūhacatuṣṭayatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 94 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 094 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 95
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 096 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ śrīhareḥ paramātmanaḥ ।
rādhe caikādaśabhaktayogād deśaḥ surakṣitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
dakṣiṇe vartamāne vai khaṇḍe uṣṇālayābhidhe ।
astrālaye raṇe tatra sāmudraghoravāyubhiḥ ।। 2 ।।
jāte tūpadrave deśo vālukābhistu madhyagaḥ ।
parito'bdhijalaiścāpi dharṣito viplavīkṛtaḥ ।। 3 ।।
ācchādito'bhavad bhādrapade vṛṣṭyā vināśitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena svāminā tataḥ ।। 4 ।।
rakṣitaḥ svasya bhaktārthaṃ śṛṇu puṇyatamāṃ kathām ।
ūṣṇālaye mahākhaṇḍe pūrvega'styo mahāmuniḥ ।। 5 ।।
ākāśena yayau pūrvaṃ pāvayituṃ tu tadbhuvam ।
agastyo bahudeśāँśca samudraṃ pravihāya ca ।। 6 ।।
yayau tasmin mahākhaṇḍe hemaśālākhyaparvate ।
tato bālācalaṃ rāvāsanādriṃ tvambarād yayau ।। 7 ।।
dārāliṃgagiriṃ maṣīgrīvādriṃ bhekadānakam ।
adriṃ tathā śālavīnagiriṃ grāmācalaṃ tataḥ ।। 8 ।।
ācālaparvataṃ cāpi divādikparvataṃ tathā ।
cāṭādriṃ ca tato gatvā tvāyayau hemaśālake ।। 9 ।।
tasya droṇīṃ vṛkṣavallītṛṇaiḥ pallavitāṃ śubhām ।
suvṛṣṭyā phalapuṣpāḍhyāṃ vīkṣya vatsaramāvasat ।। 2.95.1 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaँ smaratyaharniśam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 1 1।।
japatyeva sadā mantraṃ hemaśālācale vasan ।
lopāmudrāpi taṃ mantraṃ japatyeva pativratā ।। 1 2।।
tayā saha munirnityaṃ tīrthīkartuṃ tadā''pagāḥ ।
nityaṃ vihāyasā yāti snātuṃ bhinnasarittaṭam ।। 13।।
murānadyāṃ turunadyāmaitanadyāṃ tathā muhuḥ ।
sasnau gośaṃkunadyāṃ ca bālānadyāmapi kvacit ।। 14।।
sasnau marcāśanānadyāṃ mākamānasarasyapi ।
bālāsarovare māṅgisarasi śvānikājale ।। 15।।
kuvane sarasi sasnau lābharucisarasyapi ।
jhinkunadyāṃ rinkunadyāṃ phinkunadyāṃ tathā punaḥ ।। 16।।
sasnāvuttuṃgasarasi ārasarovare tathā ।
turūsarovare sasnau grāgirākhye sarasyapi ।। 17।।
maurīnadyāṃ turānadyāṃ bhurānadyāṃ tathā muniḥ ।
sasnau kavindumānadyāṃ gaurānarasarovare ।। 18।।
kāruliṅgyāṃ dāruliṅgyāṃ cāruliṃgīsarityapi ।
kvīlpīnadyāṃ laviṃgāyāṃ pāvanāyāṃ tathā tataḥ ।। 19।।
mīcalāyāṃ philañcāyāṃ sasnāvagastyako muniḥ ।
ghelīnadyāṃ helīnadyāṃ vitūrīyāsarityapi ।। 2.95.20।।
phījarāyāṃ cāpagāyāṃ sasno nirjharaṇeṣvapi ।
lopāmudrā satī pūjāṃ cakre taddevatārcanam ।।21 ।।
sarāṃsi saritaścāpi cakruragastyamānanam ।
athaiteṣu pradeśeṣu sarittaṭeṣu kutracit ।। 22।।
kutracitpārvate deśe kutracit sarasastaṭe ।
viprāstu tāpasā raudrā vaiṣṇavāḥ sūryadevatāḥ ।। 23।।
vasantaste vilokyainamagastyaṃ khyātapauruṣam ।
prasannahṛdayāḥ sarve svāgatādi vyadhurmudā ।।24।।
hemaśālāyano bālāyano rāvāsanāyanaḥ ।
dārāliṅgāyanaścāpi bhekadāneyatāpasaḥ ।।25।।
masigrīvamaharṣiśca tathā śālavanāyanaḥ ।
ācālarṣistathā grāmāyano vāṭāyanastathā ।।26।।
divādiṅgāyanādyāśca tāpasā brahmavedinaḥ ।
sahasraśo'nyaviprāśca brahmagṛhavanasthitāḥ ।। 27।।
yatayaśca mahātyāgaparā vijñāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
satyaḥ sādhvyo nivasanti cātmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ।।28।।
agastyastu dadau tebhyo vijñānaṃ pārameśvaram ।
parabrahmā''kṣarātītaḥ paradhāmavirājitaḥ ।।29।।
anantamuktasevyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ।
paramātmā'ntarātmā ca kṛṣṇāt kṛṣṇataraśca yaḥ ।।2.95.3 0 ।।
vāsudevānmahāvāsudevaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
divyaiśvaryavibhūtyādisaṃbhṛto bhagavān prabhuḥ ।। 31 ।।
kālamāyāniyantā ca vyūhāvatāraśāsakaḥ ।
īśvarāṇāmīśvareśaḥ surāṇāṃ suraśaktidaḥ ।।32।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ rakṣakastaddhṛdi sthitaḥ ।
devamānuṣanāgānāmantaryāmī parātparaḥ ।।।33 ।।
sarvabrahmapriyākāntaḥ sarvadhāmaprabhāpradaḥ ।
sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvasākṣī nirañjanaḥ ।। 34।।
svaprakāśo'sīmaśobhā'sīmakandarpasundaraḥ ।
divyamūrtirvedavedyo yogivedyo'ntarātmani ।।35।।
hṛccakṣurbhistathā vedyaścā'vedyo bāhyavṛttibhiḥ ।
agamyo māyayā channairgamyo bhaktisamanvitaiḥ ।। 36।।
atidūro'pyatisāmīpyasthaḥ sakhā sukhapradaḥ ।
sarvapradaḥ sadā''nandaḥ sarvānandaprado hariḥ ।।37।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāramāpatiḥ ।
prabhāpāravatīhaṃsāmaṃjulāsaguṇāpatiḥ ।। 38 ।।
lakṣmīśrīmāṇikīnāthaḥ satpatirbhaktabhāvitaḥ ।
ṛṣīśaḥ karuṇāpūrṇo hyabālo bālarūpadhṛk ।।3 9।।
vartate yaścājanābhe khaṇḍe deśe surāṣṭrake ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre'kṣarakṣetre vimuktide ।।2.95.40।।
divye kuṃkumavāpyākhye nagare ca nijālaye ।
kambharāśrīnandanaḥ sa śrīmadgopālabālakaḥ ।।41।।
parabrahma svayaṃ yaḥ sa bālabrahmā'dya vartate ।
antarātmā ca yaḥ so'dya bālātmā bahirasti vai ।।।42।।
yogināṃ yogaphalado jñānināṃ vittigocaraḥ ।
muktānāṃ mānase tiṣṭhan satīnāṃ satyadhārakaḥ ।।43 ।।
yajñānāṃ vahnirūpe ca bhojako havanāśanaḥ ।
tapasvināṃ tapovṛtteḥ śraddhārūpo'sti yaḥ prabhuḥ ।।44।।
sāttvikānāṃ dharmasattvaṃ nītīnāṃ nyāyavistaraḥ ।
satkriyāṇāṃ cātitheyo bhaktā rādhanagocaraḥ ।।45।।
nirākāro'saṃkhyamūrtiryaḥ sa bālo virājate ।
kṛpayā karuṇāsindhurmokṣadaḥ pāpināmapi ।।46।।
yatprasaṃgena tattvāni jaḍānyapi kṛtānyapi ।
akṛtāni cetanāni divyāni saṃbhavanti ca ।।47।।
amuktā muktimāyānti pāpā bhavanti pāvanāḥ ।
asiddhāḥ siddhimāsādya yaddhyānād yānti mokṣaṇam ।।48।।
aguṇā guṇavantaśca bhavantyasya pratāpataḥ ।
māyikā māyayā śūnyā jāyante'sya smṛterapi ।।49।।
kalmaṣā nāśamāyānti yanmūrterdarśanādapi ।
nā'sya vai darśane prāpte kartavyaṃ cāvaśiṣyate ।।2.95.50।।
prāptavyaṃ śiṣyate nāpi sa vai bālo'dya vartate ।
viprā gṛhṇantu tanmantraṃ muktidaṃ sarvasiddhidam ।।51 ।।
ityuktā rādhike! viprā jagṛhurmantramuttamam ।
'auṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।52।।
prajepuḥ satataṃ taṃ ca dadhyurvai divyarūpiṇam ।
teṣāṃ vai hṛdaye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ samasphurat ।।53।।
kiśoro divyarūpaśca koṭimanmathasundaraḥ ।
bhejuste ca tato nityamagastyoditapūjanaiḥ ।।54।।
aṣṭadhā śrīharerbhaktiṃ cakrurmokṣābhivāñcchayā ।
evaṃ sahasralakṣāśca bhajante brāhmaṇā harim ।।55।।
agastyasya tu yogena astrālayakṣitau tadā ।
uṣṇālaye mahākhaṇḍe'bhavan bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।56।।
varṣānte'gastyamunirāṭ kṛtvā tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ ।
vaihāyasā yayau lopāmudrāyuto'śvasārasam ।।57।।
kṣetraṃ śrīkuṃkumavāpīsaṃjñaṃ tatra sthiro'bhavat ।
atha bhādrapade tatra vyomni rātrau graho mahān ।।58।।
sahasrayojanadīrghatejaḥkalgilasacchirāḥ ।
udayaṃ caiti nityaṃ vai deśopaplavasūcakaḥ ।।19।।
dhūmaketurmahātrāsaprado lokavināśakaḥ ।
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu prajāḥ sarvā nāśabhītisamākulāḥ ।।2.95.60।।
abhavaँścā'pyabhajaँśca bālakṛṣṇa pubhuttamam ।
akurvaṃstasya bhaktiṃ ca vividhārādhanātmikām ।।61।।
atha bhādrasya vigame pūrṇāyāṃ prātareva tu ।
samudrasya jalānāṃ vai viplavaḥ parito hyabhūt। ।।62।।
velā bhayapradā sarvadeśapralayakārikāḥ ।
cukṣubhuścāticaṇḍairvai vātaiḥ saha ca vṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।63।।
uṣṇālayasya khaṇḍasya parito'bdhijalairbhuvaḥ ।
yojanāyatabhāgā vai saṃplutā pralayo yathā ।।64।।
grāmāḥ kheṭāḥ kharvaṭāścāvasathā ghoṣavistarāḥ ।
samudramavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvadyojanameva te ।।65।।
abdhivelaughavegaiśca naṣṭā jalalaye tadā ।
vṛkṣā latā vanoddeśā udyānāni ca vāṭikāḥ ।।66।।
naukāstheyāni bandhāni setavaḥ kṣetrabhūmikāḥ ।
vartmāni yānarakṣārthaṃ gṛhṇāṇi bhūśirāṃsi ca ।।67।।
velaughavegairnaṣṭāni vyāpārasya sthalāni ca ।
vimānāvasthalībandhā naṣṭāḥ sarve jalaughakaiḥ ।।68।।
nadīmukhāstathā sarve prajāvasatayo'pi ca ।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścānye khanayo'pi layaṃ gatāḥ ।।69।।
evaṃ jalalaye jāte hāhākāro mahānabhūt ।
atha nadyo'pi saṃkṣubdhāḥ kṣubdhāni ca sarāṃsyapi ।।2.95.70।।
nadīsarovarā''paśca yayuḥ kṣetreṣu cābhitaḥ ।
udvelābhiḥ pradeśāste saprajāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥ ।।71।।
sthale jalaṃ jale sthalaṃ viparītamapadyata ।
ativarṣātivātaiśca dehino vilayaṃ gatāḥ ।।72।।
pārvatā vanavāsāśca dṛśyante naiva dehinaḥ ।
jalānāṃ tu pravāheṣu śavā mānavapakṣiṇām ।।73।।
paśūnāṃ ca sarīsṛpamṛgādīnāmanekaśaḥ ।
kallolairuhyamānāśca vilokyante sahasraśaḥ ।।74।।
vṛkṣāśca vṛkṣaśākhāśca dṛśyante pūravāriṣu ।
gṛhāṇi parṇaśālāśca taranti layavāriṣu ।।75।।
nadyaḥ sarovarāṇyanyā dīrghikāścāpi kūpakāḥ ।
sāmudrā'khātasadṛśā dṛśyante jalapūritāḥ ।।76 ।।
evaṃ jāte vināśasya kāraṇe jalaviplave ।
jhaṃjhāvātairvālukāścāḍīyanta raṇagāstadā ।।77।।
yathā meghāstathā tāśca dṛśyante cāmbare tadā ।
vālukābhiḥ pūritāni netrāṇi cāndhatāṃ yayuḥ ।।78।।
vālukāhatanetrāste dehinastu parasparam ।
naiva paśyanti vai tatra rajo'ndhā vātatāḍitāḥ ।।79।।
ākāśe vāyuvegena kṣipyante śākhinastathā ।
gṛhāṇi vallayaścāpi maṇḍapācchādanānyapi ।।2.95.80।।
ullocāśca vitānāni vastrāṇi pakṣiṇastathā ।
kṣipyante bahuvegena vātena ca jale sthale ।।81।।
gṛhāṇi cātibhagnāni vṛkṣā bhagnāstathoṭajāḥ ।
āśrayā āśramāḥ saudhāḥ prāsādā neśurūṭajāḥ ।।82।।
vālukāvarṣaṇairgrāmāśchannā vai vālukātale ।
evaṃ raṇāt samuḍḍīya vālukāvarṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt ।।83।।
vṛkṣāśca vāṭikā udyānāni prajāśca pakṣiṇaḥ ।
paśavastāpasāścāpi vālukāchannavigrahāḥ ।।84।।
vālukāntargarbhagāste bhūgarbhe nihitāḥ kṣaṇāt ।
abhavaँste vinā śvāsairmṛtāḥ koṭisahasraśaḥ ।।85।।
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi parvatasthāḥ kṣitisthitāḥ ।
vīkṣyopacchavamatyugraṃ samādhau kṛtasaṃyamāḥ।।86।।
ākṛṣya nāḍikāprāṇān niṣeduḥ kuṃbhakādiṣu ।
sasmarurbhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi ।।87।।
abhaktā ruruduścāpi tresuścukruṣurudgalam ।
hāhācakrurbālakāśca hā mātastāta cukruśuḥ ।।88।।
vilapanto narāḥ patnīrāhvayāṃcakrurudgalam ।
patnyo'patyāni pitaraṃ cāhvayāṃcakruratyati ।।89।।
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi uṣṭrāṇāṃ kariṇāṃ tathā ।
siṃhānāṃ cānalānāṃ cākrośāśca garjanānyapi ।।2.95.90।।
duḥkhabhṛtānyatyabhan jhaṃjhāvāte tadā muhuḥ ।
na śrūyante na rakṣyante svarakṣā yatra duṣkarā ।।9 1।।
tatrā'nyarakṣaṇaṃ kena kutra vā harimantarā ।
kālānane grāsabhāvaṃ gatānāṃ rakṣako'tra kaḥ ।।92।।
parvatā raṇadeśāśca nadyaścāpi sarāṃsi ca ।
vanāni coccabhāgāścāraṇyāni kṣetrabhūmayaḥ ।। 93 ।।
sarve pṛthvītalaṃ jhaṃjhāvātaiścāpīḍitaṃ tadā ।
jātaṃ bhādrasya pūrṇāyāṃ rātrau tu pratipaddine ।।94।।
āsāyaṃ tanmahotpātairvinā mṛtiṃ mṛtāḥ prajāḥ ।
hemaśālāyanādyāstu tadā maharṣayo'malāḥ ।।95।।
vīkṣyā'śāntaṃ vātavegaṃ jalā'nilakṛtaṃ layam ।
samādhāveva śāntyarthaṃ sasmarurbālakṛṣṇakam ।।96।।
karuṇāsāgaraṃ bhaktarakṣākaraṃ kṛpānidhim ।
avigaṇayya pāpāni śaraṇāgatarakṣakam ।।97।।
gajarakṣākaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ garbhe rakṣantamīśvaram ।
pralaye rakṣakaṃ nāthaṃ māyāto rakṣakaṃ prabhum ।।98।।
prāṇānāṃ rakṣakaṃ kāntaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ harim ।
bālānāṃ rakṣakaṃ devaṃ sṛṣṭirakṣākaraṃ patim ।।99।।
yoge rakṣākaraṃ svāminārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dehiprajīvanam ।। 2.95.1 00।।
sasmarurhṛdaye tvekādaśarṣayo laye sthite ।
tuṣṭavurmanasā sarve deśarakṣaṇahetave ।। 101 ।।
jhaṃjhāvātasya śāntyarthaṃ vṛṣṭeḥ śāntyarthamityapi ।
vālukāvṛṣṭiśāntyarthaṃ bhūtānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।। 102।।
rādhike te tuṣṭuvurvai parameśaṃ parātparam ।
kṛpāluṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ samprāpte nāśe maharṣayaḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uṣṇālayakhaṇḍe'gastyapravāsastatratyarṣigaṇena jhaṃjhāvātā'bdhijalakṣobhe laye jāte śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ smṛta ityādi-
nirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 95 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 96

← adhyāyaḥ 096 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 97
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 098 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha te rādhike'nādibālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
vaimānikā gaṇāḥ sarve koṭyarbudā hi sevakāḥ ।। 1 ।।
śaṃkaro'gastyamunirāṭ devyaścāpi nijaṃ prabhum ।
āpṛcchya cāvateruśca hemaśālāyanasthale ।। 2 ।।
hemaśālāyanasteṣāṃ svāgataṃ pracakāra ha ।
dṛṣṭvā'gastya guruṃ śaṃbhuṃ tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 3 ।।
ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpa svāgataṃ pracakāra ha ।
daṇḍavat patito bhūmau jaya kṛṣṇetyuvāca ca ।। 4 ।।
āsanāni madhuparkaṃ pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ dadau tataḥ ।
nanarta puratasteṣāṃ rakṣakāṇāṃ dayāvatām ।। 5 ।।
śrīharistaṃ nartamānaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa ca ।
bhaktasyorasi caraṇau dadau snehabharaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
mastake pradadau hastau parirebhe punaḥ punaḥ ।
divyadṛṣṭiṃ dadau śīghraṃ hemaśālāyanāya vai ।। 7 ।।
hemaśālo divyadṛṣṭyā uṣṭrālayaṃ vyalokayat ।
sarvaṃ surakṣitaṃ cāste bhūtalaṃ paritaḥ khalu ।। 8 ।।
mānavāḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi paśavo'pi sacetanāḥ ।
jīvitā vai kṛtāśceti vīkṣyā''nandamavāpa saḥ ।। 9 ।।
athā'yaṃ ca prasasmāra daśa munīn hi vaiṣṇavān ।
darśanārthaṃ harestatra drāk smṛtāścāyayuśca te ।। 2.97.1 0।।
vyomamārgeṇā'vaterurhemaśālāyanoṭaje ।
candravad bhāsamānāśca yogino vaiṣṇavāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 1।।
tulasīsragdharāḥ sarve japantaḥ śrīhariṃ tathā ।
dṛṣṭvā gurumagastyaṃ cā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 12।।।
śaṃkaraṃ sukhavaidyaṃ ca mātṝn nemurmudānvitāḥ ।
sarvāste tvarcayāmāsurmānasairupacārakaiḥ ।। 13।।
hemaśālāyano bālāyano rāvāsanastathā ।
dārāliṃgāyanaścātha bhekadāneyanāmabhāk ।। 14।।
maṣīgrīvāyanaścāpi śālavanāyanastathā ।
ācālarṣistathā grāmāyano vāṭāyano'pi ca ।। 15।।
divādiṅgālayaścaite hyekādaśamaharṣayaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasveṣṭaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 16।।
jahṛṣuścātibhāvajñā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ ।
iṣṭadevaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣyā'gastyaṃ guruṃ tathā ।। 17।।
daṇḍavatte pracakruśca jīvadānapradān hi tān ।
athā''saneṣūpaviṣṭān maharṣīn prāha keśavaḥ ।। 18।।
kuśalaṃ sarvathā kaccidāste vastvāśramādiṣu ।
kuśalaṃ tapasaścāpi kuśalaṃ dehināṃ tathā ।। 19।।
kuśalaṃ sarvajīvānāmāste kaccit prajādiṣu ।
deśānāṃ kuśalaṃ cāste kvacit saukhyaṃ tapasvinām ।। 2.97.20।।
bhaktānāṃ naranārīṇāṃ kaccit saukhyaṃ pravidyate ।
deśeṣu sarvajātīnāṃ kuśalaṃ kaccidasti kim ।। 21।।
iti pṛṣṭvā virarāma śrīsvāmiparameśvaraḥ ।
agastyastu tataḥ prāha vidyate kṣetramatra kim ।। 22।।
tāpasānāṃ prajānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ narayoṣitām ।
śaṃkaro'pi tathaivaiṣāṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ nu kim ।। 23।।
satyo'pi tān papracchuśca nirābādhaṃ tataśca te ।
āhurvai kramaśaḥ sarve maharṣayo'tidāruṇam ।।24।।
pralayaṃ kaṣṭadaṃ tatra yathā sveṣāṃ ca nāśanam ।
punarutpādanaṃ cāpi deśānāṃ viplavaṃ tathā ।। 25।।
prajānāṃ nāśanaṃ cāpi rakṣaṇaṃ ca punastathā ।
hemaśālāyanaḥ prāha bhagavaँstava darśanāt ।। 26।।
kuśalaṃ vartate tvadya yatkhaṇḍe bhavadāgamaḥ ।
prathamaṃ cāsya khaṇḍasya samudreṇa tu viplavaḥ ।। 27।।
kṛto vai paritaḥ paścāt jhaṃjhāvātairupadravaḥ ।
vātavṛṣṭyā jalavṛṣṭyā prajā bahvyo vināśitāḥ ।।28।।
bhavantaśca smṛtāḥ pṛthvyā garbhe gartairmaharṣibhiḥ ।
bhavadbhistvatra cāgatya rakṣito'yaṃ bhūgolakaḥ ।।29।।
asmātparaṃ sukuśalaṃ kṣemaṃ cānyanna vidyate ।
jīvā'bhayapradānaṃ yadbhagavadbhirvidhāpitam ।। 2.97.3 0।।
mṛtānāṃ jīvadānaṃ ca vinā śrīparameśvaram ।
kaḥ samartho bhavedatra laye tvākasmike hare! ।।3 1 ।।
yojanāyatabhūbhāgaḥ samudrasyā'ntike prabho! ।
paritaḥ salilairvārdherāplāvito vināśitaḥ ।।3 2।।
agastyena jalaṃ tacca pītaṃ svāñjalinā tataḥ ।
prāṇinaḥ prāṇayuktāśca vaidyenā'tra kṛtā hare! ।। 33।।
sarveṣāṃ kuśalaṃ tvāste kimanyat kuśalaṃ prabho! ।
sikatābhirbhuvo bhāgāśchannā yatra prajā'rditā ।।34।।
mṛtāstāstāritāḥ sarvāḥ kṛpayā marutāṃ hare! ।
viyuktā yojitāḥ sarve kuṭumbinaśca sevakaiḥ ।। 35 ।।
tavā''jñayā hare kṛṣṇa rudreṇā''paśca śoṣitāḥ ।
sampadaśca yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtāḥ śrīmātṛbhistathā ।।36।।
deśo'yaṃ rakṣitaḥ kṛṣṇa mṛtāḥ sacetanāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
sarve vai kuśalaṃ tvāste kiṃ saukhyaṃ syādataḥ param ।।37।।
aho bhāgyamaho saukhyamaho kṣemaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
yeṣāṃ rakṣaṇakartā'sti daivataṃ kimataḥ param ।।38।।
aho puṇyamaho svargamaho brāhmī sthitistathā ।
yeṣāṃ vāse svayaṃ kṛṣṇaścāyāto muktidāyakaḥ ।। 39 ।।
sarvapāpaharaḥ sarvapuṇyadaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
sarvānandapradaḥ prāptaḥ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।।2.97.40।।
kiṃ vācyaṃ parameśāna sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ pravartate ।
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña kuśalaṃ te kare hi naḥ ।।41।।
samudrasya raṇasyāpi vātasyāpi niyāmaka ।
tvayā tvetannimittena yamitāḥ sāgarādayaḥ ।।42।।
punarnaivaṃ prajānāṃ vai brahmāṇḍe'tra kṣayo bhavet ।
kuśalaṃ ca mahāsaukhyaṃ kṛtaṃ tat kimataḥ param ।।43 ।।
athaivamṛṣayaścoktvā hemaśālāyano muniḥ ।
prāha svasya mahākaṣṭaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu mānini ।।44।।
hemaśālāyana uvāca-
ahamāsaṃ prabho bālānadītīre drumāliṣu ।
ativṛṣṭyā jale magnaḥ samudraṃ prati dharṣitaḥ ।।45।।
tajjale tu yadā magnastadā vaihāyasā balāt ।
mārgeṇa hemaśālādrau samāyātastataḥ param ।।46।।
bālukāvarṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ yatra magno'bhavaṃ punaḥ ।
tataḥ samādhiṃ kṛtavānasmaraṃ tvāṃ guruṃ tathā ।।47।।
mṛtaprāyo'bhavaṃ nātha sikatāstaragarbhitaḥ ।
bhavatā tāvadāgatyoddhṛto'haṃ guruṇā'pi ca ।।48।।
bālāyana uvāca-
ahaṃ samudrasalile snātuṃ gato'bhavaṃ yadā ।
tāvat sāmudrakallolairaprāgbhavairbhayaṃkaraiḥ ।।49।।
ākṛṣṭo jalamadhye ca jalaiḥ saha bhuvaṃ prati ।
samāgato hi bālāyā nadyāstaṭe tu tāvatā ।।2.97.50।।
vālukāvarṣaṇaiśchanno vālukāgarbhito'bhavam ।
kṛtvā prāṇān brahmarandhre samādhāvāsthito'bhavam ।।51 ।।
tāvad bhavatā tvāgatya tārito jīvito'smyaham ।
vinā tavā''gamaṃ kṛṣṇa pṛthvyāṃ layo mataḥ kvacit ।।52।।
rāvāsana uvāca-
gośaṃkusaritastīre samādhāvabhavaṃ hyaham ।
na jāne kiṃ ca me jātaṃ yadā'haṃ jāgratiṃ gataḥ ।।53।।
tadā jñātaṃ mayā tatra vālukā'ntarmṛdā'rditaḥ ।
asmyahaṃ pṛthivīgarbhe'smaraṃ kṛṣṇamagastikam ।।54।।
tāvadbhavadbhirāgatya rakṣito'haṃ kṛpānidhe ।
saprāṇo nirgato bhūmeryathā nidrita utthitaḥ ।।55।।
dārāliṃgāyana uvāca-
dārāliṃgasya śailasya vane cāsaṃ japan harim ।
tatra vātena vṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhā vibhidya dūrataḥ ।।56।।
prakṣiptā śākhayā bhagnaṃ śarīraṃ me mṛto'bhavam ।
na jāne kiṃ tato jātaṃ svastho'hamutthitaḥ prabho ।।57।।
śītalaṃ rasapānaṃ ca mayā prāptaṃ tu jāgratā ।
tato'haṃ viplavaṃ cāvediṣaṃ tvayā hi rakṣitaḥ ।।58।।
bhekadāneya uvāca-
ahaṃ tvāsaṃ bhekadāne parvate droṇikāśrayaḥ ।
vātyayā me parṇakuṭī samūlā gaganaṃ gatā ।।59।।
ahaṃ kuṭyāṃ prasuptaścā'bhavaṃ kāṣṭhatale tadā ।
parṇakuṭyā saha kṣipto'bhavaṃ vyomnaśca parvate ।।2.97.60।।
agamye śikhare naṣṭo'bhavaṃ gaganapātataḥ ।
na jāne jīvitaḥ kena bhavatā hariṇā kimu ।।61 ।।
smṛtvā tvāṃ cāgatā'smyatra jaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।
tvāṃ vinā kaḥ rakṣako'sti maraṇe samupasthite ।।62।।
maṣīgrīva uvāca-
ahaṃ raṇasya ca taṭādagacchaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vanam ।
araṇyaṃ tanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ kṣaṇājjaleṣu majjitam ।। 63।।
jale'haṃ makareṇaiva dhṛtaśca bhakṣito'bhavam ।
na jāne tatkathaṃ paścājjīvito'smi kṛpā tava ।।64।।
vartate kāraṇaṃ tatra bhakṣitasyā'pi jīvanam ।
evaṃ nātha tvayā'vaśyaṃ jīvito vaidyaśārṅgiṇā ।।35।।
śālavanāyana uvāca-
śālavane'bhavaṃ śaile tvāṃ bhajan puruṣottamam ।
vātyayā coddhṛtaḥ sthānāt pañcayojanadūragaḥ ।।66।।
ambarāt patitaścābdhau magno mṛto'bhavaṃstataḥ ।
tvāṃ smarāmi kṛpāsindho rakṣa rakṣeti vai tadā ।।67।।
dṛṣṭo bhavān mayā tatra gṛhṇan māṃ svakareṇa vai ।
rakṣitastāritaścā'haṃ tvayā cātra niveśitaḥ ।।68।।
ācālarṣiruvāca-
ahaṃ tvāsaṃ cāgnihotre vātyayā vahnirulbaṇaḥ ।
samajanyatha kāṣṭhānāmaraṇyaṃ dāvadharṣitam ।।69।।
dāve dagdho'bhavaṃ cāhaṃ tatraiva bhasmatāṃ gataḥ ।
tadānīmasmaraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।2.97.70।।
agastiṃ ca guruṃ devaṃ rakṣakama jagadīśvaram ।
bhasmataścāhamutpannastvayā punarnavīkṛtaḥ ।।71 ।।
āpyāyitaśca gaṇakaiścetanena suyojitaḥ ।
vaihāyasā balenā'tra samāyāto'smi te kṛpā ।।72।।
grāmāyana uvāca-
grāmādriparvate cāhamāsaṃ tatra hariṃ smaran ।
snātaḥ pūjāṃ karomyeva yāvattāvattu garjanā ।।73 ।।
bhayadā bhūkampajanyā'bhavat so'haṃ kṣaṇāntare ।
kampamānāt parvatasya śikharātpatito yadā ।।74।।
tāvad vātyā hṛto dūraṃ vyomni meghe niveśitaḥ ।
mṛto meghe'tiśaityena na jāne kimataḥ param ।। 75।।
kathaṃ vā jīvanaṃ prāptastavaiva karuṇedṛśī ।
bhaktasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇa karoṣyevā'mbare'pi ca ।।76।।
vāṭāyana uvāca-
ahaṃ vātyāmbare kṣipto bhrāmyamāṇo'tivegataḥ ।
araṇye kutracit kṣipto dṛṣṭavān mattahastinam ।।77।।
tenātikṣudhitenā'haṃ dhṛtaścāpi prabhakṣitaḥ ।
tataḥ kasmājjīvanaṃ me na jāne vetsi keśava ।।78।।
divādiṅgāyana uvāca-
divādikparvatayostu madhye kavindumātaṭe ।
āsaṃ tatra ca sāmudraṃ jalaṃ pūrvata āgatam ।।79।।
kavindumānadī tatra sāmudrajalasaṃplutā ।
tatrā'haṃ tu nimagno vai jalaṃ dūraṃ hyapāsarat ।।2.97.80।।
tato vālukayā jātaḥ parvato macchirasyapi ।
tatrā'vasaṃ samādhistho bhavatā parvato hṛtaḥ ।।81 ।।
tato'haṃ nijadehastho jāgratiṃ cāgamaṃ prabho ।
tāvanmayā'mbare dṛṣṭaṃ vimānaṃ cātibhāsuram ।।82।।
atidūraṃ sūryanibhaṃ cāgato'haṃ vilokya tat ।
rakṣito'haṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa jīvito mṛtyudantataḥ ।।83।।
kṛpāṃ vinā na nāthā'tra jīvedvai dehavān khalu ।
deśe mṛtāstvayā kṛṣṇa jīvitā hi prajājanāḥ ।।84।।
punaryathāvad vihitaṃ kastathākartumīśvaraḥ ।
agastyena kṛtā rakṣā śaṃkareṇa punaḥ punaḥ ।।85।।
aśvinībālakenātra prajāḥ sacetanīkṛtāḥ ।
śrībhirdeśāḥ smṛddhipūrṇāḥ kṛtā ujijīvitāḥ punaḥ ।।86।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa tvayā'vitāḥ ।
dhanyo'strālayadeśo'yamuṣṇālayā'parābhidhaḥ ।।87।।
uṣṭrālayasamāno'pi ūrdhvālayasamaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
pāvito bhavatā''gatya rakṣitāstāritā vayam ।।88।।
ityevaṃ rādhike tvekādaśarṣibhirnivedite ।
śrīhariḥ prāha yuṣmākaṃ bhaktyā mayā hi tāritāḥ ।।89।।
mama bhaktārthamevā'haṃ sarvatvaṃ pradadāmi tu ।
mayā hi cakravākyarthaṃ jalaṃ śailopari drutam ।।2.97.90 ।।
pārśvabhūmiṃ samāplāvya prāpitaṃ pāyitaṃ purā ।
mayā bhaktakṛte lakṣmīstyaktā bhaktavirodhinī ।।9 1 ।।
madbhaktārthaṃ mayā sarvaṃ dīyate rakṣyate ca saḥ ।
ekasyā'rthe'saṃkhyadehabhṛtāṃ karomi rakṣaṇam ।।92।।
ekasyā'rthe'saṃkhyadehabhṛtāṃ karomi nāśanam ।
sarvaṃ karomi bhaktārthaṃ nā'bhaktārthaṃ kadācana ।।93।।
abhaktāstu bhaktapārśve nāntarīyakalābhinaḥ ।
bhavatāṃ mama bhaktānāmarthe deśo'yamuddhṛtaḥ ।।94।।
mārjārā'patyakānāṃ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ ca purā mayā ।
kṛtaṃ sā'nalabhrāṣṭraughe mārjārikā'tibhaktitaḥ ।।95।।
yasya yādṛk bhavet snehastasya tathāvidhā'vanam ।
karomi satataṃ loke vrataṃ me bhaktarakṣaṇam ।।96।।
kīrtanātsmaraṇātsparśāddarśanādvandanādapi ।
arcanācca sakhībhāvāt śravaṇādapi cottamam ।।97।।
ātmasamarpaṇaṃ snehapūrvaka mama rocate ।
madarthaṃ yasya nā'deyaṃ kiñcidapīha vidyate ।।98।।
tasyā'rthe sarvathā cāhaṃ tyajāmīha paratra ca ।
bhavadarthaṃ mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥ ।।99।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān parameśvaraḥ ।
rādhike bālakṛṣṇe te babhūvuḥ sthiramānasāḥ ।। 2.97.100 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ dadhyurbahirmūrtiṃ tato'ntare ca taṃ harim ।
ānandasāgare magnāḥ kṣaṇaṃ viśaśramuśca te ।। 101 ।।

itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uṣṭrālayadeśe hemaśālāyanāśrame śrīharervimānasyā'vataraṇam, svasvarakṣāvṛttāntādikathanaṃ cetyādinirū-
paṇanāmā saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 97 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 097 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 98
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 099 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha kṣaṇāntare sarve yoginaḥ parameśvaram ।
papracchuḥ rādhike! cakravākīrakṣā yathā kṛtā ।। 1 ।।
yathā lakṣmīḥ purā tyaktā priyā'pi paramātmanā ।
yathā mārjārikā'patyānyarakṣayaddhariḥ purā ।। 2 ।।
ke te'bhavan kathaṃ bhaktāḥ kathaṃ rakṣā ca kīdṛśī ।
puṇyameṣāṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca yadrakṣāṃ mādhavo'karot ।। 3 ।।
śrīhemaśālāyana uvāca-
cakravākī bhaktā tava kīdṛśī pūrvajātijā ।
kathaṃ snehastvadarthaṃ vai tiraścāṃ chindhi saṃśayam ।। 4 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇutemāṃ kathāṃ viprāścakravākyāḥ purābhavām ।
