sanatsujātanāmā'sau brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ।। 5 ।।
vedavedāṃgatattvajño bhaktimārgaparāyaṇaḥ ।
brahmacaryaparaścāpi brahmavidyopadeśakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu cā'vyāhatagatirvratī ।
kiśorabhāvenorvyāṃ sa vyacarat tīrthakāṃkṣayā ।। 7 ।।
nārāyaṇasaro yātaḥ kacche snātuṃ sa caikadā ।
pūrṇacandrānanaḥ saumyastejoparidhiśobhitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
rūpānurūpāvayavo valkalairāvṛto muniḥ ।
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāvayavaśca kāmakāntisamujjvalaḥ ।। 9 ।।
strīṇāṃ manoharaścātikṣamāsaujanyaśobhitaḥ ।
prasannamānasaścaikaprabhudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 2.98.1 0।।
valkalāni samutsṛjya kaupīnamātravastrakaḥ ।
avātatāra ca nārāyaṇasarojalāntare ।। 11 ।।
avagāhya taṭaṃ yāti prajaptvā vedamātaram ।
punarjalāntare yāti punastaṭe ca tiṣṭhati ।। 12।।
hariṃ dhyāyan ca gāyatrīṃ japtvā punarjalāntare ।
gatvā snāti sukhaṃ sūryaṃ natvā'vagāhate jale ।। 1 3।।
bahirāgatya ca dhyāne sthito vai ghaṭikāvadhim ।
tāvat tatrorvaśī nārāyaṇaputrī himālayāt ।। 14।।
bahvībhiḥ saha sakhībhiḥ samāyayau nijecchayā ।
ūrorutpāditā sā tu mahendrāya samarpitā ।। 15।।
yaddināt taddinād badrīṃ piturdarśanakāraṇāt ।
samāyāti pratipakṣaṃ pūrṇā'mādivaseṣu sā ।। 16।।
badaryāṃ sā piturnārāyaṇasya darśanaṃ śubham ।
vidhāyaiva ca tīrthārthaṃ nārāyaṇasarovaram ।। 17।।
samāyayau mahābhaktā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇuputrikā ।
mahābhāgavatī devī cāpsarogaṇamūrdhajā ।। 18।।
apsarasāṃ nisargastu cāñcalyaṃ subhage nare ।
evaṃ cañcalabhāvena bhaktā'pi yuvalālasā ।। 19।।
bhāsantaṃ tejasā ramyāvayavaṃ dṛṣṭigocaram ।
ekalaṃ savilokyaiṣā manobhavavaśīkṛtā ।।2.98.20।।
rantuṃ sanatsujātaṃ tamṛṣiṃ cārthayadagragā ।
nanarta bahubhāvena bhūtvā kiśorikākṛtiḥ ।। 2 1।।
satālaṃ gāyanaṃ cakre gītikāṃ prajagau mudā ।
cakravat paritastasya bhramaṇaṃ nartane bahu ।।22।।
cakrākāraṃ cakāraiṣā khyāpayantī svacāpalam ।
vācā tvarañjayañcakranṛtyena saha sā munim ।।23।।
muniḥ śuśrāva vācaṃ ca cakranṛtyaṃ vyalokayat ।
sāpi sammanute mugdhaṃ muniṃ nṛtyati cādhikam ।।24।।
hāvabhāvāṃgaceṣṭābhiḥ premahārdavilokanaiḥ ।
muniṃ sā mohayāmāsa munirjahāsa vai muhuḥ ।।25।।
sāpi jvarayutā spraṣṭuṃ yāvanmuniṃ samicchati ।
tāvadvivekavān vipraḥ sanatkumārako muniḥ ।। 26।।
mā spṛśetyāha ca tataḥ samutthāya sadharmadhṛk ।
yayau dūraṃ hasanneva niṣasāda sthalāntare ।।27।।
tasya vai sarasastīre tadā sāpi vaśaṃgatā ।
yayau tatra cakārāpi punarnṛtyaṃ manoharam ।।28।।
punaḥ punaścekṣamāṇā prārthayitrī ca taṃ munim ।
rantukāmā'bhisṛtyaiva pārśvagā sā sthirā hyabhūt ।। 29।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha kathaṃ ceṭi! ceṭīvad vartase'tra vai ।
sākṣānnārāyaṇaputrī yā tvaṃ sparśe na lajjase ।। 2.98.30 ।।
ahaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ putrastvaṃ putraputraputrikā ।
brahmavrato'hamevā'smi mā vṛthā ceṣṭanaṃ kuru ।।3 1 ।।
snāhi tīrthajale ramye nārāyaṇe sarovare ।
mā vṛthā mānasīṃ pīḍāmāvahā'sthānake sute! ।।32।।
ityuktā sā nirāśā ca santāpakhedasaṃyutā ।
uvācainaṃ yuvānaṃ vai tyaktamaryādacetasā ।। 33 ।।
vayaṃ tvapsaraso vipra sarvasāmānyabhogadāḥ ।
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā cāpi śambhunā sammatāḥ suraiḥ ।।34।।
tasmānnā'haṃ sutā yogin draṣṭavyā'tra tvayā kvacit ।
sarvā nārāyaṇaputryo nārāyaṇapriyāstathā ।।35।।
nārāyaṇāṃgasañjātā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇapriyā ।
rādhā kṛṣṇāṃgasañjātā rādhā kṛṣṇasya kāminī ।। 36।।
ajavaṃśe tu sañjātā gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ।
ajaputrasya dakṣasya putryo dharmādiyoṣitaḥ ।।37।।
devasṛṣṭau na bādho'sti tasmāt tvāṃ samupasthitā ।
tvayā hāsyaṃ bhāvanā ca darśite ratibodhike ।।38।।
tasmād gṛhāṇa viprendra na cecchapsyāmi satvaram ।
ityuktvā sā sanatsujātasyā'ṅke nipapāta ha ।। 39।।
ṛṣiḥ sanatsujātastu śāpasya bhayakāraṇāt ।
yadvā brahmavratahānerna tāṃ jagāda kiñcana ।।2.98.40।।
kintu yogaṃ tadā kṛtvā prāṇānākṛṣya tatkṣaṇam ।
brahmarandhraṃ samādhau tu gatvovāsa yathāsukham ।।41।।
ūrvaśī taṃ muniṃ kāntaṃ kāmaśūnyaṃ vilokya ca ।
atṛptidaṃ biḍālasya vṛttiṃ dhṛtvā''tmani sthitam ।।42।।
śaśāpa vai tadā śīghraṃ biḍālī bhava dhūrtarāṭ ।
yasya nāsti striyā mūlyaṃ bhaktāyā api sarvathā ।।43।।
striyā duḥkhaṃ na jānāti strīkāmaṃ vardhayatyapi ।
agnimudbhāvya ca dūre dahyamānāṃ prapaśyati ।।44।।
tādṛśasya tu ṣaṇḍhasya mārjārījanmayogyatā ।
bhavatveva dayāhīnā mārjārī duḥkhavedinī ।।45।।
strīduḥkhaṃ kāmabhedena kīdṛśaṃ jñāsyase yathā ।
tathā mārjārahīnā tvaṃ mārjārī bhava bhrāṣṭragā ।।46।।
ityevaṃ śāpamāpannaḥ ṛṣirmārjārikā'bhavat ।
jātismaraśca tatraiva nārāyaṇasarastaṭe ।।47।।
samādherutthito drāk ca svaṃ dehaṃ cāvalokayat ।
mārjārībhāvamāpannaṃ krodhaṃ cāvāpa vai tadā ।।48।।
snāntīṃ tadorvaśīṃ prāha cakravannartane ratā ।
vāgvilāsena mohaṃ ca karoṣi mādṛśānapi ।।49।।
alabdhāśā ca śapase sadoṣā doṣavarjitam ।
tasmāt tvaṃ jalaśūnye vai pradeśe tṛṣṇayā yutā ।।2.98.50।।
atṛptā bhava ceṭī ca cakravākī smarāturā ।
cakravākavihīnā ca sakhījanavivarjitā ।।51 ।।
ityevaṃ corvaśī śaptā cakravākī kṣaṇāntare ।
tatraiva jātā citrāḍhyā sapakṣā pakṣijātijā ।।52।।
athā'nyā vyomamārgeṇa sakhyastūrṇaṃ vihāya tām ।
yayurdivaṃ mahendraṃ ca tā ūcustad yathā'bhavat ।।53।।
saṃsāre kāmanā doṣo bahuduḥkhaprado yataḥ ।
na guṇe gaṇyate vijñairyadyapyānandaśevadhiḥ ।।।54।।
athendraḥ śokamāpanno yayau śrīparameṣṭhinam ।
nijagāda ca vṛttāntaṃ vrahmā'pi śokamātavān ।।55।।
dvau tau viṣṇuṃ taduddhārakartāraṃ badarīvane ।
naranārāyaṇarūpaṃ yayatuḥ śāpamuktaye ।।56।।
praṇematurvavandāte cārcayāmāsaturharim ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ natvā brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।।57।।
madhuparkaṃ dadau kṛtvā svāgataṃ samuvāca ha ।
kuśalaṃ sarvathā kaccit prajānāṃ ca pitāmaha ।।58।।
brahmā prāha hare sarvaṃ prajānāṃ kuśalaṃ sadā ।
yadarthaṃ tapyase cātra tāsāṃ cā'kuśalaṃ katham ।।59।।
kintu te corvaśī putrī yā cendrāya samarpitā ।
sanatsujāto me putro yogīndraḥ sāṃkhyayogavit ।।2.98.60।।
dvāvetau śāpayogena tiryagbhāvamupāgatau ।
dvau bhaktau vaiṣṇavau śreṣṭhau sutā sutastathā''vayoḥ ।।6 1 ।।
cakravākī ca mārjārī jāte kacchapradeśake ।
nārāyaṇasarastīre kāmenā'nyonyaśāpite ।।62।।
jātismare ca .bhavatastanmokṣaśca yathā bhavet ।
tathā vidhīyatāṃ deva dayālo bhagavān bhavān ।।63।।
kartumakartumanyathākartuṃ śakto'sti śāsakaḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavānāha vicintya vedhasaṃ tadā ।।64।।
tayoruddhāramevā'haṃ kariṣye svalpakālataḥ ।
śāpena tiryagbhāve ca kiñcid duḥkhamavāpsyataḥ ।।65।।
jātismarasvabhāvena madbhaktyā māṃ smariṣyataḥ ।
tiryagyonivimokṣārthamudbhāvya ca nimittakam ।।66।।
tadā'ntike tayoḥ śīghraṃ gatvā dāsye pramokṣaṇam ।
bhaktayorna ciraṃ duḥkhaṃ cintāṃ tyaja pitāmaha ।।67।।
ityuktau ca prasannau tau mahendraśca pitāmahaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaṃ prapūjyaiva natvā nārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ ।।68।।
āyayatuśca tattīre yatra ceṭībiḍālike ।
jātismare tu te dṛṣṭvā mahendraṃ vedhasaṃ tathā ।।69।।
āyayaturdrutaṃ pārśve rurudatuśca duḥkhataḥ ।
āśvāsite ca te tābhyāṃ śāpamuktirniveditā ।।2.98.70।।
svalpakālena bhagavān śāpamuktiṃ vidhāsyati ।
kurutaṃ bhajanaṃ svāmyanādinārāyaṇasya vai ।।71।।
jñānināṃ naiva śoko'sti āgamā nāśino yataḥ ।
śarīrāṇi samānāni bhauktikāni hi dehinām ।।72।।
vijñatvaṃ śiṣyate tatra jñānaṃ duḥkhavināśakam ।
ajñānināṃ tu yadduḥkhaṃ jñānināṃ sukhameva tat ।73।।
pariṇāmaiśca vastūnāṃ tāpaistrividhakaistathā ।
saṃskāraiśca vibhinnaiśca duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vivekinām ।।74।।
yauvanaṃ sarvathā duṣṭaṃ duḥkhadaṃ kāmakāraṇāt ।
tṛṣṇā sahacarī tasya sukhyapi duḥkhamāpnuyāt ।।75।।
saṃsāre yadi duḥkhaṃ na ko viśeṣo'sya mokṣataḥ ।
tasmād duḥkhaṃ hi saṃsāraḥ sukhaṃ muktirnigadyate ।।76।।
sukhamiśraṃ sadā duḥkhaṃ māyāyāṃ cābhivardhate ।
tṛṣṇākṣaye mahānando māyā tatra na bādhate ।।77।।
tṛṣṇāṃ parityajet prājño yadicchet sukhamātmanaḥ ।
koṭīndriyasukhāgryāṇāṃ tṛṣṇānāśasya nāṃ'śatā ।।78।।
viṣayāṇāmupabhogastṛṣṇāṃ vardhayate navām ।
tṛṣṇā doṣo viṣayāṇāṃ phalaṃ duḥkhataraṃ hi tat ।।79।।
jñānināṃ tu viṣayāṇāmupabhogo nivṛttaye ।
icchānāśe phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ mokṣasahāyakam ।।2.98.80।।
yogināṃ jñānināṃ caivaṃ bhogā api na bandhadāḥ ।
pratyutā'darśanajanyatṛṣānivartakā hi te ।।81 ।।
tṛṣātṛptyantaviśrāntā jñānayuktā yadā hi sā ।
tṛṣā tṛṣṇāvardhinī ca mauḍhyabhāvānvitā yadi ।।82।।
mauḍhyaṃ jñānena naśyedvai gururjñānasya kāraṇam ।
guroḥ prāptiḥ puṇyayogāt puṇyaṃ śāstraśravādibhiḥ ।।83।।
śāstraśravādyāḥ śraddhābhiḥ śraddhā mumukṣutādibhiḥ ।
mumukṣutā ca kṛpayā harereva pravartate ।।84।।
hareḥ kṛpā tu bhajanāt sevanāt smaraṇāditaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipareśvaraḥ ।।85।
śrotavyaścāpi mantavyo nididhyāse'rthya eva saḥ ।
tasya śaraṇamāpannā taranti duḥkhasāgarān ।।86।।
sarvathā'rpaṇametasmai kāryaṃ sarvātmanā saha ।
premabhaktiḥ sadā kāryā tasyaiva bhavapāradā ।।87।।
yadi syāmo vayaṃ tasya so'pi syātsarvadā tu naḥ ।
bhakto bhajate bhakteśaṃ bhakteśo bhajate'nugam ।।88।।
sukhasāgarayogena cāpagā sukhitāṃ vrajet ।
dugdhasāgarayogena saridvāri payo bhavet। ।।89।।
na māyā parameśe'sti na duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇikā na ca ।
na doṣā santi vai kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe pareśvare ।।2.98.90।।
guṇā divyā anavadhikātiśayavivarjitāḥ ।
santi deve mahākṛṣṇe bhaktāstānāpnuvanti vai ।।9 1 ।।
smaryatāṃ ca bhavadbhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ।
sa evā'cirakālena śāpamokṣaṃ vidhāsyati ।।92।।
nimittaṃ ca samudbhāvya svayamevāgamiṣyati ।
tiryagbhāve'pi cātraiva tīrthe snānaṃ smṛtiṃ hareḥ ।93।।
namanaṃ mastakenāpi phalapatrārpaṇādikam ।
nāmaraṭaṇamevā'pi na tyaktavyaṃ kadācana ।।94।।
etādṛśī yadi bhaktistiryagbhāve'pi jāyate ।
mānuṣādapi dehātsa lābhaḥ śreṣṭhatamo bhavet ।।95।।
vinā bhaktiṃ paśutvaṃ cātmanāṃ tulyaṃ sureṣvapi।
ko viśeṣaḥ suratve'pi yadi bhaktirna vidyate ।।96।।
rājyasthasyā'pi jihvāyā rasagrāhe samānatā ।
sarvendriyāṇāṃ sāmarthyaṃ daridrasya ca bhūpateḥ ।।97।।
samānaṃ vai mayā klṛptaṃ viśeṣo nā'tra vidyate ।
śarīraṃ tu samānaṃ vai samānānīndriyāṇyapi ।।98।।
rasāsteṣāṃ samānāśca tṛptiḥ samā'pi sarvathā ।
dattāḥ sarvaśarīribhyo viśeṣo nā'tra vidyate ।।99।।
harerbhaktiḥ kevalaikā kṛtā sā'tra viśiṣyate ।
tasmād bhaktyā bhavatoścoddhāraḥ śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 2.98.10 0।।
gacchāvo'smatsusaṃsthānaṃ śaṃ vāmastu ca bhaktitaḥ ।
ityuktvā pūjyamānau tau mahendravedhasāvubhau ।। 101 ।।
ceṭībiḍālikābhyāṃ suspraṣṭau bhāvena pādayoḥ ।
natau suvanditau vyomnā yayatuśca nijaṃ divam ।। 1 02।।
te hyubhe piturādeśād bhajete śrīnarāyaṇam ।
divāniśaṃ japataśca svāminaṃ śrīramāpatim ।। 1 03।।
ityevamṛṣayastatra nārāyaṇasarovare ।
te hyubhe bhavatāṃ śāpakāraṇāt paśupakṣije ।। 1 04।।
ityuktvā rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
viśāśrāma kṣaṇaṃ bhaktārpitaṃ vāri papau śubham ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uṣṭrālayadeśe hemaśālāyanena pṛṣṭāyāścakravākīmārjārikāpūrvajanmakathāyā varṇananāmā'ṣṭanavati-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 98 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 098 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 99
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 100 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścādanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
yathoddhāraṃ kṛtavān śrīhariḥ provāca tāṃ kathām ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca-
hemaśālāyanarṣe tvaṃ kathā śṛṇu tataḥ parām ।
yā'bhūnmārjārikā nārāyaṇasarastaṭe tu sā ।। 2 ।।
vṛkādibhayamāpannā yayau kheṭaṃ samīpagam ।
yatra vai śrīharerbhaktā vasanti paśupālakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
narā nāryo vaiṣṇavāste bhajante parameśvaram ।
tatra sā hyaṭati nityaṃ pratigrahaṃ kṣudhānvitā ।। 4 ।।
duḥkhenā''sādya bhojyaṃ 'vai cauryeṇa bahuyatnataḥ ।
vartate sā'thavā cauryaṃ karotyeva na ca kvacit ।। 5 ।।
śunāṃ bhayāttu sā rātrau śete pulakasañcaye ।
tṛṇānāṃ sañcaye cāpi gṛhapṛṣṭhasthasañcaye ।। 6 ।।
yathākathañcitsamprāpyocchiṣṭaṃ vṛttiṃ karoti sā ।
yatra nāstyeva mārjārajātistatreyamekalā ।। 7 ।।
vinā naraṃ vasatyeva yuvatī ṛtudharmiṇī ।
kāmadāhena mārjārī pīḍyate'haniṃśaṃ tadā ।। 8 ।।
śāpasya kāraṇenaiva mārjāraṃ labhate na sā ।
kheṭād dūratarā grāmāstatra gantuṃ na śakyate ।। 9 ।।
madhye vanyapaśūnāṃ sā bhayāttatraiva tiṣṭhati ।
evaṃ sā pīḍitā kāmadāhenā'ṣṭasamāvadhim ।। 2.99.1 0।।
navame vatsare vṛṣṭiścātivṛṣṭirabhūdbhuvi ।
tatpravāheṇa vai kaścinmārjāro dūrabhūmitaḥ ।। 1 1।।
taraṃgairuhyamānaḥ saḥ sarovāriṣu cāyayau ।
vṛkṣaśākhāṃ samālambya jīvan sarovarāntike ।। 12।।
jalena vakravegena śākhayā sahitastu saḥ ।
mārjāro vāhitastīraṃ śākhā tīragatā'bhavat ।। 1 3।।
jale līne biḍālaḥ saḥ yayau śanaiḥ śanaistadā ।
kheṭaṃ vilokya tatraiva yatra mārjārikā'sti sā ।। 14।।
tena yogaṃ gatā sā ca sagarbhā sambabhūva ha ।
kuṃbhakāragṛhe sā tu ghāsakaccaramadhyagā ।। 15।।
sagarbhā pūrṇakālena prasūtā pañcabālakān ।
nidadhe tṛṇapuñje tān tato vai cāparasthale ।। 16।।
tataḥ sthalāntare cāpi rarakṣa nijabālakān ।
athā'pakvasthale cāmapātrapuñje rarakṣa sā ।। 17।।
kuṃbhakāreṇa saṃklṛpte pākārthaṃ vahnigartake ।
āmapātreṣu bālān sā gopayitvā bahiryayau ।। 18।।
nijabhojyasya lābhārthaṃ paścāt kubhakṛtā'nalaḥ ।
dattaḥ pātraprapākārthaṃ sā dṛṣṭvā dhūmrameva tam ।। 1 9।।
śīghraṃ tatra samāyātā dadarśā'gre'nalaṃ mukhe ।
pṛṣṭhe'patyāni tiṣṭhanti mārgo nirgamanāya na ।।2.99.20।।
vahnirvṛddhiṃ gatastatra jvālāmālāsamujjvalaḥ ।
sāpi śvabhayatastatra pārśve tṛṇeṣu kaccare ।।21 ।।
suguptā cā'rudaccāti bālā rudanti cānale ।
bālānāṃ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ hyupāyo vidyate na vai ।।22।।
kuṃbhakāro na tatrāsti rodanaṃ śṛṇuyāttu kaḥ ।
apatyasnehasampannā'patyarakṣaṇahetave ।। 23 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminamasmarat ।
tuṣṭāva kalpitairbhāvairnārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।। 24।।
vahniḥ pātrapragarte tu paritaścāvṛto'bhavat ।
apatyāni tu pātrāṇāṃ madhye tiṣṭhanti tattale ।।25।।
jvalate cā'nalaścordhvaṃ tale naivā'bhiyāti ca ।
mārjārikā'tibhāvenā'japat kṛṣṇa hare prabho ।।26।।
rakṣa me bālakān kṛṣṇa yatnena prāpitān śubhān ।
nirdoṣān jñānahīnāँśca rakṣa svāminnarāyaṇa ।।27।।
yadyahaṃ tvayi bhaktā'smi rakṣa me bālakān vibho ।
garbhe rakṣā kṛtā yena yatpitā ca jalāntare ।।28।।
rakṣito yena devena sa me bālān prarakṣatu ।
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa svāmin śrīman pumuttam ।।29।।
yenā'haṃ janitā pūrvaṃ sa me bālān prarakṣatu ।
agnau jale pṛthivyāṃ cāmbare vāyau nivāsakṛt ।। 2.99.30।।
hṛdaye cāmapātre ca garte bhrāṣṭre ca cullake ।
yaḥ sadā vyāpako devaḥ sa me bālān prarakṣatu ।।3 1।।
hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin kṛṣṇa rakṣaya bālakān ।
priyān me prāṇataḥ svalpānanāthān saṃprarakṣaya ।।32।।
lakṣajapān kariṣye'haṃ tava tuṣṭyarthameva yat। ।
rakṣa me śāvakān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagadguro ।।33।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt potakānme prarakṣaya ।
ityevaṃ prārthayitrī sā kuṃbhakārāṃgaṇe sthitām ।।34।।
tulasīṃ prati gatvaiva neme ca daśa daṇḍavat ।
pradakṣiṇāśca pañcāśaccakre matvā drume harim ।।35।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin śrīpate kamalāpate ।
rakṣa rādhāpate brahmapate muktapate prabho ।।36।।
pārvatīśa prabhāsvāmin haṃseśa mañjulāyate ।
saguṇeśā''tmasākṣiँstvaṃ rakṣa bālān hare mama ।।37।।
ātmātman karuṇāsindho lakṣmīpate jayāpate ।
amṛtaprada devānāṃ rakṣa śāntāpate'cyuta ।।38।।
śrīpate bhūpate badrīpate līlāpate'nagha ।
bhūtipate'kṣarapate śaktipate'va bālakān ।।39।।
golokādhipate haimīpate ca lalitāpate ।
gahvarāvāsa garbhāsya rakṣa vahnipate pate ।।2.99.40 ।।
hṛṣīkeśa maheśeśa brahmapriyeśa bhīhara ।
akṣarakṣetravāsā'smadbālakān rakṣa meśvara ।।41।।
vahnirdevo'vatu bālān śāntadāho'stu sarvaga ।
bālā me tvamṛtadehā bhavantu bhavadāśraye ।।42।।
yatrā'nyastvāśrayo nāsti tatrāśrayo bhavān guruḥ ।
tārakaśca śaraṇyaśca nātha rakṣaya bālakān ।।43।।
ityevaṃ cārthayamānā biḍālī tulasīṃ muhuḥ ।
natvā patrāṇi cādāya vahnisthāna gatā'bhavat ।।44।।
patrāṇi tvarpayāmāsa vahnidehāya śārṅgiṇe ।
rakṣa me bālakān agne vārdhakyaphalarūpiṇaḥ ।।45।।
ityuktvā ca namaskṛtya pracakāra pradakṣiṇam ।
nā'nyopāyo'tra ca hareḥ smṛtiṃ vinā tu rakṣaṇe ।।46।।
ityevaṃ manasā vācā karmaṇā parameśvaram ।
apūjayad biḍālī sā patraiḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।47।।
jepe nāma ca satataṃ tasthau bhrāṣṭrāgnisannidhau ।
jīvitāśāṃ samālambya bhajamānā jagatpatim ।।48।।
athaivaṃ sā sthitā pārśve kaścinnāyāti mānavaḥ ।
dṛśyate naiva rakṣākṛt nirāśā bhajate harim ।।49।।
tāvacchuśrāva bālānāṃ vākyāni bhrāṣṭrikāntarāt ।
jīvitāśāvatī sā ca prasannamānasā'bhavat ।।2.99.50।।
vahniścoparibhāge cā'mbarīṣordhve pravardhate ।
nīlaharitapiṅgābhirjvālābhiśca samantataḥ ।।5 1।।
raktacitrābhirugrābhiḥ śvetamūlābhirulbaṇaḥ ।
agnirnimbhrāṣṭrake vyāpto'bhavadvai parito'bhitaḥ ।।52।।
antarbahistathā pārśve madhye tale'pi sarvaśaḥ ।
āmapātrāṇi pakvāni vigataṃ ca divāniśam ।।।53 ।।
kṣudhātṛṣāyutā sāpi mārjārī bālakānnijān ।
śṛṇoti vadamānāँśca ramataḥ kṣudhitāँstathā ।।54।।
ekaḥ prāha kadā mātā prāgamiṣyati cāgraja ।
kṣudhā me bādhate cāti samāhvaya ca mātaram ।।55।।
jyeṣṭhaḥ prāhā'nalaścāste mārgān ruddhvā samantataḥ ।
kathaṃ mātā samāgacchet smara śrīparameśvaram ।।56।।
yena garbhe kṛtā rakṣā so'tra rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ।
jīvayiṣyati bhagavān datvā bhaktyā hi bhojanam ।।57।।
agniṃ paśyoṣṇamatyugraṃ jvālāmālāsamedhitam ।
kathaṃ mātā'tra cāgacchet smara kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।58।।
kṛpā bhagavataścaiṣā jīvāmo yadvibhāvasau ।
śītale vivare cātra rakṣaṇaṃ hariṇā kṛtam ।।59।।
agnirnātra samāyāti satyapīndhanasañcaye ।
paśya jvālā na dahati dhūmo mūrchāṃ karoti na ।।2.99.60।।
ehyāgaccha bahiryāmo nirvahnisuṣirād drutam ।
śīto bahnirayaṃ bhāti me na dahyati cānuja ।।61।।
mātaraṃ prati gacchāma ścetyuktvā niryayurdrutam ।
vahnimadhyād vinirgatyā'dagdharomāṇa eva tām ।।62।।।
mātaraṃ prayayuḥ sarve bālā bhrāṣṭrād vinirgatāḥ ।
harṣavyāptāḥ kṣudhāvyāptā apiban mātṛsatpayaḥ ।।63।।
mātā snehaṃ pracakre ca lilehāpi punaḥ punaḥ ।
mātre prāhustu te bhrāṣṭraṃ śītalaṃ rakṣaṇālayam ।।64।।
paya āpīya cā''pṛcchya bhrāṣṭre praviśya te punaḥ ।
bhrāṣṭrikāyāstale gatvā viśaśramuḥ sukhaṃ mudā ।।65।।
yo'gniścā''maghaṭādīnvai pakvān karoti dāhataḥ ।
yo'gniścendhanaghāsādīn dagdhā bhasma karotyapi ।।66 ।।
so'yameva biḍālyāstu bālakārthe suśītalaḥ ।
tadānīṃ dāhahīno vai jātaḥ kṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt ।।67।।
mārjārī cāvalokyaitat svayaṃ ca nirbhayā satī ।
bhrāṣṭrītale samāgantuṃ yayau bhrāṣṭrīmukhaṃ prati ।।68।।
tāvad vahnistathā spraṣṭo'tyuṣṇaścātyantadāhakaḥ ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā'smarat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।69।।
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ hyekameva tu vastu yat ।
sukhāyaikasya bhavati duḥkhāyā'nyasya tat khalu ।।2.99.70।।
sarveṣāṃ dāhakartā'yaṃ pakṣe dāhakaro'bhavat ।
avaśyaṃ śrīnaranārāyaṇena paramātmanā ।।71 ।।।
rakṣitā bālakā me'tra rakṣyante ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
idaṃ me bhaktimāhātmyaṃ bālānāṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ ।।72।।
yadvā tadvā bhavetpuṇyaṃ prāgbhavīyaṃ mahattaram ।
yena bālā ramante me vahnimadhye yathā gṛhe ।।73।।
mārjārī kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ jñātvā pūrṇatamaṃ tadā ।
bheje cātīva bhāvena śrīhariṃ parameśvaram ।74।।
kṣudhātṛṣābhisantaptā kṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ ca niścayam ।
mayā nā'nyatra gantavyaṃ harirdāsyati bhojanam ।।75।।
mahyaṃ mama ca bālebhyo rakṣakaḥ rakṣayiṣyati ।
ityevaṃ manyamānā sā jajāpa auṃ hare'cyuta ।।76।।
kṛṣṇagovindagopālanārāyaṇanarāyaṇa ।
śvāsocchvāsaṃ jajāpaivaṃ vācā ca manasā hṛdā ।।77।।
niṣasāda samīpe ca bhrāṣṭrikāyā hariśritā ।
dinadvayaṃ gataṃ tāvannottiṣṭhati na yāti ca ।।78।।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo devo narottamo narāyaṇaḥ ।
dṛḍhaṃ ca niścayaṃ jñātvā bhaktiṃ jñātvā parātparām ।।79।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt kuṃbhakārasvarūpadhṛk ।
bhādraśrāddhe kṛtaṃ kṣīrapākaṃ ca pūrikāstathā ।।2.99.80 ।।
kare dhṛtvā samāyāto dadau pitṛbhya eva saḥ ।
ambare ca dadau kākapakṣibhyo dhenave dadau ।।81 ।।
dadau bhūtebhya evā'sau mārjāryai cāpi sandadau ।
tāvat tadbālakā vahnibhrāṣṭrato bahirāyayuḥ ।।।82।।
tebhyo dugdhaṃ śrāddhapakvamapāyayat sukhapradam ।
pītvā te viviśustatra bhrāṣṭrītale sukhāvahe ।।83 ।।
evaṃ kuṃbhakṛtā tenā''hutāḥ kuṃbhakṛto'pare ।
paśyantu vahnimadhye vai jīvanti hi biḍālakāḥ ।।84।।
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa kuṃbhakṛdbhyo hi bālakān ।
bhrāṣṭryadhipālakaścāpi dadarśāścaryamāptavān ।।85।।
āmapātrāṇi pacyante naiva dahyanti bālakāḥ ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tvetat tatra prakāśatāṃ gatam ।।86।।
āyayurjanasaṃghāstu vīkṣituṃ bhrāṣṭrikā'rbhakān ।
pupūjurvahnidevaṃ ca biḍālyai bhojanaṃ daduḥ ।।87।।
arbhakebhyo dadurdugdhaṃ bālāścāgatya te bahiḥ ।
pītvā prayānti bhrāṣṭryāṃ te suṣireṇa punaḥ punaḥ ।।88।।
evaṃ vilokya lokāste niścikyurharirakṣitāḥ ।
jīvantyete na duhyanti dīnarakṣākaro hi saḥ ।।89।।
athā'dhipaḥ kuṃbhasraṣṭā vahniśāntyuttaraṃ svayam ।
dūrīcakāra bhasmādi kuṃbhān pātrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।।2.99.90।।
talaṃ riktaṃ cakārā'pi yatra bālā vyavasthitāḥ ।
tatra śrībhagavatpādacihne saṃdṛṣṭavān hi saḥ ।।9 1 ।।
kuṃbhakāraścakārā'tra bhagavatpādavedikām ।
tīrthaṃ mārjārarakṣākhyaṃ prasiddhaṃ tvabhavaddhi tat। ।। 92।।
bālakā rakṣitā yena nārāyaṇena yoginā ।
so'pi tatraiva sarveṣu madhye tadā virājate ।।93।।।
kuṃbhakārasvarūpeṇa nānye vidanti taṃ prabhum ।
athā'yaṃ bhagavān badrīnārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tadā ।।94।।
kṛpayā darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ nijaṃ caturbhujam ।
kuṃbhakārā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā pupūjuḥ śraddhayā'nvitāḥ ।।95।।
mārjārikā dadarśainaṃ śrīmannārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
drāgeva smaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ sanatsujātarūpiṇaḥ ।। 96।।
śokaṃ cakāra vividhaṃ biḍālīprasavādijam ।
kvā'haṃ sanatsujāto'smi kvā'haṃ biḍālatāṃ gataḥ ।।97।।
adya nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣācchāpanāśārthamāgataḥ ।
ityevaṃ tvāptavairāgyo neme nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।। 98।।
nārāyaṇo'pi tāṃ tiryagdehād vivṛtya satvaram ।
sanatkumārarūpaṃ ca dadau brahmasutātmakam ।। 99।।
arbhakāḥ kuṃbhakāraiśca rakṣitā vardhitāstathā ।
tadvaśāste vanīyā vai mārjārā abhavaँstataḥ ।। 2.99.1 00।।
atha nārāyaṇo devastathā sanatsujātakaḥ ।
yayatuśca saraḥ snātuṃ kuṃbhakārā yayustataḥ ।। 101 ।
tadā devaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirmuktā vyomnā sarovare ।
nārāyaṇena vai sākṣād yatra snātaṃ tataḥ suraiḥ ।। 102।।
nārāyaṇasaraśceti tīrthaṃ prakhyāpitaṃ śubham ।
rakṣākṛnmuktikṛccāpi nārāyaṇasya dāyakam ।। 1 03।।
sanatsujātasahitaḥ snātvā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
yayau śrībadarīṃ haimaśaile viśālikāṃ nijām ।। 1 04।।
ṛṣiḥ sanatsujātaśca snātvā tripathagājale ।
natvā nārāyaṇaṃ satyalokaṃ yayau kṣaṇāttataḥ ।।1 05।।
grāmo mārjārapurasaṃjñako'bhavat prajākṛtaḥ ।
ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hemāyanarṣaye ।। 1 06।।
mārjāraputrarakṣāyāḥ kathāmakathayattathā ।
virarāma kṣaṇaṃ rādhe prāpurharṣaṃ mahattaram ।।।1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārjārikā'patyānāṃ kuṃbhakāramahābhrāṣṭrīvahnito nārāyaṇakṛtarakṣaṇaṃ mārjārikāyāḥ śāpamokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇa-
nāmā navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 99 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 099 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 100
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 101 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! 'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabhuḥ ।
prajagāda kathāṃ cakravākyā hemāyanarṣaye ।। 1 ।।
sanatsujātaśāpena nārāyaṇasutorvaśī ।
nārāyaṇasarastīre cakravākī tu yā'bhavat ।। 2 ।।
jātismarā tu sā nityaṃ tīrthacintāṃ karoti hi ।
grāmādgrāmāntara yāti nityamuḍḍīya dūrataḥ ।। 3 ।।
madhyāhne tu kaṇān bhuṃktvā viśramya ca drumāntare ।
uḍḍīya dūradeśaṃ cā''sāyaṃ yāti vihāyasā ।। 4 ।।
evaṃ sā tīrthakāmā ca vairāgyavṛttimāsthitā ।
kacchadeśaṃ śanaistyaktvā'khātamullaṃdhya vegataḥ ।। 5 ।।
ānartadeśānāyātā camatkārapuraṃ prati ।
snātvā sarovare kṛtvā hāṭakeśvaradarśanam ।। 6 ।।
somanāthaṃ yayau dṛṣṭvā'kṣarakṣetramupāyayau ।
natvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapūjya ca ।। 7 ।।
siddhasarasvatīṃ gatvā'rbude puṣkaramāyayau ।
brahmāṇaṃ sā praṇamyaiva gaṃgādvāramupāgatā ।। 8 ।।
kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pragaṇḍakīṃ nadīm ।
śālagrāmānnamaskṛtya śālādriṃ praṇipatya ca ।। 9 ।।
darśanārthaṃ paśupateruḍḍīya yāti cāmbare ।
himādreḥ sannidhau tasyopatyakordhvaṃ tadā'mbare ।। 2.100.10 ।।
uḍḍayantyā bhuvo bhāge nīpālayapradeśake ।
adhodṛṣṭyā tayā dṛṣṭā kanyaikā gaṇḍakītaṭe ।। 11 ।।
candrānanā'tigaurī ca sūryavadbhāsurāṅginī ।
aṣṭavarṣā'pi kamalātulyā tanuśriyā'bhitaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sthalapadmābhakāntyāḍhyā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā ।
sugandhavyāptadehā ca divyā nārāyaṇī yathā ।।1 3 ।।
hṛdaye śrīpatiṃ kāntaṃ jihvāyāṃ haraye namaḥ ।
kaṭyāṃ jaladharaṃ dhṛtvā paśyatīvā'bhitaḥ sthitā ।। 14।।
maṇikaṃkaṇahastā ca maṇinaddhasukaṇṭhikā ।
raśanāvyāptakaṭikā śṛṃkhalāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakā ।। 1 5।।
nupūrāḍhyacaraṇā ca natthikāyuktanāsikā ।
kuṇḍalāḍhyasukarṇā ca vahnayābhavastramaṇḍitā ।। 16 ।।
kundacampakasauvarṇakāntyāḍhyā bahuśobhanā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo parabrahma pate hare ।। 17।।
puruṣottamabhagavan kadā dāsyasi darśanam ।
ityevaṃ nirjane śabdaṃ vyāharantī vilokitā ।। 18 ।।
cakravākī tu tāṃ jñātvā viśvāsapātrarūpiṇīm ।
avātatāra vai vyomnaḥ pārśvasthe śrīdrame tataḥ ।। 1 9।।
tasyā ākarṣaṇārthaṃ ca jagau girā sumiṣṭayā ।
yathā'psarasā gītaṃ vai samākarṇya tu kanyakā ।। 2.100.20 ।।
vyalokayad drume svalpāṃ pakṣiṇīṃ gītikovidām ।
gītikāyāmabhūdbhāvaḥ kadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ।।2 1 ।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaputrī yadā prāpsyāmi mādhavam ।
tadā te'pi mahākṛṣṇo miliṣyatīti mā śucaḥ ।। 22।
yathā'haṃ vai viyuktā'smi tathā tvaṃ dṛśyase sakhi ।
kā tvaṃ kanyāsvarūpā'si mānavī prāksthitiṃ vada ।। 23 ।।
ityevaṃ gāyane bhāvaṃ śrutvā kanyā'tiharṣitā ।
uvāca kā'si ceṭi tvaṃ pakṣidehavatī vad ।। 24।।
āgaccha devavāṇyā māṃ vibodhayasi suvrate ।
kṛṣṇo vā kṛṣṇadūtī vā kṛṣṇā vā vartase'tra kim । । 25 ।।
ehyatra tiṣṭha me pārśvaṃ śaṃsa me maṃgalaṃ śubham ।
śṛṇomi tava māṃgalyaṃ hariḥ kaṣṭaṃ hariṣyati ।।26 ।।
ityuktā sā bhuvaṃ tasyāḥ sannidhau nyapatad drumāt ।
apaśyat pādayoḥ saumyaṃ rūpaṃ śrīpādayoriva ।। 27 ।।
anamat pādayoścāpi papau vāri tayā'rpitam ।
niṣasādā'ntike tasyā āsīnāyāḥ sarittaṭe ।। 28 ।।
pṛṣṭā paricayārthaṃ sā jagād śāpajaṃ phalam ।
urvaśīti hareḥ putrī sanatsujātaśāpataḥ ।। 29 ।।
apsaro'pi vivṛtā'smi cakravākī bhavāmi ha ।
yadā nārāyaṇasyaiva darśanaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।। 2.100.30 ।।
tadā śāpavinirmuktā bhaviṣyāmyurvaśī punaḥ ।
ityevaṃ kathayitvā sā ceṭī muhurhi kanyakām ।। 31 ।।
vilokayati bhāvena śrīsamāṃ cihnaśobhitām ।
cakravākyā hṛdye'syāḥ kṛṣṇacihnaṃ vyalokayat । । 32।।
caraṇordhvatilakākhyapuṇḍrarekhāṃ vyalokayat ।
jaghane bāṇarekhāṃ ca lalāṭe mukuṭākṛtim ।। 33 ।।
gaṇḍe tu dakṣiṇe bhāle śoṇabinduṃ vyalokayat ।
urasi viṣṇurekhāṃ sā vāmabāhau gadāṃ tathā ।। 34।।
vāmasakthni pādukāṃ ca vaijayantīṃ hṛdi sthitām ।
kare tu kamalaṃ ramyaṃ hasticihnaṃ vyalokayat ।। 35।।
dakṣe pāde śaṃkhacihnaṃ naukācihnaṃ vimānakam ।
gadāṃ matsyaṃ śikharaṃ ca jhaṣaṃ tāmbūlavallikām।। 36 ।।
vāme pāde yavarekhāṃ prāsādaṃ chatramityapi ।
ūrdhvarekhāṃ kamalaṃ ca dhvajāṃ'kuśau ghaṭaṃ tathā ।। 37 ।।
kumudaṃ śrīphalaṃ cāpi sthalapadmaṃ vidhuṃ tathā ।
daśacakrāṇi pūrṇāni svarṇarekhāyutā'ṅgulīḥ ।। 38 ।।
lalāṭe pauraṭaṃ hāraṃ svarṇarekhāṃ ca bindukam ।
cibuke bindukaṃ hastarekhāṃ dakṣastanopari ।। 3 9।।
cakraṃ vāmastane kaṇṭhe hāraṃ vakṣasi kānakam ।
dhvajaṃ matsyaṃ ca vaṃśī ca svastikaṃ dakṣiṇe kare ।।2.100.40।।
dhanurmatsyaṃ kalaśaṃ ca tathā vyalokayat kare ।
prākāraṃ toraṇaṃ cāpi dakṣahaste vyalokayat ।।41 ।।
phaṇāyāṃ lāṃgalacihnaṃ dadarśa sumanoharam ।
pade'śvaṃ ca gajaṃ vṛkṣaṃ yūpaṃ bāṇaṃ ca tomaram ।।02। ।
haste sumālikārekhāṃ dīparekhāṃ ca cāmaram ।
śailaṃ ca kuṇḍalaṃ vedīṃ cakraṃ vyadarśayattu sā ।।43। ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpat matvā śrīṃ pārameśvarīm ।
nānyāṃ tvetādṛśīṃ prādṛśyaṃ vinā śrīṃ narāyaṇīyam ।।44।।
naitādṛśāni cihnāni sarvāṇi kamalāṃ vinā ।
iti niścitya cāpṛcchat tasyā nāma kulādi ca ।।45।।
śrutvā jagād kanyā tāṃ cakravākī yathārthataḥ ।
putri! kiṃ te vadāmyatra vidhirvai balavān sadā । ।46 ।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇapatnī tava mātā bhavāmi vai ।
nāmnā lakṣmīranādiśrīkṛṣṇapriyā'smi śāśvatī ।। 47।।
ardhāṃganā mahāvaikuṇṭhākhye vasāmi sarvadā ।
nā'haṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā kadācid yāmi dūrataḥ ।। 48 ।।
nārāyaṇastu māṃ tyaktvā bhaktārthaṃ yāti dūrataḥ ।
yadyahaṃ vighnarūpā syāṃ bhaktabhaktau hareḥ puraḥ ।। 49।।
bhaktārthaṃ tava pitrāhaṃ tyaktā vaikuṇṭhadhāmataḥ ।
vatse śrībhagavān bhaktapriyo vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।। 2.100.5 0 । ।
tyaktvā bhaktā'nugo bhūtvā brahmāṇḍe'tra samāyayau ।
ahaṃ gaveṣayituṃ taṃ samāyātā'smi bhūtale ।।51 ।।
aprakāśitasāmarthyā'bhavaṃ mānavarūpiṇī ।
pitā me śivarājeti śaṃkaro gaṇḍakītaṭe ।।5 2 ।।
svecchāmānavarūpo'sti kailāsā'dhipatirharaḥ ।
mahābhāgavataḥ śrīgopālabhakto virāgavān ।।5 3 ।।
dakṣaputrī satī tatstrīḥ jānakīrti harapriyā ।
sāpi svecchāmānavī ca śaṃbhorgṛhe virājate ।।14।।
pitarau tau mayā klṛptau mānasau śreṣṭhavaiṣṇavau ।
gaṇḍakītīrasaṃsthaṃ vai kailāsadhāmanāmakam ।।55।।
pattanaṃ vartate cedaṃ śailadroṇyāṃ mahattamam ।
atra mānavarūpeṇa virājete satīśivau ।।56।।
kailāsasadṛśodyāne nijarājyasya pattane ।
kṣātradharmaṃ samāśritya lokapālanahetave ।।57।।
lokā'vijñātatattvau tau sarvavijñātarājajau ।
yadgehe vasatiṃ śrīmat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vaśe ।।58।।
prātarnityaṃ haristatra samāyātyarcanagṛhe ।
satīśaṃbhvarpitāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā yāti līnatām ।।59।।
tadahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārhaṇārthameva tu ।
udyānāt pitṛdevārthe jalamāhartumāgatā ।।2.100.6 0 ।।
diṣṭāt putri dṛṣṭavatī tvāṃ viyuktāṃ cirādiha ।
āgaccha mama gehe'tra vasā'tra mama pañjare ।।6 1 ।।
pakṣidharmeṇa vartethā yathā jānanti naiva te ।
sarvathā pālayiṣyehaṃ prāpte kāle priye sute ।।62।।
nārāyaṇecchayā śīghraṃ śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati ।
atra pārśve na dūrāṇi santi vanānyanekaśaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
vihariṣyāva evātra paśyāmaśca narāyaṇam ।
nātra bhayaṃ hareryogāt śivayogāttathā kvacit ।।64।।
mama yogāttathā putri! satīyogācca nirbhayam ।
rājyaṃ kailāsadhāmākhyaṃ nagaraṃ cāpi nirbhayam ।।65।।
samañjasaṃ ca kuśalaṃ vartate sarvameva tu ।
nārāyaṇo pitā te'tra māṃ jānāti tathāpi saḥ ।।66।।
ajña iva sadā cāste na bodhayati śaṃbhave ।
sa eva vatsalaḥ prāpte kāle coddhārayiṣyati ।।67।।
yadvā guptaṃ kariṣyāmastapaścoddhārahetave ।
tadā nijaprasādākhyaṃ tapaḥphalaṃ pradāsyati ।।68।।
śrutvetthaṃ jānakīputryā vacaḥ śivasutoditam ।
nārāyaṇasutā cakravākyurvaśī hyuvāca tām । ।69। ।
mātaste darśanādadya mama duḥkhaṃ gataṃ kila ।
yasyā kasyāmavasthāyāṃ māturaṃko hi śāntidaḥ । ।2.100.70।।
diṣṭādadya mayā prāptā dṛṣṭā pūjyatamā'tra mo ।
yathā vadasi mātarme karomi tattathaiva ca । ।7 1 ।।
māturvacanaṃ vedo'sti dharmo dānaṃ tapo vratam ।
sarve māturvacane vai kanyāyāḥ saphalaṃ matam ।।72।।
duḥkhahā tvaṃ mama mātastathā'haṃ te ca putrikā ।
kṛṣṇaviyoganāśārthaṃ yatiṣye tapāadibhiḥ । ।73 । ।
mātuḥ sevā hi kanyāyāḥ sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ paro vṛṣaḥ ।
sarvasvaṃ jananī putryāḥ pūrvaṃ vivāhanāttataḥ ।। 74। ।
ājīvanaṃ tu jananī putryāḥ saukhyaṃ samicchati ।
na ca putrīsamo jīvo māturanyo hi vidyate ।।72।।
śatajanmakṛtātpuṇyānmātā putrīmatī bhavet ।
putrī sahasrajanmotthapuṇyāt syānmātṛsevikā ।।73।।
mātureva dhanaṃ putrī piturdhanaṃ tu putrakaḥ ।
pituḥ putraḥ sahāyaḥ syānmātuḥ putrī sahāyinī ।।77।।
putre satyapi vandhyeva mātā putrīṃ vinā matā ।
snāne pāke bhojane ca gṛhe vāṭe divāniśam ।।78 ।।
śayane ca pravāse caikānte putrī sahāyinī ।
yathā vatsāyutā dhenuḥ priyatarā'ti jāyate ।।79 ।।
tathā putrīyutā mātā mānyā loke'dhikā matā ।
mātravalambanaṃ putrī mātā putryavalambanam ।।2.100.80 ।।
tasmātputryā sadā mātā śreyaḥpradā prasevyate ।
mātṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mātā sākṣāt sarasvatī ।।8 1 ।।
mātā lakṣmīḥ sadā poṣṭrī tārayitrī ca pālikā ।
parārthāmapi svāṃ putrīṃ śikṣayatyeva satkalāḥ ।।82।।
ātmavad rakṣatīṣṭaṃ ca sarvaṃ dadāti nityadā ।
kaṣṭe kaṣṭaṃ sukhe saukhyaṃ mātā vindati netarā ।।83 ।।
bhuktvā kaṣṭaṃ sutāṃ matvā cā'balāṃ baladā tu yā ।
sadā''śrayaṃ dadātyeva mātā nānyā tathā'parā ।।84।।
mātā bodhyā tu sāvitrī mātā svāhā svadhā yathā ।
mātā brāhmī mahāśaktirmātā sarvagarīyasī ।।85 ।।
mātṛvākyaṃ sadā śreyaḥ śakunaṃ cottamaṃ matam ।
mātṛgālīghṛtanālīāśirvādātmikā sadā ।।86 ।।
mātṛbhūmirmātṛbhāṣā mātṛdugdhaṃ praśasyate ।
mātā triveṇikābhūśca tāriṇī sā praśasyate ।।87।।
mātṛdugdhaṃ matā gaṃgā māturaṃko yamī nadī ।
mātā tīrthatrayaṃ proktaṃ mātṛvākyaṃ sarasvatī ।।88।।
mātuḥ pādajalaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanaṃ pāpanāśanam ।
mātuḥ sparśo'mṛtasparśaḥ poṣako bhojanaṃ vinā ।।89।।
māturucchiṣṭabhojyaṃ ca parameśaprasādavat ।
mātū raktāṇavaḥ kanyā tasmānmātā praśasyate ।।2.100.90 ।।
navamāstu mātṛdehāt putrīdehaḥ prajāyate ।
tasmād brahmasamā mātā sṛṣṭipravāhakāraṇam ।।9 1 ।।
taddarśanaṃ cādhikaṃ vai phaladaṃ brahmadarśanāt ।
tatsmaraṇaṃ cādhikaṃ vai sukhadaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛteḥ ।।92।।
taddāsyaṃ sevanaṃ tasyā ājñāpālanamityapi ।
vedādhyayanataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmalokapradaṃ matam ।।93।।
yayā putryā nijā mātā toṣitā sevanādibhiḥ ।
manasā karmaṇā vācā'nuvṛttyā rañjitā tathā ।।94।।
tasyā nāsti bhayaṃ māyākālakarmayamādijam ।
nā'kasmācca bhayaṃ tasyā rogādijaṃ bhayaṃ na ca ।।।95।।
na tredhātāpabhītiśca na caurādibhayaṃ tathā ।
nāpi vighnabhayaṃ tasyā na pretādibhayaṃ tathā ।।96 ।।
kimatra bahunoktena janmamṛtyubhayaṃ na ca ।
piturdaśaguṇī mātā garbhajanmaprapoṣaṇaiḥ ।।97 ।।
gururmātā harirmātā jananī brahmadhāma ca ।
svargaṃ mātā gṛhaṃ mātā mātā vai śāśvataṃ padam ।। 98।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi bālā vā vṛddhatāṃgatāḥ ।
yuvānaścāpi kaṣṭāptau moṃ moṃ moṃ samvadanti te ।। 99।।
mātṛsnehau brahmasnehastasmānmuktirna vai parā ।
svapne putrīṃ samālokya māturharṣaḥ prajāyate ।। 2.100.1 00।।
adya putrī mayā dṛṣṭetyuktvā nityaṃ smaratyapi ।
mātustu tāriṇī putrī sarvakāryakarī yadi ।। 101 ।।
mātaraṃ cā'sevamānā bhāgyahīnā bhavet sadā ।
māturhṛdayakleśena putryā bhāgyaṃ vinaśyati ।। 1 02।।
gṛhakārye jalasyā'pyānayanaṃ cānnarandhanam ।
niṣkāsanaṃ kaccarādeḥ pātrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ tathā ।। 103।
śayyādīnāmunnayanaṃ vastrāṇāṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā ।
anujānāṃ rañjanaṃ ca gṛhaśuddhyādirakṣaṇam ।। 1 04।।
kaṇādīnāṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ veṣavārādiśodhanam ।
gṛhavastuprarakṣā cocitā sevā kuṭumbinām ।। 1 05।।
devapūjādikaraṇaṃ dadhitakrādimāthanam ।
gopaśvādiprasevā ca māturdehasya mardanam ।। 1 06।।
keśaprasādhanaṃ mātuḥ pādasaṃvāhanādikam ।
evamādikriyākāṇḍaṃ mātṛbrahmaṇi putrikā ।। 1 07।।
kṛtvā kṛtvā'rpayed bhāvayuktā śraddhāvatī sutā ।
sā mātṛvratapuṇyena dharmārthā'naṃgamuktiṣu ।। 108।।
vijayaṃ labhate putrī cābhyudayaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
nārāyaṇīva loke tu jāyate brahmakoṭikā ।। 109।।
kiṃ bahunā'tra vaktavyaṃ mayā mātā niṣevitā ।
sevitaṃ śāśvataṃ brahma tayā prāptaṃ divaṃ bhuvi ।।2.100.1 1 0।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! putrī cakravākī svamātaram ।
uvāca duḥkhahālakṣmīrmāhātmyajñā'tibhāvukī ।। 11 1।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hemāyanarṣaye ।
prāha caitāṃ kathāṃ tatra hemaśālākhyaparvate ।। 112।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cakravākyāstīrthayātrāyāṃ gaṇḍakītīre svamāturlakṣmyā melanaṃ mātṛmahimakathanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 100 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 100 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 101
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 102 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! cakravākī sā punaḥ papraccha mātaram ।
kimarthaṃ hariṇā tyaktā bhavatīti vadā'tra me ।। 1 ।।
iti pṛṣṭā jananī sā lakṣmīruvāca putrikām ।
hemaśālāyanāya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha kathāmṛtam ।। 2 ।।
śṛṇu tvaṃ te kathayāmi bhaktārthaṃ bhagavānapi ।
yathā tyajati lakṣmīṃ ca tatrā'nyasya tu kā kathā ।। 3 ।।
mahāvaikuṇṭhaloke śrīnārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
sevyate satataṃ bhaktyā mahāvaikuṇṭhavāsibhiḥ ।। 4 ।।
yathā lakṣmyā tathā sarvaistato'pyadhikabhāvanaiḥ ।
kṛṣṇānāmnī sakhī lakṣmyā lakṣmyadhikā ca sevane ।। 5 ।।
svagṛhe satataṃ nārāyaṇaṃ rakṣati bhāminī ।
snānaṃ sugandhalepaiśca sā svayaṃ kurute priyā ।। 6 ।।
aṃgānāṃ mardanaiḥ samyak kṣaurakarmādibhiḥ saha ।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādyaiḥ śṛṃgārayati sā sakhī ।। 7 ।।
pūjābhojanapānādyaiḥ śayyopaskaraṇādibhiḥ ।
hasanairhāsyabhedaiśca sevābhedairnirantaram ।। 8 ।।
premabhedaiśca bahubhiḥ sarvārpaṇairdivāniśam ।
kṣaṇaṃ viyuktā naivā''ste svadehamiva kṛṣṇikā ।। 9 ।।
vyavasthāyāṃ sadā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa ceti raṭatyapi ।
tridehaiḥ sevate nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ priyam ।। 2.101.1 0।।
evaṃ tasyā bhrātarau dvī pārṣadau jayacandrakau ।
sarvaṃ vai karmakāṇḍaṃ svaṃ cārpayāmāsaturharau ।। 11 ।।
mahābhāgavattau nityaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇau ।
harau sarvasukhau kṛṣṇaṃ vinā kṣaṇavivarjitau ।। 12।।
tāpasau ca japamālāparāyaṇau haripriyau ।
indriyā'ntaḥkaraṇānāṃ kṛṣṇe vṛttisamanvitau ।। 13।।
navadhā bhaktisampannau dhyānayogaparāyaṇau ।
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvau tau bhajete parameśvaram ।। 14।।
kṛṣṇastatrāpi vasati yatra tadbhrātṛsaṃsthitiḥ ।
sākṣāt kṛṣṇo nivasati kiśorastadgṛhe sadā ।। 15।।
dhenupālo'pi gopeśo gopāla iva sarvadā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāmagno'bhavat pitā tayoḥ ।। 16।।
ātmasamarpaṇaiḥ kṛṣṇamūrtyātmako yathā tathā ।
avartata harau premṇā sarvasevāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 17।।
athaikadā te catvāro lakṣmīnārāyaṇāya vai ।
upadā vividhā dātumāyayurnijamandiram ।। 18।।
adṛśyarūpato nārāyaṇaścāyāti taiḥ saha ।
tadā divye mahāmahāprāsāde cāntaragṛhe ।। 1 9।।
śayane śrīmahālakṣmyā sevitaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
premasevāṃ mahālakṣmyā gṛhṇannāste'titanmayaḥ ।। 2.101.20।।
mahālakṣmīḥ premamagnā nārāyaṇāṃgayoginī ।
parabrahmamahānandavārdhimagnā'bhavat priyā ।।।2 1 ।।
cirasevābhilāṣā sā cirānandecchayā hareḥ ।
biyogecchārahitā śrīharyāśleṣayutā'bhavat ।। 22।।
etasmin samaye te tu catvāro'pi susevikāḥ ।
upadāḥ saṃgṛhītvaiva dvāramāgatya satvaram ।।23।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parameśvarakeśava ।
hṛṣīkeśa hṛdayasya bhaktebhyo dehi darśanam ।।24।।
ityevaṃ cārthanāśabdaṃ cakrurbhaktisamanvitam ।
bhagavāँstaṃ bhaktaśabdaṃ śrutvā śayyāṃ vihāya tu ।।।25।।
utthāya śīghraṃ dvārasthaṃ pālaṃ tvājñāpayad drutam ।
praveśārthaṃ, tataścāpi svāṃ tyaktvā'tisukhaplutām ।।26।।
gataṃ patiṃ na sovāca kiñcid dāsī pativratā ।
sākṣānnārāyaṇānandaviyogārtā'pi sā priyā ।।27।।
pratīkṣate hariṃ śīghraṃ samāyāt keśavaśca mām ।
rāmayeteti cintāḍhyā śayane susthirā'bhavat ।।28।।
tāvad bhaktān samādāya kānto nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
praviveśa gṛhāntaḥsthaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ yutastu taiḥ ।। 29।।
samājuhāva lakṣmīṃ svāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śubhāsane ।
lakṣmīḥ prasannavadanā nārāyaṇābhiśabditā ।।2.101.3 0।।
samāyayau tadā tūrṇaṃ siṃhāsane hariṃ prati ।
sākaṃ śrīhariṇā lakṣmīrupaviṣṭā''sane'bhavat ।।3 1।।
catvāraste'ti sadbhaktyā'rpayāmāsustadā''hṛtāḥ ।
vividhā upadāḥ sarvā bhojyapānāvalehanam ।।32।।
śṛṃgāravastusāmagrīrvastrabhūṣāsumālikāḥ ।
anekahārahārālīḥ sthālīmauktikasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।3 3 ।।
phalapuṣpasugandhāḍhyān padārthān sadrasānvitān ।
lakṣmīśṛṃgārayogyāँśca dadurnārāyaṇāya te ।।34।।
lakṣmyai daduśca te tatra pupūjuścātibhaktitaḥ ।
tasthuḥ stutiṃ pracakruśca dhyānamagnāstadā''bhavan ।।35।।
pūjāṃ kṛtvopadā datvā nottasthuśca yadā ciram ।
lakṣmīḥ roṣaṃ gatā vighnarūpāṇāmupari drutam ।।36।।
aprakāśaṃ ca roṣaṃ sā prakāśayati no bahiḥ ।
naiva vaktuṃ samarthā'pi harericchā vinā tu tān ।। 37।।
notthituṃ ca samarthā'sti nārāyaṇaṃ vihāya tu ।
saroṣā cintayatyeva kadā yāsyanti bhaktakāḥ ।।38।।
punarnārāyaṇaṃ prāpsye kadā tu śayane sukham ।
dhyānamagnāstu te bhaktā dhyāne baddhvā hariṃ puraḥ ।।39।।
niṣedustu ciraṃ tatra tāvadvai śrīsatīharau ।
āyayatuśca kailāsād vīkṣituṃ śrīṃ narāyaṇam ।।2.101.40।।
ekaṃ vighnaṃ gataṃ naiva tāvad dvitīyamāgatam ।
matvaivaṃ śrīḥ kṛṣṇapārśve hyavaśā saṃsthitā sthirā ।।41 ।।
śaṃkaro'pi tathā bhaktottamo bhāgavato mahān ।
satī cāpi mahābhaktā kastāvullaṃghayettadā ।।42।।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ siṃhāsanādutthāya satvaram ।
samāśliṣya ca śaṃbhuṃ taṃ svāgataṃ tvācaraddhariḥ ।।।43।।
satyāścāpi svāgataṃ tu lakṣmīrācaradādarāt ।
satīśaṃbhū pūjanādi cakratuḥ śrīharestadā ।।44।।
satīdattāsane ramye niṣasāda śriyāḥ puraḥ ।
śaṃbhurbhāgavato bhakto nṛtyaṃ cakāra naikadhā ।।45।।
ciraṃ nanarta premṇaiva śrīhareḥ sannidhau haraḥ ।
haristatrā''kṛṣṭacitto'bhavannā'nyadavediṣat ।।46।।
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇasparśānandapratīkṣayā''kulā ।
nṛtyāntaṃ nirjanabhāvaṃ drutaṃ samabhivāñchati ।।47।।
bhaktavaśyo harirnaiva lakṣmīṃ smarati paśyati ।
bhaktalagnamanā bhaktān gantuṃ bahirna śāsti ca ।।48।।
tadā dhairyaṃ parityajya vṛthāsamayahārakān ।
śaṃkaraṃ ca satīṃ dhenupālaṃ jayaṃ ca candrakam ।।49।।
kṛṣṇāṃ sakhīṃ śaśāpaiva bhavantu mānavā iti ।
yatra vighnaphalaṃ vaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।2.101.50।।
akālatāṇḍave magnā akāladhyānayoginaḥ ।
kālāpekṣāṃ vihāyaiva yato me vighnakāriṇaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
savighnā mānave loke bhavantu dehadhāriṇaḥ ।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ cāpi gṛhītvā ca kare muhuḥ ।।52।।
āhā''yātu gṛhe kṛṣṇa viśrāmaṃ kuru vai kṣaṇam ।
īdṛśo bhaktavrātāste nātha katipayā iha ।।53।।
vartante tu vinā kālam āyānti snehilā muhuḥ ।
premalā bhaktakāste vai jānantyeva na mānasam ।।54।।
samāgaccha hare cā'ntaḥśayane śāntimāvaha ।
cirāsanasthitasyā'tra śramaste vipulo bhavet ।।55।।
ityevamāgrahaṃ cakre netuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramā ।
śaṃkarādyāstu te bhaktāḥ śrutvā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ।।56।।
lakṣmyāḥ śāpena namrāsyā nistejaskā ivā'bhavan ।
natvā nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ kliṣṭāṃ jñātvā tu satvaram ।।57।।
niryayustvālayācchīghraṃ śrīharerantikāttataḥ ।
nipeturmānave loke paśyatāṃ dvārarakṣiṇām ।।58।।
vaikuṇṭhavāsināṃ tatra hāhākāro mahānabhūt ।
sarvatra prāsaradvārtā vaikuṇṭhe ca pratisthalam ।।59।।
lakṣmyāḥ śāpena kṛṣṇadyāścatvāraśca satīharau ।
nipeturmānave loke hyakālajñā jaḍā yathā ।।2.101.60।।
tasmāt tejasvināṃ neyaḥ kṣaṇo vṛthā na vai kvacit ।
akāle naiva gantavyaṃ mahatāṃ sannidhau kvacit ।।61।।
vidhnaṃ naivā'pi kartavyaṃ dampatyoścaikale sthale ।
sukhahā duḥkhabhoktā syānmahān vā'pīśvaro'thavā ।।62।।
vighnakṛd vighnamṛcchedvai dampatīvidhnakṛt kila ।
hāhākāro'bhavaccaiśalokeṣu mānaveṣvapi ।।63।।
śaṃkaro śivarājetināmnā rājā'bhavacchubhaḥ ।
kailāsadhāmanagare himādrau gaṇḍakītaṭe ।।64।।
kṛṣṇasiṃhagṛhe putro mānaso devayonivat ।
mahādivyo mahaiśvaryayuto'rjunaprabhaḥ prabhuḥ ।।65।।
satī ca mānavī jātā ṣaṇmāṇḍavyapureśituḥ ।
putrī sā jānakī devī nāmnā guṇaiḥ śivāsamā ।।66।।
jātismarau satīśambhū vivardhāte tu devavat ।
vāgarthāviva saṃpṛktau vivāhavidhinā punaḥ ।।67।।
suyogyasamaye saṃyojitau kailāsavāsinau ।
evaṃ tau gaṇḍakīmūle himaśaile nadītaṭe ।।68।।
svarājye kailāsadhāmni nagare rājyamāpnutaḥ ।
athakṛṣṇā sakhī dhenupālaścandro jayastathā ।।69।।
nipeturhimaśaile te kailāsadhāmapattane ।
dhenupālo'bhavad bhrātā śivarājasya cā'nujaḥ ।।2.101.70 ।।
kṛṣṇā'bhavat sutā tasya śivarājasya sadguṇā ।
candrādityo'nujastasyā'nujo jayakumārakaḥ ।।71 ।।
kuṭumbaṃ tvekamevā'bhūt samaśāpaprasaṃgataḥ ।
sarve bhaktā brahmaniṣṭhāḥ sadā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।।72।।
dhyānayogataponiṣṭhā dharmajñānavirāgiṇaḥ ।
satataṃ brahmayajñāśca brahmabhāvā amāyinaḥ ।।73।।
sarvacihnaiḥ samāyuktā mānavairaviniścitāḥ ।
prajāpālanadharmāśca mahābhāgavatāḥ sadā ।।74।।
satataṃ kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ vaikuṇṭhe iva tatparāḥ ।
nīpālayapradeśeṣu himaśaileṣu gocarāḥ ।।75।।
vartante divyarūpaiśca nisargayogasiddhibhiḥ ।
vartante mānavai rūpaiḥ śāpaprāptakriyādibhiḥ ।।76।।
śāpād yadā nipetuste tadā taddhṛdaye hariḥ ।
duḥkhyabhūd bhaktaduḥkhena tathāpi śrīṃ prati prabhuḥ ।।77।।
vaktuṃ śaśāka naivā'nyat sattvasaṃjño yato hariḥ ।
sarvaṃ sehe bhaktaduḥkhaṃ maunaṃ jagrāha vai kṣaṇam ।।78।।
śaṃkarādyāḥ samarthāśca śaptuṃ lakṣmīṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।
tathāpi dāsabhaktāste na śepustāṃ ramāṃ tadā ।।79 ।।
mātā yā jagatāmasti sā harisparśamantarā ।
vighnarūpān śaśāpā'smān yogyaṃ tanmenire'nugāḥ ।।2.101.80।।
evaṃ matvā harericchāmiṣṭadevena niścitām ।
jagṛhuḥ sukhadāṃ matvā daṇḍarūpāmapi prabhoḥ ।।81 ।।
viśvāsaḥ śrīharau teṣāṃ varadānaṃ harervacaḥ ।
nyāso harau ca kārpaṇyaṃ nārāyaṇe pareśvare ।।82।।
sati vaibhavayoge'pyaiśvaryayoge'pi sarvathā ।
kaiṃkaryaṃ tasya vai teṣāmāsīd divāniśaṃ harau ।।ṭa3।।
matiḥ sthirā mahāpatsu bhaktānāmeva vartate ।
teṣāṃ caiṣā matiḥ susthā'bhavacchrīparamātmani ।।84।।
sarvanāśe'pi bhagavān mā dūraṃ yātu mānasāt ।
ānukūlyaṃ hareryattu tadānukūlyameva tu ।।85।।
prātikūlyaṃ hareryattu tatprātikūlyameva tu ।
dāsadharmaḥ prapannānāmayaṃ yato'nyathā na vai ।।86।।
iti matvā ca śaṃbhvādyā asahanta śriyā vacaḥ ।
satī yā vaiṣṇavī bhaktā rudrāṇī pralayaṃkarī ।।87।।
kathaṃ saheta śāpaṃ sā yadi bhaktā na vai haraiḥ ।
jānāti mātaraṃ lakṣmīṃ yato guroḥ priyā hi sā ।।88।।
gurupatnīṃ suvandeta na roṣayet kadācana ।
guroḥ patnī yadājñāṃ ca karoti tvavicāritām ।।89।।
sāpi pālyā yathāśakti nakāro vācya eva na ।
atra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhagavān svāmivallabhaḥ ।।2.101.90।।
guruḥ śrīvedavaktā'sti nāvamānyā hi tatpriyā ।
satī jānāti sarvaṃ ca ratibhaṃgasamutthitam ।।9 1 ।।
duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ pratikalpe tasmācchāpaṃ dadau na sā ।
evaṃ vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'pi cārtihā ।।92।।
hemaśālāyananāmne jagāda śāpakāraṇam ।
prāha lakṣmīścakravākyai vṛttaṃ kauṭumbikaṃ nijam ।।93 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāvaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīśayanasthite bhagavati sati samāgatakṛṣṇādhenupālacandrādityajayādityādisevakānāṃ satīśaṃkarayo-
ścāgame lakṣmyā nārāyaṇena saha śayanasukhabhaṃge lakṣmyāḥ śāpena teṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ mānavaloke'vataraṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 101 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 101 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 102
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 103 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike yacca vaikuṇṭhe śapanottaram ।
yadabhūt kamalākṛṣṇamadhye tu kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hemāyanarṣaye ।
yajjagāda tathā kanyā cakravākyai jagāda yat ।। 2 ।।
tatsarvaṃ te kathayāmi nibodhekāgramānasā ।
śāpaṃ śrutvā harirnārāyaṇakṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
bhaktaduḥkhena duḥkhātmā hyanuktvā kamalāṃ tadā ।
svayaṃ tvacintayat kṛṣṇo nyāyayuktaṃ śubhāspadam ।। 4 ।।
aho vyaktestu vaicitryaṃ vilakṣaṇapadaṃ gatam ।
sarvadā toṣayāmyenāṃ lakṣmīṃ hṛdayavāsinīm ।। 5 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ dūraṃ karomyeva nahi kvacittathāpi sā ।
atṛptā me mahānandādadhīreva prabhāṣate ।। 6 ।।
madbhaktānāṃ kṛte cāpi sahate na kṣaṇaṃ satī ।
madviyogaṃ na sahate sahate na cirāyanam ।। 7 ।।
sadā saukhyaṃ dadāmyeva yathā''tmane tathā śriyai ।
yathā śriyā viyogo me neṣṭastathā na sevinām ।। 8 ।।
nārīṇāṃ tu svabhāvo'yaṃ svārthaścennahi pūryate ।
kṣaṇe paravaj jāyeta phalaṃ duṣṭaṃ prayacchati ।। 9 ।।
yadyapi naiva lakṣmīstu bhaktā tyājyā kadācana ।
bhaktottamā'tibhaktā me patnī priyā sakhī svayam ।। 2.102.10 ।।
śaṃkaro'pi yathā bhakto bhaktā satī ca kṛṣṇikā ।
jayaścandro dhenupālastato bhaktottamā ramā ।। 11 ।।
tathāpi bhaktavaryeṣu snehadarśanahetave ।
bhaktāḥ snigdhā mama lakṣmyapekṣayā nitarāṃ sadā ।। 12।।
bhaktaduḥkhapradā cet syāllakṣmīryadyapi me priyā ।
bhaktārthaṃ santyajāmyenāṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ kamalā svayam ।। 1 3 ।।
bhavedatra vidhāne tu tathā kurve nidarśanam ।
śāpaphalaṃ me lakṣmyā śca prāptaṃ bhavennidarśane ।। 14।।
śikṣā'pi ca yathārthā syāt punarnaivaṃ caret kvacit। ।
ityevaṃ saṃvicāryaiva bhagavān śokamāvahan ।। 15।।
bhaktaduḥkhena duḥkhātmā na vakti śrī na paśyati ।
nirmanaska iva jāto nāpi hasati vai manāk ।। 16।।।
nordhvaṃ paśyati manasā mahodvigno vibhāsate ।
yathā vai mātṛmaraṇe yathā patnīvināśane ।। 17।।
yathaikaputranāśe vā śokastathā vibhāvyate ।
yathā kṣaṇāntare gehaṃ tyaktvā yāsyati vā kvacit ।। 18।।
yathā sarvasvanāśe vā bhagnamānasavān bhavet ।
tathā vairāgyamāpanno nārāyaṇo vilokyate ।। 1 9।।
yathā jitendrayagrāmo jitāntaḥkaraṇādikaḥ ।
māyāpārasthitiścāste tathā nārāyaṇo'bhavat ।।2.102.20।।
lakṣmīrvihasya bahudhā hāvabhāvaiḥ samāyutā ।
hastaṃ haste gṛhītvā'ti kṛtvā pracumbanaṃ muhuḥ ।।।2 1 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ samākṛṣya gṛhāntare ninīṣati ।
nārāyaṇastu śavavat tathā prastaravattadā ।।।22।।
jaḍavad bhaktaśokena sañjātaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
yadgṛhe nijabhaktānāmāśrayaḥ sukhado'sti vai ।।23 ।।
tadgṛhe yadi bhaktānāṃ śāpaduḥkhaṃ prajāyate ।
tatra kiṃ me nivāsena vicāryetthaṃ jagāda tām ।।24।।
mā māṃ spṛśā'tra vāmoru mā khedaṃ kāraya vṛthā ।
yadgṛhe mama bhaktānā śāpastatra na me spṛhā ।।25 ।।
yāhi tvaṃ śayane sādhvi na me śayyā sukhāvahā ।
mahābhāgavatāḥ śaptāścāto duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।26 ।।
prāghūṇikāḥ sadā mānyāstatrāpi nijabhaktayaḥ ।
madarthekṛtasarvasvāḥ pūjyā mānyāḥ sadā mama ।।27।।
madbhaktārtha sadā lakṣmi! mālāmāvartayāmyaham ।
madbhaktārthaṃ ca lokeṣu sarvadā'vatarāmyaham ।।28।।
naranārāyaṇaścā'smi tāpaso bhaktahetave ।
kṣīrode śvetabhūmau cā'kṣarakṣetre narāyaṇaḥ ।।29 ।।
goloke cāpi vaikuṇṭhe'vyākṛte'mṛtadhāmani ।
yatra vasanti me bhaktāstatra tiṣṭhāmi padmaje ।।2.102.30।।
ahaṃ bhaktagṛhāvāso bhaktaiḥ saha vihāravān ।
bhaktālayo me vaikuṇṭho nānyadvai ruciraṃ mama ।।3 1।।
me bhaktānāṃ duḥkhaprāptau nimittaṃ madgṛhaṃ yadi ।
tadā vaikuṇṭhanāmā'sya yathārthatāṃ prahanti vai ।।32।।
yadvai śāśvatasukhadaṃ dhāma me khyātamaiśvaram ।
tad yadi duḥkhadaṃ janmapradaṃ cet kā vikuṇṭhatā ।।33।।
tatrāpi devadevasya śaṃkarasya priyasya me ।
satyāśca mama bhaktāyāḥ śāpo mānavajanmadaḥ ।।34।।
kimataḥ paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ duṣkīrtipradamulbaṇam ।
kṛṣṇāyāstava sakhyāśca jayacandrakayorapi ।।35।।
dhenupālasya ca tathā pārṣadasya nipātanam ।
kathaṃ te cedṛśī buddhirakāṇḍatāṇḍavī priye ।।36।।
aprayojyaṃ proktavatī bhaktabhaktivirodhinī ।
kadāpi na tvayā tvevaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tu śaṃkare ।।37।।
mayā kimatra kartavyaṃ virodhistrīyute gṛhe ।
bhojanaṃ miṣṭamṛṣṭādi bhaktaṃ vinā viṣāyate ।।38।।
peyaṃ śītasugandhāḍhyaṃ bhaktaṃ vinā'nalāyate ।
vastraṃ saumyaṃ ca kauśeyaṃ vinā bhaktaṃ śarāyate ।।39।।
bhūṣaṇaṃ svarṇaratnādi vinā bhaktaṃ jhaṣāyate ।
sugandhatailavāsādi na bhakte kardamāyate ।।2.102.40।।
sarvaṃ jvālāyate saukhyaṃ me hṛdi bhaktamantarā ।
lakṣmi śaṃbhuṃ vinā cāhaṃ dahyāmi śāpavaibhavāt । ।41 ।।
bhaktaśāpaḥ sa me śāpo macchāpastattavāpi ca ।
aṃśā'rdhāṃgasvabhāvatvād duḥkhado nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।।42।।
tvaṃ na jānāsi māhātmyaṃ madbhaktānāṃ mahattamam ।
sanatkumāro jānāti bhaktamāhātmyamucchritam ।।43।।
yadi netre na paśyetāṃ madbhaktān māmupasthitān ।
niṣkāsya golakābhyāṃ te dūrīkaromi sarvadā ।।44।।
yadi me mastakaṃ naiva namate bhaktayogine ।
galāt saṃchidya dūraṃ tannikṣipāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।45।।
yadi karṇau śṛṇuyātāṃ naiva bhaktavacāṃsi me ।
tau mūlāt saṃchidya dūre nikṣipāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।46।।
yadi nāsā bhaktagandhaṃ naiva gṛhṇāti me tadā ।
sañchidya mūlato nāsāṃ dūraṃ kṣipāmi padmaje ।।47।।
yadi jihvā bhaktagāthāṃ naiva gāyati sarvadā ।
yadi vā rasanā bhaktārpitaṃ rasaṃ na ṛcchati ।।48।।
tadā mūlād viniṣkāsya jihvāṃ tyajāmi nityadā ।
yadi cauṣṭhau bhaktadattaṃ tāmbūlādi na ṛcchataḥ ।।49।।
yadi dantā na bhaktairyaccarvayanti samarpitam ।
tadauṣṭhadantakān śastraiśchedayitvā tyajāmi vai ।।2.102.50।।
yadi hastau svabhaktānāṃ sevāyāṃ nopayoginau ।
chindyāmāmūlatastau saṃtyajeyaṃ kāṣṭhavattu tau ।।51 ।।
vakṣo yadi na bhaktānāmāśleṣe copayogavat ।
tadā vakṣaḥ samutpāṭya tyajāmi gartake sadā ।।52।।
yadi me hṛdaye bhaktā vaseyurna kadācana ।
hṛdayaṃ raktasahitaṃ niṣkāsya saṃkṣipāmi hi ।।53।।
yadyudaraṃ me pacanaṃ bhaktārpitasya neṣyate ।
vibhidya sarvaṃ tvaritaṃ tyajāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।54।।
yadi tvaṅ mama bhaktānāṃ sparśaṃ saṃrocate na vai ।
utpāṭya varṣmaṇastūrṇa nikṣipāmi mahānale ।।55।।
yadi vīryaṃ balaṃ liṅgaṃ bhaktānāṃ sukhakṛnna me ।
tadā vināśya tatsarvaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ prakaromi me ।।।56।।
yadi corū prabhaktānāmupaveśārthameva na ।
tadā tyaktvā kabandho vai bhavāmi bhaktakāraṇāt ।।57।।
yadi pādau mama bhaktān prati yāto na vai tadā ।
kuṭhāreṇa vinicchidya pādahīno bhavāmi vai ।।58।।
deho me yadi bhaktānāṃ saukhyārthaṃ na prajāyate ।
tathā prodbhāvya vahniṃ ca karomi bhasmasānnanu ।।59।।
guṇā buddhyādayaścāpi yadi bhaktā''śritā na me ।
guṇāँstyaktvā nirguṇaśca vasāmi gahane vane ।।2.102.60 ।।
vahunoktenā'tra kiṃ te tvaṃ yadi bhaktarodhinī ।
bhaktakleśakarī bhaktivighnakarī pravartase ।।6 1 ।।
bhaktaduḥkhakarī vāpi bhaktaśāntivirodhinī ।
tvāṃ tyajāmi rame tarhi kimanyanna tyajāmi vai ।।62।।
sarvaṃ tyajāmi sarvasvaṃ bhaktārthaṃ nātra me spṛhā ।
bhaktanāśe vinaṣṭaṃ me sarvamavehi padmaje ।।63।।
bhakte tu rakṣite sarvaṃ rakṣitaṃ mama viddhi tu ।
aho śrīśaṃkaraḥ kutra mānavo vai bhaviṣyati ।।64।।
aho satī priyā tasya mānavī kva bhaviṣyati ।
aho kṛṣṇā priyā dāsī bhaktā vā kva janiṣyati ।।65।।
aho vai dhenupālo'pi jayaścandrastathā rame ।
tava śāpena bhūmau te bhaviṣyantyasukhasthale ।।66 ।।
yāvajjānāmi naiteṣāṃ sthitiṃ janmavatāṃ rame ।
tāvat sukhaṃ na me cāsti gacchāmi yatra te'pyaham ।।67।।
ityuktvā kamalāṃ tyaktvā tyaktvā śrīkamalākaram ।
tyaktvā siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ prāsādaṃ dhāma cojjvalam ।।68।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ sarvathā tyaktvā tyaktvā snehapadaṃ hariḥ ।
niryayau vimanā bhūtvā tyaktvā garuḍamityapi ।।69।।
paścādanavalokyaiva brahmāṇḍe bhūtalaṃ yayau ।
rorūyamāṇāṃ nā'paśyat lakṣmīṃ prāṇātivallabhām ।।2.102.70।।
nātha nātha vyāharantīṃ śrīharirbhūtalaṃ yayau ।
adṛśyo'vyaktadehaśca maṇijanye'tra bhūtale ।।7 1 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre'kṣarakṣetre hyavātarat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।72।।
parabrahmā''kṣarā'tīto'vatārāṇāṃ niyāmakaḥ ।
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye kaṃbharāśrīgṛhe tadā ।।73।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya gṛhe divyarddhisaṃyute ।
nārāyaṇā''gamanasya nimittenā'pyavātarat ।।74।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīpuruṣottame ।
āgatya līnatāṃ prāpya tasthau cā'śvasaro'ntike ।।75।।
tato'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā''deśato bhuvi ।
yathāvajñātarūpo'sau gaveṣaṇārthamuttare ।।76।।
himālayāśraye deśe nīpālayapradeśake ।
kailāsadhāmarājye ca śivarājaṃ kumārakam ।।77।।
anveṣya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktaṃ tatra tasthāvagocaraḥ ।
tataḥ satīṃ mārgayituṃ ṣaṇmāṇḍavyapurīṃ yayau ।।78।।
tatra kanyā jānakīti nāmnā satī ca sā'bhavat ।
tatrāpi vartate nārāyaṇo'dṛśyo'nugapriyaḥ ।।79।।
tayorvivāhato jātā kṛṣṇā jayaśca candrakaḥ ।
dhenupālaḥ śivarājabhrātā ca tatra saṃsthitaḥ ।।2.102.80 ।।
nārāyaṇaśca tadbhaktaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvasati prabhuḥ ।
aprakāśaḥ saha bhuṃkte ramate vartate'niśam ।।8 1 ।।
kvacidāyātyakṣaraṃ ca kṣetraṃ tvaśvasarovaram ।
kvacittatra śivarājagṛhe tiṣṭhati bhaktitaḥ ।।82।।
ityevaṃ bhagavān lakṣmīṃ tyaktvā bhaktārthameva tu ।
samāyayau ca brahmāṇḍe bhaktamadhye nivāsakṛt ।।83।।
atha vaikuṇṭhagā lakṣmīrjñātvā svāṃ pravihāya tu ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāsanaṃ dhāmālayaṃ tyaktvā narāyaṇaḥ ।।84।।
jagāma cirayātrārthaṃ bhaktārthaṃ mānave bhave ।
śuśoca bahudhā tatra ruroda śūnyavadgṛhe ।।85।।
tuṣṭāva bahudhā vāṇyā doṣānnijān jagāda ca ।
ahaṃ vai cañcalā lakṣmīrduḥkhadoṣānukāriṇī ।।86।।
garvādīnāṃ sadā heturdīnānāmasahāyinī ।
pāpā'nyāpakṛtāṃ gehe vāso me bahudhā mataḥ ।।87।।
hiṃsā'nṛtādidoṣāṇāṃ gṛhaṃ cādharmapuṣṭidā।
māyākāpaṭyabhogādisthānaṃ pūjyāvamānanam ।।88।।
śīlahāniḥ śuddhihānistṛṣṇā rāgo'tigṛdhnatā ।
cauryaṃ prasahyatā cādhikṣepo doṣā madāśrayāḥ ।।89।।
cañcalā na sthirā kvāpi vaimanasyavidhāyinī ।
sarvaharatagatā cā'smi tathāpi karuṇālayaḥ ।।2.102.90 ।।
bhagavān māṃ svahṛdaye rakṣatyatikṛpāvaśaḥ ।
na māṃ niṣkāsya bhuṃkte'pi svayaṃ bhogān dayāparaḥ ।।9 1।।
sarvaṃ datvā tu me kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ gehādvinirgataḥ ।
kīdṛśaṃ cāsya sāralyaṃ na me duḥkhaṃ prayacchati ।।92।।
na māṃ tiraskarotyalpaṃ sahate'vinayaṃ mama ।
aśuddhāṃ māṃ sadā bhaktāṃ bhaktyadhīnaḥ prarakṣati ।।93 ।।
pātivratyaṃ na me samyak tathāpi bhagavān svayam ।
patnīvrataparo bhūtvā'vatyadhikaṃ nijādapi ।।94।।
māṃ vihāya na bhukte'sau na vai pibati vāryapi ।
māṃ vinā yatra pakvānnaṃ kṛtaṃ tvanyena tat khalu ।।95।।
naiva paśyati gṛhṇāti naiva naivā'tti keśavaḥ ।
pācakeṣu praveśo me yadā syāccettadā hariḥ ।।96।।
bhuṃkte naivedyamāptānnaṃ nānyathā vai kvaciddhariḥ ।
vastraṃ ratnaṃ jalaṃ pātraṃ tāmbūlamannamañjanam ।।97।।
bhūṣaṇaṃ candanaṃ svarṇe yānaṃ vāhanamīśatā ।
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ vastu copadāḥ phalamarpaṇam ।।98।।
sarva māmasamarpyā'yaṃ me nātho bhukta eva na ।
aho vicārataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ patnīvratasthitaḥ ।।99।।
cañcalā'pi snehapātraṃ nedṛśyahaṃ pativratā ।
aho me sarvasaubhāgyaṃ vinā kāntaṃ hi niṣphalam ।। 2.102.10 0।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ sampadaḥ sarvā bhogyajātaṃ ca niṣphalam ।
dāsā dāsyo vāṭikāśca vimānodyānabhūmayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
saudhaprāsādakalaśā gajā'śvarathadhenavaḥ ।
bhūṣāmbarā'mṛtapānaṃ kāntaṃ vinā hi niṣphalam ।। 10।
gṛhātkānto viniryāto mamaiva doṣakāraṇāt ।
aho mṛtā kathaṃ nā'haṃ kathaṃ śavo bhavāmi na ।। 10 3।।
kāntaṃ vinā śa vaścā'smi jīvanaṃ niṣphalaṃ yataḥ ।
ityevaṃ vilalāpeyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho! ।। 1 04।।
nātha śmaśānasadṛśaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvāṃ vinā mama ।
ityuktvā nipapāteyaṃ siṃhāsanasamīpataḥ ।। 1 09।।
mūrchāṃ kṣaṇaṃ samāsādya punarutthāya vegataḥ ।
kānta kānteti cākrośaṃ kurvāṇā dvāramāgatā ।। 1 06।।
mūrchayā'ṅganabhāge sā punaḥ papāta nirbalā ।
tāvat sakhyaḥ samāyātāḥ kimidaṃ kimidaṃ bruvāḥ ।। 1 07।।
tarkayantyo'pyaniṣṭaṃ ca tacchokenā'tiśokitāḥ ।
duḥkhitāḥ pavanādyaiśca jalasecanakaistathā ।। 1 08।।
puṣpārpaṇādibhiścāpi mūrchāmapānudaṃstu tāḥ ।
papracchuḥ kimakāle te duḥkhametadupasthitam ।। 109।।
prāha lakṣmīrhariḥ kvāpi vaikuṇṭhānniryayau ciram ।
māṃ vihāya ca sarvāśca bhaktā bhaktān narāyaṇaḥ ।। 2.102.11 0।।
śrutvaivaṃ vajrapātābhaṃ vaco lakṣmyāstu tā api ।
mūrchāmavāpuratyugrāṃ śrutvā'niṣṭaṃ ca rādhike ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīlakṣmyāḥ śaṃbhvādau śāpottaraṃ śrīnārāyaṇasya kamalāṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhānnirgama ityādinirūpaṇanāmā
dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 102 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 102 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 103
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 104 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hemāyanarṣaye ।
tathā kanyā cakravākyai vṛttāntamāha rādhike ।। 1 ।।
lakṣmīstayā ca sakhyaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ sarvameva ca ।
saśokaṃ vai kṣaṇājjātaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇavivarjitam ।। 2 ।।
mūrchitāśca tadā sarvā vaikuṇṭhavāsiyoṣitaḥ ।
mūrchāmapānudaँstāsāṃ vāyucandanavāribhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
atha lakṣmīrvimūrchā ca saṃbabhūva kṣaṇāntare ।
viyogaṃ śrīhareḥ smṛtvā ruroda bahudhā punaḥ ।। 4 ।।
na bhokṣye naiva pāsye ca mariṣye taṃ hariṃ vinā ।
nārīdehena bhagavatprāptistu durlabhā sadā ।। 5 ।।
sā samprāptiḥ śāśvatī vai mayā labdhā hareḥ kila ।
yadyahaṃ na hariṃ lapsye kariṣye dehanāśanam ।। 6 ।।
saṃkariṣye tapo ghoraṃ gamiṣye bhūtalaṃ prati ।
yatra nāthaḥ kṣitāvāste tatra me maraṇaṃ varam ।। 7 ।।
mānasaṃ karapādādi tyakṣye kṛṣṇavirodhi yat ।
nāthanātha harekṛṣṇakānta nārāyaṇaprabho ।। 8 ।।
tyaktvā māṃ dāsikāṃ duṣṭāṃ kva yāto vada me drutam ।
tvāṃ vinā śravaṇaṃ me'tra karṇaśūlāyate hare ।। 9 ।।
tvāṃ vinā darśanaṃ me'tra vahnijvālāyate hare ।
tvāṃ vinā kīrtanaṃ me'tra viṣadagdhāyate prabho ।। 2.103.10।।
tvāṃ vinā sparśanaṃ me'tra ghrāṇavraṇāyate prabho ।
tvāṃ vinā rasanaṃ sarvaṃ mama vāntāyante hare ।। 11 ।।
tvā vinā gandhagrahaṇaṃ nāsikā vṛścikāyate ।
tvāṃ vinā bhojanaṃ pānaṃ galabandhāyate vibho ।। 12।।
tvāṃ vinā cāsanaṃ ramyaṃ yānaṃ bhallāyate prabho ।
tvāṃ vinā puṣpamālādi kṣveḍakuntāyate hare ।। 1 3।।
śṛṃgārastvāṃ vinā viṣṇo sarvo me rākṣasāyate ।
hariṃ vinā me vaikuṇṭhaṃ riktagartāyate prabho ।। 14।।
samayo me kṣaṇarūpastvāṃ vinā tu yugāyate ।
śītavāto vinā kṛṣṇaṃ sūryātapaviṣāyate ।। 19।।
jalaṃ sthalaṃ gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyāyate vinā prabhum ।
vastraṃ vyāghrāyate ramyaṃ bhūṣā siṃhāyate tathā ।। 16।।
saubhāgyaṃ keśakabarī sarva me vidhavāyate ।
bhuktaṃ sukhaṃ mamedānīṃ vinā tvāṃ khasumāyate ।। 17।।
dehadravyādikaṃ sarvaṃ tvāṃ vinā nidhanāyate ।
astitvaṃ cāpi te patnyā vinā tvāṃ nāstikāyate ।। 18।।
kimvatra bahunoktena tvāṃ vinā śrīnarāyaṇa ।
sthāsye naikākinī kvāpi patiṣye tvāmanu kṣitau ।। 1 9।।
he svāmikṛṣṇagovinda nārāyaṇanarottama ।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhamūrte rakṣa māṃ svāntike pate ।।2.103.20।।
jīvanaṃ me gataḥ kvā''sse kva te bhaktā harādayaḥ ।
yatra te tatra te bhāryā lakṣmīriyaṃ gamiṣyati ।।21 ।।
sarvagasya gamanaṃ te na jāne kutra vartitam ।
eṣā'haṃ sampatāmyadya tava pṛṣṭhe janārdana ।।22।।
tava bhaktāṃ patamānāṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru ।
ityuktyā vaikuṇṭhāllakṣmīḥ papāta śirasā hyadhaḥ ।।23।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīd vaikuṇṭhe sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ।
lakṣmīrvai sarvalokebhyaḥ papāta pralaye yathā ।।24।।
brahmādyāḥ satvaraṃ satye patamānāṃ śriyaṃ surāḥ ।
dadhruḥ komalapuṣpāṇāmulloce na ca satvaram ।।25।।
pātapīḍā na vai jātā tathā jagṛhurīśvarāḥ ।
lakṣmyāścā'nunipetuśca dāsyo dāsāśca lakṣaśaḥ ।।26।।
satyaloke surādyaiste vitāne saṃdhṛtāstu khe ।
satkṛtāste sāntvayitāḥ pūjitāḥ sarvavastubhiḥ ।।27।।
bhojitāḥ pāyitāścāpyāsaneṣvapi niṣāditāḥ ।
māyāvāyuhatāḥ sarve'bhavan vai mohamiśritāḥ ।।28।।
visasmaruśca duḥkhaṃ tannārāyaṇaviyogajam ।
sāvitryā pūjitāḥ sakhyaḥ sakhāyo brahmaṇā'rcitāḥ ।।29।।
viśrāntyanantaraṃ pṛṣṭāḥ kimarthaṃ patanaṃ tviti ।
tadā lakṣmīḥ punaḥ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaviyojanam ।।2.103.30 ।।
rurude ca kṣaṇaṃ jijñāsayāmāsa narāyaṇam ।
kva sthitaṃ vartamānaṃ ca kathaṃ yogo bhavediti ।। 31 ।।
brahmā prāha svayaṃ nārāyaṇaścā'śvasarovare ।
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre cā'dya hi vartate ।।32।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīpuruṣottame ।
antarbhāvya nijaṃ rūpaṃ tadabhinno virājate ।।33।।
atha nārāyaṇo nityaṃ tava svāmī ca vallabhaḥ ।
deśe nīpālaye yāti bhaktārthaṃ mādhavo rame! ।।34।।
gaṇḍakyāścodbhavadeśe kailāsadhāmanāmake ।
nagare nṛparūpo yaḥ śaṃkarāṃśo virājate ।। 35।।
patnī tasya satī nāmnā jānakīti sadāśivā ।
tava śāpena sadyojā mānavī vartate'dhunā ।।36।।
jānakyāḥ sa patiḥ śaṃbhuḥ śivarājābhidhānakaḥ ।
tasya putrī tava sakhī kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇakumārikā ।।37।।
sadyo jātā tava śāpād vartate tasya putrikā ।
jayādityastathā candrādityaśceti ca putrakau ।।38।।
dhenupālo mahāvīraḥ śivarājā'nujastathā ।
vartate kailāsadhāmni mahābhāgavataḥ sakhā ।।39।।
śivarājasya patnī yā ṣaṇmāṇḍavyapureśituḥ ।
putrī sā jānakī devī bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam ।।2.103.40।।
evamete mānavā vai tava śāpena padmaje ।
sañjātāḥ santi gaṇḍakyāstīre śailabhuvastale ।।41।।
yatra te'sti matirgantuṃ yāhi tatra hariṃ smara ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre yadvā śrīgaṇḍakītaṭe ।।42।।
miliṣyati patiḥ kāntastava nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
ityevaṃ brahmaṇā proktā mumoda kamalā tadā ।।73 ।।
drāgevā'syā asphuraँśca vāmāṅgāni muhurmuhuḥ ।
dāsīdāsasahasrāṇāṃ śakunāni śubhānyapi ।।44।।
abhavaँścā'cyutaprāptiśaṃsakāni muhurmuhuḥ ।
evaṃ vai brahmaṇā proktā lakṣmīrdāsāśca dāsikāḥ ।।45।।
namaskṛtya tu sāvitrīṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।
prāpya pūjāṃ niryayuścāyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpikām ।।46।।
avateruścāmbarātte cā'śvapaṭṭasaro'ntike ।
vilokya sadhvajasvarṇaghaṭaṃ prāsādamuttamam ।।47।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanamācaran ।
parabrahmā'kṣarātītānādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।48।।
vijñāya sarvavṛttāntaṃ cakre svāgatamādaram ।
nyūṣuḥ sammānitāḥ śrīmadvaikuṇṭhanāthalabdhaye ।।49।।
kintu caturbhujo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānna dṛśyate ।
svayaṃ lakṣmīrmahālakṣmyā śrīmatkaṃbharayā śriyā ।।2.103.50।।
sevyate pālyate nityaṃ prasannīkriyate tathā ।
svavat sarvāśca taddāsyaḥ pātyante cāti bhāvataḥ ।।5 1।।
dāsā vaikuṇṭhavāsāśca rakṣyante janakena ca ।
evaṃ tatra sthitāḥ sarve kintu caturbhujaḥ svayam ।।52।।।
nā''yātyeṣāṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ tadā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
prārthayāñcakruratyarthaṃ darśanārthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।।53।।
tapaścaryāṃ cakrurete sambhūya pavanāśinaḥ ।
viṣṇuyāgaṃ tathā cakurmāsadvayaṃ taduttaram ।।54।।
nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno'bhūduvāca tān ramāyutān ।
prasannavadanaścaturbhujo vaikuṇṭhavāsakṛt ।।55।।
yūyaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsā me bhaktā yāta hi gaṇḍakīm ।
nīpālayapradeśe ca vihāre kosale tathā ।।56।।
śivarājagṛhe nityaṃ yāmi sevāvaśaṃgataḥ ।
yatra kṛṣṇā jayaścandro vidyante bālakā iti ।।57।।
dakṣaputrī satī yatra jānakī śivabhāminī ।
dhenupālo'nujastasya vartate tatra mānavaḥ ।।58।।
ete lakṣmyāstava śāpānmānavā vicaranti vai ।
tvaṃ tathā mānavī tatra śivakanyā bhava priye ।।569।।
śāpadānaphalaṃ kaṣṭaṃ mānavī bhuṃkṣva kanyakā ।
ete dāsāḥ pārṣadā me vibhinnatīrthavāsinaḥ ।।2.103.60।।
bhavantu mānavāḥ sarve kāle sevārthino mama ।
rājasu brāhmaṇeṣvatra bhavantu bhūtale'naghāḥ ।।6 1।।
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve jātismarā bhavantu ca ।
śāpadoṣe vinivṛtte vo miliṣyāmahaṃ tadā ।।62।।
tapasā śuddhabhāveyaṃ lakṣmīryadā himālaye ।
cakravākyā samaṃ putryā darśanaṃ mama lapsyate ।।62।।
urvarśyāścakravākyā me putryā mokṣo bhaviṣyati ।
himādreḥ śikhare putrīṃ tṛṣitāṃ vāri vṛṣṭidam ।।64।।
pāyayitvā tarpayiṣye tato me darśanottaram ।
lakṣmyāḥ prāpte yogyakāle vivāhastu mayā saha ।।65।।
kāśyāṃ rājyamahodyāne yadā sampatsyate tadā ।
pārṣadānāṃ bhavatāṃ me dāsīnāṃ cāpi tatra vai ।।66।।
darśanaṃ ca vivāhe me sarveṣāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
tato yuṣmānnayiṣye'haṃ mama dhāma ca śāśvatam ।।67।।
ityuktvā bhagavānnārāyaṇaścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe svāmini śāśvate ।।68।।
lakṣmyādayaśca vaikuṇṭhavāsā āpṛcchya kaṃbharām ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇamīśvaram ।।69।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ tyaktvā śrīgaṇḍakīnadīm ।
nīpālayapradeśaṃ te yayuḥ śrīśaṃkarālayam ।।2.103.70।।
kailāsadhāmasaṃjñaṃ ca pattanaṃ vīkṣya cāmbarāt ।
avateruḥ śivarājagṛhe śrījānakīyute ।।71 ।।
śivarājo yogadṛṣṭyā viveda tān yathārthataḥ ।
lakṣmīyutān pārṣadāँśca tathā dāsījanānapi ।।72।।
mumoda svāgataṃ cakruḥ jānakī pramumoda ca ।
kṛṣṇā'pi mumude tatra jayo'pi candrako'pi ca ।।73 ।।
dhenupālo'pi mumude jñātvā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।
svāgataṃ cāsanaṃ vāri madhuparkaṃ phalaṃ dalam ।।74।।
annaṃ satkāramutkṛṣṭaṃ cakrurdaduḥ śivādayaḥ ।
prāsādaṃ rājyayogyāni śayanāni gṛhāṇi ca ।।75।।
yānavāhanabhogyāni sarvopakaraṇānyapi ।
bhojyapeyavimṛdyāni vastūni rājarītitaḥ ।।76।।
dadau śrīśaṃkarastebhyo mahīmānebhya īśvaraḥ ।
prāghūṇikāśca sañjātāstṛptāḥ śaṃkarasevayā ।।77।।
sarve nityaṃ pratīkṣante prātarutthāya tatra ca ।
nārāyaṇasya devasya darśanaṃ cāgatasya hā ।।78।।
śaṃkarādyaiḥ kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ grahītuṃ śaṃkarālaye ।
hariḥ prātaḥ svayaṃ caitya pūjāṃ prāpya prayāti ca ।।79।।
ete nainaṃ prapaśyanti mahīmānāḥ kadācana ।
tato lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ tatra śivarājagṛhe sutā ।।2.103.80।।
bhavituṃ vāñcchayāmāsa prātardarśanakāṃkṣayā ।
saṃkalpamātrasiddhā sā śivarājasutā'bhavat ।।8 1।।
jātismarātivijñānā mānuṣī divyasadguṇā ।
sarvalakṣmayutā kanyā ramā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।।82।।
nārāyaṇena yā viprakṛtā sā kanyakā'bhavat ।
satīśaṃbhvorgṛhe śāpaphalabhogāya duḥkhinī ।।83।।
tataḥ sā duḥkhinīlakṣmīritināmnā hareṇa ha ।
satyā saṃgaditā nityaṃ svasrā ca kṛṣṇayā'pi tu ।।84।।
lakṣmyāḥ prākaṭyakāle'tra janairvaikuṇṭhavāsibhiḥ ।
kailāsavāsibhiścāpi puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā'mbarāt ।।85।।
candanasya tathā vṛṣṭirvasūnāṃ vṛṣṭirityapi ।
jayāśīrvādadānaṃ ca vādyavādanamutsavaḥ ।।86 ।।
apsarobhirnartanaṃ ca devībhirmaṃgalāni ca ।
śivarājena dānāni saṃskārāśca dvijairapi ।।87।।
tathā'nyotsavajātāni sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ śivādibhiḥ ।
lakṣmīstu mānuṣīrūpā prakāśayituṃ necchati ।।88।।
patyuḥ sevanalābhārthaṃ sthitā kapaṭamānuṣī ।
rājakanyā'pi sā nityamṛṣikanyeva vartate ।।89।।
tapovrataphalāhārā nārāyaṇasya sevikā ।
putrī śivakuṭumbotthā tataḥ kuṭumbavat sadā ।।2.103.90 ।।
vaikuṇṭhavāsinaṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prasevate ।
nārāyaṇasya sevārthaṃ jalamāharati priyā ।।91।।
dadāti bhojanaṃ pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhi ca ।
nīrājanaṃ karotyeṣā'mṛtaṃ pibati pādayoḥ ।।।92।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ nityaṃ karoti kanyakā ramā ।
nityamarthayate śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ janārdanāt ।।93।।
vivāhārthaṃ tathā śīghraṃ vaikuṇṭhagamanāya ca ।
ekadā tāṃ hariḥ prāha tapaḥ karotu bhāmini ।।94।।
cakravākyā samaṃ tena taveṣṭaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktā sā kanyakā tu cakravākyā samaṃ tataḥ ।। 95।।
militā tapasaḥ siddhiṃ kartuṃ himālayaṃ yayau ।
anye dāsāstathā dāsyo nīpālayapradeśake ।।96।।
vihāre kosale cā'pyavimuktakṣetrake tathā ।
iṣṭapitṛgṛhe sarve svaprākaṭyaṃ prapedire ।।97।।
jātismarā abhavaँśca sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ siddhimantaśca kāmarūpadharāstathā ।। 98।।
divyā divyavihārāśca divyāmbaravihāriṇaḥ ।
sukhinaḥ sarvasampannā yathā vaikuṇṭhasaṃsthitāḥ ।।99।।
etāṃ sarvāṃ kathāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
hemaśālāyanāyā''ha kanyā prāha tathorvaśīm ।। 2.103.10 0।।
ityevaṃ rādhike sarvaṃ nārāyaṇecchayā'bhavat ।
na kālo na ca karmā'pi prārabdhaṃ nātra kāraṇam ।। 10 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vaikuṇṭhāllakṣmyā dāsānāṃ dāsīnāṃ ca satyalokāgamastato'śvapaṭṭasarovarāgamastato nīpālayapradeśe śivarājagṛhe lakṣmyāḥ prākaṭyaṃ dāsadāsīnāṃ bhinnapradeśeṣu prākaṭyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 103 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 103 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 104
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 105 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! tatparaṃ hemaśālāyano narāyaṇam ।
papraccha tu tapaḥ kīdṛk kṛtaṃ śaṃkarakanyayā ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāda tūttaram ।
śivarājasutā cakravākīṃ śrīgaṇḍakītaṭe ।। 2 ।।
uvāca parayā prītyā putri cāgaccha me gṛham ।
ityuktā prayayau putrī hyurvaśī jananīgṛham ।। 3 ।।
rājyagṛhe'tiramye sā pāliteva sutiṣṭhati ।
janānāṃ sā tu sānnidhye naiva vadati kiñcana ।। 4 ।।
nirjane bahudhā''lāpān mātrā saha karoti sā ।
nadyāmudyānake vāṭyāṃ kṣetre saudhe sabhāgṛhe ।। 5 ।।
pākagṛhe ca śayane kaṇagṛhe mahānase ।
snānagṛhe samāje ca mandire svāminastathā ।। 6 ।।
evamanyatra sarvatra sahagā corvaśī sadā ।
mātrā saha dinakṣepaṃ karoti śāpakāraṇāt ।। 7 ।।
śivarājasya vai bhaktyā satyā bhaktyā jayasya ca ।
kṛṣṇāyāścāpi candrasya subhaktyā dhenupasya ca ।। 8 ।।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ divyakiśorarūpavān ।
prasannastadgṛhe yāti viyāti prāpya pūjanam ।। 9 ।।
bhuṃkte dattaṃ tu naivedyaṃ jalaṃ pibati miṣṭakam ।
tāmbūlaṃ cāpi gṛhṇāti vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇam ।। 2.104.1 0।।
lakṣmyā ca kanyayā dattaṃ sarvamaśnāti bhāvataḥ ।
urvaśyā'pi pradattaṃ ca pracchannaṃ janakāya yat ।। 1 1।।
tat sarvaṃ cātibhaktyaiva gṛhṇāti bhagavān prabhuḥ ।
nityamevaṃ gṛhyamāṇe kānte kāntā'tibhāvukī ।। 1 2।।
nimagnā premavaśagā tvekānte prārthanāṃ śubhām ।
cakāra svavivāhārthaṃ śāpanāśārthamityapi ।। 13।।
kṛṣṇādīnāṃ pramuktyarthaṃ -tadā prāha narāyaṇaḥ ।
mā śaighryaṃ vaha vāmoru nātidūraṃ kṣaṇaṃ tu tat ।। 14।।
ityuktvā'dṛśyabhāvaṃ śrīnārāyaṇo'gamattataḥ ।
urvaśī prāha sā kanyā tapasā sādhyate hariḥ ।। 15।।
ityevaṃ bhagavānāha pitā te māṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।
vad kīdṛk tapaḥ kāryaṃ kva gantavyaṃ himālaye ।। 16।।
upadravā na yatra syustādṛśaṃ kiṃ sthalaṃ bhavet ।
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ bhavet putri vada darśaya tatsthalam ।। 17।।
daityāśca - rākṣasāścāpi dānavā harivairiṇaḥ ।
śaṃbhośca vairiṇo'raṇye vicaranti divāniśam ।। 18।।
abalānāṃ mahatkaṣṭaṃ nirjane tu tapo'rjane ।
tatra tvaṃ cakravākyāsse śyenebhyaste bhayaṃ sadā ।। 1 9।।
ahaṃ kanyā vivāhārhā daityādibhyo bhayaṃ ca me ।
tapaḥsiddhiryathā syādvai nirvighnā harituṣṭaye ।।2.104.20।।
tādṛk sthalaṃ vada putri yadi jānāsi parvate ।
ityuktā tūrvaśī prāha mātaryāvān himālayaḥ ।।21।।
mayā dṛṣṭo'sti parito viharantyā suraiḥ saha।
kāścit sthalyastatra santi yatra vasanti mānavāḥ ।।22।।
droṇyastāḥ pārśvabhāgasthā araṇyavanamiśritāḥ ।
bhūtāyanapradeśo'sti yatra vai śāṃkarīprajāḥ ।। 23।।
nīpālayapradeśo'yaṃ yatra vai pārvatīprajāḥ ।
tathā badarīdeśaśca yatra nārāyaṇīprajāḥ ।। 24।।
tathā trivartadeśo'pi yatra tridevajāḥ prajāḥ ।
tathā kāśmīradeśo'pi yatrāste kāśyapī prajā ।।25।।
tathā gāndharvadeśaśca cāraṇānāṃ pradeśakaḥ ।
kinnarāṇāṃ pradeśāśca kiṃpuruṣabhūmayaḥ ।।26।।
satīśivasya kailāsastathā devādibhūmikāḥ । -
vidyante'saṃkhyakā mātaḥ parvate tu himālaye ।।27।।
tatra vighnā bhaveyurvai devamānavadaityajāḥ ।
nirjanaṃ na sthalaṃ tatra kvā'pi saṃbhāvyate'mba vai ।।।28।।
mayā tvekaṃ sthalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ purā yannātidūragam ।
droṇyāṃ yat kṛṣṇaśailasya yatrāste pūrvasṛṣṭijaḥ ।।।29।।
hanumān brahmacārī ca rāmabhakto'titāpasaḥ ।
yatra naivā'sti vighnānāṃ saṃbhavastasya sannidhau ।। 2.104.30 ।।
kadalīnāṃ vane so'yaṃ mahābhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ ।
nityaṃ sītādāsabhakto rājate nātigocaraḥ ।। 31 ।।
kvacit śrībadarīṃ yāti kvacidgaurītapaḥsthalam ।
gaurīśikharamevāpi kvacit kailāsaparvatam ।।3 2।।
kvacidvai kāñcanīṃ gaṃgāṃ gahare śṛṃgavartini ।
yatra yatra hanumān sa prayāti ca vasatyapi ।।33।।
tatra naivā'sti vighnānāṃ mātarvai saṃbhavaḥ khalu ।
gaṃgāmūle tu śikhare kalpalatā bhavanti ca ।। 34।।
yad yadā ceṣyate tattat tadopasthitamāpyate ।
hanūmadāśramastatra vartate sarvarakṣakaḥ ।।35।।
gantavyaṃ tatra śikhare tapaḥ kāryaṃ hi nirjane ।
āvedayitvā kīnāśaṃ sthāsyāvastapase sadā ।।36।।
ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā duḥkhinīkamalā sutā ।
mātre nivedayāmāsa jānakyai tapa īhitam ।। 37।
mātarme vartate cecchā kartuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ patim ।
sa māṃ prāha madarthaṃ vai tapaḥ kuru sukanyake ।।38।।
tato'haṃ tapaso'rtha vai gamiṣye tu himālayam ।
gahanaṃ nirjanaṃ prāpya kariṣye tapa uttamam ।।39।।
tapaḥ siddhyuttaraṃ mātaścāgamiṣye tavā'ntikam ।
śrutvā mātā śuśocā'ti komalā bālikā mama ।।2.104.40।।
kathaṃ pāraṃ tapasaḥ sā gamiṣyati hareḥ kṛte ।
ityevaṃ cintayamānā sā jagād harāya tat ।।41।।
śivarājo vicāryaiva yogenā''ha tu jānakīm ।
yogyaṃ sā vakti kanyā'tra yataḥ sā'sti ramā svayam ।।42।।।
tvaṃ cā'si dakṣaputrī vai satī cā'haṃ haraḥ svayam ।
kṛṣṇādyā vaikuṇṭhavāsāḥ santi śāpavaśādiha ।।43।।
sarve'tra janimāpannā nārāyaṇaḥ sadā prage ।
bhaktasnehādatra nityaṃ samāyāti pareśvaraḥ ।।44।।
tadvākyena priye kanyā ramā tapaḥ kariṣyati ।
ramayā saha ca tato nārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।।45।।
prāpte tu samaye patni vivāhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
tato vayaṃ ramāśāpād vimuktāḥ syāma bhāmini ।।46।।
tadyogyaṃ sarvathā cāstu tapo nirvighnameva ca ।
saphalaṃ tattapaścāstu hariścāstu sutāpatiḥ ।।47।।
eṣā yā cakravākyasti sā putrī corvaśī hareḥ ।
śāpamuktā'pi tapasā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।48।।
ityevaṃ śaṃbhvanumatā jānakī prāha putrikām ।
vatse tvayā'rthitaḥ kānto nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।49।।
tapasā tattapaste'stu saphalaṃ samanoratham ।
prāpayituṃ sthalīṃ yatra tapastvaṃ vai kariṣyasi ।।2.104.50 ।।
śivarājastathā cā'haṃ samāgacchāva īśvari ।
apekṣitaṃ gṛhāṇā'tra muhūrtaṃ ca śubhaṃ tathā ।।51।।
rakṣārthaṃ vada dāsyāmi bhrātaraṃ yadi rocate ।
tadā prāha ramā mātarmama kiṃcinna rocate ।।।52।।।
rakṣāṃ me tapasaḥ kṛṣṇo rakṣānāthaḥ kariṣyati ।
vastu kiñcinna cecchāmi vanyaṃ yaddehasādhanam ।।53।।
śubho me'stu haraḥ sākṣāt kailāsavāsakṛt prabhuḥ ।
rakṣā me'stu sadā mātā satī dakṣasutā mama ।।54।।
rakṣako me vaiṣṇavo'stu hanumān śaṃbhubālakaḥ ।
sāhacarye cakravākī yorvaśī mama bālikā ।।55।।
himālayaḥ svayaṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyati mamā'mbike ।
svayaṃ me rakṣakaścāste varado'pi narāyaṇaḥ ।।56।।
nārāyaṇaṃ variṣye'haṃ mariṣye vā himālaye ।
sādhayiṣye mano'bhīṣṭaṃ mokṣayiṣye tu śāpataḥ ।।57।।
ityevaṃ pūrvasaṃskārā jagāda mātaraṃ sutā ।
tataḥ sā balavaccandre pṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya mātaram ।।58।।
pitaraṃ bāndhavān bālā svasāraṃ ca suhṛjjanān ।
sakhījanān samāpṛcchya kṛtakautukamaṃgalā ।।59।।
jaṭāvalkalavastrāḍhyā śālagrāmaśilānvitā ।
aparigrahasarvasvā tyaktvā rājyasya vaibhavān ।।2.104.60।।
vighneśaṃ ca satīṃ sūryaṃ natvā śivaṃ narāyaṇam ।
kārtikasyaiva pūrṇāyāṃ yātrāṃ cakāra kanyakā ।।61 ।।
cakravākyā saha putrī yayau śīghraṃ vihāyasā ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadābhavan ।।62।।
surāṇāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca cāndanī vṛṣṭiruttamā ।
pārṣadānāmabhavacca sahāyā maruto'bhavan ।।63।।
śakunānyabhavaँstatra vyomni saubhāgyacihnitāḥ ।
suradevyaśca militā gacchantyo badarīvanam ।।64।।
śveto gajaścaturdanto milito'vataran divaḥ ।
hanūmān bālasūryābho mārge dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ।।65।।।
yāsyan kāñcanagaṃgāṃ saḥ svāśramaṃ tu himālaye ।
apṛcchat kanyake kutra gamyete vada no'dhunā ।।66।।
mamāśrame hyabhaktānāṃ praveśo nāsti sarvathā ।
ramā prāha namaste'stu rāmanāmamahodadhe ।।67।।
mahābhāgavataśreṣṭha rāmapriya namo'stu te ।
tāpasīnāṃ taporakṣākara bhakta namo'stu te ।।68।।
abhaktā nāsmi sītā'smi nārāyaṇapriyā ramā ।
iyaṃ nārāyaṇaputrī cakravākyurvaśī sutā ।।69।।
sanatsujātaśāpena cakravākītanusthitā ।
śāpamokṣaṇakāmeyaṃ tapastaptuṃ samicchati ।।2.104.70।।
ahaṃ lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ cā'smi tatho'rthaṃ yāmi vānara ।
hanūmadāśramo yatra tvāste śṛṃge sugahvare ।।71।।
yatrā''ste kāṃcanagaṃgā kalpavallīsamāśrayā ।
tatra yāmi tapo'rthaṃ te sannidhau harilabdhaye ।।72।।
śrutvaivaṃ tu ramāvākyaṃ hanūmān mātaraṃ drutam ।
nanāma pādayoḥ śīghramahobhāgyamamanyata ।।73।।
śivarājasya jānakyā putrīṃ śrutvā tatastaram ।
ānandaṃ prāptavāँścāti sevāvān kiṃkaro'bhavat ।।74।।
śaṃkarasya sutaḥ sākṣāddhanūmān vānarottamaḥ । '
śaṃbhuputrīṃ svasāraṃ śrīṃ jñātvā''nandabharo'bhavat ।।75।।
svasṛputrīmurvaśīṃ ca jñātvā tāmabhyanandayat ।
sarvāśramaṃ nītavāँstatra kadalīvanaśobhitam ।।76।।
svalpaśṛṃgādhityakāyāṃ gahvare sarvadā sukhe ।
kalpavallīsamāyukte sarvasiddhisamanvite ।।77।।
narbhaye rājyasadṛśe vāsaṃ dadau plavaṃgamaḥ ।
dhūnī dadau tathā vahnikuṇḍaṃ dadau śubhāśrayam ।।78।।
kamaṇḍaluṃ valkalāni cāsanaṃ japamālikām ।
śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāni phalamūlajalāni ca ।।79।।
tathā nārāyaṇamūrtiṃ caturbhujāṃ dadau tadā ।
tathopacārasarvasvaṃ dadau svasre hanūdharaḥ ।।2.104.80 ।।
evaṃ tadrakṣite deśe lakṣmīścakravatī tathā ।
mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyātastapa ādyaṃ - japātmakam ।।81।।
'auṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
mālābhistanmantrajapaṃ cakratustu divāniśam ।।82।।
snānaṃ kāñcanagaṃgāyāṃ sadā triṣavaṇaṃ hi te ।
cakratuḥ prātarevaite natvā śrībhrātaraṃ kapim ।।83।।
pūjayitvā hariṃ nityavidhānatastataḥ punaḥ ।
havanaṃ tvanale kṛtvā tepāte sajapaṃ mudā ।।84।।
cakrāte māsamātraṃ te kandāhāraṃ sakṛd divā ।
rātrau bhūśayana kṛtvā cakrāte bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।85।।
tato dvitīyamāse te phalāhāraṃ pracakratuḥ ।
tṛtīye māsi te patrāhāraṃ cakraturādarāt ।।86।।
caturthe māsi te puṣpāhāraṃ cakraturutsuke ।
pañcame māsi meghāmbupānaṃ cakraturambare ।।87।।
ṣaṣṭhe māsi tu bāṣpāṇāmaśanaṃ cakraturmudā ।
saptame cakratuḥ sādhvyau kṛṣṇārthaṃ pavanāśanam ।।88।।
aṣṭame śvāsamātreṇa tasthatuścetanānvite ।
navame māsi taruvat tvekapādena saṃsthite ।।89।।
daśame māsi ca tayordehayoḥ kāṣṭhatulyatā ।
ekādaśe tato māsi vahnistu tapasodbhavaḥ ।।2.104.90।।
samutthito mahājvālaścātmaśaktyā bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
vyānaśe sarvato dikṣu brahmāṇḍe nāśakārakaḥ ।।9 1।।
aṇurūpaiścātidāhairjāvāntaṃ prāṇanāśakaḥ ।
āścaryaṃ prāpa hanumān rāmakṛṣṇeti vai japan ।।92।।
rakṣāyāṃ vartate tatra sevako haribhaktakaḥ ।
vijñāya bhagavān lakṣmyāstapasaścātikāṣṭhatām ।।93 ।।
urvaśyāścāpi tapasaḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ vilokya ca ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra drāgeva ca samāyayau ।।94।।
padbhyāṃ samāyayau premṇā patnyāstapo vilokitum ।
phalaṃ dātuṃ tapasaśca tapo'ntārthaṃ samāyayau ।।95।।
koṭisūryasamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vilokya ca ।
hanumān daṇḍavaccakre tathā svāgatamuttamam ।।96।।
āsanaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca pūjanaṃ phalapuṣpakaiḥ ।
sunaivedyaṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ dadau nārāyaṇāya saḥ ।।97।।
naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ naiva bubhuje śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
yāvallakṣmīścorvaśī ca na bhuñjāte phalaṃ jalam ।।98।।
atha gatvā sannidhau drāguvāca parameśvaraḥ ।
aho lakṣmyāstathorvaśyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ tapa uttamam ।।99।।
yadvarṣmaṇoranalā vai sūryasamāḥ kṣaranti hi ।
brahmāṇḍadāhaśaktā vai mahāpralayasadṛśāḥ ।। 2.104.10 0।।
śāpasya pratikāro'dya pūrṇo jāto na śiṣyate ।
dadāmyābhyāṃ bodhayitvā yadiṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ tayoḥ ।। 10 1।।
iti vicintya bhagavān hanumantamuvāca ha ।
yāhyetayoścetanārthaṃ jalaṃ kāṃcanagāṃgakam ।। 102।।
śīghramānaya pātre'smin mā ciraṃ kuru bhaktarāṭ ।
ityuktvā bhagavānāste kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ samādhimān ।। 1 03।।
ityevaṃ rādhike svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa phalaṃ dātuṃ samāyayau ।। 1 04।।
hemaśālāyanādyāstacchrutvā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ।
acintayannaho lakṣmyāścorvaśyāstapa uttamam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mātā-pitrājñāṃ gṛhītvā lakṣmyurvaśyostapo'rthaṃ himālaye hanumadāśramagamanaṃ, tapaḥ, varṣānte tapaḥphalaṃ dātuṃ tatra nārāyaṇasyasākṣādgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 104 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 104 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 105
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 106 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yajjātaṃ kathayāmi te ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hemaśālāyanāya yat ।। 1 ।।
kamaṇḍaluṃ gṛhītvā śrīhanumān vyomamārgagaḥ ।
jalaṃ kāñcanagaṃgāyā ānayatpāvanaṃ drutam ।। 2 ।।
dadau nārāyaṇāya drāṅ nārāyaṇo'ñjaliṃ dadau ।
tāpasībhyāṃ tu śuṣkābhyāṃ yāvat tāvattu vai dvayoḥ ।। 3 ।।
brahmarandhrāccetanasya sañcāro hṛdaye'bhavat ।
prāṇo'pyasañcarad dehe netre coddhāṭya te tadā ।। 4 ।।
puro vyalokayatāṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
prāpatustu paraṃ harṣaṃ vilokya puruṣottamam ।। 5 ।।
sauvarṇamukuṭaṃ ratnamaṇimauktikaśobhitam ।
dhārayantaṃ mastake sve vakrasnigdhajaṭāyute ।। 6 ।।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale cāpi pārśvayoḥ śekharālikām ।
lalāṭe tilakaṃ candraṃ netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ śubham ।। 7 ।।
paritaḥ paridhiṃ śuklataijasaṃ tvānanasya vai ।
hāsyayuktamukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hārakaustubhaśobhitam ।। 8 ।।
raśanāśṛṃkhalābhiśca kaṭakairurmikādibhiḥ ।
aṅgulīyakakaṭakairveṣakusumahārakaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
śobhitaṃ parameśānaṃ parabrahma janārdanam ।
sarvaśobhāspadaṃ ramyaṃ kiśoraṃ svarṇarūpiṇam ।। 2.105.1 0।।
campakābhaṃ vahnidhautadivyāmbaravirājitam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 1 1।।
varadānaṃ pradātuṃ vai tvāgataṃ kamalāpatim ।
bhaktapatiṃ kṛpāpārāvāraṃ śāntamanoharam । 12।।
punarjalena ' saṃprokṣya śāntayantaṃ tapo'nalam ।
āhvayantaṃ kamaleti urvaśīti punaḥ punaḥ ।। 13।।
vadantaṃ yuvayoḥ siddhiṃ dātuṃ cāgatavāniti ।
varaṃ' vṛṇuta kamale priye putri tathorvaśi ।। 14।।
yuvābhyāṃ cātikaṣṭaṃ vai madarthaṃ prāptamityataḥ ।
prasanno'smi dadāmyadya varaṃ bhavatyapekṣitam ।। 15।।
tapoyogānnivartethāṃ kamale cakravāki ca ।
śopasyā'nto bhavatvadya dadāmīṣṭatamaṃ ca vām ।। 16।।
kamalā prāha bhagavan vivāhavidhinā tu mām ।
gṛhāṇa nijapatnīṃ vai cāparādhaṃ kṣamasva me ।। 17।।
yadyapyahaṃ sadā patnī tavā'smīti na guptatā ।
tathāpi śivarājasya kanyāṃ māṃ vidhinā vaha ।। 18।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha yāhi pitṛgṛhaṃ priye ।
pūrṇe dvādaśavarṣe te pitā mātā ca bāndhavau ।। 19।।
svasā tvete prayāsyanti kāśīvāsārthameva tu ।
tatrā'haṃ prasamāgatya grahīṣye tvāmaninditām ।।2.105.20।।
tatra tvāmudvahiṣyāmi neṣyāmi mama mandiram ।
jalaṃ piba phalaṃ bhuṃkṣva meṃ'ke niṣīda vai rame ।।21 ।।
ityuktā sā tapastyaktvā nārāyaṇāntikaṃ yayau ।
aṃke niṣadya kāntaṃ taṃ samāśliṣat kṣaṇaṃ ramā ।।22।।
dattaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cāpi putrīṃ vihāya padmajā ।
nā'grahīdatha bhagavānurvaśīṃ prāha putrike ।।23।।
śīghramāyāhi bhuṃkṣvedaṃ phalaṃ piba jalaṃ tataḥ ।
putrī prāha pitanaivaṃ grahīṣye tu phalaṃ jalam ।।24।।
pitaryadi prasanno'si tapaḥ pūrṇaṃ ca me yadi ।
bhakteṣṭadātā'si nā'deyaṃ vidyate yadi ।।25।।
apātrabhṛtavāryatra śikhare tapasaḥ sthale ।
prāpayā'nyat salilaṃ na pibāmi dehinā'rpitam ।। 26।।
yadyevaṃ na dadāsyatra vāri tarhi pibāmi na ।
prāṇān jahyāṃ śikhare'tra tvadagre jalamantarā ।। 27।।
viśvaṃbhareti ca pitastava nāma prasiddhyati ।
bhaktavatsalanāmā ca bhaktārthaṃ śrīviyogavān ।। 28 ।
mama mātā ramā lakṣmīṃ tyaktavān dhāmasaṃsthitām ।
tato'haṃ yadi bhaktā'smi putrī snehasya pātrikā ।। 29।।
vātsalyena prayuktastvaṃ kiṃ karoṣi vilokaye ।
mayā vṛṣṭijalaṃ pātrā'bhṛtaṃ cātra samiṣyate ।। 2.105.30 ।।
tat pibāmi tataḥ śāpānmokṣaṇaṃ cāstu me pitaḥ ।
ityuktvā nā''gatā cā'ṅke jalārthaṃ tūrvaśī sutā ।।3 1 ।
sarvaṃ tyajati bhaktārthaṃ madarthaṃ ki tyajatyayam ।
pito madbhaktivaśatāṃ prāptaśced bhagavān svayam ।। 35।।
vicāryetthaṃ haṭhānnaivā'gamat pituḥ samīpataḥ ।
pitā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha sute tatra jalāptaye ।। 33 ।।
vṛṣṭyā droṇyāṃ saṃbhṛtāyāṃ jalaṃ śṛṃgagataṃ bhavet ।
ucchrite vṛṣṭisalile śikharānnimnabhūmikāḥ ।। 34।।
sarvā magnā jaleṣu syuḥ prāṇināṃ pralayo bhavet ।
tatpāpaṃ te bhavet putri tato'trā''gatya vai piba ।। 35 ।।
urvaśī prāha bhagavan varadānavacastava ।
abhīṣṭadānavākyaṃ cet satyaṃ tvatra jalaṃ naya ।। 36।।
yadi satyaṃ na te vākyaṃ yāhi kurve tapaḥ pitaḥ ।
atraiva tu mayā peyaṃ jalaṃ nānyatra kutracit ।। 37।।
apātrasaṃsthitaṃ peyaṃ sthiraṃ peyaṃ na cañcalam ।
na vā divyaṃ bindurūpaṃ tbambarāt prapatat kila ।। 38 ।।
ahaṃ cettava bhaktāsmi bhaktāvākyaṃ prapūraya ।
avākyapūraṇe te syātpāpaṃ tvasatyavāgbhavam ।। 39 ।।
mṛṣā'bhīṣṭapradaṃ vākyaṃ noccāryaṃ vā kadācana ।
śaṃkarārthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ madarthe na kathaṃ pitaḥ ।।2.105.40 ।।
kṛṣṇārthaṃ ca kṛtaṃ sarve madarthaṃ na kathaṃ pitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin janārdana kṛpālaya ।।41 ।।
māṃ bhaktāṃ śikhare cātra pānīyaṃ na dadāsi cet। ।
saṃkariṣye tapaścograṃ sarvasaṃsārabhasmakṛt ।। 42।।
bahūnāṃ dehināṃ nāśe tava pāpaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
jalamagne jagatyeva mama pāpaṃ yathoditam ।। 43 ।।
kimatra cātivaktavyaṃ pāpanāśakaro bhavān ।
vartate'tra tathāpyatra pāpabhītiṃ dadāti cet ।।44।।
pitaḥ pāpavināśārthaṃ kastvāṃ vai saṃbhajiṣyati ।
puṣpodyānāni naivedyamiṣṭānnāni tvadarśakam ।।45।।
kaḥ kariṣyati te'rthaṃ vai yadi pāpaṃ na nāśyase ।
pāpahantā bhaved bhīruḥ pāpī kaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ।।46।।
ityukto bhagavānāha pibedaṃ pātumicchasi ।
tvayā'rthitaṃ jalaṃ tatra nāgamiṣyati putrike ।।587।।
lakṣmi tvaṃ ca jalaṃ tvetad piba cet pātumicchasi ।
eṣo'nyathā tu gacchāmi yatheṣṭaṃ cara bhāmini! ।।48।।
