ityuktvā bhagavāँstatra kṣaṇādantaradhīyata ।
lakṣmīḥ putrīṃ vinā naiva papau vāri manāgapi ।।49।।
putrī jalaṃ na jagrāha yatheṣṭaṃ nārpitaṃ yataḥ ।
ityevaṃ ca jalā'pāne punastapaḥ pracakratuḥ ।।2.105.50।।
putrīṃ vihāya vai mātā gantuṃ gṛhaṃ śaśāka na ।
punarghoraṃ tapaścograṃ jalārthaṃ te pracakratuḥ ।।51 ।।
sarvaṃ dadāti bhaktārthaṃ jalaṃ dadāti nau na kim ।
ityevaṃ te viniścitya tṛṣite tapasi sthite ।।52।।
nārāyaṇena caikātmyaṃ kṛtvā saṃyamasādhanaiḥ ।
tapaste ceratuścograṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatāluke ।।93 ।।
cakratuste tapaścograṃ māsaṃ caikātmyayogataḥ ।
tadā putryāstathā patnyāstṛṣāyogāddharestṛṣā ।।54।।
vavṛdhe pratidivasaṃ kaṇṭhadāho'pyajāyata ।
bhaktairbhaktābhiratyarthaṃ pāyitaṃ jalamamṛtam ।।55।।।
punaḥ punaḥ sa pibati nārāyaṇo jalāñjalīn ।
tathāpyasya tṛṣāyāstu nirodho naiva jāyate ।।56।।
śvetadvīpe kṣīravārdhau vaikuṇṭhe badarīvane ।
akṣare cāmṛte cāvyākṛte cānyatra yatra ca ।।57।।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tvāste tatra tatra tu sarvathā ।
asaṃkhyabalapāne'pi tṛṣā nivartate na vai ।।58।।
jalaṃ pītvā svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śramamavāptavān ।
udaraṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ vārbhiḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śuṣkāyate muhuḥ ।।59 ।।
urvaśyāstṛṣitāyāstu tathā lakṣmyāstapo bahu ।
vegena vardhate nārāyaṇaḥ śāntiṃ na vindati । ।2.105.60।।
tṛṣādāhāgninā dagdho vicitta iva vartate ।
utthāyotthāya patati conmatta iva dhāvati ।।6 1 ।।
mūrchāṃ prāpnoti tṛṣito nidrāṃ sukhaṃ na vindati ।
kvacidutthāya salile vārdhau patati vai muhuḥ ।।62।।
bhaktābhiḥ sevakaiścāpi pavanaiḥ sevito jalaiḥ ।
siktaścāpi na śaityaṃ sa prāpnoti parameśvaraḥ ।।63।।
sarvāntarātmanaścaivaṃ jāte tṛṣātiśoṣaṇe ।
antaḥsthitasya dehā vai sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।। 64।।
avāpuḥ śoṣaṇaṃ cāti tṛṣājanyaṃ jagattraye ।
īśvarāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro mānavāḥ khagāḥ ।।65।।
paśavo jalagāḥ sarve daityādyā api sarvaśaḥ ।
tṛṣādoṣairhatā bhrāntā dhāvanti ca patanti ca ।।66 ।।
trailokyaṃ tṛṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tadā nāśonmukhaṃ hyabhūt। ।
jalārtipānakartṛtve tundanāśe vināśanam ।67।
jalā'pāne kaṇṭhaśoṣaḥ pāne'pi śoṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
ubhayathā'pi nāśo'tra jagatāṃ samupasthitaḥ ।।68।।
tadā brahmā haro viṣṇuḥ kṛtvā samādhimeva te ।
jñātvā hetuṃ tṛṣāyāstu ramorvaśotṛṣātapaḥ ।।69।
śīghraṃ yayurbhūtale te saurāṣṭre'kṣarabhūtale ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatrā'nādinarāyaṇaḥ ।।2.105.70 ।।
vartate kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre nijālaye prabhuḥ ।
sarvāvatāratṛṣayā mūrchitastṛṣito bhṛśam ।।71।।
brahmādyāstṛṣitāścāpi mṛtyusaṃyogino'pi te ।
yathākathaṃcidbhagavatpādayoḥ patitāstathā ।।72।।
śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādyā mṛtyukṣaṇagatā iva ।
trūṭitayā tadā vāṇyā jagaduḥ parameśvaram ।।73 ।।
śīghraṃ nātha ramāyāścorvaśyāḥ prāpaya vai jalam ।
avṛṣṭijaṃ cā'pātrasthaṃ cā'nyā'spṛṣṭamanāhutam ।।74।।
anyathā vai jagat sarvaṃ kṣaṇānte vā vinaśyati ।
sarvanāśe samutpanne svalpanāśo hitāvahaḥ ।।75।।
yadi dṛśyeta ca tadā svalpa tyaktvā parānavet ।
śīghraṃ vṛṣṭyā himaśaile śikhare vānarāśrame ।।76।।
ramorvaśītapobhūmau jalaṃ prāpaya ceṣṭakṛt ।
ityarthitaḥ suraiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।77।।
drutaṃ meghān samāhūyā''jñāpayāmāsa vṛṣṭaye ।
meghā vṛṣṭiṃ pracakruśca sambhūya dvādaśaiva te ।।78।।
droṇīścopatyakāḥ kṣetraṃ śailaprākāramadhyagam ।
sarvaṃ tvāplāvayāmāsurāśṛṃgāntaṃ jalairlayaḥ ।।79।।
varyavarti mahān ghoro droṇyāṃ vai paśupakṣiṇām ।
araṇyāni nimagnāni magno hanumadāśramaḥ ।।2.105.80।।
daśayojanavistāraḥ sarvo magnaḥ pradeśakaḥ ।
jalaṃ śikharaparyentaṃ saṃmataṃ kṣitipātrake ।।8 1 ।।
nimnadeśā nimnabhāgā nimnāni śikharāṇi ca ।
droṇyaśca gahvarāṇyeva nimagnāni jalairlaye ।।82।।
lakṣmyurvaśyoḥ pādayośca jalaṃ sāmudrajaṃ yathā ।
tayoḥ prāptaṃ ca śikhare tapaḥsthalyāṃ puraḥ sthitam ।।83।।
tadā nārāyaṇo devā gatvā ca prārthayanmuhuḥ ।
jalapānārthametābhyāṃ te pānaṃ cakratustadā ।।84।।
tṛṣā nārāyaṇānāṃ ca drāgeva nivṛtā'bhavat ।
dehināṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ jaṅgamānāmapi sarvaśaḥ ।।85।।
tṛṣā śāntā'bhavattūrṇaṃ jalāni harivāñcchayā ।
pṛthvyāṃ samapasasnuśca divyā meghā yayurlayam ।।86।।
śrīśṛṃgaṃ corvaśīśṛṃgaṃ khyātaṃ tattapasaḥ sthalam ।
lakṣmīvanaṃ cakravākīvanaṃ khyātamabhūd vanam ।।87।।
lakṣmīgaṃgorvaśīgaṃgā khyātā gaṃgā tu kāṃcanī ।
hanumadgahvaraṃ cāpi nārāyaṇaguhābhidham ।।88।।
jalaṃ sarovaraṃ lakṣmīsarovaramabhūttataḥ ।
kāṃcanagaṃgātīrthaṃ ca brahmagaṃgā'dhikaṃ hyabhūt ।।89।।
kuśyāṃ kāṃcanagaṃgāyāṃ jalānyāsan gatāni vai ।
nimnadeśeṣu lokānāmadhairyaṃ jaladarśanāt ।।2.105.90।।
jātaṃ jalalayaḥ syādvai gantavyamitaratra tu ।
evaṃ kolāhalo jāto deśeṣu saritāṃ jalaiḥ ।।9 1।।
tanmiṣeṇa tato lokāḥ kāśīṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kṣetraṃ ca kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ yayuryātrānimittataḥ ।।92।।
śivarājo jānakī ca kṛṣṇā jayaśca candrakaḥ ।
dhenupālaṃ pradāyaiva rājyaṃ kāśīṃ yayustadā ।।93।।
deśāntareṣu ye dāsā dāsyo vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।
prākaṭyaṃ jagṛhuste'pi kāśyāmāgatya cottare ।। 94।।
varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye nyūṣuścāmravaṇeṣu te ।
phalidrumasamākīrṇe puṣpavallyādigandhite ।।95।।
kāśīrājasya sainyaiścādhiśritodyānaśobhite ।
kāśīrājasya sauvarṇe prāsāde varaṇātaṭe ।।96।।
sarvopaskārasaṃyukte kāśīrājena mānitāḥ ।
satkṛtāḥ svāgataiścāti śatahastivimānakaiḥ ।।97।।
bahuvādyādibhiścāpi lakṣaśairmānavaiḥ suraiḥ ।
vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇairbrāhmairbṛhaspatipurogamaiḥ ।। 98।।
devībhiḥ śaktibhiścāpi gaṇairvīrairasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।
sarvatīrthaiśca yatibhiḥ satībhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ ।। 99।।
pūjitaṃ śivarājasya kuṭumbaṃ guptamānavam ।
nityāvāsaṃ sāptabhaume saudhe suvarṇanirmite ।। 2.105.10 0।।
kalpavallīsamāyukte cakāra śaṃbhumānitam ।
satīpatiḥ svayaṃ kāśīviśvanātho'nnapūrṇikā ।। 101 ।।
śaṃbhordāsyastathā dāsāḥ śaṃbhurūpaṃ kuṭumbakam ।
śivarājaṃ śivaṃ caivāśliṣya svāgatamācarat ।। 1 02।।
madhuparkaṃ cāmṛtādi dadau jaharṣa cāpyati ।
evaṃ vāsaṃ cakāraitat kuṭumbaṃ harivāñcchayā ।। 1 03।।
sarvaṃ kālena bhavati yathā kṛṣṇaḥ samicchati ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ pārṣadāścā'nye pārṣadānyaśca yāḥ striyaḥ ।। 1 04।।
mānavyaścā'bhavaँstāśca kāśikānṛpamānitāḥ ।
śaṃbhunā mānitāścāpi nyūṣuḥ rājā''layeṣvadhi ।। 1 05।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaranta eva te ।
naranārāyaṇaṃ cāpi lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 06।।
lakṣmīṃ ca tāpasīṃ devyaḥ smarantyo nyūṣureva ca ।
rādhike corvaśīlakṣmyau sasmaratuḥ kuṭumbakam ।। 1 07।।
cakravākyabhavacchāpānmuktā kanyā ramāsamā ।
urvaśītisvarūpāḍhyā neme svapitaraṃ harim ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nārāyaṇa-prokṣitajalena tapasi lakṣmīcakravākyoḥ prāṇasaṃcāre sati cakravākī śikhare jalapānaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca vavre, harirvṛṣṭibhirdeśaṃ nimajjayitvā śikhare jalaṃ dadau, pītvā śāpamuktiḥ, vṛṣṭibhayāt
śivarājakuṭumbasya vaikuṇṭhīyapārṣadādīnāṃ mānavarūpāṇāṃ kāśyāmāgatya varaṇātaṭe kāśīrājasaudheṣu cāmravaṇe vāsādiḥ, śaṃbhukṛtasatkārādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcā'dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 105 ।।



← adhyāyaḥ 105 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 106
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 107 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ityevaṃ rādhike hemaśailāyanarṣaye hariḥ ।
kathayāmāsa cākhyānaṃ cakravākyā jalārthakam ।। 1 ।।
urvaśī sā śāpamuktā'bhavadvai surasundarī ।
natvā svapitaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ svāṃ mātaraṃ ramām ।। 2 ।।
indralokaṃ yayau pūrvamindrāya cārpitā yataḥ ।
atha lakṣmīḥ svakāntāya kathayāmāsa vai tadā ।। 3 ।।
hanūmān rakṣayāmāsa māṃ saputrīṃ tapaḥsthitām ।
tasmai hanumate deyaṃ varadānaṃ tvayā prabho ।। 4 ।।
ityuktaḥ śrīharistvāha hanuman vṛṇu cepsitam ।
kapīśo varayāmāsa nāmārthaṃ sārthakaṃ sadā ।। 5 ।।
kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ nārāyaṇamūrternirantaram ।
pibāmītyarthakaṃ me'stu kapitvaṃ kṛpayā tava ।। 6 ।।
tvayi nārāyaṇe bhaktirastu cā'vyabhicāriṇī ।
yatra nārāyaṇakathā tatra me prāṇajīvanam ।। 7 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te kathāmṛtam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāścāpi kathāmṛtam ।। 8 ।।
yatra tatra bhavettatra mamopasthitirastu vai ।
yatra gāyanti te bhaktāstatra me sthānamastu ca ।। 9 ।।
yatra yatrā''layaste syāttatra taddvāri me sthitiḥ ।
sevārthaṃ śāśvatī cā'stu bhaktarakṣaṇakāriṇī ।। 2.106.1 0।।
ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ cakre hanūmān bhaktarāṭ tataḥ ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha dadau mauktikamālikām ।। 1 1।।
pāduke ca dadau tasmai cā'mlānāṃ puṣpamālikām ।
lakṣmīrdadau hanumate kuladevatvamityapi ।। 1 2।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hanuman mama sannidhau ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre vasa bhūmiṃ surakṣayan ।। 13।।
hanumān kārayāmāsa lakṣmyāḥ śaile sumandiram ।
nārāyaṇena sākaṃ ca lakṣmyāḥ karoti pūjanam ।। 14।।
atha lakṣmīṃ tato nītvā vimānena tu kāśikām ।
hariryayau śivarājādayo yatra vasanti hi ।। 15।।
avatārya vimānācca vivāhārthaṃ varaṃ dadau ।
āyāsyāmi dvādaśā'bde te śāpānto bhaviṣyati ।। 16।।
tāvanmāṃ tvaṃ pratīkṣasva śivarājāya cāha tat ।
udvāhayiṣye cāgatya sarvaṃ śubhaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 17।।
ityuktvograṃ tapaścāsyāḥ praśrāvya śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
yayāvadṛśyatāṃ tatra varaṇāyāstaṭe prabhuḥ ।। 18।।
vimānena yayau cāśvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ hariḥ ।
hemaśālāyanaṃ prāhetyevaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 19।।
lakṣmīṃ vivāhya śaṃbhvādīn śāpāt muktān vidhāsyati ।
ityevaṃ nijabhaktārthaṃ lakṣmīṃ jahau hariḥ purā ।।2.106.20।।
hemaśālāyanādyāstacchrutvā harṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ ।
atha sarvarṣayastatroṣṭrālayeṣu sthale sthale ।।21।।
anādiśrīhareryogaṃ pādayoḥ sparśanaṃ tathā ।
pāvitryaṃ cāpi tīrthatvaṃ kārayituṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।22।।
pūjayitvā'rthayāmāsustīrthīkartuṃ bhuvastalam ।
uṣṇālayapradeśaṃ taṃ prajāṃ pāvayituṃ tathā ।।23।।
bhagavan devadeveśa śailasarovarā''pagāḥ ।
naijacaraṇanyāsaiśca snānāsanaprahīṇḍanaiḥ ।।24।।
tīrthīkurvantu tīrthāni gṛhāraṇyāni nastathā ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha divye vimānake tataḥ ।।25।।
āruruhuśca te sarve hemaśālākhyaparvatam ।
prathamaṃ parito vīkṣya hemaśālāyanagṛham ।।26।।
pāvayitvā caraṇotthaṃ sparśaṃ tatra vidhāya ca ।
pūjāṃ haimakṛtāṃ prāpya tato bālānadīṃ yayuḥ ।।27।।
tatra snātvā pāvayitvā vīkṣya bālādimityapi ।
gośaṃkusalile snātvā rāvāsanādrimāyayuḥ ।।28।।।।
parvataṃ caraṇaiḥ sarvaṃ pāvayitvā tataśca te ।
marcāśanānadīṃ cāpi surānadīṃ turūnadīm ।।29।।
aitanadīṃ pāvayitvā tīrthīkṛtvā''plavena ca ।
mākamānasaraḥsaṃjñe snātvā bālāsarasyapi ।।2.106.30।।
śvānanadyāṃ tataḥ snātvā dārāliṃgaṃ ca parvatam ।
kṛtvā supāvanaṃ padbhyāṃ snātvā kuvansarovare ।।3 1 ।।
lābharucisaraścāpi dṛṣṭvā'raṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇam ।
gaurānarasaromadhye snātvā turusarovare ।।32।।
snātvā grāgiri sarasi snātvā ārasarovare ।
pāvayitvā maṣīgrīvaṃ parvataṃ caraṇaistathā ।।33।।
uttuṃgasarasi snātvā raṇaṃ vilokya cāmbarāt ।
mekadāneyaśailaṃ ca kṛtvā padbhyāṃ tu pāvanam ।। 34।।
uttare ca tato gatvā vitūrīyajalāplavam ।
kṛtvā delyāṃ ca ghelyāṃ ca snātvā nipīya tajjalam ।।35।।
gatvā śālavīnaśailaṃ pāvayitvā ca taṃ tataḥ ।
rinkunadyāṃ jhinkunadyāṃ phinkunandyāṃ ca te tataḥ ।। 36 ।।
snātvā ca grāmaśailaṃ ca pāvayitvā'vatīrya ca ।
kāruliṃgasarityeva dāruliṃgājale tataḥ ।।37।।
cāruliṃgājale snātvā snātvā murānadījale ।
turānadyāṃ murānadyāṃ snātvā''cālādrimāyayuḥ ।।38।।
padbhyāṃ taṃ pāvayitvaiva divādiṅparvataṃ yayuḥ ।
kiṇḍīcāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā kuvindūmānadījale ।।39।।
kvīlpīnadyāṃ laviṃgāyāṃ sasnuśca pāvanījale ।
micalāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca cāṭaparvatam ।।2.106.40।।
pāvayitvā cottaraṃ collaṃghya te paścimaṃ yayuḥ ।
phijarāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā pāvayitvā prajāśca tāḥ ।।41।।
prajābhiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jagṛhurharisevakāḥ ।
bhojitāḥ pūjitāścāpi vanditāśca muhurmuhuḥ ।।42।।
agastyaśca tathā śaṃbhurlopāmudrā ramā tathā ।
pārvatī cāśvinīputrastathā teṣāṃ ca sevakāḥ ।।43।।
uṣṇālayaprajānāṃ tu ye yāḥ rakṣākarāstadā ।
āśīrvādān dadustābhyaḥ prajābhyaścātinirbharān ।। 44।।
dadustābhyo mahāmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।45।।
tulasīkaṇṭhikāścāpi tathā ca japamālikāḥ ।
daduśca śaraṇaṃ paścājjayakāro'bhavat mahān ।।46।।।
tato gatvā rājadhānyāṃ cakruste vaiṣṇavaṃ makham ।
tatratyāḥ ṛṣayastatra yājakāśca tadā'bhavan ।।47।।
agastyaścā'bhavadbrahmā rudro rudrasthale sthitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'tiṣṭhanmukhyadevasthale prabhuḥ ।।48।।
hotā homāyanaścaiva tathodgātā balāyanaḥ ।
āhartā ca maṣīgrīvaḥ pratihartā ravāsanaḥ ।।49।।
anye hotāra evā''san yajamāno'bhavanmahān ।
rājoṣṇālayadeśasya samrāṭ dakṣajavaṃgaraḥ ।।।2.106.50।।
dakṣasya mānasaḥ putro devadaityābhivanditaḥ ।
deśaviplavavighnaiśca yāni pāpāni kānyapi ।।51 ।।
nivṛttāni bhaveyuśca vighnā bhavantu no punaḥ ।
ityabhipretya te sarve rājājñayā tu bhūsurāḥ ।।52।।
cakuryajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tuṣṭā devāśca dehinaḥ ।
brāhmaṇāstatra vai cakruḥ puraścaraṇamityapi ।।।53।।
kecitpuruṣasūktasya viṣṇusūktasya cāpare ।
tathā nārāyaṇasūktasyā'nye śrīsūktakasya ca ।।54।।
pare lakṣmīprasūktasya devīsūktasya cetare ।
rudrādhyāyasya ca pare sāvitryāḥ savituḥ pare ।।55।।।
gaṇeśādhyāyinaścānye sāmavedaprapāṭhakaḥ ।
evamanye ca vedānāṃ pāṭhāni cakrire tadā ।।56।।
dakṣajavaṃgaro rājā yajñārambhāt sadā prage ।
dadātyeva ca dānāni bhuṃjate ca prajāḥ sadā ।।57।।
miṣṭānnāni pratyahaṃ ca bālakā bālikādikāḥ ।
dīnā'nāthā'dhanāścāpi paṅgavndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ ।।58।।
pakṣāhaṃ yajñamevaite samāpyāvabhṛthaṃ tataḥ ।
dakṣajavaṃgararājño rājadhānyāḥ samīpage ।।59।।
uṣṇādattāṃgarākhyāyā nagaryā dakṣiṇe śubhe ।
ārasarovare cakruḥ phiṃkūnadīsamāgame ।।2.106.60 ।।
śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ parihāraṃ cakrurvimānakaistataḥ ।
yayurnaijān pradeśāṃśca tatratyā brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
rājā tuṣṭo'bhavaccāpi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।
prārthayacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kartuṃ sumandiram ।।62।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha rājā'kārayaduttamam ।
mandiraṃ tatra nṛpateḥ rājadhānyāṃ samucchrayam ।।63।।
iṣapūrṇātithau śrīyukkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
sthāpitavān mahāvijño'gastyo vedavidhānataḥ ।।64।।
rājā bhaktiṃ cakārā'sya kaṃbharānandanasya vai ।
atheyeṣa prajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ sabhūsuraḥ ।।65।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīharipattanam ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ vaiṣṇavo dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ।।66।।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stveva vimānaśatakena saḥ ।
daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākanaranārīprajājanān ।।67।।
gṛhītvā vyomamārgeṇa cāyayau lomaśāśramam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi sahā''yayau ।।68।।
naijenaiva vimānena nijavaimānikaiḥ saha ।
uṣṭrālayīyabhaktānāṃ saṃghāścāpi samāyayuḥ ।।69।।
ūrjakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ te'kṣarakṣetramāyayuḥ ।
svāgatādyairmānitāste nyūṣurvai dinapañcakam ।।2.106.70।।
sarvatīrthāni cakruśca śuśruvuśca kathāmṛtam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nityaṃ pramuktidam ।।71।।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamībrāhme muhūrte'śvasarovare ।
snātvā cakruśca te'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇotsavam ।।।72।।।
dvādaśābdīyajanmāhanimittaṃ cārcanādikam ।
śrīkānto bhagavāँstatra nirmite svarṇamaṇḍape ।।73।।
devadevīsatīsādhvīmaharṣirājaśobhite ।
īśvarairīśvarāṇībhiradhiṣṭhite'tivistṛte ।।74।।
pitṛgāndharvavidyādhraiḥ śobhite cāpsarogaṇaiḥ ।
divye gajāsane'rājat pupūjustaṃ munīśvarāḥ ।।76।।
āśīrvādān daduścāpyārārtrikaṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ।
sā'kṣatacandrakaṃ cakrurupadāḥ pradadurjanāḥ ।।76।।
saṅgītakaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ savādyaṃ samajāyata ।
stutayo devabandībhirdivyalābhā'bhibodhikāḥ ।।77।।
kṛtāstatra ca kanyābhirbrahmapriyābhirarcitaḥ ।
bhagavān śuśubhe divyo vardhito vṛddhavāṅmayaiḥ ।।78।।।।
dānāni pradadau tatra śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
rātrāvuṣṭrālayabhaktā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।79।।
lomaśaṃ ca tathā'gastyaṃ hemaśālāyanaṃ tathā ।
puraskṛtya prabhorjanmanimittamutsavaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।2.106.80।।
prabhuṃ gajāsane ramye niṣādya sarva eva te ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvā pūjayitvā yathākramam ।।81 ।।
pupūjurbālakṛṣṇaṃ te yāvadvidhopacārakaiḥ ।
nyadhuste mukuṭaṃ divyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya mastake ।।82।।
sadratnasārasauvarṇamaṇirnaddhāँśca śekharān ।
ālambayāmāsuriṣṭān mukuṭe karṇapārśvayoḥ ।।83।।
keśeṣu nyakṣipaँstailaṃ sugandhaṃ cāttarādikam ।
lalāṭe puṇḍrakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kāśmīrabindukam ।।84।।
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ datvā karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale daduḥ ।
karṇapūre ca sauvarṇe pauṣpe rañjanamoṣṭhayoḥ ।।85।।
skandhayoḥ rājakavacaṃ sauvarṇaṃ maṇibhiryutam ।
kañcukaṃ nāṭajātīyaṃ kauśeyaṃ svarṇatāritam ।।86।।
sauvarṇamaṇiratnāḍhyau paṭṭakau dīpacandrakau ।
sūryacandrojjvalau prabhāprasavau cāyatau śubhau ।।87।।
skandhayorlambamānau tau stanayorvakṣasi sthitau ।
kaṭisauvarṇaraśanāyojitau kiraṇānvitau ।।88।।
lakṣalakṣādhikamūlyau nyadhuḥ kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi ।
mukuṭordhve nyadhuḥ kalgiṃ mūle mauktikayojitām ।।81।।
madhye tejaḥparidhyuptasūkṣmahīrakaśobhitām ।
prānte sauvarṇatārālisravattejaḥsamanvitām ।।2.106.90।।
kaṇṭhe ca gaṇḍayorbhāle cibuke ca prakoṣṭhayoḥ ।
svarṇaśṛँkhalikānaddhān maṇīn daduḥ. sulagnitān ।। 91।।
svarṇahārān puṣpahārān taulasīsraja uttamāḥ ।
gale nyadhustathā bāhvornyadhuḥ kaṭakaśṛṃkhalāḥ ।। 92।।
ūrmikāḥ kaṭakāँścāpyaṅgulīyakāni vai daduḥ ।
svarṇayaṣṭi svarṇagacchān dhārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।।93।।
kaṭyadhaḥ svarṇavastrāṇāṃ sūravālaṃ dadhāra ca ।
svarṇabuṭṭāḍhyamurudhā maṇimauktikatārakam ।।94।।
saptapātālacitrāḍhyaṃ bahuraṃgavicitritam ।
pādaprakoṣṭhayoḥ svarṇamaṇinaddhe ca nūpure ।।95।।
daduste bhaktavaryā vai pādayoḥ svarṇapāduke।
siṃhāgrāṅguṣṭhakīlāḍhye madhyahastivirājite ।।96।।
pārśvayorhaṃsaśobhe ca paścād garuḍarājite ।
agre śeṣasamākāre madhye kamaṭhaśobhite ।।97।।
parito maṇihārālirājite ca dadurhi te ।
nakheṣu rañjanaṃ dravyaṃ karapādataleṣvapi ।।98।।
tāmbūlakaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ daduste cūrṇamiśritam ।
uttarīyaṃ mahāvastraṃ saptasvargavirājitam ।।99।।
kānakaṃ divyadṛśyāḍhyaṃ daduste'kṣarasannibham ।
chatraṃ dvātriṃśacchalākaṃ sarvadhāmavirājitam ।। 2.106.10 0।।
cāmare sūryacandrāgnividyuttejovirājate ।
ratnadaṇḍe dadustatra vitānaṃ satyasadṛśam ।। 101 ।।
vimānaṃ sarvalokānāṃ pratimāḍhyaṃ śriyā yutam ।
kalpavallīyutaṃ divyaṃ daduścaikaṃ mahāyatam ।। 102।।
rājā sauvarṇapātrāṇi ratnasthālān dadau tadā ।
sahasraikasuvarttyādyairyuktamārārtrikaṃ dadau ।। 1 03।।
koṭikanyākṛte bhūṣā brahmapriyākṛte dadau ।
anantamaṇiratnādi tatho'pakaraṇāni ca ।। 1 04।।
pūjottaraṃ dadau paścānnīrājanaṃ vyadhānmudā ।
tadā vādyānyavādyantā'jāyanta nartanāni ca ।। 1 05।।
stutayaśca maharṣīṇāṃ gītikāḥ svargayoṣitām ।
susvarāḥ kanyakānāṃ ca śrūyante maṃgalapradāḥ ।। 1 06।।
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣīyajanmāhotsavamadbhutam ।
cakraste'strālayabhaktāḥ sarājāḥ saprajā niśi ।। 1 07।।
tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ suṣupuśca taduttaram ।
prātarnavamīdivase snātān kṛtasumaṃgalān ।। 1 08।।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ dugdhasārānnasārakān ।
rasasārān peyasārān bhakṣyabhojyādisārakān ।। 1 09।।
mukhaśuddhyabhisārāँśca dadau gopālanandanaḥ ।
lomaśaṃ ca tathā'gastyaṃ tathā'nyānṛṣipuṃgavān ।। 2.106.11 0।।
śaṃbhuṃ cāśvinikāputrau tathā gaṇagaṇā'yutān ।
pupūjuste'stradeśīyā dadustebhyo dhanāni vai ।। 111 ।।
yatheṣṭadravyajātāni phalapuṣpāmbarāṇi ca ।
parihāraṃ tataścakrurājñāṃ jagṛhurādarāt ।। 112।।
gamanārthaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ mokṣaṃ tadā''rthayaँśca te ।
hariḥ prāha kariṣyāmi mokṣaṃ vaḥ prāṇanirgame ।। 11 3।।
hemaśālāyanādyāścaikādaśarṣaya eva te ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre nityaṃ vāsaṃ vyadhustataḥ ।। 114।।
atha rājñaḥ śatakanyāḥ prajākanyāsahasrakam ।
vakrastaṃ paramātmānaṃ mugdhāstadā hi rādhike ।। 1 15।।
rājā prajā dadustāśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tāḥ ।
lomaśasyāśrame sarvā rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā ।। 1 16।।
athā''jñāṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya yayuruṣṭrālayaṃ ca te ।
vimānaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajanta eva ha ।। 1 17।।
smarantaścā'kṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ praśaṃsanto'śvatīrthakam ।
pratāpaṃ saṃraṭantaśca prāpurdeśaṃ nijaṃ tu te ।। 1 18।।
rādhike caitadākhyānaṃ mārjārībālarakṣaṇam ।
cakravākījalapānaṃ lakṣmītapo'tivāhanam ।। 1 19।।
uṣṭrālayamahādeśaprajāpīḍānivārakam ।
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvā yaḥ śrāvayedvā smarecca vā ।। 2.106.1 20।।
tasya bhuktistathā muktiryatheṣṭaṃ syāddhareḥ khalu ।
siddhyaiśvaryādisamprāptirdharādhānyasutādikam ।। 121 ।।
sampadvaṃśapravistāraścārogyaṃ gṛhamedhitā ।
sarvaṃ bhavet kṛpayā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।। 1 22।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hanumate varadānaṃ, uṣṭrālayakhaṇḍe prabhukṛtāni sarvatra tīrthāni, tatratyabhūpena dakṣajavaṃgareṇa kṛtaviṣṇuyāgaḥ, śatavimānaiḥ saprajanṛpasyā'śvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrāgamanam, prabhordvādaśa-
janmadinotsave pūjopadādi, rājñaḥ śatakanyāḥ prajānāṃ sahasrakanyāśca bālakṛṣṇāyā'rpitāḥ nṛpādīnāṃ svadeśagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 106 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 106 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 107
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 108 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestataḥ ।
bhaktasāhāyyakṛtkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'bhavad yathā ।। 1 ।।
ekadā bhūtalaṃ draṣṭuṃ pitṝṇāṃ janavāsinām ।
mānasyaḥ kanyakā bahvyo vimānena samāgatāḥ ।। 2 ।।
brahmaputrī lavahītā candrāvatī irāvatī ।
śālāvatī mīnakaṅgū lāṭiśā kāniśā tathā ।। 3 ।।
māpīṃgā cāpi śīkyāṃgā aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgahā ।
mauktikā tārimā cāpi pannāmā tvāṃgahā tathā ।। 4 ।।
mīnāmī tānasarimā sīnā gāndharvavedikā ।
nṛtyagāyanakuśalārāgarāgiṇyabhijñikāḥ ।। 5 ।।
surūpā yauvanabharāścandrāsyāḥ sūryabhāsurāḥ ।
vahniśuddhāṃśukavastrā divyabhūṣāḥ prabhānvitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
viṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ kanyāstāsāṃ dāsyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
kāmarūpadhārāḥ siddhaiśvaryasāmarthyarājitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
astraśastradhārikāśca devyo'pradhṛṣyasadbalāḥ ।
nijalokāttu divyena vimānena śubhāṃganāḥ ।। 8 ।।
yayuḥ satyaṃ namaskṛtya viṣṇuṃ śaṃbhumajaṃ tathā ।
brahmasabhāsthitān devān natvā kṛtasumaṃgalāḥ ।। 9 ।।
meroḥ śikharāt prathamaṃ merudroṇīmupāyayuḥ ।
meruṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā devālayān bahūn ।। 2.107.1 0।।
brahmalokālayasamān saudhodyānamahālayān ।
svargātisvargaśobhāḍhyān dikpālānāṃ tathālayān ।। 1 1।।
prāsādān grahanakṣatratārakāṇāṃ mahojjvalān ।
yogināṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gāndharvāṇāṃ tathā''layān ।। 1 2।।
daityadānavasaudhāni kinnarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।
sthānāni kiṃpuruṣāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ tathā''śramān ।। 13।।
vilokyailāvṛtaṃ paścāt viyuktāṃ jāmbavīṃ bhuvam ।
pṛthvyāṃ samāyayurvyomnā tāḥ kiṃpuruṣakhaṇḍakam ।। 14।।
āpatāyīparvataṃ ca gopīraṇaṃ tathā'kṣigam ।
parvataṃ kunalīnādriṃ kārukoraṃ triyānaśam ।। 15।।
cipiṃgaṃ prācīnabhāga dṛṣṭvā pītasamudrakam ।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgasaritaṃ śikṣāṃgikāṃ nadīṃ tathā ।। 16।।
jalapānapradeśāँśca phullipānapradeśakān ।
vāraṇīyadvīpagaṇān dṛṣṭvā sumātṛkāṃ yayuḥ ।। 17।।
tataḥ parāvṛttya yayurmīnakaṅgūnadīṃ prati ।
irāvatīṃ candravīnāṃ patatkāyādrimāyayuḥ ।। 18।।
tāvat kanyāvimānaṃ ca vīkṣya sāmudrarākṣasāḥ ।
jalapānapradeśasthā vyomayānavihāriṇaḥ ।। 19।।
piśaṃgavarṇā dīrghāśca parvataśṛṃgasadṛśāḥ ।
saśastrā stvāyayurhartuṃ kanyāratnāni cāmbare ।।2.107.20।।
evaṃ phullipānadeśaprajātā dānavā api ।
vyomamārgeṇa yānena kanyā hartuṃ samāyayuḥ ।।2 1 ।।
māyāvino vikarālā yatheṣṭarūpadhāriṇaḥ ।
astraśastradharā vyomni vihārāścābdhivartinaḥ ।।22।।
parvataprāyadehāśca vidyucchastrā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
nirdayāḥ piṅgavarṇāśca rūkṣadehāḥ pradāhakāḥ ।।23।।
evamanye vāraṇīyadvīpadaityā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
nirghṛṇā mānuṣādāśca vahnipāṣāṇaśastriṇaḥ ।।24।।।
vrajakṣepaṇabāṇādyairyuktā vyomavihāriṇaḥ ।
kanyakānāṃ vimānaṃ tad ramyaṃ krośāyataṃ śubham ।।25।।
sūryaprabhaṃ vilokyaite hartuṃ kanyāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
ādamanadvīpataśca kṛṣṇānāgāśca kaṣmalāḥ ।।26।।
āyayustaṃ pravijñāya kanyāgaṇaṃ surūpiṇām ।
evaṃ te rākṣasāḥ pañcaśatāni ca sahasraśaḥ ।।27।।
daityāśca dānavāḥ kṛṣṇanāgāścāpi sahasraśaḥ ।
sarve te pañcasāhasrāḥ paritaścāyayustadā ।।28।।
patatkāye mahāśaile vimānaṃ rurudhuśca te ।
sarvāḥ śaraṇamāyāntvanyathā naṅkṣyatha vai drutam ।।29।।
ityuktvā cāsurāḥ sarve vimānaṃ pravivikṣavaḥ ।
praviṣṭuṃ tvaramāṇāśca dudruvuḥ parito yadā ।।2.107.30।।
vimāna puṇyatattvasya pāpināṃ sparśavarjitam ।
rakṣodānavadaityānāmapradhṛṣyaṃ tadā'mbare ।। 31 ।।
nirodhaṃ nā''pa ca yadā tadā te cāsurāḥ punaḥ ।
māyāṃ vai nijapāpānāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tatkṣaṇam ।। 32।।
pāpatattvasya rūpāṇi pāpātattvāyudhāni ca ।
pāpāstrāṇi ca pāpānāṃ śastrāṇi pāpapāśakān ।।33 ।।
pāpamantritanārācān dhanuḥkhaḍgādikāँstathā ।
vahnipāṣāṇabāṇāँśca gadātomaramudgalān ।।34।।
golakān vahnicūrṇāḍhyān visphoṭakāँstathāvidhān ।
vimānaṃ cā'varurudhustāsāṃ jivṛkṣavo hi te ।। 35।।
pāpatattvena meghena gatiṃ rurudhureva te ।
dvārāṇyuparurudhuśca viviśuśca vimānakam ।।36 ।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīdvimāne kanyakāgaṇe ।
na kaścid vidyate trātā vimāne sannidhāvapi ।।37।।
bhūtale cā'mbare vā'pi parvate vāridhāvapi ।
kanyakā duḥkhamāpeduraryamāṇaṃ ca sasmaruḥ ।।38।।
pitaraṃ rakṣakaṃ naijaṃ janakaṃ duḥkhavārakam ।
tāvacchīghraṃ samāyātastvaryamā svagaṇaiḥ saha ।।39।।
smṛtamātro vimāne'sāvadṛśyata śataprabhaḥ ।
sahasraśaravarṣābhirvārayāmāsa rākṣasān ।।2.107.40 ।।
rākṣasā dānavā daityāḥ kṛṣṇanāgāśca vai tadā ।
parito bāṇavarṣābhirardayāmāsurāryakam ।।41 ।।
aryamā vahnimutpādya preṣayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।
rākṣasādīn pradagdhuṃ sa dadāha sarvato diśaḥ ।।42।।
jalapānīyarakṣāṃsi jalānyutpādya māyayā ।
śāntayāmāsuranalaṃ tato'yamaryamā pitā ।।43 ।।
aruṇānayutān sṛṣṭvā preṣayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।
tīkṣṇajvālā'ṇuśastrāste dāhayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।44।।
rākṣasān dānavān daityān kṛṣṇanāgāँśca sarvaśaḥ ।
tadā'surā mṛṣārūpadharāḥ svamāyayā'bhavan ।।45।।
mūlarūpāṇi cācchādya yuyudhuścāruṇaiḥ samam ।
āruṇā aryamadūtāstīkṣṇoṣṇaraśmihetibhiḥ ।।46।।
anviṣyā'nviṣya daityādīn dāhayāmāsurāsurān ।
dagdhāstu bahavastatra navotpannāśca bhasmataḥ ।।47।।
ayutā'yutalakṣāṇi rākṣasā abhavaँstadā ।
yuddhaṃ taccāmbare sarvaṃ sarvasvadhvaṃsakārakam ।।48।।
āruṇānāṃ rakṣasāṃ cā'bhavattarkaparaṃ mahat ।
aryamṇā sūryamantraiścotpādyante'ruṇakoṭayaḥ ।।।45।।।
rakṣobhiḥ rākṣasairmantrairutpādyante ca rākṣasāḥ ।
nāntastvāyāti sainyānāṃ vardhante sainyakoṭayaḥ ।।2.107.50 ।।
āyudhānyapi vardhante vardhante śastrarāśayaḥ ।
vibhidyante vichidyante mriyante ca patanti ca ।।51।।
raktaṃ raktamayaṃ jātaṃ cāmbaraṃ bhūtalaṃ tathā ।
kāyavyūhāḥ patantyatra lakṣaśo vai samantataḥ ।।।52।।।
āruṇānāṃ rākṣasānāmadriśṛṃgasamā hatāḥ ।
dehāḥ kāyāḥ patantaśca sañcayā ucchrayāstathā ।।53 ।।
meghānullaṃghya gagane sañjātāḥ parvatā yathā ।
śatayojanavistāre bhūtale parvatocchrayāḥ ।।54 ।।
nagnānāṃ vai śavānāṃ te parvatā vai tadā'bhavan ।
patatkāyāḥ parvatāste nagnaśailā hi te'bhavan ।।55।।
piṃgoccayāḥ samabhavan ye naṣṭā yuddhakovidāḥ ।
āsaptāhaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ divāniśaṃ tvavartata ।
na virāmo'bhavattatra tadā'ryamā svayaṃ raviḥ ।।56।।
pitṛkakṣaḥ prasasmāra viṣṇuṃ śivamajaṃ trayam ।
rakṣārthaṃ devadeveśān pitṝūpān pitāmahān ।।57।।
rakṣārthaṃ devadeveśāḥ samāyāntu drutaṃ kṣaṇāt ।
rakṣantu kanyakāḥ sarvā nāśayantvasurāniti ।।58।।
tāvattatra samāyātā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
vimānatrayamārūḍhā divyasainyasamanvitāḥ ।।59।।
etasminneva kāle tu daityadānavarākṣasāḥ ।
sasmaruśca mahādaityaṃ mahāmāyāviśāradam ।।2.107.60।।
kālaprāleyanāmānaṃ koṭisainyasamanvitam ।
mahākālasamaṃ mahāmāyotthaṃ merusadṛśam ।।61 ।।
sahasramastakaṃ pratyānane śatā'jacarvaṇam ।
drāgeva sa samāyātaḥ kampayan bhuvanāni vai ।।62।।
yasyāṭṭahāsyamātreṇa nipeturgrahasañcayāḥ ।
cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāḥ sarve medinī cā'pyakampata ।।63 ।।
śikharāṇi nipetuśca bhūtāni tatyajurdhruvam ।
mahāvajranipātena samā jātāśca garjanāḥ ।।64।।
mandarasya śikharaṃ vai hastenaikena saṃdhṛtam ।
kālaprāleyakenā'nyakareṇa ketavo dhṛtāḥ ।।65।।
etādṛśo mahākāyo'suro yasyā''nanaṃ tadā ।
vyāttaṃ samabhavad vikāsitaṃ tu daśayojanam ।।66।।
evaṃ sahasravadano dṛṣṭvā'javiṣṇuśaṃkarān ।
sakthisphoṭairājuhāvā'mbare koṭisurānvitān ।।67।।
atha devāstu taṃ vīkṣya vairājapratirūpakam ।
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ sasmaruḥ kālanāśakam ।।68।।
tūrṇaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo devastatrāmbare samāyayau ।
tuṣṭuvuste trayo devā rakṣārthaṃ sagadaṃ prabhum ।।69।।
saṃkarṣaṇo gadāṃ tasya mūrdhni balānnyapātayat ।
kālaprāleyakaḥ śīghraṃ vañcayitvā tu tāṃ gadām ।।2.107.70।।
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ sa gadayā tatāḍa mastakopari ।
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ svagadayā cūrṇayāmāsa tadgadām ।।7 1 ।।
kālaprāleyakaṃ mūrdhni tatāḍa vegatastataḥ ।
gadā bhagnā'bhavad daṇḍād daityamūrdhā babhaṃja na ।।72।।
daityastriśūlamādāya hantuṃ dudrāva tatkṣaṇam ।
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ svaśūlenā'bhinad vakṣasi kālakam ।।।73 ।।
nipapāta tadā pūrvasamudre parvatocchrayaḥ ।
śaktyā hatastataḥ kaṇṭhe vajreṇa ca tathodare ।।74।।
marditaḥ parvataiścāpi kūrcitaḥ pattalaistathā ।
vyasuryathā tathā jātaḥ kṣaṇānmūrchāmavāpya saḥ ।।78।।
utthāya jīvarakṣārtha cakāra sa palāyanam ।
meruṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dudrāva ca bahiryadā ।।76।।
saṃkarṣaṇastu taṃ lokā'lokācalā'vadhiṃ yayau ।
pṛṣṭhadeśe yayau yenā'suraḥ sa kālakālayaḥ ।।77।।
lokālokaṃ vihāyaivā'lokaṃ vyoma yayau bahiḥ ।
sakarṣaṇabhayāt so'pyanantā'saṃkhyāmbare yayau ।।78।।
saṃkarṣaṇo'pi devastu śaṃbhvādīn sūkṣmarūpataḥ ।
nirbhayaṃ saṃpradatvaiva yayāvīśvaradhāma ca ।।79।।
atha daityairdānavaiśca yuyudhuḥ śaṃkarādayaḥ ।
nijaghnuḥ sarvato daityān kālaprāleyapakṣakān ।।2.107.80।।
triśūlaiścakrakairvidyutpāśaiḥ pāśaiśca tomaraiḥ ।
khaḍgaiḥ prakṣepaṇaiḥ śailairasibhiḥ śaktibhistathā ।।8 1 ।।
vāyvastraiḥ parvatāstraiśca meghāstrairanalāstrakaiḥ ।
nāgāstrairgaruḍāstraiśca siṃhāstraiḥ śarabhāstrakaiḥ ।।82।।
vārāhāstraiḥ kṛkalāstraiḥ karkastrairvṛścikāstrakaiḥ ।
yamāstrai rākṣasāstraiśca makarāstrairjalāstrakaiḥ ।।83 ।।
vyāghrāstraidīpakāstraiśconmādāstrairmūrcchanāstrakaiḥ ।
kṣudhāstraiśca tṛṣāstraiśconmattāstrairjaghnurāmithaḥ ।।84।।
brahmādīnāṃ ca sainyāni daityadānavarākṣasān ।
ardayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nāśayāmāsurantataḥ ।।85।।
koṭisaṃkhyā āsurāste hatā yuddhe samantataḥ ।
kṛtrimāścā'kṛtrimāśca māyikāścāpyamāyikāḥ ।।86।।
āruṇānāṃ ca sainyāni brāhmānāṃ pṛtanāstathā ।
śāṃkarāṇāṃ gaṇāścāpi vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pārṣadāḥ ।।87।।
hatā yuddhe koṭiśaśca tān sarvāṃste'surāstrayaḥ ।
jīvayāmāsurāmnāyamantraiḥ saṃkalpasiddhibhiḥ ।।88।।
brahmādyāścāhuretebhyo varadānārthamiṣṭadāḥ ।
vavruste paramaṃ mokṣaṃ ye sarve jīvitāśca te ।।89।।
brahmādyāstu tadā prāhurvṛṇutā'nyaddhi mokṣaṇāt ।
jīvitāścāruṇādyāste mokṣānyaṃ naiva vavrire ।। 2.107.9 0।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tatastāँśca mokṣāḥ santi hyanekaśaḥ ।
naranārāyaṇalokaṃ badrikāśramamityuta ।।9 1 ।।
payonidhiṃ vā yuṣmabhyaḥ śvetadvīpaṃ dadāmi vā ।
te prāhurnaiva taddhāma śāśvataṃ na tato vayam ।।92 ।।
samicchāmaḥ kintu cecchāmaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ param ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalasyāvaraṇopari ।।93 ।।
vartate tad dadāmyeva vairājaṃ dhāma vottamam ।
te prāhurnahi vaikuṇṭhaṃ vairājaṃ vā'pi śāśvatam ।।94।।
tasmādicchāma evānyaddhāma mokṣābhidhaṃ param ।
viṣṇuḥ prāhā'mṛtaṃ dhāma bhūmno dadāmi caiva vaḥ ।। 95।।
yadvā'vyākṛtasaṃjñaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā dadāmi vaḥ ।
te prāhurnaiva cecchāmastaddhāma kintu tatparam ।।96।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha dadāmyeva golokaṃ parama padam ।
te prāhurnaiva vāñcchāmo vāñcchāmastu tataḥ param ।।97।।
śāśvataṃ cā'kṣarabrahmapadaṃ vedāntabodhitam ।
sarvadhāmnāṃ paraṃ dhāmopaniṣadvarṇitaṃ śubham ।।98।।
yatsamaṃ yatparaṃ nāsti taddhāma paramaṃ hareḥ ।
icchāmo dehi taddhāma parabrahmasamāśritam ।।99।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha na me śaktirvidyate'rpayituṃ tu tat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 2.107.10 0।।
paramātmā parabrahma sarvāvatāradhārakaḥ ।
dātuṃ śakto'sti taddhāma sa vai dāsyati tatpadam ।। 101।।
ityuktāḥ sasmarustūrṇaṃ taṃ vai śrīpuruṣottamam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipumuttamam ।। 102 ।।
dhyānamagnāśca sahasā hyabhavaँstatkṣaṇe tu te ।
ātmātmanyavagāhyaivā'smaran sarvāvatāriṇam ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛkanyakānāṃ kimpuruṣakhaṇḍe rākṣasādikṛtasya nirodhasya nivṛttaye brahmādidevakṛtayuddhaṃ mṛtānāṃ prāṇadānaṃ, jīvitairmokṣo yācitaḥ paramamokṣadastu anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa evetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 107 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 107 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 108
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 109 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devairdhyāte smṛte narāyaṇe ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ pumān ।। 1 ।।
prāha svānparamān bhaktānṛṣiṃ maṃkaṇakaṃ yatim ।
maṃkirayaṃ maharṣiṃ ca kūrmiṇam ṛṣipūjitam ।। 2 ।।
prācīnabarhaṃ trītaṃ ca prabhūtānarṣimuttamam ।
ruśāyinaṃ ca khāsīnaṃ cāṃgaśyāmalakaṃ munim ।। 3 ।।
ārakarṇaṃ brahmadāsyamanāmayarṣimityapi ।
śyāmalarṣiṃ malayarṣiṃ caturdaśarṣimaṇḍalam ।। 4 ।।
samāhūya hariḥ prāha cā'śvapaṭṭasaraḥsthitān ।
śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ saumyā mahābhāgavatā yataḥ ।। 5 ।।
tāpasā vaiṣṇavāgryāśca mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ।
himālayāt pūrvadeśe dakṣiṇe ca pradeśake ।। 6 ।।
patatkāye ca vartante vimāne pitṛkanyakāḥ ।
pradharṣitāstu tā daityaistataḥ pitā tadā'ryamā ।। 7 ।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca saṃkarṣaṇo mahān prabhuḥ ।
ete daityāśca yuyudhurjaghnurdaityāsurāँstataḥ ।। 8 ।।
mṛtānujjīvayāmāsurāruṇān sūryapārṣadān ।
vaiṣṇavān śāṃkarāँścāpi vaiśvasṛjāँśca koṭiśaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tebhyo varapradānārthaṃ devairvacanamarpitam ।
pārṣadairarthito mokṣaḥ paramo'kṣarataḥ paraḥ ।। 2.108.10 ।।
surā dātumaśattarāstaṃ tataste cā'ruṇādayaḥ ।
bodhitā devavargaiśca tādṛṅmokṣapradaṃ ca mām ।। 11 ।।
tataste dhyānamagnāśca māmidānīṃ smaranti vai ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 1 2।।
bhavadbhyaśca maharṣibhyo gatebhyo mama dāsatām ।
mahābhāgavatebhyo vaścājñāpayāmi sarvathā ।। 1 3।।
yūyaṃ yāta kṣaṇāttatra patatkāyādritaḥ param ।
varṣe kiṃpuruṣe gatvā prāgjyotiṣṣu tathā''darāt ।। 14।।
prācīnā'dripradeśeṣu vicaratā'pi sarvataḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 15।।
mantramimaṃ pradaddhvaṃ ca sarvebhyo vai surājñayā ।
kanyārakṣakaśaṃbhvādyāḥ pratīkṣante ca māmapi ।। 16।।
bhavadbhiḥ saḥ pradeśaśca kāryo bhāgavatātmakaḥ ।
militvā cāruṇādyaiśca kāraṇīyā hyupāsanā ।। 17।।
pravartanīyā me bhaktirdāsye teṣāmabhīṣṭakam ।
vimānairyāta vai sarve mā ciraṃ procya ceti vai ।। 18।।
dadau divyaṃ vimānaṃ ca bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
yayuste ṛṣayaścaturdaśa kṣaṇena cāmbarāt ।। 1 9।।
patatkāye parvatordhve vimānaṃ tat sthiraṃ vyadhuḥ ।
apaśyan vyomasaṃsthaṃ ca pitṛkanyāvimānakam ।।2.108.20 ।।
bhāsvaraṃ koṭisūryābhaṃ vimānaṃ vīkṣya kanyakāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstathā cāruṇapārṣadāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
jayaśabdān harṣanādān cakrurutsāhasaṃbhatāḥ ।
ṛṣayo'pi tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviti ।।22।।
ityevaṃ jayaśabdāँśca pracakrurvyomasaṃstare ।
jaya kṛṣṇa jaya nārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ।।।2 3 ।।
jayo'stvanādidevasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
akṣarātītakṛṣṇasya parabrahmaṇa ā jayaḥ ।। 24।।
evaṃ tu bhajanaṃ cakrustacchrutvā vyomamārgataḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ vai vimāne te daśayojanavistare ।।25।।
yayuḥ sarve tu te nemuḥ paramarṣīn tato muhuḥ ।
kanyakābhiḥ pitṛjābhiḥ kumārikābhireva ca ।।26 ।।
prathamaṃ pādukāsammārjanaṃ tataśca pādayoḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanaṃ pādaprakṣālanaṃ phalārpaṇam ।।27।।
jalārpaṇaṃ svāgatādi candanādyarghyamityapi ।
svāsanādi pradattaṃ ca madhuparkādikaṃ kṛtam ।।28।।
tatasteṣu ca deśeṣu tatpaddhatyā nirantaram ।
prāghūṇikānāṃ sanmānaṃ kumārībhirvidhīyate ।।29।।
kiṃpuruṣapradeśānāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryameva ca ।
kumārikābhiḥ sarvatra prathamaṃ sampravartyate ।।2.108.30 ।।
rādhike kanyakādyāste vidhāyarṣisamarcanam ।
ninyuratān svaṃ vimānaṃ ca tataste ṛṣayo'malāḥ ।।31 ।।
parabrahmapratāpena parabhāvamupāgataḥ ।
viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorbrahmaṇaścāryamṇaḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire ।।32।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśiṣaḥ samūcire ।
śrīmatāṃ smaraṇādatra preṣitāstena cocire ।।33 ।।
mantradānārthamevā'tra preṣitāśceti cocire ।
kiṃpuruṣaḥ samantācca kartavyo vaiṣṇavaḥ khalu ।।34।।
ityājñā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'stīti cocire ।
tato'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।।35।।
āgamiṣyati sarvātmetyevaṃ tebhyaḥ samūcire ।
śrutvā sarve jahṛṣuśca vimānadvayameva tu ।।36।।
candrāvatīnadītīre śobhane'raṇyasannidhau ।
ṛṣīṇāmājñayā cāvatārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 37।।
mīnasthānaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ vilokya tatra te janāḥ ।
havanaṃ cakrire daivam ṛṣayaste ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।38।।
tato'ryamṇaḥ sevakebhyaścāruṇebhyo maharṣayaḥ ।
'oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 39।।
itimantraṃ dadustatra srajaṃ ca taulasīṃ gale ।
pitṛputrā vaiṣṇavāste tato'bhavan sahasraśaḥ ।।2.108.40 ।।
ayutā'yutasaṃkhyāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
bhejire ca tatastatra ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ ।।41 ।।
viṣṇujebhyaḥ pārṣadebhyo dadurmantraṃ tameva ca ।
rudrasya ca gaṇebhyaśca brahmaśiṣyebhya ityapi ।।42।।
koṭikoṭisahasrebhyo dadurmantraṃ tameva ca ।
te sarve vaiṣṇavāstatra bhejire puruṣottamam ।।43।।
atharṣayastataḥ pitṛkanyābhyaścāpi taṃ manum ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।44।।
pradaduśceti kanyāstā bhejire puruṣottamam ।
athaivaṃ dīkṣaṇāt paścāt kāmavallīdrumodbhavam ।।45।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ dānato miṣṭaṃ siddhānnaṃ bhojanādikam ।
dadurvai vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kanyābhyaścāpi te dvijāḥ ।।46।।
bhuktvā candrāvatīnadyāṃ sasnuste vaiṣṇavādayaḥ ।
athā'tra mantrayāmāsuḥ ṛṣayo vaiṣṇavāstathā ।।47।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāścāryamā ca kanyakāstathā ।
mīnakaṅgūnadītīre kartavyo vaiṣṇavo makhaḥ ।।48।।
tatra prāgjyotiṣāṃ sarvāḥ prajāḥ samantataḥ kila ।
āhūtā āgamiṣyanti āsamudrāddhi sarvataḥ ।।49।।
kiṃpuruṣasya khaṇḍasyā''gamiṣyanti prajāstathā ।
yajñe tābhyaḥ pradeyo vai mantrastu vaiṣṇavo yataḥ ।।2.108.50।।
ityevaṃ śrīharerājñā pūrṇā cātra bhaviṣyati ।
brahmā prāha makhe tatra yuddhaṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati ।।5 1 ।।
tāmasyo vai prajāstvatra vartante pārvatā nṛpāḥ ।
jalapānaphilīpānavāraṇīyapradeśajāḥ ।।52।।
vartante tāmasāścāti mānavā rākṣasopamāḥ ।
eteṣvapi pradeśeṣu taistu yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।53।।
tataḥ syād vaiṣṇavī bhūmiḥ pāvanī tīrtharūpiṇī ।
astvevam ṛṣayaḥ prāhurviṣṇuḥ prāha tathā'stviti ।।54।।
rudraḥ prāha tathā'stvevaṃ cāryamā prāha omiti ।
mīnakaṅgūnadīmūle melakāṃgābhuvastale ।।।55।।
makhaḥ prajāyatāṃ sarvadeśānāṃ madhyabhūtale ।
itiniścitya te sarve prayayurvai himālayāt ।।56।।
prāguttare pradeśe vai īśānadigbhave śubhe ।
piṃgadeśe kiṃpuruṣe yajñārthaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitāḥ ।।57।।
menakāṃgāvane tatra mīnakaṅgūnadītaṭe ।
piṃgāraṇye pracakruste yajñārthaṃ bhūmiśodhanam ।।।58।।
aṃgasvāṃgāpaścime ca śālāvatyāstu pūrvataḥ ।
pañcāśadyojanamāne vartule'raṇyaśobhite ।।।59।।
mīnakaṃgvāḥ paścime ca yajñamaṇḍapamācaran ।
mīnakaṃgvāḥ pūrvataścā'vasathān cakruruttamān ।।2.108.60 ।।
mīnakaṃgūbhayatīre ṛṣyāśramān vyadhustadā ।
devāśramān pitṛvāsān siddhāśramān vyadhustathā ।।61।।
īśvarāṇāmāśramāँśca śālāvatīnadītaṭe ।
cakrurbrahmamaheśādyāḥ pūrvabhāge'tiśobhane ।।62।।।
muktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ cāśramān ramyānmanoharān ।
śālāvatyāḥ paścime ca pracakrurvyomagāminām ।।63।।
ityevaṃ triṇadaṃ deśaṃ piṃgāraṇyaṃ mahāyatam ।
yajñārthaṃ kalpayitvaiva dūtaiḥ sarvān samāhvayan ।।64 ।।
muktāँstatheśvarān sarvānavatārāँstitheśvarīḥ ।
brahmapriyāstathā pitṝnṛṣīndevān digīśvarān ।।65।।
mānavān devajātīśca pātālasthān satīḥ sataḥ ।
gāndharvān kiṃpuruṣāँśca vidyādhrānapsarogaṇān ।।66।।
devīśca yoginīścāpi kailāsīyān samagrataḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhīyān samastāँśca satyīyāँśca samastataḥ ।।67।।
pitṛgaṇān samastāँśca sureśvarān surāँstathā ।
dikpālān pṛthivīpālān prajāpālān samagrataḥ ।।68।।
paśūn pakṣigaṇāँścāpi kāśyapīrbahulāḥ prajāḥ ।
vallīrvṛkṣān tṛṇastambān kandauṣadhikadambakān ।।69।।
nadān nadīstaṭākāँśca sarāṃsi sāgarāँstathā ।
parvatān khātabhāgāँścā'khātānaraṇyabhūmikāḥ ।।2.108.70।।
vanānyupavanādīni vāpīśca dīrghikāḥ prahīn ।
tīrthāni sāgārāँścāpi narānnārīḥ samantataḥ ।।71 ।।
gaṇeśān kārtikeyāँśca hanūmataśca pārṣadān ।
hetīn sarvān samūrtāṃśca sudarśanādikā''yu×Vr̤M×dhān ।।72 ।।
mantrān vedān sarvavidyāḥ kalāḥ sarvā rasāँstathā ।
tattvāni cāpi sarvāṇi caityāni vividhānyapi ।।73 ।।
ṛtūn māsān vatsarādīn yugāndināni ca kṣaṇān ।
māyāṃ guṇān prakarmāṇi yāmyān pretāṃśca dānavān ।।74।।
daityānāsurabhāvāँśca rākṣasān brahmavaṃśajān ।
sarvān makhe maheśādyā āhvayāñcakrire tadā ।।75।।
ājagmuste mahīmānāḥ sarvalokebhya utsukāḥ ।
devatrayā'nugāsteṣāmātithyaṃ cakrurutsave ।।76 ।।
brahmasthāne svayaṃ brahmā rudrasthāne haraḥ svayam ।
viṣṇusthāne svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ pitṛsthāne'ryamā svayam । ।77।।
mātṛkāścāsane tāsāṃ grahāṇāṃ -cāsane grahāḥ ।
dikpālānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca sthāneṣu cetanāstu te ।।78।।
niṣeduścānyadevānāṃ sthāneṣu devayoṣitām ।
samūrtāste niṣeduśca devā devyo yathocitam ।।79।।
mukhyadevaḥ svayaṃ tatrā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
saṃsmṛtastaistadā sākṣānmātāpitṛsamanvitaḥ ।।2.108.80।।
lomaśādisametaśca brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।
vimānenā''yayau śīghraṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।81।।
kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣakalpadhenvādisaṃyutaḥ ।
yājñikāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurbahumānapuraḥsaram ।।82।।
samājo harṣamāpannaḥ parameśvaradarśanāt ।
vāsaṃ kṛtvā''plavanaṃ ca yajñabhuvaṃ hariryayau ।।83।।
kalpavallyādibhistatra ghṛtakulyāstadā''yatāḥ ।
dadhikulyā madhukulyā dugdhakulyāstathāvidhāḥ ।।84।।
rasakulyā rasaśālābhṛtā miṣṭānnakāmṛtaiḥ ।
havyasāmagryasaṃkhyāśca bhakṣyasāmagryanantatā ।।85।।
vinirmitāstadā tatra parameśapratāpataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।86।।
pradhānadevasadane svarṇāsane vyarājata ।
yajamānaḥ svapatnīśrīkambharāsahitaḥ pitā ।।87।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai naijāsane vyarājata ।
pārṣado bhagavanhemantakau devaprakāśakaḥ ।।88।।
svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān vyarājanta sumaṇḍape ।
varaṇaṃ dehaśuddhiśca puṇyāhavācanādikam ।।89।।
aṃgadevasthāpanādi kṛtvā śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।
vahniṃ kuṇḍe samantraṃ ca prātiṣṭhipat tataḥ param ।।2.108.90।।
havanaṃ vedamantraiśca prāvartata sukhocitam ।
gaṇeśabhūtayakṣādyāḥ surādyāśca nijādanam ।।91।।
svasvabhāgān vahnimukhājjagṛhurhariṇā'rpitāḥ ।
pitṛdevā atṛpyanta ceśvarā muktakoṭayaḥ ।।92।।
āmantritāśca paritaḥ prāgjyotiṣāṃ ca mānavāḥ ।
jīvasumātṛkajanā malayasya janāstathā ।।93।।
irāvatītaṭasthāśca mīnakaṅgūtaṭasthitāḥ ।
śālāvatītaṭasthāśca śikṣāṃgātaṭasaṃsthitāḥ ।। 94।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgatīrasthā harāṃgātaṭavāsinaḥ ।
tārimātaṭavāsaśca mahatītaṭavāsinaḥ ।।95।।
āmūrataṭavāsāśca saritpradeśavāsinaḥ ।
tanmadhyadeśavāsāścā''hūtā yajñe tu mānavāḥ ।।96।।
deśakalyāṇaheturvai mantro'yaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpatidaivataḥ ।।97।।
sampadyate'tra gantavyaṃ sarvaiḥ kalyāṇahetave ।
ityāmantraṇamāśrutya sāttvikā mānavāstathā ।।98।।
rājasāścāpi viprādyāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyajīvinaḥ ।
vaiśyottamāstathā śūdrā nāryo narā yayurmakham ।। 99।।
vimānairvyomayānaiśca garuḍaiśca jaṭāyukaiḥ ।
ātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ te menire vīkṣya vai kratum ।। 2.108.10 0।।
prāpya prāsādikaṃ cā'pyavāpya kṛṣṇamanuṃ tathā ।
'om anādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 101 ।।
japaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam ।
dṛṣṭvā bhuktvā'mṛtaṃ pītvā divyabhāvaṃ yayuśca te ।। 1 02।।
kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ dhṛtvā'bhavan paramavaiṣṇavāḥ ।
koṭiśo mānavā bhaktā mumukṣavo haripriyāḥ ।। 1 03।।
avabhṛthaṃ tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ makhasya ca ।
tāvattāmasabhāvā ye yajñadveṣiṇa eva ye ।। 1 04।।
surārayo lakṣaśaste saśastrā yajñaghātinaḥ ।
satkāryanāśakāḥ krūrā jalapānīyajātayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
philīpānīyavāsānāṃ sambandhino'tighātakāḥ ।
vāraṇīyaprajānāṃ ca jātīyā ādamāninaḥ ।। 106 ।।
parasparaṃ tu militāḥ kālaprāleyajātikāḥ ।
anye tatsuhṛdaścāpi tatsahāyā guṇairapi ।। 1 07।।
rājāno bodhapāṭhīyāścaityapāṭhakajātikāḥ ।
cāṃkaśekāḥ siṃgaliṅgā hāṃgacāudakāstathā ।। 1 08।।
tūnakīnā hanoyāśca rāyagā baṃgakākinaḥ ।
lāśahā māṃgajātīyā mañcarāyāstathā'pare ।। 1 09।।
ete ca kṣatriyāḥ sarve tāmasā rākṣasā iva ।
lakṣāyutāni sainyāni gṛhītvā cāyayustadā ।। 2.108.11 0।।
raṇatūryāṇyavādyanta prājāyanta ca garjanāḥ ।
śūrāṇāṃ raṇaśastrāṇi prā'sphurannambare tadā ।। 11 1।।
ityeva rādhike tatra makhānte yuddhasaṃbhavaḥ ।
samabhavaddhi daityānāṃ brahmāṇḍasarjakaiḥ saha ।। 1 12।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kuṃkumavāpītaḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ preṣaṇāṃ tataḥ pitrādibhyāṃ ca saha hareḥ prāgjyotiṣādideśeṣu vimānena gamanaṃ, yajñānte yuddhasaṃbhavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 108 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 108 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 109
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 110 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike teṣāmāsurāṇāṃ tu garjanaiḥ ।
vyanadaँstu digantā cā'mbaraṃ cukṣobha sagraham ।। 1 ।।
jalapāneyadeśānāṃ rājā makaraketumān ।
philīpānāṃ nṛpaścāpi phalajaṃgamanāmakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vāraṇīyadvīparājo nāmnā vārdhūṣaketanaḥ ।
ārdramānadvīparājo nāmnā kalmāṣakesariḥ ।। 3 ।।
kālaprāleyakānāṃ ca rājā raṇamadāṃkanaḥ ।
prācīnānāṃ ca deśānāṃ nṛpo bodhavihaṃgamaḥ ।। 4 ।।
cipiṃgānāṃ ca deśānāṃ rājñā piṃgalakastathā ।
maṃgūjānāṃ mahārājo nāmnā samaramaṃgalaḥ ।। 5 ।।
mañcūrāṇāṃ tathā rājā hārakiriṭanāmakaḥ ।
lāśahānāṃ mahārājaḥ kṣaṇātmavādanābhidhaḥ ।। 6 ।।
karvarīprāntajo rājā kāruvarmā'bhidhastathā ।
ilādeśanṛpo nāmnā māṇḍalākṣirmahābalaḥ ।। 7 ।।
pannāmadeśarājaśca nāmnā pādasahā'bhidhaḥ ।
prākcayanapradeśānāṃ rājā prācīnaśāyanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ śṛṃgaśekābhidho nṛpaḥ ।
etai cānye ca vai mukhyā rājānau yuddhadurmadāḥ ।। 9 ।
lakṣāyutairnijaiḥ sainyairvyomaprasāribhiḥ saha ।
vidyudgolairvahniyantraistūrṇasphoṭaiśca puttalaiḥ ।। 2.109.10 ।
śastrakṣepaiścā''ṇukṣveḍaiḥ suraṃgaśaktibhistathā ।
vyomajālaiḥ śataghnībhirmāyājālairviṣāśrubhiḥ ।। 11 ।
viṣānilaiḥ kṛtrimāryairyuyudhuḥ suramānavaiḥ ।
yuddhaṃ samabhavañcedaṃ śatayojanavartule ।। 12।।
pitṛkanyāvimānaṃ ca brahmapriyāvimānakam ।
rarakṣaśaṃkaro devo bālakṛṣṇastathā svayam ।। 13 ।।
anye ca śāṃkarā brāhmāḥ sauryāśca vaiṣṇavā gaṇāḥ ।
koṭiśo yuyudhustatrā''jñayā''suraiḥ samaṃ tadā ।।14।।
rādhike! parvataprāyā yojanordhvembare tu te ।
utplutya grahavat sarve yuddhyanti sma tadā'mbare ।। 15।।
anye pañcayojanordhve pañcāśadyojanordhvagāḥ ।
sūryavat sahasā gatvā patanti sainyaśaktiṣu ।। 16।।
nakṣatramaṇḍalānīva śobhante yodhino'mbare ।
makaraketumān rājā śatasāhasrasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।। 17।।।
yoddhṛbhiḥ sahito vyomni yuyudhe cāruṇaiḥ saha ।
aryamā taṃ tu rājānaṃ sasainyaṃ sāgaropari ।। 18।।
viṣṇupradattacakreṇa tathā cakraiḥ svakairdrutam ।
ghātayitvā'mbare tānapreṣayat sa yamālayam ।। 1 9।।
sūryaketuśca tatputro hareḥ śaraṇamāgataḥ ।
rakṣito hariṇā tatra vaiṣṇavaḥ sa kṛtastataḥ ।।2.109.20 ।।
philīpānāṃ mahārājo yuyudhe śāṃkarairgaṇaiḥ ।
ayutayoddhṛsahito vahnigolaiśca hotibhiḥ ।।21 ।।
gaṇāstu śatasāhasrā nijaghnurvidyudastrakaiḥ ।
philīparājasahitān yoddhṝnayutasaṃkhyakān ।।22।।
tatsutaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ śrīharerbījajaṃgamaḥ ।
anye'pi śataśaḥ putrāḥ śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ । ।23।।
te sarve bījajaṃgādyā vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ ।
vāraṇīyabhuvo rājā dvaipo vārdhūṣaketanaḥ ।। 24।।
pañcalakṣabhaṭopeto yuyudhe viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ ।
vahniyantraistūrṇaśastrairambare cakrakaistathā ।।25।।
pārṣadā nijacakraistān nijaghnuścābdhisaṃgame ।
caturlakṣabhaṭā naṣṭā rājā -hataḥ sudarśanāt ।। 26।।
tatputraḥ sāraketuśca lakṣayoddhṛsamanvitaḥ ।
śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ prāpto vaiṣṇavo hariṇā kṛtaḥ ।। 27।।
tadbhaṭā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve jātāḥ prāṇarirakṣavaḥ ।
ārdramānadvīparājo daitya kalmāṣakesarī ।। 28।।
kṛṣṇakrūrāyutasaṃkhyabhaṭaiḥ saha vimānagaḥ ।
yuyudhe vyomajālādyairastraśastrairviṣāśrubhiḥ ।। 29।।
kalpavallījanyabhaṭairlakṣasaṃkhyakavaiṣṇavaiḥ ।
vaiṣṇavā vyomajālāni cicchiduḥ kartarīgaṇaiḥ ।। 2.109.3 0।।
kalpavallyutthitaistūrṇaṃ cāmbare bahuyatnataḥ ।
nijaghnuḥ prāṇataḥ sarvān sudarśanaiśca tadbhaṭān ।। 31 ।।
kalmāṣakeśaraṃ mūrdhno dvedhā cakraṃ tadā'karot ।
hate .kalmāṣakeśe ca tatputrāḥ pañca kalmaṣāḥ । ।3 2 ।।
raktakeśaḥ kṛśākeśaścitrakeśo'gnikeśakaḥ ।
dhūmrakeśastathā cānye śrīhareḥ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।।33 ।।
te'pi mantrapradānena vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ।
atha kālalayajanyā āsurā ye bhayaṃkarāḥ ।।34।।
triṃśallakṣāḥ saśastrāste naikarūpadharāḥ khagāḥ ।
yuyudhurvaiṣṇavaiḥ sārdhaṃ pārṣadairdaśalakṣakaiḥ ।।35।।
puttalaiḥ kṛtrimairvyomni tūrṇasphoṭaiśca golakaiḥ ।
śarāṇāṃ vṛṣṭibhirvidyutpāśaiḥ kāsāravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 36। ।
nāgapāśaiḥ śilābhiśca ghanairlohodbhavaistathā ।
nijaghnurvaipṇavān krūrā mṛṣāmāyāmadoddhatāḥ ।।37। ।
pārṣadā bhagavadvarma dhārayitvā tu taiḥ saha ।
antarīkṣe vimānasthāstadā yuyudhire'strakaiḥ ।।38। ।
kālakāleyajo jyeṣṭhaḥ putro raṇamadāṃkanaḥ ।
gadāṃ dhṛtvā mūḍhamāraṃ mamāra vaiṣṇavān bahūn ।।39। ।
mūrchitāstvāpatannurvyāmanye bhagnāśca dudruvu: ।
kṛpṇanārāyaṇavarma rakṣārthaṃ jepurudvijaḥ ।।2.109.40। ।
'asya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavarmaṇaḥ satī ramā ।
chando'nuṣṭup tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadiṣṭadaḥ ।।41।।
sarvajiṣṇuṃ parabrahma daityadānavanāśanam ।
namāmi śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīśaṃ vallabhaṃ prabhum । 42।।
bījaṃ gopālabālaśca bhaktapālo mahāprabhuḥ ।
śaktiśca vaiṣṇavīdīkṣā mahābhāgavatī śubhā । ।43 ।।
kīlakaḥ śrīkambharāśrīnandano bhaktivardhanaḥ ।
viniyukto jape smṛtvā rādhāpāravatīpatiḥ ।।44।।
dhyānaṃ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ sāmarthyānāṃ prabhāvatām ।
prabhavasya saguṇasya mañjuhaṃsaharerhṛdi ।।45।।
nyāso me mastake cāstu mastakaṃ śrīhareriha ।
netrayorbhagavannetre hareḥ karṇau ca karṇayoḥ ।।46।।
nāsāyāṃ kṛṣṇanāsā'stu mukhe nārāyaṇānanam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakaṇṭho me kaṇṭhe'stvasurakṣakaḥ ।।47।।
hṛdaye me cakradharturhṛdayaṃ cā'stu śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
pṛṣṭhe kuṃkumavāpīsthahareḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'stu me ।।48।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthasyodaraṃ mamodare'stu ca ।
nābhyāṃ me bālakṛṣṇasya nābhirastu jagaddharā ।।49।।
jaghane me hareścā'stu jaghanaṃ balasaṃbhṛtam ।
gupte kaṭyāṃ ca me stāṃ ca harerdhātuḥ kaṭīndriye ।।2.109.50।।
sakthnorme sakthinī ca stāṃ daityadānavanāśituḥ ।
jānvorme ca harerjānū stāṃ śaktisevituḥ prabhoḥ ।।51।।
jaṃghayoḥ stāṃ paranārāyaṇajaṃghe jagacchraye ।
pādayorme sarvadhātuḥ pādau stāṃ balirakṣakau ।।।52।
mayyanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mūrtimāniha ।
brahmapriyāpatiścāstu maccharīrendriyādiṣu ।।53।।
ūrdhve māṃ rakṣatu svāmī paramākṣaradhāmagaḥ ।
puro māṃ rakṣatu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।54।।
pārśvayoḥ rakṣatāṃ kṛṣṇo harirbhrātṛvarāvubhau ।
pṛṣṭhe'dhastād rakṣatāṃ me naro nārāyaṇastathā ।।55।।
pṛthvyāṃ mā'vatu lakṣmīśo jale rakṣatu satpatiḥ ।
tejasyavatu śrīkānto'ntarīkṣe tu prabhāpatiḥ ।।56।।
brahmapriyāpatirvyomni māṇikīśo'nile'vatu ।
rādhāpatiraraṇye me rakṣāṃ karotu cakradhṛk ।।57।।
gadādharo harirmāṃ saṃrakṣatvasurakoṭitaḥ ।
śaktidhṛg bālakṛṣṇo māṃ dikṣu vidikṣu rakṣatāt। ।।58।।
golokādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo'vatu vahnigaṇācca mām ।
vaikuṇṭhādhipatirnārāyaṇo rakṣatu cāsurāt ।।5 9।।
astraśastravighātebhyo vīryavān māṃ prarakṣatāt ।
ākasmikabhayānmāṃ thīhṛdayasthaḥ prarakṣatāt ।।2.109.60 ।।
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuḥsvastikadhṛk prarakṣatāt ।।61 ।।
ityevaṃ kavacaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
dhṛtavanto'tha divyāste māyāpāraśarīriṇaḥ ।।62 ।।
sarvakṛṣṇabalā jātāḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva hi mūrtayaḥ ।।63 ।।
sudarśanairmahācakraiḥ prayukteḥ sarvatodiśi ।
cicchiduḥ kālalayajān triṃśallakṣā'surān drutam ।।64।।
jīvataste mṛtāḥ sarvai raṇe peturmahājale ।
kālaprāleyaputro'pi mṛto raṇamadāṃkanaḥ ।।65 ।।
tatsutānāṃ śataṃ naṣṭaṃ viṣṇucakreṇa cāmbare ।
prācīnānāṃ nṛpo bodhavihaṃgamo'pi cāmbare ।।66 ।।
koṭipiśaṅgayoddhṛbhṛt pṛthvyāṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra ha ।
āruṇairvaiṣṇavaiḥ raudrairgaṇaiḥ kalpalatodbhavaiḥ ।।67।।
koṭisaṃkhyaiḥ raṇe deśe śastrāstrairavitarkitaiḥ ।
ambare salile pṛthvyāṃ parvate'raṇyabhūmiṣu ।।68।।
sarvato yuyudhustasya sainyānyanalaśastrakaiḥ ।
vidyudgolairvahniyantraistūrṇasphoṭaiśca puttalaiḥ ।।69।।
aṇukṣveḍaiḥ kṣepaṇaiśca śaraiḥ suraṃgaśaktibhiḥ ।
vidyu'ttārairvahnipāśairvyomajālairviṣānalaiḥ ।।2.109.70।।
śataghnībhiḥ sainyahābhiḥ śakaṭībhirvimānakaiḥ ।
jalaghātaiḥ kṣitighātairghātayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।।71।।
āruṇādyā gaṇā varma dhārayāmāsuraiśvaram ।
nijaghnurbodhasainyāni koṭiprasphoṭakāni vai ।।72।।
kalpavallyuttharamyā vai puttalā devasadṛśāḥ ।
vahniyantraprapūrāścā'mbare jaghnurhi dānavān ।।73।।
ardhaṃ naṣṭaṃ mahāsainyaṃ puttalaiḥ puttalātmakam ।
sacetanaṃ tataḥ sainyamaśītilakṣasaṃkhyakam ।।74।।
āsurāṇāṃ hi tannaṣṭaṃ daśalakṣāṇi dudruvuḥ ।
daśalakṣāṇi śaraṇaṃ śrīharestatra cāyayuḥ ।।।75।।
nāśaṃ prāptastathā rājā piṃgo bodhavihaṃgamaḥ ।
tatputrāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca vijñavihaṃgamādayaḥ ।।76 ।।
śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ prāptā rakṣitā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
daśalakṣabhaṭāścāpi vaiṣṇavā hariṇā kṛtāḥ ।।77।।
cipiṃgāstrilakṣasaṃkhyā yoddhāro vyomayānagāḥ ।
piṃgalakena cā''diṣṭā yuyudhuste vināyakaiḥ ।।78।।
kalpavallījanaiḥ sarvaiḥ raudraistadā vane'mbare ।
katpalatodbhavairvināśakaiste lakṣaśo bhaṭāḥ ।।79।।
hatāḥ sarve paraśubhirgolakaiḥ kṣepaṇairnagaiḥ ।
sarpaiḥ pāśairvajradaṃśaistriśūlaiste jale'mbare ।।2.109.80 ।।
bhūmau caiva vimāneṣu yatra prāptā hatā hi te ।
piṃgalako hataścāpi tatputraḥ piṃgaśekakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ prāpto hariṇā vaiṣṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
maṃgūjanapradeśānāṃ rājā samaramaṃgalaḥ ।।।82।।।
maṃcūraṇapradeśānāṃ hārakirīṭabhūpatiḥ ।
lāśahānā pradeśānāṃ kṣaṇātmavadano nṛpaḥ ।।83।।
kāruvarmā tathā rājā karvarīdeśajo'pi ca ।
ta ete nijasainyaiśca pañcāśallakṣasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।।84।।
sahitā yuyudhuḥ sarve brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ।
brahmātvatharvamantraiśca janayāmāsa jāṭikān ।।85।।
devān daityapṛtanāsu prerayāmāsa satvaram ।
vidyutpāśaiḥ sametāste vyomamārgeṇa vai kṣaṇāt ।।86।।
uḍḍayāñcakrire tūrṇaṃ pañcāśallakṣajāṭikāḥ ।
vidyucchastraiśca tatpāśaistriṃśallakṣāँstu dānavān ।।87।।
nāśayāñcakrire vidyudvajraiḥ śeṣāśca dudruvuḥ ।
ātharvaṇotthaśalabhairmeghavaccāmaradravaiḥ ।।88।।
viṣāktairdaṃśitā daityāḥ śeṣā ye daśalakṣakāḥ ।
mṛtāḥ sarve tataḥ śeṣā daśalakṣāṇi tadbhaṭāḥ ।।89।।
jīvanārthaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ śrīharestatra cāgatāḥ ।
te sarve vaiṣṇavāstatra bālakṛṣṇena vai kṛtā ।। 2.109.90।।
mṛto hārakirīṭaśca tathā samaramaṃgalaḥ ।
hārakirīṭaputrāśca daśa sarve mahābalāḥ ।।9 1 । ।
jīvanāśā yayuḥ sarve śaraṇaṃ śrīharestadā ।
prabhāsakirīṭaśreṣṭhā hariṇā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।92।।
sahasraputrāḥ samaramaṃgalasyāpi vai hareḥ ।
śaraṇaṃ tvāgatāḥ sarve hariṇā vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।93।।
kṣaṇātmavadano rājā yuyudhe śaṃbhunā punaḥ ।
lakṣasainyasamāyukto nihataḥ śaṃkareṇa saḥ ।।94।।
kāruvarmā lakṣasainyayutaḥ punaśca śārṅgiṇā ।
yuyudhe hariṇā so'pi sudarśanena ghātitaḥ ।।95।।।
tayoḥ putrāḥ prapautrāśca tatsahāyapradāstathā ।
samare nihatāḥ sarve sudarśanairhi viṣṇunā ।।96।।
ilādeśasya vai rājā maṇḍalākṣirmahābalaḥ ।
tathā pādasaho rājā pannāmadeśarakṣakaḥ ।। 97।।
prākcayanabhūpālo nāmnā prācīnaśāyanaḥ ।
śatalakṣasainyayutā yuyudhuḥ śaṃbhunā saha ।। 98।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ śṛṃgaśekābhidho nṛpaḥ ।
śatalakṣabhaṭaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuyudhe śaṃbhunā saha ।। 99।।
hatāste dviśatalakṣairyoddhṛbhiḥ sahitā raṇe ।
hareṇa svagaṇaiḥ sarve nāśitā māritā mṛdhe ।। 2.109.100 ।।
eko'pi nā'vaśiṣṭo'bhūddharasaṃgrāmayāyinām ।
evamete vinaṣṭāste catuṣkoṭiraṇaṃgamāḥ ।। 101 ।।
śeṣā prajāstathā sainyabhaṭāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rādhike! tadā ।। 102।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
mantraṃ dadau haristebhyaḥ ṛṣayaścā''jñayā hareḥ ।। 103 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne makaraketumadādipañcadaśabhūbhatāṃ sapādacatuṣkoṭisainyasahitānāṃ śaṃbhvādibhiḥ saha yuddhe maraṇācchiṣṭānāṃ pañcaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ śaraṇāgatirityādinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।109।।


← adhyāyaḥ 109 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 110
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 111 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ityevaṃ rādhike pūrvapṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntike ।
prāgjyotiṣādideśeṣu raṇo'bhūddānavāntakṛt ।। 1 ।।
tatasteṣāṃ viśuddhyarthaṃ yajñaṃ punastu vaiṣṇavam ।
śālāvatīnadīmūle lāśahāsarasastaṭe ।। 2 ।।
brahmaputrottare pārśve śatayojanavistare ।
sarovarā'bhitaścakre'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
samāhūtāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yuddhadeśīyamānavāḥ ।
vimānaiḥ sarvatobhadrairghaṭyā krośasahasragaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarve surāḥ samāyātāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ।
saptāhaścā'bhavad yajño'tyutkṛṣṭahavanādibhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
havyānāṃ nahi saṃkhyā'sti rasānāṃ gaṇanā'pi na ।
bhojyānāmapi nā'nto'sti peyānāṃ tatra kā kathā ।। 6 ।।
abjādhikā mahīmānāḥ saṃhatāstatra sāttvikāḥ ।
pārthivāśca narā nāryo yuddhaśuddhimabhīplavaḥ ।। 7 ।।
devānāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ gaṇanā tu na ।
āhūtāni ca tīrthāni nadā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ ।। 8 ।।
lāśahāsarasaścāpsu brahmaputrājaleṣu ca ।
śālāvatyāstathā nadyā mūle tīrthāni cāyayuḥ ।। 9 ।।
śatayojanavistāro bhūdeśo devatāśrayaḥ ।
goloka iva samabhūd vaikuṇṭha iva cā'bhavat ।। 2.110.1 0।।
brahmaloka iva vāpi hyakṣaraṃ ceva vā'bhavat ।
yatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।। 11 ।।
svayaṃ virājate yatra brahma brahmarṣayastathā ।
ṛṣayaśca surāścāpi jagatāṃ pitarastathā ।। 12।।
tatra kiṃ nāma vai nyūnaṃ rādhike! ṛddhivarjitam ।
yatra brahmapriyāḥ santi santi vai kalpavallayaḥ ।। 13।।
svayaṃ brahmā haro viṣṇuścāryamā tatra kā kṣatiḥ ।
yatra vahniḥ saptajihvaścaturvedadharo hyajaḥ ।। 14।।
pañcānanaḥ svayaṃ rudrastatra kā nyūnatā bhavet ।
lokakalyāṇadā devā īśvarā yatra sāttvikāḥ ।। 15।।
yatra mokṣapradāḥ śuddhā maharṣayaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
pāvanā lokaśuddhyarthaṃ militāstīrtharūpiṇaḥ ।। 16।।
yatra pravartate yajño vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavaiḥ suraiḥ ।
tatra kā nāma kalyāṇe nyūnabhūmiḥ prajāyate ।। 17।।
kalpavallyastathā muktā nadā nadyo drumāstathā ।
surāstattvāni cā'jahruryajñasāmagrikāḥ parāḥ ।। 18।।
pañcagavyāni sarvān vai pāyayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
ṛṣayo ye vimānasthā nārāyaṇasahasthitāḥ ।। 19।।
prajānāṃ yuddhagānāṃ ca dehaśuddhiṃ yathāvidhi ।
kārayāmāsurutsāhāt tato mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।2.110.20।।।
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvathā ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।।21।।
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ।।22।।
brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me ।।23।।
prathamaṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu samarpaṇam ।
ṣoḍaśākṣarayuktaṃ ca prathamaṃ ca dvitīyakam ।।24।।
tṛtīyaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ mantraṃ dvitriṃśadakṣaraṃ tathā ।
caturthaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ ca haryardhāṃgapradaṃ manum ।।।25।।
dvātriṃśadakṣaraṃ daduḥ ṛṣayaste caturdaśa ।
maṃkaṇako maṃkirayaḥ kūrmo prācīnabarhaṇaḥ ।।26।।
trītaḥ prabhūtānakaśca ruśāyī khāsanastathā ।
aṃgaśyāmaḥ ārakarṇo brahmadāso hyanāmayaḥ ।। 27।।
śyāmalarṣimalayarṣiścaite manūn dadustadā ।
havanottaramete vai prajābhyastaulasīḥ srajaḥ ।।28।।।
daduścā'bjapramāṇābhyaḥ prajābhyaḥ śāsanāddhareḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ।।29।।
yajñe mantraṃ dadustābhyaḥ pāvanyaścā'karotprajāḥ ।
lāśahāsalile sarvāḥ snāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।। 2.110.30 ।।
śālāvatyāśca salile brahmaputrījale tathā ।
evaṃ sarvāḥ prajā nārīrnarān bālāँśca bālikāḥ ।।3 1।।
pāvayāmāsa bhagavān sarvajñātīyamānavān ।
vahniṃ devān havyarasaiḥ santṛpya pitṛdevatāḥ ।। 32।।
pārṣadān kanyakāścāpi santṛpya yuddharakṣitān ।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān miṣṭānnairabjamānavān ।। 33।।
yajñaprasādamāsādya kṛtakṛtyāśca te'bhavan ।
avabhṛthaṃ vidhāyaiva sabhāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।34।।
ajamājñāpayāmāsa pāritoṣikahetave ।
brahmā natvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।। 35।।
prakāśaṃ prāha sarvābhyaḥ prajābhyo'bhayadānakam ।
parabrahmā'kṣarātītaḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ।।36।।
vāsudevādikavyūhā utpadyante yataḥ khalu ।
kālo mahāpūruṣaśca māyā yasya tu śaktayaḥ ।।37।।
avatārāśca dhāmāni jāyante yasya mūrtitaḥ ।
so'yaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo'sti svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।38।।
kaṃbharāśrīsutaḥ śrīmadgopālabālako hariḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre'kṣarakṣetre nivāsakṛt ।।3 9।।
kuṃkumavāpikāsaṃsthaḥ prabhāpāravatīpatiḥ ।
kṛṣṇābrahmapriyārādhāramālakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।2.110.40।।
māṇikīlalitāhaṃsāmañjulāsaguṇāpatiḥ ।
jayāśāntādayāmuktādevīhaimīkalāpatiḥ ।।41 ।।
satāṃ svāmī muktikāntaḥ sṛṣṭisvāmī pareśvaraḥ ।
sarvadhāmeśo'ntarātmā dehināṃ phaladaḥ svayam ।।42।।
yadāśrayeṇa jñātavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।
yatparo na samo yena kaścidanyo na vidyate ।।43 ।।
āruṇaiḥ prārthanīyā yā muktiḥ śāśvatikā parā ।
tasyā dātā tvayaṃ svāmī patiḥ kāntaḥ paro hariḥ ।।44।।
parāmuktiḥ sameṣṭavyā hyetasmācchrīharerjanāḥ ।
asmākaṃ vijayastvasya pratāpena sadā'sti vai ।।45।।
nārāyaṇādyāḥ satataṃ yaṃ bhajāmaḥ sa eva saḥ ।
asya mūrtiṃ pūjayadhvaṃ bhajadhvaṃ tvenameva ca ।।46।।
sevāmasya prakurudhvaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vacane'sya ca ।
asya vāṇī mahāvedā asya kriyā vṛṣo mahān ।।47।।
asya mūrtiḥ sadā sevyā hyayaṃ dhyeyaḥ sadā janaiḥ ।
asya sparśād pavitrā vai jāyante jaḍacetanāḥ ।।48।।
yuddhe hatāstu ye devā devapakṣāstathā ca ye ।
sajīvāḥ santu te sarve kṛpayā'sya kṣaṇādiha ।।49।।
pṛthvyāṃ jale'mbare ye vā mṛtā devānusāriṇaḥ ।
śīghraṃ bhavantu divyāste samāyāntu hariṃ prati ।।2.110.50।।
ityuktvā jalamādāya kamaṇḍalau hareḥ padāt ।
cikṣepa cāmbare brahmā jalaṃ tanmeghasadṛśam ।।5 1 ।।
vardhamānaṃ drutaṃ ca prā'sarad bhūvyomavāriṣu ।
amṛtaṃ tattadā bhūtvā jīvayāmāsa vai mṛtān ।।52।।
surapakṣān sarvajīvān kṛtrimānaparāँstathā ।
tadeva jalamevā'bhūt spṛṣṭaṃ dānavasuptiṣu ।।53।।
tathāpi dānavā naiva sajīvā abhavaँstadā ।
śrīśasvāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyecchā hi tādṛśī ।।54।।
spṛṣṭaṃ samaṃ surapakṣā jīvitā na tu dānavāḥ ।
atha brahma tadā tebhyo dadau mantracatuṣṭayam ।।55।।
jīvitebhyo haristatra pradadau pāritoṣikam ।
vijetṛbhyastathā tatra dadau supāritoṣikam ।।56।।
dehadvayaṃ muktiyogyaṃ caikaṃ paraṃ tu bhūsthitam ।
preṣayāmāsa tān sarvān muktiyogyān pade'kṣare ।।57।।
bhūyogyān bhagavānāha svayaṃ prasannamānasaḥ ।
yajñahavyaṃ prasādaṃ ca pānaṃ miṣṭaṃ subhojanam ।।58।।
gṛhṇantu ceti te sarve bhuktavantastadājñayā ।
atha rājakumārāँśca ṛṣīn sainyāni cāpi ca ।।59।।
samāhūya hariḥ prāha prajāśca sakalāstathā ।
pāvitā vai mayā deśā bhavatāṃ tīrtharūpiṇaḥ ।।2.110.6 0।।
kṛtā mokṣapradā nadyo nadāḥ sarāṃsi parvatāḥ ।
daityadānavanāśo'ti kṛtaścātra bhuvastale ।।61 ।।
ete rājakumārāśca vaiṣṇavāste mamāśritāḥ ।
mayā nṛpāsaneṣveva sthāpyante mama bālakāḥ ।।62।।
prajāścāpi bhavatyo me bālikāḥ santi sarvathā ।
nṛpā''jñāyāṃ pravartantu mamā''jñaiṣā hi śāśvatī ।।63।।
mama bhaktiṃ prakurvantu mānyā me ṛṣayastathā ।
śṛṇvantvapi vibhāgena yathā rājyaṃ dadāmi tat ।।64।।
ayaṃ brahmā prajānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
yasya nāma vadāmyasmai kirīṭaṃ pradadātu saḥ ।।65।।
jalapānadvīpabhūmirdīyate sūryaketave ।
philīpadvīpasaṃghātā dīyante bījajaṃgine ।।66।।
vāraṇīyadvīpabhūmiḥ sāraketāya dīyate ।
ārdramānadvīpabhūmiḥ raktakeśāya dīyate ।।67।।
dīyate prācīnarājyaṃ vijñavihaṃgamāya ca ।
piṃgacipiṃgarājyaṃ tu piṃgakeśāya dīyate ।।68।।
maṃgūbhūmirdāyate ca āhavamaṃgalāya tu ।
mañcuraṇo'rpyate prabhākirīṭāya pradeśakaḥ ।।69।।
lāśahākhyapradeśaśca trītarṣaye pradīyate ।
trītavittetināmnā ca prasiddhaṃ rājyamastu tat ।।2.110.70।।
ṛṣirājyaṃ bhavatvetad vasantu tatra cāruṇāḥ ।
chāyāśarīrarūpāśca brahmātmajñānavedinaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
kārurājyaṃ dīyate ca kūrmiṇe tu maharṣaye ।
ṛṣirājyaṃ tadapyastu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ।।72।।
ilādeśasya vai rājya svayaṃ brahmā karotu ca ।
brahmadeśaḥ sadā cā'stu tīrthaṃ cairāvatī nadī ।।73।।
pannāmanadikābhūmiṃ viṣṇuḥ praśāstu sarvadā ।
śyāmadeśo brahmapūrve pannāmnītīrthamastu ca ।।74।।
prākcayanākhyabhūmeśca rakṣako'stu śivaḥ sadā ।
vināyakāśca prācīnarakṣakāḥ santu tatparāḥ ।।75।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāṃ rājā'pi śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
svagaṇaiḥ saharājyaṃ tacchāstu prācīnadakṣiṇam ।।76 ।।
sumātṛke pradeśe ca tiṣṭhantu mātaraḥ sadā ।
śivasatyo rakṣaṇārthaṃ sāmudradaityanāśikāḥ ।।77।।
evametāni rājyāni bhavantu vaiṣṇavāni vai ।
iṭyevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena bhāṣitam ।।78।।
brahmā ca pradadau tasmai tasmai rājyakirīṭakam ।
harirdadau svayaṃ cāpi viṣṇave'jāya śaṃbhave ।। 79।।
tilakaṃ kaisaraṃ kṛtvā kaṇṭhīṃ mālāṃ ca taulasīm ।
nūtanebhyaśca pradadau bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tadā ।।2.110.8 0 ।।
athā''ha ca haristebhyo rājabhyo hitakṛdvacaḥ ।
guravo'pi mayā vo'tra dīyante bhaktihetave ।।8 1 ।।
karvarījalapānānāṃ guruḥ kūrmīti vai ṛṣiḥ ।
prācīnānāṃ philīpānānāṃ guruḥ śaṃbhurmaheśvaraḥ ।।8 2 । ।
prācīnottarabhāgānāṃ guruḥ prācīnabarhaṇaḥ ।
śyāmalānāṃ cipiṃgānāṃ guruḥ śyāmalako muniḥ ।।83 ।।
malayānāṃ malayarṣirilāyā brahmadāsakaḥ ।
lāśahānāṃ gurustrīto lūśānāṃ lūśayastathā ।।84।।
vāraṇānāṃ mātaraśca gurvyo bodhyāḥ ṛṣipriyāḥ ।
ārdramānagururbrahmā brāhmāṇāmapi viśvasṛṭ ।।85।।
maṃgūjānāṃ maṃkaṇako gurustaddeśavāsinām ।
maṃcūrāṇāṃ prajādīnāṃ maṃkirayo gururmataḥ ।।।86 ।।
bhūtānāṃ tu prabhūtānaḥ pannāmānāmanāmayaḥ ।
prākcayanapradeśānāṃ cayanarṣirgururmataḥ ।।87 ।।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgadeśānāmaṃgaśyāmalako guruḥ ।
ārākāṇāmārakarṇaḥ khasīnānāṃ tu khāsanaḥ ।। 88 ।।
ete taddeśarājānāṃ prajānāṃ guravaḥ sadā ।
maharṣayo mayā dattā mahābhāgavatottamāḥ । ।89 । ।
svīcakruste'pi rājāno vaiṣṇavā vaiṣṇavān gurūn ।
harṣaṃ prāpuśca te sarve ṛṣayo bhūbhṛtaḥ prajāḥ ।। 2.110.90 ।।
atha śrībhagavān bhaktahṛdayajñaḥ prajā''rttihā ।
abjarūpadharo bhūtvā mimile sarvadehinaḥ ।। 91 ।।
caraṇau pradadau sarvavakṣassu cihnaśobhitau ।
aṣṭakoṇaścordhvarekhā svastiko yavavajrakau ।। 92।।
jāmbūphalaṃ dhvajoṃ'kuśaḥ padmaṃ dakṣapade'bhavan ।
trikoṇaḥ kalaśaścāpi goṣpadaṃ ca dhanuṣyakam ।। 93 ।।
mīnā'rdhacandrakau vyoma vāme tu caraṇe'bhavan ।
kacchapaśca garuḍaśca śikharaṃ karihaṃsakau ।। 94।।
vimānaṃ sūryamevaite pādagrantheradho'bhavan ।
dakṣe pade harestatra ghuṭikā'ḍguṣṭhadigbhavā ।। 95।।
vāme tu ghuṭikānimne lakṣmīḥ saudhaṃ drumaśca gauḥ ।
siṃhāsanaṃ ca pañcaite pade samabhavan hareḥ । । 96।।
atha mīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikaśūlinam ।
padmabāṇadaṇḍayutaṃ dakṣaṃ karaṃ tu siddhidam । । 97।।
nirbhayacakrasahitaṃ śrīrekhaṃ samayūrakam ।
vaṃśīcihnaṃ kalpavallīyutaṃ cā'śvavṛṣānvitam । । 98।।
vāmaṃ karaṃ tu śubhadaṃ kṛtvā dvayostadā'ñjalim ।
prajānāṃ ca nṛpādīnāṃ pradadau mūrddhasu prabhuḥ । । 99।।
mudrikāḥ kalpaphaladāḥ pradadau pratimānavam ।
kalpamūrtiṃ nijāṃ pūjākarmaṇe pradadau prabhuḥ । । 2.110.100 । ।
annavastrarddhibāhulyaṃ pradadāvāśiṣastathā ।
dadau divyaṃ darśanaṃ ca paradhāmavirājitam । । 101 । ।
rādhike! kṛpayā yatra prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
tatra triguṇajīvānāṃ samo lābho harerbhavet । । 102। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāgjyotiṣādideśānāṃ vaiṣṇavanṛpavyavasthā, ṛṣivyavasthā, kṛpāvarṣaṇaṃ, divyadarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 110 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 110 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 111
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 112 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! divyakiśoraṃ darśanaṃ param ।
paradhāmagataṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 1 ।।
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ koṭikāmāśrayaṃ śubham ।
sarvatejomayaṃ sarvānandaśāntidayābhṛtam ।। 2।।
apārakaruṇāyuktaṃ tathā vātsalyaśevadhim ।
anantānanta sauhārdasnehapremaprapūritam ।। 3 ।।
sarvagandharasādyuktaṃ sarvapuṣṭibalānvitam ।
sarvābhṛtaprasavaṃ ca sarvasparśasukhapradam ।। 4 ।।
mukuṭādivibhūṣābhiḥ śobhitaṃ ca manoharam ।
divyāmbarasuśobhaṃ ca sarvacihnavirājitam ।। 5 ।।
rādhālakṣmīyutaṃ pārśve prabhāpāravatīyutam ।
māṇikīsahitaṃ divyaṃ brahmapriyābhivanditam ।। 6 ।।
asaṃkhyamuktadhāmādiprastutaṃ cāvatārakaiḥ ।
pārṣadairīśvaraiḥ sarvairīśvarībhirnataṃ tathā ।। 7 ।।
saguṇairnirguṇaistattvaiḥ sṛṣṭipālaiḥ pravanditam ।
ṛṣibhiḥ pitṛbhirdevairmānavairjaḍacetanaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
pātālavāsibhiścāpi śaktibhiśca stutaṃ prabhum ।
sarvaṃ yatra mamau sūkṣmaṃ yasmācca niryayāvidam ।। 9 ।।
sarvātmakaṃ tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ camatkāraprapūritam ।
sarvāścaryāśritaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ śrīkambharāsutam ।। 2.111.10 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
divyākṣaraṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ darśayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ।। 11 ।।
pitṛkanyā viṃśatiśca daśasāhasrasevikāḥ ।
sarvāstāḥ pitṛputryo vai mumuhuḥ śrīharau tadā ।। 1 2।।
vavrire kāntamātmānaṃ sarvātmavallabhaṃ prabhum ।
prajākanyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā vavrire kāntameva tam ।। 1 3।।
aryamṇā ca prajābhiśca bālakṛṣṇāya cārpitāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena svīkṛtāśca tāḥ ।। 14।।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca prāptavyaḥ prāpta eva yat ।
bhagavān svavimāneṣu tābhyo vāsaṃ tadā dadau ।। 15।।
athā'ryamāṇa bhagavānāha kārukaparvate ।
sindhumūle sadā mūtyā stheyaṃ tvayā'tra bhūtaye ।। 16।।
trītarājye cāruṇānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ paścime sthale ।
aryamaँstava rājyaṃ tad bhaviṣyati sukhāvaham ।। 17।।
ityevaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhāsvate ।
aryamṇe pradadau kurukarādriṃ sindhupārśvagam ।। 18।।
āruṇā divyavasanā divyarūpāśca tatstriyaḥ ।
prāpya tat sundaraṃ sthānaṃ mumudurdevatā iva ।। 19।।
kaṃ sukhaṃ tatpradā yā aśmanām irā kṣitiḥ śubhā ।
kaśmerā parvatabhūmiḥ kāruparvataśobhanā ।।2.111.20।।
tatrā'ryamā svayaṃ vāsaṃ cakre śrīsahitaḥ sadā ।
śrībhūmiḥ pāvanī sā cā'bhavacchrīnagarī sadā ।।21 ।।
evaṃ sarvaṃ vyavasthāpya haristīrthavidhitsayā ।
vidhāpayituṃ tīrthāni nadīrnadān sarāṃsi ca ।।22।।
prajāḥ svasvapradeśāँśca gantumājñāpya vai tataḥ ।
vimānairniryayau kṛṣṇo yātumādiśya vai nṛpān ।।23।।
brahmapriyākumārībhirdevapitrarṣibhiḥ saha ।
sasnau sa brahmaputryāṃ vai lāśahākhyasarojale ।।24।।
tataḥ sasnau sindhumūle tataśca terimājale ।
āmūrāyā jale sasnau homāṃgāyā jale tataḥ ।।25।।
mahatyāśca jale aṃgaśikṣāṃgāyā jale tataḥ ।
śikṣāṃgāyā jale sasnau manikaṅgvā jale tataḥ ।।26।।
pannāmnyāśca jale cāpi śālāvatyā jale'pi ca ।
irāvatyā jale snātvā sundarāraṇyamāyayau ।।27।।।
pitṛkanyā hariḥ prāha bhavatyo'tra mama priyāḥ ।
dvirūpiṇyo bhavantveva mūlacchāyātmikāḥ śubhāḥ ।।28।।
mūlātmikā mama kṣetre vasantu tu mayā saha ।
chāyātmikā nadīrūpā vasantu tīrthabhūmigāḥ ।।29।।
brahmaputrī lavahītā candrāvatī irāvatī ।
śālāvatī mīnakaṅgū lāṭiśā kāniśā tathā ।।2.111.3 0।।
māpīṃgā cāpi sīkyāṃgā aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgikā ।
mauktikā tārimā cāpi pannāmā tvāṃgahā tathā ।।3 1 ।।
mannāmnī maṇivarṇā ca raṃgavarṇā ca sundarī ।
etāḥ sarvāḥ svanāmnaiva khyātiṃ yāsyatha me priyāḥ ।। 32।।
bhavatibhyo mayā dattaṃ sāmarthyaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
mokṣadaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ putrādisampradam ।। 3 3।।
bhavatīnāṃ mahimānaṃ kathayāmi mama priyāḥ! ।
yāsāṃ sākṣāddhareryogo divyatāpādakaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 34।।
muktatādāyako yogo yāsāṃ nārāyaṇena vai ।
tāsāṃ vai divyatā nityamuktatā kamalāsamā ।।35।।
rādhikayā samā lakṣmyā samāḥ śriyā samāstathā ।
yūyaṃ prabhāsamā divyā yūyaṃ pāravatīsamāḥ ।।36।।
yūyaṃ vai māṇikītulyā mama prāṇasamāḥ priyāḥ ।
yuṣmatsaṃsargamāptānāṃ mama dhāmni nivāsanam ।।37।।
bhavatīnāṃ jale snātā ye pakṣipaśavo janāḥ ।
kīṭāḥ pataṃgajantvādyāste yāsyanti paraṃ padam ।।38।।
yathā gaṃgā ca yamunā yathā sarasvatī satī ।
tathā yūyaṃ sarvamokṣapradā divyāḥ stha tārikāḥ ।।39।।
yathā ca gaṇḍakī śreṣṭhā gomatī svarṇalekhikā ।
tathā yūyaṃ sadā me vai nivāsārhāḥ stha yoṣitaḥ ।।2.111.40।।
mama mūrterjalaṃ yadvat tattathaiva ca vo jalam ।
brahmakamaṇḍaluvārisadṛśaṃ vo jalaṃ śubham ।।41।।
virājāyā yathā vāri brahmahradajalaṃ yathā ।
pāvanaṃ vo jalaṃ yadvadāmūla vārdhisaṃgamāt ।।42।।
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ ghātahatyādibhāvinām ।
akṛtyajāyamānānāṃ kṣālanaṃ vo jale sadā ।।43।।
pītaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaṃ ghrātaṃ cācamanīkṛtam ।
kaṇamātrajalaṃ vo'stu pāvakaṃ mama yogataḥ ।।44।।
āsurā rākṣasā daityā mlecchāḥ pāpāśca dānavāḥ ।
śuddhimeṣyanti salilādbhavatīnāṃ yuge yuge ।।45।।
pretā bhūtā rākṣasādyā asadgatigatāstathā ।
yadākadācit snānena muktimeṣyanti vai kṣaṇāt ।।46।।
śālāvatyā cāṃgaśikṣāyā madhye tu mayā kratuḥ ।
menakāṃgātaṭe yatra prathamastu kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ।।47।।
tathātra lāśahānāmnastaḍāgasya samīpataḥ ।
dvitīyo'yaṃ mahāyajñaḥ kṛto vai vaiṣṇavaḥ śubhaḥ ।।48।।
ādyā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśī golokena samā parā ।
bhūmirdivyā bhavatīnāṃ yogācca mokṣasadṛśī ।।49।।
tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvā mama pārṣadarūpiṇī ।
mama brahmapriyātulyāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ striyo'pi ca ।।2.111.50।।
bālā madbālatulyāśca vṛddhā me vṛddhasadṛśāḥ ।
samānā me samabhāvāḥ pāvanā mama yogataḥ ।।5 1 ।।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe vāsaṃ kurvāṇā dehinaḥ khalu ।
jarā'ṇḍasvedabhedotthāścatvāro'pi prajīvinaḥ ।।52।।
pāvanā me bhaktiyuktā viṣṇutulyā matā mama ।
bhavatīnāṃ jale vāsaṃ kurvāṇā jantavastu ye ।।53।।
sadā vaikuṇṭhavāsāste bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ kaṇavyāptāḥ pavanā yānti yaddiśam ।।54।।
te deśāḥ pāvanā viṣṇulokatulyā hi dehinām ।
bhavatīnāṃ jale yeṣāmasthikhaṇḍaḥ patedapi ।।5 5 ।।
yadvā bhasma śavasyāpi patetsvalpaṃ yadā tadā ।
te jīvāḥ pāvanā bhūtvā yāsyanti mama dhāma vai ।।56।।
bhavatīnāṃ smaraṇena prātarnāmnā tu yāḥ prajāḥ ।
yatra kvāpi kariṣyanti snānaṃ vāpījalādiṣu ।।57।।
gṛhe vā parvate'raṇye samudre yānavāhane ।
brahmaputryādināmneva te prāpsyanti kratoḥ phalam ।।58।।
atha gaṃgā cājanābhe abrikte ca narāyaṇī ।
irāvatī brahmadeśe trivitte brahmaputrikā ।।59।।
śyāmadeśe menakāṃgā prācīneṃ'gaśivāṃgikā ।
sarvāstā gomatītulyā golokā''vāsadāyikāḥ ।।2.111.6 0।।
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ yāyāt snātvā smṛtvā'pi mānavaḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe kaścid dāsyatyapi ca ḍhabbukam ।।6 1 ।।
koṭimudrāpradānasya phalamāpsyati mānavaḥ ।
rūpyakaṃ vā svarṇamudrāṃ ratnaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ca vā ।।62।।
mauktikaṃ cāpi māṇikyaṃ maṇiṃ tāmraṃ varāṭikām ।
dāne dāsyanti ye tīre teṣāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam ।।63 ।।
vastraṃ bhūṣāḥ kajjalādi śṛṃgāraṃ candanādikam ।
pāduke vāhanaṃ vāpi tathopakaraṇādikam ।।64।।
gṛhaṃ gṛhasya sāmagrīścānnaṃ rasaṃ ca bhojanam ।
yo vā dāsyati bhāvena tasya puṇyamanantakam ।।65 ।।
gajaṃ cāśvamajāṃ dhenuṃ dogdhrīṃ kanyāṃ ca vāṭikām ।
dāne dāsyati tīre vastasya puṇyamanantakam ।।6 6 ।।
vidyāṃ vidyārthināṃ cāpi sāhāyyaṃ pāṭhaśālikām ।
dāsyati vastaṭe teṣāṃ svargaṃ syāt samanantakam ।।67।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī jalāddhastacatuṣṭaye ।
tīre dānapradātāro yāsyanti mama dhāma te ।।68।।
nārīṇāṃ cāpi bālānāmanāthānāṃ ca yoginām ।
sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sevāṃ kartavyā'nantapuṇyadā ।।69।।
anaṃgānāmadhanānāmagṛhāṇāmanāyuṣām ।
sevanaṃ vastaṭe kāryaṃ tasya puṇyamanantakam ।।2.111.70 ।।
māghe pūrvadale yajñaḥ prathamaḥ pañcamītithau ।
samārabdho menakāṃgātaṭe tatra dine tu yaḥ ।।71 ।।
kariṣyati kratuṃ tatra vaiṣṇavaṃ raudrameva vā ।
svargarājyaṃ brahmarājyaṃ prāpsyanti mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।72।।
ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kṛtā tasyeti taddine ।
bhojanādīni dāsyanti prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim ।।73।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
ārabhya kārayiṣyanti prāpsyanti mama dhāma te ।।74।।
mandire mama tatraivotsavaṃ ca mama sannidhau ।
kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāsteṣāṃ mokṣastu śāśvataḥ ।।75।।
dṛḍhaṃ ca mandiraṃ nūnaṃ kārayitvā tu tattaṭe ।
lakṣmīrādhāprabhāpāravatīśrīmāṇikīyutam ।।76 ।।
saptamūrtisvarūpaṃ mā sthāpayiṣyanti ye janāḥ ।
tebhyo dhāma paraṃ sthānaṃ dāsyāmi mama śobhanam ।।77।।
pūjāpravāhaṃ vṛttiṃ ca jīvanaṃ dānabhojanam ।
dāsyanti ye bhavatīnāṃ taṭe manmandire janāḥ ।।78।।
tebhyaḥ svargāṇi ramyāṇi dhāmāni dyutimanti ca ।
dāsyāmyajasraṃ divyāni śāśvatāni na saṃśayaḥ ।।79।।
mandire dīpadānaṃ ca bhavatīnāṃ jale tathā ।
dīpadānaṃ kariṣyanti teṣāṃ cakṣurhi śāśvatam ।।2.111.80।।
sarvaṃ jñānamayaṃ divyaṃ vidhāsye muktidaṃ śubham ।
tulasīṃ campakaṃ padmaṃ tadudyānaṃ phalānvitam ।।8 1 ।।
kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāstānnayiṣyekṣarālayam ।
mama vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ pūjāṃ bhojanadakṣiṇām ।।82।।
sevāṃ pādasya dāsyaṃ vā kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ।
sādhvīnāṃ vā pārṣadānāṃ kariṣyanti prasevanam ।।83 ।।
annadhanā'mbareṣṭādyaistānnayiṣye'kṣaraṃ padam ।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe ramye grāme cāvasathādiṣu ।।84।।
sādhurūpeṇa satataṃ vicariṣyāmi vallabhaḥ ।
sādhvīrūpeṇa me patnyo vicariṣyanti sarvadā ।।85।।
tāsāṃ pūjā'nnadānādyaiḥ kāryā svaśreyase janaiḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ jale tāśca snāsyanti tīrthahetave ।।86।।
mama bhaktāvatārāśca me'vatārā yuge yuge ।
snāsyanti bhavatīnāṃ vai salileṣu punaḥ punaḥ ।।87।।
māghe saritsu caitāsu ye tu snāsyanti dehinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ pāpāni vilayaṃ yāsyanti koṭijanmanām ।। 88।।
nadīnāṃ saṃgamādau ca kuṃbhalagne tu ye janāḥ ।
snāsyanti dūrato gatvā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ।।89।।
mayā kṛpayā pitṛkanyāstīrthīkṛtāḥ sadā ।
matpriyā bhavathā'to vai mattulyā nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.111.90।।
māghamāse bhavatīnāṃ jaleṣu svargavāsinaḥ ।
devāśca pitaraścāpi samāyāsyanti nityaśa ।।9 1 ।।
sarvatīrthāni lokebhyaścāgamiṣyanti sarvataḥ ।
koṭitīrthātmakaṃ vāri bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 92।।
satyaṃ svargādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatīnāṃ jale tadā ।
bhaviṣyati na sandeho yūyaṃ śreṣṭhatamāstataḥ ।।93 ।।
tattaddeśodbhavāḥ santo nivatsyanti hi vastaṭe ।
bhavatīnāṃ supāvitryaṃ vardhayiṣyanti sādhavaḥ ।।94।।
putrapautrakalatrādidhanadhānyā'mbarādikam ।
bhūṣākṣetrodyānarājyasampatsmṛddhipradaṃ tathā ।।95।।
sarveṣṭasukhadaṃ svargamokṣadaṃ vaṃśadaṃ śubham ।
bhavatīnāṃ jale snānaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāsyati ।। 96 ।।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe vāsakṛtāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati ।
muṇḍanaṃ kārayiṣyanti ye tatpāpāni sarvathā ।।97।।
nāśameṣyanti ca śuddhiṃ yāsyanti cātmanāṃ tataḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe dīkṣāṃ grahīṣyanti narāḥ striyaḥ ।। 98।।
te muktā mama dhāmasthatulyā dehayutā api ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ।। 99।।
anāthapālanaṃ gopālanaṃ dīnasahāyanam ।
kariṣyanti janā ye'tra taṭe te mokṣabhāginaḥ ।। 2.111.1 00।।
kumāradānakartāraḥ kanyādānavidhāyinaḥ ।
brahmadhāmagatiṃ cānte yāsyanti śāśvataṃ padam ।। 101 ।।
bhavatīnāṃ jale tvekavāraṃ snāsyanti ye janāḥ ।
smṛtvā śatakulānyeva tāni yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।। 1 02।।
bhavatīnāṃ taṭe śrāddhaṃ mṛtānāṃ puṇyasatkriyāḥ ।
devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ vṛkṣe jalapānaṃ tathā''layam ।। 103 ।।
āśrayaṃ dharmaśālāṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ vipadātmanām ।
kariṣyanti janā ye'tra te prāpsyanti parāṃ gatim ।। 1 04।।
bhavatīnāṃ mandirāṇi kāriṣyanti ye janāḥ ।
kuladevīṃ kūlavāsā mānayiṣyanti vaśca ye ।। 105 ।।
pūjayiṣyanti vividhairnūtanairmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ ।
jalapuṣpaphalārghyaiśca teṣāṃ svargaṃ hi śāśvatam ।। 1 06।।
avagrahā'tivṛṣṭyādipīḍā teṣāṃ na vai bhavet ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ mama śiṣyāṇāṃ mandire pratimārcanam ।। 1 07।।
kariṣyanti janāsteṣāṃ dāridryaṃ naiva dṛśyate ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! tābhyo dadāvāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ ।। 1 08। ।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne brahmaputryādibhyo hariṇā dattadivyadarśanam, daśasahasrāṇi viṃśatiśceti kanyakā'rpaṇam, aryamṇe kaśmerāpradeśarājya-
dānam, brahmaputryādīnāṃ nadīrūpeṇāpi bhavanam, tāsu harikṛtasnānam, varadānāni, tīrthaphalāni, dānaphalāni cetinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 111 ।।
