adhyāyaḥ 112
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 113 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! tābhirnadībhiryattadā'rthitam ।
tvayā kṛṣṇa! vayaṃ sarvāstīrthīkṛtāḥ kṛpāvaśāt । । 1 ।।
sarvadevanivāsāँśca pradehyasmattaṭeṣviha ।
ityasmākaṃ susaṃkalpaṃ prapūraya prabhāpate ।। 2 ।।
śrutvā prāha mahārājaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevā''hvanāya vai ।। 3 ।।
tridevāḥ sasmarurdevān trayastriṃśatprakoṭikān ।
sarve tūrṇaṃ samājagmuryatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vane vai sundarākhye te samāgatya narāyaṇam ।
namaścakruḥ samīhānā ājñāṃ nārāyaṇasya te ।। 5 ।।
hariḥ prāha vasūnaṣṭau rudrānekādaśaiva ca ।
dvādaśādityavaryāścā'śvinau dvau lokahetave ।। 6 ।।
bhavanto bhinnarūpaiśca tiṣṭhantu tīrthakāmyayā ।
brahmaputryādisalile lokapāvanahetave ।। 7 ।।
tata ārabhya tanmūle vasavo vāsamācaran ।
saṃgameṣvādityavaryā rudrāḥ samudrasaṃgame ।। 8 ।।
aśvinau vakragatyādau vāsān samācaraँstataḥ ।
indrādyāśca diśāṃ pālā aṣṭau teṣāṃ hradeṣu ca ।। 9 ।।
saptarṣayastīravaneṣvavasan yatra parvatāḥ ।
navagrahā nivāsaṃ cā'kurvan nagarasannidhau ।। 2.112.1 0।।
maruddevāśca tīreṣu svalpasaritsamāgame ।
catuḥṣaṣṭimahāyoginyaścā'vasan samucchraye ।। 11 ।।
avatāreṣu sarvatrā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamaṇḍalam ।
vālakhilyāḥ pitaraścarṣayo viśvesurāstathā ।। 12।।
siddhāścāsāṃ pramārgeṣu nyavasaँstīrtharūpiṇaḥ ।
ityevaṃ śrīharistābhyastīrthāni pradadau svayam ।। 13।।
eteṣāṃ tu nivāseṣu yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ ।
kriyamāṇā yajamāne śāśvatapuṇyakārikāḥ ।। 14।।
māghakṛṣṇaikādaśikottaraṃ punarmṛdho'bhavat ।
saptāhastatra vai sarvān daityān vināśya mādhavaḥ ।। 15।।
cakre dvitīyayajñaṃ sa māghe site tu pañcame ।
dine saptāhayajñaḥ sa pūrṇo'bhavad vrate dine ।। 16।।
ekādaśyāṃ kṛtaṃ tasyā'vabhṛthaṃ ca tataḥ param ।
caturdināni sarvāsāṃ jaleṣu snānamācarat ।। 17।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpūrṇimātithau ।
āyayau ca vimānena vanaṃ sundarasaṃjñakam ।। 18 ।।
tasmāttīrthāni sarvāṇi lāśahākhye sarovare ।
śālāvatyā brahmaputryā jale saptāhake'tra vai ।। 1 9।।
vasanti ca samāyānti māghaśukle viśeṣataḥ ।
saritsvanyāsu ca caturdineṣu saṃvasanti ca ।। 2.112.20।।
tatra dānaṃ gavāṃ deyaṃ gajānāṃ vājināṃ tathā ।
ajānāṃ ca tathoṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ deyamityapi ।।21 ।।
kambalānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ yānānāṃ dānamuttamam ।
vimānānāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ deyamityapi ।। 22 ।।
annānāṃ vividhānāṃ ca dvidalānāṃ pradānakam ।
śākānāṃ cāpi pātrāṇāṃ kandānāṃ deyamityapi ।। 23।।
kaṇānāṃ surasānāṃ ca śarkarāṇāṃ patattriṇām ।
patrāṇāmikṣudaṇḍānāṃ phalānāṃ deyamityapi ।।24।।
peṭikānāṃ mañjuṣāṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ dānamuttamam ।
mañcopakaraṇānāṃ ca svarṇasya rajatasya ca ।।25।।
mudrādeśca dhanasyāpi kartavyaṃ dānamityapi ।
vidyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ dāsadānaṃ tathottamam ।।26।।
dāsīdānaṃ pradātavyaṃ mokṣadānaṃ mahottamam ।
jñānadānaṃ kathādānaṃ putradānaṃ svadānakam ।।27।।
kanyādānaṃ pradātavyaṃ yogyāya tu varāya ca ।
saudhadānaṃ tathā śayyādānaṃ paryaṃkadānakam ।।28।।
kartavyaṃ daivapuruṣe daivīsatyāṃ phalapradam ।
devamūrtipradānaṃ ca svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ।।29।।
dehadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kaṭidānaṃ parātmane ।
sarvadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ śrīśāya paramātmane ।।2.112.3 0 ।।
ātmadānaṃ sadā deyaṃ gurave mokṣadāya vai ।
pustakānāṃ pāṭhadānaṃ kartavyaṃ pāṭhine sadā ।।31 ।।
māghe sarvāṇi dānāni sarvamāseṣvapi dhruvam ।
kartavyāni sakāmaistu labhyate phalamakṣaram ।।32।।
raktadānaṃ vāṣpadānaṃ garbhadānaṃ tathā striyāḥ ।
ratidānaṃ pradātavyaṃ auṣadhādipradānakam ।। 33।।
nārāyaṇabaliḥ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ mṛtamuktidam ।
āśrayā ālayā dharmaśālā makhāśca tattaṭe ।।34।।
annasatrāṇi kāryāṇi vṛddhānāmāśrayāstathā ।
vidyānāmāśrayāḥ kāryāḥ kanyā'nāthāśrayāstathā ।।35।।
vidhavānāṃ vidhurāṇāmāśrayāḥ karmayojakāḥ ।
kartavyā dhanibhistāsāṃ nadīnāṃ tīrabhūmiṣu ।। 36 ।।
lokasevāpravāhāśca kāraṇīyāḥ samantataḥ ।
paropakārāḥ kartavyā mānavairnarayoṣitām ।।37।।
tīrthekṛtāni tānyeva koṭiguṇaphalāni vai ।
kālamānapradānaṃ ca vidyunmānapradānakam ।।38।।
aṃgadānapradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tīrthabhūmiṣu ।
yantradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pratibimbapradānakam ।। 39।।
dūraśravaṇadṛṣṭyādiyantradānaṃ tathottamam ।
deyaṃ kṛṣihalādyaṃ ca sādhanaṃ mahaduttamam ।।2.112.40 ।।
atha deyaṃ sugandhyādi puṣpasāraṃ saduttaram ।
gandhasāraṃ rasasāraṃ sārasāraṃ parātparam ।।41 ।।
brahmaputrī sthāpanīyā caturhastā'tisundarī ।
lavahītā sthāpanīyā dvihastā ramaṇī satī ।।42।।।
candrāvatī sthāpanīyā ṣoḍaśakaraśālinī ।
irāvatī sthāpanīyā aṣṭahastā sukanyakā ।।43।।
śālāvatī sthāpanīyā caturhastā manoharā ।
menakāṃgā manikaṅgū sthāpanīye caturbhuje ।।44।।
lāṭiśā kāniśā sthāpye dvibhuje kanyake śubhe ।
māpīṃgā cāpi sīkyāṃgā sthāpye'ṣṭakaraśālinī ।।45।।
aṣṭādaśabhuje sthāpye aṃgasvāṃgā harāṃgikā ।
mauktikā tārimā sthāpye dvibhuje cittakarṣike ।।46 ।।
pannāmnī tvaṃgahā sthāpye dvibhuje ca surūpiṇī ।
mannāmnī maṇivarṇā ca sthāpye daśabhuje śubhe ।।47।।
raṃgavarṇā tathā sthāpyā caturbhujā nadī satī ।
ityevaṃ kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ rūpāṇi saritāṃ priye ।।48।।
kṛtvodbhinnayuvatītvabhāvāpannāni sarvathā ।
suhāsyasaumyavātsalyayuktānanāni rādhike ।।49।।
śvetacampakavarṇāni svarṇakāntiyutāni ca ।
kārayitvā pratimāśca mandirāṇi śubhāni ca ।।2.112.50 ।।
sthāpanīyānyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।
sahitāni kiśoreṇa ramyāṇi mānavairbhuvi ।।5 1 ।।
tattannadīpradeśānāṃ prajānāṃ tā hi mātaraḥ ।
pūjitā vanditā nityaṃ kariṣyanti prajā'vanam ।।52।।
tābhyo bhūṣāḥ pradātavyā nārībhiḥ patikāmyayā ।
saubhāgyadāśca tāḥ santi nārīṇāṃ pūjitāḥ sadā ।।।53 ।।
avaidhavyapradāścāpi tathā''yuṣyavivardhikāḥ ।
putrapautrapradāścāpyārogyadā dhanadhānyadāḥ ।।54।।
tābhyaḥ śāṭyaḥ pradātavyāḥ kaṃcukyaścolikāstathā ।
keśatailaṃ pradātavyaṃ keśaśṛṃgārakādikam ।।55।।
puṣpahārāḥ kajjalaṃ ca tailaṃ sugandhasārakam ।
ghargharyaḥ kavacaṃ vastraṃ tathā matsaravāriṇī ।।56 ।।
śayyā gendukamutkṛṣṭaṃ mṛdulaṃ guptadorakam ।
utarīyaṃ keśakāñcī pradeyā sarite janaiḥ ।।57।।
siṃhāsanaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ chatraṃ ca hāṭakādijam ।
mukuṭaṃ tantikā kāñcī raśanā kaṭakādikam ।।58 ।।
ūrmikā'ṅgulīyakāni śṛṃkhalāśca nupūrakam ।
hārāḥ suvarṇajanyāśca svastikaścandrakastathā ।। 59 ।।
binduścandrakapaṭṭī ca nakharañjanakāni ca ।
bhojyapānāni deyāni mandire saritāṃ janaiḥ ।।2.112.6 0 ।।
kaṃkatirdorakaścāpi cipīṭakaśca rājataḥ ।
sukiṃkiṇījālayuktacaḍḍikā pādayostathā ।।6 1 ।।
dhūpo dīpaśca naivedyaṃ tathā nīrājanādikam ।
kalaśaścānyavastūni deyāni saritāṃ gṛhe ।।62।।
kanyakābhiḥ kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatā deyāśca śarkarāḥ ।
suvāsanībhiḥ śṛṃgārāmbarabhūṣādi saubhagam ।।63 ।।
dātavyaṃ vai nadībhyaśca haripriyābhya uttamam ।
preṅkhā deyā ghoṭakādi dolā pālanamityapi ।।64।।
vātayānaṃ vāṣpayānaṃ vahniyānaṃ tathā śubham ।
uṣṇayānaṃ prabhāyānaṃ cāṇuyānaṃ samuttamam ।।65।।
pradātavyaṃ vihārārthaṃ vyomni jale tathā'mbare ।
jalayānaṃ cāśvayānaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūvihāri ca ।।66 ।।
jalarūpāṃ mūrtirūpāṃ pitṛkanyāṃ sutoṣayet ।
tāsu bhagavatpatnīṣu tuṣṭāsu tuṣyati prabhuḥ ।।67।।
tāsāṃ mahotsavāḥ kāryā māghe kṛṣṇe site tathā ।
tāsāmagre prakartavyaṃ nṛtyaṃ vāditravādanam ।।68 ।।
kīrtanaṃ bhagavadgānaṃ stavanaṃ sāmavaidikam ।
koṭihīrakaratnādyaiḥ śobhanīyāśca tāstadā ।।69।।
puṣpasugandhaśobhādyairarcanīyā haripriyāḥ ।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle brahmapriyāyutaḥ ।।2.112.70।।
pitṛkanyāyuto'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
pūjanīyo'tibhāvena śobhanīyo'tivastubhiḥ ।।7 1।।
śṛṃgāraṇīyo bhagavān tadā rājādhirājavat ।
svarṇahārādibhiḥ svarṇatantvambarādibhistathā ।।72।।
aṣṭottaraśataiścāpi bhakṣyabhojyādibhistathā ।
paricaryādibhiḥ kṛṣṇastoṣaṇīyo'tigītibhiḥ ।।73।।
rāśairmanoharaiścāpi naranārīsumiśritaiḥ ।
nagare nagare grāme vane cāvasatheṣvapi ।।74।।
ghoṣe ca pattane pūre rājadhānyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
tābhistābhiḥ supatnībhiḥ saha nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।75।।
gajayānairaśvayānaiḥ svarṇaśakaṭībhistathā ।
rājatībhiḥ śakaṭībhiḥ kalaśadhvajāpārṣadaiḥ ।।76।।
sahitābhiḥ śubhābhiśca bhrāmayitavya eva saḥ ।
rathaśca sevakaiḥ sthirīkartavyaḥ praticatvaram ।।77।।
pratihaṭṭaṃ pratirathyaṃ pratyāpaṇaṃ ca gopure ।
pūjanīyaḥ śrīphalādyaiḥ pratirājagṛhaṃ tathā ।।78।।
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ prakartavyā'kṣatalājādimiśritā ।
candanaṃ gandhasalilaṃ prokṣaṇe deyameva tu ।।79।।
miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭapānīyaṃ pātavyaṃ cārthine rathāt ।
prasādaśca pradātavyo bhaktebhyaḥ pathi sarvathā ।।2.112.80।।
tūryāṇi rājatūryāṇi vādanīyāni cāgrataḥ ।
dhūpadīpasahito'yaṃ bhrāmaṇotsava uttamaḥ ।।8 1।।
kartavyaḥ kārtike kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇajanmamahotsavaḥ ।
evaṃ vai bhrāmayitvaiva bhagavantaṃ priyāyutam ।।82।।
viśāle maṇḍape rātrau sthāpanīyo gajāsane ।
nīrājanaṃ prakartavyaṃ śatāṣṭavarttibhistataḥ ।।83।।
rāsastatra prakartavyastālikādaṇḍikādibhiḥ ।
vāditrairvividhaiścāpi kathā kāryā tadā hareḥ ।।84।।
pūjanaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva parihāraṃ samācaret ।
rātrau tanmandire neyo bhagavān saha patnībhiḥ ।।85।।
tato bhaktaiḥ prakartavyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tathā'thavā ।
suptavyaṃ svagṛhe gatvā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaiḥ ।।86।।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā kṛtvā darśanapūjanam ।
tato dānādi kartavyaṃ navamyāṃ prātarityapi ।।87।।
tasya puṇyasya nānto'sti paramokṣapradaṃ hi tat ।
evaṃ mahotsave kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasīdati ।।88।।
saritaśca prasīdanti dadatyatīva sampadaḥ ।
dhanadhānyādisamṛddhīrdadatyapi navā navāḥ ।।89।।
ārogyaṃ putrapautrādi gomahiṣī dhanānyapi ।
aśvahastyuṣṭrayānāni vimānaṃ rājasampadaḥ ।।2.112.90 ।।
kīrtiṃ svarṇaṃ pūjyatāṃ ca loke khyātiṃ parāṃ sthitim ।
dadatyeva saricchreṣṭhāstuṣṭāḥ śrīpatinā saha ।। 91 ।।
ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
gṛhe gṛhe prarakṣyā me pratimā saritā saha ।। 92।।
pūjanīyā sadā prātarmadhyāhne sāyamityapi ।
kariṣye tanmana_ pūrṇaṃ sveṣṭaṃ dāsye punaḥ punaḥ ।। 92 ।।
ityāha bhagavāँstābhyaḥ satībhyastatra sundare ।
vane paścād brahmaputrīsāgare sasnureva ca ।। 94।।
gaṃgāsāgarayoge ca sasnuḥ sarvavimānagāḥ ।
sākaṃ bhagavatā svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।। 95।।
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā pupūjuśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
dadhyurnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ hṛdayeṣu sthirīkṛtām ।।96।।
ityetad rādhike! tubhyaṃ mayoktaṃ hariceṣṭitam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ।।97।।
svargamokṣapradaṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।
sarvadā kīrtanīyaṃ vai bhaktairapi mumukṣubhiḥ ।।98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dvitīyayajñabhūmirūpalāśahāsarovarasaritāṃ mūrtyādipūjanapratiṣṭhāmāhātmyavarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 2 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 112 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 113
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 114 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha śrīrādhike! kṛṣṇapriyāstāḥ pitṛkanyakāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ papracchurādarāt ।। 1 ।।
asmākaṃ mahimā kānta kṛpayā vardhitastvayā ।
śrīmataśca mahimānaṃ jñāsyāmaśca yathā vayam ।। 2 ।।
tava no vada sarvātman mokṣo'nte no yathā bhavet ।
ityukto bhavanāśādivihīno bhagavān prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
āha tābhyaḥ svarūpasya jñānaṃ bhaktisahāyakṛt ।
jīvalokātpare santi īśvarāṇāṃ hi bhūmayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vāsudevādayastatra vasanti vyūhakoṭayaḥ ।
goloke'haṃ rādhayā sevitaḥ kṛṣṇo vasāmi ca ।। 5 ।।
vaikuṇṭhe'haṃ śriyā yukto nārāyaṇo vasāmi vai ।
tatpare cākṣare dhāmni vartāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।। 6 ।।
akṣarātītasaṃjño'haṃ dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
parataścākṣarāccāpi paro'smi paradhāmani ।। 7 ।।
asaṃkhyamuktasevyo'haṃ brahmapriyāprasevitaḥ ।
mama romaikāṇudeśādutpannaṃ teja aiśvaram ।। 8 ।।
sarveśvareṣu tad vyāptaṃ pūrṇamiva prajāyate ।
madekaguṇaleśena bhavantīśā guṇocchrayāḥ ।। 9 ।।
mama saṃkalpamātreṇa cāvatārā bhavanti hi ।
sṛṣṭayaścā'pyasaṃkhyātā matpuruṣecchayā khalu ।। 2.113.1 0।।।
jāyante'nantasaṃkhyākāstatrā'ntaryāmyahaṃ sthitaḥ ।
antarbahiśca bhūtānāṃ yathāsthānaṃ vasāmyaham ।। 11 ।।
yathākāryaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ yathābhaktānusevanam ।
tathā bhūtvā nivasāmi bhaktavṛndeṣu matpriyāḥ ।। 1 2।।
kvacid bhavāmi ceśeṣu kvacid deveṣu vā divi ।
ṛṣivaryeṣu bhakteṣu kvacinmānavajātiṣu ।। 13।।
kvacijjale sthale'raṇye śaile pṛthvyāṃ ca gahvare ।
paśau pakṣiṇi yādassu vṛkṣe vallyāṃ tṛṇādiṣu ।। 14।।
yathākāryaṃ bhavāmyeva naro nārī ca vetaraḥ ।
rājā prajā'thavā dīnaḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī ca kāminī ।। 15।।
gopālo vāpi gobālo gojālo gopikāpatiḥ ।
kalpe yuge dine lagne'vatāro me dhruvaṃ priyāḥ ।। 16।।
idānīṃ bālakṛṣṇo'smi śrīkaṃbharāsatīsutaḥ ।
koṭyabjakanyakākāntaḥ kanyecchāpūraṇārthakaḥ ।। 17।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasyā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ paramātmā hi mānavaḥ ।। 18।।
bhavatīnāṃ prāpyarūpaḥ karuṇākṛtakaitavaḥ ।
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre'śvapaṭṭaśobhite ।। 19।।
lomaśāśramasāmīpye'kṣarakṣetre vasāmyaham ।
naranāṭyaṃ prakurvāṇo'meyo'pi mānatāṃ gataḥ ।।2.113.20।।
pūrvakalpīyakanyānāṃ tapaḥphalapradehayā ।
koṭikandarpasaundaryā'navadhivīryavānaham ।।21।।
ṣaḍbhagairaṣṭasāmarthyairaṣṭasiddhibhiranvitaḥ ।
koṭyabjarūpasāmarthyā'saṃkhyabalaguṇāśrayaḥ ।।22।।
kanyānāṃ bhāvapūrtyarthaṃ sākṣājjāto'smi kāntakaḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ patiścā'haṃ varte'dya tapaso balāt ।। 23।।
mama sevā prakartavyā bhavatībhiḥ sukhāptaye ।
snehena mama sevaiva bhaktireva matā mayā ।। 24।।
tayā cāhaṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ nānyopāyena kenacit ।
satī pativratā yadvat sevate svapatiṃ sadā ।।25।।
tādṛgananyabhāvena mumukṣurmā sadā bhajet ।
parānurāgarūpā sā kartavyā mayi sarvathā ।।26 ।।
śravaṇaṃ ca kathāyā me kartavyaṃ janmakarmaṇām ।
mama bhaktasya bhaktāyā mukhādvā mokṣadaṃ hi tat । ।।27।।
me'vatāracaritrāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ ca mumukṣuṇā ।
tathaiva mama bhaktānāṃ camatkāraśravaḥ śubhaḥ ।।28।।
śrotavyāni caritrāṇāmākhyānāni mumukṣubhiḥ ।
evaṃ priyā! mama kāryaṃ kīrtanaṃ matsatāmapi ।। 29।।
janmakarmacaritrāṇāṃ kathāvārtāḥ satāṃ mukhāt ।
kāraṇīyāstathā yogye samaye śraddhayā muhuḥ ।। 2.113.3 0।।
madbhaktānāṃ mama cāpi granthānāṃ paṭhanaṃ tathā ।
pāṭhanaṃ mama patnīnāṃ caritrāṇāṃ hi mokṣadam ।। 31 ।।
chandasāṃ baddhapadyānāṃ gadyānāṃ mama sarvadā ।
saṃskṛtānāṃ prākṛtānāṃ granthānāṃ gāyanaṃ mudā ।। 32।।
vīṇādivādyasanmiśraṃ tālikāsahitaṃ ca vā ।
gāladhvānaiścipīṭābhiḥ kartavyaṃ kīrtanaṃ mama ।।3 3।।
pādayornupūranaddhakikiṇīdhvānamiśritam ।
kaṭyāṃ nibaddhapaṭṭatya ghurghurādininādanaiḥ ।।34।।
sahitaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ nṛtyayuktaṃ sukīrtanam ।
me stutiḥ samprārthanā ca nāmnāṃ me kīrtanaṃ tathā ।। 36।।
kāryaṃ padyairmama prītyā tathā vākyairmanoramaiḥ ।
atha me smaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ cintanaṃ hṛdayāmbuje ।। 36।।
sāṃgopāṃgā mama mūrtiścintyā svahṛdaye priyāḥ! ।
ekaikamaṃgaṃ saṃcintya keśāt pādanakhāvadhim ।। 37।।
mūrtidhyāne mama hāsyaṃ cintanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
mama nāmāni karmāṇi smaraṇīyāni sarvadā ।। 38।।
camatkārāḥ smaraṇīyā madbhaktānāṃ mamā'pi ca ।
guṇānāṃ ramaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ japtavyo me manustathā ।।3 9।।
paradhāmā'kṣaradhāmnorgolokasyā'mṛtasya ca ।
vaikuṇṭhasyā'vyākṛtasya śvetadvīpasya vai tathā ।।2.113.40 ।।
viśālākhyasya me dhāmnaḥ sāketanāmakasya me ।
nityakailāsanāmnaśca kṣīrodasya ca me tathā ।।41 ।।
śrīpuraṃ ca śriyāṃ me pārṣadānāṃ brahmayoṣitām ।
aiśvaryāṇāṃ ca siddhīnāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ ca me priyāḥ! ।।42।।
smaraṇaṃ mama divyānāṃ sādhūnāṃ kāryamutsavāt ।
mama devālayānāṃ ca mama pitroḥ kuṭumbinām ।।43।।
gavāṃ me vāhanādīnāṃ mama veṣasya vai tathā ।
mamā''yudhānāṃ matsambaddhavastūnāṃ smṛtiḥ sadā ।।44।।
kartavyā vai tayā muktiḥ syād divyā muktidā hi me ।
atha kāryaṃ caraṇayoḥ saṃvāhanaṃ mama priyāḥ! ।।45।।
pratyakṣasya harerme'trā'nādikṛṣṇasya satpateḥ ।
mama mūrteḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā muhuḥ ।।46।।
tatra sthito'haṃ gṛhṇāmi sevāṃ saṃvāhanādikām ।
mama mūrtiḥ kāraṇīyā sarvāṃgā cihnaśobhanā ।।47।।
dhātavī dāravī vāpi pārthivī ca kiśorikā ।
tasyāḥ sevā naraiścāpi nārībhiḥ sarvathā sadā ।। 88।।
kāraṇīyā snehapūrṇā kartavyā manasepsitā ।
mānasīṃ vā mama mūrtiṃ prakalpya dhyānanirmitām ।।49।।
tasyāścaraṇayoḥ sparśastadaṃgānāṃ samantataḥ ।
sparśo bhāvena kartavyo rantavyaṃ ca tayā saha ।।2.113.50 ।।
mānasaṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ sevanaṃ mama bhāvitam ।
bhojanīyaḥ pūjanīyau rañjanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।। 51 ।।
hṛdayastho'pyahaṃ kṛṣṇo grahīṣye sevanaṃ tu vaḥ ।
dhṛtvā māṃ śayane nitya suptavyaṃ hi mayā saha ।।52 ।।
vyavahāre'pi māṃ cā'gre kṛtvā kartavya eva saḥ ।
bhoktavyaṃ māṃ pradhāryaiva nānyathā tu kadācana ।।53।।
śarīre'haṃ sadā cāsmi tathendriyeṣu sarvathā ।
bhoktaryevaṃ prabhogyeṣu māṃ nidhāyā''caret kriyāḥ ।। 54 ।।
tatsarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣapradaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhavet ।
gantavyaṃ māṃ puraskṛtya sthātavyaṃ mayi sarvathā ।।55।।
evaṃ me sevanaṃ kāryaṃ dehasaṃvāhanaṃ mama ।
sevayā me vāsudevā'nujā vyūhasvarūpiṇaḥ ।।56 ।।
yāvatsṛṣṭyudbhūtipuṣṭisaṃhṛtiśaktimāpnuvan ।
mama pādāṃguṣṭhapūtā gaṃgā punāti golakam ।। 57।।
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatrukuhṛdbhayādikam ।
mama pādāśrayavatāṃ tūrṇaṃ naśyati sevayā ।। 58।।
rādhāramāprabhāpāravatīśrīmāṇikīpriyāḥ ।
dvādaśādhikaśatasaṃkhyāścānyā brahmayoṣitaḥ ।।59।।
pādau paricarantyanyāḥ koṭyarbudastriyaśca me ।
muktakoṭyo'pi yau pādau sadā paricaranti hi ।।2.113.60।।
devapriyā hyasaṃkhyāśca mama pādaprasevayā ।
gopyaścā'saṃkhyakāścāpi kīrtiṃ prāpurmamā'dhikām ।।6 1।।
yau pādau me stuvantyeva vyāsāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ।
tau pādau saṃvāhanīyau sevyau me muktikāmukaiḥ ।।62।।
caraṇau ca yayā sevyau sevyau bhujau tathā mama ।
mastakaṃ me sadā sevyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ saṃvāhanena ca ।।63।।।
sevyaṃ meṃ'gaṃ tathopāṃgaṃ pratyaṃgaṃ bhāvataḥ priyāḥ! ।
yasya kasyā'pi meṃ'gasya sevanaṃ mokṣadaṃ mama ।। 64।।
athā'rcanaṃ mama kāryaṃ sātvatībhiśca sāttvataiḥ ।
bāhyārcanaṃ ṣoḍaśabhistathā cāṣṭaśatairapi ।। 65 ।।
upacāraiḥ prakartavyaṃ hṛdyaiḥ śreṣṭhairmanoramaiḥ ।
calāyāṃ me pratimāyāṃ māmāvāhya prapūjayet ।। 66 ।।
snāpayed ghṛtadugdhādyairabhiṣiñcejjalaistathā ।
kārayecca tataḥ śreṣṭhavāsāṃsi susamarpayet ।। 67 ।।
alaṃkārān vividhāँśca yathāsthānaṃ pradhārayet ।
kāśmīrakesaropetacandanādyaṃgalepanam ।। 68 ।।
yathartuṃ kuryāt snehena tilakaṃ bindugarbhakam ।
hārān sugandhinaścāpi śekharānavataṃsakān ।। 69।।
mama dadyātpradīpaṃ sudhūpaṃ naivedyamuttamam ।
mahānīrājanaṃ kuryādgītavāditravādanaiḥ । ।2.113.7 0 ।।
pradakṣiṇāṃ stavanaṃ ca prārthanāṃ namanādikam ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca pañcakālaṃ tu pūjanam ।। 71 ।।
trikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ vā prātareva tu vā''caret ।
mama janmadineṣvatra kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat ।।।72 ।।
vrateṣvekādaśīnāṃ ca gītavāditrapūrvakam ।
bhojanīyāḥ sādhavaśca satyaśca pāraṇādine ।।73 ।।
dhanavantaḥ kārayeyurmandirāṇi dṛḍhāni me ।
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettatra dhanī me sumahotsavaiḥ ।। 74।।
grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ dhanaṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ pūjādhanārthikām ।
vṛttiṃ prabandhayed ramyāṃ pūjāpravāhasiddhaye । । 79 ।।
kūpaṃ ca vāpikāṃ puṣpavāṭikāṃ susarāṃsyapi ।
kuṇḍān kūpān kārayecca madarthaṃ ca satāṃ kṛte ।। 76।।
vaiṣṇavān kārayecchreṣṭhān makhān vai bhūridakṣiṇān ।
mantrajapān prakuryācca stotrāṇāṃ pāṭhanādikam ।।77।।
puraścaryāṃ tathā kuryānmama nāmnāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
mantrāṇāṃ ca puraścaryāṃ granthānāmapi bhāvataḥ ।। 78 ।।
pitaro devatāḥ pūjyāḥ ṛṣayo vṛddhadehinaḥ ।
evaṃ bāhyārcanaṃ proktaṃ mānasaṃ cāntaraṃ tu tat ।। 79।।
aṣṭādhikaśataśreṣṭhopacārairmānasairhṛdi ।
pūjanaṃ me prakartavyaṃ premasāgarasaṃbhṛtā । । 2.113.80 ।।
atha me vandanaṃ kāryaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ vāṃ'gaṣaṣṭakam ।
padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāmurasā śirasā dṛśā ।। 81 ।।
vacasā manasā ceti daṇḍavat puruṣaiḥ sadā ।
padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ manasā vacasā śirasā dṛśāḥ ।। 8 2।।
nārībhiḥ sanniṣadyaiva praṇāmaḥ kārya eva me ।
matpādaspṛṣṭasaddhūlyāṃ kartavyaṃ pariluṇṭhanam ।।83।।
rajāṃsi varṣmaṇi śīrṣe nidhatavyāni tāni vai ।
madgātraspṛṣṭavāryādi madgātraspṛṣṭacandanam ।।84।।
raṃgasalilasaugandhyacūrṇādi dhāryamityapi ।
aho bhāgyaṃ mama śreṣṭhaṃ prāptaṃ cūrṇaṃ rajo mayā ।।85।।
bhagavatpādapadmairyat spṛṣṭaṃ cāho subhāgyavān ।
ityevaṃ vai vadan nityānande bhagno bhavejjanaḥ ।।86।।
atha dāsyaṃ sadā kāryaṃ yathā me lomaśo muniḥ ।
dāsabhāve sadā lakṣmīriva saṃvartate tathā ।।87।।
na mānaṃ tatra vai kāryaṃ sevane kṣatidhāyakam ।
sarvakāle yathāpekṣasevāyāṃ dāsavad bhavet ।।88।।
paricaryā sarvavidhā yogyā'yogyā'pi sarvathā ।
kartavyā mama dāsyeva bhṛtyeva yoṣitā'pi ca ।।89।।
nareṇa vā sadā bhaktyā sevyo'haṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
mama snānopayogārthaṃ jalaṃ svayaṃ samāharet ।। 2.113.90 ।।
kusumānyāhareccāpi mālāṃ prāgumphayet svayam ।
tulasīṃ candanaṃ cāpi gharṣayed dravameva ca ।।91।।
pākaṃ kuryāt svayaṃ bhakto bhojayet kavalaiśca mām ।
jalapānādikaṃ dadyācculukaṃ kārayedapi ।। 92।।
tāmbūlakaṃ mukhavāsaṃ dadyānme svayameva tu ।
tālavṛntādibhirbhakto vejayenmāṃ yathocitam ।।93 ।।
sammārjanaṃ mandirasya mama kuryād vilepanam ।
jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakurvīta nūtanaṃ mandirādikam ।।94।।
bhaktānāmannatoyādyaiḥ phalādyaiḥ sevanaṃ śubham ।
mānaṃ hitvā prakurvīta praṇamettān hi bhāvataḥ ।।95।।
dehastrīputravittāderdāsye'rpaṇaṃ vidhāpayet ।
ityevaṃ vartamānasya mama sāmyaṃ dadāmyaham ।।96।।
atha sakhyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sarvaṃ prakāśavanmayi ।
ācaritavyemevā'tra paratra sa samo mama ।। 97।।
dehastrīpatiputrādeḥ snehaḥ kāryo'dhiko mayi ।
mānuṣyanāṭyaṃ dadhato me kriyāsu na doṣadhīḥ ।।98।।
karturakarturanyathākarturme karmasu kvacit ।
saṃśayo nahi kartavyo bhaktādhīnasya me priyāḥ ।।99।।
kāmān krodhāttathā lobhānmohāt svārthāt sukhecchayā ।
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham ।। 2.113.10 0।।
na tatra saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ sakhyaṃ maitryamidaṃ mayi ।
yatkaromi tu bhaktārthaṃ bhaktakalyāṇahetave ।। 10 1।।
lokā naitad vijānanti gahanāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ mama ।
tasmāt kāryo hi viśvāso mama kriyāsu sarvathā ।। 1 02।।
atha kāryaṃ samastaṃ vai mayi tvātmanivedanam ।
nareṇa yoṣitā vāpi deho'rpyo mayi sarvathā ।। 10 3।।।
tathendriyāṇi cārpyāni tathā'ntaḥkaraṇānyapi ।
svabhāvāśca mayi cārpyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ cāpi vai mayi ।। 1 04।।
samarpaṇīyaṃ bhaktena tadadhīno bhavenna vai ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhavāmyaham ।। 1 05।।
mamā'dhīno bhavennityaṃ madarthaṃ sakalakriyaḥ ।
madarthasarvavyāpāro bhaved bhakto mama priyaḥ ।। 106 ।।
evaṃ priyābhiryuṣmābhirvartitavyaṃ sadā mayi ।
kānto'haṃ bhavatīnāṃ ca dāsye vai śāśvataṃ sukham ।। 1 07।।
evamāha svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
rādhike! bahudhā bhaktisvarūpāṇi viśeṣataḥ ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhoḥ sarvathā prasannatā''pādakavividhabhaktisvarūpavivecanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 113 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 113 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 114
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 115 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evaṃ viśeṣataḥ prāha śrīpatiḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
adhikaṃ cāpi yatprāha śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike hi tat ।। 1 ।।
mama bhaktau vighnakṛtān svajanānapi saṃtyajet ।
netrābhyāṃ darśanaṃ kuryānme'ṅgopāṅgātmavarṣmaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
śrutibhyāṃ matkathāṃ nityaṃ śṛṇuyānmama karmaṇām ।
tvacā sparśaṃ mama kuryāt sarvāṃgānāṃ samastataḥ ।। 3 ।।
me guṇoccāraṇaṃ kuryājjihvayā mantrajāpanam ।
mukhena me prasādasyā'śanaṃ kuryājjalaṃ pibet ।। 4 ।।
nāsayā me prasādaṃ ca patraṃ tulasīsaṃbhavam ।
puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāccandanaṃ me samarpitam ।। 5 ।।
karābhyāṃ mama dehasya kuryāt saṃvāhanaṃ śubham ।
śīrṣṇā kuryād vandanaṃ me padbhyāṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।। 6 ।।
manasā mama saṃkalpaṃ dhiyā me niścayaṃ param ।
cetasā cintanaṃ me ca kāntasyaiva vidhāpayet ।। 7 ।।
mama dāsatvābhimānaṃ svasmin kuryātsadā'hamā ।
madarthameva kuryādvai kṛṣivyāpārasatkriyāḥ ।। 8 ।।
udyamaṃ ca madarthaṃ vai prakuryāt pitṛkanyakāḥ! ।
yadyat sveṣṭaṃ bhaved vastu tattanme tvarpayet sadā ।। 9 ।।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cāmbaraṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ tathā ।
matprasādaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā dhārayettu tataḥ param । । 2.114.10 ।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ vāpi mahyaṃ yatsyānna cārpitam ।
tanna bhakṣyaṃ na vā peyaṃ na dhāryaṃ hīrakādyapi ।। 11 ।।
tapaḥ kuryāt kratuṃ kuryād dānaṃ kuryājjapaṃ tathā ।
mama prasannatārthaṃ vai sarvaṃ kuryāt parārthakam ।। 1 2।।
sāttvatāṃ sevanaṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā ।
kartavyaṃ mama bhaktairvai prasannatāyai me'naghāḥ ।। 13 ।।
bhakte sādhau tathā sādhvyāṃ sthito vai sarvadā'smyaham ।
tadaṃgeṣu mamā'ṅgāni sarvendriyāṇi me sadā । । 14।।
vasantyeva na sandehastasmāt sevyāstu te'nvaham ।
sakāmaiḥ sādhavaḥ sevyāḥ kalpavṛkṣā hi me matāḥ । । 15 ।।
kāmanāpūrakāḥ santi sādhavaḥ svargamokṣadāḥ ।
sādhvyo me kalpavallyaśca sevyāḥ sakāmayā striyā ।। 16 ।।
tābhyo manorathāḥ sarve siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ sadāśīrbhiḥ phalantyeva manorathāḥ । । 1 7 ।।
dharmā'rthakāmamokṣākhyāḥ puruṣārthāḥ phalanti ca ।
teṣu tāsu vasāmyeva svayaṃ nārāyaṇottamaḥ । । 18 ।।
yathāyathaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ pūrayāmi manorathān ।
dehānte śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ mahānandaṃ dadāmi ca । । 1 9।।
labhante ceṣṭasaukhyāni tatra te cā'kṣayāṇi hi ।
sālokyaṃ sārṣṭi sāmīpyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca tadātmatām । । 2.114.20 ।।
dadāmyetebhya evā'haṃ yathā tuṣṭo hi sevanaiḥ ।
anye śreṣṭhā mahābhāgavatā bhaktāśca me parāḥ । । 21 ।।
mama sevāṃ vinā nānyadicchanti siddhivaibhavān ।
na ca muktiṃ caturdhāṃ vā te samicchanti karhicit । । 22।।
mayā dattaṃ dīyamānaṃ tvaiśvaryaṃ corjitaṃ param ।
naiva vāñchanti te bhaktā yathā lakṣmīrna te tathā । । 23 । ।
antarāyakaratvādvai santi vighnāni siddhayaḥ ।
aiśvaryāṇyapi vighnāni gṛhṇanti na hṛdā'pi te । । 24।।
mamā''nandenasampūrṇaṃ hṛd ātmakuṭikā śubhā ।
manmūrttyānandasaṃvyāptā bhavatyasya priyāḥ! khalu । । 25।।
evaṃ niṣkāmabhāvena māṃ bhajeraँśca ye janāḥ ।
bhaktottamāste proktā me matpūrṇahṛdayā yataḥ ।। 26 ।।
evaṃ māṃ bhajamānasya sevamānasya nityadā ।
sneho vivardhate bhūyān yatra vighno na jāyate ।। 27।।
brahmaputryā yathā hyāpo bhittvā himagirīn bahūn ।
āyāntyāsāmadeśāँśca viśanti sundarābdhikam ।। 28 ।।
tathā premā hi bhaktānāṃ vighnān vibhidya deśajān ।
kālajān saṃgajāँścānyān viśatyanantake mayi ।।29।।।
āntarāṇāṃ ca bāhyānāṃ tattvānāṃ vṛttayo'khilāḥ ।
svabhāvāścāpi saṃskārā mayyeṣāṃ viśramanti vai ।।2.114.3 0।।
pratyakṣe mayi samprāpte sannidhāvapyupasthite ।
svasamāne mānavākhye sajātīyādivartane ।। 31 ।।
prāptasnehabharā bhaktā matsukhābdhau sukhaṃ gatāḥ ।
anyatra nā'nuraktāḥ syurmāṃ vihāya kvaciddhi te ।।32।।
vastudvayaṃ janaiḥ prāptaṃ viviktaṃ ca dvidhā hi tat ।
ramaṇīyaṃ svānukūlaṃ sukhadaṃ prathamaṃ matam ।। 33।।
dvitīyaṃ nā'nukūlaṃ cā'ramaṇīyaṃ ca duḥkhadam ।
tattu tyājyaṃ svabhāvāddhi sarveṣāṃ tatra kā kathā ।।34।।
prathamaṃ tu sadā ceṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ khalu ।
tadāpyeṣā mahadduḥkhapradaṃ bhāti vivekinām ।। 35।।
dehanirvāhamātraṃ vai grāhyaṃ prasahya yoginām ।
viśeṣaṃ tu tadapyeṣāṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhāti buddhitaḥ ।।36।।
ramyatvaṃ ramaṇīyeṣu naiṣā bhavati karhicit ।
ramyatvaṃ cāsti yatrā'haṃ tatraivaiṣāṃ mahātmanām ।।37।।
madvinā candanaṃ ramyaṃ śītalaṃ gandhasaṃbhṛtam ।
spṛṣṭaṃ viṣāyate śīghraṃ madyuktaṃ cāmṛtāyate ।।38।।
madvinā puṣpamālāśca svarṇahārādayastathā ।
pāśāyante gale kṣiptā madyuktāstu vadhūkarāḥ ।।3 9।।
bhūṣaṇaṃ madvihīnaṃ ca svarṇamauktikahīrakam ।
dhṛtaṃ godhāsamaṃ syādvai madyuktaṃ candravatsukham ।।2.114.40।।
sundarī puṣpaśayyā madvihīnā ramaṇīyutā ।
vahnidhautāmbaraklṛptā śreṣṭhā'pi rauravāyate ।।41 ।।
cāndrakāntiḥ śāradī ca madvihīnā sudhāsravā ।
viṣā''tapāyate dugdhāyate sā tu mayā yutā ।।42।।
prāsādaścendravāsārho madvihīno guhāyate ।
janā''vāso madvihīno bhūtāraṇyāyate tathā ।।43 ।।
sugandhiśītalo vāyurmadvihīno'nalāyate ।
śreṣṭhavastraṃ madvihīnaṃ śūlayukkharjanāyate ।।44।।
sambandhino madvihīnā vṛkāyante'sya sarvathā ।
rūpaṃ kuṣṭhāyate saumyaṃ madvihīnaṃ manoharam ।।45।।
svādu bhojyaṃ tu macchūnyaṃ bhaktasya tu viṣāyate ।
svādu pānaṃ mayā hīnaṃ vāntāyate'mṛtaṃ tvapi ।।46 ।।
gatirmādhuryapūrṇā'pi mayā hīnā śarāyate ।
mayā hīnā satī nārī devyapi pradavāyate ।।47।।
sukhaṃ duḥkhāyate sarvaṃ śāntaṃ krūrāyate tathā ।
miṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mayā hīnaṃ bhaktasya kaṭukāyate ।।48।।
utsavo madvihīnastu bhagnotsādvāyate sadā ।
ānando'pi mayā hīno tiktamarcāyate tathā ।।49।।
prasaṃgo'pi śubhaḥ sarvo māṃ vinā maraṇāyate ।
śubhaṃ sarvaṃ vinā māṃ tu bhaktasyaivā'śubhāyate ।।2.114.50।।
evaṃ bhaktasya vijñeyaḥ sneho mayyatyasīmakaḥ ।
ahameva sphurāmyeko bhaktasyā'ntaśca vai bahiḥ ।।51 ।।
dṛṣṭo'hameva bhaktena sahasā tvāntare yadā ।
tadā vilokya māṃ bhaktaḥ premṇā vai hasati kvacit ।।52।।
kvacinmāṃ dūramālokya gacchantamiva roditi ।
kvaciccānandalābhena nṛtyaṃ karoti gāyati ।।53।।
kvacit saṃbhāṣate divyamūrtinā sa mayā saha ।
kvacit karoti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ kvacidāliṅgatīti mām ।।54।।
kvacit pracumbati māṃ ca kvacit svapiti cādarāt ।
kvacidutthāya sahasā jalaṃ dadāti me tadā ।।55।।
snānabhojanabhūṣādi kkacit kvacid dadāti me ।
kvaciddhyānaparo bhūtvā ramate cāntare mayi ।।56।।
kvacinmaunaṃ samālambya samāhvayati māṃ hṛdi ।
kvacit snehāt samākṛṣya māṃ nayatyeva nirjane ।।57।।
kvacid dāsī svayaṃ bhūtvā dāsyaṃ karoti me tadā ।
kvacit maitryaṃ kvacicchraiṣṭhyaṃ kvacit karoti sāmyakam ।।58।।
kvacinmatvā'parādhaṃ svaṃ kṣamasveti vadatyapi ।
kvacit prārthayate vastu kvacit paravaśo bhavet ।।59।।
anargalaḥ kvacidbhūtvā nāmānyeva gṛṇāti ca ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprabho ।।2.114.6 0।।
parabrahma parātmanme nātha kānta hare vibho ।
nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo kṛṣṇa śrīmannarāyaṇa ।।6 1 ।।
parameśa dayāsindho kvāsse vadā'tra māṃ prati ।
evamāhūya ca māṃ sa sevate'pi yatheṣṭakam ।।62।।
nā'tra loke bhavettasya trapā sevanavighnikā ।
tādṛśo mama bhakto yo bhaktā dāsī ca vā mama ।।63 ।।
punāti bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ pāravāribhiḥ ।
tasya vai pādarajasā prajvalanti durītikāḥ ।।64।।
tasya sandarśanāllokāḥ pūtā bhavanti vai drutam ।
etādṛśasya bhaktasyāśrayeṇa muktiruttamā ।।65।।
sevanena bhavet sevā mamaivātra na saṃśayaḥ ।
tasya me nahi bhedo'sti tanuḥ so'sti mamaiva saḥ ।।66।।
tadindriyāṇi me santīndriyāṇi nātra saṃśayaḥ।
paśyāmi tasya netrābhyāṃ spṛśāmi tasya vai tvacā ।।67।।
śṛṇomi tasya karṇābhyāṃ rasayāmi ca jihvayā ।
vadāmi tasya vai vācā jighrāmi ghrāṇayoginā ।।68।।
mama ghrāṇena tatraiva vividhān gandhagauravān ।
bhruvā ciceṣṭe tasyaiva gṛhṇāmi tatkareṇa ca ।।6 9।।
gacchāmi tatpadābhyāṃ ca devakṣetreṣu sarvadā ।
ānandayāmi tasyaivendriyeṇa kāmavṛttinā ।।2.114.70।।
kaccaraṃ cotsṛjāmyeva tadindriyeṇa pāyunā ।
cintayāmi tu tasyaiva cetasā mama cetasā ।।7 1 ।।
mananaṃ ca tayā kurve manasā tasya vai sadā ।
ahaṃbhāvaṃ ca sarvatra karomyahaṃ hi taddhṛdā ।।72।।
nirṇayaṃ tasya buddhyaiva karomyahaṃ sadā priyāḥ! ।
śabdaṃ sparśaṃ rasaṃ rūpaṃ gandhaṃ cānandamityapi ।।73 ।।
gṛhṇāmyahaṃ sthitastasmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ।
evaṃ tasya kriyāḥ sarvā divyā mama kriyārhi tāḥ ।।74।।
mokṣarūpā bhaktibhāvā māyikā nahi vai hitāḥ ।
tasya sevā prakartavyā tayā vindāmi tarpaṇam ।।75।।
tasyārpaṇena me syādvai sarvārpaṇaṃ hi dehinām ।
pratyakṣo'haṃ tathā cā'smi mama sādhusvarūpavān ।।76।।
parokṣo'haṃ tathā cāsmi mama sādhuviyogavān ।
pratyakṣāḥ sādhavo me vai santi divyāstu mūrtayaḥ ।।77।।
teṣāṃ bhagavatāṃ kāryā sevā sarvakriyādibhiḥ ।
na tatra saṃśayaḥ kāryo mama mūrtyātmakā hi te ।।78।।
na tathā brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhā munayo na maharṣayaḥ ।
na cācāryā na guravo yathā me sādhavo varāḥ ।।79।।
varṇeṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇeṣu ca sāttvatāḥ ।
sāttvateṣu mama bhaktāścātmanivedinaḥ parāḥ ।।2.114.80।।
ātmanivediṣu śreṣṭhā dīkṣāvanto hi sādhavaḥ ।
sādhubhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ evā'haṃ nānyo mattaḥ paraḥ samaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
sādhavo me samāḥ śreṣṭhā japāmyetān sadā hyaham ।
karomi darśanaṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ mayi vāsinām ।।82 ।।
mayyarpitasamastānāṃ mokṣadānā madātmanām ।
karomi smaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyaṃ mahātmanām ।।83 ।।
kīrtanaṃ vandanaṃ teṣāṃ sādhūnāṃ ca karomyaham ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kurve sādhūnāmahamātmanām ।।84।।
arcane tvātmano me ca karomyapi nivedanam ।
sādhuto na priyaṃ me'sti mama tattvasya cintanāt ।।85।।
parameśvarasaṃjñāste mama nāmnā hi mokṣadāḥ ।
nārāyaṇāśca te proktāḥ sādhavo mama vai priyāḥ ।।86।।
tanmukhairbhojanaṃ kurve tṛpto bhavāmi teṣu ca ।
na devā na ca gandharvāścāraṇā guhyakādayaḥ ।।87।।
pitaro munayo viprā nādhikāḥ sādhuto hi me ।
īśvarā lokapālādyāḥ sādhuto nādhikā hi me ।।88।।
muktā muktiṃ gatāścāpi sādhuto nā'dhikā hi me ।
kā kathā vā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ rādhikā kamalādikāḥ ।।89।।
śrīrlīlā bhūrvibhūtiśca pārvatī cāpi māṇikī ।
prabhādyā me sādhuto nā'dhikā anyasya kā kathā ।।2.114.90।।
evaṃvidhayā bhaktyā māṃ bhajadhvaṃ pitṛkanyakāḥ! ।
uddhariṣyāmi sarvā vaḥ pāvayadhvaṃ ca dehinaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
ipyuktvā ca tatastābhyo rādhike! śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
dadau tāsāṃ hṛdayeṣu caraṇau mūrtimityapi ।।92।।
snātvā bhuktvā bhojayitvā dadāvājñāṃ svayaṃ hariḥ ।
svasvasthāneṣu gantuṃ vai tīrtheṣu pāvaneṣu ca ।।93 ।।
mayoktayā sadā rītyā bhajadhvaṃ māṃ patiṃ prabhum ।
anāyāsena bhaktānāṃ bhaktiṃ kārayatā'pi ca ।।94।।
ante vinā prayatnena nirodhaṃ prāpya vai mayi ।
yāsyanti tādṛśā bhaktā bhavatyaścāpi matpadam ।। 95।।
divyā brahmatanuṃ prāpya madicchayā mamā''laye ।
mayā saha prayāsyanti bhavatyo bhaktiyugjanāḥ ।।96।।
mayā dattāni sarvāṇi śāśvatāni parāṇi ca ।
anantānyakṣarāṇyeva divyasaukhyāni sarvadā ।।97।।
prāpsyanti mama sevāṃ ca bhavatyo bhaktisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
ye janāśca tathā bhaktiṃ kariṣyanti striyo'pi yāḥ ।।98।।
te ca tāśca prayāsyanti mama muktipadaṃ param ।
yāntyevaṃ māṃ vidantvevaṃ sevantāṃ māṃ tathā priyam ।।99।।
mama mantraṃ pradāyaiva mokṣayantu hi dehinaḥ ।
gacchāmyahaṃ mama kṣetraṃ śāśvatīṃ kuṃkumasthalīm ।। 2.114.10 0।।
ityuktvā pitṛtanayābhyaśca nadībhya ityapi ।
ṛṣīn devān brahmapriyāstato maunaṃ sthitaḥ kṣaṇam ।। 101 ।।
ātmanyacintayat kiñcid vaktuṃ śrīśaṃkarāya saḥ ।
ājñāṃ pālayituṃ sajjā narā nāryo'vatasthire ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pitṛkanyātmakanadībhyo bhagavatā svātmātmakasādhujanādibhaktisvarūpapradarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā
caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 114 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 114 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 115
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 116 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! caivamājñāpya saritātmikāḥ ।
svasvapradeśān gantuṃ ca tataḥ śrīśaṃkaraṃ hariḥ ।। 1 ।।
prāha yogin tava bhaktā ime yoddhāra eva ye ।
tebhyo rājyaṃ pradātavyaṃ tadyogyaṃ pārvataṃ śubham ।। 2 ।।
kailāsasannidhau cātra parvate tu himālaye ।
bhūtānāṃ parvatāḥ santu tvāsāmasyordhvabhūmiṣu ।। 2 ।।
pārvatīyaṃ mahārājyaṃ bhūtāsanaṃ tadastu vai ।
ityuktvā śaṃbhave kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadau śubham ।। 4 ।।
mukuṭaṃ bhūtanātheti nāmnā rājyaṃ dadau tadā ।
bhūtanāthasvarūpega bhagavān bhairavātmakaḥ ।। 5 । ।
svasvarūpāya bhūtānāmadhipāya mahātmane ।
bhairavāya dadau tatra mukuṭaṃ śaṃkaro'pi ca ।। 6 ।।
bhairavo rājyamāsādya natvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
haraṃ svapitaraṃ natvā gṛhītvā bhūtamaṇḍalam ।। 7 ।।
ṣaṣṭilakṣādhikaṃ śailaṃ himālayaṃ yayau drutam ।
bhūtānāmālayāstena parvatā vai kṛtāstadā ।। 8 ।।
evaṃ tasmai pradatvaiva rājyaṃ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ prāha tatraiva bhavān cerāvatībhuvam ।। 9 ।।
brahmadeśamitikhyātāṃ śāstu rakṣatu sarvadā ।
śaṃkaro yātu piṃgāyāṃ bhūmau prācīnarājyake ।। 2.115.10 ।।
viṣṇuryātu śyāmarājyaṃ bhavannāmnā prasiddhimat ।
evamājñāpya tāndevān visarjayitvā cāpagāḥ ।। 11 ।।
ṛṣīn tattatpradeśīyān ājñāpya gantumityatha ।
svasvasthānāni nityāni copadeṣṭuṃ prajā api ।। 12।।
sarvavidhān devasaṃghān jātān yoddhṝn haristataḥ ।
prāha me sāmavedākhye deśe vasantu te'nugāḥ ।। 13 ।।
ye'vaśiṣṭā bhavantyatra brahmaputryāstu pūrvagāḥ ।
kāmarūpapradeśeṣu patatkāyāvadhiṃ drutam ।। 14।।
dakṣiṇe tu pradeśe'tra yāvadvai lukaśāyinam ।
nagnā ye parvatāścāpi lukahītānadīṃ prati ।। 11 ।।
tanmadhye sāmadeśam ā abhivyāpya vasantviti ।
sarvayoddhṛgaṇānevaṃ vāsayitvā hariḥ svayam । । 16 ।।
āsāmānāṃ nṛpaṃ tatra śivaliṃgaṃ cakāra ha ।
śivaliṃgākhyakagaṇo nītvā sarvān bhaṭāँstataḥ । । 17। ।
āsāmīyapradeśe saṃvāsaṃ cakre samantataḥ ।
śivaliṃgodbhavāṃ devīṃ śivāṃ kāmasvarūpiṇīm ।। 18।।
kāmarūpīyakāmākṣīṃ saha nītvā yayau gaṇaḥ ।
parvate tanmandiraṃ ca śubhamucchritamālayam ।। 19।।
kṛtvā saṃsthāpayāmāsa kāmarūpāṃ satīṃ gaṇaḥ ।
mātaraṃ tāṃ sadā matvā pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।।2.115.20।।
svanāmnā nagaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa cocchraye ।
evaṃ nārāyaṇo datvā śivaliṃgāya rājyakam ।। 21 ।।
bhaṭān sarvān vyavasthāpya devān visṛjya vai munīn ।
tato vimāne saṃgṛhya koṭikanyāḥ prajārpitāḥ ।।।22 ।।
daśasāhasrakanyāśca sevikā viṃśatiśritāḥ ।
viṃśatipitṛkanyāśca tathā brahmapriyāḥ parāḥ ।।23 ।।
saṃgṛhya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī salomaśaḥ ।
mātāpitṛyuta āyād vyomnā kāśīṃ śriyāḥ sthalīm ।।24।।
śivarājagṛhe yatra nijalakṣmīrhi kanyakā ।
rājate sapratīkṣā vai prati śrīpuruṣottamam ।।।25।।
tatrodyāne varaṇāyāstaṭe nijaṃ vimānakam ।
avatārya bhuvi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau gṛham ।।26।।
śivarājaṃ haraṃ natvā śvaśuraṃ pārvatīṃ tathā ।
bhaktaṃ jayaṃ ca candraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhenupamityapi ।।27।।
ekānte svasatīṃ lakṣmīṃ militvā svapriyāṃ tataḥ ।
tāṃ vimāne sarvakanyā''śleṣaṃ tāsāṃ ca darśanam ।।।28।।
kārayitvā tathā pitrorlomaśasyāpi darśanam ।
āśvāsya ca punastasyāḥ pitṛgehe niveśyatām ।।।29।।
āśīrdatvā vimānena bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ cā'kṣarasaṃjñakam ।।2.115.30।।
phālgunasyā'site pakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ sāyaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 31 ।।
māsānte tvāgataṃ vīkṣya bhrātṛsambandhisajjanāḥ ।
rudro devāśca tīrthāni aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ svayam ।।32।।
ṛṣaryo'śā'vatārāśca tathā bhaktāśca koṭiśaḥ ।
āyayuḥ sannidhau dṛṣṭvā tejo vilakṣaṇaṃ tu khe ।।33 ।।
dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ vai śrīnārāyaṇaśobhitam ।
koṭisūryaprabhaṃ ramyaṃ candrakāntisuśītalam ।।34।।
koṭikanyā'yutakanyāviṃśatikanyakānvitam ।
jayaśabdān pracakruste'kṣarakṣetranivāsinaḥ ।।35।।
lājābhiścā'kṣataiścaiva kāśmīraiḥ kuṃkumaistathā ।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ।।36 ।।
avātatāra ca tadā paścime'śvasarovarāt ।
udyāne'nādikṛṣṇasya prāsādasannidhau tataḥ ।।37।।
avaterurvimānācchrīsvāmī nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
brahmapriyāḥ pitṛkanyāḥ prajākanyāśca sevikāḥ ।।38।।
lomaśaśca tathā cānye maharṣayastathā pitā ।
mātā ramādikāḥ satyo viviśuśca nijālayam ।।39।।
viśaśrāma harirmātā pitā kṣaṇaṃ ca lomaśaḥ ।
kanyakāstā hareḥ saudhaṃ parātparamalokayan ।।2.115.40।।
akṣarasthā'tisaundaryasampadvyāptaṃ mahālayam ।
divyasmṛddhiyutaṃ koṭisāmarthyaiśvaryarājitam ।।41 ।।
sāptabhaumaṃ puttalaiśceśvarāṇāṃ maṇḍitaṃ śubham ।
brahmahradena ca brahmasarasā cābhiśobhitam ।।42।।
divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ divyayantrādirājitam ।
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptāstāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakāstataḥ ।।43।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāṃ bhaginīṃ tadā ।
santoṣāṃ prāha caitābhyo bhojanaṃ dīyatāṃ svasaḥ ।।44।।
bhrātṛjāyāṃ tathā devīṃ tvamṛtāṃ prāha mādhavaḥ ।
etābhyo dīyatāṃ peyaṃ mukhavāsādikaṃ śubham ।।45।।
ityukte sahasā te dve kalpacintāmaṇiprajam ।
bhojanaṃ śatarūpaṃ ca peyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā ।।46।।
dadaturbahusatkāraṃ cakratuḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitām ।
samāślikṣaँśca tāḥ sarvāḥ svasāraṃ bhrātṛyoṣitam ।।47।।
tathā'nyāḥ kanyakāścāpi ṛṣipatnīśca yoṣitaḥ ।
atha kṛṣṇārpitayā sudivyayā dṛṣṭidhārayā ।।।48।।
tāḥ sarvā lokayāmāsurdivyāstāḥ kanyakāstadā ।
vallyātmikāstathā pakṣimṛgyādirūpadhārikāḥ ।।49।।
kṛṣṇakāntā bahurūpā vilokyā''ścaryamāvahan ।
paścācchrīlomaśaṃ prāha bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।2.115.50 ।।
etā neyā bhavataiva guro śubhanijāśrame ।
brahmapriyādibhiḥ sārdhe rakṣaṇīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ।।51।।
lomaśaśca pūjito bhojito'bhivanditastathā ।
kanyā nītvā''jñayā naijāśramaṃ vai sa tadā yayau ।।52।।
bhagavāँśca viśaśrāma pitarau yayatuḥ sukham ।
atha vai rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।।53।।
phālgune pracakāraiva puṣpadolamahotsavam ।
kārayitvā divyaraṃgān vicitrān vārimiśritān ।।54।।
hemantabhagavadbhyāṃ pārṣadābhyāṃ cānyapārṣadaiḥ ।
sāmagrīḥ klṛptayitvā'tha samārabhata khelanam ।।।55।।
kṣepakairyantravaryaiśca sauvarṇaiḥ śrīvasantakam ।
pūjayitvā nijamūrtiṃ tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।।56।।
akṣaraṃ ca tathā muktān tathā ca sāṃkhyayoginīḥ ।
svayaṃ dhṛtvā kare yantraṃ sauvarṇaṃ raṃgasaṃbhṛtam ।।57।।
cikṣepa raṃgaṃ maryādāsthitāsu janatāsu vai ।
nijā'saṃkhyāsu kāntāsu bhaktabhaktāsu vai muhuḥ ।।58।।
bhakteṣu sāttvateṣvevaṃ maharṣiṣu janeṣu ca ।
gopīṣu gopabhakteṣu cikṣepa raṃgamuttamam ।।59।।
pracikṣepa gulālaṃ ca raktavarṇānakārayat ।
sarvānnijāśritāँścāpi svayaṃ rakto'bhavattathā ।।2.115.60।।
raktaṃ vyomā'bhavaccāpi piśaṃgaṃ kaisaraṃ tathā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca jalaṃ raṃgavimiśritam ।।61 ।।
citrabhāvaṃ gataṃ yadvad vyomnīndradhanuṣā samam ।
bhūtalaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ kṣetraṃ citraraṃgamayaṃ hyabhūt ।।62।।
mṛttikā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrīyā candanākṛtim ।
prāptā piśaṃgarūpaṃ sā raṃgavārisumiśritā ।।63 ।।
athaivaṃ puṣpadolasya khelanaṃ saṃvidhāya saḥ ।
sasnau haristu sarvābhiḥ prajābhiḥ saha cā'śvake ।।64।।
tato vaneṣu vṛkṣeṣu nūtnāmbaradharā janāḥ ।
yayuḥ sugandhavāyvābhivyāptodyāneṣu cābhitaḥ ।।65।।
tatra puṣpamayī dolā preṃkhāṃ śākhāsu śākhinām ।
bhinnāṃ bhinnāṃ vicitrāṃ ca bandhayitvā samantataḥ ।।66।।
phalapuṣpādibhistatra kṛtvā śobhāmanuttamām ।
nūtnabeṣadharāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakā bhagavāँstathā ।।67।।
prajājanāśca vai sarve puṣpadolamahotsave ।
āndolanaṃ śubhaṃ cakrurjahṛṣuścāpi nirbharam ।।68।।
sakhyaḥ parasparaṃ sarvāścāndolayanti kanyakāḥ ।
brahmapriyā nijaṃ kāntaṃ cāndolayanti bhāvataḥ ।।69।।
kīrtayanti vividhāni camatkārāṇi kīrtanaiḥ ।
nṛtyanti ca tadā kāściddharerāndolanāntike ।।2.115.70।।
vādayanti suvādyāni cāparāḥ kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
tathā'nyā hāsayantyeva kṛṣṇaṃ narmavacoyutāḥ ।।71।।
aparāśca dadustasmai kāntāya śītalaṃ jalam ।
itarāśca dadustasmai pakvaphalāni yoṣitaḥ ।।72।।
bahvyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā svāndolane tataḥ ।
padbhyāṃ sahaiva dolāṃ svāmāndolayati vai muhuḥ ।।73।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī patīśvaraḥ ।
jñātvā sarvamanāṃsyatrā'saṃkhyarūpo'bhavattadā ।।74।।
pratikanyaṃ pratināripratibhaktaṃ pratidrumam ।
kiśoraścā'bhavad ramyaḥ koṭikāmamadāpahaḥ ।।75।।
sarvāsāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ brahmayoṣitām ।
sevāṃ saṃgṛhya bhagavān punaścaikavidho'bhavat ।।76।।
evaṃ caitre kṛṣṇapakṣe dine tu prathame hariḥ ।
puṣpadolotsavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cakārā'kṣarakṣetrake ।।77।।
tato gehaṃ jagāmātha bhojayāmāsa vai punaḥ ।
sāyaṃ samutsavaṃ cakre gītanartanavādanaiḥ ।।78।।
tataḥ suptiṃ yayuḥ sarve viśrāntiṃ prāpurañjasā ।
athaivaṃ vartamānasya śrāvaṇastu samāgataḥ ।।79।।
bhaktaiḥ saṃklṛpya dolāśca vividhāḥ svarṇarājataiḥ ।
anekabhūṣāśobhāḍhyāḥ puṣpahārālirājitāḥ ।।2.115.80।।
divyahīrakamaṇyādyaiḥ khacitāśca sugandhitāḥ ।
divyakomalaśayyābhirvirājitāḥ śubhāsanaiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tatra nārāyaṇasvāmikṛṣṇakāntaṃ niṣādya tu ।
brahmapriyāśca tā āndolayāmāsuḥ svamīśvaram ।।82।।
athā''ścaryamabhūttatra meghā vai mānuṣāstadā ।
bhūtvā vyomno hariṃ tvāndolanārthaṃ tatra cāyayuḥ ।।83।।
preṃkhāṃ ca nūtanāṃ vidyutprabhāṃ divyāṃ nirāśrayām ।
vyomāśrayāṃ dadustasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane ।।84।।
yatraikaikāṃgake tatra muktā gopyaśca pārṣadāḥ ।
avatārāśca dhāmāni dṛśyante īśvarāstathā ।।85।।
ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānuṣā api ।
samudrāḥ parvatāścāpi grahā nakṣatramaṇḍalam ।।86।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca tathā pātālavāsinaḥ ।
kṣīrodaḥ śvetadhāmā'pi viśālā'kṣaravāsinaḥ ।।87।।
avyākṛtaṃ tathā tatrāmṛtaṃ dhāmāpi dṛśyate ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ sāketaṃ ca kilāsakam ।।88।।
tathā caturmukho brahmā brahmā cāṣṭamukhastathā ।
tathā'jaḥ ṣoḍaśamukho dvātriṃśadānanastathā ।।89।।
pañcāśadānanaścāpi śatānano'pi dṛśyate ।
sahasrānana evāpi lakṣānano'pi dṛśyate ।।2.115.90।।
koṭyānanastathā brahmā dṛśyate maṇimaṇḍale ।
tādṛśī divyadolā vai meghairdattā tu śārṅgiṇe ।।91।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagrāha tāṃ tadā ।
āruhyā''ndolanaṃ cakre meghān papraccha vai tadā ।।92।।
kasmādiyaṃ samānītā sarvabrahmāṇḍadarśikā ।
divyā preṃkhā śubhā yogyā mama sarveśituḥ kṛte ।।93।।
meghāḥ prāhurmahārāja vayaṃ kāśyāṃ samāgatāḥ ।
āṣāḍhe tīrthayātrārthaṃ varaṇāyāstaṭe tadā ।।94।।
dṛṣṭā mahālaye ramye śivarājasya kanyakā ।
vayaṃ tatra mitho vārtāmakaravāma śobhanām ।।95।।
snānaṃ ca darśanaṃ cātra kṛtvā gantavyameva tu ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ śubham ।।96।।
akṣarākhyaṃ śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ mokṣadaṃ śāśvataṃ param ।
yatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī paraḥ pumān ।।97।।
sarvāvatāradhartā yaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
virājate mahārājo'nādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।98।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātparamātmā parātparaḥ ।
kambharāśrīsutaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ।।99।।
tasyaiva darśanārthaṃ vai gacchāmaśceta eva nu ।
tacchrutvā kanyakā prāha dolā mama gṛhe'sti vai ।। 2.115.10 0।।
tasyārthaṃ sā pradeyā vai yadi gantavyamasti hi ।
tayā vai duḥkhahālakṣmyā datteyaṃ cāhṛtā prabho ।। 101 ।।
tad gṛhāṇa kṛpāsindho kanyābhāvabharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ityukto bhagavāँścāti jaharṣa cādade tu tām ।। 1 02।।
āśīrvādān dadau tasyai tebhyaścāpi punaḥ punaḥ ।
meghā natvā yayurvyoma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 1 03।।
āndolanaṃ svayaṃ cakre dolāyāṃ śrāvaṇe smaran ।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ devīṃ manyate tu mahotsavam ।। 1 04।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanam ।
caritaṃ mokṣadaṃ rādhe sarvasampatpradaṃ śubham ।। 1 05।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi śrāvaṇātpāṭhanādapi ।
mananānmokṣadaṃ divyāṃ brāhmīṃ tanuṃ dadāti ca ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhurbhūtāsanarājyaṃ bhairavāya, nagnaparvatarājyaṃ sāmarājyaṃ ca viśiṣṭayoddhṛbhyaḥ pradattavān, sundaravane nadīḥ svasvapradeśān gantumājñāpya kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ pratyāgamane sati phulladolotsavaṃ śrāvaṇotsavaṃ ca kṛtavānityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 115 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 115 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 116
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 117 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
janmamāsaḥ kārtiko vai kṛṣṇapakṣātmakaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 1 ।।
aṣṭamīdivyadivasastrayodaśaḥ samāgataḥ ।
tadutsavaṃ vidhātuṃ prāgjyotiṣāṃ vaiṣṇavā janāḥ ।। 2 ।।
prācīnadeśabhaktāśca śyāmabrahmapradeśajāḥ ।
trivittadeśajāścāpi kāśmerā''sāmavāsinaḥ ।। 3 ।।
tathā'nye himadeśasthāḥ śaṃbhudeśasamudbhavāḥ।
narā nāryo bālakāśca bālikā vṛddhasevinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vimānairāyayustvaśvapaṭṭatīrthaṃ maharṣayaḥ ।
sādhavaśca tathā satyaḥ pragṛhya vividhopadāḥ ।। 5 ।।
āyayurbālakṛṣṇasya pūjārthaṃ vai samutsukāḥ ।
uṣṭrālayapradeśācca tathā'briktapradeśajāḥ ।। 6 ।।
ārabījapradeśācca kumārīkṣetrajāstathā ।
anye vai cājanābhīyāḥ kacchadeśodbhavāstathā ।। 7 ।।
āyayuḥ kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ cotsukāḥ sopadādayaḥ ।
prātarvai maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
gajāsane bālakṛṣṇaḥ snātvā dhṛtvā'mbarāṇi ca ।
śṛṃgārābhūṣaṇādīni dhṛtvā sadasi cāyayau ।। 9 ।।
tatra devāḥ pitaraśca munayo'kṣaramuktigāḥ ।
anyadhāmanivāsāśceśvarā devāśca mānavāḥ ।। 2.116.1 0।।
āyayuḥ śrīharestasya pūjārthaṃ tasya saṃsadi ।
avādyanta suvādyāni jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।। 1 1।।
vireje śrībālakṛṣṇo vardhitaśca nijāsane ।
samāje lomaśo vipraḥ pūjayāmāsa cācyutam ।। 12।।
mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa pradadau kuṇḍale tataḥ ।
tilakaṃ sākṣatacandraṃ cakre bhāle harestataḥ ।। 13 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'sya puṣpahārān dadau gale ।
āśīrvādān dadau paścāt pūjayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।। 14।।
rādhike! ca tato lakṣmyo brahmapriyāstato'pi ca ।
devyo gāndharvya āryāśca ṛṣipatnyastataḥ param ।। 15।।
devā devyastathā vai prāgjyotiṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīprajā ।
deśāntarāgatāścāpi mahīmānāśca taṃ prabhum ।। 16।।
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ divyaiḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ ।
ārārtrikaṃ ca te cakrurdaduścāgre mahopadāḥ ।। 17।।
vividhānyambarāṇyābhūṣaṇāni mauktikāni ca ।
hārān suvarṇarūpyotthān hīrakān raśanāyutān ।। 18।।
yānāni vāraṇāँścāśvān alaṃkārāँstathottamān ।
dadurbhojyāni pānāni phalāni cāmṛtāni ca ।। 19।।
evaṃ sampūjya te sarve bālakṛṣṇaṃ sumaṇḍape ।
mātaraṃ śrīṃ ca gopālaṃ pitaraṃ śrīharistadā ।। 2.116.20।।
natvā śrīlomaśaṃ carṣīn janarītyā gajāsanāt ।
utthāya ca sabhāsaṃsthān vṛddhān praṇamya vai tataḥ ।।21।।
yayau nijālayaṃ pitṛsammataḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
mahīmānān bhojayitvā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।22।।
visarjayāmāsa lokān svasvān satīśca vai tataḥ ।
pūjayāmāsa lakṣmīśrīkambharā bhāvatastadā ।। 23 ।।
bhojayitvā ca tā visarjayāmāsa nijālayān ।
evaṃ trayodaśasaṃkhyaḥ śrīharerjananotsavaḥ ।।24।।
susampanno mahīmānā yayurnaijān pradeśakān ।
dvitīye'hnyabhavattatrāścaryaṃ saṃśṛṇu rādhike। ।।25।।
dattātreyeṇa guruṇā bhagavatā parātmanā ।
preṣitaḥ śarabhaḥ kaścit kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntikam ।। 26।।
āyayau tatra mokṣārthaṃ tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ tataḥ ।
divyadehaśca vai bhūtvā yayau dhāmā'kṣarābhidham ।।27।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
ka āsīccharabhaḥ kṛṣṇa dattātreyeṇa noditaḥ ।
vada me tatkathāṃ sarvāṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvaśaḥ ।।28।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi śarabhasya kathāṃ śubhām ।
samīraṇo'bhavad rājā sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। 29।।
ājanābhasya khaṇḍasya paścimāyā bhuvaḥ śubhaḥ ।
gaurjarāṇāṃ ca kacchānāṃ saurāṣṭrāṇāṃ nṛpādhipaḥ ।। 2.116.30 ।।
prajāpālanakaruṇo bhakto nārāyaṇasya ca ।
dharmakarmaparo nityaṃ dānahomaparāyaṇaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
akhaṇḍakīrtimānāsīd dīnarakṣāparastathā ।
gobhūbrāhmaṇasādhūnāṃ rakṣākaraḥ prarakṣakaḥ ।।32।।
yasya rājye kadācidvai durbhikṣaṃ nā'bhavatpurā ।
śaraṇāgatarakṣākṛt deśarakṣākarastathā ।।33 ।।
dhanurdharaḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ devasevāṃ karoti ca ।
rājadhānyabhavattasya śatruṃjītānadītaṭe ।। 34।।
kuṇḍalākhyā mahādivyā nagarī vipraśobhitā ।
kṣatrīyavaiśyaśūdrādisaumyaprajānivāsitā ।।35।।
yajñayāgaparā yatra viprāśca vedaghoṣiṇaḥ ।
sādhavo yatayo yatra kṛṣṇadhyānaparāstathā ।।36।।
vanino'pi na yadrājye kaṣṭaṃ vindanti kutracit। ।
nāryo narāśca sukhino yadāśraye'bhavan sadā ।।37।।
samīraṇasya rājye vai viśeṣo'yamabhūt sadā ।
prātarninādyate nityaṃ paṭaho rājapūruṣaiḥ ।। 38।।
dīno'ndhaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kaścinnirādhāro nirāśrayaḥ ।
niranno'nāthabālo vā vṛddho vā bhikṣuko'pi vā ।।39।।
nārī nirāśrayā vṛddhā vidhavā cā'kuṭumbinī ।
sādhuḥ sādhvī yoginī vā tāpasī dhanavarjitā ।।2.116.40।।
daridro vā'dhano vā ca ṣaṇḍho vā ṣaṇḍhikā tathā ।
prātarāgatya maddvāre gṛhṇātu cānnabhojanam ।।41 ।।
mama grāme ca nagare pattane ca prajāsu ca ।
yatra yatra mamā'nnānāmāgārāṇi bhavanti vai ।।42।।
tatra tatra samāgatya gṛhṇātu cānnabhojanam ।
vastraṃ pātraṃ pragṛhṇātu bhajatāṃ puruṣottamam ।।43।।
ityevaṃ paṭahastasya prātarnadati bodhayan ।
mānavā nirdhanāstasya bhuñjate'nnaṃ sthale sthale ।।44।।
bhuktvā tṛpyanti satataṃ dadatyāśīrvacāṃsi ca ।
evaṃ puṇyayuto rājā tvekadā bhṛtyamaṇḍalam ।।45।।
gṛhītvā prayayau vyāghrāraṇyaṃ vihartumutsukaḥ ।
bhṛtyāśca gajaghoṭāśca dāsā api yayuḥ saha ।। 46।।
madhyāraṇye dīrghikāyāstaṭe vṛkṣeṣu vai tadā ।
nivāsaṃ gajaghoṭādeḥ kārayitvā sa bhūpatiḥ ।। 47।।
rājadharmeṇa mṛgayāṃ kartuṃ vanaṃ viveśa ha ।
bhṛtyā api yayuḥ kecit sārdhaṃ rājñā savāhanāḥ ।।48।।
gavayaṃ saṃvilokyaiva rājā pṛṣṭhamanuvrajan ।
araṇye gavayenā'yaṃ viveśa gahane mudhā ।। 49।।
dhanurdharo'śvamārūḍho vegād rājā paśupriyaḥ ।
nadīṃ ramyāṃ prāpa tatra jalapūravatīṃ śubhām ।।2.116.50।।
tasyāstīre'bhavat tatrāśramo ramyo'tisundaraḥ ।
phalapuṣpādiyuktānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ sughaṭāsu vai ।।5 1 ।।
munīnāṃ cātiviśvāsumṛgapakṣyādiśobhanaḥ ।
hiṃsrāṇāṃ hiṃsravṛttyādiśāntikṛccātinirmalaḥ ।52।।
muniśiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiśca sevito brahmadhāmavat ।
kāmakrodhātilobhānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ yatra nodbhavaḥ ।। 53।।
māyā'nṛtādidoṣāśca paśuṣvapi na yatra vai ।
pakṣiṇo madhurān rāvān gāyanti sma drumādiṣu ।।54।।
vedavākyāni ca śukā mayūrā militāstadā ।
kokilā rājahaṃsāśca pragāyanti svabhāṣayā ।।55।।
devā devyo'pi nākācca yatrā''gatya vasanti hi ।
ṛṣiṃ natvā prayāntyeva manvānāḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ।।56।।
etādṛśe cāśrame tu pārṣṇigṛho mahāmuniḥ ।
tapaḥ karoti vipulaṃ lokakalyāṇahetave ।।57।।
grīṣme pañcāgnimadhye ca niṣīdati nirantaram ।
varṣāyāṃ bhūtale varṣādhārāsveva niṣīdati ।।58।।
śaitye jale kṛtā''vāso divā tiṣṭhati sarvathā ।
rātrau vṛkṣatale tatra vartate vai nirāvṛtau ।।5 9 ।।
kvacitphala kvacitpuṣpaṃ kvacinmunyannamityapi ।
kvacijjalaṃ kvacitpānīyakaṃ gṛhṇāti vārdalam ।। 2.116.60 ।।
nirāhāraḥ kvattvāste bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam ।
susvāmiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa saṃbhajate hṛdi ।। 61 ।।
tādṛśo'yaṃ muniryatra vṛkṣe'dho vartate tadā ।
tasya puraḥ sa gavayaḥ samāgatyā'tibhītitaḥ ।। 62 ।।
abhavat susthirastatra ṛṣeḥ śaraṇamāśritaḥ ।
rājā dūrādanāvīkṣyā''śramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tathā ।। 63 ।।
mṛgayālagnacitto'sau jaghāna gavayaṃ balāt ।
śareṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa hyudarāntaḥpraveśinā ।। 64।।
saśaro gavayastatrā''krośaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣeḥ puraḥ ।
nipapāta yathā putrastathā rakṣārthameva tu ।। 65।।।
dīnavattaṃ muniṃ paśyan tadā dīnena cakṣuṣā ।
patitaṃ śarasahitaṃ vīkṣya pārṣṇigṛho muniḥ ।।66 ।।
dayāluḥ śīghramevainaṃ paśuṃ pasparśa pāṇinā ।
jalaṃ dadau mukhe tasyā'paśyallagnaṃ śaraṃ tadā । । 67।।
tathā trāsena hariṇān palāyanaparān paśūn ।
parito dhāvamānāँśca vilokya kaṣṭamāptavān ।।68 ।।
aho mamāśrame ko'yaṃ ghātakaścādya saṃgataḥ ।
paśūnāṃ trāsakṛd duṣṭo nirmaryādo'tidāruṇaḥ ।।6 9 ।।
nirdoṣaṃ gavayaṃ yo'tra jaghāna prāṇata śaraiḥ ।
evaṃ yāvanmuniśreṣṭho vicāraṃ prakaroti hi ।।2.116.7 0 ।।
tāvadrājā turaṃgasthastatra sṛtyā samāgataḥ ।
dadarśa brāhmaṇaṃ mālājaṭāśmaśrudharaṃ śubham ।।7 1 ।।
patitaṃ pādavikṣepān kurvantaṃ gavayaṃ tathā ।
manasā mṛdubhāvena tadāśramaprasaṃgataḥ ।। 72 ।।
dūyamānaḥ sa vai rājā pārṣṇigṛhaṃ pravīkṣya ca ।
āyātaścāśvamābaddhya vṛkṣamūle padakramaiḥ ।।73 । ।
bhītaḥ papāta sa ṛṣeḥ pādayoḥ śīghrameva tu ।
tāvad ṛṣistamuvāca kathaṃ duṣṭa! ḥataḥ paśuḥ ।।74।।
tvayā vyādhena nirdoṣo mamā'raṇyanivāsakṛt ।
duṣṭastvaṃ dṛśyase rājā kṛtyaṃ karoṣi hiṃsrakam ।।75।।।
vyādhavat krūrakarmā tvaṃ munīnāmāśrameṣvapi ।
duṣṭakāryaṃ prakartuṃ kiṃ lajjase na narādhipa ।।76 । ।
śareṇa bhagnā hariṇā mamāśramanivāsināḥ ।
gavayo'yaṃ mṛtaścātra bhavatyeva kṣaṇāntare ।।77।।
śare vikarṣaṇaṃ prāpte nā'sya prāṇo'vatiṣṭhati।
paśya pāpa nijaṃ putraṃ kathaṃ ghātayase na vai ।।78।।
mṛgayā te na vai yogyā ṛṣiviśvastajantuṣu ।
mṛgāḥ putrā mama tulyā mamā''śramasamīpataḥ ।।79।।
tava bhītyā dudruvuvai prāṇarakṣaṇavāñcchayā ।
śareṇa bhagnā hariṇā mamāśramasamīpataḥ ।।2.116.80।।
śarabho bhava rājendra! vanā''vāso'tikaṣṭavān ।
punarnaivaṃ daṇḍaśikṣaḥ kariṣyasi vadhaṃ kvacit ।।8 1 ।।
ityuktaḥ ṛṣiṇā rājā tatraiva śarabho'bhavat ।
vihāya mānavaṃ rūpaṃ pāśavaṃ rūpamāptavān ।।82।।
ityevaṃ sa ṛṣiṇā vai śapto rājā samīraṇaḥ ।
śarabhaḥ sa paśurbhūtvā tadāśramād viniryayau ।।83।।
śāpamokṣaṇamatraiva prārthayituṃ na cā'vadat ।
bhītaścātīva doṣeṇa kopenā'pi ṛṣestadā ।।84।।
śīghraṃ tadāśramaṃ tyaktvā siṃhāraṇyaṃ viveśa ha ।
duḥkhātiduḥkhasaṃmagnaḥ sukhaṃ nā'vāpa kutracit ।।85।।
jātismaraḥ sadā svasya duḥkhāntaṃ kartumeva tu ।
cintayatyeva satataṃ caran vane muhurmuhuḥ ।।86।।
rājabhṛtyāstu vai jñātvā vṛttāntaṃ taṃ tataḥ kila ।
bhītā nijaprāṇārakṣāṃ jñātvā gṛhān drutaṃ yayuḥ ।।87।।
gavaye ca ṛṣiṇaiva mantrapuṣpāñjalistadā ।
sandhinyā sahitaḥ kṣiptastenojjīvanamāhitam ।।88।।
rājā śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ bhramitvā tadvanaṃ tataḥ ।
pārṣṇigṛhaṃ samāgatya prārthayāmāsa mokṣaṇam ।।89।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha mahāraṇye pātālīye sarovare ।
raivatādriḥ samāgatya nijā''vāsaṃ kariṣyati ।। 2.116.90।।
tatra vai bhagavān sākṣād dattātreyo mahāprabhuḥ ।
śikhare tu janaihīne tvagamye vyomagāmini ।।9 1 ।।
svayaṃ tapo mahaccograṃ kariṣyati yadā tadā ।
śailadroṇyāṃ tvayā tatra sthitena bhagavān hi saḥ ।।92।।
dṛṣṭaścārādhitaścāpi kṛpayā tvāṃ suneṣyati ।
kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ tatra sthāsyati cā'trijaḥ ।। 93 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre paścime tapasā harim ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamārādhayaँstadā ।।94।।
dattātreyasya kṛpayā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
vīkṣya tvaṃ tatpādayośca pītvā jalaṃ prasādajam ।।95।।
śīghraṃ śāpānmama mukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ śarabhasya tu dehavān ।।96।।
araṇyaṃ prayayau tasmānmahāsarovarāntike ।
tataḥ kālāntare tatra raivatādriḥ samāyayau ।।97।।
tatraiva bhagavānatriputrastapaścacāra ha ।
śikhare taṃ dadarśā'sau śarabho japamācarat ।।98।।
dattātreyo dayāluḥ sa cainamādāya tadgṛham ।
samāyāto'sti bhagavānaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।।99।।
adṛśyastiṣṭhati cāsya śāpamokṣārthameva tu ।
dattātreyābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ tadatrā'śvasarovare ।। 2.116.100 ।।
śāpapāpavināśārthaṃ vartate pāvanaṃ hi tat। ।
tatra vai śarabho gatvā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 101 ।।
vīkṣya pādajalaṃ pītvā śāpānmokṣamavāptavān ।
rājarūpaṃ śubhaṃ prāptastato'pi tīrthavīryataḥ ।। 1 02।।।
divyarūpo'tra bhūtvaivā'kṣaraṃ lokaṃ yayau śubham ।
ityevaṃ rādhike cāśvasarovaraṃ varaṃ sadā ।। 1 03।।
sāyaṃ sa śarabhaḥ pītvā jalaṃ pādajalaṃ hareḥ ।
muktiṃ jagāma paramāṃ brāhmīṃ divyāṃ tu śāśvatīm ।। 1 04।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ।
sakāmānāṃ vaṃśavṛddhirduḥkhamuktirbhavedapi ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prabhostrayodaśajanmadinotsavaḥ, samīraṇarājño mṛgayārthaṃ gatasya vane pārṣṇigṛharṣiśāpena śarabhatvaṃ, tato raivatādrau dattātreyadvārā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre mokṣaṇam, aśvapaṭṭasarasi dattātreyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 116 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 116 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 117
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 118 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! cānyad vārāhaṃ tīrthamityapi ।
kuṃkumāyā aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva purā'bhavat ।। 1 । ।
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
parabrahma svayaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ yadā''rebhe svamūrtitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tattvāni cintayato'sya maravādagnirajāyata ।
divyo divyākṣaramukto divyamuktasvarūpadhṛk ।। 3 ।।
dvibhujaḥ śvetavarṇaśca śītalasparśavāँstadā ।
mūrtitejomayaḥ so'yamabhavad rūpavān śubhaḥ ।। 4 ।।
bhagavānaikṣata vahniṃ kartuṃ tattvātmakaṃ tadā ।
vahniśceṅgitamājñāya tasthau puroharestadā ।। 5 ।।
hariścājñāṃ cakārā'sya yāhi tvaṃ ceśvarādiṣu ।
mayā vai sṛjyamāneṣu tejastattvaṃ sadā bhava ।। 6 ।।
ityāśāṃ sa samādāya mahāmāyāṃ viveśa ha ।
garbharūpastadā māyā kṣobhaṃ tvavāpa vahnivat ।। 7 ।।
yathā yathā tu sā māyā guṇatrayātmikā tadā ।
sūkṣmā sāmyasvarūpā'pi kṣobhaṃ tvavāpa vai muhuḥ ।। 8 ।।
tathā tathā ca māyāyā mauṣṇyaṃ kāryaṃ vyavartata ।
tāmaso vai sa bhāgastu vyavardhata harīcchayā ।। 9 ।।
māyayā tattvasaṃghāto vairājaḥ samapadyata ।
tatroṣṇabhāvamāsādyoṣmātmako vai mahānalaḥ ।। 2.117.10 ।।
mukhato bahirāyātaśceśvaro vahnināmakaḥ ।
vaṃ vairājaṃ samāśritya haṃ hanuṃ mukhamārgataḥ ।। 11 ।।
abhito nirgato devo vahnirityeva so'bhavat ।
divyo'yaṃ śubhravadanaḥ śubhravarṇaḥ samujjvalaḥ ।। 12 ।।
brahmabhāvaṃ tu visṛjyeśvarabhāvamupāgataḥ ।
vairājo nijaputraṃ taṃ vahniṃ puruṣarūpiṇam ।। 13 ।।
prāha putrān sṛṣṭiyogyān sṛja putra samān tvayā ।
omityājñāṃ śirasyeva dhṛtvā vahnirvyatarkayat ।। 14।।
putrā me sṛṣṭiyogyā vai bhavantu matsvarūpiṇaḥ ।
saṃkalpamātrajātā vai pāvanāḥ pavamānakaḥ ।। 15 ।।
paviḥ trayaḥ samutpannā pavirvajraṃ tu vaidyutam ।
indrāya cārpitaḥ putro brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ।। 16।।
pāvakākhyastu lokebhyaścārpitaḥ pākakarmaṇe ।
pavamāno mahājvālāyutaścātīva cañcalaḥ ।। 17।।
vegavān hānidaśceti dāhako'pi maholbaṇaḥ ।
iti jñātvā janāste tu nā'gṛhṇanta yadā tadā ।। 18।।
kruddho'raṇyaṃ jagāmā'yaṃ bhojanārthaṃ mahāvane ।
babhrāma sa mahāraṇyaprabhṛtiṣu mahābalaḥ ।। 1 9।।
evaṃ saurāṣṭraviṣaye pavamānaḥ svayaṃ bhraman ।
anveṣayan bhojanaṃ cā'labhamāno'tiduḥkhitaḥ ।। 2.117.20 ।।
vyāghrāraṇyaṃ dadāhā'sau kṣudhayā'tīva bādhitaḥ ।
jvālāmālāsamāvyāptaṃ vanaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।। 21 ।।
dahyamānaṃ duṣpraveśaṃ durnirgamyaṃ samantataḥ ।
hariṇā paśavaḥ pakṣyādayo mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ ।। 22।।
dahyante vahninā tatra nibiḍe vṛkṣasaṃkule ।
tṛṇavallīghaṭāvyāpte'dṛśyabhūtalabhūmike ।।।23 ।।
dhāvanti hariṇāḥ sarve dhūmāndhāḥ pakṣiṇastathā ।
aśaktā'patyabālādyā vanyānāṃ tiryagātmanām ।। 24।।
sahasraśaḥ prāṇadhārā aśaktā vahnisaṃkulāḥ ।
dagdhāstatra vahniputrapavamānena vai mṛtāḥ ।।25।।

vṛkṣā dagdhāḥ sajīvāśca vallikā bhasmatāṃ gatāḥ ।
tṛṇānāṃ ca latānāṃ ca stambānāṃ gaṇanā tu kā ।। 26।।
śikharāṇi vilokyante vṛkṣāṇāṃ vahniśailavat ।
ucchrayā bhūpradeśāśca vane vahnimayāstadā ।। 27।।
alpaśṛṃgāstathā śailā vukṣāraṇyāmbarāstadā ।
dahyanti vahninā jvālāmukhāḥ śailā yathā'bhavan ।। 28।।
evaṃ kraurye saṃpravṛtte vanavāsivināśane ।
vyāpake cānale jāte pavamāne'nilānvite ।। 2 9।।
nadītīre'pi vṛkṣāṇāṃ dagdhabhāve hyupasthite ।
āśramaḥ picchalarṣeśca dāhavegena dharṣitaḥ ।। 2.117.3 0। ।
picchalarṣirbahuvarṣapurāṇastapasi sthitaḥ ।
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śvetavārāharūpiṇam ।। 31 ।।
tepe tapo mahāghoraṃ cāraṇye vanavāsiṣu ।
yatra kāmadughā gāvo pravasanti tadāśrame ।। 3 2।।
gopālāstatra tiṣṭhanti pārśve vṛkṣāśraye'pi ca ।
te tā vahnipravegena dudruvuśca nadījale ।। 32 । ।
nipeturjīvarakṣārthe gopālāḥ peturapsu ca ।
athāyaṃ tu maharṣirvai picchalākhyo dvijeśvaraḥ ।। 34। ।
vilokya pavamānasya ceṣṭitaṃ krūratāmayam ।
dayāparaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā pavamānamuvāca ha ।।3 5। ।
re re vahne mahākrūra mahāhiṃsakato'dhika ।
kṣudhayā pīḍitaścaitadvanaṃ mamāśramaṃ tathā ।। 36 । ।
gāḥ paśūn prāṇinaḥ pakṣigaṇān sarīsṛpāँstathā ।
vinā'parādhaṃ dahasi dīnaṃ cāpi na muñcasi ।। 37।।
bubhukṣitaḥ pāpabuddhirbhavatyeveti tattathā ।
kathaṃ vihāya maryādāṃ sarvaṃ nāśayase balāt ।। 38।।
paśyā'patyāni pakṣyādijantūnāmapi niṣpadāḥ ।
apakṣāścāpi dahyanti paśyataste ghṛṇā'pi na ।। 3 9।।
kathaṃ tvaṃ krūratāṃ prāptaḥ śāntiṃ naivā'dhigacchasi ।
parvato bhūcchrayāścāpi dagdhāstava prabhāvataḥ ।।2.117.40 ।।
bhojyaṃ svaṃ vai labdhavatā dagdhaṃ sarvā'nyabhojanam ।
kṣayaṃ nītaṃ mamāraṇyaṃ kṣīṇāḥ sarve hi jīvinaḥ ।।41 ।।
tasmāttvāṃ kṣayakartāraṃ śapāmyatra na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityeva vahninā kliṣṭaḥ picchalarṣistu rādhike ।।42 ।।
śaśāpa pavamāna । tvaṃ kṣayamāpnuhi vai drutam ।
ityuktvā svakarasthaṃ ca jalaṃ mumoca bhūtale ।।43।।।
yāvattāvaccānalasya jvālā māndyamupāgatāḥ ।
dāhaśaktirvinaṣṭā ca pākaśaktirlayaṃ gatā ।।44।।
rasādanasya sāmarthyaṃ līnaṃ kṣaṇāntare tathā ।
śvaityaṃ vahnervinaṣṭaṃ ca tathauṣṇyaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ।।।45।।
naisargavardhanaṃ cāpi hrāsaṃ yātaṃ tadā svayam ।
dhūmrabhāvaḥ pravṛddhaścā'ṅgārā nistejasā'sitāḥ ।।46।।
aprakāśāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ kāṣṭhakūrcāstadā'bhavan ।
vinā prayatnaṃ vahnirvai śamitaḥ śāpakāraṇāt ।।47।।
bhakṣitāstu rasāḥ sarve bījāni paśupakṣiṇaḥ ।
pavamānasya jaṭharādapakvā niryayurbahiḥ ।।48।।
mandodaro mandatejā mandaśvāso babhūva saḥ ।
maraṇonmukhatāṃ prāptaḥ pādaśaktivihīnakaḥ ।।49।।
jvālāśūnyaścendriyāṇāṃ vṛttiśūnyo babhūva ca ।
śuśoca bahudhā karmaphalaṃ prāpto ruroda ca ।।2.117.50।।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kathaṃ śāpo maharṣikṛt ।
nivarteta kathaṃ so'pi prasannaḥ syād vyacintayat ।।51 ।।
athāyaṃ pavamānaśca nirmānastamṛṣiṃ prati ।
yayau hṛdā daṇḍavacca patitvā manasā girā ।।92।।
tuṣṭāva brahmarūpaṃ taṃ duḥkhamokṣasya kāṃkṣayā ।
he sādho tvaṃ dayālurvai nirdayo'haṃ tu hiṃsrakaḥ ।।55 ।।
satyavrato bhavān sādho na satyaṃ vidyate mayi ।
niṣpāpastvaṃ sadā tvāste pāpiṣṭho'haṃ tu duḥkhadaḥ ।।54।।
asantuṣṭo'smi vai lubdhastvaṃ santoṣī na lubdhakaḥ ।
parigrahaparaścā'haṃ tva virāgo'parigrahaḥ ।।59।।
tāpano'haṃ tu jīvānāṃ tvaṃ tapasvī na tāpanaḥ ।
brahmabhūtaḥ sadā tvaṃ tu bhramātmā'haṃ tu māyikaḥ ।।56।।
kṣamāśūnyo bhavāmyeva tvayi kṣamā sadā'sti ca ।
siddhīnāṃ mayi leśo na siddhyāśrayo bhavāniha ।।57।।
pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ nā'haṃ śakto bhavāniva ।
tīrtharūpo bhavānāste nā'haṃ tīrthaṃ tarāmi na ।।58।।
ahamāvidyako jīvo bhavān vidyāśrayaḥ sadā ।
brahmatanurbhavānasti māyātanurbhavāmyaham ।।59।।
divyamokṣapradastvaṃ ca janmado'haṃ vināśakaḥ ।
śāntiprado bhavānāste'hamudvegaprado'smi tu ।।2.117.60।।
nityaṃ brahma paraṃ saumyaṃ cintayāno bhavāniha ।
kartumuddhāramevā''ste samartho dīnadehinām ।।61।।
ajñānāmaparādhānāṃ kṣamāṃ kuru mahāmate ।
mayā prajvālitaṃ yattajjīvayituṃ prabhurbhavān ।।62।।
tapasā dyotamānastvaṃ samujjīvaya jaṅgalam ।
paśūn prāṇigaṇāँścāpi pakṣiṇaśca vanaspatīn ।।63।।
jīvān sarīsṛpādīँśca māmuddhara tapodhana ।
śāpapātraṃ punaḥ syācca sādhūnāṃ toṣapātrakam ।।64।।
śikṣā prāptā mayā sādho maraṇaṃ mā vidhehi me ।
mṛtyoḥ sānnidhyamāpto'smi māmujjīvaya cārtihan ।।65।।
sādhūnāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ sādhutvaṃ tvetadeva yat ।
kṣāntvā''parādhān jīvasya tasmai guṇān dadāti ca ।।66।।
vṛścikaḥ kaṇṭakaṃ yuṃkte sādhustaṃ na vimuñcati ।
mūṣakaḥ kṛntati pakṣaṃ haṃsastaṃ na vimuñcati ।।67।।
rakṣakāḥ kurvanti rakṣāṃ duṣṭānāmapi dehinām ।
māmujjīvaya viprendra kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ ।।68।।
naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣye'haṃ cāparāddhaṃ kadācana ।
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ patitastava pādayoḥ ।।69।।
ityevaṃ sa hṛdā rādhe! pavamāno muhurmuhuḥ ।
ṛṣiṃ taṃ picchalaṃ tatra tuṣṭāva patito vane ।।2.117.70 ।।
dhyānavṛttyā maharṣistajjñātvā tatstavanaṃ tataḥ ।
prasannaḥ karuṇāvārdhirdrāgevotthāya cāsanāt ।।71 ।।
pavamānaṃ stuvantaṃ svaṃ yayau śīghraṃ śubhāśrayaḥ ।
pavamāna! śubhaṃ te'stu mā śokaṃ kuru vahnija! ।।71।।
bhavān devo vahniputro yadi naivaṃ karoti cet ।
jīvayāmi bhavantaṃ vai mā pradahyatu dehinaḥ ।।73 ।।
ityuktvā jalamādāya kare sammantrya pātrataḥ ।
gṛhītvā pavamānasyopari cikṣepa yāvatā ।।74।।
pavamānaḥ saśakto'bhūduttasthau ca nanāma ca ।
tejoyukto daṇḍavacca cakāra tam ṛṣiṃ tadā ।।75।।
pavamānaśca taṃ prāha śāpamokṣaṃ kuru prabho ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha mayā śaktirdattā gantuṃ vihāyasā ।।76।।
yāhi śrīśailasaṃjñaṃ ca parvataṃ yatra sūkaraḥ ।
āste mokṣapradaḥ śrīmān dharaṇiprāṇarakṣakaḥ ।।77।।
sarvarakṣākaraḥ kroḍaḥ sa te rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ।
ityuktaḥ pavamānaḥ sa yayau śrīśailamādarāt ।।78।।
valmīkasannidhau tiṣṭhan smaratyeva ca taṃ tadā ।
rādhike bhagavāँstasmād valmīkādutthito'bhavat ।।।79।।
śvetavarṇaḥ sundaraśca pavamānastamānamat ।
sukhī bhaveti bhagavānāha vahnisutaṃ tadā ।।2.117.80।।
papraccha kāraṇaṃ tatrāgamanasya tato'nalaḥ ।
akhilaṃ kathayāmāsa kāraṇaṃ śāpamityapi ।।81।।
samuddhāraṃ mama viṣṇo kurvityāha vibhāvasuḥ ।
tejaḥ śaktiṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ divyatāṃ vyāpitāṃ tathā ।।82।।

guṇān purā bhavān me'tra dadātu parameśvara ।
ityuktaḥ śrīvarāhaśca prāha taṃ pavamānakam ।।83 ।।
āyāhi pavamāna tvaṃ mayā saha surāṣṭrakam ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।84।।
sarvāvatāradhartā yaḥ sākṣāt svāmī pumuttamaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।।85।।
virājate'kṣarakṣetre sa te sarvaṃ pradāsyati ।
mokṣaṃ caiśvarabhāvaṃ ca sarvaṃ sa te pradāsyati ।।86।।
ityuktvā śrīvarāhastaṃ nināyā'kṣarabhūmikām ।
sahasā vyomamārgeṇa tathā cā'śvasarovare ।।87।।
snapayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ darśanārthaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।
taṃ nītvā prayayau śrīmān vārāho bhagavānprabhuḥ ।।88।।
cakāra daṇḍavat bhūmau pavamānastamādarāt ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścotthāpya vahnijam ।।86।।
niṣādya tvāsane kroḍaṃ samāślikṣattu vakṣasi ।
siṃhāsanaṃ dadāvasmai varāhāya nijātmane ।।2.117.90 ।।
tasmācca kāraṇaṃ jñātvā mānuṣyaṃ nāṭayan hariḥ ।
ṛṣeḥ śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ prasādaṃ pradadau prabhuḥ ।।91 ।।
pavamānaḥ prasādaṃ taṃ bubhuje cā'mṛtaṃ phalam ।
jalaṃ papau ca yāvadvai tāvat sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ।।92।।
samapadyata viśvātmā yathāpūrvaguṇāśrayaḥ ।
sarvaśāpavinirmukto'bhavat sukhyatiharṣitaḥ ।।93 ।।
varāhaṃ pūjayāmāsa tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇām ।
pavamāno hareryogāttīrtharūpo'bhavattataḥ ।।94।।
tīrthe vāsaṃ cakārā'sau varāho'pi sarovare ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaivā''jñayā prabhoḥ ।।95।।
evaṃ vārāhatīrthaṃ tat samabhūt tatra nityadā ।
varāho bhagavānāste pavamānayutaḥ prabhuḥ ।।96।।
tatra snānaṃ kariṣyanti ye janāste virogiṇaḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti hareryogāt secanāt tīrthavāriṇām ।।97।।
muktiṃ bhuktiṃ gamiṣyanti yāsyanti divyatāṃ tathā ।
paṭhanād vācanādasyā''rogyaṃ syātsarvadā priyam ।।98।।
rādhike bhagavānevaṃ tvāha vārāharūpiṇam ।
phālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ vai prātarvai pavamānakam ।।99।।
dadau vāsaṃ yajñabhūmau tathā'raṇye mahājale ।
vṛṣṭyāścāpi jale vāsaṃ pavamānāya vai dadau ।। 2.117.1 00।।
bhūgarbhe ca tathā''vāsaṃ dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
pradadau nirbhayatvaṃ c vaiṣṇavatvaṃ dadau tathā ।। 10 1।।
kaṇṭhīṃ ca taulasīṃ cāpi tilakaṃ candrakaṃ tathā ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 102 ।।
evaṃ mantraṃ dadau cātha praṇamya pavamānakaḥ ।
prapūjya ca hariṃ tīrthe vāsārthaṃ prayayau saraḥ ।। 103 ।।
varāho'pi pradattaṃ satkāraṃ jagrāha sarvathā ।
vārāhe tanmahattīrthe vāsaṃ cakāra rādhike ।। 1 04।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne picchalarṣidttaśāpanivṛttaye varāhaṃ prabhuṃ gṛhītvā'śvapaṭṭasarovaraṃ prati pavamānasya gamanaṃ, hareryogācchāpamuktiḥ,
varāhatīrthaṃ pavamānatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 117 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cā'nyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham ।
bhaktarakṣākaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।। 1 ।।
saurāṣṭre jayanagare'bhavat santāraṇo dvijaḥ ।
vedadharmarataḥ samyak pūjāvidhānatatparaḥ ।। 2 ।।
ṣaṭkarmanirataḥ kathāvācane guṇakīrtane ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇe viṣṇoḥ smaraṇe pādasevane ।। 3 ।।
arcane vandane dāsye sakhye cātmanivedane ।
mahābhāgavataścāsīt kṛṣṇapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
svayaṃ dvijaḥ samutthāya prātarnityaṃ nadītaṭam ।
gatvā snātyeva bhadrāyāṃ kṛtvā sandhyāṃ ca vandanam ।। 5 ।।
jalasya kalaśaṃ mūrghni svayaṃ nītvaiva bhāvataḥ ।
śālagrāmasya vai pūjāṃ svā''hṛtakusumādibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
svaghṛṣṭacandanādyaiśca karotyeva sadā dvijaḥ ।
pūjāyāṃ jāyamānāyāṃ tasya patnī pativratā ।। 7 ।।
taraṇyākhyā tu sāmagrīrdadātyeva hi bhāvataḥ ।
jalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cāpi vastraṃ bhūṣāṃ ghṛtādikam ।। 8 ।।
putrī tasya taralikā kanyā kumārikā satī ।
śīghraṃ pūjāsamayādvai pūrvamutthāya nityadā ।। 9 ।।
snātvā natvā svapitarau devaṃ natvā'tibhāvataḥ ।
cullikāṃ vahniyuktāṃ ca vidhāya tvaritā satī ।। 2.118.10 ।।
dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāśca paktvā naivedyamuttamam ।
samarpayati kṛṣṇāya viṣṇave cātibhaktitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
dvitīyā kanyakā nāmnā kumudā sarvadā prage ।
gāṃ nijāṃ dohayitvaiva kṣīraṃ dadāti cārcane ।। 12।।
dugdhasārādikaṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ dadāti cārcane।
putrastasya vinodaśca devapuṣpadrumāśraye ।। 13 ।।
jalasecanakāryādi karotyeva tu sevanam ।
pātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ jalārpaṇādikam ।। 14।।
karoti sarvadā pārśve pituḥ sthitvā yathāsthalam ।
dvitīyastasya putro'pi vasantarṣiśca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 1781।।
vāyudānaṃ vyajanena karoti pūjanādiṣu ।
makṣikādrāvaṇaṃ cāpi śarkarātulasīdalam ।। 16।।
phalānyapi dadātyeva yathāpekṣaṃ ca sevanam ।
atha pūjottaraṃ sarve kurvanti stavanaṃ prabhoḥ ।। 17।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāñjaliṃ dadatyapi ।
kṣamāyāñcāṃ prakurvanti tato nṛtyanti vai mudā ।। 18।।
vādayanti suvādyāni kīrtayanti pragītikāḥ ।
gāyanti tālamānādyairvividhairnartanaiḥ sadā ।। 19 ।।
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā ca ramākāntaṃ sadā patim ।
tataḥ prasādaṃ bhaktebhyaḥ saṃvibhajya pradāya ca ।।2.118.2 0।।
gṛhiṇaste samaśnanti śarkarānnajalādikam ।
madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥ ।। 21 ।।
jīvikārthaṃ tu divase yatante'pekṣitaṃ manāk ।
evaṃ prayāte samaye bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।22।।
suprasanno'tibhaktyaiva sākṣād babhūva caikadā ।
āṣāḍhe kṛṣṇapakṣe vai rātrāvekādaśīvrate ।।2 3 ।।
mukuṭaṃ dhārayan ramyaṃ vakraṃ sauvarṇamuttamam ।
mayūravaryapicchāgraṃ maṇiratnādiśobhitam ।।24।।
kuṇḍale makarākāre dadhan ramye tu karṇayoḥ ।
tilakaṃ kauṃkuma madhye bhāle bibhrat sucandrakam ।।25।।
mandahāsyānano divyasmerākarṣitamānasaḥ ।
kaṇṭhe sukaustubhahārān tūlasīpatramālikāḥ ।।26।।
sauvarṇahāramālālīn dadhan kaṭyāṃ tu mekhalām ।
sauvarṇīṃ kaṭake cāpi bhujayośca prakoṣṭhayoḥ ।।27।।
śṛṃkhale svarṇaje ramye'ṅgulīyakormikāḥ kare ।
yaṣṭiṃ ca pauraṭīṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakānvitām ।।28।।
pāduke ramyasauvarṇajanite dhārayan hariḥ ।
pītāmbaraśca ruciro vyadṛśyata yadṛcchayā ।। 29 ।।
tejomaṇḍalamadhyastho dāsadāsīgaṇārcitaḥ ।
yuvā rājādhirājaśca rādhāramādisevitaḥ ।।2.118.3 0।।
tato bhaktān tirobhāvya kiśoro'bhūt svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ śrīmahārājādhirājakaḥ ।।3 1।।
'kiśoro bhagavān kṛṣṇo dadau mantraṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ravāmine svāhā' ।।32।।
dadau ca mastake hastaṃ prabhustatra tiro'bhavat ।
evaṃ tato dinānnityaṃ prārabhyoṣaḥsamarcane ।।33।।
pūjāyāṃ śrīmahārājo nityamāyāti keśavaḥ ।
kiśoraḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhūprasevitaḥ ।।34।।
sarvopacārān gṛhṇāti pūjāyāmarpitāni vai ।
śrāvaṇe bhādrake māse tathā''śvine'pi vai prabhuḥ ।।35 ।।
pūjāṃ teṣāmamāyāṃ vai gṛhītvā prāha tān hariḥ ।
ūrjakṛṣṇadalāṣṭamyāṃ mama janmamahotsavaḥ ।।36।
caturdaśo'śvasarasastaṭe'kṣarākhyabhūtale ।
bhaviṣyatīti yuṣmābhiścāgantavyaṃ mama gṛham ।।37।।
pitṛbhyāṃ cāpi kanyābhiḥ putraiḥ saha mamālaye ।
āgamiṣyanti trailokyeśvarā mamārcanāya yat ।।38।।
ityuktvā bhagavāँstebhyo bhaktebhyo'tha tiro'bhavat ।
bhaktāste tīrthayātrārthaṃ samutsukāstato'bhavan ।।।39।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prasādhya pātheyaṃ gṛhaṃ pidhāya tālakaiḥ ।
upadāḥ subhagā gṛhya padbhyāṃ prasthānamācarat ।।।2.118.40 ।।
saptamyāṃ sāyamevaite prāpustvaśvasarovaram ।
dṛṣṭvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ ca tathā śrīlomaśāśramam ।।41 ।।
ṛṣīn satīḥ sādhujanān devān devālayān bahūn ।
kṣetrapān kṣetrarakṣāँśca nagaraṃ vāṭikādikāḥ ।।42।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi daivivṛkṣavanāni ca ।
yajñaśālāḥ kathāśālā dharmaśālā mahālayān ।।43।।
dṛṣṭvā śrīkambharālakṣmīṃ śrīgopālaṃ hariṃ tathā ।
daivīṃ bhūmiṃ vilokyaiva brahmapriyāśca kanyakāḥ ।।44
vimānāni sudivyāni muktān saudhān samantataḥ ।
avāpuḥ paramāścaryaṃ parameśvaramadbhutam ।।45।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā''rcya vai tataḥ ।
satkṛtā bhojitāstena nārāyaṇena te janāḥ ।।46।।
nyūṣuḥ rātriṃ mahīmānagṛhe saudhe'tisundare ।
cakrurjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau saptamyāṃ premavihvalāḥ ।।47।।
dadṛśurvyomamārgeṇa vimānānyāgatāni te ।
yeṣu muktāstvakṣarasya tathā golokavāsinaḥ ।।48।।
vaikuṇṭhasya tathā muktā vairājā'mṛtavāsinaḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā īśvarāḥ pitarastathā । ।49।
ṛṣayaḥ svargiṇo devā mervāśrayāḥ surādayaḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālāśca mānavāḥ sādhavo'malāḥ ।।2.118.50।
siddhāḥ sādhvyaḥ satīnāryaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ।
nadā nadyaśca tīrthāni samudrāḥ ṛtavastathā ।।5 1 ।
māsā guṇā araṇyāni pātālavāsino'surāḥ ।
divyā bhaktāstathā daityā dānavāścāraṇādayaḥ ।।52।
rājāno divyabhaktāśca saṃsthitāḥ santi yeṣu vai ।
tādṛśāni vimānāni sūryacandranibhāni vai ।।53।
kumārīgaṇagītaiścodghoṣitāni śubhāni ca ।
vādyanādātiśabdāni vyomno'vaterurakṣare ।।54।
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāstu sannidho vai sahasraśaḥ ।
teṣāṃ prabhāḥ prakāśāśca koṭicandrasamāstadā ।।55।।
abhavan gagane bhūmau nagare sarvato diśi ।
rajomātraṃ nāndhakārastatrā'bhūddhāmasadṛśe ।।56।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।
tathā gopālakṛṣṇākhyaḥ pitā mātā tu kambharā ।।57।।
santoṣā ca svasā bhrātā bhagavāँśca śukastathā ।
vallabhaścā'tha vai hemantako'pi bhagavāँstathā ।।58।।
dāsau dvau mañjulā haṃsā saguṇā ca sakhīgaṇaḥ ।
svāgataṃ vāsamarghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ daduḥ sukham ।।59।।
atha vai brāhmasamaye vedānūcurmaharṣayaḥ ।
tadā maṃgalatūryāṇi tvavādyanta samantataḥ ।।2.118.60।।
munayo bhajanaṃ cakruḥ sādhavo dhyānamācaran ।
janāścāpi mahīmānā yayuḥ snātuṃ sarovaram ।।61।।
santāraṇo dvijaścāpi taraṇistasya bhāminī ।
taralā ca kumudā ca vinodaśca vasantakaḥ ।।62।।
sarve te vai kuṭumbaṃ ca smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
yayuḥ snātuṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovarajale tadā ।।63।।
naukāmādāya śabaraṃ tīrasthaṃ te vyalokayan ।
vihartumānasā vārdhau nāvamāruruhuśca te ।।64।।
śulkaṃ datvā niṣeduśca nāviko nāvamairayat ।
jalamadhye gatā naukā krośādapyadhikaṃ yadā ।।65 ।।
tadā naukā aparāśca mānavairadhirohitāḥ ।
śataśaścāpi saraso madhye taṭe samantataḥ ।।66 ।।
viharanti sma jaladhau sukhānnanu sarovare ।
yadṛcchayā mahatyā sā naukayā saha vai tadā ।।67।।
āghātaṃ sahasā prāpya vakrā cādhomukhī kṣaṇāt ।
abhavat tadbhayenaite naukāsthāḥ sahasā tadā ।।68।।
ekapārśve'pasasruśca patitāḥ salilāntare ।
naukā'pi jalamadhye sā magnā jalaprapūritā ।।69।।
atropāyo na caivā'sti samuddhartuṃ tadā hi tān ।
mahatyā naukayā cāpi tathā naukābhireva ca ।।2.118.70।।
sahasā tatra te sarve dhīvaraiḥ parimārgitāḥ ।
agādhe tu jale tatra magnāḥ ṣaḍeva tatkṣaṇāt ।।71 ।।
taraṇasya kalāṃ naite jānanti tena hetunā ।
sarasyeva tale magnā dhīvarāṇāṃ na hastagāḥ ।।72।।
abhavaiṃste tale magnāḥ papurjalaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
sasmaruḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।। 73।।
ārttihaṃ trāṇakartāraṃ nirādhārajalāntare ।
tuṣṭhuvurmanasā mṛtyupāśādhīnāśca vai harim ।।74।।
jalamagnāṃ mahīṃ yaśca samuddadhāra sūkaraḥ ।
jalasthāṃ ca mahānaukāṃ jagrāha makaraśca yaḥ ।। 75।।
jalamagnaṃ mahāśailaṃ pṛṣṭhe kūrmo dadhāra yaḥ ।
jalamagnaṃ gajaṃ bhaktaṃ yo rarakṣa prabhurhariḥ ।।76।।
jalamagnaṃ ca vaṇijaṃ rarakṣa bhagavāँstu yaḥ ।
jalamagnaṃ mahādeśaṃ coṣṭrālayaṃ rarakṣa yaḥ ।।77।।
jalamagnaṃ nṛpaṃ yaśca rarakṣodayanaṃ purā ।
māṃjhāṃbikāṃ jalamagnāṃ samudre saṃrarakṣa yaḥ ।।78।।
evaṃ cānyān jalamagnān rarakṣa vahudhā prabhuḥ ।
nijabhaktān yadi satyān manyase tvaṃ narāyaṇa ।।79।।
tadā'smān dayayā kṛṣṇa santāraya jalāntarāt ।
mṛtyuste sarvadā'dhīnaḥ kālaste kavalastathā ।।2.118.80।।
jalaṃ prāṇanirodhaśca tava śaktivaśau sadā ।
antarātmā bhavānāste tvakālamṛtyuhārakaḥ ।।8 1।।
hara duḥkhāni deveśa yadi trātuṃ hi manyase ।
tvaṃ naukāstvaṃ mahāprāṇastvaṃ jīvastvaṃ ca jīvanam ।।82।।
tvameva jalamadhye vai prahlādaṃ prāṇado'bhavaḥ ।
nāsti stutestu samayaḥ prāṇā jalanirodhitāḥ ।।83।।
sthairyaṃ yānti hṛdātmā ca mūrdhānaṃ pratigacchati ।
kṣaṇaṃ mṛtyormadhyavarti vidyate nā'dhikaṃ tataḥ ।।84।।
ityevaṃ te jalamadhye rādhike'tīva mūrchitāḥ ।
stutvā'rpaṇaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ śrīkambharāsutam ।।85।।
sarvajño bhagavān śrīśo bālakṛṣṇastvarāyutaḥ ।
dhṛtvā vai kāmaṭhaṃ rūpaṃ mahākacchapamuttamam ।।86।।
ṣaḍbhaktān sahasā pṛṣṭhe dhṛtvā tāṃśca jalopari ।
ānayāmāsa bhagavān nirnaukājalamastake ।।87।।
mūrchāṃ jalaṃ ca sahasā bālarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
hastābhyāṃ ca muhuḥ spṛṣṭvā vārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।।88।।
pītaṃ jalaṃ vilīnaṃ ca karasparśanamātrataḥ ।
mūrchā dūra gatā cāpi bhānavanto'bhavaँśca te ।।89।।
svastidā mahati kūrme sthitān dadṛśurantike ।
bālaṃ gopālakṛṣṇasya rakṣakaṃ dadṛśustathā ।।2.118.90 ।।
divarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ ।
mārgayadbhirjanaiḥ ṣaṭ te dṛṣṭā vai kamaṭhopari ।।9 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena rakṣitā iti ।
sahasā te tadā yātā naukāyāṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhataḥ ।।92।।
jagṛhustān nāvikā vai kūrmaścā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo'bhūd bhagavān hi saḥ ।।93।।
sarvaireva kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kūrmo jalāntare naraḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇe layaṃ yātaścaivaṃ dṛṣṭo janaistataḥ ।।94।।
naukayā tān samagṛhya tīramānīya tatyajuḥ ।
āścaryaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇacamatkārātmakaṃ prajāḥ ।।95।।
āvidan rakṣakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhejurvai bhāvatastataḥ ।
atha janmotsavapūjāṃ kartuṃ tataśca maṇḍape ।। 96 ।।
āyayurīśvarā muktā devā devyaśca dehinaḥ ।
pūjanaṃ sarvavastvādyairvyadhuścārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ ।। 97।।
upadāścārpayāmāsustathā pradadurāśiṣaḥ ।
śrīgopālo mahīmānān bhojayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।। 98।।
datvā dānāni bahūni matvopakṛtimuttamām ।
sarvān visarjayāmāsa mahīmānān yayuśca te ।।99।।
santāraṇo dvijastatra bālakṛṣṇāya vai tadā ।
kanyādvayamataṃ jñātvā kanyādvayaṃ dadau mudā ।। 2.118.10 0।।
jagrāha bhagavān kanyāratnadvayaṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
kanyake kṛtakṛtye ca sañjāte patilābhataḥ ।। 10 1।।
lomaśasyā''śrame cobhe lomaśāya harirdadau ।
rakṣituṃ kanyake brahmapriyābhiḥ saha mādhavaḥ ।। 1 02।।
santāraṇaḥ sapatnīkaḥ saputraḥ śrīharestadā ।
pūjāṃ janmotsavaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā kṛteṣṭako'bhavat ।। 1 03।।
ājñāmādāya sa vipro yayau jayantapattanam ।
rādhike tanmahātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ santāraṇābhidham ।। 1 04।।
abhavad yatra vai kūrmo rājate bhagavān svayam ।
tīre mandiramadhye ca snānāt saṃsāratārakaḥ ।। 1 05।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi pāpatāpātsa tārayet।
smaraṇādasya mokṣaḥ syāt kiṃ punaḥ sevanātprabhoḥ ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'śvapaṭṭasarovare caturdaśavarṣīyabālakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprātaḥkāle jalamagnānāṃ santāraṇādiviprāṇāṃ kūrmarūpeṇoddharaṇamityādi-
nirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 118 ।।
