adhyāyaḥ 119
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 120 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ rādhe! bhaktasya vai hareḥ ।
nāmnā devāyatanasya saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ priye ।। 1 ।।
grāme samādhiyānākhye bhakto'bhavacchubhāśrayaḥ ।
ābhīrajātimūrdhanyo devāyatanasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
nityasnānaparo'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritaḥ।
hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin hare nārāyaṇa prabho ।। 3 ।।
śrīgopāla hare kṛṣṇa kambharāśri rame sati! ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ।। 4 ।।
akṣareśa prabhārādhāmāṇikīpārvatīpate ।
satpate muktadhāmeśa bālakṛṣṇa hare hare ।। 5 ।।
evaṃ nityaṃ kīrtanaṃ sa karoti saritastaṭe ।
vālukāsu jale cāpi vṛkṣāśraye ca bhūtale ।। 6 ।।
gṛhe kṣetre vāṭikāsūdyāne'raṇye vane'pi ca ।
sarvakarmasu kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parameśaṃ smaratyatha ।। 7 ।।
bhojane śayane yāne gamane cāsane sadā ।
mroḍe kṣutau cāplavane śauce cālasyamandire ।। 8 ।।
catvare ca sabhāyāṃ ca jātikuṭumbakotsave ।
sūtake śokaviṣaye harṣasthāne'pi sarvadā ।। 9 ।।
hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin tālīvādanapūrvakam ।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sarvadā ।। 2.119.1 0।।
śraddhayā sa karotyeva snānottaraṃ ca pūjanam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ karoti ca ।। 1 1।।
ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalānnajalaśobhitam ।
dadātyeva bhagavate bhāvapremaprapūritaḥ ।। 12।।
grāme deśe janāstaṃ tu devāyatarṣisaṃjñayā ।
prāhurdevāyatarṣiścaikadā vṛkṣatale sthitaḥ ।। 1 3।।
ṭimburuphalamādāya pakvaṃ miṣṭaṃ sukhapradam ।
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nivedanāya vai ।। 14।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhaktyā vaśaṃgataḥ ।
āyayau tumburuvṛkṣasthale yatra sa bhaktarāṭ ।। 15।।
bālagopālaveṣo vai samāgatya hasaँstadā ।
devāyatanahastābhyāṃ tumburudruphalāni tu ।। 16।।
pakvamiṣṭāni saṃgṛhya bubhuje miṣṭatadrasam ।
bhakto devāyatanarṣiścāruphalāni saṃdadau ।। 17।।
prasādaṃ kṛṣṇadattaṃ ca bhuṃkte nṛtyati śaṃsati ।
tallīno mūrtisaṃmagno divyadṛg divyadehavān ।। 18।।
abhavad bandhanaśūnyo vyomākramaṇaśaktimān ।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ phalānyattvā nadīṃ yāto jalāya tu ।। 19।।
devāyano'pi tatpṛṣṭhe nadīṃ yāto jalāya vai ।
kṛṣṇākṛṣṭendriyaprāṇavarṣmā vāṭaṃ yayāvanu ।।2.119.20।।
parvatān vanavṛkṣādīn samullaṃghya hariṃ tvanu ।
jagāma vyomamārgeṇa nirāvaraṇadehavān ।।21 ।।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ cāśvasarovaram ।
śrīhariṃ dhyānavṛttyā vai lakṣyīkṛtya sarovare ।।22।।
sasnau śrīkṛṣṇayogena sopānaiśca jalāntare ।
dehaṃ vismṛtya salile magno'bhūllīlayā kṣaṇāt ।।23।।
deho vai jalamadhye santiṣṭhanneva jalāvilaḥ ।
jalaṃ pītvā''tmanā divyo bhūtvā vai sa jalopari ।।24।।
hare kṛṣṇa hare ravāminnevaṃ raṭan bahistaṭe ।
nirgatya divyadehena kṣaṇaṃ tasthau ca yāvatā ।।25।।
tāvat tasya samāyāto vicāro jīvatārakaḥ ।
yadyahaṃ divyadehena kārayāmi prajāsu tu ।। 26।।
bhajanaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇorjīvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।
ityevaṃ saṃvicāryaiva bhajanaṃ śrīhare hare ।।27।।।
kurvan tvāraṇyakaṃ vyāghraṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ tataḥ param ।
tataḥ saṃyamanīṃ yāmyāṃ purīṃ gatvā'pyakīrtayat ।।28।।
hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin hare nārāyaṇa prabho ।
śrīgopāla hare kṛṣṇa kaṃbharāśri hare vibho ।।19।।
bālakṛṣṇa ramārādhālakṣmīpāravatīpate ।
kamaleśa prabhāmāṇikīśa nārāyaṇa prabho ।।2.119.3 0।।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre nāmakīrtanaghoṣaṇām ।
śrutvā yāmyanigaḍasthā vipāśā bandhanacyutāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
babhūvuḥ sahasā śuddhāḥ pāpatāpavivarjitāḥ ।
muktiyogyā divyadehā vaikuṇṭhayogyadehinaḥ ।।3 2।।
puṇyadehāśca te bhūtvā śrutvā nāma harermuhuḥ ।
dharmarājaṃ namaskṛtya yayurbrahma sanātanam ।।33।।
devāyano'pi yāmyānā bhramitvā sarvabhūmiṣu ।
bālakṛṣṇasya ca hareḥ śrāvayitvā'bhidhāṃ muhuḥ ।। 34।।
prajvālya pāpipāpāni preṣayāmāsa dhāma ca ।
yamadūtā vilokyaitanmahāścaryaṃ yamaṃ prati ।। 35।।
tvaritāḥ prayayurvijñāpayāmāsuraniṣṭakam ।
yamarāja mahābāho kārāgārāṇi pāpinām ।।36।।
kenacittu samāgatya saṃśrāvya nāma vai hareḥ ।
vidhāpyante tu riktāni prayānti brahma pāpinaḥ ।।37।।
puṇyadehāḥ puṇyarūpāḥ puṇyātmāno vihāyasā ।
divyayānena vai gantuṃ samarthāste prayānti hi ।।38।।
nā'smāँste gaṇayatyatra yojitān daṇḍadāyinaḥ ।
tiraskṛtya ca naḥ sarvān pradarśyāṅguṣṭhadantakān ।।3 9।।
vihasyā'smān prayāntyete paśya riktaṃ puraṃ tava ।
ityukto yamarājo'sau yāvat paśyati pattanam ।।।2.119.40।।
yāmyaṃ sarvaṃ daṇḍalokaṃ riktaṃ saṃdṛṣṭavāँstataḥ ।
taṃ dadarśa divyadehaṃ bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ hareḥ ।।41 ।
nāma gṛṇantaṃ tānena śrāvayantaṃ ca nārakān ।
prakṣālayantaṃ pāpāni kurvantaṃ divyamuktatām ।।42।।
preṣayantaṃ harerdhāma baliṣṭhaṃ sāttvataṃ sthitam ।
yamarājo vilokyainaṃ bhaktaṃ nanāma bhāvataḥ ।।43 ।।
prāha svāgatamarghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau tathā ।
āsanaṃ pradadau tasmai upāviveśa bhaktarāṭ ।।44।।
papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ nirāmayaṃ ca nāma ca ।
āgamaṃ ceti bhaktasya bhakto jagāda vai śubham ।।45।।
yamaḥ prāha harernāma pāpināṃ pāpanāśakam ।
bhavān gṛhṇāti bhaktāgrya tadyogyaṃ vai vidhīyate ।।46 ।।
saṃsāro'yaṃ tu pāpiṣṭho duḥkhadaḥ karmabhirvṛtaḥ ।
karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva vilīyate ।।47।।
karmaṇā bhujyate duḥkhaṃ karmaṇā sukhamāpyate ।
sādhukarmaprakartā vai svargaṃ prāpnoti caiśvaram ।।48।।
asādhukarmakartā vai nārakaṃ duḥkhamṛcchati ।
adharmakṛtakāryāṇāṃ pāpināṃ daṇḍahetave ।।49।।
viṣṇunā daṇḍaśālā'tra nirmitā vidyate sadā ।
tatrā'haṃ sūryaputro'smi niyukto dharmadehavān ।।।2.119.50।।
dharmarūpasya me putro harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
kṛṣṇo naraśca te putrāścatvāro mama vai purā ।।5 1 ।।
viśālāyāṃ badaryāṃ vai mānasā hyabhavaiṃśca me ।
tannāmnā sarvadā pāpipāpāni prajvalanti hi ।।52।।
muktiṃ prayānti jīvāśca karmabhūmerbalāt khalu ।
yamasya nagaraṃ tvetad dṇḍaśālā hi kevalā ।।53।।
naiṣā karmakṣitiścāste nā'tra bhaktapraveśanam ।
antareṇa phalabhuktiṃ nā'smāt sthānānnivartanam ।।54।।
ityevaṃ śrīharerājñā manorājñā vidhestathā ।
tāmanusṛtya caivā'tra phalaṃ dadāmi dehine ।।55।।
tanmadhye na kṣatiḥ kāryā yena kenāpi vai kvacit ।
ityevaṃ niyamastvadya bhakta tvayā pradharṣitaḥ ।।56।।
avigaṇayya kṛṣṇasya niyamaṃ yad bhavāniha ।
samāgato'sti pāpānāṃ vināśako vimuktidaḥ ।।57।।
tad yogyaṃ na kṛtaṃ bhakta mā hareḥ kīrtanaṃ kuru ।
ityevaṃ cānunīto'pi na mene śrīharerbalāt ।।58।।।
prāha bhakto yamaṃ tatra muñcedaṃ vyādhapattanam ।
harernāmnā tu te dharma muktiṃ karomi te'pi ca ।।59।।
hare kṛṣṇa hare svāmin vada nārāyaṇeti ca ।
bhajainaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ vācamanyāṃ vimuñca vai ।।2.119.6 0।।
taṃ viditvā cātimṛtyumupaiti netarā sṛtiḥ ।
mokṣārthaṃ khalu jīvānāṃ muktidānaṃ paraṃ matam ।।6 1 ।।
dīnā'nāthadaridrāṇāmaśaktānāṃ pramokṣaṇam ।
ajñānāṃ cā'pyasurāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ sadā ।।62 ।।
kāryaṃ vijānatā nityaṃ saṃsāre pāpasaṃkule ।
mayā tvatra samāgatya pāpināṃ pāpavārdhayaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
pradahyante harernāmnā tad yogyaṃ kriyate yama ।
eko'pi mānavastvatra nāmnā ceduddhareditaḥ ।।64।।
tasya puṇyasya vai pāraṃ naiva paśyāmi sūryaja ।
yamadūtāḥ kathaṃ nvete rakṣitā rākṣasā iva ।।65।।
dīyatāṃ vai tvayā tebhyaścādyadinādabhṛtyatām ।।
śravaṇādyāścitraguptāḥ pragacchantu ca mokṣaṇam ।।66।।
śrāvayāmi harernāma kurvantu nirjanāṃ purīm ।
vasantu bhagavadbhaktāḥ sarve duḥkhavivarjitāḥ ।। 67।।
prakṣālayantu yantrāṇi pāpināṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuru ।
vaiṣṇavāśca bhavantyeva sarve dayālusāttvatāḥ ।।68।।
harernāmabalāt sarvān mokṣayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ ।
yāmyāpurī bhavatveṣā svargapurī sukhānvitā ।।6 9।।
pāpiriktāṃ karomyeṣo bhajanena hareriha ।
yatheṣṭaṃ kuru yāmyeśa bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।2.119.70।।
ityuktvā ca yamaṃ natvā bhajannārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi dhṛtvā yayau kuṇḍeṣu pāpinām ।।7 1 ।।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa śrīpate pārvatīpate ।।72।।
parabrahmā'kṣarātīta māṇikīśa ramāpate ।
rādhālakṣmīpate kṛṣṇa prabhāpate'va pāpinaḥ ।। 73।।
ityevaṃ karatālābhyāṃ śabdayan kaṇṭhatastathā ।
purīṃ yāmyāṃ sukhayaṃśca pāpinaḥ parito yayau ।।74।।
asaṃkhyān pāpinastvevaṃ saṃśrāvya kīrtanaṃ manum ।
pāpāni saṃpradāhyaiva preṣayāmāsa cākṣaram ।। 75।।
yamarājo vihvalaḥ san yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ।
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ cāśvasarovaram ।।76।।
akasmācchrīhareścāgre tvāgatya daṇḍavat bhuvi ।
patitaḥ sāśrunetraśca maunamāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ ।।77।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
jānannapi nṛnāṭyena papracchainaṃ hi kāraṇam ।।78।।
jagāda yamarājo'pi bhaktaṃ yāmye samāgatam ।
arpayantaṃ pramuktiṃ ca pāpibhyo nāmakīrtanāt ।।72।।
hariḥ prāha tu tacchrutvā bhaktā'dhīno'smyahaṃ yama ।
bhaktecchāpūrakaścā'smi bhaktavaśyaḥ karomi kim ।।2.119.80।।
na niroddhumahaṃ śaktastvenaṃ brahmādayo'pi ca ।
tasmācchṛṇu mamājñāṃ tvaṃ mā śucaścātra saṃbhave ।।8 1 ।।
ekavāraṃ yāmyalokaṃ riktaṃ kārayituṃ hi te ।
madbhaktāya tu samayaṃ dehi paścāt gamiṣyati ।।82।।।
riktāyāṃ yamapuryāṃ sa nā'valokya tu pāpinaḥ ।
kṛtakāryaṃ tu matvā svaṃ svayaṃ gato bhaviṣyati ।।83।।
adya me janidivasaścaturdaśasamākṛtaḥ ।
pāpināṃ nigaḍānāṃ vai mokṣaṇaṃ bhavatād yama ।। 84।।
ityukto yamarājo'pi kṛṣṇājñāṃ prāpya pūjanam ।
hareścakāra vidhinā mumude sukhataḥ sthitaḥ ।।85।।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān yamarājaṃ tataḥ param ।
dadau ca mukuṭaṃ tasmai sauvarṇaṃ mastake hariḥ ।।86।।
kaṇṭhe hāraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ ratnahīrakaśobhitam ।
'oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।87।।
mantraṃ dadau ca tulasīmālāṃ yameśvarāya vai ।
pāritoṣyaṃ dadau mūrtiṃ pratimāṃ svāṃ suvarṇajām ।।88।।
tataśca bhagavān bālakṛṣṇo jagāda sūryajam ।
bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ brūhi jaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।।8 9।।
vimānaṃ sarvagāmyetad dehi tasmai sukhāspadam ।
yātrārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ kalpavallyādi saṃśritam ।। 2.119.90।।
adhiruhya prayāhi tvaṃ yamarāja vimānakam ।
prasādaṃ tu mama nītvā dehi sarvebhya eva ca ।।9 1।।
tvatpuraṃ pāvanaṃ cāstu cādyā'parādhivarjitam ।
devāyane prayāte tu punaḥ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।92।।
ityukto yamarājaḥ sa rādhike śrīhariṃ tadā ।
natvā kṛtvā daṇḍavacca bhūtvā vai vaiṣṇavo mahān ।।93 ।।
yayau vimānavaryeṇa yāmyaṃ naijaṃ puraṃ punaḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa sarvebhyo yadvṛttaṃ harisannidhau ।।94।।
devāyano'pi yacchrutvā mumude'ti nanarta ca ।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakre bhramitvā paritaḥ puram ।।95।।
riktaṃ yamapuraṃ cakre saṃśrāvya nāma vai hareḥ ।
yamarājo dadau tasmai prasādaṃ ca vimānakam ।।96।।
yamadūtāḥ pāpināṃ ca pīḍanaṃ prajahustataḥ ।
mocitā nigaḍebhyaśca bandhanebhyastathā tadā ।।97।।
gatāḥ sarve harernāmnā svargaṃ satyaṃ sukhāśrayam ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ tathā'mṛtam ।।98।।
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nivartante na yadgatāḥ ।
ityevaṃ sucamatkāro dṛṣṭo jāto janaistadā ।।99।।
caturdaśasthalokairvai tathā dhāmanivāsibhiḥ ।
bhuktimuktipradaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samartho na karoti kim ।। 2.119.10 0।।
yasya sarvaṃ yatra sarvaṃ yadvaśe sarvameva ca ।
yasmāt sarvaṃ sa vai śāstā kiṃ na karoti rādhike।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devāyatanarṣibhakto yamapuryāṃ śrīharernāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā yāmyān sarvān mocayāmāsetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
navadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 119 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 119 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 120
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 121 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! paścād yāmyalokaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ।
devāyatanabhaktastu pūjāṃ prāpya yamārpitām ।। 1 ।।
vimānena yayau tasmānnairṛtāṃ diśamekalaḥ ।
dadarśa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ svargatulyāṃ suvarṇajām ।। 2 ।।
nirṛtānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ prāsādairabhiśobhitām ।
lakṣayojanavistīrṇaprākārapariveṣṭitām ।। 3 ।।
mṛṣāmāyendrajālānāṃ śālābhiḥ ṛddhisaṃbhṛtām ।
arbudārbudapadmānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ kuṭumbakaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
niṣevitāṃ mahāsvargopamāṃ cā'mbarasaṃsthitām ।
sūryavad bhrājamānāṃ tāṃ vilokya bhaktarāṭ tadā ।। 5 ।।
dīrghasvareṇa tālādyaiḥ sahitaṃ kīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ।। 6 ।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa parabrahma ramāpate ।
lakṣmīpate māṇikīśa pāravatīprabhāpate ।। 7 ।।
śrīgopāla satāṃpāla rādheśa kaṃbharātmaja ।
akṣareśa ca gopeśa mukteśa kuṃkumādhipa ।। 8 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parameśa janārdana ।
muktinātha mahāviṣṇo śrīpate puruṣottama ।। 9 ।।
evaṃ nairṛtapuryāṃ sa vicarannambare gṛṇan ।
nāmāni śrāvayāmāsa nairṛtebhyo manuṃ tathā ।। 2.120.1 0।।
nairṛtāśca prajālokāḥ śrutvā śrutvā śubhāṃ giram ।
niṣpāpā abhavan rakṣogaṇāśca divyavigrahāḥ ।। 11 ।।
rakṣobhāvavihīnāśca divyapārṣadadehinaḥ ।
sambhūya muktarūpāśca vihāya nagarīṃ nijām ।। 1 2।।
yayurbhaktabalenaiva kalpalatotthavāhanaiḥ ।
gajayānairvimānaiśca devāyanārpitaistadā ।। 13।।
akṣaraṃ brahmalokaṃ te tathā vaikuṇṭhamityapi ।
tathā golokamevā'nye'mṛtaṃ vā'vyākṛtaṃ pare ।। 14।।
yatheṣṭaṃ pārṣadā bhūtvā tattaddhāmasu te gatāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmaśraveṇa te ।। 15।।
mahāpuṇyābdhayo bhūtvā yayurvai brahma śāśvatam ।
atha tasmātpradeśāt sa vyomnā vai vāruṇīṃ purīm ।। 16।।
paścimāyāṃ yayau kurvan nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।
lakṣayojanavistīrṇaprākārāntaḥkṛtāśrayām ।। 17।।
dadarśa tāṃ bhraman vyomnā vimānena samantataḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa janatāḥ prācetasīrmuhurmuhuḥ ।। 18।।
tāḥ sarvāśca prajā divyā bhūtvā śrutvā'bhidhāṃ manum ।
kalpavallīkṛtairyānairyayuste dhāma caiśvaram ।। 19।।
narā nāryo divyadehāḥ sarvathā divyarūpiṇaḥ ।
bhinnadhāmāni ca yayurdevāyanasamāgamāt ।।2.120.20।।
atha tasmātpradeśācca vyomnā vai vāyavīṃ purīm ।
yayau devāyano bhakto gṛṇannāma harermuhuḥ ।।21 ।।
vāyūnāṃ devatāḥ sarvā marutāṃ sṛṣṭayastathā ।
vāyavīyaśarīrāste śrutvā'bhidhāṃ manuṃ hareḥ ।।22।।
lakṣayojanamadhyasthāstadā purīprajājanāḥ ।
divyadehadharā bhūtvā yayurdhāma hareḥ khalu ।।23।।
vimānaṃ tu bhramad vyomnā sarvāṃ prācetasīṃ purīm ।
prajāstatra sthitāḥ saṃśrāvayāmāsa hare hare ।।24।।
devāyano'pi tāḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa harergṛham ।
tathā'nyānyapi dhāmāni kalpavallīvimānakaiḥ ।।25।।
athottarāṃ diśaṃ devāyanarṣiḥ prayayau tataḥ ।
kauberīṃ supurīṃ lakṣayojanāyatadurgikām ।। 26 ।।
dadarśā'mbaramārgeṇa gṛṇan nāma manuṃ hareḥ ।
tāṃ bhraman savimānena tadgatāṃ yakṣakaprajām ।। 27।।
śrāvayāmāsa nāmāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।
harebrahma parabrahma yakṣān muktān cakāra saḥ ।।28।।
kṣayaṃ yātāni pāpāni yakṣāṇāṃ puṇyaśālinām ।
puṇyānyeṣāṃ vardhitāni nārāyaṇaśruterbalāt ।। 29।।
divyadehāstato bhūtvā muktadehāḥ samantataḥ ।
kalpavallīsamutpannavimānairakṣarābhigaiḥ ।।2.120.30 ।।
yayuste tāṃ purīṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gavāṃ sthalīm ।
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ prāpuste śrīharerbalāt ।। 31 ।।
atha devāyano bhakto yayau ceśānapālitām ।
diśaṃ vilokayāmāsa purīṃ tatreśapālitām ।।32।।
lakṣayojanadurgāntarvartinīṃ rudraśobhitām ।
śatarudrāḥ koṭirudrāḥ śaṃkarā īśamūrtayaḥ ।।33 ।।
īśānyo rudrapatnyaśca yatrā'rbudā'bjakoṭayaḥ ।
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍāśca vināyakāḥ ।।34।।
vetālāśca kumārāśca bhairavā gaṇakoṭayaḥ ।
vīrāśca bhadradevāśca ḍākinyaḥ śākinīgaṇāḥ ।।35।।
yoginyo yoginaścāpi yatayaśca virāgiṇaḥ ।
vetālanyaśca kūṣmāṇḍyaḥ kṛtyāśca pūtanāgaṇāḥ ।।36।।
durgāśca nandinaścāpi caṇḍāścaṇḍyaḥ satīgaṇāḥ ।
ete yatrā'saṃkhyadāsadāsīgaṇāvasanti hi ।। 37।।
īśānasya harasyaiva dṛṣṭā devāyanena hi ।
tato vimānaṃ vyomni tad bhrāmayāmāsa bhaktarāṭ ।।38।।
jagādoccairharernāmā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।
kambharānandana viṣṇo gopālabāla mādhava ।। 39।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa puruṣottama keśava ।
antarātman prabhākānta śrīkānta parameśvara ।।2.120.40 ।।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ।
svāminnārāyaṇa nārāyaṇeśvara rameśvara ।।41 ।।
māṇikyeśvara māyeśa pārvatīśvara bhūpate ।
līlāpate vibhūtīśa rādhāpate satāṃpate ।।42।।
śrīvallabha śrīpadmeśa śrīkṛṣṇa śrīnarāyaṇa ।
śrīrāma śrīkamaleśa maṃgalāyatana prabho ।।43।।
ityevaṃ sa gṛṇan kṛṣṇanāmāni ca manuṃ hareḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mokṣayāmāsa karmataḥ ।।44।।
divyadehamayān kṛtvā dhāmayogyān gaṇān śubhān ।
viṣṇutulyān śaṃbhudāsān dāsīḥ ramāsamāstathā ।।।42।।
preṣayāmāsa vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā ।
amṛtākhyaṃ divyadhāmā'vyākṛtaṃ ca kilāsakam ।।46। ।
sāketaṃ cāpi ye yasya yogyāstāँstatra cairayat ।
muktiṃ kṛtvā tu vai teṣāṃ nāmakīrtanato hareḥ ।।47।।
vimānaiḥ preṣayitvaiva tataḥ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ yayau ।
ujjvalāṃ koṭisūryābhāṃ dadarśendrapurīṃ śubhām ।।48।।
lakṣayojanaprākāravartinīṃ smṛddhisaṃbhṛtām ।
rājadhānīṃ divo ramyāṃ lokapālālayāṃ parām ।।49।।
sarvasuvarṇaprāsādāṃ dikpālādyadhivāsitām ।
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ prāsādairabhiśobhitām ।।2.120.50।।
ketūnāṃ suravargāṇāmālayairabhitaḥ kṛtām ।
mandiraiḥ sarvasiddhīnāṃ vasūnāṃ ca sumandiraiḥ ।।51 ।।
nidhīnāṃ mandiraiścāpi saptarṣīṇāṃ nivāsanaiḥ ।
kṛttikānāṃ mahāsaudhairdiśāṃ prāsādakairyutām ।52।।
rudrāṇāṃ cāpi sūryāṇāṃ kāmānāṃ cālayairyutām ।
manūnāṃ ca kalānāṃ ca tithīnāṃ mandirairyutām ।।53।।
marutāṃ vālakhilyānāṃ cāruṇānāṃ nivāsanaiḥ ।
devīnāmapsarasāṃ brahmasarasāṃ tathālayaiḥ ।।54।।
tattvānāṃ susamudyānaiḥ kalpadrumaiḥ samantataḥ ।
amṛtānāṃ ca kulyābhirbrahmavāṭyabhiśobhitām ।।।55।।
sūtairmāgadhalokaiśca bandījanaiḥ prasevitām ।
bhāṭacāraṇagandharvaiḥ kimpuruṣaiśca kinnaraiḥ ।।56।।
sādhyadevairviśvadevaiḥ siddhaiśca rājabhiryutām ।
sarvaśreṣṭhāṃ rājadhānīṃ vilokya cātisaṃbhṛtām ।।57।।
vividhairdehibhiḥ ramyāṃ bhinnajātīyavāsibhiḥ ।
harṣaṃ prāpyā'tivegena devāyanarṣirutsukaḥ ।।58।।
kīrtayāmāsa nāmāni bālakṛṣṇasya vai manum ।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ।।59।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa rāmakṛṣṇa janārdana ।
śrīgopāla satāṃpāla kaṃbharānandana prabho ।।2.120.60।।
brahmapriyāpate rādhāpate ramāpate vibho ।
ātmapate prāṇapate parabrahma pareśvara ।।61 ।।
sarvalokapate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabhāpate ।
māṇikyeśvara māyeśa sureśvareśvareśvara ।।62।।
śrībhūpāravatīkānta svāminnārāyaṇa prabho ।
akṣareśvara mukteśa mokṣaprada mahāprabho ।।63।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa lakṣmīkānta divaspate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ।।64।।
nārāyaṇeśa kṛṣṇeśa kṛṣṇavallabhasatpate ।
vidyāvyāsā'vatāreśa naranārāyaṇa prabho ।।65।।
evaṃ nāmāni bahudhā gṛṇan tālī pravādayan ।
bhrāmayan svaṃ vimānaṃ cābhitaścaindrīṃ purīṃ tadā ।।66।।
rādhike! bhaktarāṭ devāyatanaḥ sāttvatāgraṇīḥ ।
mokṣayāmāsa devāṃśca mahendrapuravāsinaḥ ।।67।।
divyadehān muktadehān dhāmayogyān vidhāya saḥ ।
preṣayāmāsa kalpadrulatotthaiśca vimānakaiḥ ।।68।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ golokamakṣaram ।
paramaṃ dhāma muktānāṃ vāsārhaṃ kārṣṇavāllabham ।।69।।
dharmabhaktiyutaṃ sarvasvāminā paramātmanā ।
adhiṣṭhitaṃ paraṃdhāma parameśaniṣevitam ।।2.120.70।।
devā naikavidhā devyo divyadehāścaturbhujāḥ ।
dvibhujāścā'ṣṭahastāśca tathā ṣoḍaśabāhavaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
bhūtvā bhūtvā ca nāmāni śrutvā dhāma yayurhareḥ ।
evaṃ svargasthitān kṛtvā muktān nāmnāṃ prakīrtanaiḥ ।।72।।
devāyatanabhaktaśca yayāvagnipurīṃ tataḥ ।
yatrā'gnayo vibhinnāśca vasanti koṭyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।73 ।।
garbhāgnayaśca pākānāmagnayo jāṭharāgnayaḥ ।
ūṣmāgnayastathā homāgnayaḥ kṣveḍāgnayastathā ।।74।।
cintāgnayastathā devāgnayaścitāgnayastathā ।
dāvāgnayaḥ śītavahnigaṇāścāmāgnayastathā ।।75।।
pretāgnayaśca devānāṃ mukharūpāgnayastathā ।
pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca paviḥ śmaśānajāstathā ।।76।।
ghaṭāgnayaḥ sarvabhakṣā havyabhakṣāgnayastathā ।
vaḍavānalarūpāśca tathā meghānalādayaḥ ।।77।।
ārtavā agnayaścāpi krūrāḥ saumyā gaṇāstathā ।
khanyagnayaśca bhūtānāmagnayo bhinnajātayaḥ ।।78।।
śvetā raktāstathā kṛṣṇā nīlā pītā haridguṇāḥ ।
kapīśāḥ saptajihvāśca bahujihvāḥ pradāhakāḥ ।।79।।
tān sarvān vīkṣya bhakteśo'mbare vimānasaṃsthitaḥ ।
kīrtayāmāsa bahudhoccakairnāmāni vai hareḥ ।।2.120.80।।
manuṃ saṃśrāvayāmāsa hare kṛṣṇa hare hare ।
bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma māṇikīrādhikāpate ।।81 ।।
yajñanārāyaṇa kṛṣṇavallabha śrīsatīpate ।
parameśvara deveśa muktadhāmapate hare ।।82।।
prabhākānta ramākānta kamalākānta mādhava ।
śrībhūlīlāpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa satīpate ।।।83 ।।
lakṣmīnātha ca dīnānāṃ pate brahmapriyāpate ।
pārvatīlalitāsvāmin vṛndāvibhūtipālaka ।।84।।
sarvavahnipate viṣṇo mahāviṣṇo narāyaṇa ।
sarvāvatāraheto śrīpate gopālanandana ।।85।।
ityevaṃ bhaktarāṭ devāyatano nāma vai hareḥ ।
gṛṇan saṃśrāvayāmāsa tālavādanakaiḥ saha ।।86 ।।
bhramitvā parito vahneḥ purīṃ lakṣāyatāṃ śubhām ।
vahnīn vahniprajāḥ sarvā divyā bhaktaścakāra ha ।।87।।
dvibhujān sucaturbāhūn bahubāhūn parān śubhān ।
nāmakīrtanasāmarthyāt kṛtvā datvā manuṃ hareḥ ।।88।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।।89 ।।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।। 2.120.90।।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।। 91 ।।
'kṛṣṇavallabhabhaktohaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
ityevaṃ tu manūn tebhyo datvā muktān vidhāpya ca ।। 92।।।
vaiṣṇavān dhāmayogyāँśca vimāneṣu niṣādya ca ।
preṣayāmāsa tān dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ।।9 3 ।।
avyākṛtaṃ ca golokaṃ paramā'kṣaradhāma ca ।
jayaśabdān prakurvanto yayuste dhāma vai hareḥ ।।94।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! bhakto devāyatanasaṃjñakaḥ ।
śrīhareścātmavedī vai mokṣakartā'bhavatpurā ।।95 ।।
aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ dhāmabhyastāḥ prajāḥ sa hi ।
mokṣayāmāsa sarvāśca preṣayāmāsa mokṣaṇam ।।96 ।।
nāmakīrtanabhaktyaiva balena śrīharestathā ।
manūn datvā sa sarvebhyo vidhāya vaiṣṇavān śubhān ।। 97।।
riktān vai tatpradeśāँśca kārayāmāsa nāmataḥ ।
na bhūto vā na ca bhāvī devāyanasamo muniḥ ।। 98।।
ādyasṛṣṭau hi bhakto'yaṃ sañjātaḥ kṛṣṇavigrahaḥ ।
atha tasyā diśaścāyaṃ bhakto vimānamāsthitaḥ ।। 99।।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre harṣasamanvitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā puraḥ sthitaḥ ।। 2.120.10 0।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ samutthāya taṃ bhaktaṃ pariṣasvaje ।
dadau hṛdaye caraṇau hastau ca mastake tathā ।। 101 ।।
prasādaṃ bhojayāmāsa gale hāraṃ dadau hariḥ ।
ūrje dhavalapratipaddine tasmai hariḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 02।।
dadau pāritoṣikaṃ ca tathā''vāsaṃ nijālaye ।
sa viśrāntiṃ tataścakre kārtike pūrṇimā'vadhim ।। 103 ।।
rādhike! paṭhanādasyā madbhaktasya camatkṛteḥ ।
pāṭhanācchrāvaṇādvāpi śravaṇānmuktibhāgbhavet ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devāyatanarṣerbhaktyā prasanno bālakṛṣṇastadvaśībhūto jalāttaṃ rarakṣa, aṣṭadikpālaprajābhyaḥ śrīharernāma śrāvayitvā
taddvārā tāsāṃ muktiṃ cakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 120 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 121
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 122 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rāseśvari mahādevi rādhe golokakaumudi ।
ākarṇaya kathāṃ devāyatanasya tataḥ parām ।। 1 ।।
parabrahmabalenā'sau muktatāṃ tu samarjayan ।
parabrahmasamaṃ kāryaṃ karotyeva nideśataḥ ।। 2 ।।
mārgā'sitasya pratipaddine kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
prāha bhaktaṃ pūjayantaṃ bahuvastubhirādarāt ।। 3 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo'hamevā'smi parabrahmaparātparaḥ ।
parameśaḥ sarvanārāyaṇānāmīśitā prabhuḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarve nārāyaṇā mattaḥ prāvirbhavanti sarvadā ।
sarvasṛṣṭiṣu bhaktendra me'vatārā asaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 5 ।।
mama rūpāṇyasaṃkhyāni guṇaiśvaryamayānyapi ।
teṣāṃ yogena jīvānāṃ karomi śreya uttamam ।। 6 ।।
mama bhaktāḥ pārṣadāśca satyo brāhmyo'pi me priyāḥ ।
āvirbhavanti lokeṣu tārayanti ca dehinaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tvaṃ sadā mama mukto'si mamā''layo'si vai hṛdi ।
mannivāso'si bhaktendra matkāryaṃ kriyate tvayā ।। 8 ।।
jīvā yāmyā aiśvarāśca devā uddhāritāstvayā ।
athā'pi kṣitiloke'tra yāhi kiṃpuruṣottarān ।। 9 ।।
himālayāt pare pāre prajākalyāṇahetave ।
sindhumullaṃghya śailaṃ ca paramindukuśaṃ tataḥ ।। 2.121.1 0।।
kaśyapāyanavārdhiṃ ca tathā ca urulāṃ nadīm ।
urulaṃ parvataṃ cāpi kārusamudramityapi ।। 1 1।।
trimuraṃ dvīpakalpaṃ ca tandrāpradeśamityapi ।
śāntalāriṃ pradeśaṃ ca kāmacāṭakadeśakān ।। 12।
stenāvāsaṃ parvataṃ ca tathā śailaṃ prabhānulam ।
dvikalaṃ ca saraścāpi samānaṃ parvataṃ tathā ।। 1 3।।
kīragarjanabhūbhāgaṃ śibirājapradeśakān
obīnadīpradeśaँśca yāneśīsarito bhuvam ।। 14।।
bīnāṃ nadīṃ piṃgadeśān yātu tvaṃ raśanābhuvam ।
uttarān raśanāsaṃjñān bhāgān kiṃpuruṣasya vai ।। 19।।
tatratyamānavān sarvān vaiṣṇavān kuru bhaktarāṭ ।
bhajanaṃ ca manuṃ nāmnāṃ kīrtanaṃ śrāvayā'niśam ।। 16।।
vimānaṃ sacamatkāraṃ mahāścaryamayaṃ mahat ।
kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣacintāmaṇisamanvitam ।। 17।।
gṛhīpvā ca prayāhyevaṃ jīvānuddhartumādarāt ।
pradyumnaṃ mama rūpaṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ te dadāmyapi ।। 18।।
ityuktvā suvimānaṃ ca datvā pradyumnamityapi ।
preṣayāmāsa bhagavān mārgaśīrṣe'sita dale ।। 19।।
yathoktena tu mārgeṇa devāyatanabhaktarāṭ ।
indukuśaṃ cābhivīkṣya mumude manasā muhuḥ ।। 2.121.20।।
bhajanaṃ coccakaiścakre bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin śrīmadgopālanandana ।।21।।
parabrahma harekṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śriyaḥpate ।
rādhākṛṣṇa prabhākṛṣṇa māṇikīkṛṣṇa mādhava ।।22।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇa svāminnārāyaṇa narāyaṇa ।
jaya muktapate satāṃpata śrīpārvatīpata ।।23।।
sarvāvatāradhartastvaṃ jayaśrīkṛṣṇavallabha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīpuruṣottama ।।24।।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare ।
haresvāmin rāmakṛṣṇa sītāpate satīpate ।।255।।।
rāmakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇarāmajanārdana! ।
kaṃbharānandana śrīmadgopālabāla keśava ।।26।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥsūrya akṣarakṣetracandramaḥ ।
śrīmatkuṃkumavāpīstha jayakṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।।27।।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa harehare ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīparameśvara ।।28।।
brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇaharehare ।
padmāpate ca kamalāpate śrītulasīpate ।।29।।
vṛndāpate tathā cātmapate kṛṣṇaharehare ।
bhārgavīkānta lalitākānta gopīpatehare ।।2.121.30।।
ityevaṃ kīrtanaṃ nāmnāṃ kurvan saṃgarjayan muhuḥ ।
ninādayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ prajābhyaḥ śrāvayan muhuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vimānena yayau tvagre kaśyapāyanavārnidhim ।
tasya pūrvapradeśeṣu prajāḥ saṃśrāvayan tataḥ ।।32।।
ūrulāsaritaḥ pūrvapradeśeṣu punaḥ punaḥ ।
saṃśrāvayan harernāmakīrtanaṃ vyomamārgataḥ ।।33।।
urulāt parvatāt pūrvadeśān kārusamudrataḥ ।
pūrvadakṣiṇadeśāँśca śrāvayannabhidhā hareḥ ।।34।।
trimuraṃ dvīpakalpaṃ ca yayau tandrāprajāsu ca ।
śrāvayāmāsa tannāma himaśaityasahāḥ prajāḥ ।।35।।
śāntalāripradeśāँśca tato vai kāmacāṭakān ।
stenāvāsaṃ giriṃ cāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ।।36।।
prabhālunagiriṃ cāpi samānaṃ parvataṃ yayau ।
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi kīragarjanabhūtalam ।।37।।
śibirājapradeśāँśca obīṃ yāneśakīṃ nadīm ।
bīnāṃ pigapradeśāँśca sarvāṃ ca raśanābhuvam ।।38।।
rāśiyānapradeśāँśca bhramitvā tu punaḥ punaḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa vai sarvān janān nāmāni vai hareḥ ।। 39।।
saptakṛtvo dadau cakraṃ rāśiyāneṣu rāśivat ।
uktasthalīyalokeṣu bhūśailaraṇavāriṣu ।।2.121.40।।
vanāraṇyahimadvīpopadvīpāntarabhūmiṣu ।
vimānena dadau cakraṃ śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam ।।41।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ harikṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma bhajantviha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa kurvantu vai hṛdi ।।42।।।
karṇābhyāṃ tatkathāṃ ramyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm ।
śṛṇvantu cakṣuṣā tvasya kurvantu darśanaṃ sadā ।।42।।
kaṇṭhe tasyaiva tulasīmālāṃ gṛhṇantu mānavāḥ! ।
bhakṣayantu prasādaṃ ca pibantu tajjalaṃ śubham ।।44।।
kīrtayantu ca nāmāni bālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā ।
spṛśantu tasya caraṇau jighrantu gandhamasya ca ।।45।।
pūjayantu hariṃ nityaṃ śrīmadgopālabālakam ।
smarantu śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ kurvantu tasya vai stutim ।।46।।
śaraṇaṃ tasya kṛṣṇasya gṛhṇantu mokṣahetave ।
bhuktimuktipradaścāsya caraṇaḥ saṃ prasevyatām ।।47।।
dhāryatāṃ hṛdye mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
parabrahmasvarūpaḥ sa vartate puruṣottamaḥ ।।48।।
saurāṣṭre kambharāgehe śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
aho lokā dehanāśe saha nāyānti kiñcana ।।49।।
sarvaṃ cātraiva tiṣṭhatyāvināśaṃ ca mṛṣā tataḥ ।
tadbandhanaṃ vihāyaiva bhajantu parameśvaram ।।2.121.50 ।।
ahaṃ tasyaiva bhakto'smi sākṣānnārāyaṇasya ha ।
tannāmāni raṭantvatra smarantvarthaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।।5 1।।
brahmadhāmeśvaraṃ sādhupatiṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim ।
muktanāthaṃ cātmanāthaṃ smarantu narayoṣitaḥ ।।52।।।
mānuṣasya tu deho'yaṃ durlabho durlabhā gatiḥ ।
mokṣasyā'nena dehena prāpyate sādhanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।।53।।
haresvāmin harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa janārdana ।
dharmaputra hare brahmapara śrīparameśvara ।।54।।
rādhāramāsatīsvāmin prabhāpāravatīpate ।
lakṣmīśrīmaṃgalākānta śrījayālalitāpate ।।55।।
bhagavan sarvalokeśa sarvanārāyaṇeśvara ।
avatāreśa dhāmeśa tattveśvara prabho hare ।।56।।
evaṃ saṃkīrtayantveva bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhi vaḥ ।
ityevaṃ saptavāraṃ sa bhaktarāḍ rādhike! muhuḥ ।।57।।
rāśiyāneṣu deśeṣu śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam ।
janāḥ śrutvā vimāna ca dṛṣṭvā divyaṃ sukhapradam ।।।58।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā ābālavṛddhamānavāḥ ।
draṣṭuṃ sambhūya ca bahiḥ samāyānti sma cāmbare ।।59।।
vilokayanti bahudhā kīrtayanti hariṃ tathā ।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇasvāmin kṛṣṇa hare hare ।।2.121.60।।
praśaṃsanti guruṃ bhaktaṃ devāyatanamīśavat ।
aho mātā pitā bandhurbhagavannāmadāyakaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
patiḥ patnī priyo mitraṃ harernāmnāṃ pradāyakaḥ ।
sutaḥ putrī sakhā saṃśrāvako nāmnāṃ harerhi saḥ ।।62।।
sutādayastu ye bhaktiṃ naivā'tra bodhayanti vai ।
te tu svārthaparā loke nāmamātrasya dhārakāḥ ।।63।।
durlabho mānuṣo deho dehināṃ kṣīṇadharmakaḥ ।
akṣīṇaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma prāptavyaṃ tena dhīmatā ।।64।।
parameśvarabhaktau ye nirodhayanti mānavāḥ ।
na te sambandhino mānyāḥ sambandhino hi bhaktidāḥ ।।65।।
vimāne yaḥ sthito devaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktipradarśakaḥ ।
so'tra deśe gṛhe no'tra samāyātu pratāpavān ।।56।।
vayaṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣyāmo bālakṛṣṇasya devate! ।
āruhyā'smadgṛhān deva pāvayā'smadgṛhāṇi ca ।।67।।
ityevaṃ te janāḥ sarve rāśiyānapradeśakāḥ ।
śrutvā śrutvā harernāma prārthayāmāsurādarāt ।।68।।
atha tatrā'bhavanmukhyāḥ ṛṣayo dvādaśottamāḥ ।
bhinnasthāneṣu tiṣṭhantastrikālajñā virāgiṇaḥ ।।69।।
rādhike! te harerbhaktaṃ vimānaṃ bhaktiśobhitam ।
vijñāya vyomamārgeṇa vimānaṃ prati cāyayuḥ ।।2.121.70।।
meṣāyano maharṣiśca vṛṣabhāyana yogirāṭ ।
mithunāyananāmarṣiḥ karkāyanaśca tāpasaḥ ।।7 1।।
siṃhāyanastathā kanyāyanastulāyanastathā ।
vṛścikāyananāmarṣirdhanāyanaśca vai ṛṣiḥ ।।72।।
makarāyanasaṃjñarṣiḥ kuṃbhāyanastathāṛṣiḥ ।
mīnāyanaṛṣiścāpi sarve yogaparāyaṇāḥ ।।73।।
rāśiyānapradeśeṣu labdhasthānā maharṣayaḥ ।
brahmadhyānaparāścāsan sarve bhinnanivāsinaḥ ।।74।।
brahmajñānaparāścāpi samādhisthitivartinaḥ ।
jñātvā yogena ca devāyatanaṃ harideśitam ।।75 ।।
bodhayantaṃ janān loke kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ śubham ।
draṣṭuṃ vyomni vimāne te tvāyayurharṣavihvalāḥ ।।76।।
prathamaṃ te tu ṛṣayaḥ prajārūpeṇa bhaktakam ।
nemulauṃkikarītyaiva satkṛtā bhaktakena ca ।।77।।
vanditāḥ pūjitāḥ praśaṃsitā dhanyavacāyitāḥ ।
niṣāditāśca bhaktena jijñāsitāḥ pratīṣṭakam ।।78।।
pṛṣṭāḥ paricayārthaṃ ca jagaduste nijodbhavam ।
vayaṃ sarve bhrātaraḥ sma rudraputrā hi rudrajāḥ ।।79।।
brahmaṇā prathamaṃ sṛṣṭirlalāṭād yā kṛtā tadā ।
rudro jātaḥ krūraputro vṛddhaye viniyojitaḥ ।।2.121.80।।
tenā'saṃkhyāḥ samā svena rudrā vai prakaṭīkṛtāḥ ।
krūrāste brahmaṇā dṛṣṭāḥ saṃhāriṇo'vamāninaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
teṣāṃ saṃharaṇārthaṃ vai brahmā rudraṃ jagād ha ।
rudrasteṣāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yadā saṃhāramācarat ।।82।।
tadā vayaṃ bhayaṃ prāptā dvādaśa rudraputrakāḥ ।
rudrā eva svakaṃ rūpaṃ pravivṛttya jalāntare ।।83 ।।
gahvare ca guhāyāṃ ca khanyāṃ droṇyāṃ yathāyatham ।
guptā jīvanavāñcchāḍhyā līnabhāvamupāgatāḥ ।।84।।
bahuvarṣasahasrānte brahmā tapastato'karot ।
rudrasṛṣṭervināśānte dundubhyādīn sasarja saḥ ।।85 ।।
mandirasthān pārṣadān vai tataśca sanakādikān ।
tato yogeśvarāँścāpi tato maharṣimaṇḍalam ।।86 ।।
rājarṣīṃśca tato brahmā sasarja pitṛdevatāḥ ।
kaśyapācca tataḥ sūryacandrādyā subhavestadā ।।87।।
asmābhiḥ svaprakāśatvaṃ kṛtaṃ devasabhāsu tu ।
brahmaṇā ca tathā devaiḥ sammāntitā maharṣayaḥ ।।88।।
yogino mānave loke sṛṣṭyarthamupakāriṇaḥ ।
niyuktā brahmaṇā devaiḥ saha kṛtvā vinirṇayam ।।89।।
rāṃ lakṣmīṃ sampadaṃ śobhām aśnumo vayamādarāt ।
dadmaścāpi prasannāśca rāśayastena vai vayam ।।2.121.90।।
niyuktāḥ phaladānārtha karmiṇāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām ।
tato vayaṃ sthitā yatra tatra te naḥ pradeśakāḥ ।। 91 ।।
rāśiyānā ime santi vayaṃ vai rāśisaṃjñakāḥ ।
ājñāṃ saṃpālayantaśca brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ।।92।।
dhruvadeśaṃ vicaranto vasāmastvatra sarvadā ।
sūryacandrādibhiḥ sarvairnavagrahaiḥ sahāyatām ।।।92।।
asmākaṃ tu samagṛhya pacyate sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam ।
te vayam ṛṣayastvatra vasāmo rudraputrakāḥ ।।94।।
rudrasṛṣṭyavaśeṣā vai yathākarmaphalapradāḥ ।
tato brahmā dadau varṇān nastu sārasvatān pṛthaka ।।95।।
meṣāyanāya pradadau alaivarṇakān ajaḥ ।
vṛṣabhāya dadau brahmā vavauvarṇakān tadā ।।96।।
mithunāya dadau brahmā kachaghavarṇakāँstadā ।
karkāyanāya pradadau ḍahākṣarau pitāmahaḥ ।।97।।
siṃhāyanāya pradadau maṭavarṇau pitāmahaḥ ।
kanyāyanāya pradadau paṭhaṇavarṇakān ajaḥ ।।98।।
tulāyanāya pradadau ratavarṇau pitāmahaḥ ।
vṛścikāya dadau brahmā nayavarṇau tadā tataḥ ।।99।।
dhanāyanāya bhamaphaḍhavarṇān pradadāvajaḥ ।
makarāya dadau brahmā khajavarṇau tadā tataḥ ।। 2.121.1 00।।
kuṃbhāyanāya pradadau gaśavarṇau pitāmahaḥ ।
mīnāyanāya dacajhayavarṇān pradadāvajaḥ ।। 101 ।।
tattadvarṇān jīvakarmabodhakān vidadhe hyajaḥ ।
asmadyoge tu candrādau yasya janma tu dehinaḥ ।। 1 02।।
tattadvarṇakṛtanāmnā tatkarmāyurbhavediti ।
lokatantrapravāhārthaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ।। 1 03।।
niyuktāḥ smo vaya raudrāḥ sṛṣṭyupakṛtaye sadā ।
adya vai kṛtakṛtyāḥ smo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 04।।
bhavānatra samāyāto lokakalyāṇahetave ।
vayaṃ guptasvarūpeṇa meṣādinā purā tadā ।। 1 05।।
jīvanārthaṃ tvabhavaँśca tāni nāmāni santi naḥ ।
vastuto vai vayaṃ divyā raudrāḥ smo brahmapautrakāḥ ।। 106 । ।
āyāhyasmadgṛhān bhakta! viśrāntiṃ labha sarvathā ।
kīrtanaṃ saṃkariṣyāmaḥ sūbhūya śrīharermuhuḥ ।। 1 07।।
ityukto bhaktarāṭ devāyatanarṣirjaharṣa ha ।
omityāha tadā rādhe! vimānaṃ cāvatārayat ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kiṃpuruṣakhaṇḍe rāśiyānapradeśeṣu harināmakīrtanabodhārthaṃ preṣitena devāyatanarṣiṇā dvādaśameṣāyanādimaharṣisamāgamanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 121 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 121 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 122
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 123 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! bhagavadbhakto devāyatanamuktarāṭ ।
meṣādīnāṃ maharṣīṇāmanumatyā vimānakam ।। 1 ।।
dvikalākhyasarastīre dakṣabhāge'vatārayat ।
kṛkalāsasvarūpeṇa karkāyanarṣirapsu vai ।। 2 ।।
vāsaṃ karoti sarasi tattaṭe cā'varohayat ।
jayaśabdāstadā lokaiḥ kṛtā jaya vimānakam ।। 3 ।।
jaya devo vimānastho jaya pradyumna īśvaraḥ ।
ityevaṃ tu narā nāryo jayaśabdasamanvitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
lājābhiḥ kusumairgandhairakṣataistamavardhayan ।
āśīrbhiḥ samayuñjaँśca dadṛśurdevatāyanam ।। 5 ।।
pradyumnaṃ ca tathā karkaṃ devāyatanamārcayan ।
pādayoḥ patitāḥ sarve pādavāri papustathā ।। 6 ।।
menire dhanyabhāgyāni ghoṣayanto hare hare ।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।। 7 ।।
karkarṣistatra rājānaṃ tharkūṭasthābhidhaṃ prati ।
harernāmagrahaṇasyopadeśaṃ pracakāra ha ।। 8 ।।
rājā jagrāha mantraṃ tanmālikāṃ taulasīṃ tathā ।
tharkūṭasthālaye saumye prāsāde tamavāsayat ।। 9 ।।
devatāyatanarṣeśca mahāpūjanamācarat ।
devatāyatanastatra prāsāde rājakīyake ।। 2.122.10 ।।
meṣādīn dvādaśarṣīṃśca rājasambandhinastathā ।
rājñīṃ cārumakāvāṃ ca tathā bākṛkalāsikām ।। 11 ।।
trilūnāṃ maṃgalāṃ cāpi nāma mantraṃ tadā''rpayat ।
'harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin harenārāyaṇa prabho ।। 1 2।।
bālakṛṣṇa kambharāśrīyutra gopālanandana' ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 13 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt । । 14।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
'brahmā'haṃ ' śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।। 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।
'kṛṣṇavallabhabhakto'haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।। 16।।
ityevaṃ pradadau mantrān devatāyatanastadā ।
tataḥ prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo dadau samantrakīrtanam ।। 17।।
ityevaṃ vaiṣṇavān kṛtvā tatratyaiḥ pratipūjitaḥ ।
vimānaṃ ca samāruhyarṣibhiḥ rājakuṭumbibhiḥ ।। 18।।
rājñā ca rājapatnibhiḥ samaṃ paścimabhūmikām ।
tānutuvāpradeśasthān śrāvayan nāmakīrtanam ।। 1 9।।
avā'tārayad vāyānaṃ datvā mantrān prajātaye ।
tatkṛtāṃ prāpya saṃpūjām alpamātrāsarovaram ।
gatvā'vatīrya yānācca irātrīśānadīmanu ।। 2.122.20 ।।
makararṣinivāse ca sasnuḥ sarve'vatīrya ca ।
taṭāke ca tathā nadyāṃ snāpayitvā prajājanān ।। 21 ।।
nāmamantraṃ dadau tebhyo devatāyatanaḥ ṛṣiḥ ।
tatkṛtāṃ paramāṃ pūjāṃ prāpya tato'pi paścime ।।।22।।
bālakṛṣṇasaro gatvā'vateruste sarastaṭe ।
dakṣiṇe bālikānadyāḥ saṃgame snānamācaran ।।23।।।
mīnarṣiḥ svagṛhaṃ nītvā pupūja bhaktamaṇḍalam ।
vimānaṃ ca samāruhya pradyumnaṃ samapūjayat ।।24।।
śrāvayan kṛṣṇanāmāni prajābhyaḥ śrīharermanūn ।
dadau devāyatanakaścakāra vaiṣṇavīḥ prajāḥ ।।25।।
tatpradattāṃ prāpya pūjāṃ yayuḥ sarve tu paścime ।
kīragarjanadeśeṣu vimānātte hyavātaran ।। 26।।
vṛścikarṣinivāseṣu gatvā datvā svadarśanam ।
taddeśīyajanebhyaśca manūn devāyano dadau ।। 27।।
kīragarjanarājānaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ manuṃ śubham ।
śrāvayitvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kṛtvā nītvā vimānake ।। 28।।
prajākṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ gṛhītvā devatāyanaḥ ।
sarṣirājakuṭumbādiḥ sīrānadīsamāgame ।।19।।
urule sarasi naijaṃ vimānaṃ svāmatārayat ।
nāma saṃśrāvayan sarvāḥ prajāstatra sarovare ।। 2.122.30 ।।
asnāpayat tato mantrān dadau tebhyaḥ sakīrtanān ।
mithunāyanasaṃjñaśca ṛṣiryugalarūpadhṛk ।।3 1 ।।
svāvāse śrīvimānasthān pradyumnādīnupānayat ।
pupūja parayā bhaktyā vimānaṃ cāruroha ca ।। 32।।
tataśca prayayuḥ sarve āmunadīsamāgame ।
tadūrdhvadeśavāsāśca prajāḥ saṃśrāvayan muniḥ ।।33 ।।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa mantrānaśrāvayacca tāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavīstāḥ prajāḥ kṛtvā vimānamadhiruhya ca ।। 34।।
keśapāpayanavārdhiṃ ca gatvā pūrvataṭe śubhe ।
vimānādavatīryā'tha snātvā vārdhau ca te tataḥ ।।35।।
snapayitvā prajāstatra śrāvayannāmakīrtanam ।
mantrān dadau devatāyatanastābhyastataḥ khalu ।।36 ।।
vimānaṃ ca samāruhya urulāsaṃgamaṃ yayau ।
tatra kuṃbharṣiṇā sarve pūjitāḥ parameśvarāḥ ।।37।।
svāvāse bhrāmaṇaṃ teṣāṃ kāritaṃ cāpi pāvanam ।
devāyanaḥ śrāvayitvā nāmamantrān prajājanān ।।38 ।।
tebhyo datvā manūn paścād vimānenā''pa parvatam ।
urulaṃ trivalāsaṃjñāṃ nadīṃ cāpi yayau muniḥ ।।39।।
irātrīśātribālāsaṃgame sasnuśca te tadā ।
tatpradeśīyalokāँśca devatāyatano muniḥ ।।2.122.40।।
śrāvayāmāsa vai nāma hareścātha manūn dadau ।
siṃharṣiṇā samādiṣṭaprajābhyo munirāṭ khalu ।।41 ।।
taiḥ pradyumnaḥ pūjitaśca devāyano'pi pūjitaḥ ।
anye'pi pūjitāḥ sarve vimānena tadottare ।।42।।
śrāvayanto harernāma obītribalāsaṃgamam ।
avaterurvimānācca sasnustatra mahājale ।।43।।
dhanāyano maharṣiśca tathā prajājanā api ।
pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā vimānasthān janāṃstadā ।।44।।
devatāyatano nāma hareḥ saṃbhāvayan muhuḥ ।
prajābhyo nāma manrtrāँśca datvā tatratyabhūpatim ।।45।।
vīrajāraṃ śrāvayitvā nāmamantraṃ manūँstathā ।
putrān putrīśca tatpatnīṃ śrāvayitvā ca tān manūn ।।46।।
vimāne saha nītvā ca yayau obyabdhisaṃgamam ।
avaterurvimānācca sasnurobyabdhisaṃgame ।।47।।
śrāvayanto harernāma āmadrākṣaprajājanān ।
tebhyo mantraṃ dadau devāyanarṣiśca tataḥ param ।। 48।।।
kanyāyanarṣistatraiva parvate corulābhidhe ।
nijā''vāse vimānena nītvā sarvānapṛjayat ।।49।।
gṛhītvā tasya vai pūjāṃ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
trāsasāgarasaṃyoge cāvaterurvimānataḥ ।।।2.122.50।।
śrāvayāmāsuratyarthaṃ harekṛṣṇa prajājanān ।
snātvā ca snapayitvā ca manūn datvā ca vai tataḥ ।।51 ।।
yāneśīsāgarasaṃgaṃ yayuḥ sarve vimānagāḥ ।
sasnuśca snapayāmāsuḥ śrāvayitvā prajājanān ।।52।।
nāma mantraṃ dadau devāyatanarṣiśca bhaktarāṭ ।
aikāgārikadeśīyaprajābhyaśca manūn dadau ।।53 ।।
śibirājapradeśānāmuttareṣu stareṣu ca ।
tuṃgā'sikānadīprānte prajābhyaḥ pradadau manūn ।।54।।
tandrādeśaṃ yayau devāyanarṣiḥ sarvasevitaḥ ।
himabhūmiprajāstatra śrāvayitvā'bhidhāṃ hareḥ ।।55।।
tābhyo manūn dadau devāyanarṣistrimuraprajāḥ ।
śrāvayitvā tatastābhyo nāma mantraṃ dadau tataḥ ।।56 ।।
renḍī meṣāyanarṣiśca pupūja tān vimānagān ।
svasthānaṃ pāvanaṃ cakre teṣāṃ pādarajo'nvitam ।।57 ।।
meṣāyanena ṛṣiṇā pradyumnādyāḥ prapūjitāḥ ।
gṛṇantaste harernāma anāvārānadīṃ yayuḥ ।। 58 ।।
śrāvayitvā ca nāmāni snāpayitvā prajājanām ।
snātvā sarve saṃgame ca tatprajābhyo manūn daduḥ ।।59 ।।
vimānena yayuḥ pūrve ālanaukānadīṃ prati ।
tadabdhisaṃgame sasnuḥ sarve prajājanā api ।।2.122.6 0 ।।
śaktyakṣinṛpatiḥ sasnau sakudumbo'bdhisaṃgame ।
śrutvā nāma harekṛṣṇa vālakṛṣṇa narāyaṇa ।।6 1 ।।
jagṛhuste nāmamantrān devāyanamaharṣitaḥ ।
rājaprajārpitāṃ pūjāṃ prāpya pradyumnakādayaḥ ।।62।।
yayuḥ pūrvasthitān tandrādeśān bīnānadīmanu ।
līnāsāgarasaṃge ca sasnuḥ sarve vimāninaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakruḥ prajāstatra samāyayuḥ ।
jagṛhurnāmamantrāँśca devatāyatanāt tataḥ ।। 64।।
tatratyo vṛṣabharṣiśca pūjayāmāsa tāँstataḥ ।
pūjāṃ prāpya vimānena cāyayuḥ sarva eva te ।।65।।
uṣṭrīyāskānadīṃ tatra sasnuḥ prajājanaiḥ saha ।
prajābhyaḥ pradadau devāyatanaśca manūn tataḥ ।।66 ।।
nāma viṣṇoḥ śrāvayaँśca yānāṃ nadīṃ yayustataḥ ।
yānā'bdhisaṃgame snātvā snapayitvā prajājanān ।।67।।
śrāvayitvā harernāma tebhyo manūn daduśca te ।
tato yayurvimānena kālimāṃ saritaṃ ca te ।।68 ।।
kālimā'bdhijale snātvā snapayitvā prajājanān ।
śrāvayitvā harernāma tebhyo manūn dadustadā ।।69।।
tulāyano maharṣiśca svasthānaṃ tān vimānagān ।
nināya pūjayāmāsa pradyumnadevatādikān ।।2.122.7 0 ।।
kālimāśaśca rājā'pi suvaiṣṇavastadā'bhavat ।
pupūja parayā prītyā vimānasthān sureśvarān ।।71 ।।
vimāne sakuṭumbo vai samāruroha vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
tato yayuralāṃśukāpradeśān vai tataḥ param ।।72।।
dviraṃgākhyapradeśāँśca anādīranadītaṭān ।
śrāvayitvā tadbhūmisthajanebhyo nāmakīrtanam ।।73 ।।
manūn tebhyo daduścā'tha yayurvai kāmacāṭakān ।
tatprajāḥ pāvayitvaiva harernāmnā tataḥ param ।।74।।
tābhyo mantrān pradāyaiva akṣauḍhābhuvamāgatāḥ ।
stenāvāsijanān sarvān śrāvayitvā harermanum ।।75।।
tebhyo mantrān pradāyaiva prabhālunādrimāyayuḥ ।
śrāvayitvā tadbhūmisthajanebhyo nāma vai hareḥ ।।76।।
tābhyo mantraṃ dadurdevāyatanādyāstataśca te ।
paścimaṃ prayayuḥ sarve vilīnāyupradeśakān ।।77।।
tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
harekṛṣṇa haresvāmin bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।।78।।
mantrān tābhyo daduścāpi tābhiḥ kṛtāṃ tathopadām ।
saṃgṛhītvā yayuḥ sarve yoniṣoḍhāpradeśakān ।।79।।
tatratyāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayitvā'bhidhāṃ hareḥ ।
tābhyo mantrān pradaduśca tatkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ।।2.122.80।।
samādāya yayuḥ sarve ompradeśān vimānagāḥ ।
avatīrya prajāḥ sarvāḥ śrāvayitvā'bhidhāṃ hareḥ ।।81।।
tābhyo dadurharermantrān cakrustān vaiṣṇavān śubhān ।
athaivaṃ rādhike sarvān deśān devāyano muniḥ ।।82।।
pradyumnena tathā śreṣṭhadvādaśarṣibhiranvitaḥ ।
rāśiyānapradeśānāṃ rājabhiḥ sahitastathā ।।83।।
bhramitvā'ṣṭabhramān daivān jīvān cakāra vaiṣṇavān ।
sthale sthale harernāma japapārāyaṇā janāḥ ।।84।।
abhavan vai narā nāryo bālā vṛddhāśca madhyamāḥ ।
snānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ nityaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya sarvadā ।।85।।
gṛhe gṛhe'bhavad vāso devadevasya vai tadā ।
atha devāyatanāya prārthayāmāsureva te ।।86।।
meṣāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayo tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ ।
vayaṃ vai bhavato yogānnārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।।87।।
jātāḥ smo'dya prajāḥ sarvāḥ pāpamārgānnivāritāḥ ।
kṛṣṇabhaktiparā jātāścopakāro mahān kṛtaḥ ।।88।।
nṛdehasya tu sāphalyaṃ kāritaṃ bhavatā'dhunā ।
gurureva parabrahma tārako'sti bhavān hi naḥ ।।89।।
gurudvārā. hariḥ sākṣāt milatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
yathā sākṣāddhareryogo bhavet tathā vidhehi naḥ ।।2.122.90।।
bālakṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇasya sveṣṭadevasya darśanam ।
pratyakṣaṃ no bhavettadvad bhavān karotu yojanām ।।91 ।।
yanmantro nāmamātraṃ ca pāpaprajvālanakṣamam ।
tasya sākṣāddarśanaṃ tu kiṃ na dhatte hiṃ dehinām ।। 92।।
śravaṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yasya smaraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ muhuḥ ।
kīrtanaṃ maṃgalaṃ yasya kiṃ na dhatte tu darśanam ।।93।।
yathā kṛpā'tra cāgatya bhavatā'nuṣṭhitā tathā ।
iṣṭadevaḥ samāgacchet tathā kṛpāṃ vidhehi naḥ ।। 94।।
bālānāṃ bālikānāṃ ca narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
aśaktānāṃ darśanaṃ śrīhareḥ syādāgamena vai ।।95।।
yadbhaktasya prasaṃgena daivā mumukṣutāṃ gatāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāstaṃ bhajantyatra kṛtinastu tadāgame ।।96।।
deśo'pi divyatāṃ yāyānnadyo nadāḥ saro'bdhayaḥ ।
divyatāṃ tīrthatāṃ pṛthvyo yāsyanti cāgamāddhareḥ ।।97।।
vanāni parvatā grāmā nagarāṇi jalāni ca ।
khātāni cā'pyakhātāni yāsyanti divyatāṃ tataḥ ।। 98।।
raṇānāṃ bhūmayaścāpi dvīpānāṃ bhūmikāstathā ।
durgā'durgapradeśāśca yāsyanti divyatāṃ tataḥ ।। 99।।
mānavānāṃ hṛdayāni kāluṣyasaṃbhṛtāni vai ।
hareryogāddhavalāni bhaviṣyanti supuṇyataḥ ।। 2.122.10 0।।
ityevaṃ prārthayāmo'tra pradyumnāya mahātmane ।
devatāyatanāyā'pi dadmaścāśīrvacaḥ śubham ।। 10 1।।
ityevaṃ cā'rthitau rādhe! pradyumnadevatāyanau ।
āśvāsanaṃ dadatuśca tebhyo vai omiti dhruvam ।। 1 02।।
tato vimānaṃ sarvaiśca bālakṛṣṇasarovare ।
uttare tattīrabhāge'vatāritaṃ nivṛttaye ।। 1 03।।
viśaśramustu te sarve kṛtvā vai bhojanādikam ।
niśāyāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ bhejire sasmaruśca te ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāśiyānapradeśeṣu maharṣibhiḥ rājabhiśca saha vimānena bhramitvā prajāsu harernāmaśrāvaṇaṃ mantradānaṃ ca devā-
yatanarṣiścakāretyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 122 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 122 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 123
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 124 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha rāseśvari rādhe! prātaḥ snātvā harerjanāḥ ।
pūjayitvā bālakṛṣṇamūrtiṃ pradyumnamityapi ।। 1 ।।
devatāyatanaṃ cāpi hitāṃ cakrurvicāraṇām ।
meṣāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ ।। 2 । ।
rāśiyānapradeśānāṃ bhaktāgryāḥ sāttvatottamāḥ ।
śrutvā purā kratuṃ cakre bhagavān lāśahātaṭe ।। 3 । ।
śālāvatyāstaṭe cāpi piṃgadeśeṣu tatprajāḥ ।
kṛpayā pāvayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 4 । ।
svayamāgatya devaiśca brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha ।
pitṛbhyāṃ sahitaścāpi tīrthīcakāra tadbhuvam ।। 5 ।।
tathā cātra samāgacched bhaveyustīrthabhūmayaḥ ।
pavitrāḥ sukhadā sarvapāpapraṇāśaśaktayaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sarvadevanivāsārhāḥ sarvapūjyāḥ pramokṣadāḥ ।
sarvanadyo bhaveyuśca bhagavatpādapāvitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
tasmād yajñān kariṣyāmaḥ pañca śrīvaiṣṇavān śubhān ।
ādyaṃ makhaṃ śibirājye bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe ।। 8 ।।
tharkūṭasthabhūparājye dvitīyaṃ ca kratuṃ śubham ।
vīrajāramahārājarājye kratuṃ tṛtīyakam ।। 9 । ।
śaktyakṣinṛparājye ca makhaṃ caturthakaṃ śubham ।
kālimāśanṛparājye makhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca pañcamam ।। 2.123.10 ।।
kariṣyāmo dhanādyaiścārpaṇaiḥ sarvaprasādhanaiḥ ।
muktān tathā'tārāँśca īśvarān pārṣadāँstathā ।। 11 । ।
īśvarīrdevadevīśca pitṝn siddharṣipuṃgavān ।
mānavān jaḍacaitanyāśrayān sarvān hi dehinaḥ ।। 12 ।।
tīrthāni lokapālādyānāhvayiṣyāma eva ca ।
kārayiṣyāma upkṛṣṭānmakhān kṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ।। 13 ।।
tasmānnārāyaṇasvāmī bālakṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ ।
samāgacchecca no deśeṣvevaṃ bhaktavidhīyatām ।। 14।।
ityukto devasadṛśo devatāyatano muniḥ ।
bāḍhaṃ bāḍhamuvācaitān mumukṣūn vaiṣṇavāँstadā ।। 1 5।।
kṣaṇaṃ viśramituṃ tvājñāṃ pracakāra ca bhaktarāṭ ।
gatvā śrībālakṛṣṇākhyasarastaṭe nṛpādikān ।। 16 ।।
ṛṣayaśca nṛpādyāśca devāyatanako muniḥ ।
yayurvimānamārgeṇa bālakṛṣṇasarovaram ।। 1 7।।
avateruśca te bhūmau vimānenottare taṭe ।
catvāro'pi ca rājāno dvādaśā'pi maharṣayaḥ ।। 18 ।।
tathā prajāgramānyāśca sahasraśo dhanānvitāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāste'vateruśca yajñārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।। 1 9।।
pradyumnaśca ṛṣīn prāha kurvantu ghoṣaṇāṃ bhuvi ।
yajño vai vaiṣṇavaḥ kāryo bālakṛpṇasarastaṭe ।।2.123.20।।
uttare prathamaḥ paścād dvitīyastu kratūttamaḥ ।
dvikalākhyasarastīre tharkūṭabhūbhṛtā punaḥ ।।।2 1 ।।
tṛtīyaśca kratuḥ kāryo vīrajāreṇa bhūbhṛtā ।
obīrātrīśanadyośca saṃgame kṣitivistare ।।22।।
caturthastu kratuḥ kāryaḥ śaktyakṣibhūbhṛtā śubhaḥ ।
ālanaukābdhisaṃyoge viśāle bhūtale tathā ।।23 ।।
pañcamastu kratuḥ kāryaḥ kālimāśena bhūbhṛtā ।
kālimāsāgarayoge teṣvāyāntu hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।24।।
tatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān paramātmā pareśvaraḥ ।। 25।।
bālakṛṣṇo hi bhagavānasmākamiṣṭadevatā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāt svayaṃ caivāgamiṣyati ।। 26 ।।
darśanārthaṃ ca sevārthaṃ samāgantavyameva ha ।
pūrṇimāvadhiparyantaṃ dattā dīkṣā sthale sthale ।। 27।।
athedānīṃ mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇaikādaśikādine ।
prathamasya makhasyaivārambhaḥ samyag bhaviṣyati ।।28।।
sāptadainasya yajñasya kāryaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kariṣyati ।
dvitīyasya tu yajñasya mārge vai pañcamīdine ।।29।।
samārambhaḥ samāptiśca hyekādaśyāṃ site dale ।
tṛtīyasya kratoścāpyāraṃbho va tṛtīyātithau ।।2.123.3 0।।
pauṣakṛṣṇe samāptiśca navamyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
caturthayajñārambhastu ekādaśyāṃ bhaviṣyati ।।3 1 ।।
śuklāyāṃ tu dvitīyāyāṃ samāptiśca bhaviṣyati ।
pañcamasya tu yajñasyā''rambho vai pañcamīdine ।।3 2।।
ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca bhaviṣyatīti niścitam ।
ityevaṃ ghoṣayantveva rāśiyāneṣu sarvathā ।।33 ।।
ityuktā rājavargāśca tathā tattanmaharṣayaḥ ।
udghoṣaṇāṃ tathā cakruḥ svasvadeśeṣu satvaram ।।34।।
vaihāyasā tu yānena tato rājādayaśca te ।
śodhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ sāmagrīrvividhāḥ śubhāḥ ।।35।।
kārayāmāsurevātra sañcitāḥ sarvato diśaḥ ।
maṇḍapādīँstathā śālā nivāsān śibirāṇi ca ।।36।।
daśayojanabhūmau ca kārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
pradyumnaḥ kārayāmāsa yathāyogyaṃ nirīkṣakaḥ ।।37।।
devatāyatanaścāpi dvādaśarṣaya eva te ।
vimānena yayuḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।।38।।
prārthayāmāsurīśeśeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam।
tathā'stvevaṃ hariḥ prāha prasannaḥ pitṛdeśitaḥ ।। 39 ।।
lomaśena tathā''jñapto devatāyatano muniḥ ।
ṛṣīn sahasraśo nītvā vimāne prayayau kratum ।।2.123.40।।
te sarve kārayāmāsurbālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe ।
kuṇḍān vividhān vedīśca sthāpanārthaṃ ca vedikāḥ ।।41 ।।
śālāḥ kratorvāsaśālā mahīmānāśrayāँstathā ।
muktānāṃ cālayāna ramyānavatārālayāँstathā ।।42।।
īśvarāṇāmālayāँśceśvarīṇāmālayāँstathā ।
pitṝṇāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ brahmapriyālayāँstathā ।।43 ।।
brahmasarasāmālayāँścāpsarasāmālayāँstathā ।
devānāṃ bahujātīnāmālayān vividhāँstathā ।।44।।
dāsānāmālayāँścāpi bhuvarlokanivāsinām ।
mānavānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathālayān ।।45।।।
atalādinivāsānāmālayān bahubhūmikān ।
viśāle bhūtale cāpi vyomni cāpi vyadhustadā ।।49 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ ca viśālaṃ daśayojanam ।
vyadhustu viśvakarmāṇaḥ pradyumnasya nideśataḥ ।।47।।
pañcāśadyojane bhāge mahīmānāśrayān vyadhuḥ ।
pratyāśrayaṃ pradīpāśca maṇīnāṃ tu svabhāvajāḥ ।।48।।
śītoṣṇādijalānāṃ ca kulyāḥ svabhāvajāstathā ।
payodadhivṛtānāṃ ca kulyāścāpi svabhāvajāḥ ।।49।।
madhūnāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca rasakulyāḥ svabhāvajāḥ ।
peyānāṃ śītatoyānāṃ hradāścāmṛtasaṃjñakāḥ ।।2.123.50।।
brahmahradāstathā gopahṛdā nārāyaṇahradāḥ ।
satyahradāstathā devahradāśca nihitā dhruvāḥ ।।51 ।।
yathāpekṣamanalānāṃ kuṇṭhāśca kuṇḍikāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
naisargā dugdhapākāśca dugdhasārā nisargajāḥ ।।52।।
kāmadhenusamūhāśca rasavallīdrumālayāḥ ।
rasaśālāḥ sarvasṛṣṭibhojyapānapradāḥ śubhāḥ ।।53 ।।
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārabhogyadravyādipeṭikāḥ ।
gandhasārapracūrṇādikajjalālaktavārpikāḥ ।।54।।
vādyagāyananṛtyādipradarśanapradarśikāḥ ।
manorañjanajālādyāḥ prasphoṭakānalānilāḥ ।।55 ।।
yānavāhanaśibikāgāruḍahaṃsagovṛṣāḥ ।
śayyāparyaṃkavitānollocapaṭādibhittikāḥ ।।56।।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi sarvauṣadhipravāṭikāḥ ।
bhojyapeyādivastūnāṃ parvatā iva sañcayāḥ ।।57।।
havyānāṃ ca kaṇānāṃ ca phalānāṃ sañcayāstathā ।
patrāṇāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca samidhāṃ saṃcayāstathā ।।58 ।।
vrīhīṇāṃ ca yavānāṃ ca munyannānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
tilānāṃ ghṛtabhāgānāṃ pakvānnānāṃ samucchrayāḥ । । 59 ।।
dūraśravaṇayantrāṇāṃ dūradarśanakāriṇām ।
candrāṇāṃ dūravedhānāṃ sparśabodhanakāriṇām ।।2.123.6 0 ।।
ṛtubodhakarāṇāṃ ca golakāntarabodhinām ।
vārtātāragṛhāṇāṃ ca klṛptanaṃ vai sthale sthale ।। 61 । ।
dāsīnāṃ sevakānāṃ ca nisargalekhakāriṇām ।
klṛptanā kāritā tatra makhabhūmau sthale sthale । । 62 ।।
rājamārgā devamārgā hastyaśvahaṃsagāruḍāḥ ।
yeṣu prayānti sukhatastathā vai nirmitāstadā ।। 63 ।।
dakṣiṇārthaṃ dravyaśālā yajñārthaṃ pātramandiram ।
dānārthaṃ vastraśālāśca devapūjārhaśālikāḥ । ।64।।
sarvopacāraśālāśca nirmitā viśvakarmabhiḥ ।
sthāne sthāne kalpalatāḥ koṇe koṇe maṇiprabhāḥ । । 65 । ।
cintāmaṇipradhānāśca vāsāḥ sarvasukhapradāḥ ।
muktānāṃ dhavale vyomni cāntarīkṣe tu nākinām । । 66 ।।
bhaumānāṃ bhūmibhāgeṣu bhūstare tvanyadehinām ।
nirmitāḥ sukhadā vāsā bālakṛṣṇamakhotsave । । 67 । ।
ityevaṃ sarvathā bhūmiḥ śṛṃgāritā mahālayaiḥ ।
maṇḍapasya śirobhāge dhvajo'ṣṭaśatahastakaḥ ।।।68 । ।
sahasraṃ kalaśānāṃ tu sauvarṇānāṃ ca ropitam ।
vedamantrā jhallarīṣu toraṇeṣu pralekhitāḥ ।। 69 ।।
raṃgaraṃgolikāśobhāḥ svargodyānasamāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
evaṃ vai bhrājamāneṣu nivāseṣu makhābhitaḥ ।। 2.123.70 ।।
āyayuśca mahīmānāḥ patraiścāmantritāstadā ।
yajño'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kārayati svayam ।।7 1 ।।
śibidevanṛpadvārā sarvairgantavyamādarāt ।
idānīṃ mārgaśīrṣe vai kṛṣṇaikādaśikādine ।। 72 ।।
bālakṛṣṇasarastīre yajñāraṃbho vilokyatām ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paṭaho mahān ।।73 ।।
vyanadat sarvalokeṣu hariṇā''jñāpitaḥ śubhaḥ ।
daśamyāṃ sarvalokasthāḥ śrutvā kratuṃ samāyayuḥ ।।।74।।
akṣarabrahmalokādvai muktāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ।
dhāmāni cāpi sarvāṇi bhagavantastadāśritāḥ ।।75 ।।
bhagavatyaḥ samājagmurmuktānyaścāpyasaṃkhyikāḥ ।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca pitaro munayastathā ।।।76 ।।
siddhā brahmapraśīlāśca surāḥ surāṇya eva tu।
brahmasaraso'psaraso devyo dikpālapuṃgavāḥ ।।77।।
sāṃkhyayoginya evāpi bhuvarlokasurāstathā ।
mānavāḥ ṛṣayo viprāḥ kuṃkumavāpikājanāḥ ।।78।।
abriktajāścājanābhā uraṣṭrālayādivāsinaḥ ।
āyayustalavāsāśca bhūvivaranivāsinaḥ ।।79।।
nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca vṛkṣā vallaya ityapi ।
tīrthāni paśavaḥ pakṣavantastiryakprajātayaḥ ।।2.123.80।।
pārthivāśca jalīyāśca vāhneyā vāyavīyakāḥ ।
dehinaścāyayustatra yajñārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।।8 1।।
devadānavadaityāśca rudrāśca vasavastathā ।
viśvedevāstathā sādhyā manavo brahmaputrakāḥ ।।82।।
sanakādyā sādhavaśca nāradādyā mahārṣayaḥ ।
brahmaputraprapautrādyāścāyayustvadhvare hareḥ ।।83 ।।
vineduśca diśaḥ sarvā vimānānāṃ samāgamaiḥ ।
rājāno rāśivargāśca dadurvāsāni cādarāt ।।84।।
tāvaddevāyanarṣiśca vimāne kāmage śubhe ।
sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇe tu śātabhaume mahāyate ।।85।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvāḥ sarvaṃ kuṭumbamityapi ।।86।।
lomaśādīn saptarṣīṃśca viprān narāँśca yoṣitaḥ ।
mātāpitarau devādīn tīrthāni śaṃkarādikān ।।87।।
kṣetrapān sevikā devīrdevatāśceśvarādikān ।
tatratyadivyadehāँśca nītvā vyomnā samāyayau ।।88।।
avādyanta suvādyāni jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
lājāpuṣpākṣataiḥ sarve vardhayāmāsureva tat ।।89।।
nemuśca paritaḥ sarve koṭisūryojjvalaṃ śubham ।
vimānaṃ parameśasyā'kṣaratulyaṃ mahojjvalam ।।2.123.90।।
divyahastisuśobhāḍhyaṃ divyahaṃsavirājitam ।
divyadhvajasukalaśaiḥ rājitaṃ kāmagaṃ sukham ।। 9 1।।
yatpārśve suvimānāni suprayānti sahasraśaḥ ।
aśabdaṃ cā''gataṃ meghādūrdhvaṃ dvipañcayojanam ।।92।।
ākāśe sthairyamāpannaṃ tasmādvai bhagavān svayam ।
avātatāra sahasā koṭyabjasārthaśobhitaḥ ।।93 ।।
vidyudyantrādinirghoṣā avādyanta ca sūcakāḥ ।
ākāśo mūrtimān bhūtvā kṛṣṇagītimagāyata ।।94।।
rāgāścāpi ca rāgiṇyaḥ sarasvatyaśca śāradāḥ ।
vidyāḥ sarvāstadā kṛṣṇakṛte'gāyanta catsukāḥ ।।95।।
lakṣmīgaṃgāvirajāsulalitāvijayājayāḥ ।।96।।
suśīlādyāśca vai gītiṃ tadā cakrurmanoharām ।
gandharvā gāyanaṃ cakrustadā kṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ।।97।।
ṛṣayo vedanirghoṣāँścakrurghanaravādibhiḥ ।
vahnyādyā devatāścāpi jayaśabdān pracakrire ।।98।।
śiṣyādyāśca ṛṣayaśca sanmānaṃ daṇḍavatpuraḥ ।
cakruḥ sarve jaya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saṃjaguḥ ।।99।।
tāvaddhariḥ pṛthivyāṃ vai sabhāmaṇḍapamāgamat ।
puṣpahārān dadustasmai śekharān gucchakān daduḥ ।। 2.123.100 ।।
puṣpāṇāṃ sañcayaiḥ sarve vardhayāmāsuracyutam ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhagavantaṃ śukaṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
santuṣṭāṃ cāmṛtāṃ cāpi devāyatanakaṃ munim ।
hemantaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ lomaśaṃ śaṃbhuviṣṇvajān ।। 1 02।।
brahmapriyādikā rādhe! kuṃkumavāpikāprajāḥ ।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ rāśiyānaprajā muhuḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasarovarataṭe yajñamaṇḍapādikaraṇaṃ mahīmānāgamo bālakṛṣṇādyāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatya-
dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 123 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 124
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 125 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
ityevaṃ rādhike ! kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ ।।
avatīrya vimānācca yajñamaṇḍapamāyayau ॥ 1 ॥
vilokya ca tataḥ śīghraṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ taḍāgake ।।
yajamānaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā patnīvratadvijena ca ॥ 2 ।।
lomaśena tathā devāyatanena yutaḥ prabhuḥ ।।
mātāpitrādisahito niṣasāda śubhāsane ।। 3 ।।
viprāśca jagadustāvat svastivācanamutsukāḥ ।।
ācamanaṃ grāhayitvā tato vai lomaśo muniḥ ।। 4 ।।
śuddhimantrān samuccārya pañcagavyaṃ pradāya ca ।।
jalena prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā sūtrakaṃ kare ॥ 5 ॥
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prakoṣṭhe cā'bandhayad yajamānakam ।।
tathā bhūpaṃ yajamānaṃ gauṇaṃ sastrīkameva ca ।। 6 ।।
śibidevābhidhānaṃ cā'bandhayan lomaśo muniḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi bhagavān lomaśaṃ yajñavedinam ।। 7 ।।
mukhyaṃ cā'bandhayattatra gauṇaṃ patnīvrataṃ tathā ।।
ācāryayugalaṃ kṛtvā tato dvādaśabhūsurān ॥ 8 ॥
raudrān rudrasvarūpāँścā'bandhayad rudrasannidhau ।
brahmaṇo nikaṭe cānyān daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakān ॥ 9 ॥
ṛṣīँścā'bandhayat tatra japahomakarāँstathā ।।
brahmā svayaṃ brahmavedyāṃ sthitaḥ kṛṣṇājñayā'bhavat ।।10।।
vedāstathopavedāśca gātāraścā'bhavaँstadā ।।
udgātārastadā cāsan śākhāmūrtaya ityapi ॥11॥
hotāraścopahotārastadā''san sanakādikāḥ ।।
yogeśvarāstathā siddhāḥ kapilādyā narāyaṇāḥ ।।12।।
āhartārastathā pratihartāraśceśvarāḥ śubhāḥ ।।
bhūmādayo'pyabhavaँśca vairājādiyutāstathā ।।13।।
ṛtvijaścā'bhavaँstatra vasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥ ।
vālakhilyā abhavaँśca vedapāṭhakarāstadā ॥14॥
vyāsādyā vedavettāro bṛhaspatyādayastathā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prapāṭhino'bhavan ॥15॥
nārāyaṇāstadā sarve havyavāhā hi vahniṣu ।।
abhavan avatārāśca vahnyānanāstadā makhe ॥16॥
vahnayo divyarūpāśca rājante tatra saṃsadi ।
kalpavallīyutāḥ kalpadrumā havyapradāyinaḥ ।।17।।
samāharanti dravyāṇi saṃkalpitāni vai tadā ।
ityevaṃ yajñasāhāyyāḥ klṛptāstatra makhe tataḥ ।।18।।
pṛthvyāḥ sampūjanaṃ cāpi vārāhasya prapūjanam ।
kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ cāpi vedikānāṃ prapūjanam ।।19॥
cakruḥ śrīlomaśādyāśca tato gaṇeśapūjanam ।।
pratyakṣasya gaṇeśasyā'rcanaṃ cakrustadā dvijāḥ ।।20।।
śaṃkhasya pūjanaṃ cāpi tathā cakrasya pūjanam ।
kalaśasyā'rcanaṃ cāpi tathā lakṣmyāḥ supūjanam ।।21।।
rudrasya pūjanaṃ cāpi durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ।।22।।
dikpālānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca grahāṇāṃ cārcanaṃ tathā ।
īśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaktīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।23।।
pārṣadānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca vasūnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।
ādityānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca surāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ॥24॥
lokapālārcanaṃ cāpi satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ pitṛpūjanam ṛṣipūjanam ॥25॥
bhūtānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi iṣṭā'niṣṭapravedinām ।।
diśāṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi viśvedevaprapūjanam ॥26॥
aśvinīsutayoścāpi pūjanaṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā ।।
kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetrapālānāṃ pūjanaṃ yogināṃ tathā ॥27॥
yoginīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca kalānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।
manūnāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tattvānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ॥28॥
marutāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tīrthānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।
rājasānāṃ tāmasānāṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ॥29॥
vighnānāṃ vighnarājānāṃ brāhmīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
vidyānāṃ brahmapatnīnāṃ pūjanaṃ dhāmayoṣitām ।।30।।
mūrtimatāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sarvāsāṃ tatra pūjanam ।
cakāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ pratuṣṭaye ॥31॥
tataḥ svayaṃ harikṛṣṇasvāmī śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mukhyadevasthale sthitaḥ ।।32॥
tasya pūjāṃ mahāpūjāṃ śibidevaścakāra ha।
mukhyadeve pūjite cā'vādyanta tūryakoṭayaḥ ।।33।।
tato vahniṃ mūrtimantaṃ prāha nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
tiṣṭha kuṇḍe mama mūrte devānāṃ tṛptaye makhe ।।34॥
ityuktvā pūjito vahniḥ prasannaḥ kuṇḍamāsthitaḥ ।
jvālārūpo'bhavattatra samitsu havyavāhanaḥ ॥35।।
yajñapātrādipūjāṃ ca kṛtvā vai ṛṣayastataḥ ।।
kuṇḍadevān samiddevān sampūjya cānyadevatāḥ ॥ 36॥
tebhyo datvā yathāpūjāṃ homakāryaṃ vyavartata ।
svāhādyāstatra devyaśca sakhyo vai divyavigrahāḥ ॥37॥
kare kṛtvā ca havyāni dadurvahnimukhādiṣu ।।
devatā īśvarāścāpi muktā nārāyaṇā api ।।38॥
brahmapriyāśca muktānya īśvarāṇyaśca devikāḥ ।।
surāṇyaścāpi mānavyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣisaṃpriyāḥ ॥39।।
sāttvikā rājasāścāpi tāmasāścāpi vai surāḥ ।।
sāttvikyaścāpi rājasyatāmasyastanavo hareḥ ।।40॥
pratyakṣā mūrtimatyastā bhāgān jagṛhuradhvare ।
jīvasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭau tu ye ca ye ॥41॥
dehino vedaparṇasthāste sarve bhuñjate'nale ।।
adhvare'rpitahavyāni jāyate tṛptimān hariḥ ॥42॥
evaṃ saptadinānyevā'bhavad yajño vidhānataḥ ।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo homaḥ sarvatṛptiprado makhaḥ ॥43॥
śrīrādhikovāca—
yān devān vai tadā smṛtvā yathā homaḥ prajāyate ।
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tasmin vai vaiṣṇave makhe ॥44॥
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca—
śṛṇu rādhe tatra homo yathā vai samprajāyate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।।45।।
akṣarabrahmaṇe svāhā svāhā muktebhya ityapi ।।
svāhā brahmapriyābhyaśca svāha muktābhya ityapi ।।46।।
svāhā kṛṣṇāya kāntāya svāhā gopīgaṇāya ca ।।
rādhāyai kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā gopagaṇāya ca ।। 47।।
svāhā golokadhāmne ca svāhā dhenubhya ityapi ।।
svāhā nārāyaṇāyeti lakṣmyai svāhā śriyai tathā ॥48॥
śrīsakhībhyastathā svāhā svāhā vaikuṇṭhakāya ca ।
svāhā pārṣadavargāya svāhā dāsīgaṇāya ca ।।49।।
vāsudevāya vai svāhā svāhā saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ।
pradyumnāya tathā svāhā svāhā'niruddhasaṃjñine ।।50।।
mahākālāya vai svāhā mahāpuruṣasaṃjñine ।।
māyāyai ca tathā svāhā svāhā tatpuruṣāya ca ।।51।।
pradhānapuruṣāyeti svāhā'vyākṛtadhāmine ।।
amṛtavāsine svāhā bhūmne svāhā subuddhaye ।।52।।
ahaṃkārāya ca mahāviṣṇave manase tathā ।
svāhā vairājarūpāya viṣṇave śaṃbhave tathā ।।53।।
brahmaṇe ca tathā svāhā svāhā sadāśivāya ca ।
īśvarebhyastathā svāhā īśvarāṇībhya ityapi ।।54
tanmātrābhyastathā svāhā svāhendriyebhya ityapi ।
prāṇebhyaśca tathā svāhā svāhā bhūtebhya ityapi ।।55।।
aṣṭāvaraṇavāsibhyaḥ svāhā īśeśvarāya ca ।
matsyāya kūrmarūpāya svāhā vārāharūpiṇe ।।56।।
kapilāya ca haraye svāhā śrīpṛthave tathā ।
dattātreyāya haṃsāya svāhā nṛsiṃharūpiṇe ।।57।।
ṛṣabhāya vāmanāya svāhā paraśudhāriṇe ।
yajñāya ca kumārāya svāhā rāmāya dhanvine ।।58।।
hayaśīrṣāya vai svāhā svāhā nāradanāmine ।
rājarājāya vai svāhā svāhā vyāsāya kalkine ।।59।।
svāhā mohinikāyai ca svāhā'ntaryāmiṇe tathā ।।
svāhā satyanivāsibhyaḥ svāhā śrīparameṣṭhine ॥60 ।।
sarasvatyai ca gāyatryai sāvitryai brahmayoṣite ।
asiknyai ca paliknyai ca svadhā vīriṇiyoṣite 61॥
sṛṣṭyai cā'pyatha sandhyāyai mohinyai svāhiketi ca ।।
dakṣādibhyo vaṣaṭ cāpi prajāpatibhya ityapi ।।62।।
manubhyo vālakhilyebhyo vaṣaṭ ṛṣibhya ityapi ।।
pitṛbhyaśca svadhā cāpi svāhā meghebhya ityapi ॥63।।
svāhā dharmādharmavaṃśagaṇāya kāmamūrtaye ।।
ṛtubhyo vatsarādibhyaḥ svadhā yugebhya ityapi ।।64।।
digbhyaḥ svāhā guṇebhyaśca svāhā dravyebhya ityapi ।
karmabhyaścāpi jātibhyaḥ svāhā yogebhya ityapi ॥65॥
indrādibhyo digīśebhyaḥ svāhā lokibhya ityapi ।
satyāya tapase svāhā janāya mahare'pi ca ॥66॥
svargāya svargavāsibhyaḥ svāhā devebhya ityapi ।
svāhā'psarogaṇebhyaśca svāhā devībhya ityapi ॥67।।
siddhibhyaśca vasubhyaśca svāhā nidhibhya ityapi ।
svāhā grahebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sūryebhyastithināmine ।।68।।
kalābhyaśca tathā svāhā nakṣatrebhyaśca ityapi ।
tārakābhyastathā svāhā svāhā marudbhya ityapi ॥69।।
rudrebhyo rudrapatnībhyaḥ svāhā śrīśaṃkarāya ca ।।
kalābhyo yoginībhyaśca svāhā khanibhya ityapi ।।70
naranārāyaṇāyeti svāhā vai śeṣaśāyine ।।
avatārasvarūpāya svāhā mūrtyātmane tathā ।।71।।
gaṃgādyāyai tathā svāhā svāhā tīrthebhya ityapi ।
kailāsagaṇakeśāya gaṇeśāya śivāya ca ।।72।।
mātre yoginikācakrāya ca svāhā hanūmate ।
kārtikāya ca haṃsāya garuḍāyā'ruṇāya ca ।।73।।
svāhā'gnimaṇḍalāyeti svadhā yāmyāya cetyapi ।
śrāvaṇebhyaḥ svadhā cāpi pretebhyaśca svadhā hyapi ।।74।।
bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ kūṣmāṇḍebhyaḥ svadhā tathā ।
vināyakebhyo vetālebhyaśca svāhā svadhā tathā ।।75॥
ḍākinīśākinībhyaśca svadhā vai pitṛyoṣite ।
sūtamāgadhabandībhyo vaṣaṭ tīrthebhya ityapi ।।76।।
mānavebhyastathā vaṣaḍ vṛkṣadrubhyo vaṣaṭ tathā ।।
vallībhyaśca vaṣaṭ tṛṇalatābhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ।।77॥
tiryagbhyaśca paśubhyaśca pakṣibhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ।
sarīsṛpebhyaḥ kīṭebhyaḥ kṣudrebhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ।।78।।
gṛhagrāmakṣetradevatābhyaḥ svāhā ca bhūmaye ।।
vanāraṇyanadebhyaśca vauṣaṭ cābdhibhya ityapi ।।79।।
āśramebhyaśca varṇebhyo vauṣaṭ śailebhya ityapi ।
svadhā pitre pitāmahāya prapitāmahāya ca ।।80॥
mātrādyāyai svadhā cāpi śrauṣaṭ viśvādhivāsine ।
gandharvebhyaḥ kinnarebhyaḥ śrauṣaṭ kiṃpuruṣāya ca ।।81॥
sādhyebhyaścāpi viśvebhyaḥ svāhā marudbhya ityapi ।
cāraṇebhyo vaṣaṭ vauṣaṭ nārībhyo gaṇikābhya ā 82॥
sādhvībhyaśca tathā śrauṣaṭ tyāginībhyaśca sarvathā ।।
yādobhyaśca vaṣaṭ nāgasarpebhyaśca vaṣaṭ tathā ।।83।।
daityebhyo dānavebhyaśca rākṣasebhyo vaṣaṭ tathā ।
yakṣebhyaśca vaṣaṭ cāpi kāśyapebhyo yathāyatham ॥84॥
sarvasṛṣṭipradevebhyaḥ svāhā'ntaryāmiṇe tathā ।
svāhā śrīharikṛṣṇāya ghanaśyāmāya vai tathā ॥85॥
bālakṛṣṇāya ca svāhā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāya ca ।।
gopālabālakāyeti kaṃbharāśrīsutāya ca ॥86॥
svāhā śrīharaye śrīmanmāṇikīpataye tathā ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyeti svāhā prītimayāya ca ।।87।।
pārvatīpataye svāhā svāhā rāseśvarīśine ।
svāhā śrīduḥkhahālakṣmīsvāmine paramātmāne ।।88।।
svāhā jayālalitādhipataye haṃsayogine ।
antaryāmisvarūpāya svāhā sarveśvarāya ca ।।89॥
yajñanārāyaṇāyeti svāhā śrīvahnaye tathā ।
oṃ parabrahmaṇe svāhā homaṃ bhagavate daduḥ ।।90॥
sarve jīvāstadā tṛptā havyaiḥ kavyairmanoharaiḥ ।
ityevaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā bhojayāmāsurādarāt ।।11।।
mahīmānān tathā deśanivāsān koṭikārbudān ।।
mānavaॉśca cetanāँśca jaḍāँśca bhojyavastubhiḥ ।।9।।
āgatā vai tatra yajñe koṭiśo mānavāstadā ।।
jagṛhuścāvaśiṣṭāśca mantrān śrīvaiṣṇavāँstathā ।।93।।
ityevaṃ nityamevā'pi jāyante havanādayaḥ ।।
vaiṣṇavāścāpi jāyante mānavāḥ koṭiśo'pi ca ।।94।।
saptāhena susampādyo nyavartata kratuḥ śubhaḥ ।
avabhṛthaṃ tataścakrurbālakṛṣṇasarovare ।।95
sarve vai dehino divyā'divyā ye'tra samāgatāḥ ।
pāvanāste ca sañjātā bālakṛṣṇasya yogataḥ ।।96॥
dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'tibhūyasīḥ ।।
śibidevo'pi sarvasvaṃ rājā yajñe dadau tadā ।।7।।
kanyakānāṃ śataṃ naijaṃ bālakṛṣṇāya vai dadau ।
hastyaśvarathasauvarṇayānavimānakāni ca ।।98॥
svarṇarūpyakahīrādigṛhavāṭīrdadau tathā ।
dāsīdāsānanekāँśca dadau rājā kratau tadā ॥99॥
annavastragavāṃ dānaṃ koṭisaṃkhyaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।।
sarvasvaṃ haraye naijaṃ dadau vai rādhike tadā ।।100।।
parihāraṃ tataścakre rātrau sarve viśaśramuḥ ।।
śibistu kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ tatra śobhanam ।।101।।
bālakṛṣṇaśca ṣaṭpatnīsahito yatra rājate ।।
rādhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca kamalā śrīḥ ramā tathā ।।102॥
sevayanti sadā kāntaṃ mandire vyomagāmini ।
paṭhanācchravaṇācāsya yajñasya phalabhāg bhavet ॥103॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śibidevarājye bālakṛṣṇasarovarataṭe mahāyajñe yājñikavyavasthā, yajñakāryanivṛttiḥ, śrīharaye nṛpakṛtaśatakanyādānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 124 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 124 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 125
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 126 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
evaṃ bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe kṛtvā kratuṃ hariḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ svanāmnaiva vālakṛṣṇasaro'karot । । 1 । ।
asaṃkhyadehadhāribhyo datvā manuṃ ca darśanam ।
kṛtvā tānpāvanānpaścādbhojayitvā janānapi । । 2 । ।
tṛtīyāyāṃ janān sāyaṃ cājijñapatprabhuḥ svayam ।
śibidevo mahārājo muktavad vartate bhuvi । । 3 । ।
śibirājyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca matkṛpāvaśato'bhavat ।
śrīsampaddravyabhogyādisaṃbhṛtāśca śibeḥ prajāḥ । । 4 । ।
bhavantu sukhapātrāṇi mā tāsāṃ syāddhi nimnatā ।
mā syād duḥkhaṃ kvaciccāpi syāt sadā'bhyudayaḥ kila । । 5 । ।
bhavatīnāṃ prajānāṃ ca rājño'pi bhavatāt sadā ।
rājavaṃśe prajānāṃ ca mama bhaktiḥ sadā'stu ca । । 6 । ।
atha kartuṃ dvitīyaṃ tu makhaṃ yāntu prajājanāḥ ।
sevakāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi tharkūṭasthanṛpādayaḥ । । 7 । ।
tharkūṭasthabhūparājye sāhāyyārthaṃ prayāntu ca ।
naijo dharmaḥ pālanīyo bhavadbhirbhaktisaṃyutaiḥ । । 8 ।।
satāṃ guṇāścārjanīyāḥ sukhadā divyaśāntidāḥ ।
svasvarūpe brahmarūpe sthitiḥ kāryā hi sarvadā । । 9 । ।
satyaṃ yathārthavaktṛtvaṃ pālanīyaṃ hitapradam ।
śaucaṃ sadātmanaḥ śuddhiścāntarāṇāṃ praśuddhitaḥ । । 2.125.10 ।।
pālanīyā sadā bhaktairakāluṣyaṃ tu pāpakaiḥ ।
dayā kāryā tu jīveṣu teṣāṃ duḥkhanivārikā । । 11 । ।
kṣāntiḥ rakṣyā sāparādhajaneṣvapi sahiṣṇutā ।
cittasaṃyamarūpā ca sadā'nudvegaśālinī ।। 12 । ।
tyāgo rakṣyaḥ sadā dānaṃ pūrṇakāmatvayogataḥ ।
māyikeṣu tu bhogyeṣu tvanādaraḥ praśāntidaḥ । । 13 ।।
arthiṣu muktakaratā prāpteṣvapi na lubdhatā ।
santoṣaśca nijānandaparipūrṇatvamityapi । । 1 4। ।
yathālabdheṣvalaṃbhāvastṛṣṇārāhityamityapi ।
kleśarāhityamevā'pi rakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā janaiḥ ।। 15।।
ārjavaṃ cāpi sāralyaṃ trayāṇāmekarūpatā ।
manovāṇīśarīrāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ caikarūpatā ।। 16।।
rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ sadā ।
śamaḥ śāśvatikī śāntirviṣayebhyo nivartanam ।। 17।।
atiprākṛtasaṃjñebhyo duḥkhadebhyo nirantaram ।
damaścendriyaniyamaḥ kartavyaḥ śreyase sadā ।। 18।।
tapo vijñānalabdhyarthaṃ yatnaḥ kāryaḥ sadā janaiḥ ।
vratopavāsarūpaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vṛddhasevanam ।। 1 9।।
sāmyaṃ rakṣyaṃ śubhe duṣṭe'nādaro māyike sadā ।
titikṣā sahanaṃ rakṣyaṃ dvandvākhyairduḥkhasaṃsthitau ।।2.125.20।।
ātmarūpeṇa vai stheyaṃ cā'pratikṣatibhāvataḥ ।
uparamaḥ sadā rakṣyo vyarthavyāpāravarjanam ।। 21 ।।
śrutaṃ jñānaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ śāstrasadgurudevataḥ ।
svayaṃ cāpi paraścāpi vedanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।।22।।
vairāgyaṃ sarvaviṣaye nispṛhatvaṃ tathā sadā ।
anākṛṣṭamanastvaṃ ca rakṣaṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।।23।।
aiśvaryaṃ bhagavadyogāt sārṣṭi prāpyaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।
śauryaṃ svabhāvavijayaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā janaiḥ ।।24।।
tejo rakṣyaṃ bhaktajanairanyaiḥ pradhṛṣyaśūnyatā ।
balaṃ cātmabalaṃ sarvaniyantṛyogataḥ sadā ।।25।।
rakṣaṇīyaṃ hi sāmarthyaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya me kṛpā ।
smṛtiḥ kartavyaviṣaye'nusandhānaṃ śubhāśraye ।। 26 ।।
rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena parameśaprasaṃgataḥ ।
svātantryaṃ ca parā'napekṣatā rakṣyā tu sātvataiḥ ।। 27।।
kauśalaṃ sarvakāryeṣu naipuṇyaṃ rakṣyamuttamam ।
kāntiḥ rakṣyā brahmacaryabalajā śobhanātmikā ।।28।।
dhairyaṃ viṣamabhāve'pi vyākulatvavivarjanam ।
mārdavaṃ sarvadā rakṣyaṃ rokṣyakāṭhinyavarjanam ।।29।।
prāgalbhyaṃ pratibhā rakṣyā mokṣavicāradāyinī ।
praśrayo vinayo rakṣyaḥ sadvṛttiḥ śīlakāriṇī ।।2.125.3 0 ।।
sahanaṃ manasā kāryaṃ sarvaghāte'pyaghātitā ।
ojaḥ rakṣyaṃ cakṣurādau jñānendriyeṣu sarvathā ।। 31 ।।
prabhāvaśca balaṃ rakṣyaṃ karmendriyeṣu vai tathā ।
bhago rakṣyo maddaiśvaryaṃ sarvotkarṣādisaṃsthitiḥ ।। 32।।
gāmbhīryaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ ca durgāhyā''ntaramantraṇam ।
sthairyaṃ rakṣyaṃ sadā bhaktaiścāñcalyena vihīnatā ।।33।।
āstikyaṃ dharmamokṣādau harau mayi sthirā matiḥ ।
śāstrokte'rthe ca viśvāsaḥ śraddhā ca paramātmani ।।34।।
kīrtiḥ prāpyā śubhā bhaktiḥ khyātirdhāmapradā janaiḥ ।
maunaṃ rakṣyaṃ vṛthālāpavarjanaṃ sāttvataiḥ sadā ।।39।।
garvābhāvaḥ sadā rakṣyo guṇādyahantvahīnatā ।
mānābhāvastathā rakṣyo'vṛthāsvarūpahānitā ।। 36।।
daṃbhābhāvastathā rakṣyo vañcakatvavihīnatā ।
yogyāhārastathā kāryo yo mokṣe phalado bhavet ।।37।।
dākṣyaṃ rakṣyaṃ hitavākyopadeṣṭṛtvaṃ na cetarat ।
maitrī rakṣyā ca viśvāsādhāratā sarvadehinām ।।38।।
upakāraśca sarveṣāṃ kartavyo'tivāñcchayā ।
akṣobhaśca sadā rakṣyo vegena tṛṣṇayā'pi vā ।।39।।
kṣubdhavyaṃ naiva viṣaye sāttvikairbhaktiyogibhiḥ ।
pīḍanaṃ prāṇināṃ naiva kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ kvacit ।।2.125.40 ।।
sarvasatkārakāritvaṃ grahaṇīyaṃ samantataḥ ।
aniṣṭāptaparābhūtirāhityaṃ kāryameva ca ।।41 ।।
brahmajñānāṃ sahavāsaḥ kartavyaśca satāmapi ।
sādhutā rakṣaṇīyā ca śaraṇāgatapālitā ।।42।।
phalecchāśūnyatā rakṣyā parigrahavivarjitā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe mayi parātmani ।।43 ।।
sarvasvārpaṇabhaktiśca kartavyā mama sāttvatai ।
yathā bhaktirmama kāryā tathā kāryā satāṃ mama ।।44।।
nirdaṃbhapremabhāvena guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
guroḥ sevā mama sevā bhuktimuktipradā sadā ।।45।।
mama pūjā prakartavyā satāṃ mamā'rcanaṃ tathā ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitat sarvapāpapraṇāśakam ।।46 ।।
patnī rakṣyā sadā saukhye pīḍanīyā na vai kvacit ।
patiḥ pūjyaḥ sadā patnyā pīḍanīyo na vai kvacit ।।47।।
vṛddhāḥ sevyāḥ sadā madhyāvasthaiḥ putrādibhiḥ khalu ।
gāvaḥ santaḥ sadā rakṣyā bhaktibodhakarā api ।।48।।
devā rakṣyā gṛhe mūrtisvarūpā dṛṣṭipāvanāḥ ।
guravaśca sadā rakṣyā gehe saṃsāratārakāḥ ।।49।।
bhajanaṃ ca sadā kāryaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya vai ।
śaraṇaṃ ca mama grāhyaṃ puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।।2.125.50।।
gurorājñā sadā pālyā śubhā vā mokṣadāyinī ।
sveṣāṃ śāntikarī mānyā vāco guroḥ sadā'nujaiḥ ।।5 1।।
pūjanaṃ sarvadā kāryaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ।
parabrahma evā'tra mūrtau me bhaktapuṃgavaiḥ ।।52।।
snānaṃ sarovare cātra kartavyaṃ bālakṛṣṇake ।
mārgaikādaśikāyāṃ cā'māyāṃ dvitīyake dine ।।53।।
saptāheṣu prakartavyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।
atra dānaṃ prakartavyaṃ gavāṃ mokṣapradāyakam ।।54।।
mama mūrteḥ pradānaṃ ca bhavet sarvārthasādhakam ।
istidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ vṛṣabhasya pradānakam ।।55।।
mahiṣīdānamārpyaṃ ca reṇḍīvṛṣabhadānakam ।
śakaṭasya ca yānasya vimānasya pradānakam ।।56।।
śibikāyāḥ pradānaṃ ca vāhanānāṃ pradānakam ।
vastrāṇāṃ kambalānāṃ ca śāṭīnāṃ ca pradānakam ।।।57।।।
kartavyaṃ kañcukīnāṃ ca dāna koṭiguṇārthakam ।
svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ tāmradānaṃ śriyaḥpradam ।।।58।।
pātradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ cānnadānaṃ mahattamam ।
jaladānaṃ miṣṭadānaṃ ceṣṭadānaṃ śubhāvaham ।।।59।।
śākadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ kanyādānaṃ divaspadam ।
jñānadānaṃ tathā yajñopavītasya pradānakam ।।2.125.60।।
gṛhadānaṃ tathā dānaṃ gṛhopakaraṇādijam ।
prakartavyaṃ vāṭikāyā dānaṃ kṣetrapradānakam ।।61 ।।
yadyat sveṣṭaṃ bhavettasya dānaṃ kartavyamatra vai ।
sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ deyaṃ maharṣibhyaśca pūjanam ।।62।।
bhojanaṃ valkalādyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śreya icchatā ।
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi kartavyaṃ pitṛtṛptaye ।।62 ।।
bālakṛṣṇasarasyeva śāśvatītṛptidaṃ bhavet ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bālakṛṣṇasarastaṭe ।।64।।
mandirāṇi surāṇāṃ ca kāraṇīyāni tattaṭe ।
muktānāmavatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ tathā''layāḥ ।।65।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ prāsādā mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ ।
kāraṇīyā dharmaśālā bhaktiśālāḥ śubhāvahāḥ ।।66।।
udyānāni vāṭikādyāḥ kāraṇīyā hareḥ kṛte ।
mandiraṃ kārayitvā'tra mama mūrtyā samaṃ surān ।।67।।
sthāpayiṣyanti ye bhaktāstebhyo dhāma dadāmyaham ।
jīvikāṃ vṛttikāṃ cāpi pūjāyāśca pravāhikām ।।68।।
kārayiṣyanti ye bhaktāsteṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam ।
sarvaṃ dāsye'hamevā'smai dhāmni me puruṣottamaḥ ।।69।।
sarve devāstathā muktā īśvarāśca narāyaṇāḥ ।
avatārā īśvarāṇyo muktānyo devapuṃgavāḥ ।।2.125.70।।
devyo devāḥ ṛṣayaśca tīrthāni ca vasantviha ।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma svayaṃ vasāmi cātra hi ।।71 ।।
mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇapakṣaikādaśikādine'niśam ।
pratisamvatsaraṃ sarvatīrthaiṃrdevaiśca sādhubhiḥ ।।72।।
muktaistatheśvaraiścātrā''gantavyaṃ lokahetave ।
sarvapāvitryalābhārthaṃ saptāhaṃ tīrthabhāvataḥ ।।73।।
koṭiśaśca janāstvatra snāsyanti hi sarovare ।
teṣāṃ pāpavināśaśca puṇyaṃ syādapyanantakam ।।74।।
etattīrthavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam ।
mayā sampādyate cātra vāsaṃ kṛtvā tu śāśvatam ।।75।।
atra tīrthaprakartṝṇāṃ rogā yāsyanti vai kṣayam ।
dāridryaṃ nāśamāyācca durbhāgyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ।।76।।
lakṣmīsteṣāṃ gṛhe syācca saubhāgyaṃ vardhayettathā ।
putrapautrādivaṃśaśca tairthikānāṃ bhavediha ।।77।।
yatheṣṭaḥ syāttasya lābhaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye ।
mārgaśīrṣātirikte'pi māse tīrthavidhāyinām ।।78।।
praṇaśyanti ca pāpāni puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet। ।
atra vārdhau mṛtānāṃ vai bhasmā'sthikṣepaṇe'pi ca ।।79।।
sarvapāpavināśo'pi muktiśca śāśvatī bhavet ।
etatsarojalasyāpi kaṇaṃ pāsyati yo janaḥ ।।2.125.80।।
mṛtyavasthāgatasyāpi muktistasya tu śāśvatī ।
sarasaścāsya saṃbhūtaḥ svāmyahaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।।8 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
sarojalasya yogena mama yogo dhruvo bhavet ।।।82।।
snānāt pānād darśanāccā''camanāt sparśanādapi ।
smaraṇādasya yajñasya sarasaśca pramokṣaṇam ।।83।।
bhavatyeva na sandeho dāsye'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
tapastīrthaṃ vrataṃ homaḥ kāryāścātra mumukṣubhiḥ ।।84।।
samarpaṇaṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca kartavyaṃ mayi śārṅgiṇi ।
śāśvataṃ puṇyameva syādarpitasya mayi dhruvam ।।85।।
muktatīrthaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ brahmapriyāditīrthakam ।
avatārāditīrthāni bhūmatīrthaṃ tathā'tra ca ।।86।।
vāsudevā'bhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ prādyumnaṃ tīrthamityapi ।
devāyatanakaṃ tīrthaṃ vairājatīrthamityapi ।।87।।
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tathā rādhātīrthaṃ śrītīrthamityapi ।
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ śubhaṃ param ।।88।।
brahmatīrthaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ śivatīrthaṃ satīyutam ।
rudratīrthaṃ rāśitīrtham ṛṣitīrthaṃ tathottamam ।।89।।
pitṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ dikpālānāṃ ca tīrthakam ।
indratīrthaṃ vahnitīrthaṃ dharmatīrthaṃ śubhottamam ।।2.125.90।।
vāyutīrthaṃ yamatīrthaṃ kuberatīrthamuttamam ।
īśānatīrthamutkṛṣṭaṃ bṛhaspatipratīrthakam ।।9 1।।
lomaśākhyaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ śubhottamam ।
kambharātīrthamevā'pi santoṣātīrthamityapi ।। 92।।
śrīmadgopālatīrthaṃ ca māṇikītīrthamityapi ।
sabhātīrthaṃ tathā pāravaśaṃtīrthaṃ śubhaṃ priyam ।। 93।।
vedatīrthaṃ ca gāyatrītīrthaṃ sāvitrikāhvayam ।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ bālakṛṣṇapratīrthakam ।।94।।
kalpavallīmahātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ sarveṣṭadāyakam ।
grahatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ devāyatanatīrthakam ।।95।।
vasutīrthaṃ sādhyatīrthaṃ viśvetīrthaṃ śubhāspadam ।
sāmudratīrthamevāpi kailāsatīrthamityapi ।।96 ।।
vaikuṇṭhatīrthamevāpi gaṇeśatīrthamityapi ।
gaṇatīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ sādhvītīrthottamottamam ।।97।।
vratatīrthaṃ vimānākhyatīrthaṃ ca śibitīrthakam ।
avabhṛthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthā'dhivāsitam ।।98।।
etānyanyāni sarvāṇi mūrtānyatra vasanti hi ।
mamā''jñayā'dyā'rabhyaiva pāvanāni tu dehinām ।।99।।
dharmakāryaṃ sadā cātra kartavyaṃ mānavaistataḥ ।
atha sarve prayāntyeva tharkūṭasthasya rājyake ।। 2.125.100 ।।
yatra yaśaḥ prakartavyastatra kurvantu tatsthitim ।
ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi śvo vā paraśca eva tu ।। 101 ।
ityuktāstīrthadevāśca kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvitīyakam ।
tatra tīrthasvarūpeṇa sthitāḥ sadā hi rādhike! ।। 102 ।।
atha sarve yayustatra dvikalākhyasarovare ।
tharkūṭasthamahārājarājye yajñārthameva ha ।। 1 03।।
vyomayānena vai sarve īśā devāśca mānavāḥ ।
koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyā hi satīsādhvīharipriyāḥ ।। 1 04।.
bālakṛṣṇaḥ samuvāsa śibirājagṛhe dinam ।
viśrāntyarthaṃ tathā rājñaḥ sevāsvīkaraṇāya vai ।। 1 05।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇamūrtinā śrīhariṇā pradattopadeśāśiṣo, dvitīyayajñārthamājñā, bālakṛṣṇasarastīrthāni cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 125 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 125 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 126
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 127 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra camatkāro'bhavanmahān ।
sabhāyāḥ sannidhau tatra kṛśāṃgāśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 1
rukṣavarṇā narā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇāstejovihīnakāḥ ।
duḥkhinaścāśrayahīnā dīnā iva samāyayuḥ ।। 2 ।।
prārthayantaḥ svamokṣaṃ vai duḥkhasāgarabandhanāt ।
dṛṣṭvā tāँstu prajānāṃ ca tadā''ścaryamabhūnmahat ।। 3 । ।
ka ime kuta āyātā jijñāsāṃ cakrire prajāḥ ।
jñātvā ca hariṇā hārdaṃ pṛṣṭāste yūyamatra ke ।। 4 ।।
te rudantastadā prāhuḥ śṛṇvatāṃ narayoṣitām ।
vayaṃ pretā mṛtāḥ pūrve pūrvajāḥ pretayonayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
asadgatiṃ gatāḥ sarve sahasraśaḥ sarastaṭe ।
vasāmo'tra mahāraṇye kṣudhitā duḥkhitāstathā ।। 6 ।।
prajānāṃ pitaraḥ smo'tra manyante na ime tu naḥ ।
uddhāraṃ tvaṃ bhagavannaḥ kurvatra jaladānataḥ ।। 7 ।।
ītyuktavadbhyastebhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jalam ।
prāsādikaṃ nijaṃ kṛtvā dadau pānārthameva ca ।। 8 ।।
miṣṭaṃ prasāda datvā ca tṛptān kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
dadau muktiṃ brahmalokagāminīṃ paramottamām ।। 9 ।।
sarve te divyadehā vai muktāstatrā'bhavan śubhāḥ ।
muktatulyā vimānaiśca yayuste brahma śāśvatam ।। 2.126.10 ।।
ityevaṃ sarasastīre muktiṃ tebhyo dadau hariḥ ।
āścaryaṃ parama dṛṣṭvā prajāḥ śrāddhāni cācaran ।। 11 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ tena muktiśca tṛptiścāpi vyajāyata ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! pitṛtīrthaṃ tat samavartata ।। 12 ।।
śibidevena codyāne bhūpaveṣe prapūjitaḥ ।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaḥ sainyādiparivāritaḥ ।। 13 ।।
bhūpaveṣasuśobhāḍhyaścāmbālikāsamanvite ।
caturdantagaje śukle niṣāditaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 14।।
svāmipālāśanāmnyāṃ vai gatvā vimānakena tu ।
rājadhānyāṃ nijāyāṃ ca caturdantagajopari ।। 15 ।।
punaśca bhrāmitaḥ kṛṣṇo rājamārgādibhistataḥ ।
prajābhirvardhitaḥ puṣpākṣatalājābhiracyutaḥ ।। 16 ।।
pūjito vanditaḥ kṛṣṇo bahubhāvena cārthitaḥ ।
rājñyā bhūprabhayā sākaṃ rājñā bhūpālaye ciram ।। 17 ।।
tatastāmrakaśāyāṃ ca gatvā vimānamārgataḥ ।
datvā svadarśanaṃ rājñyāḥ pitṛbhyāṃ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 8।।
vimānena yayau rājñā śibinā saha mādhavaḥ ।
tharkūṭasthanṛparājye dvikalākhyasarastaṭe ।। 19 ।।
paścime bhūtale bīnānadīparyantameva ha ।
kṛtāँśca maṇḍapān dṛṣṭvā śibirāṇi navāni ca ।।2.126.2 0 ।।
sarovaraṃ bhrāmayitvā'vā'tārayad vimānakam ।
paścime sarasastīre maṇḍapasya samīpataḥ ।। 2 1 ।।
avādyanta suvādyāni tadā māṃgalikāni hi ।
jayaghoṣā hyabhavaँśca sādhuvādāstathā'bhavan ।।22।।
puṣpacandanalājābhiścā'kṣataiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ ।
vardhayanti sma janatāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasvāminaṃ harim ।।23।।
koṭiśo mānavāstatra dvikalasya taṭe'bhavan ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanotsukāḥ ।। 24।।
pāvitryā''kāṃkṣayā yajñaṃ draṣṭuṃ cāpi samāgatāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ koṭiśaste ābālavṛddhamānavāḥ ।।25।।
sūryavat kāśamānaṃ taṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ tathā ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhrātarau bhaginīṃ snuṣām ।।26 ।।
śibidevaṃ ca bhaktā'gryaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣurutsukāḥ ।
devatāyatanaścāpi lomaśaḥ patnikāvrataḥ ।।27।।
vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca hārān śrīharaye daduḥ ।
tharkūṭastho nṛpatiśca rājñyaścatasra ityapi ।।28।।
dadurhārān gale viṣṇormeṣādyāḥ ṛṣayo'pi ca ।
pañcāśadyojane tatra maṇḍapo vidyate mahān ।। 29।।।
tanmadhye śrībālakṛṣṇo yayau snātvā sarovare ।
madhyapīṭhe tu sauvarṇe nyaṣīdacca vyarājata ।।2.126.3 0।।
pañcamyāṃ mārgaśuklasya prātareva hariḥ svayam ।
nyayuṃkta yajñakāryārthaṃ yathāyogyarṣimaṇḍalam ।।3 1 ।।
devān deveśvarān muktānavatārān dvijādikān ।
satīḥ sādhvīrdāsadāsīryathā vai prathame makhe ।।3 2।।
tharkūṭastho mahārājo yajamānaḥ priyāyutaḥ ।
vavre prakoṣṭhabandhena brahmādīn yājñikāँstataḥ ।।33।।
lomaśaśca nṛpaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca yajamānakam ।
prakoṣṭhe'bandhayat kṛṣṇo lomaśaṃ cā'pyabandhayat ।।34।।
ācāryaṃ gauṇamevā'pi patnīvrataṃ haridvijam ।
anyān pāresahasraṃ ca pārelakṣaṃ hyabandhayat ।।35।।
śuddhiśca svastivācaśca devānāṃ sthāpanādikam ।
pūjanaṃ havanaṃ dānaṃ pūrvakratau yathā'bhavat ।।36 ।।
arcanaṃ bhojanaṃ dānaṃ dakṣiṇāḥ svāgatādikam ।
yathā pūrvakratau tadvat sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ tvapadyata ।।37।।
saptāho yajña evā'yaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ pūrṇatāṃ gataḥ ।
dakṣiṇāścānnavastrādisvarṇarūpyakadānakam ।।38।।
sarvaṃ pūrvavadevātra kṛtaṃ tharkūṭakena vai ।
avabhṛthaṃ ca mārgasya sitaikādaśikādine ।।39।।
dvikale sarasi tatra paścime cakrurutsukāḥ ।
muktā īśā avatārā devāśca pitṛmānavāḥ ।।2.126.40 ।।
pātālasthāstathā cānye jaḍacetanadehinaḥ ।
bīnāmūle tathā sasnuḥ kṛṣṇayuktā janāḥ punaḥ ।।41 ।।
evaṃ ca dvikale kṛṣṇo bīnānadyā jale'pi ca ।
snātvā tīrthāni vai kṛtvā mahīmānānabhojayat ।।42।।
dīnā'nāthadaridrādīnabhojayacca tatparaḥ ।
prajāḥ sarvāstataścābhojayanmiṣṭānnajātibhiḥ ।।43 ।।
abhojayaddhariḥ paścāt pariveṣaṇakārakān ।
jaḍacetanavargāścātarpayāccannavāribhiḥ ।।।44।।
mantrān tatrāgatasarvamumukṣebhyo dadau ṛṣiḥ ।
lomaśaḥ .śrīhariścāpi nijān manūn svayaṃ dadau ।।45 ।।
evaṃ nirvartito yajñaḥ tharkūṭasthena bhūbhṛtā ।
tasmai rājñe harirnaije pādābje pradadau hṛdi ।।46 ।।
rājyaṃ cā'vicalaṃ tvastu prajā te cāstu modinī ।
sarvasampadbharā cāstu bhavān vaṃśadharo'stu ca ।।47।।
bālakṛṣṇasarastoye yathā tīrthāni santi ca ।
tathā tīrthāni sarvāṇi sarasyatra vasantvapi ।।48।।
muktā īśā avatārā rādhālakṣmīramādikāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ pitaro munayastathā ।।49।।
devā devyo mānavāśca yatra sasnustadantare ।
te sarve divyarūpeṇa vasantu divyarūpiṇaḥ ।।2.126.50 ।।
ityevaṃ hariṇā''jñaptā ūṣustatra nirantaram ।
tāni tīrthāni sarvāṇi kṛtāni paramātmanā ।।5 1।।
snānadānajapayajñahomopakārakāṇi ca ।
koṭyanantaphaladāni bhaviṣyantītyuvāca saḥ ।।52।।
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tvatra tīrthe yajñasaptāhake śubhe ।
sarvatīrthanivāse'tra mokṣadaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ bhavet ।।5 3 ।।
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe pañcamyekādaśīkṣaṇe ।
samājastatra kartavyaḥ saraso vai taṭe śubhe ।।54।।
mandiraṃ cātra kartavyaṃ mūrtirme kānakī śubhā ।
abhayadānadātrī ca mālikāsahitā tathā ।। 55 ।।
sthāpanīyā mandire'tra ṣaḍdāsīsahitā varā ।
rādhālakṣmībrahmavidyāramāśrīmāṇikīyutā ।।56।।
yajñāstvatraiva kartavyāḥ sarvamedhādivaiṣṇavāḥ ।
yathā'yaṃ vaiṣṇavo yajñaḥ kṛtaḥ sarvasurārcanaḥ ।।57।।
tathā bhaktaiḥ prakartavyā yajñā yathādhanaṃ śubhāḥ ।
asadgatīnāṃ mokṣo'tra bhavitā tarpaṇāt khalu ।।58।।
śrāddhadānādi kartavyaṃ tīrthe'tra pitṛnāmataḥ ।
