pāpānāṃ pravināśārthaṃ snātavyaṃ tvatra sarvathā ।।59।।
atrā''sannamṛtyubhistu vāsaḥ kāryaḥ sarastaṭe ।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇasvāmī mantraṃ dāsyāmi mokṣaṇam ।।2.126.6 0 ।।
kathā divyā vācanīyā mama sāmarthyabodhikāḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathā tattvavedibhiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
mokṣadā vācanīyā'tra sarvādibodhadāyinī ।
mama śāstraṃ veda eva lakṣmyā śrutaṃ ca rādhayā ।।6 2।।
māṇikyayā ca ramayā vidyayā ca śrutaṃ tathā ।
maṃjulayā haṃsayā ca śrutaṃ sadguṇayā tathā ।।63।।
jayālalitābhūlīlādyābhirmuktaistathā śrutam ।
ṛṣipitṛsuranārāyaṇabhūvāsibhiḥ śrutam ।।64।।
atalādisthitairanyaiḥ śrutaṃ yasmād bahirna vai ।
caritrāṇi pūrvapūrvaṃkṛtāni tanubhirmayā ।।65।।
tacchravyaṃ śrāvaṇīyaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahmā'hamasmi puruṣottamaḥ ।।66।।
bhajanīyaḥ sa evāhaṃ cāntarātmā parātparaḥ ।
evaṃ me niścayaḥ kāryo vikalpavarjito dhruvaḥ ।।67।।
mama bhaktiḥ sadā kāryā sarvasvārpaṇapūrvikā ।
mama bhaktāḥ sadā divyatayā mānyā yathā nvaham ।।68।।
bhaktadroho na kartavyo drohaḥ svarūpakhaṇḍanam ।
kartavyastu tathā nityo mama bhaktasamāgamaḥ ।।69।।
darśanaṃ me sadā kāryaṃ prātaḥ snātvā ca mandire ।
dāsabhaktirbhṛtyabhaktistathā kāryā satāṃ mama ।।2.126.70।।
mama vāse pravastavyaṃ duḥkhadoṣanivṛttaye ।
hiṃsā kāryā na kasyāpi bhoktavyā na parastriyaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
māṃsādanaṃ na kartavyaṃ pātavyaṃ madirādi na ।
śīlabhaṃgo na kartavyo hyayogye dehini kvacit ।।72।।
ātmaghāto'pi kāryo na cauryaṃ kāryaṃ na vai kvacit ।
mithyāropakalaṃkādi deyaṃ naiva parāya ca ।।73 ।।
nindanīyā na vai devā devyo vā dehino'pi vā ।
pāpasyotpādikā nindā tataḥ puṇyavināśinī ।।74।।
abhakṣyaṃ naiva bhakṣyaṃ cā'peyaṃ pātavyameva na ।
devaprasādahīnaṃ cā'bhakṣyā'peyaṃ yato matam ।।75।।
nāstikānāṃ prasaṃgo na kartavyo mokṣarodhakaḥ ।
satāṃ sevā sadā kāryā santo vai mama mūrtayaḥ ।।76।।
naro vā yadi vā nārī sevayā mucyate hyaghāt ।
mama ye sādhavaḥ santi te santi mokṣadāyakāḥ ।।77।।
taddehaḥ sarvathā puṇyaḥ puṇyadaḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ ।
bhāgatyāgo na tatrā'sti yathā mayi tathā sati ।।78।।
mātāpitṛsevanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sarvathā bhuvi ।
mamā''jñāṃ pālayiṣyanti dhruvāsteṣāṃ hi siddhayaḥ ।।79 ।।
kalpavidyutpravāhāśca kalpatattvāṇavastathā ।
kalpavallīrasāsteṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti gṛhe sadā ।।2.126.80।।
kāmāvasāyitāśālāḥ saṃkalpavaṃśavistarāḥ ।
sarve kāmadughāstattvasamūhāḥ sārvabhaumikāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
bhaviṣyanti gṛhe teṣāṃ ye madājñāpravartinaḥ ।
teṣāmahaṃ sadā dātā yatheṣṭasyākṣare yathā ।।82।।।
bhogāḥ kāryā na cā'tyarthaṃ bhaktiḥ kāryā'tiśāyinī ।
nidrā kāryā na cātyarthaṃ sevā kāryā'tiśāyinī ।।।83 ।।
manaḥ kāryaṃ nā'pakṛṣṭaṃ kāryā māyā vimūlinī ।
tṛṣṇā kāryā na cātyarthaṃ vāñcchā kāryā mamā'tigā ।।84।।
āgraho neha kartavyaḥ kartavyo'mutra mokṣadaḥ ।
udvegaḥ sarvathā tyājyaḥ śāntiḥ prāpyā tu śāśvatī ।।85।।
nā''yāso bahudhā kāryo vijñāne kārya uttamaḥ ।
parādhīnena no bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ tu sattayā''tmanaḥ ।।86 ।।
dehātmanā na vai vṛttyaṃ vartitavyaṃ nijātmanā ।
lagnatā na gṛhe kāryā kāryā susvāmini dhruvā ।।87।।
svāmī cāhaṃ hi bhaktānāṃ sarveṣāmapi sarvathā ।
bhavāmyeva paraḥ svāmī parameśvarasaṃjñakaḥ ।।88।।
jalaṃ tīrthaṃ sthalaṃ tīrthaṃ cātmatīrthaṃ sadottamam ।
sādhujanaḥ sadā tīrthaṃ svāmī tīrthamahaṃ hariḥ ।।89।।
yatrā'haṃ mama mūrtiśca tattīrthaṃ divyamokṣadam ।
ityevaṃ sarvathā yūyaṃ tharkūṭasthaprajājanāḥ ।।2.126.9 0।।
vittaṃ kuruta bhaktiṃ me bhajatā'nvahamādarāt ।
ādatta mama mantrāṃśca matta eva sumuktidān ।। 91 ।।
ityupadiṣṭā bhaktāste koṭiśo manulabdhaye ।
āyayuḥ śrīhareḥ pārśvaṃ dadau tebhyo manūn hariḥ ।। 12।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 93।।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ।।94।।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।।95।।।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।। 96।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
ityevaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇastebhyo manūn hi rādhike ।।97।।
parihāraṃ tataścakre viśrāntyarthaṃ yayau gṛham ।
tharkūṭasthamahārājastathā rājñyaḥ sutāḥ sutāḥ ।। 98।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā ।
rājñā sarve pūjitāśca bhojitāśca viśaśramuḥ ।।99।।
rājadhānyāṃ dvitīye ca dine tvabhrāmayanmudā ।
hastisthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vai prajā dadṛśurutsukāḥ ।। 2.126.100 ।।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pupūjurutsukāstathā ।
āgatya rājabhavane sabhāyāmāha keśavaḥ ।। 101 ।।
śvaḥ prayāntu prabhuktvaiva obīrātrīśasaṃgamam ।
vīrajāramahārājarājye yajñastṛtīyakaḥ ।। 1 02।।
pauṣakṛṣṇatṛtīyāto yajñāraṃbho bhaviṣyati ।
saptāhaḥ kāraṇīyo'sti yāvannavamikātithim ।। 103 ।।
ahaṃ tatrā''gamiṣyāmi dvitīyāprātareva ha ।
ityuktā vyomayānairvai sarve deveśvararṣayaḥ ।। 1 04।।
sarvasṛṣṭimahīmānā yayuścaubīnadītaṭam ।
śrīhariṃ svāsthyamāpannaścovāsa tharkuṭasthakam ।। 1 05।।
sukhayan tadgṛhe tāvad rādhike! mokṣakṛddhariḥ ।
sarvakāmanidhiḥ svāmī sarvasaṃkalpapūrakaḥ ।। 1 06।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya śrāvaṇānmananādapi ।
dvikalasnānapuṇyaṃ ca yaśapuṇyaṃ labhejjanaḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne tharkūṭasthamahārājarājye dvikalasarovare dvitīyaviṣṇuyāgakaraṇaṃ prajābhyo mantropadeśadānādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 126 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 126 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 127
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 128 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! tatrā'pyāścaryaṃ samabhūddhi yat ।
pūrvaṃ bhūkampayogena mṛtāścāpagatiṃ gatāḥ ।। 1 ।।
lakṣādhikāstu ye pretāḥ samānaparvatasthitāḥ ।
āyayurdvikalaṃ tīrthaṃ mokṣārthe kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 2 ।।
kecidvai vakravadanāḥ kecicchuṣkakalevarāḥ ।
anye tu kaṭibhagnāśca pṛṣṭhalagnodarāḥ pare ।। 3 ।।
sakeśā makṣikāvyāptāścānye maśakajālinaḥ ।
kṣuttṛṣāduḥkhinaścānye'ndhāḥ paṅguvṛkṇakāḥ pare ।। 4 ।।
kuṣṭhino'ṅgādivikalāḥ śvāsakāsādirogiṇaḥ ।
lambajalodarāścānye nirnetrāḥ karṇavarjitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
pṛṣṭhapādāḥ pṛṣṭhamukhā vikarālā daridrakāḥ ।
sahasraśo duḥkhinaste samāyayurhareḥ puraḥ ।। 6 ।।
duḥkhanāśārthamevaite prārthayāmāsuracyutam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 7 ।।
bhūkampe hi vayaṃ naṣṭā gṛhapātārdanaiḥ purā ।
vṛkṣapātā'rdanaiścāpi bhūsphāṭe patitā api ।। 8 ।।
vivareṣu sajaleṣu magnā naṣṭā mṛtāstadā ।
ākasmikaiśca maraṇaiḥ pretā vayaṃ hi duḥkhinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
yogyā uddhartumevā'tra bhavataiva na cetaraiḥ ।
tasmāduddhara pāpiṣṭhayonerasmān kṛpāṃ kuru ।। 2.127.1 0।।
ityarthitaḥ śrībhagavān jalaṃ cikṣepa teṣu ha ।
añjalinā kṛtaṃ prāsādikaṃ prāptaṃ ca taistadā ।। 11 ।।
dagdhapāpā abhavaँśca jalaṃ yayācire punaḥ ।
pānārthaṃ pradadau tebhyaḥ kṛṣṇo jalaṃ tu sārasam ।। 12।।
ānītaṃ nijakāryārthaṃ pāyayāmāsa tānprabhuḥ ।
pītvā pītvā'titṛptāste yayācire'tha bhojanam ।। 1 3।।।
bhagavān pradadau tebhyo miṣṭānnaṃ śārkaraṃ śubham ।
saghṛtaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca kalpadhenusamudbhavam ।। 14।।
bhuktvā tṛptāḥ punarjātā yayācire virogitām ।
haristebhyo dadau ramyamārogyaṃ saumyavarṣma ca ।। 15।।
yayācire tato mokṣaṃ divyadehaiḥ prasevanam ।
haristebhyo dadau mokṣaṃ divyedehairyayuśca te ।। 16 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ lokaṃ vimānaiḥ sūryasannibhaiḥ ।
narāśca pārṣadā jātāścaturmujāḥ subhāsurāḥ ।। 17।।
nāryaśca pārṣadānyaśca caturbhujāḥ subhāgyikāḥ ।
muktarūpā hi jātā vai mokṣasthānanivāsinaḥ ।। 18।।
ityevaṃ kṛpayā tebhyo bālakṛṣṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
dadau vaikuṇṭhamevā'dya svayogena kṣaṇānnanu ।। 1 9।।
kṛpaiva kāraṇaṃ cātra na puṇyaṃ bhaktirityapi ।
śaraṇāgatapālatvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛpayā'nvitam ।।2.127.20।।
rādhike ca tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahārājo ramāpatiḥ ।
māṇikyākānta īśeśaḥ tharkūṭasthaṃ jagāda ha ।।।2 1 ।।
tharkūṭasthamahārāja! śṛṇu jñātavyamatra yat ।
dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaśca bhaktiśceti catuṣṭayam ।।22।।
tvayā pālyā hi catvāraḥ kartavyārthāḥ sadā bhuvi ।
loke'smin sukhadāste ca paratrā''nandadāyakāḥ ।।23 ।।
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ kāryaṃ dayā kāryā prajādiṣu ।
dīnā'nātheṣu yoṣitsu satsu vṛddhajanādiṣu ।।24।।
paropakāraḥ kartavyaḥ parātmasukhakārakaḥ ।
parapīḍā na kartavyā yuddhadharmaṃ vinā kvacit ।।25।।
śaraṇāpannajīvānāṃ rakṣā kāryā tvayā sadā ।
yanmukhe bhagavannāma sa pūjyo'daṇḍya eva ca ।। 26 ।।
vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvathā pūjyā dānamānā'rhavastubhiḥ ।
vinayena ca vākyena sevayā dāsadharmayā ।। 27 ।।
sāttvatānāṃ saṃgamaśca kartavyo hṛdyena vai ।
rājasānāṃ saṃgamastu kartavyo varṣmaṇā manāk ।। 28 ।।
tāmasānāṃ saṃgamastu kartavyo vai mṛṣānibhaḥ ।
yathā rājyaṃ vinaśyenna bandhanaṃ svasya no bhavet ।। 29 ।।
vighnā neyuryathā cāpi kartavyaṃ tattathā sadā ।
viśvāsaḥ sarvathā kāryaḥ satsu bhāgavateṣu vai ।। 2.127.30 ।।
rājñyāṃ putre pradhāne vā viśvaset sāvadhānakaḥ ।
nijān nijānna manvīta yāvanna syātparikṣaṇam ।। 31 ।।
svārthamātraparān gṛdhnāyutān rājye na viśvaset ।
nispṛhān viśvaset bhaktyā sādhumārga sthitān janān ।। 32।।
ekākī na milet kaṃcid bhayasthānaṃ hi nirjanam ।
bhojanaṃ nāpi gṛhṇīyāt vinā'nyagrahapūrvakam ।। 33 ।।
peyaṃ spṛśyaṃ dadet kaścinna gṛhṇīyādacintayan ।
bhogyānāṃ jaḍavastūnāṃ vinā'nyasmin samarpaṇam ।। 34।।
svārthārthaṃ nopayuñjīta kaṇamātramapi kvacit ।
api bhrātā sutaścāpi draṣṭavyastvavadhāninā ।। 35 ।।
prajā nodvejanīyāśca hiṃsitavyā na dehinaḥ ।
namantaṃ viśvasennaiva iṣanmilatpranetrakam ।। 36 ।।
śūnyagṛhe vasennaiva vinā śastraṃ na vai vaset ।
ceṭīṃ vinā vasennaiva rājñyā sahā'pi nirjane ।। 3 7।।
bahupatnīrna vai kuryānna dāsyāṃ surataṃ śrayet ।
vinā dharmaṃ na gacchecca padaṃ kṛtyārthameva vā ।। 38।।
na svapennirbhayo bhūtvā pārśve sādhūnprarakṣayet ।
dharmasthāne na vai kāmaṃ prayuñjīta kadācana ।। 39 ।।
kāmasthāne na vai jñānaṃ prayuñjīta virāgitām ।
vairāgyasya tapasaśca sthāne yuñjyānna lālasām ।।2.127.40 ।।
cārān yuñjyāt parasthāne svarājye'pi gṛhe sthale ।
dehendriyādirājye'pi cārān yuñjīta dharmajān ।।4 1 ।।
vivekaṃ ca pradhānaṃ vai kṛtvā kāryāṇi vartayet ।
pradhāno vimanāḥ syāccet kāryarodhaṃ samarthayet ।।42।।
vṛddhādanubhavaṃ prāpya śāntidaṃ śāśvataṃ caret ।
sadyojātaṃ bālakaṃ ca mahatyarthe na saṃśrayet ।।।43 ।।
mokṣārthe hitadṃ svalpaṃ mahāntaṃ vā samāśrayet। ।
vuthā''yāsapradāṃ buddhiṃ vivāsayed vṛkīmiva ।।44।।
śāntipradāṃ matiṃ hṛsvāṃ suvāsayet satīmiva ।
jaḍaṃ cāpi janaṃ rakṣed stambhamiva vipatsthale ।।45।।
vidvāṃsamapi rakṣenna cātatāyikriyāparam ।
araṇye vā mṛgayāyāṃ naikākī vicarennṛpaḥ ।।46 ।।
jalāśaye ca kūpādau viśvasenna nijaṃ janam ।
purohitaṃ puraskṛtya sasainyaścā'ṭavīṃ caret ।।47।।
tatrāpi cāṭavījñaṃ hi kuryādagragataḥ sadā ।
varṣāyāṃ nā'ṭavīṃ gacchedutsave viplave tathā ।।48।।
rātrau veṣāntareṇā'pi parīkṣeta prajāsukham ।
nāpitāt tantuvāyācca bhārāccāṭācca taskarāt ।।49।।
svayaṃ tadrūpamāsādya mahīmāno bhavet kvacit ।
sarvaṃ vijñāya vṛttāntaṃ prajāsukhaṃ samācaret ।।2.127.50।।
nāpitādau nijān bhṛtyān tadrūpaiḥ prerayet purā ।
tataḥ svayaṃ ca tadrūpo bhūtvā gacchenna cānyathā ।।5 1 ।।
nārī bhūtvā brāhmakāle jalārthaṃ jalahāriṇī ।
svadāsībhirjalahāriṇībhirgacchejjalasthalīm ।।52 ।।
vijānīyācca tābhyaśca vārtayā ca prajāhitam ।
svabhṛtyānāṃ svāśritānāṃ svastrīṇāṃ vartanādikam ।।53 ।।
dīnā'nāthadaridrāṇāṃ jñātvā duḥkhāni nāśayet ।
nāstikyaṃ ca pratāritvaṃ kauṭilyaṃ nāśayettathā ।।54।।
kathādvārā daṇḍadvārā duṣṭāḥ prajāḥ praśikṣayet ।
vidhavābhyaścānnavastrāśrayān dadyād dayāparaḥ ।।55।।।
vidyādānaṃ dāpayecca śikṣājñānaṃ pradāpayet ।
kalājñānaṃ śilpavidyāṃ vikāsayet sadā nṛpaḥ ।।56 ।।
narāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ tu cā'ṇḍakośānna chedayet ।
nārīṇāṃ bālarakṣādi paradvārā na kārayet ।।57।।
mātṛdvārā bālarakṣāpuṣṭiśikṣādi kārayet ।
ṛtudharmānna vai rundhyācchāsanena kadāpi vai ।।58।।
ārtavaṃ phalapuṣpādi vikārayenna cauṣadhaiḥ ।
mānavaṃ tu parādhīnaṃ paśuvanna pravāhayet ।।59।।
mārayenna ca niṣkāmaṃ niṣprayojanamakriyam ।
vighnarūpaṃ ca vā'yogyaṃ mānavaṃ vai kadācana ।।2.127.6 0 ।।
mokṣadharmaṃ tādṛśāya samarpayeddhitāya vai ।
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya devakāryāṇi cārpayet ।।6 1 ।।
mānavaṃ durlabhaṃ kuryāt tuṣavanna kadācana ।
vikāsaṃ sādhayennūtnaṃ vikāsaṃ na vilopayet ।।6 2।।
kṛṣiṃ vikāsayet sarvavikāsottamarūpiṇīm ।
śailpyaṃ vikāsayeccāpi vijñānaṃ tāttvikaṃ tathā ।।63।।
rāsāyanaṃ tāntrikaṃ yāntrikaṃ ca māntrikaṃ tathā ।
daivikaṃ vyomamārgīyaṃ vikāsayed yathābalam ।।64।।
śreṣṭhe saṃkaratāṃ naiva kuryānnimnatvadāyinīm ।
nimne śraiṣṭhyapradāṃ kuryāt kalāṃ vibhūtidāyinīm ।।65।।
dūraśravaṇadṛśyādi vikāsayeddhi tāttvikam ।
pṛthvīpraveśamārgādi vikāsayettu yogivat ।।66।।
jalatejo'ntarīkṣādigamanaṃ ca vikāsayet ।
parāṇḍagamanaṃ cāpi lopayenna kadācana ।।67।।
ṛṣipitṛsurādīnāṃ daityamānavarakṣasām ।
samājaṃ kārayecchreṣṭaṃ mithaḥ paricayārthakam ।। 68 ।।
yajñānnirvartayettasmāt sarvamedhānnṛpaḥ svayam ।
syācca paricayastena sarvalokanivāsinām ।।।69।।
pūjyapūjādisatkārakramotkramaṃ na cācaret ।
gurūṇāṃ pūjyatābhāvaṃ vardhayet sarvathā nṛpaḥ ।।2.127.70 ।।
svargavat sarvavastūnāṃ kalpanidhīn prarakṣayet ।
prajāḥ sarvāḥ suravacca modante yattathā''caret ।।71 ।।
rājā prajānāṃ sukhado yathā'haṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
mayā vāsaḥ sadā rājñi kriyate rājadharmiṇā ।।72।।
matsvarūpastato rājā putravatpālayetprajāḥ ।
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ pradāpayettataḥ ।।73 ।।
parameśā''rādhanātaḥ pātayenna prajāḥ kvacit ।
patanaṃ mokṣahāniśconnatirmokṣā'visarjanam ।।74।।
mukhyaṃ vai mānave bhāve dhyeyaṃ matvā cared vṛṣam ।
bhakticyutiryathā na syāttathā dhyeyaṃ subhāvayet ।।75।।
tadvinā rājasaṃjñā tu jārasaṃjñā bhaved bhuvi ।
nāmnā tharkūṭarājā tvaṃ thurānandamayo bhava ।।76।।
maduktadharmalope tu duḥkhaṃ vai syāt kvacit tvayi ।
tasmādvai sāvadhānastvaṃ prarakṣa mama deśanāḥ ।।77।।
sāradvayaṃ harau bhaktiḥ satāṃ samāgamaḥ śubhaḥ ।
sarvathā kārayettau ca rājā rājārthasārthakaḥ ।।78।।
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ cātra paratra mokṣadāyakam ।
svamokṣadāyakaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ rājadharmiṇā ।। 79।।
pālyadharmaviruddhārthaṃ kurvāṇānāṃ praśāsanam ।
daivadharmapravṛttānāmuttejanaṃ parārthinām ।।2.127.80।।
muktidhyeyā'nusandhānaṃ kartavyaṃ rājadharmiṇā ।
rājyapraśāsane niyoktavyāstadbuddhiśālinaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
rājñā mānuṣadehasya phalaṃ sādhyaṃ tu mokṣaṇam ।
adhruvasya tu saṃskāre phalaṃ nā''pyeta vai dhruvam ।।82 ।।
rājyaṃ praśāstvā vidhinā mokṣaśāsanamācaret ।
tadā rājyaṃ pradadyācca putrādibhyo'tha saṃvrajet ।।83 ।।
yadi pravrājanaṃ neṣṭaṃ tadāpi rājakarmasu ।
ārādhanātmakaṃ karma viśeṣayet pradhānataḥ ।।84 ।।
pararāṣṭrasya vijayo vijayo na dhruvo mataḥ ।
brahmarāṣṭrasya vijayo vijayaḥ sa dhruvo mataḥ ।। 85 ।।
dehendriyādiśayanaṃ śayanaṃ na dhruvaṃ sukham ।
vāsanāśayanaṃ proktaṃ śayanaṃ vai dhruvaṃ sukham ।।86 ।।
bhuktānāṃ smaraṇe līne saṃskāre layitāṃ gate ।
tṛṣṇākṣayaṃ sukhaṃ cātmānandatulyaṃ prajāyate ।।87।।
brahmarājyaṃ mahārājyaṃ prāptavyaṃ tattu bhūbhṛtā ।
yanna sāntaṃ na vai hāryaṃ na codvegapradaṃ kvacit ।।88 ।।
vyāpārastādṛśaḥ kāryaḥ śreṣṭhinā phalavardhakaḥ ।
hānipradastu santyājyo vyāpāraḥ puruṣārthinā ।। 89 ।।
rājyād rājyottamaṃ rājyaṃ yathā prāpyeta taccaret ।
na kuryād rājyanāśe tu nārakitvapradaṃ tu yat । । 2.127.90 ।।
puṇyaṃ sādhupadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svargaṃ maccaraṇābjakam ।
bhogo manmūrtisaṃyogo labdhavyāste tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ ।। 91 ।।
duḥkhaṃ sāmrājyabandhaśca narakaṃ vāsanāgaṇaḥ ।
pramādālasyakaṃ mṛtyustyaktavyāste tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ ।। 92 ।।
sāmrājyaṃ me'kṣaraprāptiḥ kuṭumbaṃ muktamaṇḍalam ।
prāsādaḥ svayameva syānmukto me'kṣaradhāmani ।। 93 ।।
yadrājyaṃ mama sāmrājyaṃ tadrājyaṃ tasya me bhavet ।
tasmai dadāmi me rājyaṃ bhaktāyā''tmanivedine ।। 94 ।।
rājan māṃ bhaja bhaktyaiva dāsīva sarvadā prabhum ।
mokṣaṃ dāsye yathākāle bhaktiṃ kāraya me bhuvi ।। 95।।
kuru me maṃdiraṃ ramyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ prabhum ।
rādhālakṣmīramābrahmavidyāśrīmāṇikīyutam । । 96 ।।
pravāhaṃ mama pūjāyāścā'khaṇḍitaṃ pravartaya ।
kariṣye tava sevāyāḥ svīkāraṃ pratimāsthitaḥ ।। 97।।
ityevaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasvāmīśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhike! tharkūṭanāmne hyupādiśat kuṭumbine । । 98 ।।
rājā tu kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ sumahattamam ।
tatra saṃsthāpya mūrtistā asevayattu dāsavat ।। 99 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrībhagavatprabhuḥ ।
pratipadrātrivigame prātaḥ tharkūṭasaṃjñakam ।। 2.127.100 ।।
prāha tṛtīyayajñārthaṃ vīrajārasya rāṣṭrake ।
gantavyaṃ prātarevā'dya gamiṣyāmi tvayā saha ।। 101 ।।
ityuktvā tu dvitīyāyāṃ prātareva hariḥ svayam ।
rājñā rājñyā tadā naijāḥ pañcāśatkanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 102।।
vidhinā cārpitāstāśca gṛhītvā yautakaṃ tathā ।
pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya ca datvā''śīrvādān śobhanān śubhān ।। 10 3।।
prajādibhyo vimānena obīrātrīśasaṃgamam ।
yayau śīghraṃ dadarśā'pi pradeśānmaṇḍapānvitān ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pretoddhāraḥ, tharkūṭasthanṛpataye rājanītisaddharmopadeśādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 27।।


← adhyāyaḥ 127 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 128
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 129 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
vimānenā'mbare yāvatsamāyāto'tibhāsvaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
prakāśaḥ samabhūtkoṭicandraprakāśavat sitaḥ ।
pṛthvyāṃ dikṣu vidikṣvatra nadīdvayasamāgame ।। 2 ।।
koṭiśo mānavā devāḥ ṛṣayo jaya mādhava ।
jaya kṛṣṇa jaya svāmin bālakṛṣṇa jaya prabho ।। 3 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām ।
ityevaṃ jayaśabdāँśca muktakaṇṭhā mahotsavāḥ ।। 4 ।।
jagaduḥ prāñjalayaśca dadṛśurnirnimeṣakāḥ ।
tāvadvimānaṃ kṛṣṇasya bhramitvā pañcavārakam ।। 5 ।।
vyomnyeva janatābhyastu datvā śubhaṃ svadarśanam ।
avātatāra bhūbhāge kāmagaṃ śubhadarśanam ।। 6 ।।
irātriśauṣikāyoge madhyadeśe'tiśobhane ।
pañcāśadyojane ramyamaṇḍapasya samīpataḥ ।। 7 ।।
irātrīśātaṭe kṛṣṇo vimānād bahirāyayau ।
śrīgopālaḥ kaṃbharāśrīstathā rājāna ityapi ।। 8 ।।
vimānāllomaśaścāpi kanyāśca bahirāyayuḥ ।
lājābhiścā'kṣataiḥ puṣpairvardhitāste prajājanaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
atha śrībhagavān snātvā irātrīśānadījale ।
maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍavedyādīrdṛṣṭvā''vāsaṃ yayau nijam ।। 2.128.10 ।।
rājñā rājakuṭumbena vīrajārādibhistadā ।
pūjitaḥ sevitaḥ kṛṣṇo viśaśrāma ca mandire ।। 11 ।।
bālakṛṣṇastataḥ prātaḥ snātvā yajñasthalīṃ yayau ।
pauṣakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ devarṣipitṛśobhitān ।। 12।।
dadarśa vedīṃ kuṇḍāँśca paṭṭikāḥ kāñcanīstathā ।
sāmagrīryajñakāryārthā asaṃkhyā mānavarjitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
yajñabhūmau dadarśā'tha koṭiviprarṣidevatāḥ ।
varaṇārthaṃ haristatra maṇḍape tu nijāsane ।। 14।।
niṣasāda tathā rājā vīrajāraḥ priyānvitaḥ ।
ājagāma ca yajñārthaṃ lomaśaścājagāma ha ।। 15।।
patnīvratastathā brahmā vaśiṣṭho vaiṣṇavo mahān ।
niṣeduḥ svāsaneṣveva maṃgalā gītayastadā ।। 1 6।।
sāmavedasya vai viprā agāyan harṣanirbharāḥ ।
devyaśca gītikāstatra jagurmaṃgalabodhikāḥ ।। 1 7।।
vāditrāṇi hyavādyanta tūryāṇi vividhāni ca ।
prakoṣṭhabandhanaṃ svastivācanādi vyavartata ।। 1 8।।
aṃgadevasthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ vighnahānaye ।
abhavadvai mukhyapātrapūjanaṃ dravyapūjanam ।। 19 ।।
devadevīpūjanādi prāvartata tadā'mbare ।
candanādipravṛṣṭyarthaṃ surādyāstvāyayuḥ kṣaṇam ।। 2.128.20 ।।
vahnidevaḥ kuṇḍapātre pratiṣṭhapita eva ca ।
brahmādyā mūrtimantaste devāścakrurhavaṃ tadā ।। 21 ।।
lomaśaśca vaśiṣṭhaścā''rabhete sma ṛtukriyāḥ ।
mantrāstatra tu paṭhyante prahūyante havīṃṣi ca ।।22।।
vahnyānanāḥ parabrahmabrahmamuktāvatārakāḥ ।
īśvareśarṣidevarṣipitṛmānavabhūdvijāḥ ।। 23 ।।
tṛptiṃ gacchanti havyairvai bhuñjate cānalānanāḥ ।
jīvasṛṣṭirbrahmasṛṣṭiśceśvarasṛṣṭirityapi ।। 24।।
tṛptāḥ sarvāḥ sṛṣṭaścā'saṃkhyahavyaprabhojanaiḥ ।
abhavan rādhike! tatra pūrvayajñe yathā'bhavan ।। 25।।
jaḍāśca sthāvarāścāpi cetanāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।
tīrthāni parvatā nadyaḥ kīṭapataṃgapakṣiṇaḥ ।।26 ।।
sarve vai bhagavaddehāstṛptāstatra mahādhvare ।
vaiṣṇave'nādilakṣmīśrīkāntanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ।। 27।।
sarvā'ntarātmā bhagavānatṛpyatā'graṇīrhariḥ ।
evaṃ vai saptadivasāstṛptyutsavavratātmakāḥ ।।28।।
vyatīyurdevayajanairnavamyāṃ tu visarjanam ।
kratostasya parihāro dakṣiṇāścāṃkavarjitāḥ ।। 29।।
bhojanāni ca sarveṣāṃ nityavannūtanāni ca ।
yathāyogyāni pacyāni pathyāni dehināṃ yathā ।। 2.128.3 0।।
vyajāyanta tato bālaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
obyā irātriśāyāśca saṃgame'vabhṛthaṃ param ।।3 1 ।।
cakāra yājñikaiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ koṭijanaiḥ saha ।
tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi mūrtimanti tadā'bhavan ।।32।
muktatīrthāni sarvāṇi brahmatīrthāni vai tathā ।
avatārapratīrthāni muktātīrthāni yāni ca ।। 33।।
kṛṣṇatīrthāni sarvāṇi nārāyaṇasya yāni ca ।
brahmaviṣṇu maheśānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ yogināṃ tathā ।। 34।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca dvijānāṃ ca satāmapi ।
satīnāṃ devadevīnāṃ dikpālānāṃ tapasvinām ।।35।।
sādhvīnāṃ cāpi sādhūnāṃ tīrthāni mūrtimanti ca ।
obyā nadyā irātriśāsaṃgame nyavasaँstadā ।। 36।।
tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ pauṣakṛṣṇatṛtīyakāt ।
dinādā navamīṃ yāvat saptāhe kratupuṇyadam ।।37।।
evamāha mahārājo rādhike'vabhṛthe tadā ।
ahaṃ snāto harestasya pārśve tiṣṭhaँstadā muhuḥ ।।38।।
nārāyaṇo'pi tatrā''sīt pārśve lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam ।
śrutavān hariṇoktaṃ tat tathoktaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।।3 9।।
nārāyaṇaiśca sarvairvai kṛṣṇaiḥ sarvaistathā'tra vai ।
vāsudevairavatāraiḥ sarvairīśvarakoṭibhiḥ ।। 2.128.40।।
tīrtharūpeṇa cātrā'pi vastavyaṃ śreyase nṝṇām ।
rādhālakṣmyādibhiścāpi devībhiḥ sarvathā'tra ca ।। 41 ।।
svasvakāntaiḥ samaṃ stheyaṃ tīrtharūpeṇa vai sadā ।
ityevaṃ tatra yajñasya tīrthe tu saṃgame surāḥ ।।42।।
obyāmirātriśāyāṃ ca trivalāyāṃ jalādiṣu ।
vāpīṣu kūpabhāgeṣu dīrghikāsvapi sarvathā ।। 43 ।।
palvaleṣu tatra yajñabhūmiṣvapi sthale sthale ।
nivasāmo vayaṃ sarve śrīharerājñayā priye ।। 44।।
hariḥ prāha punastatra pāpātipāpakāriṇām ।
atra snānena vai nāśaṃ yāsyanti pāpaparvatāḥ ।। 45।।
puṇyabhājo bhaviṣyanti putrapautrakuṭumbinaḥ ।
śreṣṭhino bhogabhājaśca nīrogā bahujīvinaḥ ।।46।।
yadā kvāpi samāgatya snāsyanti cātra ye janāḥ ।
jalapānaṃ kariṣyanti sprakṣyantyetajjalāni ca ।।47।।
smariṣyanti kratostīrthaṃ deśāntare'pi vartinaḥ ।
tebhyo bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ pradāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।48।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ paropakaraṇādikam ।
devasthānaṃ dharmaśālāṃ vṛkṣāropaṇamityapi ।।49।।
vidyādānaṃ ca kanyāyā dānaṃ cauṣadhaśālikām ।
kārayiṣyanti ye lokāsteṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam ।।2.128.50।।
rasaśālāṃ grahaśālāṃ vedhaśālāṃ kratugraham ।
satāṃ śālāṃ kathāśālāṃ yantraśālāṃ vṛṣagṛham ।। 51 ।।
annaśālāṃ ca satrāṇi jalaśālāṃ payogṛham ।
prasūtigṛhamevāpi jñānaśālāṃ prasevinām ।।52।।
sevāśālāṃ tathā'tithibhojanādigṛhāṇi ca ।
kārayiṣyanti ye lokā bhūtaśālāṃ kratusthale ।।53।।
tebhyo bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ pradāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityevaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha rādhike'vabhṛthasthale ।। 54।।
sasnau svayaṃ nimajjyaiva punaḥpunarjaleṣvapi ।
añjalibhiḥ snāpitaḥ saḥ sarvaiḥ sarve'pi tena ca ।।55।।
snāpitā añjalidhārābhiścāvabhṛthake muhuḥ ।
mayā prāsādikaṃ vāri dhṛtaṃ caitattavārthakam ।।56।।
kalaśe piba cālabhyaṃ pāvanaṃ pārameśvaram ।
pibāmīti papau rādhā śrīhareścaraṇāmṛtam ।।57।।।
nārāyaṇaḥ pradadau ca lakṣmyai sāpyapibajjalam ।
evaṃ rādhe vinirvartyā'vabhṛthaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।। 58।।
bahirnirgatya ca vastrāṇyādhāya bhūṣaṇādikam ।
maṇḍapā'ntaḥsthitaṃ naijaṃ cāsanaṃ prayayau hariḥ ।।59।।
lebhe kṣaṇaṃ ca viśrāntiṃ tataḥ sāyaṃ sabhāṃ śubhām ।
kārayāmāsa bhagavān sarvalokanivāsinām ।।2.128.6 0।।
vīrajāramahārājaḥ pūjāṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ।
śrīharerājñayā kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayat ।। 61 ।।
vāsudevaṃ ca bhūmānaṃ vairājaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ cāryamāṇaṃ sanatkumārakādikam ।।62।।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvāḥ indraṃ sūryaṃ prajāpatīn ।
vaśiṣṭhaṃ gālavaṃ patnīvrataṃ devāyataṃ munim ।। 63 ।।
śrīgopālaṃ kambharāśrīrādhālakṣmīsarasvatīḥ ।
anyā devīstathā pūjyāḥ pūjyānapūjayannṛpaḥ ।। 64 ।।
upadā vividhāstatra pūjāyāmārpayattadā ।
kṣamāṃ cā'yācata nyūnākṣamyā sevā mameti ca ।।65।।
pāvito'haṃ kṛpayaiva pāvitaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalam ।
īśvarairatra cāgatya khyāpito'haṃ digantare ।।66 ।।
dhanyo rājā jārasaṃjño vīratāṃ samupāgataḥ ।
yadahaṃ sarvathā jāro jāratā nāśitā mama ।।67।।
ataḥ paraṃ ca kiṃ bhāgyaṃ mama śreṣṭhaṃ bhavet kila ।
yadahaṃ svagṛhe kṛṣṇacaraṇau prāptavāniha ।।68।।
rājyaṃ me sārthakaṃ cāpi bhogā me sārthakā api ।
kuṭumbaṃ sārthakaṃ tvadya śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtāt ।।69।।
prajā me sārthakāstvadya narā nāryo'pi sārthakāḥ ।
āyuṣyaṃ sārthakaṃ cāpi yadatra puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2.128.70।।
dhanaṃ me sārthakaṃ sarvaṃ gajavājivimānakam ।
sarvaṃ me sārthakaṃ cādya yadatra puruṣottamaḥ ।। 71 ।।
dhanyo'haṃ jananī dhanyā dhanyaṃ śatakuṭumbakam ।
yadvaṃśe yadgṛhe kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāvatāraśobhanaḥ ।। 72 ।।
koṭijanmakṛtātpuṇyāllabdhiḥ syācchrīhareriha ।
sā kṛpāvaśato jātā kiṃ vadāmi subhāgyatām ।। 73 ।।
obī dhanyā tathā dhanyā irātriśā nadī śubhā ।
tribalā'pi tathā dhanyā yajjale puruṣottamaḥ ।। 74।।
dhanyā vai rāśiṛṣayo yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ ।
dhanyā vṛkṣāśca virudhaḥ stambāstṛṇagaṇādayaḥ ।।75।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo dhanyā yadvāse puruṣottamaḥ ।
nārāyaṇāstathā kṛṣṇā yadgṛhe'dya samāgatāḥ ।।76।।
mokṣasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ teṣāṃ saubhāgyasampadaḥ ।
sarvā'pi śrīḥ sadā teṣāṃ yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ ।।77।।
dhanyo nṛpaḥ śibiścāpi dhanyaḥ tharkūṭako nṛpaḥ ।
dhanyo rājā vīrarājo yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ ।। 78।।
dhanyāḥ pātālavāsāśca dhanyāḥ parvatavāsinaḥ ।
dhanyāḥ kanyāḥ kumārāśca yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanam ।।79।।
gṛhṇantu mānavāścāsmānnārāyaṇātpareśvarāt ।
mantraṃ mokṣapradaṃ sarve ye'vaśiṣṭā mumukṣavaḥ ।।2.128.80।।
ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre rājā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
sabhāṃ ca daṇḍavaccakre'loṭhīd rajassu cotsukaḥ ।।8 1।।
haristasmai caraṇau dvau dadau tanmastakopari ।
hṛdaye'pi dadau pādau samāleṣaṃ tato dadau ।।।82।।।
puṣpahāraprasādaṃ ca dadau rājñe hariḥ svayam ।
rājñyastasya catasraśca pupūja parameśvaram ।।83।।
putrāḥ putryastathā kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja bahubhāvataḥ ।
prajājanāḥ pupūjuśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।84।।
narā nāryaḥ pupūjuśca deśīyā mahīmānakāḥ ।
prāghūṇikāḥ pupūjuśca śrīsvāmiparameśvaram ।।85।।
śrīhariḥ pradadau rājñe mukuṭaṃ nijamastakāt ।
atha mantrārthamājagmuḥ koṭiśastu prajājanāḥ ।।86।।
haristebhyo dadau mantrān nāmasmaraṇapūrvakān ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।।87।।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।।88।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।।89।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 2.128.9 0।।
pitā vandyaḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।
'ahaṃ tasya śarīraṃ vai sa me śārīrako'stu vai' ।। 91 ।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
itimantrān dadau śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ।।92।।
prāsādikaṃ jalapānaṃ hyakārayajjanānnijān ।
darśanaṃ divyadhāmasthamahāmuktādibhiḥ saha ।। 93।।
dadau svasya janatābhyo bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
śiśriyurjanatāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ prabhum ।। 94।।
sabhāsamāptau bhagavān bhojayitvā''gatān janān ।
viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ viśaśramuḥ sarvaṃ niśi prage ।। 95।।
snātvā harirjanānāha ṛṣīn devādikāँstathā ।
caturthayajñakāryārthaṃ yāntu sarve'pi vai drutam ।।96।।
ālanaukābdhisaṃyoge śaktyakṣibhūparājyake ।
kārayantu yogyatāṃ ca prārambhasya kratordrutam ।।97।।
ekādaśyāṃ vayaṃ prātaścāgamiṣyāma eva tu ।
ityājñaptāśca hariṇā devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।।98।।
yayuḥ sarve yājñikāśca ālanaukā'bdhisaṃgamam ।
bālakṛṣṇo vīrajārālaye tasyau tadarthitaḥ ।। 99 ।।
rājñībhiśca tathā rājñā kumārādyaiḥ prasevitaḥ ।
hariḥ kuṭumbasahitaḥ sukhaṃ tasthau mano vidan ।। 2.128.100 ।।
rājā tu nijakanyānāṃ śataṃ kṛṣṇe vimohitam ।
jñātvā rājñyabhimatyā ca dadau kṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ ।। 101 ।।
kanyāśataṃ patiṃ prāpya tadā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadā jātaṃ rājādyāḥ sukhino'bhavan ।। 1 02।।
rājñyaḥ sarvāśca vai kṛṣṇaṃ jāmātāraṃ tadā''pya ca ।
kṛtakṛtyāḥ sadā mene puṇyapātrāṇi rādhike! ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vīrajāranṛparājye obīrātrīśāsaṃgame tṛtīyaviṣṇuyāgakaraṇaṃ, mantrādidānaṃ, tīrthamāhātmyaṃ, cetinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭā-
viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 128 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 128 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 129
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 130 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatrāścaryaṃ nṛpagṛhe'bhavat ।
kaścid rājā vyomamārgānmukuṭena virājitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmasaṃśobhitacaturbhujaḥ ।
sudivyabhālatilakaścandanārjitabindukaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vahniśuddhāmbaro mālāṃ tolasīṃ svakare dadhan ।
svarṇavarṇaḥ prasannāsyaḥ kaṭyāṃ kṛpāṇarājitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājaveṣadharaścānyairbahubhirnijasadṛśaiḥ ।
chatracāmarayuktaśca jayaśabdairvivardhitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo jayatvatra tadbhakto'yaṃ jayatvapi ।
tasyāśritānāṃ cāsmākaṃ vijayo'dya pade pade ।। 5 ।।
aho pātraṃ parabrahma dātā vīrajaraḥ svayam ।
yatpratāpotthapuṇyena caturbhujatvamuttamam ।। 6 ।।
prāpto'yaṃ nṛpatiścātra vayaṃ bhṛtyāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ ।
śubhaṃ rājan vīrajāra! kṛtavān jīva śāśvataḥ ।। 7 ।।
ityuktvā nṛpaveṣaḥ sa praṇanāma hariṃ muhuḥ ।
anye praṇemuḥ sarve vai bhṛtyāste ca caturbhujāḥ ।। 8 ।।
śrīhareścaraṇau spṛṣṭvā nidadhurnijamūrdhasu ।
jalaṃ prāsādikaṃ kṛtvā pādaprakṣālanottaram ।। 9 ।।
papuste rādhike sarve jaya kṛṣṇetikīrtanāḥ ।
pupūjurdivyahārādyaiḥ śrīsvāmiśrīrameśvaram ।। 1.129.1 0।।
tāvat tatra sthitā rādhe vīrajārādayaḥ khalu ।
bālakṛṣṇanivāse te kanyādyā api sarvaśaḥ ।। 11 ।।
rājñyaśca rājabhṛtyāśca paramānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
āścaryamatulaṃ prāptā jijñāsāṃ cakrire tadā ।। 1 2।।
ko'yaṃ kasmāt samāyāto rājā cāpi caturbhujaḥ ।
kurmo'tra svāgataṃ tasyetyuktvā siṃhāsanaṃ daduḥ ।। 13 ।।
arghyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭavāri ca ।
tāmbūlakaṃ ca sanmānaṃ cakrire tu yathocitam ।। 14।।
jagṛhuste'tibhāvena prasannā''śiḥ parāyaṇāḥ ।
śrīharirmaunabhāvaṃ ca vihāya kuśalādikam ।। 15।।
apṛcchattaṃ divyabhaktaṃ mumoda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
tadā rājā vīrajāraḥ samapṛcchaddhariṃ tadā ।। 16 ।।
mahābhāgavatāśceme mahārājānugā api ।
kuta āyānti bhagavan vayaṃ jijñāsavo yataḥ ।। 17।।
kva rājyaṃ kva ca bhūreṣāṃ kathaṃ khyātāḥ kimarthakāḥ ।
asmabhyastava sevāyāṃ raktebhyo dehi vedanam ।। 18।।
ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇastvāha taṃ bhūbhṛtaṃ tadā ।
vada rājan svavṛttāntaṃ jijñāsubhyo yathārthakam ।। 1 9।।
ityājñāṃ tatra saṃprāpya prasannaḥ sannarādhipaḥ ।
tatsarvebhyo'kathayacca vṛttāntaṃ śṛṇu rādhike ।।1.129.2 0।।
ahaṃ rājā śūrajārābhidho'trā''saṃ narādhipaḥ ।
vīrajārapitā caite mantriṇo me'bhavaँstadā ।।2 1।।
rājyaṃ dharmeṇa kṛtavān prajārakṣākaraḥ sadā ।
prajānāṃ sevako bhūtvā'karavaṃ rāṣṭrapālanam ।।22।।
dānapuṇye'karavaṃ ca svargade sukhapūrite ।
anāthādīnarakṣaṃ ca satre'bhojayamanvaham ।।23।।
sādhūnapūjayaṃ pitṝn atithīnārcayaṃ sadā ।
asevayaṃ gavādīṃśca prajāścā'toṣayaṃ muhuḥ ।।24।।
vṛkṣānavāpayaṃ śreṣṭhān prajānānupakāriṇaḥ ।
varṣe varṣe gatavatsarasyā'nnaṃ śiṣyate yadi ।।25।।
pākottaraṃ ca tatsarvamarthibhyaścārpitaṃ mayā ।
viprāḥ saṃbhojitā nityaṃ satyaścātīva pūjitāḥ ।।26।।
sakṛtā grāmadevādyāḥ satkṛtāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
ārtānāmārttināśaṃ cā'karavaṃ vastudānakaiḥ ।।27।।
rogiṇāmoṣadhadānāt svāsthyaṃ cā'karavaṃ sukham ।
gṛhadānaṃ hastidānaṃ kṣetradānādikaṃ tathā ।। 28।।
sarvaṃ cā'karavaṃ cā'rocayaṃ yadyacchubhārthanam ।
tena puṇyena rājyaṃ ca kṛtvā nidhāya putrake ।। 29।।
nidhanaṃ prāpya rājñīṃ svāṃ vihāyā'haṃ divaṃ gataḥ ।
tatra sūryasya loke'haṃ nivasāmi samujjvalaḥ ।।1.129.3 0।।
hiraṇyadevajātīyaḥ sarvasaukhyasamanvitaḥ ।
ime puṇyakriyāsveva bhṛtyā āsanpurā mama ।।3 1 ।।
dharmakāryasahāyāste mṛtvā svargaṃ mamā''gatāḥ ।
hiraṇyajātijā devā vartante te mayā saha ।।3 2।।
tatrāpi mama rājyaṃ vai vartate bahuyojanam ।
ime pradhānā me santi mantriṇastatra kecana ।। 33।।
bhṛtyāḥ kecana dūtāśca santi sarve prabhākare ।
sukhinaḥ sukharūpāśca mahānandapariplutāḥ ।। 34।।
asmābhistatra devādidvārā yajñaḥ śruto'tra vai ।
putreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ śreṣṭho nirvartitaḥ surādibhiḥ ।।35।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
samāyāto'sti bhagavān lokakalyāṇahetave ।। 36।।।
tasmai devādhidevāya sarvā'dhipataye'dya vai ।
mama putreṇa vai dattāḥ pūjāyāṃ śatakanyakāḥ ।।37।।
taddānena kuṭumbaṃ me pāvanaṃ divyatāṃ gatam ।
vayaṃ svargasthitāḥ sarve kanyādānasya puṇyataḥ ।।38।।
vilīya dvibhujāḥ sarve caturbhujāḥ sma eva tu ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ pārṣadāścā'dya sañjātā dhāmayoginaḥ ।।39।।
viṣṇutulyasvarūpāśca viṣṇordhāmagamāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sarvaiśvaryasamāpannāḥ koṭisūryādhitejasaḥ ।।1.129.40।।
mokṣosmākaṃ suputreṇa kṛto'sti kanyakā'rpaṇāt ।
kanyādānaṃ śubhe pātre tīrthe śatakulādhikam ।।41।।
tārayatyeva pitṝṇāṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭameva yat ।
tasmāccaturbhujā bhūtvā kṛtvā ca haridarśanam ।।42।।
prayāsyāmo harerdhāma divyaṃ tvakṣarasaṃjñakam!
etatkathayituṃ tvatrā''gatāḥ sūryagṛhā vayam ।।43।।
śrīharerdarśanaṃ kartuṃ bhoktuṃ prasādamityapi ।
ājñāṃ prāptuṃ ca taddhāma yācituṃ prasamāgatāḥ ।।44।।
ityuktvā ca viremuste hariḥ prāsādikaṃ dadau ।
kanyādyā divyarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā naijaṃ pitāmaham ।।45।।
susaṃhṛṣṭā praṇemuśca prasādaṃ pradadau hariḥ ।
bubhujuste hṛṣṭahṛdaḥ papuśca caraṇāmṛtam ।।46।।
śrīharirvai tataḥ prāha śūrajārādikāँstadā ।
mama bhaktāḥ sāttvatā vai prayānti dhāma me śubham ।।47।।
mantraṃ gṛhī vā yogyāste gantuṃ bhavanti tatra vai ।
nānyathā saṃpraveśo'sti mama dhāmni kathaṃcana ।।48।।
ityuktā jagṛhurmantrān bālakṛṣṇānanāttadā ।
'o namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।49।।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।
kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।।1.129.50 ।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ।
'parabrahmā'kṣarātīto bālakṛṣṇaḥ patirmama' ।।51।।
brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।।52।।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।।53।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
etān mantrān dadau tebhyaḥ śrīsvāmī śrīrameśvaraḥ ।। 54।।
tataste'kṣaramuktāśca gantuṃ yogyāstato'bhavan ।
atha rājā vīrajārastatkuṭumbaṃ piteti ca ।।55।।
vijñāya pūjanaṃ cakre tasya kṣamām parārthayat ।
atha rājñī rājamātā nāmnā devavarūthinī ।।56।।
vṛddhā jñātvā patiṃ muktaṃ divyaṃ yātuṃ tathā'kṣaram ।
vavande caraṇau tatra patyuḥ pativratā satī ।।57।।
mumocā'śrūṇi vidhavā gantuṃ saha manomatī ।
uvāca praśrayā bhūtvā kiṃ me pāpaṃ yadatra ca ।।58।।
tiṣṭhāmi vidhavā dehe naya māṃ saha bhūpate ।
yadgṛhe bhagavān sākṣājjāmātā nanu vartate ।
tasya puṇyasya pāraṃ na tanmātā'haṃ tava priyā ।।59।।
kathaṃ vṛddhā divyamuktā na bhavāmi yathā patiḥ ।
tasmād rājan madarthaṃ tvaṃ yācanāṃ kuru śāśvatīm ।।1.129.60।।
yathā muktiṃ saha yāmi tathā tvaṃ kuru satvaram ।
śrutvā śūrapatiḥ rājā yayāce śrīhariṃ tadā ।।61 ।।
patitvā daṇḍavattatra rājñyarthaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣayā ।
bhagavān śrīhariḥ prāha rājan manorathastava ।। 62।।
tathā rājñyāśca saṃkalpaḥ siddha eva na saṃśayaḥ ।
māse'smin pauṣasaṃjñe vai yajñakāryāṇi santi tu ।।63।।
tāni dṛṣṭvā tato yāyād rājñī te dhāma me'kṣaram ।
tāvaddarśanalābhārthaṃ tiṣṭhatvatra priyā tava ।।64।।
pauṣaśuklasya pūrṇāyāṃ rājñī dhāmākṣaraṃ mama ।
yātu vimānamārūḍhā mama pārṣadasevitā ।।65।।
bhavāँścaturbhujastvatra mukhaiḥ saha sthiro'stu ca ।
pūrṇimāyāṃ tvayā rājñīṃ saha nītvā caturbhujām ।।66।।
gantavyaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma mama mantraiḥ pariplutām ।
ityuktvā rādhike svāmī bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tadā ।।67।।
kṛpayā pradadau rājñyai mantrān divyatvalabdhaye ।
rājñī bhautikadehā'pi tadā divyā vyajāyata ।।।68।।
yathā caturbhujo rājā tathā sā'pi caturbhujā ।
vaikuṇṭhavāsayogyā sā yathā rājā tathā'bhavat ।।69।।
rādhike! mantradāne'pi caturmujāstu pūrṇimām ।
avadhīkṛtya loke'tra sthāsyantyeva harīcchayā ।।1.129.70।।
pūrṇimāyāṃ yadā te tu gamiṣyantyakṣaraṃ padam ।
tadā te dvikarā bhūtvā'kṣaramuktasamāḥ śubhāḥ ।।71।।
yāsyanti paramaṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ śrīsvāminaḥ sukhāt ।
evaṃ śūraṃ śūradevīṃ śūrṛbhatyān hariḥ svayam ।।72।।
sthātumājñāpya yajñārthaṃ bhojayāmāsa cāmṛtam ।
pāyayāmāsa ca pādajalaṃ puṇyaṃ harirnijam ।।73।।
vāsayāmāsa ca nije prāsāde śūrajārakam ।
bodhayāmāsa vividhairvacanairmokṣadāyakaiḥ ।।74।।
rājan yatra naro nārī tatra saṃsāravāsanā ।
rājan yatra hariścā'haṃ tatrā'kṣarasya bhāvanā ।।75।।
rājan yatra sādhavo me tatrā'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
yatra brahmapriyā me ca tatrā'kṣaraṃ padaṃ mama ।।76।।
māyā'pi divyatāṃ yāti mama yogena sarvathā ।
muktā cā'kṣararūpā syāttadanyasya tu kā kathā ।।77।।
imāḥ pautryaśca te sarvā dṛśyante yadyapi striyaḥ ।
bhūtadehavikāriṇyastathāpi mama yogataḥ ।।।78।।
muktāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti matsvarūpā vimāyikāḥ ।
māṃ bhajitvā purā rājan bahvyo vai divyatāṃ gatāḥ ।।79।।
nāryo yathā tathā muktā vyajāyanta narā api ।
mama yogena bahavo'bhavannarā narāyaṇāḥ ।।1.129.80 ।।
nārāyaṇāśca bahavo'bhavannārāyaṇā api ।
nārāyaṇāśca bahavo'bhavan vai pumuttamāstathā ।।8 1।।
pumuttamāśca bahavo'bhavan vai puruṣottamāḥ ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñāste puruṣottamaśāsane ।।82।।
vartante dhāmni puruṣottamabhaktāstadanvitāḥ ।
puruṣottamasadṛśā guṇairdharmaiśca śaktibhiḥ ।।83।।
aiśvaryaiḥ rūpavibhavaistataste puruṣottamāḥ ।
ahameṣāṃ ca puruṣottamānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।।84।।
niyāmako hi sarveṣāṃ tat puruṣottamottamaḥ ।
nāsti me sadṛśaḥ kaścitparasyaiva tu kā kathā ।।85।।
tādṛśo'haṃ tava rājye prāpto'smi te sutasya vai ।
satyaṃ rājyaṃ mama rājyaṃ na pṛthivyā mṛṣā hi tat ।।86।।
satyānando mahānando na māyāyā mṛṣā hi saḥ ।
satyaṃ sukhaṃ sukhaṃ me'tra na bhautikaṃ mṛṣā yataḥ ।।87।।
kuṭumbaṃ satyamevā'haṃ daihikaṃ na mṛṣā yataḥ ।
kāryaṃ nāmnā vikṛtaṃ ca madyoge vikṛtaṃ na tat ।।88।।
mṛṣā nāmnā cā'nṛtaṃ ca madyoge nā'nṛtaṃ hi tat ।
asthiraṃ ca vinā māṃ yat susthitaṃ madyutaṃ tu tat ।।89।।।
madriktaṃ parihāryaṃ ca madyuktaṃ grāhyameva tat ।
māṃ vinā śūnyamanyad yat madyuktaṃ bharapūrakam ।।1.129.90।।
māṃ vinā pralayaḥ sarvo madyuktaḥ samṛddhāyate ।
madvinā kalmaṣaṃ yacca tanmadyuktaṃ tu mādṛśam ।।9 1।।
madbhaktā mādṛśāḥ sarve tasmātte puruṣottamāḥ ।
ityevaṃ māṃ viditvaiva bhaja māṃ bhava tādṛśaḥ ।। 92।।
ityuktvā śrīhariḥ śūrajārāya nijadarśanam ।
dadau tatraiva puruṣottamānāṃ puruṣottamam ।।93।।
divyadṛṣṭyā śūrajāro vilokya parameśvaram ।
anantaparameśādyaiḥ sevitaṃ puruṣottamam ।।94।।
mumude mahimānaṃ ca viveda śrīharestadā ।
tato harirdivyabhāvaṃ tirobhāvya manuṣyavat ।।95।।
abhavat kṣaṇamātreṇa prasannaḥ prāha vīrakam ।
viśrāntiṃ labha rājendra gantavyaṃ vai prage drutam ।।96।।
ekādaśyāṃ caturthasya yaśasyā'rthebdhisaṃgamam ।
pauṣe kṛṣṇe dale caikādaśyāṃ prārabhya taṃ kratum ।।97।।
pauṣe śukle dvitīyāyāṃ kariṣye pūrṇameva ca ।
ityukto vīrajāraśca śūrajārastathā'pare ।।98।।
viśaśramuḥ sukhenaiva viśaśrāma haristathā ।
rātrau suṣvāpa bhagavān kanyābhiḥ sevito hariḥ ।।99।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage śīghraṃ samutthāya kṛtārcanaḥ ।
svastho bhūtvā vimānena rājakuṭumbasevitaḥ ।। 1.129.10 0।।
mātāpitṛyutaścāpi prajābhiścābhivardhitaḥ ।
yayau śaktyakṣinṛpateḥ rājye yajñakṣitau kṣaṇāt ।। 101 ।।
ālanaukā'bdhisaṃyoge viśālaṃ bhūtalaṃ tadā ।
bhrāmayitvā vimāne cāmbare vyalokayat muhuḥ ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vīrajāranṛpateḥ pitre śūrajāramahārājāya divyadevarūpāya sakuṭumbāya hiraṇyapuruṣātmikāyā'kṣarayogyadivya-
dehādyarpaṇādinā muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā navaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 129 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 129 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 130
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 131 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! vyomni śaktyakṣinṛpateḥ kṣiteḥ ।
viśālaṃ bhūtalaṃ yajñakṛte vīkṣya susaṃskṛtam ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī pumuttamaḥ ।
ālanaukānadīpārśve paścime'nāvarāvadhim ।। 2 ।।
uttare'bdhitaṭaṃ yāvat pañcāśat krośabhūtale ।
vilokya maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ vimānaṃ samatārayat ।। 3 ।।
prakāśaḥ koṭisūryāṇāṃ tadā vyomnyabhavat sitaḥ ।
jayaśabdāḥ kīrtanāni harṣanādāstadā'bhavan ।। 4 ।।
vetrabandīstavanāni jayakāraiḥ sahā'bhavan ।
vāditrāṇi vividhānyāvādyanta paritastadā ।। 5 ।।
samutsāhabharāḥ sarve dudruvustadvimānakam ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prabhuṃ draṣṭuṃ vardhayituṃ sumādibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
satkartuṃ puṣpahārādyaiḥ rājā ca janatā yayuḥ ।
narā nāryo'tisammarde'vatarantaṃ vimānataḥ ।। 7 ।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prasannāsyaṃ vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
lājābhiścā'kṣataiḥ puṣpaiḥ svāgataṃ vidadhurmudā ।। 8 ।।
atha śrībhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapumuttamaḥ ।
yayau snātuṃ saṃgame ca samudre ca tataḥ param ।। 9 ।।
śīghramāgatya ca yajñe madhye pratīkṣatāṃ satām ।
svarṇāsane nṛpeṇā'bhyarpite vyarājata prabhuḥ ।। 2.130.10।।
ṛṣayo lomaśādyāśca brahmendrādyāḥ sureśvarāḥ ।
patnīvratādyā viprāścā muktā nārāyaṇāstathā ।। 11 ।।
gaṇeśādyā yajñadevā devyaśca mātarastathā ।
sarvasṛṣṭisurādyāśca vyarājanta sumaṇḍape ।। 12।।
svastivāco dehaśuddhiḥ prakoṣṭhabandhanādikam ।
aṃgadevapratiṣṭhānaṃ mukhyadevādhivāsanam ।। 13।।
vahnyādhānaṃ havanādi yathāpūrvakratau tathā ।
vedaghoṣā gītayaśca vyajāyanta vidhikramāt। ।। 14।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
havyaṃ rājñā'rpitaṃ dravyaiścāgnyānano bhunakti saḥ ।। 15 ।।
saptāhaḥ sa ṛturjāto vaiṣṇavo yatra dehinaḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāsā vai tṛptāḥ pratyakṣabhojinaḥ ।। 16।।
muktā īśā avatārā īśvarāṇyaḥ surādayaḥ ।
surāṇyo devadevyaśca dikpālalokapālinaḥ ।। 17।।
yajñadevā lokadevāḥ kṣetrādidevatāstathā ।
mānavā vāyulokasthā jalasthāstalagā api ।। 18।।
pādapā vāyupāścāpi śaityapāḥ prāṇinastathā ।
tīrthāni santaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro daityadānavāḥ ।। 19।।
rakṣāṃsi tāmasāścāpi jīvāḥ sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ ।
tṛptā jātā havyamiṣṭaistathā miṣṭānnabhojanaiḥ ।।2.130.20 ।।
nyūnaṃ tatra ca naivā'sti kalpadrumaṇivallibhiḥ ।
samutthabhakṣyabhojyādi kāmadhenupayāṃsi ca ।।21 ।।
dakṣiṇāḥ samavartanta bhūyasyaḥ svarṇaratnajāḥ ।
annavastravibhūṣāṇāṃ dānāni nā'ntavanti vai ।।22।।
dattāni tatra śaktyakṣinṛpeṇa harisannidhau ।
parihāraśca saptāhe dvitīyāyāṃ kṛtastataḥ ।।23।।
avabhṛthaṃ ca madhyānte kṛtaṃ cā'bdhau samāgame ।
ālanaukājalamiśre'nāvarābdhijale'pi ca ।।24।।
anāvarāyāṃ nadyāṃ ca ālanaukāsarityapi ।
tadā dānāni hastīnāmaśvānāmuṣṭragogavām ।।25।।
yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca kṣetravāṭibhuvāṃ tathā ।
rājñā dattāni viprebhyo gṛhāṇāmṛddhisaṃyujām ।।26।।
kanyādānāni dīnebhyo bhojyadānāni vai tadā ।
svarṇarūpyakabhūṣāṇāṃ dattāni dānakāni ca ।। 27।।
devāyatanako bhakto mahimānaṃ jagāda ca ।
avabhṛthasya sarvebhyaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! śubham ।।28।।
avatīrya kratuṃ sarvaṃ nirvighnaṃ yena pūrṇatā ।
karmaṇā cāntimenā'sti saṃbhṛtiḥ sā bhṛthātmikā ।।29।।
yajñe nyūnaṃ kramatyāgo jantūnāṃ pīḍanādikam ।
durītaṃ yatra vai snāne sarvaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham ।। 2.130.30 ।।
aśuddhijaṃ ca vāgjātaṃ dehajaṃ mānasaṃ ca vā ।
pāpaṃ tu yatra vai snāne sarvaṃ naśyati tadbhṛtham ।। 31 ।।
mantrāṇāṃ vai samuccāre havyadāne'pi vai kratau ।
lobhādijaṃ ca yatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ naśyati tad bhayam ।। 32 ।।
āśāvatāṃ jalānnādyairdakṣiṇābhiratoṣaṇam ।
manāg vā cā'ṇumātraṃ vā pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham ।। 33 ।।
samitprajvālane janturvahnāvākasmikaḥ patet ।
sūkṣmo'pi kāṣṭhasaṃvāsaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham ।। 34। ।
pātrāṇāṃ cāpi havyānāṃ saṃskṛtau yadi śuddhatā ।
pūrṇā na syācca tatpāpaṃ naśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham ।। 35।।
devānāṃ yadbhavediṣṭatamaṃ tanmilitaṃ na cet ।
havane sā kṣatiḥ pāpaṃ naśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham ।। 36।।
bījānāmaṅkurārhāṇāṃ vahnau yā dagdhatā tu sā ।
bījaghātātmakaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatyeveti tad bhṛtham ।। 37।।
gṛdhrādipakṣiṇāṃ cañcvāḥ patitaṃ vyomato'pi ca ।
aśuddhaṃ vā'nyadevā'pi pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham । । 38 ।।
asaṃkhyānāṃ tu devānāmāvāhane kvacit kratau ।
anupasthitaniḥśvāsaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham ।। 39 ।।
mantroccāraṇakāle'pi svaraiḥ sākaṃ mukhānnanu ।
thūkakaṇā utpatanti pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham । ।2.130.40 ।।
kāmakrodhādiyuktānāṃ viprāṇāṃ varaṇe kratau ।
saṃsargajaṃ vā pāpaṃ tannaśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham ।।4 1 ।।
yajamānasya cintāyāṃ duḥsvapnaṃ vā samāpatet ।
rogo vā sūtakaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham ।।42।।।
abhīṣṭavyayataścogre vyaye'kasmādupasthite ।
saṃkocavyayajaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham । ।43 ।।
yajñe vighnasya kartṝṇāṃ vināśanaṃ bhavet kvacit ।
hiṃsanaṃ tattadā pāpaṃ naśyatyeva ca tad bhṛtham ।।44।।
prāyaścittādigauṇatvaṃ brahmacaryādigauṇatā ।
karmakāṇḍādigauṇatvaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati tad bhṛtham ।।45 ।।
yajñe nityaṃ pratiyajñaṃ tadaṃgādiṣu vai pṛthak ।
puṇyamutpadyate yattat militvā puṇyaparvataḥ । ।46 ।।
jāyate yajamāne vai cet kṣatirnāśanaṃ bhṛtham ।
kvacit kālaprabhāveṇa nānukūlyaṃ kratau tu yat ।।47 ।।
tajjaṃ pāpaṃ kratau jāte naśyatyeva tu tad bhṛtham ।
devānāmavamānādi hyajānatā bhaved yadi । ।48 । ।
pūjyānāmavamānādi jānatā'pi bhaved yadi ।
apūjyapūjyatāpāpaṃ naśyatyeva tu tad bhṛtham ।।49।।
varuṇaḥ sarvadā sākṣī jalādhidevarūpakaḥ ।
svarge sampatpradaḥ syāt sa nārāyaṇātmako bhṛtham ।।2.130.5 0 ।।
yajamāne sarvadevā yajamānyāṃ ca devikāḥ ।
snānakāle vasantyeva tīrthaṃ sarvātmakaṃ bhṛtham ।।5 1 ।।
ācārye śrīharistvāste yājñikeṣvavatārakāḥ ।
ṛtvikṣu ceśvarāḥ santi tīrthaṃ sarvātmakaṃ bhṛtham ।। 52।।
jāpakeṣu ca tīrthāni tattvāni karmacāriṣu ।
sāhāyyeṣu ca ṛṣayastīrthaṃ sarvātmakaṃ bhṛtham ।।53 । ।
yavāṃkurāḥ pradātavyā varuṇāya mahātmane ।
ghṛtādyaṃgapaṃcakaṃ ca dātavyaṃ salile tadā ।।54।।
pañcāmṛtāni dattāni labhyante divi vai punaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjanīyo jaleśvaraḥ ।।55।।
tatra nārāyaṇaścāste'kṣareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
jale snānaṃ harau snānaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ prapuṇyadam ।।56।।
yatra yajñaścānnasatraṃ pārāyaṇaṃ kathāmṛtam ।
avabhṛthaṃ cāplavanaṃ tattīrthaṃ śāśvataṃ matam ।।57।।
nadā nadyastaṭākāni sarāṃsi dīrghikāstathā ।
akhātāni ca khātāni tīrthānyavabhṛthena vai ।।58।।
avabhathakṣaṇe vāri grāhyaṃ pātreṣu pāvanam ।
antakālerpitaṃ martyamukhe mokṣapradaṃ hi tat। ।।99 ।।
pāpināṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ yajñadevādayaḥ sadā ।
avabhṛthasthale snātvā tatatiṣṭhanti tatra vai ।।2.130.6 0 ।।
mṛtasyāpi tu jāntorvai yasya kasyāpi dehinaḥ ।
asthipatrāṃgabhāgo'lpaḥ patitaścedavabhṛthe ।।6 1 ।।
sa yāti paralokasthaḥ preto vā yāmyalokagaḥ ।
asadgatiṃ tato vāpi śrīharerdhāma śāśvatam ।।62।।।
asatkarmāṇi naśyanti jāyante puṇyaparvatāḥ ।
avabhṛthasthale snātuḥ paralokāḥ sukhapradāḥ ।।63।।
avabhṛthasthalīloke māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇapratimāśca trayo mokṣapradottamāḥ ।।64।।
sādhavo vaiṣṇavā loke sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāstisro mūrtayo hareḥ ।।656।।
brahmapriyā brahmamuktā brahmakuṃkumavāpikā ।
trayaste brahmatīrthāni sarvayajñabhṛthāni vai ।।66।।
hṛdaye sarvadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saṃsmṛtiḥ ।
kare tu taulasī mālā kaṇṭhe sragapi taulasī ।।67।।
prasādamātragrahaṇaṃ trayaste'kṣaradhāmadāḥ ।
lalāṭe tilakaṃ candraḥ bāhvoścakrādilekhanam ।।68।।
jihvāyāṃ śrīharernāma trayaste yāmyanāśakāḥ ।
gṛhe tu vaiṣṇavā yasya vāṭikāyāṃ tu tūlasī ।।69।।
paśuṣvapi ca gauryasya trināvo bhavapāragāḥ ।
bhāryā pativratā yasya kṛpā yasya ca sadguroḥ ।।2.130.70।।
śāstrajñānaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ pāragaḥ sa bhavāmbudheḥ ।
yena sarvaṃ harau kṛṣṇe'rpitaṃ varṣma ca daihikam ।।71 ।।
śāntavṛttinirīhaśca trayaṃ nirlepatāpradam ।
rātriryasya harāvāste prātaryasya prapūjane ।।72।।
madhyāhno jñānabhāge ca sa vai mukto'tra sākṛtiḥ ।
satāṃ yogād yajñayogād yogāt pratyakṣaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।।73 ।।
nage nārī nānyataro jāyate'vabhṛthādhikaḥ ।
kratusnānaṃ tilasnānaṃ snānamāmalakīphalaiḥ ।।74।।
smṛtvā tīrthāni kurvīta jāyate'vabhṛthā'dhikam ।
antakāle yajñabhūmistathā nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।75।।
smaryante sādhavaḥ sādhvyastatphalaṃ tu bhṛthādhikam ।
koṭikanyāpradānena sahasrakratubhiśca yat। ।।76।।
annakṣetrasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ tadavabhṛthāt ।
cāturmāsyavrataiścāpi vedādhyayanakaistathā ।।77।।
sahasravarṣatapasā gosahasrapradānakaiḥ ।
yatphalaṃ labhyate bhūmau tatphalaṃ syādavabhṛthāt ।।78।।
yātrābhiḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ piturmātuśca sevayā ।
patyuśca sevayā gavāṃ sevayā devasevayā ।।79।।
daivikṣetranivāsena tulasīsevayā tathā ।
yatphalaṃ labhyate tatsyāt sādhoścaraṇasevayā ।।2.130.80 ।।
buddhyā hīno naro nārī kathāṃ śrutvā hariṃ bhajet ।
sādhuṃ seveta satataṃ mokṣo'pi tadbalād bhavet ।।8 1 ।।
yasyā'gre nāsti vai dravyaṃ kṣetraṃ vā vāṭikā'pi vā ।
jīvanaṃ śramamātreṇa bhṛtyadāsyādibhistathā ।।82।।
tena vai mandiraṃ sevyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
mārjanena ca lepena jalaprakṣālanena ca ।।83।।
kaccarādyapahāreṇa puṣpamālākalādibhiḥ ।
śilpanena ca vastrādikṣālanena nirantaram ।।84।।
pātrāṇāṃ mañjanenāpi bhittikāgharṣaṇena ca ।
lutājālā'pahāreṇa rajoniṣkāsanena ca ।।85।।
vyavasthayā ca vastūnāṃ catvare dīpakarmaṇā ।
dvāroddhāṭanakāryeṇa vāditranādanena ca ।।86।।
kīrtanena ca tālādyairguṇānāṃ kathanena ca ।
jayaśabdairhare śabdairbhajanairmālikādibhiḥ ।।87।।
pātrāṇāmānayanaiśca dhānyānāṃ śuddhibhistathā ।
jalānāṃ cā''haraṇaiśca stavanaiśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ ।।88।।
daṇḍavadbhirnamaskārairguṇānāṃ grahaṇaistathā ।
bhāvaiḥ premabharairdivyairmanorañjanakāryakaiḥ ।।89।।
mṛttikā''nayanaiścāpi sevyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamandiram ।
nāryā nareṇa vā nānyatareṇāpi yathāmati ।।2.130.90 ।।
yathābalaṃ yathāsādhyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ bhavettu yat ।
tattathā sevanaṃ kāryaṃ mandirasya satāmapi ।।9 1।।
ityevaṃ sevako yastu dāso bhāgavato mahān ।
sarvāvabhṛthataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pāvano vartate hi saḥ ।।92।।
avabhṛthe tadetyevaṃ devāyatanako muniḥ ।
upadiśya virarāma tataḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 93।।
prāha cāsmi prasanno'tra kratau rājñā'rpitaṃ bahu ।
sevayā ca prasanno'smi jayatvatra sadā nṛpaḥ ।। 94।।
tato rājā parameśaṃ śrīhariṃ caraṇe'patat ।
hariṇā'rpita evā'sya kaṇṭhe hāraḥ suvarṇajaḥ ।।95।।
rājñā prāghūṇikāḥ sarve pūjitā upadādibhiḥ ।
āśīrvādān samagṛhya parihāraṃ tato'karot ।।96।।
āyayurnijavāseṣu viśaśramuḥ kṣaṇaṃ janāḥ ।
rājā saṃbhojayāmāsa sṛṣṭitrayasya dehinaḥ ।।97।।
dakṣiṇāśca dadau tatra tutuṣuḥ sarvadehinaḥ ।
rātrau mahotsavaṃ lokā devarṣayaśca cakrire ।।98।।
rāsakīrtananṛtyaiśca bhagavattoṣaṇāya vai ।
tato nidrāṃ gatāḥ prātaḥ samutthāya ca naityakam ।। 99।।
kṛtvā tatra sabhāyāṃ cāgatāḥ śrīhariṇā tadā ।
pūjitā devatādyāścā'mūlyopadāsamarpaṇaiḥ ।। 2.130.100 ।।
tataḥ saṃbhojitāḥ sarvaṃ ājñaptā hariṇā tataḥ ।
kartuṃ tu pañcamaṃ yajñaṃ gantavyaṃ sāyameva ha ।। 101 ।।
kālimā'bdhitaṭe deśe kālimānṛpateḥ kṣitau ।
pañcamyāṃ pauṣaśuklasya yajñāraṃbho bhaviṣyati ।। 1 02।।
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra caturthyāṃ sāyameva ca ।
ityuktvā bhagavān lokān mumukṣūn pradadau manūn ।। 1 03।।
narān nārīrnānyatarān mumukṣūn śaktirājyagān ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 1 04।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।। 1 05।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।। 1 06।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 1 07।।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako'stu saḥ' ।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmīṃ śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।। 1 08।।
ityetebhyo dadau mantrān mumukṣubhyaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।
atha sarve yayustatrājñaptā vai pañcamakratoḥ ।। 1 09।।
yajñārthaṃ kālimāśasya rājye kālīsarittaṭe ।
śrīhariṃ rādhike! tatra śaktyakṣibhūpasevitaḥ ।। 2.130.110 ।।
dinadvayaṃ samuvāsā nandayan nṛpamutsukam ।
jñānaṃ dadau nṛpādibhyaḥ kṛpayā vallabhaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 11 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śaktyakṣinṛpateḥ rājye caturthaviṣṇuyāgakaraṇamavabhṛthārthasphuṭatāmahimādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 130 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 130 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 131
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 132 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhuvaḥpatim ।
śaktyakṣināmakaṃ prāha tṛtīyāyāṃ prage hitam ।। 1 ।।
yajñastvayā kṛtaḥ samyak toṣitāḥ sarvadehinaḥ ।
tuṣṭo'haṃ śrīhariḥ sākṣāt toṣaṇīyaṃ na śiṣyate ।। 2 ।।
santuṣṭe śrīharau kṛṣṇe tuṣṭā bhavanti dehinaḥ ।
sarvāntarātmā bhagavān santuṣyāmi hṛdi sthitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vada te vāñcchitaṃ cātra dadāmi cottamottamam ।
bhaktyā te'smi prasanno'haṃ dadāmi manasepsitam ।। 4 ।।
ityukto bhūpatiḥ prāha sadā'tra mandire vasa ।
kāraye'haṃ suvarṇānāṃ mandiraṃ kānakaṃ śubham ।। 5 ।।
tatra tvaṃ pratimāprakhyo vasa me śreyase sadā ।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stvevaṃ nivatsye mandire tava ।। 6 ।।
mūrtiṃ me ramaṇīyāṃ vai tatra sthāpaya kānakīm ।
rādhālakṣmīramābrahmavidyāśrīmāṇikīyutām ।। 7 ।।
vāsaṃ kurvan sadā mūrtau grahiṣye sevanādikam ।
sākṣād yathā tathā tatra tava snehaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 8 ।।
yathā varte sadā hṛtsu janānāmantarātmakaḥ ।
tathā mūrtau cāntarātmā nivatsye gocaro yathā ।। 9 ।।
yathā'kṣare mahākṣetre dhāmni cā'kṣarasaṃjñake ।
yathā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca bhaviṣyāmyatra gocaraḥ ।। 2.131.1 0।।
mūrtirme'ntaryāmiṇo yā sā divyā sevanārthikā ।
bhaktecchādhīnasāmarthyā śreyase jagatāṃ matā ।। 1 1।।
yuge'tra prathame mūrtiṃ saptatālasamocchrayām ।
yathā vai mānavā dīrghāstathā me tvaṃ prakāraya ।। 12।।
yugāntareṣu kāleṣu yathā hrāso hi dehinām ।
tathā tanmānasāreṇa mūrtirme teṣu sammatā ।। 13 ।।
yathā vai pūjane yāne vihāre rathavāhane ।
susṛpyā syāttathā kāryā naramānānna cā'dhikā ।। 14।।
naikaṃ mānaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ kālabhedena saṃbhavet ।
saptavitastikāyaḥ svaḥ svasyaiveti vinirṇayaḥ ।। 15।।
yathā dīrgho bhaved dehastathā dīrgho bhaved bhujaḥ ।
bhujavattasya vai dīrghā bhavantyaṅgulikāstadā ।। 16 ।।
aṅgulo'pi tathā dīrghastattaddehānusārataḥ ।
bālye bālyāṅgulo hrasvo yauvane yauvanādivat ।। 17।।
asmyahaṃ cā'dya te gehe mamāṅgulaiḥ pramāpitaḥ ।
sārdhapañcaṣaṣṭibhirvai ūrdhvamānaḥ surūpavān ।। 18।।
svarṇacampakaśuklābhastathā''jānukarā'nvitaḥ ।
ākarṇāntā''yatanetrakoṇavakrabhruvānvitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
sukundakalikātulyadantapaṃktivirājitaḥ ।
viśālabhālatilakaḥ puṣṭisaṃbhṛtavigrahaḥ ।।2.131.20 ।।
viśālonnatavakṣāśca puṣṭasakthyādaśobhitaḥ ।
tathā mūrtirmama rājan kāraṇīyā tvayā śubhā ।।21 ।।
mama pārśve tu vai dakṣe lakṣmīḥ brahmavidyā ramā ।
lakṣmīḥ ṣaṣṭyaṃgulā saptapañcāśat brahmavidyikā ।।22।।
ramātatastṛtīyā vai catuṣpañcāśadaṃgulā ।
prejjvalāḥ svarṇavarṇābhāḥ sarvāḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanāḥ ।। 23 ।।
atha vāme mama pārśve rādhā māṇikī śrīstathā ।
rādhā ṣaṣṭyaṃgulā saptapañcāśanmāṇikī matā ।।24।।
śrīstṛtīyā suśobhāḍhyā catuṣpaṃcāśadaṃgulā ।
mamāṃgulaistā māpanīyāḥ kartavyāścandraśobhitāḥ ।।25।।
surūpāḥ kṛśakaṭyaśca pūjāpātrādihastakāḥ ।
projjvalāḥ svarṇavarṇābhāḥ sarvāḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanāḥ ।।26।।
sarvasaubhāgyaśobhāḍhyāḥ sarvāṃgaparipūrṇikāḥ ।
puṣṭāḥ prasannavadanā dravabhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ।। 27।।
caturbhujo'haṃ madhye ca sthāpanīyastvayā hariḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśrīvatsakaustubhānvitaḥ ।।28।।
rājacihnadharo ramyo yuvā'ṣṭādaśahāyanaḥ ।
sarvacihnāṃgasampūrṇaḥ kāraṇīyo na cā'nyathā ।।29।।
ityevaṃ māṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kuru me madhyamandire ।
pūjanaṃ nityadā rājannatha dakṣe tu mandire ।।2.131.3 0।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dvādaśavarṣaśobhanam ।
pratiṣṭhāpaya me pitrā mātrā ca sahitaṃ tu mām ।।3 1 ।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo'yaṃ pitā me'tra virājate ।
mātā me kaṃbharālakṣmīrvirājate'tra lokaya ।।।32।।
tathā śilpakalādvārā mūrtitrayaṃ prakāraya ।
atha vāme mandire me śayyāṃ kāraya śobhanām ।।33 ।।
svarṇagendukaśobhāḍhyāṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitām ।
hastigaruḍau kāraya madhyamandirasannidhau ।।34।।
agragolasusaudhe vai madhye sthāpaya tau tathā ।
catvare chatrikāmadhye mama vai caraṇau śubhau ।।35।।
pratiṣṭhāpaya rājendra gopure mama pārṣadam ।
devāyatanabhaktaṃ ca bhaktaṃ raṇaṃgamābhidham ।।36।।
sarvaśastrayutau tau ca prakāraya śubhottamau ।
hemantaṃ ca vasantaṃ ca dvārapālau vidhāpaya ।।37।।
svaprakāśaṃ dyuprakāśaṃ sevakau ca prakāraya ।
mandirāgrasukhaṇḍeṣu vijayadhvanikārakān ।।38।।
santoṣāṃ bhagavantaṃ ca śukaṃ ca vallabhaṃ tathā ।
pārśvakhaṇḍe samasthāpayārghapātrayutān śubhān ।।39।।
rāśayo dvādaśaivā'pi mandiropari kāraya ।
ṛṣimūrtipratimāste tāpasā vaiṣṇavāḥ śubhāḥ ।।2.131.40 ।।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ mukhyānāṃ catvāriṃśattathā śatam ।
sarvāsāṃ mama patnīnāṃ narāṇāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak ।।41 ।।
rāsarūpeṇa madhyordhve golasaudhe prakāraya ।
vāditrāṇi samādāya maṇḍalaṃ madhyagaṃ kuru ।।42।।
śilpināṃ vidyayā vāpi caitrāṇāṃ vidyayā'pi vā ।
madhye'haṃ pārśvataḥ patnīcaturviṃśatidviśatam ।।43।।
evaṃ rājan sadā saumyaṃ prakāraya prasevanam ।
tatrā'haṃ gocaraste'tra nivatsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।44।।
atha rājā'ha kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ divyadarśanakāṃkṣayā ।
divyaṃ te darśanaṃ dehi prāsāde sthāpitasya vai ।।45।।
ṣaṭpatnīsahitaṃ ramyaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā karomi hi ।
pitṛmūrtīṃstathā rāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā śayyāṃ karomyapi ।।46।।
ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi rādhike ।
drāgeva darśayāmāsa pratimā mandirāṇi ca ।।47।।
anekakoṭisūryābhastejo vyāptasumūrtikaḥ ।
bhagavān ṣoḍaśavarṣapatnībhiḥ sahitaḥ śubhaḥ ।।48।।
darśayitvā svarūpāṇi divyadhāmagatāni vai ।
rājānaṃ toṣayāmāsa kuṭumbaṃ nṛpatestathā ।।49।।
nṛpakanyāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāstathā śatakumārakāḥ ।
rājñī ca mumuhurdṛṣṭvā pratyakṣaṃ puruṣottamam ।।2.131.50।।
rājā vijñāya kanyānāṃ mānasāni harau tadā ।
ākṛṣṭāni patiprāptyai rājñī vijñāya tattathā ।।5 1 ।।
dadau śrīharaye kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭireva kumārikāḥ ।
tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtakṛtyā vai jātāḥ prāpya hariṃ patim ।।52।।
jāmātāraṃ hariṃ prāpya rājā rājñī mudaṃ gatau ।
menāte kṛtakṛtyau ca viśeṣeṇa tadā punaḥ ।।53 ।।
pūjanaṃ śrīhareścakruḥ kanyakāḥ premavihvalāḥ ।
varamālā hareḥ kaṇṭhe tvarpayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।54।।
bhojanādyairhariṃ tatra sevayāmāsurādarāt ।
rājā'pi yautakaṃ divyaṃ dadāvatarkitaṃ bahu ।।55।।
divyaratnādihārośca koṭyarbudādisaṃkhyakān ।
divyadāsīrdadau cāpi ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāstathottamāḥ ।।56।।
caturdantā gajāḥ śvetā rājñā samarpitāstadā ।
vimānaṃ bahuvegaṃ ca divyaṃ sahasramānavaiḥ ।।57।।
adhiṣṭheyaṃ dadau dāne kanyāvihārahetave ।
śrīhariścaivamāsādya dānaṃ sukhaṃ nyuvāsa ha ।।58।।
caturthīṃ tatra kṛtvaiva sāyaṃ prāha narādhipam ।
sāyaṃ pañcamayajñārthaṃ gantavyaṃ kālimākṣitau ।।59।।
āgaccha sakuṭumbastvaṃ yajñe sākaṃ mayā nṛpa ।
ityukto bhūpatiḥ sajjo babhūva meyabhṛtyakaḥ ।।2.131.6 0।।
jalapānaṃ hariścakre tāvattatra samāyayau ।
piśācyekā śatabhṛtyāsahitā durdaśāṃ gatā ।।6 1 ।।
ruroda bahudhā tatra sannidhau śrīharestadā ।
bhagavān śrīhariḥ prāha kā tvaṃ kasmācca rodiṣi ।।62।।
kiṃ te duḥkhaṃ ca kāḥ sakhyo vada saukhyaṃ karomi te ।
tadā sā lajjayā yuktā novācāpi tu kiṃcana ।।63 ।।
tāvattatra samāyātaḥ śaktyakṣiḥ purato hareḥ ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevaiṣā rurodākrandanaṃ muhuḥ ।।64।।
rājā dṛṣṭvā ca papraccha kā tvaṃ kathaṃ nu rodiṣi ।
sā tadā pūrvajanmīyaṃ rūpaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dadhāra ha ।।65।।
rājño yā bhaginī jyeṣṭhā kanyakā yuvatī mṛtā ।
vāsanāviṣadoṣeṇa piśācītvamupāgatā ।।66।।
samuvāca nṛpaṃ cā'haṃ vinā yajñopavītakam ।
vivāhamantarā rugṇā mṛtā yauvanadarśinī ।।67।।
vāsanāyuktahṛdayā puruṣaṃ prati tṛṣṇayā ।
pretabhāvaṃ gatā śīghraṃ tvaraṇye'tra vasāmi hi ।।68।।
anyāśca kanyakā yā yā vāsanāhṛdayānvitāḥ ।
prāpnuvanti tu maraṇaṃ tā imāḥ santi yoṣitaḥ ।।69।।
piśācinyo hi me sakhyaḥ piśācapatnikāḥ kila ।
piśācāḥ patayo'smākaṃ bhuktvā yajñaprasādakam ।।2.131.70।।
dhūtapāpā gatāḥ muktiṃ svargaṃ vā tatparaṃ padam ।
vayaṃ prasādahīnāśca gṛhe eva sthitā yataḥ ।।7 1 ।।
piśācānāṃ nirodhena yajñe nā'tra samāgatāḥ ।
na prāptaṃ darśanaṃ cāpi kratoḥ prāsādikaṃ hyapi ।।72।।।
piśācītvaṃ tadasmākaṃ na naṣṭaṃ cedṛśe makhe ।
piśācāste gatā muktiṃ śiṣyāmahe'śubhā'balāḥ ।।73।।
abalānāṃ valaṃ nāsti vinā trātāramacyutam ।
apatyapatiśūnyāśca jātāstato'tra cāgatāḥ ।।74।।
mokṣecchayā harekṛṣṇa rājan bhrātaḥ śubhaṃ kuru ।
sā'haṃ te bhaginī cemāḥ prajākanyā mṛtāstu yāḥ ।।75।।
tā vayaṃ devadevasya mokṣārthaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
kurvasmākaṃ mahāmokṣaṃ yathā duḥkhaṃ bhavenna vai ।।76।।
rājā prāha piśācinyaścemā vai kena karmaṇā ।
saṃbhūtā vada me cātra svasaste'stu śubhaṃ tataḥ ।।77।।
svasā prāha ca rājānaṃ śṛṇu piśācikodbhavam ।
yā kanyā nirdayā cāste pitṛgṛhe'tikrodhinī ।।78।।
kalahasyā'tikartrī ca mṛtā syāt sā piśācinī ।
avamanya svajananīṃ svatantrā śīlanāśinī ।।79।।
pāpakarmanimagnā ca mṛtā syāt sā piśācinī ।
pravṛttā guptapāpeṣu puṇyadharmavivarjitā ।।2.131.80।।
mātuḥ sevāparā nāsti nāsti gṛhasya śodhinī ।
kṛṣṇabhaktiparā yā na sā mṛtā syāt piśācinī ।।81 ।।
yathā codvejitā mātā bhaginī bhrātṛbhāminī ।
kalaṃkinaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca sā mṛtā syāt piśācinī ।।82।।
snānapūjāvihīnā ca rājasvalyānvitā tathā ।
aśuddhā paśugamyā ca mṛtā syāt sā piśācinī ।।83 ।।
ātmaghātakarī yā ca yā ca kuṭumbaghātinī ।
pitrādighātinī yā ca sā mṛtā syāt piśācinī ।।84।।
arbhakān yā krodhavaśā tāḍayatyeva vai muhuḥ ।
gṛhe cauryakarī kanyā mṛtā syāt sā piśācinī ।।85।।।
jantūnāṃ mārayitrī yā keśeṣu cāmbareṣu ca ।
jānatyapi ca cullyāṃ yā mṛtā sā syāt piśācinī ।।86।।
mūṣakāṇāṃ viḍālānāṃ ghātinī prāṇināṃ tu vā ।
govatsānāṃ ghātayitrī mṛtā sā syāt piśācinī ।।87।।
mahiṣībālakebhyo yā dugdhaṃ pāyayatīva na ।
tanmātuścāpi takraṃ vā mṛtā sā syāt piśācinī ।।88।।
pakṣiṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca hiṃsikā jīvaghātinī ।
svairiṇī puṃścalī yā ca kāminī gaṇikā tathā ।।89।।
madyamāṃsādanā garbhahantrī syādvai piśācinī ।
jale mṛtā tathā vahnau kṣutpipāsānvitā yadi ।। 2.131.90 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ magnā vivarādau mṛtā sā syāt piśācinī ।
asaṃskṛtā mṛtā yā syādakṣatā vā kṣatā'pi vā ।।9 1 ।।
bhaktihīnā rāgayuktā mṛtā sā syāt piśācinī ।
ityevaṃ doṣayuktā vai imā jātāḥ piśācikāḥ ।।92 ।।
uddhāraṃ kuru rājendra hareḥ prasādadānataḥ ।
yajñastvayā kṛtaścātra kanyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।।93 ।।
tena puṇyena naḥ pāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhāgena bhautikam ।
mānasaṃ tu prasādena nāśameṣyati dehi naḥ ।। 94।।
tato muktiṃ harirdadyāt sarvaprāṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! tābhiścārthito bhūpatiḥ svayam ।।95।।
dadau hareḥ prasādaṃ sa jalaṃ ca pādasaṃspṛśam ।
papustā bhakṣayāmāsuḥ prematastatkṣaṇātkhalu ।।96 ।।
divyarūpāstadā jātā yathā devyaḥ sureśituḥ ।
tāḥ pavitrāḥ kanyakāśca nipetuḥ pādayorhareḥ ।। 97।।
śrīhariśca dayāmagno dadau mantrān nijānanāt ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।98।।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।।99।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava ।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।। 2.131.1 00।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 101 ।।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।। 1 02।।
ityetān pradadau mantrān dadau yajñopavītakam ।
sarvān pradarśya pitrāhīn kuṭumbaṃ ca tadīyakam ।। 103 ।।
tāḥ sarvāḥ śrīhariryāvat sampreṣayati cākṣaram ।
tāvat sarvā harau mugdhā gantuṃ naicchaँstadākṣaram ।। 1 04।।
vihāya sundaraṃ kāntaṃ patiṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
vavrire tā harikṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 1 05।।
kanyakāḥ śatasaṃkhyāstāstathā ca rājanyakāḥ ।
mālāḥ kareṣu saṃgṛhya koṭicandranibhānanāḥ ।। 1 06।।
surūpāḥ sūjjvalāḥ sarvāṃstadā ṣoḍaśavatsarāḥ ।
premṇā kṛṣṇagale ramye nyadhuḥ patnītvakāmyayā ।। 1 07।।
hariṇā svīkṛtāḥ sarvāstāsāṃ priyacikīrṣayā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike tāśca gṛhītvā svavimānake ।। 1 08।।
rājakanyā gṛhītvā ca sāyaṃ tvambaravartmanā ।
parihārottaraṃ śīghraṃ yayau kālimabhūtalam ।। 1 09।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo maṃgalasūtradaḥ ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇasvāmyanādipumuttamaḥ ।। 2.131.110 ।।
pāvayannijabhaktānāṃ hṛdayāni tadāmbarāt ।
kālimāśanṛparājye gatvā dadarśa bhūtalam ।। 111 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya mokṣasya phalabhāgbhavet ।
pāṭhayecchrāvayedyaṃ ca so'pi mokṣaphalaṃ labhet ।। 11 2।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śaktyakṣinṛparājye yajñottaraṃ devarṣīṇāṃ pañcamayajñārthaṃ preṣaṇaṃ, rājñā ṣaṣṭikanyā haraye'rpitāḥ, piśācītve kāraṇāni, ekādhikaśatapiśācinīmokṣakaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 131 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 132
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 133 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! nārāyaṇanārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ।
vimānenā'mbare'paśyat kālimāśanṛpakṣitim ।। 1 ।।
kālimāsāgarayoge'paśyad viśālamaṇḍapam ।
pañcāśadyojanāyāmaṃ yāvadyānānadīṃ śubham ।। 2 ।।
vimānena bhuvo bhāge tathā dikṣu vidikṣu ca ।
sarvatrā'bhūt prakāśo vai sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ।। 3 ।।
tadā tūryāṇyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ ca devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca dehinām ।। 4 ।।
darśakāścāpyatha śīghraṃ dadruvustāṃ sthalīṃ śubhām ।
vimānasyā'varohārhāṃ salājā'kṣatapuṣpiṇaḥ ।। ।9 ।।
samudrasya taṭe kṛṣṇo'vātārayadvimānakam ।
avātatāra sa tasmātsvayaṃ tato nṛpādayaḥ ।। 6 ।।
brahmapriyāstataḥ sarvā avaterurvimānataḥ ।
pūjitā hāradānādyairlājākṣatairvivardhitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
jayaśabdaiḥ satkṛtāśca namanaiḥ svāgatīkṛtāḥ ।
dṛṣṭāḥ prajājanaiḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇasahajāstadā ।। 8 ।।
niṣāditāścāsaneṣu madhuparkaiśca bhāvitāḥ ।
toṣitā jalapānādyairmiṣṭānnairbhojitāstathā ।। 9 ।।
viśrāmitāstathā rātrau saṃvāhitāḥ sukhaṃ yathā ।
nidrāpitāśca prāsādeṣvamūlyaśayanādiṣu ।। 2.132.10 ।।
kālimāśena ca rājñā sakuṭumbena vai tadā ।
sevito vanditaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sakuṭumbo yathocitam ।। 11 ।।
prātarjātaṃ prabubodha harirvādyādigītibhiḥ ।
bandīkṛtāṃ stutiṃ śṛṇvan dantadhāvanamācarat ।। 12।।
sugandhasalilādyaiśca sasnau nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ ।
bhūṣāḥ sandhārayāmāsā'mbarayogamupāgataḥ ।। 1 3।।
rājādyāḥ śrīhareḥ pūjāṃ cakrurvairājavaibhavaiḥ ।
brahmapriyāstathā pūjāṃ cakrurvai pārameśvarīm ।। 14।।
pañcamyāṃ tu śubhe kāle yayau sa yajñamaṇḍapam ।
dadarśa yogyaṃ sarvaṃ cā'kārayallomaśena saḥ ।। 15।।
tathā patnīvratenā'pi prāraṃbhaṃ ca kratostadā ।
saṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa kālimāśaṃ nṛpaṃ kratau ।। 16।।
prakoṣṭhau bandhayāmāsa svastivācanapūrvakam ।
japahomapragītyādimantrārthaṃ brāhmaṇānṛṣīn ।। 17।।।
varayāmāsa devāँśceśvarānīśān divigṛhān ।
munīn sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīrdevīrdivyāśca kanyakāḥ ।। 18।।
tīrthatattvāni ditijān kāśyapīrvai prajāstathā ।
varayāmāsa yogyāँśca pratyakṣadehidevatāḥ ।। 1 9।।
mukhyadevasthale śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'bhavat ।
sabrahmaviṣṇurudrādyāḥ pratyakṣāḥ sthānadharmiṇaḥ ।।2.132.20।।
svasvasthāne'bhavaँstatra dikpālā mātarastathā ।
gṛhapālāḥ kṣetrapālā grahāścā'nye ca tāmasāḥ ।।21 ।।
te'pi tatrā'bhavan yogyasthale sthitā hi gocarāḥ ।
vasavaśca tathā''dityā aśvinau sādhyasiddhijāḥ ।। 22।।
viprāśca vaidikā ārṣāḥ surāśca pitarastathā ।
ṛṣayaśceśvarāścāpi īśvarāṇyastathā gaṇāḥ ।।23।।
gaṇeśaḥ pārṣadāścāpi siddhayo muktakoṭayaḥ ।
avatārāstathā sarve'vatārāṇāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ।।24।।
yajñe pratyakṣarūpāste svasvasthāne virejire ।
vedāścatvāra evāpi mūrtimanto'bhavaँstadā ।।25।।
ṛcaśca gocarībhūtā mantrā mūrtimayāstathā ।
vahnayaśca tathā mūrtā havyakavyādimūrtayaḥ ।। 26।।
sarve'pi gocarāstatra yajñe vai vaiṣṇave pare ।
upasthitāḥ samabhavan kriyāḥ kramāḥ samūrtayaḥ ।।।27।।
vidhayo viniyogāśca pātrottamāḥ samūrtayaḥ ।
sruksruvādyā mūrtimanto darbhādyā vrīhayo yavāḥ ।।28।।
godhūmāśca nivārāśca rasāḥ śārkaramākṣikāḥ ।
samūrtāḥ sarva evaite'bhavannupasthitāstadā ।। 29।।
samidho maṇḍalānyatra sthāpanāni ca vedikāḥ ।
kuṇḍāḥ pālyaśca kāṇḍādyāḥ samūrtā hyabhavaँstadā ।।2.132.3 0।।
yatra sākṣāddhariścāste sarvaśarīrasaṃyutaḥ ।
tatra kā nyūnatā rādhe bhojyabhogyakriyādiṣu ।।3 1।।
athā'rcane gaṇeśasya jāte rudrādipūjane ।
mātṛkāpūjanādau ca nivṛtte śrīhariḥ svayam ।।32।।
rājahastena kuṇḍe vai vahnyādhānaṃ vidhānataḥ ।
kārayāmāsa ca tadā vedā nādān pracakrire ।।33।।
sākṣādagnistataḥ kuṇḍe jvālāmadhye vyarājata ।
havyadānaṃ samantraṃ ca vahnau prāvartatā'rthitam ।।34।।
devarṣipitṛkāryādau nirvṛtte bhojanādikam ।
miṣṭānnajalatāmbūlaprabhṛtyapi vyavartata ।।35।।
rātrau kathādikaṃ yatra jāyate sāttvataiḥ kṛtam ।
punarnityavidhiścā'tha havanādi pravartate ।।36।।
evaṃ saptāhako yajño vyavartata mahotsavaḥ ।
pauṣaśuklaikādaśikādine pūrṇo'bhavaddhi saḥ ।।37।।
madhyāhne dakṣiṇā datvā'ntimo homo'bhavattathā ।
śrīphalānāmasaṃkhyaiśca vahniścānte'pyatṛpyata ।।38।।
tato vai śrīharirmuktān bhojayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।
brahmapriyāścāvatārānavatārapriyāstathā ।।39।।
dhāmadhāmanivāsāँśca pārṣadān dāsadāsikāḥ ।
īśvarānīśvarāṇīśca nārāyaṇān narāyaṇīḥ ।।2.132.40।।
tattvāni mūlamāyāṃ ca brahmādīn vyūhamūrtikāḥ ।
pitṝn devān siddhasādhyān munīn yatīn prayoginaḥ ।।41 ।।
sādhūn sādhvīḥ sāṃkhyayogā''śritāśca divyadevikāḥ ।
mānavān dikprapālāँśca grahanakṣatratārakāḥ ।।42।।
viprān dehasthitān varṇān tathā''śramanivāsinaḥ ।
vṛkṣavallī stṛṇastambān nadīrnadān sarāṃsi ca ।।43 ।।
akhātakhātasāmudrān dvīpān gahvaraparvatān ।
talādilokavāsāँśca jalasthalā'nilasthitān ।।44।।
vivarasthān bhūgarbhasthān mahīmānān samāgatān ।
ā3 kīṭapataṃgādyān bhojayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।।45।।
nāsti kaścidanaśano jaḍā vā sthāvarā api ।
cetanā jaḍatulyā vā budhā vā balino'pi vā ।।46।।
sāttvikā rājasā vāpi tāmasā api dehinaḥ ।
svasya putrāsta eveti bhojitā hariṇā tadā ।।47।।
pāyitā jalapānādyairdakṣiṇābhiśca toṣitāḥ ।
tato viśrāntimācakruḥ sarve śrīharisaṃyutāḥ ।।48।।
avabhṛthaṃ tataḥ kartuṃ yayau śrībhagavān hariḥ ।
kālimā'bdhijalayoge vādyaghoṣapuraḥsaraḥ ।।49 ।।
gītikābhiḥ sarvadevyo yayuścāvabhṛthāya vai ।
kālimājalamāviśya tathā'nye yānikājale ।।2.132.50 ।।
samudrasya jale cānye kūpavāpīsarassu ca ।
sasnuḥ prāghūṇikāstatra yajñāntāvabhṛthe tadā ।।51।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā pareśvaram ।
kāntaṃ śāntipradaṃ bhāntaṃ hṛdayeṣu nirantaram ।।52।।।
mokṣadaṃ muktidaṃ nāthaṃ nārāyaṇeśvareśvaram ।
brahmadhāmeśvaraṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।।53 ।।
rājā tatra ca dānāni dadau kośoṣṭravājinām ।
gajahaṃsagaruḍānāṃ vimānayānayāninām ।।54।।
svarṇarūpyakamāṇikyahīrakamauktikāni ca ।
gṛhāṇyupaskarāṇyudyānānyaraṇyāni vāṭikāḥ ।।55।।
kṣetrāṇi cāpi pātrāṇi dadāvannāni sarvaśaḥ ।
mahādānāni sarvāṇi dadau kālimakeśvaraḥ ।।56 ।।
evaṃ cā'vabhṛthaṃ kṛtvā tvāyayurnijamandire ।
sāyaṃ pradadau bhojyāni pānāni vividhānyapi ।।57।।
bālakṛṣṇodito rājā kālimeśaḥ sukhānvitaḥ ।
rātrau lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīḥ kanyārūpā hareḥ kathām ।।58।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā vyāsāsanasthitā ।
bālakṛṣṇājñayā ramyāṃ vācayāmāsa saṃsadi ।।5 9 ।।
tatrā''gatāḥ samudrasya patnyo nadyaśca devikāḥ ।
pupūjustāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ tataḥ śrīkambharāsatīm ।।2.132.6 0।।
ratnādyairvividhairvastubhiśca hārairmanoharaiḥ ।
vastrabhūṣābhirevāpi śubhaṃ divyābhirarcanam ।।6 1 ।।
cakrurārārtrikaṃ cāpi vanadevyo'pi vai tadā ।
yajñapatnyaḥ samagrāśca devapatnyastathā tadā ।।62।।
pitṛpatnyaḥ siddhapatnya īśapatnyastathā śriyaḥ ।
pūjāṃ cakrurbrahmapatnyo dhāmapatnyastathā tadā ।।63 ।।
harermātuḥ kambharāyā lakṣmyāḥ pūjāṃ vyadhurmudā ।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinyo devyaḥ pūjāṃ vyadhuḥ śubhām ।।64।।
parihāraṃ kathāyāśca pūjāyāścāpi nāmabhiḥ ।
śrīpatiṃ śrīgopaputraṃ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ।।65।।
kaṃbharābālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramāpatim ।
sarvakāmapatiṃ rādhāpatiṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim ।।66।।
brahmavidyāramānāthaṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ satāṃ patim ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ brahmapriyāpatiṃ kāntaṃ bhajāmahe ।।67।।
ityevaṃ kīrtanaṃ ramyaṃ cakruḥ sarvesabhāsadaḥ ।
atha viśrāntilābhārthaṃ prasādagrahaṇottaram ।।68।।
ārārtrikaṃ kathayāśca cakrurnijālayān yayuḥ ।
nidrāṃ vai jagṛhuḥ sarve yathā jāgaraṇaśritām ।।69।।
dvādaśyāṃ naityakaṃ kṛtvā rājā pūjārthamāyayau ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ nijātmānaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।2.132.70।।
aṣṭottaraśatadravyaiḥ rājñyaścāpi samarcayan ।
viṃśatisaṃkhyakarājñyaścārārtrika mahad vyadhuḥ ।।71।।
tadā ca kanyakāstāsāṃ śate dve mumuhurharau ।
divyarūpe koṭikoṭikandarpasundare prabhau ।।72।।
varayāmāsurevaitā varamālā dadurgale ।
rājñyaḥ sarvāśca tāstatrārpayāmāsuśca kanyakāḥ ।।।73।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ।
jagrāha śrīharistāśca rājā'pi yautakaṃ dadau ।।74।।
vimānaṃ yojanāyāmaṃ caturdantāँśca hastinaḥ ।
garuḍān pradadau vāhān sapakṣān vyomacāriṇaḥ ।।75।।
naisargadīpamaṇikān dāsān dāsīstadā dadau ।
dve śate dve śate cāpi jagrāha kaṃbharāsutaḥ ।।76।।
kanyakāḥ parameśaṃ taṃ patiṃ prāpya manoharam ।
sarvā mumudire'tyarthaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।।77।।
evaṃ yajñottaraṃ kṛṣṇo dvādaśyāṃ pūjanottaram ।
dadau rājñe svacaraṇau hṛdaye mastake karau ।।78।।
rājñyai cāpi dadau hāraṃ pauṣpaṃ prāsādikaṃ hariḥ ।
rājñībhyaścāpi sarvābhyo dadau hārān sahīrakān ।।79।।
iyeṣa darśanaṃ dātuṃ naijaṃ pareśabodhakam ।
drāgeva sahasā tejomaṇḍalaṃ prāvirāsa ha ।।2.132.80।।
śrīharerabhitastejaḥ pravāhāḥ nissaranti hi ।
vyāpnuvanti tadā''kāśe koṭyarbudaraviprakhāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tadā cakṣūṃṣi sarveṣāṃ sarvāsāṃ militāni vai ।
dadau divyāṃ harirdṛṣṭiṃ tejaḥsahāṃ sudarśanām ।।82।।
atha rājakuṭumbaṃ tat tathā prajājanā api ।
dadṛśuḥ śrīparameśaṃ parākṣaraparaṃ vibhum ।।83।।
dhāmadhāmādhimuktaiśca sevitaṃ brāhmikādibhiḥ ।
avatārairīśvaraiśca suraiḥ siddhaiśca mānavaiḥ ।।84।।
rūparūpānuvayavaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ।
kāmagarvaharaṃ kāntaṃ rādhālakṣmīprasevitam ।।85।।
dvibhujaṃ sundaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ manoharam ।
prapūraṃ yovanabharaṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam ।।86 ।।
mayūrapicchamukuṭaṃ svarṇakuṇḍalarājitam ।
sakaustubhahārarājatpronnatavakṣasaṃ vibhum ।।87।।
svarṇabhūṣānvitaṃ vaṃśīdharaṃ vakrasthiraṃ manāk ।
tataścaturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadābjaśobhitam ।।88।।
dṛṣṭvā tato dvibhujaṃ ca nijakanyādisevitam ।
svarājyasthaṃ saudhabhājaṃ sānnidhye saṃvirājitam ।।89।।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ sarve samādhiṃ pravihāya tāḥ ।
dadṛśuḥ śrīhariṃ cāgre tadāścaryaparāmuhuḥ ।।2.132.90।।
ātmanāṃ menire rājñyo rājā prajāḥ kṛtātmatām ।
athā'nye darśanārthaṃ vai samāgacchanti bhūbhṛtaḥ ।।9 1।।
pañcarājyāni śāsanto rājñīyutā hariṃ prabhum ।
arcayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tato maharṣayo'pi ca ।।92।।
sādhavaśca surā martyā daityā bhakteśvarā api ।
sarvalokanivāsāścāgatya pupūjuracyutam ।। 93 ।।
rāśiyānapradeśānāṃ śibirājyasya cāpi yāḥ ।
anyadvīpaprajāścāpi pupūjurīśvareśvaram ।।94।।
kāmacāṭakadeśīyā ālāyutāyanāḥ prajāḥ ।
pūrvabhūdeśīyalokāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।95।।
riṅgajalaprajāścāpi pakṣavātaprajājanāḥ ।
māloṣṭhadvīpavāsāśca sphuṭākṣadvīpavāsinaḥ ।।96।।
thurāyasadvīpavāsāḥ kūṭalānanivāsinaḥ ।
svairanārīdvīpavāsā kṣemīyānanivāsinaḥ ।।97।।
evamanyāḥ prajāścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
sādhurlālāsanaḥ kaścid rādhe pūrvābdhimadhyagaḥ ।। 98।।
dvīpastho vyomamārgeṇa kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyayau ।
pādayoḥ patitaścāpi yayāce bhojanaṃ haraiḥ ।।99।।
haristasmai dadau śreṣṭhaṃ pāyasaṃ pūrikādikam ।
bubhuje sādhuvaryo'sau tāvad dundubhayo divi ।। 2.132.10 0।।
vineduḥ śaṃkhaninadāścā'bhavan vai nisargataḥ ।
jalaṃ pītvā samudgāraṃ mumoca tṛptisūcakam ।। 101 ।।
tāvat tūryāṇi sarvāṇi tvavādyanta nisargataḥ ।
apreryamāṇānyaniśaṃ camatkāro'yamadbhutaḥ ।। 1 02।।
dṛṣṭo lokaistadā rājā kālimeśa uvāca ha ।
bālakṛṣṇa haresvāmin kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।। 103 ।।
kimidaṃ jāyate śīghraṃ vāditrāṇi nivāraya ।
bhayaṃ me jāyate kṛṣṇa! śrutvā''kasmikagarjanāḥ ।। 1 04।।
hariḥ prāha bhayaṃ nāsti sādhurme bhaktarāḍayam ।
kalpāntarāt tapaḥ kurvan lālāsane'bdhimadhyake ।। 1 05।।
yogāsane sadī cāste jñātvā māmatra cāgataḥ ।
tadbhukte pūrṇatāṃ yātā yajñaḥ pañca mayā kṛtāḥ ।। 106 ।।
ekasmin sāttvate tṛpte trailokyaṃ tṛptameva hi ।
yajñāntasūcakaḥ so'yaṃ saccidānandamūrtikaḥ ।। 1 07।।
mukto me vartate harṣāyante tūryāṇi tena vai ।
ityuktvā sa hariścakre vāditranādarodhanam ।। 1 08।।
sādhurbhuktvā ca digvāsā yayau dvīpaṃ lalāsanam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ।। 1 09।।
kṛṣṇaikāntamanaskānāṃ sanmānantu jaḍā api ।
kurvanti sarvatattvāni yathā vādyāni sañjaguḥ ।। 2.132.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kālimeśanṛparājye kālimābdhisaṃgame pañcamaviṣṇuyāgaḥ, avabhṛthaṃ bhojanaṃ kathānakaṃ pūjanaṃ, śatadvayakanyādānaṃ divyadarśanaṃ, naikadvīpīyaprajākṛtapūjanaṃ, sādhulālāsanabhojanaṃ, nisargaśaṃkhādininādāścetyādivarṇananāmā dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 132 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 132 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 133
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 134 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ vaiśvadevānte bhojayitvā makhīyakān ।। 1 ।।
sarvāṃśca dehinaḥ paścād bhuktavā viśrāntimāpa ha ।
sāyaṃ sabhāṃ ca mahatīṃ cakre vai yajñamaṇḍape ।। 2 ।।
lālāsanaścā'dṛśyata sabhāyāṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
sarvakāṣāyavasano dadhānastaulasīṃ srajam ।। 3 ।।
rūpānurūpāvayavo yathā cākṣaravāsakṛt ।
mahāmuktasvarūpo vai brahmavratābhikāśitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
japan saṃkīrtayan kṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo jayatviha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatu satpatiḥ ।। 5 ।।
jaya svāminbālakṛṣṇa paramātmannamo'stu te ।
jaya śrīkambharāputra jaya gopālanandana ।। 6 ।।
deśo'yaṃ makhayogena pāvito vaiṣṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
dhanyāste mānavā loke yeṣāṃ sākṣād bhavāniha ।। 7 ।।
dhanyā nāryo narāḥ sarve yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ ।
dhanyo'haṃ saccidānando lālāsano'pi yogirāṭ ।। 8 ।।
yadahaṃ prāptavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ paraprabhum ।
mantraṃ dehi śaraṇya tvaṃ dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ tathā ।। 9 ।।
pradehi cā'kṣaraṃ dhāma maraṇānte padaṃ tava ।
ityukto bhagavāँstasmai dadau dīkṣāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ।। 2.133.1 0।।
rādhike dvīpavāsāya yogine tu mumukṣave ।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa bhagavāँstatra kādalam ।। 11 ।।
patratoraṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ vedīkalaśaśobhitam ।
kuṇḍayuktaṃ savitānaṃ gavyahavyādiśobhitam ।। 1 2।।
pañcagavyena ca śuddhiṃ haristasyā'pyakārayat ।
lāsāsanasya bhaktasya dehaśuddhimakārayat ।। 13 ।।
tataḥ pūrvamukhaṃ taṃ ca hariścottarakā''nanaḥ ।
dadau vai prathamaṃ vāri kare saṃkalpasiddhaye ।। 14।।
deśakālādi saṃkīrtya mocayitvā jalaṃ kṣitau ।
mastake prokṣaṇaṃ tasya kārayitvā tato hariḥ ।। 15।।
dadau taṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ dakṣe karṇe kṛpānidhiḥ ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 16।।
mantramiti pradāyaiva rakṣaṇamantrakaṃ dadau ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।। 17।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
mantramiti pradāyaivā'rpaṇamantraṃ tato dadau ।। 18।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 1 9।।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।
itimantrān pradāyaiva kārayitvordhvapuṇḍrakam ।।2.133.20 ।।
mālāṃ ca taulasīṃ kaṇṭhe dadau dviguṇitāṃ hariḥ ।
madyaṃ māsaṃ pāradāryaṃ cauryaṃ kāryaṃ na vai kvacit ।।2 1 ।।
ityevaṃ ca yamān tasmai śrāvayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
upakāraṃ virāgaṃ ca jñānaṃ bhaktiṃ dadau tadā ।।22।।
niyamān mokṣadān kṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
sādhusaṃgaḥ sadā kāryau mokṣadaśceti cāha tam ।।23।।
guroḥ sevā hareḥ sevā pitroḥ sevā kuṭumbinām ।
sevā kāryeti taṃ prāha bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।। 24 ।।
na kaścidudvejanīyastoṣaṇīyaḥ sadā kṣitau ।
satyaḥ sādhvyoḥ namaskāryāstā hi pareśaśaktayaḥ ।।25।।
ityevaṃ tamupādiśya tataḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
mahādīkṣāpradānārthamupavāsaṃ tamādiśat ।।26।।।
upavāsasthale tatra godānaṃ samakārayat ।
dehaśuddhyarthamevaṃ sa datvopoṣaṇasadvidhim ।।27।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ svastyayanaṃ tvakārayat svayaṃ hariḥ ।
maṇḍape sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhānyaśobhitam ।।28।।
akārayacca tanmadhye haimaṃ kuṃbhaṃ nyadhāpayat ।
aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭakuṃbhāँśca toyaratnaphalānvitām ।।29।।
pallavāmbarayuktāँścā'sthāpayacca ghaṭopari ।
tilapūrṇāṃ śubhasthālīṃ nidhāya pratimāṃ hareḥ ।।2.133.3 0।।।
sanevedyāṃ sthāpayitvā sauvarṇīṃ cā'pyapūjayat ।
rādhālakṣmībrahmavidyāramāśrīmāṇikīyutām ।।3 1 ।।
tato'ṣṭadikṣu kalaśe pūrve satīṃ ca śaṃkaram ।
dakṣiṇe bhāskaraṃ saṃjñāṃ, pratīcyāṃ tu gaṇeśvaram ।।32।।
siddhibuddhisahitaṃ ca, kauberyāṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ।
āgneyyāṃ tu caturvyūhaṃ, nairṛtyāṃ garuḍaṃ gajam ।।।3 3।।
vāyavyāṃ hanumantaṃ caiśānyāṃ brahmapriyāgaṇam ।
asthāpayat svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।34।।
svastivāco vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ param ।
kārayitvāṃ'gadevānāmāvāhanādikaṃ tathā ।। 35।।
mātṛkānyāsanaṃ kārayitvā'pūjayadacyutam ।
upacāraiḥ śoḍaśabhirmantraistathā ca vaidikaiḥ ।।36।।
atha kuṇḍe vahnidevamasthāpayattu dakṣiṇe ।
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca caruṃ cā'śrāpayaccā'pūjayaddharim ।।37।।
samidājyacarūṇāṃ ca homaṃ tvakārayattadā ।
aṣṭottaraśatasamarpaṇamantrairakārayat ।। 38।।
aṅgā'ṅgadevatābhyaścaikaikāmāhutimārpayat ।
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā mahānīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ।।39।।
puṣpāñjaliṃ tadā kṛṣṇo'pyadāpayaddharau śubhām ।
pūrvamukhaṃ niṣādyaiva śiṣyamudaṅmukho hariḥ ।।2.133.40 ।।
kāṣāyāmbarakaṃ divya cottarīyaṃ tathā dadau ।
yajñopavītakaṃ cakrādikacihnacatuṣṭayam ।।41 ।।
tato mantraṃ dadau tasmai lālāyanāya karṇake ।
dakṣe trivāramevā'rthasahitaṃ brahmabhāvadam ।।42।।
'brahmāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।।42।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
iti mantraṃ dadau paścāt svamūrtiṃ pūjanāya vai ।
dadau svarṇāṃ ṣaṭpriyābhiḥ sahitāṃ mokṣahetave ।।44।।
jñānaṃ dadau tārakaṃ ca saccidānandabodhakam ।
ātmā vai brahmarūpo'yaṃ saccidānandabhāsuraḥ ।।45।।
tatra kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma māṃ hṛdi cintayeḥ mune ।
ātmanivedī tvaṃ cādyadināt mama samo hyasi ।।46।।
ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ samutthāya śrīkṛṣṇapādayoḥ।
patito daṇḍavat bhūmau dīkṣāvidhestu dakṣiṇām ।।47।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ hṛdayaṃ cā'samarpayat ।
haristasmai dadāvāśīrvādān mokṣapradān śubhān ।।48।।
mamā'tra kṛpayā bhakta phalitaste manorathaḥ ।
māṃ prasevya cobhayatra paraṃ sukhamavāpsyasi ।।49।।
yasya kṛṣṇe parā bhaktirgurau śrīkṛṣṇavallabhe ।
tasya pumarthasiddhiśca sā te'stvanugrahānmama ।।2.133.50 ।।
atha visarjanaṃ cakre devānāṃ śrīhariḥ svayam ।
tataḥ prāha haristaṃ ca bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ tu mām ।।51 ।।
upadeśaṃ mama dehi mamopāsanasaṃbhṛtam ।
anena vidhinā dīkṣāṃ dehi mumukṣave mune ।।52।।।
saccidānandanāmā tvaṃ kāṣāyāmbaradhārakaḥ ।
ācāryo'si mamā''jñāṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa dīkṣaṇe, janān ।।53 ।।
nārīrnarān paśūn pakṣijātismarān tṛṇādikān ।
kāmarūpadharān sarvān kuru dīkṣā'bhipāvitān ।।54।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇaḥ svāmī vai sarvadehinām ।
sarve bhajantu māṃ nityaṃ patiṃ brahmaparaṃ harim ।।55।।
tvaṃ prakāraya sādho me bhaktiṃ pṛthvyāṃ jane jane ।
ābālayuvavṛddheṣu naranārīnapuṃsu ca ।।56।।
ityuktaḥ saccidānando yogirāṭ tatra saṃsadi ।
natvā svāmibālakṛṣṇaṃ janānupādideśa ha ।।57।।
dadāti jñānamaiśaṃ ca pāpāni kṣālayatyapi ।
etādṛśī harericchā dīkṣānāmnī mahāsatī ।।58।।
brahmaputrī brahmadhāmapradā muktipradā yataḥ ।
sāmānyā ca viśeṣā vā grahītavyā janaiḥ śubhā ।।59।।
adīkṣitasya nā'śnāti dattamannajalaṃ hariḥ ।
dīkṣitasya patramapi na vai tyajati śrīhariḥ ।।2.133.6 0।।
dīkṣito bhaktarāṭ tīrthaṃ tīrthottamaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi nivasanti padāṃ'gule ।।6 1 ।।
dīkṣite devatāḥ sarvā īśvarā api sarvaśaḥ ।
nivasanti sadā dehe tasmādvai dīkṣito bhavet ।। 61।।
dīkṣitasya tu sevāyāḥ phalaṃ mokṣo bhavediti ।
dīkṣitasparśajaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpāpādināśakam ।।6 3 ।।
dīkṣitasya prasādānnaṃ pāvanaṃ cāpi tajjalam ।
dīkṣitasya sahavāso mokṣado dhāmadāyakaḥ ।।64।।
dīkṣitasya tu satsaṃgo bhagavatsaṃgasadṛśaḥ ।
dīkṣitasya kriyāḥ sarvā divyā haryarpaṇātmikāḥ ।।6 5 ।।
dīkṣite sarvayajñānāṃ puṇyāni nivasanti vai ।
dīkṣitasya snānavāri pītvā tṛpyanti pūrvajāḥ ।।66।।
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhā yogino yatayastathā ।
sādhavo brahmaśīlāśca dīkṣitaṃ praṇamanti vai ।।67।।
dīkṣito yadgṛhe yāti tadgṛhaṃ dhāmasadṛśam ।
sevate yā dīkṣitaṃ sā bodhyā vai puṇyaśālinī ।।68।।
sevate yo dīkṣitaṃ sa jāyate pārṣado hareḥ ।
pṛthvī nityaṃ hareragre prārthayati pradīkṣitam ।।69।।
sādhudīkṣāprapannānāṃ caraṇaiḥ pāvanī hyaham ।
dīkṣitasnānamātreṇa jalaṃ tīrthaṃ prajāyate ।।2.133.70।।
sādhulālāsanaścāhaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vai muhuḥ ।
saccidānandasaṃjño'haṃ jāto vai dīkṣayā hareḥ ।।71 ।।
ābālyādapi saṃgrāhyaḥ śaraṇāgatamantrakaḥ ।
tasyāśrayapradātā śrīkṛṣṇo yatra bhayaṃ na vai ।।72।।
tato grāhyo rakṣaṇasya mantro'pyābālyato'pi vai ।
kālānmāyābandhanācca pāpācca karmabandhanāt ।।73।।
śatrubhyo yāmyaduḥkhācca kumitrād yadbhayādikam ।
tasmāt triśūlamatsyādicihno'vatyeva mādhavaḥ ।।74।।
yaddhaste triśūlacihnaṃ mīnacihnaṃ dhvajā'ṅkakam ।
dhanuraṃkaṃ cakracihnaṃ svastikā'ṅkaṃ ca vajrakam ।।75।।
tatra triśūlakaṃ divyaṃ kālabhītiṃ prahanti vai ।
dīvyamīnastathā hanti māyābhītiṃ ca bandhanam ।।76।।
dhvajacihnaṃ tathā divyaṃ hanti pāpabhayaṃ sadā ।
dhanuraṃkaṃ tathā divyaṃ karmabhītiṃ prahanti ca ।।77।।
cakracihnaṃ mahādivyaṃ śatrūn prahanti tadbhayam ।
svasticihnaṃ tathā divyaṃ yamabhītiṃ prahanti ca ।।78।।
kaṃ vajraṃ divyamevaitat kuhṛdbhayaṃ nihanti ca ।
saptacihnadharo hasto yasya dehaṃ spṛśatyapi ।।79।।
taddehe tūktabhītīnāṃ saṃbhavo'pi na jāyate ।
tataḥ samarpaṇo mantro grāhyo vai jñānapūrvakaḥ ।।2.133.80।।
oṃnāmne haraye cā'haṃ namaskaromi sarvadā ।
svāmine śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyā'rpaṇatāṃ gataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
nā'nyasyā'haṃ bhavāmyadyadināt tasyaiva vai vaśe ।
dāso bhṛtyo dīnadāsī bhavāmyadyadināddhare ।।82।।
ityevaṃ tvātmadānākhyaṃ sarvasvaṃ tatra cārpyate ।
