hutaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathā vahnau hutaścā'haṃ tathā harau ।।83।।
pṛthagbhāvo na me'styadyadinācchrīkṛṣṇaballabhāt ।
matvaivaṃ nijabhāve śrīharau dehe yathātmani ।।84।।
tathā śrībālakṛṣṇo'tra pare brahmaṇi sarvadā ।
patitvaṃ śāśvataṃ jñeyaṃ pitṛtvaṃ bandhutā'pi ca ।।85।।
suhṛtā mitratā cāpi rakṣayitṛtvamityapi ।
pālakatvaṃ tathā kṛṣṇe śāśvataṃ jñeyameva ca ।।86 ।।
ityevaṃ cārpaṇe jñāne paripakve dṛḍhe sati ।
tato grāhyā sādhudīkṣā brahmabhāvapradā śubhā ।।87।।
brahmarūpo yataścāhaṃ dehendriyādyahaṃ na vai ।
premasevākaro bhaktaḥ śāśvato'smi hareryataḥ ।।88।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvatvameva me ।
patiḥ pātā tathā bhoktā svāmī niyāmako mama ।।89।।
antarātmā parātmā ca bāhyātmā'pi mamaiva saḥ ।
indriyātmā śarīrātmā daihikātmā mamaiva saḥ ।।2.133.90।।
ityevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇād rikto'smi na kvacit ।
sadā tanmūrtimagno'smi tadguṇaśca tadaṃśakaḥ ।। 91 ।।
evaṃ vai brahmabhāvaṃ svaṃ viditvā sādhutā phalet ।
parā'kṣare tu vindeta śrīhareḥ śāśvataṃ sukham ।।92।।
evaṃ dīkṣāgrahe śīghraṃ divyā bhavanti dehinaḥ ।
tasmād dīkṣā harergrāhyā jñānibhiḥ sādhavī parā ।।93 ।।
tadanyaiḥ rakṣiṇī dīkṣā śaraṇī vā samarpaṇī ।
grahītavyā vinā dīkṣāṃ na stheyaṃ mānavairiha ।।94।।
deśaḥ kālaḥ śubhaḥ saṃgo na hātavyaḥ kadācana ।
parameśe gṛhe prāpte prasanne mokṣadāyini ।।95।।
yo na māyāṃ tyajenmūḍhastasya hāniḥ pade pade ।
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ varṣma mokṣasādhanamuttamam ।।96 ।।
prāpya tanna yatetāpi mokṣe'tra tvātmahā hi saḥ ।
tasmādātmā na hantavyo mokṣayogyo'pi mānavaiḥ ।।97।।
gṛhṇantu sādhavīṃ dīkṣāṃ tadanyāṃ pātratā yathā ।
ayaṃ śrībhagavān sākṣād dadātyeva yathā hi me ।।98।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau saccidānandayogirāṭ ।
lakṣaśo mānavāḥ śrutvā dīkṣārthaṃ samupāgatāḥ ।।99।।
bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyaḥ śaraṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
samarpaṇaṃ manuṃ cāpi jñānibhyo brahmamantrakam ।। 2.133.1 00।।
pañcasāhasrabhaktāste tadā vai sādhavo'bhavan ।
guravo lokajīvānāṃ mokṣakāriṇa eva ca ।। 101 ।।
rāśiyānādideśeṣūpadeśārthaṃ nideśitāḥ ।
prayayurbhinnadeśeṣu haryājñayā hareḥ priyāḥ ।। 1 02।।
rādhe! harirviśaśrāma sabhāntaṃ pracakāra ha ।
nivāseṣu pragatvaiva viśaśramuśca dehinaḥ ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhariḥ sādhulālāsanayogine sādhavīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ datvā tataḥ pañcasahasrebhyaḥ sādhavīṃ dīkṣāṃ dadāvityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 133 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 133 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 134
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 135 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
trayodaśyāṃ prage snātvā samājuhāva bhūbhṛtam ।। 1 ।।
kālimeśaṃ mahārājaṃ sa tu rājā drutaṃ yayau ।
hariṃ natvā supūjyaiva niṣasāda puro hareḥ ।। 2 ।।
bhagavānāha sarvebhyo bhojanānte'dya dakṣiṇām ।
vidāyākhyāṃ dehi rājannutsavasya visarjane ।। 3 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa mahārājo randhayāmāsa satvaram ।
bhojanāni vividhānyāhārayāmāsa saddhanam ।। 4 ।।
hīrāmāṇikyaratnāni svarṇarūpyakamudrikāḥ ।
bhūṣālaṃkāravastrāṇi gā vimānāni vāhanam ।। 5 ।।
madhyāhne śrīhariṃ sarvamahīmānebhya ityapi ।
dakṣiṇā dāpayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa tān mudā ।। 6 ।।
bhojitā muktamuktānyo brahmākṣaravibhūtayaḥ ।
śaktayaḥ pārṣadā dāsā dāsyo bhṛtyāśca bhūbhṛtā ।। 7 ।।
sevakāścāvatārāścā'vatāriṇyaḥ subhojitāḥ ।
rādhālakṣmyādayaḥ sarvā vāsudevādayastathā ।। 8 ।।
bhūmaviṣṇumahāviṣṇuvairājaśaṃbhutadgaṇāḥ ।
māyāstatpuruṣāścāpi dhāmāni tannivāsinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vairājāḥ satyalokīyāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ।
siddhāśca sādhavaścāpi pitaraḥ suradevatāḥ ।। 2.134.1 0।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca meruparvatavāsinaḥ ।
bhuvarlokasthitāścāpi maruto viśvadevatāḥ ।। 11 ।।
vasavaścāraṇāḥ sādhyā nidhayo mānavā gaṇāḥ ।
gaṇeśā gaṇikāścāpi bhūtāḥ pretāśca mātaraḥ ।। 1 2।।
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi hyasurā bhaktasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
sūryā rudrā grahāstārā nakṣatrāṇi ca kāśyapāḥ ।। 1 3।।
vṛkṣā vallyastṛṇastambā vaṃśāḥ kandāḥ phaladrumāḥ ।
nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi nirjharādayaḥ ।। 14।।
vāpīkūpataṭākāni khātā'khātāni cābdhayaḥ ।
tīrthāni parvatāścāpi vanānyupavanāni ca ।। 15।।
kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca sarīsṛpāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ।
anye'pi deśadeśīyāstattvānyapi jaḍāni ca ।। 16।।
yajñāśca vahnayaścāpi pātrāṇi havyasaddravāḥ ।
sarve mūrtā hareryogāt pūjitā bhūbhṛtā tadā ।। 17।।
tathā sarvaiḥ rājabhiśca pūjitā bhojitāstathā ।
toṣitā dakṣiṇābhiśca kṣatyādau prakṣamāpitāḥ ।। 18।।
dāsavargāḥ karmacārā ye'bhavan yajñakarmasu ।
bhāṭṭāśca bandinaḥ sūtā bhāṭāścāraṇaguhyakāḥ ।। 19।।
gāndharvā nartakā nāṭyakalā naṭāśca gāyakāḥ ।
nartakyo gāyikāścāpi devyo'psarogaṇādayaḥ ।।2.134.20।।
pādasaṃvāhakāścāpi bhṛtyāḥ sevākarāstathā ।
sevakāḥ kṣālakāścāpi mārjakā hārakā api ।। 11 ।।
kvaṇakā mālinaścāpi tvaṣṭārastantuvāyakāḥ ।
rajakā rājakāścāpi śilpinaḥ sukalāvidaḥ ।।22।।
evamanye dīpahārā vetrahārādayastathā ।
jayakārā vāharakṣāḥ saudhodyānādirakṣiṇaḥ ।। 23।।
gopālā gṛhapālāśca vanāraṇyaprapālakāḥ ।
yānavāhanapālāśca koṭiśo'pi ca mānavāḥ ।। 24।।
vārapriyāstathā vārā napuṃsakāni bhaṇḍakāḥ ।
bahurūpā raṅgagāmā hāsakāḥ kathakāstathā ।।25।।।
sabhyāḥ sabhākalājñāśca śṛṃgārahāvabhāvinaḥ ।
pradarśanakarāścāpi vahnisphoṭakarāstathā ।। 26।।
vidyudvijñā yantravāhā jalavāhādayastathā ।
dṛśyaśilpāstathā cānye ye ke karmacarādayaḥ ।।27।।
narā nāryaśca sarve te sarvā rājabhirarcitāḥ ।
toṣitā dakṣiṇābhiśca pāritoṣikavastubhiḥ ।।28।।
vastrāmbaradhanādyaiścālaṃkāropakarādibhiḥ ।
dravyaiḥ suvarṇakūpyaiśca ratnahārādibhistathā ।।29।।
bhojitāstoṣitāścāti prasāditāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
bhikṣukā dīnavargāścā'nāthā dāridryayoginaḥ ।।2.134.3 0।।
narā nāryaḥ satīsādhvyaḥ sādhavo rāgavarjitāḥ ।
aniketāstāpasāścātithayo vanavāsinaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
bahujātīyajīvāśca jātismarā viyonijāḥ ।
evamanye'pyalasāśca rājasāstāmasā api ।। 3 2।।
sarve santoṣitāḥ sarvapradānairacyutājñayā ।
rājabhiḥ sarvadānaiste toṣitāstatra cotsave ।।33 ।।
atha rādhe! hareḥ pūjāṃ cakruste'pyaparāhṇake ।
vidāyaṃ cārthayāmāsurharirvidāyakaṃ dadau ।। 34।।
nīrājayitvā śrīpatiṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam ।
kṛtakṛtyān manyamānāḥ prāpyā''jñāṃ pārameśvarīm ।।35।।
prārthayate kṣamāṃ sevākṣatau rājñe pradāya ca ।
āśīrvādān vimānaiḥ svairyānaiḥ rathaiśca vāhanaiḥ ।।36।।
yathaiśvaryaṃ yathāsmṛddhiṃ yathāgati yayurgṛhān ।
svasvalokān kṣiterbhāgervāyumārgairvimānakaiḥ ।। 37।।
garuḍaiśca gajairaśvairhaṃsaiḥ siṃhādibhistathā ।
analaiḥ kiraṇaiścāpi saṃkalpaiḥ siddhibhistathā ।।38।।
samādhinā yayuścāpyaiśvaryakaiḥ rūpalakṣakaiḥ ।
adṛśyabhāvanābhiśca līnaiśvaryādibhistathā ।। 39।।
sṛjyaiśvaryaistathā cātmatattvabhāvairyayurgṛham ।
evaṃ tatra trayodaśyāṃ mahīmānāḥ samastataḥ ।।2.134.40।।
yayurlokānnijāndeśān saurāṣṭramaṇḍalaṃ vinā ।
koṭyarbudabrahmapriyākanyakāsahito hariḥ ।।41 ।।
lomaśādimunibhiśca tathā'śvapaṭṭatīrthakaiḥ ।
kṣetrapairavatārādyaiḥ pitṛbhyāṃ sahitastathā ।।42।।
bhaktairdāsaiḥ kuṭumbena vaiṣṇavaiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ saha ।
sādhvībhiḥ sādhubhiḥ sākaṃ sarvakanyābhirityapi ।।43।।
akṣarakṣetravāsābhiḥ prajābhiḥ sāttvataiḥ saha ।
devāyanādibhiḥ sākaṃ śrīhariḥ pūrṇimāvadhim ।।44।।
kālimeśanṛpasaudhe samuvāsa kṛpākaraḥ ।
kālimeśakuṭumbasya śreyase toṣaṇāya ca ।।45।।
sarvarājakuṭumbāni nyūṣuścā''pūrṇimāvadhim ।
ahaṃ kṛṣṇastathā nārāyaṇastasyecchayā prabhoḥ ।।46।।
tvayā lakṣmyā yutau cāvāṃ nyūṣima pūrṇimāvadhim ।
evaṃ vai rādhike kṛtvā prāghūrṇikavidāyakam ।।47।।
rātrau viśrāntimāpannaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
caturdaśyāṃ prage snātvā samāhūya nṛpān hariḥ ।।48।।
upādideśa hārdaṃ svaṃ sabhyebhyo nṛpasaṃsadi ।
śṛṇvantu vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve rājānastatkuṭumbinaḥ ।।49।।
rājā dharmāśrayaścāsti rājanyahaṃ vasāmi ca ।
dikpālānāṃ śaktayaśca nihitā vai nṛpe mayā ।।2.134.50।।
rājādhīnaprajāḥ sarvāḥ pālayanti vṛṣān śubhān ।
acauryama cā'pyahiṃsāṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ nayaṃ tathā ।।5 1 ।।
satyaṃ prapālanaṃ cāpi mātāpitṛprasevanam ।
patyadhīnā tathā patnī patnyadhīnaḥ patistathā ।।52।।
svāmyadhīnāstathā bhṛtyā bhṛtyādhīnaśca rakṣakaḥ ।
rājabhītyā yathācāre vartante daṇḍabhītitaḥ ।।53 ।।
tasmād rājā mama rūpo mama śāsanavartanaḥ ।
rājñā vai pālyate dharmastathā'rtho'pi prapālyate ।।।54।।
rājā prajānāmarthaiśca karoti kratumutsavam ।
annasatrāṇi devānāṃ mandirāṇyartharāśibhiḥ ।।55।।
bhaktiṃ karoti rājā ca kārayatyapi rāṣṭrake ।
tārayati prajāścāpi yastu bhāgavato bhavet ।।।56।।
tasmād bhavadbhiḥ kṣitipaiḥ pṛthvyāṃ dūtaistu sarvataḥ ।
kāraṇīyā harerbhakterghoṣaṇā paṭahairapi ।।57।।
prajā bhavantu ca harerbhaktimatyaḥ sudīkṣitāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyaḥ sarvathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasamāśritāḥ ।।58।।
yajñopavītaṃ gṛhṇantu vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ śubham ।
dīkṣāṃ mantraṃ harernāma gṛhṇantvapi pramokṣadam ।।59।।
vrataṃ kurvantu ca harerjanmāṣṭamyāṃ śubhorjake ।
kṛṣṇe dale'tibhāvena caikādaśyā vrataṃ tathā ।।2.134.6 0।।
atra yajñadinānāṃ ca kurvantu tīrthayātrikām ।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi prakurvantu divāniśam ।।6 1 ।।
utsavān vividhāँścapi vaiṣṇavairmilitaiḥ saha ।
kārayantu prajāścāpi kathāpārāyaṇādikam ।।62।।
cāturmāsye prapūjādi kurvantu śrīharestathā ।
ityevaṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ rājye kārayantu nije nije ।।6 3 ।।
ityādiṣṭāstu rājānaḥ pañcamukhyāstathā'pare ।
śibidevanṛpaścāpi tharkūṭasthanṛpastathā ।।64।।
vīrajāramahārājaḥ śaktyakṣinṛpatistathā ।
kālimāśanṛpaścāpi tathā'nye khaṇḍabhūbhṛtaḥ ।।65।।
āśāṃ śirasi cādhāya nemuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kariṣyāmastathetyuktvoddhoṣaṇāṃ dūtasattamaiḥ ।।66।।
kārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ svasvarājye samantataḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa ca sarvān śrīharirnijamandire ।।67।।
kālimāśanṛpoktyā vai prāsādikaṃ tu naikadhā ।
sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya lālāyanamunergṛham ।।68।।
yayau śrībhagavān pūrvasamudre dvīpasaṃsthitam ।
prāsādikaṃ ca tat kṛtvā tvāyayau vyomamārgataḥ ।।69।।
kālimāśanṛpasaudhaṃ viśrāntiṃ prāpa vai niśi ।
lālāyanamṛṣiṃ sādhuṃ saccidānandasaṃjñitam ।।2.134.70।।
dīkṣitaṃ śrīharistvāha vraja tvaṃ cottarān kurūn ।
tava dvīpātpūrvadeśān kenāṭadvīpasaṃyutān ।।71 ।।
amarīṇāṃ pradeśāँśca mama bhaktiṃ prakāraya ।
ityādato yatiḥ so'pi yayau kenāṭakān kurūn ।।72।।
vyomamārgeṇa yogena bahuśaktisamanvitaḥ ।
atha rātrau hariḥ prāpa viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ punaḥ ।।73।।
pūrṇāyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā dhyānaparo'bhavat ।
tāvat tatrā'bhavad rādhe mahāścaryaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।।74।।
vimānaṃ tvakṣarāddhāmno muktayuktaṃ samujjvalam ।
āyātaṃ drāk sthiraṃ tasthau śrīhareḥ sannidhau tataḥ ।।75।।
pārṣadāstadvimānāccā'vatīrya puruṣottamam ।
rādhike! pūjayāmāsuḥ prāhurbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।76।।
śūrajārasya muktyarthaṃ tathā tasya tu yoṣitaḥ ।
devavarūthinīnāmnyā mokṣārthaṃ bhavadājñayā ।।77।।
yathā pratiśrutaṃ tadvat smṛtvā samāgatā vayam ।
ājñāpaya yathā kṛṣṇa tathā smaḥ sevane ratāḥ ।।78।।
śrīhariṃ śrāvayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ bhūbhṛte tadā ।
saṃprayujyā''śiṣo rājñe kālimeśāya śaktaye ।।79।।
vīrajāreṇa sahitaḥ śūrajārādisaṃyutaḥ ।
śrīharivīrajārasya rājyaṃ cobīnadītaṭe ।।2.134.80।।
āyayau suvimānena nijamaṇḍalasevitaḥ ।
śūrajāraṃ tathā devavarūthinīṃ tadā hariḥ ।।8 1 ।।
prāpayanmokṣakaṃ divyaṃ tvakṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।
atha śrībhagavāँstūrṇa bālakṛṣṇasarovaram ।।82।।
āyayau tadvimānena śibirājālaye punaḥ ।
tharkūṭastho harerājñāṃ prāpya rājyaṃ nijaṃ yayau ।।83।।
athāścaryamabhūttatra kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāyayuḥ ।
divyarūpadharāḥ sarvāstriśūlinyastrinetrikāḥ ।।84।।
tathā kumārāścatvāraste'pi triśūlanetrikāḥ ।
divyā yogakalāyuktā mahaiśvaryādiśālinaḥ ।।85।।
athā'nye puruṣā divyāḥ śvetāstriśūlanetrakāḥ ।
catvāraścaṃcalā dīrghāḥ sthūlāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।86।।
pañcā'pare ca puruṣāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāstriśūlinaḥ ।
trinetrā divyarūpāśca dīrghāḥ kṛśāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।87।।
ekaḥ kaścid durbalaśca niḥśastro'pi samāyayau ।
rūkṣavarṇo'pi sukhavān niścintaścañcalo'pi san ।।88।।
evamete samāgatya triṃśatte harisannidhau ।
nipeturdaṇḍavat kṛṣṇapādayorbhaktisaṃyutāḥ ।।89।।
dhanyā vayaṃ vayaṃ dhanyā uddhṛtāḥ paramātmanā ।
ityuktvā bahuratnādyaiḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।2.134.90 ।।
ārārtrikādikaṃ cakruḥ satkṛtāḥ śibinā tu te ।
niṣeduścātha saṃpṛṣṭāḥ ke yūyaṃ devarūpiṇaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
jagaduste vayaṃ rudrasṛṣṭāḥ purā tadātmajāḥ ।
rudrasṛṣṭervināśe'tra pracchannā vāsakāriṇaḥ ।।92।।
sadā vartāmahe tvadya pāvitāḥ paramātmanā ।
dehi mantrān vaiṣṇavāँśca kuru śrīparameśvara ।। 93।।
ityevaṃ tvarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dadau manūn ।
tatra yāḥ kanyakāstvāsan rodryaḥ putryastu tā yathā ।।94।।
urulā bālikā irātriśā obī ca māniśī ।
bīnā tribalā trāsā ca tuṃgāsikā anāvarā ।।95।।
ālanaukā uṣṭrīyāskā yānā anādirā tathā ।
anāṃśukā kālimā ca vaiṣṇavyastāstadā'bhavan ।।96।।
kumārāścāpi catvāro nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike! ।
bālakṛśo dvikalaśca alpamātro yurālakaḥ ।।97।।
te'pi mantrāँstadā prāpya vaiṣṇavāścā'bhavan śubhāḥ ।
anye dīrghāśca puruṣā nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike ।।98।।
akṣoḍhā kārakaścāpi kaśyapāyo dviriṃgakaḥ ।
te'pi mantrān jagṛhuśca vaiṣṇavāścā'bhavaँstadā ।।99।।
anye ca pañca puruṣā nāmnā tān śṛṇu rādhike! ।
ūrulaśca samānaśca stenāvāsaḥ prabhālunaḥ ।। 2.134.10 0।।
āpatāyī ta aivāpi jagṛhurvaiṣṇavān manūn ।
vaiṣṇavāścā'bhavaँścā'tha yaścaiko durbalo janaḥ ।। 101 ।।
nāmnā śivaraṇaścā'yaṃ jagrāha ca manūँstadā ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ samajāyanta sarve śrīharisevakāḥ ।। 1 02।।
ājñāṃ gṛhītvā kanyāstā nadīrūpā yayuḥ sthalam ।
catvārastu kumārā vai sarorūpā yayuśca te ।। 1 03।।
catvāraścāpi puruṣāścābdhirūpā yayuśca te ।
pañcāpi puruṣāścaite śailarūpā yayuśca te ।। 1 04।।
eko rūkṣo durbalaśca raṇarūpo yayau tataḥ ।
tīrtharūpā nyavasaँśca tārakā dehināṃ sadā ।। 1 05।।
śibidevakuṭumbaṃ tad dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaparaṃ hyabhūt। ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tattattīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīsaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarveṣāṃ mahīmānānāṃ vidāyasatkāraḥ, vaiṣṇavīghoṣaṇā, saccidānandalālāyanasyottarakurūn prati preṣaṇaṃ,
śūrajāradampatīmokṣaḥ, triṃśadraudrīraudrātmajānāṃ vaiṣṇvībhavanam, tāni tīrthāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 134 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 134 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 135
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 136 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
śibeḥ saudhe hyuṣitvā tatkṛtāṃ sevāṃ pragṛhya ca ।। 1 ।।
vinirgamayya ca niśāṃ māghādyadivase prage ।
naityakaṃ daivikaṃ kṛtvā''diśya dharmān susāttvatān ।। 2 ।।
prāpya dattāṃ mahāpūjāṃ bhojanaṃ copadādikam ।
sarvān śubhāśīrvacanaiḥ saṃprayujya prasādya ca ।। 3 ।।
devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ tathā śrīlomaśādikān ।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvā akṣarakṣetravāsinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
kṣetrapān devatīrthāni kuṭumbaṃ pārṣadādikān ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi bhrātṝn bhrātṛvadhūstathā ।। 5 ।।
bhaginīṃ tatsakhīṃ cāpi rājā'rpitāśca kanyakāḥ ।
saurāṣṭrīyajanān naijān vimāneṣu naveṣu ca ।। 6 ।।
niṣādya svavimānena vyomamārgeṇa sañcaran ।
indukuśaṃ samatītya sindhuvyoma vilaṃghya ca ।। 7 ।।
badarikāśramaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā naraṃ narāyaṇam ।
ṛṣīn dṛṣṭvā tāpasāँśca tataḥ śrīkāśikāṃ yayau ।। 8 ।।
varaṇāyāstaṭe naijāṃ lakṣmīṃ śivasutāṃ satīm ।
śivarājaṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ candraṃ jayaṃ ca jānakīm ।। 9 ।।
dṛṣṭvā sarvān sammilitvā snātvā gaṃgājale tataḥ ।
viśveśaṃ sarvadevāṃśca dṛṣṭvā sampūjya sarvathā ।। 2.135.1 0।।
vimānaiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhike! cāyayāvaśvapaṭṭakṣetraṃ nijaṃ śubham ।। 11 ।।
prajābhirjayakāraiśca vardhitāstīrthakāriṇaḥ ।
vimānāni tvakṣaraṃ tat kṣetraṃ tu vārasaptakam ।। 12।।
bhramitvā kuṃkumavāpīṃ vilokyodyānavāṭikāḥ ।
sarvān vijñāpya ca nijāgamaṃ vai paścime tataḥ ।। 13 ।।
avaterurmahodyāne sthairyamāptāni vai tataḥ ।
puṣpākṣataiśca lājābhiḥ satkṛtāni prajājanaiḥ ।। 14।।
vimānebhyo bahiḥ sarve nirgatyā''pṛcchya vai muhuḥ ।
kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cānā'mayaṃ datvā sragādikam ।। 15।।
satkṛtya ca samāśliṣya svasvasthānaṃ yayurjanāḥ ।
nivāsārheṣu saudheṣu nijān harirnyavāsayat ।। 16।।
bhojayāmāsa śīghraṃ ca viśaśramuśca te tathā ।
prāhiṇot kanyakāḥ sarvāstadā brahmapriyāyutāḥ ।। 17।।
lomaśasyā''śrame ramye sadā māyāvivarjite ।
rarakṣa lomaśaḥ sarvā divyamuktottamo muniḥ ।। 18।।
ṛṣayo devatādyāśca kṣetrapāstatravāsinaḥ ।
bhuktvā naijānnivāsāँśca yayurviśrāntimāgaman ।। 19।।
hariḥ kuṭumbasahito bhuktvā viśrāntimāpa ca ।
dvitīyāyā dine prātaḥ kṛtvā svaṃ naityakaṃ vidhim ।। 2.135.20।।
mahīmānān surāṣṭrīyān bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
kanthādharādyāśca tathā raṇaṃgamādayo'pi ca ।। 21 ।।
viprāḥ śīlavratādyāśca maharṣayo'pi sādhavaḥ ।
ājñāṃ prāpya harernaijān grāmān yayuḥ samantataḥ ।।22।।
devāyatanakaṃ prāha hariḥ prasannamānasaḥ ।
tvayā bhakta kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ rāśirājyakam ।।23।।
naitādṛśaṃ mahat kāryaṃ vinā bhaktena jāyate ।
pāvitāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vai narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ ।।24।।
prasanno'smi vadā'deyaṃ tava me naiva vidyate ।
śṛṇu sarvaṃ dadāmyeva yatte manasi vartate ।।25।।
ityuktvā ca samākṛṣya mimile vakṣasā svayam ।
mastake śrīharistasya hastau tatra nyadhāt kṣaṇam ।।26।।
hṛdaye caraṇau divyau dadau śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
devāyano'pi bhakto'sau pūrṇakāmo'sti rādhike ।।27।।
tato vavre bhaktarāṭ sa gṛhaṃ te vai bhavāmyaham ।
yatra yatra bhavānāste pararūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।।28।।
avatārasvarūpaścaiśvare daive ca mānuṣe ।
vibhavākhyo'thavā vyūhasvarūpo'pyathavāṃ'śakaḥ ।।29।।
arcārūpo'thavā''veśakalāvibhūtirūpavān ।
śaktirūpo devarūpo yatrāste bhagavān bhavān ।।2.135.3 0।।
tatra tatra gṛhaṃ me'stu madgṛhe vasa sarvadā ।
hariḥ prāha ca dhanyo'si tvadātmakagṛhe'nvaham ।।3 1।।
yathā vasāmi saukhyena tathā tvaṃ bhava madgṛham ।
cetano muktarūpo'si saccidānandavigrahaḥ ।।32।।
tathā kāryasvarūpo'pi mama devālayo bhava ।
devālaye sadā cā'haṃ nivatsye sṛṣṭimaṇḍale।।33।।
prāsādo me bhavatveva gataḥ prāsādapātratām ।
yatrā'haṃ tatra sarvatra devāyatanako bhava ।।34।।
anekaśaktisampannaścānekarūpadhṛgbhava ।
jaḍavad dṛśyarūpastvaṃ tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।।35।।
devālanāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhava tvaṣṭṛpravardhitaḥ ।
adhidevo'tirūpaśca darśanīyo hi dehinām ।।36।।
darśayiṣye ca rūpāṇi devālayātmakāni te ।
ityuktvā bhagavānasmai devāyatanakāya ca ।।37।।
darśayāmāsa śikharānvitaṃ devālayaṃ śubham ।
nijamūrtau tato mūrtidevālaye'pi tiṣṭhati ।। 38।।
tādṛśaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvāṃge devatālayam ।
vedikāṃ jagatīṃ bhīṭaṃ pīṭhaṃ maṇḍovaraṃ tathā ।। 39।।
śṛṃgaṃ padmaśilāṃ cāpi kalaśaṃ dhvajamityapi ।
agragaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cāpi gajāsanaṃ pradakṣiṇam ।।2.135.40।।
sarvaṃ mūrtau harirnaijasvarūpāyāṃ tadā muhuḥ ।
devatāyatanāyaiva devatāyatanātmakam ।।41।।
darśayāmāsa viśadaṃ jñānaṃ divyaṃ dadau tathā ।
devāyatanakaḥ prāpya jñānaṃ ca bhavanātmatām ।। 42।।
kṛtakṛtyo'bhavannamro babhūva dvitvarūpavān ।
muktarūpastathā devālayarūpo'tiśobhanaḥ ।।43।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divyo devālayo'bhavat ।
sahasraḥ hastamānaḥ sa prāsādo'bhavadambare ।।44।।
yaddhaṭāścābbhrasalilaiḥ snānti nityaṃ dhvajānvitāḥ ।
tādṛśaṃ khalu bhagavān cakāra svaṃ śubhālayam ।।45।।
vijñāyaitadṛṣayaśca siddhāḥ devyaśca devatāḥ ।
jalajāḥ sthalajāścāpi catuḥkhanisusambhavāḥ ।।46।।
īśā īśvaramukhyāśca tattvāni cetanānyapi ।
vṛkṣā vallyaścākṛtayo garuḍā gajavājinaḥ ।।47।।
yoginyaḥ puṣpavallyaśca stambā mumukṣavastathā ।
araṇyasthā ambarasthā anye'pi saudhayoginaḥ ।।48।।
jñātvā devāyatanasya devālayasvarūpatām ।
tatra vāsaṃ cehamānāścāyayurharisannidhau ।।49।।
sadehāḥ śrīhareḥ sevāmicchanto bhaktibhāvukāḥ ।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ hi te ।।2.135.50।।
kṛpānātha dayāsindho sarvātman sarvarakṣaka ।
sarvāśrayapradātastvaṃ dehi vāsaṃ nijālaye ।।51 ।।
bhaktavatsalasaṃjño'si tava sarvaṃ śarīrakam ।
tvāṃ vinā naiva lokānāṃ vāsaḥ sukhāya kalpyate ।।52।।
devatāyatano bhakto bhaktyā tvadālayo'bhavat ।
vayaṃ te kṛpayā dāsāstvadālayanivāsinaḥ ।।53।।
bhavema iti viśvātman dhārayāmaḥ pradehi tat ।
tānāha bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśreyaḥparāyaṇaḥ ।।54।।
durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ matvā bhavadbhistvarthitaṃ nviha ।
mamā''layo bhavatyeva tredhā yatra vasāmyaham ।।55।।
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ muktisthānaṃ mamā''layaḥ ।
yatrā'kṣaraṃ bhaved brahma tatrā'haṃ nivasāmi vai ।।56।।
yatra vāso hi muktānāṃ nā'nyeṣāṃ bhavati kvacit ।
māyāpāraṃ gatānāṃ ca brahmavidāṃ ca yoginām ।।57।।
yatra pūrve santi sādhyā devā nityanivāsinaḥ ।
jīvabhāvaṃ parityajya ceśabhāvaṃ vihāya ca ।।58।।।
māyākarmāśayaṃ dagdhvā mamā''rādhanatatparāḥ ।
me dhyānaparamā bhūtvā kṣālitā'śeṣakāraṇāḥ ।।59।।
śuddhāḥ sañcinmayānandā matprapannā madarthakāḥ ।
manmūrtau saṃyamaparāste yānti brahma cā'kṣaram ।।2.135.60।।
matkṛpāleśato divyā ye saṃbhūtā madātmakāḥ ।
madanyalayabhāvāste me yānti brahma cākṣaram ।।61 ।।
māyāvikṛtilubdhānāṃ māyāmiṣṭarasātmanām ।
māyā'haṃbhāvayuktānāṃ māyāsvabhāvaśālinām ।।62।।।
svārthasādhanayatnānāṃ rāgārthaṃ yatatāṃ sadā ।
madbhāvanāvihīnānāṃ na sthānaṃ brahmaṇi kvacit ।।63।।
mama bhaktivihīnānāṃ mama mārgā'vidāṃ tathā ।
mama mantrādiśūnyānāṃ na sthānaṃ brahmaṇi kvacit ।।64।।
ityevaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ mayoktaṃ tanmamā'kṣaram ।
tadanyad vai dvitīyaṃ tu sthānaṃ me hṛdayaṃ satām ।।65।।
yatrā'haṃ sarvadā vāsaṃ prakurve cetanālaye ।
mama muktā mahāmuktāścā'kṣaraṃ brahma cetyapi ।।66।।
muktānāṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ satāṃ vai jīvatāmiha ।
vasāmo militāḥ sarve hṛdayeṣu satāṃ vayam ।।67।।
tatra vai vāsanā nāsti nāsti māyāvikāritā ।
tatra matto'tiriktaṃ vai nāsti tato vasāmyaham ।।68।।
mama mūrtiḥ sadā divyā'kṣaradhāmanivāsinī ।
bhaktidharmayutā tatra rājate hṛdaye satām ।।69।।
dharmavaṃśo mama mūrto yo'sti divyaguṇātmakaḥ ।
te guṇāstatra rājante hṛdaye vai satāṃ sadā ।।2.135.70।।
śraddhā śāntirdayā medhā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirgatistathā ।
lajjā maitrī titikṣā ca buddhirmūrtiḥ kriyonnatiḥ ।।71 ।।
dharmapriyā vasantyeva sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye sadā ।
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ cā'bhayaṃ tapa ārjavam ।।72।।
satyaṃ kṣemaḥ sukhaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyaṃ dhairyaṃ ca mārdavam ।
nigrahastyāga āstikyaṃ santoṣaśca kṣamā smṛtiḥ ।।73।।
damo yajñaḥ śamo yogaścoparatirupāsanā ।
prasādaśca śubhaṃ tejaḥ svādhyāyaḥ praśrayaśca mud ।।74।।
dhyānaṃ sāmyaṃ brahmavidyā lābhaḥ sāmārtha udyamaḥ ।
śravaṇādyā bhaktirūpā vasanti hṛdaye satām ।।75।।
tatrā'haṃ sarvadā śānto nivasāmi prasannahṛt ।
sadālayo mama yūyaṃ tatra vāso'nyadurlabhaḥ ।।76 ।।
amuktānāṃ mama mantravihīnānāṃ kadācana ।
mamā'bhaktimatāṃ vāso mama satsu na vidyate ।।77।।
yeṣāṃ vai tvakṣare vāso yeṣāṃ ca hṛdaye satām ।
teṣāṃ vāsaḥ sadā yogyo mama devālaye śubhaḥ ।।78।।
athā'yaṃ bhaktavaryo'dya devāyatanako'bhavat ।
devālayasvarūpo'pi jaḍaprakhyo'pi cetanaḥ ।।79।।
tatra vāsaṃ jaḍacaitye prāsāde yadi cecchatha ।
mama mantrān pragṛhṇantu mama bhaktā bhavantu ca ।।2.135.80।।
vinā me sāttvatān bhaktān sthātumarhanti netare ।
lomaśo'yamṛṣiśreṣṭho mantrān vaḥ sampradāsyati ।।8 1 ।।
vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃbhavantvatra tato vasantu madgṛhe ।
ityuktā devatādyāśca dehinaḥ śrīhariṃ tadā ।।82।।
natvā samarcya sampūjyā''jñayā śrīlomaśaṃ yayuḥ ।
lomaśo'pi dadau tebhyo mantrān cakāra vaiṣṇavān ।।83।।
tataste devasadanaṃ devāyatanamāyayuḥ ।
nemurdevāyatanakaṃ nipeturharipādayoḥ ।।84।।
haryājñayā vaiṣṇavāste devālayanivāsinaḥ ।
bhavituṃ dīkṣitā jātāstadā devālayo'bravīt ।।85।।
bhagavan caṃcalā devāṃścañcalā dehinastathā ।
bhītiyuktāḥ sadā tvete hyāpatkāle samāgate ।।86।।
āsuropadravaṃ jñātvā vidraveyurna ced yadi ।
madhye madhye vihāyaiva gaccheyurna sthalāntaram ।।87।।
nityavāsapratijñāṃ cet kuryuste tava sannidhau ।
tadā vāsaḥ pradeyaḥ syādebhyaśceti vidhiṃ kuru ।।88।।
bālakṛṣṇastu tacchrutvā devālayavacaḥ śubham ।
hitaṃ pathyaṃ tathā satyaṃ prāha prārthayatastadā ।।89।।
yathā devālayo vakti tathā cenmanyate yadi ।
śapathān kurutā'traiva tadā vāsaṃ dadāmyaham ।।2.135.90।।
yāvad devālayastiṣṭhejjīrṇo vā bhittimātrakaḥ ।
yāvaddevo'pi tiṣṭhecca tāvatstheyaṃ tadālaye ।।91 ।।
devatāyatano devo yadā sthānaṃ vihāya ca ।
sarvakālārthamudgacchet tadā gamyaṃ na cānyathā ।।92।।
ityevaṃ vai pratijñāṃ ca kurutā'tra tadā'pyaham ।
vāsaṃ dadāmi devāyatane devālaye sadā ।।93।।
ityuktāste pratijñāṃ vai tathā cakrurnirantarām ।
yāvad devālayastiṣṭhed yāvattiṣṭhecca devatā ।।94।।
tāvadvastavyamevā'tra mahāpatkālake'pi ca ।
ityuktvā ca jalaṃ pītvā prāsādikaṃ kṣitāvapi ।।95।।
jalaṃ pramucya caraṇe hareḥ surādayo'spṛśan ।
ityevaṃ śapathaṃ prāptāḥ prāptā vāsaṃ mahālaye ।।96।।
devālaye harervāse vāsārhā vaiṣṇavā hi te ।
yāvaddevālayastasmāt taddevo'pi ca tiṣṭhati ।।97।।
tāvadvai rādhike devālayāṃ'gāni ca sarvadā ।
tiṣṭhantyeveti bhagnāśca khaṇḍitā api rādhike! ।।98।।
jīrṇoddhārastato devālayasya hitado nṛṇām ।
prasannā devatāṃśāste sukhayanti sahāyinaḥ ।।99।।
evaṃ prasannatāṃ prāpya devāyatanako muniḥ ।
devālayātmatāṃ prāptastathā devā nivāsanam ।। 2.135.10 0।।
kṛpayā śrīhareḥ prāptāstān named dūro'pi vai ।
śālagrāme khaṇḍite'pi yathā vasāmi sarvadā ।। 101 ।।
devālaye prabhagne'pi jīrṇe'pi mūrtisaṃyute ।
vasāmyeva tvahaṃ yāvad devāyatanako'pi ca ।। 1 02।।
vasatyeva tu tāvadvai mamā''jñāṃ mūrdhni dhārayan ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya devālayaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhareraśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ prapyāgamanaṃ, akṣaradhāmni satāṃ hṛtsu devālayamūrtau ceti harestredhā vāsaḥ, devāyatanarṣerdevālayasvarūpatā, devālayāṃgadevānāmapi sthairyādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 135 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 135 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 136
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 137 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! devāyatanako bhaktarāṭ punaḥ ।
papraccha śrīhariṃ jñātuṃ prāsādanirmitiṃ tadā ।। 1 ।।
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ jñātumaṃgapramāṇakam ।
antarmānāni sarvāṇi vijñātuṃ mandirasya vai ।। 2 ।।
bhagavan devadeveśa devālaye yathā yathā ।
aṃgāni mūlato yāni bhavanti cā''dhvajaṃ vada ।। 3 ।।
yenā'haṃ ca mamāṃ'gāni jānīyāṃ yatra devatāḥ ।
ādhyātmikyaṃ imāścāpi nivatsyanti tanau mama ।। 4 ।।
ityasya vai svarūpaṃ ca jñātvā prāsādakasya ca ।
anye prāsādavaryāśca bhaviṣyanti sajātayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
śilpino viśvakarmāṇo yadādhārān svabuddhibhiḥ ।
prāsādān kalpayiṣyanti naikarūpāँstaduttaram ।। 6 ।।
tasmād vada harekṛṣṇa prāsādāṃgavivecanām ।
hitakṛd devavāsānāṃ yanmūlaḥ śilpivistaraḥ ।। 7 ।।
itipṛṣṭo harikṛṣṇastamuvāca samāsataḥ ।
rekhālakṣyātmarūpaṃ vai devāyatanakaṃ munim ।। 8 ।।
saptayavodarairmītaścā'ṅgulo madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
caturviśatyaṃgulaiśca hasto vai parikīrtitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
hasto'yaṃ gajasaṃjño'sti devaprāsādke tathā ।
pratimāyāṃ ca liṅge ca pīṭhe ca maṇḍape tathā ।। 2.136.1 0।।
rājaprāsādike cāpi mahādīrghanivāsake ।
dīrghaharmye pṛthivyāṃ ca hastenā'nena māpayet ।। 1 1।।
devaprāsādake cāpi maṇḍape bhittibāhyataḥ ।
mānaṃ grāhyaṃ ca śikhare mandire devatālaye ।। 1 2।।
pṛthivyā dīrghatāyāṃ vai hastasaṃkhyā tu yāvatī ।
guṇitā sā prakartavyā vyāsatā hastasaṃkhyayā ।। 12 ।।
utpannā yā hastasaṃkhyā bhañjanīyā'ṣṭasaṃkhyayā ।
śeṣasaṃkhyā bhavedaiva āyanāmnīti viśrutā ।। 14।।
ekā'ṅkastu dhvajāyaḥ syāt pañcā'ṅkastu vṛṣāyakaḥ ।
saptasaṃkhyā gajāyaḥ syād devālaye ta uttamāḥ ।। 11।।
dhvajāye tvarthalābhaḥ syād vṛṣāyo dhanadhānyadaḥ ।
kalyāṇado gajāyaśca mandirādau matā ime ।। 16 ।।
prāsāde ca pratimāyāṃ liṅge pṛthvyāṃ ca maṇḍape ।
pīṭhe siṃhāsane vedyāṃ kuṇḍe dhvaje ca cāmare ।। 17।।
chatre vāpyāṃ taṭāke ca kūpe devāsane'mbare ।
bhūṣāyāṃ pīṭhikāyāṃ ca hāre mukuṭake tathā ।। 18।।
dhvajāyaḥ sarvathā śreṣṭho grāhyaḥ śilpikalāvidā ।
śeṣe tritve tu siṃhāyaḥ siṃhāsane śubho mataḥ ।। 1 9।।
devālaye dhvajāyaḥ syācchreṣṭha eva na saṃśayaḥ ।
vṛṣāyo vā gajāyo vā na grāhyo devatālaye ।।2.136.2 0।।
dhvajāyo na bhaveccedvai gajāyastatra gṛhyate ।
pūrvāyāstu dhvajaḥ svāmī paścimāyā vṛṣāyakaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
uttarāyā gajāyo'sti siṃhāyo dakṣiṇādiśaḥ ।
kṣetrāyāmaṃ guṇayecca vistāreṇa tataśca tām ।। 22।।
saṃkhyāṃ vibhañjyācca saptaviṃśatyā śeṣakaṃ ca yat ।
bhavettadaṃkasaṃkhyākaṃ nakṣatraṃ veśmano bhavet ।। 23।।
nakṣatraṃ bhañjayitvā vai aṣṭākhyasaṃkhyayā tataḥ ।
śeṣasaṃkhyā vyayasaṃjñā nyūnā sā cā''yato yadi ।। 24।।
śreṣṭhā sā narasaṃjñā'sti dhanadhānyādidāyinī ।
vyayo'dhiko rākṣasaḥ syāt samānastu piśācakaḥ ।।25।।
aśubhau tau sadā bodhyau naravyayo hi lābhadaḥ ।
aṣṭau vyayāśca te bodhyāḥ śeṣaike śāntanāmakaḥ ।।26।।
dhvajāyena samaṃ śānto vyayo deyaḥ phalapradaḥ ।
siṃhāyena samaṃ pauro vyayo deyo dvitīyakaḥ ।।27।।
vṛṣāyena samaṃ deyaḥ śriyānandastu pañcamaḥ ।
gajāyena samaṃ deyaḥ śrīvatso vyaya eva ca ।।28।।
kṣetrapāste prakīrtyante pūjitā vighnanāśakāḥ ।
maṇiratnasuvarṇādyaiḥ prāsādā devatāpriyāḥ ।।29।।
nadyāstaṭe pure tīrthe siddhāśrame ca gahvare ।
udyāne ca taṭāke ca kāryā devālayāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 2.136.30 ।।
nagarābhimukhāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāsādāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ।
teṣu madhye ca bāhye ca devatāḥ sukhadā sadā ।।3 1 ।।
śrīḥ kubero gaṇeśaśca gopure sukhadāḥ sadā ।
madhye vā svasya nilaye sukhadāḥ santi vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।32।।
rātrau pṛthvyāṃ pradīpaṃ ca saṃsthāpya dhruvatārake ।
avalambanasūtreṇa rekhaikyaṃ lekhayed budhaḥ ।। 33 ।।
uttarā sā diśā śuddhā kīlakairniścitāṃ tu tām ।
kuryādāvāri niravanedāśilābhāgabhūtalam ।।34।।
pāṣāṇānte jalānte vā kūrmaśilāṃ niveśayet ।
yaddiśi syātsarpamukhaṃ tasyāṃ khātaṃ na cācaret ।।35।।
catuṣṣaṣṭicatuṣkīnāṃ kāryamekaṃ hi koṣṭhakam ।
samakoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ kṛtvā cobhayatodiśi ।।36।।
ravyādivāsarāँstatra likhedaṣṭau kramādapi ।
catuṣkoṇe raviryathā patellikhettathāvidham ।। 37।।
tatra koṣṭhe maṃgalasya paṃktau nāgamukhaṃ mahat ।
śaneḥ paṃktau maṃgalasya paṃktau deho mato'sya vai ।। 38।।
śanaiḥ paṃktau tathā pucchaṃ bhavennāgāsyakoṣṭhake ।
dehasthale na vai khātaṃ kartavyaṃ kvacideva ca ।।39।।
kanyātulāvṛścike ca ravau pūrve mukhaṃ bhavet ।
bhādreṣorjeṣvapi nāgamukhaṃ pūrve bhavet sadā ।।2.136.40 ।।
tatastrike ca dakṣe syāt tatastrike tu paścime ।
tatastrike uttare syāt tatra khātaṃ na kārayet ।।41 ।।
kukṣidvayasya vai pārśve khātaṃ śastaṃ mataṃ yathā ।
yadi nāgamukhaṃ pūrve vāyavye khātamācaret ।।42।।
dakṣiṇe cet sarpamukhaṃ tvaiśānyāṃ khātamācaret ।
paścime cennāgamukhaṃ khātaṃ vahnau tadācaret ।।43।।
uttare cennāgamukhaṃ nairṛtye khātamācaret ।
devālayeṣu sarvatra nikhaned vāmakukṣike ।।44।।
gajaikamānaprāsāde caturaṃgulakūrmakaḥ ।
tato daśagajaṃ yāvad dvyaṃgulāṃ pratihastakam ।।45।।
kūrmaṃ saṃvardhayet kūrmaśilā yogyā tu sā matā ।
daśato viṃśatiṃ yāvadekāṃgulāṃ vivardhayet ।।46।।
viṃśatitaśca pañcāśadgajaṃ cārdhāṃgulaṃ dharet ।
iṣṭakānāṃ tu prāsāde iṣṭakākūrmakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।47।।
pāṣāṇānāṃ mandirādau pāṣāṇasya hi kūrmakaḥ ।
kūrmaśilā'dhobhāge'ṣṭāṃ'śakaṃ padmaṃ samācaret ।।48।।
ekagajāyatā cā'ṣṭāṃ'gulordhvā caturasrikā ।
pāṣāṇasaudhe dātavyā svasthākhyā sā sahāyadā ।।49।।
iṣṭikānāṃ tu saudheṣu kūrmārdhāṃgulamānataḥ ।
kṛtvā kūrmaśilā deyā sthaulye sā syād dhruvapradā ।।2.136.50।।
kūrmaśilopari kāryā nava vai koṣṭhakāstataḥ ।
agnisthe koṣṭhake vāridṛśyaṃ matsyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe ।।51 ।।
nairṛte maṇḍukadṛśyaṃ paścime makaradṛśiḥ ।
vāyavye tu grāsamukhamuttare śaṃkhadarśanam ।।52।।
caiśāne sarpadṛśyaṃ ca pūrve kuṃbhasya darśanam ।
navame madhyabhāge vai kūrmaḥ kārya itisthitiḥ ।।53।।
nandā bhadrā jayā riktā tathā'jitā'parājitā ।
śuklau saubhāginī cātha dharaṇī navamī matā ।।54।।
kūrmaḥ kāryaścaikahaste devālaye'ṅgulā'rdhakaḥ ।
suvarṇasyā'thavā raupyakasya śreṣṭhaḥ sa sammataḥ ।।55।।
paścāt pratyekahastena āpaṃcadaśahastakam ।
ardhāṃ'gulena kūrmo'yaṃ vardhanīyo bhavediti ।।56।।
pañcadaśādekatriṃśadgajaparyantameva tu ।
caturthāṃśāṃ'gulavṛddhiḥ kūrmasyaiveṣyate sadā ।।57।।
ekatriṃśādāpañcāśadgajaparyantameva tu ।
ekaikadorakasyaiva vṛddhiḥ kūrme pradīyate ।।58।।
dugdhadadhighṛtamadhuśarkarābhiḥ sakūrmakaḥ ।
snapanīyastataḥ sthāpyo dharaṇīnāmako hi saḥ ।।59।।
patrā''yo naiva kartavyaḥ kartavyaśchidravarjitaḥ ।
madhye ca vyomaśūnyaśca kartavyo bhāgavarjitaḥ ।।2.136.6 0 ।।
maṇibhiḥ pūjanīyaścācchādanīyaḥ pravālakaiḥ ।
yā nandādyāścāṣṭadikṣu śilāstāśca śubhā yathā ।।6 1 ।।
prāsāde tvekahaste tu matā saptāṃgulā śilā ।
tataḥ pañcagajaṃ yāvat dvyaṃgulāstāḥ śilāḥ matāḥ ।।6 2।।
tato vai daśahaste tu tryaṃgulāstāḥ śilā matāḥ ।
tato viṃśatihaste tu pādonacaturaṃgulā ।।63।।
pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ sapādacaturaṃgulāḥ ।
samakoṇāścaturthāṃ'śasthūlāḥ kāryāḥ śilā nava ।।64।।
śilānāmupari cāgnikoṇe śaktiṃ pradāpayet ।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca daṇḍaṃ tu nairṛtyāyāṃ tu khaṅgakam ।।65।।
paścimāyāṃ tu pāśaṃ vai vāyavyāyāṃ tathāṃ'kuśam ।
uttarāyāṃ gadāṃ dadyād aiśānyāṃ tu triśūlakam ।।66।।
pūrvasyāṃ vajrakaṃ dadyānmakhaṃ tāsāṃ bahiryathā ।
raktaṃ śyāmaṃ cābhravarṇaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ śvetamambaram ।।67।।
haritaṃ śvetaṃ pītaṃ ca bastramācchādayet kramāt ।
khāte śilā'dhaḥ saṃpuṭāḥ sthāpanīyā nidhernava ।।68।।
śaṃkhaḥ padmo mahāpadmo makaraḥ kundanālakau ।
kacchapaśca mukundaśca kharvaśca nidhayo nava ।।69।।
īśānādagnikoṇādvā dakṣe śilā'ṣṭakā'rpaṇam ।
madhye kūrmaśilā paścād vedamāṃgalyagītikaiḥ ।।2.136.70 ।।
pūrve nandā sthāpanīyā tato'nyā dharaṇī tataḥ ।
śilāṣṭakodaraṃ sāvakāśaṃ rakṣyaṃ puṭādivat ।।।7 1।।
abhitaḥ pālikāḥ kṛtvopari sthāpyāḥ puṭādivat ।
dharaṇīnābhinālaṃ tu sāvakāśaṃ tadūrdhvake ।।।72।।
āsiṃhāsanaparyantaṃ cānayet sukhado hi saḥ ।
kūrmasya sthāpane śilāsthāpane ghṛtapakvakam ।।73 ।।
miṣṭānnaṃ devatābhyaśca dikpālebhyo'pi miṣṭakam ।
baliṃ dadyād divyavastraṃ śilpine śrīphalānvitam ।।74।।
brāhmaṇāyā'rpayed bhojyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vaidikāya ca ।
prāsādānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ jagatī vedikā matā ।।75।।
yāvatkoṇo bhavet devaprāsādo jagatī tathā ।
caturasrā tathā'ṣṭāsrā vartulā cā'yatā'thavā ।।76।।
prāsādarūparūpā tu vedikā vai praśasyate ।
vedikā jagatī pradakṣiṇā ceti samarthakāḥ ।।77।।
prāsādājjagatī kāryā ṣaḍguṇā śobhanā matā ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ saptaguṇā tu mandire ।।78।।
dviguṇā vā caturguṇā pañcaguṇā kvacinmatā ।
tribhramā jagatī śreṣṭhā dvibhramā tu ca madhyamā ।।79।।
ekabhramā kaniṣṭhā ca tribhramā viṣṇumandire ।
ucchrāyasya tribhāgena nyūnā dvitīyabhrāmiṇī ।।2.136.80 ।।
taducchrāyavibhāgena nyūnā tṛtīyabhrāmiṇī ।
evaṃ samucchrayaḥ kāryo bhramaṇīnāṃ tribhāgataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
catuṣkoṇā dvādaśakoṇā vā viṃśatikoṇakāḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatikoṇāḥ ṣaṭatriṃśatkoṇāstu cottamāḥ ।।82।।
prāsādaśced dvādaśahastā''yato jagatī tadā ।
āyatā'rthapramāṇena samucchrayavatī matā ।।83।।
dvāviṃśatigajā''yatye tattṛtīyāṃ'śakocchrayā ।
dvātriṃśadāyatabhāve caturthāṃ'śocchrayo mataḥ ।।84।।
pañcāśadāyatabhāve turye'pi caturaṃśikā ।
ucchraye samatā cāpi sadā nirvighnatākarī ।।।85।।।
jagatyucchrāyamānasya bhāgāḥ kāryāḥ samāḥ purā ।
aṣṭāviṃśatirevā'tha jāḍyakuṃbhastribhāgakaḥ ।।86।।
dvibhāgā karṇikā kāryā tribhāge sarapaṭṭikā ।
padmapatrayutā kāryā dvibhāgaḥ khurako mataḥ ।।87।।
saptabhāgo bhavet kuṃbhastribhāgaḥ kalaśo bhavet ।
ekabhāgā''ntarapatrī kapotālistribhāgajā ।।88।।
caturbhāgaḥ puṣpakaṇṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ sukhadā ime ।
nirgame puṣpakaṇṭho vai caturbhāgo hi gṛhyate ।।89।।
jāḍyakuṃbho'pi ca tathā caturbhāgo hi gṛhyate ।
karṇikāsu pūrvato vai samārabhya pradakṣiṇam ।।2.136.90।।
aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ sthāpyāḥ supratimāḥ śubhāḥ ।
śilāḥ prāsādadhartryastu dīrghāḥ puṣṭā nīrandhrakāḥ ।। 91 ।।
sthāpyā dṛḍhāḥ sucūrṇādyairavakāśavivarjitāḥ ।
jagatīdāśikāyāścopari bhīṭaṃ tato bhavet ।।92।।
gajaprāsādakabhīṭaṃ caturaṃgulamucchritam ।
kṛtvā tataśca pañcāśadgajaparyantameva tu ।।93।।
ardhāṃgulaṃ pratigajaṃ bhīṭamucchritameva ca ।
ekadvitrīṇi bhīṭāni coparyupari mānataḥ ।।94।।
caturthāṃśanyūnamānaiḥ kāraṇīyāni sarvathā ।
nikāso'pi caturthāṃ'śaḥ svasvocchrayapramāṇataḥ ।।95।।
bhīṭasyāṃ'śatrayaṃ kṛtvoparibhāge parārdhake ।
puṣpakacippikāḥ kāryāḥ pīṭhaṃ bhīṭopari nyaset ।। 96।।
prāsāde tvekahaste tu pīṭhaṃ vai dvādaśāṃgulam ।
pañcahastāvadhiṃ pañcāṃgulaṃ pratigajaṃ tataḥ ।।97।।
daśāvadhiṃ tato vṛddhiścaturaṃgulamānataḥ ।
viṃśāvadhiṃ tato vṛddhistryaṃgulā vai matā śubhā ।।98।।
ṣaṭtriṃśadavadhiṃ vṛddhiḥ sārdhaikāṃgulamānataḥ ।
pañcāśadgajaparyantamūnapādaḥ samucchrayaḥ ।।99।।
pañcamāṃśā'dhikā śreṣṭhā pīṭhavṛddhiḥ śubhā matā ।
ekaviṃśatisaṃbhāgāḥ prāsādasyocchraye ca ye ।। 2.136.1 00।।
pañcādinavabhāgāntaḥ pīṭhotsedho yatheṣṭakaḥ ।
śubhadaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ padmaṃ vasundharaṃ tathā ।। 10 1।।
siṃhaṃ vyomaṃ garuḍaṃ ca haṃsaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca pīṭhakam ।
navadhā pīṭhameva syāt pīṭhaṃ prāsādadhārakam ।। 1 02।।
pīṭhocchrāye tripaṃcāśad bhāgāḥ kāryāstataḥ param ।
dvāviṃśatibhāgāstu nirgame'rpyā vidhānataḥ ।। 103 ।।
navabhāgā jāḍyakubhe saptabhāgāstu karṇake ।
andhārīsahite bodhyāścāthāpi saptabhāgakāḥ ।। 1 04।।
chajjikāsahitagrāsapaṭṭikāyā matāstathā ।
hastistaro dvādaśāṃśe vājistaro daśāṃśake ।। 1 05।।
aṣṭabhāge narastaraḥ kartavyaḥ śubhadarśanaḥ ।
aśvastare mukhyadevavāhanasya staro'pi vā ।। 1 06।।
karṇakāgraprabhāvādvai pañcabhāgātmanirgamaḥ ।
jāḍyakuṃbho hi kartavyaḥ sārdhatribhāgakarṇakaḥ ।। 1 07।।
āntarālaścārdhabhāgaścaturbhāgā tataḥ param ।
chajjikāyuggrāsapaṭṭī kartavyā śobhanā parā ।। 1 08।।
hastistaraścaturbhāge nirgamo vājinirgamāt ।
prabhāgako hi kartavyonarastaro dvibhāgakaḥ ।। 109।।
starāṇāmantarāle ca tathordhve karṇikā tathā ।
chajjikā ca prakartavyā śobhākarī tu rādhike ।। 2.136.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe mandiranirmāṇe khātādyārabhya pīṭhakarṇīparyantaṃ mandirāṃgānāṃ nirdeśapramāpaṇādināmā ṣaṭtriṃśa-
dadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 136 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 136 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 137
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 138 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tato nārāyaṇaḥ prāha devāyatanakaṃ munim ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! maṇḍovarādikaṃ yathāyatham ।। 1 ।।
prāsādasya karṇarekhopari maṇḍovaraḥ smṛtaḥ ।
maṇḍovara udayinī ubhiṇīti samārthakāḥ ।। 2 ।।
hastādipañcahastasya prāsādasyodayaḥ khalu ।
prāsādā''yatatā sāmyā kartavyā śubhadā hi sā ।। 3 ।।
daśahastapraparyantaṃ caturdaśāṃ'gulocchrayaḥ ।
pratihastaṃ prakartavyastatastriṃśadgajāvadhim ।। 4 ।।
dvādaśāṃgulako maṇḍovaraḥ kāryastataḥ param ।
pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ navāṃgulobhiṇīṃ matā ।। 5 ।।
maṇḍovarasya bhāgāstu kartavyāḥ śilpinā yathā ।
catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśataṃ maṇḍavārakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
pīṭhasya mastakācchajjāmastakāntaṃ ca te matāḥ ।
khurakaḥ pañcabhāgeṣu viṃśatiḥ kuṃbhakastathā ।। 7 ।।
aṣṭabhāgeṣu kalaśo'ntarālaṃ sārdhakadvayam।
kapotikā'ṣṭabhāgeṣu mañcikā navabhāgikā ।। 8 ।।
pañcatriṃśadbhāgajaṃghā pañcadaśasu tūdgamaḥ ।
aṣṭabhāgā ca bharaṇī śirāvaṭṭī daśāṃśikā ।। 9 ।।
kapotāliścāṣṭabhāgā sārdhadvayā'ntarālakam ।
chādyaṃ trayodaśabhāgaṃ daśabhāgaśca nirgamaḥ ।। 2.137.10 ।।
khurakaḥ pañcabhāgordhvo dvibhāgastasya nirgamaḥ ।
bhāgārdhaṃ cāntarapatraṃ karṇakastu dvibhāgakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
vāpīskandhaḥ sārdhabhāgo bhāgaikaḥ kaṇakottamaḥ ।
kaṇakāgraṃ paṭṭikābhyāṃ śobhanīyaṃ sudarśanam ।। 1 2।।
paṭṭike nirgame bhāgaike ca bodhye nacā'dhike ।
kaṇako nirgame sapādaikabhāgo bhavediti ।। 13 ।।
kuṃbhakasya mahāpaṃktāvapaskandhasya nirgamaḥ ।
karṇakāvadhi kartavyastvatha vai kuṃbhakaṃ śṛṇu ।। 14।।
viṃśatibhāgakotsedhaḥ kuṃbhakastatra khaṇḍaśaḥ ।
bhāgārdhaḥ skandhapaṭṭo vai cippikā tvekabhāgataḥ ।। 15।।
skandhapaṭṭaḥ sulalito vartulaścitrapallavaḥ ।
kartavyaḥ śobhano yatra dṛśyaṃ vai sundaraṃ bhavet ।। 16।।
cippikāṃ kamalaiḥ patraiḥ śobhanīyāṃ vidhāpayet ।
prācyamadhyāvasāneṣu kuṃbhe brahmā harirharaḥ ।। 17।।
pratimāḥ rūpataḥ sthāpyā darśanārhāḥ sahetayaḥ ।
trisandhyābhadraśobhāṃ ca citrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। 18।।
skandhapaṭṭe prakuryādvai yathādṛśyaṃ manoharam ।
nāsikāḥ karṇanāmnyastu pratirathikāyā dale ।। 1 9।।
koṇeṣveva madhyagarbhe kāryāḥ sapratimāḥ śubhāḥ ।
staṃbhikāsu prakartavyaṃ toraṇaṃ padmapatravat ।।2.137.20।।
tathā kamaladaṇḍādyaiḥ śobhitaṃ susvarūpavat ।
vicitrākārarūpo'yaṃ kuṃbhakaḥ śreṣṭhako mataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
kuṃbhordhve kalaśaḥ kāryaścāṣṭabhāgaḥ suśobhanaḥ ।
ṣaḍbhāgo madhyabhāgo'sya kartavyo vai suśobhitaḥ ।। 22।।
vṛttarūpaḥ prakartavyastasyordhve cippikā śubhā ।
ekabhāge prakartavyā paṭṭabandha'pi śobhanaḥ ।।23 ।।
ratnayuktaḥ prakartavyastathā sārdhadvayāṃ'śake ।
antarālaṃ prakartavyaṃ divyapuṣpādiśobhitam ।।24।।
athā'ṣṭabhāgikā kāryā kapotālī śubhāvahā ।
bhāgārdhā skandhapaṭṭī ca skandhaḥ sapādakadvayaḥ ।।25 ।।
mukhapaṭṭī pādabhāge dvibhāge karṇapaṭṭikā ।
skandhasyanirgamaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayātmakaḥ śubhaḥ ।।26 ।।
bhāgārdhaḥ skandhapaṭṭaśca kartavyo galatāyutaḥ ।
mukhapaṭṭī ca kartavyā tadadho'gre gagārakāḥ ।।27।।
sanmukhau caturaṃgulāḥ sadṛśāḥ śobhanā matāḥ ।
ūrdhvaskandhastu kartavyo dalagarbhanikāsavān ।। 28।।
kapotālyaṃgagarbhordhve kartavyā tu ṭhagārikā ।
kapotālyupari kāryā mañcikā navabhāgikā ।।29।।
sapādabhāgaṃ cāntarapatrakaṃ ca tataḥ param ।
kāmarūpaṃ ca pādonaṃ paṭṭikā pādabhāgikā ।।2.137.3 0।।
skandho dvibhāgaḥ pāde ca mukhapaṭṭī tataḥ param ।
sapādāḥ karṇakastadvat skandho'pi ca sapādakaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
sapādāntarapatrī ca sārdhabhāgaḥ kaṇastathā ।
nirvāṇaṭṭikā pāde kartavyā śobhanā śubhā ।। 32।।
kapotālyāḥ sūtradārai kartavyāśca gagārakāḥ ।
jaṃghāstaṃbhā nirgamāḍhyāstadadhovṛttalumbikāḥ ।।33 ।।
tadūrdhve jaṃghikāḥ kāryāḥ pañcatriṃśatsubhāgagāḥ ।
golastaṃbhīyutā nāsāphalanāsahitāḥ śubhāḥ ।।34।।
sarvāsu mūlanāsāsu kāryāḥ staṃbhīcatuṣkikāḥ ।
gajaiḥ siṃhairgaruḍaiśca makarairhesakairyutāḥ ।। 356।।
karṇeṣu tvaṣṭadikpālāḥ pūrvākramāt pradakṣiṇe ।
nṛtyan rudraḥ paścabhāge'ndhakahantā sa dakṣiṇe ।।36 ।।
caṇḍanāśakarī daṃṣṭrānanā devī tathottare ।
pratirathe sūtradevāstathā diśādhipā api ।।37।।
munīndrā vārimārgeṣu kartavyāstapasi sthitāḥ ।
gavākṣakāśca bhadreṣu kartavyā nirgamānvitāḥ ।।38।।
pañcārabhaṇakaiḥ staṃbhaiśchādyaiśca tilakairyutāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumahādevaiḥ suśobhitāḥ sudarśanāḥ ।।39।।
gavākṣastambhikordhve'rdhagolatoraṇaśobhitāḥ ।
jaṃghāsu dampatī vāpi patrayūthāni vā tathā ।।2.137.40।।
mañjaryo vā tathā paryyaḥ kartavyāḥ śobhanā yathā ।
bharaṇī cāṣṭabhāgocchrā'dhaśchando golarūpavān ।।41 ।।
nirgamā grāsapaṭṭī ca bharaṇiskandhikāvaṭī ।
vartulā sā na kartavyā nirgame samasaddalā।।42।।
pādonaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ca pādā syāt skandhapaṭṭikā ।
cippikā cārdhabhāgā ca sapādaṃ kaṇakaṃ tathā ।।43।।
paṭṭikā cāntarālaṃ ca pādaṃ pādaṃ smṛtaṃ sadā ।
dvibhāgaḥ skandha ākāryo bhāgārdhaṃ karṇakotpalam ।।44।।
paṭṭikā cāntarālaṃ ca pādaṃ pādaṃ tathā matam ।
bhāgārdhaśca tathā skandho bartnaṃ pādonabhāgakam ।।45।।
antaḥpatraṃ cārdhabhāgaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmanāpradam ।
nāsopāṃgeṣu sarveṣu kartavyāḥ pallavāḥ śubhāḥ ।।46।।
aśokapallavāścāpi sarvakāmapradā hi te ।
kaṇakeṣu skandhabandhāstamālapatrarūpiṇaḥ ।।47।।
kartavyāśca bharaṇyūrdhve golabhāge pralīninaḥ ।
śirāvaṭṭirdaśabhāge kartavyā cocchrayā śubhā ।।48।।
tatra tribhāge kartavyā bhāraputtalikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
pādonastu bhavet skandhaḥ pādonaḥ karṇakastathā ।।49।।
antarā cārdhabhāgaṃ tadantare paṭṭakastathā ।
vṛttā śirāvaṭī pañcabhāge kāryā satantrakā ।।।2.137.50।।
mauktikā'laṃkṛtiyuktā kartavyā hīrakānvitā ।
tadūrdhve ca kapotālī pādabhāgasukalpitā ।।।5 1 ।।
sārdhadvibhāgakaṃ cāntarālaṃ kartavyameva tu ।
chādyaṃ trayodaśabhāge kartavyaṃ tatra vai yathā ।।52।।
ardhabhāgā skandhapaṭṭī tribhāgaḥ skandha eva ca ।
ardhabhāgā mukhapaṭṭī caturbhāgaḥ chajodayaḥ ।।।53।।
ekabhāgā daṇḍikā cāntarālaṃ caturaṃśakam ।
sapādabhāgaḥ kaṇako dvibhāgaḥ skandha ityapi ।।54।।
pādabhāgā skandhapaṭṭī sarvakāmaprapūrikā ।
kapotālpāśchādyanirgamastu daśāṃśako mataḥ ।।55।।
caturbhāgo hyadhaḥ skandhaḥ sārdhaiko maṇibandhakaḥ ।
agrecippī tvardhabhāgā sarvakāmapradā bhavet। ।।।56 ।।
kāmarūpaṃ tvekabhāgaṃ pādaikāskandhapaṭṭikā ।
cippikā cāpi bhāgārdhā pādaikā mukhapaṭṭikā ।।57।।
dvibhāgaḥ kaṇakaścāpi bhāgārdho daṇḍakastathā ।
maṇibandhasya vai sthāne tribhāge sārilambanam ।।58।।
nikāro daśabhāgaśca praveśastu ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ ।
vārimārga3tu ṣaḍbhāgaḥ praveśo'pi ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ ।।।59।।
bhāgasya ṣoḍaśoṃ'śastu pāṇitārāyatātmakaḥ ।
evaṃ sthite dṛḍhaḥ syādvai prāsādo dīrghajīvanaḥ ।।2.137.6 0।।
kuṃbhādayaḥ stharāḥ sarve nirgame samasūtriṇaḥ ।
pīṭhasya nirgamo bāhye tathaivācchādakasya ca ।। 61।।
kumbhastarapramāṇaṃ ca prāsādā''yatatā tathā ।
boddhavyā mūlanāsābhiryathāyogyā tu śilpinā ।।62।।
tripañcasaptanavaka upāṃgaphālanodgamaḥ ।
bahireva hi boddhavyaḥ śilpinā cārukarmaṇā ।।63।।
karṇaṃ pratirathaṃ caiva karṇikā caiva nandikā ।
uparathaṃ ca bhadraṃ ca subhadraṃ ceti nirgame ।।64।।
yathā bahirmūlasīmno bhavettathā bhavediti ।
saptanāsāḥ prakartavyā bhadrārdhe vai ṣaḍaṃśake ।।65।।
prathamā tvaṣṭabhāgaiśca dvitīyaikā daśāṃśikā ।
tṛtīyā'pyaṣṭabhāgā ca prānte sārdhacatuṣṭayā ।।66 ।।
bhadrārdhaṃ syāddhi ṣaḍbhāgaṃ pūrṇaṃ tu dvādaśāṃśakam ।
vāstukṣetraṃ cāṣṭakoṇaṃ kartavyaṃ devatālaye ।।67।।
dṛṣṭikānāṃ stare bhittiḥ pādasthūlā matā sadā ।
pāṣāṇabhittikā bodhyā ṣaḍaṃśā'vadhiketi ca ।।68।।
kāṣṭhaprāsādabhittiśca saptamāṃ'śātmikā matā ।
svarṇarūpyādibhittiśca māṇikyādyā daśāṃśikā ।।69।।
bhramaṇī cāpi kartavyā prāsādasya daśāṃśataḥ ।
bhramaṇīmadhyakoṇādyā neyāścopari tatkramāt ।।2.137.70 ।।
pañcāśadgajasaudhe ca bhadravad bhramaṇordhvanā ।
maṇḍapo'pi bhramayuktaḥ kartavyaḥ staṃbhasaṃdhṛtaḥ ।।71 ।।
dīpālayaṃ prakartavyaṃ prāsāde dakṣiṇeṃ'śake ।
prāsādavyāsabhāgārdhā kartavyā kolikā tathā ।।72।।
tadūrdhvaṃ śukanāsaśca kartavyo vai suśobhanaḥ ।
dvāraṃ pūrve paścime cottare kāryaṃ na dakṣiṇe ।।73 ।।
gajaprāsādake dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamucchritam ।
caturgajapraparyantaṃ pratihastaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam ।।74।।
aṃgulānāṃ vardhanīyaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ cāṣṭahastake ।
pañcāśadgajaparyante dvyaṃgulaṃ pratihastakam ।।75।।
dairghyā'rdhena pṛthutvaṃ ca dvārasya śobhanaṃ sadā ।
ūrdhvatāyāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃ'śo'dhiko'rdhe nihito yadi ।।76 ।।
śreṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavet taddhi sarvasampatsukhapradam ।
vimānapuṣpajātīnāṃ prāsāde nāgaraṃ śubham ।।77।।
navaśākhaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvāraṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ hi tat ।
dhvajāyastu pradātavyo dvāraṃ prāsādasūtrataḥ ।।78।।
talacchandānusāreṇa dvāraśākhā vibhājayet ।
navāṃge navaśākhā vai kartavyāstryaṃśake śubhāḥ ।।79।।
āyadoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ hrasvavṛddhyāvapi mate ।
madhyapeṭe dvārapālāḥ kartavyāḥ sumanoharāḥ ।।2.137.80।।
pārśvaśākhāsvapi sūkṣmā vallayaḥ śobhitā matāḥ ।
śākhocchrayacaturthāṃ'śe dvārapālau matau śubhau ।।81 ।।
vāme ca yamunā dakṣe gaṃgā tathaiva cobhaye ।
gāndharvyaścātha gandharvāḥ kartavyā vādyasaṃyutāḥ ।।82।।
gajāśca garuḍāścāpi haṃsā aśvāśca pārṣadāḥ ।
devā vā yatra yogyāḥ syuḥ kartavyā navaśākhake ।।83।।
śākhāyāstatra kartavyā bhāgā ekādaśā''yatāḥ ।
rūpastambhau ca dvau kāryau dvibhāgau koṇikāyutau ।।84।।
pādonadvayabhāgena nirgamastatra śobhanaḥ ।
prathamā patraśākhā ca gandharvā ca dvitīyakā ।।।85।।।
rūpastaṃbhā tṛtīyā ca khalvaśākhā caturthikā ।
gandharvā pañcamī cāpi rūpastaṃbhaśca ṣaṣṭhakaḥ ।।86 ।।
saptamī rūpaśākhā ca khalvaśākhā tathā'ṣṭamau ।
navamī siṃhaśākhā ca yatheṣṭaśobhanā'thavā ।।87।।
śākhāpeṭakavistāraḥ praveśāyatapañcamaḥ ।
sthāpyadevasya mūrtiścottaraṃge śākhidevayuk ।।88।।
yadvā gaṇeśako devo devāḥ saparivārakāḥ ।
devyo brahmapriyāścāpi kartavyā uttaraṃgake ।।89।।
mūlakarṇasya sūtreṇa kuṃbhenodumbaraṃ samam ।
kartavyaṃ pañcaratnāni nihitavyānyadhasstare ।।2.137.90।।
dvārā''yatyatṛtīyāṃ'śe madhye mandāriko mataḥ ।
ardhacandrasamākāro mṛṇālapatrasaṃyutaḥ ।।91 ।।
mṛṇālā'dho jāḍyakuṃbhaḥ kaṇālī kaṇapīṭhakaḥ ।
mṛṇālasya dvayapārśve koṇikā grāsayormukhe ।।92।।
udumbarasya pārśve ca śākhārūpatilāni ca ।
udumbarocchrayaḥ kāryaḥ kuṃbhāt pādonakaḥ śubhaḥ ।।93।।
khurakeṇa samo bodhyo'rdhacandrasyocchrayaḥ sadā ।
yathā dvārā''yatalambo nirgame tu tadardhakaḥ ।।94।।
bhāgadvayā'rdhacandre cā'rdhārdhabhāge gagārakau ।
pārśvadvaye prakartavyau śobhanau ca surūpiṇau ।।95।।
candragagārayormadhye śaṃkhaḥ campakavalliyuk ।
candre'pi kamalaṃ kāryaṃ .śobhitaṃ smṛddhidaṃ hi tat ।।96।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! sarvamāntarāgaṃ tavoditam ।
devāyatanakaṃ prāha yacchrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।97।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe maṇḍovarakuṃbhīchajjunāsāmaṇḍapadvārodumbarādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 137 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 137 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 138
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 139 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike 'nādiśrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ tato yadāha vacmi te ।। 1 ।।
prāsādasya pramāṇena kartavyo maṇḍapaḥ śubhaḥ ।
prāsādamūlakarṇāptasūtreṇa kolikī yathā ।। 2 ।।
catuṣkī maṇḍapaścā'pi kartavyāḥ śikharaṃ tathā ।
gūḍho vā'nāvṛttaścaikadvāro vā'tha tridvārakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
prāsādāgre sukartavyo maṇḍapo devatāgṛhe ।
maṇḍapasyottare dakṣe pūrve rūpacatuṣkikāḥ ।। 4 ।।
nṛtyamaṇḍapaḥ kartavyaḥ kartavyaśca balāṇakāḥ ।
sārdhaikāyatabhāgo vai prāsādācchobhano mataḥ ।। 5 ।।
catuṣkikāyutaḥ kāryo dviguṇaḥ sumahāniti ।
maṇḍapopari ghūmmaṭaścāyatadīrghapramāṇavān ।। 6 ।।
ucchrāyāḍhyaścārdhagolākāraḥ kartavya eva tu ।
aṣṭāṃśo maṇḍapaḥ śreṣṭho bhittibhiścāpi vartitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
sopānatoraṇāḍhyaśca makarāsyajalasravāḥ ।
gavākṣā jālakayuktā yadvā nirjālakā matāḥ ।। 8 ।।
mūlaprāsādake jaṃghāmekhalāpīṭhakādayaḥ ।
yathā syurvai tathā kāryā maṇḍape caikasūtragāḥ ।। 9 ।।
dalenārdhena pādena dalānāṃ nirgamā matāḥ ।
maṇḍapaṃ navabhāgaṃ ca kṛtvā bhāgacatuṣṭayam ।। 2.138.1 0।।
madhyaśālātmakaṃ grāhyaṃ padaṃ kartavyameva ca ।
raṃgabhūmirvicitrā ca saśobhā vai padātmikā ।। 11 ।।
catuṣṣaṣṭistaṃbhayukto maṇḍapo me priyaḥ sadā ।
ekaviṃśatisopānāḥ kartavyā maṇḍapāgrataḥ ।। 12।।
hastyaśvagāruḍarūpaiḥ śobhāḍhyā maṇibhistathā ।
pārśve catuṣkikāḥ kāryāḥ śobhanā yogyavistarāḥ ।। 13 ।।
nava catuṣkikāḥ kāryāḥ śobhanā api sarvataḥ ।
bahuvitānaśobhāḍhyāścitraśobhānvitāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 14।।
ākṣarabrahmanāmā vai maṇḍapo mama supriyaḥ ।
yugmastaṃbhaḥ prakartavyo na tvekīsaṃkhyayā kvacit ।। 15।।
kādambaḥ kamalākāraḥ sūryamukhākṛto'pi ca ।
cāndro vā maṇḍapo bodhyaścendradhanuḥsamo'pi ca ।। 16।।
jagatīmaṇḍapau bhadramānena nirgame matau ।
pratolyā jagatī cāpi bhadravannirgame matā ।। 17।।
agre kāryāḥ pratihārā mukhyamūrtestu pārśvayoḥ ।
narapīṭhasya cordhvāttu yāvadbharaṇīmastakam ।। 18।।
padāni daśasārdhāni kartavyāni tataḥ param ।
ekabhāgaṃ rājasenaṃ dvibhāgā vedikā matā ।। 1 9।।
ardhabhāgā''sannapaṭaḥ staṃbho bhāgacatuṣṭayaḥ ।
ardhabhāgaṃ bharaṇaṃ ca carustvekāṃśakastathā ।। 2.138.20।।
sārdhaikabhāgaḥ pāṭaśca chādyakaṃ tu tataḥ param ।
kammānikāstathā kāryāstoraṇādisurūpikāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
raṃgamaṇḍapapūrve ca kāryā nṛtyasya maṇḍapāḥ ।
kathāyā maṇḍapāḥ kāryā homasya maṇḍapāstathā ।। 22।।
udyāpanasya ca kāryā maṇḍapā rāsamaṇḍapāḥ ।
vāstuvedho na vai kāryaḥ staṃbhavedho'pi naiva ca ।। 23।।
staṃbhasthaulyaṃ daśāṃśādvai caturdaśāṃ'śakā'vadhim ।
prāsādasthaulyasāpekṣaṃ pāṣāṇadṛḍhatānugam ।। 24।।
prāsāde tvekahaste tu stambhaḥ syāccaturaṃgulaḥ ।
dvihaste cāṃgulāḥ sapta trihaste nava cāṃgulāḥ ।।25।।
tato dvādaśahaste ca pratihastaṃ dvayā'ṅgulau ।
sapādā'ṅgulavṛddhiśca yāvatṣoḍaśahastake ।। 26।।
aṃgulikābhivṛddhiśca catvāriṃśatkarāvadhim ।
pañcāśatkaraparyantaṃ pādonāṃgulikā'dhikā ।। 27।।
svastikā mastake bhadrayutā'ṣṭāsrāśca stambhakāḥ ।
mūrtipatrasuvallyāḍhyā bhadrayukkaṃbhikāstathā ।।28।।
bharaṇe vallikāyuktāścaravaḥ kinnarānvitāḥ ।
mama vai mandiraṃ saptaśikharaṃ kāryamuttamam ।।29।।
tadagre kolikā bodhyā tadagre gūḍhamaṇḍapaḥ ।
tato nṛtyamaṇḍapaśca tataḥ sabhākhyamaṇḍapaḥ ।।2.138.3 0।।
tato vai rūpacokī ca tataḥ sopānakāni ca ।
ṣaṭpañcāśaddakṣabhāro ṣaṭpaṃcāśacca vāmake ।।3 1।।
mandirāṇi ca kāryāṇi patnīnāṃ mama sarvataḥ ।
madhyamandirake cā'haṃ pārśveṣu ṣaṭ prapatnikāḥ ।।32।।
maṇḍapeṣu ghūmmaṭeṣu bhūmikāḥ sapta sapta ca ।
rāsatoraṇavedyādiyutāḥ kāryāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।।33।।
paścime rathaśālā ca dakṣiṇe maṭhaśālikāḥ ।
uttare sūdaśālā ca pūrve cāyudhaśālikā ।।34।।
vāyau koṣṭhāgārakaṃ cāgnikoṇe tu mahānasaḥ ।
īśāne puṣpaśālā ca nairṛtye pātraśālikā ।।35।।
paścime jalaśālā ca hyupari vācanālayaḥ ।
kartavyā api sāpekṣā ālayā mandirā'bhitaḥ ।।36।।
dvārocchrāyasya tribhāge bhāgadvayaṃ tu jālakam ।
gavākṣāśca tathā kāryā hrasvā vā samastakāḥ ।।37।।
maṇḍapopari cāṣṭāsraṃ tadūrdhve ṣoḍaśāsrakam ।
tadūrdhve ghūmmaṭo golaścāyatā''rdhordhvamānataḥ ।।38।।
ucchraye ṣaṣṭhibhāgān vai kṛtvā tatrādimeṣu vai ।
karṇadardarikāḥ saptabhāge samocchranirgamāḥ ।।39।।
caturbhāge rūpakaṇṭho dvyaṃśe nirgamavānmataḥ ।
vidyādhrāḥ ṣoḍaśa kāryāścaturviṃśatihastinaḥ ।।2.138.40।।
vidyādharapṛthutvena saptāṃśe nirgamo mataḥ ।
tadūrdhve citrarūpāśca nartikā rāsanartanāḥ ।।41 ।।
ādyāste sārdhaṣaḍbhāgā dvitīyāḥ ṣaḍvibhāgikāḥ ।
pañcabhāgāstataḥ kolāḥ sārdhacaturgavālakam ।।42।।।
madhyagolavitānaṃ tu kathācamatkṛtiprabhaiḥ ।
saṃgītagītanṛtyādiputtalaireva śobhitam ।।43 ।।
jīvalokeśvaralokabrahmalokādicitrakaiḥ ।
śobhitā ratnagarbhāśca sūryavarṇā vitānakāḥ ।।44।।
sābharaṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ prathamaṃ bhāgaṣaṭkake ।
dvitīyādyāni tānyeva caturbhāgavivṛddhitaḥ ।।45।।
kartavyāni pañcaviṃśatisābharaṇāni kramāt ।
prathame pañcaghaṇṭāśca kartavyāstvatiśobhanāḥ ।।46 ।।
dvitīyādau caturvṛddhyā kāraṇīyāstaduttare ।
vāme dakṣe tu bhadrārdhe rakṣārdhe navaghaṇṭakam ।।47।।
rathikā''yatatā'rdhe ca bhāge tu rathikopari ।
ghaṇṭāḥ kūṭāḥ prakartavyāstato vai kalaśo bhavet ।।48।।
prathamā ghaṇṭikā kāryā pañcakalaśaśobhanā ।
evaṃ tvekīsaṃkhyayā'pi cāgre kāryāḥ sughaṇṭikāḥ ।।49।।
ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṭkasaptapadāntare ।
prāsādadevatāyāśca vāhanasya catuṣkikā ।।2.138.50।।
kartavyā vāhanasthānarūpā suśobhanā śubhā ।
devamūrternavabhāgā āpādaśikhameva tu ।।5 1 ।।
kartavyāḥ pañcaṣaṭsaptabhāgānto vāhanocchrayaḥ ।
yadvā vāhananetre ca guhyanābhistanocchraye ।।।52।।
samarekhe bhavetāṃ ca tathocchrayaṃ tu vāhanam ।
yadvā pādakaṭijānusamarekhaṃ tu vāhanam ।।53 ।।
śivaliṃgasya vāhastu jalādhārīsamucchrayaḥ ।
sūryavāhaḥ skandharekhāsamau devasya vai mataḥ ।।54।।
mukhyaprāsādaparitaḥ prāsādā garbhasaṃkhyayā ।
garbhaṃ dhṛtvā tataḥ kāryā nābhivedhaṃ na kārayet ।।55।।
brahmaviṣṇuśivasaudhaḥ pūrvapaścimakā''nanaḥ ।
nagarābhimukhā devāḥ śubhāḥ kṣemakarāḥ sadā ।।56।।
parāṅmukhāḥ puraṃ ghnanti sarvāsyāstrisurāḥ śubhāḥ ।
gaṇeśo bhairavaścaṇḍī nakulīśo navagrahāḥ ।।57।।
mātaraśca kuberaśca dakṣiṇābhimukhāḥ śubhāḥ ।
nairṛtyadakṣiṇamukho hanumān nānyadevatā ।।58।।
prāsādagarbhatṛtīyabhāgena pratimottamā ।
daśabhāgena hīnā yā madhyamā sā prakīrtitā ।।59।।
pañcabhāgena hīnā yā kaniṣṭhā svastikāsanā ।
dvārocchrāyanavabhāge bhāgordhvaika vihāya ca ।।2.138.60।।
śiṣṭāṣṭabhāgake caturbhāgocchrāyā śubhā matā ।
caturbhāgāvaṣaṃ tu siṃhāsanaṃ mataṃ tathā ।।6 1 ।।
yadvā dvārocchrayasyaiva dvātriṃśadbhāgakeṣu tu ।
ūrdhvaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ tyaktvā'ṣṭāviṃśatiprabhāgake ।।62।।
siṃhāsanaṃ ca pratimā caturdaśe caturdaśe ।
siṃhāsanaṃ trayodaśe mūrtiḥ pañcadaśe smṛtā ।।63 ।।
siṃhāsanaṃ pañcadaśe mūrtistrayodaśe smṛtā ।
siṃhāsanaṃ dvādaśe cet pratimā ṣoḍaśāṃ'śake ।।64।।
prāsāde ekahaste tu mūrtirekādaśāṃgulā ।
daśāṃgulā vardhanīya yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam ।।65।।
dvyaṃgulā vardhanīyā ca yāvadvai daśahastakam ।
ardhāṃgulaṃ vardhanīyā pañcāśadaṃgulāvadhim ।।66।।
madhyā daśāṃśahīnā syāt kaniṣṭhā taddaśāṃśahā ।
suptā mūrtirgarbhagehe saptabhāgeṣu pañcagā ।।67।।
dvau bhāgau varjanīyau ca śayanasthā sukhapradā ।
prāsādagarbhakhaṇḍau dvau dvārakhaṇḍaṃ vihāya ca ।।68 ।।
śeṣakhaṇḍe paccabhāgāḥ kartavyā āsanārdhakāḥ ।
bhittilagne prathame tu bhāge yakṣādikāsanam ।।69।।
dvitīye tu vibhāge syuḥ sarvadevāsanāni vai ।
tṛtīye tu vibhāge vai brahmaviṣṇuharāsanam ।।2.138.70।।
pañcamāṃśe yavamātramīśānyāṃ tu śivāsanam ।
prāsādānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vibhāgo garbhato mataḥ ।।7 1 ।।
garbhasya madhyabhāgāddhi kramād devāsanāni vai ।
caturasrāṇyāyatānyāyatavṛttāni vai tathā ।।72।।
yathāyogyāni kuryācca vṛttānyaṣṭāsrakāṇyapi ।
bhittigāni maṇḍalāni tvaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā ।।73 ।।
madhye śivo dvitīye tu maṇḍale viśvasṛḍ bhavet ।
nakulīśastṛtīye sāvitrī caturthake matā ।।74।।
rudramūrtiḥ pañcame ca ṣaṣṭhe svāmī tu kārtikaḥ ।
brahmā tu saptame vāsudevo'ṣṭame tu maṇḍale ।।75।।
janārdanastu navame daśame viśvadevatāḥ ।
agnirekādaśe cāpi dvādaśe bhāskarastathā ।।76 ।।
durgā trayodaśe caturdaśe vighneśa ādṛtaḥ ।
navagrahāḥ pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe mātṛdevatāḥ ।।77।।
saptadaśe gaṇāścāpi bhairavo'ṣṭādaśe mataḥ ।
kṣetrapālā navadaśe yakṣarājastu viṃśake ।।78।।
hanumānekaviṃśe ca bhago dvāviṃśake tathā।
trayoviṃśe'paradevāścaturviṃśe tu daityakaḥ ।।79।।
pañcaviṃśe rākṣasaśca ṣaḍviṃśe tu piśācakaḥ ।
saptaviṃśe bhūtavargo'ṣṭāviṃśe riktameva ca ।।2.138.80 ।।
tattatpatnībhṛtyadāsīkuṭumbabhaktasevitāḥ ।
yathāyogyaṃ sthāpanīyā devā svasvālaye sadā ।।8 1 ।।
gajāsanaṃ ca vā siṃhāsanaṃ haṃsāsanaṃ tathā ।
vimānaṃ muktadhāryaṃ vā sachatraṃ cottamottamām ।।82।।
śaivaliṃgaṃ yādṛśaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ yonikāsanam ।
yonistvaṣṭādaśabhāgā kartavyocchrayamānataḥ ।।83 ।।
kaṇaḥ syāt sārdhabhāgena paṭṭikā cārdhabhāgikā ।
dvitīyā paṭṭikā tulyā skandhastribhāgakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।84।।
ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā cāntarapatraṃ tu sārdhake ।
ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā dvibhāgaḥ karṇakastathā ।।85।।
ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā sārdhabhāgaṃ tu patrakam ।
ardhabhāgā paṭṭikānyā tribhāgaḥ skandha eva ca ।।86।।
paṭṭikādvayamevāpi tvardhadvayaprabhāgake ।
sārdhabhāgaḥ karṇakaśca tato liṃgasya darśanam ।।87।।
yaddravyaṃ tu bhavelliṃgaṃ taddravyā yonikā matā ।
caturasrā vartulā samekhalā bahukoṇikā ।।88।।
liṃgasthaulyaṃ māpanīyaṃ sūtreṇa paridhirhi saḥ ।
sūtrāyatāyataṃ kāryaṃ pīṭhaṃ vai vistṛtaṃ tu tat ।।89।।
sūtraṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kāryaṃ dvibhāge yonikā matā ।
bhāgaike śivaliṃgaṃ cocchraye bodhyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ ।।2.138.90 ।।
liṃgāt praṇālaṃ sūtreṇa pramītaṃ nirgame matam ।
sūtradīrghaṃ dvayameva yoniliṃgaṃ tu nādhikam ।।91 ।।
apūrṇāpūrṇaśirasordhvādvai liṃgapraveśa iṣyate ।
koṣṭhalādvā prapūrṇādvai liṃgapraveśa ūrdhvataḥ ।।92।।
praṇālaṃ cottare vāme guptaṃ caṇḍamukhe patet ।
bahudeveṣu praṇālaṃ jagatyāṃ vai caturdiśi ।।93।।
ṣaḍbhāgā dvāraśākhāyāḥ kāryā vai pañcame śubhe ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇādīnāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ kāryā śubhā sadā ।।94।।
tṛtīyāṃśe śivamūrteḥ śrīśeṣaśāyino'pi ca ।
aṣṭabhāgāṃ dvāraśākhāṃ vibhajyaikaṃ tathā'ṣṭakaiḥ ।।95।।
catuḥṣaṣṭirbhavatyevaṃ bhāgānāṃ tatra sarvathā ।
ekībhāge devadṛṣṭirna tu yugme vinirṇayaḥ ।।96।।
ekī dvātriṃśadaṃśeṣu devadṛṣṭirvidhīyate ।
yugmāṃśā devadṛṣṭyarthaṃ niṣiddhā eva hānidāḥ ।।97।।
dṛṣṭidoṣavipākena sthānanāśo dhanakṣayaḥ ।
dṛṣṭidoṣahataṃ yadyanna punaśca prarohati ।।98।।
ūrdhvadṛṣṭyā dravyanāśo bhogahāniradhaḥsthayā ।
samadṛṣṭiḥ sukhadā'sti sarvakāle yathāyatham ।। 99।।
catuḥṣaṣṭiprabhāgeṣu prathame tvāditattvakam ।
sṛṣṭistṛtīye tattvaṃ ca pañcameṣṭistu saptame ।। 2.138.10 0।।
āyustu navame caikādaśe lakṣaṃ mataṃ tathā ।
vijñaṃ trayodaśe pañcadaśe prājñaṃ mataṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
śāntitattvaṃ saptadaśe'vyaktaṃ navadaśe tathā ।
vyaktā'vyaktaṃ tvekaviṃśe trayoviṃśe tu vyaktakam ।। 1 02।।
pañcaviṃśe śeṣanāgaḥ saptaviṃśe śayī hariḥ ।
navaviṃśe tu garuḍastvekatriṃśe tu mātaraḥ ।। 1 03।।
trayastriṃśe kuberaśca pañcatriṃśe varāhakaḥ ।
saptatriṃśe hyumārudrau navatriṃśe tu buddhakaḥ ।। 1 04।।
ekacatvāriṃśake'jastricatvāriṃśake tataḥ ।
durvāsā nārado'gastyastrayaste'nye maharṣayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
pañcacatvāriṃśake śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇādayaḥ ।
saptacatvāriṃśake ca dhātā tato'tha devatā ।। 106 ।।
navacatvāriṃśake ca śāradā ca gaṇeśakaḥ ।
ekapañcāśadaṃke ca brahmā padmāsane sthitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
tripaṃcāśattame siddhirharasiddhistathā'parāḥ ।
pañcapañcāśattame'jo viṣṇuḥ sūryo virāgiṇaḥ ।। 1 08।।
saptapañcāśattame tu śukrācāryaḥ pare yathā ।
navapañcāśattame caṇḍikā cānyāśca devikāḥ ।। 1 09।।
ekaṣaṣṭitame devā bhairavādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
triṣaṣṭyāṃ vetālakādyāstatparaṃ śūnyameva tu ।। 2.138.11 0।।
arcāyāḥ pādayoḥ kaṭyāṃ vā dṛṣṭirvāhanasya tu ।
evaṃ sthānapratiṣṭhānāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ।। 111 ।।
vaiparītye viparītaṃ phalaṃ vai rādhike! bhavet ।
kṣayakṛt śrīhariṃ prāha devāyatanakaṃ munim ।। 11 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpemaṇḍapaghūmmaṭasiṃhāsanataddevāditattadaṃśapramāpaṇādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 138 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 138 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 139
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 140 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe! hariṇā daivatāya tu ।
kathitaṃ śikharādyaṃ tat kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।। 1 ।।
atha prāsādaśikharāṃ sabhedaṃ citrabandhanam ।
kathayāmi samāsena bahujātīyakaṃ śubham ।। 2 ।।
bahuśṛṃgaṃ bahughūmmaṭakaṃ bahupraphālaṇam ।
bahubhadragavākṣaṃ ca bahurūpaṃ hi naiṣṭhikam ।। 3 ।।
bahuvedībahupīṭhaṃ bahuvallīprapatrakam ।
bahurekhaṃ bahucitraṃ bahvagaṃ gṛhadharmi tat ।। 4 ।।
sāptabhaumaṃ śatabhaumaṃ śikharaṃ bahuputralam ।
candraśālāntakaṃ bahukalaśaṃ vānaprasthakam ।। 5 ।।
ekaśṛṃgaṃ tu sannyastamaśṛṃgaṃ sādhujātikam ।
lambagolaṃ tathā golaṃ aṃgaṃ yatheṣṭakaṃ bhavet ।। 6 ।।
āyatatve caturbhāgaṃ dairghye tu pañcabhāgakam ।
ūrdhve trikalaśaṃ siṃhayuktaṃ tu lambagolakam ।। 7 ।।
lambagole dakṣavāmabhāgau sārdhaikavistarau ।
phālanānirgamaścāṣṭabhadrakaṃ lambagolakam ।। 8 [।
ekāṇḍaṃ golaśikharaṃ karṇe śreṇyaṇḍakāni ca ।
caturbhāgaṃ samārabhya dvādaśottarakaṃ śatam ।। 9 ।।
talānāṃ darśanaṃ kṛtvā bhavanti śikharāṇi vai ।
ekasyāpi talasyordhve bahūni śikharāṇi hi ।। 2.139.10 ।।
chādyasyordhve prahāraḥ syācchṛṅge śṛṃgaṃ taduttaram ।
ekadvitriśikharāṇi rekhayaiva bhavanti vai ।। 11 ।।
garbhāntare śṛṃgabhittirekhā naiva tu śasyate ।
vipulā vistṛtā bāhye sarvasaukhyapradā tu sā ।। 1 2।।
śṛṃgarekhordhvatā rekhā''yatatāpekṣayā kila ।
sapādā sārdhakā vā ca grāhyā na nyūnikā kvacit ।। 1 3।।
śṛṃgaskandhordhvake ghaṇṭā kartavyā phaladā śubhā ।
pahārāṃśaṃ punardadyāt punaḥ śṛṃgāṇi tatra ca ।। 14।।
śṛṃgā'dho vādyayuktā vai pratimāḥ śobhanā matāḥ ।
śṛṃgapārśve ca śṛṃgordhve śṛṃgikāḥ śobhanāstathā ।। 15।।
uruśṛṃgāṇi kāryāṇi nava vā samarekhayā ।
ādyoruśṛṃgatalataḥ paroruskandhakāvadhim ।। 16 ।।
bhāgāstrayodaśa kāryāḥ saptabhāgādyaśṛṃgakam ।
kṛtvā dvitīyakamuruśṛṃgaṃ pramardayet tataḥ ।। 17।।
evaṃ vai nava kāryāṇi mṛdyamūlāni cordhvataḥ ।
rekhāmūle daśabhāgān kṛtvordhve tu ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ ।। 18।।
skandho ramyaḥ prakartavyo nā'dhikāṃśaḥ sadoṣakaḥ ।
pañcabhāgānna vā nyūnaḥ sudṛśyo yo na jāyate ।। 1 9।।
mūlaskandhe dhvajadaṇḍaścāviśet svāmināśakṛt ।
pratigajaṃ cāṃgulena dhvajadaṇḍāsanaṃ bahiḥ ।। 2.139.20।।
ādyaśṛṃge gavākṣaṃ ca dvitīye māḍhameva ca।
tṛtīyamastakaṃ yāvat siṃhasthānaṃ mataṃ śubham ।।21 ।।
caturthamastakaṃ yāvat śukasiṃhaḥ samucyate ।
yadvā vai navaparyantaṃ tathā'nyādivyamūrtayaḥ ।। 22।।
gavākṣeṣu devatāśca hyagre śuko haristraye ।
bhadre sthāpyastena sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ syāt śikharodbhavam ।।23।।
chādyādvai skandhaparyantaṃ bhāgā vai caikaviṃśitaḥ ।
navatrayodaśamadhye siṃhā vai śukanāsakāḥ ।।24।।
pañcadhā tatra kartavyāḥ śukanāsā śubhā matāḥ ।
kolyāmekānnava yāvat siṃhā dairghyasya sūtrataḥ ।।25।।
maṇḍape stambhakān kuryānmadhyagarbhānusārataḥ ।
śukanāsasamā ghaṇṭā kartavyā nimnikā'thavā ।। 26।।
śṛṃgoruśṛṃgapratyaṃgairaṇḍān dadyāddhi tāvataḥ ।
karṇeṣu navakoṇeṣu tilakaṃ saudhabhūṣaṇam ।।।27।।
aṃgānāṃ saṃkhyayā vāryantarāḥ kāryāḥ śubhāvahāḥ ।
yadvā mūlaśilā''rambhāt kalaśāntaṃ samucchraye ।।।28।।।
bhāgāstu viṃśatiḥ kāryā aṣṭabhāge hi cottamam ।
maṇḍovaraṃ dvisārdhā'ṣṭe madhyaṃ nave kaniṣṭhakam ।।29।।
maṇḍovarāduparyeva śikharodaya ucyate ।
prāsāde daśabhāgeṣu dvitracaturthake tathā ।।2.139.30 ।।
pāde cārdhe tribhāge vā śṛṃgodayo mataḥ sadā ।
daśāṃśān śikhare mūle kṛtvā daśāśakāँstataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
dvau dvau bhāgau dvikarṇau ca sārdhau sārdhau paḍhārakau ।
tribhāgaṃ bhadrakaṃ kāryaṃ bandhanāmastake tvapi ।।3 2।।
navāṃśāśca prakartavyā dvau dvau bhāgau dvikarṇakau ।
sārdhau sārdhau tu paḍharau dvibhāgaṃ bhadrakaṃ tataḥ ।।33।।
karṇāt sapādaṃ śikharaṃ sārdhaikaṃ śikharaṃ ca vā ।
sapādakarṇayormadhye rekhāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।।34।।
udaye karṇayormadhye rekhāśca pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।
aṣṭādito'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyantaṃ rekhā bhavanti ṣoḍaśa ।।35।।
ūrdhve pañcā''yatatve ca pañceti pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।
aṃśavṛddhiḥ kalā kāryā tena bhedāstathāvidhāḥ ।।36।।
aṣṭādito'ṣṭaṣaṣṭhyantaṃ caturvṛddhyā tu ṣoḍaśa ।
aṣṭadvādaśaṣoḍaśaviṃśā ūrdhve tathā''yate ।। 37।।
yadvā'ṣṭādaśa cordhve cāyate ṣoḍaśa eva ca ।
evaṃ rekhāḥ ṣaṭpañcāśad dve śate ca bhavanti vai ।।38।।
trikhaṇḍebhyaḥ khaṇḍavṛddhiryāvadaṣṭādaśaiva tu ।
ekaikasya kalā aṣṭau samārcāstena ṣoḍaśa ।।39।।
caturviṃśatiḥ prathamā dvitīyā saptaviṃśatiḥ ।
triṃśadbhāgā tṛtīyā ca tatra tatrāpi ṣoḍaśa ।।2.139.40।।
sūtraṃ caturguṇaṃ dhṛtvā rekhātaḥ padmakośavat ।
śikharā''yatatā golā kāryocchrayaḥ sapādakaḥ ।।41 ।।
pañca bhāgāśca ṣaṭ saptāṣṭau dvādaśā'tha ṣoḍaśa ।
atha dhvajapuruṣaṃ vai kathayāmi tu rādhike! ।।42।।
śṛṃgarekhā samārabhya yāvadbandhanikocchraye ।
ṣaḍbhāgān saṃvidhāyaiva ṣaṣṭhe bhāgacatuṣṭayam ।।43।।
ūrdhvabhāgaṃ vihāyaiva śeṣabhāgatrayāṃśakaḥ ।
dhvajādhāraḥ prakartavyaḥ pratirathe tu dakṣiṇe ।।44।।
yadvā rekhāṃ samārabhya śṛṃgaskandhāntakeṃ'śakau ।
dvau kṛtvordhveṃ'śake bhāgatrayaṃ kṛtvā tadardhakaḥ ।।45।।
vaṃśādhāraḥ prakartavyastadvāme tu kare dhvajaḥ ।
pradātavyo dhvajastaṃbhaḥ pradātavyastu dakṣiṇe ।।46 ।।
prāsādapṛṣṭhadeśe tu dakṣiṇe vai paḍhārake ।
dhvajādhāraḥ prakartavyaḥ pūrvānanasya nairṛte ।।47।।
īśānai paścimamukhaprāsādasya dhvajādharaḥ ।
prāsādasya skandhadeśe madhye paḍharayordvayoḥ ।।48।।
paḍharāvat prakāryo vartulaścāmalasārakaḥ ।
utsedho vistarā'rdhena kartavyastasya śobhanaḥ ।।49।।
taducchrayasya vai bhāgāścatvārastatra copari ।
grīvā pādonikā tasyā'malasāraḥ sapādakaḥ ।।2.139.50।।
ekabhāgā candrikā ca jhāṃjharī caikabhāgikā ।
kalaśasya tato mānaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।।51 ।।
padmakośe saptabhāgāḥ grīvāstasyaikabhāgikā ।
sārdhaikocchrāyavān āmalasāraḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ ।।52।।
pādonaṃ pañcapatraṃ ca pādonā jhāṃjharī tataḥ ।
tribhāgocchrayakalaśo dvibhāgāyatavān śubhaḥ ।।53।।
prāsādakarṇā''yatyāyāḥ kalaśaścā'ṣṭamāṃśakaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśāṃ'śo vardhitaḥ sa śreṣṭho vyāse ghaṭo mataḥ ।।54।।
dvātriṃśadbhāgato vardhitaḥ sa vai madhyamo mataḥ ।
yadvā mūlasya rekhāyā vyāsasya pañcamāṃśikā ।।55।।
āyatatā kalaśasya kartavyā śobhanā matā ।
yadvā cā'malasārasyā''yatatāyāścaturthake ।।56 ।।
aṃśe cāyatatā yā sā kalaśasya prakīrtitā ।
caturthāṃśo vardhanīyaḥ sārdhaścocchrayavāँstataḥ ।।57।।
ucchrayo navabhāgaśca sthaulye ṣaḍaṃśakastathā ।
pramāṇasūtramānena kalaśaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ ।।58।।
grīvāpīṭhau tvekabhāge tribhāge tvaṇḍakaṃ tathā ।
karṇike caikaikabhāge ḍoḍalaśca tribhāgakaḥ ।।59।।
ḍoḍalāgraṃ caikabhāgaṃ mūlasthaulyaṃ dvibhāgakam ।
karṇikā ca tribhāgā'tha chajjī bhāgacatuṣṭayam ।।2.139.6 0 ।।
grīvā dvibhāgikā'rdhapīṭhakaṃ dvibhāgakaṃ tathā ।
pūrṇaṃ pīṭhaṃ caturbhāgaṃ cāṇḍaṃ ṣaḍbhāgakāyatam ।।6 1 ।।
śreṣṭhastu sarvaśreṣṭhānāṃ sauvarṇakalaśo dhvajaḥ ।
prāsādasyā'malasāro jīvasthānaṃ prakīrtitam ।।62।।
prāsādapuruṣastatra devāyatanako mataḥ ।
sthāpanīyaḥ sa puruṣaścādhyātmā cetanānvitaḥ ।।63।।
prāsāde caikahaste tu puruṣo'rdhāṃgulātmakaḥ ।
pañcāśadgajaparyante pratyekamardhaṃ vardhayet। ।।64।।
tasya vai śayanaṃ raupyaṃ kamalaṃ dakṣiṇe kare ।
vāme dhvajastripatāko vakṣasi dhārito yathā ।।65।।
dhvajāpatākābhāgastu yathā skandhopari sthitaḥ ।
āmalasārake tāmraṃ svarṇaṃ vā ghṛtapātrakam ।।66।।
sthāpanīyaṃ tathā svarṇaprāsādapuruṣo'pi ca ।
raupyaparyaṃkaśāyī ca sthāpanīyaḥ śubho mataḥ ।।67।।
paryaṃkasya catuṣpāde kuṃbhāścatvāra eva tu ।
sahemaratnasaṃyuktāstannidhicihnaśobhitāḥ ।।68।।
śaṃkhaḥ padmo mahāpadmo makaraśceti nāminaḥ ।
dhvajadaṇḍapramāṇaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ।।6 9 ।।
prāsādaḥ karṇake yāvadāyatastāvadeva saḥ ।
lamba eva dhvajādaṇḍaḥ kartavyo jyeṣṭhamānataḥ ।।2.139.70।।
madhyo daśāṃśahīnaśca pañcamāṃśaḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ ।
yadvā jagatīśiraso ghaṭordhvaṃ yāvadeva ca ।।71।।
ucchrayasya trayo bhāgāstatraikadīrghadaṇḍakaḥ ।
jyeṣṭho bhavenmadhyamastu cāṣṭāṃśahīnako mataḥ ।।72।।
ṣaṣṭhāṃśahīnakaḥ proktaḥ kaniṣṭha eva sarvathā ।
yadvā rekhāpramāṇastu kaniṣṭhakaḥ sa ucyate ।।73।।
dvādaśabhāgavṛddhyā ca madhyamaḥ sa bhavedatha ।
ṣaṣṭhāṃśavṛddhitaḥ śreṣṭho bhavatyeva sa daṇḍakaḥ ।।74।।
prāsādakoṇamaryādā saptahastāntikā matā ।
garbhamānasya maryādā hastāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।।75।।
rekhāmānasya maryādā pañcāśaddhastikā matā ।
tattanmaryādayā dhvajādaṇḍasya dairghyamityapi ।।76।।
prāsāde caikahaste tu daṇḍaḥ pādokāṃgulaḥ ।
pṛthustataḥ pratigajaṃ cārdhāṃgulaṃ pṛthuṃ dharet ।।77।।
pañcāśadgajaparyantaṃ mānaṃ sthaulye mataṃ śubham ।
vaṃśamayaścāṃjano vā mādhukaḥ śaiṃśapeyakaḥ ।।78।।
khādiro vā prakartavyo vṛttaḥ sopānapaṃktiyuk ।
ekīparvayuto dvitvagranthisaṃkhyāsamanvitaḥ ।।79।।
daṇḍadairghyaṣaḍaṃśena lambā markaṭī pāṭalī ।
dairghyā'rdhāṃśaiścāyatā ca sthūlā cā''yatyatryaṃśakaiḥ ।।2.139.80 ।।
kiṃkiṇīghaṇṭikāyuktā kāṃgarībhiḥ suśobhitā ।
markaṭyāyatatāyāśca pañcāṃśaiḥ kalaśocchrayaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
markaṭyadho'rdhacandrābhaḥ pakṣayoḥ sagagārakaḥ ।
daṇḍoparyeva kalaśaḥ sthāpanīyaḥ kuśāgrakaḥ ।।82।।
patākā daṇḍavallambā tadaṣṭāṃśaistathā''yatā ।
tribhirvā pañcakaiḥ paṭṭairbhinnarūpaiḥ suśobhitā ।।83।।
dakṣaskandhe paṃḍharāyāṃ dhvajadaṇḍaḥ sthito bhavet ।
prāsādasya pṛṣṭhabhāge dakṣe tu paṃḍhare śubhaḥ ।।84।।
dhvajadaṇḍādhārarūpaḥ kalābaḥ śobhano mataḥ ।
kalābā''yatatā kāryā mittiṣaṣṭhāṃśamānataḥ ।।85।।
ghaṇṭodayasamocchrāyaḥ kalābo manyate śubhaḥ ।
prāsādasya pṛthutve ca yāvaddhastā bhavanti ca ।।86।।
tāvadaṅgulamānena daṇḍagartaviśālatā ।
caturmukhe tu prāsāde īśānyāṃ daṇḍaropaṇam ।।87।।
īśānyāṃ tu manāk pāṭalikā daṇḍe parakṣayet ।
rājyavṛddhiḥ sthānavṛddhiḥ prajāsaukhyaṃ tato bhavet ।।88।।
dhvajahīne mahāsaudhe vāsamicchanti rākṣasāḥ ।
dhvajadānena tuṣyanti devatāḥ pitarastathā ।।89।।
daśāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ śataikaṃ tārayet kulam ।
jīrṇoddhāre pūrvasūtraṃ prāsāde na samutsṛjet ।।2.139.90 ।।
pūrvadravyāpekṣayā cottamadravyeṇa vāstukam ।
sumuhūrtādisadyoge śubhaṃ jīrṇaprapātanam ।।9 1 ।।
svarṇarūpyamayahastivṛṣadantaiḥ prapātanam ।
anyadevasya jīrṇādirnānyadevagṛhe'rpayet ।।992।।
pratiṣṭhitasya devasya cālanaṃ puṇyanāśakam ।
gṛhasthānāṃ na tu satāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।।93।।
pratimotthāpanaṃ lagne care lañcena vai matam ।
laṃcanaṃ ca gajāśvasya rūpyakaṃ vā'tha vajrakam ।।94।।
kapāṭāḥ samasūtre ca śreṇībhaṃgaṃ na kārayeta ।
pāṣāṇāditharāḥ sarve samasūtreṇa sammatāḥ ।।95।।
pratolikāḥ śubhāḥ kāryāḥ gopurāṇi mahānti ca ।
kīrtistaṃbhastathā kāryo vedhayantrādikaṃ tathā ।।96।।
ityevaṃ rādhike nārāyaṇaḥ prāha nijāśritam ।
devāyatanabhaktāyalakṣmyai prāha ca tat tathā ।।97।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe śikharapadmakośakalaśadhvajādiviśeṣanirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśā'dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 139 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 139 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 140
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 141 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! devāyatanāyā''ha yaddhariḥ ।
merujātīyasubhagaprāsādaṃ tadvibhāgakān ।। 1 ।।
prāsādeṣu śataikāni cāṇḍāni kānakāni vai ।
sahasraikānyapi daive prāsāde saṃbhavanti hi ।। 2 ।।
prāsādarājo merurvai sarvadevāśrayo mataḥ ।
prāsādastvakṣarākhyaśca golokākhyaśca kīrtitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vaikuṇṭhākhyo'vyākṛtākhyo'mṛtā'khyaśca hiraṇmayaḥ ।
vāhneyaścāpi vairājo bhūmā ca vaiṣṇavo'pi ca ।। 4 ।।
kailāsaścāpi vaiśālaḥ śvetadvīpo'pi mandaraḥ ।
sarvatobhadranāmā ca śrīvatsaḥ svastikastathā ।। 5 ।।
haimo haṃso gāruḍaśca gajo vṛṣabha ityapi ।
mandiro brāhmasaṃjñaśca paṃcaviṃśatijātikāḥ ।। 6 ।।
vartulo'nantaśikharo merurājaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
sahāsrāsraścākṣaraścā'nantabhavanasaṃkulaḥ ।। 7 ।।
navaśatanavatistaṃbhāḍhyo goloka iṣyate ।
sarvathā śikharāḍhyaśca vaikuṇṭhākhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
sarvathā ghūmmaṭāḍhyaścā'vyākṛtākhyaḥ prakīrtyate ।
sarvathā gṛhamātrāḍhyaścāmṛtaḥ parikīrtyate ।। 9 ।।
sarvathā kammānikāḍhyo hiraṇmayaḥ prakīrtyate ।
sarvathā pāṭakādhāro vāhneyaḥ parikīrtyate ।। 2.140.10 ।।
sarvathā gajaśobhāḍhyo vairājaḥ saṃprakīrtyate ।
sarvathā'ścādiśobhāḍhyo bhūmāsaudhaḥ prakīrtyate ।। 11 ।।
dāsībhirvaiṣṇavadūtairvyāpto vaiṣṇava ucyate ।
sarvathā tu gaṇairvyāptaḥ kailāsaḥ sa prakīrtyate ।। 12।।
sarvathā ṛṣibhirvyāpto vaiśālaḥ saprakīrtyate ।
tāpasaiḥ sarvathā vyāptaḥ śvetadvīpākhya ucyate ।। 13 ।।
catuṣkoṇaḥ sarvabhadraḥ śrīyantravacchrīvatsakaḥ ।
svastikena samaḥ svastirbahukhaṇḍastu haimakaḥ ।। 14।।
bahuhaṃso hāṃsakaśca gāruḍāḍhyaśca gāruḍaḥ ।
pañcapādo gajākhyaśca catuṣpādo vṛṣābhidhaḥ ।। 15।।
śatapādo mandiraṃ ca daśapādastu brāhmakaḥ ।
iti mukhyā bhavantyeva tvaṃgabhedairvibhinnakāḥ ।। 16।।
śilpabhedaiḥ rūpabhedairdṛśyabhedairvibhinnakāḥ ।
yathābuddhi yathāśakti yathālokaṃ yathāsukham ।। 17।।
śilpabuddhisamutpannā mānavedhavivarjitāḥ ।
vaimānikāstu prāsādā bahudhā saṃbhavanti hi ।। 18।।
yāvanto dehinaḥ santi tāvantastādṛśālayāḥ ।
bhaviṣyantyapare cāpi prāsādā bahurūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 9।।
talabhāgāṣṭakaścāṇḍapaṃcakastu sa kesarī ।
navāṇḍaḥ sarvatobhadrastalatilāṣṭako hi saḥ ।।2.140.20।।
prāsādo nandanākhyastu trayodaśāṇḍasaṃyutaḥ ।
nandiśālikasaudhastu saptadaśāṇḍakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।।21 ।।
talabhāgā daśa tatra tilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam ।
talabhāgā daśa caikaviṃśatyaṇḍastu nandiśaḥ ।।22।।
dvādaśa talabhāgāśca pañcaviṃśatikāṇḍakaḥ ।
aṣṭatilakasaṃśobho mandirākhyaḥ sa ucyate ।।23 ।।
caturdaśatalabhāgo navaviṃśatikāṇḍakaḥ ।
caturviṃśatitilakaḥ śrīvatsākhyaḥ sa ucyate ।। 24।।
caturdaśatalabhāgastrayastriṃśacchubhāṇḍakaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśottamatilakaścā'mṛtodbhava ucyate ।।।25।
caturdaśatalabhāgaḥ saptatriṃśacchubhāṇḍakaḥ ।
dvādaśatilakāḍhyaśca himavān sa tu kīrtitaḥ ।।26।।
caturdaśatalabhāgaścāṣṭatilakavāँstathā ।
ekacatvāriṃśadaṇḍo hemakūṭaḥ sa ucyate ।।27।।
ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam ।
pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ kailāsaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ ।।28।।
navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍastalabhāgāśca ṣoḍaśa ।
pṛthvīvijayasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।।29।।
ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ tathā'ṣṭakam ।
tripaṃcāśadaṇḍakaśca prāsādaścendranīlakaḥ ।।2.140.30।।
ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāśca tilakānāṃ tathā'ṣṭakam ।
saptapaṃcaśadaṇḍaśca mahānīlaḥ sa ucyate ।।3 1।।
ṣoḍaśatalabhāgāścaikaṣaṣṭyaṇḍaḥ sa bhūdharaḥ ।
aṣṭādaśatalabhāgāḥ paṃcaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakastathā ।।32।।
catuścatvāriṃśattilaḥ ratnakūṭa sa ucyate ।
aṣṭādaśa talabhāgāścatvāriṃśattilastathā ।।33 ।।
navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaḥ prokto vaidūryākhyaḥ śubho mahān ।
aṣṭādaśatalabhāgāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattilakānvitaḥ ।।34।।
trisaptatyaṇḍakaḥ proktaḥ padmarāgaḥ śubho mahān ।
aṣṭādaśa talabhāgā dvātriṃśattilakastathā ।।35।।
saptasaptatyaṇḍakaśca prāsādo vajrako hi saḥ ।
aṣṭādaśatalabhāgā aṣṭāviṃśatisattilaḥ ।। 36 ।।
ekāśītyaṇḍakaśceti mukuṭojjvala ucyate ।
aṣṭādaśa tilabhāgāścaturviṃśatisattilaḥ ।। 37।।
pañcāśītyaṇḍakaścāyamairāvatākhya ucyate ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāścatvārastilakāstathā ।।38।।
navāśītyaṇḍakaḥ prokto rājahaṃsetināmavān ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāstilakāṣṭakavāँstathā ।।39।।
trinavatyaṇḍakaḥ prokto garuḍākhyaḥ śubho hi saḥ ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāstilakānāṃ catuṣṭayam ।।2.140.40।।
saptanavatyaṇḍakaśca vṛṣabho'yaṃ samucyate ।
dvāviṃśatatilabhāgāḥ śataikāṇḍakavāँstathā ।।41।।
meruprāsāda ukto'yaṃ sarvaśobhāspado hi saḥ ।
caturasratalaṃ caikāṇḍakastilakanāmakaḥ ।।42।।
gaurītilaka ekāṇḍāṣṭatilaścaturasrakaḥ ।
talabhāgāṣṭakastilacatuṣṭyāṇḍakaikavān ।।43।।
rudratilakaprāsādaḥ śreṣṭho bodhyaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ।
talabhāgāṣṭakaścatustilako'ṇḍakapañcakaḥ ।।44।।
śrītilakasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādo'pi śubhāvahaḥ ।
talabhāgāṣṭakaṃ tilakānāṃ tathā catuṣṭayam ।।45।।
navāṇḍaṃ haritilakābhidhaṃ vai śikharaṃ matam ।
tadeva tu trayodaśāṇḍakaṃ lakṣmītilākhyakam ।।46।।
daśabhāgatalaṃ tathā dvādaśatilakāśritam ।
navaviṃśatyaṇḍakaṃ ca bhūtilakaṃ taducyate ।।47।।
tadeva ca trayastriṃśadaṇḍaṃ raṃbhātilākhyakam ।
caturviṃśatitilakaṃ talaṃ dvādaśabhāgakam ।।48।।
saptatriṃśadaṇḍakaṃ ca mandiratilakaṃ matam ।
dvādaśatalabhāgāśca viṃśatistilakāni ca ।।49।।
pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaṃ hemavattilakaṃ matam ।
caturviṃśatitilakaṃ taladvādaśabhāgakam ।।2.140.50।।
navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaṃ kailāsatilakaṃ matam ।
dvādaśa talabhāgāśca viṃśatitilakānvitam ।।51।।
saptapañcāśadaṇḍaṃ ca pṛthivītilakaṃ matam ।
ṣaṭtriṃśattilakaṃ cāṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāgakam ।।52।।
pañcaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaṃ proktaṃ tribhuvanākhyameva tat ।
tadeva navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍaṃ cendranīlatilātmakam ।।53।।
aṣṭāviṃśatitilakaṃ dvātriṃśattalabhāgakam ।
trisaptatyaṇḍakaṃ proktaṃ sarvāṃgatilakaṃ matam ।।54।।
caturviṃśatitilakaṃ dvātriṃśattalabhāgakam ।
saptasaptatyaṇḍakaṃ ca suravallabhakābhidham ।।।55।।
pañcaviṃśatyaṇḍamaṣṭabhāgatalaṃ catustilam ।
siṃhatilakamevaitat kalpitaṃ śilpibhiḥ śubham ।।56।।
dvādaśatilakaṃ saptasaptatyaṇḍaṃ talā daśa ।
makaradhvajasaṃjñaṃ tat tilakaṃ śobhanaṃ matam ।।57।।
pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatāṇḍasuśobhitam ।
daśabhāgatalaṃ cāṣṭatilaṃ maṃgalanāmakam ।।।58।।
saptadaśādhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ catustilātmakam ।
talabhāgadaśakaṃ ca tilakākṣābhidhaṃ hi tat ।।59।।
tadevaikonapañcāśadaṇḍaṃ padmatilābhidham ।
pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ talāṃśadvādaśam ।।2.140.60।।
caturviṃśatitilakaṃ somatilakamucyate ।
navāśītyadhikaśatāṇḍakaṃ dvādaśa vai talam ।।61 ।।
viṃśatitilakaṃ nāma vijayākhyaṃ mataṃ śubham ।
pañcaviṃśatyadhikacatuḥśatāṇḍakaṃ śubham ।।62।।
tale dvādaśatilake caturviṃśe tralokanam ।
dvātriṃśattalabhāgāśca catustilaka eva ca ।।63।।
trayastriṃśatsaptaśatāṇḍakaḥ ṛṣabhasaṃjñakaḥ ।
dve śate navaṣaṣṭiścāṇḍakāni yasya santi ca ।।64।।
dvādaśatalabhāgāścājitaprāsāda ucyate ।
trayodaśādhikaśatāṇḍako'ṣṭādaśasattalaḥ ।।65।।
svayaṃbhūnāmakaḥ proktaḥ prāsādaḥ sukhadāyakaḥ ।
saptasaptatyadhikāḍhyaśatāṇḍakaḥ śubhākṛtiḥ ।।66 ।।
aṣṭādaśatalabhāgaścābhinandananāmakaḥ ।
caturdaśatalabhāgaḥ saptapañcāśadaṇḍakaḥ ।।67।।
sumatyākhyaḥ sa vai bodhyaḥ sarvaśāntipradāyakaḥ ।
viṃśatistalabhāgāśca aṇḍāni dve śate nava ।।68।।
padmavallabhasaṃjñaḥ sa prāsādo nāmato mataḥ ।
daśabhāgatalaścāpi saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍakaḥ ।।69।।
supārśvavallabhaḥ so'yaṃ prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।
aṇḍakāni bhaveyuśca dve śate navaviṃśati ।।2.140.70।।
dvātriṃśattalabhāgaśca prāsādaḥ śītalābhidhaḥ ।
caturviṃśatitalabhāg dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।71 ।।
navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ śriyoṃ'śakaḥ sa ucyate ।
caturviśatitilabhāka caturviṃśatisattilaḥ ।।।72।।
trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca śītalākhyaḥ sa ucyate ।
aṣṭādaśatalabhāgo dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।73।।
saptadaśāṇḍakaḥ so'yaṃ svakulābhidha ucyate ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāgaḥ ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।74।।
dve śate saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍāni vasupūjyakaḥ ।
caturviṃśatitalabhāk saptasaptatikāṇḍakaḥ ।।75।।
vimalākhyo bhavet so'yaṃ prāsādaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ।
viṃśatitalabhāgaśca tripaṃcāśaccatuḥśatam ।।76।।
aṇḍānāṃ yasya so'nantamāyā prāsāda ucyate ।
aṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāg dvādaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।77।।
pañcaviṃśatirdve śate'ṇḍānyayaṃ dharma ucyate ।
dvādaśatalabhāgaśca navāśītiḥ śataṃ tathā ।।78।।
aṇḍānyayaṃ śāntanāmā prāsādaḥ śobhano mataḥ ।
talabhāgāṣṭakaścāpi viṃśatitilakānvitaḥ ।।79।।
navaṣaṣṭyaṇḍakaḥ so'yaṃ kanthādharaḥ samucyate ।
aṣṭabhāgatalavāँścaikaviṃśatyaṇḍakaśca yaḥ ।।2.140.80।।
kamalakandanāmā sa prāsādaḥ śobhano bhavet ।
dvādaśatalabhāgaśca tathā'ṣṭatilakaśca yaḥ ।।81।।
ekāśītiḥ śataṃ cāṇḍānyayaṃ mahendrasaṃjñakaḥ ।
caturdaśatalabhāgāstilakānyaṣṭa yatra ca ।।82।।
pañcāśītyaṇḍakaścāyaṃ mānasatuṣṭināmakaḥ ।
paḍviṃśattalabhāgāśca ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।83।।
trisaptatiścatuḥśatānyaṇḍāni sumatirhi saḥ ।
dvāviṃśatistalabhāgāścatvāriṃśattilātmakaḥ ।।84।।
śataṃ trinavatiścāṇḍakānyayaṃ nemināmakaḥ ।
ṣaḍviṃśatistalabhāgāstathā ca tilakāṣṭakam ।।85।।
trayodaśādhikaśatāṇḍakaḥ pārśvābhidho hi saḥ ।
caturviṃśatitalabhāg dve śate caikaviṃśatiḥ ।।86।।
aṇḍāni yasya sa bodhyo vīranāmā śubhāvahaḥ ।
ekāṃgaścaikaprāsādaścaturasro'ṇḍakaikavān ।।87।।
trayāṃgāstriprāsādakāḥ paṃcāgāḥ pañca ityapi ।
saptāṃgāḥ saptaprasādā navāṃgā nava ityapi ।।88।।
vicitraśikharākārāḥ śilpibuddhyudayānvitāḥ ।
ekāṇḍakaścaturasro vairājākhyo hi kathyate ।।89।।
caturbhāgatalastrayodaśāṇḍo nandanābhidhaḥ ।
ekonatriṃśadaṇḍaśca śrīnandanaḥ sa ucyate ।।2.140.90।।
ṣaṭtalāṃśaḥ pañcaviṃśatyaṇḍo mandiranāmakaḥ ।
ekonatriṃśadaṇḍaśca malayākhyaḥ sa ucyate ।।91।।
trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca vimānākhyaḥ sa ucyate ।
saptatriṃśadaṇḍaścāṣṭatilakastu viśālakaḥ ।।।92।।
ekacatvāriṃśadaṇḍastrailokyabhūṣaṇo mataḥ ।
talāṣṭāṃśaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaka eva ca ।।93।।
catustilakasaṃyukto mahendranāmako mataḥ ।
aṇḍānāṃ vardhanāt saptabhedāścāsya bhavanti hi ।।94।।
talabhāgadaśakaścaikacatvāriṃśadaṇḍakaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśatilakairyukto mahīdharaḥ sa ucyate ।।95।।
tilakāṇḍaprabhedena bahudhā'yaṃ bhavatyapi ।
ityevaṃ rādhike bhedān śikharāṇāṃ tadāha tam ।।96 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prāsādarūpe mervādijātīyā'kṣarādijātīyatadanyajātīyaprāsādānāṃ svarūpanirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhika-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 140 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 140 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 141
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 142 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yathā''ha ca ।
bhaktaṃ devāyatanakaṃ te vadāmi yathāyatham ।। 1 ।।
ekā'dhikasahasrāṇḍo dvāsaptatitalānvitaḥ ।
jyeṣṭhamervākhya evā'sau mataḥ sarvottamottamaḥ ।। 2 ।।
caturasrīkṛte kṣetre dvāsaptativibhājite ।
sārdhacaturbhāgabhittiḥ sārdhataryābhramantikā ।। 3 ।।
atha kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ daśadhā bhājayettataḥ ।
bhāgaikā bhramaṇī kāryā bhittirbhāgaikasammatā ।। 4 ।।
koṇo bhāgadvayātmā sārdhaikaṃ pratirathaṃ tathā ।
bhadraṃ bhāgatrayaṃ caitat sarvadikṣu samānakam ।। 5 ।।
atha kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ tvaṣṭadhā bhājayetpunaḥ ।
dvibhāgastatra koṇaśca bhadraṃ bhāgadvayātmakam ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ tridhā bhavantyeva meruprāsādakā bhuvi ।
dvāsaptatitalabhāgāḥ kaṇādibhadrakāntakāḥ ।। 7 ।।
bodhyāstatra ṣaḍdvayaṃ ṣaḍdvayaṃ ṣaḍdvayam ṣaḍdvyam ।
ākarṇabhadramāvṛtya cāṃgabhāgādiyojanā ।। 8 ।।
bhāgāṣṭakaṃ ca bhadrārdhaṃ nirgame bhāgaṣaṭkakam ।
bhadropari gavākṣāśca tavaṃgarathikāstathā ।। 9 ।।
tathā paṃcoruśṛṃgāṇi ropaṇīyāni sarvathā ।
koṇe tu sarvatobhadro nandīśaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ ।। 2.141.10 ।।
krameṇoparyuparyeva saṃsthāpyāste dṛḍhātmakāḥ ।
navāṇḍo bhadrako nandīśaścaikaviṃśatyaṇḍakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
navacatvāriṃśadaṇḍaḥ pṛthivījaya ādṛtaḥ ।
karṇasamabhāgapaḍhare keśarībhadrakastathā ।। 12।।
nandīśālaḥ pradātavyāstatra pañcāṇḍakeśarī ।
nandīśālaḥ saptadaśāṇḍako bhadro navāṇḍakaḥ ।। 13।।
bhadrasya vāmadakṣasthanandikānāmuparyatha ।
keśarī keśarī śrīvatsaḥ śrīvatsāṇḍakāstathā ।। 14।।
deyāstatraikāṇḍakastu śrīvatso'nye tu pūrvavat। ।
koṇasya vāmadakṣasthanandikānāmuparyatha ।। 15 ।।
keśarī keśarī śrīvatsaśrīvatsāṇḍakāstathā ।
nandikāstatra ṣaḍbodhyāḥ svalpā mahatya eva vā ।। 16 ।।
pratikarṇavāmadakṣasthanandikopari dhruvaḥ ।
keśarī eva dātavyo nā'nyathā tu kadācana ।। 17।।
bhadre tu nāsikāṃ kṛtvā tatra śrīvatsakā'ṇḍakaḥ ।
karṇe ca pratikarṇe ca bhadrasya vāmadakṣiṇe ।। 18।।
catuḥṣvevaṃ pradeyāni pratyaṃgānyaṣṭasaṃkhyayā ।
evaṃ caturṣu dikṣu dvātriṃśatpratyaṃgakāni vai ।। 19।।
dvāsaptatipadasaudhe catuṣpaṃcāśadaṃśakaiḥ ।
śikharasya namaṇasya rekhāḥ kāryāstataḥ param ।। 2.141.20 ।।
evaṃ bhavati caikāḍhyasahasrāṇḍasamanvitaḥ ।
jyeṣṭhamerusamākhyo vai parabrahmanivāsavān ।। 21 ।।
madhyameruṃ kathayāmi kṣetraṃ tu caturasrakam ।
catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgaṃ ca garbhādikoṇakāvadhim ।। 22।।
saptadvayatricatuṣṣaṭactuṣṣaḍbhirvibhājayet ।
tribhāgo bhadranistāro bhadro'yaṃ bhāgasaptakaḥ ।। 23।।
prathamā nandikā bhāgadvayā bhāgatrayā'parā ।
pratikarṇacaturbhāgaḥ ṣaḍbhāgaḥ prātirāthakaḥ ।।24।।
pratikarṇaścaturbhāgaḥ koṇaḥ ṣaḍabhāgajastathā ।
evaṃ kāryaṃ caturdikṣu ṣaḍbhāgā bhramaṇī matā ।।25।।
ṣaṭṣaḍbhāgā bhittikāśca rekhā viṃśatibhāgikā ।
keśarī sarvatobhadro nandano nandaśālikaḥ ।।26।।
sthāpyāḥ krameṇa koṇeṣu trayodaśāṇḍanandanaḥ ।
śrīvatsau dvau keśarī syuḥ pratikarṇe sthitāḥ kramāt ।।27।।
śrīvatsaḥ keśarī caiva sarvatobhadrakastathā ।
paḍharopari dātavyaḥ prāsādatrayabhūṣaṇāḥ ।।28।।
śrīvatsaḥ keśarī caiva nandikāyāṃ niyojayet ।
dvitīyā nandikā kāryā śrīvatsadvayaśobhitā ।।29।।
paḍhare pratirathake karṇe ca nandike tathā ।
tadardhe vāmadakṣe tu deyaṃ pratyaṃgameva ca ।।2.141.30।।
aṇḍakāḥ pūrvavad bodhyāḥ śṛṃgamānaṃ ca pūrvavat ।
pañcādhikapañcaśatāṇḍako'yaṃ merumadhyamaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
munividyādharasiṃhagajaghaṇṭakakūṭakaiḥ ।
varālikāsaṃvaraṇairyuktaḥ śivādhivāsanaḥ ।।32।।
catuṣṣaṣṭitalaḥ pañcādhikapañcaśatāṇḍakaḥ ।
madhyameruḥ kīrtito'tha kaniṣṭhaṃ pravadāmi ca ।।33।।
