caturasrīkṛte kṣetre pañcapañcāśadaṃśake ।
ṣaṭtritriṣaṭtriṣaḍbhiśca kartavyā yojanā kramāt ।।34।।
bhadramārabhya karṇāntā bhadrārdhaṃ cāṃśaṣaṭkakam ।
bhāgadvayaṃ nirgame ca tribhāṇā nandikā tathā ।।35।।
dvitīyāpi tribhāgā ca paḍharo bhāgaṣaṭkavān ।
tṛtīyā nandikā bhāgatrayāḍhyā koṇakāstu ṣaṭ ।।36।।
nirgame samabhāvāste tataḥ kāryāṃ'gayojanā ।
bhittiḥ sārdhacaturaṃśā bhramaṇyapi tathā''yatā ।।37।।
namaṇasya tu rekhāśca madhyamerāviva dhruvāḥ ।
pratirathe ca koṇe ca śṛṃgāṇi trīṇi trīṇi ca ।।38।।
keśarīsaṃjñakānyeva deyānyuparitastataḥ ।
nandikāyāṃ pratikarṇe śrīvatsāśca trayastrayaḥ ।।39।।
bhadre tu nāsikāṃ kṛtvā dvau prakāryau śrīvatsakau ।
catvāri coruśṛṃgāṇi pratyaṃgaṃ vāmadakṣake ।।2.141.40 ।।
trinavatyāḍhyadviśatāṇḍako meruḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ ।
gaṇavidyādhrādiśobho devānāṃ priya eva ca ।।41 ।।
atha mandiranāmāpi merumandiramucyate ।
caturastrīkṛte kṣetrehyaṣṭātriṃśadvibhājite ।।42।।
caturbhāgaṃ bhaved bhadraṃ dvibhāgaścāsya nirgamaḥ ।
nandikā caikabhāgā ca dvitīyā dvayaṃśikā tathā ।।43।।
pañcabhāgaḥ paḍharaśca tathā bhāgadvayā'parā ।
nandikā cā'tha koṇastu pañcabhāgātmakastathā ।।44।।
samadalāḥ sarva ete bhittiḥ sārdhatrayā matā ।
bhramaṇyapi sārdhatrayā caturdikṣu samā matā ।।45।।
madhyaprāsādakatalaṃ mataṃ dvādaśabhāgakam ।
caturdikṣveva kartavyaṃ koṇe keśariṇastrayaḥ ।।46 ।।
ekaṃ śrīvatsakaṃ cāpi tato'tha paḍharopari ।
śrīvatsāśca trayaścaikaṃ tilakaṃ kāryameva ca ।।47।।
sarvanandikordhvake ca śrīvatsānāṃ tathā'ṇḍakāḥ ।
trayastrayaḥ karaṇīyāścatuḥśṛṃgāṇi bhadrake ।।48।।
pratyaṃgāni dakṣiṇe vāmake cāpi yathāyatham ।
rekhordhve dvādaśabhāgeṣvapi rūpāṇi sannyaset ।।49।।
aṣṭātriṃśattalabhāgastathā ca tilakāṣṭakaḥ ।
evaṃ pañcāśītyadhikā'ṇḍako merurayaṃ mataḥ ।।2.141.50।।
aṣṭātriṃśattalabhāgāścatuṣṣaṣṭitilāni ca ।
navacatvāriṃśadadhikaṃ śataṃ cāṇḍamaṇḍalam ।।51 ।।
lakṣmīkoṭarasaṃjño'yaṃ prāsādo merurucyate ।
caturviṃśatitilakaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattalabhāgavān ।।52।।
navaviṃśatyekaśatāṇḍakaḥ kailāsamerukaḥ ।
dvāsaptatitilakāḍhyaścāṣṭādaśatalāṃśavān ।।53।।
ekaṣaṭyadhikaśatāṇḍaḥ sa paṃcānanābhidhaḥ ।
caturviṃśatitilakaḥ saptasaptatikāṇḍavān ।।54।।
ṣaḍeviṃśattalabhāgaḥ sa vimānamerurucyate ।
catuṣṣaṣṭyādhikaśatatilakaśca tale tu yaḥ ।।।55।।।
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhāgavān navādhikadviśatakāṇḍakaḥ ।
gandhamādananāmā'sau meruḥ prāsādako mataḥ ।।56।।
ṣaḍviṃśatitalabhāgā viṃśatistilakāni ca ।
pañcaviṃśatyadhikaikaśatāṇḍo muktakoṇakaḥ ।।57।।
ṣaṭtriṃśaśca śataṃ cāpi tilakāni tathā tale ।
dvātriṃśadbhāgakā yasya tathā śataṃ ca paṃca ca ।।58।।
catvāriṃśaccāṇḍakāni giriprāsādakā'bhidhaḥ ।
caturaśītitilakaścāṣṭādaśatalāṃśavān ।।59।।
ekaviṃśatyaṇḍakaśca tilakābhidhamerukaḥ ।
dvānavatitilakaśca navādhikaśatāṇḍakaḥ ।।2.141.6 0।।
catustriṃśattalabhāgaścandraśekharamerukaḥ ।
ṣaṭpaṃcāśattilakaścaivatrisaptatikāṇḍakaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
aṣṭāviṃśatitalabhāṅmandiratilakābhidhaḥ ।
trayastriṃśadaṇḍakaśca ṣoḍaśatilakānvitaḥ ।।62।।
dvādaśatalabhāgaśca saubhāgyamerureva saḥ ।
aṇḍāni ca navādhikacattvāriṃśattu yatra vai ।।63।।
tilakāni cāṣṭayuktacatvāriṃśattu yatra ca ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāgāḥ sundaro merureva saḥ ।।64।।
viṃśatistalabhāgāśca ṣaṭtriṃśattilakāni ca ।
aṇḍāni navacatvāriṃśadyuktaśatameva tu ।।65।।
śrītilakā'bhidhāno'sau prāsādaḥ sammataḥ śubhaḥ ।
saptapaṃcāśadāḍhyaikaśatāṇḍakastu yo bhavet ।।66।।
catvāriṃśattilakaścāṣṭāviṃśatisattalaḥ ।
viśālākhyaḥ sa vai bodhyaḥ prāsādaḥ śubhado mataḥ ।।67।।
ekāṇḍaśca catuścatvāriṃśattilakavāँstathā ।
dvādaśatalabhāgaśca parvatakūṭako hi saḥ ।।68।।
catvāriṃśattilakaśca saptapaṃcāśadaṇḍakaḥ ।
dvāviṃśatitalabhāk sa nandivardhana ucyate ।।6 9 ।।
ityevaṃ kathitāḥ sarve prāsādāśca mamā''layāḥ ।
pratimāścātha vakṣyāmi yathā yathā tu me matā ।।2.141.70।।
nibiḍā nirvaṇā mṛdvī sugandhā madhurā śilā ।
kāntiyuktā darśanīyā pratimārthā śilā bhavet ।।71 ।।
nirmalaṃ hemakāṃsyādi cihnaṃ lohamayaṃ ca yat ।
tathā vicitravikṛtiḥ pratimāyāṃ bhayāvaham ।।72।।
bhṛṃgakapotakumudamāṣamudgasitopamā ।
pāṇḍurā ghṛtapadmābhā sarvārcāsu śilā śubhā ।।।73।।
dvādaśāṃgulato nyūnā pūjyā mūrtirgṛhe matā ।
dvādaśāṃgulato navagajāntā'rcyā surālaye ।।74।।
daśagajordhvā pratimā pūjyā prāsādakaṃ vinā ।
catuṣkyāmeva sā paṃcacatvāriṃśadgajāntikā ।।75।।
aṣṭalauhamayī śailī ratnajā śreṣṭhadārujā ।
pravālādimayī cāpi pratimā śubhadāyinī ।।76 ।।
śatavatsarapūrvā yā daivipuruṣaveśitā ।
khaṇḍitā sphuṭitā'pyarcyā tadanyā doṣadāyinī ।।77।।
tīrthabhūmiṣvaraṇye ca devatāḥ khaṇḍitā api ।
pūjanīyā hi phaladā nānyatra tu kadācana ।।78।।
rātnī ca dhātavī lepaliptā ca durghaṭā tu yā ।
punaḥ saṃskārayogyā sā pūjanīyā tato bhavet ।।79।।
kāṣṭhapāṣāṇajā bhagnā saṃskārārhā na sā matā ।
nādhikāṃgā na hīnāṃgā kartavyā sā kadācana ।।2.141.80।।
kāṣṭhalepāśmadantotthā vitrā''yasādijāpi ca ।
mānādhikā devaparivārā gṛhe na pūjyate ।।8 1 ।।
garjanāṃ rodanaṃ hāsyamunmīlananimīlane ।
krūratāṃ yatra kurvanti devāstatra mahadbhayam ।।82।।
pṛthvyāṃ śilā tu yā suptā nikhanyate bahistadā ।
dakṣiṇaṃ paścimaṃ pārśvaṃ smṛtvā śiro vidhāpayet ।।83 ।।
ekabhāgaṃ grāhamukhaṃ pakṣī dvibhāgavāँstathā ।
tribhāgāḥ kuṃjarādyāśca caturbhāgāśca kinnarāḥ ।।84।।
vṛṣāḥ surāḥ pañcabhāgāḥ kartavyāḥ śilpinā śubhāḥ ।
gaṇeśo vāmanaḥ kroḍaścaite ṣaḍaṃśakā matāḥ ।।85।।
saptabhāgāstu kartavyā vṛṣabhakroḍamānavāḥ ।
aṣṭāṃśā pārvatī śaktistathā'nyā devikā api ।।86।।
navāṃ'śā'nyasurāḥ śivasaṃkarṣaṇā daśāṃśakāḥ ।
caṇḍībhūtahanumān kārtikāścaikādaśāṃśakāḥ ।।87।।
vaitālo dvādaśāṃśaśca trayodaśāṃśarākṣasāḥ ।
daityāścaturdaśāṃśāśca pañcadaśāṃśako bhṛguḥ । ।88।।
krūrā devā devikādyāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśā matāḥ sadā ।
gaṇeśo mūṣakārūḍho dhatte dantaparaśvadhau ।।89 । ।
paṃkajaṃ modakaṃ cāpi hastyāsyaḥ sarpabhūṣaṇaḥ ।
mukhaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ tasya bhāgadvayaṃ tathodaram ।। 2.141.90 ।।
caturaṃgulaṃ jaghanam ājānvaṃgulasaptakam ।
jānū tryaṃgulamevā'pi jaṃghā saptāṃgulā tathā ।। 91 ।।
pādastryaṃgula evāpi mānaṃ ṣaḍbhāgamūrtikam ।
saptabhāge pramāṇaṃ tu kathayāmi nibodha me ।। 92 ।।
keśāntāstu trayo bhāgā mukhamekāṃśakaṃ tathā ।
tryaṃgulaḥ kaṇṭha evāpi pakṣaḥ sārdhadaśāṃgulaḥ ।। 93 ।।
navāṃgulodaraṃ proktaṃ sārdhaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu vai ।
nābhiliṃgāntarālaṃ ca sakthyaṣṭādaśakāṃgulam ।। 94।।
jānustryaṃgulakaścāpi jaṃghā'ṣṭādaśakāṃgulā ।
pādastryaṃgulako bodhyaḥ saptavitastikāyakaḥ ।। 95।।
aṣṭatāle mukhaṃ tālaṃ keśāntaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ tathā ।
grīvā ca tryaṃgulā bodhyā hṛdayaṃ ca navāṃgulam ।। 96 ।।
dvādaśāṃgulamānābhim āmeḍhaṃ ca navāṃgulam ।
ekaviṃśatyaṃgulorurjānustryaṃgulako mataḥ ।। 97।।
ekaviṃśatyaṃgulā jaṃghā pādastryaṃgulastathā ।
eṣā cāṣṭavitastyāḍhyā mūrtiḥ proktā suśilpake ।। 98।।
navatālaṃ tathā vacmi keśāntaṃ tryaṃgulaṃ tathā ।
dvādaśāṃgulakaṃ bodhyaṃ mukhaṃ kaṇṭhoṃ'gulatrayaḥ ।। 99 ।।
daśāṃgulaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ nābhirdvādaśakāṃ'gulā ।
caturaṃgulamudaraṃ guhyaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulāntaram ।। 2.141.100 ।।
sakthi caturviṃśatikāṃgulaṃ jānuścaturmitaḥ ।
caturviṃśatyaṃgulā ca jaṃghā pādaścaturmitaḥ ।। 101 ।।
vistāre stanagarbhe tu dvādaśāṃgulamīritam ।
stanāt kukṣiścaturaṃgulāyatā śobhanā tathā ।। 102।।
kukṣibāhvoravakāśaścaikāṃgulo mataḥ śubhaḥ ।
hastaḥ saptāṃgulaḥ puṣṭaḥ skandhāt kaphoṇikāṃ prati ।। 103 ।।
śoḍaśāṃguladairghyaṃ ca tataḥ prakoṣṭhakaṃ daśa ।
prakoṣṭhāyatatā tryaṃgulā'tha hastatalaṃ tu vai ।। 1 04।।
dvādaśāṃgulalambaṃ ca paṃcāgulaṃ tathā''yatam ।
madhyaṃ caturdaśāṃgulāyataṃ kaṭistu vai tathā ।। 105 ।।
caturviṃśatyaṃgulā ca sakthimūlaṃ daśaikakam ।
jaṃghāprakoṣṭhaścaturaṃgulāyatastathā punaḥ ।। 1 06।।
caturdaśāṃgulapādāyatatāṃ'gulikāntikā ।
bāhutaḥstanabhāgaśca caturaṃgulordhvagaḥ ।। 1 07।।
kukṣeḥ skandhoparibhāgaścāṣṭāṃgulo matastathā ।
kaṇṭho'ṣṭāṃśaḥ pādaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśāyataśceti mānatā ।। 1 08।।
ityevaṃ rādhike mānaṃ bahudhā'pi bhavatyapi ।
yugānurūpamevā'pi yathāha devataṃ hariḥ ।। 1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave uttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhamerumandirāṇāṃ gaṇeśādimūrtīnāṃ ca mānānumāpādinirūpaṇanāmaika-
catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 141 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 142
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 143 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! cānyasuramūrtīrvadāmi te ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadāha bhaktakam ।। 1 ।।
aṃgapratyaṃgabhagnāṃ tu mūrtiṃ visarjayejjale ।
nakhā''bharaṇamālā'strabhagnāṃ tāṃ na visarjayet ।। 2 ।।
ṛgvedādicaturbhedāt satyayugādibhedataḥ ।
brāhmādivarṇabhedācca caturmukho hi viśvasṛṭ ।। 3 ।।
dakṣiṇārdhaḥ karādūrdhvaṃ japamālāṃ tathā srucam ।
granthaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ dhatte saśmaśruḥ kamalāsanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
akṣasūtraṃ pustakaṃ ca dhatte padmakamaṇḍalū ।
caturvaktrā hi sāvitrī śrotriyā''nandakāriṇī ।। 5 ।।
ṛgvedaḥ śvetavarṇaśca dvibhujo rāsabhānanaḥ ।
akṣamālāmbupātraṃ ca bibhran svādhyayane rataḥ ।। 6 ।।
ajā''syaḥ pītavarṇaśca yajurvedo'kṣasūtravān ।
vāme cāṃkuśapāṇistu bhūtido maṃgalāvahaḥ ।। 7 ।।
nīlotpaladalābhāsaḥ sāmavedo hayānanaḥ ।
akṣamālādharaḥ savye vāme kambudharaḥ sa vai ।। 8 ।।
atharvaṇābhidho vedo dhavalo markaṭānanaḥ ।
akṣasūtraṃ ca khaṣṭvāṃgaṃ bibhran vai vijayapradaḥ ।। 9 ।।
viśvakarmā caturbāhurakṣamālāṃ ca sūtrakam ।
gajaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ dhatte trinetro haṃsavāhanaḥ ।। 2.142.10 ।।
sudarśanakarā savye padmahastā tu vāmataḥ ।
etad viṣṇunāmakasya rūpaṃ sūryasya kīrtitam ।। 1 1।।
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
dvibhujaṃ caikavastraṃ ca śvetapaṃkajadhṛkkaram ।। 12।।
vartulaṃ tejasāṃ bimbaṃ madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam ।
saptānanahayairyuktaṃ rathe'ruṇena saṃyutam ।। 13 ।।
viṣṇurgaṇeśaḥ sūryaśca śaktiḥ rudraśca devatāḥ ।
pañcāyatanarūpāśca bodhyāḥ sarvatra śobhanāḥ ।। 14।।
navāṃśā tatra kartavyā mūrtirnārāyaṇasya vai ।
śaṃkhapadmagadācakradhāriṇī mukuṭānvitā ।। 15।।
harirdhārayate kambuṃ cakraṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇo dhatte pāñcajanyaṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ sudarśanam ।। 16।।
garuḍo harito rūpe kauśikākāranāsikaḥ ।
caturbhujo vṛttanetramukhaḥ pakṣadvayā'nvitaḥ ।। 17।।
gṛdhrorujānucaraṇaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ kalāyutaḥ ।
chatraṃ kumbhaṃ dhārayeścāṃ'jaliṃ kurvan namoyutaḥ ।। 18।।
vāmāgre kuñcitaḥ paścādanyapādastu jānunā ।
pṛthivīṃ saṃśritaḥ patro garuḍāsanasaṃsthitaḥ ।। 19।।
umāmaheśvaro dakṣe kare triśūlakaṃ tathā ।
mātuliṃgaṃ samādhatte āliṃgitaṃ tu vāmake ।।2.142.20 ।।
aṃke sve pārvatīṃ devīṃ samāsīnāṃ śubhānanām ।
nāgendro'nyakare skandhe umāhasto'tiśobhanaḥ ।।21 ।।
karānye darpaṇaṃ cāpi vṛṣabho'dhaḥsthitastathā ।
kumāreṇa gaṇeśena bhṛṃgīraṭādibhiryutaḥ ।।22।।
umāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ kuryāllakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇāśritām ।
hariḥ śastraiḥ svakīyaiśca garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ ।।23।।
dakṣiṇaḥ kaṇṭhalagnaḥ syād vāmahastaḥ sarojadhṛk ।
harervāmakaro lakṣmyāḥ kukṣibhāge sthitaḥ śubhaḥ ।।24।।
varaṃ triśūlarekhe ca pānapātraṃ subibhratī ।
mayūraṃ ca hastiṃ ca mahālakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā ।।25।।
aṣṭapatrāmbujasyordhve lakṣmīḥ siṃhāsanasthitā ।
vināyakavadāsīnā bhūṣitā''bharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।।26।।
ūrdhvahastau prakartavyau devyāḥ paṃkajadhāriṇau ।
vāme'mṛtaghaṭaṃ dhatte dakṣiṇe mātuliṃgakam ।।27।।।
ekavaktrā caturhastā mukuṭena virājitā ।
prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃyuktā kuṇḍalānvitaśekharā ।।28।।
akṣā'bjavīṇāgranthāḍhyā mahāvidyā prakīrtitā ।
varākṣā'bjagranthayuktā sarasvatīśubhāvahā ।।29।।
bhittisaṃlagnabimbaśca puruṣaḥ sarvathā'śubhaḥ ।
na kadāpi dhvajādaṇḍaḥ sthāpyo vai gṛhamandire ।।2.142.3 0।।
ravāvuttarage śreṣṭhaṃ devānāṃ sthāpanādikam ।
abhiṣekaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca praveśaḥ pūjanādikam ।।3 1 ।।
prāsādā'gre tathaiśāne cottare maṇḍapogajaiḥ ।
tripaṃcasaptanavaikādaśabhiścāntarālake ।। 3 2।।
pṛthvīṃ pūrvaṃ śodhayitvā dāhakhātajalārpaṇaiḥ ।
puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca pūjayitvā ca kūrmakam ।।33।।
śeṣanāgaṃ kṣitiṃ cāpi pūjayitvā tataḥ param ।
śuddhapūrvāṃ diśaṃ maṇḍapārthaṃ prasādhayed yathā ।।34।।
sūtreṇa vartulaṃ kṛtvā madhye śaṃkuṃ praropayet ।
udayā'stasamayasya rekhābhyāṃ sādhayed diśam ।।35।।
aṣṭadaśadvādaśaṣoḍaśā'ṣṭādaśahastakaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśādistaṃbhayukto viṃśatihastako'pi vā ।। 36।।
vitastyucchrāyatalavān gajocchrāyatalo'pi vā ।
dvitīye maṇḍape kārye cādyamaṇḍapamānataḥ ।।37।।
tāvaddhastapramāṇaṃ ca tyaktvā kāryo'nyamaṇḍapaḥ ।
maṇḍape navabhāge ca madhyabhāgā tu vedikā ।।38।।
maṇḍapasya tṛtīyāṃśā vedikā madhyagā matā ।
aṣṭāṃgulādhikadvihastapramāṇamitāni vai ।। 39।।
caturdvārāṇi ramyāṇi toraṇādyairdyumanti ca ।
kartavyānyatha ca dhvajān kathayāmi nibodha me ।।2.142.40।।
aṣṭadhvajā ropaṇīyāḥ pūrvādikramato yathā ।
dvidvagajāyatāḥ paṃcapaṃcagajapralambanāḥ ।।41 ।।
pūrve pīto hasticitra indradhvajaḥ sa ucyate ।
agnau raktaścoraṇā''syacitravānagnidaivataḥ ।।42।।
dakṣe kṛṣṇo mahiṣāḍhyo yamadhvaja saḥ ucyate ।
nairṛtye nīlavarṇaśca sacitro rākṣaso dhvajaḥ ।।43।।
paścime śvetavarṇaśca makarāsyaśca vāruṇaḥ ।
vāyau harito mṛgavān vāyudhvajaḥ sa ucyate ।।44।।
uttare śvetavarṇaśca hasticihnaḥ kuberakaḥ ।
īśāne śvetavarṇaśca vṛṣacitrayuto dhvajaḥ ।।45।।
daśahastadīrghavaṃśaśīrṣe dhṛtvā'rpayeddhi tān ।
vaṃśā bhūmau ropaṇīyā dārḍhyasya hetave khalu ।।46।।
maṇḍapasya madhyabhāge saptahastasudīrghakaḥ ।
trihastāyata evāpi kiṃkiṇījālakāntakaḥ ।।47।।
miśraraṃgaścāmarāḍhyaḥ pradātavyaḥ śubho mataḥ ।
daśahastavaṃśaśīrṣe sudṛḍhaḥ śobhano bhavet ।।48।।
saptasaptahastadīrghā ekaikahastakā''yatā ।
trikoṇākṛtikā tattadāyudhāḍhyā ca vaṃśagā ।।49।।
vajraśaktidaṇḍakhaṅgapāśāṃkuśagadāstathā ।
triśūlaṃ ceti kramaśo bodhyānyāyudhakāni ca ।।2.142.50।।
pūrvoktaraṃgayuktāśca patākāstu samantataḥ ।
patākā navamī śvetā madhye ceśānapūrvayoḥ ।।51।।
puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tāṃ ropayed daṇḍaśīrṣasu ।
api kuṇḍavidhiṃ vacmi maṇḍapāntarabhūmiṣu ।।52।।
daśahastebhya ārabhya ṣoḍaśagajasammite ।
vedīṃ maṇḍapamadhye ca kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍāँstathā śubhān ।।53।।
pañcā'ṣṭau nava vā kuryāt pūrvādikramaśaḥ khalu ।
pūrve catuṣkoṇakaṃ ca yonyākāraṃ tathāgnike ।।54।।
ardhacandraṃ dakṣiṇe tu nairṛtye tu trikoṇakam ।
paścime vartulaṃ kuryād vāyau ṣaṭkoṇameva ca ।।55।।
uttare'ṣṭadalapadmābhamaṣṭāsrakamīśini ।
vṛtto vā caturasro vā pūrveśānasumadhyake ।।56।।
ācārya kuṇḍanāmā'sau sadikpālādikuṇḍavān ।
yadvā kuryāt pañcakuṇḍīḥ pūrve sā caturastikā ।।57।।
ardhacandrasamā dakṣe vṛttā tu paścime ca sā ।
uttare padmarūpā ca īśāne vartulā'thavā ।।58।।
caturasrā ca kartavyā rūpāntaraprabhedataḥ ।
eka eva yadīṣṭaḥ saḥ caturasro mato hiḥ saḥ ।।59।।
paścime cottare vā caiśāne vā kārya eva saḥ ।
sapādagajadūre vai vedyāḥ sarve ca kuṇḍakāḥ ।।2.142.6 0।।
yadvā vedīcaturbhāgā'ntarālā'nte matā hi te ।
caturasro brahmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vartulaḥ ।।6 1।।
ardhacandraḥ sa vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sa trikoṇakaḥ ।
yadvā catuṣkoṇa eva sarveṣāṃ vartulo'thavā ।।6 2।।
nārīṇāṃ yonikuṇḍo vai sammataḥ sarvathā śubhaḥ ।
mekhalāyoniyuktaśca hastamātro hi kuṇḍakaḥ ।।63।।
homāyutaṃ hastamātre lakṣārdhaṃ tu dvihastake ।
lakṣahomaṃ trihaste ca daśalakṣaṃ catuṣkike ।।64।।
triṃśallakṣaṃ pañcahaste koṭyardhaṃ tu ṣaḍasrake ।
saptake'śītilakṣaṃ ca koṭihomaṃ gajāṣṭake ।।65।।
pañcāśaddhavane kuryādekaviṃśatikāṃgulam ।
śatahome sārdhadvāviṃśatikāṃgulakaṃ tathā ।।66।।
sahastahavanārthaṃ tu hastaikamānavānmataḥ ।
homā'yutāya dvigajo lakṣe caturgajātmakaḥ ।।67।।
ṣaḍhasto daśalakṣārthaṃ koṭihomārthameva tu ।
aṣṭahasto daśahasto'thavā ṣoḍaśahastakaḥ ।।68।।
sūkṣmaṃ havistilaghṛtaṃ madhyaṃ drākṣāyavādikam ।
sthūlaṃ bilvaṃ nārikelaṃ samidhādi prakīrtitam ।।69।।
yādṛśaṃ tu bhaved dravyaṃ tathā kuṇḍo'pyapekṣitaḥ ।
yadvā kuṇḍaṃ pratilakṣaṃ gajamānaṃ vivardhayet ।।2.142.70।।
daśalakṣapraparyantaṃ daśahastaṃ vidhāpayet ।
yadvā saptagajaḥ pañcāśallakṣahavanārthakaḥ ।।71 ।।
daśalakṣahavanāya pañcahastamito'pi vā ।
viṃśatilakṣahomārthaṃ ṣaṅgajaḥ kuṇḍako mataḥ ।।72।।
lakṣārdhahavanārthaṃ trihastakaḥ kuṇḍa ityapi ।
kuṇḍasya gādhatā kṣetrasamā samekhalā matā ।।73।।
vināpi mekhalāṃ samā gādhatā'pi prakīrtitā ।
caturviṃśatyaṃśake dvādaśāṃśaḥ kuṇḍakaṇṭhakaḥ ।।74।।
ekā dve tisra etā vā dve tisraḥ pañca mekhalā ।
kṣetrabhāgāṣṭake pañcabhāgāṃ gādhāṃ khanet tataḥ ।।75।।
tribhāge mekhalāścordhve tisraḥ kāryā vidhānataḥ ।
ūrdhvā caturaṃgulā ca madhyā tryaṃgulakā matā ।।76 ।।
nimnā bhāgadvayāḍhyā ca mekhalā śubhadā matā ।
caturasraṃ gajamātraṃ caturaṃgulakocchrayam ।।77।।
ekāṃgulocchrayaṃ vāpi sthaṇḍilaṃ homavedikā ।
viśālāyāṃ vedikāyām ekadvitragajāyatam ।।78।।
sarvatobhadrakaṃ nāma maṇḍalaṃ kāryameva ca ।
aṣṭau dvātriṃśadevā'pi catuṣṣaṣṭiśca vā dvijāḥ ।।79।।
ṛtvijo vaidikāścābhimantraṇīyāḥ kriyāvidaḥ ।
maṇḍapasya tribhāgena cottare snānamaṇḍapaḥ ।।2.142.80।।
tatra vai sthaṇḍile śaile vāluke chāyayānvite ।
pratimāḥ snapayitavyāḥ pañcagavyaiḥ kaṣāyakaiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
snāpayecchatakalaśavāribhirvalkalānvitāḥ ।
vedamantraiśca vāditrairgītimaṃgalakīrtanaiḥ ।।82।।
vedīpārśve maṇḍapādho vastreṇācchādayet surān ।
tulāmāropayed vedyāmuttarādau ca tāṃ nyaset ।।83 ।।
kalaśaṃ tu śirodeśe pādasthāne kamaṇḍalum ।
vyajanaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe ca darpaṇaṃ vāmabhāgake ।।84।।
vajravaidūryamuktāśca tvindranīlaṃ sunīlakam ।
puṣparāgaṃ ca gomedaṃ pravālaṃ pūrvadikkramaiḥ ।।85।।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ rītiṃ ca sīsakam ।
vaṃgaṃ lohaṃ ca pūrvādau kramād dhātūnihā'rpayet ।।86।।
vajraṃ vahniśikhāṃ sahadevīṃ tulasīpatrakam ।
indravāruṇikāṃ śaṃkhāvalīmudyāvalīṃ tathā ।।87।।
tvaritāṃ pūrvakramataścauṣadhīḥ sthāpayettathā ।
yavaṃ vrīhiṃ ca kaṅgūṃ ca javarīṃ ca tilāni ca ।।88 ।।
akṣakān mudgakān godhūmakān pūrvāditaḥ kramāt ।
mahotsavaṃ nṛtyagītanaivedyārārtrikādibhiḥ ।।89।।
aṃganyāsādibhiścāpi pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret ।
devārpitaṃ vastrabhūṣādikaṃ dadettu śilpine ।।2.142.90।।
yajñārpitaṃ samagraṃ tu dadyādācāryarūpiṇe ।
prāsāde devatānyāsān pratyekāṃgeṣu kārayet ।।91 ।।
vārāhaṃ kharaśilāyāṃ nāgaṃ tu vārimārgage ।
kuṃbhīṣu jaladevaṃ ca puṣpakaṇṭhe'surāँstathā ।।92।।
jāḍyakuṃbhe nandinīṃ ca viṣṇuṃ karṇikayostathā ।
gajapīṭhe gaṇeśaṃ ca hyaśvapīṭhe tathā'śvinau ।।93।।
narapīṭhe nagāँścaiva kṣurake medinīṃ tathā ।
sandhyātrayaṃ bhadrakuṃbhe kalaśe pārvatīṃ tathā ।।94।।
kapotālyāṃ ca gandharvān mañcikāyāṃ sarasvatīm ।
jaṃghāyāṃ tu diśāṃpālān udgame cendradevatām ।।95।।
sāvitrīṃ tu bharaṇyāṃ ca śirāvaṭyāṃ tu devikāḥ ।
vidyādharīṃ puṣpakaṇṭhe surāँścāyantarālake ।।96।.।
parjanyaṃ kūṭacchādye ca śākhayoḥ sūryacandrakau ।
uttaraṃge tridevāँścodumbare yakṣakaṃ tathā ।।97।।
śaṃkhāvaṭe'śvinīputro kolyāṃ śeṣaṃ kṣmāṃ paṭṭake ।
staṃbhe parvatadevāँśca ghūmmaṭe vyomadevatāḥ ।।98।।
madhye mukhyaṃ ca devaṃ ca paranāle tu jāhnavīm ।
śikharasyoruśṛṃgeṣu brahmaviṣṇuhareśvarān ।।99।।
indraṃ ceti pañcadevān prāsāde trīn sureśvarān ।
śikhare caiśvaraṃ devaṃ kalaśe tvindrameva ca ।। 2.142.100 ।।
grīvāyāmamaraṃ cāmalasāre tu niśācaram ।
padmapatre tu padmākṣaṃ kalaśo tu sadāśivam ।। 10 1।।
chādyavāmeva'ghoradevaṃ dakṣe tatpuruṣaṃ tathā ।
bhairavaṃ sthāpayeccāpi prāsāde pañcabhāgake ।। 102।।
devaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmakanyā vilokayet ।
tato'nye darśanaṃ kuryuḥ sādhusādhvyo virāgiṇaḥ ।। 103 ।।
tato vai gṛhadharmāṇastena devapratoṣaṇam ।
prārthayed yajamānastu puṇyaṃ vai sūtradhārataḥ ।। 1 04।।
sūtradhāro vadecchreṣṭhinnakṣayaṃ bhavatāttava ।
sūtradhārāya śilpibhyau dadyāt pūjopadādikam ।। 1 05।।
mahotsavaṃ bhojanādyaiḥ kuryāt kathādibhistathā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike karma te mayoktaṃ harermatam ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave brahmavedadevadevīprabhṛtimūrtimānopamaṇḍapa kuṇḍasaṃkṣiptapratiṣṭhādipradarśananāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikaśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 142 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 142 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 143
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 144 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
devāyatanakāyā''ha vāstuṃ taṃ te vadāmi ca ।। 1 ।।
kūrmaśilāsthāpanaṃ ca dvāraśākhādiropaṇam ।
padmaśilāsthāpanaṃ ca dhvajāpuruṣaveśanam ।। 2 ।।
ghaṇṭāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ cāpi dhvajasya sthāpanaṃ ṭathā ।
devapratiṣṭhānamiti puṇyāhasaptakaṃ matam ।। 3 ।।
vāstupūjā hi kartavyā tatra tatra punaḥ punaḥ ।
śāntikarmāṇi tānyeva caturdaśa vadāmi te ।। 4 ।।
bhūmikhāte kūrmadāne śilādāne ca sūtrake ।
dvāradāne khuradāne kuṃbhīdāne ca pāṭake ।। 5 ।।
pādmaśaile śukanāse dhvajapuṃsi ca ghaṇṭake ।
kalaśe dhvajadāne ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ matāni vai ।। 6 ।।
ekadā tu parabrahma svaṃ rūpaṃ dṛśyamācarat ।
tasmāttejo'nantakoṭisūryābhaṃ samajāyata ।। 7 ।।
tatra yogīśvaro devaḥ saṃhāradharmavāँstadā ।
samabhavat tallalāṭāt svedabindurabhūttadā ।। 8 ।।
mūrtapūruṣarūpaṃ tad yadā cā'bhūd bhayaṃkaram ।
tadā devairbrahmabhāvairnyastaṃ bhūmāvadhomukham ।। 9 ।।
tasya vāstoḥ pūruṣasya nairṛtāyāṃ tadā'bhavan ।
pādau jaṃghe ca jānū ca tatheśānyāṃ śiro'bhavat ।। 2.143.10 ।।
dakṣakaphoṇikā cāgnau vāmā vāyau tadā'bhavat ।
asya dehe pañcacatvāriṃśaddevāstadā'bhavan ।। 11 ।।
sarvadevayutaḥ pūjāṃ prāptaḥ sa sukhado bhavet ।
catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgo'pi caturasro'pi pūjyate ।। 12।।
ekāśītivibhāgo'pi caturasraḥ sa pūjyate ।
śatabhāgayutaścāpi caturasraḥ sa pūjyate ।। 13 ।।
aṣṭāvaṣṭau surāścāsya pratikāṣṭhaṃ vasanti ca ।
gajādekāttu pañcāśadgajātmako vidhīyate ।। 14।।
dvātriṃśanmaṇḍalānyeva kṛtvā'bhitaḥ prapūjayet ।
maṇibhiḥ svarṇarūpyābhyāṃ vidrumaiśca phalairapi ।। 15।।
catuṣṣaṣṭipadaṃ śatapadaṃ vāstuṃ ca vā likhet ।
piṣṭena vā'kṣataiścāpi kṛtvā ca balimarpayet ।। 16 ।।
catuṣṣaṣṭipadaṃ vāstuṃ darśayāmi nibodha me ।
caturastrīkṛte kṣetre hyaṣṭabhāgavibhājite ।। 17।।
madhye brahmā caturbhāge tatpūrve cā'ryamā tathā ।
dakṣe vaivasvato maitragaṇaśca paścime tathā ।। 18।।
pṛthvīdharaścottare ca tatheśānyāṃ dvidhākṛte ।
āpaśca āpavatsaśca tathāgnau ca dvidhā kṛte ।। 1 9।।
sāvitraśca savitā ca tathā dvedhā tu nairṛte ।
indro jayaśca ca tathā vāyāvapi dvidhā kṛte ।।2.143.20 ।।
rudraśca rājayakṣmā ca sthāpanīyāstataḥ param ।
abhitaḥ sarvabhāgeṣu pradakṣiṇakramācchṛṇu ।।21 ।।
iśānyāmīśaditī dve parjanyo dakṣakarṇake ।
skandhe jayastathā cendraḥ sūryaḥ satyo bhṛśastataḥ ।।22।।
ākāśāgnī dvāvagnau ca pūṣā vitatha ityataḥ ।
gṛhakṣato yamaścāpi gandharvaśca bhṛṃgastataḥ ।। 23।।
mṛgapitarāvaike ca nairṛte nandikastataḥ ।
sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto'pi varuṇaścāsurastathā ।।24।।
śeṣaśceti tato vāyau pāparogau vyavasthitau ।
tato nāgaśca mukhyaśca bhallāṭaśca kuberakaḥ ।।25।।
śailaścā'ditirityevaṃ vāmaskandhe sthitā'ntimā ।
ta ete pūjanīyā vai catuṣṣaṣṭivibhāgake ।।26।।
ekāśītivibhāge tu koṇe dvau dvau surau tu na ।
ekaika eva devaḥ syāt tadyathā pravadāmi te ।।27।।
īśaḥ parjanyakaścāpi jayaścendraśca sūryakaḥ ।
satyo bhṛśastathā''kāśo'gniḥ pūṣā vitathastathā ।। 28।।
gṛhakṣato yamaścāpi gandharvaśca bhaṃgo mṛgaḥ ।
pitṛ nandī sugrīvakaḥ pūṣyaśca varuṇo'suraḥ ।।29।।
śeṣaḥ pāpaśca rogaśca nāgo mukhyo bhallāṭakaḥ ।
kuberaśca tathā śailo'ditirditistatheti ca ।। 2.143.3 0।।
carakī bahirīśāne'gnau vahistu vidārikā ।
pūtanā bahinairṛtye vāyau pāpā bahirmatā ।।3 1।।
caturasraukṛte kṣetre navabhāgavibhājite ।
madhye navapado brahmā ṣaṭpadāścāryamādayaḥ ।।32।।
koṇe tu padamadhyasthā dvipadāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।
abhitaḥ padikā jñeyā ekāśītipade surāḥ ।। 33।।
atha vāstuṃ śatapadaṃ vacmi nibodha rādhike ।
caturasrīkṛte kṣetre daśabhāgavibhājite ।।34।।
koṇāḥ sarve bahiṣṭhāstu riktā devāstu dakṣagāḥ ।
madhye brahmā ṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ ṣaḍaṃśāścaryamādayaḥ ।।35।।
āpādyāśca dvidvabhāgāḥ sthāpyāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā śubhāḥ ।
īśo mūrghni ca parjanyo dakṣakarṇe sthitaḥ sadā ।।36 ।।
jayaḥ skandhe indrasūryasatyabhṛśā'mbarā bhuje ।
sāvitraḥ savitā haste'gnyādipitrantakāḥ pade ।।37।।
nandyādirogakāntāśca vāme pade bhavanti ca ।
vāme sakthini maitraśca vivasvān dakṣasakthini ।।38।।
guhye cendro gudābhāge jayantaśceti kīrtitau ।
rudraśca rājayakṣmā dvau vāmahaste matau tathā ।।39।।
nāgo mukhyaśca bhallāṭaḥ kuberaḥ śailako'ditiḥ ।
ta ete vāmabhujagā ditiḥ karṇe tu vāmake ।।2.143.40 ।।
āpaḥ kaṇṭhe āpavatso hṛdi pārśve'ryamā mataḥ ।
dakṣe'tha vāmake pārśve pṛthvīdharo matastathā ।।41 ।।
īśāne carakī bāhye cipicchā pūrvato matā ।
vidārikā'gnikoṇe ca dikpālā dakṣiṇe tathā ।।42।।
nairṛtye pūtanā proktā paścime skandha eva ca ।
vāyau pāpā rākṣasī cottare tathā kuberakaḥ ।।43 ।।
evaṃ pūjyā vāstudehe devatāḥ śubhadā matāḥ ।
prāsādasyottare veśāne vā vedīṃ dvihastakām ।।44।।
kṛtvā tatra ca kauśeyaṃ śvetavastraṃ samāstaret ।
tatrā'kṣatasvastikaṃ ca kṛtvā pītāmbaraṃ tataḥ ।।45।।
āstīryā'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tatraivā'kṣatajaṃ caret ।
pītopari tato raktaṃ vastramāstīrya tatra ca ।।46।।
vāsturekhāḥ svarṇaśalākayā vā yavapiṣṭajāḥ ।
kṛtvā brahmasthale madhye vārikalaśamānyaset ।।47।।
gaṃge yamune viraje godāvari sarasvati ।
narmade sindho kāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ vaha ।।48।।
viṣṇuścāgre śivo madhye tale brahmā virājate ।
mātaraḥ paritaḥ kukṣau samudrāstīrthakoṭayaḥ ।।49।।
sarve vedāḥ patrarūpā ratnarūpā vasundharā ।
phalāni śrīphale sīdeta sthāpayāmi sthiro bhava ।।2.143.50 ।।
'oṃ śrīsiddhyai namaḥ oṃ śrībrahmaṇe'pi namo namaḥ ।
oṃ śrībrahmāsane ramye tiṣṭha śrīgurave namaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
oṃ namaste vāsudeva viśvakarmannamo'stu te ।
śuddhānyarcanadravyāṇi jalena prokṣitāni vai ।।52।।
sarvaṃ śuddhaṃ jāyate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛteḥ ।
oṃ klīṃ siddhyai namaścātrā''gaccha sthāne sthirā bhava ।।5 3 ।।
omaryamṇe namaścātrā''gaccha sthāne sthiro bhava ।
vivasvate nama omāgaccha cātra sthiro bhava ।।54।।
oṃ mitrāya nama oṃ pṛthvīdharāya sthiro bhava ।
om ṛddhyai nama āgaccha sthāne'tra tvaṃ sthirā bhava ।।55 ।।
nama āpā''pavatsāmyāmāgachataṃ sthirau tathā ।
sāvitrīsavitṛbhyāmoṃ nama āgacchataṃ sthirau ।।56 ।।
indrajayābhyāṃ nama omāgacchataṃ sthirau tathā ।
nama oṃ rudrayakṣmabhyāmāgacchataṃ sthirau tathā ।।57।।
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ īśāya nama āgacchātra sthiro bhava ।
parjanyāya jayāyā'pīndrāya sūryāya oṃ namaḥ ।।58।।
satyāya ca namo bhṛśāthā''kāśāya ca auṃ namaḥ ।
āgacchā'smin samāgaccha naije sthāne sthiro bhava ।।59।।
oṃ klīṃ agnaye nama āgaccha sthāne sthiro bhava ।
pūṣṇe virocanāya auṃ gṛhakṣatāya oṃ namaḥ ।।2.143.6 0 ।।
oṃ yamāya namo gandharvāya bhṛṃgāya oṃ namaḥ ।
oṃ mṛgāya nama āgacchā'smin sthāne sthiro bhava ।।61।।
oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ pitṛbhyo nama āgacchata sthirāstathā ।
dauvārikāya ca sugrīvāya namaḥ sthiro bhava ।।62।।
puṣpadantāya ca varuṇāya namaḥ sthiro bhava ।
om asurāya śeṣāya pāpāya ca sthiro bhava ।।63 ।।
oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ rogāya nama āgacchātra sthiro bhava ।
oṃ nāgāya ca mukhyāya bhallāṭāya sthiro bhava ।।64।।
namaḥ somāya śailāyā'dityai dityai namaḥ sthirā ।
oṃ cipicchāyai nama āgacchātra tvaṃ sthirā bhava ।।655।।
oṃ vidāryai ca jaṃbhāyai pūtanāyai ca oṃ namaḥ ।
skandāyai pāparākṣasyai yamāya oṃ namo'tra ca ।।66।।
oṃ carakyai nama āgacchātra sthāne sthirā bhava ।
oṃ śrīmanmahāgaṇādhipataye te namo namaḥ ।।27।।।
iṣṭadevebhyaśca kuladevatābhyo namo namaḥ ।
sthānavāstudevatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namo namaḥ ।।68।।
etatkarmapradhānāḍhyadevatābhyo namo namaḥ ।
kalpe'tra vatsare māse dine madiṣṭasiddhaye ।।69।।
devāḍhyavāstudevasya kariṣye pūjanaṃ namaḥ ।
paṃcāmṛtairjalairdevaṃ saṃsnāpya brahmasūtrakam ।।2.143.70।।
vastraṃ bhūṣā puṣpamālāṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ।
aṣṭabhyaśca baliṃ cācamanaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।।71।।
nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavannamanādikam ।
tata oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kuru kuru svāheti japenmanum ।।72।।
nama oṃ vāstudevāya caikaviṃśatikaṃ japet ।
auṃ pūrve hetakabhairavāya namo'tha dakṣiṇe ।।73 ।।
ādivaitālabhairavāya namo'tha ca paścime ।
kālabhairavāya nama uttare'tha namo'stu ca ।।74।।
ekapādabhairavāya nama om ūrdhvake'tha ca ।
svacchandabhairavāyā'stu nama āgneyako'tha ca ।।75।।
tripurāntakabhairavāya namo'tha nirṛtyake ।
agnijihvakabhairavāya namo'tha ca vāyuke ।।76।।
vāyudevāya namo'theśāne īśānakāya ca ।
namo'tha oṃ ca pātāle viṣṇave ca namo namaḥ ।।77।।
arghyaṃ datvā kṣamāṃ prārthayitvā vāstuṃ namet tataḥ ।
dikpālān kṣetrapālāँśca gaṇeśaṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā ।।78।।
samarcayet tataḥ pratiṣṭhādi sarvaṃ samācaret ।
oṃ āṃ īṃ klīṃ mahendrāya namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।79।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇendrāya svāhā ।
oṃ hrīṃ hroṃ hrāँ vahnaye ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।2.143.80।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇā'gnaye svāhā ।
oṃ krauṃ krauṃ krū kālamūrtaye namo'tra sthiro bhava ।।8 1 ।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
oṃ aiṃ kṣoṃ kṣīṃ mṛtyave ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।82।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
o śrāṃ śrīṃ śrūṃ vaṃ viṃ varuṇāya namaḥ sthiro bhava ।।83।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
auṃ aiṃ viśvādhināthāya namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।84।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kuberāya ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।85।।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
oṃ klīṃ klīṃ klūṃ viśvaṃbharāya ca namaḥ sthiro bhava ।।86।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
oṃ vrāṃ vrīṃ vrūṃ brahmaṇe ca namaḥ sthāne sthiro bhava ।।87।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
oṃ śrāṃ śrīṃ śrīpataye namo'tra sthāne sthiro bhava ।।88।।
kṣetrapālaiḥ saha baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa namaḥ svāhā ।
evaṃ prapūjayet paścāt pratiṣṭhākāryamāvahet ।।89।।
māghe ca phālgune dhanāyuṣyārogyapradā hi sā ।
jyeṣṭhe vaiśākhake cāpi pratiṣṭhā dravyaputrahā ।।2.143.90 ।।
dakṣiṇāyanage sūrye vārāhaṃ mātṛkāstathā ।
bhairavaṃ vāmanaṃ devīṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayettathā ।।9 1 ।।
śrāvaṇe śāṃkaraṃ liṃgamāśvine jagadambikām ।
mārgaśīrṣe hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pauṣe tu sarvakān ।।92।।
śanau ravau śaśāṃke ca budhe gurau ca śukrake ।
dvārocchrāyo'ṣṭadhā kāryaścāṣṭamaṃ parihāya ca ।। 93।।
saptabhāgātmaśākhāyā bhāgatrayaṃ punaścaret ।
bhāgadvayaṃ pratimā syāt lambeti sarvanirṇayaḥ ।।94।।
dvāraṃ vibhajya navadhā bhāgaikaṃ ca parityajet।
aṣṭabhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā dvibhāgā pratimā matā ।।95।।
gajāccaturgajāntaṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulā gaje gaje ।
tato daśagajāntaṃ tu gaje tryaṃgulavardhanam ।।96।।
pañcāśadgajaparyantamekāṃgulapravardhanam ।
atra viṃśatyaṃśā''dhikyai śreṣṭhā prāsādamānataḥ ।। 97।।
prāsādārthapramāṇena kolī jyeṣṭhā'pi kathyate ।
ityevaṃ devatāyana! bhavānāste tathāvidhaḥ ।।98।।
mandiraṃ mama rūpaṃ vai śṛṇu te rūpamarthavat ।
prāsādo devarūpo'sti pādau pādaśilāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 99।।
jaṃghā tu jagatī bodhyā staṃbhā vai jānavaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
sakthi kammānikā bodhyā meḍhraṃ kuṃbhādadhastalam ।। 2.143.10 0।।
praṇālaṃ tu gudābhāgo ghūmmaṭaścodaraṃ matam ।
devasthānaṃ nābhitulyaṃ pīṭhikā hṛdayaṃ matam ।। 101 ।।
pratimā jīva evā'sau śikharaṃ vakṣa eva ca ।
amalasāraḥ kaṇṭhaśca śukanāsastu nāsikā ।। 10 2।।
dīpaścakṣuḥ gavākṣaḥ karṇaḥ skandhaḥ kāyapālikā ।
kalaśo mastakaṃ dhvajā keśā bhūtāni dhātavaḥ ।। 103 ।।
pralepo māṃsamevā'tra medaśca vasudhādravāḥ ।
asthīni ca śilāḥ sarvā vastraṃ cūrṇapaṭātmakam ।। 1 04।।
evaṃ viddhi svakaṃ dehaṃ devāyatana! bhaktarāṭa ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāda tam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave vāstupuruṣataddevādisthāpanāprabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 143 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cā'gre pratiṣṭhādividhānakam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadāha daivatam ।। 1 ।।
yajamānaḥ prage snātvā''cāryahaste pradāya ca ।
pūjāsaṃbhārakān strībhiḥ suvāsinībhiranvitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
prāsādo'gre maṇḍapasya bhūmimāgatya prāgdiśi ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā''sane samupaviśya ca ।। 3 ।।
ācamanaṃ tathā prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ।
baddhaśikhaḥ sapatnīko dhyāyan gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ ।। 4 ।।
prāṅmukho vodaṅmukho vā saṃkīrtya deśakālakau ।
parameśvaraprītyarthaṃ pratiṣṭhākāryasiddhaye ।। 5 ।।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kuryādācāryavaraṇādikam ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ pādapūjanaṃ tasya cācaret ।। 6 ।।
candrakā''kṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ samarcya praṇameddhi tam ।
asya devasya vai ramye prāsāde karmasiddhaye ।। 7 ।।
pratiṣṭhāsiddhaye maṇḍapādikāryādisiddhaye ।
bhavantaṃ śrīharerbhaktamācāryatvena saṃvṛṇe ।। 8 ।।
auṃ vṛto'smītyāvadeccācāryaḥ sarvārthapaṇḍitaḥ ।
yajamānaśca badhnīyādācāryakarakaṃkaṇam ।। 9 ।।
ācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmimāvāhayettataḥ ।
āgaccha sarvakalyāṇi vasudhe'tra sthirā bhava ।। 2.144.1 0।।
āyāhi varade dhātri yajñe'smin śubhadāyini ।
oṃ mahīrdyoḥ pṛthivī naḥ imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām ।। 11 ।।
pipṛtānno bharimabhiḥ sarvarasā'nvitekṣite ।
evamāvāhya pṛthivīṃ smṛtvā ca sarvadevatāḥ ।। 1 2।।
oṃ viśve devāsa iha mādayantām oṃ pratiṣṭha ।
iti kṣitiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya baddhvā'ñjaliṃ ca prārthayet ।। 1 3।।
yajñabhāgaṃ pratīcchasva praṇamāmi kṣamāṃ kuru ।
tavopari maṇḍapādi bhaviṣyati makhe hitā ।। 14।।
bhaveti tāṃ namaskṛtya prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ ।
kuśaiśca haritaiḥ kṛtvā prokṣayecca vadettathā ।। 15।।
omidaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam ।
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā tvāṃ ca havāmahe ।। 16।।
oṃ śanno mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śanno bhavatvaryamā ।
śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śanno viṣṇururukramaḥ ।। 17।।
oṃ devasya tvāṃ savituḥ prasavena tathā'śvinoḥ ।
bāhubhyāṃ ca karābhyāṃ ca pūṣṇo vācā sarojuṣaḥ ।। 18।।
agneḥ sāmrājyakenā'bhiṣiñcāmi prokṣitā'si bhūḥ ।
ityuktvā ca gṛhītvā ca śvetasarṣapakān kare ।। 1 9।।
īśānābhimukho vikiret tataḥ sarvatomukham ।
oṃ bhūtāni rākṣasā vā yatra tiṣṭhanti kecana ।।2.144.20।।
te sarve'pyapasarpantu viṣṇuyāgasya bhūmitaḥ ।
bhūtapretapiśācādyāścāpakrāmantu dūrataḥ ।।21 ।।
apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ ।
ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste'payāntu harājñayā ।।22।।
ityabhidhāya sarvatra vikīrya śvetasarṣapān ।
saṃprokṣya pañcagavyena dadyādarghyaṃ bhuve yathā ।।23।।
gandhadūrvāphalapuṣpayavānvitaṃ jalaṃ śubham ।
tāmrapātre gṛhītvaiva dhṛtaśuklāmbaradvayaḥ ।। 24।।
udaṅmukhaścārghyahasto'rghyaṃ dadyāt sukṛtāñjaliḥ ।
gṛhāṇā'rghyaṃ jaganmātaḥ prasannā bhava sarvadā ।।25।।
evaṃ sampūjya pṛthivīṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ।
bhadrapīṭhe cā''rcya vāstuṃ prācīṃ saṃsādhayed diśam ।।26।।
samānāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai gaṇeśaṃ śrīguruṃ tathā ।
yajan mānasopacārairdhyāyecca kuladevatām ।।27।।
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā toṣayitvā tu śilpinam ।
kuryādvai maṇḍapaṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśātmakam ।।28।।
daśahastaṃ cā'ṣṭahastaṃ yathāvakāśakaṃ ca vā ।
tatra kuṇḍaṃ pūrvavacca yathoktaṃ pravidhāya ca ।।29।।
tata uttaravedyāśca catuṣkoṇeṣu sarvathā ।
īśakoṇe grahapīṭhaṃ catustriṃśāṃgulātmakam ।।2.144.3 0।।
agno hastaṃ mātṛpīṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulakocchrayam ।
nairṛte vāstupīṭhaṃ ca hastaṃ dvādaśakocchrayam ।।3 1।।
vāyau ca yoginīkṣetrapālapīṭhaṃ tu hastakam ।
dvādaśāṃgulakordhvaṃ ca prakuryādvā yathocitam ।। 32।।
aṣṭahastamitāyāstu dhārāyā vai ghṛtasya ca ।
kṛte pūrvasthale ramyaśilāropaṇamityapi ।।3 3।।
iṣṭikānāṃ ca vā bhittirvidheyā śobhanā tadā ।
toraṇaiśca patākābhiścaturasraṃ tu maṇḍapam ।।34।।
prāguktarūpaṃ kṛtvaiva taduttare'pi maṇḍapam ।
snapanārthaṃ ca kṛtvaiva kuryācca vedikātrayam ।।35।।
yathāyogyān maṇḍapāँścādyadine saṃvidhāya ca ।
haviṣyabhojanaḥ syādvai yajamānaḥ supuṇyavān ।। 36।।
rātrau bhūśayano bhūtvā brahmacārī susāttvikaḥ ।
prātaścādhivāsane'hni snātvā tīrthodakaistataḥ ।।37।।
prāyaścittasya muktyarthaṃ pāpadhenuṃ samarpayet ।
adyāsmin divase devaprāsādakarmayogyatā ।।38।।
mayi syāditi lābhārthaṃ pāpānāṃ nuttaye tathā ।
pāpadhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāmīti samarpayet ।।39।।
snātvā punastīrthajalaiḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaiḥ ।
pañcagavyayutaiścāpi vāruṇamantrayojitaiḥ ।।2.144.40।।
oṃ tvaṃ vāruṇī mūrtirvaruṇotthā hi devatā ।
vāruṇaṃ sadanaṃ cā'si vahā''yurmama śobhanam ।।41 ।।
tava pāśāḥ prayāntyeva dūraṃ yajñe patantu na ।
apāśo'haṃ devatābhyo dāsye havyaṃ vidhehi tat ।।42।।
iti snātvā śuklapaṭe dhṛtvā gandhānulepanaḥ ।
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ patnīyuto'tisāttvikaḥ ।।43।।
yajamānaḥ sarvasaṃbhārān dhṛtvā śilpibhūmitaḥ ।
prādakṣiṇyena daivaṃ vai samānīya sugītibhiḥ ।।44।।
vāditraninadaiścāpi strīṇāṃ maṃgalagītibhiḥ ।
śāntipāṭhaiḥ saha caivāgatya maṇḍapasannidhau ।।45।।
praviśya paścimadvāreṇā''sane sannidhāya ca ।
devaṃ tato yajamāno dakṣiṇadvārasannidhau ।।46।।
paścime bhadrapīṭhe prāgagradarbheṣu prāṅmukhaḥ ।
udaṅmukhaḥ sapatnīkaścopāviśet tataḥ param ।।47।।
saṃbhārān yajñīyakāँśca dakṣapārśve nidhāpayet ।
kathayāmi samāsena saṃbhārān vividhān yathā ।।48।।
pratyekasamidhāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ samarjayet ।
arkamudumbaraṃ pippalakaṃ vaṭaṃ ca tūlasīm ।।49।।
apāmārgaṃ palāśaṃ cāmalakīṃ yajñabhūruhān ।
candanaṃ śiṃśapāṃ bilvaṃ pippalīṃ yajñabhūruhān ।।2.144.50।।
tilānevaṃvidhān yathāprāpyān samarjayed drumān ।
bhadrapīṭhatrayaṃ rakṣet puṣpamālāḥ phulāni ca ।।51 ।।
kuṃkumaṃ candanadravaṃ kastūrīṃ ghanasārakam ।
aguruṃ guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ dhūpapātraṃ ca darpaṇam ।।52।।
ghaṇṭāṃ ca pādukāmārārtrikaṃ balikaṇān balim ।
pāyasaṃ bhakṣyabhojye ca naivedyaṃ ca phalāni ca ।।53।।
pūgīphalāni tāmbūlaṃ cājyaṃ tilā yavā'kṣatāḥ ।
śarkarā ca phalaśreṣṭhānyapi śrīphalakāni ca ।।54।।
drākṣāśca kadalānyeva navaraṃgādikānyapi ।
catvāro viṣṭarāḥ pratikuṇḍaṃ sruksruvakau tathā ।।55।।
āsanāni kuṃkumāktatrisūtrī śobhanā tathā ।
śvetorṇāsūtrakaṃ cā'tha sarvatobhadralabdhaye ।।56।।
śvetaraktanīlapītakṛṣṇaraṃgāni yāni ca ।
tathā snapanakalaśāḥ pallavāḥ pañcajātikāḥ ।।57।।
kadalīstambhavaryāśca patākā daśasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
dhvajāsteṣāṃ veṇudaṇḍā eko madhyadhvajastathā ।।58।।
vajramauktikavaiḍūryaśaṃkhasphaṭikapuṣpakāḥ ।
indranīlamahānīlāścāṣṭaratnāni yāni ca ।।59।।
manaśśilāharitālābhrakakṛṣṇāṃjanāni ca ।
mākṣikakāsīsasvarṇamākṣikagairikāstathā ।।2.144.6 0।।
dhātvaṣṭakaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ rakṣayed yajñakarmaṇe ।
yavagodhūmanīvāramudgaśyāmākasarṣapāḥ ।।61 ।।
tilavrīhaya evaitatad bījāṣṭakaṃ ca sannyaset ।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ sīsakaṃ trapu cāyasam ।।62।।
raṃgaṃ rītirdhātvaṣṭakaṃ rakṣayed yajñakarmaṇe ।
madhuparkasya pātraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ tāmrameva vā ।।63।।
arghapātraṃ suvarṇasya śalākāṃ rakṣayet tathā ।
kanakaṃ kuliśaṃ nīlaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca mauktikam ।।64।।
tāni kalaśaratnāni sthāpayennijapārśvake ।
ṣoḍaśadvārakalaśān aṣṭau tu lokapāghaṭān ।।65।।
caturo vedikalaśān vāstughaṭaṃ prarakṣayet ।
kuṇḍasaṃkhyakakalaśān nidrāyāḥ kalaśaṃ tathā ।।66 ।।
snapanaikāśītighaṭān śarāvāँścāpi tāvataḥ ।
dhārāsahasrakalaśau rājasthānasya mṛttikām ।।67।।
aśvasthānamṛdaṃ cāpi valmīkamṛttikāṃ tathā ।
saṃgamamṛttikāṃ kūladvayamṛdaṃ varāhajām ।।68।।
mṛdaṃ rājadvāramṛdaṃ rakṣayedaṣṭamṛttikāḥ ।
murāmāṃsīvacākuṣṭhaśaileyaharidrāstathā ।।69।।
dāruharidrāśuṇṭhīcampakamustāḥ sarvauṣadhīḥ ।
rakṣayeccāpi pañcagavyakaṃ pṛthak pṛthak tathā ।।2.144.70।।
vrīhiyavatilagodhūmaśyāmākanivārakān ।
mudgāniti ca saptāpi dhānyāni rakṣayettathā ।।71 ।।
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ śvetacchatraṃ ca cāmaradvayam ।
vicitraṃ tu vitānaṃ ca trīn vai dukūlapaṭṭakān ।।72।।
ṛtvigvaraṇasāmagrīrudvartanārthadravyakam ।
goghṛtaṃ ca gośṛṃgodakaṃ tīrthodakaṃ ca kambukam ।।73।।।
śilpideyāni vastrāṇi sugandhitailamityapi ।
netrāñjanārthakaṃ pātraṃ sindūraṃ rakṣayet tathā ।।74।।
āmrasatpatramālāśca devamūrtīśca kānakīḥ ।
nārikelaphalādīni rakṣayed yajñamaṇḍape ।।75।।
etān sarvān susaṃbhārān nije tu dakṣiṇe sthale ।
sthāpayitvā''camanaṃ ca prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca ।।76 ।।
gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ darbhādikaṃ tathā ।
om prapunātu padmākṣo nārāyaṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।।77।।
ityuktvā sarvasaṃbhārān prokṣya cātmānamityapi ।
gaṇeśādīn surān smṛtvā kuryāt saṃkalpamityamum ।।78।।
brahmāṇḍe'tra sthale viprasannidhau vatsare'muke ।
māsapakṣatithau vāre sarvapāpakṣayāya vai ।।79।।
uddhartuṃ pūrvajāँścā'haṃ sampadāyuṣyalabdhaye ।
bhuktimuktisulābhārthaṃ mūrtau devā''gamāya ca ।।2.144.80 ।।
yathāśakti pratiṣṭhāṃ śrīharervā'nyasurasya ca ।
saṃkariṣye tadaṃgākhyaṃ śrīgaṇeśādipūjanam ।।8 1 ।।
svastipuṇyāhavācaśca mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathā''cāryavaraṇaṃ viprapūjanam ।।82।।
kariṣye iti saṃkalpya jalaṃ bhūmau samutsṛjet ।
sumukhaścaikadantaśca kapilo gajakarṇakaḥ ।।83 ।।
lambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnanāśo vināyakaḥ ।
dhūmraketurgaṇādhyakṣo bhālacandro gajānanaḥ ।।84।।
dvādaśaitāni nāmāni mama rūpasya vai paṭhet ।
saśuṇḍhaṃ ca triśūlāḍhyaṃ patnīputrayutaṃ gaṇam ।।85।।
prasannaṃ sāyudhaṃ dhyāyed vighnānāṃ vāraṇāya ca ।
evaṃ dhyātvā gaṇeśaṃ ca pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ ।।86।।
he heramba tvamehyehi lakṣalābhayutastviha ।
siddhibuddhipate tvehi sarvāyudhasamanvitaḥ ।।87।।
āvāhayāmi pūjārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ ca makhasya me ।
āgaccha ca bhava svārṇāsane sthiraḥ prarakṣa naḥ ।।88।।
gaṇānāṃ ca patiṃ priyapatiṃ nidhipatiṃ tathā ।
havāmahe vasā'traiva śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śāṃkaro'si ca ।।89।।
āhamajāni garbhadhamātvamajāsigarbhadham ।
siddhibuddhiyutaṃ cāvāhayāmi gaṇanāyakam ।।2.144.90।।
sampratiṣṭhāpayāmyā''sye sauvarṇe gṛhṇa cāsanam ।
pādyaṃ jalaṃ gṛhāṇā'pi sugandhi nirmalaṃ śubham ।।9 1 ।।
tāmrapātragataṃ toyamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa siddhikṛt ।
ācamanaṃ tīrthajalaṃ gṛhāṇa gaṇanāyaka ।। 92।।
payaḥsnānaṃ gṛhāṇaitad dadhisnānaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।
ghṛtasnānaṃ gṛhāṇā'pi madhusnānaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।।93।।
gṛhāṇa śarkarāsnānaṃ gṛhāṇodvartanaṃ tathā ।
tīrthajalaiḥ śuddhavārisnānaṃ kuru gaṇeśvara ।।94।।
vāsāṃsi dhāraya yajñopavītaṃ svīkuru prabho ।
candanaṃ cākṣatān ramyapuṣpāṇi pratigṛhyatām ।।95।।
durvāṃkurāṇi ramyāṇi dhūpaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām ।
dīpaṃ ghṛtāktamevā'pi naivedyaṃ laḍḍukādikam ।।96।।
phalānyācamaṃ cāpi jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।
dakṣiṇā gṛhyatāṃ devā''rārtrikaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।।97।।
puṣpāṃjalirgṛhyatāṃ ca pradakṣiṇāṃ karomi te ।
viśeṣārghyaṃ phalayuktaṃ prāpyātra varado bhava ।।98।।
namaste gajaśuṇḍhāya kṛṣṇarūpāya te namaḥ ।
nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryaṃ makhādikam ।। 99।।
anayā pūjayā sāṃgaḥ prīyatāṃ me gaṇādhipaḥ ।
iti sampūjya ca tataścaret puṇyāhavācanam ।। 2.144.100 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
devāyatanakaṃ bhaktaṃ cāha te kathitaṃ tu tat ।। 101 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya pūjanasya phalaṃ labhet ।
nirvighnaṃ jāyate śroturvaktuḥ kāryaṃ phalānvitam ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mūrtipratiṣṭhotsave ācāryavaraṇayajñasāmagrīsamarjanagaṇeśapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 144 ।।
