adhyāyaḥ 145
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 146 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athāpi rādhike cāgre kalaśasthāpanādikam ।
kathayāmi yadāha śrīharirdevāyataṃ munim ।। 1 ।।
kalaśaṃ jalasampannaṃ phalaratnādirājitam ।
nijayoḥ karayordhṛtvā śiraso'gre tato bhuvi ।। 2 ।।
vakreṇa jānunā cārdhaṃ niṣadya dakṣiṇena tu ।
kareṇa dhārayitvā saṃsthāpayed vidhinā sthale ।। 3 ।।
tato vipraiśca puṇyāhaṃ vācayed yajamānakaḥ ।
yajamānavacaḥprativaco dadhuśca bhūsurāḥ ।। 4 ।।
me puṇyāhaṃ dī'rghamāyurastu te brūma eva tat ।
śivā āpaḥ santu ceti saumanasyaṃ tathā'stu ca ।। 5 ।।
akṣatā'riṣṭamastveva saumāṃgalyaṃ tathā'stu ca ।
pāntu gandhāstathā pāntu cākṣatā āyurastu ca ।। 6 ।।
pāntu puṣpāṇi cāstveva sauśriyaṃ siddhirastu ca ।
pāntu tāmbūlāni cāstvaiśvaryaṃ pāntu ca dakṣiṇāḥ ।। 7 ।।
astu dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ śrīrastu cāstu sadyaśaḥ ।
vidyāvinayavittādi cāstu cāyuṣyamityapi ।। 8 ।।
bahuputrādimattvaṃ ca dīrghamāyuḥ samastu te!
śāntiḥ puṣṭiścāstu tuṣṭiryajamānasya sarvadā ।। 9 ।।
ityuccāryā'bhisiñceyuryajamānasya mūrdhani ।
bhadraṃ karṇe śṛṇuyāma bhadraṃ paśyema cakṣuṣā ।। 2.145.1 0।।
stutiyogyaṃ tanu prāpnuyāma devahitaṃ sadā ।
devā bhadraṃ bhāvayantu cārātiśca nivartatām ।। 11 ।।
devasakhyaṃ sadā cā'stu tathā''yuḥ kālavarjitam ।
draviṇaṃ puṣkalaṃ cāstu savitā'vatu sarvataḥ ।। 12।।
candraścāyuścāmṛtaṃ ca dadātvasmai sudaivatam ।
hiraṇyadā vasavo'sya yajamānasya santu vai ।। 13।।
ityāśīrvādapātraṃ tvaṃ yajamāno vivardhatām ।
samāhitā'ntaḥ karaṇāḥ prasannāḥ smo'stu śāntikā ।। 14।।
puṣṭistuṣṭirvṛddhirastu cā'vighnāyuṣyamastu ca ।
ārogyaṃ śivakarmā'stu samṛddhirastu karmaṇām ।। 15।।
vedaśāstrasaṃhitānāṃ jñānasmṛddhiḥ sadā'stu te ।
dhanadhānyaputrapautrasmṛddhirastviṣṭasampadām ।। 15।।
ariṣṭanāśanaṃ cāstu dūre'stu rogapāpakam ।
akalyāṇaṃ hataṃ te'stu śreyo'stu sarvabhāvitam ।। 17।।
uttare karmaṇi nirvighnatvaṃ cāstu sadā tava ।
śubhāśca saphalāḥ santu kriyāste cottarodbhavāḥ ।। 18।।
tithyādayaḥ śubhāḥ santu jalasekena te sadā ।
tithyādyadhisurāḥ sarve prīyantāṃ jalasekataḥ ।। 1 9।।
prīyetāṃ tithikaraṇe durgāpāñcālike tathā ।
prīyantāṃ viśvadevāśca prīyantāṃ ca marudgaṇāḥ ।।2.145.20 ।।
umāmātaraḥ prīyantāṃ prīyantāmekapatnikāḥ ।
prīyantāṃ sarvadevāśca prīyantāṃ vedamūrtayaḥ ।। 21 ।।
prīyantāṃ brāhmaṇā brahma prīyetāṃ śāradāśriyau ।
śraddhāmedhe suprīyetāṃ kātyāyanī ca prīyatām ।।22।।
māheśvarī prīyatāṃ ca ṛddhikarī ca prīyatām ।
siddhikarī prīyatāṃ ca puṣṭikarī ca prīyatām ।।23।।
tuṣṭikarī prīyatāṃ ca prīyantāṃ kuladevatāḥ ।
prīyetāṃ bhagavantau ca tathā vighnavināyakau ।।24।।
prīyantāṃ grāmadevāśca hatāste paripanthinaḥ ।
brahmadviṣo hatāścāpi vighnadāśca hatāstathā ।। 25।।
śatravaśca hatāḥ sarve śāmyantu ghoramūrtayaḥ ।
śāmyantu pāpapuñjāśca śāmyantu tava cetayaḥ ।।26।।
vardhantāṃ śubhakāryāṇi santu cāpaḥ śivāstu te ।
śivā āhutayaḥ santu syātāṃ śive niśādine ।।27।।
kāmaṃ varṣatu parjanyo hyoṣadhayaḥ phalānvitāḥ ।
yogakṣemau bhavetāṃ te prīyantāṃ gṛhadevatāḥ ।। 28।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca prīyatāṃ tathā ।
parjanyaḥ prīyatāṃ svāmī prīyatāṃ kārtikastathā ।।29।।
brāhmaḥ kālaśca puṇyāhaḥ sadā te'stu śubhakriyaḥ ।
astu devapratiṣṭhākarmaṇaḥ puṇyāhameva te ।।2.145.3 0।।
punantu māṃ devadevāḥ punantu mānasaṃ dhiyam ।
punantu viśvābhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mām ।।3 1 ।।
pṛthivyāmuddhṛtāyāṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ tu bruvantu me ।
oṃ kalyāṇaṃ maharddhiṃ ca bruvantu brāhmaṇā mama ।। 32।।
satrarddhi mama ca jyotiramṛtaṃ svaḥ bruvantu me ।
svastiṃ vṛddhiṃ bruvantveva santu brūmaśca bhūsurāḥ ।।33।।
svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ ।
svasti nastārkṣyo'riṣṭanemiḥ svanti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ।।34।।
haripriyā svastimatī svastiṃ karotu sarvadā ।
omastu śrīśca te lakṣmīḥ patnyau nārāyaṇasya vai ।।35।।
evaṃ puṇyāhavācaśca santu pūrṇā bhūsūriṇām ।
tataścā'bhiṣekakarma pātre tu kalaśodakam ।।36।।
dhṛtvā viprāśca catvāro dūrvā''mrapallavādibhiḥ ।
yajamānamabhiṣiñceyuśca tvāṃ prapunantviti ।।37।।
punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu tīrthasāgarāḥ ।
pañcanadyo jātavedo punantyete yajisthitam ।।38।।
sāmrājyenā'bhiṣiñcāmi vācāṃ tvāṃ tu yajisthitam ।
bhaiṣajyenā'bhiṣiñcāmi tejasā brahmavarcasā ।।39।।
aindriyeṇābhiṣiñcāmīndrasya tvāṃ tu yajisthitam ।
viśvāni devasavitardurītāni parāsuva ।।।2.145.40।।
makhasatre tu sarveṣāṃ yad bhadraṃ tanna āsuva ।
oṃ dyauḥ śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntiścādhyātmikī tava ।।41 ।।
anena vācanenā'tra prīyatāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ ।
evaṃ vai rādhike puṇyāhavāguttarame ca ।।42।।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ kuryāttvagnikoṇe supīṭhake ।
akṣatānāṃ prapuñjeṣu yadvā pūgīphaleṣu ca ।।43।।
gaurī padmā śacī medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā ।
devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ ।।44।।
hṛṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā tuṣṭirātmanaḥ kuladevatā ।
gaṇeśaśceti sampūjyā vṛddhāvetā hi ṣoḍaśa ।।45।।
rādhā lakṣmīrmāṇikī ca brahmavidyāramāratiḥ ।
suguṇā maṃjulā haṃsā lalitā kambharā satī ।।46।।
santoṣā kamalā durgā śāradārcyāśca ṣoḍaśa ।
gaṇeśāya nama omāvāhayāmi gaṇādhipam ।।47।।
oṃ gauryai ca namo gaurīmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ padmāyai namaḥ padmāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।।48।।
oṃ śacyai ca namaḥ śacīmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ medhāyai namo medhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।।49।।
oṃ sāvitryai namaḥ sāvitrikāmāvāhayāmi ca ।
vijayāyai namaścāvāhayāmi vijayāṃ namaḥ ।।2.145.50।।
oṃ jayāyai namo jayāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
namaḥ śrīdevasenāyai senāmāvāhayāmi ca ।।91 ।।
oṃ svadhāyai namaḥ svadhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ svāhāyai namaḥ svāhāmāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।।52।।
oṃ mātṛbhyo namo mātṝrāvāhayāmi vai namaḥ ।
namo vai lokamātṛbhyo nama āvāhayāmi tāḥ ।।53 ।।
hṛṣṭyai namaścāvāhayāmyo puṣṭyai ca namastathā ।
āvāhayāmi tāṃ tuṣṭyai nama āvāhayāmi ca ।।54।।
namaḥ śrīkuladevyai cāvāhayāmi namo'stu te ।
oṃ rādhāyai namaścāvāhayāmi pratinaumi tām ।।55।।
oṃ śrīlakṣmyai nama āvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām ।
oṃ māṇikyai nama āvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām ।।66।।
oṃ brahmavidyāyai namaścāvāhayāmi praṇamāmi tām ।
ramāratyai namaścāvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।।57।।
oṃ śriyaṃ cāvāhayāmi śrīdevyai namo namaḥ ।
oṃ suguṇāṃ nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।।58।।
mañjulāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।
haṃsāyai ca nama āvāhayāmyasyā namo'stu ca ।।।99।।
lalitāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।
kaṃbharāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyā namo'stu ca ।।2.145.60 ।।
oṃ satyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai ca namo namaḥ ।
santoṣāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
kamalāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।
oṃ durgāyai nama āvāhayāmyasyai namo namaḥ ।।62।।
śāradāyai namaścāvāhayāmyasyai namo'stu ca ।
ityāvāhya pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।।63।।
prīyantāṃ pūjayā devā devyastuṣyantu mātaraḥ ।
kuṇḍasthamātṛkāmūrdhni ghṛtadhārāṃ dadāmi ca ।।64।।
brāhmī māheśvarī cāpi kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā ।
vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā ghṛtadhārayā ।।65।।
sahadhārayā tuṣṭā bhavantu varadāstathā ।
pādyādibhiḥ pūjayecca dhārā divyā balapradāḥ ।।66 ।।
tathā'nyāḥ ṣoḍaśadevīḥ pūjayed ghṛtadhārayā ।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakuryācca krameṇā''camanādinā ।।67।।
prāṇānāyamya ca kālaṃ deśaṃ saṃkalpya vai tataḥ ।
asya devasya ca pratiṣṭhānakarmasu vastubhiḥ ।।68 ।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ kariṣye'haṃ vighnādivinivṛttaye ।
nāndīmukhāḥ satyavasusaṃjñakā viśvadevatāḥ ।।69।।
oṃ bhūrmuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścā'stu mātā pitāmahī ।।2.145.70।।
prapitāmahikā caitā nāndīmukhyo bhavanti yāḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam ।।71 ।।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścā'stu pitā pitāmahaḥ ।
prapitāmaha evaite nāndīmukhā bhavanti ye ।।72।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścā'stu sarvā tataḥ param ।।73 ।।
mātāmahaḥ pramātāmaho vṛddhapramātāmahaḥ ।
sapatnīkā nāndīmukhā ye ca ye ca bhavanti te ।।74।।
oṃ bhūrbhuva sva idaṃ vaḥ pādyaṃ pādāvanejanam ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ vṛddhiścāstu dadāmi cāsanam ।।75।।
satyavasusaṃjñakebhyo viśvedevebhya ityapi ।
nāndīmukhebhya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva idaṃ sukhāsanam ।।76।।
svadhā vo'stu nāndīśrāddhekṣaṇau kriyetāmoṃ tathā ।
svīkurutāṃ bhavantau ca prāpnuvaśca sukhānvitau ।।77।।
mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahīnāṃ sukhāsanam ।
āsādayatāṃ vaḥ svāhā''sādayāvaḥ sukhāvaham ।।78।।
pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ sukhāsanam ।
āsādayatāṃ vaḥ svāhā''sādayāmaḥ sukhāvaham ।।79।।
mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ।
va āsanaṃ svadhā vo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sukhāvaham ।।2.145.80।।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dīyate ca satyavasubhya eva ca ।
viśvebhyo nāndīmukhyebhya idaṃ gandhādikārcanam ।।81 ।।
sampadyantāmiha vṛddhiḥ svadhā bhavanta eva ca ।
mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhya eva ca ।।82।।
idaṃ gandhādyarcanaṃ ca svāhā vṛddhiḥ samastu ca ।
pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhya eva ca ।।83।।
idaṃ gandhādyarcanaṃ ca svadhā vṛddhiḥ samastu ca ।
mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ।।84।।
sastrībhyo va idaṃ gandhārcanaṃ svadhā'stu vṛddhikā ।
ityevamarcanaṃ datvā bhojanasya tu niṣkrayaḥ ।।85।।
dravyaṃ dadyāt satyavasu viśvedevebhya eva ca ।
yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam ।।86।।
svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirāyustejaḥpradā śubhā ।
mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhya eva ca ।।87।।
yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam ।
svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhiḥ hiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam ।।88।।
pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhyo'pi caiva ha ।
yugmabhojanaparyāptamannamamṛtamarpitam ।।89।।
svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirhiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam ।
mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ।।2.145.90।।
sastrībhyo va idaṃ bhojyaṃ paryāptā'mṛtamarpitam ।
svadhā sampadyatāṃ vṛddhirhiraṇyadakṣiṇāyutam ।।91।
dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ drākṣā''malakayavaniṣkrayām ।
nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrvyai sasyavasubhya eva ca ।।92।।।
mātṛpitāmahīprapitāmahībhyo'pi caiva ha ।
nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrttyai dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।।93।।
pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhyo'pi caiva ha ।
nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrttyai dadāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।।94।।
mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāḥ ।
sastrībhyo vo dadāmyatra dakṣiṇāṃ niṣkrayātmikām ।।95।।
nāndīśrāddhaphalapūrtyai drākṣā''malakamārdrakam ।
phalapratiṣṭhāsiddhyarthaṃ gṛhṇantu cotsṛjāmi ca ।।96।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ susampannaṃ paṭhitvā''rpyaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।
viśvedevāḥ prīyantāmomiti devavisarjanam ।। 97।।
nāndīmukhā mātaraśca prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam ।
nāndīmukhāḥ pitaraśca prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam ।।98।।
nāndīmukhā mātāmahāḥ prīyantāṃ tadvisarjanam ।
anuvrajya ca viprāṇāṃ vacanāt paripūrṇakaḥ ।। 99।।
śrāddhavidhirnāndīmukhaprāsādāt paripūrṇakaḥ ।
astu vai paripūrṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco'nugaḥ ।। 2.145.10 0।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
devāyatanakāyā''ha vidhiṃ mayoditastu te ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave kalaśasthāpanapuṇyāhavācanamātṛkādyāvāhananāndīśrāddhāsanapūjanabhojanadakṣiṇādānavisarjanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 145।।


← adhyāyaḥ 145 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 146
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 147 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike caivaṃ nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ tu yat ।
bhaktāya bhagavānāhā''cāryādivaraṇaṃ yathā ।। 1 ।।
ometasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ tu karmasu ।
ācāryatvena vipraṃ tvā vṛṇe gandhā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।। 2 ।।
puṣpatāmbūlamudrābhirvāsobhiścāsmi oṃ vṛtaḥ ।
taṃ prapūjya tato brahmavaraṇaṃ saṃvidhāpayet ।। 3 ।।
ometasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ tu karmasu ।
kṛtā'kṛtekṣātmasu brahmasthāne tvāmahamāvṛṇe ।। 4 ।।
gandhapuṣpākṣatatāmbūlakamudrā'mbarādibhiḥ ।
brahmatvena vṛto'smīti brahmā'smi vai kratau tava ।। 5 ।।
taṃ prapūjya ṛtvijo'ṣṭau caturo vṛṇuyācca vā ।
asya devasya ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vedavido'tra ca ।। 6 ।।
amukān vo vṛṇe ṛtviktvena gandhādibhistviha ।
oṃ vṛttāḥ sma iti tān saṃpūjya gandhākṣatādibhiḥ ।। 7 ।।
aṣṭau vā caturo dvārapālān saṃvṛṇuyānmakhī ।
ekaikavedinau dvau dvau jāpakau vṛṇuyānmakhī ।। 8 ।।
bhavanti ṛtvijaścaivaṃ pañcaviśaṃtisaṃkhyakāḥ ।
yadvā'śaktau vṛṇuyādvai tathā hotraṣṭakaṃ punaḥ ।। 9 ।।
jāpakān caturo dvārapālacatuṣṭayaṃ gurum ।
evaṃ vai ṛtvijaḥ saptadaśāpyapi bhavanti hi ।। 2.146.1 0।।
yadvā hotṝँśca caturo jāpakāँścaturastathā ।
caturo dvārapālāँśca guruṃ ceti trayodaśa ।। 11 ।।
yadvā''cāryaṃ tathā brahmāṇameva vṛṇuyānmakhī ।
dvābhyāṃ sarvaṃ yajñakarma nivartate na saṃśayaḥ ।। 12।।
rājā tu śatasāhasrān vṛṇuyācca yathābalam ।
tato'rcayecca vidhinā gurvādīn varaṇakramāt ।। 13।।
madhuparkeṇā'rcayedvai miṣṭena pāyasādinā ।
bhaghuparko bahuvidho miṣṭāmblapāyasādijaḥ ।। 14।।
atha viprān prārthayecca makhī prāñjalirutthitaḥ ।
brāhmaṇāḥ santu me śāntāḥ sarvapāpanivārakāḥ ।। 15।।
dānayajñajapahomairyājakāstṛptidāyakāḥ ।
pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca vedamūrtaya eva te ।। 16।।
rakṣantu jāpakā māṃ ca ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ dadatvapi ।
yāganiṣpattaye viprā vṛtāḥ kurvantu śāntikam ।। 17।।
pauṣṭikaṃ ca prakurvantu niyame saṃsthitāḥ dvijāḥ ।
evaṃ viprān susamprārthyā''cāryaṃ saṃprārthayenmakhī ।। 18।।
mantramūrtirbhavānāste kuru dharmonnatiṃ mama ।
tvatprasādena yajño'yaṃ nirvighno vai samāpyatām ।। 19।।
evaṃ samprārthya ca tataḥ sasutthāya makhī svayam ।
gṛhītvā yogyasambhārān kṛtvā'grataḥ suvāsinīḥ ।।2.146.20।।
viprāṃstathā'grataḥ kṛtvā tūryaghoṣe pravartite ।
pūrṇakuṃbhasamāyukto yajamāno hi maṇḍapam ।।2 1 ।।
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ prāpya paścimadvārameva tu ।
pāṇibhyāṃ cārghapātraṃ vai samādāya sthito bhavet ।।22।।
sārgho dvāre pṛthivīṃ ca dhyātvā kūrmoparisthitām ।
śuklāṃ padmaśaṃkhacakraśūlayuktacaturbhujām ।। 23।।
savatsāṃ gorūpadharāṃ cāgaccha vasudhe tviha ।
gṛhāṇa phalapuṣpāṇi pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa matkṛtām ।।24।।
yajñārthaṃ bhagavatpatnīṃ tvāṃ vṛṇomīha vaiṣṇavīm ।
saubhāgyaṃ dehi putrāँśca dhanaṃrūpaṃ pradehi ca ।।25।।
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ ca me devi susaubhāgyaṃ prayaccha me ।
ityaṣṭāṃgaṃ mahārghyaṃ ca datvā natvā tato makhī ।।26।।
paścimadvāramārgeṇa praviśed yajamānakaḥ ।
homadravyapraveśastu pūrvadvāreṇa vai mataḥ ।।।27।।
dānadravyapraveśastu dakṣadvāreṇa vai mataḥ ।
dānārthān dakṣiṇārthāṃśca pratiṣṭhārthān supāvanān ।।28।।
saṃbhārānuttaradvāreṇaiva praveśayenmakhī ।
ācāryastu tato vāme haste vai gaurasarṣapān ।।29।।
lājāyuktān gṛhītvā ca kuryādvai dikprarakṣaṇam ।
oṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ valagaṃ cotkirāmi samantataḥ ।।2.146.3 0।।
aniṣṭānutkhana sarvān valaga tvāṃ kirāmi ca ।
rakṣohaṇo valagāḥ prokṣayāmi vaiṣṇavān balān ।।3 1 ।।
tṛṇāmyupadadhāmyatroparyūhāmi samantataḥ ।
rakṣobhāgo nirasto'sti rakṣobādho na vai bhavet ।।32।।
rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhiyonimayohate ।
droṇesadhaḥ sthalaṃ puṣṭaṃ samāsadat vinirbhayam ।।33।।
bhūmibhūtā vighnarūpā asarpantvitaḥ sthalāt ।
apakramantu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvato diśaḥ ।।34।।
yajñakarmavirodhyatra bhūtaṃ sthitaṃ sthale'tra vai ।
sthānaṃ vihāya cānyatra prayāntvastu ca śāntidam ।।35।।
pretādyāścāpagacchantu svīkaromi bhuvaṃ tvimām ।
karomi śāntikaṃ cātra kirāmīśānataḥ kramāt ।।36।।
āyāntvatra surā yātudhānādyā apayāntu ca ।
devayajanaṃ kṣetraṃ tvaṃ rakṣa viṣṇo'ntare sthita ।।37।।
iti rakṣāṃ vidhāyaiva pañcagavyena satkuśaiḥ ।
prokṣayenmaṇḍapabhūmiṃ yajñasaṃbhārakāṃstathā ।।38।।
hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvikā lokapāvikāḥ ।
agniṃ yā dadhire garbhe tā āpaḥ pāvayantu naḥ ।।39।।
vāruṇyo madhusrāviṇyaḥ śaṃsya apo bhavanti yāḥ ।
yatspṛṣṭaṃ bhakṣyameva syād devānāṃ tāḥ punantu naḥ ।।2.146.40 ।।
antarīkṣe pṛthivyāṃ ca śukraṃ yadudbhavaṃ rasam ।
puṣṭidaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tā āpo naḥ punantviha ।।41 ।।
śivena cakṣuṣā paśyatāpo māṃ spṛśatā'pi ca ।
śivayā tanuvā māṃ ca balatejonvitaṃ tathā ।।42।।
punātu yajñasaṃbhārān pavamāno jalānvitaḥ ।
punantu manavo devāḥ punantu viśvāayavaḥ ।।43।।
agne salila śaktyā te idaṃ brahma punīmahe ।
vaiścānaro raśmibhirmāṃ vātaḥ prāṇena varcasā ।।44।।
dyāvāpṛthivī payasā savitā kiraṇairihā ।
punantu māṃ ca saṃbhārānidaṃ brahma punīmahe ।।45।।
pāvamānyā pavitraṃ yat tadaśnantyeva devatāḥ ।
pāvamānyā tu saṃbhārāḥ saṃmatāḥ sadrasaiḥ sadā ।।46।।
tasmai rasavatī duhe sarvamaśnanti devatāḥ ।
ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtarasaṃ kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūttamam ।।47।।
brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitaṃ nihitaṃ tacca vastuṣu ।
pavamānyā pavitreṇa devāścāśnanti bhāvataḥ ।।48।।
indraḥ somo varuṇaśca yamo rājā pūnantvidam ।
brahmajātaṃ vastujātaṃ pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe ।।49।।
ityevaṃ cābhiṣicyaiva āpohiṣṭhāmayo bhuvaḥ ।
tā na ūrje dadhātana maheraṇāya cakṣase ।।2.146.50।।
yo vaḥ śreṣṭhatamo miṣṭo rasastadbhājanaṃ vayam ।
āpastadbhājanaṃ sarvam āpo janayathā rasam ।।51।।
ityevaṃ sarvasaṃbhārān prokṣya kṛtāñjalirmakhī ।
tiṣṭhed vipro vadet svastimaśvinau kurutaṃ tava ।।52।।
aditiste svastimeva pūṣā svastiṃ dadhātu te ।
dyauḥ kṣitiste svastimeva cinutaḥ svastimaryamā ।।53 ।।
vāyuḥ svastiṃ guruḥ svastiṃ vahniḥ svastiṃ karotu te ।
devyaḥ svastiṃ tathā devāḥ svastiṃ kurvantu te sadā ।।54।।
svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ ।
svasti nastārkṣyo'riṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ।।55।।
ityevaṃ svasmimādhatya maṇḍapasyā'rcanaṃ tathā ।
kuryādvai vāstupūjāṃ copaviśya vāstusannidhau ।।56।।
maṇḍapanairṛtyakoṇe prāṅmukho yajamānakaḥ ।
upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya ca samāhitaḥ ।।57।।
deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya vāstupūjāṃ carenmakhī ।
vāstoścaturṣu koṇeṣu catuḥśaṃkūn praropayet ।।58।।
oṃ viśantu bhūbhāge nāgāśca lokaprapālakāḥ ।
maṇḍape'trā'vatiṣṭhantu balāyuṣyapradāḥ sadā ।।59।।
balidānaṃ māṣabhaktadadhyodanena cārpaye ।
śaṃkavaḥ pratigṛhṇantu bhavatpārśve samarpitam ।।2.146.60।।
rudrebhyaścāpi sarpebhyo baliṃ dadāmi śobhanam ।
gṛhṇantvīśānabhāgasthā ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ ।।61।।
om agnibhyo'tha sarpebhyo ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ ।
āgneyyāṃ vo baliṃ gṛhṇantvodanaṃ pradadāmi yat ।।62।।
nairṛtyādhipatiścaiva nairṛtyāṃ rākṣasāśca ye ।
baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇantu mantritaṃ balim ।।63।।
vāyavyādhipatiścaiva vāyavyāṃ ye ca rākṣasāḥ ।
baliṃ dadāmi gṛhṇantvodanaṃ puṇyaṃ samarpitam ।।64।।
vāstupīṭhe kuṃkumādyaiḥ svarṇaśalākayā tathā ।
ratnena rajatenāpi phalena kusumena vā ।।65।।
navarekhāḥ prakartavyāstatra lakṣmyai namaśca om ।
yaśovatyai namaśceti oṃ kāntāyai namastathā ।।66।।
supriyāyai namaśceti vimalāyai namaśca om ।
oṃ śriyai nama oṃ subhagāyai namaśca omiti ।।67।।
oṃ sumatyai nama om iḍāyai namaśca omiti ।
evaṃ vai sthāpayitvaiva kṛtvā rekhāḥ punarnava ।।68।।
oṃ dhānyāyai namastatra oṃ prāṇāyai namastathā ।
viśālāyai namaścāpi oṃ sthirāyai namastathā ।।69।।
oṃ bhadrāyai namaśceti oṃ jayāyai namastathā ।
oṃ niśāyai namaśceti virajāyai namaśca om ।।2.146.70 ।।
vibhavāyai namaśceti sthāpayitvā prapūjayet ।
aiśāne ca pade devamīśānaṃ śikhinaṃ haram ।।71 ।।
dhyātvā cā''vāhayāmyatra śaṃbhavāya namo namaḥ ।
bhavāya śaṃbhave śivatarāya ca namo namaḥ ।।72।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śikhinnihā''gaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ।
taddakṣiṇe ca parjanyaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ।।73 ।।
abhivarṣatu parjanyaḥ parjanyāya namo namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ parjanya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।74।।
tato dakṣe jayantaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ।
jayanta varmaṇā channa cāmṛtena samāplutā ।।75।।
urasā balamāpanna tvāṃ mṛndantu surā iha ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ jayanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।76 ।।
jayantāya namaste'stu jayaṃ tanotu sarvathā ।
tato dakṣe mahendraṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ।।77।।
om āyātvindro vasatvatra stutaḥ śūraśca vardhanaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mahendra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।78।।
mahendrāya namo vajradharāya dyuprabhāviṇe ।
tato dakṣe sūryadevaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ।।79।।
savitre brahmarūpāya tejaḥkośāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।2.146.8 0।।
tataśca dakṣiṇe satyaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmyaham ।
satyena dīkṣā phalati saśraddhā dakṣiṇātmikā ।।81 ।।
tatsarvaṃ satyakādhāraṃ satyāya te namo namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca satya ihāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।।82।।
tato dakṣe bhṛśaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi bhāvataḥ ।
ātvā hārṣamantarabhrurdhruvastiṣṭhā'vicācaliḥ ।।83 ।।
viśastvāṃ sarve vāñcchantu mā tvadrāṣṭradhidbhraśat ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhṛśa ihāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ।।84।।
tato dakṣe mahākāśaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।
svarā nādā dhvanayaśca sunṛtā mādhvya eva ca ।।85 ।।
tvayi santi mahākāśa tubhyaṃ divyāya vai namaḥ ।
au bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ākāśa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।86 ।।
tato dakṣe koṇabhāge'nalamāvāhayāmi ca ।
vāyusakhaṃ tathā vāyuṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।।87।।
agne saptasahasrātyajivha tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ।
vāyo sahasrarathavan vahnimitra ca te namaḥ ।।88।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca vahne vāyo cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
tataḥ paśce pūṣaṇaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।।89।।
pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadācana ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca pūṣannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।2.146.9 0 ।।
pūṣṇe namastava stotāro vayaṃ smaḥ sukhaṃ kuru ।
tataḥ paśce ta vitathaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 91 ।।
vitatha tvaṃ sūryamahastubhyaṃ namaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vitatha ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 92 ।।
tataḥ paśce gṛhakṣataṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।
om akṣannamīmadaṃtahyavapriyā adhūṣata ।। 93 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gṛhakṣata namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
tataḥ paśce yamaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।।9 4।।
te yamāya pitṛmate svadhā dharmāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yamaścehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca. ।। 95।।
tataḥ paścime gandharvaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।
gandharva tvāṃ viśvāvasuḥ paridadhātu bhūtaye ।। 96 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gandharva namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
tatpaśce bhṛṃgarājaṃ ca dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 97।।
bhṛṃgarājāya ca namaḥ sūriṇe ca saromate ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhṛṃgarāja ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 98।।
tataḥ paśce mṛgaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
viśatruṃ kuru mṛgarāṭ durge'pi sahado bhava ।।99।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mṛgā'tra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
tatpaśce nairṛtakoṇe pitṝnāvāhayāmi ca ।। 2.146.10 0।।
pitṛbhyaśca namaḥ sarvapitṝn samabhidhīmahi ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitara ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 101 ।।
taduttare dvārapaṃ nandinaṃ cāvāhayāmi ca ।
bahurakṣādhara nandin namaste'stu prarakṣaya ।। 1 02।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nandiँstvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
taduttare sugrīvakaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 1 03।।
sugrīvāya namo rudropāśritāya gaṇāya te ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sugrīva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 04।।
taduttare puṣpadantaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।
śaṃbhusāmavidhātre te puṣpadantāya vai namaḥ ।। 105 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ puṣpadanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
taduttare ca varuṇaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 1 06।।
raseśāya namo miṣṭahavyavāsāya dyumate ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 07।।
taduttare'suraṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca asura ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 08।।
taduttare śeṣamāvāhayāmi te namo namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śeṣākhya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 09।।
taduttare ca vai pāpaṃ dhyāyāmyāvāhayāmi ca ।
o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pāpa te namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।। 2.146.11 0।।
taduttare vāyukoṇe rogamāvāhayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ roga te namaścāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।। 11 1।।
pāparogau prajānāṃ mā syātāṃ namāmyubhāvapi ।
tatpūrve nāganāmānaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ namāmi ca ।। 1 12।।
āvāhayāmi cāgaccha tiṣṭhā'tra bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca ।
tatpūrve mukhyanāmānaṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 11 3।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mukhyā'trā''gaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ।
tatpūrve ca namo bhallāṭāya cāvāhayāmi tam ।। 1 14।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhallāṭa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
tatpūrve tu kuberāya nama āvāhayāmi tam ।। 1 15।।
somāya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ ।
tatpūrve tu ca śailāya nama āvāhayāmi tam ।। 1 16।।
sarpāya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ ।
tatpūrve'ditaye nama āgaccheha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 17।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva adite mayi kalpapradā bhava ।
tatpūrve ca ditiṃ dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।। 1 18।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dite'tra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
vāstoḥ kaṇṭhe apo dhyātvā cāvāhayāmi vai namaḥ ।। 11 9।।
āpo hiṣṭhāmayo bhuvastāna'ūrjedadhātana ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpo vai ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 2.146.120।।
skandhe dhyātvā cā''pavatsaṃ cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpavatsa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 121 ।।
dakṣe pārśve cāryamāṇaṃ namāmyāvāhayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aryaman ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 122।।
tato dakṣe kare sāvitrakamāvāhayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sāvitrāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ।। 123।।
sāvitrapārśvake savitāramāvāhayāmi ca ।
kaphoṇikāyāḥ sānnidhye namāmi saṃsmarāmi ca ।। 124।।।
oṃ viśvāni devasavitarduritāni parāsuva ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ savitoścehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 125।।
tatpaśce dakṣasakthina vivasvantaṃ saṃsmarāmi ca ।
āvāhayāmi ca namaste vivasvan sudhāṃ kuru ।। 126।।
dampatī cāśnutaścātrāgaccha tiṣṭha ca te namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vivasvantaṃ devaṃ saṃpradhīmahi ।। 127।।
tatpaśce meḍhradeśe ca indramāvāhayāmi ca ।
vasudo bhava cāgaccha namaste tiṣṭha svaḥpate ।। 128।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva indrāya vibudheśāya te namaḥ ।
tadadho gudabhāge ca jayantaṃ prasmarāmi ca ।। 129।।
āvāhayāmi auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ehi ca tiṣṭha ca ।
jayantāya nama aṣāḍhāya namo jayāya te ।। 2.146.130।।
taduttare vāmasakthni mitramāvāhayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ mitra tvamāgaccha tiṣṭha te namaḥ ।। 13 1।।
taduttare vāmakare rājayakṣmāṇameva ca ।
āvāhayāmi te namo yakṣmaṇā viprakarṣakṛt ।। 132।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rājayakṣmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
kaphoṇīsannidhau haste vāme rudraṃ smarāmi ca ।। 133।।
āvāhayāmi ca rudra namāmi śreyase bhava ।
auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudrātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 34।।
tataḥ pūrve vāmapārśve pṛthvīdhara smarāmi ca ।
āvāhayāmi pṛthivīdhṛk śreyase namāmi ca ।। 135।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pṛthivīdharāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
vāstūdare ca brahmāṇaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca ।। 136।।
brahmarūpa namaste'stu sato yoniṃ pradehi naḥ ।
auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmaँstvamāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 137।।
īśāne koṇake bāhye carakīṃ ca smarāmi ca ।
āvāhayāmi carakīṃ namāmi pāśanāśinīm ।। 1 38।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ caraki cehāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
agnau koṇe bahirvidārikāmāvāhayāmi ca ।। 139।।
mṛtyunāśakari vidārike namāmi yogini ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vidārike cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।।2.146.140।।
rakṣaḥkoṇe pūtanāṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।
bandhahantri pūtane tvaṃ nirṛtiduritāpahe ।। 141 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pūtane cāgaccha tiṣṭha cātra ca ।
vāyukoṇe pāpinīṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।। 142।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pāpe tvaṃ cehāgacchātra tiṣṭha ca ।
pūrve skandaṃ namāmyāvāhayāmi saṃsmarāmi ca ।। 143 ।।
bāṇebhyo rakṣa senāni śarma yacchatu duṣṭahan ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skandā'tra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 144।।
dakṣe'ryamāṇaṃ ca naumyāvāhayāmi smarāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aryaman samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 145।।
paścime jṛṃbhakaṃ naumyāvāhayāmi smarāmi ca ।
hiṃkṛte prothate śayānāya svāhā ca valgate ।। 146।।
svapate jāgrate svāhā jṛṃbhamāṇāya kūjate ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ jṛmbhaka samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 147।।
uttare pilipicchaṃ naumyāvāhayāmi cintaye ।
pilippilākyai piśāṃginyai svāhā te namo'stviha ।। 148।।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pilipiccha samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūrve cendraṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca ।। 149।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra cāgaccha ceha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
agnāvagniṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca ।। 2.146.150।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ agne cāgaccha ceha tiṣṭha ca ।
yāmye yamaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi ca namāmi ca ।। 151।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama cāgaccha ceha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
nairṛte nirṛtiṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca ।। 152।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛta cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ।
paścime varuṇaṃ smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca ।। 153।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ।
smarāmi vāyuṃ vāyavye naumi cāvāhayāmi ca ।। 154।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo cāgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ।
kuberamuttare smarāmyāvāhayāmi naumi ca ।। 155।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kubera ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
īśānyāmīśānadevamāvāhayāmi naumi ca ।। 156।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśāna ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
īśānapūrvamadhye vai brahmāṇaṃ prasmarāmi ca ।। 157।।
āvāhayāmi naumyenaṃ devā avantu sarvataḥ ।
o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmā'tra samāgacchātra tiṣṭha ca ।। 158।।
varuṇanirṛtimadhye'nantaṃ smarāmi naumi ca ।
āvāhayāmyanantaṃ ca viṣarakṣākaraṃ harim ।। 159।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ananta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ityāvāhya vāstupīṭhadevān praṇamya rādhike ।। 2.146.160।।
kuryād devapratiṣṭhāṃ vai sāṃgopāṃgāṃ kratau tataḥ ।
buhaspatistanotvenaṃ viśvedevāḥ pratiṣṭhata ।। 161 ।।
ityeva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāha tu daivatam ।
tadeva tu mayā te'tra vāstudhyānaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 162।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave ācāryaṛtvigādivaraṇaṃ saṃbhāraprokṣaṇaṃ svastivāco maṇḍapapūjā vāstupīṭhadevāvāhananamanādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 146 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 146 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 147
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 148 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vibhuḥ ।
āha devāyatanakaṃ yattad vacmi ca te tataḥ ।। 1 ।।
vāstudevārcanaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣṭhā'nantaraṃ yataḥ ।
tadaṅgātmā sthāpanīyastāmrasya kalaśo navaḥ ।। 2 ।।
om ājighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantu cendavaḥ ।
sahasradhārāḥ payasvatvastvāṃ viśantu tiṣṭha ca ।। 3 ।।
iti kalaśaṃ sthāpayitvā jalaṃ tatra prapūrayet ।
varuṇasya sukhaṃ sthānaṃ cottaṃbhanaṃ jalaṃ tvayi ।। 4 ।।
ṛtaṃ ca sadanaṃ tvaṃ vai jalamādhatsva pāvanam ।
iti vāri pūrayitvā kaṇṭhe vastraṃ praveṣṭayet ।। 5 ।।
vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāravat ।
itivastraṃ veṣṭayitvā pūgīphalaṃ ghaṭe'rpayet ।। 6 ।।
oṃ phalinī puṣpiṃṇī syādaphalā'puṣpāpi te yujeḥ ।
pūgi tvaṃ ca ghaṭe tiṣṭha phaladā bhava dehinaḥ ।। 7 ।।
iti pūgīphalaṃ datvā pañcaratnāni cārpayet ।
svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ hīrakaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā ।। 8 ।।
parivājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyāni cākramīt ।
iti ratnāni datvaiva hiraṇyaṃ prakṣiped ghaṭe ।। 9 ।।
agnerapatyaṃ devena vidhṛtaṃ śirasā purā ।
hiraṇyaṃ hariṇā nītaṃ kalaśe pradadāmi tat ।। 2.147.10 ।।
iti hiraṇyaṃ dattvaiva gandhaṃ kalaśe prakṣipet ।
kauṃkumaṃ kaisaraṃ gandhaṃ cāndanaṃ pradadāmi te ।। 1 1।।
itigandhaṃ pradāyaivā'rpayedoṣadhikāstataḥ ।
rasaplutā madhusrāvāḥ purā jātā harestanau ।। 12।।
tāstvapi prakṣipāmyeva śataṃ sapta ca rughghanāḥ ।
iti sarvauṣadhīrdatvā saptamṛdaḥ samarpayet। ।। 13।।
gajāśvagosthalījātāṃ valmīkacatvarodbhavām ।
rājacatvaralabdhāṃ cārpayet tulasīmūlajām ।। 14।।
pṛthivī sarvarūpā tvaṃ śarmadā bhava vāsade ।
iti saptamṛdo datvā dūrvāṃ ghaṭe samarpayet ।। 15।।
kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaḥ pari ।
evaṃ no dūrve pratanoḥ sahasreṇa śatena ca ।। 16।।
iti dūrvāṃ ghaṭe datyā'rpayedvai pañcapallavān ।
aśvatthevo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiḥ kṛtā ।। 17।।
gobhāja itkilā'tha yat sa navatha pūruṣam ।
oṃ namaḥ kalaśe mukhe'śvatthasya ca vaṭasya ca ।। 18।।
cūtasyodumbarasyā'pi plakṣasyāpi navāni vai ।
patrāṇi sthāpayāmyatra sasyavad rāṣṭrakaṃ tava ।। 19।।
oṃ pavitraṃ pavitrākhyaṃ punātu sūryaraśmivat ।
pavitrapate kalaśe'rpayāmyatra pavitrakam ।।2.147.20 ।।
oṃ namaste pavitrāya kuśajanyāya vedhase ।
ghaṭe tvāṃ ca nikṣipāmi pavitraṃ kuru vāri tat ।।21।।
iti datvā pavitraṃ ca ghaṭoparyakṣatabhṛtām ।
sthālīṃ nyasennavāṃ śarkarādiyuktāṃ sukāṃcanīm ।।22।।
pūrṇā darvī parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata ।
vasneva vikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjaḥ śatakrato ।। 23 ।।
iti taṇḍulapātraṃ ca natvā śrīphalamarpayet ।
śrīśca lakṣmīḥ ramā rādhā brahmavidyāsatīratiḥ ।। 24।।
suguṇā mañjulā haṃsā lalitā kambharā satī ।
santoṣā māṇikī durgā'mṛtā'mbā śāradā imāḥ ।।25।।
śrīphale saṃvasantvatra sampajjuṣyo bhavantu naḥ ।
iti śrīphalamāsthāpya śrīdaṃ taṃ praṇamenmakhī ।।26 ।।
oṃ manojutirjuṣatāmājyasya bṛhaspatiḥ kratum ।
imaṃ tanotvariṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ samimaṃ dadhātu ca ।
viśvedevā iha ghaṭe mādayantāmoṃ pratiṣṭha ।।27।।
iti ghaṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyā''vāhayed varuṇaṃ tataḥ ।
jalaṃ sarvarasāḍhyaṃ vai pāvanaṃ ca kratorhitam ।।28।।
tattvāyāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ ।
aheḍamāno varuṇeha boddhyuruśaṃsamāna āyuḥ pramoṣī ।।29।।
oṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ityāvāhya varuṇaṃ cārcayet ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।।2.147.30 ।।
sarve samudrāḥ saritastīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca ।
āyāntu ca makhīyānāṃ duritakṣayahetave ।। 3 1।।
kalaśasya mukhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ sadāśivaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
mūlaṃ brahmā svayaṃ bodhya udaraṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।।32।।
kukṣayaḥ sāgarāḥ santi pṛthvī kalaśarūpiṇī ।
vedāḥ sāṃgāśca kalaśāvayavātmāna eva ca ।।33।।
āvāhayāmi tīrthāni cāgacchata ca tiṣṭhata ।
amṛtonmathane jātaḥ kalaśo viṣṇuhastagaḥ ।।34।।
tīrthaprāṇasurabhūtavāso'si phalado'si ca ।
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāḥ sapitṛkāḥ ।।35।।
aśvinau tvayi tiṣṭhantu yajñārthaṃ sannidhiṃ kuru ।
ityevaṃ kalaśaṃ prārthya tasyopari tu kānakīm ।।36।।
vāstumūrti kṛkalāsarūpāṃ tatra nidhāpayet ।
agnyuttāraṇakaṃ kuryād vastrairācchādayet paṭaiḥ ।।37।।
tata uttānakaṃ vāstumīśānaśirasaṃ naram ।
dhyāyedagnyuttāraṇe ca deśakālau prakīrtya ca ।।38।।
avaghātādidoṣāṇāṃ parihārārthameva ca ।
agnyuttāraṇakaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca samācaret ।।39।।
mūrtiṃ pātre nidhāyaiva dugdhadhārā prapātayet ।
jaladhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt sūktaṃ paṭhet punaḥ punaḥ ।।2.147.40।।
oṃ samudrasya tvāvakayāgne parivyayāmasi ।
sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako'smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ।।41 ।।
oṃ himasya tvā jarāyuṇā'gne parivyayāmasi ।
sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako'smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ।।42।।
omapāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam ।
vighnarūpāँstathā'nyāँste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ ।।43 ।।
sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako'smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ।
namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe ।।44।।
vighnarūpāँstathā'nyāँste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ ।
sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako'smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ।।45।।
prāṇadā'pānadā vyānadā varcodā variṣṭhadāḥ ।
vidhnarūpāँstathā'nyāँste hyasmattapantu hetayaḥ ।।46 ।।
sarvadevottāraṇaḥ pāvako'smabhyaḥ śivo bhava ।
evamagnyuttāraṇaṃ ca kṛtvā pañcabhiramṛtaiḥ ।।47।।
saṃsnāpya vāstupuruṣaṃ kalaśopari vinyaset ।
dhyāyed vāstusvarūpaṃ ca parabrahmodbhavaṃ purā ।।48।।
tataḥ śaṃbhoḥ śarīrāccā'bhavat putro balī mahān ।
yajñāpakārakaḥ so'yaṃ devaiḥ parājito mṛdhe ।।49।।
nipātyā'dhomukho baddhaḥ samantād devatāgaṇaiḥ ।
īśāne mastakaṃ nyastaṃ nairṛtye pādasaṃpuṭam ।।2.147.50।।
jānunī kūrparīkṛtya bāhuyugmaṃ tathāvidham ।
vāyavyāgnyostato jānuṃ hṛdaye cāṃjalistathā ।।51 ।।
padīkṛtya ca tasyordhvaṃ sarve surāśca rohitāḥ ।
taṃ sarvasukhāsaṃ cāvāhayāmi ca vāstukam ।।52।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ saḥ vāstunaraṃ cāvāhayāmi naumi ca ।
sammānayāmi cāgaccha mahābalaparākrama ।।53।।
sarvadevāśritavapurbrahmaputra namo'stu te ।
sarvabrahmāṇḍadhṛgasi tvāgaccha bhagavanniha ।।54।।
āgaccha bhagavan vāsto sarvadevānvitastviha ।
tiṣṭhātra kuru kalyāṇaṃ yajñe'smin sannidho bhava ।।55।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ ।
yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śanno bhava dvipadeśaṃ catuṣpade ।।56।।
ityāvāhyā'kṣatapuṣpaiścandanāmbarabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
sampūjya prārthayed rakṣāṃ rakṣa saṃkaṭaviplavāt ।।57।।
naivedyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca nīrājanādi cārpayet ।
svāhetyuccārya ca tato'gadavān vidhinā'rcayet ।।58।।
oṃ namaḥ śikhine ceśānāya pādyaṃ tathā'rdhakam ।
ācamanaṃ snapanaṃ cāmbaraṃ gandhaṃ tathā'kṣatān ।।59।।
puṣpāṇi dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam ।
tāmbūlaṃ śayanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāmi gṛhāṇa śam ।।2.147.6 0 ।।
parjanyāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।
jayantāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।।6 1 ।।
omindrāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।
oṃ sūryāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।।62।।
oṃ satyāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।
oṃ bhṛśāya namaḥ pādyādikaṃ gṛhāṇa śaṃ kuru ।।63।।
oṃ ākāśāya namaśca oṃ vāyave ca namo namaḥ ।
oṃ pūṣṇe ca namaḥ oṃ vitathāyāpi namo namaḥ ।।64।।
gṛhakṣatāya nama oṃ oṃ yamāya namo namaḥ ।
oṃ gandharvāya ca namo bhṛṃgarājāya oṃ namaḥ ।।65 ।।
oṃ mṛgāya nama oṃ ca pitṛbhyo'pi namo namaḥ ।
pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ।।66 ।।
oṃ nandine nama oṃ ca sugrīvāya namo namaḥ ।
oṃ puṣpadantāya namo varuṇāya ca oṃ namaḥ ।।67।।
omasurāya ca namaḥ śeṣāya ca namo namaḥ ।
namaḥ pāpāya rogāya oṃ nāmaścāhaye namaḥ ।।68।।
oṃ mukhyāya namo bhallāṭāya oṃ ca namo namaḥ ।
oṃ somāya ca nāgāyā'ditaye ditaye namaḥ ।।69।।
omadabhyaśca namaścāpavapsāya namo namaḥ ।
pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ।।2.147.70।।
omaryamṇe nama oṃ sāvitrāya ca namaśca om ।
oṃ savitre namo vivasvate cendrāya oṃ namaḥ ।।7 1।।
oṃ jayantāya nama oṃ mitrāya nama oṃ namaḥ ।
rājayakṣmaṇe nama oṃ oṃ rudrāya namo namaḥ ।।72।।
oṃ pṛthivīdharāya ca nama oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ ।
pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ।।73।।
oṃ carakyai nama oṃ ca vidāryai ca namaśca om ।
pūtanāyai nama oṃ ca pāpāyai ca namaśca om ।।74।।
oṃ skandāya namaścāryamṇe namo jṛṃbhakāya om ।
nama oṃ pilipicchāya omindrāya namaśca om ।।75।।
agnaye oṃ namo yamāya oṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ ।
nama oṃ ca varuṇāya oṃ vāyave namo namaḥ ।।76।।
oṃ kuberāya nama omīśānāya oṃ namaḥ ।
oṃ brahmaṇe namaśca omanantāya namo namaḥ ।।77।।
pādyādīni ca gṛhṇantu kurvantu śaṃ namo namaḥ ।
bhavantaścāṃgadevādyā gṛhṇantu gandhamakṣatān ।।78।।
puṣpadhūpau dīpavastre pratipātrasthabhojanam ।
jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇādikam ।।79।।
ārārtrikaṃ cārpayāmi gṛhṇantu vitarantu śam ।
atha vāstupuruṣaṃ ca pūjayettu punastathā ।।2.147.80।।
kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vai bījapraṇavabṛṃhitām ।
ekāgraṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā devaṃ samuccaret ।।8 1 ।।
oṃ āṃ hrī krau yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so'ham ।
asya devasya vai prāṇā iha prāṇā vasantu ca ।।82।।
oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so'ham ।
asya devasya vai jīva iha jīvaḥ sthitaśca om ।।83।।
oṃ āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ haṃ saḥ so'ham ।
asya devasya vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥśrotramityapi ।।84।।
jihvā ghrāṇaṃ pāṇipādāḥ pāyūpasthāni cāntaram ।
asminnāgatya ca ciraṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhantu vai svāhā ।।85।।
oṃ manojūtirjuṣatāmājyasya bṛhaspatiryajñam ।
imaṃ tanotvariṣṭaṃ ca yajñaṃ samimaṃ dadhātu ।।86।।
viśvedevāsa iha mādayantāmoṃ pratiṣṭhata ।
evaṃ pratiṣṭhāyajñena yajante vai pratiṣṭhitān ।।87।।
tava vāsto mahāpūjāṃ karomyanugrahaṃ kuru ।
oṃ vāstupuruṣāya ca namo'rpayāmi pādyakam ।।88।।
arghyaṃ cācamanaṃ pañcāmṛtasnānaṃ dadāmi ca ।
śuddhodakaṃ yajñasūtraṃ cārpayāmi ca te namaḥ ।।89।।
vastraṃ gandhaṃ kusumaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā'ttaram ।
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle cārpayāmi ca te namaḥ ।।2.147.90।।
dakṣiṇāṃ prāñjaliṃ cārghyaṃ samarpayāmi te namaḥ ।
oṃ pūjyo'si trilokeṣu yajñarakṣārthahetave ।।9 1 ।।
tvadarcanaṃ vinā naiva siddhyanti kratusatkriyāḥ ।
ayone bhagavan śaṃbhulalāṭasvedasaṃbhava ।। 92।।
gṛhāṇā'rghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ vāsto svāminnamo'stu te ।
evamarthaṃ pradatvaiva balidānaṃ samarpayet ।।93 ।।
oṃ vahnaye nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।
oṃ parjanyāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।।94।।
oṃ jayantāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।
omindrāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।।95।।
oṃ sūryāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।
oṃ satyāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।। 96 ।।
evaṃ vai vāstudevebhyaḥ pratyekāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
omamukāya nama eṣa pāyasabalirnamama ।।97।।
iti dadyād baliṃ tataścarakyādibhya ityapi ।
dikpālebhyo māṣabhaktabalīn dadyācca tadyathā ।। 98।।
oṃ carakyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।
oṃ vidāryai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।।99।।
pūtanāyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।
oṃ pāpāyai nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।। 2.147.1 00।।
oṃ skandāya nama eṣa māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।
aryamṇe jṛmbhakāyāpi pilipicchāya cārpayet ।। 101 ।।
indrāgniyamanirṛtavaruṇavāyave namaḥ ।
kubereśājānantebhyo māṣabhaktabalirnamama ।। 1 02।।
tato vāstupuruṣāya baliṃ dadyāddhi mantrataḥ ।
nānāsugandhipakvānnaṃ pāyasādyaṃ vibhinnakam ।। 103 ।।
baliṃ gṛhāṇa vāsto tvaṃ kṣudhādoṣaṃ praṇāśaya ।
oṃ nama eṣa vāstupuruṣāya balirnamama ।। 1 04।।
ye devāḥ pāyasabhujo gṛhṇantu pāyasaṃ hi te ।
ye devāścānnabhoktāro gṛhṇantvannaṃ śubhaṃ madhu ।। 1 05।।
ye devā rasabhoktāro gṛhṇantvete rasān bahūn ।
ye devāḥ kṛśarādāste gṛhṇantu kṛśarānnakam ।। 1 06।।
ye devā māṣabhoktāro gṛhṇantu māṣajaṃ balim ।
ye devāścāmṛtabhujo gṛhṇantvamṛtameva te ।। 1 07।।
ye devāḥ piṣṭacūrṇādā gṛhṇantu piṣṭacūrṇakam ।
ye devāḥ phalabhoktāro gṛhṇantvete phalāni ca ।। 1 08।।
ye devāḥ kaṇabhoktāraḥ sarṣapādāśca ye surāḥ ।
śākādā havyabhoktāro yeṣāṃ yogyaṃ tu yadbhavet ।। 1 09।।
tattanmayārpitaṃ devā gṛhṇantviṣṭabaliṃ namama ।
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktiśraddhāvihīnakam ।। 2.147.11 0।।
yadarpitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ vidhīyatām ।
namaste vāstudeveśa sarvavighnaharo bhava ।। 11 1।।
śāntiṃ kuru sukhaṃ dehi sarvān kāmān prayaccha me ।
oṃ śrīvāstupuruṣāyā'rpayāmi nārikelakam ।। 1 12।।
suvarṇaṃ cārpayāmyatra praṇamāmi sukhaṃ kuru ।
śrīṃ lakṣmīṃ ca ramāṃ rādhāṃ brahmavidyāṃ ca padmajām ।। 113 ।।
suguṇāṃ maṃjulāṃ padmāṃ lalitāṃ kaṃbharāṃ satīm ।
santoṣāṃ māṇikīṃ durgā'mṛtā'mbāḥ śāradāmimāḥ ।। 1 14।।
arcayet sāttvikairdravyaiḥ pāyasādyaiśca toṣayet ।
tato vai maṇḍapaṃ veṣṭayet trisūtryā samantataḥ ।
sūktena pavamānena rakṣaghnena ninādayan ।। 1 15।।
oṃ pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ ।
yaḥ potā sa punātu māṃ punantu māṃ devajanāḥ ।। 116 ।।
punantu manavo dhiyā punantu viśva āyavaḥ ।
jātavedaḥ pavitravat pavitreṇa punīhi mām ।। 1 17।।
śukreṇa devadīdyat agne kratvā kratūranu ।
yatte pavitramarciṣi agne vitatamantarā ।। 1 18।।
brahma tena punīmahe ubhābhyāṃ devasavitaḥ ।
pavitreṇa savena ca idaṃ brahma punīmahe ।। 119 ।।
vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgād yasyaistanuvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ ।
tayā madantaḥ sadhamādyeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ।। 2.147.120 ।।
vaiśvānaro raśmibhiryā punāttu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro mayobhūḥ ।
dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhiḥ ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām।। 121 ।।
bṛhadbhiḥ savitastṛbhiḥ vaśiṣṭhairdeva-
manmabhiḥ agne dakṣai punīhi mā ।
yena devā apunata yenāpo divyaṃ kaśaḥ
tena divyena brahmaṇā idaṃ brahma punīmahe ।। 122।
oṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ valagahanaṃ vaiṣṇavī-
midamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi ।
yaṃ me'niṣṭyo yamamātyo
nicakhānedamahantaṃ balagamutkirāmi ।। 123 ।।
yaṃ me samāno yamasamāno
nicakhānedamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi ।
yaṃ me sabandhuryamasabandhu-
rnicakhānedamahantaṃ valagamutkirāmi । । 124 । ।
yaṃ me sajāto yamasajāto
nicakhānotkṛtyā kirāmi ।
oṃ kuṇuṣvapājaḥ prasitiṃ na
pṛthivīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṃ ibhena । । 125। ।
tṛṣvīmanuprasitiṃ druṇānostā-
si viddhyarakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ ।
punantu māṃ devajanā manasā dhiyo
viśvābhūtāni jātavedo'pi mām ।। 126 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! maṇḍapaṃ trisūtryā praveṣṭayet ।
maṇḍape ca tataścāgatyāsane tata āviśet ।। 127।।
evaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda devatāyanam ।
tattathaiva mayoktaṃ te yadyapi nāti vistaram ।। 128 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratiṣṭhotsave kalaśasthāpanaṃ vāstoḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ pūjanaṃ vāstudevānāṃ pūjanaṃ naivedyaṃ balistrisūtryā maṇḍapaveṣṭanaṃ mantrāścetyādikathananāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 147 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇastataḥ ।
devāyatanakāyā''ha pañca tatte vadāmi ca ।। 1 ।।
tato vāyavīyapīṭhe yoginīkṣetrapālakān ।
pūjayed vidhinā samāvāhya śoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।। 2 । ।
oṃ divyayoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
oṃ divyayoginīṃ naumi kṣetrarakṣaṇakāriṇīm । । 3 । ।
oṃ mahāyoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ ।। 4 ।।
oṃ siddhayoginīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ ।। ।1 ।।
oṃ śrīgaṇeśvarīmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaistāṃ tasyai te namo namaḥ ।। 6 ।।
oṃ pretākṣīṃ ḍākinīṃ ca kālīṃ ca kālarātrikām ।
āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ । । 7 । ।
niśācarīmo hūँkārī siddhivetālinīṃ tathā ।
āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 8 ।।
oṃ hrīṃkārīṃ bhūtaḍāmarīmūrdhvakeśīṃ ca oṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ । । 9 ।।
virūpākṣīṃ ca śuṣkāṃgīṃ narabhojanāṃ ca oṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 2.148.10 । ।
oṃ kaṃkārīṃ vīrabhadrāṃ dhūmrākṣīṃ oṃ kalipriyām ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 11 । ।
rākṣasīṃ ghorarākṣasīṃ virūpākṣīṃ bhayaṃkarīm ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 12 ।।
viśālākṣīṃ kāmarīṃ ca caṇḍīṃ vārāhinīṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।।1 3 ।।
muṇḍadhartrīṃ bhairavīṃ cakriṇīṃ krodhāṃ ca durmukhīm ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 1 4।।
pretavāhanāṃ kuraṃgīṃ pralambauṣṭhīṃ mālinīṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 15 ।।
mantrayoginīṃ kālāgnīṃ mohinīṃ vakrikāṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 16 ।।
kuṇḍalinīṃ bālakīṃ ca kaumārīṃ yamadūtikām ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 17। ।
auṃ karālīṃ kauśikīṃ ca yakṣiṇīṃ bhakṣiṇīṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 18 ।।
kumārikāṃ yantravāhāṃ viśālākṣīṃ ca kāmukīm ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 19 ।।
oṃ vādhrīṃ rākṣasīṃ pretabhakṣiṇīṃ dhūrjaṭīṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 2.148.20 ।।
oṃ vikaṭāṃ ca ghorāṃ ca kapālīṃ vimalāṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 21 ।।
oṃ mālāṃ sarvasiddhāṃ cā''vāhayāmi ca vāṃ namaḥ ।
sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi sarvāḥ santu ca siddhidāḥ ।। 22।।
anayā pūjayā ṣoḍaśopacārādibhiriha ।
prīyantāṃ pāyasabaliṃ dadāmi yoginīgaṇāḥ ।। 23 ।।
atha kṣetrapālapīṭhadevatāḥ saṃprapūjayet ।
omajaramāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca te namaḥ ।। 24।।
pūjayāmi baliṃ cārpayāmi namo'jarāya te ।
indracoram āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi ca te namaḥ ।। 25।।
vyāpakaṃ cendramūrtiṃ cokṣṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ varuṇakam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 26 ।।
vāmukaṃ ca vimuktaṃ ca līlālopaṃ ca śaptakam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 27।।
airāvataṃ caikadaṃṣṭram oṣadhighnaṃ ca bandhanam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 28 ।।
divyakaraṃ kambalaṃ ca gavayavaṃ ca kṣobhaṇam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 29।।
kālaṃ baladharaṃ cā'ṇḍaṃ candravāraṇakaṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 2.148.30 ।।
phaṭāṭopaṃ ca jaṭilam ṛtuṃ ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 31 ।।
vikaṭaṃ cāṇimaṃ guṇatrandhaṃ ca ḍāmaraṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 32।।
ṭhaṃṭhaphaṇaṃ sthavilaṃ ca danturaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 33 ।।
nāgakarṇaṃ photkaraṃ ca mahādalaṃ ca cīrakam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 34।।
oṃ siṃhaṃ ca mṛgaṃ yakṣaṃ meghavāhanamityapi ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 35 । ।
oṃ tīkṣṇauṣṭhamanalaṃ sukratuṃ yudhāpaṃ vakrakam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ca vo namaḥ ।। 36 । ।
oṃ vātaṃ yāpanaṃ cāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
pūjayāmi baliṃ cārpayāmi vā praṇamāmi ca ।। 37।।
pañcāśatkṣetrapālāścehāgacchatātra tiṣṭhata ।
āsanaṃ ca tathā pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ।। 38 ।।
pañcāmṛtāplavanaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ cāmbarāṇi ca ।
bhūṣāścandanagandhādi cākṣatān kuṃkumādikam ।। 39।।
puṣpahārān kajjalaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ।
bhojanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca phalaṃ tāmbūlakādikam ।। 2.148.40 ।।
nīrājanādikaṃ samarpayāmi santu rakṣakāḥ ।
oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hruṃ svāhā baṭukāya prabhūtabalimarpayet ।। 41 ।।
yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca sarve yatra vasanti hi ।
tataścātra samāgatya baliṃ gṛhṇantu me'mṛtam ।। 42।।
balidānena santuṣṭāḥ prayacchantu mamepsitam ।
yajñe kāryāṇi kurvantu doṣāँśca ghnantu me makhe ।।43 ।।
iti datvā'rthayityā ca praṇamet sarvadevatāḥ ।
tataḥ śrīmaṇḍapapūjāṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।।44।।
ṛtvibhirguruṇā cāpi snāpito yajamānakaḥ ।
sarvauṣadhisalilena śuklamālyāmbarastathā ।।45।।
śuklagandhānulepaśca sapatnīputrapautrakaḥ ।
sā''cāryartvik kare pūrṇakalaśastūryanādane ।। 46।।
mukhyadevaṃ dhyāyamāno maṇḍapadhyānatatparaḥ ।
vedaghoṣān praśṛṇvāno maṇḍapaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ ।। 47।।
oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemā'kṣabhiryajatrāḥ ।
sthirairaṃgaistuṣṭuvāँsastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ।।48 ।।
ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau prakīrtya ca ।
mukhyadevapratiṣṭhāne yajñāṃgaṃ pūjanaṃ śubham ।।49।।
gaṇeśasya devatānāṃ maṇḍapasya karomyaham ।
āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca namanaṃ prakaromi ca ।।2.148.50 ।।
oṃ śrīgaṇeśvaramāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ sampūjayāmi praṇamāmi ca ।।51 ।।
evaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sampūjya datvā naivedyakaṃ tathā ।
stambhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryādīśānādikramānmakhī ।।52।।
omīśānyāṃ brahmamūrtimāvāhayāmi vedhasam ।
sthāpayāmi pustakā'kṣasūtraśūlakamaṇḍalūn ।।।53 ।।
dadhāna devatāyuktaṃ haṃsasthaṃ taṃ pitāmaham ।
āgaccha sṛṣṭikṛd brahman prathamastaṃbhavāsakṛt। ।।54।।
oṃ vrahma yajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād
visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ ।
sabudhnyāḥ upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ
sataśca yonimasataśca vivaḥ ।।55।।
oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarbrahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
nama oṃ brahmaṇe ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ।।56 ।।
athā''gneye śubhe staṃbhe viṣṇumāvāhayāmi ca ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacaturbāhuṃ ramāpatim ।।57।।
garuḍasthaṃ kamalāśrīlakṣmīgaṇaprasevitam ।
āgaccha bhagavan viṣṇo dvitīyastaṃbhavāsakṛt ।।58 ।।
sthāpayāmi prabhuṃ tvāṃ ca pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।59 ।।
nama oṃ viṣṇave ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ।
om idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā ca nidadhe padam ।।2.148.6 0 ।।
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure ā viṣṇave te namo namaḥ ।
atha nairṛtyakastaṃbhe śivamāvāhayāmi ca ।।6 1 ।।
vṛṣabhasthaṃ candrabhālaṃ śūlinaṃ muṇḍamālinam ।
umāgaṇasamājuṣṭaṃ nāgayajñopavītakam ।।।62।।
āgaccha bhagavan śaṃbho tṛtīyastaṃbhavāsakṛt ।
sthāpayāmi haraṃ tvāṃ ca pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।।6 3 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śaṃbho ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
nama oṃ śaṃbhave ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ।।64। ।
oṃ namaste rudramanyava utota iṣave namaḥ ।
bāhubhyāmuta te namaḥ oṃ śaṃbhave te namo namaḥ । ।65।।
atha vāyukoṇastaṃbhe indramāvāhayāmi ca ।
sahasrākṣaṃ gajārūḍhaṃ vajriṇaṃ ca śacīpatim ।।।66 ।।
āgaccha bhagavannindra caturthastambhavāsakṛt ।
sthāpayāmi mahendraṃ tvāṃ pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।। 67।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
nama indrāya oṃ ṣoḍaśopacārān dadāmi te ।।68 ।।
oṃ trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ have have suhavaṃ śūramindram ।
hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ।।69 ।।
oṃ indrāya namastato dvādaśastaṃbhapūjanam ।
bāhyabhāge maṇḍapasya karomīśānataḥ kramāt ।।2.148.7 0 ।।
atheśāne sūryamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
saptāśvarathasaṃrūḍhaṃ raktāṃgaṃ tigmatejasam ।।7 1 ।।
sapadmaṃ pūjayāmyatra pañcamastaṃbhasaṃsthitam ।
trailokyanetrarūpaṃ caṃ kuṇḍalādivirājitam ।।72।।
oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca ।
hiraṇmayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ।।।73 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।।74 ।।
atheśānapūrvayostu madhye staṃbhe gaṇeśakam ।
āhayāmi sthāpayāmi vighnaharaṃ gajānanam ।।75।।
siddhibuddhipradātāraṃ praṇamāmi vināyakam ।
āgaccha gaṇanātha tvaṃ ṣaṣṭhastaṃbhe ca tiṣṭha ca ।।76 ।।
oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe ।
oṃ priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe ।
oṃ nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe ।
vaso mama āhamajānirgarbhadhamātvāmajāsigarbhadham ।।77।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇapate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhna ca te namaḥ ।।78 ।।
atha pūrvā'gnyantarālastambhe yamaṃ yamādhipam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi sarvajantubhayaṃkaram ।।79 ।।
raudramūrtiṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ praṇamāmi sadaṇḍakam ।
māhiṣavāhanaṃ karmasākṣiṇaṃ dharmamūrtikam ।।।2.148.8 0 ।।
āgaccha dharmarāja tvaṃ saptamastaṃbhake viśa ।
oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryasya tvā tapase ।।8 1 ।।
devastvā savitāmaddhānaktupṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi ।
arcirasi śocirasi tapo'si brahmamūrtikaḥ ।। 8 2।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtā pūjā gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ । ।8 3 । ।
athā'gnikoṇake staṃbhe śeṣaṃ pātālavāsinam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi sahasraśirasaṃ śubham । ।84।।
svastikarekhayā yuktaphaṇāmaṇivibhūṣitam ।
nārāyaṇāsanaṃ devaṃ praṇamāmi viṣānvitam ।।85।।
āgaccha śeṣarāja tvaṃ cāṣṭamastaṃbhake viśa ।
o namo'stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu ।।86 ।।
ye'ntarikṣe ye ca divi tatsarpebhyo namo namaḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śeṣa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca । ।87।।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।
athā'gnidakṣamadhyasthe stambhe skandaṃ tu ṣaṇmukham ।।88 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi kārtikeyaṃ hi śāṃkaram ।
sarvatattvabrahmavidaṃ mayūrasthaṃ namāmi ca ।।8 9 ।।
āgaccha śarajanma tvaṃ navame stambhake viśa ।
devasenāpate gāgeyaka vāhneyaka prabho ।। 2.148.90 ।।
oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyansamudrāduta vā purīṣāt ।
śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhu upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te'rvan ।। 91 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skanda ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।। 92।।
dakṣanairṛtyāntarālastaṃbhe vāyuṃ prāṇaṃ dehinām ।
kṛṣṇamṛgasamārūḍhaṃ sarvādhāraṃ dhvajāyudham ।। 93 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi sadāgatim ।
āgacchātra vāyudeva daśame staṃbhake viśa ।। 94।।
oṃ vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirāgahi ।
niyutvānsomapītaye prāṇītyadabhramātmasu ।। 95।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।। 96 ।।
nairṛtyakoṇake staṃbhe somaṃ vai rātrināyakam ।
śaśinaṃ rudraśīrṣasthaṃ śvetaṃ kṣīrodaputrakam ।। 97।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi suśītalam ।
āgacchātra somadevaikādaśastaṃbhake viśa ।।98 ।।
oṃ āpyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam ।
bhavāvvājasya saṃgathe'mṛtavarṣī prapoṣitā । । 99 । ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ somadeva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ । । 2.148.100 । ।
nirṛtipaścamadhyasthe staṃbhe tu varuṇaṃ suram ।
kuṃbhīrathasamārūḍhaṃ pāśahastaṃ samujjvalam । । 101 । ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi jaleśvaram ।
āgacchātra varuṇeśa dvādaśastaṃbhake viśa । । 102 । ।
om imamme varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya ।
tvāmavasyurācake tṛṭprabhāhan vipāśakṛt । । 103 ।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ । । 10 4। ।
paścavāyvorantarāle staṃbhe'ṣṭavasusattamān ।
aśvasthān puṣpamālādyairdhanasmṛddhyā samanvitān । । 105 । ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi vasubhṛtān ।
atrāgacchata vasavo viśantu ca trayodaśe । । 106 । ।
oṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ
vasoḥ pavitramasi sahasradhāram ।
devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ
pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supvā kāmadhukṣaḥ । । 107 । ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vasavo ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇantu vo namaḥ । । 108 । ।
vāyustaṃbhe dhanadaṃ sayakṣaṃ narayānaṃ gadādharam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi kuberakam । । 109 । ।
atrāgaccha ca dhanada viśa staṃbhe caturdaśe ।
oṃ vayaṃ somavrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ । । 2.148.110 । ।
prajāvantaḥ sacemahi svarṇavantoḥ bhavemahi ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhanada ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca । । 111 । ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।
vāyūttarāntarālasthastaṃbhaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ gurum । । 112।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi girāṃ nidhim ।
atrāgaccha bṛhaspate staṃbhe pañcadaśe viśa । । 11 3। ।
oṃ bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhādyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu ।
yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtapprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram । । 11 4। ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bṛhaspate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ । । 11 5।।
uttareśānayormadhyestaṃbhe tu viśvakarmakam ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi praṇamāmi sutejasam ।। 116।।
śvetaṃ śilpakalāḍhyaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ ca sanātanam ।
atrāgaccha viśvakarman staṃbhe ṣoḍaśake viśa । । 117
oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravarddhayam ।
tasmai viśaḥ samanamantapūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathāsat । । 118
o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viśvakarmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ । । 119
ityevaṃ ṣoḍaśastaṃbhān pūjayed rādhike dharān ।
yadāha bhagavān kṛṣṇastatte proktaṃ mayātra ca । । 2.148.120
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā dvitīye tretāsantāne devapratiṣṭhāne catuṣṣaṣṭiyoginīpañcāśatkṣetrapālamaṇḍapī ṣoḍaśastaṃbhadevāvāhanapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 148 । ।

adhyāyaḥ 149
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 150 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! paścād bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
devāyatanabhaktāya yajjagāda vadāmi te । 1 ।
oṃ nāgamātre nama iti balikāṣṭhāni pūjayet ।
candanaṃ kusumaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet ।2 ।
oṃ sarvebhyo nama iti śākhodbandhanamarcayet!
candanaṃ kusumaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamarpayet । 3।
nirgatya paścimadvārāt pūrvadvārasya toraṇam ।
pūjayenmaṇḍapātpūrve hastamātre bahiḥśubham ।4 ।
aśvatthaṃ sudṛḍhākhyaṃ sindūravarṇaṃ hi toraṇam ।
mahendraparvatayutaṃ śaṃkhākitaṃ hi pūjayet ।5 ।
oṃ aśvatthatoraṇaṃ cainaṃ yajñaṃ rakṣa prarakṣya ca ।
sarvān vighnān vārayā'tra sthitaṃ sthiraṃ namāmi te । 6।
oṃ agnimīle purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam ।
hotāraṃ ratnadhātamaṃ rakṣa maṇḍapasārthakam ।7 ।
oṃ ṛgvedādhiṣṭhitāya sudṛḍhatorāṇāya ca ।
namaḥ sudṛḍhatoraṇa cāvāhayāmi te namaḥ ।8 ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ।
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa dṛṇatoraṇa te namaḥ ।9।
omatra tiṣṭhate kṛtayugāya ca namo namaḥ ।
kṛtaṃ yugaṃ toraṇe cāvāhayāmi ca te namaḥ ।2.149.10 ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ।
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa satyayuga ca te namaḥ । 11।
tatraiva rāhave nama āvāhayāmi rāhukam ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ।12।
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa rāho deva ca te namaḥ ।
bṛhaspataye nama āvāhayāmi bṛhaspatim ।। 1 3।।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ।
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gṛhṇa bṛhaspate ca te namaḥ ।। 14।।
tatraikaṃ kalaśaṃ dhṛtvā mahīṃ spṛṣṭvā manuṃ vadet। ।

oṃ syonā pṛthivī no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśinī ।। 28 ।।

u śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ ।

nihotā satsi barhiṣi iti gandhādibhistadā ।
sampūjyendrāya ca sāma gāyato dvau sugītikam ।। 1 25।।
ahamasmi prathamajā setūṃ starā svadiṣṭyā ।
gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ dvārapālajapo bhavet ।। 1 26।।
makarasthaṃ pāśahastaṃ dhyātvā ca varuṇaṃ sitam ।
ehi yādo'psaromeghavidyādhraiḥ pāhi te namaḥ ।। 1 27।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
kalaśayoḥ sāṃgamāvāhayāmi tvāṃ namāmi ca ।। 1 28।।
tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ।
aheḍamāno varuṇeha boddhyuruśaṃsaḥ mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ ।। 1 29।।
varuṇāya namaḥ saṃpūjayāmi gandhavastubhiḥ ।
imamme varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya ।। 2.149.130 ।।
tvāmavasyurācake śvetapatākādhvajāvucchrayet ।
natvā ca varuṇaṃ jayaṃ vijayaṃ dvāraśākhayoḥ ।। 131 ।।
ūrdhvaṃ śriyaṃ gaṇapatim adhaśca dehalīṃ tathā ।
vāstupuṃsaṃ staṃbhayornandinaṃ candraṃ namāmi ca ।। 1 32।।
revāyai narmadāyai ca kalaśayornamāmi ca ।
pūjayāmi varuṇaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ māṣayugbalim ।। 133।।
arpayāmi tato gatvā vāyavyāṃ kalaśaṃ dade ।
puṣpadantaṃ ca siddhārthaṃ cāhvayāmi namāmi ca ।। 1 34।।
pūjayāmi pradīpaṃ ca dadāmi cintaye'nilam ।
mṛgasthaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ca citrāmbaraṃ ca cañcalam ।। 1 35।।
varadhvajadharaṃ dakṣavāmayoḥ karayostataḥ ।
ehi yajñe rakṣaṇāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa ca te namaḥ ।। 1 36।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
praṇamāmi vahnisakhaṃ pūjayāmi manuṃ gṛṇan ।। 137।।
oṃ āno niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ
sahasriṇībhirupayāhi yajñam ।
vāyo asmin savane mādayasva
yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ।। 138।।
oṃ vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirāgahi ।
niyutvānsomapītaye dhūmrapatākādhvajāvucchrayet ।। 1 39।।
vāyuṃ namāmi sāṃgāya dadāmi māṣayugbalim ।
gatvottare pratiśākhaṃ nidhāya kalaśadvayam ।। 2.149.140।।
tatra sārvabhaumadiggajamāhvayāmi te namaḥ ।
dīpaṃ dadāmi cātharvavedinau dvārapālakau ।।।141।।।
bṛhannetro'tharvavedo hyanuṣṭup rudradaivataḥ ।
vaṃśapāyana viprendra ṛtvik tvaṃ me makhe bhava।। 142।।
vṛtveti śanno devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu prītaye ।
śaṃyyorabhisravantu naḥ gandhādyairarcayāmi ca ।। 143 ।
atharvāgirasaṃ caiva atharvaśirasaṃ tathā ।
śāntyādhyāyamityādidvārapālajayo bhavet। ।। 1 44।।
narayānasthamābhūṣaṃ vastragadākaradvayam ।
haritābhaṃ kuberaṃ ca dhyāyāmi pūjayāmi ca ।। 145।।
ehi vidhatsva rakṣāṃ no nakṣatrauṣadhipitṛbhiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kubera ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 46।।
oṃ vayarṭha somavrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ ।
prajāvantaḥ sacemahi namāmi pūjayāmi ca ।। 147।
oṃ āpyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam ।
bhavā vājasya saṃgathe haritau patākādhvajāvucchrayet ।। 148।
kuberāya tu somāya namāmi dvāraśākhayoḥ ।
pracaṇḍāya ca caṇḍāya namo dvāraśriyai namaḥ ।। 149।
gaṇeśāya namaścādho dehalyai ca namo namaḥ ' ।
vāstupuṃse stambhayostu mahākālāya bhṛṃgiṇe ।। 2.149.150 ।
namaḥ kalaśayorvāruṇyai veṇyai ca namo namaḥ ।
namaḥ śrīkalaśāyā'stu tatsthasurebhya oṃ namaḥ ।। 151।
kuberasomarūpāya sāṃgāya māṣayugbalim ।
dadāmi yāmi caiśānyāṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayāmi ca ।। 1 52।
supratīkāya ca tatra maṃgalāya namo'rcaye ।
dadāmi dīpakaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ vastriśūlakam ।। 153 ।
dakṣavāmakarayośca dadhataṃ tryakṣamujjvalam ।
dhyāyāmīśānadevaṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।।।154
ehi yajñasya siddhyarthaṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo'stu te ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśāna ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca।।।155
oṃ tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ
dhiyaṃ jinvamavase hūmahe vayam ।
pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasadvṛddhe-
rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye ।156
iti saṃpūjya ca natvā śūlapāṇiṃ trinetrakam । ।
tamīśāneti mantreṇa pañcavarṇapatākādhvajāvucchrayet ।। 157
sāṃgāyeśānakāyemaṃ māṣayugbalimarpaye ।
īśānapūrvayormadhye ūrdhvamuddiśya vai ghaṭam ।। 158
nidhāya tatra brahmāṇaṃ pūjayed gandhavastubhiḥ ।
akṣasūtrakuśamuṣṭidharadakṣiṇahastakam ।।। 159
sruvakamaṇḍaludharavāmakaraṃ caturmukham ।
śmaśrulaṃ jaṭilaṃ cājaṃ dhyāyāmi pūjayāmi ca ।। 2.149.160
ehi sarvapitaryajñe śivaṃ vidhehi no makhe ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 161 ।।
oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād
visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ ।
savudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ
santaśca yonirasataśca vivaḥ ।। 162।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ raktapatākādhvajāvucchrayet ।
natvā taṃ brahmaṇe māṣabhaktabaliṃ dadāmi ca ।। 163 ।।
tato nirṛtivaruṇāntarāle nyasya vai ghaṭam ।
tatrā'dho'nantaśayanāsīnaṃ phaṇābhimaṇḍitam ।। 164।।
padmaśaṃkhadharordhvādhodakṣiṇahastakadvayam ।
nīlaṃ cānantakaṃ dhyātvā ehītyāvāhayet tataḥ ।। 165।।
rakṣa nāgābhipūjyāṃ'ghre'dhvaraṃ nastaladhṛk prabho ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ananta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 166।।
āvāhayāmi sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ saśaktikam ।
oṃ āyaṃ gauḥ praśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ ।। 167।।
pitaraṃ ca priyaṃssvaḥ anantāya namo namaḥ ।
āyaṃgauriti dhūmrau patākādhvajau samucchrayet ।। 168।।
anantāya ca sāṃgāya māṣayugbalimarpayet ।
tato maṇḍapamadhye cāmarakiṃkiṇikāyutaḥ ।। 169।।
ṣoḍaśahastako daṇḍo daśahastamito'pi vā ।
trihastalambahastāyapañcavarṇadhvajānvitaḥ ।। 2.149.170।।
omindrasya vṛṣṇo iti mantreṇordhvaṃ dhṛto bhavet ।
brahmayajñānamiti ca brahmāṇaṃ pūjayet tataḥ ।। 171 ।।
namet ṣoḍaśastambhasthadevān dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
vaṃśeṣu kinnarebhyaḥ pannagebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhake namaḥ ।। 172।।
pūjayitvā ca tān pūrvadiśi bhūmiṃ vilipya ca ।
maṇḍapād bahiretasyāmupaviśya vadenmakhī ।। 173 ।।
caturdaśastaravāsā jāḍāścetanavargakāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇuharavyāptā rakṣantu ca makhaṃ hi naḥ ।। 174।।
siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā āsurarākṣasāḥ ।
dānavā yakṣagandharvā bhūtāḥ piśācakādayaḥ ।। 175।।
mānavāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaśca pādapajātayaḥ ।
sūkṣmadehāḥ sarpagaṇā makhaṃ rakṣantu nastathā ।। 176।।
sarve devā īśvarāśca īśvarāṇyaśca bhūmipāḥ ।
kṣetrapā lokapāḥ sarve makhaṃ rakṣantu maṇḍapam ।। 177।।
ghnantu vighnān duritāँśca virodhinaśca vai makhe ।
sthāvarāṇi carāṇyāvāhayāmi pūjayāmi ca ।। 178।।
namāmi saṃsmarāmyeva brahmaṇe viṣṇave namaḥ ।
devebhyo dānavebhyaśca gandharvebhyo namo namaḥ ।। 179।।
siddharṣibhyaśca pitṛbhya āsurebhyo namo namaḥ ।
rākṣasebhyaśca yakṣebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo namaḥ ।। 2.149.180।।
piśācebhyo mānavebhyaḥ paśupakṣibhya ityapi ।
śākhibhyaḥ sūkṣmadehebhyaḥ sarpebhyaśca namo namaḥ ।। 181 ।।
īśebhyaśceśvarāṇībhyo bhūmipebhyo namo namaḥ ।
kṣetrapebhyo lokapebhyo namaḥ sthiracarādaye ।। 182।।
mātṛbhyo brahmasatībhyo namaścāvāhayāmi tān ।
pūjayāmi smarāmyetān dadāmi yogyabhājanam ।। 183 ।।
māṣabaliṃ pāyasādīn phalā'mṛtādikaṃ tathā ।
iti pūjāṃ vidhāyaiva sarvebhyo vai namo namaḥ ।। 184।।
yajamānastathā''cāryaḥ ṛtvik dhautāṃghrihastakāḥ ।
ācāntāḥ pūrvadvāreṇa praviśeyurhi maṇḍapam ।। 185।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne toraṇakalaśadvāraśākhādehalītaddevādīnāṃ ṣoḍaśopacārapūjanādinirūpaṇanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 149 ।।
