adhyāyaḥ 150
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 151 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yat kartavyaṃ tadāha ca ।
anādiśrīharirbhaktāya tvā sarva vadāmi tat ।। 1 ।।
śuddhimān yajamānaśca dakṣiṇadvārasannidhau ।
paścimāṃśe udaṅmukhaścopaviśya dvijostataḥ ।। 2 ।।
kurudhvaṃ tu kratoḥ karma yathāvihitamādarāt ।
ityarthayet tataḥ pūrvakuṇḍe ṛgvedinau dvijau ।। 3 ।।
hotārābupaviśetā brahmā tu paścimānanaḥ ।
homakartā'paraścodaṅmukhastataśca dakṣiṇi ।। 4 ।।
kuṇḍe yajurvedinau ca brahmā tatra hyudaṅamu'khaḥ ।
pūrvamukho homakartā tataḥ paścimakuṇḍake ।। 5 ।।
sāmavedidvijāvuttarakuṇḍe'tharvavedinau ।
tathā'parau jāpaka1 dvau śāyapyadhikabhūsurau ।। 6 ।।
tattadvedavidau copaviśetāṃ vai yathāsanam ।
tata ācārya indreśānayormadhye svakuṇḍake ।। 7 ।।
upāviśet prāṅmukho'tha brahmā tūdaṅmukhastathā ।
guruḥ svakuṇḍe āgatya svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ ।। 8 ।।
agniṃ saṃsthāpayet pañcakuṇḍike'nye'pi tattathā ।
kuryuścāgnisthāpanaṃ caikakuṇḍe tu yathāyatham ।। 9 ।।
ācāryaḥ prāṅmukho brahmodaṅmukhaḥ samupāviśet ।
prathamaṃ kuṇḍapūjāṃ ca kuryādvai yajamānakaḥ ।। 2.150.1 0।।
svayamagneścāyatanādupaviśya ca dakṣiṇe ।
ācāryaścopaviśyaiva kuṇḍapaścimatastadā ।। 1 1।।
ācamya ca tathā prāṇānāyamya ca tato vadet ।
apasarpantu ye bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ ।। 12।।
ye bhūtā vighnakartāro dūraṃ yāntu makhakṣiteḥ ।
vikīrya sarṣapān pañcagavyena prokṣya maṇḍapam ।। 1 3।।
kuṇḍaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhārān gurubhyo nama āvadet ।
gaṇeśaṃ sampraṇamyāpi kare dhṛtvā'kṣatādikam ।। 14।।
gandhapuṣpajalādyaṃ ca deśakālau prakīrtya ca ।
tadetaddevaprāsādotsargakarmaṇi bhāvataḥ ।। 15।।।
kariṣye'gnipratiṣṭhāṃ ca tadaṃgamārjanādikam ।
mekhalāyonidevānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।। 16।।
tataścāgnerāyatanaṃ saṃmṛjya kuśavāriṇā ।
kuṇḍaṃ prokṣyā'ñjalau puṣpāṇyādāya kuṇḍamāspṛśet ।। 17।।
āvāhayāmi tatkuṇḍaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam ।
śārīraṃ yacca te divyamagnyadhiṣṭhānamadbhutam ।। 18।।
ye ca kuṇḍe sthitā devāḥ kuṇḍāgre yāśca devatāḥ ।
ṛddhiṃ yacchantu tāḥ sarvā yajñasiddhiṃ samāhitāḥ ।। 19।।
he kuṇḍa vāñchitāṃ yajña siddhiṃ dadātu no hitām ।
iti prārthya kuṇḍamadhye viśvakarmāṇamarcayet ।।2.150.20।।
oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravaddhyam।
tasmai viśaḥ samanamaṃta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathā sat ।। 21 ।।
upayāma gṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇaḥ ।
eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe oṃ namaḥ ।।22।।
sampūjya candanādyaiśca prārthayet khātaśuddhaye ।
jñātā'jñātakhātadoṣān vināśaya namo'stu te ।।23।।
śvetāyāṃ mekhalāyāṃ śrīviṣṇumāvāhayettataḥ ।
oṃ viṣṇo yajñarakṣārthaṃ kuṇḍe sannihito bhava ।। 24।।
auṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam ।
samūḍhamasya pāṇḍure svāhā'rcayāmi cakriṇam ।।25।।
sampūjya śrīhariṃ viṣṇumekhalāyai namo namaḥ ।
śvetādyamekhalāmā''rcya tato raktāṃ tu madhyamām ।।26।।
mekhalāṃ tatra brahmāṇaṃ cāvāhayet manuṃ gṛṇan ।
haṃsastho yajñarakṣārthaṃ kuṇḍe'smin sannidho bhava ।। 27।।
oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād
visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ ।
sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ
sataśca yonirasataśca vvivaḥ ।।28।।
brahmāṇamitisampūjya mekhalāyai namo namaḥ ।
raktāṃ brahmādhiṣṭhitāṃ ca mekhalāṃ pūjayenmakhī ।।29।।
tato'dho mekhalāyāṃ tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ rudrameva ca ।
āvāhayāmi vṛṣagaṃ gaṃgādharaṃ pinākinam ।।2.150.3 0।।
āgaccha bhagavan rudra kuṇḍe'smin sannidho bhava ।
oṃ namaste rudra mannyava uto'ta iṣave namaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
bāhubhyāmuta te namo mekhalāyai namo namaḥ ।
rudradevāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ mekhalāṃ pūjayenmakhī ।।32।।
kuṇḍe trikoṇe vṛtte ṣaṭkoṇe padme'ṣṭakoṇake ।
yoniryojyā paścime'gryaṃ bhavetpūrvamukhaṃ tathā ।।33 ।।
koṇe kuṇḍe yonikuṇḍe yoniḥ kāryā na sarvathā ।
kṣetrārdhamānalambā ca kṣetryaṃśāyatā tathā ।।34।।
caturviṃśatyaṃśordhvā ca samekhalā'granimnagā ।
praviṣṭā kuṇḍamagrerdhagoladvayayutā tathā ।। 35।।
viśālamūlā samadhyanālā'śvatthadalākṛtiḥ ।
brahmā''dhānasvarūpā sā pūjanīyā hi kuṇḍake ।।36।।
namo jagaddhetukāyai brahmadhātryai ca te namaḥ ।
oṃ sarvasya yonirasi sarvasya nābhirapyasi ।।37।।
gandhādibhiḥ pūjayāmi prārthayāmīṣṭasiddhaye ।
dehinastvāṃ prasevante puruṣārthān yunakti yā ।।38।।
yonirbrāhmī sukhadāyai brahmagarbhe ca te namaḥ ।
iti yoniṃ samarcyātha kaṇṭhapūjanamācaret ।।3 9।।
sragdharaṃ cottamāṃgasyādhāramāvāhayāmi ca ।
nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ ।।2.150.40 ।।
teṣāṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasi ca ।
iti sampūjya gandhādyaiḥ prārthayet kaṇṭhamujjvalam ।।41 ।।
kaṇṭha kuṇḍe sthito'bhito mekhalā''ste'si maṃgalaḥ ।
tata nābhiṃ pūjayecca kuṇḍābhāṃ padmabhāṃ ca vā ।।42।।
ādhārāṃ sarvakuṇḍānāṃ nābhimāvāhayāmi ca ।
nābhirme cittavijñānaṃ pāyurme'pacitirbhasat ।।43।।
ānandavandāvāṇḍau me bhagaḥ saubhāgyaṃpasaḥ ।
jaṃghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo'si viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।।44।।
iti sampūjya nābhe tvaṃ sadevā kuṇḍake sthitā ।
bhava śubharddhidetyabhyarthya ca natvā punastataḥ ।।45।।।
kuṇḍe nairṛtakoṇe vāstupuruṣaṃ prapūjayet ।
puṣpāṇyādāyāhvayāmi vāstuṃ prapūjayāmi ca ।।46।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyasmān
svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ ।
yattvemahe pratitanno juṣasva
śanno'bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ।।47।।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ cārpayāmi ca ।
vāstupuruṣarūpāya baliṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।48।।
brahmaputraṃ rudraputraṃ sarvadevāśrayaṃ naram ।
vāstuṃ natvā tato'gniṃ sthāpayet kramānmakhī yathā ।।49।।
tuṣakeśakaṃkarādihīne kuṇḍe ca vā tathā ।
sthaṇḍile tu caturasrā bhūmiṃ samūhya satkuśaiḥ ।।2.150.50।।
īśānyāṃ ca kuśān tyaktvopalipyayā gomayodakeḥ ।
sphyena vā sruvamūlena prāgagradeśamātrakam ।।51 ।।
uttarottarakramatastrirullikhya tatastathā ।
ullekhanakrameṇaivā'nāmikāṃguṣṭhacipyayā ।।52।।
mṛdamuddhṛtya ca jalenābhyukṣya kāṃsyapātragam ।
vahniṃ kāṃsyā'nyapātreṇā'pihitaṃ pratyaṅānanam ।।53।।
upasamādhāya gāyatrīmantreṇābhipūjya ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvassvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi ।।54।।
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayād vahniṃ cāpūjayāmi ca ।
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ।।55।।
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayād vahniṃ namāmi cintaye ।
tataśca yonimārgeṇa sthāpayet kuṇḍake'nalam ।।56।।
oṃ agnirmūrddhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam ।
apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati iti gṛṇan nidhāpayet ।।57।।
agneśca jīvanārthaṃ ca kiñcit samidh niyujya ca ।
vahnipātre jalādi kṣepayet tataśca vai śubham ।।।58।।।
ācāryakuṇḍakāyuddharaṇaṃ kuṇḍāntareṣu ca ।
agnisthāpanamādadhyāt tato navagrahārcanam ।।59।।
īśānyāṃ gṛhapīṭhe tu navagrahāhvanaṃ caret ।
raktapuṣpākṣatairmadhye vartulākārake ravim ।।2.150.60।।
prāṅmukhamāvāhayecca sthāpayecca manuṃ gṛṇan ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sūrya ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।61 ।।
oṃ ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca ।
hiraṇmayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ।।62।।
sūryāya ca namo gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmi ca ।
āgneyyāmardha candrābhe cakre śvetasumākṣataiḥ ।।63।।
candramāvāhayeddhyāyetpūjayeccandanādibhiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ candra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।64।।
oṃ imaṃ devā asapatnaṃ suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya ca ।
mahate jyeṣṭhāya mahate jānarājyāyendriyasyendriyāya ।।65 ।।
imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vaḥ ।
amī rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā ca oṃ namaḥ ।।66।।
dakṣiṇasyāṃ trikoṇe tu raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ bhaumamāvāhayecca pūjayet ।।67।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhauma ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam ।।68।।
apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati oṃ bhaumāya namo namaḥ ।
īśānyāṃ bāṇasadṛśe maṇḍale ca udaṅmukham ।। 69।।
pītapuṣpākṣataiḥ ramyairbudhamāvāhya pūjayet। ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ budha ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।2.150.70।।
oṃ udbudhya svāpneppratijāgṛhi
tvamiṣṭvā pūrte sasṛje'thāmayaṃ ca ।
asmintsadhasthe addhyuttarasmin viśve
devā yajamānaśca sīdata ।।7 1।।
uttare caturasre ca maṇḍale udaṅānanam ।
bṛhaspatiṃ pītapuṣpākṣatairāvāhayennameta ।।72।।
auṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bṛhaspate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
gandhapuṣpādibhirguruṃ pūjayāmi manuṃ gṛṇan ।।73।।
oṃ bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhāddyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu ।
yaddīdayacchavasaṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ।।74।।
pūrve pañcakoṇake ca maṇḍale prāṅmukhaṃ kavim ।
śuklapuṣpākṣateḥ śukramāvāhayetprapūjayet ।।75।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śukra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpādi saṃgṛhāṇa namāmi te ।।76 ।।
oṃ annāt parisruto rasaṃ brahmaṇā
vyapibat kṣatraṃ payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa
indrasyendriyamidaṃ payomṛtammadhu ।।77।।
paścime tu dhanustulye maṇḍale pratyaṅānanam ।
kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣataiḥ śanimāvāhayecca pūjayet ।।78।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śane cātra samāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ śanno devirabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye ।।79।।
śaṃyyorabhisravantu naḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
nairṛtye śūrpasadṛśe maṇḍale dakṣiṇānanam ।।2.150.80।।
kṛṣṇapūṣpākṣataiḥ rāhumāvāhayecca pūjayet ।
o bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rāho cātrāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।8 1 ।।
oṃ kayānaścitra ābhuvadūtīsadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā ।
kayā śaciṣṭhayāvṛtā pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।।82।।
vāyavyāṃ ca dhvajākāre maṇḍale dakṣiṇānanam ।
dhūmrapuṣpākṣataiḥ ketumāvāhayecca pūjayet ।।83।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ keto ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśomaryā apeśase ।।84।।
samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
athādhidevatā āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।।85।।
ādityābhimukhāḥ sthāpyā devatā madhyake raviḥ ।
dakṣapārśve śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ rudraṃ samāhvayet ।।86।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudra samāgaccheha tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam ।।87।।
urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt ।
āgneyyāṃ candradakṣe ca raktapuṣpākṣatairumām ।।88।।
āvāhayet sthāpayecca pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ ।
oṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ ume ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।89।।
oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre
pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam ।
iṣṇanniṣāṇāmummaiiṣāṇa
sarvalokammaiṣāṇa umāyai namaḥ ।।2.150.90।।
yāmyāṃ bhaumasya dakṣe tu pītapuṣpā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।
skandamāvāhayetsaṃpūjayennamecca saṃsmaret ।।9 1।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ skanda ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyādi gṛhāṇa ca ।।92।।
oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānaḥ
udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt ।
śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū
upastutyaṃ mahijātante arvvan ।।93 ।।
īśānyāṃ budhadakṣe tu viṣṇuṃ pītasumā'kṣataiḥ ।
āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇorāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।।94।।
oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam ।
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā ca viṣṇave namaḥ ।।95।।
uttare tu gurordakṣe śvetapuṣpākṣatairajam ।
āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।।96।।
oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvisīmataḥ suruco vvena āvaḥ।
sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonirasataśca vvivaḥ ।।97।।
pūrvasyāṃ śukradakṣe tu pītapuṣpākṣaterharim ।
āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।।98।।
oṃ trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ
havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram ।
hvayāmi śakrampuruhūtamindraṃ
svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ।।99।।
paścime śanidakṣe ca kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣatairyamam ।
āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।। 2.150.1 00।।
oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryyasya tvā tapase ।
devastvā savitāmaddhānaktupṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi ।। 101 ।।
arccirasi śocirasi tapo'si yama te namaḥ ।
rāhordakṣe ca nairṛtyāṃ kālaṃ dhūmrasumākṣataiḥ ।। 1 02।।
āvāhayed bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kāla āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ kārṣirasi samudrasya tvā kṣityā unnayāmi ।। 1 03।।
samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhībhiroṣadhīḥ kāla te namaḥ ।
vāyavyāṃ ketudakṣe tu raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।। 1 04।।
āvāhayeccitraguptamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ citrāvaso svasti te pāramaśīya ।। 1 05।।
pūjayāmīti vai rādhe'dhidevatāsamarcanam ।
śrīhariḥ prāha bhaktāya yattanmayā ta īritam ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne agnisthāpanakuṇḍadevamekhalādevayonivahnipūjanaṃ navagrahapūjanamadhidevatāpūjanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 150 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 150 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 151
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 152 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devāyatāya prāha yaddhariḥ ।
pratyadhidevatādyāvāhanādyaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
madhye sūryasya vai vāme raktapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca agnimāvāhayāmyetiṣṭha ca ।। 2 ।।
oṃ agniṃ dūtaṃ purodadhe havyavāhamupabruve ।
devānāsādayayādiha agne'rcayāmi te namaḥ ।। 3 ।।
āgneyyāṃ candravāme ca śvetapuṣpākṣatairjalam ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca jalamāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 4 ।।
oṃ apsvagne'sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranuruddhyase ।
garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ jalā'rcayāmi te namaḥ ।। 5 ।।
dakṣiṇe bhaumapārśve tu bhūmiṃ raktasumā'kṣataiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kṣite cāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 6 ।।
oṃ syonā pṛthivī no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśinī ।
yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ bhūme'rcayāmi te namaḥ ।। 7 ।।
īśānyāṃ budhavāme ca viṣṇuṃ pītasumā'kṣataiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo āhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 8 ।।
oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā vai nidadhe padam ।
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure viṣṇo'rcayāmi te namaḥ ।। 9 ।।
uttare guruvāme ca indraṃ pītasumākṣataiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indra āhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 2.151.1 0।।
oṃ sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ
somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān ।
jahi śatrūँrapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ
kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ ।। 11 ।।
pūrve śukrasya ca vāme pītasumākṣataiḥ śacīm ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ indrāṇyāhvayāmyehi pratiṣṭha ca ।। 12।।
oṃ adityai rāsnāsīndrāṇyā uṣṇīṣaḥ ।
pūṣāsi gharmmāya dīṣvendrāṇyarcayāmi te namaḥ ।। 13।।।
paśce vāme śaneḥ śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ prajāpatim ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ prajāpate hvayāmye hi tiṣṭha ca ।। 14।।
oṃ prajāpate na ttvadetānnyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paritā babhūva ।
yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ।। 15।।
rāhorvāme ca nairṛtyāṃ nāgaṃ kṛṣṇasumākṣataiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nāgā''vāhayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 16।।
oṃ namo'stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu ।
ye'ntarīkṣe ye divi tebhyo'rcayāmi vo namaḥ ।। 17।।
ketorvāme ca vāyavyāmajaṃ śvetasumākṣataiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannāhvayāmyehi tiṣṭha ca ।। 18।।
oṃ vrahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād visīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ ।
sabudhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vvivaḥ ।। 1 9।।
atha cāvāhayet pañcalokapālān surakṣakān ।
nairṛtyāmuttare rāhoḥ pītapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।।2.151.20।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇeśaṃ hvayāmyehi ca tiṣṭha ca ।
gandhapuṣpākṣatairnaivedyairabhyarcya namāmi te ।।21 ।।
oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe
priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe ।
nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe
vaso mama gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmi ca ।।22।।
āhamajāni garbhadhamāttvamajāsi garbhadham ।
śanyuttare paścime ca durgāṃ raktasumā'kṣataiḥ ।।23।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durge hrayāmyehi ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi praṇamāmi sukhaṃ kuru jane namaḥ ।।24।।
oṃ jātavedase sunavāma
somamarātīyato nijahāti vedaḥ ।
sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā
nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ ।।25।।
madhye sūryottare vāyuṃ pītapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।26।।
oṃ ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinī-
bhiruddharaṃ sahasriṇībhirupayāhi yajñam ।
vāyo asmin savane mādayasva
yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ।।27।।
pūrve śukrapūrvabhāge hyākāśaṃ nīmapuṣpakaiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ ākāśa āgacchātra ca tiṣṭha ca ।।28।।
oṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata vasāṃ vasa
pāvānaḥ pibatāntarikṣasya havirasi svāhā ।
diśaḥ pradiśaḥ ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo
digbhyaḥ svāhā pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।।29।।
rāhordakṣe ca nairṛtyāṃ śvetapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svo'śvināvihāgacchata tiṣṭhatam ।।2.151.30।।
oṃ yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī ।
tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatāmaśvinau pūjayāmi ca ।।31।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ devān prārpya namāmi ca ।
atha pūrvādikāṣṭhāsu cendrādīnāhvayenmakhī ।।32।।
pūrve oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścendra ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।33।।
āgneyyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaragne āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।34।।
dakṣiṇe oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yama cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।35।।
nairṛtyāmoṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛte caihi tiṣṭhā ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।36।।
paścime oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।37।।
vāyavyāmoṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyo āgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।38।।
uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kuberāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।39।।
īśānyāmoṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।2.151.40 ।।
īśānapūrvayormadhye brahmāṇamāhvayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannatrāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।41 ।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
nirṛtivāruṇamadhye'nantaṃ hvayāmi naumi ca ।।।42।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścānanta ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।।43।।
atha maṇḍalamadhyasthapitāmahādi cāhvayet। ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।44।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ śiva ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।45।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇo ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।46।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇapate ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।47।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ lakṣmi ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।48।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatīmapiyanti sasrotasaḥ ।।49।।
sarasvatī tu pañcadhā sā vai deśe'bhavat sarit ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sarasvati ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।2.151.50।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ ambe'mbike'mbālike na mā nayati kaścana ।।51।।
sasastyaśvakaḥ śubhadrikāṃ kāṃpīlavāsinīm ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durge ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।52।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kṣetrapāla ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।53।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhūtāni ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।।54।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viśvakarmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।55।।
pūjayāmi ca gandhādyaiḥ saṃsmarāmi namāmi ca ।
deśakālau prasaṃkīrtya yajñasiddhyarthamuttamam ।। 56।।
karomi pūjanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ candanādibhiḥ ।
oṃ sūryādinavagrahebhyo namaḥ śāntidā hi naḥ ।।57।।
oṃ rudrādidevatābhyo namaḥ rakṣāpradā hi naḥ ।
omagnyādidevatābhyo namastejaḥpradā hi naḥ ।।58।।
oṃ gaṇeśādilokaprapālebhyo nama iṣṭadāḥ ।
omindrādidikprapālebhyo namaḥ puṣṭidā hi naḥ ।।।59।।
brahmādiviśvakarmāntebhyo namaḥ sampadāṃpradāḥ ।
iti sampūjya ca makhī grahavedīsamīpataḥ ।।2.151.60 ।।
bhūmau tattannāmamantrairbaliṃ dadyācca tadyathā ।
guḍaudanaṃ tu sūryāya somāya ghṛtapāyasam ।।6 1 ।।
masūrānnaṃ maṃgalāya budhāya kṣīramodanam ।
dadhyodanaṃ tu gurave śukrāya ca ghṛtaudanam ।।62।।
śanaye tilapiṣṭaṃ ca pāyasaṃ rāhave tathā ।
citraudanaṃ ketave ca hyanyebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ balim ।।63।।
datvā tataścaiśakoṇe kalaśaṃ sthāpayenmakhī ।
oṃ bhūrasītimantreṇa bhūmisparśanamācaret ।।64।।
oṃ dhānyamasīti manunā bhūmau dhānyaṃ kṣinpemakhī ।
omājighretimantreṇa dhānyopari nyased ghaṭam ।।65।।
oṃ varuṇasyetyudakaṃ ca kalaśe paripūrayet ।
oṃ vasoḥ pavitreti manunā vastraṃ kaṇṭhe ca veṣṭayet ।।66।।
oṃ yāḥ phalinīti manunā pūgīphalaṃ samarpayet ।
oṃ parivājetimanunā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ।।67।।
oṃ hiraṇyagarbheti manunā hiraṇyaṃ ca samarpayet ।
oṃ gandhadvāretimanunā gandhādikaṃ samarpayet ।।68।।
oṃ yā oṣadhīriti ca savauṣadhīḥ samakṣipet ।
aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamād hṛdāt ।।69।।
rājadvārād gokulācca mṛdamānīya nikṣipet ।
oṃ kāṇḍātkāṇḍamiti durvāṃ kalaśe tu samakṣipet ।।2.151.70।।
omaśvatthetimantreṇa pañcapallavakān kṣipet ।
oṃ pavitreṇasthamantreṇa pavitrāṇi vinikṣipet ।।71।।
oṃ pūrṇā darvīti tandulapātraṃ ca kalaśe kṣipet ।
oṃ śrīśca ta itimantreṇa śrīphalaṃ kalaśe kṣipet ।।72।।
evaṃ ghaṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya varuṇaṃ salile hvayet ।
oṃ tattvāyāmīti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ prasamāhvayet ।।73।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi namaste ca ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।।74।।
sarve samudrāḥ saritastīrthānyapi sarāṃsi ca ।
jaladāśca samāyāntu sarvadurītanāśakāḥ ।।75।।
sarve devāḥ kalaśe tu pratitiṣṭhanti pāvakāḥ ।
kalaśasya mukhe ceti kalaśaṃ cābhimantrayet ।। 76।।
devadānavamantreṇa kalaśaṃ prārthayet tataḥ ।
atha vai sarvatobhadramaṇḍalasya ca pūjanam ।। 77।।
prāgudīcyāṃ gatā rekhāḥ kuryādekonaviṃśatim ।
khaṇḍendustripadaḥ koṇe, śṛṃkhalā pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ ।।78।।
ekādaśapadā vallī bhadraṃ tu navabhiḥ padaiḥ ।
caturviṃśatpadā vāpī viṃśatyā paridhiḥ padaiḥ ।।79।।
madhye ṣoḍaśabhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ padmaṣṭadalaṃ smṛtam ।
śvetenduḥ śṛṃkhalā kṛṣṇā vallīrnīlena pūrayet ।।2.151.80 ।।
bhadrā'ruṇā sitā vāpī paridhiḥ pītavarṇakaḥ ।
bāhyāntaradalaśvetā karṇikā pītavarṇakā ।।8 1 ।।
paridhyāveṣṭitaṃ padmaṃ bāhye sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ ।
tanmadhye sthāpayeddevān brahmādyāṃśca sureśvarān ।।82।।
deśakālau ca saṃkīrtya devasthāpanakarmasu ।
sarvatobhadrake ṣaṭapañcāśaddevān samāhvayet ।।।83 ।।
gṛhītvā cākṣatānmadhye brahmāṇaṃ tu samāhvayet ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।।84।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi gṛhṇa pūjanam ।
uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ somamāvāhayāmi ca।।85।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
īśānyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānamāhvayāmi ca ।।86।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
pūrvasyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ ṣvaḥ indramāvāhayāmi ca ।।87।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
āgneyyāṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ agnimāvāhayāmi ca ।।88।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
dakṣiṇe oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yamamāvāhayāmi ca ।।89।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
nairṛtyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ nirṛtimāhvayāmi ca ।। 2.151.90।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
paścime oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇamāhvayāmi ca ।।9 1 ।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
vāyavyām oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vāyumāvāhayāmi ca ।।92।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
uttare oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ kuberamāhvayāmi ca ।।93।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
īśāne oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ īśānamāhvayāmi ca ।। 94।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmyāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।
īśānapūrvayormadhye brahmāṇamāhvayāmi ca ।।95।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ brahmannihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhado bhava ।।96।।
vāyusomāntarāle'ṣṭavasūnāvāhayāmi ca ।.
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vasava ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।।97।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।
someśānāntarāle ca rudrānāvāhayāmi ca ।।98।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ rudrā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।।99।।
īśānapūrvayormadhye ādityānāhvayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ sva ādityā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 2.151.10 0।।
indrāgnyāntarabhāge'śvikumārāvāhvayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ aśvināvihāgacchataṃ tiṣṭhatam ।। 10 1।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadau hi naḥ ।
omagniyamayormadhye viśvedevān sapitṛkān ।। 1 02।।
āhvayāmi bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitarastiṣṭhatā'tra ca ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 1 03।।
yamanairṛtayormadhye yakṣānāvāhayāmi ca ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ yakṣāḥ samāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 1 04।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।
nairṛtivaruṇāntarbhvāṃ bhūtanāgān hvayāmi ca ।। 1 05।।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhūtā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 106 ।।
tatraiva bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sarpānāhvayāmi tiṣṭhata ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 1 07।।
varuṇavāyvantare ca gandharvāpsarasastathā ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścārcayāmi smarāmi ca namāmi ca ।। 1 08।।
tatraiva bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścāpsarasaścāpi tiṣṭhata ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 1 09।।
oṃ puñjikasthalī kratusthalī cāpsarasau daṃkṣṇavaḥ ।
paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu ।। 2.151.11 0।।
brahmasomayormadhye skandaṃ śūlaṃ ca nandinam ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ sva āhvayāmi smarāmi ca namāmi ca ।। 111 ।।
pūjayāmi iha sthāne samāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
nandīśvarāya śkrāya mahākālāya vo namaḥ ।। 1 12।।
brahmeśānāntarāle ca saptaprajāpatīn śubhān ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ prajeśānā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 11 3।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।
brahmendrayormadhyabhāge durge cāgaccha tiṣṭha ca ।। 1 14।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ durgāmāhvayāmi naumyarcayāmi ca ।
durgāpūrve bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ viṣṇumāvāhayāmi ca ।। 1 15।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi naumyāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
brahmāgnyormadhyake pitṝnāhvayāmi ca tiṣṭhata ।। 1 16।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pitaraścāgacchatārcayāmi ca ।
brahmayamayormadhye ca mṛtyurogān hvayāmi ca ।। 1 17।।
oṃ paraṃ mṛtyo anupare hi panthā yaste
anya itaro devayānāt ।
cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate bravīmi mānaḥ
prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān।। 1 18।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi naumyāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
brahmanirṛtyantarāle gaṇeśaṃ cāhvayāmi ca ।। 1 19।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ gaṇeśa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhado bhava ।। 2.151.120।।
brahmavaruṇayormadhye apaścāhvayāmi ca ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ āpa ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 121 ।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।
brahmavāyavyantarāle ca maruta āhvayāmi ca ।।1 22।।
brahmapāde pṛthivīmāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pṛthivī ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 123।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā bhava ।
tatraiva saptanadyaśca ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 1 24।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca gaṃgādyāḥ pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
gaṃge ca yamune sarasvati śatadrutāpike ।। 1 25।
uṣṇā'siknī saptanadīḥ smarāmi ca namo namaḥ ।
tatraiva saptavārdhīṃśca āhvayāmi namāmi ca ।। 126।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sāgarāśca samāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi tṛptidāḥ sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 127।।
tadūrdhve merumāhvayāmyāgaccha cātra tiṣṭha ca ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca mero tvāṃ naumi me sukhado bhava ।। 128।।
atha vai maṇḍalād bāhye somādisannidhau kramāt ।
uttare tu gadāmāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।। 129।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca gade ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
īśānyāṃ tu śūlamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।। 2.151.13 0।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca śūlaka ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
pūrve vajramāhvayāmi sthāpayāmi namāmi ca ।। 131 ।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca vajra tvamihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।
āgneyyāṃ śaktimāvāhayāmi saṃsthāpayāmi ca ।। 1 32।।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścaihi cātrāgaccha tiṣṭha namāmi te ।
dakṣiṇasyāṃ daṇḍamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।। 133।।
nairṛtyāṃ khaṇḍahetiṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।
paścime pāśamāvāhayāmi saṃsthāpayāmi ca ।। 134।।
vāyavyāmaṃkuśamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi ca ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca daṇḍādyā ihāgacchata tiṣṭhata ।। 1 35।।
pūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi namāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।
tadbāhye cottare gautamamāhvayāmi naumi ca ।। 1 36।।
īśānyāṃ bhāradvājaṃ cāhvayāmi praṇamāmi ca ।
viśvāmitraṃ ca pūrvasyāmāhvayāmi namāmi ca ।। 137।।
āgneyyāṃ kaśyapamāvāhayāmi praṇamāmi ca ।
dakṣiṇe jamadagniṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।। 138।।
nairṛtyāṃ ca vaśiṣṭhaṃ cāvāhayāmi namāmi ca ।
paścime'trimāhvayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।। 139।।
vāyavyāṃ cārundhatīmāhvayāmi praṇamāmi ca ।
pūrve caindryai namaścāgnau kumāryai tu namo namaḥ ।। 2.151.140।।
dakṣe brāhmyai namo vārāhyai nairṛtyāṃ namo namaḥ ।
paścimāyāṃ cāmuṇḍāyai vaiṣṇavyai vāyuke namaḥ ।। 141।।
māheśvaryai cottare ceśāne vaināyakīśriyai ।
namaḥ prapūjayāmi saṃsmarāmi sukhadā hi naḥ ।। 142।।
ṣaḍpaṃcāśaddevagaṇānāvāhya paripūjayet ।
ityāha śrīharirbhaktadevāyatanakāya tat ।। 143।।
mayā te'bhihitaṃ rādhe ūhyā mantrāstadarthagāḥ ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyaistarpayed devatāgaṇān ।। 144।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratyadhidevatāvāhanalokapālatridevadevīgrahāvāhanādighaṭasthāpanasarvatobhadrapūjanaṣaṭpañcāśaddevapūjanādipradarśananāmaika
pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 151 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 151 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 152
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 153 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tato yadāha bhagavān bhaktaṃ rādhe vadāmi te ।
vedimadhye tu kamale tāmraghaṭaṃ nidhāpayet ।। 1 ।।
oṃ bhūrasīti vai bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā prakṣipya tandulān ।
yavān vā samiti tatra oṣadhīḥ sanniyujya ca ।। 2 ।।
omājighreti kalaśaṃ sthāpayet tatra vai sthale ।
oṃ varuṇasyetyudakaṃ kṣiptvā vastreṇa veṣṭayet ।। 3 ।।
oṃ yāḥ phalinīti pūgīphalaṃ ca pañcaratnakam ।
hiraṇyaṃ ca kṣipedgandhaṃ kṣipet sarvauṣadhīṃstathā ।। 4 ।।
kṣipet saptamṛdaścāpi dūrvā ca pañcapallavān ।
pavitrāṇi kṣipettandulasthālīṃ ca nidhāpayet ।। 5 ।।
śrīphalaṃ sannidhāyai va pratiṣṭhāpya ca devatām ।
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ varuṇa ihāgaccha ca tiṣṭha ca ।। 6 ।।
namāmi ṣoḍaśadravyaiḥ pūjayāmi ca te namaḥ ।
samprārthya tanmukhe svarṇamūrtiṃ nārāyaṇīṃ nyaset ।। 7 ।।
agnyuttāraṇapūrvāṃ cācchādya paṭṭāmbarādibhiḥ ।
ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrahakāraka ।। 8 ।।
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namo'stu te ।
oṃ viṣṇave namo madhusūdanāya namo namaḥ ।। 9 ।।
oṃ namastrivikramāya vāmanāya ca oṃ namaḥ ।
śrīdharāya nama oṃ śrīhṛṣīkeśāya oṃ namaḥ ।। 2.152.10 ।।
padmanābhāya ca namo dāmodarāya oṃ namaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namo namaḥ ।। 11 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇāya nama oṃ ca nārāyaṇāya oṃ namaḥ ।
naranārāyaṇāya oṃ namo vai haraye ca om ।। 12।।
etaiśca nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sampūjya praṇametpunaḥ ।
gururācamya ca dvārapālān gandhaiḥ samarcayet ।। 13 ।।
paṭhadhvaṃ ca yajadhvaṃ ca viprān vai prerayettathā ।
ācārya ṛtvijaḥ kuṇḍe'gniṃ smṛtvā kuryurāvidhim ।। 14।।
pratikuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍadakṣe yajamāno niṣadya ca ।
dhṛtvā kuśayavajalānyadya kālādike śubhe ।। 15।।
etaddevapratiṣṭhārthayajñakarmasvidaṃ haviḥ ।
dravyaṃ sarvagrahebhyo'dhidevatābhyaśca vai tathā ।। 16 ।।
pratyadhidevatābhyaśca lokapālebhya ityapi ।
dikpālebhyastridevebhyo gaṇeśāya tathā hyapi ।। 17।।
ambikābhūtayūthebhyastathā ca viśvakarmaṇe ।
varuṇāgnivāyusūryaprajāpatibhya ityapi ।। 18।।
sviṣṭakṛdādidevebhyaḥ sarvebhyaśca namama om ।
ityuccārya pratikuṇḍaṃ dravyatyāgaṃ samācaret ।। 19।।
jāpakānāṃ jape jāyamāne homaṃ samācaret ।
kraṇeṇa varaṇaṃ kuryād deśakālau prakīrtya vai ।।2.152.20।।
amukaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahmatvena tvāmahamāvṛṇe ।
vṛto'smīti prativākyaṃ vihitaṃ karma cācara ।।2 1।।
yathājñānaṃ karavāṇi vahnerdakṣiṇatastataḥ ।
tyaktvā paristaraṇārthabhuvaṃ datvā tu vedhase ।।22।।
vāraṇādidārurūpāsanaṃ prāgagragān kuśān ।
āsane tu samāstīrya vahnipradakṣiṇakramāt ।। 23 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ tu samānīya pratiṣṭhākarmaṇi svayam ।
brahmā bhavetyabhidhāyā''sane samupaveśayet ।।24।।
tadabhāve tu pañcāśatkuśātmakaṃ prakalpayet। ।
agneruttarataḥ prāgagrakuśairāsanadvayam ।। 25।।
kalpayitvā vāraṇaṃ dvādaśāṃgulasudīrghakam ।
caturaṃgulavistāraṃ caturaṃgulakhātakam ।।26।।
camasaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā dakṣahastasthapātragam ।
jalaṃ prapūrya ca kuśairācchādya brahmaṇo mukham ।।27।।
vīkṣyā'gneruttarataḥ paścimāsane kuśopari ।
nidadhyādvai tataḥ paristaraṇaṃ syād yathā tu tat ।।28।।
barhiṣo vai caturthāṃśaṃ dhṛtvā prāgagrakaiḥ kuśaiḥ ।
caturbhiśca caturbhiścā''gneyādīśānakāvadhim ।।29।।
brahmataścāgniparyantaṃ nairṛtyād vāyakāvadhim ।
agnitaḥ praṇītakāntaṃ paristaraṇamiṣyate ।।2.152.30।।
kṛtvā tacca tato'gneruttarataḥ paścime khalu ।
pavitracchedanārthaṃ tu kuśatrayaṃ samādadet ।।3 1।।
pavitrakaraṇārthaṃ ca dvau kuśastabakau nayet ।
vāraṇaṃ prokṣaṇīpātra dvādaśāṃguladīrghakam ।।32।।
ājyasthālī taijasī dvādaśāṃgulaviśālikā ।
prādeśoccā'tha carusthālī sammārgatridarbhikāḥ ।। 33।।
upayamakuśāstriprabhṛtayaśca samit trayam ।
pālāśyaḥ prādeśamātryaḥ sruvo hastaśca khādiraḥ ।। 34।।
ājyaṃ gavyaṃ vrīhitandulakā dravyaṃ hiraṇyakam ।
ṣaṭapaṃcāśattathā śatadvayaṃ taṇḍulamuṣṭikāḥ ।।35।।
tandulapūrṇapātra ca rakṣaṇīyāni maṇḍape ।
āsādanaṃ pavitracchittidarbhānāṃ tu pūrvataḥ ।।36।।
tataḥ kuśaistribhiścāgre hitvā prādeśamātrakam ।
dve kuśataruṇe pracchidya pavitravidhāpanam ।। 37।।
sapavitrakareṇaiva prokṣaṇīpātrake tadā ।
praṇītodakamākṣipyā'nāmikāṃ'guṣṭhacippyayā ।।38।।
uttarāgre pavitre gṛhītvā trirutyavaṃ tathā ।
prokṣaṇīpātrasya vāme haste vidhāpanaṃ tathā ।।39।।
anāmikāṃguṣṭhacippyā pavitre prāpya vai tataḥ ।
triruddiṃganamādheyaṃ tataḥ praṇītavāriṇā ।।2.152.40 ।।
prokṣaṇīprokṣaṇaṃ cātha prokṣaṇīvāriṇā tataḥ ।
ājyasthālyādīni pūrṇapātraparyantakāni vai ।।41 ।।
krameṇaikaikaśaḥ prokṣya prokṣaṇīpātrakaṃ tataḥ ।
asañcare praṇītāgnyorantarāle nidhāya ca ।।42।।
ājyamāsāditaṃ cājyasthālyāmagnestu paścake ।
nihitāyāṃ samākṣipya carusthālyāṃ tataḥ param ।।43।।
praṇītodakamāsicyā''sāditān nyasya tandulān ।
brahmā'dhiśrayati cājyaṃ taduttarataśca svayam ।।44।।
carumevaṃ ca yugapadagnāvāropya vai tataḥ ।
īṣacchṛte carau jvaladulmukaṃ tu pradakṣiṇam ।।45।।
ājyacarvoḥ samantādvai bhrāmayecca tataḥ punaḥ ।
dakṣiṇapāṇinā sruvamādāya prāñcameva ca ।।46।।
adhomukhaṃ tathā'gnau tāpayitvā savyahastake ।
kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇenaiva sammārgāgraiśca mūlataḥ ।।47।।
agraparyantakaṃ mūlairagramārabhya cāpyadhaḥ ।
saṃmṛjya mūlaparyantaṃ praṇītavāriṇā tataḥ ।।48।।
abhiṣicya punaḥ pūrvavatpratāpya ca dakṣataḥ ।
nidadhyādvai tata ājyamutthāpya pūrvataścaroḥ ।।49।।
nītvā'gneruttarataśca sthāpayitvā caruṃ tataḥ ।
utthāpyājyasya paścādvai nītvā''jyasyottarāttataḥ ।।2.152.50।।
sthāpayitvā cā''jyamagneḥ paścādānīya vai carum ।
ānīyā''jyasyottarato nidhāya pūrvavat tataḥ ।।51 ।।
pavitrābhyāmājyamutpūyā'valokya ca vai tataḥ ।
apadravyanirāsaśca punaḥ prokṣiṇikotpavaḥ ।। 52।।
tataścopayamakuśāt dakṣahastena vāmake ।
haste kṛtvā samuttiṣṭhan dhyātvā prajāpatiṃ hṛdi ।।53 ।।
tūṣṇīmagnau ghṛtāktāstrisamidhaḥ prakṣipenmakhī ।
upaviśya prokṣaṇīvāriṇā pavitrayojinā ।।54।।
dakṣiṇena culukena gṛhītenāgnimeva ca ।
īśānādyudagapavargaṃ pariṣicya vai tataḥ ।।55।।
dakṣiṇajānvavācyakuśāgreṇa brahmaṇā'pi ca ।
anvārabdho yajamānenā'nvārabdhaśca vai tataḥ ।।56।।
samiddhe'gnau sruveṇā''jyāhutīśca juhuyānmakhī ।
ādhārāttu samārabhya dvādaśāhutikāsu ca ।।57।।
tattadāhutiśeṣasya sruvalagnaghṛtasya tu ।
prokṣaṇīpātrake kṣepaḥ kartavyo vidhirīdṛśaḥ ।।58।।
homastatra yathāyogyaḥ kartavyaḥ syād yadiṣṭakaḥ ।
oṃ prajāpataye svāhedaṃ prajāpataye namama ।।59।।
omindrāya svāhedamindrāyāghārakau namama ।
omagnaye svāhedamagnaye om oṃ namama ।।2.152.6 0।।
oṃ somāya svāhedaṃ somāyājyabhāgakau namama ।
oṃ bhūḥ svāhedaṃ bhūḥ namama bhuvaḥ svāhā idaṃ bhuvaḥ ।।61।।
oṃ svaḥ svāhā idaṃ svaśca mahāvyāhṛtayastvimāḥ ।
oṃ tvanno'gneityagnivaruṇābhyāṃ ca namama om ।।62।।
oṃ satvano'gna idamagnivaruṇābhyāṃ namaśca om ।
omayāścāgne iti ca idamagnaye namaśca om ।।63।।
oṃ ye te śatamiti svāhā savitre viṣṇave idam ।
idaṃ ca viśvadevebhyo marudbhyo'rkebhya omidam ।।64।।
oṃ uduttameti ca svāhedaṃ varuṇāya namama ।
varmavad devavighnānāṃ vāraṇaṃ śāntirucyate ।।65।।
oṃ āpaḥ śivāḥ śivatamāḥ śāntāḥ
śāntatamāstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ।
evaṃ kuryāt prokṣaṇaṃ sarvakuṇḍeṣva-
gniprokṣaṇāntakaṃ karma bhūsuraiḥ ।।66।।
athā''cāryo'gniṃ saṃpūjya grahahomaṃ samācaret ।
arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiraścāpāmārgo'tha pippalaḥ ।।67।।
audumbaraḥ śamī dūrvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ।
navagrahāṇāṃ boddhavyā dadhikṣīraghṛtā''ktakāḥ ।।68।।
samidhaḥ śākalyayutā juhuyādvai gṛṇan manūn ।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā'ṣṭāviṃśatirvā'ṣṭavārakam ।।69।।
oṃ ākṛṣṇeneti vai svāhā idaṃ sūryāya vai namama ।
o imaṃ deveti vai svāhā idaṃ candramase namama ।।2.152.70।।
oṃ agniritivai svāhā idaṃ bhaumāya vai namama ।
o udvuddhyasveti svāhā idaṃ budhāya vai namama ।।7 1।।
oṃ bṛhaspate iti svāhā idaṃ bṛhaspataye namama ।
oṃ annāditi vai svāhā idaṃ śukrāya vai namama ।।72।।
o śanna iti vai svāhā idaṃ śaniścarāya namama ।
oṃ kayāna iti vai svāhā idaṃ vai rāhave namama ।।73।।
oṃ ketumiti vai svāhā idaṃ vai ketave namama ।
atha haste jalaṃ dhṛtvā homena grahadevatāḥ ।।74।।
prīyantāṃ ca namameti jalaṃ bhūmāvavāsṛjet ।
tato navagrahādhidevānāṃ homaṃ samācaret ।।75।।
pālāśya īśvarādibhyaḥ prādeśamātrikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sājyāḥ samidhaḥ pratyekaṃ cāṣṭau catasra eva vā ।।76।।
saghṛtāḥ sayavāstilā hotavyāśca vidhānataḥ ।
oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe svāhedamīśvarāya namama ।।77।।
oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca svāhedaṃ hmumāyaiḥ namama ।
oṃ yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ svāhedaṃ skandāya namama ।।78।।
oṃ viṣṇorarāṭamasi svāhedaṃ viṣṇave namama ।
oṃ brahmayajñānaṃ prathamaṃ svāhedaṃ brahmaṇe namama ।।79।।
oṃ trātāramindraṃ svāhedaṃ cendrāya namama ।
oṃ yamāya tvā makhāya svāhedṃ yamāya namama ।।2.152.80।।
oṃ kārṣirasi svāhedaṃ kālāya oṃ namama ।
oṃ citrāvaso svāhedaṃ citraguptāya namama ।।81।।
anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ cādhidevatāḥ ।
namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī ।।82।।।
atha pratyadhidevānāṃ homaḥ kramāt tataḥ param ।
oṃ agniṃ dūtamiti svāhā idaṃ tu cāgnaye namama ।।83।।
auṃ apsvagne iti svāhā idamadbhyaśca oṃ namam ।
oṃ syonāpṛthivīti svāhedaṃ dharaṇyai oṃ namama ।।84।।
oṃ viṣṇorarāṭamiti svāhedaṃ viṣṇave oṃ namama ।
oṃ sajoṣā iti svāhedaṃ cendrāya oṃ namama ।।85।।
oṃ ādityaireti svāhedamindrāṇyai oṃ namama ।
oṃ brahmayajñānamiti svāhedaṃ brahmaṇe oṃ namama ।।86।।
oṃ namo'stu iti svāhedaṃ sarpebhya oṃ namama ।
oṃ prajāpate iti svāhedaṃ prajāpataye namama ।।87।।
anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ pratyadhīśvarāḥ ।
namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjen makhī ।।88।।
atha homaḥ pañcalokapālānāṃ vidhinā tataḥ ।
oṃ gaṇānāmitisvāhedaṃ gaṇeśāya oṃ namama ।।89।।
oṃ ambe'mbālike svāhedaṃ cāmbikāyai namama ।
oṃ vāto vāmana svāhedaṃ vāyave oṃ namama ।।2.152.90।।
oṃ ghṛtaṃghṛteti svāhedaṃ ākāśāya ca oṃ namama ।
oṃ yāvāṃkaśetisvāhedaṃ aśvibhyāṃ ca oṃ namama ।।91।।
anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ lokapālakāḥ ।
namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī ।।92।।
atha homo daśadikprapālānāṃ vidhinā tataḥ ।
oṃ trātāramindraṃ svāhedaṃ cendrāya namama om ।।93।।
omagnidūtamiti svāhedaṃ cāgnaye namama om ।
oṃ yamāya tveti svāhā idaṃ yamāya vai namama ।।94।।
oṃ asunvanteti svāhā idaṃ nirṛtaye namama ।
oṃ varuṇasyeti svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama ।।95।।
oṃ vāyo ye te iti svāhā idaṃ ca vāyave namama ।
oṃ kuvidaṃ ceti svāhā idaṃ kuberāya namama ।।96।।
oṃ tamīśānamitisvāhā idamīśānāya namama ।
oṃ asmerudrā iti svāhā idaṃ vai brahmaṇe namama ।।97।।
oṃ syonā pṛthivīti svāhā idaṃ cānantāya namama ।
anena dravyahomena prīyantāṃ dikprapālakāḥ ।।98।।
namameti samuccārya jalaṃ samutsṛjenmakhī ।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ naivedyakaṃ dīpaṃ ca dhūpakam ।।19।।
arpayāmi ca tāmbūlaṃ prīyantāṃ parameśvarāḥ ।
ityevaṃ vidhinā kuryātpūjanaṃ rādhike tathā ।। 2.152.10 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha vidhānataḥ ।
devāyatanabhaktāya taduktaṃ ca mayāpi te ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kalaśataddevadvārapālapūjanaṃ, varaṇaṃ, prokṣaṇīpātrādi, caruḥ, ājyāhutiḥ, vāraṇaṃ, grahahomam, adhidevapratyadhi-
devānāṃ homaḥ, lokapāladikpālānāṃ homa, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 152।।

adhyāyaḥ 153

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhe vāstusthadevānāṃ homaṃ ca vidhinā tataḥ ।
harirbhaktāya yaṃ tvāha tathā'nyat karma vacmi te ।। 1 ।।
śikhyādibhyaśca tatrādau svāhāntāḥ praṇavādikāḥ ।
nāmabhirvedamantraiśca pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭavat ।। 2 ।।
aṣṭāviṃśatirvāṣṭau vā''hutistilājyapāyasaiḥ ।
samidbhiśca pradātavyā audumbarībhireva ca ।। 3 ।।
tadabhāve'śvatthasamidanyā madhvājyadugdhayuk ।
hotavyā ca tilāḥ kṛṣṇā vidhinā mantrapūrvakam ।। 4 ।।
oṃ śikhine ca vai svāhā idaṃ ca śikhine namama ।
oṃ parjanyāya ca svāhā idaṃ parjanyakāya ca ।। 5 ।।
oṃ jayantāya ca svāhā idaṃ jayantakāya ca ।
omindrāya ca vai svāhā idamindrāya namama ।। 6 ।।
oṃ sūryāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sūryāya namama ।
oṃ satyāya ca vai svāhā iha satyāya namama ।। 7 ।।
oṃ bhṛśāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ bhṛśāya namama ।
omākāśāya ca svāhā idamākāśakāya ca ।। 8 ।।
oṃ vāyave ca vai svāhā idaṃ vāyave namama ।
oṃ pūṣṇe ca namaḥ svāhā idaṃ pūṣṇe ca namama ।। 9 ।।
oṃ vitathāya ca svāhā idaṃ vitathāya namama ।
oṃ gṛhakṣatāya svāhā idaṃ gṛhakṣatāya ca ।। 2.153.10 ।।
oṃ yamāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ yamāya namama ।
oṃ gandharvāya ca svāhā idaṃ gandharvāya namama ।। 1 1।।
oṃ bhṛṃgarājāya svāhā idaṃ bhagāya namama ।
oṃ mṛgāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ mṛgāya namama ।। 12।
oṃ pitṛbhyaśca vai svadhā idaṃ pitṛbhyo namama ।
oṃ dauvārikāya svāhā idaṃ dauvārikāya ca ।। 13।।
oṃ sugrīvāya ca svāhā idaṃ sugrīvakāya ca ।
oṃ puṣpadantāya svāhā idaṃ puṣpāya namama ।। 14।।
oṃ varuṇāya ca svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama ।
omasurāya ca svāhā idamasurāya namama ।। 15।।
oॆ śeṣāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ śeṣāya namama ।
oṃ pāpayakṣmaṇe svāhedaṃ pāpayakṣmaṇe namama ।। 16।।
oṃ rogāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ rogāya namama ।
oṃ sarpāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sarpāya namama ।। 17।।
oṃ mukhyāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ mukhyāya namama ।
oṃ bhallāṭāya ca svāhā idaṃ bhallāṭakāya ca ।। 18।।
oṃ somāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ somāya namama ।
oṃ sarpāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ sarpāya namama ।। 19।।
omaditaye ca svāhā idamaditaye namama ।
o ditaye ca vai svāhā idaṃ ditaye namama ।।2.153.20।।
omadbhyaśca tathā svāhā ḍadamadbhyaśca namama ।
oṃ sāvitrāya ca svāhā idaṃ sāvitrāya namama ।।2 1 ।।
oṃ jayāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ jayāya namama ।
oṃ rudrāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ rudrāya namama ।।22।।
omaryamṇe ca vai svadhā idamaryamṇe namama ।
oṃ savitre ca vai svāhā idaṃ savitre namama ।।23।।
oṃ vivasvate ca svāhā idaṃ vivasvate namama ।
oṃ vibudheśāya svāhedaṃ vibudheśāya namama ।।24।।
oṃ mitrāya ca vai svāhedaṃ mitrāya ca namama ।
oṃ rājayakṣmaṇe svāhedaṃ rājayakṣmaṇe namama ।।25।।
oṃ pṛthvīdhṛge svāhā idaṃ pṛthvīdhṛge namama ।
omāpavatsāya svāhedamāpavatsāya namama ।।26।।
oṃ brahmaṇe ca vai svāhā idaṃ ca brahmaṇe namama ।
oṃ carakyai ca vai svāhā idaṃ carakyai namama ।।27।।
oṃ vidāryai ca vai svāhā idaṃ vidāryai namama ।
oṃ pūtanāyai ca svāhā idaṃ pūtanāyai namama ।। 28।।
oṃ pāparākṣasyai svāhedaṃ pāparākṣasyai namama ।
oṃ skandāya ca svāhā idaṃ skandāya namama ।।।29।।
omaryamṇe ca vai svadhā idamaryamṇe namama ।
oṃ jṛṃbhakāya ca svāhā idaṃ jṛṃbhāya namama ।।2.153.3 0।।
oṃ pilipicchāya svāhedaṃ pilipicchāya namama ।
omindrāya ca vai svāhā idamindrāya namama ।।3 1 ।।
omagnaye ca vai svāhā idamagnaye namama ।
o yamāya ca vai svāhā idaṃ yamāya namama ।।32।।
oṃ nirṛtaye ca svāhā idaṃ nirṛtaye namama ।
oṃ varuṇāya ca svāhā idaṃ varuṇāya namama ।।33।।
oṃ vāyave ca vai svāhā idaṃ vāyave namama ।
oṃ kuberāya ca svāhedaṃ kuberāya vai namama ।।34।।
omīśānāya ca svāhedamīśānāya vai namama ।
oṃ brahmaṇe ca vai svāhā idaṃ vai brahmaṇe namama ।।35।।
omanantāya ca svāhā idamanantāya namama ।
omugrasenāya svāhedamugrasenāya namama ।। 36।।
oṃ ḍāmarāya ca svāhā idṃ ḍāmarāya namama ।
oṃ mahākālāya vaṣaṭ mahākālāyedaṃ namama ।।37।।
omaśvibhyāṃ ca vai svāhā idamaśvibhyāṃ namama ।
oṃ durgāyai ca vai svāhā idaṃ durgāyai namama ।।38।।
etaddhomena śikhyādyāḥ prīyantāṃ jalamutsṛjet ।
atha vāstoṣpataye ca śataṃ cāṣṭau tathā''hutīḥ ।।39।।
samittilapāyasājyairjuhuyānmantrayojitāḥ ।
ekaikena tu mantreṇa saptaviṃśatikā hi tāḥ ।।2.153.40 ।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate prati jānīhmasmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ ।
yatvemahepprati tanno juṣasva śanno bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhā।।।41।।
idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।42।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na
edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo ।
ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati
tanno juṣasva sanno bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhā ।।43 ।।
idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।44।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate śagmayāsaṃ
sadā te sakṣīmahi hiraṇyayāgātumatyā ।
pāhi kṣema uta yoge varanno
yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ svāhā ।।45।।
idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।46 ।।
oṃ amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvārūpāṇyāviśan ।
sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ svāhā vardhaya sampadā ।।47।।
idaṃ vāstoṣpataye svāhā vāstoṣpataye namama ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।48।।
tato vai sthālīpākenā''hutayaḥ ṣaṭ ca tadyathā ।
omagnimindraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ viśvān devānupahvaye ।।49।।
sarasvatīṃ ca vājinaṃ ca vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ।
idamagnaye indrāya bṛhaspataye viśvadevebhyaḥ sarasvatyai vājine ।।2.153.50 ।।
oṃ sarpyadevajanānsarvān himavantaṃ sudarśanam ।
vasūँśca rudrānādityānīśānaṃ jagadaiḥ saha ।।51 ।।
etān sarvān prapadye'haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ।
idṃ sarpadevajanebhyo himavate sudarśanāya vasubhyo rudrebhya
ādityebhya īśānāya jagadebhyaśca svāhā namama ।।52।।
oṃ pūrvāhṇamaparāhṇaṃ cobhau madhyandinā saha ।
pradoṣamardharātraṃ ca vyuṣṭāṃ devīṃ mahāpatham ।।53।।
etān sarvān prapadye'haṃ vāstu
me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ।
idaṃ pūrvāhṇāyā'parāhṇāya pradoṣāyā'rdharātrā-
vyuṣṭyaidevyai mahāpathāya namama ।।54।।
oṃ kartāraṃ ca vikartāraṃ viśvakarmāṇamoṣadhīśca vanaspatīn ।
etānsarvānprapadye'haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ।।55।।
idaṃ kartre vikartre viśvakarmaṇe oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo namama ।
oṃ dhātāraṃ vidhātāraṃ nidhīnāṃ ca patiṃ saha ।।56।।
etānsarvān prapadye'haṃ vāstu me datta vājinaḥ svāhā ।
idaṃ dhātre vidhātre ca nidhīnāṃ pataye namama ।।57।।
oṃ śyonaḥ śivamidaṃ vāstudattabrahma prajāpatīna sarvāśca devatāḥ svāhā ।
idaṃ brahmaṇe prajāpataye sarvābhyo devatābhyo namama ।।58।।
punaḥ vāstoṣpate ceti mantrairekena vā saha ।
juhuyād vakṣyamāṇena bilvaṃ sājyaṃ sabījakam ।।59।।
pañcamaṃ cājyayuktaṃ ca bilvaṃ dhṛtvā manuṃ vadan ।
juhuyādvai śataṃ cāṣṭau pratyekaṃ ca vidhānataḥ ।।2.153.6 0।।
oṃ vāstoṣpate dhruvasthūṇāṃ satraṃ so abhyānādrapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnām ।
indro munīnāṃ sakhā śanno bhavadvipadeśaṃ catuṣpade svāhā idṃ vāstoṣpataye ।।6 1 ।।
aghorebhyo'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaśca ।
sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyaḥ ।।।62।।
vāstumarmasusandhānārthaṃ juhuyāt śatātparam ।
śikhyādibhyaḥ punarhutvā''pūjya paṃcopacārakaiḥ ।।63।।
pīṭhasthāṃ pratimāṃ vāstordadhiddarvādibhistathā ।
śaivalasaptadhānyaiśca gandhākṣatasumādibhiḥ ।।64।।
yukte'pakvamṛdo bhāṇḍe saṃsthāpya ca pidhāya ca ।
prāsādāgneyakoṇe vā koṇapadāttathottare ।।65।।
ākāśapade jānugarte jalenāpūrya tatra ca ।
prakṣipya gandhapuṣpāṇi mṛdbhāṇḍaṃ ca nidhāpayet ।।66।।
gṛṇan namo varuṇāya mṛdā mṛdaṃ prapūrayet ।
hutvaivaṃ vāstudevebhyo yoginībhyo'rpayettataḥ ।।67।।
oṃ divyayoginyai svāhā idṃ divyayoginyai namama ।
yojanīyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ yoginyai namameti ca ।।68।।
oṃ mahāśabdāyai siddhyai gaṇeśvaryai svāhā namama ।
pretākṣyai ḍākinyai kāmyai kālarātryai svāhā namama ।।69।।
niśācaryyai ca huँkāryyai siddhivetālyai svāhā namama ।
hrīṃkāryyai bhūtaḍāmaryai ūrdhvakeśyai svāhā namama ।।2.153.70।।
virūpākṣyai ca śuṣkāṃgyai narabhojinyai svāhā namama ।
phutakāryai vīrabhadrāyai dhūmrākṣyai ca svāhā namama ।।71।।
kālapriyāyai rākṣasyai ghorarākṣasyai svāhā namama ।
virūpākṣyai bhayaṃkaryai viśālākṣyai svāhā namama ।।72।।
kaumāryyai caṇḍikāyai vārāhyai muṇḍamatyai svāhā namama ।
bhairavyai cakriṇyai krodhāyai durmukhyai svāhā namama ।।73।।
pretavāhāyai kuraṃgyai pralambauṣṭhyai svāhā namama ।
mālinyai mantrayoginyai kālaghnanyai svāhā namama ।।74।।
mohinyai vakrāyai kuṇḍalinyai bālakyai svāhā namama ।
kaumāryyai yamadūtyai karālyai kauśikyai svāhā namama ।।75।।
yakṣiṇyai bhakṣiṇyai kumārikāyai svāhā namama ।
yantravādinyai viśālākṣyai kāmukyai svāhā namama ।।76।।
vyāghryai rākṣasyai pretabhakṣiṇyai svāhā namama ।
dhūrjaṭyai vikaṭāyai ghorāyai kapālyai svāhā namama ।।77।।
vikalāyai ca mālāyai sarvasiddhyai svāhā namama ।
catuṣṣaṣṭiśca yoginyaḥ prīyantāṃ homataḥ khalu ।।78।।
kṣetrapālahavanaṃ ca kuryādvai vidhinā makhī ।
oṃ ajarāya ca svāhedam ajarāya vai namama ।।79।।
pāvakāya ca caurāya dakṣāya cendramūrtaye ।
kuṣmāṇḍāya varuṇāya bāhukāya svāhā namama ।।2.153.80।।
nimuktāya liptakāya tilalopāya svāhā namama ।
ekadaṃṣṭrāyairāvatāyauṣadhighnāya svāhā namama ।।81 ।।
bandhanāyā''divyāptāya kambalāya svāhā namama ।
kṣobhaṇāya bhagavate dharāyā''lāya svāhā namama ।।82।।
aṇave candravāraṇāya karāṭopāya svāhā namama ।
uroṭopāya jaṭilāya ṛtave svāhā namama ।।83 ।।
maheśvarāya vikārāya maṇimāya svāhā namama ।
guṇabanghāya ḍāmarāya dṛḍhakiraṇāya svāhā namama ।।84।।
sthavilāya danturāya dhanadāya svāhā namama ।
nāgakaraṇāya ca phenakāriṇe svāhā namama ।।85।।
mahādalāya cirakāya siṃhāya svāhā namama ।
mṛgāya pakṣiṇe siṃhavāhanāya svāhā namama ।।86।।
tīkṣṇauṣṭhāya alābhāya sruktuṇḍāya svāhā namama ।
yudhāmanyave alīlāya vavrakāya svāhā namama ।।87।।
pāvanāya svāhā namama prīyantāṃ kṣetrapālakāḥ ।
tataśca mātṛkāhomaḥ gauryai svāhā ca oṃ namama ।।88।।
padmāyai śacyai medhāyai sāvitryai svāhā namama ।
vijayāyai jayāyai devasenāyai svāhā namama ।।89।।
svadhāyai svāhāyai mātṛbhyaḥ svāhā oṃ namama om ।
lokamātṛbhyo hṛṣṭyai puṣṭyai tuṣṭyai svāhā namama ।।2.153.90।।
kuladevyai namaḥ svāhā vasuhomastataḥ param ।
dhruvāya ca dharāya ca somāyā'dbhyo'nilāya ca ।।91।।
nalāya pratyūṣāya prabhāsāya svāhā namama ।
ādityahavanaṃ cātha dhātre'ryamṇe svāhā namama ।।92।।
mitrāya varuṇāyā'pi cāśāya ca svāhā namama ।
gabhastimate indrāya vivasvate svāhā namama ।।93।।
pūṣṇe parjanyakāyā'pi viṣṇave jaghanāya ca ।
svāhā namama ca tato rudrāṇāṃ havanaṃ yathā ।।94।।
oṃ vīrabhadrāya ca svāhā namama śaṃbhave tathā ।
girīśāyājaikapāde'hirbudhnyāya pinākine ।।95।।
aparājitāya bhuvanādhīśvarāya svāhā namama ।
kapāline sthāṇave bhagāya svāhā namama ।।96।।
saptamātṛhavanaṃ ca yathā brāhmyai svāhā namama ।
vaiṣṇavyai ca māheśvaryai kumāryai svāhā namama ।।97।।
kuberāyai ca vārāhyai indrāṇyai svāhā namama ।
ṣaḍvināyakahomo'tha modāya svāhā namama ।। 98।।
pramodāya sanmukhāya durmukhāya svāhā namama ।
avighnāya vighnahartre svāhā namama oṃ namaḥ ।।99।।
pitāmahādihomaśca brahmaṇe svāhedṃ namama ।
viṣṇave svāhedaṃ namama rudrāya svāhedaṃ namama ।। 2.153.10 0।।
gaṇeśāya svāhedaṃ namama lakṣmyai svāhedaṃ namama ।
jātavedase viśvakarmaṇe svāhedaṃ namama ।। 10 1।।
bhūtagrāmāya ca svāhedaṃ namama ca oṃ namaḥ ।
daśāṃśo'tha japānāṃ cāyuto gāyatrīhomakaḥ ।। 1 02।।
samidājyacaruyavatilaiḥ sadugdhaśarkaraiḥ ।
śrīsūktādyairlakṣmīhomaḥ pradhānadevahomakaḥ ।। 1 03।।
kartavyaśceti bhaktāya devāyatanakāya saḥ ।
hariḥ prāha mayā te'pi coktaṃ rādhe yathāyatham ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāstudevahavanaṃ yoginīhavanaṃ kṣetrapālahavanaṃ mātṛkāhavanaṃ vasvādityarudramātṛgaṇapatipitāmahaviṣṇulakṣmīsūryādi-
havanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 153 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 154
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 155 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tataśca śrīhariḥ prāha devāyatanakāya yam ।
brahmapriyādihomaṃ ca rādhe taṃ te vadāmyapi ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya brāhmarūpiṇīḥ ।
brahmapriyaścatvāriṃśat śataṃ cāvāhya pūjayet। ।। 2 ।।
svarṇasihāsanaṃ dhyātvā viśālaṃ tāḥ samāhvayet ।
taṇḍuleṣvatha vā pūgīphaleṣu cārcayed dravaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
oṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve-
nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyātaṃn iṣṇaṃ ।
niṣāṇamummaiiṣāṇa sarvalokammaiṣāṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
prathamaṃ ṣaṇmahābrāhmīpriyāścāvāhayenmakhī ।
oṃ śrīrādhikāyai svāhā idaṃ rādhikāyai namama ।। 5 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi tām ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।। 6 ।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
oṃ śrīlakṣmyai tathā svāhā idaṃ lakṣmyai namama om ।। 7 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।। 8 ।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
oṃ śrīmāṇikyāyai svāhedaṃ māṇikyāyai namama ।। 9 ।।
oṃ śrībrahmavidyāyai svāhā idaṃ brahmavidyāyai namama ।
o śrīramāyai ca svāhā idaṃ ramāyai ca namama ।। 2.154.1 0।।
oṃ śriyai ca tathā svāhā idaṃ śriyai ca vai namama ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।। 1 1।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।। 12।।
paravidyāṃ cāhvayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ samarpayāmi oṃ namama ।। 1 3।।
brahmapriyāstathā gītā upaniṣada ityapi ।
jayantīścaikādaśīścā''rādhanāṃ cāhvayāmi ca ।। 14।।
mahālakṣmīṃ tathā bhaktiṃ rādhāṃ ramāṃ pativratām ।
gaṃgāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ kāmadughāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ tathā ।। 15।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।। 16।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
saṃjñā vibhūtiṃ duḥkhahālakṣmīṃ ca kamalāṃ tathā ।। 17।।
siddhiṃ mohinīmurvaśīṃ muktāṃ buddhiṃ ca pārvatīm ।
dīkṣāṃ līlāṃ virajāṃ ca vṛndāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ tathā ।। 18।।
sarasvatīṃ svarṇarekhāṃ sitāṃ ca devikāṃ tathā ।
vibhāvarīṃ ca tulasīṃ mūrtiṃ jayāṃ ca gomatīm ।। 19।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।।2.154.20।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
premasakhīṃ rukmiṇīṃ godāvarīṃ mañjulāṃ tathā ।।2 1।।
haṃsāṃ suguṇāṃ lalitāṃ dhātrīṃ raṃbhāṃ kumudvatīm ।
campāṃ ca śītalāṃ svarṇagaurīṃ nandāṃ dayāṃ kalām ।।22।।
durgāṃ ca nandinīṃ sādhyāṃ vijayāṃ vañjulīṃ tathā ।
dhanyā dolāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ puṇyāṃ ca kokilāṃ manum ।।23 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ candanādi jalaṃ tathā ।।24।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
citralekhāṃ pūrṇimāṃ śāradāṃ māṃ mañjarīṃ tathā ।।25।।
devikāṃ preyasīṃ śreyasīṃ vikuṇṭhāṃ tathā'ruṇām ।
jyoṣṭrīṃ śabarīṃ pampāṃ ca gālavīṃ sudughāṃ tathā ।।26।।
yājñasenīṃ vasumatīṃ padmāvatīṃ ca bhārgavīm ।
padminīṃ śrīmatīṃ jaratkārvīṃ līlāvatīṃ tathā ।।27।।
kalāvatīṃ ca kadalīṃ revāṃ kāntimatīṃ tathā ।
kālindīṃ vardhinīṃ puṇyanaidheyikāṃ sumitrikām ।।28।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā ।।29।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
bandulāṃ ca suśīlāṃ ca mānasāṃ mādhavīṃ tathā ।।2.154.3 0।।
śarmavatīṃ dīrghikāṃ karṇotpalāmakṣamālikām ।
udumbarīṃ badarīṃ kubjikāṃ haimīmṛtambharām ।।31 ।।
maṃgalāṃ cā'mṛtāṃ mahāvedīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ haripriyāḥ ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।।32।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā ।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।।33।।
santoṣāṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīmāhvayāmi namāmi ca ।
sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi dhūpadīpajalādibhiḥ ।।34।।
naivedyaṃ candanaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ samarpayāmi ca ।
oṃ rādhāṣaṭkāya ca svāhedaṃ rādhāṣaṭkāya namama ।। 35।।
pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnādi sadvyaṃjanāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ।। 36।।
oṃ parāvidyādikānāṃ catvāriṃśadyuje śatāya ca ।
svāhā idaṃ parāvidyādibhya oṃ tābhyo namama ।।37।।
pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnādi sadvyaṃjanāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ।।38।।
oṃ santoṣāyaiḥ kaṃbharālakṣmyai svāhā tābhyāṃ namama ।
pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnāni sadvyaṃjanāni ca ।।3 9।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ।
iti brāhmīḥ pūjayitvā hyavatārān prapūjayet ।।2.154.40।।
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kapilaṃ ca hariṃ tathā ।
vāsudevaṃ pṛthuṃ dattātreyaṃ haṃsaṃ nṛsiṃhakam ।।41 ।।
ṛṣabhaṃ vāmanaṃ parśurāmaṃ yajñaṃ kumārakān ।
rāmaṃ hayagrīvadevaṃ nāradaṃ rājarājakam ।।42।।
vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca gopālaṃ buddhaṃ kalikaṃ ca mohinīm ।
dhanvantariṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tathā ।।43 ।।
sahasrahastaṃ vyūhaṃ ca sthāpayet svarṇamūrtiṣu ।
tanduleṣu pūgikāsu maṇiṣvapi nidhāpayet ।।44।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanādi naivedyaṃ jalamityapi ।।45।।
tāmbūlakaṃ nīrājanaṃ samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ।
oṃ matsyādibhyaśca svāhā idaṃ matsyādibhyo namama ।।46।।
pāyasaṃ polikā miṣṭānnāni sadvyaṃjanāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyāni cośyāni cārpayāmi ca ।।47।।
saśaktikāḥ sāyudhāśca sabhūṣāśca sasevakāḥ ।
pragṛhṇantvaṣṭyukchataṃ bhojyānāṃ tu makhe'rpitam ।।48।।
oṃ yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni
dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan ।
te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta
yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ।।49।।
ityevaṃ tvavatārāṇāṃ homamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
yadvā pratyekamevā'pi kuryānmakhī yathābalam ।।2.154.50।।
atha siṃhāsane svarṇe saguṇaṃ tu catuṣṭayam ।
vāsudevaṃ cāniruddhaṃ pradyumnaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇam ।।।51 ।।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।
aṣṭottaraśatadravyairarcayāmi saśaktikam ।।52।।
vāsudevādibhyaḥ svāhā idṃ catuṣṭyāya namama ।
pāyasaṃ polikāḥ śākānyapi rasāँśca miṣṭakān ।।53।।
atha siṃhāsane svarṇe nirguṇaṃ tu catuṣṭayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।54।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ naranārāyaṇaṃ samāhvayet ।
āhvayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi namāmi ca ।।55।।
aṣṭottaraśatadravyairarcayāmi saśaktikam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇādibhyaśca vai svāhā ।।56।।
idaṃ tebhyaśca namama nīrājayāmi vai namaḥ ।
pāyasaṃ polikāḥ śākānyapi rasāṃśca miṣṭakān ।।57।।
iti sampūjya parameśvarān havanamācaret ।
tattannāmnā'ṣṭāhutīścārpayetpāyasājyakaiḥ ।।58।।
viṣṇormāsūramayaścaruḥ kṣīramayaścaruḥ śubhaḥ ।
idaṃ viṣṇuriti gṛṇān dvādaśā'kṣaravidyayā ।।59।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
ṣoḍaśākṣaramanunā sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatam ।।2.154.60।।
caruṃ juhuyāt oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya svāhā ।
samidbhiścājyayavatilaiḥ phalairjuhuyāttathā ।।6 1 ।।
oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam ।
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure svāhā idaṃ tu viṣṇave ।।62।।
anena cāpi sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatamarpayet ।
omagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhedamagnaye namama ।।6 3 ।।
tata oṃ bhūḥ svāhedamagnaye namama śaṃ makhe kuru ।
oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhedaṃ vāyave namama śaṃ makhe kuru ।।64।।
oṃ svaḥ svāhedaṃ sūryāya namama śaṃ makhe kuru ।
itivyāhṛtihomaṃ ca kṛtvā tu maṇḍapasthitān ।।65 ।।
sampūjya ca baliṃ dadyāt sarvadevebhya eva ca ।
tataśca bahirāgatya lokapālebhya ārpayet ।।66 ।।
pūrve indra samāgaccha rakṣā'dhvaraṃ namo'stu te ।
diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ।।67।।
indrasyā'nucarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ ।
āgneyyāmagne āgaccha rakṣā'dhvaraṃ namo'stu te ।।68।।
diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ।
agneścānusarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ ।।69।।
dakṣiṇe yama āgaccha nairṛtyāmehi nairṛte ।
paścime varuṇā''gaccha vāyavyāmehi vāyurāṭ ।।2.154.70।।
uttarasyāṃ kuberaihi aiśānyāmehi īśvara ।
diśaṃ rakṣa baliṃ bhakṣa yajamānodayaṃ kuru ।।71।।
tattadanucarāḥ sarve bhakṣayantu baliṃ sukhāḥ ।
īpūmadhye ehi brahman nipamadhye hyanantarāṭ ।।72।।
diśaṃ ca rakṣataṃ baliṃ bhakṣataṃ sānusevakau ।
kurutaṃ yajamānasyā'bhyudayaṃ ca makhodayam ।।73।।
atha kṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇa rakṣa makhaṃ sadā ।
sānucaro yajamānodayaṃ kuru sukhaṃ kuru ।।74।।
dadhimāṣādikaṃ bhakṣetyuktvā tu taṇḍulān kṣipet ।
atha catuṣpathe bhūtā baliṃ gṛhṇantu śūrpagam ।।75।।
piṣṭaṃ māṣānnadadhyodanaharidrādikajjalam ।
sindūrakaṃ gandharaktapuṣpādi catvare makhī ।।76 ।।
gandhapuṣpārcitaṃ śūrpaṃ sthāpayedvai gṛṇan manūn ।
baliṃ gṛhṇantu te devā ādityā vasavastathā ।।77।।
marutaścāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ ।
jṛmbhakāḥ siddhagandharvā mālā vidyādharā nagāḥ ।।78।।
asurā yātudhānāśca piśācā ḍākinīgaṇāḥ ।
śaktayo yakṣavetālā ye ca vighnavināyakāḥ ।।79।।
bhūtāḥ pretāśca kūṣmāṇḍāḥ śākinyo mātarastathā ।
tṛptā bhavantu balinā yajñaprasādarūpiṇā ।।2.154.80।।
mā vighnaṃ yajamānasya rogaṃ duḥkhamaniṣṭakam ।
kurvantu tatkuṭumbasya mā santu paripanthinaḥ ।।81।।
sarve bhavantu tṛptāśca rakṣāṃ kurvantu me'dhvare ।
devatābhyaśca pitṛbhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sahajantubhiḥ ।।82।।
etatsthānādhivāsibhyaḥ prayacchāmi baliṃ namama ।
trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।।83 ।।
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ।
kiṃpuruṣāḥ kinnarāśca sādhyā santaśca sādhvikāḥ ।।84।।
ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara ityapi ।
kāśyapyastasya vaṃśīyā rājasāstāmasāḥ sitāḥ ।।85।।
ete mamā'dhvare rakṣāṃ kurvantu dehadhāriṇaḥ ।
mūrtā'mūrtasvarūpāśca yamā yāmyāścarantu śam ।।86।।
etebhyaścāpi sarvebhyaḥ svāhā baliṃ ca oṃ namama।
kṛtvā'thācamanaṃ śuddhiṃ yāyānmaṇḍapasannidhau ।।87।।
viśramya yūpakāryaṃ ca tata ācārya ācaret ।
iti rādhe prabhūktaṃ te mayoktaṃ brāhmakarma tat ।।88।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rādhikādiṣaṭkaparāvidyācatvāriṃśaddhikaśatasantuṣṭākambharādvayaparameśāvatāraviṣṇulokapālabhūtādipūjābalisamarpaṇādināmā catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 154 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 155
