[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 162 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike divyabhaktaḥ sa devāyatanako muniḥ ।
śrutvā''ścaryabhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pupūja ha ।। 1 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā premamagno'tisiddhimān ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā tadā svayam ।। 2 ।।
divyaprāsādarūpo'bhūt sahasrakalaśānvitaḥ ।
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ sarvāṃgaparipūritaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sarvopasthāpanayuktaḥ sevāyāṃ mūrtimānapi ।
vyatirikeṇāpi cāste muktarūpadharo'pi san ।। 4 ।।
prāsādaḥ so'bhavat khyāto devādyaiśca prapūjitaḥ ।
indro vilokya tattulyaṃ kārayituṃ mano'karot ।। 5 ।।
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya darśayāmāsa tatkṛtim ।
ājñāṃ dadau tato'marāvatyāṃ kartuṃ sumandiram ।। 6 ।।
viśvakarmā samabhyasya kuṃkumā'kṣarabhūsthale ।
tataḥ svargaṃ yayau śṛṃgaṃ sahasrakalaśaṃ vyadhāt ।। 7 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
patnīṣaṭkasahitaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mahotsavaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
atha pravṛttāḥ prāsādāḥ sarvalokeṣu vai tataḥ ।
sarvatrā''dhyātmiko devāyano devo'sti teṣu vai ।। 9 [।
evaṃ divyaṃ mandiraṃ tu draṣṭumāyānti mānavāḥ ।
surāḥ pātālasaṃsthāśca satyalokanivāsinaḥ ।। 2.161.1 0।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā mandiraśobhitam ।
pramodante narā nāryo viśrāmyanti bṛhatsukhe ।।1 1।।
darśanīyaṃ mandiraṃ tu śrutvā kapardisaṃghataḥ ।
āsamudrāt samāyānti janā draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ ।। 12।।।
dhanamedo dhīvaro'pi pratīcivārdhitīragaḥ ।
śrutvā kuṭumbasahito draṣṭuṃ gṛhād viniryayau ।। 13।।
vastrāpathaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā turīdevīṃ yayau pathi ।
vṛkṣacchāyāghaṭāmadhye sthitāṃ mūrtimayīṃ śubhām ।। 14।।
jīvantikānadītīre prāsāde saṃsthitāṃ satīm ।
āmrāṇāṃ vanamadhyasthāṃ kāṣṭhahārādisevitām ।। 15।।
āśrayadāṃ vanināṃ tāṃ śāntidāṃ vanavāsinīm ।
vilokya gajapṛṣṭhasthāṃ caturbhujāṃ haripriyām ।।16।।
lakṣmyaṃśarūpāṃ sattvāḍhyāṃ phalapuṣpādipūjitām ।
neme gatvā'ntike tasthau dhanamedo'tibhāvataḥ ।। 17।।
sasnau nadyā hrade cāmravṛkṣasyā'dho bhuvastale ।
sāmagrīryātrikīḥ sarvā nidhāya ca tataḥ param ।। 18।।
samādāya jalaṃ śītaṃ puṣpāṇi cāmpakāni ca ।
amṛtasya phalānyuttamāni pakvāni taulasīm ।। 1 9।।
yayau lakṣmīṃ turīnāmnīmarcayituṃ hi mandire ।
kuṭumbena tu taddevyāḥ sannidhau praṇanāma saḥ ।।2.161.20।।
stutiṃ cakāra vidhinā vanyarakṣaṇakāriṇīm ।
pupūja parayā prītyā phalapuṣpajalādibhiḥ ।।21।।
aho mātaśca he mātarmahālakṣmi mahāsati ।
vane dattaṃ mayā nītaṃ gṛhaṇā''dyaṃ namostu te ।। 22।।
prasannā bhava yātrārthaṃ prajvālaya ca kalmaṣam ।
dhīvarāṇāṃ pāvanī tvaṃ samuddhara haripriye ।।23।।
na jānāmyarcanaṃ jātyā nikṛṣṭo'śuddha eva yat ।
hṛdayaṃ te'rpitaṃ śuddhaṃ matvā gṛhāṇa cāmṛtam ।।24।।
buddhiṃ dehi tathā bhaktiṃ muktiṃ dehi madarhikām ।
parivārasahitasya mahyaṃ śreyaḥ pradehi ca ।।25।।
ityuktvā ca muhurnatvā mārjayāmāsa mandiram ।
śuṣkapatrāṇi niṣkāsya dhūlyādi cāpahṛtya ca ।।26 ।।
jalena kṣālayāmāsa mandiraṃ turikāṃ tathā ।
snapayāmāsa salilaiḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakāra saḥ ।।27।।
patrapuṣpāṇi cādāya nūtanāni bahūnyapi ।
toraṇaṃ mālikāṃ cāpi klṛptvā dadau samarhaṇe ।।28।।
rātrimuvāsa tatraivāśrayaṃ pravīkṣya śāntidam ।
phalādivanyabhojyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvovāsa dināntare ।।29।।
tṛtīye'pi dine tasthau viśrāntimāpa bhūyasīm ।
nityaṃ svagṛhavat sarvaṃ devīkāryaṃ supūjanam ।। 2.161.3 0।।
saṃśodhanaṃ sevanādi karoti bhāvato vane ।
rātrau kurvanti bhajanaṃ kuṭumbino hi kaṇṭhataḥ ।।3 1।।
vahniṃ prakāśayitvaiva tāpaṃ śaityanivṛttaye ।
gṛhṇantyapi ca taddevyā āgāre militāśca te ।।32।।
ityevaṃ rādhike rātriṃ viniryāpya dināntare ।
puṣpāṇi vividhānyeva samādāyā'mbarāṇi ca ।।33।।
puṣpāṇāmeva saṃsādhya lakṣmyai samarpayanti te ।
mukuṭaṃ karṇaphullāni cāvataṃsān sukañcukīm ।।34।।
śāṭīṃ ca ghargharīṃ mālāṃ gucchaṃ ca raśanāṃ tathā ।
pāduke jhullarīṃ ceti kṛtvā samarpayanti te ।।35।।
sugandhi madhu miṣṭaṃ cānīya vṛkṣasusaṃsthitam ।
samarpayanti devyai ca bhojanaṃ surasān bahūn ।।36 ।।
candanasya śubhaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ samāhṛtya vanāntarāt ।
dhūpaṃ kurvanti gandhāḍhyaṃ sevante smeti bhāvataḥ ।।37।।
bhajanaṃ śrīhare kṛṣṇa lakṣmi mātarnamo'stu te ।
evaṃ kurvanti satataṃ vanamadhye turīgṛhe ।। 38।।
turyāvasthātmikā lakṣmīradṛśyā'pi tadarhaṇām ।
samagrahīt prasannā'bhūt svabhāvasevayā satī ।।39।।
mūrtau sthitā'pi jagrāhā'mṛtaṃ madhu phalāni ca ।
papau tu salilaṃ śītaṃ dadhāra mālikāśca tāḥ ।।2.161.40।।
pauṣpāmbarāṇi jagṛhe dhūpaṃ jagrāha bhāvataḥ ।
vane sevāṃ bhaktakṛtāṃ sarvāṃ jagrāha mūrtigā ।।41।।
evaṃ kuṭumbasahito dhanamedo'pi dhīvaraḥ ।
yogakṣemau vane lebhe tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ।।42।।
nirmalāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sa pañcadaśadināni vai ।
uvāsa mandire tatra vane turyāntike mudā ।।43।।
nityapūjādisampattyā puṇyaṃ cāvāpa bhūri ca ।
pāvitryaṃ prāpa bahudhā lakṣmīdevīprasādataḥ ।।44।।
pauṣaśuklasya pūrṇāyāṃ rātrau candre śirogate ।
kīrtanaṃ pracakārā'sau mṛdaṃgena kuṭumbibhiḥ ।।45।।
śītakāntisudhāvalye vanavṛkṣādiśobhite ।
nirmale rajanībhāge śānte rājasabhāvane ।।46 ।।
gītiṃ cakāra patnyā ca putrībhiḥ putrakaiḥ saha ।
pratyakṣaṃ madhuraṃ śrutvā sākṣāt turī babhūva ha ।।47।।
rūparūpānuśobhāḍhyāvayavāṃ'gātisundarī ।
prasannavadanā haste kamalaṃ bibhratī satī ।।48।।
maṇisvarṇavibhūṣāḍhyā divyāmbarādidhāriṇī ।
koṭiśāradapūrṇendukāntyatikāntibhāsurā ।।49।।
śvetagajasya pṛṣṭhe sā niṣaṇṇā ca manoharā ।
varadānaṃ gṛhāṇā'tra prasannā'smītyuvāca tam ।।2.161.50।।
bhakta tvayā vane me'tra mandire vasatiḥ kṛtā ।
sevā bahuprakāreṇa kṛtā naijagṛhādivat ।।51 ।।
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ vada cārpaye ।
ekavāraṃ gṛhasyāpi mārjanena mamātra ca ।।52।।
dāridryaṃ nāśamāyāti svargaṃ divyamavāpnuyāt ।
ekavāraṃ pradīpena mamālaye tu vai ciram ।।53।।
phalaṃ sūryasya lokāptiḥ sahasrayugajā bhavet ।
ekavāraṃ tulasyāścārpaṇena mama mastake ।।54।।
cakravartitvamevā'smai dadāmi sampadaściram ।
puṣpahārādyarpaṇena dadāmi svarṇabhūṣaṇam ।।55।।
ekavāraṃ phalānāmarpaṇena pradadāmi vai ।
śāśvataṃ cāmṛtaṃ svargamaindraṃ padaṃ samujjvalam ।।56।।
ekavāraṃ jaladānād dadāmi vāruṇaṃ padam ।
ātmārpaṇena sarvasvaṃ dadāmi dhāma śāśvatam ।।57।।
patirme bhagavān sākṣādanādiḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
tatsmṛddhiṃ pradadāmyasmai madbhaktāya mahātmane ।।58।।
mayyarpitaṃ pragṛhṇāmi samarpya pataye tataḥ ।
tatprasādaṃ sadā cā'dmi tasya sevāparāyaṇā ।।59।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
smṛddhaḥ prasanno bhagavān jāyate mama sevayā ।।2.161.6 0।।
ahaṃ priyā yathā tasya yathā ca māṇikī priyā ।
tathā priyo'pi me bhaktastasmai dadātyalaṃ patiḥ ।।61।।
dhanameda pavitro'si prasannā'haṃ yatastvayi ।
vṛṇu yatte mānase'sti dadāmi pativāñcchayā ।।62।।
ityukto dhanamedaḥ sa rādhike kṣaṇamāntare ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sukhaṃ prāpya mudaṃ parām ।।63।।
dāsyaṃ kuṭumbayuktasya varayāmāsa mātari ।
na sampadaṃ na ca rājyaṃ naiśvaryaṃ samiyeṣa saḥ ।।64।।
dhanyo'si dhanameda! tvaṃ dāsye sarvaṃ pravartate ।
dāsyaṃ tu durlabhaṃ loke niśchadmaṃ svāminaḥ kṛte ।।65।।
abhilaṣanti dāsyaṃ vai bhṛtyāḥ saṃsārakoṭiṣu ।
svārthadāsā hyasaṃkhyātā vartante bhuvanatraye ।।66।।
hārdadāsā durlabhā vai hārdadāso'tra me bhava ।
hārdadāsye vasantyeva siddhyaiśvaryāṇi sarvadā ।।67।।
chadmadāsye kleśabhūtā vartante raktahāriṇaḥ ।
tasmāt kartavyamevātra dāsyaṃ hṛdayaraṃjitam ।।68।।
yathā dāsī bhavāmyatra nārāyaṇasya padmajā ।
yathā dāsī bhavatyatra śivasya pārvatī satī ।।69।।
sūryadāsī prabhā cāste dāsī padmāvatī hareḥ ।
yathā ca māṇikī dāsī rādhā dāsī harerjayā ।।2.161.70 ।।
yathā ca maṃjulā haṃsā dāsī ca suguṇā hareḥ ।
lalitā cā'kṣarabrahma garuḍo dāsa ityapi ।।71 ।।
tathā dāsyaṃ kuru deve yathā ca hanumān kapiḥ ।
yathā hemantako dāso vasanto dāsa ityapi ।।72।।
kalpe kalpe bhavantyeva dāsā hyete harestathā ।
labha dāsyaṃ mayi me ca patyau śrīpuruṣottame ।।73।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkaṃbharāsutaḥ ।
mānavena tu rūpeṇa vartate yatra gacchasi ।।74।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśramasannidhau ।
devāyatanasaudhe śrīkāntastatra virājate ।।75।।
mādṛśyaḥ kamalāstatra rājante koṭiśo'pi ca ।
sarvavīryadharasyā'sya sevayā''nandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।76।।
yāhi bhakta śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikābhidham ।
kāntaṃ sevaya sarvaṃ te dāsyaṃ phalarddhimadbhavet ।।77।।
gṛhāṇa vanapuṣpāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca ।
arpaya pataye tatra namaskārāँśca me vada ।।78।।
ahaṃ paścimabhāge'tra kṣetrasīmni tadājñayā ।
turīrūpeṇa tiṣṭhāmi kṣetrapā kamalā svayam ।।79।।
adṛśyena svarūpeṇa kṛṣṇaṃ seve hi nityadā ।
yāhi śīghraṃ mānaseṣṭaṃ tava tatra bhaviṣyati ।।2.161.80।।
ityuktvā sā turīlakṣmīrmūrtau vilīnatāṃ gatā ।
dhanamedo harṣamatto māghamāse tu kṛṣṇake ।।81 ।।
pakṣe kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sakuṭumbaśca mudā yayau ।
vīkṣya vīkṣya mudaṃ prāpa hyudyānāni vanāni ca ।।।82।।।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ vīkṣya vīkṣyākāśagatālayam ।
brahmapriyāḥ samālokya vilokyā'śvasarovaram ।।83 ।।
saudhāni bahulakṣāni vilokya devatālayān ।
vīkṣya tīrthāni divyāni dhanamedo jaharṣa ha ।।84।।
sthale sthale cakārā'sau daṇḍavat sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
lakṣmīdarśitakāntaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ mahālayaṃ yayau ।।85।।
yatrā'nādiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo virājate prabhuḥ ।
koṭisūryābhamukuṭābhūṣaṇādipratejitaḥ ।।86।।
rūpānurūpāvayavo bhagavān kamalādibhiḥ ।
sevitaḥ śrīhariḥ sākṣād devamuktādisevitaḥ ।।87।।
neme ca daṇḍavat kṛṣṇaṃ dadau turīpradopadāḥ ।
pupūja ca svayaṃ puṣpaiḥ phalairbhāvairhṛdaṃgamaiḥ ।।88।।
pādodakaṃ papau mūrti hṛdaye sa dadhāra ca ।
prāpya prāsādikaṃ cāpi satkāraṃ svāgatādikam ।।89।।
bhojanaṃ cāpi saṃprāpya viśrāntiṃ sa cakāra ha ।
sāyaṃ tīrthāni kartuṃ ca yayāvaśvasarastaṭe ।।2.161.90।।
niśāyāṃ ca taṭe nyagrodhasya tale hyuvāsa saḥ ।
jātisvabhāvabhāvena tīre vāsamarocayat ।। 91 ।।
rātrau sa bhajanaṃ cakre nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।
prātarjātisvabhāvena vīkṣya matsyāँstu rohitān ।।92।।
cakracihnasuśobhāḍhyān dhartuṃ mano'karottadā ।
tīraṃ gatvā sūtraraśmiṃ mumocā'psu sakaṇḍakām ।।93।।
matsyarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।
bhūtvā''nane ca baḍiśaṃ gṛhītvā tadvaśaṃ yayau ।।94।।
dhanamedena samprāpto matsyo viśālatāṃ yayau ।
śaṃkhacakragadādhārī babhūva padmavān kṣaṇāt ।।95।।
mahadrūpaṃ vilokyā'sau lajjāṃ bhakto yayau tadā ।
hariḥ prāha svabhāvaṃ tvaṃ tyaja māṃ bhaja dhīvara ।।96।।
lakṣmyāstvāśīrvacanaiśca prāpto'haṃ te kṛpālavāt ।
dāsyaṃ gṛhāṇa me yāhi lomaśaṃ manumāvaha ।। 97।।
vaiṣṇavo bhava tiṣṭhā'tra kuru me sevanaṃ tathā ।
yathā tvaṃ dṛṣṭavānatra matsyarūpaṃ caturbhujam ।।98।।
matsyatīrthamidaṃ me'sti matsyāvatārarūpavān ।
tvadarthaṃ te dṛṣṭipathaṃ samāgato'smi taṃ bhaja ।।99।।
dhīvarā matsyadāyādā matsyasnehā bhavanti vai ।
tavā'haṃ matsyarūpeṇa dāsye mokṣaṃ bhajasva mām ।। 2.161.10 0।।
matsyamūrtiṃ vidhāyā'tra vaṭādhastād bhajasva mām ।
tīrthaṃ matsyāvatārasya mamaitatpāpanāśanam ।। 10 1।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
dhīvarāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa bhaviṣyati prabhuktidam ।। 1 02।।
ityuktvā rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastiro'bhavat ।
dhanamedo yayau śīghraṃ lomaśasyāśramaṃ tataḥ ।। 1 03।।
prāpto mantraṃ taulasīṃ ca srajaṃ vaiṣṇavadāsatām ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyāṇāya pataye svāhā' ।। 1 04।।
itiprāpya sarastīre samāyayau kuṭumbayuk ।
vaṭādhastāt parṇakuṭīṃ kṛtvovāsa nirantaram ।। 1 05।।
matsyamūrtiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bheje kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
svalpakālena vai rādhe muktiṃ cāpa tu śāśvatīm ।। 1 06।।
divyapārṣadavaryaiśca nīyamānaḥ kuṭumbayuk ।
yayāvakṣaralokaṃ sa tīrthe mātsye'śvasārase ।। 1 07।।
evaṃ ye tatra vai gatvā kariṣyantyāplavādikam ।
dhīvarā api tattulyā mokṣaṃ yāsyanti rādhike ।। 1 08।।
māghā'māyāṃ mayā tatra matsyarūpaṃ prakāśitam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya matsyatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1 09।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhenmartyaḥ svargaṃ putraṃ dhanādikam ।
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ sarvaṃ labhet kṛṣṇakṛpālavāt ।। 2.161.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne turīdevyā āśīrvādena dhanamedadhīvarasya yātrāloḥ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ matsyāvatāradarśanottaraṃ muktirmatsyatīrthaṃ ceti-
nirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 161 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 161 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 162
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 163 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
māghapūrṇāṃtithau rādhe camatkāro'paro'bhavat ।
kathayāmi samāsena śṛṇu taṃ jñānadāyakam ।। 1 ।।
pāñcāle paścime deśe viṣṭijātisamagraṇīḥ ।
āsīdbhaktaḥ śatoḍhuśca nāmnā paramavaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dāsavargo'sya vaśagaḥ śibikāvāhako'bhavat ।
rājñāṃ ca śreṣṭhināṃ yānavāhakatvaṃ caranti te ।।3 ।।
viṣṭayo dūradeśaṃ ca yātrālubhiḥ sahaiva tu ।
gacchanti viṣṭikarmāṇaḥ somakṣetraṃ tathā'param ।। 4 ।।
gopakṣetraṃ camatkārapuraṃ siddhapuraṃ tathā ।
māthuraṃ kṣetramevāpi kṣetraṃ ca puṣpakaraṃ tathā ।। 5 ।।
vārāṇasīṃ narmadāṃ ca godāvarīṃ ca gomatīm ।
svarṇarekhāṃ tathā cāśvapaṭṭatīrthaṃ prayānti ca ।। 6 ।।
ekadā sa śatoḍhuśca kathāṃ śuśrāva vaiṣṇavīm ।
saṃhitāṃ putrahīnasya gatirnāstīti sarvathā ।। 7 ।।
aputrasya śatoḍhośca hṛdaye sā kathā sthitā ।
putrārthaṃ prairayat so'pi maunamādāya nityaśaḥ ।। 8 ।।
mālāṃ japtvā nadītīre śamīsthāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm ।
pupūjā''rādhayāmāsa rātrau rātrau tadaikalaḥ ।। 9 ।।
svagrāmanikaṭe nityaṃ śamīvṛkṣatale sthitaḥ ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ śamīpatraṃ naivedyaṃ caṇakādikam ।। 2.162.1 0।।
samarpyaivaṃ baliṃ mālāvṛttiṃ karoti vai śatam ।
bhuvaneśi bhuvaneśi bhuvaneśīti saṃjapan ।। 1 1।।
ante dehi ca putraṃ me prārthya gṛhaṃ prayāti saḥ ।
evaṃ vai varṣaparyantaṃ pracakāra tapaḥ śubham ।। 1 2।।
varṣāyāṃ śiśire tāpe śaityādhikye'pi sarvathā ।
vratabhaṃgaṃ na cā'vāpa śraddhayā tīvrayā tathā ।। 13 ।।
titikṣayā guṇenāpi vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
varṣānte bhuvaneśī sā navarātrāntime dine ।। 14।।
sākṣādbabhūva bhaktasya prasannā'smītyuvāca tam ।
bhakto'pi vīkṣya tejo'ntamūrtiṃ divyāṃ surūpiṇīm ।। 15 ।।
tryakṣāṃ śūladharāṃ śvetāṃ prasannavadanāṃ satīm ।
siṃhasthāṃ varadānārthaṃ kṛtordhvahastakāṃ śubhām ।। 16 ।।
praṇanāma jayaśabdaṃ jagāda ca nanarta ca ।
mātarmanorathaścādya phalito me supuṣpitaḥ ।। 17।।
yā sākṣājjagatāṃ dhātrī mama dṛṣṭimupāgatā ।
svalpenaiva hi tapasā phalaṃ labdhaṃ mayā bahu ।। 18।।
kiṃ karomi ca pūjādi cātmanā'rpitavāhanam ।
pādayoste patito'smi mānasaṃ nihitaṃ tvayi ।। 19 ।।
yāsāṃ prajānāṃ jananī rakṣayitrī ca poṣikā ।
vartate sarvathā tāsāṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ।। 2.162.20।।
mama duḥkhaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ viṣṭijātīyakasya vai ।
ityuktvā pradadau śreṣṭhaṃ baliṃ pūjāṃ tathopadāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
prasannā bhuvaneśī sā jagāda praṇataṃ janam ।
varaṃ vṛṇu drutaṃ bhakta kiṃ te manasi vartate ।। 22।।
śīghraṃ dadāmi varadā nā'deyaṃ vidyate tava ।
ityuktaḥ saḥ śatoḍhuśca devīprabhāvadharṣitaḥ ।। 23 ।।
maunaṃ dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ ca ceṣṭayā bālakaṃ śubham ।
vavre kukṣau karau kṛtvā maunicihnena putrakam ।। 24।।
devī tathā'stviti prāha mūkaḥ putro bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā tu tirobhāvaṃ prāptā śatoḍhurityapi ।। 25।।
śamīṃ praṇamya devīṃ ca kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ ।
kṣamāṃ prārthyā'ntimāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau tataḥ ।।26।।
patnyai prāha kathāṃ sarvāṃ mūkaputrābhidāyinīm ।
sāpi śrutvā putramodaṃ mūkā'modaṃ jagāma ha ।।27।।
atha varṣāntare jāto bālo devīpratāpataḥ ।
vavṛdhe candrasadṛśo mūko vāṇīvivarjitaḥ ।।28।।
saṃskṛto bahudhā ceṣṭāvijñānaiḥ pratibodhitaḥ ।
janayāmāsa harṣaṃ sa pitrorvaṃśasutantukaḥ ।।29।।
vāṇīśūnyatvamevātra śokasthalaṃ hi vartate ।
pitā viṣṭisvarūpeṇaikadā śreṣṭhipravāhaṇaḥ ।।2.162.3 0।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthayātrārthaṃ gatavāँstadā ।
kathāṃ śuśrāva ca rātrau lomaśasyāśrame śubhām ।।3 1।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ sarvārthasādhikām ।
cakṣurdadāti deveśaścāndhāya suprasāditaḥ ।।32।।
karṇau dadāti bhagavān badhirāya prarādhitaḥ ।
paṅguṃ pādau samarpyaiva dadhāti sukhinaṃ hariḥ ।।33।।
vṛkṇaṃ karau pradāyaiva karoti sukhinaṃ śritam ।
kuṣṭhinaṃ kuṣṭharahitaṃ karotyeva janārdanaḥ ।।34।।
daridraṃ sampadā yuktaṃ karotyeva śriyāḥ patiḥ ।
sarvakāmān hariḥ so'yaṃ svāmikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।35।।
pūrayatyeva bhaktasya gopālakambharāsutaḥ ।
tīrthe vāsaḥ sadā kṛtvā yaścainaṃ pūjayeddharim ।।36 ।।
tasya sarvaṃ bhavet siddhaṃ prayatno niṣphalo nahi ।
ityevaṃ sa śatoḍhuśca śrutvā kathāṃ sarastaṭe ।।37।।
suṣvāpa ca tadā rātrau nidrāyāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
bhagavān divyarūpaḥ sa śatoḍhoḥ sannidhau tadā ।।38।।
āgatyāha ca te bhakta cintā dūre bhaviṣyati ।
voḍhurnāmnā tava putraścātrāgatya ca tapsyati ।।39।।
tasya vāṇī svayaṃ cātra sāṃkurā saṃbhaviṣyati ।
yāhi gṛhaṃ tataḥ putraṃ nītvā cāśvasarovaram ।।2.162.40।।
samāyāhi tataste'tra mānasaṃ phalavad yataḥ ।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastiro'bhavat ।।41।।
prabuddhaśca śatoḍhustanmahāścaryaṃ hyacintayat ।
satyaṃ kṣetraphalaṃ jātaṃ tīrthāgamanamātrataḥ ।।42।।
yathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā svapne tathā karomi vai śubham ।
ityevaṃ ca vinirṇīya kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu sārthakaiḥ ।।43 ।।
śreṣṭhinaḥ śibikāsthāँśca prāpayya tadgṛhāṇi ca ।
gṛhaṃ gatvā nijāṃ bhāryāṃ prāha sarvaṃ yathāyatham ।।44।।
putrasya śāradāsiddhyai cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
vāso yogyo mato me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrahāt ।।45।।
ityuktvā sammatiṃ prāpya patnyāḥ putraṃ nināya saḥ ।
śatoḍhuśca saha patnyā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।46।।
voḍhustatra mahāmūko janmamūko niśāmukhe ।
suptaḥ svapnaṃ dadarśā'tha tapasā vākprakāśatām ।।47।।
ceṣṭayā pitarau prātarvijñāya svāpnavaibhavam ।
voḍhuḥ svayaṃ cakāraiva tapastāpasinaḥ kramāt ।।48।।
prathamaṃ sa yayau tatra lomaśasya mahāśramam ।
mantraṃ jagrāha vidhinā pañcagavyasya cādanam ।।49।।
cakāra dehaśuddhiṃ ca dadhāra taulasīṃ srajam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।2.162.50 ।।
samprāptaṃ taṃ manuṃ śaśvajjapan śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।
draṣṭuṃ devālayaṃ gatvā natvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।।51 ।।
pītvā pādodakaṃ tasya sarastaṭamupāyayau ।
praṇamya caraṇau pitroścāmalakīdrumāśraye ।।52।।
bhūtale sa niṣadyaiva kuśāsane tu mālayā ।
japaṃ kurvan hariṃ dhyāyan śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।53।।
vṛttīḥ sarvāścāntare ca kṛtvā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ।
vāgarthaṃ sa tapastepe cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।।54।।
mūrtiṃ vidhāya vai svalpāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya saikatīm ।
sarvopacārakaistasyāḥ pūjāṃ cakre trikālikīm ।।55।।
mālājapaṃ cakārāpi vāṇīṃ dehīti mānasam ।
tulasīvanato nitya samāhṛtya dalāyutam ।।56।।
arpayati sma nityaṃ vai bālakṛṣṇāya pūjane ।
svayaṃ tulasīpatrāṇi bhuṃkte māsaṃ nināya saḥ ।।57।।
māse dvitīyake vanyaphalāhāro babhūva saḥ ।
tṛtīye māsi bhājānāṃ patrādaḥ sa babhūva ca ।।58।।
caturthe kandamūlānāmāhāreṇa sa vartate ।
pañcame jalamātreṇa ṣaṣṭhe vāyuprajīvanaḥ ।।59।।
saptame phenapaścāpi babhūva jalaśāyanaḥ ।
jale kṛtvā vicāraṃ sa naśyāmi vā vadāmi vā ।।2.162.60।।
arpayāmi haraye'tra cātmānaṃ mokṣaṇāya tu ।
ityevaṃ sa vinirdhārya jalavāso'bhavattataḥ ।।61।।
nāmaraṭaṇamātraṃ vai jānātyeva na cetarat ।
mānasaṃ raṭaṇaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇāntaṃ ca tapaḥ param ।।62।।
viditvā bālakṛṣṇo'yaṃ tutoṣa bālakāya saḥ ।
voḍhuścā'yaṃ śāradārthaṃ tapastapati dāruṇam ।।63 ।।
madarthaṃ tyaktasarvasvo maraṇāya kṛtādaraḥ ।
toṣaṇīyo mayā bhakto vāṇīdānena vai bhuvi ।।64।।
śaraṇāgatarakṣo'haṃ bhaktatrātā bhavāmi ca ।
kṛpayā sādhya evā'haṃ kṛpayā toṣayāmi tam ।।65।।
iti vicārya bhagavān bhaktānugrahasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kapilarūpadhṛk ।।66।।
sādhuveṣaḥ piṅgajaṭaḥ skandhe dhṛtopavītakaḥ ।
kare kamaṇḍaluṃ bibhran kukṣau cādhārapāvaṭīm ।।67।।
mṛgacarma dadhan mālāṃ sphāṭikīṃ jolikāṃ dadhan ।
yuvā tejaḥpravāhaiśca saṃśobhadvigrahaḥ śubhaḥ ।।68।।
bhasmacchannaśarīraśca kaupīnāmbarabhūṣitaḥ ।
surūpaḥ śāntamūrtiśca hṛdaye svarṇarekhakaḥ ।।69।।
matsyaśūladhanuḥsvastidhvajacihnitahastakaḥ ।
vāmasakthni śubhralakṣmīcandracihnavirājitaḥ ।।2.162.70।।।
sādhuveṣo'pi bhagavān divyasiddhivirājitaḥ ।
akasmād vyomamārgeṇa tejomaṇḍalamadhyataḥ ।।71।।
avātatāra salile bhaktāgre susthiro'bhavat ।
anādhāro jalādhāro bhagavān voḍhumeva tam ।।72।।
dakṣahastena connītvā sarastaṭe nidhāya ca ।
netre pramṛjya coddhāṭya darśanaṃ pradadau nijam ।।73।।
prāha kasmājjale tvaṃ vai vartase'tra kimicchasi ।
vada dāsye samagraṃ te tapasā'smi pratoṣitaḥ ।।74।।
ananyasya bhavāmyeva cātmasamarpako'pyaham ।
ananyo me bhavāñjātastavā'nanyo bhavāmyaham ।।75।।
vada śīghraṃ varaṃ yācasvātra dadāmi cepsitam ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān karuṇānidhiḥ ।।76 ।।
voḍhuḥ svāsthyaṃ samāpanno bhānayuk śrīhariṃ tadā ।
sādhuveṣaṃ varadaṃ ca ramyarūpaṃ vilokya vai ।।77।।
atiharṣātimagnaścotthāya papāta pādayoḥ ।
hareścaraṇatalayoścāvalehaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।78।।
hṛdaye bhagavatpādau nyadhāt kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ yayau ।
mastake karakamale nyadhāt cakāra daṇḍavat ।।79।।
netrāśrūṇi mumocāpi snehodbharātivihvalaḥ ।
romāñcatāṃ tadā prāpto'ceṣṭayat parameśvaram ।।2.162.80। ।
mānasenaiva bhāvena jihvāṃ pradarśya ceṣṭayā ।
nāsti vāṇī kṛpāsindho vāṇīṃ dehi kṛpāṃ kuru ।।8 1 ।।
iti sarvaṃ ceṣṭayaiva jñāpayāmāsa mādhavam ।
piṅgalaṃ kapilaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ darśayāmāsa jihvikām ।।82।।
bhagavānapi dīnasyoddhārakartā kareṇa tām ।
prahasan darśitāṃ jihvāṃ pasparśā'ṅgulibhirmudā ।।83 ।।
samākṛṣya manāk tatra kamaṇḍalorjalaṃ dadau ।
śvetavarṇaṃ sarvavidyāśritaṃ līnaṃ ca tatra tat ।।84।।
babhūva yatra salile sākṣāt sarasvatī hyabhūt ।
brahmajñānaṃ hyabhūdyatra sāṃkhyavijñānamityapi ।।85।।
vedānāṃ sarvavijñānaṃ tattvadṛṣṭirabhūttathā ।
evaṃ jalamiṣeṇaiva tattvapradarśitāṃ dadau ।।86।।
tāvadvāṇī devavāṇī gīrvāṇavāk susaṃskṛtā ।
prādurabhūt tadā voḍhujihvāyāṃ kṛpayā hareḥ ।।87।।
stutiṃ cakāra vividhāṃ voḍhurvedamayīṃ hareḥ ।
bṛhadbrahmaṇyayanavān divyaviprāsanaśca yaḥ ।।88।।
īśanībhirjuṣṭapadaḥ śrīśo'vatvakhilāspadaḥ ।
prāvirbhāvāṃ'śadivyātmā'saṃkhyadharmābhirarcitaḥ ।।89।।
īśakoṭiratho juṣṭo bhagī me bharaṇaṃ kuru ।
vedahṛd vāṅpravistāraḥ śāradādhipatiḥ pumān ।।2.162.90।।
sarasvatīpatiḥ pātā'raṇaṃ me kuru piṃgalaḥ ।
indrendro'gocaro vācāṃ dehabhedātmadarśakaḥ ।।91।।
prākṛtāṃ'śapṛthagrūpaḥ kapilo māṃ sadā'vatu ।
yaḥ kraturjātavedāśca siddharṣibrahmapādapaḥ ।।92।।
satīrthyaścātmanāṃ stambaḥ sāmbaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prarakṣatu ।
pṛthubhūtāni sūkṣmāṇi raśmayaśca pravāhaṇam ।।93।।
sphurtayaścāpūrakāṇi yacchrayāṇi sa mā'vatu ।
yajjīvaṃ cāṃkurāt sarvaṃ yadātmakaṃ viśiṣyate ।।94।।
yatpratnaṃ sakriyaṃ caitajjāyate budhnakaṃ punaḥ ।
tasmai devāya divyāya vidhema haviṣā hṛdā ।।95।।
rādhayeyaṃ ca taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu kaṃbhṛtam ।
kāmbhareyaṃ kāpilākhyaṃ guruṃ śamastu tatpade ।।96।।
iti stutvā rādhike sa papāta kṛṣṇapādayoḥ ।
kapilākhyaharistatra śīghramantaradhīyata ।।97।।
voḍhurvijñānamāpanno divyarṣiścābhavattataḥ ।
sāṃkhyayogāditattvānāṃ vyākhyātā paṇḍitaḥ śubhiḥ ।।98।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kapilarūpiṇam ।
yatra tīrthe dadarśā'sau kapilaṃ tīrthameva tat ।।99।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva jātaṃ vidyāpradaṃ śubham ।
tatra voḍhurdadau lokebhyo vijñānaṃ tu tāttvikam ।। 2.162.10 0।।
voḍhvāśrame harermūrti kāpilīṃ sundarāṃginīm ।
sarastīre pratiṣṭhāpya voḍhuḥ pupūja nityaśaḥ ।। 10 1।।
mandiraṃ ramaṇīyaṃ vai kāpileyaṃ tato'bhavat ।
māghapūrṇādine voḍhurjñānaṃ vāṇīṃ ca darśanam ।। 1 02।।
avāpa śrīharestatra ciraṃ vāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tato mokṣaṃ gato voḍhuḥ rādhike yugaparyaye ।। 1 03।।
tatra snātvā kathāṃ śrutvā brahmajñānamavāpnuyāt ।
aihikīṃ tu parāṃ siddhiṃ cāpnuyānnahi saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śibikāvāhaśatoḍhutapasyayā labdhasya mūkaputrasya voḍhoścāśvapaṭṭasarasi tapasā kapilarūpeṇa śrīharerdarśanaṃ sāṃkhyajñānavāṇīsiddhiprāptiścetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 162 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 162 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 163
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 164 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ śubham ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pravadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre pāvane kāmyake pure ।
karṣuko bhagavadbhakto dyuviśrāmā'bhidho'bhavat ।। 2 ।।
dharmaṃ karma na jānāti naiva jānāti pūjanam ।
naiva jānāti śāstroktaṃ vidhānaṃ daivakarma ca ।। 3 ।।
gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ caiva govṛṣāṇāṃ prapālanam ।
jānātyeva paraṃ karma kṛṣiṃ jānāti cottamām ।। 4 ।।
snānaṃ gopādarajasā sandhyā gokavalārpaṇam ।
gāyatrī gonāmajapaḥ pūjanaṃ goprarakṣaṇam ।। 5 ।।
vaiśvadevo nijabhuktiḥ svādhyāyaḥ kṛṣireva tu ।
homo roṭakanirmāṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sasyapoṣaṇam ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ tasya karmakāṇḍaḥ kṛṣikārye pravartate ।
nānyat kiñcit sa jānāti tathāpi śuddhamānasaḥ ।। 7 ।।
na cauryaṃ nā'nṛtavṛttirna droho jantuhiṃsanam ।
na pratāraṇakāryaṃ ca vidyate'sya hṛdi kvacit ।। 8 ।।
akalmaṣo vṛddhasevī gosevāpuṇyabhāg vratī ।
kṣetre vāṭyāṃ samāgacchedatithiścet sa pūjyate ।। 9 ।।
dīyate'tithaye cekṣudaṇḍaḥ śākadalādikam ।
phalaṃ mūlaṃ dalaṃ kandaḥ vāso'pi pūlakagṛhe ।। 2.163.1 0।।
sādhurvā bhagavadbhaktaḥ kaścidāyāttu vāṭikām ।
sastrīputraḥ sevate taṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
rātrau kṣetre drumā'dho bhūtale vahnikhale śubhe ।
vahniṃ prajvālya viśrāntiṃ tatprakāśe pravindati ।। 12।।
mānasyai tu pratimāyai samarpayati bhojanam ।
jalaṃ phalaṃ mūlakandaṃ kaṇān dalādikaṃ ca yat ।। 1 3।।
rātrau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ smṛtvā nidrāṃ pragacchati ।
prātarutthāya śārīraṃ kṛtvā śuddhimayaṃ tataḥ ।। 14।।
gṛhītvā bhojanaṃ kṣetre kṛṣikārye pravartate ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya niṣpāpasya gṛhe kvacit। ।। 15।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ kartuṃ vai bhaktamaṇḍalam ।
samāyātaṃ niśāraṃbhe jñātvā''śrayapadaṃ tu tam ।। 16।।
so'pyāśrayaṃ dadau kāṇḍaśālāyāṃ bhāvabhaktimān ।
bhaktebhyaḥ sa dadau vāri dugdhaṃ ca roṭakādikam ।। 17।।
tārṇāsanāni pradadau viśrāntiṃ cāpureva te ।
niśāyāṃ bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ ।। 18।।
kīrtane'nādikṛṣṇaśrīpatinārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
kīrtitaḥ kaṃbharāputraḥ prabhurgopālanandanaḥ ।। 19।।
svarūpā'dvaitarūpaḥ sa yo'kṣare dhāmni vai pare ।
vartate divyarūpaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।2.163.20।।
sarvāvatāradhartā ca sarvāntaryāmī mādhavaḥ ।
jaḍacetanajātātmā bālakṛṣṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।।21 ।।
īśvarāṇāmīśvaro yo devānāmapi daivatam ।
prāṇināṃ prāṇarūpo yo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।22।।
indriyāṇāṃ tu yaścendro vastūnāṃ vāstavaṃ balam ।
karmaṇāṃ phalado yaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।23।।
viprāṇāṃ pāvano dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāmadhṛṣyatā ।
vaiśyānāṃ sasyasampattirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।24।।
vṛkṣāṇāṃ rasasampattirvallīnāṃ phalapuṣpitā ।
dāsānāṃ sevikāvṛttirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।25।।
varṇināṃ brahmacaryaṃ yad gṛhasthānāṃ saputratā ।
yatīnāṃ ca satāṃ brahma bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।26।।
rājñāṃ nītiḥ prajānāṃ ca dāsyaṃ paropakāritā ।
anugrahaśca devānāṃ vālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।27।।।
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ vahneśca vidyutāmapi ।
maṇīnāṃ cakṣuṣā tejo bālakṛṣṇa sa eva saḥ ।।28।।
yā tṛptirdehināṃ bhojye bhogye tṛptiśca yā matā ।
yā śāntiḥ prāpyalābhe'sti bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।29।।
viśvāse phalavattā yā dāne śraddhā ca yā matā ।
kathāyāṃ cāntaro bodho bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।2.163.3 0।।
yajñe yaddhavanaṃ proktaṃ vipreṣu sattvabhāvanā ।
yajamāne dadadvṛttirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।3 1।।
garbhatanturyasya haste daurhṛdatvaṃ ca yatkṛtam ।
nālapuṣṭervidhātā ca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।। 32।।
cidākāśājaḍākāśaṃ kṛtavān yo nirañjanaḥ ।
racayāmāsa cāṇḍāni bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।33।।
kulālān brahmasaṃjñāँśca karṣukān viṣṇusaṃjñitān ।
lunakān rudrakāँścakre bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva yaḥ ।। 34।।
dugdhayantrātmakapaśūn rasayantrātmapādapān ।
jñānayantranarāँścakre bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva yaḥ ।। 35।।
ārtavaṃ ca jagaccakraṃ cālayanniyamena yaḥ ।
viśvakarmatvamāpanno bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।36।।
ekasmād bhūstarāt khādyaṃ bhakṣayitvā'pi pādapāḥ ।
bījabhedād bhinnabhāvāḥ bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa bījakaḥ ।। 37।।
bhojyaṃ caikavidhaṃ nyastaṃ jaṭhare bhinnarūpi yat ।
bhinnaguṇaṃ yena dehe bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa jāṭharaḥ ।।38।।
adṛśyād dṛśyabhāvāstu sajātīyāt sajātikāḥ ।
bhavantyeva yadāveśād bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।। 39।।
mantrādhīnāstathā devā vāgadhīnā'rthaśemuṣī ।
ātmādhīnaṃ jaḍaṃ yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।2.163.40 ।।
iṣṭādhīnaścecchukaśca karmādhīnaṃ tathā jagat ।
yadadhīnā parāmuktirbālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।41।।
atithīn sevate yaśca tasmai sevāphalapradaḥ ।
bījavacchatadhā dātā bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।।42।।
sarvasaukhyapradātā yaḥ sarvarakṣākaraśca yaḥ ।
sarvamānasapūraśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।43।।।
rātrirviśrāntidā yena dinaṃ pravṛttidaṃ kṛtam ।
nidrā śramaharā klṛptā bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।44।।
sādhurūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ yena vairājaṃ ca tathā dhṛtam ।
paramāṇuḥ kṛto yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।45।।
mārdavaṃ divyavastrādau kāṭhinyaṃ copalādiṣu ।
dehe dvayaṃ kṛtaṃ yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।46।।
mahākālaḥ kṛto yena mahāmāyā yamāśritā ।
puruṣo yojito yena bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।47।।
pralayaśca kṛto yena sargo yena kṛto muhuḥ ।
nirlepastatra yaścāste bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।48।।
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ mahālobhaṃ mohaṃ madṃ ca matsaram ।
ākurvannapi cā'sakto bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।49।।
sadṛśeṣvapi bījeṣu vibhinnaśaktidhāyakaḥ ।
bhinnapākapradātā yo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।2.163.50 ।।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo viṣṇurvāsudevo'kṣarādhipaḥ ।
antarātmeśvaro yaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।। 51।।
bhagavān paramātmā ca hariḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhālakṣmīpatiryaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।52।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre sahasrakalaśālaye ।
brahmapriyā'saṃkhyasevyo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।53।।
bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyaścintanīyaśca yo hṛdi ।
sevayā prāpaṇīyaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।।54।।
evaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ cakruḥ sarve bhaktā niśotsave ।
dyuviśrāmaḥ karṣukaśca śrutvā''nandaṃ lalābha ha ।।55।।
jijñāsāṃ kṛtavān mantragrahaṇe'tithimaṇḍalāt ।
atithistatra vipraśca ṣaḍguṇākhya uvāca tam ।।56।।
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ devasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mat ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।57।।
itimantraṃ dadau tasmai karṣukāya tu ṣaḍguṇaḥ ।
sukaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ cāpi dadau nāma narāyaṇam ।।58।।
mālikāṃ pradadau tasmai japārthaṃ pratimāṃ tathā ।
dadau darśanakāryārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca ।।59।।
mālāyāṃ japanārthaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti ca ।
dadau nāma tadā sarve prātastasmātpratasthire ।।2.163.60।।
āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ śrīlomaśāśramam ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi sahasraghaṭamandiram ।।61।।
udyānaṃ sarvatīrthāni vyadhustato narāyaṇam ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ yayuḥ sarve rājamānaṃ gṛhāntare ।।62।।
sampūjya vidhivattīrthaṃ kṛtvā deśaṃ nijaṃ yayuḥ ।
dyuviśrāmaḥ kṛṣīvalaḥ sakuṭumbo mudānvitaḥ ।।63।।
vicārya tīrthayātrārthaṃ niryayau kāmyakātpurāt ।
gobhirgovṛṣabhaiḥ sākaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।64।।
āyayau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇan samutsukaḥ ।
cārayan vai vane gāśca vṛṣabhān sāyamāpa tat ।।65।।
sarastīre pūrvadakṣe viśrāntiṃ niśi cākarot ।
pāyayitvā jalaṃ gāśca vṛṣabhān pādapāśraye ।।66 ।।
vyasarjayanniṣeduste paśavaḥ sukhato'ntike ।
rātrau nidrāvaśaṃ yātāḥ paśavo mānavāśca te ।।67।।
pariśramaṃ cādhvajaṃ te vyapānudan sunidrayā ।
aviśaṃkāstīrthabhūmau svapanti sarasastaṭe ।। 68।।
ardharātrau vyatītāyāṃ śānte mānavasañcare ।
grāmaśabde praśānte ca nidrāptapaśupakṣiṣu ।।69 ।।
siṃhānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāyāt saptānāṃ vyāghrajaṃgalāt ।
akasmād govṛṣān tadvai jagrāhā'tibhayaṃkaram ।।2.163.70।।
gāvaśca vṛṣabhāścāpyākrośāँścakruḥ praraṃbhaṇān ।
ākrandanāni viśrutya janā bubudhire drutam ।।7 1 ।।
bhagavantaṃ sasmaruśca rakṣārthaṃ parameśvaram ।
bhakto'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra vai hṛdā ।।72।।
āyāhi bhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa parātpara ।
sarvajīvā'dhivāsa tvaṃ rakṣa trāhi ca pāhi ca ।।73।।
godhanaṃ me durbalasya balaṃ kṛṣīvalasya yat ।
siṃhairvināśyate cette dāso duḥkhī bhaviṣyati ।।74।।
śīghraṃ kuru mahārāja yāvannaivābhidharṣitam ।
dharṣaṇe naiva jīveyurgāvo vā vṛṣabhāstava ।।75।।
tvaccharaṇe'rpitāśceme paśavo me na santi vai ।
tvameva rakṣa bhagavan dugdhaṃ piba yathocitam ।।76।।
gā dāsye te mahārāja śīghraṃ pāhi ca rakṣaya ।
ityuccārya mahākāṣṭhaṃ vahnidagdhaṃ savahnikam ।।77।।
samuttolya sthito bhaktaḥ siṃhānāṃ sannidhau haṭhāt ।
siṃhāstu garjanāścakrurmuhurnādairbhayaṃkaraiḥ ।।78।।
saraḥkṣetraṃ samastaṃ tannāditaṃ garjanāmayam ।
tresuśca dehinaḥ sarve vinidrā garjanādibhiḥ ।।79।।
vidudruvuritastato bahiranto bhayārditāḥ ।
sāgnikaṃ tanmahākāṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhā bhayānvitāḥ ।।2.163.80 ।।
nopājagmuḥ sannidhau vai kintu gāvo bhayānvitāḥ ।
saraḥsetuṃ parityajya dudruvurdūrameva yat। ।।8 1 ।।
tatpṛṣṭhe dudruvuḥ siṃhā dadhrurdūraṃ gatāśca tāḥ ।
ruroda bhaktavaryaśca paśavo jñānavarjitāḥ ।।82।।
siṃhavajraparābhūtāḥ kiṃ karomyatra so'rudat ।
bhaktarakṣākarastāvad bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।।।83 ।।
gopālabālako devaścakradhāryabhavat kṣaṇāt। ।
harṣanādaṃ nadan kṛṣṇo mumoca cakramulbaṇam ।।84।।
vegādgataṃ bhramaccakraṃ jaghānasiṃhamaṇḍalam ।
yatra yatra paśūnāṃ tu nakhasparśo'bhavattadā ।।85।।
vidāraṇaṃ tvacāṃ cā'bhūt siṃhakṛtaṃ ca bhañjanam ।
tatra tatra paśudehe pasparśa svakareṇa saḥ ।।86 ।।
dayālurbhagavān śīghraṃ rujaṃ nyavārayat kṣaṇāt ।
sandhānaṃ ca tvacāṃ sparśamātreṇa pūrvavaddhariḥ ।।87।।
pracakāra yathā sparśo nakhānāṃ naiva vidyate ।
navā raktasya saṃsrāvastatra tatrā'bhavaddhyapi ।।88।।
śrīhareḥ karasaṃsparśād raktasrāvo'pi nā'bhavat ।
yathā devaśarīraṃ vai nīrujaṃ tādṛśāni vai ।।89।।
gavāṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śarīrāṇi kṛtāni vai ।
godhanaṃ rakṣitaṃ caivaṃ tato vaṃśīṃ vyanādayat ।।2.163.90।।
bhaktasya sannidhau gatvā bhaktaṃ ca samabhāvayat ।
godhanaṃ sahasā śrutvā vaṃśīṃ bālaharestadā ।।9 1 ।।
tūrṇaṃ cāyāt sarastīre dyuviśrāmasya sannidhau ।
bhagavān cakradhāryeva niṣasādā'sane'rpite ।।92।।
govṛṣāśca samāgatya lilihurharipatkajam ।
dugdhadhārāḥ pramuñcantyo gāvaścakrurhi raṃbhaṇam ।।93 ।।
bhakto dugdhāni tatkālaṃ dohayitvā hariṃ prabhum ।
pāyayāmāsa ruciraṃ miṣṭaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ payo muhuḥ ।।94।।
praśaṃsan bhagavān dugdhaṃ papau bhaktasamarpitam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ hastacatuṣṭayam ।।95।।
darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ haryavatārarūpiṇam ।
siṃhebhyaśca dadau muktiṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāhiṇoddhi tān ।।96।।
dyuviśrāmaṃ ca tatpatnīṃ putrān putrīḥ kuṭumbakam ।
divyaṃ rūpaṃ darśayitvā haristūrṇaṃ tiro'bhavat ।।97।।
phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ rātrimadhyake ।
siṃhebhyastu gavāṃ rakṣāṃ cakāra bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।98।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca dadau bhakto dānāni vividhānyapi ।
pūjayāmāsa bhāvaiśca śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।।99।।
dyuviśrāmo dadau bālakṛṣṇāya godhanaṃ tadā ।
hariḥ pratyarpayāmāsa bhakto'pi mumude hyati ।। 2.163.10 0।।
haryājñayā ca gāḥ prāpya yayau svaṃ kāmyakaṃ puram ।
tattīrthaṃ haritīrthākhyaṃ gotīrthaṃ khyātamapyabhūt ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ tatra kṛṣīvalaiḥ kāritaṃ harimandiram ।
hariṃ ca sthāpayāmāsuścaturbhujaṃ pareśvaram ।। 1 02।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca gāstatra sthāpayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktistathā bhavet ।। 1 03।।
godānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ koṇe'gnāvāśvasārase ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasannatāṃ vrajet ।। 1 04।।
rādhike yamadūtebhyo rakṣāṃ kuryāddhi tīrthinaḥ ।
godāturvṛṣadātuśca bālakṛṣṇo dayānidhiḥ ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dyuviśrāmākhyakṛṣikārasya siṃhapradharṣitagodhanasyā'vanaṃ harirūpeṇa bhagavatā kṛtaṃ haritīrthaṃ gotīrthaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā
triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 163 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 163 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 164
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 165 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ harestataḥ ।
bakasrāvākhyanagare vyāghrāraṇyābhisaṃsthite ।। 1 ।।
bahuvṛkṣasamākīrṇe yatisādhunivāsite ।
cāturvarṇyajanavyāpte vṛkaśāvīnadītaṭe ।। 2 ।।
nīlakarṇākhyacātvālo vasati sma kuṭumbayuk।
jyeṣṭhe'raṇye cātivṛṣṭyā nadīpūre tu pattanam ।। 3 ।।
magnaṃ samantato jātaṃ mānavāḥ paśavastathā ।
mṛtāścānnāni naṣṭāni bhakṣyaṃ kvāpi na labhyate ।।4 ।।
saptāhavṛṣṭyā bhūbhāgaḥ samudra iva dṛśyate ।
mārgā ruddhā gamanasya grāmāntaraṃ na gamyate ।। 5 ।।
cātvālaḥ sakuṭumbo'sau druśākhāsvavalambate ।
baddhvā kāṣṭhāni vallyā ca śākhādolāsu jīvati ।। 6 ।।
kuṭumbaṃ cāpi śākhāsu preṃkhāsu cābhijīvati ।
kṣudhitaṃ tadabhūccāpi mṛtinaikaṭyamāsa ca ।। 7 ।।
vṛkāyano maharṣiśca samādhisthitimāsthitaḥ ।
uhyamānaśca kallolairāyād vṛkṣasya sannidhau ।। 8 ।।
cātvālena tadā dīrgharajjvā cāvṛtya śākhayā ।
niruddhastatra vṛkṣādho vṛkṣastambanirodhitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
cātvālena śanairvṛkṣādavatīrya vṛkāyanaḥ ।
jaṭayā saṃgṛhītaśca śākhāyāmadhiropitaḥ ।। 2.164.10 ।।
atidurbaladeho'yaṃ samādhau magna eva tu ।
viveda naiva vṛṣṭyādi vahanaṃ drumarodhanam ।। 11 ।।
cātvālena muhuḥ spṛṣṭaḥ kampito mastake ca saḥ ।
bahudhvānairbodhitaśca jāgratiṃ cāpa vai ṛṣiḥ ।। 12।।
tadā sa jñātavān sarvaṃ cātivṛṣṭimayaṃ jalam ।
śīghraṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।। 13 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkṛṣṇavallabha ।
gopālanandana lakṣmīpate śrīkaṃbharātmaja ।। 14।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrakṛtaprākaṭya keśava ।
brahmapriyāpate ramāmāṇikīpadmajāpate ।। 15।।
satāṃ pate bibho dhāmākṣarādhipa pareśvara ।
rakṣa rakṣa janān kṛṣṇa cātivṛṣṭyā'tiduḥkhitān ।। 16।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre prārthanāṃ ca vṛkāyanaḥ ।। 17।।
tāvattasyātibhāvena bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
śvetagajasamārūḍho vyomamārgeṇa cāyayau ।। 18।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaraḥ mukuṭamastakaḥ ।
vaijayantīkaṇṭhakaśca sudarśanāṅgulīyakaḥ ।। 19।।
mandahāsānanaḥ premavarṣāmuñcatsunetrakaḥ ।
bhojyasaṃbhṛtapeṭāyuk aurṇavastrādimañjuṣaḥ ।।2.164.20।।
chatracāmarasaṃśobhatpārṣadadvayasevitaḥ ।
ākāśamārgataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya drumāntare ।।2 1।।
śākhāyāṃ ca svayaṃ bālo niṣadya peṭikādvayāt ।
bhakṣyaṃ pradattavān tasmai vṛkāyanāya tatkṣaṇam ।।22।।
nīlakarṇakuṭumbāya nīlakarṇāya vai dadau ।
bhakṣyaṃ pūrṇaṃ ca vastrāṇi dadau śrībhagavān svayam ।।23।।
nīlakarṇo hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkuṭumbaṃ nirāśrayam ।
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ sākṣāt sādhuyogena vai tadā ।।24।।
babhūva kṛtakṛtyo vai bubhuje ca prasādajam ।
annaṃ dadhāra vastrāṇi śaityaṃ dūraṃ gataṃ tadā ।।25।।
praṇanāma muhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
vṛkāyano maharṣiśca stotraṃ cakāra vai hareḥ ।।26।।
pūjanaṃ pracakārā'sau śālavṛkṣadalaistadā ।
vṛṣṭijalairmanobhāvaiḥ pupūja parameśvaram ।।27।।
yena rakṣā kṛtā''rambhe brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ।
tena tvayā'tra me rakṣā kṛtā tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।28।।
yena rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ satyavratasya sāgare ।
tena tvayātra me rakṣā kṛtā tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।29।।
yenā'bdhimanthane rakṣā bahūnāṃ vai kṛtā purā ।
yena devā rakṣitāśca daityāstu vinipātitāḥ ।।2.164.30।।
yena dugdhā medinī ca rakṣitāḥ prāṇinaḥ purā ।
yena sāgaratalagā rakṣitā vai kṣitiḥ purā ।।3 1 ।।
yenā'ṅguṣṭhajalenaitad brahmāṇḍaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛtam ।
tena tvayā'tra me rakṣā vihitā te namo'stu ca ।। 32।।
yena dhruvaśca prahlādo rakṣitau bālakau purā ।
yena sāṇāsuraścātra ghātitaḥ paramātmanā ।।33।।
talājā rakṣitā yena mokṣitā śaraṇāgatā ।
daityo damanako yena mokṣitaḥ paramātmanā ।।34।।
kaṃkatālā mokṣitāśca nārakā mokṣitāstathā ।
sālamālo nāśitaśca yena tenā'vito'smi ca ।।35।।
bālāḥ prabhokṣitā yena rājyamātā pramokṣitā ।
vallīdīno nāśitaśca varāṭako vināśitaḥ ।।36।।
vanaspatyādayo yena rakṣobhāvād vimocitāḥ ।
devāyanasamuddhāraścāṇḍālayonitaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।37।।
kaṃthādharaḥ kṛto yena ciraṃjīvo'pi vai tataḥ ।
raṇaṃgamena putreṇa tārito yena śārṅgiṇā ।। 38।।
māँjāṃmbikā rakṣitā ca mlecchā vināśitāstathā ।
raktabījo nāśitaśca yena tenā'vito'smyaham ।।39।।
jalamagno nṛpatiśca rakṣito hyudayābhidhaḥ ।
vasumedho rakṣitaśca jale yena namo'stu te ।।2.164.40।।
jyāmaghastārito yena caurebhyaḥ sudhano'vitaḥ ।
tryaṣṭakārurmokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namo'stu me ।।41 ।।
hiraṇyakeśaśiṣyāśca sajīvā yena vai kṛtāḥ ।
vṛhadvarcāstāritaśca baleśvaro'pi mokṣitaḥ ।।42।।
jayadhvajo mokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namo'stu me ।
ailavilā tāritā cā'dharmajīvo vināśitaḥ ।।43।।
mahāmārī nāśitā ca mṛtā yena tu jīvitāḥ ।
uṣṇālayaprajā vārimṛtā yena prajīvitāḥ ।।44।।
cakravākyai jalaṃ yena giriśṛṃge samarpitam ।
mārjārībālakā yena vahnibhrāṣṭryāṃ prarakṣitāḥ ।।45।।
kiṃpuruṣapradeśāśca prāgjyotirbhūpradeśakāḥ ।
yajñādyaiḥ pāvitā yena tasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।46।।
samīraṇo'vito yena pavamāno'pi rakṣitaḥ ।
santāraṇo'vito yena tasmai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।47।।
devāyatanako yena rakṣitaḥ paramātmanā ।
pretoddhāraḥ kṛto yena rāśiyāneṣu śārṅgiṇā ।।48।।
śūrajāro mokṣitaśca piśācyo mokṣitāstathā ।
dhanamedo mokṣitaśca yena tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।।49।।
voḍhurvijñānavān yena kṛto gā rakṣitāstathā ।
bālakṛṣṇāya te lakṣavāraṃ me'stu namonamaḥ ।।2.164.50।।
mama yogena bhagavan cātvālo'yaṃ samuddhṛtaḥ ।
tasmai dayāludevāya koṭivāraṃ namonamaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
nivārayā'tivṛṣṭiṃ ca meghān pravāraya prabho ।
samāveśaya pūrā'po rakṣa magnān hi dehinaḥ ।।52।।
ityuktvā sarjapatrāṇi nyakṣipanmastake hareḥ ।
hariṃ śaṃkhaṃ tadā dadhmau meghāḥ śīghraṃ tu ghoṣataḥ ।।।53।।
vyadīryanta jalānāṃ ca varṣaṇaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ।
jalāni jalapūrāśca vyalīyanta ninādataḥ ।।54।।
prāṇinaḥ sukhino jātā vṛkāyanaprasaṃgataḥ ।
vṛkāyano maharṣiśca yayau kṛtasmaraṃ girim ।।55।।
bālakṛṣṇastirobhūya yayāvaśvasarovaram ।
nīlakarṇaḥ sacātvālastaddinātparameśvaram ।।56।।
ārādhayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca taṃ harim ।
tasyaiva bhajanaṃ cakre pratyakṣasya hareḥ sadā ।।57।।
vṛkṣavāsī phalāhārī mālājāpī virāgavān ।
jñānī śrībālakṛṣṇe svahṛdayāpīṃ subhaktimān ।।58।।
bhajate sma hariṃ nityaṃ karatālādibhirgṛṇan ।
bālakṛṣṇaharekṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'va māṃ vibho ।।59।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa jayakṛṣṇa harehare ।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇavallabha śrīhare jaya ।।2.164.60।।
evaṃ sa bhajanaṃ cakre saha palyā sutādibhiḥ ।
yathālabdhānnasantoṣī svalpavastrāditṛptimān ।।61 ।।
bhajate śrībhagavantaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum ।
svajñātīnāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtavān hi saḥ ।।62।।
nityaṃ rātrau militvaiva maṇḍalasthā bhajanti ca ।
kīrtayanti harikṛṣṇaṃ stuvanti praṇamanti ca ।।63।।
pūjayanti tulasyādyairbhojayanti phalādikam ।
ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvanti prasādaṃ bhakṣayanti ca ।।64।।
tato yānti gṛhaṃ naijaṃ svapanti harimānasāḥ ।
utthāya ca hariṃ dhyātvā tato vyāpārayanti ca ।।65।।
evaṃ vai vartamānāste cātvālā bhaktivedinaḥ ।
nirṇayaṃ tvekadā cakruryātrārthaṃ kuṃkumasthalīm ।।66।।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ draṣṭuṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro draṣṭuṃ kartuṃ tīrthāni tatra ca ।।67।।
pātheyāni gṛhītvā te sakuṭumbāḥ śatā'dhikāḥ ।
mānavā vai narā nāryo bālavṛddhānvitā yayuḥ ।।68।।
mārge gāyanti vādyāḍhyāṃ gītiṃ nārāyaṇasya te ।
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāyānti kuṃkumavāpikāṃ tataḥ ।।69।।
kecinnamanti vṛkṣāँśca keciddhūlīṃ vahanti ca ।
kecinnārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā viluṭhanti bhuvastale ।।2.164.70।।
keciccāpi prakurvanti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṇḍavat tadā ।
anye nṛtyanti bhāvena vādyamaṇḍalikāyutāḥ ।।71।।
pare gāyanti ca guṇān hareḥ kṛṣṇasya bhāvukāḥ ।
apare pratigāyanti guṇān punaśca tānapi ।।72।।
smṛtvā śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ te pibantyadanti vai pathi ।
satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvanti mārge pragacchatāṃ tadā ।।73 ।।
evaṃ sarve samāyātā bhaktāḥ śrīkṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।
lomaśasyāśramaṃ vādyakīrtanagarjanādibhiḥ ।।74।।
tān draṣṭumṛṣayaḥ sarve tathā brahmapriyādayaḥ ।
yayurbahirmārgatīre tadā bhaktā vilokya tān ।।75।।
cakruśca daṇḍavat sarve rajo nyadhuśca mastake ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca prakṣālya caraṇān jalaiḥ ।।76।।
papuḥ prasādasalilaṃ nyadhurdehe ca mastake ।
lomaśaṃ vīkṣya vidhitaḥ pūjayitvā haripriyāḥ ।।77।।
prajvālya nijapāpāni gṛhītvā lomaśānmanum ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।78।।
japantastaulasīrmālā dadhānā nijavakṣasi ।
raṭanto bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca parabrahma sanātanam ।।79।।
sahasrakalaśaṃ divyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimandiram ।
nemustatkalaśān divyān dhvajaṃ cāmroparisthitam ।।2.164.80 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre yayuḥ snātuṃ drutaṃ purā ।
snātvā pītvā tīrthajalaṃ viśramya cāmradrutale ।।8 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya tu ।
yayuste sopadāḥ sarve pradivyamandirāntaram ।।82 ।।
bhagavān śrīhariḥ śīghraṃ nijaśiṣyaṃ suyoginam ।
svayaṃprakāśaṃ cāhūya dadau svacaraṇāmṛtam ।।83 ।।
tebhyo dadau ca te sarve pītavantaḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ ।
prasādaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo bhuktavantaśca te tataḥ ।।84।।
dṛṣṭimātreṇa hariṇā vīkṣitāḥ sarva eva te ।
tāvaddivyasvarūpāste bhūtadehavivarjitāḥ ।।85 ।।
sūryadehasamā jātā devā vai divyavigrahāḥ ।
kuṇṭhabhāvavihīnāśca vyomamārgābhigāminaḥ ।।86 ।।
bhittyāvaraṇahīnāśca nirāvaraṇadṛṣṭayaḥ ।
divyajñānabhṛtāḥ sarve śvetavarṇāḥ sumūrtayaḥ ।।87।।
rūpānurūpāvayavā yathā muktā ihā''gatāḥ ।
akṣarabrahmalokasya vaikuṇṭhasyā'thavā''gatāḥ ।।88।।
yadvā golokadhāmnaśca śvetadhāmnaśca vā''gatāḥ ।
tādṛśāḥ śvetavarṇāśca candrabimbābhakāntayaḥ ।।89 ।।
hareḥ prasādamāpannā divyatāṃ bhaktito yayuḥ ।
cāṭvālatvaṃ vilīnaṃ ca jaḍatā vigatā tathā ।। 2.164.90 ।।
apāvitryaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca mānuṣatvaṃ layaṃ gatam ।
devatvaṃ ca samudbhūtaṃ śāstrajñatvaṃ samarjitam ।। 91 ।।
divyadṛṣṭijuṣo jātā nīlakarṇādayo'khilāḥ ।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ te pupūjuḥ paramādarāt ।।।92।।
tāvattatra vimānaṃ vai divyaṃ vyomnaḥ samāgatam ।
muktyarthaṃ haribhaktānāṃ tadā te cakrurarthanām ।।93 ।।
tavā''jñāṃ ca vahāmo'tra saiva muktirhi vo matā ।
neṣyate'tra vimānaṃ vā neṣyate pāralaukikam ।। 94।।
rakṣā'traiva mahārāja kurmo dāsyaṃ tavā'tra ha ।
ityevaṃ yācamānebhyo hariścājñāṃ dadau tadā ।।95।।
yūyaṃ bhaktā divyayāne sthitvā yāntūttarāṃ diśam ।
ketumālaṃ mahādeśaṃ mālyavatastu paścimam ।।96।।
mālyo'yamuralākhyo'sti ketumālasya pūrvagaḥ ।
taddeśeṣu prajābhyo me mantradānaṃ dadatvapi ।।97।।
ityuktāḥ śrīhariṃ natvā vimānaṃ cā'dhyarohayan ।
tāvat kṛṣṇena tu smṛto vṛkāyanarṣisattamaḥ ।।98।।
vyomamārgeṇa cāyātastasmai śrīharireva saḥ ।
ājñāṃ dadau ketumālaṃ gantuṃ bhaktipravṛttaye ।।99।।
so'pi vimānamāruhya śatādhikairmaharṣibhiḥ ।
śrāvaṇe devarūpaiśca saha jagāma cāmbare ।। 2.164.10 0।।
ketumālaṃ prati śīghraṃ vimānaṃ prairayaddhi saḥ ।
kacchaṃ sindhumindukuśaṃ kaśyapābdhiṃ vilokya tat ।। 101 ।।
kukeśāsanamullaṃghya ketumālaṃ yayau drutam ।
yatra śaityena śubhrāṃgāḥ prajā vasanti kaśyapāḥ ।। 10 2।।
kāśyapyaḥ sarvajanatā dharmakarmasu vai samāḥ ।
nīparāyāḥ saritaśca tīre vimānakaṃ nijam ।। 1 03।।
nīlakarṇo bhaktarājo vṛkāyanājñayā tadā ।
kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāptuṃ vai cāmbarādavatārayat ।। 1 04।।
rādhike nīlakarṇādyāścāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
yatra snātāśca tat tīrthaṃ nīlakarṇābhidhaṃ hyabhūt ।। 1 05।।
divyatāpādakaṃ taddhi snānamātreṇa dehinām ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi divyatā labhyate janaiḥ ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nīlakarṇacāṭvālakuṭumbasyā'tivṛṣṭau vṛkāyanarṣidvārā bhagavatā kṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ, kuṃkumavāpīmāgatya nīlakarṇasya
śataparijanasya divyatā, ketumālakhaṇḍaṃ prati tasya bhagavatā kṛtaṃ preṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 164 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 164 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 165
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 166 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
priya prāṇapate kṛṣṇa kānta sarvamanohara ।
nīlakarṇo vṛkarṣiśca tathā'nye bhaktapuṃgavāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kiṃ cakruḥ ketumālākhye nīparāyāstaṭe tataḥ ।
tadajñāte pradeśe tatsarvaṃ me vaktumarhasi ।। 2 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasambandhavatkathām ।
śrutvā tṛptiṃ na cāpnomi priyaprāṇamukhāt punaḥ ।। 3 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
nīparāyāstaṭe rādhe! bahuvṛkṣasamākule ।
bahupakṣisamāvāse śītavāyumanohare ।। 4 ।।
vimānātte kṣitau sarve cāvaterurjalāntikam ।
gatvā sasnustataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā'nādihareśca te ।। 5 ।।
naivedyaṃ phalamūlādeḥ pakvānnasya tathā''rpya ca ।
pātheyādi prabhuktvaiva pītvā vāri prasādajam ।। 6 ।।
ghaṭikāmātramāśramya cakruste nāmakīrtanam ।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma harehare ।। 7।।
maheśāna pareśāna sarveśāna harehare ।
evaṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ vādyaiḥ saha cakruḥ pramodinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ vīkṣituṃ te vimānamadhyarohayan ।
vyomamārgeṇa dakṣeṇa krameṇa gatimācaran ।। 9 ।।
yavakrītapradeśāँste lokayāmāsurambarāt ।
nistārāṃ ca nadīṃ pṛthānadīṃ romāyanakṣitim ।। 2.165.1 0।।
kṛpāsthalādriṃ dinapāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya ca sevikām ।
yugaśāvapradeśāँśca valgurāyapradeśakān ।। 11 ।।
vīkṣya girīśadeśāँśca iṣṭalavapradeśakān ।
āpyāyanādriṃ ca tathā'lpādriṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param ।। 1 2।।
sveṣṭajarapradeśāँśca pherunasapradeśakān ।
rāhūnāṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya parījaparvatam ।। 1 3।।
indirāṃ ca nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā gavādakavitāṃnadīm ।
nadīṃ gavādayānāṃ ca pūrtagaṇḍapradeśakān ।। 14।।
trigrāsāṃ ca nadīṃ dūrāṃ nadīṃ mitrāṃ nadīṃ tathā ।
supānadeśān saṃvīkṣya gurūnāṃ saritaṃ tataḥ ।। 15 ।।
phalāśanapradeśāँśca lavavārāṃ nadīṃ tathā ।
senānadīṃ vilokyā'tha sthāyinīṃ vīkṣya cāpagām । । 16 ।।
vallījīvanadeśāँśca jarāmaunadradeśakān ।
ālpāpāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya audarīṃ saritaṃ tathā ।। 17।।
pālanādapradeśāँśca nadīṃ viṣatulāṃ tathā ।
prapīṭhāṃ ca niyamānāṃ nadīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ param ।। 18।।
lātavāyapradeśāँśca vīkṣya dūnānadīṃ tataḥ ।
pāyupaśyasaro dṛṣṭvā leṇḍugaṃ vīkṣya vai saraḥ ।। 19 ।।
yonigaṃ ca saro dṛṣṭvā phālanādapradeśakān ।
svādvadanapradeśāँśca nāraravapradeśakān ।। 2.165.2 0।।
trinayāṃ ca nadīṃ vīkṣya lepanādapradeśakān ।
koladvīpaṃ prasamīkṣya śvetavārdhiṃ vilokya ca ।। 21 ।।
hīnāṃ nadīṃ vilokyātha pācaurāṃ saritaṃ tathā ।
kāmāyā vastunāyāśca saṃgamaṃ vīkṣya sundaram ।। 22।।
donānadīṃ vilokyā'tha ājavābdhisamāgame ।
bhaktāste śanakainaiṃjaṃ vimānaṃ hyavatārayan ।।23।।
nyūṣuste tatra vṛkṣādyaiḥ ramaṇīye pradeśake ।
bhajanaṃ śrīhareścakrurvādyagāyananartanaiḥ ।।24।।
rātrau viśrāntimāsādya dvitīye divase punaḥ ।
ṣaṭkarmāṇi vinirvartya kīrtayantaḥ savādyakāḥ ।। 25।।
tenaiva ca krameṇaite babhramurvai vimānagāḥ ।
śratvā prajāśca rājāno raṭaṇaṃ parameśituḥ ।।26।।
paramānandamāpannā jayavāco'bhisañjaguḥ ।
svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ceti satkāravācamairayan ।।27।।
puṣpādyairvardhayāmāsuḥ pratideśaṃ pratisthalam ।
evaṃ deśān bhramitvā ca donānadīṃ samāyayuḥ ।।28।।
viśaśramurbhojyapānaistṛptā niśāṃ tu kīrtanaiḥ ।
yāpayāmāsurevaite tṛtīye'pi dine tathā ।।29।।
prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidhāyaiva niṣadya ca vimānake ।
tenaiva ca krameṇaite babhramurvai vimānagāḥ ।।2.165.3 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtergale ca yaḥ ।
cintāmaṇirdhṛto mālāmadhye spṛṣṭvā tu taṃ tadā ।।3 1।।
vṛkāyano maharṣiśca cintayitvā tu śarkarām ।
miṣṭāmamṛtakalpāṃ ca samutpādya navāṃ navām ।।32।।
yatra yatra janā deśe vilokyante ca tatra ca ।
varṣayāmāsa bahudhā hareḥ prasādalabdhaye ।।33 ।।
prajāstu harṣanādaiśca jagṛhuḥ śarkarāśca tāḥ ।
cakhaduścātimuditā jayanādān pracakrire ।।34।।
svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ceti prārthayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
prasādaṃ ca samarpayya vimānaṃ sāyameva tat ।। 35।।
donājavā'bdhisaṃgaṃ ca samāyātaṃ niśāmukhe ।
rātrau te bhajanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti vai ।। 36 ।।
tāvattatra samāyātā aṣṭāviṃśatikanyakāḥ ।
divyarūpadharāḥ sarvāḥ kumāryaḥ śvetabhāsurāḥ ।।37।।
divyamālāmbarabhūṣādhāriṇyaścandrakāntayaḥ ।
ramaṇīyā'tisundaryo vaiṣṇavyastaulasīsrajaḥ ।।38।।
nārāyaṇaharekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇeti vai harim ।
raṭantyaḥ saumyabhāvena bhagavallagnamānasāḥ ।।39।।
puṣparatnā'kṣatahastāḥ kasturīcandanānvitāḥ ।
pūjāsāmagrikāyuktāḥ praṇemustā vimānakam ।।2.165.40।।
kumāryaḥ pañca divyāśca divyābharaṇaśobhitāḥ ।
divyavaiṣṇavaveṣāśca pūjopakaraṇānvitāḥ ।।41 ।।
ekaḥ śvetaścāparaśca kṛṣṇastṛtīyako javī ।
caturthastrinayanaśca pañcamo nīlavarṇakaḥ ।।42।।
te'pi natvā vimānaṃ ca tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ kumārakāḥ ।
tāvat trayaṃ samāyātaṃ nānyataraṃ suśobhitam ।।43।।
strīpuṃbhāvarahitaṃ ca śvetavarṇaṃ manoharam ।
natvā vimānaṃ tvaritaṃ tasthau trikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।।44।।
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ viṃśatiyatimaṇḍalam ।
sajaṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ tāpasaṃ brahmabhāsuram ।।45।।
nārāyaṇaharekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa namo'stu te ।
ekasvareṇa pravadat neme vimānakaṃ tu tat ।।46।।
atha smṛddhapuruṣāśca catvārastatra cāyayuḥ ।
divyā divyābharaṇāśca divyarddhisaṃbhṛtāḥ śubhāḥ ।।47।।
tāpasāḥ siddhimantaśca yathā vai brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
natvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ te tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ viśaśramuḥ ।।48।।
atha ṣaṣṭirdivyarūpā militvā te narāḥ striyaḥ ।
vṛkāyanaṃ tathā cāṭvālarṣīn sarvān praṇamya ca ।।49।।
stutiṃ cakrurvimānābhimukha vilokya bhāvataḥ ।
ekasvareṇa muditā netre pramilya vai tadā ।।2.165.50।।
vyāpako yaḥ parabrahmā'nādiśrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
muktamuktānikāsevyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
akṣaraṃ brahma yatrāste dhāma divyaṃ parātparam ।
sevate yaṃ sadā tatra tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।52।।
yanmūrtestu samutpannā rādhā śaktiḥ surūpiṇī ।
rādhārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo'bhūt tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।53।।
yaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nityagoloke gāvo gopyaśca gopakāḥ ।
sevante sukhadaṃ rāse tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।54।।
yanmūrtestu samutpannā lakṣmīrmūrtiḥ surūpiṇī ।
nārāyaṇo'bhūllakṣmyarthaṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।55।।
yaṃ vaikuṇṭhe pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca bhagāni ca ।
prasevante sakhīkoṭyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।56।।
yo nātho'nādisṛṣṭeśca pravāhārthaṃ catuṣṭayam ।
vāsudevādikaṃ vyūhaṃ dhatte kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।57।।
yo devo vai mahābhūmā vairājaśca purā'bhavat ।
tridevatāṃ samāpannastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।58।।
yaḥ svamūrtau māṇikīṃ ca ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ satīm ।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ dhatte tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।59।।
yo haṃsāṃ suguṇāṃ mañjulikāṃ dhatte svavigrahe ।
dayāṃ jayāṃ ca lalitāṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।2.165.60।।
yo rādhāṃ yamunāṃ gaṃgāṃ virajāṃ ca sarasvatīm ।
śāradāṃ kamalāṃ dhatte tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
yaḥ svamūrtervivareṣu dhatte brahmāṇḍakoṭikāḥ ।
brahmāṇḍeṣvanvitaścāste tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।62।।
avyākṛte'mṛte dhāmni śvetadvīpe narāyaṇaḥ ।
yastvāste śrīramāsevyastasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।63।।
ādityamaṇḍale hiraṇmayo yaśca virājate ।
agnau yajñasvarūpaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।64।।
brahmāṇḍe viṣṇurūpo yaḥ svarge vāmanarūpadhṛk ।
badaryāṃ ca hariścāste tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।65।।
śeṣe nārāyaṇarūpaścātmasvantarniyāmakaḥ ।
sākṣī yaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।66।।
yaścāste bālakṛṣṇo'yaṃ śrīmadgopālanandanaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।67।।
yena gaṃgā kṛtā divyā'smanmātā ṣaṣṭibālakā ।
pādāṅguṣṭhena satye vai tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।68।।
mūrtirūpo vimāne'tra yaścāste bhagavān hariḥ ।
gaṃgā'patyakṛpāvarṣī tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।69।।।
karmakāṇḍāya yogāya jñānāya ca viviktaye ।
nītaye ca vicārāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।2.165.70।।
jīvāya jīvakāyāpi prāṇāya kośine ca te ।
khāya kāya ca satyāya tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥ ।।71 ।।
tīrthāya sādhurūpāya sarvajñāya vihāriṇe ।
muktaye muktidātre ca tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥ ।।72।।।
cidacitsarvarūpāya vimānasthāya mūrtaye ।
bālāya bālakṛṣṇāya kāntakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।73 ।।
brahmapriyādhipataye koṭiśaktīśvarāya ca ।
śatacatvāriṃśadūrdhvakanyākāntāya te namonamaḥ ।।74।।
māyākālapuruṣāṇāṃ pataye dhāmadhāminām ।
īśajīvādhipataye tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।75।।
gocarāyā'gocarāya ṣaṣṭivandyāya mūrtaye ।
śaraṇaṃ smaḥ samāpannāḥ śaraṇyāya ca te namaḥ ।।76।।
evaṃ stutvā rādhike! te vṛkāyanābhikāṃkṣayā ।
puṣpāñjalīnnibaddhyaiva vimānabhūmikāṃ yayuḥ ।।77।।
gāṃgeyāḥ ṣaṣṭibālāste viviśuśca vimānakam ।
yatrā''ste bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa mūrtirūpo hariḥ svayam ।।78।।
dṛṣṭvā puṣpāñjaliṃ cakrurdaṇḍavaccādarādati ।
tāvanmūrteḥ prāvirāsa bālakṛṣṇastu gocaraḥ ।।79।।
caturdaśasamāmūrtirdivyāvayavaśobhanaḥ ।
koṭikāmādhisaundaryo hāsyasaumyānanaḥ prabhuḥ ।।2.165.80 ।।
brahmapriyābhisahitaḥ ṣaṭpatnīsahitaḥ svayam ।
gaṃgāditīrthasahito vimāne gocaro'bhavat ।।81।।
gaṃgāṃ ca mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
ṣaṣṭibālā mumudire gaṃgāstanyaṃ tadā'sravat ।।82।।
nipetuḥ śrīhareścāpi mātuśca pādayordrutam ।
pañjalāni papuḥ sarve prakṣālya magnamānasāḥ ।।83।।
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpamauktikahīrakaiḥ ।
divyaratnaiḥ svarṇavastrābhūṣaṇaiśca phalādibhiḥ ।।84।।
divyaiśca madhubhiścāpi sugandhicandanādibhiḥ ।
gandhasāraiḥ sarvarasairbhāvanābhiśca vai hṛdā ।।85।।
nīrājanaṃ tadā cakrurhareśca māturityapi ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca prārthanāṃ cakrureva ca ।।86।।
koṭijanmāparādhānāṃ kṣantā nārāyaṇaprabho ।
asmaddeśeṣu cāgatya kuru deśān hi pāvanān ।।87।।
pratīkṣāmastvāgamaṃ te prajānāṃ pāvanāya vai ।
samāgatya harerasmān pāvayātra ciraṃsthitān ।।88।।
mātrā saha yadā satyāllokādāgamanaṃ tu naḥ ।
bhagīrathasya yatnena cābhūttadā hareṇa vai ।।89।।
grahītā svajaṭāyāṃ no jananī tu tadā vayam ।
viyuktā himavadvayomnastyaktvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ talam ।।2.165.90 ।।
ketumālaṃ nirjanaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā'tra nirupadravam ।
nārāyaṇecchayā''gatya nivasāmo'tiśāntitaḥ ।।91 ।।
asmanmadhye bhavantīyā aṣṭāviṃśatikanyakāḥ ।
gaṃgāputryo vayaṃ sarvāḥ pañca putrā ime tathā ।।।92।।।
trīṇyapatyāni caitāni kumārā viṃśatistathā ।
catvāraścāpi bālāśca sarve gaṃgodbhavā vayam ।।93 ।।
kṛtvā yajñotsavānatra cāhūya daivamaṇḍalam ।
ketumālaṃ pāvanaṃ ca kuru kṛṣṇaṃ samantataḥ ।।94।।
śrutvā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
jahāse mumude cāpi svīcakāra tadarthitam ।।95।।
datvā tebhyaḥ prasādaṃ ca pratimāyāṃ tirobhavat ।
parivāro'pi sarvo hi kṣaṇādantaradhīyata ।।96।।
vṛkāyano maharṣiśca nīlakarṇādayastathā ।
śrutvā vṛttāntakaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāślikṣan hṛdā mudā ।।97।।
svāgataṃ te tataścakruḥ pūjābhojanavāribhiḥ ।
gāṃgeyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇakṛpājuṣām ।।98।।
militvā ca vimāne te cakruḥ śrīharikīrtanam ।
pradaduśca tato naijaṃ paricayaṃ parasparam ।।99।।
āmantraṇaṃ pracakruśca gāṃgeyāstu vimānagān ।
naijān deśān pāvayituṃ vihartuṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 2.165.10 0।।
vṛkāyanādyāḥ svīcakrurāmantraṇaṃ punastataḥ ।
jagaduḥ svavimāne ca saha sthātuṃ tu ṣaṣṭikam ।। 10 1।।
aṅgīcakruśca te ṣaṣṭirdivyabālā yathoditam ।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇecchayā sammelanaṃ hyabhūt ।। 1 02।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vṛkāyananīlakarṇādimaharṣīṇāṃ ketumālaṃ prati vimānena gamanaṃ deśanirīkṣaṇaṃ gāṃgeyā'patyaṣaṣṭisammelana-
mityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 165 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 165 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 166
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 167 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
kathaṃ kadā samutpannā gaṃgāyāṃ bālabālikāḥ ।
tatsarvaṃ me vada kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
vṛkāyanādibhiḥ pṛṣṭāste sarve'pi tathaiva tu ।
vṛttāntaṃ jagaduḥ sarve yathābhūtaṃ vadāmi te ।। 2 ।।
ekadā khalu goloke rādhayā cārthitastvayā ।
śrīkṛṣṇo'hamapatyārthaṃ mayā saṃkalpitastadā ।। 3 ।।
vikuṇṭhākhyā tadā putrī putrāśca saptasāgarāḥ ।
utpādyaiva pradattāste tvamabhūstuṣṭamānasā ।। 4 ।।
tvāmapatyavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṃgā tvapatyavarjitā ।
apatyecchāvatī jātā'patyāni cārthayacca mat ।। 5 ।।
mayā putryaḥ śubhā dattā yāvatyastvabhivāñcchitāḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstadā toṣamupāgatā ।। 6 ।।
athaicchat sā kumārāँśca mayā pañcā'rpitāstadā ।
tathāpi naiva santuṣṭā catvāraśca tato'rpitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
athāpi toṣaṃ naivā''ptā punarviṃśatibālakāḥ ।
mayā dattā tadā toṣaṃ hyavāpaicchattathāpi sā ।। 8 ।।
apatyāni tadā trīṇi mayā'rpitāni tatkṣaṇāt ।
evaṃ mayā tu gaṃgāyai goloke ṣaṣṭibālakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
saṃkalpayogajā dattāstadā sā toṣamāpa ha ।
yadā sā'vātaralloke tadā'patyayutā tu sā ।। 2.166.1 0।।
samāgatā snehayuktā'patyānyādhāya vai saha ।
golokāt sā prathame tu vaikuṇṭhe samavātarat ।। 11 ।।
tato jalasyā''varaṇe vaikuṇṭhe tu dvitīyake ।
tato viṣṇupādabhūtā satyaloke hyavātarat ।। 12।।
brahmaṇā rakṣitā satye loke'bhiṣekavāñcchayā ।
kamaṇḍalau dhṛtā nityaṃ samūrtā svagṛhe'pi ca ।। 13।।
kāryakāraṇarūpaiva brahmavāse virājate ।
bhagīrathaprayatnena kāryakāraṇarūpiṇī ।। 14।।
arpitā sāgaramuktyai bhagīrathāya vedhasā ।
sampunānā maharṣīṃśca pitṝn devāँśca vāyujān ।। 15।।
merumārgeṇa sā devī nyapatad rudramastake ।
śaṃbhunā svajaṭāyāṃ sā dhṛtā tatra layaṃ gatā ।। 16।।
tadā mātrā copadiṣṭā ṣaṣṭibālā himālayam ।
śaṃbhusthānaṃ parityajya dūraṃ bhayād yayurdrutam ।। 17।।
indukuśaṃ kaśyapābdhiṃ tyaktvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ tathā ।
yayuḥ khaṇḍāntare yatra nirbhayāstasthureva te ।। 18।।
ketumāle kṛtasthānā nyavasaṃste yathāmatam ।
gāṃgeyāste kumārāśca kumāryaḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 19।।
pratīkṣante sma bhagavatpādapadmaṃ sukhasthitāḥ ।
ārādhayanti sma hariṃ smaranti mātaraṃ sadā ।।2.166.20 ।।
teṣāṃ mano'bhilaṣitaṃ pūrayituṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
preṣayāmāsa śatakaṃ bhaktānāṃ miṣamātrakam ।।21 ।।
tanmiṣeṇa svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
rādhike mūrtirūpeṇa vimāne gocaro'bhavat ।।22।।
teṣāṃ saṃkalpasiddhyarthaṃ yajñaṃ kartumiyeṣa saḥ ।
ato datvā vacastatra punaścāntaradhīyata ।।23।।
śṛṇu kanyakānāmāni kumāranāmakāni ca ।
tiṣṭhanti mūrtimantaśca tiṣṭhanti kṛtakāni ca ।।24।।
jyeṣṭhā kanyā valgunāmnī niṣṭhāparā dvitīyakā ।
nistārā ca pṛthā cāpi dinapā sevikā tathā ।।25।।
saptamī cendirā gavādakavitā'ṣṭamī matā ।
rāhūnā navamī gavādayānā daśamī tathā ।।26।।
trigrāsā dūrikā mitrā gurūnā lavavārikā ।
senā sthāyinī cālpāpā hyaṣṭādaśī matā hi sā ।। 27।।
audarī viṣatulyā ca prapīṭhā niyamānikā ।
dūnā trinayā ca hīnā pācaurā kāmikā tathā ।।28।।
donā'ṣṭāviṃśatitamā kanyāḥ proktāḥ kumārikāḥ ।
bālatrikastathā śvetaḥ kṛṣṇaśca kaśyapābhidhaḥ ।।29।।
ājavaḥ pañcamaśceti jyeṣṭhā vai bhrātarastvime ।
tataścatvāra evā''san bhrātarastān vadāmi te ।।2.166.3 0।।
parījo'lpaścāpyāyanaḥ kṛpāsthalaścaturthakaḥ ।
tato viṃśatiḥ sañjātāḥ śṛṇu nāmnā vadāmi te ।।3 1।।
yavakrītastathā romāyanaśca yugaśāvakaḥ ।
valgurāyo girīśaśca ṣaṣṭhaśceṣṭalavo mataḥ ।।32।।
sveṣṭajaraḥ pherunasaḥ pūrtagaṇḍaḥ supānakaḥ ।
phalāśano vallijīvo jarāmaunastrayodaśaḥ ।।।33 ।।
pālanādo lātavāyaḥ phālanādastu ṣoḍaśaḥ ।
svādvadano nāraravo lepanādaśca kolakaḥ ।।34।।
ete viṃśatisaṃkhyā vai kṛṣṇatulyāḥ parākrame ।
tatastrīṇi ca jātāni hyapatyāni tu nāmataḥ ।।35।।
pāyupaśyaṃ leṇḍugaṃ ca yonigaṃ ceti ṣaṇḍhakam ।
evaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ sahajānāṃ rādhike divyavaibhavā ।।36।।
vartate vaiṣṇavī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇakriyā ।
yatra yatra tu yaścāste tattannāmnā sthalādikam ।।37।।
tattattataḥ prasiddhiṃ cā'gamat tadadhidaivatam ।
ta ete ṣaṣṭibālā vai gāṃgeyāśca vṛkāyanam ।।38।।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhramituṃ nijadeśakān ।
punarvimānamāruhya sarve te śatameva tu ।।39।।
ṣaṣṭyā saha vimānena niryayurbhramituṃ tadā ।
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva vyomnā pūrvakrameṇa ca ।।2.166.40।।
tattaddeśānavatīrya gāṃgeyānāṃ pravāñcchayā ।
pāvanān vai prakurvantaḥ kurvanto bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।41।।
ṣaṣṭisthalāni saṃvīkṣya kṛtvotsavāँśca tatra ca ।
śrāvayitvā harernāma nṛpān nṝँśca muhurmuhuḥ ।।42।।
punastatrā''yayuḥ sarve donā''javābdhisaṃgamam ।
nyūṣuḥ sukhena te sarve kīrtayanto hareḥ kathām ।।43।।
gāṃgeyāḥ prāhurevaitān vṛkāyanādikān punaḥ ।
kadā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāddhariḥ svayam ।।44।।
āgamiṣyati yajñārthaṃ kadā dṛṣṭyāmavāpsyate ।
deśeṣvatra prajāḥ sarvāḥ pratīkṣante samutsavam ।।45।।
vṛkāyana maharṣe tvaṃ prayāhi śrīhariṃ prati ।
śīghraṃ yathā bhavedyajñastathā'rthayitumarhasi ।।46।।
ityuktaḥ siddhimān divyo vṛkāyanaḥ samādhinā ।
drutaṃ prāṇān sanniruddhya brahmarandhramupāgataḥ ।।47।।
niryayau yogarītyaiva cāyayāvāśvasārasam ।
natvā devaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ cārthayāmāsa hṛdgatam ।।48।।
śrutvā śrībhagavānāha śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣake ।
pañcamyāṃ tu makhaḥ kāryaścaikādaśyāṃ samāptimān ।।49।।
tato deśeṣu sarvatra sthāne sthāne tu rājasu ।
gantavyaṃ bhādramāse vai āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣake ।।2.166.50 ।।
yāhi tvaṃ ca pradeśeṣu tathā prakāśanaṃ kuru ।
yathā yajñasya samayaṃ jānīyurjanatāḥ prajāḥ ।।51 ।।
sāmagrīścāpi gāṃgeyairmilitvā sañcitāḥ kuru ।
idaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ saha nītvā prayāhi me ।।52।।
preṣaya vyomamārgeṇa taddeśeṣu samantataḥ ।
bhramitvā ca muhuryatra bhūmau viśrāntimācaret ।।53।।
tatra yajñaḥ prakartavyastatsthalaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ kuru ।
prakāśitaṃ sthalaṃ tacca vimānena punardinam ।।54।।
bhramitvā'mbaramārgeṇa prasūcitaṃ vidhāpaya ।
ahaṃ vimānamārgeṇa śrāvaṇe'hni tṛtīyake ।।55।।
śukle devaiḥ kuṭumbādyairmaharṣibhiśca śaktibhiḥ ।
saha nītvā samāyāsye madhyāhnottarameva ha ।।56।।
ityājñapto maharṣiśca sudarśanena śobhitaḥ ।
yogaiśvaryeṇa sahasā donā''javābdhisaṃgamam ।।57।।
yayau prātaśca vṛttāntaṃ sarvebhyo'kathayacchubham ।
ṣaṣṭibālāḥ prasannāste'bhavad śrutvā'cyutāgamam ।।58।।
prātaḥkṛtyāni nirvartya sarvavādyaiśca kīrtanaiḥ ।
sarve vimānamāruhya māṃgalyasūcanāya te ।।59।।
vyomnā prāguktakramaśaḥ sudarśanena saṃyutāḥ ।
yajñabhūmernirṇayārthaṃ kīrtayanto viniryayuḥ ।।2.166.60।।
ekavāraṃ mahaccakraṃ bhramitvā''lokya bhūmikāḥ ।
pradarśayat svakaṃ tejomaṇḍalaṃ sūryasadṛśam ।।6 1 ।।
sahasrāraṃ sudurlakṣyaṃ kiñcillakṣyaṃ prabhāvinām ।
hṛdayeṣu prajānāmāścaryaṃ cājanayanmahat ।।62।।
kautūhalaṃ vyadadhācca divyabhāvaṃ nyadhāpayat ।
evaṃ tu bhrāmaṇe jāte prajāścāsan suvihvalāḥ ।।6 3।।
draṣṭuṃ punaśca taccakraṃ vimānaṃ sūryavarcasam ।
atha cakraṃ punastena vimānena samaṃ bhuvam ।।64।।
nirṇetuṃ prāsarat śīghraṃ prasannaṃ janayat sukham ।
niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame śāntamavātarat ।।65।।
uttarasyāṃ kṣitau rāsāyanāraṇyasuśobhite ।
paritaḥ sarvadeśānāṃ samamadhye subhūtale ।।66 ।।
vilokya śrīhareḥ sudarśanāvataraṇaṃ kṣitau ।
vimānaṃ saṃgame tatrā'vā'tārayan maharṣayaḥ ।।67।।
vṛkāyano nīlakarṇo yavakrītastathā'pare ।
viśramya bhūmikāṃ divyāṃ vīkṣya ramyāṃ makhārhikām ।।68।।
praśaśaṃsuḥ prasannāścā'bhavan gāṃgeyakādayaḥ ।
athodghoṣayituṃ sthānaṃ dinaṃ yajñaṃ ca te tataḥ ।।69।।
savādyakīrtanagītāḥ vimāne cā'mbare'bhavan ।
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva śaṃkhavādanapūrvakāḥ ।।2.166.70।।
paṭahān nādayantaśca gāyantaḥ kīrtanāni ca ।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa ramākṛṣṇa harehare ।।7 1।।
padmajāśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa lakṣmīpatehare ।
ityevaṃ saṃraṭantaste madhye madhye sthale sthale ।।72।।
udghoṣayanti yajñaṃ susthānaṃ ca dinamityapi ।
saptāho vaiṣṇavo yajño vaidikaḥ sārvadaivataḥ ।।73।।
niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame viśālabhūtale ।
yatakrītarṣisaṃsthāne nadīdvayāntarālake ।।74।।
sampatsyate'tra bhagavān śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāyāsyati svayam ।।75।।
śrāvaṇasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śrīhariṃ prabhuḥ ।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāmājanābhapradeśataḥ ।।76।।
kṣetrātkuṃkumavāpyākhyād vimānenāgamiṣyati ।
devarṣipitṛsahito brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।।77।।
śrāvaṇasya tu śuklāyāṃ pañcamyāṃ prātareva saḥ ।
vidhāsyati makhārambhaṃ pāvanaṃ sarvadehinām ।।78।।
ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kratostatra bhaviṣyati ।
āmantryante prajāḥ sarvā rājāno'pi kuṭumbinaḥ ।।79।।
sarvavarṇā narā nāryo samāyāntu mahādhvare ।
paśyantu devadeveśaṃ kṛtārthayantu janma ca ।।2.166.80।।
gṛhṇantu cādhvaraprāsādikaṃ bhajantu ceśvaram ।
śṛṇvantu sukathā divyāḥ pāvayantu kulāni ca ।।8 1 ।।
bhajantu bhagavantaṃ taṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṛṣṇanāmakam ।
sarvaistu bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ saptāhe yājñaśālikam ।।82।।
prāptaṃ divyaṃ tu samayaṃ saphalayantu sarvathā ।
gṛhṇantu vaiṣṇavān mantrān nārāyaṇamukhānnanu ।।83।।
dhārayantu pāvanīśca srajastulasikodbhavāḥ ।
raṭantu śrīharernāma bhavantu divyavigrahāḥ ।।84।।
āgacchantu mahābhāgā yajñe nārāyaṇīyake ।
na bhūto na punarbhāvī kratuścaitādṛśaḥ khalu ।।85।।
adhvare cāgamiṣyanti dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ ।
muktakoṭyaśceśakoṭyo devakoṭyaśca mānavāḥ ।।86।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro yakṣā gāndharvā rākṣasāstathā ।
drumāstīrthāni tattvāni parvatā bhūmayastathā ।।87।।
mūrtā'mūrtagaṇāḥ sarve samāyāsyanti cā'dhvare ।
kalpalatāḥ kāmagāvaḥ siddhayo yatayastathā ।।88।।
yoginaḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ śaktayo yoṣitastathā ।
sarve cātrā''gamiṣyanti paśyantu tanmahā'dhvaram ।।89।।
harekṛṣṇa svāmikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin harehare ।।2.166.90।।
rādhālakṣmīpate haṃsāramāpadmāvatīpate ।
māṇikīśrīmaṃjulāsadaguṇāpate śriyāḥpate ।।91 ।।
brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇaparameśa harehare ।
harekṛṣṇa svāmikṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।।92।।
vijayo'stu hareścātra prajānāṃ vijayo'stu ca ।
sukhābhivṛddhirevā'stu smṛddhiścāstu sadā'vyayā ।।93 ।।
ārogyaṃ cā'stu deśānāṃ bhaktiścāstu pareśvare ।
parameśaṃ cintayantu prāpayantu parāṃ gatim ।।94।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ cārjayantu nārāyaṇaprasādataḥ ।
avaśyaṃ tu makhe samāgatya tṛptā bhavantu hi ।।95।।
bhavantu pāvanā bhaktā mokṣayogyāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ ।
dānahomaparāstatra bhavantu makhabhāginaḥ ।।96।।
rājāno rājavargāśca śreṣṭhivargāḥ prajājanāḥ ।
bālā bālyaḥ striyo vṛddhā gṛhṇantu lābhamādhvaram ।।97।।
ityevaṃ rādhike vyomni vimānaṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ muhuḥ ।
akarot saptavāraṃ vai bhramitvā ketumālake ।।98।।
uralāt paścime deśe samudratīrakāvadhim ।
sarvadeśeṣu kṛṣṇasya ghoṣaṇā vai pravartitā ।।99।।
tato vimānaṃ śāntaṃ ca yatakrītapradeśake ।
avātarat prapīṭhāyāḥ pūrve nīparapaścime ।। 2.166.1 00।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatu sarvadā ।
uccarantaścāvateruḥ sudarśanena saṃhitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
viśaśramurmahāraṇye'mārātrau te maharṣayaḥ ।
gāṃgeyā bālabālādyaḥ śāntimāpuḥ parāṃ tadā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gāṃgeyānāmudbhavavṛttāntastannāmāni, vṛkāyanasya kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāgamanaṃ, harerāmantraṇaṃ, sudarśanena saha ketumāle vṛkāyanāgamaḥ, sudarśanasthairyadarśitakratusthalīnirṇayaḥ, yajñodghoṣaṇā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 166 ।।
