adhyāyaḥ 167
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 168 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadajāyata vacmi te ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatīśvaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
praiṣayallomaśaṃ cānyān maharṣīn yajñakovidān ।
patnīvrataṃ maharṣiṃ ca śvetavyāsaṃ sanātanam ।। 2 ।।
sanatkumāraṃ ca tathā gaṇeśaṃ jātavedasam ।
satrāyaṇaṃ gālavaṃ ca svīyaprakāśamityapi ।। 3 ।।
śatānandaṃ nāradaṃ ca devaguruṃ bṛhaspatim ।
īśānaṃ ca mahādevaṃ kapilaṃ bhagavanmunim ।। 4 ।।
śukaṃ ca vallabhamuniṃ vāmanaṃ suratāyanam ।
hemantaṃ devaprakāśaṃ yajñopakaraṇānyapi ।। 5 ।।
samagrāṇi vimāne preṣayāmāsa sa tānmunīn ।
pratipaddivase sarve madhyāhnottarameva tu ।। 6 ।।
prāptā niṣṭhāparātīre yatra vṛkāyanādayaḥ ।
svāgataṃ kṛtavantaste yavakrītādayastadā ।। 7 ।।
āgatānāṃ lomaśādimaharṣīṇāṃ jayādibhiḥ ।
madhuparkādibhiścāpi pupūjurlomaśādikān ।। 8 ।।
vimānaṃ tu vimānena saha bhūmāvarakṣayan ।
gāṃgeyāśca yavakrītādayaḥ pupūjurādarāt ।। 9 ।।
viśvakarmā tathā devāyatano dvau samāgatau ।
haryājñayā śilpivaryau tatraiva pratipaddine ।। 2.167.1 0।।
viśramya bhojanaṃ kṛtvā tato bhūmiviśodhanam ।
maṇḍapaṃ dharmaśālāśca pākaśālāḥ pracakratuḥ ।। 1 1।।
yajñaśālā vāsaśālā homaśālāḥ pracakratuḥ ।
ghaṭaśālā vastuśālā mahīmānālayān śubhān ।। 12।।
muktaśālā avatāranivāsān devatālayān ।
ṛṣiśālāḥ pitṛśālā yakṣarākṣasasadgṛhān ।। 1 3।।
jaḍacetanavāsāँśca cakratuste samantataḥ ।
śatakrośamite deśe nadīdvayāntarālake ।। 14।।
cakraturmaṇḍapān ramyān yathāvāsisamarhaṇān ।
yavakrītādayaścāpi svasvadeśān yayurdrutam ।। 15।।
tattaddeśīyanṛpatīnāninyuśca prajāstathā ।
śreṣṭhino bhaktavaryāṃśca narān nārīḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 16।।
vimānaistvaritaṃ sarve cāninyuścādhvarasthalīm ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike mukhyābhidhānāni makhārthinām ।। 17।।
samrāṭ pūrvapradeśānāmuralaketusaṃjñakaḥ ।
yavakrītarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ ṣaṣṭilakṣaprajāyutaḥ ।। 18।।
kuṭumbasahitaścībjalakṣmīdravyādibhiḥ saha ।
yānavāhanasaṃsmṛddhyā yajñārthaṃ samupāyayau ।। 19।।
romāyanarṣiṇā sākaṃ rumāṇāṃ krathako nṛpaḥ ।
lakṣaprajābhiḥ sahitaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ।।2.167.20।।
kṛpāsthalarṣiṇā sārdhama pṛthurājaḥ kuṭumbavān ।
daśasāhasramanujaiḥ saha yajñārthamāyayau । ।21 ।।
yugaśāvarṣiṇā sārdhamuṣṭrālanṛpatistathā ।
haṃkārākhyanṛpaścāpi jayakoṣṭhalabhūpatiḥ ।।22।।
trayaste bhrātaro bhūpāḥ kuṭumbasahitāstathā ।
lakṣaprajāyutāstatra makhārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ ।।23।।
valgurāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ tīrāṇabhūpatistadā ।
daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbī kratumāyayau ।। 24।।
girīśena samaṃ rājā alvīnaraḥ kuṭumbavān ।
daśasāhasramanujaiḥ sārdhaṃ yajñārthamāyayau ।।25।।
iṣṭalavarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ jinavarddhinṛpastadā ।
kuṭumbī pañcasāhasraprajābhiryajñamāyayau ।।26।।
āpyāyanarṣiṇā sārdhamalpaketurnṛpastadā ।
daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbena sahāyayau ।।27।।
sveṣṭajararṣiṇā sārdhaṃ jayakṛṣṇavabhūpatiḥ ।
daśasāhasramanujaiḥ kuṭumbena sahāyayau ।।28।।
pherunararṣiṇā sārdhaṃ parīśānanṛpo makhe ।
daśalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ।।29।।
parījamuninā sārdhamindurāyanṛpo makhe ।
trisāhasraprajāyuktaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāyayau ।।2.167.3 0।।
pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ gaṇḍako nṛpa āyayau ।
sakuṭumbaḥ pañcaśataprajābhiścādhvare tadā ।।3 1।।
supānamuninā sārdhaṃ nudrāṇḍanṛpatistadā ।
pañcalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।32।।
phalāśanarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ līnorṇanṛpatirmakhe ।
lakṣadvayaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।33।।
vallījīvanamuninā sākaṃ bṛhaccharo nṛpaḥ ।
sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī makhamāyayau ।।34।।
jarāmaunarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ balalīno nṛpo makhe ।
daśalakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbavān samāyayau ।।35।।
pālanādarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ varasiṃho nṛpo'dhvare ।
lakṣaprajānvitaḥ kuṭumbena yutaḥ samāyayau ।।36।।
lātavāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ rāyagāmalabhūpatiḥ ।
sahasramanujaiḥ sārdhaṃ kuṭumbī yajñamāyayau ।।37।।
phālanādarṣiṇā sākaṃ phenatantunṛpo makhe ।
sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।38।।
svādvadanarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ stokahomanṛpo makhe ।
sahasramanujairyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।39।।
nāraravarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ kāṣṭhayānanṛpo makhe ।
pañcaśataprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।2.167.40।।
lepanādarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ kolako nṛpatiḥ kratau ।
śatamānavayuktaśca kuṭumbī samupāyayau ।।41।।
layadānapradeśebhyaścāṃgarājaḥ samāyayau ।
viṣaparṣiyuto lakṣaprajāyuktaḥ kuṭumbavān ।।42।।
śakuntadeśataścāpi śākuntako nṛpo'dhvare ।
lakṣaprajānvitaḥ kuṭumbavān tatra samāyayau ।।43।।
āyasāttu pradeśādvai prajā yajñe samāyayuḥ ।
uttaradvīpabhāgebhyastathā prajāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।44।।
vimānairhastibhiścāśvairanobhiḥ rāṇḍiyaistathā ।
uṣṭraiśca vṛṣabhaiścāpi svarṇaratnadhanānvitāḥ ।।45।।
bahubhojyapradeyaiśca vastubhiḥ saha cāyayuḥ ।
dāsadāsīsamāyuktāḥ putraputryādivalgitāḥ ।।46।।
dampatīsamudāyāśca save tatra samāyayuḥ ।
yajñārhābhiścopadābhiḥ sāmagrībhiḥ samāyayuḥ ।।47।।
ṣaḍviṃśatikṣitipāste'saṃkhyadravyasamanvitāḥ ।
yajñārthaṃ vastusāmagrīnītvotsāhabharā makhe ।।48।।
āgatya pradaduḥ sarvāḥ sāmagrīrvividhāstadā ।
gālavāyarṣaye sarvādhyakṣeśānāya vai tathā ।।49।।
īśānaḥ śrīmahādevo vaiṣṇavaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
sarvayajñakriyādhyakṣo vastvadhyakṣo'bhavattadā ।।2.167.50।।
maṇḍapādivyavasthāyā niyāmako'pi so hyabhūt ।
rājabhistatra cāgatyeśānāya viniveditam ।।51।।
rājavargo hi pratyekaṃ yajñārthaṃ yajamānakaḥ ।
vyayaṃ dātuṃ prabhavati tasmānmakhā nṛpā'rthitāḥ ।।52।।
ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyākāśca bhavantu kuṇḍaśobhitāḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ rājavargasya vākyaṃ vṛkāyanastathā ।।53।।
lomaśaśca tatheśāno nīlākarṇādayastathā ।
svayaṃprakāśaḥ kapilo devaprakāśako'pare ।।54।।
agragā jagṛhurvāco viśvakarmā'tra daivataḥ ।
ājñāṃ prāpyarṣīṇāṃ tatra tathā kuṇḍāni cakratuḥ ।।55।।
saptaviṃśo mahān kuṇḍamūrdhanyo bhagavatkṛte ।
vihito homamūrdhanyaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthakaḥ ।।56।।
kuṇḍā navavidhāstatra kṛtā vai viśvakarmaṇā ।
vedarṣividhitaḥ sarve diśā niyamatastathā ।।57।।
sarvatobhadravedyākhyaḥ kamalākārakuṇḍakaḥ ।
sarvatobhadrikā vedī caturasrā tathā kṛtā ।।58।।
yonikuṇḍaḥ kṛtaścāpi kuṇḍo'rdhacandrakaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
kuṇḍastrikoṇakaścāpi kuṇḍo vartulakastathā ।।59।।
ṣaṭkoṇakuṇḍakaścāpi ṣaṭpatrakuṇḍakastathā ।
kuṇḍo'ṣṭakoṇakaścāpi kuṇḍo'ṣṭapatrakastathā ।।2.167.60।।
kṛtaścācāryakuṇḍaśca ṛgvedikuṇḍakaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
yajurvedikuṇḍakaścā'tharvavediprakuṇḍakaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
sāmavedikuṇḍakaśca vedikāścāparāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
madhyavedyaḥ pārśvavedyastathā ca vidhinā kṛtāḥ ।।62।।
evaṃ yathāyathaṃ pṛthvīṃ saṃskṛtya maṇḍapāntare ।
yathāyogyān śubhakuṇḍān vedikāścātiśobhitāḥ ।।63 ।।
devāyatanakaścāpi viśvakarmā pracakratuḥ ।
maṇḍapān rucirān ramyastaṃbhadhvajasuśobhitān ।।64।।
dikcihnādisamāḍhyasattoraṇādibhirañcitān ।
śatakrośe kārayāmāsatustau divyavaibhavān ।।65।।
naisargikāni tejāṃsi nisargasalilānyapi ।
śītasugandhivāyuśca nisargodyānabhūmayaḥ ।।66।।
svalpavimānavāhāśca vidyudvimānakoṭayaḥ ।
dolāśca vividhāstatra nisargagītayastathā ।।67।।
śītoṣṇahadakuṇḍāśca nisargagandhasārakāḥ ।
śayyāvāhanabhogyāni mālāpuṣpāṇi vai tathā ।।68।।
nisargatailasārāśca sarvaṃ naisargikaṃ kṛtam ।
svargaṃ vā satyaloko vā kiṃ vā vaikuṇṭhameva tat ।।69।।
sūryā nisargajā yatra candrā nisargabhāsurāḥ ।
sarāṃsi sarito yatra vahanti ca nisargajāḥ ।।2.167.70।।
evaṃ vai daihikaṃ sarvaṃ klṛptaṃ divyaṃ nisargajam ।
rājñāṃ cāpi prajānāṃ ca śreṣṭhināṃ ca tapasvinām ।।71।।
daridrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca yoṣitāṃ ṣaṇḍhakasya ca ।
bhogā bhogyāstathā vāsā bhakṣyāḥ peyāstathālayāḥ ।।72।।
samānaṃ divyalokīyaṃ nityavibhūtijaṃ tadā ।
klṛptaṃ vai saccidānandaṃ hāsanāśavivarjitam ।।73।।
dugdhārthaṃ cāgatāstatra golokāt kāmadhenavaḥ ।
dugdhakulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtakulyāśca pāyasam ।।74।।
kṣīraṃ ca dugdhasārāṇi navanītāni vai tadā ।
akṣayyānyabhavan divyānyapi havyānyanantataḥ ।।75।।
vṛkṣāśca vallikā kalpalatā ninyurmadhūnyapi ।
ikṣusārān guḍān khaṇḍāḥ śarkarāścāpyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।76।।
gundrāँśca gundrapākāṃśca phalāni ca dalāni ca ।
araṇyāni vanānyudyānāni ninyuranantataḥ ।।77।।
oṣadhayastadā divyāḥ kaṇān vrīhīn rasāँstathā ।
tilān yavān sudhānyāni samidho ninyurutsukāḥ ।।78।।
meghāśca vārdhayo miṣṭā nadā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca ।
naisargaśītamiṣṭāni ninyuḥ peyāni cāntataḥ ।।79।।
śrīlakṣmyau śrīhareḥ patnyau bhūlīlābjāvibhūtayaḥ ।
ramā'nnapūrṇā kamalā ninyurmiṣṭānnaparvatān ।।2.167.80।।
stambāḥ stabakāgucchāśca gulmā nālāśca kāṇḍikāḥ ।
vallayastṛṇapatrāśca ninyuḥ puṣpāṇi cāntataḥ ।।8 1।।
gahvarāṇi khanayaśca parvatā vivarāṇi ca ।
gairikāścitracūrṇāni ninyuḥ kuṃkumaraṃgakān ।।82।।
meruḥ pātrāṇi sarvāṇi cendraścā''staraṇāni ca ।
devatāśca vimānāni ninyuryajñamahotsave ।।83।।
vasavaśca kuberaśca dravyāṇi tu dadurmakhe ।
himālayoralādyāśca maṇiratnāni vai daduḥ ।।84।।
samudrā dvīpabhāgāśca mauktikāni dadurmakhe ।
ghanāścakrustadā chāyāmṛtavaścānukūlatām ।।85।।
gandharvā vādakāḥ sarve dadurvādyāni śāradāḥ ।
rājānaśca dadurdāsadāsīrbhṛtyān sukarmiṇaḥ ।।86।।
chatracāmarayānāni vāhanāni kratau tadā ।
gṛhe gṛhe ca nicitāścintāmaṇigaṇāstataḥ ।।87।।
cintayanti yadevā'rthyaṃ tat tat sarvaṃ dadatyapi ।
paṭahaḥ śrīharerdivyo nṛtyaँśca ninadan muhuḥ ।।88।।
kalpapaṭaharūpo'yaṃ cā'kṣarabrahmarūpavān ।
sarvāpekṣyanidhiprakhyo dadātyapyabhivāñchitam ।।89।।
vastrābhūṣādravaddravyaśṛṃgāraṃ devaśilpinaḥ ।
yadapekṣyaṃ drutaṃ pratyupasthāpayanti vai makhe ।।2.167.90।।
evaṃ vai sarvavastūnāmānantyaṃ tatra vidyate ।
jaladevī svayaṃ yatra rasarūpā vyajāyata ।।91।।
bhūdevī bhojyarūpā ca kiṃ nyūnaṃ tatra rādhike ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāñcchayā tvidam ।।92।।
saṃhitaṃ samabhūt tatrā'ntaḥsthitasyā''jñayā drutam ।
sūryaṃ candraṃ niśāṃ sandhyāṃ dinaṃ vāyuṃ tathā'mbaram ।।93।।
analaṃ śravaṇān devān pṛthvīṃ jalaṃ ca parvatān ।
meghān kālaṃ vṛṣaṃ māyāmājñāṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ।।94।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sarve drāgeva sarvatra caturdaśastareṣu vai ।।95।।
āvedayantu janatā adhvaro vai prajāyate ।
havyamādāya ca ketumāle yantu makhotsukāḥ ।।96।।
ityājñaptairveditāśca sthāninaḥ staravāsinaḥ ।
āninyustatra havyāni copadāḥ sīmavarjitāḥ ।।97।।
ityevaṃ rādhike yajñe'saṃkhyasāmagrikādrayaḥ ।
pūrvamevā'bhavan klṛptā acintyā vai maharṣibhiḥ ।।98।।
ṣaḍviṃśatikṣitipālā mahāścaryaṃ prapedire ।
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ cānumātuṃ na śakyate ।।99।।
abhavan garvahīnāśca sāmagryalpaṃ nijaṃ viduḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya rādhe yajñaphalaṃ labhet ।। 2.167.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ devāyatanaviśvakarmaṇoḥ ketumālīyabhūbhṛtāṃ prajānāṃ ca yajñabhūmāvāgamanam,
maṇḍapakuṇḍahavyopakaraṇādisamupasthitiritinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 167 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 167 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 168
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 169 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
akṣarākhyaṃ pārṣadaṃ svaṃ sasmāra tūrṇameva ha ।। 1 ।।
āgataścākṣarastatra kuṃkumavāpikāsthale ।
natvā tasthā haristasmai dadāvājñāṃ śubhaśrutim ।। 2 ।।
ketumāle mahān yajño bhaviṣyatīti patrikām ।
kuṃkumāḍhyāṃ sarvasṛṣṭāśamantraṇārthamarthadām ।। 3 ।।
śīghraṃ divyaiḥ pārṣadaistvaṃ sampreṣaya ca mā ciram ।
ityuktvā bhagavān tasmai dadau tāṃ patrikāṃ yathā ।। 4 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām ।
ketumāle sāprapauṭhāniṣṭhāparāsamāgame ।। 5 ।।
śrāvaṇe śuklapañcamyāṃ sarveṣṭiṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ makham ।
kariṣyati trilokasthaistatrāgantavyamādarāt ।। 6 ।।
gṛhṇīmaścātithilābhaṃ makhalābhaṃ vidantu ca ।
ekādaśyāṃ pūrṇahavo bhaviṣyati sukhotsavaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
avatārā īśvarāśca pitaraḥ ṛṣidevatāḥ ।
mānavāḥ kāśyapāḥ sarve pātālādinivāsinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi samāyāntu makhe sukhāḥ ।
lomaśaśca yavakrītaḥ kapilaśca bṛhaspatiḥ । । 9 ।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān uralaketubhūpatiḥ ।
īśānaśca vayamete nivedayāma ādarāt ।। 2.168.1 0।।
jīvaloke īśaloke brahmaloke vasanti ye ।
āgantavyaṃ samastaistairnārāyaṇo'pi vacmyaham ।। 11 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastrivārakaṃ dale ।
pratijñāya punarvacmi sarve cāyāntu vai makhe ।। 12।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrāt tṛtīyāyāmahaṃ makhe ।
gamiṣyāmi bhavadbhiścopasthātavyaṃ tadā makhe ।। 13 ।।
pārṣadāḥ sarvadhāmasthāḥ pārṣadānyaśca śaktayaḥ ।
samāyāntu mahīmānasevārthaṃ pūrvake dine ।। 14।।
ityevaṃ patrikāḥ koṭirūpiṇīḥ samapraiṣayat ।
sarvalokeṣu bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 15।।
cidākāśena ca bhūtākāśena māyayā tathā ।
mahākālena dharmeṇa dvārā vai sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ।। 16।।
sṛṣṭyādau rādhike sarvatattvānāṃ lokalokinām ।
āsīt kuṭumbavad yogaḥ saṃsargo melanaṃ gatiḥ ।। 17।।
tatra naivāsti cāścaryaṃ yatraite dvārarūpiṇaḥ ।
ahaṃ golokagaścāpi tvayā sākaṃ tadā'gamam ।। 18।।
sarve nārāyaṇāstatrā'gacchan vilokya patrikāḥ ।
sarvasṛṣṭijanāstatra cāyayuḥ snehasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 19।।
vārdhayastu janānāṃ vai vimānānāṃ tadāmbare ।
pradṛśyante sarvadikṣu tvāyānto makhabhūmikām ।।2.168.20 ।।
koṭyarbudābjapadmāni tvāyayuḥ pratidikstarāt ।
yāvanto muktakoṭyaśca tāvantaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ।। 21।।
tāvatyaḥ śaktayaścāpi muktānyaḥ siddhayastathā ।
tāvantaśceśvarāḥ sarve svasvaśaktyādiśobhitāḥ ।।22।।
tāvantaśca maheśādyāstāvantaścāṇḍavāsinaḥ ।
surā'surāścidacido dravyaguṇakriyādikāḥ ।।23।।
vedā vidyāśca tīrthāni tattvāni dharmavistarāḥ ।
tāvanta eva khanijāḥ sarvasvarganivāsijaḥ ।।24।।
vivarasthāśca miśrasthā vyatiriktāstathā'nvitāḥ ।
parabrahmamayāḥ sarve triguṇāstatra cāyayuḥ ।।25।।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsānāṃ darśanaṃ durlabhaṃ tu yat ।
makhe'tra sulabhaṃ tadvai nārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt ।।26।।
kiṃ vaktavyaṃ tadā rādhe'nyathākartā haristadā ।
kartā'kartā'pi siddhaḥ sa nānyaśaktistu tādṛśī ।।27।।
cumbyante sarvasāmagryo yādṛśaṃ cumbakaṃ bhavet ।
cumbako'tra parabrahma sarvā''kṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃ na vai ।।28।।
varṇayituṃ na śaknomi yathā''kṛṣṭāḥ prajā makhe ।
ataḥ pūrvaṃ mayā''kṛṣṭā na dṛṣṭā vai makhāntare ।।29।।
utsavātte samāyānti kīrtanairvādyanartanaiḥ ।
vadantaśca parabrahmā''mantrayatyeva no'pyaho ।।2.168.3 0 ।।
evaṃ vai gamyamāneṣu sarveṣu ca samantataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prasthānamācarat ।।3 1।।
ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ sākaṃ kṣetrapālādibhistathā ।
tīrthaiḥ saurāṣṭradeśīyaiḥ prajājanaiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ ।।32।।
brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।
bhaktaistathā kuṭumbena sahā''rohad vimānakam ।। 33 ।।
vimāneṣu sahasreṣu tathā'nyā bhaktakoṭayaḥ ।
ārohan vyomamārgeṇa jayanādān pracakrire ।।34।।
sādhavaśca tathā siddhāḥ satyo'nvīyustadā harim ।
ākāśaṃ vyanadat sarvaṃ vimānavādyagarjanaiḥ ।।35।।
agre vedā mūrtimantaḥ prayānti mantrighoṣiṇaḥ ।
vetradharyaḥ śāradādyā gāyanti guṇakīrtanam ।। 36।।
devavādyavimānāni kavayo yānti vai tataḥ ।
niśānadhvajaḍaṃkādyāstato yānti jayadhvanāḥ ।।37।।
tato muktāstataḥ patnyo brahmapriyā asaṃkhyakāḥ ।
tato vimānaṃ kṛṣṇasya tataśca rakṣiṇo janāḥ ।।38।।
pārṣadāśca tataḥ sarve prajāstataḥ surāṣṭrajāḥ ।
kṣetrapālāḥ sarvapaścāḥ samāyānti makhe tadā ।।39।।
himālayaḥ svayaṃ yadvad gagane kiṃ pragacchati ।
svargaṃ vā svayamāgatya kṣityuttare pragacchati ।।2.168.40 ।।
sāgarā ratnaśobhāḍhyā yānti vā nākameva kim ।
ityevaṃ darśanaṃ vyomni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।41 ।।
prasthānasārthayānasyā'bhavattadā vilakṣaṇam ।
tṛtīyāyā dine madhyāhnottaraṃ bhagavān svayam ।।42।।
ghaṭikāsu daśasveva vyatītāsu makhāmbaram ।
prāpa tadā jayadhvānā'ntarīkṣe khe sthale'bhavan ।।43।।
arbudā'rbudakoṭyaśca darśakānāṃ viniryayuḥ ।
ākāśaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ vilakṣaṇena cā'bhavat ।।44।।
sūryavahnayādayo yatra vilīnā naiva gocarāḥ ।
lokānāṃ darśanayogyānyāsan naitrāṇi vai tadā ।।45।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kṛpayaiva ha ।
śrīharestejasā sarve tejomayaṃ hyabhūttadā ।।46।।
api kṛṣṇāḥ śilāḥ sarvā bhāsante maṇayo yathā ।
api kṛṣṇaṃ bhūtalaṃ tu candrojjvalamabhūttadā ।।47।।
api romāṇi keśāśca svarṇavarṇāstadābhavan ।
api kākā bhramarāśca haṃsā iva ca kokilāḥ ।।48।।
api nīlaṃ tadā vyomā'bhavaccāndraṃ talaṃ yathā ।
apyāntarāṇi lokānāmabhavan brahmabhāni tu ।।49।।
bhautikaṃ tu tadā divyaṃ yāvattvakṣaravaddhyabhūt ।
svargabhūvyomatattvānāṃ bhedo'pi vilayaṃ gataḥ ।।2.168.50 ।।
saptarūpāṇi sarvāṇi śvetavarṇāni cā'bhavan ।
māyāyāstāmaso rakto bhāvo'pi sattvatāṃ yayau ।।51।।
api sarvāśca sāmagryo brahmamayyastadā'bhavan ।
brahmabhavanatulyāśca tadā grāmā gṛhāṇi ca ।।52।।
sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ cābhūd bālakṛṣṇasya tejasā ।
divyopahārapūjādyaiḥ prajā nṛpā maharṣayaḥ ।।53 ।।
rādhike svāgatārthaṃ copatasthire samutsukāḥ ।
jayanādān prakurvantaścitrayantaḥ pratikṛtīḥ ।।54।।
sāñjalayaḥ sārhaṇāśca sabhāvāḥ snehilānanāḥ ।
praphullanetrapadmāśca premabharā''ntarāstathā ।।55।।
nāryaḥ kukṣau dhṛtabālā narāścyutaśirodhṛtāḥ ।
ūrdhvalagnavṛttayaścottānānanāstadā'bhavan ।।56।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।
tirobhāvayadugraṃ tattejo'mbarādavātaran ।।57।।
sarvadṛśyo'bhavaccāpi sthūladṛśyo'bhavat prabhuḥ ।
ambarāt suramuktānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭistadā'bhavat ।।58।।
candanānāṃ śubhā vṛṣṭiścā'kṣatānāṃ tathā'bhavat ।
svarṇarūpyakahīrāṇāṃ vṛṣṭistadā'mbarādabhūt ।।59।।
klṛptagopurasopānaiḥ śanaiḥ kṛṣṇo hyavātarat ।
caturdantārjunahastiyāne kṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayat ।।2.168.6 0।।
nṛpāḥ sarve svarṇaratnahārān gucchān samārpayan ।
nemuśca daṇḍavat devyo rājñyaḥ kanyā vyavardhayan ।।61 ।।
bhagavantaṃ tvakṣatādyaiścāṃkuraiścandanaiḥ sumaiḥ ।
netrapuṭākhyakamalairduḥkhahāñjalibhirmuhuḥ ।।62।।
śāṭīprāntaistathā copasthānaiḥ svastikahastakaiḥ ।
hṛdayaiḥ premabhāvaiśca namanaistamavardhayan ।।63।।
jayaśabdaiśca lājābhiḥ kusumaistīrthavāribhiḥ । [
avardhayan hariṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prajāḥ ।।64।।
vyajanaiścāmaraiśchatraiḥ sugandhiśītalairjalaiḥ ।
gandhasārānvitaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śreṣṭhino sukhayan mudā।।65।।
nārikelaiḥ śarkarābhiḥ kuṃkumābīralālakaiḥ ।
māṃgalikaphalādyaiśca bālakṛṣṇaṃ vyavardhayan ।।66।।
svarṇarathe śatacakre divyasiṃhāsane prabhuḥ ।
rājamānaśca gṛhṇāti janārpitopadāstadā ।।67।।
kāṃścid dṛṣṭyā netrakoṇaiḥ smitairhastaiśca kena ca ।
bhāvaistu vividhaiḥ kṛṣṇo mānayāmāsa vai prajāḥ ।।68।।
sarvebhyo hāsavadanairbahurūpaistadā hariḥ ।
samantato dadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ kṛpayā ciram ।।69।।
yathā cāgre tathā paśce yathā pārśve tathordhvake ।
tathaiva sarvanetreṣu hṛdayeṣvapyadṛśyata ।।2.168.70।।
kebhyaściddhārapuṣpāṇi dadātyeva prasādataḥ ।
kebhyaściddhīrakān mauktikādīn ratnāni gucchakān ।।71 ।।
dadātyeva mahārājaḥ prāsādikān pareśvaraḥ ।
phalāni tāmbūlakāni pūgyādīni dadāti ca ।।72।।
nārikelāni vastrāṇi pūjāyāmāgatāni ca ।
svāgatārthopadātmāni prāsādīni dadāti vai ।।73 ।।
śatakrośeṣu sarvatra datvā svadarśanaṃ hariḥ ।
gajayānena vai rātrau nivāsālayamāyayau ।।74।।
jalapānādikaṃ cakruḥ sarve sārthāśca bhojanam ।
dattālayeṣu yogyeṣu viśaśramuśca vai tataḥ ।।75।।
sakuṭumbo hariścāpi brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।
ṣaḍyukcatvāriṃśadūrdhvaṃ śatayuk bubhuje svayam ।।76 ।।
papau śāntiṃ jagāmā'tha nidrāṃ yogamayīmapi ।
āprātaścāpi jagrāha dāsadāsīprasevitaḥ ।।77।।
rātrau sthale sthale tatra babhūvuḥ kīrtanāni tu ।
kathāḥ prāgvṛttamiśrāśca saṃpracakrurmaharṣayaḥ ।।78।।
cāraṇā vaṃśavistārān itivṛttajuṣastadā ।
itihāsān jagaduśca samāje bhūbhṛtāṃ tadā ।।79 ।।
sādhavo jñānavārtāśca cakrurmokṣavidhipradāḥ ।
nāryo gāyanti rāgādyairgītikāḥ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।।2.168.80 ।।
kanyakā rāsamābadhya bhramanti vartulāni ca ।
gāyanti tālikādhvānairnupūraghurghurīgataiḥ ।।8 1।।
nartakyo nartanaṃ raṃge kurvanti dhanisaṃkule ।
vādyakā vādyakuśalā vādayanti ramanti ca ।।82।।
naṭā nāṭyaṃ prakurvanti darśayanti ca pāṭavam ।
kavayo racanāvyāptā dṛśyante śaṃsinastadā ।।83।।
mallāḥ kurvanti yuddhāni lokarañjanakāni ca ।
pradarśanāni dṛśyante sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyantarāṇi ca ।।84।।
indrajālāni lokyante racitāni suvedibhiḥ ।
hāsyaśālāsu hāsyāni narmāṇi ca bhavantyapi ।।85।।
prakāśyante vahnicūrṇairvidyudagnisuśilpibhiḥ ।
vahnāvākārarūpāṇi cāmbare garjanāni ca ।।86।।
khelanāni vahniyogaiḥ kṣipyante tvambare'pi ca ।
bhavanti garjanā vyomni prasphoṭadravyacitratā ।।87।।
bahurūpadharāścāddi rūpyante kauśalairnijaiḥ ।
bhaṇḍakā veṣakāścāpi rañjayanti prajāstadā ।।88।।
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ rāṇḍiyānāṃ pragarviṇām ।
kariṇāṃ bhallukānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ yodhanāni ca ।।89।।
rātrāvutsavarūpeṇā'bhavaँstadā tu rādhike ।
dvandvavādyānyavādyanta tūpaśabdāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।2.168.90।।
ajāyanta murādīnāṃ vipañcīnāṃ svarāstadā ।
apsarasāṃ kanyakānāṃ gītayaḥ sarvato'bhavan ।।91।।
vaidikā dhvanayastatrā''rṣāṇāmapyabhavan kṣitau ।
napuṃsakānāṃ narmāṇi puttalīkhelanāni ca ।। 92।।
gāruḍīnāṃ ca vidyānāṃ prayogāśca tadā'bhavan ।
kalpajālasya racanā vividhāśca kvacitsthale ।।93।।
rāse kṛṣṇakṛtā līlā gopījanavibhūṣitāḥ ।
kutraciccā'bhavaँstatra bhaktibhedairmanogamāḥ ।।94।।
rāmādityanarādityalīlāścāpi kvacitsthale ।
bālakṛṣṇacamatkārāḥ kvacitkurvanti tadvidaḥ ।।95 ।।
evaṃ rātrau tadā rādhe! janānāṃ bhūmivāsinām ।
tathānyeṣāṃ yatheṣṭānyāsannānandotsavāni vai ।।96।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya tathā śrīkambharāśriyaḥ ।
yaśogānāni yoṣitsu sarvasthale tadā'bhavan ।।97।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ surāṣṭaṃ cājanābhigam ।
tadā gītiṣu sarvāsāṃ dhanyavādena śasyate ।।98।।
gāṃgeyāstu tadā bālā bālikā bhūbhṛtastathā ।
ṛṣayo brahmabhaktāśca praśasyante ca gītiṣu ।।99।।
dvinadīsaṃgamaścāpi tīrthaṃ sudarśanaṃ tathā ।
yajñatīrthaṃ śatakrośaṃ śasyante rādhike'bhitaḥ ।। 2.168.10 0।।
evaṃ tṛtīyarātriḥ sā vyatīyāya sukhocchrayā ।
prātarjātaṃ caturthyāstu kṛṣṇo nidrāṃ jahāti ca ।। 10 1।।
maṃgalāni ca turyāṇi hyavādyanta samantataḥ ।
agāyanta yaśovārtāḥ sūtamāgadhabandayaḥ ।। 1 02।।
rādhike śrīharirnidrāṃ tatyāja maṃgalaśravāḥ ।
unnidraṃ sarvataḥ kṣetraṃ cābhūt krośaśatāntaram ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñamaṃgalapatrikāprakāśanaṃ sarvasṛṣṭivāsināmāgamanaṃ śrīhareḥ sakuṭumbasaurāṣṭrīyaprajāsahitasya vimānairyajñabhūmigamanaṃ svāgataṃ bhramaṇaṃ viśrāntirmanorañjanādīni cetinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 168 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike prātarutthāya bhagavān snānamācarat ।
dhyānaṃ japaṃ tathā homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 ।।
pūjanaṃ nijarūpasya pitṛdarśanavandanam ।
sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca darśanaṃ cākarottataḥ ।। 2 ।।
dugdhāmṛtaṃ manāk pītvā yajñabhūmyavalokanam ।
kartuṃ kariṇamāruhya niryayau sa nijālayāt ।। 3 ।।
sapakṣahastī vyomnaivā'sañcarat sarvabhūmiṣu ।
vyalokayacchubhāṃ bhūmiṃ sudarśanaṃ pragṛhya ca ।। 4 ।।
līnaṃ prakāśitaṃ jātaṃ yatra tatraiva vedikām ।
viśvakarmakṛtāṃ vīkṣya prasannaḥ sthānamāyayau ।। 5 ।।
praśaśaṃsa hariśceśānaṃ devaṃ sarvadṛṣṭikam ।
bhaktaṃ devāyanaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ kapilādikān ।। 6 ।।
devaguruṃ gaṇeśādīn praśaśaṃsa tadā hariḥ ।
sāmagrīdāyakān sarvān dāsān dāsīśca koṭiśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
sarvabhūpālakāँścāpi praśaśaṃsa haristadā ।
sarvatattvāni bhagavān praśaśaṃsa muhurmuhuḥ। ।। 8 ।।
rājānaḥ ṛṣayaḥ satyaḥ sādhavaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ।
vrahmapriyādyāśca tataścakruḥ pūjāṃ harestadā ।। 9 ।।
lomaśādīn harirnatvā viśrāntiṃ mandire'labhat ।
prātaḥ peyāni bhojyāni sarvebhyo'dāpayat prabhuḥ ।। 2.169.1 0।।
rasaśālāḥ pravartante dīyante bhojanāni ca ।
yathāyogyāni ceṣṭāni sarvebhyaḥ pūrṇatṛptaye ।। 11 ।।
prātarārabhya vai bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ cānyadapekṣitam ।
sātatyena pravāheṇa dīyate cā''niśāmukham ।। 1 2।।
yathā yāni tu tattvāni varṣmāṇi yādṛśāni ca ।
yādṛśaṃ pathyameteṣāṃ tādṛg dadati vallikāḥ ।। 1 3।।
maṇayo dhenavaścāpi vṛkṣāśca kalpacintanāḥ ।
muktā muktānya evāpi siddhayaḥ śrīramādayaḥ ।। 14।।
brāhmyaḥ suśaktayo'nantā aiśvaryāṇi guṇāstathā ।
arpayanti samastebhyo'pekṣyabhojyāni vai tadā ।। 15।।
pratimandirametebhyaḥ prāpayantīṣṭabhojyakam ।
yadyadapekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tvadhikaṃ prāpayanti hi ।। 16।।
tvaṃ rādhe'marṣamāpannā dṛṣṭvā gāṃgeyagauravam ।
kinna smarasi śāntā ca mayā tvaṃ sunayaiḥ kṛtā ।। 17।।
bhojitā vanditā tvaṃ tu gaṃgayā pādavāhitā ।
śṛṃgāritā kavaryā ca prasannā tvaṃ tadā hyabhūḥ ।। 18।।
caturthyāṃ rādhike tatra prāghūṇikā viśeṣataḥ ।
samāyayurvimānaiśca koṭiśo mānavā dine ।। 1 9।।
rāśiyānapradeśebhyo ṣoḍaśalakṣamānavāḥ ।
prāgjyotirdeśato lakṣamānavāścāyayustadā ।।2.169.20।।
prācīnadeśataścāpi daśalakṣāṇi cāyayuḥ ।
brahmadeśāllakṣajanā uṣṭrālayācca lakṣakam ।। 21 ।।
ājanābhāt koṭijanā abriktāt koṭiśo janāḥ ।
āraktāllakṣajanatāścottarādapi cāyayuḥ ।।22।।
mānavānāṃ koṭicatuṣṭayaṃ tatrā'bhavattadā ।
tadanyānāṃ tu lokānāṃ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinām ।।23।।
āgatānāṃ dehināṃ tu saṃkhyāsaṃkhyā na vidyate ।
mahīmānālayā bhūmau jale'nile'ntarīkṣake ।।24।।
meghe girau ca vivare'mbare tattveṣu sarvaśaḥ ।
racitāścābhavan viśvakarmaṇā sūkṣmadarśinā ।।25।।
siddhimantastadā cāṇūbhūya miśrīprabhūya ca ।
līnībhūyā'pi yajñe'tra tiṣṭhanti harimānasaḥ ।।।26।।
pare brahmaṇi sarveṣāṃ tvakṣare cāpi dhāmani ।
āntarabhāvavāsena samāveśo'bhavattadā ।।27।।
mamuḥ sarve pare dhāmnyakṣare sākṣādvirājite ।
āścaryaṃ nāsti rādhe'tra sarvāśrayo yato hariḥ ।।28।।
aṇudeśe sarvasṛṣṭīḥ samāveśayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।
svalpe sthale viśālatvaṃ pradarśayitumarhati ।।29।।
tatkṛtyantaṃ na vinde'haṃ ko'nyo jñātuṃ tadā'rhati ।
aṇau sṛṣṭīḥ kṣaṇe kalpān darśayituṃ sa cārhati ।।2.169.3 0।।
jalagaṇḍūṣamātreṇa tarpayituṃ trilokajān ।
kaṇabhakṣaṇamātreṇa tṛptiṃ dātuṃ sa cārhati ।।3 1।।
asaṃbhāvyaṃ tathā'tarkyaṃ tathā'śakyaṃ na mādhave ।
yanmūrteḥ sarvamevedaṃ samabhūt cekṣaṇātpurā ।।32।।
yatsaṃkalpātpunarhrāsaṃ cānte tatraiva yāsyati ।
ko'haṃ kā tvaṃ tathā cānye nārāyaṇāścaturbhujāḥ ।।33।।
tadagre śaktimanto vai yanmūrterabhavāma ha ।
alaṃ cātivacobhiśca sarvādhāro harirhi saḥ ।।34।।
sarvānakarot sukhino makhe saṃbhāvanādibhiḥ ।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇo'sau caturthyāṃ madhyage ravau ।।35।।
mantrān dadau nṛpebhyaśca janatābhyaśca maṇḍape ।
koṭirūpadharo bālakṛṣṇaḥ sarvatra so'bhavat ।। 36 ।।
pratyāśrayaṃ tadā vṛṣyāṃ kuśajāyāṃ niṣadya ca ।
sajalaṃ bhaktakarṇeṣu mantrānaśrāvayat prabhuḥ ।।37।।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 38।।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।। 3 9।।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ' ।
'anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।।2.169.40।।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।।41 ।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī me'yaṃ patirhi me' ।
evaṃ śaraṇamantraṃ cārpaṇamantraṃ ca rakṣakam ।।42।।
manuṃ ca brahmabhāvaṃ ca mantraṃ svāmyanivedakam ।
sarvasvaṃ ca manuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।43 ।।
yathādhikāraṃ saṃvīkṣyā''bālavṛddhanarīnarān ।
kṛtārthān śrāvayāmāsa cakāra mānavān bahūn ।।44।।
tato vai bhojanaṃ cakrurdīkṣitāśca harirjanāḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyānaṃ sāyameva vai ।
lomaśaḥ pracakārā'tha cakre nīrājanaṃ hareḥ ।।45 ।।
jāyante cotsavāstatra rātrau tu bhojanottaram ।
sarveṣāṃ sukhadā rādhe'pararātre viśaśramuḥ ।।46।।
pañcamyāṃ ca prage brāhme muhūrte śrīhariḥ svayam ।
sasnau tu saṃgame nadyoḥ sarve sasnustataḥ param ।।47।।
nityavidhīn vidhāyā'tha kṛtvā devārhaṇādikam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yajñamaṇḍapaṃ śīghramāyayau ।।48।।
rājānaśca prajāḥ sarve ṛṣayo munayastathā ।
karmacārāḥ ṛtvijaśca jāpakādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।49।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadā'bhavan susūcakāḥ ।
adhvarasya kriyākāṇḍaṃ kurvantu bhūsurā iti ।।2.169.50 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścājijñapad dvijān ।
viprādyā maṃgalaṃ cakrarvedamantraiḥ prasusvaram ।।51।।
ācāryo lomaśastatra deśakālāvakīrtayat ।
gaṇeśasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।52।।
ācāryavaraṇaṃ cakre natvā śrīlomaśaṃ gurum ।
prakoṣṭhe bandhanaṃ cakre cakre cāvāhanaṃ kṣiteḥ ।।53 ।।
pañcagavyakuśairbhūmeḥ prokṣaṇaṃ pracakāra ha ।
bhūtādyapakramārthaṃ ca prākṣipat śvetasarṣapān ।।54।।
evaṃ bhūmiṃ pūjayitvā prāyaścittaṃ cakāra ha ।
ācamanaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā cakre prapūjanam ।।55।।
svātmakasya gaṇeśasya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।
puṇyāhavācanaṃ cakre kalaśasthāpanaṃ tathā ।।56।।
āśīrvādān dadustatra brāhmaṇā vedavedinaḥ ।
śāntipāṭhāñjagurvārisekaṃ cakrustadā dvijāḥ ।।57।।
svastivāco jaguścāpi cakruḥ kṛṣṇābhisecanam ।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ cakrurnāndīśrāddhaṃ pracakrire ।।58।।
tadaṃgadakṣiṇādānaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ ।
pratyekācāryavaraṇaṃ brahmavaraṇamityapi ।।59।।।
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ dvārapālavaraṇamityapi ।
jāpakānāṃ varaṇaṃ ca cakre pupūja tāँstataḥ ।।2.169.60।।
tataḥ pṛthivīṃ sampūjya cakre digrakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
samprokṣya yajñasāmagrīḥ svastimantrān jagāda ha ।।61 ।।
maṇḍapapūjanaṃ vāstupūjanaṃ pracakāra ha ।
vāstudevārhaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vidhinā pracakāra ha ।।62।।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ cakre phalauṣadhimṛdārpaṇam ।
darbhapavitradānaṃ ca tīrthāvāhanamityapi ।।63।।
athā'gnyuttāraṇa cakre sarvadevān pupūja ca ।
prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantrāṃśca jagāda parameśvaraḥ ।।64।।
yoginīkṣetrapālāँśca pupūja vidhinā hariḥ ।
pīṭhadevārhaṇaṃ cakre baliṃ dadau nanāma ca ।।65।।
maṇḍapasyā'rhaṇaṃ cakre brahmapūjāṃ cakāra ha ।
tathā maṇḍapadevānāmarhaṇaṃ pracakāra ca ।।66।।
ṣoḍaśādistambhapūjāṃ bahirdevādipūjanam ।
śākhādevaprapūjāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।67।।
sarvakalaśapūjāṃ ca vedapūjāṃ cakāra ha ।
vedīkuṇḍeṣu sarveṣu kuṇḍapūjāṃ cakāra ca ।।68।।
kuṇḍamadhye viśvakarmapūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
mekhalāpūjanaṃ tatra devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।69।।
yonipūjāṃ kaṇṭhapūjāṃ nābhipūjāṃ cakāra saḥ ।
vāstupūruṣapūjāṃ ca vahnisthāpanamācarat ।।2.169.70।।
navagrahārhaṇaṃ cādhidevatārhaṇamācarat ।
pratyadhidevatāpūjāṃ nāgapūjāṃ samācarat ।।7 1 ।।
lokapālārhaṇaṃ cakre gaṇeśabhūtapūjanam ।
dikpālapūjanaṃ cakre śrīdevīpūjanaṃ tathā ।।72।।
maṇḍalasthāpitadevārhaṇaṃ cakre haristathā ।
kalaśārhaṇamevāpi ṣaṭpañcāśatsurārhaṇam 73।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ pitṛpūjanaṃ siddhapūjanam ।
mṛtyukālārhaṇaṃ cakre saritsāgarapūjanam ।।74।।
śailā''yudhā'rhaṇaṃ cakre ārṣīdevīprapūjanam ।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā varuṇārhaṇamācarat ।।75।।
caturviṃśatyavatārān vāsudevādikānapi ।
īśvarān tatsatīḥ sādhvī sarvāśca harirārcayat ।।76।।
tridevapārṣadān sarvān sarvadhāmanivāsinaḥ ।
brahmasṛṣṭimayān sarvān īśasṛṣṭimayānapi ।।77।।
jīvasṛṣṭimayān sarvān śrīkṛṣṇaḥ samapūjayat। ।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu ye vasanti tu dehinaḥ ।।78।।
jaḍān divyān cetanāँśca gurūn dāsīśca dāsakān ।
catuḥkhaniṣu cotpannān sarvān kṛṣṇo hyapūjayat ।।79।।
pratikuṇḍaṃ ca rājānastathā cakruḥ prapūjanam ।
tattanmaharṣiguruṇā yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā vyadhuḥ ।।2.169.80।।
dravyatyāgaṃ kuṇḍavahnau cakāra parameśvaraḥ ।
prokṣaṇīprokṣaṇaṃ cakre tathā''jyahavanaṃ vyadhāt। ।।8 1 ।।
caruṃ tvagnau samāropya tathā'vasthāpya tatsthale ।
samidho havanaṃ cakre sruveṇā''jyāhutīrdadau ।।82।।
svāhā devāyā'mukāyetyevaṃ homaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭibhya eva ca ।।83।।
yajñadevebhya evā'pi bahvāhutīrdadau prabhuḥ ।
kuṇḍamaṇḍapavāstūnāṃ devatābhyo havaṃ dadau ।
satīsādhvīsevikāśaktibhyaḥ kṛṣṇo havaṃ dadau ।।84।।
yoginībhyaśca muktābhyo brahmapriyābhya ityapi ।
sarvāṃgavyāpinībhyaḥ siddhibhyaḥ kṛṣṇo havaṃ dadau ।।85।।
ādityavasurudrāśvikumārebhyo havaṃ dadau ।
avatārasahitāya nijāya cāhutīrdadau ।।86।।
carvāhutīrdadau cāmṛtātmikāstṛptaye hariḥ ।
yūpāropaṃ tataścakre yūpadevānapūjayat ।।87।।
yūpamasiñcayaccāpi baliṃ yūpāya vai dadau ।
nidrākalaśapūjāṃ ca prākārayaddharistataḥ ।।88।।
āmantritān jīvajātān yajñe bhāgaṃ harirdadau ।
pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ phalāni ca rasān dadau ।।89।।
yathā yathā makhe vahnau sahasrāyutadhārikāḥ ।
patantyāhutayo havyātmikāstathā tathā'bhitaḥ ।।2.169.90।।
sarve jīvāstṛptimanto jāyante haryanugrahāt ।
vrīhayaśca yavā nivārādyā munyannakāni ca ।।9 1।।
kharjurā rasavantaśca kaṇā miṣṭarasānvitāḥ ।
oṣadhayaśca samidhaḥ phalāni rasavanti ca ।।92।।
śarkarādyāstathā miṣṭānnāni cāhutayo'bhavan ।
vahnayaḥ sarvajātīyāścāgatya tṛptimāvahan ।।93।।
agnimukhā dehinaśca ye'nye brahmamukhāstathā ।
kṛṣṇamukhāstathā sarve sādhumukhāstathā'pare ।। 94।।
satīmukhyo devikāmukhyaśca yāḥ śaktayastathā ।
svāhāmukhyaśca yā lakṣmīśrīmukhyaśca tathā'parāḥ ।।95।।
annapūrṇānanā yāśca sarvāstāstṛptimāvahan ।
jaḍacetanatattvāni tṛptāni vividhairhavaiḥ ।।96।।
pūrṇāhutiṃ dadau paścādārārtrikaṃ tato'karot ।
sarvadevādisattvānāṃ viśrāntiṃ pradadau tataḥ ।।97।।
evaṃ vai saptaviṃśatyātmakeṣu kuṇḍakeṣu ca ।
sarvatra ṛṣibhiḥ pūjābalidānahavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।98।।
rājabhiryugalaiścāpi havanecchāyutaistathā ।
gṛhīto havalābhaśca bālakṛṣṇājñayā makhe ।।99।।
dakṣiṇāḥ pratipūjāyāṃ bhūyasyo'rpyanta eva ca ।
phalāhārā rasāhārā annāhārā hyatipriyāḥ ।। 2.169.100।।
dīyante sarvajantubhyaḥ svasvāhārāstu śārṅgiṇā ।
kalpacintāmaṇijanyā dīyante bhakṣyasadrasāḥ ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ nirvartitaṃ ramyaṃ pañcamīhavanaṃ śubham ।
tataḥ sarvānabjakoṭyarbudapadmādisaṃkhyakān ।। 1 02।।
muktān dhāmāni muktānīścāvatārāँśca tatpriyāḥ ।
pārṣadān pārṣadānīśca bhojayāmāsa cāmṛtān ।।1 03 ।।
miṣṭānnāni ca divyāni peyānyanantakāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi lehyānyapi śubhāni ca ।। 1 04।।
brahmapriyāstathā bhaktāḥ satīḥ sādhvīrharipriyāḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān kanyakā bahusaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 1 05।।
īśvarānīśvarāṇīśca māyāṃ māyākuṭumbakam ।
caturviṃśatitattvāni bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 1 06।।
aṣṭāvaraṇalokasthān brahmeśaviṣṇusevakān ।
tridevadāsadāsīśca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 1 07।।
tridevadevikāḥ sarvā brahmacaryā'dhikanyakāḥ।
devīḥ kumārikā yoginīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīḥ satīḥ ।। 1 08।।
sarvāḥ saṃbhojayāmāsa vrataikādaśikādikāḥ ।
tithirūpān devikānāṃ gaṇānapsarasastathā ।। 1 09।।
sarvāḥ saṃbhojayāmāsa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
merusthān satyalokasthān maharjanatapaḥsthitān ।। 2.169.11 0।।
ṛṣīn pitṝn tathā''rṣīśca pitṛkā mātṛkāstathā ।
svaḥsthān devān devikāśca bhuvarlokasthitāँstathā ।। 11 1।।
bhūsthānnarān nārīvargān jarāyujā'ṇḍajāँstathā ।
svedajānudbhitprajātān bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 11 2।।
tīrthānyaraṇyasaritaḥ parvatān sāgarādikān ।
api kīṭapataṃgādyān bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 11 3।।
brahmaputrān rājasāṃśca tāmasān sarvajātikān ।
dharmādharmaprajātāँśca kāśyapān sūryacandrajān ।। 1 14।।
pātālasthān rākṣasāँśca yakṣān gandharvakinnarān ।
saptatalino bhūtāँśca pretān yamālayasthitān ।। 11 5।।
kiṃpuṃso māgadhān sūtān bandijanānabhojayat ।
cāraṇān śūdrajātīyān vidyādhrān vanavāsinaḥ ।। 1 16।।
krūrān sattvān ḍākinīśca śākinīśca tathā'parāḥ ।
cāṇḍālān śvapacān paśūn bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 1 17।।
sarpānnāgān pakṣigaṇān kuṣmāṇḍān pravināyakān ।
daityān devānāsurāँśca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 1 18।।
jaḍaṃ ca cetanaṃ sarvam ādhārādheyamiśritam ।
bubhuje yajñabhāgaṃ vai kratoḥ prāsādikaṃ śubham ।। 11 9।।
sarvaṃ trisṛṣṭijaṃ nityamanityaṃ sthirajaṃgamam ।
bhuktvā yajñaprasādaṃ sutṛptimāpa hi śāśvatīm ।। 2.169.1 20।।
rādhādyā me priyāḥ sarvāstṛptimāptā prasādajām ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! yajñakāryaṃ cādyadine'bhavat ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñe bhūmipūjanaṃ vāstukuṇḍamaṇḍapādidevānāṃ pūjanaṃ brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭidehināṃ pūjanaṃ havanaṃ mahāpūrṇāhutidānaṃ
bhojanadānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 169।।


← adhyāyaḥ 169 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 170
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 171 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāmaṣṭamītithau ।
navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ ca tarpitā hariṇā makhe ।। 1 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ tarpitāśca yāvadbhirvidhibhistathā ।
sarve vai dehino'dehāḥ sthūlasūkṣmā hi nāminaḥ ।। 2 ।।
jaḍāścetanajātāśca dravyākhyāśca guṇābhidhāḥ ।
karmābhidhāśca taddevāstattattattveśvarādayaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sarvalokanivāsāśca sarve kuṭumbinastathā ।
sthāvarā jaṃgamā nāryo narāḥ ṣaṇḍhāśca tarpitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
abhidheyaṃ na vai kiñcid bhojane hyavaśiṣyate ।
evaṃ sarveṣṭiyajño'yaṃ vaiṣṇavo hariṇā kṛtaḥ ।। 5 ।।
saptāhe nityamāyānti lokalokanivāsinaḥ ।
kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ yānti koṭyarbudā narāḥ striyaḥ ।। 6 ।।
gagane tu vimānānāṃ sāṃkulyaṃ na nivartate ।
yāvanto gagane santi surāḥ svargādivāsinaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tāvanto mānavā bhūmau tāvantaḥ parvatādiṣu ।
tāvanta eva vṛkṣeṣu tāvantaśca nadīṣu ca ।। 8 ।।
naukāsu taṭabhūmyādau tāvantaḥ santi mānavāḥ ।
maṇḍapeṣu ca śālāsu saudheṣu gahvareṣvapi ।। 9 ।।
kuṃjeṣu ca śakaṭyadau tāvanto vāhaneṣvapi ।
mānavā mānavā yatra tatra lokayanta eva tu ।। 2.170.1 0।।
dhāmadhāmanivāsāśca lokyante tatra tatra ca ।
lokālokanivāsāśca dṛśyante tatra tatra ca ।। 11 ।।
talastaranivāsāśca lokyante sarvatastadā ।
saptāhe cādhvare nityā''gamavṛddhirvilokyate ।। 1 2।।
svarṇarūpyakahīrāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ bhūṣaṇātmanām ।
maṇīnāṃ sarvakāntānāṃ kalpānāṃ śṛṃgiṇo'bhavan ।। 1 3।।
upadāparvatā jātā yānavāhanakoṭayaḥ ।
vastravaibhavabhakṣyāṇāṃ bhogānāṃ śailapaṃktayaḥ ।। 14।।
mauktikānāṃ śikharāṇi miṣṭānnānāṃ tu parvatāḥ ।
bhogyopakaraṇānāṃ tu śailagaṃjāstadā'bhavan ।। 15।।
peyānāṃ saritaścāsan gavyānāṃ vārdhayo'bhavan ।
śevadhayaśca dravyāṇāṃ cāsan makhe samarpitāḥ ।। 1 6।।
kubero vasavaścendro merurbṛhaspatistathā ।
viṣṇurvīkṣyā'dhvararddhīśca babhūvurlajjayā natāḥ ।। 17।।
annapūrṇā mahimānaṃ vilokya pārameśvaram ।
lakṣmīḥ śrīścātra namrā babhūvaturlajjayā'dhvare ।। 18।।
aprameyamatarkyaṃ cā'nupasthitamacintyakam ।
yadyadicchati tattvajñastattadaivopatiṣṭhati ।। 1 9।।
pratāpo'yaṃ harestatra bālakṛṣṇasya rādhike! ।
andhakuṣṭhidaridrāṇāṃ vyaṃgānāṃ duḥkhināmapi ।।2.170.20।।
āndhyaṃ kuṣṭhaśca dāridryaṃ vyaṃgatā vilayaṃ gatā ।
aniṣṭaṃ nāśamāpannaṃ tadeṣṭaṃ prāptameva tu ।। 21।।
svargavat sarvamevā'bhūt makhe'tra pārameśvare ।
siddhayo'pi vilokyaitadāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ।।22।।
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni lajjānamrāṇi cā'bhavan ।
māyā'pi mohamāpannā camatkāre harestadā ।।23।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣituṃ vai koṭyarbudābjamānavāḥ ।
samāyānti cānuvelaṃ sammardo jāyate bahuḥ ।।24।।
nirāśatāṃ tadā yānti janā darśanalālasāḥ ।
teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ paraṃ jñātvā vijñāyā''gamanaśramam ।।25।।
hatāśatāṃ parijñāya bhaktavātsalyavān prabhuḥ ।
antarātmā ca tatraiva bhaktāgre gocaro'bhitaḥ ।।26 ।।
netrāgre koṭirūpaiśca sthale sthale vilokyate ।
yādṛśo maṇḍape cāste homāsane ca yādṛśaḥ ।।27।।
tādṛśaścānyakuṇḍāgre havanāsanakeṣu ca ।
tādṛśo'saṃkhyasaudheṣu maṇḍapeṣu ca tādṛśaḥ ।। 28।।
nadīkūleṣu naukāsu yāneṣvapi ca tādṛśaḥ ।
vimāneṣu ca vṛkṣeṣu vane'raṇyeṣu tādṛśaḥ ।। 29।।
bhakteṣu bhaktavṛndeṣu mārgeṣu vīthikādiṣu ।
śālāsu candraśālāsu pākaśālāsu tādṛśaḥ ।।2.170.3 0।।
mahīmānanivāseṣu cātithisthānakeṣvapi ।
bhojyaśālāsu śaileṣu vāṭikāsvapi tādṛśaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
ratheṣu śakaṭībhāgeṣvapi cāśvagajādiṣu ।
dṛśyeṣu raṃganāṭyeṣu gahvareṣvapi tādṛśaḥ ।।3 2।।
jale sthale'mbare vārdhau sarassu ca nadīṣvapi ।
vigameṣu ca durgeṣu hariḥ sarvatra dṛśyate ।। 2 3।।
mandahāsyānanaḥ śubhraḥ sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ।
pītavastradharaḥ saumyo bālakṛṣṇo vilokyate ।।34।।
divyacihnadharaḥ svāmī dhanurdhvajatriśūlavān ।
mīnasvastikacakrādyaiḥ śobhitaḥ sa vilokyate ।। 35।।
nīlacañcadvakrakeśaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ।
kaustubhaśrīśobhitoraḥsthalo lakṣmīprasevitaḥ ।। 36 ।।
koṭyarkabhādharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilokyate ।
evaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ sarvatodiśam ।।37।।
bhāvukānāṃ purato'bhūt saptāhe cādhvare tadā ।
rādhike! bālavṛddhādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ gṛhṇāti pūjanam ।। 38।।
bhojanaṃ ca pramodaṃ ca gṛhṇāti pradadāti ca ।
ramate rāsabhāveṣu ramate ca satījane ।। 39।।
ramate sarvalokeṣu sarvarūpadharo'bhavat ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā camatkāraṃ rādhe'haṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ ।।2.170.40।।
nārāyaṇo'pi vaikuṇṭheśvaraścāha tadā nu mām ।
paśya kṛṣṇa mahāścaryaṃ parākāṣṭhāgataṃ tvidam ।।41 ।।
rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo bālakṛṣṇo hi rājate ।
nāsti vai tādṛśī bhūmirbālakṛṣṇo na yatra vai ।।42।।
ajñātamārgā lokā ye samāyānti makhaṃ prati ।
agre teṣāṃ jano bhūtvā jāyate mārgadarśakaḥ ।।43।।
asvasthamanasāṃ tvagre bhūtvā sa kathako dvijaḥ ।
kathāṃ purātanīṃ ramyāṃ kathayatyeva rañjanām ।।44।।
asvasthavarṣmaṇā pārśve gatvā vaidyasvarūpavān ।
svāsthyaprasañjakaṃ tebhyo dadāti cauṣadhaṃ śubham ।।45।।
camatkāro'dbhutastatra dṛṣṭo mayā tu rādhike ।
koṭyarbudābjalokeṣu dehatyāgo na kasyacit ।।46।।
nā'kasmāttu kṣayaḥ kvāpi kaścid duḥkhī na tatra ca ।
na kuṭumbī janaḥ kaścid viyuktaḥ svakuṭumbataḥ ।।47।।
sammarde na ca bhūṣādi vigataṃ kasyacittadā ।
nāṃgamardo'bhavattatra kasyacit pādakaccaraḥ ।।48।।
na yānaṃ cāpi bhagnaṃ vā na vastu vigamo'bhavat ।
adṛṣṭabālakṛṣṇaśca na ko'pi mānavo'bhavat ।।49।।
aprāptādhvaraśeṣaśca na kaścid dehavānabhūt ।
aprāptasvāgataḥ kaścinmahīmāno na vā'bhavat ।।2.170.50 ।।
ajātapūrṇakāmaśca tadā kopi na cā'bhavat ।
alabdhabrahmamantraśca tadā kopi na cā'bhavat ।।51 ।।
aho devasya aiśvaryam īśāno'pi mumoha tu ।
vāsudevādayo vyūhā dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ prapedire ।।52।।
lajjānamrā babhūvuste vimadāḥ svabale'bhavan ।
aho vibhavo devasya bālakṛṣṇasya cādhvare ।।53 ।।
mahāviṣṇustu bhūmānaṃ prāhaivaṃ dhūnayan śiraḥ ।
pārvatī māṇikīṃ prāha patyuste'ho camatkṛtiḥ ।।54।।
kaṃbharā kamalāṃ prāha paśya me putravaibhavam ।
kamalā patimodāḍhyā svātmānaṃ bahvamanyata ।।55।।
kṛṣṇasthāne tathā nārāyaṇasthāne sukarmaṇi ।
svayamāste hariḥ kartā mahāścaryaṃ tvidaṃ mama ।।56।।
aho vai rādhike kṛṣṇaprāptyā gāṃgeyakaistviha ।
putrāste sāgarā nimnīkṛtāstīrthavidhāviha ।।57।।
ketumālo nijārthe'dya sārthako harilabdhitaḥ ।
ketuvannanu sañjātaḥ sarvalokeṣu cādyataḥ ।
mālāsu ketuvaccāste brahmāṇḍānāṃ nvayaṃ sadā ।।58।।
bālakṛṣṇaprasaṃgena sadā'dhvareṇa pāvitaḥ ।
śvetadvīpasamo bhāvī tvaiśvarye'yaṃ mahattame ।
pāvano'yaṃ mahān deśo mokṣadātā bhaviṣyati ।।59।।
atra mṛtiṃ gatā jīvāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kīṭādayo hyapi ।
muktiṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ pāpino'pi ca dehinaḥ ।।2.170.6 0।।
yajñaṃ sarveṣṭirūpaṃ tu smariṣyantyapi ye janāḥ ।
teṣāṃ pāpapraṇāśaśca muktiḥ karagatā bhavet ।।6 1 ।।
namiṣyati bhuvaṃ smṛtvā dūradeśagatā api ।
teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ makhajanyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।62।।
api nāma raṭiṣyanti nīparāṃ ca prapīṭhikām ।
teṣāṃ pāpavināśaḥ syāt snānajaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet ।।63।।
saptaviṃśatikuṇḍān yaḥ śaṃsiṣyati tu mānavaḥ ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mahātṛptiṃ smṛddhyādibhiḥ prayāsyati ।।64।।
api dhūlīṃ saṃgamasya madhyabhūmergrahīṣyati ।
mastake vā śarīre vā śuddhātmā sa bhaviṣyati ।।65।।
api padbhyāṃ śraddhayā tāṃ bhūmiṃ tīrthavidhitsayā ।
gamiṣyati tu yaḥ kaścit pade'dhvaraphalaṃ labhet। ।।66 ।।
api sāptāhavāsaṃ vā dinavāsaṃ tu saṃgame ।
kariṣyati janaḥ kaścit svargaṃ tasya tu śāśvatam ।।67।।
api vrataṃ tu sāptāhaṃ dinamātraṃ phalādinā ।
vidhāsyati naro nārī sāmrājyaphalamāpnuyāt ।।68।।
api dīpaṃ patrapṛṣṭhe prajvālya salile tu yaḥ ।
dāsyati tīrthadevāya sa sūryasthānamāpnuyāt ।।69।।
api pāyasabhojyaṃ yo dīnā'nāthāya dāsyati ।
candralokaṃ sa vai prāpyā'mṛtabhojī bhaviṣyati ।।2.170.70।।
api vastraṃ ca vā bhūṣāṃ pāduke kaṃkaṇau ca vā ।
chatraṃ vā cāmaraṃ vāpi vyajanaṃ naktakaṃ ca vā ।।71 ।।
pātraṃ jolīṃ koṣṭhalīṃ vā cāṃgarakṣakameva vā ।
kaupīnaṃ yataye yo'tra dadyāccaindrapadaṃ labhet ।।72।।
māṇikyāṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ śriyaṃ ca rādhikām ।
bālakṛṣṇena sahitāṃ pūjayedatra mokṣabhāk ।।73 ।।
gobhyo grāsānatra dadyāt pakṣibhyaśca kaṇān śubhān ।
janebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādatra so'pi ca mokṣabhāg ।।74।।
jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyāt patraṃ puṣpaṃ payo'rpayet ।
makhabhūmau saṃgame'tra svargabhāk sa tu mānavaḥ ।।75।।
śayyāṃ ca gendukaṃ khaṭvāṃ ye'tra dāsyanti bhāvataḥ ।
te yāsyanti mahat svargaṃ mahatpuṇyapratāpataḥ ।।76।।
āsanāni bṛsīścāpi dāsyantyatra catuṣkikāḥ ।
te brahmāsanayogyāśca bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।77।।
makhabhūmau makhaṃ ye'tra kariṣyanti tu mānavāḥ ।
cidākāśaṃ paraṃ dhāma prayāsyanti tu te janāḥ ।।78।।
hastidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ reṇḍiyādānamityapi ।
haṃsakokilamenānāṃ dānaṃ śukasya cāpi ye ।।79।।
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ vimānānāṃ yānānāmanasāṃ tathā ।
dānaṃ ye'tra kariṣyanti yāsyanti brahmadhāma te ।।2.170.80।।
kanyādānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ putradānaṃ mahattamam ।
gṛhadānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ vāṭikādānamityapi ।।8 1 ।।
vṛkṣavallīstambadānaṃ kariṣyantyatra ye janāḥ ।
prayāsyantyamṛtaṃ svargaṃ sarvarasāmṛtānvitam ।।82।।
kāṣṭhadānaṃ copalādipradānaṃ loṣṭhadānakam ।
dhātudānaṃ vidhāsyantyāpsyanti te vahnimaṇḍalam ।।83।।
dadhidugdhādidātāro yāsyanti candramaṇḍalam ।
gṛhopakaraṇānāṃ tu dātāro brahmaṇaḥ padam ।।84।।
rājyadātāra evātrā''psyanti vairājamaṇḍalam ।
svarṇarūpyakadātṝṇāṃ golokagamanaṃ bhavet ।।85।।
vidyādānapradātāro bhaviṣyanti surārhaṇāḥ ।
kṛṣeḥ sādhanadātāro bhaviṣyanti kuberakāḥ ।।86।।
kalākauśalyaśikṣādyā bhaviṣyanti tu viddharāḥ ।
etajjalaghaṭaṃ nītvā deśāntare'pi bindukam ।।87।।
anyasmai ye pradāsyanti cobhayormokṣadaṃ bhavet ।
atra jale paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ picchasthikaṃ patet ।।88।।
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste yāsyanti paraṃ padam ।
api mṛtyusamaye'pi mukhe yasya jalaṃ patet ।।89।।
śarīre mokṣaṇaṃ vāpi cāsthi yasya patejjale ।
te sarve muktimeṣyanti rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।2.170.90।।
etādṛśī sthalī tveṣā śatayojanavartulā ।
nadīdvayāntarālasthā pāvanī varṇanottarā ।।91 ।।
makhasthalyāṃ yadi kaścid dīkṣāṃ gṛhṇāti vaiṣṇavīm ।
caturbhujo bhaved divyaḥ pārṣadaḥ sa vikuṇṭhake ।।92।।
nārī dīkṣāvatī divyā caturbhujā haripriyā ।
jāyate nityamuktānī punarjanma na vidyate ।।93।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu ye janāḥ ।
śrāvayanti ca śṛṇvanti te'tra mokṣagamā janāḥ ।।94।।
satībhyo bhojanaṃ dadyāt sādhvībhyaścātra sarvathā ।
sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād dātā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।95।।
atropavāsaniyamaiścariṣyanti tapastu ye ।
te śuddhā brahmagā bodhyā muktā divyākṣarārthinaḥ ।।96 ।।
kimu te rādhike vacmi yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
nārāyaṇāstathā cānye'vatārā īśvarāḥ surāḥ ।।97।।
pitaraḥ ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyo yatīśvarāḥ ।
yoginyo'rhaṇavargāśca tīrthāni tārakāṇi ca ।।98।।
āgatyoṣitavantaśca pītavantaḥ sarijjalam ।
bhuktavantaśca vanyāni spṛṣṭavantaḥ pratisthalam ।।99।।
tallīlāsmaraṇādeva bhavanti mokṣabhāginaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhed dhruvām ।। 2.170.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptāhayajñe samarpitopadāḥ, bālakṛṣṇasya koṭyabjarūpadhāritvaṃ, yajñabhūmidānādimāhātmyaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 170 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 170 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 171
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 172 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike tatra nityaṃ vai rātrau janasamājake ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathā jāyate śubhā ।। 1 ।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān svayaṃ vācayati prabhuḥ ।
śvetakṛṣṇāyanavyāsaḥ kathāṃ vivecayatyapi ।। 2 ।।
śvetavyāsasya nāmnā ca śvetāsanaṃ taducyate ।
sthalaṃ tīrthasvarūpaṃ tajjñānavijñānadaṃ sadā ।। 3 ।।
yavakrīto maharṣiśca gāṃgeyo yatra vai sthale ।
kṣārasya kavalaṃ bhuktvā tapastepe sudāruṇam ।। 4 ।।
kṣārakavalasaṃjñaṃ tatpāvanaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
tatra sthalyāṃ samabhavat prasiddhaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā ।। 5 ।।
tannāmnā sa pradeśo'pi śatayojanavistṛtaḥ ।
kṛṣṇavārdhipraparyantaṃ nistārāṃ yāvadeva ha ।। 6 ।।
yavakrītaḥ prasiddho'bhūt niṣṭhāparātaṭāśrayaḥ ।
yavakrīto maharṣiḥ sa vedakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagāda ha ।
hare'bhijinmuhūrte'tra pūrṇāhutīḥ pradehi vai ।। 8 ।।
lomaśastattathā śrutvā'numatyā śrīharestathā ।
dadau pūrṇāhutīstatra parabrahmātmavahnaye ।। 9 ।।
tāmbūlaphalapūgīphalā'kṣataghṛtakāni ca ।
śrīphalaṃ ca sruve kṛtvā dadau pūrṇāhutīrhariḥ ।। 2.171.1 0।।
oṃ samudrāditimantrān pūrṇādarvītibodhitān ।
ṛṣibhirvācyamānāँśca śrutvā pūrṇāhutīrdadau ।। 11 ।।
idamagnaye vaiśvānarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ
śatakratave adbhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ tridivebhya īśebhyo'vatārebhyaḥ śaktibhyaḥ
parabrahmaṇe svāhā namama ।। 12।।
idaṃ saptatalasthebhyo bhūsthebhyaścaturbhyo
jaḍacetanebhyaḥ svāhā namama ।
idaṃ saptasvarbhyaścāṣṭāvṛtisthebhya
īśānāntebhyo dhāmibhyaḥ svāhā namama ।। 13।।
idaṃ ca brahmaṇe svāhā svāhā ca parabrahmaṇe ।
ekasmai cā'dvitīyāya mahyaṃ svāhā ca oṃ namama ।। 14।।
ityuktvā śrībālakṛṣṇo mahāpūrṇāhutīrdadau ।
śrīphalāni hyasaṃkhyāni sahasraghṛtadhārikāḥ ।। 15।।
candanāni samidhaśca miṣṭamahāhutīrdadau ।
sākṣādanādibhagavān pratyakṣo vahnimaṇḍale ।। 16।।
pratyahāt saviśeṣeṇa hasan jagrāha cāhutīḥ ।
sarvakuṇḍeṣu ca tadvajjagrāha yugalārpitāḥ ।। 17।।।
dakṣiṇāśca tadā'saṃkhyāḥ svarṇamayīrdadau prabhuḥ ।
maṇimauktikahīrādīn ratnāni vividhānyapi ।। 18।।
evaṃ pūrṇāhutīrhutvā viprāstu vedapāragāḥ ।
āśīrvādān dadustatra yajamānāya mantrakaiḥ ।। 19।।
śāntighaṭodakairviprāḥ kuśadūrvā''mrapallavaiḥ ।
punantvityādibhiścābhiṣiñcāma iti vādinaḥ ।।2.171.20।।
tataḥ śāntipravācaścocire viprāḥ samantataḥ ।
dakṣiṇāśca punaḥ prāptāḥ svastivāco jagustadā ।।2 1 ।।
hutāśanādidevāँśca nijasthānavidāyakam ।
dadurviprāḥ pūrṇatāyā vācastato'vadan sukhāḥ ।।22।।
yajñaprasādaṃ sarvebhyaścarujaṃ padmarekhayā ।
vṛddhiṃ yāntaṃ cā'vyayaṃ ca dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।23।।
koṭyabjarūpadhārī ca dadau sarvatra mādhavaḥ ।
vinā caruprasādaṃ vai kaścittadā na śiṣyate ।।24।।
antarīkṣe'mbare vyomni jale sthale vane kṣitau ।
gahvare prāntake bhāge'raṇye vṛkṣe ca parvate ।।25।।
vimāne vāhane yāne naukāyāṃ śikhare'pi ca ।
asaṃkhyarūpadhṛkkṛṣṇo dadau caruprasādakam ।। 26।।
tato vai bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānakān ।
prāghūṇikān mahāmuktān muktān dhāmāni dhāminaḥ ।।27।।
brahmapriyāśca muktānī rādhāramādikāstathā ।
avatārān sarvanārāyaṇān śrīparameśvarān ।।28।।
vyūhān prakṛtipālāँśca kālapuruṣakeśvarān ।
vairājān bhūmasaṃjñāँśca mahāviṣṇugaṇāँstathā ।।29।।
tridevānāvaraṇeśān tatpatnīdāsikāstathā ।
bhṛtyāँśca pārṣadāँścāpi pārṣadānīḥ samantataḥ ।।2.171.3 0।।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān brahmasṛṣṭīśasṛṣṭijān ।
tataḥ siddhānṛṣīn sādhūn pitṝn satīśca yoṣitaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
pañcasvargasthitān sarvān devān devīḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।
brahmacārigaṇāँścāpi dikpālān lokapālakān ।।32।।
trayastriṃśaddevatāśca bhuvarlokanivāsinaḥ ।
bhūlokasthān catuḥkhanijīvān jaḍāँśca cetanān ।।।33 ।।
saptapātālasaṃsthāँśca bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
surā'suragaṇān sarvān kāśyapeyāँśca mānavān ।।34।।
brahmasṛṣṭān sthiracarān guṇakarmatadāśritān ।
tadāśrayāँśca bhagavān bhojayāmāsa vai kratau ।।35।।
adyā'haṃ bhagavānasmi bhojayāmi ca nirguṇam ।
ekādaśīdine cāpi phalavat sarvameva me ।।36।।
matspṛṣṭaṃ nirguṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhuñjantu bhāvato'khilāḥ ।
bhojanaṃ vai vrataṃ tvadya madicchayaiva jāyatām ।।37।।
ityevaṃ bhagavānāha bālakṛṣṇastu rādhike ।
sarvān saṃbhojya ca tataḥ svayaṃ pitrā yutastathā ।।38।।
bhrātṛbhiśca kuṭumbena saha bhojanamādade ।
mātā ca mātaraścānyā svasā santoṣiṇī tathā ।।39।।
brahmapriyāśca vai sarvāḥ kuṭumbaṃ bubhuje tadā ।
tāmbūlaṃ prāpya ca sarve viśrāmaṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ।।2.171.40।।
tato vādyānyavādyanta hyagāyanta ca gītikāḥ ।
avabhṛthāplavanārthaṃ sarve vai yatnino'bhavan ।।41।।
niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāyāḥ saṃgame'nantamānavāḥ ।
devā muktā īśvarāścāvatārāḥ śaktayo'khilāḥ ।।42।।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāsāścarṣayaḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ ।
prayayurbhagavān sarveśvareśvareśvareśvaraḥ ।। 43।।
padbhyāṃ jagāma sahito maharṣibhiśca kīrtitaḥ ।
vedamantraiḥ stūryamāno'vabhṛthārthaṃ nadītaṭam ।।44।।
tasthau ca saṃgame bālakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
saṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa lomaśastu purātanaḥ ।।45।।
caturmukhā'jabrahmāṇḍe sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe kṛtāntage ।
prathame paryaye śrīmatkāṃbhareye narāyaṇe ।।।46।।
vartamāne vatsare ca caturdaśe'tra bhūtale ।
sarvādyanararūpe'sminnavatāriṇi vartati ।।47।।
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣīyaikādaśyāṃ sūryavāsare ।
niṣṭhāparāprapīṭhāsaṃgame yajñāntakaṃ tvidam ।।48।।
avabhṛthātmakaṃ snānaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhakam ।
adhvare nāntarīyakāghānāṃ kṣālanaśaktikam ।।49।।
sarvapuṇyapradaṃ sarvā'jñātakalmaṣavārakam ।
sūkṣmajantubījakāṣṭhakaṇapuṣpakalārpaṇe ।।2.171.50 ।।
vahnau samarpaṇe bhūmeḥ śodhane maṇḍapakṛtau ।
rasaśālāsthale cūllyāṃ kaṇḍanyāṃ jalakuṃbhake ।।51।।
peṣaṇyāṃ mārjane cāpi patradalāvabhedane ।
durītaṃ pratyavāyādi yatkiṃcijjātamityapi ।।।52।।
tasya nāśakaraṃ snānaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
yajñakarmaprapūrtyarthaṃ suraprasannatārthakam ।।53।।
paramā'pūrvapuṣṭyarthaṃ tvavabhṛthāplavātmakam ।
snānaṃ sṛṣṭitrayopetaḥ karomyadya ca oṃ namaḥ ।।54।।
iti kṛtvā susaṃkalpaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhike sa jale magno'bhavannirgavai punaḥ ।।55।।
snānāṃgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ cakre smṛtvā sṛṣṭitrayaṃ tadā ।
śarīre mardanaṃ cakre tilapiṣṭena vai tadā ।।56।।
āmalakīphalacūrṇaistīrthamṛdā ca bhasmanā ।
yajñakuṇḍīyakenaiva haridrācūrṇakena ca ।
candanena ca kastūryā yavapiṣṭādinā tathā ।।57।।
pañcaraṃgaistathā cūrṇaiḥ sarvauṣidhībhirityaṃpi ।
pañcagavyena ca tathā suvarṇatīrthavāriṇā ।।58।।
brahmakamaṇḍaludvārā'bhiṣedhavidhinā tadā ।
saṃmṛdya sarvacūrṇāni cakre snānamavabhṛtham ।।59।।
yadā snāto mahārājastadā tatra tu sāgarāḥ ।
brahmahradaḥ sudhāsindhurvirajā ca mahājalam ।।2.171.60।।
nārā āpastathā nadyo nadāḥ sarāṃsi dīrghikāḥ ।
vyomavāri tathā meghā jalaṃ divyaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ।।61 ।।
vāruṇaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ mahābhūtajalaṃ tathā ।
sādhidaivāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tatra cāyayuḥ ।।62।।
snapayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhagavantaṃ hi dhārayā ।
muktā dhāmānyavatārā avatāriṇya ityapi ।। 63 ।।
śaktaya īśvarā īśvarāṇyo brahmapriyāstathā ।
pitaro devadeveśāḥ ṛṣayaḥ siddhasādhavaḥ ।।64।।
āśramāḥ sarvavarṇāśca narā nāryo napuṃsakāḥ ।
jarāyūjāścāṇḍajāścodbhijjāḥ svedajajātayaḥ ।।65।।
daityāśca dānavā yakṣā rākṣasā vahnayastathā ।
pārthivāśca jalīyāśca taijasā vāyudehinaḥ ।।66 ।।
gaganīyāstalavāsāścetanāśca jaḍāstathā ।
sarve sasnustatra tīrthe'vabhṛthe puṇyavāridhau ।।67।।
divyayoge divyaguṇe nirguṇe divyakāriṇi ।
puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiśca tadā tatrā'bhavacchubhā ।।68।।
ākāśād devaguravaḥ pāvanānyavadaँstadā ।
pāvayantu parabrahma brahmā'kṣaranivāsinaḥ ।।69 ।।
dhāmadhāmasthitā bhaktā bhakteśvarā'vatāriṇaḥ ।
avatārāḥ pārṣadāśca pāvayantu tatheśvarāḥ ।।2.171.70।।
īśvarāṇyo mahāsatyaḥ pāvayantu sureśvarāḥ ।
yajamānaṃ yajamānān pāvayantu maharṣayaḥ ।।71 ।।
svabhāvapāvanaṃ devaṃ mahānārāyaṇaṃ surāḥ ।
pāvayantu ca tīrthāni cāvabhṛthā''gatāni vai ।।72।।
gaṃgā cerāvatī menakāṃgī ca brahmaputrikā ।
aṃgaśikṣāṃgikā harāṃgahā āyūrikā tathā ।।73।।
bīnā yāneśvarī caubī sindhuścoralikā tathā ।
valgurniṣṭhāparā dīnā dinapādyāḥ saridvarāḥ ।।74।।
nārāyaṇī naṣṭajarā karmāṃgī jāmbujā nadī ।
murā ca kāruliṃgā ca parīnā āmajānikā ।।75।।
miśrasurī mahākāñjī yūkāsanā saridvarā ।
etāścānyā mahānadyaḥ pāvayantu makheṣṭinaḥ ।।76 ।।
aśvapaṭṭaṃ puṣkaraṃ mānasaṃ nārāyaṇaṃsaraḥ ।
pampāsaraścendradyumnasaro brahmasarovaram ।।77।।
śaṃbhulaṃ ca saraścilaṃsaraḥ kolārakaṃsaraḥ ।
mākamānasaro bālāsaraśca māṅgirāsaraḥ ।।78।।
lābharucisaraḥ saraḥ kuvanaṃ grāgiraṃ saraḥ ।
ārasarasturusaro gairānarasarastathā ।।79।।
suśīlaṃ ca saro mīnakaṅūsarastathā śubham ।
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ।।2.171.80।।
yugalaṃ ca sarastryaṃginarasarovaraṃ tathā ।
phulamaṇḍasaraścāpi lurāsaṃ ca sarastathā ।।8 1 ।।
maśakelasaraścāpi jayeśānasarastathā ।
udvaśaṃ ca saraścāpi yonigaṃ ca sarastathā ।।82।।
leṇḍugaṃ ca saraścāpi pāyūśaṃ ca sarovaram ।
tūnāyaṃ ca rukmavāsam āvālaṃ ca rudanphalam ।।82।।।
viśturīyasaraścāpi ālavārtaṃ sarastathā ।
itivarttaṃ saraḥ kimvāsaraśca tuṃgayānikam ।।84।।
mādhuraṃ vāgviyālaṃ ca saro nyāsajayātmakam ।
śirovaṃ caṇḍasaṃjñaṃ ca grātavīraṃ sarastathā ।।85।।
grātaślavasaraścāpi arthavāsaṃ sarastathā ।
vinipāraṃ saraścāpi suparīyārakaṃ tathā ।।86।।
klinnavārisaraścāpi itīśaṃ sarovaram ।
śoṇabhadranadaścāpi ghargharānada ityapi ।।87।।
sāgarāścāpi sarve'tra pāvayantu ca dehinaḥ ।
punantu devasaritaḥ punantu tīrthakoṭayaḥ ।।88।।
merurmandaraśailaśca himādriryuralastathā ।
kārukarmā patatkāyo raivatādriḥ punantu vaḥ ।।89।।
ityevaṃ ca śatakrośe saritsāgaravāriṣu ।
sasnuḥ sarve ca rājāno makheṣu yajamānakāḥ ।।2.171.90।।
tatra tatraikapuruṣo divyastu sūryabhāsvaraḥ ।
nadyostu saṃgamāttatra samutpanno hariryathā ।। 91 ।।
haste sauvarṇapātre ca dadhan candanakākṣatān ।
puṣpamālāṃ ca mukuṭaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ samāyayau ।।।92।।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā candrakaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
harerbhāle'kṣatādraiḥ kuṃkumacandanakardamaiḥ ।।93 ।।
dadau tu mukuṭaṃ kṛṣṇamastake mālikāṃ gale ।
cakāra daṇḍavattatra bālakṛṣṇaṃ jagāda ha ।।94।।
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ meghanādagambhīrayā girā ।
avabhṛtho'haṃ puruṣo yamaputro'smi śāśvataḥ ।।95।।
sarveṣṭivaiṣṇavo yajñaḥ pūrṇo'yaṃ pūrṇapuṇyadaḥ ।
ahaṃ puṣṭiṃ gato'smyadya sarvatīrthāgamādiha ।।96 ।।
atra snānaṃ prativarṣaṃ kurvāṇānāṃ tu śāśvatam ।
mokṣapadaṃ niścitaṃ syānnārāyaṇakṛpālavāt ।।97।)।
sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ śriyā dravyaiśca sampadā ।
ārogyeṇa kuṭumbādyai rasairbhogyaiḥ prapūritāḥ ।।98।।
yoginaḥ kṣemiṇaścāpi bhavantu siddhidhāriṇaḥ ।
narāḥ nāryaḥ samastāśca ye'tra makhe samāgatāḥ ।। 99।।
bhuktimuktikṛtāhlādā bhavantu harisadṛśāḥ ।
ityuktvā ca jalaṃ tvavabhṛthau papau hi rādhike ।। 2.171.10 0।।
tāvajjalātsamutpannā kumārī candrabhāsvarā ।
surūpā sarvaśobhāḍhyā puṣṭā campakaśobhanā ।। 101 ।।
yogyā prasannā sumukhī lakṣmītulyā sabhūṣaṇā ।
haste pātraṃ pūjanārhadravyayuktaṃ ca bibhratī ।। 10 2।।
akṣatādyaiḥ parameśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pupūja sā ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ sarve koṭiśo mānavā api ।। 103 ।
devā daityāḥ ṛṣayaśca pitaro dehadhāriṇaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ natvā pūjayitvā jagāda sā ।। 1 04। ।
ahaṃ tṛptiḥ śāśvatī ca havyaputrī bhavāmi ca ।
yajñe'tra sarvahavyebhyo mama janmā'sti puṇyavat ।। 1 05।।
kumāryahaṃ susantuṣṭā jātā'smi ca śubhāśiṣā ।
yunajmi vo bhavanto'tra bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā ।। 106 ।।
mama saubhāgyadātāro bhaviṣyanti subhāginaḥ ।
śrīharistāṃ tadā prāha varaṃ yācasva kanyake ।। 1 07। ।
kanyā prāha varaṃ dehi varaścāvabhṛtho hi me ।
śrīharirdrāk vicāryaiva dānakāle hyavabhṛtham ।। 1 08।।
kumāraṃ taṃ samāhūya kare dhṛtvā kumārakam ।
kanyāyai cārthitavatyai cārthayantaṃ kumārikām ।। 1 09।।
dadau kumāryai dānaṃ ca vidhinā dānavit prabhuḥ ।
kumāradānaṃ pradadau kumāryai bhagavān prabhuḥ ।। 2.171.110 ।।
kumāro ratnahāraṃ ca kumāryai ca samārpayat ।
evaṃ vivāhavidhinā kumāradānamāpya sā ।। 111 ।।
kumārī saubhāgyavatī kumāraḥ subhago'bhavat ।
ketumāle tadārabhya kumāradānamuttamam ।। 11 2।।
nārī pradhānabhūtā ca kumāro nāryadhīnakaḥ ।
nārīvarcasvamevā'pi narasya pāravaśyatā ।। 113 ।।
avabhṛthakṛtaṃ jātaṃ nāryai samarpaṇaṃ sadā ।
nārīrājyaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ tanmāhātmyena vidyate ।। 1 14।।
ityevaṃ naradānākhyaṃ saṃgame snānasaṃgame ।
utsave tatra kṛtvaiva niryayuśca jalād bahiḥ ।। 1 15।।
sarve vai snānakartārastāvattu dampatīdvayam ।
nṛtyaṃ kurvat prasannaṃ ca jalāntare vyalīyata ।। 116 ।।
ityevaṃ lokayāmāsurmahāścaryaṃ makhārthinaḥ ।
dadau dānāni ca tadā koṭiśo mānavādayaḥ ।। 1 17।।
kanyābhyaḥ koṭisaṃkhyābhyaḥ kumārāṇāṃ yathākṛtam ।
kanyakāstu tadā prāpya kumārān vararūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 18।।
koṭiśastatra sañjātāḥ saubhāgyabhāgyaśobhitāḥ ।
evaṃ kumāradānaṃ vai vivāhe tatra cādyajam ।। 11 9।।
abhavat tat sadā tatra vidyate śāśvato vidhiḥ ।
kumāraiśca samaṃ pṛthvīgṛhagosvarṇadānakam ।। 2.171.1 20।।
dadurvai pitarasteṣāṃ vadhūṭībhyo mudānvitāḥ ।
evaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ kṛtvā datvā dānāni koṭiśaḥ ।। 121 ।।
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve viśaśramuśca mandire ।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadā śāntimupāgaman ।। 122।।
ityevaṃ rādhike mahāścaryaṃ yatte niveditam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanādasya smaraṇācchrāvaṇādapi ।। 123 ।।
avabhṛthaphalaṃ prāpya kumāradānajaṃ phalam ।
labhet bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ labhet ।। 124।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pratyakṣaharirmahāpūrṇāhutīrjagrāha, sarveṣāṃ bhojanāni, avabhṛthasnānaṃ, avabhṛthātmakakumāraprākaṭyam, tṛptirūpakumārī
prākaṭyam, kumāryai varaṃ yācamānāyai avabhṛthākhyasya kumārasya dānam, vivāhavidhau kumāradānāni, mahādānāni, svasvasthāneṣu viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 171 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 171 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 172
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 173 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ketumālākhye kumārikābhya eva tu ।
kumārāṇāṃ pradāne vai phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate ।। 1 ।।
nārī tatra svatantrā'sti kumāre svatvayāminī ।
patnīvaco mahattatra patnyājñā pārameśvarī ।। 2 ।।
patnī varcasvadhartrī hi patirdāsasamastataḥ ।
patistu bījado mātraṃ kṣetraṃ pradhānamuttamam ।। 3 ।।
kṣetraṃ vai rakṣakaṃ pātṛ janayitṛ niyāmakam ।
sthāyi sarvādhikārāptaṃ pārampararyasya sūcakam ।। 4 ।।
avabhṛthapradānena dharmo kumāradānakam ।
pravṛttastatra tatkālād bālakṛṣṇecchayā paraḥ ।। 5 ।।
gāṃgeyādīṃstadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvara ।
aśikṣayat kumārāṇāṃ dānavidhiṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
makhabhūmau ca vā devamandire vā gurorgṛhe ।
śṛṃgārite ca vādyādyairdhvānite ca samājite ।। 7 ।।
śubhe nirudyame vāre ārādhanādine prage ।
yāyāt kanyākuṭumbaṃ tu nītvā kanyāṃ suśobhitām ।। 8 ।।
suveṣāṃ yogyaśṛṃgārabhāsitāṃ pūrṇayauvanām ।
sarvadṛśyānanāṃ citravastrāṃ chatrānvitāṃ tataḥ ।। 9 ।।
mahāsiṃhāsane dharmaguruṃ natvā niṣāditām ।
mātrā dattapuṣpamālāṃ guruṇā''śīḥprayojitām ।। 2.172.1 0।।
anyaiścadarśakairmitraiḥ suhṛdādibhirarcitām ।
ācāryaḥ śrāvayeddharmān nītīśvarādimiśritān ।। 11 ।।
tāvattatra samāgacchet kumāreṇānvitaṃ tadā ।
kuṭumbaṃ tu kumārasya mitrasuhṛtsamanvitam ।। 1 2।।
suśobhitaṃ kumāraṃ ca kanyāpārśve niṣādya ca ।
puṣpahārādikaṃ dadyāccāśīrvādān gurustadā ।। 13 ।।
parameśānamantrāँstau śrāvayed dharmabhaktivit ।
tatastau dvau guruḥ puṣpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya mandire ।। 14।।
puṣpahārau svahastena dadyāt tatkaṇṭhayoḥ pṛthak ।
gucchau dadyāt sugandhādi dadyānamālādvayaṃ kare ।। 15।।
parasparaṃ nidadhyācca mālāṃ kaṇṭhe vadhūrvaraḥ ।
guruḥ kumārahastaṃ ca dadyātkumārikākare ।। 16।।
kumārikā ca gṛhṇīyāt karaṃ patyustadā tataḥ ।
kumārasya kare dadyāt karaṃ naijaṃ kumārikā ।। 17।।
kumārastaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt premabhāvena lokayan ।
tataḥ parasparaṃ kuryāt mitho hastādicūmbanam ।। 18।।
parasparaṃ parasparakarau dhṛtvā ca nartanam ।
tatastau praṇametāṃ ca pareśvaraṃ guruṃ tathā ।। 19।।
atha dvayoḥ pakṣiṇaśca dadyurharidvayaṃ tadā ।
pratyekasya gale sarve sugandhādi śubhāspadam ।। 2.172.20 ।।
sukhinau bhavatāṃ cāpi bhavatāṃ cirajīvinau ।
bhavatāṃ putraputryādiphalinau premakośinau ।। 21 ।।
ityāśīrvādasamprāptau nametāṃ dharmapustakam ।
guruṃ tato bhavennṛtyaṃ paśyetāṃ dvandvayojitam ।। 22।।
bhojanaṃ ca samājena gṛhṇīyātāṃ sahasthitau ।
tāmbūlakādikaṃ prāpya guruṇā''śīḥprayojitau ।।23।।।
gacchetāṃ ca samutthāya yatheṣṭaṃ kanyakāgṛham ।
kanyājñayā ca vā gacchetāṃ tadānīṃ varagṛham ।।24।।
svatantraṃ vā gṛhaṃ kīrtilabhyaṃ vāsāya yojitam ।
kumāraḥ kanyakājñāṃ ca lopayitvā na sañcaret ।।25।।
vadhūḥ sā svāminī nityaṃ svāmino vai niyāmikā ।
varteta sarvathā'dhīno varastasyā matau mate ।।26।।।
evaṃ kumāradānaṃ vai kumāryai devamandire ।
utsavena ca bhojyena hāratorādibhirmatam ।।27।।
gāyanena ca nṛtyena vādyādibhiḥ suśobhitam ।
nātra yajñavidhirvahnau devasākṣye hyapekṣyate ।।28।।
abandhano vidhiścāyaṃ yatheṣṭagṛhayāpanaḥ ।
yadi premṇaḥ kṣatiścāste na cet svabhāvamelanam ।।29।।
puruṣo vai bhavatyeva tyaktavyo yoṣitā tadā ।
dvitīyaścāpi kartavyaḥ svatantrayā tu yoṣitā ।।2.172.30 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kanyāyai kumārapradānake ।
vidhiste'tra satīvaśyaḥ prokto vai ketumālake ।।3 1 ।।
tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo rātrau viśrāntimāpa ha ।
vivāhāḥ koṭiśastatra jātā vai dvādaśīdine ।।32।।
adhvare maṇḍape dānaṃ vivāhavidhinā'bhavat ।
madhyāhne bhojayitvā ca mahīmānān samastakān ।। 33 ।।
vidāye bahudānāni tebhyo dadau hariḥ svayam ।
yāḥ sarvā upadāstatrāgatāstāstu prasādajāḥ ।।34।।
kṛtvā matvā dadau kṛṣṇo jagṛhuḥ sarvadehinaḥ ।
muktāstathā'vatārāśca bhagavanto narāyaṇāḥ ।।35।।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ śaktayastathā ।
tattvāni tattvavijñāśca satyaśca brahmacāriṇaḥ ।। 36।।
sādhavaḥ pitaro devāḥ ṛṣayo devatopamāḥ ।
rājāno mānavā daivagandharvādyāḥ suraprajāḥ ।। 37।।
lokapālā diśāṃpālā vanāni tīrthabhūmayaḥ ।
pātālasthā jalavāsā vyomavāsāśca bhūsthitāḥ ।।38।।
jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi mahīmānāstu ye tadā ।
yajñe samāgatāścāsan vidāyaṃ jagṛhuśca te ।।39।।
śrīharestvājñayā sarve pūjayitvā pareśvaram ।
yayurvimānayānaiśca vāhanaiḥ svālayāँstataḥ ।।2.172.40 ।।
saurāṣṭrīyāḥ prajāścāpi yayurvimānamārgagāḥ ।
brahmapriyāḥ sarvakanyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ śrīharestadā ।।41।।
ṛṣayo lomaśādyāśca nīlakarṇavṛkādayaḥ ।
rājabhiścārthitāḥ sarve nyūṣustatra makhasthale ।।42।।
aśvapaṭṭasarodevāḥ kṣetrapā devatādikāḥ ।
īśāno rājaguravo makhācāryāśca tadbhavāḥ ।।43 ।।
gāṃgeyāścāmukaprajā nyūṣustatra tu saṃgame ।
harerdarśanalābhārthaṃ netuṃ hariṃ nijā''layān ।।44।।
bhuktvā rātrau tadā cakrurviśrāntiṃ ca prage punaḥ ।
harirutthāya vidhivat snānapūjāṃ cakāra ha ।।45।।।
trayodaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne bhojayāmāsa mānavān ।
rājā samrāṭ karau badhvā prārthayāmāsa mādhavam ।।46 ।।
me gṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇa pādanyāsairvidhehi ca ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha tataścoralaketukaḥ ।।47।।
rājā tvājñāpayāmāsa pradhānān svāgatāya vai ।
vimānāni susajjāni tvānayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।48।।
pradhānādyāstato yajñaparihāraṃ pracakrire ।
sāmagrīṇāṃ tu śiṣṭānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dadhire tathā ।।49।।
yānābdherbhūpavargāstu prajāśca śreṣṭhinastathā ।
ninyuḥ svasvālayān staṃbhapaṭamaṇḍapapātrikāḥ ।।2.172.50।।
rājabhistvarthitastatra śreṣṭhibhiścārthitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
svasvadeśagṛhāṇyeva pavitrayitumādarāt ।।51 ।।
haristathā'stviti prāha svasvarṣimatamāvahan ।
sarvālayānahaṃ samāgamiṣyāmi sukhāya vaḥ ।।।52।।
rājānaḥ sarva evā'to yāntu nijālayānitaḥ ।
guravastu mayā sākaṃ gāṃgeyāḥ santu saṃsthitāḥ ।।53 ।।
pratīkṣantu krameṇaiva mamāgamaṃ dinottare ।
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaivāgamiṣyāmi ca vo gṛhān ।।54।।
ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve rājāno nijarājyakam ।
vimāneṣu samāruhyoralabhūpena vanditāḥ ।।55।।
śrīharyādyā yayurvyomnā rājadhānīṃ tu mokṣadām ।
mokṣakapattanākhyāṃ ca bahuśobhārhaśobhitām ।।56।।
gopurāṇi svarṇarūpyamayāni toraṇānyapi ।
sūryacandraprabhātulyopajjvalāni śobhitānyapi ।।57।।
rājamārgāḥ śobhitāśca kṛtrimodyānapuṣpakaiḥ ।
raṃgavallyādibhiḥ staṃbhaiḥ kādalaiḥ padmapatrakaiḥ ।।58।।
jalakuṃbhaiḥ svāgatādyairdhvajaiścitrairmakhātmakaiḥ ।
yaśoślokānvitai ramyai raṃgapaṭādirājitaiḥ ।।59।।
patākābhiḥ śobhitāni phaṭākābhiśca śālikāḥ ।
gandhajalaiḥ prasaktāni vartmāni vīthayastathā ।।2.172.60।।
rājamārgāḥ sugandhādyaiḥ puṣpairaṃgaiḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
jayasvāgatamānādisūcikāmudrikānvitāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
sarvayantrānvitāṃ ramyāṃ viśālāṃ bahumānavām ।
daśayojanavṛttāṃ ca smṛddhyādibhiḥ prapūritām ।।62।।
śvetacampakatulyābhairmānavaiḥ pariśobhitām ।
vṛkṣavallīgṛhodyānai ramyāṃ manoharāṃ purīm ।।63।।
bahuvāditraninadaistūpasphoṭanagarjanaiḥ ।
rājasainyaiḥ kṛtamāno bālakṛṣṇo viveśa tām ।।64।।
vimānādavaruhyaiva caturdantakaristhitaḥ ।
śuśobha bhagavāṃstatra vardhito janakoṭibhiḥ ।।65।।
chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyo rājñā rājñyā gajāntare ।
jayakāreṇa mānena premṇā nibhālito muhuḥ ।।66।।
rājamārge pūjitaśca vandito namito muhuḥ ।
prasannatāṃ darśayan tān harirnṛpālayaṃ yayau ।।67।।
avātarat śanairdevo mātṛpitṛsamanvitaḥ ।
kuṭumbibhiryuto maharṣibhiryukto'ṅgaṇe śubhe ।।68।।
mahodyānamaye rājasaudhāgre bhūtale tadā ।
brahmapriyāstatheśānādayo hyavātaraँstadā ।।69।।
vimānebhyo vyomamārgāt mahodyāne śubhāśraye ।
rājasaudhe mahādivye nināya puruṣottamam ।।2.172.70 ।।
ūrukīrtirnṛpaputraścoralaketubhūpatiḥ ।
pupūja bahudhā bhaktyā jalānnamadhuparkakaiḥ ।।71।।
candanākṣatagandhādyaiḥ kastūrīgandhasārakaiḥ ।
bahusvarṇamayaiḥ pātraṃ ratnāḍhyābharaṇādibhiḥ ।।72।।
divyavastūpasāmagrībāhulyairārcayaddharim ।
nīrājanaṃ tataścakre svarṇamudrāstu koṭiśaḥ ।।73।।
dadau dāne tu haryagre maṇihārān dadau gale ।
pādau prakṣālya ca tadā sakuṭumbo jalaṃ papau ।।74।।
śataṃ putrā daśa putryastathā'nyā bālabālikāḥ ।
dve patnyau dāsikāścāpi papurvāri prasādajam ।।75 ।।
kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ menire rājayoginaḥ ।
sarve kuṭumbino rājñastriṃśatkanyā viśeṣataḥ ।।76।।
jahṛṣuḥ śrīhariṃ prāpya manasaicchan sadā prabhum ।
yavakrīto maharṣiśca pupūja parameśvaram ।।77।।
rājñā'rpitaṃ dhanaṃ cānyad dadau maharṣaye hariḥ ।
kanyābhiścārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kumāradānadharmataḥ ।।78।।
nṛpālaye'bhavat kṛṣṇecchayā kumāradānakam ।
kanyāstatra hariṃ prāpya jātāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ ।।79।।
pitṝn vṛddhān mātṛvargān praṇamyā''jñāṃ samarjya ca ।
sākaṃ śrīhariṇā sthātuṃ sarvadaiva mano vyadhuḥ ।।2.172.80।।
prāpya mantrān vaiṣṇavāṃśca pāvanyaḥ kanyakāstu tāḥ ।
pavitrahṛdayairbrahmapriyāmadhye sthitāḥ sadā ।।8 1 ।।
rājñā tatra kṛtā sevā rājñyādibhiśca sevakaiḥ ।
pradhānaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiścāpi dāsadāsībhirityapi ।।82।।
bhojanaiḥ pānadānaiśca mardanaiḥ raṃjanādibhiḥ ।
nagare'pi hariṃ nītvā śreṣṭhinaścā''rcayan prabhum ।।83।।
āprātaḥ śrīhariṃ ramyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
śreṣṭhinaḥ svālayānnītvā pupūjurbahubhāvanāḥ ।।84।।
bahvarpaṇāni pradaduścātmārpaṇaṃ vyadhurmudā ।
ekāntinaśca te bhaktā jātā narāḥ striyo'khilāḥ ।।85।।
paramā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve bālakṛṣṇasya sevakāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇāśrayaṃ muktyai cakrire tu samutsukāḥ ।।86।।
vidyutprakāśake tatra nagare bhrājite'bhitaḥ ।
paribabhrāma bhagavān kuṭumbena sahā'cyutaḥ ।।87।।
maharṣibhistatheśānamaṇḍalena purīṃ tataḥ ।
prātaḥ svasthānamāsādya viśrāntiṃ cāpa vai manāk ।।88।।
gṛhītvā yoganidrāṃ ca sūryodaye vihāya tām ।
samuttasthau nijaṃ dhyānaṃ kṛtvā cakāra cāplavam ।।89।।
uṣṇodakaiścandanādyairarcito marditastathā ।
rājñyādibhistathā bhaktābhiśca sasnau jagadvidhiḥ ।। 2.172.90।।
pūjāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sadyojātaṃ ca bhojanam ।
pracakāra mahārājaḥ sabhāyāṃ tata āyayau ।।9 1।।
pūjitaḥ saprajābhiśca śobhate jayate hariḥ ।
rājate rājasanmānaiḥ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 92।।
tāvat tatra sabhāyāṃ vai kṛṣṇadehāstu mānavāḥ ।
samāyayurvirūpāśca kṛśā duḥkhānvitāstadā ।।93 ।।
praṇipatya hariṃ prāhuḥ kuru no mokṣaṇaṃ prabho ।
vayaṃ tvatroraladeśe vasāmo'gatikā janāḥ ।।94।।
vāsanāyuktacittāśca pūrvajā rājamāninām ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavāँstān jalapānamakārayat ।।95।।
rājñāṃ tu pūrvajāste saṃtyaktvā kāluṣyamulbaṇam ।
divyadehāḥ samabhavan caturbhujā vimānagāḥ ।।96।।
pārṣadairnīyamānāste viṣṇordhāma yayuḥ param ।
etad vilokya nṛpatistvāścaryaṃ paramaṃ mahat ।।97।।
natvā''tmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ mene mokṣaṃ svakaṃ hyapi ।
mokṣārthaṃ tvarthayāmāsa śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।98।।
tathā'stviti prabhuḥ prāha prāpte kāle bhaviṣyati ।
mokṣaṇaṃ sakuṭumbasyetyevaṃ varaṃ dadau tadā ।।99।।
athaivaṃ rādhike trayodaśyāṃ vidāyamāpya ca ।
rājñā sanmānitaścāpi prasthāpito haristataḥ ।। 2.172.10 0।।
hārādibhiḥ śobhitaḥ śrībhagavān gantumutsukaḥ ।
prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ sāyaṃ sarvānupādideśa ha ।। 10 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kumāradānavivāhavidhiḥ, mahīmānānāṃ vidāyaḥ, uralaketurājadhānyāṃ mokṣikāyāṃ prabhorgamanaṃ, nagare bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ, rājapūrvajānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 172 ।


← adhyāyaḥ 172 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 173
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 174 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra yavakrītāya carṣaye ।
bhagavān pradadau jñānaṃ gāṃgeyāya mahātmane ।। 1 ।।
rājñe rājakuṭumbāya prajābhyaścāpi śobhanam ।
pāramparyaprarakṣārthaṃ śiṣyatvāvedakaṃ nijam ।। 2 ।।
yavakrītoralaketoḥ rājñyastathā prajāstvimāḥ ।
śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni kṛṣṇamūlaparāṇi vai ।। 3 ।।
ahaṃ śrībhagavānasmi parabrahma parātparaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 4 ।।
akṣarāttu pare dhāmni divye virājamānakaḥ ।
divyamūrtirnivasāmi divyamuktaprasevitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ahaṃ mama svarūpasya jñānaṃ dadāmi vai muhuḥ ।
bhaktebhyo muktasaṃjñebhyo muktānībhyastathā kvacit ।। 6 ।।
kvacid brahmapriyābhyaśca rādhāyai ca śriyai kvacit ।
kvacillakṣmyai ramāyai ca māṇikyāyai kvacittathā ।। 7 ।।
ramāyai ca jayāyai ca lalitāyai tathā kvacit ।
padmāvatyai mahālakṣmyai pārṣadebhyastathā kvacit ।। 8 ।।
āyudhebhyo vibhūṣābhyo guṇebhyaśca tathā kvacit ।
aiśvaryebhyaśca śaktibhyaḥ kvacidbhaktebhya ityapi ।। 9 ।।
jñānaṃ samyak svarūpasya pradadāmi tu sevine ।
sampradāyaḥ sa vai prokto jñānātmakaḥ pramuktidaḥ ।। 2.173.10 ।।
jñānaṃ cāhaṃ parabrahmāsmīti jānantu sarvathā ।
dīyate'dya mayā tvatra bhavadbhyaḥ sarvathottamam ।। 11 ।।
mayā sākṣāttu tad dattaṃ grāhyaṃ dhāryaṃ sadā hṛdi ।
matto'vatārā jāyante kṛṣṇādyāḥ koṭiśaḥ sadā ।। 12।।
caturviśatyavatārāstathā'nye'pi sahasraśaḥ ।
mattaḥ sarve prajāyante madaiśvaryānvitāstu te ।। 13।।
nārāyaṇāstathā sarve jāyante matsvarūpataḥ ।
vāsudevādayo vyūhā jāyante mama mūrtitaḥ ।। 14।।
bhūmādayastvīśvarāśca mamāṃśāḥ sarva eva te ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā mamāṃśā'śā bhavanti te ।। 15।।
rādhāramādikāḥ sarvā mama santi praśaktayaḥ ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca kilāsanam ।
mamākṣarapradeśāste prāntadhāmāni santi me ।। 16 ।।
akṣaraṃ dhāma sarveśaṃ sarvebhyo mānavarjitam ।
anyadhāmāni sarvāṇi mānavanti bhavanti me ।। 17।।
mahannagaramabhito yathā śākhāpurāṇi hi ।
bṛhaddhāmābhitastadvacchākhādhāmāni tāni vai ।। 18।।
samrāḍasmyavatārāṇāṃ sarve mamāṃśayoginaḥ ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya niyāmakasya me param ।। 1 9।।
akṣarācca bṛhato'pi dhāmā'sti paramottamam ।
manmūrterabhitaścaste mama dhāma parottamam ।।2.173.20।।
tasmācca paradhāmādvai tejo yannirgataṃ puraḥ ।
tadakṣaraṃ bṛhaddhāma bhaṇyate sarvabuddhiṣu ।। 2 1।।
tasmād bodhyaṃ mama dhāma tvakṣarād paramaṃ bṛhat ।
akṣaraṃ tu brahatproktaṃ dhāmānyanyāni sīmni ca ।।22।।
akṣarasyaiva tiṣṭhanti tataśceśvarakoṭayaḥ ।
tato'ṣṭāvaraṇānyeva malināni bhavanti hi ।।23।।
tato brahmāṇḍalokāścoḍḍayanti tvaṇuvat sadā ।
sarveṣvahaṃ sadā cāntaryāmitayā vasāmi ca ।। 24।।
atra yo'smi sa tatrā'smi bālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
atra me yogamāpannāste sarve paradhāmagāḥ ।।25।।
ahaṃ sadaikarūpo'smi sarvaiśvaryādisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
janāstu bhinnanetrā māṃ svīyadṛṣṭyā svavat sadā ।।26।।
paśyanti devavad devāḥ paśyanti martyavannarāḥ ।
paśyanti siddhavat siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ṛṣivattathā ।।27।।
pitaraḥ pitṛvaccāpīśvarā īśvaravattathā ।
avatārāḥ svavaccāpi muktā muktasamaṃ tathā ।। 28।।
brahmā tu brahmavaccāpi māyikā māyikaṃ yathā ।
mahāmuktāḥ svavaccāpi māṃ paśyanti sadā svavat ।।29।।
anantā'pārarūpo'haṃ cā'prameyo'smi sarvathā ।
svarūpeṇa svabhāvena guṇairbhāvaiśca sarvadā ।।2.173.3 0।।
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ svarūpāṇāṃ kutastu me ।
vibhūtīnāṃ na me tvantaḥ kuto me mānatā tadā ।।3 1 ।।
ahamānandavānasmi tena jīvanti jīvinaḥ ।
yatrānandaśca tatrā'haṃ viditvaivaṃ ca māṃ bhajet ।।32।।
naro vā yadi vā nārī tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।
mokṣikeyaṃ hi nagarī mayā tvāgatya satkṛtā ।। 33 ।।
mama jñānena lokānāṃ vasatāṃ mokṣadā nviyam ।
śarīreṇendriyairbhāvairantaḥkaraṇakaiśca mām ।। 34।।
prabhajanti janā ye māmāntarasthaṃ taranti te ।
sarvadā karmakāṇḍe vai daihike mānase'thavā ।।35।।
aindriyake'pi madbhānaṃ tadeva mokṣadaṃ matam ।
nirguṇaṃ matkṛte sarvaṃ divyaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ ca vā ।। 36।।
ityevaṃ ca jaḍaṃ cāpi cetanaṃ varṣma me matam ।
tatrā'haṃ sarvadā cāsmi viśiṣṭo'haṃ bhavāmi ca ।।37।।
cullikāyāṃ tathā kāṣṭhe vahnau bhrāṣṭre kapālake ।
piṣṭe ca roṭake cāhaṃ kartryā bhoktari cāpyaham ।।38।।
jāṭhare codare sarvavikṛtau ca bale'pi ca ।
dhātuṣvahaṃ ca garbhādau bāle'haṃ yauvane'pyaham ।।39।।
vārdhake ca śave bhūtībhāve cāhaṃ vasāmi hi ।
punaḥ khādye khādake ca bīje vṛkṣe kuṭhārake ।।2.173.40।।
chedane chettari dvaidhībhāve samitsu cāpyaham ।
evaṃ sarvatra nidhane puṣṭau ca janane'smyaham ।।41 ।।
madvinā nā'pyaṇustvasti mayā sarvaṃ tvadhiṣṭhitam ।
evaṃ jñātvā sarvavidhāṃ mama mūrtiṃ bhajet sadā ।।42।।
tadā nairguṇyamāsādya mama bhāvāya kalpate ।
etajjñānaṃ mayā dhāmni pare purā tu sarjane ।।43 ।।
māṇikyāyai mama devyai vāhāyai cārpitaṃ dhruvam ।
tayā tu duḥkhahālakṣmyai dattaṃ tayā tu śaṃbhave ।।44।।
śivarājasvarūpāya śivena nijayoṣite ।
satyai dattaṃ tayā putragaṇeśāya purā'rpitam ।।45।।
tena buddhayai tathā siddhyai tābhyāṃ tajjñānamuttamam ।
padmāvatyai ramāyai ca tābhyāṃ hiraṇyagarbhiṇe ।।46 ।।
tena cānekaśiṣyebhyo bahuśākhāgataṃ tataḥ ।
bahudhā vardhitaṃ sampradāyaśākhāsu vartate ।।47।।
vighnā vai sampradāyasya nāśakāstu bhavantyapi ।
tairjñānaṃ na parābhāvyaṃ yadyahaṃ saṃsmṛto'ntare ।।48।।
sampradāyo rakṣaṇīyaḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyakaistataḥ ।
tanvā ca manasā buddhyā dhanairjñānaiḥ sumandiraiḥ ।।49।।
jñānā'vanārthamevātra śāstraṃ tvapekṣyate sadā ।
vedāśca saṃhitā cāpi sarvavedārthabodhinī ।।2.173.50 ।।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhiteyaṃ rakṣyā sadā hṛdi ।
tadvyākhyātā gururdhāryaḥ pūjārthaṃ mama rūpavān ।।5 1 ।।
gururvai dīkṣitaḥ saṃhitājño madātmako hi saḥ ।
saṃhitārthaṃ jñāpayet sa kathā dvārā sadā janān ।।52।।
mama pūjāprakārādi prakuryāt likhitaṃ yathā ।
pūjārthaṃ mama mūrtiśca sthirā sthāpyā sumandire ।।53।।
rādhayā ramayā lakṣmyā śriyā māṇikyayā saha ।
padmāvatyā ramayā gaṃgayā virajayā saha ।।54।।
sarasvatyā durgayā bhvā brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha ।
jayayā padmayā vṛndayā tulasyā ca haṃsayā ।।55।।
maṃjulayā sadguṇayā sthāpyā lalitayā saha ।
devyā ca muktayā haimyā śāntyā vā campayā saha ।।56 ।।
tatpūjāyāḥ pravāharthaṃ bhūgrāmādisamarpaṇam ।
kartavyaṃ vidhinā rājñā dhanāḍhyaistu dhanārpaṇam ।।57।।
vidyāyāstu parāyā me dānārthaṃ pāṭhaśālikāḥ ।
vidyālayā viśālāśca kāraṇīyā hi bodhadāḥ ।
śikṣakā yojanīyāśca pūjakā mandire'pi me ।।58।।
pustakānāṃ pracāraśca kartavyo mānaveṣvapi ।
deveṣu cānyalokeṣu pātāleṣvapi sarvathā ।।59।।
tatra tatratyasaṃhitābhāgaprasāramācaret ।
evaṃ ṣaḍaṃgarūpeṇa sampradāyaḥ pravartate ।।2.173.6 0।।
vidyā śāstraṃ gururmūrtirmandiraṃ śiṣyavargakaḥ ।
vidyā proktā parā mantro nāma cārādhanādikāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
aparā bahudhā jñānaṃ vyavahāreṇa miśritam ।
śāstraṃ vedāḥ saṃhitāśca gurorvāṇī harervacaḥ ।। 62।।
gurustu vaiṣṇavo jñānamantraśāstrādiyojakaḥ ।
mūrtiścāhaṃ svayaṃ patnīsahitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।63।।
muktairbhaktaiḥ priyābhiśca sahā''ryaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
avatārāśca me sarve vyūhā me kāryakāriṇaḥ ।।64।।
aṃśāḥ kalāstathā''veśā vibhūtayaḥ svarūpiṇaḥ ।
pūrṇāścopāsakā bhaktā nārāyaṇāstathā'pare ।। 65।।
mandiraṃ śatakalaśaṃ sahasrakalaśaṃ tathā ।
sauvarṇaṃ ca tathā divyaṃ maṇijaṃ kārayed dṛḍham ।।66।।
śiṣyavargā bhaveyurvai mantragrahaṇasevanaiḥ ।
sādhavo gṛhavargāśca narā nāryo hi sevakāḥ ।।67।।
bālā yuvāno vṛddhāśca sadhavā adhavā api ।
bālikāśca kumārāśca vijñā vijñānavarjitāḥ ।।68। ।
rājā prajāḥ pradhānāśca brahmiṣṭhā vītarāgakāḥ ।
sanyāsāḥ sādhavo yogābhyāsāśca yatayastathā ।।69।।
mānavā api ṣaṇḍhā ye ye ke'pi sampradāyinaḥ ।
bhajeran māṃ sadā bhāvabharāḥ kapaṭavarjitāḥ ।।2.173.70।।
tṛṣṇārāgadveṣamanyudroherṣyāvarjitāstathā ।
bhajeyurmāṃ tadā sampradāyo śāśvato bhavet ।।71 ।।
nirdoṣaistvāśritaiḥ sampradāyaḥ prakāśatāṃ vrajet ।
sadoṣaistvāśritaiḥ sampradāyaścāndhyamupāvrajet ।।72।।
yatra nāsti gururboddhā nityatṛpto nirīhakaḥ ।
yamaiśca niyamairyuktaḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।73 ।।
yatra nāsti gurustyāgī vairāgyavān jitendriyaḥ ।
śāstrajño dharmaśīlaśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।74।।
yatra nāsti gururjñātā jñānado'jñānanāśakaḥ ।
sarvaśāstravyāpakaśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati।। 75।।
yatra gururdravyahartā vyasanī cānṛtī tathā ।
svārthamātraparastṛṣṇī sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।76 ।।
yatra gururdayāhīnaḥ pārakyān manute śritān ।
duḥkhe prakṣipati śiṣyān sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।77।।
yatra gururdharmahantā nāstikaḥ śaṭhadhūrtakaḥ ।
doṣālayaśca viṣayī sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।78।।
yatra guruḥ sarvabhakṣī tṛṣṇālobhādiśevadhiḥ ।
pūryate nodaraṃ yasya sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।79।।
rakṣakā bhakṣakā yatra trātāraśca viḍambakāḥ ।
viśvāsaghātinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।2.173.8 0 ।।
pāṣaṇḍicaurahārāṇāṃ luṇṭakānāṃ kriyāparāḥ ।
mūrdhanyā yatra vidyante sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।8 1 ।।
sabhāsado vyavahāranirṇatāraśca yojakāḥ ।
luñcākhādakino yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।।82।।
prasahyā'nyāyayuktāśca vigantāro virodhinaḥ ।
kleśino mānavā yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।83।।
gurudrohijanā yatra nimnadoṣāvalokinaḥ ।
bhāvahīnā nindakāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।84।।
avivekā adīrghadṛṣṭayaḥ premavihīnakāḥ ।
pūjyapūjollaṃghakāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।85।।
hatyākāṇḍābhirucayo devānnadravyabhojakāḥ ।
gurormānahano yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।86।।
kudṛṣṭayaḥ kusaṃkalpāḥ kusaṃgavyāptamānasāḥ ।
paragṛhaprabhaṃktāraḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।87।।
guṇeṣu doṣadraṣṭāraḥ parotkarṣā'sahiṣṇavaḥ ।
mānavā yatra vai yāmyāḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।88।।
asatkāryamasadvāṇī anyāyaśca pade pade ।
mahatāmavamānaṃ ca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।89।।
yatra me pratimā nāsti nāsti me mandiraṃ ca vā ।
nāsti me saṃhitāśāstraṃ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।2.173.90 ।।
kathā me satataṃ nāsti santi hṛndyamalāni na ।
sevakā nirmalā naiva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।9 1 ।।
gṛhasthā guravo yatra tyāginaḥ śiṣyakoṭayaḥ ।
guravaḥ strījuṣo yatra sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।92।।
sarvabhogavilāsāśca guruṣveva vasanti cet ।
tyāgāṃśo yatra nāstyeva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।93 ।।
guroḥ pṛṣṭhe mahacchidraṃ hṛdaye rākṣasī sthitiḥ ।
agre tu grahaṇāndhyaṃ ca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।94।।
narā nāryo niḥśvasanti yaṃ yān vai sāmpradāyikān ।
teṣāmādhārabhūtaścet sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।। 95।।
vidyā vidyālayo nāsti camatkāro na yatra ca ।
siddhā yatra na santyeva sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।96।।
udaraṃbhariṇo yatra śiṣyā dhārmyaśabhakṣakāḥ ।
devabhītivihīnāśca sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।97।।
vākṣvanyad darśane cānyat hṛdaye'nyattu mānave ।
tādṛśo yatra kāryāgnyaḥ sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।98।।
jñāne karmaṇi nāstikyaṃ cā'nṛtaiśvaryadarśanam ।
yatrā''dānaṃ vamayitvā sampradāyaḥ sa naśyati ।।99।।
vidyā śāstraṃ gururdevā ālayā yatra santi na ।
sampradāyasya nāśastu druta tatra prajāpate ।। 2.173.10 0।।
tasmāmantrā mayā dattā dīyantāṃ śiṣyavargiṇe ।
vidyāṃ śāstraṃ guruṃ devān sthāpayantvarcayantu ca ।। 101 ।।
evamuktvā''śiṣo datvā vimānaṃ tvadhyarohayat ।
jayanādairvādyanādairyantranādaiśca harṣaṇaiḥ ।। 10 2।।
saha vyomnā sārthayukto yayau krathakarāṣṭrakam ।
romāyanenarṣiṇā prārthitaḥ krathakabhūbhṛtā ।। 10 3।।
rādhike tu tadā vyomni yāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ prajāḥ ।
āgantavyaṃ rakṣaṇīyā deyaṃ ca darśanaṃ jaguḥ ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uralaketurājarṣiyavakrītamaharṣi-prajābhyaśca hariṇā svasvarūpajñānaṃ sampradāyaśāśvatikajñānaṃ ca dattamiti nirūpaṇa-
nāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 173 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 174
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 175 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
krathakasya rājadhānyām oṃkāreṣṭābhidhājuṣi ।। 1 ।।
nagare śobhite kṛṣṇanāmadhunyaninādite ।
romāyanenarṣiṇā ca krathakena ca bhūbhṛtā ।। 2 ।।
darśite bahuvidhibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaharitsthale ।
avātārayadudyāne vimānaṃ janasaṃkule ।। 3 ।।
nṛpālaye vimānāccāvatīrya bhagavān yadā ।
praviveśa tadā puṣpākṣatavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। 4 ।।
tūryāṇi rājarītyaivā'vādyanta miṣṭasusvaraiḥ ।
agīyanta sugītāni jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।। '6 ।।
kuṭumbaṃ śrīhareḥ sarvaṃ brahmapriyā maharṣayaḥ ।
avaterurvimānāttu svarṇāḍhye -bhūbhṛdālaye ।। 6 ।।
vidyutprakāśakaiḥ samujjvale sugandhaśālini ।
sarvasāmagrikāramye dāsadāsīsabhājite ।। 7 ।।
bhṛtyaiḥ pradhānakai rājakuṭumbakaiḥ prajājanaiḥ ।
saṃkulite'tisammarde kṛṣṇaḥ saudhe viveśa ha ।। 8 ।।
praveśanasya samaye vardhitaḥ svāgatena tu ।
namanairvandanaiḥ premṇā darśanena sumā'kṣataiḥ ।। 9 ।।
rājñā rājñyā kumāraiśca putrībhirbhrātṛbāndhavaiḥ ।
śrīhariḥ salilenāpi śītalairanilairapi ।। 2.174.10 ।।
phalai rasaiḥ supeyaiśca satkṛtaḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
kuṭumbādisārthajanaḥ satkṛtāḥ sarva eva te ।। 11 ।।
puṣpahāraistathā gucchaiḥ sugandhidravasecanaiḥ ।
rañjito bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 2।।
evaṃ kṣaṇaṃ praviśramya romāyanena bodhitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rājasabhāṃ yayau ।। 13 ।।
rātrāvapi tu dinavad bhrājamānāṃ pradīpakaiḥ ।
maṇīnāṃ kiraṇaiścāpi klṛptacandrakaraistathā ।। 14।।
viśālāṃ parito bhittipaṭaleṣu suraiḥ sthitām ।
udyānadṛśyaśobhāḍhyāṃ svargavatsukalevarām ।। 15।।
sabhāmāsādya tu harirniṣasāda gajāsane ।
svarṇahīrakaśobhāḍhye chatracāmarabhūṣite ।। 16।।
anye pitrādayaścāpi niṣeduryogyakāsane ।
bhagavān sarvalokānāṃ kuśalaṃ sukhasampadam ।। 17।।
samapṛcchattathā''rogyaṃ janāśca sukhino'bhavan ।
rājā rājakuṭumbaṃ ca pādau prakṣālya vai hareḥ ।। 18।।
prāsādikaṃ payaḥ sarve papustataḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।
candanaiḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ sauvarṇairhārakaistathā ।। 1 9।।
hīrakairmauktikaiścāpi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
prajājanāḥ pupūjuśca pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastathā ।।2.174.20 ।।
kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛtā nātha vayamāgamadarśanaiḥ ।
bhagavatā śrīhariṇā pāvanī nagarī kṛtā ।।21 ।।
adya viśrāntimāsādya prātardehi svadarśanam ।
ityuktvā tvabhivandyaiva yayuḥ sarvaprajājanāḥ ।।22।।
mahimānāstataḥ sarve nivāsānāyayurdrutam ।
śrīhariḥ sakuṭumbaśca nṛpasaudhe suśobhane ।।23 ।।
viśrāntyarthaṃ yayau rājñā krathakena tatharṣiṇā ।
