darśite śayane kṛṣṇaḥ suṣvāpa nidrito'bhavat ।। 24।।
mahīmānā dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā viśaśramuḥ ।
rājā yayau nijaṃ saudhaṃ viśrāntyarthaṃ tu rādhike ।। 25।।
caturdaśyāṃ prage samutthāya śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।
bodhito maṃgalaśabdaiḥ śuśrāva svayaśo'malam ।।26।।
dhyātvā svaṃ ca tato nityavidhiṃ cakāra sarvaśaḥ ।
darśanārthaṃ samājagmurlomaśādyāḥ prajāstathā ।।27।।
sa rājā krathako rājñī putryaḥ putrāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
pūjanārthaṃ hareḥ sarvasāmagrībhiḥ samutsukāḥ ।।28।।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakruḥ payasā tajjalaṃ papuḥ ।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādyairhīrakairmauktikaistathā ।। 29।।
candanā'kṣatapuṣpādyairmaṇibhiścārcayan harim ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi santuṣṭāṃ śukavallabhau ।।2.174.3 0।।
brahmapriyāśca kanyāśca lomaśādīn samārcayan ।
tata ārārtrikaṃ cakrurdaṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇam ।। 3 1।।
upadā sannyadhustvagre vividhā bhāvatastadā ।
rājā prāha harikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ।।।32।।
pāvitaṃ mama rāṣṭraṃ saṃpāvitopi madālayaḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ pāvitaṃ me'tra vasā'tra bhagavan sadā ।।3 3 ।।
bhavato'smi kuṭumbena sahito'haṃ kṛpānidhe ।
bhagavāँśca nṛpaṃ prāha mūrtirūpeṇa sarvadā ।।34।।
rājaṃstava gṛhe nivatsyāmi pratyakṣavat sadā ।
kāraya tvaṃ mandiraṃ me sthāpayā'tra ca māṃ prabhum ।।35।।
nṛpaḥ papraccha ca hariṃ kadā kāryaṃ nu mandiram ।
kaḥ kālo hi muhūrtādiḥ dinanakṣatrarāśayaḥ ।।36।।
uttamā hi śubhe kārye mandirādau sukarmaṇi ।
bhavatsthāpanakālāśca tad vadātra tu me prabho ।।37।।
hariḥ prāha yadā rājan bhagavān bhuvi vartate ।
dhṛtamānuṣarūpo vai tadājñā tu yadā bhavet ।। 38।।
rātrau vā divase vāpi sandhyāyāṃ sūtake'pi vā ।
akāle vā tathā'niṣṭe śoke kleśamaye'pi vā ।।39।।
yādṛśastādṛśaḥ kālastanmataḥ śubha eva saḥ ।
haryadhīnāḥ sarvakālāstadicchayā śubhā hi te ।।2.174.40।।
deśaḥ sarvavidhaścāpi haryāśritaḥ śubho hiṃ saḥ ।
kṛṣṇatulyāḥ samarthā ye santasteṣāṃ vacāṃsi ca ।।41।।
yasmin kāle tu labdhāni kālaḥ sarvaḥ śubho hi saḥ ।
naisargeṇa tu te vacmi śṛṇu śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu kālikam ।।42।।
varṣaṃ māsāstathā pakṣāḥ saptāhāni dināni ca ।
nakṣatrāṇi grahā vārāścaturghaṭyo muhūrtakam ।।।43।।
yogāśca tithayaḥ klṛptā vyavahārasya siddhaye ।
varjyān vacmyapi prathamaṃ śṛṇu rājan yathāyatham ।।44।।
tithinakṣatravāreścotpannān yogān hi dūṣitān ।
varjayecchubhakārye vai vyatīpātādikāṃstathā ।।45।
duryogānatha bhadrāṃ cāmāvāsyāṃ sūryasaṃkramam ।
janmarkṣaṃ janmatithikāṃ janmamāsaṃ vivarjayet ।।46 ।।
tithervṛddhiṃ kṣayaṃ cāpi vivarjayet sukarmaṇi ।
pāpagrahaiḥ prabhuktāni bhujyamānāni cāpi ca ।।47।।
bhogyānyapi ca ṛkṣāṇi varjayecchubhakarmasu ।
utpātarkṣaṃ pāpagrahaviddharkṣaṃ ca vivarjayet ।।48।।
ṛtaṃ ca bheditaṃ pāpagraheṇa tadvivarjayet ।
khagrāsagrahaṇarkṣaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsāvadhi varjayet ।।49।।
ardhagrāsasya nakṣatraṃ trimāsāvadhi varjayet ।
pādagrāsasya nakṣatraṃ māsāvadhi vivarjayet ।।2.174.5 0।।
grāsāt prāk tridinaṃ tyājyaṃ paścāt saptāhakaṃ tyajet ।
grastāste prāk tridinaṃ grastodaye tryahamuttaram ।।61 ।।
pūrṇagrāse prāk ca paścād dinatrikaṃ vivarjayet ।
māsāntaikadinaṃ cāpi nakṣatrāntaghaṭīdvayam ।।62।।
tithyantaghaṭikaikaṃ ca lagnāntārdhaghaṭīṃ tathā ।
nakṣatrāṇāṃ viṣāṃ nāḍīṃ varjayecchubhakarmasu ।।53 ।।
pātadoṣaṃ tathā caikārgalaṃ dagdhadinātmakam ।
saṃkrāntisamayaṃ cāpi varjayecchubhakarmasu ।।54।।
lagnasvāmī bhavet sthāne śatrormṛtyośca vā yadā ।
madhyāhnaṃ madhyarātriṃ ca sandhyāsandhiṃ vivarjayet ।।55।।
adhimāsaṃ ca śukrasya guroścāstaṃ vivarjayet ।
śukrasya ca gurorbālyaṃ vārdhakyaṃ ca vivarjayet ।।56 ।।
janmeśāstaṃ manobhaṃgaṃ sūtakaṃ māturārtavam ।
rogotpātādyariṣṭāni śubhakāryeṣu varjayet ।।57।।
siṃhasthe tu gurau tyājyā vivāho vapanaṃ vratam ।
yātrā dīkṣā pratiṣṭhā ca yatastatra savighnakāḥ ।।58।।
krūragraheṇa yadbhuktaṃ bhoktavyaṃ bhojyameva vā ।
nakṣatraṃ sarvakāryeṣu siddhikṛdgrāhyameva tat। ।।59।।
kintu rāhuyutamṛkṣaṃ tyājyaṃ vai śubhakarmasu ।
grahaduṣṭaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ sūryabhuktaṃ yadā bhavet ।।2.174.60 ।।
candrabhuktaṃ ca vā syācca tataḥ śubhapradaṃ bhavet ।
grahaṇena hatamṛkṣaṃ ṣaṇmāsānte śubhaṃ bhavet ।।6 1 ।।
ekamāse coparāgadvaye prāthamikaṃ tu bham ।
dvitīyagrāsapūrvaṃ syācchuddhaṃ ṣāṇmāsike'param ।। 62।।
khātaṃ caitreśokada syād vaiśākhe dhanadaṃ smṛtam ।
jyeṣṭhe grahaprapīḍādam āṣāḍhe paśunāśanam ।।63।।
śrāvaṇe dhanavṛddhikṛt bhādrapade tu śūnyakṛt ।
āśvine kleśadaṃ syācca kārtike bhṛtyanāśakam ।।64।।
mārgaśīrṣe dhanadaṃ syāt pauṣe kāmarddhisampradam ।
māghe tvagnibhayadaṃ syāt phālgune śrīpradaṃ matam ।।65।।
gṛhāraṃbhastu meṣasthe sūrye sarvaśubhapradaḥ ।
vṛṣasthe dhanavṛddhikṛt mithunasthe mṛtipradaḥ ।।66।।
karkasthe śubhadaḥ syācca siṃhasthe bhayavardhakaḥ ।
kanyāsthe rogadaḥ syācca tulāsthe sukhado bhavet ।।67।।
vṛścikasthe dhanavṛddhirdhanuḥsthe mahatī kṣatiḥ ।
makarasthe dhanā''yaḥ syāt kuṃbhasthe ratnado mataḥ ।।68।।
mīnasthe bhayadaḥ syācca vicāryā''raṃbhamācaret ।
devapratiṣṭhā māghe ca phālgune dhanadā tathā ।।69।।
āyuṣyārogyadā bhartuḥ kīrtikarī bhaveddhi sā ।
caitre sā bhayadā rogapradā bodhyā tu sarvathā ।।2.174.70।।
vaiśākhe sā tathā jyeṣṭhe dhanaputrādidāyinī ।
dakṣiṇāyanage sūrye vārāhaṃ mātṛkāstathā ।।71 ।।
bhairavaṃ vāmanaṃ durgāṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayet sukham ।
śrāvaṇe śivaliṃgaṃ cāśvine tu jagadambikām ।।72।।
mārgaśīrṣe hariṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca māṃ prabhum ।
sthāpayet pauṣamāse tu sthāpayet sarvadevatāḥ ।।73।।
nītyaṃ gītaṃ kṛṣiṃ citramutsavaṃ ca gṛhādikam ।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi śilpitā ca kalādikam ।।74।।
ekādaśyāṃ pratipadi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nandākhyatattithau ।
vidhāpayet śikṣayet svo'dhīyīta śubhadaṃ bhavet ।।75।।
vivāhaścopanayanaṃ yātrā bhūṣādidhāraṇam ।
śilpakāryaṃ kalāśikṣā hastirathāśvacālanam ।।76।।
āvāhane samāroho siddhidāstu yathā śṛṇu ।
dvitīyāyāṃ ca saptamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ bhadrikātithau ।।77।।
sainyasaṃgrāmaśastrādidhṛtyabhyāsaprayodhanam ।
yātrotsavagṛhāraṃbhauṣadhivyāpārakarma ca ।।78।।
jayākhyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā śṛṇu ।
trayodaśyāṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam ।।79।।
śatrūṇāṃ māraṇaṃ bandhanaṃ tathā viṣayojanam ।
śastrāgniyojanaṃ kāryaṃ riktākhyāyāṃ tithau śṛṇu ।।2.174.80।।
caturthyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ ca siddhyati ।
riktāyāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ।।8 1।।
rājyābhiṣeko yātrā ca vivāhaścopavītakam ।
śāntikarma puṣṭikarma pūrṇākhyāyāṃ tithau śṛṇu ।।82।।
pañcamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ ca pūrṇimāyāṃ hi siddhidam ।
ityevaṃ karaṇe kāryasiddhirbhavati niścitā ।।83।।
dvitīyā paṃcamī cāpi tṛtīyā saptamī tathā ।
daśamyekādaśī kṛṣṇapratipacca trayodaśī ।।84।।
pūrṇimā tithayo hyetāḥ sarvakārye śubhāvahāḥ ।
anyāstu tithayo naiva śubhadā vai matāḥ kvacit ।।85।।
kṛṣṇā caturdaśī śuklā pratipat darśasaṃjñakā ।
varjanīyāḥ śubhe kārye tithayastā bhayāvahāḥ ।।86।।
ādityaścandramā bhaumo buddhaścāpi vṛhaspatiḥ ।
śukraḥ śanaiścaraśceti vāsarāḥ sapta yojitāḥ ।।87।।
guruścandro budhaḥ śukraḥ śubhāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ।
raviḥ śanirmaṃgalaśca krūrāḥ krūre tu karmaṇi ।।88।।
sthiraḥ sūryaścaraścandro bhaumaścogro budhaḥ samaḥ ।
laghurgururmṛduḥ śukraḥ śanistīkṣṇaḥ svabhāvataḥ ।।89।।
ravau devapratiṣṭhā tu tejaḥprabhāvadāyinī ।
candre kṣemakarī bhaume vahnidāhapradāyinī ।।2.174.90।।
budhe ceṣṭaphaladā syād gurau sthiratvadāyinī ।
śukre cānandadā syācca śanau kalpanivāsinī ।।9 1 ।।
rājyābhiṣeko māṃgalyaṃ yānavāhananirmitiḥ ।
sainyasvārī mantrasiddhirastraśastrāvamocanam ।।92।।
bheṣajasya prayogaśca yuddhaṃ cāpaṇapaṇyakam ।
agnidānaṃ sevanaṃ ca sauvarṇakāryamityapi ।।93।।
ābhūṣādhāraṇaṃ cāpi ravau vāre śubhāni hi ।
atha candre vāsare tu śaṃkhamauktikarūpyakaiḥ ।।94।।
ābhūṣaṇavidhānaṃ ca bhūṣādhāraṇamityapi ।
saṃgītavidyādhyayanaṃ yajñakāryaṃ kṛṣikriyā ।।95।।
bhojyaṃ strīsevanaṃ cekṣurasapākavidhāpanam ।
jalapravāhakūpādikoṣavahanamuttamam ।।।।6।।
atha bhaume vāsare tu bhedabhāvastathā'nṛtam ।
caurye śāṭhyaṃ viṣaśastravahnighātanamityapi ।।97 ।।
karadaṇḍā''dānadānaṃ svarṇapravāladhāraṇam ।
evametāni kāryāṇi śubhānyuktāni maṃgale ।।98।।
atha vāre budhe śikṣyaṃ vāṇijyaṃ ca kalādikam ।
sambandhaśca bhṛtyatā ca vyāyāmo vedaghoṣaṇam ।।99।।
śāstrasya lekhanārambhaścaitāḥ kriyāḥ śubhā matāḥ ।
gurau vāre yajñakāryaṃ dharmaḥ satkāra ityapi ।। 2.174.100 ।।
māṃgalyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyā yātrā gṛhavidhāpanam ।
bhaiṣajyaṃ cā'laṃkaraṇaṃ kartavyāni śubhāni vai ।। 101 ।।
śukre gītaṃ strīsaṃgaśca ratnadhāraṇamityapi ।
śayyāparyaṃkakaraṇaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇam ।। 1 02।।
utsavo bhūkrayavikrayau kṛṣiścāpaṇakriyā ।
kośasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ ceti śubhāni tāni śukrake ।। 103 ।।
śanau gṛhapraveśaśca mantradīkṣā tathottamā ।
hastiprabhṛtigṛhaṇaṃ bhṛtyatānirṇayastathā ।। 1 04।।
śastropayogaścā'satyavadanaṃ cauryamityapi ।
kartavyāni sthirakarmāṇyapi śubhāni vai śanau ।। 1 05।।
rohiṇyaśvimṛgāḥ puṣyo hastaścitrottarātrayam ।
revatī śravaṇaṃ caiva dhaniṣṭhā ca punarvasūḥ ।। 1 06।।
anurādhā tathā svātī śubhānyetāni bhāni vai ।
śubhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi siddhyantyeteṣu bheṣu ca ।। 107।।
pūrvātrayaṃ viśākhā ca jyeṣṭhā''rdrāmūlamityapi ।
śatatārābhameteṣu kṛtyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ bhavet ।। 1 08।।
bharaṇī kṛttikā cāpi maghā''śleṣā tathaiva ca ।
atyugraṃ duṣṭakāryaṃ tat kartavyameṣu bheṣu tu ।। 1 09।।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
krathakāya tadā prāha romāyanarṣisannidhau ।। 2.174.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne krathakarājadhānyām oṃkāreṣṭāyāṃ gatvā pūjāṃ pragṛhya viśramya caturdaśyāṃ prage nṛpapṛṣṭo harirmandirādinirmāṇe śubhakālādīn prāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 174 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 174 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 175
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 176 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścād yadāha bhagavān svayam ।
nakṣatreṣu viśeṣeṇa śubhāśubhādi karma ca ।। 1 ।।
rohiṇī cottarāstistro dhruvāsaṃjñā matā yataḥ ।
tāsu devālayaṃ grāmakhātaṃ nṛpābhiṣecanam ।। 2 ।।
sthirakāryāṇi sarvāṇi kārayettu sthirāṇyataḥ ।
mṛgaścitrā'nurādhā ca revatī mṛdusaṃjñikāḥ ।। 3 ।।
mitrabhāvāstatastāsu kuryād gītaṃ ratiṃ tathā ।
bhūṣāṃ māṃgalyakaṃ vastraṃ dhārayet sukhadaṃ sadā ।। 4 ।।
puṣyāśvinyabhijiddhastaṃ laghu kṣipramudāhṛtam ।
tatra bhūṣauṣadhajñānaṃ gamanaṃ śilpitā ratiḥ ।। 5 ।।
jyeṣṭhārdrā mūlamāśleṣā tīkṣṇaṃ dāruṇamucyate ।
tatra bhedo vadho bandho mantrabhūtādisādhanam ।। 6 ।।
śravaṇāditribhaṃ svātiḥ punarvasucaraṃ calam ।
tatra vājigajāroho vāṭikāracanādikam ।। 7 ।।
bharaṇī ca maghā pūrvā krūramugramudāhṛtam ।
viṣaśastrāgniśatādi tatrecchedavināśanam ।। 8 ।।
viśākhā kṛttikā cāpi miśraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ matam ।
vṛṣotsargo'gnikāryaṃ ca miśrakāryaṃ ca siddhyati ।। 9 ।।
gurau puṣyaṃ cottarāśca tisro vā rohiṇī mṛgaḥ ।
śravaṇaṃ cāśleṣikā vā pūrvāṣāḍhā bhaved yadi ।। 2.175.1 0।।
gururvā tatparaḥ syācced gṛhāraṃbha sutapradaḥ ।
rājyapradaśca vā syācca sarvasaukhyapradastathā ।। 11 ।।
aśvinī citrikā śatabhiṣā''rdrāḥ śukrake yadi ।
śukro vā tatparaḥ syācced gṛhārambhodhanā'nnadaḥ ।। 12।।
revatīpuṣyahastāśca pūrvāṣāḍhā maghā tathā ।
mūlaṃ bhaume ca vā bhaumastatparaḥ syāttadā gṛham ।। 1 3।।
ārabdhaṃ vahnidagdhaṃ syād yadvā putraprapīḍakam ।
rohiṇyaśvinyuttarāphālgunīcitrakahastikāḥ ।। 14।।
budhe vā tatparaḥ sa syād gṛhāraṃbhaḥ sutapradaḥ ।
bhādradvayānurādhāsvātijyeṣṭhābharaṇībhidhāḥ ।। 15।।
śanau vā tatparaḥ śanirgṛhārambho'tra ced yadi ।
bhūtarākṣasavāsaḥ syād gṛhe tatra na saṃśayaḥ ।। 16।।
kṛttikopari sūryo vā candro vā ca bhavettadā ।
ārabdhaṃ tu gṛhaṃ sadyo vahnibhasma prajāyate ।। 17।।
pāpagrahairyute yadvā viddhe candre ca tārake ।
candratārābale hīne'pi puṣye bhe kriyāḥ khalu ।। 18।।
siddhayantyeva na sandeho samastamaṃgalāni vai ।
evaṃ vicārya khātādi kartavyaṃ krathaketi vai ।। 1 9।।
yoganāmāni ca saptaviṃśatiṃ pravadāmi te ।
viṣkuṃbhaḥ prītirāyuṣmān saubhāgyaḥ śobhanastathā ।।2.175.20।।
atigaṇḍaḥ sukarmā ca dhṛtiḥ śūlaśca gaṇḍakaḥ ।
vṛddhirdhruvaśca vyāghāto harṣaṇo vajrakastathā ।।21 ।।
siddhiśca vyatīpātaśca varīyān parighaḥ śivaḥ ।
siddhiḥ sādhya śubhaḥ śuklo brahmā aindraśca vaidhṛtiḥ ।।22।।
yathā nāma tathā te vai phaladāḥ sārthakā matāḥ ।
vaidhṛtiṃ ca vyatīpātaṃ varjayet sarvathā śubhe ।।23।।
vajravikumbhayostyājyaṃ ghaṭikātrayamādimam ।
parighārdhaṃ parityājyaṃ ghaṭikāḥ pañca śūlake ।।24।।
gaṇḍātigaṇḍayoḥ ṣaṭ ca vyāghāte ghaṭikā nava ।
tyājyā vai śubhakārye ca viruddhayogapādakam ।।25।।
karaṇānyatha te vacmi kistughnaṃ bavamityapi ।
bālavaṃ kaulavaṃ cāpi taittilaṃ ca garaṃ tathā ।।26।।
vaṇijaṃ viṣṭiṃ śakuniṃ catuṣpādaṃ ca nāgakam ।
bave pauṣṭikakarmāṇi dvijakarmāṇi bālave ।। 27।।
kaulave strīsuhṛtkarma taittile patnikāpriyam ।
gare bījapraropaśca vāṇijyaṃ vaṇije caret ।।28।।
dāhapātādikaṃ viṣṭyāṃ na śubhaṃ tatra sañcaret ।
śakunāvauṣadhaṃ mantrasādhanaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caret ।। 29।।
rājyaṃ goviprayoḥ kāryaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ catuṣpade ।
saubhāgyaṃ dāruṇaṃ nāge kistughne magalaṃ caret ।। 2.175.30 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca śukle bhadrā parāhṇake ।
aṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca bhadrā pūrvāhṇike matā ।।3 1 ।।
tṛtīyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ ca kṛṣṇe bhadrā parāhṇake ।
saptamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ bhadrā pūrvāhṇike tathā ।।32।।
mukhe pañcaghaṭikā sā kaṇṭhe caikaghaṭīrhi sā ।
hṛdi daśaghaṭīrbhadrā nābhau pañcaghaṭīrhi sā ।।।33 ।।
kaṭyāṃ ṣaḍghaṭikā bhadrā pucche sā ghaṭikātrayam ।
evaṃ triṃśadvibhāgaiśca bhadrāṃgāni tu ṣaṭ tathā ।।34।।
kramāt phalāni cāṃgānāṃ kāryeṣvetāni tadyathā ।
kāryanāśo mṛtirlakṣmīnāśo buddhilayaḥ kaliḥ ।।35।।
tasmād viṣṭiḥ parityājyā''vaśyake cānanaṃ tyajet ।
devarkṣayoge some ca budhe śukre gurau yadi ।।36।।
bhadrā bhavet sukalyāṇī sā sarvakāryasādhikā ।
titheḥ pūrvārdhajā rātrau dine bhadrā parārdhajā ।।37।।
na vai doṣapradā bodhyā kārye tvāvaśyake sadā ।
meṣe vṛṣe ca mithune vṛścike candrake sthite ।। 38।।
bhadrā tiṣṭhati vai svarge śubhā sā sarvadā matā ।
dhane tulāyāṃ kanyāyāṃ makare candrike sati ।।39।।
bhadrā pātālavāsā''sti sāpi śubhā sadā matā ।
kuṃbhamīnakarkasiṃheṣvavasthite tu candrake ।।2.175.40।।
bhadrā'sti mānave loke sā tyājyā śubhakarmasu ।
vyatīpāto vaidhṛtiśca bhadrā bhaumaḥ parāhṇake ।।41 ।।
śubhāḥ sarve tathā duṣṭatārāścāpi śubhā matāḥ ।
janmarāśisthite candre puṣṭiḥ phalaṃ prajāyate ।।42।।
dvitīyasthānage naiva sukhaṃ syādvai kadācana ।
tṛtīye dhanalābhaśca caturthe rogasaṃbhavaḥ ।।43 ।।
pañcame kāryanāśaśca ṣaṣṭhe dravyāgamo mahān ।
saptame bhūpasanmānaṃ cāṣṭame maraṇaṃ dhruvam ।।44। ।
navame tu bhayaṃ jñeyaṃ daśame kāryasampadaḥ ।
ekādaśe'rthalābhaśca dvādaśe vividhā''padaḥ ।।45 ।।
dvitīyaḥ pañcamaścandro navamo dhavale śubhaḥ ।
kṛṣṇe tārā valavatyo grāhyāḥ śubhapradāstu tāḥ ।।46।।
catuṣkoṇaṃ koṣṭakaṃ ca dīrghaṃ tu navakhaṇḍakam ।
viśālaṃ tu trikhaṇḍaṃ ca kṛtvā sapta ca viṃśatim ।।47।।
khaṇḍāँsteṣvādyanavake deyā aṃkāḥ kramānnava ।
dvitīye navake daśā'ṣṭādaśāṃkāḥ kramāttathā ।।48।।
tṛtīye navake caikonaviṃśasaptaviṃśatiḥ ।
evaṃ datvā navake ca janmasaṃpat vipattathā ।।49।।
kṣemaṃ carma sadhanaṃ ca nidhanaṃ maitrī mitratā ।
nāmnī tārā tu sā bodhyā janmatārā navātmikā ।।2.175.50।।
prathame navake sā ca dvitīye tu karmātmikā ।
tṛtīye navake sā ca ādhānā procyate sadā ।।51 ।।
triṣvapi navakeṣveva prathamā ca dvitīyakā ।
aṣṭamī tārakā madhyaphaladā samprakīrtitā ।।52।।
dvitīyā pañcamī saptamī tārā hyadhamā matā ।
caturthī ṣaṣṭhī navamī tārā śreṣṭhā phalapradā ।।53।।
aśubhaṃ candramaśubhāṃ tithiṃ bhaṃ cāśubhaṃ tathā ।
vimṛdya phaladā tārā ṣaṭacaturthanavasthitā ।।54।।
yātrāyuddhavivāheṣu janmatārā na śobhanā ।
anyeṣu śubhakāryeṣu śubhā praveśane'pi ca ।।55।।
meṣe siṃhe dhane candraḥ pūrve bhavati sarvathā ।
vṛṣe makare kanyāyāṃ dakṣiṇe candramā mataḥ ।।56।।
kuṃbhe tulāyāṃ mithune paścime candramā mataḥ ।
karke mīne vṛścike cottare vai vartate śaśī ।।57।।
sanmukhe cārthalābhaṃ tu dakṣiṇe sukhasampadaḥ ।
paścime kurute mṛtyuṃ vāme candro dhanakṣayam ।।58।।
karaṇarkṣavārasaṃkrāntikutithikulikakam ।
praharacatuṣghaṭīmaṃgalaśaniravigraham ।।59।।
rāhuṃ ketuṃ cānyadoṣān haratīndustu sanmukhaḥ ।
rāśyekastho'pi ca candro vartate sarvadikṣvapi ।।2.175.60 ।।
pūrve saptadaśaghaṭyaḥ pañcadaśa tu dakṣiṇe ।
ekaviṃśatiḥ paśce cottare ghaṭyastu ṣoḍaśa ।।61 ।।
punaḥ saptadaśa pūrve caturdaśa tu dakṣiṇe ।
viṃśatiḥ paścime pañcadaśaghaṭyastathottare ।।।62।।
tattaddiśāphalaṃ dadātyekarāśisthito'pi saḥ ।
utsave ca vivāhe ca gururvai balavān mataḥ ।।63।।
rājasammīlane sūryabalaṃ sarvatra ceṣyate ।
bhaumabalaṃ tu saṃgrāme vidyābhyāse budho balī ।।64।।
śukrabalaṃ tu yātrāyāṃ dīkṣāyāṃ ca śanerbalam ।
sarvakāryeṣu candrasya balaṃ pūrṇaphalapradam ।।65।।
ekādaśyāṃ guruḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaumaḥ śukraḥ trayodaśe ।
navamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pratipadi vāro ravirbhavet ।।66।।
dvitīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ somavārakaḥ ।
tatra bodhyaḥ siddhiyogaḥ sarvāraṃbhaprasiddhikṛt ।।67।।
nandā śukre budhe bhadrā śanau riktā kuje jayā ।
gurau pūrṇā bhavet siddhiryogakṛtkāryasiddhidā ।।68। ।
ravau hasto mṛgaścandre gurau puṣyaṃ kuje'śvinau ।
anurādhā budhe śukre revatī rohiṇī śanau ।।69।।
amṛtasiddhiyogaḥ syāt sarvakāryārthasiddhikṛt ।
pañcamyāṃ ced bhaveddhasto raviyukto na śobhanaḥ ।।2.175.70 ।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ mṛgaśirā candrayukto'pi sa na śobhanaḥ ।
saptamyāmaśvinī bhaumayuktāpi na ca śobhanā ।।7 1 ।।
aṣṭamyāmanurādhā budhayuktā'pi na śobhanā ।
navamyāṃ tu guruyuktaṃ puṣyaṃ naiva śubhāvaham ।। 72।।
yadyapyamṛtasiddhiḥ sā tyaktavyā śubhakarmasu ।
anye'mṛtasiddhiyogāḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakāḥ ।।73।।
udvāhe gurupuṣyaṃ ca praveśe tu kujāśvinīm ।
tyajedetat prayatnena prayāṇe śanirohiṇīm ।।74।।
somabhīmabudhagurvanyatame vārake dine ।
ekapañcaṣaṭdaśaikādaśānyatamāyā tithau ।।75।।
anurādhārohiṇīpunarvasumaghānyatame ।
hastaviśākhamūlaśravaṇaprāgbhādrānyatame ।।76 ।।
nakṣatre syāt śreṣṭhaḥ kumārayogaḥ sarvasiddhikṛt ।
ravibhaumabudhaśukrānyatame vārake dine ।।77।।
dvātrasaptadvādaśapañcadaśānyatamātithau ।
bharaṇīmṛgapuṣyaprākphālgunīcitrānyatame ।।78 ।।
anurādhāprākṣāḍhādhaniṣṭhottarābhādrānyatame ।
rājayogo bhavatyeva śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthasādhakaḥ ।।79।।
guruśanyanyantare caturaṣṭanavānyatame ।
trayodaśacaturdaśānyatare tithiviśeṣake ।।2.175.80 ।।
kārtikārdrāśravaṇottarāphālgunīsvātyanyatame ।
jyeṣṭhottarāṣāḍhāśatatārakārevatyanyatame ।।8 1।।
ṛkṣe sthavirayogaśca śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthasādhakaḥ ।
bhaumaguruśanyanyatame dvāsaptadvādaśānyatame ।।82।।
mūlacitrādhaniṣṭhānyatame dvipuṣkarayogaḥ ।
śreṣṭhaḥ kāryārthadaḥ proktaḥ kāryārambhaḥ sukhapradaḥ ।।83।।
bhaumaguruśanyanyatame dvāsaptadvādaśānyatame ।
kṛttikāpunarvasūttarāphālgunikā'nyatame ।।84।।
viśākhāprāgbhādrapadottarāṣāḍhā'nyatamarkṣe ।
tripuṣkarayogaśca sarvakāryārthasādhakaḥ । ।85।।
ravau haste ca pañcamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।
some mṛge ṣaṣṭhikāyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।।86।।
bhaume'śvinyāṃ ca saptamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।
budhe'nurādhāyāmaṣṭamyāmaśubho mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।।87।।
gurau puṣye navamyāṃ cāśubho vai mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।
ravāvārdrāyāṃ dvādaśyāmabalāyogako'śubhaḥ ।।88।।
ekādaśyāṃ mṛge sāme'balāyogo'pyaśuddhakaḥ ।
budhe dvaye ca rohiṇyāmabalāyogako'śubhaḥ ।।89।।
kṛttikāyāṃ śanau pañce'balāyogo'pyaśuddhakaḥ ।
kṛttikāyāṃ ravau dvādaśyāṃ bhaved viṣayogakaḥ ।।2.175.90 ।।
śatabhiṣāyāṃ saptamyāṃ bhaume viṣayogo'śubhaḥ ।
dvitīyāyāmāśleṣāyāṃ śanau viṣayogo'śubhaḥ ।।9 1 । ।
bharaṇyāṃ ca ravau dagdhayogo'śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ।
some citrāyāṃ ca dagdho yogo'śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ।।92।।
maṃgale cottarāṣāḍhāyāṃ ca dagdho'śubhaḥ sadā ।
dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ budhe dagdho yogo'śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ।।93।।
gurāvuttarāphālgunyāṃ dagdho yogo'śubhaḥ sadā ।
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ śukrake dagdho revatīyukśanāvapi ।।94।।
dagdho'śubhaḥ sadā bodhyaḥ kāryahānikaro hi saḥ ।
maghāyāṃ ca ravau yamaghaṇṭayogo'śubhastathā ।।95।।
viśākhāyāṃ candrake sa ārdrāyāṃ maṃgale'pi saḥ ।
mūle budhe yamaghaṇṭaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ gurau ca saḥ ।।96।।
rohiṇyāṃ śukrake so'pi haste śanau sa cāpi vai ।
yamaghaṇṭaḥ sadā varjyaḥ śubhaṃ naiva dadāti saḥ ।।97।।
sūryabhāt candranakṣatre turye ṣaṣṭhe trayodaśe ।
viṃśe ca navame raviyogaḥ sarvaśubhapradaḥ ।।98।।
anekadoṣasaṃghānāṃ dhvaṃsakaḥ śubhadaḥ sadā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।99।।
krathakaṃ prāha yat sarvaṃ mayoditaṃ tu te tathā ।
jñānadaṃ śubhakālānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ phalakṛttathā ।। 2.175.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nakṣatreṣu śubhā'śubhakāryatatphalayogakaraṇabhadrācakra-śubhāśubha-candraphalatārābalacandrabalabhramaṇasiddhiyogacakraśubhāśubhayoga-raviyogabalānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 175 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 175 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 176
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 177 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānandādyaṣṭāviṃśatiṃ tathā ।
yogān yānāha bhagavān krathakāya vadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
ravāśvivanikāyukte some mṛgayute tathā ।
bhaume cāśleṣānvite ca budhe hastayute tathā ।। 2 ।।
gurāvanurādhāsthite śukre cottaraṣāḍhige ।
śatatārānvayaśanāvānandayogaḥ siddhidaḥ ।। 3 ।।
ravau bharaṇikāyukte ārdrānvite ca somake ।
maghāyukte maṃgale ca budhe citrāyute tathā ।। 4 ।।
jyeṣṭhāyute gurau cāpi śukre'bhijitsamanvite ।
śanau prāgbhādrapadage yogaḥ sa kāladaṇḍakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
phalaṃ mṛtyustatastyājyaḥ sarvathaiva tu karmasu ।
ravau tu kṛttikāyukte some punarvasusthite ।। 6 ।।
maṃgale prākphālgunīsthe budhe svātiyute tathā ।
gurau mūlayute śukre śravaṇasthe śanau tvatha ।। 7 ।।
uttarābhādrage dhūmrākṣayogaścā'sukhaṃ phalam ।
ekaghaṭikā tyājyāsyā'rambhe tataḥ sukhapradaḥ ।। 8 ।।
ravau tu rohiṇī some puṣyaṃ ca maṃgale tvatha ।
uttarāphālgunī cāpi budhe viśākhikā tathā ।। 9 ।।
gurau pūrvāṣāḍhikā ca śukre dhaniṣṭhikā tathā ।
śanau ca revatī prajāpatiyogaḥ subhāgyadaḥ ।। 2.176.10 ।।
ravau mṛgaśirā some cāśleṣā hastakaḥ kuje ।
budhe'nurādhā ca gurāvuttarāṣāḍhikā tathā ।। 11 ।।
śukre śatatārakā cāśvinī śanau yadā bhavet ।
subhāgyadaḥ saumyayogaḥ tyājyaḥ pañcaghaṭīkikaḥ ।। 1 2।।
ravāvārdrā maghā some citrā tu maṃgale tathā ।
jyeṣṭhā budhe'bhijid gurau pūrvābhādrapadā kavau ।। 1 3।।
śanau tu bharaṇī dhvāṃkṣayogaḥ sa dhananāśakṛt ।
ravau punarvasuḥ pūrvāphālgunī somake tathā ।। 14।।
svātiḥ kuje budhe mūlaṃ śravaṇaṃ tu gurau tathā ।
śukre cottarabhādrā ca kṛttikā ca śanau yadā ।। 15।।
dhvajayogaḥ sukhado vai sarvakārye jayapradaḥ ।
ravau puṣyaṃ cottarāphālgunī some'tha maṃgale ।। 16 ।।
viśākhā ca budhe pūrvāṣāḍhā gurau dhaniṣṭhikā ।
śukre revā śanau rohā sukhaḥ śrīvatsayogakaḥ ।। 17।।
ravāvāśleṣikā some hasto'nurādhikā kuje ।
budhe cottaraṣāḍhā ca gurau tu śatatārakā ।। 18।।
śukreśvinī śanau mṛgo vajrayogaḥ kṣayapradaḥ ।
tyājyaḥ sa pañcaghaṭikaḥ tato vai śubhadaḥ kvacit ।। 1 9।।
ravau maghā somake tu citrā jyeṣṭhā tu maṃgale ।
budhe'bhijid gurau pūrvābhādrā bharaṇī śukrake ।। 2.176.20।।
śanāvārdrā mudgarākhyayogo vai dhananāśakṛt ।
tyājyaḥ pañcaghaṭikaḥ sa tato vai śubhadaḥ kvacit ।। 21 ।।
ravau pūrvāphākanī ca some svātiḥ kuje tvatha ।
mūlaṃ budhe śravaṇaṃ cottarābhādrā gurau yadā ।।22।।
śukre tu kṛttikāḥ śanau punarvasuryadā sa ca ।
chatrayogaḥ sa vai proktaḥ rājasanmānadaḥ sadā ।।23 ।।
uttarāphālgunī sūrye viśākhā somake yadā ।
pūrvāṣāḍhā maṃgale ca dhaniṣṭhā budhavāsare ।। 24।।
revatī ca gurau śukre rohiṇī puṣyakaṃ śanau ।
mitrayogaḥ sa vai proktaḥ puṣṭidaḥ sarvakarmasu ।।25।।।
ravau hasto'nurādhāḥ tu some ca maṃgale tvatha ।
uttarāṣāḍhikā cātha budhe tu śatatārakā ।। 26।।
aśvinī ca gurau śukre mṛga āśleṣikā śanau ।
mānasākhyaḥ sa yogo vai sukhadaḥ sarvakarmasu ।।27।।
ravau citrenduke jyeṣṭhā'bhijid bhaume budhe tu ca ।
pūrvābhādrā bharaṇī syād gurāvārdrā tu śukrake ।।28।।
maghā śanau padmayogo dhanaprāptikaraḥ sa ca ।
caturghaṭiko varjyaśca tataḥ sukhaprado mataḥ ।।29।।
ravau svātirmūlamindro śravaṇaṃ maṃgale yadā ।
uttarābhadrikā budhe gurau ca kṛttikā tathā ।। 2.176.3 0।।
śukre vasuḥ śanau prākphālgunī lambukayogakaḥ ।
dhanahānikaro varjyaścaturghaṭika eva saḥ ।। 31 ।।
viśākhā ca ravau pūrvāṣāḍhā tu candrake yadā ।
dhaniṣṭhā maṃgale revā budhe gurau tu rohiṇī ।।32।।
puṣyaṃ śukre śanāvuttarāphālgunī yadā tadā ।
utpātayogo varjyaḥ sa prāṇanāśaphalo yataḥ ।।33 ।।
anurādhā ravāvuttarāṣāḍhā candraje tathā ।
śatatārā maṃgale cāśleṣā budhe gurau mṛgaḥ ।।34।।
āśleṣā śukrake hastaḥ śanau sa mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।
varjanīyaḥ sadā pūrṇo mṛtyuphalo yato hi saḥ ।।35।।
jyeṣṭhā ravāvabhijitsomake prāgbhadrikā kuje ।
budhe bharaṇī gurāvārdrā maghā śukre śanau tu vai ।।36।।
citrā sa kāṇayogaḥ kleśado varjyo ghaṭīdvayam ।
ravau mūlaṃ śravaḥ some uttarābhadrikā kuje ।।37।।
kṛttikā budhake vasurgurau śukre prākphālgunī ।
svātiḥ śanau siddhayogaḥ kāryasiddhiḥ phalaṃ bhavet ।।38।।
pūrvāṣāḍhā ravau some dhaniṣṭhā revatī kuje ।
budhe rohā gurau puṣyamuttarāphālgunī kavau ।।39।।
śanau viśākhā śubhayogaḥ sa kalyāṇakārakaḥ ।
ravau tu cottarāṣāḍhā śatatārā tu candrake ।।2.176.40।।
aśvinī maṃgale mṛgaśirā budhe gurau tu vai ।
āśleṣā śukrake hastaḥ śanau tathā'nurādhikā ।।41।।
amṛtasiddhiyogaḥ sa rājamānādisampadaḥ ।
ravāvabhijit pūrvābhādrapadā candrake tathā ।।42।।
bharaṇī maṃgale cārdrā budhe maghā gurau bhavet। ।
citrā śukre śanau jyeṣṭhā mūśalayoga ucyate ।।43।।
dhanakṣayakaraḥ catuṣghaṭiko varjya eva saḥ ।
ravau śravaścandrake cottarābhādrapadā tathā ।।44।।
kṛttikā maṃgale punarvasurbudhe gurau tu vai ।
pūrvāphālgunikā śukre svātiḥ mūlaṃ śanau tathā ।।45।।
gadayogaḥ kṣayadaḥ sa varjyaḥ saptaghaṭīkakaḥ ।
dhaniṣṭhā tu ravau some revatī rohiṇī kuje ।।46।।
puṣyaṃ budhe gurāvuttarāphālgunī kavau tu vai ।
viśākhā ca śanau pūrvāṣāḍhā mātaṃgayogakaḥ ।।47।।
kulavṛddhipradaḥ so'sti śubhakṛt sarvadā mataḥ ।
śatatārā ravau some'śvinī mṛgaśirā kuje ।।48।।
āśleṣā budhake hasto gurau śukre'nurādhikā ।
śanāvuttarāṣāḍhā ca rākṣasī yogakaḥ sa tu ।।49।।
mahākaṣṭaprado varjyaḥ sarvadā śubhakarmaṇi ।
pūrvābhādrapadā sūrye some ca bharaṇī tathā ।।2.176.50 ।।
ārdrā bhaume maghā budhe citrā gurau kavau tu ca ।
jyeṣṭhā'bhijicchanau carayogaḥ kāryasya hānikṛt ।।51।।
varjyaḥ sa vai trighaṭikaḥ, tato lābhakaraḥ kvacit ।
uttarābhadrikā sūrye candre tu kṛttikā tathā ।।52।।
punarvasurmaṃgale ca pūrvāphālgunikā budhe ।
svātirgurau kavau mūlaṃ śravaṇaṃ tu śanau tathā ।।53।।
sthirayogo mahāraṃbhakaraḥ sarvavivardhanaḥ ।
ravau tu revatī candre rohiṇī puṣyakaṃ kuje ।।54।।
uttarāphālgunī budhe viśākhā ca gurau tathā ।
śukre pūrvāṣāḍhikā ca dhaniṣṭhā tu śanau yadā ।।55।।
vardhamānākhyayogaḥ sa lagnakaraḥ śubhaḥ sadā ।
ravau śukre ca pratipat candre budhe dvitīyakā ।।।56 ।।
maṃgale tṛtīyā śanau caturthī pañcamī gurau ।
maṃgale śukrake ṣaṣṭhī budhe ca saptamī tathā ।।57।।
ravau śanau maṃgale vā'ṣṭamī navamī maṃgale ।
ravau śanau cātha daśamī tu gurau ca candrake ।।58।।
ekādaśī gurau śukre dvādaśī budhavāsare ।
maṃgale śukrake trayodaśī śanau caturdaśī ।।59।।
gurau pañcadaśī cet syāt siddhiyogaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ।
athā'nyānaśubhān yogān dvādaśa pravadāmi te ।।2.176.60।।
hutāśanaśca dagdhaśca viṣaśca krakacastathā ।
saṃvartaścaturthīgṛhaṃ mṛtyuśca vajrapātakaḥ ।।6 1।।
kālamukhastathā jvālāmukho varjyo'śubhāstvime ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ candraśca saptamyāṃ maṃgalaśca budhe'ṣṭamī ।।62।।
navamyāṃ ca guruḥ śukre daśamyekādaśī śanau ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu ravirhutāśanayogo'śubhaḥ sadā ।।63।।
tṛtīyāyāṃ budhaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaumaḥ ṣaṣṭhake guruḥ ।
śukro'ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca śaniścandre hyekādaśī ।।64।।
ravau ca dvādaśī dagdhayogo'śubhaḥ sadā mataḥ ।
dvitīyāyāṃ budhaḥ sūryaścaturthyāṃ ṣaṣṭhake śaśī ।।65।।
śanirbhaumaśca saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca gurustathā ।
navamyāṃ śukrako yatra viṣayogo bhayāvahaḥ ।।66।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaniśca saptamyāṃ śukro'ṣṭamyāṃ gurustathā ।
navamyāṃ budha evāpi daśamyāṃ maṃgalastathā ।।67।।
ekādaśyāṃ candrakaśca dvādaśyāṃ ca ravistathā ।
krakacākhyaḥ sa yogo vai aśubhaḥ sarvathā mataḥ ।।68।।
ādye budhaḥ saptame'rkaḥ saṃvartayogako'śubhaḥ ।
ādye śanirdvitīye śukrastṛtīye gurustathā ।।69।।
caturthyāṃ budhakaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaumaḥ ṣaṣṭhake śaśī ।
saptamyāṃ ca raviḥ caturthīgṛhayogako'śubhaḥ ।।2.176.70।।
ādye gururmaṃgalaśca dvitīye śukrako guruḥ ।
tṛtīye ca budhaḥ śukraścaturthe śukrako guruḥ ।।71।।
pañcamyāṃ śanirarke ca gurau ca ṣaṣṭhikā tathā ।
ravau candre gurau śukre saptamī budhake'ṣṭamī ।।72।।
navamī śukrake śanau daśamī ca tataḥ param ।
ekādaśyāṃ ravirbhaumo dvādaśyāṃ candrako guruḥ ।।73।।
trayodaśyāṃ budhacandrau pañcadaśyāṃ śanistathā ।
caturdaśyāṃ budhaśukraravayo mṛtyuyogakaḥ ।।74।।
aśubho mṛtyukaraṇaḥ tyājya eṣaḥ sadā tu saḥ ।
anurādhā dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīye cottarātrayam ।।75।।
pañcamyāṃ tu maghā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ rohiṇī ca tataḥ param ।
hastaṃ mūlaṃ ca saptamyāṃ pūrvābhādrapadā'ṣṭame ।।76।।
navamyāṃ kṛttikā caikādaśyāṃ tu rohiṇī yadi ।
citrā svātistrayodaśyāṃ yogaḥ sa vajrapātakaḥ ।।77।।
vajrapātasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ karoti karmasu dhruvam ।
anurādhā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāmuttarātrayam ।।78।।
pañcamyāṃ ca maghā'ṣṭamyāṃ rohā navame kṛttikā ।
kālamukhākhyayogaḥ sa sadā cāśubhapākadaḥ ।।79।।
mūlaṃ pratipadi cāpi bharaṇī pañcamīdine ।
aṣṭamyāṃ kṛttikā rohā navamyāṃ daśame'śliṣā ।।2.176.80।।
jvālāmukhaśca yogaḥ sa sadodvegakaro'śubhaḥ ।
saptamyāṃ bharaṇī puṣyaṃ navamyāṃ daśame'śliṣā ।।8 1 ।।
trayodaśyāṃ citrikā ca varjyayogo'śubho hi saḥ ।
ādye sūryo maṃgalaśca dvitīye śukrakaḥ śaśī ।।।82।।
tṛtīyāyāṃ budho guruścaturthyāṃ paṃcame śaniḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūryo maṃgalaśca saptamyāṃ śukrakaḥ śaśī ।।83।।
budho'ṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca gururdaśamake śaniḥ ।
ekādaśyāṃ ravirbhaumaścandraśukrau tu dvādaśe ।।84।।
budhastrayodaśe guruścaturdaśe pūrṇe śaniḥ ।
aśubhayogāḥ proktāste sarvakāryavighātakāḥ ।।85।।
jyeṣṭhāmūlarkṣayoḥ sandhau revatyaśvibhayostathā ।
āśleṣāmaghayorantarāle ghaṭīcatuṣṭayam ।।86।।
dve pūrvāyā dve paścāyā ghaṭyau gaṇḍāntayogakaḥ ।
tyājyaḥ so'pi śubhakārye phalāniṣṭo hi gaṇḍakaḥ ।।87।।
antare pañcamīṣaṣṭhyoḥ sandhau pṝṇāpratipadoḥ ।
daśamyekādaśīsandhau gaṇḍānto ghaṭikādvayam ।।88।।
navamyante dve ghaṭike pañcamyante ghaṭī tathā ।
caturthyante'rdhaghaṭikā gaṇḍāntaṃ tyājyamityapi ।।89।।
karkasiṃhāntarālaṃ ca mīnameṣāntarālakam ।
vṛścikadhanuṣyamadhyaṃ ghaṭī gaṇḍāntakaṃ smṛtam ।।2.176.90 ।।
ravitaḥ śaniparyantaṃ muhūrtāḥ kramaśastvime ।
caturdaśadvādaśadaśāṣṭaṣaṭcaturdviprakhāḥ ।। 91 ।।
kulikayogarūpāste tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ।
budhato bhaumaparyantaṃ muhūrtāṃ'kāsta eva tu ।। 92।।
kramaśaḥ kaṇṭakayogarūpāstyājyāsta ityapi ।
guruto budhaparyantaṃ mūhūrtāṃ'kāsta eva tu ।। 93 ।।
kramaśaḥ kālavelākhyayogastyājyaḥ sa eva ca ।
śukrato guruparyantaṃ muhūrtāṃ'kāsta eva tu ।। 94
yamaghaṇṭaḥ kramaśo vai tyājyaḥ sa śreṣṭhakarmasu ।
divase te kulikādyāścoktā rātrau tvatha śṛṇu ।।95 ।।
ravitaḥ śaniparyantaṃ muhūrtāḥ kramaśastvime ।
trayodaśaikādaśanavasaptapañcatryekakāḥ ।।96।।
kulikayogarūpāste tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ।
budhato bhaumaparyantaṃ ta evāṃ'kāstu kaṇṭakaḥ ।।97।।
guruto budhaparyantaṃ teṃ'kāśca kālavelikāḥ ।
śukrato guruparyantaṃ teṃ'kāstu yamaghaṃṭakāḥ ।।98।।
tyaktavyāste niśābhāge sarvathā śubhakarmasu ।
ravau caturdaśaṃ muhūrtakaṃ tyājyaṃ hi duṣṭakam ।।99।।
tathā candre navamaṃ dvādaśaṃ tyājyaṃ hi duṣṭakam ।
bhaume rātrau saptakaṃ ca dine tyājyaṃ caturthakam ।। 2.176.10 0।।
budhe'ṣṭamaṃ gurau ṣaṣṭhaṃ dvādaśaṃ tyājyamityapi ।
śukre turyaṃ navamaṃ ca śanāvādyaṃ dvitīyakam ।। 10 1।।
duṣṭakṣaṇāsta ete vai tyājyāḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ।
candre śubhe tu te sarve nirbalāḥ śubhaśaṃsakāḥ ।। 1 02।।
siddhiyoge kuyogāste nirbalāḥ siddhiśaṃsakāḥ ।
ravau gaganamadhyasthe muhūrte'bhijidāhvaye ।। 103 ।।
ghaṭīdvayaṃ sarvadoṣān hanti jayamuhūrtakam ।
tatrārabdhaṃ sarvakāryaṃ jayadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 04। ।
saptāṃgulā yaṣṭikā ca sthāpanīyā kṣitau tataḥ ।
chāyā tasyāḥ pradraṣṭavyā siddhacchāyā'bhidhā yathā ।। 1 05।।
ravau caikādaśāṃ'gulā some sārdhā'ṣṭakāṃgulā ।
bhaume navāṃ'gulā dīrghā budhe'ṣṭāṃguladīrghikā ।। 1 06।।
gurau saptāṃgulā śukre sārdhā'ṣṭāṃguladīrghikā ।
śanau sārdhā'ṣṭāṃgulā ca yadā sūryakṛtā bhavet ।।107।।
siddhicchāyāmuhūrtaṃ tat duṣṭān karoti śobhanān ।
ṛkṣaṃ tithiṃ dinaṃ tārāṃ candraṃ grahaṃ tadādikān ।। 1 08।।
uktānetān vicāryaiva kāryaṃ khātādikaṃ śubham ।
ityāha śrīhariṃ rādhe! krathakaṃ bhūpatiṃ tadā ।।1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ānandādyaṣṭāviṃśatiyogatithivāranakṣatrotpannaduṣṭayoga-trividhagaṇḍāntayogakulikādimuhūrtaduṣṭamuhūrtā'bhi-
jicchāyāmuhūrtādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 176 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 176 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 177
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 178 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike coccagrahādikaṃ yathā hariḥ ।
krathakāyā''ha tadvacmi tathā'nyadaupayogikam ।। 1 ।।
meṣasyā'rko vṛṣasyendurnakrasya maṃgalastathā ।
kanyāyāśca budhaḥ karkarāśergurustathā khalu ।। 2 ।।
mīnasya śakrastulāyāḥ śaniścoccasthitā hi te ।
tulāyāśca ravirvṛścikasya candrastathā khalu ।। 3 ।।
karkasya maṃgalo mīnasya ca budhastathā khalu ।
makarasya guruḥ kanyāyāḥ śukro meṣago śaniḥ ।। 4 ।।
nīcasthānagatā ete bodhyā naiva sukhapradāḥ ।
rāhorgṛhaṃ tu kanyā'sti mithunaṃ coccakālayam ।। 5 ।।
dhanurnīcaṃ sthānameva bodhyaṃ tathā phalaṃ hyapi ।
dviḥ svabhāve sthire lagne tyaktvā'ṣṭamaṃ ca dvādaśam ।। 6 ।।
sthānamanyeṣu sthāneṣu bhavanti cet। śubhagrahāḥ ।
ekādaśe ca ṣaṣṭhe tu pāpagrahā bhavanti cet ।। 7 ।।
gṛhasaudhamandirāṇāmārambhastatra śobhanaḥ ।
lagne gurau ravau ṣaṣṭhe saptame ca budho yadi ।। 8 ।।
caturthe śukrakaḥ śanistṛtīye cet tadā yadi ।
gṛhādyāraṃbhaṇaṃ kuryāt śatavarṣāyureva tat। ।। 9 ।।
lagne śukre tṛtīye'rke ṣaṣṭhe bhaume gurustvapi ।
pañcame cet gṛhaṃ kuryāt śatadvayāyureva tat ।। 2.177.1 0।।
sūrye caikādaśe lagne śukre daśamage budhe ।
tatra kuryād gṛhādyaṃ cet śatavarṣāyureva tat ।। 1 1।।
gurau turye śanau bhaume caikādaśe'tha candrake ।
daśame ced gṛhaṃ kuryādaśītyāyurbhaveddhi tat ।। 12।।।
śukre ucce ca vā lagne gurau lagne vā turyake ।
ucce caikādaśe vā ca śanau sampatpradaṃ gṛham ।। 1 3।।।
lagne syāccet karkacandro guruḥ syāt kendrake yadi ।
anyagrahā uccarāśau mitrarāśau ca vā yadi ।। 14।।
tadyoge mandiraṃ jātaṃ lakṣmīdaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ।
mīnarāśerlagnake ca śukraśca vartate yadi ।। 15।।
karkaguruścaturthe ca bhavane vartate yadi ।
tulāśaniśca vaikādaśake bhavanake bhavet ।। 16।।
prārabdhaṃ tu gṛhaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ cirāyureva tat ।
sarve grahā dvādaśe cāṣṭame sthāne na śobhanāḥ ।। 17।।
kendratrikoṇadhanurgāḥ pāpagrahā na śobhanāḥ ।
lagnacandro budhayuktaścāpi naiva sa śobhanaḥ ।। 18।।
aṣṭamasthaḥ candramāḥ sa śobhano naiva naiva ca ।
sarve grahā bhaveyuśca nīcāṃśe tatra nirmitam ।।1 9।।
gṛhaṃ vai nirdhanaṃ syācca tatra kāryaṃ na sarvathā ।
ko'pyekaśca grahaḥ śatragrahasya navamāṃśake ।।2.177.20।।
sthito'pi daśame vā saptame syāccet tathā punaḥ ।
lagneśo yadi vai nirbalo bhavet tatra mandiram ।।2 1 ।।
kṛtaṃ varṣāntare syāt tatparahastagataṃ dhruvam ।
lagnasvāmī janmasvāmī rāśisvāmī ca yo grahaḥ ।।22।।
tathā candro guruḥ śukraścaite'nastagatā yadi ।
tathā svoccasthale svakṣetrake svāṃśe bhavanti cet। ।।23।।
tadā''rabdhaṃ gṛhaṃ saukhyaśrīpradaṃ jāyate sadā ।
atha pratiṣṭhāsamaye sūryaścellagnakuṇḍale ।।।24।।
triṣaḍdaśaikādaśeṣūpacayasthānakeṣu cet। ।
bhavecchreṣṭhastathaiva syāccandro'pyuktasthaleṣu cet। ।।25।।
dhanurdharmasthānayukṣu bhavecchreṣṭhastathāvidhaḥ ।
bhaumaḥ śanistṛtīye caikādaśe ṣaṣṭhake śubhāḥ ।।26।।
budho gururdvādaśāṣṭabhinnasthāneṣu vai śubhau ।
ekadvātracatuḥpañcanavasthāneṣu cet kaviḥ ।।27।।
daśaikādaśayoścāpi vartate śreṣṭha eva saḥ ।
pāpagrahāḥ ravirbhaumaḥ śaniśca rāhuketukau ।।28।।
ādye'ṣṭame pañcame saptame cet syustadā ca te ।
tathā śubhagrahāḥ syuraṣṭame śaśī tathā''dyake ।।29।।
ṣaṣṭhe'ṣṭame bhavet kuṇḍalīgrahāstyājyakā ime ।
siṃhalagne sūryadevapratiṣṭhā tu śubhā matā ।।2.177.3 0।।
harasya mithune kanyālagne viṣṇormamāpi ca ।
kuṃbhe tu brahmaṇaścaralagne kṣudrasurasya ca ।। 3 1।।
yoginīnāṃ tathā lagne care vai sthāpanaṃ matam ।
lagne tu dvisvabhāve devīnāṃ susthāpanaṃ varam ।।32।।
sthire lagne sarvadevapratiṣṭhā cottamā matā ।
pratiṣṭhākuṇḍale cādyabhavane mṛtyudaḥ śaśī ।।33।।
dvitīye tu dhanuḥsthāne dhānyavṛddhipradaḥ śaśī ।
parākrame tṛtīye tu kleśado vai bhavecchaśī ।।34।।
pañcamasthaḥ śaśī gotrasantānakṣayakārakaḥ ।
śatruto bhayadaḥ ṣaṣṭhe saptame duḥkhadaḥ śaśī ।।35।।
aṣṭame mṛtyudo vighnapradaśca navame śaśī ।
daśame baladaścaikādaśastho dhanadaḥ śaśī ।। 36 ।।
dvādaśastho vyayakārī bodhyaścandro hi kuṇḍale ।
śubho'pi candramāḥ pāpagrahāt cet saptame sthale ।। 37।।
aśubhaḥ syāttathā pāpagrahayukto'pyaśuddhakaḥ ।
tathā pāpagrahamadhye'śubhaḥ kṣīṇo'pyaśuddhakaḥ ।।38।।
nīcagaśca śanuvargagaścāpyaśobhano bhavet ।
yadi candro gurudṛṣṭyā yuktaścet śubhako bhavet ।।39।।
svakarkarāśigaḥ syādvā uccago vā śubho bhavet ।
śubhagrahanavāṃśasthaḥ svādhimitranavāṃśagaḥ ।।2.177.40।।
bhavedvāpi tadā'śubhaḥ śaśī syācchubha eva saḥ ।
candrāccādye caturthe saptame ca daśame sthale ।।41 ।।
yadi krūro grahaḥ syāt tatkramāt yogāstvime'śubhāḥ ।
āpīḍā cāpi saṃpīḍā bhṛgvādyā vartitā tathā ।।42।।
tatra kārye kṛte svasya bandhornāryāśca karmaṇaḥ ।
caturṇṇāṃ vai vināśaḥ syāt tatra kāryaṃ na cārabhet ।।43 ।।
yatra rāśau bhaveccandrastatra krūragraho'pi cet ।
tadā yutirbhaveddoṣastyājyaḥ śubhe tu karmaṇi ।।44।।
budhena guruṇā yukte candre doṣo yutirna vai ।
abdā'yanartumāsarkṣapakṣadagdhāhasaṃbhavāḥ ।।45।।
andhakāṇādilagnotthāḥ sapāpendunavāṃ'śajāḥ ।
doṣā naśyanti gurujñaśukraiḥ kendratrikoṇagaiḥ ।।46 ।।
kunavāṃ'śagrahodbhūtāḥ ṣaḍvargakṣaṇalagnajāḥ ।
śaśinyekādaśe doṣāḥ sarve naśyanti tadbalāt ।।47।।
lagne vargottame vendau ravau caikādaśe'thavā ।
kendre koṇe guruḥ syāccet doṣā naśyanti tadbalāt ।।48।।
tyaktvā vai saptamaṃ sthānaṃ kendre trikoṇake budhaḥ ।
śatadoṣānapi hanti teṣu śukraḥ śatadvayam ।।49।।
teṣu gururlakṣadoṣān hanti kāryaṃ śubhaṃ bhavet ।
lagneśo lagnake syādvā navāṃśe vā bhaved yadi ।।2.177.50।।
ekādaśe vā kendre vā sarvadoṣavināśakṛt ।
lagnabale cottame kuyogā na doṣadāḥ kvacit ।।51 ।।
śuklādyadivasād gaṇayitvā vai tithisaṃkhyakām ।
ravervārād vārasaṃkhyāmaśvinyā ṛkṣasaṃkhyakām ।।52।।
tadaṃkasaṃkhyāḥ sammiśrya bhaṃktavyāsturyasaṃkhyayā ।
ekaśeṣe sthitā pṛthvī gṛhāraṃbhe kalipradā ।।53।।
dviḥśeṣe kṣitirāsīnā śubhā triḥśeṣake'pi ca ।
śūnye śeṣe jāgratī sā gṛhārambhe tvaniṣṭadā ।।54।।
evaṃ vilokya sarvaṃ vai krathakā'tra sumandiram ।
prakāraya mamārthaṃ tvaṃ pūjāsevādilabdhaye ।।55।।
ityuktvā virarāmeśaḥ pareśaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
krathakastad vaco dhṛtvā pupūja parameśvaram ।।56।।
romāyanastathā cānye pupūjuśca prajājanāḥ ।
hariṃ ca nagare tatra bhrāmayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।57।।
yānavāhanavādyādyairmaṃgalaiḥ svāgatādibhiḥ ।
upadābhiranantābhirarcayāmāsuracyutam ।।58।।
hariḥ sarvaṃ dadau tatra romāyanamahātmane ।
prajābhyaśca dadau prāsādikaṃ rājñe kuṭumbine ।।59।।
nagarīṃ pāvanīṃ kṛtvā harmyāṇi śreṣṭhināṃ tathā ।
āgatya rājasaudhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ sa upādade ।।2.177.6 0।।
sarve te bhojanaṃ cakrustato nṛpasya kanyakāḥ ।
pañca divyātmavettryaśca harestu jagṛhuḥ karam ।।6 1।।
kumāradānaṃ madhyāhne hyabhūt tāśca tataḥ param ।
kumāreṇa samaṃ rājyānniryayurhariṇā saha ।।62।।
vimānenarṣayaḥ sarve lomaśādyā haripriyāḥ ।
brahmapriyāstathā sarve vidāyaṃ prāpya niryayuḥ ।।6 3।।
prasthāpitāśca rājñā te rājamānapuraḥsarāḥ ।
kṛpāsthalādrinṛpatipṛthunā prārthitāstataḥ ।।64।।
pṛthunā bhūbhṛtā sākaṃ kṛpāsthalarṣiṇā tathā ।
prajājanairyutaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vihāyasā ।।65।।
mārgeṇa divyayānena rājadhānīṃ jarasthalīm ।
vyomnā vilokayāmāsū rādhike'raṇyaśobhitām ।।66।।
kṛtasvāgataśobhāḍhyāṃ pṛthāpagātaṭasthitām ।
vīkṣya prajā vimānaṃ ca cakrurjayetighoṣaṇām ।।67।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uccanīcagrahaphalaṃ, pratiṣṭhāne lagnakuṇḍalīsthagrahāṇā phalaṃ, candraphalam, āpīḍādiyogāḥ, yutidoṣaḥ, lagnabalaṃ, pṛthivī
suptetyādiparīkṣā, tato nagarībhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vidāyaṃ, pṛthurājadhānīṃ jarasthalīmāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 177 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 177 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 178
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 179 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike devi prāṇapriye surūpiṇi ।
jarasthalīṃ yayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānataḥ ।। 1 ।।
pṛthurājakuṭumbaṃ ca sahā'bhūt hariṇā tadā ।
vimānasthaṃ svāgatārthaṃ cā'vārohayadacyutam ।। 2 ।।
vādyaghoṣairjayanādairyantrasphoṭanaghoṣaṇaiḥ ।
bherīḍaṃkakavigalaiḥ kṛtadhvānairninādayan ।। 3 ।।
rājā gṛhṇan hārapūjāṃ samīpastho'bhavad bhuvi ।
pṛthātīre mahodyāne rājasaudhavirājite ।। 4 ।।
viśāle bhūtale vyomno hyavārohayadīśvaraḥ ।
dadau hārān svayaṃ rājā śrīśāya paramātmane ।। 5 ।।
rājño kṛpī dadau hārān kaṃbharāyai śriyai tadā ।
tasyāḥ kumārikā hārān dadrurbrahmapriyāgale ।। 6 ।।
viṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuścāparā api ।
kumārāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca pupūjuśca ṛṣīṃstathā ।। 7 ।।
svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā rājā nyaṣādayaddharim ।
divye siṃhāsane rājasabhāsthe janatānvitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
hariśca janatāḥ sarvāḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ śubham ।
caturdaśyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ nagare'bhrāmayaddharim ।। 9 ।।
tato nadītaṭe gatvā sandhyāṃ rātrau samācarat। ।
śrīhariḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tato bhojanamācarat ।। 2.178.10 ।।
rātrau viśrāntimāsādya prātarbubodha satvaram ।
nityapūjādikaṃ kṛtvā sabhāyāṃ rājapūjitaḥ ।। 1 1।।
upadeśaṃ dadau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
rājan varṣāsu cābhrāṇi jāyante yānti līnatām ।। 1 2।।
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni jāyante ca viśanti ca ।
adya vā śvaḥ paraśvo vā tato'gre vā viyojanam ।। 13।।
saṃghātānāṃ militānāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
garbhe dehā vipacyante bahiḥ puṣṭiṃ prayānti ca ।। 14।।
jarāyāṃ khalu jātāyāṃ hasantyeva vichittaye ।
asthiraṃ mānasaṃ yadvaccañcalaṃ ca pratārakam ।। 15।।
tathā varṣmā'pi boddhavyaṃ viśeṣo nātra vidyate ।
kadā kvaitad viyuktaṃ ca bhaviṣyatīti mānavaḥ ।। 16।।
nirṇetuṃ naiva śaknoti rakṣitaṃ cāpi yāsyati ।
rājyaṃ kulaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca jñātiḥ prajāśca sevakāḥ ।। 17।।
pūrvakarmānusāreṇa striyo'patyāni santi ca ।
bhagavatprāptireteṣāṃ bahupuṇyaiḥ prajāyate ।। 18।।
tava puṇyasya nānto'sti kuṭumbasyāpi ṭe nṛpa ।
yenā'dya tvadgṛhe vāso maharṣīṇāṃ mayā saha ।। 19।।
prajānāṃ te mahadbhāgyaṃ yāsāṃ vai darśanaṃ mama ।
rāṣṭraṃ puṇyaṃ tava cādya jātaṃ tīrthasvarūpakam ।।2.178.20 ।।
ityevaṃ śrīhariṃ tatropadiśantaṃ nṛpaḥ svayam ।
papraccha śrīhariṃ natvā nijapūrvabhavādikam ।।2 1 ।।
ko'hamāsaṃ purā kṛṣṇa ka ime mama bāndhavāḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ ca mama sarvaṃ prajā me vada mādhava ।।22।।
itipṛṣṭo hariḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ tava ।
purā kalpe bhavānāsīnmuniścāraṇyakā'bhidhaḥ ।।23।।
vanyaphalādano vṛkṣastambe vāsakaraḥ sadā ।
mahāmārgāṣṭakaṃ yatra yujyate svāśramāntike ।।24।।
mānavā mārgakairyānti cāyānti ca tavāśrame ।
viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ bhuktvā tvaddattāni phalāni tu ।।25।।
pītvā jalaṃ ca natvā tvāṃ prayānti ca yatheṣṭakam ।
teṣāṃ sevā tvayā tatra phalairjalairvidhīyate ।।26।।
bṛsyādibhiścāśrayasya pradānena ciraṃ muhuḥ ।
nijasevāṃ bhavāँstaiścā'kārayannaiva sarvathā ।।27।।
yatastvaṃ jñānavānāsīḥ ṛṇaṃ kāryaṃ na sarvathā ।
dātavyameva sarvebhyo grāhyaṃ naiva rajo'pi tu ।।28।।
pratigrahe tathā''dāne teṣāmṛṇaṃ prajāyate ।
mānuṣyeṇa tu dehena ṛṇaṃ kāryaṃ na vai kvacit ।।29।।
ṛṇakartā punarjanma sameti nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
sevayā jāyate mokṣaḥ sevayā svargamāpyate ।।2.178.3 0।।
sevābhiścāśiṣaḥ prāpya bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ ।
dattaṃ sarvaṃ purā paścādāpyate niyamād dhruvam ।।3 1 ।।
tasmād deyaṃ yathāśakti dātavyaṃ śraddhayā muhuḥ ।
puṃse nāryai prāṇine vā yasmai kasmaicidātmane ।। 32।।
evaṃ matvā tvayā dattaṃ bahvātmānaḥ prasāditāḥ ।
tavāśrame tadā pañcaviṃśatiḥ ṛṣayo'bhavan ।।33 ।।
tvayā tulyāḥ sevakāste sarvasevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
evaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sarvaiścā'nāthā nāryo narādayaḥ ।।34।।
sevitā āśrayaṃ datvā bālāśca vanavāsinaḥ ।
yuṣmākamāśrame saukhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sevāṃ vilokya ca ।।35।।
daridrāśca tathā'nāthāstatra nyūṣurnirantaram ।
ṣaḍviṃśatibhūsurāṇāmājñāyāṃ tu sthitāḥ sadā ।।36।।
sevante'bhyāgatān sarvān puṇyaṃ cāpyarjayanti hi ।
sakāmāḥ sarva evai te sevakāḥ sevayanti vai ।। 37।।
ṛṣīṇāmāśritāścāśramasthā jātāḥ kuṭumbavat ।
maṇḍalaṃ tanmanuṣyāṇāṃ sahasrottaratāṃ gatam ।।38।।
ṣaḍviṃśatyāśritaṃ tadvai vartate sevakādivat ।
taiśca vijñānavārtāyāṃ paralokagatau kila ।।39।।
prārthitāśca bhavanto'gresarā viprā dayālavaḥ ।
asmān vihāya gantavyaṃ naiva yuṣmābhiravyayam ।।2.178.40।।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vā viprā nītvā gantavyameva naḥ ।
āśriteṣu tathāstviti dayayā cārpitaṃ vacaḥ ।।41।।
dayaiṣā bandhanarūpā varivarti bhavatkṛte ।
sādhubhistu dayā kāryā jīvaduḥkhaharā śubhā ।।42।।
na tu kāryā tathā yatra svasyāpi bandhanaṃ bhavet ।
bhavadbhistu kṛtā sveṣāṃ bandhadā yatra te khalu ।।43।।
tatra sthātavyarūpā vai puṇyaśevadhibhiḥ purā ।
paropakārapuṇyena bhavanto viṃśatiśca ṣaṭ ।।44।।
tathā pāre sahasraṃ cāśrite yanmaṇḍalaṃ ca tat ।
naityake tu laye cākasmike sāyaṃ samāgate ।।45।।
sarve dehān vihāyaiva svargalokamito gatāḥ ।
tato maharlokameva gatvā niśāṃ tu vaidhasīm ।।46।।
kṣapayitvā punaḥ sṛṣṭau svargamāśritya devatāḥ ।
caturdaśa tu manavastathā dvādaśa sūryakāḥ ।।47।।
jātāḥ kalpe gate tatra svargavāsāḥ sukhāśrayāḥ ।
āśritāḥ sarva evaite ye yasya sevakāḥ purā ।।48।।
abhavaँste tathā teṣāṃ kuṭumbaṃ samajāyata ।
gataḥ kalpaḥ susampūrṇaḥ sevāpuṇyaiḥ purārjitaiḥ ।।49।।
svarge bhukto devasṛṣṭau tadā'haṃ bhagavān svayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।2.178.50।।
rājarājasvarūpeṇa bhavatāṃ sarvasandhiṣu ।
paṭṭābhiṣekadātā'haṃ cābhuvaṃ tatra tatra ca ।।51।।
sūryāṇāṃ ca manūnāṃ ca śāsako'haṃ tadā khalu ।
arthitaśca bhavadbhirvai mokṣārthaṃ sevayā tadā ।।52।।
mayā vicārya puṇyaṃ vai hyekajanmottaraṃ tataḥ ।
mokṣostu bhavatāṃ ceti tathāstviti vaco'rpitam ।।53।।
nā'bhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma koṭikalpe gate'pi tu ।
svargabhogāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ bhūtale bhavet ।।54।।
karmabhogātmabhūmau tad bhogārthaṃ cāgataṃ hi vaḥ ।
kalpe kṣīṇe punaḥ sṛṣṭau śubhabhogārthameva ha ।।55।।
bhavanto'tra kuṭumbairvai saha jātā bhavanti ca ।
bhavānāraṇyakaścāsīt tṛtīyaśca manustataḥ ।।56।।
ādyaścoralaketuśca dvitīyaḥ krathako manuḥ ।
uṣṭrālarājā caturtho'bhūnmanustatra kalpake ।।57।।
haṃkāro'yaṃ pañcamo'bhūt ṣaṣṭhastu jayakāṣṭhalaḥ ।
tīrāṇaḥ saptamaścāsīt alvīnarastathā'ṣṭamaḥ ।।58।।
jinavarddhirnavamo'bhūd daśamastvalpaketukaḥ ।
ekādaśo jayakṛṣṇo dvādaśo yajñaśānakaḥ ।।59।।
trayodaśaścendurāyo gaṇakastu caturdaśaḥ ।
ete vai manavaścāsan bhavanto'trakṣitīśvarāḥ ।।2.178.6 0 ।।
athā''san dvādaśa sūryā mudrāṇḍaḥ prathamo'bhavat ।
līnorṇo'rko dvitīyo'bhūd vṛhaccharastṛtīyakaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
balalīnaścaturthaśca pañcamo varasiṃhakaḥ ।
rāyagāmalakaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamaḥ phenatantukaḥ ।।62।।
stokahomaścāṣṭamārko navamaḥ kāṣṭhayānakaḥ ।
daśamaḥ kolako rājā ekādaśoṃ'garājakaḥ ।।63।।
śākuntarājā'pyabhavat dvādaśo'rkastadā purā ।
evaṃ sūryā rājarājeśvarasya mama mūrtayaḥ ।।64।।
mamāveśena cāsan vai bhavanto viṃśatiśca ṣaṭ ।
rājāno'tra samudbhūtā manavo'rkāḥ śubhāśrayāḥ ।।65।।
rājarājeśvarayogastadāsīd bhavatāṃ tataḥ ।
svarge vāmanayogaśca punarāsīt pare dine ।।66।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'tra kṣitau mama ।
mahāpuṇyapratāpena yogo jāto'sti vaḥ punaḥ ।।67।।
anāthā ye tu te sarve nāryo narāśca bālakāḥ ।
bālikāḥ sevakāḥ svarge tadāsan vaḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 68।।
atra bhūmau tu te jātāḥ kuṭumbino'pi vaḥ punaḥ ।
yajñe mayā samastebhyo lābho datto hi gocaraḥ ।।69।।
pṛṣṭaṃ yad bhavatā tasmāt kathitaṃ prāgbhavaṃ hi vaḥ ।
jānāmyahaṃ ca tatsarva bhavadbhirvismṛtaṃ hi tat ।।2.178.70 ।।
bhavadbhistu vane vanyairyā sevā dehināṃ kṛtā ।
tatpuṇyairmanurājyāni bhuktvā rājyāni vai raveḥ ।।71 ।।
adyātra śeṣabhogārthaṃ jātā rājāna eva ha ।
mama yogena puṇyena purātanena cāpi vai ।।72।।
saṃskārāṇāṃ balaiścāpi gāṃgeyāśca maharṣayaḥ ।
kṛpāsthalādyā deśe'tra sthitā yuṣmābhirarjitāḥ ।।73।।
sevitāḥ sarvathā premṇā''śīrvādāścārjitāstathā ।
tenā'haṃ punarevā'tra sarvaṃ smṛtvā purātanam ।।74।।
vṛkāyanaṃ nīlakarṇaṃ yajñārthaṃ samapreṣayam ।
prabodhārthaṃ ca mokṣārthaṃ lomaśādīnmunīṃstathā ।।75।।
ahaṃ svayaṃ cāgato'smi smṛtvā bhaktāṃśca vastathā ।
imāḥ prajāśca yāḥ sarvāḥ purā''san bhavatāṃ puraḥ ।।76।।
śamyajanā atithayo yairjagdhāni phalāni ca ।
tāḥ prajā vaḥ pradeśeṣu puṇyā bhaktā bhavanti hi ।।77।।
teṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ paraṃ manye bhagavadyojanaṃ yataḥ ।
nālpapuṇyena labhyeta bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ।।78।।
nālpapuṇyena labhyante sādhavo brahmavedinaḥ ।
nālpapuṇyena labhyante bāndhavā bhaktitatparāḥ ।।79।।
nālpapuṇyena labhyeta kuṭumbaṃ sevaka hareḥ ।
satī nārī sevikā ca putrā bhaktā nideśagāḥ ।।2.178.80 ।।
putryo bhaktiyutāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparātmani ।
mṛtyā dharmayutāḥ satyavratāḥ santoṣakāriṇaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
karmacārāḥ puṣṭidāśca dharmakārye sahāyadāḥ ।
duḥkhe bhāgagrahāścāpi na milantyalpapuṇyataḥ ।।82।।
sāṃsārikaṃ sukhaṃ puṇyairlabhyate'nantakālikam ।
parabrahmasukhaṃ sevādharmeṇa labhyate hareḥ ।।83 ।।
asaṃkhyaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca na ca grastaṃ kadācana ।
na hrastaṃ na pariṇataṃ tatsukhaṃ duḥkhavarjitam ।।84।।
mānuṣasya tu sāphalyaṃ rājan brahmasamarpaṇam ।
yuṣmābhī rājabhistattu kṛtaṃ yajñamahotsave ।।85।।
kṛtakṛtyā bhavanto'tra jātā mamāśrayādiha ।
prasanno'smi pūjito'smi sarvabhāvairmahāmakhe ।।86।।
gṛhe niveśito'smyadya gṛhaṃ te pāvanaṃ sadā ।
bhaja māṃ premabhāvena prakāraya sumandiram ।।87।।
pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ tatra dvibhujaṃ parameśvaram ।
yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathālabdhaṃ surūpaṃ māṇikīyutam ।।88।।
lakṣmīyutaṃ divyabhāvaṃ prasevaya ca sarvadā ।
sahā'rdhapañcaṣaṣṭhyaṃgulocchrayaṃ ca gajāsane ।।89।।
tathā śrīpadmābhyāṃyuktaṃ ramāyuktaṃ mahāsane ।
pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ nityaṃ prapūjaya sukhaṃ labha ।।2.178.90 ।।
ityādiśyā'rhaṇāṃ prāpya bhojayitvā janānatha ।
svayaṃ bhuktvā bahūn kṛtvā nijamantrādhisaṃśritān ।।91 ।।
prāpya viśrāntimalpāṃ ca madhyāhne rājamaṇḍalaiḥ ।
pradhānādyaiḥ praharānte pūjitaḥ śrīharistataḥ ।।।92।।
iyeṣa bahudhā rājñā'rthitaścoṣṭrālakena ha ।
yugaśāvena muninā cārthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।93।।
uṣṭrālaṃ tanmahadrājyaṃ gantuṃ madhyāhnakottaram ।
tāvadvai pṛthurājasya kanyakāḥ viṃśatistadā ।।94।।
mātṛbhiḥ saha saṃgatya pūjanārthamupāyayuḥ ।
varamālā'kṣatapuṣpasugandhipātrahastakāḥ ।।95।।
svayaṃvarasvarūpeṇa hareḥ kaṇṭhe tu rādhike ।
viṃśatyā cārpitā mālā vaivāhikā hi tatkṣaṇe ।।96।।
kumāradānavidhinā jagṛhuśca hareḥ karam ।
premṇā sarvā hariṃ nibhālayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ।।97।।
pitaraṃ tāḥ praṇamyaiva mātṝśca vṛddhamaṇḍalam ।
āśiṣaḥ sarvathā''sādya brahmapriyāstadā'bhavan ।।98।।
utsavaḥ satvaraṃ sarvaiḥ kṛto mālādikārpaṇaiḥ ।
vimānāni tadā''saँśca prasthānasamparāṇi tu ।।99।।
kanyakāviṃśatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai saha ।
gantukāmā vimāne śrīhareḥ priyāsu sarvathā ।। 2.178.100 ।।
sammīlya prasthitāścānye sarve vimānamāsthitāḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ ca hareḥ sarva maharṣayastathā'pare ।। 101।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta maṃgalaśravaṇāni vai ।
gītikāścāpyagāyanta kīrtanaṃ ca vyajāyata ।। 1 02।।
ārārtrikena vidhinā puṣpāñjalyādibhistathā ।
vardhitaḥ śrīharistūrṇaṃ tatsthalāccāmbare'bhavat ।। 1 03।।
jayaśabdairyantraghoṣairharṣanādaiḥ saha prabhoḥ ।
vimānaṃ cā'nyayānāni vyomnyagre'saṃcaran sukhāt ।। 1 04।।
prajāścā''gamyamevātra punarvai kṛpayā prabho ।
ityāhurbahudhā vākyairatoṣayan pareśvaram ।। 1 05।।
kṣaṇamātrād rādhike vai vimānānyambarāttadā ।
yugaśāvena nirdiṣṭamārgeṇoṣṭrālarāṣṭrakam ।। 1 06।।
āyayurdinapānadyāstaṭe viyānikāṃ purīm ।
dadarśa rādhike vyomnā rāṣṭraṃ suśobhitaṃ hariḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pṛthurājadhānīṃ jarasthalīṃ gatvā svāgatamāsādya harirūpādideśa, ṣaḍviṃśatinṛpāṇāṃ prākkalpe ṛṣitvaṃ manutvaṃ sūryatvaṃ
cetyāha, tato viśramya pūrṇimāyām uṣṭrālarāṣṭramupāgamadityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 178 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 178 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 179
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 180 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā viyānānagarīpatiḥ ।
uṣṭrālaśca tathā tasya bhrātā'nujo'pi bhaktarāṭ ।। 1 ।।
nāmnā haṃkārakaḥ saumyo guḍākeśīpurīpatiḥ ।
tathā bhrātā tṛtīyaśca nāmnā tu jayakāṣṭhalaḥ ।। 2 ।।
prayāganagarīrājo dhārmikaḥ śubhabhāvanaḥ ।
trayāṇāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ kulaguruśca yugaśāvakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājñāṃ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca bandhavo'nye suhṛjjanāḥ ।
śreṣṭhinaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ svāgatārthaṃ harestadā ।। 4 ।।
dīnapāsaritastīre mahodyānasuśobhite ।
viyānākhyanagaryāstu nātidūre kṛtasthale ।। 5 ।।
svāgatārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।
dhvajapatākikāḍaṃkāniśānavādyakānvitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
yānavāhanaśakaṭīvimānarathasaṃhitāḥ ।
puṣpamālā'kṣatadravyacandanagandhadhāriṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
rājasainyaiḥ prajāklṛptasvasevāmaṇḍalairyutāḥ ।
āsan vai tatparā vyomni pratīkṣantaḥ śubhāgamam ।। 8 ।।
vimānaṃ ca vimānāni sūryatulyāni tāvatā ।
lulokire'titejobhiścakruste tu jayadhvanīn ।। 9।।
svāgatadhvajadānāni darśayāmāsurambare ।
tadā vādyānyavādyantā'jāyanta yantragarjanāḥ ।। 2.179.1 0।।
vimānāvataraṇārthaṃ sūcakāḥ sūcanāṃ daduḥ ।
prajāḥ sarvā jayakārān jaguḥ kīrtanamiśritān ।। 11 ।।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।
parabrahma ramākānta rādhākānta harevibho ।। 12।।
ityevaṃ kīrtanaṃ cābhūllakṣādhimānavaiḥ kṛtam ।
nadītīraśca gaganaṃ kīrtanoddhoṣitaṃ hyabhūt ।। 13।।
prajā draṣṭuṃ tadā''saँśca udvelā iva vārdhayaḥ ।
pūrṇimenduṃ pratīśeśeśvareśvaraṃ prati prabhum ।। 14।।
mahodyāne viśāle tu hareryānamavā'tarat ।
tato yānāni sarvāṇi vyomnastatra hyavātaran ।। 15।।
nṛpatrayaṃ tadamātyāḥ svāgataṃ cakrurādarāt ।
prajāḥ sarvāḥ svāgataṃ ca cakrustadā hareḥ śubham ।। 16।।
agrajena hareḥ kaṇṭhe maṇihāraḥ samarpitaḥ ।
dvitīyena hīramālā harergale'rpitā tadā ।। 17।।
tṛtīyena tu sāmudramauktikasrak samarpitā ।
rājñībhiśca tadā svarṇamālā haraye cārpitā ।। 18।।
putraputryādibhiḥ puṣpamālāḥ kaṇṭhe samarpitāḥ ।
puṣpākṣataiścandanādyaiḥ satkṛtaḥ pūjito hariḥ ।। 19।।
prajābhiśca dhanāḍhyaiścāmātyavargaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ।
śrīharistatpitarau ca bhrātṝn svasāramityapi ।।2.179.20।।
ṛṣīn maharṣīn bhaktāṃśca brahmapriyāśca sevikāḥ ।
sarvān sarvāstadā rājakuṭumbādyā hyapūjayan ।।2 1 ।।
gajāsane samāsīnaṃ natvā rājakuṭumbakam ।
kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat pādau prakṣālya caraṇāmṛtam ।।22।।
papau krameṇa rājādyāḥ pradhānāśca prajāstataḥ ।
evaṃ susvāgataṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā ca pāyasam ।।23।।
pānaṃ phalādanaṃ sarvān nagaryāṃ cāpyabhrāmayan ।
rājyaśobhitasainyaiśca vādyairvividhakaistathā ।।24।।
kīrtanairnāmagānaiśca bhrāmayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
hastiyānaṃ suśobhaṃ ca viśālaṃ prāsarat puraḥ ।।25।।
gopure kanyakābhiśca vardhitaḥ kusumā'kṣataiḥ ।
lājābhirjalakalaśairduḥkhahāñjalibhistathā ।।26।।
ghaṇṭāpathe cāpaṇasthairdhanikaiḥ pūjito hariḥ ।
mauktikaiḥ prokṣitaścāgre catuṣke vanitāgaṇaiḥ ।।27।।
prajābhiḥ sarvathā sarvābhiśca candanavāribhiḥ ।
puṣpākṣatādibhirnārikelaiḥ phalaiśca kuṃkumaiḥ ।।28।।
śarkarābhiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pūjito vardhito hariḥ ।
sarveṣu rājamārgeṣu paurastrībhiḥ prapūjitaḥ ।।29।।
nirīkṣitaśca bahudhāsvarūpastṛptidaḥ prabhuḥ ।
kumārīṇāṃ kamanīyaḥ kumāro viditastadā ।।2.179.30।।
yuvatīnāṃ mugdhamūrtiryuvā suviditaḥ prabhuḥ ।
vṛddhānāṃ bālarūpaḥ saḥ putravadviditastadā ।।3 1।।
vidhavānāṃ prabhuḥ sākṣāt prāpyaḥ sa viditastadā ।
satīnāṃ satsvarūpaścā'nāthānāṃ vidito'vitā ।।32।।
kumārāṇāṃ śikṣakaśca yūnāṃ praśāsakastathā ।
jaraṭhānāṃ prāpyarūpo viditaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।33।।
bhaktānāṃ premapātrāṇāṃ svāmī sa vidito hariḥ ।
darśakānāṃ surūpaśca yogināṃ brahmamūrtimān ।।34।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ śaṃkhacakrādidhṛgacyutaḥ prabodhitaḥ ।
sādhūnāṃ ca tadā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।31।।
jñāto'bhūt sarvalokānāṃ dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
ityevaṃ nagare datvā darśanaṃ bhrāmaṇena vai ।।36।।
ākṛṣya janatācittānyāyayau sve nṛpālaye ।
viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tatropadeśaṃ lomaśo dadau ।। 37।।
ayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād rājan śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
prāgbhavīyamanūnāṃ ca ravīṇāṃ bhavatāṃ kṛte ।।38।।
bhaktavaśyaḥ prabhuḥ sākṣād bhaktān smṛtvā'tra cāgataḥ ।
yajño homo japo mālāvartanaṃ bhajanaṃ tapaḥ ।।39।।
jñānaṃ dānaṃ sevanaṃ ca sākṣāt kṛṣṇe virājate ।
sarvadharmāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvapuṇyanidhiḥ svayam ।।2.179.40।।
yeṣāṃ sa militaḥ sākṣānmānavarṣisvarūpavān ।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ bhavet sevā kṛṣṇarañjanakāriṇī ।।41 ।।
yathā patyau yathā patnyāṃ yathā vṛddhe ca mātari ।
gurau jyeṣṭhe pūjyavarge yathā sevā tathā harau ।।42।।
sākṣātkṛtā divyarūpā puruṣārthacatuḥpradā ।
gṛhadharmo yatidharmo yatra bhaktiḥ suvidyate ।।43 ।।
nityaṃ tatraiva vasatastāvubhau parameśvare ।
sarvātmanā'rpaṇe kāryaṃ parameśe parātpare ।।44।।
satpātraṃ bhagavān sākṣātprāpyate puṇyakoṭibhiḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ vittaṃ kṣaṇaṃ cittaṃ kṣaṇo deho dhanaṃ kṣaṇam ।।45।।
kṣaṇena sādhanīyaḥ sa bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
kiṃ rājyena dhanenāpi kuṭumbena janena vā ।।46 ।।
kiṃ lakṣmyā cāpi sampattyā kiṃ mānena ca vidyayā ।
kiṃ kṣetreṇa striyā strībhiḥ putraiḥ putryādibhiśca kim ।।47।।
kiṃ yānena vimānaiśca kiṃ kīrtyā yaśasāpi kim ।
kiṃ puṣṭena surūpeṇa śarīreṇa balena kim ।।48।।
yadyanādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhāvena sevayā ।
arpaṇena ca bhaktyāpi toṣito nahi janmani ।।49।।
ātmā deyastvātmano yat sarvaṃ tatrā''rpyameva ha ।
bhuktirmuktiścārjanīye sarvārpaṇena cācyutāt ।।2.179.50।।
bhavadbhiḥ rājabhiścātra kṛto yajñaḥ śubho mahān ।
ayaṃ śrīkambharābālo bālakṛṣṇaḥ pratoṣitaḥ ।।51।।
kṛtakṛtyā bhavanto vai sarvaṃ prāptaṃ śubhāspadam ।
kartavyaṃ śiṣyate naiva yato'yaṃ suprasāditaḥ ।।52।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau lomaśaśca tataḥ param ।
śrīhareścaraṇau dhṛtvā rājā svamastake nyadhāt। ।।53।।
rājñī rājakumārāśca rājaputryo hṛdi nyadhuḥ ।
ājñāṃ prāpya yayuḥ sarve harirviśrāntimāpa ha ।।54।।
bhojanādi saṃvidhāya sarve nidrāṃ prajagṛhuḥ ।
prātarutthāya ca nityaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā haristataḥ ।।55।।
niṣasādāsane ramye maharṣikulapūjitaḥ ।
tāvad rājā tathā rājñī putryaḥ putrāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।56।।
uṣṭrālaścāpi haṃkāro jayakāṣṭhala ityapi ।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ ciravāsārthamīśvaram ।।57।।
hariḥ prāhā'dya bhavatāṃ janmasāphalyameva tu ।
darśanātpūjanājjātaṃ prasannatā'rjitā mama ।।58।।
yenā'haṃ samprasannaḥ syāṃ tadvidheyaṃ sadā'naghāḥ ।
ciravāsāya samayo vidyate nahi sarvathā ।।59।।
haṃkārasyā''laye rāṣṭre gantavyamapi vidyate ।
jayakāṣṭhalarājye ca gantavyamapi vidyate ।।2.179.6 0।।
atra lābho gṛhītaśca santuṣṭo'smyatra pūjayā ।
caraṇasparśanaṃ bhūmau rājyālaye bhavediti ।।6 1।।
bhavatāṃ kāmanāpūrtiṃ karomyadyaiva dhāryatām ।
adya prātardugdhapānaṃ kṛtvā vimānayānakaiḥ ।।62।।
sarvairgantavyamevā''dye haṃkārālayarāṣṭrake ।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ tatra nagarabhramaṇaṃ tathā ।।63।।
pādanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhnottarameva tu ।
jayakāṣṭhalarājye vai gantavyaṃ tu tadālaye ।।64।।
tatra puryāṃ bhramitvā ca pāvayitvā tadālayam ।
rātrau ca bhojanaṃ kṛtvā viśramya ca niśāṃ tataḥ ।।65।।
aruṇodayavelāyām ālvīnarasya rāṣṭrakam ।
gantavyaṃ ceti tadrītyā kurvantu cānukūlatām ।।66।।
mamā''jñā sarvathā pālyā sukhaṃ tatraiva vidyate ।
svalpe'pi samaye dāsye saukhyaṃ saṃkhyāvivarjitam ।।67।।
ityāśrutya hareścājñāṃ bhrātarastraya eva te ।
prasannā bhagavadvākye tathaiva cakrurādarāt ।।68।।
uṣṭrālasyā'rhaṇāṃ prāpya prasthānāya samudyatam ।
bhagavantaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vai rādhike tadā ।।69।।
uṣṭrālasya sutāḥ pañca pūjanaṃ cakrurādarāt ।
putryo daśa hareḥ pāṇiṃ jagṛhuḥ patikāmyayā ।।2.179.70।।
pitṛbhyāṃ moditāstatra vivāhavidhinā harim ।
prāpurbrahmapriyāṇāṃ maṇḍale'milansamutsukāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
āśīrvādāँstadā nītvā prasthānamāsthitāstadā ।
prasthitena ca hariṇā sārdhaṃ kanyāśca bhūbhṛtaḥ ।।72।।
vimānānyadhiruhyā'tha vyomnā śīghraṃ pratasthire ।
guḍākeśīṃ rājadhānīṃ haṃkārarājapālitām ।।73।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa saṃprāpuḥ śṛṇvanto jayaghoṣaṇām ।
tyaktaiḥ purogataiścāpi śrāvitāṃ maṃgalānvitām ।।74।।
dīnapāyāḥ saritaśca taṭe sthitāṃ suśobhitām ।
guḍākeśīṃ tu nagarīṃ mahodyānasamanvitām ।।75।।
śṛṃgāritāṃ gopurādyaistoraṇaiḥ kalaśādibhiḥ ।
raṃgavallīsvastikādyairdhvajacihnairalaṃkṛtām ।।76।।
sammārjitāṃ gandhajalaiḥ saṃsiktāṃ vādyanāditām ।
svāgatārthaṃ prajābhiśca pura āgatya garjitām ।।77।।
haṃkāraḥ sakuṭumbaścā'nujena saha pūrvagaḥ ।
svāgataṃ sainyasahitaścakre jayadhvajādibhiḥ ।।78।।
vimānaṃ tatsūcanānusāreṇa yugaśāvakaḥ ।
ṛṣiḥ saudhasya nikaṭe vyomno'vā'tārayattadā ।।79।।
vimānāni cāvaterustathānyāni tadāmbarāt ।
tūpaśabdāstadā jātā jayanādāḥ sakīrtanāḥ ।।2.179.80।।
harirvimānatastūrṇaṃ cāvatīrṇo mahītale ।
rājā haṃkārakeṇāpi kuṭumbena haristadā ।।81 ।।
vardhito vai jayadhvānaiḥ pūjitaścandanādibhiḥ ।
hareścaraṇau prakṣālya rājādyāśca papurjalam ।।।82।।
tato'śvayāne śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samāropya purīṃ prati ।
utsavena saha ninye rājā tadrājamārgakam ।।83।।
sthale sthale hariṃ natvā prajāḥ pupūjurādarāt ।
upadāḥ pradaduścakrurdarśanaṃ vandanādikam ।।84।।
amātyāḥ svagṛhān nītvā cakruścārārtrikaṃ prabhoḥ ।
prajāḥ svasvagṛhān nītvā pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।85।।
evaṃ kṛtvā pāvanīṃ ca guḍākeśīṃ purīṃ tataḥ ।
rājālayaṃ yayuḥ sarve hariḥ svarṇarathāttadā ।।86।।
avatīrya drutaṃ snātvā madhyāhnavidhimācarat ।
devāya bhojanaṃ cārpya svayaṃ sarvān nijāśritān ।।87।।
bhojayitvā ca bubhuje viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
rājānaṃ suprasannaṃ ca kṛtvā datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ।।88।।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ vimānena sasārthakaḥ ।
jigamiṣurhariḥ rājñyā prārthitaḥ kanyakādibhiḥ ।।89।।
pūjitaśca tataḥ pañca kanyakā nṛpatestadā ।
pāṇiṃ jagrāha kṛṣṇasya mātrā cājñāpitāstadā ।।2.179.90।।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca kuṭumbaṃ harṣitaṃ tvabhūt। ।
brahmapriyāsu tāḥ pañca mimīlurdivyavigrahāḥ ।।91।।
atha rājānamāpṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ ca tatprajājanān ।
harirvimānamāruhya sasārthaścāmbaraṃ yayau ।।92।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
datvā sa darśanaṃ śīghraṃ yayau prayāgapattanam ।।93।।
jayakāṣṭhalanṛpateḥ rājadhānīṃ śubhāśrayām ।
mahodyānānvitāṃ ramyāṃ sāyaṃ prāpa prabhustataḥ ।। 94।।
jayo rājā puro gatvā svāgataṃ prajayā saha ।
ācarad vādyaghoṣādyairdhvajaiḥ sainyaiḥ suśobhitaiḥ ।।95।।
sāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā purīṃ ramyāṃ prayāgākhyāṃ vimānakam ।
yugaśāvoktamārgeṇa vyomnastadā bhuvaṃ prati ।।96।।
avātārayadīśeśaḥ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
vimānāni cāvateruḥ saudhasya sannidhau tadā ।।97।।
jalena rājā caraṇau hareḥ prakṣālya vai papau ।
hāramālādibhiḥ kṛtvā svāgataṃ sujalaṃ dadau ।।98।।
sarvān jalāni miṣṭāni pāyayitvā sasainyakaḥ ।
'rājā svanagarīṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa sotsavaḥ ।।9 9 ।।
prajābhirmukhyavargaiśca pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
caraṇairdarśanadānaiḥ pāvayitvā purībhuvam ।। 2.179.10 0।।
rājasaudhaṃ samāyācca bhojanādi tato'karot ।
sarvān vai bhojayitvaiva viśaśrāma niśāmukhe ।। 10 1।।
tadrājyagāyakairgānaistoṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
tebhyo dadau copahārān pāritoṣikahīrakān ।। 102।।
rātrau suptvā prage tūryaiḥ prabubodha haristataḥ ।
nityaṃ vidhiṃ brāhmakāle śīghraṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ।। 103 ।।
rājā prajāḥ samāgatyopadā nyadhurhareḥ puraḥ ।
bhrātṛtrayasya tatsarvaṃ yugaśāvāya sandadau ।। 1 04।।
atha rājñī vaiṣṇavī ca pañcaputrīsamāyutā ।
āyayau pūjanārthaṃ ca pañcakanyāḥ prapūjya tam ।। 1 05।।
hariṃ jagṛhuḥ kāntaṃ svaṃ matvā mohavaśaṃgatāḥ ।
kumāradānavidhinā vivāhya parameśvaram ।। 106 ।।
kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātāstato dugdhāni vai papuḥ ।
pāyayāmāsuratyarthaṃ bhagavantaṃ kuṭumbinam ।। 1 07।।
rājānaṃ ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ pāyayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
ṛṣīn devādikān sarvān brahmapriyādikāstathā ।। 1 08।।
dugdhādi pāyayāmāsa paramātmā sanātanaḥ ।
atha gantumanāḥ kṛṣṇaścāśīrvādān dadau tadā ।। 1 09।।
sajjo'bhūcchīghramevātha prasthāpitaḥ prajādibhiḥ ।
vimānaṃ śīghramevādau divyaṃ samāruroha saḥ ।। 2.179.11 0।।
anye'pyāruruhurnaijavimānāni tadā drutam ।
jayamaṃgalaśabdaiśca prasthānaṃ cakrire tataḥ ।। 111 ।।
valgurāyapradeśānāṃ rājā tīrāṇanāmakaḥ ।
sakuṭumbastathā ṛṣirvalgurāyaḥ kuṭumbavān ।। 1 12।।
vimānena hariṃ śritvā saha pūrvaṃ yayau tadā ।
valgurāyapradeśāँśca harirdadarśa cāmbarāt ।। 1 13।।
ramaṇīyān sevikāyā nadyāstaṭe suśobhanām ।
tīrāṇāṃ rājadhānīṃ ca tato dadarśa cāmbarāt ।। 1 14।।
rādhike ca vimānasthā aśṛṇvan maṃgalasvanān ।
jayadhvānān tūpaśabdān jayaśabdān prajoditān ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne uṣṭrālayasya haṃkārasya jayakāṣṭhalasya ca nṛpasya rājadhānīṣu vimānairgamanaṃ nagareṣu bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ pratipadi prātastī-
rāṇārājadhānīṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 179 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 179 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 180
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 181 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tataḥ śrīmaddhariḥ svāmī rādhike svavimānakam ।
valgurāyarṣiṇā sārdhaṃ tīrāṇena ca bhūbhṛtā ।। 1 ।।
pradarśitena mārgeṇa samavātārayat kṣitau ।
tataścānyavimānāni tvavaterustu pṛṣṭhataḥ ।। 2 ।।
jayaśabdāstu tūryāṇāṃ ninādāśca tadā'bhavan ।
harṣaśabdāśca nārīṇāṃ bālānāṃ kalaghoṣaṇāḥ ।। 3 ।।
prajānāṃ svāgataśabdāścābhavam paritastadā ।
puṣpavarṣā'kṣatavarṣā cāndanī vṛṣṭirityapi ।। 4 ।।
abhūttadā vimānādvai yadā harirbarhiryayau ।
anye cāpi mahīmānāścāvaterurvimānataḥ ।। 5 ।।
tīrāṇākhyanṛpastatra neme caraṇayorhareḥ।
kuṭumbaṃ rājakīyaṃ ca neme caraṇayorhareḥ ।। 6 ।।
prakṣālya caraṇau pānaṃ vyadhuḥ sarve kuṭumbinaḥ ।
hemahārān ratnahārān mauktikamaṇisañjitān ।। 7 ।।
hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuḥ sarve parabrahmaparātmanaḥ ।
svāgataṃ puṣpamālābhirjayaśabdaiḥ pracakrire ।। 8 ।।
reṇḍiyārasaptavāhye rathe rājā hariṃ tadā ।
śvete niṣādayāmāsa tathā'nyān vājivāhane ।। 9 ।।
rājasainyaiḥ kṛtamānaḥ pradhānaiharipūjitaḥ ।
chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyo reje śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 2.180.1 0।।
tīrāṇākhyanagaryāṃ vai bahumānapuraḥsaram ।
śrīhariṃ sārthasahitaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।। 11 ।।
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ sthale sthale ।
āmadhyāhnaṃ pradāyaiva darśanaṃ ca nṛpālayam ।। 12।।
devasabhāsamaṃ cendrasaudhāmaṃ prāpa vai prabhuḥ ।
viśrāntiṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snānādikamathācarat ।। 13 ।।
dugdhapānādikaṃ sarvānakārayadati nṛpaḥ ।
kṛtapūjo hariścāpi bhojayitvā kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 14।।
mahīmānān ṛṣīn sarvān brahmapriyāśca sevakān ।
svayaṃ ca bubhuje svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 15।।
rājādyāśca prasādaṃ śrīharerāpustadāśubham ।
ārāmaṃ kṛtavantaśca sarve madhyāhnakottaram ।। 16।।
rājā kuṭumbasahitaḥ kṛṣṇapādāvamardayat ।
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre sevālābhamavāpa ha ।। 17।।
atha sāyaṃ sabhāsthāne viśālā'bhūt sabhā tadā ।
lakṣaśo mānavā yatra niṣeduḥ sannidhau hareḥ ।। 18।।
nāryo narāśca parito niṣedustasthurityapi ।
atha rājā pupūjainaṃ copadābhiḥ pareśvaram ।। 19।।।
niṣasādā''sane rājā papraccha vinayānvitaḥ ।
kathaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛte rājye bandhanaṃ nopasarpati ।।2.180.20 ।।
bhavatprāptyā bandhanāni chinnānīti ca vedmyaham ।
tathāpi baddhabhāvatvād yathā na bandhanaṃ bhavet ।।21 ।।
tathā śādhi mahārāja kuṭumbaṃ vada śāntidam ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavānāha sabhāyāṃ sarvaśṛṇvatām ।।22।।
bhavasāgaratīrasya prāpakaṃ pravadāmi te ।
yathā na bandhanaṃ madhye kutracit syāt kadācana ।।23।।
prāṇasyā'nnamidaṃ sarvaṃ nātmanastu kadācana ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇasyaivāsti bhojanam ।।24।।
sthite prāṇe tu tattvānāmapekṣā varṣmaṇi sthitā ।
prāṇo vai prakṛteḥ kāryaṃ gate prāṇe na tṛṣṇikā ।।25।।
matvaivaṃ tu budho bhakṣye bhogye varteta nispṛhaḥ ।
lubdhavannaiva varteta virāgasya na bandhanam ।।26।।
yathā''ruhya mahāvṛkṣamapahṛtya tato madhu ।
vṛkṣaṃ tyajati tatraiva bhuktvā madhu tataḥ param ।।27।।।
malaṃ tyajati tatpaścād dehastyājyo bhaviṣyati ।
ityevaṃ cānusandhāya vartate na sa badhyate ।।28।।।
yathā mārgaṃ mahāntaṃ vai janastvāśāśatākulaḥ ।
patan phalaṃ na vindeta nirāśaḥ samprajāyate ।।29।।
smṛtvā sarvaṃ tathā vijñaścalaṃ matvā na badhyate ।
āpatkāle yathā śaktajano'pi yāti mārdavam ।।2.180.30 ।।
tathā varteta māyāyāṃ mārdavena na badhyate ।
yathā ca jarayā vyāptaḥ śanuhastagato'pi vā ।।3 1 ।।
bhogyāśāṃ prajahātyeva tathāvṛttirna badhyate ।
parvatāśca drumāścāpi nityasaṃnyāsayoginaḥ ।।32।।
mamakāraṃ parityajya vartante niṣparigrahāḥ ।
tathāvṛttiḥ rājyakartā nirlepo nahi badhyate ।।33।।
audakāḥ sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā ātmabharaṇatatparāḥ ।
parigrahaṃ na kurvanti tathāvṛttirna badhyate ।।34।।
śṛṇu cātretihāsaṃ tvaṃ tāpasānāṃ hitāvaham ।
purā gṛhān parityajya dvijāḥ kecana vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 35।।
vanamabhyāgaman dhīrā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ।
yatitulyā rūpavanto hyajātaśmaśravo'pi ha ।। 36।।
indro dayāparo bhūtvā''babhāṣe pakṣirūpadhṛk ।
aho bhavanto bālyādvai tyāgamārgamupāśritāḥ ।।37।।
kathaṃ gatā na gārhasthye ko hetustyajane'naghāḥ ।
śrutvā tadṛṣayaḥ prāhurnispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ।।38।।
gārhasthye vā vane vāpi tasya bandho na vidyate ।
vayaṃ vai nispṛhāstasmādvanamārgamupāśritāḥ ।।39।।
prakṣālanāddhi paṃkena paṃkā'sparśo hi cottamaḥ ।
pakasparśo yasya jātastasyā'pekṣā jalasya vai ।।2.180.40।।
jalātmakena jñānena prakṣālanaṃ varaṃ matam ।
yadvā cātapayogena śuṣkabhāvo varo mataḥ ।।41 ।।
kardamaḥ kṛkacībhūtvā svayaṃ viyogamāśrayet ।
ārādhanaṃ hareścāstyātaparūpaṃ viśodhakam ।।।42।।।
yadvā ca vāyunā śuṣkabhāvo'pi cottamo mataḥ ।
guruṃ vāyuṃ samāśrityā'vidyākardamanāśanam ।।43।।
tasmād guruṃ mahāntaṃ vai santaṃ vā parameśvaram ।
tadvijñānaṃ samāśliṣya māyāṃ vināśayet sudhīḥ ।।44।।
karmā'pi sarvamevaitallaukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca vā ।
kurvannaiṣkarmyabhāvena siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ।।45।।
siddhikṣetramidaṃ puṇyaṃ pakṣin karmaphalapradam ।
devavaṃśān pitṛvaṃśān brahmavaṃśān sato janān ।।46।।
anusṛtyaiva yatkarma tatkarma phaladaṃ nṛṇām ।
vayaṃ vartāmahe brahmavaṃśamāśritya vaidikam ।।47।।
gārhasthyaṃ cet tapoyuktaṃ yujyate mokṣadāyakam ।
kintu vighnagṛhaṃ tadvai vayaṃ śāntā yatastataḥ ।।48।।
nairbalye sati sāralyaṃ cātmamārgasya saṃśrayet ।
sabalānāṃ mahāmārgo gārhasthyaṃ bahutāpinām ।।49।।
na vayaṃ prabhavo voḍhuṃ gṛhadharmānato yamān ।
sādhudharmān saṃśritāḥ smo yatra śreyo dhruvaṃ bhavet ।।2.180.50।।
saṃśaye nirṇaye cādyaṃ tyaktvā nirṇayamāśrayet ।
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ pakṣirāṭ svayam ।।51।।
jagāda tān gṛhadharmān kaṭhinān paramottamān ।
jale nimajjitaścāpi jalasparśātirekavān ।।52।।
vahnau tu patitaścāpi dāhabhāvātirekavān ।
kāmadharme sthitaścāpi kāmanāṃśavivarjitaḥ ।।53।।
kaścideva bhavelloke samarthaḥ puṇyāvānapi ।
tādṛśaḥ syād gṛhasthaścellabhate śreya uttamam ।।54।।
tyāgena tvātmamātrasya kalyāṇaṃ labhate janaḥ ।
gṛhadharmairasaṃkhyānāṃ kalyāṇakṛdbhavejjanaḥ ।।55।।
yathā sarvāstu sarito viśrāntiṃ yānti vāridhau ।
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni viśramante gṛhigṛhe ।।56।।
tyāgavanto mahātmāno nispṛhā api yoginaḥ ।
gṛhadharmasthitān vṛkṣān saphalānāśrayanti vai ।।57।।
paropakaraṇaṃ tatra gṛhadharme prajāyate ।
atithīnāmāśrayo vai pakṣiṇāṃ gṛhadharmavān ।।58।।
arjitaṃ gṛhadharmaiśca nītyā satyena yuktayā ।
vibhajyaiva gṛhī bhuṃkte kuṭumbāśritabhikṣukān ।।59।।
nṛpaṃ cāgantukaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ pipīlikādikān ।
smṛtvā tebhyo yathāyogyaṃ datvā bhuṃkte gṛhī sadā ।।2.180.60।।
prātardevā hi tṛpyanti madhyāhne'tithibhikṣukāḥ ।
tataḥ paraṃ ca pitaraścānte vai kṣudrajantavaḥ ।।61 ।।
gṛhiṇā randhitaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjate sarvadehinaḥ ।
vighasāśī gṛhī tasmād datvā gṛhṇāti nānyathā ।।62।।
ghasaṃ pāpaṃ svātmamātrodaraṃbharatvamucyate ।
vigataṃ tu ghasaṃ pāpaṃ yatrā'nye yānti tarpaṇam ।।63।।
yajño dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaśceśvarārpaṇam ।
ṣaḍetāni yatra santi vighasāśitvameva tat ।।64।।
śreṣṭhaṃ vai sarvadharmebhyo vighasāśitvamuttamam ।
pālayitvā ca taddharmaṃ śreyaḥ paramamarjayet ।।65।।
loko'yaṃ bhogadasteṣāṃ svargo'pi cātisaukhyakṛt ।
tato'pi ca phalādhikye paraṃ śreyo bhavedapi ।।66।।
sarvārpaṇavidhānena prāptavyaṃ paramaṃ padam ।
nedṛśaṃ karmabhūmau vai śreṣṭhaṃ tvanyad gṛhāśramāt ।।67।।
ahamindro'smi yatayaḥ karmaṇā''ptaḥ sureśatām ।
sūryacandrādayaḥ sarve'bhavan prāg vighasāśinaḥ ।।68।।
vartante tvadhunā svarge vighasāśina eva te ।
vaikuṇṭhastho hariḥ sākṣād vighasāśī virājate ।।69।।
goloke'pi tathā kṛṣṇo vighasāśī virājate ।
caturbhujo vāsudevo viṣṇuśca vighasāśanaḥ ।।2.180.70।।
haro brahmā vasiṣṭhādyā vighasāśina eva te ।
vartante bhogamārgasthā api dvandvavivarjitāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
īśvarārpaṇadharmāṇo gamiṣyanti paraṃ padam ।
evaṃ vai yatayo brahma gacchanti vighasāśinaḥ ।।72।।
sāyaṃ prātarvibhajyā'nnaṃ kuṭumbe'tithibhikṣuke ।
pareśe ca sure bhūte pitari svajane'pi ca ।।73।।
anāthe cāśrite bhṛtye śvādau cānāthake tathā ।
nāryāṃ gavi ca samprāpte yācake ca gurāvapi ।।74।।
dāse dāsyāṃ karmacāre prajāyāṃ bhautikātmasu ।
vibhajyānnādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathāyogyaṃ tu dharmataḥ ।।75।।
avaśiṣṭaṃ samaśnanti ye te syurvighasāśinaḥ ।
te lokaguravo bhūtvā jāyante śāśvatāśinaḥ ।।76।।
tridivaṃ ca mahadrājyaṃ prāpya śāśvatavārṣikam ।
īśvarārpaṇapuṇyena prayāntyapunarāgamam ।।77।।
tasmād vighasabhoktāro bhavanti bandhanojjhitāḥ ।
gṛhadharmān samāśritya bahavastatpadaṃ yayuḥ ।।78।।
tasmād bhavanto bālāśca bhavantu vighasāśinaḥ ।
etad vidustapo viprāḥ saptarṣayastathā pare ।।79।।
ityuktāste dharmayuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā yatīśvarāḥ ।
tyāgāśramaṃ vihāyaiva gārhasthyaṃ samupāśritāḥ ।।2.180.80।।
cakruḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe vighasāśā maharṣayaḥ ।
ātmanivedanadharmāśrayāḥ sarve tato'bhavan ।।8 1।।
sastrīputrakuṭumbāḍhyāścānte brahma yayuḥ purā ।
tasmād rājan gṛhadharmaḥ kaṭhino'pi sukhāvahaḥ ।।82।।
paropakārapuṇyāḍhyaḥ satsevāprāpakaḥ sadā ।
parameśvarasevāderlābhadaḥ śreṣṭhako yataḥ ।।83।।
vighasāśī bhavān nityaṃ vartayatu sahāśritaiḥ ।
sarvendriyakriyāsveva kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyatu māṃ muhuḥ ।।84।।
bandhanaṃ te na vai bhāvi mama yogāt kadācana ।
mama yogāt sadā śāntistava rājan bhaviṣyati ।।85।।
rakṣā'tra pratimāṃ me ca kuru sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi ।
ananyabhaktaṃ tvāṃ bhūbhṛt nayiṣye brahmadhāma te ।।86।।
ye ye mamārpaṇadharmaparāyaṇā janā iha ।
teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā karmabandhanasāgarāt ।।87।।
ityuktvā bhagavāँstatra virarāma prajāstu tāḥ ।
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ mantrān jagṛhurādarāt ।।88।।
vighasāśivratavatyo jātāḥ sarvāśca taddināt ।
ityevaṃ rādhike sabhāṃ samāpya bhagavāँstataḥ ।।89।।
snānasandhyādikaṃ cakre tataśca bhojanādikam ।
sarve te mahīmānāśca bhuktavanto viśaśramuḥ ।।2.180.90 ।।
rājā kuṭumbasahitaṃ siṣeve nidritaṃ harim ।
prātarbubodha ninadairvādyānāṃ śrīharistataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
kṛtvā nityavidhiṃ siṃhāsane cāgatya saṃsthitaḥ ।
tāvad rājādayaḥ sarve tvāyan pūjayituṃ harim ।।92।।
bahupadā arpitāśca rājñā tīrāṇakena vai ।
tasya rājñyastathā kanyāḥ samājagmuḥ kareṣu tu ।।93 ।।
dhṛtvā pūjanapātrāṇi pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
rādhike! kanyakāḥ ṣaṭ ca jagṛhuḥ śrīhareḥ karam ।।94।।
kumāradānamāsādya kṛtakṛtyāstadā'bhavan ।
atha viśrāntimāsādya kṛtvā vai bhojanādikam ।।95।।
alvīnaranareśena prārthito gantumutsukaḥ ।
girīśarṣivanditaśca sajjo'bhavaddharistadā ।।96।।
tadā vādyānyavādyantā'gāyanta gītikāstathā ।
jayaśabdān praśṛṇvānaḥ prāpya satkaraṇādikam ।।97।।
harirnaijaṃ vimānaṃ cādhyāruroha tathā pare ।
āruruhurvyomamārge vimānānyabhavaँstadā ।।98।।
māṃgalikaninādaiśca yantraśabdādibhistathā ।
vardhitaścāśiṣā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastathā pare ।।99।।
pratasthire'tivegena vimānaiḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
girīśākhyāṃ bhuvaṃ prāpyā'bdhiyutaṃ rāṣṭramuttamam ।। 2.180.1 00।।
prasanno'bhūddhariḥ śṛṇvan jayaśabdān vilokayan ।
alvīnaraḥ puro gatvā svāgatārthamupasthitaḥ ।। 101 ।।
eti harirmahārāja iti prajāḥ samutsukāḥ ।
draṣṭuṃ svāgatamādhātuṃ sajjāścāsan bhuvastale ।। 1 02।।
vilokayantyaścākāśaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ ।
rādhike'kṣatapuṣpādidhṛtahastāḥ striyo narāḥ ।। 10 3।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne tīrāṇanṛparājyaṃ gatvā tīrāṇānagaryāṃ sasainyasvāgatarūpeṇa bhramitvā bhojanādi kṛtvā sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ vighasāśitvadharmopadeśena nirbandhanatāmuktvā rātrau viśramya prātaḥ pūjāṃ pragṛhya bhuktvā sajjo bhūtvā harirdvitīyāyām alvīnararājyamājagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'śītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 180 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 180 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 181
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 182 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike gopi! saśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
bhādrakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāmalvīnarabhuvaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
girīśamuninā''diṣṭasthale nijavimānakam ।
paśyan prajāḥ pratīkṣantīrvyomno'vātārayanmudā ।। 2 ।।
vimānāni tadā'nyāni cāvaterustato'mbarāt ।
arthaśrīrājadhanyāḥ sannidhāvudyānabhūstare ।। 3 ।।
girīśarṣistathā rājā'lvīnaraḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
cakāra svāgataṃ vādyaiḥ pūjanairhāracandanaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
vimānāt klṛptasopānaniḥśreṇyā bahiraṃgaṇe ।
niḥsarantaṃ hariṃ svarṇahārān kaṇṭhenyadhurjanāḥ ।। 5 ।।
jayaśabdā vetradhārayaśaḥśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ cāraṇānāṃ yaśośritam ।। 6 ।।
ślokaśravaṇamutkṛṣṭaṃ vāṇījanyaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
puṣpākṣataiśca lājābhiḥ svarṇamudrādibhistathā ।। 7 ।।
godhūmaiḥ pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇasyā'kurvan janatāstadā ।
rājasaudhe hariṃ nītvā rājā sahakuṭumbakam ।। 8 ।।
jalapānādi tāmbūlaṃ dadau neme ca pādayoḥ ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre rājā sutasutādiyuk ।। 9 ।।
caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca pracakre sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
dugdhapānaṃ dadau tatra sarvebhyaśca tataḥ param ।। 2.181.1 0।।
śīghraṃ sainyena sahito nagaryāṃ bhramaṇārthakam ।
yānaṃ sāśvaṃ suvarṇotthamānināya hareḥ kṛte ।। 11 ।।
vyarājad bhagavāँstatra pitṛbhyāṃ sahito mudā ।
bhrātaraścānyamunayo brahmapriyādayastadā ।। 12।।
yāneṣu śibikāyāṃ ca ratheṣu hastiyantrake ।
niṣeduśca tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaiḥ saha ।। 13 ।।
vāhinī sarvaśobhāḍhyā prayayau nagaraṃ prati ।
arthaśryākhyanagaryāṃ sā rājamārgagatā'bhavat ।। 14।।
amātyai rājapuruṣaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ prajayā tathā ।
vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ sākṣād dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ prabhurmuhuḥ ।। 15।।
vanditaścopadābhiśca suprasādita ityatha ।
sarvāṃ nagarīṃ parito bhramitvā bhagavān punaḥ ।। 16।।
udyāne rājasaudhe ca samāgatya nijāsane ।
viśrāntimāpa ca sasnāvanye'pi śrāntimāgatāḥ ।। 17।।
viśaśramuḥ svabhavane tataśca bubhujuḥ sukham ।
pakvānnāni hyanekāni bubhujuḥ paramādarāt ।। 18।।
tadā''ścaryamabhūd rādhe! śṛṇu tatkathayāmi te ।
krītadvipasya vāstavyo hyartheṣṭo rākṣaso mahān ।। 19।।
āgato vai parīkṣārthaṃ laukituṃ tu harerbalam ।
prathamaṃ tena miṣṭānne miṣṭānnasadṛśīḥ śilāḥ ।।2.181.20 ।।
ghṛtāktā bhojane dattā pariveṣakarūpiṇā ।
jñātavāँstaddhariḥ śīghraṃ śilāḥ sarvā harīcchayā ।।21 ।।
miṣṭānnatāmavāpurvai hitvā tāḥ śailatāṃ tadā ।
sa tvāścaryaṃ gatastatra tataścakre parīkṣaṇam ।। 22।।
aparaṃ tacchṛṇu rādhe śayyārūpo babhūva ha ।
upari mañcake ramyaṃ gendukaṃ sa pradarśya vai ।।23 ।।
guptaṃ cādhaḥ śūlaśayyāmakarot śrīhareḥ kṛte ।
haristāṃ śūlaśayyāṃ cā'dhyāruroha kṛtādaraḥ ।।24।।
śūlāḥ suvarṇapuṣpāṇi kaisarāṇyabhavaँstadā ।
tatrā'pyāścaryamāpyaiva nirgato rākṣasastataḥ ।।25।।
upānahau viṣeṇāpi yojite kṛtavāँstadā ।
parīkṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sa cakre'tha bhagavānapi ।।26 ।।
upānahau paridhāyā'mṛtarūpe vidhāya vai ।
acalat sukhatastatra saudhe ca paritaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 27।।
athāpi ca caturthī sa parīkṣāṃ rākṣaso'karot ।
sabhāyāmāsanaṃ divyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ cāgnimāvyadhāt ।।28।।
haristatra sabhāyāṃ ca gatvā''sanaṃ tadāgnikam ।
spṛṣṭvā ca śītalaṃ cakre sauvarṇaṃ punareva tat ।।29।।
tadāścaryaṃ paraṃ prāpto rākṣaso mānavarjitaḥ ।
mokṣaṃ svasya nijaṃ gehamāyātuṃ kṛṣṇamārthayat ।।2.181.3 0 ।।
haristathāstvitiprāha rākṣasaṃ mūrdhni vai tadā ।
dadau svacaraṇau yāvat tāvad devo babhūva ha ।।3 1 ।।
tuṣito nāma divyaḥ saḥ svargavāsakaraḥ sadā ।
pṛṣṭo janaistadā so'pi vṛttāntamāha cātmanaḥ ।।32।।
tuṣito nāma devo'haṃ pṛthvyāmatra yadṛcchayā ।
bhramituṃ tvāgatastvatra mayā dṛṣṭā'tra sundarī ।।33 ।।
artheṣṭā nāmataścātra purā samudrasannidhau ।
pradharṣitā mayā sā cā'kasmācchāpaṃ dadau ca me ।। 34।।
rākṣaso bhava duśceṣṭa kanyādharṣaṇatatpara ।
ahaṃ drāgeva tu jāto rākṣasaḥ krītabhūmigaḥ ।।35।।
tava sparśena bhagavannadyā'haṃ śāpavarjitaḥ ।
jāto devaḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho ।।36 ।।
ājñā cedahametasyāt sthalād yāsye nijaṃ gṛham ।
hariḥ prāha prayāhi tvaṃ kurūnuttaradiksthitān ।।37।।
lālāyano mayā pūrvaṃ saccidānandabhāvanaḥ ।
preṣito'sti mārgayitvā sūcanāṃ me pradehi tam ।।38।।
gṛhāṇa mantrā deva tvaṃ mamājñayā prayāhi ca ।
ityuktvā sampradāyā'smai mantrān apreṣayat suram ।।39।।
vyomnā cottarakenāṭān deśān sūcayituṃ munim ।
hariḥ svayaṃ samāyātaḥ ketumāle tu paścime ।।2.181.40।।
māsānte'trā'pi bhagavānāgamiṣyati niścayaḥ ।
uvāca taṃ muniṃ gatvā pālipārasarastaṭe ।।41।।
sthitaṃ pūrvataṭe śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadīyute ।
jaharṣā'tīva cākarṇya nijanāthāgamaṃ muniḥ ।।42।।
svāgataṃ sa muniścakre tuṣitasya tadā bahu ।
tuṣitena samaṃ deśeṣvevottare munirdrutam ।।43।।
janebhyaścāha kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ cotsukastadā ।
dvau tu babhramatuḥ kenāṭakeṣu sarvatodiśi ।।44।।
nāmamantrān dadaturvai prajābhyaścādarāt prabhū ।
atha śrībhagavān rādhe !'lvīnarasyā''laye tataḥ ।।45।।
rātrau sabhāṃ sumahatīṃ pracakre tatra mādhavaḥ ।
sammānitaḥ pūjitaścopādideśa prajājanān ।।46।।
prajā vā rājavargo vā yatayo vā gṛhasthitāḥ ।
kurvanto yogyakarmāṇi samarpayanti cenmayi ।।47।।
bandhanaṃ na bhavet teṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca phalasya ca ।
ahaṃ phalapradasteṣāṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tatkaromi vai ।।48।।
vittāni dharmalabdhāni ye kratuṣūtsṛjanti ca ।
kṛtātmānaḥ karmiṇaste tyāgāśramiṇa eva te ।।49।।
na tyāgaṃ tyāgamityāhurabandhastyāga ucyate ।
audāsīnyaṃ parigṛhya vṛkṣavāsastu yo janaḥ ।।2.181.50 ।।
na karoti ca vā kiñcit tāmaso hi sa ucyate ।
yadīśvare bhavedvāsaḥ sa tu nairguṇyamāpnuyāt ।।51 ।।
kurvan karmāṇi sarvāṇi sukhecchayā muhurmuhuḥ ।
na devaṃ saṃsmaret tatra rājasāni tu tāni vai ।।52।।
sukhārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ tyāgo rājasaḥ sa mato bhavet ।
kurvan karmāṇi sarvāṇi mayi kṛṣṇe parātpare ।।53।।
yaścārpayati sarvasvaṃ sukhecchayā phalecchayā ।
sāttvikaṃ tad bhavet karma tyāgo'pi sāttvikaḥ sa tu ।।54।।
phalecchāvarjitaṃ kṛtvā mayi nyasyati yo janaḥ ।
tadbhavennirguṇaṃ sarvaṃ matsambaddhaṃ madarthakam ।।55।।
yathāguṇaṃ ca yatkarma tathā gṛhī nibadhyate ।
aguṇaṃ ced bhavet karma mucyate na tu badhyate ।।56।।
ekataścāśramāścānye gṛhasthāśrama ekataḥ ।
gṛhadharmī kṛṣṇadharmī bhavet sa nirguṇāśramī ।।57।।
mayi tyaktaṃ sarvakarma madātmakaphalaṃ dadet ।
śamo damastathā dhairyaṃ satya śaucaṃ tathā''rjavam ।।58।।
yajño dhṛtiśca dharmaśca nā'sya pārthakyamāpnuyuḥ ।
abhimānakṛtaṃ karma mama smṛtivivarjitam ।।59।।
yamadvārā mṛtyupāśaṃ kaṇṭhe kārayati drutam ।
tasmānmānaṃ vihāyaiva kurvantu karma matparam ।।2.181.60।।
gārhasthye'pi tu mokṣārthaṃ kariṣyāmi mayi dhṛtam ।
asṛjaddhi prajāḥ sarvāḥ brahmā mamā''jñayā purā ।।61 ।।
karmapravāharakṣārthaṃ mama pūjārthamityapi ।
virudhaścāpi vṛkṣāँśca yajñārthaṃ ca tathauṣadhīḥ ।।62।।
rasān phalāni patrāṇi yajñārthāni havīṃṣi ca ।
gārhasthyaṃ patnikāyuktaṃ yajñaṃ kartuṃ sadā matam ।।63।।
yugalaṃ devadevīnāṃ pūjārthaṃ vai praśasyate ।
tatsaṃprāpya gṛhasthā ye dhanadhānyarasānvitāḥ ।।64।।
na yajante yadi devān kilbiṣaṃ bhuñjate tu te ।
jñānayajñā viduṣāṃ ca satāmārādhanā makhāḥ ।।65।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ svādhyāyayajñā dravyayajñāstu bhūbhṛtām ।
annayajñāḥ kṛṣīśānāṃ dhyānayajñāstu yoginām ।।66।।
sevāyajñāḥ sevakānāṃ strīṇāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kratuḥ ।
putrāṇāṃ pitṛvākyāni brahma vai brahmacāriṇām ।।67।।
gṛhasthānāṃ dānayajñāstāpasānāṃ tapomayāḥ ।
evaṃ yajñāśca vividhā bhavanti yogyatāvaśāḥ ।।68।।
sarveṣāntu harerbhaktiyajñāḥ santi vibandhanāḥ ।
tasmāt kāryā yathāyogyaṃ yajñā māṃ vīkṣya tadgatam ।।69।।
dāsye muktiṃ na sandehastuṣṭo bhūtvā samarpaṇaiḥ ।
rājabhiḥ khalu dātavyā aśvā gajā gavādayaḥ ।।2.181.70 ।।
dāsā dāsyo'laṃkṛtāśca grāmā janapadāstathā ।
vāṭikāśca gṛhakṣetrodyānāni vividhāni ca ।।71 ।।
tatphalaṃ śāśvataṃ proktaṃ rājñāṃ tattu viśeṣataḥ ।
adātāro'śaraṇyāśca nṛpāḥ kilbiṣabhāginaḥ ।।72।।
doṣāṇāmeva bhoktāro na sukhānāṃ kadācana ।
aniṣṭvā tu mahāyajñairakṛtvā tarpaṇādikam ।।73।।
tīrtheṣvanabhisaṃplutyā'nārādhya parameśvaram ।
yadi prayāti panthānaṃ punarāvartate sa vai ।।74।।
chinnābhramiva vā gantā layaṃ yāti vinaśyati ।
dvyakṣaraṃ tu bhavenmṛtyustryakṣaraṃ brahma cā'mṛtam ।।75।।
mameti mṛtyurevāsti namameti sadā'mṛtam ।
taddvayaṃ sarvadā cāste nije mūrdhni ca vā hṛdi ।।76।।
tatra cāghaṃ parityajya paraṃ prāpyaṃ tu dehibhiḥ ।
mārgo'yaṃ sevitaḥ sadbhirbhavadbhiḥ sevyatāṃ sadā ।।77।।
labdhvā rājyaṃ sukuṭumbaṃ dhanāni sampadastathā ।
yajate na prabhuṃ yajñe niṣphalaṃ tasya tat khalu ।।78।।
