anārādhitadevasya svārthamātraṃ prajīvataḥ ।
dravyādau mamabhāvasya mṛtyuḥ śikhāṃ na muñcati ।।79।।
bāhyābhyantaravartī yo bhūtānāṃ nityasākṣikaḥ ।
yairihārādhito dravyaistān mṛtyuḥ pravimuñcati ।।2.181.80।।
api smṛddhaṃ bhogapūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ tṛṣṇayā sthitam ।
klībaṃ tanmānasaṃ proktaṃ brahmarājyaṃ na vindati ।।81 ।।
na klībo brahmavasudhāṃ bhuṃkte bhaktidhanaṃ na ca ।
na tu klībālaye devārcanamāṃgalyamasti hi ।।82।।
tasmānna klībatā kāryā pareśārādhane kvacit ।
vṛddhaiḥ sadā hariḥ sevyastānanye'nusaranti hi ।।83।।
vṛddhonmādādāśritāśca syuḥ sadonmādino yataḥ ।
tasmādunmattatā tyājyā māyārāgādisaṃbhavā ।।84।।
bhajanīyaḥ sadā kṛṣṇo'nādinārāyaṇaprabhuḥ ।
yajñaḥ kṛto yathā tadvat kartavyaḥ sarvadā gṛhe ।।85।।
brahmayajñaḥ sadā kāryo mokṣaṃ dāsye na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityuktvā pradadau mantrān prajābhyaśca tadā prabhuḥ ।।86।।
rādhike'tha sabhāyāstu parihāro'bhavattataḥ ।
rātrau viśramya bhagavān prātaḥ kṛtavidhistataḥ ।।87।।
gantumiyeṣa vai śīghraṃ jinavarddhinṛpārthitaḥ ।
iṣṭalavarṣiṇā cāpyarthita iṣṭālirāṣṭrakam ।।88।।
rājā pūjāṃ bhojanādi cānayat sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
alvīnarastataḥ kṛṣṇo jagrāha tasya ceṣṭakṛt ।।89।।
anye'pi jagṛhuḥ sarve hareḥ sārthāstataḥ param ।
rājñī tasya pañcakanyāsahitāścārcayaddharim ।।2.181.90।।
pañcāpi kanyakāstatra jagṛhuḥ śrīhareḥ karam ।
vivāhavidhinā kṛṣṇo dadau tābhyaḥ karaṃ nijam ।।9 1 ।।
pūjāṃ cāśīrvacaḥ prāpya gantuṃ sajjo'bhavaddhariḥ ।
pañcakanyā brahmapriyādibhiḥ saha sutatparāḥ ।।92।।
yayuḥ śrīhariṇā sārdhaṃ vimāne samupāviśan ।
vidāyaṃ prāpya bhagavān yānamadhyāruroha ca ।।93।।
anye'pi ca tadā sarve'rohan vimānakāni vai ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।।94।।
prajāḥ sarvā harekṛṣṇa harenārāyaṇaprabho ।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ cakrurvimānāni tadāmbare ।।95।।
iṣṭalavaproktadiśāṃ gatiṃ cakrurjalopari ।
vārdhikhāḍīṃ vyatyakrāman prāpuḥ rāmapurīṃ tataḥ ।।96।।
paścime khāḍikātīre jinavarddhinṛpaḥ purā ।
avā'tarad vimānād svāt svāgatārthaṃ kuṭumbavān ।।97।।
iṣṭalavo maharṣiśca prajāḥ sarvāstadā taṭe ।
udyānasannidhau cāsan svāgatārthaṃ prabhorhareḥ ।।98।।
aśrūyanta vilokyaiva vimānāni jayānvitāḥ ।
prajānādāstūpanādāḥ saṃkīrtanaravāstathā ।।99।।
ityevaṃ rādhike sarvaṃ rāṣṭraṃ svāgatatatparam ।
tatrā'bhūt saṃhitaṃ pṛthvī janavārdhisamā'bhavat ।। 2.181.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne harirbhādrapadakṛṣṇadvitīyāyām alvīnararājyaṃ gatvā'rthaśrīnagarīṃ bhramitvā bhuktvā rākṣasamuktiṃ kṛtvā taṃ tuṣitadevam uttarān kurūn sampreṣayitvā sabhāyāmupadiśya pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya viśramya prātarbhojanottaraṃ jinavarddhinṛparājadhānīṃ pratipratasthe cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 181 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 181 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 182
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 183 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
iṣṭalavarṣyupādiṣṭasthale nijavimānakam ।। 1 ।।
avātārayadudyāne viśāle bhūtale śubhe ।
trivarāyāścāpagāyāstaṭasthe sudrumākule ।। 1 ।।
rāmapuryā nagaryāstu nikaṭe vādyanādite ।
jinavarddhinṛpo'mātyaiḥ kumārairbāndhavaiḥ saha ।। 3 ।।
prajābhiśca harestatra susvāgataṃ cakāra ha ।
puṣpahārān hīrakāḍhyasvarṇahārān gale dadau ।। 4 ।।
bahiścāvatarantaṃ śrīhariṃ vimānakāt prajāḥ ।
sarvāścandanalājābhiścākṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
jayaśabdairharṣanādairnamanairarhṛṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ।
pitarau bāndhavān sarvān bhaginīṃ ca gurūnṛṣīn ।। 6 ।।
brahmapriyāśca sarve te pupūjurhāracandanaiḥ ।
atha sainyasahāye ca gajayāne suvarṇaje ।। 7 ।।
harimārohayāmāsa rājā tu jinavardhakaḥ ।
mahīmānān samastāँścārohayāmāsa bhūriṣu ।। 8 ।।
vāhaneṣu vimāneṣu gantrīṣu śakaṭīṣvapi ।
vādyakīrtanasaṃhrādotsavaiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 9 ।।
rāmapuryāṃ nagaryāṃ sambhrāmayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।
rājamārgeṣu sarvatra prajābhiḥ pūjito hariḥ ।। 2.182.1 0।।
phalapuṣpākṣataraupyasvarṇamudrāmbarādibhiḥ ।
evaṃ vai darśanaṃ datvā rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau ।। 11 ।।
vardhito janatābhiśca śuśubhe parameśvaraḥ ।
ānandapūrṇahṛdayaḥ sāyaṃ sabhāmakārayat ।। 12।।
lakṣāvadhimanuṣyāṇāṃ priyakāryārthahetave ।
jalapānaṃ hariḥ kṛtvopādideśa prajāstadā ।। 13 ।।
divye siṃhāsane tatrāsīnaḥ prasannabhāvanaḥ ।
bhagavatkāryakartāro bhagavaccaraṇāśrayāḥ ।। 14।।
bhagavaddhyānasampannāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।
satāṃ sevāprakartāraḥ satāṃ vā caraṇāśrayāḥ ।। 15।।
satāṃ mārge pragantāraḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।
smṛddhayo bhūmikājanyāścānte bhūmau viśanti hi ।। 16 ।।
tā yadi syuḥ satāmarthe haryarthe mokṣadāśca tāḥ ।
pṛthvī dadāti cānnāni meghā apo dadatyapi ।। 17।।
vahniḥ pākaṃ karotyeva vāyuḥ karoti rūkṣatām ।
saṃvidhāyaiva te sarve śayyābhogyadhanāni ca ।। 18।।
mānavārthe dadatyeva mānavairarpyamīśvare ।
vinā'rpaṇaṃ pareśe tu sampado vipado nanu ।। 19।।
nārakiṇyo bhavantyevānte'pi nirayasampradāḥ ।
tasmād bhūtaistu yā dattā vibhūtayo'tigauravāt ।।2.182.20।।
arpaṇīyā harau sarvāstāstadā mokṣadāḥ khalu ।
samudro'pi kṛtastena pṛthivī tena nirmitā ।।21 ।।
sasyāni tena devena kṛtāni kaṇadāni tu ।
dehastena kṛtaścāpi bījaṃ tena vinirmitam ।।22।।
sajātīyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena bhogyaṃ dattaṃ samānakam ।
yena dattamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai deyaṃ parātmane ।।23।।
sa eva bhagavānatra bhūtale lokahetave ।
dehināṃ śreyase cāste dṛggocaraḥ sukhapradaḥ ।।24।।
sevanīyastoṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnenā'vagatya ca ।
evaṃ jñātvā mama sevāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ।।25 ।।
tānahaṃ tūddhariṣye vai janmasaṃsāravāridheḥ ।
ahaṃ daṇḍapradātā'smi daṇḍo mayā vinirmitaḥ ।।26।।
yadāśrayaṃ vinā daṇḍapātrāṇi dehinaḥ khalu ।
daṇḍadātāramevātra māmāśrayantu sarvathā ।।27।।
rājasu yo mayā kṣipto daṇḍo vaśyaḥ sa me sadā ।
yame cāpi mayā nyasto daṇḍo vikarmiśāsakaḥ ।।28।।
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā dharmadaṇḍaḥ prarakṣati ।
daṇḍo jāgarti supteṣu dharmārthakāmamokṣakṛt ।।29।।
dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ striyaḥ putrā bhṛtyāḥ putryaśca vāṭikāḥ ।
dharmo nyāyaśca maryādā rakṣyante daṇḍabhītitaḥ ।।2.182.3 0।।
mātṛdaṇḍabhayādbālā kalahaṃ na prakurvate ।
rājadaṇḍabhayādeke pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate ।।3 1 ।।
devadaṇḍabhayād duṣṭā anyāyaṃ nāśrayanti hi ।
yamadaṇḍabhayāścāpi paralokabhayādapi ।।32।।
parasparabhayāścāpi niyamyante prajā iha ।
evaṃ sāṃsiddhiko loko bhayāddharme vyavasthitaḥ ।।3 3।।
daṇḍasyaiva bhayātsarve na khādanti parasparam ।
rājadaṇḍo dharmadaṇḍo yamadaṇḍastathā'paraḥ ।।34।।
devadaṇḍaḥ pradhānāste rakṣanti vividhāḥ prajāḥ ।
adaṇḍikāḥ prajāścetsyurnimajjeyurmahāndhasi ।।35।।
adāntānapyaśiṣṭāँśca damayatyeva daṇḍakaḥ ।
ājñādaṇḍo mamā'styeva mamājñā vaidikī hi sā ।।36 ।।
tāmanutsṛjya gantāro yānti daṇḍasya pāratām ।
netā'haṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ śāsako rakṣakastathā ।।37।।
rājasvāviśya tiṣṭhāmi vartayāmi ca śāsane ।
prajāḥ sarvāstathā sarvān nṛpān niyamarūpavān ।। 38।।
yatra daṇḍo mama yāti carate sūdyataḥ sadā ।
prajāstatra na muhyanti neyuḥ sanmārgabhraṃśatām ।। 3 9।।
manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣavanto'pi kīṭamakṣikāḥ ।
daṇḍasyaiva bhayādete yathārthe vartmani sthitāḥ ।।2.182.40।।
nā'bhīto yajate kaścinnā'bhīto dātumicchati ।
nā'bhītaśca janaḥ kaścit samaye sthātumicchati ।।41 ।।
rudraḥ skando mahendraśca vahniśca varuṇo yamaḥ ।
kālo vāyuḥ kuberaśca ravirmṛtyuḥ śanistathā ।।42।।
vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāśca rākṣasāḥ ।
ete'pi bhayamāpannā daṇḍasya niyame sthitāḥ ।।43 ।।
etān prajāstathā bhītāḥ praṇamanti muhurmuhuḥ ।
bhayaṃ na ced bhavelloke vinaśyeyuḥ parasparam ।।44।।
daṇḍasyaiva bhayādbhīto dharme sarvaḥ pravartate ।
cāturvarṇyapramodāya sunītirakṣaṇāya ca ।।45।।
daṇḍabhītistu vihitā dharmārthau rakṣituṃ sadā ।
tābhyāṃ mokṣo bhavet paścād yo'sti manmūrtimāśritaḥ ।।46।।
yadi dharmānna bibhiyuḥ śvāpadādyā vijātayaḥ ।
adyurjñātiṃ nijāṃ siṃhādayaḥ krūrā vanaśritāḥ ।।47।।
manuṣyāścāpi saṃbhūya cādyuḥ prasahya vai mithaḥ ।
viśvak lopaḥ pravarteta bhidyerannītisetavaḥ ।।48।।
careyurnāśramaṃ karma kanyā nodvahanaṃ laṣet ।
yuvatī nāśrayet kāntaṃ preṣyā tvājñāṃ na codvahet ।।49।।
narastiṣṭhenna niyame śīle dharmabhayaṃ vinā ।
dharme svargo manuṣyāṇāṃ lokaścāyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।।2.182.50।।
dharmo bhaktyāśca sahito nirguṇatvāya kalpate ।
nātyantaṃ guṇavat kiñcinna cā'pyatyantanirguṇam ।।51 ।।
ubhayaṃ sarvalokeṣu dṛśyate sādhvasādhu vā ।
sādhu vicārya kartavyaṃ tyaktavyaṃ yanna sādhu tat ।।52।।
satāṃ samāgamaḥ sādhuḥ śrīharerme sadāśrayaḥ ।
sarvārpaṇavidhānena kartavyo me samāgamaḥ ।।53 ।।
avadhye śāsake kṛṣṇe mayi nyastā hi ye janāḥ ।
na te vai kālamāyāderbhayena syuḥ prapīḍitāḥ ।।54।।
tasmād bhāgavataṃ dharmaṃ pālayantu prajājanāḥ ।
mamā''jñā daṇḍarūpā'sti sukhadā bhayavarjitā ।।55।।
nirbhayāḥ santu sarve'tra mānavā iṣṭalīsthitāḥ ।
svasti vo'stu jinavarddhe iṣṭalavāśrayasthite ।।56 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
tato nīrājanaṃ cakruḥ pūjanaṃ śrīharestadā ।।57।।
pitrośca bāndhavānāṃ ca rājādyāḥ susamutsukāḥ ।
rājñyādyāḥ pūjanaṃ cakrurbrahmapriyādiyoṣitām ।। 58।।
upadāśca nyadhuḥ sarvāḥ svarṇarūpyakahīrakān ।
ābhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi maṇīn pātrāṇi mauktikān ।।59।।
ratnāni copakaraṇānyadhurvividhakāni ca ।
mantrāँśca jagṛhuḥ sarve narā nāryo'vaśeṣitāḥ ।।2.182.60।।
tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ sabhāyāḥ śrīharistataḥ ।
bubhuje dugdhapurikādikaṃ cānyepi sarvaśaḥ ।।6 1।।
mahīmānā bubhujuśca prasādaṃ jagṛhuḥ prajāḥ ।
rājādyāśca tato naijaṃ sthānaṃ yayustato hariḥ ।।62।।
nidrāṃ jagrāha rātrau ca prātarutthāya vai hṛdi ।
dhyātvā rūpaṃ paraṃ naijaṃ śuśrāva maṃgalasvanān ।।63।।
nityavidhiṃ vidhāyaiva yāvatsvastho'bhavattadā ।
rājā pakvānnapātrāṇi dugdhādīnyānināya ha ।।64।।
ārpayaddharaye praghūṇikebhyaste'danaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
atha madhyāhnakāle ca bhuktvā viśrāntimāyayuḥ ।।65।।
hariṃ tu bhuktavantaṃ vai rājñī kanyāśca sapta vai ।
sevituṃ tvāgatāḥ puṣpahārādyarpaṇamācaran ।।66 ।।
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi dhārayāmāsurīśvaram ।
ābhūṣayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ surūpiṇam ।।67।।
kare ca jagṛhuḥ kanyāḥ sapta vivāhakarmaṇā ।
kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuśca prāpya śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।।68।।।
brahmapriyāsu militā vaiṣṇavyaḥ sukhapūritāḥ ।
atha rādhe tadā sarve pupūjuryugalāni vai ।।69।।
tataścaikaṃ mahāścaryamabhūcchṛṇu vadāmi te ।
kaścid dīnajano'nātha ivā''yāto hareḥ puraḥ ।।2.182.70।।
ākrośannāha bhagavan mama bālaṃ kumārakam ।
putrīṃ caikāṃ jahārātra rākṣasaḥ kaścideva ha ।।7 1 ।।
prajāputrān prajāputrīrharanti rākṣasāḥ pare ।
mārayanti janāँścāpi pṛṣṭhe gacchanti tānapi ।।72।।
dhṛtvā haranti cādrau tān vṛddhān yūno'pi rākṣasāḥ ।
tasmād rakṣa mahārāja nārāyaṇa pareśvara ।।73 ।।
parvatīyaprajāḥ sarvāḥ kṛpānātha kṛpāṃ kuru ।
ityuktaḥ śrīharistūrṇaṃ rādhe sajjo babhūva ha ।।74।।
dhṛtvā sudarśanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ cāṃgulyāṃ cormikāsamam ।
gūḍhatejo'nvita śīghraṃ gantuṃ ceyeṣa tatsthalam ।।75।।
tāvad rājā jinavarddhiścāpi śastrasamanvitaḥ ।
sajjo'bhavacca hariṇā sārdhaṃ dīnā'vanodyataḥ ।।76 ।।
tāvattatra samāyāto rājā nāmnā'lpaketukaḥ ।
ālpaparvatarājyeśaḥ prāha natvā hariṃ tadā ।।77।।
mama rājyaṃ pāvanaṃ tvaṃ kuru śrīparameśvara ।
āpyāyano maharṣiśca tathaivā''rthayadīśvaram ।।78।।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha jagādodantakaṃ tathā ।
rākṣasasya krūrakarmā'nāthasya parirakṣaṇam ।।79।।
alpaketuśca tacchrutvā śastrasajjo vimānake ।
niṣasāda vimāne'pi hantuṃ rākṣasapuṃgavam ।।2.182.8 0।।
vimānaiśca tadā sarvasainyānyapi ca satvaram ।
śastrāstrayantrayuktāni yuddhārthaṃ cāmbare'bhavan ।।8 1 ।।
rājñā rājñyādibhiścāpi prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
alpaketorgṛhaṃ yāsyan haniṣyatīti rākṣasam ।।82।।
vijñāya ca śrīharaye dattānyupāyanānyapi ।
gṛhītvā suvidāyaṃ sarvebhyo datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ।।83।।
vidāyatūryaninadān yuddhabherīpragarjanāḥ ।
śrutvā dhṛtvā puṣpahārān yānamadhyāruroha ca ।।84।।
anye prāghūṇikavargāḥ sārthāḥ sarve harestadā ।
vimānāni samāruhya jayaśabdān pracakrire ।।85।।
anātho'pi janaḥ kṛṣṇavimāne darśako'bhavat ।
tannidarśitamārgeṇa yānāni gatimācaran ।।86।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa śailaṃ tam apināyaṃ prapedire ।
pūrvavārdhikhāḍikāyāḥ paścime cāyatādrikam ।।87।।
durgamaṃ kaṇṭakāraṇyaiḥ pāṣāṇairgaṇḍaśailakaiḥ ।
hiṃsraprāṇinivāsaiśca rākṣasaiśca viśeṣataḥ ।।88।।
jvālamālāvṛtaśailarasavighnairviśeṣataḥ ।
ākāśātparvate'dhityakāyāṃ tu gahvaraṃ mahat ।।89।।
yanmukhe rākṣasā āsan vṛkṣo'dhaḥkṛtaketanāḥ ।
bhayaṃkarā vivastrāśca paśumāṃsāśanā api ।।2.182.90।।
naramāṃsādanāścāpi digambarā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
asthiśastrānvitā mantrajālaśastravidastathā ।।91 ।।
vimānastho'nāthabhakto darśayāmāsa tāṃ diśām ।
harirvilokya bubudhe rākṣasānāṃ tadālayam ।।92।।
naranāṭyadharaḥ kṛṣṇo vetti sarvaṃ tathāpi vai ।
tadā prāha mahāyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।।93 ।।
ime tu rākṣasā ghorā vinā rudraṃ tu śaṃkaram ।
aśakyā hantumevātretyuktveśānamuvāca ha ।।94।।
rudra rudra mahābāho mama bāho sureśvara ।
yodhanārthaṃ prarakṣārthaṃ mayā tvamatra vai sadā ।।95।।
mama pārśve rakṣito'si kāryaṃ te samupasthitam ।
dhārayograṃ mahadrūpaṃ saṃharaitān mahāsurān ।।96।।
mārayaitānīśasaṃjñeśānadevo'rthavān bhava ।
ityevaṃ svavimānasthaṃ kṣetrapāleśvaraṃ haram ।।97।।
mahārudraṃ mahārājaḥ proktvā yuddhārthamairayat ।
tāvad rudro maheśānastyaktvā śāntaṃ tu bhāvanam ।।98।।
vikarālaṃ svarūpaṃ sandadhāra śailasadṛśam ।
ākāśe tu vimānāni hariṇā cakrasadṛśam ।।99।।
vyūhaṃ prakārayitvaiva sthirīkṛtāni sarvathā ।
jinavarddhimahārājastathā'lpaketubhūpatiḥ ।। 2.182.1 00।।
ājñāṃ cakraturvādyānāṃ yuddhāvedananardane ।
yuddhavādyānyavādyanta śūrā raktadṛśo'bhavana ।। 101 ।।
śaṃkhā bheryo bigulāni tadā'vādyanta sarvaśaḥ ।
jayaśabdāśca vīrāṇāṃ yuddhārthamabhavaँstadā ।। 1 02।।
rākṣasā daśasāhasrā mārīśāyāṃ tadā'bhavan ।
te ca śarve viditvaivākasmād yuddhaninādakān ।। 103 ।।
sajjā bhūtvā niryayuśca mārīśānagarīmukhāt ।
ākāśamārgagā sarve gahvaraṃ prāpya vismitāḥ ।। 1 04।।
naṣṭabhānā iva cāsan mahāyuddhajayārthinaḥ ।
rādhike tu tadā rudragomukhaṃ vyanadad bahu ।। 105 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jinavardhinṛparājye rāmapurīṃ pāvanīkṛtyopadiśya bhuktvā viśramya pūjāṃ prāpya janahārirākṣasavināśārthaṃ savidāyam
apināyā'driṃ harirjagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 182 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 183

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrutvā raṇabherīstu rākṣasāḥ ।
kṛtvā kilakilāśabdān sakthisphoṭān bhayaṃkarān ।। 1 ।।
kampayantaśca pṛthivīṃ nādayanto diśastathā ।
aṭṭahāsān prakurvanto yuddhārthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।। 2 ।।
bhallān śūlānasīn khaḍgān mudgarān muśalāni ca ।
prastarān sarjavṛkṣāँścopalāḥ saṃgṛhya cāmbare ।। 3 ।।
yodhanārthaṃ samutpeturdhṛtaparvatavigrahāḥ ।
astraśastrānvitāḥ sarve daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 4 ।।
mārayantu khādayantu carvayantu vimānagān ।
bandhayantu mardayantu mocayantyasubhiśca tān ।। 5 ।।
chindantu karapādādi śirāṃsi pātayantu ca ।
bhakṣayantu naradehān harantu kanyakāstvimāḥ ।। 6 ।।
prajvālayantu yānāni yantrāṇi bhañjayantu ca ।
cūrṇayantu mastakāni vimānāni harantu ca ।। 7 ।।
ityevaṃ bahujalpāste rākṣasāḥ sainyasadṛśāḥ ।
ākāśe parito bhūtvā gatvordhvaṃ kṣepaṇaistadā ।। 8 ।।
pāṣāṇamāraṃ cakruśca bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ bhayaṃkarīm ।
nārācavṛṣṭiṃ golānāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakruḥ pradāhikām ।। 9 ।।
tadā hariḥ samudraṃ ca tathā candramasaṃ drutam ।
sasmāra tāvubhau mūrtimantāvāgatya nematuḥ ।। 2.183.1 0।।
hariḥ prāha jalaiścāpyamṛtaiḥ śamayataṃ tvimam ।
vahniṃ śīghraṃ golakānāṃ tau tathā cakraturmudā ।। 11 ।।
samudro varṣaṇaṃ cakre bāṣpāṇāṃ jalasaṃbhṛtām ।
candro'mṛtaṃ drutaṃ tatra varṣayāmāsa vahnihṛt ।। 12।।
atha rājā jinavarddhiścālpaketurmahābalau ।
nārācaiḥ śatasāhasrainijaghnuḥ rākṣasāँstadā ।। 1 3।।
ardhacandraistathā bhallaidvedhā chinnāḥ patanti tai ।
rākṣasā bhūtale pādakarān kṣiptvā jalaṃ jalam ।। 14।।
pralapantastyajantyeva prāṇān pārvatadurgame ।
rājasainyāni bhūsthāni tūpagolaistadā'mbare ।। 15।।
rākṣasān mārayantyeva pātayanti ca jīvataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ ghorakadanaṃ mantramālinyakārikāḥ ।। 16।।
rākṣasyo gahvarāttatra bahirāgatya satvaram ।
śatasāhasrasaṃkhyāstā utpetuścāmbare tadā ।। 17।।
mantrakṛtairmṛṣodbhūtaiḥ rākṣasaiḥ khaṅgadhāribhiḥ ।
pātayāmāsurevaitau rājānau cāmbarād bhuvi ।। 18।।
sainyāni mārayāmāsuḥ kṛtrimaiḥ rākṣasaistu tāḥ ।
mānavānāṃ tu sainyānāṃ mardanaṃ samajāyata ।। 1 9।।
hāhākāro vimāneṣu tadā'bhavat samantataḥ ।
mriyamāṇau nṛpau dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।2.183.20।।
vimānādavatīryaiva vāyuvegena bhūbhṛtau ।
dhṛtvā bhujābhyāṃ ca punarvimānaṃ svaṃ samāyayau ।।।21।।
karasparśena rājānau jīvayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
candramājñāpayāmāsā'rpayā'mṛtaṃ samantataḥ ।।22।।
mānavānāṃ tu sainyeṣu mṛtān jīvaya satvaram ।
candraścakre tathā śīghraṃ sainyāni jīvanaṃ hyaguḥ ।।23 ।।
atha kṛtrimasainyānāṃ rakṣasāṃ nāśanāya vai ।
jaṭātaḥ susamutpādya māyāṃ mṛṣādinīṃ tadā ।।24।।
īśānadevo vyasṛjat mṛṣāsainyaṃ jagāma sā ।
pratirakṣo'bhavad rākṣasīsvarūpā'tyasaṃkhyakā ।।25।।
bhakṣayāmāsa sarvāṃśca rākṣasānatha śaṃkaraḥ ।
prerayāmāsa durgā svāṃ samutpādya tu vāmataḥ ।।26।।
rākṣasīnāṃ nāśanārthaṃ natvā durgā tu śaṃkaram ।
koṭirūpadharā bhūtvā'ṣṭādaśahastaśobhanā ।।27।।
siṃhārūḍhā bahuśastrā mahābalaparākramā ।
sarvarūpaiḥ sahakāle nipapātā'mbare'bhitaḥ।।28।।
pratyekāṃ rākṣasīṃ dhṛtvā gale'nayad yamālayam ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīttadā rākṣasamaṇḍale ।।29।।
harṣanādā vimāneṣu sainyeṣu mānaveṣu ca ।
dṛṣṭvā durgākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ jaharṣa parameśvaraḥ ।।2.183.3 0 ।।
jahṛṣuḥ kanyakā brahmapriyādyā labdhalālasāḥ ।
tāvad dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāśca patnīnāṃ yamagāmitā ।।3 1 ।।
kruddhāścātīva vidhurā durgāsainyaṃ prati drutam ।
strīnāśārthaṃ cāmbarādvai durgāḥ prati pradudruvuḥ ।।32 ।।
śaṃkaraḥ svagaṇān kṣetrapālānāha dharantu vai ।
rākṣasān vyomamārgeṇa ekaikaśo gale drutam ।।3 3 ।।
kṣetrapālāstadā vyomnā dadhruḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu rakṣasām ।
prāpya prāpya gale dadhrurmārayāmāsureva tān ।।34।।
padbhyāṃ ca gadayā mudgareṇa bhallādibhistathā ।
muṣṭibhyāṃ jānumāreṇa kaphoṇikābhighātakaiḥ ।।35।।
asthibhagnaṃ mahābhāraṃ mārayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
kāँścicchastraistathā khaḍgaiḥ śūlaiḥ śaktyā ca bhallakaiḥ ।।36।।
prāṇairviyojayāmāsuḥ rakṣāṃsīśānapārṣadāḥ ।
mṛtāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi rākṣasā narayodhinaḥ ।।37।।
hṛtāśca śatasāhasryo rākṣasyo vyasavastadā ।
avaśiṣṭā vicāryaiva jīvane ko'rtha eva naḥ ।।38।।
hateṣu kulavargeṣu martavyaṃ sarvathā hyanu ।
ityevaṃ saṃvicāryaiva sannaddhāḥ sarvathā'mbare ।।39।।
māyājālāni racayāmāsustā vividhāni vai ।
mohanānyapyasaṃkhyānyaracayan māyikāni ca ।।2.183.40।।
yathā vimānasainyāni vaimānikāni cāpyapi ।
vināśaṃ prāpurevā'trā'mbare tathā vyadhurmṛṣā ।।41 ।।
rākṣasānāṃ mahān rājā māyājālaparāyaṇaḥ ।
nāmnā mārīcaśārdūlo roṣatāmrekṣaṇo daśan ।।42।।
dantān jihvāmoṣṭhakau ca māyāmantrānavāsṛjat ।
avijñāya mahārudraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satīṃ tadā ।।43 ।।
vijñāya mānavaṃ sainyaṃ balavad vā tathāvidham ।
rakṣasāṃ tvanyabhūjānāṃ māyāmantrānavāsṛjat ।।44।।
prathamaṃ pañcasāhasrān saṃrakṣya chāyayā svayā ।
tato mantrān mumocā'yaṃ śālabheyān bhayaṃkarān ।।45।।
śalabhānāṃ samudro vai tadā''kāśe'bhavannavaḥ ।
yadbhāreṇa vimānāni nimnāni tu tadā'bhavan ।।46।।
yoddhāraścāvṛtāḥ sarve śalabhairvṛṣṭisadṛśaiḥ ।
abhraiḥ śālabharūpairna vyadṛśyanta tadā mithaḥ ।।47।।
tadvināśāya rudraśca kilahā'stramavāsṛjat ।
asaṃkhyāḥ pakṣiṇo jātāḥ kilahākhyāstadā'mbare ।।48।।।
śalabhādrāḥ sarvatastān bhakṣayāmāsurambare ।
karbūrīṇāṃ samūhāśca vīkṣya rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ ।।49।।
tāsāṃ kalahajātīnāṃ vināśārthaṃ mano dadhe ।
māyayā śyenajālāni racayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ ।।।2.183.50।।
śyenāścābjābjasaṃkhyāste bhakṣayāmāsurambare ।
kilahāँśca tato bhūtvā yānatulyāḥ śarīrataḥ ।।5 1।।
vimānāni pakṣabalaistāḍayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।
kecidvimānatulyāśca kecitparvatadehinaḥ ।।52।।
anyānyasthaulyavantaste babhañjurvai samantataḥ ।
vimānāni tu bhinnāni kṣiptāni peturambarāt ।।।53।।।
evaṃ vicitre ghāte ca jāyamāne hariḥ svayam ।
vāyudevaṃ tadā cājñāpayāmāsa dhṛteḥ kṛte ।।54।।
bhagnānyapi vimānāni dhārayāmāsa vāyurāṭ ।
ambare eva tu viśvakarmā smṛto hyupāyayau ।।55।।
śilpena karmaṇā śīghraṃ bhagnabhāgānayojayat ।
yathāsaṃsthānayānāni vidhāya parameśvaram ।।56।।
cakāra suprasannaṃ ca tasthau tatraiva yodhane ।
atha rudro'nalamantraiḥ pakṣiṇo'nalasaṃjñitān ।।57।।
koṭyabjasaṃkhyakān śīghraṃ janayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ ।
analāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śyenān bhakṣayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।।58।।
rākṣasānapi cāttuṃ te dudruvuḥ rudranoditāḥ ।
rākṣasā māyayā tatra tirodhānaṃ gatāḥ kṣaṇam ।।59।।
sarjayāmāsurugrāँśca nāgān viṣolbaṇāṃstadā ।
sapakṣāँste vimānasthān gatvā''viśya daśanti hi ।।2.183.60।।
rudro gāruḍamantreṇotpādayāmāsa bhakṣakān ।
garuḍān nāgasaṃhārakartṝn koṭisahasraśaḥ ।।61 ।।
garuḍāstānanudrutya bhakṣayāmāsureva ca ।
garuḍānāṃ vināśārthaṃ rākṣaso vahnimāsṛjat ।।62।।
agniragnirmahāgniścāmbare tvālāmayo'bhavat ।
rudro netraṃ tṛtīyaṃ coddhāṭayāmāsa tatkṣaṇe ।।63।।
tatrotpannaḥ pralayāgnirmṛṣāgniṃ rākṣasotthitam ।
ākṛṣya cā''jahāraiva naije rūpe'tidāruṇam ।।64।।
śaśāmā'gnistadā śīghraṃ rākṣasā bhayamāvahan ।
gahvarasya drumādhastād guptā bāṇān śarāँstathā ।।65।।
mumucurbhallakāँścāpi yoddhavyamiti niścitāḥ ।
rudragaṇā vyomamārgāt kṣetrapālāḥ samantataḥ ।।66 ।।
cakrustadā bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ hantuṃ rākṣasapuṃgavān ।
atha te rākṣasāḥ prāptāḥ prāṇasandehatāṃ yadā ।।67।।
tadā pāṣāṇamantraiste mumucurmārgaṇān bahūn ।
śilā vyomni samutpannā gaṇḍaśailasamāstadā ।।68।।
utpatyotpatyā'narīkṣe jaghnurvimānakāni vai ।
jñātvā rudraśceṣṭitaṃ tad vajrāstraṃ pramumoca ha ।।69।।
śilāścūrṇībhūya sarvā vāyunoḍḍiḍyire diśaḥ ।
vyalīyanta tato daityā meghānugrānavāsṛjan ।।2.183.70 ।।
vāyvastreṇa tadā rudro meghān līnānakārayat ।
atha te rākṣasā bhītā mṛtaśeṣāstu vāridhim ।।7 1।।
praveṣṭuṃ dudruvustāvacchaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
gaṇān vimocayāmāsa tatpṛṣṭhe dhartumeva tān ।।72 ।।
parāvṛtya tadā daityā gaṇairyuddhaṃ vyadhuḥ punaḥ ।
tadā rudro mumocātha śūlaṃ lokabhayaṃkaram ।।73।।
bhramad vegena vahnīṃśca muñcat samantataśca tat ।
mārayāmāsa daityāṃstān mārīśeśo tiro'bhavat ।।74।।
dhṛtvā tu māyikaṃ rūpaṃ vāhneyaṃ śūlameva tat ।
mukhe samāgrasattatra sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā ।।75।।
vīkṣyā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptāḥ śaṃkarādyā gaṇāstathā ।
tadvilokya paraṃ karma rākṣasasya narāyaṇaḥ ।।76 ।।
praśaśaṃsā'surasyaitatkarma lokabhayaṃkaram ।
śaṃbhuṃ vīkṣya haristūrṇaṃ cakraṃ karānmumoca ha ।।77।।
urmikāsadṛśaṃ cakraṃ nirgataṃ cāṃguleryadā ।
śīghraṃ vahniṃ vimuñcaccā'vardhatā'tibhayaṃkaram ।।78।।
sahasrāraṃ sūryatulyaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca vegavat ।
ninādayaddiśaḥ sarvāḥ prajvālayad vanāni ca ।।79।।
parvataṃ bhasmasāt kurvat cāgrasad rākṣasān drutam ।
pṛthivī kampitā tasya vegena vāyumaṇḍalam ।।2.183.80।।
kampitaṃ ca samudrā vai stabdhāścodvelatāṃ gatāḥ ।
vimānānyambare sthairyaṃ samatāṃ tatyajuḥ kṣaṇam ।।8 1 ।।
sarvadehihṛdayāni tresurdhairyaṃ pratatyajuḥ ।
hāhākārastadā jāto mumuhurnirbalāḥ kṣaṇam ।।82।।
satvāni mūrchitānyeva kṣaṇaṃ cakre'tivegite ।
rākṣasāḥ stabdhatāṃ yātā jñātavantaḥ sudarśanam ।।।83 ।।
tāvaccakraṃ prāptameva vyadārayacchirāṃsi hi ।
hatāḥ śeṣā rākṣasā ye māriśeśo'pi nāśitaḥ ।।84।।
gaṇḍaśailā iva teṣāṃ dehāḥ petuḥ kṣitau tadā ।
atha cakraṃ gaṇarakṣākaraṃ śūlaṃ pragṛhya tu ।।85।।
nyavartata mahāghoraṃ vahnimaṇḍalasadṛśam ।
ativegaṃ samāpannaṃ śāntiṃ nā'vāpa satvaram ।।86।।
parvatāraṇyabhogeṣu śanaiḥ śanairapā'sarat ।
parvatasya bhūmikā yāḥ pradeśā bahavastadā ।।87।।
cakrāgnināṃ pradagdhāśca rasabhāvaṃ gatāstadā ।
śvetasphaṭikabhasmāḍhyāḥ kṛṣṇamaṇisamā api ।।88।।
pītāḥ svarṇasamāścāpi pradeśāstvabhavan priyāḥ ।
pāṣāṇaparvatarasā dagdhāścakrasya vahninā ।।89।।
punaḥ pāṣāṇatāṃ prāptā maṇayo vai yathā śubhāḥ ।
āsamantād rasotpannaḥ pāṣāṇā ārasāratmakāḥ ।।2.183.90 ।।
cakrasaṃgena saṃjātā marmarāḥ saṃgamarmarāḥ ।
śilpakāryā'rhadehāste pradeśā vikṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
cakre śāntaṃ hyabhūccāpi mūrtiṃ dadhāra pārṣadīm ।
śūlaṃ tu gaṇamūrtiṃ ca dadhārāpi trilocanām ।।92।।।
gaṇānāhūya ca senāṃ mānavānāṃ vanasthitām ।
dhairyaṃ ca dadatuścobhau vijayaṃ ca śaśaṃsatuḥ ।। 93।।
tāvad vijayatūryāṇi tvavādyanta samantataḥ ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiścābhavattvambarād devādibhiḥ kṛtā ।।94।।
bheryo ninādān cakruśca śaṃkhāśca bigulāni ca ।
sainye tu mānave harṣo mūrtimān praviveśa ha ।।95।।
gaṇeṣvapi tu sarveṣu vaimānikeṣu vai tathā ।
ubhayornṛpayoścāpi hṛtsvānando na vai mamau ।।96।।
jayaśabdā vimāneṣu prābhavan bahuharṣataḥ ।
atha cakraṃ tathā śūlaṃ pārṣadau dvau ca parvate ।। 97।।
yayaturgahvaradvāraṃ rakṣonivāsabhūmikām ।
vilokayāmāsatuścāntare gatvā'ndhakārite ।।98।।
prakāśaṃ svaṃ prasāryaiva tāvattatra ca gahvare ।
bhakṣitānāṃ narāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ śeṣāsthisaṃcayān ।।99।।
vilokya duḥkhamāpannau dayāparau hi pārṣadau ।
agre gatvā punastatrālokayāmāsatustadā ।। 2.183.10 0।।
kanyakāśca striyaścāpi rākṣasairyā apahṛtāḥ ।
śate dve ca sahasraṃ ca yuvatyo rurudustadā ।। 101 ।।
tāvubhau vedayāmāsurvṛttāntāni hi rakṣasām ।
pārśve ca vidyate vṛkṣasamūhe nagarī vane ।। 1 02।।
droṇyāmadṛśyarūpā tu yatra santi hyanekaśaḥ ।
apahṛtā narā nāryo bālā bālyaśca bandhane ।। 1 03।।
tāḥ sarvāstau gahvarācca bahirniṣkāsya satvaram ।
yayaturnagarī rākṣasaiḥ prāk kṛtā yathā ।। 1 04।।
tatra dṛṣṭā - nigaḍasthā bahavo yuvamūrtayaḥ ।
anye vimuktabhāvāśca prākārāntarniveśitāḥ ।। 1 05।।
narā nāryaśca bahavo bhakṣyāḥ kramāttu rakṣasām ।
pāresahasramāvīkṣya mocayāmāsatuśca tān ।। 106 ।।
atha cakraṃ sthitaṃ tatra śūlaṃ yayau hariṃ haram ।
jagāda sarvaṃ vṛttāntaṃ tadā nārāyaṇo haraḥ ।। 1 07।।
vimānaṃ satvaraṃ tyaktvā nagarīṃ yayaturdrutam ।
rudanto'pi gatā harṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ haraṃ prabhum ।। 1 08।।
prajāstāśca praṇemurbandhanamuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
hariḥ sarvāḥ prajāstatrā''śvāsayāmāsa pitṛvat ।। 10 9।।
anāthasya sutaścāpi sutā'pi ca praṇematuḥ ।
parameśaṃ haraṃ cāpi rurudatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 2.183.11 0।।
haristebhyo rādhike vai dhairyaṃ nirbhayatāṃ dadau ।
śaṃkarāya hariḥ prāha nistārārthaṃ sukhāvaham ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rākṣasānāṃ rājabhyāṃ tatsainyaiḥ saha yodhanaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ durgayā saha yodhanaṃ rudreṇa rākṣasānāṃ nāśanaṃ nigaḍasthaprajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ parvatasya sudarśanatejasā rasaśilāmayatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 183 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 183 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 184
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 185 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
rudraṃ rākṣasahantāraṃ prāha coddharaṇakṣamam ।। 1 ।।
śaṃbho'nāthasya bālāṃ ca bālaṃ pradehi mantrakam ।
anāthāya tato dehi vaiṣṇavau tasya bālakau ।। 2 ।।
śaṃbhurmantraṃ dadau śīghraṃ bālāyai bālakāya ca ।
anātho'pi manuṃ śaṃbhorjagrāha vaiṣṇavo'bhavat ।। 3 ।।
bālā sā rakṣakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ matvā yogyaṃ varaṃ tadā ।
pitrājñāṃ prāpya tatraiva kṛṣṇahastamupādade ।। 4 ।।
etadvilokya ca tadā śate dve ca sahasrakam ।
yā yuvatyo gahvarāttu mocitā rakṣitāśca tāḥ ।। 5 ।।
sarvā vijñāya kāntaṃ svaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
śuklavarṇā yathā devyastādṛśyo yogyamīśvaram ।। 6 ।।
rakṣitāraṃ harerhastaṃ vivāhahṛdayaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
jagṛhustatra ca vane svatantrāḥ puṇyanoditāḥ ।। 7 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ sarvābhya evādau manuṃ dadau tu vaiṣṇavam ।
brahmapriyāsu tāḥ sarvāḥ sthāpayāmāsa cāmbare ।। 8 ।।
kārāgāre sthitān sarvān narānnārīśca mādhavaḥ ।
dadau svacaraṇau mūrghni svatantrānapyacīkarat ।। 9 ।।
duḥkhānyapāharat kṛṣṇo'dāpayacchaṃbhunā manum ।
vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā bhejire śrīnarāyaṇam ।। 2.184.1 0।।
mārīśānāmapuryāṃ ca ruddhā yā rākṣasaiḥ prajāḥ ।
tābhyo datvā mantrakāँstu vaiṣṇavīstā haro'karot ।। 11 ।।
tāṃ suśubhāṃ nagarīṃ ca paribhramya sthale sthale ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvāṃ devo'pavitrayattadā ।। 12।।
taiḥ sarvairarthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjito hṛdayaistathā ।
sthātuṃ niśāṃ tu tatraiva punaḥ punaḥ samarthitaḥ ।। 13।।
dṛṣṭvā tadbhāvanāṃ vimānānyavātārayad drutam ।
viśāle'raṇyake mārīśāpuryāḥ sannidhau tadā ।। 14।।
niśāmukhe nivāsāँścākārayad vṛkṣavadbhuvi ।
rātrau vai bhojanaṃ sarvān kārayitvā hariḥ svayam ।। 15।।
vijayasyotsavaṃ tatra kārayāmāsa cottamam ।
gāyanairnartanairvādyaiḥ saṃkīrtanaiśca harṣaṇaiḥ ।। 16।।
nāṭakaiśca kathākhyānairniśāmagamayattadā ।
yuddhe mṛtāstu ye sarve nijapakṣīyayodhinaḥ ।। 17।।
tān sarvān śrīharistūrṇaṃ sasmāra yogavidyayā ।
sarve te jīvabhāvaṃ ca prāpya prāṇān śarīrakam ।। 18।।
svasthā bhūtvā ca tadrātrau harervāse samāyayuḥ ।
gahvare'sthīni yeṣāṃ vai mṛtānāṃ ca vane'pi ca ।। 19।।
nagaryāḥ sannidhau cāpi patitānyabhavaँstadā ।
yogaiśvaryeṇa bhagavān sasmāra tatra dehinaḥ ।। 2.184.20।।
mṛtāḥ sarve satyasaṃkalpasya kṛṣṇasya vāñcchayā ।
sajīvāścā'bhavan svasthā rātrau tatra samāyayuḥ ।।21 ।।
aneke vai narā nāryo bālā bālyaśca mānavāḥ ।
prātarnavīnarūpāḥ samadṛśyanta nivāsane ।।22।।
pārelakṣaṃ mānavān śrīhariścaivaṃ niśāntare ।
jīvayāmāsa kṛpayā tebhyaḥ śaṃbhurmanuṃ dadau ।।23।।
vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātā hareḥ pādajalaṃ papuḥ ।
bhinnadeśīyalokāste sasmarurnijabhūsthalīm ।।24।।
yayuḥ śaktā nijān deśānanye nyūṣuśca tatra vai ।
atha śrībhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ।।25।।।
jinavarddhinṛpāyedaṃ rājyaṃ samarpyameva tu ।
abhiṣekavidhinainaṃ pradehi mukuṭaṃ guro ।। 26 ।।
vidhehi tilakaṃ tasya bhāle rājā bhavediha ।
jinavarddhistadā prāha vijetre deyameva tat ।।27।।
īśānāya pradeyaṃ tadrājyaṃ śrīparameśvara ।
alpaketustathā cānye maharṣayo'pi tattathā ।।28।।
ūcustato hariḥ śaṃbhuṃ prasahya kānakāsane ।
pratiṣṭhāpyā'kṣataiḥ kuṃkumaiśca candraṃ lalāṭake ।।29।।
svayaṃ dakṣakareṇaiva cakāra mukuṭaṃ dadau ।
īśānaḥ śrīmahādevo mārīśāyā nṛpo'bhavat ।। 2.184.3 0।।
nagarīṃ pārvatībhūmerupatyakāsthale punaḥ ।
avāsayacchanaiḥ rādhe vāṭikodyānamaṇḍitām ।।3 1 ।।
īśānaḥ śaṃkaraḥ so'yaṃ dvitīyarūpadhṛk prabhuḥ ।
durgayā sahitaścāpi gaṇaiśca sahitastathā ।।32।।
haryājñayā nivāsaṃ svaṃ pracakāra prajārthitaḥ ।
iṣṭadevo'bhavat so'yamīśānaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।33 ।।
śvetagauraprajānāṃ vai rakṣasāṃ nāśakārakaḥ ।
doṣāṇāṃ nāśako devo mokṣadaḥ sukhadaḥ sadā ।।34।।
āpyāyanaṃ ca gāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha taddine ।
rājyasthitiṃ prasādhyaiva dāsye tubhyaṃ purīmimām ।।35।।
mālāṃ gṛhāṇa ca hareḥ sannidhau sajalāñjalim ।
ityevaṃ tatra saḥ prātaḥ prokto mālāmupādade ।।36 ।।
prātarharirgaṇān śaṃbhoḥ rakṣakān nyasya tatra ca ।
śaṃbhuṃ durgāṃ brahmasatīrmaharṣīn svakuṭumbakam ।।37।।
kārayitā dugdhapānaṃ pañcamyāṃ bhādrakṛṣṇake ।
upādideśa bhagavān sabhāṃ kṛtvā prajājanān ।।38।।
kālo vai rākṣasaścā'sti yathā'tra rākṣaso hyabhūt ।
māritaḥ śaṃkareṇā'sau mama bhaktena sā'nvayaḥ ।।39।।
tathā mamāśrayeṇaiva bhaktāḥ kālo'pi rākṣasaḥ ।
muktabhāvasamāpannairnāśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।2.184.40 ।।
mama bhaktiṃ prakurvantu tatheśānaṃ bhajantvapi ।
iṣṭadevaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhavantu vai ।।41 ।।
mahādevīṃ satīṃ durgāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ ca bhajantvapi ।
gataśvaḥ sūryavāro vai hyabhavat sūryadevatā ।।42।।
sarvadoṣavināśārthaṃ samārādhyā prakāśadā ।
sūryavāre mayā tvatra śaṃkarādisahāyinā ।।।43 ।।
prahatā rākṣasā ghorā bhakṣakā duḥkhadāyinaḥ ।
bhavadbhiścāpi hantavyā doṣāḥ pāpapradā ravau ।।44।।
kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve pālanīyo vṛṣo ravau ।
dvividho jāyate vyādhiḥ śārīro mānaso'thavā ।।45।।
śārīrānmānaso vyādhirmānasād dehajo'pi ca ।
parasparaṃ tayorjanma kāmakrodhādayo hi te ।।46 ।।
doṣā vai vyādhayaḥ proktāstyaktavyāste ravau dine ।
sattvaṃ rajastama iti mānasā vai trayo guṇāḥ ।।47।।
ravau vāre nātiyojyāstrayaste viśvarūpiṇaḥ ।
harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate ।।48।।
tāmasena tu dharmeṇa harṣaśokau prabādhyataḥ ।
vijñāyaiva guṇacakraṃ bādhanīyaṃ ravau prabhau ।।49।।
asantoṣaḥ pramādaśca mado rāgo'tilālasā ।
lobho moho'bhimānaścodvegaścaite hi rākṣasāḥ ।।2.184.50।।
ebhiḥ pāpmabhirāviṣṭo bhavennaiva ravau kvacit ।
udarākhyāṃ khaniṃ nā'hnā pūrayitumalaṃ janaiḥ ।।51 ।।
ravau tāṃ pūrayennaivā'pūryā matvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
yatheddhaḥ prajvalatyagnirasamiddhaḥ praśāmyati ।।52।।
ravāvāhāraśūnyaḥ sa svayaṃ śāmyati vai prabhau ।
ātmodarakṛte lokaḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu ।।53।।
ravāvudarajetā syād vijetā sarvapāpmanām ।
mānuṣāḥ kāmabhogāśca jetavyāḥ sūryavāsare ।।54।।
abhogino janāḥ sūrye yānti sthānamanuttamam ।
yogaḥ kṣemastathā tyāgaḥ sūrye kāryā harau sadā ।।55।।
ekodarakṛte vyāghraḥ karoti vighasaṃ bahu ।
tamanye'pyupajīvanti mandā lubdhā mṛgādayaḥ ।।56 ।।
vicāryaivaṃ ravau tyājyā vṛthā vighasarāśayaḥ ।
patrāhāraiḥ phalāhāraiścaikāhārairjanaiḥ ravau ।।।57।।
yastvimāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ praśiṣyādakhilāṃ nṛpaḥ ।
ravau tyāgaparo bhakto viśiṣyate na vai nṛpaḥ ।।58।।
saṃkalpāstu nirāraṃbhā ravau kāryā hare śubhāḥ ।
nirāmiṣā na śocanti tyājyaṃ vai cāmiṣaṃ ravau ।।59।।
pitṛyānaṃ devayānaṃ ravau labhyeta śaṃkarāt ।
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa bhajanena maharṣayaḥ ।।2.184.6 0।।
vimucya dehān yāntyante brahmalokamanāmayam ।
āmiṣaṃ bandhakṛtkarma tat tyaktavyaṃ ravau sadā ।।6 1 ।।
tasmānmukto hare lagnaḥ padamāpnoti tatparam ।
prajñāprasādamāruhya tyājyaṃ tyaktavyameva yat ।।।62।।।
grāhyaṃ ceśānabhajanaṃ cakṣuṣmatā subuddhinā ।
ṣāṭkauśike'tra dehe vai ravistu saptamaḥ pṛthak ।।63।।
taddevaṃ ca tadātmānaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ।
tata eva tu śanakairbrahma sampadyate param ।।64।।
sūrye sūrigatiṃ yānti dāntāḥ śāntāstitikṣavaḥ ।
sūrye ceśānahavanaṃ durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।65।।
guroḥ pūjā hareḥ pūjā kartavyā bhaktamānavaiḥ ।
asaktastaddine tiṣṭhenniḥsaṃgo muktabandhanaḥ ।।66।।
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sa vai mukto bhaved dhruvam ।
evaṃ dharmamanukrāntāḥ sadvā dānatapaḥparāḥ ।।67।।
ānṛśaṃsyaguṇopetāḥ kāmakrodhādivarjitāḥ ।
prajāpālanayuktāśca sūryeśānavratasthitāḥ ।।68।।
guruvṛddhārhaṇaparā iṣṭalokānavāpsyatha ।
svasti cāstu bhavatāṃ ca sadā sūryajuṣāṃ sukham ।।69।।
ityuktvā śrīharirmaunaṃ samāsthāya vicārya ca ।
alpaketuṃ prāha gantuṃ tadīyāṃ jīvanīpurīm ।।2.184.70।।
sajjā bhavantu cānye'pi bhokṣyāmastatra caiva ha ।
jinavarddhimahārājaḥ prāha natvā hariṃ tadā ।।71 ।।
īśānaśca tathā durgā āpyāyano munistathā ।
bhuktvā'tra bhagavan puryāṃ bhramitvā ca tataḥ param ।।72।।
pāvayitvā bhūtalaṃ ca gantavyaṃ tu tataḥ param ।
dayālurbhagavānāha rādhike vai tathāstviti ।।73 ।।
pakvānnāni kṛtānyeva śīghraṃ tatratyamānavaiḥ ।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cakruḥ sarve ceśānavāñcchayā ।।74।।
durgā satī brahmapatnīrbhojayāmāsa vai tadā ।
viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ yānairvāhanaiśca vimānakaiḥ ।।756।।
sajjībhūyā'mbare prāpya pūjāstanmānavaiḥ kṛtāḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇādyā vai vimāne viviśurdrutam ।।76 ।।
vidāyasya suvādyāni tadā'vādyanta bhūriśaḥ ।
jayaśabdāstūryaśabdāścābhavan vai samantataḥ ।।77।।
rājasainyaṃ prarakṣyaiva tatra rājā jinarddhikaḥ ।
vidāyaṃ pradadau śaṃbhudurgānārāyaṇādaye ।।78।।
alpaketunṛpeṇaiva sākaṃ yānānyapāsaran ।
vimānāni cālpaketudarśitena pathā'gaman ।।79 ।।
āpyāyano maharṣiśca vimāne saha cāgamat ।
apiyānaṃ parvataṃ cātikramya cottare girim ।।2.184.80।।
alpākhyaṃ samapaśyaँśca vimānasthāḥ susundaram ।
alpaketurvimānena prathamaṃ cāgrago'bhavat ।।8 1 ।।
sā''pyāyanaḥ svāgatārthaṃ nijāṃ vai jīvanīpurīm ।
savādyasainyayuktaśca śīghraṃ hārārhaṇādibhiḥ ।।82।।
rājñīputrasutādyaiśca sahitaḥ purato'bhavat ।
tadājñayā drutaṃ vādyaghoṣāḥ kṛtāśca vādakaiḥ ।।83 ।।
jayaśabdāḥ prajābhiśca vetrahārairyaśogiraḥ ।
yāntrikairyantraśabdāśca kṛtāḥ svāgatasūcakāḥ ।।84।।
narā nemuścāmbare ca dṛṣṭvā svarṇavimānakam ।
nāryaḥ parvatavāsinyastathā bhūbhavanā janāḥ ।।85।।।
harervimānamālokya sadhvajaṃ tejasā jvalat ।
vilakṣaṇaṃ susampannaṃ divyatādhikyarājitam ।।86।।
bahumālātoraṇādyairmuktāhīrakajātikaiḥ ।
smṛddhaṃ mūrtisarattejaḥkiraṇaiḥ sūryasannibham ।।87।।
agre haṃsaiśca garuḍergajairmāṇikyavājibhiḥ ।
siṃhaiśca śarabhaiścāpi mūrtimadbhiḥ prayāpitam ।।88।।
bahubhiścānyayānaiśca vimānaiḥ pārśvamaṇḍitam ।
paścācca devadevībhiḥ parībhirjayaghoṣitam ।।89।।
puṣpākṣatādyairmālābhiḥ śṛṃgāritaṃ suvardhitam ।
adhastāccandrasadṛśairmaṇibhiḥ śītabhānvitam ।।2.184.90 ।।
kalpadrumālipuṣpādyaiḥ kṛtodyānasumadhyamam ।
cintāmaṇipraṇaddhāḍhyabhittipaṭṭavirājitam ।।9 1 ।।
svarṇakalaśaśobhāḍhyaśikharairatiśobhitam ।
kamalākārakalyāṇīkṛtasvastikacitrakam ।।92।।
divyavyajanacchatrādyaiścāmarairujjvalairyutam ।
vetrahārairjayaśabdairgajitaṃ pūrvakāṃganam ।।93 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām ।
ityevaṃ svarṇavarṇaiśca sūcayanmādhavāśritam ।।94।।
evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya vimānaṃ nemurambare ।
rājñā darśitamārgeṇa bhūtale cāyate śubhe ।।95 ।।
harirnijaṃ vimānaṃ taccāvātārayadacyutaḥ ।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterurbhuvastale ।।9 6 ।।
jayaśabdaiḥ svāgataṃ ca cakruḥ prajāḥ sudaṇḍavat ।
lājādi cikṣipustatra vimāne dūrataḥ sthitāḥ ।।97।।
puṣpāṇi cikṣipuścānye'kṣatāna kecicca cikṣipuḥ ।
gandhamālyādīni cānye cikṣipuśca vimānake ।।98।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇe bhādre tu pañcamīdine ।
jīvanīṃ nagarīṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prāpto vanānvitām ।।99।।
rājā'lpaketuko rājñī tathā putryaḥ sutādayaḥ ।
vimānāgre pratīkṣante bahiścāgamanaṃ hareḥ ।। 2.184.10 0।।
sarve paśyanti tatraiva dvāre kadā hi mādhavaḥ ।
bahiśceyāt sthiranetrāścātiharṣā'bhisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne anāthabāloddharaṇāya rākṣasānāṃ vināśottaraṃ dvyadhikaśatayuksahasrakanyābhiḥ harikaragrahaṇaṃ, rākṣasamāritā'sthibhyo
mṛtānāmujjīvanam, īśānarājyasthāpanaṃ,ravivāramāhātmyaṃ, pūjāśīrvādā niśāviśrāntiḥ, prātarbhojanottaram alpaketunṛpasya jīvanīṃ nagarīṃ prati bhādrakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 184 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athā'yaṃ bhagavān rādhe jīvanīnagarīṃ prati ।
dṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vimānāt svād bahistūrṇaṃ samāyayau ।। 1 ।।
tāvad rājā'lpaketuścāpyāyanarṣistathā pare ।
kumārā bālakṛṣṇasya kaṇṭhe hārān nyadhuḥ śubhān ।। 2 ।।
sauvarṇān kausumāँścāpi hairakān rātnikānapi ।
kare gucchān sugandhāँśca daduḥ puṣpāṇi mastake ।। 3 ।।
akṣatairvardhayāmāsuḥ praṇemuḥ pādayorapi ।
anye'pi pūjitāḥ sarvairīśānādyāstatharṣayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
pitaraḥ sakuṭumbāśca svāgataiścātimānitāḥ ।
pādau prakṣālya ca vāri papurbhaktā harestadā ।। 5 ।।
hariṃ suvarṇaśobhāyāṃ gajagantryāṃ nyaṣādayan ।
anyān śubheṣu yāneṣu vāhaneṣu hyanassu ca !। 6 ।।
śibikāsu vimāneṣu niṣādya maṃgalasvanaiḥ ।
nagarīṃ bhrāmayāmāsuḥ rājādyāḥ premavihvalāḥ ।। 7 ।।
pradhānaiśca nṛpādyaiśca śreṣṭhibhiścādhikāribhiḥ ।
prajābhiḥ sarvajātīyanārībhiśca naraistathā ।। 8 ।।
vardhitaḥ pūjitaścāpi ghaṇṭāpathe ca catvare ।
aṃgane mārgikāyoge cā''paṇānāṃ ca vartule ।। 9 ।।
svāgatena hariḥ sarvaiḥ prāsāditaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
upadābhiramūlyābhiḥ sarvopakaraṇādibhiḥ ।। 2.185.10 ।।
phalapuṣpairmaṃgalaiśca samarcito narāyaṇaḥ ।
evaṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ vīkṣya datvā ca darśanaṃ tataḥ ।। 11 ।
nivāsālayamāgatya jalapānaṃ samācarat ।
haristūrṇaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca niṣasādā''dideśa ca ।। 1 2।।
yatrā''ste bhagavān sākṣāt yatra santo hariṃ śritāḥ ।
yatra vasanti bhaktāśca deśaḥ sa divya ucyate ।। 13 ।
nirguṇaḥ sa pradeśo vai bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ ।
dhanyo'yaṃ ketumālaśca dhanyā nṛpā nadītaṭāḥ ।। 14।।
dhanyānyeṣāṃ nagarāṇi yatra maccaraṇāgamaḥ ।
dhanyā yūyaṃ prajāścātra vaiṣṇavatvamupāgatāḥ ।। 15।।
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca satsaṃgaḥ parameśaprasannatā ।
sadeṣṭadevabhaktiśca sevā satāṃ hi durlabhāḥ ।। 16।।
te yeṣāṃ militāsteṣāṃ prāptavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
sthānino divyalokasthā vāñcchantyetattu pañcakam ।। 17।।
tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlānāṃ santi lokāḥ sanātanaḥ ।
ajātaśatravo dhīrā bhaktyā mokṣaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ।। 18।।
viṣayebhyaḥ parāvṛttā yānti bhaktyā paraṃ padam ।
anirdeśyāṃ gatiṃ yānti mokṣiṇo bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ।। 19।।
uktaṃ tu pañcakaṃ yeṣāṃ nāsti teṣāṃ tu laukikam ।
vipāṭya kadalīstambhaṃ sāralābho na vidyate ।। 2.185.20 ।।
tasmāttatpañcakaṃ labdhvā śreyo lakṣyaṃ vidhāya ca ।
nigṛhya ca manastṛṣṇāmutsṛjya karmasantatim ।।2 1।।
pareśvare tu saṃlagnaḥ satāṃ mārgamanusmaran ।
dhyāyeddevaṃ cāntarasthaṃ sa vai śreyaḥ prayāsyati ।। 22।।
kriyāratāḥ kratau magnā dāne sevāvidhāvapi ।
māṃ pralakṣyotsṛjanto ye te matā mama lokagāḥ ।। 23।।
tyāgaḥ santoṣa iśejyā'bhilālasākṣayastathā ।
mānādivilayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham ।। 24।।
catuṣpado bhavedatra niḥśreṇī brahmalokadā ।
kathāyajñaḥ ṛṣiśreṇī jñānaṃ śreṇī tu tattvinām ।।25।।।
karmaśreṇī gṛhasthānāṃ tapaḥśreṇī satāṃ matā ।
īhā ced viṣayāḍhyā'sti tato'nīhā garīyasī ।। 26 ।।
īhāyāṃ bahavo doṣāḥ saṃhārajananapradāḥ ।
īhayā dūṣyate cātmā śreyastena vilīyate ।। 27।।
anarhaṃ yo'rjayatyatrā'rhaṃ ca tyajati sarvathā ।
sa cānte saṃparityakto bhaved dvābhyāṃ tato'ndhagaḥ ।।28।।
evaṃ vicārya manujairgṛhasthaistu viśeṣataḥ ।
karmayajño'pi vidhinā dhanayajño'pi saddhanaiḥ ।।29।।
kartavyaśca sameṣṭavyo nārāyaṇo'hameva ca ।
indro yajñaiśca vividhaiḥ surarājo'bhavat purā ।। 2.185.3 0।।
mahādevo mahāyajñe hutvā''tmānaṃ babhūva saḥ ।
devadevo vyāpya viśvān viṣṭabhyeśānatāṃ gataḥ ।।3 1।।
āvikṣito marutaśca yajñe śrīṃ pariveṣiṇīm ।
prāpa sarvapradāṃ bhaktyā yayau dhāma mamāpi ca ।। 32।।
evamanye pūrvakalpe kalpāntareṣu karmiṇaḥ ।
karmayajñeṣu saṃyujya dhanaṃ cāpi divaṃ gatāḥ ।।33।।।
karmayajñe vaiṣṇavatvaṃ satsaṃgo haritoṣaṇam ।
satāṃ sevā bhavantyeva tādṛgyajñaṃ samācaret ।।34।।
anīhaścet susantoṣī vindate brahma śāśvatam ।
santoṣo vai paraṃ svargaṃ parānando hi toṣaṇam ।।35।।
tuṣṭeḥ paraṃ na vai kiñcit sukhaṃ kvāpi praśasyate ।
dehī kāmān samāhṛtya svātmanyeva prasīdati ।। 36।।
bhayaṃ nā'sya kutastādvai nāsmāttu kasyacid bhayam ।
svayaṃ hīnaḥ kāmaruḍbhyāṃ yadā tatrā''tmadṛg bhavet ।। 37।।
adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvākāṃkṣāvivarjitaḥ ।
sarvārpaṇaṃ harau prāpto brahma sampadyate sa ca ।।38।।
yathā pravṛttiryeṣāṃ tu bhūtānāṃ rāgavāhinī ।
tatra teṣāṃ gatiścāsti haryarpaṇe tu śāśvatī ।।39।।
kecit sāma praśaṃsanti prayatnaṃ cāpare janāḥ ।
anye dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti cetare cāśrayaṃ śubham ।।2.185.40।।
ke'pi yajñaṃ praśaṃsanti sannyāsamapare'pi ca ।
dānaṃ caike praśaṃsanti pare lānti pratigraham ।।41।।
śāntāstūṣṇīṃ sthitiṃ prāpya parameśaṃ bhajanti ca ।
aśāntā rājyamicchanti yatrobhayatulā samā ।।42।।
etad vicārya vijñānaiḥ śrayaṇīyaṃ sukhapradam ।
naisargānugamaṃ śreyaḥpradaṃ vai sādhanaṃ śubham ।।।43 ।।
adroheṇa tu bhūtānāṃ vartanaṃ sādhusādhanam ।
satāṃ mārgaḥ sa vai prokto yatrātmā naiva badhyate ।।44।।
rājā cet sa sadā rājye vartetā'drohavartmanā ।
satyena saṃvibhāgena damena dayayā tathā ।।45।।।
hriyā dānena deve'tibhaktyā prajāsu rakṣayā ।
vaśibhāvena ca priyā'priyatulyamanīṣayā ।।46 ।।
yajñaśiṣṭādanenā'pi sādhvanugrahaṇena ca ।
tasyā'yaṃ ca paro loko bhavecchreṣṭhaphalodayaḥ ।।47।।
evaṃ dharmaparāṇāṃ vai sādhusevājuṣāṃ sadā ।
prajārakṣārthamevā'tra yudhyatāṃ dharmahetave ।।48।।
bhavet svargātpare svarge sarvottamā gatiḥ śubhā ।
pūrve rudrāśca vasavaścādityā lokapālinaḥ ।।49।।
sādhyā maruto viśveśā devā dharmaṃ tathāvidham ।
kṛtvā puṇyaiḥ paraṃ svargaṃ prāptāstato'tra mānavāḥ ।।2.185.50 ।।
tadvidhaṃ dharmamāśritya yāntu vai paramāṃ gatim ।
gṛhasthaṃ hi sadā devāḥ pitaro'tithayastathā ।।51।।
bhṛtyāḥ santaśca satataṃ copajīvanti mānavāḥ ।
vayāṃsi paśavaścāpi bhūtānyupāśritāni ca ।।।52।।
tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣyamindriyasaṃyamaḥ ।
dhyānamekāntaśīlatvaṃ tuṣṭirjñānaṃ ca sevanam ।।53 ।।
vipradharmā gṛhasthe ye te kṛṣṇe'rpyāḥ sadā mayi ।
yajño vidyā samutthānaṃ śryarjanaṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam ।।54।।
ugratvaṃ caritaṃ jñānaṃ prajāvanaṃ pradānakam ।
rājadharmā gṛhasthe ye te kṛṣṇe'rpyāḥ sadā mayi ।।55।।
dhanārjanaṃ vyavasāyo dānaṃ ca pālanādikam ।
sasyotpattyādikaṃ vaiśyadharmā arpyā mayi prabhau ।।56 ।।
sevanaṃ sahanaṃ cājñāvartanaṃ śeṣabhojanam ।
bhṛtyatvaṃ śūdradharmā yete'pyarpyā mayi mādhave ।।57।।
pātivratyaṃ guroḥ sevā gṛhasaṃskaraṇādikam ।
apatyarakṣaṇaṃ nārīdharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ।।58।।
adhyayanaṃ khelana ca vikāsanaṃ ca rañjanam ।
narma sāhasakaṃ bāladharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ।।59।।
kāmo balaṃ svārthadṛṣṭirvijayo'tivicāritā ।
arjanaṃ yojanaṃ yuvadharmā arpyāḥ prabhau mayi ।।2.185.60।।
jalpanaṃ kampanaṃ pāravaśyaṃ cāśaktirugratā ।
ālasyaṃ cā'vamānādi mayyarpyā vṛddhadharmakāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tāḍanaṃ sahanaṃ duḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ paśutulyatā ।
daṇḍaḥ pāruṣyamarpyāśca dīnadharmāḥ prabhau mayi ।।62।।
hāsyaṃ ratirvilāsaśca prītirdāsītvamugratā ।
bandho nirāśritetyarpyā strīdharmā vai prabhau mayi ।।63।।
ityevaṃ vartamānānāṃ mayyevārpitacetasām ।
samuddhāraṃ karomyeva mṛtyuvārdhinimajjatām ।।64।।
purā śaṃkhaśca likhito bhūdevasaṃbhavau munī ।
abhūtāṃ bhrātarāvāvasathāvāstāṃ tayoḥ pṛthak ।।65।।
nityaṃ puṣpaphalairvṛkṣairupetau bāhudāmanu ।
kadācillikhitaścāyādāśrame śaṃkhapālite ।।66।।
śaṃkho nā'bhūdāśrame tu tadā vanāntaraṃ gataḥ ।
likhitaḥ pātayāmāsa pakvāni tu phalāni vai ।।67।।
bhakṣayāmāsa tatraiva tāvacchaṃkha upāgataḥ ।
bhrātaraṃ prāha cā'pṛṣṭvā sasvāmikāni vai tvayā ।।68।।
pātitāni phalānyatra tava dharmo'tra dūṣyati ।
tvayā steyaṃ kṛtaṃ cedaṃ phalānyādadatā svayam ।।69।।
gaccha rājānamāsādya cauryaṃ karma nivedaya ।
so'pi tūrṇaṃ gato bhūpaṃ nyavedayacca karma tat ।।2.185.70।।
mayā cauryaṃ kṛtaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tasya pradehi me ।
sudyumno nāma rājā''ha yadi rājā matastava ।।7 1 ।।
tadā'nujñāṃ mama vipra gṛhṇā'nyad daṇḍato vṛṇu ।
evamukto'pi ṛṣirāṭ varayāmāsa netarat ।।72।।
tato rājā karau pracchedayāmāsa ṛṣestataḥ ।
dhṛtadaṇḍo yayau vipro bhrātaraṃ prajagāma ha ।।73 ।।
śaṃkhastaṃ prāha dharmiṣṭha bhrātaryāhi ca bāhudām ।
ṛṣīn pitṝn surāँścaiva tarpayasva yathāvidhi ।।74।।
tataḥ punaḥ kadācidvai naivā'dharme manaḥ kṛthāḥ ।
śaṃkhasyā''jñāṃ gṛhītvaiva likhito bāhudāṃ yayau ।।75।।
avagāhyā''pagāṃ puṇyāṃ prāyaścittaphalaṃ mayi ।
samarpyodakadānārthaṃ yāvadvipraḥ pracakrame ।। 76।।
prādurāstāṃ karau tāvattasya mayyarpaṇāttadā ।
tataḥ kṛtvodakadānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ sadā mayi ।। 77।।
samācarat sa vipro'tra karmabhūmau nirantaram ।
vijñāyā'rpaṇamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।।78।।
rājā yo dattavān daṇḍaḥ so'pi tenā'rpito mayi ।
udakādipradānaṃ ca likhitenā'rpitaṃ mayi ।।79।।
śaṃkhenā''jñāvacanaṃ ca tathaivā'bhyarpitaṃ mayi ।
evaṃ sarvārpaṇenaite pūtā mama prabhāvataḥ ।।2.185.80।।
na vāgdoṣo'sti śaṃkhasya daṇḍadoṣo na bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
hastadoṣo nāpi tathā likhitasya madarpaṇāt ।।81 ।।
ityevaṃ mānavā ye māṃ smṛtvā mayi samarpya ca ।
bhuñjate cāpi vartante nirbādhāste mamāśritāḥ ।।82।।।
māmevānte prayāntyeva karmapāśavivarjitāḥ ।
tathā yūyaṃ rājavargāḥ prajāvargāśca sarvaśaḥ ।।।83।।।
mayi sarvārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhajitvā yāta dhāma me ।
ahamante'suvigame tūpasthāsyāmi gocaraḥ ।।84।।
nayiṣye'haṃ vimānena madbhaktān dhāma me param ।
bhajanaṃ me prakuruta prapūjayata māṃ sadā ।।85।।।
dṛḍhāśrayaṃ me kuruta nayiṣye dhāma me param ।
ityuktvā bhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ।।86।।
dehi mantrān prajābhyaśca gṛhṇantu bhojanaṃ janāḥ ।
ityuktaḥ sa dadau mantrān śaraṇāgatatārakān ।।87।।
atha sarvaprajāḥ svasvagṛhān yayustato hariḥ ।
bhojanaṃ rādhike cakre sarve'pi bhojanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।88।।
rātrau viśrāntimāsādya prātarutthāya satvaram ।
kṛtanityavidhiḥ kṛṣṇo niṣasāda nijāsane ।।89।।
tāvad rājā dugdhapānādikaṃ kārayituṃ prabhum ।
prārthayāmāsa ca hariścakāra dugdhabhojanam ।।2.185.90।।
tāmbūlakaṃ cādade'pi prasthānārthamiyeṣa ca ।
anye'pi kṛtadugdhādibhojanāḥ prātareva ha ।।9 1 ।।
gantuṃ sajjā babhūvuśca tāvad rājñī sakanyakā ।
pūjanārthaṃ cāyayau ca pupūja parameśvaram ।।92।।
saptakanyāḥ kumāryaśca jagṛhuśca karaṃ hareḥ ।
karadānaṃ tathā kṛtvā prāpya kāntaṃ pareśvaram ।।93 ।।
varamālādikaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāstadā'bhavan ।
brahmapriyāsu tāḥ sapta militvā tadvimānakam ।। 94।।
āruruhustadā rājā hariṃ pupūja cādarāt। ।
prajā vidāyadānaṃ ca daduḥ rājopadā dadau ।।95।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta prasthānasūcakāni vai ।
mahīmānā vimānāni cāruruhustataḥ prabhuḥ ।।96।।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ kuṭumbena ca śaṃbhunā ।
saha sveṣṭajareṇāpi muninā bhaktiśālinā ।। 17।।
rājñā ca jayakṛṣṇavanāmnā tadā'rthito hariḥ ।
alpaketvādikān vardhayitvā''śīrbhistadā'mbare ।। 98।।
vimānena gatiṃ cakre jayakṛṣṇavarāṣṭrakam ।
alpādriṃ ca vyatikramya sveṣṭajarāśrayāṃ bhuvam ।।99।।
prāpā'mbare harikṛṣṇastathā'nye vyomavāhanāḥ ।
rāhūnāyā āpagāyā mūladeśeṣu cāyayuḥ ।। 2.185.10 0।।
rājā ṛṣiryayatuśca pūrvaṃ svāgatasiddhaye ।
bhūtalaṃ cakratustatra vādyādyaiḥ svāgataṃ hareḥ ।। 101 ।।
varaṇāṃ nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa harirīśvaraḥ ।
viśālāṃ śobhitāṃ śṛṃgāritāṃ ca rādhike tadā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne 'lpaketorjīvanyāṃ nagaryāṃ śrīharerbhamaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ sabhāyāṃ śaṃkhalikhitadṛṣṭāntenopadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ
prātarbhojanottaraṃ sveṣṭajararṣideśeṣu jayakṛṣṇavanṛpateḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ varaṇānagaryāmāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 185 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 186
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 187 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
ākāśād bhagavān rādhe'paśyat prāvaraṇāṃ purīm ।
rājñā''diṣṭena mārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।। 1 ।।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustaduttaram ।
bhūrivādyānyavādyantā'jāyanta jayaghoṣaṇāḥ ।। 2 ।।
jayanādāścā'bhavaँśca prajāharṣā mamurna ca ।
śrīhariṃ tu svayaṃ rājā'bhigatvā svarṇahārakaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
puṣpahārairgucchapuṣpā'kṣatādyaiḥ samapūjayat ।
rājabhṛtyāḥ śreṣṭhinaśca prajāḥ svāgatamācaran ।। 4 ।।
namaskārairjayadhvānaistathā saṃkīrtanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
utsāhaṃ darśayantyaśca prajāḥ mānamadarśayan ।। 5 ।।
śrīhareśca caraṇau vārbhiḥ prakṣālyā'mṛtamāpapau ।
rājā kuṭumbasahitaḥ prajāstadamṛtaṃ papuḥ ।। 6 ।।
īśānasyā'rhaṇaṃ cakrustathā'nyeṣāṃ yathāyatham ।
rājñī brahmapriyādīnāmarhaṇāṃ saṃvyadhāttathā ।। 7 ।।
śṛṃgāriteṣu sainyeṣu hastiyāneṣu sarvaśaḥ ।
ārohayitvā bhagavān gajayānaṃ samāruhat। ।। 8 ।।
nagaryāṃ vādyagītaiśca rājā kṛṣṇaṃ mahāpathe ।
rathyāyogeṣu sarveṣu hariṃ tvabhrāmayanmudā । । 9 ।।
rājasaudhe bhṛtyasaudhe pradhānasya gṛhe'pi ca ।
prajālayeṣu cānyeṣu prajāḥ nītvā'rhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ।। 2.186.10 ।।
pāvanīṃ nagarīṃ kṛtvā madhyāhne bhagavān nijam ।
āvāsaṃ tvāyayau snānaṃ cakre viśrāntimāpa ca ।। 11 ।।
sarve śrāntāstato rājā bhojanāni śubhāni vai ।
kārayāmāsa yuktāni pramiṣṭānnāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 1 2।।
bhagavān bubhuje cānye pracakrurbhojana tataḥ ।
viśramya tu kṣaṇaṃ sāyaṃ sabhāṃ cakre prabhurhariḥ ।। 12 ।।
tatropadeśaṃ pradadau bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ yathā ।
puṇyapāpe tu panthānau yujyete dehinā sadā ।। 14।।
kāle. pāpaṃ ca vā puṇyaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ dadātyapi ।
bhavatāṃ phalitaṃ puṇyaṃ yadatra tu mamā''gamaḥ ।। 15।।
mama yogo mama sevā bahupuṇyaphalaṃ tvidam ।
mantraḥ phalati kālena kāle phalati cauṣadham ।। 16।।
kāle vṛṣṭiśca bhavati vṛkṣāḥ phalanti kālataḥ ।
candraḥ kāle pūryate ca pūryante sarito'pi ca ।। 17।।
prāpte tu samaye smṛddhiḥ svayamevābhigacchati ।
bījamuptaṃ ca samaye kālāgame prarohati ।। 18।।
kāle jarā tathā kāle rasahānirdrumeṣvapi ।
kālakṛto hi paryāyaḥ sarvān spṛśati dehinaḥ ।। 19।।
vicāryaivaṃ svasthakāle parameśaṃ śrayet sudhīḥ ।
kālo'yaṃ maṃgalatamo bhavatāṃ vidyate'dhunā ।।2.186.20।।।
yogo'tra bhavatāṃ jāto mama nārāyaṇasya vai ।
etādṛśaṃ tu sākṣānmāṃ labdhvā ye'nyatra saṃsthitāḥ ।।21 ।।
mugdhā vā'jñānasampannāsteṣāṃ hāniḥ pade pade ।
parameśaṃ vihāyaiva tṛṣṇālobhasamudbhavaiḥ ।।22।।
vegaiścānyatra viṣaye sthitāste duḥkhabhāginaḥ ।
tṛṣṇārtiprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ na cetarat ।।2 3 ।।
yadvā labhyeta ced duḥkhottaraṃ sukhaṃ kṣaṇasthiram ।
sukhasyā'nantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyā'nantaraṃ sukham ।।24।।
sukhameva hi duḥkhāntaṃ sukhāntaṃ duḥkhameva ca ।
tasmādetat dvayaṃ jahyād ya icchecchāśvataṃ sukham ।।25।।
yannimitto bhavecchokastāpo vā mūrchanādikam ।
tat (yajed buddhimānatra śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ।।26।।
sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhanāntarīyakaṃ māyikaṃ nviha ।
duḥkhānāṃ tu kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyuttarottaram ।।27।।।
tasmāt paryāyabhāvena cāntarbhāvena sarvadā ।
sukhamiśraṃ samāyāti duḥkhaṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ khalu ।। 28।।
vicāryaivaṃ kṣaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ bahvāyāsaṃ ca tāpakṛt ।
sukhasaṃjñaṃ dhruvasaṃjñaṃ śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ।।29।।
sevayā tapasā bhaktyā dharmeṇaikāntikena ca ।
dānena nigraheṇā'pi yānti sukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ।।2.186.3 0 ।।
santoṣo vai svargatamaḥ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham ।
tuṣṭiḥ sudhā'mṛtaṃ tuṣṭistuṣṭyā vai siddhiruttamā ।।3 1 ।।
nārāyaṇāśrito jīvo nārāyaṇabalāt sadā ।
bibheti na parāt kvāpi nā'smād bibhyati kecana ।।3 2।।
sarvatra matkṛtāhlādo brahma sampadyate tadā ।
yadā na bhāvaṃ kurute kasmiṃścidapi pāpakam ।।3 3।।
manasā karmaṇā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ।
mānamohau hatau yena hatāḥ saṃgā mṛṣā tathā ।।34।।
mamāśrayamupetaśca nirvāṇamupayāti saḥ ।
matvā kṣayāntanicayān patanāntasamucchrayān ।।3 5।।
viyogāntakasaṃyogān maraṇāntakajīvanam ।
duḥkhāntakasukhaṃ cāpi vijño māṃ samupāśrayet ।।36।।
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ krameṇaivopapadyate ।
taṭasya cetanāmāśu haratyeva ca dehinaḥ ।।37।।
satyevaṃ cābhijāto'smi siddho'smi cāsmi vai mahān ।
ityevaṃ sicyate cittaṃ naṣṭasmṛtirbhavatyapi ।।38।।
naṣṭasmṛtiḥ parasvānāmādānaṃ sādhu manyate ।
tamatikrāntamaryādaṃ rājā śāsti yamastataḥ ।।3 9।।
tasmād vicārya vīkṣyāpi vijño bhaiṣajyamācaret ।
sādhūnāṃ śaraṇaṃ yadvā śrīmannārāyaṇasya ca ।।2.186.40।।
anyathā duḥkhasampattirvibhramo'niṣṭavedanam।
trikaṃ samupapadyeta caturthaṃ nā'sya vidyate ।।41 ।।
jarāmṛtyū hi bhūtānāṃ khāditārau yathā vṛkau ।
na kaścittāvatikrāmedapi brahmāṇḍabhūpatiḥ ।।।42।।
upasthitasya duḥkhasya parihāro na vidyate ।
sukhasyāpi tathā bodhyaṃ naikāntaṃ tacca vidyate ।।43।।
arthā nā''yānti saṃsāre vāñcchitāḥ kintu cānyathā ।
upatiṣṭhanti vartante'varjanīyāḥ sadā'nyathā ।।44।।
apriyaiḥ saha saṃyogo viyogaḥ supriyaiḥ saha ।
arthā'narthakarāvetau sukhaduḥkhapradau matau ।।45।।
utpattiḥ puṣṭirantaśca sarveṣvete pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
gandharūparasasparśā kāle santi prayānti ca ।।46 ।।
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ vimānaṃ pānamañjanam ।
bhojanaṃ ca samutthānaṃ jāyate ca vinaśyati ।। 87।।
vaidyā api tu rugṇāste balinaḥ strīṣu nirbalāḥ ।
śrīmanto'pi tu ṣaṇḍhāste vicitraḥ karmaparyayaḥ ।।48।।
kule janma mahāvīryamārogyaṃ rūpamārjavam ।
saubhāgyamupabhogādyā labhyante bahupuṇyataḥ ।।49।।
teṣu satsvapi bhaktiścet kṛṣṇe nāstīti niṣphalāḥ ।
santi putrā daridrāṇāṃ bahavaścāpyanicchatām ।।2.186.50।।
nāsti putraḥ samṛddhānāṃ vicitraṃ karmaceṣṭitam ।
vyādhistāpaśca viduṣo bubhukṣā nirdhane tathā ।।5 1 ।।
āpadastu dhanāḍhyasya jvaraśca nṛpateḥ sadā ।
nirmāṇaṃ yasya yattasmād vicitraṃ karma ceṣṭitam ।।52।।
yuvā dhanī mṛto yāti nirdhanaḥ śatavarṣabhāk ।
akiñcanāściraṃjīvāḥ smṛddhāścālpāyuṣastathā ।।53 ।।
śrīmatsu bhogaśaktirna daridre jāṭharo'tigaḥ ।
sadhane kāryabuddhirna vicitraṃ karmaceṣṭitam ।।54।।
etadvicārya matimān svātmaśreyaḥ samācaret ।
nauṣadhāni na vai mantrā na homā na punarjapāḥ ।।55।।
mānatā mānavasmṛddhiḥ prāptamṛtyuṃ na rakṣati ।
yathā pūre taruḥ kāṣṭhaṃ sameyātāṃ yadṛcchayā ।।।56 ।।
sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tathā bhūtasamāgamaḥ ।
strīrājyasutavanto ye ye'nāthāśca parānninaḥ ।।57।।
īśvarā vā daridrā vā kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ ।
kṛtavidyāśca ye'ndhā vā yatnavanto na yatninaḥ ।।58।।
bhajamānāścā'bhajantaḥ kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ ।
abhuktaṃ vā prabhuktaṃ vā rakṣitaṃ nā'dṛtaṃ ca vā ।।59 ।।
viprakṛtaṃ svīkṛtaṃ vā kālasteṣu samakriyaḥ ।
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradārāyutāni ca ।।2.186.60।।
asaṃkhyadhanarājyāni bhuktvā tyaktāni janmasu ।
punaḥ prāptāni saṃsāre kasya te kasya vā vayam ।।6 1 ।।
na cā'sya kaścid bhavitā nā'yaṃ bhavati kasyacit ।
mārge saṃgatameved dārabandhusuhṛnmayam ।।62।।
kvā''se kva ca gamiṣyāmi ko'haṃ kimatra cāsthitaḥ ।
kiyān kālo dhruvo me'sti vicārayet punaḥ punaḥ ।।63 ।।
anitye duḥkhasaṃvāse bahiḥ sukhasame'śubhe ।
mārge saṃgatamevedaṃ mātā bhrātā sutaḥ priyā ।।64।।
jaganmajjati ṇityaṃ ca gaṃbhīre kālasāgare ।
jarāmṛpyumahāgrāhe na kaścidavabudhyate ।।65।।
āyurvedamadhīyānā api vyādhiparābhavāḥ ।
pibanto'pi kaṣāyāँśca na mṛtyumatiyānti te ।।66।।
rasāyanapibāścāpi bhavanti jarayā''plutāḥ ।
tapasvino'pi dātāro yajñino'pi ciraṃsthitāḥ ।।67।।
divyadehāścāmbarasthā api jīryanti kālataḥ ।
na hyahāni nivartante bhūtānāṃ yāni yānti vai ।।68।।
kālādhvānamanantaṃ vai sarvalokaniṣevitam ।
kṛtasthairyo'pi saṃyāti jano'vaśo'tilālasaḥ ।।69।।
deho jīvaṃ ca vā jīvo dehaṃ cābhyeti pānthavat ।
pānthena pānthā abhyetya viyanti bāndhavādayaḥ ।।2.186.70 ।।
nā'trā'tyantaṃ susaṃvāso labhyate jātu kenacit ।
api svena śarīreṇa tadā'nyena tu kā kathā ।।7 1।।
ka gatāḥ karmiṇaḥ pūrve pitāmahādayastvataḥ ।
na paśyāmo vayaṃ tāṃstu te na paśyanti no'pi ca ।।72।।
māyayā tu piśācinyā bhakṣitāḥ pācanaṃ gatāḥ ।
agādhagarte saṃsuptā na nissaranti te punaḥ ।।73।।
tasmād vicārya kālaṃ ca karma māyāṃ viḍambinīm ।
dehaṃ viśvāsahaṃ cāpi saṃgatānāṃ viyojanam ।।74।।
svasyā'sthairyaṃ kālabhakṣyaṃ cākasmikaṃ jagattathā ।
bhajantu bhagavantaṃ māṃ rakṣakaṃ kālapāśataḥ ।।75।।
madyoge na punarmṛtyurna grāsaḥ kālabhoginaḥ ।
na nāśaḥ sukhasampatterdhāmni me bhavatāṃ bhavet ।।76।।
macchrayāśca manmanaso madarpitendriyārthakāḥ ।
matsvarūpe sthitaprajñā yānti me śāśvataṃ sukham ।।77।।
jñānaṃ cāmṛtamevoktaṃ yadi bodhaphalaṃ bhavet ।
sevā me bhojanaṃ tasya yadi śraddhānvitā bhavet ।।78।।
prāptirme tṛptirevā'sti yadi māhātmyasaṃyutā ।
sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi tasya śāśvatānandadāyakam ।।79।।
evaṃ vicintya vai bhaktā narā nāryo'pi sarvathā ।
karma sarvavidhaṃ kṛṣṇe mayyarpayantvaharniśam ।।2.186.80।।
ahaṃ nairguṇyametasmin prāpayya phalavarjanām ।
madātmakaphalāvāptiṃ dāsye coddhārasaṃjñitām ।।8 1 ।।
ityuktvā bhagavān rādhe virarāma tato janāḥ ।
pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā bālakṛṣṇaṃ krameṇa vai ।।82।।
candanena kusumaiścā'kṣatairhāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।
puṣpasārai rasasārairambarairbahumūlyakaiḥ ।।83।।
vibhūṣābhiḥ phalairbījairmauktikai ratnahīrakaiḥ ।
upadābhirvividhābhirarcayitvā tato janāḥ ।।84।।
ārārtrikaṃ vyadadhuśca namaḥ stutiṃ vyadhustathā ।
atha rājā tathā rājñī tathā rājakuṭumbakam ।।85।।
sabhāyāstu samāptiṃ vai kṛtvā nijālaye harim ।
sanninyubhojayāmāsurhariṃ hareḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।।86।।
maharṣīṃśca mahīmānān brahmapriyāstathā'parān ।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ rājasevāparāyaṇāḥ ।।87।।
tato rājñī svayaṃ kanyāmāha naijāṃ suśobhanām ।
ekāmevā'dvitīyāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇahastaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ।।88।।
sāpi cecchāvatī śīghraṃ kṛṣṇahastaṃ samagrahīt ।
mālāṃ sauvarṇajāṃ ratnakhacitāṃ śrīharergale ।।89।।
nyadhāt puṣpamayīṃ cāpi haristasyā gale hyapi ।
evaṃ vivāhavidhinā rājakanyā''pa mādhavam ।।2.186.90।।
tadutsavaṃ tadā rājā cakre'tha ca tataḥ param ।
rātrau viśramya bhagavān prātaḥ prajājanān svayam ।।9 1 ।।
śrāvayāmāsa ca manuṃ naijaṃ vaiṣṇavatāpradam ।
kṛtāhnikastato gantuṃ mano dadhe'tha bhūpatiḥ ।।92।।
dugdhabhojyairhariṃ sarvān mahīmānān samantataḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa vidhinā vidāyaṃ ca dadau tataḥ ।।93।।
yānavāhanasainyaiśca vādyaghoṣairjayasvanaiḥ ।
puṣpākṣatairharṣaṇaiśca vidāyaṃ pradadau tadā ।।94।।
vimānānyabhavan vyomni niṣeduḥ sarvaśo janāḥ ।
harirvimānamāruhya gatyarthaṃ ca samairayat ।। 95।।
rāhūnāṃ cāpagāṃ krāntvā vyomni vimānakāni vai ।
pherunasarṣivāsātmapradeśān prayayurdrutam ।।96।।
parīśāno nṛpaścātra pherunaso munistathā ।
vimānaṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā'vateraturbhuvaṃ drutam ।। 97।।
svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ rājā sainyaṃ samairayacchubham ।
vādyaghoṣān jayaśabdān yantrasphoṭānakārayat ।।98।।
prajā vyomni vimānāni pratīkṣante sma sādaram ।
lājākṣatakusumādyairyuktā harṣabharāstadā ।।99।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇo vai dadarśa śobhanāḥ sthalīḥ ।
senānadītaṭe ramye parīśāṃ nagarīṃ śubhām ।। 2.186.10 0।।
śobhayā nākamadharaṃ kurvāṇāṃ smṛddhiśālinīm ।
udyānairmiśritāṃ saudhaiḥ svarṇavaṇairvirājitām ।। 101 ।।
viśālāṃ devatulyaiśca mānavairadhivāsitām ।
rādhike tvatsamābhiśca sundarībhirvirājitām ।। 1 02।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa mahodyāne nṛpālaye ।
vimānaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ samavātārayacchanaiḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne jayakṛṣṇavarājarṣirājye vimānādavatīrya varaṇānagarīṃ paribhramya pūjāṃ pragṛhyopadeśaṃ datvā rātrau bhojanaṃ viśrāntiṃ labdhvā prātaścāhnikaṃ kṛtvā dugdhapānādyuttaram ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pherunasarṣideśān parīśānarājarājyaṃ harirjagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 186 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 187
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 188 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
golokarāśeśvari bālakṛṣṇo
vimānamadhyād bahirājagāma ।
dadarśa lakṣādhikamānuṣāṇāṃ
sammardamāścaryakaraṃ tadānīm ।। 1 ।।
cakorajātīyasamastakānāṃ
yathendutejovalaye'kṣivṛttiḥ ।
tathā'khilasvāgatakārakāṇāṃ
pareśvare'bhūd varade'kṣivṛttiḥ।। 2 ।।
yathā mayūrā ghanadarśanena
bhavanti kekāninade'timagnāḥ ।
tathā prajāḥ śrīharidarśanena
tadā'bhavan vai jayanādamagnāḥ ।। 3 ।।
yathā ghane svātijale'tihṛṣṭā
nandanti vai cātakapakṣisārthāḥ ।
tathā ghanaśyāmaphale'tihṛṣṭā
ānanditāḥ svāgatapakṣisārthāḥ ।। 4 ।।
yathā tu bālā madhurāṃ suśarkarā-
māsādya modātibhṛtā bhavantyapi ।
tathā prajāḥ sveṣṭasudhānanaṃ prabhuṃ
samprāpya modātibhṛtāstadā'bhavan ।। 5 ।।
yathā satī kāntamatīva sundaraṃ
ciraṃ viyuktaṃ hyadhigamya modate ।
tathā prajāstaṃ parakāntamacyutaṃ
sadāviyuktaṃ pratilabhya harṣitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
yathā pataṃgā hyatitejasānalaṃ
vilokya kṛṣṭā abhiyanti mohitāḥ ।
tathā prajāṃgāni samujjvalaṃ prabhuṃ
vilokya kṛṣṭāni patanti mohini ।। 7 ।।
yathā niśeśaṃ prasamīkṣya pūrṇinaṃ
jagatsu vārāṃnidhayo dravantyabhi ।
tathā'kṣareśaṃ prasamīkṣya pūrṇakaṃ
prajābjakoṭyo'bhimukhaṃ dravantyapi ।। 8 ।।
yathā''pya lauhāni tu lauhakāntaṃ
nisargatastatparito'bhiyanti ।
tathā''pyalokā bahulokakāntaṃ
nisargato bālahariṃ prayānti ।। 9 ।।
yathā tu nadyo jaladhiṃ prayānti
yatheṣṭalabhye hṛdayāni yānti ।
tathā prajānāṃ hṛdayāni kṛṣṇe

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇa upādideśa saṃsadam ।
parīśānanagaryāṃ yat tatte saṃśrāvayāmyaham ।। 1 ।।
hariḥ prāha hi saṃsāre maraṇaṃ dhruvameva hi ।
śarīraṃ gatvaraṃ prāṇā gatvarā gatvarāḥ śriyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
saṃyogā gatvarāḥ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ cāpi gatvaram ।
gatvarāṇi hi bhūtāni cātmā'nyatra gamiṣyati ।। 3 ।।
punarnaitādṛśaṃ prāpyaṃ gatvaraṃ kṛtabuddhinā ।
ātmanā sthāsnunā labhyaḥ sthāsnurmokṣo hi śāśvataḥ ।। 4 ।।
agrimāṇāṃ kṣitibhujāṃ mānyo devamaharṣibhiḥ ।
vardhitaḥ svastivacanairāśīrbhiryojito nṛpaḥ ।। 5 ।।
āvikṣito maruttaśca mahābhāgavato hyabhūt ।
yasya sendrāḥ savaruṇā bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ ।। 6 ।।
devā viśvasṛjo rājño yajñamīyurmahātmanaḥ ।
yasmin śāsati pṛthivī cā'kṛṣṭapākadā'bhavat ।। 7 ।।
yasya yajñe tadā''saँśca viśvedevāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।
marutaḥ pariveṣṭāraḥ sādhyāśca sādhavastathā ।। 8 ।।
ahamāsaṃ kratau bhoktā mūrtimānanale tadā ।
sa rājyaṃ matparaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā svaṃ matparāyaṇam ।। 9 ।।
yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me ca tathā kāryaṃ nṛpairiha ।
suhotro nāma nṛpatistathā bhāgavato'bhavat ।। 2.188.1 0।।
yasmin hiraṇyaṃ vavṛṣe maghavā parivatsaram ।
satyanāmā vasumatī svarṇaṃ nadyo'vahaँstadā ।। 11 ।।
indro vavarṣa makarān kūrmān yādāṃsi yāni ca ।
hiraṇyamayāni samrāṭ sa brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samārpayat ।। 11।।
ahaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo'smi sarvapātreṣu māṃ sa tu ।
suyaṣṭvā so'tithirbhūtvā yayau me paramaṃ padam ।। 13।।
aṃgo bṛhadratho rājā mahābhāgavato hyabhūt। ।
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ śvetānaśvān pradattavān ।। 14।।
sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ kanyā hemapariṣkṛtāḥ ।
sahasraṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ gajānāmatipadminām ।। 15।।
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi vṛṣāṇāṃ hemamālinām ।
sahasrāṇi suvarṇānāṃ niṣkāṇāṃ pratimānavam ।। 16।।
ījāno vitate yajñe somasaṃsthāsu saptasu ।
bhikṣukebhyo'pi viprebhyo dakṣiṇā atyakālayat ।। 17।।
kṛtvā māṃ suprasannaṃ ca bhajitvā māṃ kratau nṛpaḥ ।
mahābhāgavato bhūtvā yayāvante tu matpadam ।। 18।।
śibiścauśīnaro rājā mahābhāgavato'bhavat ।
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ suvarṇairabhyaveṣṭayat ।। 1 9।।
yāvadasyāṃ gavāśvaṃ ca hastigavayakaṃ tathā ।
abhūt sarvaṃ pradadau sa dāne'saṃkhyaguṇaṃ tataḥ ।।2.188.20।।।
prāpya prasannatāṃ me'tra bhūtvā bhāgavato mahān ।
māṃ bhajitvā yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ śibiḥ ।।21 ।।
bhagīratho'nayad gaṃgāṃ pitruddhāraṇahetave ।
mahābhagavato bhūtvā yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ mama ।।22।।
dilīpaḥ kṛtavān yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mama tuṣṭaye ।
sahasraṃ vāraṇān haimān dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat ।।।23।।
caṣāle yasya sauvarṇe tasmin yūpe hiraṇmaye ।
nanṛturdevagandharvāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi saptadhā ।।24।।
sa prasādya paraṃbrahma māṃ bhaktyā sevayā satām ।
yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me tu śāśvataṃ cā'punarbhavam ।। 25।।
māndhātā yauvanāśvo'bhūd rājā bhāgavato mahān ।
indro poṣṭā'bhavad yasya sarvakṣmāśāsako'bhavat ।।26।।
aśvamedhaśataṃ cakre rājasūyaśataṃ tathā ।
hairaṇyān rohitān matsyān brāhmaṇebhyo'dadat sa ca ।। 27।।
yajñeṣu māṃ pratarpyaiva kṛtvā bhaktiṃ mamā'dhikām ।
prāpa dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me sa kṛtakṛtyo'bhavat sadā ।।28।।
yayātiścā'bhavad rājā nāhuṣo bhaktimān mama ।
tīrakṣepeṇa kuṇḍaṃ sa kārayitvā'yajaddhi mām ।।29।।
cakre yajñasahasraṃ sa vājapeyaśataṃ tathā ।
dadau dāne trīn suyogyān svarṇaśailān madarthakān ।।2.188.3 0।।
vane gatvā sa māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prasādyā'kṣaramāptavān ।
ambarīṣaśca nābhāgo mahābhāgavato'bhavat ।। 31 ।।
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ rājñāmayutayājinām ।
ījāno vitate yajñe mayi sarvārpaṇaṃ nyadhāt ।।32।।
sudarśanaṃ mayā cakraṃ tadrakṣārthaṃ samarpitam ।
so'nte dhāmā'kṣaraṃ prāpa prasādya māṃ pareśvaram ।। 33।।
śaśabindurabhavacca bhūpo bhāgavato mahān ।
yajñe rājyaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ dattvā vanaṃ jagāma ha ।।34।।
māmārādhya yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me śāśvataṃ sthiram ।
gayo rājā'bhavacchreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ।। 35।।
sa ca varṣaśataṃ rājā hutaśiṣṭāśano'bhavat ।
agnistuṣṭo varadānaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ dadau harau ।। 36।।
ayajad vājimedhena sahasraṃ parivatsaram ।
sauvarṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā dadau dānaṃ dvijātaye ।। 37।।
yāvatyo gāṃgasikatāstāvatīḥ pradadau sa gāḥ ।
mām ārādhya cāyuṣo'nte mamā'kṣarapadaṃ yayau ।।38।।
rantidevo'bhavad rājā mahābhāgavataśca saḥ ।
atithau māṃ vilokyaiva puṣkasāya jalaṃ dadau ।। 39।।
śatakoṭisahasrāṇi bhuñjate tadgṛhe dvijāḥ ।
sa māṃ prasādya samprāpa dhāmā'kṣarapadaṃ mama ।।2.188.40 ।।
sagaro nāma rājā ca vājimedhasahasrakam ।
kṛtvā datvā ca sarvasvaṃ māmārādhya gato'kṣaram ।।41 ।।
pṛthuḥ sākṣādahamāsaṃ so'pi cārādhanāṃ mama ।
kṛtvā viveśa madrūpe tathā kurvantu bhūmipāḥ ।।।42।।
rukmāṃgadaśca rājarṣirdharmāṃgadaśca tatsutaḥ ।
ārādhya māṃ yayatuśca mama dhāmā'kṣaraṃ param ।।43 ।।
rukmāṃgadagṛhe kanyā vedhaso mohinī priyā ।
patnīrūpā'bhavad yā tu vedhā tithiḥ samucyate ।।44।।
sudyumnaścā'bhavad rājā dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tu mām ।
prāpad dhāmā'kṣaraṃ bhaktyā śāśvataṃ mama vai prajāḥ ।।45।।
indradyumno'bhavad rājā puruṣottamabhaktarāṭ ।
māmāradhya yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ vai śāśvataṃ mama ।।46।।
puṇḍarīko'bhavad rājā mahābhāgavato mama ।
bhaktyā dhāmā'kṣaraṃ prāpa śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ।।47।।
prahlādaśca balirbāṇo bhūpāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ।
rājasthā api bhaktyā māṃ toṣayanti divāniśam ।।48।।
udayano mahārājastathā raṇaṃgamo'pi ca ।
citraketustathā nandastvete bhāgavatā mama ।।49।।
kanthādharaśca bhadrāśvo lakṣmaṇo mucukundakaḥ ।
viśālaśca prajāpālo durjayo'śvaśirāstathā ।।2.188.50।।
camatkāraḥ satyasandho'mitrajit kalaśo nṛpaḥ ।
puṇyanidhiḥ suyaśaśca paṃcālanṛpatistathā ।।5 1 ।।
alarkastoṇḍamāँścāpi nābhiḥ ṛtadhvajastathā ।
rantirvedaśravāścāpi nandasāvarṇirityapi ।।52।।
nimidhruvastathā dharmadhvajaḥ kuśadhvajastathā ।
dṛḍhadhanvā divodāsaścānartto raivatādayaḥ ।।।5 3 ।।
ete tvanye ca bahavo rājāno vaiṣṇavā mama ।
matprāptiṃ durlabhāṃ prāpya saṃsiddhāścā'bhavan khalu ।।54।।
saprajā bahavastatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayuḥ param ।
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ dharmo rājñāṃ bhaktiyuto harau ।।5 5 ।।
rājājñāpālanaṃ dharmaḥ prajānāṃ bhaktiyuk harau ।
evaṃ parasparaṃ kṛtvā sāhāyyaṃ dharmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।।56।।
mama smṛtyā'nvayenaiva te bodhyā mokṣabhāginaḥ ।
mayā niyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ sādhvasādhu karoti hi ।।57।।
svayaṃ sādhupravāhaḥ syānna tvasādhupravāhaṇaḥ ।
jñānadṛṣṭyā vicāryaiva sādhu kuryānna cetarat ।।58।।
sarvakarmasu sādhutvaṃ mayyarpaṇaṃ mayā matam ।
mayyarpitaṃ bhavet sādhu tadbhinnaṃ naiva sādhu tat। ।।59।।
nānyadrohakaraṃ kuryānnodvejanaparaṃ kvacit ।
nātmahānikaraṃ kuryānna kuryāllokagarhitam ।।2.188.60।।
evaṃ varteta medhāvī sarvaṃ prakṣipya vai mayi ।
tadā śāntiṃ parāṃ labdhā tiṣṭhedante'kṣare pare ।।6 1 ।।
narā nāryaḥ karmanaddhā nā'karmāṇo bhavanti vai ।
naisargikī kriyā yā ca sā'pi kṣipenmayīśvare ।।62।।
vahnau kṣiptaṃ yathā kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkamārdraṃ ca vetarat ।
drutaṃ cireṇa vā bhasmībhavennaivātra saṃśayaḥ ।।63 ।।
tathā karma śubhaṃ vā'nyat kṣipenmayi pareśvare ।
bhasmīkuryā samartho'smi mokṣayāmyapi karmadam ।।64।।
athavā tadupādānāt prāpnuyāt karmaṇaḥ phalam ।
prāpnuyāditi hetośca mayīśvare nivedayet ।।61।।
tathāpi puruṣaḥ kartā karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ ।
sābhimāno'jñānavṛttyā bhoktā syāt tatphale'pi ca ।।66।।
karmasūtrātmakaṃ sarvaṃ sannaddhaṃ kramaśaḥ khalu ।
sukhaduḥkhaguṇodarkaṃ mayi nyastaṃ viśīryate ।।67।।
yo hi karmasamārambhe bhavet tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ।
tadā tenābhibhūyeta mayīte nābhibhūyate ।।68।।
mayyeva kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ samāptaṃ jāyate tataḥ ।
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti bhogo vā vidyate'sya na ।।69।।
akurvan vihitaṃ karma pratiṣiddhaṃ tathā''caran ।
prāyaścittīyate dehī mayyarpaṇavivarjitaḥ ।।2.188.70 ।।
akāryāṇi na manujo jātu kuryāt tathāhi vai ।
svadharmasya parityāgaṃ paradharmānuvartanam ।।71 ।।
śaraṇāgatasantyāgaṃ bhṛtyasyā''bharaṇādikam ।
parasvāpābhiharaṇaṃ pitrā vādaṃ na vai caret ।।72।।
strītyāgaṃ ca yuvā kānto na vai kuryāt kadācana ।
patnī ca yuvatī kāntaṃ na tyajedvai kadācana ।।73।।
āśritānāṃ subharaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvadā matam ।
vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ kāryaṃ dīnānāṃ tu sahāyatā ।।74।।
asatyaṃ na vadet kvāpi pāruṣyaṃ chalasaṃbhṛtam ।
jīvānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ naiva kuryād dayāparo bhavet ।।75।।
āśritānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca kuryāt kṣuttṛṭnivāraṇam ।
paropakāraṃ kuryācca sataśca bhojayet sadā ।।76।।
satāṃ sevāṃ prakuryācca mama sevāṃ ca sarvadā ।
ātmānaṃ sukhinaṃ kuryānnodvege svaṃ nayet kvacit ।।77।।
nā'nyānudvejayet kvāpi vṛthāmṛṣā'nṛtādibhiḥ ।
hareḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ kuryāt satataṃ vacasā hṛdā ।।78।।
dhyānaṃ hareḥ sadā kuryānmuktidaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
kuryācchubhāni karmāṇi nivarteta śubhetarāt ।।79।।
dadyād vittādi nityaṃ ca tena mucyeta kilbiṣāt ।
śiṣṭācāraḥ paro dharmo deśakālādiyojitaḥ ।।2.188.80 ।
sevitavyaḥ sa evātra pretyeha ca sukhepsunā ।
daivadeśe japaṃ kuryāt homaṃ copoṣaṇādikam ।।8 1 ।।
daivasandarśanaṃ jñānaṃ kuryādātmapraśodhanam ।
na garveṇa bhavet prājñaḥ kadācinmṛtyudharmavān ।।82।।
devānṛṣīnmanuṣyāँśca pitṝn gṛhyāśca devatāḥ ।
pūjayitvā hariṃ cāpi gṛhastho bhoktumarhati ।।।83 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā na lipyeta rājā prajā'tha sādhavaḥ ।
striyo dīnā vṛndalāśca tathā kurvantu sarvathā ।।84।।
mama nāma gṛṇannityaṃ smaranmāṃ sarvataḥ kṣaṇam ।
kurvan sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi nyasya na lipyate ।।85।।
tathā kurvantu satataṃ māṃ smṛtvā mayi cārpaṇam ।
ahaṃ mokṣyāmi sarvān me vaiṣṇavān matparāyaṇān ।।86।।
astu svasti tu bhavatāṃ rājñāṃ rājakuṭumbinām ।
prajānāṃ ca prajeśānāṃ dīnānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ।।87।।
astu svastyabalānāṃ ca madarthakṛtakarmaṇām ।
sarvadā svasti cāstveva hariḥ śaṃ vidadhātu vaḥ ।।88।।
ityuktvā rādhike bālakṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
parīśānasabhāyāṃ tu kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīmabhūttadā ।।89।।
rājā pūjāṃ ca vidadhe'saṃkhyamauktikahīrakaiḥ ।
hārādyairambarādyaiśca candanādyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।। 2.188.90।।
ārārtrikaṃ mahaccakre rājñī rājakumārikāḥ ।
kumārāśca pradhānāśca prajāścāpi pracakrire ।।9 1 ।।
vandanaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā cakhaduśca prasādakam ।
hariṇā karadattaṃ ca tataśca rājakanyakāḥ ।।92।।
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākā yuvatyo mugdhamānasāḥ ।
hareḥ karaṃ jagṛhuśca vivāhavidhinā tadā ।।93 ।।
karagṛhottaraṃ śīghraṃ rājā mahotsavaṃ niśi ।
bhojayitvā mahīmānān hariṃ prāghūṇikādikān ।।94।।
kārayāmāsa lalitaṃ nṛtyagītikalādibhiḥ ।
rātrau prāghūṇikāḥ sarve viśrāntiṃ cāpuruttamām ।।95।।
kanyakāstu navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire'tibhāvataḥ ।
prātarutthāya bhagavān naijaṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ।।96।।
rājā'pi tvāyayau kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ ca pupūja tam ।
evaṃ mahotsavo rādhe vṛtto vai pārameśvaraḥ ।।97।।
parīśānānagaryāṃ copadāḥ prajāstato daduḥ ।
vidāyaṃ jagṛhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā nṛpaḥ ।।98।।
dugdhapānādikaṃ sarvān kārayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
lomaśastu prajābhyo vai manuṃ dadau ca tārakam ।।99।।
hariḥ sajjo trabhūvā'tha gantu parījaparvatam ।
indurāyo nṛpastasyā''grahaṃ cāti cakāra ha ।। 2.188.10 0।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta harirvimānamāsthitaḥ ।
anye vimānagāstatrā'bhavaँstato nṛpājñayā ।। 101 ।।
vyomamārgeṇa ca yayuścendurāyasya rāṣṭrakam ।
harirvilokayāmāsa bhūtalaṃ parvatānvitam ।। 1 02।।
svāgatārthaṃ cendurāyastvagre yayau kuṭumbavān ।
sanmānatūryaninadāstadā'bhavan samantataḥ ।। 10 3।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne parīśānāprajādibhya upadeśadānaṃ pūjanaṃ vimānaiḥ saptamyāṃ prātaḥ parījarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 188 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 188 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 189
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 190 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrīhariḥ śobhāṃ parīnijādrisaṃbhavām ।
ambarādeva parito lokayāmāsa vṛkṣajām ।। 1 ।।
tatpaścime tu nagarīṃ vāyūnākhyāṃ śubhāṃ sthitām ।
vilokya tatra janatā darśanārthamupasthitāḥ ।। 2 ।।
svāgatārthaṃ tu rājānaṃ samupasthitamagrataḥ ।
bhūpadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayadvimānakam ।। 3 ।।
udyāne rājasaudhāgre vanatulye'tisundare ।
avateruśca sarvāṇi vimānānyambarāttataḥ ।। 4 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo vimānātsvādaṃganaṃ prati cāyayau ।
rājā hārān dadau kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe sumasuvarṇajān ।। 9 ।।
anyeṣāṃ svāgataṃ cāpi yathārhaṃ tvakarottadā ।
ninādaśravaṇenā'tha hariḥ prasannatāṃ gataḥ ।। 6 ।।
samuttīrya tadā rājasaudhe viśrāntimāpa ha ।
pādau prakṣālya rājādyāścaraṇāmṛtamāpapuḥ ।। 7 ।।
miṣṭānnādyaiśca vividhairbhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।
mahārājaṃ kuṭumbādīn maharṣīn brahmayoṣitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
sarvānanyān mahīmānān bhojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।
madhyāhne ca hariḥ prāpa viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ param ।। 9 ।।
rājā sainyaṃ mahat svasya suśṛṃgāryāvadaddharim ।
vāyūnāyāṃ nagaryāṃ me darśanadānahetave ।। 2.189.10 ।।
sasainyo'haṃ samicchāmi bhramaṇaṃ bhavataḥ prabho ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha gajapīṭhe'tiśobhite ।। 11 ।।
ambālikāyāṃ kānakyāṃ niṣasāda tadetare ।
yathāyogyeṣu vāheṣu niṣeduśca tataḥ param ।। 1 2।।
prāvādyanta suvādyāni tūryāṇi vividhāni ca ।
yantrāṇāṃ sphoṭanaśabdā mānadāśca tadā'bhavan ।। 1 3।।
prajāḥ paryo harikṛṣṇaṃ gauryo nijāṃgaṇādiṣu ।
vardhayāmāsurīśeśaṃ lājāpuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।। 14।।
phalādīnyarpayāmāsuḥ pupūjurdadṛśuściram ।
ātmānaṃ kṛtakṛtyaṃ ca menire tāḥ prajāstadā ।। 15।।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ yayau hariḥ ।
rājā rājñī mahāpūjāṃ cakraturbahuvastubhiḥ ।। 16।।
svarṇapātrāṇi raupyāṇi mudrāśca hīrakādikān ।
dadau śrīharaye rājopadā ambarabhūṣaṇam ।। 17।।
rājñyājñayā tadā kanyādvayaṃ kāntaṃ hariṃ tadā ।
pravīkṣya bālakṛṣṇasya karaṃ jagṛhaturmudā ।। 18।।
vivāhavidhinā tatrotsavaḥ samyag vyajāyata ।
rājā dadarśa kṛpayā jāmātāraṃ caturbhujam ।। 1 9।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ karuṇāmukham ।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā parvatastho'pyaparvakam ।।2.189.20 ।।
avidyāparvaśūnyastvaṃ māyāguṇavivarjitaḥ ।
pāhi saṃghātadharmebhyo naya dhāmā'kṣaraṃ tava ।।21 ।।
anādyantaḥ parabrahma bālakṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ।
harikṛṣṇo bhavānāste naro nārāyaṇo bhavān ।।22।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhā devā gandharvadānavāḥ ।
pannagā rākṣasā yakṣā yaṃ na jānanti tattvataḥ ।।22 ।।
yoginaḥ sādhavaḥ satyo jñāninastāpaseśvarāḥ ।
yaṃ na jānanti deveśaṃ kuto'yaṃ bhagavāniti ।।14।।
tasmai me nama ityastu pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ।
yasmin janiḥ puṣā naṣṭirbhūtānāṃ te namonamaḥ ।।25।।
viśvātman viśvakarmātman viśvakarmekṣaṇādiman ।
karmaṇāmapi naiṣkarmyaṃ dadhaँstvaṃ pāhi sāgarāt ।।26।।
sahasrakiraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvataścakṣuṣaṃ prabhum ।
anantakarapādādyaṃ namāmi parameśvaram ।। 27।।
aṇuṣvaṇuṃ mahāntaṃ ca mahatsvapi dhruvaṃ harim ।
gariṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhamatyūrdhvaṃ tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ।।28 ।।
atibhūtādikarmāṇaṃ buddhīndriyādyagocaram ।
purāṇapuruṣaṃ brahma tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ।।29।।।
jagatkośaṃ cātmayoniṃ sanātanaṃ jagatpatim ।
sarvapatiṃ hiraṇvarṇaṃ tvāṃ namāmi pareśvaram ।।2.189.3 0।।
tapate śītalāyā'pi prakāśāya ca te namaḥ ।
svarāya sārthatattvāya gītirūpāya te namaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tvamoṃkāro'vatārastvaṃ vyūhastvaṃ tvaṃ caturbhujaḥ ।
bhūmā tvaṃ ca mahāviṣṇurvirāṭ tvaṃ kamalāśayaḥ ।।32।।
tvaṃ kriyā karaṇaṃ kartā karma tvaṃ kārakastathā ।
draṣṭā sākṣī mahākālaḥ kavalastvaṃ ca te namaḥ ।।33।।
sarvarūpāya śāntāya kāṃbhareyāya te namaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇāya gopālajāya te namaḥ ।।34।।
sarvapāpapraśāntāya sarvaduḥkhaharāya ca ।
ātmapātheyarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ।।35।।
gṛhaṃ me pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇavallabhasvāminā kṛtam ।
nimagnaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ me tvayoddhṛtaṃ pragṛhya mām ।।36।।
namaste sarvalokeṣu sarvātmasu ca te namaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇa mahākṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeśvara namo'stu te ।।37।।
ityuktvā rādhike rājā cendurāyo namo'karot ।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇastu taṃ prāha śubhāṃ giram ।। 38।।
rājan bhaktiṃ pravilokya parāṃ tava mayi dhruvām ।
manāg divyaṃ svarūpaṃ me darśitaṃ ca mayā'tra te ।। 3 9।।
kanyādvayaṃ mamedaṃ yat hastagrahaṃ cakāra ha ।
tadā te mānase jātaṃ kathamevaṃ ca ko nvayam ।।2.189.40 ।।
saṃśayaṃ taṃ nirasituṃ kṛpayā darśitaṃ mama ।
caturbhujaṃ svarūpaṃ te dhyāyasvaitat sadā hṛdi ।।41 ।।
ityuktvā'saṃharad rūpaṃ mānavo'tha vyajāyata ।
papāta pādayoḥ rājā dadhāra caraṇau hṛdi ।।42।।।
sāśrunetro'bhavaccāpi prayayāce kṣamāṃ kuru ।
sarvaṃ jagat tavaivāsti tatra kiṃ kanyakādvayam ।।43 ।।
ityuktvā vidhinā cakre mahotsavaṃ tadā nṛpaḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa sarvāṃśca pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।44।।
hariścopādideśāpi yathā nirbandhanaṃ bhavet ।
rājan karmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sampadyate vipadyate ।।45।।
madāśrayaṃ tu tatkarma vyatyeti sveṣṭakṛddhi tat ।
mamāśrayabalaṃ tādṛk karma syādanyathāphalam ।।46।।
devatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ pūjanaṃ satām ।
ānṛṇyaṃ tatkarotyeva pitrośca pūjanaṃ tathā ।।47।।
rājñāṃ dharmaḥ samutthānaṃ tena daivaṃ prajāyate ।
ubhayaṃ tat prasambhūya śrīpradaṃ muktidaṃ tathā ।।48।।
pauruṣaṃ prathamaṃ kāryaṃ tato daivaṃ samāśrayet ।
vinā''rambhaṃ prayatnaṃ vā phalabhāṅ na bhavet kvacit ।।49।।
pauruṣaṃ cāpi daivaṃ ca satyenāsāditaṃ yadi ।
dhruvasiddhipradaṃ syāttat pretya ceha sukhāvaham ।।2.189.50 ।।
śīladāntimārdavāḍhyo janaḥ śrīsevito bhavet ।
kāraṇaṃ svasya saukhyasya parabrahma vicintayet ।।51 ।।
kāraṇaṃ naiva hanyādvai tatkṛte svo vihanyate ।
jalādagnirbrāhmaṇātkṣatriyo'śmanaśca loṣṭhakam ।।52।।
utpannaṃ yadi hetuṃ svaṃ hantuṃ yāti vinaśyati ।
ātmā jñānaṃ kriyā karma samutpannā hareḥ puraḥ ।।5 3 ।।
hariṃ cenna bhajate'sāvātmahā harihā bhavet ।
kṛṣṇaghātaparasyā'sya vināśo vahnivad bhavet ।।54।।
tasmādahaṃ sadā rakṣyo dhāryo mantavya ādarāt ।
smartavyaśca pūjanīyo dāsye muktiṃ hi bandhanāt। ।।55।।
vṛthā saṃpariheyāni vyasanāni mumukṣubhiḥ ।
vyasanaṃ bhojanaṃ pānaṃ śayanaṃ narmakāritā ।।56।।
rañjanaṃ nityasaṃlagnaṃ yathāpekṣātireki tat। ।
mayi cennyastamevaitad vyasanaṃ na nigadyate ।।57।।
nirvāhamātrā'pekṣaṃ tad vyasanaṃ na nigadyate ।
ayogyanupayogī ca dyutādistu vipanmatā ।।58।।
vipadāṃ tu padaṃ nityaṃ duḥkhaśokānuyāyi vai ।
yatra tat syāt kathaṃ saukhyaṃ vindeta mānavo nijam ।।99।।
tasmād vicārya nairarthyaṃ tyajennisargadūṣakam ।
evaṃ vai vartamānā cet prajā syād varapaddhatiḥ ।।2.189.60।।
tadā dharmo bhavet tatra bhaktyā ca śraddhayā yutaḥ ।
yatra dharmaśca tatrā'haṃ nivasāmi nirantaram ।।6 1 ।।
pratyakṣo vā ca hṛdaye rakṣayāmi nijāśritam ।
bālān rakṣati māteva taṃ rakṣāmi vṛṣānvitam ।।62।।
tasmād dharmayutāḥ sarve māṃ bhajantu prajādayaḥ ।
uddhariṣyāmi kāmodāt sāgarānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।63।।
mūrtiṃ me sthāpayantvatra nityadarśanahetave ।
gamiṣye tvadya saṃsnātumindirāyā jale śubhe ।।64।।
svasti vo'stu sukhaṃ cāstu sadā''rogyaṃ nirāmayam ।
ityuktvā cāsanāt kṛṣṇaḥ samuttasthau tataḥ param ।।65।।
nṛpo yānāni sarvāṇi vyomayānāni yāni ca ।
sajjayāmāsa śīghraṃ ca vidāyaṃ nṛpatirdadau ।।66।।
indirāyāṃ mahānadyāṃ snātvā supānarāṣṭrakam ।
gantavyameva sāyaṃ vai ceti niścayato hariḥ ।।67।।
sajjo bhūtvā samārohad vimānaṃ cāparepi ca ।
yānānyāruhya ca vimānānyāruhyā'mbare'bhavan ।।68।।
rājā rājñī kuṭumbaṃ ca prajāḥ kṣamā yayācire ।
prasthānasya ca tūryāṇāṃ ninādā gītayastathā ।।69।।
jayaśabdā harṣanādā jīvaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
supānamuninā sārdhaṃ mudrāṇḍena nṛpeṇa ca ।।2.189.70।।
sahasthenārthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau puraḥ ।
vardhitaścāñjalivrātairindirātaṭamāyayau ।।71 ।।
avatīrya viśāle ca pradeśe yānatastadā ।
sasnau haristathā sarve sasnustīrthaṃ hyabhūddhi tat ।।72।।।
dānaṃ śrībhagavāँstatra supānamunaye dadau ।
hareḥ snānāmṛtavāri papurbhaktajanāstadā ।।।73 ।।
yatra snāto haristatra vetālā bahavo'bhavan ।
pūrvakarmakṛtāḥ sarve vigatiṃ tatra vai gatāḥ ।।74।।
te sarve tvāyayurgaurā api tejovihīnakāḥ ।
duḥkhino mānave rūpe nyavedayannasadgatim ।।।75।।
prasahya luṇṭhakāḥ pūrve vayamārāvaṇāḥ khalāḥ ।
prajāpīḍākarāścaurā nijapāpairmṛtā iha ।।76।।
śītajhaṃjhāpravātena pīḍitāḥ kṣutpipāsitāḥ ।
jātā vetālakāścātra nivasāmo nadītaṭe ।।77।।
uddhāraṃ kuru deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'mṛtaṃ jalam ।।78।।
dadau tebhyo'bhipānārthaṃ papuste pāpavarjitāḥ ।
tatkṣaṇaṃ jātapuṇyāśca divyadehāḥ surā yathā ।।79।।
devā devyo'bhavaँste ca svargārhāḥ śubhagātriṇaḥ ।
kṛpālurbhagavānāha lomaśāya mahātmane ।।2.189.80 ।।
manumebhyaḥ prāpayā'tra vaiṣṇavāḥ syustaduttaram ।
lomaśastān harermantraṃ śrāvayāmāsa satvaram ।।81 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
śrutvā mantraṃ vaiṣṇavāste divyarūpā vavandire ।।82।।
hariśceśānadevaṃ samprāha caitān nijāśritān ।
kailāse preṣaya śaṃbho gaṇāste santu tatra ca ।।83 ।।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastān saṃpreṣayāmāsa vai drutam ।
vyomnā kailāsalokaṃ ca hariḥ sarve janāstataḥ ।।84।।
vimānāni samāruhyā''yayuḥ supānarāṣṭrakam ।
dūrākhyasaritastīre madriṭāpattane śubhe ।।85।।
viśāle lakṣaśāle ca bahūdyāne samantataḥ ।
svarganibhe susamṛddhe vyomnaḥ śobhāṃ vyalokayan ।।86 ।।
śṛṃgāritaṃ hi bahudhā saṃsiktaṃ gandhavāribhiḥ ।
toraṇairgopūravaryairnagaraṃ bahvaśobhata ।।87।।
sainyaṃ rājā''jñayā sāyaṃ nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭaye ।
svāgatārthaṃ nadītīre mahodyāne tadā'ramat ।।88।।
vimānaṃ nṛpatiḥ svasya samavātārayat tataḥ ।
ṛṣiḥ rājā prajāścāpi svāgatārthaṃ puro'bhavan ।।89।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstato'bhavan ।
yantraśabdā janaghoṣāstūpaśabdāstato'bhavan ।। 2.189.90।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharirnijam ।
mahodyāne'vātārayad rājasaudhasamīpataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadā'mbarāt ।
rādhike harṣanādaiśca lājā'kṣatasumādibhiḥ ।।92।।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajā rājādayastadā ।
jayatvasaṃkhyatattvādhidevaścetiravān vyadhuḥ ।।93 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne indurāyarāṣṭre tatsaudhe hareḥ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vāyūnānagarībhramaṇam upadeśanaṃ vidāya saptamyāṃ sāyam indirānadī - snānaṃ vetāloddhāro mudrāṇḍarājarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ cetyādi-
nirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 189।।


← adhyāyaḥ 189 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 190
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 191 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā mudrāṇḍo mādhave tadā ।
puṣpahārān svarṇahārān ārpayat samapūjayat ।। 1 ।।
rājaveṣaṃ bahuśobhamadhārayattadā harim ।
madriṭānagarīṃ sāyaṃ bhrāmayituṃ samārthayat ।। 2 ।।
sarvāṃstatra mahīmānān pupūja rājakeśarī ।
supānarṣiśca tilakaṃ candrakaṃ haraye'karot ।। 3 ।।
jalapānaṃ dadau paścād vāhaneṣu nṛpo'khilān ।
nyaṣādayad satūryāṇi vyanādayacchubhāni vai ।। 4 ।।
harirnavaṃ rathaṃ śubhraṃ kambalājinasaṃvṛtam ।
yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirgobhiḥ pāṇḍuhurairdevalakṣaṇaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
tathā'gryaikena mahatā pāṇḍureṇa vṛṣeṇa ca ।
bandibhiḥ stūyamānaścā'bhyarcyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
āruroha rathaṃ svarṇamaṇimauktikarājitam ।
jagrāha raśmīn maudrāṇḍaḥ kumārastrigrasāṇḍakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
gavādakavitarṣiśca dhārayāmāsa chatrakam ।
dhriyamāṇaṃ mahacchatraṃ pāṇḍuraṃ rathamadhyagam ।। 8 ।।
śuśubhe tārakāyuktacandramiva suhīrakaiḥ ।
cāmaravyajane tvasya munī jagṛhaturmudā ।। 9 ।।
supānarṣistathā mitramaharṣiśca mahāvratau ।
candraraśmisamakāntiyute dīrghātimañjule ।। 2.190.10 ।।
kṛṣṇasya pitarau rādhe bhrātaraśca svasā tathā ।
rathe sthitā adṛśyanta sarvedevasamāstadā ।। 11 ।।
rathaṃ śubhraṃ samāsthāya yuktaṃ turagasatamaiḥ ।
anvayāt pṛṣṭhato rudraśceśāno gaṇasevitaḥ ।। 1 2।।
rathaṃ hemamayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mahādīrghāśvayojitam ।
lomaśaśca samāsthāyā'nvayād rudraṃ guruḥ svayam ।। 1 3।।
vṛkāyano nīlakarṇaścobhau pītarathena ca ।
yayatustu tato nīlavarṇāśvayojitena vai ।। 14।।
