brahmapriyāstataḥ sarvāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
narayānaistathā yānairuccāvacairyayustataḥ ।। 15।।
gāṃgeyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve kanyakāśca tathā'pare ।
rājakanyāśca rājñyaścānvayurbhavyaiḥ rathādibhiḥ ।। 16।।
tato rathāśca bahulā nāgāścoṣṭravṛṣānvitāḥ ।
padātayo hayarūḍhāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanuvrajan ।। 17।।
tato vaitālikāḥ sūtā māgadhāścāraṇāstathā ।
subhāṣitāni gāyanto yayuḥ prajājanānvitāḥ ।। 18।।
tadā tu darśanaṃ viṣṇorbabhūvā'pratimaṃ sukham ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'nupamaṃ bhuvi ।। 19।।
madriṭāyāṃ hareḥ praveśane nagaravāsibhiḥ ।
nagarī rājamārgādyā bahudhā samalaṃkṛtāḥ ।। 2.190.20 ।।
pāṇḍurairmālyavargaiśca patākābhiśca medinī ।
saṃskṛtā rājamārgā'bhūd dhūpanaiśca pradhūpitā ।।2 1 ।।
tathā cūrṇaiḥ sugandhānāṃ nānāpuṣpapriyaṃgubhiḥ ।
mālyadāmabhiḥ saṃsaktairnagarī śobhitā kṛtā ।।22।।
kuṃbhā dvāri kṛtāścāsan jalapūrṇā navāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sitāḥ sumanaso gaurā nikṣiptāstatra tatra ca ।।23।।
yathāsvalaṃkṛtānyeva dvārāṇi raṃgavallibhiḥ ।
evaṃ śṛṃgāritāyāṃ ca nagaryāṃ sa viveśa ha ।।24।।
praveśane harestatra janānāṃ puravāsinām ।
didṛkṣūṇāṃ sahasrāṇi samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।25।।
rājamārgo'tiśuśubhe samalaṃkṛtacatvaraḥ ।
candrodaye'bdhivṛddhiśca pūrāgatāgatairyathā ।।26।।
prajānāṃ rājamārgeṣu vṛddhiścā'cintitā'bhavat ।
gṛhāṇi rājamārgeṣu ratnanaddhāni sarvathā ।।27।।
prākampantīva bhāreṇa gaurīṇāṃ pūrṇitāni vai ।
tāḥ striyaśca praśaśaṃsuḥ kāṃbhareyaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।।28।।
brahmapriyā imā dhanyā yāḥ prāptāḥ puruṣottamam ।
gaurīṇāṃ vratacaryāṇi praśaśaṃsustathā striyaḥ ।।29।।
praśaṃsāvacanaistāsāṃ prītiśabdaiśca rādhike ।
jayaśabdaiḥ kīrtanaiśca puramāsīnnināditam ।। 2.190.30 ।।
pratirathyaṃ pratimārgasaṃgamaṃ praticatvaram ।
pratihaṭṭaṃ pratiharmyaṃ prajā ānarcurīśvaram ।।3 1 ।।
bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājamārgeṇa ca tato hariḥ ।
alaṃkṛtaṃ śobhamānamupāyād rājaveśma ha ।।32।।
tatra prakṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ paurā jānapadā api ।
ūcuḥ karṇasukhā vāco diṣṭyā prāpto'si mādhava ।। 33 ।।
bhavatkṛpā bhavataśca darśane'tra matā śubhā ।
anyathā darśanaṃ kṛṣṇa kathaṃ te bhāgyamantarā ।।34।।
evaṃ rājakuladvāri maṃgalairabhitoṣitaḥ ।
praviveśa hariryānāduttīrya rājamandiram ।। 35।।
rājā maharṣayaścāpi rājapatnī kumārikāḥ ।
gandhamālyai ratnahārairārcayan kṛṣṇavallabham ।। 36।।
sumanomodakai ratnairhiraṇyena ca bhūriṇā ।
upadābhirvividhābhirvividhaiśca kimicchakaiḥ ।। 37।।
tatraivā'vasaraṃ jñātvā mohapāśavaśaṃgatāḥ ।
rājakanyā harerhastaṃ jagṛhurdaśa pañca ca ।। 38।।
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣo'bhūnnāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā ।
suhṛdāṃ prītijanakaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutisukhāvaham ।। 39।।
tathā dundubhinirghoṣaḥ śaṃkhānāṃ ca manoramaḥ ।
jayaṃ pravadatāṃ cāpi prādurabhūtsvanaḥ śubhaḥ ।।2.190.40।।
śrutvā śrībālakṛṣṇaśca prasannahṛdayastadā ।
kāñcane rājasaudhasthe nyaṣīdat paramāsane ।।41।।
upādideśa bahudhā sabhāyāṃ bhūpatervṛṣān ।
vyasanī ced bhaved rājā lokaiḥ saparibhūyate ।।42।।
udvejayati lokaṃ yo dveṣṭi sukhaṃ na vindati ।
svapriyaṃ tu parityajya lokahitaṃ samācaret ।।43 ।।
dhīratāṃ na tyajet kvāpi rājā lokahitāvahaḥ ।
nātyarthaḥ parihāsaśca bhṛtyaiḥ kāryo nṛpeṇa vai ।।44।।
avamanyanti rājānaṃ saṃgharṣādupajīvinaḥ ।
sve sthāne na tu tiṣṭhanti laṃghayanti tu tadvacaḥ ।।45।।
preṣyamāṇā na gacchanti guhyaṃ prakāśayanti ca ।
ayācyamapi yācante bhojyāni bhakṣayanti ca ।।46।।
kruśyanti paridīpyanti kāryāṇi ghātayanti ca ।
vañcanāṃ cāpi kurvanti luñcāṃ gṛhṇanti vai kvacit ।।47।।
hastākṣaraiḥ kṛtrimaiśca sādhayanti nijāṃ kṛtim ।
strīrakṣibhiśca sajjante tulyaveṣā bhavanti ca ।।48।।
vāntaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ cāpi kurvate rājasannidhau ।
nirlajjā nṛpanikaṭe bhūtvā ghnanti yaśo'pyanu ।।49।।
rājavāhaṃ hayaṃ hastirathādyārohayanti ca ।
sabhāyāmapi rājānaṃ cā'jñāninaṃ vadanti ca ।।2.190.50 ।।
kruddhe nṛpe hasantyeva mantraṃ visraṃsayanti ca ।
guptaṃ prakāśaṃ kurvanti śāsanaṃ laṃghayanti ca ।।5 1।।
helanaṃ cāpi kurvanti nindanti sannidhāvapi ।
asmanmuṣṭyāṃ nṛpo'styeva lokāँścaivaṃ vadantyapi ।।52।।
tasmād bhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ harṣulo na mṛdurbhavet ।
udyamaṃ saṃprakuryācca bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā ।।53।।
lokānāṃ rañjanād rājā nṛpadharmo hi rañjanam ।
satyasya rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi vyavahārasya rakṣaṇam ।।54।।
kṣānteśca rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rājamārgāccalenna ca ।
ātmavān puruṣārthaṣu jāgran rājatvamarhati ।।55।।
mānavāḥ sarvadharmāśca rakṣitavyā nṛpeṇa vai ।
vṛddhāḥ prasevanīyāśca sevanīyāśca sādhavaḥ ।।56।।
sadbhyo dadyādasadbhyastu samādadyānnṛpo vṛṣāt ।
śiṣṭān śiṣṭakriyāścāpi mānayet sarvathā nṛpaḥ ।।57।।
viduṣo rakṣayed rājā nītijñān śāstrakovidān ।
kathākārān dharmadhartṝn parameśopadeśakān ।।58।।
gurūँśca mānayed rājā pūjayed bahudānakaiḥ ।
sādhūn sampūjayennityaṃ bhojayed śṛṇuyāt kathāḥ ।।59।।
devālayān kārayecca pūjāprabandhamācaret ।
nityaṃ bhaktyā svayaṃ rājā yajeta devatāḥ priyān ।।2.190.60।।
daśāṃśaṃ vā ca viṃśāṃśaṃ śatāṃśaṃ pañcamāṃśakam ।
rājyarddhidravyadhānyebhyo'rpayeddharmārthameva saḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tīrthāni rakṣayed rājā kratūँśca kārayettathā ।
goviprastrīdīnabālān yatīn saṃrakṣayecchritān ।।62।।
nityaṃ dadyāttu dānāni pūjayitvā gurūn janān ।
vṛddhān vandeta satataṃ gṛhṇīyādāśiṣastataḥ ।।63।।
bhagavantaṃ smarennityaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca karmasu ।
na trāsaṃ janayet kiṃcidāyurnāśakaraṃ na ca ।।64।।
puṇyanāśakaraṃ cāpi naiva kuryāt kadācana ।
vighasāśī bhavennityaṃ brahmayajñaparo bhavet ।।65।।
prajāyāṃ saṃprapaśyettu putravātsalyamuttamam ।
māṃ hariṃ saṃsthitaṃ sarvāsvapi matvā'rcayed yathā ।।66।।
hiṃsanaṃ na vṛthā rājā kuryāt svārthārthamityapi ।
satkāryāṇi sadā loke samārabheta bhāvataḥ ।।67।।
puṇyakāryeṣu sāhāyyaṃ dadyāt kuryāt svayaṃ hyapi ।
sādhūn saṃvāsayed rājye seveta paramādarāt ।।68।।
bhagavantaṃ ca bhaktāँśca bhrāmayennagarādiṣu ।
mālāvartanamādadhyād rājā nityāsanasthitaḥ ।।69।।
vartayet svakuṭumbādi dharme karmaṇi bhaktiṣu ।
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca nivedanam ।।2.190.70।।
dānaṃ dharmaṃ bhajanaṃ ca sevāṃ kurvannṛpaḥ svayam ।
evaṃ varteta ced rājā mucyate na tu badhyate ।।71 ।।
yasya kūṭaṃ na kapaṭaṃ na māyā satsu vai kvacit ।
yasya gehe kathā jñānaṃ bhajanaṃ devapūjanam ।।72।।
satāṃ vartmānugaścāpi tyāgīva vartate ca yaḥ ।
sa bhavedvai kvacinmokṣabhāgīśvareśasevayā ।।73।।
yathā rājā tathā dharmo yathā dharmastathā prajāḥ ।
kṛṣṇadharmo'tiyatnena rājñā rakṣyo mumukṣuṇā ।।74।।
svasmin bhāgavate dharme tiṣṭhatyeva kuṭumbakam ।
bāndhavāḥ suhṛdaścānye prajādyā api sarvathā ।।75।।
varteran sātvate dharme yathā rājā tathā prajāḥ ।
tasmād rājan prajāścāpi sarve kurvantu sāttvatīm ।।76।।
bhaktiṃ me mokṣadāṃ śreṣṭhāmuddhariṣye madāśritān ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike ।।77।।
rājā prajādayaḥ sarve jagṛhustadvacāṃsi vai ।
mantraṃ mantravihīnā ye te sañjagṛhuraiśvaram ।।78।।
kaṇṭhīṃ ca bhajanaṃ nāmaraṭaṇaṃ jagṛhuśca te ।
tataḥ sabhāṃ visarjayāmāsa mudrāṇḍako nṛpaḥ ।।79।।
bhojanāni hariścāpi kuṭumbaṃ ca maharṣayaḥ ।
īśānādyā mahīmānāścakrurbrahmapriyādikāḥ ।।2.190.80।।
rātrau viśrāntimāsādya kṛtvotthāyā''plavādikam ।
nityapūjāṃ vidhāyātha dugdhapānādikaṃ tathā ।।81।।
hariḥ sajjo'bhavad gantuṃ pūrtagaṇḍapradeśakān ।
tadā rājā prārthayacchrīhariṃ śaivālapattanam ।।82।।
gantuṃ gavādakavitānadītaṭasthamuttamam ।
haristathā'stviti prāha jayaśabdaiśca kīrtanaiḥ ।।83।।
saha pūjāṃ samāgṛhya svaṃ vimānamarūruhat ।
anye niṣeduḥ śīghraṃ ca mudrāṇḍako'pi tatkṣaṇam ।।84।।
vimānamadhiruhyāgre yayau svāgatasiddhaye ।
vimānāni viceruśca śaivālapattanaṃ prati ।।85।।
kṣaṇāt prāpuśca taṃ deśaṃ gavādakavitāntikam ।
avaterurvimānāni gavādakavitātaṭe ।।86।।
rājā nijālaye kṛṣṇaṃ sarvānānarca bhāvataḥ ।
udyānaphalapuṣpādyairapūjayaddhariṃ nṛpaḥ ।।87।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'tha nagare'bhrāmayatprabhum ।
kṛtvaivaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi pattanam ।।88।।
dugdha phalādikaṃ jagdhvā prāpya pūjāṃ nṛpādibhiḥ ।
prajābhiśca kṛtāṃ sarvāmāśiṣaḥ sampradāya ca ।।89।।
tanmānena samaṃ śīghramiyeṣa gantumacyutaḥ ।
gaṇḍo nāma nṛpastatra netuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāgataḥ ।।2.190.90।।
pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sākaṃ hariḥ sajjo'bhavattataḥ ।
śīghraṃ vimānamāruhya datvā''śīrvacanāni ca ।।91 ।।
yayau śṛṇvan jayanādān nadīṃ gavādayānikām ।
samullaṃghya nadīdeśānākāśe vyacaraddhariḥ ।।92।।
trigirāṃ ca nadīṃ prāpya rājā vai gaṇḍakaḥ puraḥ ।
pūrtagaṇḍarṣiṇā sākaṃ svāgatārthamavātarat ।।93।।
līśavanaṃ pattanaṃ ca śṛṃgāritaṃ hi rādhike ।
sainyayuktaṃ śubhaṃ gatvodyāne svāgatamācarat ।।94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne madriṭānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ rājaveśmāgamanaṃ pūjanam upadeśo bhojanaṃ niśottaram aṣṭamyāṃ prātaḥkṛtyottaraṃ prayāṇaṃ śaivālanagarīṃ bhramitvā pūrtagaṇḍarṣipradeśeṣu gaṇḍakanṛpasya līśavanapattanaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 190 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 190 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 191
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 192 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike pūrtagaṇḍarṣirgaṇḍako nṛpaḥ ।
rājñī kumārikāścāpi kumārāśca tathā'pare ।। 1 ।।
bāndhavāścāmātyavargāḥ svāgatārthaṃ puro'bhavan ।
vimānamambarād rājodyāne hyavātaraddhareḥ ।। 2 ।।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvateruḥ samantataḥ ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta tūryanādāstadā'bhavan ।। 3 ।।
agāyanta ca gītāni jayaśabdā babhūvire ।
paṭahānāṃ vigulānāṃ dundubhīnāṃ ravottamāḥ ।। 4 ।।
prajāharṣabharaiḥ śabdairdiśo hyanādayan daśa ।
harirvimānādutthāya śreṇyā bahiḥ samāgamat ।। 5 ।।
rājā ṛṣiḥ kuṭumbādyāḥ puṣpādyaiḥ samavardhayan ।
hārairakṣatavaryaiśca lājābhiḥ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
gajayanvyā harikṛṣṇaṃ rājā nyaṣādayattathā ।
anyān yathocitavāheṣvapi sadvāhaneṣu ca ।। 7 ।।
gantryādiṣu paṭolle ca śakaṭīṣu nyaṣādayat ।
vādyaśabdaiḥ saha deveśvaraṃ līśavanāṃ purīm ।। 8 ।।
bhrāmayāmāsa sotsāhaḥ prajāścakruḥ samarhaṇam ।
darśanaṃ pādapūjāṃ ca bahūpadābhirādarāt ।। 9 ।।
samudratīraśobhāṃ ca vilokya bhagavāँstataḥ ।
rājaprāsādake śreṣṭhe samāyāt sakuṭumbakaḥ ।। 2.191.1 0।।
rājā rājñyā ca kanyābhiḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
candanairgandhasāraiśca kusumairambaraiḥ śubhaiḥ ।। 11 ।।
śītahāraiścaurṇaveṣai ratnairābhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ।
dravyaiḥ phalaiḥ prapūjāṃ śrīhareścakruḥ pradhānakāḥ ।। 12।।
atha gaṇḍasya vai kanyā nava tatra kumārikā ।
karagrahaṃ hareścakrurvivāhavidhinā drutam ।। 13।।
rājā babhūva ca bhāgyāt kṛtakṛtyo nṛpī hyapi ।
tadutsavaṃ mahāntaṃ ca cakre pūjanamānanaiḥ ।। 14।।
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa rājā pakvānnapūritam ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ tatra kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।। 15।।
rājā kṛṣṇāya bahudhā'rpayāmāsa vibhūtikāḥ ।
bhagavān pūrṇagaṇḍāya ṛṣaye tā dadau tadā ।। 16।।
bhuktvā viśrāntimāpuśca pānatāmbūlacarvaṇaiḥ ।
dugdhapānaiḥ svayaṃ rājā mahīmānānarañjayat ।। 17।।
atha sāyaṃ sabhāsthāne bālakṛṣṇaḥ prajājanān ।
upādideśa bahudhā śāntivākyāni cāṃjasā ।। 18।।
rājye vā vāṭikāyāṃ vā gṛhe vāpi vane'pi vā ।
antarvṛttiparo dehī vivekī śāntimṛcchati ।। 1 9।।
tṛṣgātantuṃ suvicchidya bhogyavṛttiṃ vihāya ca ।
ātmasthityā sutiṣṭhed yaḥ sa śāntimadhigacchati ।। 2.191.20।।
īhā coparatā yasya liṅgaṃ nirliṅgatāṃ gatam ।
rasanā nīrasā yasya sa śāntimadhigacchati ।।21 ।।
śabdāstvākāśabhāgāśca sparśā dāvānalopamāḥ ।
rūpāṇi kuṣṭhatulyāni yasya śāntiṃ sa ṛcchati ।।22।।
nāryaḥ prāṇaharā yasya yasyā naraśca rākṣasaḥ ।
dṛśyate manasā tyāgāt sa śāntiṃ sā'bhiyāti vai ।। 23।।
dhātavo malarūpāśca kuṭumbaṃ vānarāyitam ।
bhṛtyāḥ kṣayasamā yasya sa śāntimabhiyāti vai ।। 24।।
śiṣyāḥ śatrusamā yasya putrā bhakṣaṇatatparā ।
deho yasya sadā rugṇaḥ sa śāntimabhiyāti vai ।। 25।।
vairāgyaṃ vartate yasya rāgasthalaṃ tu duḥkhadam ।
snehasthalaṃ nā'nukūlaṃ sa śāntimabhiyāti vai ।।26।।
bahubhoge bahuduḥkhe śāntiṃ yāti vivekavān ।
nā'haṃ deho na me bhogyaṃ nā'haṃ bhoktā hi dīnavat। ।। 27।।
nā'haṃ jaḍādhīna evaṃ vivekī śāntimṛcchati ।
nadīnāṃ ramyabhāgeṣu vanodyāneṣu mandire ।। 28।।
devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu nirjane śāntibhāg bhavet ।
yadā yatra na vai santi śatravo bahirāntarāḥ ।।29।।
āgantukāśca vā nityāstadā śāntiṃ pragacchati ।
kṣataduḥkho yathā nidrāvaśo duḥkhaṃ na vetti hi ।।2.191.30। ।
jagaddhato'pi jīvātmā tūryāgato na khidyati ।
vāsanāprahataḥ prāṇī sādhusaṃgatimṛcchati ।।3 1 ।।
sādhusevārataḥ syāccet sādhvīṃ śāntiṃ sa gacchati ।
satāṃ guṇān pragṛhṇīyāt satāṃ śīlaṃ samācaret ।।3 2।।
agrāhyaṃ varjayennityaṃ grāhyaṃ śubhaṃ samārthayet ।
taraṃgān mānasān dehī śamayet śāntimān bhavet ।। 33 ।।
vikalpān saṃśayān mohān tyajet guroranugrahāt ।
tarkān hetūn vivādāँśca tyajennijamanīṣayā ।।34।।
udvegān dāvahetūँśca jñātvā dūrād vivarjayet ।
āyatiṃ suvicāryaiva vartayet nirabhiplavaḥ ।। 35।।
hariṃ śaraṇamāsādya phalaṃ tatra samarpayet ।
ārabheta hariṃ dhyātvā māṃ kartāraṃ vibhāvya yaḥ ।। 36।।
madanusyūtabhāvena kuryāddhitaṃ hitārthadam ।
svasya vā'nyasya sutarāṃ śreyaskṛtaṃ samācaret ।। 37।।
jñānavijñānakośena dhanāḍhyatvaṃ vicārayet ।
aparigrahasampannastṛpto'tiśāntimāvahet ।।38।।
evaṃ vicārya satataṃ rājñā rājñyā prajādibhiḥ ।
anyonyahitamāśritya vartitavyaṃ suśāntaye ।।39।।
sevāṃ prajānāṃ rakṣāṃ ca rājarakṣāṃ parasparam ।
ātmabuddhyā sutabuddhyā samācaret suśāntidām ।।2.191.40।।
bṛhaspatirviśālākṣaḥ kāvyaḥ prācetasastathā ।
bharadvājo mahendraśca gauraśirā manustathā ।।41 ।।
brahmavādāsta evaite rakṣāṃ dharmaṃ parasparam ।
praśaṃsanti sadā kalpe kalpe rājapratāhitam ।।42।।
dānaṃ satāṃ sadā sevā satāṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ tathā ।
dākṣyaṃ satyaṃ cārjavaṃ cā'vekṣā samantatastathā ।।43।।
sīdatāṃ ca samuddhāraḥ kulīnānāṃ prasañjanam ।
sādhūnāmaparityāgaḥ sevā buddhimatāmapi ।।44।।
śatrumitraudāsyakānāṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ pare svake ।
nītidharmānusaraṇaṃ cānāryavarjanaṃ sadā ।।45।।
utthānaṃ sarvathā yogyaṃ loke kārye harau matau ।
mokṣe tyāge ca vairāgye dharmā rakṣāparā nvime ।।46 ।।
rakṣaṇīyāḥ sadā rājñā prajayā cāmṛtehayā ।
utthānenā'mṛtaṃ prāptāḥ surā mahendrasaṃhitāḥ ।।47।।
utthānena vihīnasya rakṣā dūraṃ prayāti hi ।
dharmotthānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ cācaret kriyām ।।48।।
yadyapyasya vipattiḥ syād rakṣādharmasya dehinaḥ ।
so'pyasya vipulo dharmo yato rakṣā'hameva vai ।।49।।
rakṣā ca rakṣakaścāhaṃ rakṣyaścāpyahameva ca ।
sadā rakṣākaraṃ cāhaṃ rakṣayāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।2.191.50 ।।
arakṣakān krūrabhāvān na rakṣāmi kadācana ।
rakṣako rājavargaśca matsvarūpo'sti bhūtale ।।51 ।।
tasmād rakṣā mama dharmo matkṛtā pālyatāṃ janaiḥ ।
ityucyamāne śrīkṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe parātmani ।।52।।
rādhike gaṇḍako rājā papraccha śrīnarāyaṇam ।
rājaśabdaḥ kathaṃ kasmāt kadā vai bhavatā kṛtaḥ ।।53 ।।
tulyaśārīrabhāve'pi tulyendriyātmake'pi ca ।
tulyaduḥkhasukhe tulyavikāre tulyavigrahe ।।54।।
tulyaśukrāsthimajje ca tulyamāṃsādisaṃbhṛte ।
tulyaprāṇaśarīre ca tulyamṛtyubhavānvite ।।55 ।।
evaṃvidhe'pi caikasmin rājatā kathamūrdhvagā ।
kathameko viśiṣṭāँśca śūrāँśca paṇḍitānapi ।।56 ।।
adhitiṣṭhati sattāvān pṛthvīṃ rakṣati caikalaḥ ।
prasādena tathaikasya lokaḥ sarvaḥ prasīdati ।।57 ।।
ekasminneva rāṣṭraṃ ca devavad yāti sannatim ।
bhagavaँstatkathaṃ sāmye'pyeṣā vai rājatā'tigā ।।58 ।।
vartate sarvamūrdhanyā vadātra kāraṇaṃ tu kim ।
śrutvā prāha hariḥ rādhe rājaniyamajāṃ kathām ।।59।।
ādau kṛtayuge cātra nāsīd rājyaṃ na rājyapaḥ ।
na rājā na ca daṇḍo'bhūd daṇḍyo nāsīcca daṇḍakṛt ।।2.191.60 ।।
satyadharmaiḥ prajā brāhmyo rakṣanti sma parasparam ।
kalpavṛkṣāḥ kalpavallyaścintāmaṇiśca kāmagauḥ ।।61 ।।
āsaiṃstena prajāḥ sarvāḥ svātmādhīnāḥ sukhāstadā ।
atha kāle kṛtānte ca kalpanāyāṃ balāni tu ।।62।।
kṣīṇatāṃ saṃgatānyeva tadā svatvaṃ pravartitam ।
mamedaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca na tavedaṃ vivāditam ।।63।।
evaṃ mamatāmohau ca prajāsvāviśatāṃ tadā ।
cintāḥ saṃkalparūpāśca niṣphalāśca tadā'bhavan ।।64।।
tṛṣṇādoṣā'bhiveśena dharmaḥ satyo vyanīnaśat ।
lobhasya vaśamāpannā aprāptasyā'bhimarśinaḥ ।।65।।
kāmo'paro mahān doṣaḥ prajāsu pratyapadyata ।
kāmaparān janān rāgo'niṣṭakṛd vai samaspṛśat ।।66।।
tena kāryaṃ tathā kāryaṃ nābhyajānanta mohitāḥ ।
agamyāgamanaṃ cāpi vācyāvācyaṃ vyajāyata ।।67।।
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ tathā dūṣyādūṣyaṃ ca pratyapadyata ।
viplute mānave loke brahmabhāvo nanāśa ha ।।68।।
brahmanāśe dharmanāśo devāstrāsaṃ tato'gaman ।
yayuśca pitaraṃ cā'jaṃ prasādyocuḥ suduḥkhinaḥ ।।69।।
brahman mānavaloke vai satyaṃ brahma layaṃ gatam ।
dharmo nāśaṃ gatastena vayaṃ svāhāvivarjitāḥ ।।2.191.70 ।।
kṣīṇatāṃ ca gatāḥ smo'dya mānavaiḥ samatāṃ gatāḥ ।
ato niḥśreyasaṃ yattad dhyāyasveha pitāmaha ।।71 ।।
brahmā''ha bhavatāṃ śreyaścintayāmi bhayāpaham ।
tatastretāmukhe brahmā dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmanām ।।72।।
mokṣaṃ ceti caturvargaṃ dharmaṃ cakre pṛthagguṇam ।
dharmarūpān niyamāँśca daṇḍarakṣādikalpitān ।।73।।
cakre yajñādirūpāँśca karmaphalādimiśritān ।
artharūpān padārthāṃśca kṣetravāṭīgṛhādikān ।।74।।
dhanasampatsvarūpāँśca cakre svatvādibodhakān ।
kāmarūpān niyamāँśca ṛtūn parasparānvitān ।।75।।
mohādiniyamāँścakre svasvabhogyavyavasthitān ।
mokṣadharmaṃ sāmarūpaṃ cārpaṇaṃ mayi mādhave ।।76।।
trivargārpaṇamevāpi mokṣadaṃ cetyanirṇayat ।
anyāni bahudhānyeva prakārāṇi hyanirṇayat ।।77।।
tāṃ nītiṃ śaṃkaraḥ pūrvaṃ jagrāheśānako hyayam ।
śaṃkaroktaṃ ca tacchāstraṃ vaiśālākṣaṃ tadā'bhavat ।।78।।
indrastasmātprajagrāha bāhudantakameva tat ।
bṛhaspatirlilekhedaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ tato'bhavat ।।79।।
auśanasaṃ tato jātaṃ tato nītiḥ pravartitā ।
devairviṣṇuścārthitaśca nītiśāstravidaṃ prati ।।2.191.80।।
tato nārāyaṇaścāhaṃ dadau vai mānasaṃ sutam ।
virajasaṃ tatputro'bhūt kīrtimān tasya putrakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kardamo'bhūt tasya putro'naṃganāmā subuddhimān ।
prajārakṣayitā sādhurdaṇḍanītiviśāradaḥ ।।82।।
tatsuto'bhūdaṃgarājo mṛtyuputrīṃ sunīthikām ।
vivāhya venaṃ krūraṃ vai putramekamajījanat ।।83।।
taṃ venaṃ dveṣiṇaṃ mantrakuśairjaghnurmaharṣayaḥ ।
mamanthurdakṣiṇaṃ corumṛṣayo venadehajam ।।84।।
niṣādaṃ janayāmāsurniṣādāśca tato'bhavan ।
bhūyo'sya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ mamanthuste maharṣayaḥ ।।85।।
tato'haṃ pṛthurūpaścā'bhavaṃ śastrī ca varmavān ।
nītiśāstrajña evā'haṃ rājaśabdamavāptavān ।।86।।
mayā devaiḥ saha bhūmiḥ samapāṭā vidhāpitā ।
saṃkalpena mayā sarvā rājyasmṛddhirnavīkṛtā ।।87।।
ādye tu yugaparyāye rājyaṃ vai sthāpitaṃ mayā ।
pṛthvī dugdhā prajārthaṃ ca prajā daṇḍena rakṣitā ।।88।।
rañjanādvai prajāḥ prāhuḥ rājā pṛthuriti kṣitau ।
kṣatatrāṇāt kṣatriyo'haṃ tato'bhavaṃ dvijo'pi san ।।89।।
pṛthivīsthāpanaṃ rājyasthāpanaṃ cāhameva tu ।
viṣṇuḥ sanātanastatrā'karavaṃ nītiyojim ।।2.191.90 ।।
mallalāṭāttadā jātaṃ kamalaṃ kānakaṃ śubham ।
śrīḥsaṃbhūtā tato devī kamalā dharmapatnikā ।।9 1।।
śrīrartharūpā'bhūd rājye kāmadā mokṣadā api ।
vaiṣṇavī śrīryadā rājye vartate mokṣadā tu sā ।।92।।
evaṃ tataḥ samārabhya devāśca naradevatāḥ ।
budhaistulyāḥ śabditāśca madaṃśā bhūbhṛto yataḥ ।।93।।
śraiṣṭhyamevaṃ mayā nyastaṃ rājñi rājatvasaṃjñakam ।
tena rājñā prajābhiśca draṣṭavyo'haṃ nijātmasu ।।94।।
pūjanīyo vandanīyaścārpaṇīyo'tibhāvataḥ ।
mayyarpitāstu māmeva prāpsyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।95।।
māṃ vihāyā'bhimantāro naijaṃ padaṃ tu ye nṛpāḥ ।
kṣayaṃ yāsyanti te nyūnaṃ rājavaṃśā daridrakāḥ ।।96।।
ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ jñātvā bhajantu māṃ janārdanam ।
rājarājeśvaraṃ nityaṃ caturvargaṃ nidhāya ca ।।97।।
mayyeveti hariḥ prāha rādhike ca sabhājanāḥ ।
jagṛhustadvacāṃsyeva nemuḥ sarve tato yayuḥ ।।98।।
hariḥ prāpa nijāvāsaṃ rājasaudhe ca bhojanam ।
cakārā'nye mahīmānāścakrurbhojanamādarāt ।।99।।
viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ prāpuḥ rātrau sarve'pi nidritāḥ ।
rādhike rājakanyāstaṃ kṛṣṇakāntaṃ siṣevire ।। 2.191.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne gaṇḍakarājadhānīṃ prati gamanaṃ līśavanānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanamupadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 191 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 191 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 192
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 193 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike navamīprātarmaṃgalaistūryaniḥsvanaiḥ ।
bandimāgadhasūtānāṃ vāgbhirjāgaritaḥ prabhu ।। 1 ।।
jajāgarustathā sarve nityavidhiṃ pracakrire ।
rājā dugdhādi bhojyādi tvānīya haraye dadau ।। 2 ।।
sarve cakrurdugdhapānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yathocitam ।
āśīrvādān dadau tatra bhūbhṛte śrīhariḥ prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
janatābhyastathā''śīrvāggauravādi dadau hariḥ ।
tato gantumabhavacca sajjo līnorṇarāṣṭrakam ।। 4 ।।
līnorṇanṛpatistatrāgatya cārthayadacyutam ।
phalāśanena ṛṣiṇā sārdhaṃ prabhustadā'vadat ।। 5 ।।
gaṇḍako nṛpatistatra vidāyaṃ pradadau bahu ।
harirvimānavaryaṃ ca samāruroha pūjitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
āruruhustathā'nye'pi prajājayadhvanīṃstadā ।
śṛṇvantaḥ sarva evaite prerayan vyomapattriṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
khāḍikāṃ ca samullaṃghya vāruṇīṃ nagarīṃ yayuḥ ।
līnorṇabhūpatiḥ pūrvamavatīrya puraṃ nijam ।। 8 ।।
phalāśanarṣiṇā sākaṃ hareḥ svāgatamācarat ।
bhūpadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।। 9 ।।
haristathā'nye yānānyavātārayattadā'mbarāt ।
vādyānāṃ gītikānāṃ ca ninādo vyānaśe'bhitaḥ ।। 2.192.1 0।।
hariryānāt samuttīrya narayāne suśobhite ।
rājñā pradarśite svarṇe vyarājata jayadhvanaiḥ ।। 1 1।।
rājñā mālādibhiḥ samyak pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
kuṭumbādyaiḥ saha sarvān vāruṇyāmavihārayat ।। 12।।
rājasainyena sahito bhagavān nāgarairjanaiḥ ।
arcitaścāyayau saudhaṃ rājālayaṃ viśālakam ।। 1 3।।
viśaśrāma tataḥ sasnau bhojanaṃ jagṛhe tadā ।
anye'pi bhojanaṃ cakrustato rājñī hareḥ puraḥ ।। 14।।
pūjanārthaṃ samāyātā catuḥkanyāsamanvitā ।
kanyā hariṃ priyaṃ prāpya karagrahaṃ vyadhurmudā ।। 15।।
rājñī pūjāṃ yautakaṃ ca pradadau vidhinā tataḥ ।
viśramya ca tataḥ sajjo babhūva bhagavān drutam ।। 16 ।।
rājñaścābhiprāyamāpya sarvān sajjān vyadhāt prabhuḥ ।
bṛhaccharanṛpasyā'gre rāṣṭraṃ vai khāḍigāntigam ।। 17।।
vallījīvanamuninā'rthito harirjagāma ha ।
bṛhaccharo nṛpaścāgre hyavātarannijāṃ purīm ।। 18।।
dhīvarākhyāṃ śobhitāṃ ca śrīhariṃ tu sahā''nayat ।
nagaryāṃ bhavane ramye pupūja parameśvaram ।। 19।।
rājā rājñī kanyake ca prajāḥ svāgatamācaran ।
kanyādvayaṃ hareḥ pāṇiṃ jagṛhatuḥ subhāvataḥ ।।2.192.20।।
rājā'bhavat kṛtakṛtyo harirniśāṃ nināya ha ।
prātarnagaryāṃ parito vyabhramat sainyaśobhitaḥ ।। 21 ।।
prajābhyo darśanaṃ datvā kṛtvā tāṃ pāvanīṃ purīm ।
dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā gantuṃ sajjo'bhavatprabhuḥ । ।22।।
tāvatpaścimasāmudro rājā śrutvā prabhuṃ drutam ।
vimānaiḥ saha vai śīghraṃ netuṃ tatra samāyayau ।। 23।।
aṃgarājo hariṃ natvā'prārthayatparameśvaram ।
haristathā'stviti prāha sajjastūrṇaṃ tadā'bhavat ।। 24।।
anyānyapi vimānāni susajjāni tadā'bhavan ।
khāḍīmuttīrya bhagavān milindāṃ nagarīṃ yayau ।। 25।।
rājñā sammānitaḥ śaktyā vādyaiḥ sainyena kīrtanaiḥ ।
pūjanairupadādānaistoṣito bhrāmitaḥ pure ।।26।।
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa madhyāhne sarvamānavān ।
sāyaṃ sarvān vimāneṣu kṛtvā dvīpānadarśayat ।। 27।।
punaḥ sarvaṃ vilokyaiva milindāmāyayau hariḥ ।
dadau tatropadeśaṃ ca rājanītyupabṛṃhitam ।।28।।
dvilīnāyāḥ prajāścāpi sukautukīprajāstathā ।
śruśravustatra cāgatyopadeśaṃ saha cāṃgakaiḥ ।।29।।
daśamīrajanībhāge lakṣādhijanasaṃsadi ।
hitaṃ mokṣakaraṃ cāpyupādideśa ca rādhike ।।2.192.3 0।।
īśāno'yaṃ parabrahma mānanīyaḥ sadā janaiḥ ।
īśāne tu parābhaktiḥ kartavyā vai madātmake ।।3 1 ।।
anṛtaṃ na hi vaktavyaṃ śapathaṃ tatra nāpi vai ।
sūryavāraḥ pālanīyo harasyārādhanāya vai ।। 32।।
pitarau sarvadā sevyau ghātaḥ kāryo na sarvadā ।
stainyaṃ varjyaṃ mṛṣā sākṣyaṃ varjyaṃ nyāyālaye'pi ca ।। 33।।
pareṣāṃ dhanavastrādi kāmanīyāni naiva tu ।
parasattvaṃ na hantavyaṃ pārakyaṃ grāhyameva na ।। 34।।
viśvāsaghātanaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kasyacit kvacit ।
prajāyāṃ dharmaghātaśca kartavyo naiva sarvathā ।।35।।
evaṃ dharmān pālayitvā rājā nākaṃ samāpnuyāt ।
satyavākyaṃ krodhaśūnyaṃ kṣamāpanaṃ vibhājanam ।। 36।।
svadāresveva ramaṇaṃ śaucaṃ drohavivarjanam ।
ārjavaṃ bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvajanaiḥ sadā ।।37।।
damaṃ purātanaṃ dharmaṃ jagṛhurviprajātayaḥ ।
svādhyāyaṃ yogakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ santānapālanam ।। 38।।
maitryaṃ hitakaraṃ vākyaṃ dhartavyaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ।
evaṃ vai vartayan vipraḥ svargaṃ nityamavāpnuyāt ।। 39।।
kṣatriyastu samadadyāt cādhīyīta yajeta ca ।
prajāḥ prapālayet parākramedanyāyavartini ।। 2.192.40।।
kṣatrakṛtyaṃ dasyujātervāraṇaṃ mukhyamasti yat ।
dānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ yajñaśceti rājñāṃ sukhāvahāḥ ।।41 ।।
taiśca tiṣṭhannije dharme rājā sarvān hi vartayet ।
evaṃ dharme sthito rājā rājanyendraḥ samucyate ।।42।।
athetaraḥ kṛṣikarmā vyāpāravān ca vā janāḥ ।
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaṃ prakārayed dhanārjanam ।।43।।
paśūn vai pālayet sarvān putravātsalyabhāvataḥ ।
paśūnāṃ rakṣayā vaiśyaḥ paramaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ।।44।।
prajāpatiḥ purā sṛṣṭvā paśūn vaiśyāya sandadau ।
rājñe dadau prajāḥ sarvā viprebhyaḥ śāradāṃ dadau ।।45।।
saptamaṃ bhāgamādāya jīvanaṃ sarvathā caret ।
kṣatriyaścettadā mahyaṃ samarpya mokṣamāpnuyāt ।।46।।
sevāṃ ca bhṛtyatāṃ dāsyaṃ paricaryā ca dūtatām ।
kurvāṇā dāsavargāstu mahatsukhamavāpnuyuḥ ।।47।।
śuśrūṣā kalpavallyasti śuśrūṣā kalpapādapaḥ ।
śuśrūṣā kāmadhenuśca cintāmaṇiśca sā matā ।।48।।
sevayā vaśamāyāti siṃho rājā gururgrahāḥ ।
dāsyena vaśatāṃ yānti svāmīpatiḥ satī prajāḥ ।।49 ।।
śuśrūṣayā vaśaṃ yānti śatrurdveṣṭā tamaḥ khalāḥ ।
paricaryāparo loko rañjayati niyāmakān ।।2.192.50।।
rañjanād rājarājyādi rañjakasya na vai pṛthak ।
tasmāt sarvaṃ prapadyeta sevayā ratnasaṃbhṛtam ।।5 1।।
chatraṃ veṣṭanamābhūṣā copānad vyajanādikam ।
ambarāṇi subhojyāni dīyante paricāriṇe ।।52।।
anapatyo hi bhartavyo bhartavyau vṛddhadurbalau ।
dāso dāsī bhatyavargo bhartavyā dharmatastu te ।।53 ।।
yajñaḥ pūjā brāhmaṇānāṃ yajño dhanena bhūbhṛtām ।
vaiśyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ yajñaḥ śraddhā yajñastu sevinām ।। 54।।
agre sarveṣu yajñeṣu śraddhā yajño'tiduṣkaraḥ ।
daivataṃ paramaṃ śraddhā yayā tuṣyāmi mādhavaḥ ।।55।।
śraddhāmayāḥ karmakārāḥ sarvaphalaiḥ samṛddhinaḥ ।
tasmāt sarveṣu lokeṣu śraddhāyajño vidhīyate ।।56।।
daivataṃ paramaṃ yatra śraddhākhyaṃ tatra devatā ।
kāryasiddhiśceśasiddhirmayi nyasya samarthyate ।।57।।
steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ ।
yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṃ yaḥ sādhureva yato hi saḥ ।।58।।
yaṣṭavyaṃ sarvadā tasmād deve vā cetane'pi vā ।
daridre'nāthavarge vā pālye vā śraddhayoddhṛte ।।59।।
sarvathā sarvadā sarvairyaṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ ।
nahi yajñasamaṃ kiñcit phaladaṃ sukhadaṃ param ।।2.192.60।।
brahmacaryaparo vā syād gṛhadharmamanācaran ।
brahmaṇyeva tu juhvānaḥ parabrahmā'dhigacchati ।।6 1 ।।
yadvā sadārakarmāpi matparāyaṇadharmavān ।
mamāśraye caran dharmaṃ bandhanānmucyate'pi saḥ ।।62।।
kṛtakṛtyo'thavā jñānadṛṣṭyā vane vasedapi ।
matparaḥ sa sadā karmī vrajatyakṣarasāmyatām ।।63 ।।
mama dharmān sādhubhāvānāśritya dvandvavarjitaḥ ।
yatiścet prāpnuyānmāṃ sa madbhāvāyopakalpyate ।।64।।
bhaikṣavṛttiśca yastiṣṭhenniṣparigraha ātmavān ।
karmī vā karmaśūnyo'pi madbhāvāyopakalpate ।।65।।
mitaśāyī mitāśī ca nirāśī cāpyaketanaḥ ।
yathopalabdhajīvī ca munirmāṃ samavāpnuyāt ।।66 ।।
nirāśī brahmavatproktastṛptaḥ pūrṇasukhāśrayaḥ ।
nirbhogo vṛttivarjyaśca vrajatyakṣarasāmyatām ।।67।।
gṛhāśramī tarenmāyāṃ māyāyāṃ māyayoṣitaḥ ।
api sarvāṃ mayi kṣiptvā tato bandhād vimucyate ।।68।।
svadāratuṣṭaḥ santoṣī śāṭhyajaihmyavivarjitaḥ ।
devapūjāparaḥ satyo dānto vibhāgakṛttathā ।।69।।
kṣamādayāparo dātā sarvebhyaśca yathocitam ।
ārjavaṃ cātithipūjāṃ bharaṇaṃ śritadehinām ।।2.192.70।।
yaḥ kuryād vartayeccāpi vartetāpi sa mokṣabhāk ।
svarge śuddhaṃ phalaṃ prāpya moditvā śāśvatīsamāḥ ।।71 ।।
dehānte cākṣayān kāmānanantān sarvataḥ sthitān ।
avāpnuyānna sandeho mayyarpaṇe tu madgatān ।।72।।
yo yathā kurute cātra tādṛśaṃ sa samāpnuyāt ।
pārakyaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvopakārarūpamutsavāt ।। 73 ।।
tato daihyaṃ cāntaraṃ ca tato naijaṃ samācaret ।
pārameśaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sarvadoṣanivārakam ।।74।।
ya evaṃ vartate rājā loke prajājano'pi vā ।
sarvatantuprotamaṇirmerukṛṣṇaṃ sa vindati ।।75।।
tasmāt prajābhiḥ satataṃ parameśe samarpya ca ।
nirdvandvābhirniṣkarmābhirbhāvyaṃ brāhmyadhilabdhaye ।।76।।
matkarmāṇaṃ madviśrāntaṃ maddhomaṃ matparāyaṇam ।
tārayāmi na sandeho mṛtyusāgarapūrataḥ ।। 77।।
arcayitvā sarvapitṝn devānṛṣīn samāśritān ।
āntarasthaṃ hariṃ cāpi yāyādante hareḥ padam ।।78।।
akurvan vā vikurvan vā kurvan vā matkṛtāśrayaḥ ।
madyogātpāramāpnoti karmā'saṃkhyā'dhivāridheḥ ।।79।।
māṃ yajantu sadā prātarmāṃ smarantu kriyādiṣu ।
māmante hṛdaye kṛtvā prayāntu me'kṣaraṃ padam ।।2.192.80 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmaiva rādhike bhagavān svayam ।
milindārājadhānyāśca rājā prajāstathetare ।।8 1।।
dharmamāsādya vijñānairmiśritaṃ bandhanāśakam ।
prasannā jagṛhuḥ sarvān dharmāstadopadeśitān ।।82।।
lomaśaśca dadau tatra tābhyo mantraṃ harerapi ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।83।।
tataḥ prajāśca rājā ca pūjayāmāsurīśvaram ।
svarṇarūpyakamudrābhiścopadābhistathā'mbaraiḥ ।।84।।
vibhūṣābhiścandanādyairakṣataiḥ puṣpahārakaiḥ ।
vividhairdānayogyaiśca vastubhiḥ parameśvaram ।।85।।
haristābhyaḥ prajābhyaśca rājabhyaśca prasannahṛt ।
āśīrvādān dadau yūyaṃ bhavata śreṣṭhakīrtayaḥ ।।86।।
śreṣṭharājyāḥ śreṣṭhadharmāḥ śreṣṭhanyāyaparāyaṇāḥ ।
śreṣṭhasya me maheśānasyaiva bhaktau kṛtādarāḥ ।।87।।
evamuktvā viśaśrāma harirnijanivāsane ।
janā naijān nivāsāँśca yayuḥ kṛtātmavedinaḥ ।।88।।
aṃgarājo bhojanāni dadau śrīparamātmane ।
sarvānabhojayaccāpi mahīmānān hareḥśritān ।।89।।
īśānaṃ pūjayāmāsa lomaśaṃ ca pupūja ha ।
hareḥ kuṭumbakaṃ prārcya rājā jagrāha bhojanam ।। 2.192.90 ।।
rājñī raṃgarajānāmnī cāṃgarājasya patnikā ।
gaurī prasannahṛdayaikādaśaputrikāyutā ।। 91 ।।
pauṣpakānakahārāँśca candanākṣatagandhinaḥ ।
ādāyā'rcayituṃ cāyād bālakṛṣṇasya sannidhau ।। 92।।
pupūja prītyā caraṇau payasā'kṣālayaddhareḥ ।
papau papuśca gauryastāḥ kanyāstvekādaśāpi vai ।।93 ।।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya kāntamīśvaram ।
kare jagṛhuratyarthaṃ vivāhavidhinā tu tāḥ ।।94।।
kaṇṭhe hārān dadustāśca haristābhyo'pi sandadau ।
utsavaḥ sa mahān jātaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'bhavannṛpaḥ ।।95।।
atha nidrāṃ jagṛhuśca viśaśramuḥ sukhaṃ niśām ।
gatāṃ vilokya bhagavān śrutvā maṃgalaniḥsvanān ।। 96।।
kṛtāhniko haristūrṇaṃ svastho'bhavad yadā drutam ।
tāvad rājā satī rājñīścājahratuḥ payaḥ śubham ।। 97।।
phalātmabhojanādyaṃ ca jagrāha bhagavāँśca tat ।
brahmapriyāḥ kuṭumbaṃ carṣayo jagṛhurutsukāḥ ।। 98।।
phalāni jagṛhuścāpi tāmbūlāni tataḥ param ।
vidāyaṃ jagṛhuścāpi sanmānaṃ prāpya tatkṣaṇam ।।99।।
hariścānye nṛpaṃ pṛṣṭvā''ruruhuḥ sajjitā drutam ।
vimānāni tūryanādān śṛṇvanto vyomamārgataḥ ।। 2.192.10 0।।
ākāraṇādivacaso viceruścāgratastadā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau puraḥ ।। 101 ।।
balalīnanṛparāṣṭraṃ jarāmaunarṣibhūtalam ।
ambarād bhūtalaṃ kṛṣṇo dadarśa bahuśobhanam ।। 1 02।।
rājā puro yayau bhūmau balalīno maharṣiṇā ।
jarāmaunena sākaṃ vai svāgatārthaṃ harestadā ।। 103 ।।
rādhike śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ praharadvaye ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayadhvānāstadā'bhavan ।। 1 04।।
yantraśabdā nāmamālā bhajanānyabhavan bhuvi ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānāni kramāttadā ।। 105 ।।
avaterurmahodyāne vālīnāyāstu sannidhau ।
viśālāyā rājadhānyā lakṣādhijanasaṃkule ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne harerlīnorṇarāṣṭrāgamanaṃ vāruṇyāṃ nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ, tato bṛhaccharanṛparāṣṭrāgamanaṃ dhīvarāyāṃ nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ, tato'ṅgarājasya milindānagarīṃ prati gamanaṃ
bhrāmaṇamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśrāntirbhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ praharadvaye balalīnanṛparāṣṭragamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 192 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 192 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 193
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 194 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe tato rājā'vatarantaṃ vimānataḥ ।
bhagavantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ puṣpahāraṃ gale dadau ।। 1 ।।
ratnahāraṃ dadau kaṇṭhe kare gucchaṃ tu puṣpajam ।
rājñī sākṣatacandraṃ ca kauṃkumaṃ pracakāra ha ।। 2 ।।
kumārikāḥ kṛṣṇapādau prakṣālyā'mṛtamāpapuḥ ।
rājñaḥ kuṭumbaṃ cāmātyāḥ pradhānādyāḥ prajāstathā ।। 3 ।।
śrīhareḥ svāgataṃ cakruḥ pūjābhistatra sādaram ।
jalapānaṃ ca haraye rājā dadau sugandhimat ।। 4 ।।
anyānapi janān sarvān jalapānamakārayat ।
hariṃ rājā gajayāne sauvarṇe sannyaṣādayat ।। 5 ।।
kuṭumbaṃ gajayāneṣu maharṣīn vṛṣavājibhiḥ ।
vāhiteṣu ramyapaṭṭīgantrīṣu sa nyaṣādayat ।। 6 ।।
brahmapriyāstu divyāsu paṭṭagantrīṣu bhūpatiḥ ।
nyaṣādayattato rājā hastiyāne tvarūruhat ।। 7 ।।
vālīnāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sasainyo rājā hariṃ prabhum ।
abhrāmayad rājamārgeṇānyarathyādicatvare ।। 8 ।।
agre ḍaṃkakanādo vai yāti coṣṭrasya pṛṣṭhake ।
tato vājivaro yāti sadhvajo vāhakānvitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tato hastī mahān yāti dundubhidhvānabodhanaḥ ।
śṛṃgāritāstu te vāhāḥ śobhante devatā yathā ।। 2.193.1 0।।
tato yāti ratho divyaḥ puttalīcakraśobhitaḥ ।
puṣpahārādidānārthaṃ prajāyai kṛṣṇapūjane ।। 11 ।।
tataḥ svarṇamayī gantrī viśālā yantravāhitā ।
yatra jhāṃjhapakhājādimaṇḍalī kīrtanārthinī ।। 1 2।।
yatra dhvānakarāścāśvavārāḥ sakuntasaddhvajāḥ ।
tato yāti mahān hastī yatra rājakumārakāḥ ।। 1 3।।
tato yānti coṣṭragantryo yatra pradhānajāḥ prajāḥ ।
tato yānti siṃhaveṣā vāditranādino janāḥ ।। 14।।
tato vyāghrapraveśāśca vigulādininādinaḥ ।
atha saptagajā yānti brahmarṣivāhanāstadā ।। 15।।
tato'śvavārayugalāḥ svarṇaveṣāśca śastriṇaḥ ।
vādyayuktagaṇā yānti dundubhyānakadhāriṇaḥ ।। 16।।
paṭahadhrāstato yānti paṭṭaghāśca tataḥ param ।
tato gaṇā yathā śaṃbhoḥ śataśo bhṛtyapārṣadāḥ ।। 17।।
tato bhṛtyā rājagantrīvaryāsu vai sahasraśaḥ ।
tato vādyāni cānyāni miṣṭamadhurasadravaiḥ ।। 18।।
bodhayanti janān paścād yānti brahmapriyā imāḥ ।
tato gantrīṣu sarvāsu gauryaḥ śṛṃgāritā yayuḥ ।। 1 9।।
tataḥ kuṭumbaṃ kṛṣṇasya gajeṣu yāti śobhitam ।
tata īṣānadevaśca gajapṛṣṭhe virājate ।।2.193.20 ।।
tato rājñī rājamātā svarṇagantryāṃ virājate ।
tataḥ kumārakāḥ sarve kumārikāstataḥ param ।।2 1 ।।
gajayantrīṣu rājante tato rājā suśobhitaḥ ।
balalīno mahārājaḥ śrīkṛṣṇena tu satkṛtaḥ ।।22।।
hastiyāne bālakṛṣṇasannidhau rājate puraḥ ।
dhṛtachatraḥ pārśvabhāge cāmaradhrau pratiṣṭhataḥ ।। 23 ।।
pṛṣṭhe mahāśvavārāśca gajavārāḥ prayānti ca ।
tato gauryaḥ svarṇaveṣāḥ prayānti maṃgalasvarāḥ ।।24।।
mastake kṛtakalaśāḥ phalapatrajalānvitāḥ ।
yānti gītiparāḥ sarvā rakṣakāśca tataḥ param ।। 25 ।।
yantradhvānakarāścāpi cānte prayānti vai tadā ।
gauryaḥ prajāpriyāścāpi prayānti saṃghaśastadā ।।26।।
rājamārgāḥ saṃkulitāstadā''san mānavairati ।
catvarāścandraśālāścālayāḥ saudhāḥ pratardikāḥ ।। 27।।
vitardyaḥ saṃgamā rathyāyogāḥ pārśvapadasṛtiḥ ।
vallabhyaścāṃgaṇānyagārāṇi gopurabhūmikāḥ ।।28।।
vṛkṣaśākhā durgabhāgā bhittikā gṛhaveṣakāḥ ।
koṇāḥ kaphoṇāścottānā madhyabhārā nalājalāḥ ।।29।।।
ucchrayā jīrṇabhāgāśca gaṇḍordhvā gṛhabhūmayaḥ ।
udyānā mārgabhāgāśca pārśvaprākāravṛttikāḥ ।। 2.193.30 ।।
sarvaṃ saṃkulitaṃ cāsīnmānavairdarśanārthibhiḥ ।
nagarī koṭimānuṣyairmarditā darśanārthakaiḥ ।। 31 ।।
svargasyendrāvatīnāmnī yathā'śobhata sā purī ।
catvarāḥ puṣpastabakaiḥ kṛtrimodyānakīkṛtāḥ ।। 3 2।।
rathyādvārāṇi ca śṛṃgāritāni gopurādibhiḥ ।
haṭṭāṃgaṇāni sarvāṇi śobhitāni ca toraṇaiḥ ।।3 3।।
mārgapārśvaprabhāgāśca śobhitāḥ kadalīvanaiḥ ।
agārāṇi raṅgavallīsvastikādyaiḥ kṛtāni ca ।। 34।।
mārgoparyantarīkṣaṃ śobhitaṃ patākikādhvajaiḥ ।
vāvaṭābhistoraṇaiśca saṃśobhitāḥ subhūmikāḥ ।। 39।।
kalaśaiḥ śrīphalaiścāpi dvāraśākhāḥ suśobhitāḥ ।
kanyābhirgauravarṇābhiḥ śobhitā vallabhībhuvaḥ ।। 36।।
śobhitāni gavākṣāṇi mṛgākṣīṇāṃ mukhābjakaiḥ ।
saudhā dhavalavarṇāśca vāvaṭābhiḥ suśobhitāḥ ।। 27।।
śikharāṇi ghūmmaṭāni stūpāni vedhakāni ca ।
ghaṭīśṛṃgāṇi sarvāṇi śobhitāni śubhadhvajaiḥ ।।38।।
jayaśabdairvādyaśabdairyantrīdhvānaiḥ sugītibhiḥ ।
garjitā daśadikṣveṣā purī vālganikā'bhavat ।।39।।
gopure rakṣibhiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjitaśca pradhānakaiḥ ।
agre sainyaiḥ pūjitaśca rājakīyairjanaistataḥ ।।2.193.40 ।।
śreṣṭhibhiḥ satkulaiścāpyāpaṇibhiḥ sthānibhistathā ।
pūjitaḥ sarvavargaiśca yoṣidbhiśca naraistathā ।।41।।
upadābhiḥ phalādyaiśca kaṇādyairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ।
ambaraiḥ kambalādyaiśca hāraiḥ sragbhiḥ suvarṇajaiḥ ।।42।।
akṣataiḥ kuṃkumaiścāpi ratnahīrakahārakaiḥ ।
puṣpaiśca vardhitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'tibhāvataḥ ।।43।।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau ।
rājā saṃpūjayāmāsa koṭiratnārpaṇairharim ।।44।।
rātrau pūjāṃ vratasyaivaikādaśyāṃ pracakāra ha ।
jāgaraṇaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca dharmādeśayutaṃ hariḥ ।।45।।
pracakārotsavayuktaṃ kṛṣṇakīrtanasaṃyutam ।
rādhike ca mahīmānāścakrurviśrāntimādarāt ।।46 ।।
hariścopādideśaiva sarvān jāgaraṇasthitān ।
jāgratyeva nare vratasthite nidrotthadūṣaṇam ।।47।।
vrataghnaṃ nopasaṃyāti caitajjāgaraṇe phalam ।
vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaveccāpi tamobhāvo niruddhyate ।।48।।
prasahyāpi bhaved bhaktirharau santoṣakāriṇī ।
śrīharau toṣite sarvaṃ saphalaṃ mānavaṃ janu ।।49।।
tadarthaṃ vai vrataṃ loke kartavyaṃ sāvadhāninā ।
udaye yā tithistvāste saikādaśī vratarthinī ।।2.193.50।।।
sūryasyodayanaṃ matvā kāryā tvekādaśī sadā ।
mama janmāṣṭamī prātarjanmanyaṣṭamikodaye ।।51 !।
ūrje kṛṣṇe sadā grāhyā śaratpūrṇottarā''gatā ।
evaṃ cānyāśca tithayo grāhyā sūryodaye sthitāḥ ।।52।।।
nakṣatraṃ vāsaraṃ vāpyālambya setsyanti mānavāḥ ।
tanna mukhyaṃ mataṃ me vai tithirme hyudaye matam ।।53।।
vrataṃ tatraiva kartavyaṃ yadvrate yatra yā tithiḥ ।
titheḥ kvāpi kṣayo nāsti kṣīṇā candrodaye matā ।।।54।।
candrodaye ca vā sūryodaye'stitvaṃ titherdhruvam ।
rātrāvutsavakārye tu tithiścandrodayā matā ।।55।।
dine tūtsavakārye tu sūryodayā matā tithiḥ ।
evaṃ vratāni kāryāṇi madbalāttāni sarvathā ।।56।।
puṇyadāni pūrṇakāni bhavanti nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
mohinī brahmajā vedhā matsambandhe na hānidā ।।57।।
iti mamājñāṃ jñātvaiva vratāni cottamāni vai ।
kartavyāni sadā bhaktairmadājñā phaladāyinī ।।58।।
yatkāle yasya devāderutsavo janma vā layaḥ ।
tatkṣaṇe yā tithiścāste sā vrate śobhanā sadā ।।59।।
sūryodayastathā candrodayo vā tārakodayaḥ ।
gauṇastatraiva mantavyaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ divāniśam ।।2.193.60 ।।
etad vihāya manujāḥ kariṣyanti vratāni cet ।
bhinnamatāni tatraiva bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
vratacchedakarāṇyeva bhaviṣyanti tu tāni vai ।
tasmāt kṣaṇaḥ sadā grāhyo vrate sarvavidhotsave ।।62।।
tena dharmo vardhate vai nānyathā tu kadācana ।
śraddhayā vardhate puṇyaṃ kālayuktaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।।63 ।।
pātrayuktaṃ tato'pyati vardhate pātrasadbalāt ।
pātraṃ cāhaṃ parabrahma sevanīyo vrataṃ mahat ।।64।।
mātāpitrorguroścāpi śuśrūṣā vratamuttamam ।
ācāryasādhuśuśrūṣā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ mahat ।।65।।
janasevāḥ prapāḥ kūpāḥ śayanāni śubhāni ca ।
dānāni kārayed bhaktyā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ hi tat ।।66।।
ahiṃsā satyamakrodho vṛttidānaṃ prapālanam ।
vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ putradārāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ vratam ।।67।।
dakṣiṇā yajñakāryeṣu dātavyā bhūtimicchatā ।
pākayajñāḥ prakartavyāḥ kaṇayajñāśca bhūtidāḥ ।।68।।
arhān pūjayato nityaṃ saṃvibhāgena sarvathā ।
vrataṃ tasya bhavettadvai svargadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।69।।
jñātisambandhimitrāṇāmāpaduddharturatra tu ।
puṇyaṃ svargapradṃ syādvai vratametatparaṃ sadā ।।2.193.70।।
sarvasatkārakartustu svargaṃ dhruvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ cātitheḥ pūjanādikam ।।71 ।।
devayajñaṃ kurvatastu svargaṃ dhruvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
dīkṣāyā grahaṇaṃ cāpi śiṣṭānāṃ pūjanaṃ sadā ।।72।।
devānāṃ smaraṇaṃ cāpi śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam ।
akauṭilyena vṛttiśca vrataṃ brahma divaḥ pradam ।।73।।
sarvabhūteṣu dayayā pravṛttasya tu dehinaḥ ।
paritrāṇaparasyā'tra vrataṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet ।।74।।
āgatānāṃ svāgatādikarturyogyakriyāvatām ।
pūjayiturvinamrasya vrataṃ svargapradaṃ bhavet ।।75।।
kuṭumbasya vaśe sthātuḥ sādhūnāṃ vacane'pi ca ।
śāstrāṇāṃ vacane sthāturvrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ।।76।।
āśrame yatra kutrāpi tadvṛṣe'vasthitasya tu ।
vrataṃ dharmamayaṃ svargyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।77।।
sthānamānaṃ kulamānaṃ vayomānaṃ guṇārhaṇam ।
kurvan varteta loke yastasya nākaṃ suniścitam ।।78।।
deśadharmān jñātidharmān prajādharmān vilokya ca ।
tattathā vartate yaśca vrataṃ tasyedamuttamam ।।79।।
gṛhastho'pi na vai lubdhaḥ smṛddhau ca viṣaye dhane ।
dehe vā daihike vā'pi vrataṃ sādhusamaṃ bhavet ।।2.193.80 ।।
dharmārāmā dharmaparā dharmasāhāyyadā janāḥ ।
dharmāvāsā bhavantyeva gārhasthye'pi hi sādhavaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
ātmopamaśca yo loke bhūteṣu vartate sadā ।
paraduḥkhaharo dehī pratyeha labhate sukham ।।82।।
dharmodayā dharmavīryā dharmapālādhvarakṣakāḥ ।
tyāgadharmāśritāḥ śīghraṃ tarantyeva bhavāmbudhim ।।83।।
yadā dutstho'sya saṃkalpo nivṛtto mūlato bhavet ।
dehī sattvagatiṃ prāptastato brahma samaśnute ।।84।।
tasmāt sarve'pi saṃkalpā nyasanīyā mayi prabhau ।
ātmā nivedanīyaśca dāsye mokṣaṃ tu dhāma me ।।85।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
rājā pupūja devaṃ ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।।86।।
satīśānaṃ maheśaṃ sapupūja paramādarāt। ।
prātaḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjanādi vidhāya ca ।।87।।
rājā prakārayāmāsa miṣṭānnādyaiśca pāraṇām ।
śrīhariḥ pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā viśrāntiṃ cāpa yāvatā ।।88।।
tāvad rājñī śrīratīśā pūjopakaraṇānvitā ।
catvāriṃśatkanyakābhirgaurībhiḥ saha cāyayau ।।89।।
pupūja paramātmānaṃ pādāmṛtaṃ papau tataḥ ।
catvāriṃśatkanyakāśca hareḥ pāṇiṃ prajagṛhuḥ ।। 2.193.90।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta rājājñayā ca gītayaḥ ।
agāyanta ca gaurībhirutsavo nṛtyasaṃyutaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
ajāyata nṛpaśca svaṃ kṛtakṛtyamamanyata ।
upadā yautakaṃ cāpi rājā dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ।।92।।
ratnahārān svarṇabhūṣāḥ kambalāmbarabhūtikāḥ ।
hariḥ prāpya ca tatsarvaṃ nṛpājñayā drutaṃ tadā ।।93 ।।
gantuṃ sajjo'bhavacchīghraṃ rājā'bhojayadacyutam ।
mahīmānān samagrāँścā'bhojayatpāyasādikam ।।94।।
sainyaṃ tato'bhavatsajjaṃ prasthāne mānadaṃ tadā ।
avādayacca tūryāṇi cakre jayaninādanam ।।95 ।।
vimānāni tadā sarvāṇyevā'bhavan vihāyasi ।
āruroha mahārājaḥ pūjitaḥ prajayā'bhitaḥ ।।96 ।।
āruruhustathā sarve pālanādarṣibodhitāḥ ।
varasiṃhanṛpeṇāpi nimantritāśca te tadā ।।97।।
gatimanto'bhavan vyomni śṛṇvanto vai jayadhvanīn ।
harervimānamagamad varasiṃhasya rāṣṭrakam ।।98।।
rājā pūrvaṃ varasiṃho'vātatārarṣisaṃyutaḥ ।
svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ sainyaṃ sajjaṃ cāsthāpayatpuraḥ ।।99।।
viṣṇutulyānadītīre vāśīlānagarītaṭe ।
harervimānamālokya sainyaṃ svāgatamācarat ।। 2.193.100 ।।
vicitravādyadhvanibhiryantragarjanayā tathā ।
gītikābhiśca gaurīṇāṃ vyoma nādamayaṃ hyabhūt ।। 101 ।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ bhuvamāgatam ।
hareścānyāni ca vimānāni cāpyāgatāni vai ।। 102।।
vimānopari puṣpāṇāṃ vṛṣṭiḥ prajākṛtā'bhavat ।
rādhike janatā cābhūd vihvalā darśanāya ca ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vālīnānagaryāṃ śrīharerdhamaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vratopadeśanaṃ dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tato vāśīlānagarīṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 193 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 193 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 194
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 195 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike viṣṇutulyāyāstaṭe viśālavartule ।
udyāne śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānād bahirāyayau ।। 1 ।।
rājā puṣpasrajaḥ kaṇṭhe dadau nārāyaṇasya ha ।
ṛṣirhārān dadau rājñī pradhānādyā daduḥ srajaḥ ।। 2 ।।
supuṣpaiḥ prajayā kṛṣṇo vardhitastvakṣatādibhiḥ ।
gucche kare nyadhād rājā śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaprabhoḥ ।। 3 ।।
gandhasārādikaṃ gandhijalaṃ veṣe'pyadāttadā ।
pādau prakṣālya rājādyā amṛtaṃ ca papustataḥ ।। 8 ।।
varasiṃho nṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yantragantryāṃ nyaṣādayat ।
kuṭumbaṃ dīrghagantryāṃ ca maharṣīn vātagāsu ca ।। 5 ।।
brahmapriyā gajayāneṣveva rājā nyaṣādayat ।
mahīmānayutaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śārabheyarathe śubhe ।। 6 ।।
nyaṣādayattato vādyaiḥ sainyasatkārabodhanaiḥ ।
vāśīlāyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai hariṃ cā'bhrāmayannṛpaḥ ।। 7 ।।
gopure'pūjayat kṛṣṇaṃ tato rājakuṭumbakam ।
pradhānāścatvare kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
śreṣṭhinastvāpaṇāgreṣu sthānino mārgasaṃgame ।
prajāḥ sarvā mahāmārge pupūjuḥ kṛṣṇavallabham ।। 9 ।।
tadānīṃ yoṣito gauryaḥ samārūkṣan nijālayān ।
hariṃ vilokayantyaścā'vākiran puṣpakairharim ।। 2.194.1 0।।
procuḥ parasparaṃ gauryo hṛṣṭāḥ śāntiṃ gatāstadā ।
netrāyataphalaṃ prāpya tadvīkṣākṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 11 ।।
karuṇātinoditasudattadarśanaṃ
lalanā śarīribhiragamyadarśanam ।
prasamīkṣyasundarataraṃ hariṃ nvamuṃ
saphalaṃ svakaṃ kuruta janma mā ciram ।। 12।।
viṣayātilubdhamavaśaṃ pravāsanaṃ
nahi mānasaṃ samupagacchati sthitim ।
iti cāti lubdhamavaśaṃ pradarśanā-
nnanu yoṣito bhavati mādhavaḥ svayam ।। 1 3।।
praṇamatsurādhipatibhūpatīśadhṛk-
mukuṭāgrakalgikṛtayogitāsanam ।
caraṇāravindayugalaṃ satīnutaṃ
kamalādhṛtaṃ kuruta mānase nvidam ।। 14।।
paradhāmni yaśca śubhadivyavigrahaḥ
parivarṇito'sti nigamairguṇāśrayaḥ ।
vibhavarddhirūpaguṇakaiḥ prapūritaḥ
prabhayāvṛtaṃ kuruta mānase nvimam ।। 15।।
bahukāntisaṃbhṛtamimaṃ hi sundaraṃ
bahupuṣṭavigrahamimaṃ grahāśrayam ।
abalāḥ punarna tu gataṃ tvavāpsyatha
tadayaṃ sadā svahṛdaye nigṛhyatām ।। 16।।
vadanāmbujaṃ vividhatāpanāśanaṃ
mitamandamiṣṭahasanātilobhanam ।
bhuvi muktidaṃ ca paralokamuktidaṃ
nviṣapūrṇacandrasukhadaṃ nipīyatām ।। 17।।
puruṣottamo'yamatikarṣati drutaṃ
hṛdayaṃ tathendriyagaṇaṃ ca cetanam ।
tamavetya kāntamiha śāśvataṃ prabhuṃ
hṛdaye milantu militaḥ prabhujyatām ।। 18।।
hṛdayasthito bahirupāgato hyayaṃ
kusumaiśca mānasabharaiḥ prapūjyatām ।
ratiratnahīrakasamarpaṇairayaṃ
parirabdha āli! militaḥ prasevyatām ।। 19।।
itthaṃ gītayaśāḥ kṛṣṇo bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ ।
rājaharmyaṃ samāyāto vandito nāgarairjanaiḥ ।।2.194.20।।
rājā tūrṇaṃ hareḥ pādau pūjayāmāsa candanaiḥ ।
akṣataiḥ kusumaiścāpi hariḥ siṃhāsane'bhavat ।।21 ।।
niṣīdantaṃ puṣpahāraiḥ kusumaistaṃ vavarṣa ha ।
lokaḥ premabharairhadbhiḥ sthiranetro dadarśa ca ।।29।।
sabhā'timahatī tatra kṛtā śrīparamātmanā ।
upādideśa ca tadā janatāhitahetave ।।23 ।।
bhagavān parameśo yo rājate parame'kṣare ।
kṛpayā sa samāyāti nijaprajāvanāya vai ।।24।।
prajāḥ putryo bhagavataḥ pālanīyāśca mātṛvat ।
poṣaṇīyāḥ sukhanīyā netavyāścākṣaraṃ padam ।।25।।
sarvāvatāradhartā'haṃ śrīsvāmikṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
māyāṃ pramṛdya loke'tra varte bhavatpragocaraḥ ।।26 ।।
kāṃbhareyo rādhikeśo lakṣmīpadmāvatīpatiḥ ।
māṇikīśaḥ ramānāthaḥ svayaṃ gopālanandanaḥ ।।27।।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ kāntaśca sarvasṛṣṭipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
sadguṇāmaṃjulāhaṃsālalitāvijayāpatiḥ ।।28।।
yatra vāso'tra loke'pi me tad dhāmamayaṃ bhavet ।
nārāyaṇanivāsena bhūmivaikuṇṭhasadṛśī ।।29।।
jāteyaṃ bhagavān heturdivyatve divyabhāvini ।
tathā bhakto'pi me hetuḥ saddeśādisamarjane ।।2.194.3 0 ।।
rājā bhakto bhaveccedvai tatra kṛtayugo bhavet। ।
nītidharmayuto rājā kṛtaṃ pravartayet khalu ।।3 1 ।।
tatra vai sarvavarṇānāṃ nā'dharme jāyate matiḥ ।
kṣemaṃ prajānāṃ subhagaṃ sarvadā hi pravartate ।।32।।
satkarmāṇi samastāni kriyante tu dvijātibhiḥ ।
susukhāḥ ṛtavaḥ sarve bhavantyapi nirāmayāḥ ।।।3 3।।
prasīdanti mānavāśca hṛdā ca manasā girā ।
na jāyante vyādhayaśca nālpāyurjāyate janaḥ ।।34।।
kṛpaṇā na janāstatrā'patikā na ca yoṣitaḥ ।
pṛthvī cāpi vinā kṛṣṭiṃ janayatyeva sasyakam ।।35।।
oṣadhayaḥ phalantyeva kṣmārasena sukhapradāḥ ।
tvakpatraphalamūlāni vīryavanti bhavantyapi ।।36।।
dharma eva sukhaṃ caiva tṛptiścaiva gṛhe gṛhe ।
jane jane ca viśvāsaḥ sukhaṃ nodvejanaṃ kvacit ।।37।।
evaṃ rājā dharmayuktaḥ satyakālasya kāraṇam ।
yadāṃ'śaṃ tyajate rājā dharmasyaiva tadā bhavet ।।38।।
tretānāmayugaścātra mānaveṣu sthale sthale ।
aśubhāṃśaścaturthāṃśastāvanmānaṃ ca kaṣṭakṛt ।।39।।
kṛṣṭapacyā bhūrbhavecca tribhāgaphaladā tadā ।
sarvaṃ tribhāgaphaladaṃ phalgu bhāge caturthake ।।2.194.40।।
sukhe tatsādhane cāpi labdhavye viṣaye'pi ca ।
sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ na phalati tretāheturnṛpo yadā ।।41 ।।
ardhaṃ rājā yadā dharmaṃ nītiṃ tyajati vai tadā ।
dvāparaṃ nṛpatau prāptaṃ prajāsvevaṃ pravartate ।।42।।
meghe'raṇye ṛtau vṛkṣe rase goṣu pravartate ।
aśubhāṃśau bhavetāṃ dvau śubhāṃśau dvau matau tadā ।।43 ।।
sarvaṃ cārdhaṃ phalatyeva bāhyaṃ vā'ntaramityapi ।
svakīyaṃ vā ca pārakyaṃ daivaṃ vā'daivamityapi ।।44।।
svārthaṃ vā'tha parārthaṃ vā cārdhaṃ phalati sarvathā ।
ardhā pṛthivī phalati sasyeṣvardhakaṇarddhitā ।।45।।
yadā rājā tyajatyeva tryaṃśaṃ dharmaṃ tadā bhuvi ।
ṛtau rase jane vṛkṣe kārye phale ca pādatā ।।46 ।।
tryaṃśe niṣphalatā bodhyā cāṃ'śe'pi niścayo nahi ।
evaṃ vai vartate rājā tadā tiṣyaḥ pravartate ।।47।।
prajā kliśnātyayogena tadā'dharmaparā janāḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ mānavānāṃ vai svadharmāccyavate manaḥ ।।48।।
kalāvadharmo balavān gṛhe gṛhe jane jane ।
bhikṣavo varṇasarvasvā bhṛtyāśca sārvavarṇikāḥ ।।49।।
varṇasāṃkaryabhūyiṣṭhaṃ yogakṣemau na vai kvacit ।
satkarmāṇi na vidyante kuto vaidikavārtikā ।।2.194.50।।
ṛtavaścā'sukhāḥ sarve bhavantyāmayino janāḥ ।
asatye vijayaṃ manyamānāstiṣṭhanti sarvadā ।।51 ।।
hrasanti mānavānāṃ tu rūpasvaramanāṃsyapi ।
vyādhayo nūtanāstatra mriyante cālpakālinaḥ ।।52।।
vidhavā vidhurāḥ prāyo bhavanti bahavo janāḥ ।
nindyā eva prajāḥ prāyaḥ sukhaśāntivivarjitāḥ ।।53।।
pārśve varṣati parjanyaḥ pakṣe'vagrahakārakaḥ ।
kvacitsasyakaṇotthāṇaṃ kvaciccāṃkuradagdhatā ।।54।।
rasāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ syuśca yadā rājñi kalirbhavet ।
prajārakṣāhano bhūpāḥ kalikośā bhavanti vai ।।15।।
rājā kṛtasya sraṣṭā vai tretāyā dvāparasya ca ।
kaleśca sraṣṭā rājaiva kāraṇaṃ yugaparyaye ।।56।।
kṛtasya karaṇād rājā svargamuttamamaśnute ।
tretāyāḥ karaṇād rājā tryaṃśaṃ svargaṃ samaśnute ।।57।।
dvāparasyā'rjanād rājā'rdhaṃ sukhaṃ samavindati ।
kaleḥ pravartanāt kleśaṃ rājyanāśaṃ ca vindati ।।58।।
evaṃ kalau pāpameva bhuṃkte rājā hi rākṣasaḥ ।
tato yātyeva narake vasatyeva ciraṃ samāḥ ।।59।।
prajānāṃ kalmaṣaṃ bhuṃkte duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkte'pyasīmakam ।
pāpaṃ cāpyapakīrtica bhuṃkte duḥkhaparamparām ।।2.194.60।।
tasmānnītyā sadā rājñā vartitavyaṃ kṛtādivat ।
careddharmānasaṃmohān kuryāt snehaṃ vibandhanāt ।।6 1 ।।
labhedarthaṃ ca nirlobhāccaret kāmaṃ sadārtavāt ।
brūyāt priyaṃ na kārpaṇyāt parakramenna katthanāt ।।62।।।
dadyāt kupātrado na syāt syād gaṃbhīro na nimnagaḥ ।
milet sarvairanāryaiśca gṛhṇīyānnāpyanītitaḥ ।।63 ।।
acāro na bhavet kvāpi kāryaṃ kuryānna pīḍayet ।
arthaṃ vadenna duṣṭeṣu guṇān vadenna cātmanaḥ ।।64।।
ādadyānna daridrebhyo nāśrayaṃ duḥsataścaret ।
avimṛśya daṇḍayenna rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet ।।65।।
visṛjenna tu duṣṭebhyo viśvasennāpakāriṣu ।
īrṣyāśūnyo bhaveccāpi dāreṣvapi prajāsvapi ।।66।।
strīḥ saṃseveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta nā'hitam ।
mānayet pūjyavargāśca gurūn sevet bhāvataḥ ।।67।।
devān prapūjayed bhaktyā śriyaṃ cecchedaninditām ।
dākṣyaṃ kuryād yathāpekṣaṃ mārdavaṃ kālaviccaret ।।68।।
sāntvayet hārdalābhāyā'nugṛhṇīyāt samṛddhaye ।
praharet tattvamājñāya kṛtvā paścānna śocayet ।। 69।।
krodhaṃ kuryānnānyathā vai mārdavaṃ gṛhṇīyānna ca ।
sataḥ seveta satataṃ śāntaye mokṣaṇāya ca ।।2.194.70 ।।
samādhyarthaṃ paṇḍitāँśca seveta satataṃ nṛpaḥ ।
evaṃ buddhiṃ praseveta prātarutthāya nirjane ।।71 ।।
seveta cāntarātmānaṃ māṃ yathārthapradarśine ।
catvāriṃśadguṇaiḥ rājā devatvamiva rājatām ।।।72।।
vikāsayitumarhaḥ syāt tasmānnītiyuto bhavet ।
māṃ sadā sarvathā sākṣye cāntare saṃsmarennṛpaḥ ।।73।।
tataḥ sarvaṃ prakurvīta satyayugaprado'smyaham ।
asanmārgapravṛttasyoddhārako'haṃ bhavāmi ca ।।74।।
saṃśayapaṃkamagnasyonnetā'smyahaṃ janārdanaḥ ।
akāryajālagrathanāgatasyā'haṃ vimocakaḥ ।।75।।
apāraṅgamagantuśca pāraṅgamaka ityaham ।
bhavāmyeva sadā tasmāt sevanīyo'hamāśrayaḥ ।।76।।
rājā'thavā prajā putraḥ putrī vā kāryayoginaḥ ।
vistareṇa tu dharmāṇāṃ na jātvantamavāpnuyuḥ ।।77।।
taiḥ sadā'nuṣṭheyake'rthe sandigdhe nāntavartini ।
praṣṭavyā dharmaniṣṭhāśca śrutavantaḥ surottamāḥ ।।78।।
pratyutthāyopasaṃgṛhya caraṇāvabhivādya ca ।
nivedanīyāḥ kāryārthe nārāyaṇasmṛtestathā ।।79।।
gopāyitāraṃ dātāraṃ dharmanityamatandritam ।
akāmadveṣasaṃyuktamanurajyanti mānavāḥ ।।2.194.80।।
matparaṃ sādhusevaṃ ca madarthakṛtayatnakam ।
mayi nyastasamastaṃ ca bhūtānyanusaranti hi ।।8 1।।
tasmānniruktasṛtyā ca bhāvyaṃ rājñā prajājanaiḥ ।
tathā saukhyaṃ bhavedatra paratrāpi gatirbhavet ।।82।।
rājā prajā bhaved yo vā ko vā'pyatra tu dehavān ।
dehadaṃ māṃ bhajennityaṃ sa syāt sukhī na cetaraḥ ।।83।।
dharmā arthāśca kāmāśca mokṣe yena niyojitāḥ ।
yojitaḥ sa bhavatyeva naisargānmayi mādhave ।।84।।
evaṃ sarve prakurvantu kāryāṇi manmayāni ha ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।।85।।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇo mantraṃ dadau tadā nijam ।
virarāma tataḥ svāmī sarvamānasatṛptidaḥ ।।86।।
rājñī ca rājakanyāśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
pañcakanyāstadaivā'sya hastaṃ jagṛhurādarāt ।।87।।
kāntaṃ prāpya parānandaṃ lebhire pañcagaurikāḥ ।
rājā mumude'tyarthaṃ ca rājñī mene kṛtārthatām ।।88।।
hareḥ pūjā kṛtā lokaiḥ sabhāvisarjanaṃ hyabhūt ।
harirbhojanamāsādya viśrāntimāpa cālaye ।।89।।
mahīmānāḥ samastāśca viśrāntiṃ lebhire bhṛśam ।
rātriṃ nināya bhagavān pālanādāya carṣaye ।।2.194.90।।
datvopadādisāmagrīrgantuṃ sajjo'bhavattadā ।
rājā sainyena vādyādyairvidāyaṃ pradadau mahat ।। 91 ।।
hariṃ rājā puṣpahāraiḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaṃ tadā ।
dugdhapānādikaṃ vyadhāpayattato'tipūjanam ।। 92।।
cakārā''rārtrikaṃ cāpi papau pādāmṛtaṃ tataḥ ।
hārālirājitavakṣā harirvimānago'bhavat ।।93 ।।
mahīmānāḥ samastāścāruruhurvyomagāmiṣu ।
vimāneṣu tato vādyānyavādyanta ca bhūriśaḥ ।।94।।
jayanādairyayustasmād rāyagāmalarāṣṭrakam ।
rāyagāmalarājā ca lātavāyamunistathā ।।95।।
kuṭumbaṃ rājakīyaṃ ca puro gatvā'tiśobhanam ।
svāgataṃ śrīhareścāpi sainyaśobhātikāritam ।।96।।
cakruḥ sarve ninādaiḥ kīrtanairvādyaiḥ sumādibhiḥ ।
ākāśe cāgataṃ kṛṣṇavimānaṃ vīkṣya te tadā ।।97।।
jayanādān pracakruśca yantrīdhvānānakārayan ।
goryaḥ sarvā gītinādān madhurānapyagāpayat ।।98।।
evaṃ sanmānasaubhāgye sthale hyudyānaśobhite ।
dvyūnāsarittaṭe puryā rigāyāḥ sannidhau hariḥ ।।99।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadāmbarāt ।। 2.194.10 0।।
rādhike janatāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyalokayan sthiradṛśaḥ ।
puṣpairavardhayan gītijayadhvānairavardhayan ।। 101 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne varasiṃhanṛpasya vāśīlānagaryāṃ harerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ yugopadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ nidrottaraṃ trayodaśyāṃ madhyāhnapūrvaṃ rāyagāmalarāṣṭragamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā
caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 194 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 194 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 195
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 196 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānāt samavātarat ।
rāyagāmalanṛpatiḥ puṣpahārān dadau gale ।। 1 ।।
rājñī prakṣālayāmāsa caraṇau paramātmanaḥ ।
kanyakāśca kuṭumbaṃ ca rājñaḥ pupūjuracyutam ।। 2 ।।
gandhākṣataiḥ puṣpasragbhiścandanena sugandhinā ।
hārān gucchān dadau cāpi tato rājā hariṃ ca tam ।। 3 ।।
nyaṣādayad ramyagaje'mbālikāvaraśobhite ।
śṛṃgārite'tisubhage caturdante'rjune vare ।। 4 ।।
uccake saṃsthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ janatā samalokayat ।
chatraṃ dadhuśca śirasi kumārāścāmare'pi ca ।। 5 ।।
anyān sarvān mahīmānān śakaṭīṣu nyaṣādayat ।
rājā'bhrāmayadīśeśaṃ nagaryāṃ rājamārgake ।। 6 ।।
rigāprajā hariṃ natvā pupūjuruttamottamaiḥ ।
phalai ratnairambarādyaiḥ svarṇarūpyakakambalaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
puṣpahārairhīrakādyairamūlyavastubhistathā ।
gopure catvare saṃge haṭṭake mārgasannidhau ।। 8 ।।
aṃgaṇe sarvathā lokā apūjayan suvastubhiḥ ।
avardhayan śubhā gauryo'kṣatalājābjakesaraiḥ ।। 9 ।।
hārdikairbhāvanaiścāpi nirīkṣaṇaiḥ sumānasaiḥ ।
svāgataṃ sarvato buddhyā cakruḥ kīrtanagītibhiḥ ।। 2.195.10 ।।
rājaprāsādavaryaṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇo'tibhāsvaraḥ ।
rājakanyāḥ pañca kṛṣṇahastaṃ jagṛhurādarāt ।। 11 ।।
rājñī pupūja deveśaṃ jāmātāraṃ tadā mudā ।
dadau dānāni subhagā vividhāni pupūja ca ।। 1 2।।
dadau kanyāḥ pañca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya tatra ha ।
utsavaṃ ca śubhaṃ cakre rājā kṛtārthatāṃ vahan ।। 13।।
tataḥ pradhānasaudhāni prajāgṛhāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
śreṣṭhināṃ mandirodyānagṛhādīni yayau hariḥ ।। 14।।
bhagavān śrīharistatra sarvatra pūjitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
īśāno brahmapatnyaśca gauryo maharṣayastathā ।। 15।।
sarve'pi pūjitāstasyāṃ nagaryāṃ nāgarairmudā ।
gaurībhiḥ pūjitaṃ kṛṣṇakuṭumbaṃ bhāvavastubhiḥ ।। 16 ।।
tato harirnijāvāsaṃ cāyayau sainyaśobhitaḥ ।
jalapānaṃ cakārā'tha sabhāṃ cakāra tatra ca ।। 17।।
upādideśa ca janān rādhike kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
dharmaḥ pālyaḥ sadā bhaktairarthastena prajāyate ।। 18।।
kevalārthaparo janturacireṇa vinaśyati ।
vittaṃ dattaṃ ca vā nyastamasthāne ced vinaśyati ।। 19।।
hiṃsārthaṃ yojitaṃ cāpi pāpāyaiva prakalpate ।
yadvā''tmano'pi hiṃsāṃ vā kurute hiṃsakaṃ bhavat ।।2.195.20।।।
dharma ūdho bhavatyeva mā chindyāttaṃ kadācana ।
ūdhaśchede payolābho kṣīrārthino na jāyate ।। 21 ।।
ūdhaso'rthamayaṃ dugdhaṃ pragṛhṇīyād vivekavān ।
dugdhaṃ dogdhryāḥ sevanena prāpyate nityamuttamam ।। 22।।
evaṃ pṛthvīmupāyena bhuñjāno labhate phalam ।
satīṃ gāṃ ca tanuṃ dharmaṃ bhuñjāno labhate phalam ।। 23।।
dogdhrīṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rakṣayet pṛthivīṃ ca tām ।
dharmaṃ nityaṃ rakṣayecca dogdhrīṃ matvā vivekavān ।।24।।
bhūtānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharmo dayā sā paramā matā ।
dayādharmeṇa kartā vai taratyasārasāgaram ।।25।।
bhītānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rakṣāphalaṃ sulabhyate ।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vāsātmakaṃ hi tat ।। 26।।
sviṣṭiḥ svadhītiḥ sutapā yān lokān jayate tataḥ ।
tāneva dayayā prājño jayate dharmamācaran ।।27।।
devatāḥ pitaraḥ santo jīvanti dānadharmaṇā ।
anyabhūtāni jīvanti dayāgārhasthyadharmaṇā ।।28।।
chāyāyāmapsu vāyau ca sukhamuṣṇe pramelane ।
agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṃ śīte pramelane ।। 29।।
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ ।
uṣṇe śītaṃ sādhurūpaṃ prāptavyaṃ sukhadaṃ hṛdi ।।2.195.3 0।।
śīte coṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ prāptavyaṃ sukhadaṃ sadā ।
teṣu bhogeṣu nā'sakto labhate sukhamuttamam ।।3 1।।
anye dharmāḥ śītajānāmanye coṣṇanivāsinām ।
uṣṇasthānāṃ snānajaṃ ca phalaṃ yat syācchubhapradam ।।32।।
śītasthānāṃ yajñadānaistato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
arthadānaṃ mataṃ puṣṭipradaṃ dehasya tuṣṭaye ।।33 ।।
artho dvedhā dhanarūpaḥ sukhado'tra bhavet khalu ।
parārtho mokṣarūpastu śāśvatikasukhapradaḥ ।।34।।
abhayasya pradātustu phalaṃ sarvottamottamam ।
nahi prāṇasamaṃ dānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ tato'dhikam ।।35।।
ahaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo vai svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
dadāmi mokṣadānaṃ ca prāṇadānaṃ dhanādi ca ।।36।।
śreṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ ca trayametadvibhajyate ।
mokṣadānaṃ paraṃ dānaṃ dātavyaṃ sarvathā bhuvi ।।37।।
grahītavyaṃ tu taddānaṃ nityānandapradaṃ tu yat ।
anyā''dāne bhaved vyādhirmokṣadāne vinaśyati ।। 38।।
mokṣadāne brahmadānaṃ brahmabhūtaṃ karoti hi ।
brahmavṛkṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhuhema dadāti vai ।।3 9।।
brahmadānaparaṃ dānaṃ nādhikaṃ sṛṣṭimaṇḍale ।
mokṣadānaṃ brahmadānaṃ brahmāhaṃ māṃ dadāmi ca ।।2.195.40 ।।
dharmo'haṃ cārtharūpo'haṃ mokṣo'haṃ mokṣado'pyaham ।
mokṣātmānaṃ dadāmyeva mumukṣave prasāditaḥ ।।41 ।।
striyaṃ vā brahma vā hanyāt sādhuṃ hanyāttu yo ghṛṇī ।
tatpāpaiḥ kriyamāṇaiśca sṛjyate sa daridrakaḥ ।।42।।
īśāno rudradevaśca hinastyasādhupāpinaḥ ।
sādhūn rakṣati sarvātmā madrūpo rudra īśvaraḥ ।।42।।
ātmā rudro nijaḥ proktaḥ pāpaṃ hanyād yadā svataḥ ।
pāpaṃ dveṣo vañcanādi cātmaghātādi nāśayet ।।44।।
ātmaghāto mokṣaghātastaṃ na kuryāt kadācana ।
ātmā svārthī bhavennityaṃ mokṣārthī matsamāgamāt ।।45।।
dehabhāvaṃ na coheta miśrabhāvaṃ parityajet ।
śuṣkairārdraṃ dahyate'pi miśritaṃ ced bhaved yadi ।।46 ।।
ātmā duḥkhī jāyate'pi dehamiśro bhaved yadi ।
pāpakṛdbhiḥ kathaṃcicca na syānmiśro vivekavān ।।47।।
rāgadveṣau pāparūpau tyaktavyau muktimicchatā ।
pramādamohau pāpau ca tyaktavyau bhūtimicchatā ।।48।।
puṇyalokaḥ svayaṃ svargaḥ sukhī cātmā divaṃ matam ।
pāpaloko'tra nirayo duḥkhī cātmā hyadho mataḥ ।।49।।
pṛthvī sādhūँstathā'sādhūn sandhārayati sadṛśī ।
sūryaḥ sādhūँstathā'sādhūn karoti tāpanaṃ samaḥ ।।2.195.50 ।।
jalaṃ tṛptān karotyeva sādhūnasādhukānapi ।
vātaḥ prāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ ca samaṃ karoti dehiṣu ।।।51 ।।
āpaḥ punanti sarvāṃśca sādhvasādhūn samānataḥ ।
atra loke tathā cāsti phalaloke tu bhinnatā ।।52।।
puṇyaśālikṛte vāri śītaṃ tatropasarpati ।
apuṇyasya kṛte vāri dṛṣṭimārgaṃ na gacchati ।।53।।
puṇyaśālikṛte pṛthvī komalāstaraṇānvitā ।
apuṇyasya kṛte pṛthvī kaṇṭakakarkarānvitā ।।54।।
puṇyaśālikṛte vāyuḥ śītalo gandhisaṃspṛśaḥ ।
apuṇyasya kṛte vāyurviṣolbaṇo'tidāruṇaḥ ।।55।।
puṇyaśālikṛte sūryo yathāpekṣoṣṇatāpradaḥ ।
apuṇyasya kṛte sūryo dāhako bhasmasātkaraḥ ।।56।।
ityevaṃ cāntaraṃ loke phalāḍhye vartate sadā ।
puṇyaloko madhumāँśca ghṛtādaḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ।।57।।
amṛtādo modayukto jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ।
pāpasya loko nirayastamoduḥkhasutāpanaḥ ।।58।।
kṣuttṛḍvyāptaḥ śokakośaḥ kṣaṇamṛtyuvaśaṃgataḥ ।
taṃ lokaṃ gantumicched yo vivekabhraṣṭa eva saḥ ।।19।।
puṇyalokaṃ prayātuṃ yo vāñcched vivekavān hi saḥ ।
śāśvataṃ ca paraṃ lokaṃ mama dhāmā'kṣarābhidham ।।2.195.6 0।।
gantumicchettu yaḥ prājño mumukṣūttama eva saḥ ।
nityapūjo brāhmaṇastallokaṃ samabhigacchati ।।6 1।।
nityaṃ dānī makhī rakṣī pūjī kṣatro'pi gacchati ।
udyamī copakārī ca dharmī vaiśyo'pi gacchati ।।62।।
hitī sevī ca santoṣī yāti śūdro'pi śeṣabhuk ।
tatra tatrā'nusandhānaṃ mama bhaktyātmakaṃ smṛtam ।।63 ।।
ājñāṃ vahate niyato guroryo'skhalito janaḥ ।
tasya siddhirbhavatyeva gurobarlānna saṃśayaḥ ।।64।।
alpaṃ ca sārabhūtaṃ ca karaṇīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
yena siddhirdrutaṃ śreyaḥpradā bhavati dehinaḥ ।।65।।
yeṣāṃ śrībhagavān rakṣyo yeṣāṃ rakṣyaṃ ca kīrtanam ।
mama bhaktāstathā rakṣyāste rakṣyā mama sarvadā ।।56।।
yeṣāṃ purogamā bhaktāḥ santo brahmaparaṃ tvaham ।
yadgṛhe bhaktakanyāśca te rakṣyā mama sarvadā ।।67।।
na kālāt karmatasteṣāṃ māyāto yamato bhayam ।
yoṣāṃ cāsmi gṛhe cāhaṃ hṛdaye pūjitaḥ sadā ।।68।।।
sādhūn rakṣet sadā rājā te hi rakṣanti rakṣitāḥ ।
āśīreṣāṃ bhaved dhāmapradātrī bandhanāśinī ।।69।।
dānena tapasā yajñairbhaktyā damena sevayā ।
sādhavo vā gṛhasthā vā kṣemamiccheyurātmanaḥ ।।2.195.70।।
apāre pārakartā yaścā'plave plavado'pi yaḥ ।
yamāśrityā'tighore'tra saṃsāre sukhino janāḥ ।।71 ।।
tyāgī vāpi gṛhī vāpi naro nārī ca vā bhavet ।
tārakaṃ bāndhavaṃ matvā sādhuṃ taṃ paripūjayet ।।72।।
parameśaṃ tathā santaṃ jñānadaṃ ca guruṃ prabhum ।
satīṃ sādhvīṃ pūjayecca mokṣado hi yato guruḥ ।।73।।
kiṃ tairye vṛṣabhā nohyāḥ kiṃ dhenvā vā'pyadugdhayā ।
kiṃ patnyā vandhyayā lābhaḥ ko'rthā rājñā'pyarakṣatā ।।74।।
kiṃ taddhanena dehena sevā sādhorna me bhavet ।
kiṃ rājyena ca śuṣkeṇa kiṃ dasyugrastasampadā ।।75।।
kiṃ niḥsnehena bhogyena kiṃ janu yanna muktidam ।
yathā kāṣṭhakṛto hastī śārdūlaścarmakṛd yathā ।।76।।
yathā ṣaṇḍho yathā kṣāraṃ kṣetraṃ nirvidyako yathā ।
yathā meghā''ḍambaraśca kṣatraṃ balavivarjitam ।।77।।
yathā vrataṃ dānahīnaṃ bhaktaḥ snehavihīnakaḥ ।
gururjñānādiśūnyaśca sarvepyete nirarthakāḥ ।।78।।
saphalaṃ mokṣadaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ tadvivarjitam ।
ātmalābho na vai yatra sa lābho hānirucyate ।।79।।
ātmalābhaḥ paro lābhaḥ paramātmasamarpaṇam ।
mokṣalābho bhavettena satyalābho mato hi saḥ ।।2.195.80 ।।
sevayantu sato nityaṃ bhajantu māṃ sadā janāḥ ।
rakṣayantu svakaṃ dharma mama dhāma prayāntvapi ।।8 1।।
bhavatāmastu vai svasti loke cātra paratra ca ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'tha rājā pupūja taṃ prabhum ।।।82।।
prajāścānarcayāmāsurbahuvastubhirādarāt ।
rājñī pūjāṃ cakārātha śrīhareḥ kanyakāyutā ।।।83।।।
tisraḥ kanyā harerhastaṃ jagṛhuḥ patibhāvitāḥ ।
sārthakaṃ ca januścakruḥ prāpya śrīpuruṣottamam ।।84।।
bhojanaṃ pradadau rājā haraye ca kuṭumbine ।
mahīmānebhya evāpi tataḥ svo bubhuje nṛpaḥ ।।85।।
cakāra sumahāntaṃ cotsavaṃ rātrau prajāyutaḥ ।
nṛtyāni kārayāmāsa vādyabhaktyādibhiḥ saha ।।86।।
rātrau subhojanaṃ labdhvā haryādyāste viśaśramuḥ ।
prātaḥ samutthitā vādyaravairmaṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ।।87।।
kṛtāhnikāstu haryādyā gantuṃ sajjāstadā'bhavan ।
mantraṃ harirdadau tatra prajābhyastūrṇamarthitam ।।88।।
rājā śrīharaye svarṇaṃ yautakaṃ bahudhā dadau ।
upadāḥ pradadau cāpi hariścāpi dhanaṃ tadā ।।89।।
lātavāyarṣiṇe prādād yathāyogyaṃ prapūjanam ।
rājā dadau vidāyaṃ ca dugdhapānottaraṃ tataḥ ।।2.195.90।।
harirvimānamāruhya tūrṇaṃ śṛṇvan jayadhvanim ।
ambare cā'bhavat sarvakuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
anyayānāni sarvāṇi cāmbare tvabhavaँstadā ।
rājā sainyena sanmānaṃ kṛtavān samayocitam ।।92।।
phenatantunṛpaścāpi phālanādo munistadā ।
ājagmatuḥ samānetuṃ nijarājyaṃ satāṃ patim ।।93 ।।
haristenārthitastūrṇaṃ bahumānapuraḥsaraḥ ।
vyomnā sarvān prayujyaivā''śīrvādaiḥ prayayau tadā ।।94।।
anyānyapi vimānāni yayustūrṇaṃ tadāmbare ।
phenatantumahārājarāṣṭramullaṃghya khāḍikām ।।95।।
tūrṇanayānadītīre saṃgamasthe manohare ।
nagare trinayākhye tatsamīpodyānamaṇḍale ।। 96।।
rājā puraḥ pragatvaiva sainyasanmānamācarat ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa harirnaijaṃ vimānakam ।।97।।
avātārayadudyāne rājasaudhasya sannidhau ।
vimānāni tathā'nyāni cāvaterustadā'mbarāt ।।98।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ prajānāṃ cā'bhavadvimānasannidhau ।।99।।
rādhike kīrtanānyeva gauryo jaguḥ prajājanāḥ ।
svāgataṃ paramaṃ rājā cakre yāntrikasadravaiḥ ।। 2.195.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāyagāmalarāṣṭre rigānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ rātriyāpanaṃ caturdaśīprātardugdhādipānottaraṃ phenatantunṛparāṣṭrābhigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā
pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 95।।


← adhyāyaḥ 195 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 196
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 197 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe tataḥ śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
vimānādavatīryā''dye ramye'śvavāhane śubhe ।। 1 ।।
vyarājat svarṇaśobhāḍhye chatracāmarayojite ।
aurṇacitrādalikāstaraṇagaddisamanvite ।। 2 ।।
phenatantunṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja puṣpahārakaiḥ ।
svargahāraiścandanādyairamūlyavaravastubhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājñī rājakuṭumbaṃ ca phālanādamunistathā ।
prajāścāpi tadā''narcuḥ śrīpatiṃ gaurikāpatim ।। 4 ।।
rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgatena vivardhayan ।
hariṃ vai bhrāmayāmāsa trinayāyāṃ samantataḥ ।। 5 ।।
rājadhānyā gopure taṃ pradhānāḥ samapūjayan ।
rājamārge rājabhṛtyāḥ śreṣṭhinaścatvarādike ।। 6 ।।
pratihaṭṭaṃ krayiṇaśca vikrayiṇaḥ prajājanāḥ ।
candanaiḥ kuṃkumaiḥ puṣpairdivyaiḥ śrīphalabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthe gauryaḥ sthale sthale tadā ।
nemuścākṣatalājābhirvardhayāmāsuracyutam ।। 8 ।।
prajājanmaphalaṃ lebhurdarśanena harestadā ।
gauryo netrā''yatalābhaṃ prāpuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vilokya ca ।। 9 ।।
trinayānagarī sarvā janasaṃkulitā tadā ।
harerdarśanakāryārthaṃ tyaktā'nyakāryikā'bhavat ।। 2.196.10 ।।
evaṃ sarvatra saṃsthāneṣvakhileṣvapi mādhavaḥ ।
datvā svadarśanaṃ rājasaudhaṃ sanmānito'gamat ।। 11 ।। 73
tatropadeśaṃ pradadau prajābhyo bhagavān svayam ।
virājamānaḥ sauvarṇe siṃhāsane'tibhāsvaraḥ ।। 1 2।।
jetavyaṃ ca mano nityaṃ saṃsāravāsanāśritam ।
indriyāṇi tathā'rthebhyo jetavyāni viśeṣataḥ ।। 13 ।।
nivartitavyaṃ satataṃ viṣayebhyaśca dehibhiḥ ।
vṛthā cintā na kartavyā vihāya parameśvaram ।। 14।।
dinaṃ vyarthaṃ na netavyaṃ bhaktiṃ bhagavato vinā ।
āyurvyarthaṃ na netavyaṃ sādhūnāṃ sevayā vinā ।। 15।।
āyāso na vṛthā kāryaḥ satsaṃgamantarā janaiḥ ।
vāṇī vyarthā na netavyā vinā me kīrtanaṃ kvacit ।। 1 6।।
daihikaṃ na vṛthā kṣepyaṃ vinā samarpaṇaṃ mayi ।
rātrirvyarthā na vai kṣepyā vinā dhyānaṃ harermama ।। 17।।
dhanaṃ vyarthaṃ na kartavyaṃ vinā manmandirādikam ।
ātmā vyartho na yoktavyo vinā māṃ parameśvaram ।। 18।।
māyā vyarthā bhavet sarvā yadyahaṃ nāsmi tatra ca ।
tathā vyarthaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ yatrā'haṃ nāsmi pūjitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
pūjite tu mayi kṛṣṇe sarve bhavati pūjitam ।
mayyarpite manāk cārthe sarvārtho nirguṇo yataḥ ।। 2.196.20।।
nairguṇyena sadā bhāvyaṃ bhaktairmānuṣavigrahaiḥ ।
adroho'nabhimānaśca hrīstitikṣā damaḥ śamaḥ ।।21 ।।
satyaṃ dhṛtiḥ smṛtirdāntiścoparatirvilubdhatā ।
guṇā hyete'rpitāḥ kṛṣṇe mayi nairguṇyamāpnuyuḥ ।।22।।
tena muktirbhavedeva mokṣado'haṃ ca nirguṇaḥ ।
sarvaiśvaryacamatkāradivyaguṇādisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 23 ।।
bhakte nairguṇyamāsañjya tārayāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
ahiṃsā satyavacanamānṛśaṃsyaṃ damo ghṛṇā ।।24।।
etattapo mahatproktaṃ tena tuṣyāmyahaṃ sadā ।
dehasya śoṣaṇācchreṣṭaṃ manaḥśoṣaṇameva ha ।। 25।।
manasaḥ śoṣaṇāt sevā dāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ mama ।
ājñānusārasaṃsthānaṃ sarvebhyo'pyadhikaṃ mama ।। 26।।
ājñāṃkito jano nityaṃ dūro'pi nikaṭe'sti vai ।
anājñākṛnnikaṭe'pi vidūre'stīti me matam ।। 27।।
tasmādāśā pālanīyāḥ guroḥ pitrorhareḥ striyāḥ ।
patyuśca pūjyavargasya viśeṣajñasya sarvadā ।।28।।
mayā vedā hi racitā ājñā vai vidhayaśca tāḥ ।
ṛṣibhistāḥ śreyase ca smaryante dehināṃ muhuḥ ।। 29।।
prajābhyastūpadiśyante vartante tadanusṛtāḥ ।
ye te muktiṃ prayāntyeva bhuktvā svargāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 2.196.3 0।।
sanmānayetpūjayecca ṛṣīn vācā ca karmaṇā ।
kuryācca priyametebhyo nā'priyaṃ kiñcidācaret ।।3 1 ।।
ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo divyā mama mūrtaya eva te ।
sarvathā guṇakośāste matsvarūpā vimuktidāḥ ।।32।।
nahi doṣo guṇo veti nirūpyasteṣu dṛśyate ।
ya evaṃ vartate nityaṃ sādhusatsaṃgamaṇḍale ।।33।।
yatra kvāpi sthitaḥ te'tra kalpyate yaśase ciram ।
pare svarge mama dhāmni gata eva sa kalpyate ।।34।।
loko'yaṃ tvāpadāṃ sthānaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vipatpradaḥ ।
satāṃ yogā'jñānalabdhyā vilīyante tadāpadaḥ ।।35।।
āpado dvividhāḥ santi bāhyāścābhyantarāstathā ।
svena vānyena vā sarvāḥ prāvirbhavanti nityaśaḥ ।।36।।
ābhyantarā bhavantyeva svena kṛtena karmaṇā ।
bāhyāstvanyasamutpannā vinā kṛtyaṃ bhavantyapi ।।37।।
ābhyantarāḥ sahanena jñānena nirvaheṇa ca ।
bāhyā anunayenā'nusṛtyā dānena yānti ca ।।38 ।।
śaktyā'nnadānaṃ satataṃ dravyadānaṃ hyapekṣitam ।
ārjavaṃ mārdavaṃ cāti titikṣā pūjanādikam ।।39।।।
prasannīkaraṇaṃ cāpi bāhyāpadāṃ nivārakam ।
sarvāpadāṃ nāśakantu satāmāśīrvaco matam ।।2.196.40।।
śrīharerme śrayaṇe tu sarvasaukhyapradaṃ matam ।
sukhānāṃ śevadhiścā'haṃ yatra bhaktaiḥ supūjitaḥ ।।41 ।
rakṣitaśca dhṛtaścāpi tatrā''nandasya vāridhiḥ ।
na tatrā''patpraleśo'pi yatrā'haṃ sukhasāgaraḥ ।।42।
yatra nā'haṃ tatra caurā duṣṭā ghnanti purīpatim ।
prajā ghnanti satprāmāṇyaṃ ghnanti vinā prarakṣakam ।।43 ।
purā kākalato nāmnā munirāsīd drumāśrayaḥ ।
kākaṃ sa śikṣayāmāsa mānuṣaiḥ sahavāsanam ।।44।
kākāstu bahavastasya vṛkṣe tiṣṭhanti pañjare ।
kākavidyāṃ cireṇāsāvadhītavān samāgamāt ।।45।
vāṇīṃ sarvāṃ jñātavāँśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prasaṃgataḥ ।
śakunāni vijānāti jānātyaśakunāni ca ।।46 ।
kākān sa paṃjare kṛtvā paryacarati pattane ।
kosalāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sa yayau vasatisannidhau ।।47।
vadan janān bhāgyadarśī pravṛttyarthī punaḥ punaḥ ।
adhīdhvaṃ vāyasīṃ vidyāṃ śaṃsanti mama vāyasāḥ ।।48।
anāgatamatītaṃ ca vartamāne ca vedmyaham ।
evaṃ bhraman caturmāssu nagaryāṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe ।।49।।
sarveṣāṃ rājabhṛtyānāṃ duṣkarma paridṛṣṭavān ।
sarve'nyāyena gṛhṇanti dhanāni rājasevakāḥ ।।2.196.50 ।।
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca khādanti cauryaṃ kurvantyaśīlinaḥ ।
nirdayāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ pīḍayantyaprakāśitam ।।51 ।।
rājānaṃ hantumicchanti rājyāptaye'pi te'nugāḥ ।
etatsarvaṃ kākavācā parijñāya yayau nṛpam ।।।52 ।।
sarvajño'smīti nṛpatiṃ prāha bhṛtyādivartanam ।
amātyaṃ prāha nṛpatervacanādapi kākapaḥ ।।53 ।।
idaṃ dravyaṃ coritaṃ cāmutredaṃ ca tvayā kṛtam ।
asāvatra rājakośastvayā hṛto vināśitaḥ ।।54।।
anye kośaharāścāpi bhavantīme'nugāstava ।
evamākhyāti kāko'yaṃ satyametanmayoditam ।।55।।।
rājā pragṛhya tān sarvān kośadravyamamārgayat ।
sarva satyaṃ prajātaṃ tat nā'nṛtaṃ kathitaṃ tu yat ।।56।।
tena rājñā daṇḍitāste pradhānādyāstataḥ param ।
anye bhṛtyā bhītimāptā daṇḍasya kākavācinaḥ ।।।57।।
rātrau suptasya viprasya bāṇaiḥ kākamavedhayan ।
anye kākā bhinnajālātpañjarānniryayustataḥ ।।58।।
mṛtaṃ kākaṃ prasamīkṣya vipro gatvā nṛpaṃ prati ।
prāha rājaँstava kṣemaṃ yāce tvāṃ nirbhayaṃ tathā ।।59।।
vacanātte mayā satyaṃ proktaṃ kākoditaṃ tu yat ।
daṇḍitāśca tvayā bhṛtyā anye bhītāstato nvimam ।।2.196.60 ।।
kākaṃ me hatavantaste duṣṭā bhṛtyāstavā'hitāḥ ।
rājā yatra balī nāsti tatreyaṃ me daśā''gatā ।।6 1 ।।
kākadravyaṃ hataṃ me'tra kākāścānye gatāstathā ।
tvattaḥ prāptaṃ na vai kiñcit prāṇabhītiṃ vinā'param ।।62।।
bahumitrā hi rājāno bahvamitrāśca te tathā ।
rājasaṃgaprasaktasya nāśaḥ pūrvaṃ pravartate ।।63 ।।
naikāntenā'pramādo hi kartavyaḥ syānmahīpatau ।
pramādite mahīpatau viśvasto yaḥ sa naśyati ।।64।।
pramādāddhi skhaled rājā skhalite nāsti jīvanam ।
rājānaṃ sevayet prājño mṛto'smītyabhimatya vai ।।65।।
durvyāhṛtādanādeśād duḥsthitād duradhiṣṭhitāt ।
durāsitād durvrajitād īṃgitādaṃgaceṣṭitāt ।।6 6 ।।
śaṃkamānaḥ pravarteta prājño nṛpasya sannidhau ।
vaiśvānara iva kruddhaśced yāvat pradahennṛpaḥ ।।67।।
tasmānnā'haṃ nivatsye'tra mama kṣemāya kevalam ।
paraṃ nibodha me rājan yatra rājā na vidyate ।।68 ।।
tatrāpadaḥ prajāsveva jāyante duṣṭanoditāḥ ।
yatra rājā nirbalaścā'draṣṭā'jñātā'vivekavān ।।69।।
tatrāpi cāpado gurvyo bhavantyeva prajāsvapi ।
bhavadrājye vasantyeva bhṛtyā ādānatatparāḥ ।।2.196.70 ।।
abhūtikāmā bhūtānāṃ vināśacauryahāriṇaḥ ।
ye vā bhavadvināśena rājyamicchantyanantakam ।।7 1 ।।
teṣāmahaṃ bhayād rājan gamiṣyāmyanyamāśrayam ।
yathā kāko mṛtastaiścābhisandhitaśareṇa me ।।।72 ।।
tathā'haṃ vā tathā tvaṃ vā mā bāṇasya gatiṃ gataḥ ।
syāṃ syā veti viniścitya tīrṇo'smi kākadānataḥ ।।73 ।।
bahunakrajhaṣagrāhāṃ timiṃgilagaṇairyutām ।
tava rājyātmikāṃ duṣṭāṃ nadīṃ maraṇadāyinīm ।। 74।।
gahanaṃ tava rājyaṃ vai hyandhakāramayaṃ nanu ।
neha viśvasituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatā'pi kuto mayā ।।71।।
ato nātra śubho vāso vadho yatrā'grago'sti vai ।
sukṛtaṃ vadhyate yatra rakṣyante duṣprakarmiṇaḥ ।। 76 ।।
neha yuktaṃ ciraṃ sthātuṃ cātmanaḥ kṣemamicchatā ।
madhuprapātaṃ rājyaṃ te bhojanaṃ viṣasaṃyutam ।।77।।
āśīviṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ cāsadbhiḥ khāditaṃ pṛthak ।
śvagṛdhragomāyuyutaṃ rājaँstatpariśodhaya ।।78।।
tvayā puṣṭāstvayā rājye'dhikṛtāḥ paripālitāḥ ।
tvāmeva cābhisandhāya jighāṃsanti tavā'nugāḥ ।।79।।
bhavato'rthe mama kāko hatastairduṣṭamānasaiḥ ।
tasmād yāmi mahārāja kāraṇaṃ nānyadasti yat ।।2.196.8 0 ।।
arerhi durhṛdāt sarvairbhettavyaṃ kṣemayācibhiḥ ।
ityuktaśca nṛpaḥ prāha kākinaṃ satyavādinam ।।8 1 ।।
ahaṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣye te satkāreṇā'pi bhūyasā ।
toṣayiṣye kākapālin bhūyo vasa gṛhe mama ।।8 2।।
evaṃ taṃ kathayantaṃ ca rājānaṃ prāha kākapaḥ ।
mā kuru tvaṃ sāhasaṃ vā vegaṃ rājan vidhāviha ।।8 3।।
kintvekaikaṃ pradaṇḍena pragṛhya durbalīkuru ।
tato doṣānusāreṇa pratyekaṃ puruṣaṃ jahi ।।84।।
evaṃ kṛte vijayaste nā'nyathā sahasā kṛte ।
kaṇṭakā bahavo yuktā hiṃsanti hastinaṃ dṛḍhāḥ ।।85।।
mṛdavo bahavo yuktā hiṃsanti balinaṃ nṛpam ।
adṛśyā bahavo doṣā nighnanti varṣmaṇaḥ patim ।।86 ।।
tasmādekaikaśo doṣā iva kṣayyā hi śatravaḥ ।
evamukte cakāraivaṃ rājā jaghāna vai kramāt ।।87।।
śatrūn niṣkaṣṭakaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā śrīkosalādhipaḥ ।
śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ paścāt kṛtvā satkarmaśobhanam ।।88।।
vrataṃ tapastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ guroḥ satām ।
kṛtvā ca bhajanaṃ divyaṃ yayau dhāma sukhāspadam ।।89।।
tathā dehanagaryā vai rājā kauśalanāmakaḥ ।
ātmā'yaṃ vartata dasyuvaryakrodhādipīḍitaḥ ।। 2.196.90।।
guruḥ kākī śāstrakākān saha nītvā purīpatim ।
krodhādīnāṃ tu duṣṭatvaṃ vadatyeva punaḥ punaḥ ।। 91 ।।
doṣāḥ śāstravihantāro'tidṛḍhā balinastathā ।
māyāyāṃ sthitamātmānaṃ jighāṃsanti ca saṃhatāḥ ।। 92।।
tadvijñāya nṛpeṇaivā''tmānaṃ bhāvyaṃ sasattakam ।
doṣāḥ kramācchanaireva hantavyā nijasattayā ।।93।।।
tato niṣkaṇṭake rājye kuryācchrīkṛṣṇasevanam ।
tenā''nando mahāँścāpi muktirājyaṃ bhavediha ।। 94।।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
upādiśya virarāma dadau mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।। 95 ।।
tāvat kanyādvayaṃ rājño rājñā sākaṃ sabhāsthale ।
prapūjya paramaṃ kāntaṃ jagrāha śrīhareḥ karam ।। 96 ।।
vivāhavidhinā prāpya prabhuṃ jāte kṛtārthike ।
hariṃ rājā prajāḥ sarve pūjayāmāsureva tu ।। 97।।
bhūpatiḥ kārayāmāsa bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ tataḥ ।
sarve viśaśramuḥ sāyaṃ rātrau cakrurmahotsavam ।। 98।।
prātarutthāya bhagavān phālanādāya sarvathā ।
upadāvastusarvasvaṃ pradadau parameśvaraḥ ।। 99।।
kṛtāhniko dugdhapānaṃ kṛtvā gantuṃ mano'karot ।
tāvadrājā stokahomo netuṃ kṛṣṇamupāyayau ।। 2.196.100 ।।
phenatantuṃ samāpṛcchya hariḥ sajjo'bhavad drutam ।
rājadattāṃ parigṛhya pūjāṃ vimānago'bhavat ।। 101 ।।
anye sarve mahīmānā vimānagāstadā'bhavan ।
vidāyatūryaninadāstadā jayaravaiḥ saha ।। 1 02।।
ambare dikṣu sarvatrā'vyāpnuvan prajayā kṛtāḥ ।
harṣanādāḥ samabhavan śṛṇvan tān śrīhariryayau ।। 103 ।।
stokahomanṛparājyaṃ svāduvadanarāṣṭrakam ।
samudrakhāḍikāṃ muktvā deśaṃ dadarśa saubhagam ।। 1 04।।
rājā yayau purastatra svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ khalu ।
ṛṣiḥ svādananāmāpi yayau purastadā'mbarāt ।। 105।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne phena- tantunṛpasya trinayānagaryāṃ śrīhareravataraṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanam upadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ ratryanantaraṃ bhādrakṛṣṇā'māyāṃ prātardugdhapānottaraṃ stokahomanṛparāṣṭrāgamanamityādi nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṇavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 196 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 196 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
