śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike svādanarṣiśca stokahomo nṛpo'pi ca ।
ambarādavatīryaiva mahodyāne viśālake ।। 1 ।।
umāpuryāḥ sannidhau svāgatārthaṃ yayaturdrutam ।
sainyamādāya tūdyāne tiṣṭhataḥ saṃpratīkṣataḥ ।। 2 ।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।
hariścānye vimānāni tadudyāne'vatārayan ।। 3 ।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathā'bhavan ।
prajānāṃ harṣanādāśca kīrtanāni tadā'bhavan ।
vimānaṃ phalapuṣpādyaiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃpravardhitam ।। 4 ।।
harirlājā'kṣatādyaiśca vardhitaḥ svāgatīkṛtaḥ ।
śrīharirmadhyabhāgācca vimānād bahirāyayau ।। 5 ।।
rājā pupūja vai bhaktyā svarṇakausumaśekharaiḥ ।
hārai ratnamayaiḥ pauṣpairgucchaiścandanavāribhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
sugandhasārairvividhaiḥ pādaprakṣālanena ca ।
papau pādajalaṃ cāpi kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
pradhānādyaiśca sahitaḥ prajābhiḥ sahitastathā ।
atha rājā tu pitarau hareḥ pupūja vai tataḥ ।। 8 ।।
rājñī brahmapriyāḥ sarvāḥ pupūja parameśvarīḥ ।
rājā''narceśānadevaṃ kanyā gaurīṃ pupūja ca ।। 9 ।।
ṛṣirmaharṣīnānarca bhūbhṛttadā hariṃ prabhum ।
nyaṣādayannarayāne śeṣavatsvarṇamaṇḍite ।। 2.197.1 0।।
phaṇāsahasraśobhāḍhye ṣaṣṭimānavavāhite ।
anyān nyaṣādayad rājā śakaṭīṣu navāsu ca ।। 11 ।।
tatastūryaninādairhi yaśogānaiḥ sugītibhiḥ ।
nināditāsu tvāśāsu hariḥ svāgataśobhitaḥ ।। 1 2।।
umāpuryāṃ vicacāra pāvayituṃ pratisthalam ।
gopure rājapuruṣairvardhito ratnamaṇḍanaiḥ ।। 13 ।।
purīmadhye bhṛtyavaryaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiśca mahāpathe ।
gṛhibhiścāṃgaṇeṣveva sarvatra prajayā tadā ।। 14।।
vardhitaḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo yayau dadan svadarśanam ।
pūjāṃ prāpya tataḥ sainyasahitaḥ svanivāsanam ।। 15।।
āyayau jalapānādi cakāra nṛpanoditaḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ jalapānādi cakre tathā'pare'pi ca ।। 16।।
jalapānādikaṃ cakruratha kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāsthale ।
rājasiṃhāsane sthitvā niṣadyopādideśa ha ।। 17।।
prajābhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ parameśvarahetave ।
rājabhiḥ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ prajāntaryāmihetave ।। 18।। '
ubhābhyāṃ sarvathā bhāvyaṃ mitho'ntaryāmihetave ।
ubhayatra virāje'haṃ māṃ yajantu samāhitāḥ ।। 1 9।।
tena yuṣmadvijayaśca bhuktau muktau bhaviṣyati ।
sādhūn saṃpūjayennityaṃ spardhāṃ tatra parityajet ।। 2.197.20।।
na ca kāmād bhayāllobhākrodhādvā dharmamutsṛjet ।
amāninā satyavācā bhāvyaṃ jitātmanā tathā ।।21।।
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya bhūtirbhavati śāśvatī ।
tejo dhairyaṃ kṣamā śaucamanurāgaḥ sthitirdhṛtiḥ ।।22।।
etān guṇān samāśritya vartitavyaṃ hi muktaye ।
kṛtaprajñaśca medhāvī budhaḥ sarvātmadarśakaḥ ।।23।।
sarvasatkarmaśuddhaśca vijñaścātmaparātmanoḥ ।
suhṛdātmā virāgaśca malloke gantumarhati ।।24।।
satyavāk śīlasampannaḥ satrapo brahmasaṃsmaraḥ ।
santuṣṭaḥ satyavratavān malloke gantumarhati ।।25।।
sāntvanaṃ vacanaṃ caikapadaṃ guṇairvibhūṣitam ।
ācaran puruṣaḥ saukhyaṃ labhet sarvatra sṛṣṭiṣu ।।26।।
sāma me stavanaṃ proktaṃ sāntvanaṃ ca tadeva tat ।
janānāṃ sāntvanaṃ cāpi hṛdisthasya mamaiva tat ।।27।।
tena tuṣyāmi satataṃ sāntvakīrtanasevanaiḥ ।
sāntvaṃ caikapadaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhadaṃ sadā ।।28।।
sukṛtasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca ।
samyagāsevyamānasya jihvāyāṃ saṃvasāmyaham ।।29।।
vyavahāreṇa śuddhena hṛdaye saṃvasāmyaham ।
ubhābhyāṃ sannidhau tasya cāgatya gocaro yathā ।। 2.197.3 0।।
bhavāmyeva tathā nityaṃ karomyasya śubhaṃ nvaham ।
evaṃ tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ dhārmikeṣu janeṣvaham ।।3 1 ।।
dhārmikaiśca janairyatra svakīyā vasatiḥ kṛtā ।
tatra gūḍho vasāmyeva teṣāṃ rakṣaṇahetave ।। 32।।
yaṣṭavyaṃ kratubhistaiśca dātavyaṃ dānayogine ।
anātharakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ dharmabādhakam ।। 33।।
kṛpaṇā'nāthavṛddhānāṃ yoṣitāṃ sevināṃ tathā ।
yogaḥ kṣemastathā vṛttiḥ kalpanīyā hi dhārmikaiḥ ।। 34।।
āśrameṣu yathākālaṃ cailabhājanabhojanam ।
dātavyaṃ taiḥ prajājanairnṛpeṇa śreṣṭhinā'pi ca ।।35।।
sarvārthatyāginaṃ santaṃ mokṣadaṃ śāstrasaṃvṛtam ।
pūjayecchreya icchan vai śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ ।।36।।
dasyavo'pi ghātakāśca viśvasanti tathāvidhe ।
pāpanāśakare śuddhe sādhau mokṣaprade gurau ।।37।।
sarvaśreyaskare sādhau viśvasanti vanasthitāḥ ।
āraṇyakāśca paśavaḥ siṃhāḥ krūrādayo'pi ca ।। 38।।
śānti labhante tatraiva yatra sādhunivāsanam ।
ṛtavo'pi sattvavṛttā bhavanti sādhusaṃgame ।। 39।।
bhūtāni sattvayuktāni jāyante sādhusannidhau ।
ahaṃ yasmād vasāmyeva sādhūnāṃ hṛdaye'nvaham ।।2.197.40 ।।
teṣāṃ sevanataḥ sevā mama saṃjāyate śubhā ।
phalaṃ yatsevanasyaiva jāyate sāghusevanāt ।।41।।
yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ yathābuddhiṃ yathābalam ।
sādhūn seveta satataṃ dharmārthī mokṣalālasaḥ ।।42।।
yathā śreyo bhavennaijaṃ tathā seveta kṣemavat ।
tathā karmāṇi kurvīta sādhustuṣṭo bhaved yathā ।।43 ।।
ye bhūtānyanugṛhṇanti śikṣayanti vṛṣādikam ।
te sādhavaḥ sadā rakṣyā rāṣṭre rājñā vipaścitā ।।44।।
dhanī saṃpūjayennityaṃ pānācchādanabhojanaiḥ ।
sādhuṃ prajāniyantāraṃ dharmasya śāsakaṃ śubham ।।45।।
prāyo dhanī dhārmikaśca tapoyuktān prapūjayet ।
buddhimān sādhupuruṣaṃ rakṣet svanagare sadā ।।46।।
satyamārjavamakrodhaṃ bhaktiṃ dharmaṃ virāgitām ।
pālayantaḥ sādhavaste rāṣṭrakṣemakarā matāḥ ।।47।।
kiṃ chidraṃ kasya saṃgo me kiṃ vā karomi sādhanam ।
kuto māṃ nāśrayed doṣaḥ iti vidvān vicintayet ।।48।।
rājā sādhūn rakṣayedvai sarvadoṣaharā hi te ।
dharmāya rājā bhavati lokarakṣaṇahetave ।।49।।
rājā carati ceddharmaṃ devatvāyaiva kalpate ।
rājā caratyadharmaṃ cennarakāyaiva kalpate ।।2.197.50।।
dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmau rājasu tiṣṭhati ।
taṃ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā rakṣako mataḥ ।।51।।
rājā paramadharmātmā sādhurdharmaḥ sa ucyate ।
svadharme vartamānānāmarthasiddhiḥ pradṛśyate ।।52।।
tameva maṃgalaṃ dharmaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate ।
mamedamiti naivā'sti sādhūnāṃ dharmaśālinām ।।53।।
ṛṣayaḥ sādhavo vīkṣya lokakṣemaṃ samantataḥ ।
asṛjatsa mahadbhūtaṃ hyayaṃ dharmo bhaviṣyati ।।54।।
yasmin dharmo virājeta sa rājā rakṣako mataḥ ।
dharme vardhati vardhante sarvabhūtāni saukhyataḥ ।।55।।
tasmin hrasati hīyante tasmāddharmaṃ prarakṣayet ।
prabhavārthaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ dharmaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ।।56।।
sādhau dharmaḥ prabhavati rakṣyāstasmāddhi sādhavaḥ ।
dharmasya sādhavo yonistasmāttān pūjayet sadā ।।57।।
mattātpramattāt paugaṇḍādunmattādvyasanāśrayāt ।
māyikācca śaṭhāddhūrtāllampaṭātkitavātmakāt ।।58।।
dūre bhavanti satataṃ sādhavo nirmalā yataḥ ।
tārayanti nimagnāँśca prāpayanti ca māmapi ।।59।।
tasmād rakṣyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ sevanīyāḥ hi sādhavaḥ ।
atyāgaṃ cābhimānaṃ ca daṃbhaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayet ।।2.197.60 ।।
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśca yugaturyatā ।
rājādhināni sarvāṇi rājaiva yugamucyate ।।6 1 ।।
sudharmātmā nṛpaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ yugaṃ sa tūcyate ।
adharmātmā bhaved rājā sādhavastvapayānti vai ।।62।।
vipado'pi bhaveyurvai rāṣṭre tatra samantataḥ ।
adharmabhūte nṛpatau sarve sīdanti jantavaḥ ।।63।।
yasya nāsti gururdharme na ca sādhūn supṛcchati ।
svayaṃ cāpāradarśī ca na ciraṃ sukhamaśnute ।।64।।
gurupradhāno dharmeṣu sādhudharme svayaṃ sthitaḥ ।
dharmapradhāno nṛpatiḥ sukhamakṣayamaśnute ।।65।।
tasmād prajābhiḥ satataṃ rājñā ca dharmavarmaṇi ।
vartitavyaṃ sādhusaṃge yena bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam ।।66।।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇo virarāmā'tha vai tataḥ ।
bhūpatiḥ pūjayāmāsa prajāḥ pupūjurādarāt ।।67।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ stokahomasya kanyakā ।
mātṛvākyaṃ paripālya kṛṣṇahastamupādade ।।68।।
kṛtakṛpyā'bhavad gaurī rājotsavaṃ cakāra ha ।
hariṃ saṃbhojayāmāsa kuṭumbaṃ mahīmānakān ।।69।।
viśaśramustataḥ sarve prajāḥ svasvālayān yayuḥ ।
rātrau nṛtyādi ca rājā'kārayanmahadutsave ।।2.197.70।।
bhojanaṃ cātha viśrāntiṃ jagṛhuśca tataḥ param ।
prātarutthāya bhagavān kṛtāhnikaḥ supūjitaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
kṛtadugdhādipānaśca sajjo'bhūd gantumacyutaḥ।
rājā dadāvupadāśca sainyena saha śobhanaḥ ।।72।।
vidāyaṃ pradadau cāpi tūryanādāstadā'bhavan ।
harirvimānamāruhya śṛṇvan jayadhvanīn śubhān ।।73 ।।
gaurīṇāṃ gītikāścāpi sarvairvimānavāsibhiḥ ।
prayayau cāmbarāttūrṇaṃ kāṣṭhayānanṛpasya vai ।।74।।
rāṣṭraṃ nāraravarṣidhraṃ sāgarāntaṃ mahāyatam ।
tunnayāmānagaryāḥ sannidhau vṛkṣādhivāsite ।।75।।
udyāne kāṣṭhayānaśca rājā puro yayau tathā ।
nāraravamuniścāpi svāgatārthaṃ hareryayau ।।76।।
ityevaṃ rādhike rājā sainyayukto'bhavatpuraḥ ।
sarvāḥ prajāstathā kṛṣṇasanmānārtha samāyayuḥ ।।77।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne stokahomasya umāpuryāṃ hareravataraṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanam upadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklapratipadi prātastataḥ kāṣṭhayānanṛpatirāṣṭrāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 197 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 198
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 199 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha rādhe bālakṛṣṇaṃ kāṣṭhayāno nṛpastadā ।
ādideśā'vatarituṃ vimānena yutaṃ harim ।। 1 ।।
harirvimānamākāśādudyāne samatārayat ।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadā'mbarāt ।। 2 ।।
sainyavādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstato'bhavan ।
prajābhirvardhitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jaharṣa ca ।। 3 ।।
candanākṣatakusumairhārakādyaiśca pūjitaḥ ।
rājñā ca prajayā cāpi muninā'rcita īśvaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
āyayau sa vimānādvai bahiḥ prasannatānvitaḥ ।
abhayaṃ pradadan premṇā kareṇa kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kāṣṭhayāno mahārājo harerhāraṃ gale dadau ।
koṭihīrakamūlyāḍhyaṃ pādau pupūja candanaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
papau jalaṃ prasādotthaṃ kuṭumbaṃ cāpyapūjayat ।
śyāmāśvasyandane kṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayanmudānvitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
rātrā chatraṃ dadhārā'tha kumārau cāmare śubhe ।
tadā jayasya ninadāḥ prabhābhirabhighoṣitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
gaurībhiḥ puṣpamālābhiścākṣatairvardhitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
athā'nyān vai mahīmānān vāhaneṣu śubheṣu ca ।। 9 ।।
rājā nyaṣādayat samyaguccāvaceṣu vai tadā ।
tunnavāyānagaryāṃ śrīhariṃ tvabhrāmayannṛpaḥ ।। 2.198.1 0।।
rājñā gopuramadhye ca samarcitaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
pradhānaiḥ pañcavartibhirnīrājitaśca pūjitaḥ ।। 1 1।।
śreṣṭhibhiḥ pūjito madhye nagaryā hṛdayāṃgaṇe ।
āpaṇeṣu prajābhiśca pūjitaḥ phalanāṇakaiḥ ।। 12।।
gṛhe gṛhe ca gaurībhirarcitaḥ prāṇadhārakaḥ ।
evaṃ vai nagarīṃ sarvāṃ bhramitvā bhagavān svayam ।। 13।।
ājagāma nivāsaṃ svaṃ rājodyāne ca mandiram ।
tatrā'bhavatsabhā ramyā lokānāṃ bhagavān svayam ।। 14।।
pūjāṃ prāpya prajābhyaścopādideśa hitāvaham ।
saṃsārasāgaraścāsti śītoṣṇādipradaḥ sadā ।। 15।।
nimajjamānaṃ spṛśati doṣanakranakhādikam ।
tarituṃ nausvarūpā vai bhavanti khalu sādhavaḥ ।। 16।।
tārayanti kare dhṛtvā bhavasāgaramajjitān ।
bhagavān hṛdaye yeṣāṃ nityaṃ vasāmi mokṣadaḥ ।। 17।।
te pūjyāḥ sādhavo dhīrā hṛdayaṃ me yato matāḥ ।
sādhupakṣe vijayaḥ syādaihikaḥ pāramārthikaḥ ।। 18।।
asādhuyukto vijayo hyadhruvo'svargya eva ca ।
sādayatyeva jayinaṃ saṃsāre ghorakardame ।। 19।।
yastu dharmavilopena maryādālopanena ca ।
sādhuvākyopalaṃghanena kuryāttatra sukhāvaham ।।2.198.20।।
yasya lokāḥ prasannāścātithayaḥ pūjayā'rhitāḥ ।
santuṣṭaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ ca nārāyaṇo gṛhe'sya vai ।।21।।
sādhavo guravaścācāryāścānye pūjyamānavāḥ ।
satyaśca pūjitā yasya tasya gṛhe vasāmyaham ।।22।।
nigraheṇa tu pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃgraheṇa ca ।
bhaktyā yajñena dānena sevayā'haṃ vaśī sadā ।।23 ।।
sādhvarthe cāpi mokṣārthe haryarthe yaśca yudhyati ।
ātmānaṃ yūpamutsṛjya sa yaśo'nantadakṣiṇaḥ ।।24।।
madarthaṃ tyaktamānādirmadarthaṃ dīkṣitaśca yaḥ ।
so'śnute sarvakāmān vai sarvārthapraduho'kṣayān ।।25।।
duṣṭāँstyaktvā tataḥ sādhoḥ saṃgatiṃ sarvadā''caret ।
duṣṭān bhāvairvijānīyālliṃgaiḥ parokṣagocaraiḥ ।। 26।।
parokṣamaguṇānāha sadguṇānabhyasūyate ।
parairvā kīrtyamāneṣu tūṣṇīmāste parāṅmukhaḥ ।।27।।
niḥśvāsaṃ cauṣṭhasaṃdaṃśaṃ śirasaśca prakampanam ।
karotyabhīkṣṇaṃ vimanā bhāṣate viparītakam ।।28।।
parokṣe tu vikurute pratyakṣe nābhibhāṣate ।
pṛthaguktvā ca mṛdgāti nedṛgidaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।29।।
āsane śayane yāne viruddhaṃ parivartate ।
yasmiँstatra pravijñeyaṃ duṣṭatvaṃ sahavāsataḥ ।।2.198.3 0।।
ārtirārte priye prītiretāvanmitralakṣaṇam ।
viparītaṃ tu boddhavyaṃ sadā duṣṭārilakṣaṇam ।।3 1 ।।
sādhavaḥ suhṛdo mitravaryā ātmahitaiṣiṇaḥ ।
pāpahā mokṣadāḥ santi sevanīyā viśeṣataḥ ।।32।।
svayaṃ cāpi vivekena vartitavyaṃ tadagrataḥ ।
hṛdaye'pi vivekaṃ vai kuryādanityavastunaḥ ।।33 ।।
anityaṃ sarvamevaitanmamā'haṃkārasaṃbhṛtam ।
nāmarūpaṃ yadastyeva sarvaṃ tannāsti cottare ।।34।।
evaṃ vivekavān naṣṭe vyathate na kadācana ।
prāpte na harṣavānāste gatvare kā nu devanā ।।35।।
āpadaṃ pragataścāpi vyathate na vivekavān ।
bhūtaṃ gataṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tu nāgataṃ vartate tu yat ।।36।।
hasamānaṃ prayātyeva sarvaṃ tanna bhaviṣyati ।
evaṃ viditavedyastu nahi śokāya kalpate ।।37।।
āgataṃ tadvinaśyeta jñātvaivaṃ ko nu saṃjvaret ।
śokamūlaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ jñātvā śokaṃ parityajet ।।38।।
kva nu vṛddhā gatā ye tu pitā pitāmahādayaḥ ।
sarve dhruvā na vidyante jñātvaivaṃ ko nu saṃjvaret। ।।39।।
bālā madhyavayasaśca tato vṛddhāścirāyuṣaḥ ।
lakṣādhilakṣakoṭyabdā mariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।2.198.40 ।।
tathāpi mahatīṃ tṛṣṇāṃ vimuñcanti na dehinaḥ ।
vicāryaivaṃ ca tāṃ tyaktvā kurvīta priyamātmanaḥ ।।41 ।।
anāgataṃ na me cāsti krāntaṃ me nahi vartate ।
asti me na lalāṭe'sti tasmāt sādhurbhavet sadā ।।42।।
anāḍhyāścāpi jīvanti rājāno'pi tathaiva ca ।
rājasu vyādhibāhulyaṃ nā'nāḍhye'to'dhanaḥ sukhī ।।43।।
evaṃ matvā na śoceta kālaḥ sarvatra vai samaḥ ।
bhoktāro'nye'rjayitāro'pare cintāparāḥ pare ।।44।।
sarvabhogyeṣu loke'tra dṛṣṭvaivaṃ na śucaścaret ।
pūrvadattaṃ parasmiँśca prāpyeteti sthitidhrurvā ।।45।।
adattaṃ cāpi vāñcchanti vinā yatnaṃ laṣanti ca ।
hīnabhogyo janaḥ so'jaṃ garhate na nijaṃ kvacit ।।46।।।
īrṣyābhimānasampannastūdvegaṃ labhate tataḥ ।
etasmāt kāraṇād vyaktau duḥkhaṃ bhūyo'nuvartate ।।47।।
sahanīyā parā lakṣmīryā nāsti svalalāṭake ।
yatitavyaṃ tadarthaṃ vā yatnaphalā ramā yataḥ ।।48।।
anyatrāpi satīṃ lakṣmīṃ kuśalā bhuñjate sadā ।
abhinispandate śrīrhi yatnavantaṃ prabhāvinam ।।49।।
śriyaṃ ca putrapautrāṃśca kanyāṃ ca pṛthivīmapi ।
utpādya parabhogyāni svayameva tyajanti hi ।।2.198.50।।
akāmyān kāmayāno'rthān parādhīnānupadravān ।
tyaktvā bhavettu saṃkalpān sukhī sādhuryathā'grahī ।।5 1।।
anarthāstvartharūpā vai arthāścānartharūpiṇaḥ ।
bhavantyeva yathābhāgyaṃ tatra prājño na viśvaset ।।।52।
arthāyaiva tu keṣāñcit sarvanāśo bhavatyapi ।
anarthāyaiva keṣāñcid bahulābho bhavatyapi ।।53।।
ajñaścānantalubdhaśca sukhaṃ matvā prasajjate ।
ramamāṇaḥ śriyā paścānnānyacchreyo'bhimanyate ।।।54।।
akasmāttu śriyo nāśe samāraṃbho vinaśyati ।
tadā nirvidyate so'rthāt paribhagnamanorathaḥ ।।55।।
dharmameke carantyeva kalyāṇābhijanā bhuvi ।
paratra sukhamicchanto nirvidyante tu laukikāt ।।56।।
dhanameke'rjayantyeva mahālobhābhimarditāḥ ।
jīvitārthaṃ hi manyante puruṣārthaṃ dhanaṃ ca te ।।57।।
jñātvā teṣāṃ kṛpaṇatāṃ jñātvā teṣāmabuddhitām ।
adhruve jīvite mohādarthadṛṣṭimupāśritān ।।58।।
niṣphalān tapyamānāँśca jñānavarjitamānavān ।
vilokyā'ndhatamaḥkṣiptān ko nu dadyānmṛṣā manaḥ ।।59।।
niyacchatendriyāṇyebhyo yacchatāpi mano nijam ।
saṃyacchata giro'pyebhyo viṣayebhyo vicārataḥ ।।2.198.60।।
bhavata pratiṣeddhārastadā jayo bhaviṣyati ।
bhāveṣu kṣaṇamātreṣu prajñātṛpto na śocati ।।6 1।।
alpe tṛpto mṛdurdānto brahmaśīlo na śocati ।
nṛśaṃsavṛttiṃ pāpiṣṭhāṃ prāptaḥ śokānna mucyate ।।62।।
api mūlaphalā''jīvo ramate nirjane vane ।
vāgyato matparo bhaktaḥ sarvārpaṇaḥ sukhī janaḥ ।।63।।
manīṣayā vinigṛhyeṣaṇāḥ sukhī gṛhī bhavet ।
yathaiko ramate'raṇyeṣvāraṇyenaiva tuṣyati ।।64।।
mahāpuruṣatṛptaśca svātmanaiva prasīdati ।
sādhuvadvartamānasya sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ parātmani ।।65।।
hitvā daṃbhaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ harṣaṃ bhayaṃ tathā ।
sādhūn prasevya dehādyaiḥ śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ।।66।।
sādhusevā paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyādhikaṃ matam ।
asaṃśayaṃ puṇyaśīlaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ।।67।।
mātāpitrorgurūṇāṃ ca pūjā bahumatā mama ।
iha yukto naro lokān yaśastu mahadaśnute ।।68।।
yacca te'bhyanujānīyuḥ kartavyaṃ pūjitāḥ khalu ।
dharmyaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ vā tatkartavyaṃ sutādibhiḥ ।।69।।
na ca tairabhyanujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācaret ।
yaṃ ca te'bhyanujānīyuḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ।।2.198.70 ।।
ete eva trayo lokāstrayo'gnayaśca te matāḥ ।
trayo vedāstryāśramāśca tanmatasthā jayanti vai ।।71 ।।
pitā vai gārhapatyo'gnirmātā vai dakṣiṇo'nalaḥ ।
guruścāhavanīyāgniḥ sāgnitretā garīyasī ।।72।।
triṣvapramādyanneteṣu trīn lokān vijayeta vai ।
pitṛvṛttyā tvimaṃ lokaṃ mātṛvṛttyā divaṃ tathā ।।73 ।।
brahmalokaṃ guruvṛttyā jayeta nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
nityaṃ paricaretvetān tadvai sukṛtamuttamam ।।74।।
sarve tasyā''dṛtā lokā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ ।
anādṛtāstu yasyaite sarvāstasyā'phalāḥ kriyāḥ ।।75।।
amānitā nityameva yasyaite guravastrayaḥ ।
na cāyaṃ na parolokastasya kṣemāya jāyate ।।76।।
na cātra vā pare loke yaśastasya pravartate ।
na cānyadapi kalyāṇaṃ cobhayatrā'sya jāyate ।।77।।
daśaśrotriyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadācāryo hi vidyate ।
daśācāryebhya evātropādhyāyaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ।।78।।
daśopādhyāyataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pitā sarvatra vartate ।
daśapitruttamā mātā sarvapṛthvīsamā hi sā ।।79।।
gururmātā yathā proktā nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
gururgarīyān pitṛto mātṛtaścāpi sarvadā ।।2.198.80।।
ubhau hi mātāpitarau janmadau śarīrasṛjau ।
gururjñānaprado divyo divyajñātikarastathā ।।8 1 ।।
guruyuktā tu yā jātiḥ sā divyā sā'jarā'marā ।
avadhyā hi sadā mātā pitā guruḥ sutādibhiḥ ।।82।।
ṛṣayaścāpi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha ।
pūjyamāneṣu guruṣu tasmāt pūjyatamo guruḥ ।।83 ।।
kenacinna ca vṛttena hyavajñeyo gururbhavet ।
na te'vamānamarhanti mātā pitā gurustathā ।।84।।
na teṣāṃ dūṣayet kāryaṃ satkāraṃ tvācaret sadā ।
avamānaprakartuśca bhrūṇahatyāghamasti yat ।।85।।
mitradruhaḥ kṛtaghnasya strīghnasya gurughātinaḥ ।
caturṇāṃ niṣkṛtirnāsti mahāmahātipāpinām ।।86 ।।
sādhavaḥ śrīharerbhaktāstyāgino guravaḥ śubhāḥ ।
pūjanīyā vandanīyā bhojanīyāḥ samantataḥ ।।87।।
teṣu vai dharmasarvasvaṃ seviteṣu bhavediha ।
santuṣṭeṣu sarvayajñā bhavantīha na saṃśayaḥ ।।88।।
evaṃ gurūn pūjayitvā''rādhayitvā ca māṃ sadā ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhadhvaṃ vai matprasādājjanā iha ।।89।।
ityuktvā bhagavān rādhe virarāma tato nṛpaḥ ।
pupūja śrīhariṃ nīrājanādyaistu kṛtādaraḥ ।।2.198.90।।
pupūjuśca prajā sarvā bahubhirvastubhistadā ।
rājñī pūjāṃ cakārāpi rājakanyā kumudvatī ।।9 1।।
harerhastagrahaṃ cakre vivāhavidhinā tadā ।
mahotsavaṃ nṛpaścakre parihāraṃ cakāra ha ।।92।।
bhojayāmāsa nṛpatirhariṃ prāghūṇikāँstataḥ ।
viśramya ca niśāṃ yāpayitvā prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ ।।93।।
hariḥ sajjo'bhavad gantuṃ kolakakṣmeśarāṣṭrakam ।
kṛtadugdhādipānaśca kṛtārcano vimānakam ।।94।।
samāruroha sarve'pi cāruruhustato'mbare ।
jayanādaiḥ saha kṛṣṇo lepanādarṣisaṃyutaḥ ।। 95।।
lepadeśān yayuḥ śīghraṃ mānito mānavaistadā ।
rājā svāgatasiddhyarthaṃ yayau purotibhāvatāḥ ।। 96।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāṣṭhayānanṛpasya tunnavāyāpuryāṃ śrīharerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanamudeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ niśottaraṃ prātaḥ kolakanṛparāṣṭrābhigamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 198 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 198 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 199
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 200 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hariḥ svayam ।
leparāṣṭranṛpaṃ sainyasahitaṃ bhuvyalokayat ।। 1 ।।
svāgatārthaṃ sthitaṃ naije mahodyāne'tivistṛte ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vimānamambarāt pṛthvyāṃ muramāṣāpurītaṭe ।
viśāle ramyabhāge cāvātārayat suśobhite ।। 3 ।।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvateruḥ samīpataḥ ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathā'bhavan ।। 4 ।।
gaurīṇāṃ gītikāścāsan prajānāṃ harṣaghoṣaṇāḥ ।
vimānācca hariḥ śīghraṃ bahistatra samāyayau ।। 5 ।
rājñā ca prajayā rājñyā maharṣiṇā'rcitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
hāraiḥ suśekharaiḥ puṣpaiścandanairakṣatādibhiḥ ।। 6
anye'pi pūjitāstatra mahīmānāḥ prajājanaiḥ ।
narayāne hariṃ rājā niṣādyā'nyān gajādiṣu ।। 7 ।
muramāṣānagaryāṃ cā'bhrāmayad bahumānataḥ ।
rājavaṃśaḥ pradhānāśca śreṣṭhinaḥ paṇḍitā api ।। 8 ।
narā nāryo gopurādau rājamārge susaṃgame ।
catvarādau ca śālāsu pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।। 9 ।
bahvībhistūpadābhiśca svarṇaratnavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
anekadivyabhūṣābhiḥ kambalaiśca dhanaistathā ।। 2.199.10।।
sthale sthale pracakruste nīrājanaṃ samarhaṇam ।
gauryaḥ puṣpādibhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vardhayāmāsurīśvaram ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ sa āyayau ।
sabhāṃ kṛtvā janānāha bhagavān hitakārakaḥ ।। 12।।
saccidānandarūpo vai parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
pūjanīyo bhajanīyo mānavairmokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ।। 13 ।।
satyaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ sādhu na satyād vidyate param ।
hānidaṃ satyamevāpi vaktavyaṃ na kadācana ।। 14।।
ahiṃsārthāya bhūtānāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam ।
dhāraṇād dharma ityāhurdharmeṇa vidhṛtāḥ prajāḥ ।। 15।।
yaḥ syāddhāraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ ।
yaḥ syādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ ।। 16।
hiṃsāyāṃ satyavacane'nṛtaṃ dharma itisthitiḥ ।
anṛte'pi ca hiṃsāyāṃ dharma itisthitiḥ ।। 17।
satye'nṛte vā hiṃsāyāṃ maunaṃ dharma itisthitiḥ ।
jīvarakṣā satyaśiṣṭā satyaṃ brahma yato matam ।। 18।
caurebhyo na dhanaṃ vācyaṃ satyaṃ tatra na bhūṣaṇam ।
tebhyaḥ satyaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ sa dharma itiniścayaḥ ।। 1 9।
akūjanena cenmokṣo nā'vakūjet kathaṃcana ।
avaśyaṃ kūjitavye vā svalpaṃ cānṛtamiśritam ।।2.199.20।।
dharma eva bhavettatra śreyaskaraṃ tadā'nṛtam ।
śapatho'pi pravaktavyo yadi cauraiḥ pramucyate ।।21।
prāṇātyaye vivāhe cānṛtaṃ satyaṃ taducyate ।
arthasya rakṣaṇārthāya parasya prāṇadhāraṇe ।। 22।
anṛtaṃ satyamevā'sti dharmatattvaṃ nigūḍhakam ।
sādhubhyo nā'nṛtaṃ vācyaṃ tārakāste hi dehinām ।। 23 ।।
teṣvanṛtaṃ sadā pāpaṃ satyapūtaṃ tato vadet ।
satyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ vai vrataṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam ।। 24।।
karmaṇā manasā vācā satyaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret ।
satyavratasya duḥkhāni nopayānti kadācana ।।25।।
saṃyatātmā vitṛṣṇaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।
daṃbhācāravihīnaśca viṣayāṇāṃ vinigrahī ।।26।।।
ahiṃsako nātivādī duḥkhadurge taratyapi ।
dātā yācakatāhīno'tithisaṃpūjakastathā ।।27।।
anasūyo'tisevākṛt mātāpitrorguroḥ satām ।
pāpahīno nyāyavṛttirduḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।। 28।।
satyavrato'nyakaṣṭasya nivārakaḥ śuciḥ sthiraḥ ।
kuhakena vihīnaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।।29।।
tāpaso brahmavarcaskaḥ śāntaḥ sattvātivartanaḥ ।
trāsaśūnyo'bhayadaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।। 2.199.30।।
samadṛṣṭiśca sarvatra paraśrīvardhakastathā ।
grāmyārthavinivṛttaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।। 31 ।।
sarvadevanamoyuktaḥ sadā kṛṣṇakathāśravaḥ ।
śraddhadhānaḥ śāntacitto duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।।32।।
amānī mānado mānyo devarṣipitṛpūjakaḥ ।
akrodhaḥ krodhaśamano duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।। 33।।
jitajihvo jitaśiśno jitanārāyaṇo'pi ca ।
jitatṛṣṇo jitavṛttirduḥkhadurgaṃ taratyapi ।।34 ।।
yatrā'haṃ padmaraktākṣaḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ ।
suhṛd bhrātā ca mitraṃ ca sambandhī ca sukhapradaḥ ।।35।।
kāmbhareyo bālakṛṣṇo gopālabālako'cyutaḥ ।
sthito'smi hitakṛd yatra bhaktasya hṛdi sannidhau ।।36।।
brahmapriyāpriyaḥ kāntaḥ śrīpatiryatra cāsmi tam ।
māṃ hariryaścāśrayati duḥkhadurgaṃ taratyasau ।। 37।।
satyo'haṃ satyadharmo'haṃ duḥkhānāṃ nāśako'pyaham ।
māṃ viditvā''śrayantaśca duḥkhadurgaṃ tarantyapi ।। 38।।
tasmād bhajata māṃ nityaṃ māmevāpsyatha dhāmni me ।
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ bhagavān śaraṇārthine ।। 39।।
rājñe cāpi prajābhyaśca tato rājā'rcayaddharim ।
rājñī kanyāyutā kṛṣṇaṃ rādhe prāpūjayattadā ।।2.199.40 ।।
kanyaikā kṛṣṇakāntaṃ taṃ kare jagrāha bhāvataḥ ।
vivāhavidhinā prāpya kṛtakṛtyā babhūva ha ।। 41 ।।
sabhāṃ visarjayitvaiva sa rājā mahīmānakān ।
bhojayāmāsa vividhānnāni rasya phalāni ca ।। 42।।
utsavaṃ subhagaṃ cakre rājā bhādrasya cārjune ।
tṛtīyāyā niśāyāṃ ca viśaśramustataḥ param ।।41 ।।
sarve prātaḥ kṛtasnānāścakruḥ pāyasabhojanam ।
tāvad gāṃgeyaputryaścāyayustvarthayituṃ hareḥ ।।44।।
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya kanyāstā varadānakam ।
vavrire bālakṛṣṇādvai tīrthīkartuṃ saridvarāḥ ।।45।।
snāhi nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇavallabhaśrīpate jale ।
sarvā vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmastīrthātmikāstavāplavāt ।।46।।
haristathāstviti prāha dhṛtvā rūpāṇyanekaśaḥ ।
kṛpayā prayayau śīghraṃ snātuṃ nadīṣu vai tathā ।।47।।
sarassu ca samudreṣu yayāvanekarūpadhṛk ।
tathaikarūpataḥ kṛṣṇo rājate rājasannidhau ।।48।।
kolakākhyo mahārājo divyadṛṣṭyā pradattayā ।
sarvaṃ paśyati tatraiva muramāṣāsthito'pi san ।।49।।
hariḥ sasnau nīparāyāṃ nistārāyāṃ tathā tadā ।
pṛthāyāṃ dinapāyāṃ sevikāyāṃ snānamācarat ।।2.199.50।।
trivarāyāṃ rāhuṇāyāṃ senāyāṃ snānamācarat ।
indirāyāṃ gavādakavitāyāṃ snānamācarat ।।51 ।।
gavādayānānadyāṃ trigirāyāṃ snānamācarat ।
dūrānadyāṃ gurūṇāyāṃ mitrāyāṃ snānamācarat ।।52।।
senāyāṃ lavavārāyāṃ dvilīnāyāṃ tathā'plavam ।
sukautukyāṃ sthāyinadyāṃ cālpāpāyāṃ tathā'karot ।।53।।
audaryāṃ viṣṇutulyāyāṃ prapīṭhāyāṃ samāplavam ।
niyamānājale dūnānadyāṃ ca pāyupaśyake ।।54।।
sarasyapi leṇḍuge yonige snānaṃ samācarat ।
trinayāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ paṃcorāyāṃ samāplavam ।।।55।।।
kāmāyāṃ cāpi volgāyāṃ donāyāṃ snānamācarat ।
ājavābdhau śvetavārdhau kṛṣṇābdhau kāśyapeyake ।।56।।।
bālatrike'bdhau bhagavān sasnau vai yugapattadā ।
catvāriṃśadrūpadhartā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ।।57।।
vidhāya tīrtharūpāstāḥ kanyakāśca sarāṃsi ca ।
upakanyāśca vai tatrādyātmikāḥ saṃvidhāya ca ।।58।।
śīghraṃ tiro'bhavat kṛṣṇaḥ kolakālayamāyayau ।
kolakastu tadā kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ saṃbubodha ha ।।59।।
avatārāvatāryeva paramātmā parātparaḥ ।
so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣājjāmātā me'bhavat prabhuḥ ।। 2.199.60।।
kṛtakṛtyo'hamevā'smi vasā'tra bhagavan sadā ।
mamā''vāse tava yogye kṛpāṃ kuru janārdana ।। 61।।
ityevaṃ cārthayattāvanmadhyāhnaḥ samajāyata ।
yavakrītādayaḥ sarve gāṃgeyāśca maharṣayaḥ ।।62।।
āyayurdarśanārthaṃ vai hariṇā saṃsmṛtāstadā ।
niṣeduste praṇamyaiva bālakṛṣṇasya sannidhau ।।63।।
lomaśādyāstathā vṛkāyanāśca nīlakarṇakaḥ ।
īśāno'nye gaṇāścāpi pārṣadāḥ saṃsmṛtāstadā ।।64।।
āyayuḥ sannidhau sarve kolarājasya mandire ।
hariḥ prāha kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ ketumālasya sarvataḥ ।।65।।
deśāḥ sampāvitāḥ sarve rājāno bhaktimāśritāḥ ।
prajā bhaktāḥ prajātāśca tīrthānyapi kṛtāni ca ।।66।।
ṛṣayaścāpi santuṣṭā jātā dānādibhistathā ।
brahmapriyāstathā gauryaḥ sukhamayyo mayā kṛtāḥ ।।67।।
parvatāḥ pāvitāścātra sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ tato'bhavat ।
adhunā tatra gantavyaṃ yatrarṣimaṇḍalaṃ vadet ।।68।।
bhavanto me pramāṇaṃ vai sādhavaśca maharṣayaḥ ।
ityuktvā bālakṛṣṇaśca ṛṣivākyaṃ pratīkṣate ।।69।।
tāvad vyomnaḥ sakāśādvai puṣpavṛṣṭirvavarṣa vai ।
jayaśabdaiḥ saha sādhuḥ saccidānandasaṃjñakaḥ ।।2.199.70 ।।
lālāyano maharṣiryaḥ pūrvaṃ cottarato hyagāt ।
poṣapūrṇātithau paścāt tuṣito'pi suro hyagāt ।।71 ।।
tāvubhau suvimānasthau tvāgatau kolakālaye ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ bhajamānau jayaśabdān pracakratuḥ ।।72।।
tīrthīkurvan ketumālaṃ jayatvakṣaradhāmapaḥ ।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇasvāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabha ।।73।।
kāmbhareya brahmaśaktisvāmingopālanandana ।
vardhayā'tra ciraṃ tiṣṭha deśān saṃkuru pāvanān ।।74।।
ityevaṃ vyāharantau tau vimānaṃ bhāskaropamam ।
avatārayatāṃ rājālayodyāne śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।।75।।
nirgatau tau vimānācca munī sāttvatapuṃgavau ।
puṣpamālānvitau bhaktibharau kṛṣṇe'timānasau ।।76।।
nematuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ samāgatya samīpataḥ ।
daṇḍavat puṣpahārādyairānarcatuḥ pareśvaram ।।77।।
sāśrunetrau galatkarṇau jātapulakitāṅgakau ।
haryājñayā''sanayośca niṣedatuḥ samīpataḥ ।।78।।
harirutthāya caraṇau dadau vakṣasi vai tayoḥ ।
nyadhāddhastau mastake ca bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje ।।79।।
papraccha kuśalaṃ tābhyāṃ bhaktikāryaprasāraṇam ।
ūcatustau kṛpayā te yogakṣemau pravartataḥ ।।2.199.80।।
kenāṭāścāmarīdeśā bhavataḥ kṛpayā prabho ।
mumukṣuvāsitāḥ santi pratīkṣante tavāgamam ।।8 1 ।
āgatya tatra kartavyo viṣṇukraturhi pāvanaḥ ।
tāḥ prajāḥ pāvayitavyā amarīkapradeśajāḥ ।।।82।
rājānaśca prajāścāpi maharṣayaśca tadgatāḥ ।
āgamaṃ te pratīkṣante kṛtārthīkuru tatprajāḥ ।।83।
ityarthito hariḥ śrīmallomaśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tathā ।
maharṣīn paripapraccha kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadantu mām ।।84।
sarve prāhuryathā lālāyanaḥ prārthayate prabho ।
tathā kartavyamevā'tra tārako hi bhavān yataḥ ।।85।।
yavakrīto nīlakarṇo vṛkāyanaśca lomaśaḥ ।
gāṃgeyāśca vayaṃ sarve śaṃkarādyā yathādiśaḥ ।।86 ।।
tathā kurmo na sandeho lokatāraṇahetave ।
evaṃ pratyuttare prāpte bhagavān naranāṭyadhṛk ।।87।।
tathāstviti prāha lālāyanaṃ tuṣitadaivatam ।
hāritarṣirnāmataśca prāha tatra tadā harim ।।88।।
gacchāmyahaṃ hare pūrvaṃ mama śiṣyapradeśakān ।
garimākhyān hāritāँśca mādhyasthān kuru pāvanān ।।89।।
ityuktvā''jñāṃ śiro dhṛtvā yayau vimānataḥ puraḥ ।
garimākhyapradeśāँśca svāgatārthamasañjayat ।।2.199.90।।
aparānāvikāpuryā dinamānārkabhūpatiḥ ।
hāritarṣipraśiṣyaśca svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ śubhaiḥ ।।9 1 ।
maṃgalairvividhaiḥ kalpaiḥ śṛṃgāraṃ samasajjayat ।
athātra kolako rājā parameśaṃ munīn satīḥ ।।92।।
mahīmānān paramānnaistṛptayāmāsa bhojanaiḥ ।
pūjayāmāsa bahudhā samarpaṇaiśca sarvathā ।।93।।
arthayāmāsa rātryaikyaṃ sthātuṃ nijālaye prabhum ।
haristathā'stviti prāha rājā rātrau mahotsavam ।।94।।
kārayāmāsa subhagaṃ nṛtyamallapradarśanaiḥ ।
niśānidrottaraṃ prātarhariḥ kṛtāhniko drutam ।।95।।
gantuṃ sajjo'bhavattūrṇaṃ rājā mānā'rhaṇāṃ vyadhāt ।
sainyena mānitaścāpi prajābhirmānitaśca saḥ ।।96।
vimānaṃ cārurohā'nye cāruruhurnijānyapi ।
yaśaḥkīrtyādi śṛṇvan śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।97।
gāṃgaiyairnaijikaiścāpi vyomamārgeṇa sattvaram ।
samudraṃ tu samullaṃghya garimāpṛthivīṃ yayau ।।98।
hāritāँstānpradeśāँśca vyalokayattadāmbarāt ।
svāgatārthaṃ hāritarṣidinamānārkabhūpatī ।।99।
yatrāstāṃ tāvaparānāvikāpuryāṃ puraḥsthitau ।
tau vilokya dhvajacihnairambare sthairyamāptavān ।। 2.199.10 0।।
sainyakṛtaṃ svāgataṃ saṃvilokya bhagavān hariḥ ।
rādhike bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa mumude tvantarīkṣagaḥ ।। 10 1।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kolakanṛpasya muramāṣānagaryāṃ śrīharestṛtīyāyāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ gāṃgeyakanyādikṛtaprārthanayā tajjaleṣu bahurūpāṇi dhṛtvā yugapat snānena tīrthī-
karaṇatā rātrau viśrāntirbhādraśuklacaturthyāṃ dinamānārkanṛpakhaṇḍaṃ prati gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 199 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 200
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 201 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhe hāritadeśeṣu bahvaraṇyā'tiśītiṣu ।
svalpaprajāśriteṣveṣaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
aparānāvikāpuryāṃ samudrasannidhau nijam ।
vimānamambarāttūrṇaṃ dinamānārkabhūbhṛtā ।। 2 ।।
pradarśitena mārgeṇa garimāpṛthivītale ।
hāritarṣiṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā samavātārayacchanaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustadā'mbarāt ।
rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
samācarattathā rājñī hāritaśca prajājanaḥ ।
rājā śrutaṃ hariṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ vimānagam ।। 5 ।।
antikaṃ cābhigatvaiva dadarśā''ścaryamāptavān ।
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ śrīkāntaṃ ramaṇīyasuvigraham ।। 6 ।।
prathamaṃ divyamālokya kṣaṇaṃ tu sthiratāṃ gataḥ ।
vimāne śrīharermūrtau līnaḥ samādhimāniva ।। '7 ।।
jāta eva tathā rājñī kumārāśca kumārikāḥ ।
sarve dṛṣṭvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ samādhiṃ cābhipedire ।। 8 ।।
koṭividyutsamaṃ tejo dadṛśuḥ sarvatomukham ।
tatreśvarān virāḍādyān dadṛśuśca tataḥ parān ।। 9 ।।
bhūmādyānatha tatpaścād dhāma golokamuttamam ।
lokayāmāsurutkṛṣṭaṃ koṭigopagaṇāśritam ।। 2.200.1 0।।
tatra kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya punareva te ।
akṣarākhye pare dhāmni sthitaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 11 ।।
vyalokayanmuktamadhye brahmapriyāsamanvitam ।
sarveśvareśvaraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ muktādisevitam ।। 1 2।।
tataḥ samādhirnaṣṭaśca vyutthitāste vimānake ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ nije rāṣṭre dadṛśuste'tibhāvukāḥ ।। 1 3।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāptā rājā rājakuṭumbinaḥ ।
hāracandanagandhādyairapūjayan vimānake ।
tāvaddharirbahiryāto vimānād bhāsvarāmbaraḥ ।। 14।।
sarvalāvaṇyasaundaryaujjvalyahāsyamanoharaḥ ।
prajā gauryaśca hārityo vardhayāmāsuracyutam ।। 15।।
lājākṣatādibhiḥ puṣpairgītaiśca namanādibhiḥ ।
prajājanāḥ praṇemuśca śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ।। 16।।
rājā hariṃ kareṇaiva karamādāya kānake ।
yantrabāhye rathe nyaṣādayat sragādiśobhite ।। 17।।
kuṭumbaṃ ca nṛpasyā'pi rathe'tra niṣasāda ha ।
rājā chatraṃ dadhārāpi rājñī dadhre ca vāyudam ।। 18।।
kumāryaścāmare dadhruḥ kumārā vetramāvahan ।
ratheṣvanyeṣu pitarau hareḥ kuṭumbameva ca ।। 19।।
niṣādyā'nyarathe śaṃbhuṃ pareṣu munimaṇḍalam ।
guptigantrīṣu ca kṛṣṇakāntā nyaṣādayannṛpaḥ ।।2.200.20।।
mahatā svāgatenaivaṃ vādyadhvanipuraḥsaram ।
tūpaśabdairnāditā ca purīṃ prāveśayat prabhum ।।21 ।।
mahotsāhaḥ prajāyāṃ vai tadā'bhūnnūtanekṣaṇāt ।
hṛndi hariḥ prajānāṃ saṃpracakarṣa muhurmuhuḥ ।।22।।
yatrā'ṅge yasya cakṣurvai tadā lagnaṃ tvabhūddhareḥ ।
tatrā''saktaṃ dhruvaṃ cā'bhūnnirnimeṣaṃ sthiraṃ sukhāt ।।23।।
kecidasyamukhapaṃkajamīkṣyā''purhisādhanamapāsya samādhim ।
tatra cātihṛdayaṃgamamīśaṃ vīkṣya śāntimatigāṃ samavāpuḥ ।।24।।
kāścidasya madanāśritanetraṃ tvāyatāntamatikṛṣṭibharaṃ ca ।
vīkṣya mohitadhiyaḥ sthiratāṃ vai prāpya cakruramṛtottamapānam ।।25।।
yāstadoṣṭhamururaktakabimvābhaṃ vilokya samakarṣitacittāḥ ।
yoṣitaḥ samabhavansamalabdhau tāḥ satṛṣṇahṛdayā abhavaँśca ।।26।।
kāścidasya purusundaragātrelubdhavṛttaya itīśvarabodhāḥ ।
arpaṇaṃ ca paricakruramuṣmai mānasaṃ tanugataṃ ca samastam ।। 27।।
saṃvilokya purubhaktisevikāḥ kāścideṣa parameśvarottamaḥ ।
no nayatviti parākṣaraṃ nijaṃ hāritāḥ samavakalpayaँstadā ।।28।।
rādhikākamalagāramāsatīmāṇikīprabhṛtayo divāniśam ।
yaṃ bhajanti bahudhā tu padmajābrāhmaśaktaya imā hi gaurikāḥ ।।29।।।
taṃ bhajāma idamādhisaṃyutaṃ saṃvihāya tu calaṃ kalevaram ।
śāśvataṃ bhavati cātra vai sukhaṃ nvālayo'sya kuruta prapūjanam ।।2.200.3 0 ।।
atra śītabhavane samudrage'nugraheṇa bhagavān samāgataḥ ।
karmaṇā ca manasā ca kīrtanaiḥ sevayā kuruta naijamīśvaram ।।3 1 ।।
kīdṛśo nu paridhiḥ samantataścānanasya bhavatīha taijasaḥ ।
koṭicandraparikāntisaṃsravadvigraho'syahṛdayaṃgamo'sti yat।।32।।
naikamuktajanasevitapādaḥ koṭidāsaparimarditagātraḥ ।
prāpyate nu bahupuṇyadhanāḍhyairnā'yamāpta iti vismaraṇīyaḥ ।।33।।
mānavāśca janatā ita ādye nedṛśaṃ hṛdi ca kāmitavantaḥ ।
tādṛśo'yamiha cāpta umeśastaṃ śrayanvatisukhaṃ parameśam ।।34।।
mā tyajantu militaṃ sulabhaṃ ca kāntakāntamurusadguṇabhājam ।
vardhayantu hadayaiḥ kusumaiśca pūjayantu nijasarvasudānaiḥ ।।35।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! svāmibālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokya tāḥ ।
hāritāḥ pramadāḥ sarvā ūcuḥ papuḥ prabhuṃ sukhaiḥ ।।36।।
rājā gopurake ghaṇṭāpathe prādhānikāstathā ।
haṭṭeṣu haṭṭapāścāpi rathyāmukheṣu yoṣitaḥ ।।37।।
vallabhīṣu kanyakāśca janatāḥ pārśvabhūstaṭe ।
catvareṣu prajāḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।38।।
lājābhiḥ satphalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kuṃkumairakṣatairapi ।
vastraiścandanapaṃkādyairgandhairānarcuracyutam ।।39।।
sāmudraratnahārāँśca dadau te parameṣṭhine ।
aparānāvikāpuryāṃ bhrāmayitvā prajājanāḥ ।।2.200.40।।
pūjayitvā gṛhe nītvā sve sve kṛtārthatāmaguḥ ।
haristato nijāvāse dinamānārkamandire ।।41।।
āyayau hāritarṣiśca natvā''ha parameśvaram ।
bhojanāni sumṛṣṭāni vidyante bhuṃkṣva tāni vai ।।42।।
bhojayā'nyān harekṛṣṇa pāyasādīn pratarpaya ।
tato vimānamāruhya garimākṣmāṃ vilokitum ।।43 ।।
gantavyaṃ dṛṣṭimātreṇa pāvayituṃ samantataḥ ।
ityukto bhagavān śīghraṃ jagrāsa pāyasādikam ।।44।।
mahīmānān samastāँśca bhojayāmāsa vai drutam ।
sarvān rājālaye tyaktvā śaṃkareṇa nṛpeṇa ca ।।45।।
ṛṣiṇā ca samaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parimeyapuraḥsaraḥ ।
vimānaṃ svaṃ samāruhyāmbare jagāma cottare ।।46।।
vāśṛṃgatanubhūbhāgaṃ vilokyāpi parīsthalam ।
phudriktaṃ vilayaṃ deśaṃ kāñcanaṃ cārṣukaṃ sthalam ।।47।।
hāyanaṃ ca sthalaṃ vīkṣya hyaparānāvikāṃ yayau ।
evaṃ vilokya bhagavānavātatāra cāmbarāt ।।48।।
rājasaudhe viśaśrāma rājñī pūjārthamāyayau ।
pūjayitvā hariṃ tasyāḥ kanyādvayaṃ hariṃ tadā ।।49।।
apūjayat sukhāsakte kanyake sthiranetrike ।
hariṃ dṛṣṭvā cakamāte vavrāte'rpitamālayā ।।2.200.50 ।।
pāṇī jagrāha bhagavān pratyarpitasumālayā ।
tadutsavaṃ nṛpaścakre rātrau bhojanataḥ param ।।51 ।।
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa dūrvālaḍḍūkakuṃkumaiḥ ।
nṛtyaṃ tvakārayad rājā vādyānyavādayattathā ।।52।।
sindūraiścārcayāmāsa gaṇeśavigrahe śubhe ।
agāpayacca padyāni kīrtanāni tadutsave ।।53।।।
hārite kanyake kṛṣṇaṃ siṣevāte savottaram ।
niśā gatā prabhāte'tha kṛtasnānasupūjanaḥ ।।54।।।
bālakṛṣṇo'bhavat sajjo dugdhapānottaraṃ tadā ।
gantuṃ kenāṭakadeśānamarīṇāṃ pradeśakān ।।55।।
pañcamyāṃ saṃgave kāle bhādre śukle'tiśobhane ।
rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau bahuratnādikaṃ tadā ।।56।।
harirhāritamunaye'rpayāmāsa dhanādi tat ।
rājā sainyena sahito mānaṃ tatra dadau bahu ।।57।।
jayaśabdā yaśaḥśabdā gītayaścābhavaँstadā ।
gaurībhirhāritābhiśca kṛtā mādhuryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।58।।
harirhāraṃ dadau rājñe rājñyai putrebhya ityapi ।
prajānatiṃ samāgṛhya samāruroha śobhanam ।।59।।
āsanaṃ cānyavargāścāruruhuścāsanāni hi ।
upādideśa rājānaṃ prajājanāśca saddhitam ।।2.200.60।।
uṣṭraḥ purā tapaścakre prajāpatiḥ samāyayau ।
varadānaṃ tadā vavre grīvā'stu yojanā''yatā ।।6 1 ।।
brahmā tathā'stvitiprāhā'raṇye tūṣṭraḥ sadā sthitaḥ ।
mahālaso niṣadyaikasthale cakhāda pādapān ।।62।।
parito yojanāvarte rātrau svapiti saukhyabhāk ।
madhye śṛgālaḥ samprāpto vavalge tadgale dṛḍham ।।63।।
mamāroṣṭro madhyakaṇṭhe bhedanāllambakaṇṭhavān ।
tathā loke lambatṛṣṇo mriyeta māyayā hataḥ ।।64।।
tasmāt tṛṣṇāṃ na kurvīta kurvīta bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।
mamāśrayaṃ prakurvīta tāraye'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।।65।।
siṃhasyā''sītpradhāno vai haṃsaḥ kaścid vanāntare ।
daridro brāhmaṇo nāmnā sattvavṛttiryayau vanam ।।66।।
haṃsastaṃ milito mārge papraccha kutra gamyate ।
sa prāha dhanalābhārthaṃ yāmi deśāntaraṃ nvitaḥ ।।67।।
haṃsaḥ prāha bhavān vipro mama pūjyo'sti cānagha ।
dāsye ratnāni te tvatra siṃhārjitāni hastitaḥ ।।68।।
mārayitvā gajān kuṃbhasthalamauktikajātikān ।
ityuktvā saha nītvainaṃ vipraṃ haṃso hyaraṇyake ।।69।।
yayau yatrāsti siṃhaḥ saḥ siṃhaṃ prāha sa haṃsakaḥ ।
atithirbrāhmaṇaścāyaṃ pūjanīyaḥ samāgataḥ ।।2.200.70।।
hiṃsājanyaṃ mahatpāpaṃ naśyedasmai pradānataḥ ।
ityuktaḥ śārdūlavaryaḥ prakṣālya caraṇau tataḥ ।।71 ।।
viprapādāmṛtaṃ pītvā pupūja ratnadānakaiḥ ।
vipro gṛhaṃ prayātyeva haṃsastadāha taṃ dvijam ।।72।।
āyāhi mā punastvatra mām ṛte duḥkhamudbhavet ।
ityuktvā prayayau haṃsastataḥ kālāntare dvijaḥ ।।73।।
punarlobhena saṃprāptastadvanaṃ saṃsmaran harim ।
haṃso mantrī tadā nā'bhūt kāko mantrī tadā hyabhūt ।।74।।
dvijaṃ pravīkṣya kākastu siṃhaṃ prāha prakhādaya ।
siṃhaḥ prāha na caivaṃ syād vipro'yaṃ pāvanaḥ sadā ।।75।।
pādavāri papau dhūlīṃ mastake sa nyadhāttadā ।
kākaḥ prāha pavitraṃ vai pādavāri tu yasya hi ।।76।।
sa tu pūrṇaḥ pavitro'sti bhakṣitavyaḥ sa sarvaśaḥ ।
tena pūtā vayaṃ syāmaḥ pāpaṃ naśyettathā''ntaram ।।77।।
ityuktaḥ siṃharājastu bhakṣayāmāsa taṃ dvijam ।
tasmāllobhaṃ na kurvīta mṛtyurlobhagṛhe sthitaḥ ।।78।।
lobhaṃ (yaktvā hariṃ smṛtvā santoṣeṇa hi vartayet ।
sukhī sa syādatra loke dhāmni paratra me sukhī ।।79।।
santuṣṭasya paraṃ dhāma niścitaṃ bhaktisañjuṣaḥ ।
ekadā sāgaraḥ prāha saritaḥ kimu śākhinaḥ ।।2.200.80।।
āyāntyeva jalohyā vai nāyānti vaitasāni tu ।
nadyaḥ prāhurdrumāścaite kūlasthā api sarvadā ।।81।।
asmadabhyudaye cāpi na namanti kadācana ।
tān vayaṃ mūlato hṛtvā nayāmaḥ sāgarodare ।।82।।
vaitasīnālikāḥ pūre patitāstu namantyapi ।
vigate pūravege tu śanairyānti samutthitim ।।83।।
na tān vayaṃ nayāmo vai namato nālapatrakān ।
ye namanti janāḥ kāle mahāntaṃ veginaṃ tu te ।।84।।
nāpnuvanti mūlanāśaṃ sthitimanto bhavanti te ।
evaṃ kālaṃ tathā māyāṃ vegakāle namanti ye ।।85।।
śanairutthānamāsādya jīvanti dehinastviha ।
te na duḥkhaṃ prapaśyanti tadvad vṛtyaṃ janairiha ।।86।।
māmāśritya śanairmāyāṃ tyaktvā gantavyameva me ।
dhāma divyaṃ sukhāvāsaṃ susthirāśrayameva ha ।।87।।
deśakālau vicāryaiva vartitavyaṃ sukhārthinā ।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhajanīyaḥ sadā prabhuḥ ।।88।।
tārayāmi na sandeho bhajantaṃ māṃ padāgatam ।
mūrkhaḥ kroḍo'bhavatpṛṣṭhe śṛgālaṃ dhartumeva ha ।।89।।
adhāvad bahuvegena śṛgālo'vasare tadā ।
kūpamutplutya cākrāmat paratīraṃ gato'bhavat ।।2.200.90।।
kroḍaḥ sthūlavapurdhāvan vegataḥ kūpago'bhavat ।
apatajjalamadhye ca mamārā'jñānasaṃhataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
tasmānnaiva kvacidbhāvyaṃ vegena karmaṇā janaiḥ ।
śanaistareddhi saṃsāraṃ madāśrayeṇa mānavaḥ ।। 92।।
śṛgālābhaṃ lobhavegaṃ nāśrayenmānavastviha ।
doṣātmakaṃ mahādhūrtaṃ pātayantaṃ tu gartake ।।93।।
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ lobhaṃ mānaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ।
māmīśaṃ sādhupuruṣaṃ sādhvīṃ śritvā sukhī bhavet ।।94।।
evamuktvā dadau mantraṃ hariḥ rājñe kuṭumbine ।
prajābhyaśca dadau mantraṃ lomaśastu nideśitaḥ ।।95।।
hāritābhyaḥ prajābhyaśca mantraṃ dadau maheśvaraḥ ।
tato jalaṃ prapītvaiva bhagavān cāmbare'bhavat ।।96।।
gajādibhiḥ puṣpahāraiḥ pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
āśīrvādān muhurdatvā nijaṃ vimānamāsthitaḥ ।।97।।
anye sarve'bhavan vyomni vimāneṣu sthitāstadā ।
vādyānyatīva vegenā'vādyanta mānanāya vai ।।98।।
jayaśabdā yaśaḥśabdā yantrāṇāṃ dhvanayastathā ।
abhavaँstatra deśe vai hariḥ śīghraṃ vimānakam ।।99।।
prairayad vyomamārgeṇa kenāṭakabhuvaṃ prati ।
samullaṃghya samudraṃ vai kenāṭakapradeśakān ।। 2.200.10 0।।
āyayuśca vimānāni madhyāhne vegavanti vai ।
deśān jale vikīrṇāṃśca dṛṣṭvā'vicārayaddharim ।। 101 ।।
yajñasthānaṃ prathamaṃ vai gantavyaṃ yatra vartate ।
lālāyano maharṣiśca tato'nyatkāryameva ha ।। 1 02।।
atha lālāyanaścāpi smṛtvā vimānamaṇḍalam ।
tūrṇaṃ svāgatanādāँśca rājasainyairakārayat ।। 103 ।।
hariścāpi dviphenābdhiṃ dviphenadvīpameva ca ।
haḍḍikāsanamullaṃghya vinipārasaro yayau ।। 1 04।।
yatra vādyāni vādyante svāgatārthaṃ harestadā ।
asaṃkhyamānavā yatra pratīkṣante pareśvaram ।। 1 05।।
rādhike harṣanādāścābhavan digantagāminaḥ ।
dūradarśādibhirlokā vyapaśyannambare tadā ।। 106 ।।
tūpaśabdāḥ karkaśāśca vāyukampanakāriṇaḥ ।
tūryasaṃgītaghoṣāścā'bhavan sammānane hareḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dinamānārkanṛpasya garimākhaṇḍe hareraparānāvikāpuryāmavataraṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ samantato deśe vimānena gamanaṃ rātrau viśrāntyuttaraṃ prātarbhojanaṃ prasthānaṃ kenāṭakapradeśeṣu vinipārasarovaraṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 200 ।।

śrīrādhikovāca-
kānta kānta kṛpāsindho rādhāpate ramāpate ।
amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kiṃ kiṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kva kva kutra yayau tasthau kaiḥ kaiḥ saṃsevito hareḥ ।
camatkārāśca ke tatra darśitāḥ paramātmanā ।। 2 ।।
prajābhiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ tatra prāpte pareśvare prabhau ।
kāँskān deśān jagāmā'yaṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vadā'marīpradeśānāṃ bhagavaccaritāni me ।
yāni yānyabhavaँstatra brahmapriyāniṣevituḥ ।। 4 ।।
bahutṛptā bhavāmyasya bhūtvā nāthasya satkathāḥ ।
punastṛṣā bhavatyeva śrotuṃ taccaritāni me ।। 5 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike yāvaccaritrāṇi vadāmi te ।
yajñaḥ pūjā svāgatādi samarpaṇaṃ nideśanam ।। 6 ।।
bhramaṇaṃ mantradānaṃ ca divyadarśanakāni ca ।
mokṣaṇaṃ dehināṃ tīrthīkaraṇaṃ saritāṃ tathā ।। 7 ।।
sarasāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca pāvanīkaraṇaṃ śubham ।
kathayāmi samāsena camatkāramayāni te ।। 8 ।।
yajñaṃ cakāra bhagavān vinipārasarastaṭe ।
śeṣakāṣṭhavanāsaṃge viśāle bhūtale śubhe ।। 9 ।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tṛptidaṃ prāṇināmiha ।
sṛṣṭitrayasthadehyādyā jaḍāśca cetanāstathā ।। 2.201.1 0।।
bālakṛṣṇasya hastābhyāṃ tṛptiṃ te śāśvatīṃ yayuḥ ।
kenāṭakapradeśānāṃ khaṇḍānāṃ sārvabhaumakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
rājā paṃcasarasāṃ vai rāyakinnaranāmakaḥ ।
divimānāyanarṣiśca sāhāyyaṃ cakratuḥ kratau ।। 1 2।।
vaiṣṇavau paramau tau dvau lālāyanasya saṃgamāt ।
tuṣitasya pratāpena bhaktottamau babhūvatuḥ ।। 13 ।।
lālāyanasya śiṣyo vai rājā ṛṣernideśataḥ ।
maṃgalapatrikāḥ sampreṣayāmāsa makhārthinīḥ ।। 14।।
lālāyanasya yogena cāmarīṇāṃ pradeśakāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavībhiḥ prajābhiśca vāsitāḥ santi dharmiṇaḥ ।। 15।।
khaṇḍe khaṇḍe ca rājāno bhavantaśca prajājanāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ copagatā ahobhāgyāni tāni naḥ ।। 16।।
yo vai nārāyaṇānāṃ śrīnārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
yadbhaktāśca vayaṃ smo'tra sa śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 17।।
mama rājye samāgatya yajñaṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ śubham ।
kariṣyatīti sarvairāgantavyaṃ tanmakhotsave ।। 18।।
bhādraśuklasya saptamyāṃ kratvāraṃbho bhaviṣyati ।
pañcamyāṃ paramātmā sa vimānādāgamiṣyati ।। 1 9।।
khaṇḍagaiḥ rājabhiścātra saṃhitavyaṃ purā dine ।
svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ sarvaiḥ prajājanaiśca sāttvataiḥ ।। 2.201.20 ।।
sainyaśobhāsusahitaiḥ kartavyaṃ harimānanam ।
ekādaśyāṃ samāptiśca kratorasya bhaviṣyati ।।21 ।।
lālāyanā''jñayā rāyakinnaro'haṃ likhāmi ca ।
uktairanuktaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ strīnarairiha ।।22।।
ityevaṃ cāmarīṇāṃ vai pradeśeṣu supatrikāḥ ।
preṣayāmāsa dūtaiḥ sa rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ ।।23।।
prāpyā''mantraṇapatrāṇi tvāyayustvaritaṃ janāḥ ।
utsukā naranāryādyā darśanārthaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 24।।
vimānairvāhanairyānairājagmuścopadāyutāḥ ।
svarṇarūpyakadhānyādyai ratnahīrakasadrasaiḥ ।।25।।
yajñīyavastubhiryogyairdeyaiḥ saha samāyayuḥ ।
koṭiśo mānavāḥ śeṣakāṣṭhāvanānadītaṭe ।।26।।।
vinipārasaroyoge rājāno'pi tadā'bhavan ।
sainyāni bahuraṃgāni samāyātāni bhūbhṛtām ।। 27।।
svāgatārthaṃ hareścāsannupasthitāḥ suveṣiṇaḥ ।
vādyayuktā dhvajāpatākikāvāvaṭaśobhitāḥ ।। 28।।
hetihastā gajavāhā aśvavāhoṣṭravāhinaḥ ।
daśayojanavistāre klṛptanūtanapattane ।। 29।।
sammardo'bhūttadā śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadītaṭe ।
sarastīre'nuśayināṃ koṭyabjanarayoṣitām ।।2.201.3 0।।
svargavadbhrājate yajñapattanaṃ nūtanaṃ tadā ।
pattanaṃ taddharikṛṣṇo'lokayattvambarānmuhuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
maṇḍapārthaṃ samālokya bhūmiṃ sarasorāntare ।
divimānāyanarṣyuktadiśāṃ vīkṣya samasthalīm ।।32।।
cakraṃ vidhāya sarvordhve'vātārayadvimānakam ।
vāditraninadāścāsannamarīṇāṃ ca gītikāḥ ।।3 3। ।
jayadhvānāḥ prajānāṃ ca tadā''san vyomayoginaḥ ।
tūpaśabdā yantraravā mānane tvabhavan hareḥ ।।।34।।
śreṣṭhā daśa nṛpastatra sārvabhaumā hyupasthitāḥ ।
gṛhītvā copadāḥ svarṇapātreṣu sapradhānakāḥ । ।35।।
rāyakinnaranṛpatiḥ rāyarokīśvaro nṛpaḥ ।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca rāyavākakṣako nṛpaḥ ।।36। ।
rāyamārīśabhūpaśca rāyabāleśvaro nṛpaḥ ।
rāyalambārabhūpaśca rāyanavārkabhūpatiḥ ।। 37।।
rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca rāyakūpeśabhūpatiḥ ।
ete sainyaiḥ suyuktāśca svāgatārthaṃ harestadā ।।38।।
vimānaistatra cāgatya prāgeva samupasthitāḥ ।
hastyaśvarathavāhādyaiḥ śṛṃgāritasuvigrahaiḥ ।
sainyaṃ svāgatakāryārthaṃ tadā'bhūttu vyavasthitam ।।39।।
vādakā nītikartāraścāgnirañjanaveṣiṇaḥ ।
jalavādyavidhartāro nṛtyavādyapraśabdinaḥ ।।2.201.40 ।।
galavādyaprabhāvajñā mayūravaṃśivādyakāḥ ।
tāravādyātikuśalāḥ paṭahadhvānakāriṇaḥ ।।41 ।।
sahaśārīraceṣṭākāḥ saśastrā namanārthinaḥ ।
vetradharā gaṇaveṣā vyāghraveṣāśca bhāllukāḥ ।।42।।
piṃgaveṣāḥ parīveṣā avadhūtasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
śūlacakradharāścāpi carmakhaḍgadharāstathā ।।73 ।।
tāṃsakaiḥ karatālaiśca vigulairlakṣitā api ।
śaṃkhino vajriṇaścāpi sukanyāveṣiṇastathā ।।44।।
jaṭāveṣadharāścāpi yoddhṛveṣātiśobhanāḥ ।
arjunāmbarayuktāśca raktāmbarāḥ pracitriṇaḥ ।।45।।
suchatrairvyajanaiścāpi cāmarairgucchakaistathā ।
vardhayitvā darpaṇaiśca svāgatārthaṃ hyupasthitāḥ ।।46।।
amaryo yoṣitastatra pāṇḍurābhāḥ suyauvanāḥ ।
kanyakā raktakādharāḥ pūravegātisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।47।।
nīlapītaharidvarṇaveṣāḥ svarṇavibhūṣaṇāḥ ।
kiṃkiṇījālamālādyairambarairatiśobhitāḥ ।।48।।
dhṛtasthālā harerarcanārthaṃ lājākṣatānvitāḥ ।
kalhārapadmakumudaiḥ kādambapārijātakaiḥ ।।49।।
kundasāhasrapatraiśca sthalapadmaiḥ sukesaraiḥ ।
cāmpakaiḥ kāmalairhāraiḥ śekharaiḥ sragbhiranvitāḥ ।।2.201.50।।
kuṃkumavāṭikāyuktāḥ pūjārhacandanānvitāḥ ।
amaryastatra cāyātā lakṣaśo divyayoṣitaḥ ।।51।।
sahasraśo rājayoṣā asaṃkhyātāḥ prajāstriyaḥ ।
kenāṭakāḥ sarvadeśā maṃgalāmantraṇaistadā ।।5 2 ।।
samrājo mandire rāyakinnarasya makhottame ।
āyāsyato bālakṛṣṇaharerdarśanalabdhaye ।।53 ।।
ābālavṛddhā manujāḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
āyayuste svāgatārtha hareḥ samupatasthire ।।54।।
śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyā vinipārasarovare ।
saṃgamasyā'tidīrgha bhūtale samupatasthire ।।55।।
āgantukānāṃ vāsārhaṃ nagaraṃ bahuyojanam ।
makhasevābhidhaṃ vyadyotata svargamivā'param ।।56।।
maṇisevānagaryāḥ sannidhau pūrvaṃ sarovarāt ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।57।।
vimānaṃ sūryasadṛśaṃ cāvātārayadambarāt ।
dyotayattu diśaḥ sarvāḥ svarṇavarṇamaśobhata ।।।58।।
bhūmau sthairya samavāpya candratulyaṃ vyadṛśyata ।
anyānyapi vimānāni cāvaterustato'mbarāt ।।59।।
ākṛtigrāhakayantraiḥ kuśalā jagṛhuḥ kṛtim ।
rājānastaṃ tvekasūtre tiṣṭhantaścakrurānatim ।।2.201.6 0।।
sainyāni nemire dehairvādyairnṛtyakalādibhiḥ ।
samrājā sahitāḥ sarve nṛpāstannikaṭaṃ yayuḥ ।।6 1 ।।
īśāno lomaśaścobhau vimānāgraṃ prajagmatuḥ ।
vṛkāyano nīlakarṇaścobhau paścāt samāgatau ।।62।।
dvārapālāḥ pārṣadāścāṃ'gaṇe tasthuḥ savetrakāḥ ।
niḥśreṇī samadhiprāpya rājānastasthurīkṣakāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
tāvaddharirbālakṛṣṇaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ sahito bahiḥ ।
vimāne tvāyayau cāgre subhāsvare tu gopure ।।64।।
koṭikoṭyarkacandrāgnividyudbhāsvaravigrahaḥ ।
toraṇā'dhaḥsthitaṃ cañcadvidyudābhāṃ tu vallabhīm ।।65 ।।
kareṇa ca manāk spṛṣṭvā mandahāsyaṃ manoharam ।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ ।।6 6 ।।
praṇamya gandhavipulāṃ mālatīpuṣpamālikām ।
citraraṃgāṃ dadau kaṇṭhe ratnahāraṃ dadau tataḥ ।।67।।
gucchaṃ pauṣpaṃ dadau haste candanārka tu bhālake ।
dadau sugandhasārāṇi pātreṇa sandhṛtāmbare ।।68।।
pādayoścākṣatān svarṇamayān mūrdhni sutandulān ।
puṣpāṇi vigrahe rājā cikṣepārhaṇakarmaṇā ।।69।।
jalaṃ dugdhaṃ dadau tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ ca sannidhau ।
kṛtāñjaliḥ prārthayacca makhārthakṣmāṃ vilokitum ।।2.201.70।।
hariḥ śanaiḥ svarṇasopānakairavātatāra ha ।
tato dattāsane saiṃhe kṣaṇaṃ vā niṣasāda ha ।।71।।
rāyarokīśvaraḥ puṣpahārai ratnairapūjayat ।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca maṇyādyaistamapūjayat ।।72।।
rāyavākakṣako rājā svarṇādyaistamapūjayat ।
rāyamārīśabhūpo'pi ratnādyaistamapūjayat ।।73 ।।
rāyabāleśvaro rājā hīrakaistamapūjayat ।
rāyalambārabhūpaśca dhanādyaistamapūjayat ।।74।।
rāyanavārkabhūpaśca māṇikyaistamapūjayat ।
rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca muktābhistamapūjayat ।।75।।
rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca rājataistamapūjayat ।
atha pradhānāḥ sarve'pi pupūjurbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ।।76 ।।
śreṣṭhino'pi prabhumānarcuśca dhanānnasadrasaiḥ ।
havyakavyādibhiścāpi samidbhirbahuvastubhiḥ ।।77।।
pupūjuśca prajāvargāḥ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।
pūjāsvāgatamātaḥ śrīhariḥ papraccha tāँstadā ।।78।।
anāmayaṃ sukuśalaṃ kṣemaṃ yogaṃ sukhādikam ।
rājādyāḥ sampraṇamyaiva prāhuste kṛpayā sukham ।।79 ।।
sarvavidhaṃ vidyate'tra dine'dya tu mahatsukham ।
svarṇasūryodayastvadya jāto naste kṛpā yataḥ ।।2.201.80 ।।
prāpto'dya śāśvato lābho yadbhavaddarśanaṃ tviha ।
siddhāścādya caturvagāścatvāraśca pumarthakāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
rājyabhāraphalaṃ tvadya labdhaṃ labdhavyalābhataḥ ।
śrīḥ sarvā cendrapadavīpradātrī no gṛhe'dya vai ।।82।।
puṇyaṃ tvakṣayamadyaivā''sādita tava darśanāt ।
pāvanā no'dya deśā vai bhavadāgamanāt prabho ।।83 ।।
sampadaḥ sārthakāstvadya bhavatā viniyojitāḥ ।
satkārye saphalāḥ sarvā lakṣmambo'pi vividhā dhruvāḥ ।।84।।
mānavāḥ kṛtakṛtyāśca vaya mādhavadarśanāt ।
narā nāryo bālabālā vṛddhāḥ puṇyatamā nanu ।।89 ।।
paśavo vṛkṣavallyādyā bahupuṇyā dine'dya vai ।
pakṣiṇo jalagāścāpi bhūmigā vanino'pi ca ।।86 ।।
yadatra bhavatāṃ pādau spṛśato bhūtalādikam ।
bhūriyaṃ bahubhāgyā ca dhāmatulyā hi modate ।।87।।
jātā'dya pulakāḍhyā sā gandhadānairviśeṣataḥ ।
kṣā drrumāstṛgastambā dhanyabhāgyā dine'dya vai ।।88 ।।
yadatra bhavatāṃ pādarajaḥpūtā bhavanti te ।
dhanyāḥ pipīlikādyāśca bhavatprasādabhāginaḥ ।।89।।
dhanyā janapadāstvete yatra nārāyaṇāgamaḥ ।
prākaṭyaṃ mokṣadaṃ tvadya prāvartata harestava ।।2.201.90 ।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ rājyamṛddhiḥ putrāḥ puro gajādayaḥ ।
yānavāhanasamṛddhiḥ sarvaṃ saphalameva yat ।।9 1 ।।
tavāgamena bhagavan kiṃ kiṃ nyūnaṃ bhavennanu ।
sarvaṃ naḥ pūrṇamevā'sti harerlābho hi durlabhaḥ ।। 92।।
yajñaṃ kṛtvā pāvayā'smān kalyāṇaṃ kuru śāśvatam ।
sadā deśe'tra vasatiṃ tavecchāmo'nugāstava ।।93 ।।
ityuktvā tu namaskāraṃ cakre rājā tu kinnaṭaḥ ।
anye nṛpāḥ praṇemuśca tato vai bhagavān svayam ।।94।।
samutthāya kṣitiṃ yogyāṃ draṣṭuṃ cacāra cābhitaḥ ।
śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyāḥ saṃgamād dakṣiṇe sthale ।।95।।
bahuyojanavistāre maṇḍapārhāṃ kṣitiṃ śubhām ।
vīkṣya cājñāpayāmāsa rājānaṃ maṇḍapāya vai ।।96।।
rājadūtā viṣṇudūtāḥ śivadūtāstathā'pare ।
smṛtāstatrā''yayuḥ śīghraṃ viśvakarmā samāyayau ।।97।।
tānājñāpya navakuṇḍān kartuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca maṇḍapam ।
āprātaḥ sarvamevaitad yathā syāt samupasthitam ।।98।।
harirnivāsasaudhaṃ ca yayau madhyāhnake tataḥ ।
bhojanādi cakārā'tha viśaśrāma sasārthakaḥ ।।99।।
sarve te maṇḍapaṃ cakruḥ rātrāveva suśobhanam ।
kuṇḍavedīmahāvedīśobhitaṃ kalaśagṛhaiḥ ।। 2.201.100 ।।
vastugṛhairvahniśālābhiśca yuktaṃ manoharam ।
maṇisevānagaryantaṃ maṇḍapaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ।। 10 1।।
pārṣadā yajñasamidhaścāhartuṃ parito gatāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ sarvagāṃgeyāstathā lomaśaśiṣyakāḥ ।। 102।।
yajñasaṃbhārakān cakrurdevā devyaśca tanmayāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo mahīmānapurīṃ navām ।। 10 3।।
vīkṣituṃ prayayau hastipṛṣṭhāsano nṛpairyutaḥ ।
pākaśālā rasaśālāḥ snānaśālā mahāyatāḥ ।। 1 04।।
svāpaśālāḥ śāntiśālā havyaśālā vyalokayat ।
rājabhiḥ pūritāḥ pātraśālā mahānasāni ca 105।।
vyalokayatsusāmagrīsaṃbhṛtāḥ sarvasaṃvidhāḥ ।
hariḥ sasmāra vai prātardevendraṃ cā'mṛtānvitam ।। 1 06।।
śīghraṃ samāyayau tatra mahendro'mṛtasaṃyutaḥ ।
amṛtasya hradastatra parito'kṣayatṛptikṛt ।। 1 07।।
smṛtāḥ kalpalatāstatra tvāyayuḥ phalasaṃyutāḥ ।
phalānāṃ parvatāstābhiḥ kṛtā yajñārthameva ha ।। 1 08।।
smṛtāḥ puṣpakaṇadāśca vṛkṣasasyadrumādayaḥ ।
kalpavṛkṣāḥ kaṇapuṣpādīnāṃ vai parvatān vyadhuḥ ।। 10 9।।
āgatāḥ kāmadugdhadhrāḥ smṛtā vai nijadhāmataḥ ।
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāḥ payaḥkulyāśca dhenubhiḥ ।। 2.201.11 0।।
saṃbhṛtā havyaśālāsu tvakṣayā dravyapūritāḥ ।
annapūrṇā satī devī śivā lakṣmīstadā smṛtā ।। 111 ।।
āgatāstāḥ parvatāँśca cakruḥ pakvānnakalpitān ।
pṛthvī mūrtā samāgatya miṣṭaṃ śarkaraparvatam ।। 11 2।।
vyadhāddharervacanāt sā jaladevo rasān vyadhāt ।
oṣadhayaḥ samastāśca veṣavārādikān vyūdhuḥ ।। 11 3।।
brahmā svayaṃ smṛtastatra samāyātaścaturmukhaḥ ।
nirmame yogyasaṃvāsāँstathopakaraṇāni ca ।। 1 14।।
kubero dakṣiṇārthaṃ ca svarṇarūpyādikaṃ nyadhāt ।
evamanye rāṣṭrapālā lokapālāḥ prajeśvarāḥ ।। 1 15।।
saṃsmṛtāstvāyayuḥ śīghraṃ pūrtaye havyakavyayoḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ madhyāhnake jāte sarvaṃ sampūrṇamūrjitam ।। 1 16।।
susampannaṃ samabhūcca nyūnaṃ kiñcinna vidyate ।
koṭiśo mānavān rājā kinnaro miṣṭabhojanaiḥ ।। 1 17।।
tarpayāmāsa bahudhā samastāँstānprajājanān ।
hariḥ kuṭumbasahito maharṣimaṇḍalānvitaḥ ।। 1 18।।
nijasārthayutastatra jagrāha bhojanāni vai ।
tato rājā''rthayat kṛṣṇaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatiḥ ।। 1 19।।
rādhike svālaye kṛṣṇaṃ tvāgantuṃ sainyasatkṛtam ।
nagare bhramituṃ cāpi kṛṣṇa omāha tatkṣaṇam ।। 2.201.120 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kenāṭakeṣu kratormaṃgalapatrikāpreṣaṇam । samāgataharerdaśabhūpādikṛtaṃ svāgatam, kuśalapraśnādikam, maṇḍapādinirmāṇājñā, bhojanādikaṃ kratupakaraṇa-
saṃcayādītyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 201 ।।
