adhyāyaḥ 202
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 203 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike rāyakinnāraḥ śīghraṃ sainyamasajjayat ।
hastyaśvarathasaṃśobhadvādyamānavavāhanam ।। 1 ।।
śvetahastī caturdantaḥ parvataśṛṃgakocchrayaḥ ।
sā'mbāliko'ticitrāḍhyaḥ svarṇakūthasuśobhitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
rājā''jñayā harerarthe hastipakena noditaḥ ।
āyayau śīghramevā'gre cāruroha gajaṃ hariḥ ।। 3 ।।
anye gajāstathordhvā vai ṣaṭ tatraivopatasthire ।
pitarau bhrātaraścāpi svasā bhrātṛpriyā hyapi ।। 4 ।।
āruruhurgajān tāँśca lomaśastuṣitastathā ।
lālāyanastathā ceśānaḥ svayaṃ gajamuttamam ।। 5 ।।
āruruhurnarayāneṣvapi brahmapriyāḥ striyaḥ ।
sāvaraṇeṣu yāneṣu raṃginyo navayauvanāḥ ।। 6 ।।
kanyakā gaurikāścāpi piśaṃgyo hāritāstathā ।
ratheṣvapi ca gāṃgeyā maharṣayastathā'pare ।। 7 ।।
niṣeduḥ sukhasampannā bhramituṃ maṇipattanam ।
mahīmāneṣu sarveṣu tūpaviṣṭeṣu tattathā ।। 8 ।।
vāhṛneṣu tato lokajanānāṃ sainyakāni hi ।
agre vādyasuyuktāni dhvajāpatākikādibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
celurgāyanta evā''dyanārāyaṇamahadyaśaḥ ।
tato hastī mahān yātīśānadevasya śobhanaḥ ।। 2.202.10 ।।
kuṭumbināṃ gajāḥ paścāttato maharṣivāraṇāḥ ।
brahmapriyādīnāṃ narayānāni yānti hi ।। 11 ।।
rathāḥ prayānti śobhāḍhyāḥ sauvarṇakalaśānvitāḥ ।
citrapaṭṭāvṛtāścāpi śubhāḥ śvetāśvavāhitāḥ ।। 12।।
tato hastī mahān yāti śrīpatikṛṣṇaśobhitaḥ ।
rājā kinnārako yatra chatraṃ dadhāra pṛṣṭhake ।। 13 ।।
pārśve kumārakau dhṛtvā cāmarau samatiṣṭhataḥ ।
tato rājñāṃ vāhanāni niryayuḥ śobhanāni vai ।। 14।।
amaryaḥ kanyakāḥ paścādgītanārāyaṇābhidhāḥ ।
kṛtakautukaveṣāśca śṛṃgārabhāvamaṃgalāḥ ।। 15 ।।
mauktikāsanakalaśāḥ saphalāḥ śubhapallavāḥ ।
sarvaśobhāmbarabhūṣā yānti gāyantya aiśvaram ।। 16।।
kīrtanaṃ kāṃbhareyasya śrīpateḥ kamalāpateḥ ।
narayāneṣu tanmadhye rādhā lakṣmīḥ prabhā satī ।। 17।।
pārvatī māṇikī haṃsā maṃjulā saguṇā'mbikā ।
santoṣā cā'mṛtā muktirdevī ca lalitā jayā ।। 18।।
etā anyāśca rājante bhūṣitāścāparāḥ striyaḥ ।
prayānti rājamārge'nyā aśvavārāśca rakṣakāḥ ।। 1 9।।
rājājñākṛjjanādiṣṭamahāmārgeṇa saṃcaran ।
śrīhariḥ śobhate'rkadyutistadā janatārcitaḥ ।।2.202.20 ।।
evaṃ sainyaṃ cacālaitan maṇipuryāṃ harestadā ।
prathamaṃ rājaśobhāḍhyaṃ yayau tadrājamandiram ।। 21 ।।
rājyā''sane'tisauvarṇe maṇiratnasamujjvale ।
rājā vāhādavatīrya hariṃ nyaṣādayannaraḥ ।।22।।
jayaśabdāścābhavaँśca puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttathā ।
pradhānādyaiḥ kumārādyai rājñībhiśca kṛtottamā ।।23।।
rājñī mukhyā satī devī pupūja parameśvaram ।
tilakaṃ kukumenā'pi candanenā'kṣataistathā ।।24।।
akarocchrīharerbhāle duḥkhahāñjalimācarat ।
puṣpairvikīrya kṛṣṇasya mastake namanaṃ vyadhāt ।।25।।
pādau prakṣālya dugdhena sthālyāṃ dugdhaṃ samānayat ।
papau prāsādikaṃ śīghraṃ rājakuṭumbameva tat ।।26।।
vāriṇā caraṇau paścātprakṣālya paramātmanaḥ ।
sannidhau hārabhūṣādirdravyaṃ koṭimitaṃ nyadhāt ।।27।।
yajñe'rpitaṃ mayā kṛṣṇa nṛpājñayā tavā'sti tat। ।
ityuktvā pārśvamāgatya sthirekṣaṇā dadarśa tam ।।28।।
rādhike ca tadā rājā nanāma haripādayoḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ maṇiratnādi pradadau pūjane tadā ।।29।।
bālakṛṣṇo dadau tebhyastadā netre sudivyake ।
pararūpagrāhiṇī ca tato naijaṃ tvalaukikam ।।2.202.30 ।।
darśanaṃ pradadau kṛṣṇaḥ sudivyaṃ sumanoharam ।
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ koṭimanmathasundaram ।।3 1 ।।
koṭimuktaiḥ koṭiśaktibhiśca saṃsevitaṃ param ।
anantānantamuktaiśceśvarādyairjuṣṭamuttamam ।।32।।
brahmādyairvanditaṃ divyāmbarabhūṣāvirājitam ।
rādhāramādisaṃjuṣṭaṃ kāntakāntātikāntikam ।।33 ।।
avatāraistathā vyūhairdeveścaraiḥ prasevitam ।
vilokya rājakulino mumuhustatra mādhave ।।34।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vīkṣya kṣaṇaṃ stabdhā ivā'bhavan ।
tato rājā stutiṃ cakre divyabhāvena noditaḥ ।।35।।
mahātejaḥpuñjātmakaparamadhāmastharuciro
mahāmuktaiḥ sevāparicaraṇatuṣṭo vijayate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇo'navadhiguṇadhārī parataro-
'kṣareśaḥ śaktyādyairadhigatapadaḥ saṃvijayate ।।36।।
tvamevā''sse divye'kṣaraparamadhāmni svanilaye
sa evāsse kṛśā dvibhujavararūpo'tisukhakṛt ।
gavāṃ loke gopīgaṇasuracitārghyaḥ svabhavane
sa evāste lakṣmīparicaritavaikuṇṭhabhavane ।। 37।।
tvamevāsse bhūmannamṛtaparipūrteśvarapade
sa evāste vyūhātmakatanumayo'vyākṛtabhuvi ।
virāja tvaṃ cāsse bhavasi ca hiraṇyarbha puruṣa-
strideva tvaṃ viṣṇo bhavasi manujānāṃ hitakaraḥ ।।38।।
surā daityāścānye pitara iha viprāḥ ṛṣigaṇā
nṛpāḥ pātālasthā jaḍacidabhidhaṃ sā tava tanūḥ ।
naro nārādyā ye munaya iha badrīśatanugaṃ
bhajantyevātmajñā yugalatanugaṃ muktilaṣiṇaḥ ।।39।।।
tathā śvete loke dhavalarucidehāstava janāḥ
prasevante lakṣmīkṛtacaraṇasevaṃ phaṇiśayam ।
tvameva tvaṃ candre raviparidhiga tvaṃ hṛdayago-
'nale tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhavasi tamasāṃ lopakṛtimān ।।2.202.40।।
idaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ tava jaḍacitisthaṃ nijadṛśā
prapaśye'haṃ viṣṇo bhavadatikṛpāleśabalataḥ ।
tvamevādau cābhūḥ saparikaratattvādisṛjikṛt
praviṣṭastvaṃ poṣṭā bhavasi parihāre'pi layakṛt ।।41 ।।
tvamevāsse'saṃkhya'vataraṇasumūrtidhragapi yaḥ
paraṃśreyaḥkartā bhavajaladhimagnasya kṛpayā ।
sa evātra prāpto bhavasi bhagavan yajñatanumān
prabhoktā tvaṃ yajñe kuru nijajanānāṃ sukhamayam ।।42।।
mayā dattaṃ dravyaṃ tava bhavati bhogyaṃ nanu purā
samastaṃ rājyādyaṃ tava caraṇayorāhitamidam ।
ahaṃ varte rājye nanu satatamāgantuka iti
mahārāja tvaṃ vai gṛhapatirasi svīyaviṣayaḥ ।।42 ।।
ityabhīṣṭūya rājā sa bālakṛṣṇaṃ tu rādhike ।
maunaṃ jagrāha ca tato bhagavān divyadarśanam ।।44।।
tirobhāvayadatha te dadṛśuḥ svarṇakāsane ।
nemuḥ praṇemuḥ sahasā sāśrunetrāḥ sahṛdgadāḥ ।।45।।
rājñyaḥ sarvāśca caraṇau dhṛtvā tadā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
alihan dve tale premṇā jñātvā śrīparameśvaram ।।46।।
kanyakāstatra ca rājñastvekapañcāśaduttamāḥ ।
āsan darśanakartryastā mumuhuḥ puruṣottame ।।47।।
varamālāṃ karayośca dhṛtvā kaṇṭhe harerernyadhuḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇo nṛpādiṣṭaḥ karān jagrāha vai tadā ।।48।।
prāpya kṛṣṇaṃ kāntamīśaṃ tā āsan kṛtakāryikāḥ ।
rājānaṃ śrīharistatrāśīrvacāṃsi pradāya tu ।।49।।
yajñadravyaṃ dinamānarṣaye'dhīnaṃ vidhāya ha ।
uttasthau tvāsanād rājā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha ।।।2.202.50 ।।
mandire tvālaye rājñaḥ sarvatra bhagavāँstadā ।
vicacāra bahubhaume śatabhūmyādisaṃyute ।।51 ।।
rājodyānaṃ vicacāra pādapūtaṃ vidhāya ca ।
rājamandiramevādau tataḥ pradhānamandiram ।।5 2।।
śreṣṭhiṇāmālayāँścāpi tato nagaravāsinām ।
gṛheṣu caraṇau nyasyā''dāya pūjāṃ kratoḥ kṛte ।।53।।
rājamārge cāpaṇeṣu catvareṣu sthale sthale ।
pūjāṃ prāpya hariḥ sarvaṃ yajñārthaṃ tat samārpayat ।।54।।
evaṃ nagaryāmabhito bahumānapuraḥsaram ।
vicacāra janānāṃ tu manāṃsi sve jahāra ca ।।55।।
rājamārge bhramantaṃ taṃ mahāhastisthitaṃ prabhum ।
vilokya pramadāḥ sarvā amaryaḥ sañjaguryaśaḥ ।।5 6 ।।
dhanyāstā rājakanyā yā vavruḥ śrīpatimīśvaram ।
kṛtapūrvatapaḥpūjāphalamāpuḥ kuto'nyathā ।।57।।
nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ kānto gṛhe milet striyastviha ।
yaṃ rādhā kamalā padmā lakṣmīḥ prabhā ca pārvatī ।।58।।
māṇikyādyāḥ prasevante taṃ prāptā bhāgyagauravāt ।
yaṃ sevante brahmapriyā yaṃ sevante'nyakanyakāḥ ।।59।।
yaṃ sevante gaurikāśca taṃ prāptā bhāgyagauravāt ।
yaṃ sevante hāritāśca devyo'saṃkhyaguṇāśrayam ।।2.202.60।।
prapaśyantu mukhaṃ tvasya candrabimbojjvalaṃ param ।
bhrūkuṭyāṃ vartate bāṇaḥ kāmadevasya saṃsthitaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
dhanurbhruvorvartate'sya dehe'sya rāmaṇīyakam ।
hāsye mahāँścamatkāraḥ samākarṣaṇamohanaḥ ।।62।।
netrakoṇe'sya rucirā camatkāntirvirājate ।
oṣṭhamadhye'tisaundaryaṃ samākarṣaṇakārakam ।।।63 ।।
paśyantu cālayastvasya viśālaṃ samuraḥsthalam ।
kaustubhaśrīsamādhāraṃ sabalaṃ mohakaṃ vapuḥ ।।64।।
alaktātigaśobhāḍhye paśyantu karapattale ।
kadalīstaṃbhaśobhāḍhyau paśyantūrū hareḥ striyaḥ ।।65।।
pūrtistvasyā'titejo'bhivyāptā pāradṛśiśrayā ।
mūrtistvasyā'titejo'bhivyāptā pāradṛśiśrayā ।
nā'yaṃ mānuṣadeho'sti divyo'sti parameśvaraḥ ।।66।।
nāsya mūrtāvavayavā dṛśyante sandhiyojitāḥ ।
sakhyaḥ paśyantu saundaryaṃ bahiścāntaḥ samantataḥ ।।67।।
amalaṃ cāsthināḍyādiklṛptighaṭanāvarjitam ।
ekatattvaṃ vibhātyeṣo'vaśyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।68।।
saccidānandarūpo'sti parātparaḥ pareśvara ।
śruto yaḥ śāstrakathane sa evāyaṃ vitarkyate ।।69।।
asya darśanamātrādvai sukhānantyaṃ samarjyate ।
ānandaghana evā'yaṃ sarvagandharasāśrayaḥ ।।2.202.70 ।।
ātmajyotiḥpradaścāyaṃ haratyantarmano hi naḥ ।
prāptavyaḥ sarvathā cāyaṃ maraṇānte pare'kṣare ।।7 1 ।।
mantraṃ tasya grahīṣyāmo yajñe'vaśyaṃ hi yoṣitaḥ ।
prāpsyāmastaṃ paraṃ kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam ।।72।।।
tejaḥpuñjo'sya tanuto niryāti kīdṛśo'tigaḥ ।
sukho nimeṣahṛtsaumyaḥ śīlaśāntiprado'vyayaḥ ।।73 ।।
evaṃ parasparaṃ rādhe maṇipuryāṃ tu yoṣitaḥ ।
amarījātīyanāryo vadanti smātimohitāḥ ।।74।।
mārge mārge gṛhāgre ca catvare saudhasannidhau ।
lājā'kṣataiḥ sumairvardhayanti sma parameśvaram ।।75।।
jayaśabdān samuccārya rañjayanti satāṃ patim ।
namanti tu gavākṣebhyaḥ paśyantyaḥ kāntamīśvaram ।।76।।
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ deveśvareśvaraṃ guhāśrayam ।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ maṇipūryabhidhāṃ hariḥ ।।77।।
yajñapattanamutkṛṣṭaṃ vīkṣituṃ saṃyayau tataḥ ।
mahīmānā narā nāryo dṛṣṭvā deveśvareśvaram ।।78।।
vardhayāmāsuriṣṭābhirdattābhiścopadādibhiḥ ।
pūjayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cakruḥ svāgatamuttamam ।।79।।
dhanairdravyai rasaiḥ kṣārairveṣavāraiḥ kaṇādibhiḥ ।
gavyairhavyaiḥ śālibhiścā'kṣatādyairārcayan prabhum ।।2.202.80।।
vastraiḥ śubhāsanaiḥ pātraiḥ kambalaiścolakañcukaiḥ ।
varmabhiśca vibhūṣābhirmukuṭādyaiśca kuṇḍalaiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
candanairatimiṣṭānnaiḥ phalaiḥ śuṣkaphalādibhiḥ ।
mukhasaugandhyavāsaiśca ratnahārālibhistathā ।।82।।
dakṣiṇābhirvividhābhiḥ suvarṇakūpyatāmrakaiḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayāmāsureva ha ।।83।।
sainyenotsāhitaḥ kṛṣṇo datvaivaṃ darśanaṃ param ।
āśīrvādairyojayitvā janān prāpya tathopadāḥ ।।84।।
āyayau rājavargādyaiḥ sahitau nijasaṃśrayam ।
rājasaudhaṃ rumāvāsayogyaṃ svargasamaṃ hariḥ ।।85।।
dadau sarvaṃ cāgataṃ vai dhanaṃ dhānyādikaṃ makhe ।
sāyaṃ vinodakāyeva rājā prākārayan mudā । ।869।।
niśāyāṃ nartanotsāhaṃ mahotsavamakārayat ।
kanyārpaṇanimittaṃ ca dhanārpaṇamathā'karot ।।87।।
harirbhuktvā bhojayitvā kuṭumbinaḥ samāśritān ।
mahīmānān munīn sarvān brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।।88।।
prajājanān sukhaṃ paścāt suṣvāpā'marikāśaye ।
amaryastaṃ navaṃ kāntaṃ siṣevire'tisevayā ।।89।।
prātastūryāṇyavādyanta prabodhayitumīśvaram ।
maṃgalāni kīrtanāni gītikāśca striyo vyadhuḥ ।।2.202.90।।
vāditraninadā miṣṭāḥ śravaṇe'pyabhavaँstadā ।
jajāgāra harikṛṣṇaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ sabhāṃ yayau ।।91।।
dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā vīkṣituṃ maṇḍapaṃ yayau ।
viśvakarmādibhiḥ rātrau racitaṃ śobhanaṃ param ।।92।।
viśālaṃ tu daśakrośaṃ cāyutāsanaśobhitam ।
koṭidevasamāveśaṃ citradhvajasamanvitam ।।93।।
kuṇḍāni nava tatraiva tathaikaṃ paramaṃ param ।
vīkṣya vedīśca pātrāṇi śālāśca havyaśālikāḥ ।।94।।
homasamidhaḥ saṃvīkṣya kavyāni vīkṣya cāpi vai ।
tutoṣa bhagavān cābhūtprasannaścātiharṣitaḥ ।।95।।
sudivyādivyasiddhīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ gaṇāstathā ।
devīnāṃ mātṛkānāṃ ca satīnāṃ maṇḍalāni ca ।।96।।
maṇḍalāni sāṃkhyayoginīnāmaiśvaryajūṃṣi ca ।
mahānasānāṃ rakṣārthaṃ vartante pākasiddhaye ।।97।।
tadvilokyā'tituṣṭo'bhūd bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
devīṃ dharaṇiṃ cāhūyā'dhikāriṇīṃ tadā'karot ।।98।।
annapūrṇāṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ dadau sahāyyadāṃ hariḥ ।
dharaṇyai sarvalokānāṃ bhojanādiprapūrtaye ।।99।।
varuṇāya jalārthaṃ dakṣiṇārthaṃ tu kuberakam ।
nyayojayaddharistatrā''rogyārthaṃ cāśvinau sutau ।। 2.202.10 0।।
rakṣārthaṃ dharmarājaṃ ca vighneśaṃ vighnaśāntaye ।
akṣayārthaṃ sūryadevaṃ śāsanārthaṃ tu śūlinam ।। 101 ।।
dānārthaṃ gocaraṃ viṣṇuṃ vyavasthārthaṃ tu vedhasam ।
sanmānārthaṃ tvāgatānāṃ mahendraṃ samayojayat ।। 1 02।।
pācanārthaṃ vahnidevaṃ prakāśārthaṃ tu pārvaṇam ।
dhvanyādiparivṛddhyarthaṃ vidyutaḥ samayojayat ।। 1 03।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhātake ।
nyayojayat karmacārān ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhādre site dale ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maṇisevāpuryāṃ yajñapattane ca harerviharaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaḥ karmacārayojanetyādi nirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 202 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 202 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 203
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 204 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike vai tataḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtādanaḥ ।
kṛtābhivṛddhasevaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sabhāṃ yayau ।। 1 ।।
rājā tatrā''yayau tūrṇaṃ pūjādarśanalālasaḥ ।
kṛtvā pūjāṃ candanādyairhariṃ tadā''ha sannatiḥ ।। 2 ।।
adya kartavyaviṣayaṃ tvājñāpaya dayānidhe ।
sarva śaktyā sādhayiṣye kratvarthaṃ sevanaṃ prabho ।। 3 ।।
haristamāha sauvarṇī pratimāṃ śobhanāṃ śubhām ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyā'dya prakāraya saratnakām ।। 4 ।।
navāṃgulāṃ caturbāhuṃ nārāyaṇasya mūrtikām ।
lakṣmyāścāṣṭāṃgulāṃ cāpi prakāraya nu kānakīm ।। 5 ।।
mama pratimāṃ ramyāṃ ca prakāraya daśāṃgulām ।
māṇikīṃ svarṇamūrtiṃ ca matkarṇordhvāṃ prakāraya ।। 6 ।।
lakṣmīṃ matskandhaparyantāṃ matkarṇordhvā ca padmajām ।
matskandhordhvāṃ ramāṃ cāpi rādhāṃ matkaṇṭhakocchrayām ।। 7 ।।
amarīśāṃ tava kanyāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ manmukhakordhvakām ।
rājan kāraya sauvarṇīṃ yajñārthaṃ bahuśobhanām ।। 8 ।।
mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ kārayitvā satīśivau prakāraya ।
sauvarṇau ca gaṇanāthaṃ sauvarṇaṃ samprakāraya ।। 9 ।।
nandinaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca tathā samyak prakāraya ।
pañcamūrtīstathā rājan kārayitvā ca bhāskaram ।। 2.203.1 0।।
viṣṇuṃ ca kānakaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prakāraya kānakam ।
kaṃbharāṃ mātaraṃ cāpi gopālaṃ pitaraṃ mama ।। 11 ।।
prakāraya ca sauvarṇaṃ pañcakaṃ śobhanaṃ tataḥ ।
vāstudevaṃ kānakaṃ ca prakāraya viśālakam ।। 12।।
yūthaṃ ca kānakaṃ sarvadevāvāsaṃ prakāraya ।
ityājñāṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo devagṛhaṃ vidhāpaya ।। 13।।
ājñāṃ labdhvā nṛpastūrṇaṃ kārayāmāsa mūrtikāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇo'tha sasmāra nāradaṃ lokavedinam ।। 14।।
sanatkumāraṃ sādhuṃ ca garuḍaṃ vāhanaṃ nijam ।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ cāpi saccidānandayoginam ।। 15।।
pañcaite divyabodhāśca tūrṇaṃ tatrāyayuḥ puraḥ ।
kṛtvā'rhā daṇḍavaccakrurājñāṃ yogyāṃ samārthayan ।। 16।।
bālakṛṣṇastadā tebhyo dadau prasādabhojanam ।
pānaṃ hārān karau mūrdhni tataḥ kāryaṃ samādiśat ।। 17।।
āmantraṇadalaṃ tebhyo dadau yajñārthabodhakam ।
saptamyāṃ vaiṣṇavo yajñaḥ prārapsyate'tra bhūtale ।। 18।।
amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kenāṭakābhidhe sthale ।
maṇisevānagaryāḥ sannidhau viśālabhūtale ।। 1 9।।
śeṣakāṣṭhāvanānadyāḥ saṃgame vinipārage ।
sarastīre'tra dhāmasthairmuktairmuktābhirutsave ।।2.203.20 ।।
avatāraiḥ samastaiśca tathā taddhāmapārṣadaiḥ ।
sarvāvatāriṇībhiśca pārṣadānībhirādarāt ।।21 ।।
vyūhairvyūhānikābhiśca nārāyaṇaiḥ samastakaiḥ ।
nārāyaṇībhiḥ sarvābhirāgantavyaṃ makhotsave ।।22।।
viṣṇubhirvaiṣṇavībhiśceśvarairīśvaraśaktibhiḥ ।
vairājena ca vairājñyā satyā gaṇaiḥ śivena ca ।।23।।
māyayā māyikaistatvaiḥ puruṣeṇāpi sarvathā ।
āgantavyaṃ mahotsāhairbrahmaṇā brahmaśaktibhiḥ ।।24।।
brahmacāriyatibhiśca ṛṣibhiḥ sādhavaistathā ।
pitṛbhirmātṛbhiścāpi devairdevībhirityapi ।।25।।
dikpālairlokapālaiścāgantavyaṃ svapriyāyutaiḥ ।
suraiḥ surābhiḥ svargasthairbhuvarlokanivāsibhiḥ ।।26।।
grahanakṣatratārābhirgrahaiḥ pretapiśācakaiḥ ।
bhūtakuṣmāṇḍakairvināyakairgaṇaiḥ samantataḥ ।।27।।
yakṣai rakṣobhiścaivāgantavyaṃ daityaiśca dānavaiḥ ।
kāśyapībhiḥ prajābhiśca vetālakaiśca śaktibhiḥ ।।28।।
rājasaistāmasaiścāpi mānavaiḥ sakuṭumbakaiḥ ।
yatibhiryogibhiścāpi vṛkṣaistṛṇaiśca vallibhiḥ ।।।29।।
stambairghāsairjantubhiśca jarājairaṇḍajairapi ।
svedajaiḥ kaṇajaiścāpi kandajairjalajaistathā ।।2.203.3 0।।
āgantavyaṃ parvataiśca nadībhiśca sarovaraiḥ ।
tīrthairvanairaraṇyaiśca khātā'khātaiḥ samudrakaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
āgantavyaṃ kṣetrapālairgṛhadevaiḥ samantataḥ ।
kuladevairāyatanairgandharvaiścāraṇādibhiḥ ।। 3 2।।
sūtairmāgadhakairbandījanairnartakanāṭyibhiḥ ।
bahurūpadharairmallairvidyādhraiḥ kinnarādibhiḥ ।।33।।
gaṇairgaṇikavargaiścā'nāthaiśca bhikṣukairapi ।
vanibhiścātalāvāsaiḥ pātālāntanivāsibhiḥ ।।34।।
phaṇibhirbalibhiścāpi samāgantavyamādarāt ।
śāstrairvedaiśca vidyābhirvyavahāraiḥ samantataḥ ।।35।।
jaḍaiśca cetanaiḥ sarvairāgantavyaṃ mahāmakhe ।
ahaṃ brahmapatirbrahmapriyāsvāmī pareśvaraḥ ।। 36।।
avatārī bālakṛṣṇo nimantrayāmi cādhvare ।
devadaityagurubhiścācāryairaiśvaryaśālibhiḥ ।।37।।
viprairmunibhirbrāhmībhiścāgantavyaṃ makhe mama ।
saptamyāṃ prātarārabhyaikādaśyāṃ bhādraśuklake ।। 38।।
makhakāryaṃ mataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāgantavyaṃ kuṭumbibhiḥ ।
anāgatānāṃ śapathaṃ dadāmyahaṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।।39।।
avaśyaṃ cāmarīdeśaṃ pavitrayantu pāvanāḥ ।
naranārāyaṇādyāśca śeṣanārāyaṇādayaḥ ।।2.203.40 ।।
svasvamuktādisahitāḥ samāyāntu sukhapradāḥ ।
śrīramārādhikāgaṃgāśāradātulasīprabhāḥ ।।41 ।।
tattaddhāmanivāsinyaḥ samāyāntu mahādhvare ।
yoginyo mātaraḥ sarvāḥ kuladevyaśca caṇḍikāḥ ।।42।।
sarvā vai brahmacāriṇyaḥ samāyāntu mamā'dhvare ।
sapatikāḥ saputrāśca savaṃśāḥ sānugāḥ samāḥ ।।43।।।
āyāntu cādhvare'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'rthitāḥ ।
samājo'tra mahān bhāvī brahmāṇḍeśvaraśobhitaḥ ।।44।।
śatasahasravadanā brahmādyā viṣṇavo'pi ca ।
tathottamāḥ samāyāntu sarve śrīvaiṣṇave'dhvare ।।45।।
āhvayāmyāmantrayāmyākārayāmyahamacyutaḥ ।
parabrahmā'kṣarātītaḥ svāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।46।।
ityevaṃ rādhike yajñā''mantraṇārthāṃ supatrikām ।
dadau śrībālakṛṣṇo vai nāradādibhya eva tu ।।47।।
dadāvanantarūpāṇāṃ dhartṛtvaṃ paramādbhutam ।
aiśvaryaṃ cāpi gatikāṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ca satvaram ।। 48।।
sarve yayurharerājñāṃ pragṛhyāmantraṇārthikāḥ ।
madhyāhne yamarājaṃ ca sasmāra parameśvaraḥ ।।49।।
yamalokaṃ bandhaśūnyaṃ kārayāmāsa cājñayā ।
sarvān vimocayāmāsa jīvān yamavaśaṃgatān ।।2.203.50।।
yamadūtāँstadā yajñe karmacārān cakāra ha ।
evaṃ nirvartya bhagavān madhyāhne bhojanādikam ।।5 1 ।।
kārayāmāsa sarvebhyo makhārthibhyastataḥ svayam ।
bubhuje'tha ca viśrāntiṃ lebhe kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ param ।।52।।
ādideśa haristatra brahmaṇe viṣṇave tathā ।
śaṃkarāya ca sarveṣāmāgamyamānadehinām ।।53 ।।
makhārthināṃ narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ svāgatāya vai ।
satyai lakṣmyai sarasvatyai cādideśa tathaiva ca ।।54।।
naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ cādideśa svāgatāya vai ।
dharmadevāya ca vāsudevāyā'pyādideśa ca ।।55।।
svāgatārthaṃ hi sarveṣāmāgantukamakhārthinām ।
atha śrīlomaśaṃ prāha bhāradvājaṃ tathā munim ।।56।।
divimānāyanaṃ cāpi gāṃgeyān yavakrītinaḥ ।
bhavantaḥ svāgataṃ sarve kurvantu sarvadehinām ।।57 । ।
āgatānāṃ jalaiścānnaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca mandiraiḥ ।
āvāsanapradānaiścā'pekṣyavastubhirādarāt ।। 58 । ।
kalpavṛkṣān kalpalatāḥ kalpamaṇīṃśca kalpagāḥ ।
prāha sarvanivāseṣu yajñapattanake'bhitaḥ ।।59 ।।
upatiṣṭhantu sarvatra svāgatārthaṃ samanvitāḥ ।
yathāpekṣaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca vidhāyāpi navaṃ navam । । 2.203.60 ।।
arpayantu mahīmānebhyastadā sārvavāñcchikam ।
brahmahradaṃ ca virajāṃ rasakūpaṃ tathā'mṛtam । ।6 1 । ।
brahmasaro hariḥ prāha tiṣṭhantu ca sthale sthale ।
sarvābhivāñcchitaṃ sarvaṃ peyaṃ samarpayantu vai । । 62 ।।
pavanaṃ vahnidevaṃ ca prāha vyajanado bhava ।
uṣṇado bhava cāpyatra bahurūpadharo bhavān ।। 63 ।।
vyoma prāha bhavānatra dūraśrutiṃ karotu vai ।
siddhīḥ prāha bhavatyo'tra kurvantu prāpaṇādikam । । 64।।
evaṃ mantrāँstadā prāha ghoṣayantu makhasthale ।
maṃgalāni vicitrāṇi cāgatānāṃ hi mānane ।। 65 ।।
śāradāśca tadā prāha kurvantu gītikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
āgatānāṃ svāgatārthe vādyāni vādayantu vai ।। 66 । ।
rājabhyaśca hariḥ prāha sainyaiścarantu mānanam ।
svāgataṃ sarvalokānāmāgatānāṃ makhārthinām ।। 67 ।।
vādyairyantradhvānakaiśca kurvantu bahumānanam ।
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya bālakṛṣṇo jagāda ha ।। 68 ।।
muktānāṃ tu nivāsān vai vyomni kṣaṇātprakalpaya ।
avatāreśvarāṇāṃ ca tathā vyomni prakalpaya । । 69 । ।
devānāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ vyomni pitṝṇāṃ kalpaya ।
brahmāṇḍāntaravāsānā bhūtale yajñapattane । ।2.203.7 0 । ।
uttarottarabhūbhāgān prakalpaya kṣaṇānnanu ।
divyāṃ dadāmi śaktiṃ te saṃkalpotthaphalātmikām । ।7 1 । ।
kalpaklṛptyabhidhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tayā sādhaya satvaram ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān svāsane'bhavat । ।72 । ।
tāvad rājā rāyarokīśvaraḥ saṃprārthayaddharim ।
adya ced bhavato vāñchā mama rājyaṃ pavitraya । ।7 3 । ।
sphūrtinārīvanāṃ divyāṃ mahākañjīnadītaṭe ।
nagarī me samāgatya dvimānāyanarāṣṭrakam । ।74। ।
pavitraya harekṛṣṇa tavā''gamyaṃ na kiñcana ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha pītvā jalaṃ suśītalam । । 75 । ।
vimānaṃ cārurohāpi mātrā pitrā samanvitaḥ ।
lālāyanena sahito māṇakyā sahitastathā ।।76।।
pārṣadairdivyadehaiśca bhṛtyairdāsīśatairapi ।
dvādaśabhiśca mukhyābhiḥ satībhiḥ sahito yayau ।।77।।
sphūrtinārīvanāpuryāmambarāt kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।
rājā ṛṣiścakratuśca sanmānaṃ sahagau tadā ।।78।।
udyāne tvavatīryaiva rājasaudhasamīpataḥ ।
sainyena svāgataṃ viṣṇoḥ kurutaḥ sma vidhānataḥ ।।79।।
pādau prakṣālya vidhinā papaturjalamamṛtam ।
candanaiḥ puṣpahāraiśca pupūjatustamādarāt ।।2.203.80।।
anyān sahagatāँścāpi pupūjaturnṛpo muniḥ ।
atha saudhe ninyatuśca śrīpatiṃ nṛpamandire ।।8 1 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'sya rājñīdaśakameva tu ।
kumārāśca kumāryaśca cakrurnirājanaṃ tataḥ ।।82।।
harirdivyaṃ darśanaṃ svaṃ caturbhujaṃ dadau ca tān ।
āścaryacakitāścāsan kumāryaścaikaviṃśatiḥ ।।83।।
rājakanyā mātṛvaśyā mātrājñayā ca mohitāḥ ।
varamālāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaṇṭhe samārpayaँstadā ।।84।।
kṛtakṛtyāstā abhavan prāpya kāntaṃ janārdanam ।
rājā tadutsavaṃ cakre rājasaudhe hi śobhanam ।।85।।
hareśca pādayordravyaṃ koṭisaṃkhyaṃ nyadhānnṛpaḥ ।
yautakaṃ pradadau cāpi svarṇahārādikāँstathā ।।86 ।।
bhūṣāmbarāṇi pradadau nīrājanamakārayat ।
natvā hariṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ kṣamāmayācata prabhoḥ ।।87।।
pāvito'haṃ dhṛto haste kanyā svīkṛtya me tvayā ।
naijīkṛto'smi bhagavan sadā rakṣaya māyikāt ।।88।।
rājñyastato hariṃ natvā candrakaṃ bhālake vyadhuḥ ।
kṣamāṃ harerayācanna samuddhareti cārthayan ।।89।।
hariḥ prāhoddhariṣye'haṃ nayiṣye'nte paraṃ padam ।
tato divyasvarūpaṃ svaṃ caturbhujaṃ vyalopayat ।।2.203.90 ।।
sarvato rājasaudheṣu vihṛtya ca tataḥ param ।
pradhānānāṃ gṛhāṇyeva gatvā'pāvayadacyutaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya sainyena śobhitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sphūrtinārīvanāpuryāṃ rājamārge gato'bhavat ।।92।।
darśakaiḥ pūjakaiścāpi prajājanaiḥ supūjitaḥ ।
vandito'rcitapādaśca dravyādibhiḥ samarpitaḥ ।।93 ।।
amarībhiryaśogānaiḥ śrāvito rañjito'rcanaiḥ ।
vardhitaścāśiṣā puṣpairvikīrito'timānitaḥ ।।94।।
jayaśabdairvādyaśabdaiḥ kīrtitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
netrapadmaistathā pīto bhāvaiścākarṣito yayau ।।95।।
pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ sarve prajājanāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
daduḥ pūjāṃ parigṛhya bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ ।।96।।
rājasaudhaṃ samāgamya mahākāñcījalaṃ papau ।
mahākāṃcananāmānaṛṣiṃ sammānayan prabhuṃ ।।97।।
dravyaṃ tasmai dadau tatra rājā munirdhanaṃ tu tat ।
yajñārthaṃ tu vimāne vai kṛtvā'prāpayadadhvaram ।।98।।
harirvimānamāruhya kuṭumbasahitastadā ।
rājñā rājñyā kanyakābhiḥ saha dvimānarāṣṭrakam ।।99।।
bhramitvā vyomamārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā deśapradeśakān ।
vinipārasarastīraṃ sāyaṃpūrvaṃ samāyayau ।। 2.203.10 0।।
rājasaudhe tvavatīrya viśrāntiṃ prayayau hariḥ ।
kanyakāstā brahmasatyaḥ kāntāsu vāsamācaran ।। 10 1।।
rāyarokīśvaro mahākāñcanarṣirdhanāni vai ।
dadaturyajñakāryārthaṃ kuberāya tadā hyubhau ।। 1 02।।
athākāśe mahīmānavimānāni mahāmbarāt ।
akṣarāccāpi golokād vaikuṇṭhādamṛtādapi ।। 103 ।।
avyākṛtādīśalokādvairājācca hiraṇmayāt ।
satyāt svargājjanādeśca merordigbhyaḥ samantataḥ ।। 1 04।।
puryaṣṭakād bhuvanānāmantarālebhya āyayuḥ ।
pātālebhyastrisṛṣṭibhyo vimānāni samāyayuḥ ।। 105 ।।
āmantritānāṃ yānāni koṭyarbudāni cāyayuḥ ।
ambaraṃ channabhāvaṃ vai prāptaṃ vimānakoṭibhiḥ ।। 106 ।।
svargaṃ svargaṃ mahāsvargaṃ brahmasvargaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
sūryavatkāśamānaṃ vai divaṃ dvitīyakaṃ hyabhūt ।। 1 07।।
rādhike jīvasṛṣṭiśceśvarasṛṣṭistathā parā ।
brahmasṛṣṭiḥ sarvavidhā tvāyayau vai nimantraṇāt ।। 10 8।।
niśā layaṃ gatā tatra śrīhareścaikaromake ।
svāgataṃ sma prakurvanti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
mahīmānāścāmbarāccāvatarantyucitasthalīḥ ।। 109 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rāyakinnaranṛpāya sauvarṇamūrtividhāpanādeśaḥ, nāradādīnāṃ kuṃkumāmantraṇapatrikāyuktānāṃ sṛṣṭiṣu preṣaṇaṃ, hareḥ rāyarokīśvaranṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ pūjanaṃ sphūrtinārīnagaryāṃ
deśe ca bhramaṇaṃ punaryajñasthalāgamanaṃ, mahīmānānāmāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 203 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 203 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 204
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 205 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
āyayū rādhike muktāḥ paramākṣaradhāminaḥ ।
muktānyaścāyayustatra divyavimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛtaṃ śrīhariṇā teṣāṃ svāgataṃ bahuśobhanam ।
dhāmeśvarā avatārāścāyayuḥ śaktiśobhitāḥ ।। 2 ।।
ahaṃ rādhe tvayā sākaṃ gopagopīgaṇānvitaḥ ।
agamaṃ divyapatnībhiḥ sākaṃ vimānamāśritaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vaikuṇṭhācchrīpatirnārāyaṇo'pi tatra cāyayau ।
sarvapārṣadayuktaśca ramābhiḥ sahitastadā ।। 4 ।।
vāsudevādayo vyūhāścāyayustatra cādhvare ।
avatārāstathā sarve'pyāyuḥ śaktisevitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
sanmānaṃ svāgataṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ vyadhāt ।
mahāviṣṇustathā bhūmā virāḍapi hiraṇmayaḥ ।। 6 ।।
aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃsthāśceśvarā māyāgatā api ।
śivalokagatāścāpi tatrāyayustadaṃśakāḥ ।। 7 ।।
śrīhariḥ svayamevaiṣāṃ svāgataṃ mānamācarat ।
īśasṛṣṭisamastānāṃ brahmasṛṣṭinivāsinām ।। 8 ।।
cidānandāmbare klṛpte nagare ca nivāsanam ।
pradadau śrībālakṛṣṇo'vatārī puruṣottamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
brahmaṇaḥ satyalokasthāstathānyalokavāsinaḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhāścāyayustatra vai makhe ।। 2.204.10 ।।
devā deveśvarāścāśāpālā lokaprapālinaḥ ।
āyayuśca vimānairadhvare bhuvarnivāsinaḥ ।। 11 ।।
meroḥ samāyayuścāpyantarīkṣād grahatārakāḥ ।
nakṣatrāṇi surādyāśca vasavo rudrakoṭayaḥ ।। 12।।
ādityā aśvinau dharmarājastathā'pare surāḥ ।
āyayuścādhvare naijakuṭumbapariśobhitaḥ ।। 13 ।।
kailāsasya gaṇā gaṇyo yoginyaścaṇḍikāstathā ।
bhairavā bhūtadehāśca śāṃkarāste samāyayuḥ ।। 14।।
etebhyo devakoṭibhyo yogyā''vāsān dadau hariḥ ।
susvāgataṃ susammānaṃ cakrurbrahmā'javiṣṇavaḥ ।। 15।।
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca cakruḥ sammānanaṃ bahu ।
vālakhilyamaharṣīṇāṃ munīnāṃ cordhvaretasām ।। 16।।
sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sāṃkhyayoginīnāṃ sumānanam ।
lakṣmyādyāścakruratyarthaṃ nivāsān pradaduḥ sukhān ।। 17।।
sūtamāgadhabandyādyā vidyādhrāḥ kinnarādayaḥ ।
kimpuṃsaścāpi gandharvāścāraṇā bhāṭajātayaḥ ।। 18।।
āyayuḥ kathakāścāpi rañjakā mallayodhinaḥ ।
rūpakāścāyayuścāpi narā nṛtyakarāstathā ।। 1 9।'।
sarvavarṇāḥ sarvadeśanivāsāstatra cāyayuḥ ।
saurāṣṭrīyā mānavāśca dakṣiṇāpathavartinaḥ ।।2.204.2 0।।
uṣṭrālayajanāścāpi brahmabhūmijanā api ।
śivarājyasthitāścāpi prācīnarājyavāsinaḥ ।।21 ।।
rāśiyānanivāsāśca ketumālanivāsinaḥ ।
abriktasthāstathā lokā āraktadeśavāsinaḥ ।।22।।
ārārtrikaguhāvāsāścāmarīdeśavāsinaḥ ।
hāritāśca tathā''raṇyavāsāḥ parvatavāsinaḥ ।।23।।
jalasthāśca sthalasthāśca vyomasthāḥ prasamāyayuḥ ।
tebhyo dadurnivāsāँścā'kurvan mānaṃ harādayaḥ ।।24।।
vṛkṣā vallyastṛṇastambāḥ kandamūlādayastathā ।
āyayuḥ kaṇajātāścodbhijjā divyaśarīriṇaḥ ।। 25।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi haṃsagaruḍajātikāḥ ।
anye'pi jantavastatrāyayurdivyaśarīriṇaḥ ।।26।।
teṣāṃ nivāsān pradaduścakrurmānaṃ harādayaḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarvā'talādivāsinaḥ ।। 27।।
sarpāśca nāgā nāgendrā vāhanāni samāyayuḥ ।
daityāśca dānavā raudrā rākṣasāśca samāyayuḥ ।।28।।
teṣāṃ dadunivāsāँśca dakṣiṇe sarasastathā ।
sammānaṃ śaṃkaraścakre yathāyogyaṃ satī tathā ।।।29।।।
naranārāyaṇādyāśca śeṣanārāyaṇādayaḥ ।
avatārāstathā cānye tatrāyayurmahādhvare ।।2.204.3 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasteṣāṃ samutsukaḥ ।
sammānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre nivāsān pradadau śubhān ।।3 1।।
nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca tattvāni tvāyayustadā ।
tīrthāni vipravaryāśca divyadehāḥ maharṣayaḥ ।।32।।
meghā vidyudvilasitāścāyayustatra cādhvare ।
yathāyogyaṃ svāgataṃ ca teṣāṃ brahmā tadā'karot ।।33 ।।
kālaḥ kṣaṇā muhūrtāni divasāḥ pakṣavatsarāḥ ।
yugā māsāścāyayuśca svāgataṃ śaṃkaro vyadhāt ।।34।।
śilpinaḥ koṭilokasthāścāyayustatra cādhvare ।
viśvakarmā susammānaṃ vyadhād vāsān dadau tadā ।।35।।
sarveṣāṃ bahudhāmānaṃ vāsudevo narāyaṇaḥ ।
yathāyogyaṃ pracakre vai sarvadānādibhistadā ।। 36।।
rādhike tatra vāseṣu sarvaṃ sampūrṇamasti vai ।
pradīpāḥ pānapātrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca ।।37।।
miṣṭānnāni ca peyāni lehyāni santi tatra ca ।
coṣyāṇi cāsanādīni śayyā yogyāḥ sukomalāḥ ।।38।।
dāsā dāsyo dugdhakuṇḍā amṛtānāṃ saridvarāḥ ।
udyānānāṃ sudṛśyāni bhṛtyā dāsyaśca sevakāḥ ।।39।।
karmacārā nideśasthāḥ sarvāvāseṣu nirmitāḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇena saṃkalpāt koṭiśo'nantasevakāḥ ।।2.204.40।।
dūraśravaṇayantrāṇi dūradarśanakāni ca ।
vaihāyasāni yānāni sarvasparśādisiddhikāḥ ।।41 ।।
ghṛtakulyāḥ payaḥkulyāḥ śarkarāparvatāstathā ।
tatrā''san sarvataḥ klṛtā mahīmānādituṣṭaye ।।42।।
rādhike kiṃ varṇaye'haṃ svarṇabhūṣādiparvatāḥ ।
ambarāṇāṃ tathā śailāḥ kṛtāḥ śrīparamātmanā ।। 42।।
alaktānāṃ sugandhānāṃ droṇyastatra tadā kṛtāḥ ।
sarvaśṛṃgāravastūnāṃ tatrā''san parvatāḥ parāḥ ।।44।।
dīrghikāśca tathā''saँśca rasānāṃ ca sarāṃsi vai ।
dravāṇāṃ tu nadāścāsan bhuktaye tu makhārthinām ।।45।।
yādṛśyaścā'kṣare santi goloke ca vikuṇṭhake ।
kailāsake śvetabhūmau tādṛśyaḥ smṛddhayo'bhavan ।।46।।
visasmarurmahīmānāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ।
nijāṃ nijāṃ samṛddhiṃ cādhikāṃ prāpya harermakhe ।।47।।
āprātaścaivamevaivaṃ svāgataṃ samabhūt khalu ।
bhojanaṃ sevanaṃ pānaṃ śayyādānaṃ nivāsanam ।।48।।
dāsadāsīpradānaṃ ca sarvaṃ pūrṇamabhūt tadā ।
mahīmānāḥ prasannāśca jahuḥ pariśramaṃ tadā ।।49।।
sukhāvāsān parān prāpyā''dhikyena sukhino'bhavan ।
rātrau sthale sthale tatra manorañjanaśālikāḥ ।।2.204.50।।
abhavannartanādīnāṃ kathānāṃ yodhināṃ tathā ।
rūpapradarśanānāṃ ca hāsyānāṃ gītikāriṇām ।।51।।
ākhyānānāṃ ca nāṭyānāṃ rañjanānyabhavanniśi ।
prātarjātaṃ tvevameva saptamyāḥ śobhanaṃ priyam ।।52।।
rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ snānaṃ cakre prabodhitaḥ ।
kṛtapūjāvandanaścā''juhāva lomaśaṃ munim ।।53।।
ṛṣiṃ cājñāpayāmāsa kṛtābhivandanaṃ gurum ।
yajñakārye samādhehi sarvadraṣṭāramuttamam ।।54।।
lomaśaścāha kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ tava śiṣyaṃ mahāmunim ।
vedaśāstranidhānaṃ ca karmakāṇḍātigocaram ।। 55।।
trikālajñaṃ ca mantrajñaṃ samādhisiddhiśālinam ।
sarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ pareśvarayoginam ।। 56।।
samarthaṃ naiṣṭhikavaryaṃ naikabhavanaśaktikam ।
svayaṃprakāśanāmānaṃ sarvadraṣṭāramuttamam ।।57।।
vidhehi tvadhvare cātra sarvatragatiśālinam ।
śāntaṃ guṇanidhiṃ yogyaṃ draṣṭāraṃ taṃ suyojaya ।।58।।
viṣṇurbrahmā haraścāpi bṛhaspatiḥ kumārakaḥ ।
gaṇeśaścāpi yogyaṃ taṃ cānvamodanta vaiṃ tadā ।।59।।
bhāradvājo vaśiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurvaiśvānarastathā ।
viśvedevā marutaścā'pyanvamodanta taṃ tathā ।।2.204.60।।
svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān sārvajñyasya mahānidhiḥ ।
gurorvākyaṃ harervākyaṃ sarvadraṣṭṛtvadhāyakam ।।6 1।।
svīcakāra vinītaḥ saṃstataḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
kaṇṭhahāraṃ dadau tasmai śirastrāṇaṃ tadarthakam ।।62।।।
kañcukaṃ svarṇatārāḍhyaṃ vastraṃ kauśeyakaṃ dadau ।
dhautraṃ tathāvidhaṃ cāpi sarvadraṣṭṛtvabodhakam ।।63 ।।
āsanaṃ cottamaṃ tatra maṇḍape tatkṛte mahat ।
nyadhāpayattatastaṃ cāpreṣayad yajñamaṇḍapam ।।64।।
gurvāsanaṃ lomaśāya dattavān bhagavān svayam ।
saccidānandarūpāya lālāyanāya mādhavaḥ ।।65।।
bālakṛṣṇo dadau pratinidhitvaṃ svasya vai tadā ।
yajamānastadā rājā rāyakinnarako mataḥ ।।66।।
satīdevīmahārājñīyuto maṇḍapamāyayau ।
avādyanta samastāni tūryāṇi maṃgalakṣaṇe ।।67।।
āyayuḥ sarvato yajñabhūmau tadadhikāriṇaḥ ।
bhūdevāḥ svargadevāśca satyadevāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।68।।
īśadevā devadevā devāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ।
muktāstathā'vatārāśceśvarāḥ patnīsamāyutāḥ ।।69।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mānavāḥ strīsamāyutāḥ ।
guravaḥ sarvalokānāṃ vyāsā vyāsatarāstathā ।।2.204.70 ।।
vedāḥ ṛcaśca sāmāni pūjyātmānaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
vayovṛddhā jñānavṛddhāḥ karmaṭhāśca samāyayuḥ ।।71 ।।
svaravṛddhā bhūtivṛddhā guṇavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dhanavṛddhā dharmavṛddhā lokavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।72।।
yogavṛddhāstapovṛddhāḥ sthānavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
gītivṛddhā vedavṛddhā vṛddhavṛddhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।73।।
sattāvṛddhāścāyayuśca rājāno'pi samāyayuḥ ।
jāpakāḥ karmacārāśca homakā dānakāstathā ।।74।।
dvārapā maṇḍaparakṣā mukhyā gauṇāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dravyahārā havyahārā samiddhā×Vr̤M×rāḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 75।।
niśānirmitakuṇḍāśca raṅgavallīprapūrakāḥ ।
dhvajāpatākādhartārastatra sarve samāyayuḥ ।।76।।
jalādānaprakartāraḥ pātrasaṃcayakāriṇaḥ ।
vastuhārāḥ phalapuṣpahārāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।77।।
rasahārā gavyahārā miṣṭahārāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
vāditreṣvatigarjatsu ninādite digambare ।।78।।
sarve maṇḍapabhūmiṃ vai draṣṭuṃ cāyayurutsukāḥ ।
vyomni vyomavihartāro'ntarīkṣe'ntarayoginaḥ ।।79।।
vāyustare bhuvarvāsaḥ samāgatya sthitāstadā ।
dyuvāsāśca prakāśeṣu vaimānikā vimānake ।।2.204.80 ।।
āgatya tu sthitāḥ sarve maṇḍapābhimukhāstadā ।
satyaḥ sādhvyaśca gauryaśca brahmapriyāśca hāritāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
amaryaḥ kanyakāścāpi devyaḥ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ ।
devapatnyaḥ kṛtaveṣāścitraśṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ।।82।।
pūrṇānandabharāḥ sarvā yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।
īśvarāṇyaśca muktānyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ।।83।।
mānavyo mātaraścāpi yoginyaśca samāyayuḥ ।
yatinyaśca brahmapatnyo brāhmaṇyaśca samāyayuḥ ।।84।।
vāstudevāḥ kuṇḍadevāḥ śākhādevāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dvāradevāstoraṇādisurā maṇḍapadevatāḥ ।।85।।
staṃbhadevā dhvajadevā yūpadevāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
trayastriṃśatpradevāśca pañcāyatanadevatāḥ ।।86।।
śrutvā vāditraninadān yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।
nṛpā daśa sayoṣāśca bahuratnasamanvitāḥ ।।87।।
yajamānasvarūpāste yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।
pṛthvyādibhūtatattvāni śabdādyā viṣayāstathā ।।88।।
vahnayo mūrtimantaśca yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।
kuṇḍā bahuvidhāścāpi vedikā mukhyavedikāḥ ।।89।।
sthaṇḍilāḥ pālikāścāpi mūrtimantaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
sruksruvādyāni pātrāṇi patrāṇi kuśadevatāḥ ।।2.204.9 0 ।।
samidhaḥ kaṇajātāni havyānyapi samāyayuḥ ।
caravaśca pavitrāṇi mūrtāni tatra cāyayuḥ ।। 91 ।।
śuddhayaścāpi gavyāni saptamṛdaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
āsanānyupakaraṇānyapi mūrtāni cāyayuḥ ।। 92।।
atha jyotiḥpūruṣaśca mūrtimān divyarūpadhṛk ।
paṭahena diśaḥ sarvā nādayan samupāyayau ।।93 ।।
svarṇayūpapūruṣaśca mūrtimāँstatra cāyayau ।
tīrthāni sarvarūpāṇi mūrtimanti samāyayuḥ ।। 94।।
svastayaḥ śrāddhapuruṣāstṛptayastatra cāyayuḥ ।
apūrvāṇi samastāni paramāpūrvalabdhaye ।।95।।
madhyāpūrvatrikāpūrvāyutāni tatra cāyayuḥ ।
kāṇḍikā vidhayaḥ sarve kramāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।96।।
hotavyāni samastāni mūrtimanti samāyayuḥ ।
prajāḥ prajeśvarāścāpyābālavṛddhayuvādikāḥ ।। 97।।
narā nāryaścāyayurvai vādyaghoṣaiḥ kratusthalīm ।
saṃskṛtāṃ śobhayā yuktāṃ dyubhāsāṃ tvakṣarīkṛtām ।।98।।
yugalaiścāyugalaiśca saṃbhṛtāṃ navajīvanīm ।
maṇḍapai rājitāṃ yajñapattanairatigarvitām ।।99।।
sarvasṛṣṭyādhivāsaiścāśritāṃ śreṣṭatamāṃ mahīm ।
sārvabhaumīṃ dhāmatulyāṃ dhāminīṃ pārameśvarīm ।। 2.204.10 0।।
rādhike karmaṇāṃ prāraṃbhasyottamaṃ muhūrtakam ।
upasthitaṃ tadā nādāḥ śaṃkhānāmabhavan śubhāḥ ।। 10 1।।
tūpaśabdā abhavaँśca vidyudvaṃśaninādakāḥ ।
sūcakāḥ karmakāṇḍasyārambhasyaiva tadā'bhavan ।। 1 02।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
āyayau maṇḍapaṃ śīghraṃ jayanādapravardhitaḥ ।। 103 ।।
niṣasādā''sane divye maṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau ।
nṛpāścāgatya kuṇḍānāṃ nyaṣīdan sannidhau tadā ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarveṣāmāgantukānāṃ svāgatamāvāsanaṃ copakaraṇasaṃklṛptiḥ svayaṃprakāśasya haryavatārasya makhe sarvadraṣṭṛtvavidhānaṃ, maṃgalavādyaghoṣāḥ, sarveṣāṃ devīdevādīnāṃ yajñamaṇḍapāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 204 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātarmaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau ।
rāyakinnaranṛpatirditrimānāyanarṣiṇā ।। 1 ।।
samaṃ samāyayau patnyā sahito yajamānakaḥ ।
rāyarokīśvaro rājā mahākāñcanakarṣiṇā ।। 2 ।।
tathā svapatnyā sahitaḥ kuṇḍasannidhimāyayau ।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca ālrāyasarṣiṇā samam ।। 3 ।।
patnyā yutastathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau ।
rāyavākakṣako rājā cārulāṣarṣiṇā samam ।। 4 ।।
patnyā yutastathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau ।
rāyamārīśabhūpaśca ' dānavarṣiyuto makhe ।। 5 ।।
patnyā sākaṃ tathā kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape yayau ।
rāyabāleśvaro rājā mālāvanarṣisaṃyutaḥ ।। 6 ।।
rājñyā sākaṃ yayau kuṇḍasannidhau maṇḍape tadā ।
rāyalambārabhūpaśca rūpartuṛṣiṇā saha ।। 7 ।।
patnyā yuto yayau yajñe kuṇḍasya sannidhau tadā ।
rāyanavārkabhūpaśca vāśṛṃgatanukarṣiṇā ।। 8 ।।
patnyā sākaṃ yayau yajñamaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau ।
rāyahuṇḍeśanṛpatirvīrākajanakarṣiṇā ।। 9 ।।
samaṃ patnyā tvāyayau ca maṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau ।
rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca heyatānarṣiṇā saha ।। 2.205.10 ।।
patnyā sākaṃ yayau yajñamaṇḍape kuṇḍasannidhau ।
ityevaṃ daśa rājānau daśakuṇḍān nijīkṛtān ।। 11 ।।
pratyekasyaiva kuṇḍasya niṣeduḥ sannidhau tadā ।
ācāryasya tadā kuṇḍe śrīharirbālanaiṣṭhikaḥ ।। 1 2।।
lomaśena tu sahito rāyakinnarabhūbhṛtā ।
sapatnīkena sākaṃ vai nyaṣīdatparamāsane ।। 1 3।।
anyakuṇḍarṣisahitā vedaprādhānikā nṛpāḥ ।
yathāyogyaṃ lomaśoktā niṣeduryugalātmakāḥ ।। 14।।
rādhike devaviprāśca bhūviprāḥ satyabhūsurāḥ ।
prārabhanta tatastatra maṃgalāni śubhasvaraiḥ ।। 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭhāsane sthitaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।। 16।।
asthāpayaddhariścaivaṃ sarvā mūrtīrnyadhāpayat ।
svarṇamayaṃ ca garuḍaṃ dvārapālāँśca pārṣadān ।। 17।।
asthāpayacchaktiyuktān harirviṣṇostu sannidhau ।
gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ caiśānyāṃ tu rudrasya pīṭhakam ।। 18।।
pūrve kṣetrapīṭhaṃ cāgneyyāṃ śaktiprapīṭhakam ।
dakṣe gaṇeśapīṭhaṃ nairṛtyāṃ ca vāstupīṭhakam ।। 19।।
vāyavyāṃ yoginīpīṭhaṃ snānapīṭhaṃ tathottare ।
grahapīṭhāni sarvāṇi koṇamadhyagagarbhake ।। 2.205.20 ।।
nyasya tatra ca devāँstānasthāpayat pareśvara ।
kuṇḍamaṇḍapavedīśca prokṣyadravyāṇi maṇḍape ।।21 ।।
asthāpayacca mukhyāni kaṇāँśca samidhastathā ।
yavavrīhikuśān dūrvādadhicandanasarṣapān ।।22।।
siddhārtharocanāścāpi phalāni śarkarāstathā ।
gandhakusumapūgāni dhūpadīpādikāँstathā ।।23।।
ācāryo lomaśastatra cakāra svastikaṃ śubham ।
vastrorṇāmudrikāpātramadhuparkādikāँstathā ।। 24।।
hiraṇyā''rārtrikāsnānapātraśaṃkhadharādikān ।
candanāgurukastūrīkarpūrakuṃkumāni ca ।।25।।
ājyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ tandūlān bhājanāni ca ।
upavītaṃ cāsanāni mudrābhūṣāsumāni ca ।।26।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā tatrā'pekṣitāni nyadhāddhariḥ ।
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ snānaśālāṃ yayau tataḥ ।।27।।।
snānaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍape tvāyayau gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ ।
pupūja pracakārāpi mātṛśrāddhaṃ tato nṛpaḥ ।।28।।
mātṛpūjāṃ vidhāyā'tha dīkṣāṃ jagrāha vaiṣṇavīm ।
prāyaścittaṃ cakārā'tha vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tato'karot ।।29।।
graharakṣāṃ dhvajāniveśanaṃ śibirabandhanam ।
pracakāra tataścācāryādīnāṃ varaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ।।2.205.3 0।।
deśakālau samuccārya madhuparkaṃ tato'karot ।
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre brahmaṇo varaṇaṃ tathā ।।3 1 ।।
ācāryavaraṇaṃ cāpi tathā''sanāni sandado ।
saṃvaraṇopahārāँśca niṣkrayaṃ dravyamityapi ।। 32।।
varaṇaṃ jāpakānāṃ ca pāṭhakānāṃ tathāvidham ।
sahasrāyutakoṭīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ varaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।।33।।
cāturvedā brāhmaṇāśca mantrān jepurnijocitān ।
puṇyāhavācanaṃ cakrurviprāścāgamavedinaḥ ।। 34।।
svastivāco'vadaँścāpyāśīrvādāँśca dadustataḥ ।
saptarṣayastathā lakṣamitāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ ।। 35।।
vardhinīkalaśaṃ tīrthavāribhṛtaṃ nṛpo'mucat ।
svarṇa tatra pallavāँśca ratnānyapi nyadhāttataḥ ।।36।।
atha śrīlomaśastatrānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
rādhālakṣmīprabhāśrīmāṇikībhūpārvatīyutam ।।37।।
sauvarṇa sthāpayāmāsā'pūjayacca vidhānataḥ ।
svayaṃ śrīmadvālakṛṣṇaḥ sākṣāttatra vyarājata ।। 38।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāyuktaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śriyāyutam ।
sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sākṣāt so'pi hyupasthitaḥ ।। 39।।
avatārān śaktiyuktān sthāpayāmāsa vai tadā ।
sarve sākṣādatiṣṭhantā'dhvare tatra nijāsane ।।2.205.40।।
vāsudevādikavyūhān sthāpayāmāsa vai tadā ।
catvāraste gocarā vai hyupātiṣṭhanta cāpare ।।41।।
bhūmānaṃ ca hiraṇgarbhaṃ vairājaṃ cāvṛtīśvarān ।
sthāpayāmāsa te sarve sākṣāttatrāpyupasthitāḥ ।।42।।
svasvaśaktiyutāḥ svasvapārṣadādisamanvitāḥ ।
īśāno viśvasṛṭ viṣṇuḥ svasvaśaktisamanvitāḥ ।।43 ।।
āvāhitāḥ samāgatyā'rājanta gocarāśca te ।
mahāmāyā pūruṣaśca tattvānyapi ca tāttvikāḥ ।।44।।
śaktayaścāpi sākṣādāvāhitāścopatasthire ।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāścāvāhitā āyayurmakhe ।।45।।
sākṣātsarvā vyarājanta maṇḍape tu nijāsane ।
brahmā brahmapade'tiṣṭhat sākṣāllokapitāmahaḥ ।।46।।
rudro rudrapade'tiṣṭhaccaikādaśasvarūpavān ।
rudrāṇībhiryuto gaṇairgaṇeśakārtikādibhiḥ ।।47।।
sākṣānniṣeduḥ sauvarṇā api divyā nijāsane ।
āvāhitāśca pitarastathā maharṣayo'pi ca ।।48।।
sākṣādupasthitāstatra nijāsaneṣu cādhvare ।
maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sureśvarāḥ ।।49।।
digīśvarā lokapālā āvāhitāśca gocarāḥ ।
patnīyutāḥ samāgatya niṣeduścāsaneṣu te ।।2.205.50 ।।
siddhayo nidhayaścāpi grahāścopagrahādayaḥ ।
tārakāścāvāhitāśca sastriyo gocarāstadā ।।5 1 ।।
sākṣānniṣeduḥ sarve te svāsaneṣu samāhitāḥ ।
saptarṣayo vālakhilyāḥ kṛttikāśca diśastathā ।।5 2।।
ādityāḥ kāmadevaśca manavastithayastathā ।
āvāhitāstu sākṣātte hyupātiṣṭhanta cādhvare ।।53 ।।
nakṣatrāṇi kalāścāpi trayastriṃśatsurānugāḥ ।
guṇā yoginikācakraṃ tīrthāni saritastathā ।।54।।
sāgarā dīrghikāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi parvatādayaḥ ।
āvāhitāścāyayuste sākṣātsarve sumūrtayaḥ ।।55।।।
yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācakāḥ ।
vināyakāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vetālādyā mahādhvare ।।56 ।।
svasvakuṭumbasahitāḥ sākṣāt tatrāyayurmakhe ।
āvāhitā niṣeduśca nirbhayā maṇḍape tadā ।।57।।
sūtamāgadhabandyādyā bhāṭacāraṇakinnarāḥ ।
vidyādharāḥ kiṃpuruṣā gandharvāḥ siddhakoṭayaḥ ।।58।।
sākṣātsamāvāhitāste cāgatā maṇḍape sthitāḥ ।
cāturvarṇā yatayaśca sādhavaḥ sanakādayaḥ ।।59।।
āvāhitā naiṣṭhikāśca sarve te maṇḍape sthitāḥ ।
garuḍaśca tathā haṃso hastī cāśvaśca kesarī ।।2.205.60 ।।
vṛṣabhaśconduruścaite āvāhitāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dattāsaneṣu sākṣātte vyarājanta sumaṇḍape ।।6 1 ।।
hanumānādayaściraṃjīvāḥ sākṣāttu maṇḍape ।
āvāhitā āyayuśca sarve vai brahmavarcasaḥ ।।62।।
varṇāstathā''śramā dharmā dharmarājo'nugā'nugaḥ ।
citraguptādisahitaḥ śrāvaṇādyaiḥ samāyutaḥ ।।63।।
kālaḥ samvatsarādyāśca yugā mūrtiyutāśca te ।
āvāhitā atiṣṭhanta maṇḍape sarvagocarāḥ ।।64।।
jalasthāśca sthalasthāśca jantavo'pi tṛṇādayaḥ ।
vallikāśca drumādyāśca kalpakandāśca mūlikā ।।65।।
stambādyāścāyayuścāvāhitāḥ sākṣāddhi maṇḍape ।
gṛhadevā grāmadevā vanadevāśca sīmagāḥ ।।66।।
āraṇyakāstathā devāḥ śākhātoraṇadevatāḥ ।
staṃbhadevā dvāradevāḥ kuṇḍadevāśca vai tadā ।।67।।
dehalīdevatāścāpi pālikādevatāstathā ।
prākāradevatāḥ sarve sarvā gopuradevatāḥ ।।68।।
prāṃgaṇadevatāḥ koṇadevatā bhāradevatāḥ ।
pāṭadevā dhvajadevā ghaṭadevāstadā makhe ।।69।।
daṇḍadevāḥ pīṭhadevāḥ svasvadevīsamanvitāḥ ।
āvāhitāstu te sākṣānmūrtimanto'bhavan sthitāḥ ।।2.205.70 ।।
dharmadevo'tha tatpatnyaḥ putrīputrasamanvitāḥ ।
mūrtimatyaḥ samāgatyā''vāhitāstatra cāyayuḥ ।।7 1।।
dānavā daityavargāśca kaśyapajāḥ prajādayaḥ ।
pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaścāpi jantavaśca sarīsṛpāḥ ।।72।।
sarpā nāgādayaḥ sarve āvāhitāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
mūrtimanto maṇḍape te nyaṣīdan vihitāsane ।।73।।
sarvadhāmanivāsāśca sarvalokanivāsinaḥ ।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsāścāvāhitāstatra maṇḍape ।।74।।
mūrtimanto hyatiṣṭhanta dattāsaneṣu cetanāḥ ।
jaḍāśca jaḍavargāśca dīnānāthāśca dehinaḥ ।।75।।
dattayogā maṇḍape te cāyayurdhanyavādinaḥ ।
kāśāśca kuśāśca patrāṇi śalākāḥ samidhastathā ।।76।।
havyānyapi ca kavyāni phalapuṣpakaṇādayaḥ ।
rasā dravyāṇi miṣṭāni miṣṭānnāni tvacastathā ।।77।।
gandhasārāṇi sarvāṇi samūrtāni tadā'dhvare ।
maṇḍape cāyayuścāvāhitāḥ sākṣāt sthitāśca te ।।78।।
kāmadhenugaṇāścāpi kalpavallyaśca mūrtayaḥ ।
kalpadrumāścāyayurvai cintāmaṇaya ityapi ।।79।।
mūrtimantaḥ kalpakośā akṣayapātrakoṭayaḥ ।
hetayaḥ śaṃkhacakrādyā makhānāṃ hetayastathā ।।2.205.80 ।।
sādhanāni samastāni pūjāṃgapātrakoṭayaḥ ।
āvāhitā mūrtimantaḥ sarve'tiṣṭhanta maṇḍape ।।8 1 ।।
mantrā vedāśca vidhayaḥ karmakāṇḍaprakārakāḥ ।
śuddhayo'pūrvadevāśca mūrtimantastu maṇḍape ।।82।।
āvāhitāścāyayuste'tiṣṭhanta vihitāsane ।
svarā vidyāḥ śāradādyā brahmavidyādikāstathā ।।83 ।।
gītayaḥ sāmasūktāni svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkulam ।
agnayaḥ sarvajātīyā ākāritāśca maṇḍape ।।84।।
mūrtimanto nyaṣīdan vai dattāsaneṣu te tadā ।
devadaityaguravaśca vyāsā vyākhyānamūrtayaḥ ।।85।।
tapāṃsi yogavidhayo jñānaṃ vairāgyamityapi ।
bhaktirvibhūtayaḥ sarvā ākāritāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।86।।
pratyakṣā yoṣitāṃ vargā atiṣṭhanta samūrtayaḥ ।
vighnā avighnarūpāste rogā arogarūpiṇaḥ ।।87।।
duḥkhānyadūḥkharūpāṇi ākāritāni cāyayuḥ ।
dharmavaṃśāstathā'dharmastatpatnyaścāpi vai tadā ।।88।।
tadvaṃśyāśca makhe te'pi saumyā bhūtvā samāyayuḥ ।
adharmo dharmarūpo'bhūttadā rūpaṃ vivartayan ।।89।।
ānandaśca sukhaṃ śāntistṛptiḥ santoṣakādayaḥ ।
āvāhitāścāyayuśca mūrtayo maṇḍape tadā ।। 2.205.90।।
śabdādyā viṣayāścāpi ṣaṭkośādyāśca dehagāḥ ।
samūrtāścāyayuḥ sarve ākāritāstu maṇḍape ।।91 ।।
rādhike maṇḍapaścaivaṃ sarvasṛṣṭisamanvitaḥ ।
śobhane'nādikṛṣṇasyopasthitau divyadhāmavat ।।92।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe śrīkṛṣṇavallabhe ।
sarvasvāmini yatrasthe tatra kiṃ pakṣapātanam ।।93 ।।
jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi jaḍacetanamiśrakāḥ ।
sarve vaṃśā hareḥ santi sarveṣu samavartinaḥ ।।94।।
rājasāstāmasāścāpi sāttvikā dehino'pi ca ।
santaścidaśca sarve vai ānandā mūrtiyoginaḥ ।।95।।
āvāhitāścāyayuste nyaṣīdan vai sumaṇḍape ।
dātā hotā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।96 ।।
tatra nyūnaṃ na vai cāsti saṃkoco'pi vikāsitaḥ ।
dāridryaṃ prāptamevodāratāṃ vivartitaṃ tadā।।97।।
nakāro'pi gatastatra hākāratāṃ vivartitaḥ ।
saṃśayo'pi gatastatra niścayatāṃ vivartitaḥ ।।98।।
bhayaṃ vivṛttaṃ sahasā'prāpannirbhayatāṃ tadā ।
nyūnatveṃ vivṛtaṃ cāpyadhikatāṃ tu samāsadat ।।99।।
ityevaṃ rādhike tatra maṇḍape devatādikāḥ ।
mūrtimantaḥ samāgatya niṣeduḥ sthāpane nije ।। 2.205.10 0।।
ya evā'dṛśyarūpaiśca grahītārasta eva ha ।
sākṣādupasthitāstatra bālakṛṣṇecchayā'khilāḥ ।। 10 1।।
ityevaṃ sarvadevānāṃ daśakuṇḍeṣu maṇḍape ।
yathāpekṣamabhūd rādhe! sthāpanā vedikādiṣu ।। 1 02।।
sarve nṛpāstathā'kurvan karma yajñīyameva tat ।
tataḥ pūjā pravṛttā ca tattadṛṣipraṇoditā ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne rājñāmṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍape samāgamanaṃ devapīṭhānāṃ sthāpanā, ṛtvigācāryādivaraṇaṃ, pratyakṣadevānāṃ virājamānatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 205 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 205 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 206
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 207 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike maṇḍape kṛṣṇaḥ sauvarṇau pitarau tathā ।
sūryaṃ candraṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca satīṃ gaṃgāṃ vyatiṣṭhipat ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaṃ lomaśoktavidhānataḥ ।
rāyakinnararājaḥ saṃpūjayat parameśvaram ।। 2 ।।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ cāpi harestatrā'pyapūjayat ।
āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ dadau tadā ।। 3 ।।
dadāvācamanaṃ vāri śaucārthaṃ vāri cetyapi ।
śuddhyarthaṃ ca tato dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ ca śarkarām ।। 4 ।।
madhu dadau tataścābhiṣekārthaṃ tīrthavāri ca ।
vastrā''mārjanamevāpi sugandhitailamardanam ।। 59 ।।
vastrābhūṣāpradānaṃ candanākṣatagulālakam ।
puṣpahārān kajjalādi dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca kuṃkumam ।। 6 ।।
tulasīṃ padmahārāँśca naivedyaṃ copavītakam ।
chatraṃ cāmaravyajane naivedyaṃ phalamuttamam ।। 7 ।।
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cārārtrikaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।
stutiṃ kṣamāṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat kusumāñjalim ।। 8 ।।
dadau pūjāprakāraiśca samarcya śrīnarāyaṇam ।
tato'vatārān muktāँśceśvarān devān munīn surān ।। 9 ।।
pitṝn devīrdevatāśca pūjayāmāsa pārthivaḥ ।
cakāra ca tataḥ prāyaścittāṃgaṃ vyāhṛterhavam ।। 1 0।।
viṣṇuśrāddhaṃ cakārā'tha cakre mukhāvalokanam ।
ājyapātrasya dānaṃ cācāryāya pradadau nṛpaḥ ।। 11 ।।
śuśrāva śāntipāṭhāṃśca viprakṛtān sukhāvahān ।
svastipāṭhān māṃgalikān śrutvā vavanda vai gurum ।। 12।।
lomaśarṣistataścakre pradhānaṃ makhakarmaṇaḥ ।
saṃkalpaṃ cāṃgasaṃkalpaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam ।। 13 ।।
bhūmikūrmā'nantapūjāṃ dīpasthānaṃ nṛpo vyadhāt ।
cakre digrakṣaṇaṃ vāme kare tvādāya sarṣapān ।। 14।।
vikīrya sarvatobhāge'ghātayadvāmapāṇinā ।
bhūmiṃ cātha tataścakre kalaśārādhanaṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 15।।
jale tīrthāni cāvāhya dehe sve prokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।
pañcagavyena yajñasya saṃbhāraprokṣaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।। 16।।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakre sākṣād dūrvādibhistathā ।
ṣoḍaśabhistūpacārairathā''varaṇapūjanam ।। 17।।
cakre tataśca gauryādimātṛkāpūjanaṃ vyadhāt ।
brāhmyādimātṛkāpūjā kṛtvā rājā tato'karot ।। 18।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam ।
athā'rghavandanaṃ cakre kalaśe sūtraveṣṭanam ।। 1 9।।
oṣadhipuṣpaniḥkṣepaṃ pañcapallavaratnakam ।
cikṣepa ca phalaṃ svarṇaṃ mṛttikāṃ dhānyadūrvikām ।। 20।।
tataścācāryavaraṇaṃ brahmādivaraṇaṃ punaḥ ।
gaṇeśavaraṇaṃ dvārapālavaraṇamācarat ।।2 1 ।।
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre madhuparkārhaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।
madhuparkaprāśanaṃ ca vyadhādācamanaṃ tataḥ ।।।22।।
goniṣkrayaṃ dhanaṃ rājā dadau viprāya vai tadā ।
prārthayacca guruṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ ca lomaśam ।।23 ।।
bhūbhṛtastilakaṃ cakre- lomaśarṣistadā tataḥ
rājñyā babandha ca vāme kare rakṣārthasūtrakam ।। 24।।
kaṃkaṇaṃ vā tataścāpi puṇyāhavācanaṃ vyadhāt ।
sajalaṃ kalaśaṃ pūrṇapātrayuktaṃ tu dhānyake ।। 25 ।।
nyadhāt। pupūja kalaśaṃ tajjalaistarpaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।
yajamānā'bhiṣekaṃ ca lomaśaḥ samavartayat ।। 26।।
vardhanīkalaśasyāpi sthāpanaṃ pracakāra ha ।
rājā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṇḍape taṃ nyaveśayat ।। 27।।
jalayātrāṃ lomaśaścā'kārayat kalaśānvitām ।
saubhāgyābhiśca nārībhirvādyayānasukīrtanaiḥ ।।।28।।
tīrthe sampūjya varuṇaṃ gaṇeśaṃ jalamātaram ।
jalaṃ pupūja ca jīvamātaraṃ sthalamātaram ।। 29।।
matsyī kūrmī ca vārāhī dardurī makarī tathā ।
jalūkī cāpi tantūkī tṛpyantāṃ jalamātaraḥ ।। 2.206.30 ।।
kumārī dhanadā nandā vimalā maṃgalā calā ।
padmā ceti pratṛpyantāṃ saptaitā jīvamātṛkāḥ ।। 31 ।।
urmīrlakṣmīrmahāmāyā pānadevī ca vāruṇī ।
nirmalā ca tathā godhā tṛpyantāṃ sthalamātaraḥ ।।3 2।।
tato'rcayaccatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīcakramityapi ।
kṣetrapālaṃ tīrthagaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ samapūjayat ।।3 3 ।।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ cakre kṣetrapālaprapūjanam ।
tato maṇḍapamāgatya kalaśena samanvitaḥ ।।34।।
rājā ca dvāraśākhādhiṣṭhātṛdevānapūjayat ।
dehalīṃ māḍalaśobhāṃ kṛtvā vāstuṃ praṇamya ca ।।35।।
vāstusthāpanamevāpi lomaṣarṣistadā'karot ।
vāstupīṭhaṃ vidhāyā'pi gaṇeśaṃ samapūjayat ।।36 ।।
vāstudevān catuḥṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākān lomaśo muniḥ ।
āvāhya ca samabhyarcya kalaśaṃ samapūjayat ।। 37।।
kalaśe vāstumūrtiṃ cā'pūjayat ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ ।
bahirhomaṃ vidhāyā'tha baliṃ tasmai dadāvṛṣiḥ ।।38।।
maṇḍapasya tataḥ pūjāṃ stambhapūjāṃ samācarat ।
sarvakoṇastambhadevān madhyadevānapūjayat ।।3 9।।
dvāratoraṇadevāँścā'pūjayannṛpatistataḥ ।
vedapūjāṃ cihnapūjāṃ śākhāpūjāmathā'karot ।।2.206.40।।
kalaśe śākhino devānapūjayadvidhānataḥ ।
bhūtādibhyo māṣabalimārpayat sannyavartayat ।।41 ।।
sarvatobhadrakaṃ ramyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ devatāyutam ।
apūjayat trayastriṃśaddevatāstatra maṇḍale ।।42।।
madhye'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tamavatāriṇam ।
sarvapatnīyutaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaṃ śrīmannarāyaṇam ।।43।।
avatārān śaktiyuktānīśvarānapyapūjayat ।
īśvarāṇīstathā sarvā anyaśaktīrapūjayat ।।44।।
muktān muktānikāścāpi dhāmā'kṣaraṃ hyapūjayat ।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāyuktaṃ gopagopīgaṇānvitam ।।45।।
apūjayattadā dāsīpatnīpriyāsamanvitam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pārṣadairgaruḍena ca ।।46।।
ramābhiśca pārṣadānībhiśca pupūja bhūpatiḥ ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakre vāstudevaprapūjanam ।।47।।
īśvarāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca cakāra bhūpatistataḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā somamīśānamindramityapi ।।48।।
agniṃ vaivasvataṃ rakṣo varuṇaṃ samapūjayat ।
vāyuṃ kuberaṃ ca vasūn rudrānekādaśāpi ca ।।49।।
ādityān dvādaśa caivā''śvinau tatrā'pyapūjayat ।
pitṝँśca viśvadevāँśca saptayajñānapūjayat ।।2.206.50 ।।
sarpān gandharvakānapsarasaḥ skandamapūjayat ।
nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ śūlaṃ dakṣādisaptakam ।।51।।
apūjayattathā durgāṃ viṣṇuṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā ।
svadhāṃ svāhāṃ mṛtyurogau gaṇeśaṃ samapūjayat ।।।52।।
varuṇaṃ ca makheśaṃ ca marutaḥ samapūjayat ।
pṛthivīṃ ca nadīṃ gaṃgāṃ saritaścā'pyapūjayat ।।53 ।।
sāgarān sapta meruṃ ca pārthivaḥ samapūjayat। ।
āyudhāni samastāni tīrthāni samapūjayat ।।54।।
vibhūṣaṇāni divyāni mūrtimanti hyapūjayat ।
bhāradvājādikān maharṣivaryānapyapūjayat ।।55।।
arundhatīṃ tathā cānyā devīstatrā'pyapūjayat ।
sarvadikpālapatnīśca rājā samyagapūjayat ।।56।।
īśvarān sarvapitṝँśca munīn devānṛṣīṃstathā ।
sādhūn sādhvīḥ sāṃkhyayoginīśca sarvā hyapūjayat ।।57।।
-bhuvarlokanivāsāँśca kuṣmāṇḍakān vināyakān ।
vetālān rākṣasāँścāpi pretān sarvānapūjayat ।।58।।
yamadūtān dharmavaṃśyān adharmavaṃśajānapi ।
nārīrnarān nṛpatiḥ saḥ sarvāṃstatra hyapūjayat ।।59।।
parvatān vanavṛkṣāँśca vallīśca tṛṇajātikān ।
stabakān vaṃśajātīyān rasadānapyapūjayat ।।2.206.60 ।।
mūlakandān phalivṛkṣān jarāyūjāṃstathā'ṇḍajān ।
jantūn sūkṣmān viśālāँśca yādovāsānapūjayat ।।6 1 ।।
svedajān kāśyapīḥ sarvāḥ prajāścāpyatyapūjayat ।
sthalajān vāyujāँścāpi vahnijān khātajānapi ।।6 2।।
pārthivān dehino vārijātān sarvānapūjayat ।
sāttvikān malinān rājasāँśca tāmasadehinaḥ ।।63 ।।
apūjayattadā dīnānāthān bhikṣukānapi ।
anāśritān parādhīnān parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ ।।64।।
bhṛtyavargān dūravargān dāsavargānapūjayat ।
kalājñān śilpavetṝँśca nāṭyanartanakārakān ।।65।।
sūtamāgadhabandyādīn kathākārānapūjayat ।
jaḍān tattvaviśeṣāṃśca guṇān svarānapūrvakān ।।66।।
mantrān sarvān viṣayāँśca bhūpatiḥ samapūjayat। ।
gītikā vedamūrtīśca yajñapātrāṇi satkaṇān ।।67।।
sasyāni samidhaḥ sarvān havyānyapi tvapūjayat ।
yāni yāni tadā yajñamaṇḍape hariṇā svayam ।।68।।
āmantritāni bhūtāni cāgatāni samutsave ।
api nikṛṣṭanāmāni nikṛṣṭadehavantyapi ।।69।।
pareśvaro nijāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ nijāpatyasvarūpiṇīm ।
sarvāṃ śrīvaiṣṇave naije yajñe hyapūjayattadā ।।2.206.70।।
pātālasthān daityagaṇān dānavān nāgavigrahān ।
dhāmalokanivāsāँśca maṇḍape vai samāgatān ।।71 ।।
sarvānapūjayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sukhapradaḥ ।
api kīṭapataṃgādyān pūjayitvā hariḥ svayam ।।72।।
sarvebhyo'rpya baliṃ cātarpayadvai nijake'dhvare ।
saṃkarṣaṇādikāँścāpi sanakādyāँśca yoginaḥ ।।73।।
viśvaksenādikān sarvān pārṣadān yantradevatāḥ ।
śukādīn jñānayogāँśca matsyādīn keśavānapi ।।74।।
praṇavādīn śāradāँśca'vatārān ṛṣabhādikān ।
viśvāmitrādikān sarvānapūjayattadā nṛpaḥ ।।75।।
brāhmyādikāḥ śaktirūpā aṇimāsiddhikāstathā ।
dikpālān cāyudhānyeva vedān gaṃgādikāstathā ।।76।।
mantradevān kuṭumbāḍhyān pūjayattadā nṛpaḥ ।
tato'gnyuttāraṇa cakre mūrtānāṃ ghṛtalepanam ।।77।।
jaladhārābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā prāṇān sa bījakān ।
iha prāṇāśca āṃ hrīṃ krauṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃham ।।78।।
saḥso'hamiti mantrādyairnyāsairbījairayojayat ।
evaṃ sauvarṇamūrtīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ tatra maṇḍape ।।79।।
sthāpitānāṃ hariścāpi pūjāṃ cakāra vai punaḥ ।
nijāṃ nijapituścāpi nijamātustathā svasuḥ ।।2.206.80।।
bhrātṝṇāṃ ca gaṇeśasya rādhākṛṣṇasya vai tathā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāpi padmāyāśca tathā śubhām ।।8 1।।
ramāyāśca tathā māṇikyāyāstathā ca kānakīm ।
sūryasyāpi ca candrasyeśānasyāpi ca kānakīm ।।।82।।।
satyāśca kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ pratiṣṭhārthamapūjayat ।
ṣoḍaśaprāṇavāsārthaṃ mūrtīḥ sarvā apūjayat ।।83।।
brahmasṛṣṭimīśasṛṣṭiṃ jīvasṛṣṭimatho'smarat ।
tatrāvatāramūrtīnāṃ tadā kṛṣṇaḥ smṛtiṃ vyadhāt ।।84।।
sarvāvatārāścāgatya maṇḍape pratimādiṣu ।
atiṣṭhanta hi divyāste sarvatattvamayāḥ surāḥ ।।85।।
evaṃ vai vidhinā mūrtīḥ pratiṣṭhāpya sajīvikāḥ ।
cetanāstā vidhāyaiva prāviśad bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।86।।
tataścakre pīṭhapūjāṃ rājā kṛṣṇānumoditaḥ ।
paradevatāpūjāṃ ca guroḥ pūjāṃ cakāra saḥ ।।87।।
vedavyāsaṃ ca garuḍaṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīṃ tathā ।
yamaṃ vāyuṃ śivaṃ cendraṃ nirṛtiṃ rudramārcayat ।।88।।
śaktiṃ kūrmamanantaṃ ca pṛthvīmadrimapūjayat ।
kṣīrābdhiṃ śvetadvīpaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ padmamārcayat ।।89।।
sūryamaṇḍalamevā'pi hiraṇmayaṃ narāyaṇam ।
somamaṇḍalamevāpi viṣṇuṃ divyaṃ narāyaṇam ।।2.206.90 ।।
hutāśane'gnidevaṃ ca nṛsiṃhaṃ ca narāyaṇam ।
sattvaśriyaṃ rajobhūmiṃ tamodurgāmapūjayat ।। 91 ।।
ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ parātmānamapūjayat ।
jñānātmānaṃ vimalādyāḥ pīṭhaśaktīrapūjayat ।।92।।
pradhānapuruṣaṃ prakṛtipūruṣamapūjayat ।
kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ cāpi viśvakarmaprapūjanam ।। 93।।
mekhalādevatā viṣṇubrahmarudrānapūjayat ।
yonipūjāṃ kaṇṭhapūjāṃ nābhipūjāmathā'karot ।।94।।
vāstudevāँstathā brahmādīn vedān kacchapādikān ।
apūjayattadā rājā rāyakinnarasaṃjñakaḥ ।।95।।
dharmādikān pūjayitvā cakre'gnisthāpanaṃ tataḥ ।
sampuṭe'gniṃ samāhṛtya bhrāmayitvā trireva tam ।।96 ।।
agnimasthāpayat kuṇḍe dakṣe svāhāṃ svadhāṃ pare ।
samārcayacca vidhinā praṇītānayanaṃ tataḥ ।।97।।
paristaraṇamevā'pi pātrāsādanamityapi ।
pavitrīkaraṇaṃ cāpi tathā vāryabhiṣecanam ।।98।।
uttānaṃ coddiganaṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā ।
sekaścarvadhiśrayaṇaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ tathā ।।99।।
cakāra lomaśo devo grahasthāpanamācarat ।
navagrahānārcayaccā'dhidevānārcayattathā ।। 2.206.100 ।।
pratyadhidevatārhāṃ ca lokapālārhaṇāṃ tataḥ ।
kṣetrapālasthāpanaṃ ca dikpālasthāpanaṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
mahārudrasthāpanaṃ ca teṣāṃ pūjanamācarat ।
catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ pūjanaṃ cākarottataḥ ।। 1 02।।
pañcāśatkṣetrapālānāṃ pūjanaṃ ca tato'karot ।
parameśaṃ cāvatārānīśvarān devatāstathā ।। 103 ।।
dadhyau rājā tu tilakaṃ hyakārayaddharestadā ।
tulasīmālikāṃ cāpi dadau mālāṃ dadau tataḥ ।। 1 04।।
śaṃkhaṃ cakrādikaṃ datvā'pūjayannṛpatiśca vai ।
matsyacihnaṃ triśūlaṃ ca dhanuṣaṃ bāṇamityapi ।। 1 05।।
svastikaṃ ca dhvajaṃ cakraṃ vajraṃ cāpūjayattataḥ ।
ghaṇṭāpūjāmācaracca kalaśārhāṃ samācarat ।। 1 06।।
bhūśuddhiṃ lomaśastaṃ cākārayad vai namastathā ।
āsanaṃ ca śikhāyā bandhanaṃ digbandhanaṃ tathā ।। 1 07।।
tālatrayaṃ tathā bhūmitāḍanaṃ triḥ samācarat ।
bhūtaśuddhiṃ prācaracca kuṇḍalinīmapūjayat ।। 1 08।।
ṣaṭcakrāṇi pūjayitvā jīvaṃ brahmā'pyapūjayat ।
pāpapuruṣadāhaṃ ca dhyātvā rājā'karottadā ।। 1 09।।
śarīrā''plavanaṃ cakre tathā''tmaśodhanaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ sanyāsāṃ bījākṣarayutāṃ tathā ।। 2.206.110 ।।
pāṭhaśaktisahitāṃ ca kṛtvā pūjanamācarat ।
pañcāvaraṇadevārhāṃ prāṇasthāpanamityapi ।। 111 ।।
athā'ntarmātṛkānyāsān bahirmātṛkanyāsanam ।
ekādaśa tathā nyāsān śrīhareśca samācarat ।। 11 2।।
pātrāsādanamevāpi dīpadānamathācarat ।
kalārhaṇāṃ tathā'rghaṃ ca kṛtvā datvā viśeṣataḥ ।। 113 ।।
pādyā'rghyācamanaprokṣaṇīmadhuparkapātrakam ।
vidhinā'pūjayad rājā rādhike maṇḍape makhe ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sauvarṇīmūrtipūjā gaṇeśapūjā kalaśasthāpanaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vāstusthāpanaṃ sarveśvareśvaradevādipūjā kuṇḍamaṇḍapaśākhādidevadevīyoginīkṣetrapālātmādipūjā dehaśuddhyādibrahmapūjā'gnisthāpanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 206 ।।
