adhyāyaḥ 207
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 208 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrīpatiṃ rādhike rājā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
apūjayanmahāmahopacāraiḥ sakuṭumbakam ।। 1 ।।
dhyānamāvāhanaṃ samyagāsanaṃ pādyamarghyakam ।
ācamanaṃ madhuparkaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu ।। 2 ।।
śarkarāṃ pradadau tasmai cābhyaṃgaṃ nirmalodakam ।
abhiṣekaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ vastrāmārjanamādadau ।। 3 ।।
vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ cā'laṃkārān mālikāṃ dadau ।
gandhasāraṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca kajjalaṃ cākṣatān dadau ।। 4 ।।
puṣpamañjarikāścāpi tulasīpatramādadau ।
aṃgapūjāṃ kṛtavāँścā'varaṇānā prapūjanam ।। 5 ।।
śrīharestatsevikānāṃ vyūhānāṃ ca prapūjanam ।
pārṣadānāmavatāramūrtīnāṃ ca prapūjanam ।। 6 ।।
tathā'vatāriṇīnāṃ pūjanaṃ pārṣadapūjanam ।
hetīnāṃ ca tadaiśvaryavibhūtīnāṃ prapūjanam ।। 7 ।।
vāhanānāṃ tathā bhṛtyadāsānāṃ ca prapūjanam ।
dāsīnāṃ putrapautrāṇāṃ kuṭumbānāṃ prapūjanam ।। 8 ।।
gṛhapālārhaṇaṃ dvārapālārhaṇaṃ cakāra ha ।
śvetacūrṇaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ sindūrakaṃ haridrikām ।। 9 ।।
dhūpaṃ dīpamalaktaṃ ca naivedyaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam ।
apośanaṃ karodvarttaṃ tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। 2.207.1 0।।
chatraṃ cāmarakaṃ cāpi vyajanaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadau ।
pāduke sarvaśṛṃgāraṃ dadau nīrājanaṃ tataḥ ।। 11 ।।
vastranīrājanaṃ vārinīrājanaṃ namaḥkriyām ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau ।। 12।।
atha homaṃ tato vahnau cakāra nṛpatiḥ svayam ।
ādāvadhiśrite caroḥ sruvasya tapanaṃ vyadhāt ।। 13।।
mārjanaṃ cā'bhyukṣaṇaṃ ca tapanaṃ ca nidhānakam ।
ājyodvāsanamevā'pi carorudvāsanaṃ tathā ।। 14।।
pavitrābhyāṃ tata ājyotpavanaṃ cāpyavekṣaṇam ।
apadravyanirāsaṃ ca prokṣiṇyutpavanaṃ tathā ।। 15।।
paryukṣaṇaṃ nidhānaṃ ca kṛtvā homaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।
āghārāvājyabhāgau ca brahmā home dadau tadā ।। 16।।
samiccarutilājyādihavirdravyāṇi sandadau ।
pareśāya maheśāya prajānāṃ pataye tathā ।। 17।।
dikpālebhyastatheśebhyo lokapālebhya ityapi ।
navagrahebhyo devebhyaḥ pratyadhidevakoṭaye ।। 18।।
adhidevebhya evāpi homaṃ dadau nṛpastadā ।
vāstumaṇḍaladevebhyo homaṃ dadau tataḥ param ।। 19।।
samittilān pāyasādīnudumbarasamidvarāḥ ।
aśvatthādīn ghṛtamadhukṣīrāṇi pradadau tadā ।।2.207.20।।
tathāmaṇḍaladevānāṃ homaṃ dadau yathocitam ।
phalairbhinnairvibhinnaiśca dravyairhomaṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।।21 ।।
brahmādidevatābhyaśca homaṃ dadau ghṛtādibhiḥ ।
pīṭhadevatābhyaścāpi homaṃ dadau ghṛtādibhiḥ ।।22।।
tataḥ samittilājyaiśca caruṇā pāyasena vai ।
homaṃ pradhānaṃ pradadau sahasrā'yutameva ca ।। 23।।
āvaraṇasurebhyaśca homaṃ dadau tato nṛpaḥ ।
drākṣekṣupūganāriṃgaistilājyairvyāhṛterhavam ।।24।।
dadau ca jambiraṃ bījapūrakaṃ khārikāṃ tathā ।
nārikelaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca guggulaṃ sarṣapādikān ।।25।।
lakṣmyai dadau tato dugdhaṃ śarkarākadalīghṛtam ।
phaladūrvā'kṣatāँścāpi homaṃ cakre nṛpaḥ svayam ।। 26।।
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ ca dadau tataḥ ।
brahmā dadau tataḥ sviṣṭakṛddhomaṃ ca navāhutīn ।। 27।।
sarvebhyaśca surebhyaśca balidānaṃ yathocitam ।
dikpālebhyo dīpayuktaṃ pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ dadau ।।28।।
gaṇeśāya ca mātṛbhyo vāstudevebhya eva ca ।
vāstupuṃse tathā''dityādibhyo baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।।29।।
yoginībhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyaśca baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।
maṇḍalasya pradhānasya devebhyo'pi baliṃ dadau ।।2.207.30।।
ṣaṭapaṃcāśaddevatābhyo baliṃ dadau sapūjanam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇarādhākṛṣṇābhyāṃ ca baliṃ dadau ।।3 1 ।।
naranārāyaṇavāsudevanārāyaṇāya ca ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svabaliṃ dadau ।।32।।
sarvābhyaśca hareḥ śaktibhyaśca baliṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।
brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhyo baliṃ rājā dadau tataḥ ।।33।।
dhāmapālabaliṃ cāpi dārapālabaliṃ tathā ।
sṛṣṭipālabaliṃ cāpi kṣetrapālabaliṃ dadau ।।34।।
nagaragrāmakṣetrādisthitebhyo'pi baliṃ dadau ।
gṛhāraṇyavanasthebhyo baliṃ rājā dadau tataḥ ।।35।।
pātālādisthitebhyaśca bhūmisvarvāsine tathā ।
bhuvarlokasthitebhya satyāntebhyo baliṃ dadau ।।36।।
āvaraṇasthitebhyaśca vairājalokavāsine ।
hiraṇmayā'vyākṛtagolokavāsebhya ādadau ।।37।।
vaikuṇṭhā'kṣaradhāmasthamāyāsthebhyo baliṃ dadau ।
cetanebhyo jaḍebhyaśca dehyadehibhya ityapi ।।38।।
baliṃ dadau tadā rājā tattvebhyaśca yathocitam ।
śreṣṭhebhyaśca kaniṣṭhebhyo dadau baliṃ yathocitam ।।39।।
āmantritebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sthitebhyo maṇḍape tadā ।
naranārīsametebhyo baliṃ rājā dadau śubham ।।2.207.40।।
āmantritā ye cāgatā anāgatāstathā'dhvare ।
sakuṭumbāḥ sabhṛtyāśca sadāsāḥ sānugāstathā ।।41 ।।
sapatnīkāḥ savaṃśāśca sattvarajastamonvitāḥ ।
triguṇebhyaśca ye jātāḥ sādhyāḥ sādhanarūpiṇaḥ ।।42।।
yajñātmakā yajñadehā yajñāṃgāni makhāśritāḥ ।
sarvebhyastatra rājā'sau baliṃ yathocitaṃ dadau ।।43।।
sarvakuṇḍeṣu rājānastattadgurvarṣinoditāḥ ।
dadurbaliṃ tathaivaite sarvaṃ karma vyadhustathā ।।44।।
grāhakā bhojakāścāpi ye cā''hutyadanāḥ surāḥ ।
asurā vā mūrtimanto jagṛhuḥ svabaliṃ kare ।।45।।
pratyakṣaṃ te bhuktavantaḥ pratyakṣāḥ svakṣaṇe'nale ।
sarve vai dehinastatra bhuñjānāstṛptimāyayuḥ ।।।46।।
yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ yadannaṃ tat tatra tatra yathocitam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ saṃkalpya vai dadau ।।47।।
ākaṇṭhatṛptāḥ sarve te sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ।
māyā tattvāni māyotthā māyikā dehinastathā ।।48।।
ātmā tattvāni cātmotthā ātmīyā dehinastathā ।
īśastattvāni ceśotthā īśīyā dehinastathā ।।49।।
muktāstattvāni muktotthā muktīyā dehinastathā ।
brahmatattvāni brahmotthā brahmīyā dehinastathā ।।2.207.50 ।।
śaktistattvāni śaktyutthāḥ śaktīyā dehinastathā ।
guṇauśvaryāyudhabhūṣādikā ye kecanāpi ca ।।।51।।
sarvebhyaḥ śrīharistatra baliṃ datvā hyatarpayat ।
tṛptiṃ vai śāśvatīṃ naijāṃ dadau sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।।52।।
sarve codgāramāpannā ākaṇṭhabhakṣaṇāstathā ।
bahutṛptiṃ gatāstatra parameśamakhe janāḥ ।।53।।
jarāyūjāścāṇḍajāścodbhijjāḥ svedajanāstathā ।
bhautikāḥ kośajāścāpi kardamotthā rasotthitāḥ ।।54।।
sarve tṛptiṃ gatāstatra bālakṛṣṇamakhe'nale ।
athā'ntimāhutiṃ prādāllomaśastatra kuṇḍake ।।55।।
vasordhārāyutaṃ bahvāhutihomaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
parihāraṃ tataścakre devānāṃ śayanaṃ vyadhāt ।।56 ।।
evaṃ nityaṃ bhavatyeva rādhike'rhā havādikam ।
āmadhyāntaṃ tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇādayaśca te ।।57।।
cakrire bhojanānyeva mahīmānādayastathā ।
sarvaprajā bhojanāni cakrire nityameva ha ।।5 8।।
saptamyāṃ cāpi cāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ daśamīdine ।
ekādaśyāṃ makhakāryaṃ nityaṃ pravartate tathā ।।59।।
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi nityaṃ bhavanti tatra ca ।
asaṃkhyadehinastatra bhuṃjate sma divāniśam ।।2.207.6 0 ।।
dīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti ।
ghoṣaṇā tvannadānasya satataṃ vai pravartate ।।6 1 ।।
annapūrṇā tathā lakṣmīstaddāsyo'nekaśaktayaḥ ।
sevante tvannadānādyairyathālokamapekṣitaiḥ ।।62।।
kalpalatāḥ kalpadrumāḥ kalpagāvo nirantaram ।
kalpakanyāstathā cintāmaṇayaḥ kalpacullikāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
kalpahradāḥ kalpapātrāṇyapi kalpanadādayaḥ ।
kalpapeṭāḥ pūrayanti ceṣṭabhojyāni cārthiṣu ।।64।।
bhojanānte janāḥ sarve viśrāmyanti viśeṣataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhūbhṛdarthitaḥ ।।65 ।।
āmantraṇānusāreṇa prayāti rājamandiram ।
punaḥ sāyaṃ maṇḍape'tra samāyāti vimānataḥ ।।66।।
evaṃ pañcadinaṃ rāṣṭre bhramaṇaṃ hariṇā kṛtam ।
pāvitāni samastāni rāṣṭrāṇi gamanakramāt ।।67।।
makhe dadāti bhagavān dakṣiṇāḥ koṭiśastathā ।
makhād bahiścārpayati yatheṣṭaṃ tvarthine'pi saḥ ।।68।।
deyaṃ deyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śabdastvevaṃ hi sārthakaḥ ।
hareragre jāyate vai sarvayajñaphalapradaḥ ।।69।।
yatheṣṭaṃ dīyate nityaṃ rājāno'pi dadatyapi ।
prajāścāvasaraṃ prāpya dadatyapi dhanānyapi ।।2.207.70।।
gṛhadānāni ca kanyādānāni bahudhā vyadhuḥ ।
vidyābhūṣāmbaradānānyapi vyadhuḥ prajājanāḥ ।।71 ।।
yatra svāmī parabrahma śrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
kartā dātā ca bhoktā ca tatrā'śubhaṃ na vai kvacit ।।72।।
vighnaṃ nāsti niṣedhaśca nāsti yatra prabhāpatiḥ ।
kālo nāsti yamo nāsti bandho nāsti pareśvare ।।73।।
sūtakaṃ na ca śoko na na vā'paśakunānyapi ।
kumuhūrtaṃ ca naivāsti yatra śrīpārvatīśvaraḥ ।।74।।
sarvaṃ śubhaṃ bhavatyeva yatra lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
sarvaṃ puṣṭaṃ bhavatyeva yatra śrīmāṇikīpatiḥ ।।75।।
sarvaṃ daivaṃ bhavatyevā'nukūlaṃ priyamityapi ।
sarvaṃ sampatpradaṃ cāste yatra devaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।76।।
sarvaṃ tu maṃgalaṃ tatra jāyate yatra mādhavaḥ ।
viruddhā yadvaśe santi ko virodho'sya sannidhau ।।77।।
rādhike śrīhariścaivaṃ makhotsavaṃ vyadhācchubham ।
saptamyāmatha madhyāhnottaraṃ bhuktyuttaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।।78।।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca prārthayatparameśvaram ।
nijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pāvayituṃ samāyāhīti vai tataḥ ।।79।।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stveva sajjastūrṇaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
ālāyasarṣimunirāṭ raṇajinnṛpatistathā ।।2.207.80 ।।
śīghramājñāṃ hareḥ prāpya vimānena nijālayam ।
ālākṣākapradeśasthaṃ mīnārkakṛṣṇapattanam ।।8 1।।
yūkāsanānadītīragataṃ gatvā'gratastadā ।
śīghraṃ sainyādisahitaṃ vādyamaṇḍalatatparam ।।।82।।
janatāpūrarājaccā'śṛṃgārayad yathocitam ।
svāgatārthaṃ sopadāśca janatā rājasevikāḥ ।।83।।
śīghraṃ śīghraṃ copatasthurnṛpodyāne mahāyate ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta dhvajā dhṛtāstathā'mbare ।।84।।
tūpaśabdāḥ prābhavaँśca śrīhareḥ svāgatāya vai ।
ghaṭikāyāṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṃgāritaṃ nṛpeṇa ha ।।85।।
tāvacchrīkāntabhagavān pitṛbhyāṃ śaṃkareṇa ca।
lomaśena tatheśaiścāvatāraiśca sureśvaraiḥ ।।86।।
yathāpekṣaiḥ saha śīghraṃ rādhālakṣmyādibhistathā ।
naijaṃ vimānamāruhya prakāśayan diśo daśa ।।87।।
yayau yūkāsanātīre mīnārkakṛṣṇapattanam ।
dṛṣṭvā śrīmatsūryatulyaṃ vimānaṃ pārameśvaram ।।88।।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca ālāyasarṣisattamaḥ ।
vimānāvataraṇārthaṃ dadatuḥ sthalasūcanām ।।89।।
bhramitvā'mbaramevaitad vimānaṃ tadavātarat ।
tadā vādyāni tūryāṇi cāvādyanta muhurmuhuḥ ।। 2.207.90 ।।
jayaśabdā harṣanādāḥ prajānāmabhavan śubhāḥ ।
dudruvuścātivegena darśanārthaṃ samīpagāḥ ।।9 1।।
prajājanā vardhayanti lājākṣatasugandhakaiḥ ।
kusumaiścā'ñjalibhiśca netravṛttyarpaṇaistathā ।।92।।
bhāvadānaiḥ svāgatādyairvardhayāmāsuracyutam ।
rādhike bhūbhṛtā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānataḥ. ।।93।।
haste hastaṃ gṛhītvaivānīto'tibhāvato bahiḥ ।
rājā puṣpasrajaṃ kaṇṭhe bālakṛṣṇasya vai dadau ।।94।।
ṛṣiścandanadānenā'pūjayat parameśvaram ।
rājaputrādayo'pyenaṃ samānarcuḥ sumādibhiḥ ।।95।।
vimānāgre kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā datvā naijaṃ ca darśanam ।
avatīrya hariḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha janatākṛtām ।।96।।
sarvāḥ prajāḥ sukhaṃ prāptāḥ pūjayā darśanena ca ।
tato nṛpālayāntarvai praviveśa śubhāsane ।।97।।
niṣasāda hariścānye niṣeduryogyakāsane ।
rājā rājñī rājaputryaḥ kumārāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।।98।।
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ।
daśalakṣaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dadau rājā'tibhāvataḥ ।।99।।
koṭimūlyān hīrakāँśca dadau kṛṣṇāya bhūpatiḥ ।
kanyakā viṃśatiḥ kṛṣṇagale nyadhurhi mālikāḥ ।। 2.207.1 00।।
rājñī dadau tadā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇāya tāḥ sutāḥ ।
viṃśatiḥ kanyakā prāpya bālakṛṣṇaṃ pati prabhum ।। 101 ।।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca harirdugdhaṃ papau tadā ।
tato mīnārkakṛṣṇākhye pattane śvetahastinā ।। 1 02।।
vijahāra mahāsainyasammānito gṛhe gṛhe ।
pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaḥ sarve samānarcuḥ sthale sthale ।। 103 ।।
bhramitvā nagarīṃ ramyāṃ nṛpasaudhaṃ samāyayau ।
rādhike śrīhariḥ śāntiṃ cālambyopādideśa ha ।। 104।।
prajājanāँstathā bhūpaṃ pāramārthikamuttamam।
ubhayatra mahānandapradaṃ pumarthasādhakam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyetretāsantāne śrīhareḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjanaṃ vahnāvāhutipradānaṃ sṛṣṭitrayadehibhyāahutipradānaṃ savebhya āhutipradānaṃ, parihāraḥ, bhojanaṃ, tato rāyaraṇajidrāṣṭraṃ pratigamanam, nagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ
pūjanaṃ kanyakārpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 207 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 207 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 208
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 209 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo'tihetubhiḥ ।
upadeśaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ kathayāmi nibodha me ।। 1 ।।
mayā sṛṣṭaṃ hariḥ prāha jagat sarvaṃ hi gatvaram ।
na sthiraṃ jāyate tattvaṃ dīrghakāle'pi naśyati ।। 2 ।।
avināśī mahānātmā saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ ।
nijānandamayo dehe karmānugaphalādanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
yāvatkarma sthirastāvat tato yānti gṛhāntaram ।
atra kṛtaṃ pare loke bhuṃkte phalātmakaṃ hi tat ।। 4 ।।
vihāya sarvaṃ gantavyaṃ sarvairlokāntare dhruvam ।
yatra gatvā bhavet saukhyaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhanaṃ hi tat ।। 5 ।।
lokāntarāṇi sarvāṇi svarādīni sukhāni vai ।
bahupuṇyena dānena paropakṛtikarmabhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
labhyate sevayā cāpi vṛddhānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।
āśīrvādātmapuṇyena jāyate svargamuttamam ।। 7 ।।
tato'pi cottamaṃ svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā tataḥ param ।
golokaṃ vā'kṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃdhāma mamāpi ca ।। 8 ।।
vaikuṇṭhe me bhavantyeva kuṭumbāni śubhāni vai ।
pārṣadānāṃ tathā pārṣadānīnāṃ maṇḍalāni ca ।। 9 ।।
yugalāni bhavantyeva divyāni yugalo'pyaham ।
lakṣmyādikoṭidāsībhiḥ sevyamāno'smi tatra ha ।। 2.208.1 0।।
goloke'pi tathā cāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā yutaḥ ।
koṭyabjagopagopībhiryugalaiḥ samprasevitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
rājādhirājo varte'haṃ sadānandamahāmbudhiḥ ।
yugalānāṃ mahat saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ tatra vartate ।। 1 2।।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ mama yogānmokṣasthānamagatvaram ।
nityaṃ vivardhamānaṃ tat hrāsaśūnya paraṃ sukham ।। 13 ।।
tadvat sukhaṃ sadā cāste kailāse nityayogibhiḥ ।
āśrite śāṃkare loke golokādadha eva ha ।। 14।।
gaṇaiśca gaṇībhirdivyayoginībhiḥ prasevyate ।
śaṃkaro'haṃ vasāmyeva tatra kailāsake śubhe ।। 15।।
mayā rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ tadvai gārhasthyayogidarśakam ।
yogī tiṣṭhāmi gārhasthye satyapi śaṃkarātmakaḥ ।। 16।।
tatsukhaṃ śāśvataṃ cāpi yugalānāṃ satāṃ dhruvam ।
satīsevāṃ ca gṛhṇāmi yoginīnāṃ patiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 17।।
tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ cāste tribhyo lokebhya uttamam ।
akṣare me nityadhāmni yatheṣṭaṃ pārameśvaram ।। 18।।
sarvaiśvaryamayaṃ sarvayogātmakaṃ sukhottamam ।
kāmarūpadharaṃ naikarūpabhogyaṃ sukhātsukham ।। 19।।
sarvarūpadharatvaṃ vai vartate tatra cottamam ।
svātantryaṃ divyamuktānāṃ sarvaśaktijuṣāṃ sadā ।।2.208.20 ।।
sukhasyā'ntaḥ kvacinnāsti kadācit hrāsa eva na ।
vardhante sukhasandehāḥ sadā ānandavārdhayaḥ ।। 21 ।।
anekendriyaviṣayā divyā akṣarasaṃjñitāḥ ।
śabdāḥ sparśā rasā gandhā dṛśyā divyā bhavanti vai ।।22।।
ānandākhyāḥ sukhaśailā ātmāno bhuñjate sadā ।
akṣare tatra koṭyabjagolokānāṃ sukhādhikam ।। 23।।
tathā koṭyabjavaikuṇṭhakailāsānāṃ sukhādhikam ।
sukhaṃ sarvavidhaṃ cāste muktānāṃ mānasepsitam ।।24।।
tato'pyadhikaṃ caivāste paredhāmni sukhaṃ mama ।
mama yogena bhaktānāṃ sukhaṃ sarvottamottamam ।।25।।
anantaṃ manmūrtilabhyaṃ sarvendriyasugocaram ।
niravadhyadhikaṃ caiva niratiśāyi śāśvatam ।।26।।
yatheṣṭaṃ caikamūrtyā vā labhyaṃ ca yugalena vā ।
aikyabhāvena labhyaṃ vā sarvabhāvārjitaṃ ca vā ।।27।।।
yatheṣṭeṣṭeṣṭeṣṭatamaṃ rādhe nirūpaṇātparam ।
evaṃ harirnijaṃ saukhyaṃ varṇayāmāsa mūrtijam ।।।28।।।
athāheha sukhārthaṃ ca rādhike vartanaṃ śubham ।
mārutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti ca ।।29।।
oṣadhayo drumā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam ।
tathā sacetā bhūtvaiva prasahetā gataṃ parāt। ।। 2.208.3 0।।
prātikūlyaṃ nigilatā prāpyate vijayaḥ sadā ।
sukṛtaṃ labhyate tena sahamānena sarvathā ।।3 1।।
duṣkṛtaṃ nāśyate tena namyamānena sarvadā ।
dehendriyādibhiḥ kvāpi dīyamāne nijātmane ।।32।।
kleśo vā''turatā cāpi sahanīyā subuddhibhiḥ ।
lokairvā nijalokairvā bhūtairvā tattvasattamaiḥ ।।3 3 ।।
dīyamānaṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ sahate yaśca dehavān ।
sa eva vijayaṃ yāti pare svarge'pi modate ।।34।।
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā yo'parāniha nindati ।
nindāvṛttiḥ śvavalloke mṛtatulyaḥ śavādivat ।।35।।
nindakaṃ vai nartamānaṃ mayūraṃ nagnapucchakam ।
varjayenmṛtatulyaṃ vai tādṛśaṃ pāpacetasam ।।36।।
śālāvṛkaṃ ca mātaṃgaṃ cārivrataṃ vimārgiṇam ।
varjayet sarvathā kruddhaṃ sa syāt sukhī janeṣvapi ।।37।।
yasya bhṛtyajanaḥ sarvo jñānavijñānakovidaḥ ।
hitaiṣī vacane saktaḥ snigdhaḥ sa jāyate sukhī ।।38।।
mantriṇo yasya hitadā matidāśconnatipradāḥ ।
anāgatavivektāraḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ।।39।।
samaduḥkhasukhā yasya sahāyāḥ priyakāriṇaḥ ।
hitacintāparāḥ satyāḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ।।2.208.40।।
yasya nārtaḥ śritavargo bhāvato nikaṭāgamaḥ ।
sevādharmaparo dakṣaḥ sa sadā jāyate sukhī ।।41 ।।
bhāvyaṃ rājñā hitakartrā sevakenāpi sarvathā ।
aiśvaryabhāginā cāpi vindataḥ sukhameva tau ।।42।।
yasmātprāptaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ prajayā cāśritena ca ।
tena vā ca tayā vā tad vismartavyaṃ na vai kvacid ।।43।।
kṛtaghnatve punarnāśo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
duḥkhamāsādyate tena viparītārthagāminā ।।44।।
āsīd vane mahāraṇye munirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ ।
kṛpāyano dvijaśreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ।।45।।
bhajamāno hariṃ nityaṃ niyato tapa āsthitaḥ ।
aiśvaryādhāra evā'sau phalamūlādanaḥ sukhī ।।46।।
sattvabhāvena nivasan bahvāśrayaprado'bhavat ।
tamenaṃ sattvasampannaṃ cāhiṃsakaṃ samadṛśam ।।47।।
vijñāya vaninaḥ sattvāḥ samīpe nivasantyapi ।
mūṣakā nakulāścāpi mārjārāḥ sārameyakāḥ ।।48।।
dvīpino bhallukāścāpi vyāghrā gajā mahāgajāḥ ।
siṃhāścānye khaṅgamṛgā gaṇḍakā hariṇāstathā ।।49।।
vairaṃ tyaktvaiva tiṣṭhanti yānti cāraṇyake dine ।
rātrau vā''hāralābhārthaṃ punaścāyānti tatra ca ।।2.208.50।।
mūṣakastvekadā yāto nijāhārārthamekalaḥ ।
dūraṃ tadāśramāttatra mārjāro militastadā ।।51 ।।
kṣudhayā ca patan dhartuṃ pṛṣṭhe'bhavadbalād yadā ।
mūṣakaḥ so'tivegena ṛṣyaṃke nyapatad bhayāt ।।52।।
prārthayanme bhayaṃ cāsmānmārjārājjāyate ṛṣe ।
nirbhayaṃ kuru viprendra yathā sukhaṃ vasāmyaham ।।53।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha bhavaivātra mārjārastvaṃ sukhī bhava ।
jātaḥ so'pi ca mārjārastaṃ dhartuṃ śvā samāgataḥ ।।54।।
punaścaivaṃ prārthayacca ṛṣiḥ prāha kṛpāyanaḥ ।
śvā bhaveti drutaṃ so'bhūt śvā tadā nirbhayo'niśam ।।55।।
athaikadā samāyāto vṛkastaṃ dhartumāpatat ।
śvā prāha ca ṛṣiṃ gatvā nirbhayaṃ māṃ vidhehi ca ।।56।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha vṛko'tra tvaṃ bhavaivaṃ nirbhayo bhava ।
vṛke jāte'tha ca tato vyāghraḥ kṣudhākulo vane ।।57।।
samāyāto vṛkaṃ hantuṃ vṛko bhayānvito munim ।
prārthayannirbhayaṃ bhāvaṃ munistaṃ vyāghratāṃ dadau ।।।58।।।
vyāghro bhūtvā nirbhayo'bhūt munyāśrame sukhasthitaḥ ।
kadācinmattabhāvena mahādantena hastinā ।।59।।
dṛṣṭaśca tāḍituṃ śīghraṃ samāyātena vegataḥ ।
uvācaivaṃ muniṃ gatvā dantyayaṃ māṃ haniṣyati ।।2.208.60।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha bhavātraiva dantī balī mahāvapuḥ ।
vyāghraḥ śīghraṃ hastibhāvaṃ gato'tibalapuṣṭimān ।।6 1।।
tāvat kaścit kadācidvai kesarī dṛṣṭavān gajam ।
dhartuṃ yāvat samāyāti gajastāvanmuniṃ prati ।।62।।
samāgatya bhayaṃ prāha nirbhayatvamayācata ।
ṛṣistasmai dadau śīghraṃ kesaritvaṃ kṛpāyanaḥ ।।।63।।
athāyātaḥ kadācidvai śarabhastatra daivataḥ ।
dhartuṃ kesariṇaṃ tāvad bhayena kesarī munim ।।64।।
prārthayannirbhayaṃ bhāvaṃ muniḥ prāha kṛpāyanaḥ ।
bhava tvaṃ śarabhaḥ putra mā'stu bhayaṃ kadācana ।।65।।
śarabhaḥ sa tadā jātaḥ kesariprāṇanāśanaḥ ।
nirbhayo'sti vane tāvat kadācid dinasaptake ।।66।।
ativarṣā abhavaँśca na prāpaccharabho'danam ।
tadā vyacintayaccainamṛṣiṃ saṃbhakṣayāmi vai ।।67।।
dhyānayogabalenāpi maharṣistaṃ tathāmatim ।
jñātvā''ha mūṣakaṃ tvāṃ tu madaiśvaryabalena ha ।।68।।
śarabhatvaṃ dattavāँśca sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ ca nirbhayam ।
tathaiśvaryapradātāraṃ kṛpayā rakṣakaṃ prabhum ।।69।।
apāpaṃ prāṇadātāraṃ yato hiṃsitumicchasi ।
tasmātpunarmūṣakatvaṃ prayāhi pāpayonija ।।2.208.70।।
evaṃ śapto mūṣikatvaṃ prāptaḥ śarabhatā gatā ।
dīnatāṃ vai gataḥ paścādṛṣiṇā sa bahiṣkṛtaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
evaṃ vijñāya pātrādi sāttvikaṃ sattvavarjitam ।
vā tathā tatra vai deyaṃ caiśvaryaṃ nādhikaṃ kvacit ।।72।।
etādṛśānāṃ lokānāṃ viśvāso na hitāvahaḥ ।
svāminā śreṣṭhinā rājñā jñātavyaṃ vai sukhārthinā ।।73।।
nā'parīkṣya kadācidvai deyaṃ sarva kupātrake ।
kupātrapāśamāpanno na kadācid sukhaṃ vrajet ।।74।।
kulīnaḥ prākṛto'pyatra duḥkhamāpto'pi vai kvacit ।
na pāpe kurute buddhiṃ bhidyamāno'pi sāttvikaḥ ।।75।।
kulīnabhinnapuruṣo buddhyā hīno'timūrkharāṭ ।
durlabhaiścaratāṃ cāpi prāpitaḥ śatrutāṃ vrajet ।।76।।
kulīnaṃ śikṣitaṃ prājñaṃ jñānavijñānapāragam ।
kṛtajñaṃ ca sahiṣṇuṃ ca santuṣṭaṃ ca jitendriyam ।।77।।
hitaiṣiṇaṃ satāṃ sevāṃ kurvantaṃ pitṛsevinam ।
brahmasevāparaṃ ceṣṭadevārpaṇavṛṣānvitam ।।78।।
yuktācāraṃ śubhacintāparaṃ vinayavedinam ।
iṃgitajñaṃ nītiyuktaṃ kuśalaṃ guṇasaṃbhṛtam ।।79।।
sevājñaṃ lābhahānyādivedinaṃ sattvamāśritam ।
durlabhaiśvaryavantaṃ yaḥ kurute jñānavān patiḥ ।।2.208.80 ।।
svāmī rājā'thavā'nyaśca sa sukhī jāyate sadā ।
evaṃ śiṣyaṃ pravijñāya rājaँste'tra dadāmyaham ।।8 1।।
yogaiśvaryaṃ samādhisthaṃ bhāvaṃ mama svarūpake ।
paśya nityaṃ divyabhāvaṃ mama tvaṃ raṇajit! sadā ।।82।।
yena te paramā siddhirmokṣadā hastagā bhavet ।
ityuktvā pradadau divyaṃ bhāvaṃ raṇajite hariḥ ।।83 ।।
viṃśatikanyakāpitre śvaśurāya mahātmane ।
sa cāpi bhāvamāpanno divyaṃ divyasunetrakaḥ ।।84।।
dṛṣṭavān kuṃkumavāpīṃ divyāṃ smṛddhāṃ mahāpurīm ।
dṛṣṭavān divyavaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ tathā ।।85।।
akṣareśaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sutāpatim ।
tato hariḥ prajābhyaśca svaṃ divyaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।।86।।
kṣaṇānte mānavaṃ bhāvaṃ prāpya mantraṃ nijaṃ dadau ।
vaiṣṇavāste tadā jātāḥ prajālokāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।87।।
atha yukāsanānadyāṃ snātuṃ gopālanandanaḥ ।
yayau snātvā dhyānapūjāṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ nṛpārpitām ।।88।।
pūjāṃ pragṛhya dugdhādipānaṃ kṛtvā vihāyasā ।
vimānena kṛtaṃ prāpya sammānaṃ prayayau tataḥ ।।89।।
ālāyasarṣisahito bhūbhṛtā sahitastathā ।
viṃśatikanyakāyukto hariḥ pitṛsamanvitaḥ ।।2.208.90।।
yajñabhūmiṃ cāyayau vai lakṣakoṭikamudrikāḥ ।
yajñe samarpayāmāsa dānārthaṃ kośarakṣiṇe ।। 91 ।।
rātrau ca bhojanaṃ cakre mahotsavaṃ tathottamam ।
bhojayitvā janān sarvān suṣvāpa parameśvaraḥ ।।92।।
saptamyāṃ deśajāścānyadeśīyā mānavāstadā ।
ṛṣayo munayaścānye dharmākhyānaparā janāḥ ।।9 3 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathānakāni vai ।
jagustatra mahotsāhayutā makhe'tiśobhane ।। 94।।
kīrtanāni bhavantyeva līlāścaryamayāni ca ।
śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyāstīre satāṃ nivāsane ।।95।।
rāsabhāvena sarvāścāmaryo ramanta ityapi ।
nāṭyabhāvena narakā nāṭyaṃ kurvanti vai niśi ।।96 ।।
atha rādhe prasevante viṃśatikanyakā harim ।
niśi śrīpatimīśeśaṃ kāntaṃ kāntimanoharam ।। 97।।
śāśvataṃ sukhamāpustāḥ sevayitvā navaṃ prabhum ।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca yogaiśvaryapratāpinam ।।98।।
prātarjātaṃ harirnidrāṃ tatyāja maṃgalaśravaiḥ ।
dhyānairmaṃgalatūryotthaiḥ sūtamāgadhajaiḥ ravaiḥ ।।9 9 ।।
gītikābhiśca vai brahmapriyāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ satām ।
kīrtanairbhajanaiścāpi prabubodha janārdanaḥ ।। 2.208.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mīnārkakṛṣṇapattane rāyaraṇajitprabhṛtijanān hariḥ samupādideśa, yajñabhūmimājagāma, rātrau suṣvāpa, prātaḥ prabubodhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭā'dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 208 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 208 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 209
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 210 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātaḥ kṛtasnānavidhiḥ prabhuḥ ।
pūjāṃ kartuṃ niṣasādā''sane sauvarṇaśobhane ।। 1 ।।
yajñanārāyaṇaṃ tatra pūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ ।
ṣoḍaśādibhirutkṛṣṭaistāvattatra samāyayau ।। 1 ।।
lomaśarṣiḥ pūjanārthaṃ pupūja parameśvaram ।
brahmapriyāśca rājānaḥ samāyayustathā''rcayan ।। 3 ।।
tāvad vādyānyavādyanta yajñakāryamahotsave ।
gamanārthaṃ ca rājānaḥ prajā maharṣayastathā ।। 4 ।।
brahmādyā īśvarāḥ sarve yajñabhūmiṃ drutaṃ yayuḥ ।
saṃbhārān bhūbhṛto'pīṣṭān cakrurekatritān makhe ।। 5 ।।
dugdhaṃ samidhaḥ kāṣṭhādi kaṇāḥ phalāni śālayaḥ ।
sarvaṃ copasthitaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ devādibhiḥ kṣaṇāt ।। 6 ।।
ācāryo devatāḥ sarve ṛtvijo jāpakāstathā ।
karmaṭhā yajamānāśca sahāyāścopatasthire ।। 7 ।।
svastivāco'bhavaँstatra brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhapradāḥ ।
puṇyāhavācanaṃ cāpi vedaghoṣāstadā'bhavan ।। 8 ।।
yathāsthānasthiteṣveva sarveṣu yājñikeṣu ca ।
dehaśuddhirdaśasnānaṃ gurupādābhivandanam ।। 9 ।।
saṃkalpo digrakṣaṇaṃ ca kalaśārādhanaṃ tathā ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ।। 2.209.1 0।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathārghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ tato'bhavat। ।
abhiṣeko vardhinīpūjanaṃ vāstuprapūjanam ।। 11 ।।
maṇḍapārcanamevā'tha sarvatobhadrapūjanam ।
devatāpūjanaṃ yantradevānāmarhaṇaṃ tathā ।। 12।।
agneruttāraṇaṃ pīṭhadevānāṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ ।
kuṇḍapūjā devapūjā tato'gnipūjanaṃ śubham ।। 1 3।।
grahāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kṣetrapā'rcanam ।
muktānāmavatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ prapūjanam ।। 14।।
īśvarīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitpūjanaṃ brahmacāriṇām ।
sāṃkhyayoginyarhaṇaṃ ca satīnāṃ pūjanaṃ satām ।। 15।।
pitṝṇāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca dikpālānāṃ prapūjanam ।
lokapālārhaṇaṃ cāpi svargasthānāṃ prapūjanam ।। 16।।
trayastriṃśatsurāṇāṃ ca pañcadevārhaṇaṃ tathā ।
bhuvarlokanivāsānāṃ pūjanaṃ rakṣasāṃ tathā ।। 17।।
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ mānavānāṃ samarhaṇam ।
catuḥkhanisthajīvānāṃ pūjanaṃ dāsavargiṇām ।। 18।।
jaḍānāṃ cetanānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ pūjanādikam ।
rasapradānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ prapūjanam ।। 19।।
jantūnāṃ cāpi tattvānāmatalādinivāsinām ।
pūjanaṃ śrīmahāviṣṇorviṣṇośca pūjanaṃ tathā ।।2.209.20 ।।
śaṃkhaghaṇṭārhaṇaṃ prāṇapūjanaṃ ca nivedanam ।
havanaṃ bahumiṣṭānnairājyairghṛtādibhistathā ।। 21 ।।
nīrājanaṃ ca vai balidānaṃ puṣpāñjalistathā ।
dakṣiṇā ca namaskāraḥ stutiścāśīḥpradānakam ।।22।।
parihāro bhojanāni kramāt sarvaṃ makhe hyabhūt ।
koṭiśo lakṣaśo devā tṛptiṃ prāptā mahāmakhe ।। 23।।
aṣṭamyāmeva madhyāhne tathā sarvaṃ vidhānakam ।
kṛtvā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo bubhuje sakuṭumbakaḥ ।।24।।
jagrāha tāmbūlakaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpa ha ।
tāvattatra nṛpaścāyāt prārthanārthaṃ samutsukaḥ ।।25।।
cārulāṣarṣisahito rāyavākakṣako nṛpaḥ ।
nijarāṣṭraṃ jalasthaṃ vai dvīpaṃ viṣaturīyakam ।।26।।
tūryapadāṃ purīṃ cāpi pāvayituṃ tadā''rthayat ।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stvevaṃ śīghraṃ sajjobhavattadā ।।27।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharāsutaḥ ।
pitarau bhrātaraścāpi santuṣṭā bhaginī tathā ।।28।।
amṛtā bhrātṛjāyā ca brahmapriyāśca vai satī ।
śaṃkaro lomaśaścāpi cārulāṣaṛṣistathā ।। 29।।
rāyavākakṣako rājā vimānayostadā drutam ।
āruruhuryayuḥ sarve parimeyapadānugāḥ ।। 2.209.30 ।।
samudrakhāḍikāṃ samullaṃghya dvīpamupāyayuḥ ।
viṣaturīyasaṃjñaṃ te rājā cāgre gato'bhavat ।।3 1 ।।
turyapadānagaryāṃ sa haryarthaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhāt ।
rājñyā sainyena sahito rājā sammānamācarat ।।3 1 ।।
vimānaṃ nikaṭe rājasaudhasyodyānamaṇḍale ।
uttārya śrīharistasmād vimānādbahirāyayau ।।33 ।।
rājā puṣpādibhiḥ pūjāṃ cakre śrīmādhavasya ha ।
kuṃkumādyaistathā'maryaḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।34।।
jayaśabdā vādyaśabdāstadā'bhavan samantataḥ ।
vardhayāmāsurīśeśaṃ puṣpalājā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।।35।।
prajāśca vardhayāmāsurharṣanādaiḥ pareśvaram ।
tato rājā hariṃ svalpe vimāne cādhyarohayat ।।36।।
kuṭumbaṃ ca vimāneṣu tathaiva cādhyarohayat ।
nagaryā pratibhavanaṃ vimānairabhigamya ca ।।37।।
pāvanāni janānāṃ vai gṛhāṇi pracakāra ha ।
pūjāṃ mahopacārāँśca dhanaṃ dravyaṃ suratnakam ।।38।।
prāpya kṛtvā pāvanāni gṛhāṇi punareva ha ।
bhramitvā nagarīṃ divyāṃ datvā naijaṃ ca darśanam ।।39।।
ājagāma nṛpāvāsaṃ divyaṃ saudhaṃ haristataḥ ।
viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ dugdhaṃ papau sarve tataḥ papuḥ ।।2.209.4 0 ।।
rājā rājñī kumārāśca kanyakātrayamityapi ।
pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।।41।।
upadābhirvividhābhiścandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।
anyahārairmahāratnaistato nīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।42।।
kanyātrayaṃ harau mugdhaṃ varamālā dadurgale ।
harirjagrāha hastāँśca tāsāṃ rājñīmatena vai ।।43 ।।
kanyā jātāḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ prāpya kāntaṃ surūpiṇam ।
rājā mumoda bahudhā rājñī cāti mumoda ha ।।44।।
haristebhyo dadau samyagupadeśaṃ sukhapradam ।
rājasaudhe mahāsiṃhāsane niṣadya cotsave ।।45।।
sadā bhaktirhareḥ kāryā'kṣareśasya mamāśritā ।
satāṃ sevā sadā kāryā puṇyadā mokṣadā śubhā ।।46।।
rakṣaṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kartavyaṃ dayayā'nvaham ।
yasminnarthe hitaṃ yat syāttad grāhyaṃ netarat kvacit ।।47।।
ātmasaṃyamanaṃ buddhyā grāhyabuddhyā tu vartanam ।
parāmarśena mokṣaśca prāptavyo dehinā tviha ।।48।।
anuyuñjīta kṛtyāni dharmajñānamayāni ca ।
āgamairupadiṣṭāni gurūditāni yāni ca ।।49।।
dharmāṇāmavirodhena sarveṣāṃ priyamācaret ।
dharmamevābhirakṣedvai nijārthaṃ sādhayet kṛtī ।।2.209.50 ।।
śāstraṃ dharmo brāhmaṇasya daṇḍaḥ kṣatrasya vai vṛṣaḥ ।
kṛṣṭirvaiśyasya dharmo'sti sevakasya ca sevanam ।।51 ।।
satyaṃ dharmo hi sarvasya dharmāḍhyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
mānavā devatulyāste sarveṣāṃ prāṇarūpiṇaḥ ।।52।।
śāstraṃ śāsanakartṛ syād bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇam ।
brahmaṇā lokarakṣārthaṃ mannideśāt purā kṛtam ।।513।।
vyavahārasukhārthaṃ ca bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।
daṇḍo vinirmitaścāpi kṣātradharmātmakaḥ śubhaḥ ।।54।।
vyavahāro'paraścāpyudyamarūpo vinirmitaḥ ।
bibharti janatāḥ sarvā nītilabdhānnanāṇakaiḥ ।।55।।
āyotpādanarūpaḥ sa bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।
tṛtīyaḥ puruṣaścāpi nirmitaḥ sukhasādhanaḥ ।।56 ।।
ājñā''deśātmakaścānyaḥ puruṣo'pi vinirmitaḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ dīnavarṇānāṃ bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।।57।।
ādeśe saṃsthitāścāpnuvanti bharaṇasādhanam ।
lokānāmeva sarveṣāṃ sasurā'surarakṣasām ।।58।।
samanuṣyoragavatāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
caturdhā'yaṃ vyavahāro bhartṛpratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ।।59।।
sukhasampatpravāhārthaṃ kṛto'sti pūrvato mayā ।
dharmayukto mama bhaktyā yuto yo matparāyaṇaḥ ।।2.209.6 0।।
bhūtvā varteta satataṃ tadbhartā'haṃ bhavāmi vai ।
karmaṇāṃ ca svabhāvānāṃ puṇyānāṃ vyavasāyinām ।।6 1 ।।
prayatnānāmahaṃ bhartā bhartṝṇāṃ cāpi bhartṛkaḥ ।
śāstā niyāmakaścāhaṃ lokayātrākaro'pyaham ।।62।।
evaṃ jñātvā ca māṃ lokā bhajeran vai taranti te ।
dharmamūlaḥ sadaivārthastathā'rthaphalanaṃ ratiḥ ।।63 ।।
dharmārthakāmanāḥ sarvā manomūlotthitāstviha ।
pravṛttirūpiṇaḥ sarve dharmādyā bhavayoginaḥ ।।64।।
samūlebhyaśca vai tebhyo nivṛttirmokṣa ucyate ।
dharmāccharīrayogaśca śārīro'rthaḥ sahāyakṛt ।।65।।
kāmaḥ phalaṃ mahābandhaḥ sarve tvete rajasvalāḥ ।
tān vihāya viśeṣāṃścā'rajasko bhaktimān mayi ।।66।।
vartate yogayuktātmā brahmabhūyāya kalpate ।
dharmo na cenmama prāptiprado'rtho'pi na cettathā ।।67।।
kāmo na cenmama prāptipradaste'narthakā matāḥ ।
arthānanartharūpāँstān yuñjīta mayi vā tyajet ।।68।।
anyathā viṣaye buddhiryāsyatyeva vihāriṇaḥ ।
mokṣārthe saṃhṛtā buddhirvināśaṃ vai vrajettataḥ ।।69।।
buddhināśo mahānmohastāmaso'pi vivardhate ।
tasmānnāstikatā syācca durācārastato bhavet ।।2.209.70।।
durācārātprajā naṣṭā bhavatyeva hi sāṃkarī ।
sādhavo na gṛhaṃ yānti durācāragatasya vai ।।71।।
pāpānyasya tu vardhante duḥkhaṃ jīvitamṛcchati ।
jīvato'pi nirayo'yaṃ cāsukhaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ ।।72।।
tasmāttaddoṣanāśārthaṃ sukhārthaṃ sattvabhāvataḥ ।
brahmaniṣṭhān praseveta bhaktiyuktān harerjanān ।।73।।
japennāma sadā me'trā'rpayet sarvaṃ tathā mayi ।
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣāya kalpate hi saḥ ।।74।।
sādhūn prasādayennityaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā ।
tavā'smīti vadennityaṃ praṇamet sevanaṃ caret ।।75।।
satāmāśīrvacobhiśca prasādena ca sevayā ।
samāgamena yogena pāvano jāyate janaḥ ।।76।।
apāpo'yaṃ satāṃ saṃgaḥ sarvadoṣanikṛntanaḥ ।
pāpānyapi ca kṛcchrāṇi śamayennātra saṃśayaḥ ।।77।।
guravaḥ sādhavo loke śreṣṭhā mokṣapradā mama ।
suvarṇaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ sarvāṃśe sādhavastathā ।।78।।
āpādakeśaparyantāḥ pāvanāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ।
yathākathañcitprāptāste dāsyanti mama yojanam ।।79।।
kārayiṣyanti me bhaktiṃ yāpayiṣyanti dhāma me ।
tasmāt sevyā mama bhaktimantrayuktā hi sādhavaḥ ।।2.209.80 ।।
guravaste paraṃ dharmaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ mama ।
brūyustaṃ ye tvācarayeyuste yāsyanti parā'kṣaram ।।8 1 ।।
gurūṇāṃ tu prasādādvai paraṃ śreya avāpnuyuḥ ।
sarvadharmottamaṃ śīlaṃ śīladharmā hi sādhavaḥ ।।82।।
śīlena hi trayo lokāḥ śakyā jetuṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
nahi kiñcidasādhyaṃ vai loke śīlavatāṃ bhavet ।।83।।
etatpṛthivyāmamṛtaṃ śīlaṃ sarvottamottamam ।
etāvacchreya evāsti śīlaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhitam ।।84।।
sādhūnāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ satīnāṃ pariśīlanam ।
sevā śīlaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ brahmaśīlaṃ vrataṃ param ।।85।।
yathāvad guruvṛttyā vai samaṃ nānyaddhi vidyate ।
pūrvakalpe'bhavadrājā prahlādaḥ śīlavān sadā ।।86।।
sādhuśīlanamevā'sya vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
tamenaṃ tu samāgatya vṛhaspatiḥ purā śubham ।।87।।
prahlādāya dadau jñānaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ sanātanam ।
prasthite tu gurau rājā dakṣiṇārthaṃ tadā'vadat ।।88।।
bṛhaspatiryayāce vai dakṣiṇāṃ śīlarūpiṇīm ।
prahlādaśca dadau śīlaṃ yāvat tāvacca dehataḥ ।।89।।
śīlaṃ divyaṃ viniryātaṃ śrīścāpi niryayau saha ।
prahlādaścābhavattatra nistejo dharmavarjitaḥ ।।2.209.90।।
śīlahīnaḥ śriyāhīnaḥ papraccha puruṣaṃ ca tam ।
kastvaṃ kasmāt prayāsyevaṃ vada me tu yathāyatham ।।9 1 ।।
śīlaṃ prāha vrataṃ cāsmi dāne dattaḥ prayāmyaham ।
mayi yāte ca dharmo'yaṃ puruṣo'pi prayāti ca ।।92।।
dharmavaṃśyā ime cānye prayānti paśya pārthiva ।
mayi yāte dharmapatnī bhaktiryāti tathā ramā ।।93।।
lakṣmīḥ śrīrbhūḥ samagrāśca prayāntyeva haripriyāḥ ।
tacchrutvā bhayamāpannaḥ prahlādaḥ śīlavarjanāt ।।94।।
yatra nāsti satāṃ sevā śīlaṃ cendriyanigrahaḥ ।
adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra nārāyaṇo na ca ।।95।।
yatra nārāyaṇo nā'smi yatra nāsti ramā mama ।
tatra mokṣo na vai cāste tasmād bhavantu śīlinaḥ ।।96।।
satāṃ me ca samarhāṃ vai sevāṃ kurvantu nityadā ।
sarvabhūtānugrahaṃ ca śīlaṃ samāsato hi tat ।।97।।
sampadaṃ bhuñjate śīlāḥ śāśvatīṃ madanugrahāt ।
aśīlāścedāpnuvanti bhuñjate na ciraṃ hi te ।।98।।
yajñadānādikāryārthaṃ dattā samattu nirguṇā ।
etaddeśīyalokā vai bhavantu yajñavṛttayaḥ ।।99।।
sukhino dānaśīlāśca tathā śīlavṛṣānvitāḥ ।
ityuktvā virarāmaiva bhagavān rādhike tataḥ ।। 2.209.100 ।।
prajābhiḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇo rājñā rājñyā samarhitaḥ ।
mantrān dadau prajābhyaśca dugdhapānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 101 ।।
rājasaudhe caraṇau svau datvā kṛtvā ca pāvanam ।
sāyaṃ svāgatamānena vādyaghoṣādibhirhariḥ ।। 1 02।।
vimānaṃ svaṃ samāruhya sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।
dvinaskaṃ pārśvarājyaṃ ca milvilaṃ dvīpamityapi ।। 1 03।।
vilāsadvīpamevāpi bulandadvīpamityapi ।
vimānena tadā gatvā vihṛtya gagane tadā ।। 1 04।।
vilokya śrīharistūrṇaṃ rātrau vaihāyasā drutam ।
aṣṭamyāmāyayau yajñabhūmiṃ nijālaye śubham ।। 1 05।।
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ cakārā'pi bhojanaṃ jagṛhe hariḥ ।
tathā'nye bhojanaṃ cakrurdravyaṃ yajñe harirdadau ।। 1 06।।
viśaśrāma sukhaṃ rātrau kanyātrayeṇa sevitaḥ ।
yoganidrāvaśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ ।। 1 07।।
gītibhirvedaghoṣaiśca tūryasvanaiśca kīrtanaiḥ ।
sūtamāgadhabandyādyairbodhitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 08।।
rādhike svasvarūpaṃ sa dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ parātparam ।
akṣarātītarūpaṃ yat pūrṇabrahmaparātmakam ।। 1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bhādraśuklā'ṣṭamyāṃ yajñe sarvakarmaṇāmantimāhutiparyantānāṃ karaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ tato rāyavākakṣakanṛpārthito haristadrājyaṃ viṣaturīyadvīpaṃ dvinaskaṃ milvilāṃ ca gatvā pāvayitvopadiśya rātrau×Vr̤M× punarmakhabhūmimājagāma viśaśrāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 209 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 209 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 210
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 211 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike prātaḥ snātvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
kṛtvā tu naityikī pūjāṃ yajñabhūmiṃ jagāma ha ।। 1 ।।
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca rājāno yajamānakāḥ ।
prajā devāḥ sureśāśca karmaṭhāścopatasthire ।। 2 ।।
yajñahavyāni navyāni tatrāhṛtāni sarvataḥ ।
kāmadrumādibhistatra rasāḥ sampratipāditāḥ ।। 3 ।।
svastivāco'bhavaँścāpi puṇyāhavacanānyapi ।
vādyaghoṣā abhavaँśca vedadhvanaya ityapi ।। 4 ।।
yajamānāśca rājāno navamyāṃ prātareva te ।
yathāsthānaṃ samāgatya karmakāṇḍe kṛtādarāḥ ।। 5 ।।
sāvadhānā abhavaँśca jāyante kramaśaḥ kriyāḥ ।
prokṣaṇāni pūjanāni naivedyabalayo'rpitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
vahnau havyapradānāni jātānyāhutayo'bhavan ।
devatātarpaṇaṃ jātaṃ surādyāstṛptimāgatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭisthadehinaḥ ।
yajñāhutibhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tṛptiṃ gatāstadā'dhvare ।। 8 ।।
antyāhutiṃ tathā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau harirmakhe ।
parihāraṃ cakārā'tha bhojanānyadadāt prabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
meśubhānnaṃ mohanasthālānnaṃ mudgajalaḍaḍu'kān ।
sukhadāṃ cūrṇalaḍaḍūँ'śca mauktikān śaṣkulīstathā ।। 2.210.10 ।।
śāṭakān ghṛtapūrāँścāpūpāँśca śatachidrakān ।
piṇḍakān barphikāṃ miṣṭapūrṇapolīśca pūrikāḥ ।। 1 1।।
khājakān pāyasān kṣīraṃ saṃyāvaṃ ca birañjakam ।
kaṃsāraṃ bundikālaḍḍūn śarkarāghṛtalaḍḍukān ।। 12।।
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ rājikārāddhaṃ kvathikāṃ sūpamityapi ।
odanaṃ bahuśākāni patrabhājāśca bhojanāḥ ।। 13।।
caṇakā māṣakāścāpi śrapitā bharjitāstathā ।
vaṭikāḥ phullavaṭakā polikāścāmṛtāni ca ।। 14।।
divyabhojyāni muktānāṃ sattvabhojyāni ceśinām ।
sudhābhojyāni devānāṃ cāmabhojyāni pitṝṇām ।। 15।।
rasabhojyāni tattvānāṃ madabhojyāni rakṣasām ।
yathāyogyāni bhojyāni sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tathā ।। 16 ।।
yajñaprasādarūpāṇi tṛptidānyabhavaँstadā ।
takraṃ bahuvidhaṃ śubhraṃ cāmblamiṣṭaṃ sugandhi ca ।। 1 7।।
pācakaṃ śāntidaṃ tatrāmīkṣāghaṃ cābhavattathā ।
madhūni naikarūpāṇi madhuparkāṇi yānyapi । । 18।।
tiktāmblakaṭucūrṇāni caṭanyaścābhavaँstadā ।
āranālāni ramyāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca ।। 1 9।।
tāmbūlakāni divyāni dehibhyo'dāpayaddhariḥ ।
evaṃ sarvān bhojayitvā tataḥ saṃbubhuje prabhuḥ ।। 2.210.20 ।।
kuṭumbasahitaḥ śrīśo viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
madhyāhne rāyamārīśo nṛpaḥ prārthayadacyutam ।।2 1 ।।
nijadvīpaṃ samāgantuṃ hariḥ sajjo babhūva ha ।
anyān yathāpekṣitāँśca nityayogasthitān prabhuḥ ।। 22।।
pitrādīnīśvaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ satīṃ kuṭumbakaṃ nijam ।
ṛṣīn lomaśamukhyāँśca nītvā vimānamāsthitaḥ ।। 23 ।।
tadā rājā ca rājñī ca dānavarṣistathā puraḥ ।
vimānena yayuścāgre dvīpamālīsmarābhidham ।। 24।।
ṛddhīśā nagarī saṃśobhābhiścalaṃkṛtā tadā ।
sainyena svāgatārthaṃ copasthitiḥ racitā drutam ।। 25।।
tāvad vimānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vardhimullaṃghya khāḍikām ।
dvīpānuccāvacāँścāpyullaṃghya rāṣṭraṃ suśobhanam ।।26।।
ālīsmaraṃ hariḥ prāpa vimānaṃ bhūtale'nayan ।
ṛddhīśāyā mahodyāne nṛpālayasya sannidhau ।।।27।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayadhvānāstathā'bhavan ।
gītikāḥ smaranārīṇāṃ prajānāṃ jayagarjanāḥ ।।।28।।
susvāgataiḥ patākādyairdhvajairlājā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।
toraṇaiḥ puṣpahārādyairañjalyādibhireva ca ।। 29।।
namanaiḥ puṣpadānaiśca sammānaṃ śrīharerabhūt ।
vimānācchrīharistūrṇaṃ bahiryadā''yayau tataḥ ।। 2.210.3 0।।
rāyamārīśabhūpastrī rājñī kuśalakuṇḍalā ।
pādau tīrthajalaiḥ saṃprakṣālayāmāsa satvaram ।।3 1 ।।
harestaccaraṇotthaṃ ca jalaṃ papurnṛpādayaḥ ।
kuṃkumaiścaraṇau rañjayitvā mudrāśca jagṛhuḥ ।।।32।।
puṣpahārān gandhavāri gandhasārān dadau tathā ।
duḥkhahāñjalibhirnāryaḥ smārikāḥ kṛṣṇameva tāḥ ।।33।।
pupūjurbahubhāvena kanyakā bhāvagarbhitāḥ ।
atha kṛṣṇaṃ mahāsaudhe rājā nyaṣādayat kṣaṇam ।।34।।
siṃhāsane svake nītvā dadau dhanaṃ tu koṭikam ।
sauvarṇaṃ cāmbarādyaṃ cīrṇaṃ sarvaṃ kūpyamityapi ।। 35।।
ratnalakṣaṃ pradadau ca tadā kanyātrayaṃ śubham ।
mugdhaṃ kṛṣṇagale mālātrayaṃ samārpayat patim ।। 36।।
matvā mātṛvaco'vāpya kṛṣṇavallabhamuttamam ।
patiṃ kanyātrayaṃ prāpa rājā santoṣito'bhavat ।। 37।।
rājñī jātā kṛtakṛtyā tato dugdhaṃ papau prabhuḥ ।
anye dugdhaṃ papuścāpi drutaṃ kṛṣṇo vimānake ।। 38।।
sthitvā svalpe ṛddhīśāyāṃ nagaryāṃ sainyavardhitaḥ ।
prajābhiścārthitaḥ saṃvihṛtya gṛhāṇi sarvataḥ । । 39।।
pāvanāni tadā kṛtvā datvā svaṃ darśanaṃ śubham ।
prajābhiśca kṛtaṃ naikavidhopadābhirarcanam ।।2.210.40 ।।
gṛhītvā rājasaudhaṃ cā''yayau svāmī hariḥ prabhuḥ ।
rājyasiṃhāsane sthitvopādideśa prajādikān ।।41 ।।
mama yogo mahatpuṇyairjāto'styatra mahārṇave ।
bhavatāṃ bhāvanākṛṣṭaḥ samāyāto'smi dūrataḥ ।।42।।
madarthe dīyate sarvaṃ śāśvataṃ jāyate hi tat ।
nirguṇaṃ mama yogena mokṣadaṃ jāyate hi tat ।। 43 ।।
āśāṃ vihāya cānyasmin māyike'khilavastuni ।
ramate cātmayogeṣu mokṣamārgaṃ sa vindati ।'। 44।।
āśā duḥkhagṛhaṃ śaśvat himavatsamaniścalam ।
mahodadhisamaṃ cāpyagādhaṃ doṣasamanvitam ।।45।।
nabhaḥsamamapāraṃ ca rauravaṃ jīvataḥ sthitam ।
api rājyasthito rājā cāśayā mṛgayākṛte ।।46।।
vane duḥkhaṃ tathā''pnoti yathā kṣudro hi lubdhakaḥ ।
api sarvendriyatṛptaḥ kāmanāśādhṛto bhavet ।।47।।
anyāyakāmabhogena mahadduḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।
antarīkṣaṃ tathā kāmo dvayorjyāyān nu ko bhavet ।।48।।
iti praśne'ntarīkṣaṃ vai jyāyaḥ kāmo na hi kvacit ।
antarīkṣasya pāraṃ vai yānti yogijanāḥ kvacit ।।49।।
āśāyā naiva pāraṃ saṃlabhante tadanusṛtāḥ ।
ṛṣabho nāma bhakto me purā śrībadarīvanam ।।2.210.50 ।।
upāyayau mama divyaṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam ।
yatra me badarī ramyā hrado vaihāyaso'malaḥ ।।51 ।।
aśvaśirā ṛṣiryatra yatra gaṃgā'tipāvanī ।
tatrāgatyāśrame ramye maṇḍape mama sannidhau ।।52।।
natvā vāsārthamevā'sau dṛṣṭvā''śramarṣisatkuṭīm ।
parṇakuṭīṃ yayau kartuṃ dīrghavāsecchayā punaḥ ।।53 ।।
tena mārge ṛṣirnānnā tanurdṛṣṭastapodhanaḥ ।
ūrdhve tvaṣṭaguṇo dehe kṛśatāyāṃ tṛṇeśavat ।।54।।
kaniṣṭhikāsamastvasya darśanaṃ cādbhutaṃ hyabhūt ।
taṃ natvā ṛṣabhastasthau dattāsane viveśa ha ।।55।।
pṛṣṭaḥ kuśalamevāpi kathayāmāsa sāntvanam ।
tathā''ha parṇaśālāṃ ca kartumicchāmi cātra vai ।।56।।
tapaḥ kartuṃ tathecchāmi śāntiṃ vindāmi yena ca ।
tatsarvaṃ kartumicchāmi śādhi me tvaṃ tano mune ।।57।।
tanuḥ prāha mayā naiva kṛtā'tra parṇasatkuṭī ।
yataḥ sarvaṃ naśvaraṃ vai kasyārthe parṇajā kuṭī ।।58।।
yāvadicchā ca te tvāste parṇaśālāvidhāpane ।
tāvacchāntirna te syādvai tṛṣṇāśālāvṛtasya vai ।।59 ।।
nistṛṣṇasya nirīhasya niricchasya mahatsukham ।
tapasā'pi sukhaṃ naiva yadīcchā tatra jāgrati ।।2.210.6 0।।
parṇakuṭyāṃ niviṣṭasya na syād brahmapraveśanam ।
āśākuṭīvihīnasya bhaved brahmapraveśanam ।।6 1 ।।
brahmāveśitalokasya śāntiḥ śāśvatayoginī ।
tasmādāśāṃ parityajyā'ntarīkṣādapi dīrghikām ।।62।।
cidākāśe parṇakuṭyāṃ labha viśrāntimacyute ।
tanunaivaṃ samuktaḥ sa ṛṣabho jñānacakṣuṣā ।।63।।
parṇakuṭīṃ parityajyā'bhajanmāṃ parameśvaram।
mamāṃ'śo matsvarūpaḥ so'bhavanmokṣagatistataḥ ।।64।।
tasmādāśāṃ parityajya mano mayi samarpayet ।
sarvaṃ mayi samarpyaiva śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ।।65।।
āśā kṛtā kṛśā yena puṣṭātmā sa mato mama ।
āśā puṣṭā bhaved yasya kṛśaḥ syāt sa na saṃśayaḥ ।।66।।
yā saktā sarvabhūteṣu kṛtaghneṣvalaseṣu ca ।
nṛśaṃseṣu hiṃsakeṣu yā'pakāriṣu vidyate ।।67।।
putrastrīdhanasaudheṣu dehendriyeṣu bhuktiṣu ।
vārdhakye putrahīnānāṃ putre rājñāṃ ca rāṣṭrake ।।68।।
pradānakāṃkṣiṇīnāṃ ca kanyānāṃ suvilāsane ।
lubdhānāṃ priyaviṣaye ḍimbhānāṃ mātari dhruvā ।।69 ।।
yā''śā kṛtā kṛśā yena sa śāntimadhigacchati ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi gautamastapa ācarat ।।2.210.70 ।।
upāyāto dharmarājastamugratapasaṃ munim ।
gautamo dharmarājāya namaskutyā''sanaṃ dadau ।।7 1 ।।
prapaccha kuśalaṃ cāpi svāgataṃ cākarottataḥ ।
dharmarājo gautamaṃ saṃpapraccha tapasā mune ।।72।।
kiṃ te prayojanaṃ cāste kathaṃ karoṣi dustapaḥ ।
gautamaḥ prāha śāntyarthaṃ tapaścarāmi duścaram ।। 73।।
yena yāsye puṇyakṛtāँllokān sukhādisaṃbhṛtān ।
yamaḥ prāha vicāraste vimārgaṃ pratigacchati ।।74।।
puṇyakṛtāṃ tathā'puṇyakṛtāṃ lokeṣu sadṛśam ।
tṛṣṇājanyaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bādhate puṇyaśālinaḥ ।।75।।
dhāmākṣaraṃ vinā'nyatra tārṣṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ pravidyate ।
tasmādāśāṃ vihāyaiva tiṣṭha brahmaṇi niścalaḥ ।।76।।
sarvāṃ śāntiṃ brahmayogādavināśāmavāpsyasi ।
āśāvataḥ sukhaṃ nāsti yayā te tapato'pi vai ।।।7।।
yāvadāśā ca tṛṣṇā ca tathehā svārthagṛdhnikā ।
icchā'bhilāṣā kāmaśca tāvad vyakteḥ kathaṃ sukham ।।।77।।
sarvaṃ ceṣṭaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca yasya bhavati sarvathā ।
tasyā'bdhiḥ śāśvataścopatiṣṭhedānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।।79।।
tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād yeṣāmicchāsvavasthitaḥ ।
santo'pi brahmavettārasta eva śāntisaṃbhujaḥ ।।2.210.80 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ gautamastyaktvā tapo bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ ।
nirāśaḥ śāntahṛdayaḥ parāṃ śāntiṃ gatastadā ।।8 1 ।।
tasmānnṛpaiḥ prajābhiśca narairnārībhireva ca ।
yaṣṭavyo'haṃ mahāyajñaiḥ santoṣaṇīyaḥ sevayā ।।82।।
icchārpaṇena sākṣācca bhajanīyo'hameva ca।
evaṃ māṃ prāpya sevābhirmokṣaṃ naijaṃ prasādhayet ।।।83 ।।
bhavantaśca janāḥ sarve prajā rājādayo'pi ca ।
mayi nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe karmaṇā manasā girā ।।84।।
sarvaṃ samarpya māṃ kṛṣṇe bhajantu gatalālasāḥ ।
mahāśāntiṃ paramāṃ me dāsye'kṣare pare sthitām ।।883 ।।
ityuktvā śrīhariḥ rādhe cāha mantraṃ prajādiṣu ।
bhaktiṃ dadau nijāṃ paścād virarāma mahāprabhuḥ ।।86।।
rājā rājñī prajāścāpi bhojayāmāsuracyutam ।
sārthān saṃbhojayāmāsuḥ rājādyāścakrurādanam ।। 87।।
tataḥ pūjāṃ parigṛhya vimānamadhyarohayat ।
sarvān svayaṃ cāruroha gantuṃ ca makhabhūmikām ।।88।।
sammānaṃ bahudhā cakruḥ prajāḥ sainyāni yoṣitaḥ ।
sasāra ca tataḥ kṛṣṇo rājñā ca ṛṣiṇā saha ।।89।।
dvīpe dvīpāntare cāpi sāyaṃ vai kāśimaṃ yayau ।
dvivāmaṃ ca yayau paścānmīlavīlaṃ samāyayau ।। 2.210.90 ।।
tato'dhvarapradeśaṃ sa āyayau ca niśāṃśake ।
snātvā sandhyā tatra cakre nijāvāse ca bhojanam ।।91 ।।
viśaśrāma ca nidrāyāṃ rāyamārīśakanyakāḥ ।
tisraḥ siṣevire kāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ navaṃ patim ।। 92।।
prātaḥkāle vedaghoṣairmaṃgalāvahatūryakaiḥ ।
gītibhirvādyaghoṣaiśca jajāgāra hariḥ stavaiḥ ।। 93 ।।
rājādhirājo bhagavān kṛtasnānavidhistataḥ ।
pitarau pūjayāmāsa bhaktebhyo darśanaṃ dadau ।। 94।।
kṛtāhnikaḥ suveṣaśca makhabhūmiṃ samāgataḥ ।
dānavarṣiṃ tathā rāyamārīśabhūpatiṃ tadā ।। 95।।
prāhedaṃ koṭidravyaṃ yat pūjāyāṃ mama cāgatam ।
bhavatośca prajānāṃ ca sarvaṃ makhe'stu cārpitam ।। 96 ।।
ityuktvā''hūya kośeśaṃ kuberaṃ pradadau ca tat ।
makhe vyayārthaṃ dhanarāḍayuṃkta sarvameva tat ।। 97।।
ityevaṃ rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
pāvayitvā janān deśān narāँśca yoṣitastathā ।। 98।।
saṃgṛhya śaraṇe muktiyogyān karotyanugrahāt ।
bālān vṛddhān madhyarūpān yūnaḥ sarvāśca dehinaḥ ।।99।।
pāvayitvā mokṣayogyān karoti parameśvaraḥ ।
api kanyā bhūbhṛtāṃ ca mugdhāḥ samarpitāḥ svayam ।। 2.210.10 0।।
parigṛhyāpi vidhinā nijayogaṃ dadāti saḥ ।
kṛpāpārāvārarūpo divyo'pi janatāśrayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
adivyān mānavān dehān svīkṛtyāpi pramokṣaṇam ।
dadātīti kṛpā tasyā''nandavārdherhareḥ priye ।। 102।।
alepyasya na lepo'sti kālamāyeśituḥ kvacit ।
sarvaṃ cāsya śarīraṃ vai bhogyaṃ cādhīnakaṃ tathā ।। 103 ।।
viśeṣeṇa parigṛhya pāvayatyeva bhaktigam ।
nityatṛptasya nāstyeva parādhīnā hi tṛptikā ।। 1 04।।
sarvānandapradaḥ so'yaṃ sarvatra jayatetamām ।
rādhe bhaktyaiva bhagavān bhaktādhīno bhavatyapi ।। 1 05।।
yo yathā taṃ prapadyeta taṃ tathā bhajate prabhuḥ ।
yā yathā sevata kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇastāṃ sevate tathā ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne navamyāṃ yajñakāryottaraṃ rāyamārīśabhūparāṣṭre ālīsmaradvīpe ṛddhīśāpurīṃ pratigamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanamupadeśanaṃ kāśimadvivāmamīlavīla- dvīpān pāvayitvā makhabhūmāvāgamanaṃ rātrau viśrāntiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā daśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 210 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 210 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 211
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 212 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike bālakṛṣṇo'yaṃ daśamyāmadhvaraṃ prage ।
yayau nijāsane svarṇe saṃsthitaśca tadā'bhavan ।। 1 ।।
tūryāṇāṃ ninadāścāpi gītayo varayoṣitām ।
vedaghoṣā maharṣīṇāṃ gāndharvagāyanāni ca ।। 2 ।।
dhvanayaścāpi mantrāṇāṃ haryāśca makhināṃ tathā ।
sajjāḥ kṛtāhnikā devāḥ karmaṭhā havyavāhakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
havyapradā yajamānā maṇḍape copatasthire ।
svastivācaḥ prokṣaṇāni vastūnāṃ cāhṛtistathā ।। 4 ।।
puṇyāhavāco viprāṇāṃ devānāṃ stavanāni ca ।
unnidratvaṃ tathā sākṣādupasthitiśca pūjanam ।। 5 ।।
kramaśo'kṣaradhāmastheśvarasṛṣṭinivāsinām ।
jīvalokīyajīvānāṃ pūjanaṃ kramaśo'bhavat ।। 6 ।।
ṣoḍaśopasuvastūnāmarpaṇairbhojanādibhiḥ ।
validānairhavyadānai rasadānaiḥ samarhaṇam ।। 7 ।।
sudhāvṛtaphalānnādipāyasādipradānakaiḥ ।
carudānairyathāyogyayavamāṣādidānakaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
bhakṣyabhojyapradānaiśca lehyacoṣyapradānakaiḥ ।
svādyapeyapradānaiśca tṛpyadṛśyapradānakaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhāvyagamyapradānaiśca kalpyaklṛptyapradānakaiḥ ।
sthūlasūkṣmapradānaiśca sattvā'sattvapradānakaiḥ ।। 2.211.1 0।।
tṛptā bhavanti devādyāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ।
vahnayo bhuñjate snigdhaṃ bahvannaṃ bahujātikam ।। 11 ।।
havanāni ca havyānāmabhavaँstatra vahniṣu ।
asaṃkhyānyuttamānyeva bahuhastaiśca bhāvataḥ ।। 12।।
antimaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā datvā ca bhūyasīstathā ।
dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇamukhyāśca parihāraṃ vyadhāddhariḥ ।। 13।।
rājāno yajamānāśca dadurdānāni koṭiśaḥ ।
evaṃ yajñe vartite'tha madhyāhne bhojanāni ha ।। 14।।
cakrurmakhasya vai sarve prāsādikānnajāni vai ।
muktāstathā'vatārāścā'vatāriṇyo haripriyāḥ ।। 15।।
pārṣadāḥ pārṣadānyaśca sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ।
satyaḥ sādhvyaśceśvarāṇya īśvarā devatāstathā ।। 16।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā dikpālā lokapālakāḥ ।
mānavā daityayakṣāśca dānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ।। 17।।
api kīṭapataṃgādyā vṛkṣāḥ stambāśca vallayaḥ ।
tattvānyapi jaḍānyeva cetanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ।। 18।।
nāmarūpamayaṃ sarvaṃ yatkiñciddharinirmitam ।
sarvaṃ prasādamāsādya tṛptiṃ jagāma cādhvare ।। 1 9।।
hariḥ kuṭumbasahito'nugairyuktaśca sevibhiḥ ।
vrahmapriyābhiḥ sahito bubhuje carubhojanam ।।2.211.20 ।।
miṣṭānnāni ca śākāni rasasnigdhāni yāni ca ।
divyāni cāpi sarvāṇi bubhuje bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
bhojanottaramevātra sannidhau śrīharestadā ।
rājā dvaipāyanadvīpapatiḥ rājñīsamanvitaḥ ।।22।।
rāyabāleśvaro nāmnā prārthayatparameśvaram ।
mālāvanarṣisahito vāyuphenāpurīṃ prati ।।।23।।
netuṃ svarāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hāritāsmāritāpatim ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tūrṇaṃ sajjo'bhavattadā ।।24।।
lomaśena kuṭumbena śaṃkareṇa saha prabhuḥ ।
vimānaṃ divyamāsthāyā'mbare'bhavat kṣaṇāntare ।।25।।
ṛṣiḥ rājā vimāne sve kuṭumbasahito'bhavat ।
pūrvaṃ svāgatadānārthaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ nijāṃ purīm ।।26।।
sainyaṃ sajjaṃ cakārā'sau tūrṇaṃ sammānanāya vai ।
prajāḥ puṣpādisāmagrīrdhṛtvā sajjāstathā'bhavan ।।27।।
vāyuphenānagaryāḥ sannidhāvudyānasaṃsthite ।
rājasaudhe mahāviśālāṃgaṇe ca yayustadā ।।28।।
tāvaddharervimānaṃ cāmbare'tyantasubhāsuram ।
samadṛśyata suryābhaṃ vādyāni vividhāni vai ।।29।।
avādyanta tathā ghoṣā jayayuktāstadā'bhavan ।
prajāstvekāgradṛṣṭyaiva vīkṣituṃ tvaritāstadā ।।2.211.3 0।।
tāvacca sannidhau tūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ hi khe ।
rājñā darśitamārgeṇā'vātarat saudhasannidhau ।।3 1।।
mālāvanarṣirmālābhirvimānaṃ prāgavardhayat ।
prajā lājākṣatādyaiścā'vardhayat paritastataḥ ।।32।।
rājā mālāṃ svarṇahāraṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe samārpayat ।
pādau prakṣālya ca papau harirbahiḥ samāyayau ।।33।।
prajāḥ sragādibhistūrṇaṃ pupūjuḥ svāgatādibhiḥ ।
rājā saudhe hariṃ nītvā pupūja bahubhirdhanaiḥ ।।34।।
tato yāne tu sauvarṇe copaveśya pareśvaram ।
kuṭumbaṃ lomaśaṃ śaṃbhuṃ nagaryāṃ nītavānnṛpaḥ ।।35।।
sasainyaḥ śrīharirmārge sammānitaḥ prajājanaiḥ ।
pūjito vanditaścāpi vīkṣito bhāvanetrakaiḥ ।।36।।
ārpito bahuratnādyairdhanaiḥ sauvarṇarūpyakaiḥ ।
pradhānaiḥ pūjitaścāpi bhramitvā nagarīṃ tataḥ ।।37।।
āyayau rājasaudhaṃ taṃ niṣasāda nṛpāsane ।
upādideśa ca tadā prajābhyo hitakṛdvacaḥ ।।38।।
īṣyate bahubhiḥ kṛṣṇo vinā puṇyaṃ na labhyate ।
labhyate bahubhiḥ puṇyairvinābhāvaṃ na sevyate ।।39।।
sevyate bahubhirbhāvairvinā śraddhāṃ na rajyate ।
rajyate cārpaṇaiḥ sarvaistatrā'nugrahakāraṇam ।।2.211.40।।
anugraheṇa vivaśo bhavāmyeva svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
mayā''nugrahayuktena bhavaddeśo vilokitaḥ ।।41।।
sevā cāṃgīkṛtā premṇā nirguṇā muktidā hi sā ।
madyogo muktidaścāste sadā sarvasya dehinaḥ ।।42।।
yathājñānaṃ ca sevante prāpya māṃ dehinastviha ।
teṣāṃ tathaiva dātā'haṃ tathā'nugrahakārakaḥ ।।43।।
prasanno'haṃ dadāmyeva sukhaṃ rakṣāmi vighnataḥ ।
yogakṣemo karomyasya bhaktasya sevakasya me ।।44।।
sevābalāḍhyabhaktasya sarvaṃ sannihitaṃ śubham ।
sevābale bubhūṣedvai savaṃ balavato vaśe ।।45।।
sevābalaṃ sthitaṃ svasmiँttrāyate mahato bhayāt ।
sarvadharmādbalaṃ dharmaḥ sarvasaukhyapravartakaḥ ।।46।।
sevābale sthito dharmo dharme tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ sadā ।
mayi tiṣṭhati yāvacchrīḥ sarvasaukhyasya sādhanam ।।47।।
dhūmo vāyoriva vaśe sevāṃ dharmo'nuvartate ।
sevā balavatāṃ dharmaḥ sarvāpatyaḥ pravartate ।।48।।
nāstyasādhyaṃ sevakānāṃ prasannatvajuṣāmiha ।
madanugrahapātraṃ vai kṣipraṃ bahumataṃ bhavet ।।49।।
loke vai labhate pūjā paratreha mahatphalam ।
sukhaṃ sucitraṃ bhuñjīta śāśvataṃ ca tataḥ param ।।2.211.50।।
sevā satyena kartavyā devapitṛtapasvinām ।
atithīnāṃ satāṃ cāpyanāthānāṃ yoṣitaḥ tathā ।।5 1 ।।
asevā naiva kartavyā asevā droha eva tu ।
udvejanaṃ bhaved drohāt tena ruṣṭā bhavanti te ।।52।।
yeṣāṃ ruṣṭāśca gurvādyāsteṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ vilīyate ।
na teṣāṃ triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kaścana ।।53 ।।
yastān parivadeccāpi tannāśaṃ cāpi rocayet ।
svayaṃ nāśe gataḥ syāt sa tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ।।54।।
anāgatasya sandraṣṭā pratyutpannamatistathā ।
sevayā sukhamedhete tadvihīnau vinaśyataḥ ।।55।।
prāpte kāle bhavet sevā sā sevā mokṣadā matā ।
gate kāle gate deve gate śrīsaṃbhave tataḥ ।।56।।
sa lābho na bhavatyeva yo lābho'nugrahe'rthitaḥ ।
brahmavetṝn praseveta jñānavṛddhāँstapasvinaḥ ।।57।।
śrutacāritryavṛttāḍhyān sataḥ seveta bhūtaye ।
prītyā yaśo bhaveddivyamaprītyā śreyasāṃ kṣayaḥ ।।58।।
prītiṃ sampādayet sevāṃ kṛtvā satāṃ sa buddhimān ।
prītāḥ santo harirvāpi śaraṇāyaṃ prarakṣati ।।।59।।
kapotena śaraṇāyaḥ pūjito māṃsadānakaiḥ ।
lubdho'raṇye śabaro vai krūrakarmā ca niṣṭhuraḥ ।।2.211.60।।
janaḥ pāpasamācārastyaktaḥ svairbāndhavaiḥ purā ।
yayau vanaṃ tadā vṛṣṭirabhūt sarvātiśāyinī ।।6 1।।
jalaṃ jalaṃ hyabhūt sarvaṃ mahājalamayaṃ yathā ।
labhyante prāṇino naiva pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo'pi na ।।62।।
lubdhakaḥ sa tadā sāyaṃ tvekāṃ kapotikā vane ।
prāptavān pañjare tāṃ ca kṛtvā vṛkṣaṃ samāśritaḥ ।।63।।
lubdhakaḥ sa tadā rātrau vṛkṣaṃ matvā tu daivatam ।
sāñjaliḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā vākyamāha vanaspatim ।।64।।
śaraṇaṃ yāmi yānyasmin daivatāni vanaspatau ।
rakṣantu māṃ nirādhāraṃ śaraṇāgatamatra vaḥ ।।65।।
kṣudhitaḥ sa tu suṣvāpa mūle nidhāya mastakam ।
śākhāyāṃ vihagaścāste nāmnā citrakapotakaḥ ।।66।।
bhāryā tasya gatā bhakṣyaṃ carituṃ nāgatā tu sā ।
śuśoca bahudhā rātrau kapoto vṛṣṭipīḍitaḥ ।।67।।
manye bhāryā mṛtā me vai vātavṛṣṭibhiradya vai ।
api svasti bhavettasyāḥ priyāyā mama kānane ।।68।।
bhāryāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ tvadya śūnyaṃ me dṛśyate kila ।
putrapautravadhūbhṛtyadāsādyaiḥ pūritaṃ hyapi ।।69।।
na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityāhurgṛhiṇī gṛhameva yat। ।
patnīṃ vinā gṛhaṃ cāste'raṇyaṃ śūnyamivā'param ।।2.211.70 ।।
tayā vinā jīvanaṃ me vyapārthakaṃ hi lokyate ।
na bhuṃkte mayyabhukte yā nā'snāte snāti suvratā ।।7 1 ।।
nā'tiṣṭhatyupatiṣṭhetsā śete tu śayite mayi ।
hṛṣṭe bhavati sā hṛṣṭā duḥkhite mayi duḥkhitā ।।72।।
proṣite dīnavadanā kruddhe tu priyavādinī ।
pativratā patigatiḥ patipriyahite ratā ।।73 ।।
yasya syāt tādṛśī bhāryā dhanyaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sadā ।
sā ca śānta kṣudhārtaṃ ca jānīte māṃ tapasvinī ।।74।।
anuraktā sthirā caiva bhaktā snigdhā yaśasvinī ।
vṛkṣo'pi sadgṛhaṃ bhāti tayā yuktaṃ sukhāvaham ।।75।।
tadvihīno mahāsaudhaḥ kāntāra iva bhāti vai ।
dharmārthakāmakāryeṣu bhāryā puṃsaḥ sahāyinī ।।76।।
videśagamane cāpi viśvāsapātrikā hi sā ।
bhāryā vai paramaścārthaḥ puruṣasya sadā'sti hi ।।77।।
asahāyasya loke'tra bhāryā cāste sahāyinī ।
rogakṛcchrābhibhūtasya bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ hi sā ।।78।।
nāsti patnīsamo bandhuḥ sahāyo dharmasaṃgrahe ।
vinode paraloke ca gatau suhṛt tu sā saṭā ।।79।।
yasya sādhvī satī bhāryā ramyā ca priyavādinī ।
nāsti gṛhe ca tenātrā'raṇye gantavyameva tu ।।2.211.80 ।।
martavyaṃ veti rātrau sa vilāpaṃ kṛtavān bahum ।
taṃ vilāpaṃ prasuptenā'raṇye dhṛtā kapotikā ।।8 1 ।।
pañjarasthā praśuśrāva sasnehā vākyamabravīt ।
aho'tīva subhāgyā'haṃ yasyā me dayitaḥ patiḥ ।।82।।।
anājñāpālikāyā me guṇānevaṃ prabhāṣate ।
na sā strī hyabhimantavyā yasyāṃ bhartā na tuṣyati ।।83।।
tuṣṭe bhartari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।
bhasmībhavati sā nārī yasyā bhartā na tuṣyati ।
iti sañcintya bhartāraṃ kapotī vākyamabravīt ।।84।।
nātha vakṣyāmi sukhakṛt tattayā kartumarhasi ।
śaraṇāgatasevāyāṃ tatparo bhava sarvathā ।।85।।
ayaṃ śākuniko lubdhastava vāsaṃ samāgataḥ।
kṣudhārtasyā'nnadānena sevanaṃ puṇyadaṃ bhavet। ।।86।।
śaraṇāgatasevāyāḥ puṇyaṃ svargapradaṃ matam ।
sa tvaṃ sevaya kairātiṃ dehadānena vā priya ।।87।।
pūjāmasmai prayuṃkṣva tvaṃ śarīre mā spṛhāṃ vaha ।
iti śrutvā priyāvākyaṃ kapoto'dho jagāma ha ।।88।।
tamutthāpyā''ha bhadraṃ te svāgataṃ karavāṇi te ।
svagṛhe vartase cātra kimicchasi karomi te ।।89।।
tvamatra vanamadhye me śaraṇāgata āgataḥ ।
śatrāvapyucitaṃ kāryamātithyaṃ gṛhamāgate ।।2.211.90 ।।
yajñatulyaṃ phalaṃ tasyātithyakarturgṛhasthiteḥ ।
śrutvā kirātaścovāca śītaṃ kṣudhā ca me'dya vai ।।9 1 ।।
vādhete tannivṛttyarthaṃ yatnaḥ syācced vidhīyatām ।
kapotaḥ śīghramuḍḍīya karmāragṛhamāgataḥ ।।92।।
jvalatkāṇḍaṃ gṛhītvaiva cañcvā vṛkṣamupāyayau ।
śuṣkaparṇeṣu vahniṃ cā'dīpayallubdhako'tapat ।।93।।
śītaṃ gataṃ tataḥ prāha bhojanaṃ dehi me priya ।
kapotaḥ prāha me nāsti sañcayo vanavāsinaḥ ।।94।।
nityoñcchavṛttyā jīvāmi nāśayeyaṃ kathaṃ kṣudhām ।
kintu svātmapradānena tarpaye tvāṃ nu manyase ।। 95।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ।
satīnāṃ ca satāṃ pūjāṃ kuryādātmārpaṇairapi ।।96।।
ityuktvā triḥparikramyā'gniṃ viveśa vihaṃgamaḥ ।
bhakṣayeti gṛṇan vākyaṃ natvā'tithiṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 97।।
lubdhako'pi kapotaṃ saṃvīkṣyāgnibharjitaṃ tadā ।
uppannakaruṇaḥ prāha pātakaṃ mitraghātajam ।।98।।
mamotpannaṃ nṛśaṃsasya prāyaścittaṃ nu kiṃ bhavet ।
aho dehapradānenātithyasevā pradarśitā ।।99।।
so'haṃ cāpi vane sthitvā cariṣye pāralaukikam ।
dharmaṃ karmaṃ cariṣyāmi dharmasevā parā gatiḥ ।। 2.211.10 0।।
ityabhidhāya śīghraṃ tatpañjaraṃ ca kapotikām ।
pramucya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti jajāpa bhaktimān yathā ।। 101 ।।
sā kapotīṃ patiṃ vīkṣya vahnidagdhaṃ tato'pyanu ।
satīdharmaṃ tadālambya vahniṃ viveśa duḥkhitā ।। 1 02।।
tataścitrāṃgadadharaṃ bhartāraṃ sā'nvapaśyata ।
vimānasthaṃ hi devībhiḥ pūjitaśca mahātmabhiḥ ।। 1 03।।
prāpi divyā surāṇī ca bhūtvā vimānagā'bhavat ।
lubdhakastau vimānasthau devau khe sandadarśa ha ।। 1 04।।
sevādharmaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kirāto'pi tapo'karot ।
atithīnāṃ sevanaṃ cākarod vananivāsinām ।। 1 05।।
pālanaṃ paśupakṣyādeḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam ।
dāvāgninā vane dagdhe bhasmībhūto'bhavattataḥ ।। 106 ।।
naṣṭakalmaṣa evā'sau japan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
divyāṃ gatiṃ jagāmaiva sevayā brahmasevinām ।। 1 07।।
evaṃ sevāṃ prakurvantu yāntu mokṣapadaṃ param ।7
ityuktvā rādhike kṛṣṇo virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'dhvaradevatāpūjanahomādyuttaraṃ bhojanaṃ, tato rāyabāleśvararāṣṭraṃ dvaipāyanadvīpaṃ ca pratigamanam । vāyuphenāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ
pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 211 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 211 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 212
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 213 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ svayam ।
dugdhaṃ papau bhojanaṃ ca cakāra sakuṭumbakaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tāvat pūjāṃ mahārājñī kartuṃ kanyāyutā''yayau ।
tisraḥ kanyā varamālāṃ daduḥ kaṇṭhe harestadā ।। 2 ।।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँstā rājñī mene subhāgyakam ।
rājā koṭisuvarṇāni pradadau haraye tadā ।। 3 ।।
prajā mahotsavaṃ cakre pūjanaṃ ca harestataḥ ।
pūjāṃ labdhvā drutaṃ kṛṣṇo vimānaṃ cādhyarohayat ।। 4 ।।
sarvān svayaṃ cāruroha rājā sainyena vai tadā ।
vidāyamānaṃ sammānaṃ vyākarod vādakaistathā ।। 5 ।।
svayaṃ vimānamāruhya sarṣistadā'mbare'bhavat ।
deśān rājye suyuktāँśca vīkṣya harirnṛpānvitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sādhudvīpaṃ tato vīkṣya haṭṭāsanābdhimāpya ca ।
ullaṃghya śīghramevā''pā'dhvarabhūmiṃ niśāmukhe ।। 7 ।।
bhojanaṃ madhuraṃ cakre viśaśrāma sukhoṣitaḥ ।
tisraḥ kanyā hareḥ sevāṃ cakrire śayane tadā ।। 8 ।।
prātastūryaninādaiśca māṃgalikastavaistathā ।
gītibhirbrahmapatnīnāṃ prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛtasnānādikastūrṇaṃ prapūjya pitarau gurūn ।
yajñabhūmau haristūrṇaṃ tatrājagāma sānvayaḥ ।। 2.212.1 0।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage viprā munayo'pi maharṣayaḥ ।
sādhavaḥ karmaṭhāścānye yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।। 11 ।।
devādyāḥ sthānabhoktāraḥ sarve svasthānamāyayuḥ ।
niṣedurvahnayaḥ kuṇḍamadhye mūrtā yathocitam ।। 12।।
svastivāco'bhavaँstatra puṇyāhavacanāni ca ।
prokṣaṇānyudbodhanāni pūjanānyabhavan kramāt ।। 13।।
havanāni tarpaṇāni yathānityaṃ tathā'bhavan ।
antimaṃ homakāryaṃ ca parihāro'bhavattathā ।। 14।।
havyānāṃ bhojanānyevā'bhavaiँstadvratapuṣṭaye ।
anannā'hāramāpuste śrīhareḥ karataḥ surāḥ ।। 15।।
tṛptāstatra mahātṛptiṃ gatā hariprasādajām ।
atha tatra mahādravyadakṣiṇāḥ svarṇaratnajāḥ ।। 16।।
koṭyabjārbudapadmānāṃ parārdhānāṃ parātparāḥ ।
viprebhyo'dāpayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca rājabhiḥ ।। 17।।
tataḥ sarve'pi rājāno rājñīyuktā nije nije ।
kuṇḍe cakrurhavanāni pūrṇāhutyātmakāni vai ।। 18।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'pi mukhyakuṇḍake ।
pūrṇāhutīrdadau vahnau devatābhyo'mṛtātmikāḥ ।। 19।।
tataścacāra bhagavān mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ parām ।
tadā muktā avatārā īśvarā munayastathā ।।2.212.20।।
ṛṣayo devatāḥ sarvā devyaśca mānavādayaḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā mūrtimanto narāḥ striyaḥ ।।21।।
caruprasādalābhārthaṃ mahāpūrṇahavāptaye ।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve copatasthurhi maṇḍape ।।22।।
ghṛtadhārāsahasrādyaistṛpyante devatādayaḥ ।
vasudhārāyutādyaiśca tṛpyante'nantasṛṣṭayaḥ ।।23 ।।
mahāpūrṇāhutihomasaṃkalpottarameva tu ।
mṛḍaṃ vahniṃ namaskṛtyā''jyaṃ cādhiśritya sruksruvau ।।24।।
pratāpya darbhaiḥ sammṛjyodvāsyājyamabhivīkṣya ca ।
saṃskṛtyā''jyaṃ gṛhītvā śrīphalaṃ sruci nidhāya ca ।। 25।।
tāmbūlaṃ ca phalānyatra pūgā'kṣatādikāni ca ।
dhṛtvopari ca samidho'laṃkṛtya puṣpacandanaiḥ ।।26।।
pūrṇāhutyai nama iti saṃpūjya havyameva ca ।
dhṛtvā karābhyāṃ bhagavān rājādyā yajamānakāḥ ।।27।।
sthitāḥ praṇālikādvārā ghṛtadhārāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
kuṇḍamadhye pravahantyavicchinnāśca tadā muhuḥ ।।28।।
vedamantrā abhavaँścoccaritā vahnidevatāḥ ।
vahnerdhyānaṃ tadā cakruḥ sākṣāt sthitasya hominaḥ ।।29।।
catuḥśṛṃgaṃ tridhā baddhaṃ dvimūrdhānaṃ samujjvalam ।
nāsādvayaṃ ca ṣaṇṇetraṃ catuḥśrotraṃ tripādakam ।।2.212.3 0।।
saptahastaṃ dakṣe catuḥkaraṃ vāme trihastakam ।
sruvaṃ srucaṃ tathā śaktimakṣamālāṃ ca dakṣiṇe ।।3 1 ।।
tomaraṃ vyajanaṃ caiva ghṛtapātraṃ tu vāmake ।
dadhānaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca trirjihvottarakānanam ।।32।।
caturjihvaṃ dakṣabhāge dvipañcāśatkalāyutam ।
koṭidvādaśamūrtyākhyaṃ raktapadmāsanasthitam ।।33।।
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārairaṃkitaṃ raktahāriṇam ।
piṃgākṣaṃ lohitagrīvaṃ kṛṣṇamārgaṃ hutāśanam ।।34।।
jvālāmayaṃ tathā saptārciṣaṃ taṃ havyavāhanam ।
agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ tvāṃ vai namāmo gocaraṃ suram ।।35।।
iti dhyātvā tathā natvā vedamantrān jagurdvijāḥ ।
ghṛtadhārāḥ patantyeva tatra sahasraśo'nale ।।36।।
oṃ samudrādūrmirmadhumāँ udāradupāँśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ ।
ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ।।37।।
vayannāmapprabravāmāghṛtasyā'smin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ ।
upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṃgovamīdgaura etat ।।38।।
catvāri śṛṃgāstrayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe saptahastāso asya ।
tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti mahodevo martyānāviveśa ।।3 9।।
tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvaviṃdan ।
indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ।।2.212.40।।
etā arṣanti hṛdyāt samudrācchatavrajāripuṇānāvacakṣe ।
ghṛtasya dhārā abhicākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ।।41।।
samyaka sravanti sarito'naghenā'antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ ।
ete'arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇo rīṣamāṇāḥ ।।42।।
sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vvātappramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ ।
ghṛtasya dhārā'aruṣona vvājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānāḥ ।।43।।
abhipravaṃta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso'agnim ।
ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho na santatā juṣāṇo haryyati jātavedāḥ ।।44।।
kanyā iva vvahatumetavā'u 'aṃjyaṃjānā'abhicākaśīmi ।
yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā'ati tatpavante ।।45।।
abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta ।
imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ।।46।।
dhāmaṃ te viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhiśritamantaḥsamudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi ।
apāmanīke samitheya'ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ।।47।।
oṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ājātamagnim ।
kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ।।48।।
oṃ citiṃ juhomi manasā ghṛtena yathā devā ihā'gaman vītahotrā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ।
patye viśvasya bhūmano juhomi viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhādābbhyaṃ haviḥ ।।49।।
sapta te agne samidhaḥ ṣaptajihvāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ saptadhāma priyāṇi ।
saptahotrāḥ saptadhātvā yajanti saptayonīrāpṛṇasvā ghṛtena svāhā ।।2.212.50।।
śukraṃ jyotiśca citrajyotiśca satyajyotiśca ।
jyotiṣmāँśca śukraśca ṛtapāścātyaṃhāḥ ।।51 ।।
īdṛṅtvānnyādṛṅca sadṛṅc pratisadṛṅca ।
mitaśca saṃmitaśca sabharāḥ ।।52।।
ṛtaśca satyaśca dhruvaśca dharuṇaśca dhartā ca vidhartā ca vidhādhayaḥ ।
ṛtajicca satyajicca senajicca suṣeṇaśca antimitraśca dūre'amitraśca guṇaḥ ।।53।।
īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsa ūṣuṇaḥ sadṛkṣāsaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsa etana ।
mitāsaśca sammitāso no'adya sabharaso maruto yajñe'smin ।।54।।।
svatavāँśca praghāsī ca sāntapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca śākī cojjeṣi ।
ugraśca bhīmaśca dhvāntaśca dhuniśca sāsahvāṃścābhiyugvā ca vikṣipaḥ svāhā ।।55।।
punastvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇovvasunītha yajñaiḥ ।
ghṛtena tvaṃ tannvanvardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ।।56 ।।
vasoḥ pavitramasi śatadhāraṃ vasoḥ pavitramasi sahasradhāram ।
devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa suppvāvākāmadhukṣaḥ ।।57।।
pūrṇā darvvi parāpata supūrṇā punarāpata
vasneva vvikrīṇāvahā iṣamūrjjaṃ śatakrato svāhā ।
idamagnaye vaiśvānarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ śatakratave adbhyaśca namama ।।58।।
idaṃ diviṣadbhyo bhuvaḥ sadbhyo mahaḥṣadbhyo
janasadbhyastapaḥsadbhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ satyasadbhyaścā''vṛtiṣadbhyaśceśvarebhyo
virājāya mahāvirājāya namama ।।59।।
idaṃ viṣṇubhyo mahāviṣṇubhyo hiraṇyagarbhebhyo namama ।
idaṃ bhūmabhyo mahāpuruṣebhyo mahākālebhyaścaturvyūhebhyo namama ।।2.212.6 0 ।।
idaṃ cākṣarāya cākṣaraṣadbhyo'vatārebhyo'vatāriṇe namama ।
idaṃ brahmapriyābhya īśanībhyo dhāminībhyaḥ satībhyo namama ।।6 1 ।।
idaṃ pārṣadebhyaḥ pārṣadānībhyo gaṇebhyo gaṇanībhyo namama ।
idaṃ yogibhyo yoginībhyaḥ sarvapālebhyaḥ kṣetrapebhyo namama ।।62।।
idaṃ maharṣibhyaśca pitṛbhyo vāyavīyebhyo jalīyebhyo namama ।
idaṃ yamīyebhyaḥ kāśyapīyebhyo yakṣebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca namam ।।63।।।
idaṃ mānavebhyo mānavībhyaḥ pāśavībhyaḥ paśubhyaśca namama ।
idṃ pākṣiṇībhyaśca pakṣibhyaḥ sṛpebhyaśca sṛpībhyaśca namama ।।64।।
idaṃ dāsebhyaśca dāsībhyaśca pādapebhyo vallībhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ tṛṇebhyaśca stambebhyaśca virudbhyaśca mūlebhyo namama ।।65।।
idaṃ tīrthebhyaśca nadībhyaścā'bdhibhyaśca taḍāgebhyo namama ।
idaṃ caityebhyaśca jaḍebhyaśca tattvebhyaśca cetanebhyo namama ।।66।।
idaṃ daityebhyaśca bhūtebhyaśca piśācebhyaśca bhūtinyādibhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ adhobhyaścoparibhyaścāntarebhyaśca pārśvagebhyo namama ।।67।।
idaṃ sādhyebhyaśca tāpasebhyaśca sāṃkhyayoginībhyaśca namama ।
idamaṃśebhyaśca kalābhyaścā''veśebhyaśca vibhūtibhyo namama ।।68।।
idaṃ arcābhyaścāntaryāmiṇe ca svarūpebhyo rūpebhyo namama ।
idaṃ vibhavebhyaśca pratibimbebhyaścāvatīrṇebhyaśca namama ।।69।।
idaṃ tyāgibhyaśca yatibhyaśca śīlibhyaśca brahmiṣṭebhyo namama ।
idaṃ guṇebhyaśca kriyābhyaśca rasebhyaśca priyābhyaśca namama ।।2.212.70 ।।
idaṃ garbhebhyaśca bālebhyaśca yuvabhyaśca sthavīrebhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ pretebhyaśca vṛṣavandhebhyaśca kālebhyaśca namama ।।71।।
idaṃ kośebhyaścendriyebhyaśca
śaktibhyaśca devatābhyo namama ।
idaṃ māyābhyaśceśānebhyaśceśānībhyaśca
vaiṣṇīvībhyaśca namama ।।72।।
idaṃ brāhmībhyaśca brahmāṇībhyaśca
vairājībhyaśca bhūmnībhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ dhāmabhyaśca vikuṇṭhābhyo
hāritābhyaḥ śvetābhyaśca namama ।।173।।
idaṃ piśaṃgībhyaśca raktābhyaśca
gaurībhyaḥ smāritābhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ lakṣmyai rādhikāyai sarasvatyai
durgāyai gaṃgāyai namama ।।74।।
idaṃ virajāyai padmāvatyai ramāyai
māṇikyai maṃjulāyai namama ।
idaṃ kamalāyai haṃsāyai camṛtāyai
sadguṇāyai sudevyai ca namama ।।75।।
idaṃ duḥkhahālakṣmyai santuṣṭāyai cāmarībhyaḥ
kambharāyai śriyai namama ।
idaṃ dharmāya ca vṛṣāya ca gopālāya ca
bhagavate vallabhāya ca namama ।।76।।
idaṃ śukāya ca svataḥprakāśāya ca
mahāvyāsāya ca daivādhikāśāya ca namama ।
idaṃ brahmasṛṣṭyai ceśasṛṣṭyai jīvasṛṣṭyai
sarvasṛṣṭyai asṛṣṭyai ca namama ।।77।।
idaṃ viśiṣṭāya pareśāyā'nādikṛṣṇa-
nārāyaṇāya svāmine namama ।
idaṃ yajñāya ca havyāya ca pātrebhyaśco-
pakaraṇebhyaśca śrīkṛṣṇavallabhāya ca namama ।।78।।
idaṃ kuṇḍāya ca vedebhyaśca
maṇḍapāya ca svarebhyaśca namama ।
idṃ mahīmānebhyaśca dīnebhyaścā-
'nāthebhyaśca kīṭebhyaśca namama ।।79।।
idaṃ bhikṣukebhyaśca nyāsibhyaśca bhṛtyebhyaśca
sāśebhyaścāntevāsibhyaśca namama ।
idṃ pratīkṣadbhyaścā'pratīkṣadbhyaśca
mūrtebhyaścā'mūrtebhyaśca tattvebhyaśca namama ।।2.212.80।।
idaṃ līnebhyaścā'līnebhyaścāgatebhyaścā-
nāgatebhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ lokibhyaścā'lokibhyaśca dehibhyaścā-
'dehibhyaśca paricchinnebhyaśca namama ।।8 1 ।।
idaṃ smṛtebhyaścā'smṛtebhyaścograkebhyaścā-
'nugrakebhyaścā'paricchinnebhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ sāttvikebhyaśca rājasebhyaśca
tāmasebhyaśca trikāspṛṣṭebhyaśca namama । ।82 ।
idamindriyavadbhyaścānindriyebhyaśca
kalalebhyaśca bījebhyaśca sūkṣmebhyo namama ।
idaṃ yāvadbhyaśca prayāvadbhyaśca parāṇubhyaścā-
'naṇubhyaścāṃ'kurebhyaśca namama । ।82 ।।
idaṃ kāmebhyaśca ratibhyaścaiśvaryebhyaścā-
'vṛṣebhyaśca yonibhyaśca namama ।

idaṃ rājabhyaśca prajābhyaśca śraddadhānebhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ vaṃśebhyaśca pravaṃśebhyaścānuvaṃśebhyaśca namama ।।86।।
idaṃ satībhyaśca garbhiṇībhyaśca prasūtābhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ viṣibhyaśca daṃṣṭribhyaśca śṛṃgibhyaśca namama ।।87।।
idaṃ mantribhyaśca malibhyaścā'malibhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ hetibhyaśra veṣebhyaśca yantrebhyaśca namama ।।88।।
idaṃ gantrībhyaśca vimānebhyaśca yānebhyaśca namama ।
idaṃ kalpebhyaśca kalpadrubhyaśca kalpavallībhyaśca namama ।।89।।
idaṃ dhenubhyaśca kāmadughābhyaśca cintāmaṇibhyaśca namama ।
idṃ brahmasarase brahmahradāyāmṛtadhārāyā'kṣayapātrāya namama ।। 2.212.90 ।।
idaṃ caitasmai cetadvṛttaye mahākṛṣṇāya bālakṛṣṇāya namama ।
idaṃ brahmaṇe ca parabrahmaṇe ca nārāyaṇāya paramātmane namama ।। 9 1 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike havyāhutayo'nantanāmabhiḥ ।
dīyante kuṇḍake vahnau sākṣād devapradāya vai । । 92।।
āgatyāgatya sarve te gṛhṇanti vahnikānanāt ।
tṛptāḥ prayānti sukhinaḥ sodgārāḥ sāśiṣastadā ।। 93 ।।
evaṃ kṛtaṃ hi havanaṃ nārikelādibhistadā ।
mahāpūrṇāhutiprakhyaṃ bālakṛṣṇo'nale śubhe ।। 94।।
divyarūpo'bhavad dṛśyaḥ sarveṣāmeva dehinām ।
viśvaṃbharaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃkte havyāni vividhāni vai ।। 9 5।।
antarbhāvya tu tāँstāँśca tṛptastṛptiṃ dadāti vai ।
śarkarā madhuparkāśca caravaśca phalāni ca ।।96।।
ghṛtāni vrīhayo divyā rasā miṣṭānnakāni ca ।
amṛtāni sudhāścāpi peyāni vividhānyapi ।। 97।।
kaṇabhūjāni sasyāni bījāni samidhastathā ।
dugdhasārāṇi cānyāni hūyante cānale harau ।।98।।
yadyalloke tu yānyeva yeṣāṃ khādyāni santi ca ।
sattvabhāvāni tānyeva hūyante cānale harau ।। 99।।
yeṣāṃ yat tṛptikṛccāpi sarvajño bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
tatpradāyaiva taṃ tāṃ vā tarpayatyeva cānale ।। 2.212.1 00।।
evaṃ pūrṇāhutirjātā mahāpūrṇāhutistathā ।
tṛptaṃ jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tṛptaṃ vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam ।। 101 ।।
tṛptaṃ sṛṣṭeḥ paraṃ cāpi sarvaṃ vai brahmamaṇḍalam ।
tato devādayaḥ prāhuḥ pacyante nodare'dhunā ।। 1 02।।
havyānīti parihāraṃ karotu parameśvaraḥ ।
ityevaṃ devakoṭīnāṃ ghoṣaṇāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ।।1 03।।
tṛptaḥ prasannaścodgāraṃ prāpya homāntakaṃ vyadhāt ।
mahāpūrṇāhutau home jāte nārāyaṇāstadā ।
amṛtākhyaphalānyagnau juhuvurdhāmajāni vai ।। 1 04।।
muktāḥ kalpamayānyeva phalāni juhuvustadā ।
īśvarā aiśvarasudhāphalāni juhuvustadā ।। 1 05।।
ṛṣayo devatāścāpi pīyūṣaphalakāni ca ।
juhuvurmānavā nārikelāni śarkarāstathā ।। 106 ।।
parvatāścandanādīni dhenavaḥ pāyasānyapi ।
drumā rasān śreṣṭhagundrān juhuvuḥ sarvaśastadā ।। 1 07।।
sasyāni juhuvustatra śālikaṇādikān śubhān ।
vallayo miṣṭapuṣpāṇi devyo miṣṭānnakāni ca ।। 1 08।।
yathā yeṣāmabhūt smṛddhistathā phalādikāni vai ।
juhuvustatra kuṇḍāgnau parameśe parātpare ।। 1 09।।
patravantastu patrāṇi gandhavantaḥ sugandhakān ।
tvagvantaśca tvacaḥ śreṣṭhā juhuvustatra cānale ।। 2.212.11 0।।
trailokyāṃ vyānaśe dhūmraḥ sugandhimiṣṭatṛptidaḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ tadā tṛptaṃ harau tṛpte hi rādhike ।। 11 1।।
evaṃ yajño mahān jāto madhyāhne'bhūt samāptimān ।
devānāṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca visarjanam ।। 1 12।।
cakāra bhagavān sākṣād dakṣiṇādānamityapi ।
bhikṣukāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ bhojanādīnyakārayat ।। 1 13।।
ācāryādyā yathāyogyāḥ sāmagrīrjagṛhuśca tāḥ ।
yajñīyā dakṣiṇādyāśca parihārastato'bhavat ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caikādaśyāṃ mahāpūrṇāhutipradānaṃ sarveṣāṃ tṛptiryajñaparihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 212 ।।
