śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike yajñabhūmau vai kuṇḍe tvagnirmahānalaḥ ।
acumbata vyoma hṛṣṭaścāśīrvādān dadau tadā ।। 1 ।।
bhūmiśceyaṃ śāntivṛttiḥ śreṣṭhasmṛddhimayī sadā ।
nītisaukhyaprapūrāśca prajāḥ santu sadā tviha ।। 2 ।।
amaryaḥ sukhabhāgyāśca smṛddhāḥ santu sadā tviha ।
rājāno nyāyamārgasthā mahāsmṛddhā bhavantu vai ।। 3 ।।
kanyakāḥ sukhavatyaśca kumārāḥ smṛddhisaṃyutāḥ ।
prajā dīrghajīvavatyo bhavantu rogavarjitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
sasyasmṛddhiḥ sadā cāstu svarṇarūpyādibhūrilā ।
buddhimanto janāḥ santu striyaḥ saubhāgyasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 5 ।।
paśavo bahudugdhāśca pādapā rasasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
rasālā pṛthivī cāstu devatulyāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sāmrājyaṃ śreṣṭhasattākaṃ cāstu smṛddhaṃ dhanādibhiḥ ।
divyo bhavatu deśo'yaṃ khaṇḍāḥ santu samṛddhayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
pātrāṇi santu manujā devarṣigurupūjakāḥ ।
yajñā bhavantu loke'tra svarṇaṃ cāstu samunnatam ।। 8 ।।
ityevaṃ vahninā dattā āśīrvādā hi cādhvare ।
aśrūyanta janaiḥ sarvaiḥ prasannahṛdayaistadā ।। 9 ।।
evamāśīrvacanāni datvā vahnistiro'bhavat ।
yajñabhasmaprasādaṃ ca jagṛhurdehinastadā ।। 2.213.1 0।।
yajñe parihṛte cājñā bhojanānāṃ tadā'bhavat ।
dīyante miṣṭabhojyāni tadā sarvavidhāni hi ।। 1 1।।
bhuṃjate dehinaḥ paṃktibaddhā īśasurādikāḥ ।
mānavāścānyajātīyāstadā miṣṭānnamadhvare ।। 1 2।।
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti ।
gṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāṃ ceti vadanti pariveṣakāḥ ।। 13।।
asaṃkhyānnaṃ tathā dravyamasaṃkhyaṃ dīyate tadā ।
ambarāṇi hyasaṃkhyāni pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। 14।।
annānyapi vividhāni dīyante tatra cādhvare ।
ekādaśyāṃ mahādānānyādīyante samantataḥ ।। 15।।
rājabhiśca prajābhiśca svarṇapradhānakāni vai ।
rādhike ye mahīmānāste'pi dadati sarvaśaḥ ।। 16।।
grāhakāśca gṛhītvaiva dadatyaparayācine ।
koṭiśo dehinastatra bhuñjate havyamuttamam ।। 17।।
evaṃ samutsave jāte'vabhṛthārthaṃ prabhurjanān ।
munīn prajājanānāha nadīsaraḥsamāgame ।। 18।।
snātuṃ gantavyamevā'dya sajjā bhavantu vai drutam ।
paṭaho vai mahāँstatra tāḍito ghoṣaṇākṛte ।। 19।।
avabhṛthārthaṃ cāyāntu bhagavāँstatra yāti vai ।
yāni kāni ca pāpāni jantudrohodbhavāni ca ।।2.213.20।।
karmakāṇḍasya vaiguṇye samutthāni ca yānyapi ।
kaṇaśālisamiddhome yāni vā duritāni ca ।। 21 ।।
teṣāṃ vināśanārthaṃ vā'vabhathaṃ śasyate sadā ।
avabhṛthe'vatāraiśceśvarairdevaiśca mānavaiḥ ।।22।।
snātavyaṃ varuṇaṃ sampūjyaivā''pūjya ca vāri ca ।
āmalakīphalaiścāpi bhasmanā ca ghṛtena ca ।।23।।।
tīrthamṛdā tilaiścāpi snātavyaṃ vāribhistadā ।
ityevaṃ paṭahenāpi bodhitā mānavādayaḥ ।।24।।
īśvarā devatāścāpi nārāyaṇā nareśvarāḥ ।
devyaḥ satyo bhagavatyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ।।25।।
vādyaghoṣairgītibhiścāyayustvabhṛthāya vai ।
śeṣakāṣṭhavanānadyā vinipārasarovare ।।26।।
saṃgame pāvane sasnurvidhinā makhinastadā ।
yatra yatra taṭe ye ye tvabhavaँstatra tatra te ।।27।।
sasnuḥ sampūjya varuṇaṃ tīrthāni ca jalāni ca ।
bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇo brahmapriyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।।।28।।
sasnurdevāstathā devyastīrthottamaṃ hyabhūjjalam ।
nārāyaṇā'vatārāśca tathā rādhāramādayaḥ ।। 29।।।
sasnustatra tu tīrthāni pāvanānyapi śuddhaye ।
evaṃ cā'vabhṛthe jāte tvāyayurvai gṛhānnijān ।।2.213.3 0।।
tataḥ sabhā mahatyāsīt pāritoṣikalabdhaye ।
sarvebhyaḥ karmacāribhyastūpadāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ।।3 1।।
bhūṣā dravyāṇi ratnāni dīyante mādhavena vai ।
hārāḥ svarṇamayāścāpi śreṣṭhāmbarāṇi cāpi tu ।।32।।
suvarṇacandrakā ratnanaddhāḥ kāryaprasūcakāḥ ।
guṇāvedanarekhāśca makhacihnasamanvitaḥ ।।33 ।।
rūpyacandrāstathā caurṇakambalā'mbaraśāṭikāḥ ।
tantikāḥ kuṇḍale cāpi raśanāṃ'gulimudrikāḥ ।। 34।।
ūrmikāḥ kaṭakāścāpi mauktikānāṃ srajaḥ śubhāḥ ।
svarṇapātrāṇi ramyāṇi sthālikāḥ kalaśāstathā ।।35।।।
chatrāṇi cāmare cāpi vyajanāni vimānakam ।
siṃhāsanāni ramyāṇi paṭṭikā ca catuṣpadī ।।36।।
svarṇamaṇimahāhārā mālāśca hīrakaiḥ kṛtāḥ ।
pāritoṣikarūpeṇa dadau śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।37।।
kṣatriyebhyaścāyudhāni viprebhyo yājanāni ca ।
anyebhyastu yathāpekṣaṃ dadau vai pāritoṣikam ।। 38।।
mūrtayaḥ svarṇamayyo yāḥ prāṇaiḥ supratiyojitāḥ ।
pūjanārthaṃ dadau svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryakaḥ ।। 39।।
ācāryādeśamālambya bhūbhṛdbhyastatra cādhvare ।
evaṃ samāpya sarvaṃ vai kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntimāpa ha ।।2.213.40।।
tāvattatra samāgatya rāyalambārabhūpatiḥ ।
rūpartumaharṣiścāpi prārthayāmāsaturdrutam ।।41 ।।
kimuvakrān pradeśān nau kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ tathā ।
prapunīhi mahārājaikādaśyāmadya śobhanām ।।42।।
haristvathā'sviti prāhā''sahat sajjo vimānakam ।
kuṭumbena hareṇāpi lomaśena samanvitaḥ ।।43।।
rājā tūrṇaṃ yayau pūrvaṃ svāgatārthaṃ vimānagaḥ ।
hariḥ sāyaṃ yayau śīghraṃ kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ śubhām ।।44।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।
udyāne nijasaudhasya svāgataṃ cācaran nṛpaḥ ।।45।।
vādyāni bahuramyāṇi tadā'vādyanta sarvataḥ ।
prajā draṣṭuṃ samāyātā vardhayāmāsuracyutam ।।46।।
vimānācchrīharistatrodyāne bahirupāyayau ।
lājākṣatādibhiḥ puṣpaiścandanaiḥ parameśvaram ।।47।।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ prajādyā narayoṣitaḥ ।
rājā saudhe hariṃ natvā pupūja bahuratnakaiḥ ।।48।।
rājñī pūjāṃ cakārā'tha kanyakā bhūbhṛtastu ṣaṭ ।
vavrire bhagavantaṃ taṃ varamālāpradānakaiḥ ।।49।।
kṛtakṛtyāstu tā jātā rājā mumoda cāpyati ।
rājñī mumoda bahudhā dadāvupāyanāni ca ।।2.213.50।।
yautakaṃ pradadau rājñī nīrājanaṃ tato'karot ।
bhojayāmāsa dgdhādi pāyasaṃ śārṅgiṇe tadā ।।5 1 ।।
atha sainyena sahitaṃ tvācāryaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ।
nagaryāṃ bhrāmayāmāsa rājamārgeṇa bhūpatiḥ ।।52।।
pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaścānye vardhayāmāsurīśvaram ।
pupūjuśca prajāḥ sarvā vakriṇyaḥ kanyakāstathā ।।53।।
hāraiḥ phalairdhanaiścāpi kambalairambarādibhiḥ ।
vibhūṣābhiḥ samānarcuḥ sarvaṃ dhanaṃ haristadā ।।54।।
rūpartuṛṣaye prādād yautakaṃ nītavān saha ।
rājasaudhaṃ samāgatya niśi viśrāntimāpa ca ।।55।।
kanyāṣaṭkprasevāṃ ca gṛhṇan bubodha vai prage ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ payaḥ pītvā gantuṃ sajjo'bhavaddhariḥ ।।56।।
sūryodaye samāyācca sainyasammānito drutam ।
prāpya pūjāṃ yajñapṛthvyāṃ naijālaye hyavātarat ।।57।।
evaṃ vai rādhike kṛtvā kimuvakrāṃ purīṃ śubhām ।
pāvanīṃ dvādaśīprātaryajñasthalīṃ vyalokayat ।।58।।
mahīmānānsārvabhaumānākārayat sabhāsthale ।
muktā dhāmānyavatārā nārāyaṇāstatheśvarāḥ ।।59।।.
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā daityāśca mānavāstathā ।
khagā jalagāḥ pātālāvāsāḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ।।2.213.60।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi jaḍāśca cetanāstathā ।
dāsā bhṛtyāḥ svāminaśca svāminyaśca sabhāṃ yayuḥ ।।61 ।।
īśvarāṇyastathā nārāyaṇyaḥ satyaḥ surapriyāḥ ।
sarvapriyāścāyayuścāpsaraso mātṛkāstathā ।।62।।
yatinyo brahmasaraso brahmacāriṇya ityapi ।
sāṃkhyayoginya evāpi sṛṣṭayaścāgatāḥ sabhām ।।63 ।।
hariḥ prasanno bhagavān kalpadrudhenuvallikāḥ ।
kalpamaṇīn sevakāँśca pārṣadān sevikāstathā ।।64।।
parṣadyākārayāmāsā''yayuste tāḥ sabhāṃ tadā ।
siṃhāsaneṣu divyeṣu bhrājamāneṣu sūryavat ।।65।।।
āsīneṣu samasteṣu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'bravīt ।
āgatebhyo'vatārebhyaḥ sarvebhyaścāha mādhavaḥ ।।66।।
sammānanaṃ dhanyabhāvaṃ kurve'haṃ bhavatāmiha ।
dhāmānyapi vihāyaiva yajñārthaṃ yadupāgatāḥ ।।67।।
īśvarāṇāmīśvarīṇāṃ sammānaṃ dhanyabhāvanām ।
kurve'haṃ dūrataścāpi yajñārthaṃ yadupāgatāḥ ।।68।।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।।69।।
devānāṃ kāśyapīnāṃ ca prajānāṃ manujanmanām ।
sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।।2.213.70।
vṛkṣādīnāṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ vallīnāṃ virudhāṃ tathā ।
sanmānaṃ dhanyavādṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।।7 1 ।
tīrthānāṃ daivatatvānāṃ jaḍānāṃ ca citāmapi ।
sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।।72।
pātālatalavāsānāṃ jalasthalanivāsinām ।
vahnivāyunivāsānāṃ tīrthānāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ।।73 ।।
lokānāṃ ca diśāṃ pālakānāṃ ca karmacāriṇām ।
pārṣadānāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca gaṇeśānāṃ ca yoginām ।।74।।
sanmānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।
yajñārthaṃ kṛtayatnānāṃ sevakānāṃ samantataḥ ।।75 ।।
sevikānāṃ samastānāṃ kṣetrapānāṃ samantataḥ ।
dāsīnāṃ dāsavargāṇāṃ rakṣakāṇāṃ samantataḥ ।।76 ।।
sarvādhikāramāptānāṃ rasaśālākṛtāṃ tathā ।
dravyaśālārakṣakāṇāṃ saṃkalpavastusaṃjuṣām ।।77 ।।
dātṝṇāṃ ca nṛpāṇāṃ ca nṛpīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitām ।
viprāṇāṃ vedamantrāṇāṃ havyānāṃ makhapātriṇām ।।78 ।।
tattvānāṃ jaḍagranthīnāṃ caityānāṃ viśvakarmaṇām ।
sammānaṃ dhanyavādaṃ ca kurve yanmakhamāgatāḥ ।।79 ।।
vidāyaṃ prāñjaliṃ cātmaprasādatvaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
manmūrtiṃ svarṇarūpyādi sudhāmṛtāni sandade ।।2.213.8 0 ।।
mukuṭāni kaṭakāni sucandrakāṇi sandade ।
bhūṣāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi cāmbarāṇyapi sandade ।।8 1 ।।
chatrāṇi divyayānāni śāṭyādīni ca sandade ।
śirastrāṇāni ramyāṇi kauśeyāni ca sandade ।।82 ।।
hastyaśvaratharatnāni hīrakānapi sandade ।
śṛṃgārāṇi vicitrāṇi kañcukādīni sandade ।।83 ।।
akṣayānyapi pātrāṇi kalpavṛkṣādikān dade ।
kalpavallīḥ kalpadhenūḥ kalpamaṇīn dade ca vaḥ ।।84 ।।
divyajñānaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ divyatejo dade ca vaḥ ।
divyarddhiṃ śāśvatīṃ śāntiṃ bhaktiṃ sevāṃ dade ca vaḥ ।।85 ।।
divyasiddhīrmahālābhaṃ mamā'mṛtaṃ dade ca vaḥ ।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhācārya iṣṭakṛt ।। 86 ।।
dadau divyākṣarasvarṇakṛtakirīṭakuṇḍale ।
avatārebhya evādye īśvarebhyastataḥ param ।।87 ।।
lokapālebhya evāpi rājabhyaśca tataḥ param ।
evaṃ sarvebhya evāpi yathāyogyaṃ tvapekṣitam ।।88 ।।
naranārīsametebhyo dadau vai pāritoṣikam ।
prātaścaivaṃ dānakarma samācaraddharistataḥ ।।89 ।।
dāsabhṛtyādidehibhyo dhanāni vyataratprabhuḥ ।
svarṇahārān ratnahārān dadau yogyān punaḥ punaḥ ।। 2.213.90 ।।
nārībhyo nārikāyogyā dadau bhūṣāḥ suvarṇajāḥ ।
annapātrebhya evāpi dadāvannāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 91 ।।
vastrapātrebhya evāpi dadau vastrāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
bahubhyo gṛhadānāni dadau nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 12 ।।
rājadvārā'dāpayacca bhavanāni dvijātaye ।
evaṃ sarvaṃ dānakarma tvapārayatprabhuḥ svayam ।। 93 ।।
bhojanaṃ tu tataścaivā'kārayat sārvabhaumikam ।
pāraṇātma śubhaṃ miṣṭaṃ pāyasānnamabhojayat ।। 94।।
rasānnaṃ madhuparkānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।
sudhānnaṃ cāmṛtānnaṃ ca pīyūṣānnamabhojayat ।। 95 ।।
puṇyānnaṃ bhāvanānnaṃ ca phalānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।
kaṇānnaṃ cāpi munyannaṃ patrānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।। 96 ।।
bhājānnaṃ cāṃkurānnaṃ ca sasyānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।
jalīyānnaṃ pāvanānnaṃ cānalānnamabhojayat ।। 97।।
taijasānnaṃ ca dhāmānnaṃ sāttvikānnamabhojayat ।
śuddhasattvānnakaṃ līlāvibhūtyannamabodhayat ।। 98 ।।
ṛtvannaṃ cāpyaṛtvannaṃ dehajānnamabhojayat ।
kalpānnaṃ cāpi siddhayannaṃ siddhānnaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।। 99 ।।
bhāvanānnaṃ ca tṛptyannaṃ santoṣānnamabhojayat ।
ānandānnaṃ mahāsaukhyānnakaṃ sarvānabhojayat । । 2.213.100 ।।
takraṃ ca śarkarāṃ dugdhaṃ sūpaṃ tathaudanādikam ।
pūrikāṃ polikāṃ cāpi vyaṃjanānnānyabhojayat ।। 101 ।।
miṣṭānnāni kvathikāśca caṭanīḥ parpaṭādikān ।
sevikāśca tathā'pūpān saṃyāvaṃ cāpyabhojayat ।। 102।।
caṇakāँśca phullavaṭīrbharjitāścāpyabhojayat ।
meśubhāँśca sukhadāँśca mohasthālānabhojayat । । 103 ।।
cakrapārān sthirakāँśca granthakānapyabhojayat ।
rājikārāddhamevā'pi tvāranālānyabhojayat ।। 1 04।।
dadhighṛtaṃ navanītaṃ gūḍaṃ madhu hyabhojayat ।
amblavāna śaratpibaṃ cāmrarasānabhojayat ।। 105 । ।
phalāni tvārdraśuṣkāṇi bījānyapi hyabhojayat ।
mukhavāsān gandhikaṇān tāmbūlakānyabhojayat ।। 106 ।।
brahmahṛdasya salilaṃ sarvebhyo'pāyayat prabhuḥ ।
evaṃ prabhojayitvaiva svayaṃ tu bubhuje hariḥ ।। 107 ।।
kuṭumbena tu sahito brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।
rādhāramāsatīlakṣmīprabhāpāravatīyutaḥ ।। 108 । ।
māṇikīduḥkhahālakṣmīmaṃjulā'mṛtikāyutaḥ ।
saguṇāśāradāhaṃsādurgāsarasvatīyutaḥ ।। 109 ।।
pitarau bubhujāte ca lomaśādyā gurūttamāḥ ।
bubhujire ca sarve vai dehino mahīmānakāḥ ।। 2.213.110 ।।
gāṃgeyāścāmareyāśca maharṣayaśca kanyakāḥ ।
nadā nadyaśca tīrthāni bubhujire'tikaṇṭhataḥ ।। 111 ।।
madhyāhne śrīharistatra rājabhyo'bhojayattvati ।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ makhasya mahīmānakān ।। 11 re।।
gantumājñāpayāmāsa svasvalokānnijālayān ।
ṛte brahmapriyāḥ sarvāḥ ṛte lomaśakādikān ।। 113 ।।
ṛte naijaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ceśānaṃ satīṃ gaṇeśvaram ।
ṛte cāmarikarṣīṃśca ṛte ca tuṣitaṃ tathā ।। 1 14।।
ṛte ca saccidānandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ ca rādhikām ।
ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīm ṛte'śvasaraso janān ।। 1 15।।
ityevaṃ sarvathā cājñāṃ labdhvā labdhvā ca rādhike ।
pratasthire vimānaiḥ svaiḥ sāyaṃ śūnyamivā'bhavat ।। 1 16।।
racanānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ saṃhāraṃ viśvakarmiṇaḥ ।
sadāsā vai niśāyāṃ te cakruḥ sthalī prage'bhavat ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vahnerāśīrvādo bhojanāni, avabhṛthaṃ pāritoṣikāṇi, sāyaṃ hareḥ rāyalambāranṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ, kimuvakrāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ
pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ prātaryajñabhūmimāgamanaṃ, mahīmānasabhākaraṇaṃ sammānadhanyavādopadāpāritoṣikādidānaṃ, bhojanāni vidāyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhika-
dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 213 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 214
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 215 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike trayodaśyāṃ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ ।
haristvāsanamāsādya pūjāyāṃ saṃsthito'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
tāvattatra samāyāto rāyanavārkabhūpatiḥ ।
nijarāṣṭraṃ samānetuṃ bhagavantaṃ samārthayat ।। 2 ।।
haristathā'stviti prāha sarvān sajjān samākarot ।
rāyakinnarasamrājaṃ tvāhūya prāha tadvidhim ।। 3 ।।
rājā sampūjya kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ vidāyaṃ pradadau tataḥ ।
haristūrṇaṃ vimānaṃ svaṃ cā'varuhyā'mbare'bhavat ।। 4 ।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta vidāye pārameśvare ।
rokīśvaro raṇajicca mārīśo vāyukakṣakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
bāleśvaraśca lambārasta ete bhūbhatastadā ।
vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ cāpi sutābhyo haraye daduḥ ।। 6 ।।
sainyaiḥ sammānito vādyairgītikābhiḥ sabhājitaḥ ।
vimānena yayau tūrṇaṃ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
rāyanavārkabhūpasya rāṣṭraṃ miśrasurābhidham ।
miśrasurāsaridyoge supārīyasaro'ntike ।। 8 ।।
ciñcāgopurikāpuryā udyāne copakaṇṭhage ।
vāyuśṛṃgatanurnāmā ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇena vai saha ।। 9 ।।
vimāne cāgamat tatra rājā pūrvaṃ yayau tathā ।
svāgatārthaṃ hareḥ samyak sainyamasajjayad drutam ।। 2.214.1 0।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta prajānādāśca harṣajāḥ ।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāścā'bhavan digantacāriṇaḥ ।। 1 1 ।।
kanyakāḥ pramadāścāpyagāyan sugītikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
māṃgalyadravayuktāścāyayuḥ kṛṣṇasamīpagāḥ ।। 12।।
vimānaṃ nṛpabodhyena mārgeṇā'vātarad bhuvi ।
tadā'kṣatānāṃ lājānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt ।। 13 ।।
jayaśabdā jīvaśabdāḥ sarvānanebhya ābhavan ।
sthirādvimānakāt kṛṣṇo bahiścāgre hyupasthitaḥ ।। 14।।
tadā lokai rājabhiśca vardhitaḥ kanyakādibhiḥ ।
prakṣālya caraṇau rājā papau vāri ca ke nyadhāt ।। 15 ।।
tato dugdhaṃ dadau pānārthaṃ ca sarvebhya eva ca ।
sainyena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ puryāmabhrāmayanmudā ।। 16।।
prajāḥ pupūjuḥ premṇaiva pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastathā ।
narā nāryo hyamaryaśca miśrasuryaśca yoṣitaḥ ।। 17।।
dravyaiḥ puṣpairambaraiśca phalai ratnaiśca hīrakaiḥ ।
vividhairmukuṭaiścāpi bhūṣābhiḥ samapūjayan ।। 18।।
avardhayannañjalibhirhṛdayārpaṇabhāvanaiḥ ।
namanaiśca yathāśaktidānaiścāpi samarhaṇaiḥ ।। 1 9।।
bhramitvaivaṃ nagaryāṃ svaṃ datvā darśanamuttamam ।
āyayau rājasaudhaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇo'nugānvitaḥ ।।2.214.20 ।।
rājā pupūja ratnādyaiḥ sauvarṇairhārakaistathā ।
divyāmbarairdhanaiḥ śreṣṭhairdivyopadābhirādarāt ।।21 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi candanādyairapūjayat ।
papāta pādayoścāpi kṛtārtho'smīti saṃvadan ।।22।।
rājñyastasya catasraśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।
kanyakāḥ sapta bhūpasya tadā candranibhānanāḥ ।। 23।।
mumuhuḥ śrīpatau kānte jagṛhurmanasā patim ।
varamālā dadustāśca kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe suharṣitāḥ ।। 24।।
kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātā rājā rājñyo'pi vai tathā ।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi menire ।
rājotsavaṃ cakārāpi madhyāhne harṣasaṃbhṛtam ।। 25।।
tataḥ sarvān sumiṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।
tāmbūlakādikaṃ datvā yautakaṃ copadāṃ dadau ।।26।।
harirjagrāha sarvaṃ tat tanvartuṛṣaye dadau ।
yathāyogyaṃ nijayogyaṃ vimāne'sthāpayat tvapi ।। 27।।
viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ paścād rājā svarlatikāpurīm ।
nijāṃ gantuṃ hariṃ prāha hariḥ sajjo'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।।28।।
rājā pūrvaṃ yayau tatra puryāṃ sammānamācarat ।
vādyaghoṣaiḥ prajāharṣanādaiḥ puṣpādipūjanaiḥ ।।29।।
mahodyāne cāvatīrya vimānād bhagavāँstataḥ ।
rājoktarītyā nagare cābhramad darśanapradaḥ ।।2.214.3 0।।
pūjito vandito lokaiḥ vastubhiśca samārpitaḥ ।
dṛṣṭaścāvadhṛto naije hṛdaye parameśvaraḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vardhito bahudhā lokaiḥ prasanno'bhūtpareśvaraḥ ।
pūjāyāmāgataṃ vāyuśṛṃgatanvarṣaye dadau ।।32।।
viśaśrāma mahāsaudhe rājño divye suvarṇaje ।
tatrāyāto rāyahāṇḍeśvaro mākṣikarāṣṭrapaḥ ।।33।।
prārthayituṃ hariṃ naijaṃ rājyaṃ tathā''rthayattadā ।
hariḥ sajjo'bhavacchīghraṃ sāyaṃ sārthasamanvitaḥ ।। 34।।
rāyanavārkabhūpaśca vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau ।
vimānena haristūrṇaṃ vyomnā mākṣikarāṣṭrakam ।। 35।।
niśāmukhe samāyācca mākṣikānagarīṃ prati ।
vidyutprakāśaiḥ paritaḥ śobhamānāṃ mahāpurīm ।। 36।।
rāyahaṇḍeśabhūpaśca prāggatvā svāgataṃ vyadhāt ।
sainyena vādyaghoṣaiśca dhvajāpatākikādibhiḥ ।। 37।।
puṣpahārairjayaśabdairgītikābhiśca maṃgalaiḥ ।
candanādyaiḥ svāgataṃ śrīhareḥ rājā'karottadā ।। 38।।
vimānaṃ cāgataṃ pṛthvyāṃ harirbahiḥ samāyayau ।
anantaśākhavidyudbhiḥ kāśite ca divānibhe ।।39।।
vimānāgre hi bhagavān śuśubhe divi candravat ।
taṃ vilokya paraṃbrahma yoṣitaśca prajājanāḥ ।।2.214.40।।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ hariṃ candanapuṣpakaiḥ ।
akṣataiścāpi lājābhirgandhasārairmanoharaiḥ ।।41।।
rātrau rājā nagaryāṃ vai bhrāmayāmāsa mādhavam ।
sainyena sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajāḥ pupūjurutsukāḥ ।।।42।।
gopure cāṃgaṇe madhye catvare rājamārgake ।
haṭṭāgreṣu ca saudheṣu vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।43।।
dravyaiḥ suvarṇamudrābhiḥ phalaiḥ kuṃkumacandanaiḥ ।
ambarairnārikelādyairgandhasāraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।।44।।
puṣpahārai ratnahārairamūlyopasuvastubhiḥ ।
evaṃ nagaryāṃ bhagavān paribhramya nṛpālayam ।।45।।
āyayau ca sabhāṃ cakre rātrāvupādideśa ha ।
sarveṣāṃ svavṛttitayeṣyamāṇaṃ vai prayojanam ।।46।।
sukhaṃ ca duḥkhābhāvaścetyubhayaṃ vai prayojanam ।
sukhārthaṃ ceṣyate dharmo dharmāt sukhaṃ hi jāyate ।।47।।
anāgatasya duḥkhasyā'nāgamāya yateta vai ।
adharmo duḥkhadaḥ prokto'dharmo hyapuṇyanāmadhṛk ।।48।।
hiṃsanaṃ parapīḍādi drohaḥ pāpaṃ hyadharmakaḥ ।
steyaṃ cānṛtakaraṇaṃ ca pratāraṇaṃ hi pāpakam ।।49।।
anyāyavartanaṃ cāpi paranāśakarī kriyā ।
paravṛttivināśaśca paravastuvināśanam ।।2.214.50।।
svasya mokṣasya hānyādirjñānena varjanaṃ tathā ।
maurkhyaṃ ca nijapitroścā'sevanaṃ pātakāni vai ।।51 ।।
anyadravyādyāharaṇaṃ cāśritā'rakṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
vismṛtirdevadevasya pūjyānāṃ cāvamānanam ।।52।।
nārīṇāṃ pīḍanaṃ cāpi bālānāṃ pīḍanaṃ vṛthā ।
vṛkṣavallyādināśaśca vahnidānaṃ mahāvane ।।53।।
yatra jīvāḥ pradahyeyustatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ mahat ।
manuṣyeṇa na kartavyaṃ svātmanaḥ pīḍanaṃ tathā ।।।54।।
sukhaṃ dehasamutthaṃ vendriyajaṃ cātmajaṃ ca vā ।
sarvaṃ prayojanaṃ svasya sādhayatyeva mānavaḥ ।।55।।
anityaṃ tu sukhaṃ nāśaṃ prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
vicāryetthaṃ ca tannā'rjyaṃ cā'rjyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham । ।56 ।।
yajño dānaṃ dayā devāḥ satyaṃ ca sevanaṃ tapaḥ ।
sucāritryaṃ sukhadāni yogidharmā ime matāḥ ।।57।।
aṣṭaitāni pavitrāṇi śreyaḥ prasādadāni vai ।
puṇyatīrthābhigamanaṃ sukhadaṃ śāśvate hitam ।।58।।
puṇyadeśābhigamanaṃ pavitraṃ śreyasāṃpradam ।
martyo'nnadhanavastrādyaiścet samṛddhaśca jīvati ।।5 9 ।।
tadā yajñādikaṃ kṛtvā śāśvataṃ sukhamarjayet ।
puṇyatīrthāni santyeva sādhavo jagatāṃ hitāḥ ।।2.214.6 0।।
puṇyadeśāśca santyeva mandire pratimā hareḥ ।
tatra gatirmokṣagatistayā sukhaṃ hi śāśvatam ।।6 1 ।।
prāyaścittodvejanena jāyate pāpanāśanam ।
punarnaiva prakuryācced bhāvipāpāt pramucyate । ।6 2।।
satāṃ saṃgaṃ prakuryāccet kusaṃgāt parimucyate ।
sādhutīrthe parisnāto yamakleśātpramucyate ।।63 ।।
sādhutīrthī bhavet sādhurharitīrthī haro bhavat ।
sugandhasevī sugandhī syāt kṛṣṇagandhī bhavettataḥ ।।64।।
karmakṛtvā'bhimanyeta nāhamasmīti cetanaḥ ।
karmaṇā lipyate naiva padmapatramivā'mbhasā ।।61।।
chidrāṇi vivṛtānyeva sādhūnāṃ cāvṛṇoti yaḥ ।
pāpātipāpakṛccāpi sa kalyāṇaṃ prapadyate ।।66।।
yathā sūryastamonāśī tathā kalyāṇakṛjjanaḥ ।
sarvapāpābhihartā'pi sarvapāpavināśakaḥ ।।67।।
sevāparo jano nityamāśīrvādān pravindati ।
āyurannaṃ dhanaṃ saukhyaṃ vindati sevayā tataḥ ।।68।।
sādhūnāṃ sevayā saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ ।
sādhutīrthī bhavettasmānmānavo dīrghadṛṣṭiyuk ।।69।।
śāśvate sukhakośe te nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti keśave ।
tadāśrayiṇāṃ kośaḥ sa śāśvataḥ syādupasthitaḥ ।।2.214.70।।
ahaṃ kośaḥ śāśvato'smi mahānandapariplutaḥ ।
santo madānandayuktāḥ kurvantyāndino'parān ।।71 ।।
mukhyaṃ prayojanaṃ muktiḥ śāśvataṃ sukhameṣu vai ।
sādhuṣvevopalabhyeta sevyāḥ santastato'niśam ।।72।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān rādhike tataḥ ।
sabhānte nṛpatiḥ pūjāṃ cakāra dravyakoṭibhiḥ ।।73।।
suvarṇarūpyakapātrairambaraiśca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
mukuṭaṃ dhārayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya mastake ।।74।।
kaṇṭhe hārān ratnayuktān sauvarṇān śrīharerdadau ।
aurṇān komalaveṣāँścārpayāmāsa suvarṇinaḥ ।।75।।
suchatraṃ cāmare śreṣṭhe svarṇadaṇḍaṃ ca vetrakam ।
hīrakaimauktikairyuktā mālā dadau ca śobhanāḥ ।।76।।
ūrmikāḥ karakānyācchādanāni vividhāni ca ।
dadau sugandhasāraiśca puṣpā'kṣatairapūjayat ।।77।।
rājñī hīravatī kṛṣṇapūjāmārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt ।
tilakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ bhāle sākṣataṃ candrakaṃ vyadhāt ।।78।।
mastake'kṣatapuṣpādyairarhaṇāṃ cottamāṃ vyadhāt ।
dadau miṣṭānnakavalaṃ mukhe kṛṣṇasya sā tataḥ ।।79।।
svasyāḥ pārśve sthitāḥ kanyā nava prāha janeśvarī ।
kanyākāḥ! śrīpatiścāyaṃ rādhāsvāmī hi rājate ।।2.214.80।।
bahujanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairlabhyate draṣṭumityapi ।
eṣa sākṣānmilito'sti kṛpayā svagṛhe'dhunā ।।8 1।।
hṛdaye taṃ vāsayantu mā tyajantu kadācana ।
pūjayantu hariṃ premṇā sevayantu janārdanam ।।8 2।।
sadā bhaktiṃ prakurvantu śrīramākamalā iva ।
śrutvaivaṃ kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇe bālakṛṣṇe'timohitāḥ ।।83 ।।
mātṛvākyena puṣṭiṃ ca prāptāstaṃ kāntamacyutam ।
vavrire phullavadanā hṛṣṭā mālāpradānakaiḥ ।।84।।
varamālāḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhurnava tāḥ kanyakāḥ ।
tāsāṃ karagrahaṃ cakre bhagavān vidhinā tataḥ ।।85।।
utsavaṃ kṛtakṛtyaśca rājā cakāra vai niśi ।
bhojanāni tataḥ sarvasārthebhya pradadau nṛpaḥ ।।86।।
prajā api hareḥ pūjāṃ cakrustatrātibhāvataḥ ।
rādhādyā bhojanaṃ cakrūstataḥ kṛṣṇo niśāntare ।।87।।
kanyakāsevito nidrāṃ jagrāha kṣaṇameva tu ।
maṃgalairvādyaghoṣaiśca prabubodha prage drutam ।।88।।
trayodaśyāṃ kṛtasnānapūjanaśca payaḥ papau ।
papuścānye'pi dugdhādi huṇḍeśanṛpatergṛhe ।।89।।
prātaḥ ṛṣiśca vīrākajanarṣi śrīhariṃ prabhum ।
pūjayāmāsa vividhairvastubhirvedamantrakaiḥ ।।2.214.90 ।।
mahāpūjāṃ prakṛtvaiva mokṣaṃ vavre ca śāśvatam ।
hariḥ prāha samādhau tvaṃ tiṣṭharṣe mokṣamāvraja ।।9 1 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa ṛṣistūrṇaṃ dhyāne sthiro'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
tāvanmūrti harerdivyāmapaśyat hṛdaye śubhām ।।92।।
divyatejomayīṃ divyamuktādyaiḥ sevitāṃ tataḥ ।
vimānaṃ tvakṣarasaṃjñamapaśyattejasāvṛtam ।।93।।
bhagavāँstaṃ rādhike vai haste dhṛtvā vimānake ।
nītvā dhāmā'kṣaraṃ naijaṃ prāpayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।।94।।
rājādyāstu ṛṣerdehaṃ cikṣipurgartamadhyake ।
dehe jātaścamatkārastaṃ rādhe kathayāmi te ।।95।।
dehāt tatra samutpannā vīrā hetisamanvitāḥ ।
mahādehā baliṣṭhāśca hariṃ natvā'grataḥ sthitāḥ ।।96 ।।
vīrākajanaputrāste nivāsaṃ cārthayan prabhoḥ ।
haristebhyo dadau vāsaṃ śaṃbhorgaṇeṣu sarvadā ।।97।।
vīrāste ca janāste ca na tveśānaṃ satīṃ tataḥ ।
labdhājñāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kailāsaṃ śāśvataṃ sthalam ।।98।।
śaṃbhorlabdhamanavaste tāmasā vaiṣṇavāḥ sadā ।
vīrajanakhyātimanto'bhavan bhaktā harasya vai ।।99।।
atha śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ kāmbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum ।
rājā cakre daṇḍavacca cakre vai pādavāhanam ।। 2.214.1 00।।
sevāṃ kṛtvā tato nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt sa bhūpatiḥ ।
pādadhautajalaṃ divyaṃ papau tasthau samīpataḥ ।। 10 1।।
tāvat tatra samāyāto rāyakūpeśabhūpatiḥ ।
hariṃ netuṃ svanagarīṃ havānākhyāṃ suśālinīm ।। 1 02।।
hariḥ prāha tathāstvevaṃ śīghraṃ sajjo babhūva ca ।
huṇḍeśo yautakaṃ prādād yayāce ca kṣamāṃ hareḥ ।। 1 03।।
hariścābhayadānaṃ ca datvā vimānamāruhat ।
sārthāścāpi vimānasthā abhavan keśavājñayā ।। 1 04।।
rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca sammānārthaṃ jagāma ha ।
pūrvaṃ gatvā nijaṃ sainyaṃ nītvodyāne sthiro'bhavat ।। 1 05।।
rāyahuṇḍeśabhūpaśca vidāyaṃ mānanaṃ tathā ।
jayaśabdairvādyaśabdairgītibhiśca dadau tadā ।। 106 ।।
hareryānaṃ samāyācca havānāpurikāntikam ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāḥ prajākṛtāḥ ।। 1 07।।
mantravādāstvabhavaँśca mahodyāne tu rādhike ।
prajādyā harṣahṛdayā draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tadā'bhavan ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne
trayodaśyāṃ prātaḥ rāyanavārkanṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ ciñcāgopurikāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ svarlatikāpurīṃ pratigamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ sāyaṃ rāyahaṇḍeśvaranṛparāṣdragamanaṃ mākṣikānagaryāṃ
bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ hyupadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vīrākajanarṣipramokṣaṇaṃ rāyakūpeśanṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśā- dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 214 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 214 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 215
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 216 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'bdhisthe dvīpe kūpeśabhūpatiḥ ।
sammānaṃ śrīhareścakre kyūbākhye bahuśobhite ।। 1 ।।
jalayantrairvāhanaiśca naukābhiśca prajāstadā ।
havānāyā nagaryāḥ sannidhau tūdyānake'gaman ।। 2 ।।
vimānaṃ tvabdhitīrasya sannidhau bhūtale śubhe ।
avātarat tato rājā śrīkṛṣṇasannidhiṃ yayau ।। 3 ।।
nanāma pādayoścāpi puṣpahārān dadau gale ।
rājñī pupūja deveśaṃ puṣpalājā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।। 4 ।।
heyatāyanarājarṣiḥ pupūja parameśvaram ।
nagaryāṃ śrīhariṃ rājā bhrāmayāmāsa vāhanaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
suvarṇaśakaṭīmadhye niṣādya chatracāmaraiḥ ।
śobhitaṃ śrīhariṃ lokāḥ pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।। 6 ।।
dravyaiḥ phalaiścāmbarādyai ratnaiścandanakesaraiḥ ।
pūgīphalādibhirnārikelaiśca śarkarādibhiḥ ।। 7 ।।
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu naukāyāṃ niṣādya bhūpatiḥ svayam ।
abdhau vihārayāmāsa dvīpasya sannidhau tadā ।। 8 ।।
atha bhojanavelāyāṃ madhyāhne bhojanaṃ vyadhāt ।
bhagavān sārthayukto vai tadā rājñī samāgatā ।। 9 ।।
pūjanārthaṃ hariṃ tatra tatputrīṃ haraye dadau ।
tāmbūlaṃ kāntamālāṃ ca kaṇṭhe nyadhāddharerhi sā ।। 2.215.10 ।।
kanyā prāpya patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtakṛtyā babhūva sā ।
mātā cātiprasannā'bhūd rājotsavaṃ cakāra ha ।। 1 1।।
tato viśrāntimāpā'yaṃ bhagavān bhavanottame ।
athā''yād darśanārthaṃ hi kanyāyā mātulo nṛpaḥ ।। 12।।
kulambāyanarāṣṭreśo vigoṣṭhānagarīpatiḥ ।
nāmnā kālīmaṇḍalīnaḥ pupūjāpi sa mādhavam ।। 13 ।।
śrīhariṃ cārthayāmāsa svarāṣṭragamanāya hi ।
haristathāstviti prāha tadā sajjo'bhavad drutam ।। 14।।
kūpeśaśca vidāyaṃ śrīharaye yautakaṃ dadau ।
yayau kālīmaṇḍalīnaḥ pūrṇāsanarṣiyuk puraḥ ।। 15।।
bhagavān svavimānastho vyomnā yayau vigoṣṭhikām ।
samudraṃ samatītyaiva sāyaṃ tvavāpa tāṃ purīm ।। 16।।
rājā sainyena sahitaḥ sammānaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt ।
avātatāra bhagavān vigoṣṭhikāntikakṣitau ।। 17।।
prajāstaṃ vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ cākṣatādibhiḥ ।
bhagavān svavimānāccā'vatīryārpitakāñcane ।। 18।।
niṣasādāsane divye rājā nanāma pādayoḥ ।
puṣpasrajo dadau kaṇṭhe gandhasāraṃ dadau tathā ।। 19।।
tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ cāpi dadau sārthebhya ityapi ।
sainyena sahito rājā bhrāmayāmāsa vāhanaiḥ ।। 2.215.20 ।।
gajāśvaśakaṭībhiśca tathā mānavavāhanaiḥ ।
vigoṣṭhākhyanagaryāṃ vai prajāḥ pupūjuracyutam ।। 21 ।।
gajayāne sthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pitarau ca kuṭumbakam ।
īśānaṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi satīṃ lakṣmyādikāstathā ।। 22।।
aśvayānasthitāँścānyān sevakānṛṣisattamān ।
brahmapriyādikāḥ sarvāḥ śibikāsthāśca yoṣitaḥ ।।23 ।।
prajāḥ pradhānā viprādyāḥ śreṣṭhino dhaninastathā ।
dīnā narāḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ pupūjuśca yathādhanam ।।24।।
namanaiḥ stavanaiścāpi hṛdayairnetrakaiḥ karaiḥ ।
bhāvanaiḥ puṣpahārādyaiḥ phalaiśca śarkarādibhiḥ ।। 25।।
pupūjuḥ parameśānaṃ prāptaṃ divyaguṇodadhim ।
eva nagarīṃ sarvāṃ tāṃ bhramitvā bhagavān prabhuḥ ।।26।।
āyayau cārṣitāvāsaṃ sabhāṃ cakāra śobhanām ।
upadeśaṃ dadau tatra yogyaṃ yogyataraṃ hariḥ ।।27।।
yeṣāṃ deve'sti viśvāsasteṣāṃ phalati viśvasṛṭ ।
yeṣāṃ nāsti tu viśvāsasteṣāṃ phalaṃ na jāyate ।।28।।
bhavatāṃ cātiviśvāsāt prāptirme'tra sukhāvahā ।
jātā kālīmaṇḍalīnabhūbhṛtā dvārarūpiṇā ।।29।।
ahaṃ cāsmi pareśo vai sarvāvatāradhṛk prabhuḥ ।
parabrahma hṛdayasthaścāntaryāmī phalapradaḥ ।।2.215.3 0।।
pūjane sevane cāpi darśane vandane'rpaṇe ।
pādasaṃvāhane dāne phalado'smi na saṃśayaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
mama bhakto mahādevaḥ purā bālamajīvayat ।
viśvastānāṃ jambukasya vākyādapīti tattathā ।।32।।
devā viśvāsapūjyāśca nṛpā viśvāsavartinaḥ ।
śaraṇāgatimāptānāṃ viśvāsaḥ prathamā sthitiḥ ।।33।।
varaṇaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ cārpaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param ।
dīnavat sevanaṃ cāpi sthairyabhāvastataḥ param ।।34।।
yathā yathā haristuṣyettathā tathā'nuvartanam ।
na tuṣyettu yayā rītyā tasyā tasyā vivarjanam ।।35।।
evamādīni karmāṇi sādhanāni vimuktaye ।
santīha mānave bhāve sarvatrāpi tathā sthitiḥ ।।36।।
tasmāt sevyo'hamevātra muktaye smṛddhaye surāḥ ।
śāśvatānandalābhāya sevyo'haṃ parameśvaraḥ ।।37।।
śraddhayā sevitaścāhaṃ viśvāsena vinoditaḥ ।
dadāmi śreyaḥsarvasvaṃ svaṃ lakṣmīṃ pradadāmyaham ।।38।।
jīvanaṃ dhanasampattiṃ cārogyaṃ vaṃśavistaram ।
bhogān bhogyān bhogaśaktīrdadāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 39।।
purā pāpakṛtaścāpi paścāt puṇyaniṣeviṇaḥ ।
mṛtā api purā te vai jīvitā iti niścayaḥ ।।2.215.40।।
purā puṇyakṛtaścāpi paścāt pāpaniṣeviṇaḥ ।
jīvitāste purā paścānmṛtā eva hi te matāḥ ।।41 ।।
tasmānmṛtānāṃ jīvāśā jīvanaṃ dīyate tu yaḥ ।
jīvanasya pradātā sa gururbodhyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।42।।
jīvannapi hariṃ naiva jānāti gocaraṃ prabhum ।
mṛta eva śvasan bhastrāsadṛśo mata eva ha ।।43।।
tādṛśo'pi satāṃ yogād bhagavantamupāgataḥ ।
bhajan sthitaścālaso'pi jīvatyevā'mṛto hi saḥ ।।44।।
jīvanaṃ jīvanīyaṃ vai miṣṭaṃ śrīharisevanāt ।
rūkṣaṃ tu jīvanaṃ tyājyaṃ viṣayādiprasevitam ।।45।।
maraṇe'pi nikaṭe'pi smartā me yāti madgṛham ।
tathā buddhyā smarenmāṃ vai viśvāsena milāmyaham ।।46।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe'kṣarakṣetre purā'bhavat ।
viprasya vṛddhadevasya vārdhakye tvekaputrakaḥ ।।47।।
yayau jale sutaḥ snātuṃ jalamadhye papāta ha ।
mṛtaḥ so'yaṃ mṛtakalpo jalapānena so'bhavat ।।48।।
prāṇastasyā'bhavan mūrdhni na cāyāti ca netrayoḥ ।
nāḍyo naiva prasaranti coṣmā nāpi ca vidyate ।।49।।
mṛto vā mṛtakalpo vā dṛśyate sthāpito bhuvi ।
gomayena praliptāyāṃ janā jñātvā mṛtaṃ ca tam ।।2.215.50।।
pitrā sākaṃ khātabhāgaṃ ninyuryatra śmaśānakam ।
tatrā''sīd vṛddhagṛdhro'pi dadarśa mṛtabālakam ।।51 ।।
dhṛtaṃ cāṃke janakena rudatā'tyajatā tadā ।
pitā bālaṃ parityajya gantuṃ śaknoti naiva tu ।।52।।
anye'pi bālakaṃ tyaktvā pratigantuṃ na śekire ।
tadā gṛdhraḥ samāgatyā'bravīd gacchata vai gṛham ।।53।।
iha nāryo narā nityaṃ sahasrādhikataḥ khalu ।
āyānti tu mṛtāँstyaktvā prayānti svagṛhaṃ sadā ।।।54।।
nahi kaścit samāyāti mṛtaḥ punaḥ śarīrake ।
jagat sarvaṃ tathābhūtaṃ saṃklṛptaṃ vartate yataḥ ।।55।।
sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvyāptaṃ tatra kā paridevanā ।
mṛtā yātā mṛtavāhāḥ mariṣyanti kṣaṇāntare ।।56।।
iti jñātvā ye bhajeran hariṃ te cirajīvinaḥ ।
na punaḥ prāṇavān kaścinmahākālamukhaṃ gataḥ ।।57।।
priye'priye'pi samatā kālasya gatirīdṛśī ।
sarveṇa khalu gantavyaṃ janmavateha dehinā ।।58।।
karmāntajīvane yāte punarjīvo na labhyate ।
yāntu gṛhāṇi santyajya mṛtaṃ śavaṃ prayāntu śam ।।59।।
evaṃ jñānaṃ samāsādya samutsṛjya kṣitau narāḥ ।
prākrośanto yayuḥ snānahradaṃ jñātvā mṛtaṃ hi tam ।।2.215.60।।
tatrā'bhūjjambukavṛddhaścāgatyovāca tāñjanān ।
nirghṛṇā mānavāḥ sarve nirdayāḥ snehavarjitāḥ ।।।6 1 ।।
kathaṃ tyaktvā gamane vai hṛdayaṃ vaḥ prajāyate ।
divaso'sti muhūrtaśca bahurūpo vivartate ।।62।।
kadācinmṛta evāpi jīvan yāti śmaśānataḥ ।
yūyaṃ vai nirvṛṇāstyaktvā kathaṃ yātha hi nirdayāḥ ।।63।।
tasya cakṣuḥ śrutirnāsā dehaḥ sarvo'pi vidyate ।
na vo'styasmin kimu snehaḥ paśupakṣisamo'pi na ।।64।।
asvārthavardhitānāṃ tu bālānāṃ sadṛśo'pi na ।
catuṣpātpakṣikīṭānāṃ poṣitānāmapi kvacit ।।65।।
phalāgamo na caivā'sti na guṇo'pi kathaṃcana ।
tathāpi mṛtabālāँste yāvatpaśyanti bhūtale ।।66।।
tāvannaiva tyajantyete tāvān sneho'pi nāsti vaḥ ।
tato mā yāntu visṛjya kuladaṃ putramuttam ।।67।।
ciraṃ paśyata putraṃ taṃ yāvaddeho'sti cākṣataḥ ।
yatra nā'nye hi tiṣṭhanti tatra tiṣṭhanti bāndhavāḥ ।।68।।
jambukasya vacaḥ śrutvā snātā api narāśca te ।
putrasnehaparābhūtāḥ samāyātāḥ śmaśānakam ।। 69।।
gṛdhrastāvad vilokyaivovāca janān śucānvitān ।
aho vai mānuṣā bhūtvā kimāyātā vimohitāḥ ।।2.215.70।।
prāṇendriyaiḥ parityaktaṃ bhūtātmakaṃ śavaṃ tvidam ।
śuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhatvamāpannaṃ kathaṃ śocatha vedinaḥ ।।71 ।।
kinna śocatha cātmānaṃ gatvaraṃ kinnu śocatha ।
tapasā nāśyate pāpaṃ bhaktyā bhavāntarādi ca ।।72।।
vilāpena bhavet kiṃ vai gatasya bālakasya nu ।
ṛṇaṃ datvā ca vā nītvā yānti dehadharā bhuvi ।।।73।।
bālo'yaṃ gatavān tadvad datvā śokamanantakam ।
gṛhaṃ svarṇaṃ dhenavaścāpatyaṃ ratnāni bhūtayaḥ ।।74।।
sarvaṃ tapo'rjyamevā'sti bhaktyā labhyaṃ tathā matam ।

svakṛtena tu dharmaṇa pāpena sukhiduḥkhitā ।

tasmād yāta nijān gehān dharmaṃ kuruta sattamāḥ ।
vartadhvaṃ ca harerbhaktau satsu sureṣu pitṛṣu ।।77।।
śokaṃ tyajata mohaṃ ca nivartadhvaṃ vihāya tat ।
vidvān vā yadi vā cā'jño rājā dhanī ca nirdhanaḥ ।।78।।
sarvaḥ kālavaśaṃ prāptaḥ punarāyāti naiva ha ।
yūno bālān sthavīrāँśca garbhān nārīrnarānapi ।।79।।
sarvānāviśate mṛtyurnayatyevā'punargamān ।
ityuktā mānavāste tu hitvā śavaṃ prayāntyatha ।।2.215.80 ।।
tāvadvai jambuka āha kena sneho hato hi vaḥ ।
snehahīnasya vākyena snehahīnāḥ kṛtāḥ katham ।।8 1।।
daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca śraddhā viśvāsa ityamī ।
kṛtāntaṃ cāpi dūraṃ vai drāvayanti kadācana ।।82।।
anirvedena bhāvyaṃ vai nirvede vai kutaḥ phalam ।
prayatnātprāpyate sarvaṃ mā yāntu nirdayāḥ katham ।।83।।
ātmamāṃsasamutthaṃ tu pitṛvaṃśasya sādhanam ।
śavaṃ tyaktvā sthite sūrye nirdayāḥ kva prayāsyatha ।।84।।
astaṃgate hi gantavyaṃ sthātavyaṃ cātra vā punaḥ ।
ārādhitāḥ surāścāpi dadatyasūn dayālavaḥ ।।85।।
ityuktāste ṛtaṃ matvā samāyātāḥ śavaṃ prati ।
atha gṛdhro jagādenān bāliśāḥ stheti bhāti me ।।86।।
atra bahūni varṣāṇi me jātasya gatāni hi ।
na dṛṣṭaṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtvā punaḥ strīpuṃnapuṃsakam ।।87।।
garbhā bālāḥ kiśorāśca yuvāno jaraṭhā api ।
mṛtāḥ punarna jīvanti sambandhisnehitā api ।।88।।
śokitāstu gṛhaṃ yānti sambandhibāndhavādayaḥ ।
tyajyatāmeṣa deho'pi śūnyaḥ kāṣṭhasamaḥ sutaḥ ।।89।।
anyatra vai gataṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ gṛhaṃ na yāsyatha ।
nātrendriyāṇi prāṇāśca tyaktvā kathaṃ na gacchatha ।। 2.215.90।।
paraloke sukhārthaṃ vai yatnaṃ kuruta sattamāḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ vinivṛttāste jambukastāvadāha tān ।।9 1 ।।
aho svarṇasamaṃ putraṃ tyaktvā yānti hi nirghṛṇāḥ ।
rākṣasā api putraṃ svaṃ tyaktvā naiva prayānti hi ।।92।।
yeṣāṃ nāsti svayaṃ prajñā teṣāṃ kimupadeśanaiḥ ।
śvetarājasya vai putro mṛtaḥ saṃjīvitaḥ punaḥ ।।93।।
satyavān jīvitaḥ patnyā sāvitryā'pi patiḥ punaḥ ।

rukmāṃgadasya putro'pi mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ punaḥ ।

maruto nāma devāśca garbhe hatāśca jīvitāḥ ।

naiva śṛgālaśatakaṃ jīvayiṣyati pretakam ।
atheśāno harirbrahmā yamarājo'thaveśvarāḥ ।। 2.215.1 00।।
yadi tvenaṃ jīvayeyustadā jīvenna cānyathā ।

devasyā''rādhanaṃ kurmo militvā dharmasaṃyutāḥ ।। 1 02।।
yadi syājjīvanaṃ yāvadāprātaḥ kurma eva tām ।

rājotsavaṃ vyadhādrātrau bhojanādīnyakārayat ।
sevanaṃ kanyakāścakrurnidrāṃ kṛṣṇo hyavāpa ca ।। 122।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ rāyakūpeśabhūparāṣṭragamanaṃ havānānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ kālīmaṇḍalīnabhūparāṣṭragamanaṃ vigoṣṭhikānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ
pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 215 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 215 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 216
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 217 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike pañcadaśyāṃ vai prabhāte bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
maṃgalairgītikābhiśca vādyairbubodha saṃstavaiḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtadugdhādipānakaḥ ।
siṃhāsane niṣasāda pitarāvabhivandya ca ।। 2 ।।
tāvadrājā samāyātaḥ pūjanārthaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।
dadau vai mukuṭaṃ mūrdhni kuṇḍale kaṭake tathā ।। 3 ।।
suvarṇasyormikāścāpi śṛṃkhalāṃ mauktikasrajam ।
ratnahīrakahārāँśca dravyaṃ lakṣādhikaṃ dadau ।। 4 ।।
ātmārpaṇaṃ dadau cāpi puṣpahārān dadau tathā ।
pādau prakṣālya ca papau rājā sambandhisaṃyutaḥ ।। 5 ।।
nīrājanaṃ cakārā'tha nanāma pāhi māṃ jagau ।
rājñī pūjāṃ yautakaṃ ca dadau vavre'vanaṃ sadā ।। 6 ।।
evaṃsthite tu tadbhrātā kālīmaṇḍalināgrajaḥ ।
pūrvarājyapraśāstā vai vanajeleśabhūpatiḥ ।। 7 ।।
vanajvālāpradeśeśaḥ sānujyoṣṭrīpurīpatiḥ ।
āyayau svavimānena samānetuṃ hariṃ tadā ।। 8 ।।
āgatya daṇḍavaccakre puṣpamālāṃ gale nyadhāt ।
ārpayat svarṇapātre ca sauvarṇamudrikāśatam ।। 9 ।।
prārthayacca pradeśān svān pāvayituṃ pareśvaram ।
haristathāstviti prāha sajjo'bhavat kṣaṇāntare ।। 2.216.1 0।।
cakre kālīmaṇḍalīno nṛpo vidāyamānanam ।
arhaṇāṃ mahatīṃ cakre candanā'kṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।। 1 1।।
dravyairnānāvidhai ratnairhāraiḥ śekharakuṇḍalaiḥ ।
yautakaiścopadābhiśca nīrājanaṃ tato'karot ।। 12।।
hareḥ sārthasya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā sainyena tūryakaiḥ ।
jayanādaistathā mānaṃ vidāyaṃ śrīharervyadhāt ।। 1 3।।
śrīhariḥ svavimānastho'bhavattatra tadāmbare ।
prajāstu darśanaṃ cakrurnemustuṣṭuvurutsukāḥ ।। 14।।
āgantavyaṃ rakṣitavyā vayamāhuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
harirdarśitamārgeṇa vyomnā vimānamairayat ।। 15।।
rākāsano maharṣiśca rājaguruvimānake ।
sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena cāyāti rājā pūrvaṃ yayau purīm ।। 16।।
sammānārthaṃ harestatra sainyaṃ sajjaṃ hyabhūt tathā ।
prajāḥ sarvāḥ sākṣatāśca puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ ।। 17।।
svāgatārthaṃ mahodyāne sānujyoṣṭrīsamīpataḥ ।
puraḥsthitā abhavaँśca pratīkṣantyo harerdiśam ।। 18।।
guruḥ kālīmaṇḍalīnasya pūrṇāsanako muniḥ ।
āyayau hariṇā sārdhaṃ tathā rākāsano muniḥ ।। 19।।
vyomni prajā vimānaṃ vai samālokyā'tiharṣitāḥ ।
rājā sainyena sahitaḥ svāgataṃ vādyanādanaiḥ ।।2.216.20।।
cakāra jayaśabdaiśca dhvajaḥ patākikādibhiḥ ।
namanaiḥ puṣpadānaiśca gītikābhiśca maṃgalaiḥ ।।21 ।।
vimānaṃ bhūtale sthairyamāptaṃ harirbahiryayau ।
rājā dadau bālakṛṣṇakaṇṭhe pauṣpīḥ srajaḥ śubhāḥ ।।22।।
pādayośca jalaiścakre'bhiṣecanaṃ tadamṛtam ।
papau kuṭumbasahito daṇḍavat pracakāra ha ।।23।।
rājñī neme kaṃbharāyai mahālakṣmyai pupūja tām ।
gopālakṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ pupūja nṛpatistataḥ ।।24।।
kuṭumbaṃ brahmakāntāśca pupūjuśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।
hastiyāne hariṃ rājā nyaṣādayat suvarṇaje ।।25।।
tathā'nyānaśvagantryādau śibikādau nyaṣādayat ।
hāraśekharagucchādyaiḥ sampūjya sainyasaṃyutaḥ ।।26।।
vādyaghoṣaiḥ kīrtanaiśca ninye puryāṃ hariṃ nṛpaḥ ।
gopure pūjayāmāsuḥ rājakumārakāḥ pṛthak ।।27।।
catvare śreṣṭhinaścāpi pradhānā mahati sthale ।
prātirathyaṃ pūjanaṃ ca harestatra prajā vyadhuḥ ।।28।।
pramadā hārapuṣpādyaiścandanā'kṣatasatphalaiḥ ।
kuṃkumaiḥ pūjayāmāsurhṛdayairbhāvanādibhiḥ ।।29।।
ambaraiśca tathā bhūṣābhiśca dravyaiḥ suvarṇakaiḥ ।
pādasparśairmastake ca duḥkhahāvardhanairapi ।।2.216.3 0।।
añjalibhiścakṣuṣāṃ ca bhāvanābhirapūjayan।
dṛṣṭvā kāntaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ rūparūpātiśobhitam ।।3 1 ।।
dadhyurvai hṛdaye kāntā avismaraṇaśāśvatam ।
aparā dūrataḥ sthitvā lokayāmāsuracyutam ।।32।।
divyatejomayaṃ śāntaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram ।
kṛṣṇaṃ rādhādisahitaṃ gopagopīgaṇārcitam ।।33।।
tathā'nyāstaṃ caturhastaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ramārcitam ।
lokayāmāsureveśaṃ cetarā badarīpatim ।।34।।
tāpasaṃ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parāstu śeṣaśāyinam ।
kāścidanyāḥ sūryasaṃsthaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ prabhuṃ harim ।।35।।
tathā'nyā vahnimadhyasthaṃ divyaṃ satpuruṣaṃ prabhum ।
yuvatyo dadṛśuḥ kāntaṃ pūrṇakāmasukhapradam ।। 36।।
bhaktā dadṛśustaṃ devaṃ mahā'kṣaranivāsinam ।
prajā narāstathā nāryo dadṛśurviṣṇurūpiṇam ।। 37।।
rādhāramāsatīvṛndātulasīśrīprasevitam ।
ramāpadmāvatīhāsāmaṃjulāsadguṇārcitam ।।38।।
māṇikīduḥkhahālakṣmīdurgikākamalārcitam ।
dadṛśurbahudhā tatra hastiyānagataṃ harim ।।3 9।।
brahmapriyādibhiścāpi piśaṅginīprapūjitam ।
gaurībhiścāmarībhiśca kanyābhirarcitaṃ prabhum ।।2.216.40।।
dadṛśurvai yoṣitaśca divyaṃ śrīharimeva tāḥ ।
evaṃ harirdadau naijaṃ darśanaṃ bahudhā tadā ।।41 ।।
sānujyoṣṭrīnagaryāṃ vai prajābhyo viharan muhuḥ ।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ rājasaudhaṃ samāyayau ।।42।।
siṃhāsane vyarājacca rājñī pūjāṃ cakāra ha ।
jalapānaṃ dadau cāpi tasyāstu pañcakanyakāḥ ।।43।।
pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ kāntaṃ sundaraṃ manasepsitam ।
varamālāṃ nyadhuḥ kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasya pārijātikīm ।। 44।।
vavrire tamalabhyaṃ vai sulabhaṃ svagṛhāgatam ।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँśca prāpya kāntaṃ hariṃ ca tāḥ ।।45।।
nṛpo rājñī kumārāśca sadbhāgyaṃ menire nijam ।
rājotsavaṃ cakārāpi madhyāhne bhojanaṃ dadau ।।46।।
bhuktvā sārthāḥ suviśrāntimāpustrivādanottaram ।
yautakaṃ ca vidāyaṃ ca dadau rājā tu śārṅgiṇe ।।47।।
darśanārthaṃ narā nāryaścāyayuśca tadā''layam ।
tebhyo harirdadau bodhaṃ mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ śubham ।48।।
balaṃ sadā hareḥ rakṣyaṃ sarvasaukhyapradaṃ nṛṇām ।
āpatkāle mṛtyukāle yamakāle hyasadgatau ।।49।।
gatireva balaṃ me'sti cāpadādinivārakam ।
śālmalirbalahīno'pi purā brahmāśrayājjayī ।।2.216.50 ।।
abhavad vāyudevasya kṛtvā parābhavaṃ khalu ।
himācale mahānāsīd vṛkṣaḥ śālmalisaṃjñakaḥ ।।51 ।।
śākhī skandhī ca patrī ca paśupakṣyāśrayapradaḥ ।
puṣpaphalādibhiḥ kṣudvārakaścāśrayiṇāmapi ।।52।।।
viśālāṃ prati gacchan vai nāradastaṃ viśālinam ।
papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ vṛkṣa nirbhayo vartase sukhī ।।53 ।।
vāyunā tava śākhāṃ ca bhagnāṃ paśyāmi naiva yat ।
kinnu te pavanaścāste mitraṃ yastvāṃ prarakṣati ।।54।।
mahābalo hi pavanaḥ parvatānapi nāśayet ।
sa tvāṃ tyaktvā vartate'tra tato heturbhaviṣyati ।।55।।
hastino gavayāścānye mṛgāstiṣṭhanti te hyadhaḥ ।
śobhase tvaṃ parasevyaścopakārī hi sarvathā ।।56।।
tarkaye pavanaste'sti bandhuḥ sakhā'thavā suhṛt। ।
yadvā tvaṃ pavanasya syāccharaṇāgata eva ha ।।57।।
śrutvā tu śālmaliḥ prāha na me vāyuḥ sakhā suhṛt ।
na bandhurna śaraṇyaśca yenā'haṃ rakṣito'bhavam ।।58।।
mama tejo balaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vāyoścāṣṭādaśādhikam ।
tena viṣṭambhito vāyurmayaivaṃ sa parākṛtaḥ ।।59।।
tasmād bibhemi vāyorna kuddhātvā vegavattamāt ।
nāradastu tadā prāha mahāścaryamidaṃ śrutam ।।2.216.60 ।।
varuṇo yamarājaśca kubero na marutsamāḥ ।
sarvaceṣṭākaro vāyustaṃ tvaṃ vai jītavān yataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
yadvā mithyā bhāṣase tvaṃ drupate buddhilāghavāt ।
kathayiṣye'nilaṃ gatvā tava durbhāṣitaṃ khalu ।। 62।।
parvataiḥ sāgaraiścāpi grahairvā devapādapaiḥ ।
naiva kṣiptaḥ kadācidvai vāyuryathā tvayoditaḥ ।।63।।
te taṃ sarve namasyanti tvaṃ mohāt katthase'phalam ।
ityuktvā nāradaścāyād yatra vāyuḥ sthito'bhavat ।।64।।
śālmalivacanānyāha vyākṣepasaṃbhṛtāni tam ।
śrutvā tu pavanastatrā''yayau yatra hi śālmaliḥ ।।65।।
kruddhaḥ prāha tvayā vṛkṣa nāradāya vigarhaṇam ।
mama proktaṃ yatastvāṃ darśaye balaṃ sthiro bhava ।।66।।
pitāmahaḥ prajāsarge tvayi viśrāntavān yataḥ ।
tvāṃ tyajāmi sadā vegena spṛśāmi harāmi ca ।।67।।
tadguṇaṃ tvaṃ parityajya balaṃ tvagre karoṣi me ।
samūlaṃ tvāṃ nayiṣye'dya vaṃśavistāravarjitam ।।68।।
evamuktaḥ śālmaliśca prāha me bhayameva na ।
yathābalaṃ samāyāhi tyajyatāṃ krodhanaṃ mayi ।।69।।
na me bhayaṃ tava vāyo balaṃ me'sti tvadūrjitam ।
ye tu buddhyā hi balinaste satyaṃ balinaḥ sadā ।। 2.216.70।।
dehamātrabalā naiva balino vai yathārthataḥ ।
ityuktaḥ pavanaḥ kruddho jhaṃjhāvātamayo'bhavat ।।7 1 ।।
śālmalistaṃ vilokyaiva śātayāmāsa vai nijān ।
dalān śākhāḥ kusumāni phalāni svalpaśākhikāḥ ।।72।।
tasthau daṇḍasamo bhūtvā pavanaḥ kiṃkariṣyati ।
tāvadvāyuścātivegī dadarśa hīnaśākhakam ।।73 ।।
śīrṇaparṇadalādyaṃ provāca vanaspatiṃ hasan ।
paśya me balamaiśvaryaṃ yadbhayāt tvaṃ viśīrṇitaḥ ।।74।।
brahmāśrayāttathā me'tra kṛpāleśādabhūḥ sukhī ।
mahatāmāśrayaṃ tyaktvā mahāntamavamanyase ।।75।।
tatastvaṃ duḥkhito jāto vaṃśavistāravarjitaḥ ।
tvāṃ bhaktuṃ prasamartho'smi mā garvaṃ vaha vai kvacit ।।76।।
utkhātuṃ ca samartho'smi mā garvaṃ vaha niṣphalam ।
evamuktvātivegātmapravāheṇa vavau balāt ।।77।।
vakrībhūto'bhavat stambo bhaṃktuṃ ca tatparo'bhavat ।
utkhātuṃ ca bhuvaḥ kampo'bhavad vāyupravegataḥ ।।78।।
śālmalistu tadā namro brahmāṇaṃ smṛtavān hṛdi ।
nanāma vāyave cāpi brahmā śīghramupāyayau ।। 79।।
abhayaṃ pradadau vāyurnirvego hyabhavattadā ।
pūjitau devavaryau tau yayatuśca nijasthalīm ।।2.216.80।।
ityevaṃ balahīno'pi dehī vṛkṣajaḍo'pi ca ।
yadi māṃ brahmadhāmānaṃ samāśrayati kānane ।।8 1।।
māyāmaye'pi tamahaṃ rakṣāmi māyikānilāt ।
kālācca karmaṇaścāpi yamadūtādavāmi ca ।।82।।
madbalaṃ mama sādhūnāṃ balaṃ tyajati cet pumān।
vāyurūpāḥ kālakarmamāyāstaṃ nāśayanti vai ।।83।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ śākhāḥ pautrān dhanaṃ sukhaṃ sutān ।
tyaktvāpi saṃśrayet sādhūn bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate ।।84।।
sarvatyāge'pi cennāsti mamāśrayastadā bhayam ।
kālānilād bhavatyeva tasmānmamāśrayaṃ labhet। ।।85।।
ityādiṣṭāśca rājādyāḥ prajājanā narāḥ striyaḥ ।
cakruḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇāśrayaṃ manuṃ ca jagṛhuḥ ।।86।।
jagṛhustaulasīṃ kaṇṭhīṃ mūrtiṃ hareśca jagṛhuḥ ।
pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ premṇā tatheśānādikānapi ।।87।।
jalapānaṃ vyadhāccāpi viśrāntimāpa yāvatā ।
tāvad rājā vimānena pārāvārapibābhidhaḥ ।।88।।
ambikarṣiyutaścāyānnetuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svarāṣṭrake ।
prārthayadbahudhā tvīśaṃ kṛṣṇastathetyamānayat ।।89।।
sajjo'bhavattadā śīghraṃ tato vidāyakaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
yautakaṃ ca dadau mānaṃ vanajvāleśabhūpatiḥ ।।2.216.90।।
prajābhirbhūbhṛtā sammānitaḥ śrībhagavāँstataḥ ।
vimānago'bhavacchīghraṃ vyomamārge vimānakam ।।9 1।।
sammānena yayau rāṣṭraṃ gatainasaṃ pavitrakam ।
gatainārāṣṭrake rājā sammānārthaṃ yayau purā ।।92।।
kāyanyākhyanagaryāḥ sannidhau cābdhestaṭe tadā ।
mahāviśāle bhūdeśe mahodyāne mahālaye ।।93।।
sainyena sahito rājā sammānaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhāt ।
vimānaṃ cāgataṃ śīghraṃ cāvātarat subhūtale ।।94।।
prajā rājā tathā cānye jayaśabdān jagustathā ।
sainyāni nemire kṛṣṇaṃ prajāścakruśca vardhanam ।।95।।
māṃgalikasutūryāṇāṃ ninādāstvabhavan muhuḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ prajāḥ sarvā narā nāryaḥ samantataḥ ।।96।।
ājagmustatra sukhade mahodyāne mudānvitāḥ ।
puṣpahārādibhiryuktā lājā''kṣatādiśobhitāḥ ।। 97।।
premṇā halahalāśabdairgogośabdātiharṣitāḥ ।
savegāḥ kakṣabālāśca nāryo'pi drutamāyayuḥ ।।98।।
medinī dyaurivā''sīdvai tadojjvalaprajāyutā ।
harirvimānatastūrṇaṃ tvagre bahiḥ samāyayau ।।99।।
rājā nanāma caraṇe puṣpahāraṃ gale dadau ।
rājñī pupūja puṣpādyairjalaṃ cāmṛtavad dadau ।। 2.216.100 ।।
pradhānā nemire cāpi puṣpahāraiḥ samārcayan ।
harirjagrāha sarveṣāṃ namaskārādimānanam ।। 101 ।।
svāgataṃ svīcakārāpi madhuparkādikaṃ śubham ।
phalaṃ jalaṃ payaścāpi yadadādvai prajājanaḥ ।। 1 02।।
rādhike vīkṣya kamalākāntaṃ manoharaṃ prabhum ।
vṛttayo niścalabhāvaṃ prāpustatra hi yoṣitām ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ paṃcadaśyāṃ prabhāte prabodhanaṃ kṛtāhnikatvaṃ pūjanaṃ tato vanajvālārāṣṭragamanaṃ sānujyoṣṭrīnagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ divya-
darśanamupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ tato gatainasarāṣṭragamanaṃ svāgataṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 216 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 217
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 218 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike kāyanīpuryāṃ netuṃ ceyeṣa bhūpatiḥ।
śrīhariṃ prārthayāmāsa tūpaviṣṭaṃ gajopari ।। 1 ।।
harirgaje caturdante svarṇāmbālikayā yute ।
nyaṣīdacca tataścānyān nyaṣādayad gajādiṣu ।। 2 ।।
śibikāsu haripriyā nyaṣādayattu rādhike ।
gaurīrbrahmapriyādyāśca hāritāścāmarīstathā ।। 3 ।।
sainyavādyaiḥ saha śrīmatkṛṣṇo vai śuśubhe tadā ।
ambikarṣiścāmaraṃ ca dhṛtvā pṛṣṭhe hyupāviśat ।। 4 ।।
evamabhrāmayat kṛṣṇaṃ kāyanyāṃ nṛpatiḥ svayam ।
nagaryāṃ catvarādau ca saudheṣvapi ca haṭṭake ।। 5 ।।
sthale sthale prajāstaṃ sampupūjurbālakṛṣṇakam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ candanakāñcanaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
phalaiśca mauktikairhārai ratnādyairakṣatādibhiḥ ।
vastrairbhūṣādibhiścāpi śarkarāmiṣṭavastubhiḥ ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ śrībhagavān puryāṃ bhramitvā''vāsamāyayau ।
jalaṃ papau rājasabhāgṛhe rātrau hyupādiśat ।। 8 ।।
pūrṇārātrau deśajanānāha śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।
upārjanīyaṃ puṇyaṃ vai yena kenāpi karmaṇā ।। 9 ।।
pāpaṃ vai parihartavyaṃ yadvai śreyovighātakam ।
pāpasya vidyate sṛṣṭāvadhiṣṭhānaṃ pralobhanam ।। 2.217.1 0।।
eko lobho mahāduṣṭo lobhātpāpaṃ pravartate ।
nāśamūlaṃ mahān lobho yena dhvaṃsagatā janāḥ ।। 1 1।।
lobhāt saṃjāyate kvāpi krodhaḥ kāmaśca tṛṣṇikā ।
mānaṃ māyā ca mohaśca staṃbhaḥ parā'sutā'pi ca ।। 1 re।।
akṣamā hrīvināśaśca sampacchrīdharmasaṃkṣayaḥ ।
akīrtirdīnatā vaśyabhāvo lobhāt pravartate ।। 13 ।।
adānaṃ cātyajanaṃ ca tṛṣā vikarmavartanam ।
mado droho'vamānaṃ cā'viśvāso'nārjavaṃ tathā ।। 14।।
paradravyādiharaṇaṃ nindā vego vibhogakaḥ ।
īrṣyā kutsā vikatthā ca mātsaryaṃ duṣṭakāritā ।। 15।।
sāhasaṃ vañcanaṃ cauryaṃ lobhāt sarvaṃ pravartate ।
yo na pūrayituṃ śakyo'yutajanmagatairapi ।। 16।।
jīryato jīryati dhrauvyaṃ lobho dhrauvyaṃ na muñcati ।
nityaṃ gabhīratāṃ yāti prayukto'rtheṣu cā'kṣataḥ ।। 17।।
rāgaṃ janayati dravye bhogye prayojitaḥ sadā ।
āsaktiṃ ca parāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ lobhāt prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। 18।।
sa lobhaḥ saha mohena jetavyaḥ śreya icchatā ।
lobhāśrayau dveṣaruṣau śiṣṭācāravighātakau ।। 1 9।।
antaḥkrūrau channakūpau jagatāṃ nāśakārakau ।
lobhāśrayā janāścānyān vañcayantīha hetubhiḥ ।।2.217.20।।
satāṃ mārgān vilumpanti nāśayanti nijān vṛṣān ।
patanti dāruṇe kleśe pātayantyaparānapi ।।21।।
dharṣayantyuttamān svārthasiddhyarthaṃ pitṛbāndhavān ।
śiṣṭānaśiṣṭān kurvanti lubdhā lobhādayastathā ।।22।।
tena puṇyasya lopaḥ syāttathā bhūto vinaśyati ।
tasmācchucivratān sādhūn samāśrayed vitṛṣṇakān ।।23 ।।
lobhamoharahitān vai śreyaḥ syātparamaṃ tataḥ ।
satye sthitān dharmavṛṣān śiṣṭācārasamanvitān ।। 24।।
kṛṣṇaprasaṃgasaṃprāptān sevetāpi dayāparān ।
pitṛdevā''titheyāṃśca tathā sarvopakāriṇaḥ ।।25।।
sarvadharmā''stikabhāvān sarvabhūtahite ratān ।
sarvadevān pūjayeccāśrayecchreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet ।।26।।
na yeṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yatpurā sādhubhiḥ kṛtam ।
na trāsino na capalā na krūrāḥ satpathe sthitāḥ ।।27।।
tān sādhūn samprasevetā'hiṃsakān matparāyaṇān ।
sarvadoṣavyapetāँśca nirmamān nirahaṃkṛtān ।।28।।
suvratān sthiramaryādān samupāsīta bhūtaye ।
na dhanārthaṃ yaśo'rthaṃ vā dharmo yeṣāṃ vilupyate ।।29।।
avaśyaṃ kārya ityevaṃ śarīrasya kriyāparāḥ ।
na bhayaṃ ruṭ na cāpalyaṃ na śoko yeṣu laukikaḥ ।।2.217.30।।
satyārjavaparā ye ca mama mūrtiparāstathā ।
na bhraśyante ratiṃ prāpya na ca lābheṣu harṣitāḥ ।। 3 1।।
na vyathanti vilābheṣu sattvamārgamupāśritāḥ ।
samabhāvā dayābhāvāḥ paropakārabhāvinaḥ ।। 32।।
lābhālābhau sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye janimṛtī ।
samāni yeṣāṃ cetāṃsi tānupāsīta bhaktimān ।।3 3।।
mahānubhāvān daivāँśca guṇinaḥ samupāśrayet ।
ajñānahārakān divyān gurūn śrayecca bhūtaye ।।34।।
ajñānaṃ lobhamūlaṃ ca pāpotpādakamityapi ।
ajñānānna naro vetti tvātmanaḥ kṣayamityapi ।।35।।
ubhāvetau samaphalau samadoṣau mahattamau ।
ajñānaṃ cātilobhaśca sthitervināśakau matau ।।36।।
lobhaprabhavamajñānaṃ lobhavṛddhyā pravardhate ।
lobhe kṣīṇe kṣayaṃ yātyanyathā yātyabjadhāgatīḥ ।।37।।
indriyāṇāṃ damanena lobhaḥ kṣīṇo bhavennan ।
vāsanāyā vilopena lobhamūlaṃ vinaśyati ।।38।।
damaḥ kalyāṇado bodhyo damo dharmā'tiśobhanaḥ ।
damāt siddhirbhavatyeva damo dānād viśiṣyate ।।39।।
damāttejo vardhate ca tejasvī puruṣo bhavet ।
damī cātra paratrā'pi paraṃ sukhaṃ pravindati ।।2.217.40।।
sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate ।
sukhaṃ paryeti lokāँśca manaścāsya prasīdati ।।41 ।।
adānto hi janaḥ kleśamabhīkṣṇaṃ pratipadyate ।
anarthośca bahūnanyān prasṛjatyadamo janaḥ ।।।42।।
gurupūjāphalaṃ proktaṃ daminaḥ śīlinaḥ sataḥ ।
kāmaḥ krodho darpalobhau roṣa īrṣyā'vamānane ।।43 ।।
asūyādyā durguṇāśca dānte tiṣṭhanti naiva ha ।
samudrakalpo dānto'sti yenendriyajhaṣā hatāḥ ।।44।।
yena grāmyāstathā''raṇyāḥ pravṛttayo'pi vai hatāḥ ।
suvṛttaḥ śīlasampannaḥ prasannātmā''tmavid budhaḥ ।।45।।
dāntaṃ prāpyeha satkāraṃ sugatiṃ labhate pare ।
satāṃ samācaritaṃ yat karma dāntasya vartate ।।।46 ।।
śubhaṃ kalyāṇadaṃ vartma satāṃ dāntasya vardhate ।
dānto dhūtvā''tmaniṣṭhaśca sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ ।।47।।
maddhyānanirato bhakto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ।
yasmādabhayaṃ bhūtānāṃ bhūtebhyo yasya cā'bhayam ।।48।।
dehe vā ca videhe vā bhayaṃ tvasya kuto'pi na ।
ācinoti tu me sevāṃ sarveṣu mitratāṃ gataḥ ।।49।।
satāṃ mārgaṃ prapannasya gatirme sadṛśī sadā ।
lobhaṃ cā'jñānakaṃ tyaktvā dānto bhūtvā tu māṃ bhajet। ।।2.217.50।।
mokṣastejomayā yadvā lokāstasya tu śāśvatāḥ ।
samarpya mayi karmāṇi samarpya mayi vai tapaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
samarpya mayi vijñānaṃ prasannātmā madāśrayaḥ ।
prāpya bhogān divisthāँśca matsvargaṃ vindati dhruvam ।।52।।
yadvā paitāmahaṃ sthānaṃ vairājaṃ vā tataḥ param ।
brahmarāśimayaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ dhāmā'mṛtaṃ ca vā ।।53 ।।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktyā damena vindati ।
jñānārāmasya bhaktasya sarvadehyavirodhinaḥ ।।54।।
nātra bhayaṃ punaścāsti paralokabhayaṃ na ca ।
damino yādṛśī śāntistādṛśī yatnino nahi ।।55।।
dame lokoktirekā syāt soḍhavyā sāhi sādhunā ।
yā cainaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ।।56।।
aśaktyā kṣamayā śreṣṭho guṇo'sya jāyate dhruvaḥ ।
kṣamayā vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā yenu durlabhāḥ ।।57।।
sahiṣṇutā sādhudharmo durlabho'nyadurātmanām ।
dāntasya kimaraṇyenā'raṇyaṃ yatra saṃvaset। ।।58।।
dāntistapaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ yadicchāmāraṇaṃ mahat ।
vegavatāmindriyāṇāṃ nirodho yodhanaṃ mahat ।।59।।
tadvai tapaḥ sañcitaṃ ca sarvān kāmān dadāti hi ।
trīn lokāँstapasā siddhāḥ prapaśyanti damānvitāḥ । । 2.217.60 । ।
yad durāpaṃ bhavet kiñcit tatsarvaṃ tapasā labhet ।
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni tapomūlāni tāni vai । । 61 ।।
sarvapāpāni tapasā dahyante tāpitāni hi ।
nivṛttendriyavargasya tapo'naśananāmakam ।। 62। ।
sabalaṃ vardhate divyatejovardhanakaṃ param ।
na duṣkarataraṃ dānāt tapo nānaśanātparam । । 63 ।।
na dākṣyaṃ cātmamuktyāpterna santoṣātparaṃ sukham ।
tapasā śakyate prāptuṃ deveśamuktatādikam ।। 64। ।
vāṅtapaḥ satyamevā'sti satsu satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
satyaṃ dharmastapo yogo yajño brahma sanātanam ।। 65 । ।
tatsarvaṃ satyarūpaṃ vai tapaḥ kṛṣṇe samarpitam ।
hareryogād bhavet satyavrataṃ satāṃ tu sevanāt । । 66 । ।
sarvavastuṣu māṃ paśyet samatāvratamucyate ।
icchākṣayena ca damavrataṃ tṛṣṇākṣayena ca । । 67 ।।
ātmaniṣṭhādṛḍhatvenā'bhayavrataṃ hyavāpyate ।
jñānena cāpyate sthairyaṃ gāṃbhīryaṃ dhairyamityapi ।। 68 ।।
amātsaryaṃ labhyate ca nirmamatveva sarvathā ।
sādhutvaṃ kṣamayā śīlaṃ cā'saṃkalpena labhyate । । 69 ।।
dhiyā śreyo labhyate ca kalyāṇaṃ puṇyakarmabhiḥ ।
hrīrdharmātprāpyate kṣāntirdhairyeṇa labhyate tathā । । 2.217.70 ।।
tyāgaḥ snehasya yattyāgo viṣayāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
rāgadveṣaviyogena vairāgyeṇa ca labhyate । । 71 । ।
dhairyaṃ vikāraśūnyatvaṃ sukhaduḥkhaprade'pi ca ।
viṣaye cā'pyadhṛṣyatvaṃ prāpyate cātmasattayā । । 72 ।।
sarvathā kṣamiṇā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ satyapareṇa ca ।
vītaharṣabhayaruḍbhirbhāvyaṃ kalyāṇalabdhaye । ।73 ।।
adroheṇa sadā bhāvyaṃ sānugraheṇa vai tathā ।
satyadharmeṇa śīlena bhāvyaṃ kalyāṇamicchatā ।। 74। ।
satāṃ sevākṛtā bhāvyaṃ bhāvyaṃ madbhaktisaṃyujā ।
ātmārpaṇena vai bhāvyaṃ paraśreyo'bhikāṃkṣiṇā ।। 75 ।।
mantro grāhyo vaiṣṇavaśca śaraṇaṃ me harestathā ।
tena śreyastathā preyaḥ paramaṃ vo bhaviṣyati ।। 76 । ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
prajāḥ premṇā pupūjuśca mantraṃ hareśca jagṛhuḥ । । 77 ।।
tato rājā ca rājñī ca kumārāścakrurarhaṇām ।
tisro rājñyastathā tisraḥ kanyakāścakrurarhaṇām ।। 78 ।।
mahānīrājanaṃ cakruḥ karpūravartikāyutam ।
rājaveṣaṃ dhārayāmāsuśca gopālanandanam ।।7 9 । ।
yogyāḥ kanyāśca vai tisro ramyā yuvatya eva tāḥ ।
mātrājñayā svahṛdayaiḥ suvarṇavaramālikāḥ । । 2.217.80 । ।
hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuḥ sarvāścaraṇāmbu papustathā ।
madhuparkaṃ daduścāpyādaduḥ kānte samarpitāḥ ।। 81 । ।
kṛtakṛtyā abhavaँstāḥ sthalapadmadalaprabhāḥ ।
pārāvārapibo rājā cakre vivāhakotsavam । ।82 ।।
parihārottaraṃ cakrarbhojanaṃ tatra saṃgatāḥ ।
asvapaँśca tataḥ sarve kanyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ siṣevire । ।8 3 । ।
prātarvādyairgītibhiśca prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo'bhavat svastho yadā hariḥ ।। 84 । ।
rājā tvāyāt tatra kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayituṃ pupūja ca ।
tadā samāyānnṛpatiḥ śuciḥ koṭīśvarābhidhāḥ । । 85 । ।
ekadvārapradeśānāmadhiśāstā sudharmavān ।
tathā cāyānnṛpatiśca śrīsatīśābhidhaḥ śuciḥ । । 86 । ।
pārūparāṣṭranṛpatirdharmavānbhaktibhāvavān ।
mṛtyuharṣikoṣṭhakarṣibhyāṃ yutau tau nṛpau śubhau । । 87 । ।
prārthayāmāsatuḥ śrīśaṃ svarāṣṭragamanāya ha ।
haristathā'stviti prāha satkāraṃ cākarot tayoḥ । ।88 । ।
tāvadāyāt pradhāno vai hyamātyo yājaneśvaraḥ ।
īśānapānaśiṣṭākhyasamrājo brāhmileśituḥ । । 89 । ।
patreṇa sākaṃ natvaivā'prārthayatparameśvaram ।
brāhmīlarājye cāgatya goyājanīpurīṃ ca naḥ । । 2.217.90 । ।
yajñairmahotsavaiḥ kṛṣṇa pāvayeti nṛpeṣaṇām ।
pūrṇāṃ karotu bhagavān prajāśreyo bhaviṣyati । । 91 ।।
amarīṇāṃ ca bhāgyāni bhaviṣyanti śubhāni ca ।
bhavato darśanenā'pi pūjanena ca sevayā । । 92 । ।
ityukto bhagavānāha svāgataṃ te nṛpasya ca ।
vacanaṃ mānaye'mātyavarya yogyaṃ samīhitam । । 93 ।।
pañcamyāṃ tu prage tatra samāgatya kratūtsavam ।
kariṣye lomaśaṃ nītvā tathā maharṣisattamān । । 94। ।
īśānaṃ ca satīṃ nītvā yāhi rājñe nivedaya ।
sāmagrīsañcayaṃ cāpi prakāraya ca ghoṣaṇām । । 95 । ।
nadītīre śubhaṃ sthānaṃ yogyaṃ yajñārthamācara ।
pañcamyāṃ tu prage yajñāraṃbhaścaikādaśīdine । । 96 । ।
pūrṇāhutiḥ kratoḥ syācca praghoṣayeti sarvathā ।
amātyaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ tvājñāṃ prāpya nijālayam । । 97। ।
brāhmīleśaṃ tathoktaṃ cāvedayāmāsa sarvathā ।
lomaśeśānadevau ca lālāyano vṛkāyanaḥ ।।98।।
nīlakarṇo yavakrītastathā'nye ṛṣayo yayuḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān yayau yajñārthasiddhaye ।।99।।
āmrajanisarittīre śāntārāmarṣisevite ।
goyājanībhūmimadhye yajñasthalīṃ hyakalpayan ।। 2.217.100 ।।
atha kṛṣṇo'bhavat sajjo dugdhaṃ pītvā kuṭumbayuk ।
gantumekadvārarāṣṭraṃ tathā pārūparāṣṭrakam ।। 101 ।।
pārāvārapibo rājā vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau ।
pūjālabdhaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ dadau sa cāmbikarṣaye ।। 1 02।।
svāgataṃ mānanaṃ prāpya harirvimānago'bhavat ।
koṭīśvaro yayau pūrvaṃ sammānārthaṃ harestadā ।। 103 ।।
śrīsatīśo yayau cāpi nijarāṣṭraṃ haristataḥ ।
mṛtyuharṣisuyuktaśca koṣṭhakarṣiyutastathā ।। 1 04।।
vyomnā śīghraṃ samāyācca peyisthānagarīṃ prati ।
rādhike ca tadā vādyānyavādyanta vilokya tam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ kāyanīnagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ rājālaye samupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ svapanaṃ prātarvidāyaṃ āśvinakṛṣṇapratipadi koṭīśvara-
nṛpasya ekadvārarāṣṭragamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 217 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 218
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 219 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike pratipatprātaścāśvīnakṛṣṇapakṣake ।
peyisthāyāḥ sannidhau vai mahodyāne hi koṭiśaḥ ।। 1 ।।
nṛpaḥ sainyena kṛṣṇasya svāgataṃ svaṃ vyadhārayat ।
vimānaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya divyasūryanibhaprabham ।। 2 ।।
janā dṛṣṭvā jayaśabdān cakrurharṣasamanvitāḥ ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।। 3 ।।
peyisthāyā nagaryā udyāne dhvajādiśobhite ।
vimānaṃ cā'vardhayaँśca prajā akṣatacandanaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
puṣpāñjalibhiścātyarthaṃ gītibhiḥ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānato bahiḥ ।। 5 ।।
āyayau ca tadā sūryānanaṃ vilokya mānavāḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ tejodharṣitāścā'bhavaiṃstataḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
candrānano'bhavacchīghraṃ śāntasudhāpravarṣaṇaḥ ।
dadṛśuśca janāḥ sarve tadā śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।। 7 ।।
koṭīśvaro nṛpaḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe hāraṃ dadau śubham ।
papau pādāmṛtaṃ cāpi tato'nye'pūjayan prabhum ।। 8 । ।
gaje niṣādya sarveśaṃ peyisthāyāṃ mahāpathe ।
mahāsainyena rājā so'bhrāmayanmānapūrvakam ।। 9 । ।
pradhānaiśca tathā'mātyaiḥ śreṣṭhibhiśca prajājanaiḥ ।
dhanāmbarairhīrakaiśca mauktikai ratnahārakaiḥ ।। 2.218.10 ।।
phalaiḥ puṣpairdalairmiṣṭaiḥ suvarṇādyaiśca pūjitaḥ ।
nīrājito vanditaśca yoṣidbhiḥ sannirīkṣitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
manoharasvarūpaḥ śrīkāmbhareyo narāyaṇaḥ ।
datvaivaṃ darśanaṃ cāyānnṛpāvāsaṃ manoharam ।। 12 ।।
rājā svamandire divye siṃhāsane janārdanam ।
niṣādya caraṇau natvā puraḥ svarṇāyutaṃ nyadhāt। ।। 13 ।।
rājñī pupūja bhaktyāḍhyā candanākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ ।
kanye dve ca tadā kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe mātrājñayā śubhe ।। 1 4।।
varamāle nyadhātāṃ te jāte pūrṇamanorathe ।
pareśvaraṃ patiṃ prāpyānandamagne babhūvatuḥ ।। 1 5।।
rājā bhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ nṛpāṃganā ।
nīrājanaṃ cakārā'tha hariścopādideśa ha ।। 1 6।।
krodho lobho rasāsvādo mānaḥ stainyaṃ ca paiśunam ।
ete pramattāḥ satataṃ tudanti puruṣaṃ striyam ।। 1 7।।
ebhyaḥ pravartate duḥkhamebhyaḥ pāpaṃ pravartate ।
lobhāt krodhaḥ prabhavati mānācca jāyate bhṛśam ।। 18 ।।
paradoṣaistathā krodho bhavedicchāvighātakaḥ ।
avamānād bhavet krodho vākkāṭhinyaśravāttathā ।। 1 9।।
kṣamayā krodhanaṃ sādhau drāgeva vinivartate ।
krodhamūlaṃ kvacit kāmo bhavatyeva viyojitaḥ ।। 2.218.20 ।।
kāmamūlaṃ tu saṃkalpo hetuvṛddhau vivardhate ।
sevyamānastu sutarāṃ tyajyamānastu naśyati ।। 21 ।।
asūyā jāyate mānād yaśaḥkhaṇḍanatastathā ।
dāridryāt svāpakarṣāccā'vanaternimnasaṃsthiteḥ ।। 22।।
ajñānaprabhavo mohaḥ pāpābhyāsāt pravartate ।
jñānamārgeṇa vihato moho mūlānnivartate ।। 23 ।।
vidhitsā karmaphalikā mayyarpaṇānna bandhadā ।
prītyā śokaḥ prabhavati ceṣṭāviyojanāttathā ।। 24।।
yadā nairarthyamānaṃ syācchokaḥ sarvo nivartate ।
pāravaśyaṃ tṛṣṇayā vā lobhāt kāmāt sukhehayā ।। 25।।
jāyate tattu vairāgyānnivartate samūlakam ।
asatyāśrayiṇo nityaṃ mātsaryaṃ pravivardhate ।। 26 ।।
sādhūnāṃ sevanāt satyodbodhāttattu nivartate ।
avasthāguṇasampattikulakhyātikalādibhiḥ ।। 27।।
aiśvaryād vidyayā cāpi jāyate tu madodbhavaḥ ।
teṣāmaṃśaṃ sukhadaṃ ca prāpyā'nyāṃ'śaṃ vivarjayet ।। 28।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya madaduḥkha na jāyate ।
īrṣyā paronnatiśraiṣṭhyā'sahiṣṇunā vitanyate ।।29।।
upekṣayā nāśayed vai saṃharṣād vā vicārataḥ ।
kutsā sañjāyate śraiṣṭhyagarveṇā'nyatra vastuni ।।2.218.3 0।।
avasthābhedasāmyajñaḥ kutsāṃ jayati nānyathā ।
iti kartuṃ na śaktā ye balasthāya mahātmane ।।3 1।।
asūyā jāyate teṣāṃ bhāgyatuṣṭyā nivartate ।
kṛpā saṃjāyate loke hyupakāravivekataḥ ।।32।।
kṛpaṇeṣu tathā'nyeṣu daurguṇyena nivartate ।
ajñānaprabhavo lobho yatra yatra prajāyate ।। 33 ।।
tatra tatra bhāvayeccā'sthiratvaṃ duḥkhadāyitām ।
anapekṣasvabhāvena lobho'pyatra nivartate ।। 34 ।।
nṛśaṃsaṃ varjayennityaṃ vijñāya ca yathātatham ।
saspṛho garvitaścāpyākroṣṭā ca vañcakastathā ।। 35।।
śaṭhaḥ kṣudro naikṛtiko viṣamaśca vikatthanaḥ ।
saṃgī mānyasaṃvibhāgī sarvaśaṃkī ca nirdayaḥ ।। 36 ।।
kṛpaṇo dveṣavān hiṃsāvihāro bahvalīkakaḥ ।
lubdhaḥ pāṣaṇḍavān nindākartā tvete nṛśaṃsakāḥ ।। 37।।
dharmaśīlaṃ guṇopetaṃ pāpamityavagacchati ।
śreṣṭhān pūjyān sataḥ sādhvīḥ svārthārthamupahanti yaḥ ।।38।।
svapaiśunyapramāṇena na viśvasiti kasyacit ।
guṇināṃ svalpadoṣaṃ vā bahutvena ca vakti yaḥ ।। 39।।
yaścopakāriṇaṃ mitraṃ manyate vañcakaṃ param ।
hitakṛte'pi ca muhustapatyeva nirarthakam ।।2.218.40।।
bhojanaṃ sādhu nītvaiva bhuṃkte prekṣakapaṃktiṣu ।
nārīṃ pratāpayed yaśca pitarau tāpayecca yaḥ ।। 41 ।।
ete nṛśaṃsā jñātavyāsteṣāṃ saṃgaṃ na cācaret ।
sadbhyo datvā bhuṃjate ye suhṛdbhirbāndhavaiḥ saha ।। 42।।
pretya labhante svargaṃ te svargāt svargaṃ tathottaram ।
nṛśaṃsān vardhayed jñātvā''śrayet sādhūn hariṃ tathā ।।43।।
niḥsvebhyo deyameveti vidyā'nnā'mbaramuttamam ।
yakṣyamāṇo dānapātraṃ sarvavidyādharastathā ।। 44।।
ācāryapitṛkāryaśca dharmārthadattajīvanaḥ ।
ete vai sādhavaḥ proktāḥ parameśaparāyaṇāḥ ।।45।।
teṣāmāśrayaṇānmokṣo mahāsvargādikārjanam ।
sarvaiśvaryapralābhaśceśvarabhāvastadāśrayāt ।।06।।
madrūpaḥ sādhavaste vai yeṣu me sadguṇāḥ śubhāḥ ।
madguṇo vai madaṃśo'sti naro nārāyaṇāhvayaḥ ।।47।।
tyaktavyāँśca janān vacmi yeṣāṃ saṃgo bhayāvahaḥ ।
lubdhaṃ krūraṃ dharmahīnaṃ mama bhaktivivarjitam ।।48।।
nikṛtiṃ ca śaṭhaṃ kṣudraṃ pāpācāraṃ vivarjayet। ।
alasaṃ sarvaśaṃkaṃ ca dīrghasūtraṃ vivarjayet ।।49।।।
anṛjuṃ ca sadā kruṣṭaṃ gurudārapradharṣakam ।
vyasaneyaṃ durātmānaṃ pitṛhaṃ nirapatrapam ।।2.218.50 ।।
sarvataḥ pāpacakṣuṣkaṃ nāstikaṃ nindakaṃ khalam ।
asaṃyamendriyaṃ kāmāsaktaṃ pramattamutsṛjet। ।।51 ।।
asadvṛttaṃ ca vidviṣṭaṃ samaye cā'navasthitam ।
piśunaṃ cā'kṛtaprajñaṃ matsariṇaṃ ca pāpinam ।।52।।
duḥśīlaṃ cā'kṛtātmānaṃ kitavaṃ ca nṛśaṃsakam ।
mitrā'pakṛtikaṃ cānyadravyārthalālasānvitam ।।53।।
dānadveṣiṇamevāpi cāsantuṣṭaṃ parityajet ।
adhīraṃ balakhaṇḍaṃ cā'sthānakrodhaparāyaṇam ।।54।।
ayuktaṃ cā'vivekaṃ cā'kasmād virodhinaṃ tyajet ।
akalyāṇakaraṃ duṣṭaṃ vyasanāḍhyaṃ vivarjayet ।।55।।
apakāraparaṃ mūḍhaṃ puṇyapradhvaṃsakārakam ।
śatrurmitramukho yaśca mitradveṣī suhṛt tvapi ।।56।।
jihmaprekṣī svārthamātramelano yaśasāṃ kṣayī ।
pratyakṣe śaṃsako yaśca parokṣe nindako naraḥ ।।57।।
svārthe mṛduḥ kṛte svārthe stabdho yastān parityajet ।
pānapaṃ dveṣiṇaṃ ṛddhaṃ nirghṛṇaṃ paruṣaṃ tyajet । ।58।।
paratāpakaraṃ prāṇivadhe raktaṃ kṛtaghnakam ।
adhamaṃ chidrapaśyaṃ ca dūrato varjayet sudhīḥ । ।59।।
tena hānirna vai loke nātmavikṣepaṇaṃ kvacit ।
buddhināśo na caivāpi nābhyudaye'sya vighnatā ।।।2.218.60।।
evaṃ parīkṣya matimān sādhūn hitān samāśrayet ।
kulīnān jñānasampannān kovidān subahuśrutān ।।6 1 । ।
guṇopetānalubdhāँścā'jitān jitaśramāँstathā ।
sanmitrāṇi kṛtajñāँśca sarvajñān lobhavarjitān ।।62।।
mādhuryaguṇasampannān satyasandhān jitendriyān ।
vyāyāmaśīlānnirdoṣān sadācārān samāśrayet ।।63।।
nā'sthāne krodhinaścāpyakasmānnaiva virāgiṇaḥ ।
viraktāँścārthavetṝँśca suhṛtkāryaparāyaṇān ।।64।।
viśvastān ghātahīnāँśca rakṣakān dharmavatsalān ।
loṣṭakāñcanatulyārthān suhṛdo dṛḍhabuddhikān ।।65।।
svāmyarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvān śrayed vicārya sajjanān ।
īdṛśairbhagavadbhaktairyaḥ sandhiṃ kurute janaḥ ।।66।।
tasya nityaṃ bhavecchreyaḥ kalyāṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
śāstranityā jitadoṣāḥ santoṣiṇo haristhitāḥ ।।67।।
śīlaśāntiguṇopetāḥ sandheyāḥ puruṣottamāḥ ।
nṛśaṃsāśca tathā duṣṭā ye coktāśca tato'dhamāḥ ।।68।।
kṛtaghnā mitraghātāśca tyaktavyā dharmavarjitāḥ ।
kutaḥ kṛtaghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṃ kutaḥ sukham ।।69।।
aśraddheyaḥ kṛtaghno hi kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ।
mitradroho na kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa viśeṣataḥ ।।2.218.70।।
mitradhruṅ narakaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhaṃ yāti vipattidam ।
kṛtajñena sadā bhāvyaṃ mitrakāmena caiva ha ।।71 ।।
mitrācca labhate sarvaṃ mitrāt pūjāṃ prapadyate ।
mitrādbhogānavāpnoti gitrādāpad vinaśyati ।।72।।
mitrāṇi sādhavo loke jīvānāṃ pāpanāśakāḥ ।
vāsanākṣālakāścāpi svargamokṣapradāstathā ।।73 ।।
bhavamṛtyuharāste ca śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ ।
sarvathā duḥkhahartāro dayālavo'tisāttvikāḥ ।।74।।
naraiścābālavṛddhaiśca nārībhiḥ śīlaśobhanāḥ ।
sevanīyāḥ sadā santaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitāḥ ।।75।।
divyā divyaguṇopetā āśritadivyatāpradāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me'nusevakāḥ ।।76।।
yatprasādo'pi divyo'sti darśanaṃ divyameva ca ।
sparśanaṃ divyamevā'pi sevanaṃ divyamityapi ।।77।।
vandanaṃ vartanaṃ cājñāpālanaṃ caraṇāmṛtam ।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ dibyayogātte sevyāḥ satataṃ janaiḥ ।।78।।
naitādṛśaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ paro dharmo'pi nedṛśaḥ ।
parābhaktiśca me sādhau sādhavo bhavatārakāḥ ।।79।।
ityupādiśya bhagavān dadau mantrān suvaiṣṇavān ।
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa rājā koṭīśvaro harim ।।2.218.80 ।।
mahīmānāँstathā sarvān tāmbūlāni tato dadau ।
dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇamudrādyā dadau caurṇāmbarāṇyapi ।।8 1।।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ kuṣṭhakarṣistadā harim ।
ārthayannijarāṣṭraṃ tvāgantuṃ pārūpanāmakam ।।82।।
śrīsatīśo nṛpaḥ pūrvaṃ gato'bhūt svāgatāya ca ।
haristathā'stviti prāha sajjo'bhavad drutaṃ tadā ।।83।।
koṭīśvaro nṛpaḥ prādād yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu ।
vidāyaṃ svarṇaratnanādi hariḥ prāpya nijānvitaḥ ।।84।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca prasasāra purodiśam ।
tadā vidāyavādyāni hyavādyanta nṛpājñayā ।।85।।
jayaśabdāḥ prajābhiśca kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇo nato janaiḥ ।
vardhito bhāvanābhiśca yayāvambaramārgataḥ ।।86।।
pārūparāṣṭramāyācca sañcālānagarīṃ prati ।
mahodyāne rājasaudhe rājā sainyasamanvitaḥ ।।87।।
svastho'bhūt svāgatārthaṃ vai vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ drutam ।
sūryatulyaṃ vilokyaiva prajāḥ sainyāni cābhitaḥ ।।88।।
jayaśabdān pracakruśca darśayāmāsurānatim ।
dhvajān patākikāँścāpi darśayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।89।।
candratulyā gṛhacitrā vāvaṭikāśca vāvaṭān ।
darśayāmāsurākāśe yaśoślokasamanvitān ।। 2.218.90 ।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharistadā ।
udyāne mandirāgre'vātārayacchanakaiḥ sthale ।। 91 ।।
prajābhistu vimānaṃ tat puṣpapatrādibhiḥ śubham ।
vardhitaṃ pūjitaṃ cāpi nataṃ prāñjalibhistadā ।।92।।
śrīharistvāyayau cāgre vimāne kṛpayā drutam ।
dātuṃ svadarśanaṃ sarvalokebhyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।93 ।।
sūryanibho'titejasvī candraśītalamānasaḥ ।
padmākṣaḥ premabhṛnnetro mandahāsyānano hariḥ ।।।94।।
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptavigrahaḥ kānakīprabhaḥ ।
koṭikandarpasaundaryo vātsalyavāridhiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 95।।
janebhyo darśanaṃ prādājjagrāha namanādikam ।
bhāvanāṃ hṛdayairdattāṃ svīcakāra hṛdā tadā ।।96।।
atha rājā puṣpahārān svarṇahārān gale dadau ।
śītasugandhasārāँśca siṣeca mastakādiṣu ।। 97।।
kare dadau puṣpagucchān tilakaṃ kaisaraṃ vyadhāt ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre prasādāmṛtamāpapau ।। 98।।
rājñī tasyā'pūjayacca śrīpatiṃ pārvatīpatim ।
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhāt tatra vimāne bahuvartikam ।। 99।।
pūjāścakruḥ pūjanaṃ ca hārāvalyādibhistadā ।
atha kṛṣṇaḥ papau vāri śītalaṃ madhuraṃ tadā ।। 2.218.100 ।।
rādhike'tha tadā sainyaṃ sañcālānagarīṃ prati ।
sajjaṃ hyabhūt hariṃ bhrāmayituṃ rājā samutsukaḥ ।। 10 1।।
bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇo vimānādavaruhya ca ।
śṛṃgārite gaje śvete svarṇāsane hyupāviśat ।। 102।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne peyisthānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ tataḥ sāyaṃ pārūparāṣṭrāgamanaṃ pūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭā-
daśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 218 ।।
