adhyāyaḥ 219
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 220 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'nādikṛṣṇasya gajapṛṣṭhe gajāntare ।
pitarau ca tato gajāntare svabhrātarastrayaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tato brahmapriyādīnāṃ śibikādyāstathā'bhavan ।
amaryaścā'bhavan paścād gītikārasikāstathā ।। 2 ।।
agre ḍaṃkāniśānādi paṭahādyāstathā'bhavan ।
sainyavādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathā'bhavan ।। 3 ।।
yantraśabdā vipraghoṣā jāyante smā'tigarjanāḥ ।
sañcālāyāṃ gopurādau candraśālāsu śākhiṣu ।। 4 ।।
rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu gṛheṣu vallabhīṣvapi ।
haṣṭeṣu vedikāsveva caityeṣu durgamastake ।। 5 ।।
saudheṣu madhyamārgeṣūdyāneṣu ca samantataḥ ।
prajānanā narā nāryo bālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokitum ।। 6 ।।
upasthitāstadā''saँśca dhṛtapūjāḥ karādiṣu ।
nagaryāṃ gopure kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjāmātyamaṇḍalam ।। 7 ।।
catvareṣu dhanāḍhyāścodyānakeṣu pradhānakāḥ ।
rathyāsu cāpaṇeṣvete catvareṣu prajājanāḥ ।। 8 ।।
apūjayan hariṃ puṣpāmbarabhūṣāphalādibhiḥ ।
hāraiḥ pauṣpairhīrakādyaiḥ ratnamālābhirityapi ।। 9 ।।
amaryaḥ kanyakāścāpi pupūjurakṣatādibhiḥ ।
sthalapadmādihāraiścormikābhiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ ।। 2.219.10 ।।
evaṃ bhramitvā bhagavān nagaryāmatha mandiram ।
rājñaḥ samāyayau tūrṇaṃ jalapānamathā'karot ।। 11 ।।
upādideśa bhagavān prajābhyaśca nṛpādaye ।
bhuktimuktipradān ramyān saddharmān vai niśīthake ।। 12।।
deśe kāle tathā vyaktau kālaparyāya ulbaṇaḥ ।
aniṣṭo'pi samāyāti virāgajanakaḥ sadā ।। 13।।
loko'yaṃ bahudoṣo'sti nirdoṣāḥ sādhavo'tra vai ।
bhagavadyogayuktāste kālapāśavivarjitāḥ ।। 14।।
ātmamokṣakarāḥ santo mama yogād bhavanti vai ।
sarvaṃ vilokya niḥsāraṃ duḥkhabāhulyasaṃbhṛtam ।। 15।।
ātmamokṣanimittaṃ vai yateta matimān janaḥ ।
naṣṭe dhane ca dāreṣu putre pitari svāmini ।। 16 ।।
duḥkhaṃ yāti vimūḍho'yaṃ loko mamatvakarṣitaḥ ।
tacchokaṃ nāśayatyeva sādhureva na cetaraḥ । । 17 ।।
yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahājale ।
sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ tadvad dehisamāgamaḥ ।। 18 ।।
evaṃ pautrāstathā putrā dārāḥ putryaśca bāndhavāḥ ।
satyaśca patayaścāpi viyogottaranirṇayāḥ ।। 19 ।।
tatra sneho na kartavyo viyogo tairhi vai dhruvaḥ ।
adṛṣṭaścāgataḥ pūrvaṃ gate punarna darśanam ।। 2.219.20 ।।
evaṃ jñātvā jagat sarvaṃ mahīmānasvarūpavat ।
yathā śoko na jāyeta tatha vṛttyaṃ sudhājanaiḥ ।। 21 ।।
tṛṣṇāsnehotthadukhaṃ vai duḥkhād duḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
prāptau sukhaṃ gate duḥkhaṃ śoko dukhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 22 ।।
sukhaduḥkhe janānāṃ vai jāyete cakrame muhuḥ ।
śarīraṃ vidyate tvāyatanaṃ dvayorvivartatoḥ ।। 23 ।।
tad duḥkhaṃ na punaḥ syādvai vartitavyaṃ tathā pathi ।
anādiśrīhariḥ panthāḥ sarvaduḥkhavināśakṛt ।। 24।।
āśrayaṇīyaḥ so'haṃ duḥkhāntauṣadhamasmi yat ।
anāśritāstu sādhūn ye māṃ tathā parameśvaram ।। 25।।
vidanti duḥkhabhāgaṃ te sukhaśūnyā bhavanti hi ।
snehapāśairanekaiste nibaddhā viṣayehayā ।। 26।।
akṛtārthā hi sīdanti mṛgatṛṣṇājalabhramāḥ ।
snehena tilavad yantre sarge sarvaṃ nipīḍyate ।। 27।।
snehabaddhaḥ karotyasmai karma pāpabharaṃ tataḥ ।
tena kleśānavāpnoti paratreha punaḥ punaḥ ।। 28 ।।
putradārakuṭumbeṣu prasaktāḥ sarvadehinaḥ ।
śokasāgaramagnāste sukhino na bhavanti vai । । 29 ।।
iṣṭanāśe yathā prāpto dāvāgnistatsamo janaḥ ।
dahyate vai vṛthā bhasmībhavituṃ na phalaṃ śubham ।। 2.219.3 0 । ।
nālaṃ sukhaṃ pradātuṃ vai suhṛdo bāndhavā api ।
nā'laṃ duḥkhaṃ pradātuṃ ca śatravo'nye pare'pi ca ।। 31 ।।
nālaṃ cārthāḥ sukhaṃ dātuṃ nālaṃ tatsādhanānyapi ।
na dāridryaṃ duḥkhadātṛ prājño jānāti no'paraḥ ।। 3 2।।
vivekī ca virāgī ca madbhakto vai bhavet sukhī ।
ahaṃ dhenusvarūpo'smi dogdhāraḥ sukhino mama ।। 33 ।।
dhenurvatsasya gopasya svāminastaskarasya ca ।
payaḥpibasya sarvasya sukhadā vai tathānvaham ।। 34।।
mama bhakteḥ pānakartā sukhī syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।
buddhimāśritya jananīṃ vivekinīṃ ca poṣiṇīm ।। 35।।
sukhaṃ samarjayet prājño nā'ntare kleśavān bhavet ।
vivekāllabhyate śāntiḥ sukhaṃ cānanda ityapi ।। 36।।
ye vivekasukhaṃ prāptā dvandvātītā nirīhakā ।
tānnaivā'rthā na cā'narthā vyathayanti kadācana ।। 37।।
abuddhāścā'vivekāśca mūḍhāḥ svabhāvakarṣitāḥ ।
prahṛṣyanti ca yāvantastapyante śatadhā'dhikam ।। 38।।
vivekaprasavā śāntiḥ santoṣasahakāriṇī ।
bhūtiḥ smṛddhiḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ dakṣe vasati nā'lase ।। 3 9।।
mūḍhaṃ smṛtihanaṃ tṛṣṇāyutaṃ ca sparddhinaṃ tathā ।
īrṣyāyuktaṃ janaṃ śokaścāviśati sahasradhā ।।2.219.40।।
mamāśritaṃ satāṃ bhaktaṃ vivekinaṃ subuddhikam ।
asūyerṣyāvarjitaṃ tu śoko na spṛśati kvacit ।। 41 ।।
ātmasattāsamopetaṃ brahmaniṣṭhāniṣeviṇam ।
satsamāgamakartāraṃ na śokaḥ spraṣṭumarhati ।। 42।।
yannimitto bhavecchokastāpo duḥkhaṃ ca vignatā ।
aśāntirvā yato mūlāt tat tyajet sa sukhī bhavet। ।।43।।
mamatvena nijasvārthe kalpitaṃ yatnitaṃ ca vā ।
sadyastatparitāpārthaṃ sampadyate nijātmani ।।44।।
kāmānāṃ tyāgakartā'tra sukhena pūryate sadā ।
kāmānupātī satṛṣṇaḥ kāmānanu vinaśyati ।।45।।
tṛṣṇākṣayo mahān prokto yogināṃ sukharūpakaḥ ।
tṛṣṇāyutasya lokasya dhāvataścehayā'bhitaḥ ।।46।।
atiśoko'bhipadyeta kila dehātmavādinaḥ ।
khaṅgadhāre'mṛtaṃ liptaṃ jihvayā leḍhumicchataḥ ।।47।।
aprāptirbhedanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tredhā duḥkhaṃ prajāyate ।
tathā priyeṣu magnasya kāmaleḍhurjanasya vai ।।48।।
kṣaṇādduḥkhaṃ prajāyeta kāmaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ।
sarvān kāmān jugupsedvai kāmo mṛtyurmanobhavaḥ ।।49।।
saṃhṛtya kāmasaṃkalpān bhayaṃ tyaktvā bhavet sukhī ।
yadā necchā na ca dveṣastadā brahmagato bhavet ।।।2.219.50।।
durmatibhiryā dustyājyā na yā jīrṇā tu jīryataḥ ।
prāṇagrāsakaro rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ।।5 1 ।।
mṛtyunā'bhyāhato loko jarayā veṣṭitaḥ sadā ।
kālagrasto'pi na vetti tvātmaśreyaḥprasādhanam ।।5 2।।
divā rātrirvinā bhaktiṃ moghā yāto hi dehinaḥ ।
evaṃ jānan bhajet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu māṃ harim ।।53।।
yāte prayāte divase janāyuḥ śrīyate sadā ।
vinā bhaktiṃ divā vandhyo dehinā yāti sarvathā ।।54 ।।
atīva tṛṣṇayā yāti sukhārthī gahane tale ।
anavāpte tu kāme vai mṛtyurabhyeti bhakṣakaḥ ।।55। ।
vicinvantaṃ sukhaṃ raktaṃ dūre cāsaktamānasam ।
sarpo bhekīmivā''sādya mṛtyurgrastvā pragacchati ।। 56 ।।
adyaiva śreyaḥ kartavyaṃ kālakṣepo na lābhakṛt ।
asaṃpūrṇeṣu kāryeṣu mṛtyurādāya yāsyati ।।57 । ।
ātmakāryaṃ drutaṃ cā'dya kurvīta sāvadhānakaḥ ।
asyā'pūrṇamidaṃ kāryaṃ ceti kālo na paśyati ।।58 ।।
kadā mṛtyurbhavet kasya naiva jānāti kaścana ।
tasmānmokṣārthakaṃ kāryaṃ prāk kartavyaṃ vijānatā ।।59 ।।
ābālyādvai bhajanīyaḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
tuṣṭe kṛṣṇe bhavet saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ ।। 2.219.60 । ।
mohāviṣṭaṃ dhanadāraputrakṣetrātimagnakam ।
kṣetrapaśvādisampannaṃ suptaṃ mṛtyurhariṣyati ।। 61 ।।
avitṛptaṃ yatamānaṃ kāmārthaṃ bahuveginam ।
dhāvantaṃ cānudhāvan vai mṛtyurādāya gacchati ।। 62 ।।
kariṣye śvaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ tato'nyacca tataḥ param ।
evaṃ vai cintayānaṃ taṃ kṛtāntaḥ sannayiṣyati ।।63 ।।
ārabdhānāṃ phalaṃ nā''ptaṃ saṃsaktaṃ cānyakarmaṇi ।
kṛtānāṃ duḥkhabhoktāraṃ yamaścādāya gacchati ।।64।।
rājānaṃ ca daridraṃ ca vijñaṃ bhṛtyamanāthakam ।
sarvathā rakṣitaṃ cāpi mṛtyurādāya gacchati ।। 65 । ।
mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ ca śaithilyaṃ pāravaśyaṃ vimānanām ।
vyādhimaśaktiṃ dehe'tra vīkṣya vijño hariṃ bhajet । । 66 ।।
jāto'nirdhārito bālo'nirdhāritā mṛtistathā ।
āgamiṣyatyakasmādvai tadvicārya hariṃ bhajet ।। 67।।
mṛtyusthānaṃ viṣayeṣu ratireva hi dehinaḥ ।
viratirvai mahāraṇyaṃ yogināmiva śāntidā ।।68 ।।
pāśarajjurviṣayāḍhyā vṛttiryā dehināṃ sadā ।
chitvā tāṃ śrīhareḥ pādau samāśrayet sa buddhimān ।। 69 ।।
na yoddhā jayati keścidāyāntīṃ mṛtyuvāhinīm ।
satyayoddhā jayapyenāṃ harau satye'mṛtaṃ sthitam ।।2.219.70 ।।
satyaṃ brahmeti vai proktaṃ parabrahmaparo bhavet ।
satyavrate sthitaścāpi satyayogaṃ samāśritaḥ ।।7 1 । ।
satsamāgamanirataḥ sadyogenā'ntakaṃ jayet ।
mohamṛtyuṃ vijityaivā'mṛtaṃ satsaṃgato labhet। ।।72।।
sādhvarthī parameśārthī sevārthī cātmaniṣṭhitaḥ ।
mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā mahānandā'mṛtaṃ prāpnoti modate ।।73।।
sādhuyajñasthito dānto brahmayajñe ratiṃ gataḥ ।
parabrahmārpaṇamagno mahāmokṣaṃ prayāti hi ।।74।।
yasya kṛṣṇaḥ sadā tuṣṭaḥ sādhavo'nugrahānvitāḥ ।
kṛpāvarṣiṇaḥ pitaraḥ sa vai sarvamavāpnuyāt ।।75।।
vidyācakṣurdivyanetraṃ brahmavrataṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ।
sādhusevā paraṃ puṇyaṃ tyāgaḥ sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam ।।76।।
ātmanā vartamānasya parameśe sthitasya ca ।
vītarāgasya muktasya kiṃ punastārakāntaram ।।77।।
vittaṃ divyaṃ sādhavo vai ratnaṃ divyaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
pravṛttirbhajanaṃ yasya tasya kimanyasādhanaiḥ ।।78।।
akiñcanaḥ sukhaṃ śete sukhaṃ prabodhate'pi ca ।
sukhaṃ pathyaṃ śivaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpya pramodate sukhī ।।।79।।
hariṃ vinā na yasyā'sti dravyaṃ cākiṃcano hi saḥ ।
ākaiṃcanyaṃ paraṃ saukhyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayātireki tat ।।2.219.80 ।।
ākaiṃcanye tathā rājye viśeṣo vartate mahān ।
rājyavānnityamudvigno nirudvego hyakiñcanaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
nā'gnermṛtyoścā'sya bhītirna caurā'riṣṭakādapi ।
na śatroḥ kālavegādvā bhayaṃ tasya prajāyate ।।82।।
tyāginaṃ bhagavadbhaktaṃ dehagṛhaṃ hariśrayam ।
sādhusevāparaṃ śāntaṃ praśaṃsanti harādayaḥ ।।83 ।।
nā'tyaktvā sukhamāpnoti nā'tyaktvā brahma vindati ।
nā'tyaktvā nirbhayaścāste tyāgaṃ labdhvā sukhī bhavet। ।।84।।
īhākṛṣṭasya dīnasya pramādamāviśed bhṛśam ।
pramattaṃ tyaktamaryādaṃ hyupayānti mahāpadaḥ ।।82।।
tāsāṃ vināśakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bheṣajaṃ sādhusevanam ।
yeṣāṃ saṃgājjñānalābhaścehānāṃ vilayo bhavet ।।86।।
snehadhārā bhavet kṛṣṇe mayi śrīśe pareśvare ।
śāśvatānandasampūrṇe madyogānmāmakaḥ sukhī ।।87।।
śāśvatānandapūrṇaḥ syāt tatkāryaṃ mānavairiha ।
ityuktvā rādhike'nādiśrīśanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।88।।
'oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।
itimantraṃ dadau sarvebhyaśca sarvābhya ityapi ।।89।।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।
ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ dadau sarvebhya eva saḥ ।।2.219.90।।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmya kuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।।9 1 ।।
ityevaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ janebhyaḥ pradadau tadā ।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।।92।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।
ityevaṃ vai brahmabhāvamanuṃ dadau ca vai hariḥ ।।93 ।।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।।94।।
ātmanivedanamantraṃ dadāveva hariḥ svayam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।।95।।
ityevaṃ śrāvayāmāsa namaskārārcanaṃ tataḥ ।
'śrīśrīkṛṣṇasya bhaktohaṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।।96 ।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabheśo'yaṃ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।।97।।
ityevaṃ nijamantrāँśca pradadau bhagavān svayam ।
atha prajā hariṃ natvā pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।।98।।
śrīsatīśanṛparājñī pupūja parameśvaram ।
śrīsatīśanṛpakanyāstisro yuvatya eva tam ।।99।।
hariṃ kāntaṃ manobhāvyaṃ prāpya kaṇṭhe tu mālikā ।
varamālātmikā datvā'rpaṇaṃ nyavedayan svakam ।। 2.219.100 ।।
haristāsāṃ karān dhṛtvā tāsāṃ nātho babhūva ha ।
rājñī rājā mumudāte kṛtakṛtyāśca kanyakāḥ ।। 101 ।।
tadutsavaṃ nṛpaścakre yautakaṃ bahudhā dadau ।
ārārtrikaṃ tataścakre rājā sa bhojanaṃ dadau ।। 1 02।।
mahīmānān miṣṭavaryairbhojayāmāsa vai tataḥ ।
viśaśrāma harī rātrau trikanyāstaṃ siṣevire ।। 103 ।।
prātarmāṃgalyavādyaiśca gītikābhiḥ stavādibhiḥ ।
prabubodha harikṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo narādhipaḥ ।। 1 04।।
kṛtāhnikaṃ kṛtapūjaṃ hariṃ rājā hyupāyayau ।
dugdhaṃ vai pāyayāmāsa sarvān sukhena bhūpatiḥ ।। 105 ।।
siṣeve ceṣṭadānādyairāśīrvādānavāpa ca ।
tāvattatra samāyāto netuṃ śrīharimacyutam ।। 106 ।।
tretākarkaśarājarṣiḥ karṇaphālarṣisaṃyutaḥ ।
bālāvittakarāṣṭreśaḥ phānkalāśīpurīṃ prati ।। 1 07।।
netuṃ samārthayat kṛṣṇaṃ daṇḍavat pracakāra ha ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha svāgataṃ bhūpaternṛpaḥ ।। 108 ।।
vyadhāttato'bhavatsajjo rādhike parameśvaraḥ ।
rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau sainyena mānanaṃ dadau ।। 1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sañcālānagaryāṃ harerbhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ copadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ dvitīyāprātarvidāyaṃ sammānanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।219।।


← adhyāyaḥ 219 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 220
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 221 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tato vai rādhike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mahāprabhuḥ ।
sajjo bhūtvā'rhaṇāṃ labdhā'mbare vimānago'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
kuṭumbaṃ ca vimāne cā'bhavanmaharṣisaṃyutam ।
brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca niṣedustadvimānake ।। 2 ।।
karṇaphālaṛṣiścāpi vimāne hariṇā saha ।
nyaṣīdacca nṛpastretākarkaśastu vimānake ।। 3 ।।
nije cāruhya śīghraṃ vai prāg yayau svāgatārthakaḥ ।
harervidāye vādyāni tvavādyanta prajāravāḥ ।। 4 ।।
jayakīrtanarāgāścā'bhavan digantaghoṣiṇaḥ ।
prasasāra vimānaṃ tu kṣaṇāntare hyavāpa ha ।। 5 ।।
bālāvittakarāṣṭraṃ vai tvambare dyotate'rkavat ।
tretākarkaśanṛpatiḥ svāgataṃ tvācarattadā ।। 6 ।।
vādyairninādairgītyādyaiḥ prajānāṃ harṣanādanaiḥ ।
jayaśabdaiḥ sainyavādyairnamanaiḥ puṣpakā'kṣataiḥ ।। 7 ।।
ṛṣidarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayad vimānakam ।
haristūrṇaṃ vimānādvai bahiścāgre samāyayau ।। 8 ।।
svarṇabṛsyāṃ niṣasāda rājā taṃ samapūjayat ।
svarṇahārairambarādyaiścandanākṣatasatphalaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
rājñī pādau jalaiścābhiṣiñcya papau jalāmṛtam ।
prajāḥ pupūjurīśeśaṃ harirdugdhaṃ papau tadā ।। 2.220.10 ।।
mahīmānān samastāṃśca pāyayāmāsa satpayaḥ ।
bhūpatiśca tadā rājñī pāyayāmāsa yoṣitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
atha sainyaṃ mahāśobhaṃ tadā śṛṃgāritaṃ hyabhūt। ।
nagaryāṃ brahmaṇārthaṃ vai rājodyānamukhātpuraḥ ।। 1 2।।
mahāsvarṇarathe kṛṣṇaṃ śataikavṛṣayojite ।
nyaṣādayanmahārājastretākarkaśabhūpatiḥ ।। 13।।
śataikasvarṇakalaśaiścaikaviṃśaticakrake ।
bahuvistārake rājapathamātrapravāhaṇe ।। 14।।
hariṇā saha munayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pārṣadāstathā ।
bhrātaraśca tathā rājā nṛpasyāpi kumārakāḥ ।। 1 5।।
niṣedustvanyarathagā brahmapriyāstadā'bhavan ।
vādyaghoṣaiśca nagare vāhinī sā viveśa ha ।। 16।।
jayaśabdāḥ prajānāṃ vai tadā'bhavan samantataḥ ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ phalavṛṣṭiścandanānāṃ kaṇārpaṇam ।। 17।।
svarṇamudrārpaṇaṃ hārārpaṇaṃ puṣpātisāraṇam ।
namanaṃ darśanaṃ dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca vyadhuḥ prajāḥ ।। 18 ।।
amarīṇāṃ gotayaścā'bhavan vyomābhibodhanāḥ ।
divyabhāvayutā nāryo vardhayāmāsuracyutam ।। 1 9।।
pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinaścāpi prajāśca parameśvaram ।
pupūjuḥ sarvaratnādyairbhāvanābhiḥ sthale sthale ।। 2.220.20 ।।
phāṃkalāśīnagaryāṃ saṃbhramitvaivaṃ nṛpālayam ।
samāyayau nṛpastatra pupūja parameśvaram ।। 21 ।।
svarṇasiṃhāsane ramye nyaṣādayat prabhuṃ mudā ।
karṇaphālaṛṣirnyarājayat kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam ।। 22।।
rājñī kṛṣṇasya tilakaṃ kuṃkumenā'kṣataistathā ।
kesareṇa vyadhāt hāraṃ suvarṇasya dadau gale ।।23 ।।
yuvatyaḥ kanyakāḥ sapta rājñyā kṛṣṇaṃ manoharam ।
vīkṣya niścitya hṛdaye kāntaṃ vyadhuḥ patiṃ tadā ।। 24।।
mātrājñayā varamālāḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhurmudā ।
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruścārpitā iti jagurmuhuḥ ।। 25।।
rājñī rājā prasannau ca kṛtakṛtyāśca kanyakāḥ ।
abhavan rādhike mokṣe prāpyaḥ prāpto'tra mādhavaḥ ।। 26।।
utsavaṃ nṛtyagītādyairnṛpaścakre dine tathā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścopādideśa ha ।। 27।।
mānavasya tu dehasya prāpteḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ hareḥ ।
bhaktyuttaraṃ mahāmuktiḥ sevā satāṃ phalaṃ mahat ।। 28।।
arāgadveṣabhāvaśca sadā kṛṣṇakathāruciḥ ।
titikṣā ca vivekaśca yasya saḥ syātsukhī janaḥ ।। 29।।
arāgatā sukhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dveṣābhāvaḥ praśāntidaḥ ।
sukhaṃ svapiti nirviṇṇo nirdveṣaḥ kṣamayā yutaḥ ।। 2.220.30 ।।
yaḥ kāmānāpnuyāt sarvān yaśca kāmān parityajet ।
tayostyāgī mahāsaukhyaṃ vindati na tu sarvavān ।। 31 ।।
nāntaṃ gato'sti kāmānāṃ pūrvaḥ kaścinna cā'paraḥ ।
gamiṣyatīti tṛṣṇāyāḥ kṣayāt prasādhayet sukham ।। 3 2।।
bhuktamuktasya kāmasya nāntaṃ gacchati kaścana ।
sañcitasya dhanasyāpi nāntaṃ gacchati kaścana ।। 3 3।।
tyaktvā sarvasamāraṃbhān sukhamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।
adhanasya bhaved rāgo labdhvā tu vardhate punaḥ ।।34।।
labdhanāśe tu mṛtyuḥ syād yadvā śocati nityaśaḥ ।
punarlabdhaṃ na bhavati tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।35।।
na hi tuṣṭistu labdhena bhūya eva ca mṛgyati ।
anutarṣula evātra duḥkhī syādvai muhurmuhuḥ ।।36।।
dhananāśe'dhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvebhyaścā'vamānanam ।
dhane sukhakalā yā sā sahasraduḥkhamātṛkā ।।37।।
dhanavantaṃ vinighnanti dasyavo'nye haranti ca ।
tasmādāśāṃ parityajya mādhavaṃ samupāśrayet ।।38।।
nirvedaṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca tṛptiṃ śāntiṃ kṣamā damam ।
āśrayeccāpi santoṣaṃ sā syāt sukhī sadā'tra vai ।। 39।।
kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca tṛṣṇāṃ ca spṛhāṃ kārpaṇyamityapi ।
tyaktvā bhavejjano loke sukhī mukto jano yathā ।।2.220.40।।
svīyaprakāśaṃ papraccha bhagavān nāradaḥ purā ।
kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase brahman sukhe yatra na śocanam ।।41 ।।
yadā yadā tu paśyāmi tadā tadā sukhe'si vai ।
na śoke vai mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kimatra kāraṇaṃ vada ।।42।।।
svīyaprakāśastaṃ prāha śṛṇu vidvan matiṃ mama ।
sadā paśyāmi sukhinaṃ kathaṃ kiṃ sukhamasya nu ।।43।।
sādhanaṃ cāsya vai kīdṛk kathaṃ cāste sukhī tathā ।
vṛṣabhaḥ śakaṭīṃ karṣan mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ sukhī ।। 44।।
sa cāha me na vai cintā bhojyavastragṛhādibhiḥ ।
karṣukeṇa dhṛtā sā tu madbalādhīnavartinā ।। 45।।।
tathā'haṃ trividhārthaṃ sañcintayāmi na sarvathā ।
tasmāt sukhī sadā cāsmi bhojyavastragṛhādibhiḥ ।।46।।
satrabhojī mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ vartase sukhī ।
sa cāha me'nnapūrtyarthaṃ dhanaṃ cārjayate dhanī ।। 47।।
aparo'yaṃ pācayitvā mahyaṃ dadāti nityaśaḥ ।
tato dhanānnapākānāṃ cintā me nāsti sarvathā ।। 48 ।।
tadvicārya mayā sāpi kriyate na vṛthā yataḥ ।
śukaḥ pṛṣṭo mayā'raṇye kiṃ tvaṃ pramodase vane ।। 49।।
sa cāha me na bandho'sti yatra kvāpi carāmi vai ।
nīḍe vā gṛhanāle vā svapimyapi yathāmanaḥ ।।2.220.50।।
uḍḍīyā''raṇyakaṃ gatvā bhakṣayāmi phalādikam ।
nāsti cintā sañcayasya nāsti me rakṣaṇasya ca ।।51।।
nāsti gṛhādicintā vā kuṭumbaṃ nāsti me yataḥ ।
tasmātsukhī pramode'haṃ sadā cintāvivarjitaḥ ।।52।।
tadvicārya mayā sāpi tyaktā nirbandhano'smi ca ।
atha pṛṣṭo mahā siṃhaḥ kathaṃ sukhī vibhāsase ।।53 ।।
sa cāha bhojanaṃ daivagatyā prāpya tryahāntare ।
na me hantā vane kaściditi matvā svapimyaham ।।54।।
tadvicārya mayā bhītiḥ kālādeḥ parivarjitā ।
tasmāt sukhī nirbhayaśca vicarāmi svapimyapi ।।55।।
sukhaṃ jīvanti munayaḥ parabrahmasamāśritāḥ ।
hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vināśaṃ codbhavaṃ bhūtagatānimān ।।।56।।
na māṃ lumpanti matvaivaṃ vicarāmi sadā sukhī ।
saṃyogān virahāntāँśca saṃcayān śīrṇatānnakān ।।57।।
utpannān cāntayuktāँśca jñātvā śocāmi naiva ca ।
śayanaṃ nidrayā vyāptaṃ rodanaṃ hānilepitam ।।58।।
harṣaṇaṃ prāptisañjanyaṃ trayaṃ tyaktvā sukhī sadā ।
satī śaṃbhoḥ mayā pṛṣṭā parādhīnā kathaṃ sukhā ।।59।।
sā''ha māṃ vai mayā dārḍhyaṃ kṛtaṃ svāminideśanam ।
mama dharmo na cānyo'sti mamānukūla eva saḥ ।।2.220.6 0।।
ato mayā mahatsaukhyaṃ svāminyevā'nubhūyate ।
tadvicāryaṃ mayā ceśe parameśe'nukūlatā ।।61।।
sarvavidhā kṛtā cāste pātivratyavidhottamā ।
ātmanivedyahaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe pareśvare ।।62।।
tasyecchā mama bhāgyaṃ vai bhāgyacintā'rpitā harau ।
viśeṣataśca tenā'haṃ sukhī sukhāśrayeṇa vai ।।63 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ nāradaścāpi jagrāha tādṛśīṃ sthitim ।
sukhyabhūcca sadā loke nirālambaścaran muniḥ ।।64।।
svīyaprakāśo bhagavān sanatkumārakastathā ।
lomaśarṣistathā śaṃbhuḥ sukhinaste hi śāśvatāḥ ।।65।।
indriyāṇi tadarthāśca vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai ।
aiśvaryāṇi ca bhūtāni vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai ।।66।।
camatkārāḥ siddhayaśca vaśe yeṣāṃ bhavanti vai ।
kālaḥ karma svabhāvaśca māyā yeṣāṃ vaśe sadā ।।67।।
ātmā vaśe ca yeṣāṃ vai ye vaśe paramātmanaḥ ।
te sadā sukhinaḥ santi sṛṣṭau vā'kṣaradhāmani ।।68।।
satī ramā brahmapriyāstathā muktāstathāvidhāḥ ।
sukhinaḥ śāśvatāścaite haryarthātmanivedinaḥ ।।6 9 ।।
tasmātsarvairharervaśyairbhāvyaṃ nānyavaśānugaiḥ ।
hariḥ śāśvatasukhavān sukhīkaroti sevakān ।।2.220.70 ।।
ityupādiśya bhagavān dadau mantrān tataḥ param ।
upārarāma nṛpatistvānarca rādhike hṝim ।।71 ।।
tāvattatra vimānena prārthanārthaṃ samāyayau ।
adhaścilīrāṣṭraśāstā āṇḍajarākhyabhūpatiḥ ।।72।।
mantrāgnikarṣisahito namāma bahubhāvataḥ ।
labdhasvāgatasammāno'rthayāsa hariṃ nṛpaḥ ।।73।।
bhagavanme purīmantaḥprāgasthāṃ pāvaya prabho ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha sajjastūrṇo babhūva ha ।।74।।
tretākarkaśarājā ca vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ dadau ।
sainyena ca vyadhāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mānanam । ।75।।
hariḥ kuṭumbasahito vimāne cā'mbare'bhavat ।
mantrāgnikarṣisahitastathā sārthasamanvitaḥ ।।76।।
rājā cāṇḍajarābhūpaḥ pūrvaṃ svāgatakārthakaḥ ।
yayau rāṣṭraṃ tadā tūrṇaṃ sainyaṃ prāk samasajjayat ।।77।।
tāvaddhariḥ samāyāto vimānavaravāhanaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā prajājanāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jayatviti ।।78 ।।
harṣanādān jayanādān tūryanādān pracakrire ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa ṛṣiṇā saha mādhavaḥ ।।79।।
udyāne'ntaḥprāgasthāyā nagaryāḥ sannidhau nijam ।
śṛṇvan svāgataghoṣāँścā'vatārayad vimānakam ।।2.220.80।।
āyayau śrīharistūrṇaṃ vimānāgre bahistadā ।
cillyo nāryo harṣanādaiḥ śrīpatiṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ।।8 1 ।।
ciraṃjīveti vacanai rakṣarakṣetibhāvanaiḥ ।
sukhaṃ dehīti hṛdayairvardhayāmāsuracyutam ।।82।।
rājā pūjāṃ cakārādau candanā'kṣatapuṣpakaiḥ ।
rājñī pūjāṃ cakārā'pi prajā nemuśca bhāvataḥ ।।।83।।
tato rājā bālakṛṣṇaṃ nyaṣādayanmahāgaje ।
svarṇāmbālikayā yukte tathā'nyāśca rathādiṣu ।।84।।
hāragucchārcitān sarvān sasainyo bhūpatistadā ।
ninye svāṃ nagarīmantaḥprāgasthāṃ ca vibhūṣitām ।।85।।
bhrāmayituṃ rājamārge vādyakīrtanagītibhiḥ ।
gopure'pūjayat kṛṣṇaṃ pradhānāḥ śreṣṭhinastataḥ ।।86।।
catvarādau dhanāḍhyāścāpaṇeṣu paṇinastathā ।
rathyāmukheṣu cillyaśca nāryo bhāvabharāstadā ।।87।।
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ hāracandanakuṃkumaiḥ ।
akṣatādyaiḥ phalairnārikelādyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ ।।88।।
kṛtakṛtyāścābhavaँśca vīkṣya prapūjya mādhavam ।
tato rājā''nayat kṛṣṇaṃ nijaṃ viśālamandiram ।।89।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'tha mukuṭaṃ mastake dadau ।
kaṇṭhe sauvarṇaratnānāṃ hārān dadau nṛpastadā ।। 2.220.90 ।।
caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca pracakārābhipūjya ca ।
kṛtārtho'smītyuvācā'tha rājñī pūjāṃ vyadhāpayat ।। 91 ।।
suvarṇamudrāsthālaṃ śrīhareścaraṇayornyadhāt ।
candanā'kṣatapuṣpādyairānarca parameśvaram ।। 92 ।।
asyāstu kanyakāścillyo yuvatyo bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ।
catasro'pi hṛdi kṛtvā mātrājñayā tu mālikāḥ ।। 93 ।।
hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhurhṛṣṭāścārpaṇavidhinā patim ।
prāpya kṛtārthakāryāstā babhūvurbhāgyanoditāḥ ।। 94।।
rājā cātiprasanno'bhūnmahotsavamakārayat ।
hariścopādideśā'tha rādhe prajājanān niśi ।। 95 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ prātaḥ phānkalāśīnagaryāṃ gamanaṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanamupadeśanaṃ vidāyaṃ madhyāhnottaram
āṇḍajarānṛparaiṣṭragamanam āntaḥprāgasthānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 220 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 220 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 221
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 222 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrīhariḥ svasthaḥ svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ।
upādideśa cillyākhyaprajābhyaḥ suhitāvaham ।। 1 । ।
prajñā pratiṣṭhā jīvānāṃ prajñā mokṣakarī matā ।
mānavaṃ dehamāsādya prajñayā harimāpnuyāt ।। 2 ।।
prajñā niḥśreyasī śuddhā prajñā svargasukhapradā ।
prajñayā prāpyate cārthaḥ prajñāvān vai sadā sukhī ।। 3 ।।
pāṇipādayuto loke mānavaḥ puṇyavānmataḥ ।
pāṇibhyāṃ prajñayā budhvā praseveta prabhuṃ sataḥ ।। 4 ।।
nānyasaktamanāḥ syādvai vihāya parameśvaram ।
bhavantyeke sukhitarāḥ santyanye bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
naikāntaṃ sukhameveha bhavate kasyacit kvacit ।
janā dhanāḍhyatāṃ prāpya rājyamicchanti cottamam ।। 6 ।।
tato devatvamicchanti tataścendrādipūjyatām ।
brahmatāṃ ceśvarabhāvaṃ mokṣaṃ necchanti vai kacit ।। '7 ।।
prajñā vivekasampannā mokṣadātrī bhavatyataḥ ।
prajñayā labhyate mokṣo brahmaloke dhruvā sthitiḥ ।। 8 ।।
prajñānaṃ brahma cetyetat hṛdaye'pi vyavasthitam ।
upāsanīyaṃ satataṃ paraṃbrahma sanātanam ।। 9 ।।
brahmarasaprasaktasya kāmo'nyo naiva jāyate ।
saṃsparśād darśanādvā'pi śravaṇād brahmaṇastathā ।। 2.221.10 ।।
sevanāddhyānakaraṇādbrahmarasaparo bhavet ।
taṃ vinā na bhavet tṛptiḥ priyalābhe'pare kvacit ।। 11 ।।
tṛṣṇā śāmyati nādbhirvai bhūyo jvalati bhogakaiḥ ।
prajñayā sā samūlā vai naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 2।।
kāmyakarmodbhavaṃ chitvendriyāṇi viniyamya ca ।
ātmabhāvena varteta tasya tṛṣṇā vinaśyati ।। 1 3।।
aprāśanamasaṃsparśamasandarśanamityapi ।
arasanaṃ cā'śravaṇaṃ cā'ghrāṇanaṃ ca nehanam ।। 14।।
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ prajñākṛtaṃ bhavet ।
pāṇiyanto balavanto dhanavanto'pi dehinaḥ ।। 15।।
tṛṣṇādāsyaparā bhūtvā kliśyante vadhabandhanaiḥ ।
rudantyapi ramante ca modante ca hasantyapi ।। 16।।
evaṃ lokā bahubalā labdhavidyā manohṛtāḥ ।
jugupsitāṃ kṛpaṇāṃ ca hīnavṛttimupāsate ।। 17।।
utsahante ca vardhante patantyapi rudanti ca ।
na bheko vā varāho vā śvā''tmānaṃ tyaktumicchati ।। 18।।
puṣkaso vā'pi cāṇḍālo baddhaḥ kīṭo'pi varṣmaṇi ।
svayā yonyā mahātuṣṭaḥ sthātumicchati māyayā ।। 19।।
dṛṣṭvā vyaṃgān pakṣahatān kuṇīn kuṣṭhina ityapi ।
svastho'pi bhajate naiva hariṃ māṃ māyayā hataḥ ।।2.221.20।।
tasmād vicārya manasā vinirṇīya ca prajñayā ।
bhajenmāṃ paramātmānaṃ tyaktvā''saktiṃ ca mohanam ।।21।।
dhyānaṃ śuddhiṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ vṛddhapitrādisevanam ।
satāṃ sevāṃ mama bhaktiṃ kuryācchreyo vidhitsayā ।। 22।।
sati rājye gṛhasmṛddhau satkāryāṇi samācaret ।
sunakṣatre puṇyakāle sutithau sumuhūrtajāḥ ।।23 ।।
yajñadānādibhiḥ puṇye yatante sādhuśīlinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ prajñā parabrahmayogācchīghraṃ prakāśata ।। 24।।
prajñayā yāti paramaṃ dhāma me śāśvataṃ sukham ।
ye nakṣatreṣvāsureṣu duḥsthitau durmuhūrtajāḥ ।।25।।
te patantyāsurīṃ yoniṃ prajñāhīnāḥ kratudviṣaḥ ।
śṛgālaśvakhaniṃ yānti śreyasteṣāṃ na vidyate ।। 26।।
santuṣṭaścā'pramādaśca yajñadānatapaḥpriyaḥ ।
sādhusevāparaḥ prajñāśrayo yāti parāṃ gatim ।। 27।।
priyadevā''titheyāśca sevakāḥ priyasādhavaḥ ।
haryarthaṃ kṛtasarvasvāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।।।28।।।
utsavādutsavaṃ yānti haṣāddharṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
svargātsvargaṃ paraṃ yānti sādhorme ca prasevinaḥ ।।29।।
khalāḥ śaṭhāśca dhūrtāśca vañcakā ye tu pāpinaḥ ।
ātmanā'narthayuktena niviśante'ghakarmasu ।।2.221.3 0 ।।
punaśca kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā kṛcchre loke bhavanti te ।
durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṃ kleśātkleśaॆ punaḥ punaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
bhayādbhayaṃ tathodvegādudvegaṃ samprayānti te ।
mṛtyormṛtyuṃ punaryānti daridrāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ ।।32।।
tuṣā yathā tu dhānyeṣu maśakā iva pakṣiṣu ।
tadvidhāste mānaveṣu dharmakarmavivajiṃtāḥ ।।33।।
pacyante kaṇavat garbhavahnau kālena bharjitāḥ ।
vinā prajñāṃ paraṃ śreyo nāpnuvanti kathaṃcana ।।34।।
udvignāste pradhāvanti saṃsārāraṇyamunmukhāḥ ।
kṛtaṃ karmā'nugaṃ bhūtvā dhartuṃ dhāvati tāँstataḥ ।।35।।
suptau suṣuptau vijane jāgratyapi na muñcati ।
lagnaṃ chāyeva satataṃ taṃ vimucya na gacchati ।। 36।।
karmākṛṣṭaṃ parādhīnaṃ vāsanāparisaṃvṛtam ।
vilokya ca mahākālo duḥkhābdhau parikarṣati ।।37।।
svakarmaphalaniḥkṣepaṃ kālo dadāti karmiṇe ।
yathāvṛkṣeṣu kālena puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। 38।।
jāyante nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam ।
ātmanā kṛtaśeṣeṇa garbhaśayyāṃ prayāti ca ।।39।।
bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca tatphalaṃ pratipadyate ।
prajñā'gninā viśuddhasya dīrghaṃ sukhamanantakam ।।2.221.40।।
prajñayā dhūtapāpānāṃ naṣṭarāgadviṣāṃ satām ।
parameśe prasaktānāṃ prapadyate'kṣayaṃ sukham ।।41 ।।
prajñāvān kurute yadyat tatsarvaṃ bandhanāya na ।
prajñayā mayi yukto yastasya karma na vidyate ।।।42।।।
jale jhaṣāṇāṃ gagane pakṣiṇāṃ na yathā padam ।
dṛśyate na tathā karma mayi bhaktasya vedinaḥ ।।43 ।।
jñānavidāṃ gatiścaiṣā brahmadhāmaparāyaṇā ।
sādhyā tu prajñayā sādhvyā mānavairvai mumukṣubhiḥ ।।44।।
sarvabhūteṣu gūḍho'haṃ cāntarātmā vasāmi vai ।
prajñayā tvagryayā tattvadarśinyā labhya eva ha ।।45।।
matprasādakṛtāhāro matsādhukṛtsamāgamaḥ ।
yuñjāno mayi cātmeśe brahmatulyaḥ prajāyate ।।46।।
cittasya ca prasādena samarpya mayi mānasam ।
nirmalātmā prasannātmā niveditātmā tiṣṭhati ।।47।।
mayi kṛṣṇe pare sthitvā sukhā''nantyaṃ samaśnute ।
anantā'pāramānandaṃ samaśnute sthirāyatiḥ ।।48।।
sarvopāyairmahātṛṣṇāṃ lobhaṃ krodhaṃ jayet sadā ।
tadā prajñākṛtaṃ jñānaṃ pāvitryaṃ samupaiti ha ।।49।।
ātmasaṃyama evāsti mokṣātmā vṛṣasattamaḥ ।
tenā''tmanā''tmani tiṣṭhenmayi nārāyaṇe sadā ।।2.221.50 ।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya mokṣaḥ karatale sthitaḥ ।
hṛdayastho'hamevā'sya muktidogdhā bhavāmi vai ।।51 ।।
ityupādiśya bhagavān kāṃbhareyo mahāprabhuḥ ।
mantrān daduḥ prajābhyaśca cakruḥ pūjāṃ hareḥ prajāḥ ।।52।।
dravyāṇi cārpayāmāsurvastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca ।
suvarṇāni ca rūpyāṇi daduḥ śrīharaye prajāḥ ।।53 ।।
tato rātrau nṛpatirvai bhojayāmāsa mādhavam ।
kuṭumbaṃ ca maharṣīṃśca bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ।।54।।
tato viśrāntimāpā'tha nidrāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ ।
kanyakāstā nijaṃ kāntaṃ pareśvaraṃ siṣevire ।।55।।
prātarvādyanighoṣaiśca gītibhirmaṃgalasvanaiḥ ।
vedaghoṣaiśca viprāṇāṃ prabubodha haristataḥ ।।56 ।।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtadugdhaphalādanaḥ ।
rājñā rātryā pūjitaśca svarṇasiṃhāsane sthitaḥ ।।57।।
anyānnṛpaḥ payaḥpāna kārayāmāsa sārthakān ।
tāvatprajāḥ pūjanārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ samāyayuḥ ।।58।।
mantrāgnikarṣaye kṛṣṇo dhanādīni dadau tadā ।
samāgataścāṇḍajarānṛpabhrātā hariṃ naman ।।59।।
kurvaṃśca daṇḍavat prāha nijāṃ purīṃ suśobhanām ।
mantriṇāṃgāṃ pāvayituṃ nāmnā bālyarajo nṛpaḥ ।।2.221.6 0।।
haristathā'stviti prāha cāṇḍajarāprapūjitaḥ ।
vidāyena yautakena saha samvanditaḥ prabhuḥ ।।61 ।।
mahīmānairyutaḥ śīghraṃ vimānamāruroha ca ।
rājā'nujo yayau sārdhaṃ vimānena tadā'mbare ।।6 2।।
vidāyamānavādyāni cāvādyanta muhurmuhuḥ ।
prasasāra vimānaṃ ca hareragre'mbare tadā ।।63।।
rājño vimānaṃ purato yāti vai vegatastadā ।
mantriṇāṃgāṃ tu nagarīṃ prati cābdhyanumārgagam ।।64।।
sainyamāsīttatra yuktaṃ svāgatārthaṃ puraiva ha ।
tad dṛṣṭvā ca vimānaṃ vai sūryatulyaṃ mahojjvalam ।।61।।
svāgataṃ mānavāścakrurdhvajaiḥ patākikādibhiḥ ।
rājā hyavātarat pūrvaṃ tato harervimānakam ।।66।।
avātarat samudyāne mantriṇāṃgāsamīpataḥ ।
sammānaṃ tatra vai rājñī puraḥ sthitvā cakāra ha ।।67।।
vimānasthaṃ hariṃ natvā pupūja hārapuṣpakaiḥ ।
akṣataiścandanaiścāpi prakṣālya caraṇau papau ।। 68 । ।
rājasaudhe hariṃ nītvā vāsayāmāsa ceśvarī ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'tha kanyaikā yuvatī satī । । 69 । ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya varamālikām ।
kaṇṭhe dadau tadā rājā mahotsavamakārayat । ।2.221.7 0 । ।
bhojanaṃ pradadau bālakṛṣṇādibhyastataḥ param ।
āśvarathe niṣādyaiva bhrāmayāmāsa pattane । । 71 । ।
prajāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāminaṃ mudā ।
madhyāhne tu viśaśrāma haristāvannṛpaḥ svayam । । 72 । ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre bālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā ।
sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya babhrāma sāgarāmbare । । 73 । ।
tṛtīyāyāṃ tadā sāyaṃ netuṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ।
pātragonayarāṣṭreśo rāyasomanabhūpatiḥ । । 74। ।
nijaṃ deśaṃ pāvayituṃ netuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāyayau ।
harirvihṛtya cāvāsaṃ tvāyayau tatra bhūpatiḥ । । 75 । ।
neme rāyasomanaśca prārthayatparameśvaram ।
haristathā'stviti prāha jalaṃ pītvā vimānakam । । 76 । ।
adhyāruroha śīghraṃ ca sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।
vāyumānanagarīṃ vai gantuṃ sajjo'bhavattadā । । 77 । ।
rājā vidāyaṃ pūjāṃ ca yautakaṃ pradadau mudā ।
vimānaṃ prairayat kṛṣṇo rāyasomanabodhitaḥ । । 78 । ।
śṛṇvan vidāyamānārthavādyāni bhagavān svayam ।
āyayau nagarīṃ divyāṃ vāyumānāṃ suśobhanām । । 79 । ।
nadītīrasthitāṃ ramyāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo vimānakam ।
rājadarśitamārgeṇā'vātārayannadītaṭe । । 2.221.80 । ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta svāgataṃ bahudhā'bhavat ।
vardhayāmāsuratyarthaṃ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ prajāḥ । । 81 । ।
harirvimānataścāyād bahiḥ svarṇāsane tadā ।
niṣasāda svayaṃ rājā'pūjayat puṣpamālayā । ।8 2 । ।
candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ sugandhidravasecanaiḥ ।
rājñī pupūja ca prītyā nīrājanaṃ cakāra ha । । 83 । ।
rājā gaje niṣādyaiva bhrāmayāmāsa pattane ।
pradhānāḥ śrīhariṃ tatrā''narcurgopuracatvare । । 84 । ।
mahāpathe samānarcuḥ śreṣṭhino dhaninastathā ।
rathyāmukheṣu nāryaśca sthānino gṛhasannidhau । । 85 । ।
pupūjuḥ śrīpatiṃ nāryo gītibhiḥ kīrtanaṃ jaguḥ ।
evaṃ hariṃ bhrāmayitvā nagaryāṃ ca nṛpo nije । । 86 । ।
mandire tvānayāmāsa rātrau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rājñī pupūja vastubhiḥ ।।87।।
tisraḥ kanyā hareḥ kaṇṭhe varamālāṃ nyadhustadā ।
patiṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāśca tāḥ śubhāḥ ।।88।।
abhavan rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
bhojanāni tadā rātrau jagrāha sārthakānvitaḥ ।।89।।
āśvinā'sitatṛtīyarātrau viśrāntimāpa ca ।
siṣevire ca nāthaṃ svaṃ kanyāstisro'tibhāvataḥ ।।2.221.90।।
harirjagrāha vai nidrāṃ prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ ।
vādyaghoṣairgītibhiśca vedamantraiśca kīrtanaiḥ ।।9 1 ।।
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ praśaṃsāvākyakāvyakaiḥ ।
kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo vavande pitarau nijau ।।92।।
dugdhapānādikaṃ cakre caturthyāṃ prātareva saḥ ।
prajāstvāyayurīśeśapūjārthaṃ prātareva ha ।।93 ।।
rājā pupūja pūrvaṃ taṃ prajāścānarcuracyutam ।
tato dadau harirdravyaṃ bāladvijarṣaye dhanam ।।94।।
rāyasomananṛpatirbāladvijaṛṣistathā ।
santuṣṭau paramau jātau prajāstuṣṭāstathā'bhavan ।।95।।
hariścopādideśā'tha rādhike hitakṛttadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'vatārakāraṇam ।।96 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āntaḥprāgasthanagaryāmupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇam āśvinakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ prātarbālyarajonṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ
mantriṇāṃgānagaryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vidāyaṃ yautakaṃ sāyaṃ ca rāyasomananṛparāṣṭragamanaṃ vāyumānānagaryāṃ svāgataṃ bhramaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।22 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 221 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 222
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 223 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaścopādideśa tatprajāḥ ।
prātareva nṛpasaudhe viśāle hitakṛtprabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
rāyasomananṛpatiḥ śuśrāva sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ pradhānādyāḥ sahasraśo'pi śuśruvuḥ ।। 2 ।।
harau tyāgaḥ sadā kāryaḥ pravṛtteḥ karmaṇāṃ tathā ।
evaṃ tyāgī tu nairguṇyaṃ vindati mokṣasādhanam ।। 3 ।।
tyāge yasya hutaṃ karma na tasya phaladaṃ bhavet ।
nirbandhān samparityajya rāgahīno bhavet sadā ।। 4 ।।
aśokaṃ māṃ parabrahmā''tiṣṭhed yena mahatsukham ।
ajitaṃ tu jayet prājño manaḥ saṃgeṣvasaṃgataḥ ।। 5 ।।
indriyairgṛhyate yat tat tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ na bhāvataḥ ।
mano nigṛhya vai prāṇān dhārayet paramātmani ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ dhāraṇayā syādvai nirvāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ।
sukhaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ prāpyaṃ brahmārpaṇena sarvathā ।। 7 ।।
satyaṃ brahma sadā grāhyaṃ cānṛtaṃ heyameva ca ।
anṛtaṃ tu tamaḥ proktamāndhyapradaṃ ca gartadam ।। 8 ।।
vāsanārajjuyuktasya garte patanamāsthitam ।
avāsanasya tṛptasya prakāśo dhāmadaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 9 ।।
prakāśaṃ tu samālambya yateta duḥkhahānaye ।
tamonāśāya satataṃ satāṃ samāgamādibhiḥ ।। 2.222.1 0।।
śārīrairmānasairvāpi duḥkhairnodvijate tu yaḥ ।
mama saṃgī sukhaṃ vetti sa eva mama mārgagaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yatra duḥkhaṃ sa nirayaḥ sukhaṃ tu paramaṃ padam ।
tyaktaduḥkhasamārambhaḥ svargastasya na durlabhaḥ ।। 12।।
brahmavratena doṣāṃśca dagdhvā jayetparaṃ padam ।
muktyāśramaṃ yaścarate muktabuddhirharipriyaḥ ।। 13 ।।
sarvaṃ hutvā harau brahmalokaṃ janaḥ sa vindati ।
santaḥ sevyā brahmabhaktā brahmāptistena jāyate ।। 14।।
ācāraniratāḥ santo mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।
pālyaḥ sadā śubhācāro gṛhasthairapi bhūtaye ।। 15 ।।
śaucamāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpi vṛddhānāṃ mānanaṃ tathā ।। 16 ।।
sūryaṃ sadopatiṣṭheta sandhyākāle hariṃ smaret ।
śuciḥ kuryād bhojanaṃ ca na nindyānmānavādikān ।। 17।।
devālayaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ sādhvīṃ vṛṣaṃ catuṣpatham ।
dhārmikaṃ divyapuruṣaṃ nityaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam ।। 18।।
atithīnāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ ।
anāthānāṃ copakāraṃ kuryācchakto bhavedyadi ।। 1 9।।
dvivāraṃ caikavāraṃ vā bhojanaṃ nā'ntarā tu tat ।
evaṃ bhakṣayitā proktaścopavāsī sadā sukhī ।।2.222.20 ।।
yajñakārye pradātā ca ṛtau dānī na cānyathā ।
evaṃ dānto brahmacārī sadā bhavati śobhanaḥ ।। 21 ।।
amṛtaṃ devabhuktaṃ vai pathyaṃ tathā'mṛtaṃ matam ।
pāṃktaṃ grāhyaṃ yasya sosti devavanmānavaḥ sukhī ।। 22।।
santastūpāsate devaprasādaṃ cāyuṣaḥ pradam ।
santaścopāsanīyā vai prasādakāmanāvatā ।। 23।।
guroḥ sevā prakartavyā kartavyaṃ cābhivādanam ।
gurūnabhyarcya yujyante hyāyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ।। 24।।
tīrthānāṃ guravastīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ guravaḥ śuciḥ ।
śiṣṭakṛtaṃ praśastaṃ tad gopucchaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ।।25।।
darśane sparśane nityaṃ guruṃ sādhuṃ hi sevayet। ।
sādhorvai mastakaṃ keśāḥ romāṇi pāvanāni vai ।।।26 ।।
satāṃ pādarajo mokṣapradaṃ pāpapraṇāśakam ।
sādhūnāṃ sparśanaṃ puṇyaṃ netre puṇye sadā mate ।।27।।
karṇau puṇyau hi sādhūnāṃ nāsā puṇyā sugandhinī ।
bhālaṃ vai tu satāṃ puṇyaṃ gaṇḍagālau hi puṇyakau ।।28।।
kapolau sarvathā puṇyau hāsyaṃ puṇyaṃ manoharam ।
dantā jihvā tathauṣṭhau ca puṇyadāḥ pāvanāḥ satām ।। 29।।
kaṇṭhaḥ puṇyastathā śabdo vāṇī puṇyā sarasvatī ।
kathā puṇyā hi sādhūnāṃ puṇyadā saṃgatiḥ satām ।।2.222.30।।
skandhau puṇyau bāhuhastau puṇyau karāṃgulidhrajāḥ ।
nakhāḥ puṇyāśca rekhāśca prakoṣṭhaḥ puṇyadastathā ।।3 1।।
kaphoṇikā tathā cipīṭikā puṇyā satāṃ sadā ।
hastatale sadā puṇyaprade vakṣaśca puṇyakṛt ।।32।।
stanacihno sadā puṇyau nābhiḥ puṇyā ca pāvanī ।
udaraṃ puṇyakṛccāpi kaṭiḥ puṇyatamā satām ।। 33।।
guptaṃ supāvanaṃ cāpi jaghanaṃ pāvanaṃ sadā ।
nitambau pāvanau cāpi sakthinī pāvane tathā ।।34।।
indriyāṇi pāvanāni jānū ca pāvanau sadā ।
jaṃghe pāvanakāriṇyau ghūṭike pāvane tathā ।। 35।।
pattale caraṇau cāṃgulikā nakhāśca pāvanāḥ ।
tvaṅmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ divyaṃ divyaṃ tathā'sthimaṇḍalam ।। 36 ।।
majjā medo rasaścāpi pāvanā dhātavaḥ satām ।
śrīhareriva sādhūnāṃ sarve pāvanakārakam ।।37।।
trividhā bhagavatputrāḥ pāvanā bhagavāniva ।
santo vai bhagavatputrā dīkṣitāśca gṛhāśramāḥ ।। 38।।
vaṃśodbhavāstathā putrāstrayaste pāvanottamāḥ ।
bhagavadbhaktisampannāsturyāste pāvanā api ।।39।।
dīkṣayā karmaṇā bhaktyā jñānena ca samanvitāḥ ।
santaḥ śrīharitulyāste pāvanā jagatāṃ matāḥ ।।2.222.40।।
tatprasādaḥ pāpahartā tajjalaṃ gāṃgato'dhikam ।
tatsevā pāpahā sarvā brahmārpaṇaṃ tadarpaṇam ।।41।।
sādhavo yaṃ tu vṛkṣādi spṛśanti taravo'pi te ।
divyā mokṣapradā loke jāyante pāpanāśakāḥ ।।42।।
yadvastraṃ dhāryate sadbhiḥ kārpāsaṃ vaurṇameva vā ।
kauśeyaṃ drutvaksvarūpaṃ divyaṃ tatpāvanaṃ sadā ।।43।।
paśuḥ pakṣī jano vā'nyaḥ sādhunā spṛṣṭa eva yaḥ ।
sa vai divyo bhavatyāśu bhūtapiṇḍo'pyalaukikaḥ ।।44।।
aśuddhaṃ jāyate śuddhaṃ sādhusparśena pāvanam ।
pāpaṃ pāpataraṃ vāpi sādhusparśād viśuddhyati ।।45।।
sādhunā yad dhṛtaṃ dehe tacchuddhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।
jalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavatyāśu sādhunā sevituṃ tu yat। ।।46।।
pṛthvī satā sevitā ca tīrthībhūtā bhavatyati ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ dhāryaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca vā'param ।।47।।
yadyat sādhuprasaṃgaṃ vai prāptaṃ śuddhaṃ hi tanmatam ।
sādhusevī sadā śuddhaḥ sādhvī divyā harestanūḥ ।।48।।
vāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ vācyaṃ śuddhaṃ sādhuprasevitam ।
sāyaṃ prātaśca sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ svargamokṣadam ।।।49।।
sādhusevā paro dharmaḥ sādhusevā dhanaṃ param ।
sādhusevā paraḥ kāmo mokṣo'pi sādhusevanāt ।।2.222.50।।
hṛdayaṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ sādhutāṃ yāti sarvathā ।
sañcitaṃ sādhutādravyaṃ pade dhāmni sahāyadam ।।51 ।।
sādhutā sarvabhūtānāṃ śāntidā kṣemavāhinī ।
arjayet sādhutāṃ tasmād dhāmamārge sahāyinīm ।।52।।
devarṣipitṝṇāṃ yoniḥ sādhutā brahmasevinām ।
muktānāṃ sādhutā yonistāṃ seveta sadā budhaḥ ।।53।।।
maraṇaṃ dhruvamevā'sti kṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ gataṃ tu tat। ।
nūtanaṃ nārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati kimatsyasi ।।54।।
ityevaṃ samvicāryaiva puṇyapradā hi sādhavaḥ ।
sevanīyā hi satataṃ pitaro devatāstathā ।।55।।
sevāphalaṃ mahatsvargaṃ tvagre sthāsyati niścitam ।
prasannatāphalaṃ guroścāgre sthāsyati niścitam ।।56।।
iti nirṇīya satataṃ sevyantāṃ sādhavo'malāḥ ।
bhagavanmūrtayaḥ santi sādhavaḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥ ।।57।।
yasmāt sṛṣṭiriyaṃ jātā yato'vatārakoṭayaḥ ।
yasmādaiśvaryamāsādya jāyante ceśvarādayaḥ ।।58।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā yamarcayanti nityaśaḥ ।
yataḥ sūryādayastejaḥpradhānāḥ saṃbhavantyapi ।।59।।
yato bhūtāni jāyante yasmāt hriyanta eva ca ।
indriyāṇi mano buddhiryasmājjātāni santi ca ।।2.222.60 ।।
tatra sākṣī sthito devaścetano'nukriyāparaḥ ।
taṃ niyamyā''ntare cāste yaḥ prabhuḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 61 ।।
yena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ vartate cāpiyāti ca ।
taṃ samāśritya deveśaṃ labhate śamamuttamam ।।62।।
tyaktvā vai prākṛtaṃ bhāvaṃ divyabhāvamupetya yaḥ ।
ātmaratirbhaved bhaktaḥ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ।।63।।
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī vāriṇā nahi lipyate ।
kṛtaprajñastathā loke sthitaścāpi na lipyate ।।64।।
iṣṭadevakṛpāprāptatuṣṭisantoṣavān naraḥ ।
aśocannaprahṛṣyeśca tiṣṭhate corṇanābhivat ।।65।।
vāsanākhyāṃ dṛḍhāṃ granthiṃ hṛdayasthāṃ nijātmanaḥ ।
vicchitvā sukhamāsīta paraṃdhāma sa cāpnuyāt ।।66।।
malino jalamādāya yathā śuddhati cāplutaḥ ।
tathā māyākaluṣo'pi śuddhiṃ yāti satāṃ grahāt ।।67।।
mahāraṇyasya pārajño na vai muhyati tatra vai ।
tathā māyāntavijñātā na vai tattveṣu muhyati ।।68।।
trivargo yasya viditaḥ prekṣya bhuktvā pramuñcati ।
abaddhasya nirīhasya brahmamārgaḥ prakāśate ।।69।।
viduṣāṃ na bhayaṃ cāsti tvajñānāṃ nirbhayaṃ na vai ।
ubhayeṣāṃ hareryoge cātyantikabhayaṃ na vai ।।2.222.70।।
yatkāryaṃ jāyate loke'nabhisandhiprapūrvakam ।
na tad bandhāya jāyeta priyaṃ vā'priyakaṃ samam ।।71 ।।
lokamāturamālokya sādhūṃścā'nāturāँstathā ।
sādhuvṛttiṃ samāśritya māṃ bhajed yastareddhi saḥ ।।72।।
śocato naiva paśyedvai yena śoko na naśyati ।
aśocataḥ sadā paśyed yenā''pyeta satāṃ sukham ।।73 ।।
satāṃ mārgānusāreṇa ye prayānti janāstviha ।
satāṃ gatiṃ labhante te prayānti paramaṃ padam ।।74।।
yatrā'haṃ satataṃ cā'smi virājito mahāhariḥ ।
anantakoṭimuktaiḥ saṃsevito dhyāta eva ca ।।75 ।।
ityuktvā rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
virarāma dadau mantrān vaiṣṇavān vai tadā svayam ।।76।।
rājā prajāḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjurbahuvastubhiḥ ।
harirgantumiyeṣā'tha rājā dadau vidāyakam ।।77।।
yautakaṃ ca dadau śreṣṭhaṃ hariḥ sajjo babhūva ha ।
tāvattatra samāyāto rājārāyapatirnṛpaḥ ।।78।।
rājagirarṣisahitaḥ prārthayituṃ prabhuṃ harim ।
netuṃ svakīyabhavanam ārṣajatanurāṣṭrakam ।।79।।
vyenojarāśānagarīṃ parībhāsaritastaṭe ।
āvāsayituṃ satataṃ bhagavantaṃ tadā''rthayat ।।2.222.80 ।।
hariḥ kṛpāvaśastasmai tathāstviti nyavedayat ।
adya vai samayo nāsti gantavyaṃ tvadhare drutam ।।8 1 ।।
śvaḥ pañcamyāṃ bhaved yajñārambho brāhmīlarāṣṭrake ।
tasmād yajñaṃ samāpyaiva trayodaśyāṃ prage nṛpa ।।।।82।।
bhavadrājye samāyāsye sāyaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ ।
bhavanmano'nusāreṇa sthāsye tavā''laye'dhikam ।।83।।
bhavatā tu makhe tatrā''gantavyaṃ pañcamīprage ।
ekādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne samāptiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।।84।।
ityukto hariṇā bhūpaḥ svīcakāra harervacaḥ ।
pūjayitvā yayau naijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tūrṇaṃ vimānagaḥ ।।85।।
atha rājā dvitīyo'pi samāyācchrīhariṃ prati ।
urugavākṣanṛpatiḥ rāyagrāmāpurīpatiḥ ।।86।।
urogamanarāṣṭreśaḥ prārthayatparameśvaram ।
mānatrivedaṛṣirāṭ prārthayaccāpi mādhavam ।।87।।
mama rāṣṭraṃ prajāścāpi pāvayā''gatya keśava ।
haristathā'stviti prāha sajjo vimānago'bhavat ।।88।।
sārthā vimānagāścāpyabhavaँstadā prajājanāḥ ।
rājādyāśca vidāye vai janā nādān samūcire ।।89 ।।
bahuvādyānyavādyanta vimānaṃ cāmbare'bhavat ।
nataṃ prajājanaiḥ puṣpākṣatādyaiḥ pūjitaṃ tu khe ।।2.222.90 ।।
prasasāra tataścāgre urogamanarāṣṭrakam ।
āyayau śīghrameveti rājā hyavātarat puraḥ ।।9 1 ।।
sammānaṃ svāgataṃ cakre rāyagrāmāpurīpatiḥ ।
śṛṃgāritā'bhūnnagarī prāsādaḥ śobhito'bhavat ।।92।।
dhvajādyaiḥ patrakadalīstambhatoraṇasvastikaiḥ ।
kalaśai_ raṃgavallyādyairjalasecanakaistathā ।।93 ।।
evaṃvidhāyā puryāśca sannidhau sāgarāntike ।
vimānaṃ śrīharernaijaṃ saṃketenā'nayadbhuvam ।।94।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।
bheryādyā nedire nārīgītayaścā'bhavan śubhāḥ ।।95।।
yantrīśabdā garjanāśca prajānāṃ harṣasadgiraḥ ।
abhavan svāgatārthaṃ vai vimānaṃ samavardhayan ।। 96।।
prajāḥ puṣpākṣatādyaiśca haristvagre samāyayau ।
vanditaḥ pūjito rājñā rājñyā prajābhirityapi ।। 97।।
niṣasāda śubhe svarṇāsane śrībhagavāँstadā ।
rādhike stabakān hārān harergale dadau nṛpaḥ ।। 98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pātragonayarāṣṭrīyaprajābhya upadeśanaṃ vidāyaṃ tato rājārāyapatirājyam ārṣajatanurāṣṭraṃ prati gamanaprārthanāṃ svīkṛtya tata urogamanarāṣṭraṃ prati gamanaṃ sammānanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।222।।

adhyāyaḥ 223
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 224 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike śrīhariṃ bhrāmayituṃ svapattane nṛpaḥ ।
rāyagrāmānagaryāṃ vai sainyaṃ sajjaṃ samānayat ।। 1 ।।
hariṃ nyaṣādayattatra śvetā'śvarathake śubhe ।
kuṭumbaṃ ca tathā kanyā brahmapriyā ratheṣu ca ।। 2 ।।
vāditraninadairgītaiḥ saha kṛṣṇaṃ pure nṛpaḥ ।
abhrāmayat sukhaṃ tatra gopure tu pradhānakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
pupūjuḥ paramātmānaṃ catvare śreṣṭhisattamāḥ ।
rathyāmukheṣu nāryaśca mārge haṭṭeṣu vai prajāḥ ।। 4 ।।
suvarṇarūpyamudrābhiścandanā'kṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।
ambaraiḥ puṣpahāraiśca nārikelaphalādibhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
evaṃ bhramitvā nagarīṃ harī rājyālayaṃ yayau ।
urugavākṣanṛpatiḥ pupūja parameśvaram ।। 6 ।।
cakre'bhiṣekaṃ payasā pādayoḥ paramātmanaḥ ।
tato miṣṭajalaiścāpi śuddhodakena vai tataḥ ।। 7 ।।
papuḥ rājakuṭumbādyāḥ śrīhareścaraṇāmṛtam ।
rājñī pūjā cakārātha nīrājanaṃ vyadhādapi ।। 8 ।।
kanyake dve tadā kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe mālāṃ tu kausumīm ।
varamālātmikāṃ dīrghāṃ dadatuḥ śobhanavrate ।। 9 ।।
kṛtakṛtye tu te jāte prāpya kāntaṃ śriyāḥ patim ।
rājā rājñī ca menāte kṛtakṛtye tadā hṛdi ।। 2.223.1 0।।
tadutsavaṃ tadā rājā kārayāmāsa śobhanam ।
bhojayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca mahīmānān samantataḥ ।। 11 ।।
harirdravyaṃ dadau mānatrivedamunaye'khilam ।
tataścopādideśāpi prajābhyastatra mādhavaḥ ।। 12।।
vṛttīnāṃ vilaye kṛṣṇo bhāsate hṛdaye sadā ।
dhyānagamyo bhavatyeva nārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ]।। 1 3।।
dhyānayogena munayaḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ gatāḥ purā ।
gacchanti ca gamiṣyanti yoginaśca pare tathā ।। 14।।
dhyānajñānamahātṛptā nirvāṇahṛdayā janāḥ ।
nā''vartante hi saṃsāre muktāḥ saṃsārakardamāt ।। 15। ।
rāgadveṣaparityaktāścātmabhāve vyavasthitāḥ ।
nityasattvasthitā muktā nāvartante punaḥ kvacit ।। 16 ।।
śāntipradāni karmāṇi saṃgahīnāni yāni ca ।
vādamāyārahitāni kurvanmāṃ yāti bhaktimān ।। 17।।
prātarutthāya ca mano niyamya mama sannidhau ।
mama mūrtau dhārayedvai cintayet pratimāṃ mama ।। 18।।
śabdaṃ sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ vā rasaṃ gandhaṃ hyupasthitam ।
gṛhṇīyānnaiva maddhyātā cintayennānyavastukam ।। 1 9।।
indriyāṇi manaḥ piṇḍīkṛtya mayi nirodhanam ।
kuryād yastasya manmūrtisphuraṇaṃ hṛdye bhavet ।।2.223.20।।
cañcale vai mano dhyāne mīnavad yadi jāyate ।
samādadhyātpunarmūrtau parāvṛttya prasahya tat ।।2 1 ।।
sabhūṣāmbaraveṣāḍhye mayi dhyānaṃ purā caret ।
tato veṣaṃ vilīyaiva mūrtimātraṃ vicintayet ।।22।।
tato divyaṃ hasantaṃ ca vadantaṃ māṃ vicintayet ।
tataścānandadātāraṃ tvekarūpaṃ vicintayet ।।23।।
evaṃ mūrtau cendriyāṇi mano'haṃkārabuddhayaḥ ।
vilīyante śanaiḥ premṇā tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।24।।
yogināṃ pragatiścaiṣā karmiṇāṃ nyāsalakṣaṇā ।
bahirvṛttānīndriyāṇi kṛṣṇārthāni samāni ca ।। 25।।
arpitāni vidheyāni sarvārpaṇena karmibhiḥ ।
śuddhaḥ siddho mama bhaktaḥ sarvārpaṇena jāyate ।।।26 ।।
śanairyatrendriyagrāmo vegalagno bhavatyapi ।
vijñāya viṣayaṃ taṃ ca mūrtau samparikalpayet ।।27।।
tatra tatra sthiraṃ cittaṃ kartavyaṃ tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
iṣṭaviṣayadānena tṛptaṃ sthairyaṃ vrajiṣyati ।। 28।।
tatastaṃ viṣayaṃ mūrtau vilīya pratimāṃ mama ।
cintayettu śanairbhaktaścaivaṃ cireṇa śuddhyati ।। 29।।
prasanne mama yogena citte sattvodbhavottamaḥ ।
tena sneho mama bhaktistena muktirbhavedanu ।।2.223.3 0।।
dhyānaṃ tapo damaṃ kṣāntiṃ vyāpāraṃ cintanādikam ।
vāṇīṃ ceṣṭāṃ gatiṃ sarvāṃ pravṛttiṃ mayi cārpayet ।। 31 ।।
evaṃ pravartakaṃ yajñaṃ mayi tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ।
yadvā sarvavidheyāni pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā ca niṣkriyaḥ ।।32।।
bhūtvā pracintayenmāṃ vai manasā māṃ japet sadā ।
viṣayebhyo namaskuryād vyavahāraṃ na bhāvayet ।।3 3 ।।
hṛdyudbhāvya ca manmūrtiṃ tatra lagno bhavettataḥ ।
evaṃ madyogamāpannaścānte yāti paraṃ padam ।।34।।
sarvatyāgakṛtaścaivaṃ niricchasya tu yoginaḥ ।
brāhmyāstanvāḥ samavāptirmattulyo jāyate'kṣare ।।35।।
mama mūrtiṃ smarennityaṃ japennāma mamottamam ।
madarthaṃ tvācaret sarvaṃ mama lokamavāpnuyāt ।।36 ।।
brahmasthityā ca nirlipto bhūtvā māyā''mayordhvagaḥ ।
amṛtaṃ cāmṛtapadaṃ parātmānaṃ prapadyate ।।37।।
prāptīnāmuttamaprāptiḥ pareśvararuciḥ sadā ।
satāṃ prāptirhareḥ prāptirdhāmaprāptirna cetarā ।। 38।।
ahaṃkārakṛtā lokāḥ sarve nirayagāminaḥ ।
brahmakārakṛtā lokāḥ sarve tvakṣaragāminaḥ ।।39।।
ātmaghātī jano yāti nirayān yamarakṣitān ।
brahmasambandhamāpto vai nātmaghātī ca dhāmagaḥ ।।2.223.40।।
abhidhyānaṃ bhaved yatra pretabhāve ca tatra ca ।
jīvo yāti punarbhāvaṃ brahmābhidhyānamācaret ।। 41 ।।
aiśvaryadhyānaparamo yāti māyāṃ tu sāttvikīm ।
punarbhāvapradāṃ tasmād brahmadhyānaparo bhavet ।।42।।
aiśvaryaiḥ samadhivyāpto madagarvādyadhiṣṭhitaḥ ।
vartate māyayā yaśca sa eva nirayo'sya vai ।।43 ।।
yasya tṛṣṇā yakṣiṇī ca rākṣasī ceṣaṇā sthitā ।
cintā piśācī yasyāsti tāstisro nirayātmikāḥ ।।44।।
rāgaśca rākṣaso yasya moho yakṣo'sti yasya ca ।
dveṣaḥ piśāco yasyāsti te trayo rauravātmakāḥ ।।45।।
trayo yatra bhavantyasya tatra tatropapadyate ।
durbuddhirjāyate taiśca tābhiśca mohavartanam ।।46।।
akṛtaprajñakastena mṛtyuṃ yāti hi rauravam ।
duṣprajñānena nirayā bahavo'tra bhavanti vai ।।47।।
yajjvālā dehinaścātra dāhayanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
nahyatṛptasya saukhyaṃ vai nirduḥkhaṃ samajāyate ।।48।।
duḥkhamiśraṃ sukhaṃ yattannirayākhyaṃ mataṃ tviha ।
māyā niraya evāsti nirduḥkhā na kadāpi sā ।।49।।
māyādehavataḥ saukhyaṃ naikāntā'tyantakaṃ na hi ।
tasmāt saukhyaṃ nirayātma vinā'kṣarapadaṃ dhruvam ।।2.223.50।।।
varṇayāmi nirayān vai hyuccāvacān hi māyikān ।
prākṛtān layajuṣṭāँśca brahmabhāve tu niṣphalān ।।51।।
mānavānāṃ tu saṃbhogā nirayā eva gocarāḥ ।
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṃsthānāni gṛhāṇi ca ।।52।।
tādṛśā eva nirayā dehināṃ dehasaṃsthitāḥ ।
lokapānāṃ diśāpānāṃ grahāṇāṃ marutāṃ tathā ।।53।।
sādhyānāṃ viśvadevānāṃ gāndharvāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।
rudrādityavasūnāṃ ca siddhānāṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ।।54।।
divyāni kāmacārāṇi vimānāni sabhālayāḥ ।
udyānāni ca padminyaḥ kāñcaneyagṛhāṇi ca ।।55।।
amṛtāni ca bhogāśca tejo'mbarāṇi yāni ca ।
samṛddhayaḥ surādīnāṃ dehāścāmṛtabhojinaḥ ।।56।।
divyāṃganā divyaśayyā divyagandharasādayaḥ ।
māyāpākā nirayāste brahmadhāmāgrato matāḥ ।।57।।
īśvarāṇāṃ virājānāṃ pradhānapuruṣasya ca ।
māyādhāmnāṃ ca ye bhogāḥ sattvamayāśca māyikāḥ ।।58।।
te sarve'pi mahattattvātmajā nirayasaṃjñakāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhāmā'grato matāḥ ।।59।।
golokasya tathā dhāmno vaikuṇṭhasya samīpataḥ ।
māyāmayāśca ye lokā bhogāste nirayā matāḥ ।।2.223.60 ।।
brahmalokasamaṃ nānyaddhāmā'sti divyaśāśvatam ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmadhāmātmakaṃ hi tat ।।6 1।।
māyānirayaśūnyaṃ vai cāmāyikaṃ hi mokṣadam ।
ahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpo'smi rādhādibhiḥ prasevitaḥ ।।62।।
goloke gopagopībhirmadrūpābhiḥ prasevitaḥ ।
divyaśāśvatarūpo'smi yatra māyā na vidyate ।।63।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇarūpo vaikuṇṭhe parame sthitaḥ ।
lakṣmīramādibhirdivyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ susevitaḥ ।।64।।
pārṣadairdivyarūpaiśca sevito divyaśāśvataḥ ।
divyaśāśvatarūpo'smi yatra māyā na vidyate ।।65।।
vāsudevasvarūpo'smi tvavyākṛte pare sthale ।
yatra māyā na cā'styeva so'haṃ divyasvarūpavān ।।66।।
evaṃ yatra mayā sthānaṃ kṛtaṃ divyaṃ hi tanmama ।
madyogād divyatāṃ prāptaṃ nirayastanna vidyate ।।67।।
madviyuktāni saudhāni sthānāni smṛddhayastathā ।
svāminaḥ sthāninaḥ sarve nirayā māyayā hatāḥ ।।68।।
ityevaṃ saṃvilokyaiva prajñayā matpradattayā ।
madyogaṃ sarvathā kuryānnirayatvaṃ vilīyate ।।69।।
divyatvaṃ prāpyate cāpi madarthayogatāṃ gatam ।
yatra me nāsti sambandhaścārpaṇātmaka ityapi ।।2.223.70।।
tatra sampadyate kālo matsambaddhe sa na prabhuḥ ।
ahaṃ kālasya śāstā'smi mayi pravartate na saḥ ।।7 1 ।।
yatrāhaṃ tatra bhakto me gatvā naiva hi śocati ।
īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmasambandhināṃ satām ।।72।।
tadbhinnāni tu nirayāḥ sarve eva yathāyatham ।
tadvicārya tu matimān matsambandhaṃ samācaret ।।73।।
jaḍaṃ vā cetanaṃ vāpi matsambaddhaṃ vidhāpayet ।
tadevā'nirayaṃ proktaṃ divyaṃ divyasuyogataḥ ।।74।।
evaṃ jñātvā'rpayitvaiva bhaktā me divyatāṃ gatāḥ ।
sṛṣṭau te naiva jāyante kālagrāse na yānti ca ।।75।।
aduḥkhaṃ sukhamāpyaiva vartante śāśvate sukhe ।
mamānande pare dhāmnyaśnuvate sarvakāmanāḥ ।।76 ।।
mama jāpaprakartāro mama mūrtiparāyaṇāḥ ।
amṛtāścāmṛtaṃ prāpya brahmabhūtā bhavanti te ।।77।।
brahmasthānamanāvarttamekamakṣarasaṃjñakam ।
aduḥkhamajaraṃ śāntaṃ prayānti mama yoginaḥ ।।78।।
sarāgaścekṣate lokān sarvānnirayasaṃjñikān ।
madyuktaḥ sarvato mukto'kṣare tu ramate sukham ।।79।।
naikadhā mama mūrtau sa ramate ca mayā sadā ।
mamānandabhṛto mukto matto nyūno na vartate ।।2.223.80 ।।
ityevaṃ copadiśyaiva tato mantrān dadau hariḥ ।
prajābhyaśca nṛpasyāpi kuṭumbāya nṛpāya ca ।।8 1 ।।
atha kṛṣṇo manaścakre gantuṃ rājā tadā punaḥ ।
dravyaṃ ca yautakaṃ cāpi vidāyaṃ bahudhā dadau ।।82।।
vādyaghoṣaiḥ prajādvārā sammānaṃ bahudhā vyadhāt ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto rājā parāṅvratā'bhidhaḥ ।।83।।
alaṃtrātarṣisahitaścā''śanāpurīśvaraḥ ।
pārāvātarāṣṭrapatiḥ prārthayatparameśvaram ।।84।।
mama deśān samāgatya pāvayā'smān kṛpālaya ।
hariḥ śrutvā tathā'stvāha sajjo'bhūt sakuṭumbakaḥ ।।85।।
śīghraṃ pūjāṃ parigṛhya tadā vimānago'bhavat ।
brahmapriyādyāḥ kanyāśca ṛṣayo'pyakhilāstadā ।।86।।
vimānasthā abhavaँśca vimānaṃ prasasāra ha ।
vegena cāgataṃ pārāvātarāṣṭraṃ tadā nṛpaḥ ।।87।।
parāṅvrato hi sahasā'mbarāt pūrvamavā'tarat ।
svāgataṃ nijasainyena śrīharestu samācarat ।।88।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayanādāstathā'bhavan ।
prajāḥ svāñjalibhiḥ susthāḥ svāgataṃ vai samācaran ।।89।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇāvātarad vai vimānakam ।
udyāne subhage cā''śāsanāpuryāḥ samīpage ।। 2.223.90।।
hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prajā rājā rājñī prādhānikāstathā ।
anye'pi cāgatāḥ sarve svāgataṃ namanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।9 1 ।।
rājā pupūja puṣpādyaiḥ svarṇahāraiḥ sumauktikaiḥ ।
rājñī nīrājanaṃ cakre hariṃ nyaṣādayattataḥ ।।92।।
gaje svarṇāmbālikayā yute cānyān rathādiṣu ।
āśāsanānagaryāṃ tu bhrāmayāmāsa mādhavam ।। 93।।
pupūjurmānavāḥ sarve sāyaṃ ratnāmbarādibhiḥ ।
dravyasauvarṇamudrābhiḥ puṣpākṣatasragādibhiḥ ।।94।।
bhrāmayitvā rājasaudhaṃ tvānayāmāsa keśavam ।
pūjayāmāsa ca punarbhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।।95।।
tataḥ kanyādvayaṃ rājño mātrājñayā pareśvaram ।
pupūja ca hariṃ vavre patiṃ ca varamālayā । ।96।।
kaṇṭhe samarpya mālāṃ te kanyake tvarpite tadā ।
abhavatāṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇe sarveśe parameśvare ।।97।।
rājā mumoda hṛdaye rājñī prasannatāmagāt ।
kṛtakṛtye kanyake ca jāte nṛpo mahotsavam ।।98।।
kārayāmāsa vai rātrau hariścopādideśa ha ।
rādhike rājasaudhe vai sarveṣāṃ mokṣasādhanam ।।99।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ rāyagrāmānagaryāṃ bhramaṇam upadeśanaṃ pūjanaṃ vidāyaṃ tataḥ parāṅvratanṛpasya pārāvātarājye gamanam āśāsanāpuryāṃ
svāgataṃ āśvinakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ sāyaṃ bhramaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 223 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 223 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 224
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 225 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike bhagavānāha sarvāḥ prajā nṛpādikān ।
śvo'sti yajño mahān śreṣṭho brāhmīle rāṣṭrake śubhe ।। 1 ।।
yajño yatra bhavatyeva deśaḥ sa puṇyado bhavet। ।
yajño nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sa cāsmi puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2 ।।
ahaṃ yajñena satataṃ prasannastṛptimemi hi ।
mayyarpitāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yajña eva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
nahi khalvanupāyena kaścidartho'pi siddhyati ।
yajñakāryeṇa yajño'yaṃ siddhyāmīha na saṃśayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
mṛgairmṛgāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣibhiryathā ।
gajānāṃ ca gajairevaṃ yajño yajñena gṛhyate ।। 5 ।।
yathā candro hyamāyāṃ vai hyaliṃgatvānna dṛśyate ।
tathā'haṃ hṛdi kaluṣe dṛśyo bhavāmi naiva ha ।। 6 ।।
yathā pūrṇāṃ tithiṃ prāpya bhrājate candramāstathā ।
bhaktipūrṇāṃ matiṃ prāpya vibhrāje'haṃ pareśvaraḥ ।। 7 ।।
rāhugrasto'pyapi candro jāyate viprakāśakaḥ ।
māyāgrasto'pi jīvātmā viprakāśaḥ prajāyate ।। 8 ।।
abuddhiścā'kṛtaprajñastvākṛṣyate bahirmukhaḥ ।
viṣayeṣu kṛtāvāsaḥ kadāpi nahi tṛpyati ।। 9 ।।
atṛptasya na vai śāntiraśāntasya na vai sukham ।
asukhasya na vai mokṣaḥ punarnirayagāmitā ।। 2.224.1 0।।
viṣayāścaiko nirayaścendriyāṇi dvitīyakaḥ ।
manastṛtīyo nirayo vāsanā tu turīyakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
karmāṇi pañcamaścāpi ṣaṣṭho nirayo durguṇāḥ ।
saptamastu gṛhe kleśaścāṣṭamaśca daridratā ।। 12।
navamo nirayo rogo daśamaḥ paravaśyatā ।
ekādaśaścāpakīrtirdvādaśo buddhihīnatā ।। 1 3।।
trayodaśaḥ kuṭumbādiścaturdaśastu bhṛtyatā ।
pañcadaśo vyaṃgatā ca śatravaḥ ṣoḍaśo'pi saḥ ।। 14।।
saptadaśastu vai sākṣād deho nirayasaṃjñakaḥ ।
aṣṭādaśo vikārāśca dehajā nirayā ime ।। 15।।
ityevaṃ nirayā loke saṃlagnā dehināmiha ।
yajñena yajñamāsādya nirnirayagato bhavet ।। 16।।
yāvat kalmaṣamāste vai tṛṣāchedo na tāvatā ।
nivartate tadā tṛṣā kalmaṣānto bhaved yadā ।। 17।।
viṣayeṣu tu saṃsargāt tarṣo vivardhate sadā ।
viṣayāṇāṃ virāgeṇā'tarṣo jñānena vardhate ।। 18।।
jñānā''darśe nijātmānaṃ śuddhaṃ paśyati paśyakaḥ ।
indriyāṇāṃ niyamena sukhī bhavati mānavaḥ ।। 1 9।।
indriyebhyaśca rūpebhyo yacchedātmānamātmanā ।
vimuñcetprākṛtān grāmān matsthito'mṛtamaśnute ।।2.224.20।।
praṇītaṃ karmaṇā mārgaṃ bhuktvā tyaktvā'thavā mayi ।
svargaṃ vā śāśvataṃ svargaṃ maddhāma paramaṃ labhet ।। 21 ।।
ātmā tyājyaguṇairhīno yadā mayi pravartate ।
tadā sampadyate dhāma brahmalokaṃ mamāśrayam ।।22।।
ākṛtayo vilīnāḥ syuḥ samanobuddhivṛttayaḥ ।
yadā''tmani brahmarūpe parabrahma prakāśate ।। 23 ।।
āgataṃ viṣayaṃ duḥkhaṃ cintayenna nivartate ।
bhaiṣajyametattyāgasya yadeteṣāṃ na cintanam ।।24।।
anityaṃ jīvanaṃ dravyaṃ priyayogo gṛhādikam ।
kālabhakṣaṃ vicāryaitanna gṛdhyettatra cātmavit ।। 25।।
duḥkhaṃ tyaktaṃ bhavettatra sukhaṃ yadviṣayodbhavam ।
duḥkhamiśraṃ ca tadapi duḥkhabahulamityapi ।।26।।।
vicāryobhayamevāpi tyajedabhyeti māṃ hi saḥ ।
yadātmanā bhaved bhaktirbrahmabhāve'timāyike ।।27।।
tadā prajñāyate brahma labhyate ca samādhinā ।
brahmabhāvaṃ ca nikaṣā gato dhyānamavāpnuyāt ।।28।।
dhyāto'haṃ cāsya vai dhyātrā cārohāmi tadantaram ।
sarvadvāraniruddhasya prakāśe'haṃ tadātmani ।।29।।
guṇānāṃ vilayastasyā'nāyāsena prajāyate ।
aguṇo divyaguṇavān madrūpaḥ sa prajāyate ।। 2.224.30 ।।
saguṇāḥ prakṛtau sarve pravartante śarīriṇaḥ ।
svargayogyāśca te sarve nirguṇāstu madarhaṇāḥ ।। 31 ।।
yāvadasya vartate'tra bhūtāveśo'tikaṣṭadaḥ ।
tāvadasya khaniścāste duḥkhasaṃsāravastujā ।।32।।।
yāvadasya ca bhūtānāṃ viyogo jāyate bhṛśam ।
sūkṣmāṇāṃ cāpi hetūnāṃ brahma sampadyate tadā ।।।33।।
dharmād bhaktervirāgāccotkṛṣyate śreya ātmanā ।
śreyasā''ḍhyo hariṃ caiti mā paraśreyasāṃ nidhim ।।34।।
yathā sāmyarasā bhūmirbhinnabījarasā'nugā ।
tathā sāmyarasaścātmā bhinnakarmajadehagaḥ ।। 35।।
yathā svarṇaṃ lohamiśraṃ vahninā śodhitaṃ bhavet ।
tathā dehī mama bhaktyā prajñayā śodhito bhavet ।।36।।
prajñā purāṇī maddattā śodhitasya prakāśate ।
prajñāsṛtiṃ samālambya bhaktimān māṃ prapadyate ।।37।।
prajñānāṃ cāpi bhaktīnāṃ phalaṃ me divyadarśanam ।
aprajñāścāpyabhaktāśca taṃ māṃ paśyanti naiva ha ।।38।।
karmibhyaḥ sāttvikāḥ śreṣṭhāstato'pi śuddhasattvajāḥ ।
tebhyaḥ kālo mamaśaktirbalavān sarvabhakṣakaḥ ।।39।।
kālātparaṃ tu me dhāmā'kṣaraṃ divyaṃ nivāsanam ।
nādirnamadhyaṃ naivāntastasya dhāmnaḥ pravidyate ।।2.224.40।।
janmamṛtyujarājanyaṃ duḥkha yatra na vidyate ।
tad brahma paramaṃ sthānaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ padam ।।41 ।।
kālamūrdhni padaṃ dhṛtvā madbhaktā yānti tatpadam ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ śubhaṃ madarpaṇātmakam ।।42।।
samāśritya prayāntyeva tato'nantaṃ parākṣaram ।
na yatnasādhyaṃ tadbrahma śabdabrahma samaṃ matam ।।43।।
kṛpāsādhyaṃ hi tadbrahma parabrahmaprasajjakam ।
pāpāt sādhanavirahādāsakteḥ karmabandhanāt ।।44।।
martyā naiva prapaśyanti svarūpaṃ nirmalaṃ nijam ।
viṣayeṣu tu viśrāntermamāhaṃkārabhāvanāt ।।45।।
balāttṛṣṇāpravāhasya brahma nātmā prapadyate ।
satāṃ prasevanād dhyānānmanmūrterbhaktibhāvanāt ।।46।।
brahmābhyāsāt pravairāgyāt snehād brahma prakāśate ।
guṇamiṣṭaṃ prapaśyanti miṣṭatṛṣṇāparāhatāḥ ।।47।।
paraṃ naivābhikāṃkṣanti cāmṛtottamamācyutam ।
avaraiśca guṇairyuktā naiva paśyanti pāragān ।।48।।
apāragā muhuścātra vicālyante'ṇḍarāśiṣu ।
satāṃ yogena bahavaḥ para pāraṃ gatāḥ purā ।।49।।
santaścaranti satataṃ śreyomārgajuṣāṃ puraḥ ।
yadi nāmā''śrayante cet pārameṣyanti satvaram ।।2.224.50।।
āśīrvādātpuṇyabalāt sevāphalāt sukarmaṇaḥ ।
cedāśritāstadā yanti tūrṇaṃ brāhmīṃ tanuṃ śubhām ।।5 1 ।।
dhyātṝṇāṃ sevināṃ snigdhabhaktānāṃ brahmavartinām ।
sanātanī gatiryā'sti tāmamṛtāṃ prayānti te ।।52।।
ityupādiśya ca kṛṣṇo virarāma pareśvaraḥ ।
jalapānādikaṃ kṛtvā suṣvāpa bhagavān prabhuḥ ।।53।।
kanyakāsevitaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prage ।
prabubodha suvādyādyairmaṃgalairgītibhistataḥ ।।54।।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ śīghraṃ gantumiyeṣa ha ।
rājā vidāyaṃ pradadau yautakaṃ pradadau tathā ।।55।।
svasārthasahitaḥ sajjo babhūva brāhmasaṃjñake ।
muhūrtaṃ śrīhariḥ samāruroha ca vimānakam ।।56 ।।
tadā tūryāṇyavādyanta prajāśca mānanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
vardhitaḥ śrīharirdravyaṃ cālaṃtrātarṣaye dadau ।।57।।
śṛṇvan yaśo nijaṃ vyomni vimānaṃ cairayad drutam ।
āśvīnakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ prātareva makhasthalīm ।।।58।।
brāhmīlarāṣṭre goyājānagaryāḥ sannidhau śubhe ।
āmrajānikanadyāstu taṭe śīghraṃ samāgamat ।।59।।
vimānaṃ vai tadā jātaṃ sūryasahasrasatprabham ।
pratīkṣamāṇāḥ ṛṣayo rājādyāśca prajājanāḥ ।।2.224.60।।
vimānamāgataṃ vīkṣya dudruvuḥ svāgatasthalīm ।
viśāle bhūtale nadyāstīre'saṃkhyajanā''śrite ।।6 1 ।।
sthirībhūtā janāḥ svasthāḥ, avātarad vimānakam ।
jayaśabdāḥ prajānāṃ vai gaganaprasarāstadā ।।62।।
abhavaँstūpaśabdaśca yantrīśabdāḥ sumānadāḥ ।
pratidhvanayo dhvanijāḥ pratineduḥ samantataḥ ।।63।।
gītayo yoṣitāṃ cāpyaśrūyanta harṣasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
vādyānāṃ ca vicitrā vai dhvanayo'pyabhavaँstadā ।।64।।
śaṃkhanādāśca parito bigūlānāṃ ninādakāḥ ।
abhavanmaṃgalaghoṣā viprāṇāṃ tvāgate harau ।।65।।
vimānaṃ vardhitaṃ cāpi rājanyaiḥ samprapūjitam ।
surairdevagaṇaiścāpi kusumāñjalikārpitam ।।66।।
candanaiḥ prokṣitaṃ tilakitaṃ kuṃkumacandritam ।
namaskṛtaṃ vanditaṃ sammānitaṃ cāpi bhāvanaiḥ ।।67।।
śrīhariśca vimānādvai kṣaṇamātraṃ bahiryayau ।
tadā hārān hareḥ kaṇṭhe dadurmaharṣayastathā ।।68।।
lomaśastilakaṃ cakre śaṃbhuḥ puṣpasrajaṃ dadau ।
īśānapānaśiṣṭaśca rājā svarṇasrajaṃ dadau ।।69।।
śāntārāmaṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe vṛndāsrajaṃ dadau ।
atha pitrośca caraṇau pūjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।।2.224.70 ।।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ pūjāṃ ca cakāra rājapatnikāḥ ।
rājakanyāstathā pūjāṃ cakrurvai sarvayoṣitām ।।71।।
lālāyano maharṣiśca tuṣito devasattamaḥ ।
svīyaprakāśo bhagavāँścaite prāhuḥ pareśvaram ।।72।।
maṇḍapaṃ ca kratoḥ kuṇḍaṃ samitkuśādihavyakam ।
janāvāsān bhakṣyabhojyān drutaṃ vilokaya prabho ।।।73 ।।
bhavadājñānusāreṇa sarvaṃ samupatiṣṭhate ।
nyūnaṃ na vidyate kiñcid dṛṣṭyā pāvaya sarvataḥ ।।74।।
ityarthitaḥ śrībhagavān janāvāsān suvīkṣitum ।
viṃśatiyojanabhūsthān yayau vimānago drutam ।।75।।
āmantraṇena patreṇa yajñamaṃgalabodhinā ।
samāgatān mahāmuktānakṣaraṃ brahma dṛṣṭavān ।।76।।
muktānīśca brahmasatīrdṛṣṭavān makhamāgatāḥ ।
aiśvaryāṇi samastāni guṇān sarvān sumūrtikān ।।77।।
ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi hetīn sarvān samūrtikān ।
dṛṣṭavān bhagavān naijāvatāraṃ kṛṣṇamityapi ।।78।।
rādhādibhiḥ sahā''yātaṃ gopagopīgavānvitam ।
nārāyaṇaṃ ramayā śrīkamalābhyāṃ ca līlayā ।।79।।
bhūlakṣmītūlasīvṛndāpadmādibhiḥ samanvitam ।
pārṣadaiḥ pārṣadānībhiḥ sahitaṃ dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ ।।2.224.80।।
vāsudevādikān vyūhān pradhānapuruṣādikān ।
mahākālādisamayān bhūmānaṃ dṛṣṭavāँstathā ।।8 1 ।।
mahāviṣṇuṃ ca vairājaṃ brahmādidevatātrayam ।
saśaktikaṃ tathā māyāṃ tattvayuktāṃ ca dṛṣṭavān ।।82।।
siddhāṃśca yoginaḥ sarvān maharṣīn pitṛdevatāḥ ।
surān sureśvarān lokaprapālān dikprapālakān ।।83।।
sāttvikān rājasāँścāpi tāmasān dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ ।
rudrān vasūn tathā''dityānaśvinau marutastathā ।।84।।
vidyādhrān devagandharvān diśo bhuvarnivāsinaḥ ।
sāgarān sarito vṛkṣān vallīstṛṇāni dṛṣṭavān ।।85।।
tīrthāni kāmadhenvādyāḥ svarān vedān guṇādikān ।
khanīn bhūdhrān mānavāँśca nṛpān strīśca narān prajāḥ ।।86 ।।
grahān nakṣatratārāśca sthāvarān cāṇḍajāँstathā ।
jarāyūjān svedajāँścodbhijjakān dṛṣṭavāँstathā ।।87।।
yakṣarākṣasabhūtādīn gaṇān gaṇeśvarāँstathā ।
yajñadevān samastāँśca mātṛkā devikāstathā ।।88।।
yoginīrbrahmasarasaścāpsaraso'pi sarvaśaḥ ।
ārṣīrvidyādharīścāpi śaktīśca sāṃkhyayoginīḥ ।।89।।
vahnīn sarvavidhāँścāpi kāśyapīśca prajāstathā ।
talalokanivāsāँśca yakṣarākṣasadānavān ।। 2.224.90 ।।
daityān nirannamuktāँśca tāpasān ṛtvijastathā ।
makhīyānmānavāँścāpi gāyakān yajamānakān ।।9 1।।
hotṝṃśca jāpakāँścāpi mahīmānān dadarśa saḥ ।
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyāstakranirjharaṇāँstathā ।।92।।
payohradānāmamṛtānāṃ sarito'pi dadarśa saḥ ।
kaṇamiṣṭānnaśālyādiparvatān phalasañcayān ।।93।।
nārikelādikān śuṣkasarasārdrān dadarśa saḥ ।
sādhanāni rasaśālāḥ patnīśālā dadarśa saḥ ।। 94।।
yūpaśālā havyaśālā devaśālā dadarśa saḥ ।
sarvaṃ sampūrṇameveti copasthitaṃ vilokya ca ।।95।।
lomaśaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ lālāyanaṃ ca śaṃkaram ।
svīyaprakāśaṃ cānyāṃśca maharṣīn praśaśaṃsa saḥ ।।96।।
samāgatān bhūmipālān dṛṣṭavān makhakarmaṇe ।
amarībhūpradeśānāṃ rāśiyānabhuvāṃ tathā ।।97।।
ketumālapradeśānāṃ prācīnoṣṇabhuvāṃ tathā ।
prāgjyotiṣāṃ cājanābhapradeśānāṃ ca bhūpatīn ।।98।।
āntarabhūpradeśānāmabriktā''raktasaṃbhuvām ।
dvīpātidvīpalokānāṃ bhūpatīn dṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ ।।99।।
alabdhamakhalābhāँśca dṛṣṭavān sa viśeṣataḥ ।
dakṣāmarīpradeśānāṃ bhūpatīn yajñayoginaḥ ।। 2.224.10 0।।
nṛpaṃ kālīmaṇḍalīnaṃ vanajeleśabhūpatim ।
pārāvārapibaṃ bhūpaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nṛpaṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
śrīsatīśaṃ ca rājānaṃ tretākarkaśabhūpatim ।
parāṅvrataṃ nṛpaṃ rājārāyapatiṃ ca dṛṣṭavān ।। 1 02।।
rāyasomanarājaṃ ca tathā'ṇḍajarabhūpatim ।
bālyarajonṛpaṃ corugavākṣaṃ bhūbhataṃ tathā ।। 103 ।।
īśānapānaśiṣṭaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ sa dṛṣṭavān ।
sarvān patnyādisahitān dakṣāmarīpradeśajān ।। 1 04।।
nṛpānāha mahākṛṣṇo yajamānā bhavantviti ।
omityaṃgīkṛtaṃ taiśca parameśavacaḥ śubham ।। 105।।
evaṃ saṃbhāvayitvaiva mahīmānān makhāgatān ।
nyūnaṃ pradāpayitvaiva drutaṃ naijālayaṃ yayau ।। 1 06।।
tāvad vādyānyavādyanta kratormuhūrtavittaye ।
sajjā bhūtvā maṇḍape ca drutaṃ samāyayurjanāḥ ।। 1 07।।
muktāstathā'vatārādyā īśvarāḥ siddhasattamāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā deveśā devavaśyagāḥ ।। 1 08।।
devyo devīvaśinyaśca mānavā daityadānavāḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sthāvarā jaṃgamāstathā ।। 1 09।।
makhārthā makhakartāraḥ karmaṭhāḥ sādhanāni ca ।
mantrāśca havyakavyāni sarvaṃ copasthitaṃ makhe ।। 2.224.11 0।।
rādhike maṃgale śreṣṭhe kṣāme kāryamavartata ।
śrīharirmaṇḍapaṃ cāyāt sarvaprayojyapūjitaḥ ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pārāvātarāṣṭraprajādibhya upadeśanaṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ vidāyam, āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ brāhmīlarāṣṭre
makhasthalīṃ prati cāgamanaṃ, mahīmānādīnāṃ saṃbhāvanā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 224 ।।
