adhyāyaḥ 225
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 226 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
yajñasya ca śubhe śreṣṭhe muhūrte rādhike prage ।
ṛṣayo devatāścāpi yajñamaṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।। 1 ।।
gṛṇantaḥ śrīharernāma vadanto vedakāṇḍikāḥ ।
japantaśca vedabhuvaṃ hṛṣṭā maṇḍapamāyayuḥ ।। 2 ।।
devā deveśvaraḥ sākṣād brahmādyā īśvareśvarāḥ ।
īśāḥ pradhānāḥ patnyaśca devyaśca pārṣadādayaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sākṣādvai maṇḍape tatrāyayurharṣabhṛto makhe ।
sāmagryaścāpi havyāni mūrtimanti śubhāni ca ।। 4 ।।
āsanāni sādhanāni samidhaśca samāyayuḥ ।
dhvajaḥ sākṣād ghaṭaḥ sākṣāt sākṣāttathaiva maṇḍapaḥ ।। 5 ।।
makhaḥ sākṣād vedikāśca sākṣāt sākṣācca yūparāṭ ।
kuṇḍaḥ sākṣād vāstupumān sākṣādvai samupāgataḥ ।। 6 ।।
vedāḥ sākṣād vidhayaśca sākṣānmantrāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
sākṣāt suviniyogāśca kuśā darbhāḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 7 ।।
sākṣāt pātrāṇi caravo vahnayaśca samāyayuḥ ।
samastopakaraṇāni tvāyayurmaṇḍape tadā ।। 8 ।।
svastaścaya samayaśca deśaḥ puṇyāha āyayuḥ ।
evaṃ tīrthāni bhaumāni pañcāmṛtāni cāyayuḥ ।। 9 ।।
upasthitāḥ samastāśca tanmakhe kāmadhenavaḥ ।
kalpalatāḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇaya āyayuḥ ।। 2.225.1 0।।
sarvāṇyakṣayapātrāṇi kalpā''pūrakapeṭikāḥ ।
akṣayāḥ kośanidhayaścāmṛtāni samāyayuḥ ।। 11 ।।
rasāśca phalajātāni patrapuṣpā'kṣatādayaḥ ।
mūrtimanto makhe tatra rādhike vai samāyayuḥ ।। 1 2।।
viniyogānusāreṇa viniyujyanta eva te ।
lakṣmyaḥ sarvāśca vidyāśca satyaḥ sarvāśca siddhayaḥ ।। 1 3।।।
camatkārāstathā siddhāstatra yajñe samāyayuḥ ।
madhuparkāḥ sarvavidhāḥ sarve pakvānnaparvatāḥ ।। 14।।
peyavastūni mūrtāni sākṣāt sarve sugandhakāḥ ।
svarṇarūpyakamudrāśca sākṣādgavyāni cāyayuḥ ।। 15।।
evaṃ yāvatsu sākṣādvai hyupasthiteṣu maṇḍape ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ maṃgalāni yoṣitāṃ gītayo'bhavan ।। 16।।
svastivāco'bhavaँstatra viprāṇāṃ sarvamaṃgalāḥ ।
deśakālādisaṃkalpo'kārayallomaśo muniḥ ।। 17।।
maṇḍape yajamānaśca īśānapānaśiṣṭakaḥ ।
rājā ca dampatīrūpo mukhyastatra vidhiṃ śubham ।। 18।।
ṛṣiṇā preritaścakre tathā'nyanṛpamaṇḍalam ।
maṇḍape kuṇḍasānnidhye'nukalpavidhimācarat ।। 1 9।।
pradhānākhyaṃ ca saṃkalpaṃ lomaśaḥ samakārayat ।
digrakṣāṃ ca kalaśasyā''rādhanāṃ pracakāra ca ।।2.225.20।।
gaṇeśasya sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cāpyakārayat ।
svastivācaśca puṇyāhavācanaṃ pracakāra ca ।।21 ।।
yajamānādyabhiṣekaṃ lomaśaḥ samakārayat ।
mātṛkāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ samakārayat ।।22।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathā''cāryādīnāṃ varaṇamityapi ।
arghavandanamevāpi madhuparkamakārayat ।।23।।
vardhanīkalaśasyāpi sthāpanaṃ cāpyakārayat ।
maṇḍape saṃpraveśaṃ ca maṇḍapaprokṣaṇādikam ।।24।।
vāstusthāpanamevā'pi vāsudevaprapūjanam ।
maṇḍapasyārcanaṃ tatra sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।।25 ।।
devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjāmakārayaddhi lomaśaḥ ।
yantradevasthāpanaṃ ca devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।। 26।।।
pīṭhasya pūjanaṃ vedīpūjanaṃ kuṇḍapūjanam ।
kuṇḍadevārhaṇaṃ cāpi kuṇḍe'gnisthāpanaṃ tathā ।।27।।
grahāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjāṃ yoginīsthāpanādikam ।
kṣetrapānāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cāpyakārayat ।।।28।।
kuṇḍe ca mekhalādīnāṃ pūjanaṃ devapūjanam ।
agneḥ pūjanamevāpi grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।।29।।
anvādhānasya saṃkalpaṃ lomaśarṣirakārayat ।
āghārājyabhāgahomaṃ lomaśo'kārayattadā ।।।2.225.3 0 ।।
vāstumaṇḍaladevārthaṃ yoginyarthaṃ havaṃ tathā ।
pradhānahomaṃ tatrāpi vyāhṛtihomamācarat ।।3 1 ।।
balidānaṃ sunaivedyaṃ dadau vai lomaśo muniḥ ।
yūpāropaṇamevāpi tato jalādhivāsanam ।।32।।
jalamātṛjalapūjāṃ śaṃkhaghaṇṭādipūjanam ।
bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathā prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ cāpyakārayat ।। 33 ।।
sauvarṇapratimāpūjāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya cācarat ।
ṣoḍaśopacārapūjāṃ carunaivedyamārpayat ।।34।।
sahasrāhutikāścāpi sarvahomamakārayat ।
idaṃ muktebhyo namama samarpayāmi bhojanam ।।35।।
idaṃ brahmaṇe namama samarpayāmi bhojanam ।
muktānībhya idaṃ namama samarpayāmi bhojanam ।।36।।
avatārebhyo namama idaṃ dadāmi bhojanam ।
avatāriṇībhya idaṃ dade namama bhojanam ।। 37।।
guṇaiśvaryavibhūtibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
bhūṣāhetipraśaktibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।। 38।।
īśvarebhyaśceśvarāṇībhyo namama bhojanam ।
vyūhebhyaḥ pārṣadādibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।। 39।।
brāhmībhyaśca satībhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।2.225.40 ।।
rādhālakṣmyādiśaktibhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
māṇikyādisatībhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।41 ।।
gaṃgāsarasvatīśrībhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
dāsadāsīsametābhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।42।।
mahāviṣṇuhiraṇgarbhavirāḍbhyo bhojanaṃ namaḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśebhyo nama idaṃ ca bhojanam ।।43 ।।
sāvitrīkamalādurgādibhyo namama bhojanam ।
kaṃbharāyai mahālakṣmyai idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।।44।।
santuṣṭāyai cāmṛtāyai idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
padmāvatyai ramāyai ca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।45।।
maṃjulāsadguṇāhāsā'mbābhyo namama bhojanam ।
bālakṛṣṇāṃganāduḥkhahālakṣmyādibhya ityapi ।।46।।
bhojanaṃ sarvapatnībhyaḥ siddharṣibhya idaṃ namama ।
idaṃ pitṛbhyo namama pitṛkābhyaśca bhojanam ।।47।।
ārṣībhyo bhojanaṃ cedaṃ surebhyo bhojanaṃ namama ।
surāṇībhyaśca devībhyo devatābhyaśca bhojanam ।।48।।
dikpālebhya idaṃ lokapālebhyo bhojanaṃ namaḥ ।
ādityebhyaśca rudrebhya idaṃ cedaṃ ca bhojanam ।।49।।
vasubhyaścāśvinībhyāṃ ca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।
digbhyaścāpi ca tattvebhya idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।।2.225.50।।
nidhibhyaśca gṛhebhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।
siddhibhyaśca maharṣibhya idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।।5 1 ।।
kṛttikābhyo manubhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।
marudbhyaśca kalābhyaśca idam idaṃ ca bhojanam ।।52।।
tīrthebhyaśca vālakhilyebhyaścedaṃ bhojanaṃ namama ।
yakṣarākṣasabhūtebhyaḥ pretebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।।53।।
kūṣmāṇḍebhyaḥ piśācebhya id cedaṃ ca bhojanam ।
vināyakebhyo gaṇebhya idaṃ cedaṃ ca bhojanam ।।54।।
vetālebhyaścāraṇebhyaḥ sūtebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।
māgadhebhyaśca bandībhyo bhṛtyebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।।।55।।
ḍākinībhyaḥ śākinībhyastāmasībhyaśca bhojanam ।
vidyādhrebhyo gandharvebhyaḥ kinnarebhyaśca bhojanam ।।56।।
kiṃpuṃbhyo viśvadevebhyo namama bhojanaṃ tvidam ।
daityebhyo dānavebhyaśca nāgebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।।57।।
sarpebhyaśca phaṇibhyaśca sarīsṛpebhyo bhojanam ।
vṛkṣebhyaśca virudbhyaśca tṛṇādibhyaśca bhojanam ।।58।।
tīrthebhyaḥ parvatebhyaśca sāgarebhyaśca bhojanam ।
saridbhyaśca taḍāgebhyaścaityebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।।59।।
kalpalatādrumebhyaśca kāmadhenubhya ityapi ।
cintāmaṇibhya idaṃ cākṣayapātrebhya ityapi ।।2.225.6 0।।
kuṇḍebhyaḥ kuṇḍadevebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
maṇḍapebhyo maṇḍapasthadevebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।।6 1 ।।
dvārebhyo dvāradevebhyaḥ śākhāsurebhya ityapi ।
dhvajadevebhya idaṃ ca yūpadevebhya ityapi ।।62।।
sruksruvādisādhanebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
staṃbhebhyaḥ stambhadevebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।63।।
mātṛkābhyaḥ satībhyaśca sādhvībhya idamityapi ।
idaṃ sāṃkhyayoginībhyo bhojanaṃ ca namonamaḥ ।।64।।
pativratābhyo devībhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
kāmadevāya ca saptarṣibhyo namama bhojanam ।।65।।
īśānāya varuṇāya mahendrāya ca bhojanam ।
agnaye ca kuverāya nairṛtāya ca bhojanam ।।66।।
vāyave ca yamāyedaṃ dūtebhyo bhojanaṃ tvidam ।
yādobhyo vāyuvāsebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।67।।
bhūvāsebhyo himasthebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
jarāyūjebhyo'ṇḍajebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।68।।
svedajebhya udbhijjebhyaścedṃ namama bhojanam ।
idaṃ kīṭapataṃgādisūkṣmebhyo bhojanaṃ namama ।।6 9।।
jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca makhibhyo bhojanaṃ namama ।
meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhya idṃ namama bhojanam ।।2.225.70।।
surāsurādisarvebhya idṃ namama bhojanam ।
brahmasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।71 ।।
īśasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idṃ namama bhojanam ।
jīvasṛṣṭisthitebhyaśca idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।72।।
caturaśītikhanijebhyaścedaṃ bhojanaṃ namaḥ ।
smṛtebhyaścā'smṛtebhyaścedaṃ ca namama bhojanam ।।73।।
viśiṣṭaśiṣṭatattvebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
samastebhyaśca vyastebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।।74।।
pratyekebhyaśca yāvadbhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।
karmaṭhebhyo brāhmaṇebhya idaṃ namama bhojanam ।। 75।।
idṃ namama sarvātmānanāya vahnaye svāhā ।
sahasradhārābhiścedaṃ havyaṃ ca vahnaye svāhā ।।76।।
evaṃ vai vahnaye havyaṃ ghṛtaṃ samit phalāni ca ।
miṣṭānnāni rasāścāpi dravāścāpi samarpitāḥ ।।77।।
tato bahvāhutiṃ homaṃ pracakre lomaśo muniḥ ।
mahāghṛtā''hutihomaṃ tataścākārayanmuniḥ ।।78।।
tadā pratyakṣadevādyāstṛptā api punaḥ punaḥ ।
jagṛhurvahninā sārdhaṃ pradattaṃ havyamuttamam ।।79।।
nīrājanaṃ pracakāra tataḥ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninadāścā'bhavaँstadā samantataḥ ।।2.225.80 ।।
vedaghoṣā ajāyanta gītayo yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
puṣpāñjaliṃ tato rājā dadau devebhya eva ca ।।8 1।।
viprāścakruryajamānābhiṣecanaṃ tu pāvanam ।
śreyaḥpradānakaṃ cakruḥ rājā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।।82।।
viprā āśīrvacanāni jagurharṣabharāstataḥ ।
vahniṃ natvā ca devebhyo namaskṛtya kṣamārthanām ।।83।।
kṛtvā ca kārayāmāsa visarjanaṃ hi lomaśaḥ ।
ākāśaṃ tu tadā vyāptamabhūd vimānapadmakaiḥ ।।84।।
sṛṣṭitrayādhivāsānāṃ samāgamena sarvataḥ ।
pañcamyāṃ rādhike caivaṃ makhakāryottaraṃ hariḥ ।।85।।
bhojayitvā mahīmānān maharṣīṃśca dvijātikān ।
sarvān prāghūṇikāँścāpi dhāmadhāmādivāsinaḥ ।।86 ।।
bhojayitvā yathāyogyān tataścakāra bhojanam ।
yajamānairnṛpaiḥ sārdhaṃ bubhuje bhagavān svayam ।।87।।
evaṃ pravartito yajño rādhike saritastaṭe ।
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādyaistarpaṇaṃ samajāyata ।।88।।
sāyaṃ snānaṃ tataścakre bhagavān sarvamānavaiḥ ।
devaiśca dehibhiḥ sākaṃ varuṇaṃ samprapūjya ca ।।89।।
jalaṃ prapūjya bhagavān sasnau sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ ।
athā''yayau nijaṃ sthānaṃ dadau dānāni vai tadā ।। 2.225.90।।
muktebhyaḥ pāduke sarvāvatārebhyaḥ kirīṭakān ।
muktānībhyo'vatāriṇībhyo dadau svarṇaśāṭikāḥ ।।91 ।।
mukuṭāँśca dadau caiśebhyaśca hārān dadau prabhuḥ ।
īśānībhyaśca sa dadau śṛṃkhalā raśanāstathā ।।92।।
ṛṣibhyaḥ svarṇakalaśān ārṣībhyaḥ svarṇatantikāḥ ।
siddhebhya svarṇamālāśca siddhibhyaḥ svarṇakañcukīḥ ।। 93।।
pitṛbhyaścāmṛtasthālīḥ pitrikābhyo'kṣayān ghaṭān ।
devebhyaḥ svarṇachatrāṇi devībhyaḥ kaṇṭhapatrikāḥ ।। 94।।
kaṭakāni dadau cāpi deveśebhyaśca vetrakān ।
bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ kañcukān pradadau prabhuḥ ।। 95।।
mānavebhyaḥ svarṇamudrā daityebhyaśca maṇīn dadau ।
sūtamāgadhabandībhyaḥ svarṇahārāँstadā dadau ।।96।।
anāthabālavṛddhebhyo dravyāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca ।
dadau śrībhagavāँstatra yeṣāṃ yadyadapekṣitam ।। 97।।
jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca yeṣāṃ yadyadapekṣitam ।
saṃkalpya sarvaṃ pradadau paramātmā dayānidhiḥ ।। 98।।
mahādānāni sarvāṇi madhyadānāni yāni ca ।
kṣetrakanyādidānāni tadgurubhyo'pyadāpayat ।।99।।
rājānaśca daduḥ sarvaṃ dravyaṃ cānnaṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।
kanyādānāni bahūni gavāśvagajadānakam ।। 2.225.10 0।।
evamārātriparyantaṃ dānāni pradadau prabhuḥ ।
tatastvārārtrikaṃ cābhūd bālakṛṣṇasya rādhike ।। 10 1।।
rājabhiḥ saṃkṛtaṃ paścād bhojanānyabhavan punaḥ ।
athopadeśaṃ bhagavān rātrau prajāsu saṃvyadhāt ।। 10 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ prātarhariṇā saha yajñabhūmiṃ prati mahīmānānāmāgamanam maṇḍape sarveṣāmupasthitiḥ svasti-
vācanādi ghṛtabahvāhutihomaparyantakāryāṇāṃ vinivartanaṃ parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 225 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 225 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 226
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 227 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
yamupadeśaṃ pradadau svātmakalyāṇakārakam ।। 1 ।।
tamahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi prajābhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ ।
parabrahmaprayuktena brahmaṇā cākṣareṇa vai ।। 2 ।।
preryate puruṣo dhāmni sthitaḥ sṛṣṭividhāpane ।
yuyuje nijaśaktyā sa māyayā tena māyikāḥ ।। 3 ।।
māyālīnā'nādino ye ātmānaste svakarmabhiḥ ।
preritā īśvarā yadvā jīvā bhavanti dehinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
dehendriyāntaḥkaraṇatanmātrābhūtasaṃjñakam ।
saṃghātaṃ tu nijaṃ matvā badhyate tatra karmabhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
saṃghātarūpān bhāvān vai gṛhṇanti prāṇino muhuḥ ।
punarviyogaṃ saṃyanti cakravatpariyanti ca ।। 6 ।।
śāntaghoravimūḍhāṃśca bhāvān prayānti sarvataḥ ।
romalohitamāṃsāni bhāvā vai mātṛsaṃbhavāḥ ।। 7 ।।
majjā'sthisnāyavo bhāvā bhavanti pitṛsaṃbhavāḥ ।
sukhaduḥkhavimohāḍhyāḥ śītoṣṇadāhakāḥ sadā ।। 8 ।।
tān bhāvān samavāpyā'pi tairna yo bhāvito bhavet ।
so'haṃ so'haṃ vicintya syād bhāvabandhanavarjitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
navadvāraṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ tattadbhāvaiḥ samanvitam ।
vyāpya śete cetanātmā puruṣaḥ so'yamucyate ।। 2.226.10 ।।
tebhyaḥ puruṣasaṃjñebhyo'nantebhyaścottamo'smyaham ।
antarātmā virāje'haṃ brahmaloke yathā'smyaham ।। 11 ।।
puruṣottama evā'haṃ bhavāmi sarvaśāsakaḥ ।
sarveṣu cetaneṣu yadvadahaṃ nivasāmi ha ।। 1 2।।
tathā sarvajaḍe'pyasmi śarīrī tattvavadhārakaḥ ।
taṃ māṃ vijñāya bhakto me videho jāyate'cirāt ।। 13 ।।
ajaraḥ so'maraścaiva sūkṣmo mama vṛṣānvitaḥ ।
mama mūrtau mama bhaktau sarvārpaṇo vimucyate ।। 1 4।।
agniścāste sadā dārau dārunāśe viyujyate ।
pare tattve prayātyeva tathā''tmā dehanāśane ।। 15 ।।
taṃ paraṃ paramātmānaṃ māmāśrityā'pi pāpinaḥ ।
puṇyavanto bhavantyevā'ṅgārā ivā'gniyogataḥ ।। 16।।
mama satāṃ prasaṃgena mamaiśvaryātiyogataḥ ।
mamāṃ'śaguṇalābhācca bhakto matsamatāṃ vrajet ।। 17।।
svapnadṛśyān padārthān vai tyaktvā cāyāti jāgrati ।
tathā māyādikāstyaktvā sarvadraṣṭari yāti vai ।। 18।।
bhūmiṃ tyaktvā yathā vāri sariddvārā mahārṇavam ।
yāti tadvad vihāyedaṃ varṣmātmā māṃ pumuttamam ।। 1 9।।
kṛtakāryā nivartante yathā vai karmacāriṇaḥ ।
bhuktabhogā nirvatante tathā''tmānaśca dehinaḥ ।। 2.226.2 0।।
vegahīnaḥ śaro yadvanniṣkriyo yāti bhūtalam ।
vāsanāvegahīno'yaṃ jīvo yāti mamā'kṣaram ।। 21 ।।
nirāśo jāyate yadvannivṛttaḥ karmaṇastathā ।
sarvāśāvarjito loke nivṛtto māṃ prayāti vai ।।22।।
sarvabhāvairvarjito yat tato yāti mamāspadam ।
madabhyāsānmayi sakto na yāti prakṛtiṃ punaḥ ।। 23।।
bījānyagnyupadagdhāni na prarohanti sarvathā ।
tathā'sya sarvabījāni na prarohanti vai punaḥ ।। 24।।
amṛtāsvādasaṃsaktaḥ svādāntare na sajjate ।
mama svāde prasaktaḥ sa guṇasvāde na sajjate ।। 25।।
durlabhā mama vettāro jagatyatra bhavanti vai ।
sulabhāḥ sarvato jīvā dehendriyārthapoṣakāḥ ।।26 ।।
nimnabhāve vegavanto yānti vāripravāhaṇāḥ ।
nimnagrāmye tathāvegā yānti vai prāyaśo janāḥ ।।27।।
vahnisvabhāvāḥ santastu yāntyūrdhvaṃ brahmavedinaḥ ।
satāṃ prasaṃgato bhaktāḥ prayāntūrdhvaṃ mamā'kṣaram ।। 28।।
evaṃ vicārya satataṃ bhajanīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
satāṃ saṃgena kartavyā bhaktirme dhāmadāyinī ।।29।।
sarvārpaṇaṃ mayi kṛṣṇe nārāyaṇe pareśvare ।
ye kurvanti na vai teṣāṃ māyā bādhakarī bhavet ।।2.226.3 0 ।।
yaḥ snehaḥ putravittādau yaḥ snehaḥ pramadādiṣu ।
yaḥ sneho nijadehādau taṃ snehaṃ tvarjayenmayi ।।3 1 ।।
yā tṛṣṇā viṣaye saukhye yā tṛṣṇā bhogasādhane ।
yā tṛṣṇā mānayaśasoḥ sā kāryā mayi mādhave ।।3 2 ।।
yo vegaḥ svārthasamprāptau yo vego'rijayādiṣu ।
yo vego'haṃkṛtau cāste sa kāryo mayi keśave ।। 33 ।।
yā tṛptiśceṣṭalābhe'sti yā tṛptirbhoganirgame ।
yā tṛptirbahusantoṣe sā kāryā mayi sarvathā ।।34।।
yatsukhaṃ sāttvike bhāve nirdvandve cāpi yatsukham ।
yatsukhaṃ ca vivekena tat kāryaṃ mayi sarvathā ।।35।।
yā puṣṭiḥ sampadā syācca yā puṣṭirbalasaṃgrahaiḥ ।
yā puṣṭiḥ śāstraviṣayaiḥ sā kāryā mayi sarvadā ।।36।।
yatsthānaṃ cāśraye nityaṃ yatsthānaṃ ca sahāyade ।
yatsthānaṃ svasya hṛdaye tatkāryaṃ mayi sarvathā ।।37।।
yat tādātmyaṃ ca dehādau yattādātmyaṃ ca gaurave ।
yattādātmyaṃ nije saukhye tatkāryaṃ mayi satpatau ।।38।।
yā śubhāśā nije putre yā cā''śā tvāyatau sukhe ।
yā cāśā lābhasaँlagnā sā kāryā mayi sarvadā ।।39।।
upārjite yā mamatā tādātmye mamatā ca yā ।
yā'bhimate ca mamatā sā kāryā mayi muktaye ।।2.226.40 ।।
yaḥ prayatno viṣayārthaṃ dhanārthaṃ yaḥ prayatnakaḥ ।
prāṇārthaṃ yaḥ prayatnaśca kāryaḥ sa mayi mādhave ।।41 ।।
śarīravānupādatte mohāt sarvān parigrahān ।
tena vai bandhanaṃ syācca nirayaṃ tvabhiyāti saḥ ।।42।।
nā'śuddhamācarettasmāt samicchan brahmasadgatim ।
karmaṇāṃ vighnarūpāṇāṃ phalaṃ necchet subuddhimān ।।43 ।।
yaśca karmā''carellobhānmohānmadācca matsarāt ।
mokṣapanthānamutkramya sānubandhaḥ sa naśyati ।।44।।
tasmād rāgayujā naiva bhāvyaṃ kvacid vivekinā ।
bāliśena na vai bhāvyaṃ vā mugdhena jaḍātmanā ।।451।।
mṛnmayaṃ tu gṛhaṃ yadvanmṛdā samparilipyate ।
annamayaṃ tathā varṣma lepanīyaṃ tathānnakaiḥ ।।46।।
pārthivaṃ varṣma caivaitat pārthivaiḥ puṣṭimeti hi ।
naitāvatā mamatvena kāryā''saktirhi varṣmaṇi ।।47।।
miṣṭaṃ tiktaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ snigdhaṃ dhānyaphalādikam ।
mṛdvikārā mṛdo dehe'pekṣaṇīyā hi santi vai ।।48।।
tāvantaścopayoktavyā bandhanādivivarjitāḥ ।
evaṃ yātrāṃ vinirvāhya bhavapāraṃ prayāti vai ।।49।।
yathā'raṇyaṃ gato yogī kvacidbhojyaṃ hi pattanāt ।
gṛhṇātyapi na tatrāpi badhyate rāgatastathā ।।2.226.5 0 ।।
saṃsārāraṇyamātiṣṭhan śramavān yātriko bhavan ।
yātrārthamadyādāhāraṃ yathā bandhāya no bhavet ।।5 1 ।।
indriyairmanasā buddhyā samīkṣya viṣayānapi ।
śāntimicchanna lubdhaḥ syāttadā nirbandhano bhavet ।।5 2।।
vāsanābhibhūtalokā mohitā māyayā mama ।
cakravat parivartante janmamṛtyubhavabhrame ।।53।।
tasmādajñānajān doṣān tyaktvā ca bandhanānyapi ।
mama mārgaṃ samāśritya mokṣabhāk syādvivekavān ।।54।।
akālapuruṣāt sarvaṃ cāhaṃkāre bhramatyapi ।
phalaṃ cāhaṃkṛtaṃ bhuṃkte punarmāyāṃ pragacchati ।।55।।
rajojanyaṃ svargarūpaṃ sthānaṃ vai bandhanaṃ param ।
tamojanyaṃ rākṣasādi sthānaṃ vai bandhanaṃ param ।।56 ।।
tasmādātmavatā varjyaṃ rajaśca tama ityapi ।
rajastamobhyāṃ śūnyaṃ ca sattvaṃ nirmalatāmiyāt ।।57।।
nairmalye cetanaḥ samyak prasādavān prajāyate ।
prasādarūpaḥ prāpnuyāt parameśaprasannatām ।।58।।
nityaprasannatāprāpto mokṣaṃ samadhigacchati ।
ātmā nara itiprokto nārī tu vāsanā matā ।।59।।
kṛtyā hyeṣā ghorabhāvā garte nayati kāminaḥ ।
rajastamomayīmūrtirindriyāṇāṃ balapradā ।।2.226.6 0।।
vāsanā ḍākinī duṣṭā naraṃ kṣipati sāgare ।
naradehe ca vā nārīdehe mohasya kāriṇī ।।6 1 ।।
pātayatyeva saṃghāte'śucau malinamandire ।
asaṃskṛtamahāmārge rūparāgapralepite ।।62।।
mohātpatitaḥ puruṣo bījaṃ vapati māyikam ।
jāyante jantavo bījāt putraputrītināmakāḥ ।।63।।।
sādṛśye'tra viśeṣo'sti sāmye'pi svedajaiḥ sutaiḥ ।
svedajāḥ kramayaḥ proktā dhātujāḥ sutasaṃjñakāḥ ।।64।।
mokṣārthī tu kramīn putrān svajātān sāmyabhāvavān ।
virāgeṇa vivekena visṛjya māṃ samāśrayet ।।65।।
janau duḥkhe pāravaśye bālabhāve'pi duḥkhakam ।
yauvane viṣayecchābhiścendriyaparatantratā ।।66।।
vārdhakye pāravaśye ca punarduḥkhaṃ taduttaram ।
duḥkhādyantairduḥkhamadhyairnaraḥ śārīramānasaiḥ ।।67।।
vijñāyedaṃ duḥkhasaudhaṃ tadupekṣet māṃ śrayet ।
upādānānnimittācca sahakārita ityapi ।।68।।
āpūrakāttathā sarvaṃ duḥkhameva hi varṣmaṇi ।
tādṛśaṃ samanādṛtya tyāgānnirodhamāśrayet ।।69।।
mayi rodhaṃ prapannasyā'tarṣulasya vivekinaḥ ।
bhaktasya mama yogena muktireva na saṃśayaḥ ।।2.226.70।।
tattvajñānāmṛtabhujo bhaktirasapibasya vai ।
mama snehasudhāktasya mamā'kṣarapadaṃ matam ।।7 1 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ śīlaṃ cidambaraṃ matam।
cidākāśaṃ samālambya mamākāśamupāvrajet ।।72।।
dehākāśaṃ tathendriyākāśaṃ cāntarvikāśakam ।
brahmākāśena saṃyujya haryākāśe'rpayet kṛtī ।।73 ।।
evaṃ mukto bhavatyeva mama yogamupāgataḥ ।
kṛtvaivaṃ nityamabhyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।।74।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
rādhike sa tato mantrān dadau bhaktebhya ārthitān ।।75।।
tato rātrau parāṃ śāntiṃ yoganidrātmikāṃ yayau ।
prātarvādyādimāṃgalyaiḥ kīrtanairyaśasāṃ śravaiḥ ।।76 ।।
jajāgāra svayaṃ nāthastrailokyāṃ maṃgalaṃ vyadhāt ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtasambhāvanaḥ prabhuḥ ।।77।।
sarvān bhaktān mahīmānān saṃbhāvya maṇḍapaṃ yayau ।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta makhotsāhapravṛttaye । ।78।।
maṃgalā gītayaścāsan nārīṇāṃ brahmayoṣitām ।
vedaghoṣā abhavaँśca vaidikānāṃ samantataḥ ।।79।।
āyayuśca kratusthānaṃ makhīyāḥ karmaṭhā drutam ।
avatārāśca muktāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ ।।2.226.80।।
pitaro mānavā daityā yakṣāḥ surāśca dānavāḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā devyaśca brahmayoṣitaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
nāgāḥ sarpāḥ khanijāścāyayurvai jaḍacetanāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaryajñakāryaṃ pūrvavanmunibhistadā ।।82।।
pravartitaṃ yathāyogyaṃ svastivācanapūrvakam ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ jātaṃ tathā balinivedanam ।।।83 ।।
havyadānaṃ ca vahnau cāhutipradānakaṃ tathā ।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpi puṣpāñjaliśca dakṣiṇāḥ ।।84।।
ārārtrikaṃ parihāraḥ sarvaṃ jātaṃ yathocitam ।
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi mahīmānādibhojanam ।।85।।
yajamānādilokānāṃ bhojanāni śubhānyapi ।
jātānyatha suviśramya hariḥ sāyaṃ sabhāṃ śubhām ।।86।।
akārayat svayaṃ tatra svāmīśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
ācāryavaryo bhagavān janebhyaḥ pradadau manūn ।।87।।
tataścopādideśāpi mokṣadaṃ hitakṛcca vai ।
rādhike'nādikṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatirgopālabālakaḥ ।।88।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhācāryaḥ koṭimuktābhivanditaḥ ।
dhāmadhāmeśvaranāthaḥ sarvāvatārakāraṇam ।।89।।
asaṃkhyabrāhmīsevābhiprasāditapareśvaraḥ ।
yajñe tṛptaḥ surādyaiśca pūjito mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ ।।2.226.90।।
kāruṇikaḥ kāṃbhareyo'nantaśaktipatirhariḥ ।
upadeśakṣaṇe sarvaistvekavṛttyā vilokitaḥ ।।91।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pañcamyāṃ rātrau prajābhya upadeśanaṃ rātrau viśramaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaścāhnikottaraṃ yajñasamastakāryanirvartanaṃ bhojanādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 226 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 226 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 227
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 228 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
rādhike śrīharikṛṣṇo brahmavratamupādiśat ।
śṛṇu sarvavratebhyastacchreṣṭhaṃ brahmapadaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
brahmacaryamiti khyātaṃ sarvamūrdhanyameva yat ।
bhaktaścā'pyadhyavasyedvai brahmacaryamakalmaṣam ।। 2 ।।
brahmavratirbrahmacārī brahmasevī ca śīlavān ।
kālaṃ māyāṃ ca karmāṇi jitvā maddhāma cāpnuyāt ।। 3 ।।
sukaraṃ yoginā taddhi siddhānāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।
satīnāṃ sukaraṃ cāpi duṣkaraṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām ।। 4 ।।
sampradīptaṃ baliṣṭhaṃ cendriyagrāmaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
nigṛhṇīyāt sāvadhānaḥ sa vai jayati mṛtyudam ।। 5 ।।
kāmasya na svarūpaṃ vai cintayed viṣayānna ca ।
kāmacihnāni paśyenna rajobhāgān vivarjayet ।। 6 ।।
rajaḥpuṣṭikarān bhāgān varjayed dehavāniha ।
dhātupuṣṭikarān bhogāँstathaiva parivarjayet ।। 7 ।।
jñānayuktena manasā virāgasahitena ca ।
rāgabhāvaṃ vināśyaiva vartayedātmabhāvavān ।। 8 ।।
kuṇapā'medhyasaṃyuktaṃ śarīraṃ kāmanāśrayam ।
bhaviṣyannirayakṣepakārakaṃ viśvasenna vai ।। 9 ।।
vātapittakaphāgāraṃ raktatvaṅmāṃsakuṇḍakam ।
majjāsnāyvasthināḍyāḍhyaṃ malamūtrādisaṃbhṛtam ।। 2.227.1 0।।
kāmāśrayaṃ ca nikṛṣṭaṃ jñātvā rāgaṃ vivarjayet ।
dhamanyo malavāhinyaḥ pratāyante samantataḥ ।। 11 ।।
āpagā iva cābdhiṃ vai dehaṃ puṣṇanti bāhyakaiḥ ।
tāsu caikā tu dhamanī manovāhābhidhā hṛdi ।। 12।।
kāmadhātvāśrayā cāste śukraṃ muñcati kalpajam ।
śukraṃ bahuvidhaṃ proktaṃ taijasaṃ netrayorgatam ।। 1 3।।
karṇayordravarūpaṃ ca śabdagrāhakameva tat। ।
evamanyendriyāṇāṃ mandire prāptaṃ praśaktidam ।। 14।।
jale cāste tathā dugdhe sneho ghṛtaṃ ca varṣmaṇi ।
tadeva śukrarūpaṃ nirmathyate'ti tu manthanaiḥ ।। 15 ।।
svapne'pyevaṃ manojanyaṃ saṃkalpajaṃ rajoṃ'śakam ।
śukraṃ tūtpadya vegena balahīnaṃ viśatyapi ।। 16 ।।
trīṇi bījāni śukrasya hyannaṃ raso manovahā ।
etattrayaṃ viditvaiva śithīlayet trikaṃ muhuḥ ।। 1 7।।
tataśca śukrānutpādād brahmavrataṃ prapuṣyati ।
mano bhakṣyasyā'ṇutamo bhāgaḥ puṣṭatamaṃ tataḥ ।। 18 ।।
nirvāsanaṃ vidhāyaiva virāgeṇa jayeddhi tat ।
jyotiṣmadvirajaḥ svātmarūpatāmeti mānasam ।। 19 ।।
rajomayaṃ parāvṛttya sattvamayaṃ prajāyate ।
sattvabhāvabhāvitaṃ ca saccidānandatāmiyāt ।। 2.227.20 ।।
taruṇādhigataṃ tadvai rājasaṃ bhāti yāvatā ।
tāvatā tallayārthaṃ vai dhyānayogaṃ samācaret ।। 21 ।।
ekāgrā'bhyasanaṃ kāryaṃ tāruṇyaṃ tena līyate ।
pakvabhāvaṃ gataṃ tacca balahīnaṃ prajāyate ।। 22।।
tadātmānaṃ samāśritya jīvadātmabalānvitam ।
tataścātmānamutsṛjya na yāti viṣayaṃ kvacit । । 23 ।।
na cendriyāṇyabhiyāti neśvarādicamatkṛtim ।
na siddhīrna ca vegādyaṃ na māyāṃ na ca tadguṇān ।। 24।।
evaṃvidhaṃ vegahīnaṃ yadā syādvai svamānasam ।
tadā sudurgaṃ panthānaṃ guṇarājyānuyāyinam ।। 25 ।।
atītya paramaṃ mārgaṃ cātmarāṣṭrīyamṛcchati ।
āsīmamārgaṃ collaṃdhyā'kṣare'mṛtaṃ samaśnute ।। 26 ।।
ityevaṃ vartamānasya brahmalokaḥ karasthitaḥ ।
brahmacaryaratasyā'tra brahmaloko hi vartate ।। 27।।
duranteṣvindriyārtheṣu saktāḥ sīdanti dehinaḥ ।
asaktā ye brahmaśīlāste yānti dhāma me param ।। 28 ।।
dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭiṃ santatāṃ ca janmamṛtyujarādibhiḥ ।
ādhivyādhikleśaduḥkhairvyāptā yateta muktaye ।। 29।।
śarīrendriyasaṃghātānantaḥkaraṇakānyapi ।
saṃyujya śrīpatau bhakto nirapekṣaścaret sukham ।। 2.227.30 ।।
manaḥsaṃgaṃ kṛpayā'pi naiva kuryānmumukṣukaḥ ।
saṃge hyupekṣāṃ kurvīta jñātvā saṃgaphalaṃ jagat ।। 31 ।।
saṃgaphalaṃ vihāyaiva vartayan karmaṭho'pi san ।
naiva badhnāti muktātmā padmapatramivāṃbhasā ।। 32 ।।
kṣamā''rjavaṃ tathā droho yasya syāt sa sukhī bhavet ।
duḥkhānniḥsaraṇaṃ jñātvā niḥsaret sa sukhī bhavet ।। 33 ।।
nā'padhyāyenna spṛhayennā'yogyaṃ cintayedasat ।
cintayedvai paraṃbrahma śṛṇuyānme kathāmṛtam ।। 34।।
kalkāpetāṃ vaded vācaṃ dharmaṃ kārṣṇamanuvrajet ।
vyāharecchrīharernāma cintayedarthamuttamam ।। 35।।
anarthaṃ nirayāṇāṃ samprasañjakaṃ vivarjayet ।
pratilomāṃ diśaṃ budhvā sāṃsārikīṃ vivarjayet ।। 36 ।।
anīhaśca tathā muktaḥ sarvaiḥ parigrahairmuhuḥ ।
viviktacārī niyamī jñānapradagdhakilbiṣaḥ ।। 37 ।।
ātmāvān dhṛtimān bhūtvā hṛtprakāśaṃ pramārgayet ।
yatra devāḥ prakāśante tato brahma prakāśate ।। 38 ।।
evaṃ sthitiṃ samāpanno brahmabhūyāya jāyate ।
yadvā yogamahāvṛttiṃ samācarecchanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।।3 9 ।।
āhāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā cintāniyamamityapi ।
dhyānavṛddhiṃ samāsādya svātmaprakāśamarjayet ।।2.227.40 ।।
jñānaprakāśasaṃyuktaścātmaprakāśa edhitaḥ ।
bhaktiprakāśasanmiśraḥ sūryavatsamprakāśate ।। 41 ।।
devaprakāśavān pūrvaṃ paścādātmaprakāśakaḥ ।
tataḥ svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt sa syādvai kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।42 ।।
evaṃ prakāśamārgeṇa parān svargān vikramya ca ।
citprakāśo bhavet śaśvad brahmaprakāśavān hi saḥ ।।43 ।।
saguṇo mañjulo haṃsaḥ pāravān svaprabho yadā ।
vītarāgo'pavargajño bhavenmāmeti vai prabhum ।। 44।।
guṇātīto jarāmṛtyū jitvā māyāmayaṃ puram ।
akṣarāmṛtamāpnoti yattadbahma sanātanam ।। 45।।
etatsarvaṃ brahmacaryalabhyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ।
nidrā vratahā saṃtyājyā brahmacaryaṃ samicchatā ।। 46 ।।
mano nidrāyu'taṃ vyagraṃ rajasā tvabhibhūyate ।
rajobhāvasya nairbalye vyagratā kṣīṇatāṃ vrajet। ।।47।।
śāntirbhavet sattvavṛttiprādhānyaṃ gurutālayaḥ ।
tena nidrālayaḥ syācca jñānavṛttyā svapityapi ।।48 ।।
saṃsāravṛttivilaye svapnaṃ dūrataraṃ bhavet ।
tena brahmaparo bhūtvā brahmaśreṣṭhamavāpnuyāt ।।49।।
prasannamanasā yadyat saṃkalpayati mānasam ।
tattatsaṃskāramāpannaṃ smaryate ca muhurmuhuḥ ।।2.227.50 ।।
ṣāttvikeṣvapi deveśaṃ pareśaṃ māṃ vicintayet ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ tena māṃ cottare labhet ।।5 1 ।।
lipsettu manasā bhakto mama yogaṃ sukhāvaham ।
ātmaprasādaṃ saumyaṃ ca devānāṃ darśanaṃ hṛdi ।।52।।
nityamevaṃ samabhyāsāt tatsaṃskāraḥ surāṃstataḥ ।
hṛdayaṃ saṃsthitān paśyettato brahma prakāśate ।।53 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ tadevāhuryattad brahmaṇi vartanam ।
brahmasaṃsṛṣṭadeveṣu satsu yadvartanaṃ ca tat ।।54।।
brahma tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ cāmṛtā'kṣaravedanam ।
evaṃ viditvā svātmānaṃ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।।55 ।।
māyāṃ tyaktuṃ pravidyāccā'kṣaraṃ vidyādvimuktaye ।
pravṛttiṃ samparityajyā'kṣaro bhūtvā'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।।56।।
pravṛttiḥ punarāvṛttirnivṛttiḥ paramā gatiḥ ।
nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo brahmadaḥ śāśvatapramut ।।57।।
śriyaṃ divyāmabhiprepsuḥ śrīpatiṃ māṃ hṛdi smaret ।
sarvabhāvena matprāptyai kuryān madyogakṛttapaḥ ।।58।।
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa tanmatam ।
matsmṛtirmanaso rodho mānasaṃ tapa eva tat ।।59।।
matprasādādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapo vai pāpanāśanam ।
vāsanāyā vimardo'pi buddhestapaḥ paraṃ matam ।।2.227.6 0।।
ātmaniṣṭhā cetanasya tapaḥ paramamucyate ।
madyogārthaṃ prayatnaśca satataṃ tapa uttamam ।।61 ।।
avyāhatā matiryasya madanyairjaḍacetanaiḥ ।
saṃsthitiṃ brahmasāmyāṃ vai gato yāsyati māmanu ।।62।।
māyāsarge yā''yatiḥ sā parasarge na vidyate ।
ātmajñānaguṇādyaiśca divyabhāvaiḥ pramodate ।।63 ।।
āyuṣo'nte'tra manujāḥ sataḥ kecidupāsate ।
kecidakṣarabhāvaṃ cā''tmānaṃ kecidupāsate ।।64।।
pare devaṃ paraṃ māṃ vai prasthāne samupāsate ।
sarva ete parabhāvāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।।65।।
brāhmīṃ tanuṃ labhante te vimuktāmaparigrahām ।
mama vijñānasampannā madārādhanatatparāḥ ।।66 ।।
mamāśrayaṃ paraṃ labdhvā prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।
vidyāṃ labdhvā parāṃ brahmabhūtā yānti parāṃ gatim ।।67।।
yathābhāvamupāsantaḥ sarve yānti parāṃ gatim ।
kaṣāyavarjitāḥ śāntā madāśrayaparāyaṇāḥ ।।68।।
vimucyante guṇakleśaiḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।
bhagavantamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ divyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।6 9।।
jñātvā''tmasthaṃ hariṃ māṃ ca śuddhasnehasamanvitāḥ ।
bhāvatṛptā hi māṃ yānti nivartante na te'kṣarāḥ ।।2.227.70।।
māṃ vā me sādhupuruṣān madaṃśān saṃśrayanti ye ।
prāpya te paramaṃ dhāma modante'kṣaramavyayam ।।7 1 ।।
tṛṣṇābaddhaṃ jagat sarvaṃ cakravat parivartate ।
tṛṣṇātanturyena dagdhastasya maddhāmamārgaṇam ।।72।।
sūcyā sūtraṃ yathāvastre saṃsārayati vāyakaḥ ।
tadvat saṃsārasūtraṃ hi tṛṣṇāsūcyā prasāryate ।।73।।
tasmād vimuktaḥ puruṣo me bhaktyā yāti māmapi ।
taṃ snehena vimānena nayāmi dhāma māmakam ।।74।।
ityupādiśya bhagavān virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
rādhike pradadau mantraṃ nūtnebhyaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।।75।।
sabhāsamāptimakarot sandhyāvandanamācarat ।
rātrau ca bhojanaṃ cakruḥ sarve'dhvare samāgatāḥ ।।76।।
mahīmāneṣu sarvatra rañjanānyabhavanniśi ।
śrīhariḥ śayanaṃ prāpa brahmapriyādisevitaḥ ।।77।।
makhārthimahīmānānāṃ śivireṣu naṭādayaḥ ।
cakrū rātrau nāṭyamagryaṃ pūrvāvatārabodhakam ।।78।।
mallāścakrurmallayuddhaṃ bahuyuktisamanvitam ।
gāyakānāṃ gāyanāni gāndharvamaṇḍape'bhavan ।।79।।
kutracittu viduṣāṃ vai kathā''khyānāni cā''bhavan ।
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ cāraṇānāṃ ca śāstriṇām ।।2.227.80।।
kāvyāni caitihāsāni maṇḍape tvabhavanniśi ।
kutracid vāranārīṇāṃ nṛtyāni gītimanti ca ।।8 1 ।।
rājanyavargasaṃsatsu bhavanti sma tadā niśi ।
kutracid devatānāṃ ca devīnāṃ devayoṣitām ।।82।।
brahmasarasāmapsarasāṃ gītinṛtyāni cābhavan ।
kutracidīśasṛṣṭīnāṃ mahotsavā bhavanti hi ।।83 ।।
kvacid dānavadaityānāṃ manorañjanakāni ca ।
bhavanti vividhāstatra krīḍā utsavabodhikāḥ ।।84।।
pradarśanāni lokānāṃ paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।
yoṣitāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca dehināmabhavaँstathā ।।85।।
kutracid vanavallīnāṃ drumāṇāṃ tṛṇapatriṇām ।
phalānāṃ śibikānāṃ ca pradarśanāni cābhavan ।।86।।
kutracicchilpakāryāṇāṃ kāṣṭhopalamṛdāṃ tathā ।
kārpāsahīrakauśeyatvagūrṇānāṃ tadā'bhavan ।।87।।
evaṃ gajānāmaśvānāṃ gavāṃ kesariṇāṃ tathā ।
śarabhāṇāṃ garuḍānāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ darśanāni ca ।।88।।
reṇḍīyānāṃ ca haṃsānāṃ śukānāṃ darśanāni ca ।
sainyānāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ darśanāni ca ।।89।।
evaṃvidhāni nūtnāni bahudeśodbhavāni ca ।
bahulokasamutthāni vastūni yāni yāni ca ।। 2.227.90।।
kalātmakāni sarvāṇi hetumukhyāni yāni ca ।
yantrātmakāni cānyāni tatrā'bhavaँstadā śubhe ।।9 1 ।।
goyājanabhūmau vai pradarśitāni pālakaiḥ ।
evaṃ ṣaṣṭhīniśā sarvā mahotsāhasamanvitā ।।92।।
vyatītā'rdhā tato lokā nidrāyāṃ saṃgatāḥ sukhāḥ ।
saptamyāṃ prātarevā'thā'vādyanta tūryajātayaḥ ।।93।।
maṃgalāni kīrtanāni gītayaścā'bhavaँstathā ।
stāvakānāṃ stavanāni ninādā yantrasaṃbhavāḥ ।।94।।
vedaghoṣāśca viprāṇāṃ satāṃ sadbhajanāni ca ।
yoṣitāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇayaśoyuktāśca gītayaḥ ।।95।।
devīnāṃ devatādivyakathākhyānapragītayaḥ ।
īśvarīṇāṃ śeṣavārtāgītikāśca tadā'bhavan ।।96।।
nidrāśūnyā api rātrau bhūrītiṃ parigṛhya ca ।
maunaṃ śāntiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ prāptāścāsanniśāhvaye ।।97।।
prātaścaivaṃ tu vividhairmāṃgalikaśravādibhiḥ ।
svasthā bhūtvā kṛtasnānā kṛtāhnikāstadā'bhavan ।।98।।
rādhike śrīhariḥ snātaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtārcanaḥ ।
pitarau ca nijau kṛṣṇo vavande pādayoḥ patan ।। 99।।
rājādyāśca kṛtakāryā hariṃ pūjayituṃ tadā ।
samāyayurmahāsaudhe śrīnivāsālaye śubhe ।। 2.227.10 0।।
pupūjuḥ śrīhariṃ prītyā pādodakāni vai papuḥ ।
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca rājanyāḥ saṃgatā gṛhe ।। 10 1।।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradatvaiva natvā cāśīrvaco'nvitāḥ ।
kṛtabhāgyāstathā rājñyaḥ pūjayitvā tathaiva tam ।। 10 2।।
āyayurvai maṇḍapaṃ ca yajñasya bhagavānapi ।
ṛṣayaścāyayustatra karmaṭhā devatāstathā ।। 1 03।।
rādhike sarvahavyāni samidhā mantradevatāḥ ।
vahnayaḥ sarva evāpi maṇḍape tatra cāyayuḥ ।। 104।।
atha prāvartata kāryaṃ yajñīyaṃ cāditaḥ khalu ।
yathāpūrvaṃ kramalābhaṃ sāvadhānatayā makhe ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne yajñabhūmau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyaṃ copadeśādi bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ saptamyāṃ prātaryajñamaṇḍapāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśa-
tyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 227 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 227 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 228
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 229 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike saptamīprātarmuhūrte cottame punaḥ ।
makhakāryaṃ lomaśādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvadine yathā ।। 1 ।।
prokṣaṇaṃ svastivāgādi puṇyāhavacanaṃ tathā ।
devānāṃ samprabodhaśca pūjanaṃ ca vidhānataḥ ।। 2 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ balerdānaṃ mahānaivedyakāni ca ।
jalārpaṇaṃ tathā tāmbūlārpaṇaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ।।3 ।।
agnāvāhutayaścāpi sarveṣāṃ havyalābhanam ।
ārārtrikaṃ ca devānāṃ viprāṇāṃ dakṣiṇādikam ।। 4 ।।
puṣpāñjalistataḥ parihāraścetyabhavan kramāt ।
evaṃ nivartite kārye rājabhiryajamānakaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
śrīharerājñayā sarve mahīmānottamādayaḥ ।
havyāni miṣṭabhojyāni bubhujuśca tataḥ param ।। 6 ।।
lakṣāyutādyā manujā bubhujurdīnavargiṇaḥ ।
atha viśrāntimāsādya sāyaṃ tatrā'bhavatsabhā ।। 7 ।।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇasvāmī nārāyaṇādhipaḥ ।
prajābhyo hitakṛdvākyānyādideśa kṛpāparaḥ ।। 8 ।।
yajñaścāhaṃ parabrahma vahnirmukhaṃ tu me matam ।
tanmukhena haviḥ sarvaṃ grasāmi bhakṣayāmi ca ।। 9 ।।
manmūrtau brahmarandhre me'kṣaraṃdhāma virājate ।
keśeṣu sarvamuktā me muktānyo bhrakuṭau mama ।। 2.228.10 ।।
mukhe netre gaṇḍayośca kapolayośca karṇayoḥ ।
śmaśruṣu cāpyavatārāḥ sarve vasanti mastake ।। 11 ।।
cibuke nāsikādaṇḍe'vatāriṇyo vasanti me ।
kaṇṭhe vyūhā vāsudevādayo vasanti ceśvarāḥ ।। 12।।
skandhe pṛṣṭhe mahāmāyā prakṛtiryā prakīrtyate ।
pradhānapuruṣaḥ kālo bhūmā puruṣa ityapi ।। 13।।
mahāviṣṇustathā rudraḥ sadāśivo virāḍapi ।
sarve tvete pārśvayorme vartante kukṣisaṃśritāḥ ।। 14।।
īśvarāṇyo mahādevyo mahālakṣmyaśca vai śriyaḥ ।
sarvāstāḥ śaktayo vakṣobhāge vasanti me striyaḥ ।। 15।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ siddhāśceśvarakoṭayaḥ ।
vasanti nābhibhāge me sapatnīkā mamodare ।। 16।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā vasanti jaghane mama ।
yakṣā rakṣāṃsi daityāśca dānavā guptaromasu ।। 17।।
gupte kāmādikā devā vasanti rājasā nṛpāḥ ।
nitambe bhūtakūṣmāṇḍāḥ pretapiśācakoṭayaḥ ।। 18।।
sakthnorme mānavādyāśca jānvorme cāraṇādayaḥ ।
jaṃghayorme talavāsā daityādyāḥ saṃvasanti hi ।। 19।।
patphaṇayoḥ sarpanāgā vasanti ca sarīsṛpāḥ ।
vṛkṣavallīprabhṛtayo vasanti romasu drumāḥ ।।2.228.20।।
kīṭapataṃgaśalabhāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ paśavastathā ।
śārīrakṣaraṇasthā me vasanti paritaḥ sadā ।।21 ।।
ityevaṃ mayi sarvā vai jaḍacetanasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
vasantīti mayi tṛpte tṛptāḥ sarve madātmakāḥ ।।22।।
viṣṇuyāge mahāyāge māṃ prapūjya pareśvaram ।
madbhaktān bhojayed yastu phalaṃ tasyā'śvamedhajam ।।23।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayitvā makhe dvijān ।
bhojayet sa labhedatra vājapeyakratoḥ phalam ।।24।।
kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ makhe yaḥ pūjayecca mām ।
sādhūn saṃbhojayettasya rājasūyakratoḥ phalam ।।25।।
gopālabālaṃ govindaṃ makhe'tra pūjayettu mām ।
satīḥ sādhvīrbhojayecca phalaṃ tasyātirātrajam ।।26।।
puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ māṃ makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
bhojayedbālakān yaḥ sa pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ।।27।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayedadhvare tathā ।
anāthān bhojayettasyā'gniṣṭomā'dhvarajaṃ phalam ।।28।।
brahmapriyāpatiṃ māṃ yo'dhvare'tra pūjayettathā ।
kanyakā bhojayed yaḥ sa gavāyanaphalaṃ labhet ।।29।।
piśaṃgīkāntaṃ māṃ bhaktyā'dhvare'tra pūjayettu yaḥ ।
brahmayatīn bhojayecca labhet somakratoḥ phalam ।। 2.228.30 ।।
śrīrādhāmāṇikīnāthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ māṃ prapūjayet। ।
gopagopīrbhojayitvā yāyādviśvajitaḥ phalam ।।।3 1 ।।
prabhāpāravatīnāthaṃ pūjayenmāṃ makhe tathā ।
bhojayecca mahīmānān sautrāmaṇyāḥ phalaṃ labhet ।।।32।।
gaurīnāthaṃ ca māṃ bhaktyā pūjayedadhvare'tra yaḥ ।
rudrayāgaphalaṃ yāyād bhojayitvā hi karmaṭhān ।।33।।।
amarīsvāminaṃ māṃ yaḥ pūjayedatra vai makhe ।
amarīrbhojayitvā ca brahmayajñaphalaṃ labhet ।। 34।।
brāhmīnāthaṃ ca māṃ bhaktyā makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
brāhmīḥ sādhvīrbhojayitvā mahārudraphalaṃ labhet ।।35।।
lākṣmaṇīsvāmina māṃ ca makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
labhennārāyaṇaphalaṃ prabhojya sāṃkhyayoginīḥ ।।36।।
ābriktisvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
jalahārīrbhojayitvā jalamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।।37।।
uṣṇālīsvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
pācinīrbhojayed yaḥ sa labhedannakratoḥ phalam ।। 38।।
īśvarīsvāminaṃ māṃ ca makhe'tra pūjayettathā ।
makhabhṛtyān bhojayed yaḥ sa labhenmakhajaṃ phalam ।।39।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam ।
muktapatiṃ ca duḥkhahālakṣmīkāntaṃ tu yo'dhvare ।।2.228.40 ।।
pūjayed bhojayet sarvān sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।
mūrtimantaṃ gocaraṃ māṃ prīṇayitvā'tra cādhvare ।।41।।
yadyadicchenmama bhaktastattatsarvaṃ samāpnuyāt ।
dātā'haṃ sarvanātho'smi sarvaṃ dadāmi sevine ।।42।।
dānānyatra makhe śaktyā deyāni dharmakarmiṇe ।
dānairyat sukṛtaṃ cātra tadbhavedakṣayaṃ dhruvam ।।43।।
yajñavidho gṛhī divyaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamaṇḍitam ।
arkaprabhaṃ samāruhya vimānaṃ yāti matpadam ।।44।।
annānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca dānaṃ vai samidhāṃ tathā ।
oṣadhānāmambarāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ dānamityapi ।।45।।
bhaved dadāno dīrghāyuḥ svargabhāṅ mokṣabhāk tataḥ ।
saṃhitāpustakadānaṃ yaḥ karoti sa gacchati ।।46 ।।
svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ mokṣaṃ me cā'kṣaraṃ padam ।
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi dayitaṃ gṛhe ।।47।।
tattat svārthaṃ pradeyaṃ vai tadevā'kṣayamicchatā ।
na dānaṃ yaśase dadyānna bhayena na lobhataḥ ।।48।।
paralokahitāyaiva deyaṃ pātrāya muktaye ।
vidyāvate hyanāthāya cārthine śīlayogine ।।49।।
sādhave dīyate syādakṣayaṃ tadvai mahāphalam ।
mama bhaktāḥ sarvasahā nispṛhā jitamānasāḥ ।।2.228.50।।
sarvabhūtahitāḥ santastebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ।
santastuṣṭāstārayanti dātṝn sahasravaṃśajān ।।51 ।।
devālayaṃ dharmaśālāṃ sanmaṭhān kārayed dṛḍhān ।
yāvatya iṣṭikāstatra citā devālayādiṣu ।।52।।
tāvantyabdasahasrāṇi svargeṣu modate kṛtī ।
mama mandiranirmātā mama dhāmābhigacchati ।।53।।
pratiṣṭhayā pārameṣṭhyaṃ prāsādenaiśvaraṃ padam ।
pūjāvṛttyā brahmalokaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।54।।
sudhādibhirlepayitvā jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakārayet ।
sammārjayellepayecca sevayet pratimāṃ mama ।।55।।
kūpavāpītaḍāgāni madarthaṃṃ kārayedapi ।
gāvaḥ pibanti salilaṃ sādhavo mānavāstathā ।।56 ।।
sarvāṇi cāpi sattvāni tṛṣārtāni pibanti ca ।
tīrthālaye ca tatpuṇyamaprameyaṃ hi jāyate ।।57।।
prāsādasyā'bhito ropaṇīyā vṛkṣā hi śākhinaḥ ।
ārāmāścāpi kartavyā viśrāntyarthaṃ tu dehinām ।।58।।
phalopayogino vṛkṣāstathā puṣpopayoginaḥ ।
samitpatropayogāśca pitṛdevopabhogadāḥ ।।59।।
etatatpuṇyamanantaṃ vai sarvasmṛddhipradaṃ bhavet ।
bhaktiyuktaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu mama dhāmapradaṃ bhavet ।।2.228.6 0 ।।
gṛhasthairvā dhanāḍhyaiśca rājabhistu viśeṣataḥ ।
tīrthabhūmiḥ sadā kāryā sajīvanā mahotsavaiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
yajñabhūmiḥ sadā puṇyā nadī puṇyā kratostaṭī ।
goyājanī medinī sā sadā mokṣakarī matā ।।62।।
atra vāse'pi lokānāṃ yāmyānāṃ darśanaṃ na vai ।
atra manurdhṛto yena vaiṣṇavastasya mokṣaṇam ।।63 ।।
mama pūjā kṛtā yena tasyāpi mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ cānnaṃ yena makhe'rpitam ।।64।।
tasya muktiṃ kariṣyāmi nayiṣye me'kṣaraṃ padam ।
aho yajña iti prājño guṇagrāhī bhavatyapi ।।65।।
tasya pāpābdhimevā'haṃ jvālayiṣyāmi keśavaḥ ।
yajñe dhṛtaṃ ca vastraṃ ca pātraṃ pāyasamityapi ।।66।।
yaḥ pradāsyati bhaktyā taṃ nayiṣye me'kṣaraṃ padam ।
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ vidhāsyati ।।67।।
kanyādānaṃ putradānaṃ kumāradānamityapi ।
svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ yānavāhanadānakam ।।68।।
vāṭikodyānadānaṃ ca chatradānaṃ gajārpaṇam ।
yaḥ kariṣyati yajñe'tra taṃ nayiṣye'kṣaraṃ padam ।।6 9।।
ātmārpaṇaṃ tathā brahmārpaṇaṃ ca gurave'rpaṇam ।
sadbhyo'rpaṇaṃ ca yatkiñcid yathāśakti makhe'tra vai ।।2.228.70।।
yaḥ kariṣyati bhaktātmā dāsye'smai cākṣaraṃ padam ।
evamuktvā tato rādhe'nādiśrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।71 ।।
mantrān dadau manuṣyebhyo makhibhyastatra vaiṣṇavān ।
tataḥ sandhyāṃ hariścakre devārārtrikamācarat ।।72।।
īśānapānaśiṣṭādyā rājādyāḥ śrīharerapi ।
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca pūjāṃ pūṣpāñjalīn dadau ।।73।।
prajāśca bhojayāmāsurmahīmānān samāgatān ।
yajñīyān karmaṭhān devān sarvāśca dehino'pi ca ।।74।।
āgantukān kautūhalānnirīkṣakān janānapi ।
āgatān vigatāँścāpi bhojanāni janādayaḥ ।।75।।
kārayāmāsuratyarthaṃ hareḥ kuṭumbakāni ca ।
miṣṭānnādyairvicitraiśca tattatsṛṣṭyucitairapi ।।76 ।।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsāँśca bhojayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
jalapānāni miṣṭāni tāmbūlāni dadustataḥ ।।77।।
rātrāvāsan kathāśrāvāḥ pradarśanāni vai tataḥ ।
nidrārāmāstataścāsan sarve vai dehino niśi ।।78।।
yathocitaṃ virāmasthāḥ prātarjajāgarurdrutam ।
maṃgalairvādyaghoṣaiśca gītibhirdevayoṣitām ।।79।।
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ yaśogānaiḥ samantataḥ ।
aṣṭamyāṃ rādhike prātarjajāgāra hariḥ svayam ।।2.228.80।।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ pitarau svau pupūja ha ।
brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca hariṃ pupūjurīśvaram ।।8 1 ।।
śrīharirlomaśaṃ natvā jagrāhāśīrvacastataḥ ।
rājāno rājabhṛtyāśca rājñyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।82।।
pupūjuścandanādyaiśca papuśca caraṇāmṛtam ।
tato muhūrtasadbhāve śrutvā vādyadhvaniṃ śubham ।।83।।
hariryajñasthale bhaktaiḥ sameto maṇḍape yayau ।
kṛtaśuddhirhariścāpi rājānaḥ karmaṭhāstathā ।
aparā devakoṭyaśceśvarāvatārakoṭayaḥ ।।84।।
mānavāḥ ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaraḥ sthāvarāstathā ।
jaṃgamā naranāryaśca maṇḍape tūrṇamāyayuḥ ।।85।।
sāmagryo havyarūpiṇyo havyavāhāśca vahnayaḥ ।
havyadā yajamānāśca yajñe tatra samāyayuḥ ।।86 ।।
viprāḥ karmaprayoktāro vedāḥ svarāśca gītayaḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā maṇḍape tatra cāyayuḥ ।।87।।
prokṣaṇaṃ svastivācaśca puṇyāhavacanānyapi ।
abhavan devatānāṃ prābodhanaṃ ca samantrakam ।।88।।
snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ patrapuṣpākṣatādivastubhiḥ ।
sarvopacāraiḥ subhagairdhūpadīpādibhistathā ।।89।।
ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ tathā tadā ।
tāmbūlādipradānaṃ ca mahā''hutipradānakam ।।2.228.90 ।।
pūrvato'pyadhikaṃ jātaṃ havyadānaṃ tadā'nale ।
carordānaṃ pāyasādipradānaṃ ca phalārpaṇam ।। 91 ।।
evaṃ yāvatpradehibhya āhutayaḥ samarpitāḥ ।
tṛpyuttaraṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cābhavad bahu ।।।92।।।
devīnāṃ mātṛkāṇāṃ ceśvarīṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ।
śaktināṃ vāminīnāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ hyabhūt ।।93।।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ prataptaṃ ca parihāraṃ kratostataḥ ।
cakāra śrīhariḥ paścād bhojanānyabhavaँstadā ।।94।।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ sarve bubhujire janāḥ ।
miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi sudhā'mṛtāni yāni ca ।। 95।।
divyān rasāँstathā divyapīyūṣāṇi śubhāni ca ।
brahmarasān dhāmarasān siddharasān parottamān ।।96।।
papurbubhujire devāḥ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ।
tṛptā bhojanamāsādya jalapānaṃ tataḥ param ।।97।।
takrapānaṃ pracakruśca phalādanaṃ ca tatparam ।
tāmbūlagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā viśaśramurnivāsake ।।98।।
tataḥ sāyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaḥ sabhāyāṃ vai samāyayau ।
prajābhyo rādhike naijaṃ copadeśaṃ dadau hariḥ ।।99।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptamyāṃ prātarmakhakāryāṇi nirvartya śrīhariṇā kṛtaṃ svasya sarvātmakatvādyupadeśanaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrāvutsavaḥ, tataḥ
prātaraṣṭamyāṃ makhakāryavinirvartanaṃ bhojanama cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 228 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 229
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 230 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike lokānupādideśa mādhavaḥ ।
tyāga eva tu sarveṣāṃ mahāsukhaprade mataḥ ।। 1 ।।
tyajanaṃ tyāga evā'sti dūrīkaraṇamityapi ।
anāgrahaṇamevāpi tyāga eva hi so'rthataḥ ।। 2 ।।
tṛṣṇātyāge mahāśāntiricchātyāge nivartanam ।
dravyatyāge karmaśāntirbhogatyāge vratodbhavaḥ ।। 3 ।।
sukhatyāge tapaḥprāptiḥ sarvatyāge vimokṣaṇam ।
tyāgamārgo hi duḥkhānāṃ viprahāṇāya jāyate ।। 4 ।।
yatra yena bhaved duḥkhaṃ tattat tyaktvā sukhī bhavet ।
māyāṃ tyaktvā guṇātīto brahmānandabharo bhavet ।। 5 ।।
guṇayoge guṇabhāvāḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vimohanam ।
guṇatyāge guṇabhāvavidhvaṃsaścātmano bhavet ।। 6 ।।
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti śītoṣṇāṃgārasādhanāḥ ।
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā ।। 7 ।।
sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavantyete vairāgyādveṣṭalābhataḥ ।
atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathā'kṣamā ।। 8 ।।
rājasāḥ saṃbhavantyete rāgādvā dviṣṭalābhataḥ ।
avivekastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandrite ।। 9 ।।
tāmasāḥ saṃbhavantyete jāḍyādvā buddhivibhramāt ।
iṣṭatāyāḥ parityāge sāttvikānāṃ layo bhavet ।। 2.229.1 0।।
dviṣṭatāyāḥ parityāge rājasānāṃ layo bhavet ।
vibhraṃśasya parityāge tāmasānāṃ layo bhavet ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ guṇatrayatyāge guṇātītasthitirbhavet ।
saccidānandarūpaṃ svaṃ vindati cetanaḥ svayam ।। 1 2।।
evaṃ sati rūpanāmākṛtayo'sya na vai tadā ।
rūpanāmākṛtijanyā'hantā na mamatā'pi na ।। 13 ।।
tayostyāge cetanasya mokṣabhāvo'bhijāyate ।
lipyate karmabhirnaiva na badhyate'pi mucyate ।। 1 4।।
dṛḍhapāśā gatāścāsya śarīrendriyasaṃbhavāḥ ।
gatāścāntaḥkaraṇotthāstadā mukto'grago bhavet ।। 1 5।।
aparokṣānubhavavān kālamṛtyubhayātigaḥ ।
puṇyāpuṇyātmapātheyaśūnyaḥ phalavivarjitaḥ ।। 16 ।।
cidambarātmānamāpya cidākāśe pramodate ।
ūrṇanābhirhi nirbandhaḥ svajāle mukta eva saḥ ।। 1 7।।
gireḥ patito grāvā vai bandhaśūnyo yathaiva saḥ ।
purāṇaṃ ruroḥ śṛṃgaṃ tyaktaṃ bandhāya naiva tat ।। 18 ।।
tyaktā jīrṇā na bandhāya tvak sarpasya yathā tu vai ।
picchaṃ tyaktaṃ na bandhāya picchinastattathaiva ca । । 19 ।।
nadyāṃ patan drumastyaktaḥ pakṣiṇo bandhanāya na ।
evaṃ dehālayaṃ tyaktvā vimukto vai mahāsukhī ।। 2.229.20 ।।
dehe sthito'pi yaḥ prajñāmetāmāśritya vartate ।
muktavanmukta evā'yaṃ guṇā'saṃgī mahāsukhī ।। 21 ।।
atha loke sthitaścāpi guṇayogena vartate ।
tasyāpi sukhabāhulyasādhanaṃ dama eva ha ।। 22 ।।
kriyāstapaḥ sukhaṃ satyaṃ dame sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
damastejo vardhayati bhayaṃ pāpaṃ nikṛntati ।। 23 ।।
sukhaṃ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate ।
sukhaṃ lokaiḥ samanveti sukhaṃ hṛdi prasīdati ।। 24।।
damena vardhate cātmabalaṃ bhāgyamudeti ca ।
satkāryāṇāṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ dame dānte pratiṣṭhati ।। 25 ।।
bhavantyete guṇā nityā damayuktasya dehinaḥ ।
akārpaṇyamasaṃraṃbhaḥ santoṣaḥ śraddadhānatā ।। 26 ।।
akrodha ārjavaṃ saumyaṃ nātivādo na paiśunam ।
nābhimānaṃ nāpyasūyā dayā ca gurupūjanam ।। 27।।
janavādamṛṣāvādastutinindāvivarjanam ।
sādhukāmaḥ spṛhāśūnyaścā'vairaḥ sūpacāravān ।। 28 ।।
suvrataḥ śīlavān jalpavarjitaḥ suprasannahṛt ।
prasannātmā''tmavān doṣān jitvā''tmaniṣṭhasaṃsthitiḥ ।। 29 ।।
sarvabhūtahite yukto na sma dviṣṭe'paraṃ tu yaḥ ।
mahāhradaṃ ivā'kṣobhyaḥ prajñātṛptaḥ prasādavān ।। 2.229.30 ।।
kālākāṃkṣī carellokān nirapāya ivātmavān ।
svargavanmokṣavaccāpi dānto guṇairitīdṛśaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavanmodate sukhī ।
tyāgastapaḥ paraṃ proktaṃ dāntistapaḥ parottamam ।।32।।
ārjavaṃ tapasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maunaṃ śīlaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ।
amṛtāśitvamaparaṃ tapaḥ sādhuprasevanam ।।33।।
kṛtaprajñasya dāntasya vitṛṣṇasya nirāśiṣaḥ ।
śrīharau dhyānaśīlasya sthairyaṃ tatparamaṃ tapaḥ ।।34।।
ārjavenā'pramādena prasādena ca sevayā ।
vṛddhaśuśrūṣayā śāntyā tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāyate ।।35।।
prajñālābhāttu puruṣaḥ sarvaṃ tudati kilbiṣam ।
vimāyiko labhate śaṃ śāntisthaḥ samprasīdati ।।36।।
labdhavyānyeva labhati gantavyānyeva gacchati ।
prāptavyānyeva prāpnoni duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ।।37।।
etadviditvā kārtsyena yo na muhyati dehavān ।
kuśalī sa sadā cāste sa vai sarvadhano mataḥ ।।38।।
tasmād guṇānupārjyaiva sato seveta cānayān ।
satsaṃgena bhaved vṛddhirguṇānāṃ brahmagāminām ।।39।।
brahmaprāptirbhavettena sarvārpaṇena mādhave ।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prajājanān ।।2.229.40।।
manūnaśrāvayat samyag vaiṣṇavāँstān vyadhāpayat ।
aṣṭamyāstu rajanyāṃ vai datvopadeśanaṃ tataḥ ।।41 ।।
bhagavān bhojayāmāsa sarvān vai mahīmānakān ।
prajāśca bhojayāmāsa tathā naijakuṭumbakam ।।42।।
svayaṃ bhuktvā ca viśrāntiṃ lebhe suyoganidrikām ।
navamyāṃ maṃgaladhvānaiḥ sūtamāgadhagītibhiḥ ।।43।।
bandīgītayaśovrātaiḥ prabubodha mahāprabhuḥ ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ kṛtavṛddhābhipūjanaḥ ।।44।।
māṃgalike muhūrte tvāyayau kratoḥ sumaṇḍapam ।
rājādayo yajamānāḥ samāyayustu maṇḍape ।।45।।
yathāpūrvamabhavacca yajñakāryaṃ samastakam ।
madhyāhne cāhutiṃ datvā bhagavān bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।46।।
bhojayāmāsa sarvāṃśca svayaṃ ca bubhuje prabhuḥ ।
sāyaṃ vimānamāruhya samudropari cāmbare ।।47।।
rājabhiḥ saha bhagavān vihārārthaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
samāgatya nijaṃ sthānaṃ sandhyāṃ cakāra keśavaḥ ।।48।।
bhojayitvā janān bhuktvā rātrau viśrāntimāpa ca ।
daśamyāmapi prātaḥ sa kṛtāhnikaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।49।।
yajñamaṇḍapamāgatya yajamānaiḥ sametakaḥ ।
maharṣibhiḥ kratoḥ kāryaṃ kārayitvā tathā havān ।।।2.229.50।।
datvā madhyāhnavelāyāṃ bhojayāmāsa vāḍavān ।
mahīmānān samastāṃśca svayaṃ ca bubhuje tataḥ ।।51।।
sāyaṃ manūn dadau tatra bhaktebhyo bhagavān prabhuḥ ।
śrāddhāni kārayāmāsa vāḍavairbahutarpaṇam ।।52।।
rātrau bhojanamāsādya viśrāntiṃ cāpa mādhavaḥ ।
ekādaśyāṃ prage śīghraṃ samuttasthau sureśvaraḥ ।।53।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo maṇḍapaṃ drutamāyayau ।।54।।
vastūnāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ svastivācaḥ puṇyāhavācanam ।
kārayitvā surādīnāṃ prabodhanaṃ ca pūjanam ।।55।।
balidānaṃ mahānaivedyakaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā ।
homaṃ havyaviśeṣāṇāṃ pradadau bhagavāँstataḥ ।।56।।
sahasraghṛtadhārābhistarpayāmāsa devatāḥ ।
tadā pratyakṣarūpāste bhuktavantaḥ surādayaḥ ।।57।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamā sarve tṛptiṃ prāptāḥ suhavyakaiḥ ।
iyaṃ cākṣaradhāmādhipataye cāhutirnamaḥ ।।58।।
imā muktebhya evāpi cāhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।
imāḥ sarvāvatārebhyaścāhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।।59।।
imā īśebhya āhutayaśca tebhyo namonamaḥ ।
imāḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ sarvebhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।।2.229.60 ।।
imāḥ pitṛbhyāahutayastebhyaśca namonamaḥ ।
imā devebhya āhutayaśca tebhyo namonamaḥ ।।61 ।।
imā bhuvarnivāsibhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।
imā mānavajātibhya āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।।62।।
imāḥ saptatalavāsibhyaścāhutayastānnumaḥ ।
imā drumebhyaḥ sarvebhyo latātṛṇebhya ityapi ।।63 ।।
kandamūlādiyāvadbhyā āhutayaśca tānnumaḥ ।
imāḥ kīṭapataṃgādibhyaścāhutayastānnumaḥ ।।64।।।
sarvayoṣidbhyaśca sṛṣṭitrayasthābhya imā numaḥ ।
jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca tattvebhyo'pi nama imāḥ ।।65।।
āhutayaḥ pradattāste tṛptiṃ yāntu hi dehinaḥ ।
ityevaṃ sruci śreṣṭhājyaṃ śrīphalaṃ samidhastathā ।।66।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ miṣṭaṃ nidhāya sarvajātikam ।
mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ naumi namaskṛtya vicintanam ।।67।।
agnirnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasmai dadāmi te namaḥ ।
idamagnaye ca vaiśvānarāya paramātmane ।।68।।
ityuktvā pradadau vahnau nārikelādikaṃ hariḥ ।
rājānaḥ pradaduścāpi śrīphalādyāni vai tadā ।।69।।
namaste gārhapatyāya namaste dakṣiṇāgnaye ।
namaścāhavanīyāya mahāvedisthitāya ca ।।2.229.70।।
brahmaṇe gārhapatyāya viṣṇave dakṣiṇāgnaye ।
śivāyā''havanīyāya śaktivedisthitāya ca ।।71 ।।
namaste sabhyarūpāya namo gṛhyāgnirūpiṇe ।
pañcāgnirūpiṇe tubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane ।।72।।
namo'gnihotrarūpāya namaḥ parveṣṭirūpiṇe ।
cāturmāsyasvarūpāya namaḥ paśviṣṭirūpiṇe ।।73।।
sautrāmaṇaye tubhyaṃ namo'gniṣṭomāya te namaḥ ।
atyagniṣṭomarūpāya namaste coktharūpiṇe ।।74।।
namaḥ ṣoḍaśarūpāya vājapeyāya te namaḥ ।
atirātrasvarūpāya sarvamedhātmane namaḥ ।।75।।।
tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvajīvānāṃ tvayā'ttaṃ tarpayet surān ।
jīvasṛṣṭirīśasṛṣṭirbrahmasṛṣṭiśca yā matā ।।76।।
tāsāṃ tṛptipradastvaṃ vai havyabhuk havyamāvaha ।
yāntu havyāni sarvebhyaḥ svadhāsvāhādyudīraṇāt ।।77।।
kālī karālī dhūmrā ca manobhavā sphulliṃginī ।
piṃgā raktā ca te jihvā tābhirgrasa havirmuhuḥ ।।78।।
pūgīphalāni ca vahnau phalānyanyāni yāni ca ।
praduduśca tadā vahnau tṛpyatāṃ parameśvaraḥ ।।79।।
ityuktvā śrīharikṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ ।
mahāpūrṇāhutiṃ cāntāṃ dadau śrīpataye tadā ।।2.229.80।।
evaṃ homaṃ pradāyaiva brahmaṇe pātrakārpaṇam ।
kṛtavān śrīharirbrahmāyajamānābhiṣecanam ।।81 ।।
kṛtvā'mṛtābhiṣekaṃ ca śreyodānaṃ tato'karot ।
dakṣiṇārpaṇamevāpi maṇḍape cā'karoddhariḥ ।।82।।
svarṇagobhūtilādīnāṃ dānānyadāpayat prabhuḥ ।
rājāno rājyayogyāni dānāni pradadustadā ।।83।।
athā'bhiṣekam ṛṣayo lomaśādyā vyadhustadā ।
pavamānāni ṛṣayo hyāśīrvādāँstadā jaguḥ ।।84।।
bhūyasīṃ sampradāyaivā''śīrvādāँśca dadustathā ।
smṛddhayaḥ santu divyā vo'kṣayāḥ śāśvatasaukhyadāḥ ।।85।।
kuṭumbavaṃśavistārāḥ prabhavantu nirogiṇaḥ ।
rājyavaibhavapaśavo dāsā dāsyo bhavantu vaḥ ।।86।।
āyurdīrghaṃ yaśo divyaṃ cānte svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।
bhavantu bhogyajātāni bhavatāṃ sarvadā tviha ।।87।।
sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sarve santu nirogiṇaḥ ।
svargaṃ dīrghaṃ paraṃ bhuktvā prayāntvante'kṣaraṃ padam ।।88।।
ityuktvā yajñadevānāṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vidāyakam ।
pradadurlomaśādyāśca parihārastato'bhavat ।।89।।
yajñaprasādaṃ havyaṃ vai sarve bubhujire makhe ।
yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ ca yānyeva havyāni tāni tāni vai ।।2.229.90।।
tebhyastebhyo harikṛṣṇo dattavān nijaśaktibhiḥ ।
sarvavidhāni bhojyāni havyānyamṛtakāni ca ।।9 1।।
sudhārasāँśca vividhān pīyūṣapānakoṭikāḥ ।
yathāyogyebhyaḥ pradadau tṛptayāmāsa yāvataḥ ।। 92।।
tato'dhikaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dadau bhikṣukayāyine ।
bhikṣukā'nāthanārībhyo pradadau bhojanānyapi ।।93।।
sarvebhyaḥ pradadāvekādaśyāṃ madhyāhnakottaram ।
bhojanāni samastāni pitṛśrāddhaṃ tato'karot ।।94।।
anekāni phalādīni jalādīnyapi sandadau ।
sāyaṃ sabhāyāṃ bhagavān niṣasāda śubhāsane ।।95।।
dadau mantrān janebhyaśca vyadhād vaiṣṇavasattamān ।
nijaṃ divyaṃ darśanaṃ ca dadau tvakṣaradhāmagam ।। 96।।
brahmapriyābhirmuktaiśca sevitaṃ pārameśvaram ।
punastatra bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ sambabhūva ha ।।97।।
yajñatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ janebhyaḥ prajagāda ca ।
rādhike tattadā sṛṣṭitrayaṃ śuśrāva vai mudā ।।98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinakṛṣṇanavamīdaśamyekādaśīṣu yajñādikāryanirvartanaṃ mahāpūrṇāhutipradānaṃparihāro bhojanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇa-
nāmā navaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 229 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 229 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 230
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 231 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-.
rādhike yajñabhūmau ca yāni tīrthāni cāvasan ।
tānyāha śrībālakṛṣṇaścāmrajānīsarittaṭe ।। 1 ।।
yatra nārāyaṇaścāsmi yajñakartā pareśvaraḥ ।
sā bhūmistvakṣaratulyā divyā divyagatipradā ।। 2 ।।
āmrajānīnadī divyā svargaṃgā badarīsutā ।
āmrajānyapsarā divyā nareṇa nijaśaktitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
āmramañjarikābhiśca pramṛdyotpāditā purā ।
tapaścaryāpravighnārthaṃ purā mahendra āyayau ।। 4 ।।
bahvapsarobhiḥ sahito badaryāṃ śrīhareḥ puraḥ ।
nārāyaṇena tāḥ sarvā nṛtyantyaścendradeśitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
vilokitāstatastāsāṃ garvabhaṃgāya vai mayā ।
badaryāṃ ca naradvārā hyurvaśī prakaṭīkṛtā ।। 6 ।।
tasyāstu sannidhau sarvāstadā śyāmā ivā'bhavan ।
rūpagarvaṃ vihāyaiva tatra kṣamāmayācire ।। 7 ।।
tadā mayā tu tāḥ sarvā mantreṇa vaiṣṇavīkṛtāḥ ।
āmrajānīṃ yayāce vai mahendro rūpasundarīm ।। 8 ।।
sā mayā tu mahendrāyā'rpitā tvekasvarūpiṇī ।
dvitīyā brahmacaryasthā matputrī mama sannidhau ।। 9 ।।
badaryāṃ sā vasatyeva sā'tra jalasvarūpiṇī ।
pārākarṣitapaścaryāphaladānārthamāgatā ।। 2.230.10 ।।
pārāko nāma rājarṣiḥ pitṝṇāṃ muktaye'tra vai ।
tapaścacāra paramaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrakam ।। 11 ।।
pūrvajānāṃ pratṛptyarthaṃ jalārthaṃ so'pyakalpayat ।
māṃ dhyāyan jalalābhārthaṃ tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhamayācata ।। 1 2।।
mama mūrtiṃ pratuṣṭāva dhyānamagno'tibhāvataḥ ।
mayā hṛdā prasannena smṛtā putrī madāśrayā ।। 13 ।।
seyaṃ jalasvarūpā'bhūt putrī mamā''jñayā tadā ।
saptadhārāsvarūpā sā bhūtvā brāhmīlabhūtale ।। 14।।
pravāheṇa gatā yatra yatra pitara āsate ।
tatra tatra kṛtasteṣāṃ mokṣo yayuśca te'kṣaram ।। 15 ।।
seyaṃ cā'mrajanī divyā mokṣadā vartate nadī ।
tasyā rūpāṇi saptā'tra āmrajānī varīyasī ।। 16 ।।
rākāntikāsanā cāpi dvitīyā sā prakīrtitā ।
gonikaṣā tṛtīyā ca goyājñī ca caturthikā ।। 17।।
mādvārikā pañcamī ca ṣaṣṭhī sā puruṣā matā ।
mānāsanā saptamī ca sarvā mokṣapradā hi tāḥ ।। 18 ।।
śāntārāmā purī ceyaṃ pāreśvaraṃ ca pattanam ।
āmrajānīsamudrasaṃgamaśca mokṣadaḥ sadā । । 1 9।।
mahāpāpātipāpānāṃ kṣālakaḥ saṃgamo hyayam ।
atra bhūmau tu yajñānāṃ tīrthānāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ।। 2.230.20 ।।
mervādīnāṃ ca sarasāṃ nadīnāṃ vāsa eva ca ।
mayā saṃkalpitastasmāt tīrthānyatra vasantu vai ।। 21 ।।
āmrajānyāṃ ṣaḍanyāsāṃ nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣviha ।
muktāstathā'vatārāśceśvarā devā vasantvapi ।। 22।।
devyaśca śaktayaścāpi sāgarāḥ saritastathā ।
sarvatīrthanivāso'tra bhavatviti nideśanam ।।23 ।।
bālakṛṣṇasthalī śāntārāmapāreśvarāntare।
sarvatīrthanivāsā vai pāvanyakṣarasannibhā ।।24।।
goyājanyā gavākṣāyā madhye pṛthivī yāvatī ।
triśatakrośaparyantā sarvā mokṣapradā śubhā ।।25।।
atra snānena muktiḥ syād vāpyāṃ kūpe taḍāgake ।
nadīnāṃ jalapānena mama dhāma vrajejjanaḥ ।।26।।
svalpānnadānakaraṇād yajñajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt। ।
godānāt svarṇadānācca svargaṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ ।।27।।
kanyādānaṃ bhuvo dānaṃ vastradānaṃ gavārpaṇam ।
bhūṣādānaṃ cānnadānaṃ pātradānaṃ kariṣyati ।।28।।
atra bhūmau tasya rājasūyaphalaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
oṣadhānāṃ pradānaṃ ca vidyādānaṃ jalārpaṇam ।।29।।
rasadānaṃ chatradānaṃ copakaraṇadānakam ।
gṛhadānaṃ vāhanānāṃ dānaṃ jñānapradānakam ।।2.230.3 0।।
yaḥ kariṣyati tasyā'tra sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhavet ।
vṛkṣāropaṃ phaladānaṃ dharmaśālāṃ ca vedikām ।। 31 ।।
gṛhaṃ saudhaṃ nadīghaṭṭaṃ kārayiṣyati yo janaḥ ।
tasya svargaṃ bhaved dhrauvyaṃ tvante mokṣo bhavedapi ।।32।।
śubhe kāle śubhe pātre dattaṃ cātrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ।
śayyādānaṃ bṛsīdānaṃ corṇāmbarapradānakam ।।33।।
dāsyatyatra bhavettasya svargaṃ ceha samṛddhayaḥ ।
vividhā rājabhogāśca vaṃśavistārasampadaḥ ।।34।।
atra tīrthaṃ tu ye lokāḥ saptasaritsu yatra vā ।
kariṣyanti jalapānaṃ snānaṃ caiṣyanti te divam ।।35।।
ityuktvā śrīharistatra rādhike virarāma ha ।
īśvarādyā nijāvāsaṃ cakrustīrthasvarūpiṇaḥ ।।36।।
saptanadyaḥ samāyātāḥ kanyakāstatra vai kṣaṇe ।
candanādyaiḥ svapitaraṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।37।।
pupūjuḥ pādayornatvā prāhurvasā'tra sarvadā ।
haristathā'stviti prāha mūrtirūpaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।।38।।
tata ārabhya tatraiva mandireṣvavasat sadā ।
rājabhyaśca dadau svarṇamūrtīḥ śrīhariracyutaḥ ।।39।।
kanyakāstā yayustīrtharūpiṇyo vai nijālayān ।
rājāno'pi tataścakrurmandirāṇi sarittaṭe ।।2.230.40 ।।
suvarṇamūrtīsteṣu prātiṣṭhipan vidhinā nṛpāḥ ।
evaṃ vai rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।41 ।।
upādiśyā'tha pradadau pāritoṣikarūpiṇaḥ ।
suvarṇasthālān mahataḥ suvarṇotthakamaṇḍalūn ।।42।।
suvarṇahārān vividhān mukuṭān kānakāँstathā ।
svarṇasrajaḥ kuṇḍalāni śṛṃkhalāḥ kaṭakāni ca ।।43 ।।
hemaratnāni bhūṣāśca hemasūtrāmbarāṇyapi ।
svarṇahīrakasadratnapātrāṇi kalaśāँstathā ।।44।।
veṣān śāṭīḥ kañcukīśca kauśeyīḥ svarṇabuṭṭikāḥ ।
yānavāhanadāsāँśca dāsīśca mudrikāstathā ।।45।।
evaṃvidhāni pradadau sampāritoṣikāni vai ।
tato dadau dhanyavādān mahīmānebhya cādhvare ।।46।।
yajñasāhāyyakartṝṃścāśīrbhistatrāpyayūyujat ।
atra rātrau pāyasāni bhojanāni phalāni ca ।।47।।
akārayaddhi bhagavān sarvāṃstatra mahotsave ।
nṛtyagītotsavānte ca viśaśrāma pareśvaraḥ ।।48।।
nidrāṃ jagrāha bhagavān prātarbubodha maṃgalaiḥ ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjo mātāpitṛprasevakaḥ ।।49।।
āsane niṣasādā'thā''yayustatra nṛpādayaḥ ।
arcanaṃ śrīhareścakruḥ sannyadhuścopadāḥ puraḥ ।।2.230.50।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca tataḥ sarvānabhojayat prabhuḥ svayam ।
miṣṭānnāni vicitrāṇi rasān peyāni yānyapi ।।5 1 ।।
bhakṣyabhojyānyanekāni bhojayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।
svayaṃ sububhuje kṛṣṇastataḥ sabhāṃ cakāra ha ।।52।।
avabhṛthārthaṃ prayayuḥ sarve bhagavatā saha ।
āsaँstatra tu nārīṇāṃ devīnāṃ gītikā śubhāḥ ।।।53।।
vādyānāṃ ninadāścāpi vedaghoṣāśca bhūsadām ।
āmrajānyāṃ gonikaṣāsaṃgame'vabhathaṃ tadā ।।54।।
cakrurmukhyaṃ mahāsnānaṃ varuṇādyarcanaṃ tathā ।
ye ye yatrā'bhavaँścāpi tatra sasnuśca tatra ca ।।55।।
tūpaśabdā yantraśabdāḥ śatadhnīdhvanayo'bhavan ।
saritsāgarasaṃyoge saritāṃ saṃgame tathā ।।56 ।।
vimānairdivyayānaiśca gatvā sasnuḥ prajājanāḥ ।
īśvarāścāpi devādyā dehinaḥ sasnurityapi ।।57।।
tataścāyayurāvāsān śrīharyādyā vimānakaiḥ ।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ pitṛśrāddhāni cācaran ।।58।।
sarve'pi pitarastatra mūrtimantaḥ samāgatāḥ ।
tṛptiṃ prāpya vimānaiśca yayuḥ svargaṃ sahasraśaḥ ।।59।।
atha bhojanaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
sarve bubhujurmiṣṭānnaṃ punastatra sabhā'bhavat ।।2.230.60 ।।
vidāyaṃ śrīharistatra pradadau tu yathocitam ।
karmaṭhebhyaḥ karmakartṛbhyaśca sahāyivargiṇe ।।6 1।।
muktebhyaśceśvarebhyaścā'vatārebhyaśca śobhanam ।
īśvarāṇībhya evāpi muktānībhyastathā dadau ।।62।।
devībhyo devatābhyaścā''rṣībhyo munibhya ityapi ।
mānavībhyo manuṣyebhyo maharṣibhyo'pi sandadau ।।63।।
jaḍebhyaścetanebhyaśca sarvebhyo'pi dadau hariḥ ।
yathocitaṃ vidāyaṃ vai kalpayoṣidbhya ityapi ।।64।।
karmakartrībhya evāpi dāsadāsībhya ityapi ।
pradadau svarṇahārāँśca svarṇamudrāyathocitāḥ ।।65।।
āgantavyaṃ ceti punaryadā yajñe smarāmyaham ।
ityevaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha tato labdhvā vidāyakam ।।66।।
sabhāṃ vyasarjayat paścānmahīmānāḥ pratasthire ।
nijāँllokānpradeśāँśca grāmān sāyaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ ।।67।।
dvādaśyāmevamevāpi samājāḥ svagṛhān yayuḥ ।
rātrau śrībhagavānāste rājabhiḥ sevitaḥ sukham ।।68।।
brahmapriyādibhiścāpi kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ।
nidrāṃ viśrāntirūpāṃ cāvāpa prātarbubodha ca ।।69।।
trayodaśyāṃ māṃgalikairvādyādyairgītibhirhariḥ ।
kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛṣṇo niṣasāda varāsane ।।2.230.70 ।।
īśānapānaśiṣṭaśca rājā rājñī ca kanyakāḥ ।
hariṃ pūjayituṃ prātaścāyayuste tadā hareḥ ।।7 1 ।।
nīrājanāṃ pracakruśca pupūjuścandanādibhiḥ ।
brāhmīlyaḥ kanyakāścaikacatvāriṃśannṛpasya tu ।।72।।
varamālāṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe daduḥ kāntaṃ hariṃ vyadhuḥ ।
rājā tvatiprasanno'bhūd yautakaṃ paramaṃ dadau ।।73।।
rājñī cāpi kṛtakṛtyā hyabhūt tatra mumoda ha ।
yautakaṃ haraye prādāt svarṇarūpyadhanādikam ।।74।।
vimānaṃ cāyataṃ cāpi dāsān dāsīḥ śatā'dhikāḥ ।
rājā mahotsavaṃ cakre kanyādānanimittataḥ ।।75।।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dadau rājā'tibhāvataḥ ।
anyebhyaścāpi sarvebhyo rājabhyo bhojanaṃ dadau ।।76।।
vidāyaṃ pradadau paścād rājabhyo nṛpatirmahān ।
rājānaḥ prayayurnaijān deśān vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।।77।।
tatra tāvat trayodaśyāṃ śrīmān rāyapatirnṛpaḥ ।
rāyagirarṣisahitaḥ prārthayāmāsa keśavam ।।78।।
nijadeśaṃ samāgantuṃ pāvayituṃ nijāṃ purīm ।
haristathā'stviti prāha viśvakarmādikāँstataḥ ।।79।।
sarvayajñīyavastūnāṃ parihārārthameva ha ।
maṇḍapādikadivyānāṃ samādideśa tūrṇakam ।।2.230.80।।
śīghraṃ sāyaṃ viśvakarmā tirobhāvayadeva tat ।
atha sajjo'bhavat kṛṣṇaḥ kuṭumbādyairyutastadā ।।8 1।।
śaṃkarādyaiḥ pārṣadaiśca tathā sarvamaharṣibhiḥ ।
tāvad rājā sainyayukto vidāye mānane hareḥ ।।82।।
avādayattadā ramyavāditrāṇi muhurmuhuḥ ।
hariḥ sammānamādāya puṣpahārān śubhān śubhān ।।83।।
brāhmīlībhiścākṣatādyairvardhitaḥ pūjito hariḥ ।
jayaśabdaiḥ śrāvitaścā''ruroha svavimānakam ।।84।।
kuṭumbena saha kṛṣṇo maharṣiśaṃkarādibhiḥ ।
vimānago'bhavaccātha prasasārāmbare'gragam ।।85।।
vidāyayantraśabdāścā'bhavaँścāti nṛpājñayā ।
rājārāyapatiścāgre vimānena yayau drutam ।।86।।
svāgatārthaṃ harestatra sainyaṃ prāsajjayad drutam ।
ārṣajatanurāṣṭre sve parīnāsaritastaṭe ।।87।।
vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ vai mahodyāne viśālake ।
sammānārthaṃ sainyayutastasthau rājā samālikaḥ ।।88।।
tāvadākāśamārgādvai vimānaṃ śobhanaṃ tadā ।
sūryavaccā''gataṃ śīghraṃ dyotayan vidiśo diśaḥ ।।89।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāstathā'bhavan ।
paryaḥ samantato vīkṣaṇārthaṃ dudruvurādarāt ।।2.230.90।।
rājadarśitamārgeṇa vimānaṃ śrīharirbhuvi ।
udyānamadhye bhūbhāge'vātārayacchannaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
harirvimānataḥ śīghraṃ tvagrabhāge bahiryayau ।।9 1।।
janānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirvai vimānopari cābhavat ।
akṣatādyairvardhitaśca prajābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।92।।
rājā svarṇasrajaḥ kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇasyā'dhānnanāma ca ।
tadā rājñī puṣpamālāṃ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nyadhānmudā ।।93।।
kumārāśca kumāryaścandanādyairarhaṇāṃ vyadhuḥ ।
siṃhāsane niṣasāda haristatra kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।94।।
datvā svadarśanaṃ siṃhāsanāttūtthāya catvare ।
āyayau nṛpatistaṃ sugaje śṛṃgārite mudā ।।95।।
kuṭumbaṃ śrīhareścāpi nyaṣādayad gajādiṣu ।
śakaṭīṣu ca vāheṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ।।96।।
śibikāsu tathā divyagantrīṣu ca nyaṣādayat ।
atha vādyādininadairgītibhiśca suvardhitaḥ ।।97।।
harṣanādairjayaśabdaistathā gāyanakīrtanaiḥ ।
vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ śrīhariḥ saṃbhrāmito'bhitaḥ ।।98।।
gopurāgre ca rājanyairnagaryāṃ ca pradhānakaiḥ ।
catvareṣu prajābhiśca haṭṭāgre dhanikaiḥ prabhuḥ ।।99।।
pūjitaścāpi rathyāgre yoṣidbhiḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
svarṇamudrādidānaiśca nārikelaphalādibhiḥ ।। 2.230.100।।
vastrapātravibhūṣābhiścandanā'kṣatavāribhiḥ ।
vardhitaścābhitaḥ puryāṃ bhramitvā sainyaśobhitaḥ ।। 10 1।।
samāyayau śubhāvāsaṃ rājasaudhaṃ haristataḥ ।
jalapānaṃ vidhāyaiva viśrāntimāpa dharmapaḥ ।। 1 02।।
gṛhītvā bhojanaṃ rātrau nidrāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ ।
brahmapriyādibhiḥ saṃsevitaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 03।।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āmrajānyādisaptasaritsu devatīrthānāṃ vāso māhātmyamavabhṛtham, pāritoṣikam, rātriyāpanaṃ, prātarvidāyaṃ mahīmānamaṇḍapādiparihārastato rājārāyapatirāṣṭragamanaṃ vyenojarāśāpuryāṃ bhramaṇaṃ bhojanaṃ rātrau śayanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 230 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 230 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 231
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 232 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
caturdaśyāḥ prage rādhe āśvinakṛṣṇapakṣake ।
māṃgalikaistūryanādairgītibhiḥ prabubodha saḥ ।। 1 ।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ kṛtasnānapūjaḥ svāsanamāviśat ।
rājārāyapatiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitumupāyayau ।। 2 ।।
nanāma pādayorbhaktyā'bhiṣekaṃ payasā tadā ।
pādayoḥ pracakārā'tha prasādā'mṛtamāpapau ।। 3 ।।
sakuṭumbaḥ śrīpatiṃ taṃ cāndanaṃ tilakaṃ vyadhāt ।
sacandrakaṃ tathā ramyanetrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadau ।। 4 ।।
mukuṭaṃ mastake cāpi kuṇḍale karṇayordadau ।
kaṇṭhe suvarṇaratnāḍhyahārān praśṛṃkhalāṃ dadau ।। 5 ।।
bhujabandhau ca kaṭakāvaṅgulīyakamūrmikāḥ ।
raśanāṃ nūpūrakau ca kaṭyāṃ pādaprakoṣṭhayoḥ ।। 6 ।।
nidhārayāmāsa rājā bhagavantaṃ ramāpatim ।
sugandhigandhasārādi vyalepayattadā'ṅgake ।। 7 ।।
yathocitaṃ puṣpahārān pradadau ca sugandhinaḥ ।
rājaveṣaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ dhārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।। 8 ।।
harirdadhāra pramudā rājñaḥ snehābhivṛddhaye ।
tato nīrājanaṃ cakre rājā rājñīsamanvitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kanyāścāsya trayastriṃśan mahānīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
varamālā dadurmugdhā bālakṛṣṇasya vakṣasi ।। 2.231.1 0।।
patiṃ prāpya prabheśaṃ tāḥ kṛtakṛtyāstadā'bhavan ।
rājā taṃ kānake siṃhāsane ramye nṛpārcite ।। 1 1।।
niṣādya śrīhareḥ rājyamukuṭaṃ mastake dadau ।
rājyaṃ ca kanyakāḥ kṛṣṇa! mokṣārthaṃ te pradīyate ।। 1 2।।
ata ārabhya rājyaṃ te vayaṃ te dāsadāsikāḥ ।
atraiva bhagavaँstiṣṭha kṛpāsindho parātpara ।। 1 3।।
tvamātmā tvaṃ tvantarātmā paramātmā prabhurmataḥ ।
sarvaprāṇapate viṣṇo pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ।। 14।।
bhavaddattaṃ mayā rājyaṃ nirvāhitaṃ makhāvadhi ।
atha śrībhagavān svāmī samāyāto dhuraṃ vaha ।। 15।।
tvannideśaṃ pālayiṣye bhṛtyavat tiṣṭha rājyapaḥ ।
anāyāsena bhagavān kṛpayā'smābhirarjitaḥ ।। 16।।
yogino yasya labdhyarthaṃ tapaḥsu kṛcchrasādhiṣu ।
homaṃ nijāyuṣaḥ prakurvantyapi tvaṃ na cāpyase ।। 17।।
siddhāḥ samādhibhājo'pi satataṃ tvāmupāsate ।
sākṣāttathāpi tvaṃ teṣāmakṣidṛśyo na jāyase ।। 18।।
so'yaṃ vinā tapo me'tra gṛhe'nugrahataḥ prabho ।
samāgato mamoddhārakṛte kuṭumbinaśca me ।। 1 9।।
sarvaṃ samarpya te haste kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmi tat ।
gṛhāṇa bhagavan dattaṃ rājyaṃ me mokṣamarpaya ।। 2.231.20।।
mayā jñāto divyarūpastathā mānuṣavartanaḥ ।
avatārāvatārī tvaṃ śrutyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 21 ।।
brahmapriyāpate tvaṃ vai sāṃkhyayoginikāpate ।
lākṣmaṇīkānta kṛṣṇa tvaṃ cāraktānāṃ pate'va mām ।।22।।
uṣṇonāṃ kānta kṛṣṇa tvaṃ piśaṃgīnāṃ pate prabho ।
prācīnīnāṃ pate kṛṣṇa hāritīnāṃ pate'va mām ।।23।।
gaurīṇāṃ kānta bhagavannamarīṇāṃ pate vibho ।
brāhmīlīnāṃ parīṇāṃ ca pate rādhāpate'va mām ।।24।।
lakṣmīpate kṛpāsindho ramāsvāmin satāṃ pate ।
rājapate surādīnāṃ pate ceśapate'va mām ।।25।।
kamalā caraṇau te yā sevate lalitā'pi yau ।
bahupuṇyena militau putrīṇāṃ mama keśava ।।26।।
sevate duḥkhahālakṣmīrjayā yau maṃjulā ca yau ।
nārāyaṇī sadguṇā yau tau divyau militau mama ।।27।।
māṇikyā sevate yau ca muktā yau sevate sakhī ।
padmāvatī satī hāsā sevate yau pramuktidau ।।28।।
catvāriṃśat śataṃ cāpi tathā'parāstu koṭiśaḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinyastava dāsyo bhavanti hi ।। 29।।
īśvarā avatārāśca muktā devā maharṣayaḥ ।
caraṇau yau prasevante te kṛpāplāvitā yadi ।।2.231.3 0।।
tau suprāptau mayā kṛṣṇa caraṇau pāvanau gṛhe ।
yatra sarvārpaṇaṃ pūrve rājānaścakrurātmanaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
āsāditau mayā tau vai tato'rpaye'va māṃ vibho ।
mahākālabhayaṃ māyābhayaṃ karmaprabandhanam ।।32।।
dūrayituṃ samarthaṃ netarat tato bhaje'va mām ।
śaraṇāgatarakṣa tvaṃ śaraṇyo'si janārdana ।।।33।।
bhavapravāhapatitaṃ māmuddhara maheśvara ।
tava yogena divyaṃ me rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanādikam ।।34।।
tīrtharūpaṃ mahajjātaṃ dhāmā'kṣarasamaṃ bhuvi ।
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ rājārāyasya bhūtale ।।35।।
yadgṛhe kanyakākāntaḥ svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ parīnāsarito'pi ca ।।36।।
yatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi samāyānti te balāt ।
ārṣajatanturāṣṭrasya mahābhāgyaṃ pravartate ।।37।।
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvartate parameśvaraḥ ।
vyenojarāśānagarī tavopasthititaḥ prabho ।।38।।
sārthakā'dya tu sañjātā sarvapāpavināśinī ।
mṛtyujarādirahitā tava vāsādajāyata ।।39।।
sadā tiṣṭha hare'cātra kariṣye tava sevanam ।
ityuktvā śrīhareścā'gre daṇḍavat pracakāra ha ।।2.231.40।।
rādhike sā tato rājñī cakāra daṇḍavaddharim ।
mahotsavaṃ tataścakre caturdaśyāṃ mahattamam ।।41।।
prajāḥ pradhānā nāryaśca narāḥ samantatastadā ।
āyayurdarśanārtha vai dūrātidūradeśataḥ ।।42।।
tebhyo harirdadau mantrān sukhaṃ darśanajaṃ tathā ।
mānasānāṃ nijamūrtāvākarṣaṇena sarvathā ।।43।।
bhagavadbhāvanāṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa śāśvatīm ।
tatkṛtāṃ suprapūjāṃ ca jagrāha parameśvaraḥ ।।44।।
tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ datvā toṣayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।
divyaṃ svadarśanaṃ cāpi pradadau pārameśvaram ।।45।।
akṣarasya tathā golokasthaṃ vaikuṇṭhagaṃ tathā ।
avyākṛtasthaṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ cāmṛtasthaṃ tathā vibhuḥ ।।46।।
hiraṇmayaṃ tathā vahnimaṇḍalasthaṃ tathā punaḥ ।
viśālāsthaṃ śvetadhāmagataṃ kṣīrābdhivāsinam ।।47।।
tathā kuṃkumavāpīsthaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ ca gocaram ।
evaṃ tvanekarūpairvai pareśaṃ svamadarśayat ।।48।।
tena te kṛtakṛtyā vai narā nāryo'bhavaँstadā ।
tebhyo mantrān dadau śrīmatsvāmiśrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।।49।।
rājā prapūjya deveśaṃ bhojayāmāsa vai tataḥ ।
paryaḥ sarvāḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ paryasevanta taṃ patim ।।।2.231.50 ।।
hariḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ mama rājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
tvayā'rpitaṃ mayā labdhaṃ punardadāmi te nṛpa ।।।51 ।।
mamājñayā mahadrājyaṃ prapālaya yathocitam ।
dṛḍhaṃ ca mandiraṃ sāptaśikharaṃ saṃprakāraya ।।।52।।
tatra māṃ śrīsametaṃ vai pratiṣṭhāpaya kānakam ।
svarṇamūrtau sadā sthāsye grahiṣye ca tvayā kṛtam ।।53।।
pūjanaṃ sarvadā rājan mamājñāṃ paripālaya ।
tathā'stviti nṛpaḥ prāha rādhike drutameva ha ।।54।।
suvarṇamūrtiṃ tatraiva kārayāmāsa sannidhau ।
śrīsahitāṃ tatra kṛṣṇo viveśa gocaraḥ svayam ।।55।।
rājā gṛhe rarakṣaiva tataḥ kālena mandire ।
nyaveśayaddhariṃ caivaṃ siṣeve paramādarāt ।।56।।
caturdaśyāṃ ca madhyāhne bhojayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।
sāyakāle pitṛpūjāṃ parīnāsaritastaṭe ।।57।।
śrāddhāni vividhānyeva cakāra bhagavān svayam ।
pitṝṇāṃ jalapiṇḍādyaistṛptiṃ cakāra keśavaḥ ।।58।।
tataḥ sandhyāṃ pracakāra tataḥ saudhaṃ samāyayau ।
rātrau kanyāstu tāḥ sarvāḥ patiṃ naijaṃ siṣevire ।।59।।
prātarhariḥ prabubodha māṃgalikapragītibhiḥ ।
pravādyaiśca yaśobhiśca tataḥ sasnau nadījalaiḥ ।।2.231.6 0।।
amāvāsyādine pitṛjaladānaṃ cakāra ha ।
plakṣamūle dadau vāri sarvasṛṣṭibhya eva saḥ ।।6 1 ।।
āgatāḥ pitarastatra tṛptyarthaṃ harihastataḥ ।
muktā akṣarasaṃjñāśca golokāvāsagopakāḥ ।।6 2।।
pārṣadā vaikuṇṭhavāsā avyākṛtanivāsinaḥ ।
amṛtasthāstathā muktā anyavaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।63 ।।
satyasthā brāhmasaṃjñāśca siddhā maharṣayastathā ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā munayo devatādayaḥ ।।64।।
aryamādyāśca pitaro mātṛkāḥ pitṛyoṣitaḥ ।
tathānye yāmyalokasthāstrilokisthāśca sarvataḥ ।।65।।
tṛptyarthaṃ tvāyayustatra nārāyaṇajalecchayā ।
śrīhariṃ svakarābhyāmañjalibhiḥ salilaṃ dadau ।।66।।
papuḥ sarve'pi pitaro muktiṃ gatāśca mokṣiṇaḥ ।
sthāninastṛptimāpuśca jagmurnijaṃ svarādikam ।।67।।
sarve tṛptiṃ gatā ye ye pitṛyonisthitāstadā ।
atha śrībhagavān svasyālayaṃ saudhaṃ samāyayau ।।68।।
pitṛśrāddhāni vividhaprakārāṇi tato'karot ।
piṇḍadānaiḥ pāyasādyaiḥ kṣīrānnabhojanādibhiḥ ।।69।।
phalapuṣpaudanādyaiḥ śarkarādyairmiṣṭasadrasaiḥ ।
sudhāmiṣṭānnakaiścāpi munyannaistānatarpayat ।।2.231.70।।
śrāddhāni vidhinā kṛtvā parihāraṃ tato'karot ।
prāsādikāni bhojyāni bhojayāmāsa vāḍavān ।।7 1 ।।
dīnā'nāthān kṛpaṇāṃśca satīḥ sādhvī sato yatīn ।
āśritān kanyakāścāpi kumārān karmacāriṇaḥ ।।72।।
bhaktān sarvāṃśca bhṛtyān saṃbhojayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ।
rājñaśca rājavargāśca vaiśyān sevāparāyaṇān ।।73।।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān sa rājā'pyājñayā hareḥ ।
bubhuje tatprasādānnaṃ madhyāhnottarameva tu ।।74।।
hariḥ sabhāṃ sumahatīṃ cakre tūpādideśa vai ।
gṛhasthaiḥ sarvadā mātā sevanīyā pitā tathā ।।75।।
guruśca sevanīyo'tha tadājñāyāṃ yathocitam ।
sthātavyaṃ manasā vāṇyā dehena ca dhanena ca ।।76 ।।
daśaśrotrīyasadṛśaścaikopādhyāya ucyate ।
daśopādhyāyasadṛśaḥ pitā loke mahān mataḥ ।।77।।
mātā daśaguṇī śreṣṭhā pituḥ putraprapālinī ।
mātrā dhṛtaḥ sa garbhe vai bālye'pi sevitastathā ।।78।।
yauvane yojitaḥ patnyā tasmānmātā garīyasī ।
gururdaśaguṇo māturgarīyān jñānado mataḥ ।।79।।
janmamṛtyujarāho yo vāsanābandhanāśanaḥ ।
pāpanāśakaraḥ pūjyo gururjīvasya mokṣakṛt ।।2.231.80।।
mātā pitā gururmānyāḥ pūjanīyā hitaiṣubhiḥ ।
trayaste pūjitā yena tasya smṛddhirna riṣyati ।।81 ।।
trayaste devarūpā vai trayo'gnayaśca te matāḥ ।
teṣāṃ sevā kṛtā yena prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ śubham ।।82।।
bhartsanīyā na te putraistāḍanīyā na vai kvacit ।
udvejanīyā nā'pyatra poṣaṇīyāstrayo'pi te ।।83 ।।
mātaraṃ yaḥ prakuryādvai pradakṣiṇāṃ namastathā ।
tena pradakṣiṇā pṛthvyāḥ kṛtā syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।84।।
pitā saṃpūjito yena viṣṇustena prapūjitaḥ ।
guruśca pūjito yena tenārcitāḥ surādayaḥ ।।85।।
tebhyo deyaṃ yathāśakti dhanamannaṃ tathā'mbaram ।
yadyadyogyaṃ tathā'pekṣyaṃ tattaddeyaṃ hi sarvathā ।।86।।
vṛthā kliśyanti tīrtheṣu yeṣāṃ tīrthatrayaṃ gṛhe ।
trayāṇāṃ sevayā sarvādhvarapuṇyaṃ bhaved dhruvam ।।87।।
trayāśīrvādalābhena yāmyāḥ prayānti dūrataḥ ।
lakṣmyaḥ sarvavidhāstasya gṛhe tvāyānti cānyataḥ ।।88।।
trayaste pitaraḥ proktāḥ sajīvāḥ sevanāya vai ।
atraite sevitā yena paraloko'sya śobhanaḥ ।।89।।
ete duḥkhīkṛtā yena sa duḥkhī syātparatra ca ।
putrādibhiḥ sevitāśca tṛptā mṛtyuṃ prayānti ye ।।2.231.90 ।।
pitaraste bhaveyurvai muktāḥ svargādigāminaḥ ।
pretatvaṃ nahi teṣāṃ vai naiva kanīyasī gatiḥ ।।9 1।।
na janma duḥkhakṛt teṣāṃ prasannā ye mṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।
aprasannā duḥkhitāśca mṛtiṃ gatāśca ye janāḥ ।।92।।
krūrabhāvā hi te vaṃśyasthānāṃ raktaṃ pibanti vai ।
teṣāṃ sadgatilābhārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ dadyāt sutādibhiḥ ।।93।।
vaṃśe vighnāni naśyeyurvaṃśavṛddhirbhavet tathā ।
adya kṛtaṃ pradattaṃ ca śrāddhamannaṃ jalaṃ phalam ।। 94।।
svargaṃ prayāti yatraiva santi pitara eva ha ।
tṛpyanti pitarastatra gṛhītvā sukhinaḥ sadā ।।95।।
tasmācchrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣasiddhaye ।
tannāmnā'nnaṃ jalaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ pāyasamityapi ।। 96।।
śayyā pātrāṇi dhānyāni rasā deyā viśeṣataḥ ।
bhojanāni pradeyāni pitṛtṛptyarthakāni hi ।।97।।
tīrtheṣu satsu pātreṣu deyaṃ śaktyā yathocitam ।
svarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ tāmraṃ dhanaṃ deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 98।।
vāhanaṃ yānamevāpi yadāsīttasya vai priyam ।
tattaddeyaṃ hi pātrāya tatpuṇyaṃ syādanantakam ।।99।।
ityuktvā virarāmātha prajāḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire ।
dhanānnāmbarapātrādyaiścandanākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ ।। 2.231.100 ।।
tato dhanaṃ viśeṣeṇā''gataṃ pūjātmakaṃ tu yat ।
rājagirarṣaye kṛṣṇaḥ pradadau dānarūpakam ।। 10 1।।
rātrau nidrāṃ ca viśrāntiṃ prāpa gopālanandanaḥ ।
rādhike sevitaḥ sarvapriyābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 02।।
prātarmaṃgalavādyaiśca nārīṇāṃ gītibhistathā ।
prabubodha harikṛṣṇo dhyānaṃ svahṛdaye'karot ।। 103 ।।
kṛtasnānādikaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtagurustavaḥ ।
niṣasādā''sane divye tāvad rājā samāyayau ।। 1 04।।
kṛtavān sa mahāpūjāṃ śrīhareścandanādibhiḥ ।
pāyasaṃ pāyayāmāsa mahīmānān samastakān ।। 1 05।।
rājñī pūjāṃ cakārāpi pupūjuśca tataḥ prajāḥ ।
rājā ceyeṣa nagarāntarāṇi netumacyutam ।। 10 6।।
haristathā'stviti prāha sadyaḥ sajjo babhūva ha ।
rādhike svavimānastho'bhavat saha kuṭumbakaiḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ pūjanamupadeśanam pitṛśrāddhadānavāridānādikamamāvāsyāyāṃ kṛtvā rātrau viśramyā''śvinaśuklapratipadi prātaḥ
pūjanādikaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 231 ।।
