adhyāyaḥ 232
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 233 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike cāśvinaśuklapratipadvāsare prage ।
rājārāyanṛpoktyā śrīhariḥ sajjo babhūva ha ।। 1 ।।
khaṇḍarāṣṭrātmake rājye lāpalātrīpurīṃ yayau ।
samudrataṭavāsinyā nagaryāścopasāgare ।। 2 ।।
mahodyāne dvīpakalpe mandire samavātarat ।
rājā pupūja kanakairyautakairvividhairapi ।। 3 ।।
hīrakaiḥ ratnavaryaiśca mauktikairmaṇibhistathā ।
nagaryāṃ vādyaghoṣaiśca mahāsammānapūrvakam ।। 4 ।।
rājārāyanṛpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।
haristatra mahodyāne kṛtasevaḥ kṛtaśramaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kṛtārāmaḥ samuvāca dinadvayaṃ praśāntaye ।
āśvinasya tṛtīyāyāṃ daityo vai navajīvanaḥ ।। 6 ।।
māyāvī bahuvegaśca mahādritulyavigrahaḥ ।
samākarṣan bahūnmeghān keśairmastakasaṃbhavaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
gadayā vidyuto vegān saṃnighnan bahusattvayā ।
ākāśaṃ garjayan hāsyaiḥ samudraṃ kṣobhayannakhaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
gṛhāṇicchādayan dehasthaulyena niśi cāyayau ।
jñātvā divyaṃ vimānaṃ sa hastaikyenāpyatolayat ।। 9 ।।
rudro vijñāya daityaṃ taṃ garjanāṃ pracakāra ha ।
ko'yaṃ vimānaṃ spṛśati gaccha dūraṃ mṛto'si vā ।। 2.232.10 ।।
śrutvaitad vyanadacchīghraṃ prāṭṭahāsaṃ mumoca ha ।
gadayā sahito vyomni garjan jagāda bhītikṛt ।। 11 ।।
kastvaṃ vimānabhūpo'si vimānaṃ kasya vā vada ।
ahaṃ neṣye vimānaṃ vā yuddhārthaṃ bhava cittavān ।। 12।।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha mā yuddhaṃ samiccha yāhi dūrataḥ ।
yuddhe te nāsti vai śreyo vimānaṃ muñca satvaram ।। 13 ।।
daityaḥ prāha vinā yuddhaṃ vijayo na bhavediha ।
neṣye vimānaṃ sarvāśca hariṣye yoṣitastvitaḥ ।। 14।।
ityuktvā gadayā rudraṃ tatāḍa mūrdhni vegataḥ ।
śaṃkaro vegavān śīghraṃ śūlena tāṃ bibheda ha ।। 15।।
gadā bhagnā hi daityasya samudre patitā yadā ।
tāvat samudravelāstu jalaplutāstadā'bhavan ।। 16 ।।
atha vai gadayā śūnyo daityaḥ kṣobhamavāpa ha ।
kiṃ kṛtvā cāpi kiṃ hṛtvā vidravāmītyacintayat ।। 17।।
rājasaudhe mahodyāne rājārāyanṛpasya vai ।
kaniṣṭhā bhaginī yā''sīt suptā mātrā samaṃ tu tām ।। 18।।
uttolya ca nidhāyaiva skandhe vyomagato'bhavat ।
vidyunmaṇiḥ rurodāti kumārī daityavāhitā ।। 1 9।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt trāhi trāhīti nādinām ।
mānavānāṃ ninādā vai sabhayāstvabhavaँstadā ।। 2.232.2 0।।
rājārāyapatiḥ śrutvā prabubodha kṣaṇāntare ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpyutthito'bhavat ।।2 1 ।।
prajāḥ prabubudhuścāpi kolāhalasamanvitāḥ ।
mahīmānā yoṣitaśconnidrā jātāḥ samantataḥ ।। 22।।
vṛttāntaṃ śaṃkareṇoktaṃ kanyāmādāya daityarāṭ ।
navajīvananāmā vai drutaṃ dhāvati cāmbare ।। 23।।
eṣa nātidūrago'sti tvambare yāti paścime ।
māraṇīyo mayā kṛṣṇa tavā''jñāṃ prāpya sarvathā ।।24।।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha rājārāyapatirnṛpaḥ ।
mātovāca tadā'pyevaṃ tubhyaṃ dattā hi kanyakā ।।25।।
rakṣa rakṣa mahākṛṣṇa rakṣa śīghraṃ nivāraya ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tu rājānaṃ vimānaṃ sajjamāviśan ।।।26।
eṣa prayāmi rakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ vimāne'tra me śubhe ।
yadvā tava vimāne'tra mātrā sahānuyāhi mām ।। 27।।
evamuktvā hariḥ śīghraṃ paścimāṃ kakubhaṃ prati ।
daityasyā'nujagāmaiva śīghraṃ kuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ ।।28।।
rājā'pi svavimānaṃ vai tatpaścād bhṛtyasevitaḥ ।
vegenā'vāhayad vyomni sūryatulyo'nugo'bhavat ।।29।।
harervimānaṃ vīkṣyaiva tathā rājavimānakam ।
daityo bhayena dudrāva vyomni kanyāyuto'pi san ।।2.232.3 0।।
vāyuvegena laghunā varṣmaṇā coḍḍito'bhavat ।
samudropari dudrāva rātrau sahasrayojanam ।।3 1।।
vimānaṃ śrīhareḥ paścād rājño vimānamityapi ।
anvadhāvaddhi vegena dhartuṃ taṃ daityapuṃgavam ।।32।।
daityo'pi bahuvegena dudrāvā''prātareva ha ।
tāvad dvīpaḥ samāyātaḥ samudrāntargato mahān ।।3 2।।
navajīvanadaip-yaścā'pyavātatāra tāṃ bhuvam ।
śatayojanavistīrṇo dvedhā bhinnāṃ jalāntarām ।।34।।
prākāranagarīśobhāṃ daityalainyabhayaṃkarām ।
rājasaudhādiśobhāḍhyāṃ daityāvāsamayīṃ purīm ।।35।।।
śīghraṃ praviśya daityo vai nanardā'nyān nyabodhayat ।
bherīṃ pratāḍayāmāsa yuddhāvedanakāriṇīm ।।36।।
śrutvā jarāmahānādaṃ daityā jagarjurutsukāḥ ।
yodhanārthe dhṛtaśastrā nirjagmuḥ parvatā iva ।।37।।
navajīvo'pie śīghraṃ tāṃ kanyāṃ nikṣipya gahvare ।
yodhanārtha tvājagāma daityasainyasamanvitaḥ ।।38।।।
śrīhariryauvanaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā cakraṃ sudarśanam ।
yayau tadgahvaraṃ kanyāṃ nināya svavimānake ।।39।।
anyā māyāmayīṃ kanyāṃ kṛtvā mṛdā yathātatham ।
nikṣipya gahvare sarva daityamohakarīṃ prabhuḥ ।।2.232.40 ।।
yathārthā bhaginīṃ rājñe tvarpayāmāsa vai drutam ।
daityāstvetadajānanto yuddhāyā'bhyapatan balāt ।।41 ।।
kanyābhrātrā ca mātrā sā kṛṣgā'rpaṇaṃ niveditā ।
hareḥ kaṇṭhe karaṃ datvā patiṃ vavre vimānake ।।41।।
karamālāṃ varamālāṃ pragṛhya kṛṣṇakāminī ।
abhavat sā tataḥ śrīmān bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।43।।
īśānāya dadāvājñāṃ hantuṃ daityānmṛdhe tadā ।
śaṃkaro drāk jaṭāṃ krodhād vikīrya gaṇanāyakān ।।44।।
daśalakṣānasṛjattu rudrarūpān bhayaṃkarān ।
saṃkalpajanyahetīṃśca yoddhumājñāṃ dadau tadā ।।45।।
utplutyotplutya daityāँste nijaghnurvai triśūlakaiḥ ।
āmadhyāhnaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ daityanāśakaraṃ hyabhūt ।।46।।
sarve daityā vinaṣṭāśca viṃśatilakṣasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt strīṇāṃ prarodanānyapi ।।47।।
dayāluḥ śrībālakṛṣṇastāsāṃ sukhāptaye gaṇān ।
ājñāṃ cakāra taddeśe nivāsārthaṃ gṛhāśrame ।।48।।
sarvāsāṃ daityapatnīnāṃ pāṇigrahān vyadhurgaṇāḥ ।
śāṃkarāste sutāḥ sarve vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇanoditāḥ ।।49।।
tāṃ tāṃ patnīṃ samagṛhya tattaddeśagṛhāṇi vai ।
yayuḥ sarve gaṇāstatra rājānaṃ kāmanāyakam ।।2.232.50।।
kāmanāyakanāmānaṃ gaṇaṃ cakāra mādhavaḥ ।
abhiṣicya mahadrājye gaṇakoṭiṃ tathā dadau ।।5 1 ।।
mahotsavaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā vallīliṅgapuraṃ prabhuḥ ।
bhramitvā śrīhariḥ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ pracakāra ha ।।52।।
tato vimānamāruhya samullaṃghya ca khāḍikām ।
dinediṣṭhāṃ purīṃ gatvā bhramitvā'tha gaṇeśvarān ।।53।।
vāsayitvā tatkṛtāṃ supūjāṃ labdhvā pareśvaraḥ ।
rājānaṃ bhojanaṃ kartumājñāṃ pradāya māpatiḥ ।।।।54।।
militvā svavimāne vai bhojanāni harirdadau ।
vaimānikebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sāyaṃ datvā'bhayaṃ dhanam ।।55।।
dvinediṣṭhapure rājasaudhe niśāmuvāsa saḥ ।
āśvinaśuklapañcamyāṃ prage nidrāṃ vihāya ca ।।56।।
śrīhariḥ svavimānena vīkṣya dvīpaṃ samantataḥ ।
rājānaṃ tanmātaraṃ ca sasainyaṃ gantumeva tu ।।57।।
nijarājyaṃ samājñāpya tataḥ kuṭumbasaṃyutaḥ ।
harirvimānamāruhya mahīmānasamanvitaḥ ।।58।।
vyomamārgeṇa vai śīghraṃ samullaṃghya tu vāridhim ।
trāsamānadvīpamāyāt hambārtanagarīṃ prati ।।59।।
vaimānikā hi madhyāhne jagṛhurbhojanāni vai ।
tato maharṣayo bhaktā uṣṇālayapradeśajāḥ ।।2.232.60।।
pūrvaṃ prarakṣitāste tu darśanārthaṃ vimānakaiḥ ।
samāyayurharisteṣāṃ svāgatāni vyadhānmudā ।।6 1 ।।
pūjāṃ labdhvā''śiṣo datvā vimānena harirdrutam ।
samudraṃ tu samullaṃghya allālīnagarīṃ yayau ।।6 2।।
uṣṇālaye bhūśiraso bhāge vandārukālaye ।
uṣitvā rajanīṃ tvekāṃ prātaḥ kṛtvā prabhojanam ।।63 ।।
vṛndārukarṣiṇā prātaḥ kṛtapūjo narāyaṇaḥ ।
samutthāya yayau vimānena kuṭumbaśobhitaḥ ।।64।।
uttarasyāṃ tu kāṣṭhāyāṃ pañcāśadyojanāntare ।
sthitaṃ siṃhalanāmānaṃ dvīpaṃ prāpā'bdhimadhyagam ।।65।।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ kṛtvoḍḍīya vimānago hariḥ ।
sāyaṃ pampāsaraḥ prāpya rātriṃ tīre nināya ca ।।66।।
saptamyāṃ vai tataḥ prātarvimānamadhiruhya ca ।
gopanārthaṃ nijaṃ tīrthaṃ saurāṣṭre tvāyayau prabhuḥ ।।67।।
madhyāhne gopanāthe tu kṛtvā pūjanabhojane ।
āśvinaśuklasaptamyāṃ sāyaṃkāle śanaiḥ prabhuḥ ।।68।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tvāyayau vyomamārgagaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpījanatāvirahārtāḥ pratīkṣaṇam ।।69।।
kurvantyaḥ kṛśatāṃ prāptā vinekṣāṃ śrīhareḥ sadā ।
tā narāḥ pramadā bālā bālikāḥ svāmisevakāḥ ।।2.232.70।।
vyomni tejaḥ samudāyaṃ vilokyā'supriyāgamam ।
pratarkyātimudā tvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāntike ।।71।।
mahodyāne dudruvuśca darśanārthaṃ samutsukāḥ ।
vimānaṃ tāvadevā'pi sannidhau samupāgatam ।।72।।
jayaśabdāstūryanādāḥ śaṃkhānāṃ dhvanayastathā ।
gītikā yoṣitāṃ cāpi samantādabhavaँstadā ।।73।।
kṣetrapālāśca tīrthāni devāstatra nivāsinaḥ ।
muktāstatheśvarāścāpyavatārāḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ।।74।।
maharṣayaśca rājanyā viprāḥ satyaśca sādhavaḥ ।
yoginaḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ santastathā vratasthitāḥ ।।75।।
akṣarabhūnivāsinyaḥ kanyakāśca kumārakāḥ ।
saubhāgyavatyo nāryaśca sarvamāṃgalikānvitāḥ ।।76।।
śīghraṃ prayayuḥ kṛṣṇasya svāgatārthaṃ sarontikam ।
lomaśāśramavāsāśca tathā''mravaṇavāsinaḥ ।।77।।
tāpasāḥ prayayuḥ kṛṣṇa āyāta iti harṣitāḥ ।
candanaṃ puṣpamālādi gandhākṣataphalāni ca ।।78।।
gandhasārān gṛhītvāpi tyaktvā kāryāṇi vai gṛhe ।
sīmni visṛjya kāryāṇi karṣukādyāstathā vane ।।79।।
vanakāryāṇi visṛjya vyāpārādi vaṇigjanāḥ ।
sarve drutaṃ yayuścā'śvapaṭṭasaro'bhi vai hareḥ ।।2.232.80।।
svāgatārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ yayustyaktvā nijālayān ।
harervimānaṃ tvaritaṃ tatra bhūmau hyavātarat ।।8 1 ।।
vardhitaṃ candanādyaiśca puṣpairakṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।
bhagavān śrīharistūrṇaṃ vimānāgre sthito'bhavat ।।82।।
darśanaṃ pradadau sarvajanebhyo vai samantataḥ ।
kuśalaṃ paripapraccha sarveṣāṃ snehapūritaḥ ।।83 ।।
sarve tvanāmayaṃ prāṇapateḥ papracchurutsukāḥ ।
tataḥ premāśrusahitā hariṃ cāśliṣya vai muhuḥ ।।84।।
puṣpahārān hareḥ kaṇṭhe nyadhuścandanakuṃkumaiḥ ।
akṣatādyairgandhasārairarhaṇaṃ vai tadā vyadhuḥ ।।85।।
puṃvargaḥ sampraṇanāma śrīmadgopālapādayoḥ ।
nārīvargaḥ praṇanāma kaṃbharāpādayormuhuḥ ।।86।।
gaṇavargaḥ praṇanāmeśānasya pādayostadā ।
yoginīmaṇḍalādyaṃ ca nanāma satīmīśvarīm ।।87।।
brahmapriyābhyaḥ sarvābhyo namaścakrurhi yoṣitaḥ ।
gaurīrhārītakīścāmarīśca vai brāhmilīstathā ।।88।।
nemire nūtanāḥ kṛṣṇavadhūrvai sarvayoṣitaḥ ।
atha vādyaiśca gītaiśca maṃgalairmandire hareḥ ।।89।।
prāveśayaddhariṃ tvārṣyaḥ kuṭumbasahitaṃ mudā ।
munayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve pūjāṃ cakruśca daṇḍavat ।।2.232.90 ।।
prajāścāgatya kuśalaṃ papracchurvirahāturāḥ ।
hariḥ kuśalamāpṛcchya śubhāṃ saṃbhāvanāṃ vyadhāt ।।9 1।।
kṛtakāryāṇi bhaktebhyastvāvedayanniśāmukhe ।
tataścotthāya prayayau snānasandhyākṛte prabhuḥ ।।92।।
vinirvartyā'rhaṇaṃ paścād bhojanāni vyadhāpayat ।
lomaśaṃ samprapūjyaiva śaṃkaraṃ pitarau tathā ।।93।।
maharṣīn yavakrītādīn bhojayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
brahmapriyāstathā kṛṣṇo bhojayāmāsa kanyakāḥ ।।94।।
sarvāḥ kāntā bhojayitvā lomaśasyā''śrame śubhe ।
sarvāstāḥ preṣayāmāsa brāhmīnāṃ maṇḍale tadā ।।95।।
bālakṛṣṇaśca divyāni sarvopakaraṇānyadāt ।
bahurūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇastābhyaḥ sukhaṃ dadau niśi ।।96।।
evaṃ vai rādhike pṛthvyāṃ sarvadeśeṣu sarvataḥ ।
sarvabhaktān pāvayitvā rājate'kṣarakṣetragaḥ ।।97।।
kuṃkumavāpikā dhanyā dhanyāstāḥ kanyakā api ।
dhanyā deśāśca te sākṣānnārāyaṇaprasaṃgagāḥ ।।98।।
imaṃ divyaṃ caritraṃ ye śroṣyanti bhuvi mānavāḥ ।
paṭhiṣyanti kīrtayiṣyantyapi bhāvabharā janāḥ ।।99।।
teṣāṃ pāpavināśaḥ syād bhuktiḥ śreṣṭhatamā'tra vai ।
muktiścā'nte'kṣaraloke syādevā'tra na saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.232.10 0।।
yajñānāṃ ca kathāṃ divyāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ।
bhaktānāṃ ca kathāṃ ke'pi kīrtayiṣyanti mānavāḥ ।। 101 ।।
teṣāṃ yajñaphalaṃ syācca smṛddhayaḥ syuśca tadgṛhe ।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ caritaṃ śrutvā''psyanti divaṃ param ।। 10 2।।
japayajñaphalaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ vrataphalaṃ tathā ।
sarvapūjāphalaṃ syācca śravaṇādasya bhāmini! ।। 103 ।।
etaddivyaṃ caritraṃ vai prathamaṃ pārameśvaram ।
pṛthvyāmabhūt sārvabhaumaṃ bhaviṣyantyaparāṇyapi ।। 1 04।।
saṃkṛtānyavatāraiśca madādyairbhagavatkulaiḥ ।
bhaktairbhāgavataiścāpi kalyāṇadāni rādhike! ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinaśuklapratipadi lāpalātrīpurīṃ hariryayau, tatra sāmudro daityaścāgatya nṛpasvasāraṃ vidyunmaṇināmnīṃ jahāra, rājā ca hariśca vimānābhyāṃ tamanu dudruvatuḥ, navajīvadvīpaṃ gatvā daityena yuddham, śaṃkarotthadaśalakṣagaṇairviṃśatilakṣadaityānāṃ nāśaḥ, kāmanāyakagaṇāya rājyaṃ dadau hariḥ, vidyunmaṇināmnī kanyā hariṃ vavre, dvinediṣṭhapuraṃ pāvayitvā pañcamyāṃ vimānena trāsamānadvīpamāgatya tato vṛndārukāmāgatya tataḥ siṃhaladvīpamāgatya pampāsaraścā-
gatyā''śvinaśuklasaptamyāṃ sāyaṃpūrvaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāmavāpa, svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ bhojanaṃ śayanādikaṃ cedyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।232।।

adhyāyaḥ 233
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 234 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
gopīpate harekṛṣṇa śrāvitaṃ paramādbhutam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caritaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
pāvanaṃ divyamādyaṃ ca sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe navaṃ navam ।
śrutvā śrutvā'ti me śraddhā punaḥ śrotuṃ prajāyate ।। 2 ।।
na hi tṛpyāmi kāntā''syodgatavāṇyā viśeṣataḥ ।
bhūyo me śrāvaya svāmin bālakṛṣṇo mahāprabhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kiṃ tataḥ pracakāra ha ।
yatkiṃciccaritaṃ divyaṃ laukikaṃ vāpi muktidam ।। 4 ।।
kauṭumbikaṃ tairthikaṃ vā camatkārayutaṃ ca vā ।
svalpaṃ vāpi mahadvāpi śrāvayā''lasyamantarā ।। 5 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu kānte priye rādhe puruṣottamasatkathāḥ ।
bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānandapravarṣiṇīḥ ।। 6 ।।
me'pi kathayamānasya tṛptirnaivopajāyate ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñasya mama mūlasya satkathāḥ ।। 7 ।।
api tvaṃ rādhike cāsi mamārdhaṃ puruṣottamī ।
so'haṃ tvāṃ mat pṛthakkṛtvā goloke'smi pṛthak sthitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
mūlarūpāt parabrahmasvarūpāt kṛṣṇarūpavān ।
tvadarthe cāsmi niṣpannastava kāmaprapūrtaye ।। 9 ।।
tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca tathā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaśca rādhike ।
pṛthagbhūtā dṛśyamānā api pṛthaṅn mūlataḥ ।। 2.233.10 ।।
tvādṛśyo mādṛśā mūle pare brahmaṇi koṭiśaḥ ।
avatārā virājante mamaikasya tu kā kathā ।। 11 ।।
tasya śrībālakṛṣṇasya kaṃbharāśrīsutasya vai ।

sarvapateḥ pareśasyā''nandapradāni yāni tu ।
caritrāṇi paraṃ cetaḥ kathayāmi nibodha me ।। 1 3।।
śrotṝṇāṃ cāpi vaktaṝṇāṃ mokṣadānīha sarvathā ।
smartṝṇāṃ vāsanānāśakārīṇi śobhanāni ca ।। 14।।
sāttvikārthaṃ sāttvikāni rāgyarthaṃ rājasāni ca ।
tāmasārthaṃ tāmasāni muktārthaṃ nirguṇāni ca ।। 15।।
nirguṇo'pi harirmāyāṃ yuktvā tadvānivā'niśam ।
vartate guṇināṃ madhye teṣāṃ sukhābhisandhaye ।। 16।।
stryapatyavanto lokāstu svatulyaṃ kalpayanti tam ।
strīputrābhijanabaddhaṃ na divyaṃ yad guṇadṛśaḥ ।। 17।।
ahaṃ rādhe nirguṇo'smi kā kathā me parātmanaḥ ।
tvaṃ rādhe nirguṇā cāsse kā kathā brahmayoṣitām ।। 18।।
gopā gopyo'pi divyā me golokasthāśca dhenavaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhavāsino divyāḥ kā kathā paramātmanaḥ ।। 1 9।।
camatkārāstasya divyāḥ kriyā divyā abandhanāḥ ।
yogo divyo harestasya ramaṇaṃ rāsanādikam ।।2.233.20 ।।
dāmpatyaṃ sarvathā divyaṃ divyaścābhijano'sya ca ।
divyāstasya guṇāḥ sarve māyā yatra ca tadvidhā ।।21 ।।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ ca śāśvatānandadāyakam ।

mahīmānaṃ kathayato hṛdayaṃ me dravatyapi ।

atṛpto'haṃ kathayāmi miṣṭān miṣṭān harerguṇān ।

mugdhābhāvaṃ tathā madhyābhāvaṃ prauḍhādibhāvanām ।

anyāḥ sarvāḥ samāklṛpya veṣaṃ śṛṃgāraśobhitam ।।41।।

rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ śīghramutthāya cā'layāt ।

śaityaṃ sukhaṃ ca kampaṃ ca prāpyā'pi dravitāni vai ।

paśya svahṛdaye kāntaṃ ramantaṃ tadyathāsthitam ।। 11 2।।
sphurantaṃ paśya gopi tvaṃ cā'vismṛtaṃ pareśvaram ।
tasyānandottamalābhāt pūrṇakāmā'si rādhike ।। 113 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne āśvinaśaratpūrṇimārātrau sarvanijapatnībhirbālakṛṣṇasya rāsānandaramaṇakrīḍāvarṇananāmā trayastriṃśadadhikadvi-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 233 ।।

1.(40,4, 55, 6, 22) catuḥkoṭyaḥ, caturlakṣāṇi, paṃcapaṃcāśatsahasrāṇi, ṣaṭśatāni, dvāviṃśatiśca kanyāḥ ।

adhyāyaḥ 234
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 235 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike tata ārabhya śaradrātriprabhātataḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ vinā nā''sāṃ kṣaṇo yāti sukhecchayā ।। 1 ।।
śayane bhojane yāne vane snāne tathā''sane ।
vārtane ramaṇe gāne sakhībhiḥ saha narmaṇi ।। 2 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo hi netrāgre hṛdaye'pi sphuratyayam ।
smāraṃ smāraṃ mahānandaṃ bhramanti kṛṣṇavṛttikāḥ ।। 3 ।।
kadā''gacchet punaścaivaṃ śāradotsavamācaret ।
kāntā''nandapradaṃ kāntaścetyevaṃ saṃvyacintayan ।। 4 ।।
brahmānandaṃ muhuḥ smṛtvā kanyā nidrāṃ na lebhire ।
kṛṣṇastāsāṃ divyarūpaiḥ pūrayatyeva kāmanā ।। 5 ।।
sadā sahaiva tāḥ sarvāḥ prārthayāmāsuracyutam ।
rakṣituṃ mandire naije na tu vai lomaśāśrame ।। 6 ।।
bālakṛṣṇastu tāḥ prāha mārgaśīrṣe vidhānataḥ ।
nayiṣye mandire naije śrutvā tā dhairyamāvahan ।। 7 ।।
athorjakṛṣṇapakṣasyā'ṣṭamī janatithirhareḥ ।
āyātā cotsavaṃ tatra cakre gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
caturdaśasamā jātā bālakṛṣṇasya bhūtale ।
pañcadaśī janmajayantyaṣṭamyatra pravartate ।। 9 ।।
tatra śrībālakṛṣṇasya pitā kīrtyanusārataḥ ।
mahotsavaṃ paraṃ cakre pūrvapūrvātivartinam ।। 2.234.1 0।।
sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ nirmātuṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham ।
śīghraṃ copāyayau viśvakarmā nanāma pādayoḥ ।। 11 ।।
eṣa dāso hi kṛṣṇasyopasthito'smi 'nideśanām ।
dehi karomi śīghraṃ vai yatheṣṭaṃ śobhanaṃ yathā ।। 1 2।।
śrutvā pitā''ha putrasya bālakṛṣṇasya śobhanā ।
janmajayantikā prāptā pañcadaśīti maṇḍapam ।। 12 ।।
viśālaṃ nūtanaṃ divyaṃ divyasāmagrikodbhavam ।
prakāraya viśeṣeṇa deveśasaṃsaduttaram ।। 14।।
tathāstviti praṇamyātha śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ prabhum ।
pūjayituṃ yayau pārśve pūjayitvā prasannatām ।। 15।।
ājñāṃ cāpya drutaṃ divyaṃ maṇḍapaṃ hṛdyacintayat ।
apūrvaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kartuṃ tvājñā jātā'sti tattathā ।। 16।।
karomi maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ catuḥkammānikopari ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro yasyā'dho nihitaṃ yathā bhavet ।। 17।।
ityevaṃ saṃprakalpyaiva pratimāṃ māṇḍapīṃ hṛdi ।
dhanuścatuṣṭayaṃ tatra sasmāra yojanāyatam ।। 18।।
aindraṃ dhanuḥ śāṃkaraṃ ca dhanurdhanuśca vaiṣṇavam ।
dhanurmanobhavasyāpi dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ śubham ।। 1 9।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpūrvadiśāyāṃ caindrameva saḥ ।
dakṣottaraṃ dīrghamasthāpayat kammānikātmakam ।
aiśaṃ dhanuścottarasyāmasthāpayattathaiva ca ।।2.234.20।।
paścimasyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cā'sthāpayat tattathaiva ca ।
dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca kāmasyā'sthāpayattattathaiva ca ।।2 1 ।।
yojanāyatabhūbhāge prāntāṣṭakaṃ nyadhāpayat ।
kṛtvaivaṃ caturasrāṃ vai catuṣkīṃ pādarūpiṇīm ।।22।।
tatra nyadhāpayat sūryaraśmīn tejonidhānakān ।
sūryakāntaiścandrakāntaiḥ sphāṭikairmaṇibhistathā ।।23 ।।
samasūtrāṃ catuṣkīṃ tāṃ kṛtvābhittisvarūpiṇīm ।
prākāraṃ gopurāḍhyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kammānikāyutam ।।24।।
kārayāmāsa śīghraṃ saḥ madhye sabhāṃ śuśobhanām ।
cāndrakiraṇasampādyasudhādravyavitānikām ।।25 ।।
amṛtodbhavavallyāḍhyaśobhāstaṃbhasamanvitām ।
sauvarṇāsanasaṃrājatpārśvavartulamadhyamām ।।26।।
grahanakṣatratārādipradīpasthānarājitām ।
kaustubhavrātasaṃlagnavitānacchāyayā'nvitām ।। 27।।
yāvallakṣmīsvarūpā'nurūpaśrīdhṛtamālikām ।
yāvadapsarasāṃ nṛtyā'rhaṇagītisvabhāvagām ।।28।।।
sudharmābrāhmabhaumeśīsabhācatuṣṭayāṃ'kinīm ।
kāmadhenukalpalatācintāmaṇisamanvitām ।।29।।
kalpavallīkalpadrumā'kṣayapātrādimaṇḍitām ।
sarvagandharasāsvādasukhasparśānilānvitām ।।2.234.3 0 ।।
dūraśravaṇadṛśyādisarvaśaktyāśrayāṃ śubhām ।
yatra yāvatpadārtheṣu dṛśyate mūrtimān hariḥ ।।3 1।।
svayaṃprakāśo bhagavān bālakṛṣṇasya bhaktarāṭ ।
yathā'dideśa rūpāṇi tathā tvaṣṭā vyadhārayat ।। 32।।
muktarūpāṇi sarvāṇi cākṣarasya svarūpakam ।
muktānīnāṃ svarūpāṇi tvaṣṭā vyakalpayattathā ।।33।।
teṣu śrībālakṛṣṇaścāntarātmā dṛśyate śubhaḥ ।
avatārān sarvavidhān tathāvatārayoṣitaḥ ।।34।।
vyūhāँśca vyūhapatnīśceśvarānīśvariṇīstathā ।
teṣu śrībālakṛṣṇaścāntarātmā dṛśyate śubhaḥ ।।35।।
siddhāśca sāṃkhyayoginyaḥ satyaḥ sādhyaśca sādhavaḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā devyastāsāṃ prayoṣitaḥ ।।36।।
mānavā dikprapālādyā lokapālāḥ sayoṣitaḥ ।
kāśyapyaśca prajāḥ sarvā divyatattvāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 37।।
ādityā vasavo rudrā gaṇeśā bhūbhṛto'pare ।
pārthivāścāpi vikhyātā nihitā viśvakarmaṇā ।। 38।।
teṣu sarveṣu divyaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo vilokyate ।
evaṃvidhāṃ sabhāṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapāḍhyāṃ sunūtanām ।।3 9। ।
nyavedayaddhi saptamyāṃ pitre rātryardhake gate ।
prasanno'bhūt pitā dṛṣṭvā sopānāni samantataḥ ।।2.234.40 ।।
yānamārgān vimānānāmavakāśān tadantare ।
hastināṃ gatimārgāśca rathānāṃ pādacāriṇām ।।41 ।।
mārgān viśrāntiviśrāmān dṛṣṭvā mumoda vai pitā ।
klṛptodyānāni paritaḥ phalapuṣpayutānyapiṃ ।।42।।
bahuraṃgavicitrāṇi vīkṣya jaharṣa vai pitā ।
tatra sarvatra putraṃ svaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ vyalokayat ।।43।।
sarvaṃ tattvātmakaṃ cāste viśiṣṭaṃ tannidarśanam ।
racitaṃ cā''jñayā tvaṣṭrā hareḥ preraṇayā bhuvi ।।44।।
divyaṃ bhaumasaromūrdhni saraścā'dhaḥ pradṛśyate ।
koṭikamalaśobhāḍhyaṃ śeṣakamaṭhaśobhitam ।।45।।
pātāladṛśyaśobhāḍhyaṃ tejaḥpaṭaṃ tathā kṛtam ।
ityevaṃ maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ vīkṣya sihāsanaṃ hareḥ ।।46।।
vyalokayanmahādivyaṃ paraṃ sarvā''sanocchrayam ।
divyasattvotthasauvarṇaracitaṃ hastipīṭhagam ।।47।।
siṃhāsane'vayaveṣu sarvasiṃhāsanāni vai ।
antaḥklṛptāni divyāni sadevāni śubhāni vai ।।48।।
kārṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevīyaṃ bhaumamācyutam ।
sādāśaivaṃ ca hairaṇyagārbhaṃ vairājakaṃ tathā ।।49।।
brāhmaṃ caindraṃ vāruṇaṃ ca yāmyaṃ kauberakaṃ tathā ।
āgnikaṃ cā'nilīyaṃ caiśānaṃ nairṛtikaṃ tathā ।।2.234.50।।
śeṣīyaṃ sauramevāpi tathā'nyāni ca yānyapi ।
siṃhāsanāni sarvāṇi kṛṣṇāsanodare'bhavan ।।51 ।।
evaṃvidhaṃ divyagajāsanaṃ tvaṣṭā hyavā''nyasat ।
divyamuktānikāvṛndaiḥ karamālairgajāsane ।।52।।
sthitaiḥ puṣpāñjalibhiścā'kṣatacandanabhṛtkaraiḥ ।
suśobhite mahādivye maṇḍape ca sugandhini ।।53 ।।
ākṣaraistaijasairdravyairbhrājamāne samantataḥ ।
śuśubhe'ntargataḥ kṛṣṇo'saṃkhyarūpo mahāprabhuḥ ।।54।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaḥ saṃvīkṣya putrāsanaṃ param ।
divyottamaṃ hi mumude mumude ca kuṭumbakam ।।55।।
brahmapriyādyāḥ patnyaśca mumudire'tikāṣṭhayā ।
nijakāntā''sane vīkṣya gauravaṃ sārvabhaumikam ।।56।।
athaivaṃ saṃvidhāyaiva tvaṣṭā harṣānvito'bhavat ।
apūrvāṃ svakṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā mene kṛpāṃ harerhi saḥ ।।57।।
anarhaṃ yatsvabuddhestat samudbhūtaṃ mahāsanam ।
āntarasthaṃ prabhuṃ tasya vidhātāramamanyata ।।58।।
atha gopālakṛṣṇo'pi tejovyāpyaṃ hi maṇḍapam ।
vīkṣyā'kṣaraṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ maṇḍapasya hi tejasā ।।59।।
dinavadbhrājamānaṃ ca prātarbhrānto'bhavad drutam ।
prābodhayad gaṇeśaṃ ceśānaṃ satīṃ ca lomaśam ।।2.234.6 0।।
saccidānandamevāpi tuṣitaṃ ca sadāśivam ।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ cāpi sanatkumārakam ṛbhum ।।6 1 ।।
śīghraṃ tvājñāpayāmāsa kṣaṇād yāntu samantataḥ ।
kṛṣṇajanmajayantyāṃ vai hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ।।6 2।।
brahmasṛṣṭīśvarasṛṣṭijīvasṛṣṭisthitā bhuvi ।
saurāṣṭre vai samāyāntu gopālakṛṣṇamandiram ।।63 ।।
aṣṭamyāmutsave sarve vardhayantu samāgatāḥ ।
ityāśāṃ saṃgṛhītvaiva drutaṃ lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ ।।64।।
muktā dhāma yayuścāpi gaṇeśaḥ śāṃkaraṃ padam ।
īśānaḥ satyalokaṃ ca satīsādhvyālayān yayau ।।65।।
lomaśastu maharṣīṃśca tuṣita pitṛmaṇḍalam ।
sadāśivaśceśvarāṇāṃ lokeṣu tūrṇamāyayau ।।66।।
saccidānandamuktaśca viṣṇudhāmāni vai yayau ।
lakṣmīḥ sarvapradevīnāṃ lokeṣu ca yayau tadā ।।67।।
nārāyaṇī badaryāṃ ca kṣīre śvete yayau tadā ।
sanatkumāro bhagavān sarvalokān yayau kṣaṇāt ।।68।।
naikarūpapradhartāraste yayuḥ sarvatodrutam ।
tattatsthānāni cāsādya sthānibhiśca kṛtārhaṇāḥ ।।69।।
nivedyā''mantraṇavāco'kṣarakṣetramupāyayuḥ ।
āmantritāśca sarve te kuṭumbaparivāritāḥ ।।2.234.70।।
praphullahṛdayāstūrṇaṃ śṛṃgārādisamanvitāḥ ।
divyopadābhiḥ saṃyuktā vimānairvāhanādibhiḥ ।।71 ।।
āyayuḥ kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ divyasumaṇḍapam ।
prātareva hariḥ snātaḥ kṛtapūjābhivandanaḥ ।।72।।
kṛtavṛddhopasevaśca śṛṃgārito'pi sarvathā ।
brahmapriyābhiḥ sarvābhirnataḥ praharṣitastathā ।।73।।
mātrā''śīrbhiryojitaśca kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ ।
divyarūpadharo bhūtvā maharṣigaṇasevitaḥ ।।74।।
yayau tanmaṇḍape hastyāsane vādyasughoṣaṇaiḥ ।
gītibhiryoṣitāṃ cāpi vedamantraiḥ samanvitaḥ ।।75।।
gatvā kṛṣṇo niṣasāda jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
lomaśastaṃ vedamantraiḥ pūjayāmāsa candanaiḥ ।।76 ।।
maharṣayo'pi sarve'pi pūjayāmāsuracyutam ।
āśīrbhirvardhayāmāsuścā'kṣataiścakrurarcanam ।।77।।
mātā cakre'sya tilakaṃ pitā'sya mukuṭaṃ dadau ।
puṣpahārān brahmapatnyaścandrakaṃ śrīstadā vyadhāt ।।78।।
ārārtrikaṃ vyadhuḥ sarvāḥ sarve ca maṇḍapāgatāḥ ।
athaivaṃ divyarūpaṃ taṃ vīkṣya saurāṣṭravāsinaḥ ।।79।।
tallīnāścā'bhavaँstatra paraṃ samādhimāgatāḥ ।
viprāṇāṃ tatra jāyante vedaghoṣāḥ samantataḥ ।।2.234.8 0।।
bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhagavāँśca śuko'pi vallabho'pyanu ।
mahādānāni dānāni dadustatra samastataḥ ।।81 ।।
athā''yayustadā muktā muktānyo'kṣaralokataḥ ।
prapūjyā''rārtrikaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya te tataḥ ।।82।।
pārṣadairdarśitaramyāsaneṣu viviśustadā ।
athā''yayuścāvatārāḥ sapatnikāḥ sapārṣadāḥ ।।83।।
rādhike ca tvayā sārdhamahaṃ tatrā'gamaṃ tadā ।
nārāyaṇo'pi lakṣmyā yuk tatrāyayau mudānvitaḥ ।।84।।
anye nārāyaṇāḥ sarve svasvaśaktisamanvitāḥ ।
āyayuśca pupūjuśca viviśurdarśitāsane ।।85।।
vyūhāstatheśvarādyāśceśvaryastatra samāyayuḥ ।
pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ।।86।।।
brahmādyāścāyayuścāpi trilokeśā hyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ।।87।।
munayo yoṣitāṃ teṣāmāyayuḥ pitarastathā ।
devā devyo lokapālā dikpālāḥ sakuṭumbakāḥ ।।88।।
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ saśaktayaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
pupūjuścopadābhiśca viviśurdarśitāsane ।।89।।
mānavāḥ sādhavaścāpi satyaḥ sādhvyaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
pātālasthā vanasthāśca parvatasthāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।2.234.90।।
siddhacāraṇagandharvā vidyādhroragarākṣasāḥ ।
kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣāścāyayuḥ pupūjuracyutam ।। 91 ।।
tīrthāni sāgarā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi caityajātayaḥ ।
drumā vallikā divyāśca gāvaḥ patatriṇastathā ।।92।।
vāhanāni sudivyāni dāsā dāsyastathā''yayuḥ ।
pupūjuścopadābhiśca vardhayāmāsurāśiṣā ।।93 ।।
niṣeduścāsanādau ca maṇḍape divyatānvite ।
lokalokanivāsānāṃ devādīnāṃ hi mūrtayaḥ ।। 94।।
maṇḍape sarvataścāpi hastyāsane pravīkṣya te ।
nijarūpāṇi saṃvīkṣyā''ścaryaṃ prapedire hyati ।।95 ।।
neyaṃ kṛtirhi devānāṃ devatvaṣṭurna vā yataḥ ।
akṣarādisvarūpāṇāṃ śilpane tasya no gatiḥ ।।9 6 ।।
tasmādasya vidhātā vai bhavettvaṣṭā'kṣarasthitaḥ ।
brahmadhāmanivāsena nirmito'yaṃ pratarkyate ।।97।।
ityāsan sandehabhājaḥ sarve maṇḍapamaṇḍitāḥ ।
lulokire hi tattveṣu bālakṛṣṇaṃ tadantare ।।98।।
mugdhāḥ sarve tathā jātā vīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ hi garbhagam ।
āmadhyāhnaṃ pūjanaṃ cāśīrbhiḥ saṃvardhanaṃ tathā ।।9 9 ।।
vyavartata harestatra nṛtyaṃ cāpsarasāṃ tathā ।
gāyanaṃ tvabhavad divyaṃ saṃhitāvācanaṃ tathā ।। 2.234.10 0।।
ākhyānānyabhavaँścāpi yaśogānaṃ harestathā ।
vetradhāreṇa ca hemantena vasantakena ca ।। 101 ।।
ninādanaṃ mahākīrtirvijayāḍhyaṃ samīritam ।
satyā'mbikayā ca tatra duḥkhahāñjalirāsthitaḥ ।। 102।
mātrā sucandrako bhāle'kṣatayukte'sya vai kṛtaḥ ।
āśīrvādāstathā dattā tāmbūlakaṃ tathā'rpitam ।। 1 03।।
sabhāyāṃ śarkarādyaṃ khārikādyaṃ ca vitāritam ।
pānatāmbūlakādyaṃ ca yogyaṃ sampāditaṃ tathā ।। 104।।
athāgatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svāgataṃ svastinā ca vai ।
nātheśena kṛtaṃ bhāvabharaṃ miṣṭavacoyutam ।। 1 05।।
amṛtānāṃ sudhānāṃ ca miṣṭānnānāṃ prabhojanam ।
pānānāṃ miṣṭagandhānāṃ tāmbūlānāṃ pradānakam ।। 1 06।।
mālānāṃ puṣpahārāṇāṃ gucchānāṃ ca pradānakam ।
maṇḍapārthā''gatānāṃ sammānaṃ vai bahuśaḥ kṛtam ।। 1 07।।
trailokyaṃ tatra samprāptaṃ tūtsave'bhūt samastataḥ ।
rādhike'tha parihāro'bhavat prātarvidhestataḥ ।। 1 08।।
mahīmānā yayuryatrā''vāsāsteṣāṃ samarpitāḥ ।
viśrāntiṃ lebhire divyasaudheṣu divasārdhajām ।। 1 09'।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hareḥ pañcadaśajanmajayantyaṣṭamyāṃ divyamaṇḍapaśobhā, āmantritānāmāgamaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇabālakṛṣṇasvāmi pūjanam, mahīmānasatkāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 234 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 234 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 235
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 236 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra samāyātā janādayaḥ ।
sarve hare prasādaṃ vai labdhavanto mudaṃ yayuḥ ।। 1 ।।
madhyāhne vālakṛṣṇasya viprā āśīrvidhiṃ jaguḥ ।
nāryāṃ jaguśca gītani tato nīrājanaṃ hyabhūt ।। 2 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo nijaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa vai tadā ।
akṣarātparadhāmasthaṃ divyaṃ divyottamottamam ।। 3 ।।
maṇḍape svāsane cāpi ye ye'ntarnihitāḥ surāḥ ।
lokāśca lokapālāśceśvarāvatāraśaktayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
te tāḥ sāmastyabhāvena bālakṛṣṇe samāsthite ।
adṛśyantākṣaramuktāḥ sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ।। 5 ।।
brahmāṇḍaṃ dṛśyate tatra caturdaśastarātmakam ।
bhūtalaṃ dṛśyate cāpi saurāṣṭraṃ dṛśyate tathā ।। 6 ।।
dṛśyate kuṃkumavāpi sabhā ca dṛśyate tathā ।
dṛśyate maṇḍapaśceti dṛśyate kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ityevaṃ śrīharau sarvaṃ pāriṣadākṣigocaram ।
samabhūt te tato hṛtsu bālakṛṣṇaṃ vyalokayan ।। 8 ।।
divyaṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ kāmbhareyaṃ mahāprabhum ।
gopālabālakaṃ brahmapriyādīnāṃ patiṃ prabhum ।। 9 ।।
atha divyaṃ darśayitvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ haristataḥ ।
bālarūpo babhūvā'ya sabhāvisarjanaṃ hyabhūt ।। 2.235.1 0।।
sarvebhyo bhojanaṃ prādācchrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
miṣṭānnāni vividhāni peyāni vividhāni ca ।। 11 ।।
tato vidāyaṃ pradadau dānamānapuraḥsaram ।
yayurvai paralokasthā deśāntareṣu sarvathā ।। 12।।
samājastatra saurāṣṭradeśīyānāṃ sthiro'bhavat ।
rātrau śrībālakṛṣṇāgre mallayuddhamabhūttathā ।। 13 ।।
nāṭakāni vicitrāṇi śrīkṛṣṇā'grebhavaँstadā ।
gāyanāni vicitrāṇi saṃgītakāni cā'bhavan ।। 14।।
bhojanāni ca peyāni muhustatrā'bhavanniśi ।
evaṃ rātrau nartanāni hyabhavan vārayoṣitām ।। 15।।
pāritoṣikadānāni hyabhavan karmacāriṇām ।
samāpya sarvaṃ rātryardhe nidrāṃ śrāntiṃ yayurjanāḥ ।। 16 ।।
prātarutthāya vādyādyaiḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ ।
hariṃ natvā vidāyaṃ ca gṛhītvā prayayurgṛham ।। 17।।
viśvakarmā nideśaṃ ca prāpya maṇḍapamuttamam ।
tiro'bhāvayadevāpi prātareva kṣaṇāntare ।। 18।।
tasmai śrībālakṛṣṇaśca pāritoṣikamuttamam ।
pradadau svarṇamukuṭaṃ kaṇṭhahāramanuttamam ।। 1 9।।
buddhiṃ ca pradadau divyāṃ gatiṃ sarvatra sandadau ।
sṛṣṭitrayā'kṣimattvaṃ ca pradadau kṛpayā prabhuḥ ।। 2.235.20।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro drāgadṛśyata maṇḍape hṛte ।
sasnuḥ prātarjanāḥ sarve sandhyāvandanadharmiṇaḥ ।। 21 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike janmajayantī pāñcadāśikī ।
vyatītā śrīharervarṣaṃ pañcadaśaṃ samāyujat ।। 22।।
śrīharerdarśanārthaṃ vai prāyānti bahavo janāḥ ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ susammardo jāyate'harniśaṃ tataḥ ।। 23।।
dīnāścāṇḍālaparyantāḥ samāyānti prayānti ca ।
rājādhirājakaruṇāṃ labdhvā prasādarūpiṇīm ।। 24।।
prāpyānandaṃ bhojanādi bhavanti sukhinaśca te ।
rādhe! tatra jayantyāṃ vai cāṇḍālaḥ kaścidāgataḥ ।। 25।।
āsīnnāmnā tāmasākṣiḥ patnīputrasamanvitaḥ ।
harerbhakto yato naiva cauryaṃ karoti sarvathā ।। 26 ।।
na vyāharatyasatyaṃ ca kapaṭaṃ na karoti ca ।
calālaye vasannityaṃ grāmamārjanakarmabhiḥ ।। 27।।
labdhānnairdehamātrāṃ ca nirvartayati vai sadā ।
kintu cānnaṃ na vai pūrṇaṃ jāyate mārjanārjitam ।। 28।।
grāme'styanyo na cāṇḍālaḥ kāryaṃ kartuṃ tu sammataḥ ।
nā'yaṃ hiṃsāṃ karotyeva na tvanyāyaṃ karotyapi ।। 29।।
bhikṣukavattathā'nnasyā'rjanārthaṃ na bhramatyapi ।
matvā lokāstu cāṇḍālaṃ kupātraṃ na dadatyapi ।। 2.235.3 0।।
tataḥ kleśaṃ varaṃ prāpya kṣudhāpīḍātikarṣitaḥ ।
kuṭumbena sahito'yaṃ pañcaputrasamanvitaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
bālairapyanudyamaiśca dvikanyāsahitastathā ।
patnīyutaśca navamo jayantyāṃ svayamāgataḥ ।। 32।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre vaṭacchāyāmupāśritaḥ ।
darśanaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya karoti sma navaṃ navam ।।3 3 ।।
mālāvartanamevāpi karoti sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
bhikṣānnaṃ tūtsave tena labdhaṃ pūrṇaṃ dine niśi ।। 34।।
navamyāṃ tena sallabdhaṃ daśamyāṃ labdhameva ca ।
ekādaśyāṃ tadānnaṃ na labdhaṃ vai vratakāraṇāt ।। 35।।
kṣudhitaḥ sakuṭumbo vai divāniśaṃ vrate'bhavat ।
rātrau tāmasabhāvena patnyapatyasamanvitaḥ ।।36।।
kṣudhādyairbhagnahṛdayo martukāmo'tivegavān ।
nipapāta sarasyeva patnī dhartuṃ papāta tam ।।37।।
putrīputrāśca patitā rudantaḥ pitarāviti ।
jalāgādhatvayogena talaṃ prāptāśca te tadā ।।38।।
madhyarātryuttare kāle naitat jānāti kaścana ।
jalaṃ te salilaṃ pītvā mṛtaprāyāstadā'bhavan ।। 3 9।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ hṛdye sve smarantyete mṛtā iva ।
bhagavān bālakṛṣṇo'pi prabubodha drutaṃ tadā ।। 2.235.40 ।।
tyaktvā śayyāṃ rādhike svāṃ tamorātrau saro yayau ।
vāsudevasvarūpaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo jalāntare ।। 41 ।।
caturbhujo viveśātha dhṛtvā bhaktaṃ śvapākinam ।
tatpatnīṃ ca bahistīre tvānayāmāsa satprabhuḥ ।। 42।।
punarjale harirgatvā putrīdvayaṃ sutaṃ tathā ।
jalānniṣkāsayāmāsa taṭe nyasya punarjale ।। 43।।
sapraviśya haristūrṇaṃ putrāँścatura ityapi ।
ānayāmāsa ca bahistaṭe rarakṣa vai kṣaṇam ।। 44।।
bālān sute ca patnīṃ ca patiṃ ca bhagavāँstataḥ ।
vāsudevaścāniruddhaḥ pradyumnaḥ samakarṣaṇaḥ ।।45।।
catūrupadharo bhūtvā dhṛtvā tān pādayoḥ pṛthak ।
uttolyā'dhomukhān kṛtvā ghaṭikāmātrameva tān ।।46।।
tathaiva dhārayāmāsa pītajalasya nirgamam ।
mukhataḥ sarvathā kārayitvā tān labdhacetanān ।।47।।
varādhastāt saprasvāpya śaityanāśāya kāṇḍikāḥ ।
vaṭapatrādisahitāḥ śalākāśca samantataḥ ।।48।।
saṃpracitvā drutaṃ tatrā'nalaṃ prādīpayatprabhuḥ ।
tatra kāṣṭhāni vinyasya tapanaṃ pracakāra ha ।।49।।
tāpayāmāsa tān sarvān śanakaiḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।
ānayāmāsa tatprāṇān mūrdhno hṛdayagahvaram ।।2.235.50 ।।
prāptajāgratprabhāvāste vīkṣya rūpacatuṣṭayam ।
vāsudevādikaṃ tūrṇaṃ nemire pādayoḥ prabhoḥ ।।51 ।।
tuṣṭuvuste hariṃ tatraikādaśīrātritūryake ।
dīnā'nāthadaridrāṇāṃ nātha dhāraka rakṣaka ।।।52।।
natāḥ sma te pādayorvai cāṇḍālā vayamādarāt ।
tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ cānnadātā tvaṃ bhartā tvaṃ hi poṣakaḥ ।।5 3 ।।
prāṇadātā tvamevā'si jīvayitā jalāddhi naḥ ।
sadā'nnaduḥkhaduḥkhino vayaṃ jīvanaduḥkhinaḥ ।।।54।।
duḥkhairviraktabhāvena prāṇāntārthaṃ jale'rpaṇam ।
kṛtavanto hi dehānāṃ te smṛtiṃ prāpya vāriṣu ।।55।।
tatra tvaṃ prāṇanātho naḥ samāgatyoddhṛtiṃ vyadhāḥ ।
deharakṣā kṛtā yadvatprāṇarakṣā tathā kṛtā ।।56।।
jīvanasya pradānena rakṣāṃ vṛttyā kuru prabho ।
yadvā te brahmalokaṃ no naya bhaktānudāsanān ।।57।।
tvayā rakṣā kṛtā garbhe kṛmiyoge'pi janmani ।
janmamārge kṛtā rakṣā bālyabhāve'pi rakṣitāḥ ।।58।।
idānīṃ yāvadevāpi tvayā'nnādyairhi rakṣitāḥ ।
vṛkṣā vallyaḥ paśavaśca kīṭāḥ patatriṇastathā ।।59।।
rakṣyante'pi tvayā nātha rakṣa rakṣaya nastviha ।
adhamoddhārakartā tvaṃ duḥkhahartā ca duḥkhinām ।।2.235.60 ।।
anāśritānāṃ cāśrayapradātā tvaṃ pitā mataḥ ।
bālānāṃ cāvalambastvaṃ jīvanaṃ tvaṃ prajīvinām ।।6 1 ।।
śaraṇyaścāpadgatānāṃ tārakastvaṃ nimajjatām ।
āturāṇāṃ cārtihāstvaṃ mamārttiṃ hara māpate ।।62।।
annavastrairvihīnānāmannavastraprado bhava ।
durbhāgyānāṃ subhāgyasya vidhātā bhava māpate ।।63।।
annaduḥkhena bhagavannimagno'haṃ sarovare ।
kuṭumbasahito rātrau tvayā dayālunoddhṛtaḥ ।।64।।
tasmāt pūrṇāṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā'nnāmbarakaṣṭamacyuta ।
vināśaya te bhaktasya śaraṇe patitasya me ।।65।।
ityuktvā ca kṣitau nyasya mastakaṃ sāñjaliṃ mudā ।
praṇanāma muhuḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ vilokayan ।।66।।
bhagavān vāsudevādisvarūpāṇi vyadarśayat ।
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpaśca bhūtvā''ha tāmasākṣikam ।।67।।
kuṭumbasahitaścātra nagaryāṃ me sadā vasa ।
mārjanādi vidhehyatra rathyāsu rājamārgake ।।68।।
vṛttiste tvannavastrādisvarūpā nirvahiṣyati ।
prātardāsye nivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ tavocitam ।।69।।
mā khinno bhava bhakta tvaṃ maivaṃ punaḥ kṛthāḥ kvacit। ।
ātmaghātasamaṃ pāpaṃ mokṣahānikaraṃ mahat ।।2.235.70 ।।
netarad vidyate tasmānmā kṛthāścātmaghātanam ।
ātmajīvanadānena tulyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahattaram ।।71 ।।
mokṣasādhanadaṃ nānyattasmād rakṣeddhi jīvanam ।
gṛhāṇedaṃ bhojanaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ pūrtamityapi ।।72।।
ityuktvā vāsudevyā cāhṛtaṃ miṣṭānnakaṃ dadau ।
vastrāṇyapi dadau tasmai kuṭumbāya dayāparaḥ ।।73 ।।
prātaścāyāhi me gopurāgre dāsye gṛhaṃ tava ।
ahaṃ gacchāmi saudhaṃ me bhaja māṃ nidrito bhava ।।74।।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike ।
cāṇḍālaśca prasanno'bhūt cakre tu bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।75।।
tālikāvādanaiḥ sarve pracakruḥ kṛṣṇakīrtanam ।
prātaḥ snātvā harerdvāraṃ yayuḥ sarve'ti bhāvukāḥ ।।76 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo hi bhaktasya rakṣārthaṃ svayameva ha ।
gajāsanāt samutthāya gopuraṃ prayayau tataḥ ।।77।।
gṛhaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsa cāmravaṇe'tisundaram ।
sundaraṃ nūtanaṃ vṛkṣavallītṛṇavirājitam ।।78।।
viśālaṃ mārjanīcullīkaṇḍanyādisamanvitam ।
udakuṃbhīpeṣaṇībhyāṃ sahitaṃ śayanādiyuk ।।79।।
kusūladhānyapūrṇaṃ ca sarvānnasūpasaṃbhṛtam ।
śākapatrādivāṭyāḍhyaṃ kūpajalavirājitam ।।2.235.80 ।।
dogdhrīgosahitaṃ ramyaṃ catuḥkakṣādivartulam ।
evaṃ subhavanaṃ kṛṣṇo nijacitrasamanvitam ।।81 ।।
sarvaśobhāyutaṃ tasmai pradadau śvaprapākine ।
bhakto'yaṃ gṛhamāsādya prasanno'bhūnmumoda ca ।।82।।
mantraṃ śrībālakṛṣṇādvai jagrāha vaiṣṇavaṃ tadā ।
'namaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya dāso'smyuddhara māṃ prabho' ।।83।।
iti mantraṃ dadau tasmai bhagavān kaṃbharāsutaḥ ।
grāme kumakumavāpyāṃ ca pattane mārjanādikam ।।84।।
kartuṃ nyayojayattaṃ vai svabhaktaṃ tāmasākṣatam ।
so'pi labdhvā śubhaṃ lābhama bhaktiṃ cakre tvaharniśam ।।85।।
kuṭumbaṃ śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mūrtai prasevate'sya ca ।
kanyaikā dugdhikā devī tasthau sā brahmacāriṇī ।।86।।
kṛṣṇabhaktyā samādhisthā divyadehā babhūva ha ।
dugdhikā devatā cāṇḍālānāṃ sā kuladevikā ।।87।।
sarvadā tvabhavalloke bālakṛṣṇaniṣeviṇī ।
mantrikā cā'parā kanyā bahumantravidhāyinī ।।88।।
harerbhajanayogena sā''tmabalavatī hyabhūt। ।
satyavaktrī manuṃ yaṃ sa klṛptvā'nyāṃ śikṣayatyapi ।।89।।
sa eva mantro balavān jāyate phalavaustathā ।
evaṃ sā mantrikā jātā mantrodbhāvanakāriṇī ।।2.235.90 ।।
cāṇḍālajātimantrāṇām ārṣī sā hyabhavattataḥ ।
putrāḥ pañcāpi sadbhaktāḥ sādhavo bhajanānvitāḥ ।। 91 ।।
ajāyantā''śrame naije maṇḍalīvāhino'bhavan ।
cāṇḍālānāṃ guravaste'bhavan santo hi bhaktitaḥ ।।92।।
bahukāle gate teṣāṃ pitarau bhaktibhāvinau ।
sevinau divyahṛdayau bhūtvā dehau vihāya ca ।।93 ।।
yayatuḥ śrīharerdhāmā'kṣaraṃ muktau babhūvatuḥ ।
rādhe kālāntare putrāḥ putryau sādhvyau ca bhaktitaḥ ।।94।।
tyaktvā dehān yayurdhāma bālakṛṣṇasya śāśvatam ।
evaṃ śrībhagavān rādhe bhaktarakṣāṃ cakāra ha ।।95।।
poṣaṇaṃ pracakārāpi jīvikāṃ pradadau tathā ।
mokṣaṃ tvante dadau cāpi śvapacebhyo mahāprabhuḥ ।। 96।।
ye'nāthāśca daridrā vā dīnā bhāgyavihīnakāḥ ।
api gatvā harerbhūmau kuṃkumavāpikā'kṣare ।।97।।
bhajanaṃ ye kariṣyantyarpayiṣyanti nijaṃ nijam ।
dehaṃ prāṇān hṛdayāni dhanāni ca kuṭumbakam ।। 98।।
teṣāṃ rakṣāṃ bālakṛṣṇaḥ kariṣyatyeva sarvathā ।
bhuktiṃ samarpya loke'tra muktiṃ dāsyati vai tataḥ ।।99।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccā'sya - kīrtanātpāṭhanādapi ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavedeva rādhike nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.235.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maṇḍapasya parihāro mahīmānavidāyaṃ tāmasākṣināmakacāṇḍālabhaktasya sakuṭumbasya jalamagnasya rakṣaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ
mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 235 ।।

[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 237 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike bālakṛṣṇastu dhanatrayodaśīdine ।
dhanalakṣmyāḥ pūjanaṃ sampracakāra vidhānataḥ ।। 1 ।।
lakṣmīṃ nijāṃ priyāṃ śrīṃ ca sauvarṇī pratimātmikām ।
kārayāmāsa dānārthaṃ tāṃ sumūrtiṃ vidhānataḥ ।। 2 ।।
prāpūjayat ṣoḍaśādyopacāraiścandanādibhiḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa bahudhā pakvānnairnavadhānyajaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
pratyakṣāṃ ca tato lakṣmīṃ patnīṃ nijāṃ śriyaṃ tathā ।
svarṇasihāsane niṣādyā''rcayaccandanādibhiḥ ।। 4 ।।
keśaveṣādikaṃ cakre svayaṃ kṛṣṇo hi yoṣitoḥ ।
kabarīṃ kṛtvā dhammilaṃ granthayāmāsa vai svayam ।। 5 ।।
puṣpahārān vibhūṣāśca granthayāmāsa tatra ca ।
śṛṃgāradravyasadratnairhīrakaiḥ kajjalādibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
kuṃkumairgandhasārādyaiḥ kesaraiḥ karakādibhiḥ ।
puṣpasragbhiśca bindvādyaistayoḥ śṛṃgāramācarat ।। 7 ।।
tayoścārārtrikaṃ cakre pratyakṣayorhi kanyayoḥ ।
te hyubhe suprasanne ca tadāśīrvacanāni vai ।। 8 ।।
prāhatuḥ śrīpate lakṣmīpate vivāhamāvaha ।
śrīpatiśca tathā lakṣmīpatirlagnena saṃbhava ।। 9 ।।
rādhāpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ padmāvatīpatirbhava ।
māṇikīpatirevāpi brahmapriyāpatirbhava ।। 2.236.1 0।।
duḥkhahālakṣmīpatistvaṃ vivāhavidhinā bhava ।
asaṃkhyānītapatnīnāṃ patirlagnena saṃbhava ।। 11 ।।
samayo'yaṃ vivāhasya tava kṛṣṇa upāgataḥ ।
yogyo yuvā bhavasyadya yauvanāṃkuravān prabho ।। 12।।
śubhe samaye śrīkṛṣṇo lakṣmīkṛṣṇo drutaṃ bhava ।
kanyakāśca vayaṃ sarvāḥ pratīkṣāmo bivāhanam ।। 13 ।।
lakṣmīvān dhanavān śreṣṭhaḥ smṛddhimān vaṃśavān bhava ।
adyāpi brahmacārī tvaṃ mahāyogī praśasyase ।। 14।।
yogaiśvaryeṇa cāsmākaṃ kāmapūro bhavasyapi ।
aviplutaḥ sadā cāste kimasādhyaṃ hi yoginaḥ ।। 15।।
tathāpi vidhinā kṛṣṇotsavaṃ vaivāhikaṃ vaha ।
ityukto bhagavān kṛṣṇastathāstvevaṃ jagāda ha ।। 16 ।।
mārgaśīrṣe kariṣyehaṃ lagnaṃ me sarvayoṣitām ।
tāvaddhairyaṃ bhavatyau cāvahatāṃ tvaparāstathā ।। 17।।
ityuktvā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vyasarjayat prapūjanam ।
dakṣiṇā vividhāścāpi dadau śrīlomaśarṣaye ।। 18।।
svarṇamūrtidvayaṃ cāpi dadau śrīlomaśarṣaye ।
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāḥ svarṇapātrāṇyapi dhanaṃ dadau ।। 1 9।।
evaṃ mahotsavaṃ kṛtvā sarovaramagāddhariḥ ।
vāsudevīyakaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra cāṇḍāla uddhṛtaḥ ।। 2.236.20 ।।
tatra snātvā vyūhatīrthe vaṭavṛkṣaṃ yayau hariḥ ।
tatra brahmapriyāḥ sarvā vihartuṃ samupāgatāḥ ।। 21 । ।
tābhyo datvā dhanānyeva kuberopahṛtāni vai ।
prapūjya sarvapatnīḥ sa kanyakā dakṣiṇādibhiḥ ।। 22 ।।
prasādya sarvasāmagrīśceṣṭā datvā taṭāntikam ।
vihartuṃ barburaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dantadhāvanakaitavāt ।। 23 ।।
spraṣṭuṃ cāpi yayau bālakṛṣṇo hi rādhike tataḥ ।
brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāstāḥ prapaśyanti tu mādhavam ।। 24।।
yāntaṃ barburavṛkṣāgraṃ gatvā spṛśantameva tam ।
dantadhāvanayogyāṃ ca prāntapraśākhikāṃ tadā ।। 25।।
gṛhītvā''karṣayantaṃ ca prapaśyanti sma yoṣitaḥ ।
tāvad barburavṛkṣaḥ saḥ samūlaścotpapāta ha ।। 26 ।।
nanāma bhūtale cāpi tasmād divyo mahānaraḥ ।
prāvirbabhūva sahasā māhendrasadṛśo'paraḥ । । 27।।
dṛṣṭvā hariṃ namaścakre pṛthvyāṃ papāta pādayoḥ ।
cakāra daṇḍavattūrṇaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram । । 28 ।।
parameśa kṛpāsindhau smṛtvā'haṃ tāritastvayā ।
tvaṃ jīvānāṃ samuddhartā mokṣakartā pareśvaraḥ ।। 29 । ।
vartase'nugrahakartā samuddhartuṃ janāniha ।
carmacakṣurna jānāti bhavantaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 2.236.30 ।।
mayā prāptaḥ pareśastvaṃ vṛkṣayonipramokṣakaḥ ।
adyā'haṃ vai pragacchāmi divyaṃ svargaṃ tavā''jñayā ।। 31 ।।
ityuktvā praṇanāmāpi puṣpāṇi barburasya tu ।
arpayitvā mādhavasya pādayorgantumicchati ।। 3 2।।
tāvattatra samāyātā āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāstāḥ papracchuḥ kāntameva tāḥ ।। 33 ।।
ko'yaṃ vṛkṣāt samutpannaḥ kathaṃ vṛkṣo nipātitaḥ ।
kautūhalaṃ paraṃ no'tra vadaitatkāraṇaṃ prabho ।। 34।।
śrutvaitad bālakṛṣṇo'pi varṇayituṃ tu taṃ naram ।
vṛttāntaṃ ca nijaṃ sarvamājñāpayaddhi tatpuraḥ ।। 3 5।।
rājā praṇamya sarvāstā āha vṛttāntamadbhutam ।
purāhamāsaṃ samrāḍ vai gaurjare sābhrikātaṭe ।। 26, ।।
barburo nāma rājā vai dharmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
prajāpālanadakṣaśca devasādhuprapūjakaḥ ।। 37।।
vratadānaparo nityaṃ nityavṛddhopasevanaḥ ।
kṛṣṇakathāparaścāpi vaiṣṇavo duṣṭaśāsakaḥ ।।38।।
ekadā tvagamaṃ dīrghe'raṇye sābhramatītaṭe ।
vanāni vīkṣituṃ parimeyabhṛtyo'tigo vane ।।39।।
dūrāraṇye prayātena padbhyāṃ cāśvo vilokitaḥ ।
saptarūpāśrayo divyaḥ kāntimadromavarmakaḥ ।।2.236.40 ।।
mukhe śuklaḥ śaphe cauṣṭhe raktaśca pucchapṛṣṭhayoḥ ।
bhramare'pyudare bhāge śyāmo nīlastu vai gale ।।41 ।।
pītaḥ karṇe pārśvabhāge jaṃghāyāṃ kapiśastathā ।
nāḍīmārgeṣu haritaścitraḥ sarvāṃgasandhiṣu ।।42।।
evaṃvidhaṃ vicitrāśca dṛḍhaṃ puṣṭaṃ balānvitam ।
śobhanaṃ saṃvilokyaiva dhartuṃ cā'karavaṃ manaḥ ।।43।।
śanaiḥ pārśvaṃ tathā gatvā yathā viśvasito bhavet ।
dhṛtavāँstaṃ karṇadeśe raśminā ca gale tataḥ ।।44।।
gṛhītvaiva ca tatpṛṣṭhāsanaṃ ca kṛtavānaham ।
so'pi mayā yathā saṃpreritastathā jagāma ha ।।45।।
na jāne tvasya sāralyaṃ kutaścārjavamāgatam ।
yathā sañcālayāmyenaṃ tathā'gre sa tu gacchati ।।46।।
evaṃ daivaturaṃgaṃ taṃ jñātvā ninye purīṃ mama ।
nijaṃ bhāgyaṃ manyamāno harṣitaścā'bhavaṃ muhuḥ ।।47।।
daivaṃ taṃ turagaṃ nāhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dūraṃ karomi vai ।
tataḥ sa kopamāpanno māṃ śaśāpa ruṣā vadan ।।48।।
yasmānmāṃ muñcasi naiva naiva jānāsi māṃ tathā ।
naiva tṛptiṃ prayātyeva dṛṣṭvā māṃ bandhanānvitam ।।49।।
naiva vijñāya tattvaṃ me miṣṭaṃ dadāsi bhāvataḥ ।
paśuṃ jñātvā bandhane'tra nijaṃ kṛtvā ruṇatsi mām ।।2.236.50।।
tato rājan mama śāpād bhava barburapādapaḥ ।
kaṇṭakī suvane tatra duḥkhaṃ yāhi divāniśam ।।5 1 ।।
ityukto'haṃ tadā śīghraṃ jñātvā pūjyottamaṃ munim ।
patitaḥ pādayostasyā'śvasya śīghraṃ vimuktaye ।।52।।
prārthitaḥ sa mayā devo munirvā'nyo'pi yo bhavān ।
ajñāto mama pūjyo'si kṣamāṃ kurvatra bāliśe ।।53।।
śāpaduḥkhaṃ yathā śīghraṃ nivarteta tathā kuru ।
nijarūpaṃ ca me deva pradarśaya namāmi te ।।54।।
aparāddhaṃ mayā cāvijānatā nānyathā prabho ।
tasmāt kṣamāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā nijarūpaṃ pradarśaya ।।55।।
ityarthito muhuḥ so'śvastiro bhūtvā mahānṛṣiḥ ।
āśvalāyananāmā'bhūd rājavaṃśaguruḥ svayam ।।56।।
ahaṃ ruroda bahudhā jñātvā kulaguruṃ tu tam ।
kṣamāṃ dinataro bhūtvā'yācaṃ śāpanivṛttaye ।।57 । ।
putro'parāddhān sandhatte pitā kṣamate'harniśam ।
śiṣyāddhi guravaścāpi samicchanti parābhavam ।।58 ।।
mayā hyajānatā cā'śvalobhena nṛpabhāvataḥ ।
aparāddhaṃ tava pūjya kṣamāṃ kuru vidhehi śam । । 59 । ।
ityarthito hi bhagavānnāśvalāyanako muniḥ ।
kṣamāṃ kṛtvā''ha māṃ tatra kiṃ te vadāmi bhūpate! ।।2.236.6 0 ।।
mahatāmavamānādvai mahadāsanalaṃghanāt ।
pūjyapūjāvilopācca puṇyaṃ naśyati sarvathā ।। 61 । ।
tava puṇyaṃ samagraṃ vai naṣṭaṃ matpṛṣṭharohaṇāt ।
rājabhāktvaṃ na cā'dyā'sti śāpadagdho bhavasyapi ।।6 2 ।।
śāpabhogottaraṃ svargaṃ tava śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati ।
parastrīsaṃgamād rājan gurūṇāmavamānanāt ।। 65 । ।
parapīḍākaraṇāccā''yuṣyanāśo hi jāyate ।
asatpakṣagrahāccāpi devasādhuvinindanāt । । 64 ।।
satāṃ drohakaraṇāccāyuṣyanāśo hi jāyate ।
pitroḥ kaṣṭapradānācca patnīnāṃ pīḍanādapi ।।65।।
hiṃsāyāḥ karaṇāccāpyāyuṣyanāśo hi jāyate ।
madyamāṃsavyavāyādidoṣād dharmaprapīḍanāt ।।66 ।।
bhūtā''veśādidoṣāccāpyāyurnāśaḥ prajāyate ।
tvayā'parāddhaṃ cātyarthaṃ mayā noktaṃ tu lajjayā ।।67।।
yadahaṃ gururasyā'smi hyaśvarūpo vane'smi ca ।
rājā'yaṃ dṛṣṭavān māṃ sa na jānīyād guruṃ yathā ।। 68 ।।
tathā rūpaṃ mayā na vyāvartitaṃ tava sannidhau ।
dūraṃ kṣaṇāntare rājā gamiṣyati tataḥ param ।।6 9 ।।
mama rūpaṃ dhariṣye'haṃ vicāryetthaṃ turaṃgamaḥ ।
abhavaṃ cā'vartayaṃ ca tāvatta bhavatā'ntikam ।।2.236.7 0 ।।
samāgatya dhṛtaścāsmi vāhitaśca gṛhaṃ prati ।
tathāpyacintayaṃ nā'smai darśayitavyamantataḥ ।।7 1 ।।
madrūpaṃ yanmandurāyāṃ gṛhe mokṣyati māṃ yadā ।
nirjane'trā'ndhakāre vā rūpaṃ dhṛtvā nijaṃ gṛhāt ।।72 ।।
prayāsye vai vanaṃ tena śoko nā'sya bhaviṣyati ।
guroratyaparādhasyetyevamacintayaṃ nṛpa ।।73 ।।
tvayā tu lobhabhāvena nāhaṃ tyakto hi nirjane ।
cauravad bandhane kṣiptaḥ kārāgāre sthiro yathā ।।74।।
tato'haṃ krodhamāpannaḥ śāpaṃ vai sṛṣṭavāँstvayi ।
puṇyaṃ tena vinaṣṭaṃ te kṛpā me kiyatī vad ।।75 ।।
tato rājatvamadyaiva dagdhaṃ te doṣakāraṇāt ।
varburasya drumasyaiva śarīraṃ te bhaviṣyati ।।76 ।।
karomyanugrahaṃ te'tra śīghraṃ śāpavināśane ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre'kṣarabhūmau saro'ntike ।।77।।
barburo bhava rājendra jalapānasukhādimān ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।।78।।
'rājate bhagavāँstatra tadyogaṃ tvaṃ prayāsyasi ।
dantadhāvanalābhārthaṃ tava śākhāṃ grahīṣyati ।।79।।
svahastena yadā sākṣāt tasya sparśena vai bhavān ।
divyabhāvaṃ divyadehaṃ samāsādya hi daivatam ।।2.236.80 ।।
śīghraṃ yāsyasi nākaṃ tad yatrendro vartate sadā ।
tatra kalpaṃ svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā'kṣaraṃ prayāsyasi ।।8 1 ।।
tyaja cintāṃ vāsanāṃ ca rājye putre priyāsvapi ।
gatāḥ pūrve hi rājāno gamiṣyantyapare'pi ca ।।82।।
hareryogād gatā ye te gatā bhavanti netare ।
ityevaṃ māṃ jagādā'tha munirvanāntaraṃ yayau ।।83 ।।
svasti te'stviti māṃ coktvā yāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛto'pyaham ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre'bhavaṃ barvurapādapaḥ ।।84।।
daśavarṣāṇi jātāni me'tra barburavarṣmaṇi ।
tvayā samuddhṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa śāpapāpaṃ vināśitam ।।85।।
puṇyavānasmi sañjātastava sparśena muktida ।
kiṃkaro'smi śaraṇyastvaṃ dehi maṃtraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।86।।
yena tvante bhavenmokṣo me tathā tvaṃ vidhatsva vai ।
rājā'haṃ rājarūpaṃ tvaṃ naijaṃ me tvaṃ pradarśaya ।।87।।
yatsvarūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā svargānmokṣamavāpnuyām ।
ityarthitastadā rādhe hariḥ rājasvarūpadhṛk ।।88।।
pṛthurājasvarūpo'bhūd bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai ।
dadau maṃtraṃ ca tasmai sa vaiṣṇavaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇakam ।।89।।
'oḥ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
gṛhītvā tu manuṃ tvenaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ।।2.236.9 0।।
puṣpādyairvardhayitvaiva śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvā yayau svargaṃ surārcitaḥ ।। 91 ।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ tadā brahmapriyāḥ pṛthusvarūpiṇam ।
vyalokayan patiṃ naijaṃ trailokyanṛpatiṃ prabhum ।।9 2।।
dhanuścakradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ dṛḍhaṃ yuvānamacyutam ।
mohamāptāśca tāḥ patnyo remire pṛthunā tadā ।। 93 ।।
āmravaṇe ciraṃ paścāt pūjayitvā kṛpānidhim ।
prayayuḥ sarasastīre sasnuśca patinā saha ।।94।।
tīrthaṃ tad varburākhyaṃ ca pṛthutīrthaṃ tato'bhavat ।
tatra vāsād bhavet svargaṃ śāpanāśaśca mokṣaṇam ।।95।।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇaḥ snātvā dhṛtvā'mbarāṇi ca ।
brahmapriyāḥ sukhayitvā preṣayitvā''śramaṃ tataḥ ।। 96।।
svagehaṃ cāyayau rātrau lakṣmīpūjāṃ punastataḥ ।
cakāra bhagavān rātrau ghṛtadīpān cakāra ha ।। 97।।
ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ prārthayadvai śriyai tadā ।
prasannā sā'bhavallakṣmīḥ smṛddhā'bhavad gṛhe gṛhe ।।98।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛtvotsavaṃ nidrāṃ jagāma saḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya lakṣmīvān mokṣago bhavet ।।99।।
śāpitānāṃ śāpamokṣaścāparādhavināśanam ।
apuṇyānāṃ puṇyalabdhirbhavennātrā'sti saṃśayaḥ ।। 2.236.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne hariṇā dhanatrayodaśyāṃ dhanalakṣmīpūjā brahmapriyāpūjā barburanṛpasya āśvalāyanarṣiśaptasya barburavṛkṣībhūtasya
mokṣaṇaṃ pṛthutīrthasthāpanaṃ barburasya svargaṃ prati preṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 236 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 236 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 237
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 238 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha caturdaśyāṃ kālyāṃ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
pūjāṃ cakāra vai śaṃbhornijakṣetraprarakṣituḥ ।। 1 ।।
prātaḥ snātvā pitarau ca pūjayitvā tataḥ param ।
īśānadevaṃ cāhūya rudrānāhūya vai tathā ।। 2 ।।
śaṃkaraṃ kṣetrapaṃ devaṃ samāhūya satīyutam ।
svarṇasihāsane śaṃbhuṃ samasthāpayadīśvaram ।। 3 ।।
pupūja bālakṛṣṇastaṃ yoginaṃ padmajāpatim ।
pādyamarghyaṃ dadāvasmai candanaṃ bhasma cākṣatān ।। 4 ।।
dhattūrapuṣpamālāṃ ca gale harasya sandadau ।
bhāle candratilakaṃ ca tripuṇḍraṃ cordhvapuṇḍrakam ।। 5 ।।
vyadhācchrībhagavāँstasya hāsayaँstaṃ maheśvaram ।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale cāpi karṇikākusumāni ca ।। 6 ।।
rudrākṣamālikāṃ cāpi dadau tasmai harāya ca ।
vyāghracarma gajacarma dadau śrībhagavān svayam ।। 7 ।।
bhaṃgāṃ dadau ca miṣṭānnaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ dadau hariḥ ।
puṣpahārān dadau cāpi śṛṃgāraṃ pradadau tathā ।। 8 ।।
sugandhasāraṃ pradadau svarṇāmbarāṇi sandadau ।
svarṇahārān dadau cāpi satyai bhūṣāṃ dadau tathā ।। 9 ।।
ambarāṇi navīnāni vibhūṣaṇāni sandadau ।
yatheṣṭāni samagrāṇi śrāṃgārikāṇi sandadau ।। 2.237.10 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārā'tha mauktikahīrakān dadau ।
evaṃ prapūjya bhagavān bhūtanāthaṃ satīyutam ।। 11 ।।
utsavaṃ divase cakre rātrāvatha haristataḥ ।
bhojayitvā pūjayitvā śaṃbhuṃ satīṃ gaṇādhipam ।। 12।।
kārtikeyaṃ nandinaṃ ca yoginīcakramityapi ।
navadurgāḥ prapūjyāpi gaṃgāṃ prapūjya śāṃkarīm ।। 13।।
vīrabhadraṃ tathā jālandharaṃ ca tārakāsuram ।
tārakākṣaṃ gajaṃ mahiṣakaṃ caṇḍapracaṇḍakau ।। 14।।
śṛṃgina bhṛṃginaṃ cāpi rīṭinaṃ ca kirīṭinam ।
agniṃ candramasaṃ cāpi maṃgalaṃ ca viṣaṃ tathā ।। 15।।
kharparaṃ tasya devāँśca tathā kharparamālikām ।
siṃhaṃ rudrākṣakāँścāpi vāsukīṃ śāṃkarīṃ prajām ।। 16।।
hanumantaṃ tathā niṣādinaṃ gaṇānapūjayat ।
bhairavaṃ kālasaṃjñaṃ ca mahākālamapūjayat ।। 17।।
bhūtapretapiśācāँśca kūṣmāṇḍānapyapūjayat ।
vaināyakāँśca vetālān gaṇān rogānapūjayat ।। 18।।
mṛtyuṃ ca mṛtyupāśāँśca caṇḍyādinīrapūjayat ।
mātṛkāśca grahāँścāpi tathā pretānapūjayat ।। 1 9।।
rogikāśca mahāmārīprabhṛtikā apūjayat ।
kṛtyāśca kālikābrahmacāriṇīścāpyapūjayat ।।2.237.20।।
kailāsavāsinaḥ sarvān śītalādyā apūjayat ।
gaṇāँśca gaṇapatnīśca rākṣasīḥ samapūjayat ।।21 ।।
māṣapiṣṭādipakvānnairatarpayattu tāँstadā ।
yakṣāṃśca rākṣasān bhūtapatnīśca ḍākinīstathā ।।22।
śākinīyoginīścāpi vetālikā hyapūjayat ।
kālarātriṃ tathā rātriprajāḥ sarvā hyapūjayat ।। 23 ।।
evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ datvā tato hariḥ ।
homaṃ cakāra vidhinā ghṛtādyaistṛptaye prabhuḥ ।।24।।
sarṣapādyaiśca māṣādyaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaphalādibhiḥ ।
kṛṣṇapuṣpādibhiścāpi tarpayāmāsa devatāḥ ।।25।।
evaṃ kṛtvā pūjanaṃ ca balidānaṃ hava tathā ।
sarvatra dīpadānaṃ ca dadau śrībhagavān prabhuḥ ।।26।।
ityevaṃ kārtikaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ niśīthake ।
kālīcaturdaśī cāpi pūjayitvā hariḥ svayam ।।।27।।
mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tataḥ rātrau susuṣvāpa prātardīpotsave dine ।। 28।।
prabubodha suvādyānāṃ śabdaiśca kīrtanaistataḥ ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ pitṛpūjāṃ vyadhāt prabhuḥ ।।29।।
brahmapriyāśca lakṣmyādyāścāyayuḥ śrīhareḥ puraḥ ।
pūjanārthaṃ nijaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalāḥ ।।2.237.3 0।।
rādhike pūjayāmāsuḥ sarvāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ ।
āśīrvādān gṛhītvā ca bhojayitvā nijaṃ patim ।।3 1 ।।
tatpradattaṃ prasādaṃ ca gṛhītvā yayurāśramam ।
sāyaṃ dīpotsavaṃ cakre sarvābhiḥ saha keśavaḥ ।।32।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ sarvaṃ dīpaiḥ pūritamapsviti ।
svargavacchobhate cāpi nagarī hi tathāvidhā ।।33।।
rātrau śrībhagavāँścakre śāradāpūjanaṃ tathā ।
sākṣācchrīṃ śāradāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ satīṃ tathā ।।34।।
pañca kṛṣṇaḥ samāhūya pupūja parameśvarīḥ ।
nāgavallīdalaiḥ pūgīphalairmiṣṭānnabhojanaiḥ ।।35।।
sugandhasārairbhūṣābhiścāmbaraiḥ saddravādibhiḥ ।
toṣayāmāsa bhagavān yatheṣṭavastudānakaiḥ ।।36।।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rañjayāmāsa narmabhiḥ ।
svarṇādidakṣiṇā datvā bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ।।37।।
parihāraṃ tataścakre tataḥ suṣvāpa śāntimān ।
kanyakāścāśramaṃ gatvā nidrāṃ jagṛhurutsukāḥ ।।38।।
prātaḥkāle haristūrṇaṃ prabubodha saro yayau ।
sarojale kṛtasnānaḥ sasmāra svaṃ purātanam ।।39।।
sanātanaṃ svarūpaṃ cā'khilarakṣākaraṃ taṭe ।
nijayogānmahātīrthaṃ yatrāste vai sarovare ।।2.237.40 ।।
rādhike śrīharistatra dadhyau cātmānamātmani ।
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ sainyaṃ samparkabhūpateḥ ।।41।।
mahāmārīduḥkhakhinnaṃ hāhākārakṛtaṃ taṭe ।
kṛśaṃ kṣudhātṛṣāvyāptaṃ śrāntaṃ maraṇasāyujam ।।42।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
saṃparko vai kathaṃ sainyasahitastatra cāyayau ।
kasya deśasya rājā'bhūt kathaṃ rogo'sya sainyake ।।43 ।।
bālakṛṣṇena kṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ kimasya vai tadā ।
brūhi kānta kathāṃ sarvāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa hareḥ śubhām ।। 44।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe sa rājā''sīt samparkaḥ kacchadeśajaḥ ।
tīrthayātrānimittaṃ saḥ somanāthaṃ gato hyabhūt ।।49।।
madaṃśaṃ pūrvakalpīyaṃ dattātreyaṃ guruṃ hi saḥ ।
bhajate sma sadā kacche kurvan rājyamakaṇṭakam ।।46।।
prātaḥ snānaparaścāyaṃ devapūjanatatparaḥ ।
dānadharmaparaścānnasatreṣvatithipūjakaḥ ।।47।।
nityaṃ dhyānaparaścāpi dīnānāthānnadāyakaḥ ।
sādhusevāparo vṛddhanideśādyanuvartataḥ ।।48।।
goviprabhaktasevī ca satīsādhvīprapūjakaḥ ।
ahiṃsakaḥ satyavṛttiścāsīt prajā'bhipūjitāḥ ।।49।।
sādhūn dṛṣṭvā ca vā śrutvotthāyā'bhiyāti dāsavat ।
sevate cāmbaradānairbhojyadānādibhistathā ।।2.237.50 ।।
yadrājye ca satāṃ santi maṇḍalāni samantataḥ ।
devabhaktiparāṇyeva kṛṣṇakathāparāṇi ca ।।51।।
yajño bhavati yadrājye nārāyaṇasarastaṭe ।
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ śreṣṭho vaiṣṇavaścātidakṣiṇaḥ ।।52।।
so'yaṃ rājā rādhike vai sainyasāmagrikā'nvitaḥ ।
hastyaśvoṣṭravṛṣabhainoyānavāhanaśobhanaḥ ।।53।।
yātrārthaṃ somanāthasya saurāṣṭre tvāśvine yayau ।
sahasrajanasaṃghāto viprasādhusamanvitaḥ ।।54।।
kṛtvā tīrthe hiraṇyāyāḥ saṃgame pitṛtarpaṇam ।
snānadānādikaṃ cāpi someśvaraṃ prapūjya ca ।।55।।
mūladvārikikātīrthaṃ kṛtvā prapūjya gopatim ।
prācīsarasvatīṃ gatvā nārāyaṇabaliṃ vyadhāt ।।56।।
tato vāmanabhūmiṃ ca svarṇarekhānadīṃ tataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā cakratīrthamindreśvaraṃ jagāma saḥ ।।57।।
tataḥ sītāphalāraṇye kṛtvā tīrthaṃ ca tūrikām ।
yāyādāmravaṇaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro'vagāhitum ।।58।।
mārge śramaviśeṣeṇa bhojanā'niyamena ca ।
tāpaprabhāvataścāpi sainyaṃ rugṇamabhūttadā ।।59।।
mahāmārīmahārogaprapīḍitaṃ saro'ntikam ।
āyayau tīrthalābhārthaṃ rogādhīnaṃ ca duḥkhitam ।।2.237.60 ।।
rājā vilokya bhṛtyādīn paśūn vai raktasāriṇaḥ ।
svaṃ ca rugṇaṃ vilokyā'pi prasasmāra guruṃ nijam ।।6 1 ।।
dattātreyaṃ bhagavanta bālakṛṣṇakṣitau nṛpaḥ ।
pāhi tīrthapradeśe'tra pīḍitān mama mānavān ।।62।।
āgatya sadguro śīghraṃ jīvadānaṃ pradehi naḥ ।
rogo'yaṃ nāśakṛcchaktihārako bhṛtyavargiṇām ।।63।।
paśūnāṃ ghātakaścāpi raktasargo'tidāruṇaḥ ।
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho dattātreya jagadguro ।।64।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuścāpi rakṣatāccharaṇāgatam ।
ityevaṃ tvarthayitvaiva sarasaḥ sannidhau nṛpaḥ ।।65।।
kadambānāṃ drumeṣvevā''vāsaṃ cakāra sainyayuk ।
sarastīraṃ samāgatya pītvā jalaṃ taṭe prage ।।66।।
sasārtho nṛpatiścakre kīrtanaṃ bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।
tālītālasametaṃ vai nāmānuguṇavarṇanam ।।67।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇā''rtihan hare ।
dattātreya guro rakṣa parameśvara pāhi naḥ ।।68।।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre rājā sahasramānavaiḥ ।
sahito garjanā ceyaṃ digantaṃ pragatā'bhavat ।।69।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā sthiro'bhavat ।
nagaraṃ tvabhiyāto'pi vīkṣituṃ bhajanādikam ।।2.237.70 ।।
sammardo'bhūt sarasyeva paritastīravāsinām ।
kuṃkumavāpīvāsānāṃ darśakānāṃ sarastaṭe ।।7 1 ।।
rādhike bhajane līnā pārśve paśyanti naiva te ।
na cāgre nāpi vai pṛṣṭhe netrāṇyunmīlayanti na ।।72।।
ekatānaṃ hi bhajanaṃ cakruḥ rogapraśāntaye ।
babandhuśca hariṃ vṛttyā rajjvā svahṛdayeṣu te ।।73।।।
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā haristatra bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
dattātreyasvarūpeṇa tūrṇaṃ copasthito'bhavat ।।74।।
kukṣau pāvaṭikāṃ haste kamaṇḍalu jaṭāṃ tathā ।
kaupīnaṃ japamālāṃ ca dadhānaḥ pāduke śubhe ।।75।।
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa japan rājñaḥ sannidhau samupāgataḥ ।
rājā dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ tūrṇaṃ cakāra daṇḍavad bhūmau ।।76।।
sainyajanāścāpi cakrurdaṇḍavad vai samantataḥ ।
prasannavadano devo dattātreyo jagāda tān ।।77।।
kathaṃ smṛto bhavadbhiśca kāraṇaṃ brūta satvaram ।
rājā prāha mahāmārīkaṣṭaṃ tasmāt prarakṣaya ।।78।।
dattātreyo hi bhagavān kukṣikoṣṭhalikāṃ tadā ।
vyādāya tatra yadbhasma dadau tad bhūbhṛtelpakam ।।79।।
mukhe kṣipetyuvācaiṣaścikṣepa ca mukhe nṛpaḥ ।
mahāmārī bahiryātā samūrtā vikṛtānanā ।।2.237.80।।
bhītā praṇamya taṃ devaṃ dudrāva śaṃkaraṃ prati ।
sainyaṃ cāpi tadā jātaṃ nirug vai kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।।81 ।।
tāvattatra samāyāto dattātreyo'trinandanaḥ ।
kāmbhareyo drutaṃ jātastadā śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।82।।
rājā vīkṣya hariṃ tatra tathārūpaṃ rameśvaram ।
rakṣakaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ hyavāpa sainyayuk tataḥ ।।82 ।।
pupūja śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ dattātreyo mahāprabhum ।
prasannaḥ śrīharistasmai varadānārthamāha ca ।।84।।
dattātreyastataḥ prāha rakṣa māmatra sannidhau ।
tavāṃ'śo'haṃ tava kṣetre vastumicchāmi sarvadā ।।85।।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stveva vasā'śvasaraso jale ।
dattātreyamahātīrthaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati ।।86 ।।
tatastvaṃ revatagireḥ śikhare vāsamāpsyasi ।
raivatādrirmahendrākhyaḥ parvataścāgamiṣyati ।।87।।
saurāṣṭre ca kumudādiḥ parito'sya nivatsyati ।
tadā te śikhare vāso dattātreya bhaviṣyati ।।88।।
sadā tīrthaṃ mahat tatsyād dattātreyasya sānu tat ।
atra tīrthaṃ jalarūpaṃ sadā sthāsyati matsthale ।।89।।
tatra tīrthaṃ tu te vyomni sadā sthāsyati raivate ।
ityukto bhagavān dattātreyaścovāsa tajjale ।। 2.237.90।।
dattātreyamahattīrthaṃ jātaṃ sarovare hi tat ।
samparkatīrthamevāpi jātaṃ rakṣākaraṃ hi tat। ।।91 ।।
sa rājā kārayāmāsa taḍāgasya taṭāntike ।
dakṣiṇe mandiraṃ ramyaṃ dattātreyavirājitam ।।92।।
nirug yayau nijaṃ deśaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ prapūjya vai ।
rādhike śrībālakṛṣṇaścaivaṃ rakṣati duḥkhinaḥ ।।93। ।
avatārasya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tatsvarūpavān ।
bhūtvā karoti bhagavānavatārī parātparaḥ ।। 94।।
sarve'vatārāstasyaiva sarvaṃ tasmāt pravartate ।
sarvanāthaḥ sarvarakṣāṃ karoti smṛta eva saḥ ।। 95।।
araṇye parvate nadyāṃ samudre ca vane'pi ca ।
viṣame bhayade sthāne smṛto rakṣati māpatiḥ ।। 96 ।।
śatrumadhye kālamukhe vahnau vāyuprakopane ।
bhūkampe ca mahāyuddhe smṛto rakṣati sarvagaḥ ।। 97।।
tridoṣe mardane kūpe roge durbhikṣavatsare ।
nigaḍe parapāśe ca smṛto rakṣati sarvadṛk ।।98।।
viṣimukhe hiṃsramukhe śastrapāte ca vajrake ।
vyomapāte prapāte ca smṛto rakṣati cātmagaḥ ।।99।।
rājabhaye gṛhabhaye vidrāvaṇabhaye'pi ca ।
prāṇabhaye sarvabhaye smṛto rakṣati śaktimān ।।2.237.1 00 ।।
rādhike ye nijā jātāsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇo nijo bhavet ।
tadrakṣārthaṃ mahācintāṃ karotyeva divāniśam ।। 101 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya phalaṃ tīrthakṛtaṃ bhavet ।
rakṣaṇaṃ duḥkhanāśaśca bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 102।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kālīcaturdaśyāṃ śaṃkaratadgaṇabhṛtyadāsadāsīnāṃ pūjanottaraṃ śrīhariṇā dīpadānottaraṃ ca dīpāvalyāṃ śāradāmahotsavapūjā
kṛtā, pratipadi mahāmārīrogapīḍitatīrthayātrikasaṃparkanṛpādīnāṃ dattātreyarūpeṇa darśanadānena roganāśanaṃ dattātreyatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 237 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 237 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 238
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 239 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike nūtane varṣe prabhurbrahmapriyāpatiḥ ।
cakāra kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre'nnakūṭakotsavam ।। 1 ।।
bhojayāmāsa sarvān sa kuṃkumavāpikājanān ।
narānnārīrbālavargān yūno vṛddhān samastataḥ ।। 2 ।।
paśūn cāgantukāँścāpi pakṣiṇaśca jaleśayān ।
bhūśayān cetanān sarvān bhojayāmāsa vai hariḥ ।। 3 ।।
pratipaddivase śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo nijālaye ।
lakṣmīṃ tathā'nnapūrṇāṃ ca prāha bhojanakāmyayā ।। 4 ।।
adya me vartate vāñcchā sarveṣāṃ bhojanārthikīm ।
madhyāhnottaravelāyāṃ yadi syāt kurutaṃ tathā ।। 5 ।।
ājñāṃ prāpyā'nnapūrṇā ca prāha śrīparameśvaram ।
bhagavan pakvabhāvārthaṃ ghaṭikāpañcakaṃ khalu ।। 6 ।।
apekṣyate'dya samayo vartate ca tathāvidhaḥ ।
kariṣyāmo'nnasāmastyaṃ śṛtaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ityuktvā sā cānnapūrṇā sasmāra svasakhīṃ bhuvam ।
śriyaṃ sasmāra tūrṇaṃ ca vārkṣī sasmāra tatra ca ।। 8 ।।
sudhāṃ sasmāra dhānyānāṃ lakṣmīṃ sasmāra vai drutam ।
cullikāśca sakhīḥ sarvāḥ sasmāra samidhastathā ।। 9 ।।
śākapatrāṇi sasmāra veśavārān samastakān ।
nadīḥ sasmāra gaṃgādyā dhenūḥ sasmāra kāmadāḥ ।। 2.238.1 0।।
pākalakṣmīḥ prasasmāra vahnīn sasmāra tatra ca ।
pātrāṇyakṣayanāmāni tathā sasmāra sadrasān ।। 11 ।।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca sasmāra cānnapūrṇikā ।
āndhasikīḥ prasasmāra sasmāra pariveṣikāḥ ।। 12।।
āranālādikartrīśca takrapeyavidhāyinīḥ ।
prasasmāra tadā sarvā sakhīstāśca samāyayuḥ ।। 13।।
bhuvaṃ cājñāpayāmāsa kuru śīghraṃ mahānasam ।
krośārdhaṃ vartulaṃ śīghraṃ kṣaṇāt sā'pi tathā'karot ।। 14।।
nadīḥ prāha jalārthaṃ ca tā jalāni samānayan ।
cullikāḥ prāha yogye ca sthale sthātuṃ sthitāśca tāḥ ।। 15।।
vahnīn prāha nivāsārthaṃ cullīṣu vahnayaḥ sthitāḥ ।।
kaṭāhān prāha cullīnāṃ mastake sthātumāsthitāḥ ।। 16।।
darvyādyāstūrṇamevā''san svasvakāryaniyojitāḥ ।
sasyāni cāpi dhānyāni rasādīnāha pātrake ।। 17।।
cullīpātreṣu ca sthātuṃ ghṛtādyāśca tathā'bhavan ।
āsamantāttato lakṣmyaścāndhasikyaḥ sthitāḥ puraḥ ।। 18।।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāścopakāriṇyastadā'bhavan ।
lakṣmīnāṃ vai samastānāmicchayā ca ghṛtādikam ।। 19।।
kaṭāheṣu ca pātreṣu tvāyānti ca tapanti ca ।
yathāpekṣaṃ kaṇādyāśca piṣṭādikāni tatra ca ।।2.238.20 ।।
pakvatārthaṃ samāgatya praviśanti samantataḥ ।
śarkarādyāstathā pakvā veśavārādayo'pi ca ।।2 1।।
annapūrṇecchayā tūrṇaṃ samāgatya viśanti ca ।
aṣṭa vai siddhayastatra sevante sarvataḥ sthitāḥ ।।22।।
ghaṭīdvayānte siddhāni pakvānnāni bahūnyapi ।
āmantraṇāni śaṃbhośca pārṣadāḥ kṣetrapā daduḥ ।।।23।।।
ākṣarakṣetravāsebhyo bhojanārthaṃ samastataḥ ।
pakvānnānāmabhavaiṃśca parvatā vai mahānase ।।।24।।
aśārkarādipākāśca tato'jāyanta bhūriśaḥ ।
bhakṣānyapi tato jātānyasaṃkhyarūpakāni ca ।।25।।
bhojyānyapi drutaṃ jātānyasaṃkhyarūpakāni ca ।
lehyānyapi kṛtānyeva bahusaṃkhyāni tatra ca ।। 26।।
cośyānyapi samastāni kṛtāni subahūnyapi ।
peyānyapi samastāni racitāni tadā drutam ।।27।।
āranālādīni cāpi caṭanyo vividhāstathā ।
kṣāracaṇakamāṣādyāstatra śṛtāstathāvidhāḥ ।।28।।
śākānyapi vividhāni bhājā bhājyastathāvidhāḥ ।
murabbārasasārāśca rāyatāni bahūnyapi ।। 29।।
dadhighṛtanavanītapāyasakṣīratakrakam ।
sarvaṃ yathāpekṣakaṃ tu pakvāpakvaṃ vidhāpitam ।। 2.238.30।।
sarvābhirbrahmayoṣidbhirlakṣmībhiḥ kanyakādibhiḥ ।
satībhiḥ siddhibhiścāpi sarvaṃ kṛtvoparakṣitam ।।3 1।।
ghaṭikāpañcamadhye tu sarvaṃ sampāditaṃ hitam ।
prārthayāmāsurīśvaryaḥ śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।।32।।
vartate sarvamevā'tra siddhaṃ vibhinnajātikam ।
vaiśvadevaṃ vidhehi tvaṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ prakāraya ।।3 3।।
bhojanārthaṃ janānāṃ vai paṃktayaḥ santu sarvataḥ ।
madhyāhne bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hi rādhike ।।34।।
snātvā kṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tarpitvā'gniṃ ca pitṛkān ।
tarpitvā devatāḥ sarvā ghaṇṭānādamakārayat ।।31।।
āgacchantu mahābhāgā bhojanārthaṃ hi paṃktiṣu ।
yathājñaṃ sarvapātrāṇi tadā'bhavan hi paṃktiṣu ।। 36।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye'pi mānavāḥ ।
āyayustatra śīghraṃ vai bhojanārthaṃ samantataḥ ।। 37।।
brāhmaṇebhyo brahmavargāḥ pariveṣaṇamācaran ।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ naranārīḥ samastataḥ ।। 38।।
dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau tebhyo bālakṛṣṇo hi mudrikāḥ ।
laḍaḍu'kān śaṣkulīścāpi śatacchidrāṇi khājakān ।। 39।।
meśubhān mohanasthālān parpikākhaṇḍakāँstathā ।
piṇḍakān guḍakān śreṣṭhān granthikān modakāँstathā ।।2.238.40 ।।
kalikālaḍaḍu'kāँścāpi mudgalaḍaḍūँ'śca maṇḍakān ।
sohilakāँśca saṃyāvaṃ kaṃsāraṃ ghṛtapūrakān ।।41।।
sevikāḥ polikā miṣṭāḥ pūrikāḥ pāyasaṃ tathā ।
virañjaṃ sukhadāṃ pheṇīṃ gundrapākamapūpakān ।।42।।।
pūpāँśca ghurghurāṃścāpi vaṭakān tilapiṣṭakān ।
śāṭakān sthirakāँścāpi rambhācūtaphalāni ca ।।43।।
śākāni bhiṇḍakān svarṇadugdhāṃ kośātakīṃ tathā ।
rājakośātakīṃ gavāhārāँśca mārgarīṃ tathā ।।44।।
karkoṭikāṃ śimbikāṃ ca karkaṭīṃ cirbhaṭaṃ tathā ।
raktāluṃ rājamāṣādīn śimbībimbīphalāni ca ।।45।।
śarkarākandamevāpi kharbūjaṃ kāravellakam ।
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ sūraṇaṃ cāpi muniśimbīḥ paṭolakam ।।46।।
karkaṭīrmethikāścāpi pāravallaṃ ca mūlakam ।
śatapuṣpāmamblaloṇīṃ jīvantīṃ syandikāṃ tathā ।।47।।
vṛntākaṃ bharjitaṃ cāpi rājikāktāni yāni ca ।
drākṣākhārikasammiśrān dadhimiśravaṭīvaṭān ।।48।।
puṣpavaṭīśca bhojyāni saurabhodanamityapi ।
sūpaḥ kvathikāstakrāṇi dadhimanthāni yāni ca ।।49।।
talitān harimanthāँśca niṣpāvān parpaṭāँstathā ।
navanītaṃ cāranālaṃ caṭanīṃ dhānyakādijām ।।2.238.50।।
dugdhaṃ ca kvathitaṃ miṣṭaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ sakesaram ।
marīcāni sutiktāni tathailākaṇakāni ca ।।91।।
bhūphalīśarkarābījānyapi vallān vaṭāṇakān ।
kalikā miṣṭapolīśca ghārikā miṣṭajambukān ।।52।।
roṭakān mūśalīpākān vāsudevīṃ ca mallikām ।
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ taralāṃ cāpi māṣalaḍaḍūn kalāvakam ।।53।।
ekottaraśataṃ tatra padārthān vāḍavādayaḥ ।
bhuktvā tṛptiṃ parāṃ prāpya yayurgṛhāṇi vai tataḥ ।।54।।
kṣatriyā vaiśyavargāśca śūdrā bubhujire mudā ।
dīnā anāthavargāśca bhikṣukāśca nirāśritāḥ ।।55।।।
dāsavargā dāsikāśca sarvā bubhujire tadā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrasthitā bubhujire'khilāḥ ।।56।।
tatra tatra padārtheṣu nyūnaṃ naiva prajāyate ।
vardhate tvakṣaye pātre vastuni pariveṣite ।।57।।
akṣayaṃ cā'vyayaṃ sarvaṃ dīyamānaṃ prajāyate ।
maharṣayastathā santaḥ sādhvyo bubhujire tathā ।।58।।
ābālavṛddhagopālāḥ sarve bubhujire tadā ।
kṣetrapālā devatādyāḥ sarve bubhujire'pi ca ।।59 ।।
hareḥ sarvaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca bubhuje śrīśavāñcchayā ।
brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca bhojayituṃ priyaṃ patim ।।2.238.60।।
sotsāhāścāyayurbālakṛṣṇasvāmipurastadā ।
svarṇapaṭṭikasaṃsthāni pātrāṇi ca hareḥ kṛte ।।61 ।।
pakvānnapūrṇakānyeva nyadhurhareḥ puraśca tāḥ ।
svarṇāsane hariḥ samyaṅniṣadyorṇosane prabhuḥ ।।62।।
bhoktuṃ cācamya ca samārebhe vyāhṛtipūrvakam ।
ārcican śrīhariṃ tāścandanakuṃkumakesaraiḥ ।।63 ।।
bhojayāmāsuratyarthaṃ premālyaścātibhāvataḥ ।
lakṣmīrviśālaṃ sthālaṃ ca kānakaṃ nidadhau puraḥ ।।64।।
rādhe tvayā samantācca sthāpitā laghuvāṭikāḥ ।
māṇikyā kalaśaṃ pānapātraṃ jalayutaṃ nyadhāt ।।65।।
ramā ca vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā vāyudānaṃ karoti hi ।
padmāvatī naktakaṃ ca dhṛtvā pārśve sthitā'bhavat ।।66।।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvāḥ sarvadeśodbhavāstadā ।
vidadhurvai padārthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pariveṣaṇam ।।67।।
annapūrṇādikā devyaḥ prāhuḥ śrīparameśvaram ।
bhuṃkṣva nātha kṛpākānta didṛkṣāmo'tra bhāvitāḥ ।।68।।
atha kṛṣṇaḥ kare kṛtvā kavalaṃ bubhuje mudā ।
aho miṣṭamaho bhojyaṃ kayedaṃ randhitaṃ śubham ।।69।।
pṛṣṭvā tatkartrīnāmāni praśaśaṃsa tu tā muhuḥ ।
atisvādu kṛtaṃ cedaṃ praśaṃsya bubhuje punaḥ ।।2.238.70 ।।
brahmapriyādyāḥ sarvāśca bhuñjānaṃ dadṛśurharim ।
vīkṣamāṇāḥ prāṇapatimāścaryaṃ lebhire striyaḥ ।।71 ।।
svalpaṃ bhuktvā samutthātuṃ samaihata yadā hariḥ ।
śāradā taṃ sthāpayantī jagau bhuṃkṣveti kīrtanam ।।72।।
sarasvatī savāditrā prītaye śrīhareḥ puraḥ ।
jagau bhojanapadyāni bhojayituṃ viśeṣataḥ ।।73।।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ।
kavalaṃ gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇa miṣṭamiṣṭamenam,
prāsvādaya prakṛṣṭasaurabhānnakūṭam ।।74।।
pumarthadātṛ bhagavan prabhuṃkṣva kāmametat,
samastapakvametat re jīvana yogin ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ।।75।।
meśubhamohanasthālaṃ rasālapāyasānnaṃ,
suśaṣkulīṃ ca pheṇīṃ śrīkhaṇḍamiṣṭapolīm ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kāntajīvana yogin ।।76।।
suparpikāṃ rasāḍhyāṃ ca modakān virañjaṃ,
sugundrapākamiṣṭaṃ suśāṭakāṃśca ghurghurān ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta jīvana yogin ।।77।।
svādumiṣṭacaṇakān surājamāṣavaṭakān,
praśākabhājikādiprabhojyapuṣpavāṭīḥ ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ।।78।।
parparāँśca caṭanīṃ śubhā''ranālakāni,
sutakradugdhakāni samastabhojanāni ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ।।79।।
sugandhi vāri miṣṭaṃ sūpaudanaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ,
praphullapūrikādiprapakvaghurghurādīn ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha jīvana yogin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta hṛdayeśa yogin ।।2.238.80।।
elālavaṃgamiśraṃ tāmbūlakaṃ sudhāktaṃ,
cā''kaṇṭhapūrtamadyaṃ prabhuṃkṣva dehi śiṣṭam ।
bhojanaṃ vidhehi nātha vallabha svāmin,
prasādaṃ pradehi kānta kāmaneśa bhogin ।।8 1।।
ityevaṃ rādhike sarvā bhojayāmāsa satpatim ।
bhagavān vubhuje pūrṇaṃ tataḥ sarvā api striyaḥ ।।82।।
kavalāni kare kṛtvā bhojanāya nijaṃ patim ।
viśvaṃbharaṃ prasahyaiva yatnaṃ tatra pracakrire ।।83।।
yogeśvaro haristāsāṃ tādṛṅmānasasiddhaye ।
sarvapatnīsamasaṃkhyasvarūpo'bhūdasaṃkhyakaḥ ।।84।।
sarvāsāṃ brahmapatnīnāṃ karebhyaḥ kavalāni tu ।
bubhuje samakālena snehena tāḥ prarañjayan ।।85।।
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ cāpi pratyekakarato hariḥ ।
papau prajagṛhe tatra pūrṇakāmāśca tāstataḥ ।।86।।
atha sarvasakhībhyaśca pakvānnāni muhurmuhuḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa bhagavān prasādāni kareṇa vai ।।87।।
bhojayitvā ca tāmbūlarasaṃ tāmbūlakāni ca ।
pāyayāmāsa tāḥ sarvāḥ koṭyarbudābjakanyakāḥ ।।88।।
kṛtakṛtyāśca tā jātā brahmapriyāstathā'parāḥ ।
pariveṣaṇakartryaśca pākakartryastathā striyaḥ ।।89।।
pākasāhāyyakartryaśca vastuhāriṇya ityapi ।
vastūdbhāvanakartryaśca rasadā yoṣitastathā ।।2.238.90।।
annapūrṇādibhistatra yā yāścākāritāstu tāḥ ।
sarvāḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaprasādaṃ durlabhaṃ hyapi ।।91 ।।
sulabhaṃ prāpya ca bubhujire tṛptiṃ gatāśca tāḥ ।
evaṃ bhuktvā tvannakūṭaṃ pracakruḥ parihārakam ।।92।।
jalajantubhya evāpi dadau prasādamuttamam ।
pakṣibhyaśca paśubhyaśca kīṭādibhyaḥ samantataḥ ।।93।।
pradadau bhagavāँstatra prasādaṃ tvanivāritam ।
vṛkṣebhyo vanavallībhyaḥ stabakebhyaḥ samantataḥ ।।94।।
dravatprāsādikaṃ khādyaṃ dadau mūleṣu vai hariḥ ।
prasādagrahaṇārthaṃ vai devā maharṣayastathā ।।95।।
pitaraścāpi muktāśca divyadehāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
yatra yatra prasādaḥ sa dṛṣṭastatra tathāvidhāḥ ।।96।।
bhūtvā te jagṛhuḥ sarve prasādaṃ tvaprakāśitāḥ ।
evaṃ cānugrahaṃ prāpya svasvalokān yayurhi te ।।97।।
tāḥ sarvāḥ siddhayo bhuktvā labdhvā''jñāṃ pārameśvarīm ।
mahānasapradeśasya tirobhāvaṃ vyadhustadā ।।98।।
sarvaṃ vai līnatāṃ yātaṃ nagarī tṛptimāgatā ।
jayakāraṃ jagau kṛṣṇavallabhasya suharṣitā ।।99।।
tato nijālayaṃ gatvā viśrāntimāpureva tu ।
evaṃ mahotsavaṃ cakre rādhike kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 2.238.10 0।।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya tvannakūṭaphalaṃ labhet ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi bālakṛṣṇasya tarpaṇāt ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīhariṇā'nnakūṭotsavo vihitaḥ sarvaprajābhojanādi kāritaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 238 ।।
