adhyāyaḥ 239
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 240 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha śṛṇu cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ ।
kārtikaikādṛśīrātriprānte vyadhāttu yaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
puṇḍarīko'bhavadrājā gaurjaro vaiṣṇavo mahān ।
sarvadharmānvito rājyamapālayanmahītaṭe ।। 2 ।।
prātaḥ pūjāṃ karotyeva viṣṇorlakṣmyāḥ suvastubhiḥ ।
sādhūn vṛddhān pūjayitvā gṛhṇāti bhojanaṃ sadā ।। 3 ।।
nityamatithayastasya gṛhe cāyānti yānti ca ।
harernāmnāṃ bhajanaṃ ca kṛtvā tvannāni bhuṃjate ।। 4 ।।
harerjayantikāhānāṃ karotyapi vratāni ca ।
rājñā tena nije rājye śrāvitaḥ paṭahaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ekādaśyāstu yāvatyaḥ kāryā aśanavarjitāḥ ।
sarvābhirvai prajābhiśca vṛddhabālāturān vinā ।। 6 ।।
prajāḥ sarvāstadājñāṃ ca pālayantyeva sadvratāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyaśca prajāstasya bhajante ca vrate harim ।। 7 ।।
sa rājā tīrthayātrārthaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ।
kārtikaikādaśī tena kṛtā kṣetre'kṣarābhidhe ।। 8 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikāyāṃ sa daśamyāmabhigamya ca ।
bhojayāmāsa sādhūँśca viprāṃśca bālakṛṣṇakam ।। 9 ।।
pūjayāmāsa bhaktyaiva lomaśaṃ carṣimaṇḍalam ।
tīrthe'vagāhanaṃ cakre cakre devādidarśanam ।।2.239.1 0।।
vyalokayat sa nagarīṃ divyāṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ cakārāpi sarovarasya sarvataḥ ।। 11 ।।
taṭasthadevatāḥ sarvāḥ pūjayāmāsa vastubhiḥ ।
rātrau tvārārtrikaṃ cakre sarovarasya bhūpatiḥ ।। 12।।
viśrāntiṃ prāpa śālāyāṃ prātarutthāya satvaram ।
kṛtāhnikaḥ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtavipraprapūjanaḥ ।। 13 ।।
kṛtatīrthavidhiḥ kṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ yayau tadā ।
pūjayāmāsa bāleśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।। 14।।
dadau dānānyanantāni svarṇarūpyāmbarāṇi ca ।
viprebhyaḥ pradadau tairthikebhyo rājā dhanāni ca ।। 16।।
sādhubhyo'mbarapātrāṇi dīnebhyo'pekṣitāni vai ।
godānāni dadau cāpi hyannadānānyapi nṛpaḥ ।। 16।।
udyāpanaṃ vratasyāpi kārayāmāsa satphalam ।
suvarṇaghaṭakādānādi svarṇamūrtipradānakam ।। 17।।
dhanadhānyāmbarapātradānaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāśravaṇaṃ tathā ।। 18।।
lomaśasyā''śrame gatvā cakāra divase nṛpaḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanaṃ cakre sādhvīnāṃ sevanaṃ tathā ।। 1 9।।
bhaktānāṃ vandanaṃ rājā cakre sāyaṃ prapūjanam ।
ārārtrikaṃ cakārāpi rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhāt ।।2.239.20।।।
nirjalaśca nirāhāraḥ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।
rātrau ca bhajanaṃ cakre tālīvādanapūrvakam ।। 21।।
'harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa parameśa pareśvara ।
kāṃbhareya paramātman śrīmadgopālanandana ।।22।।।
brahmapriyāpate lakṣmīpate rādhāpate prabho ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmipate vibho' ।।23।।
evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ raṭaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tadā ।
dadhyau svahṛdaye sākṣād dṛṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।।24।।
āprātarbhajanaṃ kṛtvā dhyānamagno babhūva ha ।
anugāśca yayuḥ sarve snānārthaṃ ca sarovare ।। 25।।
rājā brāhme muhūrte svahṛdaye śrīnarāyaṇam ।
dhyātvā so'haṃ ca so'haṃ ca so'haṃ so'haṃ jajāpa ha ।। 26।
so'haṃ haṃsaśca haṃsaśca haṃsahaṃsaṃ jajāpa ca ।
bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ śrutvā jāpaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ ।। 27।।
prasanno'bhūd drutaṃ smṛtvā haṃsarūpaṃ purātanam ।
babhūva śīghraṃ tatraiva haṃsarūpo hariḥ svayam ।। 28।।
śuklavarṇaḥ śuklakāntiḥ śuklahaṃsasvarūpavān ।
divyamānuṣavaktraśca haṃsadehaḥ śriyā yutaḥ ।। 29।।
rūpānurūpāvayavaḥ koṭikandarpasundaraḥ ।
sarvavidyāśevadhiśca tathā vedādiśevadhiḥ ।।2.239.3 0।।
śanaiḥ śanaiśca padbhyāṃ sa cāyayau nṛpasannidhau ।
rājā svahṛdaye deśaṃ dadarśa sarasastaṭam ।। 31 ।।
haṃsamāyāntamevāpi lakṣmīṃ dadarśa pārśvagām ।
āścaryapūrṇahṛdayaḥ premapūritavigrahaḥ ।।32।।
utthāya bhagavantaṃ taṃ cābhiyātuṃ tvarānvitaḥ ।
abhavattāvadevā'sau jāgradbhāvaṃ gato'bhavat ।।।33।।।
netre conmīlya yāvatsa rādhe paśyati sannidhau ।
paśyati sma mahātejaḥpuñjaṃ dikṣu samantataḥ ।। 34।।
tejo yogye svake netre hyajāyetāṃ kṣaṇāntare ।
tatastejogarbhake sa dadarśa jagatāṃ patim ।। 35।।
śvetavarṇaṃ haṃsarūpaṃ hasantaṃ śrīsamanvitam ।
utthāya sahasā rājā papāta daṇḍavat tadā ।।36 ।।
kṛtārtho'smītyabhidhāya mukhe pādarajo nyadhāt ।
luluṇṭha bhūtale'syāpi pādayoḥ sannidhau muhuḥ ।।37।।
netrāśrūṇi mumocā'pi harṣeṇa mahatā nṛpaḥ ।
lakṣmīḥ kamaṇḍalorvāri nṛpamūrdhyanyabhisiṣeca ha ।।38।।
prasādaṃ prāpya rājā tajjalaṃ harṣānvitaḥ papau ।
kṛtakṛtyo'bhavatprāpya darśanaṃ prajagāda ha ।।39।।
ahobhāgyamahobhāgyaṃ rājadehasya me nvidam ।
yaddṛṣṭau paramānandaḥ pūrṇabrahma pareśvara ।।2.239.40।।
haṃsarūpaḥ śriyāyuktaḥ sākṣātkaruṇayā''gataḥ ।
pāvito'haṃ mokṣito'haṃ samuddhṛto'smi sāgarāt ।।41 ।।
ityuktvā caraṇau dhṛtvā haṃsasya maunamāvahat ।
haṃsaḥ prāha varaṃ rājan vṛṇu yatte'bhivāñcchitam ।42।।।
rājā prāha hare cātra mokṣaṃ dehi pade naya ।
name vāñcchā'sti rājyasya lokaiṣaṇā na vidyate ।।43 ।।
anyaiṣaṇāstu sampūrṇā vartante mokṣamāvaha ।
yallābho yogināṃ nāsti yugakāle gate'pi ca ।।44।।
sa lābho'dya mayā prāptaścaikādaśīvratena ha ।
tasmād dehi kṛpāsindho mokṣaṇaṃ sarvathā'tra me ।।46 ।।
rādhike rājavākyāni svīkṛtya parameśvaraḥ ।
tathā'stviti hasanprāha tāvadrājānugādayaḥ ।।47।।
āyuyurvīkṣya tejāṃsi taṃ hariṃ samalokayan ।
kṛtakṛtyā hi te jātā vīkṣya haṃsasvarūpiṇam ।।47।।
tāvat tatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ sūryavarculam ।
rājā dehaṃ vihāyaiva muktadehamavāpa ha ।।48।।
caturbhujo viṣṇutulyo vimānastho'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
rājñī tasyāstadā śīghraṃ vimānaṃ svakareṇa vai ।।49।।
saha yātuṃ dadhāraiva sparśamāptā'pi sā tadā ।
tyaktvā bhautikadehaṃ svaṃ divyadehā babhūva ha ।।2.239.50।।
vimānaṃ śīghramevāpi tatastatrā'mbare'bhavat ।
haṃsaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo'pi viṣṇuścaturbhujo'bhavat ।।51 ।।
tadvimānena rājānaṃ ninye vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpeṇa sarastīre sthito'bhavat ।।52।।
tejo vilīnatāṃ yātaṃ sārtho'pyāścaryamāptavān ।
dehakriyāṃ pracakruśca sārthāḥ sarve nṛpānugāḥ ।।53।।
tato yayurnijaṃ deśaṃ putraṃ jagadurbhūbhṛtaḥ ।
vṛttāntaṃ sarvamevainaṃ punaḥ śrutvā mumoda ha ।।54।।
rādhike haṃsatīrthaṃ tattvaśvapaṭṭasarojale ।
abhavad dakṣiṇe pūrve koṇe muktipradaṃ śubham ।।55।।
snānāddānādavagāhājjalapānānniṣevaṇāt ।
bhuktiḥ svargaṃ ca muktiśca bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।56।।
ātmajñānaṃ bhavettatra snānātpānājjalasya ca ।
yajñapuṇyaṃ bhaveccāpi haṃsatīrthe'nnadānataḥ ।।57।।
dvādaśyāṃ tvekasādhorhi bhojanātpuṇyamuttamam।
śatasādhubhojanasya puṇyaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।।58।।
ekādaśyāṃ phaladānāt svarṇadānasamaṃ phalam ।
svarṇadānād rājasūyasamaṃ cātra bhavet phalam ।।59।।
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tvanyaṃ camatkāraṃ mahāprabhoḥ ।
rolākhyaścotkalarājastīrthārthaṃ somanāthakam ।।2.239.6 0 ।।
samāyayau svasainyena bahumāsaiḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
somanāthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ kṛtvā prācīsarasvatīm ।।61।।
mūladvārikikātīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca vāmanasthalīm ।
bhadrāvatīmahātīrthaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumavāpikām ।।62।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ samāyayau ।
sāyamāgatya vidhinā kṛtvā tīrthaṃ jalaṃ pāpau ।।63 ।।
sainyaṃ tṛptaṃ jalapānād rātrau bhojanamāpa saḥ ।
devā''rārtrikanādāँścā'śṛṇot sādhukṛtān stavān ।।64।।
rātrau viśrāntimāsādya tato nidrāvaśo'bhavat ।
suptaṃ sainyaṃ cotthitaṃ ca prātastaṭākaprāṅtaṭe ।।65।।
udyānaḥ phalapūṣpāṇāmāsīttatrāśvaśūṇḍhinaḥ ।
udyādyāḥ paśavo rājñastṛṇāni carituṃ yayuḥ ।।66।।
udyānavṛkṣaḥ paśubhirbhakṣitā nāśitā api ।
rājā sūryodaye bhūtvā vinidro'śvasaro yayau ।।67।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā svaniveśamupāyayau ।
tāvannityaṃ prapūjāṃ sa yasyāḥ karoti bhūpatiḥ ।।68।।
śrīnṛsiṃhapratimāyāḥ sā tatra'dṛśyatāṃ gatā ।
rājā śuśoca manasā'parāddhaṃ tvatra vai mayā ।।69।।
nānyathā pratimālopo bhavedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
sa tu tuṣṭāva nṛhariṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।।2.239.70।।
kathaṃ nātha kṛpāpārāvāra ruṣṭo'dya vai mayi ।
na jāne tvaparāddhaṃ kiṃ mayā'tra yadgato bhavān ।।71 ।।
mariṣyāmyadanaṃ tyaktvā grahīṣye na jalaṃ phalam ।
aparāddhurbhavedeva prāyaścittamidaṃ mama ।।72।।
evaṃ pravadite tena vyomavāṇī hyajāyata ।
atra rājan phalapuṣpodyānaṃ pūrvadiśi dhruvam ।73।।।
kṛṣṇavallabhakṛṣṇasya vidyate paramātmanaḥ ।
tannāśastvatpaśvādyairvai kriyate paśya mā ciram ।।74।।
nivāraya drutaṃ tāँśca mahodyānaṃ prakāraya ।
aparāddhaṃ tvayā tvetacchṛṇu cānyattvayā kṛtam ।।75।।
atra pūjā tvayā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya no kṛtā ।
ahaṃ yasyā'vatāro'smi sa me'vatārakāraṇam ।।76।।
tamapūjya mama pūjā yadi syāt te'parādhanam ।
tato'haṃ vilayaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvaṃ taṃ tvaṃ prapūjaya ।।77।।
tato māṃ sampūjayā'tra tena tuṣṭo bhavāmi te ।
mama mūrti sthāpayā'tra tvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।।78।।
mandire śobhane tatra nivatsye kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
udyānasya prarakṣyārthaṃ vanyarakṣārthamityapi ।।79।।
tato'haṃ vai tvayā sārdhamāgamiṣyāmi nā'nyathā ।
ityukto rādhike rājā vyomavāṇīṃ prapūjya ca ।।2.239.80।।
tūrṇaṃ sainyāntikaṃ gatvā vārayāmāsa tān paśūn ।
vīkṣya bhagnaṃ samudyānaṃ paraṃ śokaṃ jagāma saḥ ।।81 ।।
vṛttāntaṃ sainyapālebhyo vinivedya tato drutam ।
ājñāpyodyānarakṣārthaṃ navodyānābhiklṛptaye ।।82।।
śīghraṃ prāsādanirmityai tathā''jñāṃ sampradāya ca ।
pūjāsāmagrikāyukto bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau ।।83।।
rolamāyāntamāvīkṣya hasan jagāda satpatiḥ ।
rola! rājan! kadā tvasmin kṣetre prāpto bhavān vada ।।84।।
kaścinnirāmayaṃ te'sti tava sainyasya vai punaḥ ।
kaccit sukhinaḥ paśavo mānavā yātrikāstava ।।85।।
bhojanaṃ madgṛhe tvadya gṛhāṇa tvaṃ nareśvara ।
ityukto rolarājaḥ saḥ vimucyā'śrūṇi cāha tam ।।86।।
nārāyaṇa kṛpāsindho'parāddhaṃ te mayā'tra vai ।
udyāno nāśitaḥ sainyapaśubhistatkṣamāṃ kuru ।।87।।
kārayiṣyāmi codyānaṃ kārayiṣyāmi mandiram ।
nṛsiṃhasya tava mūrteḥ sthāpanaṃ sarvadā tviha ।।88।।
kṣetrodyānasya rakṣārthaṃ yāsyāmi ca svarāṣṭrakam ।
tava pūjāṃ vinā kṛṣṇa nṛsiṃho me layaṃ gataḥ ।।89।।
tamimaṃ me'parāddhaṃ prakṣamasva puruṣottama ।
ityuktvā rādhike śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ samārcayat ।।2.239.90।।
rājaveṣāmbarabhūṣāgandhamālā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।
daṇḍavat pracakārā'tha naivedyaṃ piṇḍakān dadau ।।9 1 ।।
tāmbūlakaṃ dadau cāpi prasādaṃ jagṛhe hareḥ ।
kṣamitaṃ ceti hariṇā prokto nijālayaṃ yayau ।।92।।
tāvannṛsiṃhabhagavān mūrtirūpo nijāsane ।
prakaṭībhūya nṛpateḥ pūjāṃ jagrāha bhāvataḥ ।।93।।
rājā'pi kārayāmāsa mandiraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam ।
nṛsiṃhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mandire vṛttikāṃ dadau ।।94।।
udyānaṃ ropayitvā ca niyujya rakṣakaṃ tataḥ ।
yayau cotkaladeśaṃ sa rādhike kṛṣṇabhaktimān ।।95।।
evaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ tat sarovarajale'bhavat ।
rolatīrthaṃ suramyaṃ tanmandiraṃ nṛharestathā ।।96।।
sarvaṃ tīrthamayaṃ cā'bhūd bālakṛṣṇapratāpataḥ ।
tatra snānaprakartāro bhuktiṃ muktiṃ śubhāṃ gatim ।।97।।
yāsyantyeva hi dātāro phalānāṃ śākhiropiṇaḥ ।
puṣpastabakaropāśca mahodyānavidhāyinaḥ ।।98।।
prayāsyanti hi te sarve brahmadhāmā'kṣaraṃ ghruvam ।
vṛkṣamūle jalasekaprakartāro'pi mānavāḥ ।।99।।
svargaṃ prāpya ciraṃ bhuktvā yāsyanti tvakṣaraṃ mama ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsyodyānaropaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 2.239.10 0।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre yatra kvāpi kṣitau taṭe ।
vṛkṣavallīropiṇo ye te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim ।। 10 1।।
avaṃśā vaṃśamāpsyanti nirdhanā dhaninastathā ।
arasā rasapūrṇāśca bhaviṣyanti drupālanāt ।। 1 02।।
dhanadhānyasamṛddhāśca phalamiṣṭānnabhojinaḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti vṛkṣaropādaśvapaṭṭasarontike ।। 1 03।।
rādhike vṛkṣapātāro bhavantyete mama priyāḥ ।
vaneṣu vallavīvrāte phale puṣpe vasāmyaham ।। 1 04।।
vṛkṣarakṣakalokānāṃ gṛhe lakṣmīsamanvitaḥ ।
vasāmyahaṃ na sandehastannāśe'pasarāmi hi ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kārtikaikādaśīvratena puṇḍarīkanṛpaterhaṃsarūpahariṃ prāptasya mokṣaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi haṃsatīrtham, colarājñā'pi nṛsiṃhayogenā'śvapaṭṭasarastīre nṛsiṃhasthāpanaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।239।।


← adhyāyaḥ 239 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 240
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 241 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ śriyaḥpateḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre jātaṃ yogeśvaraṃ prati ।। 1 ।।
vītihotro mahoyogī vane yogeśvaro'bhavat ।
himācale badaryāṃ sa tapastepe'tidāruṇam ।। 2 ।।
sarvayogakalāḥ prāpa yathā śaṃbhustathā'bhavat ।
tena yogapratāpena dṛṣṭā vai divyacakṣuṣā ।। 3 ।।
ketumāle kṛtā yajñāḥ kenāṭe'pi kṛtā makhāḥ ।
amarīṇāṃ pradeśeṣu kṛtaṃ yaddhariṇā tu tat ।। 4 ।।
ūrjākṛṣṇāṣṭamījanmamahotsavaśca yaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
śāradāpūjanādyaṃ ca hyannakūṭamahotsavaḥ ।। 5 ।।
etatsarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā vijñāya parameśvaram ।
kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sākṣādupāyayau ।। 6 ।।
āyayau kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇam ।
sahasrarūpadhartā'sau vītihotraḥ samādhimān ।। 7 ।।
mārgaśīrṣatṛtīyāyāmaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
setumāśritya ca nyagrodhasyā'dho'dhānnijāsanam ।। 8 ।।
sahasrarūpadhartā'sau saṃkalpya niṣasāda ha ।
mama mūlasvarūpaṃ cāgatyā''śliṣyet ramāpatiḥ ।। 9 ।।
tataḥ sahasrarūpaiścā''śliṣyenmā sa prabhuḥ punaḥ ।
ṛṣabhasya kārayenye sadgurordarśane yadi ।। 2.240.10 ।।
tadā'haṃ śrīhareragre nivatsye'tra sadā'nugaḥ ।
mokṣaṃ prasādhayiṣye'tra badaryā na prayojanam ।। 11 ।।
na guroraparasyāpi mokṣado hi gururyataḥ ।
yatrātmano bhavetpuṣṭiryena tarati sāgaram ।। 13 2।।
yasmāccātmamahāśāntistaṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ ।
yasmātpāpavināśaśca yasmādajñānanāśanam ।। 13 ।।
yasmād vṛttinirodhaśca vāsanākṣapaṇaṃ yataḥ ।
yasmādātmaprakāśaśca taṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ ।। 14।।
yasmācchikṣāmavāpyetaiśvaryaṃ camatkṛtiṃ tathā ।
divyayabhāvamadhitiṣṭhettaṃ guruṃ tvāśrayejjanaḥ ।। 15।।
guravo bahavaḥ santi laukikāścāpyalaukikāḥ ।
laukikena hi lokasthāḥ kāryā vai guravo yathā ।। 15 ।।
alaukikena śiṣyeṇā'laukikā guravo dhṛtāḥ ।
mayā'pyalaukikaḥ so'yaṃ kartavyo bhagavān guruḥ ।। 17।।
yatra sarvaṃ hi kartavyaṃ harau parisamāpyate ।
mātā gururhi janudā pitā gururhi bījadaḥ ।। 18।।
anye rakṣākarāḥ santi dehasya guravo hi te ।
bhāṣājñānakarāścānye bāndhavādyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
tathā śikṣākarāścānye vidyādānakarā api ।
kalākauśalyaśikṣāyā dātāro guravo'pi ca ।। 2.240.20 ।।
ta ete dehayātrāyāṃ bhavanti guravaḥ khalu ।
ātmajñānaprado yastu viṣṇumantrapradaśca yaḥ । । 21 ।।
dharmavṛttiprado yaśca guruḥ śreṣṭho hi sammataḥ ।
brahmasthitiprado yaśca yogasiddhipradaśca yaḥ ।। 22।।
vaiśāradyaprado buddhau guruḥ śreṣṭhataro hi saḥ ।
nirmalāṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā parameśapradarśakaḥ ।। 23 ।।
ātmanā paramātmānaṃ prāpako divyamokṣadaḥ ।
brahmalokapreṣakaśca guruḥ śreṣṭhatamo hi saḥ ।। 24।।
gakārastvandhamajñānaṃ rakāro jñānamujjvalam ।
ajñānahā jñānadaśca gururgauravavānmataḥ ।। 25। ।
gamayatyakṣaraṃ dhāma ramavatyapi dhāminā ।
guruḥ so'yaṃ mokṣadātā nānyaḥ śreṣṭhastato guruḥ ।। 26 ।।
gururyogī brahmacārī dharmī jñānī virāgavān ।
sādhuśīlo guruścāpi nārāyaṇaḥ paro guruḥ ।। 27 ।।
bhuktidātā mokṣadātā sarvasvado harirguruḥ ।
guroḥ sākṣātkārayitā gurorgururyato'tra saḥ । । 28।।
sa eva śrīhariścā'yaṃ muktānāṃ paramo guruḥ ।
guruḥ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca satāṃ guruḥ ।। 29 ।।
īśvarāṇāṃ tathā dhāmnāṃ yogināṃ sargasamvidām ।
pūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭikartṝṇāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ dyuvāsinām ।। 2.240.30 ।।
prajeśānāṃ karmaṭhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca paro guruḥ ।
gurūṇāṃ yāvatāmagryo nārāyaṇagurorguruḥ ।। 31 ।।
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ svāmī kāṃbhareyaḥ parātparaḥ । । 3 2।।
śrīmadgopālabālo'yaṃ svāmī vai sarvadehinām ।
mayā labdhaḥ sa me pūrṇaṃ kariṣyatyeva mānasam ।। 33 ।।
nivatsyāmi caraṇe'sya prāpsyāmi dhāma cākṣaram ।
sañcintyeti vītihotro dhyānamagnaḥ sahasradhā ।। 34।।
sahasrarūpavān jāto dṛṣṭvā taṃ mānavāstaṭe ।
snātāro'guḥ parāścaryaṃ kasyemāni samāni vai ।।35।।
rūpāṇi ke cāgatā vai yogino'tra sahasraśaḥ ।
samaveṣāḥ samadehāḥ samāṃgāḥ santi sadṛśāḥ ।। 36 ।।
samakeśāḥ samadhyānāḥ samānaparimāṇakāḥ ।
bhrātaro vā bhavantyete dhāmamuktā bhavanti vā ।। 37।।
vadarīvāsino vā'pi śvetamuktāḥ kimāgatāḥ।
śaṃkarasya gaṇāḥ kiṃvā devāstāpasarūpiṇaḥ ।। 38।।
sādhyā vā devatā yadvā meruvāsā hi tāpasāḥ ।
ka ete tu bhaveyurvai candrāsyā bhāskaraprabhāḥ ।। 39।।
dhyānayogā yogino vā yogeśvarāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
na vadanti na paśyanti na prāṇān cālayantyapi । ।2.240.40 ।।
sthiramaunāḥ sthiracittā īśvarāḥ syuśca kenvime ।
ityeva tarkayanto vai kuṃkumavāpikājanāḥ ।।41 ।।
saṃghaśo vai samāyānti draṣṭuṃ kutūhalānvitāḥ ।
kecinnamanti dṛṣṭvaiva praśaṃsanti vadanti ca ।।42।।
pratāpo'yaṃ bālakṛṣṇakṛpānāthasya vartate ।
asya darśanalābhārthaṃ nityamāyānti yoginaḥ ।।43।।
adṛśyā īdṛśāḥ sarve'dhunā te dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ ।
rudrāḥ sahasraśaścāpi viṣṇavaśca sahasraśaḥ ।।44।।
sahasraśo'pi brahmāṇo draṣṭumāyānti sadvaram ।
tathā maharṣayo nityaṃ pitaro devatāstathā ।।45।।
sādhyā viśve ca maruto draṣṭumāyānti nityaśaḥ ।
tīrthānyapi samāyānti dikpālāḥ sṛṣṭipālakāḥ ।।46।।
athavā pārṣadā divyā golokādinivāsinaḥ ।
samāyānti ca vaikuṇṭhapārṣadā api nityaśaḥ ।।47।।
grahanakṣatratārāśca sūryāścandrāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
vaimānikāḥ samāyānti lokāntarebhya ādṛtāḥ ।।48 ।।
vālakhilyāḥ samāyānti yadvā brahmasabhādvijāḥ ।
kiṃ vā bhaveyurgāndharvā yakṣā vā dhanadāśca vā ।।।49।।।
cāraṇāḥ parvatavāsā munayo vā vanasthitāḥ ।
paraṃ sādṛśyamevaiṣāmapūrvatvaṃ vigāhate ।।।2.240.50 ।।
lalāṭe vaiṣṇavaṃ puṇḍraṃ mastake tāpasī jaṭā ।
netramudrā yogapuṣṭāḥ khyāpayantyaṃśamācyutam ।।51 ।।
ye vā ke vā bhaveyuste sākṣātkṛtā yadatra te ।
asmābhirdaivayogena puṇyavadbhiḥ subhāgyakaiḥ ।।52।।।
avaśyameṣāṃ vijñānaṃ kṣaṇe'traiva bhaviṣyati ।
ityevaṃ te vadantaśca prajāḥ saṃghaśa eva ha । ।53 ।।
prapaśyanti sarastīre sahasrayoginastadā ।
atha śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo nārāyaṇagurorguruḥ ।। 54।।
samāyayau sarastīre sannidhau yogināṃ tadā ।
hārdaṃ jānaँstadā tūrṇaṃ pravīkṣya mūlarūpiṇam ।।55।।
samuttolya samāhūya nāmnā taṃ vītihotraka! ।
uttiṣṭheti karo dhṛtvā kṛtvā vakṣasi yoginam ।।56 ।।
samāśliṣyaddhasaँstūrṇaṃ svayaṃ sahasradhā'bhavat ।
samutthitaiḥ sahasrasvarūpairāśliṣyadacyutaḥ ।।57।।
tatastūrṇaṃ hariścaikasvarūpaḥ sambabhūva ha ।
vītihotro'pi sahasā tvekarūpo vyajāyata ।।58।।
āścaryacakitā lokā jayaśabdān pracakrire ।
tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇo'pi babhūva ṛṣabho guruḥ ।।59 ।।
vṛddhaḥ śvetajaṭāyukto vivastro dhūlidhūsaraḥ ।
vicitta iva conmatto jitasarvendriyo yatiḥ ।।2.240.6 0 ।।
svabhāvatejasā vyāpto brahmaniṣṭhāparaḥ pumān ।
aprākṛta iva tvāste vimanā iva dehiṣu ।।6 1 ।।
vītihotro'pi ca gurumṛṣabhaṃ vīkṣya daṇḍavat ।
cakāra bahudhā tatra tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।।69 ।।
tvaṃ gurustvaṃ cāntarātmā ṛṣabhastvaṃ ca yogirāṭa ।
yogeśvaro bhavāneva tvaṃ ceśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।।63 ।।
tvaṃ muktastvaṃ mahāmukto mukteśvaro bhavānapi ।
akṣaraṃ tvaṃ bhavān brahma parabrahma bhavānapi ।।64 ।।
bhagavān kṛṣṇa evāsi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'si ca ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।।65 ।।
avatārāḥ ṛṣabhādyāstavaiva śrīpate vibho ।
rādhāpatistvamevā'si lakṣmīpatistvameva ca ।।66 ।।
vāsudevīpatistvaṃ ca nārāyaṇīpatistathā ।
muktapatirbrahmapatirdhāmapatistvameva ca ।।67।।
mahākālasya hetustvaṃ mahāviṣṇośca kāraṇam ।
sadāśivasya hetustvaṃ vairājasya ca kāraṇam ।।68 । ।
bhūmā tvaṃ pūruṣasaṃjñaḥ puruṣottama ityapi ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ sarjako bhavān ।।6 9 । ।
devānāṃ lokapālānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ sarjako bhavān ।
maharṣīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ sarjakaḥ satām ।।2.240.7 0 ।।
satīnāṃ kamalādyānāṃ patiḥ pātā ca vai bhavān ।
surāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ ca paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।।7 1 ।।
vallīnāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca sarjakastvaṃ rasapradaḥ ।
kāmadhenukāmavallīcintāmaṇyādisarjakaḥ ।।72 ।।
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ sarjakastvaṃ khacāriṇām ।
vārijānāṃ vanasthānāṃ bhūgarbhāṇāṃ prasarjakaḥ ।।73 ।।
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sarjakastvaṃ janārdanaḥ ।
dīnā'nāthadaridrānāṃ rakṣakaḥ poṣako bhavān ।।74।।
āśritānāmannadātā śaraṇyaścārtidehinām ।
kāmukānāṃ kāmadātā sakāmānāṃ prapūrakaḥ ।।75।।
tvaṃ nārī tvaṃ naraścāsse tvaṃ garbhastvaṃ kumārakaḥ।
tvaṃ bījaṃ tvaṃ sasyarūpastvaṃ puṣpaṃ phalamityapi ।। 76 । ।
tvamindrastvamindriyastvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ jāgaro bhavān ।
tvaṃ suṣuptirmahānandastvaṃ prītistvaṃ ratistathā । । 77 ।।
manmathastvaṃ manojanyo manaḥsaṃstho bhavānapi ।
jñānaṃ jñātā jñeyameva tvamevā'si pareśvara । ।78 । ।
tvam ṛtustvaṃ dinaṃ rātristvamudyogo virāmakaḥ ।
tvaṃ viśvāsaścāśrayaśca tvaṃ mātā ca pitā guruḥ । । 79 । ।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tvamevā'si śaktirbalaṃ tvameva ca ।
nītirbhaktirvṛṣo rāgo vairāgyaṃ ca tvameva ha । ।2.240.8 0 ।।
tvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ jīvanaṃ ca naikadhā caikadhā bhavān ।
prakāśastvaṃ pravṛttistvaṃ nirodhastvaṃ guṇātmakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
guṇātītastvamevā'si sarvasiddhiguṇāśrayaḥ ।
āścaryaṃ tvaṃ camatkārastvamaiśvaryaṃ prabhutvakam ।।82 ।।
tvaṃ bhūrjalaṃ bhavāँstejo'nilastvaṃ tvaṃ tathā'nalaḥ ।
tvaṃ khaṃ tvaṃ mātrakaṃ tvaṃ ca buddhittvaṃ caiṣaṇātrayam ।।8 3 ।।
tvaṃ parīkṣā titikṣā tvaṃ tvaṃ bubhukṣā mumukṣatā ।
tvaṃ snehastvaṃ dhyānavṛttistvaṃ samādhiḥ parātparaḥ । ।84 ।।
upāstistvaṃ cittacaityaṃ tvaṃ jāḍyaṃ tvaṃ tathā'ṇutā ।
tvaṃ sāmyaṃ tvaṃ ca vaiṣamyaṃ tvameva sarvameva ha । । 85 ।।
ahaṃ tvaṃ vītihotrastvaṃ tvaṃ guruḥ ṛṣabhastathā ।
tavaivāṃ'śakalā''veśavibhūtisṛṣṭijaṃ tvidam । ।86 । ।
yat kiṃcid dṛśyate cāpi bhujyate līyate'pi ca ।
yasmād yatra ca yenāpi yadarthaṃ ca tvameva saḥ ।। 87 ।।
tasmai kṛṣṇāya nāthāya brahmaṇe parabrahmaṇe ।
samarpayāmi cātmānaṃ vītihotrābhidhaṃ sadā ।।88 ।।
dānameva na tu nyāsaṃ nāpi kusīdakaṃ tathā ।
yatheṣṭaviniyogārhaṃ samarpayāmi māṃ tvaham ।।89 ।।
iti stutvā rādhike sampapāta pādayorhareḥ ।
vītihotraścā'tha kṛṣṇastamutthāpayadūrdhvakam । । ।2.240.90 ।।
samāśliṣya punarhastau datvā tasya ca mūrdhani ।
nyayuṃkta varalābhārthaṃ vītihotraṃ hariryadā । । 91 ।।
vītihotrastadā prāha sthāsye'tra tavapādayoḥ ।
ante mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasyakṣaraṃ dhāma tava prabho ।। 92।।
dehi vāsaṃ sadā cātra tathāstūvāca vai hariḥ ।
rādhike tanmahattīrtham ṛṣabhākhyaṃ sarovare । । 93 । ।
vītihotrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ sahasrayogitīrthakam ।
evaṃ nāmnā tadevāsīt prasiddhaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham ।। 94। ।
harirbabhūva sahasā bālakṛṣṇasvarūpadhṛk ।
prayayau ca nijāvāsaṃ vītihotrastaṭe sthitaḥ ।। 95 ।।
vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśliṣya tāpaso janadarśanaḥ ।
tatra tīrthe kṛtasnānāḥ prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim ।। 96 ।।
yogasiddhimavāpsyanti yogābhyāsaṃ vinā'pi ca ।
rādhike tatra saṃsnānānnāśameṣyanti pātakam ।। 97।।
ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ mahatsvalpaṃ parapīḍākaraṃ ca yat ।
sarvaṃ naśyati pāpaṃ tajjalapānādapi drutam ।। 038 ।।
tatrā'nnadānataḥ syāttu vājimedhasamaṃ phalam ।
ṛṣabhasyā''layakarturmama dhāmā'kṣaraṃ bhavet ।। 99 ।।
ityeva bhagavānāha rādhike tīrthavaibhavam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhavettattīrthajaṃ phalam ।। 2.240.100 ।।


iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vītihotrayogeśvarāya ṛṣabharūpeṇa sahasrarūpeṇa ca harerdarśanam, ṛṣabhatīrthīkaraṇam, stutiścetyādi- nirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 240 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 240 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 241
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 242 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ camatkāraṃ prabhostataḥ ।
mārgaśīrṣasya pañcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu yo'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
akṣarādhipatestasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yaḥ ।
vāsudevābhidhaścāste'vatāro vyūhasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tasyāṃ'śaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāraneyāpāraḥ samakarṣaṇaḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇo yaḥ śāstreṣu varṇyate sa tu jāyate ।। 3 ।।
rudrarūpo muhuścāpi śaṃbhurūpastathā muhuḥ ।
pralayātmā sa evā''ste sa cāste śeṣasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 4 ।।
hariryatra praśete ca śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ।
sa eva tu mahāyogī patañjaliḥ prajāyate ।। 5 ।।
yogādeṣṭā hareraṃśaḥ patañjalimuniḥ sa vai ।
divyadeho'tra bhūmau sa kāśyāmāste sadā prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
nityaṃ prātaryogadṛṣṭyā darśanārthaṃ hareḥ sa ca ।
pūjanārthaॆ samāyāti tvaśvapaṭṭasaraḥsthalīm ।। 7 ।।
prapūjya paramātmānamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam ।
ārārtrikaṃ vidhāyaiva prasādaṃ prāpya vai tataḥ ।। 8 ।।
prayātyeva nijāvāsaṃ kṣaṇāt kāśyāṃ samādhinā ।
evaṃ nityaṃ samāyāti mahāmunipatañjaliḥ ।। 9 ।।
rādhike taṃ muniṃ tatra pūjayantaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।
dadarśa camaso nāmnā vyomnā caran hi yogirāṭ ।। 2.241.10 ।।
avātarat sa vai puthvyāṃ papraccha taṃ patañjalim ।
bhagavan pūjyate tvatra tvayā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 11 ।।
sākṣātsarvāvatārāṇāmadhīśo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
punaśca gamyate kāśyāṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā mahāprabhum ।। 12।।
vada me kāraṇaṃ vidvan tīrthārthaṃ tvahamāgataḥ ।
kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataścāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi revayā saha ।। 13 ।।
pūjayāmi prabhuṃ cāhaṃ tato yāsyāmi vai tvayā ।
ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre pupūja bālakṛṣṇakam ।। 14 ।।
pūjayitvā hyubhau cājñāmāsādyā'śvasarastaṭam ।
yayatuḥ pūrvasetau tau dhātrīvṛkṣamupāśritau ।। 1 5।।
patañjalimuniḥ prāha kāraṇaṃ kāśikāsthiteḥ ।
camasaḥ tvaṃ śṛṇu hetuṃ yato yāmi varāṇasīm ।। 1 6।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।
mahaiśvaryasvarūpā yā tvardhasvarūpadhāriṇī ।। 17।।
sarvaśaktyagragaṇyā yā sarvāsāṃ parameśvarī ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī yā'nādinī tvardhāṃganā hareḥ ।। 1 8।।
jagatāṃ brahmalokānāṃ mātā'vatārayoginām ।
duḥkhahartrī sukhakartrī muktānāṃ śaktidāyinī ।। 1 9।।
nārāyaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvasāmarthyarūpiṇī ।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ mūrdhanyā yā tu vakṣasi ।। 2.241.20 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva virājate ।
kṣaṇaṃ dūre na sā yāti vimuktā nahi jāyate ।। 21 ।।
dṛśyā'dṛśyasvarūpā yā'vinābhāvaniyojitā ।
rādhāramādidevīnāṃ sevanīyā pareśvarī ।। 22।।
sā tvāste dhṛtadehā'dya kumārī śrīhareḥ priyā ।
śivasvāmigṛhe bālā satī putrī narāyaṇī ।। 23 ।।
nāmnā tu sā dhanalakṣmīḥ sarvaduḥkhavināśinī ।
vartate sā mahīdevī samutthā divyamānavī ।। 24।।
vijayasyāpi śaśinaḥ kṛṣṇāyā sā'nujā śubhā ।
pratīkṣantī harervāṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā ।। 25।।
tasyāḥ pūjāṃ tathā sevāṃ kartuṃ dāsyaṃ prayāmi hi ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā''jñayā prayāmi vai ।। 26 ।।
camasa! tvaṃ vijānāsi yogāllabhyastu yo hariḥ ।
sa evā'yaṃ paramātmā rājate kuṃkumakṣitau ।। 27।।
asya vai darśanaṃ nityaṃ samādhirnirvikalpakaḥ ।
asya sākṣātprasevā ca samādheḥ phalamuttamam ।। 28 ।।
yamāstvasyā'nuvṛttau vai vartanaṃ sammatā mama ।
ahiṃsā śrīharergrāhyā prasannatā tadātmikā ।।29।।
satyaṃ satyasvarūpasya hareḥ sadāvalambanam ।
asteyaṃ śrīhareragre dāsyabhāvena vartanam ।।2.241.3 0।।
brahmacaryaṃ harermūrtau premṇā tallagnatā matā ।
aparigraha evāpi taṃ vinā''ptirna cetarā ।।3 1 ।।
niyamā api kṛṣṇasya paricaryātmakā mama ।
śaucaṃ tasya sparśanena hṛdaye dhāraṇena ca ।।32।।
santoṣaḥ śrīhareḥ prāptyā prasādena sadā hṛdi ।
tapastatraiva vṛttīnāṃ nirodhayatna eva ha ।।33।।
svādhyāyastasya vacanaṃ stavanaṃ bhajanādikam ।
praṇidhānaṃ ca tanmūrtau manaso nyāsa eva tu ।।34।।
ityevaṃ śrīharikṛṣṇe yamāśca niyamāḥ śubhāḥ ।
āsanaṃ vai tadājñāyāṃ saṃsthānaṃ sannidhau tathā ।।35।।
prāṇāyāmaḥ prāṇanāthe prāṇānāṃ prasamarpaṇam ।
pratyāhāraścendriyāṇāmāhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।36।।
dhāraṇā dhāryate'nādikṛṣṇo nijātmani prabhuḥ ।
dhyānaṃ harau sadā me ca pratyayasyaikatānatā ।।37।।
rūpadhyānaṃ harermūrteḥ rasadhyānaṃ hareḥ rase ।
gandhadhyānaṃ harergandhe sparśadhyānaṃ hareḥ spṛśi ।।38।।
śabdadhyānaṃ harervākye hastadhyānaṃ hareḥ kṛtau ।
pādadhyānaṃ harerarthe vāco dhyānaṃ harerguṇe ।।39।।
ratidhyānaṃ hareryoge vighnanāśo visarjanam ।
cintanaṃ hṛdaye tasya mananaṃ mānase hareḥ ।।2.241.40।।
bodhanaṃ śrīharernityaṃ cā'haṃbhāvo harau sadā ।
vāsanābhāvanālagnavṛttiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।।41 ।।
bhogastasmānmahānando nārāyaṇātpareśvarāt ।
guṇatyāgo guṇānāṃ divyatā tadyogataśca yā ।।42।।
nairguṇyaṃ śrīharerarthe yā sevā guṇato'pi vā ।
puruṣakhyātirevā'pi yaddharernityadarśanam ।।43।।
guṇavaitṛṣṇyamevāpi harerguṇeṣu lobhanam ।
vaiśāradyaṃ ca vai buddherhareḥ smṛtistu yā dhruvā ।।44।।
vṛttirodhaḥ sa evā'sti sarvatra haribhāsanam ।
samādhiśca savikalpaḥ svārthamiśraṃ hi sevanam ।।45।।
savitarkaḥ sthūlapūjā nirvitarko hi mānasī ।
savicāraḥ stotrabhaktirnirvicāro'ṅgabhāvanam ।।46।।
sānandaśca rasā''dānaṃ nirānando rasārpaṇam ।
sāsmitā svāmibhṛtyatve bhedena bhāsanaṃ harau ।।47।।
nāsmitā bhṛtyabhāvasya layaḥ kṛṣṇe sanātane ।
aikyaṃ kṛṣṇāveśitasya pārthakyaṃ na yadā mama ।।48।।
phalaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpāptiḥ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭirityapi ।
sāmīpyaṃ cā'vinābhāvaḥ sadā tatra vilīnatā ।।49।।
sarvaiśvaryacamatkārādyāptistasmānna bhinnatā ।
ityevaṃ camasaḥ prāpta sarvaṃ yogamayaṃ mayā ।।2.241.50।।
śrīharau na tato'nyadvai bhāsate ca mayi tvayi ।
bhaja tvaṃ tena bhāvena vasā'trā'śvasarovare ।।51 ।।
ityādiṣṭaścamasaratu patañjaliprayogiṇā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre sadā vāsamavācarat ।।52।।
patañjaliryayau kāśīṃ camasaśca patañjaleḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ viśramārthaṃ ca goṣṭhyarthaṃ sarasastaṭe ।।।53 ।।
pātañjalīṃ kuṭīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ cakāra kāṣṭhaparṇajām ।
pātañjalaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ loke'bhavattataḥ ।।54।।
yatra vai camaso nityaṃ karoti yogagoṣṭhikām ।
saha sthitvā śrīmatpatañjalinā yogavedinā ।।55।।
athā''yāt tatra tīrthārthaṃ rājā vaivasvato manuḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā sthānaṃ camasasya patañjaleśca pāvanam ।।56।।
mandire kārayāmāsa dṛḍhaṃ pāṣāṇajaṃ tadā ।
viśālaṃ drusamūhe vai tatra śeṣaṃ patañjalim ।।57।।
pratiṣṭhāvidhinā rājā manurasthāpayanmunim ।
śeṣanārāyaṇaṃ phaṇāsahasravrātaśobhitam ।।58।।
phaṇāsu vidyate svastikasya cihnaṃ phaṇe phaṇe ।
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ cāpi haridvarṇaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ।।59।।।
raktāsyaṃ mauktikanetraṃ śeṣikābhiḥ prasevitam ।
śobhanaṃ mṛdulaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtakuṇḍalikāsanam ।।2.241.6 0 ।।
evaṃ śeṣaṃ tathā divyaṃ muniṃ patañjaliṃ gurum ।
maharṣiṃ mandire tatra yoginaṃ cāpyatiṣṭhipat ।।61।।
tatpārśve tatpriyāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ siddhimatiṣṭhipat ।
tathā putraṃ ca yogākhyaṃ cātiṣṭhipanmanurhi saḥ ।।62।।
tathā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ gadāpadmādirājitam ।
saṃkarṣaṇīpriyāyuktaṃ mandire samatiṣṭhipat ।।63।।
rudraṃ rudrāṇikāyuktaṃ trinetraṃ cāpyatiṣṭhipat ।
īśānaṃ ceśinīyuktaṃ mandire samatiṣṭhipat ।।64।।
jīvikārthaṃ mahākṣetravāṭikāḥ pradadāvapi ।
viprāँsteṣāṃ pūjanārthaṃṃ nyayuṅkta vetanādibhiḥ ।।65।।
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ manustatra mahārudraṃ makhaṃ śubham ।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā jāpayāmāsa rudrikāḥ ।।66।।
kārayāmāsa kuṇḍāni maṇḍapāni śubhānyapi ।
āhvayāmāsa yogīndrān munīn maharṣisattamān ।।67।।
viprān kṣatrapravarāँśca surān devān prajāpatīn ।
gaṇāँśca pārṣadāँścāpi rudraśiṣyān samastakān ।।68।।
kailāsasthān samastāँśca kṣīrasthānapi sarvaśaḥ ।
śeṣajātīyanāgāँśca śāṃbhavān yogisattamān ।।69।।
yoginīdevikāścāpi satīḥ sādhvīśca sarvaśaḥ ।
avadhūtānikāścāpi mātṛkāśca samastataḥ ।।2.241.70।।
vīrabhadrādikāँścāpi nandyādīṃśca samastataḥ ।
gaṇeśān kārtikeyāँścā''hvayāmāsa makhe manuḥ ।।71 ।।
agragaśca mahācāryaḥ pulastyastatra cā'bhavat ।
mahārudrapradraṣṭā vai sarvavaidyaviśāradaḥ ।।72।।
karmaṭhāḥ ṛṣayastatra sāmagrīḥ susamarjya ca ।
svastivāco'vadan māṃgalikasvanāstathā'bhavan ।।73 ।।
dehaśuddhiśca saṃkalpaḥ kalaśārādhanaṃ tathā ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ mātṛkārcanaṃ ca tato'bhavan ।।74।।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ madhuparkastathā puṇyāhavācanam ।
vardhinīkalaśanyāso jalayātrā tato'bhavan ।।75।।
vāstunyāso maṇḍapārcā maṇḍaladevapūjanam ।
pīṭhapūjā kuṇḍapūjā vahninyāso'bhavaँstataḥ ।।76 ।।
gṛhanyāso yoginīsthāpanaṃ kṣetrapasthāpanam ।
bhūtaśuddhistathā prāṇapratiṣṭhā mātṛkānyasiḥ ।।77।।
śatarudrīyapāṭhaśca rudranīrājanaṃ tathā ।
kramahomaḥ sarvadevahomaścordhvā'rhaṇā'bhavan ।।78।।
ajākṣīreṇa vā mṛgīkṣīreṇa ceṣṭikopari ।
vāyavye koṇabhāge'rkapatreṇa havanaṃ tathā ।।79।।
adhvaryuśca paṭhan śatarudrīyaṃ ghṛtadhārayā ।
arkakṣīradhārayā ca havanaṃ śaṃbhave dadau ।।2.241.80 ।।
rudrādibhyaḥ sametebhyo devebhyo havanaṃ dadau ।
puṣpāñjalirmahāpūrṇāhutirhomo'bhavattataḥ ।।81 ।।
mandire devatānāṃ ca darśanaṃ ca nivedanam ।
abhavacca tato mahādakṣiṇā sampradānakam ।।82।।
bhojanānyabhavaँścāpi sarveṣāṃ makhavartinām ।
mahīmānasvāgataṃ cā'vabhṛthaṃ ca tato'bhavat ।।83।।
ityevaṃ rādhike vaivasvato manurhi śaṃkaram ।
śeṣaṃ patañjaliṃ saṃkarṣaṇamīśānamityapi।।84।।
mandire nūtane pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa sotsavam ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥpūrvadiśāyāṃ pāvanī sthalī ।।85।।
arkāyanī mahādivyā śeṣasthalī tato'bhavat ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva tīrthaṃ pātañjalaṃ param ।।86 ।।
cāmasaṃ tīrthamevā'pi śeṣatīrthaṃ tathā mahat ।
sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ śatarudrīyatīrthakam ।।87।।
avabhṛthaṃ mahattīrthaṃ śaṃbhutīrthaṃ sukhapradam ।
vaivasvataṃ tathā tīrthamityevamādikāni ca ।।88।।
tīrthāni cābhavan bhuktimuktipradāni sarvadā ।
suprakhyātāni jātāni tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।।89।।
gaṇāḥ snātā yatra yatra gaṇatīrthāni tāni tu ।
gaṇeśatīrthamevāpi skandatīrthaṃ tathā'bhavat ।।2.241.90।।
nāgatīrthaṃ tathā tatra pārṣadatīrthamityapi ।
satītīrthaṃ ca devikāsutīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ hyabhūt ।।9 1 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike pūrvadigbhāge tīrthamaṇḍalam ।
samudbhūtaṃ śeṣayogāt sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham ।।92।।
yatra snānājjalapānādācamanādapi spṛśeḥ ।
yogasya phaladaṃ tīrthaṃ cātmaprāptikaraṃ hyabhūt ।।93।।
tatra dānādbhavetprāptirnityakailāsakasya vai ।
tatra dīkṣāgrahaṇācca vaikuṇṭhavāsamṛcchati ।।94।।
tatra yajñāvidhānācca svargaṃ vai śāśvataṃ labhet ।
tatra mūrteḥ pratiṣṭhānāddhāma sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ labhet ।।95।।
tatra nityanivāsācca mahākālabhayaṃ na vai ।
tatra vratādikaraṇāt phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet ।।96।।
yatīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
vṛttidānād bhavenmuktiḥ śāśvatī brahmayāyinī ।।97।।
rādhike rajasā tasya snānena pāpanāśanam ।
tatpradeśe mṛtānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ devajanurmatam ।। 98।।
patañjale hara śaṃbho rudra saṃkarṣaṇa prabho ।
mano śeṣa camasa prakurvantu mama maṃgalam ।।99।।
ityuktvā prasvaped rātrau duṣṭasvapnaṃ na jāyate ।
tān smṛtvā vyavahared yastasya lābhaḥ pade pade ।। 2.241.100 ।।
prātastān saṃvicintyaiva krayavikrayavastuṣu ।
hastaṃ datvā''caret paṇyaṃ lābhastasya kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।। 101 ।।
annapūrṇā satī devī pārvatī śeṣiṇī śivā ।
sāṃkarṣaṇī yoginī ca kurvantu mama maṃgalam ।। 102 ।।
ityuktvā vyavaharet strī kumārī yuvatī ca vā ।
suvāsinī vā vidhavā tasya lābhaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।। 103 ।।
duḥkhadāridryanāśaśca pūrṇakāmatvamityapi ।
sukhasampadvaṃśavṛddhirjāyate tatkṛpālavāt ।। 1 04।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccā'sya śrāvaṇānmananādapi ।
sarvapāpavināśaśca bhuktirmuktiśca rādhike ।। 1 05।।
mānaseṣṭapralābhaśca māyānāśo'pi satvaram
ātmasiddhiḥ prajāyeta saṃkarṣaṇakṛpāvaśāt ।। 106।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne patañjalicamasayoge'śvapaṭṭasarasaḥ pūrve taṭe vaivasvatakṛtaṃ saṃkarṣaṇapatañjaliśeṣādimandiraṃ jale ca saṃkarṣaṇa-
śeṣāditīrthajātamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 241 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 242
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 243 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe kathāṃ tvanyāṃ pāvanīṃ paramā'dbhutām ।
ākṣare parame kṣetre jātāṃ cātipurātanīm ।। 1 ।।
paṃkilo nāma brahmarṣiḥ pañcakalpāyurābhavat ।
tasya mātā'bhavat sādhvī dāsī maharṣisevikā ।। 2 ।।
kumārī vyacaraccārṣe maṇḍale mṛtapitṛkā ।
ābālyādapyanāthā cā'bāndhavā mṛtamātṛkā ।। 3 ।।
brāhmaṇī brahmavetrī ca maharṣilabdhabodhikā ।
ātmaniṣṭhāparā yogeśvarī samādhisaddhanā ।। 4 ।।
sāṃkhyayogāśrayā cātmajaḍavivekaśevadhiḥ ।
samaduḥkhasukhā vṛddhasevādharmaparāyaṇā ।। 5 ।।
manasā vacasā sādhvī kāyena ca guṇairapi ।
prayatnena ca dānena ṛṣisevāparāyaṇā ।। 6 ।।
āsīdevamahājñānānaladagdhāśayā satī ।
dvandvā'bhinnā sadā dhyātrī śrīmannārāyaṇasya ca ।। 7 ।।
evaṃvidhā sā pramadā yuvatī samajāyata ।
rajobhāvavihīnā ca kāmasaṃkalpavarjitā ।। 8 ।।
brahmacaryaparā sādhvī ṛṣibhikṣā'danā śubhā ।
yasyā vastraṃ tu pavane'mbare śuṣkāyate sadā ।। 9 ।।
yasya bhikṣājolikā cāmbare vāyuṃ pralambate ।
etādṛśī camatkārasiddhirūpā'bhavaddhi sā ।। 2.242.10 ।।
aśṛṇot sā kathāṃ divyāṃ maharṣijanasaṃsadi ।
satyāḥ kathā gaṇeśasya putrabodhāṃ samāśṛṇot ।। 11 ।।
brahmaṇo mānasā jātāḥ sanakādyāśca tatkathām ।
aśṛṇodñjanīputrakathāṃ divyāṃ ca pāvanīm ।। 12।।
tataḥ sāpi putravatīkathāḥ śrutvā'vicārayat ।
mamāpi mānasaḥ putro bhavatveko guṇālayaḥ ।। 1 3।।
putravatīsabhāmadhye mānapātraṃ bhavāmi yat ।
putraphalaṃ nijaṃ syādvai yoṣitāmavalambanam ।। 14।।
mayā bhāgavataḥ putraḥ prāptavyaścetyacintayat ।
pūrvakalpe caturthe sā tretāyāṃ vāmadevataḥ ।। 15 ।।
ṛṣeḥ saṃsparśamātreṇa mānasaṃ putramāpa ha ।
agarbho jātamātraḥ sa bālo yuvā'tirūpavān ।। 1 6।।
jñānavijñānasampanno brahmacintāparāyaṇaḥ ।
vyomamārge carannitya caturvārdhyāplavakriyaḥ ।। 1 7।।
caturdhāmamahātīrthavidhyuttarā'danastathā ।
samartho mātṛvajjātaḥ pitṛvat siddhimāँstathā ।। 18 ।।
vāmadevīyasavanapraṇetā divyaśaktimān ।
dākṣīdevīṃ mātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ vāmadevakam ।। 19 ।।
hṛdaye bāhyataścāpi nityaṃ prapūjya vai tataḥ ।
nityaṃ vanyaphalādyarthaṃ vane yāti samutsukaḥ ।। 2.242.20 ।।
samitphalāni puṣpāṇi cāhṛtya gāṃgavāriṣu ।
paṃke nijāsanaṃ kṛtvā samādhau yāti vai niśi ।। 21 ।।
paṃkilastena nāmnā sa dākṣīdevyā prakīrtyate ।
paṃkilo nāma viprarṣiḥ prasiddhaḥ samajāyata ।। 22।।
ekadā paṃkamadhye sa divase'pi nijāsanam ।
kṛtvā samādhimāpannaḥ prāṇarodhena niścalaḥ ।। 23 ।।
tatrā''yātāḥ pañca satyo yadṛcchayā nadītaṭe ।
sādhvyo brahmaparāḥ śīlavratā nārāyaṇīsamāḥ ।। 24।।
yogīndrāṇyo vāmadevaśiṣyāḥ siddhisamāśrayāḥ ।
āpastambī drumastambī marutstambī tṛtīyakā ।। 25 ।।
phenastambī caturthī ca dhūmrastambī ca pañcamī ।
gaṃgājale tu tāḥ snātvā taṭe tasthuḥ kṣaṇaṃ hi tāḥ ।। 26 ।।
madhyāhne paṃkilaṃ paṃke dṛṣṭavatyaḥ kumārakam ।
ujjvalaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaṃ ca sūryavarculameva tam ।। 27।।
dhyānamagnaṃ divyarūpaṃ yoginaṃ vāmadevajam ।
bhaginyastā drutaṃ pārśve gatvā nemuśca taṃ munim ।। 28 ।।
muniścāpi samādhau tā vīkṣya nijāsanāntike ।
bahiḥ śīghraṃ samāgatyā''sanaṃ dadau nanāma ca ।। 29 ।।
bhaginyo brahmavetryaḥ sthā'grajā vande muhurmuhuḥ ।
ityuktvā pādayostāsāṃ datvā cakṣuśca mastakam ।। 2.242.30 ।।
pādadhūlīrbhaginīnāṃ mastake sa munirnyadhāt ।
svāgatārthaṃ drutaṃ saṃkalpayāmāsā''sanāni ca ।। 31 ।।
tāvattatra samāyātānyāsanānyajināni vai ।
pādyārthaṃ ca prasasmāra jalaṃ kamaṇḍalubhṛtam ।। 32 । ।
upasthitaṃ ca tattataḥ sasmāra madhuparkakam ।
miṣṭaṃ ceṣṭaṃ madhu miśphalāni śarkarādikam । । 33 ।।
upasthito madhuparko dadau tābhyastu taṃ tadā ।
pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi cāgatāni smṛtestadā ।।34।।
paṃkilaḥ pūjayāmāsa bhaginīḥ sarvavastubhiḥ ।
bhojanaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ pakvamiṣṭakalātmakam ।।35।।
sudhāmiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ cāpi pānārthaṃ pradadau tadā ।
valkalāni suramyāṇi śāṭyarthaṃ kañcukīkṛte ।।36।।
tāpasīnāṃ suyogyāni kaṃkaṇāni dadau tathā ।
āśīrvādāँstathā tāsāṃ yayāce'pi prasannatām ।।37।।
kṛtātithyāśca tāstuṣṭā bhrātre daduḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
ekā prāha tadā bhrātaḥ! kalpajīvī sukhī bhava ।। 38।।
dvitīyā'pi tathā prāha kalpajīvī sukhī bhava ।
tṛtīyā'pi caturthī ca paccamyapi ca vai tathā ।। 39।।
prāhuḥ prasannahṛdayāḥ kalpajīvī sukhī bhava ।
svasṝṇāṃ sa śubhāśīrbhiḥ pañcakalpaprajīvanaḥ ।।2.242.40।।
paṃkilarṣiḥ samabhavad rādhike svasṛpūjanāt ।
evaṃ sa pañcakalpāyurdharmajñānavirāgavān ।।41 ।।
brahmabhaktiparo loke yatheṣṭaṃ vartate ṛṣiḥ ।
kvacid yāti satyalokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ badarīṃ tathā ।।42।।
śvetadvīpaṃ tathā svargaṃ yāmyalokaṃ prayāti ca ।
aindraṃ lokaṃ sūryalokaṃ pitṛlokaṃ prayāti ca ।।43।।
kvacinmeruṃ kvacillokālokākhyabhūdharaṃ prati ।
kvacitsaptarṣilokaṃ ca dhruvalokaṃ kvacit kvacit ।।44।।
yāti cāndraṃ śītalokaṃ kvacitpātālamityapi ।
yatheṣṭaṃ paṃkilaḥ so'yaṃ viharatyeva yogirāṭ ।।45 ।।
kvacitsamādhāvevā'yaṃ varṣāyutaṃ pratiṣṭhati ।
kvacidbhūmau kvacidvārdhau vajratulyaśarīrabhṛt ।।46 ।।
kvacid vahnau kvacid vāyau kvacittiṣṭhati cāmbare ।
brahmavad brahmagatikaḥ svasṛmātṛprasevanāt ।।47।।
pitṛbalād yogabalādavyāhatagatirhyabhūt ।
anekakāyarūpaśca līnakāyo bhavatyapi ।।48।।
sūryavattu kvacid bhāti cāmbare'pi bhuvi kvacit ।
kvacid devasvarūpaśca kvacinmānavarūpavān ।।49।।
kvacicchukasvarūpaśca kvacid vṛṣabharūpavān ।
kvacinmṛgasvarūpaśca kvaciddhaṃsasvarūpavān ।।2.242.50।।
kvacitparvatatulyaśca kvacitkaṇasvarūpavān ।
evaṃ svatantravidhivān brahmaniṣṭho hi paṃkilaḥ ।।51 ।।
vāmadevasamaścāste samastaiśvaryaśevadhiḥ ।
sa cāsmin tasya vai kalpe pañcame prātareva ha ।।52।।
vicaran vyomamārgeṇa dadarśā'śvasarovaram ।
viśālaṃ nirmalajalaṃ śāntavāri mahojjvalam ।।53 ।।
candravadbhāsamānaṃ ca naikapadmasuśobhitam ।
rājahaṃsai rājaśukairmenābhirmiṣṭaśabditam ।।54।।
bhavyasetucatuḥśobhaṃ pātālā'gādhavāribhat ।
kṣīrasarasvatītīrthaṃ brahmapādodakīmayam ।।55 ।।
phalapuṣpamahodyānaiḥ samantato virājitam ।
devadevaṃ kṛtāvāsaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam ।। 56 ।।
brahmapriyābhiḥ satataṃ snānāplavaiḥ supāvitam ।
divyasopānaghāṭeśca snānā'vataraṇairyutam ।। 57।।
tāpasānāṃ sanniveśairvaṭādyaiśchāyitaṃ taṭe ।
pānīyahārikābhiśca viśvag virājitaṃ mahat ।।58 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikāpuryā paścime'kṣarasannibham ।
dakṣiṇe tu maharṣīṇāmāśramairbahupāvanam ।।59।।
uttare śivatattvānāṃ kṣetrapāṇāṃ nivāsanaiḥ ।
divyasaudhaiḥ śobhitaṃ ca pūrve sādhusatīśritam 2.242.60 ।।
yogibhiryatibhiścāpi virāgaistyāgibhistathā ।
nyāsibhiḥ satataṃ vyāptaṃ dadarśā'śvasarovaram ।। 61 ।।
dadarśa hemakalaśairmandirāṇi mahānti ca ।
samantataḥ suvarṇāḍhyān devālayān dadarśa ha ।।62।।
śuśrāva vādyanādāँśca śaṃkhaśabdān stavāँstathā ।
gītikā apsarasāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ stutivaibhavān ।। 63 ।।
śrutvā vīkṣya samastaṃ ca vyastaṃ vyomnā yathābalam ।
avātarat tato vyomnaḥ paṃkilo'śvasarovare ।। 64।।
jalaṃ pītvā tathā snātvā parāṃ śāntiṃ jagāma ha ।
smarannārāyaṇaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।।65।।
rādhike paṃkilaḥ so'yaṃ jale vāsamarocayat ।
bahiḥ sarvatra lokānāṃ sammardaśaṃkayā khalu ।। 66 ।।
divā jale tale cāste rātrau setuṃ śrayatyapi ।
tāpasānāṃ nivāseṣu yatheṣṭaṃ ca bhramatyapi ।।67।।।।।
maharṣyāśramabhāgeṣu sāyaṃ bhramati vā kvacit ।
prātarnityaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ gatvā''laye'rcayatyapi ।। 68 ।।
kvacit sa manasā yāti somanāthaṃ supāvanam ।
kvacit sa sahasā mūladvārikāṃ yāti varṣmaṇā ।।69 ।।
kvacit kanyā svayaṃ bhūtvā brahmapriyāsu tiṣṭhati ।
kvacit kumārako bhūtvā cāste gopālabālakaiḥ ।।2.242.70 ।।
evaṃ sa munirāḍ rādhe! hyaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
nityaṃ vāsaṃ prācarat bālakṛṣṇāśraye śubhe ।। 71 ।।
athaikadā muniḥ śrīmān lomaśastaṃ vyalokayat ।
kanyārūpaṃ dhṛtavantaṃ nijāśrame samāgatam ।। 72 ।।
prāha kā tvaṃ kutaścātrā''yātā'si vada kanyake ।
sa cāha paṃkilā tvasmi dākṣīdevīsutā'smi hi ।।73 ।।
kanyakānāṃ darśanārthaṃ tvāgatā'smi tavā''śrame ।
vāmadevī bhavāmyeva kāle'nyadā tu paṃkilaḥ ।। 74।।
ityuktvā kanyakārūpaṃ vihāya paṃkilo'bhavat ।
lomaśo'pi viditvainaṃ prākparicitameva tu ।। 75।।
mimīla hṛdaye kṛtvā susammānaṃ vyadhāttadā ।
prāpya mantraṃ hareḥ so'pi paṃkilo lomaśānmuneḥ ।। 76 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti' jajāpa ha ।
natvā yayau jalagarbhe nivāsaṃ ca jale'karot ।।77।।
atha dvitīyadivase lomaśastaṃ samāgatam ।
prāha vai parṇakuṭyarthaṃ tatrā''ha paṃkilo muniḥ ।। 78 ।।
āsāyaṃ me jīvanaṃ vai kalpo'yaṃ pañcamo mama ।
vyatyeti brahmaṇo'haśca tatra kā parṇaśālikā ।।79 ।।
tasmājjale nivatsye'haṃ paṃke niścintane gṛhe ।
idānīṃ yāvadevātra kvāpi loke'pi vai mayā ।।2.242.8 0 ।।
parṇaśālā kṛtā naiva cānte kāryāpi naiva tu ।
svalpakāle'vaśiṣṭe cet karomi parṇaśālikām ।। 81 । ।
haseyurmām ṛṣayaste cirakalpaprajīvinaḥ ।
ityuktvā nityamevā'yaṃ jale vāsamarocayat ।। 82 । ।
mānasaṃ śrīharau dhṛtvā jale samādhimāptavān ।
samādhau vasatastasya yugakālo hyagād yadā ।। 83 ।।
tadā rājā balirloke balavān vāmanena vai ।
prakaṭībhūya yajñe saurāṣṭre'rthito bhuvaṃ prati ।।84।।
baliḥ pradadau pṛthivīṃ vāmanāya tu chatriṇe ।
vāmanaḥ kapaṭī kṛṣṇo vardhayāmāsa varṣma ca ।।85।।
pādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulayaśca tasyāśvasārase jale ।
nyapataँstatpratāpena sarobhūmirapūryata ।।86 ।।
jalānyapāsaran śīghraṃ pārśvapṛthvyāṃ tadā'bhitaḥ ।
varuṇastajjalānāṃ vai śamanaṃ pracakāra ha ।।87।।
paṃkilo nirgataḥ paṃkājjalarikte sarovare ।
vāmanāṃguṣṭhasaṃlagno babhūva likṣikā yathā ।। 88 ।।
so'pi nirgatya sarasā'ṅguṣṭhaṃ tuṣṭāva vai kṣaṇam ।
tāvat trilokān jitvaiva vāmano bālarūpadhṛk ।।8 9 ।।
abhavat taṃ pravīkṣyaiva paṃkilaḥ premaharṣitaḥ ।
punarjalāḍhyasarasi yāvadicchati majjanam ।। 2.242.90 ।।
tāvacchrīvāmanaḥ prāha kuru me mandiraṃ śubham ।
setau ca vāmanaṃ māṃ tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya saṃvasa ।।9 1 ।।
mamājñayā sevako me bhūtvā me mandire vasa ।
ityājñāpya yayau vastrāpathaṃ śrīvāmanaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 92।।
paṃkilo yogasāmarthyaiḥ rātrau cakāra mandiram ।
tatra śrīvāmanaṃ devaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śobhanam ।।93।।
paṃkilaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sevāyāṃ vāmanasya hi ।
sevārthaṃ paṃkilaḥ śiṣyaṃ prakalpya jālakīlakam ।।94।।
tatrā'dṛśyo'bhavannityaṃ vāmanasyālaye muniḥ ।
cirañjīvo jālakīlāyā''rpayat kālaparyaye ।।95।।
yogasiddhīrhi vividhā jālakīlo'pi yogirāṭ ।
abhavad brahmakalpāyurjāleśvaro dvijo hi saḥ ।।96।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre vāsaṃ so'pi sadā vyadhāt। ।
evaṃ tad rādhike tīrthaṃ jāleśvaraṃ ca pāṃkilam ।। 97।।
vāmanaṃ tīrthamevāpi cāṃguṣṭhatīrthamityapi ।
kanyakātīrthamevāpi cāśvapaṭṭasarojale ।।98।।
abhavanmokṣadaṃ pāpapraṇāśakaṃ sukhapradam ।
yogasiddhipradaṃ smṛddhipradaṃ svargapradaṃ tathā ।।99।।
tatra snānāttathā dānād vāmanasyā'rcanāttathā ।
svargarājyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ bhūrājyaṃ vā labhejjanaḥ ।। 2.242.100 ।।
kāṃbhareyaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā'nādinarāyaṇam ।
yaḥ snāyād vāmane tīrthe brahmadhāmagatiṃ vrajet ।। 10 1।।
vāmanaṃ paṃkilaṃ smṛtvā snānadānādikaṃ caret ।
dākṣīdevīṃ tathā smṛtvā kanyādānādikaṃ caret ।। 1 02।।
kanyakābhyo bhojanaṃ ca dadyāt sadbhyo'pi bhojanam ।
sādhvībhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne
dākṣīdevīvāmadevayormānasaputrasya paṃkilasya
jyeṣṭhapañcabhaginīsatkāralabhyā''śīrvādaiḥ pañcakalpacirajīvitvaṃ yugaparyantamaśvapaṭṭasarovare samādhau sthityuttaraṃ vāmanapādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulisparśena jāgratā tena
vāmanamandiramājñayā kāritaṃ vāmanāditīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 242 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 242 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 243
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 244 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā rādhe vāmadevasya kanyakāḥ ।
pañca vijñāya vai bhrāturvāsaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।। 1 ।।
mātaraṃ divyamuktānīṃ satyaloke sthitāṃ sadā ।
pṛṣṭvā samāyayuḥ sarvāścā'śvapaṭṭasarovaram ।। 2 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।
draṣṭuṃ ca varituṃ cāpi labdhuṃ ca kṛtakṛtyatām ।। 3 ।।
divyadehāḥ kaumudikā yathā cāndryastathāvidhāḥ ।
kṛtaśṛṃgārasarvasvā nārāyaṇasya tuṣṭaye ।। 4 ।।
māyāṃśavarjitāścāpi parabrahmāṃśamohitāḥ ।
vyomamārgeṇa sahasā ciraṃjīvyaḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 5 ।।
mārgaśīrṣasya vai ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛṣṇe dale'kṣarakṣitau ।
āgatya bhrātaraṃ naijaṃ nemuśca vāmanaṃ prabhum ।
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā bhrātā svāgatamācarat ।। 6 ।।
mātrājñāṃ cānujāyāpi kathayāmāsureva tāḥ ।
bhrātā prasannatāṃ prāpto bhaginyo yaddharipriyāḥ ।। 7 ।।
yāsāṃ prasādato jātā pañcakalpāntajīvitā ।
tāsāṃ nārāyaṇītvaṃ vai śrutvā mumoda cāti hi ।। 8 ।।
saptamyāṃ prātarevaitāḥ kṛtvā śṛṃgāraśobhanām ।
mātrā samaṃ yayuḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇālayaṃ prage ।। 9 ।।
sapūjādravyahastāśca varamālānvitāstathā ।
sarvasvārpaṇabhāvāśca kṛṣṇavallabhasannidhau ।। 2.243.1 0।।
tatra sthitāṃ mātaraṃ śrīkambharāṃ prathamaṃ tu tāḥ ।
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā daduḥ paricayaṃ nijam ।। 11 ।।
pitaraṃ cāpi natvaiva svasāraṃ cāgrajāvapi ।
amṛtāṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca tato nārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।। 1 2।।
natvā natvā pūjanaṃ sapracakrurbahuvastubhiḥ ।
bhrātrā niveditāstāstu sarvasvārpaṇamāgatāḥ ।। 13 ।।
harirbhāvaṃ vilokyaiva tathāstviti samagrahīt ।
bhrātrā paṃkilamuninā tāsāṃ karā hareḥ hare ।। 14।।
arpitāḥ śrīhariṃ premṇā karān jagrāha vai tadā ।
āpastambī prathamā ca drumastambī dvitīyakā ।। 1 5।।
marutstambī tṛtīyā ca phenastambī caturthikā ।
dhūmrastambī pañcamīti patnyo'bhavan hareḥ priyāḥ ।। 1 6।।
pūjayitvā nijaṃ kāntaṃ varamālā dadurgale ।
hariḥ pārśve nije tāśca niṣādya varamālikāḥ ।। 17।।
tāsāṃ kaṇṭheṣvadhāttatra prasādaṃ pradadau tataḥ ।
tāśca bhuktvā saha bhrātrā lomaśasyā''śramaṃ yayuḥ ।। 18 ।।
nideśato hareḥ rādhe brahmapriyāsu cā'vasan ।
ityevaṃ prāpya rādheśaṃ rādhāvat tāḥ sadā'bhavan ।। 1 9।।
athā'nyatpāvanaṃ ramyaṃ priye śṛṇu kathānakam ।
svarṇāṃgadasya rājño vai saurāṣṭrīyasya vaṃśajaḥ ।। 2.243.20 ।।
haimakalgināmavāँśca rājā'bhūd dharmavarmavān ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto hi sāttvataḥ ।।21 ।।
bhajate śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ kriyāsvapi divāniśam ।
mālāṃ na dūramādhatte smaraṇaṃ na tyajatyapi ।।22।।
bhojane śayane kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye saṃprarakṣati ।
bālakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti harikṛṣṇeti vai muhuḥ ।। 23 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyāha divāniśam ।
vākyānte bālakṛṣṇeti kāṃbhareyeti sarvadā ।।24।।
pravaktyeveti raṭaṇaṃ karoti paramātmanaḥ ।
tasya pūjanavelāyāṃ yatra kvāpi gṛhe vane ।।25।।
sarastaṭe samudyāne maṇḍape mandire'thavā ।
nirjane sajane marde raho vā premabandhanaḥ ।।26 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo hi sākṣādvai gatvā tiṣṭhati cāgrataḥ ।
gṛhṇātyevā'rpitadravyāṇyakhilāni prapūjane ।।27।।
naivedyaṃ ca phalaṃ khādyaṃ pāyasādyaṃ ca pūrikāḥ ।
sarvaṃ bhuktvā bālakṛṣṇaḥ śeṣaṃ dadāti bhūbhṛte ।।28।।
tatastirobhavatyeva rājā gṛhṇāti bhojanam ।
ityevaṃ hemakalgervā bhaktyā śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ।।29।।
vaśastasya vartate sma rādhike suprasāditaḥ ।
rājñī tasya kumudākṣīnāmnī tathaiva vartate ।।2.243.3 0।।
sāpi śīghraṃ samutthāya snātvā'nnaṃ miṣṭamuttamam ।
pācayatyeva bhaktyāḍhyā bālakṛṣṇasya tuṣṭaye ।।3 1 ।।
pāyasānnaṃ gavāṃ kṣīraṃ saśarkaraṃ sahaudanam ।
pūrikā ghṛtapakvāśca tathā'nyad ṛtusammatam ।।3 2।।
gundrapakvānnamevāpi laḍḍukān māṣapiṣṭajān ।
kṛtvā dadāti prātarvai rājñe pūjānivedane ।।3 3 ।।
tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ madhuraṃ śītamuṣṇakam ।
yathākālaṃ dadātyevā'bhyaṃgadravyāṇi yāni ca ।।34।।
nityaṃ sā gāyati saudhe sakhīmadhye sukīrtanam ।
sakhyastāmanugāyanti tālīvādayutāḥ saha ।।35 ।।
śrībālakṛṣṇo janasaukhyakārīśrīkāṃbhareyo janapāpahārī ।
rājādhirājo mama bhāgyadhārī gopālabālo jayate murāriḥ ।।36 ।।
rādhāvihārī bhavabhītihārī gopīvicārī mama bhojyakārī ।
snehaprasārī nijabhaktatārī nārījanā''rtikṣapaṇaprakārī ।। 37।।
cakṣuḥprakāśī hṛdayābhikāśī vijñānavāsī bahudhāmavāsī ।
māyāvipāśī nijabhaktadāśī sevābhilāṣiprasaratprakāśī ।।38।।
bhaktervikāsī nijarūpavāsī loke'syudāsī vadatīti dāsī ।
sā pālanīyā satatapravāsī gṛhābhivāsī bhava me'ntarāsī।। 39 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike nityaṃ rājñīṃ sakhīsamāyutā ।
gāyatyevā'rthayatyeva guṇān guṇinameva tam ।।2.243.40 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi tacchrutvā jāyate tuṣṭamānasaḥ ।
evaṃ kāle gate kṛṣṇo dadau varmabhayacchidam ।।41 ।।
yad dhṛtvā nirbhayaścāste rājā rājñīyutaḥ sadā ।
mahākālo'pi tadvarma dṛṣṭvā prayāti dūrataḥ ।।42।।
yogasiddhiprabandhaṃ tanmadhyakaustubharājitam ।
paritaḥ prāntabhāgeṣu cāṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitam ।।43 ।।
mastake varmaṇo yasya rājate tu sudarśanam ।
skandhe gadā ca kukṣau tu pāśo yasya virājate ।।44।।
etādṛśaṃ suvarṇātisuvarṇaṃ taijasaṃ mṛdu ।
krūraṃ ca rakṣaṇe saumyaṃ darśane dhāraṇe laghu ।।45।।
varma vastrasvarūpaṃ vai bālakṛṣṇena cārpitam ।
rājā dadhāra tadvarma nairantaryeṇa kañcukam ।।46।।
yasmājjarā prayātyeva dūraṃ daṇḍo yamasya ca ।
saṃkarṣaṇasya saṃhāro dūraṃ yātyapi varmataḥ ।।47।।
pāśo varuṇadevasya bhayaṃ prāpnoti varmaṇaḥ ।
kavacācchaṃkaragaṇā vepante mārgagā api ।।48।।
mṛtyurmṛtyupadaṃ yāti yadi varmapathaṃ gataḥ ।
tādṛśaṃ bālasāmarthyayutaṃ tu kavacaṃ hi tat। ।।49।।
rādhike nṛpatirdhṛtvā muktavanmodate bhuvi ।
yasya kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ pārśve kā bhītirvada rādhike ।।2.243.50।।
yasya nārāyaṇaḥ pārśve kā bhītirvada bhāmini ।
rādhikeva ramevā'yaṃ nirbhīko nṛpatirvane ।।5 1 ।।
araṇye viharatyeva bhajan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
atha rājā yayau vyāghrāraṇye vihartukāmyayā ।।52।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tataścāpi yayau vyomnā vimānagaḥ ।
prayayau daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ tato yayau ।। 53 ।।
naimiṣāraṇyakaṃ cāpi māhendrāraṇyamityapi ।
evaṃ vihṛtya vai rājñyā sākaṃ saurāṣṭrakaṃ yayau ।।54।।
tadvimānaṃ mahat kṣātratejobhṛtaṃ vilokya tu ।
parśurāmaḥ kṣatrahantā cakampe kālanoditaḥ ।।55।।
mahendraparvatācchrīghraṃ gṛhītvā paraśuṃ nijam ।
dhanurdhṛtvā śarāँścāpi khaḍgaṃ dhṛtvā'tiroṣavān ।।56 ।।
nipapāta vimānasya pṛṣṭhe vyomnā sa satvaram ।
mahātejaḥpragolo vai pṛṣṭhe tvāyāti śīghragaḥ ।।57।।
rājā naitatprajānāti nirbhayo hi vimānagaḥ ।
prajānāṃ hṛdayeṣvāsīt kṣobho'nile'ntarīkṣake ।।58।।
grahacakraṃ tadākṣubdhaṃ cāsīt bhāvibhayaṃkaram।
cakampe pṛthivī cāpi tadā tejodvayā'sahā ।।59।।
sampāte pralayo bhāvī tejasoravināśinoḥ ।
evaṃ tresustadā devā divyanetrāśca yoginaḥ ।।2.243.60 ।।
maharṣayo'tisaṃvignāstadāsan bhāvibhītitaḥ ।
dikpālāḥ kṣetrapālādyāḥ kṣayaṃ lokasya menire ।।61 ।।
pratuṣṭuvustadā siddhā viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
mā bhūdvai jagatāṃ nāśaḥ parśuvarmasamāgame ।।62।।
atha rājño vimānaṃ tu manovegaṃ kṣaṇād drutam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ samāyātamavātarat ।।6 3 ।।
rājā cakre jalapānaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ mudā smaran ।
rājñī pānaṃ pracakre'pi pāyayitvā nijaṃ prabhum ।।64।।
tāvadākāśamārgeṇa sūryavat krūragolakaḥ ।
tejomayo raktavarṇaḥ satvaraṃ samavātarat ।।65 ।।
pṛthivī cukṣubhe vāri sarasaścukṣubhe tadā ।
bhayaṃ tu menire tīrthavāsinaḥ kaṣṭamāgatam ।।66।।
tarkayanti vyomamārge dṛṣṭvā paraśugolakam ।
graho vā kṣubhitaścāyaṃ bhraṣṭo vā sthānato nijāt ।।67।।
sūryakhaṇḍo'thavā''yāti vahnijvālāsamanvitaḥ ।
yadvā vahniḥ svayaṃ cāste kiṃ vā kopasamanvitaḥ ।।68।।
kiṃvā saṃkarṣaṇo devaḥ śeṣo vā''yāti roṣavān ।
brahmaśastraṃ ca vā kṣiptaṃ kenacidapyavāritam ।।6 9 ।।
lokānāmapunarbhāvāyā''yātyatra tu vā kimu ।
yadvā vai vāḍavaścāgniḥ samudrādutthitaḥ punaḥ ।।2.243.70।।
dagdhuṃ lokān samāyāti ko vā'yaṃ krūradarśanaḥ ।
ityevaṃ cā'tarkayaँśca mānasāni hi dehinām ।।71 ।।
tāvat sannidhimāpannaḥ sphuṭamūrtiradṛśyata ।
vikarālānano haste paraśudhragjaṭādharaḥ ।।72।।
sakacchaḥ sāyudhaścāpi brahmasūtrasamanvitaḥ ।
sphāracakṣuḥpradaṃṣṭrauṣṭhaprāntaścotphullavigrahaḥ ।।73 ।।
ko'yaṃ kṣātrakule cāste jīvati parśuyogini ।
vimānena vināśāya pracchanno'tra prakāśate ।।74।।
ityevaṃ vyāharaँstūrṇaṃ sarastaṭamavātarat ।
tāvaktrokaiḥ sa vijñātaḥ parśurāmo'ntakṛd dvijaḥ ।।75।।
dudruvurmānavā bhītāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo'pi ca ।
haimakalgervimānāgre parśudhraḥ samupasthitaḥ ।।76।।
āśvapaṭṭataṭe ramye garvagaṃjanaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇasyā''kṣarākhye kṣetre kaupīnabhūsuraḥ ।।77।।
yāvad bhūmau padaṃ naijaṃ dhṛtavān parśudhārakaḥ ।
tāvadaṃguṣṭhasya nakhaḥ kaṃkareṇa vibheditaḥ ।।78।।
jātaṃ viprasya vai taccā'māṃgalyaṃ vijayārthinaḥ ।
tathāpi mānabhāvena hantuṃ haimaṃ samāyayau ।।79।।
kastvaṃ kṣatriyadāyāda matparśukṣut praśiṣyase ।
vada śīghraṃ prayuddhasva yamalokābhigo bhava ।।2.243.80।।
ityukto nṛpatirhaimaḥ śīghraṃ kṣātreṇa tejasā ।
viprasya tu yathā na syādaparādho jagāda tam ।।8 1 ।।
viprāḥ pūjyā jāmadagne mā kṣatreṇa parābhavaḥ ।
mā tvaṃ pūjyaśca prayuṅkṣvā'trā'sthāne parśuṃ balaṃ ca vā ।।82।।
sambhāvitasya cā'sthāne parābhavo gururmṛtaḥ ।
kṣātro'haṃ brāhmaṇe vipra nāparāddhuṃ prakāṃkṣaye ।।83।।
mā roṣaṃ kuru viprendra mā puṇyaṃ kṣālaya dvija ।
pūjyo'syavadhya evāsi cātatāyyasi bhūsura ।।84।।
tasmātpūjāṃ pragṛhṇāsi kṣantumarhasi cānayam ।
ityuktvā haimarājo vai vipraṃ pūjayituṃ puraḥ ।।85।।
yāvadgacchati rādhe sa tāvatparśudharo dvijaḥ ।
hantuṃ pratatparo jāto roṣato yuddhamudrayā ।।86 ।।
haimakalgidrutaṃ smṛtvā śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
parśudhraṃ bandhayāmāsa sudarśanīyaraśmibhiḥ ।।87।।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ divyaṃ śrīhariṇā'rpitaṃ tu yat ।
tat svakiraṇairvāhneyairjālaṃ kṛtvā babandha tam ।।88।।
parśurāmaṃ saroṣaṃ vai sāyudhaṃ sabalaṃ kṣaṇāt। ।
parśudhrastejasā tatra cakrasyā''vṛtaśaktikaḥ ।।89।।
jaḍa iva kṣaṇājjātaḥ patāta pṛthivītale ।
rājā prāha kṣamasvā'tra śrīmān māmaparādhinam ।।2.243.90।।
vipre'vamānakartāraṃ muñca krodhaṃ drutaṃ vraja ।
parśudhraḥ prāha muñcasva na me śaktiḥ pravartate ।।91 ।।
rājaँstava prasanno'smi varadānaṃ dadāmi te ।
pāśān jālān cakradevaṃ pūjayāmi vrajāmi ca ।।9 2।।
drutaṃ muñcasva māṃ dahyamānaṃ cakrasya raśmibhiḥ ।
rājā prāha harerbhaktaṃ mā jighāṃsatu vai bhavān ।।9 3 ।।
kṣātraṃ viprāt samutpannaṃ bhaktaṃ vipro na hantu tat ।
varaṃ tvekaṃ pālayasvā'paraṃ cātraiva saṃvasa ।।94।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre tiṣṭha mūrtisvarūpadhṛk ।
ityuktaḥ parśurāmo vai varau dvau pradadau tadā ।।95।।
rājñā tu mandire parśurāmaḥ saṃsthāpitastataḥ ।
snāpito'śvajale cāpi pūjitaścopacārakaiḥ ।।96।।
rādhike tu tatastatra paraśurāmatīrthakam ।
pūrvadiśi samabhavat haimakalgipratīrthakam ।।97।।
parśurāmo hariṃ pūjayitvā yayau hi mandaram ।
mūrtirūpastatra nityaṃ tvāste'śvapaṭṭasāgare ।।18।।
rājā tato yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
pūjayitvā hariṃ natvā kathayitvā hyudantakam ।।99।।
kṛtvā tīrthaṃ yayau naijāṃ rājadhānīṃ himāvatīm ।
atra tīrthe snānadānācamanairvijayo bhavet ।। 2.243.10 0।।
paṭhanācchravaṇād vā'sya doṣā naśyanti vai hṛdaḥ ।
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpyārogyaṃ dhanaṃ sutaṃ labhet ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vāmadevīyapañcakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntalabdhiḥ, haimakalginṛpasya bhaktyā harernityaṃ pratyakṣam, nṛpāt
parśurāmaparābhavaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi paraśurāmatīrthaṃ haimakalgitīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 243 ।।
