adhyāyaḥ 244
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 245 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cāśvasarasyeva tataḥ param ।
mārgakṛṣṇasya cāṣṭamyāṃ yajñāraṃbho babhūva ha ।। 1 ।।
nṛpo'śvapāṭalākhyo vai vaiṣṇavastvarbudācalāt ।
āyayau makhakāryārthe lomaśaṃ prati sānugaḥ ।। 2 ।।
gajāḥ śataṃ gṛhe yasyā'raṇyaṃ kṣetrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ।
rājyaṃ viśālaṃ yasyāste cārbudīyapradeśajam ।। 3 ।।
sahasramānavairyuktaḥ sahasragovṛṣaistathā ।
bahusāmagrikābhiścāyayau saha makhārthakaḥ ।। 4 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre tvaiśāne pāvane śubhe ।
bhāge sainyaśibirāṇi cakre pālāśake vane ।। 5 ।।
āhūya lomaśaṃ cāpi kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ hareḥ ।
maharṣīṃśca samāhūya kratuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 6 ।।
rādhike somayajñaṃ taṃ pañcāhaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
somalatāḥ samāhṛtya sajīvāḥ kuṇḍikāsu tāḥ ।। 7 ।।
vardhitāḥ pāyitāścāpi rājñā tvaśvasarastaṭe ।
ahīnākhyaḥ somayajñaḥ pañcāho'nuṣṭhitastaṭe ।। 8 ।।
maṇḍape suviśāle saṃkāritaḥ kuṇḍasattamaḥ ।
rājā sapatnīka eva vṛttvā somapravākakam ।। 9 ।।
somapravākaṃ vipraṃ sampreṣayāmāsa ṛtvijām ।
varaṇārthaṃ sa vipro'pi gatvā''nayattu bhūsurān ।। 2.244.1 0।।
rājā datvā madhuparkaṃ varaṇaṃ pracakāra ha ।
adhvaryuṃ ca pratiprasthātāraṃ neṣṭāramityapi ।। 11 ।।
unnetāraṃ tataścāpi brahmāṇaṃ ca samāvṛṇot ।
brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ potāraṃ samāvṛṇot ।। 1 2।।
hotāraṃ ca tathā maitrāvaruṇaṃ ca samāvṛṇot ।
acchāvākaṃ grāvastutaṃ codgātāraṃ samāvṛṇot ।। 1 3।।
prastotāraṃ pratihartāraṃ subrahmaṇyamāvṛṇot ।
sadasyānṛtvijaścāpi rājā tatra samāvṛṇot ।। 14।।
devatāḥ samupasthāyā'raṇyoścāropya cā'nalam ।
somakratusthalīṃ gatvā mathitvā cāraṇī tataḥ ।। 186।।
samutpannaṃ gārhapatyā''yatane'nalameva tam ।
prātiṣṭhipat tato'dhvaryuḥ praṇīyā''havanīyakam ।। 16।।
caturviṃśatihomāँśca hutvā visṛjya cā'nalam ।
praṇīya gārhapatyācca punarhomāँśca sapta ca ।। 17।।
kṛtvā'gniṃ taṃ samutsṛjya dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭimācarat ।
ekādaśakapālaṃ ca puroḍāśaṃ vyadhāpayat ।। 18।।
agnaye viṣṇave cāpi homaṃ dadau tataḥ param ।
prācīnavaṃśaśālāṃ ca nirmāya yajamānakaḥ ।। 19।।
uttare ca bahirdeśe kārayitvā tu muṇḍanam ।
tīrthe snātvā'dhvaryuṇā ca datte dukūlake śubhe ।। 2.244.20 ।।
paryadadhat tathā rājñī nakhanikṛntanādikam ।
snānaṃ kṛtvā paryadadhad vastre dukūlake śubhe ।। 21 ।।
tato jāyāpatī cānnaṃ bubhujāte hi maṇḍape ।
navanītena vai tatra svāṅgāni cānulimpataḥ ।।22।।
añjāte cāñjanenāpyakṣiṇī naije tataḥ param ।
adhvaryuścānale tatra hutvā dīkṣāhutīśca ṣaṭ ।।।23।।
pradadau yajamānāya tataḥ kṛṣṇājinadvayam ।
yajamānaḥ parigṛhyā''havanīyasamīpagaḥ ।।24।।
tadāstīryopaviśyāpi baddhvā kaṭyāṃ ca mekhalām ।
mṛgaśṛṃgaṃ tathodumbaradrudaṇḍaṃ dadhāra ca ।।25।।
patnī tatheṣikājālaṃ muñjayoktraṃ dadhāra ca ।
yajamāno muṣṭibandhaṃ cakārā'dhvaryurāha ca ।।26।।
dīkṣito yajamāno'yaṃ dīkṣitā brāhmaṇā ime ।
vāṅyato yajamānaścā''nakṣatrodayameva ha ।।27।।
avartatā'dhvaryuṇā cārpitaṃ payo'pibattataḥ ।
patnyapibad vāgvisargaṃ cakraturdampatī tataḥ ।। 28।।
dadhi dhānānudumbaraphalasaktaँśca vodanam ।
bhojanaṃ dampatī tatra yatheṣṭaṃ sampracakratuḥ ।। 29।।
yācakā vipradevāśca yajñadravyopalabdhaye ।
yācanārthaṃ gatāścā'tha dampatī jāgṛto niśi ।। 2.244.30 ।।
vrataṃ rarakṣatuścāpi nānṛtaṃ saṃvadediti ।
nāśnīyānmāṃsamadyādi nopeyācca striyaṃ tathā ।। 31 ।।
na khaṭvādau śayītāpi kṛṣṇājinādi dhārayet ।
aṣṭamyāṃ somayāgasya kṛtyaṃ rājā tathā vyadhāt ।। 3 2।।
tato rātrau sabhāyāṃ ca lomaśastūpadeśanām ।
dadau tvātmapralābhārthāṃ jñānavijñānasaṃbhṛtām ।।3 3 ।।
adhvarāḥ sarvadā kāryā dhanikaiḥ sukhahetave ।
ātmamokṣakarā yajñāḥ kartavyā dehibhiḥ sadā ।। 34।।
mokṣayajñakarā lokāḥ puṇyahārā jitendriyāḥ ।
prāpnuvanti hareḥ sthānaṃ yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ।। 35।।
na prīyante vandyamānā na kupyantyapi ninditāḥ ।
etāṃ prajñāṃ tamāptāste prāpnuvanti hareḥ padam ।। 36 ।।
pakvavidyā jitadoṣā nāparādhyanti ye janāḥ ।
anīrṣavo na hiṃsanti tapyante na pararddhibhiḥ ।। 37।।
nindāśaṃse na kurvanti vikriyante na tatra ca ।
praśāntāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ ratā bhavanti ye hite ।। 38।।
na kruddhyanti na hṛṣyanti nāparān vañcayantyapi ।
vimucya hṛdayagranthiṃ te prayānti hareḥ padam ।। 3 9।।
na yeṣāṃ bāndhavāḥ kecid ye cānyeṣāṃ na bāndhavāḥ ।
amitrāḥ santi yeṣāṃ na ye cā'mitrā bhavanti na ।। 2.244.40।।
ye dharmaṃ cānuruddhyanti sukha jīvantyaroṣiṇaḥ ।
amṛtasyeva tṛpyerannavamānasya yoginaḥ ।। 41 ।।
viṣasyevodvijeyuśca sammānasya vicakṣaṇāḥ ।
avajñātāḥ sukhaṃ cāpi śerate tvakutobhayāḥ ।।।42।।
viyuktāḥ sarvadoṣebhyo ye te yāntyakṣaraṃ padam ।
etadvratāni cāsādya praidhante sādhavaḥ sukham ।। 83 । ।
sarvān kratūn samāsādya kṛtvā mano'tinirmalam ।
prāpnuvanti harerdhāma yatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ।। 84।।
naiṣāṃ devā na gandharvā narṣayaḥ pitaro'pi vā ।
padaṃ cānvavarohanti prāptānāṃ paramaṃ padam ।। 45 ।।
yeṣāṃ naivā'styahaṃkāro guṇacāritrakṛt tathā ।
abhinnavāgdhṛdayāśca pūjyanta'tra paratra ca ।।46 ।।
adhyātmavidhitattvajñāḥ kṣāntāḥ śaktā jitendriyāḥ ।
ṛjavaḥ satyavācaśca pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।47 ।।
tejasā yaśasā buddhyā jñānena vinayena ca ।
janmanā tapasā yuktāḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।48।।
suśīlāḥ sukhasaṃveśāḥ svādarāgatāḥ ।
suvākyāścā'pyanīrṣyāśca pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।49।।
kalyāṇaṃ kurvate'nyeṣāṃ pāpaṃ yatra na vidyate ।
na prīyante parakaṣṭaiḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।2.244.50।।
titikṣavaḥ samavṛttāḥ priyā'priyasahāstathā ।
hitārthavādinaḥ śāntāḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।51 ।।
adīnāḥ krodhahīnāścā'lubdhāḥ paropakāriṇaḥ ।
dhane kāme'pyakalahāḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।52।।
doṣā yeṣāṃ samucchinnā dṛḍhabhaktā harestu ye ।
vītasammohamānāśca pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।53।।
asaktāḥ sarvasaṃgeṣu vinaṣṭasaṃśayāśca ye ।
nātmastutiparā lokāḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।।54।।
nā'sūyanti janaṃ kaṃcinnyāyamārge vahanti ca ।
avandhyakālā mṛdavaḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।55।।
kṛtaśramāḥ kṛtaprajñā na tṛptā harikīrtane ।
nityayuktāścā'pramattāḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।56।।
nā'patrapāḥ paraśreyovidhātāraśca dāninaḥ ।
paraguhyā'prabhettāraḥ pūjyante'tra paratra ca ।।57।।
evaṃ sarvaguṇopetān dakṣānātmahitārthinaḥ ।
kālajñāँśca priyajñāँśca pūjayanti surā api ।।।58।।
anādyantamajaṃ divyaṃ parabrahma sanātanam ।
te janā āpnuvantyeva tadarthāstatsamarpaṇāḥ ।।।59।।
tapo niḥśreyasaṃ tasya mūlaṃ śamo damastathā ।
tena sarvamavāpnoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ।।2.244.60।।
tapasā jāyate dehī bhūtānāṃ dhāraṇe prabhuḥ ।
īśvarāstapasā jātā maharṣayo'pi tena ca ।।6 1 ।।
śabdabrahmaparāścāpi labhante brahma cordhvagam ।
rakṣādhvarāśca vai kṣattrā haviryajñā viśo matāḥ ।।।62।।
paricaryāmakhāḥ śūdrāstapoyajñāśca bhūsurāḥ ।
tretāyāṃ saṃhatā yajñā brahmaprāptipradāḥ śubhāḥ ।।63।।
tapasā vidyayā cāpījyayā dānena vā janāḥ ।
yaśastvakhaṇḍitaṃ prāpya saṃsthāpya bhuvi tadyaśaḥ ।।64।।
ye prayānti paraṃ svargaṃ sukhā''nantyaँ prabhuñjate ।
yajñe dātāra evātra sthāpayanti yaśobhuvam ।।65।।
yāvadyaśobhūrvidyeta tāvat svargamakhaṇḍitam ।
devarṣipitṛgurvarthe vṛddhāturātithikṛte ।।66।।
anāthadīnanāryarthe satīsādhvīsatāṃ kṛte ।
nā'deyaṃ vidyate kiṃcidyeṣāṃ te divamāgatāḥ ।।67।।
gautamo'vagrahe viprān saṃsevyā'nnādibhiḥ sadā ।
prāpya divyaṃ divaṃ paścānnārāyaṇapadaṃ gataḥ ।।68 ।।
rantidevo vaśiṣṭhāya datvā vāri sukhapradam ।
āśīrvādena vai svargaṃ bhuktvā prāpa hareḥ padam ।।69।।।
indradyumno makhe dravyamanantaṃ sampradāya ca ।
yayau divya divaṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇapadaṃ gataḥ ।।2.244.70 ।।
śibiḥ putraṃ brāhmaṇārthe datvā svargaṃ paraṃ yayau ।
pratardanaḥ kāśikeśo datvā netre dvijātaye ।। 71 ।।
bhaktyā svargaṃ prabhuktvaiva nārāyaṇapadaṃ yayau ।
dharmāṃgadaśiro datvā svarṇāṃgado'kṣaraṃ yayau ।।72।।।
devāvṛdho nṛpaśchatraṃ sauvarṇaṃ bhūsurāya tu ।
datvā sarāṣṭraḥ prayayau pārameśaṃ paraṃ padam ।।73 ।।
sāṃkṛtikaśca śiṣyebhyaścopādiśyāntarasthitam ।
parabrahma yayau divyaṃ paraṃ padaṃ hareḥ kila ।।74।।
ambarīṣaśca viprebhyo datvā govrajamityapi ।
arbudārbudamevā'pi svargaṃ bhuktvā'kṣaraṃ gataḥ ।।75।।
vṛṣādarbhiḥ sarvaratnaṃ viprāyā''rpyā'kṣaraṃ gataḥ ।
yuvanāśvaḥ priyānārīḥ ramyāṇyāvasathāni ca ।।76।।
viprebhyo dānamādattvā svargaṃ tato'kṣaraṃ gataḥ ।
nimiḥ rāṣṭraṃ pradatvaiva vaideho janako'bhavat ।।77 ।।
jāmadagnyo'pi pṛthivīṃ datvā nārāyaṇo'bhavat ।
gayo dvijātaye datvā svargaṃ ceśapadaṃ yayau ।।78 ।।
marutto nāma rājarṣiḥ samarpyāṅgirase sutām ।
divyaṃ jagāma divyaṃ sa tato'kṣarapadaṃ yayau ।।701 ।।
brahmadatto'pi pāñcālyo nidhiṃ śaṃkhaṃ dvijātaye ।
datvā svargaṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā pārameśapadaṃ yayau ।।2.244.8 0 ।।
mitrasahaśca rājarṣirvasiṣṭhāya nijāṃ priyām ।
madayantīṃ pradatvaiva patnyā sahā'kṣaraṃ yayau ।।8 1 ।।
sahasrajit tathā rājā priyān prāṇān dadau śuciḥ ।
brāhmaṇārthe yayau svargaṃ bhuktvā mokṣapadaṃ yayau ।।82।।
śatadyumno nṛpo datvā sopaskarālayaṃ nijam ।
hiraṇmayaṃ mudgalāya svargaṃ bhuktvā'kṣaraṃ yayau ।।83 ।।
dyutimānnṛpatiḥ rājyamṛcīkāya pradāya ca ।
bhuktvā svargaṃ ciraṃ bhaktyā'kṣaraṃ dhāma yayau tataḥ ।।84।।
lomapāda sutāṃ śāntām ṛṣyaśṛṃgāya yogine ।
datvā divyaṃ divaṃ bhuktvā'kṣaraṃ dhāma tato yayau ।।।85।।
madirāśvaśca rājarṣiḥ kanyāṃ datvā suśobhanām ।
hiraṇyakaraṛṣaye yayau svargaṃ tato'kṣaram ।।86।।
prasenajid gavāṃ lakṣaṃ datvā dānaṃ dvijātaye ।
svargaṃ bhuktvā tato yāto'kṣarākhyaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ।।87।।
caturdaśastarāvāsāḥ pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ ।
devā nṛpāḥ prajāḥ kanyā nijā datvā tu śārṅgiṇe ।।88।।
pūrvapūrvaṣu kalpeṣu golokaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ।
gamiṣyanti paraṃ cāpi datvā haryarthameva ca ।।89।।
sarvasvaṃ vāpi kiñcicca bhaktyā yāsyanti tatpadam ।
dānaistapobhirbhaktyā ca bahavo vai divaṃ yayuḥ ।। 2.244.90 ।।
yeṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtirbrahmaloke sadā'sti vai ।
pṛthvyāṃ kīrtistathā cāste yāvatsūryādayaḥ sthitā ।। 91 ।।
sadbhya āgatavijñānāḥ śiṣṭā nārāyaṇārpitāḥ ।
haryarthakṛtasarvasvāstiṣṭhante śāśvatā'kṣare ।। 92 ।।
dhṛtimanto'pramattāśca dāntā dharmavido janāḥ ।
vītaharṣamadakrodhā nā'vasīdanti vai kacit ।। 92 ।।
dānādhyayanayajñaiśca tapohrīdamanārjavaiḥ ।
vardhayate nijaṃ tejaḥ pāpmā sarvo vinaśyati ।। 94।।
dhūtapāpā bhaktiyuktāḥ pratyāhārajitendriyāḥ ।
kāmakrodhā'nabhibhūtāḥ prayānti brahma śāśvatam ।। 95।।
agniṃ vipraṃ satīṃ santaṃ devaṃ vṛddhaṃ namet sadā ।
vācaṃ krūrāṃ varjayecca brahma sampadyate tataḥ ।।96। ।
prajñāniṣṭhaścātmaniṣṭhaḥ kurvannapi na lipyate ।
saṃsāravāsanādehāṃ nadīṃ tartuṃ yateta ca ।। 97।।
sarvendriyajalā''vāhāṃ lobhamohataṭāṃ tathā ।
krodhapaṃkāṃ kāladīrghāṃ kuṭumbasnehasajjhaṣām ।। 98।।
sevāplavena bhaktyā vā nāvā satāṃ sahāyataḥ ।
taranti sāttvatāḥ śāntā dhīrāḥ pāragadṛṣṭayaḥ ।। 99।।
abhaktāścāpyavijñāśca nottaranti nadīmimām ।
tasmādunmajjanārthaṃ vai yateta dānadharmavān ।। 2.244.100 ।।
yajñena bhaktyā nyāsena nistarettāṃ sadāśrayaḥ ।
satāṃ dharmeṇa varteta kriyāṃ satāṃ samācaret ।। 101 ।।
dharmabhaktiviśeṣajñā nadīṃ taranti dustarām ।
sādhavaḥ śrīharerbhaktyā tārayantyabudhān plavāḥ ।। 10 2 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmān lomaśo gurureva tu ।
upādiśya virarāma parihārastato'bhavat ।। 103 ।।
bhojanānyabhavaँścāpi yatheṣṭatṛptidāni vai ।
tato'vāpuśca viśrāntiṃ rādhike sarvaśo janāḥ ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamyām aśvapaṭṭasarovarataṭe'śvapāṭalanṛpatiḥ somayāgamārabdhavān, prathamadivasīyā'nuṣṭhānam, lomaśakṛtopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvā-riṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 244 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 244 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 245
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 246 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike munirdvitīye'hni tu lomaśaḥ ।
somayāgīyakṛtyaṃ nirvartayāmāsa yacca tat ।। 1 ।।
avaśyasaṃkalpādyaṃ ca kṛtvā satkarma vai tataḥ ।
prātareva prāya(pa?)ṇīyeṣṭiṃ cakāra hi lomaśaḥ ।। 2 ।।
pathyādipañcadevāँścā'sthāpayaccāpyapūjayat ।
pathyā svastiḥ prathamaiva dvitīyo'gniḥ surastathā ।। 3 ।।
somastṛtīyaḥ savitā caturtho'ditiḥ pañcamī ।
aditerodano dravyaṃ caturṇṇāmājyameva ca ।। 4 ।।
paktvaudanaṃ cāhavanīyā'gnau cā'juhavat tataḥ ।
somaṃ ca krītavāँstatra rājā daśabhirvastubhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
aikahāyanyā gavā ca hiraṇyenā'jayā tathā ।
dhenvā savatsayā cāpi vṛṣabheṇa ca bhūpatiḥ ।। 6 ।।
śakaṭavāhyanaḍuhā vatsatareṇa cāpi vai ।
vatsataryā vāsasā ca krītavān somameva saḥ ।। 7 ।।
krītaṃ somaṃ yajamānaścorau dakṣe nigṛhya ca ।
havirdhānaśakaṭe taṃ nikṣipya cāyayau makham ।। 8 ।।
prāgvaṃśasyā'grataḥ sthitvā ātithyeṣṭiṃ cakāra ha ।
viṣṇave ca puroḍāśaṃ dravyaṃ navakapālakam ।। 9 ।।
dadau cātha ca somaṃ taṃ rājāsandyāṃ nyadhāpayat ।
ṛtvijo yajamānaścā'vairāya śapathaṃ vyadhuḥ ।। 2.245.1 0।।
pravargyaṃ karma ca tataḥ prāvartata sasādhanam ।
mahāvīrākhyapātrāṇi trīṇi, dve dohapātrake ।। 1 1।।
ājyasthālī, tathāśvau dvau, kapāle dve hi mārttikāḥ ।
vānaspatyā udumbarakāṣṭhajā api tadyathā ।। 1 2।।
samrāḍāsandī, srucau dve, dve cāgarte srucāvapi ।
dvau śaphau, dvau cāpi dhṛṣṭī, methī, ca śaṃkavastrayaḥ ।। 13 ।।
vyajanāni trīṇi, rukmau dvau, tathaikā'bhidhānikā, ।
nidāne, śākhadāmāni, tathā muñjatṛṇāni ca ।। 14।।
evaṃ pravargyasaṃbhārān adhvaryuścāharattataḥ ।
brahmaṇā cāpyanujñātaḥ pravṛñjanamathā'karot ।। 15।।
rauhiṇākhyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ vidhinā samapādayat ।
dvārāntike catuḥśaṃkūn kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamityapi ।। 16 ।।
agniṃ prajvālya tatraiva mahāvīraṃ nidhāya ca ।
ājyenā''pūrya tanmukhaṃ pidhāya kanakena ca ।। 17।।
punaḥ punaḥ prakṛtvaivaṃ cādhvaryuśca tataḥ param ।
śaṃkuṣu gāṃ ca govatsamajāṃ badhvā dudoha ca ।। 18।।
mahāvīre payastacca cikṣepoṣmā tato'bhavat ।
ta(tṛ?)pte ghṛte payaḥkṣepaḥ pravṛñjanaṃ samucyate ।। 1 9।।
pravargyaṃ karma caivaitaccakārā'dhvaryureva ha ।
tataśca pratiprasthātā puroḍāśaṃ tu rauhiṇam ।। 2.245.20 ।।
agartayā juhvayā''havanīye sma ca juhvati ।
adhva(śva?)ryuścā''śrāvaṇaṃ ca pratyāśrāvaṇamityapi ।। 21 ।।
kṛtvā juhāva ca ghṛtaṃ payomiśraṃ ca vīra''gam ।
mahāvīrasthitaṃ dugdhaṃ hutaṃ gharma prakīrtyate ।। 22।।
aśvinau ca mahendraśca devate'sya prakīrtite ।
avaśiṣṭena ca sviṣṭakṛtaṃ homaṃ cakāra ha ।। 23 ।।
dadhnā prāpūrya ca mahāvīraṃ taddhomamācarat ।
vedyāṃ śeṣaṃ nidhāyāpi pratiprasthātā tataḥ ।। 24।।
rauhiṇapuroḍāśasya homaṃ kiñciccakāra saḥ ।
adhvaryuśca ṣaṭśalahomāँścakāra vai tataḥ ।।25।।
agnihotraṃ tathā homaṃ kṛtvā ca śeṣabhakṣaṇam ।
hotṛbrahmā'gnīdhrayajamānaiḥ saha cakāra ha ।। 26।।
evaṃ prātaḥ pravargyaṃ vai samapadyata vai tadā ।
sāyaṃ pravargyamevāpi tathaiva tu bhaviṣyati ।। 27।।
chinnasya yajñaśirasaḥ sandhānārthaṃ pravargyakam ।
yajño viṣṇuḥ purā rādhe devaiḥ satramathā''caran ।। 28।।
yaśo viṣṇuravāpaiva na devāste tataḥ param ।
yuyudhurviṣṇunā sākaṃ viṣṇustu dhanuṣā surān ।।29।।
vijitya ca dhanuṣkoṭiṃ cibukā'dho vidhāya ca ।
tasthau tadā tu vamryaśca bhūtale jyāmavasthitām ।।2.245.3 0 ।।
bhūmikoṭeścicchiduśca dhanurvegāt samutpatat ।
viṣṇoḥ śiraḥ kaṇṭhadeśādutpāṭya gatamambare ।।3 1 ।।
tasya viṣṇoryajñamūrteśchinnamūrdhnaḥ prapūjane ।
niṣphalā abhavan devāḥ prārthayanta tadā'śvinau ।।32।।
śirastatpratisandhātuṃ tau tadā prāhatuḥ surān ।
somayāge havirbhāgastvāvayorastu cādyataḥ ।।33।।
devairbhāgaḥ pradattaśca tāvayojayatāṃ śiraḥ ।
tadevaitat pravargyaṃ vai yajñaśiraso yojanam ।। 34।।
mahāvīro yajñaśirorūpo bodhyaśca rādhike ।
tataśca prātarupasad iṣṭiścāpi hyajāyata ।। 35।।
agniḥ somo viṣṇurete pradhānadevatāstrayaḥ ।
ājyaṃ dravyaṃ dadau home tebhyo devebhya eva tu ।। 36।।
subrahmaṇyāhvānameva vidhāya viratistataḥ ।
sāyaṃkāle pravargyopasadau cakāra vai tathā ।। 37।।
subrahmāyāhvānameva cakāra viratistataḥ ।
evaṃ karma navamyāṃ vai somasya samajāyata ।। 38।।
tataḥ sarve bhojanāni cakrurmiṣṭānnakāni hi ।
rātrau śrīlomaśaścopādideśa mokṣasādhanam ।। 3 9।।
upāsanāvidvihīnasya śiraśchedo bhavedataḥ ।
upāsanīyo bhagavān śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।।2.245.40।।
anyebhyo vṛttimāhṛtya dhārayecchrīharau yadā ।
tadaikatānatāniṣṭhā jāyate parameśvare ।।41 ।।
indriyāhārasaṃhārairmanāahāravarjanam ।
ahaṃlayena vai buddhyā''tmano jñānaṃ prajāyate ।।।42।।
jñānena yacchedātmānaṃ tataḥ śāntimavāpnuyāt ।
iṃdriyāṇāmanudraṣṭā hāntarāṇāmapi sthiraḥ ।।43 ।।
ātmanaścātmanā draṣṭā durgaṃ tarati dustaram ।
svabhāvena yadi vyāghraḥ śvā vā sūkara eva vā ।।44।।
siṃho vā śarabho hastī mārjāro vānaro'pi vā ।
jambūkaḥ kāka evāpi nāgo vā vṛściko'pi vā ।।45।।
bako vā gardabho vāpi svabhāvairīdṛśo'pi yaḥ ।
pāpo vā puṇyakṛdvāpi kliṣṭo vā kleśamadhyamaḥ ।।46 ।।
akleśā vā vyāpṛto vā daridro vañcako'pi vā ।
pūrvāvasthānikṛṣṭo'pi sāṃkhyadharmamupāśritaḥ ।।47।।
yogavān sādhusaṃgī ca kṛṣṇadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
taratyevā''śayadurgaṃ vāsanābdhiṃ mahārṇavam ।।48।।
yajñāsanaṃ hrīvarūthaṃ dharmavairāgyakūbaram ।
prāṇayugaṃ vicārākṣaṃ prajñāmārgaṃ kṛtodaram ।।49 ।।
ācāranemiṃ cendriyavāhanaṃ jñānanābhikam ।
śamapratodakaṃ puṇyasārathiṃ haryadhiṣṭhitam ।।2.245.5 0 ।।
jīvarathaṃ dīrghamārge pārayet sādhuvāhitam ।
sthāpayedakṣarodyāne rakṣayedālaye pare ।।51 ।।
brahmajñānapratiṣṭhaṃ ca sarvayajñaparāyaṇam ।
anantaiśvaryasampannaṃ bhaktyā raṅgīkṛtāntaram ।।।52।।
bhāsate hṛdye kṛṣṇaḥ prakāśate'ntare bahiḥ ।
etādṛśe pare bhakte sarvaṃ vai nihitaṃ jagat ।।53 ।।
evaṃ māhātmyabhāvasya sadṛśaṃ nāsti kiñcana ।
pṛthvīṃ jitvā jalaṃ tejo vāyuṃ jitvā tathā'mbaram ।। 54।।
tanmātrāṇi tato jitvā'haṃbuddhiṃ ca jayettu yaḥ ।
īśabhāvaṃ jayeccāpi parameśapadaṃ vrajet ।।55।।
pauruṣaṃ karma daivaṃ ca kālaṃ grahān vijitya ca ।
svabhāvaṃ vāsanāṃ māyāṃ jitvā'kṣarapadaṃ vrajet ।।56।।
tapodharmaparāḥ proktāḥ satyayugina eva ha ।
yajñadharmaparāḥ proktāstretāyugina eva ha ।157।।
dānadharmaparāḥ proktā janā dvāparayoginaḥ ।
dharmotsādaparāḥ proktāstiṣyayugina eva ca ।।58।।
brahmadharmaparāḥ proktā mokṣayogina eva te ।
parabrahmaparāścet syuste bhavantyakṣarasthitāḥ ।।59।।
nā'ntarā vidyātapasī nāntarendriyanigraham ।
nāntarā sarvasantyāgaṃ mokṣaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ।।2.245.60 ।।
sraṣṭā sarvāṇi tattvāni sarjanasya kṣaṇe purā ।
jīvātmane pradattāni bhogasvargavimuktaye ।।61 ।।
bhūmideśe jalaṃ kukṣau tejo manasi netrayoḥ ।
prāṇe vāyuścāvakāśaḥ koṣṭhalādau niveśitāḥ ।।62।।
tanmātrāṇi tu sarvāṇi golakeṣu dhṛtāni vai ।
viṣayā api sannyastāścendriyārthāśca vastuṣu ।।63 ।।
pāde viṣṇurbale śukro haste cendro nidhāpitāḥ ।
koṣṭhe tvagnirdiśaḥ karṇe jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ।।64।।
candro manasi brahmā tu buddhau citte haristathā ।
nihitāḥ sarvadevāste jīve'ntaryāmī keśavaḥ ।।65 ।।
ityete nihitāḥ sarve'kṣaraṃ tu brahmarandhrake ।
tejastu hṛdaye śreṣṭhaṃ suṣumṇāyāṃ niveśitam ।।66।।
sarvaṃ vai vidyate tvatra mārgayitā'sya durlabhaḥ ।
pramārgyaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ brahmapathaṃ samādhinā ।।67।।
bhaktiśakaṭīṃ cāruhya yāyāddhāmā'kṣaraṃ kṛtī ।
svapradīpaprakāśena parātmānaṃ vilokayet ।।68।।
evaṃ paśyet sa vai pretya kalpate brahmabhūyase ।
parameśo jaṃgameṣu dhruveṣu vasati prabhuḥ ।।69।।
tamātmānaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaparaṃ prapadyate ।
yāvānātmanivedātmā tāvān paranivedavān ।।2.245.70 ।।
satataṃ nyāsavān kṛṣṇe so'mṛtatvāya kalpate ।
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kālo yena vipacyate ।।71 ।।
taṃ paraṃ pākinaṃ labdhvā punargrāso na jāyate ।
akṣaraṃ brahma bhūtvaiva parabrahmā'bhiyāti ca । ।72।।
sa sūkṣmaḥ sa mahāsthūlaḥ so'ntare sa bahiḥ prabhuḥ ।
adhruveṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhan bāhyabhāsā na bhāti saḥ । ।73 ।।
dṛśyate cāntarabhāsā bhāsvatā cātmanā'rthitaḥ ।
anugrahavaśaḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktyā saṃbhāsate'ntare । ।74।।
divyā'mṛtā'kṣarapade tiṣṭhannapīha tiṣṭhati ।
tattulye cātmani svāmyāśraye kalmaṣavarjite ।।75।।
upaśāntaśca dāntaścā'dhyātmaśīlapaṭaśca yaḥ ।
ātmārāmo buddhakṛṣṇo yāti tatparamaṃ padam ।।76।।
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ lobhaṃ mānaṃ svapnaṃ ca bhāvanām ।
asaṃkalpena ca śāntyā cā'pramādāt trayaṃ jayet । ।77।।
audāryeṇa vicāreṇa sattvena ca trayaṃ jayet ।
dhṛtyā śiśnodaraṃ cāpi pāṇipādaṃ ca cakṣuṣā ।।78 ।।
cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā manovācaṃ ca karmaṇā ।
karma sarvārpaṇenāpi jayet kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।।79।।
brahmatejomayaṃ sarvaṃ paśyed rasātmakaṃ harim ।
tejastu vardhate dhyānād dhyānaṃ bhaktyā pravardhate ।।2.245.8 0 ।।
bhaktiḥ saṃvardhate snehāt sneho māhātmyabodhanāt ।
bodhaścāpi satāṃ saṃgāt santo hareḥ kṛpālavāt ।।8 1 ।।
kṛpā ca śaraṇe pātāt prātaḥ prayojanāttathā ।
prayojanaṃ sukhaṃ jīve yadarthaṃ ca pravartate ।।8 2।।
pravṛttiścecchayā cecchā jñānājjñānaṃ tu śāstrajam ।
kathāśravaṇamāhātmyājjāyate divyabhāvanā ।।8 3।।
tasmād divyāṃ kathāṃ prājñaḥ śṛṇuyānnityameva tu ।
yena cintāmaṇirlabdhaḥ kathātmā tasya kiṃ punaḥ ।।84।।
etaistu vardhate tejaścaiśvaryaṃ paramārthatā ।
sarvaṃhyarthāśca siddhyanti brahmatejaḥ prakāśate ।।85।।
tejasā prakṛtiṃ jitvā pragacched brahma śāśvatam ।
indriyāṇi prachidrāṇi prajñāsrāvakarāṇi vai ।।86 ।।
tāni rundhyānmano vṛtvā nijātmani parātmani ।
prasīdatyāntaraṃ tattvaṃ tena brahma prakāśate ।। 87।।
svayaṃ brahmaṇi divye vai brahma nijātmani dhruve ।
parasparaṃ prapaśyetāṃ muktāviva prayogiṇau ।।88।।
evaṃ rahaḥ kṛtābhyāso gacchedakṣarasāmyatām ।
siddhīraiśvaryopasargānanādṛtyā'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।। 8 9।।
prātarutthāya tatraivā''sane sañcintayeddharim ।
brahmayajñaṃ dhyānayajñaṃ pūjāyajñaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 2.245.90 ।।
dravyayajñaṃ caret paścānniyamyeta manojavam ।
nābhiṣvajetpārśvavartipadārthe manasāpi tu ।।9 1 ।।
nābhidhyāyedavamānamāne harṣapravejane ।
dhyāyedātmani deveśaṃ parameśaṃ makhāśritam ।। 92।।
evaṃ dhyānātmanaḥ sādhoḥ samavṛttyabhiyoginaḥ ।
śīghraṃ brahmaparaṃ naije gahvare bhāsate'malam ।। 93 ।।
etena tu pathā nārī napuṃsako'pi vā janaḥ ।
prasādya brahma paramaṃ pragacchet paramāṃ gatim ।। 94।।
mukto bhūtvā prapaśyeta muktamanādinaṃ harim ।
brahma bhūtvā prapaśyeta brahmā'kṣaraṃ sukhālayam ।। 95।।
parabrahma prapaśyeta brahmanetreṇa muktarāṭ ।
karmaṇā badhyate janturharāvanārpitena ha ।। 96।।
vidyayā mucyate janturharāvarpitayā tayā ।
tasmādubhau hareryogau kartavyau yatinā tviha ।। 97।।
sarvārpaṇau tu tau divyau nayato dhāma cāśritam ।
yatra gatvā na maraṇaṃ na śoko na punarbhavaḥ ।। 98।।
tadāṃ'śaṃ svaṃ vijānīyādātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।
yajñaṃ karma havaṃ bhāvaṃ harau tasmāt samarpayet ।। 99।।
ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo virarāma ha ।
parihāraḥ sabhāyāścā'bhavat tato'danāni ca ।। 2.245.10 0।।
abhavaँstṛptidānyeva rātrau viśrāntimāvahan ।
raṭantaḥ śrīharernāma dhyāyantaśca hariṃ janāḥ ।। 10 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne somayāge dvitīyadivasīya kṛtye subrahmaṇyaupasadapravargyādikaṃ havanaparihāraścopadeśo lomaśakṛtaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 245 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 245 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 246
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 247 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha tato yajñatṛtīye divase punaḥ ।
prāvartata daśamyāṃ somādhvarasya vidhānakam ।। 1 ।।
lomaśaścāyayau rājā cāyayau kṛtapuṇyakaḥ ।
prātaḥ pravargyopasadāvabhyanuṣṭhitavān guruḥ ।। 2 ।।
mahāvedyāśca nirmāṇaṃ maṇḍapāt ṣaṭpadāni vai ।
dūre'pi purataścakre yathāsthavidhito guruḥ ।। 3 ।।
prākpaścāddvāsaptatisaṃkhyakapadāyatā matā ।
dakṣiṇottarataḥ ṣaṣṭipadāvistārikā ca sā ।। 4 ।।
śroṇībhāge cāṃsabhāge'ṣṭācatvāriṃśadāyatā ।
etādṛśīṃ samagrāṃ ca vedīṃ nirmāya vai tataḥ ।। 5 ।।
yajamāno vrataṃ dugdhapānātmakaṃ dadhāra ha ।
havanādyaṃ cakārāpi sarvānuṣṭheyamityapi ।। 6 ।।
sāyāhnikībhyāṃ pravagyopasadbhyāṃ sāyamityapi ।
payovrataṃ pracaryaiva subrahmaṇyāṃ tu devatām ।। 7 ।।
indrātmikāṃ samāhūya vrataṃ cakre tataḥ param ।
virāmaśca parihārastataḥ prasādabhojanam ।। 8 ।।
yāvatāṃ mahīmānānāṃ miṣṭānnaḥ pāyasādibhiḥ ।
abhūdākāṣṭhatṛptyātma, tataḥ śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।। 9 ।।
upādideśa rātrau tu sabhāyāṃ mokṣakṛd yathā ।
brahmacaryeṇa vai lokān jayanti paramarṣayaḥ ।। 2.246.10 ।।
śāśvataṃ paramaṃ śreyo vindanti ca tataḥ param ।
vane mūlaphalādāśca tapyanto vipulaṃ tapaḥ ।। 11 ।।
devāyatanavāsāśca bhūtānāṃ hitacintakāḥ ।
satāṃ samāgame magnāḥ kalpyante brahmabhūyase ।। 1 2।।
brahmacārā gṛhacārā vanacārāśca sādhavaḥ ।
svoktācārā harau lagnā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ।। 13 ।।
nityakarmasamācārā jñānadagdhaphalā hi ye ।
akāmadveṣadoṣāste vidhīyante'kṣare pare ।। 14।।
catuṣpadī hi niḥśreṇī brahmārohaṇasādhanī ।
tāmāruhya hariṃ lamban brahmalokaṃ prayāti vai ।। 15।।
brahmacāro brahmavrate tiṣṭhan sarvaṃ labheta ha ।
gururbrahma vrataṃ brahma vedo brahma haristathā ।। 16।।
tān praseveta satataṃ brahmalokagato bhavet ।
guroḥ sevāṃ prakuryādvai yajñatulyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 17।।
yattu śiṣyeṇa kartavyaṃ dāsena vā ca taccaret ।
kiṃkaraḥ sarvakārī syānmānahīno'tibhāvukaḥ ।। 18।।
āhūtaḥ sarvamutsṛjya samāgacched guruṃ prati ।
iṣṭaṃ brūyāt premapūrṇacakṣuṣekṣeta vai gurum ।। 1 9।।
bhojayitvā gurūँstato'śnīyāt pibettathottaram ।
pādasammardanaṃ kuryāt pādāvasya mṛdu spṛśet ।। 2.246.20 ।।
ājñāpaya karomyeṣa bhagavanniti sevayet ।
guroḥ sevārthamevā'sau samīpastho bhaved vaset ।। 21 ।।
gṛhastho'pi prasevedvai guruṃ devaṃ satīṃ patim ।
dharmai cā'napavādaṃ ca bhaktiṃ kuryādatandritaḥ ।। 22।।
devāya gurave dadyādannaṃ pakvaṃ pravāsine ।
nyāsine'pi pradadyācca nā''tmārthe pācayet kvacit ।। 23।।
nā'syā'tithirvaset kaścid gṛhāgato hyapūjitaḥ ।
pūjyebhyo dīnabālebhyo'nāthā'tithibhya ityapi ।।24।।
sadbhya satībhyaḥ sādhvībhyo havyaṃ kavyaṃ dadedapi ।
pūjyā bhavanti satataṃ dhārmikāstāpasā janāḥ ।।।25।।।
tathaivā'pacamānāśca tebhyo deyaṃ gṛhaṃjuṣā ।
vighasāśī bhaveccāpi bhavedamṛtabhojanaḥ ।।26 ।।
vighasaṃ bhṛtyaśeṣaṃ ca devaśeṣaṃ tathā'mṛtam ।
sambandhibhiḥ kuṭumbena bandhubhirvivadenna ca ।। 27।।
ācāryo brahmalokeśastena vādaṃ na cācaret ।
pitā prājāpatyanāthastena vādaṃ na cācaret ।।28।।
atithistvindralokeśastena vādaṃ na cācaret ।
ṛtvig vai devalokeśastena vādaṃ na cācaret ।।29।।
jāmiścāpsarasāṃ lokeśastena vivadenna vai ।
jñātirvaiśvadevalokeśvarī tayā na bhedayet ।। 2.246.30 ।।
sambandhibāndhavā digīśvarāstairna virodhayet ।
mātṛmātulavargāśca pṛthvī tayā na bhedayet ।। 31 ।।
vṛddhabālāturakṛśā - vyoma tena na bhedayet ।
bhrātā pitṛsamo bhāryā putraḥ putrī svakā tanuḥ ।। 32।।
chāyā svā dāsavargāścā''śritāśca kṛpaṇā janāḥ ।
tasmādetairadhikṣiptaḥ saheta na pratikṣipet ।। 3 3।।
kurvan karmāṇi sarvāṇi gārhasthyaniyatāni vai ।
kāmalobhabhayairvyāptaścared yadi mano vinā ।। 34।।
nirdvandvo niranudṛptaḥ sādhuvad yadi vartate ।
harau cālambanaṃ prāpto mucyate sa na badhyate ।।35। ।
sa cakrāṃkitaloke vai gatiṃ prāpnoti cottamām ।
jitendriyāṇāṃ sadṛśīṃ gatiṃ cāpnoti śobhanām ।।36 ।।
svargo dānigṛhasthānāṃ phalapuṣparasātmakaḥ ।
svargaścāpi?gṛhasthānāṃ dvitīyaḥ śāśvataḥ paraḥ ।। 37।।
sa gṛhastho nijaṃ dehaṃ valīpalitamudbalam ।
vīkṣya devaṃ pareśaṃ vai bhajed vananivāsavat ।। 38।।
alpāhāro bhavet satvāhāraḥ kandaphalāśanaḥ ।
dharmaṃ caupaniṣadagaṃ pālayed brahmasaṃjuṣam ।।3 9। ।
vane'raṇye gṛhe vā ca vāsaṃ kṛtvā maharṣivat ।
pare brahmaṇi saṃlagno bhavenmokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।2.246.40 ।।
yajñaṃ homaṃ tathā sarvadakṣiṇāṃ pravidhāya ca ।
yadvā sādhurbhavedvāpi brahmaputro hyamānavaḥ ।।41 ।।
jīvacchrāddhaṃ prakuryāttu bhavedātmātmaniṣṭhakaḥ ।
svamātmani samāropya karmakāṇḍaṃ cared vratī ।।42।।
bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ।
ijyāṃ ca raṭaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ brahmabhāvanam ।।43।।
tadarthasarvakarmāṇi carenmuktavadāsthitaḥ ।
abhayaṃ tvātmani dhrauvyaṃ labdhvā datvā'nyagarviṇe ।।44।।
pravrajyāṃ paralokāya gṛhṇīyāt sādhudharmavān ।
lokāstejomayāstasyottarottaramahāsukhāḥ ।।45।।
vartamāno'pi loke'tra bhavedakṣayatṛptimān ।
tyaktvā dehaṃ hareryogādakṣarā''nantyamaśnute ।।46 ।।
sadehaḥ pūrṇamevā'trā''kāśavad vartate sadā ।
na kruddhyenna ca prahṛṣyed brahmavad vartate śuciḥ ।।47।।
nābhinandecca maraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ vā nisargajam ।
brahmaiva sampratīkṣeta svāminaṃ sevako yathā ।।48 ।।
anabhyāhatacittaḥ syānnirmuktaḥ pāpmanaḥ sadā ।
abhayaṃ ca nijaṃ cāpi bhūtānāmapi yatkṛtam ।।49।।
mohamuktasya kasmāccid bhayaṃ yasya na vidyate ।
amṛte nityaṃ vasati śaraṇyaḥ sarvadehinām ।।2.246.5 0 ।।
prajñātṛpto nirīhaśca saṃgamukto'timṛtyugaḥ ।
jīvitaṃ yasya dharmārthaṃ dharmo haryarthameva tu ।।51।।
nirmukto bandhanaiḥ so'yaṃ brahmavid brāhmaṇo bhavan ।
ātmodbhavaṃ bhāvadravyaṃ juhoti paramātmani ।।52 ।।
homajanyāṃ haristṛptiṃ yāti prasannatātmikām ।
taṃ puṇyaṃ ca samarjyaiva yāti brahma sanātanam ।।53 ।।
devāstameva puṣṇanti spṛhayanti parāṃ gatim ।
tāṃ spṛhāṃ saphalāṃ prāptaḥ paramātmānamīkṣate ।। 54।।
prākṛtān pravikārāँśca mṛtān vīkṣyā'mṛtaṃ gataḥ ।
praśāntāpmodāsanaḥ sa ṛcchatyevā'mṛtaṃ padam ।।55।।।
saṃkalpān saṃprahatvaiva cittaṃ sattve'bhiveśayet ।
kālaṃ jitvā'mṛtaṃ yāyāt parameśasahāyataḥ ।।5 6 । ।
cittaprasannatāprāptau śubhā'śubhaṃ nivartate ।
divyātmānaṃ prapadyaiva sukhamānantyamaśnute ।।57।।
nidrā yasya sukhāptā syāt prasādastasya cātmani ।
prasādito hariścāsmai yacchatyānandaśevadhim ।।58 ।।
yasya sthānikṛte cāpyāmantraṇe phalgutā'sti ca ।
tasya prasādaḥ satataṃ vartate'kṣarasadṛśaḥ ।।59।।
indriyāṇāṃ yadā raśmīn manasā sanniyacchati ।
mano buddhyā niyamyeta tadā''tmā saṃprakāśate ।।।2.246.60 ।।
vimuktāntarabāhyaiśca guṇadoṣairna lipyate ।
aliptasya ratistatra jāyeta paramātmani ।। 61 ।।
pradhvastaguṇavṛttiścā'pravṛtto guṇakarmasu ।
hṛdayagranthiśūnyaśca brahmagranthiṃ pravindati ।। 6 2।।
parabrahmaparā śāntiṃ sāmarthyaṃ cāpi vindati ।
ātmajñānaṃ śamaśceti brahmabhāve'tisādhanam ।। 63 ।।
brahmabhāvaḥ parabrahmā'vāptido'tra na saṃśayaḥ ।
na hyato'styadhikā prāptirhareḥ prāpteḥ parāḥ khalu ।। 64।।
yatkarotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tattu nirguṇam ।
haryabhisandhipūrvaṃ ca divyaṃ muktipradaṃ hiṃ tat। ।। 65।।
yasmāddharmātparo dharmo nāstyeveha hariṃ vinā ।
brahmadharmaḥ paro dharmaḥ sarvadharmāvaguṇṭhanaḥ ।।66 ।।
harau sarvapravṛttīnāṃ layo dharma paraṃ tapaḥ ।
tapasā cātmatṛptaḥ san phalānandaṃ samaśnute ।। 67।।
āntaraṃ mārgamāsādya prāsādasthaṃ paraṃ prabhum ।
sarvātmānaṃ nijātmanaṃ prapadyate prakāśitam ।।68।।
antarātmā tadā cāsmai sarvasvaṃ pradadāti ha ।
jñānadīptimate naijasvarūpāpannayogine ।।69।।
saṃsāravāridhiṃ so'yaṃ tīrṇo māyāmayaṃ jagat ।
brahmamayaṃ prapannaśca brahmā'syā'traiva kāśate ।।2.246.70 ।।
nātmā strī vā pumānvāpi napuṃsako'pi naiva ha ।
na jaḍo na svabhāvaśca brahmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
parabrahmā'vaguptaśca parabrahmā'vabodhitaḥ ।
parabrahmaprapuṣṭaśca parabrahmādanastathā ।।72।।
parabrahmarasaścāpi parabrahmābhinandanaḥ ।
parabrahmaśarīraśca parabrahmasukhaplutaḥ ।।।73 ।।
parabrahmasakhaścāpi parabrahmaprayātrikaḥ ।
parabrahmaprasārthaśca parabrahmāśrayaśramaḥ ।।74।।
parabrahmakṛtāvāsaḥ pare brahmaṇi yāti hi ।
parabrahmasusarvasvo muktiṃ vindati tanmayīm ।।75।।
yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu vai pṛthak ।
duḥkhaṃ ca pāpakaṃ cāpi brahma sampadyate tadā ।।76 ।।
vāsanā bandhanaṃ tvekaṃ mahattamaṃ hi bandhanam ।
vāsanābandhanānmukto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ।। 77।।
jñānasyopaniṣacchāntiḥ śānteścopaniṣat sukham ।
sukhasyopaniṣat tṛptistṛpteścopaniṣat tyajiḥ ।।78।।
tyāgī na bandhanaṃ yāti prasannātmā harau sthitaḥ ।
pare brahmaṇi niṣṭhātmā sukhānantyaṃ samaśnute ।। 79।।
ajanyaṃ cāpyasaṃhāryaṃ nityasiddhamamiśritam ।
parabrahmāptisaṃvedyaṃ sukhamavyayamaśnute ।।2.246.8 0 ।।
vegaśūnyaṃ mano yasya pratiṣṭhā parameśvare ।
tṛptiryasya pare deve tasya tuṣṭirhi śāśvatī ।।8 1 ।।
yena tṛpyatyabhuñjāno yena tṛpyatyavittavān ।
yenā'sneho bale dhatte taṃ hariṃ vṛṇuyāt kṛtī ।।82।।
nijadvārāṇi saṃyamyodghāṭayed dvāramācyutam ।
tenātmaratipātheyo vindate tvacyutā'kṣaram ।।8 3 ।।
suviśrāntaṃ pare kṛṣṇo ṭattakāmaṃ harau prabhau ।
sarvataḥ sukhamāyāti cākṣayāt sukhasāgarāt ।।84।।
taṃ prabādhitamāyaṃ ca prabādhitātmakalmaṣam ।
abādhitaharidhyānaṃ jarāmṛtyū na vindataḥ ।। 85।।
evaṃ vai sarvato mukto brahmā'mukto virājate ।
paramaṃ brahma caivā'syā'muktaṃ bhavati bhāvini ।।86 ।।
evamullaṃghya triguṇān prāpya dhāmā'kṣaraṃ tviha ।
punarāvartanaṃ naiti samprāpto hi paraṃ padam ।।87।।
ajñānamūlo vṛkṣo yaḥ kāmakalpaḥ sa ucyate ।
viṣayāptistabakaśca śākhāstu viṣayā matāḥ ।।88।।
saṃbhogā nālikāstasya svādāḥ patrāṇi vai taroḥ ।
prītiḥ puṣpāṇi tasyāpi sukhaṃ phalāni cāsya vai ।।89 ।।
duḥkhasaṃkaratā tatra duṣṭakledaprakardamaḥ ।
mohinī rasatṛṣṇā ca māyā cājñānamātṛkāḥ ।।2.246.9 0 ।।
hariṃ prāpya ca tāṃ māyāṃ vivāsayeddhi yātrikaḥ ।
tena sarvaṃ prayātyeva līnatāṃ yāṃtrikasya vai ।।।91 ।।
satyeva svagṛhe kṛṣṇaḥ svargamaṇiḥ prakāśate ।
śītalaṃ taṃ prakāśaṃ ca labdhvā'kṣarapradaṃ vrajet। ।।92।।
tatsukhaṃ tvakṣarasaṃjñaṃ brahmaparāt samāhitam ।
yatrā''hitaṃ ca tatpātraṃ brahmarūpaṃ nijātmakam ।।93 ।।
acchidraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ bhaktyupāsanālepabandhitam ।
premarase prapakvaṃ ca snehasudhābhisaṃbhṛtam ।। 94।।
haridhyānaikatānākhyadivyākāranivāsitam ।
muktabhāvagataiḥ saṃrakṣitaṃ yanna viśīryate ।। 95।।
tadakṣayaṃ cāmṛtaṃ śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtam ।
naijaṃ nijātmasaukhyaṃ śrīharyāpūrakapūritam ।। 96।।
ya etat kṛpayā prāptaḥ prāpto vā sādhanairapi ।
nā'sya kośe sravaścāste prasādātparamātmanaḥ ।। 97।।
yajñairdānaiśca havanaiḥ prāptavyaṃ tvetadeva ha ।
ātmanastu tato'nyadvai prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।। 98 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmallomaśaḥ sadguruḥ svayam ।
upādiśya virarāma dugdhapānaṃ vyadhānniśi ।। 99।।
sarvebhyo'pi payaḥpānaṃ kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।
atha rātrau praviśrāntiṃ jagṛhurmakhinaśca te ।। 2.246.100 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaranto hṛdye nije ।
suṣvupuśca mahīmānā maharṣayo'pare'pi ca ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne tṛtīyadivase daśamyāṃ somayāgasya kṛtyottaraṃ bhojanopadeśanādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhika-
dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 246 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 246 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 247
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 248 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike prātarutthāya yajamāno'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
rājā kṛtāhnikaścāpi lomaśo'nyamaharṣayaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛtāhnikā yajñabhūmimāyayuśca samāhitāḥ ।
yāvatsāmagryādiyuktāsturye'hnyekādaśīdine ।। 2 ।।
svastivācaḥ prokṣaṇādi svāṃgaśuddhiṃ tathā'param ।
sarvaṃ karma ca naityoktaṃ cakruryathoditaṃ tathā ।। 3 ।।
viśeṣataḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu samāsatastvidam ।
prātaḥ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarya ca tataḥ param ।। 4 ।।
udvāsyāpi pravargyaṃ prakṣipya pātrāṇi cottare ।
agnīṣomaphalapaśostantramārabdhavān guruḥ ।। 5 ।।
idhmakāṣṭhāni cādhāyā''havanīye'prakāśayat ।
ādāya jvalitaṃ vahniṃ sīmamādāya vai saha ।। 6 ।।
mahāvedyantargatāyāṃ vedyāṃ vahniṃ nyadhāpayat ।
sa vahnirgārhapatyaśca prājahitākhya ityapi ।। 7 ।।
somaṃ cā'sthāpayaddhavirdhānaśakaṭe eva ca ।
dhṛtvā cātvālapāṃsūँśca taiśca dhiṣṇyānupā'vapat ।। 8 ।।
vapāyāgaṃ vidhāya subrahmaṇyāhvānamācarat ।
adhvaryurvai tataḥ somābhiṣavāya rasarddhaye ।। 9 ।।
taḍāgād vasatīvarījalaṃ ghaṭe samāharat ।
śālāmukhīyakaṃ cāsthāpayan madhyandine tataḥ ।। 2.247.10 ।।
paśupuroḍāśayāgaṃ prānivartayadeva ha ।
sāyāhne'pi hṛdayādiphalāṃgayajanaṃ vyadhāt ।। 11 ।।
kṛtvāṃgāni ca patnīsaṃyājāntānyasamāpayat ।
bhojanāni vyadhuḥ sarve yathāyogyaṃ yathāvratam ।। 1 2।।
rātrāvadhvaryurevāpi vasatīvarīdhraṃ ghaṭam ।
skandhenādāya vedyāśca parito viharan nyadhāt ।। 13 ।।
tataśca pratiprasthātā vatsāpākaraṇādikam ।
śvo'pekṣitāmikṣārthakaṃ dadhnā saṃskāramācarat ।। 14।।
dadhigrahārthaṃ ca dadhi picchalaṃ samapādayat ।
savanīyahaviṣyārthaṃ barhirāharaṇaṃ vyadhāt ।। 15।।

725
virāmo yajñakāryasya tatastadā vyajāyata ।
sapatnīko yajamāno rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ vyadhāt ।। 16।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyotsavaprapūrvakam ।
ṣoḍaśādipadārthaiśca pūjanaṃ śrīharervyadhāt ।। 17।।
vratasyodyāpanaṃ rātrau cakāra nṛpatistathā ।
ṛṣayo'pi janāścāpi cakruḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।। 18।।
prātaḥ pūrvaṃ hariḥ sākṣānmuralīdhara eva saḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāramāyutaḥ ।। 1 9।।
divyarūpadharo divyatejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ।
sākṣādbabhūva sarveṣāṃ dhṛtābhūṣo hasan hariḥ ।। 2.247.20 ।।
kaṃbharā dakṣiṇe yasya vāme gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
māṇikyādyā brahmasatyaḥ parito yasya cā'bhavan ।। 21 ।।
prasanno'smi vratenā'dya yajñenāpi viśeṣataḥ ।
phaladātā'smi mokṣātma svargātma yadabhīpsitam ।। 22।।
tato rājādya kṛṣṇaṃ pupūjuḥ prāptavastubhiḥ ।
haristvadṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ svīyasārthayutaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 23 ।।
lomaśo'pi tataḥ sarvānupādideśa pāvanam ।
dharmo naikavidhastvasti lokeṣu ca janeṣu ca ।।24।।
yajñadharmaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇātmā brahmalokadaḥ ।
sevādharmo mahānāśīrvādadvārā divaḥpradaḥ ।। 25 ।।
sarvabhūtā'drohadharmaḥ parasaukhyaprado'sti vai ।
prasannatā pareṣāṃ vai mahānandarddhisampradā ।। 16 ।।
devānāṃ tuṣṭirevāpi maharṣīṇāṃ tathāvidhā ।
āgantukānāṃ tuṣṭiśca paralokasahāyinī ।।27।।
purā maharṣijaṭilāyananāmā vane vasan ।
tapaścacāra bahudhā sthiradeho'calaḥ sadā ।। 28।।
jaṭāyāmasya caṭakā nīḍaṃ cakāra garbhiṇī ।
tāṃ dayāvān maharṣiḥ sa tūpapraikṣata vai tataḥ ।।29।।
tṛṇatantvāḍhyanīḍe vai jaṭāyāṃ caṭakā tu sā ।
apātayattu svāṇḍāni tānyabudhyata vai ṛṣiḥ ।। 2.247.30 ।।
budhvā'pi na cacālaiṣo dharme kṛtamanāstathā ।
sarvabhūtāśrayadānaṃ dharmaḥ śaraṇyarakṣaṇam ।
aṇḍebhyastvatha puṣṭebhyaścājāyanta śakuntakāḥ ।।31 ।।
vyavardhanta ca tatraiva jātapakṣāstathā'bhavan ।
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya sāyaṃ te punarāyānti vai niśi ।
viśramya ca punaryānti prātaḥ kaṇābhivāñcchayā ।। 32।।।
atha kāle gate jātapravāsāḥ pakṣiṇastu te ।
nopāvartanta ca yadā prātiṣṭhata tadā ṛṣiḥ ।।33 ।।

sa cā'manyata dharmo'yaṃ siddho mama tapaḥparaḥ ।
sa cāśrayaṃ dadātyeva kṛtvā''śramaṃ drumānvitam ।।34।।
atithīn sarvarūpāँśca pūjayatyeva sādaram ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra samāyātaḥ parīkṣitum ।।35।।
vyādharūpo mṛtaṃ mṛgaṃ skandhe kṛtvā samāyayau ।
dehyāśrayaṃ tathā cullīṃ pātraṃ ca samidhastathā ।।36।।
cāṇḍālo'haṃ kukkurādo dehi te yadi rocate ।
jaṭāyano vicāryaiva dadau cullīṃ samit tathā ।।37।।
pātraṃ vahniṃ dadau cāpi parṇaśālāṃ dadau tathā ।
āśrayā''gatalokasya sevane na kṣatirbhavet ।।38।।
itivratākhye dharme me cetikṛtvā dadau tadā ।
śvādaḥ sarvaṃ paripācya bubhuje tṛptipūrvakam ।। 3 9।।
sarvaṃ tathā'vaśiṣṭaṃ ca māṃsaṃ śālātale'kṣipat ।
sarvāmaśuddhāṃ kṛtvaiva niṣasāda bahiḥ sthale ।।2.247.40 ।।
pramārjayeti cājñāṃ sa kṛtavān tanmaharṣaye ।
maharṣiḥ suprasannastāṃ śālāṃ śuddhāṃ vyadhāpayat ।।41 ।।
śvādāya prāha cet kiṃcidapekṣitaṃ dadāmi te ।
śvādaḥ prāha caraṇau me mardanaṃ samapekṣataḥ ।।42।।
ṛṣistasya pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ।
phalapatrajalapānaṃ dadau bhāvena vai punaḥ ।।43 ।।
prīyatāṃ bhagavānatra śaraṇāntarvasan prabhuḥ ।
ityuktvā pradadau vāri tāvadantarhito'bhavat ।।44।।
tejasā vyāptadehaśca divyarūpo babhūva ha ।
caturbhujaḥ prabhuḥ śrīmān lakṣmīśrīsevito hariḥ ।।45।।
jaṭilāyana evāsau nanāma pādayoḥ prabhoḥ ।
kṛpā kṛtā hare cātra kṛtakṛtyaḥ kṛtastvayā ।।46 ।।
dehi dhāmā'kṣaraṃ nātha darśanottarameva te ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha ṛṣirdehaṃ vihāya ca ।।47।।
yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ tatra sevādharmeṇa sarvathā ।
tasmād yajñaiśca dānaiśca gṛhaiśca vastubhistathā ।।48।।
sevanīyā atithayastatra nārāyaṇo milet ।
śaraṇāgatarakṣā vai nārāyaṇasya sevanam ।।49।।
tadantarātmā bhagavān prasanno jāyate dhruvam ।
taṃ pralakṣya samuddiśya dehinaṃ sevayejjanaḥ ।।2.247.5 0 ।।
sa ca yajño mahānāste yajñaprāptipradaḥ śubhaḥ ।
hariṃ vinā mahāyajñā ayajñāste bhavanti vai ।।5 1 ।।
athā'nye'pi ca manyante krayavikrayamokṣaṇam ।
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ca nirguṇam ।।52।।

726
sarvadehiṣu vai cāste parameśo'ntare sthitaḥ ।
krayī vā vikrayī nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ na cā'paraḥ ।।53 ।।
lābhaṃ prāpyā''nandameti cāhartā parameśvaraḥ ।
dātā dhanaṃ tathā prāpyā''nandameti pareśvaraḥ ।।54।।
śākavikrayanāmā vai purā kaścid vaṇigjanaḥ ।
satyamārgaṃ samāśrityā'karodvai krayavikrayau ।।55।।
pūrvaṃ prātaḥ svapitarau prapūjya sa. vaṇigjanaḥ ।
bhojayitvā nideśaṃ saṃgṛhītvā yāti cā''paṇam ।।56 ।।
śākāni tulayā so'pi dadāti krayiṇe tadā ।
krayī bālo'thavā vṛddho yuvā vā cetaro'pi vā ।।57।।
strī vā kanyā ca vā'pakvabuddhiryaḥ ko'pyupasthitaḥ ।
namaste viṣṇave coktvā dadātyeva tadarthitam ।।58।।
na nyūnaṃ vartate tatra tulāyāṃ vai manāgapi ।
dadāti ceśvarabhāvād bhikṣukāyā'pi vai phalam ।।59।।
kramavāreṇa sarvebhyo dadātyeva na vikramāt ।
yathāyogyaṃ dadātyeva matvā tatra narāyaṇam ।।2.247.6 0।।
sa ca nityaṃ vikrayaṃ saṃkurvan jñānaṃ karoti vai ।
krayiṇaḥ! sarvathā yūyaṃ bhajadhvaṃ parameśvaram ।।6 1 ।।
sarveṣāṃ yaḥ suhṛnnityaṃ sarveṣāṃ suhite rataḥ ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā'ntarātmānaṃ bhajadhvamut ।।62।।
dveṣaṃ kāmaṃ tyajataiva smarata śrīpareśvaram ।
kāँścinnaivā'nuruँnddhavaṃ mā virodhayata kaiḥ saha ।। 63 ।।
samaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tatra jñātvā bhajata taṃ harim ।
divyabhāvāśca bhavata samaloṣṭhāśmakāñcanāḥ ।।64।।
yathā'ndhā badhirā naiva paśyantyākarṇayantyapi ।
tathā bhāvyaṃ viṣayeṣu prāndhaiśca badhiraiḥ sadā ।। 65।।
parameśe tvanandhatvaṃ cā'bādhiryaṃ kathāśrave ।
mūkatvaṃ tvanyaviṣaye parameśe tu vāgmitā ।। 66।।
evaṃ sarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ nārāyaṇe sacetanam ।
acetanaṃ viṣayeṣu prāptavyaṃ mānavairiha ।। 67।।
yathā vṛddhā''turakṛśā nispṛhā vai nisargataḥ ।
tayā bhāvyaṃ viṣayeṣu spṛhāhīnairjanairiha ।। 68।।
yadā svasya bhayaṃ nāsti svasmād bhayaṃ na vidyate ।
rāgadveṣādiśūnyasya brahmaprāptiḥ suniścitā ।।69।।
pāpabhāvaviyuktasya brahmasampattiruttamā ।
yatrā'bhayaṃ mahān dharmaḥ sa prāpnotyabhayaṃ padam ।।2.247.70।।
yasmād bhayaṃ pareṣāṃ syāt tasya tvāyānmahadbhayam ।
ahiṃsāḥ sādhavo loke bhayadā na yathā kvacit ।।7 1 ।।
tathā vṛttiṃ cāśrayata prayāta brahmaśāśvatam ।
adrohavṛttiścā'cauryaṃ cā'sthārthaścā'pratāraṇam ।।72।।
yasya dharmā ime rūḍhāstasya brahma prakāśate ।
bhavantyubhayadānena samā nānye makhādayaḥ ।।73 ।।
loke yaḥ sarvadehibhyo dadātyabhayadakṣiṇāḥ ।
sa sarvayajñairījānaḥ prāpnotyabhayadakṣiṇām ।।74।।
sarvabhūtātmabhūto vai nārāyaṇo nirīkṣakaḥ ।
dadātyabhayadātre vai cā'kṣaraṃ nirbhayaṃ padam ।।75।।
kṛṣyācārā hiṃsrabhāvāstṛṇacchedādikāryakāḥ ।
vṛṣabhādivāhabhāvāḥ kleśadā hi bhayānvitāḥ ।। 76 ।।
paśūn lokā vāhayanti badhnanti damayanti ca ।
mānuṣā mānuṣāneva dāsabhāvena bhuñjate ।।77।।
aśvādīn vāhanān kṛtvā nayanti bahukardamān ।
bhayadā hiṃsrakā lokāstatphalaṃ yānti vai bhayam ।।78।।
aghnyā iti gavāṃ nāma ka etā hantumarhati ।
agniṣome vatsanāma priyaṃ vṛkṣaphalaṃ tu yat ।।79।।
vatsāpākaraṇaṃ tadvai hṛdayaṃ rasapakvatā ।
aṃgānyapi phalasyaiva tena kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati ।।2.247.80 ।।
nā'haṃ hanmi tṛṇaṃ vāpi phalaṃ vāpi kareṇa vai ।
na śastreṇa netareṇa cā'bhayaṃ pālayāmi yat ।।8 1 ।।
śākapatrādikaṃ yogyaṃ pakvaṃ vṛkṣād viyujyate ।
tasyaiva krayaṇaṃ kṛtvā vikrayaṃ prakaromi vai ।।82।।
sukhaḥdukhe same me sto na hi me staḥ priyā'priye ।
evaṃ dharmaṃ pālayadhvaṃ janāstvabhayadānakam ।।8 3 ।।
tena muktimavāpsyanti bhavanto'bhayavartanāḥ ।
nārāyaṇo hi bhagavāṃstena tuṣyati sarvadā ।।84।।
namo brāhmaṇayajñāya namaḥ prajādhvarāya ca ।
namaḥ sevāpravīṇebhyo janebhyaśca namonamaḥ ।।85 ।।
sukṛtena suhavyena devāstuṣyanti sarvadā ।
namaskāreṇa havyena stotreṇa hṛdayena ca ।।86 ।।
yajñāhutyā susantuṣṭā ādityā varṣayanti hi ।
tataḥ sasyarasānnāni tebhyaḥ prajāpravardhanam ।।87।।
prajāḥ kurvanti yajñāँśca brahma tuṣyati tatra ca ।
brahmatoṣakarā bhaktāstoṣayantyaparānapi ।।88 ।।
tasmād bhaktiṃ prakurvantu sarvaṃ yad brahmadaivatam ।
brahmatṛptau jagatsarvaṃ tṛptameva na saṃśayaḥ ।।89 ।।
yajñe tṛptāḥ sarvadevāḥ syuryasya brahmatarpaṇam ।
tasya prajñānatṛptasya nityatṛptiḥ sukhodayā ।। 2.247.90 ।।

727
dharmādhārā dharmodayā brahmadhyānaparāśca ye ।
bhaktivijñānasampannāḥ paraṃ pāraṃ titīrṣavaḥ ।।9 1 । ।
sarvasthitaṃ parabrahma dṛṣṭvā labdhvā vicārya ca ।
puṇyātpuṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantyakṣaraṃ padam ।।92।।
yatra gatvā na śoko'sti na cyāvo na vyathā mṛtiḥ ।
naitādṛśānāṃ svargārthaṃ yajanaṃ vā yaśo'rthakam ।।93 ।।
satāmācararūpaṃ tad yajanaṃ drohavarjitam ।
brahmatṛptiparaṃ samidoṣadhiphalamūlakaiḥ ।। 94।।
svargārthaṃ puṇyamevā'sti nairguṇyaṃ muktaye bhavet ।
tadahaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā nairguṇyaṃ tvācarāmi vai ।। 949 ।।
anye yajanti yajñeṣu smṛddhyarthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।
tena te devayānena yathā yānti divaṃ punaḥ ।। 96 ।।
āvṛtiṃ te'bhigacchanti nā''vartante tu nirguṇāḥ ।
svayaṃ yūpānupādāya yajante svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।। 97।।
punaḥ svargaṃ punarbhūmirbhramāvarto na līyate ।
tasmād bhavantu vai brahmayajanā nānyayājinaḥ ।। 98 ।।
brahma vai daivataṃ kṛtvā yajñe mokṣaṃ prayāntu ca ।
ātmatīrthe makhaṃ śuklaṃ kurvantu divyabhāvanaiḥ ।। 99 ।।
evaṃ kṛtopadeśaśca śākavikrayako vaṇik ।
sarvasevāparo nityaṃ cābhajat puruṣottamam ।। 2.247.100 ।।
śrīharistvekadā cāyāt krayī bhūtvā tadantikam ।
dehi śākaṃ śāśvataṃ me pāravālikamāha tam ।। 101 ।।
vaṇig budhvā pāravālaṃ śākaṃ dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ।
namaḥ pāravalāyaiva kṛṣṇāya kramiṇe'rthine ।। 101 ।।
pāraṃ yo balayatyeva saṃsārābdheśca te namaḥ ।
ityuktvā daṇḍavaccakre cakriṇe divyadṛṣṭimān ।। 103 ।।
tataścaturbhujo bhūtvā haristaṃ pāṇinā'spṛśat ।
mīnadhvajadhanuḥśūlāsvastikacakracihninā ।। 1 04।।
ninye vimāne saṃsthāpya divyaṃ kṛtvā'kṣaraṃ padam ।
ityevaṃ makhamārgeṇa ye bhajante hariṃ sadā ।। 1 05।।
te prayānti harerdhāma hariṇā saha naiṣṭhikāḥ ।
tasmād bhajantu satataṃ cāntarasthaṃ narāyaṇam ।। 1 06।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopālanandanam ।
kambharābālakaṃ śrīśaṃ prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।। 1 07।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ bhagavantaṃ parātparam ।
ityuktvā lomaśo brāhme muhūrte prayayau saraḥ ।। 1 08।।
rādhike ca tataḥ sarve snānārthaṃ prayayuḥ saraḥ ।
jāgaraṇaṃ prakṛtvaiva pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca naityikīm ।। 1 09।।

maharṣayo yajamānastathā'nye makhino janāḥ ।
somakarmārthamāyātā maṇḍape pañcame dine ।। 2.247.11 0।।
nityaprāptaṃ vidhāyaiva viśeṣaṃ ca samācaran ।
rādhike te pravakṣyāmi sarvapuṇyapradaṃ śubham ।। 111 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caturthe divase somayāgasyaikādaśyāṃ kṛtyaṃ jāgaraṇamudyāpanamupadeśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 247 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 248
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 249 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
pañcame divase rādhe prātaḥ somasya cottaram ।
vidhiṃ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi lomaśo yaṃ cakāra ha ।। 1 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ brāhmakālasyā''raṃbhe tu sarvaṛtvijaḥ ।
prabudhya snātvā somābhiṣavakarmāṇi cārabhan ।। 2 ।।
adhvaryustāni pātrāṇyayojayat tatsthalīṣu vai ।
hotā śastraṃ cānuvākākhyamārabhata vai tataḥ ।। 3 ।।
savanīyahaviṣāṃ nirvāpaṃ cakre ca pañcabhiḥ ।
dhānābhiśca karaṃbhena parivāpena vai tathā ।। 4 ।।
puroḍāśena ca pratiprasthātāmikṣayā tathā ।
dhānā bhraṣṭayavā bodhyāḥ karaṃbho yavasaktavaḥ ।। ।9 ।।
parivāpaśca vai lājāḥ payasyā''mikṣikā matā ।
teṣāṃ ca devatāḥ pañca haritvānindra ādimaḥ ।। 6 ।।
pūṣaṇvānindro dvitīyaḥ sarasvatī tṛtīyakā ।
indrasturyo mitrāvaruṇau pañcamadevatā ।। 7 ।।
tāḥ prapūjya tataścakre dadhigrahapracārakam ।
tadyathodumbarapātre gṛhītvā dadhiṃ hyuttamam ।। 8 ।।
prajāpatidevatāyai juhāvaudumbareṇa vai ।
tato'dābhyagrahaṃ cakre somadevāya tadyathā ।। 9 ।।
dadhnā vā payasā''pūrya pātraṃ tathopanahya ca ।
somalatāvayavānāmaṃśutrayaṃ pragṛhya ca ।। 2.248.10 ।।
grahapātre sthāpayitvā pañcakṛtvo grahaṃ hi tat ।
saptakṛtvo'thavā''dhūya tatpātraṃ sañjuhāva ha ।। 11 ।।
tataścakreṃśugrahaṃ saṃgṛhyaikagrahasomakam ।
kṣiptvā pāṣāṇake siktvā vasatīvarīvāriṇā ।। 1 2।।
abhiṣutya grāvabhiścā'dābhyapātre nidhāya ca ।
juhāva ca prajāpatidevatāyai tataḥ param ।। 1 3।।
gṛhītvaiva ca tatpātraṃ praviśya ca sadastataḥ ।
bhakṣayitvā pātragataṃ somarasaṃ ca vai tataḥ ।। 14।।
pātraṃ khare'sādayaścopāṃśugrahaṃ vyadhāttataḥ ।
tatra krītaṃ tathā vastre sthāpitaṃ copanahya ca ।। 15।।
somaṃ samavamucyaiva gṛhītvā sarvameva ca ।
pravibhajya dvidhā prātassavanārtha viśeṣataḥ ।। 16 ।।
svalpaṃ mādhyandinasavanārthaṃ kṛtvā ca vai tataḥ ।
prātaḥ stavanasomādvai caikagrahārthameva ha ।। 17।।
somaṃ dhṛtvā hotṛcamase nidhāya ca vai tataḥ ।
vasatīvarībhiradbhiḥ siktvā piṣṭvā ca grāvabhiḥ ।। 18 ।।
niṣpīḍya ca rasaṃ labdhvā'ñjalinā'dhvaryureva tam ।
upāṃśupātre trivāraṃ cānāyya ca juhāva ha ।। 1 9।।
ādhārāgraha evā'yaṃ devatāprāṇa eva ca ।
tasyai datvā tataścakurdhārāgrahān dhruvāntakān ।। 2.248.20 ।।
somābhiṣavakaḥ so'yaṃ mahābhiṣavaḥ sammataḥ ।
upaviśyā'dhvaryavaśca hyabhiṣavasthale tataḥ ।। 21 ।।
grāvṇaḥ prācyāmadhvaryuśca pratyaṅamu'kha upāviśat ।
dakṣiṇe pratiprasthātā codaṅamukha upāviśat ।। 22।।
paścime prāṅmukho hotā cottare dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।
unnetā niṣasādāpi śilāyāṃ nyasya somakam ।। 23 ।।
siktvā vasatīvaryadbhiḥ piṣṭvā'bhiṣuṇuyustathā ।
dakṣastenaivameva vāratrayaṃ vidhāya ca ।।24।।
piṣṭān somalatākhaṇḍān nikṣipyā'dhāvanīyake ।
mṛtpātre ca prapīḍyaiva rasaṃ niṣkāsya taṃ rasam ।।25।।
pātrāntare gṛhītvaiva tuṣān pārśve samakṣipan ।
athā'jalomajāṃ nābhiṃ prādeśamātranirmitām ।। 26 ।।
pavitravastrakhaṇḍe tāmālambya droṇapātrake ।
vitatyā'dhārayaँstāṃ codgātāraśca tataḥ param ।।27।।
unnetā''dhavanīyādudacanena ca somakam ।
rasaṃ dhṛtvā''ninayacca hotṛcamase eva tam ।।28।।
yathā pavitravastrāṃśe pated rasastathā'dharet ।
tataḥ sravantyā dhārāyā antaryāmyākhyapātrake ।। 29 ।।
antaryāmagrahaṃ nyasyā'dhvaryurjuhāva śeṣakam ।
saśeṣamevā''grayaṇasthālyāṃ sampātamāpya ca ।। 2.248.30 ।।
saśeṣaṃ ca grahaṃ khare'sādayacca tataḥ param ।
indrākhyadevatāyai taṃ homaṃ dadau guruḥ svayam ।। 31 ।।
athaindravāyavādyāँśca grahān cakrustataḥ param ।
aindravāyavaṃ saṃgṛhītvā dhārātaśca tato guruḥ ।। 32 ।।
pavitradaśayā bahirmṛṣṭvā khare'pyasādayat ।
evaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ ca, śukraṃ ca, manthinaṃ rasam ।। 33 ।।
āgrayaṇaṃ, tathā''gneyam, aindraṃ sauryaṃ samukthyakam ।
dhruvaṃ ceti kramād gṛhye khare'sādayadeva saḥ ।।34।।
dhruvagrahagrahaṇordhva dhārāvirāmamācarat ।
havirdhānamaṇḍapācca pañcartvijo bahiryayuḥ ।।35।।
prāsarpan samanvārabdhā bahiṣpavamānakṛte ।
agre'dhvaryustataḥ kacchaṃ dhṛtvā prastotā'nvasarat ।।36 ।।
kacchaṃ dhṛtvā pratihartā tata udgātā'nvasarat ।
tato brahmā yajamānasataḥ kacchena cā'sarat ।।37।।
cātvāladeśaṃ gatvopaviśya kacchamavā'sṛjan ।
udgātā samprastotā ca pratihartā trayastvime ।।38।।
asruvaँste bahiṣpavamānastotreṇa vai tadā ।
tena sampāvitau cāśvinau grahau makhayogyakau ।।3 9।।
kṛtvā''gnīdhreṇa dhiṣṇyeṣu prajvāliteṣu cāśvinam ।
adhvaryurgrahamāsādya droṇaghaṭāt khare'nyasan ।।2.248.40 ।।
tataḥ kṛtvā savanīyaphalopākaraṇādikam ।
vapāyāgāntakaṃ prātaḥsavanāya tataḥ param ।।41 ।।
adhvaryubrahmayajamānasadasyāḥ sadaḥsthalam ।
praviśya grahacamacādikapātrāṇi vai tathā ।।42।।
dhṛtvā dravyāṇi ca brahmā yajamānastataḥ param ।
taistairmantrairupasthāya sarvapātrāṇi vai tataḥ ।।43 ।।
uttareṇa havirdhānaṃ gatvā ca pūrvayā tathā ।
dvārā sadaḥ praviśyaiva svasvasthāne upāviśan ।।44।।
tataścakruḥ savanīyahaviṣāmanuṣṭhānakam ।
dhārāgrahapracāraṃ ca cakruryathocitaṃ tathā ।।45 ।।
sviṣṭakṛdantakarmā'nuṣṭhāyā'dhvaryuḥ samācarat। ।
aindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇāśvinān hi trigrāhān ।।46 ।।
adhvaryuṇaindravāyave gṛhīte ca tataḥ param ।
pratiprasthātā cādityapātre droṇaghaṭāt khalu ।।47।।
aindravāyavanigrāhyaṃ dhṛtvā sākaṃ juhāva ha ।
paraspararasasekottaramādityapātrake ।।48।।
samānayacca sampātaṃ hotre pātraṃ gururdadau ।
evamuttaragrahayoranuṣṭhānaṃ ca pātanam ।।49 ।।
unnetā ca tataścācchāvākacamasameva ca ।
varjayitvā tatra navacamasānapyapūrayat ।।।2.248.50 । ।
hotuśca brahmaṇaścāpyudrāturyajayitustathā ।
brāhmaṇyācchaṃsino maitrāvaruṇasya tathā ca vai ।।51 ।।
poturneṣṭustathā cāgnīdhrasya te camasā nava ।
pariplavayā kalaśādāsrāvya somakaṃ rasam ।।52 ।।
pūtabhṛtkalaśāt somamādāya camasāँstataḥ ।
prapūrya droṇakalaśānnyasyā'tha camaseṣu ca ।।।813।।
asrāvayat prathamaṃ srāvaṇaṃ copastarātmakam ।
dvitīyaṃ srāvaṇaṃ cābhidhāraṇasthānakaṃ matam ।।24।।
evaṃ sarvonnayanaṃ kartavyaṃ prapūraṇe khalu ।
tato'dhvaryuḥ śukrapātraṃ gṛhītvā somasaṃyutam ।।55।।
manthipātraṃ pratiprasthātā gṛhītvā sasomakam ।
havirdhānamaṇḍapasya pūrvadvāri susanmukhau ।।।56।।
tiṣṭhantau svaṃ gṛhaṃ vā'ratniṃ sandhāya parasparam ।
mantrakṛtvaścāhavanīyasya puro'nugamya ca ।।57।।
paścamukhau grahahomārthaṃ sajjā sambabhūvatuḥ ।
tadā navacamasādhvaryavaḥ sacamasāḥ khalu ।।58।।
āvahanīyadeśaṃ ca gatvā pūrvānanāstadā ।
homārthamudyatāścāsan cakruścāśravaṇaṃ tathā ।।59।।
cakruḥ pratyāśravaṇādi dadau praiṣa tato guruḥ ।
hotrā kṛte vaṣaṭkāre'nuvaṣaṭkārake kṛte ।।।2.248.60 ।।
dvirhutvā camasaścādhvaryuṇā ca preṣitā sadaḥ ।
pratibhakṣārthaṃ camasānāharat hotṛkādayaḥ ।।61 ।।
maitrāvaruṇādyādhvaryavaścamasān prapūrya ca ।
homārthamānayaँścāpyāhavanīyaṃ prati drutam ।।62।।
adhvaryupratiprasthātārau ca homaṃ pracakratuḥ ।
indradevatāyai svāhā'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā ।।63 ।।
pratiprasthātā saṃsrāvahomamaṃgārake'karot ।
rudrāya svāheti tato'dhvaryuścamasamāpya ca ।।64।।
juhāva mitravaruṇābhyāṃ svāheti kramādapi ।
sarve'dhvaryavo juhuvuḥ svaṃ svaṃ camasameva ha ।।65।।
indrāya marute tvaṣṭre cāgnaye svāhā namama ।
tataścamasaprasādaṃ bhakṣayāmāsureva te ।।66 ।।
acchāvāko'pi camasaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa vai tataḥ ।
ṛtugrahapracāraṃ cā'kurutāṃ dvau tataḥ param ।।67।।
adhvaryupratiprasthātārau cakraturhavān śubhān ।
indrāya madhave svāhā maruta mādhavāya ca ।।68 ।।
tvaṣṭre śukrāya ca svāhā'gnaye ca śucaye svāhā ।
indrāya nabhase svāhā mitrāvaruṇanabhasyebhyaḥ svāhā ।।6 9।।
draviṇodase iṣāya svāhā draviṇodase ūrjāya svāhā ।
draviṇodase sahāya svāhā draviṇodase sahasyāya svāhā ।।2.248.7 0 ।।
aśvinābhyāṃ tapase svāhā, gṛhapataye tapasyāya svāhā ।
tataścamasānāṃ vai bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhinā'bhavat ।।7 1 ।।
tataḥ śastraprapaṭhanaṃ pratigarasya pāṭhanam ।
'adhvaryo śoṃsāvo im, śoṃsāmoda iva' ।।72।।
'oṃ mo3thāmoda iva, othāmoda iva' ।
'oṃ othāmoda ivetyādipāṭhaṃ samācaran ।।73।।।
tato nārāśaṃsahomaṃ juhāvā'dhvaryureva ca ।
indrāgnibhyāmidaṃ svāhā pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā namaḥ ।।74।।
nārāśaṃsaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ praugaśastramuktavān ।
viśvedevatābhyaśca svāheti havanaṃ dadau ।।75।।
camasāँśca tato'bhakṣayan vai niravaśeṣataḥ ।
ukthyagrahapracāraṃ ca homaṃ ca sarvabhakṣaṇam ।।76।।
prakṣālanaṃ khare sādanaṃ ceti sarvamācarat ।
mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ ca svāhendrāgnibhyāṃ tathā svāhā ।।77।।
ṛtvijaśca vidhāyaivaṃ sādanāntaṃ vidhiṃ tataḥ ।
prātaḥ savanaṃ nirvartya bahiryayuśca maṇḍapāt ।।78 ।।
madhyāhne ca pracakruśca mādhyandinaṃ savaṃ ca te ।
prātarvat sarvamākṛtvo dhārāsrāvaṃ vyadhuśca te ।।79।।
śukrāya manthine cāgrayaṇāya svāhā namama ।
pavamānaṃ jaguścāpi dadhiyāgaṃ vyadhustataḥ ।।2.248.80 ।।
bhakṣaṇaṃ sādane cakruruccāvacaṃ ca karma ca ।
dakṣiṇādānamevāpi yajamānaścakāra ha ।।8 1 ।।
gāvo'śvāścāśvatarāśca gardabhā'jā'vayastathā ।
tilamāṣavrīhiyavā gajavāsohiraṇyakam ।।8 2 ।।
sarvasvameva rājyādi kanyāgṛhāṇi vāṭikāḥ ।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ pradattāni rājñā tadā makhotsave ।।83 ।।
marutvatīyagrahapracārastato'bhavat khalu ।
vaiśvadevapañcahomānadhvaryuḥ pracakāra ha ।।84'।।
adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā hutvā cakraturbhakṣaṇam ।
homaṃ kampaṃ pracakruśca indrāya marutvate svāhā ।।85।।
ūrvobhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā māhendrāya namaḥ svāhā ।
agnaye cendrāya svāhā raktāya ca svāhā namama ।।86।।
ukthyavigrahānuṣṭhānaṃ pañcastotraprapāṭhanam ।
savasamāptihomaṃ ca kṛtvā bahiryayustataḥ ।।87।।
tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ cāpi cakrurhomaṃ ca bhakṣaṇam ।
ādityebhyaḥ svāhā namaḥ payo dadhīdaṃ somakam ।।88।।
tataścārbhavapavamānāya prasarpaṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
dhiṣṇyān prajvālayāmāsuḥ kṛtveḍābhakṣaṇāntakam ।।89।।
savanīyahavīṃṣi sampracaryādhvaryureva tu ।
sakṛddhomaṃ pracakāra homaṃ cakre taduttaram ।।2.248.90।।
camasinaḥ svasvapitṝnuddiśya tānatiṣṭhipan ।
tato homaṃ savitre ca viśvadevebhya ādadau ।। 91 ।।
makṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ saumyacaruyāgo hyavartata ।
anavasrāvitastaṇḍulapakvaudanakaṃ carum ।। 9 2।।
juhāva cāgnaye patnīvate svāheti vai guruḥ ।
ekaviṃśatikastomaṃ stotraṃ cāgāyata prakham । । 93 ।।
camasān juhuvuścāpi vaiśvānarāgnaye svāhā ।
marudbhyaḥ svāheti namama bhakṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ param ।। 94।।
tato hāriyojanātmagrahapracārakaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
unnetā ca somarasaṃ yavadhānādimiśritam ।। 95 ।।
juhāvā'nye'pajighraँśca patnīsaṃjāyasaṃ tathā ।
yajuhomādikaṃ prāyaścittahomān cakāra ha ।। 96।।
yajamānasya ca tato viṣṇukramaṇakādikam ।
evaṃ samāpya tṛtīyasavane bhojanāni ca । । 97।।
vyadhuḥ sarve mahīmānā janāśca tīrthavāsinaḥ ।
sthāyinaśca tataścāvabhṛtheṣṭiḥ samajāyata ।।98।।
sapatnīko yajamānaḥ ṛtvijaścāpare janāḥ ।
rājāsandyāṃ somapātrāṇyādāyā''gṛhya jīṣakam । । 99।।
yayurjalasamīpaṃ ca gāyantaḥ sāmagītikāḥ ।
jale'gnīvaruṇābhyāṃ ca ājyabhāgau dadustadā ।। 2.248.100 ।।
catuḥprayājāँścakruśca dvāvanūyājakau tathā ।
varuṇāya puroḍāśaṃ dadāmi vai jale namaḥ ।। 101 ।।
ṛjīṣādīni ca jale kṣiptvā patnīnṛpastathā ।
sasnatuścāpare cāpi nemuścādityamityapi ।। 10 2।।
śālāmukhe samāgatyodayanīyeṣṭimācaran ।
tata ānubandhyaphalayāgaścāmikṣikāyajiḥ ।। 103 ।।
mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ svāhā datvā baliṃ tathocitam ।
yajamānaḥ keśaśmaśrunakhalomāni vai tataḥ ।। 1 04। ।
vāpayitvā ca snātvā ceṣṭikalpena ca pañca ca ।
dhātā'numatirākāsinīvālīkuhūrityapi ।। 105 । ।
vyājyeneṣṭvā devatāstā udavasānīyeṣṭikām ।
aṣṭākapālapuroḍāśadravyāṃ tathā'karot ।। 106 । ।
viṣṇave svāheti datvā'gnihotraṃ niśi cācarat ।
tataścakruḥ parihāraṃ somayāgasya carṣayaḥ ।। 1 07।।
somapānaṃ pracakāra rājā patnīyutastadā ।
bhojanāni pracakruśca sarve vai makhino'dhvare ।। 10 8। ।
evaṃ vai rādhike somayāgo dvādaśikādine ।
sampūrṇaścā'bhavad rātrau yajñanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 109 ।।
darśanaṃ pradadau rājñe varadānaṃ dadau tathā ।
svasti te'stu sadā rājan cānte mokṣapadaṃ vraja ।। 2.248.110 ।।
sthāpayā'tra ca māṃ saudhe mūrtirūpaṃ narāyaṇam ।
sa rājā rādhike tūrṇa mandiraṃ samakārayat ।। 111 ।।
yajñanārāyaṇastatra yājñīpatnīsamanvitaḥ ।
sthāpitastena vidhinā tīrthaṃ yajñākhyameva tat ।। 112 ।।
somatīrthaṃ tathā cā'bhūt snānād yajñaphalapradam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeveśānakoṇe hi pāvanam ।। 113 ।।
nṛpo'śvapāṭalaḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya hastataḥ ।
kaṇṭhīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ prāpa mantraṃ jagrāha lomaśāt ।। 1 14।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
tataḥ prapūjya deveśaṃ datvā dānāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 15।।
yayau naijaṃ prarāṣṭraṃ ca rādhike sukhato nṛpaḥ ।
ṛṣayo'nye devatādyā yayurnaijān pradeśakān । । ( 11 6 ।।
tatra dānājjalapānādavagāhācca bhojanāt ।
pūjanādapi svargaṃ syādante'kṣarapadaṃ vrajet ।। 117 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne somayāge pañcamadine mārgakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ prātaḥsavane mādhyandinasavane taduttarasavanaṃ pūrṇāhutiravabhṛtheṣṭiḥ
parihāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭācatvāriṃśada-dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 248 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha tataḥ sarve nidrāṃ jagṛhureva ha ।
trayodaśyāṃ kṛtasnānārhaṇā vidāyamāpnuvan ।। 1 ।।
lomaśarṣiḥ sabhāyāṃ vai hyupādideśa dehinaḥ ।
śraddhāyajñāḥ phalavantaścā'śraddhāḥ phalavarjitāḥ ।। 2 ।।
ājyena payasā dadhnā somena ca phalena ca ।
pūrṇāhutyā śraddhayā ca phalavanti kratavastviha ।। 3 ।।
aśaktāśca makhe te tu pucchābhiṣecanena vai ।
abhiṣekeṇa vā pādarajasā santarantyapi ।। 4 ।।
śraddhāṃ patnīṃ vidhāyaiva susatyena vratena tu ।
yajamāno yajeteśaṃ taratyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
iṣṭaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yajeta śraddhayā muhuḥ ।
bhāvenā'rpaṇavidhinā taratyeva sa yāgakṛt ।। 6 ।।
puroḍāśaḥ sadā medhyo devānāṃ tṛptikārakaḥ ।
sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ ।। 7 ।।
sarvā pṛthvī harerdhāma brahmaniṣṭhasya dehinaḥ ।
śraddhā tu poṣitā yena sā tu puṣṇāti taṃ janam ।। 8 ।।
śraddhāṃ nihanti yo dharme sā hatā hanti taṃ janam ।
sādhūnāṃ śraddhadhānānāṃ kurvatāṃ yajñavistaram ।। 9 ।।
phalaṃ sampadyate sarvaṃ prasavitrī hi sā yataḥ ।
jñānavṛddhaṃ manovṛddhaṃ śraddhā deve hi rakṣati ।। 2.249.10 ।।
śraddhāvṛddhaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ kvāpi na muñcati ।

ahavirannadātuśca bhoktavyaṃ naiva sarvathā ।

śraddhā brahmapradā tadvadahiṃsā vrahmadāyinī ।
ahiṃsā sarvadharmebhyo bhūtānāṃ jyāyasī matā ।। 14।।
sarvayajñeṣu vai viṣṇurbhuṃkte havyaṃ hi pāyasam ।
pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca phalairgundrai rasairhavaḥ ।। 15 ।।
pāvanastṛptido vipṇorjāyate śuddhabhāvanaḥ ।
auṣadhyādi pavitraṃ vai sarvaṃ devārhameva tat ।। 1 6।।
yathā śarīraṃ na gleyāttathauṣadhaiḥ prajīvayet ।
kandamūlaphalādyaiśca yajñaṃ santoṣayet sadā ।। 1 7।।
śraddhā vai jananī sarvaphalāvāptiprakāriṇī ।
ahiṃsā bhaginī tasyāste hyubhe devadarśike ।। 18 ।।
jananī naiva hantavyā sadā bālopakāriṇī ।
ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ svadharmo mātṝakṣaṇam ।। 1 9।।
śraddhāṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet ।
mātā śarīrahetuḥ sā mātrā sanāthatā sadā ।। 2.249.2 0 ।।
śriyā hrīno'pi sujanaścāmveti gehamṛcchati ।
putrapautrayutaścāpi jananīṃ prati bālakaḥ ।। 21 ।।
asamaya vicittaṃ vā sutaṃ mātā prarakṣati ।
tadā vārdhakyamāyāti duḥkhadoṣasamanvitam ।। 2 2।।
tadā śūnyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate ।
nāsti mātṛsamaḥ kaścidādhāro bhūtale'pi ca ।। 23 ।।
nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇe priyaṃ prāṇasya bhājanam ।
kukṣisaṃdhāraṇād dhātrī jananājjananī hi sā ।। 24।।
aṃgānāṃ vardhanādambā mātā mānakarī śiśoḥ । (ambā)
śraddhā dhātrī svargakukṣau jananī devayoniṣu ।।।5।।
ambā'kṣarapradatvāśca mātā muktipradā yataḥ ।
svargakāmo yajeteti śraddhayā yajanaṃ matam ।।26 ।।
oṣadhyaḥ samidho vṛkṣā vīrudājyaṃ. payo dadhi ।
havirbhūmirdiśaḥ śraddhā kālaḥ ṛco yajūṃṣi ca ।। 27। ।
sāmāni yajamānāgniḥ saptadaśāṃgakaḥ kratuḥ ।
ājyena payasā dadhnā śakṛtā''mikṣayā phalaiḥ ।।।28।।
rasaiśca śraddhayā viṣṇuḥ prasīdatyeva cādhvare ।
brāhmaṇaprabhavo yajño brahmārpaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 29 ।।
anuyajñaṃ jagat sarve yajñaścānu jagat saṭā ।
omiti brahmaṇo nāma namaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ ।। 2.249.3 0 ।।
yasyaitāni prayujyante tasya bhayaṃ na vidyate ।
tasyā'bhayapradaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ 31 । ।
kāṃbhareyo hariḥ sākṣādakṣarātparataḥ paraḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bhavadbhirīkṣito makhe ।। 32 । ।
sa eva sarvayajñānāṃ phalaṃ jānāti vai prabhuḥ ।
dadātyeva phalaṃ samyag jananyā cānumoditaḥ ।। 33 ।।
tasmād yajed yājayecca yaśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।
vidhinā yajataḥ svarge śāśvataṃ cākṣarātparam ।। 34।।
nā'yaṃ loko'styayajñānāṃ nāpi paraśca niścitaḥ ।
nāpi dharmo'sti gatidaścā'yajñānāmiha kṣitau ।। 35।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ loko'yamutkṛṣṭaḥ paralokastathā''pyate ।
kathaṃ dharmaśca gatidaḥ kṣitau syāttadvadā'tra me ।। 36 । ।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
sādhvācārasya ca jitātmanaḥ samasya dehiṣu ।
sarvasatkārakāryasyotkṛṣṭo'yaṃ loka iṣyate ।। 37।।
sarvatra brahmadṛṣṭeśca brahmapūjāratasya ca ।
brahmaniṣṭhasya bhaktasya paralokaḥ prakāśate ।। 38 । ।
sarvaprasannatārhasya sarvopakāraśālinaḥ ।
ahiṃsāsatyadharmasya dharmo vai gatido bhavet ।। 3 9।।
māyābhāvavihīnasyā'kṣarabhāvagatasya ca ।
parabrahmāśritasyaiva trayaṃ karagataṃ hi tat ।।2.249.40।।
saiṣopaniṣadvidyā vai sannidhiyojikā hareḥ ।
yayā''pyate parabrahma dhāmā'kṣaraṃ ca śāśvatam ।। 41 ।।
jñānena cāpyate brahma jñānaṃ copaniṣanmatā ।
bhaktyā saṃprāpyate brahmā bhaktiścopaniṣanmatā ।।42। ।
bhāgavatena dharmeṇā''pyate kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva sā ।
vairāgyeṇa ca duḥkhena yadi gatvā hariṃ prati ।। 43 ।।
vāsaḥ sañjāyate yena tattadupaniṣanmatā ।
devasya mandire vāso jāyate yena hetunā ।। 44।।
śubhāśayaḥ sa vai heturbrahmāptyupaniṣanmatā ।

harervai sannidhau tasyopaniṣat sa prasādakaḥ ।
karmaṇā śatruṇā vāpi vāñcchayā cehayā'pi vā ।।।46।।
hare sānnidhyamāpyeta yena sopaniṣanmatā ।
yajñena sevayā cāpi sārthena svārthakena vā ।।47।।
dānena tṛṣṇayā vāpi devasannidhirāpyate ।
yena kenāpi vai sātropaniṣat sammatā bhuvi ।। 48।।
sādhusaṃgo'tivelaṃ yo brahmaprāptikaro'sti vai ।
sa copaniṣat saṃproktā satsaṃginā haripradā ।। 49।।
kathāśravaṇamevā'tra nārīṇāṃ brahmayogadam ।
sā copaniṣad bodhyaiva yena nārāyaṇo milet ।।2.249.50।।
snehastānaṃ bhāvanā ca vṛttiḥ rāgo'pi ced yadi ।
brahmaprāptikaraste vai sarve copaniṣanmatā ।।5 1 ।।
gopīnāṃ kāmataḥ prāptirviprāṇāṃ yajñatastathā ।
