sudāmno lobhataḥ prāptijīvanārthaॆ tu hastinaḥ ।
tapasā ca dhruvasyā'pi prahlādasya tu niścayāt ।।53।।
pūtanāyā vairabhāvānnāradasya tu kīrtanāt ।
evaṃ yenaiva kenaiva hetunā cāpyate hariḥ ।।54।।
hetuḥ sa copaniṣat sā brahmaprāptikarī matā ।
jñānaṃ bhaktiśca vā karma bhāvanā vā samarpaṇam ।।।55।।।
sarvaṃ copaniṣat proktā yayā brahma hyavāpyate ।
aśvapaṭṭala! yajñenā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।।56।।
prāptastvayā'tra vai divyamūrtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
somayajñastavā'traivopaniṣatsaṃmatā dhruvā ।।57।।
anugraheṇa jīvānāṃ kvacid yogaḥ prabhormataḥ ।
kvacid yatnena vā kvacijjātyā yogo bhavedapi ।।58।।
sā teṣāṃ yogināṃ hetuḥ śubhropaniṣat saṃmatā ।
yathā karmāṇi sarvāṇi phale parisamāpyate ।।59।।
phalaṃ śāntau sā ca bhoge brahmaṇyeva samāpyate ।
brahmabhāvaḥ pare deve parameśe samāpyate ।।2.249.6 0 ।।
yatayastaṃ vijānanti paśyanti yānti taṃ prati ।
nirdvandvā nirbandhanāśca vimuktāḥ śucayo'malāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
apavarge kṛtaniṣṭhā brahmiṣṭhā brahmavāsinaḥ ।
vimāyā brahmabhūtāśca gatisteṣāṃ sanātanī ।।6 2।।

anāraṃbhāḥ sudhṛtayaḥ śucayo brahmasaṃjñitāḥ ।
devaṃ pareśvaraṃ yajñaistarpayantyanṛtaiṣiṇaḥ ।।63।।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya paśyataḥ svetarāṇi ca ।
mārgaṃ yānti tatpradattanetravān tasya bhaktimān ।।64।।
navadvārapraguptiṃ ca kṛtvā hṛdayodghāṭanam ।
brahmamārgeṇa yātasya parabrahmagṛhe sthitiḥ ।। 65।।
agnihotraṃ pūrṇamāso darśaḥ prayājakāstathā ।
sviṣṭakṛccānuyājāśca pitṛyajño'ṅgayāgakaḥ ।। 66।।।
cāturmāsyaṃ vaiśvadevaḥ sākamedhaśca vāruṇaḥ ।
somayāgaśca savanaṃ cāgrayaṇeṣṭirityapi ।।67।।
avabhṛtheṣṭiścokthaṃ ca ṣoḍaśī cātirātrakam ।
atyagniṣṭoma evāpi vājapeyaśca viṣṭutiḥ ।।68।।
vāyavyaḥ śatarudrīyo vāsavo rājasūyakaḥ ।
sautrāmaṇiścāśvamedhaḥ puṃmedhaḥ sarvamedhakaḥ ।। 69।।
gomedho brahmamedhaśca yajñā ye'nye kriyāparāḥ ।
jñānaparāstapaḥparā dravyaparāśca ye makhāḥ ।।2.249.70 ।।
svāgatārthāścopakārāstathā ye dānadakṣiṇāḥ ।
sarve te kalpitā kṛṣṇe mokṣadā brahmamārgiṇaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
kṛtā vā na kṛtā vāpi nāsya kiñcit praśiṣyate ।
hariḥ santoṣitaḥ prāptastenā''ptaṃ sarvameva ha ।।72।।
kṛteṣvapi ca yajñeṣu toyiteṣu sureṣu ca ।
kṛṣṇabhānavihīnena kṛtaṃ cenmokṣadaṃ na tat ।।73।।
tasmāt teṣu cādhvareṣu kṛṣṇo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
sādhavo brahmayatayo bāhyadvāranirodhinaḥ ।।74।।
sarvayajñeṣu taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tarpayantyamṛtaiṣiṇaḥ ।
anyadvāraṃ pidhāyaiva brahmadvāraṃ prasārayet ।।75 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ lomaśa dvārāṇi pidhātavyāni tadvada ।
pidhānottaramevāpi kṛtyaṃ syād vā phalaṃ vada ।।76 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
amṛtaṃ brahmakośe'sti cātmanā rakṣitaṃ param ।
apihitena dvāreṇa prayātyanyatra durlabham ।।77।।
devanaṃ yatkarābhyāṃ vai padbhyāmanyatra dhāvanam ।
kāmanā yā ca nikṛṣṭā cāsanaṃ tvanyacatvare ।।78।।
varṇanaṃ cānyaviṣayaṃ rūpaṇaṃ lokamiśritam ।
āsvādanaṃ prasādānye ghrāṇanaṃ klinnavarṣmaṇaḥ ।।79।।
sparśanaṃ mṛdumāyāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ calanāphalam ।
mananaṃ mamakārasya bodhanaṃ bahu me bhavet। ।।2.249.80।।
cintanaṃ cāmarau me sto'haṃpadaṃ nāsti mādṛśaḥ ।
ityevaṃ cāmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jāgrati svapnake'pi ca ।।81 ।।
sarvaṃ sravatyajasraṃ vai pātraṃ riktaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tasmāt pidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ vivekena vijānatā ।।82।।
nā'kṣatulyaivaiṃ dīvyecca na dhāvet kardamasthalīm ।
na kāmayennikṛṣṭāṃ kṣmāṃ nāsīta mohacatvare ।।83।।
na varṇayeduśatyā'nyad rūpayennahi rūpakam ।
nā''svādayeccārpaṇā'nyat jighrennaiva hi daihikam ।।84।।
na spṛśenmārdavīṃ śayyāṃ śṛṇuyānna kathetarat ।
mananaṃ māpateḥ kuryād bodhanaṃ brahma me bhavet ।।85।।
cintanaṃ cāmṛtaṃ me'stu cāhaṃ tasmin vasāmi ca ।
ityevaṃ dvāraguptiṃ vai kuryācchrīharirūpiṇīm ।।86 ।।
vṛṣṭerjalād yathā bhaumaṃ jalaṃ vṛddhiṃ sameti vai ।
tathā guptyā'mṛtaṃ naijaṃ brahmaguptyā vivardhate ।।87।।
grīṣmatāpād yathā bhaumaṃ jalaṃ śuṣkaṃ vilīyate ।
tathā dvārā'pidhāne tu svāmṛtaṃ layamīyate ।।88।।
vṛthā gacchenna vai loke vṛthā''dadīta naiva ha ।
vṛthā kāmaṃ na bhuñjīta vṛthā nopāviśet kvacit ।।89।।
vṛthā bhāṣāṃ satyahīnāṃ kṛṣṇahīnāṃ na vai vadet ।
vṛthā rūpaṃ kṛṣṇahīnaṃ na vai paśyennirarthakam ।। 2.249.90।।
vṛthā svādṃ na gṛhṇīyād dehayātrātirekiṇam ।
vṛthā gandhaṃ nā''dadīta śvāsapūrtaṃ samācaret ।। 11 ।।
vṛthā sparśaṃ na kurvīta hareḥ sparśaṃ vinā sadā ।
vṛthā dadīta karṇau na parameśaśravaṃ vinā ।। 12।।
manane śrīhareḥ kuryācchrīpateḥ kamalāpateḥ ।
bodhanaṃ śrīpateḥ kuryāccintanaṃ śrīhareḥ sadā ।। 92।।
ahantā tasya caivā'smi nā'nyasyā'haṃ kadācana ।
evaṃ lakṣmīpaterarthaṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ tadātmakaḥ ।। 94।।
sarvendriyanivāso me parameśe narāyaṇe ।
bhavatveveti vai dvāraguptirbodhyā'mṛtārthinī ।। 95।।
yasya dvārāṇi sarvāṇi vihāravarjitāni vā ।
hareḥ prāptirbhavettasyā'mṛtavārdhi pibatyayam ।। 96।।
guptadvārasya bhaktasyā'mṛtaṃ śāśvatato bhajet ।
sarve yajñāḥ samāpyante'mṛtaśāśvatatārthinaḥ ।। 97।।
kiṃ tasya tapasā kṛcchrairyajñaiḥ kleśaistathetaraiḥ ।
arjanīyaṃ cārjitaṃ vai hṛdi nārāyaṇāmṛtam ।। 98।।
aśvapāṭala! saṃjñātvā kośasthaṃ tvamṛtaṃ nijam ।
na srāvayedamārgeṇa moghatāṃ na nayettathā ।। 99।।
yathāpekṣaṃ tvambaraṃ ca yathāpekṣaṃ tṛṇāsanam ।
yathāpekṣopadhānaṃ ca yātrāmātrādanaṃ tathā ।। 2.249.1 00।।
dvandvārāmān vihāyaivā''ntarārāmaṃ bhajet sadā ।
anyasārthaṃ vihāyaivāntarasārtha samāśrayet ।। 101 ।।
tena dīrghasya mārgasya pāraṃ yāyāt sugatvaraḥ ।
ityeva rādhike rājñe lomaśaḥ prāha cāmṛtam ।। 10 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalanṛpataye śraddhopaniṣadamṛtaguptyādirūpaṃ lomaśadattajñānamitinirūpaṇanāmā navacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 249 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 249 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 250
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 251 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'śvapāṭalastu śrutvā śrīlomaśaṃ punaḥ ।
papraccha tyāgamārgaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ phaladaṃ tathā ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
tyāgamārgeṇa pratyakṣaṃ yatphalaṃ samajāyate ।
tadvadā'tra maharṣe me kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ ca kiṃ phalam ।। 2 ।।
kimatra pratyakṣatamaṃ yadupāste bhavāniha ।
pratyakṣe khalu sarveṣāṃ samānatā'valokyate ।। 3 ।।
bhavānapīha śokaṃ ca yathā harṣaṃ ca vindati ।
indriyārthāśca bhavataḥ samānāḥ sarvadehinām ।। 4 ।।
samānānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ nirāmayam ।
bhavato hi kimādhikyaṃ gṛhamedhita eva yat ।। 5 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
harau tyāgastyāgamārgaḥ kimanyat tyajanena vai ।
sarvasvārpaṇarūpo'yaṃ tyāgaḥ sarvottamo harau ।। 6 ।
tenā''tmano hi sākṣāttvaṃ tatpradattadṛśā khalu ।
phalaṃ cātmasukhaṃ cāpi parameśaprasādataḥ ।। 7 ।।
ahamupāsse pratyakṣaṃ bālakṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkaṃbharāsutam ।। 8 ।।
cakṣuṣormanasaścāpi yaḥ pratyakṣatamo'tra vai ।
ātmanyeva parabrahma sa evā''ste śriyāḥ patiḥ ।। 9 ।।
lakṣmīpatiḥ satāṃ svāmīmuktapatiḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetralālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 2.250.10 ।।
brahmapriyāpatiścātmapatirvidyāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
muktipatiścā'kṣareśo dhāmeśādhipatirhariḥ ।। 11 ।।
sa pratyakṣatamo me'tra rājaँstaṃ tvaṃ vilokaya ।
harṣaṃ śokaṃ pravindāmi rājan nāṭyasya veṣavat ।। 1 2।।
samānānīndriyāṇyeva dehe samānatā'pi ca ।
grahaṇādivyavahāraḥ samāno'pi tathāpi tu ।। 1 3।।
bhūtāveśitavannityaṃ carāmi paramātmanā ।
sa bhoktā sa niyantā ca sa evā''locanādimān ।। 14।।
sarvabhūtādhibhūtenā''veśito'haṃ carāmi yat ।
harṣaṃ śokaṃ sa evā'tra dehe vetti na dehyayam ।। 15।।
tathāpi nāṭyavatsarvaṃ darśayāmi yathā mayi ।
ahaṃ vedmi tathā vetti mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ।। 16।।
vetti sanatkumāraśca nārado vā narāyaṇaḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśaḥ śaṃbhurvā vetti nānyo bhuvaṃgataḥ ।। 17।।
kapilādyāśca vartante jale kamalavaddhi te ।
nirlepāste vayaṃ kṛṣṇaliptā api vilepinaḥ ।। 18।।
rājādyāḥ svārthaliptāśca pratyakṣaṃ sukhiduḥkhinaḥ ।
vayaṃ santaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'jasraparāyaṇāḥ ।। 1 9।।
tadarthakṛtasarvasvāstanmayāstadviśeṣitāḥ ।
cintārogo na cāsmākaṃ sādhūnāṃ vidyate yataḥ ।। 2.250.20 ।।
yo rogo jīvatāṃ dehendriyātmavādināṃ tviha ।
sa rogo vigato naśca tasmānnirāmayā vayam ।।2 1 ।।
vāsanā rogamūlaṃ ca sā ca nārāyaṇe'rpitā ।
dhanvantarimahāvaidye nāḍikā sarvato'rpitā ।। 22।।
tasyānnirāmayāḥ smo'tra rājaँstvaṃ tādṛśo bhava ।
haripradattajñānena viharāmo'tra varṣmasu ।।23।।
tatpreritaṃ prakurmaśca sarvamarthyaṃ nirāmayam ।
tatkṛtaṃ samanuṣṭhānaṃ sarvaṃ cāste nirāmayam ।।24।।
tatpradattaṃ ca vijñānaṃ śokaṃ jahāti mūlataḥ ।
taṃ vinā svārthavṛttyutthaṃ jñānaṃ nāśayati prajāḥ ।। 25।
ato vayaṃ jñānavanto nirāmayā hi bhūpate ।
aikātmyaṃ brahmaṇā nārāyaṇenāptaṃ nirāmayam ।। 26।।
tattvamabuddhvā bahavaścāhaṃkāravaśaṃgatāḥ ।
vādabalā na jānanti nirāmayatvamīdṛśam ।।।27।।
tato bhavanti te brahmastenā mohavaśaṃgatāḥ ।
tamobhāvanimagnānāmeṣāṃ tamaḥ parāyaṇam ।। 28।।।
prakṛtiṃ svāṃ doṣarūpāṃ daṃbhā'nṛtamadātmikām ।
prākṛtāḥ samprayāntyeva brāhmāstadūrdhvavartanāḥ ।। 29।।
evamāntarabodhāste santyajanti śubhāśubham ।
parāṃ gatiṃ prapaśyantaḥ santo nārāyaṇe ratāḥ ।। 2.250.3 0।।
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajñaḥ prajā santānamārjavam ।
hariṃ vinā sā''mayaṃ tanmokṣaḥ kṛtvā'pi nāsti cet ।।3 1 ।।
dhikkārapadametad vai śramaḥ sarvo nirarthakaḥ ।
rājyeṣu strīṣu lokeṣu dehendriyā'rthabhuktiṣu ।। 32।।
vartamāno'pi cet kṛṣṇārpaṇaḥ so'yaṃ nirāmayaḥ ।
nirvastro nirjanaścāpi niṣpātro niṣparigrahaḥ ।। 33।।
sarvasaho'pi vai kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vinā kṣayā''mayaḥ ।
tasmād rājan bhava kāṇḍaistrībhiścāpi nirāmayaḥ ।।34।।
śuṣkajñaptyā karmaṇā vā kā nirāmayatā bhavet? ।
kṛṣṇabhaktyā'rpaṇabhaktyā dhruvaṃ nirāmayo bhavet। ।। 35 ।।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ śabdabrahma bodhyaṃ nirāmayam ।
tatra niṣṇātatāṃ prāpya parabrahmā''gamaṃ vrajet। ।। 36 ।।
evaṃ śuddhasamācāraścātmā bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ ।
kṛṣṇe tyāgakriyāvāṃśca parigrahavivarjitaḥ ।। 37।।
manaḥsaṃkalpasaṃsiddho viśuddhabodhaniścayaḥ ।
janma karma ca vidyā ca śuklā yasya harau matāḥ ।। 38।।
pratyakṣabrahmaparamaḥ śraddadhānaḥ parāvare ।
satsaṃgato bhāvitātmā śīlasantoṣasadvrataḥ ।।39।।
dharma bhāgavataṃ kṛcchre satyapyācaratīha yaḥ ।
tasya brahmasutasyaiva brahmāṃkaśayanasya vai ।।2.250.40।।
nirāmayatvaṃ cāstyeva śāśvataṃ nirupadravam ।
nāsya vai vartate kiṃcid vidhātavyaṃ divaṃ prati ।।41 ।।
prāyaścittaṃ na caivāsya karmaṇāṃ cārpaṇāddharau ।
evaṃ bahuvidhā viprā yajñakarmaparāyaṇāḥ ।।42।।
śucayo vratavantaśca tryavadānā haristhitāḥ ।
yajanto'haraharyajñairāśābandhanavarjitāḥ ।।43।।
ṛjavaḥ śamajityāśca brahmakarmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
brahma yeṣāṃ paro dharmaḥ parārtho brahma nityadā ।।44।।
kāmo'pi brahma caiteṣāṃ mokṣo brahma sanātanam ।
nyūnaṃ vā''dhikyamevāpi vartanaṃ brahma śāśvatam ।।45।।
vyutkramaśca kramaścāpi yeṣāṃ brahma parātparam ।
teṣāṃ kṛṣṇātmanāṃ brahmasattamānāṃ tu śāśvatam ।।46 ।।
svargaṃ svargottamaṃ nityaṃ nirāmayaṃ mahāsukham ।
śāśvatānandapūrṇaṃ te yanti tatparamaṃ padam ।।47।।
gṛhe yadvā vane yadvā nyāse vā brahmaṇi sthitāḥ ।
yanti te sātvatā rājan parabrahma pareśvaram ।।48।।
sakāmāste tu dṛśyante divi jyotirmayāḥ surāḥ ।
dhiṣṇyeṣu bahubhogāśca nakṣatratārakāgaṇāḥ ।।49।।
akāmā naiva dṛśyante dūraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ।
sakāmāśca punaḥ santo bhūtvā yāsyanti tatpadam ।।2.250.50 ।।
brahmātmanāmatṛṣṇānāṃ teṣāmanāmayaṃ dhruvam ।
dhāmā'kṣaraṃ parabrahmasthānaṃ paraṃ nirāmayam ।।51 ।।
sāmayasya kṛte dharmaḥ paropakārasaṃjñakaḥ ।
puṇyadaḥ puṇyaśīlasya gṛhe janmapradastathā ।।52।।
puṇyajanmatayā cārthaḥ puṇyalābho'sya jāyate ।
kāmanā rāgahīnā ca kṛtātmanaḥ prajāyate ।।53 ।।
tyāgasantoṣasiddhiśca prajñā viśāradī bhavet ।
apavargamatiścāpi brahmadharmaparo bhavet ।।54।।
brahmaṇaḥ padamanvicchan brahmalokaṃ prayāti ca ।
gacchan kṣemaṃ samanvicchan durbalo'trā'vasīdati ।।55।।
bhuṃkte datte ca yajate prāptābhirvastubhiryadi ।
parigrahaḥ śubho'pyasya na tyāgasukhasadṛśaḥ ।।56।।
karmapākaḥ śarīraṃ vai jñānapāko nirīhatā ।
bhaktipāko brahmatā ca brahmapākaḥ paraṃ padam ।।57।।
dayā kṣamā ca santoṣaḥ satyaṃ śāntirahiṃsanam ।
ārjavaṃ hrīstitikṣā ca mānagarvavivarjanam ।।58।।
satsaṃgo bhaktibhāvaśca sevā satāṃ surārcanam ।
panthāno brahmaṇastvete prāpnotyetaiḥ paraṃ padam ।।59।।
gatiṃ gacchanti santo yāṃ tāmāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
saṃsāro vāsanāvargaḥ santoṣastvapavargakaḥ ।।2.250.6 0 ।।
sāmye'pīndriyavarge'pi sāmayā'mayate nṛpa ।
ete nideśite te'tra nirāmayatvamāvaha ।।6 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
dharmārthakāmān satataṃ cāmanantīha dehinaḥ ।
mokṣaṃ kecit samicchanti tasmādvai balinastrayaḥ ।।62।।
tatra lābho viśiṣṭo vai kasyāśrayeṇa dehinaḥ ।
kiṃ phalaṃ kīdṛśaṃ ceti tanme lomaśa darśaya ।।63 ।।
lomaśa uvāca-
rājanpurā hyahaṃ kalpe gato'bhavaṃ vanāntare ।
puṣkarāraṇyasaṃjñe ca tatra vipro viśālikaḥ ।।64।।
āsīttena kṛtā me ca pūjā phalajalādibhiḥ ।
tapasvinā durbalena nirdhanena ca rāgiṇā ।।65।।
tato'haṃ pṛṣṭavāँstasya kuśalaṃ sa jagāda mām ।
dāridryaṃ duḥkhadaṃ loke tannirākuru lomaśa ।।66।।
tatastaṃ ca samādāya gato'haṃ cottarāṃ diśam ।
kuberanagaraṃ divyaṃ vyomnā dravyapralipsayā ।।67।।
kuberaḥ svāgataṃ cakre dadau dhanaṃ yatheṣṭakam ।
viśālikaḥ prasanno'bhūd dravyaṃ jagrāha śevadhim ।।68।।
athāpi dhanarājena niśi nijapure śubhe ।
rakṣitau mandire ramye tvāvāmāsva ca nidritau ।।69।।
ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nidrāyāṃ brāhmaṇena yat ।
vilokitaṃ mahāścaryaṃ kalmaṣāḍhyaṃ hi tacchṛṇu ।।2.250.70 ।।
apaśyata janān kāँściddharmāḍhyān śuddhamānasān ।
kāँścitkāmābhibhūtāśca nṛtyagītaparāyaṇān ।।71 ।।
kāँścitsvarṇamaṇiratnadravyābhūṣaṇasaṃbhṛtān ।
kuberād dravyamādāya gacchataḥ svapurīṃ prati ।।72।।
tāvad bhūkampanaṃ jātaṃ bhūtanāśakaraṃ muhuḥ ।
pṛthvīgartagatāste vai mṛtā niṣpeṣitā mṛdā ।।73 ।।
tatrāyātā yamadūtā netuṃ mṛtānanekaśaḥ ।
kāmino nītavantaste dṛḍhabandhanabandhitān ।।74।।
dhanino'pi nītavanto vinā bandhanameva tān ।
tato dadarśa kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ madam ।।75।।
nidrāṃ tandrāṃ mahālasyaṃ pāpaṃ cāvṛtya tāna sthitān ।
nirodhayitṝn svargāṇi bhayadān yāmyaduḥkhadān ।।76।।
vividhān nirayākhyāँśca puruṣān paritaḥ sthitān ।
tāneva vipraḥ svadravye dadarśa līnatāṃ gatān ।।77।।
bhayaṃ cāvāpa vai svapne vipro doṣān vilokya ca ।
tāvad devāḥ samāyātā dhārmikān netumeva ha ।।78।।
vimānaiḥ śubhaśobhaiśca smṛddhaiḥ sammānitān mṛtān ।
dhārmikān devatulyāँśca kṛtvā ninyurhi tāpasān ।।79।।
harṣitān dhārmikān prāptadivyalokān vilokya saḥ ।
vipro vicārayāmāsa tapodravyaṃ paraṃ sukham ।।2.250.80।।
dhanaṃ doṣabhṛta cāste kāmaḥ kalmaṣasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
nirayāṇāṃ kāraṇe tau dhanakāmau na śāntidau ।।8 1 ।।
atho'narthasvarūpo'sti kāmo duḥkhasvarūpavān ।
tapodharmaḥ svarga eva dharmaṃ carāmi vai tataḥ ।।82।।
cariṣye'pi tato dharmaṃ lomaśasya kṛpāvaśāt ।
asyā'nugrahamāpyaiva sukhaṃ prāpsye vṛṣodbhavam ।।83।।
pṛthivīṃ ratnapūrṇāṃ vā mahāntaṃ ratnasaṃcayam ।
avāpya yāmyalokānāṃ dvāraṃ naiṣye kadācana ।।84।।
ityuktvā tu dhanaṃ prātastyaktvā tatraiva mandire ।
taṃ kuberaṃ namaskṛtya yayau vai tapase dvijaḥ ।।85 ।।
lomaśena samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapo divyaṃ cakāra ha ।
devārcanaparo nityaṃ nityaṃ cātithipūjanaḥ ।।86 । ।
lomaśāśrayamāsādya parṇāhāro babhūva ha ।
jalāhārastataścāsīd vāyubhakṣo babhūva ca ।। 87।।
divyadṛṣṭyā dvijaścāpi yamapuryāṃ nṛpān gatān ।
kuṇḍe rājasahasrāṇi magnāni niraye tadā ।।88 ।।
dadarśa tapasā cāpi nārakān kāmamohitān ।
tataḥ svapnaṃ kṣaṇāttasya tatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 89 ।।
viśāliko drutaṃ śayyāṃ tyaktvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim ।
praṇanāma jagādāpi dṛṣṭaṃ sarvamaniṣṭakam ।। 2.250.90 ।।
kāmo'rthaśca sadā yāmyalokadau duḥkhadau guro! ।
mayā dṛṣṭau yamapuryāṃ dharmaḥ svargaprado mataḥ ।। 9 1 ।।
dharmād dṛṣṭā gatiḥ śreṣṭhā tapasā svargasaṃbhṛtā ।
devatāḥ savimānāśca pūjayantīha dhārmikān ।। 92 ।।
na dhanāḍhyānnāpi cātra kāminaḥ pūjayanti te ।
dharme sukhakalā cāste cariṣyāmi vṛṣaṃ hitam ।। 93 ।।
nedaṃ dhanaṃ mayā grāhyaṃ duḥkhadoṣānusevitam ।
sarve doṣā nivasanti dhane dṛṣṭā mayā guro ।। 94।।
adya svapne mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kampanaṃ vai bhuvaḥ khalu ।
dhanāraṃbhe mahadduḥkhabharaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tviha ।। 95।।
tadevā'maṃgalaṃ me'dya taddhanaṃ na prarocaye ।
ityuktvā dhanadāyaiva dhanaṃ datvā tu bhūsuraḥ ।। 96 ।।
lomaśena mayā sārdhaṃ cāyāt kuṃkumavāpikām ।
bheje kṛṣṇaṃ parabrahma tapasā dharmasaṃbhṛtā ।। 97।।
bhaktiṃ jagāma paramāṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya ca ।
vaiśālikaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ jātaṃ cātra purā nṛpa ।। 98 ।।
tasmāddharmo mahāsvargamokṣadaḥ sukhaśāntidaḥ ।
nirdoṣaḥ śrīharo nyasto dharmo niṣkāmasāttvataḥ ।। 99 ।।
sāttvatānāṃ samācārastapo dhyānaṃ kratukriyā ।
bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ devadevasyāśrayaṇaṃ sadā ।। 2.250.100 ।।
tanmayatvaṃ tatparatvaṃ tadarthatvaṃ tadātmatā ।
tasya sambandhavat sarvaṃ divyācaraṇameva yat ।। 101 ।।
snānasandhyādikaṃ daihyaṃ smṛtyārādhanamāntaram ।
pūjārcādyaṃ sāmayikaṃ satsaṃgādyaṃ tu sārthajam ।। 102 ।।
sarvaṃ vai pāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmākhyaṃ cātmano hitam ।
pāpanāśakaraṃ cāpi yāmyadūtanirodhakam ।। 103 ।।
viṣṇudhāmapradaṃ svargyaṃ śāśvatānandadāyakam ।
ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo virarāma ha ।। 1 04।।
rājā dharme manaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ papraccha vai gurum ।
lomaśaṃ jñānadaṃ divyātmānaṃ brahmaparāyaṇam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne
lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalakṛtastyāgamārgapratyakṣaphalapraśraḥ, nirāmayapraśraḥ, trivargeṣu kiṃśreṣṭhapraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottaraṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 250 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 250 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 251
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 252 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ca tato rājā cā'śvapāṭalako gurum ।
papraccha lomaśaṃ dharmakratuṃ brūhīha kīdṛśam ।। 1 ।।
lomaśaḥ prāha rājan yat prāṇināṃ drohakṛt bhavet। ।
tatsarvathā parityājyaṃ dharmakratuḥ sa eva saḥ ।। 2 ।।
prāṇino duḥkhinaḥ kṛtvā devāstuṣyanti naiva ha ।
sarve bhavantu sukhino yathā devāstathāvidhāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vartante'nugrahaparāstasmādadrohakaḥ kratuḥ ।
ahiṃsā vai dharmamakho hiṃsā yamagṛhaṃ matam ।। 4 ।।
adrohaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ. yajñaḥ satāṃ svabhāvajaḥ ।
snehavṛttyopakāro vai dharmayajño'sti bhūtale ।। 5 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
ātmā śuddho'sti cet kena pāpātmā jāyate hi saḥ ।
kathaṃ dharmabhṛdātmā ca kathaṃ rāgaṃ pramuñcati ।। 6 ।।
kathaṃ muktiṃ prayātyeva kutra vāsaṃ karoti ca ।
kīdṛśaṃ vartanaṃ tatra yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ।। 7 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
saccidānandarūpo'yaṃ cātmā māyāvivarjitaḥ ।
ahaṃmamatvahīnaśca saṃgāt tadvān bhavatyapi ।। 8 ।।
saṃgo māyāprasaṃgaśca sānnidhyaṃ cāntare sadā ।
tenā''kṛṣṭo bhavatyeva pāpātmā doṣasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 9 ।।
jñānābhāve ca māyāyāḥ saṃgaṃ vai labhate yatiḥ ।
jñānena saṃgadoṣāśca naśyantyeva vivekinaḥ ।। 2.251.1 0।।
jñātvā jñātvā viṣayāँstu cecchā tatra pravartate ।
tadāptyarthaṃ pravṛttiśca nivṛttirvā prajāyate ।। 11 ।।
rāgaḥ pravartakastatreṣṭatājñānena jāyate ।
dveṣo nivartakaścāpyaniṣṭatābodhanād bhavet। ।। 12।।
yadarthaṃ yatate tatrārabhate karma dehajam ।
aindriyikaṃ ca vā'bhyāsaṃ tena karoti dehabhāk ।। 1 3।।
rāgādyāḥ sudṛḍhāstena doṣā bhavanti duḥkhadāḥ ।
lobho mohaḥ prajāyete dharmasthitivināśakau ।। 14।।
vyājena jāyate dharmo vyājataścarati vṛṣam ।
vṛṣavad rocate'rtha vyājenaiva dhanaistataḥ ।। 15।।
kurute dehavānajñaḥ pāpaṃ parātmaduḥkhakṛt ।
vardhate'syā'dharmasargaścintanāt kāraṇāttataḥ ।। 16।।
ekaśīlā militvaiva vardhayanti ca pāpakam ।
pāpavṛddhāvaśāntiścodvejanaṃ vighnadarśanam ।। 17।।
kalaho rogayogaśca dhananāśo daridratā ।
jananāśo'vamānaṃ cā'yaśaścā'gaṇanā jane ।। 18।।
cauryaṃ tenā'nṛtavādaḥ kāpaṭyaṃ chaladharmitā ।
pravartante'bhayāḥ sarve pāpātmasu prakarṣataḥ ।। 1 9।।
na te sukhinaścātra kuta eva paratra tu ।
punaryāmyagatiścāpi tiryagyoniḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।2.251.20 ।।
atha dharmabhṛtāṃ mārgaṃ śṛṇu rājan sukhapradam ।
pūrvapūrvānupuṇyena sārthasaṃgena vā janaḥ ।।21 ।।
satsaṃgena sadā dehī śubhaṃ sarvaṃ pravāñcchati ।
kuśalaṃ prakarotyeva satyaṃ vadati nā'nṛtam ।। 22।।
satyaṃ vicintayatyeba satyaṃ karoti sādhanam ।
satyena vartate nityaṃ rāgaṃ dveṣaṃ na vindati ।।23 ।।
vijñavṛttyā hitaṃ svasya parasyāpi karoti ca ।
lobhaṃ mohaṃ vihāyaiva pravartate śubhāya vai ।। 24।।
kuśalenaiva dharmeṇa dehayātrāṃ karoti ca ।
dānena sevayā saṃkīrtanena bhajanena ca ।। 25।।
yajñena mālayā devapūjayā tapasā tathā ।
satsaṃgavṛddhyā nityaṃ ca vindati dharmamuttamam ।। 26।।
vṛddhānāṃ sevayā lokasevayā vardhate vṛṣaḥ ।
doṣān vijñāya sarvān sa tyajatyeva ca dūrataḥ ।।27।।
guṇān vijñāya gṛhṇāti guṇeṣu ramate sadā ।
satsaṃgasārthamāsādya vardhayatyeva sadvṛṣam ।।28।।
sādhūn prasevate nityaṃ sādhudharmān prasevate ।
sādhvācārā'bhyāsavaśād vardhante'sya vṛṣāḥ sadā ।।29।।
prajñā vṛṣe sthirā cāsya nānyatra ramate kvacit ।
dharmapravṛttimān dehī dhanārthaṃ yatate'pi ca ।।2.251.3 0।।
dharmadhanaṃ samavāpya dharme vyayaṃ karoti ca ।
dharmamitrāṇi jāyante dharmiṇo vai svabhāvataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
dharmātmā dharmaśīlaśca dharmasatsaṃgaśobhitaḥ ।
dharmajanyaṃ sukhaṃ cātra labhate'pi paratra ca ।।32।।
svarge svargapare loke prabhutvaṃ labhate tathā ।
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe bhoge prabhutvakam ।।33।।
evaṃ dharmaphalaṃ labdhvā modate nispṛho yathā ।
jñānadṛṣṭyā ca nirvedaṃ poṣayatyeva mānase ।। 34।।
bhogeṣu satsvapi vidvān naiva badhnāti tatra hi ।
abhāvayatastasyaiva mano vairāgyavegavat ।। 35।।
na kāmānanusañcāraṃ karotyasya kadācana ।
dharmaṃ naiva jahātyeva kaṣṭe cāpadi vaiśase ।। 36 ।।
lokaṃ kṣayātmaka dṛṣṭvā dharme'pi rāgahīnatām ।
prāpyātmano muktimārgaṃ mārgayatyeva yatnavān ।।37।।
yatate cānvahaṃ mokṣābhyāse hyupāyamāśrayan ।
śanaiḥ śanaiśca sopānaṃ mokṣasya labhate tataḥ ।।38।।
pāpmānaṃ sarvamevā'yaṃ karotyeva na vai kvacit। ।
jahātyeva samāyātaṃ pāpaṃ śuddhiṃ pravindati ।। 39।।
vimalātmā ca santoṣī devāśrayaparāyaṇaḥ ।
vyarthavārtādirahito mokṣaṃ vai labhate param ।।2.251.40 ।।
vaikuṇṭhe cāpi goloke'kṣare dhāmni pare ca vā ।
yathopāstiṃ prayātyeva mokṣasthalaṃ parātparam ।।41 ।।
tatra brahmahade snātvā brahmatanuḥ hariryathā ।
sampadyate surūpeṇa divyarūpeṇa tādṛśaḥ ।।42।।
jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaścāste'śnute'khilepsitam ।
ekadhā vahudhā cāpi bhavatyeva yathepsitam ।।।43 ।।
sarvarasaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvānandaḥ prajāyate ।
sarvasukhaḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvasiddhiguṇāśrayaḥ ।।44।।
parabrahmasvarūpaśca tatsāmarthyasamanvitaḥ ।
tatsevātatparo muktaḥ prajāyate'timodanaḥ ।।45।।
brahmamūrtermahat saukhyaṃ pravāhaiḥ sa sametyapi ।
karāgre sarvasṛṣṭīśca prapaśyatyeva muktarāṭ ।।।46।।
sārvajñyaṃ jāyate cāsyeśvaratvaṃ saṃprajāyate ।
nātra vā'nyatra loke'syā''vartanaṃ jāyate kvacit ।।47।।
yatra yatra prayātyeva tatra dhāmā'kṣaraṃ puraḥ ।
prakāśate'sya nā'nyadvai divyanetrasya sarvathā ।।48।।
kriyā divyā bhavatyasya māyā'sya saṃgato'pi ca ।
divyaiva jāyate tūrṇaṃ tattvādīnāṃ tu kā kathā ।।49।।
mānave suraloke vai paitṛke cārṣake'pi vā ।
aiśvare vā'vatārabhyāṃ divyo mukto'yameva ha ।।2.251.50।।
yatra kvāpi vased vāpi yatra kvāpi caredapi ।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ karotyeva mokṣaṃ dadāti dehine ।। 51 ।।
asyaiva darśanānmuktāḥ sparśanādapi mokṣiṇaḥ ।
saṃgāt prasevayā muktā jāyante strīnarādayaḥ ।।52।।
yathā dhāmni tathā sṛṣṭau dehe vā muktasaṃsthitau ।
sarvaṃ samaṃ bhavedasya bhinnatā nā'sya vartane ।।।53।।
evaṃ prāptāṃ gatiṃ nityāṃ sukhinīṃ modinīṃ satīm ।
ānandinīṃ priyāṃ mukto'nubhavatyeva sarvadā ।।54।।
rājaँstvaṃ dharmamārgaṃ vai sādhūnāmavalambya ca ।
gatiṃ labhasva vai proktāṃ kimanyena vināśinā ।।55।।
vijñānaṃ sārathiṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ kṛtvā sahāyinīm ।
dharmaṃ cāgragatiṃ kṛtvā yāhi brahma sanātanam ।।56।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ doṣavināśaḥ syād yena dharmagatirbhavet ।
vijñāpaya maharṣe tvaṃ yena śreyo hi dehinaḥ ।।57।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
jayet krodhaṃ kṣamayaiva vicāreṇa punaḥ punaḥ ।
jayet kāmaṃ hyanābhogāt saṃkalpasaṃgavarjanāt ।। 58।।
svapnaṃ jayecca tapasā'nāhāreṇa ca sattvataḥ ।
bhayaṃ jayettadutthānaparityāgād vivekataḥ ।।5 9 ।।
ātmaśīlābhyasanācca mṛtyubhītiṃ sadā tyajet। ।
dhairyeṇa kāmanāmicchāṃ dveṣaṃ jayet kaliṃ tathā ।।2.251.6 0 ।।
bhrāntiṃ mohaṃ mamakāra bhedajñānānnivartayet ।
yāthārthyajñānalābhena viparyadādikaṃ tyajet ।।6 1 ।।
upadravān jayet sarvān kauśalyena vidhānataḥ ।
rogān jayet hetujayāt pathyajīrṇamitāśanāt ।।6 2।।
lobhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ vivekādvā santoṣāt prajayedapi ।
viṣayān viṣabodhādvā tattvadṛṣṭyā jayedapi ।।6 3 ।।
adharmaṃ cātmakṛpayā jayedanarthabhāvataḥ ।
dharmaṃ pālanabuddhyā ca jayenmokṣapradaṃ caret ।।6 4।।
āśāṃ jayennirutthānād bhāviphalguvidhānataḥ ।
arthaṃ cānarthabuddhyā ca jayet saṃgavivarjanāt ।।65 ।।
snehaṃ cānityadṛṣṭyā ca bandhanādivivekataḥ ।
kṣudhāṃ jayed yātrayā ca yogenā''vaśyakena ca ।।66।।
mānaṃ jayedanāvṛttyā kāruṇyena vivekataḥ ।
santoṣācca jayed gṛdhnā vivekajñānatastathā ।।67।।
tandrāṃ jayet svasthabhāvādutthānācca balādapi ।
saṃśayaṃ śāstravacanācca nirṇayāt prajayet sadā ।।68।।
vāgdoṣān munibhāvena manodoṣāँśca vidyayā ।
pāvitryeṇa jayeccāpi kalmaṣaṃ tāmasaṃ sadā ।।69।।
jñānadṛṣṭyā tamaścāpi jayedajñānasaṃjñitam ।
ātmabodhena ca jñānaṃ mānasaṃ prajayed yatiḥ ।।2.251.70।।
ātmānaṃ ca jayetparameśe samarpaṇena tu ।
tadarpaṇāt sarvadoṣā śiṣṭā naśyanti drāk khalu ।।71 ।।
tadā vivardhate tejo brahmalokaprakāśakam ।
siddhayaścodbhavantyasya vijñānaṃ sampravardhate ।।72।।
satāmācāramāptaḥ san vartamānaḥ satāśraye ।
svecchayaiva ninīṣet sa brahmā'kṣaraṃ paraṃ padam ।।73।।
eṣa mārgo vimuktervai rājan śubhāśrayaḥ sadā ।
yatra vighnā na jāyante nirvighnasya hareḥ śrayāt ।।74।।
divyendriyakriyāhāro divyasadguṇavartanaḥ ।
divyakṛṣṇe kṛtasthāno yāti brahma sanātanam ।।75।।
saṃghāte saṃsthiteścāpi mukto naiva hi tapyate ।
baddho hi tapyate tasya sambandhāstāpadāyinaḥ ।।76 ।।
nātmā'sti kasyacit kaścinnāsya kaścana vidyate ।
kathaṃ gṛhṇātyayaṃ duḥkhaṃ parotpannaṃ nijātmani ।।77।।
naiva sañjāyate cātmā nāpi vipadyate kvacit ।
muktvā dehaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇaṃ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ।।78।।
puṇyapāpamayo dehaḥ karmakṣayena naśyati ।
tato dehī pramuktaḥ san brahmatvamupagacchati ।।79।।
puṇyapāpakṣayārthaṃ hi kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vidhīyate ।
tathā nairguṇyamāsādya yāti brahmaparāṃ gatim ।।2.251.80।।
arthāḥ smṛddhibharāścāpi bāḍhaṃ duḥkhabharā yataḥ ।
svādalālāvagūḍhāste mohayantyavicakṣaṇam ।।8 1 ।।
sarvendriyasukhaṃ divyaṃ vitṛṣṇasya tu kalmaṣam ।
satṛṣṇena mamatvena kalpitaṃ svārthapūrtikam ।।82।।
tadeva paritāpāya nāśe sampadyate'dhikam ।
tasmāt tāpakaraṃ pūrvaṃ tāpaṃ matvā na cārjayet ।।83।।
kṛtakṛtyaḥ sadā matvā bhūtvā'pyevaṃ na saṃjvaret ।
iṣṭāniṣṭāvubhau tyaktvā pareśe sarvamarpayet ।।84।।
prāṇāntikaṃ paraṃ rogaṃ tṛṣṇātmakaṃ parityajet ।
apūryamāṇaṃ pātālaṃ tṛṣṇātmakaṃ ca cāviśet ।।85।।
śīlaṃ santoṣamevāpi śāntiṃ bhaktiṃ kṣamāṃ matim ।
sevāṃ samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmadhāma samāviśet ।।86 ।।
paśyan mṛtyuṃ śikhāvāsaṃ kālaṃ ca prāṇavāsinam ।
karma cātmakṛtāvāsaṃ brahmavāsaṃ samarjayet ।।87।।
ahorātrāṇi yāntyeva yātrā bhavati khaṇḍitā ।
rātryāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāyurvindati hasvatām ।।88।।
puṣpavad dehinaṃ mṛtyurnayatyapūrṇakāminam ।
ātmakāryaṃ tu prathamaṃ kurvīta daihikaṃ tataḥ ।।89।।
dehasambandhajaṃ paścād yena na syāt pratāritaḥ ।
akṛteṣvapi kāryeṣu mṛtyurādāya gacchati ।।2.251.90 ।।
nahi kaścid vijānāti kadā mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ।
suptaṃ vā jāgrataṃ svasthaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ।।9 1 ।।
kurvantaṃ bahusaṃkalpān putrasmṛddhipaśusthitim ।
anyavyāsaktahṛdayaṃ mṛtyurādāya gacchati ।।92।।
na mṛtyupṛtanāṃ kaścinnivartayitumudbalaḥ ।
brahmabalo bhaktibalo mṛtyuṃ dūrayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।। 93।।
brahmavidyāprakāśāḍhyaḥ satsaṃgayānavāhanaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇasārathiṃ prāpto mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।।94।।
mā mohaṃ vraja rājendra kṛte puṇye kathaṃcana ।
svarge ca gatvarasaṃjñe sannaddho bhava keśave ।।95।।
keśavaḥ kālakālo'sti mṛtyormṛtyuḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
sarvakarmaphalajyoṣṭā tasmin kāryaṃ samarpaya ।। 96 ।।
nirbhīko bhava rājendra bhayaṃ kośo hi karmaṇām ।
muñca nārāyaṇe deve vikośo bhava pārthiva ।।97।।
gṛhṇā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādaṃ hi nirbhayam ।
kāṃbhareyapade sthitvā śāśvatānandabhāg bhava ।।98।।
ityuktvā rādhike tatra lomaśo virarāma ha ।
rājā'śvapāṭalaḥ śāntiṃ cāvāpa pārabheśvarīm ।।99।।
bahu matvā'mṛtaṃ śrīmallomaśānanavāhitam ।
tṛpto'pi ca punastṛptiṃ nādhijagāma bhaktarāṭ ।। 2.251.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalakṛtānām ātmanaḥ pāpātmakatve puṇyātmakatve muktibhāve doṣavināśabhāve ca praśnānāṃ
śrīlomaśakṛtottaradānamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 251 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 251 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 252
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 253 →

2.252
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athāpi rādhike devi rājā'śvapāṭalastataḥ ।
punarbhāgavatān dharmān papracchā'tṛptamānasaḥ ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kiṃ vrataḥ kīdṛśācāraḥ kiṃ bodhaḥ kiṃ samāśrayaḥ ।
akṣarākhyaṃ harerdhāma prayāti parataḥ param ।। ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
bhaktivrataḥ sadācāro brahmātmabodhavān śuciḥ ।
parabrahmāśrayo yāti dhāmā'kṣaraṃ parātparam ।। 3 ।।
gṛhe gṛhe vasan śāntaḥ svārthā'narthau vihāya ca ।
anutthitanavehaśca nirapekṣo'kṣaraṃ vrajet ।। 4 ।।
na doṣaṃ vivṛṇuyācca sākṣātparokṣameva vā ।
kalpayennāntare cāpi nirdoṣako'kṣaraॆ vrajet। ।। 6 ।।
adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāmānandado bhavatyapi ।
jīvanaṃ cā'jātaśatru kurvaṃstadakṣaraṃ vrajet ।। 6 ।।
vādatarkānna kuryācca nābhimānaṃ vivardhayet ।
priyaṃ ca kuśalaṃ kuryāt so'kṣaraṃ dhāma saṃvrajet ।। ।।
prāṇayātrikamātraḥ san viśeṣaṃ cārjayenna ca ।
pūjito harṣayennaiva snigdhe snigdho na vai bhavet ।। 8 ।।
nānnaṃ nindenna vā'nyaṃ ca naraṃ nārīṃ pranindayet ।
vṛkṣamūlamaraṇyaṃ vā guhāṃ vaset smaran harim ।। 9 ।।
ajñātacaryo vicaret nānurundhyāttu dehinam ।
sadā tṛptaśca santoṣī prasannamānasānanaḥ ।। 2.252.1 0।।
japan kṛṣṇaṃ rāgahīno nispṛhaḥ samadṛṣṭimān ।
parātmanā''tmānandaśca sarvavegapraśāntakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
madhyastha iva tiṣṭhaँśca sarvodāsīnavartanaḥ ।
parabrahmakṛtamaitryaḥ prayātyakṣaradhāma saḥ ।। 12 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kadā sanyāsamāśritya gantavyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam
kadā vā gṛhadharmāddhi yāyāt tadbrahmaṇaḥ padam ।। 13 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
putrapautrādi saṃvīkṣya nivṛttiṃ cābhivīkṣya ca ।
abādhitasvabhāvaṃ cābhyasyāśritya ca sādhutām ।। 14।।
bhaktiṃ kṛtvā vihāyā'tra varṣma gantavyamakṣaram ।
udyogino hi sānnidhye muktiścāyāti durlabhā ।। 15।.
kārtike mārgaśīrṣe vā māghe caitre'pyāṣāḍhake ।
śrāvaṇe saṃpragṛhṇīyāt sanyāsaṃ sādhutānvitam ।। 16।।
yadā nivarteta jagatastadā pravrajettatsthalāt ।
prajñayā ca tamaḥ sarvaṃ nirasya śrīharerbalāt ।। 17।।
brahmaprakāśamāsādya yāyāt kṛṣṇā'kṣaragṛham ।
ayatnasādhyaṃ muktānāmanyeṣāṃ yatnagocaram ।। 18।।
yatnena ceyate svargaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ tathā ।
yatnena karmaṇā tacca mataṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavatyapi ।। 19।।
tapasā labhyate bhūyastapasā bhujyate divam ।
tapasā''tmajuṣā dhāmā'kṣaraṃ cāpi pralabhyate ।।2.252.2 0।।
dharmeṇa sāttvatenaiva harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
prāpyate puruṣo'nanto'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।21 ।।
viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svarṇakeśaḥ hiraṇyaśmaśruracyutaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhagolokavāso brahmapriyāpriyo vibhuḥ ।।22।।
tasmin sthitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ jaḍacaityaṃ carācaram ।
sūkṣmaṃ sarvaṃ brahmajuṣṭaṃ sthaulyaṃ prāpya prajāyate ।।23 ।।
puṣṭimeti tataścaiva tasminnapyeti sarvaśaḥ ।
sa eṣo bhagavān prāpyo bhaktyā ca saṃyamena ca ।।24।।
tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ prājño nirmalo brahmaniṣṭhakaḥ ।
brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ vaśīkṛtya sukhānantyaṃ samaśnute ।।25।।
svarṇaṃ vahnisahasrārciryojitaṃ dhmāyitaṃ muhuḥ ।
śuddhaṃ sampadyate cātmā jñānabhaktyādiyojitaḥ ।।26 ।।
janmāntaraśatenāpi vaikena janmanā'pi vā ।
yatnena mahatā cātmā kalmaṣo'pi viśuddhyati ।। 27।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ śriyāḥ patiḥ ।
kṛpayā bhaktiyoge na sannidhiṃ bhajate'sya ca । ।28।।
akṣare vā kṣare loke yathā tadvad bhavadgṛhe ।
samāyāti ca ramate'nugrahapreritaḥ svayam ।।29।।
brahmaloko'sya mūrdhā'stīśvaralokā hṛdādikam ।
jīvalokāścaraṇau ca tredhā sṛṣṭirvyavasthitā ।। 2.252.30 ।।
karmaṇāṃ tapasāṃ vāpi jñānānāṃ vividhātmanām ।
sevānāṃ cākarmaṇāṃ ca phalaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 31 ।।
aṇḍāni yasya romāṃśe pārameṣṭhyadhikānyapi ।
vedāḥ sarasvatī cāpi jihvā yasyāsti sṛṣṭiṣu ।। 3 2।।
dharmo bhaktirbrahmaparau brahma yaddhṛdaye sthitam ।
tatra sthitaśca yo devo divyaḥ saḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।3 3।।
mantrāḥ pravartanā devāḥ pātrāṇi ca tadātmakāḥ ।
brahmā ca brāhmaṇācchaṃsī potā'gnīdhro yadātmakāḥ ।।34।।
hotācchāvākako grāvaḥ stotā hyete yadātmakāḥ ।
adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā neṣṭonnetā madātmakāḥ ।।35।।
udgātā prastotā pratihartā subrahmaṇya ime ।
yadātmakāḥ kraturyadātmakaḥ sa parameśvaraḥ ।।36।।
muktā akṣaralokaśca golokaśca yadātmakāḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ cāvyākṛtaṃ ca badarīvanam ।।37।।
kṣīrālayaṃ śvetabhūmiryadātmakāḥ sa mādhavaḥ ।
rādhā kṛṣṇastathā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sitāramaḥ ।।38।।
ramākāntaḥ padmajeśa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ।
vāsudevādayo vyūhā avatāraprakoṭayaḥ ।।39।।
bhūmādyā īśvarāścāpi vairājādyāḥ pradhānajāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca rudrā yadātmakā hi saḥ ।।2.252.40।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścāpi vasavaḥ siddhasādhavaḥ ।
ādityāścāśvinau sūryādayo yadātmakā hi saḥ ।।41 ।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca surāśca mānavādayaḥ ।
sarvaṃ tadātmakaṃ rājan pṛthak cāpṛthageva tat ।।42।।।
jñānena mahatā paśyan brahmaprakāśavān bhavet ।
brāhmaprakāśatejasvī paśyatyeva pareśvaram ।।।43।।
sarvān svargān vijānāti sākṣāt karoti cāṃjasā ।
tattaddṛṣṭipratāpena pareśvarānubhāvitaḥ ।।44।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
tattatsṛṣṭau tu ke sargā anityā nityakāśca vā ।
yān sa paśyati muktātmā tānme vada guro nviha ।।45।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
brahmasṛṣṭau bhavantyeva pañcadhā brahmarūpaṇāḥ ।
parabrahma, brahmapriyāḥ, akṣarabrahma ityapi ।।46।।
muktā muktānya eveti pañcarūpaḥ sa eva saḥ ।
īśasṛṣṭau bhavantyeva sadvā daśavidhastathā ।।47।।
avatārā avatāriṇyaśca vyūhāḥ pradhānakam ।
bhūmānaśca mahāviṣṇavaśca vairājakoṭayaḥ ।।48।।
sādāśaivā gavādyāśca pārṣadāṇyaśca pārṣadāḥ ।
gopā gopyaśca rūpāṇi dvādaśaitāni cāpi saḥ ।।49।।
jīvasṛṣṭau daśadhā ca sargaścetanasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
tridevāḥ siddhapuruṣāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ surāḥ ।।2.252.50।।
āsurā mānavāścāpi tiryañcaḥ kīṭajātayaḥ ।
sthāvarāśceti mukhyāste tatrā'vāntarajātayaḥ ।।51 ।।
asaṃkhyātāḥ prajāyante tridevecchānusārataḥ ।
saptaviṃśakalpa evā'yaṃ mukhyo gauṇāstvanantakāḥ ।।52।।
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca kīṭānāṃ tiraścāṃ śubhayogataḥ ।
puṇyakṣetranivāsena tīrthayogena vā punaḥ ।।53 ।।
satāṃ deveśvarāṇāṃ vā yogena mānavī januḥ ।
āsurāṇāṃ kṛṣṇayogāt siddhayogācca mānavī ।।54।।
tatra dharmādilābhena daivī vai jāyate gatiḥ ।
ṣaṇṇāṃ bhaktyā ca vā puṇyaiḥ paitrī gatiḥ prajāyate ।।55।।
śrāddhadānamahāpuṇyairārṣīgatistataḥ parā ।
yogābhyāsavaśāsiddhagatistataḥ parā śubhā ।।56।।
teṣāṃ yogajalabhyopāsanotthā brāhmavaiṣṇavī ।
śāṃbhavī vā gatisteṣāṃ sattvaprakarṣalābhajā ।।57।।
gatirvairājikī teṣāmupāstisamviśeṣataḥ ।
jāyate ca gatirmahāvaiṣṇavī cā'thavā'parā ।।58।।
sādāśaivī gatiścāpi tataścaupāsanābalāt ।
bhūmnikā ca gatiścāpi prādhānapauruṣī tataḥ ।।59।।
vyūhātmikā tataścāpyadhikopāsanayā gatiḥ ।
gopagopīmayī cāpi pārṣadādimayī tathā ।।2.252.6 0 ।।
avatāriṇī ca gatistathā muktasvarūpiṇī ।
avatārasvarūpā ca muktānikāsvarūpiṇī ।।6 1 ।।
brāhmī brahmapriyārūpā gatiścāpi prajāyate ।
ākṣarī ca gatiścāpi hareścopāsanābalāt ।।62।।
jāyate brahmaparyantā paravrahma na jāyate ।
sa evaikaḥ paramātmā sarvāntaryāmimāpatiḥ ।।6 3 ।।
parabrahmā'vatārī ca parameśvarasaṃjñakaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaprakoṭīnāṃ nārāyaṇottamottamaḥ ।।64 ।।
aśvapāla yadā dehī cādharmaṃ śrayati tviha ।
tadā tiryakkīṭayoniṃ yāti sthāvaratāmapi ।।65।।
āsurīṃ vā mānavīṃ vā nikṛṣṭāṃ janumeti ca ।
tato yāmyāṃ bhuvaṃ prāpya - yathāvaśeṣameti hi ।।66।।
aśubhaṃ vā śubhaṃ janma dharmakṛccirakālikaḥ ।
mucyata na tu cādharmamārgī kvacid viyonitaḥ ।।67।।
śuddhena tu hṛdā kṛṣṇaṃ vicinvan brahmabhāvanaḥ ।
śuddhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ brahmākṣaraṃ copaiti yatparam ।।68।।
sarvā sṛṣṭirharerlokāt pravartate viśatyapi ।
tameva bhaja cāntaḥsthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṛṣṇavallabham ।।69।।
sṛjorṇanābhivat sūtraṃ granthasva yāvadarthakam ।
punarnigila kāryānte nirbandho bhava jālake ।।2.252.7 0 ।।
yadā tyaktvā mohajālaṃ punarnavaṃ prakāśaya ।
tyaktvā dharmyaṃ cānyadeva vikāśaya sukhapradam ।।7 1 ।।
jālaṃ jālanidhānaṃ vobhayaṃ tyaktvā sukhī bhava ।
śāśvate brahmaṇi kṣmeśa bhuñjā'nantapramodanam ।।72।।।
granthayo hṛdayasyeha bhavanti vāsanāśritāḥ ।
pradhvastā brahmavijñaptyā punarnavā na santi ca ।।7 3 ।।
granthibandhanahīnaśca prayāti brahma śāśvatam ।
naiva tāmyanti santo vai vijñānino hariṃ śritāḥ ।।74।।
tāmyatyevormibhirlokā mohāśādisamanvitāḥ ।
ye jānanti ca bhūtaṃ ca bhaviṣyad bhavyamityapi ।।75 ।।
upakramaṃ ca saṃhāraṃ phalodayaṃ samā'samam ।
teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca vodvego jāyate na vijānatam ।।76 ।।
karmaṇāṃ gatayo bhinnā dhanāḍhyā dhanavarjitāḥ ।
sudṛḍhadehāścāpathyarugṇā vā cānnavarjitāḥ ।।77 ।।
daridrā vā bahuputrāḥ satī ca duṣṭakāntakā ।
aputrā vāpi rājāno devā daityādipīḍitāḥ ।।78 ।।
vidvāṃso mānahīnā vā bhṛtyāścālasyasevakāḥ ।
surūpā api durhṛdaḥ khyātāśca stenakarmiṇaḥ ।।79 ।।
rājyabhogāśca satṛṣṇāḥ paśya saṃsāranimnatām ।
sahasriṇo'pi jīvanti jīvanti śatino'pi ca ।।2.252.8 0 ।।
daridrāḥ koṭipatayo jīvanti cānnabhojinaḥ ।
sarve prayānti nidhanaṃ sāyāsā niṣprayatnakāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tadvicārya mahārāja bandhanaṃ mā'vamarśaya ।
na bāndhavāḥ suvarṇādi kaulyaṃ vīryaṃ manurbalam ।।।82 ।।
duḥkhāt trātuṃ prabhavanti tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ śrayet ।
priyaṃ yaddharṣajananaṃ garvadaṃ tat tyajet sadā ।।83 ।।
brahmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śāntipradaṃ priyaṃ bhajet sadā ।
arthakāmau mahābandhau dharmamokṣanivartakau ।।84।।
tāveva mādhave nyastau dharmamokṣakarau matau ।
evaṃ ca vartato naiva mṛtyuḥ kālo'pi bādhate ।।85।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
tattvajñānavihīnasya bahusaṃśayaśālinaḥ ।
aprāptanirṇayasyeha śreyo yena vadā'tra tat ।।86 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca--
sādhūnāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ sevanaṃ sadā ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi śāstrāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ।।87।।
kartavyaṃ bhāvato nityaṃ mātāpitṛprasevanam ।
patisevā satīsevā pūjyāśīrvādasaṃgrahaḥ ।।88।।
harerbhajanamityeva śreyaḥpradāni santi vai ।
paraṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ bhaktyā pareśasya prajāyate ।।89।।
gauṇānyapi ca jāyante śreyāṃsi śubhasādhanaiḥ ।
satāṃ śubhāśiṣo nityaṃ dānapuṇyasvabhāvitā ।।2.252.90 ।।
devamandiravāsaśca śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam ।
sarvatra brahmabhāvaśca sarvasevāvidhānakam ।।9 1 ।।
devapitratithibhṛtyā'rhaṇā śreyastathāvidham ।
māyābhramavihīnatvaṃ santoṣaśceṣaṇālayaḥ ।।92।।
antarātmakṛtāvāsaḥ śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam ।
ātmadhyānaṃ tathā mokṣasādhanādivratārjanam ।।93 ।।
jñānadhanaṃ cātmaniṣṭhā śreyo naiḥśreyasapradam ।
sarveṣāṃ śubhamicchedvai sarvotkarṣaṃ samācaret ।।94।।
anyeṣāṃ śubhabhāvādīnatyutkarṣatayā vadet ।
anyebhyo mānamutsāhaṃ dadyāt pūjāṃ samācaret ।।951।।
asvapūjāparaścāpi parapūjyavicāravān ।
prajñālābhaparaścāpi śreyo vindati sarvadā ।। 96 ।।
sādhuṣu vāsamicchecca vidvatsu mārjavaṃ bhajet। ।
puṇyaśīleṣu maitrīṃ ca kuryānniḥśreyasapradām ।। 97।।
śreyohīnā janā yatra tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet ।
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārā vartante tatra vai vaset ।।98।।
yatra sukhaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ vasenmokṣāya tatra ha ।
muktā bandhanahīnāśca caranti sukhino janāḥ ।।99।।
saṃcaye dattayatnāśca kīṭādyā api bhūpate ।
asaktāḥ sukhinaścaite saktā duḥkhārṇavārditāḥ ।। 2.252.10 0।।
svajaneṣu na vai cintā kartavyā madvinā katham ।
jīveyuriti viduṣā śreyo'rthinā vivekinā ।। 101 ।।
sarve karmavaśaṃ tiṣṭhennidhanaṃ yāti karmataḥ ।
melanaṃ viprakarṣaśca yathākarma bhavatyapi ।। 10 2।।
maraṇaṃ sarvathā satyaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ maraṇaṃ śubham ।
śreyāṃsi bahudhā kṛtvā maraṇaṃ maraṇāya tat ।। 1 03।।
parārthe kṛtadurgaśca svārthe khātaṃ prasevate ।
na tasyeha bhavecchreyaḥ kathaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param ।। 1 04।।
tasmād rājan pramādaṃ vai tyaktvā naiḥśreyasaṃ bhaja ।
divase divase kṛṣṇaṃ rātrau rātrau hariṃ bhaja ।। 1 05।।
ātmabhāvaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ paśya mukto'tra saṃbhava ।
yasya loke na vai sthātuṃ samīhā vartate'gragā ।। 106 ।।
prāṇayātrauṣadhā'pekṣā vihārodāsatā tathā ।
vicittasyeva viṣayāḥ sa vai mukto'tra niścitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
annavastrālayādyāśca yasya jīrṇatvaco yathā ।
janarddhisaṃgamo yasya marmabhedāyate'pi ca ।। 1 08।।
indriyāṇāṃ sauṣṭhave'pi yasya nirindriyātmatā ।
bhojyabhogyādisampattau vipattivad vivekitā ।। 1 09।।
so'yaṃ muktaḥ sadā cā'tra paratrā'pi ca bhūpate ।
tadyogādanyalokānāṃ muktatā'pi bhavet khalu ।। 2.252.110 ।।
ṛṣīnnṛpān susamrājo bhuktvā bhuvaṃ gatā mṛtim ।
evaṃ paśyan bhavenmukto bandhanā''śāvivarjitaḥ ।। 119 ।।
duḥkhāni sulabhānyatra sukhāni durlabhāni ca ।
yatnalabdhāni naśyanti kathaṃ mokṣaṃ na pūjayet ।। 1 12।।
sati dravye'bhitaḥ sarve śaṃsamānā aho iti ।
bhrātaḥ pitaḥ śubhāṃ vācaṃ vadanto'bhyarcayanti ca ।। 12 ।।
svārthamātraparāste vai gate dravye virodhinaḥ ।
dāridrye vā na jānanti kva bhrātā kva pitā ca vā ।। 1 14।।
kathaṃ buddhvā svārthaparān na virajyeta buddhimān ।
asāramiva mānuṣyaṃ niṣphalaṃ cāpi jīvanam ।। 1 15।।
tasmād bhagavato dharmaḥ śreyānatra paratra ca ।
satāṃ dharmo'pi bhaktiśca naiḥśreyasapradāḥ sadā ।। 1 16।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmān lomaśaścā'śvapāṭalam ।
upādideśa bahudhā rājā papraccha taṃ punaḥ ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalasyā'kṣaragatisādhanapraśnaḥ, sanyāsād gārhasthyādvā gatipraśnaḥ, sṛṣṭitrayasargapraśnaḥ, śreyaḥpraśnaḥ,
lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 252 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'śvapāṭalaśca śrutvā naiḥśreyasaṃ param ।
lomaśaṃ paripapraccha punaścātmavimokṣaṇam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapaṭṭala uvāca-
vada me'tra punaḥ śreya ihā'mutra sukhāvaham ।
kartavyārthena nirvartyaṃ cābhyudayottarottaram ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śakaṭaṃ rathino yāti bahubhāraṃ pravāsinaḥ ।
dehayātrāpare bhāre tṛptihīnasya bhūtale ।। 3 ।।
kṣudhātṛṣe dve vṛṣabhau śokamohau ca cakrake ।
sukhaduḥkhe cāgrapṛṣṭhau vāsanā madhyasaṃsthikā ।। 4 ।।
rathī svayaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ nītvā yātyadhikāya ha ।
yātrāmātrātirekeṣu lubdho'nuvindatīha ṣaṭ ।। 5 ।।
ata eva sadā kliṣṭo nidrāṃ vetti na vāhakaḥ ।
śakaṭena vahan vastūnyasaṃkhyāni muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
araṇye cendriyacaure luṇṭhito jāyate'vaśaḥ ।'
sukhaśāntyātmakaṃ dravyaṃ caurā haranti sarvaśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tasmānna vṛṣabhau rakṣyau rakṣyaṃ na śakaṭaṃ tathā ।
tattyāge dehayātrāyāṃ sukhaṃ śāntirhi yogivat ।। 8 ।।
jāyate'sya rathino vai yātrāmātraprayogiṇaḥ ।
nādhikaṃ cābhivāñchecca vastrānnajalamandiram ।। 9 ।।
puṇyakāryāṇi kurvīta devakāryāṇi yāni ca ।
paropakārakāryāṇi prakurvītātmasaṃdṛśā ।। 2.253.10 ।।
durlabhaṃ mānavaṃ cāyurnaiva kṣipet pragartake ।
utkarṣābhyudayārthaṃ ca prayateta vimuktaye ।। 11 ।।
puṇyena karmaṇā''pyetotkarṣaścābhyudayastathā ।
vratayatnā'bhyāsabhāgyaiḥ satāmāśīrbhireva ca ।। 12।।
akarmāṇi daivatānāṃ munīnāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।
mahatāṃ na carettāni tejasvināṃ na dūṣaṇam ।। 13 ।।
mahatāṃ cā'ghaṭitāni kutsayenna kadācana ।
śubhe vidadhyācchāntātmā bhadrāṇyeva sa paśyati ।। 14।।
nṛśaṃsaṃ nā'rjayetkarma dhanaṃ mānaṃ praśāsanam ।
tatsarvaṃ yāmyalokasya duḥkhadaṃ bhāvi vai yataḥ ।। 15।।
praśastaṃ cācaret sarvaṃ khyātaṃ dhanyaparāyaṇam ।
daivaṃ paitryaṃ cātitheyaṃ mānavaṃ pāśavaṃ ca yat ।। 16।।
avyayakarmaṇā yānti siddhiṃ santo maharṣayaḥ ।
vyayena karmaṇā bhūpāścopāsanena yoginaḥ ।। 17।।
sevayā yoṣitaḥ śūdrā dāsā dāsyena vai tathā ।
paṇḍitā jñānamārgeṇa kāravaḥ śilpavidyayā ।। 18।।
gavādyā dugdhadānaiśca vṛkṣādyāḥ phaladānakaiḥ ।
stambāḥ patrapradānena vallikāḥ puṣpadānakaiḥ ।। 19।।
mānavāścopakāreṇa parasparaṃ sahāyinaḥ ।
siddhiṃ vai yānti paramāṃ muktisiddhiṃ prayānti ca ।।2.253.2 0 ।।
hutvā'pi havanaṃ vahnau munayo'pi yatavratāḥ ।
prayānti siddhiṃ paramāmuddiśya śrīnarāyaṇam ।। 2 1 ।।
patnī cātmā ca mātā ca pitā janayitā sutaḥ ।
guruḥ putrī ca devāste sevyā yena phalaṃ sukham ।।22।।
te sarve vahnayaḥ proktāstaddhotraṃ hotrameva tat ।
teṣāṃ tṛptau haristṛpto bhavatyevāntare sthitaḥ ।। 23।।
tasyāstṛpteḥ phalaṃ cātra sukhaṃ paratra śāśvatam ।
bhaktyā vā sevayā vāpi dānena ca makhena ca ।।24।।
tapasā kṛcchrasaṃjñena cānarhāścārhatāṃ gatāḥ ।
uśanā viśvāmitraśca vālmīkaḥ sadgatiṃ gatāḥ ।। 25।।
uśanāstapasā śaṃbhoḥ śukratvaṃ prāpya vai tataḥ ।
śukrācāryo daityaguruḥ svarge sadā hyajāyata ।। 26 ।।
kṣatriyo viśvāmitraśca brahmarṣitvamavāpa ha ।
vālmīkiḥ śabaraścāpi sadā mukto babhūva ha ।।27।।
śuśrūṣayā striyaḥ śūdrā gatiṃ yānti parāṃ śubhām ।
satāṃ saṃgaḥ sadā bhāgyodayapradaḥ supuṇyadaḥ ।।।28।।
sannikarṣeṇa ca sataḥ sādhurvai jāyate janaḥ ।
satyaśramopārjitā ca kapardikā'pi saukhyadā ।।29।।
anyāyopārjitaṃ svarṇaṃ duḥkhadaṃ nigaḍapradam ।

brahmā'sṛjat purā putraṃ dharma prajāsukhāya vai ।।3 2।।
sarve varṇāḥ svadharmasthāḥ svargasthāḥ sukhino hi te ।
teṣāṃ muktyarthamatha ca dharmo'sṛjannijāṃgataḥ ।।3 3 ।।
bhaktiṃ yathā janā yānti svargaṃ harerhi śāśvatam ।
tābhyāṃ svargaṃ ciraṃ cāpi śāśvataṃ ca tato milet ।।34।।
evaṃ prayatnaṃ kurvīta svargadvayajayo bhavet ।
yadā vyapetahṛllekhaṃ karmā'saṃgaṃ prajāyate ।।35।।
hṛtsthā'ntaryāmiṇaṃ śritvā kalyāṇamarjayecchuciḥ ।
prāyeṇa rājan sādhūnāṃ tyāgināṃ ca virāgiṇām ।।36।।
prajñābalena bhaktyā vā bandhanaṃ na dṛḍhaṃ bhavet ।
śaithilyaṃ cāpyate jñānād vivekācchāstraśīlanāt ।।37।।
gṛhasthānāṃ jaḍānāṃ vā bandhanaṃ dṛḍhatāṃ vrajet ।
gṛhāṇyāśritya gāścāpi kṣetrāṇyapi dhanāni ca ।।38।।
dārān putrāँśca bhṛtyāँśca bandhanaṃ dṛḍhatāṃ vrajet ।
rāgadveṣau vivardhete bhogamohādibhiḥ sadā ।।39।।
ratistaiścāpyudetyeva rato grāmyasukhādiṣu ।
nahi jānāti cātmārthe vivekaṃ mokṣamityapi ।।2.253.40।।
kintu yatate bhogī syāṃ tataḥ punarvinaśyati ।
tasmānniḥsaṃginā stheyaṃ gṛhadārādhanādiṣu ।।41।।।
tapaḥphalaṃ sampadaśca bandhayanti janāniha ।
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutau manavastathā ।।02।।
viśvedevā aśvinau ca siddhāḥ sādhyā mahārṣayaḥ ।
kiṃpuruṣāśca gandharvā vahnīndrasūryacandrakāḥ ।।'3। ।
pitaro lokapālāśca rākṣasā yakṣakinnarāḥ ।
gaṇāśca pārṣadāścāpi grahā devāśca dānavāḥ ।।44। ।
rājāno guruvargāścā''cāryāḥ siddhāḥ satīstriyaḥ ।
te sarve tapasā siddhā bhuñjate tapasāṃ phalam ।।45।।
mahākule prasūtā ye smṛddhā modanta īśvarāḥ ।
kauśikānyambarāṇyeva svarṇahīrakabhūṣaṇam ।।86 ।।
vāhanāsanabhojyāni pānastrīdāsadāsikāḥ ।
śayyottamāśca mṛdvayaśca vāsaḥ prāsādabhūmiṣu ।।47।।
abhipretāni sarvāṇi sarve tat tapasāṃ phalam ।

iṣuprapātamātraṃ hi sparśayogena kāmajam ।
auṣṇyasukhaṃ praduḥkhāya sarvathā nirayāya ca ।।2.253.5 0 । ।

mokṣaṃ cānabhisandhānāḥ kāmānandādisañjakāḥ ।

prāptaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ dehaṃ mahiṣīmāyayā''vṛtam ।

anekeṣu viṣayeṣu daihikā''modadāyiṣu ।

upabhogairna deho'yaṃ kṣapaṇīyo hyanarthake ।
yāvanna vipraṇaśyetra tāvat kurmaḥ śubhaṃ param ।।2.253.7 0 ।।
etādṛśaṃ kalpabījaṃ prāpya mānuṣavigraham ।
dviṣate yo nijaṃ mokṣaṃ sa mato vañcitaḥ sadā । ।7 1 ।।
lokārthe vai prakurvītopakāraṃ dānakarmabhiḥ ।
kuṭumbārthe prakurvīta sāhāyyaṃ dhanavastubhiḥ । ।72 ।।

iṣṭiṃ dānaṃ ca yajanaṃ puṇyaṃ pitryaṃ ca daivikam ।
bhajanaṃ sevanaṃ cāpi śreyaso'rthe sadā''caret । 174।।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca--
kiṃ mūlaṃ śreyasāṃ yacca kṛtaṃ naiva vinaśyati ।
kva gato na nivarteta kvāpi brūhi ca me guro ।।75 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
sattvavṛttirasaṃgaśca satāṃ sevā samāgamaḥ ।
vṛddhāśīrvādalābhaśca śreyasāṃ mūlamakṣayam ।।76 ।।
tapo bhaktistathā'bhayadānaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ ।
ātmārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ caitat sarve naiva vinaśyati ।। 77।।
kāyakleśebhya evātra tapobhyaścottamaṃ tapaḥ ।
harau vṛtternirodho vai cā'parokṣadṛśipradaḥ ।।78।
sā'parokṣānubhūtiśca labdhā naiva nivartate ।
abhayaṃ ca paraṃ dānaṃ sarvebhyaścātivartate ।। 7 9।।
sarvā'bhayapradasyā'tra paratrā'bhayamakṣayam ।
vasan viṣayamadhye'pi vijño naiva vasatyapi ।।2.253.8 0।।
ajño'satsvapi viṣayeṣvatīva vasatīti vai ।
dharṣayanti na viṣayāḥ prājñaṃ tejasvinaṃ janam ।।8 1।।
aprājñaṃ cādhikaṃ svalpā api valganti vai dṛḍhāḥ ।
duṣkṛtaṃ tasya kartāraṃ naiva muñcati karhicit ।।82। ।
kṛtātmāno na bhidyante viṣayaiḥ karmakoṭibhiḥ ।
akṛtātmānamevā'tra bhayaṃ kvacinna muñcati ।।।83।।
vītarāgasya vai janmā'darśanānmuktireva ha ।
kṛtena karmaṇā tasya lepo naivāsti jīvataḥ ।।84।।
mṛtasyāpi na vai bhogaḥ karmaṇāmasya vidyate ।
bhaktimārgaprayātasya paradhāmagatirmatā ।।85।।
vistarāḥ kleśasaṃyuktāḥ saṃkṣepāḥ sukhadāyinaḥ ।
parārthā vistarā duḥkhāstyāgaṃ cātmahitaṃ śrayet ।।86।।
ahorātrātmake loke dehī mṛtyumukhe sthitaḥ ।
grasyate nityamevā'yaṃ chinnāyurjāyate'niśam ।।87।।
snehapāśaiśca bahubhiḥ prākṛtairmohavṛścikaiḥ ।
daṃṣṭo viṣamayodvigno na sukhaṃ labhate kvacit ।।88।।
pāśān chitvā gṛhaṃ hitvā parigrahān praṇamya ca ।
yaḥ prayāti harermārgaṃ sa vai pāragato bhavet ।।89।।
aśvapāṭala! loko'yaṃ svasthe svāsthyavibhāgahṛt ।
asvāsthye dūragaścāste svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ ।।2.253.90 ।।
svārthalokātparārtho yaḥ sa vai śreṣṭho mataḥ sadā। ।
parārthaparataścāpi titikṣurvai viśeṣitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
titikṣorapi vijñaśca vijñājjyāyāँśca bhaktimān ।
sa vai guptaṃ brahma bodhyaṃ bhaktyāḍhyaṃ mokṣakṛt sadā ।।92।।
amṛtasya paraḥ kośo mokṣasya dvāramuttamam ।
yānaṃ svargasya vai śreṣṭhaṃ dharmasya śevadhistathā ।।93 ।।
bhakto vai mānuṣe loke muktastiṣṭhati muktavat ।
bhaktasaṃgena bhaktā vai jāyante brahmagāminaḥ ।।94।।
yādṛśaṃ sevate jantustādṛśo jāyate'pi saḥ ।
yadi santaṃ sevate'tra sādhuḥ sañjāyate sa ca ।। 95 ।।
devāstṛpyanti sadbhiśca pitaraḥ siddhakoṭayaḥ ।
muktāstṛpyanti sādhubhyastasmāt sādhutvamāvrajet ।। 96।।
svārthamātraparān lokān devāstyajanti dūrataḥ ।
devā muktāḥ sādhavaśca vasanti sādhubhiḥ saha ।। 97।।
ityevaṃ sādhuyogena brahmalokaṃ pragacchati ।
parabrahmasthito mukto'nantānandaṃ samaśnute ।। 98 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike śrīmallomaśaścā'śvapāṭalam ।
upādiśya virarāma rājā papraccha vai punaḥ ।। 99 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto'bhyudayapraśnaḥ, śreyomūlādipraśnaḥ, lomaśadattottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripañcāśada- dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 253 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 253 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 254
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 255 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'śvapāṭalaśca papraccha devatoṣaṇam ।
ātmano ramaṇaṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ yena jāyate ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
maharṣe suralokeṣu vāso vai surayājinām ।
brahmaloke nivāsaśca jāyate brahmayājinām ।। 2 ।।
īśvarāṇāṃ tu loke'pi tattadīśvarayājinām ।
dhāmasu cāvatārāṇāṃ yajanādvasatirbhavet ।। 3 ।। 5
devānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ yena yenopāyena jāyate ।
vadā'tra me kṛpāṃ kṛtvetareṣāmapi dhāminām ।। 4 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
devāstuṣyanti yajñena pūjayopāstibhistathā ।
naivedyabalibhiścāpi mantrārādhanatadvrataiḥ ।। 5 ।।
satyenā'hiṃsayā śuddhyā śīlena ca vṛṣeṇa ca ।
ātmasamarpaṇenā'pi mānatāśaraṇādibhiḥ ।। 6 ।।
anuṣṭhānena kṛcchreṇa dānena smaraṇena ca ।
utsavena kīrtanādyairdevāstuṣyanti bhūpate ।। 7 ।।
ātmaśuddhyā vivekena puṇyakarmabhirādarāt ।
tuṣṭā devā dadatyevaihikaṃ svargyaṃ sukhaṃ nijam ।। 8 ।।
īśvarāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhairmahodyāpanakarmabhiḥ ।
pārāyaṇairvedavidyādhyayanaiḥ pratimārhaṇaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
mandire vidhitaḥ pratiṣṭhāpanaiḥ pūjanādibhiḥ ।
mahotsavairvedadharmaistuṣyantīśvarakoṭayaḥ ।। 2.254.1 0।।
avatārā harerbhāvā bhaktyārādhanayā tathā ।
pūjayā mūrtisevādyaistīrthatadvratabhāvanaiḥ ।। 11 ।।
ājñayā'rpaṇarītyā ca tatkathāśravaṇadibhiḥ ।
ananyaśaraṇāgatyā niṣṭhyaikaikatānayā ।। 12।
satataṃ cānuvṛttyā ca smṛtyā dhyānena sevayā ।
pavitratayā vṛttyā ca nairmalyayutayā'niśam ।। 13 ।।
tacchaktitatpārṣadādisevayā'rpaṇatāśrayaiḥ ।
tattacchṛṃgāradānādyairmānasaiḥ pūjanādibhiḥ ।। 14।।
tadbhaktānāṃ strīnarāṇāṃ sevanairbhojanārpaṇaiḥ ।
avatārāḥ pratuṣyanti tattadaiśvaryadāyinaḥ ।। 15।।
tattaddhāmapradātāro bhavanti bhaktitoṣitāḥ ।
paramātmā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇastu bhūpate ।। 16 ।।
sarvārpaṇātmabhaktyaiva tuṣyatyatra śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
viśvāsabhaktyā nyāsena dāsyena sthirasevayā ।। 17।।
ānukūlyānuvṛttyā ca varaṇenā'rhaṇena ca ।
kaiṃkaryeṇā'pyasaṃgena pūjanena vṛṣeṇa ca ।। 18 ।।
dhyānena bhajanenāpi cā''tmā'rpaṇena tuṣyati ।
bhāvanā tu mahān hetuḥ snehastasya pratoṣaṇe ।। 1 9।।
svalpaṃ vāpi mahadvāpi pūjanaṃ bhāvanānvitam ।
toṣayatyeva govindaṃ sarvavṛttyaikanirmitam ।।2.254.20 ।।
yena kenāpi bhāvena satatasmaraṇena ca ।
tanmayavitpravāheṇa premarajjumayena ca ।। 21 ।।
sarvāntarātmadṛṣṭyā ca sarvatṛptikriyādibhiḥ ।
tadīyānāṃ svāgataiśca sādhūnāṃ sevanādibhiḥ ।।22।।
sāttvatānāṃ toṣaṇaiśca dīnānāmupakārataḥ ।
anāthānāṃ poṣaṇaiścā'drohaiśca sarvadehinām ।।23 ।।
sarvairbhāgavatairdharmaistattvajñānaiḥ svavedanaiḥ ।
tatkathākaraṇaiścāpi tadguṇānāṃ ca varṇanaiḥ ।।24।।
tannāmaraṭaṇaiścāpi tadarthanyāsayojanaiḥ ।
tanmayākāravṛttyā ca tatsṛṣṭidharmarakṣaṇaiḥ ।। 25।।
tatsnehārpaṇasarvasvaiḥ parabrahma pratuṣyati ।
jaḍacetanavargāṇāṃ yathāpekṣapradānakaiḥ ।। 26 ।।
dānadharmaiḥ sattvavratairadrohā'vañcanādibhiḥ ।
satāṃ dharmaiśca bhaktānāṃ bhaktānīnāṃ ca toṣaṇaiḥ ।। 27।।
sarveṣu saṃsthitaścāste hariḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
sarvāstvasyaiva kṛṣṇasya pratimā jaḍacetanāḥ ।। 28।।
narā nāryaścetaracca sarvasṛṣṭisthadehinaḥ ।
tatra sarvatra tadbuddhyā sattvarajastamassvapi ।।29 ।।
tanmūrtiṃ sevayāmyeva sa vai tuṣyatu matpatiḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkambharāsutaḥ ।। 2.254.3 0।।
gopālanandanaḥ kṛṣṇasya vallabho preṣṭha īśitā ।
lakṣmīrādhāramāmāṇikyāramāpadmajāpatiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
brahmapriyāpatirmuktapatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
satāṃ patiścātmapatiḥ sarvapatiḥ patirmama ।।32।।
itikṛtvā bhajettaṃ cā'ntaryāmiṇaṃ hi dehiṣu ।
taddṛṣṭyā tadbhāvanayā tadarpaṇakriyādibhiḥ ।।33 ।।
aphalākāṃkṣiṇā bhāvyaṃ tatra sarvatra pūjane ।
tuṣyatyeva tathā kṛṣṇaścādṛtaḥ sarvadehiṣu ।। 34 ।।
tavā'smīha paritrāhi rakṣeti prārthayet sadā ।
harenātha harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa tavāsmyaham ।। 35।।
yathā vartayase māṃ ca tathā varte tavā''jñayā ।
tavaiva sarvamevedaṃ nānyat tvāmantarā nviha ।।36।।
mama dṛṣṭipathe sarvaṃ tavaiva ca tvameva ca ।
ityevaṃ bhagavaddṛṣṭyā bhāvitasya tu dehinaḥ ।।37।।
kāmāt krodhācca mohācca svārthād bhaktyā''śrayādapi ।
vartamānasya śaraṇe patitasya tadātmanaḥ ।।38।।
tūrṇaṃ tuṣyati bhagavān dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ।
nā'trā'nyat sādhanaṃ vāpi dravyaṃ vā havanādikam ।।39।।
apekṣate toṣaṇārthaṃ yastasya tasya tuṣyati ।
ayaṃ me nā'parasyeti hareḥ kṛpā hi tatprasūḥ ।।2.254.40।।
kṛpayā labhyate kṛṣṇaḥ kṛpayā nīyate'kṣaram ।
kṛpayā svapadaṃ cāpi samarpayati satpatiḥ ।।41 ।।
hīnabhāvanayā naiva bhavanti vai surādayaḥ ।
santuṣṭāḥ sarvadharmebhyo bahiṣkṛtena karmaṇā ।।42।।
bhaktaiḥ saha surādyā vai svāminaḥ sevakaistathā ।
dāsairniyāmakāścāpi tuṣṭā ramanta īśvarāḥ ।।43 ।।
ajñānāvṛtasattvānāṃ mātsaryādimaṣījuṣām ।
lobhādidoṣakṛṣṭānāṃ svargo mokṣo na toṣaṇam ।।44।।
prājño bhakto'kṣaraṃ yāti ramate sukhibhiḥ saha ।
balaṃ nijeṣṭadevasya prāpya śāntiṃ samaśnute ।।45।।
daivata dehināṃ karma kṛṣṇārthaṃ yat kṛtaṃ hi tat ।
devatvaṃ kṛṣṇabhajanaṃ śuddhiḥ svādhyāya ityapi ।।46।।
vrataṃ śīlaṃ jayaścāpīndriyāṇāṃ sādhunā matā ।
kalaho nindanaṃ cāpi kāpaṭyaṃ dhūrtatādikāḥ ।।47।।
asādhutvaṃ veditavyaṃ mṛtyustaiḥ saha vartate ।
parīkṣya mṛtyuryatrāste vihāya tāni buddhimān ।।48।।
mṛtyuṃ vivāsayed dūre harerāśrayaṇādiha ।
mṛtyubhītirahitaśca caredākṣarasādhanam ।।49।।
parabrahmālayalabdhiryathā syāttaccarennṛpa ।
ityevaṃ vartamānasya yasmānnaiva nivartate ।।2.254.50।।
tadakṣarasya lokasya prāptirbharveddhi śāśvatī ।
bhaktyā saṃprāpyate dhāma vāso niravadhiryataḥ ।।51 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca--
ātmānātmavivekena muktirvai kīdṛśī bhavet ।
harerupāstyā muktiśca kīdṛśī saṃbhaved guro ।।52।।
yogābhyāsena vā muktiḥ kīdṛśī syād vadātra me ।
dharmamātrāśrayeṇā'pi muktirvai kīdṛśī matā ।।।53 ।।
gurorāśrayamātreṇa bhavedvā na bhavecca sā ।
niḥsaṃśayo mokṣalābhaḥ keneti vada me guro ।।54।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
deho vai pañcabhūtaiścendriyairāntarikairapi ।
karaṇaiḥ prāṇaistriguṇaistanmātraiḥ saṃhato mataḥ ।।55।।
ātmā tebhyaḥ pṛthaṅ nityaścetanaścā'vibandhanaḥ ।
nityamukto nityaśuddho nityabuddho vasan sadā ।।56।।
jaḍacetanavijñānādṛjñānakṣayakāraṇāt ।
tattvābhyāsānnāsmi na me nā'haṃ ceti prakāśanāt ।।57।।
karmakṣayena dehādvai mukto mukto hi nirguṇaḥ ।
saccidānandarūpo vai janyaprakāśavarjitaḥ ।।58।।
svarūpakalpasthitiko muktyātmā cābhipadyate ।
na vai sukhī na cākāraḥ sadā jāḍyāśrayo bhavet। ।।59।।
jāḍyasya hāriṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ parameśaṃ bhajed yadi ।
brahmadhāmni parameśasvarūpo'bhiniṣpadyate ।।2.254.6 0 ।।
yathā haristathā bhaktaḥ sālokyaṃ sārṣṭimantikam ।
sārūpyaṃ samavāpnoti sarvāmodān samaśnute ।।6 1 ।।
brahmahrade kṛtasnāno brāhmīṃ tanuṃ hyavāpya ca ।
brāhmamukto divyaguṇaḥ sampadyate harīcchayā ।।62।।
na tatrā'yaṃ hi saṃghāto dehaḥ prākṛtakāraṇaḥ ।
ātmaiva tattvamekaṃ ca samūrtaṃ svaprabhāvataḥ ।।63।।
upāsitahareryogāt samartho mūrtirūpakaḥ ।
mukto bhavati muktau vai māyā tatra na vartate ।।64।।
sarvakāmarasasvādaḥ sarvagandhasukhāśrayaḥ ।
sarvaiśvaryayuto nityānandāmodasya śevadhiḥ ।।65।।
avyayānandamagnaśca brahmaṇā saha modate ।
sarvān kāmānātmasaṃsthān bhuṃkte brahmasvarūpavān ।।66।।
parabrahmāptayogaśca sarvānandabhṛto bhavet ।
na nyūnaṃ śrīhareścāsti bhaktamuktasya tatra ha ।।67।।
evaṃ copāstiyogena muktiṃ śreṣṭhā bhavetparā ।
yogino yogayatnasthā yadi kṛṣṇamupāsate ।।68।।।
tadā coktāṃ parāṃ muktiṃ vindati nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
yadi cānyānīśvarādīn vairājādīnupāsate ।।69।।
tadeśvarakṛtān lokānāpnuvantīśvarā yathā ।
prākṛtaiśvaryamuktiḥ sā mahālaye kṣayāvahā ।।2.254.70।।
siddhīḥ prāpya sthitiṃ labdhvā cānte nijā'vaśeṣavat ।
layaṃ vā'nyeśvarabhāvaṃ devatvaṃ vā'bhiyanti ca ।। 71।।
sahasradhābhavanādisamaiśvaryāṇi bhuṃjate ।
sā nikṛṣṭā pātadā ca muktirnimnasthalātparā ।। 72।।
dhyānayogācca vā mūrtau harerlīnatvarūpiṇī ।
aikātmyamuktireteṣāmabhinnādisamādhibhiḥ ।।73।।
svāmisevakabhāvādivarjitā sā prajāyate ।
parameśe sadā tirobhāvarūpā na vai pṛthak ।।74।।
rājan dhyānavaśātte ca tallīnāstanmayāḥ khalu ।
parameśe parameśāḥ sampadyante'bhavāḥ punaḥ ।।75।।
eṣā śreṣṭhatarā muktiryā sthitiḥ pārameśvarī ।
dāsarūpeṇa sevā'tra śiṣyate na kathaṃcana ।।76।।
dharmamātreṇa yā muktiḥ sā tu bhogā'viyoginī ।
svargasatyādilokeṣu sadeho vāsa eva ha ।।77।।
dharmaṃ bhuktvā punaḥ pṛthvyāṃ janmanā ca vṛṣārjanam ।
punaḥ svargaṃ punaḥ pṛthvī punareva pracakrakam ।।78।।
evaṃ jāte'pi dharmaḥ sa yadi bhāgavatātmakaḥ ।
brahmasambandharūpo vā nairguṇyanāmadheyakaḥ ।।79।।
sevātmako hareḥ syāccedadhvare dakṣiṇātmakaḥ ।
dānātmako harestuṣṭyai tadā muktirhi śāśvatī ।।2.254.80 ।।
dharmo vai svārthamātreṇa kṛto naiva hi muktaye ।
parārthabuddhyā'nuṣṭhitaḥ kalyāṇāya sa jāyate ।।81।।
parameśā'rpaṇabuddhyā kṛtaścenmokṣado'kṣare ।
evaṃ rājan kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śubhā vā'pyaśubhāstathā ।।82।।
asaṃgabhāvajāḥ kṛṣṇārpaṇabhāvena nirvṛtāḥ ।
kṛṣṇasmaraṇasampādyāḥ sarvā mokṣapradā hi tāḥ ।।83।।
api kṣetrādhipaḥ kṣetraṃ saṃskṛtyotkhātya karṣati ।
vapate sasyakaṇiśān lunātyapi ca khādati ।।84।।
sarva brahmārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā karoti kururājavat ।
yadvā janakavaccāpi kūrmibrahmarṣivacca vā ।।85।।
tatsarvaṃ jāyate nirdoṣakaṃ kalmaṣavarjitam।
svarṇakāraḥ satyavṛttyā sampādayati bhūṣaṇam ।।86।।
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cettat śailpyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet। ।
haryarthaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam ।।87।।
hariṃ vinā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ duḥkhadaṃ ca vā ।
abhyasyanti dvijā vedān haryanusmṛtivarjitān ।।88।।
cettadā'bhyasanaṃ śuno bhakṣaṇaṃ ceva jāyate ।
vinā maṇerhi māhātmyaṃ gopālo mahiṣīgale ।।89 ।।
badhnāti kaṃkaraṃ matvā mūlyaṃ tasya phalaṃ na ca ।
api śālagrāmaśilāṃ matvā viṣṇuṃ sanātanam ।।2.254.9 0 ।।
rakṣanti vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ sevayanti divāniśam ।
teṣāṃ viṣṇurhi tadrūpaḥ sevāṃ matvā vibhāvitām ।।9 1 ।।
caturbhujaḥ prāvirbhūy dṛśyate cākṣigocaraḥ ।
sa eva bhāvabhinnaścet tirobhavati drāk tataḥ ।।92।।
sa evā''rādhanāsnehapāśitaścet pareśvaraḥ ।
parabrahmā'vatāryeva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।93 ।।
avatārāvatāryevā'nādyanantastathā''ntaraḥ ।
prakāśate hṛdi cāgre tato nayati cākṣaram ।।9 4।।
tasmād rājan kriyāyogāḥ kṛtā dehendriyādibhiḥ ।
svārthārthaṃ bandhakā hyete haryarthaṃ mokṣadā hi te ।।95 ।।
santaḥ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena divyāḥ kṛṣṇahṛdātmakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇaiśvaryabhṛtā mokṣapradā bhavanti saukhyadāḥ ।।9 6 ।।
divyalokapradā divyānandadāścākṣarapradāḥ ।
bhagavatpratimāyogapradāśca jñānadāyinaḥ ।।97।।
vighnaghnāḥ prākṛtāvartanāśakā bhramavārakāḥ ।
duḥkhadoṣanivārāśca brahmalokasya dāyakāḥ ।। 98।।
teṣāṃ sevā prakartavyāḥ sarvāḥ saṃśayavarjitāḥ ।
yathā te bhagavanmūrtiviśeṣā itimatya vai ।।99।।
yathā patnyāṃ ca putre ca pitrośca bāndhave nije ।
prītiścāste svārthaparā'hamamatvaprayojitā ।। 2.254.100 ।।
tathā prītiḥ sadā kāryā sadgurau mokṣadā hi sā ।
dharmo vā dharmayajño vā puṇyaṃ dānaṃ śubhā kriyā ।। 101 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sarvaṃ samarpayet ।
tadā muktirmahāmuktirbrahmasāyujyarūpiṇī ।। 1 02।।
brahmasārṣṭisvarūpā ca brahmalokapradāyinī ।
parabrahmasamamūrtikāriṇī cottamāttamā ।। 1 03।।
prāpyate mānavenaiva dehena prabhaviṣṇunā ।
prabhuṇā saha saṃyogaḥ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।। 1 04।।
gopyaḥ prāptāḥ paraṃ yogaṃ tathā brahmapriyāḥ khalu ।
muktāḥ prāptāḥ paraṃ yogaṃ nā'nyayogasya vāñchayā ।। 1 05।।
ityevaṃ tvaṃ bhūpate'tra pratyakṣaṃ yogamāvaha ।
vapuḥ kṛtvā paraṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ yogamāvaha ।। 1 06।।
rādhike! lomaśastvevaṃ rājñe pradāya cāntaram ।
virarāmopadeśaṃ ca mumude nṛpatirbahu ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto devādīnāṃ toṣaṇahetupraśnaḥ, vivekopāsanāyogadharmagurubhiḥ kīdṛśī muktiritipraśnaḥ, lomaśoktottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 254 ।।
