śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ca tataścāśvapaṭṭalo lomaśaṃ munim ।
yogasya ca balaṃ cāpyabalaṃ papraccha kīdṛśam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
ṛṣe yogabalaṃ kīdṛg vettamicchāmi cābalam ।
yena mukto bhavedvāpi cāvaṣṭabhyeta nirbalaḥ ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śaucaṃ tapo dayā satyamahiṃsā steyavarjanam ।
prāṇarodho vṛttirodho dhyānaṃ samā hi yoginām ।। 3 ।।
abhyāso balavān yasya tasya yogaḥ prasiddhyati ।
nirbalasyā'bhyasanaṃ ca nirbalaṃ tena bandhanam ।। 4 ।।
kāmaṃ lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ ca snehaṃ krodhaṃ ca rāgitām ।
yogācchitvā'pyabalastu punasteṣvapi sajjate ।। 5 ।।
yathā matsyāḥ sthūladehā chitvā jālaṃ punarjalam ।
viśanti nirbalāstadvat ṣaṭkaṃ viśanti vai punaḥ ।। 6 ।।
yathā ca balavanto vai mṛgāḥ pāśān vibhidya ca ।
paraṃ vanāntaraṃ yānti tadvad yogivarāḥ param ।। 7 ।।
māyāpāraṃ prayāntyeva baliṣṭhātmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
yathā ca balahīnā vai śaśādyā bandhanāni vai ।। 8 ।।
āsādya nahi nirgantuṃ samarthā yoginastathā ।
nirbalā na samarthā vai nirgantuṃ jālato bahiḥ ।। 9 ।।
jhaṣāśca nirbalā jālaṃ chitvā prayānti naiva ha ।
nirbalā yoginastadvanmāyāṃ chitvā prayānti na ।। 2.255.10 ।।
śakunā balino jālaṃ chitvā yānti digantaram ।
yogino balino māyāṃ chitvā'mbaraṃ prayānti hi ।। 1 1।।
balavāँśca yathā vahniḥ sarvaṃ dahati cāgatam ।
baliṣṭhā yogino māyāṃ dahantyeva svatejasā ।। 12।।
nirbalastu yathā vahniḥ śāmyatyevāpi dārubhiḥ ।
yogyapi nirbalaḥ ṣaṭke parābhavaṃ prayāti vai ।। 13 ।।
nadīsroto balahīnaṃ tvākṛṣya nayate jale ।
ṣaṭkaṃ tadvannirbalaṃ cākṛṣya nayati māyike ।। 14।।
vāraṇaḥ sabalaḥ sroto viṣṭabhnāti ca gacchati ।
baliṣṭhaśca tathā yogī ṣaṭkaṃ nivārya gacchati ।। 15।।
sabalāstu pramucyante nirbalā yānti bandhanam ।
pralayotthamahādityo yathā śoṣayate jagat ।। 16 ।।
mokṣabalotthitayogī doṣān śoṣayate tathā ।
yogino yogabalato viśantīśvaramandiram ।। 17।।
devānāmālayān prajāpatisthānāni vāpi ca ।
sarvadā'bhyāsaśīlasya balaṃ yogasya vardhate ।। 18।।
tataḥ punarvibhidyaiva māyāṃ prayānti cākṣaram ।
kṛtābhyāso yathā dhanvī kuśalo lakṣyavedhakaḥ ।। 19।।
vidhvā lakṣyaṃ jayaṃ yāti tathā'kṣaraṃ prayāti saḥ ।
mastake snehapātraṃ ca kṛtābhyāso nidhāya ca ।।2.255.20।।
yathā rajjvā naṭo yātyaskhalito jayameti ca ।
tathā'bhyāsabalarddhiścākṣaraṃ yogī prayāti hi ।।2 1 ।।
yathā'bhyāso karṇadhāro nāvā pāraṃ prayāti ca ।
tathā yukto balenāpi jagatpāraṃ pragacchati ।।22।।
sārathiśca balī cāśvānniyamya yāti niścitam ।
tathā yukto yogivaryo yātyakṣaraṃ dhruvaṃ padam ।।23 ।।
nijātmani pareśaṃ yaḥ paśyatyeva ca yogavit ।
māyājālaṃ sa vai chitvā prayātyeva paraṃ padam ।। 24।।
cakreṣu dehasaṃstheṣu saṃvihṛtya malāni tu ।
dagdhvā dagdhvā brahmamārgaṃ yāti viyāti vai balāt ।।25।।
yatheṣṭaṃ ca yadā kalpayatyeva gantumakṣaram ।
tadā varṣma vihāyaiva svatantro yāti dhāma tat ।।26।।
baliṣṭhasyeṣṭadevasyopāstyā balamavāpnuyāt ।
abhyāsenātmayogena saṃyamena vṛṣeṇa ca ।।27।।
tapasā dhyānayogena samādhinā balaṃ vrajet ।
kintu rājan mahāraṇye pāraṃ kecitprayānti vai ।।28।।
baliṣṭhānāṃ vijetāro'raṇye vasanti vai yataḥ ।
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā pāraṃ gantuṃ sandehavatpadam ।।29।।
hriyante'pi baliṣṭhā vai prabaliṣṭhatamā'ribhiḥ ।
divyaiśvaryacamatkārasiddhidhāmanivāsibhiḥ ।।2.255.3 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāgre yadā bhavet। ।
pragacchan sa nayatyeva jitvā baliṣṭhasattamān ।।3 1 ।।
nijaṃ paraṃ padaṃ divyaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣamuttamam ।
rājan dehe guṇān matvā mā bhūrbaddhaḥ kadācana ।।32।।
vivekena pramātavyaṃ kalmāṣāṇāṃ gṛhaṃ vapuḥ ।
atra sattvaṃ daśabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān ।।33।।
ānandaḥ prītiruddharṣaḥ prakāśaḥ puṇyakāritā ।
santoṣamārjavaṃ śraddhā tyāga aiśvaryamityapi ।।34।।
tathā rajo navabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān ।
āstikatvamakārpaṇyaṃ dvandvopasevanaṃ tathā ।।35।।
kāmo dveṣo mado darpo vādaḥ paruṣatā tathā ।
tathā chāyā tamo'bhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi te ।। 36।।
tāmasatvaṃ mohanaṃ ca dhūmrabhāvo matikṣayaḥ ।
nidrā pramāda ālasyaṃ nāśaśceti tathāvidhāḥ ।। 37।।
buddhitattvaṃ saptabhāvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi te ।
ahantā mamatā mānaṃ dairghyaṃ cāśā svapūjyatā ।।38।।
īśateti manaścāpi ṣaḍbhāvaṃ tān vadāmi te ।
cāñcalyaṃ vegavattvaṃ ca saṃśayaśca svatantratā ।।3 9।।
snigdhatvaṃ cāpyaviśvāsyaṃ mānase te matāḥ sadā ।
indriyaṃ pañcabhāvaṃ ca me nibodha vadāmi te ।।2.255.40।।
atṛptiḥ raṃjanaṃ caudāsīnyaṃ cālocanaṃ gatiḥ ।
caturbhāvaṃ bhūtatattvaṃ me nibodha vadāmi tān ।।41।।
āśrayo bandhanaṃ nāśaḥ prasavaśceti sarvadā ।
tribhāvaṃ kośatattva ca ṣaṭkośāste tanusthitāḥ ।।42।।
romalohitamāṃsāni majjāsthisnāyavaśca te ।
bhāvāstu kledyatā mālinyaṃ tathā paribhogyatā ।।43।।
prāṇo vai dvisvabhāvaśca bhāvau dvau tau nibodha me ।
jīvanaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ ceti tattvāni kathitāni te ।।44।।
rājan tattvavivekena bhāvāste doṣarūpiṇaḥ ।
ātmano mokṣamārge vai vighnāste yadi te tathā ।।45।।
tān vivicyaikabhāvaṃ vai sukhabhāvaṃ nijātmakam ।
parameśe'rpayed bhaktyā mokṣastasya sthito dhruvaḥ ।।46 ।।
yadvā bhāvān lokayitvā didṛkṣāntaṃ vidhāpayet ।
mānuṣān viṣayān sarvān paiśācān viṣayāँstathā ।।47।।
yakṣāṇāṃ viṣayāँścāpyauragāṇāṃ viṣayāँstathā ।
gāndharvaviṣayāँścāpi pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāँstathā ।।48।।
tiraścāṃ viṣayāँścāpi marutāṃ viṣayāँstathā ।
patatriviṣayāँścāpi rājarṣiviṣayāँstathā ।।49।।
brahmarṣiviṣayāँścāpyāsurāṇāṃ viṣayāँstathā ।
viṣayān viśvadevānāṃ yogināṃ viṣayāँstathā ।।2.255.50।।
prājāpatyānaiśvarāँśca brāhmānīśvarakoṭijān ।
viṣayān samparijñāya sukhaduḥkhe'nubhūya ca ।।51 ।।
guṇadoṣān vilokyaiva śāntiṃ prāpya tataḥ param ।
ātmanā ca vivekenātmānaṃ mokṣe niveśayet ।।52।।
jñānavijñānasampannaścopāyairbhāvitaḥ svayam ।
prāpnoti mokṣaṇaṃ divyaṃ nityānandākṣaraṃ padam ।।53 ।।
rājan saṃkocayet prāṇaṃ saṣaṭkośaṃ ca bhūtake ।
bhūtāni mātrayuktāni cendriyāṇi ca vai manaḥ ।।54।।
ahantādiyutaṃ buddhau vilopayed vivekavān ।
buddhiṃ samarpayennaije svarūpe tvātmasaṃjñake ।।55।।
ātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hṛdi ।
taṃ mokṣe yojayettena gacchedakṣaradhāma yat। ।।56 ।।
jñātvā kālasya kavalān devān prajāpatīn ṛṣīn ।
saptarṣīṃścāpi rājarṣīn surarṣīṃścyāvitān sadā ।।57।।
brahmarṣīṃśceśvararṣīṃśca jñātvā kālakṛtāntakān ।
na tatra vai cared dhyānaṃ mokṣamārgagatiṃ caran ।।58।।
pāpināṃ ca gatiṃ jñātvā yāmyaloke'bhisaṃvṛtām ।
vicitrayonijanmāni pretabhāvān vilokya ca ।।59।।
garbhaduḥkhāni vai jñātvā jantūnāṃ kutsitāni ca ।
upaplavān praghorāँśca tārānakṣatrapātanam ।।2.255.60 ।।
yugalānāmakasmācca viyogaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ tathā ।
bhūtānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ cāpyanyonyaṃ vilokya nirghṛṇam ।।61 ।।
viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ gatāsūnāṃ na jīvanam ।
pāpināṃ duḥkhadāścāpi gatīrvijñāya dāruṇām ।।62।।
tiraścāṃ duḥkhamālakṣyā''yuṣāṃ kṣayaṃ dine dine ।
dehināṃ saṃkṣayaṃ vīkṣya mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ vilokya ca ।।63 ।।
dehadoṣān pravijñāya narakāgāratāṃ tathā ।
nyasya dehaṃ brahmarandhrād gantavyaṃ paramaṃ padam ।।64।।
āśrayet prāṇadevaṃ ca vāyudevaṃ tataḥ param ।
vyomadevaṃ tataścāpi sūryaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ।।65।।
cāndraraśmiṃ tataścāpi puṇyaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ।
satyaraśmiṃ tataścāpi sattvaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ।।66।।
īśaraśmiṃ tataścāpi brahmaraśmiṃ tataḥ param ।
muktaraśmiṃ tataścāpi paraṃbrahma samarjayet ।।67।।
paramātmānamāsādya tadbhūtāyatanā'malaḥ ।
amṛtaṃ paramaṃ prāpto yatpunarna nivartate ।। 68।।
paramā sā gatiḥ rājan satāṃ ca yogināmapi ।
sāttvatānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ haryarthakṛtakarmaṇām ।।69।।
tatra jñānaṃ hi sārvajñyaṃ caiśvaryavrātasaṃbhṛtam ।
tṛptiḥ sarvātirekā cānandamātrāpi nirbharā ।।2.255.70 ।।
asaṃgasya hi sārvajñyaṃ nirdvandvāya sadā matam ।
ataḥ sārvajñyabhāvena yuktāste nityatoṣiṇaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
nityānandā nityaśāntā nityatṛptā nirāśayāḥ ।
sarvadarśina evāpi saṃsārā'darśino hi te ।।72।।।
saṃsāradarśinaścāpi tattadbhāvavivarjitāḥ ।
bhāvavikṛtiśūnyāśca pratyāhārādisiddhikāḥ ।।73।।
grāhyā'grāhyasamarthāste sṛṣṭidoṣavivarjitāḥ ।
nimnasṛṣṭikṛtān bhāvān jñāne sinvanti naiva te ।।74।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kiṃ taddhāmā'kṣaraṃ vidvan yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ।
kiṃ ca kṣaraṃ tato bhinnaṃ yasmādāvartate punaḥ ।।75।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
akṣaraṃ dhāma subhagaṃ rājan pareśvarasya yat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'tyavatāriṇaḥ ।।76।।
parabrahmaṇa evaitannārāyaṇeśvarasya tat ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñasyā'kṣarātītasya śāśvatam ।।77।।
śivaṃ kṣemaṃ cābhilāṣopanītaṃ sarvasiddhimat ।
sarveśvareśvarasthānaṃ muktāvāsaṃ parātparam ।।78।।
yanna kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvatkālena vai kvacit ।
āyatyā ca na vai grastaṃ cāvyayaṃ brahmadhāma tat ।।79।।
golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ cānantamacyutam ।
yatra dhāmānyanantāni cāvatārakṛtāni vai ।।2.255.80 ।।
nārāyaṇānāṃ vidyante nārāyaṇīkṛtāni hi ।
avatārā nivasanti koṭiśo yatra dhāmasu ।।8 1 ।।
tāni yatra prabhāsante'kṣaraṃ taddhāma sarvagam ।
brahmalokaścidākāśo'khaṇḍatejobhuvāṃ nidhiḥ ।।82।।
yatrā'kṣaraṃ brahma cāpi mūrtimad rājate prabhu ।
akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ dhāma tasmātparaṃ hareḥ priyam ।।83 ।।
paraṃdhāmā'sti vai yatra parabrahmāsanaṃ sadā ।
vartate sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gajāsanaśubhāsanam ।।84।।
brahmapriyāḥ samastā vai vartante tatra sevikāḥ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya muktidāsikāḥ ।।85।।
muktānyo vai harermūrteḥ śaktayo'nantasiddhayaḥ ।
siddhāścānantasaṃkhyāśca sādhyā devā vasanti te ।।86 ।।
anādayaśca te muktā vasanti dhāmni tatpare ।
ādimuktāstvakṣare vai vasanti dhāmni sarvadā ।।87।।
etadakṣarasaṃjñaṃ taddhāma māyāparaṃ yataḥ ।
guṇātītaṃ mahānandaṃ nityānandādisaṃbhṛtam ।।88।।
yadromaleśasaukhyena dhāmānyanyāni yāni ca ।
ānandāmṛtasaukhyairvaiṃ saṃbhṛtāni bhavanti hi ।।89।।
anyāśceśvaralokākhyā bhuvastatsaukhyasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvavidhikāstadānandena nanditāḥ ।।2.255.90 ।।
māyātmikāḥ sṛṣṭayaśca kṣaraṃ kṣaranta eva vai ।
triguṇāśca tamo māyā cā'vyaktaṃ puruṣā''hitam ।। 91 ।।
vyaktarūpaṃ bhavatyeva mahattattvamahaṃ tathā ।
vidyāvidye puṇyapāpe vidhyavidhī tathā'parau ।।92।।
dharmo jñānaṃ virāgaṃ caiśvaryaṃ vyakte pratiṣṭhitam ।
tadviruddhaṃ tathā cāpi vyakte sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।।93।।
śabdaḥ sparśaḥ raso rūpaṃ gandho vai bhūtasūkṣmakam ।
manaścālocanārthaṃ ca śrotratvaṅnetrajihvikāḥ ।।94।।
ghrāṇaṃ ceti tato'nye ca vākpāṇipādapāyavaḥ ।
upasthaṃ ceti karmārthaṃ vyomānilānalāstathā ।।95।।
vārikṣye ca tataścānye ṣāṭkauśikatanubhṛtaḥ ।
etatsarvaṃ kṣarate'harniśaṃ tat kṣaramucyate ।।96।।
sarveṣāṃ dehabhāve vai caturviṃśatibhūmayaḥ ।
nyūnā vā santi kṣarikāḥ kṣaraṃ tasmādudīritam ।।97।।
yattu mūrtimayaṃ kiñcit sarvaṃ kṣaraṇadharmakam ।
jale bhuvi tathākāśe vāyau tejasi tatpare ।।98।।
puṇyastare siddhipare sattvapaṭalake'pi vā ।
kṣarādhāraṃ kṛtsnametat kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñitam ।।99।।
kṣare'kṣaraṃ sadā cāste hyātmā cākṣara ityapi ।
akṣare cātmani sthānaṃ yasya saḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 2.255.100 ।।
sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣvātiṣṭhate hariḥ ।
bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ rājan ramānvitam ।। 101 ।।
śuklaraktakṛṣṇasṛṣṭisvāminaṃ padmajeśvaram ।
pāragaṃ cāntarasthaṃ ca kāṃbhareyaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ।। 1 02।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaṃ nāthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikeśvaram ।
gopālabālakaṃ rājan lomaśeṣṭaṃ patīśvaram ।। 1 03।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetrādityaṃ brahmapriyāpatim ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ cākṣareśaṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ prabhum ।। 1 04।।
sṛṣṭyādau tu bhuvaṃ cemāṃ bhajamānaṃ surāṣṭrikām ।
mahāviṣṇusutaṃ śrīmanmahālakṣmyekabālakam ।। 1 05।।
tato'nekasvarūpaṃ ca bahvavatāradhāriṇam ।
tato dharmasutaṃ bhaktisutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ ca tam ।। 1 06।।
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cāpi brahmaśīlaparāyaṇam ।
svāminaṃ tyāginaṃ cāpi sarvajñaṃ deśikaṃ tathā ।। 1 07।।
ācāryaṃ sadguruṃ dhiṣṇyādhipaṃ sanmaṇḍaleśvaram ।
brahmavrataṃ sahājīvaṃ sarvālocakamacyutam ।। 1 08।।
bhaja rājan parāṃ muktiṃ vraja tanmatkṛpākaṇāt ।
ityevaṃ rādhike cāśvapāṭalaṃ nṛpatimṛṣiḥ ।। 1 09।।
upādiśya virarāma smaran śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।
rājā'pyānandasandohāt saṃbhṛtāntaraharṣitaḥ ।। 2.255.110 ।।
adhikasvādamāsādya parabrahmakathāmṛte ।
satṛṣa iva pipāsuḥ punaḥ papraccha lomaśam ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto yogasya balā'balapraśraḥ kṣarā'kṣaralokapraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 255 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 255 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 256
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 257 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ca tato rājā papraccha lomaśaṃ tu yat ।
kathayāmi samāsena hṛdayena nibodha me ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kṣaraścāyaṃ hi saṃsārastatrā'kṣaro hi cetanaḥ ।
kathaṃ na muñcati tvetat kṣaraṃ yātyakṣaraṃ na saḥ ।। 2 ।।
lomaśa uvāca-
garbhe karmavaśāt suptaḥ pacyate pakvamannavat ।
bhūtasaṃskāratādātmyam āpanna iva bharjitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kṣaradharmān samāsādyā'jñānadaśā'bhibhāvitaḥ ।
kṣarātmā sva iti bhrāntiṃ prāptaḥ prasūyate tataḥ ।। 4 ।।
ahaṃ bālo naro nārī bāhyaśabdairvibṛṃhitaḥ ।
śuklalohitakṛṣṇārthabhānabhrāntipramīlitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
saṃkīrṇakalpanāṃ prāptaḥ sārthasaṃgairjaḍīkṛtaḥ ।
kṛśaḥ sthūlo duḥkhī sukhī mamā'haṃtvaṃprabodhitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
karmapāśāyuṣyarajjubandhitaścā'vaśīkṛtaḥ ।
prāṇakoṣṭhalikāgranthigrathitaścā'vināśitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
māyātāpapariṣekaśokitaśca dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ।
ṣāṭkauśikarasairliptastatraiva ca kṛtāsanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
mahālepairlepitaśca neṣṭe nirgantumaprabhuḥ ।
tatraiva tāmasaṃ vāpi rājasaṃ sāttvikaṃ ca vā ।। 9 ।।
pravāhaṃ ca rasaṃ pakvaṃ svādaṃ cābhyastametyayam ।
puṣṭimeti tatastaistairindriyāhṛtasadrasaiḥ ।। 2.256.10 ।।
sukhānandaiśca puṣṇāti dhāvatyeva tadarthakaḥ ।
tadarthaṃ yatate cāpi jñātuṃ prāptuṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 11 ।।
bhoktuṃ tyaktuṃ navīkartuṃ sañcayituṃ navaṃ punaḥ ।
tadvegavāsanākṣipto mūḍhaḥ kṣare kṣarātmakaḥ ।। 12।।
abhinnaścā'pṛthagbhūtvā vartate keśakarṣitaḥ ।
dehadharmaparo bhūtvā dehānandena nanditaḥ ।। 13।।
punaḥ puṇyaṃ karotyeva divyadehādilabdhaye ।
evaṃ cakreṇa vai gacchan dehāt karma tato vapuḥ ।। 14।।
punaḥ karma punardehaścetyevaṃ kṣaragartake ।
muhuḥ patati cā'jñātmā muhurmodaṃ ca vāñchati ।। 15।।
nā'syaivaṃ vartamānasya kṣarānmuktiḥ kvacid bhavet ।
pratyuta vardhate moho bandhanaṃ saṃsṛtistathā ।। 16।।
mohānmohaṃ cānuvrajya dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā navaṃ navam ।
prāptuṃ bhoktuṃ ca yatate karma badhnāti tanmayam ।। 17।।
dehād dehasahasrāṇi karmabhiścābhipadyate ।
tiryakṣu devavargeṣu mānuṣeṣu ca pakṣiṣu ।। 18।।
daityadānavarakṣassu jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
dvandvāneti ca nirdvandvastāsu tāsveva yoniṣu ।। 1 9।।
devabhogān sādhyabhogān siddhabhogānanuttamān ।
īśvarāṇāṃ tathā bhogānāptuṃ mathnāti sarvaśaḥ ।। 2.256.20 ।।
roge bhoge vihāre codvege kṣaye kṣatau kṣate ।
śarīrātmā bhramabhinno mameti cābhimanyate ।।21 ।।
bhinnadeheṣu kurvan vai rājyaṃ śete vibhinnake ।
śayane genduke kvāpi bile dvaidhe ca kardame ।।22।।
iṣṭikāyāṃ ca gagane garte ca gahvare kṣitau ।
kaṇṭake bhasmani kṣīṇe jale phale'nile nale ।।23।।
dadhan vastrāṇi ramyāṇi aurṇāni kambalāni ca ।
tārṇāni rājasānyeva kārdameyāni carma ca ।। 24।।
yadyadyonau prajāyeta tattadvastraparigraham ।
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi gandhānyagandhakāni ca ।।25।।
kledaśaivālabhakṣyāṇi manyate svāni vaibhramāt ।
vividhāni ca kṛcchrāṇi bhuṃkte vratāni siddhaye ।।26।।।
kurute cā'pyabhīṣṭāni tānyanudravati pragaḥ ।
ātmarūpaguṇān lābhān vividhān hṛdayapriyān ।।27।।
dhāvate cānubhogārthaṃ bhoktavyāni mayeti ca ।
mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate ।।28।।
sargakoṭisahasreṣu triṣu lokeṣu tatphalam ।
yathākarma samaśnāti maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu ।।29।।
aśanārahitaścāpi sāśanaḥ samajāyate ।
nirindriyo'pi manute sendriyaṃ svaṃ vraṇānvitam ।।2.256.3 0।।
aliṃgo liṃgavantaṃ cā'mṛtyurmṛtyubhayānvitam ।
aduḥkho duḥkhinaṃ cāpyakṣaro'pi manyate kṣaram ।।31।
evaṃ kṣarābhimānena kṣarānniryāti naiva saḥ ।
rājannajñānabhāvasya nā'syānte vidyate kvacit ।।32।।
ṛte gurūpaniṣadṃ śāstrāṇāṃ pariśīlanam ।
satsaṃgaṃ satkathālābhaṃ hareḥ satāṃ prasevanam ।।33।।
anugrahaṃ hṛtsthaharermuktānāmanuvartanam ।
ārādhanaṃ hareścāpi dhyānaṃ tasya parātmanaḥ ।।34।।
etāni sādhanānyeva divyāni divyadāni hi ।
ātmanā yujyate cātmā parātmā tatra yujyate ।।35।।
tadā pāraṃ paraṃ yātyakṣarātparasthitaṃ prabhum ।
yāvaddhariṃ śrayennaiva satsaṃgaṃ nācaredapi ।।36।।
bhaktiṃ vidhāpayennaivopāsanāṃ na samācaret ।
pratyakṣasya hareḥ sevāṃ guroḥ sevāṃ satāṃ tathā ।।37।।
yāvatkuryānna vai tāvatsaṃsāro'sya na līyate ।
sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati ।।38।।
dhāmnā dhāmasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni yāti ca ।
māyāmāyikasevābhimāyikastriguṇo bhavet। ।।39।।
māyāsambandhayogena māyāguṇamayo bhavet ।
ratyarthamabhisambandhādanyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt ।।2.256.40 ।।
ṛtau garbhāśrayād rūpaṃ māyikaṃ labhate muhuḥ ।
evaṃ vai jāyamānasya mokṣadharmaḥ kuto bhavet ।।41 ।।
tasmād granthiṃ vāsanākhyāṃ chitvā bhitvā ca saṃvrajet ।
tṛṣṇākṣayaṃ tapasaiva kṛtvā jñānena vāpi ca ।।42।।
vivekena pṛthakkṛtvā matvā''tmānaṃ hyamāyikam ।
jñānaprakāśamārgeṇa gantavyaṃ satpathena ca ।।43।।
tadā guṇā viyujyante nirguṇādvai cidātmanaḥ ।
āgarbhādeva puṇyena guṇabhinnaṃ samīkṣate ।।44।।
prahlādavattathā madālasābālā ivāpi ca ।
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā yadvā divyacakṣuḥ prakāśate ।।45।।
ātmā'nātmavivekena guṇahānyā nijaṃ nijaḥ ।
paraṃ paśyati yuktātmā parātparaṃ hariṃ tathā ।।46।।
ekāgratā balaṃ tatra dhyānabalaṃ ca kāraṇam ।
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṃgebhyo brāhme muhūrtake sthiraḥ ।।47।।
dhārayettu manaḥ kṛṣṇe'pararātre hṛdantare ।
buddhyā vṛttiṃ sthirīkṛtyā'pyakaṃpo niścalo bhavan ।।48।।
hariṃ paśyati cāntaḥsthaṃ tadā yukto bhavatyayam ।
yuktasya sarvadā bhānaṃ parameśaparāyaṇam ।।49।।
nānyacchṛṇoti cāghrāti na rasyati na paśyati ।
naiva spṛśati gṛhṇāti yāti vakti ca mehati ।।2.256.50।।
na manute na ca saṃkalpayate manyate na ca ।
na buddhyati tadā cātmā parātmani pramodate ।।।51 ।।
prakāśate'mbare sūryo nirvāte dīpako yathā ।
taṃ prapaśyanti munayo brahmayonaya īśvarāḥ ।।52।।
taṃ paraṃ paramātmānaṃ dṛśyetātmadṛśā tadā ।
ātmadṛṣṭirmatā vidyā avidyā mānasī dṛśiḥ ।।53 ।।
avidyā sarganāśāḍhyā vidyā muktirhi śāśvatī ।
avyaktaṃ sṛjate'vidyāṃ vidyā cātmā'bhipadyate ।।54।।
avidyayā mṛtiṃ yāyād vidyayā'mṛtamṛcchati ।
vidyālābhe tvātmano vai viveko bahuśākhavān ।।55।।
kṛtātmanaḥ prajāyeta śṛṇu rājan vadāmi te ।
kiṃ mayā kṛtametāvatkālena māyikena vai ।।।56।।
ajñeneva jhaṣeṇātra jālaṃ samanuvartitam ।
jalādanyanna jānāti matsyo jalāptajīvanaḥ ।।57।।
tathā nā'haṃ paraṃ kaṃcijjñātavān bhramachāditaḥ ।
mamācāre bhrame dhigdhigastu mohānuvartane ।।58।।
mohānuvartanaṃ prāpya nā'vediṣaṃ pareśvaram ।
māyayā'haṃ sthitaśchanno vañcitaḥ paramātmani ।।59।।
māyayā'haṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ kālametaṃ na buddhavān ।
vañcito'smyanayā yaddhi mokṣamārgaṃ na labdhavān ।।2.256.60।।
na cā'yamaparādho'syā aparādho mamāpi ca ।
yo'hamatrā'vasaṃ sakto lubdho viṣayavāsanaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
arūpaścāpyamūrtaśca rūpamūrto'bhavaṃ tayā ।
prākṛtena mamatvena dharṣito vañcitastataḥ ।।62।।
mamakāravihīnena mayā mamatvasañjuṣā ।
kiṃ kṛtaṃ prakṣipya mokṣaṃ nirayaṃ yat pralabdhavān ।।63।।
nānayā mama kāryaṃ vai śiṣyate vārayoṣitā ।
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā yā māṃ yunakti vañcane ।।64।।
athedānīṃ prabuddho'smi kṛpayā sadgurorhareḥ ।
apetyemāṃ śrayāmyadya parameśaṃ guruṃ prabhum ।।65।।
sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi devena nānayā kūṭayoṣitā ।
kṣemaṃ kṛṣṇena yāsyāmi vrajiṣyāmi paraṃ padam ।।66 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vivekotthaṃ nirṇayaṃ cātmanā tataḥ ।
saṃgadharmā hareḥ saṃgāddharitulyo'bhipadyate ।। 67।।
etaduktaṃ parabrahma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ ।
rājan yena paraṃ jñānaṃ prāptaṃ cedṃ pramokṣadam ।।68 ।।
yena kṣarā'kṣare jñāte bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate ।
śreyaḥ prakurvataścātra bhayaṃ cāpi na yasya ha ।। 69 ।।
tasya bhayaṃ pare loke kadāpi naiva jāyate ।
dharmaṃ satāṃ hitaṃ puṃsāṃ cāśrayato bhayaṃ na vai ।।2.256.70 ।।
svādukāmukakāmānāṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ nirbhayaṃ sadā ।
jñāne dharme paricayaṃ kurvato na bhayaṃ kvacit ।।7 1 ।।
nityaṃ vai bahudātuśca sādhūnāṃ sevinaḥ sadā ।
satāṃ satkāraśīlasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ।। 72 ।।
nyāyamarhāya dātuśca hṛdā śuddhasya vedinaḥ ।
viraktasya visaṃgasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ।।7 3 ।।
sarvanirhṛtadoṣasya sarvaprāṇiprasevinaḥ ।
paropakāraśīlasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ।। 74।।
titikṣoḥ sahamānasya krodhahīnasya dehinaḥ ।
saralasya hitakarturbhayaṃ naiva prapadyate ।। 75 ।।
śubhāśrayasya dātuśca saṃyamino dayājuṣaḥ ।
sarvatra mānabhāvasya bhayaṃ naiva bhavet kvacit ।।76 ।।
dhṛtātmanaḥ praśāntasya prājñasya bhakticāriṇaḥ ।
tapasvinaḥ sevakasya bhayaṃ naiva hi jāyate ।।77।।
dharmādharmavimuktasya sarvasaṃśayanāśinaḥ ।
janmamṛtyuvimuktasya paraṃ śreyo hi niścitam ।।78 ।।
puṇyapāpavimuktasya brahmānugrahayoginaḥ ।
dehatrayātiriktasya paraṃ śreyo hi niścitam ।।79।।
mūlaprakṛtitattve ca vikārāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśe ।
prakṛtivikṛtau cāpi yo baddhaḥ sa mucyate ।।2.256.8 0 ।।
anyaṃ dehaṃ nijaṃ cānyaṃ vidyād yaḥ sa na lipyate ।
anyacca maśakaṃ vidyādanyadudumbaraṃ tathā ।।8 1 ।।
navodumbarayogena maśakastatra lipyate ।
anya ca matsyakaṃ vidyādanyad vidyājjalaṃ tathā ।।82।।
na cāpāṃ saṃprasaṃgena matsyastatra pralipyate ।
anyaścāgniścullikānyā cullyāgnirnaiva lipyate । । 83 ।।
jalaṃ cānyan padmamanyadadbhiḥ padmaṃ na lipyate ।
eteṣāṃ sahavāsaśca nivāso mitha eva ha ।। 84 । ।
tathāpyetatpṛthagbhāvaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ।
evaṃ vai paśyatastatrāśrayanāśe na bandhanama । ।85 । ।
tattajjīvanapūrāccedadhikaṃ jīvanaṃ milet ।
tato jīvanamāsādya sukhaṃ tatra pramodate ।। 86 ।।
paramātmā jīvanaṃ vai sarvānandā'mṛtapradam ।
tamāśrayaṃ samāsādya bhayaṃ mṛtyurna nāśanam । । 87 । ।
paraṃśreyaḥ paraṃbrahma parāmuktiḥ paraṃ padam ।
ajarāmaralokaścā'vyayānandasukhābdhikam । । 88
yukto muktaḥ sadā cātra nijātmani samaśnute ।
nityaprasādastṛptātmā sukhasvapananirvṛtaḥ ।। 89 । ।
meghairyathā śilā naiva calatyayaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ।
na kampettu kṛtairghoṣagarjanāgītavādanaiḥ । । 2.256. 90 । ।
tailapātraṃ kare kṛtvā rajjvā naṭaḥ prayāti ca ।
sthālyā'pi saṃyatātmā vai nirbhayaḥ kampavarjitaḥ । । 91 । ।
nā'sya pātrāt sravate ca tailabindurmanāgapi ।
prayāti cottaraprāntaṃ tayā yukto jayaṃ labhet ।। 92 ।।
etādṛśo brahmayuktaḥ paśyati brahma cātra ha ।
parabrahma samāsādya mukto mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 93 । ।
ityevaṃ rādhike bhūpaṃ copadiśya ca lomaśaḥ ।
śāntiṃ cāvāpa rājā ca punaḥ papraccha tatsṛtim । । 94। ।
yathā muktā mahātmāno muktā naiḥśreyasārthinaḥ ।
prayānti cotkramaṇādyaistāni papraccha lomine ।। 95 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyām ātmanaḥ kṣaramocanaṃ cākṣaragamanaṃ ca kathaṃ neti praśraḥ, taduttaraṃ tanmocanaṃ tadgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 256 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 256 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 257
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 258 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
yadā dehāt pṛthagbhūtaḥ śuddhaścātmā prayāti hi ।
rādhe kathaṃ prayātyevaṃ papraccha lomaśaṃ nṛpaḥ । । 1 । ।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
ṛṣe cotkramaṇaṃ kīdṛk kathaṃ kasmān prayātyayam ।
ātmā dehādviniṣkramya tadvadasva mama prabho ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
yadyatsthānād viniryāti yathā yogatapobalāt ।
yathā bhaktibalāccāpi yathā puṇyabalādapi ।। 3 ।।
yathā pāpabalāccāpi yathā karmabalādapi ।
yathā māyābalāccāpi vāsanābalato'pi ca ।। 4 ।।
tattatsthānasthadevānāṃ lokān prayāti tadyathā ।
padbhyāṃ nirgatya cedyāti viṣṇusthānaṃ prayāti vai ।। 5 ।।
jaṃghābhyāṃ cetprayātyeṣo vasūnāṃ yāti mandiram ।
ūrubhyāṃ cetprayātyeṣaḥ prajāpatiṃ prayāti saḥ ।
pāyunā cetprayātyeṣo maitraṃ sthānaṃ prapadyate ।। 6 ।।
liṃgād yonyā prayāpyeṣaḥ satyalokaṃ prapadyate ।
jaghanena prayātyeṣo merusthānamavāpnuyāt ।। 7 ।।
nābheścotkramate cedvai devānāṃ svargamāpnuyāt ।
pārśvābhyāṃ maruto lokān cetprayāti prapadyate ।। 8 ।।
bāhubhyāṃ cotkramate cedindralokamavāpnuyāt ।
urasā cet prayātyeṣo rudralokamavāpnuyāt। ।। 9 ।।
grīvayā yāti cedeṣo naralokamavāpnuyāt ।
mukhena cetprayātyeṣo viśvedevānavāpnuyāt ।। 2.257.10 ।।
śrotreṇotkramaṇe cāsya dikpālatvaṃ bhavediti ।
ghrāṇena gamane vāyorlokāvāptirbhavediti ।। 11 ।।
netrābhyāṃ gamane sūryalokaṃ candrālayaṃ ca vā ।
kapolābhyāṃ prayāṇe ca vahnilokaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 1 2।।
bhrūbhyāmasya prayāṇe cāśvinorlokamavāpnuyāt ।
lalāṭena prayāṇe tu pitṛlokagatirbhavet ।। 13 ।।
mūrdhnā cotkramaṇe yāti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ।
cakrebhyaścet prayātyeva suṣumṇāmārgamāśritaḥ ।। 14।।
tadā tattadīśvarāṇāṃ lokāneṣa prayāti ha ।
sthānabalādidaṃ proktamutkramaṇaṃ narādhipa ।। 15।।
upāsanābalāccā'pyutkramaṇaṃ vai viśiṣyate ।
pāpapuṇyabalāccāpi gamanaṃ vai vibhidyate ।। 16 ।।
śaṃbhorupāsanād yāti kailāsaṃ gaṇamaṇḍitam ।
viṣṇorupāsanād yāti śvetadvīpaṃ payodadhim ।। 17।।
naranārāyaṇabhaktyā prayāti badarīpatim ।
sūryagāyatrikābhaktyā yāti sūryasya maṇḍalam ।। 18 ।।
yajñādyupāstikriyayā svargaṃ yāti makhārthavān ।
pitrupāsanayā pitṛlokaṃ yāti hi mānavaḥ ।। 1 9।।
brahmacaryāt siddhalokaṃ satyalokaṃ tapovidheḥ ।
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena yāti vairājadhāma ca ।।2.257.20।।
mahāviṣṇorupāstyā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ।
nārāyaṇopāsanayā mahāvaikuṇṭhamṛcchati ।।2 1 ।।
rādhākṛṣṇopāsanayā golokaṃ vindatīti vai ।
māyopāstyā māyikāँśca lokānāvaraṇādikān ।।22।।
bhūmnaścopāsanayā cāvyākṛtaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ।
vāsudevopāsanayā'mṛtaṃ dhāma prayāti ca ।।23 ।।
kapilādyāvatārāṇāmupāstyā tattadālayān ।
akṣaropāsanayā yātyakṣaraṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।।24।।
parabrahmopāsanayā paraṃdhāma prapadyate ।
anupāstyā karmabhiśca yāti yoniṣu janmavān ।।25।।
tāmasaiḥ karmabhirdaityo dānavo rākṣaso bhavet ।
tiryagyoniṃ prayātyeṣaḥ sthāvarādīn viśatyapi ।।26।।
rājasaiḥ karmabhiryāti rājyaṃ śreṣṭhinamityapi ।
vasūn gāndharvalokāँśca lokapālān dyuvāsinaḥ ।।27।।
sāttvikairjāyate vipraḥ sādhurvā puṇyadevatā ।
pāpaiḥ prajāyate pakṣī paśuḥ kīṭo mṛgo'pi vā । ।28। ।
puṇyaiḥ prajāyate rājā devo guruḥ satī vratī ।
ṛṇinastu prajāyante vāhā aśvavṛṣādayaḥ ।। 29।।
dātāraśca prajāyante pūjyāsanavirājitāḥ ।
evaṃ vai bhinnaśakaṭaiḥ prayānti bhinnamandiram ।। 2.257.3 0।।
gārhasthye vartamānāśca jñānā'nalasamanvitāḥ ।
pradahya sarvakarmāṇi prakāśyātmānamātmani ।।3 1 ।।
prayānti paramaṃ brahma yathā sanyāsino'malāḥ ।
asannyastā hi sannyastā jñānasanyāsamāśritāḥ ।।3 2।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
asannyastāḥ kathaṃ proktāḥ sannyastā iti vai guro ।
kathaṃ yānti ca gārhasthyasthitāstā paramāṃ gatim ।। 3 3।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
ākarṇaya nṛpā'trā'pi kathāṃ tu paramā'dbhutām ।
ānartanṛpateḥ kuśalāyoginyā vai purābhavām ।।34।।
saurāṣṭre kṛṣṇabhakto vai rājā ānartako'bhavat ।
yenedaṃ vāsitaṃ surāṣṭrakaṃ cānāyya kṛṣṇataḥ ।।35 ।।
rājā'sau vaiṣṇavo bhakto patnīvratadvijānugaḥ ।
jñānaṃ hyavāptavān patnīvratād viprāddhi tāttvikam ।। 36।।
vartate sma ca sādhūnāṃ sabhāyāṃ jñānatatparaḥ ।
jñānaśāstreṇa saṃchidyā'haṃmametiprabandhanam ।।37।।
yoge santiṣṭhate nityaṃ samādhau parameśvare ।
sādhūnāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ bhavanti jñānavārtikāḥ ।। 38।।।
yatsabhāyāṃ sadā sāyaṃ camatkārapure nṛpa ।
tena kīrtirdiganteṣu vyāptā cānartayoginaḥ ।। 39 ।।
tāṃ śrutvā kuśalā sādhvī yoginī siddhisaṃbhṛtā ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetravāsinī pārameśvarī ।। 2.257.40 ।।
yāvadyogakalāpūrṇā parakāyapraveśinī ।
iṣṭarūpadharā vijñā tattvajñānārthaśevadhiḥ ।।41 ।।
vaiṣṇavī jaraṭhā dehadharmān vimatya tāpasī ।
ātmadharmamayī gurvī bhūtadharmā'hatā satī ।।42।।
vartamānā brāhmabhāve'lakṣyaliṃgā narāyaṇī ।
parabhāvaṃ gatā kṛṣṇe sarvasannyāsavartinī ।। 43 ।।
vaśe yasyā yathā lakṣmyā jagatsarvaṃ tathāvidhā ।
yathā'vatāriṇī devī satī ca śivaśaktikā । । 44।।
kuśalākhyā tu sā sādhvī camatkārapuraṃ yayo ।
kṛtvā rūpaṃ sundaraṃ codbhinnayauvanamuttamam ।। 45 ।
ānarttaṃ nṛpatiṃ prāptā vṛtaṃ sadasi sādhubhiḥ ।
yogibhirnyāsibhiścāpi maharṣibhiśca vedibhiḥ । ।46।।
sarve dṛṣṭvā saukumāryaṃ paraṃ tasyā navaṃ vayaḥ ।
keyaṃ kasya kutaścātretyāsan samprāptavismayāḥ । ।47। ।
rājā'pi svāgataṃ cakre dadau sadasi cāsanam ।
satkṛtā cāpi sammānairyoginī kuśalā satī ।।48।।
praṣṭuṃ cecchāvatī bhūpaṃ yogabandhairbabandha tam ।
maukṣadharme prasiddho'yaṃ rājā sarvatra gīyate ।।49।।
mukto rājā sāttvato'yaṃ kīdṛgāste vilokaye ।
ānartasya buddhisattve drāk svabuddhyā viveśa sā ।।2.257.50।।
netrābhyāṃ netrayorasya raśmīn saṃyamya raśmibhiḥ
buddhivṛttīḥ praviveśa vijetuṃ jñānamārgaṇaiḥ ।।5 1 ।।
dvayoryogavidorbuddhau vivādo ghaṭate hṛdi ।
tayorekasya yogitve'parasya tu parājayaḥ ।।।52।।।
ayogī na jayaṃ yāti rājā'yaṃ tādṛśo na vā ।
vicāryeti satī buddhau vaśīcakāra taṃ nṛpam ।।53।।
rājā vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ mūkāṃ kurve tu yoginīm ।
iti buddhyā satī buddhiṃ jagrāha yogasadbalaiḥ ।।54।।
nṛpadehe praviṣṭāṃ tāṃ satkṛtya buddhivigrahe ।
liṃgadehe hyavasthāpya rājā tasthau tayā saha ।।55।।
sthūladehā'saṃginau tau liṅgadehe sthitau tadā ।
yoginau svajayārthaṃ ca mitho vādaṃ pracakratuḥ ।।56।।
ānarta uvāca-
yogasatyāḥ kva caryeyaṃ kṛtā kva ca gamiṣyasi ।
kasya ca tvaṃ kuto veti kā ca kathaṃ hyupasthitā ।।57।।
ahaṃ rājā'pi taccihnairmukto'smi yogamāsthitaḥ ।
sa tvāṃ jñātuṃ samicchāmi mānārhe yogini drutam ।।58।।
mayā patnīvratākhyād vai guroḥ prāptaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
yogajñānaṃ viśālaṃ ca mokṣaśceti ca me śṛṇu ।।59।।
tattvajñāne ca yogarddhau rājyavidhau ca vai mayā ।
trividhe mokṣade prāptaṃ sthairyaṃ carāmyarāgakaḥ ।।2.257.6 0 ।।
mokṣasya kāraṇaṃ rāgābhāvo jñānena ceyate ।
jñānenā'rāgatādvārā mokṣasiddhirmayā kṛtā ।।6 1 ।।
advandvaścāpyasaṃgaśca tiṣṭhāmyacalabuddhitaḥ ।
śuṣkakṣetraṃ jalahīnaṃ sabījaṃ cāpi cāṃkure ।।62 ।।
kāraṇaṃ na bhavatyeva tathā'haṃ śuṣkatāṃ gataḥ ।
nā'bhirajyāmi miṣṭaiśca krūraiḥ khedaṃ karomi na ।।63 । ।
candanenā'rcayed dakṣe vāme śastreṇa bhedayet ।
kaścinmāṃ tulyatā tatra sādhvi! me vartate ṛtā ।।64।।
sukhyahaṃ kṛtasarvārthaḥ samakaṃkarakāñcanaḥ ।
asaṃgo rājyabhāve'pi varte sādhusamāgame । ।65। ।
mokṣe hetu trikaṃ cāste jñānaṃ vivekajaṃ tathā ।
karmaṇāṃ cāpi sannyāso bhaktirvā paramātmanaḥ ।।66 ।।
mayā trikaṃ guroḥ prāptaṃ miśritaṃ yattu muktaye ।
karma bhaktyanvitaṃ sarvaṃ karomi ca vivekataḥ ।।67।।
yathā sannyāsinaḥ śreṣṭhā naiṣkarmyaṃ vai samāśritāḥ ।
tathā yame ca niyame kāme dveṣe parigrahe ।।68।।
māne daṃbhe ratau snehe naiṣkarmyaṃ prāptavānaham ।
yadi te mokṣagantāraḥ kathaṃ nā'haṃ tathāgatiḥ ।।6 9।।
parṇakuṭyāṃ vasatāṃ cenmokṣo jāyeta sarvathā ।
mahāsaudhe vasato me kathaṃ mokṣo na hastagaḥ ।।2.257.70 ।।
yasyārtho yena yenā'sti tattadālambate janaḥ ।
kaścid daṇḍaṃ ca mālāṃ ca kaścicchatraṃ ca cāmare ।।7 1 ।।
gārhasthye doṣamāvīkṣya gatvā tyāgāśrame yatiḥ ।
utsṛjan prathamān dharmān gṛhṇan parān yathocitān ।।72।।
saṃgahāneḥ saṃgamāpya sa mucyeta na saṃgataḥ ।
ādhipatyaṃ mama rājye teṣāṃ vanye hi tulyakam ।।73 ।।
yadi mucyeta vai bhikṣurnā'haṃ mucye kathaṃ vada ।
bhojanaṃ cāmbaraṃ pānaṃ nidrā'pekṣitasaṃgrahaḥ ।। 74।।
ādhipatyaṃ kvāpi yatra tulyaṃ vai bhikṣuṇā mama ।
te yadi muktibhāgā vai mamāpi muktireva ha ।।75।।
yadi te bandhabhāgā vai tadā tulyāḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ ।
atha jñānena mokṣo'sti vṛthā kāṣāyadhāraṇam ।।76।।
vṛthā veṣṭanasantyāgo vṛthā jaṭāpradhāraṇam ।
vṛthā svarṇāmbaratyāgo vṛthā'gnivastradhāraṇam ।।77।।
vṛthā pakvānnasadgrāsatyāgo bhikṣā vṛthā tataḥ ।
yadi jihveṣu satsveva jñānaṃ vai mokṣakāraṇam ।।78।।
āśramocitacihnāḍhyaṃ jñānaṃ me mokṣakāraṇam ।
yadvā duḥkhāni pāpāni vīkṣya tyāgāśrame matiḥ ।।79।।
tadā sukhāni puṇyāni vīkṣya gṛhāśrame samā ।
rāgadveṣaprayuktā vā pravṛttirbandhane samā ।।2.257.80।।
ākiñcanyaṃ vinā jñānaṃ kvāpyāśrame na vidyate ।
kaiṃcanyaṃ bandhanaṃ sarvāśrame tulyaṃ ca me'pi te ।।81 ।।
tasmāt kuśale! dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu sarvathā ।
bandhanāyataneṣveva sthitaṃ māṃ viddhyasaṃginam ।।82।।।
rājyaiśvaryaṃ dhruvaḥ pāśaḥ snehakarmādibandhanaḥ ।
mokṣadhārāvatā jñānā'sinā chinno mayā sati ।।83।।
jñānāt tyāge vicarāmi saṃgaṃ prāpnomi naiva ha ।
nā'haṃ rājye'pi rājeva nipatāmi ca baddhavat ।।84।।
jñānāgninā mayā dagdhā vāsanāgranthayastataḥ ।
deharājye vicarāmīndriyādibhiḥ kuṭumbibhiḥ ।।85।।
nirbandho'haṃ vicarāmi satāṃ samāgame sthitaḥ ।
mokṣe sthito'smi no bandhe no rājye'pi tu vai vane ।।86।।
so'hamevaṃ sadā muktastvayi jātādaraḥ sati ।
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kathaṃ muktā viruddharūpadhāriṇi! ।।87।।
saundaryaṃ kāñcanābhāḍhyaṃ saukumāryaṃ navaṃ vapuḥ ।
vayo'gryaṃ rūpasampannaṃ sarvāḍhyā tvaṃ kathaṃ satī ।।88।।
sādhvī cenna bhaved raktā sarāgā sādhvikā na vai ।
tavobhayaṃ nānurūpaṃ vīkṣya yogarddhimityapi ।।89।।
mukteyaṃ vā navetyevaṃ saṃśayitaḥ sabhājanaḥ ।
bhogarājasabhāvāḍhyā śṛṃgāratānasaṃyutā ।।2.257.90।।
kathaṃ tvaṃ yogasampannā sādhvīti saṃprakāśase ।
mama yogaṃ gatā ca tvaṃ sparśadoṣābhisaṃvṛtā ।।9 1 ।।
me hṛdo nigrahakartrī kathaṃ śāstrī hi yoginī ।
yastvāṃ rāṣṭre sabhāyāṃ me sampraveśitavān janaḥ ।।92।।
tatparigrahamāpannā śīlād bhraṣṭā vibhāvyase ।
punarmāṃ kṣatriyaṃ prāpya mā kṛthā varṇasaṃkaram ।।93।।
sādhvī tvaṃ mokṣadharmā'haṃ rājadharmā gṛhāśramī ।
āvayośca hṛdaurekye dvitīyo dharmasaṃkaraḥ ।।94।।
tasmāt svātantryamādāya vartase cet prayogiṇī ।
yoginyāstava dharmādiśrutaṃ viplavate'dhunā ।।95।।
bhāvena jetumicchā'sti jayāśā bandhanānvitā ।
baddhā tvaṃ matsamā nā'si na te hastaparigrahaḥ ।।96।।
yadvā matpakṣagān sarvān māṃ vijitya jitāniti ।
darśayituṃ bhavatyavaṣṭaṃbhaste tarhi mohinī ।।97।।
amarṣayuktā mohena mugdhā jetuṃ samicchasi ।
yogākhyaṃ ca viṣāktaṃ taccāmṛtaṃ tvayi saṃsthitam ।।98।।
icchatoryoga utkṛṣṭo'nicchatostu viṣopamaḥ ।
mā pradarśaya śraiṣṭhyaṃ svaṃ mukto vā na nṛpo hyayam ।।99।।
rājñāṃ balaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ strīṇāṃ rūpāḍhyayauvanam ।
balaṃ brahma hi muktānāṃ mā balaṃ me pradarśaya ।। 2.257.10 0।।
ārjavenā'bhigantavyā balinaḥ sukhadā hi te ।
anārjavena balino nāśayanti tathāgatam ।। 10 1।।
sā tvaṃ dhārṣṭyaṃ vihāyaiva jātiṃ kulaṃ śrutaṃ tapaḥ ।
vṛttiṃ bhāvaṃ sthitiṃ cecchāṃ kāryaṃ me tattvato vada ।। 1 02।।
lomaśa uvāca-
ityevaṃ bahubhirvākyairayuktairasamañjasaiḥ ।
ānartena nirādṛṣṭā kuśalā na bhayaṃ hyagāt ।। 103 ।।
aśvapāṭalaḥ sā sādhvī tato'pi cārudarśanā ।
cāruprajñā pracakrāmottarayituṃ tato'dhikam ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmātmano dehād viniṣkramaṇe hetupradarśanaṃ sanyastā'sannyastavicāre ānartanṛpakuśalāyoginī-
samvādaścetinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 257 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 257 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 258
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 259 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike lomaśaścāśvapāṭalaṃ ca tataḥ param ।
kuśalāyāḥ prativādaṃ prāha yathā'bhisaṃbhavam ।। 1 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca--
aśvapāṭala! kuśalā yogapāraṃ gatā satī ।
tattvajñānānaladagdhakaṣāyovāca tacchrṛṇu ।। 2 ।।
kuśalovāca--
śṛṇvānarta! bhavānāste tulādvayakṛtāspadaḥ ।
gārhasthyaṃ rakṣyase vākyairyogitvaṃ ca vitanyase ।। 3 ।।
kuśalāyāścā'kauśalyaṃ bodhayase pradūṣaṇaiḥ ।
kalmaṣaṃ cedṛśaṃ rājan mukte cāste kathaṃ tvayi । । 4 ।।
āptaṃ vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ vai yogyatādisamanvitam ।
śaktyopabṛṃhitaṃ jātisārūpyādisabhājitam ।। 5 ।।
jalpādidoṣaśūnyaṃ ca bhrāntikṣetrānna codgatam ।
lakṣaṇāśleṣabhāvādyaiḥ spaṣṭaṃ spaṣṭārthasaṃbhṛtam ।। 6 ।।
vākyaṃ tādṛkpramāṇaṃ me cānartaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ।
yathā piṣṭaṃ ca pāṣāṇo meghaśca dhūmramaṇḍalam ।। 7 ।।
saṃśliṣṭāni tathā''narta! saṃśliṣṭāḥ prāṇadhāriṇaḥ ।
śabdaḥ sparśo raso gandho rūpaṃ khavā''bbhūvahnayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
saṃśliṣṭāḥ piṣṭavad rājan śilāvatte tathā''tmani ।
vilīyante meghavacca viśīryante ca dhūmravat ।। 9 ।।
na svatvaṃ te vijānanti kathaṃ parapravedanam ।
manastaiḥ saha saṃyuktaṃ tadā bāhye'nuyanti ca ।। 2.258.10 । ।
codbhūtatvaṃ ca tatrāpi mahattvaṃ bāhyayogitā ।
ātmano yogitā cāpi grāhye bhavanti hetavaḥ ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ sarvatra bāhyānāṃ grahaṇe hetavaḥ khalu ।
manaḥ saṃkalpya madbhāvaṃ tato buddhirviniścayam । । 1 2।।
karotyevābhimānena mataṃ cātmani darpaṇe ।
nikṣipati tadātmā'yaṃ mamedamiti manyate ।। 13 ।।
vāsanā jāyate taiśca dṛṣṭamuktaiḥ smṛtipradā ।
avidyā ca tamo vāpi sauṣuptā'jñānamuttaram ।। 14।।
bhramātmakaṃ ca vā tatra smaraṇaṃ jāyate muhuḥ ।
tataḥ sukhāsukhe lābhālābhau priyā'priye'pi ca ।। 15 ।।
tatra kālo bhaveddhetuḥ prakṛtiśca prapūrikā ।
adṛṣṭaṃ yādṛśaṃ tādṛk phalaṃ sampadyate tataḥ ।। 16 ।।
caturviṃśatisaṃghātaścaiva vedanakāraṇam ।
avyaktāṃ na vijānāti jānāti vyaktarūpiṇīm ।। 17।।
sthūladarśī sa evokto mamāhaṃmiśritaḥ sa ca ।
avyaktāṃ yo vijānāti sa tvātmānaṃ prapaśyati ।। 18 ।।
adhyātmacintakaḥ so'yaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ prayāsyati ।
vyaktāḥ kalāḥ prākṛtā yāḥ sarve vayaṃ narāḥ striyaḥ ।। 1 9।।
bindugarbhāsanāḥ pūrve śukraśoṇitapiṇḍikāḥ ।
kalalāṃ daśarātreṇa budbudṃ peśikā tataḥ ।। 2.258.20 ।।
tataścāṃgāni jāyante nakharomāntakāni ca ।
navame māsi bālaśca strī vā purmoṃśca vetarat। ।। 21 ।।
liṃgādhīnāni nāmāni tataḥ kumāratādikam ।
sukumārāvayavānāṃ nāma kumārasaṃjñakam ।। 22।।
abuddhasyeva tasyaiva bāliśasya tu bālatā ।
yuvabhāvena kāmena yunaktīti yuvā mataḥ ।। 23 ।।
tiṣṭhaṃstiṣṭhan prayātyeva vīro bhūtvā sthavīrakaḥ ।
evaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe'nyeṣāṃ kalānāṃ ca vivartanāt । । 24।।
nāmarūpādibhedaśca sūkṣmo'yaṃ na vibhāvyate ।
nātyayo na prabhavaścaiteṣāṃ saṃlakṣyate nṛpa ।। 25 ।।
dīpārcivad dhāvato'sya sarvalokasya sarvadā ।
kaḥ ko'yaṃ vā kutaśceti kimarthaṃ kasya kena vā ।। 26 ।।
kuto no vā kathaṃ kasya kena vā neti kaḥ kimu ।
ityete khalu sambandhā bhūtānāṃ svāṃgakairapi ।। 27।।
naivaṃ parasparaṃ śaktyā jñātuṃ gatvaraśālinām ।
ādityāt kiraṇānyeva samidbhyo vahnayo yathā । । 28 ।।
jāyante kṣaṇikā ye vai śakyante naiva niścitum ।
tathā sarve prākṛtā vai jantavaḥ saṃhatātmanaḥ ।। 29 ।।
saṃghātarūpā jāyante mriyante ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
ātmā nityaḥ śāśvato'sti svastho'saṃghāta eva saḥ ।। 2.258.30 । ।
sa ced yogaṃ samāpanno vivekī muktavatsthitaḥ ।
paśyatyeva ca saṃghātaṃ gatvaraṃ śāśvataṃ nijam ।। 31 । ।
ātmanyevātmanā''tmānaṃ yadi tvaṃ svaṃ prapaśyasi ।
anātmānaṃ pṛthagbhāvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ cet prapaśyasi ।। 3 2।।
evamevā''tmanā''tmānaṃ parātmānaṃ samastagam ।
yuktayogābhilābhena śāśvataṃ cet prapaśyasi ।। 33 ।।
tathaivātmani cānyasmin samatāṃ ced vyavasyasi ।
atha māṃ kā'si kasyeti kimarthamanupṛcchasi ।। 34।।।
idaṃ me syādidaṃ neti dvandvairmuktasya te nṛpa ।
kā'si kasmāt kimarthaṃ vā vacanaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ।। 35।।
tathāpyanabhisandhāya pṛthagbhāvaṃ ca gatvaram ।
aikyaṃ dehena sandhāya praśne kā tvayi muktatā ।। 36 ।।
rājye śatrau ca mitre ca madhyasthe cājaye jaye ।
mamāhaṃvedini kṣatre tvayi kā nāma muktatā ।। 37 ।।
dharmārthakāmanāsakte phalasaṃgānuyāyinī ।
rājabhāvena garviṣṭhe kā nāma tvayi muktatā ।। 38 ।।
nare nāryāṃ surūpe ca kurūpe bhedalokini ।
dehabhāvena saṃvyāpte kā nāma tvayi muktatā ।। 39 ।।
dehadharmān puraskṛtya saṃgadoṣābhidhāyinī ।
prākṛtaṃ bhāvamāpanne kā nāma tvayi muktatā ।।2.258.40 ।।
yogena vartamāne'pi cāyogena viḍambine ।
prākṛtaṃ sparśamāpanne kā nāma tvayi muktatā ।।4 1 । ।
jñānasya śevadhistvaṃ vai bhāṣase māṃ striyaṃ kṛtim ।
matvā vīkṣya ca rājendra kā nāma tvayi muktatā ।। 42।।
prākṛte prākṛto bhāvaścetane cetano hi saḥ ।
yasya nāsti samaṃ cakṣuḥ kā tasmin muktatā tvayi ।। 43 ।।
kuśalo'yaṃ cetano'sti saṃghāte parivartite ।
rājan viddhi ca māṃ divyaṃ cetanaṃ saṃgavarjitam ।।44।।
kā kasya ca kutaḥ kena kimarthaṃ dehasaṃgatam ।
tadbhinno'haṃ bhavāmyeṣa paśyātmānaṃ narīsthitam ।। 45 ।।
draṣṭuṃ cecchakyase naivaṃ saṃghātā''vṛttimān bhavān ।
tadayuktasya te mokṣe'bhimatirniṣphalā nṛpa! ।।46 ।।
sādhubhiḥ sannivāryā sā hyapathyabhojinastava ।
yajjñātvā vartane nāsti jñāne nāsti tatastaram ।। 47।।
vyavahāre sutarāṃ nāstīti kiṃ yogajaṃ phalam ।
vṛthā śramo vṛthā mānaṃ vṛthā vāgdūṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।48 ।।
vṛthā satsaṃgayatnaśca yadi dehaṃ prapaśyasi ।
ātmā nārī naro nāpi napuṃsako na cāsti ca ।।49।।
tvaṃ tathā''sse ca ced rājan cekṣase na kathaṃ pare ।
prākṛtāni prasaṃvīkṣya pṛthakkṛtvā''tmatattvataḥ ।। 2.258.50 ।।
sarvatrā''tmānamāpaśyet kimanyanmuktalakṣaṇam ।
saṃgasthānāni sarvāṇi paśyet parātmani prabhau ।।5 1 ।।
ātmakrīḍa ātmaratirmuktasyaiva hi lakṣaṇam ।
mokṣe sthitasya saṃgāḍhyasthānānyapi ca me śṛṇu ।। 5 2 ।।
rājyād rāṣṭrasya sāmānyād rājadhānī hi bandhanam ।
tato'pi rājasaudhaśca sāmānyaṃ bandhanaṃ hi tat। ।। 53 ।।
tato'pi svagṛhaṃ tatra śayyā svīyā hi bandhanam ।
sā'pi cā'rdhā strīsahitā vinā striyaṃ na bandhanam ।। 54।।
tryapi kāmakriyāmātraṃ bandhanaṃ na tataḥ param ।
tatrāpi vāsanā cet syād bandhanaṃ saṃgamūlakam । ।5 5 ।।
dhātulābhe kāraṇaṃ ca bhojanaṃ cauṣadhādikam ।
bandhanaṃ vai tato rājñaḥ sevakādi ca bandhanam । । ।56 ।।
evaṃ stryādiprasaṃgena phalenāpīha yujyate ।
bhojanācchādanavastrābhūṣaṇeṣu ca bandhanam ।।57।।
nigrahānugrahau cāpi rājño bhavato bandhane ।
pāratantryaṃ sadā rājñaḥ svalpakārye'pi mānataḥ ।।58।।
bhṛtyavaśyatvamevāpi yuddhasandhiṣu sarvathā ।
strīṣu krīḍāvihāreṣu mantre cāmātyamaṇḍale ।।59।।
paroktādyanugāmitvaṃ kuto rājñaḥ svatantratā ।
mantrivaśe sthitaścāste neṣṭaṃ cāpyavaśaścaret ।। 2.258.60 ।।
nidrāṃ kāle na labhate vyāpṛtaḥ svārthibhirjanaiḥ ।
śayane'pi kvacit suptaścotthāpyate'ridūtakaiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
dāsībhiśca kvacinnityaṃ cājñāyāṃ kriyate vaśaḥ ।
uttiṣṭha snāhi saṃgṛhṇa piba prāśa bravīhi ca ।।6 2 ।।
śṛṇu cāgaccha ca paśya viramasva ramasva ca ।
ityevaṃ paratantro'yaṃ rājā saṃgavaśaḥ sadā । ।6 3 ।।
yācakāśca samāyānti dātuṃ notsahate'pi ca ।
dāne koṣakṣaye cintā vairaṃ cādānake bhavet । ।64।।
rakṣaṇe satataṃ cintā cintāsaṃgī nṛpaḥ sadā ।
rājā sarvān śaṃkate vai mṛtyubhayena noditaḥ ।। 65 ।।
parasparaṃ bhayavanto bhavanti nṛpatajjanāḥ ।
sarvaḥ sve sve gṛhe rājā sarvaḥ sve sve gṛhe gṛhī ।। 66 ।।
nigrahānugrahavantaḥ sarve tulyā gṛhe gṛhe ।
putrā dārā gṛhaṃ cātmā kośo mitrāṇi saṃcayāḥ ।। 6 7।।
sarveṣāṃ tulyabhāvāste saṃgadā bandhanāni vai ।
hato deśaśca grāmaśca dagdho vāho hato mama ।। 68 ।।
dhanaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca sasyāni dagdhāni ca himāgninā ।
pakṣibhirbhakṣitaṃ kṣetraṃ caurairhṛtāśca dhenavaḥ ।।69 ।।
rogairhataṃ bhojanaṃ me svatantratā hatā'ribhiḥ ।
vāgbāṇādyairdharṣito'haṃ copthāpito nṛpāsanāt ।।2.258.7 0 ।।
ityevaṃ saṃgabhāvaiśca mithyājñānairhi tapyate ।
niyantṛjanyaduḥkhaiśca mānasai rāgaroṣajaiḥ ।।7 1 ।।
rogā'vamānajanyaiśca duḥkhairvai paritapyate ।
amuktasaṃgaḥ satataṃ prasahya duḥkhabhogavān ।।72 ।।
tadalpasukhamatyarthaṃ bahuduḥkhamasāravat ।
taptāṃgārāsanaṃ rājyaṃ ko'bhipadyeta yogavit ।।73 ।।
mamedaṃ nagaraṃ rājyaṃ manyase dhanamuttamam ।
kastvaṃ kasya dhanaṃ rājyaṃ nagaraṃ vada cātmavit ।।74।।
pāñcabhautikadeho'yaṃ tava vahnau pravekṣyati ।
mamāpi ca tathā tatra tulyatā na viśeṣatā ।।75 ।।
dehasya saṃgadharmasyā'saṃgo nāsti kutaścana ।
ādhārādheyabhāvasya prākṛtasya kṣayārthinaḥ ।।76 ।।
cetanasya tvasaṃgasya nāsti saṃgaḥ kutaścana ।
ādhārādheyaśūnyasyā'prākṛtasya sadā sataḥ ।।77।।
vada rājan samarthā'haṃ jñāne vaktuṃ sahasradhā ।
strīdehe nābhiṣaṃgo me kutastava parigrahe ।।78।।
na strīṃ matvā saṃgabhāvaṃ vyaktaṃ vaktuṃ tvamarhasi ।
nanu nāma tvayā mokṣaḥ kṛtsnaḥ patnīvratācchrataḥ ।।79।।
asaṃgaścāpyapāśastvaṃ kathaṃ sakto'si rājyake ।
śrutaṃ te niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ dehabhāvena saṃjuṣaḥ ।।2.258.8 0 ।।
śrutaṃ vā nirgataṃ karṇāt śāṭhyamātreṇa vartase ।
yadvā naiva dhṛtaṃ vā pācitaṃ naiva tvayā''tmanā ।।8 1 ।।
yena tvaṃ tiṣṭhase saṃge laukike daihike'dhunā ।
baddhastvaṃ dṛśyase cātman prākṛto bhikṣuko yathā ।।82।।
mayā''tmanā praveśaśca kṛtastvayyātmani prabhau ।
kiṃ tavā'pakṛtaṃ tatra nityamuktasya me vada ।।8 3 ।।
sādhūnāṃ śūnyavāsitvaṃ niyamo'sti sadā nṛpa ।
śūnye praveśamāsādya mayā kiṃ te'tra dūṣitam ।।84।।
na bāhubhyāṃ na corubhyāṃ nāṃgaiḥ spṛśāmi sarvathā ।
mā vaktatyaṃ sabhāyāṃ vai tvayā mayā śubhāśubham ।। 85।।
strīpuṃsoḥ samavāyākhyaṃ sadasadvā kṛtaṃ mithaḥ ।
sādhavo guravaścaite tvaṃ ca rājā gurūttamaḥ ।।86।।
yogiṣu yogivādā vai na vaktavyāḥ kadācana ।
padmapatre jalaṃ tiṣṭhadasaṃgaṃ tiṣṭhate yathā ।।87।।
tathā tvayi nivatsyāmi niḥsaṃgena nijātmanā ।
yogivṛttyā nivatsyāmi cātmalābhādhisiddhaye ।।88 ।।
yatra vai sādhavo dhīrā yatayo yogapāragāḥ ।
parameśapadārūḍhāḥ samūrtā nivasanti vai । । 89 ।।
tatra vāsaṃ yogavṛttyā ka ātmā nā'bhivāñcchati ।
yadi tvayi mama vāse sparśaṃ jānāsi cennṛpa । । 2.258.90 ।।
jñānaṃ kṛtamabījaṃ te sarvaṃ vai vāgvibhūṣaṇam ।
sa gārhasthyāccyutastvaṃ vai muktisthitiṃ na vindasi ।। 91 ।।
ubhayorantarālastho bhavasīha viḍambakaḥ ।
nahi muktasya muktena jñasya jñena samāgame ।। 9 2।।
jāyate dharmasāṃkaryaṃ sadharmayorhi yojanam ।
sattvena sattvayogaścātmanā yogastathātmanaḥ ।। 93।।
yoginā yogino yogastatra saṃkaratā na vai ।
brahmajñastvaṃ tathā rājan brahmajñā'haṃ savarṇikā ।। 94।।
āvayormelane naiva varṇasaṃkaratā matā ।
brahmaputrīdehavāँśca brahmā vai somanāthake ।। 95।।
somanāthapratiṣṭhārthaṃ cāhūtaḥ śaśinā purā ।
tadā yajñe samutpannā mānasī kuśalā kriyā ।। 96।।
satīrūpā'hamevāsmi kriyākhyā kuśalābhidhā ।
kraturyajñastasya patnī dehabhāvena cedṛśī ।। 97।।
ātmabhāvena sādhvī ca yogapāraṃgatā'smi ca ।
tasmād rājan bhavāmyatra cātmā nāsmi narī vidhā ।। 98 ।।
nātrā'sti saṃkaraḥ kaścit samabhāvāgame punaḥ ।
mokṣe te bhāvitāṃ buddhiṃ śrutvā ca kuśalaiṣiṇī ।। 99।।
kuśalā tava mokṣasya jijñāsārthamihā''gatā ।
saurāṣṭre'trā'kṣare kṣetre cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।। 2.258.100 ।।
kṛtasthānā kuṃkumākhyavāpyāstīre vasāmi ca ।
ekarātriṃ śarīre te sthitvā yāsyāmi matsthalīm ।। 101 ।।
nā'haṃ lubdhe ciraṃ rājan tiṣṭhāmi brahmayoginī ।
ātithyenā''tmabhāvena mānitā jñānabhojanaiḥ ।। 10 re।।
aprāpya tulyayogasthaṃ śvo gamiṣyāmi matsthalīm ।
yatra tulyagatiścāste lomaśo yogavittamaḥ ।। 102 ।।
svīyaprakāśo bhagavānātmavittama ityapi ।
tatraikībhūya kuśalā brahmānandaṃ vahāmi vai ।। 1 04।।
rājan dhṛtaṃ mayā rūpaṃ kiyadyogabalāṃ sabhām ।
vīkṣituṃ vīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ yatrā'gryo dehadarśanaḥ ।। 105 ।।
ime stabdhā hi munayo dehadarśanayoginaḥ ।
kimahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi mā stabdho bhava bhūpate ।। 106 ।।
naivaṃ cātmabalaṃ rājan vardhate dehadarśinām ।
nātmalābho bhaveccāpi sadṛśānāṃ vihāriṇām ।। 1 07।।
na gārhasthyād bhavenmuktiścātmarūpo na yāvatā ।
vartate muktasaṃgo vai tāvatsaṃsāralagnatā ।। 108 ।।
ānarta! mā ruṣaṃ dhehi tathyaṃ bhakṣaya pācaya ।
yogeśvaratāsiddhyarthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro vraja ।। 10 9।।
svīyaprakāśaṃ yogīndraṃ lomaśaṃ yogisadgurum ।
santuṣṭāṃ yoginīṃ devīṃ saṃbhajasvā'cyuto bhava ।। 2.258.110 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
ityevaṃ vadamānāṃ tāṃ tvānarto bhūpatistadā ।
neme vāsārhahṛdayaṃ dadau tatra samādhinā ।। 111 ।।
saṃvādaṃ cātmanostatra cāprātaścakraturhyubhau ।
ṛṣayo jñātabhāvāśca svasvasthānaṃ yayustataḥ ।। 11 2।।
aśvapāṭala! cānarto jñātvā naijāṃ hi nimnatām ।
kuśalātaḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ viveda sahayoginaḥ ।। 113 ।।
tatastayā samaṃ prāyādaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
yatra pūrṇaṃ yogabalaṃ hyavāpya lomaśānmuneḥ ।। 11 4।।
svasya prakāśādātmīyaṃ bodhaṃ prāpya mahottamam ।
santuṣṭāyoginītaśca brāhmīṃ sthitiṃ praśikṣya ca ।। 1 15।।
ānartaḥ prayayau naijaṃ camatkārapuraṃ prati ।
tasmād rājan gṛhasthānāṃ tyāgitvaṃ samapekṣate ।। 1 16।।
yadvā tyāgavatāṃ yogānmokṣo hastagato bhavet ।
sādhūnāṃ saṃgamāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo miled dhruvam ।। 1 17।।
apūrṇasyāpi pūrṇatvaṃ sarvayatne samāpyate ।
asannyastā gṛhasthā vai sannyastā guruyogataḥ ।। 1 18।।
prajāyanta kuśalāyā yogenā''nartako yathā ।
tādṛśānāṃ satāṃ yogād gṛhasthāḥ paramāṃ gatim ।। 11 9।।
prayāntyeva na sandeho māyālubdhā api dhruvam ।
ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo maunamāvahat ।। 2.258.120 ।।
aśvapāṭalarājā'pi śrutvā tṛptiṃ jagāma ha ।
tattīrthaṃ kuśalātīrthaṃ cānartatīrthamityapi ।। 121 ।।
yogitīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarojale pravidyate ।
yatsnānād yadvāripānādātmadarśanamṛcchati ।। 1 22। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyām ānartarājena saha brahmaputrīkuśalāsādhvyā vivādo gārhasthye'pi tyāgāt sādhusamāgamādvā mukti-
rityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 258 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 258 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 259
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 260 →


śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
samākarṇaya rādhe tvaṃ tataścāśvanṛpaḥ punaḥ ।
papraccha lomaśaṃ yat tat pravadāmi satāṃ hitam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro! svīyaprakāśasya nirvedaḥ śāśvatāśrayaḥ ।
kathaṃ vyajāyata tattvaniścayaścākṛterhareḥ ।। ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
brahmakallolasaṃjñasya pūrvakalpatapasvinaḥ ।
bhaktaviprasya putro'bhūnnāmnā trivikramaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
śrīhareravatāraḥ sa punaḥ kalpāntare hariḥ ।
trivikramo babhūvā'yaṃ prabaleḥ rājyahṛt tadā ।। 4 ।।
so'yaṃ svarṇanadītīre dadarśā'mānavaṃ naram ।
akasmād hṛdaye yoge nārāyaṇahradasthale ।। 5 ।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlaśarānvitam ।
dhvajasvastikavajrādicihnadakṣakarānvitam ।। 6 ।।
hasantaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ prasannaṃ dīrghanetrakam ।
ājānubhujamatyarthaṃ cojjvalaṃ śrīsamanvitam ।। 7।।
svīyaprakāśo bhagavān svaṃ dadarśa tadantare ।
brahmarūpaṃ vāmanaṃ trivikramaṃ prabalergurum ।। 8 ।।
nijāṃ mūrtiṃ vilokyaiva śrīmannārāyaṇe tadā ।
kṣaṇaṃ mumoha sahasā ko'yaṃ pṛthaṅ vyacintayam ।। 9 ।।
tato divyadṛśā naijaṃ mūlaṃ rūpaṃ bubodha saḥ ।
tuṣṭāva śrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ svāminaṃ parameśvaram ।। 2.259.10 ।।
antarātman parātmaँstvaṃ sarvāvatāradhāraka ।
sarvāvirbhāvahetustvaṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye sthitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
sarvaṃ te hṛdaye cāste brahmā'brahmamayaṃ vapuḥ ।
ahaṃ pṛthaṅnivāso'smi cā'pṛthaṅavāsavāँstvayi ।। 1 2।।
tvameva paramaṃ tattvaṃ kṛpayā me'kṣi gocaraḥ ।
gocare mama rūpaṃ cā'parokṣānubhavāñcitam ।। 13 ।।
ātmadarśanamāsādya paramātmapradarśanam ।
ubhadarśanamāsādya kṛtakṛtyo'dya saṃvṛtaḥ ।। 14।।
ājñāṃ dehi kṛpāsindho jagadbandho janārdana ।
prāpya tvāṃ paramātmānaṃ prāptavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।। 15।।
kṛtvā tvadyogamudyānaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।
iti stutaḥ prabhuḥ śrīśo'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 16 ।।
svīyaprakāśamūrtau taṃ nijasthāyāṃ tato'dhikam ।
sarvaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca darśayāmāsa caikyataḥ ।। 17।।
īśvarān brahmapuruṣān muktān dhāmānyanekaśaḥ ।
devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇān deveśvarāँśca mānavān ।। 18।।
uragān rākṣasān daityān dānavānāsurānapi ।
paśūn pakṣiṇa evāpi sthāvarān jaḍacetanān ।। 1 9।।
mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi tattvāni prakṛtiṃ sthirām ।
vikārān dehabhājaśca darśayāmāsa tallayān ।। 2.259.20 ।।
evaṃ pradarśayitvaiva tirobhāvaṃ cakāra ha ।
tadidaṃ cā'parokṣaṃ ca jñānaṃ śāśvatamātmagam ।। 21 ।।
prakāśayitvā tasmai vai hṛdaye'sthāpayad dhruvam ।
varadānaṃ dadau tasmai nityaṃ te'stu prabhāmayam ।। 22।।
jñānaṃ cedaṃ svataḥprakāśākhyaṃ māstu tirogatam ।
tataḥ ārabhya devo'yaṃ trivikramaḥ svataḥprabhaḥ ।।23 ।।
svataḥprakāśayogī ca khyāto babhūva yogiṣu ।
sa cārthayat vilokyaiva kṣetraṃ cākṣarasaṃjñakam ।।24।।
hṛdye harivāsāḍhyaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaronvitam ।
nijavāsārthamatyarthaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ tathāvidham ।। 25।।
tathāstviti prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca tatkṣaṇam ।
divyadeho'bhavattatra caturbhujo narāyaṇaḥ ।।26।।।
mānasaḥ śrīhareḥ śiṣyo nityajñānāśrayaḥ sutaḥ ।
nārāyaṇahrade tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।।27।।।
sākaṃ snātvā tatastūrṇaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthalīm ।
prāpa yogena vegena balena kṛpayā hareḥ ।। 28।।
evaṃ janmāntaraṃ dehāntaraṃ vṛttyantaraṃ tathā ।
kāyākalpaṃ hyavāpāsau putratvaṃ muktasaṃjñayā ।। 29।।
avatārasvarūpeṇa viṣṇurūpeṇa sarvadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamānasajākṛtim ।। 2.259.30 ।।
divyāmavāpya satataṃ jātamātro narāyaṇaḥ ।
dharmavairāgyasampanno bhaktaḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ ।। 31 ।।
babhūva kuṃkume kṣetre prabhuḥ kuṃkumavarṇakaḥ ।
naisargaśevadhiḥ sarvavidyānāṃ sa babhūva ha ।।32।।
sārvajñyāśraya evāpi sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ।
sarvakalyāṇakartā'sau yogidharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।33।।।
sarvātirekakāryaśca sarvātirekavarṇanaḥ ।
vicacārā'kṣare kṣetre tasmai kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।34।।
anvaśāt sakalān dharmān gurupūrvīprasiddhaye ।
laukikān vaidikāँścāpi mānasāँśca taduttarān ।।35।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa uvāca-
putra tvaṃ sāttvatān dharmān niṣevasva hitāvahān ।
prāṇaṃ jaya sahasvā'pi kṣutpipāse himātapau ।।26।।
jitvendriyāṇi tapasā satyaṃ damaṃ prapālaya ।
adrohamanasūyāṃ cā''rjavaṃ śīlaṃ prapālaya ।।37।।
devapitratithiprāptaśeṣānnayātrikāṃ hava ।
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ pareśaṃ māṃ mā svapihi tamomaye ।।38।।
phenabudbudavatsthairye cetanāśritagatvare ।
ākasmike'jñavatputra mā viśvāsaṃ vidhehi vai ।। 39।।
apramattā vinidrāśca nityayatnā hi śatravaḥ ।
chidraṃ paśyanti dehe'smin mā tvaṃ tairdharṣito bhava ।।2.259.40 ।।
divasāḥ kramaśo yānti kṛntanti vai janāyuṣam ।
jīvanaṃ kṣīyate nityaṃ guruṃ śaraṇamāvraja ।।41।।
ajñāścecchanti dehādyairmāṃsaśoṇitavardhanam ।
yadante gatvaraṃ sarvaṃ prasuptā mokṣasādhane ।।।42।।
mā tanmātreṇa putra tvaṃ prayāhi prākṛto yathā ।
prāntaduḥkhaikamātreṇa yāmyabhavanavāhinā ।।43 ।।
yāhi satāṃ vṛṣasthānāṃ yogināṃ ca mahātmanām ।
dharmyaṃ panthānamevāptaṃ mokṣadaṃ cākṣarāntagam ।।44।।
upāsasva tataḥ samyak pṛccha dhāraya tadvacaḥ ।
manomanthaṃ sanniyaccha sthairyamāvaha satpatau ।।45।।
dharmaṃ niḥśreṇikāṃ dhṛtvā cāruhya bhaktibhūmikām ।
ātmaniṣṭhāpravegeṇa yāhi dhāma sanātanam ।। 46।।
vāmataḥ kuru viprendra nāstikān bhaktivarjitān ।
āśāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ruṣaṃ mohaṃ tyaja putra ca dūrataḥ ।।47।।
nāvaṃ yogaṃ samālambya tara saṃsāravāridhim ।
loko'yaṃ mṛtyunā nīto jarayā mardito'bhitaḥ ।।48।।
vahatyeva vaitaraṇyāṃ jñānapotena taṃ tara ।
tiṣṭhantaṃ vā vahantaṃ vā pibantaṃ śayane gatam ।।49 ।।
mṛtyuranvīkṣate martyaṃ mā tvaṃ tatkarago bhava ।
sañcinvānaṃ sukhārthāṃścā'tṛptaṃ lubdhaṃ ca māninam ।।2.259.50 ।।
anirvṛttaṃ vighnamardyaṃ garviṣṭhaṃ ca vimārgagam ।
ākasmikagatirmṛtyuḥ suptamādāya gacchati ।।5 1 ।।
andhakāramayaḥ koṣṭho brahmāṇḍodaranāmakaḥ ।
tadbahirgamanārthaṃ tvaṃ dīpaṃ jñānaṃ pradhāraya ।।52 ।।
anekadehacakreṣu gacchatsu niṣphaleṣu vai ।
divyapūṇyena brāhmaṇyaṃ prāptaṃ brahmamayaṃ vaha ।।53 ।।
brahmadeho mahān śreyān kṣudrakāmāya nocitaḥ ।
mokṣāya dharmalābhāya tapase śreyase mataḥ ।।54।।
amūlyastādṛśo maṇiścintitārthaphalapradaḥ ।
helanīyo na nirmūlyaḥ kṣudrā kapardikā yathā ।।5 5 ।।
gūhate mukhamupariṣṭādantare kāmasaṃbhṛtā ।
lajjāṃ pradarśayatyasmai bhoktre parajanāntike ।।56 ।।
antarviṣāmṛtavyāptā bandhayituṃ ca tatparā ।
yatate nijalābhārthaṃ bhuktvā duḥkhākaroti ca ।। 57।।
tyajantaṃ na tyajatyeṣā yāti sthānāntaraṃ saha ।
tiraskṛtā'pi saṃlagnā vāsanāmūlabandhanā ।।58।।
nirayākhyā svasaudheṣu vāsayatyatithiṃ ciram ।
pramattaṃ madapānena paśya māyāviceṣṭitam ।।59 ।।
ko nu tatra bhaved baddho rakto vā divyanetrakaḥ ।
supātratāṃ dehasaṃlagnāṃ mā'nuprasara karhicit ।।2.259.6 0 ।।
dehaḥ karmāvanaddhaśca punaḥ karmābhisarjakaḥ ।
kāmanāśevadhiḥ kopo mā taṃ naijaṃ niśāmaya ।।2 1 ।।
yatra rājabhayaṃ cāste yatra caurabhayaṃ tathā ।
tadvihāya dhanaṃ divyaṃ pātheyaṃ cārjayasva ha ।।62।।
paratra jīvyate yena na ca kāpi viyujyate ।
dhruvaṃ tadakṣaraṃ dravyaṃ samarjayasva putraka ।।6 3 ।।
mātā pitā suhṛd bandhuḥ saṃkare nānuyānti hi ।
karmaikaṃ kevalaṃ yāti naiṣkarmyaṃ tatsamācara ।।64।।
hiraṇyasañcayā rājyaṃ dāsā dāsyaḥ prajāḥ priyāḥ ।
dehakṣaye nivartante prabhuṃ sahacaraṃ bhaja ।।65।।
sākṣiṇaṃ cāntarasthaṃ vai brahmānandapradaṃ prabhum ।
uddhārakaṃ modanidhiṃ parameśaṃ sadā bhaja ।।66।।
gṛhasthadharmiṇo lokāḥ prajāpaterbṛhaspateḥ ।
śatakratośca lokān saṃvrajanti tvāntanāśinaḥ ।।67।।
mā tvaṃ vṛttiṃ samādhatsva gārhasthye brahmaputraka ।
nirbhayaṃ ca nirantaṃ ca nidhiṃ brahmavrataṃ vaha ।।68।।
asaṃgo divyadṛṣṭistvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sannidhiṃ kuru ।
samarpya parame kṛṣṇe mayi karma samastakam ।।69।।
nairguṇyaṃ paramaṃ bhuñjan bhava mukto'kṣare yathā ।
grāmavāso bandhanaṃ vai tacchittvā vanamāviśa ।।2.259.70।।
kiṃ te dhanena suhṛdā bandhunā ca sutena ca ।
svataḥprakāśo bhūtvaiva svīyaṃ prakāśaṃ saṃbhaja ।।7 1 ।।
mriyamāṇān samānāँśca vilokya jagati sthitān ।
mariṣyataśca sañcintyā'nvicchā''tmānaṃ guhāgatam ।।72।।
śubhraṃ śīghraṃ prakurvīta śvaḥ kāryaṃ cādya vai drutam ।
kṣaṇāntare na jāne yanmṛtyurādāya yāsyati ।।73 ।।
mṛtyuśikhe hi saṃsāre mahākālasya bhakṣaṇe ।
gurvāśraye vivekī san mokṣaṃ sarvātmanā vraja ।।74।।
maraṇaṃ cātmano mokṣastameva sādhaya pradhe ।
vidvān mokṣārjanaparastaddhīno jaḍavargagaḥ ।।75।।
svargasopānakaṃ varṣma mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ tviha ।
tena sādhaya mokṣoyaṃ cānantaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ।।76।।
yasya matirmokṣamārgādanyatra naiva dhāvati ।
sa eva puṇyakarmā'sti cāśocyaḥ sarvamānavaiḥ ।।77।।
mokṣārthaṃ yanmatiḥ śuddhā dṛḍhā cārabdhatatkṛtiḥ ।
anyabhāvādiriktā ca na tasya kālato bhayam ।।78।।
hatasya puṇyapāpaiśca lubdhasya viṣayātmanaḥ ।
snehasambandhamagnasya vidyate kālato bhayam ।।79।।
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradārā'yutāni ca ।
atītāni gate kāle kasya te kasya cā'pyayam ।।2.259.80।।
eko'haṃ tvātmasaṃjño'smi tvaṃ cātmā caikalaḥ svayam ।
anye'nyatra gatāḥ santi paśyantyete na vai mithaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
na teṣāṃ bhavatāṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ tava tairiha ।
svakarmabhirgatānyeva tvaṃ svakṛtyairgamiṣyasi ।।82।।
loko'yaṃ svārthabahulaḥ svārthasnigdhaḥ svayogakṛt ।
svārthaṃ prasādhya sahasā tyajanti nirguṇaṃ janam ।।83।।
samṛddhānāṃ dhanināṃ hi vijanaḥ svajanāyate ।
daridrāṇāṃ nirdhanānāṃ svajano vijanāyate ।।84।।
kalatrayogamāsādya jano'śubhaṃ cinoti ca ।
tataḥ kleśabhṛtaṃ janma punarduḥkhaṃ punarjanim ।।85।।
evamāvartamagnasya vāsanāpreritasya ca ।
madhyasāgarabhāgādvai tīrayānaṃ na jāyate ।।86।।
tatputra dharmamāsādya vairāgyasahacāravān ।
jñānadīpātinetraśca bhaktyā yāhi paraṃ padam ।।87।।
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kaṭāhe mohasaṃjñite ।
sūryāgninā divākāṣṭhairmāsartudarvikādibhiḥ ।।88।।
nātra trātāramīkṣe'hamīkṣase tvaṃ na netaraḥ ।
na taṃ paśyāmi yasyā'haṃ na taṃ paśyāmi yo mama ।।89।।
tasmāt sadā pareśaṃ śrīpatiṃ śrīparameśvaram ।
karmabhūmau bhajasvātra yena dhāmā'kṣaraṃ vrajeḥ ।। 2.259.90।।
kiṃ janmanā ca dehena jñānena ca vṛṣeṇa ca ।
tapasā vanavāsena yena mokṣo bhavenna cet ।।9 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala ityuktaḥ svataḥprakāśa eva ha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇoktaṃ cāvadhārya ca ।।92।।
dadhau mokṣe mano nityaṃ brahmacarye vasan sadā ।
kvacid dṛśyaḥ kvaciccā'pyadṛśyo'vartata vai kṣitau ।। 93।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre divyadeho'tibhāsuraḥ ।
cirañjīvo mahāmuktaścātimānavavartanaḥ ।।94।।
sarvasaṃgaviyuktaśca brahmasaṃgamupāgataḥ ।
dvedhā bhūtvaikadehena yayāvakṣaramuttamam ।। 95।।
apareṇa sadā cāste kṣetre'trā'kṣarasaṃjñake ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhāvaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 96।।
sarvavidyāśrayo bhaktyācāryo jñānanidhiḥ prabhuḥ ।
caturbhujo dvibhujo vā yatheṣṭānandaśevadhiḥ ।। 97।।
rājaṃstattvaṃ mama yogājjñānamāsādya satvaram ।
bhajainaṃ paramātmānaṃ divyadeho bhavā'tra ca ।।98।।

vartate divyatādātṛ snānapānādibhirnṛpa ।।99।।
etajjñānaṃ samāsādya muktatā syānna saṃśayaḥ।
sarvavidyāprakāśaśca bhavedātmaprakāśitā ।। 2.259.100 ।।
devaprakāśitā syācca ciccaitanyaprakāśitā ।
putra jñānena yannaiva dharmeṇa tapasā'pi ca ।। 101 ।।
prāpyate tallabhyate vai guroḥ prasādaleśataḥ ।
ityuktvā rādhike śrīmān lomaśo virarāma ha ।। 102।।
atha rājātisantṛpto hariṃ sve hṛdi saṃsmaran ।
kṛtānāṃ phalaviṣaye papraccha svādakarṣitaḥ ।। 10 3।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ brahmakallolātmajasyā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopadeśajanyapāvanādhyayanaṃ mokṣasthitiśceti nava-
pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 259 ।।

anye'pi mānavādyāśca yajñamārge'dhikāriṇaḥ ।
gacchadhvaṃ svānadhikārān vartayadhvaṃ mahāmakhān ।। 1 04।।
pravartantāṃ kriyāyajñāḥ prādiśyata vidhīṃstathā ।
idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate ।। 1 05।।
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ pravartate'tra daivikaḥ ।
ityuktvā brahmaṇe kṛṣṇo naijaṃ rūpamadarśayat ।। 106 ।।
hayagrīvasvarūpaṃ vai vedānāvartayat śubham ।
pariṣvajyā''ha ca brahman bhāraṃ tvayi kṣipāmyaham ।। 1 07।।
asahye surakārye'haṃ jñānadaste muhurmuhuḥ ।
prāvirbhāvaṃ gamiṣyāmītyuktvā cāntaradhīyata ।। 1 08।।
hayagrīvamahātīrthaṃ tat sarasi vyajāyata ।
tatra snānājjalapānād vedavijñānavān bhavet ।। 10 9।।
brahmā jagāma svalokaṃ devā jagmurdivādikam ।
evaṃ rājan hariryajñe'graharaḥ samajāyata ।। 2.260.110 ।।
devabhāgān dadau cāpi pravṛttiṃ ca nivartanam ।
naiṣkarmyaṃ baladaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ cakāra vai tadā ।। 111 ।।
eṣa eva parabrahmā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
kathitaste jagatāṃ me mokṣadaḥ kambharāsutaḥ ।। 1 12।।
kriyatāṃ madvaco rājan sevyatāṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
gīyatāṃ satataṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyatāṃ cāntare sthitaḥ ।। 113।।
gamyatāṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma bhujyatāṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ।
ityupādiśya ca rādhe lomaśo virarāma ha ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ yogino'pi datteṣṭaguruśuśrūṣādiphalāvāptiryajñe harerdevatānāṃ ca bhāgādyutpattirityādinirūpaṇa-
nāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 260 ।।
