śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścādāśvapaṭṭalabhūpatiḥ ।
pratyakṣaśrīharerbodhaṃ papraccha munaye tadā ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
mune yo'yamanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
pratyakṣo bhagavānāste tadbodhaṃ kāraya prabho ।। 2 ।।
tannāmnā bhajanaṃ kurve sārthamāno yathā'nvaham ।
śādhi sarvārthasampannaṃ bodhaṃ māṃ pārameśvaram ।। 3 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
rājannaikāntikā bhaktā vidvāṃso vedapāragāḥ ।
niruktāni harernāmnāṃ jānanti netare janāḥ ।। 4 ।।
yato hyekāntinaḥ śreṣṭhā ye caivā'nanyadevatāḥ ।
tadātmānastatparāstacchīlāstatsahakriyāḥ ।। 5 ।।
kadā kutra kathaṃ nāma kena jātaṃ vidanti te ।
pragṛṇanti tato bhaktāḥ pūrvaṃ prakāśitaṃ ca taiḥ ।। 6 ।।
ādirjanmodbhavaścāpi dehendriyādiyojanam ।
prāgvisargaḥ paścasarge yanmūrtau naiva vidyate ।। 7 ।।
kālo'kṣaraṃ yadādau na yasmin kvacid vilīyate ।
sarveṣāṃ svetareṣāṃ sa ādireva paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 8 ।।
nānyadādi hyabhūd yasya tasmādanādireva saḥ ।
nityaśrīḥ śrayati yaṃ ca divyaśobhottamottamā ।। 9 ।।
divyaveṣaśca racanā vāṇī sampadvibhūtikā ।
aiśvaryāṇi guṇāḥ sarve śrīpadā yatra santi ha ।। 2.261.10 ।।
tasmācchrīḥ sa śrītādātmyād ramālakṣmyādisaṃśrayaḥ ।
śrīmān sa eva bhagavān prokto vai parameśvaraḥ ।। 11 ।।
narāṇāmātmanāṃ yo'yamayanaṃ vai cirantanam ।
nārāḥ sarvā divyarūpā_ śaktayastannivāsanam ।। 12।।
arā māyā ca dāridryaṃ nāsti yatra hi muktigāḥ ।
muktā narāstannivāso nārāyaṇaḥ sa vai mataḥ ।। 13 ।।
karṣatyeva jagatsarvaṃ sarvāḥ sṛṣṭistanau kvacit ।
nayatyeva layaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇastena prakīrtitaḥ ।। 14।।
kṛṣiḥ kalmaṣanāśaśca naśca nirvṛttirucyate ।
tādṛśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa evā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।।
kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ yacca kaṃ vā brahmaparaṃ prabhum ।
bibharti yā nije garbhe kaṃbharā hṛdaye ca vā ।। 16 ।।
kaṃbharāyāḥ sutaścātra kāṃbhareyo harirhi saḥ ।
gāḥ kiraṇāni kṛṣṇasya pālayatyeva yaḥ svayam ।। 17।।
gāśca dhenūḥ pṛthivīṃ gāṃ gatiṃ divyāṃ ca rakṣati ।
gopālaśca pitā tasya nando gopālanandanaḥ ।। 18।।
purāṇi ca śarīrāṇi cetanāni jaḍāni ca ।
upatyeva ca teṣu śrīharirvai puruṣottamaḥ ।। 19 ।।
bṛhatvādvyāpakatvācca paratvād brahma yaḥ paraḥ ।
parabrahma hariścaiva sa eva bhagavān svayam ।।2.261.20 ।।
paramāṇi samagrāṇyaiśvaryāṇi santi tatra ca ।
parameśvara evā'sau pareśvara_ prasiddhyati ।। 21 ।।
kṣaraṃ māyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tatparaṃ dhāma cākṣaram ।
tadatīto hariḥ so'yamakṣarātīta ucyate ।।22।।
avatārā harerevāvirbhavanti samastataḥ ।
avatārī svayaṃ teṣāṃ mūlaṃ śrīharirucyate ।।23।।
hariścāyaṃ haratyeva bhaktānāṃ mānasāni vai ।
haratyeva ca duḥkhāni hariścāyaṃ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 24।।
haraḥ saṃkarṣaṇaścāsājjāyate kāryakṛtprabhuḥ ।
harī tena tathoktaścaiśvaryavān bhagavānapi ।। 25।।
vasatyayaṃ samasteṣu dīvyatyevāntarasthitaḥ ।
vāsudevaḥ sa vai proktaḥ parameśaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 26।।
prakṛtiryasya vāñcchā'sti śaktiḥ śālo'pi vai tathā ।
māyā yā prakṛtistasya dhavo mādhava eva saḥ ।।27।।
kālātmā'pi prabhuḥ proktaḥ sarvasarjanaśaktimān ।
viśanti sṛṣṭayo yatra yasmādvā viṣṇureva saḥ ।। 28।।
veveṣṭi vyāpnoti caiṣo vyāpako viṣṇurucyate ।
damanena janā ūrdhvamṛcchanti dhāma me param ।।29।।
tena dāmodaraḥ kṛṣṇo dāne mode ramatyayam ।
keśāstadaṃśavaḥ proktāstadvān kṛṣṇo hi keśavaḥ ।।2.261.3 0 ।।
agniḥ somo mama rūpe mukhaṃ rasaśca tāvubhau ।
agniṣṭomastato nāma nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kratuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
agniḥ kṣatraṃ dvijaḥ somastayoraikyaṃ haro hariḥ ।
agnirnārī naraḥ somaścāgniṣṭomo narāyaṇaḥ ।। 32।।
naṣṭāṃ gāṃ pṛthivīṃ cāyamavindacca purā tataḥ ।
govinda iti vikhyāto gopālo goprapālanāt ।।33 ।।
hṛṣīkānīndriyāṇyeṣa īśate sa haristataḥ ।
hṛṣīkeśaḥ samabhavat hṛṣīkā tapasāṃ sthale ।।34।।
adhaḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ sarvaṃ paśyatyadhokṣajastataḥ ।
vṛṣodharmastannivāsaḥ kapirvārāharūpyayam ।।35 ।।
ramante yoginastatra rāmo ramaṇavān prabhuḥ ।
guṇakarmānuyogena nāmnāmasyāstyanantakam ।।36।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmaparaṃ bhaja ।
bālarūpaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kuṃkumavāpikā'kṣare ।।37।।
kṣetre virājate yastaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ sadā bhaja ।
bā-māyā layametyatra kṛṣṇe'to bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।38।।
bālānajñānasaṃvyāptān janānādiśya satpatham ।
karṣatyakṣaradhāmakṣmāṃ paraṃ sukhaṃ dadāti ca ।।3 9।।
bālakṛṣṇo harikṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo brahmapriyāpatiḥ ।।2.261.40।।
satāṃ patirmuktapatiḥ sarvapatirjanārdanaḥ ।
bhaktapatirnijapatiḥ sevyatāṃ prāpyatāṃ nṛpa ।।41 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
aho jñānamaho bodhaścāho'mṛtaṃ rasāyanam ।
pāyitaṃ me muro'jasraṃ divyaṃ divyavimuktidam ।।42।।
taponidhe tvayoktaṃ me nārāyaṇakathāmṛtam ।
īdṛśo bhagavān mahyaṃ darśito bodhito'ntare ।।43 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānnibhālitaḥ ।
agniṣomātmakaḥ so'yaṃ bhagavāँstarpito mayā ।।44।।
prasāditastathā sākṣāt samāsādita eva saḥ ।
na tato'sti paraḥ kaścinna tatsamo'sti vetaraḥ ।।45।।
tatkathātulyamākhyānaṃ nānyat sṛṣṭitraye'pi vai ।
vidyate phaladaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ param ।।46।।
na cātrā'lpa mama puṇyaṃ vardhitaṃ bhavatā bahu ।
kuṃkumakṣmāṃ samāsādya yenā'haṃ dṛṣṭavān harim ।। 47।।
ityevaṃ rādhike matvā kṛtakṛtyaṃ nija nṛpaḥ ।
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau lomaśaṃ svaguruṃ prati ।।48।।
lomaśastaṃ tadā prāha harṣāśrupulakāṃcitam ।
dhanyo'styanugṛhīto'sti yadbhavān dṛṣṭavān harim ।।49 ।।
adṛśyadarśane tatra taddayaiva hi kāraṇam ।
avatārī hi bhagavān durdarśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।2.261.50।।
nā'sya bhaktāt priyataro lokaṃ kaścana vidyate ।
tataḥ svayaṃ darśitavān svamātmānaṃ nṛpottama ।।5 1 ।।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate rājan kṣamā yā vai kṣitau sthitā ।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate raso yenā''po rasasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।52।।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate rūpaṃ yenā'rkādyāḥ surūpiṇaḥ ।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate sparśo yena prāṇāḥ suyoginaḥ ।।।53।।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate śabdo yena lokā gṛṇanti ca ।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate manaḥ prakāśaguṇadhārakam ।।।54।।
tasmāduttiṣṭhate buddhistattvanirṇayakāriṇī ।
buddhyā viditvā taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ sāttvatāṃ nṛpa ।।55।।
viśanti paramātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ samāhitāḥ ।
bhajainaṃ parameśaṃ taṃ rājan kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।56।।
daivataṃ paramaṃ yajñaṃ parātmānaṃ sanātanam ।
īṣyate sarvayajñeṣu nityaṃ so'yaṃ jagatpatiḥ ।।57।।
ye yajanti surān pitṝn gurūn sādhūँstathā'tithīn ।
gāśca viprān dīnajanān kṣitiṃ satīṃ ca mātaram ।।।58।।
ṛṣīn sevāparān bhṛtyān patnīṃ patiṃ ca bālakān ।
pūjyānanāthān raṃkāँśca paśūn patatriṇastathā । । 59 । ।
stambān vṛkṣān pakṣiṇaśca viṣṇumeva yajanti te ।
antargataḥ sa bhagavān sarvapiṇḍe vyavasthitaḥ । । 2.261.60 । ।
gṛhṇāti śraddhayā dattaṃ jīvatṛptiṃ samāvahat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ śrutau śrutaḥ । । 6.1 । ।
bhaja taṃ paramātmānaṃ rājan pratyakṣagocaram ।
ya eṣa gururasmākaṃ kaṃbharānandanastviha । । 62 । ।
ko yāyāt taṃ vinā cātra sarvatra kṣitimaṇḍale ।
prakuryācca mahāyajñān tārayenmocayejjanān । । 63 । ।
kathaṃ vinā taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvajaganmanoharam ।
vṛṇuyuḥ kanyakā rājñāṃ sahasraśaśca koṭiśaḥ । । 64 । ।
kathaṃ devāśca ṛṣayaśceśvarāśceśvareśvarāḥ ।
āgatya pūjanaṃ kuryurmakheṣvasya hariṃ vinā । । 65 । ।
kathaṃ rādhāramālakṣmīkamalādyāśca koṭiśaḥ ।
kṛṣṇapatnyaścāsya sevāṃ kuryurnārāyaṇaṃ vinā । । 66 । ।
kathaṃ cihnāni sarvāṇi sṛṣṭitrayordhvagāni vai ।
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā'syaiva mūrtau bhaveyurañjasā । । 67 । ।
sa vai vedanidhiḥ kṛṣṇastapasāṃ nidhireva ca ।
yogajñānanidhiścā'yaṃ sarvodaraḥ sa eva ca । । 68 । ।
parabrahmaparā vedāḥ parabrahmaparā makhāḥ ।
parabrahmaparo mokṣaḥ parabrahmaparaṃ tapaḥ । । 69 । ।
parabrahmaparaṃ satyaṃ parabrahmaparamṛtam ।
parabrahmaparaṃ puṇyaṃ parabrahmaparā gatiḥ । । 2.261.7 0 । ।
pravṛttinivṛttidharmaḥ parabrahmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
parabrahmātmako gandhaḥ pṛthvyāṃ śreṣṭhatamo nṛpa । । 71 । ।
parabrahmaparā cāpāṃ guṇā rasātmakāḥ śubhāḥ ।
parabrahmaparaṃ rūpaṃ jyotiṣāṃ rūpiṇāṃ tathā । । 72 । ।
parabrahmātmakaḥ sparśaḥ sarvaspṛśyasthito'nugaḥ ।
parabrahmātmakaḥ śabdaḥ sarvaśabdyānupāvṛtaḥ । । 73 । ।
parabrahmaparaṃ cittaṃ mano'haṃ buddhirīśvarī ।
parabrahmātmikā mātrāḥ parabrahmātmakā guṇāḥ । । 74 । ।
parabrahmātmakaḥ kālaḥ parabrahmaparā kṛtiḥ ।
kīrtiḥ śrīrdevatā lakṣmīḥ parabrahmaparā ca bhūḥ । । 75 । ।
parabrahmaparā bhūtirlīlā sarasvatī satī ।
parabrahmaparāḥ sarvāḥ ṛco brahmapriyāstathā । । 76 । ।
parabrahmaparaṃ jñānaṃ yogastyāgaḥ śubhā kriyāḥ ।
kāraṇāni samastāni parabrahmaparāṇi ca । । 77 । ।
tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ sa vijānāti manīṣitaṃ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।।78।।
daivaṃ paitryaṃ tapo dānaṃ sarvāśrayo hariḥ svayam ।
sarvabhūtakṛtāvāsaḥ kuṃkumavāpikā''layaḥ ।।79।।
akṣarabrahmavāsaśca bālakṛṣṇaḥ sa eva saḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ ।।2.261.8 0।।
sa vai hyekāntinaḥ sarvān prīṇāti bhagavān hariḥ ।
vidhikṛtāṃ supūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ।।8 1 ।।
ekāntino hi manujāḥ prayānti śrīhareḥ padam ।
ekāntadharmasarvasvaṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇam ।।82।।
sammitaṃ sāmavedena puraivādau kṛte yuge ।
dhāryate bālakṛṣṇena nārāyaṇeśvareṇa ha ।।83 ।।
nārāyaṇo yajñadharmaṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ।
nārāyaṇahrade daivaṃ paitryaṃ nyavartayat purā ।।84।।
ṛṣayo devatādyāśca somo'pi mānavāstathā ।
makhadharmaṃ purākalpe nyavartayan hariśritāḥ ।।85।।
rudraḥ kṛte yuge nārāyaṇadharmaṃ hyapālayat ।
aśikṣayattathā viprān cādye kṛte yuge haraḥ ।।86 ।।
suparṇākhyamaharṣiśca prāpya śrīpuruṣottamāt ।
yajñadharmaṃ pṛthivyāṃ saḥ prāvartayata sadvidhim ।।87।।
samudro yajñadharmāṃśca tataḥ prāvartayannṛpa ।
athā''raṇyakanāmā'pi muniḥ prāvartayattataḥ ।।88।।
manustato yajñadharmān prāvartayata sāttvavān ।
sanatkumāro bhagavān prāvartayata tatparān ।।89।।
vīraṇaḥ suvrataścāpi barhiṣadaśca dakṣakaḥ ।
vivasvān sthāpitavanto dharmamenaṃ sanātanam ।।2.261.90।।
sarvārpaṇātmako dharmaḥ sāttvato duṣkaro janaiḥ ।
dhāryate'nādikṛṣṇena sthāpyate ca punaḥ kṣitau ।।9 1।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena makharūpavān ।
sarvārpaṇātmako dharmo bhūgole sthāpite nṛpa ।।92।।।
sa eva bhagavāṃlloke saṃsthāpya dharmamācyutam ।
yathecchati tathā paścāt krīḍati śāsti vai prajāḥ ।।93।।
evamekāntadharmaste kathito nṛpasattama ।
ekāntinaḥ kṣitau rājan! bhavanti durlabhā janāḥ ।।94।।
yadyekāntibhirākīrṇaṃ jagat syād vaiṣṇavaṃ mithaḥ ।
bhaved brahmapuraṃ cātra kṛtaṃ yugaṃ vidoṣakam ।।95।।
yatra caikāntinaḥ santi parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ paśavaśca pakṣiṇo devatādayaḥ ।।96।।
sarve varṇā vaiṣṇavāśca tatrā'kṣarapadaṃ matam ।
adharmastatra nāstyeva nādharmavaṃśajā api ।।97।।
naranārīvyavahārāḥ sarve syurmuktakoṭijāḥ ।
vaikuṣṭhaṃ vā ca goloko śveto vā badarīvanam ।।98।।
bhavettatra yadi kṣmāyāṃ sarve caikāntino janāḥ ।
sāttvatā bhaktimanto vai bhaveyurmuktaye dhruvam ।।99।।
manīṣitaṃ hyavāpyaiva bhajeyuḥ puruṣottamam ।
ekāntabhaktāḥ satataṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 2.261.10 0।।
teṣāṃ haryaṃkaniṣṭhānāṃ yogakṣemavaho hariḥ ।
jāyamānaṃ janaṃ naijaṃ kṛtvā yaṃ vīkṣate hariḥ ।। 101 ।।
sāttvataḥ sa bhavedatra dharmaikāntikavān sa ca ।
parabrahmātmake mokṣe tato yāti parāṃ gatim ।। 1 02।।
nārāyaṇena dṛṣṭo yaḥ pratibuddho bhaveddhi saḥ ।
nātmecchayā tathā rājan pratibuddho bhavet kvacit ।। 103 ।।
pravṛttilakṣaṇairyuktaṃ naivekṣati hariḥ svayam ।
paśyantyenaṃ mahāmāyā brahmā devāśca mānavāḥ ।। 1 04।।
tataste vikṛtāḥ sarve māyābaddhā bhavanti vai ।
te yadi sāttvatānāṃ vai sevāṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ ।। 1 05।।
tadā kālāntare prāpya nairguṇyaṃ yānti cākṣaram ।
yadvā sāttvatasaṃghāte kṛpayā sāttvatekṣitāḥ ।। 1 06।।
bhaveyuste yadā caikāntikasādhukṛpekṣitāḥ ।
tadā teṣāṃ hṛdayasya parivartanamāśu vai ।। 1 07।।
bhaviṣyati na sandeho'thavā prasādabhojanaiḥ ।
harervā haribhaktānāṃ jalānnagrāsabhojanaiḥ ।। 1 08।।
śuddhā buddhirnirguṇābhimukhī śanaiḥ prajāyate ।
niṣkalmaṣā prasannā ca tataḥ sāttvatamaṇḍale ।। 1 09।।
nivāsena śanaiḥ sāttvatatvamāsādya mokṣaṇam ।
gamiṣyanti na sandehaḥ kṛpāsādhyā sthitirhi sā ।। 2.261.11 0।।
ityuktvā virarāmaiva maharṣirlomaśastataḥ ।
rādhike'śvapaṭṭalaśca pupūja lomaśaṃ munim ।। 111 ।।
bahusāmagrikābhiśca kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaścottare tīrthābhivāñcachayā ।। 11 2।।
lomaśaṃ prārthayattena lomaśena samaṃ tataḥ ।
sarastīrthāni ca yayau sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।। 113 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāṃ lomaśakṛtamaśvapāṭalāyā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasākṣādbhagavattvabodhanaṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇadharmabodhanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭhyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 261 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 261 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 262
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 263 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike rājā tvaśvapāṭalasaṃjñakaḥ ।
lomaśena samaṃ somatīrthe vai prathamaṃ yayau ।। 1 ।।
tatra snātvā ca vidhinā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ।
yūpasthalīṃ namaskṛtya rāmatīrthaṃ yayau tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ tīrthamidaṃ jātaṃ maharṣe rāmanāmakam ।
samāsena kathāmetāṃ praśrāvaya purātanīm ।। 3 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
bhāṇavīryo'bhavat siṃhajñātīyo nṛpatiḥ purā ।
gopanāthādikhaṇḍasya rājya karoti śobhanam ।। 4 ।।
śatrujayapradeśāँśca śāsti dharmadharo nṛpaḥ ।
rāmarāmetirāmetirāmādityeti sarvadā ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetikṛṣṇādityeti vai tathā ।
japati svakuṭumbena sahito vaiṣṇavaḥ khalu ।। 6 ।।
prajāstasya sukhasthānāḥ sukhālayāḥ sukhe sthitāḥ ।
bhajante ca sadā rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindamacyutam ।। 7 ।।
dharmaṃ karoti nityaṃ ca bhāṇavīryo'tithāvapi ।
sādhuṣu devakāryeṣu dānahomapradakṣiṇāḥ ।। 8 ।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasyaikadā kaṣṭaṃ hi bhautikam ।
samutpannaṃ bhāladeśanṛpo nāmnā kṣamābhṛtaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vijayārthaṃ svasainyena niryayau cā'nusāgaram ।
sābhramatīṃ samuttīrya dhavalākhyān pradeśakān ।। 2.262.1 0।।
vijitya bhāṇavīryasya rāṣṭraṃ jetumupāyayau ।
sainyaṃ kṣamābhṛtasyāpyuddhataṃ grāmān purāṇi ca ।। 11 ।।
aṭati sma nijān kṛtvā pradeśān siṃharāyikām ।
rājadhānīṃ vijetuṃ vai tūrṇamantikamāyayau ।। 12।।
siṃharājyā nagaryā vai paritaḥ sainyacakrakam ।
kṛtvā''vṛṇod rājadhānīṃ dūtaṃ cāpreṣayan nṛpam ।। 1 3।।
rājavākyaṃ jagādāpi dūto gṛhāṇa vaśyatām ।
yadvā yuddhaṃ pradehyatra rājyaṃ vā sakalaṃ tataḥ ।। 14।।
bhāṇavīryo jagādāpi dūtaṃ kṣamābhṛtasya ha ।
nā'nyāyo vidyate rājye nā'dharmo vidyate tathā ।। 15।।
ījyate bhagavān rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca sarvadā mayā ।
rakṣyante sādhavaḥ sarve pūjyante'tithayaḥ sadā ।। 16।।
rājyaṃ rāmasya śaraṇe mayā'rpitaṃ vibhāvyate ।
nā'trā'sti vaśyatā'nyasya yuddhaṃ naiva naraiḥ saha ।। 17।।
rājyadānaṃ kṛtaṃ rāme kathamanyena bhujyate ।
ahaṃ tu tatpradhāno'smi yotsyate bhagavān svayam ।। 18।।
vada dāsye na vai rājyaṃ kariṣye'pi na vaśyatām ।
yodhanaṃ bhagavāneva kariṣyati nijārthakam ।। 19।।
sannaddho bhava rājendra garvaṃ mā vaha ceti vai ।
vada kṣamābhṛtaṃ yadvā yāhi svabhavanaṃ prati ।।2.262.20।।
yadvā mitrasvarūpeṇa svāgataṃ te karomi ca ।
yatheṣṭaṃ me punaścātrā''vedayeti vilokaye ।9।
dūto gatvā jagādedaṃ yathoktaṃ ca tataḥ sa ca ।
kṣamābhṛto'preṣayacca dūtaṃ sajjo bhaveti ca ।।22।।
yuddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhīṣye'haṃ rājyaṃ mā madamāvaha ।
nahi nārāyaṇo yuddhe rakṣiṣyati prabhaktakam ।। 23।।
iti saṃpreṣayitvaiva dūtaṃ yuddhasya sūcakān ।
bherībyaṃgulaśaṃkhānāṃ ninādān samakārayat ।।24।।
yantraśabdān vividhāँścā'kārayat durgasannidhau ।
durgapālān gopurasthān dvārarakṣakarāँstathā ।। 25।।
bandhayitvā svavaśagān kṛtvā kṣamābhṛto nṛpaḥ ।
praviveśa nagaryāṃ vai siṃharājyāṃ sasainyakaḥ ।।26 ।।
prajāstresuḥ kampamānāḥ sasmaruḥ rāmamacyutam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ rakṣakaṃ parameśvaram ।।27।।
rājasaudhaṃ pragatvaiva kṣamābhṛto balānvitaḥ ।
bhāṇavīryād bāhuyuddhaṃ yayāce rāṣṭrakaṃ ca vā ।।28।।
bhāṇavīryo mahābhaktaḥ samadṛg vai kṣamābhṛtam ।
svāgatena samadṛṣṭyā'mānayacca jagau tadā ।।29।।
rājan yuddhe manuṣyāṇāṃ nāśo hiṃsā bhavediti ।
jayo vā'pajayo vā'pi mayi tvayi bhaviṣyati ।। 2.262.3 0।।
svasvarājye sthitau cā'vāṃ vijayasthau na saṃśayaḥ ।
nahi tṛṣṇākhyatantūnāṃ vicchedo'nto bhaviṣyati ।।3 1।।
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ rāmaṃ vṛthā kleśaṃ ca mā vaha ।
na me rājyaṃ na te rājyaṃ na kṣitiḥ saha yāsyati ।।32।।
na sainyaṃ bāndhavā bhṛtyā dhanāni rāṣṭrakaṃ prajāḥ ।
saha yāsyanti maraṇe mṛtau na kṣaṇanirṇayaḥ ।।33।।
mayā kṛṣṇārpitaṃ rājyaṃ na me rājyaṃ viśiṣyate ।
rāmarājye vṛthā gṛdhnāṃ mā samāvaha pārthiva ।।34।।
bāhuyuddhaṃ balaṃ pṛthvyā na te me'pi kathaṃcana ।
śastrayuddhaṃ hi sainyasya parasyaiva balaṃ hi tat ।।35।।
balaṃ rāmāt prasaṃpādyaṃ yadbalaṃ sahagaṃ bhavet ।
tadvinā cā'phalaṃ sarvaṃ balaṃ nirbalameva tat ।। 36।।
kṣamābhṛta uvāca-
rājā bhūtvā sādhuvādān vadasyeva hi nirbalaḥ ।
neyaṃ rājakule sādho rītiryaśaskarī kvacit। ।। 37।।
nātra rāmo na vai kṛṣṇo na yuddhe rakṣako hariḥ ।
balajayyaṃ bhaved rāṣṭraṃ yuddhadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 38 ।।
dehi yuddhena vā rājyaṃ śaraṇāgatimāvaha ।
anyathā tvāṃ nigaḍe vai kṛtvā neṣye tamogṛham ।। 3 9।।
bhāṇavīrya uvāca--
nigaḍā racitāḥ śrīmadrāmeṇa na tvayā nṛpa ।
duṣṭārthe nigaḍā yogyā yadyahaṃ tādṛśastathā ।।2.262.40 ।।
nigaḍe saṃbhaviṣyāmi mā cintāṃ tatra vai kuru ।
aduṣṭasya na nigaḍo yathā te rocate kuru ।। 41 ।।
pareśvareṇa racitā bhūmirjalaṃ ca vahnayaḥ ।
vāyuḥ prāṇā gaganaṃ ca śabdādyāścendriyāṇi ca ।।42।।
śarīraṃ racitaṃ tena rājyaṃ tenaiva nirmitam ।
rājapadaṃ pradattaṃ ca tenaiva paramātmanā ।। 43 ।।
yasya rājyaṃ jagat sarvaṃ yaddattaṃ prakaromyaham ।
rājyaṃ rājan karomyevaṃ taddattaṃ tvaṃ sukhī bhava ।।44।।
mā ca gṛdhaḥ parasyā'nnaṃ pareśasya kare sthitam ।
cātitṛṣṇo jano naśyet samūlaḥ saparigrahaḥ ।। 45।।
rājñā kārye sadā ceśadattād deyaṃ parātmane ।
pūjane'rpaṇamevā'tra tvaṃ tathā bhaktimāvaha ।।46।।
anādadāno gṛhṇāno rājaँstvaṃ doṣamugrakam ।
mā savahā'tra bhūmau vai mānave mokṣasādhane ।।47।।
paśya rājan rājyabhūmau karṣukā yadi vatsare ।
dvivatsarayośca vā trivatsareṣu karādikam ।।48 ।।
yadi naiva dadatyeva rājñe te doṣabhāginaḥ ।
rājadaṇḍyā bhaveyuste gṛhānniṣkāsitāstathā ।।49।।
kṣetravāṭīvihīnāśca bhaveyuḥ rājyadaṇḍitāḥ ।
karadānena nirdoṣāḥ karā'dānena doṣiṇaḥ ।।2.262.5 0 ।।
karṣukasya gṛhavāṭīkṣetrodyānādikaṃ ca yat ।
nṛpasyaiva bhavatyeva karā''dānanimittakam ।।5 1 ।।
karṣukastatra kṛṣyādyairjīvatyeva karapradaḥ ।
karṣukeṇa nṛpo naiva vismartavyaḥ kadācana ।। 52।।
yadi rājā vismṛtaḥ syāt karṣuko daṇḍabhāg bhavet ।
karaṃ datvā nṛpaṃ smṛtvā jīvatyeva hyabādhitaḥ ।।53 ।।
evameva jagad rājan rājyaṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ।
pṛthivī nirmitā tena jalaṃ tejo'nilo'nalaḥ ।।54।।
śarīraṃ nirmitaṃ tena dravyamannaṃ rasādayaḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ putrapaśuvṛkṣavallīgṛhādayaḥ ।।55।।
divā rātriḥ sūryacandrau sukhaṃ śamaḥ kuṭumbakam ।
sampadbhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca sarvaṃ tasyaiva rāṣṭrakam ।।56।।
tasmai rājñe samarpyo vai kasmai yajñātmako hi saḥ ।
anivedyā'samarpyā'pi karaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai ।।57।।
karṣukāśca vayaṃ sarve bhuṃkṣvahe cedanarpitam ।
tarhi daṇḍasya pātrāṇi bhavema nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।58।।
tasmād rājan nahi pṛthvī te me vāpi kadācana ।
pṛthvyāṃ sthitaiśca vā'smābhiḥ karṣukatvena pālyate ।।59।।
sa eva samrāḍ rājā'sti mā yuddhaṃ kuru pārthiva ।
mayā vā tena sākaṃ vā bhuñjīthāstena te'rpitam ।।2.262.60।।
tena vāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiñcijjagatyāṃ hi tat। ।
tena dattaṃ prabhuñjīthā mā gṛdhoḥ yatparasya vai ।।61।।
naijaṃ muktvā'rpayitvaiva haraye mokṣamāvaha ।
mokṣarājyaṃ paraṃ rājyaṃ prāpnuhīti nibodha me ।।62।।
kṣamābhṛta uvāca-
bhūpapatho mokṣapatho jñānapathaḥ pṛthak trayaḥ ।
yuddhapatho nṛpāṇāṃ vai tatra jñānaṃ na yujyate ।।63।।
sarvaṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva balavān yaḥ sa vindate ।
bhuṃkte rājyaṃ samṛddhaṃ ced rājadharmo hi yodhanam ।। 64।।
eṣa tvāṃ nigaḍe kṛtvā rājan harāmi rāṣṭrakam ।
ityuktvā sahasā kṣamābhṛto babandha bhāṇakam ।।65।।
sakuṭumbaṃ ca sāmātyaṃ kośaṃ ca rājamandiram ।
bhāṇavīryo hare rāma rāmakṛṣṇa harehare ।।66।।
bālakṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa lakṣmīnātha harehare ।
evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ nigaḍastho'pi nirbhayaḥ ।। 67।।
kuṭumbaṃ bhajanaṃ cakre nirbhayaṃ bhagavadbalam ।
kṣamābhṛtaśca mumude rājyaṃ prāptamakaṇṭakam ।।68।।
bhaktapriyo hi bhagavān bhaktasāhāyyadaḥ prabhuḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhasthaḥ prabhuḥ śrīmān sitāpatiḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।6 9।।
śuśrāva bhajanaṃ tasya bhāṇavīryasya cottamam ।
sitā prāha hariṃ tatra kimidaṃ kīrtanaṃ bahu ।।2.262.70।।
śrūyate tīvrasaṃvegaṃ kānta kena samīritam ।
rāmādityastadā prāha paśya lakṣmi svabhaktakam ।।71 ।।
nigaḍasthaṃ bhāṇavīryaṃ surāṣṭre siṃharājake ।
pattane ca nije kṣamābhṛtena nihitaḥ khalu ।।72।।
sitā'paśyannigaḍasthaṃ bhaktaṃ rājānameva sā ।
utthāya sahasā rāmaṃ samutthāya sapārṣadā ।।73 ।।
ājagāma kṣaṇāt pṛthvyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro'ntikam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahmapriyāstathā ।।74।।
saha nītvā sitā rāmaṃ sainyaṃ vyaracayattadā ।
caturaṃgaṃ ca yuddhārthaṃ vyomagaṃ śīghragāmi ca ।।75।।
bhaktasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ vai yuddhatūryāṇyavādayat ।
siṃharājīnagaryāstu prākārasya samantataḥ ।।76 ।।
cakravyūhaṃ pṛtanāyāḥ kṛtvā kṣamābhṛtaṃ nṛpam ।
cetayāmāsa yuddhārthaṃ so'pi sainyena saṃyutaḥ ।।77।।
yuddhārthaṃ tvāyayau śīghraṃ saṃgrāmo'bhūnmaholbaṇaḥ ।
daśasāhasrayoddhāraḥ kṣamābhṛtasya bheditāḥ ।।78।।
śarairbāṇaistomaraiśca vajraiścakraiḥ kṛpāṇakaiḥ ।
kṣamābhṛto dhṛto jīvasahaḥ pāśairmahābhaṭaiḥ ।।79।।
bhāṇavīryaṃ ca nirbandhaṃ cakāra hi sitā svayam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rāmastasmai dadau svadarśanam ।।2.262.80 ।।
brahmapriyā daduścāpi darśanaṃ nṛpayoṣite ।
kuṭumbāya prajābhyaścāśīrvādān lomaśo dadau ।।81 ।।
ahaṃ rājan lomaśo vai mantraṃ dade'sya vaiṣṇavam ।
rājyaṃ bhaktāya dattvaiva kṣamābhṛtaṃ nibadhya ca ।।82।।
visṛjya tasya deśaṃ ca kuṃkumakṣetrakaṃ prati ।
bhāṇavīryaṃ savaṃśaṃ ca rāmādityaṃ sapārṣadam ।।83 ।।
ānāyyā'śvasarovārau snāpayāmāsa śuddhaye ।
hatānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prādād bhagavāna bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।84।।
rāmādityaḥ samuvāsa sapārṣadagaṇastadā ।
ādṛtaḥ satkṛtaścāpi sarasyatrā''plavaṃ vyadhāt ।।85।।
tattīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ vai rājannetat tato'bhavat ।
sitātīrthaṃ muktitīrthaṃ sarasyetannigadyate ।।86।।
bhāṇavīryeṇa vai cātra mandiraṃ kāritaṃ śubham ।
rāmādityo hi sitayā sahitaścātra śobhate ।।87।।
pārṣadaiḥ sahitaścāpi dhṛtakārmukahetikaḥ ।
evaṃ bhaktasya rakṣā vai kṛtā śrīparamātmanā ।।88।।
bhāṇatīrthaṃ tathā khyātaṃ vaikuṇṭhatīrthamityapi ।
īśānataḥ paścime vai vartate somatīrthakāt ।।89।।
atra snāhi jalaṃ pītvā tarpitvā bhaktitaḥ pitṝn ।
dehi dānāni viprebhyaḥ sadbhyaḥ satībhya ityapi ।।2.262.90 ।।
sarvadānaphalaṃ cātra lapsyase tvalpadānataḥ ।
pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ cātra phalamātrapradānataḥ ।।9 1।।
svargadānaphalaṃ cātra dhenudānapradānataḥ ।
lakṣmīdānaphalaṃ cātra kanyādānapradānataḥ ।।92।।।
mokṣadānaphalaṃ cātrā'bhayadānapradānataḥ ।
ityukto rādhike rājā bhāṇavīryo mahābalaḥ ।।93 ।।
bhaktarāḍ vidhinā snānadānārhaṇāni saṃvyadhāt ।
dhyānaṃ cakre kṣaṇaṃ rāmādityasya paramātmanaḥ ।।94।।
rāmasya darśanaṃ tasya tejomadhye hṛdantare ।
jātaṃ tutoṣa rājā'pi lomaśo'pi samādhinā ।।95। ।
dadarśa divyadṛṣṭyā vai smāritaḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
dṛṣṭaḥ sākṣāttato rāmo'ntardhānaṃ prajagāma ha ।।96।।
ityevaṃ cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmādityābhidhaṃ param ।
rādhike smaraṇāccāpi rāmadarśanakārakam ।।97।।
pāpatāpaharaṃ śatrusaṃkaṭādivināśakam ।
vaikuṇṭhavāsadaṃ ramyaṃ viṣṇośca mandiraṃ śubham ।।98।।
yatra mṛtāḥ paśavo'pi yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।
yatra snātā narā nāryo yānti vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।।99।।
yatra rāmahrade snātvā prayānti satyataḥ param ।
sakāmāḥ suralokaṃ vā niṣkāmāścākṣaraṃ padam ।। 2.262.1 00।।
prayānti rādhike sampūjitāḥ pārṣadasattamaiḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya tatsarvaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ।। 10 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lomaśagītāyāmaśvapāṭalo rāmādityatīrthaṃ prāpya bhāṇavīryabhaktakathāṃ śrutvā vidhinā snānadānādikaṃ cakāra rājñoḥ mithaḥ saṃvādaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 262 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 262 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 263
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 264 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike cānyaṃ tīrthaṃ vai lomaśoditam ।
sūryanārāyaṇasyaiva sarvakuṣṭhavināśanam ।। 1 ।।
rāmatīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā yayau tvagre'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
tīrthaṃ sarastaṭe ramyaṃ sūryabhāsurasajjalam ।। 2 ।।
sūryavad yatra dṛśyante śuktayo'pi subhāsurāḥ ।
kiraṇāni vimuñcanti jālāntarasthitā api ।। 3 ।।
jalaṃ dedīpyamānaṃ tadvilokya tvaśvapāṭṭalaḥ ।
papraccha lomaśaṃ devaṃ mahāścaryabharastadā ।। 4 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro tīrthamidaṃ sarvatīrthebhyo dyotanā''śrayam ।
kathaṃ kasmāt kadā tvevaṃ jātaṃ vai sūryavarculam ।। 5 ।।
jalānyapi prakāśante sūryagarbhāṇi vai yathā ।
kinnāma kiṃguṇaṃ kiṃsatphalaṃ tat kathaya prabho ।। 6 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan mahāścaryaṃ yadatra samabhūt purā ।
stambhapure purā tvāsīt kāyastho lekhakarmakṛt ।। 7 ।।
bhajate sa prabhuṃ nityaṃ rājakarmacaro'bhavat ।
nyāyakārye sahāyo vai lekhako'bhūt subuddhimān ।। 8 ।।
dāridryadoṣachannaśca lakṣmītṛṣṇāticañcalaḥ ।
yena kena prakāreṇa dravyaṃ sādhyaṃ dhanādikam ।। 9 ।।
lekhane śabdamālānāṃ pūrvāparavichittayā ।
arthasyā'pi bhaved yatrā'nartho'pi lābhahānidaḥ ।। 2.263.1 0।।
tathā śabdān lekhaguptān kṛtvā tu lekhapatrake ।
yo dadāti dhanaṃ tasmai luñcārūpaṃ tadarthikām ।। 11 ।।
lābhalipiṃ vilikhyaiva dadātyeva jayapradām ।
dvyartharūpāṃ saṃkarārthāṃ padacchede navārthikām ।। 1 2।।
evaṃ lobhena bahūnāṃ nyāyā'nyāyavilekhanāt ।
pāpabhāreṇa jāto'yaṃ galatkuṣṭhī karadvaye ।।1 3।।
ūrjavrato hi nāmnā sa kāyastho hastarogavān ।
lekhakāryaṃ tatastyaktvā tīrthārthaṃ gopanāthakam ।। 14।।
kṛṣṇalīlāmayaṃ tīrthaṃ tvāyayau snātavāँstataḥ ।
guptaprayāgakaṃ kṣetraṃ dadau pāpanivārakam ।। 15।।
snātastatra tato mūladvārikāṃ prayayau hi saḥ ।
tato yayau somanāthaṃ prācīplakṣaṃ tato yayau ।। 16।।
sarasvatyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ plakṣamūlasamāśritaḥ ।
jajāpa manasā jāpaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇotimādhava ।। 17।।
nārāyaṇaharerāma janārdana janāvana ।
kṛpālo karuṇāsindho rogād rakṣaya māṃ prabho ।। 18।।
kṛtānāṃ karmaṇaṃ cātra phalaṃ tīvraprayogiṇām ।
jāyate mandavegānāṃ kālāntare prajāyate ।। 19।।
janmāntare ca vā sarvaṃ bhoktavyaṃ vā yamagṛhe ।
yatra kvāpi gataṃ jantuṃ kṛtaṃ karma na muñcati ।।2.263.20।।
mayā lekhe bahūnāṃ vai satyādasatyamucchritam ।
asatyād satyarūpaṃ tu kṛtvā cā'kuśalaṃ kṛtam ।।21।।
tena pāpena bhagavan kuṣṭho'galan karadvaye ।
aṃguliṣu prajāto me tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam ।।22।।
kṛtaṃ tathāpi bhagavan rogo'yaṃ na vilīyate ।
tasmāduddhara deveśa kṛpayā māṃ kṛpānidhe ।।23 ।।
naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣye'tra loke doṣaṃ kadācana ।
namaste pāpahartre'tra rogahartre namo namaḥ ।।24।।
bhaktānāṃ sukhakartre'tra tīrthe goptre namo'stu te ।
namaste sarvakarṇāya namaste sarvacakṣuṣe ।।25।।
namaste sarvavijñāya sarvahṛtsthāya te namaḥ ।
namaḥ kāyastharūpāya namo nikāyayojine ।।26।।
namaścādṛśyarūpāya śaraṇāgatarakṣiṇe ।
ityevaṃ prārthayāmāsa kāyastho vimanā iva ।।27।।
plakṣā'dho niṣasādā'pi nirāśaścintayan mṛtim ।
tāvattatra samāyātaḥ kaścid vipro jaṭādharaḥ ।।28।।
ārādhayā'rkakṣetraṃ tvaṃ gatvā'ntikasthitaṃ tviha ।
arkavṛkṣāśrayo bhūtvā sūryamantrān sadā japa ।।29।।
sūryanārāyaṇo devaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ te nāśayiṣyati ।
sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ snātvā pītvā jalaṃ ca pāvanam ।। 2.263.30।।
'namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartre namo namaḥ' ।
ityevaṃ japa gatvaiva sūryakṣetraṃ śubhapradam ।।3 1।।
ityuktaḥ sa tu kāyastho rājaँstato'rkatīrthakam ।
viśvakarmakṛtaḥ sūryaḥ śāṇollīḍho yadā purā ।।32।।
yatra khaṇḍaśca patito yatrā'rkavṛkṣatāṃ raviḥ ।
gatastatra yayau pṛṣṭvā taṃ jaṭādhraṃ praṇamya ca ।।33।।
arkavṛkṣavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣorjavrato hi saḥ ।
śvetārkān vyomaraṃgārkān sthūlapuṣpakān ।।34।।
bahudugdhān stambarūpān vallīrūpān bahūn drumān ।
phalapuṣpadalāḍhyāṃśca dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa vai hi saḥ ।।35।।
mārgayāmāsa bahudhā tīrthasthalaṃ kva vai bhavet ।
śreṣṭhārkasannidhau cā'haṃ niṣadya prajapāmi ha ।।36।।
tāvattenā'rkamūle' vai bahuśākhadalāvṛte ।
bahupuṣpāśraye mūle śikhācakraṃ vilokitam ।।37।।
tatrā'sya mānasaṃ lagnaṃ kuṭītulye'rkasadgṛhe ।
tacchāyāyāṃ cakārā'yaṃ vāsaṃ mūle japan manum ।।38।।
'namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartra namo namaḥ' ।
ityevaṃ prajapaँstatra kṣutpipāsākulo'pi san ।।39।।
rātriṃ nirgamayāmāsa nidrāṃ lebhe na vai manāka ।
prātarutthāya puṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ kṛtvā tṛṇe guṇe ।।2.263.40।।
śilācakrāya sūryāyā'rpayāmāsa sa bhaktitaḥ ।
jalaṃ dadau śilāyāṃ ca sītāphalaṃ phalaṃ dadau ।।41 ।।
tulasyāḥ patramevā'pi dadau śilāsvarūpiṇe ।
stutiṃ namaskṛtiṃ cakre tataḥ sītāphalaṃ hi saḥ ।।42।।
prasādaṃ bubhuje paścājjajāpa satataṃ hi saḥ ।
evaṃ māse gate rājan phalāhāraparāyaṇe ।।43।।
cakrān samutthitaḥ kaścidajñānarūpasundaraḥ ।
puruṣaḥ śvetavarṇaśca bahuraśmisamanvitaḥ ।।44।।
suvarṇakuṇḍalakarṇaḥ samukuṭaḥ sacakrakaḥ ।
samaṇihāravakṣāśca hiraṇyavarṇa ujjvalaḥ ।।45।।
kaṭakāṃgadabāhuśca hasan snehasamākulaḥ ।
sauvarṇāmbarasaṃrājatkāntiparidhimastakaḥ ।।46।।
śanairāgatya cakrādvai dūramūrjavrataṃ sthitam ।
jagāda vada putra tvaṃ kimicchasi ca mā ciram ।।47।।
ūrjavratastadovāca devadeva jagadguro ।
kuṣṭharogapraśāntiṃ me samicchāmi dayāṃ kuru ।।48।।
ko bhavān bhagavānāste sarvatejo'nvitastviha ।
manye sūryaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo me kṛpayā'dbhutaḥ ।।49।।
prakāśamāgatastvatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।
namaḥ sahasrarūpāya namaḥ sahasraraśmaye ।।2.263.50।।
namo bhaktakṛpākartre namaḥ sahasracakṣuṣe ।
namo jagatprakāśāya sarvabhūtapracakṣuṣe ।।51 ।।
parabrahmasvarūpāya mokṣadātre namo namaḥ ।
namastejo'bhihantre ca rogahantre namo namaḥ ।।।52।।
ityuktvā nipapātā'sāvūrjavrato'sya pādayoḥ ।
sūryastiro'bhavattūrṇaṃ divyavāṇyā jagāda ha ।।53।।
ūrjavrata svasti te'stu roganāśo bhaviṣyati ।
akṛtaniṣkṛtistvaṃ vai na māṃ spraṣṭumihā'rhasi ।।54।।
manmaṃtralakṣajāpena prāyaścittaṃ bhavet tava ।
tatkuru yāhi cetastu hyaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।55।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayā'kṣarābhidham ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ puruṣottamasaṃśritam ।।56।।
tasyaiva sarasastīre cottare śaṃkarāśraye ।
arkavṛkṣāśraye sthitvā japamantraṃ mamottamam ।।57।।
tava kuṣṭhasya vai nāśaḥ śīghraṃ tatra bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvaivaṃ śāradāṃ divyāṃ neme tāṃ diśameva saḥ ।।58।।
prasannaścorjavratako yayau śrībalikhātakam ।
tato yayau vāmanasya sthalīṃ vastrāpathaṃ tataḥ ।।59।।
suvarṇarakṣāsalile snātvā nārāyaṇe hrade।
indreśvare mahālakṣmītīrthe cakrakatīrthake ।।2.263.60।।
śaṃkhalādevikāṃ natvā turādevīṃ praṇamya ca ।
vyāghrīṃ devīṃ tato natvā natvā śrīkharkharīṃ satīm ।।61।।
rāṇikāṃ ca tato natvā yayau kuṃkumavāpikām ।
mahālakṣmīṃ vāpikāyāstīre sthitāṃ praṇamya ca ।।62।।
praṇamya nagarīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ nārāyaṇālayam ।
praṇamyā'śvasaro dṛṣṭvā yayāvuttaragaṃ taṭam ।।63।।
śāṃkaraṃ kṣetrapeśaṃ ca natvā pītvā jalaṃ tataḥ ।
mārgayāmāsa vai cārkavṛkṣaṃ dadarśa sannidhau ।।64।।
bhikṣāṃ yācitvaiva bhuktvā phalamūladalātmikām ।
arkavṛkṣatale tasthau kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā raviṃ prabhum ।।65।।
arkamūle sa śuśrāva vāṇīṃ tvadṛśyarūpiṇīm ।
svasti te'stu hi kāyastha tiṣṭha japa raviṃ smara ।।66।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ prage bhaja ।
pūjayārkeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ satāṃ patim ।।67।।
ahaṃ bhajāmi taṃ deveśvareśvareśvareśvaram ।
mayā labdhaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ teja aiśvaryamityapi ।।68।।
sūryo'haṃ tava kalyāṇaṃ kariṣyāmi hariṃ bhaja ।
lakṣajapottaraṃ hastau snānamātreṇa sārase ।।69।।
jale pūrṇau rogahīnau bhaviṣyato'rkavaibhavāt ।
ityāśrutya giraṃ corjavrataścakre'rkapādape ।।2.263.70 ।।
mūladeśe nivāsaṃ ca valkalādyadhivāsanam ।
ayācitotkarṣavṛttyā jīvayātrāṃ karoti ca ।।71 ।।
phalamūladalāhāro jalāhāraḥ kvacittathā ।
'namo brahmasavitre te kuṣṭhahartre namo namaḥ' ।।72।।
jajāpainaṃ mahāmantraṃ satataṃ sūryamānasaḥ ।
nityaṃ pañcasahasrāṇi japān karoti bhaktarāṭ ।।73 ।।
ekaviṃśe dine lakṣajapeṣu nirvṛtteṣu ca ।
sotsāhaścorjavratakaḥ smaran sūryanarāyaṇam ।।74।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre prātaḥ snātuṃ yayau drutam ।
sasnau rājannatra tīre jale'vagāhya vai muhuḥ ।।75।।
nimajyonmajya ca punaḥ karau paśyati lekhakaḥ ।
naiva paśyati nīrogau tadā snāti punaḥ punaḥ ।।76।।
punaḥ paśyati hastau ca norogau naiva paśyati ।
evaṃ snātvā śramaṃ prāpya nīrāśo'yaṃ vyajāyata ।।77।।
jape vrate kṣatiṃ naijāṃ vyatarkayata lekhakaḥ ।
sasmāra śokamāsādya sūryanārāyaṇaṃ tadā ।।78।।
vyomavāṇī jagādainaṃ bhakta vrataṃ tavā'tra vai ।
sampannaṃ sarvathā tatra kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।।79।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ madhyāhnake kṣaṇe ।
dhyātvā snāsyasi tūrṇaṃ te hastau rohiṣyatastadā ।।2.263.80।।
galatkuṣṭhena naṣṭā yā aṅgulyaśca karadvayam ।
hastatalaṃ samastaṃ tat sarvaṃ prarohayiṣyati ।।81।।
ityuktaścorjavratakaḥ kāyastho'rkasthalīṃ yayau ।
madhyāhne ca tathā sasnau yathoktasmṛtipūrvakam ।।82।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sūryanarāyaṇaḥ ।
dvau samānavayasyau vai bhūtvā bālasvarūpiṇau ।।83 ।।
sundarau mandahāsyā''syau divyakuṇḍaladhāriṇau ।
rūpānurūpāvayavau devadevādipūjitau ।।84।।
āgatya jalamadhyasthaṃ snāntaṃ kāyasthabhaktakam ।
karābhyāṃ ca karau dhṛtvonmajjya niṣkāsya vai bahiḥ ।।85।।
asthāpayatāṃ sarasastīre pūrṇakarāgrajam ।
sūryeṇa tu dhṛto vāmakaraḥ pūrṇatamo'bhavat ।।86।।
hariṇā sandhṛto dakṣaḥ karaḥ pūrṇatamo'bhavat ।
kāyasthaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo'pi tejasā tapasā tathā ।।87।।
puṇyairnārāyaṇasparśeḥ śvetarūpastadā'bhavat ।
yathā sūryo yathā kṛṣṇastattulyaḥ sa tadā'bhavat ।।88।।
tulyarūpāँstrīn puruṣān devavadbhāsamanvitān ।
janāstu dadṛśustatra mahāścaryaparāyaṇāḥ ।।89।।
ubhayoḥ śrīmatornārāyaṇayoḥ pādayostadā ।
pūrṇakāmaḥ sa bhakto vai nipapāta muhurmuhuḥ ।।2.263.90।।
tārito'haṃ kuṣṭharogād bhavarogācca tāritaḥ ।
hastalābhe harekṛṣṇa yadyahaṃ tuṣṭimāpnuyām ।।9 1 ।।
militayorbhavatorme punamelanamadhruvam ।
tasmāt tyakṣye na milito pāvitavantau māṃ prabhū ।।92।।
ūrjavrataḥ pradhṛtvaiva tayoścaraṇāveva ha ।
jagāda na mayā stheyaṃ bhūloke kleśasāgare ।। 93।।
yuvāṃ nārāyaṇau kṛṣṇau hyuddhāraṃ kurutaṃ mama ।
sūryaḥ prāha ca kāyastha sthitvā'tra mama mandiram ।।94।।
prakāraya śubhaṃ svalpaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ mama kāraya ।
kuṣṭhināṃ snānataḥ paścānmama darśanamātrataḥ ।।95।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya pūjanāttathā ।
roganāthastathā tīrthayātrā pūrṇā bhavediha ।।96।।
evaṃ kṛtvā tatastvaṃ vai saṃyātā ravimaṇḍalam ।
tataḥ satyapralokaṃ ca siddhānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ tataḥ ।।97।।
tato vaikuṇṭhamevāpi tato'kṣaraṃ gamiṣyasi ।
ityuktvā'ntarhitau devau sūryaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।98।।
kāyastho divyadehasthaḥ kārayāmāsa mandiram ।
sūryanārāyaṇaṃ cātra prātiṣṭhipat tathocitam ।।99।।
dvayornārāyaṇayośca tejāṃsyatra jalāntare ।
saṃvyāptānyabhavan rājan tadā kāle samantataḥ ।। 2.263.10 0।।
matsyāśca śuktayaścāpi maṇayaśca jalāni ca ।
rajaḥkaṇāstadā tejovyāptāḥ sūryā ivā'bhavan ।। 10 1।।
tādṛśyaḥ prakṛtayastāstato'dyā'pi jalāntare ।
tābhyo vai jāyamānāśca tejomayyo hi śuktayaḥ ।। 1 02।।
maṇayaḥ kaṃkarāścāpi rajāṃsi jalajāni ca ।
tadvaṃśāstatkiraṇaiḥ saṃvyāptā bhavanti sarvadā ।। 103 ।।
sūryanārāyaṇaścātra jale śuktau maṇāvapi ।
mandire'dṛśyarūpo'pi vartate tejasānvitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
tattejo'yaṃ sadā rājan prasaratyeva sarvataḥ ।
sūryatīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sūryavarculam ।। 1 05।।
ūrjavratastataḥ kālāntare sūryarathaṃ yayau ।
muktiṃ jagāma bhajanānnārāyaṇakṛpāvaśāt ।। 1 06।।
kuṣṭhanāśakaraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryapratyakṣadarśanam ।
sūryatejobhisaṃvyāptajalaśuktyādiśobhanam ।। 1 07।।
arkatīrthaṃ tathā corjavratatīrthamidaṃ śubham ।
kāyasthatīrthakaṃ cāpi sarvarogavināśakam ।। 1 08।।
ityukto rādhike rājā cakre tīrthaṃ vidhānataḥ ।
dadau dānāni saṃsnātvā pupūjā'rkaṃ narāyaṇam ।। 109 ।।
tataścāgre yayau tīrthāntaraṃ rājā salomaśaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasyā''rogyaṃ muktiṃ vrajejjanaḥ ।। 2.263.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne galatkuṣṭhina ūrjavratakāyasthasya sūryopāsanayā nīrogitvaṃ muktiśca sūryatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭhyadhika-
dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 263 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
tataśca rādhike cāśvapaṭṭalo lomaśānvitaḥ ।
yayāvagre ca śārṅgadhratīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kavi tīrthamidaṃ saumyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ kimātmakam ।
yatra me sphurati vidyā vedavedāṅgabodhinī ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
rājaँstīrthamidaṃ caivaṃ camatkārabharaṃ param ।
vidyate vai ṛṣeryogācchārṅgadharamahātmanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
śārṅgadharomahātmā'bhūd vipro'pi buddhivarjitaḥ ।
dharmāraṇyakṛtāvāsaḥ śṛṃgadharasya vai sutaḥ ।। 4 ।।
ābālyāttu jaḍavat sa vaktaṃ+u jānāti naiva ha ।
mūkavad vartate cāpi jihvāhrasvākhyadoṣataḥ ।। 5 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ jihvā'bhavattasya hrasvā maurkhyaṃ ca me vada ।
mūkavadvā kathaṃ cāste bālye cāñcalyamandire ।। 6 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
pūrvajanmani śūdro'bhūd daṇḍakāraṇyavāsakṛt ।
hiṃsāparastathā śāstradevanindāparo'pyabhūt ।। 7 ।।
brāhmaṇān yajñakartṝn sa kleśayatyeva vāgruṣā ।
nārāyaṇā'vatārāँśca nāstiko manute na vai ।। 8 ।।
kathā yatra ca bhavati tatrā'satyāṃ pravakti tām ।
sarvāmudarapoṣārthaṃ vakti svārthaparāyaṇām ।। 9 ।।
evaṃ nindāparaścā'yaṃ kadācid gautamītaṭe ।
mṛgayārthaṃ gatastatra śṛṃgamṛgaṃ vyalokayat ।। 1.264.1 0।।
mṛgaṃ hantuṃ śaraṃ cānusandadhāti tu yāvatā ।
tāvanmṛgo bhayāt tūrṇaṃ dudrāva gautamīṃ prati ।। 11 ।।
adṛśyatāṃ gato vṛkṣaghaṭāyāṃ ca tataḥ param ।
śūdrako'pi pradudrāva mārgayituṃ taṭaṃ prati ।। 12।।
godāvaryā jalaprānte dadarśa taṃ mṛgaṃ punaḥ ।
śaro muktaśca śūdreṇa mṛgapṛṣṭhe praveśitaḥ ।। 12।।
mṛgaścotplutya saritaḥ pravāhe nipapāta ha ।
abhāno mūrchito'gādhe jale vegapravāhaṇe ।। 14।।
karṣitaḥ saśaro yāto jalayogena vai talam ।
mṛtaśca jalamadhye vai makareṇa sa bhakṣitaḥ ।। 15।।
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃsmaran ।
mṛgo'pi tīrthamāhātmyāt pareśasmaraṇāttataḥ ।। 16।।
puṇyatīrthamṛterjāto dharmāraṇye sa bhūsuraḥ ।
śṛṃgacihnasametaśca bālaḥ parṇadharasya vai ।। 17।।
viprasya mandire kṛṣṇabhaktimān viprasadgaṇaḥ ।
jātismaro'bhavaccāpi bhajatyeva hi mādhavam ।। 18।।
gaṃge godāvari sindho yamune ca sarasvati ।
smṛtvā snāti harekṛṣṇa gṛṇātyeva divāniśam ।। 19।।
vavṛdhe sa ca bālo'pi pitrā śṛṃgadharaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
upavītī ca śāstrāṇi samadhyaita pratāpavān ।।1.264.20।।
dharmakarmaparaścābhūdvivāhitaśca vai tataḥ ।
śūdro mamāra ca godāvarī taṭe vane tadā ।। 21।।
godāvaryāṃ dehadāho niṣpāditaśca bāndhavaiḥ ।
tena puṇyapratāpena pāpāṇyasya prajajvaluḥ ।।22।।
mṛtyukāle'smarat so'pi mṛgaṃ taṃ śarasandhitam ।
tatpratāpena śūdraḥ sa śṛṃgadharasya putrakaḥ ।।23 ।।
dharmāraṇye'bhavad vipraḥ śūdrācārau jaḍo yathā ।
pitā jānāti vai sarvaṃ jātismarasvabhāvavān ।।24।
putro jānāti naivā'yaṃ ko'hamāsaṃ purā tanau ।
bālaḥ sa śāradāhīno mūka iva vyajāyata ।।25।।
jihvā hrasvā yato vaktuṃ jānātyeva na bālyataḥ ।
truṭitānsphoṭitān varṇān mammā caccā vadatyapi ।।26।।
mūko vaktuṃ na jānāti nāmnā śārṅgadharaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
upavītī kṛtaḥ pitrā ṛṇānubandhano'pi saḥ ।। 27।।
pūrvajanmakṛtanindāphalaṃ bhuṃkte hi mūkatām ।
nāstikyasya phalaṃ maurkhyaṃ bhuṃkte vicittavattathā ।। 28।।
mṛgahatyāphalaṃ tasya putratābhavanaṃ hyapi ।
ṛṇadānāya janmā'syā bhavacchṛṃgadharālaye ।।29।।
tīrthamṛtyuphalaṃ cāsya vipragṛhe janirmatā ।
so'yaṃ maurkhyānmūkabhāvājjaḍatvānmānavarjitaḥ ।।1.264.30।।
jaḍavadvai tapastaptuṃ dharmāraṇye mano'karot ।
samārebhe sa vai sthitvā valmīkaśikhare sthitaḥ ।। 31 ।।
tapaścograṃ cakārā'sau phalamūladalāśanaḥ ।
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī mānasaṃ japamādadhe ।। 32।।
lokā draṣṭuṃ samāyānti mūko vai tapasi sthitaḥ ।
nā'yaṃ paśyati kāँścittu baddhanetro'bhavattadā ।।33 ।।
nāścaryaṃ manyate tatra mālayā japamādadhan ।
sasmāra bhagavantaṃ taṃ jihvāsarasvatīpradam ।।34।।
vedānāṃ śevadhiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
sarvavidyāśrayaṃ sarvavijñaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavallabham ।।35 ।।
daśavarṣaṃ jajāpaivaṃ tapaścakāra sadṛśam ।
valmīkāvāsa evā'sau varṣāsu plakṣamūlagaḥ ।।36 ।।
parṇakuṭīvihīnaśca vitānarahitastathā ।
āsanādivihīnaśca prāvaraṇavivarjitaḥ ।।37।।
jaṭādharo romadharo bhasmadharo'titāpasaḥ ।
valkalakaupīnamātraḥ karapātro'bhavat sadā ।।38।।
daśavarṣottaraṃ corje māse prabodhinītithau ।
rātrau tvākāśagīścāsmai śravasormadhyagā jagau ।।39।।
vipra tapasā siddho'si gataṃ te kalmaṣaṃ bahu ।
pūrvajanmā'parādhānāmantastvayā vinirmitaḥ ।।1.264.40।।
tapasā cātha bhajanaistatastvaṃ sāvadhānataḥ ।
yāhi padbhyāṃ tīrthamagryamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।41 ।।
paścimodadhisānnidhye dvīpe cānartasaṃjñake ।
saurāṣṭre deśake tatrā'kṣarakṣetraṃ pravidyate ।।41।।
nāmnā kuṃkumavāpīti nagarī cācyutāśrayā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā''vāsā hi śāśvatī ।।43 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
japa mantraṃ ca satataṃ yāhi taṃ deśamuttamam ।।44।।
sthānabalād deśabalādāśramasya balāttathā ।
devabalād yatnabalādasādhyamapi siddhyati ।।45।।
ityuktā virarāmaiṣā vāṇī tataḥ sa bhūsuraḥ ।
natvā pitre ca mātre ca tapaḥsthānaṃ praṇamya ca ।।46।।
valmīkaṃ plakṣamevā'pi natvā prayayau tairthikaḥ ।
gayāṃ kāśīṃ prayāgaṃ ca indraprasthavanaṃ yamīm ।।47।।
puṣkaraṃ ca nadīṃ sarasvatīṃ siddhasamāśritām ।
bahucarāṃ satīṃ tīrthānyāvīkṣya pravidhāya ca ।।48।।
saurāṣṭraṃ cāviveśā'sau mūkaścatuṣṭilācalam ।
gatvā kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ kṣetramāpā'kṣarābhidham ।।49।।
dṛṣṭvā sarovaraṃ ramyaṃ sāgarābhaṃ mahattamam ।
sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ devadevīsatīsadāśrayam ।।1.264.50।।
maharṣikṛtasandhyādidhyānakarmādiśobhitam ।
tīrthavāsiprajābhiśca snānadānādibṛṃhitam ।।51।।
haṃsagaruḍamenādyaiḥ pakṣivrātaiḥ samanvitam ।
āmrā'mṛtaphalivṛkṣairudyānaiḥ parito'nvitam ।।52।।
īśānavaśyadevādyairgaṇaiḥ saṃrakṣitaṃ sadā ।
yajñabhūmaṇḍapādyaiśca vedaghoṣaiśca nāditam ।।53।।।
kāmadhenukāmalatākalpamaṇivirājitam ।
saṃkīrtanaparairbhaktaiḥ kṛtavaiṣṇavasanmakham ।।।54।।
devakanyārājakanyābrahmapriyā'bhiśobhitam ।
vaikuṇṭhātiprabhāśālikuṃkumānagarīyutam ।।।55।।
tejaḥ paridhisaṃvyāpanmūrddhamuktaprajānvitam ।
rādhāramāsatīlakṣmīkamalāmandirānvitam ।।56।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamandiramastake ।
sahasraikasvarṇaghaṭaiḥ prasāritaprabhānvitam ।।57।।
devālayaiḥ satāṃ sthānairvimānaiścātisampadam ।
vimānānāṃ vyomamārgairgatāgataiḥ sughoṣitam ।। ।58।।
ārtānāṃ duḥkhanāśena saṃstutaṃ ca nijārthibhiḥ ।
candraśītamadhumiṣṭakastūrīgandhasajjalam ।। 59।।
pāvanaṃ pāpināṃ cāpi muktidaṃ brahmadaṃ saraḥ ।
vipro vilokya sahasā divyabhāvamupāgamat ।। 1.264.60 ।।
vismṛtya sarvatīrthāni parāṃ śāntimupāgamat ।
uttare ca taṭe gatvā jalapānamupācarat ।। 61 ।।
sasnau suvidhinā kandaṃ mūlaṃ prabhujya vai tataḥ ।
daivaṃ paitryaṃ cakārāpi pradakṣiṇāṃ tato'karot ।।62 ।।
uttare'tra sthale rājan sthitvā manuṃ jajāpa ca ।
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī nityamaharṣipūjakaḥ ।। 63 ।।
nityaṃ devārhaṇastotrapūjāparo'bhavacchuciḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāpi golokaṃ prāpya yadvat pramodate ।।64।।
tathā mudā mūkavipraḥ kṛtakṛtyaṃ viveda ha ।
atha jñātvā lomaśasyā''śramaṃ yayau mudānvitaḥ ।। 65।।
natvā mumoda bahudhā papāta pādayoḥ ṛṣeḥ ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre ṛṣerbhāvasamanvitaḥ ।। 66 ।।
jihvāgraṃ ca karāgraiśca dhṛtvā'pyadarśayat tadā ।
ceṣṭayā tvārthayaccāpi vāṇī me bhavatu prabho ।।67।।
ṛṣistathā'stviti prāha jihvā'tyajaddhi hrasvatām ।
varṇagrahaṇayogyā sā rājan mamā''śrame'bhavat ।।6 8 ।।
tato jagrāha mantraṃ ca matto nārāyaṇasya saḥ ।
'anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī mamā'stu saḥ' ।।6 9।।
iti mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca viprastvatra taṭe punaḥ ।
snātvā jajāpa vidhinā mantradvayaṃ niśāntare ।।1.264.7 0 ।।
tāvad brāhme muhūrte vai dvādaśyāṃ kārtike site ।
prāvirbabhūva bhagavān pratyakṣastasya gocaraḥ । ।7 1 ।।
aśvaśirā vedadhartā vedamūtirmahāprabhuḥ ।
aśvamukho naradehaḥ sarvavidyāvirājitaḥ ।।72 ।।
śāradāsahitaḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda kṣmāsuraṃ tataḥ ।
vada vipra prasanno'smi kiṃ te manasi vartate ।।7 3 ।।
vipro dṛṣṭvā tathā śrutvā bhagavantaṃ purātanam ।
sahasotthāya vidhinā cakāra daṇḍavannamaḥ ।।74।।
bhāvapuṣpaiḥ prapūjyaiva vavande śubhayā girā ।
dharmamūrte dharmaputra dharmāraṇye prabodhakṛt ।।75 ।।
dhārmikaṃ ca tapantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛpāparo bhavān ।
samuddadhāra māṃ magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare prabho । ।76 ।।
kṛpāṃ vinā na cānyadvai hetuścātra mayā'rjitaḥ ।
yadahaṃ pūrvapāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ prāptavāniha ।।77।।
darśanaṃ prāptavānatra divyaṃ divyasthalasya te ।
divyamūrte kṛpāsindho vāṇī śrīlomaśasya vai ।।78।।
āśīrvādena me jātā darśanāttava cādhunā ।
jātismaro bhavāmyatra smarāmi nindanaṃ tava ।।79।।
prāgbhave śūdravarṇe yat kṛtaṃ daṇḍakasadvane ।
sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāptaṃ hato mṛgo mayā tu yaḥ ।।1.264.8 0 ।।
sa cāste mama janakaḥ śṛṃgadharaḥ saśṛṃgakaḥ ।
ṛṇaṃ tasya pradātuṃ tu tadgṛhe mūkaputrakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
jāto'smi gomatītīrthayogād vipratvamāptavān ।
vipro vidyāvihīnaścet pāpaḥ sa nāmadhārakaḥ ।।82 ।।
tasmād vidyāṃ pradehyatra pitṛṛṇavimocinīm ।
ityuktvā praṇanāmā'sau namo oṃ paramātmane । । 83 ।।
atha śrībhagavānāha vipra tvaṃ mama vāñcchayā ।
kṛpāleśena sarasā śārṅgadhara pravaidikaḥ ।।84।।
sarvauṣadhīnāṃ vijñātā rasānāṃ tattvavedanaḥ ।
guṇajñaśca tathā daivabalo bhava hi sarvathā ।। 85 ।।
ityuktvā bhagavānatra rājaँstirodadhe drutam ।
vipre sā śāradā devī saṃhitā cauṣadhiprabhā ।। 86 ।।
haridvarṇā praviveśa vipraścāyuṣyavedavān ।
abhavat tatkṣaṇādeva kare vidyāmavāptavān ।। 87 ।।
vyaracayattataḥ śīghraṃ śārṅgadharākhyasaṃhitām ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāntike ।।88 ।।
gatvā nivedayāmāsa gṛhītvā''śīrvacāṃsi saḥ ।
lomaśaṃ ca prapūjyā'dhyāpayāmāsa ca bhūsurān ।। 89 ।।
evaṃ śārṅgadharaścātra rājannaśvaśirāhareḥ ।
darśanaṃ prāptavāṃstīrthaṃ śārṅgadharākhyameva tat ।। 1.264.90 ।।
āśvaśirasamevāpi śāradātīrthamityapi ।
vartate cottamaṃ cedaṃ yatra vai tapāadibhiḥ ।। 91 ।।
labhyate vedavijñānaṃ nindāpāpādināśanam ।
snāhi dehi ca viprebhyo'nāthebhyo dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 92 ।।
sa vipraśca tataḥ kālāntare dharmavanaṃ yayau ।
pitaraṃ prāpya mumude khyātiṃ cāvāpa śāśvatīm ।। 93 ।।
yanna tapasā dravyeṇa yatnena nāpi sampadā ।
tadvai bhavati dhyānenā''śīrvādairbhajanena ca ।। 9 4।।
deśabalena cāśrayabalena mahimadṛśā ।
upāstyā jāyate cāpi durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ nṛpa ।। 95 ।।
ityukto nṛpatistatra śārṅgadharaṃ tathā dvijān ।
prapūjya cāplavanaṃ saṃpracakre saraso jale ।।96।।
dadau dānāni vidhinā bahuso'pyabhavattadā ।
tīrthasyaivaṃ pratāpaṃ sa jānan vai rādhike tataḥ ।।97।।
ratnadānaṃ ca godānaṃ vidyādānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
chatradānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūṣādānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।98।।
annadānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ cakāra cāśvapāṭalaḥ ।
natvā tīrthaṃ surān natvā lomaśena samaṃ tataḥ ।। 99।।
yayau cāgre śubhaṃ tīrthāntaraṃ māhātmyasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya vidyāvān vai prajāyate ।। 1.264.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne nindakaśūdrasya hariṇaghātino godāvaryāṃ maraṇāddharmāraṇye mūkaviprajanma, tapasā kṣīṇapāpasya kuṃkumavāpyāmoṣadhividyāvijñānaṃ, mūkatānāśaḥ śārṅgadharasaṃhitākartṛtvaṃ, śārṅgadharatīrthamāśvaśirasatīrthamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuṣṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 264 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ca tataścāpi śṛṇu tīrthaṃ kṣayāpaham ।
aśvapāṭalarājā'sau gatvā papraccha lomaśam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca -
etattīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vada me nāmasaṃyutam ।
phalaṃ kīdṛk kadā jātaṃ kasyeti brūhi me guro ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
rājan purā'bhavacchūdraḥ pārṣṇiradābhidhaḥ śubhaḥ ।
ajāsaṃrakṣako bhadrānadītīranivāsakṛt ।। 3 ।।
ājabālānnaravargānarbhakāneva vai vane ।
kṣudrabadarikājāle nikṣipatyeva nirdayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
svārthaparo hi loko'yaṃ vinā svārthe na rakṣati ।
ajāputryo dvivarṣānte bhavantyeva payaḥpradāḥ ।। 5 ।।
ajāputrāstu viphalā bahavo'sya nirarthakāḥ ।
rakṣaṇīyā vṛthā ceti matvā tyajati nirjane ।। 6 ।।
ajāprasavakāle vai bālāṃ bālaṃ pravīkṣya saḥ ।
narāँstyajati jālādau kaṇṭakādau hi nirdayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
bālikāstu sadā cājāpālā rakṣanti cāśayā ।
evaṃ vai jālake tyaktā arbhakā vanacāribhiḥ ।। 8 ।।
śṛgālādibhiśca rātrau bhujyante krūraprāṇibhiḥ ।
arbhakā bahukaṣṭena nidhanaṃ yānti vai tadā ।। 9 ।।
śapanti cārbhakāstatra kṣepakān duḥkhadāँstathā ।
yathā vayaṃ vane kṣiptā vyāpāditāśca bhakṣitāḥ ।। 2.265.1 0।।
vanibhiḥ prāṇibhistadvat tvadbālāḥ syuśca bhakṣitāḥ ।
evaṃ śapanti paśavaḥ putratulyā hi pālinaḥ ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ duḥkhapradātṝṇāṃ bālā naśyanti vai muhuḥ ।
nirvaṃśāste tu jāyante yairhatāḥ putrarūpiṇaḥ ।। 12।।
putrā vai bahudhā proktāḥ patnyāṃ caurasa eva saḥ ।
apatnyāṃ sa tu dāyādaḥ parasmādaṃkake kṛtaḥ ।। 13 ।।
kuṭumbaputrakaścāpi tathā bhṛtyo'pi putrakaḥ ।
śiṣyaśca putra evāpi śaraṇāgataputrakaḥ ।। 14।।
pālitaścāpi putraścā'dhyāpitaḥ putra ityapi ।
ta ete mānavāḥ putrāḥ putryaḥ proktāśca bhūmipa ।। 15।।
tāteti ca vadan nityaṃ putro bhavati sadṛśaḥ ।
atha gopaśavaścoṣṭrā aśvā mṛgā ajāvayaḥ ।। 16।।
mahiṣyo vṛṣabhāḥ śvāno gajā gardabhagovṛṣāḥ ।
pālitāḥ paśavaḥ sarve putrāḥ putryo bhavanti te ।। 17 ।।
svāminā putravatpālyāḥ siṃhādyā vānarā api ।
śukā menāḥ śaśādyāśca kapotāścakrakādayaḥ ।। 18।।
haṃsāśca garuḍāścāpi dāsā dāsyaśca putrakāḥ ।
rājñāṃ prajāḥ sadā putryo guroḥ śiṣyā hi putrakāḥ ।। 19।।
vṛddhānāṃ bālavargāśca putratulyā hi putrakāḥ ।
phalivṛkṣāḥ puṣpadrumā vardhitā bījato hi ye ।।2.265.20।।
sarve putrāḥ putrasamā na ghātyāḥ svāminā hi te ।
hanane tu yathā hatyā tathaiva nirjane vane ।।21 ।।
prakṣipte maraṇārthaṃ vai kṣudhātṛṣāprapīḍite ।
dviguṇā bālahatyā sā jāyate kṣepiṇo hi sā ।।22।।
tatpāpaṃ raurave duḥkhaṃ nirvaṃśatvamihāpi ca ।
āpadyate hi tatkarturbālahatyāphalaṃ nṛpa ।।23।।
pārṣṇirado hyajāpālo bahuhatyābhidūṣitaḥ ।
mṛtaputro'bhavaccāpi mṛtabhāryastato'bhavat ।।24।।।
mṛtavaṃśo'bhavaccāpi sarvanāśārditastviha ।
gṛhaṃ tasyā'bhavat sasyapulākaiḥ chāditaṃ tu yat। ।।25।।।
sarvaṃ tad vahninā dagdhaṃ sopaskaraṃ hi bhasmasāt ।
nā'vaśiṣyata evā'sya vinā vai kambaladvayam ।।।26 ।।
ajāśālā pradagdhā ca ajā dudruvurāturāḥ ।
rātrau caureṇa nītāstā ajāhīno babhūva ca ।।27।।
ityevaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ bālahatyā mahattamā ।
tatphalaṃ tvāptavān pārṣṇirado jīvanavarjitaḥ ।।28।।
samabhūd duṣṭabhāgyācca kṣayarogī praduḥkhitaḥ ।
tyaktvā bhadrānadīṃ tyaktvā vaṃśavaṭaṃ puraṃ nijam ।।29।।
śrutvā janebhyastīrthaṃ ca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitam ।
āśvapaṭṭasaraḥ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ।। 2.265.3 0।।
uttare'tra taṭe rājannāgatya vīkṣya nirmalam ।
jalaṃ papau tatastatra sasnau nārāyaṇaṃ smaran ।।3 1 ।।
kambaladvayayukto'sau taṭe'tra vāsamācarat ।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa japatyapi ।।32।।।
bālakṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa japatyapi ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārā'pi sarasaḥ paritastathā ।।33।।
lomaśasyā''śrame divyāṃ kathāṃ śuśrāva -mokṣadām ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā nārāyaṇāśrayām ।।34।।
mahāpāpātipāpāni naśyanti bhajanāddhareḥ ।
sādhūnāṃ sevayā sarvapāpāni prajvalanti hi ।।35।।
rogā naśyanti bhajanāt saubhāgyaṃ cābhivardhate ।
hareḥ saṃkīrtanāt kaṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ vilīyate drutam ।। 6।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇepyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
kīrtitaṃ yena bhāvena kaṣṭaṃ tasya vilīyate ।।37।।
harervaśe bhavantyeva kālakarmasvabhāvakāḥ ।
mṛtyubhāgyādikaṃ cāpi līyante harikīrtanāt ।।38।।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa satataṃ yena kīrtitam ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya svargaṃ vā kāmanānvitam ।।39।।
sādhūnāṃ sevayā cāpi bhāgyodayo bhavediha ।
satāmāśīrvacobhiśca dāridryaṃ pravilīyate ।।2.265.40 ।।
api janmasahasrasya pāpaṃ parvatasannibham ।
satsaṃgāllīyate tūrṇaṃ sevayā ca satāṃ tathā ।।41 ।।
ityevaṃ cāśṛṇod vārtā kathāṃ vai saṃhitāgatām ।
harṣaṃ cāvāpa bahudhā bhajanaṃ pracakāra ha ।।42।।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare ।
vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate ।। 43 ।।
evaṃ cakāra bhajanaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadehinām ।
lajjāṃ vihāya satataṃ tālīvādanapūrvakam ।। 44।।
kvacittu nartanaṃ cāpi karotyeva sutānavān ।
kvacittiṣṭhan samāsīnaḥ suptaścā'kīrtayat prabhum ।।45।।
lokayanti janāstvenaṃ nā'yaṃ paśyati kaṃcana ।
kīrtane dattacittaśca dattajihvaḥ sadā'bhavat ।।46।।
sādhūn sādhusamācārān vīkṣya yatīn sato janān ।
kāṣāyāmbaradhartṝṃśca natvā karoti daṇḍavat। । ।47 । ।
mūrdhni dehe mukhe cāpi sādhupādarajaḥ śubham ।
nikṣipatyeva ca stauti dāsaṃ māṃ pāvanaṃ kuru । । 48 । ।
sādhūnāṃ parṇaśālāsu ṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣu ca ।
raṭannārāyaṇaṃ gatvā mārjanādi karoti ca । । 49 ।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi karoti bhāvataḥ sadā ।
sādhūnāṃ bhakṣitaṃ cānnaṃ śiṣṭaṃ cādāya vai tataḥ । ।2.265.5 0 । ।
matvā prasādamevā'nnaṃ sarojale'vadhūya ca ।
pāpahartṛ samaśnāti manyate kṛtakṛtyakam ।। 51 । ।
rājannevaṃ taṭe cātra pārṣṇirado'tibhaktimān ।
vyājāyata dine yāte bhaktirasya vyavardhata ।। 52 । ।
nārado brahmaṇaḥ putrastvekadā bhagavān svayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanahetave ।। 53 ।।
samājagāma sajaṭaḥ sādhuvīṇāṃ ninādayan ।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare ।। 54।।
vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate ।
kīrtayan sa nijavīṇāsvarairmelaṃ vidhāpayan ।। 55 ।।
vyomnaścāvātatāraitattaṭe taddaivanoditaḥ ।
pārṣṇirado drutaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradāntikamāyayau । । 56 ।।
matvā prabhuṃ vā devaṃ vā neme tūrṇaṃ hri daṇḍavat ।
dhūlīṃ tasya nije dehe dhṛtvā nikṣipya cānane । । 57 । ।
'harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare ।
vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate' ।। 58 ।।
ityevaṃ vyājahārā'pi saṃnṛtyan tālikāyutaḥ ।
nāradastaṃ vilokyaiva prasanno'bhūt hṛdā tadā ।। 59 । ।
svasti te'stu tathā''rogyaṃ bhaktiste'stu pareśvare ।
bhaktaivaṃ bhaja govindaṃ sadā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । । 2.265.60 । ।
ityevaṃ pradadau tatrāśīrvādān vai nisargajān ।
tāvattasya tu pāpāni nirgatāni śarīrataḥ । । 61 ।।
yāni tīrthā'vaśiṣṭāni jajvalurbhasmasāttadā ।
kākarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jajvalurbhasmasāttadā । । 62। ।
tato hatyā narīrūpā vikṛtāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇikāḥ ।
niryayuḥ śataśastasya śarīrānnagnikāḥ striyaḥ । । 63 ।।
jajvalustāśca tūrṇa vai bhasmasāttatra cā'bhavat ।
tato'sya dehatastatra niryayuḥ kṣīṇadehinaḥ । । 64।।
vṛddhāḥ sthūlaśirasaśca kṣīṇodarāḥ kṛśorasaḥ ।
makṣikāmaśakāvyāptāḥ puruṣāḥ pāparūpiṇaḥ । । 65 ।।
kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ kṣudhitāśca nirdayāḥ pāpamūrtayaḥ ।
prajajvaluśca sahasā tadotthitena vahninā ।।66।।
bhasmasādabhavaँste'pi tataścāsya śarīrataḥ ।
kaphatantupravāhāśca raktajantumayāḥ khalu ।।67।।
viniryayurdrutaṃ tatra rogagṛhātmakā hi te ।
jajvaluste dhūmrabhūtāścā'mbare vigatāstadā ।।68।।
pārṣṇirado'bhavacchuddho devatulyaśarīravān ।
nāradena kṛto divyo divyatīrthaprabhāvataḥ ।।69।।
sasnau śīghraṃ jale tatra papau vāri śubhaṃ tadā ।
nāradasya caraṇau vai prakṣālyācamanaṃ papau ।।2.265.70 ।।
svarṇāmbarayuto jātaḥ svarṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ।
candrakāntyānanaḥ sūryaprabhaḥ surālayocitaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
nanarta divyadeho'pi dhūlīṃ kṛtvā ca varṣmaṇi ।
muhurnāradapādasthāṃ mahimānaṃ vibhāvya saḥ ।।72।।
harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa harehare ।
vāsudeva parabrahma paramātman śriyaḥpate ।।73 ।।
kīrtayatyeva satataṃ nānyad vadati vai tadā ।
devabhūto'bhavaccāpi visasmāra na kīrtanam ।। 74 ।।
nārado'pi mahāścaryaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham ।
bhaktaṃ bhaktottamaṃ tatra kṣaṇaṃ tasthau hi sannidhau ।।75।।
aho bhakto'yamevā'sti vaikuṇṭhayogya eva ha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanottaram ।।76।।
enaṃ neṣye hi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kīrtane sahayoginam ।
vicāryetthaṃ ca taṃ nītvā yayau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।77।।
pupūja parayā prītyā kusumādyaiḥ pareśvaram ।
ārārtrikaṃ tathā kṛtvā kṛtvā nṛtyaṃ ca gāyanam ।।78 ।।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā svāgatamānanam ।
pārṣṇiradaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ netumājñāmavāpya ca ।। 79 । ।
nāradastena yuktaśca śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ kaṃbharāṃ sampraṇamya ca ।।2.265.8 0 ।।
īśānaṃ lomaśaṃ cāpi natvā brahmapriyāstathā ।
smārayitvā vivāhasya kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasya mārgake ।।8 1 ।।
śukle caturthadivase vihasya ca prasādya ca ।
yayau pārṣṇiradasthānaṃ pārṣṇiradaṃ jagāda ha ।।82।।
atra tīrthaṃ tava nāmnā pārṣṇiradaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
nāradākhyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ nṛtyatīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।8 3 । ।
bhakta māsaṃ vasātraiva kuru matparṇakālayam ।
mṛttikānāradaṃ sthāpya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇavivāhanam ।।84।।
tato yāsyasi vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyadehaścaturbhujaḥ ।
ityuktvā taṃ taṭe tyaktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।85।।
punargatvā hariṃ prāha vaktukāmo'smi sevakaḥ ।
kāśyāṃ śrīduḥkhahālakṣmīḥ śivarājasya putrikā ।।86।।
samīkṣate vivāhaṃ ca tathā brahmapriyāḥ prabho ।
mārgaśīrṣasya dhavale caturthyāṃ śreyasāṃ nidhau ।।87।।
samaye bhagavāँstatra vivāhavidhimācara ।
smārayāmi bhagavantaṃ sarvajñamapi bhaktitaḥ ।।88।।
brahmapriyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ mānasairviniveditaḥ ।
ityuktvā prayayau cāpi nāradaśca yadā tadā ।।89।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hi nāradam ।
yāhi tvaṃ kāśikāṃ tatra śiveśvaragṛhaṃ prati ।।2.265.90।।
gatvā sarvaṃ yathāyogyaṃ jñātvā māṃ vinivedaya ।
tathāstvitinideśaṃ ca prāpya nāradako muniḥ ।।9 1।।
yayau tīrthanimittena jñātuṃ vṛttāntakaṃ nṛpa ।
tadidaṃ nāradaṃ tīrthaṃ pārṣṇiradaṃ ca tīrthakam ।।92।।
pāpahaṃ kṣayahaṃ tīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ samucyate ।
atra snānāt samagrāṇi naśyanti pāpakāni hi ।।93।।
atra dānāśca jāyante smṛddhayaḥ svargasannibhāḥ ।
atra vai tapasā cāpi bhajanena ca kīrtanāt ।।94।।
nartanācca bhaved divyaṃ śarīraṃ devasannibham ।
āyuṣyaṃ vardhate cāpi bhāgyaṃ prakāśate tathā ।। 95।।
satāṃ sevāsamo lābhaścātra vāsād bhavennṛpa ।
satāṃ prāptirbhaveccāpi śāntānāṃ mokṣadāyinām ।।96।।
akāmo labhate muktiṃ sakāmo labhate divam ।
viṣṇubhaktastu vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।97।।
rājannatra jalaṃ pītvā snātvā natvā ca nāradam ।
dehi dānāni dhenūnāṃ rājasūyaphalāni vai ।।98।।
ityuktau rādhike rājā dhenudānāni vai dadau ।
datvā tathā'nyadānāni snānādividhimācarat ।।99।।
tatastīrthaṃ paścimaṃ ca tato jagāma sānvayaḥ ।
lomaśena tu sahito rājā'śvapāṭalaḥ śuciḥ ।। 2.265.10 0।।
paṭhanācchravaṇādasya pāpanāśo bhavettathā ।
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi yatheṣṭāṃ ca gatiṃ labhet ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pārṣṇiradanāmakā'jāpālaśūdrasyā'śvapaṭṭasarovare snānādinā kṣayaroganivāraṇaṃ nāradatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 265 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rāseśvari priye paścād rājā tīrthāgryamāyayau ।
papraccha lomaśaṃ tatra māhātmyaṃ nāma cetyapi ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
idaṃ tīrthaṃ kadā cātra khyātiṃ prāpa kiyadbalam ।
kena kṛtaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brūhi saṃkṣepato guro ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
rājan purā samāraṃbhe sṛṣṭervyāso hariḥ svayam ।
śvetavyāsasvarūpo'trā''jagāma tīrthavāñcchayā ।। 3 ।।
atra tīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā snātvā prapūjya mādhavam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā tataḥparam ।। 4 ।।
vastrāpathaṃ somanāthaṃ mūladvārāvatīṃ yayau ।
gopanāthaṃ staṃbhatīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca puṣkaraṃ tathā ।। 5 ।।
kurukṣetraṃ yayau yatra nijāvāso hi vartate ।
tadā pṛthvyāṃ bahavo'sya śiṣyā vedādivedinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
abhavan lokamokṣārthaṃ jñānadānādikāriṇaḥ ।
atra pūrve yojanādvai dūre cā'rkapure'bhavat ।। 7 ।।
śvetavyāsasya śiṣyo vai vipro dharmasumantukaḥ ।
vyāsatulyo maharṣiḥ saḥ sarovarataṭe sadā ।। 8 ।।
vaṭavṛkṣe nijāvāsaṃ kṛtvā prajājanān bahūn ।
śreyomārgaṃ jñānarūpaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ vṛṣānvitam ।। 9 ।।
samādiśatyajasraṃ ca brāhmaṇaiḥ sevito'bhavat ।
pārśvagrāmajanāstatra kathāṃ śrotuṃ samutsukāḥ ।। 2.266.1 0।।
samāyānti sadā sāyaṃ prayānti punareva ca ।
hariṃ vinā na kalyāṇaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā na mokṣaṇam ।। 11 ।।
jñānaṃ vinā na tamaso vilayo māyike gṛhe ।
sādhuṃ vinā na sākṣādvai bhagavatprāptireva ha ।। 12।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāntarago hi naḥ ।
hariṃ bhajata kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ śvetavyāsasvarūpiṇam ।। 1 3।।
evaṃ dadātyupadeśaṃ saṃhitāṃ vācayatyapi ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro nityaṃ prātaḥ snānāya yāti ca ।। 14।।
kṛtvā tīrthavidhiṃ cāpi natvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
ṛṣīn natvā surān sampūjya prayāti svamandiram ।। 15।।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya viprasya vedavedinaḥ ।
sarpadaṃśo'bhavanmārge nirjane tīrthakāriṇaḥ ।। 16।।
tūrṇaṃ yogaparo bhūtvā niṣadya ca samādhinā ।
prāṇānāyamya mārgasya tīre yāntaṃ phaṇādharam ।। 17।।
āhvayāmāsa vipraḥ sa prasahya vaśagaṃ vyadhāt ।
phaṇādharo'pi balavān trāsaṃ prāpya tataḥ sthalāt ।। 18।।
vidravituṃ yatate'pi na śaśāka pradhāvitum ।
viprādhīnastadā bhūtvā sṛtvā sṛtvā dvijāntikam ।। 19।।
āgatya nipapātaiva rakṣa rakṣeti saṃvadan ।
daṃśākhyaścāparāddho vai mayā te'tra kṛto dvija ।।2.266.20।।
mā māṃ māraya viprendra prāṇāḥ priyāśca te ca me ।
kṣamāṃ yāce tāmaso'haṃ svabhāvo mama tādṛśaḥ ।।।21 ।।
sāttvikastvaṃ svabhāvaste dayādharma iti dvija ।
tiryagyonau vrajato me kadā mokṣo bhavediti ।।22।।
tava yogena me mokṣo bhavatyatrā'parādhinaḥ ।
mama mokṣo yathā syādvai tathā vipra vidhehi ca ।।23।।
yadvā jñānaṃ pradāyaiva pāvanaṃ māṃ vidhehi ca ।
śatrubuddhyā tu māṃ mā'tra mārayeti praprārthaye ।।24।।
śrutvā sarpasya vacanaṃ dharmasumantukastadā ।
bhūtvā dayāparastasmai papraccha janmakāraṇam ।।25।।
kastvaṃ kasmāt sarpayoniṃ prāpto'si kena karmaṇā ।
vaktuṃ jānāsi sarvaṃ cedātmaśreyaḥ karoṣi na ।।26।।
kimatra kāraṇaṃ sarpa jñātā san bhrāmyasi kutaḥ ।
jñātā māṃ saṃdaśitavān ko lābhaste'tra saṃmataḥ ।।27।।
sarpa uvāca-
śṛṇu vipra kathayāmi sarvaṃ paścād yathātatham ।
lābhavārtāṃ kathayāmi praśno'yaṃ nopayujyate ।।28।।
sraṣṭrā sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā tredhā sattvarajastamomayī ।
sāttvikāḥ śamamicchanti rājasā rāgamityapi ।।29।।।
tāmasāḥ kleśamicchanti svabhāvo'yaṃ duratyayaḥ ।
vahniḥ prajvālayatyeva ko lābho dahane'sya vai ।।2.266.3 0।।
jalaṃ tṛṣāṃ ca jantūnāṃ nivārayati sarvadā ।
vṛṣṭirvarṣati ko lābho jalasyā'tra vadasva me ।।3 1 ।।
vāyurvāti kvacid rūkṣaḥ krūro mṛduśca vegavān ।
ko lābho'sya bhavet tatra svabhāvastādṛśo yataḥ ।।32।।
sāttvikaḥ śāntimabhyeti jalaṃ śaityaṃ vahatyapi ।
candraḥ śītaḥ śilā śītā ko lābhastatra tatkṛte ।।33 ।।
sāgaro lavaṇātmā ca dugdhaṃ miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ tathā ।
tikto nimbaḥ kaṭuḥ śūṇṭhī ko lābhastatra tasya vai ।।34।।
raktaṃ japāyāḥ kusumaṃ raktaṃ raktaṃ ca kuṃkumam ।
rājasā devavargāśca ko lābho rājasasya vai ।।35 ।।
vidyutpātastathā vajrapātaḥ kālaśca saṃkṣayaḥ ।
mṛtyustathā'ndhakāraśca tāmasā vai svabhāvataḥ ।।36।।
bhaṃgā gaṃjā dhatturaśca tāmasāste svabhāvajāḥ ।
vadātra vidvan teṣāṃ vai ko lābhastāmasodbhavaḥ ।।37।।
svabhāve svasya lābho na dṛśyate vai tamovrate ।
yathāguṇaṃ pravartante bhūtāni nimnavārivat ।।38।।
yathāsvabhāvā pravṛttirdantānāṃ carvaṇādivat ।
naisargaṃ tu bhavet karma śastrapātena ghātavat ।।39।।
tathā mayā kṛtaṃ cedaṃ mā tatra kroddhumarhasi ।
lābhavārtā na te'pyasti snānaṃ vipravṛṣo yathā ।।2.266.40 ।।
rātrau nidrā bhavatyeva divase jāgaraṃ tathā ।
svabhāvaracitaṃ tvetat ko lābhastatra saṃbhṛtaḥ ।।41।।
bālye krīḍāmatirmadhye kāme'nte vimatistathā ।
ke lābhāstatra nihatāḥ svabhāvena pravartate ।।।42।।
bhavanti sādhavaḥ kecit keciccauryādikarmiṇaḥ ।
kecidīśvarabhāvāśca ke lābhāstatra me vada ।।।43।।
sarpo vai tāmasaścā'haṃ daṃṣṭrā me tāmasī matā ।
sā ca kṣataṃ karotyeva daṃṣṭrālābho'tra ko mataḥ ।।44।।
viṣaṃ vahnisvabhāvaṃ vai lālārūpaṃ pravāhaṇam ।
vidyutsamaṃ praveśe'pi vyāpane stanayitnuvat ।।45।।
rudhire nāḍikāgrāme vahatyeva jalādivat ।
svabhāvo'yaṃ viṣasyaiva ko lābho'tra viṣasya vai ।।46।।
pṛthvyādyā ye tu saṃyuktā viyogākhyasvabhāvinaḥ ।
nāḍyo grāsasvabhāvāśca ko lābho viṣasaṃgrahe ।।47।।
vada vipra prāṇanāśe dehanāśe svabhāvaje ।
mayi nāśe tvayi nāśe ko lābho'tra nijātmanoḥ ।।48।।
dehanāśe nātmalābho naśvaraṃ gatvaraṃ vapuḥ ।
gacchatyeva svabhāvena mā khedaṃ kuru bhūsura ।।49।।
gatvareṇa tu dehena lābho mokṣo hi dehinaḥ ।
samarthastvaṃ kṛtakṛtyo muktiṃ vidhehi me'nagha ।।2.266.50।।
muktilābhaḥ paro lābhaste me'pi dehināṃ tathā ।
mā krodhaṃ vaha viprendra roṣo vai nirayapradaḥ ।।।51 ।।
mayā roṣeṇa vai prāptā yoniriyaṃ viṣolbaṇā ।
nirayākhyā tato vipra mā krodhaṃ kuru māṃ prati ।।52।।
dharmasumanturuvāca-
aho vidvan khyāyase tvaṃ sarpo'pi munirāḍiva ।
ko'si sarpatvarūpastvaṃ mama prāṇaharo vada ।।5 3 ।।
mṛtyurvā ca mahākālo yamadūto yamaḥ svayam ।
matprārabdha ca vā karma vanadevo'si vā vada ।।54।।
saṃkarṣaṇo vā śeṣo vā jñānī kastvaṃ naro'si vā ।
preto vā satyasarpo vā jātismaro'si ko nviha ।।।55।।
sarpabhāve'pi naisargaṃ bhāṣase śāstrasammatam ।
svabhāvena prayātānāṃ lābho nāsti jaḍātmanām ।।56।।
lābhaḥ prāptirhi saṃyogo jaḍānāṃ kiṃ ca tena vai ।
lābhaḥ prāptiḥ sukhādeśca bhogaścātmani vai mataḥ ।।57।।
sukhaduḥkhapravedo'yaṃ jīve bhavati bhogakaḥ ।
śatrunāśe bhavecchāntirmanyate mūrkhamāyikaḥ ।।58।।
ajātaśatruścātmā'sti sukhaduḥkhaparaṃ gataḥ ।
nāsya lābhaśca vā hānirdehayogaviyogataḥ ।।59।।
phaṇin kintu mokṣaheturmānavaṃ varṣma sammatam ।
asampādya ca mokṣaṃ vā sādhanaṃ śreyasā pradam ।।2.266.6 0।।
madhye mṛtyurbhaveccet sā mokṣahānirbhavediti ।
alābhaḥ sa bhavedatra tatra nimittamāptavān ।।6 1 ।।
sarpa tvaṃ brahmahatyāyā bhāgavānatra doṣavān ।
amokṣago bhavasyatra pāpavān nahi lābhavān ।।62।।
ahaṃ cet tvāṃ mārayāmi me'pi lābho na vidyate ।
dehanāśe na vai lābho mokṣahānā ca nāpi saḥ ।।6 3 ।।
alābhau tvāvayostulyau vada kastvaṃ pravittimān ।
lābho vā'tra tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ kīdṛśo vada me phaṇin ।।64।।
sarpa uvāca-
aho vipra svabhāvena komalo'si dayāparaḥ ।
jñānena ca bṛhaspatisamo'si vyāsadevavat ।।6 5 ।।
rāgadveṣarahito'si lābhā'lābhavivecane ।
vadāmi sūtrarūpeṇa lābhā'lābhau śṛṇu tviha ।।66 ।।
lābhaḥ samayasatkāro hāniḥ sā samayacyutiḥ ।
prāpte vai samaye yogye satkāreṇa yunakti na ।।67।।
gataḥ sa samayaḥ paścānnaivā''yātigato gataḥ ।
mamā''sīt samayaścātra mānuṣe kṣatravarṣmaṇi ।।68।।
arkagrāme tava grāme smṛddhe smṛddhisamanvite ।
mama putrā bāndhavāśca bhṛtyā dāsādayastathā ।
aśvā gṛhāṇi kṣetrāṇi vidyante tava pattane ।।6 9 ।।
mayā visṛṣṭāste sarve māṃ na jānanti māyikāḥ ।
ahaṃ jātismaraḥ sarvān jānāmi tvāṃ tathā parān ।
grāmān sarvalokāँśca tvaṃ na jānāsi māmiha ।।2.266.70।।
śṛṇu vipra kathayāmi tava grāmanṛpo hi yaḥ ।
nāmnā śārdūlacandraśca so'hamāsaṃ janādhipaḥ ।।71 ।।
nāstiko nindakaścāpi viprā'vamānakārakaḥ ।
dharmakarmavihīnaśca hetuvāde rataḥ sadā ।।72।।
tvaṃ ca vipra mama grāme kathāṃ kurvan janān diśan ।
muhurmāṃ ca samāgatya dharmārthaṃ samupādiśaḥ ।।73।।
dānārthaṃ havanārthaṃ paropakārārthamityapi ।
mayā vākyaṃ tavoktaṃ vai nāṅgīkṛtaṃ kvacittadā ।।74।।
tiraskṛto bhavāँstatra ninditaśca mayā bahu ।
athaikadā tvaṃ yajñārthaṃ yāñcāṃ vai kṛtavān śubhām ।।75।।
suvarṇasya dhanādeśca mayā jñātvā tu vañcakaḥ ।
ruṣā niṣkāsito grāmād bahistvaṃ vaṭamāśritaḥ ।।76 ।।
śārdūlo'yaṃ māṃ śaśāpa mṛtyumāpnotu nindakaḥ ।
tenā'haṃ maraṇaṃ prāptaḥ sakrodhastvāṃ pratīti ca ।।77।।
sarpabhāvaṃ ceha tiryagyoniṃ prāpto'smi sa nṛpaḥ ।
duḥkhaṃ paśyāmi ca jātiṃ smarāmi sarvabāndhavān ।।78।।
darśayāmyapi svaṃ tvete naiva jānanti māmimam ।
brāhmaṇā nāvamantavyā brahmabhaktāḥ kadācana ।।79।।
vidvāṃso nāvamantavyā jñānāgnimūrtayaḥ kvacit ।
avamanturbhavennāśo nāśayiturvināśanam ।।2.266.80।।
baliṣṭhe'gnau patadvāri svayameva pradahyati ।
ahaṃ pradagdhaḥ śāpena sarpayoniṃ gato'smyapi ।।81।.।
vairabuddhiṃ smarāmyeva hantuṃ tvāṃ mārgayāmi ca ।
adya tvaṃ nirjane prāpto mayā daṃṣṭo virodhataḥ ।।82।।
vairaniryāpanārthaṃ vai mṛtyuste'sti dhruvo dvija ।
svasvakarmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte dehi kvāpi ca varṣmaṇi ।।83।।
krodhena śāpadānena rājahatyākṛtena ca ।
prāyaścittavihīnasya tavā''yuṣyamiti gatam ।।84।।
mama rājñyāśca duḥkhena tavā''yuṣyaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam ।
satīnāṃ tu viniḥśvāsairjvalanti brāhmaṇā api ।।85।।
tattathaiva hi viprendra tavā''yuṣyaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam ।
yeṣāmāyuṣyavigamaste na jīvanti vai kṣaṇam ।।86।।
kāladūtāḥ samāyānti preritāstūrṇameva ha ।
nāśayanti gatāyuṣyaṃ dūtā nimittamātrakāḥ ।।87।.।
sarpāśca vṛścikāścāpi viṣaśvāno viṣauṣadham ।
bhūtapretapiśācādyā yamadūtā grahādayaḥ ।।88।।
vahnirjalaṃ jvarādyāśca śatravo'pi nimittakam ।
hanyate sa nimittena hantā'syā'sti paro'paraḥ ।।89।।
avijñāya nvidaṃ tattvaṃ dviṣanti vṛścikādikān ।
tasmād vipra mṛtiste'tra dhruvā me'pi mṛtirdhruvā ।।2.266.90।।
muktaye tvaṃ samartho'si mamā'pi ca tavā'pi ca ।
naradehaḥ karmabhūmistena sarvamavāpyate ।। 91 ।।
prāṇānte'pi kṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rakṣatyeva prakāriṇam ।
maraṇaṃ dhruvamastyeva kuru yanmokṣaṇaṃ hi nau ।।92।।
jīvā'bhayapradānaṃ vai sarvamedhādhikaṃ phalam ।
dadātyeva tato vipra mama mokṣaṃ vidhehi vai ।। 93।।
vipraścoktastatastūrṇaṃ sarpāya kalaśājjalam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।94।।
itimantreṇa sammantrya dadau pānārthameva ca ।
taddehe prokṣitavāँśca sarpo dehaṃ vihāya ca ।। 95।।
tūrṇaṃ devasvarūpo vai bhūtvā svargaṃ yayau tadā ।
brāhmaṇaśca prasasmāra viṣadagdho hariṃ prabhum ।।96 ।।
dehaṃ tatyāja tatraiva mārgāṭavyāṃ hi nirjane ।
ātmā'sya ca samaprāptaścāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।97।।
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe tatra tasthāvante yathāmati ।
atha karṣukalokena vipro mṛto vilokitaḥ ।।98।।
karṣukastu gato grāmaṃ viprebhyo vṛttamāha tat ।
dvijā nītvā śavaṃ dagdhuṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।99।।
āyayū ruruduḥ sarve bāndhavāḥ sarasastaṭe ।
śavaṃ nidhāya vai sarve guṇān jagurdvijasya ha ।। 2.266.100 ।।
śvetavyāsasamaścāyaṃ dharmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
mokṣadaścāpi lokānāṃ durlabho vipra īdṛśaḥ ।। 101 ।।
śvetavyāsasya śiṣyo'yaṃ samādhisthitipāragaḥ ।
sarpadaṃśanimittena mṛtaścāścaryameva tat ।। 102।।
āyuṣyaṃ chinnatāṃ prāptaṃ sandhīyate na kenacit ।
vinā vai paramātmānaṃ vinā guruṃ ca yoginam ।। 1 03।।
ityevaṃ te vadantaśca śvetavyāsaṃ prasasmaruḥ ।
sasmaruḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 1 04।।
atha rājaṃstasya bhāryā viprāṇī duḥkhaduḥkhitā ।
satībhāvecchayā tatra citābhyāśe samāyayau ।। 105।।
śvetavyāsaṃ prasasmāra tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
śavaṃ prapūjya vidhinā citāyāṃ sā samārpayat ।। 1 06।।
vahniṃ prajvālya pādāgrād yāvad dagdhuṃ samīhate ।
tāvattatra bhaktivaśo bhagavān kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 1 07।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śvetasvarūpavān ।
śvetavyāsātmakastatrā''yayau dharmasumantunā ।। 1 08।।
sahaiva sa citāpārśve gatvā satīṃ jagāda ha ।
eṣa te patirāste vai gṛhāṇa mā hyanu jvala ।। 109 ।।
tāvat samutthito vipro jīvan śvasan hasan kṣaṇāt ।
satī magnā'bhavaccāpi prasedurbrāhmaṇā api ।। 2.266.110 ।।
tīrthaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sarve yayuścārkapuraṃ prati ।
śvetavyāsākhyatīrthaṃ tat satītīrthaṃ tathā nṛpa ।। 111 ।।
jīvatīrthamidaṃ cāste snāhi tīrthavidhiṃ cara ।
ityādiṣṭo nṛpaścāśvapāṭalastatra rādhike ।। 112 ।।
śvetavyāsasya vai pūjāṃ cakāra snānamācarat ।
dadau dānāni bahūni tato yayau sthalāntaram ।। 113 ।।
lomaśena samaṃ tīre tīrthāntare sthiro'bhavat ।
sasmāra śrīhariṃ cāpi neme tīrthaṃ ca mandiram ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'rkapurīnṛpasya dharmasumantuṛṣiśāpena sarpatā, viprasya sarpadaṃśaḥ, sarpamokṣaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarovare śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena viprapatnyāḥ satyāḥ prārthanayā vipro jīvitaḥ, śvetavyāsatīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 266 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 266 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 267
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 268 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha rādhe tatastīrthaṃ nārīṇāṃ dharmavardhanam ।
gatvā'śvapāṭalo rājā papraccha lomaśaṃ munim ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kimidaṃ śobhanaṃ tīrthaṃ guro strījātimokṣadam ।
dharmadaṃ bahusāmarthyapradaṃ vada kadā'bhavat ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan satītīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ paramādbhutam ।
surāṣṭranṛpateḥ patnī vastrāpathanivāsinī ।। 3 ।।
pātivratyaparā cāsīd rāṇikākhyā mahāsatī ।
rakṣāṃgārakanāmānaṃ nṛpaṃ tvīśvarasannibham ।। 4 ।।
sevate sma satī kāntaṃ sarvasevābhirutsukā ।
svarṇapattananāmnyeva nagare nagarottame ।। 5 ।।
kṛtasmarādrinikaṭe svarṇalekhānadītaṭe ।
rājadhānyāṃ sadurgāyāṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājamandire ।। 6 ।।
asūryampaśyā pramadā satīdharmasamanvitā ।
bhajate sma hariṃ nityaṃ dāmodaraṃ hi vāmanam ।। 7 ।।
rājyamātā rāṇikā sā sādhvīvrataṃ karoti vai ।
anyo naro na spraṣṭavyaḥ kvāpi svapatimantarā ।। 8 ।।
anyapuruṣavastraṃ na spraṣṭavyaṃ nūtanaṃ vinā ।
anyanaramukhaṃ naiva draṣṭavyaṃ svapatiṃ vinā ।। 9 ।।
gṛhād bahirna gantavyaṃ kvāpi svapatimantarā ।
patyuḥ sevāṃ sadā tvevaṃ karoti svakareṇa ha ।। 2.267.10 ।।
bhojanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dehamardanam ।
sarvaṃ svameva raṇikā sampādayatyatandritā ।। 11 ।।
nityaṃ dāmodaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayatyapi vāmanam ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ cānnaṃ nivedya viṣṇave ।। 1 2।।
datvā'tithaye mahate sādhave dhenave tathā ।
pataye bhṛtyavargāya tataścāśnāti sā satī ।। 13 ।।
evaṃ dharmaparā sā''ste śīlavrataparāyaṇā ।
yasyā gṛhe sadā''yāti śrīdevī yā bhaveśvarī ।। 14।।
mahālakṣmīḥ sakhīrūpā pūjā gṛhṇāti tatkṛtām ।
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ komalāṅgyā niśāntake ।। 15।।
nidrāyāṃ svapnasṛṣṭau vai mlecchānāṃ darśanaṃ hyabhūt ।
sainyaṃ rājyaṃ grahītuṃ vai samāyātaṃ samantataḥ ।। 16 ।।
rājā rakṣāṃgārako'pi yuddhārthaṃ nirdadau tataḥ ।
mṛto yuddhe patiścaiva tvaniṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ hyabhūt ।। 17।।
tūrṇamutthāya śayanāt satī patiṃ jagāda ha ।
adya svapnaṃ mayā nāthā'niṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ vināśakṛt ।। 18 ।।
tato'haṃ śrīmahālakṣmīṃ pūjayāmi bhaveśvarīm ।
vyāghreśvarīṃ pūjayāmi vighnarājaṃ namāmi ca ।। 1 9।।
ityāśāṃ saṃgṛhītvaiva tūrṇaṃ snātvā pupūja tāḥ ।
devatāśca namaskṛtya prārthayad rakṣaṇaṃ prati ।। 2.267.20 ।।
amaṃgalavināśārthaṃ vighnarājātpunaḥ punaḥ ।
prārthayad rāṇikādevī dadau dānāni vai tathā ।। 21 ।।
kārayāmāsa ca tato grahaśāntiṃ dvijādibhiḥ ।
atha prasannā pratyakṣā mahālakṣmīrbhaveśvarī ।। 22।।
jagādaināṃ rājyavighnaṃ bhavitā mlecchajātibhiḥ ।
yuddhaṃ cāpi bhavedatra sainyayośca dvayorapi ।। 23 ।।
rājā rakṣāṃgārakaśca mā samprayātu yodhane ।
durgād bahirna vai yātu tadā te vijayo'sti vai ।।24।।
śatravaśca vinakṣyanti durgād bahiḥ samantataḥ ।
durgamadhye vijayaste durgādbahiḥ parājayaḥ ।। 25 ।।
ityuktā sā satī rājñe'kathayat sarvameva tat ।
rājā'pi sāvadhānaśca vartatesma nijālaye ।। 26।।
tāvanmlecchāḥ paścabhāgāt sainyayuktāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
ayutā'yutasaṃkhyākāḥ saśastrā gajavāhanāḥ ।।।27।।
aśvavāhā rathasthāśca durgadvārāṇi cābhitaḥ ।
niruddhya dvārabandhaṃ ca racayitvā'bhavan sthirāḥ ।।28।।
dṛptā vai rājapuruṣāḥ sainyaiśca nagarāntare ।
dvārāṇyāvṛttya ca tathā pratitasthuḥ saśastrakāḥ ।।29।।
śatravo bahavaścābhibhāgebhyo yantragolakān ।
jetuṃ ca nagaraṃ durge cikṣipurbahunāśakān ।।2.267.3 0।।
bahubhirdivasaiścāpi praveṣṭuṃ naiva śekire ।
tadā bhedaṃ samupāyaṃ cakruste mlecchapuṃgavāḥ ।। 31 ।।
dhanāni svarṇarūpyāṇi datvā vāṇyā'pi kharvaṭān ।
guptaṃ purapraveśasya mārgaṃ vijñāya bhedakāt ।। 32।।
durgaṃ vibhidya taddvāre praviśya mlecchajātayaḥ ।
yuyudhuśca prajahruśca rājasaudhālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 3 3।।
rājasainyāni tu tadā yuyudhuḥ prāṇadānataḥ ।
hatā mtṭhecchā hi bahavo hatāśca rājasainikāḥ ।।34।।
senānāṃ patayaścāpi hatā vai śastraghātataḥ ।
yadā svabhavanaṃ prāptaṃ sainyaṃ mlecchajanābhidham ।। 35 ।।
tadā rājā svarakṣārthaṃ yoddhaṃ hyavātaranmṛdhe ।
atha prajā'pi sabalā mlecchānamārayad bahūn ।। 36 ।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahāsainyaṃ rakṣāṃgārasamāyutam
yuyudhe tu mahāmlecchān mārayāmāsa jīvataḥ ।।37।।
anye pradudruvuścāpi nagarasyaiva madhyataḥ ।
durgaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuśca bahirmlecchaḥ samantataḥ ।। 38।।।
rājā raṇapramatto vai vismṛtya svasatīvacaḥ ।
durgād bahiryayau yoddhuṃ hantuṃ mlecchān palāyitān ।। 3 9।।
te parāvṛttya yuyudhuḥ prāṇadānena vai tadā ।
śastrāghātaiśca rakṣāṃgārakaṃ jaghnuḥ samantataḥ ।।2.267.40।।
rājā mamāra bhūmau ca prāṇān nipatito jahau ।
rāṇikā nijasaudhe vai devapūjāṃ karoti ca ।।41 ।।
rakṣārthaṃ nijakāntasya tāvad dadarśa pādayoḥ ।
cihne rakte cākṣate ca yathārekhe hyubhe bhuvi ।।42 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ kuṃkumapādau svau dṛṣṭvā satī bhayaṃ gatā ।
hā nātheti samuccārya satīsatyaṃ vyalokayat ।।43 ।।
satī satyārūḍhabhāvā vyajāyata kṣaṇāntare ।
divyadṛṣṭyā svakāntasya dṛṣṭvā sūkṣmāṃ tanuṃ tadā ।।44।।
samāgatāṃ gṛhe naije tāṃ gṛhītvā drutaṃ bilāt। ।
vinirgatya svabhavanāt parājayapradharṣitā ।।45।।
puṃveṣeṇa satī sādhvī hyapāsaraddhi tatsthalāt ।
bahirgatvā mahoṣṭraṃ ca prāpya bhāgyavaśāddhi sā ।।46।।
guptāṃ drumasṛtiṃ gatvā niryayau bhayabhūmitaḥ ।
rājyaṃ tyaktvā duḥkhabhoktrī yayāvaśvasaraḥ prati ।।47।।
dinaikenaiva samprāptā sarasaścottare taṭe ।
sarastīre cāvaruhya sasnau ruroda cāntare ।। 48 ।।
jalāñjaliṃ dadau tatra kāntāya sahagāya ca ।
sūkṣmarūpāya ca tataḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।49।।
smṛtvā natvā cārthayitvā tasthau taṭe sthirāśayā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sannidhāviha ।।2.267.50 ।।
dehānalaṃ samutpādya prayāmyeva divaṃ śubham ।
evaṃ niścitya vai sāyaṃ śīlavrataparāyaṇā । ।5 1 ।।
satīṃ satyaṃ pratuṣṭāva tadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
'satyāḥ satyaṃ nityasatyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namāmyaham ।।52 ।।
oṃ namo brahmasavitre satyānāthāya te namaḥ ।
pātivratyasvarūpāya pañcāgnaye ca te namaḥ ।।53 ।।
tretā'gnaye bījasvarūpāya ca te namaḥ ।
garbharūpāya bālyāya yuvarūpāya te namaḥ ।।54।।
kāntāyai cāpi kāntāya savaṃśāya ca te namaḥ ।
yugalāya sthavirāya tryātmakāya ca te namaḥ ।।।55।।
namo bhagavate kṛṣṇa bhagavatyai ca te namaḥ ।
śīlarūpāya dharmāya dharmalābhāya ca te namaḥ ।।56।।
namaścitāsvarūpāya patirūpāya te namaḥ ।
namaḥ pānthasya sārthāyā'tivāhikāyai te namaḥ ।।57 ।।
namaḥ sūryāya meghāya vidyute śaśine namaḥ ।
namo divāsvarūpāya niśārūpāya te namaḥ ।। 58।।
ayanadvayarūpāya namo yugapravartine ।
namo divāya satyāya namo vaikuṇṭhavāsine ।।59 ।।
satīnāṃ pataye kṛṣṇa satīlokeśine namaḥ ।
namo golokakāntāya namo'kṣaranivāsine ।। 2.267.60 ।।
namo muktaprapūjyāya satāṃ ca pataye namaḥ ।
mukteśvareśāya brahmapriyeśa te namaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
namo māṇikyamuktānāṃ ramāyāḥ pataye namaḥ ।
padmāvatīsatīlakṣmīrādhāśrīpataye namaḥ ।। 62 ।।
sarvaśāya pareśāya namaḥ śrīparamātmane ।
lakṣmīśāya namaḥ śrīpuruṣottamāya te namaḥ ।। 63 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
antaryāmisvarūpāya sayuje te namonamaḥ ।।64।।
gopālanandanāyeśa kaṃbharājāya te namaḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasya candrāya māyāsūryāya te namaḥ ।।65।।
smṛddhidāya virāgāya sarvahartre ca te namaḥ ।
eṣā'haṃgṛhasaṃjñā'smi gṛhaṃ satyaṃ bhavānmama ।।66।।
rakṣāṃgārakanāmā tvaṃ tvatparā gīśca yāvatī ।
tvāṃ sahāyaṃ paraṃ prāpya juhomyenāṃ gṛhāṇa mām ।।67।।
viditvā cā'viditvā'pi sarvaṃ juhvati cāntataḥ ।
ubhayena vidhānā'tra homo bhavāmi vai tvayi ।।68।।
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ yajñakuṇḍe cāhavanīyarūpavān ।
gārhapatyasvarūpastvaṃ cāvasathyasvarūpavān ।।69।।।
yajñakuṇḍāgnirevā'si sarvakuṇḍāgnireva ca ।
naya māṃ satyadharmeṇa satīloke kṛpāṃ kuru ।।2.267.70।।
satīdharmo hi nārīṇāṃ jagaduddhārakārakaḥ ।
satī dākṣī purā jātā vahninā tvadahad vapuḥ ।।7 1।।
reṇukā ca satī jātā śabarī cāpi vai purā ।
kṛtadharmāśritā nāryaḥ satītvamupayānti ca ।।72।।
tathā'haṃ śrīhare kṛṣṇa satītvamupayāmi ca ।
ityevaṃ bhūpate sā tu komalāṃgī hi rāṇikā ।।73 ।।
citāmāruhya yāvaccendhituṃ vahniṃ samicchati ।
tāvacchrīlomaśo devaśceśānaśca surādayaḥ ।।74।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīśca gocarāḥ ।
abhavan sannidhau tatra satī neme samantataḥ ।।75।।
satī tvaṃ jayamāpnuhi satīlokaṃ pragacchasi ।
patyā samaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva yāvat svargaṃ pravidyate ।।76।।
ityuktvā pradadurāśīrvādān puṣṇāṇi candanam ।
santī viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtvā sasmāra ca punaḥ patim ।।77।।
sthūladehātmakaṃ tāvat śaṃkarasya gaṇastadā ।
nandī gatvā''nayacchrīghraṃ rakṣāṃgāraśavaṃ ca khe ।।78।।
dadau citāyāṃ satyai tat sāpi hṛṣṭā'milattanum ।
āśliṣyat vidhinā pretaṃ paśyatāṃ dyusadāṃ tathā ।।79।।
manuṣyāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ sā'nalamautpādayat padāt ।
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti rādhākṛṣṇeti sā jagau ।।2.267.8 0।।
gopīnātha satīkānta ramānātha vilokaya ।
ityuktvā ca citāyāṃ sā'svapat śavena lambikā ।।8 1।।
tāvad vahnirnā'spṛśattāṃ pāde eva prakāśate ।
tāvattatra hariḥ kṛṣṇo rādhākṛṣṇo babhūva ha ।।।82।।
muralyā sahitaścāste darśanaṃ pradadan prabhuḥ ।
svahastena jalaṃ sarpiḥ puṣpāṇi ca tilāni ca ।।83 ।।
candanaṃ pradadau tatra citāyāṃ bhagavān svayam ।
ātmānau dvau satīkāntau divyarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।।84।।
niryayatuḥ śavadeśāt tasthatuścāmbare kṣaṇam ।
vimānaṃ cāgataṃ svargād divyaṃ sūryanibhaṃ tadā ।।85।।
niṣedatuśca tau tatrā'paśyatāṃ śavadāhanam ।
agnirdadāha dehaudvau natvā tau parameśvarān ।।86।।
satīlokaṃ yayatuśca tatra kalpāyuṣau ca tau ।
sthitvā yāsyata evā'syā'kṣaraṃ dhāma parātmanāḥ ।।87।।
devāścātra satītīrthaṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇagṛham ।
gatvā sampūjya ca śrīmadanādi śrīnarāyaṇam ।।88।।
yayurnijaṃ divyalokaṃ kṛṣṇaścāntaradhīyata ।
śaṃbhorgaṇāścitābhasma jale cikṣipureva tu ।।89।।
rāṇikātīrthamevā'pi rakṣāṃgārakatīrthakam ।
samabhūt tatparaṃ khyātaṃ strīṇāṃ satītvabodhakam ।।2.267.90।।
satīdharmā'vanakartṛ pāpatāpapraṇāśakam ।
atra rājan snānadānājjalapānādviśeṣataḥ ।। 91 ।।
satīpūjākaraṇācca satīlokaphalaṃ vrajet ।
yā nārī vidhavā cātra patiṃ smṛtvā''plaviṣyate ।।92।।
sā tatpuṇyena kāntaṃ vai satīloke hi neṣyati ।
yā kanyā jalapānaṃ ca snānaṃ vātra kariṣyati ।।93।।
satītvaṃ vai samāsādya patiṃ labdhvā sukhapradam ।
pūrṇāyuṣyaṃ prabhuktvā'tra satīlokān gamiṣyati ।। 94।।
saubhāgyayuktā pramadā snānadānādinā tviha ।
pātivratyaphalaṃ labdhvā satīlokān gamiṣyati ।।95।।
vṛddhāpi snānamātreṇa śataikakulamuktidā ।
naro'pi snānamātreṇa satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।96 ।।
gatāṃ mṛtāṃ priyāṃ prāpya svargalokaṃ prayāsyati ।
etādṛśaṃ satītīrthaṃ nārīṇāṃ pāvanaṃ tvidam ।। 97।।
rājñyādyāścātra kurvantu snānaṃ dānaṃ jalāñjalim ।
yathā ca devagaṃgāyāṃ satītīrthaṃ mahattamam ।।98।।
yathā revāpagāyāṃ ca reṇukātīrthamityapi ।
tathā'tra rāṇikātīrthaṃ trailokyāṃ pāvanottamam ।।99।।
kṛte yuge samārabdhe jātaṃ purātanaṃ nṛpa ।
ipyukto'śvapāṭalaśca tatstriyo dāsikā api ।। 2.267.10 0।।
rādhike saraso vārau sasnuḥ satīsthale jale ।
te tarpaṇaṃ pracakruśca datvā dānāni vai tataḥ ।। 10 1।।
rājādyāḥ prayayuścāgre tīrthaṃ paraṃ hi pāvanam ।
lomaśena ca sahitāstīrthamāhātmyavedinaḥ ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saurāṣṭre svarṇapattane mlecchaiḥ rakṣāṃgārakanṛpe hate tatpatnīrāṇikāsatyāḥ kuṃkumavāpyāmāgatyā'śvapaṭṭasarastaṭe
satībhavanaṃ satītīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।267 ।।
