adhyāyaḥ 268
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 269 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tataśca vai tīrthaṃ gatvā sādhusamāśritam ।
papraccha lomaśaṃ rādhe cāśvapāṭalabhūpatiḥ ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kimidaṃ sādhubhirvyāptaṃ tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ cāpi guro tīrthadvayaṃ vada ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
amohākṣo'bhavad rājā himācalasya sannidhau ।
prabodhākhyaṃ guruṃ prāpya toṣayāmāsa sevayā ।। 3 ।।
gurustasmai dadau naije rūpe śrīharidarśanam ।
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmādirājitam ।। 4 ।।
punargurusvarūpaścā'bhavat tatra kṣaṇāntare ।
amohākhyo vismitaśca saṃśiśye śrīpatiṃ prati ।। 5 ।।
guruścāyaṃ mānavo'sti dṛśyate ca caturbhujaḥ ।
manye nārāyaṇaṃ tvenaṃ militaṃ mama bhāgyataḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmādenaṃ bhajāmyeva seve tvenaṃ samastataḥ ।
dhyātvā sampūjya vai bhaktyā paraṃ śreyo vrajāmi ca ।। 7 ।।
ityevaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā niścayaṃ ca prabodhakam ।
sevate parayā bhaktyā rājā guruṃ janārdanam ।। 8 ।।
rājñī putrāḥ prajāḥ putryaḥ sevante sma guruṃ harim ।
annajalapradānena pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
vacasāṃ pālanenāpi vastrakṣālanakādibhiḥ ।
śayanāsanadānaiśca patraphaladalārpaṇaiḥ ।। 2.268.1 0।।
candanā'kṣatatailaiśca sugandhihārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
rājabhogaiḥ sadā rājakuṭumbaṃ vai samastakam ।। 11 ।।
sevate sma prabhuṃ matvā guruṃ harimatandritam ।
bhajate sma prabodheti nāmnāṃ saṃkīrtanena ca ।। 12।।
gururvicārayāmāsa bandhanaṃ samupasthitam ।
rājabhogā bandhanāni jāyante nirayāya vai ।। 13।।
tasmādbhogāḥ parihāryā dūrato muktirodhinaḥ ।
prabodhaṃ māyikaṃ parābhāvayituṃ na cārhati ।। 14।।
ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā prabodho vai śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
upadeśairniyamaiśca bhogatyāgaṃ cakāra ha ।। 15।।
amohākṣāya ca prāha dharmavārtāṃ śubhāvahām ।
rājan rājñāṃ pṛthagdharmo dharmaścānyastapasvinām ।। 16।।
ahaṃ sādhuḥ prabodho'smi na bhogo mama yujyate ।
gṛhasthānāṃ bhūṣaṇāni sādhūnāṃ dūṣaṇāni vai ।। 17।।
gṛhasthānāṃ dūṣaṇāni sādhūnāṃ bhūṣaṇāni vai ।
sādhudharmaḥ kṣamā proktā rājadharmo hi śāsanam ।। 18।।
sādhudharmastriṣavaṇaṃ rājadharmo hyavabhṛtham ।
sādhudharmaḥ śīlarakṣā gṛhidharmaḥ strīyogitā ।। 1 9।।
sādhudharmaścāvamānaṃ gṛhidharmo hi mānanam ।
sādhurbhikṣājīvanaśca gṛhī bhujārjitādanaḥ ।।2.268.20।।
sādhurjīrṇāmbaraścāpi gṛhī svarṇāmbarādimān ।
sādhurvihāraśīlaśca gṛhī caikatra saudhavān ।।21 ।।
sādhuḥ snehavihīnaśca gṛhī kuṭumbavāsanaḥ ।
sādhuścātmaparo nityaṃ gṛhī gṛhyaparastathā ।।22।।
sādhuścāpyaniketaśca gṛhī sambandhiketanaḥ ।
mitāhāraḥ sadā sādhurgṛhī puṣṭyadanaḥ sadā ।।23।।
dvandvahīnaḥ sadā sādhurgṛhī dvandvasamanvitaḥ ।
nirāśaśca sadā sādhurgṛhī tvāśābhirāvṛtaḥ ।।24।।
mokṣadaḥ sādhudharmaśca gṛhadharmo hi nākadaḥ ।
ityevaṃ dharmamārgeṣu pārthakyaṃ vidyate hi nau ।।25।।
atha jñāne'pi vai rājan śṛṇu pārthakyamatra nau ।
mama putro mama patnī mama dravyaṃ gajādikam ।।26।।।
mama kṣetraṃ mama rājyaṃ gṛhasthasya vibhāti hi ।
na me putro na me patnī na me dravyaṃ gajādikam ।। 27।।
na me kṣetraṃ kuto rājyaṃ sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
mama sambandhinaśceme kuṭumbinastathā mama ।।28।।
mama bhṛtyā me prajāśca gṛhasthasya vibhāti ha ।
na me sambandhinaścāpi na me kuṭumbinastathā ।। 29।।
na me bhṛtyāḥ kutaḥ prajāḥ sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
mama deho mama rūpaṃ mamā''jñā ca balaṃ mama ।।2.268.3 0।।
mama sattā mama sarvaṃ gṛhasthasya vibhāti ha ।
na me deho na me rūpaṃ na cā''jñā me balaṃ na me ।।3 1 ।।
na me sattā kutaḥ sarvaṃ sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
mama puṣṭirmama rogo me miṣṭaṃ mama śītalam ।।32।।
mama duḥkhaṃ mama garvo gṛhasthasya vibhāti ha ।
na me puṣṭirna me rogo miṣṭaṃ śaityaṃ na me na me ।।33।।
na me duḥkhaṃ na me garvaḥ sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
ahaṃ vṛkṇo hyahaṃ sthūlaḥ kuṣṭhyahaṃ khañjako'smyaham ।।34।।
ahaṃ buddho jaḍaścā'haṃ gṛhasthasya vibhāti ha ।
nā'haṃ vṛkṇo na ca sthūlo na kuṣṭhī na ca khañjakaḥ ।।35।।
na vā buddho jaḍo naiva sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
mama janma mama mṛtyurmama svargaṃ bhavediti ।।36।।
mama pūjā mama kīrtirgṛhasthasya vibhāti vai ।
na me janma na me mṛtyurna me svargaṃ na bandhanam ।।37।।
na me pūjā na me kīrtiḥ sādhulokasya bhāti ha ।
tava grāmastava vāṭī tavodyānaṃ tava kṣitiḥ ।।38 ।।
tavedaṃ ca mamedaṃ ca gṛhasthasya vibhāti ha ।
na te grāmo na te vāṭī te nodyānaṃ na te kṣitiḥ ।।39।।
tavedaṃ na mamedaṃ na sādhulokasya bhāti hi ।
evaṃ jñāne'pi pārthakyaṃ vairāgye śṛṇu pārthiva ।।2.268.40 ।।
kamanīyā mama bhāryā kamanīyaṃ gṛhaṃ mama ।
kamanīyaśca me deho gṛhasthasya hi raktatā ।।41 ।।
na me bhāryā gṛhaṃ dehaḥ kutaśca kamanīyatā ।
pratyuta kledamiśrāste kalmaṣāśca jugupsitāḥ ।।42।।
ityevaṃ sādhulokasya svabhāvād rāgahīnatā ।
aho dravyamaho bhogā aho tatsādhanāni ca ।।43 ।।
aho'haṃ ca madarthaṃ yad gṛhasthasya tu vismayaḥ ।
kiṃsvid dravyaṃ ca ke bhogāḥ kānisvit sādhanāni ca ।।44।।
ko'haṃkāro mamakāraḥ sādhornaivā'sti vismayaḥ ।
utsavo'dya vivāho'dya nṛtyamadya ca gāyanam ।।45।।
raṅgo'dya nāṭakaṃ cā'dya gṛhasthasya tu vibhramaḥ ।
ātmotsavo mokṣavāho nṛtyagītī harau sadā ।।46।।
raṅganāṭye pareśārthaṃ sādhoḥ kṛṣṇe samarpaṇam ।
idaṃ dyūtamidaṃ labdhaṃ jitaṃ grastaṃ nijīkṛtam ।। 47।।
dattaṃ cāpi gṛhītaṃ ca gṛhasthasya sarāgatā ।
ātmadyutaṃ brahmalabdhaṃ jitaṃ manaḥ sthirīkṛtam ।।48।।
adattamagṛhītaṃ ca sādhoḥ rāgavihīnatā ।
sukhānuśayitā nityaṃ tṛṣṇātantvanupātitā ।।49।।
gṛdhnabhāvānuyāyitvaṃ gṛhasthasya sarāgatā ।
ātmānuśayitā nityaṃ brahmasūtrānupātitā ।।2.268.50 ।।
sādhubhāvānuyāyitvaṃ sādhorvirāgatā sadā ।
evaṃ vairāgyapārthakyaṃ bhaktau cāpi niśāmaya ।।51 ।।
gṛhasthasya gṛhe bhaktiḥ sādhorbhaktistu mādhave ।
gṛhasthasya ratau bhaktiḥ sādhostu viratau hi sā ।।52।।
svārthe ca gṛhiṇo bhaktiḥ sādhorbhaktiḥ parārthake ।
gṛhasthasyaihike bhaktiḥ sādhoḥ sā paramārthikā ।।53 ।।
gṛhasthasya sthitau bhaktiḥ sādhorbhaktiḥ parasthitau ।
gṛhasthasya rase bhaktiḥ sādhoḥ sarvarasātmani ।।54।।
gṛhasthasya bhrame bhaktiḥ sādhorbhaktirbhramātige ।
gṛhasthasya ṛtau bhaktiḥ sādhorbhaktiḥ ṛte harau ।।55।।
bhaktiḥ sādhoranāvartte hyāvarte gṛhiṇastu sā ।
bhaktirgarbhe gṛhasthasya sādhorbhaktirhiraṇmaye ।।56।।
gṛhabhaktā gṛhasthāśca sādhavo grahasevinaḥ ।
bhaktabhaktā gṛhasthā vai sādhavo naktabhaktakāḥ ।।57।।
bahubhaktā gṛhasthāśca sādhavaścaikabhaktakāḥ ।
sabhaktā vai gṛhasthāśca nirbhaktāḥ sādhavaḥ sadā ।।58।।
sarvabhaktā gṛhasthāśca hyabhaktāḥ sādhavaḥ khalu ।
evaṃ rājan bhaktimārge pārthakyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ satām ।।5 9।।
gatau cāpi sāhacaryaṃ bhavatyeva nahi kvacit ।
gṛhasthasya gatirnimnā sādhorgatiḥ sadordhvikā ।।2.268.6 0 ।।
gṛhī tvārāmagatikaḥ sādhuḥ rāmagatiḥ sadā ।
gṛhastho raktagatimān sādhuḥ śuklagatiḥ sadā ।।6 1 ।।
gṛhastho dvandvagatikaḥ sādhurdvandvā'gatistathā ।
gṛhagatirgṛhasthaśca sādhurgrahagatiḥ sadā ।।62।।
karmagatirgṛhasthasya sādhorbrahmagatistathā ।
ātmagatirgṛhasthasya sādhoścātmā''tmasadgatiḥ ।।63 ।।
sādhorgatirbhagavati gṛhasthasya bhage gatiḥ ।
evaṃ rājan gateścāpi pārthakyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ satām ।।64।।
vad tvayā samaṃ me'tra kathaṃ syāt sahayojanam ।
rāgā'rāgau sahanastastejastamasī naiva ca ।।65।।
bandhamokṣau sahayogau na sto na staḥ kadācana ।
tasmād vāsaṃ vane sādhusammataṃ samarocaye ।।66।।
paśya rājan śarīraṃ vai kalalaṃ kalalodbhavam ।
apānasya pradeśena dhātudvārā prajāyate ।।67।।
apānasya sthale garbhe pacyate kalalaiḥ sadā ।
puṣṭimeti bahiryāti payasā randhitānnakaiḥ ।।68।।
sarvaṃ kalalasaṃvyāptaṃ nidhānaṃ kalalasya vai ।
kalalaṃ ca malaṃ vāpi salilaṃ tatra vartate ।।69।।
bhautikaṃ cāpi durgandhaṃ tvāpādanakhamasti yat ।
malātmakaṃ nidhānaṃ ca malasyaiva vilokyate ।।2.268.70।।
sugandhāḍhyaṃ prabhuktaṃ ca pītaṃ galādadhogatam ।
durgandhaṃ jāyate śīghraṃ malaṃ kṛtvā prarakṣati ।।71 ।।
sugandho gandhasāraśca ghrāṇena yaḥ prapūritaḥ ।
koṣṭhale sa tu durgandho bhūtvā bahiḥ prayāti ca ।।72।।
navadvāreṣu sarvatra durgandhāni malāni vai ।
kṣarantyeva hi sarveṣāṃ nārakaṃ kuṇḍameva yat ।।73।।
paśya svāṃgajugupsāṃ ca mā saṃsargaṃ paraiḥ kuru ।
jalānnagrahaṇe yogyaṃ kalalakledavikṛtau ।।74।।
malamūtrasarjane ca kā tatra śubhavāsanā ।
aśubhaṃ śubhamāvidya ramate nigaḍe yathā ।।75।।
bhuktavikārarūpād vai lālātmasalilāt khalu ।
bhūtejovāyusammiśrājjāyate kalalodbhavaḥ ।।76।।
tasmād dehastatastatrendriyāṇi golakādayaḥ ।
tanmātrādyāstathā teṣāṃ sañcālikā praśaktayaḥ ।।77।।
grāhyagrāhakabhāvāśca tasmādeva bhavanti vai ।
tatra ko nāma saṃvidvān pramodaṃ labhate'vaśaḥ ।।78।।
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyarūpāṇi dṛśyante'tarkitāni vai ।
kutrakṣaṇe'yaṃ saṃghāto vighātaṃ saṃprayāsyati ।।79।।
abbhravad dhūmravadvā ca dhūlīpaṭalavattathā ।
jñātvaivaṃ dehapaṭalaṃ jño na viśvāsamāpnuyāt ।।2.268.80।।
śūnyaṃ kṣaṇāntare tvetatprāṇasya vigame bhavet ।
duḥkhaṃ cālokyate sākṣād yataḥ svalakṣaṇaṃ hi tat ।।81 ।।
śarīraṃ cedṛśaṃ tasya sambandhiṣu tu kā kathā ।
tasmād rājannivatsye'haṃ tvātmanyaraṇyasaṃjñake ।।82।।
anaraṇye parameśe vāsaṃ lapsye tataḥ param ।
maduktaṃ yadi miṣṭaṃ te taṃ sumārgaṃ prasādhaya ।।83 ।।
eṣa yāmi viyogasya mā śokaṃ vara vijñaka ।
gurau deho yathoktaśca sadā cettādṛśo'sti vai ।।84।।
araṇye'pi tathaivāste tatsaṃgastu bhayāvahaḥ ।
tatsaṃge cedaraṇye'pi vāsaste saṃbhaviṣyati ।।85 ।।
samadraṣṭuśca te'raṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ me'pi samaṃ yataḥ ।
vāsaṃ tvatraiva satataṃ vidhehi yāhi mā prabho ।।86 ।।
prabuddha uvāca-
satyaṃ rājan tvaduktaṃ vai mayoktaṃ cāpi tattathā ।
avighne bhavane gatvā mokṣaṃ yāsyāmi durlabham ।।87।।
bahuvighnamayaṃ rājan bhavanaṃ te vilokyate ।
svalpavighnamaraṇyaṃ vai yatiṣye ca yathābalam ।।88।।
ātmavittiṃ prāpya pravekṣyāmi vai brahmavittike ।
brahmavittyā parabrahma sādhayiṣyāmi śāśvatam ।।89।।
amohākṣa uvāca-
pūrṇabrahmasvarūpasya darśanaṃ me kathaṃ bhavet ।
guro tvaṃ me pradehyatra pūrṇabrahmapradarśanam ।।2.268.90।।
prabuddha uvāca--
karmakaṣāyadāhena pūrṇaṃ brahma prakāśate ।
rājannā'haṃ tathā yuktaḥ karmajālasamāvṛtaḥ ।।9 1।।
amohākṣa uvāca-
dehasyā'sya na viśvāsaḥ kṣaṇānte'yaṃ vinaśyati ।
guroḥ sakāśāllābho na parabrahmapragocaraḥ ।। 92।।
tadā śiṣyeṇa tu kadā kva sa lābho hyavāpsyate ।
tvaṃ pradehi guro jñānaṃ cā'parokṣaṃ parātmanaḥ ।। 93 ।।
prabuddha uvāca-
nāhaṃ tādṛk samartho'smi sāmarthyaṃ bhajanāśrayam ।
mādṛśā avatārāstu buddhā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।94।।
bhaktyopāsanayā yasya parabrahmaṇa eva ha ।
tadupāstyā bhavān rājan tariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।95।।
yāsyāmyahaṃ vane rājan tvaṃ cedicchasi satvaram ।
brahmadarśanamatraiva vinā sādhanasampadam ।।96।।
kṛpayā'haṃ kathayāmi deśe surāṣṭrasaṃjñake ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre'kṣarakṣetre śubhāvahe ।। 97।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe pratyakṣo bhagavān svayam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 98।।
virājate parabrahma dhṛtamānuṣavigrahaḥ ।
yāhi śīghraṃ ca taṃ deśaṃ parabrahma miliṣyati ।।99।।
prāsāde māṃ guruṃ tatra sthāpayitvā tataḥ param ।
yāsyasi brahmalokaṃ ca yāhi śīghraṃ hi mā ciram ।। 2.268.10 0।।
eṣa yāsyāmi rājaँste svasti bhavatu sarvadā ।
ityuktvā nṛpate buddho niryayau vanavistaram ।। 10 1।।
amohākṣo drutaṃ sajjo bhūtvā samājagāma ha ।
kṣetrametatsamāgatyā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।। 102।
pratyakṣaṃ sandadarśāpi tīrthe'tra nyavasattathā ।
prabuddhaṃ sthāpayitvā'tra yayau mokṣaṃ parātparam ।। 1 03।।
divyavimānamāruhyā'kṣaraṃ dhāma sanātanam ।
tadidaṃ buddhatīrthaṃ vai tathā tīrthamamohakam ।। 1 04।।
mohanāśakaraṃ pūrṇabrahmaprāptikaraṃ sadā ।
snāhi rājan guruṃ dhyātvā dānānyapi pradehi ca ।। 1 05।।
ityukto rādhike rājā cāśvapāṭalakastadā ।
lomaśoktadiśā snānaṃ dānaṃ cakāra śobhanam ।। 1 06।।
yayau tato'yaṃ sahasā tīrthaṃ cā'parameva saḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya parabrahmagatirbhavet ।। 1 07।।
viveko jāyate cāpi tathā brahmasthitirbhavet ।
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi svargaṃ ca śāśvataṃ bhavet ।। 1 08।।
atra dānena tapasā bhajanenā''plavena ca ।
jalapānena yajñasyā'śvamedhasya phalaṃ bhavet ।। 1 09।।
api pāpijanaścātrā''gatya prāṇān jahāti cet ।
prabuddhaścātra saṃbhūtvā mokṣapadaṃ prayāsyati ।। 2.268.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne amohākṣanṛpateḥ prabuddhagurorupadeśena kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrā''game sākṣātparabrahmaprāptiḥ, buddhatīrthaṃ, mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇa-
nāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 268 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 269
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 270 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike tatra tīrthe gatvā'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
punaḥ papraccha tīrthasya kiṃnāmādi ca lomaśam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro tīrthamidaṃ khyātaṃ kiṃnāmnā ca kadā'bhavat ।
tatsarvaṃ me tu saṃkṣepād brūhi kiṃ phalamasya ca ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ।
lakṣmītīrthaṃ tathā nārāyaṇatīrthamidaṃ nṛpa ।। 3 ।।
purā rājā hyabhayākṣo'bhavat pāṃcālabhūpatiḥ ।
dharmakarmasamācāro dānabhaktiyuto harau ।। 4 ।।
yasya gehe'tithayaśca sādhavo dīnadehinaḥ ।
bhuṃjate śataśo nityaṃ tṛptimāyānti śāśvatīm ।। 5 ।।
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sādhurūpeṇa rājate ।
ajñeyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ viprasaṃsevitaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
lakṣmīḥ rādhā tathā sādhvīrūpeṇa ca virājate ।
devā devyo vijānanti na ca jānanti mānavāḥ ।।7 ।।
divyākṣā ye munayaśca te jānanti na cetare ।
rājā nityaṃ sevate śrīprabhuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 8 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ bhajate ca caturbhujaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।
kathāṃ śṛṇoti satataṃ sādhuviprānanāt sa ca ।। 9 ।।
kuṭumbasahito rājā tvātmajñānaparo'bhavat ।
sādhusevāparaścāpi prajārakṣāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 2.269.10 ।।
nā'sya prajāyāṃ cā'dharmo na stainyaṃ nāpi hiṃsanam ।
śaucaṃ prajāḥ pālayanti santuṣṭā nijavastuṣu ।। 11 ।।
viprāstu tāpasāstasya bhuṃjate bhojanāni vai ।
vedaghoṣaparā nityaṃ ṣaṭkarmādiparāyaṇāḥ ।। 1 2।।
yajñayāgaparāścāpi nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
brahmaśīlaparā lokāḥ kāmaṃ na bahu manvate ।। 1 3।।।
arthaṃ cāpekṣitaṃ hyevārjayanti nādhikaṃ tataḥ ।
śeṣaṃ tu samayaṃ sarve mokṣārthaṃ kalpayanti vai ।। 14।।
nā'sya rājye'sti vidhavā hyaputrā cā'pyapatyakaḥ ।
apatnīko gṛhastho na dhanadhānyayutāḥ prajāḥ ।। 15।।
prātaḥ sarvatra nagare kṛṣṇakṛṣṇasvanāḥ śubhāḥ ।
māṃgalikāśca jāyante śrūyante kīrtanāni ca ।। 16।।
nā'snāto vidyate kaścin nā'pūjo vidyate tathā ।
mānavānāṃ lalāṭeṣu tilakaṃ candrakānvitam ।। 17।।
dṛśyate cāndanaṃ cordhve smārakaṃ śrīhareḥ śubham ।
kaṇṭhe sarvaprajānāṃ vai dṛśyante taulasīsrajaḥ ।। 18।।
kare'pi taulasīmālā japakāryaprabodhinī ।
jihvāyāṃ śrīharernāma namaskāre'pi vai hariḥ ।। 1 9।।
dāne paropakāre'pi śrīhariṃ smaryate janaiḥ ।
kanyakāśca kumārāśca vidyābhyāsaparāśca ye ।। 2.269.20 ।।
śālāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā kīrtanaṃ śrīharestataḥ ।
abhyasyanti pāṭhayanti copādhyāyā hariśritāḥ ।।21 ।।
nyāyālaye'pi satataṃ śrūyate'gre'vasānake ।
harerāma harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa namo'stviti ।।22।।
nadītīre gṛhe kṣetre vāṭikāsu vane'pi ca ।
karṣukāḥ śilpinaḥ kāṣṭhahārāstṛṇādinindakāḥ ।। 23।।
sarve kṛṣṇaparāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā kurvanti vai śramam ।
āndhasikā harerbhaktāḥ sthāle kṛtvā tu pācitam ।।24।।
annaṃ sarvavidhaṃ cāpi phalamūlajalādikam ।
samarpya haraye paścād bhojayanti gṛheśvarān ।।25।।।
devārpaṇaṃ prakṛtvaiva bhuṃjate ca pibanti ca ।
āpaṇasthāḥ śreṣṭhivaryā gaṇeśārcanamityapi ।।26 ।।
kṛtvā ghṛtapradīpaṃ ca tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇapūjanam ।
vyāpārayanti divase rātrau bhajanti mādhavam ।। 27।।
paśupālā hariṃ natvā gāṃ sampūjya ca mandiram ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya vīkṣya paścāt kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya darśanam ।।।28।।
yāntyaraṇyabhūbhāgān harismṛtiparāyaṇāḥ ।
kāṣṭhahārāḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa bhajanto yānti vai pathi ।। 29।।
rajakā vastrasampuṭakṣālane rāmanāma vai ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyuktvā kṣālayanti jalāśaye ।।2.269.3 0।।
śukādyāḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi vakṣanti śrīnarāyaṇa ।
raṃbhaṃte paśavaścāpyoṃkāramiśraṃ hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 31 ।।
tauryatrikā vādayanti kṛṣṇakīrtanagītikāḥ ।
kavayaścāraṇādyāśca kṛṣṇaprabandhakāriṇaḥ ।।32।।
abhayākṣaṃ svakaṃ nāma vivṛttya bhūbhujā svayam ।
adhokṣajaṃ harernāma khyāpitaṃ copanāma tat ।। 33 ।।
prajānāṃ cāpi nāmāni pareśārthayutāni ca ।
kāritāmīti rāṣṭraṃ sad vaiṣṇavaṃ saṃvyajāyata ।।34।।
evaṃvidho'bhayabhakto vicārya naśvaraṃ gṛham ।
dhanaṃ rājyaṃ ca sampacca gatvaraṃ ca vapurnijam ।। 35।।
vairāgyāveśataścāyamaśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ।
prajā viprāstathā vṛddhāstaṃ rājānaṃ samanvayuḥ ।।36।।
mārge kīrtanabhaktyaiva samāyātān vilokya tān ।
mārgagrāmāgatā lokāḥ kautūhalasamanvitāḥ ।।37।।
saha cāśvasarastīrthaṃ pratyāyayuḥ samutsukāḥ ।
uttare sarasastīre vāsaṃ cakrurdrumālaye ।। 38।।
kṛtvā tīrthāni sarvāṇi lomaśasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ ।
tato'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāsādamāyayuḥ ।। 39।।
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā śrīmatkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvā dṛṣṭvā kuṃkumavāpikām ।।2.269.40।।
kuṃkumavāpikāvāri pītvā śrīpūjanaṃ tathā ।
vidhāya datvā dānāni yayuḥ sarastaṭe punaḥ ।।41 ।।
adhokṣajaḥ sa rājā'tra sthale ceyeṣa vai kratum ।
kartuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samprasādayituṃ mahejyayā ।।42।।
lomaśaṃ saṃprārthayacca yajñārthaṃ sa hyadhokṣajaḥ ।
lakṣasauvarṇamudrābhiryajñaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇavam ।।43 ।।
devānatarpayaddhavyaiḥ pitṝn śrāddhaiḥ sato'nnakaiḥ ।
janān dānaistathā cātmārpaṇaiḥ sādhūn sureśvarān ।।44।।
pūrṇāhutau svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo vahnāvadṛśyata ।।45।।
bhuñjan havyāni sarvāṇi lakṣmyā samanvitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ramānandasunandādisevito garuḍānvitaḥ ।।46।।
prasannavadanaḥ śyāmo yuvā koṭyarkabhāsvaraḥ ।
viprāścānye janāḥ sarve'bhavannāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।।47।।
aho rājñaḥ subhaktiśca sneho nārāyaṇasya ca ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād bhuṃkte havyaṃ nṛpā'rpitam ।।48।।
rājānaṃ bhagavānāha mandiraṃ cātra kāraya ।
lakṣmyā sākaṃ nivatsye'haṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya māṃ nṛpa ।।49।।
sādhudīkṣāṃ gṛhītvaiva tvaṃ me pūjāṃ vidhehi ca ।
sthāsye vaśe ca te rājan sādho'dhokṣaja māṃ bhaja ।।2.269.50।।
ityuktvā ca prabhuktvā ca havyāni bhagavāँstataḥ ।
tirobhavat tato rājā'dhokṣajo bhūsurādike ।।51 ।।
dakṣiṇā vitarayyaiva bhojayitvā samastakān ।
svataḥprakāśaṛṣitastyāgidīkṣāṃ samagrahīt। ।।52।।
upavāsaṃ cakārā'sau dehaśuddhiṃ cakāra ca ।
muṇḍanaṃ kārayāmāsa snātvā cakre'nale havam ।।53 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ pupūjā'pi sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ svarṇadānādikaṃ dadau ।।54।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyā'pi mandirasya nimittakam ।
lakṣaṃ suvarṇamudrāṇāṃ dānaṃ ca gurave dadau ।।55।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।।56।।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।। 57 ।।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvata ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।।।58।।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛn mitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।।59।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhonāthaḥ śrīsvāmī śaraṇaṃ mama ।
kṛṣṇavallabhabhakto'haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।।2.269.60।।
'śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmī śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
itimantrān sa jagrāha svataḥprākāśasadguroḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tataḥ kāṣāyāmbarāṇi dhārayāmāsa sadvratī ।
yajñopavītakaṃ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ ca srajaṃ kare ।
tilakaṃ cāndanaṃ cordhvapuṇḍraṃ cakrādimudrikāḥ ।।62।।
pūjārthaṃ kānakīṃ kārṣṇanārāyaṇīṃ ramāyutām ।
pratimāṃ cāpi jagrāha gurupūjāṃ cakāra ca ।।63 ।।
adho'kṣajaprakāśeti nāma naijaṃ rarakṣa vai ।
dīkṣāṃgaṃ vidhivadvaidhaṃ samāpya sarasastaṭe ।।64।।
parṇakuṭyāṃ sadāvāsaṃ cakre tvatra makhasthale ।
jajāpa parayā bhaktyā śrīśaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।65।।
kārayāmāsa subhagaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇālayam ।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa mandire ।।66।।
tadidaṃ mandiraṃ rājan rājate śrīhariśritam ।
kuru vai darśanaṃ tatra śriyo hareśca vai tataḥ ।।67।।
dānāni dehi rājendra snānaṃ cātra samācāra ।
etattīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ sarvayajñaphalapradam ।।68।।
yajñatīrthaṃ sādhutīrthaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ tathā matam ।
adhokṣajākhyatīrthaṃ ca nārāyaṇākhyatīrthakam ।।69।।
dīkṣātīrthaṃ tathā khyātaṃ pāvanaṃ tvetadeva yat ।
mārgaśīrṣe keśavaṃ ca prapūjya vidhinā'tra vai ।।2.269.70।।
mārgaśīrṣe snānadānādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।
pauṣe snānācca dānācca śriyā yuktaṃ narāyaṇam ।।71।।
prapūjya labhate puṇyaṃ vājapeyamakhotthitam ।
māghamāse snānadānānmādhavaṃ samprapūjya ca ।।72।।
tīrthakṛllabhate cātra rājasūyaphalaṃ param ।
phālgune snānadānācca govindaṃ samprapūjya ca ।।73।।
atirātrākhyayajñotthaṃ phalaṃ labheddhi tīrthakṛt ।
caitre snānāttathā dānādatra viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca ।।74।।
puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ tīrthakartā prayāti pāvanam ।
vaiśākhe snānadānācca prapūjya madhūsūdanam ।।75।।
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ rājan labhate'tra sa tīrthakṛt ।
jyeṣṭhe snānāttathā dānāt trivikramaṃ prapūjya ca ।।76।।
labhate tīrthakṛccātra gavāyanakratoḥ phalam ।
āṣāḍhe snānadānācca vāmanaṃ samprapūjya ca ।।77।।
labhate tīrthakṛccātra phalaṃ vai somayāgajam ।
śrāvaṇe snānadānācca śrīdharaṃ samprapūjya ca ।।78।।
labhate tīrthakṛccātra viśvajitkratujaṃ phalam ।
bhādre snānāttathā dānāt hṛṣīkeśaṃ prapūjya ca ।।79।।
labhate tīrthakṛccātra phalaṃ sautrāmaṇikratoḥ ।
āśvine snānadānābhyāṃ padmanābhaṃ prapūjya ca ।।2.269.80।।
tīrthakṛllabhate puṇyaṃ vividhaṃ somayogajam ।
kārtike snānadānābhyāṃ dāmodaraṃ prapūjya ca ।।81।।
labhate'tra tīrthaśāyī viṣṇuyāgodbhavaṃ phalam ।
adhimāse snānadānāt prapūjya puruṣottamam ।।82।।
tīrthakṛllabhate sarvamedhayajñaphalaṃ param ।
yatra kvaciddine tvatra snānād dānājapādibhiḥ ।।83 ।।
tīrthakṛllabhate rājan sarvayajñaphalāni vai ।
śivarātryāṃ snānadānānmahārudraphalaṃ bhavet ।।84।।
ityetatpāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇoditam ।
kuru snānaṃ tathā pūjāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya vai ।।85।।
sarvān bhagavato dhyātvā sarvapuṇyānyavāpnuhi ।
ityukto rādhike! rājā tvaśvapāṭala eva ha ।।86।।
sakuṭumbo jale sasnau pupūja mandire harim ।
śriyā yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśopacārairnīrājanādibhiḥ ।।87।।
tāvattasya śrīharau vai pratimāyāṃ caturdaśa ।
keśavādyā bhagavanto hyadṛśyanta yathoditāḥ ।।88।।
kṣaṇaṃ svadarśanaṃ datvā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।
līnāḥ sarve'vatārāste sa cā'pyantaradhīyata ।।89।।
aśvapāṭalanṛpatirmahāścaryaṃ jagāma ha ।
kṛtakṛtyaṃ nijaṃ mene'dhokṣaje tīrthake tadā ।।2.269.90।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
lomaśā'tra mama jātaṃ darśanaṃ keśavādijam ।
kṛtakṛtyo bhavāmyeva kiṃ tīrthairdānavistaraiḥ ।।9 1 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
rājaँstīrthabalenaitajjātaṃ sarvaṃ vibhāvaya ।
atīrthasya balaṃ nāsti nāsti puṇyaṃ pavitratā ।। 92।।
nāsti nairmalyabhāvaśca nāsti kṛṣṇaprasannatā ।
nāsti bhaktiratīrthasya nāsti mokṣo divaṃ ca vā ।। 93।।
jaṃgamaṃ vā sthāvaraṃ vā tīrthaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam ।
kalmaṣāṇāṃ vināśordhve tīrthī prāpnoti yogyatām ।।94।।
yogyatāyāṃ susatyāṃ vai hṛdi brahma prakāśate ।
brahmarūpasya bhaktasya snehastatra prajāyate ।। 95।।
parabrahmanikaṭatvaṃ jāyate'sya nisargajam ।
tato bhavati durlabhyaṃ darśanaṃ sulabhaṃ hareḥ ।।96।।
evaṃ darśanamāptasya lokasaṃgrahahetave ।
kartavyatayā tīrthāni vihitānyeva sarvadā ।।97।।
tasmāt tīrthāni dānāni kartavyāni kṛpājuṣā ।
muktaḥ siddhaśca vā devo divyo vā brahmarūpadhṛk ।। 98।।
yadyadācarate mokṣapradaṃ svargapradaṃ ca vā ।
puṇyakṛt tatsamālambyā''carate tvaparo janaḥ ।।99।।
tena muktirbhavedevā'bhayadānaṃ bhavedapi ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā bhāvena tīrthamācaret ।। 2.269.10 0।।
ityuktvā lomaśastaṃ vai cāśvapāṭalabhūpatim ।
agre tīrthāntaraṃ ninye viṣṇumandiramuttamam ।। 101 ।।
rādhike yatra vai viṣṇoḥ śvetā mūrtiḥ sanātanī ।
rājate kamalāyuktā garuḍena praśobhitā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'bhayākṣanṛpaterbhaktirvairāgyaṃ makhaścāśvapaṭṭasarastīre tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇādidarśanaṃ mandiranirmāṇaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ nārāyaṇatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 269 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 269 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 270
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 271 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścādaśvapāṭalabhūpatiḥ ।
agre tīrthe ca prapaccha lomaśaṃ tīrthasaṃbhavam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
idaṃ tīrthaṃ ca kinnāma kadā kena kṛtaṃ prabho ।
kiṃphalaṃ ko vidhiścātra kartavyo vada me guro ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu rājan vadāmi te ।
devānīko'bhavad vaiśyaḥ kṛṣikāro'tibhaktimān ।। 3 ।।
ujjvalagrāmavāso'yaṃ vāṭikāyāṃ divāniśam ।
varṣāyāṃ vai nijāvāsaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati rakṣakaḥ ।। 4 ।।
bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ snātvā'rcayatyapi ।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ sarvaṃ nivedya haraye'tti ca ।। 5 ।।
varṣāyāṃ yāni sasyāni patrāṇi ca dalāni ca ।
śākāni kandamūlāni phalāni ca bhavanti hi ।। 6 ।।
kṣetreṣu vāṭikāyāṃ ca nūtanāni hi tāni saḥ ।
nivedya haraye paścādupabhuṃkte kuṭumbavān ।। 7 ।।
ikṣudaṇḍān kaṇiśāँśca bījāni bhājikādikam ।
munyannāni ca havyāni samidhaśca rasāṃstathā ।। 8 ।।
madhūni śarkaṭā gūḍaṃ gundraṃ dugdhāni yāni ca ।
bhājikā bharjitakaṇāँstathā bharjitaśimbikāḥ ।। 9 ।।
stambān vallīśca vai tṛṇajātīyāni ca yāni ca ।
māse māse prajātāni samarpya haraye'tti saḥ ।। 2.270.1 0।।
evamātmanivedī vai bhaktarāṭ karṣuko'bhavat ।
rājan varṣāniṣāyāṃ tvekadā vṛṣṭirabhūd drutam ।। 1 1।।
savegāḥ sthūlabindvāḍhyā rātrau cāprātareva sā ।
divase'pi tathaivā'bhūt tato rātrāvabhūttathā ।। 1 2।।
divāniśaṃ pravarṣaiśca bhūtalaṃ jalasaṃbhṛtam ।
kṣetrāṇi jalarūpāṇi nadyo jalātigāstathā ।। 13।।
amārgagā hyabhavaँśca grāmāṇāṃ parito jalam ।
mārgā nadīmayāścāsan vṛkṣā yathā saraḥsthitāḥ ।। 14।।
evaṃ jāte'tibhayade varṣaṇe karṣukaḥ sa tu ।
śaityārdravastrasaṃkampo vṛkṣāśraye sthito'bhavat ।। 15।।
jalāni saritastyaktvā mārgaṃ tyaktvā'tigāni vai ।
āyātāni niśāyāṃ vai vāṭikāyāṃ samantataḥ ।। 16।।
vṛkṣā jalagatāścāsan karṣuko vṛkṣameva tam ।
āruhya tvātmarakṣārthaṃ triśākhe susthiro'bhavat ।। 17।।
rātrau jhaṃjhāvātavarṣā daivayogādavardhata ।
vātena druma ākṣipto bhrāmitaśca nipātitaḥ ।। 18।।
śākhā bhagnā karṣukastu hariṃ smṛtvā tu śākhikām ।
pragṛhyaiva sulagno'bhūcchākhāyāṃ salilopari ।। 1 9।।
pūrā''kṛṣṭā'bhavacchākhā jalamadhye gatā tu sā ।
ūḍhā sakarṣukā''kṛṣṭā nadīmadhye gatā'bhavat ।।2.270.20।।
pūrapravāhaṇeścohmamānā'śvapaṭṭamāyayau ।
śākhā''drā bhārayuktā vai sā mamajja sarojale ।।21 ।।
karṣukastu nirādhāro jānāti tarituṃ tataḥ ।
jalamadhye taratyeva kinnu śaityena pīḍitaḥ ।।22।
kallolaiḥ śramitaścāpi stabdhahasto mamajja ha ।
hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa vibho prabho ।। 23।।
viṣṇo hastījale magnastārito bhavatā tadā ।
satyavrato jale nāvā tārito bhavatā purā ।।24।।
kṣitirmagnā jale pūrve tāritā bhavatā prabho ।
saṃsārasāgarāt tvaṃ vai tārayasyeha dehinaḥ ।। 25 ।।
kamalāni jalajāni cordhve tvaṃ nayasi prabho ।
jale suptaḥ svayaṃ pūrvaṃ vairājaṃ kṛtavāँstataḥ ।।26 ।।
kṣīrābdhau śeṣaśayane suptastvaṃ pralaye'si ca ।
adya suptā'smi ta viṣṇo jalābdhau naya māṃ drutam ।। 27।।।
svaloka svargalokordhve nijāgre māṃ prarakṣaya ।
na me vāñcchā martyaloke sthātuṃ dhāma tu te naya ।।28।।
namaḥ śrīviṣṇave lokajiṣṇave paramātmane।
sarvajñāya namaste tvantarātmane parātmane ।।29।।
eṣa prāṇāँstyajāmyeva samarpayāmi te pade ।
ityuktvā mānase dadhyau viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।2.270.3 0।।
tāvattatra samāyāto bālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
caturbhujo yuvā saumyaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।।3 1।।
haste dhṛtvā nijaṃ bhaktaṃ karṣukaṃ jalamadhyataḥ ।
tīre ninye haristvenaṃ viṣṇurgopālanandanaḥ ।।।32।।।
gṛhe nītvā'nalenā'pi tāpayāmāsa sevakam ।
bhojayāmāsa surasān vastrāṇi pradadau tataḥ ।।33।।
svāpayāmāsa śayane rakṣayāmāsa sarvathā ।
yatra bhakto jalāttīre niṣkāsya sthāpitaḥ kṣaṇam ।।34।।
viṣṇurūpeṇa kṛṣṇena tadidaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
viṣṇutīrthaṃ samabhavat tārakaṃ sāgarāt khalu।।35।।
karṣuko rakṣitaḥ paścād dināntare gṛhaṃ yayau ।
āgatya dhanadānena mandiraṃ viṣṇuśobhitam ।। 36।।
kārayitvā'tiṣṭhipacca viṣṇuṃ caturbhujaṃ tviha ।
tadidaṃ mandire rājan rājate viṣṇumaṇḍitam ।।37।।
tārakaṃ tīrthamevā'pi khyāyate cottamottamam ।
atra snānāttarantyeva dānāt smṛddhiṃ labhantyapi ।।38।।
viṣṇoḥ pūjākaraṇācca vaikuṇṭhaṃ vindate'pi ca ।
kuru snānaṃ tataścātra dānaṃ dehi yathepsitam ।।39।।
kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjāṃ kuru jagadguroḥ ।
ityukto rādhike rājā hyaśvapāṭala eva ha ।।2.270.40।।
pupūja viṣṇuṃ puṣpādyairdadau sauvarṇadānakam ।
tataścāgre yayau tīrthaṃ puruṣottamanāmakam ।।41।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
idaṃ tīrthaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ puruṣottamasaṃjñakam ।
kadā kena nimittena tadvidhiṃ ca phalaṃ vada ।।42।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ vai sākṣād yatra pumuttamaḥ ।।43।।
ānarteṣu pradeśeṣu bhadrāyane hi pattane ।
vipragṛhe brahmastambo maharṣiḥ samajāyata ।।44।।
sa tvābālyāddharau magno'kṣaraṃ brahma yaducyate ।
brahmātmā brahmaniṣṭhaścā''rādhayat dhruruṣottamam ।।45।।
sadā dhyānaparo yogī yogasamādhisaṃsthitiḥ ।
paśyatyeva divyarūpaṃ hṛdaye śrīnarāyaṇam ।।46।।
yasya bhittyāvaraṇaṃ vai nāsti nāsti jalā''vṛtiḥ ।
ākāśe gamanaṃ yasyā'dṛśyatāsiddhirasti ca ।।47।।
yo nityaṃ svakṛtapūjākāle paśyati vai harim ।
agre cāgatya dattaṃ sa gṛhṇāti candanādikam ।।48।।
sākṣād bhuṃkte pradattaṃ ca pāyasādyaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
evaṃvidhasya viprasya brahmastambasya mānase ।।49।।
tapase tvabhavad vāñcchā haryārādhanaśāntidā ।
sa tu gatvā karamardihrade tasthau hi vatsaram ।।2.270.50।।
tato yayau prasiddhaṃ vai cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
atrāgatya taṭe tasthau vāsaṃ cakāra cāmrake ।।51।।
āmramūle śubhacchāye svasthadhyānaparo'bhavat ।
snānaṃ dhyānṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ tarpaṇaṃ ceśvarārpaṇam ।।52।।
karotyeva nijaṃ karma pāvanaṃ puṇyasampradam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanaṃ sadā ।।53 ।।
karoti nityaṃ prātaśca pratyakṣaṃ pūjayatyapi ।
evaṃ saṃpūjayato'sya nityaṃ prātaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।54।।
sākṣād bhavati viśvātmā divyarūpadharo hariḥ ।
yogajñāstaṃ prapaśyanti divyadṛśo'timānuṣāḥ ।।55।।
brahmastambena tu tatra kṛpā parṇakuṭī śubhā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre puruṣottamakuṭṭikā ।।56।।
tatredaṃ mandiraṃ tena śobhanaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtam ।
yatra saṃrājate sākṣānmūrtimān puruṣottamaḥ ।।।57।।
puruṣottamatīrthaṃ tat aśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
brahmastambābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ procyate divyamokṣadam ।।58।।
atra snānād bhavetprāptiḥ puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।
atra dānād bhaved prāptirbrahmalokasya śāśvatī ।।59।।
puruṣottamapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ rājanna varṇyate ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpo vai jāyate pūjako'sya ha ।।2.270.60।।
brahmarūpo mahābhuktaścopāsako'sya jāyate ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ kuru rājan hareriha ।।6 1 ।।
ityukto rādhike cāśvapāṭṭalo nṛpatirhi saḥ ।
sarvabhāvaiścakāraiva snānadānā'rhaṇādikam ।।62।।
atha paścād yayau tīrthaṃ mahāviṣṇupratīrthakam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre kṣīrikāsaṃgame śubham ।।63।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro tīrthamidaṃ kasmānmahāviṣṇvabhidhānakam ।
kradā jātaṃ kathaṃ ceti phalādyaṃ cāpi me vada ।।64।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
devamūlasya bhaktasya duhitā'marakanyakā ।
purā tvatra tapastepe duṣkaraṃ harilabdhaye ।।65।।।
phalamūlāśanā sādhvī mahāviṣṇuparāyaṇā ।
ākāśavāsā sajaṭā suvalkalādidhāriṇī ।।66।।
paścāt pavanabhakṣā ca pādaikena sthitā'bhavat ।
netre pramīlya satataṃ japamālāparāyaṇā ।।67।।
evaṃ bahugate kāle mahāviṣṇuḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt ।।68।।
adṛśyata prasannāsyastejomadhye surūpavān ।
sāyudhaḥ sumukuṭādyairbhūṣaṇaiḥ śobhitaḥ prabhuḥ ।।69।।।
tato'bhūt sa dvibhujaścā'marakanyāṃ jagāda ha ।
vada devi prasanno'smi kiṃ te manasi vartate ।।2.270.70।।
yadyad vāñcchasi dāsye'tra tvadarthaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
tadā netre samunmīlya dadarśa sundarī harim ।।71 ।।
mahāviṣṇuṃ tataścāpi dvibhujaṃ parameśvaram ।
kāntaṃ kāntākṛte yogyaṃ yuvānaṃ sadguṇāśrayam । ।72।।
patirme bhava bhagavannityevamārthayat satī ।
patitā pādayostasya mahāviṣṇostadā hariḥ ।।73।।
tathāstviti satī prāha tāpasīṃ ca kare nije ।
saṃjagrāha kṣaṇaṃ sā'pi dadau premāvaśā nijam ।।74।।
karamālāṃ gale viṣṇorlagnā'bhūt kṛṣṇavakṣasi ।
bhagavāँstāṃ nijāṃ kṛtvā jagāda vaiṣṇavīṃ satīm ।।75।।
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi subhage'marakanye'tiśobhane ।
mahāviṣṇusvarūpo'haṃ bhagavānatra bhūtale ।।76।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'gre nivasāmi hi ।
bhaja māṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ gṛhṇāmi vidhinā'dhunā ।।77।।
tato devī mānasīṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ gale dadau ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāvirbabhūva ha ।।78।।
ahaṃ ca lomaśastatra tadā hyupasthito'bhavam ।
vahniṃ śīghraṃ prakāśyaiva mayā'marāvivāhanam ।। 79।।
kāritaṃ viṣṇunā sākaṃ sā satī rājate gṛhe ।
mahāviṣṇurbhagavāँśca rājate mānavo bhavan ।।2.270.80।।
bhagavantaṃ patiṃ kṛṣṇā'grajaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam ।
saṃprāpya sā'marīkanyā kṛtakṛtyā sukhā'bhavat ।।।81 ।।
tadidaṃ tapasaḥ sthānaṃ hyamarīkanyakāśritam ।
amarītīrthamevā'pi bhagavattīrthamityapi ।।82।।
vivāhatīrthaṃ ca mahāviṣṇutīrthaṃ tathocyate ।
atra snānācca dānācca mahāviṣṇoḥ prapūjanāt ।।83 ।।
mahāviṣṇupadaṃ labdhvā brahmaloke mahīyate ।
rājannatrā'laye ramye'marīviṣṇuṃ prapūjayet। ।।84।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajed bhaktaḥ śāśvatā''nandabhāgbhavet ।
ityukto rādhike rājā sasnau dadau pupūja tam ।।85।।
tato yayau paraṃ tīrthaṃ sanatkumārasaṃjñakam ।
puṇyapuñjapradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam ।।86।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
sanatkumāratīrthaṃ tatkathaṃ kadā'bhavatpurā ।
vada me'tra guro tasya māhātmyaṃ ca vidhiṃ phalam ।।87।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
kūpyavālaḥ kāṣṭhahāro'bhavaccātra vane sthitaḥ ।
kāṣṭhajīvī sadā'raṇye kuṭhārasādhano'bhavat ।।88।।
bhajate sma harikṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ।
sanatkumārarūpaṃ taṃ brahma putraṃ susādhukam ।।89।।
sādhusevāparaḥ satāṃ satsaṃgaṃ sa karotyapi ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā tanvā sādhūn hi sevate ।।2.270.90।।
sādhureva bhagavān vai sādhureva parāgatiḥ ।
sādhusevā mahatpuṇyaṃ pāvanāḥ sādhavo yataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
kāṣṭhahāraśca tatpatnī sevete sādhumaṇḍalam ।
divase kāṣṭhabhedādikāryaṃ kṛtvā niśāmukhe ।।92।।
satāṃ sevāṃ kurutastau nārāyaṇaparāyaṇau ।
sanatkumāraśiṣyāṇāṃ sādhūnāṃ sevane ratau ।।93 ।।
vane yātau hi kāṣṭhānāmādānārthaṃ tadā vane ।
hastinā saṃdhṛtaḥ kāṣṭhahāraḥ sasmāra sadgurum ।।94।।
sanatkumāraṃ sahasā satyalokasthitaṃ prabhum ।
sanatkumāro bhagavān sahasā gocaro'bhavat ।। 95।।
vane sa hastinaṃ prāha re paśo kiṃ karoṣi vai ।
mā vanyaṃ mitrarūpaṃ taṃ kaṣṭe kṣipa vṛthā'tra vai ।।
mā mā māraya kāṣṭhaghnaṃ na te śatrurayaṃ khalu ।। 96।।
hastī provāca-
sanatkumāra bhagavān vairaṃ niryāpayāmyaham ।
ayaṃ kacche brāhmaṇo'bhūddharmakarmāditatparaḥ ।।97।।
karmakāṇḍaparo vidyādānādipuṇyatatparaḥ ।
ahaṃ rājā'bhavaṃ cāpi nāmnā rāyadhaneśvaraḥ ।।98।।
ayaṃ me gurutāṃ kurvana śāsanaṃ pracakāra ha ।
mayā cā'sahamānena śāsane'yaṃ nivāritaḥ ।।99।।
tadā śaśāpa mahyaṃ sa hastī vanāntare bhava ।
mayā śaptaḥ kāṣṭhahāro bhava tatra vanāntare ।। 2.270.1 00।।
so'haṃ rājā kāṣṭhahāraṃ mārayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ ।
mā sādho mama vairasya yāpane vidhnamācara ।। 101 ।।
sanatkumāra uvāca-
vairasya yāpane te'tra kiṃphalaṃ syānnaraghnatā ।
mā maivaṃ kuru vanyendra mokṣaṃ gṛhāṇa madvidhāt ।। 1 02।।
sanatkumāro bhagavānnahamasmi samāgataḥ ।
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ dehaṃ ca tyaktvā yāhi paraṃ padam ।। 1 03।।
gaja uvāca-
dehi mantraṃ kṛpāsindho mokṣaṃ dehi kṛpāṃ kuru ।
punaryathā na jananaṃ saṃsāro na bhavenmama ।। 1 04।।
sanatkumāra uvāca-
ehi hastin sarastīraṃ pītvā jalaṃ sukhāśrayam ।
mantraṃ prāpya prayāhyeva paraṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ padam ।। 1 05।।
evaṃ rājan gajakāṣṭhahārau sanatkumārakaḥ ।
trayaste'ca samāyātāḥ ṛṣiḥ sanatkumārakaḥ ।। 1 06।।
jalaṃ vai pāyayāmāsa snapayāmāsa cātra vai ।
mantraṃ dadau vaiṣṇavaṃ ca dadau muktiṃ hi hastine ।। 1 07।।
kāṣṭhahāro'bhavat svasthaḥ kārayāmāsa pūjanam ।
parṇakuṭīṃ kāṣṭhamayīṃ tatra sanatkumārakam ।। 108।।
sthāpayāmāsa sādhuṃ taṃ brahmaputraṃ pareśvaram ।
sanatkumāro bhagavān mūrtirūpeṇa rājate ।। 1 09।।
divyarūpo gataḥ satye tīrthaṃ tasyedamuttamam ।
sanatkumāratīrthaṃ vai hastitīrthaṃ tathā śubham ।। 2.270.11 0।।
kāṣṭhahārapratīrthaṃ vai procyate cottamottamam ।
ityevaṃ tīrthamatraiva jātaṃ snāhi nṛpā'tra vai ।। 111 ।।
prapūjaya muniṃ sanatkumāraṃ parameśvaram ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavedatra snānād dānātprapūjanāt ।। 1 12।।
ityukto nṛpatistatra rādhike snānamācarat ।
pupūjarṣiṃ sanatkumārakaṃ dānaṃ dadau tathā ।। 113 ।।
tatraścāgre yayau tīrthāntaraṃ pāpaviśodhanam ।
smaraṇātpaṭhanāccā'sya śravaṇānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne devānīkakarṣukasya jalamagnasya viṣṇunā uddhṛtasya viṣṇutīrthaṃ, bhadrāyanagrāmīṇasya brahmastambaviprasya tapataḥ puruṣottamadarśanāt puruṣottamatīrthaṃ, devamūlakakanyayā amaryā tapasi sthitayā''rādhito mahāviṣṇurbhagavāँstāṃ vivāhavidhinā jagrāheti mahāviṣṇutīrthaṃ, kūpyavālakāṣṭhahārasya
gajato rakṣāṃ kṛtavān sanatkumāra iti sanatkumārastīrthaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 270 ।।
