[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 272 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike paścāt nṛpo'śvapāṭalastataḥ ।
tīrthaṃ prayayau kuṃkumeśvaraṃ sadāśivāśrayam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro tīrthamidaṃ kasmāt kathaṃ jātaṃ vadasva me ।
yathāvidhi phalaṃ tasya niyamādi ca sarvaṃthā ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājandūradeśāt purā kaścana ghātakaḥ ।
svajñātikleśaduḥkhaśca saurāṣṭre prasamāyayau ।। 3 ।।
jñātvā tīrthaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarastatra nyuvāsa ha ।
hiṃsākarma parityajya bhikṣā'dano'bhavattataḥ ।। 4 ।।
sādhūnāṃ yogato nāma harekṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।
bālakṛṣṇa parabrahma śrīpate parameśvara ।। 5 ।।
jajāpa bhajanaṃ cakre tīrthasnānādikaṃ tathā ।
evaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtavauṃśca sevāṃ satāmaharniśam ।। 6 ।।
prārabdhānte mṛtastatra kṣetre cā'kṣarasaṃjñake ।
tīrthayogena vai svargaṃ yayau devatvamāpa ha ।। 7 ।।
tataḥ punaśca mānuṣye kuṃkumo brāhmaṇo'bhavat ।
dharmakarmarato daivakārye ca sāvadhānakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
jātismaro'bhavaccāpi pupūja śaṃkaraṃ tathā ।
pārthivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ kṛtvā'tiṣṭhipaccā'tra bhūsuraḥ ।। 9 ।।
varṣānte pañcavarṣānte daśavarṣāntake tathā ।
mahotsavaṃ karotyeva viprāṇāṃ bhojanādikam ।। 2.271.1 0।।
śivarātryāṃ śaṃkarasyotsavaṃ karoti vārṣikam ।
evaṃ viṃśativarṣānte sākṣād babhūva śaṃkaraḥ ।। 11 ।।
prasanno'smi ca te bhaktyā vipra vṛṇu yathepsitam ।
vipraḥ prāha mahāmokṣaṃ dehi me pārvatīpate ।। 12।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu bhakta devo'haṃ pārameśvaraḥ ।
kailāso mama dhāmā'sti tataḥ paraṃ gavāyanam ।। 13।।
golokaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadhāma tasmāt paraṃ tathākṣaram ।
goloke yadi gantuṃ tvaṃ precchasi bhaja gopatim ।। 14।।
gopālaṃ śrīrādhikeśaṃ muralīhastakaṃ prabhum ।
akṣare cet pragantuṃ tvaṃ samicchasi hariṃ bhaja ।। 15।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
kailāsaṃ mama dhāmā'sti sadāśivanivāsanam ।। 16।।
vaikuṇṭhatulyaṃ yaścāste tatra ced gantumicchasi ।
nayāmi gaṇamadhye tvāṃ sthāpaye vada cepsitam ।। 17।।
kuṃkuma uvāca-
dhāmā'kṣaraṃ prayāsyāmi mokṣātmakaṃ parātparam ।
nānyadhāmni tu me vāñcchā tatsādhanaṃ vadā'tra me ।। 18।।
śaṃbhuruvāca-
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ divyaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasya cā'nagha ।
bhaja taṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāsyasi cā'kṣaram ।। 19।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
bhajainaṃ ca japainaṃ ca smarainaṃ ca pareśvaram ।।2.271.20।।
ityuktvā śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ tiro'bhavacca bhūsuraḥ ।
kuṃkumeśvaranāmānaṃ mahādevaṃ śilāmayam ।। 21 ।।
sthāpayitvā mandire cā'bhajat kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
tadidaṃ pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ sadāśivanivāsanam ।। 22।।
kuṃkumeśvaratīrthaṃ ca kṛtvā vai kuṃkumo dvijaḥ ।
bhajitvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ yayau ।।23।।
atra snānāttathā dānānmahādevaḥ prasīdati ।
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca manuṃ datvā prāpayatyakṣaraṃ padam ।।24।।
tasmād rājan snāhi śīghraṃ dānaṃ dehi ca kānakam ।
ityuktaścāśvapaṭalo rādhike lomaśena ha ।।25।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca cakre'gratīrthakaṃ yayau ।
satīśātīrthanāmnā vai prasiddhaṃ pāvanaṃ param ]।26।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro kathaṃ satīśākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ śubhaṃ tvidam ।
saṃkṣepād vada me cā'sya vidhiṃ ca phalamityapi ।। 27।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan vadāmyetat satīśātīrthasaṃbhavam ।
cāraṇānāṃ kulānyatra gopālānāṃ kulānyapi ।।28।।
vasanti sannidhau rājan derikākheṭasīmnyapi ।
pālayanti śataśo gāḥ ajāḥ sahasraśastathā ।। 29।।
vṛṣabhān vatsatarāँśca pālayanti dhanaṃ yathā ।
cārayanti sīmabhāge pāyayantīha vāryapi ।।।2.271.3 0।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre rātrau viśrāmayanti ca ।
prātaḥ punaḥ prayāntyeva paśucāramaraṇyakam ।।3 1 ।।
ityevaṃ paśupālāste cāraṇāḥ kuṃkumeśvaram ।
paritaḥ sarasaḥ setau vṛkṣā'dho nivasanti vai ।। 32।।
parṇapallyāṃ tvekadā vai suptā''sīccāraṇī satī ।
śrīmahādevabhaktā sā satīśākhyā pativratā ।।33 ।।
mahādevasya dugdhena prātaḥsnānā'bhiṣecanam ।
kārayatyeva bhāvena hārdena pārvatīpateḥ ।।34।।
tādṛśīṃ bhaktiyuktāṃ tāṃ caurāḥ praviśya tadgṛhe ।
patiśūnye pradharṣitavantastvekākinīṃ satīm ।।35।।
patirgato'bhavadgrāmāntaraṃ sambandhino gṛhe ।
evaṃ chidraṃ pralabdhvaiva caurāḥ prādharṣayan satīm ।।36।।
satīśā sā dharmavatī sasmāra pārvatīṃ satīm ।
duṣṭasaṃhārakartrīṃ ca caṇḍīṃ śaṃkarayoginīm ।।37।।
mātaḥ śīghraṃ mama rakṣāṃ kuru caurebhya eva ha ।
prātaḥ kṣīraṃ prapācyaiva kariṣye te nivedanam ।।38।।
evaṃ smṛtā satī durgā tūrṇaṃ khaṅgakarā tadā ।
kuṃkumeśvarapārśvād vai satīśā'ṅganamāyayau ।।39।।
sakhaḍgā sakṛpāṇā ca muśalāḍhyā sasiṃhikā ।
aṣṭahastā garjanāṃ ca kṛtvā jagrāha caurakān ।।2.271.40।।
jaghāna caurān sahasā satīśāṃ sā rarakṣa ha ।
caurā hatāstu khaḍgena mṛtāḥ pañca narāstadā ।।41।।
satīśā durgayā sākaṃ sarovāri samāyayau ।
ubhe pānīyakaṃ pītvā yayatuḥ kuṃkumeśvaram ।।42।।
tatra līnā'bhavada durgā satīśā mandire'vasat ।
prātargatā gṛhaṃ naijaṃ gaṇā ninyurhatāñjanān ।।43।।
satīśā sā satī yatra durgayā sahitā papau ।
jalaṃ tatra taṭe devīṃ durgāmasthāpayat satīm ।।44।।
durgātīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ satīśātīrthamityapi ।
pārvatītīrthamevāpi dharmarakṣākaraṃ hyabhūt ।।45।।
atra snānena dānena satīśādarśanena ca ।
caurādīnāṃ bhayanāśo dharmarakṣā bhaved dhruvam ।।46 ।।
rājan snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ satīśādarśanaṃ kuru ।
durgāpūjanamevāpi durgātīrthe samācara ।।।47।।।
ityukto rādhike rājā sasnau dadau pupūja ca ।
tato yayāvagrabhūmau setau tīrthāntaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।।48।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kimidaṃ tīrthavaryaṃ me samādiśa guro prabho ।
kathaṃ kasmāt kadā jātaṃ kiṃphalaṃ pāvane'tra vai ।। 49।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
dhanyeśvarī vaṇikpatnī sevābhaktiparāyaṇā ।
āsīt kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sa subhaktā vaiṣṇavī hyapi ।।2.271.50 ।।
lobhavaśā kvacit kvāpi parasvaṃ tvādadātyapi ।
ekadā sā kambharāyā mahālakṣmyā gṛhaṃ yayau ।। 51 ।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ rāmayitvā natvā śrīkaṃbharāṃ satīm ।
ratnānāṃ daśakaṃ nītvā cauryeṇa svagṛhaṃ gatā ।।।52।।।
gṛhasthe ca ghaṭe yatra ratnāni ca dhanāni ca ।
rakṣatyeva ghaṭe tatra nyadhāccauryā''hṛtānyapi ।।53।।
tataḥ kāle gate svalpe saṃkrāntau śubhaparvaṇi ।
snātuṃ dānaṃ prakartuṃ ca ghaṭamādāya vai taṭe ।।54।।
aeśvapaṭṭasaraso'tra samāyātā kuṭumbinī ।
snātvā dānāni dātuṃ ca yāvaddhaṭe karaṃ nijam ।।।55।।
prāveśayitvā ratnāni gṛhṇāti tāvadeva tu ।
hastau ratnāni sarvāṇi ghaṭe lagnāni cā'bhavan ।।।56।।
piṇḍavad ghaṭamadhye tatsarvaṃ tadā vyajāyata ।
hasto lagnaḥ piṇḍamadhye piṇḍaśca ghaṭamadhyagaḥ ।।57।।
ghaṭo lagnaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca sarvaṃ tvekīmayaṃ hyabhūt। ।
dhanyeśvarī bhayaṃ prāptā kimidaṃ me kare'bhavat ।।58।।
hastaṃ viyojayituṃ sā yatnaṃ cakāra sundarī ।
khinnā śramayutā jātā bahulokairvilokitā ।।59।।
tadā ghaṭasya garbhādvai śabdaḥ samabhavacchubhaḥ ।
tvayā cauryeṇa ratnāni ghaṭe'tra nihitāni vai ।।2.271.60 ।।
tatphalaṃ te samutpannaṃ piṇḍabhāvo na naśyati ।
yadi viyojayituṃ te vāñcchā cedvartate sakhi ।।61 ।।
ahaṃ lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ cā'smi manmandiraṃ prakāraya ।
lomaśāya dhanaṃ sarvaṃ samāhūya pradehi ca ।।62।।
tadā hasto mokṣyate te nānyathā tu kadācana ।
ityuktā sā lomaśaṃ māmatrā''hūtavatī tataḥ ।।63।।
cakre ghaṭapradānasya saṃkalpaṃ mandirārthakam ।
etatsthale tatastasya hasto'bhavat pṛthagghaṭāt ।।64।।
tadā lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ caturbhujā ghaṭāt prakāśitā ।
kṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ pradarśyaiva sthale'traiva tirogatā ।।65।।
mandiraṃ tu tato lakṣmyā mayā cā'tra prakāritam ।
lakṣmīścātra vasatyeva dhanyeśvarī prapūjitā ।।66।।
lakṣmītīrthaṃ tathā dhanyeśvarītīrthaṃ ghaṭasthalī ।
prasiddhaṃ samabhūttvetaccauryadoṣanivārakam ।।67।।
pāpapiṇḍādihāraṃ ca bhuktimuktipradaṃ tathā ।
snānadānāditaścātra kalmaṣāṇāṃ vināśanam ।।68।।
lakṣmīpūjanataścātra lakṣmīvān dhanavān bhavet ।
lakṣmīlokaṃ prāpnuyācca lakṣmīsevāparo bhavet ।।69।।
snāhi dehi samarhāṃ ca prakāraya śriyā nṛpa ।
ityuktastvaśvapaṭalaḥ sasnau dadau pupūja tām ।।2.271.70।।
rādhike sa tato yāto lomaśena samaṃ puraḥ ।
śālagrāmamahātīrthaṃ mandireṇa virājitam ।।71।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
guro tīrthamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śālagrāmakṛtasthitim ।
kadā kathaṃ prajātaṃ tadvidhiṃ phalaṃ ca śādhi me ।।72।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
caityabrahmā'bhavannāmnā dvijo nikṛṣṭavartanaḥ ।
nikṛṣṭeṣu kṛtāvāso nikṛṣṭabhojano'bhavat ।।73।।
pāpinā saṃgamāsādya sadā pāpaparo'bhavat ।
madirāṃ sa papau cauryaṃ cakre prasaṃgataśca saḥ ।।74।।
pāradāryaṃ tathā cakre hyevaṃ cāṇḍālavartanaḥ ।
samajāyata vipro'pi bhraṣṭo jātikulāditaḥ ।।75।।
athaikadā niśāyāṃ tadgṛhe sādhuḥ samāyayau ।
taṃ tiraskṛtavān vipro'tithiṃ kṣudraṃ janaṃ yathā ।।76।।
sādhurjñātvā durācāraṃ sasmāra yamadūtakam ।
yamadūtastadā śīghraṃ cāyayau nṛpa tadgṛhe ।।77।।
mārayāmāsa bahudhā paśumāraṃ tataśca saḥ ।
kṣamāmayācata yadā tadā sādhurdayāparaḥ ।।78।।
mocayāmāsa duṣṭaṃ taṃ yamadūtabhayāttataḥ ।
sādhuryayau yathāmārgaṃ duṣṭaviprastu lomaśam ।।79।।
uddhāravāñcchayā tadāśramaṃ yayau guruṃ hi mām ।
prārthayāmāsa bahudhā svoddhāraṃ pratimāṃ tadā ।।2.271.80 ।।
lomaśo'haṃ dattavāँśca prāyaścittaṃ hi vatsaram ।
cāndrāyaṇadvādaśakavrataṃ so'pi tathā'karot ।।8 1 ।।
śuddhāya tasmai viprāya śālagrāmaṃ pradattavān ।
pūjanārthaṃ sa ca vipro'pūjayattaṃ yathocitam ।।82।।
tato mantro mayā tasmai datto vaiṣṇavabhāvataḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।83।।
karoti mantrajāpaṃ sa śālagrāmaprapūjanam ।
karotyapi divārātrau dhyānaṃ ca bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।84।।
prātarbrāhmamuhūrte sa śālagrāmayuto'tra vai ।
taṭe tvāgatya ca pūjāmāsūryodayameva ha ।।85।।
karoti sa sadā setau tulasīdrumasannidhau ।
evaṃ bahutithe kāle yāte bhaktiṃ vilokya ca ।।86 ।।
śālagrāmaḥ prasanno'bhūd divyaviṣṇurbabhūva ha ।
śālagrāmaśilā tatra layaṃ prāptā tadā dvijaḥ ।।87।।
rakṣa rakṣa kṛpāsindho samuddhāraṃ kuru prabho ।
ityuktvā patitastasya viṣṇoścaraṇayostadā।।88।।
tāvadvai tulasīvṛkṣāllakṣmīrdevī vyajāyata ।
uvāca śrīrbrāhmaṇaṃ vai tulasīmandiraṃ tviha ।।89 ।।
śālagrāmālayaṃ cāpi prakāraya sarastaṭe ।
tena bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ prayāsyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।।2.271.90।।
ityuktvā sā tirobhūtā vṛkṣarūpā babhūva ha ।
viṣṇuścāpi tirobhūya śālagrāmaśilā'bhavat ।।9 1।।
tadidaṃ mandiraṃ rājaँstena vipreṇa kāritam ।
tanmadhye tulasī divyā drumarūpā virājate ।।92।।
tanmūle bhagavānnāste viṣṇuḥ śālaśilātmakaḥ ।
atra snānāttathā dānātpūjanāttulasīprabhoḥ ।।93।।
tulasīlagnakaraṇād bhuktirmuktirbhavedapi ।
sarvapāpapraṇāśaśca svargātisvargamāpnuyāt ।।94।।
śālagrāmaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ tulasītīrthamityapi ।
caityabrahmākhyatīrthaṃ ca vidyate pāvanaṃ tvidam ।।95।।
snāhi dehi samarhāṃ ca kurumandiravartinoḥ ।
tulasīkṛṣṇayoḥ rājan kṛṣṇaprasannatāṃ vraja ।।96।।
ityukto rādhike rājā sasnau dadau pupūja ca ।
jalāmṛtaṃ tathā prasādāmṛtaṃ parigṛhya ca ।।97।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca kṛtvā'gre'paratīrthakam ।
yayau lomaśayukto vai prasanno mānase hyati ।।98।।
aho tīrthāni sarvāṇi śrībhagavanmayāni hi ।
mayā kṛtāni kṛtinā kṛpāpātreṇa vai hareḥ ।।99।।
ityāścaryaparo rājā mahāśāntiṃ yayau hṛdi ।
kṣaṇaṃ dadhyo hṛdaye sve lomaśaṃ jñānadaṃ gurum ।। 2.271.1 00।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca puruṣottamam ।
vāyukoṇagato rājā smṛtvā neme sarovaram ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kuṃkumaviprakṛtaṃ kuṃkumeśvaratīrthaṃ satīśācāraṇīkṛtaṃ durgāsatītīrthaṃ vaṇikpatnīdhanyeśvarīkṛtaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ caitya-
brahmadvijakṛtaṃ śālagrāmatīrthaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 271 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 271 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 272
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 273 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe tato rājā naranārāyaṇāhvayam ।
tīrthaṃ gatvā lomaśaṃ ca papraccha munisattamam ।। 1 ।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kathaṃ kasmādidaṃ tīrthaṃ naranārāyaṇāhvayam ।
ko vidhiḥ kiṃphalaṃ cātra vada me lomaśa prabho ।। 2 ।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam ।
atra gopālakṛṣṇau vai gosvāmī ca pitā hareḥ ।। 3 ।।
prathamaṃ khalu putrārthaṃ tapaścacāra dāruṇam ।
yaśca devo naranārāyaṇaścāste himācale ।। 4 ।।
tapasvināṃ dharmapoṣṭā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ।
tāpasānāṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhyātvā tapaścacāra ha ।। 5 ।।
prathamaṃ tyaktavānannaṃ tataḥ kandaparo'bhavat ।
patrāhārastataścāpi śuṣkaparṇāśanastataḥ ।। 6 ।।
jalāhārastato vāyvāhārastato vyajāyata ।
jajāpa śrīnaranārāyaṇaṃ vai hṛdaye sadā ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ varṣaśatānte'tra naro nārāyaṇastathā ।
kṛṣṇo hariśca catvāro bhagavantaḥ samāyayuḥ ।। 8 ।।
pratyakṣaṃ te samāgatyocustaṃ gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
mahāviṣṇo kathaṃ tapaścarasi vai narāyaṇa ।। 9 ।।
vāsudeva jagaddhātā kiṃ te tapasi kāraṇam ।
prasannāḥ smo vayaṃ nārāyaṇāścatvāra eva ha ।। 2.272.1 0।।
yatheṣṭaṃ brūhi dadmo'tra varadānaṃ yathepsitam ।
śrutvā gopālakṛṣṇaśca prāha kalyāṇahetave ।। 1 1।।
lokānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
pakṣiṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca vallīnāṃ śākhināṃ tathā ।। 12।।
stambānāṃ ca tṛṇānāṃ ca bhavantu putrakā mama ।
tathā cāstviti jagadurviviśustattanau tadā ।। 13।।
catvāraste parameśā nārāyaṇo narastathā ।
kṛṣṇo hariśca te putrā babhūvustasya mānasāḥ ।। 14।।
kaṃbharābālakāścāṃ'śā lokakalyāṇahetave ।
nārāyaṇo'bhavajjyeṣṭho nāmnā śrībhagavāniti ।। 15।।
narastato'bhavannāmnā śukadevo dvitīyakaḥ ।
kṛṣṇo'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 16।।
akṣarādhipatiḥ so'yamavatārī tṛtīyakaḥ ।
hariścaturtho nāmnā śrīvallabhaścā'bhavattadā ।। 17।।
samānāśca samaiśvaryāḥ samadehaprabhāyutāḥ ।
parameśāścātra te vai hyabhavan bālakā nṛpa ।। 18।।
yatra gopālakṛṣṇena tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam ।
bhūmiriyaṃ pāvanī sā mandiraṃ cedameva yat ।। 19।।
atra gopālakṛṣṇaḥ sa nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ pratimākhyān prātiṣṭhipaddhi mandire ।।2.272.20 ।।
tadidaṃ sarvamūrdhanyaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthordhvadhāma yat ।
viśrāntiṃ cātra saṃgṛhya dhyāne gṛhṇa catuṣprabhūn ।।21।।
smaraṇād darśanādatra snānātpānāt prapūjanāt ।
dānāt prasevanāccāpi muktireva phalaṃ mahat ।। 22।।
naitattulyaṃ makhānāṃ vā vratānāṃ phalamasti vai ।
naitattulyaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ dīkṣānāṃ phalamasti ca ।।23।।
atrā''sīd bhūtalaṃ rājan viśālaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam ।
yadidaṃ dṛśyate tvadya aśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।24।।
aśvapāṭala uvāca-
kadā mune'tra saṃjātaṃ bhūtale vai sarovaram ।
sarvatīrthamayaṃ ramyaṃ sarvanārāyaṇāśrayam ।।25।।
śrīlomaśa uvāca-
ahamāsaṃ purā dhāmni vaikuṇṭhe tatra caikadā ।
āśrauṣaṃ cākṣareśo yo'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।26।।
caturmukhā'jabrahmāṇḍe gopālakṛṣṇamandire ।
mānavo bhavituṃ yāti lokakalyāṇahetave ।।27।।
tadā nārāyaṇāḥ sarve muktāḥ sarve tatheśvarāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścāpi pṛthvyāmatra samāyayuḥ ।।28।।
devyaśceśvarapatnyaśca muktānyo gopikāstathā ।
nārāyaṇyo brahmaputryo'psarasaḥ surayoṣitaḥ ।।29।।
brahmasarasaḥ sarvāśca brahmapriyā haripriyāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyaḥ śaktayaścāpi sarvāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।2.272.3 0।।
svāgatārthaṃ ca pūjārthaṃ sahavāsārthamityapi ।
sevanārthaṃ tathā te tāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।।3 1 ।।
te ca tāśca tadā pratīkṣante prākaṭyameva ca ।
tadā cāha sarvamenaṃ vyalokayaṃ samutsavam ।।32।।
akṣare tu pare dhāmni jñātaṃ māṇikyayā tadā ।
patirme bhagavān sarveśvareśvareśvareśvaraḥ ।।33।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prayāti bhūtale ।
sā pūrvaṃ dhāmataḥ pṛthvyāṃ vyāghrāraṇye samāgatā ।।34।।
brahmacaryavratasyā'sya vāhanaṃ bhavituṃ satī ।
samaicchadaśvinīrūpaṃ kanyārūpaṃ samaicchikam ।।35।।
aśvībhūtvā parā'jñātā bhūbhāge'paryaṭat satī ।
atrā'kṣare śubhe tīrthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇārthinī ।। 36।।
īśvarādyairlokitā sā divyarūpā priyā hareḥ ।
yatra yatrā'bhavat sā ca sā bhūmiścāśvapaṭṭikā ।।37।।
tīrtharūpā'bhavaccāpi nirṇayo'pyabhavacca naḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścātra nivatsyati ।।38।।
tāvattatra samāyāto brahmahrado'kṣarātpadāt ।
jalarūpo divyadhāmā cāśvapaṭṭasaromayaḥ ।।39।।
atra bhūmau jalātmā sā divyasarovaro'bhavat ।
smara rājan brahmahrado yaśca divyasarovaraḥ ।।2.272.40।।
sa eva somayāgasya kartā rājā'śvapāṭalaḥ ।
tvameva mānavaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā pṛthvyāṃ virājase ।।41।।
ityuktaḥ khalu rājā'sau rādhike svaṃ vyalokayat ।
brahmamuktaṃ brahmahradaṃ sarojalā'vatārakam ।।।42।।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ mene jñānaṃ kṣaṇaṃ hyabhūddhi tata ।
punarlayaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ svaṃ hyamanyata ।।43 ।।
tataḥ śrīlomaśaḥ prāha rājaँstīrthamidaṃ param ।
pāvanīmāṇikītīrthaṃ cāśvinītīrthamityapi ।।44।।
brahmahradamahātīrthaṃ cāśvapāṭalatīrthakam ।
mayā dṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ca tataḥ param ।।45।।
ahamatra sadāvāsaṃ kṛtavānāśrame śubhe ।
avatārāstathā muktā īśvarā devatādikāḥ ।।46।।
sarve nyūṣurhareḥ kṣetre'kṣarā'śvapaṭṭasāgare ।
sarvā devyaśca devāśca prāvirbhāvottaraṃ hareḥ ।।47।।
pupūjuḥ parayā prītyā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
rādhā lakṣmīḥ pārvatī ca padmā ramā jayā ratiḥ ।।48।।
lalitā padminī raṃbhā māṇikī śrīḥ sarasvatī ।
gaṃgā durgā ca sāvitrī saṃjñā yamunā rohiṇī ।।49।।
maṃjulā sadguṇā hāsā haimī śāntiḥ supuṣpikā ।
manuḥ kastūrikā devī campā'mbojasvatī vṛjā ।।2.272.50।।
sarvā devyo brahmapatnyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
āgatya nyūṣuścātraiva sarasyeva hareḥ pade ।।।51।।।
gaṇḍakī svarṇarekhā ca narmadā tuṃgabhadrikā ।
godāvarī brahmaputrā kāverī phalgurīśvarī ।।52।।
kṛṣṇā śoṇā gomatī ca sindhuścoralikā tathā ।
śoṇabhadraścerāvatī sālvīnā menakāṃgikā ।
mannāmnī cāṃgaśikṣāṃgī tathā kāṃcanagaṃgikā ।।53।।
tryaṃgahā cāmūrakā ca vīnā yānāsanā tathā ।
ombā ca trivalī cāmū vālagā nīparā tathā ।
devikā dīnyubā cāpi utkrośī nāilī tathā।।54।।
prapattikā sevikā ca nāstijarā ca kaṅgukī ।
kyubagaṃgā rañjikā ca viṣatūrā ca jampikā ।।55।।
śvetā nārāyaṇī cāpi matkuṃjā yūkanāyikā ।
niraśāṇā miśrajalā āmajanā parānikā ।
śvānā ca grāsakāyānā viṣatūryā kaliṃginī ।।56।।
mūrāstathā'nyā nadyaśca sarvāstatra sarovare ।
āyayustīrtharūpāstāḥ sadā vāsārthameva ha ।।57।।
mānasaṃ cendradyumnaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ ca puṣkaram ।
pampā cendraprastharūpaṃ sudarśanaṃ ca revatam ।।58।।
śivasarastathā citkṛtsaraḥ kaularakaṃ saraḥ ।
śivaśīlaṃ mīnakaṃgusaraḥ sābharakaṃ saraḥ ।।59।।
bālakṛṣṇasaraścāpi dvikalaṃ ca sarovaram ।
saṭālaphaṃ saraścāpi viṣatūrasarovaram ।।2.272.60।।
uralaṃ ca saraścāpi triguṇorasakaṃ tathā ।
pherumaṇḍaṃ lūrāsaro maśakākhyaṃ sarastathā ।।61।।
rukmaṃ trināsikaṃ cāpi ebālaṃ ca sarastathā ।
saṭālpakaṃ cālparūkṣam ārdravārtaṃ sarastathā ।।62।।
kimu tryaṃgānakaṃ cāpi mayorasaṃ sarastathā ।
bangapālaṃ nyūnajāmī śirāvāsaṃ sarastathā ।।63।।
aitasaṃ cauniyāgāraṃ lendugaṃ pāyugaṃ tathā ।
yonigam aurasaṃ tūronasaṃ gauraṃ sarastathā ।।64।।
gogrāsaṃ bālarīśaṃ ca ubarāsaṃ sarastathā ।
jayaśānaṃ grātavāraṃ grātaslāvaṃ sarastathā ।।65।।
krītaslāvaṃ ceṣṭavāsaṃ pīlipārśvaṃ sarastathā ।
supārayāraṃ kālīyam ītarīśaṃ sarastathā ।।66।।
etānyapi sarāṃsyatra tasthustatrāgatāni vai ।
vṛndāvanaṃ mahākālavanaṃ tapovanaṃ tathā ।।67।।
indraprasthavanaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ pauṣkarakaṃ vanam ।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ badaryāraṇyakaṃ sundarakaṃ vanam ।।68।।
prāgjyotiṣāraṇyakaṃ ca kāśamāraṇyamityapi ।
irāraṇyaṃ tathā śikṣāraṇyaṃ rāśavanaṃ tathā ।।69।।
uralāraṇyakaṃ cāpi khāsīnāraṇyakaṃ tathā ।
bālāyanamahāraṇyaṃ sahārāraṇyamityapi ।।2.272.70।।
vālajīvāraṇyakaṃ ca śādayānavanaṃ tathā ।
amarīvanamevāpi cābriktāraṇyakaṃ tathā ।।71 ।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tathā daivavanāni cātra cāyayuḥ ।
svāgataṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā hareścātra nivāsanam ।।72।।
pracakruḥ sarvadā cāśvapaṭṭasarasi tāni vai ।
evaṃ rājan paraṃ tīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastvidam ।।73।।
tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ cāpi śubhaṃ brahmahradātmakam ।
pṛthivyāṃ svargaloke ca tathā'nyatrāpi yāni tu ।।74।।
santi tīrthāni tānyatra virajādīni santi ca ।
samudrā divyajalino vasantyatra jale'niśam ।।75।।
yatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
tatra sarve'vatārāśca muktā dhāmāni yānyapi ।।76।।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca devā devyo vasanti ca ।
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi siddhayaḥ pravasanti ca ।।77।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthaṃ paraṃ hi tat ।
atrā''vāsaṃ samālebhe bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।78।।
tadā tena samaṃ mūrtau sarvāstasya priyāḥ śubhāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vāmabhāgagāḥ ।।79।।
paṭṭāṃganā āyayuśca śataṃ ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ ।
tāśca sarovare ramye paścime setubhājite ।।2.272.8 0।।
nyūṣustīrthasvarūpiṇyaḥ śatatīrthaṃ taducyate ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyake dine ।।8 1 ।।
gopagopāṃganāyuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastatra cāyayau ।
gopītīrthaṃ gopatīrthaṃ golokatīrthamityapi ।।82।।
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ ca tajjātaṃ paraṃ golokamuktidam ।
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāṃ prāha yadā'tra sa samāyayau ।।83 ।।
rādhike tvaṃ nibodhā'tretyuvāca rādhikāṃ priyām ।
vairājena kṛtānyeva brahmāṇḍāni sahasraśaḥ ।।84।।
tatra tatra praveṣṭuṃ ca vyavasthāpayituṃ harim ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prārthayati sma saḥ ।।85।।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇeśvareśvara ।
sarveṣu mannirmiteṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu bhavān prabhuḥ ।।।86।।
yāvannāyāsyati tāvad vyavasthāṃ dharmakarmiṇām ।
jīvānāṃ vyavahārāṇāṃ kaḥ kariṣyati mādhava ।।87।।
daityānāṃ tāmasānāṃ ca kaḥ śikṣāṃ prakariṣyati ।
pāpināṃ pāpanāśāni tvāṃ vinā kaḥ kariṣyati ।।88।।
vedadīkṣāvidhānādi tvāṃ vinā kaḥ kariṣyati ।
yajñayāgādikaṃ daivaṃ paitryaṃ puṇyapradaṃ vidhim ।।89।।
maryādāṃ dehināṃ cāpi tvāṃ vinā kaḥ kariṣyati ।
ātmajñānapradānaṃ ca sādhūnāṃ dharmarakṣaṇam ।।2.272.90।।
satīnāṃ suvidhānaṃ ca vaivāhyaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati ।
rāgadveṣanimagnānāṃ dehināṃ bhramavartinām ।।9 1।।
vinā tvāṃ tvatprasaṃgaṃ ca ko vā muktiṃ kariṣyati ।
pūjādharmaṃ tathā rakṣādharmaṃ cotpannadharmakam ।।92।।
sevādharmaṃ vinā tvāṃ ko mānavebhyo'bhidhāsyati ।
śīladharmaṃ gṛhidharmaṃ vanyadharmaṃ yatikriyām ।। 93 ।।
tyāgadharmaṃ cātmanivedanaṃ nītiṃ purātanīm ।
paddhatiṃ vārṇikīṃ cāpi tvāṃ vinā kaḥ kariṣyati ।।94।।
vinā'pi tava prākaṭyaṃ brahmāṇḍāni ca tāni tu ।
śmaśānabhūmayaḥ sarvā janmamaraṇasūtikāḥ ।।95।।
tvāṃ vinā sādhavo muktā na yāsyantyakṣarātpadāt ।
pārṣadāśca tathā lakṣmyo na yāsyantyaṇḍakoṭiṣu ।।96 ।।
tvāṃ vinā maṃgalaṃ naiva bhaviṣyati surādiṣu ।
tvāṃ vinā rakṣaṇaṃ naiva bhaviṣyati yathātatham ।। 97।।
vinā tvāṃ bhagavan sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
yogināmapi vāsāśca bhaviṣyanti na sarvathā ।।।98।।
avatārāstathā te'pi gamiṣyanti na teṣu ca ।
vinā sarvasṛṣṭisārvabhaumaṃ kaḥ prathamaṃ vrajet ।।99।।
mokṣamārgādivijñānaṃ tathopāstyādikaṃ prabho ।
sāttvikā api devādyā jñāsyantyeva na sarvathā ।। 2.272.10 0।।
māyāpaṭalamāsādya tadāvṛttā hi dehinaḥ ।
divyatāṃ svāṃ samutsṛjya patiṣyanti tamomaye ।। 101 ।।
tasmāttvaṃ bhagavan sarvabrahmāṇḍeṣu prakāśatām ।
yāhi nātha kṛpāsindho'nādiśrīpuruṣottama ।।102।।
ityevaṃ prārthito'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'kṣare ।
pare dhāmni sthitaḥ śrutvā divyavāṇyā virājakam ।। 10 3।।
samuvāca tathā'stvevaṃ yāmi brahmāṇḍakoṭiṣu ।
ityabhidhāya bhagavān paradhāmnaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 1 04।।
samaicchad bahubhavituṃ sarvakalyāṇahetave ।
pratyaṇḍaṃ pratimūrtiḥ sa babhūva parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 05।।
anekāṇḍeṣu sarvatra guṇaiśvaryavibhūtibhiḥ ।
pārṣadairdivyamuktaiśca patnībhiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha ।। 1 06।।
bhaktaiśca dharmabhogaiścopāsanābhaktibhiḥ saha ।
sa vai prādurbabhūvā'sau rādhe kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 07।।
yatra brahmā svayaṃbhūśca śaṃkaraḥ somanāthakaḥ ।
naranārāyaṇo viṣṇustatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 108।।
naranārāyaṇakhaṇḍe paścime tu surāṣṭrake ।
bhūtale tvakṣarakṣetre bhāviraivataprāgdiśi ।। 10 9।।
kukumavāpikātīrthe cāśvapaṭṭasarasta8e ।
kuṃkumāyāṃ nagaryāṃ śrīhariḥ prādurbabhūva saḥ ।। 2.272.11 0।।
ayameva paraḥ kṛṣṇo yasmāt kṛṣṇā anantakāḥ ।
āvirbhavanti rādhe tvaṃ nibodhā'sya hi gauravam ।। 11 1।।
ityevaṃ vai svayaṃ kṛṣṇastadā śrīrādhikāṃ priyām ।
samuvāca mayā tattu śrutaṃ sākṣānnarādhipa ।। 1 12।।
so'yaṃ śrīkambharāputraḥ śrīśo gopālanandanaḥ ।
yajate bālakṛṣṇo'sau kumāraḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।। 11 3।।
sarvāvatārā dhāmāni muktāstatheśvarādayaḥ ।
devāstīrthāni santaśca satyaścātra vasanti vai ।। 1 14।।
mokṣo muktirmūrtimantau virājete'tra bhūtale ।
tasmād rājannatra tīrthe yadalpaṃ tadvidhehyapi ।। 1 15।।
ityukto lomaśenaiṣa rājā dīkṣāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ।
jagrāha vidhinā tyaktvā mohaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।। 1 16।।
sādhurbabhūva rājā sa vaiṣṇavīṃ prāpya dīkṣikām ।
rādhike! citprakāśetināmnā ṛṣistato'bhavat ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne naranāyaṇatīrthaṃ harikṛṣṇatīrthaṃ māṇikītīrthamaśvapāṭalaprāgvṛttāntamaśvapaṭṭasaṃjñāsarvatīrthāgamaḥ, vairājastutyā parabrahmāgamaḥ, aśvapāṭalasya sādhudīkṣetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 272 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 272 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 273
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 274 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
rādhike kuṃkumavāpyāṃ citprakāśasya dīkṣayā ।
preritāḥ ṛṣayaścānye pañcaśataṃ hariśritāḥ ।। 1 ।।
lomaśaṃ sadguruṃ natvā dīkṣārthaṃ jagadurdrutam ।
lomaśo'pi dadau dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tatsthale śubhām ।। 2 ।।
sarvamantrayutāṃ kāṣāyāmbarīṃ sādhusammatām ।
kṛtopavāsāḥ sarve te kṛtadehapraśuddhayaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kṛtahomā jagṛhuśca mantrān kāṣāyadhāriṇaḥ ।
'śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 4 ।।
ityenaṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ jagṛhurdṛḍhamānasāḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।। 5 ।।
samarpaṇākhyaṃ mantraṃ taṃ jagṛhuśca tataḥ param ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśatruyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।। 6 ।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
ityenaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ jagṛhuśca tataḥ param ।। 7 ।।
'brahmā'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhakto'smi śāśvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।। 8 ।।
brahmabhāvābhidhaṃ mantramenaṃ jagṛhurantataḥ ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 9 ।।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛn mitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।
ityenaṃ cātmanivedaṃ mantraṃ ca jagṛhustataḥ ।। 2.273.1 0।।
atha te munayo rādhe! natvā śrīlomaśaṃ munim ।
papracchuḥ pālyadharmāṃśca lomaśaḥ prāha vai tataḥ ।।1 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sarvān sādhusamarhāṃśca dharmān svayaṃ pravakṣyati ।। 12।
atha rājñī rājapatnī sādhvīdīkṣāṃ tataḥ param ।
jagrāha tatra sarastaṭe vai rādhike śubhām ।। 12 ।।
bahvayastataḥ prajagṛhuḥ sādhvīdīkṣāṃ hi yoṣitaḥ ।
dīkṣātīrthaṃ sādhutīrthaṃ sādhvītīrthaṃ hyabhūddhi tat ।। 14।।
tataḥ sādhupañcaśataṃ sādhvīpañcaśataṃ tathā ।
lomaśena samaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇālayaṃ śubham ।। 15 ।।
gatvā sarve ca sarvāśca sādhudharmān harermukhāt ।
prapūjya ca niṣadyaiva śuśruvuḥ praśnitasya vai ।। 16 ।।
sthūladehe sūkṣmadehaḥ sūkṣmadehe tu vāsanā ।
vāsanāyāṃ jīvanaṃ ca jīvane sākṣibhāvanā ।। 17।।
sākṣibhāve ca nairguṇyaṃ nairguṇye lepavarjanam ।
alepe brahmaniṣṭhā ca brahmabhāve pramuktatā ।। 18।।
pramuktau paramānandaḥ parabrahmakṛto bhavet ।
evaṃ daśavidhā vedīṃ cāruhyā''nandamaśnute ।। 1 9।।
daśāṃgaṃ ca samādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhubhiḥ sadā ।
dehasya vaśatā kāryā tapasā nigraheṇa ca ।। 2.273.20 ।।
titikṣayā ca kṣamayā śīlena sevayā'niśam ।
sūkṣmendriyāṇāṃ vaśatā kartavyā dhairyabhāvanaiḥ ।।2 1 ।।
apravṛttyā viṣayāṇāmadānena dhiyā tathā ।
vivekena vicāreṇa śāntavṛttyā nirantaram ।।22।।
vāsanāyāstato nāśaḥ kartavyo'nicchayā sadā ।
asmṛtyā caramasmṛtyā dairghyeṇa ca cireṇa ca ।।23 ।।
jīvanaṃ prāṇasañcāraḥ karmaphalā'vinodbhavaḥ ।
phalārpaṇena vai kṛṣṇe prāṇasaṃyamanena ca ।। 24।।
yātrāmātragrahaṇena kubhakādyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
prāṇasaṃyamanaṃ kuryāt prāṇadoṣān parityajet ।। 25 ।।
sākṣibhāvaṃ sukhe duḥkhe svābhimānaṃ nijasya yat ।
tyajennirmamatāyukto nirahaṃkāra ityapi ।।26 ।।
svārthabhāve hi sākṣitvaṃ pārārthye sākṣitā kutaḥ ।
evaṃ jayet sākṣibhāvaṃ mamā'haṃtyajanād yatiḥ ।।27।।
tato'sya guṇasaṃsparśāḥ sukhaduḥkhavimohinaḥ ।
prakāśapravṛttiniyamāḥ śītoṣṇamadhyamāstathā ।।28।।
na jāyante yato'syaiva nairguṇyaṃ samapadyata ।
guṇānāmarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇe nairguṇyaṃ cāntare'pi ca ।।29।।
manasā mananaṃ yattat kṛṣṇe'rpitaṃ na lepakṛt ।
cittena cintanaṃ kṛṣṇe'rpitaṃ naiva hi lepakṛt ।।2.273.3 0।।
buddhyā ca bodhanaṃ kṛṣṇe'rpitaṃ nāpi ca lepakṛt ।
ahantayā'bhimananaṃ kṛṣṇe'rpitaṃ na lepakṛt ।।3 1 ।।
tanmātrā''locanaṃ tena sutarāṃ lepakṛnna vai ।
bhāvanā vāsanā vāpi saṃskāraśca harau dhṛtaḥ ।।32।।
sutarāṃ divyatāṃ prāpto lepakṛnnaiva nirguṇaḥ ।
evaṃ sarvārpaṇe sarvaṃ nirguṇaṃ hariyogataḥ ।।3 3।।
kartavyaṃ sādhubhiścāpi sādhvībhiḥ sarvathā tviha ।
māyāguṇairalope ca jāte phalādyayogini ।।34।।
brahmatā brahmaniṣṭhā vai brahmavad vartanaṃ sthitiḥ ।
jāyate sarvathā sādhoḥ sarvadā'kṣarasāmyatā ।।35।।
yathā'kṣare sṛṣṭayo vai jāyante'ntaḥprayanti ca ।
brahmaṇi sṛṣṭisparśo na māyāsparśo'pi naiva ca ।।36।।
tato'sya bandhanaṃ naiva māyāsparśo hi bandhanam ।
amāyikasya sādhośca dvandvābhāvo nirantaram ।।37।।
sākṣātkāro'parokṣaśca cidātmanyeva jāyate ।
aparokṣānubhūtyā ca mithyā sarvaṃ vilīyate ।।38।।
tena doṣavināśaśca pravṛtteśca vināśanam ।
phalasambandhanāśaśca sarvaduḥkhādināśanam ।।39।।
ātmamātraprasattākaḥ sādhuryadā bhavettviha ।
so'yaṃ tadā vimukto vai jīvannapi nirucyate ।।2.273.40 ।।
etādṛśaprayuktasya brahmānandaḥ prajāyate ।
nijātmānaṃ brahmarūpaṃ prāptasyeha sataḥ sadā ।।41 ।।
pare brahmaṇi cittervai tādātmyaṃ saṃprasajyate ।
tādātmyamiva tādātmyaṃ jāyate pārameśvaram ।।42।।
yathā jihvā madhorbhinnā madhoḥ rasaṃ pravindate ।
yathā cakṣurgolakasthaṃ vasturūpaṃ pravindate ।।42।।
yathā mano'ntarasthaṃ ca viprakṛṣṭaṃ pravindate ।
yathā buddhiścātmagatā parātmajñā prajāyate ।।44।।
svavettrī jāyate cāpi svātmādhikapragocarā ।
tathā''tmā svaprakāśo'sti svavettā svaṃ prakāśate ।।45।।
svaprakāśayuto'svaṃ svānvitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakāśate ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prakāśayatyenaṃ parasparaṃ prakāśate ।।46।।
dvayoḥ prakāśayoraikye tādātmyamiva jāyate ।
guṇasājātmyatādātmyād guṇinostādṛśātmatā ।।47।।
evaṃ bhūtāveśanītyā parabrahmatadātmatā ।
jāyate vai tayā sādhvordvayoścātmaparātmanoḥ ।।48।।
parabrahmātmabhāvena brahmānandaṃ samaśnute ।
ayaṃ daśāṃgayogo vai sādhudharmaḥ sadottamaḥ ।।49।।
kathitaḥ susatāṃ sevyaḥ parabrahmanivāsinām ।
svabhānaṃ parabhānaṃ ca yadi syādaparā sthitiḥ ।।2.273.50।।
svabhāvarjyaṃ parabhānaṃ sā bodhyā paramā sthitiḥ ।
etādṛśo bhavet sādhustvasamprajñātanāmakaḥ ।।51 ।।
nārāyaṇasvarūpaḥ sa vedaśāstraiḥ pragīyate ।
sanatkumāraḥ śaṃbhuśca śeṣanārāyaṇastathā ।।।।52।।
lomaśo'yaṃ maharṣiśca tvete nārāyaṇā matāḥ ।
brahmapriyāstathā sarvā rādhālakṣmīramādikāḥ ।।53 ।।
garuḍādyāśca me vāhāḥ sarve nārāyaṇā ime ।
kuṃkumavāpīnagarī sarvā nārāyaṇī mama ।।54।।
pramuktā vartate tvatra sādhavaḥ sādhvikāḥ samāḥ ।
parabrahmātmakā līlāvibhūtayo vasanti me ।।55।।
kecanātra bhavantyeva madguṇā vai sahasraśaḥ ।
kecanātra bhavantyevaiśvaryāṇi mama siddhayaḥ ।। 56।।
kecanātra bhavantyeva divyāni bhūṣaṇāni me ।
kecanātra bhavantyeva śaktayo mama mūrtijāḥ ।।57।।
kecanātra bhavantyeva tejāṃsi mama bhāḥ prabhāḥ ।
kecanātra bhavantyeva bhogyajātāni yāni me ।।58।।
sarvā kuṃkumavāpīyaṃ mamopakaraṇātmikā ।
manmūrtirvidyate sarvā nirlepā nirguṇā parā ।।59।।
parabrahmasvarūpā vai brahmadhāmanivāsinī ।
bhūriyaṃ brahmadhāmā'sti sādhavo māmakī tanuḥ ।।2.273.60।।
itītyevaṃ nijarūpaṃ parabrahmātmakaṃ sadā ।
cintayata dhyāyatā'pi prāpnutā''nandamuttamam ।।6 1 ।।
evaṃ dharmā mayā vo'tra sādhūnāṃ gaditāstviha ।
divyāḥ sūkṣmā jñānagamyāḥ sādhavo hi tathā matāḥ ।।62।।
sādhava ūcuḥ-
bhagavan sūkṣmadharmā vai bhavattato'vagatāstviha ।
sthūladharmāḥ kīdṛśā vai kathaṃ rakṣyā vada prabho ।।63।।
parabrahmovāca-
deho naro ca vā nārī sādhubhāve yadā sthitaḥ ।
tadā dehasya doṣā vai tyājyā grāhyā guṇāstviha ।।64।।
ālasyaṃ ca pramādaṃ ca styānaṃ tyaktvā prage sadā ।
vinidrastvarito bhūtvā brāhme snānaṃ samācaret ।।65।।
jalena bhasmanā vā ca vāyunā mārjanena vā ।
dehaśuddhiṃ prakuryādvai tailādyabhyaṃjanena ca ।।66 ।।
āntare bhagavad dhyānaṃ śaucaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā''caret ।
tato vai pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai hareḥ ।।67।।
viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorgaṇeśasya lakṣmyāḥ sūryasya vai tathā ।
sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ cārārtrikaṃ naivedyakā'rpaṇam ।।68।।
stavanaṃ nāmaraṭaṇaṃ mālāvartanamācaret ।
hareḥ kathaṃ prakuryācca bhikṣāṃ vai pākamācaret ।।69।।
bhūta yajñaṃ devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ samācaret ।
brahmayajñaṃ naijayajñaṃ kṛtvā bhojanamācaret ।।2.273.70 ।।
sāyaṃ cārādhanaṃ kuryānnavadhā śrīhareḥ śubham ।
yathocitaṃ śraddhayaiva sarvakalyāṇamācaret ।।71 ।।
santoṣeṇa ca saumyenā'parigraheṇa nirvahet ।
nātyāhāraṃ nātitapaḥ prakuryāt sādhudharmavān ।।72।।
anācāraṃ nācareccā'kartavyaṃ nācarettathā ।
kleśaṃ hiṃsāṃ mṛṣā nindāṃ paravādaṃ vivarjayet ।।।73।।
paropakāraṃ kuryācca dehena manasā girā ।
kriyayā parasaukhyārthaṃ hitaṃ saukhyaṃ samācaret ।।74।।
āpmamārgaṃ mokṣamārgaṃ viśeṣeṇa prasādhayet ।
pareṣāṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ śaraṇyaḥ saṃbhavet sadā ।।75।।
mama mantrān pradadyācca dīkṣāṃ dadyācca māmakīm ।
svādhyāyaṃ mokṣadaṃ jñānaṃ prakuryācchṛṇuyāttathā ।।76।।
tīrthāni vicareccāpi gṛhṇīyācchuddhabhojanam ।
śuddhaṃ jalaṃ prapeyācca gālitaṃ paya ādi ca ।।77।।
rāgaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ madaṃ lobhaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana ।
tiraskāraṃ na kasyāpi kuryād vai brahmabhāvanaḥ ।।78।।
pratāraṇaṃ na vai kuryād dveṣaṃ kvacinna cācaret ।
dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti mokṣasyā'pyabhayasya ca ।।79।।
āśritasya snehabhaktiṃ svīkuryānmokṣayoginīm ।
sādhavaḥ pāvanāḥ santi satsaṃgaścāpi pāvanaḥ ।।2.273.80 ।।
sadā samāgame naije cānīya dehadhāriṇaḥ ।
pāvayet parayā prītyā preṣayenmama dhāma ca ।।8 1 ।।
indriyāṇyantaḥkaraṇādīni pratyāharet hṛdi ।
dhyānaṃ kuryānmama nityaṃ brahmānandaṃ samarjayet ।।82।।
mama mūrtau pralīnatvaṃ kuryāt kartavyamuttamam ।
upāsanāṃ prakuryācca nityaṃ me mananātmikām ।।83।।।
evaṃ bhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ kartavyaṃ sādhubhirmama ।
sādhvībhiśca tathaivā'tra kartavyaṃ sevanaṃ satām ।।84।।
nārīṇāṃ sarvadā mokṣadānaṃ jñānaṃ samarpaṇam ।
śikṣaṇaṃ ca sādhusādhvīdīkṣaṇaṃ muktaye bhavet ।।85।।
vyasanāni na kāryāṇi mokṣarodhīni yāni ca ।
patirnārāyaṇaścā'haṃ sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ sadā ।।86।।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa sevanīyo'hamiṣṭadaḥ ।
ātmanivedanaṃ mahyaṃ kartavyaṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ।।87।।
bhoktavyaṃ tu mayā sārdhaṃ mama divyasamāgamāt ।
ahaṃ kvacinna vai tyājyaḥ sarvakriyāsu sarvadā ।।88।।
ityeṣā jīvanī muktiḥ paramuktividhāyinī ।
divyadharmamayī proktā mayā santaḥ! śubhāśrayā ।।89।।
dehadharmāḥ sādhubhirvai pālanīyā yathocitam ।
nādhikyenā'nuṣaktavyā me sevāvighnarūpiṇaḥ ।। 2.273.90।।
svasti vo'stu sādhavo me sādhvyaśca svasti vo'stvapi ।
ityuktvā rādhike'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।9 1 ।।
virarāma tataḥ santo'rhaṇāṃ nīrājanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
rakṣaṇīyā mokṣaṇīyā bhavataḥ smeti sañjaguḥ ।।।92।।
yayuścāśīrgṛhītvaiva sarastīre nijālayān ।
tāvat kāśīgato yaśca nārado harimāyayau ।।।93।।।
maṃgalapatrikāyuktaguruṇā saha cotsukaḥ ।
cakāra daṇḍavat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ param ।। 94।।
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvā maṃgalaṃ prajagād saḥ ।
bṛhaspatirdevaguruḥ praṇamya prāpya mānanam ।। 95।।
svāgataṃ madhuparkādi kuśalaṃ vinivedya ca ।
śiveśvarasya tatputryā lakṣmyāḥ saukhyaṃ namaskṛtim ।।96 ।।
patraṃ kuṃkumasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ ca saratnakam ।
patraṃ ca rādhike! datvā vṛttaṃ nyavedayacchubham ।।97।।
kuśalaṃ sarvadā lakṣmyā yugalatvamuhūrtakam ।
mārgaśīrṣasya śuklāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca nyavedayat ।।98।।
vardhayitvā ca tatpatraṃ prapūjya ca bṛhaspatim ।
gopālakṛṣṇakastatra nāradaṃ cā'pyapūjayat ।।99।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sādhusādhvībhyo mantradīkṣājñānopadeśādi dattam, kāśītaḥ śiveśvarapreṣitamaṃgalapatrikāsahitasya bṛhaspaternāradena saha kuṃkumavāpyāmāgamanaṃ tatpatrapradānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 273 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 273 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 274
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 275 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! śrībālakṛṣṇo mumude vīkṣya patrikām ।
bṛhaspatiṃ praṇeme ca ratnahāraṃ dadau gale ।। 1 ।।
bṛhaspatirharestasya janmadinaṃ vyalokayat ।
cāndre māsi kārtike ca dale kṛṣṇe'ṣṭamīdine ।। 2 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajanma satīśrīkambharodarāt ।
jātaṃ tasya caturdaśasamā māso dināni ṣaṭ ।। 3 ।।
vyatītaḥ samayaścādya vartate tu caturdaśī ।
mārgaśīrṣasya kṛṣṇasyodvāhasvīkṛtiyugdinam ।। 4 ।।
protsavo bhavitā kāśyāmitaśca pañcame dine ।
mārgaśuklacaturthyāṃ vai sarvaśreṣṭhamuhūrtake ।। 5 ।।
yogapatrī tathā cāvedayatyeva sumaṃgalam ।
śiveśvareṇa devena preṣito'haṃ sapatrakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sarvaṃ śubhaṃ subhagaṃ syād gopālakṛṣṇa! cottamam ।
gopālakṛṣṇo devarṣiṃ vilokya lomaśaṃ munim ।। 7 ।।
āhvayāmāsa tūrṇaṃ sa munistatra samāyayau ।
kṛtādaraḥ kṛtadevagurupūjaḥ śubhāsane ।। 8 ।।
niṣasāda kuśalaṃ ca pṛṣṭavān sa bṛhaspatim ।
gopālakṛṣṇadattāṃ ca patrikāṃ sa vyalokayat ।। 9 ।।
kṛtanāradaśaṃsāṃ tāṃ vācayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ।
śrāvayāmāsa māṃgalyaṃ vardhayāmāsa so'pi ca ।। 2.274.10 ।।
bālakṛṣṇastu mumude kaṃbharā mumude bhṛśam ।
kuṭumbino mumudire śrutvā tāṃ yogapatrikām ।। 11 ।।
sarvā brahmapriyāścāpi śrutvā harṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ ।
parīgaurīhāritīśaktyamaryādyā mudaṃ yayuḥ ।। 12।।
gopālakṛṣṇo vādyāni vādayāmāsa vai tadā ।
gurave pradadau pāritoṣikaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām ।। 1 3।।।
bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pāyasānnaṃ sumiṣṭakam ।
pūjayāmāsa śanakaiścandanādyaistataḥ param ।। 14।।
gopālakṛṣṇo bhagavān papraccha nāradarṣaye ।
kanyāguṇān lakṣaṇāni kanyāyā nārado'vadat ।। 15।।
brahmāṃśaḥ śaṃkaro devaḥ śiveśvaro virājate ।
mahābhāgavataścāpi mahālakṣmīrhi pārvatī ।। 16।।
ubhau nārāyaṇāṃśau hi gariṣṭhau ca variṣṭhakau ।
pūjitau sarvalokaiśca garīyāṃsau pareśvarau ।। 17।।
tayoḥ putrī svayaṃ lakṣmīrduḥkhadāridryanāśinī ।
kanyakānāṃ yoṣitāṃ ca varā cātīva sundarī ।। 18।।
kāṃ praśaṃsāmahaṃ kurve śaṃbhuputryā viśeṣataḥ ।
ramaṇīyā'tiramyā sā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā ।। 19।।
udbhinneṣadyauvanā ca nidhirvai sarvasampadām ।
lakṣmīcihnasahasraiśca śobhitā parameśvarī ।।2.274.20 ।।
pītacampakavarṇābhā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।
vidyullateva cāñcalyahāsavilāsamaṇḍitā ।।21 ।।
taptakāñcanabhāyuktā tejasojjvalitā satī ।
divyāṃgā divyatattvā ca śuddhasattvānvitā sadā ।।22।।
satyadayākṛpāśīlā tāpasī ca harivratā ।
śāntā dāntā ca subhagā'nantaudāryanidhānikā ।।23।।
mastake svastikasvarṇagūḍhalekhāvirājitā ।
vakradīrghasvarṇavarṇaprāntakṛṣṇamanoharaiḥ ।।24।।
satejaskaiśca caṃcadbhiḥ śiraḥkeśairvirājitā ।
svarṇarekhasamaṃ ramyaṃ tilakaṃ tu viśālake ।।25।।
bhāle naisargacandraṃ ca dadhānā rājate hi sā ।
rādhā vā kamalā vā sā māṇikī vā'rkajā ca kim ।।26।।
pārvatī sāramā vāpi sarasvatī ca śāradā ।
vairājī vāsudevī vā nārāyaṇī sadāśivā ।।27।।
padmā vā virajā vāpi sāvitrī vā ca vaiṣṇavī ।
indrāṇī ca varuṇānī candrāṇī rohiṇī ca vā ।।28।।
kuberāṇī sūryapatnī svāhā vā'halyikā ca vā ।
dyauḥ svayaṃ kiṃ ca vā brāhmī śaktirvā śīlikā svayam ।।।29।।
yadvā'nyāsu ramaṇīṣu śreṣṭhāḥ santi manoharāḥ ।
tāḥ sarvāḥ śivakanyāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।2.274.3 0।।
śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyā śaratkamalalocanā ।
tava putrasamā mūrtiḥ kimayaṃ tattanuṃ gataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vivāhayogyā yuvatī vartate sātiśobhanā ।
divyadehā nārikā'pi bhautikāṃśavivarjitā ।।32।।
bālakṛṣṇasvarūpā sā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇī hi sā ।
manye cāyaṃ parabrahma dvedhā bhūto virājate ।।33 ।।
kimatra varṇanīyaṃ vai yā hi sākṣāddharirhi sā ।
gopālakṛṣṇa! putraste bhāgyavān bhagavān svayam ।।34।।
puruṣottamasaṃjñāya sarvasṛṣṭiṣu gīyate ।
seyaṃ tadaṃśā sarvāṃgī śrīlakṣmīḥ puruṣottamī ।।35।।
bālakṛṣṇakṛte jātā loke'tra muktidā nṛṇām ।
jaganmātā sarvamātā kimu tāṃ varṇaye nviha ।।36।।
śṛṇu cihnāni sarvāṇi yaiḥ sā jñāyeta cedṛśī ।
kīdṛśī vā svayaṃ kā vā nirṇetavyaṃ na yatparam ।।37।।
yāni lokāḥ samākarṇya muktimīyurna saṃśayaḥ ।
divyadṛṣṭyā gurubhāvānmayā dṛṣṭāni varṇaye ।।38।।
śivakanyāhṛdaye'sti bālakṛṣṇākṛtiḥ śubhā ।
pādayoḥ puṇḍrarekhordhvarekhe staḥ śobhane śubhe ।।39।।
jaghane bāṇarekhā'syā lalāṭe mukuṭākṛtiḥ ।
gaṇḍe tu dakṣiṇe bhāle śoṇabinduḥ praśobhate ।।2.274.40 ।।
urasi viṣṇurekhā ca vāmabāhau gadā śubhā ।
vāmasakthni pādukā ca vaijayantī hṛdi sthitā ।।41 ।।
kare'syāḥ kamalaṃ cāste gajacihnaṃ tathā'param ।
dakṣe pāde śaṃkhacihnaṃ naukācihnaṃ vimānakam ।
gadā matsyaḥ śikharaṃ ca jhaṣastāmbūlavallikā ।।42।।
vāme pāde yavarekhā prāsādaśchatramityapi ।
ūrdhvarekhā kamalaṃ ca dhvajoṃ'kuśo ghaṭo'pi ca ।
kumudaṃ śrīphalaṃ cāpi sthalapadmaṃ ca candramāḥ ।।43।।
daśacakrāṇi pūrṇāni svarṇarekhā'ṅgulīṣu ca ।
lalāṭe pauraṭo hāraḥ svarṇarekhāśca bindukaḥ ।।44।।
cibuke binduko hastarekhā dakṣastanopari ।
cakraṃ vāmastane kaṇṭhe hāro vakṣasi kānakaḥ ।।45।।
dhvajo matsyaśca vaṃśī ca svastiśca dakṣiṇe kare ।
dhanurmatsyaḥ kalaśaśca dakṣe kare ca santyapi ।।46।।
prākārastoraṇaṃ cāpi kamalaṃ santi dakṣake ।
pādaphaṇāyāmaśvaśca lāṃgalaṃ ca karī tathā ।।47।।
vṛkṣo yūpastathā bāṇastomaraṃ santi pādake ।
haste ca mālikārekhā dīparekhā ca cāmaram ।।48।।
śolaśca kuṇḍalaṃ vedī cakraṃ santi śubhāni vai ।
śobhanāni sucihnāni santyasyāścetarāṇyapi ।।49।।
nā'nyā tvetādṛśī dṛṣṭā trailokye kamalāṃ vinā ।
naitādṛśāni cihnāni sarvāṇi vai śriyaṃ vinā ।।2.274.50 ।।
gopālakṛṣṇa! putro'yaṃ tava sākṣāt pareśvaraḥ ।
sarvaṃ jānāti tadvṛttaṃ nityaṃ gatvā ca pūjanam ।।51।।
tayā kṛtaṃ pragṛhṇāti tatpitṛbhyāṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।
tathā'pyajña ivā''ste'tra māyāṃ kurvan hariḥ svayam ।।52।।
hemaśālāyananāmā jānāti munirāḍidam ।
hanumāँśca vijānāti lakṣyāstapo hareḥ kṛte ।।53।।
bālakṛṣṇo varadānaṃ svayogārthaṃ dadau tadā ।
sarvametacchubhaṃ cāste lakṣmyarpaṇaṃ narāyaṇe ।।94।।
gopālarāja! paśyemaṃ devaguruṃ bṛhaspatim ।
māṃgalike mahākārye patraṃ nītvā tava gṛhe ।।55।।
āgataṃ yatpādapadme pūjayanti sureśvarāḥ ।
dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśasyaṃ te gṛhaṃ tenāpi pāvitam ।।56।।
aho bhāgyamahaṃ manye yo'haṃ godohanasthiraḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇayogotsavadarśanabhāgyavān ।।57।।
bhaviṣyāmi nivatsyāmi hyaśvapaṭṭataṭe sadā ।
praseviṣye'saṃkhyapatnīpatiṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।58।।
subhaktyā bālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ śrāvayiṣye ca gītikāḥ ।
utsaveṣu sadā sārdhaṃ vicariṣyāmi śārṅgiṇā ।।59।।
idaṃ vai janmasāphalyaṃ hareryogo bhavediha ।
yena kenāpi bhāvena bhajanīyaḥ pareśvara ।।2.274.60 ।।
gopālakṛṣṇa! dhanyo'si dhanyo'sti śivaśaṃkaraḥ ।
dhanyā'sti kambharālakṣmīrdhanyā devī ca pārvatī ।।61।।
dhanyā kuṃkumavāpī ca dhanyā vārāṇasī kṣitiḥ ।
dhanyo bṛhaspatiścāpi dhanyo devarṣināradaḥ ।।62।।
yeṣāṃ hṛdi cakṣuṣośca vasati śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
dhanyaścaturthīdivasaḥ sarvapūjyo bhaviṣyati । । 63 ।।
bhaviṣyanto'vatārāśca vidhāsyantyatra cotsavam ।
tatra dine'rpitā kanyā lakṣmītulyā bhaviṣyati ।। 64।।
ityuktvā nārado maunaṃ jagrāha ca bṛhaspatiḥ ।
viśrāntiṃ śāntibhavane jagṛhatuśca tau tataḥ ।। 65 ।।
atha śrīnāradarṣiśca lakṣmyuktaṃ surahasyakam ।
nivedayituṃ kṛṣṇāya bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ yayau ।। 66 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi bhagavān lakṣmyuktaṃ vettumāturaḥ ।
pratīkṣate nārado me kadā hṛdyaṃ vadiṣyati । । 67।।
tāvacchrīnāradastatra kṛṣṇasaudhe samāyayau ।
natvā śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ taṃ vihasya bhagavannamaḥ ।। 68।।
samuccāryā''nanditaśca niṣasāda hi bhūtale ।
tāvacchrībālakṛṣṇo'sau samutthāpya ca satvaram ।। 69 ।।
devarṣiṃ kānake naije paryaṅke taṃ nyaṣādayat ।
kṛtvā vakṣasi harṣeṇa samasaṅkta mahāmunim ।।2.274.7 0 ।।
prapraccha kuśalaṃ lakṣmyā vada nārada hṛdgatam ।
kiṃ svit sukhaṃ samāste sā kiyanmaddharṣasaṃbhṛtā ।।7 1 ।।
kiṃsvidvicāravatyāste madarthaṃ śivakanyakā ।
kimuktavatī vā kiñcid rahasyaṃ jñāpitaṃ tayā ।।72।।
vada me nārada śīghraṃ jijñāsitaṃ sukhāvaham ।
ityukto nārado rādhe! vaktukāmaḥ praharṣavān ।।73 ।।
uvāca vidhivat sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ śivakanyayā ।
ākarṇaya harekṛṣṇa sukhamāste tvadarthinī ।।74।।
yadā'haṃ gatavān kāśyāṃ varaṇāyāstaṭe śubhe ।
udyānaramyabhūbhāge śiveśvaragṛhāntike ।।75 ।।
sauvarṇakalaśairvyāpte śobhane viṣṇumandire ।
tadā sā mātṛsahitā svasrā ca kṛṣṇayā yutā ।।76 ।।
darśanārthaṃ tvāgatā vā'bhavad viṣṇuṃ praṇamya ca ।
pradakṣiṇāyāṃ sahasā yāntīṃ cāñcalyaśobhanā ।।77।।
mayā dṛṣṭā dehacihnairlakṣmīste'rdhaśarīriṇī ।
ahaṃ vicitrarūpaśca bālako vai tadā'bhavam । ।78 ।।
tatsamo vayasā yena bālakhelanake sthitaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇapramiṣeṇa tayā saha ca mandiram ।।79 ।।
abhramaṃ vegataścāpi bālakṛṣṇo'vadaṃ muhuḥ ।
graśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi śiveśvarasuteti ca ।। 2.274.80 । ।
evaṃ śabdānaśṛṇot sā manmukhācca tadā hi sā ।
apṛcchanmāṃ namaste'stu kiśora tvamitaḥ kutaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
samāgato'si vada me jānāsi bālakṛṣṇakam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarovāsaṃ tathyamāvedaya drutam ।।82।।
tadā'haṃ dhṛtavāँstatra rūpaṃ nāradasammatam ।
sā tu vijñāya māṃ bhūtaṃ jahāsa praṇanāma mām ।।83।।
tato'haṃ bālarūpaśca punastatrā'bhavaṃ ca sā ।
prakāśe catvarabhāge kadambadrumaśobhite ।।84।।
khelanādipramiṣeṇā''hūyākathayadāntaram ।
kathaṃ kasmād vada me'tra maharṣe yadi tadbhavam ।।85।।
mayā niveditā sādhvi! bālakṛṣṇā''jñayā'pyaham ।
āgato'smi vivāhasya jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ prati ।।86।।
vada śīghraṃ tava hṛdyaṃ jānīyānna yathā satī ।
pañcakaṃkarakhelādimiṣeṇa vada mā ciram ।।87।।
sā kṛṣṇa! māṃ vilokyaiva modapramodasaṃbhṛtā ।
akathayanmama prāṇapatiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।88।।
kadā tvāyāsyati śīghraṃ kadā māṃ svīkariṣyati ।
ahaṃ kṣaṇaviyogaṃ vai soḍhuṃ śaknomi naiva ha ।।89।।
śīghraṃ ca satvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vadā''gaccheddhi satvaram ।
ayaṃ me samayaścāste pradānasya guro vada ।।2.274.90 ।।
tena me vacanaṃ dattaṃ caturdaśasamottaraḥ ।
svayamāgatya bhagavān grahīṣyati karaṃ mama ।।9 1 ।।
yadyadya vatsare kṛṣṇo na māṃ cet saṃgrahīṣyati ।
prāṇāँstyaktvā divyarūpā tatrā''yāsyāmi niścitam ।।।92।।
vada me janakāya tvaṃ mātre cāpi nivedaya ।
mā madvācaṃ tayoragre prakāśaṃ kuru buddhiman ।।।93 ।।
śīghraṃ yathā sa vā me syāttathā klṛptiṃ vidhāpaya ।
ityuktvā pulakāṃgī sā premaplutā tadā'bhavat ।।94।।
snehāśrubhṛtanetrā ca samādhimiva saṃgatā ।
punaḥ svalpaṃ prākathayat nivedaya samarpitām ।।95।।
nā'dhikaṃ śrīhareragre vada nārada yāhi ca ।
madgṛhe tvāgatāṃ tatra mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vada ।।96 ।।
ityuktvā ca namaskṛtya matpādayorhi līlayā ।
utthāya khelānāsaktā śīghraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ gatā ।।97।।
mandire tatra sā mātrā saha dṛṣṭvā hariṃ punaḥ ।
yātā nijaṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṣṇa nārado'haṃ tataḥ param ।।98।।
varaṇāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ snātvā tatra gato'bhavam ।
nāradena svarūpeṇa nārāyaṇeti saṃvadan ।।99।।
jaṭādharaṃ vilokyaiva satī me namanaṃ vyadhāt ।
mayā tvāśīḥ pradattā ca sā māṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaṃ hyagāt ।। 2.274.1 00।।
apṛcchat kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ dattāsane sthitaṃ ca mām ।
gṛhṇantaṃ madhuparkādi tatrā'kasmāt samāgatam ।। 10 1।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇa viṣṇo bālakṛṣṇa hare prabho ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇetyāśrāvayaṃ tadā ।। 1 02।।
tava nāmāni sarvāṇi pāvanāni śubhāni ca ।
smārakāṇi tava kṛṣṇa tato'pibaṃ jalaṃ manāk ।। 1 03।।
atha śāntiṃ samāgṛhya vivakṣyāmi yadā tadā ।
sabhāyācca mamā'gre sukhadālakṣmīḥ śravā''turā ।। 1 04।।
jyeṣṭhā kṛṣṇā tathā sakhyaścāparā divyadṛṣṭikāḥ ।
anamanmāṃ satīṃ cāpi nyaṣīdaṃstāḥ samantataḥ ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bṛhaspatipradattamaṃgalapatrikāyā lomaśakṛtasavidhipūjanavācanādikam, gopālakṛṣṇādyāḥ svāgatamadhuparkādyuttaraṃ
bhojayāmāsuḥ, nārado gopālakṛṣṇāya kanyaiśvaryaguṇadivyalakṣaṇānyāha, bālakṛṣṇāya kanyoktarahasyārthaṃ cāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 274 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 274 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 275
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 276 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! nāradastābhyastato'kathayad yaddhi tat ।
kathayāmi samastaṃ te śṛṇu tvekāgramānasā ।। 1 ।।
nārada uvāca-
āgato'haṃ satyalokādaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
pṛthvyāṃ paścimasaurāṣṭre yatrā''ste puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tena sākaṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca vyacaraṃ yajñakarmaṇe ।
yatrā''yātā dhāmamuktāstathā'nyadhāmapārṣadāḥ ।। 3 ।।
pārṣadānyastathā satya īśvarāṇyaśca devatāḥ ।
mānavyo nāgakāntāśca sādhvyaḥ siddhivarāstathā ।। 4 ।।
avatārāḥ samastāśceśvarāścāpi ca sādhavaḥ ।
siddhā brahmavratāścāpi pitaraśca tatharṣayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ārṣyaḥ sarvāstathā devā devānyaśca samāgatāḥ ।
mānavāśca divaḥpālā lokapālā maheśvarāḥ ।। 6 ।।
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau tatstriyastathā ।
vahnayaśca marutaśca nidhayaśca grahāstathā ।। 7 ।।
diśaḥ kāmaśca menevastithayaśca kalāstathā ।
tattvāni sarvatīrthāni nadyaḥ sarāṃsi sāgarāḥ ।। 8 ।।
parvatāśca vālakhilyā vāyudehā'surādayaḥ ।
daityā bhaktā dānavāśca pakṣāśca rākṣasāstathā ।। 9 ।।
siddhacāraṇagandharvā vidyādhrāḥ kinnarāstathā ।
uragā kiṃpuruṣāśca vṛkṣāstṛṇāni vallayaḥ ।। 2.275.1 0।।
dharmādyā yāmyabhaktādyāḥ śaivāḥ kailāsavāsinaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaśvetadugdhābdhivāsā badarīvāsinaḥ ।।1 1।।
meruvāsā āvaraṇavāsāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ।
asaṃkhyadevakoṭyaśca prāyayurvai makhe makhe ।। 12।।
sarve praśaṃsanti kṛṣṇaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
vandante taṃ cārhayanti stuvanti kaṃbharāsutam ।। 13।।
tatprasādaṃ taccaraṇāmṛtaṃ pibanti te tadā ।
lokapālā dhāmapālāḥ sṛṣṭipālā narāyaṇāḥ ।। 14।।
nārāyaṇāśca ye te ca tadājñāmudvahanti ca ।
etat sarvaṃ mayā tatra pratyakṣaṃ tvavalokitam ।। 15।।
śaṃkarastu svayaṃ yasyā'kṣarakṣetre nivāsakṛt ।
kṣetrapālatayā cāste hyaśvapaṭṭasaro'bhitaḥ ।। 16।।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmadevo naro nārāyaṇastathā ।
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ sanatkumārayogirāṭ ।। 17।।
tathā'nye ceśvarāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ saṃkarṣaṇādayo'pi ca ।
mahāviṣṇustathā bhūmā vairājaśca sadāśivaḥ ।। 18।।
yasyā''jñāṃ saṃvahante ca kālamāyāyameśvarāḥ ।
yasmād bhavanti bhūtāni puṣyante cābhiyanti ca ।। 1 9।।
antarātmā tu yaḥ proktaḥ sākṣī ca bhagavān svayam ।
parabrahma ca yaḥ prokto yasmāt sarvamidaṃ tatam ।।2.275.20।।
vidyuto bhāni sūryaśca candro vahnistathā dhruvaḥ ।
yattejasā pravidyante tejasvinaḥ prabhākarāḥ ।।21।।
yatpraveśena bhūtāni bhavanti jñānavantyapi ।
yenāste jīvalokasya prakāśaṃ vai nijātmani ।।22।।
sarvaprakāśadātā saḥ kuṃkumavāpikāsthale ।
virājate hi bhagavānakṣarātīta eva yaḥ ।।23।।
mānavena svarūpeṇa gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ।
ityevaṃ te praśaṃsanti vai mahīmānakā makhe ।। 24।।
koṭirūpadharaḥ so'pi bālakṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ ।
koṭibhaktānekapade milatyeva ca vakṣasi ।।25।।
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ hi sākṣāttat śrutaṃ sarvaṃ praśaṃsitam ।
śrutā ca yoṣitāṃ vāṇī sthale sthalyāṃ mahotsave ।।26।।
dhanyā vayaṃ surūpasya sarveśvasya yoginaḥ ।
darśanaṃ tvadya kurmo yatpuṇyapāro na vidyate ।।27।।
aho'sya darśanācchāntiḥ śāśvatī samajāyate ।
asmākaṃ netrayordairghyaṃ sāphalyaṃ vindate'dya vai ।।28।।
dūrato'pi mahānando jāyate'sya vilokane ।
abhinnapūravegāḍhyaṃ yāvatsukhottaraṃ sukham ।।29।।
anubhūyate cāsmābhiḥ sarvendriyasukhaṃ mahat ।
yasya dūrāvalokena yadīdṛśaṃ paraṃ sukham ।।2.275.30।।
tadā sākṣāttasya patnyāḥ pārśvaśayanayoṣitaḥ ।
śiveśvarasutā lakṣmyā divyāyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ।।3 1 ।।
ardhāṃgī ceśvarī yā vai nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ।
sūryacandranibhau yasyāḥ kapolau gaṇḍakau tathā ।।32।।
suvarṇasadṛśaṃ yasyā vapuścampakapuṣpavat ।
alaktakanibhe yasyāḥ karapādatale tathā ।।33 ।।
pakvabimbasamau yasyā oṣṭhau prītinivāsinau ।
kadalīstambhasadṛśe sakthinī cāpi śobhane ।।34।।
padmapatrāyatanetre yasyā rūpaṃ hyanuttamam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavakṣovāsā yā parameśvarī ।।35।।
yā ca vāsayati kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ vai nijavakṣasi ।
sākṣāt sarvāṃgasaṃyuktā kīdṛśī sukhinī bhavet ।।36।।
aho dhanyā śivaputrī sukhaṃ kṛṣṇāt samaśnute ।
dhanyā sā pārvatī devī yatsukhāt sukhinī śivā ।।37।।
ramāyāḥ kamalāyā vā śriyā vā kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।
vṛndāyā vā tulasyā vā bhārgavyā vā ca tatsukham ।।38।।
lalāṭe likhitaṃ kārṣṇaṃ yallakṣmyā likhitaṃ sadā ।
aho nedṛṅparaṃ bhāgyamasmākaṃ yanna ceyate ।।39।।
na cā'smākaṃ patiḥ so'yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
vyarthaṃ janma striyā loke kṛṣṇayogasukhaṃ vinā ।।2.275.40।।
vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ pātivratyaṃ patiḥ kṛṣṇo na ced yadi ।
aho vai śivakanyāyāḥ sāphalyaṃ gaurave tathā ।।41 ।।
sarvarasān sarvagandhān sarvasparśān sukhairbhṛtān ।
sarvaśabdān sarvadṛśyān sarvānandān bhunakti yā ।।42।।
sarvānandāśrayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ labdhvā jitendriyam ।
akhaṇḍavīryaṃ sarveśaṃ bhuṃkte yā śivakanyakā ।।43 ।।
kāśīsthā'pi sadā kṛṣṇe lagnā cāste'prakāśitā ।
paśyanti divyanetrāśca satyaḥ sādhvyo divāniśam ।।44।।
ityevaṃ vai mayā kīrtiḥ śrutā nārīgaṇānmuhuḥ ।
so'haṃ didṛkṣurevā'saṃ jijñāsuśca punaḥ punaḥ ।।45 ।।
pṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā śanaiścā'tra bhavatīgehamāgataḥ ।
saṃśrutaṃ duḥkhahālakṣmīritināmāpi vai muhuḥ ।।46 ।।
kīdṛśī sā kasya kanyā kīdṛgguṇā bhavediti ।
yadi syādatra sā devī draṣṭavyā sā mayā sati ।।47 ।।
kvā''ste kīdṛk svarūpā sā kimavasthā kimambarā ।
kiṃnisargā kiṃsupiṇḍā kiṃsaṃsthānā bhavatyapi ।।48 ।।
kimākṛtiḥ kiṃsuprabhā kiyadvarṣā hi bhāminī ।
kimānanā ca kiṃvegā kiṃbhāvā kiṃsulakṣaṇā ।।49।।
kiṃkalā kiṃsvarā kisaṃvarṇā kiṃpatkarojjvalā ।
kiṃbhālā kiṃsuṣṭhukeśī kimātmā kiṃsusiddhikā ।।2.275.50
kiṃprabhāvā kiṃsukhāḍhyā kiṃbhānā kiṃsubodhinī ।
kiṃkāryā kibhaktimatī kiṃdivyā ca kimāntarā ।।5 1
kiṃvidyā kiṃcihnaśobhā kimucchrayā ca kiṃgatiḥ ।
kiṃvāsā ca kiṃsakhī ca kiṃbhūṣā kiṃghaṭāchaṭā ।।52 ।।
kiṃbalā kiṃsusattvā ca kiṃbhojanā kiṃtāpasī ।
kiṃsantoṣā ca kiṃśaucā kiṃsvādhyāyā ca kiṃvṛṣā ।।53 ।।
kiṃhārdā kiṃpremapātrā kiṃkauśalyā ca kiṃmatiḥ ।
kimaṃgā kiṃdhanā kiṃcaṃcalā kiṃlekhanā hi sā ।।54।।
kiṃruciḥ kiṃpravādā ca kiṃvṛttiḥ kiṃpravartanā ।
kiṃtrikā kiṃsamāraṃbhamadhyaprāntaphalā tathā ।।55।।
kiṃkriyā kiṃviśeṣā ca kiṃsāmānyā kiṃmadhyamā ।
kiṃviśvāsā ca kiṃyogā kiṃbodhā kimupāsanā ।।56 ।।
kimārādhanikā kiṃśṛṃgārā kiṃsaṃvirāgiṇī ।
kiṃtuṣṭā kiṃgṛdhnikā ca kimāśā ca kimicchukī ।।।57।।
kiṃtarkā kiṃniścayā ca kiṃvādā kiṃpramāṇikā ।
kiṃprameyā kiṃprayogā kiṃsiddhāntā kiṃnigrahā ।।58 ।।
kiṃvedā kiṃsādhanā ca kiṃpriyā kiṃvitarjinī ।
kiṃyamā kiṃniyamā ca kiṃdhyānā ca kimāsanā ।।59 ।।
kiṃprāṇā kiṃratiścāste kiṃkāmā śivakanyakā ।
evaṃdraṣṭuṃ ca jijñāsā me jātā'ti tato'pyaham ।।2.275.6 0 ।।
samāgato'yaṃ devarṣirnārado bhagavanmanaḥ ।
brahmaputraśca rudrasya bhrātā devarṣikīrtimān ।।6 1 ।।
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sthairyahīnaḥ sarvathā kalahapriyaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ gṛhaṃ pragacchāmi te yadi mānayanti me ।।62।।
vacāṃsi vai mayoktāni teṣāṃ sukhakaro'smyaham ।
nā''driyante yadi lokā vacāṃsi toṣayanti na ।।63 ।।
tadā teṣāṃ gṛhe kṛtvā kalahaṃ cātiduḥsaham ।
pravrajāmi paraṃ gehaṃ yatra me mānanaṃ bhavet ।।64।।
kanyakā me darśayanti karau bhāgyaṃ vilokitum ।
ahaṃ dṛṣṭvā samastaṃ ca kathayāmi sukhapradam ।।65।।
asukhaṃ ca bhavet kiñcit tadahaṃ nāśayāmyapi ।
asatkāraṃ mama kṛtvā labhante na sukhaṃ janāḥ ।।66।।
susatkāraṃ labhante te mama vāco'nuvartinaḥ ।
mama godohamātraṃ vai vāsaścaikatra jāyate ।।67।।
tathāpi bhaktimāvīkṣya vasāmyapi divāniśam ।
tato viśeṣavāso me smṛddhisvargaprado bhavet ।।68।।
tato'pyadhikavāso me nārāyaṇāptidāyakaḥ ।
tato'pyadhikavāsaśca parabrahmapradāyakaḥ ।।69।।
muktiṃ dadāmi vacanānmuktiṃ dadāmi kīrtanāt ।
kleśaṃ dadāmi kalayā sukhaṃ dadāmi toṣaṇāt ।।2.275.70 ।।
viṣaṃ dadāmi vārtāyāṃ yatra nā'haṃ pratoṣitaḥ ।
pāyayāmyamṛtaṃ cāpi yatrā'haṃ sevito'bhavam ।।71 ।।
jijñāsā yatra pūrṇā me tatra svargottamaṃ sukham ।
datvā prayāmi cānyatra jānantviti vrataṃ mama ।।72।।
harekṛṣṇa harekṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।
śrīpate kaṃbharāputra lakṣmīpate harehare ।।73 ।।
śiveśvarasutākānta hare gopālanandana ।
brahmapriyāpate kṛṣṇa bālakṛṣṇa harehare ।।74।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa brahmapate hare ।
satpate sarvakāntānāṃ kānta kṛṣṇa harehare ।।75।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabhasvāmin kuṃvarakṛṣṇarūpavān ।
deśika śrotriya svātman sarvātman śeṣaṇāśraya ।।76।।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kṛtvā virarāma sa nāradaḥ ।
lakṣmīrvai manasā vācā karmaṇā nāradaṃ prati ।।77।।
dattendriyāntaravṛttistallīnā hi tadā'bhavat ।
satī śivā''ha devarṣi dhanyaṃ bhāgyamṛṣe mama ।।78।।
bhavān kṛṣṇasvarūpo yanmadgṛhaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
matputryāśca mahadbhāgyaṃ yat sataste'tra darśanam ।।79।।
nārado'haṃ vijānāmi śatajanmakṛtaṃ yadi ।
puṇyaṃ sammilitaṃ tena janma vai mānavaṃ labhet ।।2.275.80।।
punastatra kṛtā yajñāḥ syuḥ śataṃ tarhi vai divam ।
prāpyetendrasamakālaṃ tato'tra bhūtale sa tu ।।8 1 ।।
śeṣapuṇyaprabhāveṇa śreṣṭhamānavatāṃ labhet ।
tatra viprapratāpena satāmāśīrbhirityapi ।।82।।
rājyaṃ bhaktimayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāpnuyāt sukhadaṃ śubham ।
tatra devakṛtā sevā sevā'tithijanasya ca ।।83।।
prāpayatyeva sadbuddhiṃ smṛddhiṃ vaṃśasya vallikām ।
pitṛtoṣeṇa tatrāpi putrāḥ putryo bhavanti ca ।।84।।
satāṃ sevāpratāpena jāyante sukhino janāḥ ।
satāṃ sevā dhanadātrī bhūmidātrī sukhapradā ।।85।।
sā ca dharmeṇa bhaktyā ca tapasā ca tathā vrataiḥ ।
milatyevā'nyathā naiva satāṃ sevā hi durlabhā ।।86।।
anugraheṇa dayayā satāṃ sevā'bhipadyate ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa satāṃ sevā'bhipadyate ।।87।।
paropakāraśīlānāmannasatravidhāyinām ।
sadādānaparāṇāṃ vā satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।88।।
bhaktānāṃ saumyabhāvānāṃ sarvārpaṇavidhāyinām ।
satāṃ satkārakartṝṇāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।89।।
nityaṃ tīrthasvabhāvānāṃ nityaṃ kathāṃ suśṛṇvatām ।
nityaṃ vandanaśīlānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।2.275.90।।
nityaṃ devārhaṇasthānāṃ nityaṃ satkārakāriṇām ।
nityaṃ sādhusmṛtimatāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।91।।
ātmaśreyo'bhilāṣāṇāṃ sevāvṛttijuṣāṃ tathā ।
jijñāsūnāṃ sevakānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।92।।
sato mārgayamāṇānāṃ satāṃ guṇānuśālinām ।
satāṃ gṛhe satāṃ yoge satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।93।।
sadgurūṇāṃ nivāseṣu satāṃ mahotsavādiṣu ।
satāṃ prasaṃgāt satataṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।94।।
satyavratasthitānāṃ ca satparabrahmayājinām ।
hareḥ pārṣadayogānāṃ satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।95।।
harerbhaktimatāṃ gehe bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ gṛhe ।
viraktānāṃ samūheṣu satāṃ lābhaḥ prajāyate ।।96।।
sanmitrāṇāṃ prasaṃgena saddeśasya nivāsanāt ।
satkālasya ca yogena satāṃ sevā prajāyate ।।97।।
satāṃ dīkṣāprasaṃgena satāṃ mantragraheṇa ca ।
satāṃ snehavaśenā'pi satāṃ sevā prajāyate ।।98।।
āstikyenā''mantraṇena yaśasā satkulena ca ।
sambandhena ca mahatāṃ satāṃ sevā prajāyate ।।99।।
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā vāpi hareḥ patnyāḥ samāśrayāt ।
harervāsena vā nityaṃ satāṃ sevā'bhipadyate ।। 2.275.1 00।।
adya nārada vāso me śmaśānaḥ śaṃkarālayaḥ ।
pāvito bhavatā sādho satā bhaktimatā hareḥ ।। 10 1।।
tava pādaprasaṃgena pāvitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ।
muktimārgaṃ prayātyeva madgṛhaṃ cāpi pāvitam ।। 1 02।।
śrāvitaṃ śubhadaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasambandhajaṃ sukham ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakīrtiḥ śrāvitā pāvanī tvayā ।। 1 03।।
pāvitaṃ hṛdayaṃ me'tra matputryāścā'pi te'ntike ।
sthitāyāḥ svarṇavarṇāyā lakṣmyā nārada jīva yat ।। 1 04।।
aho bhāgyaṃ mama putryā yannāma jagatītraye ।
khyāyate sarvabhūteṣu dhanyā'haṃ mama putrikā ।। 1 05।।
putri lakṣmi namaskāraṃ kuru śrīnāradāya vai ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāpi tailāṃgamardanaṃ kuru ।। 1 06।।
jalamannaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ gariṣṭaṃ dehi mā ciram ।
paryaṃkaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dehi pānaṃ manastathā ।। 1 07।।
yathecchati satāṃ varyo nārado'yaṃ hariḥ svayam ।
tathainaṃ ca parīkṣāṃ te kartuṃ dehi samastikām ।। 1 08।।
brahmabhrātuśca vai śaṃbhoḥ kanyā tvaṃ duḥkhahe sute ।
ayaṃ putro brahmaṇaśca mama putro tavā'grajaḥ ।। 1 09।।
sambandhato bhavatyeva guruścāpi mahānṛṣiḥ ।
nārado'yaṃ hareraṃśastava pūjyo'sti me'pi ca ।। 2.275.110 ।।
putri yathā susantuṣṭo bhavettathā prasevaya ।
ityuktā''jākarīlakṣmīrnāradāya nanāma ha ।। 111 ।।
jalapānaṃ tathā miṣṭamannaṃ dadau śubhāsanam ।
paryaṃkaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ ca dadau puṣpasrajādikam ।। 11 2।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre lakṣmīḥ śrīnāradasya ca ।
rādhike śramanāśaṃ ca viśramya nārado vyadhāt ।। 113 ।।
nārado'pi yathoktāni lakṣaṇāni nyabhālayat ।
sarvaśreṣṭhāni vai tatra pūrvadṛṣṭāni vai punaḥ ।। 1 14।।
satī ca jānakī śīghraṃ śiveśvaraṃ patiṃ nijam ।
āhvayat sumahodyānagataṃ viśveśvaraṃ mudā ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne pārvatī-satyai nāradoktaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahimā, lakṣmīmahimā, satāṃ samāgamalābhakāraṇāni, nāradasammānanaṃ cetyādivṛttāntāvedananāmā pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 275 ।।

[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 277 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike nāradaścaivaṃ prāha śrīpataye tadā ।
bālakṛṣṇāya vai sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ śivagṛhe tu yat ।। 1 ।।
nārada uvāca-
hare mayā viśramitaṃ tāvacchrīśivasarjakaḥ ।
viśvaśūro divyadehastryakṣo gṛhaṃ samāgataḥ ।। 2 ।।
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ vaiṣṇavo madgṛhe'dya vai ।
tatrāpi bhrātṛjo me'dya vatsalaḥ samupāgataḥ ।। 3 ।।
aho nārada putra tvaṃ kutaḥ khalu samāgataḥ ।
śubhaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāste tava bhrātuśca me tathā ।। 4 ।।
viṣṇośca kuśalaṃ cāste kaccit kuṭumbinaḥ sukhāḥ ।
ityuktvā sahasā māṃ sa śivo vai vakṣasā'milat ।। 5 ।।
mayā vai satyalokasya piturme brahmaṇastathā ।
mātuścāpi ca sāvitryāḥ kuśalaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 6 ।।
tato vai sanakādīnāṃ rudrasyāpi prakīrtitam ।
dakṣādīnāṃ tataścāpi kuśalaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 7 ।
tato viṣṇormahālakṣmyā udantaṃ sarvameva tu ।
sukhaṃ ca kuśalaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhasthaṃ prakīrtitam । । 8 ।7
tato traikuṇṭhake jātaṃ prāgvṛttaṃ smāritaṃ punaḥ ।
śivatāṇḍavakāle vai lakṣmyāḥ śāpādikaṃ tu yat ।। 9 ।।
śivasya bhūtale janma śiveśvaro bhavāniti ।
lakṣmyāśca tyajanaṃ cāpi nārāyaṇena yat kṛtam ।। 2.276.10।।
bhaktārthaṃ tvāyayau nārāyaṇo vai bhūtale hyanu ।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇastanmiṣeṇa pareśvaraḥ ।।1 1।।
parabrahma samāyātaścāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
śrāvitaṃ vai mayā tattu lakṣmīścāpi samāgatā ।।।12।।
śivasvāmigṛhe putrī jāteyaṃ śrāvitā'pi sā ।
śiveyaṃ pārvatī devī tatsarvaṃ śrāvitaṃ mayā ।। 13।।
smāraṃ smāraṃ śiveśaścā'śrūṇyapi hyavāsṛjat ।
pariṣvajya saḥ māṃ gāḍhaṃ putra putretyavā'milat ।। 14।।
ahaṃ vai śaṃkaraṃ natvā''śrāvayaṃ mama hṛdgatam ।
kanyāmetāṃ bhagavāँśca smastyevā'gadaṃ ca tam ।।15।।
pradānakālastvasyā vai samupasthita eva ha ।
yogyaṃ yathārthaṃ kartavyaṃ tena sampatsyate sukham ।। 16 ।।
kṛṣṇasya tu bhavān śaṃbho pūjāṃ karoti nityadā ।
dṛṣṭa eva muhurdivyaḥ sa eva sundaro varaḥ ।।।17।।
parabrahma svayaṃ te tu niścito'sti janārdanaḥ ।
mayā dṛṣṭo bhavatā'pi dṛṣṭo mānavarūpavān ।। 18।।
kṣetrapālasvarūpeṇa draṣṭavyo nāvaśiṣyate ।
tathāpi cet samāyāhi yadi vāñcchā pravidyate ।।19।।
ityuktaśca mayā śaṃbhuḥ sasmāraiva bṛhaspatim ।
sa ca tūrṇaṃ samāyāto madhuparkādikaṃ haraḥ ।।2.276.20।।
pradadau gurave sarvaṃ nyavedayanmayoditam ।
bṛhaspatiḥ śubhaṃ prāha sarvaṃ yathottamaṃ tathā ।।21।।
tato niścitya vai śaṃbhuḥ kanyādānaṃ tu maukhikam ।
mamā'gre tvavadaccāpi guroragre punaḥ punaḥ ।। 22।।
mayā śubhaṃ muhūrtaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā bhūṣāmbarāṇi ca ।
śrīphalaṃ tilakaṃ cāpi kanyāyai tvarpitāni vai ।।23।।
tvatto jātā prasannā sā paridhāyā'mbarāṇi ca ।
sadbhūṣā vividhāścāpi tadā sā'pi gurūditā ।।24।।
harṣaṃ gatā varārthāṃ svāṃ matvā sakhīṣu śobhanā ।
haro bṛhaspatiṃ prāha kadā mahotsavo bhavet ।।25।।
bṛhaspatiścaturthyāṃ vai mārge śukle'vadattu tam ।
śrutvā modaṃ gatāḥ sarve bṛhaspativacaḥsthitāḥ ।।।26।।
nirṇīya ca mayā sākaṃ tato vācaspatirdrutam ।
yogapatraṃ samādāya kanyāmano vilokya ca ।।27।।
pārvatyāśca mano vīkṣya pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam ।
kuṃkumārdraṃ dravaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā muhūrtakaṃ śubham ।।28।।
alikhatpatramevā'pi nāradasyaiva sākṣikam ।
vāditrāṇi janāstatrā'vādayan vai harājñayā ।।29।।
maṃgalāni tathā nāryaścāgāyan devatāstriyaḥ ।
gūḍadhānādikaṃ śrīmān nāradaśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 2.276.3 0।।
śaṃkarādyāstathā sarve samāśnan maṃgalāvaham ।
tato'yaṃ suragururāṭ śivena yogapatrayuk ।।3 1 ।।
saṃpreṣito mayā sārdhaṃ kuṃkumavāpikā''layam ।
so'yaṃ suragururdevaḥ samāyāto'sti niścitaḥ ।। 32।।
vāgdattāṃ tāṃ nijīkṛtvā kṛṣṇā''naya priyāmiha ।
pratīkṣamāṇā te mārgaṃ vartate vihvaleva sā ।। 33 ।।
kadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāgacchet kadā māṃ ca nijāṃ kriyāt ।
tyaktā pūrvaṃ kadā tvenaṃ prāpnuyāṃ prāṇajīvanam ।।34।।
kadā sā kambharālakṣmīḥ premṇā māṃ samalokayet ।
dvivāraṃ yā samāgatya māṃ vilokya gatā gatā ।।35।।
vimānenā'dhvarebhyaśca yadā''yāto haristadā ।
punaḥ pūjyā na sā''yāti kathaṃ māṃ na smaratyapi ।।36 ।।
pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā tayā cā'haṃ bālikā tu tadā'bhavam ।
mama putrasya yogyeyaṃ kṛtvā'ṅke māṃ nyaṣādayat ।।37।।
manye sā vartate devī sadā niścitanirṇayā ।
tṛptā prasannā santuṣṭā yā māṃ naiva niṣedhati ।। 38।।
nārada tvaṃ samāyātastadā sā kaṃbharā ramā ।
kiṃ māṃ manmātaraṃ vā cā'kathayad vada tattvataḥ ।39।।
ityevaṃ sā muhurmāṃ sampṛṣṭavatī rahasyakam ।
vaktavyaṃ tanmayā sarvaṃ kambharāyai samāhvaya ।।2.276.40।।
śīghraṃ kuru kṛpāsindho sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ phaliṣyati ।
ityukto rādhike tatra bālakṛṣṇaḥ surarṣiṇā ।।41 ।।
samutthāya gataḥ śīghraṃ mātaraṃ kaṃbharāṃ prati ।
praṇamya mātaraṃ prāha nārado mama mandiram ।।42।।
jñāpayituṃ rahasyaṃ tu samāhvayati sotsukaḥ ।
santuṣṭāṃ matsvasāraṃ ca tathā bhrātṛvadhūṃ satīm ।।43।।
amṛtāṃ śrīṃ saha nītvā samāyāhi mamālayam ।
ityuktā bālakṛṣṇena mātā svasṛsamāyutā ।।44।।
bhrātṛpatnīsuyuktā ca bālakṛṣṇena saṃyutā ।
āyāt samutsukā rādhe! bālakṛṣṇālayaṃ satī ।।45।।
nāradastāṃ vilokyaiva mandahāso'namat satīm ।
utthāya svāgataṃ cakre vāṇyā vai namrakaṃdharaḥ ।।46।।
kṛtahastāñjaliścāpi tadā sa protthito'bhavat ।
yāvanmātā svarṇasiṃhāsane tūpāviśat tataḥ ।।47।।
svasā bhrātṛgṛhiṇī ca yāvaccopāviśattataḥ ।
sammānitaḥ pūjitaśca vandito nārado muniḥ ।।48।।
namaskṛtya yathātathyamagadat kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
mātarnamāmi caraṇau rahasyaṃ pravadāmi ca ।
yanmāmuktavatī śaivī raho'rthaṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ ।।49।।
śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīruvāca-
kiṃ maharṣe bālikā sā nārāyaṇī pareśvarī ।
uktavatī madarthaṃ yat sarvaṃ tvatra nivedaya ।।2.276.50।।
kiṃ sā rūpavatī bālā hyavyaṃgā pūrṇalakṣaṇā ।
kiṃsvidārogyamasyā vai kiṃ svit tannirmalaṃ manaḥ ।।51।।।
kiṃsvidicchati matputraṃ kiṃ svidāste'tra hṛnmayī ।
kaccit sā snehabhāvā māṃ kiṃsvinmatputramānasā ।।52।।
prasannahṛdayā kiṃsvidāste māṃ smṛtavatyapi ।
yadā yajño'bhavaccāpi piṃgā'raṇye tadā satīm ।।53।।
samāgatāṃ tu tāṃ vīkṣya prasannā tvabhavaṃ hyati ।
snuṣābhāvaṃ pradarśyaiva svāṃ'ke nītavatī ca mām ।।54।।
punaḥ sā'haṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ gatvā tato'dhvarāntare ।
rāśiyānapradeśeṣu gatvā punaśca tāṃ gatā ।।55।।
nijaputreṇa sākaṃ vai tāṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitābhavam ।
tāṃ nijasya sutasyā'rthe vijñāpya rahasi sthitām ।।।56।।।
tanmātre'pi tadā sarvaṃ tatsambaddhaṃ prabhāṣya ca ।
nirṇītamiva niścityā''gatā gatā na tāṃ punaḥ ।।57।।
sā kanyā matputrayogyā kiṃ niveditavatyapi ।
vada me sarvamevā'tra kiṃguṇā kiṃpraśikṣaṇā ।।58।।
kīdṛśī sā buddhiyuktā kalāyuktā tato'sti sā ।
vada me sarvamevā'tra yadbodhyaṃ vai snuṣākṛte ।।59।।
nārada uvāca-
mātaḥ sā kaṃbharālakṣmīrnāma śrutvā'tigauravāt ।
premabhāvāddharṣitā sā'bhavattathā'śrusaṃyutā ।।2.276.60।।
kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā dhairyayuktā māṃ vihasya samabravīt ।
kaccit sukhaṃ mamā'rhāyāḥ kaccinmāṃ sā smaratyapi ।।6 1 ।।
kiṃvṛttāntā mama pūjyā kiyadbhāvā ca māṃ prati ।
sā kiṃ mahyaṃ yatnavatī prasannā kiṃ ca māṃ prati ।।62।।
vada mahyaṃ maharṣe tvaṃ guṇasthānāṃ yathāsthitām ।
yadvā jñātavyamevā'nyat kathitaṃ māṃ nivedaya ।।63।।
tato'haṃ cā'vad kanyāṃ śravaṇe dattamānasām ।
lakṣmi! tvāṃ kaṃbharādevī na vai vismarati kvacit ।।64।।
bhojane tvāṃ sadā smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ tvāṃ smārayatyapi ।
kvacit kvacicca te vārtāmagnā tvadguṇavarṇanā ।।65।।
snehāśrubhṛtanetrā vai jāyate kiṃ vadāmi te ।
sukhaṃ śvaśrvāḥ sadā cāste sukhinīṃ tvāṃ pratīkṣate ।।66।।
sarvaśobhanavṛttāntā dehagehasutānvitā ।
sarvasampatsamṛddhā sā lakṣmi! tvāṃ sampratīkṣate ।।67।।
yathā putrīṃ ca santuṣṭāṃ prati sā kambharā sadā ।
tathā tvāṃ prati cādhikyabhāvā''ste kambharā satī ।।68।।
tvadarthaṃ sā yatnavatī kadā''yānme sutapriyā ।
sadā prasannā cāste tvāṃ pratīśvarī hi kaṃbharā ।।6 9।।
kvacid vadati kalyāṇī snuṣā me kiṃvratā bhavet ।
kṛṣṇo me tāṃ vinā naiva śobhate sadṛśīṃ priyām ।।2.276.70।।
ityevaṃ vai mayā mātaḥ sarvaṃ tasyai niveditam ।
āśīrvādāḥ pradattāśca tvaduktāśca tadā'vadam ।।71 ।।
prasannā sā snehavatī cāste sadguṇaśālinī ।
ityevaṃ cā'vadaṃ tasyai sā punaḥ prāha māṃ namaḥ ।।72।।
namaskārāśca me tasyāḥ pādayoḥ sannivedaya ।
prāṇāstvāste tava putre tathā''ryāyai nivedaya ।।73।।
ātmā tatrā''gato'styeva pūjyāyai sannivedaya ।
kṣantavyā bālyabhāvā me'nāryāyāśceti vedaya ।।74।।
yādṛśī tādṛśī cāsmi parvatāraṇyavāsinoḥ ।
putrī jāḍyamayī cā'haṃ kṣantavyā ceti vedaya ।।75।।
nā'haṃ vidyāvatī cārye nā'haṃ kalānidhānikā ।
nā'haṃ vijñānasampannā nā'haṃ cāturyaśobhanā ।।76।।
nā'haṃ māyākarī cāpi nā'haṃ tīkṣṇaprayogiṇī।
nā'haṃ kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇayogyā tathāpi māṃ na vismareḥ ।।77।।
pūjyāyāḥ putrikā cā'haṃ pūjyāputrasya patnikā ।
kanyakā'smi drutaṃ snuṣāṃ vidhehi cā'lamīdṛśam ।।78।।
vacanaṃ kanyakāproktaṃ dānakālo hi vidyate ।
ityuktvā pradadau mahyaṃ miṣṭā'mṛtaphalāni hi ।।79।।
deyāni kambharālakṣmyai tatputrāya ca viṣṇave ।
ityuktvā prāṇaman mahyaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ।।2.276.80।।
kṛṣṇaṃ vinā kṣaṇaṃ naiva yāpayatyeva sā satī ।
lakṣmītulyā tu sā lakṣmīrnānyatulyā kadācana ।।81।।
sarvatejāṃsi piṇḍāni tatsvarūpe vasanti hi ।
ujjvalā tādṛśī cāste yauvanodbhedanāṃkurā ।।।82।।
sādhvyavasthā sadā cāste cidambarā'mbarottamā ।
śāśvatikanisargā ca saccidānandapiṇḍikā ।।83।।-
brahmasaṃsthānikā cāste muktākṛtirhariprabhā ।
dvādaśottamavarṣā ca puruṣottamamāninī ।।84।।
snehavegā harau pātivratyabhāvā virājate ।
hṛdo madhye hariścāste kṛṣṇalakṣaṇalakṣitā ।।85 ।।
sarvakalā'bhisampannā kimu mātaḥ pravarṇaye ।
jānāti pākaśāstraṃ sā jānāti grathanakriyāḥ ।।86।।
jānāti gṛhakāryāṇi gaṇakāryāṇi yāni ca ।
bālaśāstraṃ prajānāti kalāḥ śṛṃgārajā api ।।87।।
nepathyaracanāṃ sarvāṃ jānāti sundarīkriyāḥ ।
bhṛtyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi dāsyakāryāṇi yānyapi ।।88।।
sevākāryāṇi sarvāṇi manorañjanakāni ca ।
nāṭyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyakāryāṇi yāni ca ।।89।।
vādyakāryāṇi sarvāṇi gītikāryāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
utsavādīni yāvanti sabhākāryāṇi sarvathā ।।2.276.90।।
vyākhyānāni samastāni nyāyavākyāni vai tathā ।
ātmabodhān samagrāँśca kalā yogodbhavāṃstathā ।। 91 ।।
jānāti sarvasiddhīśca tattvajñānaṃ ca vaidyakam ।
āyurvedaṃ vijānāti yajñakarmāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।। 92।।
sarvān vedān vijānāti sarvān vinimayāँstathā ।
sarvān hetūnṛtūn sarvān vivṛttiṃ pariṇāmakān ।।93 ।।
sarvaṃ śailpyaṃ vijānāti vakti sarvāśca nītikāḥ ।
sarvacchandāṃsi jānāti vaṃśodbhavaṃ gṛhikriyāḥ ।।94।।
ātitheyaṃ vijānāti paitryaṃ daivaṃ samarhaṇam ।
satkāraṃ svāgataṃ cāpi vijānāti ca mānanām ।।95।।
paropakāraṃ dānaṃ ca vijānāti samudbhavam ।
snehaṃ prītiṃ svāmibhaktiṃ pātivratyaṃ vṛṣaṃ nijam ।।96।।
prajānāti rasān miśrān miṣṭānnāni samastataḥ ।
takrasaṃskārakaraṇaṃ payaḥpākādikaṃ tathā ।।97।।
vijānāti ca vayanaṃ śuddhiṃ vratāni cāṃjasā ।
paṇḍāvatī samāste sā dṛśyate ca bahuśrutā ।।98।।
śāradā vā kimāste sā kiṃ vā rādhā hi rañjanī ।
raṃgakalāṃ vijānāti dhenusevādi vetti ca ।।99 ।।
kṛṣikāryaṃ sasyapuṣṭiṃ jānātyapi vanāni ca ।
sarvauṣadhāni samidho jānātyārogyamityapi ।। 2.276.10 0।।
jalakalāṃ vijānāti vahnikalāṃ pravetti ca ।
mantrakalāḥ samagrāśca pravāsān saṃpravetti ca ।। 101 ।।
lābhā'lābhau sujānāti puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ।
sāmadānādikaṃ cāpi vijānāti vivecanām ।। 1 02।।
kathāḥ sarvā vijānāti mahodyānakalāstathā ।
miṣṭamādhuryakaṇṭhī sā miṣṭasvarā'tividyate ।। 103 ।।
svarṇavarṇā brahmavarṇā raktapatkarapallavā ।
ujjvalā śāradī jyotsnā yaddehe vasati dhruvā ।। 1 04।।
viśālonnatacandrābhabhālā candrādiśobhanā ।
kṛṣṇakeśī ca kṛṣṇātmā kṛṣṇaiśvaryādisiddhikā ।। 1 05।।
sarvasampatprabhāvā ca brahmasaukhyasamanvitā ।
parabrahmaprabhānā ca parabrahmaprabodhinī ।। 106 ।।
smṛddhikāryā harau bhaktimatī muktānikā sadā ।
bālakṛṣṇo'ntare tvasyā rājate mokṣakṛtprabhuḥ ।। 1 07।।
sā cāste kaṃbhare! caturdaśavidyāsamāśritā ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhanuḥśūlasamanvitā ।। 1 08।।
pūrvoktacihnayuktā ca kamalācihnaśobhitā ।
lakṣmīcihnasahasraiḥ śobhitā varṣmaṇi sarvataḥ ।। 1 09।।
dvāsaptatipramukhyāni mukhyāni santi tatra ha ।
bālakṛṣṇasya cā''kaṇṭhaṃ samucchrayā virājate ।। 2.276.11 0।।
gajahaṃsagatiścāste parahaṃsagatiḥ sadā ।
svarṇavāsā sugandhā ca koṭyabjasakhikā tathā ।। 111 ।।
rādhāramāsatīpadmāmāṇikīpadmajāśriyaḥ ।
śāradādyāśca sakhyo'syā vartante kṛṣṇapatnikāḥ ।। 1 12।।
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā sarvasaṃghaṭanāśritā ।
camatkārachaṭāyuktā śīlakṛṣṇabalā'sti ca ।। 113 ।।
śuddhasattvamayī brāhmī brahmānandā'danā sadā ।
pāyasādyadanā sādhvī satī kṛṣṇārthanigrahā ।। 1 14।।
kṛṣṇadhyānatapoyuktā bālakṛṣṇārthatoṣiṇī ।
sarvatṛṣṇākṣayatoṣā amāyā śuddhiśobhanā ।। 115 ।।
vedavidyāsamadhyāyā mahāsāttvatasadvṛṣā ।
mokṣahārḍhā cātmanivednahārdā samarpaṇe ।। 1 16।।
nirvāṇapremapātrā śrīkṛṣṇapremaparāyaṇā ।
kṛṣāsādhanakuśalā cāgāmibodhasanmatiḥ ।। 1 17।।
kṛṣṇāṃgā cācyutadhanā hyabhakte cañcalā sadā ।
kṛṣṇacāñcalyayuktā ca tathā kṛṣṇārthakhelanā ।। 1 18।।
muktiruciḥ kṛṣṇakathāpravādā sthiravṛttikā ।
parabrahmapravṛttiśca puruṣārthatrayānvitā ।। 11 9।।
sṛṣṭitrayavidhātrī ca yatnabhogaprahāphalā ।
yajñasvargamokṣaphalā cā''pūrakakriyāvatī ।। 2.276.120 ।।
brahmalābhaviśeṣā ca sṛṣṭisaukhyasamānikā ।
sūkṣmā''tmānandamadhyā ca mādhavaśvāsayoginī ।। 121 ।।
kṛṣṇayogā sarvabodhā sarvajñopāsanāvatī ।
vṛddhārādhanikā nityaṃ kṛṣṇaśṛṃgāraśobhanā ।। 1 22।।
kṛṣṇetare viraktā ca nārāyaṇe sutoṣiṇī ।
muktā satsaṃgagṛdhnā ca kṛṣṇā''śā kambharecchukī ।। 123 ।।
kadā vai kambharālakṣmyā gṛhaṃ paśyāmi cecchati ।
yadi nā'haṃ ca kṛṣṇārthāṃ tadā me jīvanaṃ kutaḥ ।। 1 24।।
yato me jīvanaṃ cāste kṛṣṇā'rthā'smīti tarkagā ।
parabrahmoruyugalaṃ gṛhaṃ me cetiniścayā ।। 1 25।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavādā pade pade ।
pratyakṣaḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ pramāṇaṃ divyaśāśvatam ।। 1 26।।
tasyā vai vartate mātastanmūlānyaparāṇyapi ।
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvamevāste prameyaṃ tatkṛte sadā ।। 1 27।।
parabrahma mahātattvaॆ yatsamaṃ nādhikaṃ param ।
tadyogaḥ suprayogo'syā kṛṣṇasiddhāntasiddhikā ।। 1 28।।
kṛṣṇatantrasusiddhāntā sarvasvaprativarjitā ।
bālakṛṣṇagrahabandhā kṛṣayājñāvedasaṃbhṛtā ।। 1 29।।
sādhyo nārāyaṇaścā'syāḥ sādhanaṃ na śamādikam ।
bālakṛṣṇapriyā kāntā kāntetaravitarjinī ।। 2.276.130 ।।
mahābhāgavatadharmayamā kṛṣṇayamānvitā ।
kṛṣṇārthaṃ niyatā kṛṣṇaniyamā nā'parā''śritā ।। 131 ।।
bālakṛṣṇānanadhyānā kuṃkumavāpikāsanā ।
tava putre prāṇavatī kṛṣṇe ratikriyāvatī ।। 132।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāmāvasāyinī ।
śrīkṛṣṇasyavallabhātipriyā sā kṛṣṇavatpriyā ।। 1 33।।।
vartate sā mahālakṣmi! kambhare guṇasaṃbhṛtā ।
kṛṣṇaviyogo rogo'syā mānasaṃ tena kalmaṣam ।। 134।।
tvatputrecchā'rbudayuktā hṛdayenā'tra rājate ।
sarvasnehā kaṃbharāyāṃ premasnehā sute tava ।
vivāhamānasā nityaṃ prasannahṛdayā'pi ca ।। 1 35।।
sadā smarati tvāṃ mātaḥ putraṃ nityaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
māṃ jagāda sā sadvegā śṛṇu tvaṃ kaṃbhare punaḥ ।। 136।।
yadā yajño'bhavat piṃgā'raṇye śvaśrūstadā''gatā ।
snuṣābhāvaṃ pradarśyaiva svāṃke nītavatī ca mām ।। 1 37।।
rāśiyānapradeśeṣu gatvā punaḥ samāgatā ।
māṃ nijasya sutasyā'rthe vijñāpya rahasi sthitām ।। 1 38।।
sā'kṣataṃ candrakaṃ guptaṃ kṛtvā gatā gataiva sā ।
nādyā'pi tvāgatā mātā pūjyā''ryā pārameśvarī ।। 139।।
kadā cāyāsyati śrīśā vada me nārada drutam ।
kathanīyāḥ praṇāmā me cetyavadat punaḥ punaḥ ।। 2.276.140।।
mātaḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvakāryeṣu śikṣitā ।
gṛhakāryanipūṇā sā dānayogyā prakāśate ।। 141।।
tasmācchīghraṃ pragatvaivotsavapatrānubodhitam ।
caturthīdivasaṃ matvā kuru tayorhi maṃgalam ।। 142।।।
ityuktvā rādhike vipro nāradastāṃ praṇamya ca ।
svāsane samprayātaśca viśrāntiṃ cāptavān punaḥ ।। 143।।
kaṃbharā śāntimāpannā santuṣṭā mumude tadā ।
amṛtā'pi pramodaṃ cānumodaṃ pradadau tadā ।। 144।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ prasannaścā'bhavat śrutvā hyudantakam ।
suṣvupuśca tataḥ sarve sukhaṃ caturdaśīniśi ।। 145।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne sarahasyalakṣmyuktodantaṃ nārado bālakṛṣṇāya prāha, tataḥ kaṃbharādevyai prāhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 276 ।।
