śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike'māyāṃ prātargopālakanyakā ।
viprakanyā yuvatyaśca prajagurmaṃgalāni vai ।। 1 ।।
suvāsinyastathā vṛddhā bālikā maṃgalātmakam ।
yogapatrāgamaṃ śrutvā prajagurmaṃgalāni vai ।। 2 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre bṛhaspateḥ śubhāgamāt ।।
harermaṃgalamāśrutya jagurgītīrgṛhe gṛhe ।।3 ।।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca tathaiva sarvakanyakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇapriyā jagurgītīḥ kāntasya maṃgalāvahā ।। 4 ।।
gopyaḥ sarvā militvā cā''yayuḥ śrīkaṃbharāgṛham ।
sādhvyaśca brahmacāriṇyo gāyantyo maṃgalāni vai ।। 5 ।।
kṣatrapatnyo vaiśyanāryaḥ pāṭalāścānyasevikāḥ ।
mahotsāhabharā gītīrgāyantyaścāyayurgṛham ।। 6 ।।
devyo nityanivāsinyo'kṣarakṣetraṃ samutsukāḥ ।
śrutvā harerlagnavārtāṃ gāyantyaścāyayurgṛham ।। 7 ।।
kāmarūpadharāḥ sakhyaścatuḥkhanisamudbhavāḥ ।
kāmavallyaśca gāyantyastvāyayuḥ kṛṣṇamandiram ।। 8 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthanivāsinyaśca mātṛkāḥ ।
surāṇyaśca guruṃ lagnaṃ śrutvā jñātvā sumaṃgalam ।। 9 ।।
gāyantyo divyaveṣāṃśca kṛṣṇamandiramāyayuḥ ।
ārṣyaḥ sarvāḥ pūjanīyā rājapatnyaśca kanyakāḥ ।। 2.277.10।।
kuṃkumavāpikānāryo gāyantyastatra cāyayuḥ ।
sarvavarṇayuvatyaśca sarvā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
satīṃ śrīṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ kṛtasnānārhaṇāṃ ca tāḥ ।। 11 ।।
praṇamya kānake saudhe niṣadya maṃgalāni vai ।
bālakṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇasya kīrtimayāni sañjaguḥ ।। 12।।
kṛtasnānārhaṇaṃ mātrā kṛtamaṃgalacandrakam ।
kuṃkumā'kṣatayugbhālaṃ kṛtaśṛṃgāramacyutam ।। 13।।
bhrātṛpatnyā kṛtaveṣaṃ parameśaṃ priyaṃ prabhum ।
gāyantyo yoṣitaḥ sarvā vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 14।।
cakrustāścandrakaṃ bhāle sā'kṣataṃ puṣpavardhanam ।
pragīya gītikāścāpi pradarśyā''nandamāntaram ।। 15।।
āśīrdatvā guruṃ bṛhaspatiṃ natvā kṛtāhnikam ।
pītvā mātrā'rpitaṃ dugdhaṃ saśarkaraṃ sakesaram ।। 16।।
gṛhītvā tāmbūlamiṣṭaṃ śubhamuktvā yayurgṛham ।
gṛhe gṛhe'tra saurāṣṭre kṛṣṇotsavasya vārtikā ।।17।।
vṛhaspaternāradasyā''gamaścā'prasarad drutam ।
sarvāḥ prajāstu tacchrutvā prāpurharṣaṃ mahotsavam ।। 18।।
ānandamagnā abhavan darśanārthaṃ samāgaman ।
māṃgalikāni tūryāṇi tvavādyanta ca mandire ।।19।
suravādyāni sarvāṇi rājavādyāni yāni ca ।
gṛhavādyāni yāvanti deśavādyāni yāni ca ।।2.277.20।।
karavādyāni ca śvāsavādyāni pāvanāni ca ।
daṇḍavādyāni sarvāṇi vidyudvādyāni yāni ca ।।21।।
aṃgavādyāni ca saṃgapravādyāni ca yāni ca-।
prabhinnadeśavādyāni tvavādyanta samantataḥ ।।।22।।
miṣṭā vai śaṃkhikānādā jalayantrasvanāstathā ।
tārasvanā ajāyanta vaṃśīsvanā gṛhe gṛhe ।। 23 ।।
gāyakāścāpi gāyanti nṛtyanti cāpsaraḥsamāḥ ।
nāryastadā bālakṛṣṇotsavaṃ śrutvā'tiharṣitāḥ ।।24।।
saṃnṛtyanti mayūrāśca kūjanti kokilāstathā ।
śakunāni pragāyanti śukā menāśca sārasāḥ ।।25।।
padyotante grahāścāpi tejasvinaśca vahnayaḥ ।
sādhavaḥ snehatejobhirvyāptāstatkīrtanaṃ jaguḥ ।।26।।
bhaṭṭabhūsuravidyādhrā vidvāṃso vedavedinaḥ ।।
sāmagītīstadā'gāyan cāraṇāḥ kavitāṃ jaguḥ ।। 27।।
anye jaya jaya tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇetyūcuḥ prabhuṃ prati ।
evaṃ vai rādhike harṣavāco'bhavan jane jane ।। 28।।
śrutvā'nye bālakṛṣṇasyotsavapatraṃ samāgatam ।
guruṃ ca nāradaṃ śrutvā darśanārthamupāyayuḥ ।।29।।
āśīrvādān vadantaśca cirajīvetivādinaḥ ।
api bhekā bhekasamā gālayantramanādayan ।।2.277.3 0।।
oṣṭhayantraṃ tammarikāsamāścā''vādayaँstadā ।
karatālaṃ vādayanto jayavādān vyadhuśca te ।।3 1 ।।
kiṃ bahunā rādhike'tra kathitena tavā'grataḥ ।
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya gṛhadharmaṃ grahīṣyati ।। 32।।
viśiṣṭaṃ yatparaṃ tattvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadā'sti tat ।
āvedayituṃ lokebhyo gṛhadharmaṃ cariṣyati ।।3 3।।
ityevaṃ saṃvicintyaiva lagnapatrakṛtotsavam ।
prakāśaṃ kartumicchanto mudā rāsotsavaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।34।।
naro nārī naro nārī naro nārī bhramātmakāḥ ।
bhramanto'pi ca gāyanto bālakṛṣṇaguṇān jaguḥ ।।35 ।।
dṛṣṭvā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tad divyadṛṣṭyā purādiṣu ।
saurāṣṭre sārvabhaume ca gururvismayamāvahat ।।36 ।।
aho bhāgavatī bhaktirbhūrisnehamayī bhuvi ।
mahaḥpatraprasaṃgena mayā dṛṣṭā janeṣviha ।।37।।
īdṛśā bhaktimanto'tra loke muktā na saṃśayaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ hṛtsu harerbhāvo divyātidivyako'sti yat ।।38।।
aho nārāyaṇī dhanyā lakṣmīḥ sā śivakanyakā ।
yā vai prāpsyati dhāmeśaṃ khyātaṃ kāntaṃ hi śāśvatam ।।39।।
rādhāto'pi paraṃ cāsyāḥ sopānaṃ jñāyate mayā ।
yasyāḥ patiḥ paraścāste sordhvasopānagā yataḥ ।।2.277.40।।
kanyā'pi kṛṣṇapatnī cej jaganmātā pragadyate।
vṛddhāpi kubjikā loke kṛṣṇayogā praśasyate ।।41 ।।
vṛndā tulasī daityasya jalaṃdharasya vai tathā ।
śaṃkhacūḍasya patnyau te viṣṇuyoge ramānibhe ।।02।।।
pūjanīye jagadvandye mokṣade'bhavatāṃ sadā ।
aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ brahmapriyā asaṃkhyakāḥ ।।43।।
vartante'syāstu vai lakṣmyā gauravaṃ naiva yānti tāḥ ।
lakṣmyarthaṃ likhyate lagnapatraṃ yannā'nyasadṛśam ।।44।।
lakṣmyarthaṃ gamyate yena nānyasamo bṛhaspatiḥ ।
lakṣmyarthaṃ gīyate tvadya yaśo'pi nānyasadṛśam ।।45।।
lakṣmyarthaṃ harṣajananaṃ nānyatulyamidaṃ purā ।
lakṣmyarthaṃ bālakṛṣṇasya hṛdayaṃ nānyasadṛśam ।।46।।
lakṣmyarthaṃ laukikī vāṇī divyā cādya vibhāvyate ।
lakṣmyarthaṃ lokacāñcalyaṃ kalyāṇakṛd vilokyate ।।47।।
aho lokasya lokatvaṃ lakṣmīkṛṣṇāvalokanāt ।
yāthārthyaṃ bhajate tvadya divyālokātmakaṃ hi yat ।।48।।
aho me bhāgyamūrdhvaṃ vai tatsthānaṃ sārthakaṃ mama ।
guruścordhvaḥ sadā jāto lakṣmīpatraprapreṣaṇāt ।।49।।
ityāścaryamayo vipro devānāṃ sa bṛhaspatiḥ ।
rādhike vīkṣya sarvaṃ tad bālakṛṣṇāśrito'dhikaḥ ।।2.277.50।।
mahābhāgavato bhaktaścātmaniveditāṃ yayau ।
svarūpaṃ haraye samārpayat sarvasvadānataḥ ।।51 ।।
atha gantumanā bṛhaspatirgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
prāhā'dya kāśikāṃ yātuṃ samicchāmi nivedaya ।।52।।
amāyāṃ tatra śivarāṭ matpratīkṣāṃ karoti hi ।
tathāstviti ca gopālaḥ prāha cānyad bṛhaspatim ।। 53 ।।
yāhi śīghraṃ guro! kāśīṃ śiveśvaraṃ nivedaya ।
bhavadvāñcchā prapūrṇā'stu pālayāmi vacastava ।।54।।
lagnapatraṃ prapūjya svīkṛtavānasmi bhāvataḥ ।
bhavadvidhānāṃ devānāṃ niścitaṃ tatsukhāvaham ।।55।।
viparītaṃ vaiparītye pariṇameta kaṣṭadam ।
kanyā yogyā kumāro'pi yogyo'stīti tathāstviti ।
maukhikīṃ svīkṛtiṃ proktvā pratipatraṃ dadau tadā ।।56 ।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kīdṛśaṃ yogapatraṃ tat kīdṛśaṃ pratipatrakam ।
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi cāvedanaṃ taduttaram ।।57।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu rādhe kathayāmi tūbhaye patrike śubhe ।
yathārthe likhite gāṃbhīryādisadguṇamaṇḍite ।।58।।
svastiśrīśvarapūjanīyarajasi brahmā'kṣarakṣetrake।
śrīmatkuṃkumavāpikā'bhidhavare yo rājate śrīpatiḥ ।
yadgehe parameśvaro vilasati śrībālakṛṣṇo hariḥ।
koṭyabjeśvaravandito vijayate gopālakṛṣṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 59।।
yo vairājapitā bhavannanu mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ rājate।
yaḥ sṛṣṭau prathamaॆ manuṣyacaritaścāste harerājñayā ।
sṛṣṭitryarthitayadyaśāḥ śubhaguṇā''vāsastviha khyāyate।
tasmai vai bhavate namāmi satataṃ śrīkaṃbharāsvāmine ।। 2.277.60 ।।
yeṣāṃ puṇyasupuñjaśevadhiriha prākaṭyamāpadyate।
yeṣāṃ sādhujanāśiṣo'tibahulāḥ kāle phalantyāyatau ।
yeṣāṃ yajñatapaḥphalaṃ hyudayate vṛddhopasevāphalaṃ,
teṣāṃ tvādṛśaviṣṇunā saha bhavet। sambandhitā durlabhā ।।6 1 ।।
yatputrasya pade'rpayanti kṛtinaḥ puṇyāni śaṃdānyapi,
dhāmeśāśca samarpayanti mukuṭān mūrdhasthitān pūjane ।
īśā divyasamṛddhimuttamamaṇīn ratnādikaṃ devatā,
bhūpā rājyamanuttamaṃ kṣitidharāḥ svarṇādikaṃ śreṣṭhinaḥ ।।6 2 ।।
tasmai cākṣaravāsine bhagavate sarveśvareśāya vai,
yogyāyā'tiguṇālayāya haraye śrībālakṛṣṇāya ha ।
kāśīsthastu śiveśvaro hi surarāṭ kailāsavāsīśvaraḥ,
kanyāṃ me pradadāmi dānamanaghāṃ śrīpārvatīśo nvaham ।।6 3 ।।
yā lakṣmīrharidhāmatastviha purā nārāyaṇecchāvaśā,
tadbhaktasya harasya me śubhagṛhe prākaṭyamāsāditā ।
seyaṃ sāmpratamasti yogyavaraṇā dānapradānocitā,
tasyā dānavidhiścaturthadivase mārgasya śukle dale । । 6 4।।
puṇyātpuṇyatame muhūrtakavare taddānakāryotsave,
yāvacchraiṣṭhyaviśeṣita śubhatame cā'smābhirāniścite ।
satsambandhisuhṛtprasannahṛdayairāgatya manmandiraṃ
śrīmadbhiḥ svasutena hastadharaṇādyātmā vinirvartyatām ।।6 5 ।।
bhakto'haṃ bhuvi sāttvato'tra ca haraḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya vai,
yāvacchakti susevanaṃ vidhiyutaṃ vaḥ saṃvidhāsye'nvaham ।
nirvighnaṃ gaṇanāyakasya kṛpayā sampāramāpta makhaṃ,
dṛṣṭveṣyāmi sutoṣaṇaṃ tata imā gṛhṇantu matprārthanām ।। 65 ।।
yā vai me matabodhikā hi likhitā patrī mayā śobhanā,
śrīmatkuṃkumabindumaṃgalapadā''siktā pradānārthikā ।
dvyarṣeḥ sākṣiyutā bṛhaspatikare datvā mayā preṣitā,
sā vo hastagatā karotu ca sute vo matsutā maṃgalam ।।67।।
śīghraṃ devaguruṃ kṛtādaramamuṃ sampreṣayitvā ca mām,
āśvāse hi samarpya cordhvakaraṇe nibandhanaṃ sotsavam ।
kartuṃ yogyatamān hi no vidadhatu śrīkāśikāvāsino,
bhaktānbrahmaparānhariśrutadharān naḥ sāttvatān sevakān ।।48।।।
yadvā'nyat kuśalādiśobhi ca dinaṃ yacchrīmatāṃ śobhanaṃ,
tadvā sadguruṇā samaṃ drutataraṃ dānārhamāvedyatām ।
anyaccāpi yathākula svasaraṇiprāptaṃ madarhaṃ ca yat,
tatsarvaṃ vinivedyatāmiti vadan śaṃbhuḥ śamaṃ yāmi om ।।69।।
ityevaṃ rādhike dānapatrī śaṃkarapreṣitā ।
mayoktā te'nurodhādvai ś?ṇūttaraprapatrikām ।।2.277.70 ।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo yāṃ lilekha prati śaṃkaram ।
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyāṃ bahvarthasaṃbhṛtāṃ śṛṇu ।।7 1 ।।
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanivāsabhūtasubhagāgolokabhūmau purā,
śrīkṛṣṇāt prakaṭībhavan svavanitā'rdhāṃgaśca kailāsake ।
svīye dhāmni śivaḥ sadāśivabhidhaḥ saṃrājate vaiṣṇavo,
vaikuṇṭhe harisannidhau savanito nṛtyaṃ cakārottamam ।।72।।
śrīlakṣmyā vidito hyakālagamano vighno vilāse hareḥ,
śaptaścāpi manuṣyabhāvaniyataḥ patnyā yutaḥ saṃbhava ।
śrutvā śrīharireva bhaktamanugo'bhūcchrīṃ vihāyā'pi vai,
sā lakṣmīrharilabdhilobhamanugā cāste bhavatputrikā ।।73 ।।
evaṃ vai śivarūparūpiṇa iha śrīpārvatīsatpate-
rlakṣmyāścāpi karotu kṛṣṇabhagavān sanmagalaṃ sarvadā ।
tvatputraśca gaṇādhipaḥ savanito bhadraṃ kriyānmaṃgalaṃ,
śrīmatkuṃkumavāpikānivasatirgopālakṛṣṇo'rthaye ।।74।।
madbhāgyaṃ bahulīkṛtaṃ hi bhavatā datvā sutāṃ śārṅgiṇe,
matputrāya narāyaṇāya hariṇe śrībālakṛṣṇāya ha ।
sampṛktvā'pi bṛhaspatiṃ suraguruṃ sampāvitaṃ madgṛhaṃ,
tenā'pyarpitadānapatramiha vai premṇā mayā'ṅgīkṛtam ।।75 ।।
tatrā''diṣṭaśubhottamā'vasarake samprāpya kāśīṃ purīṃ,
śaṃbho! darśanamuttamaṃ hi bhavataḥ prāptye'dya śaṃ śāntidam ।
evaṃ sarvavidhānavaidhamapi sannirvartya tīrthasthale ।
dampatyoḥ khalu śāśvataṃ vidhikṛtaṃ saṃlokayiṣye sukham ।।76।।
yattatrā'hamumāpate'mbaravimānairāgamiṣye drutam,
madhyāhnottarameva śuklagatṛtīyāyāṃ kuṭumbā'bjayuk ।
anye ye ca nṛpāḥ kṣitau kṛtamakhāḥ śrībālakṛṣṇe ratā-
statsāhasramapīha vāhimanujaiḥ koṭyarbudaiḥ saṃgatam ।।77।।
muktā dhāmanivāsino'pyagaṇitā nārāyaṇā īśvarāḥ,
siddhā ārṣagaṇāstathā ca pitaro devāstathā mānavāḥ ।
divyā dehayujo'pi cetanagaṇā bhūtāni tīrthāni vai,
devyaḥ sṛṣṭiparasthitā api parārdhordhvāḥ prayāsyantyapi ।।78।।
kanyāḥ koṭya iha sthitā api tathā brahmapriyā yoṣita-
ścā''yāsyanti bhavatsumandiramanādibrahmayogotsukāḥ ।
sarvajñe śivarūpiṇi tvayi mayā kiṃ cāntaraṃ gūḍhavad,
vaktavyaṃ kuśale suyogini hare vaiśālabhūmisthite ।।79।।
ityevaṃ samabhipraṇamya ca tathā samprārthya kāśīpatim,
patraṃ cedamathā'rpayāmi gurave satkṛtya ratnā'yutaiḥ ।
nyūnā''dhikyamathottaraṃ hyaruciraṃ miṣṭaṃ gariṣṭaṃ kaṭu,
kṣantavyaṃ mama sarvathā vilasitaṃ yuktātmanā śaṃbhunā ।।2.277.80 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike patrottaraṃ dadau harāya ca ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai nāradenā'numoditaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
brahaspatermahāpūjāṃ cakāra ratnakoṭibhiḥ ।
sadvastraiścandanaiścāpi mauktikairhāratarpaṇaiḥ ।।82।।।
bhojanaiḥ pānasatkārai rañjayāmāsa sadgurum ।
vimānaṃ pradadau ramyaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।।83।।
kalpalatānvitaṃ ramyaṃ samāruroha sadguruḥ ।
pratipaddivase prātaryayau kāśīṃ vihāyasā ।।84।।
dadau patrottaraṃ patraṃ śaṃbhave mumude haraḥ ।
vācayāmāsa māṃgalyapatraṃ ca mumude punaḥ ।।85 ।।
namaskārādikaṃ cāpi vinayaṃ snehamātmani ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya bālakṛṣṇasya vai tathā ।।86 ।।
lomaśasya tathā'nyeṣāṃ kathayāmāsa sadguruḥ ।
āgamo'tra mahān bhāvī vāhinyāḥ sārvalaukikaḥ ।।87।।
ubhayoḥ khyātayoḥ satoḥ prādhānyena jagattrayam ।
āgamiṣyati vai dāne samaye gururabravīt। ।।88।।
śaṃbhuḥ prasannahṛdayaḥ prāhū guruṃ yathābalam ।
puṇyapātrasyāṃ'gaṇe vai bhavet trailokyamāgatam ।।89।।
yathāyogyaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ sevāṃ lokottarāṃ śubhām ।
koṭikoṭyarbudābjā me gaṇā loke vasanti ca ।।2.277.90।।
koṭikoṭyarbudā devyaḥ satīrūpā bhavanti me ।
saṃkarṣaṇo mahākālo mahārudro'pi rudrakaḥ ।।9 1।।
haro'haṃ mama rūpāṇi bhavanti koṭiśo'pi ca ।
mama sākṣāt pitā kṛṣṇo goloko mama sarvathā ।।92।।
mahāmāyā mama sṛṣṭirhanūmān mama vai sutaḥ ।
gaṇeśaśceti koṭyabjārbudābjāḥ pārṣadā mama ।।93।।
sarvaṃ me śubhakṛccāste bhavān devagurustathā ।
kiṃ nyūnaṃ me vartate'dya sarvaṃ sampannamasti me ।।94।।
ityuktvā tvāsanasthaṃ taṃ bṛhaspatiṃ prapūjya ca ।
śaṃkaro bhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṇḍapam ।। 95।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādāँśca kārayāmāsa diggatān ।
dūtān sampreṣayāmāsā''mantraṇārthaṃ jagattraye ।। 96 ।।
kuṃkumapatrikāyuktān śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
rādhike tvabhavan sarvamaṃgalāni harālaye ।। 97 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne'māvāsyāyāṃ gopālakṛṣṇālaye trailokyayoṣitāṃ maṃgalagītayo gṛhe gṛhe mahotsavāḥ, bṛhaspateḥ sammānaṃ dānapatrikāvarṇanaṃ taduttaraṃ pragṛhya prapūjitabṛhaspateḥ kāśīṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, trailokye śaṃbhukṛtā''mantraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 277 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 277 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 278
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 279 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṃgalāni vai ।
pratipaddivase nāryo jaguḥ prātaḥ śubhāni hi ।। 1 ।।
vāditrāṇi samastāni tvavādyanta samastataḥ ।
gṛhe gṛhāṃgaṇe raṃgavallyaḥ prapūritā janaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
toraṇāni suramyāṇi navapallavabhāñji ca ।
gṛhadvārṣu pramadābhirnihitāni samastataḥ ।। 3 ।।
ghṛtadīpāḥ kṛtāścāpi dhvajāḥ patākikā dhṛtāḥ ।
baddhā vyomapradeśeṣu bāvaṭā raṃgaśobhitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikāśobhā samastā dhāmasadṛśī ।
prajābhiḥ saṃprahṛṣṭābhirvihitā citrayojanaiḥ ।। ।1 ।।
rathyāśca rājamārgāśca gauṇamārgāḥ pratolikāḥ ।
mārjitāśca jalaiḥ siktā raṃgacitraiśca citritāḥ ।। 6 ।।
āpaṇāni kṛtānyeva toraṇaiḥ raṃgavallibhiḥ ।
dadhnāṃ'kurairnāgavallīpatrairmaṃgalabhāñji ca ।। 7 ।।
ālayāśca mandirāṇi prāsādāḥ saudhapaktayaḥ ।
śālā viśālāścārāmāḥ śṛṃgāritā janaiḥ śubhāḥ ।। 8 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi śṛṃgāritaṃ ca raṃgakaiḥ ।
tāraṇaiḥ śubhadīpaiśca catvarā vimalīkṛtāḥ ।। 9 ।।
vitardikā vedikāśca dvāraśākhāḥ sudurgakāḥ ।
gopurāṇi ca ramyāṇi kalaśaiḥ saptasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।। 2.278.1 0।।
sapatrapallavasūtraphalaiḥ śṛṃgāritāni vai ।
bālakṛṣṇālayastatra candrakāntādibhiḥ śubhaḥ ।। 11 ।।
kalpalatāsamārāmaiḥ phalivṛkṣādibhistadā ।
sūryakāntādimaṇibhiḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ samantataḥ ।। 1 2।।
sahasraikakalaśo yaḥ prāsādaḥ śrīharerhi saḥ ।
śṛṃgārito'bhito navyaiḥ śobhādravyādibhistadā ।। 13 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāparaṃ vā kiṃ golokaścāparo'pi kim ।
brahmadhāmā'paraṃ vā kiṃ cā'mṛtaṃ dhāma vetarat ।। 14।।
svargaṃ vā'nyat samastaṃ kiṃ tarkitaḥ sa prajājanaiḥ ।
evaṃvidhāyāṃ puryāṃ vai nāryo narā navāmbarāḥ ।। 15।।
navabhūṣā navaraṃgā navaśṛṃgāraśobhanāḥ ।
navotsāhā navabalā navarddhayo'bhavaँstadā ।। 16।।
navabhojanapānāśca navakīrtanagāyanāḥ ।
navasaṃkalpakodārā navasadguṇaśālinaḥ ।। 17।।
abhavan paśavaścāpi navotsāhāśca pakṣiṇaḥ ।
dhenavo navadugdhāśca mahiṣyo navatejanāḥ ।। 18 ।।
vṛṣabhā navavīryāśca gajādyā navakautukāḥ ।
aśvādyā navaharṣāścā'bhavan vai pratipaddine ।। 1 9।।
vṛkṣā navaphalāścāpi vallikā navapuṣpikāḥ ।
śākhāḥ sarvanavarasāḥ sasyāni kaṇiśāni ca ।। 2.278.20 ।।
madhūni navapuṣṭāni tadā'bhavan samantataḥ ।
viprāśca navaharṣā vai sādhavo navabhaktayaḥ ।। 21 ।।
vidvāṃso navamatayastattvāni nūtanāni ca ।
taijasāni navatejomanti tadā'bhavan khalu ।।।22।।
viśeṣatastu lokānāṃ nirmalānyāntarāṇi vai ।
bhāvodrekādabhavaँśca śāśvatā''nandadāni hi ।। 13।।
ityevaṃ rādhike kuṃkumavāpī nūtanā yathā ।
navayauvanasampannā sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhitā ।।24।।
lakṣmīrdivyā navā cāyāsyatīti nūtanā'bhavat ।
nūtanāyāḥ sapatnyā vai navaharṣopalabdhaye ।।25।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya snehabhūtaye ।
maṇḍapaścākṣaradhāmno divyastatra samāyayau ।। 26।।
neme śrībhagavantaṃ sa neme gopālakṛṣṇakam ।
natvā ca mātaraṃ muktasvarūpo maṇḍapaḥ sa ca ।।27।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃkalpamātrataḥ ।
divyaṃ muktasvarūpaṃ ca darśayitvā kṣaṇāntare ।। 28।।
prārthayat paramātmānaṃ prasādayitumāgataḥ ।
yathā''jñaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ bhavāmyakṣaradhāmagam ।। 29।।
hariḥ prāha tathā'stvevaṃ tadarthaṃ vai smṛto bhavān ।
karotu maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ yathā'kṣare'sti rājate ।।2.278.30 ।।
omityājñāṃ samagṛhya rādhike! maṇḍapaḥ svayam ।
mahāmukto maṇḍapātmā māṇḍapaṃ rūpamagrahīt ।। 31 ।।
rūpadvayaṃ samagṛhya svalpaṃ ca mahadityapi ।
svalpaṃ rūpaṃ bālakṛṣṇaprāsādāgre sthiraṃ hyabhūt। ।।32।।
śataikakalaśāḍhyaṃ ca śatastaṃbhasuśobhitam ।
sāptabhaumaṃ ca parito madhye cāmbaramārgavat ।।33।
upari madhyakalaśenā'mūlyena virājitam ।
yathā cāndrī kaumudī ca pṛthvyāṃ pūrṇātithau bhavet ।।34।
tathāsya dhavalā kāntiḥ payonibhā samantataḥ ।
ākṣare bhūtale tatra prāsaraccāndralokavat ।। 35।।
madhye sūryamaṇiryatra naisargiko virājate ।
sahasrakiraṇaiḥ saumyairmṛdubhiḥ saṃprakāśate ।।36।।
vidyunnālāni pārśveṣu pradīpakāntibhāñji ca ।
dugdhadhāvalyabhāvanti vidyotante'bhitastadā ।।37।।
maṇayo naddhabhāvāśca śvetā raktāśca karburāḥ ।
nīlāḥ pītāśca haritāḥ kapīśāścitrabhānavaḥ ।।38।।
pratikoṇaṃ praṇaddhāste prakāśante hi tārakāḥ ।
yathā tathā vicitrāśca tatpārśve patravallikāḥ ।।39।।
oṣadhayaḥ patradīpāḥ prakāśante sthale sthale ।
stambāḥ kuṇḍasamādhārāḥ kuṇḍāḥ paṭṭīvirājitāḥ ।।2.278.40 ।।
paṭṭikā jalavāhinyo guptatejaḥpraṇālikāḥ ।
guptatejaḥpravāhāśca prakāśante yathāsthalam ।।41 ।।
vaṃśāḥ staṃbhāḥ puttalikāḥ kammānikāśca toraṇam ।
śākhāḥ praśākhā vaṃśādyāḥ prakāśante pravāhakaiḥ ।।42।।
tejasāṃ nyūnatā nāsti prakāśante'kṣare yathā ।
eka eva hi mukto'sau maṇḍapātmā yato'sti vai ।।43 ।।
tejāṃsi śītabhāvanti coṣṇabhāvanti vai tathā ।
śītoṣṇabhāprabhāvanti cā'nuṣṇaśītabhāni ca ।।44।।
miṣṭāmṛtasparśavanti brahmānandapradāni ca ।
sarvendriyāṇāmānandapradānyapi bhavanti ca ।।45।।
ityevaṃ dīpayukte'tra mahātejasvimaṇḍape ।
staṃbheṣu kadalīrūpeṣvakhaṇḍapatrayogiṣu ।।46।।
śateṣvapi sāptabhaumasthiteṣu pravibhāgiṣu ।
saptaraṃgāni divyāni veṣṭitānyambarāṇi vai ।।47।।
tanmadhye tejasāṃ vāse pravāhe sarvasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
vilokyante staṃbhamadhye merau yathā surāśrayāḥ ।।48।।
kvacit staṃbhe hi munayaḥ kvacit siddhā bhavanti ca ।
kvacittiṣṭhanti muktāśca haryākārā anantaśaḥ ।।49।।
kvacittiṣṭhantyavatārāḥ kvacittiṣṭhanti pārṣadāḥ ।
kvacinmuktānikāḥ sādhvyo brahmapriyāḥ kvacit khalu ।।2.278.5 0।।
kvacitkṛṣṇasya golokaḥ kvacidvaikuṇṭhamityapi ।
kvaciccā'vyākṛtaṃ dhāma kvacitprakāśate'mṛtam ।।51 ।।
kvacaddhiraṇmayaṃ dhāma kvacidvairājakaṃ sthalam ।
kvacidbrāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca raudraṃ dhāma prakāśate ।।52।।
kvacitstaṃbhe satyalokaḥ kvacit pitṛnivāsanam ।
kvacid devāśca dikpālāḥ kvacidviśvādhināyakāḥ ।।53 ।।
kvacitstaṃbhe virājante sūryacandrādayo grahāḥ ।
kvacittiṣṭhanti vasavaścendrā maharṣayaḥ kvacit ।।54।।
kvacitstaṃbhe mānavāśca kvacid daityāśca dānavāḥ ।
kvacitsamudrā nadyaścā''raṇyakāni vanāni ca ।।।55।।
parvatāśca kvacitstaṃbhe kvacitpātālavāsinaḥ ।
jaleśayāḥ kvacitstaṃbhe kvacitsthaleśayā api ।।56।।
kvacidbileśayāstatra dṛśyante'pi gajādayaḥ ।
garuḍāḥ śukasārāśca menakāśca mayūrakāḥ ।।57।।
bhāsā haṃsāścātakāśca dṛśyante devayonayaḥ ।
apsaraso brahmasaraso'pi kvacicca nartakāḥ ।।58।।
dṛśyante staṃbhagarbheṣu citrāvaliyuteṣu ca ।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ maṇḍape vai nihitaṃ cākṣarātmake ।।59।।
bhūtale svarṇabhūmau vai rājante divyabhūmikāḥ ।
kvacijjalaṃ kvacittejaḥ kvacidbhūmirvirājate ।।2.278.6 0।।
kvacidbhavanti sāmudrāḥ kvacidvanāni santi ca ।
kvacicca parvatāḥ santi sarāṃsi saritastathā ।।6 1 ।।
udyānāni suramyāṇi kvacicca nagarāṇyapi ।
bhūgarbhe paridṛśyante copari samasattale ।।62।।
evaṃ kṣīrasamudraśca nārāyaṇastathā prabhuḥ ।
madhye tu maṇḍape tatra bhūgarbhe dṛśyate hariḥ ।।63।।
staṃbhamūleṣu sarvatra dṛśyante vāstudevatāḥ ।
maṇḍape'pi yathāsthānā lokyante kṣitigarbhake ।।64।।
śākhādevā vilokyante dvāradevā bhavantyapi ।
toraṇasya tathā sakhyaḥ paryo devyaḥ sraganvitāḥ ।।।65।।
vilokyante citrakammānikādhārāḥ suyauvanāḥ ।
suveṣāḥ sāmbarabhūṣā divyālokaprakāśitāḥ।।66 ।।
madhye dīpapradīpāśca lambante vartulāśritāḥ ।
pratolyāṃ samarājante devyo hāsyarasānvitāḥ ।।67।।
ratijātistriyaḥ sarvā vividhāścetanā iva ।
virājante vartulāgre darśanādhārasaṃsthitāḥ ।।68।।
gāyakāścāpi gāndharvā vidyante yugalātmakāḥ ।
dhvajābhiḥ samprakāśante maṇḍapāntarabhūmikāḥ ।।69 ।।
koṇe koṇe kalaśāśca sauvarṇāḥ sapta sapta ca ।
ekasūtre sthāpitāśca śobhante sūryabhāsvarāḥ ।।2.278.70 ।।
phalaśākhāśca lambante staṃbhastambāśrayāstathā ।
rajjvastatra praṇaddhāśca maṇimauktikmālikāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
vaicitryaṃ dṛśyate cā'tra maṇḍape darśane'bhitaḥ ।
ekataḥ koṭilakṣmyaścaikato vai koṭirādhikāḥ ।।72।।
ekataśca sarasvatyaścaikataḥ koṭidurgikāḥ ।
dṛśyante sāyudhāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।।73 ।।
toraṇoparibhūmīnāṃ sarvasṛṣṭimanoharāḥ ।
tadūrdhvaṃ pārṣadāścāpi gopāścāpi svarūpiṇaḥ ।।74।।
gāndharvāścāpi sakalā gaṇāśca śāṃkarāstathā ।
āyudhāni ca divyāni yāni sṛṣṭitraye'pi tu ।।75।।
vidyante tāni sarvāṇi tadūrdhve saṃsthitāni vai ।
tadūrdhve dhruvabhāgāśca sūryadvādaśakānvitāḥ ।।76।।
tejo'mbarasamṛddhāśca dyotante vṛttatānikāḥ ।
catuṣkikāstathā ramyā maṇḍovarāḥ samujjvalāḥ ।।77।।
sopānāni samastāni svarṇarūpyāstarāṇi ca ।
bhittikāḥ paṭavastrāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ svarṇapatriṇām ।।78।।
vitānāni samastāni dyotante kauśikāni ca ।
yathā yathordhvabhūmau ca divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamanyakam ।।79।।
vikāsitaṃ mahodyāne rāsaramaṇaśobhitam ।
gajasiṃhagaruḍādivāhanāni dyuvāsinām ।।2.278.80।।
yāni śreṣṭhāni ramyāṇi śubhāni tatra santi ca ।
tāni sarvāṇyūrdhvabhūmau nihitāni kramādiva ।।8 1 ।।
kalpavallīkalpavṛkṣakalpadīpānvitaḥ śubhaḥ ।
kalpatejoviśiṣṭaśca kalpabhūphaladastathā ।।82।।
maṇḍapo hyabhavat so'yaṃ kalpamauktikamālyavān ।
kalpavāyusukhasparśaḥ kalpagandhavirājitaḥ ।।83।।
kalpāmbarapradaḥ kalpatāmbūlavallikā'nvitaḥ ।
kalpapānapradātā ca kalpasvalpavimānakaḥ ।।84।।
kalpaśayyāstaraṇaśca kalpaparyaṃkarājitaḥ ।
kalpagendukakaśipupradaḥ kalpopasādhanaḥ ।। 85 । ।
kalpabṛsīkalpamṛdvāsanasiṃhāsanānvitaḥ ।
kalpapīṭhasabhāśobhaḥ kalpapaṭṭikamaṇḍitaḥ । । 86 ।।
kalpaśavaraṇairvakrairakhaṇḍāmbarakairyutaḥ ।
kācatoraṇayuktaśca maṇiratnāditoraṇaḥ । । 87 ।।
maṇiratnānvitakapāṭāḍhyapeṭikabhittikaḥ ।
preṃkhādolādisaṃśobhatpārśvabhūmivirājitaḥ ।।88 । ।
vidyuddarśanayantraiśca vidyudvāgyantrakairyutaḥ ।
vidyucchrāvaṇayantraiśca cāndrasparśasuyantravān । ।89 ।।
kalpavedhe kṛtakalpaṃ cānukalpavivartanaḥ ।
kālakalpanayantrāḍhyaḥ sarvajñatvapravartakaḥ ।। 2.278.90 । ।
piṇḍe brahmāṇḍake cakrottameṣu yogakalpavān ।
kalpayantrātmatūryādisvaragītiprakāśanaḥ ।। 91 ।।
piṇḍabrahmāṇḍasarvasvadarśakayantraśobhitaḥ ।
kāmatṛptipradasparśottamacamatkṛtipradaḥ ।। 92 ।।
smṛtamātrasya ceṣṭasya kṣaṇamātreṇa sampradaḥ ।
prācyasṛṣṭyāścaryayutaḥ saccidānandacetanaḥ ।। 9,3 ।।
śāśvatā''nandadātā ca ghaṇṭaśaṃkhamṛdaṃgavān ।
bhogyajātahradayukto'mṛtavārdhisusaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 94।।
sarvasṛṣṭisthitā yā yā yādṛśyāḥ pramadottamāḥ ।
tāstāḥ sarvā bhinnarūpāśrayāstatra vidhāpitāḥ ।। 95 ।।
koṇe māṇikyanāmā ca staṃbho yatra suvarṇajaḥ ।
raktaraṃgābhisaṃśobhaścatuḥkarṇasumastakaḥ ।। 96 ।।
pūjitaḥ sindūrapuṣpairakṣataiḥ kamalādibhiḥ ।
tathā vai cāndanapaṭṭikāyāṃ cākṣatamaṇḍale ।। 97 ।।
vārdhinīkalaśaḥ svarṇaḥ sajalaḥ pūjikāyutaḥ ।
kaṇṭhasūtrāmbaraśobho madhye jalena pūritaḥ ।। 98 ।।
cūtā'śokasucampakanāgavallīdalānvitaḥ ।
saśrīphalaḥ saratnaśca sadhātuḥ śobhanaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 99 ।।
gaṇeśena suvarṇena pūjitena surājitaḥ ।
siddhibuddhisahitena śubhalābhānvitena ca ।। 2.278.100 । ।
ityevaṃ maṇḍapastatra divyamukto babhūva ha ।
loke bhedena yāḥ śobhāstatra tena kṛtāḥ svayam ।। 101 ।।
rādhike varṇanaṃ yasya kartuṃ naiva praśakyate ।
sarvamāṃgalikāṃ'kurā'kṣatakuṃkumapātravān ।। 102 ।।
pūjāsatkāravastūpasampatsāmagrikābhṛtaḥ ।
dedīpyamāno hyabhavad bālakṛṣṇālayā'gragaḥ ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśuklapratipadi prātarmaṃgalāni, kuṃkumavāpīsarasoḥ śobhā, divyāṃgaṇamaṇḍapaśobhetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 278 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 278 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 279
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 280 →

śrīrādhikovāca-
māṇikyastaṃbha evā'tra maṇḍape sthāpyate katham ।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ tatra kimarthaṃ vai vidhīyate ।।1
gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ cāpi mātṛkāsthāpanaṃ tathā ।
vāstusthāpanamevā'pi viṣṇoḥ sthāpanamityapi ।।2
kuladevasthāpanaṃ ca kathaṃ kṛṣṇa vidhīyate ।
kiṃ phalaṃ sthāpane proktamasthāpane kimapriyam ।। 3।।
tatsarvaṃ vada me kṛṣṇa saṃsārisukhakāraṇam ।
yajjñātvā cottare lokāḥ kariṣyanti vidhānataḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarṣayo bhagavadbhaktāḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।
sthāpayanti sadevaṃ ca kimatra kāraṇaṃ prabho ।। 5 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi dampatīhitakṛtsukham ।
gṛhasthasya viśeṣeṇa patyustatra viśeṣataḥ । । 6 ।।
maṇisvarṇādisampatkṛdgṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā ।
pūjitaścaindradaivatyaścāgnidaivatya ityapi । । 7 ।।
dhenudaivatya evāpi māṇikyastaṃbha ucyate ।
maṇḍape sthāpitaḥ so'yamindrā'gnidhenudaivataḥ ।। 8 ।।
gṛhasthasya sadā cendrasamaṃ kuryāt samṛddhibhiḥ ।
agnitulyaṃ projjvalaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ nityadā bhavet ।। 9 ।।
dhenuḥ sadā rasān dadyād gṛhaṃ vai rasavad bhavet ।
indrasya smṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā ।। 2.279.10 ।।
vahneḥ samṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā ।
dhenūnāṃ smṛddhayaḥ santu gṛhasthasya gṛhe sadā ।। 11 ।।
ityevaṃ devatāstatra sthitā āśīrdadatyapi ।
anyathā trividhaṃ cāsya dāridryamupajāyate ।। 12 । ।
asmṛddhaṃ cā'pacanaṃ cā'rasaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet khalu ।
sarvaṃ duḥkhamayaṃ syādvai māṇikyā'pūjanādiha ।। 13 ।।
yatra māṇikyavāso vai tatra vāso hareḥ sadā ।
yatra harernivāsaśca tatra lakṣmīnivāsanam ।। 1 4।।
yatra lakṣmyā nivāsaśca tatra smṛddhinivāsanam ।
tasmānmāṇikyayūpaṃ vai pūjayanti purāvidaḥ ।। 15।।
pārthivā bahavo doṣā nidrālasyagurutvakam ।
jaḍatā śuṣkatā caite līyante tasya pūjanāt ।। 16 ।।
vināśo vidhavātvaṃ ca vidhuratvaṃ ca rugṇatā ।
anapatyatvamevaite līyante tasya pūjanāt ।। 17।।
pravāsitvamanāśrayatā cāpi gṛhaśūnyatā ।
phalivṛkṣādiśūnyatvaṃ līyante tasya pūjanāt ।। 18।।
dampatyoḥ premaśūnyatvaṃ varālaye'manaskatā ।
vadhvāḥ saubhāgyaśūnyatvaṃ līyante tasya pūjanāt ।। 19 ।।
bhūmāvabhāgitā vadhvā gṛhe cā'bhāgitā tathā ।
kule cā'bhāgitā vadhvā naśyatyevā'sya pūjanāt ।। 2.279.20 ।।
rākṣasānāmṛṇaṃ cāpi kumārīdevatāṛṇam ।
pitrādīnāmṛṇaṃ yāti māṇikyasya prapūjanāt ।। 21 ।।
indrāgnidhenusākṣyaṃ vai paralokādisādhakam ।
gārhasthyaṃ sarvakarmā'pi jāyate phaladaṃ tataḥ ।। 22।।
ityevaṃ rādhike bodhyaṃ phalaṃ māṇikyapūjanāt ।
śṛṇu tvaṃ kalaśasyāpi pūjanasya phalaṃ śubham ।। 23 ।।
kalaśe jalamadhye vai varuṇaḥ saṃvirājate ।
tīrthāni tatra cāyānti samudrasaritastathā ।। 24।।।
sarāṃsi devatāścāpi kalaśe'jaharīśvarāḥ ।
tatsādhyaṃ ca vivāhasya karma śāntisukhapradam ।।25 ।।
jalānnadāyakaṃ sarvarasānāṃ ca pradāyakam ।
śārīraṃ kāmakarmā'pi pāvanaṃ tasya pūjanāt। ।।26 ।।
putrasampatpradaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā ca pāvanam ।
naisargī yā'pyaśuddhiśca nārīdehe nare'pi ca ।।27।।
varuṇasya jalaiḥ seke sā ca sarvā nivartata ।
tīrtharūpo bhavettena patistīrthaphalapradaḥ ।।28।।
tīrtharūpā bhavetpatnī sarvatīrthaphalapradā ।
yugala tīrthamevā'stītyāha varuṇadevatā ।। 29 ।।
yatra vai vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ tatra ṛṇaṃ na jāyate ।
sarve rasāḥ sarvagandhāstatra bhavanti vāruṇāḥ ।।2.279.3 0।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ nivāsastadgṛhe bhavet। ।
yadgṛhe kalaśasthānaṃ kalaśo'sya payobhṛtaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
payasā ca ghṛtenā'pi navanītena sarvadā ।
daghnā takreṇa somenā'mṛtena saṃbhṛto vaset। ।।32।।
evaṃ kalaśajātīyā dhātavo'sya vasanti ca ।
svarṇarūpyāṇi ratnāni saratnakalaśā'rhaṇāt ।।3 3 ।।
kanyāḥ kalaśamāṃgalyāścāsya snuṣāśritaṃ gṛham ।
bhaved vaṃśasmṛddhiyuktaṃ svarṇakalaśaśobhitam ।।34।।
evaṃ vai rādhike! proktaṃ kalaśā'rhāphalaṃ mayā ।
asthāpane kalaśasya proktaṃ sarvaṃ na jāyate ।। 35 ।।
viparītaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ duḥkhadāridryavardhanam ।
gaṇeśā'rhāphalaṃ vacmi kṛṣṇo'haṃ vai gaṇādhipaḥ ।। 36 ।।
bhagavān sampadāṃ dātā sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ ।
sarvasampatpradaścāpi siddhiṛddhipradastathā ।। 37।।
śubhalābhapradaścāpi sarvavighnavināśakaḥ ।
sarvadā rakṣakaścāpi bhavāmi mama pūjanāt। ।। 38।।
laḍaḍu'kādikamiṣṭānnaṃ mama pūjākṛto bhavet ।
svarṇarūpyagṛhāṇyasya jāyante pūjakasya me ।। 39 ।।
hastyaśvarathabāhulyaṃ vāhanāḍhyaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet ।
pītāmbarādisaṃśobho veṣo'sya sarvadā bhavet ।।2.279.40 ।।
gaṇeśasya mukhaṃ śuṇḍhānvitaṃ paśudhanapradam ।
udaraṃ strīsamaṃ bhojyapradaṃ putrādisampradam ।।41 ।।
kaṭyadhaḥ kāmanābhāgaḥ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ ।
duṣṭaprārabdhanāśaśca bhaved gaṇeśapūjanāt ।।42।।
upadravo bhavennā'sya gaṇānāṃ duṣṭayoginām ।
ityevaṃ rādhike te'tra proktaṃ gaṇeśapūjanāt । ।43 ।।
phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇarūpo gaṇeśo'haṃ gṛhe sthitaḥ ।
tatra sarvatra bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca labhate gṛhī ।।44।।
mātṛkāsthāpanaṃ cāpi rādhike śṛṇu satphalam ।
śaṃkarasya tu yoginyaścatuṣṣaṣṭiprasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।45 ।।
mātṛkāśca tathā'nyāśca ṛṣipatnyaśca mātṛkāḥ ।
tathā'nyā jaladevyaśca caṇḍyādyāśca tathā'parāḥ ।।46 ।।
bālagrahasvarūpiṇyaḥ koṭarādyāśca mātṛkāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhīdevīprabhṛtikā rākṣasyo'pi ca mātṛkāḥ ।।47।।
ityevaṃ bahudhā santi pūjitāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ।
apūjitā gṛhaṃ bālaṃ garbhaṃ cādanti kūpitāḥ ।।48 ।।
vadhūṃ varaṃ ca vā ruṣṭā bhakṣayanti kvacid gṛhe ।
tasmāt pūjyā bhavantyetāstuṣṭāḥ smṛddhiṃ dadatyapi ।।49 ।।
jalato vahnitaścāpi vārayantyāgataṃ bhayam ।
evaṃ sadā pūjanīyāḥ kuladevyo bhavanti ca ।।2.279.50 ।।
kulavṛddhyarthamevāpi sampadvṛddhyarthamityapi ।
vināśaparihārārthe pūjyante kuladevikāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
vāstuḥ puruṣaḥ sampūjya sadā pṛthvīpratuṣṭaye ।
gṛhakārye maṇḍape ca vedikāyāṃ ca kuṇḍake ।।।52 ।।
jantunāśajapāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ vāstupūjanam ।
digdoṣāḥ pṛthivīdoṣā bhūtadoṣāḥ samantataḥ ।।53 ।।
nāśyante sarvathā rādhe! pūjitena hi vāstunā ।
vāsaprado bhavatyeva dampatyościrameva saḥ ।। 54।।
bhūmau bhāgyaṃ bhaved vadhvā varasyāpi dhruvā'bhidham ।
sarvakarmārpaṇaṃ deve vāstau kṛte bhavecchubham ।।55।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te'tra rogaghnaṃ vāstupūjanam ।
viṣṇoḥ sthāpanamevā'pi lakṣmīdaṃ maṃgalapradam ।।56।।
yatra viṣṇustatra cāste smṛddhiḥ sarvasukhapradā ।
pūjito vandito viṣṇuḥ kuryād vaikuṇṭhavad gṛham ।।57।।
bhaktiṃ dadyāt kule tasya dampatyoḥ śreyasaṃ tathā ।
yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ sattvabhāvaṃ dadyād viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ।।58।।
sudarśanena cakreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāt prapūjitaḥ ।
dharmaṃ dadyāttathā ṭadyājjñānaṃ vivekasaṃbhṛtam ।।59।।।
āntaraṃ divyamevā'pi netraṃ dadyāt supūjitaḥ ।
ārādhitaśca nirvāṇaṃ dadyāt sarvasamarpaṇāt ।।2.279.6 0।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe! phalaṃ devādipūjane ।
maṇḍapasya phalaṃ cāpi śṛṇu rādhe śubhāspadam ।।66 1 ।।
maṇḍapaścāśrayaḥ prokto maṇḍapo devatālayaḥ ।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsaśca maṇḍapaḥ parigīyate ।।62।।
paṭamaṇḍapa evāpi dhātumaṇḍapa ityapi ।
puṇyamaṇḍapa evāpi kāṣṭhamaṇḍapa ityapi ।।6 3 ।।
maṇimaṇḍapa evāpi gṛhamaṇḍapa ityapi ।
vṛkṣamaṇḍapa evāpi hyudyānamaṇḍapastathā ।।64।।
kāṇḍamaṇḍapa evāpi pārthivo maṇḍapastathā ।
kalpamaṇḍapa evāpi bhavanti maṇḍapā hi te ।।6 5 ।।
tatra sarvatra devādyā bhūtāni yāni yāni ca ।
guṇatrayasthitānyeva samāyānti samutsave ।।66 ।।
tasmānmaṇḍapapūjā vai sarvapūjāphalapradā ।
sarve tuṣṭā bhavantyeva devādyā maṇḍapā'rhaṇāt ।।67।।
mandiraṃ subhagaṃ syācca svargaṃ ca subhagaṃ milet ।
sarvasmṛddhirmileccāpi maṇḍapasya prapūjanāt ।।68।।
svāgate ca prasatkāre maṇḍapaścāgrato mataḥ ।
manaḥśāntikaraścāpi śāntiṃ cāsmai prayacchati ।।69।।
maṇḍaॆ takrāmṛtaṃ cāpi dadāti sarvadā śubhaḥ ।
dadhimaṇḍaṃ dadātyeṣo havanaṃ kārayatyapi ।।2.279.70।।
tanmūlikāṃ parāṃ smṛddhiṃ karoti maṇḍapaḥ sadā ।
havanaॆ sarvadevānāṃ tṛptidaṃ sukhadaṃ matam ।।71 ।।
gṛhasthasya sadā rādhe havanaṃ pāpanāśanam ।
sarvabhogapradaṃ proktaṃ sarvāyuṣyavivardhanam ।।72।।
sarvārogyapradaṃ sarvaṛṇamocanakaṃ matam ।
sarvatobhadramevā'pi sthāpyate maṇḍape śubham ।।73 ।।
tatphalaṃ grahakṛtpīḍānāśanaṃ pāpanāśanam ।
svarṇarūpyopakaraṇapradaṃ gṛhapradaṃ tathā ।।74।।
smṛddhipradaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ śayyopaskarasampradam ।
pātrabhūṣāpradaṃ cāpi chatracāmarasampradam ।।75।।
rājyarddhirājyasattādisampradaṃ bhadradaṃ tathā ।
śakunānāṃ mahaccaitacchakunaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ।।76।।
puṇyadānāṃ paramaṃ ca puṇyakṛd bhadramaṇḍalam ।
svargāṇāṃ paramaṃ svargapradaṃ vai bhadramaṇḍalam ।।77।।
mokṣasyāpi ca bhakteśca dharmasyā'pyadhvarasya ca ।
iṣṭāpūrtasya sarvasya vṛkṣāropasya vai tathā ।।78।।
kanyādānasya ca tathā kumāradānakasya ca ।
sarvadharmasya puṇyānāṃ pradaṃ vai bhadramaṇḍalam ।।79।।
yogānāṃ puṇyadaṃ cāpi sevānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tathā ।
paropakārakāryāṇāṃ puṇyadaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ।।2.279.80।।
bhadraṃ paśyet sadā kanyā bhadraṃ paśyet sadā patiḥ ।
bhadraṃ paśyet kuṭumbaṃ ca bhadramaṇḍalapūjanāt ।।81 ।।
saubhāgyaṃ labhate kanyā gṛhitvaṃ labhate naraḥ ।
patiputravatī sādhvī bhaved bhadraprapūjanāt ।।82।।
viyogo na bhavet patnyāḥ patyuśca bhadrapūjanāt ।
vighnānāṃ vārakaṃ tvetat sampadāṃ ca prapūrakam ।।83।।
yatra vai pūjyate kṛṣṇaḥ pūjyante yatra devatāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pārṣadāścāpyavatārāśca grahādayaḥ ।।84।।
dikpālā yatra pūjyante gṛhapālāstathā'pare ।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca pūjyante śāradādikāḥ ।।85।।
ekādaśyaḥ prapūjyante rādhādyāśca suśaktayaḥ ।
pūjyante devavaṃśāśca bhadradaṃ bhadramaṇḍalam ।।86।।
tasmādvai rādhike! tatra maṇḍape bhadramaṇḍalam ।
pūjanīyaṃ vidhānena pūjanīyo haristathā ।।87।।
yatra kvāpi kriyāyoge mahotsave sukhotsave ।
vivāhe varayānādau kanyādāne satīsthale ।।88।।
brahmādāne mantradāne dīkṣādāne vratādiṣu ।
mahādāne janmadine pūjanīyo hariḥ sadā ।।89।।
parameśasya pūjā vai sarvapūjāphalapradā ।
sarvasaṃkalpasiddhīnāṃ pradā kāmaprapūrikā ।।2.279.90।।
sarvayajñaphaladā ca sarvakartavyapūrikā ।
sarvārambhaphalāḍhyā ca pūjā''dau śrīhareḥ sadā ।।9 1।।
lakṣmīpūjā tathā cādau kāryārambhe sukhapradā ।
sampatpradā bhavatyeṣā śāntisaubhāgyadā tathā ।।92।।
alakṣmīnāśinī cāpi duḥkhadāridryanāśinī ।
kṛpaṇatvasya vai nāśo bhavellakṣmīprapūjanāt ।।93 ।।
kanyāratnaṃ vararatnaṃ dhanaratnāni yāni ca ।
nirvighnāni bhaveyuśca lakṣmyāścādau prapūjanāt ।।94।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! proktaṃ phalaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā yataḥ ।
sukhasampad bhavedeva yatra kvā'pyapi pūjanāt ।।95।।
prāyo lokā bhavantyeva śārīrasukhavāsanāḥ ।
teṣāmuktaprapūjābhiḥ sukhasampad vivardhate ।।96।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi phalādhyāyasya tatphalam ।
yatphalaṃ pūjanāccāpi jāyate dānatastathā ।।97।।
kanyādānasamaṃ dānaṃ trailokye naiva vidyate ।
yadādhāraḥ sarvadharmo vaṃśavistāra ityapi ।।98।।
yadādhāraṃ jagat sarvaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā yadāśritā ।
yadvinā pralayaḥ prokto yadvinā śūnyatā matā ।।99।।
indratvaṃ yadvinā nāsti cātmanāṃ yoṣitaṃ vinā ।
yoṣid rājyaṃ cātmano'sti tvātmārājā tayā kṛtaḥ ।। 2.279.10 0।।
tasmād rādhe! vivāhena gṛhyate strī nareṇa vai ।
vararājaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vai vindate yoṣitā tadā ।। 10 1।।
vinā rājyaṃ vararājo bhavatyeva varā priyā ।
tasyā rājyaṃ kumāre'trā''rūḍhaṃ syādvararājake ।। 102।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
dānagrahī mahārājo bhaviṣyati dinadvaye ।। 103।।
mama putrasya śaṃbhośca putryāḥ svāmī bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā te jāyate harṣaścoktvā me'pi prajāyate ।। 1 04।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! svalpamaṇḍapena nijālayam ।
śobhitaṃ kṛtavān śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne maṇḍape
māṇikyastaṃbhasya kalaśasya gaṇeśasya mātṛkāṇāṃ vāsto-
rviṣṇoḥ kuladevatāyāḥ sarvatobhadrasya ca prapūjane
phalādeśanirūpaṇanāmā navasaptatyadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 279 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 279 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 280
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 281 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! cānyaṃ mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham ।
maṇḍapākhyo mahāyuktaḥ svātmakaṃ rūpamādadhat ।। 1 ।।
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ daśayojanamāyatam ।
ūrdhvaṃ yojanamātraṃ ca ṣaṭpañcāśatprabhūmikam ।। 2 ।।
daśasāhasrakalaśāḥ sadhvajāḥ sapatākikāḥ ।
rājante yatra sauvarṇāḥ sūryasāhasrasadṛśāḥ ।। 3 ।।
madhye śataikakalaśāścoparyupari bhānti ca ।
kiṃ vā grahāśca nakṣatrā dyotante kalaśā iva ।। 4 ।।
sauvarṇaṃ ca vitānaṃ vai divyaṃ yatra prabhāti ca ।
cidākāśāmbaraṃ yadvanmahadākāśamiśritam ।। 6 ।।
daśasāhasraśṛṃgāṇi vidyotante pare'mbare ।
meghā kaṭyāṃ maṇḍapāntaḥ praviśya yānti nirmalāḥ ।। 6 ।।
sahasracandratulyāśca tiṣṭhanti pratibhūmikam ।
pūrṇāḥ śvetāḥ śvetabhāsaścandramaso'kṣarātmakāḥ ।। 7 ।।
jyotsnāsteṣāṃ maṇḍapāntargarbhāgāreṣu yānti ca ।
kānakyo bhittikāḥ sarvāḥ sarvā brahmaprabhāśritāḥ ।। 8 ।।
brahmā'mṛtapravāhiṇyo mahānandapravarṣikāḥ ।
daśasāhasravaikuṇṭhātmakavitānamaṇḍalam ।। 9 ।।
maṇḍape cordhvabhāge vai garbhe vilokyate śubham ।
madhye rātnajhummarāṇi cāndratejobhṛtāni vai ।। 2.280.1 0।।
paritaḥ śikharāgāre muktānyo vilasanti vai ।
kalpavallyaḥ kalpavṛkṣāḥ saṃkalpamaṇayastathā ।। 1 1।।
staṃbhaśirassu śobhante sarvasaṃkalpapūrakāḥ ।
staṃbheṣu ghṛtakulyāśca dadhikulyāḥ samantataḥ ।। 12।।
madhukulyā jalakulyāḥ peyakulyā vahanti ca ।
śaratpānaprakulyāścā'mṛtakulyāḥ sravanti ca ।। 13।।
sudhākulyā navanītakulyāḥ pīyūṣavāpikāḥ ।
sudhādhārāḥ staṃbhagarbhe vasanti pravahanti ca ।। 14।।
tattaddhāmanivāsānāṃ peyā'dyarasavāhikāḥ ।
saritastatra tiṣṭhanti toraṇeṣu samantataḥ ।। 15।।
kāmakalpalatāstatra kāmastrīdāsadāsikāḥ ।
kāmabhogyapradāḥ sarvāḥ kammānikāḥ prakalpitāḥ ।। 16।।
toraṇāni samastāni vicitraraṃgabhāñji ca ।
klṛptāni maṇḍape tatra maṇḍapākhyena yoginā ।। 17।।
jalasthānaṃ snānaśālāḥ snānopakaraṇānyapi ।
śobhante cendraśālāvat sugandhidravyabhāñji ca ।। 18।।
lepakajjalakastūrīcandanādyaiḥ samanvitāḥ ।
sugandhisārarasakairyuktāḥ śālā bhavanti ca ।। 19।।
pānabhojanaśālāśca tattaddhāmanivāsinām ।
tattaddhāmnāṃ kalpalatāmaṇiyuktā vinirmitāḥ ।।2.280.20।।
teṣāṃ saṃkalpaphalikā yathāpekṣitasampradāḥ ।
tattadbhogavilāsāḍhyā bhojyaśālā bhavanti ca ।।।21 ।।
tattatpātropakaraṇāsanasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
śayyā''rāmapraśālāśca viśrāntimandirāṇi ca ।।।22।।
divyaparyaṃkayuktāni divyagendukavantyapi ।
divyā''staraṇaśobhāni divyā''varaṇabhāñjyapi ।।23।।
divyaveṣopayuktāni divyāmbarabhṛtāni ca ।
divyavilāsadravyāṇi divyabhāvakarāṇi ca ।।24।।
divyasugandhavāsāni divyaratipradānyapi ।
divyānandapradānyeva bhavanti tatra maṇḍape ।।25।।।
yatsmṛtaṃ bhojane pāne śayane ca ratāvapi ।
yugalānāṃ divyameva sarvaṃ samupatiṣṭhati ।। 26।।
dyūtaśālā vicitrāśca raṃgaśālāḥ śubhāstathā ।
sarvasādhanasampannā vidyotante tu maṇḍape ।। 27।।
nāṭyaśālāśca vividhā mallaśālāḥ pṛthak tathā ।
nṛtyaśālā veṣaśālāstathā nepathyabhūmikāḥ ।।28।।
dṛśyaśālā hyanantāśca śrotavyayantraśālikāḥ ।
vārtāgṛhāṇi saumyāni gandhāgārāṇi cāpi vai ।।29।।।
sparśāśramāṇi ramyāṇi rasyālayāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ।
gītiśālāḥ śobhanāśca vidyante tatra maṇḍape ।।2.280.3 0।।
pañcabhūtāni tattvāni viṣayāḥ sthūlasūkṣmakāḥ ।
tathā tattvāni kāryāṇi kāraṇāni ca maṇḍape ।।3 1 ।।
brahmahradāḥ kṛtāstatra virajādyāśca vai kṛtāḥ ।
amṛtānāṃ ca saritaḥ kṛtāḥ kuṇḍāḥ sthale sthale ।।32।।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi phalapuṣpabhṛtānyapi ।
śarkarārasadaṇḍādyavāṭikāstatra maṇḍape ।।33।।
miṣṭā'mblarasabhogāśca nāgapūgīlavaṃgakāḥ ।
elātvakkhādyabhāgāśca vidyotanta hi maṇḍape ।।34।।
teṣāṃ teṣāṃ praveṣāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi santi maṇḍape ।
teṣāṃ teṣāṃ cāyudhānāṃ mandirāṇyapi maṇḍape ।।35।।
tāsāṃ tāsāṃ kanyakānāṃ bālakrīḍanakānyapi ।
bālānāṃ khelanābhāgā vidyotante hi maṇḍape ।।36।।
rājamārgāstathā rathyāścatvarāśca vitardikāḥ ।
mahāsthālā virāmāśca vilasanti ca maṇḍape ।।37।।
vallabhyaścandraśālāśca gavākṣāṇi samantataḥ ।
hrasvānyapi ca dīrghāṇi dvāraveṣāṇi santi ca ।।38 ।।
chatrajātāni saumyāni kuñjavat saṃsthitānyapi ।
dvāraveṣordhvavāsāni śobhante tatra maṇḍape ।। 39।।।
śukāśca sārasāścāpi menā mayūrakāstathā ।
haṃsāḥ kāraṇḍavāścāpi garuḍā bhāsapakṣiṇaḥ ।।2.280.40।।
śyenāḥ kapotakā divyāścakravākāśca tittirāḥ ।
nīlakaṇṭhāścātakāśca divyāḥ pārāvatāstathā ।।41 ।।
evamanye pakṣiṇaśca toraṇeṣu samantataḥ ।
nūtanā navadṛśyāśca vidyotante sukhabhṛtaḥ ।।।42।।
kokilāśca prakūjanti kūjayantyaparānapi ।
staṃbhānāṃ mūrdhabhāgeṣu darśaneṣu vasanti ca ।।43 ।।
hastinaḥ śarabhāḥ siṃhāḥ kesariṇaśca dhenavaḥ ।
dvīpā vyāghrā nāradvipā bhallukā gavayāstathā ।।44।।
gaṇḍakāśca mṛgāḥ khaṅgāścitrāśca śṛṃgasābharāḥ ।
reṇḍakāśca śaśāścāpi śvetāśvāścāśvajātayaḥ ।।45।।
vṛṣabhā uṣṭrakāścāpi makarāḥ kacchapāstathā ।
timiṃgilā jhaṣāścāpi vidyotante samantataḥ ।।46।।
ratnahīrakamauktikātmakamaṇyādiśobhitāḥ ।
madhyabhāgāḥ prakāśante pratyālayaṃ tadā'mbare ।।47।।
mālāḥ puṣpaprakāṇḍāśca divyāḥ srajo'tigandhitāḥ।
tejobhṛtāḥ praśobhante kaustubhāśca sthale sthale ।।48।।
paryo devyaśceśvarāṇyaḥ surāṇyaḥ kanyakottamāḥ ।
sādhvyaḥ satyo vilasanti dvāraveṣeṣu saṃsthitāḥ ।।49।।
candraśālā vimānaiśca kāmavāhairyutāstadā ।
maṇḍape śatasāhasrāḥ śobhante vyomasaṃgatāḥ ।।2.280.50।।
udyānavāṭikāvallyaḥ puṣpastambā bhavantyapi ।
kamalānāṃ nivāsāśca sugandhayanti maṇḍapam ।।51 ।।
mandasugandhisaṃspṛśyaśītalā'nilapūrakāḥ ।
āgacchanti vanamārgānmaṇḍape vai gṛhe gṛhe ।।52।।
bhogyānāṃ nyūnatā nāsti veṣābhūṣāmbarātmanām ।
miṣṭānnānāṃ rāśayaśca maṇḍape'tra gṛhe gṛhe ।।।53।।
tattaddhāmanivāsānāṃ yogyabhogyāni santi hi ।
darpaṇādarśabhāgāśca pratibimbadravāstathā ।।54।।
siddhayaścāṇimādyāśca vidyotante hi maṇḍape ।
dāsā dāsyo'pyanantāśca kanyakāḥ koṭiśo'pi ca ।।55।।
amṛtānandadāyinyo vartante maṇḍape tadā ।
vaicitryaṃ khalu tatrā''sīd rādhike! nūtanaṃ śṛṇu ।।56।।
gṛhe gṛhe tu dehalyāṃ nihitaścaikako maṇiḥ ।
yatra vilokyate svacchaḥ samastaḥ sarvamaṇḍapaḥ ।।57।।
sarve maṇḍapabhāgāśca sarve māṇḍapinastathā ।
mahīmānāḥ samastāśca divase na tu vai niśi ।।58।।
kiṃ mayā rādhike! vācyaṃ tvatsamāścā'rbudastriyaḥ ।
muktānyaḥ sevikāstatra vartante paricārikāḥ । ।59।।
golokastho'pyahaṃ smṛtvā dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgamam ।
vilāsaste śūnyabhūto dṛśyate tatsamīpataḥ ।।2.280.6 0।।
sthale sthale ca goloko vaikuṇṭho vartate'pi ca ।
ūrdhvaṃ sthalaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrā'kṣaradhāmanivāsinām ।।6 1 ।।
tato'dhaḥ sarvadhāmnāṃ ca sarvagolokavāsinām ।
tato'dhaśca kṛtaṃ śrīmadvāsudevasthalaṃ śubham ।।62।।
tato'dhaśca kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ śubham ।
tato'dhaśca kṛtaṃ divyaṃ cā'vyākṛtaṃ śubhaṃ sthalam ।।63।।
tato'mṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ cādhastato bhaumaṃ kṛtaṃ sthalam ।
tato hairaṇyagarbhaṃ ca vairājaṃ ca kṛtaṃ hyadhaḥ ।।64।।
mahāmāyāsthalaṃ cāpi sādāśaivaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca kṛtaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca dvitīyakam ।।65।।
brāhmaṃ raudraṃ tathā śaivaṃ saiddhaṃ sthānaṃ tato'pyadhaḥ ।
īśvarāṇāṃ nivāsāśca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tato'pyadhaḥ ।।66।।
pitṝṇāṃ ca kṛtāścāpi surāṇāṃ ca tato'pyadhaḥ ।
trayastriṃśatpradevānāṃ sthānāni ca tato'pyadhaḥ ।।67।।
bhuvarlokanivāsānāṃ mānavānāṃ tato'pyadhaḥ ।
atalādinivāsānāṃ bhaktānāṃ ditijanminām ।।68।।
danujānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ yādasāṃ bhūbhuvāṃ tathā ।
vanyānāṃ sarvasattvānāṃ kāmarūpadhragātmanām ।।69।।
kāmadhenuprakulānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathā''tmanām ।
tīrthānāṃ parvatādīnāṃ sthānāni maṇḍape'pyadhaḥ ।।2.280.70।।
kṛtāni maṇḍapākhyena muktena maṇḍape nije ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā hi nūtane ।।71।।
yajñaśālā devaśālā japaśālāḥ kṛtāstathā ।
vedaśālā vaidyaśālā vedhaśālāstathā kṛtāḥ ।।72।।
āpaṇānāṃ paṃktayaśca bhṛjyaśālāstathā kṛtāḥ ।
vihāravanaśālāśca kṛtā bahvyo hyadho bhuvi ।।73।।
sopānāni vicitrāṇi sarvaratnamayāni ca ।
niḥśreṇikā vicitrāśca yathāsaṃkalpacañcalāḥ ।।74।।
ārohā'varohakuṭyaḥ sakalpaśṛṃkhalānvitāḥ ।
saṃkalpadarśakāścāpi pārṣadāśca sthale sthale ।।75।।
vihitāḥ praśramiṇāṃ ca śramaghnāḥ pādavāhakāḥ ।
rājñaḥ raṃkasya ca hareḥ samarddhirbrāhmamaṇḍape ।।76 ।।
sādhūnāṃ praṇivāsāśca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca muktānīnāṃ kṛtāḥ śubhāḥ ।।77।।
maṇḍape vanavāsāśca kṛtāścāraṇyakālayāḥ।
sūtamāgadhabandīnāṃ mālayāśca tathā kṛtāḥ ।।78।।
tūryavatāṃ stāvakānāṃ vaidikānāṃ tathā''layāḥ ।
vidyānāṃ sarvakāmānāmālayāśca tathā kṛtāḥ ।।79।।
bhṛtyānāṃ diggajānāṃ cālayāśca phaṇināṃ kṛtāḥ ।
kacchapānāṃ ca śeṣāṇāṃ nirannānāṃ tathā''layāḥ ।।2.280.80।।
maharṣīṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ bhaktānāṃ brahmayoginām ।
sannyastānāṃ tathā cāva'dhūtānāmālayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।8 1।।
prajānāṃ bhinnavarṇānāṃ bhinnadeśanivāsinām ।
bhinnasvabhāvayuktānāṃ nivāsā maṇḍape kṛtāḥ ।।82।।
śītoṣṇādinivāsānāṃ yathāpekṣālayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpāṇāṃ yathāpekṣālayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।83।।
divyā'divyasvarūpāṇāṃ yathāpekṣālayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
māyikānāmamāyānāṃ yathādehālayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।84।।
vimānānāṃ mahāmārgā maṇḍape cāmbare kṛtāḥ ।
sopānarītimāśritya patsṛtayo'pi nirmitāḥ ।।85।।
lokānāṃ nāmasaṃjñāśca nivāsināṃ tathā'bhidhāḥ ।
pratigṛhaṃ kṛtāstatra naisargikā'kṣarātmikāḥ ।।86 ।।
yathā vede tathā cātra maṇḍape tvabhidhāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
aurṇānyāstaraṇādīni kauśeyāni mṛdūni ca ।।87।।
kaisarāṇi suvarṇāni raupyāṇi ca kṛtāni vai ।
pādapīṭhāni ramyāṇi siṃhāsanāni maṇḍape ।।88।।
kauśikāni ca vastrāṇi sattvamayāni tatra ca ।
ākṣarāṇi samastāni nihitāni sthale sthale ।।89।।
yāvanti bhakṣyabhojyāni lehyacośyāni sarvaśaḥ ।
peyasvādyāni sarvāṇi vahnipakvāni yāni ca ।।2.280.90।।
vanapakvāni sarvāṇi bharjitāni tathāpi ca ।
apakvapiṣṭacūrṇāni tāmbūlakāni yāni ca ।।9 1।।
mādakāni samastāni sarvapākāni sarvathā ।
rasapākāni sarvāṇi patrapākāni yāni ca ।। 6 ।।
kṣārapākāni ramyāṇi ghṛtapakvāni yāni ca ।
pāyasāni samastāni śārkarāṇi tathāpi ca ।।93।।
aikṣavāṇi samastāni kāndavikaiḥ kṛtāni ca ।
nihitāni caṭanyaśca sūpaśca pācakālaye ।।94।।
sarvaprakāramiṣṭāni madhūni vividhāni ca ।
gundrapākāni sarvāṇi nihitānyadanālaye ।। 95।।
rādhike! kimu vaktavyaṃ maṇḍape yatpradarśitam ।
brahmaloke viśiṣṭaṃ yadīśaloke viśiṣṭakam ।।96।।
satye svarge viśiṣṭaṃ yanmānave ca viśiṣṭakam ।
pātāle dhāmalokeṣu viśiṣṭaṃ ratnanāmakam ।।97।।
tatsarvaṃ nihitaṃ tatra maṇḍape maṇḍapātmanā ।
dīrghikā nihitāstatra sarāṃsi śobhanānyapi ।।98।।
tejomārgāśca vihitāḥ saccidānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
viduṣāṃ ca kathābhāgā vyākhyānamandirāṇi ca ।।99।।
sṛṣṭiṣu yāḥ sabhāsthalyo vikhyātāḥ sthānināṃ matāḥ ।
tāḥ sarvā darśitāścātra maṇḍape maṇḍapātmanā ।। 2.280.10 0।।
āścaryaṃ cādhikaṃ rādhe! mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tato'dhikam ।
pratyālayaṃ tu dehalyāṃ nihito yo maṇiḥ śubhaḥ ।। 101 ।।
yatra vilokyate svacchaḥ samastaḥ sarvamaṇḍapaḥ ।
tatrāpi maṇḍape dṛṣṭo maṇirmayā'paraḥ śubhaḥ ।। 1 02।।
yatra dṛṣṭaṃ mayā sṛṣṭitrayaṃ jaḍacidātmakam ।
sarvadhāmāni dṛṣṭāni sarveśvaraprabhūmayaḥ ।। 103 ।।
sarve'pi jīvalokāśca mayā dṛṣṭāḥ samastakāḥ ।
yatkiñcidvai mayā dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।। 1 04।।
dehalyāṃ vai maṇistatra maṇḍapastatra vai maṇiḥ ।
tatra sarvaṃ samāpannaṃ vaicitryaṃ cedameva hi ।। 1 05।।
na goloke na vaikuṇṭhe nā'nyadhāmasu tat khalu ।
vidyate vai mahāścaryaṃ svagṛhe sarvadarśanam ।। 1 06।।
ataevā'kṣaramuktāḥ sarvajñā vai bhavantyapi ।
pratyakṣadarśinaḥ sarve maṇyantarmaṇidarśinaḥ ।। 1 07।।
mayā te darśitaṃ rādhe! kathaṃ na smarthase'dhunā ।
ityetat kathitaṃ rādhe! maṇḍapasyā'bhirūpaṇam ।। 1 08।।
śrutvā'pi divyatāṃ yāyājjijñāsutāṃ mumukṣutām ।
muktatāṃ brahmatāṃ cāpi brahmavāsasya yogyatām ।। 1 09।।
nālpamatyā dhāraṇīyaṃ bhavedetatparātmanaḥ ।
maṇḍapasya svarūpaṃ vai sarvadhāmamayaṃ śubham ।। 2.280.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahāmuktakṛtamahāmaṇḍapadivyatāvarṇanaṃ nāmā'śītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 280 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 280 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 281
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 282 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
athaivaṃ maṇḍape jāte sarvalokasamujjvale ।
sūryatejāṃsi saurāṣṭrād vyavartantā'mbarād divaḥ ।। 1 ।।
maṇḍapasyaiva tejāṃsi saurāṣṭre dinatā vyadhuḥ। ।
rātrirdeśāntaraṃ yātā tejonissāritā tadā ।। 2 ।।
rātribhānaṃ tu lokānāmakṣarakṣetravāsinām ।
maṇḍapānniḥsaradbhiśca tejobhirānumānikam ।। 3 ।।
maṇḍapāntargatānāṃ tu maṇau yatsarvadarśanam ।
tadyadā jāyate naiva tadā niśā'numānakam ।। 4 ।।
yadā maṇau cāntarmaṇau prakāśante hi sṛṣṭayaḥ ।
tadā bhānaṃ divasasya jāyate bhānivāsinām ।। 5 ।।
ityevaṃ maṇḍape jāte kimāścaryaṃ harergṛhe ।
sarvaṃ vai ghaṭate tasya svalpa eṣastu maṇḍapaḥ ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ maṇḍapanirmāṇe tato'vādyanta tadgatāḥ ।
divyavādyaviśeṣāśca tathā laukikavādyakāḥ ।। 7 ।।
draṣṭuṃ tanmaṇḍapaṃ lokā āyayuśca samantataḥ ।
devā vai haṃsarūpāśca vyomnā''yayuḥ punaryayuḥ ।। 8 ।।
atha kuṃkumapatrīṃ ca lilekha bhagavatpitā ।
lomaśaṃ tu samāhūya nāradaṃ ca mahāmunim ।। 9 ।।
svataḥprakāśaṃ devaṃ ca papraccha tanmuhūrtakam ।
sūryodayottaraṃ sārdhaghaṭīdvayādanantaram ।। 2.281.1 0।।
pratipatrīmuhūrtaṃ ca vilokyā''huśca te trayaḥ ।
sarvavijayadaḥ kālo vartate'dya śubhāvahaḥ ।। 11 ।।
pravartate tu samayaḥ śubho likhatu patrikām ।
ityuktvā vipravaryāste svastimaṃgalamantrakān ।। 12।।
jagurvedagatān sūktān sarvamaṃgalaśobhanān ।
patraṃ ca lekhinīṃ cāpi dravapātraṃ ca paṭṭikām ।। 13 ।।
raktadravaṃ tathā sarve pūjayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakrurdhūpadīpā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।। 14।।
śrīviṣṇupūjanaṃ cakrustathā gopālapūjanam ।
tathā śrībālakṛṣṇasya cakrurvai pūjanaṃ tadā ।। 15।।
bālakṛṣṇaḥ pitṛyuktaḥ pūjayāmāsa tānapi ।
dattāsaneṣu ṛṣayo viprāścānye'pi mānitāḥ ।। 16 ।।
niṣeduḥ pūjyavargāste nāryo'gāyaँstu gītikā ।
kuṃkumapatrikāṃ cāmantraṇārthāṃ yogabodhikām ।। 17।।
alikhacchrīmahāviṣṇurgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ pitā ।
natvā devānṛṣīn vṛddhān smṛtvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 18।।
śrīmadbrahmapurādhipo hi bhagavān sarvāvatāreśvaraḥ,
śrīkṛṣṇaśca narāyaṇo'pi ca hariḥ śrīvāsudevaḥ śivaḥ ।
śrīviṣṇuśca narāgrajaśca dhavaladvīpasthanārāyaṇaḥ,
śeṣasthaśca harirgaṇeśvara ime kurvantu no maṃgalam ।। 1 9।
śrīmadbrahmasarūpiṇī bhagavatī sarvāvatāreśvarī,
śrīrādhā ca narāyaṇī ca hariṇī śrīvāsudevī śivā ।
śrīrlakṣmīḥ kamalā ramā ca dhavaladvīpasthanārāyaṇī,
sāvitrī ca sarasvatī vidadhatu dyusthāśca no maṃgalam ।।2.281.20।।
śrīkāntaḥ puruṣottamaśca vibhavā vyūhāśca dhāmādhipā,
lakṣmīśāśca tatheśvarāśca pitaraścārṣāḥ surāstatstriyaḥ ।
ādityā vasavo'śvinau digadhipā rudrāstrideveśvarā,
dampatyorgṛhadharmasaṃbhṛtamidaṃ tanvantu śaṃ maṃgalam ।।21 ।।
śrīkāśīnagarīśvarasya vibudhaiḥ saṃpūjitasyaiva ca,
śrīmacchrīnidhiśaṃkarasya tanujālakṣmyāḥ paraṃ maṃgalam ।
śrīkāśyāṃ bhavitā sutena tu mama śrībālakṛṣṇena vai,
mārge śuklacaturthikāniśi, sutogantā'kṣarakṣetrataḥ ।।22।
brahmāṇḍe tu caturmukhasya ca vidheḥ padmāsanasyaiva vai,
bhūloke'pi ca merudakṣiṇadiśākhaṇḍe hyajānābhike ।
āyāntveva surāṣṭrake sthitavato gopālakṛṣṇasya me,
khyāte kuṃkumavāpikākhyanagare tūrṇaṃ svakaiḥ saṃyutāḥ ।।23।।
adyā''dye'hni tu maṇḍapasya samayastāmbūlapānasya ca,
śvo bhāvi śrīmataḥ sutasya tu tanau satpiṣṭikāmardanam ।
tārtīye tu dine surā'rhaṇamatho yātrā ca kāśīṃ prati,
turye hastasamagraho hi bhavitā taddīpayantvarthaye ।।24।।
ye vai brahmasusṛṣṭigā'kṣarajanā dhāmādivāsāśca ye,
ye cāpīśvarasṛṣṭigāśca jaḍagāścā'ṣṭā''vṛtisthā api ।
ye vai jīvanasṛṣṭigāśca vividhā lokāśca lokādhipā,
rājānaśca nijāḥ prajāśca suhṛdaścāyāntu sambandhinaḥ ।।25।।।
svasvaiśvaryayutāḥ svabhṛtyasahitāḥ sarvānugaiḥ saṃyutāḥ,
svasvairdivyasamāśritaiśca sahitāḥ strīputraputrīyutāḥ ।
tattanmitrayutāḥ pramitrasahitāścābālavṛddhānvitā,
matputrasya sumaṃgale'bhita ihā''yāntveva śobhāvahāḥ ।।26।।
śreṣṭhaḥ śrībhagavān tadagraja iti bhrājan śukaścā'paraḥ,
śrīmadvallabhanāmako'nugaratiste bāndhavāḥ sarvathā ।
tadvaccānyakuṭumbino'pi ca vayaṃ sarvānpratīṣṭā'rthanāṃ,
kurmo yad bhavatāmavaśyamanaghe sandarśanaṃ stādiha ।।27।।
muktā brahmagatāśca dhāmasu gatā ye pārṣadāḥ śrīpate-
rīśeśādikadhāmagā api mahaiśvaryāśca muktāśca ye ।
brahmādyā'bhimatāśca siddhapuruṣāḥ santaśca ye sādhavo,
dampatyośca śubhaṃ sumaṃgalamayaṃ kurvantu śaṃ śāśvatam ।।28।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! tatrā'likhad gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
kuṃkumāktāṃ patrikāṃ cā'preṣayat sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ।।29।।
ṛṣīn brahmāṇḍagoleṣu muktānakṣaradhāmasu ।
nāradādīnīśalokeṣvapreṣayat pradāya ca ।।2.281.3 0 ।।
pūjitāṃ kuṃkumaiścāpyakṣataiḥ puṣpādibhistathā ।
puṭitāṃ parṇake cāpi dorakeṇābhiveṣṭitām ।। 31 ।।
tulasīpatrasaṃyuktāṃ koṭyarbudapratikṛtim ।
samādāya yayuḥ sarve tvājñaptāste manojavāḥ ।।32।।
daduśca kuṃkumapatraṃ prāpya satkāramāyayuḥ ।
maṇḍape'tra tadā rādhe! gopālakṛṣṇako dadau ।।33।।
dugdhapānaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ samutsave ।
samāgatān nṛpān bhaktān viprān lokān prajājanān ।।34।।
śreṣṭhinaścāpyanāthāँśca mahato'pi daridrakān ।
mānyān pūjyān vandanīyān vaiśyān dāsāँśca dāsikāḥ ।।35।।
bhṛtyān kāryakarāँścāpi sthāninastairthikānapi ।
āgantukān mahīmānān prasaṃgācca samāgatān ।।36।।
pānaṃ pūgīphalaṃ dugdhaṃ pāyasaṃ miṣṭamannakam ।
phalaṃ jalaṃ dalaṃ cāpi dadau gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।37।।
vādyante tatra vādyāni tūryāṇi vividhānyapi ।
gītikāścāpi jāyante sarvastrīṇāṃ ca maṇḍape ।। 38।।
āyānti ca prayāntyetya prāpya tāmbūlakādikam ।
saurāṣṭraṃ sarvameveti nagaraṃ ca samastakam ।।39।।
samāyādutsave tatra rādhe! tāmbūlakotsave ।
tāmbūladānakaṃ tatra dīyate satataṃ priye ।।2.281.40।।
bhojanārthaṃ paṃktayaścā'bhavan madhyāhnake'pi tu ।
maṇḍapaṃ vīkṣituṃ tatrā''yayuḥ sahasraśo janāḥ ।।41 ।।
te'pi sarve bhojanāni jagṛhuḥ śrīharergṛhe ।
mahīmānā nagarasthā deśebhya āgatā api ।।42।।
vardhayitvā bālakṛṣṇaṃ prāpya susvāgataṃ tataḥ ।
bhojanāni kṛtavanto viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ yayuḥ ।।43 ।।
brāhmaṇāśca tadanyāśca svāmino bhṛtyajātikāḥ ।
dīnā'nāthā bhikṣukāśca bhojanāni pracakrire ।।44।।
miṣṭānnāni pāyasāni kṣīrāṇi bhakṣyakāṇi ca ।
lāvaṇāni svādavanti bubhujire'titṛptikam ।।45 ।।
tāmbūlāni tathā pūgīphalāni prāpya vai tataḥ ।
āgantukā bhojanāni kṛtvā yānti nijālayam ।।46।।
mahīmānā ye'dya patryā''mantritā deśagā api ।
videśagāstathā bhinnalokagā bhinnasṛṣṭigāḥ ।।47।।
āgacchanti manovegā yoginastatra cotsave ।
maṇḍape te svādavanti madhuparkāṇi bhāvataḥ ।।48।।
tāmbūlakaṃ tathā labdhvā vilokya maṇḍapaṃ tathā ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ vardhayitvā gṛhītvā bhojanāni ca ।।49।।
militvā ca mahīmānān tato yāntyarpitā''sanam ।
tūryāṇāṃ ninadāścāvyāhatā jāyanta uttamāḥ ।।2.281.5 0 ।।
gītikāḥ kanyakānāṃ ca pravartante'pi sarvataḥ ।
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti ।।6 1 ।।
satkāraṃ gṛhyatāṃ ceti śabdā rodhaṃ vrajanti na ।
bhūmimārgād vāyumārgānmahīmānavrajāśca khāt ।।52।।
āyānti sma vimānādyairvāhanaiśca manojavaiḥ ।
mahanmaṇḍapamadhye tān gopālakṛṣṇasevakāḥ ।।53 ।।
nivāsayanti ca yathākalpiteṣu gṛheṣu vai ।
svāgatārthaṃ pārṣadāśca tiṣṭhanti satataṃ puraḥ ।।54।।
kanyakā dāsadāsāśca sevante kṛtinastadā ।
evaṃ vai rādhike! sāyaṃparyantaṃ pānadānakam ।।55।।
tāmbūlādeḥ pradānaṃ ca bhojanaṃ saṃvyavartata ।
tataḥ sandhyāvandanādi nīrājanaṃ harestathā ।।56।।
abhavacca tato rātrau mahotsavaḥ kṛto'bhavat ।
gāyakā vādyayuktāśca gāyanti tālamānataḥ ।।57।।
gāyanti gītikāścāpi gāndharvyo gāyikāstadā ।
nṛtyanti nṛtyakāriṇyaḥ suveṣāḥ sumanaḥpriyāḥ ।।58।।
apsaraso brahmasarasaśca gāyanti gītikāḥ ।
nṛsarasastathā paryo gāyanti nṛtyasaṃyutāḥ ।।59।।
kanyakā vividhā''yāmā bhinnabhaṃgīkṛtaśramāḥ ।
dehayaṣṭīḥ pravivṛtya darśayantyāsanīkalāḥ ।।2.281.6 0।।
evaṃ vai rādhike jāte tato rāsārthamāgatāḥ ।
raṃgamaṇḍapamadhye tāḥ kanyakā rāsamādadhuḥ ।।6 1 ।।
sarvāstāḥ samaveṣāśca samakāntisamāmbarāḥ ।
samabhūṣāḥ samabhāvā rāsayanti hi maṇḍape ।।6 2।।
vādikā vādayantyeva gāyanti gāyikāstathā ।
madhyapare nṛtyavatyau dve striyau nṛtyatastadā ।।6 3 ।।
anyāścakrabhrameṇaiva gāyanti ca bhramanti ca ।
hastatālīpradānaiśca pādanyāsaiśca vikramaiḥ ।।64।।
pṛṣṭhapādairvakrapādairvakradehaiśca maṇḍale ।
vakragrīvādibhiścāpi vakranetraiḥ ramanti ca ।।65।।
evaṃ rāse kṛte paścānmallāstatra samāyayuḥ ।
sabalāḥ śikharaprāyāḥ puṣṭā nādavinādinaḥ ।।6 6 ।।
svabhāvacañcalā pṛṣṭhakūrdanairhāsyakāriṇaḥ ।
maṇḍale maṇḍalākāre dvau dvāvājagmatustadā ।।67।।
yodhane cakratuścāpi vikarṣaṇā'pakarṣaṇaiḥ।
uttānakṣepaṇaiścāpi bhūmukhakṣepaṇādibhiḥ ।।68।।
svamukhakṣepaṇaiścāpi svāmyākarṣaṇakādibhiḥ ।
pṛṣṭhatāḍanakaiścāpi sakthitāḍanakaistathā ।।69।।
agre vegakṣepaṇaiścā'mbare kṣepaṇakaistathā ।
bhrāmaṇai recanaiścāpi pādabāhuprayodhanaiḥ ।।2.281.70।।
vakṣoyodhanakaiścāpi jayājayaparāyaṇaiḥ ।
gurubhāravahāścā'nye dantabhārapratolakāḥ ।।71 ।।
vakṣaḥpāṣāṇabhedāśca pṛṣṭhahastigamāstathā ।
kareṇaśakaṭīrodhāḥ skandhe daśajanāśrayāḥ ।।72।।।
ityevaṃ bahudhā bhedān mallāḥ pradarśayanti ca ।
tato yātā nāṭayakarā nepathyadhāriṇaḥ śubhāḥ ।।73 ।।
bālāśca bālikāścāpi cakrurnepathyamaṃgalam ।
nāṭakaṃ bālakṛṣṇasyā'vatārasya yathātatham ।।74।।
cakruḥ suśobhanaṃ cākarṣaṇakāri manoharam ।
vaikuṇṭhādāgamo yadvallakṣmyā nārāyaṇasya ca ।।75।।
śaṃbhoḥ sunartanaṃ cāpi pṛthvyāstale tathā''gamaḥ ।
lakṣmyāstapastathā śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya darśanam ।।76 ।।
evaṃ vai nāṭakaṃ purāvṛttaṃ cakrurharerhi te ।
nāṭyaraṃge vinirvṛtte vidvāṃsastatra cāyayuḥ ।।77।।
sūtāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaḥ kavayastathā ।
kāvyāni nūtanānyeva śrāvayanti samājake ।।78।।
nārāyaṇaguṇāँścāpi prācīnacaritānyapi ।
guṇāँśca duḥkhahālakṣmyāḥ satyāścāpi śivasya ca ।।79।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya kaṃbharāyā harestathā ।
athā'bhavan kathā ramyāḥ saṃhitāsu tu yāḥ sthitāḥ ।।2.281.80।।
tataḥ śrībālakṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ ca niśārdhake ।
abhavat pānadānādyairvastrāmbaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।।81 ।।
tāmbūlāni bhojanāni miṣṭapeyāni vai tadā ।
dadau gopālakṛṣṇaśca sarvaraṃgebhya eva ha ।।82।।
bālo vāpi pramatto vā dīno vā nā'vaśiṣyate ।
sarvairlabdhaṃ bhojanaṃ ca tāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇā ।।83 ।।
dadau kāryakarebhyaśca raṃgebhyo bhagavatpitā ।
pāritoṣikapātrebhyaḥ pāritoṣikamuttamam ।।84।।
svarṇarūpyakaratnāni maṇimauktikahīrakān ।
amūlyahārā''bhūṣāँścāmbarāṇi divyakānyapi ।।85 ।।
kaṇṭhasrajaḥ prakoṣṭhakasauvarṇakaṭakāni ca ।
mudrāścānyopakaraṇānyapi dadau hareḥ pitā ।।86 ।।
santuṣṭāstai darśakāstu raṃgaśobhākarā api ।
āyāsinaśca santuṣṭāḥ kalākauśalyaśālinaḥ ।।87।।
svasvavidyākalāpradarśakāstoṣamagurdhanaiḥ ।
dhanyā dhanyā vadantaśca nemuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca gopakam ।।88।।
pitaraṃ te praṇemuśca tathā nāryaḥ kalākriyāḥ ।
nartakyādyā gāyikāśca vastrabhūṣāmbarāṇyapi ।।89।।
pāritoṣikamāsādya ratnamauktikamālikāḥ ।
hīrakāँśca śāṭikāśca kañcukīḥ svarṇasūtrajāḥ ।।2.281.90।।
śṛṃgāropakaraṇāni samprāpya toṣaṇaṃ hyaguḥ ।
pītvā bhuktvā namaḥkṛtvā svasvāvāsaṃ yayustataḥ ।।91 ।।
mahīmānā yayuścāpi mahāmaṇḍapagālayān ।
pattanīyā yayurnaijālayān maharṣayaḥ kuṭīḥ ।।92।।
santo nijāśramāँścāpi bhṛtyāḥ svasvālayān yayuḥ ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo'pi kṛtvā sāttvikabhojanam ।।93।।
bhojayitvā gṛhajanān bālakṛṣṇādikāँstataḥ ।
parāvṛtyā'mūlyaveṣaṃ sāmānyaṃ veṣamāpya ca ।।94।।
viśrāntyarthaṃ yayau naije tvālaye nidrito'bhavat ।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi bhagavān nidrāmavāpa yoginīm ।।95।।
vādyānāṃ vādakāścāpi viramya bhojanāni ca ।
kṛtvā naijānālayāँśca prayayurnidritā api ।।96।।
kṣetrapālāḥ śaṃkarādyā bhuktvā ca devatāgaṇāḥ ।
svasvamandiramāsvādya viśrāntiṃ lebhire niśi ।।97।।
kāndavikāḥ sevakāśca parihārakarāstathā ।
karmacārāḥ prabhuktvaiva svasthāneṣu ca nidritāḥ ।।98।।
tadā rātrau rādhike! ye rakṣakāḥ pālakāḥ janāḥ ।
rātricarā jāgratāste kurvanti kṣetravīkṣaṇam ।।99।।
saśastrāścāpi vāhādyairbhramanti paritodṛśaḥ ।
jāgarūkā nidritānāmālayān rakṣayanti ca ।। 2.281.10 0।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! rātrirvyatītā cojjvalā hi sā ।
prātarjātaṃ sarvadivyamāṃgalyasaṃbhṛtaṃ punaḥ ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne likhitvā kuṃkumapatrikāyāḥ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu preṣaṇaṃ, tāmbūlapūgīphalādimahotsavaḥ rātrau gāyikānṛtyavādyanāṭyamallakāvyapāritoṣikabhojanādyutsavāḥ, parihāro nidrā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 281 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 281 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 282
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 283 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike'tha samunnidrā mahīmānā babhūvire ।
prātarmaṃgalavādyādyaiḥ sūtamāgadhagītibhiḥ ।। 1 ।।
bandījanānāṃ prastāvairnaisargikaiśca tūryajaiḥ ।
susvaraiśca yaśogānairjajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 2 ।।
caturghaṭikavāditrairbrāhmasmaraṇakārakaiḥ ।
kṛṣṇakīrtananādaiśca jajāgarurjanā prage ।। 3 ।।
saubhāgyastrījanagītaiḥ kanyakākṛtakīrtanaiḥ ।
gāyakānāṃ gāyanaiśca jajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 4 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre maṇḍalījanakīrtanaiḥ ।
vedikānāṃ stotrarāvairjajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 5 ।।
utsāhaiścintanairbhāvaiḥ śraddhābhiḥ sattvavṛttibhiḥ ।
pravartanābhiḥ saumyābhirjajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 6 ।।
antaryāmipreraṇābhiḥ premabhāvabharaistathā ।
vimānānāṃ garjanaiśca jajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 7 ।।
śakuntānāṃ kalaravaiḥ svapne kṛṣṇotsavekṣaṇaiḥ
gṛhapatnīgītikābhirjajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 8 ।।
dogdhrīṇāṃ vatsaraṃbhaiśca vāditrayantragāyanaiḥ ।
mahīmānā''gamaghoṣairjajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 9 ।।
puṇyānāṃ preraṇābhiśca cāñcalyavṛttibhistathā ।
kiṃjijñāsāpravegaiśca jajāgarurjanāḥ prage ।। 2.282.1 0।।
snātvā sandhyādikaṃ kṛtvā cāśvapaṭṭasarojale ।
kṛtaśṛṃgāraśobhāśca dvārṣu svastyādikān vyadhuḥ ।। 11 ।।
raṃgavallīrvyadhuścāpi prabhṛjya dadhicūrṇakaiḥ ।
āṃgaṇeṣu citravarṇatoraṇāni nyadhustathā ।। 1 2।।
dattakajjalanetrāśca kṛtakabarīveṣikāḥ ।
dhṛtabhūṣojjvalavastrā maṃgalāni striyo jaguḥ ।। 13 ।।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ viprāścakrurmaṇḍapapūjanam ।
śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ cakrurbālakṛṣṇasya pūjanam ।। 14।।
kuladevasya ca puruṣottamasya prapūjanam ।
cakruḥ śrīśaṃkarasyāpi sūryasyāpi ca pūjanam ।। 15 ।।
pūjanaṃ sarvatobhadradevānāṃ ca vyadhustataḥ ।
dhenunāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi kanyakānāṃ ca pūjanam ।। 16 ।।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ te vyadhustataḥ ।
nīrājanaṃ sunaivedyaṃ pradadurdakṣiṇādikam ।। 17।।
viprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ cakrurharidrāpūjanaṃ tathā ।
haridrāpiṣṭikāṃ nāryaścakruḥ sammṛdya granthikāḥ ।। 18।।
gandhasāraṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ kastūrikāṃ ca kaisaram ।
sugandhatailaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca miśrayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 1 9।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇasya snānārthaṃ tapanodakam ।
tīrthajalaṃ samājahrurnāryaḥ saubhāgyaśobhitāḥ ।।2.282.20 ।।
kanyakāḥ svarṇakalaśairājahruḥ salilaṃ śubham ।
savādyaghoṣagītaiśca samājahrurjalaṃ hi tāḥ ।।21 ।।
kānake svāsane nyasya prapūjya jaladevatām ।
ratnāni pañca nikṣipya sugandhidravyakaṃ tathā ।।22।।
devāँśca sāgarāँstatra tīrthānyāvāhya cāmṛtam ।
sudhāmāvāhya ca paṭṭe snāpayāmāsuracyutam ।।।23 ।।
mardayanti tadā nāryaḥ śarīraṃ sāṃgamujjvalam ।
koṭisūryasamābhaṃ ca koṭicandraśubhānanam ।।24।।
koṭividyutsamāṃgaṃ ca koṭigandhanivāsakṛt ।
koṭirūpabhṛtaṃ cāpi koṭirasaviśiṣṭakam ।।25 ।।
sarvasadguṇakośaṃ ca sarvalāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtam ।
sarvasaundaryapātraṃ ca sarvakāmaguṇāśrayam ।।26 ।।
sarvapuṣṭibharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
mardayāmāsuratyarthaṃ nirmalasya malāpahāḥ ।। 27।।
tailaiḥ sugandharasanairgandhidravyairmalāpahaiḥ ।
āmalakaistilapiṣṭaiḥ kṣāradravyaiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ।।28।।
mṛdubhirnavanītādyaiḥ kardamaiḥ pauṣṭikaistathā ।
sugandhacandanādyaiśca snapayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 29।।
atha kṣauraṃ yathāyogyaṃ nāpitaḥ pracakāra ha ।
tato'yaṃ madhunā sasnau śarkarāvāribhistataḥ ।। 2.282.3 0।।
dugdhena ca ghṛtenāpi dadhnā sasnau svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
tataśca madhunā cāpi punaḥ śarkarayā'pi ca ।।3 1 ।।
kṣāradravyeṇa ca tataḥ sasnau suganghibhistataḥ ।
tailaiḥ kastūrikābhiśca candanaiḥ kesaraistataḥ ।।32।।
piṣṭikāmardanaiścāpi sasnau campakabho'bhavat ।
evaṃ vai piṣṭikāsnānaṃ kṛtvā vastrāṇi cādadhau ।।3 3।।
bhūṣāmbarāṇi sarvāṇi tilakādīni candrakam ।
tataḥ siṃhāsane svarṇe niṣasāda prabhuḥ svayam ।।34।।
lokāstilakadānārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ harestadā ।
samāyānti tathā nāryo mahīmānāstathā'pare ।।35।।
evaṃ sampūjyate śrīmadbālakṛṣṇaḥ sapiṣṭikaḥ ।
sugandho'sya śarīrādvai niḥsasāra samantataḥ ।।36 ।।
sugandhitaṃ hi saurāṣṭraṃ tadā'bhavatpradūrataḥ ।
mahīmānāḥ samāyānti tvākāśayānatastadā ।।37।।
samantataḥ sarvadeśebhyaśca lokebhya ityati ।
śaṃkaraḥ kṣetrapālaśca nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ ।।38।।
bhagavān bhāvayiccāpi śukaścāsyā'nuvartanaḥ ।
svataḥprakāśo bhagavāँstathā santuṣṭikādikāḥ ।।39।।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca vyadhuḥ svāgatamutsukāḥ ।
bhojanāni pravartante dugdhapānāni cāpi vai ।।2.282.40।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi dīyante ca mahānasāt ।
paṃktayo'pi bhavantyeva sarvalokanivāsinām ।।41 ।।
bhuñjate premabhāvaiśca miṣṭānnāni bahūnyapi ।
lehyacoṣyāṇi sarvāṇi pralihanti rasānapi ।।।42।।।
pibanti dugdhapākādīn khādanti kṣārabharjitān ।
āsvādayanti dadhyādi navanītaghṛtānyapi ।।583।।
mallayikāḥ piṇḍakāँśca śaṣkulīrbhakṣayantyapi ।
amṛtāni sudhāsvādūnyapi pibanti bhāvataḥ ।।44।।
śākāni rūpabhedāँścaudanānyapi sugandhikāḥ ।
phullavaṭīrbhakṣayanti guptamiṣṭaprapolikāḥ ।।41।।
pūpānapūpān laḍḍūँśca khājakānmohanasthalān ।
meśubhān bahumiṣṭāँśca bhakṣayanti janāstadā ।।46।।
ghṛtakulyā dadhikulyā madhukulyā vahanti ca ।
pibanti pācanaśaktā bhakṣayanti ca bhoginaḥ ।।47।।
tattaddhāmanivāsānāṃ tattadyogyāni sarvathā ।
upasthāpyanta evātra lakṣmyādibhiśca kalpakaiḥ ।।48।।
kalpapātrādibhiścāpyakṣayapātrādibhistathā ।
tāmbūlakāni dīyante mukhācchakāni bhujyanu ।।49।।
jalapānaṃ tathā cūrṇaṃ mukhaśuddhikaraṃ śubham ।
tato yānti vāsamandirāṇi vai mahīmānakāḥ ।।2.282.50 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike tatotsavo bhavati śobhanaḥ ।
āyānti sarvatastatra mahīmānā hi koṭiśaḥ ।।51।।
brahmadhāmagatā muktāstathā dhāmetarasthitāḥ ।
sarvadhāmanivāsāśca muktāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।52।।
muktānyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyo brahmapriyāstathā''yayuḥ ।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca samutsukāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।53।।
avatārā'vatāriṇyastatrotsukāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
īśvarāṇāmīśvarāśceśvarāṇyaḥ prasamāyayuḥ ।।54।।
māyālokagatā muktā muktānyaśca samāyayuḥ ।
aṣṭāvaraṇamuktāśca tanmuktānyaḥ samāyayuḥ ।।55।।
satyalokagatā muktāḥ sādhavaśca maharṣayaḥ ।
brahmacaryaparāḥ santaḥ siddhāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।56।।
pitaro munayo vṛddhāḥ siddhānyaśca samāyayuḥ।
satyaḥ sādhvyo virāgiṇyo devyastatra samāyayuḥ ।।57।।
mātṛkā yoginīnāryyo yoginaśca samāyayuḥ ।
devā deveśvarāścāpi devatāśca samāyayuḥ ।।58।।
dhruvasthāścāpi nākṣatralokasthā grahavāsinaḥ ।
antarīkṣasthitāścāpi ṛṣimaṇḍalavāsinaḥ ।।59।।
sūryacandranivāsāśca devāstatra samāyayuḥ ।
brahmaputryo devaputryaḥ pitṛputryaḥ samāyayuḥ ।।2.282.60।।।
vidyudvāsā meghavāsā meruvāsāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālāśca puryaṣṭeśāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।61 ।।
bhuvarlokanivāsāśca vāyudehāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
gāndharvāścāraṇāḥ siddheśvarāśca tāpasā api ।।62।।
jalecarāḥ sthalecarā vyomacarāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
yakṣāśca rākṣasā bhaktā bhūtapretapiśācakāḥ ।।63 ।।
vaināyakāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vaiṣṇavāstatra cāyayuḥ ।
gṛhadevā grāmadevā vanadevāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।64।।
āraṇyakāstathā devā munayo mānavā api ।
gāndharvādyāstathā sarvāstāpasyaśca samāyayuḥ ।।65।।
siddhayo vasavaḥ sādhyāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃjanā api ।
vidyādhrāḥ kāmadevādyāstatpatnyaśca samāyayuḥ ।।66।।
dharmo dharmasya vaṃśaśca dharmapatnyaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
jātismarāḥ paśavaḥ tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ।।67।।
kīṭāḥ pataṃgakā vṛkṣā vallyastṛṇāni cāyayuḥ ।
kāmadughāḥ kalpalatā kalpapātrāṇi cāyayuḥ ।।68।।
rasāḥ śṛṃgārabhedāśca śāradā ca svarāstathā ।
guṇāścāyudhajātāni mūrtimanti samāyayuḥ ।।69।।
vidhayo yajñapuruṣā vahnayo vaiṣṇavāstathā ।
upacāropakaraṇānyāyayurmūrtimanti ca ।।2.282.70।।
nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca vāpyaḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsyapi ।
tīrthāni parvatāścāraṇyakāni tatra cāyayuḥ ।।7 1 ।।
cāturvarṇā janāścāpi narā nāryaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dakṣiṇātpūrvadeśācca prāgjyotiṣāt samāyayuḥ ।।72।।
uṣṇadeśāduṣṭrabhāgād brahmadeśāt samāyayuḥ ।
prācīnadeśāt piṃgācca jalapānāt samāyayuḥ ।।73।।
rāśiyānāt trivittācca samāyayuśca śāṃbhavāt ।
himadeśāt kāśmirāccoraladeśāt samāyayuḥ ।।74।।
kiṃpuruṣāt ketumālāccābdhidvīpebhya āyayuḥ ।
āraktāccā''briktadeśāt sāmudradvīpatastathā ।।75।।
uttarāttarkadeśāccāyayustatra mahotsave ।
ārārtrikapradeśācca bhūgarbhācca samāyayuḥ ।।76 ।।
uttarakurutaścāpi kenārakāttathā''yayuḥ ।
brāhmīlasaṃpradeśācca hārītakapradeśakāt ।।77।।
amarīkapradeśāccāyayustatra mahotsave ।
varāsanapradeśācca mākṣikākhyapradeśakāt ।।78।।
arajaskapradeśāccāyayuḥ sarve samutsukāḥ ।
sāmudradvīpavāsāścāyayurvimānagāminaḥ ।।79।।
rājāno bhṛtyavargāśca kanyakāpitaraśca ye ।
bālakṛṣṇaśvaśurādyāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ samāyayuḥ ।।2.282.80।।
ṛṣayo rāśayaścāpi nadā nadyaśca kanyakāḥ ।
smṛddhayaḥ siddhayaścāpi samantataḥ samāyayuḥ ।।8 1।।
atalādinivāsāśca devā daityāśca dānavāḥ ।
āsurā bhaktimantaśca bhaktāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।82।।
nāgāḥ sarpā diggajāśca śaktayaḥ sṛṣṭirakṣikāḥ ।
vedā vidyāḥ samastāśca kalāḥ sarvāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।।83।।
mātṛpakṣāḥ pitṛpakṣā duhitṛpakṣagāstathā ।
svasṛpakṣāvadhūpakṣāstattatsambandhinastathā ।।84।।
paramparāsu sambaddhāḥ sambandhinaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
śiṣyapakṣā bhaktapakṣāḥ ṛṣipakṣāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।85।।
mantrapakṣā deśapakṣāḥ prajāpakṣāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
kuṭumbasya pakṣīyāṇāṃ pakṣīyāṇā ca pakṣagāḥ ।।86।।
narā nāryo devadevyastatrotsave samāyayuḥ ।
sabhṛtyāḥ sasuhṛdaḥ samitrāḥ sānugāstathā ।।87।।
sayogāḥ savyavahārāḥ sahavāsāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkāntamādhavaḥ ।। 88।।
śrīkṛṣṇo vahate lakṣmīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ śivodbhavāṃ bhuvi. ।
śiveśvarasutā śrīśālakṣmīrnarāyaṇīsvayam ।।89।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe deve samarpyate ।
lakṣmīstaṃ tu sadā''ptā syāt śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 2.282.90 ।।
lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇārdhadehā ca kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇātmikā hi sā ।
kṛṣṇo lakṣmyardhadehaśca lakṣmīnārāyaṇo hi saḥ ।।9 1 ।।
kṛṣṇena saha kṛṣṇāyāścaikātmyaṃ jāyate bhuvi ।
aho gantavyamevā'pi suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 92।।
dhāmamuktāstathā ceśā devāśca mānavā api ।
āyāntyutsukahṛdayāḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।।93।।
bālā vṛddhā yuvānaśca tṛtīyaprakṛtisthitāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ samāyānti suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।94।।
saraḥsetau nāradena śrutaṃ pipīlikāvacaḥ ।
ālyo bhojyaṃ suprāpsyāmaḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।95।।
dharmarājasya dūtā vai śṛṇvanti narake giraḥ ।
mokṣaṃ śīghramavāpsyāmaḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 96।।
kārāgāravacāṃsyeva śrutavanto nirīkṣakāḥ ।
vibandhanamavāpsyāmaḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 97।।
sādhavaḥ śrutavantaśca bhikṣukāṇāṃ vacāṃsyapi ।
dānaṃ śreṣṭhamavāpsyāmaḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।98।।
nirdhanānāmṛṇavatāmaśrūyanta vacāṃsyapi ।
anṛṇatvamavāpsyāmaḥ suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।99।।
dāsānāṃ samaśrūyanta vacāṃsyutsāhavantyapi ।
pāritoṣikamāpsyāmaḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 2.282.1 00।।
sārthānāṃ mārgamāptānāṃ vārtāyāṃ śrūyate vacaḥ ।
śīghraṃ śīghraṃ pragantavyaṃ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 101 ।।
kanyākulāni cāyānti tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
vāhinyā samameṣyāmaḥ suyoge kṛpṇayoriti ।। 1 02।।
yādasāṃ snānakāle vai śrutaṃ vaco maharṣibhiḥ ।
vayaṃ bhakṣyamavāpsyāmaḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 103 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ samaśrūyanta vacāṃsi harṣajānyapi ।
śrāddhe tṛptimavāpsyāmaḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 04।।
hiṃsrakāṇāṃ vane vāco'śrūyanta niyamānvitāḥ ।
hiṃsitavyaṃ na saptāhe suyogaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 05।।
devānāmapyaśrūyanta dharmavāco'ṣṭavāsarāḥ ।
brahmacaryaparāḥ pālyāḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 06।।
paṇḍitānāmaśrūyanta vacāṃsi sotsukāni vai ।
sāma tatraiva gāsyāmaḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 09।।
karmaṭhānāṃ śrutā vāco yāsyāmo darśanāya ha ।
paddhati supraśikṣyāmaḥ suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 08।।
amaṃgalāni tattvāni vivadante parasparam ।
amāṃgalyaṃ vihātavyaṃ maṃgale kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 109 ।।
vadantyapaśakunāni militvā svasthale drutam ।
kusvabhāvo vihantavyaḥ prayoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 2.282.110 ।।
grahāścāpi vivadante krauryaṃ tyājyaṃ dināṣṭake ।
phalaṃ naiva pradātavyaṃ maṃgale kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 111 ।।
kaścid vṛddhaḥ śuṣkagātro vakrakaṭiḥ sayaṣṭikaḥ ।
śvasan śīghraṃ vadan yāti prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 12।।
kuṃkumapatrikāṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvalokanivāsinaḥ ।
sajjā bhavantyāgamārthaṃ prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 113 ।।
kāmadughā dhenavaśca savatsāḥ sotsukāḥ śanaiḥ ।
āyāntyaśvasaro ramyaṃ maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 14।।
svavyāpāraṃ samutsṛjya vyāpāriṇaḥ prayāntyapi ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetraṃ maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 11 5।।
karṣukāśca kṛṣiṃ tyaktvā nītvodyānaphalānyapi ।
prayāntyaśvasaro hṛṣṭā maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 116 ।।
sūtakino vratinaśca nirdhūya kṛcchrato hi tat। ।
yānti cāśvasaro hṛṣṭā suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 17।।
upadāḥ parikurvanti sarvalokanivāsinaḥ ।
dātavyā vai yathāśakti suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 118 ।।
asādhyaṃ sādhayitvā'pi gantavyaṃ maṇḍapaṃ drutam ।
iti gṛṇanti bhūtāni prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 119 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! vāco'śrūyanta bhagavatparāḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇādāsāṃ bhavet svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam । । 2.282.120 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne dvitīyāyāṃ prātarmaṃgaladṛśyāni devapūjanāni bālakṛṣṇasya piṣṭikāmardanaṃ snānaṃ śṛṃgāro mahīmānādīnāṃ bhojanā-
dīni sṛṣṭitrayāgamaḥ, kṛṣṇayormaṃgalayogajanyotsāhalābhādicetinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 282 ।।
