śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
madhyāhne ca yathā tadvad rātrau sadbhojanānyapi ।
abhavan sarvayogyāni bhuktvā pītvā jalādikam ।। 1 ।।
tāmbūlakaṃ samagṛhya rātrirañjanakāni vai ।
draṣṭuṃ raṃge gatāḥ sarve dṛṣṭavanto navān navān ।। 2 ।।
dṛśyān bodhyān kalākāṇḍān parihārottaraṃ tataḥ ।
nidrāṃ śāntiṃ jagṛhuśca tṛtīyāprātarāgamat ।। 3 ।।
brāhme muhūrte satataṃ maṃgalaistūryaniḥsvanaiḥ ।
gītibhirbandikavāgbhirjajāgaruśca dehinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
brahmāṇḍe yāni vādyāni tānyavādyanta tatra vai ।
snātā hṛṣṭāḥ kṛtasandhyāvandanāśca maharṣayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
āśīrvādān pradātuṃ vai bālakṛṣṇaṃ samāyayuḥ ।
kṛtasnānaṃ kṛtaveṣaṃ samāsīnaṃ parāsane ।। 6 ।।
dattāśīrvacanā viprāstilakaṃ candrakaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ cakruḥ kalaśasya prapūjanam ।। 7 ।।
nāndīśrāddhādikaṃ cakrurgurośca pūjanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
kuladevā'rhaṇaṃ cakrurvedaghoṣān vyadhustathā ।। 8 ।।
sarvatobhadradevānāṃ viṣṇośca pūjanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
dugdhapānādikaṃ cakrurmahīmānāḥ samantataḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhojanāni vyadhuścāpi prātarārabhya dehinaḥ ।
koṭyarbudābjapadmābjaparārdhajanatāstadā ।। 2.283.10 ।।
tṛtīye prahare kṛtvā parihāraṃ samantataḥ ।
śubhe muhūrte sajjāśca babhūvuḥ sarvatojanāḥ ।। 11 ।।
kāśīṃ prati pragantuṃ vai yogayātrānuyāyinaḥ ।
vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi tadā'bhavan ।। 1 2।।
śrṛṃgāritāni sarvāṇi sajjāni vāhanānyapi ।
vyomagānyeva sarvāṇi yogayātrātmakāni vai ।। 13 ।।
uddhoṣitaṃ varapitrā kāśīmāyāntu pāvanīm ।
yogayātrātmakāḥ sarve śiveśvaraḥ samīhate ।। 14।।
śaṃkaro gaṇayukto'tra kṣetraṃ pāsyati sarvathā ।
nagaraṃ cāśramāँścāpi maṇḍapādyaṃ ca pāsyati ।। 15 ।।
śrutvā sajjā babhūvuśca sarve vai mahīmānakāḥ ।
surāṣṭrīyaprajāgryāśca sṛṣṭyagryāśca samarhaṇāḥ ।। 16।।
sarvā brahmapriyāścāpi samastakṛṣṇayatnikāḥ ।
tāsāṃ pitrādikāḥ sarve sarvabhūminivāsinaḥ ।। 17।।
śṛṇu rādhe tadā''ścaryamabhūccamatkṛtipradam ।
vyomavāṇī spaṣṭabhāvā cāśrūyanta samantataḥ ।। 18।।
sṛṣṭitraye'pi yaiḥ kanyā dattā nijāḥ parātmane ।
pañcadaśasamāmadhye bālakṛṣṇāya śārṅgiṇe ।। 1 9।।
taiḥ sarvaistatra pitrādyairāgantavyaṃ dhruvaṃ yataḥ ।
tatra vai śāṃbhavīlakṣmyā yoge syurlagnitāśca tāḥ ।। 2.283.20।।
yāvatā vedavidhinā vidhinā mānavena ca ।
vāhneyavidhinā cāpi kanyādānavidhānataḥ ।। 21 ।।
nyūnatāparihārārthaṃ deśadharmānurodhataḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vidhānaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 22 ।।
sarvābhiścāpi kanyābhirlomaśāśramavṛttibhiḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntābhireva ha ।। 23।।
āgantavyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya vāhinyā samameva vai ।
svapitrādikuṭumbādyaiḥ sārdhaṃ rodho na vidyate ।। 24।।
śrutvā sarve janakāśca kuṭumbāḥ sarvavastubhiḥ ।
yogyopakaraṇaiḥ sarve nārīyuktāḥ samutsukāḥ ।।।25।
sajjā abhavan kanyāścā'bhavan sajjāḥ samastataḥ ।
lomaśo munayaścā'nye maharṣayaśca sādhavaḥ ।। 26।।
sajjā abhavan santaśca mahīmānāḥ samantataḥ ।
bhūṣāmbaravimānādyaiḥ sahitāḥ koṭiśo'pare ।।27।।
rādhe tadā tu kanyānāmānando na mamau tanau ।
sarvaśṛṃgārabhūṣādipeṭāyuktāḥ samantataḥ । । 28 ।।
sajjā abhavaँstūrṇaṃ vai kṛṣṇālayaṃ samāyayuḥ ।
kanyānāṃ pitaraścāpi mātaro'pi drutaṃ tadā । । 29 । ।
kṛṣṇālayaṃ samāgatya kanyā''gamaṃ sahā'pi ca ।
vāhinyā ca praniścikyurbabhūvurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ । । 2.283.30 । ।
śakunānyabhavaँstatra sarveṣāṃ tu tadā muhuḥ ।
śubhānyeva hi sarvāṇi sarvāsāmapi santi ca । । 31 ।।
śreṣṭhayogapradānyeva yaśaḥkīrtikarāṇyapi ।
avighnakāryaphalakānyabhavan sūcanāni ca ।। 32। ।
prasannānanavatyaścā''nandabhṛtāḥ savatsakāḥ ।
dugdhasrāvaṃ pramuñcantyo militāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ । । 33 ।।
sarvaśṛṃgārabhūṣāḍhyāḥ sarvānandapariplutāḥ ।
kanyakā militaścāpi militā vārayoṣitaḥ । । 3 4।।
saphalārdrāṇi sasyāni dadhi gajāḥ subhūṣitāḥ ।
sā'mbālikā rājarājñīyuktāstatra samāgatāḥ ।। 35 । ।
haṃsāśca rājahaṃsāśca kanyakāśca jalānvitāḥ ।
gāndharvyo militāścāpi gāyantyaḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ ।। 36 ।।
devānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi pratyakṣaṃ cā'mbare'bhavat ।
lakṣmīnāṃ kamalānāṃ ca darśanānyabhavaँstadā ।। 37 ।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninadāścā''śrūyanta maṃgalāvahāḥ ।
yajñahomā vedamantrā aśrūyanta śubhāvahāḥ । । 38 ।।
svābhāvikaṃ cā'bhavacca śvetavastupradarśanam ।
dakṣiṇā vahnayaścāpyanukūlā vāyavo'bhavan ।। 39 ।।
gurvāśīrvādavācaścā'bhavaँstatrā'tiśobhanāḥ ।
kṛtavastūpasaṃgrāhāḥ sarve narāśca yoṣitaḥ ।। 2.283.40 । ।
kuṃkumavāpikāsaṃsthāḥ kṛtabhojanapānakāḥ ।
kṛtopahārāḥ sadveṣāḥ kuṭumbasahitā janāḥ । । 41 । ।
mahīmānāḥ sarvavargāḥ sabhṛtyamitrabāndhavāḥ ।
sajjā babhūvuḥ śīghraṃ te sajjavimānakoṭayaḥ । । 42 । ।
atha maṃgalaśaṃkhasya pāñcajanyasya vai tadā ।
yātrāmukhe ninādo'bhūd vidhaye maṃgalāya vai । । 43 ।।
tadā gopālakṛṣṇo vai dadau dānāni koṭiśaḥ ।
kanyābhyaścāpi viprebhyo bālebhyaśca viśeṣataḥ ।।44। ।
miṣṭānnāni śarkarāśca phalāni vividhānyapi ।
vastrābhūṣāśca pātrāṇi ratnāni ca dhanāni ca ।। 45 । ।
godānāni svarṇarūpyapradānāni tadā dadau ।
yātrāmukhe gaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ pracakāra ha । । 46 ।।
sarvatobhadrapūjā ca vṛddhānāṃ pūjanaṃ namaḥ ।
kuladevasya ca tathā puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।। 47 ।।
śrīviṣṇordarśanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ vai śriyāstathā ।
cakāra tatra dānāni dadāvasaṃkhyakānyapi । । 48 । ।
tīrthadevānnamaskṛtya dvāradevānapūjayat ।
gāḥ sampūjya tato yānaṃ vimānaṃ samapūjayat । ।4 9 । ।
vaidikāँścā'pūjayacca bālakṛṣṇo'pi vai tadā ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharo mukuṭaśobhitaḥ । । 2.283.5 0 । ।
sakuṇḍalo'bhavaddhaste svarṇakhaḍgadharo'bhavat ।
varaveṣo'bhavattūrṇaṃ hīrahārādiśobhitaḥ । ।5 1 ।।
sarvakauśeyasauverṇaveṣo'bhavad varottamaḥ ।
kṛtakuṃkumatilakaḥ suvāsitasugandhavān ।। 52 । ।
prakoṣṭhabāhukaṭyaṃgāṃ'gulībhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।
kṛtā'kṣatā'nvitacandraḥ śuśubhe tejasā'nvitaḥ । ।53 ।।
mātā śrīkaṃbharālakṣmīstilakaṃ tasya saṃvyadhāt ।
santuṣṭākhyā svasā candraṃ vyadhād kaṇṭhe srajaṃ dadau । । 54 । ।
maṇimauktikahārāँścojjayinī śukapatnikā ।
nyadhārayaddhareḥ kaṇṭhe'mṛtā ca kajjalaṃ dadau । । 55 । ।
cakṣuṣoḥ, śaṃvatī keśānasādhayat satailakān ।
ramā'laktakamevā'pi karayośca tale dadau । । 56 ।।
padayośca tale'laktakamarpayaddhi māṇikī ।
lakṣmīḥ kamalahārāँśca svarṇahārān dadau tadā । । 57 ।।
hāsā dadau puṣpagucchaṃ keyūraṃ mañjulā dadau ।
ambā tejomaṇiṃ cakre sugandhaṃ saguṇā'kṣipat । । 58 ।।
evaṃ vibhūṣayitvaiva brahmapriyāstathā'parāḥ ।
kanyakā kṛtaveṣāśca sajjā bhūtvā vyavasthitāḥ । । 59 । ।
tathā'nye bhrātaraścāpi gopālakṛṣṇapūrvajāḥ ।
anye cāpi bhrātaraśca bālakṛṣṇasya pitṛjāḥ । । 2.283.60 । ।
kanyakāḥ śataśaścāpi bālāśca bālikāstathā ।
putrapautrā svasāraśca sambandhinaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
sajjā babhūvustūrṇaṃ te kṛtapānādanāstadā । । 61 । ।
rājāno ye pitarau vai kanyakānāṃ ca bhūmipāḥ ।
te'pi sajjā abhavaँśca kṛtapānādanāḥ khalu । । 6 re ।।
tāvadbherīninādo'bhūcchaṃkhanādastathā'bhavat ।
vimāneṣu samārohasūcako lambagarjanaḥ । । 63 ।।
tadā gopālakṛṣṇaśca lakṣmīḥ śrīkambharāsatī ।
kuṭumbaṃ suvimāne vai cāruroha savastukam ।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāścāruruhuśca vimānakam । । 64। ।
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaścāruruhuḥ suvimānakam ।
sādhavo'śvapaṭṭavāsāścāruruhurvimānakam ।।65।।
kuṃkumavāpikālokāścāruruhurvimānakam ।
rājā svarṇāṃgado'pyāruroha savaṃśavistaraḥ ।।66।।
raṇaṃgamo'pyāruroha lakṣmaṇaścāruroha vai ।
tīrthadevāścāruruhuścāruruhuḥ prajājanāḥ ।।67।।
mahīmānāścāruruhurvimānānyayutānyapi ।
śṛṇu rādhe'gragaṇyānāṃ nāmānyapi samāsataḥ ।।68।।
meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi ca sajjitāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhī yā manasādevī bālarakṣākarī sadā ।।69।।
tasyā rūpāṇi kanyā vai dīpāvalyo hi koṭiśaḥ ।
tāḥ sajjāśca vimāno vai lomaśasyā''śramāttadā ।
āruruhuḥ kṛtaveśāḥ sotsāhāścācyutā''jñayā ।।2.283.70 ।।
talājā yā talaputrī rākṣasī divyatāṃ gatā ।
sā'pi vimānamevā'trā''ruroha mādhavā''jñayā ।।71।।
kāmadhenvātmakakanyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā vimānakam ।
āruruhustadā tatra bālakṛṣṇājñayā drutam ।।72।।
vasumatyā samaṃ kanyāśatamarjantarakṣasaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇājñayā tadā ।।73।।
āruroha harakanyā krodhanā mādhavājñayā ।
dharāputryo'yutasahasrāṇi dharāsamanvitāḥ ।।74।।
koṭisaṃkhyā gahvarākhyāścāruruhurvimānakam ।
sarvābharaṇavastrāḍhyā divyāḥ protsāhitāstadā ।।75।।
sūcyākhyā vedhasaḥ putrī vimānamāruroha ca ।
vanadevīsutāḥlakṣaṃ cāruruhurvimānakam ।।76।।
vanadevyā samaṃ mātrā oṣadhyākhyā hi kanyakāḥ ।
damanādirakṣasāṃ ca nūtnākhyā lakṣakanyakāḥ ।।77।।
āruruhurvimānaṃ ca bhūṣāmbarādibhūṣitāḥ ।
kaṃkatālyo nūtanāḥ ṣaṭ cāruruhuśca kanyakāḥ ।।78।।
kaṃkatālādināryaśca divyā'yutasukanyakāḥ ।
āruruhurvimānaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।।79।।
aryamādikapitṝṇāṃ divyāśca lakṣakanyakāḥ ।
pitṛyuktā niṣeduśca vimāne suvibhūṣitāḥ ।।2.283.80 ।।
rasātalīyadaityānāṃ pañcasahasrakanyakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇājñayā cāruruhurvimānaṃ suvibhūṣitāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
vāsantikyaḥ kanyakāśca vibhūṣitāśca ṣoḍaśa ।
āruruhurvimānaṃ vai bālakṛṣṇājñayā tadā ।।।82।।
tālamālasya daityasya kanyāḥ pañcaśatāni ca ।
svalaṃkṛtāḥ kṛṣṇavākyāccāruruhurvimānakam ।। 83 । ।
nāgakanyā viṃśatiśca tathā daśasahasrakam ।
svalaṃkṛtāścāruruhurvimānaṃ mādhavājñayā । । 84 । ।
śāvadīnasya vai kanyāsahasraṃ suvibhūṣitam ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇājñayā tadā । । 85 । ।
aindrajālikakanyānāṃ sahasraṃ ca vimānakam ।
āruroha tadā kṛṣṇājñayā śṛṃgāraśobhitāḥ ।। 86 । ।
sarasvatī tathā caturdaśavidyākhyakanyakāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭikanyāstathā'nyāścāruruhuśca vimānakam । । 87 ।।
bhūgarbhāccāgatastatra rājā lakṣmaṇanāmakaḥ ।
so'pi vimānakaṃ cāruroha naijaṃ parottamam । । 88 । ।
svakīyadvisahasrakanyakābhiḥ saha vai drutam ।
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi kanyakā nāḍikābhidhāḥ । । 89 । ।
vedhasaḥ putrikāścāruruhurnijavimānakam ।
viśvāvasuḥ svakanyābhistriśataiśca vimānakam । । 2.283.90 । ।
āruroha tadā kṛtaśṛṃgārābhiḥ samutsukaḥ ।
sahasraṃ kanyakā jumāsemlārājño vimānakam । । 91 । ।
āruruhuḥ svapitrā ca kṛtaśṛṅgāraśobhanāḥ ।
śataṃ kanyāḥ sauratyaśca vipraiḥ pitṛbhireva tāḥ । । 92 । ।
sahitā bhūṣitāścāpyaruruhuśca vimānakam ।
mahābāleśvarīkanyātrayaṃ pitrā samaṃ tadā । । 93 । ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca svalaṃkṛtaṃ vibhūṣitam ।
dakṣajavaṃgaro rājā uṣṇālayasya bhūpatiḥ । । 94 । ।
svakanyāśatakaṃ ramyaṃ prajākanyāsahasrakam ।
gṛhītvā cārurohāpi vimānaṃ suvibhūṣitam । । 95 । ।
aryamṇo viṃśatikanyā anyā daśasahasrakam ।
aryamṇā saha sarvāstāścāruruhurvimānakam । । 96 । ।
prācīnabhvāḥ prajākanyāḥ koṭirevā'pi bhūṣitāḥ ।
svasvapitṛyutāścāruruhurdivyaṃ vimānakam । । 97 । ।
santāraṇasya viprasya kanyādvayaṃ vibhūṣitam ।
vimāne ca samāruruhatuḥ pitrā samaṃ sute । । 98 । ।
ityevaṃ rādhike kanyā lomaśāśramasaṃsthitāḥ ।
pitrādibhirlomaśenarṣibhirmātrādibhistathā । । 99 । ।
kṛṣṇakāntājñayā tūrṇaṃ niṣedurvyomavāhane ।
śṛṅgāritāḥ sotsukāśca prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti । । 2.283.100 । ।
nijāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ manyamānāḥ kṛṣṇārthaṃ kṛtakā'rpaṇāḥ ।
kṛṣṇā'vinābhāvabaddhāḥ prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti । । 101 । ।
utsāhasaṃbhṛtāḥ sarvā vāhinyā kṛtayatnikāḥ ।
jagurnijotsavā''nandāḥ prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 02।।
athā'nyā api kanyāścāruruhuśca vimānakam ।
kathayiṣye rādhike te kṛṣṇakāntā vibhūṣitāḥ ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥkṛtyāni, madhyāhnabhojanādīni, tataḥ kāśīṃ prati maṃgalayogayātrārthaṃ sajjatā,
śrīhariśṛṅgāraḥ, māṃgalikakartavyāni, brahmapriyādkinyakānāṃ vimānādhirohaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 283 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 283 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 284
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 285 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu rādhe! rāśiyānādikadeśodbhavā api ।
kṛṣṇakāntāḥ kanyakāścāruruhuryad vimānakam ।। 1 ।।
śibidevo nṛpaḥ kanyāśatena saha vai tadā ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ kuṭumbādisamanvitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tharkūṭastho mahārājaḥ pañcāśatkanyakānvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ varayātrārthamutsukaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vīrajāro mahārājaḥ śatakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ varayātrārthamutsukaḥ ।। 4 ।।
śaktyakṣikṣmāpatiścāpi ṣaṣṭikanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
ekādhikaśatapiśācinīkanyāyutastathā ।। 5 ।।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ varayātrārthamutsukaḥ ।
kālimāśanṛpakanyāḥ śate dve ca vimānakam ।। 6 ।।
pitṛbhyāṃ sahitāḥ sarvāścāruruhurvibhūṣitāḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ca rādhikām ।। 7 ।।
māṇikyāṃ śrīṃ ramāṃ lakṣmīṃ padmajāṃ ca vimānake ।
ambāṃ hāsāṃ sadguṇāṃ mañjulāṃ cāpi vimānake ।। 8 ।।
parāvidyādikāścāpi catvāriṃśat śataṃ tathā ।
nyaṣādayad vimāne vai sarvaśṛṅgārapūrvakam ।। 9 ।।
uralaketuko rājā triṃśatkanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
vimānaṃ subhagaṃ cādhyarohad yātrārthamuttamam ।। 2.284.10 ।।
krathako nṛpatiḥ pañcakanyāyuto vimānakam ।
āruroha tathā saumyo kāśīyātrārthamuttamam ।। 11 ।।
pṛthurājastadā naijaṃ vimānaṃ cāruroha vai ।
viṃśatikanyakābhiśca sahito yātrikottamaḥ ।। 1 2।।
uṣṭrālasya daśakanyā āruruhurvimānakam ।
haṃkāranṛpatiḥ kanyāpañcakena samanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrārthameva saḥ ।। 1 3।।
jayakāṣṭhalanṛpatiḥ pañcakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrākṛte tadā ।। 14।।
tīrāṇanṛpatiḥ kanyāṣaṭkenāpi samanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrārthameva tu ।। 15।।
ālvīnaraḥ pañcakanyāyuto vimānamuttamam ।
āruroha kāśīyātrākṛte kuṭumbavāँstathā ।। 16।।
jīnavarddhinṛpaḥ saptakanyāyuto vimānakam ।
āruroha kāśīyātrākṛte tatra samutsukaḥ ।। 17।।
anāthaviprastatraikakanyayā saha vai tathā ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca rathayātrākṛte tadā ।। 18।।
rākṣasebhyo mocitā yā prakīrṇakāstu kanyakāḥ ।
āruruhurvimānāni śate dve ca sahasrakam ।। 1 9।।
alpaketurnṛpaḥ saptakanyābhiśca vimānakam ।
jayakṛṣṇavarājarṣiścaikakanyāyutastathā ।।2.284.20।।
samāruruhatuścaikaṃ vimānaṃ varayātrikam ।
parīśāno nṛpaścaikaviṃśatikanyakāyutaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃbhṛtam ।
indurāyo nṛpaḥ kanyādvayayukto vimānakam ।। 22।।
ārurohātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃbhṛtam ।
mudrāṇḍo nṛpatiḥ pañcadaśakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।। 23 ।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca yogayātrākṛte tadā ।
gaṇḍarājo navakanyāyuto vimānamuttamam ।।24।।
āruroha samṛddhaṃ ca kāśīyātrārthamityapi ।
līnorṇanṛpatiḥ kanyācatuṣṭayasamanvitaḥ ।।25।।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kṛṣṇayātrārthamutsukaḥ ।
vṛhaccharākhyo nṛpatiścaikādaśasutāyutaḥ ।।26।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca yogayātrākṛte tadā ।
balalīno nṛpaścatvāriṃśatkanyāsamanvitaḥ ।।27।।
smṛddhaṃ naijaṃ vimānaṃ cādhyāruroha vibhūṣitam ।
varasiṃho nṛpaḥ kanyāpañcakena samanvitaḥ ।। 28।।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrākṛte tadā ।
rāyagāmalabhūpaśca pañcakanyāyutastadā ।। 29।।
āruroha vimānaṃ cā'parakanyātrayā'nvitaḥ ।
smṛddhaṃ rājñīdvayaṃ cāpyāruroha ca vimānakam ।।2.284.3 0 ।।
phenatantunṛpaḥ kanyādvayayukto vimānakam ।
āruroha tadā smṛddhaṃ kāśīyātrārthameva ha । । 31 । ।
stokahomanṛpaścaikakanyāyukto vimānakam ।
āruroha samṛddhaṃ ca kāśīyātrākṛte tadā । । 32 । ।
kāṣṭhayānanṛpasyā'pi kanyaikā janakānvitā ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca susmṛddhaṃ yogayātrikam । । 33 । ।
kolakakṣmāpateḥ kanyā caikā tadā vimānakam ।
āruroha susamṛddhaṃ kāśīyātrākṛte tadā । । 3 4। ।
ityevaṃ rādhike gauryaḥ kṛṣṇakāntārthameva tāḥ ।
utsukāḥ kṛtaśṛṃgārā vibhūṣitā mudaṃ yayuḥ । । 35 । ।
dinamānārkanṛpatiḥ kanyādvayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ yogayātrāprasiddhaye । । 36 । ।
rāyakinnararājaśca sarvasmṛddhe vimānake ।
ārurohaikapañcāśatkanyābhiḥ smṛddhiśobhanaḥ । । 37 । ।
rāyarokīśvaro rājā caikaviṃśatikanyakāḥ ।
ādāya svavimānaṃ ca samāruroha vai tadā । । 38 । ।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaśca viṃśatikanyakāyutaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ smṛddhaṃ yātrārthamuttamam । । 39 । ।
rāyavākakṣako rājā kanyātrayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ divyayātrārthameva ha । । 2.284.40 । ।
rāyamārīśabhūpaśca kanyātrayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ smṛddhaṃ yātrārthameva ca । । 41 । ।
rāyabaleśvaro rājā kanyātrayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ kāśīyātrārthamutsukaḥ । । 42। ।
rāyalambārabhūpaśca kanyāṣaṭkayutastadā ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ yātrākṛte tadā । ।43 । ।
rāyanavārkabhūpaśca kanyakāsaptakā'nvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ smṛddhaṃ yātrākṛte tadā । ।44। ।
rāyahuṇḍeśabhūpaśca navakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca sarvasmṛddhibhṛtaṃ tato । ।45 ।।
rāyakūpeśabhūpaśca hyekakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrārthamityatha । । 46 । ।
kālīmaṇḍalīnabhūpaścatasṛkanyakāyutaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ yātrārthamuttamam ।। 47 । ।
vanajeleśabhūpaśca pañcakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
samāruroha ca tadā vimānaṃ śobhanaṃ svayam । । 48 । ।
pārāvārapibakṣmeśaḥ kanyātrayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca sarvasmṛddhibhṛtaṃ tadā । । 49 । ।
atha koṭīśvaro rājā kanyādvayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca sarvasmṛddhaṃ tadā śubham ।।2.284.50 ।।
śrīsatīśanṛpakanyāstisraḥ pitrā samaṃ tadā ।
āruruhurvimānaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ yātrārthakaṃ śubham ।।51 ।।
tretākarkaśarājaśca saptakanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ yātrākṛte tadā ।।52।।
āṇḍajarānṛpaścāpi catuḥkanyāsamanvitaḥ ।
kāśīyātrākṛte naijaṃ vimānaṃ cāruroha ca ।।53 ।।
bālyarajonṛpaścaikakanyāyukto vimānakam ।
āruroha tadā smṛddhaṃ kṛṣṇayātrākṛte śubham ।।54।।
rāyasomanabhūpaśca kanyātrayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kṛṣṇayātrākṛte tadā ।।55।।
urugavākṣanṛpatiḥ kanyādvayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ svaṃ smṛddhaṃ yātrākṛte tadā ।।56 ।।
parāṅavratastathā bhūpaḥ kanyādvayasamanvitaḥ ।
āruroha vimānaṃ ca kāśīyātrākṛte tadā ।।57।।
īśānapānarājā ca smṛddhaṃ nijaṃ vimānakam ।
āruroha caikacatvāriṃśatkanyāsamanvitaḥ ।।58।।
rājā rāyapatirbhūpaḥ ramṛddhaṃ nijaṃ vimānakam ।
trayastriṃśatsutābhiśca sahāruroha yātrikam ।।59।।
rājārāyanṛpasyāpi bhaginī svavimānakam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnī samāruroha kanyakā ।।2.284.6 0 ।।
maṃgalā lalitā revā bhārgavī ca sarasvatī ।
ramā gaṃgā dayā bhaktirmuktiścaikādaśī ratiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
kāmadughā ca tulasī kamalā virajā satī ।
mūrtiśca gomatī svarṇarekhā jayā ca nandinī ।।62।।
vanitā mohinī dolā puṣpā prītiḥ kalāvatī ।
mādhavī badarī campā kuśalā ca manurmaṇiḥ ।।63 ।।
śāntiḥ śāntā ramā haimī ūrjā vimānamāsthitāḥ ।
lomaśena śamaṃ anyāścāpi vibhūṣitāḥ ।।64।।
uktānāṃ cāpi sarvāsāṃ sakhyaścāpyarbudā hi tāḥ ।
vibhūṣitā hi kauberyo māhendryo yamakanyakāḥ ।।65।।
vāyavyo vaiśvakarmyaśca vārkṣyo raudryaśca vahnijāḥ ।
śrāvaṇyaścāpi khānijyaḥ sāṃvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ ।।66।।
prācīnyaśca piśaṃginyo rāśiyānyaḥ samuṣṭrikāḥ ।
romāyanyaśca pāraśyo dhaivaryaḥ kinnarīgaṇāḥ ।।67।।
amaryaśca tathā gauryaḥ paryo hāritikāstathā ।
ābriktyaścāpi pātālyaḥ svargyaścāpsarasastathā ।।68।।
brahmasarasau gāndharvyo'rbudakanyāśca bhūṣitāḥ ।
lomaśena samaṃ svasvapitrā samaṃ vimānakam ।।69 ।।
āruruhuḥ svaṃ svamarghyaṃ smṛddhaṃ sāmagrikā'nvitam ।
ityevaṃ rādhike kṛṣṇakāntāḥ sajjāstadā'bhavan ।।2.284.70 ।।
athā'nye kṛṣṇayātrāyāmāgatā mahīmānakāḥ ।
hemaśālāyanādyāścarṣayaḥ sedurvimānakam ।।71 ।।
cakravākyurvaśī cāpi hanumān samagastyakaḥ ।
maṃkaṇakādyāḥ ṛṣayo devāyatanako'pi ca ।।72।।
meṣāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayo munirlālāsanaḥ pradhīḥ ।
pañcasāhasrasantaśca tathā vṛkāyanādayaḥ ।।73 ।।
yavakrītādayaścāpi śvetavyāsādayastathā ।
sanatkumāraprabhṛtayo niṣeduśca vimānakam ।।74।।
tuṣitaśca hāritaśca divimānāyanādikāḥ ।
kuśalā yoginī cāpi sāṃkhyayogina ityapi ।
śāvadīnā mahākālī vārinaraśca kṣetrapaḥ ।।75।।
āryāyanādyāḥ ṛṣayo dvārapo brahmanādakaḥ ।
vaśiṣṭādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca vālakhilyādikāstathā ।
āruruhurvimānāni kṛṣṇayātrākṛte tadā ।।76।।
rādhike! cā'kṣaramuktā muktānyaśca samantataḥ ।
avatārāḥ samastāścā'vatāriṇyastathā tadā ।।77।।
āruruhurvimānāni sarvaśṛṃgārabhūṣitāḥ ।
pārṣadā dhāmagāḥ sarve tathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।78।।
vāsudevādayaścāpi bhūmā viṣṇurvirājakaḥ ।
sāttvikā munayaścāpi siddhāśca sādhavastathā ।।79।।
āruruhurvimānāni susmṛddhāni vibhūṣitāḥ ।
pitarastvaryamādyāśca lokapālā diśāṃ prapāḥ ।।2.284.80।।
ādityā vasavaścāpi kumārāvaśvinau tathā ।
āruruhurvimānāni kṛṣṇayātrākṛte tadā ।।8 1 ।।
marutaḥ siddhayaścāpi nidhayaśca grahāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sūryācandrau saptarṣayo dhruvau ca mātaro diśaḥ ।।82 ।।
kāmadevo manavaśca kalāśca tithayastathā ।
tattvāni bhāni ca guṇāstīrthāni sarito nadāḥ ।।83 ।।
brahmacārā nyāsavanto divyadevākhyapādapāḥ ।
kalpavallyaḥ kalpaśilā gṛhadevādayastathā ।।84।।
devālayāstathā caityāścāruruhurvimānakam ।
nāgāḥ sarpāśca daityāśca dānavā rākṣasāstathā ।।85।।
sūtāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaścāraṇāstathā ।
viprāśca paṇḍitāścāpi kiṃpuṃsaḥ kinnarāstathā ।।86।।
gāndharvāḥ kathakāścāpi dāsā dāsyaśca koṭiśaḥ ।
āruruhurvimānāni sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhanāḥ ।। 87।।
śilpinaḥ svarṇakārāśca dhanāḍhyā makhinastathā ।
guravo lomaśoktāśca sarvā kuṃkumavāpikā ।।88।।
āruruhurvimānāni prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।
mahī tatra samāyātā saṃsmṛtā medinī svayam ।।89।।
ṛtavaśca samāyātā dharmadevaḥ svayaṃ smṛtāḥ ।
naraścāpi samāyāto badarīvanatastadā ।।2.284.90 ।।
pīṭhikā ca samāyātā devī tvakṣaravāsinī ।
mardanāni sumūrtāni dravāṇi cādhyarohayan ।।91 ।।
maṇḍapākhyastathā muktaḥ samāyātaḥ smṛtastadā ।
māṇikyastaṃbha evāpi śrīkṛṣṇāgre samāyayau ।।92।।
sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ kṣetrarakṣākaro haraḥ ।
śrīhareḥ sannidhau natvā kṛtamānāḥ śubhāsane ।।93 ।।
niṣeduste tataḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ pitā ।
navaitān kuṃkumavāpīkṣetrarakṣārthamāha ca ।। 94।।
rakṣantu kṣetrametadvai vayaṃ yāmo varāṇasīm ।
ityuktvā yogyasāmagrīrhetīṃśca pāritoṣikam ।। 95 ।।
datvā sajjaṃ pracakāra vimānaṃ sūryavarculam ।
śṛṃgāritaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ bhrātṝn bhagavadādikān ।।016 ।।
bhrātṛpatnīstathā pitṛvargānābālavṛddhakān ।
kuṭumbino janān sambandhinaḥ sarvān vimānake ।।97।।
naranārīvargasambandhinaḥ paramparāgatān ।
nyaṣādayadvimāneṣu jayanādānakārayat ।।98।।
dundubhayo'pyavādyanta yātrāprasthānasūcakāḥ ।
vyaṃgulānāṃ śubhaśabdāḥ sarvaśravaṇayogadāḥ ।।99।।
abhavaँśca tadā gāndharvāṇāṃ vādyaninādakāḥ ।
tūpaśabdā meghavaccā'bhavan yātrāprayāṇake ।। 2.284.10 0।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetamām ।
ityuvāca tadā vāṇī divyā vyomavihāriṇī ।। 101 ।।
puṣpākṣatādimāṃgalyairvardhitaṃ devikādibhiḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇavimānaṃ ca pūrvāśāṃ gatimācarat ।। 1 02।।
gītikānāditānyeva vimānāni tadā'mbare ।
saharṣajanaśobhāni tatpaścād gatimācaran ।। 103 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike cāgre yayau vimānavāhinī ।
kṛṣṇayātrātmikā śīghraṃ svargaṃ yātīva śobhate ।। 1 04।।
mudaṃ mamau na hṛdaye pratyekasya ca dehinaḥ ।
ujjagāma mahānandaḥ prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 105।।
marudeśaṃ samullaṃghya kośalān madhyadeśakān ।
prayāgaṃ ca samullaṃghya vāhinī kāśikāṃ yayau ।। 1 06।।
kṛṣṇayānīṃ garjamāno sahasracandrasadṛśīm ।
vimānarūpiṇīṃ vīkṣya śiveśvaro'tiharṣitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
kāśīvāsāḥ prajāścāpi samutsukā yayuḥ prati ।
vadantyo rādhike! yāmaḥ prodvāhaḥ kṛpṇayoriti ।। 1 08।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne mahīmānānāṃ rājñāṃ kanyakādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca vimāneṣvārohaṇaṃ, kṛṣṇayānyāḥ kāśīṃ pratigamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 284 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! vāhinīṃ vīkṣyā'mbare vimānarūpiṇīm ।
śaṃkarasya mahīmānāḥ śiveśvarastathā nṛpaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛṣṇayānīṃ namaskṛtya svāgatārthaṃ drutaṃ tadā ।
vāditrakuśalān sarvānājñāpayan gavādikān ।। 2 ।।
vādayituṃ ca vāditrottamāni tūryavedinaḥ ।
vādyaghoṣā abhavaँśca tadā'mbarāntagāḥ sukhāḥ ।। 3 ।।
māṃgalikāstārajanyā bherījanyāśca śobhanāḥ ।
vyaṃgulādikajanyāśca śaṃkhajanyāśca dūragāḥ ।। 4 ।।
mayūrotthāstathā śabdā vaṃśīvīṇāninādanāḥ ।
jalayantrādijanyāśca gālajanyāḥ śubhāvahāḥ ।। 5 ।।
mṛdaṃgakaratālādijanyāścā'nalayantrajāḥ ।
vāyustarakṛtāḥ śabdā vyomagītāni cā'bhavam ।। 6 ।।
apsarasāṃ kaṇṭhaśabdā yoginīnāṃ ca gītayaḥ ।
miṣṭā vedādinārīṇāṃ sarasvatīninādanāḥ ।। 7 ।।
dūramiṣṭasvarāstatrā'bhavan vyomāntagāminaḥ ।
aśrūyanta śubhāste ca vimāneṣu vihāyasi ।। 8 ।।
tān śabdān vai samākarṇyā''ścaryaparā vimānagāḥ ।
dadṛśustāṃ viśālāṃ subhūmiṃ vārāṇasīmayīm ।। 9 ।।
sarve vimānagā gaṃgāvaraṇāmadhyagāṃ purīm ।
daśayojanavistīrṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhasadṛśīṃ tadā ।। 2.285.1 0।।
paścottare dadṛśuśca viśālaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtam ।
varaṇāyāstaṭe śivapuraṃ viṃśatiyojanam ।। 11 ।।
mayaṃ ca viśvakarmāṇaṃ samāhūya vidhāpitam ।
kailāsamaparaṃ kiṃ vā golokamaparaṃ ca vā ।। 12।।
sthitaṃ koṭividhuklṛptaṃ tathā koṭiraviprabham ।
bahubhaumaṃ cāmbare saṃsthitaṃ kiṃ vā triśūlagam ।
divyaṃ kailāsamevaitanmenire tadvimānagāḥ ।। 13 ।।
śiveśvareṇa svaputryāḥ māṃgalyotsavasiddhaye ।
nirmāpitaṃ mahīmānanivāsārthaṃ puraṃ hi tat। ।
svarṇaprākārasaṃśobhaṃ koṭiprāsādarājitam ।। 14।।
svarṇamandirasacchālaṃ suvarṇakalaśānvitam ।
suvarṇadhvajasaṃbodhyaṃ śātabhaumaṃ samantataḥ ।। 15।।
kuberanagarī yatra yatreśānapurī tathā ।
indrapurī tathā koṇe vahnipurī prakoṇake ।। 16।।
vāruṇī nagarī yatra dharmapurī prakoṇake ।
marutāṃ nagarī koṇe brahmapurī prakoṇake ।। 17।।
sūryapurī tathā viṣṇupurī koṇe virājate ।
madhye devanivāsāśca prāsādāḥ śatabhūmayaḥ ।। 18।।
udyānā''vṛtaprapārśvāścātisugandhisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
dhavalā himaśailāśca yadvat śaśinibhāstathā ।। 19।।
sarvasmṛddhiśritāḥ sarve prāsādā nūtanāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
candraśālāḥ praśobhante grahamārgagatā iva ।। 2.285.20 ।।
naisargikaprabhāsrāvā maṇayo yatra bhittiṣu ।
naisargikaprakāśāśca kammānikāsu santi hi ।।21 ।।
toraṇeṣu sudhāsrāvā vidyante kāmavallikāḥ ।
staṃbheṣūrdhvapradeśeṣu vidyante kāmapādapāḥ ।। 22।।
valabhīṣu ca vidyante payonadyaśca kāmajāḥ ।
ūṣmā yathāpekṣitā ca kalpatārodbhavā'sti ca ।। 23 ।।
śivapuryāṃ ca paritaḥ pratiprāsādake tathā ।
pratiprāsādabhūmau ca vidyante kāmadhenavaḥ ।।24।।
kāmarūpadharā divyā vyomacārāḥ sukhapradāḥ ।
kalpakanyāśca vidyante pratyekabhūmimāsthitāḥ ।।251।।
dāsā dāsyo divyavarṇā vidyante sevakāstathā ।
sarve saṃkalpajā divyā sevārthaṃ nihitāstadā ।। 26 ।।
dehasaṃvāhikāścāpi gāyikā nṛtyayoṣitaḥ ।
sarvāḥ saṃkalpajāstatra śaṃkareṇa nidhāpitāḥ ।।27।।
sarvarasāḥ sarvagandhā sarvarūpāḥ suśobhinaḥ ।
prāsādāḥ sarvaśabdāśca sarvasparśā bhavanti ca ।। 28।।
sauvarṇāsanaśobhāśca siṃhāsanagajāsanaḥ ।
mṛdukomalaśayyāśca vidyante yatra vedikāḥ ।।।29।।
bṛsyo bahuvidhāḥ santi paryaṃkāḥ sukhadāyinaḥ ।
āstaraṇāni divyāni kauśeyāni samantataḥ ।। 2.285.30।।
aurṇāni mṛduramyāṇi vicitrāṇi śubhāni ca ।
raṃgacitrāṇi cañcadbhāvanti pratyāśrayāṇi ca ।।3 1 ।।
gendukāni pārśvakāni kaśipavaśca komalāḥ ।
guptadorāṇyamūlyāni svarṇakaṭāni yāni ca ।।32।।।
nihitāni ca teṣveva prāsādeṣu hi śaṃbhunā ।
preṃkhā dolāḥ savallyaśca mṛduśayyāsamanvitāḥ ।। 33 ।।
lambante yatra vallībhiḥ śobhitā''ndolanārthikāḥ ।
vimānāni svalpadehānyapi bhūmigamāni ca ।। 34।।
vāyumārgeṇa ca gatimanti santi gṛhe gṛhe ।
yaddvārā cordhvabhūmau ca janāḥ svasvanivāsane ।।35।।
vyomamārgātpraviśanti nissaranti vimānakaiḥ ।
sopānānyapi niḥśreṇībaddhāni maṇimanti ca ।। 36 ।।
svarṇapātrāṇi sarvāṇi kalpapātrāṇi santi ca ।
akṣayyasthālikāstatra kalpaghaṭāḥ prasanti ca ।। 37।।
maṇimanti samagrāṇi talāni ca gṛhe gṛhe ।
ādarśāḥ svacchabhāvantaḥ prakāśante gṛhe gṛhe ।। 38।।
kapāṭāni ca devānāṃ sṛṣṭidṛṣṭimayāni ca ।
peṭikā mañjuṣādyāścā'kṣayārthavatya eva ca ।।3 9।।
veṣāḥ samastāḥ suśobhā vidyante ca gṛhe gṛhe ।
sugandhadravyapātrāṇi tailakesarakāṇi ca ।।2.285.40।।
kastūrīkarpūrasthālyo bhavanti vai gṛhe gṛhe ।
rasakulyā dadhikulyā madhukulyāśca śarkarāḥ ।।41 ।।
ikṣudaṇḍā ghṛtakulyāḥ sudhāvāpyo gṛhe gṛhe ।
pīyūṣakuṇḍikāḥ santi cāmṛtānāṃ hradāstathā ।।42।।
phalānāṃ cāpi puṣpāṇāṃ kamalānāṃ hradāstathā ।
kandānāmārdraśuṣkāṇāṃ bījānāṃ cāpi saṃgrahāḥ ।।43।।
hetīnāṃ ramyaraṃgāṇāṃ dyūtānāṃ sādhanānyapi ।
śravāṇāṃ darśanānāṃ ca yantrāṇyapi gṛhe gṛhe ।। 44।।
caityaputtalikāḥ santi karmacāryo gṛhe gṛhe ।
rasaśālāḥ pākaśālā vidyāśālāśca bhūgṛhāḥ ।।45।।
gahvarāṇi snānaśālāścānnaśālā gṛhe gṛhe ।
peyaśālāḥ śāntiśālā ratiśālā gṛhe gṛhe ।। 46।।
pracchannanidrāśālāśca vitardikā gṛhe gṛhe ।
śṛṃgāraśālā vividhā vadhūśālāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ।।47।।
vṛddhaśālāśca sugamāḥ kalpavastusamanvitāḥ ।
śaucaśālāstathā śuddhiśālāḥ santi gṛhe gṛhe ।।48।।
bhogyaśālā vicitrāśca sarvasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
sabhāśālāstathā vihārālayāśca gṛhe gṛhe ।।49।।
vāhanāni samastāni sthalajā'rṇavajāni ca ।
vāyujāni ca tiryañci dvāri dvāri kṛtāni ca ।।2.285.50।।
gopureṣu mahāsiṃhā gajāścatvaravartinaḥ ।
garuḍā mandirordhve ca śārdūlā gopuropari ।।51।।
paryaścāpsarasaścāpi gaṇyaśca yoginīgaṇāḥ ।
cetanāstatra tiṣṭhanti mahīmānaprasevinaḥ ।।52।।
viśeṣo rādhike! tatra śaṃkareṇa vidhāpitaḥ ।
yasya vāsārthamevā'sti yad gṛhaṃ tatra tatra tu ।।53।।
sa eva svakuṭumbena rājate pratimāvidhaḥ ।
saceṣṭa iva rājā vā devo daityo'suro'pi vā ।।54।।
prāsādeṣu tathā tattvaṃ nihitaṃ guptabhittiṣu ।
yo yo vasati prāsāde sa dvirūpaḥ prajāyate ।।55।।
bhramo bhavati sarveṣāṃ ko'tra satyaḥ paraśca kaḥ ।
na vidanti ca ye bimbaṃ bhramanti pratibimbake ।।56।।
aphalāśca parāvṛttya bimbaṃ te mārgayanti hi ।
tattatpramāvidhurāste bhrame pramāṃ hi manvate ।।57।।
jale sthalaṃ sthale jalaṃ jale tejobhilokitā ।
pṛthvyāmākāśabhānaṃ ca bhramanti mahīmānakāḥ ।।58 ।।
sarvatraśaṃkaraścāpi sūkṣmarūpaḥ pradṛśyate ।
māyaiṣā śāṃkarī tatra prāsādeṣu vidhāpitā ।।59।।
vyajanaiścā'niladevaḥ sevāyāṃ pratimānavam ।
vartate ca yathāpekṣaṃ sarvamānasarañjanaḥ ।।2.285.6 0 ।।
aditiścānnadātrī ca vartate kanyakātmikā ।
saṃkalpopasthitā bhūtvā datvā yāti tiraḥsthitim ।।6 1।।
oṣadhayaḥ śaṃkareṇa prāsādeṣu gṛhe gṛhe ।
sthāpitāḥ kānakā vṛkṣā vijayāstabakā navāḥ ।।62।।
siṃhavyāghrādicarmāṇi cetanānīva madhyataḥ ।
prāsādeṣu sthāpitāni sundarāṇi gṛhe gṛhe ।।63।।
ābhūṣaṇāni nārīṇāṃ veṣāśca subhagāstathā ।
śṛṃgāradravapātrāṇi sthāpitāni gṛhe gṛhe ।।64।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi lehyacośyāni yāni ca ।
āsvādyāni ca peyāni nihitāni gṛhe gṛhe ।।65।।।
ekaikā candramaḥsthālī payodā'mṛtadāyinī ।
sukhadā sthāpitā pūrṇā śaṃkareṇa gṛhe gṛhe ।।66।।
vasantaśca samāhūtaḥ sthāpitaḥ śivapattane ।
etādṛśaṃ śivapuraṃ varapakṣanivāsanam ।।67।।
dadṛśurvyomagāḥ sarve cā'dbhutaṃ viśvakarmakṛt ।
dvitīyaṃ dadṛśū ramyaṃ pārvatīpattanaṃ varam ।।।68।।
kanyāpakṣamahīmānā''vāsārthaṃ kāritaṃ tu yat ।
na nyūnamasmāt sarvāṃśe vastuṣvapi manāgapi ।।6 9।।
viṃśatiyojanāyāmaṃ varaṇāprāgbhuvastale ।
dvayordivyā'bhinavayoḥ purayormadhyavatīṃ ca ।।2.285.70।।
rājate pārvatīśasya prāsādo'yutaśṛṃgavān ।
viśvakarmakṛtaścāyaṃ mayena ca pariṣkṛtaḥ ।।71।।
niśeśā''dityayormadhye meroḥ śṛṃgamivā''babhau ।
pārvatīpattane rādhe! śivasambandhinaḥ khalu ।।72।।
kanyāpakṣāśca ye tvāsan nyūṣuste tatra śobhane ।
bhūtanāthaḥ koṭigaṇasamanvito hi śaṃkaraḥ ।।73।।
piṃgarājaḥ śaṃkaraśca īśānaḥ ketumālagaḥ ।
kāmarūpā satī kāmākṣiṇī nyūṣuśca tatra te ।।74।।
navajīvadvīparājaḥ kāmanāyakanāmavān ।
ta ete śaṃkarāḥ sarve nyūṣuḥ pārvatīpattane ।।75।।
śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān sākṣācchaṃkarasya pitā hi saḥ ।
koṭigopāṃganāgopaiḥ sahovāsa ca tatra ha ।।76।।
saṃkarṣaṇo vyūharūpo bhagavān koṭipārṣadaḥ ।
uvāsa pārvatīpuryāṃ koṭikṛṣṇasamanvitaḥ ।।77।।
mahāmāyā kṛṣṇaśaktiḥ sā'pyuvāsa ca tatra ha ।
mahākālo jagaddhartā jarāmṛtyusamanvitaḥ ।।78।।
koṭiśaktisamaiśvaryayutaścovāsa tatra ca ।
sadāśivo hi bhagavān vairājasya pitā hi saḥ ।।79।।
so'pi śivāyutastatrovāsaiva pārvatīpure ।
rudrāḥ sarve tathā rudryaḥ rudrasṛṣṭigaṇādikāḥ ।।2.285.80।।
mahīmānā pārvatīpattane nyūṣuḥ sukhānvitāḥ ।
śivaḥ kailāsavāsaśca tathā koṭigaṇānvitaḥ ।।81 ।।
yamarājaḥ koṭidūtairyutaścovāsa tatpure ।
agniśca devatāḥ sarvavidhā nyūṣuśca tatpure ।।82।।
kuberaśca nirṛtaśca yoginīcakramityapi ।
yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācakāḥ ।।83।।
vaināyakāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vetālakā gaṇāstathā ।
vetālinyaśca śākinyo ḍākinyaścaṇḍikādikāḥ ।।84।।
brahmacaryo mātaraśca durgāśca śaktayaśca yāḥ ।
kālyaścāpi mahākālyo bhairavā bhadrakāstathā ।।85।।
nyūṣuste pārvatīsaudhanagare sukhaśāyinaḥ ।
īśvarā vaikuṇṭhavāsāścāvyākṛtaparāstathā ।।86।।
amṛtasthāstathā saurāścāndrā nyūṣuśca tatra ha ।
munayaḥ siddhayogāścāvadhūtā liṅginastathā ।।87।।
yoginaścarṣayaścāpi pitaro nyūṣurityapi ।
grahāśca tārakāścāpi nakṣatrāṇi ca ketavaḥ ।।88।।
daityāśca dānavāścāpi nyūṣustatra pure tadā ।
svargīyā lokapālāśca kṣetrapālādikāstathā ।।89।।
bhuvarvāsāḥ pāvanāśca kuladevo hanūyutaḥ ।
mānavāścāpi rājānaḥ pātālasthāḥ phaṇīśvarāḥ ।।2.285.90।।
hāṭakeśastathā jyotiḥsvarūpāśca praśaktayaḥ ।
gāndharvā gaṇikāścāpi sūtāśca māgadhādayaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vidyādhrāḥ kinnarāścāpi śailā himālayādayaḥ ।
ṛṣayo'pi jvarāścāpi vighnāśca viṣasādhakāḥ ।।92।।
vṛkṣā vallyaśca tattvāni krūrāḥ kālasya mūrtayaḥ ।
vṛścikādyāḥ kāmarūpā nyūṣuḥ pārvatīpattane ।।93।।
ete cānye mahīmānāḥ śaṃkarasya gaṇādayaḥ ।
pārvatīpattanavāsāḥ sarve'mbaraṃ vilokya ca ।।94।।
kṛṣṇasya vāhinī vyomnā tvāyātetyavagatya ca ।
tūrṇaṃ vyaṃgulanādaiśca bhūtvā sajjāḥ śivagṛham ।।95।।
kuṭumbādyaiśca sahitāḥ savādyamaṃgalaśrayāḥ ।
sabhūṣāveṣaśobhāścā''yayuḥ svāgatahetave ।।96।।
prajāścāpi tadā vārāṇasyāḥ sarvāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dhanyaṃ bhāgyaṃ svaṃ manvānā prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।97।।
sopadāḥ saphalāścāpi sapuṣpahāramālikāḥ ।
anvīyuḥ pārvatīśasya mandiraṃ tūrṇameva tāḥ ।।98।।
śiveśvaro drutaṃ naijaṃ kailāsaṃ divyapūruṣam ।
himādriṃ ca tathā divyaṃ pūruṣaṃ bahuvistṛtam ।।99।।
jagādā'mbaradeśe ca vimānādhārakaṃ sthalam ।
sudivyaṃ bhavituṃ tatra kṣaṇaṃ svāgatahetave ।। 2.285.10 0।।
rādhike! drutamevā'mū kailāsaśca himālayaḥ ।
antarīkṣe staraṃ divyaṃ bhūmirūpaṃ sthirāspadam ।। 101 ।।
kailāsamaparaṃ tatra vyadhātāṃ dhāmanūtanam ।
śivādyāḥ śivapakṣāśca tūrṇaṃ yayustadambare ।। 1 02।।
dhāmni vai nūtane ramye vāhinīsvāgatāya ha ।
āścaryaṃ cāmbare prāpurvimānasthā janā'nugāḥ ।। 103 ।।
śiveśvaramahaiśvaryaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāstadā'bhavan ।
praśasaṃsurbrahmarūpaṃ brahmātmānaṃ haraṃ tadā ।। 1 04।।
samṛddhaṃ vai mahālakṣmīpitaraṃ pārvatīpatim ।
śrīmadgopākṛṣṇādyāḥ prasedurvīkṣya sampadaḥ ।। 1 05।।
śaṃkarādyāḥ kṛṣṇayānīṃ vīkṣya prasedureva ca ।
gharasparaṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ vīkṣyā'timumuhustadā ।। 1 06।।
rādhike yad dvayorgarvaharā lakṣmīḥ kumārikā ।
garvaharo bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ kumārako'sti ca ।। 1 07।।
dvayorbhagavatoścātrāṃ'śayoryogyasamāgame ।
vikasanti tadaṃśā vai prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 1 08।।
yatrā'haṃ tava kānto'smi kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ śivaḥ ।
yatra viṣṇurmahāviṣṇurbālakṛṣṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 1 09।।
sarve sṛṣṭipraṇetārastatrā''ścaryaṃ nu kiṃ bhavet ।
sarvaṃ saṃghaṭate rādhe! prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoryataḥ ।। 2.285.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāśīvāhinīsammānārthaṃ śiveśvarakāritavāditraninādanāni, ambarāt kāśikāyāḥ śivapurasyapārvatīpurasya vīkṣaṇam, puravarṇanam, pārvatīpattanīyakanyāpakṣīyamahīmānasahitasya śiveśvarasya vāhinīsvāgatārthamambare ghaṭikāsthāyikailāsaracanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītya-
dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 285 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 286

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike tatra kailāse viśāle'mbarasaṃsthite ।
pañcāśadyojanāyāme sarvāpekṣyarddhisaṃyute ।। 1 ।।
mahodyānāntare ramye sauvarṇe maṇḍape śubhe ।
praveśārhe rājamārge tasthuḥ śrīśaṃkarādayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
darśayāmāsuretāँśca vimānagān samīpagām ।
divyabhuvaṃ śanaiścāvatarituṃ vyomakalpitām ।। 3 ।।
sarvāṃ kāñcanavarṇāṃ ca kailāsā'pararūpiṇīm ।
hiṃraṇmayyā nagaryā ca śobhitāṃ kalpapādapām ।। 4 ।।
sarvartuphalibhirvṛkṣaistadānīmṛddhisaṃbhṛtām ।
koṭiviśrāntibhavanairmahākuñjāntaraiḥ śubhaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
yāvatpuṣpipraramyaiśca gandhidrumaiḥ samanvitām ।
vimānānāmavatārasthalībhiḥ paritaḥ sthitām ।। 6 ।।
etādṛśīṃ viśālāṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ darśitāṃ tadā ।
abhitaḥ sthitiyogyāsu sthalīṣu ca samāsu ca ।। 7 ।।
rādhike svavimānāni bālakṛṣṇādayastathā ।
maharṣayo nṛpāḥ kanyāḥ sādhavo devatādayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
muktāśceśāstatheśvaryaḥ pitaro mānavādayaḥ ।
nijavāhinīsvarūpā vimānāni nijāni vai ।। 9 ।।
kailāsabhūmāvavatārayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ।
tadā vādyāni sarvāṇi lakṣaśaśca śubhāni vai ।। 1.286.1 0।।
vādayāmāsurugrāṇi miṣṭāni śaṃpradāni ca ।
golokasyā'mṛtasyā'pyavyākṛtasya ca yāni ca ।। 11 ।।
kailāsasya kuberasya pṛthvyāścāsuralokinām ।
daityānāṃ bhūtajātīnāṃ gaṇānāṃ yogināṃ tathā । । 12 । ।
yoginīnāṃ gaṇikānāṃ gāndharvāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām ।
caṇḍyādīnāmavādyanta vāditrāṇi samantataḥ । । 1 3। ।
hiraṇmayyā nagaryāśca prākārāgre drumānvite ।
mahāprāsādakā'gre ca bālakṛṣṇavimānakam । । 14 । ।
avātatāra ca śanaiḥ sthiraṃ drumaṇḍale hyabhūt। ।
anyānyapi vimānāni pṛthak pṛthak drukuñjake । । 15 । ।
avatīrya sthairyamāpuḥ prāsādāgre nije pṛthak ।
tadā''ścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ rādhike! śaṃkarasya vai । । 16 । ।
yāvantyāsan vimānāni tāvadrūpadharo'bhavat ।
bṛhaspatistathā tatra tāvadrūpadharo'bhavat । । 17 । ।
ahaṃ tu śrībālakṛṣṇavimānāgre sthito'bhavam ।
śaṃkareṇa guruṇā ca vāmadevādibhiḥ saha । । 18 । ।
vyāsairvipraiśca ṛṣibhirdhṛtapūjārhapātrakaiḥ ।
puṣpā'kṣatadravalājākuṃkumaśrīphalānvitaiḥ । । 19 । ।
sugandhapuṣpahārādyairyuktaiśca vedaghoṣibhiḥ ।
sanmāṃgalyavacobhiśca pūjājalaghaṭā'nvitaiḥ । । 1.286.20 । ।
miṣṭānnajalapānārthaṃ svarṇādisthalasaṃyutaiḥ ।
anekaiśca gaṇaiścāpi sthālavadbhiśca sevakaiḥ । । 21 । ।
dāsībhiścāpyasaṃkhyābhirmiṣṭasthālayutādibhiḥ ।
tāvadrūpadharābhiśca jalapātrayutādibhiḥ । । 22 । ।
cāmaravyajanādyaiśca yuktābhiḥ sevikādibhiḥ ।
chatrapātrādibhiryuktairgaṇairdevaiśca sevakaiḥ । । 23 । ।
phalatāmbūlakairyuktairgandhasatkāravedibhiḥ ।
vetradharairhetidharairājñādhraiśca gaṇaiḥ saha । । 24 । ।
mānasammānapūrṇajñaiḥ sarvamiṣṭavacoyutaiḥ ।
śreṣṭhottamāsanadaiśca pādakṣālanavedibhiḥ । । 25 । ।
iṅgitajñaiḥ karmavāhaiścāpekṣitapradairgaṇaiḥ ।
kalpakumārakaiścāpi kalpakumārikādibhiḥ । । 26 । ।
saṃkalpavartibhistatra yuto'haṃ śaṃkarastathā ।
bṛhaspatistathā'nye cā'bhavāmaḥ svāgatārthinaḥ । । 27 । ।
yathā sarve mayā sākamabhavat sarvameva tat ।
sarvasthale'bhavat prativimānaṃ svāgatārthakam । । 28 । ।
śṛṇu rādhe tadā tvanyadāścaryaṃ bālakṛṣṇajam ।
vīkṣya śrīśaṃkaraṃ naikarūpadharaṃ tadā prabhuḥ । । 29 । ।
bālakṛṣṇo'pi bhagavān kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ।
lomaśena yutaścāpi tāvadrūpadharo'bhavat । । 1.286.30 । ।
avātatāra sahasā vimānebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।
śaṃkaro'pi mahāścaryaṃ jagāma vīkṣya mādhavam ।।3 1।।
śaṃkareṇa hi sarveṣāṃ vimānasthapradehinām ।
satkārārthaṃ dhṛtānyeva saha rūpāṇi vai tadā ।।32।।
kintu vimānagānāṃ vai cātmaniveditā yataḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇamanarpyaiva gṛhṇanti na dalādyapi ।।33।।
teṣāṃ tadā cā'prasādapūjādravyagrahe bhavet ।
ātmaniveditāhāniḥ śaṃkaro doṣabhāg bhavet ।।34।।
taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ vijñāya bhagavān prabhuḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇo hi pūjāyā grahaṇārthaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ।।35।।
vimānebhyo hi sarvebhyaścāvātarat tadā'gragaḥ ।
śaṃkaraḥ sarvabhāvaiśca sarvavastubhirityapi ।।36 ।।
cakārā'rhāṃ tu kṛṣṇasya parabrahmaṇa eva ha ।
labdhvā pūjāṃ haristāvannatvā pūjyān harādikān ।।37।।
kuśalaṃ ca samāpṛcchya nivedya svamanāmayam ।
prāpyā''śīrvādavācaśca tiro'bhavat sthalāntarāt ।।38।।
mukhye naije vimāne ca tadā sthiro'bhavat prabhuḥ ।
śaṃbhurbṛhaspatiścānye mahīmānaprapūjanam ।।39।।
vedamantraiḥ pracakruśca maṃgalaṃ vidhivattadā ।
parasparaṃ sukuśalaṃ papracchaturnirāmayam ।।1.286.40 ।।
varakanyāpitarau vai tathā sambandhibāndhavāḥ ।
papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ sarve mimilurvakṣasā tadā ।।41 ।।
svāgataṃ śobhanā vāco jagaduśca samutsukāḥ ।
sammānaṃ vidadhuḥ śīghraṃ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ ।।42।।
āsanaiśca madhuparkaiḥ sugandhavāridānakaiḥ ।
puṣpahāraiścandanādyairmālikādipradānakaiḥ ।।43 ।।
lājābhiścākṣataiścāpi vardhayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
puṣpāñjalipradānaiśca vakṣobhyāṃ melanādibhiḥ ।।44।।
niṣādanairyogyabhūmau svarṇasiṃhāsanādiṣu ।
nikuṃjeṣu svarṇasaudhe jalagaṇḍūṣadānakaiḥ ।।45।।
tato miṣṭānnadānaiśca payaḥpānādibhistathā ।
tāmbūladānakaiścāpi susatkāraṃ vyadhuḥ śubham ।।46।।
vyajanaiścāmaraiścāpi vetriyaśaḥprakāśanaiḥ ।
pādasaṃvāhanādyaiśca svāgataṃ vividhaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।47।।
mukhyaṃ vimānakaṃ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇasya vai tadā ।
saṃvardhitaṃ sulājābhirakṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ ।।48।।
jayaśabdaistathā śrīśo hyavātarad vimānataḥ ।
svāgataiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ puṣpāñjalibhirityapi ।।49।।
yavāṃkurādibhiścāpi candanaiḥ sa vivardhitaḥ ।
pṛṣṭo gopālakṛṣṇaśca kuśalaṃ prati śaṃbhunā ।।1.286.50।।
kārṣṇāśca śāṃkaraiḥ pṛṣṭāḥ kuśalaṃ ca nirāmayam ।
atha devya_ kumāryaśca kātyāyanyādikāstathā ।।51 ।।
durgādyāśca satī cāpi kaṃbharādikayoṣitaḥ ।
kanyakāścāpi papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ ca nirāmayam ।।52।।
svāgataṃ madhuparkādyairjalamiṣṭānnadānakaiḥ ।
tāmbūlakādibhiścakruḥ pupūjuśca sragādibhiḥ ।।53 ।।
āsanairvividhaiścāpi tathā'nuvṛttibhiḥ striyaḥ ।
mahīmānīyoṣitāṃ vai vyadhuḥ saṃvardhanaṃ tadā ।।54।।
duḥkhahā'ñjalibhiścāpi vakṣaḥsammelanādibhiḥ ।
sarvayogyapradānaiśca madhuvākyaiśca sevanaiḥ ।।55।।
jayaścandro dhenupālastathā'nye śivapakṣiṇaḥ ।
bālakṛṣṇakuṭumbānāṃ sammānaṃ svāgataṃ vyadhuḥ ।।56।।
aśokasundarīdevī sakhyastasyāśca kanyakāḥ ।
santoṣādikakanyānāṃ svāgataṃ saṃvyadhustadā ।।57।।
kanyakāḥ koṭiśaścāpi śāṃkaryaśca vyadhustadā ।
kanyakānāṃ svāgataṃ ca pūjābhojanasevanaiḥ ।।58।।
prajāścāpi prajānāṃ ca papracchuḥ kuśalāni hi ।
rājānaśca nṛpāṇāṃ vai papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ tadā ।।59।।
devāścāpi surāṇāṃ ca muktānāṃ muktakoṭayaḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāmṛṣayaścāpi papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ tadā ।।1.286.6 0 ।।
īśvarā īśvarāṇāṃ ca pracakruḥ svāgatādikam ।
nārīṇāṃ nārikāvargāḥ sammānaṃ saṃvyadhustadā ।।।61 ।।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha dhanyo'haṃ yadgṛhe bhagavān svayam ।
samāyāto bhikṣuko me puṇyapātraṃ sutākṛte ।।62।।
dhanyeyaṃ nagarī ramyā kāśikā tatprajā api ।
dhanyā satī tathā lakṣmīryadgṛhe bhagavān svayam ।।63।।
dhanyo'haṃ yadgṛhe cā'dya dhāmamuktā bhavanti hi ।
vāsudevaḥ prabhuḥ sākṣād viṣṇavaśca bhavanti hi ।।64।।
nārāyaṇāśca yadgṛhe santo nārāyaṇopamāḥ ।
tīrthāni yadgṛhe tvadya dhanyo'haṃ bhāgyavānapi ।।65।।
dhanyā vṛkṣāstathā vallyo dhanyāḥ kīṭapataṃgakāḥ ।
dhanyā mahīmānino me yeṣāṃ yogo'tra śārṅgiṇaḥ ।।66।।
yadgṛhe sāttvatāḥ santi bhāgavatā hi sādhavaḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ punānāśca yadgṛhe munayo'pi ca ।।67।।
mama kailāsakaṃ tvadya jātaṃ paramavaiṣṇavam ।
yatra me prāṇanāthasya vāso'dya vartate'mbare ।।68।।
adya me tu gaṇāḥ sarve jātāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ ।
adya me śivasaṃjñeti sadā tvānvarthikī mama ।।69।।
ityuktvā nijanetreṣu premāśrūṇi rurodha ha ।
āvilaṃ cāpi trinetramanāvilaṃ vyadhānmudā ।।1.286.70 ।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo'pi rādhike! śaṃkaraṃ tadā ।
prāha dhanyā vayaṃ yeṣāṃ jāyate te'dya darśanam ।।71 ।।
yaḥ parabrahmarūpaśca saṃkarṣaṇaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
mahākālasvarūpaśca tadgehe naḥ samāgamaḥ ।।72।।
dhanyā vayaṃ mahāyogin jagatsaṃhārakāraka ।
bhavatkṛpā'valeśena dānārhaste'dya me sutaḥ ।।73 ।।
dhanyo me bālakṛṣṇaśca lakṣmīṃ prāpsyati te sutām ।
sarvalokasya jananīṃ brāhmīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ satīm ।।74।।
golokeśo harikṛṣṇo rādhayā gopikādibhiḥ ।
sahā'dya vartate tvatra śiveśvaraḥ pitā ca vaḥ ।।75।।
asyā'nantasvarūpasya pumuttamasya darśanam ।
labdhvā dhanyā vayaṃ cānyat kiṃ bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhakaṃ nvitaḥ ।।76 ।।
ityuktvā praṇanāmā'pi śaṃkaraṃ kṛṣṇamityapi ।
kaṃbharāśrīḥ satīṃ cāpi tadāha bhāgyagauravam ।।77।।
satī ca nijabhāgyasya gauravaṃ prāha śobhanam ।
aho putrī mama dhanyā yatsevyā kaṃbharā satī ।।78।।
pāvanaṃ me gṛhaṃ tvadya mahālakṣmyāḥ samāgamāt ।
pāvanaṃ ca kuṭumbaṃ me sarvasṛṣṭisamāgamāt ।।79।।
pāvanaṃ kāśikākṣetraṃ mokṣadaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya parabrahmaṇaḥ ।।1.286.80।।
samāgamāttatheśānāṃ mokṣadānāṃ satāṃ tathā ।
sādhvīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca devīnāṃ ca samāgamāt। ।।8 1 ।।
mātṝṇāṃ cāpsarasāṃ ca brahmasarasāṃ cāgamāt ।
īśvarīṇāṃ cāgamācca rādhāramāsamāgamāt ।।82।।।
kamalātulasīlakṣmīmāṇikīśāradā''gamāt ।
ramāpadmāvatīśrībhūlīlāvibhūtikāgamāt ।।83।।
muktānīnāmāgamācca vaiṣṇavīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
bhaktānāṃ cāpi rājñīnāṃ dhanyā samāgamādiha ।।84।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma cā'dya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ ।
adya me saphalā smṛddhiḥ kaṃbharāśrīsamāgamāt ।।85।।
adya me saphalā vidyā sāmrājyaṃ saphalaṃ mama ।
dāsā dāsyaśca saphalāḥ kaṃbharāśrīsamāgamāt ।।86।।
śiveśvaragṛhe cāsmi vivāhitā hi pārvatī ।
saphalā'smi sakuṭumbā lakṣmīmātā'smi śobhanā ।।87।।
pārvatī tvadya jānāti bhāgyaṃ sarvottamaṃ nijam ।
yatputrī kaṃbharābālo bhagavān vai grahīṣyati ।।88।।
ityuktvā praṇanāmā'pi kaṃbharāśrīṃ tathā'parāḥ ।
kaṃbharāśrīstadā prāha sāphalyaṃ tvadya no'pi ca ।।89।।
yadgehe vayamāgatya paśyāmo girijāṃ satīm ।
mama gehe satīputrī lakṣmīścāpyāgamiṣyati ।।1.286.90।।
sarvalokapoṣayitrī bhāgyaṃ me paramaṃ nviha ।
satī brāhmī mama putramānārhā saṃbhaviṣyati ।।9 1 ।।
yannetramiṣamātreṇa sṛṣṭitrayaṃ vilīyate ।
sa me putrasya pūjyā'dya tasyāḥ pūjyaśca me sutaḥ ।।92।।
aho bhāgyaṃ trilokyāṃ me samaṃ nānyasya vidyate ।
ityuktvā praṇanāmā'sau kaṃbharāśrīḥ satīṃ tadā ।। 93।।
adrijāśrīḥ kṣaṇaṃ sarvāḥ prapūjyā''gatayoṣitaḥ ।
kṛtvā ca madhuparkādyaiḥ svāgataṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।।94।।
sudhāpānapradānaiśca miṣṭapayaḥprapādanaiḥ ।
vireme sodarau dvau tu jayacandrau mudā tadā ।।95।।
nijabhāgyau sumanvānau mumudaturhi nirbharau ।
kanyāpakṣo virarāma brahmanādo babhūva ha ।। 96।।
kṛṣṇavāhinyāstadā vai gantuṃ śivapuraṃ prati ।
nandīśvaraścakāraiva brahmanādaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।। 97।।
bṛhaspatirhariṃ sampūjya cotthito'bhavat tataḥ
viśramya ca narā nāryaḥ samutthitāstadā'bhavan ।।98।।
āvāsān pratigantuṃ ca tāvadāścaryamadbhutam ।
jātaṃ rādhe! mahācamatkāramayaṃ hi tacchṛṇu ।।99।।
sarve vadanti gantavyaṃ śiveśvarapuraṃ prati ।
ambarāt kena vidhinā kailāsaṃ pravihāya ca ।। 1.286.10 0।।
tāvadvai śaṃbhunā tatra drutaṃ yogabalena vai ।
kailāsakaṃ samagraṃ vai śanaiḥ samavatāritam ।। 101 ।।
bhuvaṃ prati yathāyogyaṃ śiveśvarapuraṃ prati ।
kailāsanagaraṃ sarvaṃ śivasṛjyapure tadā ।। 1 02।।
avatīryā'ntarbhāvaṃ prajagāma samavigrahe ।
udyāneṣu tadudyānāḥ kuṃjeṣu ca nikuṃjakāḥ ।। 1 03।।
prāsādeṣu tathā prāsādakāścāntarhitāstadā ।
vimānānāmāśrayeṣu vimānānyabhavaँstadā ।। 1 04।।
yeṣāṃ kṛte tu ye tatrā''vāsāḥ pūrvaṃ prakalpitāḥ ।
mahīmānāsta evaite tadāvāseṣu tatra ha ।। 1 05।।
niṣeduḥ sukhasampannāḥ kanyāvāseṣu kanyakāḥ ।
rājā''vāseṣu rājānaḥ sādhvāvāseṣu sādhavaḥ ।। 1 06।।
ṛṣyāvāseṣu ṛṣayo devāvāseṣu devatāḥ ।
īśāvāseṣvīśvarāśca muktāvāseṣu muktakāḥ ।। 1 07।।
kṛṣṇā''vāse hariścāpi tvanyāvāseṣu cānyakāḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāseṣu yathāyogyaṃ hi rādhike ।। 108।।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāso vai naisargiko'bhavattadā ।
kailāsaṃ līnatāṃ yātaṃ dṛśyate śivapattanam ।। 1 09।।
āvāsāँstūrṇamāpādya snānaśuddhiṃ pracakrire ।
tataścakrurbhojanāni smṛddheṣu mandireṣu vai ।। 1.286.11 0।।
tāmbūlaṃ jagṛhuścāpi viśrāntiṃ jagṛhustataḥ ।
manorañjanadṛśyāni vīkṣya nidrāmagustataḥ ।। 111 ।।
dāsā dāsyo dehasaṃvāhanādyaṃ cakrire tadā ।
śiveśvarādayo naijān gṛhān rātrau samāyayuḥ ।। 1 12।।
kanyāpakṣā mahīmānāḥ kṛtvā bhojanamuttamam ।
viśrāntiṃ lebhire nidrāṃ rādhike sukhino'bhavam ।। 11 3।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cākāśakailāse vāditraiḥ kṛṣṇavāhinyāḥ śaṃkareṇa bahurūpaiḥ kṛtaṃ svāgataṃ cābhivardhanaṃ pūjanaṃ sanmānaṃ, miṣṭānnajalapayaḥpānatāmbūladānaṃ, naranārīṇāṃ parasparaṃ kuśalā'nāmayapraśnāḥ, kailāsasya tirobhāvaḥ, śivapure'vataraṇaṃ, bhojanādi, rātrau viśrāntiścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 286 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 287

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! sukhamāpannāḥ sevābhirmahīmānakāḥ ।
apūrvasukhabhoktāro'bhavan śivapure tadā ।। 1 ।।
saṃkalpānusṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yatra samupatiṣṭhate ।
divye śivapure tatra caturthyāṃ tu prage janāḥ ।। 2 ।।
vāditrairmaṃgalaiścāpi yaśaḥśravaṇagītibhiḥ ।
nidrāṃ jahurmahīmānāḥ sasnuḥ śuddhiprapūrvakam ।। 3 ।।
pupūjuśca hariṃ cakruḥ svādhyāyaṃ ca japādikam ।
kanyakānāṃ gītayaścā'jāyanta tatra maṃgalāḥ ।। 4 ।।
gṛhe gṛheṃ'gaṇe daghnā yavāṃkuraiśca kesaraiḥ ।
raṃgaiśca kuṃkumaiścāpi raṃgavallyo'bhavan kṛtāḥ ।। 5 ।।
svastikāścāpi padmāni kṛtānyāsan puraḥ puraḥ ।
toraṇāni dhṛtānyāsan baddhāścāsan dhvajāstathā ।। 6 !।
vādyānāṃ ninadāścāsan maṇḍape ca gṛhe gṛhe ।
prātaścoṣṇajalādyaiśca vidhayo'pi tadā'bhavan ।। 7 ।।
sarveṣāṃ tu prage dugdhapānaṃ miṣṭānnasaṃyutam ।
śivasvāmisakāśādvai tadā'bhavadyatheṣṭakam ।
vṛddhānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi tadā'bhavad yathocitam ।। 8 ।।
atha snātā śivaputrī śṛṃgāritā vibhūṣitā ।
sakhībhiḥ pitaraṃ natvā natvā ca mātaraṃ tathā ।। 9 ।।
koṭicandrānanā ramyā sarvā''bhūṣaṇaśobhitā ।
kuladevaprapūjārthaṃ padbhyāṃ sāmagrikāyutā ।। 2.287.1 0।।
prayayau hanumantaṃ ca durgā pūjayituṃ satī ।
koṭikanyāyutā cāpi saubhāgyapramadānvitā ।। 1 1।।
gāyikābhiḥ samāyuktā vāditranādarañjitā ।
svarṇakalaśamūrdhābhirnārībhirveṣṭitā satī ।। 12।।
pañcagavyādiyuktābhiḥ kanyābhirveṣṭitā hyapi ।
pūjāsāmagrikāsthālayuktābhiḥ saha śobhanā ।। 13।।
vahnyujjvalāṃ'śukābhiśca saubhāgyābhiśca vardhitā ।
prathamaṃ sā yayau durgāṃ pupūja parameśvarīm ।। 14।।
pañcāmṛtaiścandanādyaiḥ payobhistīrthavāribhiḥ ।
kuṃkumā'kṣatakastūrīkaisaradravadravyakaiḥ ।। 16।।
sugandhipuṣpahārādyairnaivedyaiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ ।
miṣṭānnairjalapānādyaistāmbūlakaiḥ suvarṇakaiḥ ।। 16।।
dakṣiṇābhiśca pātraiśca nīrājanaiḥ stavaistathā ।
pradakṣiṇairnamaskāraiḥ kṣamāparādhanārthanaiḥ ।। 17।।
pupūja durgāṃ ca tataḥ śāṭīṃ ca kañcukīṃ tathā ।
ghargharīṃ naktakaṃ prā''rpya nupūre cormikāstathā ।। 18।।
śṛṃkhale raśanāṃ cāpi svarṇahārān maṇīn śubhān ।
kaṭake valaye cā'ṅgulīyakāni ca padmakam ।। 19।।
tantikāṃ natthikāṃ svarṇakuṇḍale patrikāṃ tathā ।
candrakaṃ ca prakoṣṭhayorvalaye bhūṣaṇānyapi ।।2.287.20।।
samastāni dadau durgādevyai provāca vai tataḥ ।
mātarme bhagavadyoge prodvāhe syādavighnatā ।। 21 ।।
draṣṭavyā'haṃ tvayā durge sarvadā yāmi yatra vai ।
durgā'pi rādhike tatra vihasyā''ha tathāstviti ।।22।।
evaṃ durgāṃ prapūjyaiva prāpya prāsādikaṃ phalam ।
yayau śrīhanumantaṃ sā tapo'rthaṃ tvāśrayapradam ।।23।।
gatvā natvā vāyuputraṃ śāṃkaraṃ bhrātaraṃ suram ।
pañcāmṛtaṃ jalaṃ datvā candanaṃ cārkamālikām ।। 24।।
kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatān svarṇamālāṃ sindūrakaṃ tathā ।
tailaṃ sugandhisāraṃ ca bhūṣāmbarāṇi cāpi vai ।।25।।
śarkarāṃ vaṭakān datvā miṣṭānnāni śubhāni ca ।
jalapānaṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ phalaṃ datvā ca dakṣiṇām ।।26।।।
nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā stavanaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam ।
kṣamāmayācata lakṣmīstapaḥsiddhisahāyaka ।। 27।।
bhrātaḥ rakṣa sadā māṃ tvaṃ bhagavadyogakāraka ।
nirvighno me suyogaḥ syād bālakṛṣṇena śārṅgiṇā ।।28।।
jagannāthena nāthena sukhyahaṃ syāṃ tathā kuru ।
ityabhyarthita evā'sau hanūmānāha vai svasaḥ ।।29।।
tathāstviti sadā saubhāgyavatī bhava duḥkhahe ।
atha natvā prasādaṃ ca gṛhītvā svasakhīyutā ।।2.287.3 0 ।।
samāyayau hi viśveśaṃ pitaraṃ mandirasthitam ।
viśveśvaraṃ subahudhā payasā madhunā tathā ।।3 1।।
dadhnā ghṛtena ca śarkarayā tīrthajalena ca ।
snāpayitvā gandhasāraḥ sampūjyā''rpya nivedanam ।।।32।।।
ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣamāṃ kṛpāmayācata ।
nirvighnatāṃ maṃgale cā'yācatā'pi tathāstviti ।।3 3।।
viśveśvaraḥ pitā prāha yayau tato'nnapūrṇikām ।
prapūjya mātaraṃ tathā prā''rpya śṛṃgārakaṃ tathā ।।34।।
nivedanaṃ dadau cāpi nīrājanaṃ vyadhāttataḥ ।
annapūrṇāṃ cakārā'syā bhāle sā'kṣatacandrakam ।।35।।
akhaṇḍasaubhāgyavatī śāśvatajīvanī bhava ।
āśīrvādaṃ dadau cātha kanyā natvā gaṇeśakam ।।36।।
dūrvāsindūralaḍḍūbhiḥ prapūjya tu sarasvatīm ।
gaṃgāṃ yayau paṃcagaṃgāṃ dharmaṃ devaṃ pupūja ca ।।37।।
natvā datvā ca dānāni svarṇarūpyamayāni hi ।
maṇimāṇikyahārāँśca ratnāni mauktikāni ca ।। 38।।
āśīrvādān samagṛhya prajānāṃ ca tato gṛham ।
nijālayaṃ prāyayau ca natvā śivapuraṃ satī ।। 39।।
madhyāhne tvatha sarvābhyaḥ sakhībhyo bhojanaṃ dadau ।
lakṣmīścakre sakhībhyaśca pariveṣaṇamutsukā ।।2.287.40।।
himajānagarā''vāsamahīmānastriyastadā ।
bubhujuḥ koṭiśaḥ paṃktau miṣṭānnāni samantataḥ ।।41।।
ābālavṛddhā nāryo vai tṛptā jātā hi bhojanaiḥ ।
nāryaśca śivapuragā mahīmānastriyastathā ।।42।।
bubhujurbhojanānyeva samastāḥ kanyakādikāḥ ।
tato narāśca bubhujuḥ pattanobhayavāsinaḥ ।।43।।
śivarājagṛhasthāśca kāśyāścāpi prajājanāḥ ।
bubhujuḥ koṭyarbudābjā īśā devāśca mānavāḥ ।।44।।
meśubhān mohanasthālān māṣalaḍḍūn sumauktikān ।
cūrṇalaḍḍūn dugdhapākān pāyasān kṣīrapolikāḥ ।।45।।
miṣṭapolīḥ pūrikāśca sūtrapheṇīṃ ca barphikām ।
dugdhasārāṃ biraṃjaṃ ca śaṣkulīṃ khājakān baṭīḥ ।।46 ।।
apūpān pūpasaṃyāvān bindulaḍaḍūn prabharjikān ।
śrīkhaṇḍān śatachidrāँśca jāmbūkān ghevarāँstathā ।।47 ।।
piṇḍakān granthakāँścāpi kalikā ghurghurāँstathā ।
vaṭān phullavaṭīścāpi śarkarāktā badāmikāḥ ।। 48 ।।
caṇakāँstaṇḍulāँścāpi bharjitān pācitānapi ।
sūpaudanaṃ ca kvathikāḥ śākāni vividhāni ca ।।49 ।।
bhājāśca vividhāścāpi sudhāścā'mṛtakāni ca ।
takrāṇi peyadravyāṇi cośyāni satphalāni ca ।।2.287.5 0 ।।
rasān lehyān bhakṣyakaṇānāranālāni cāpi ha ।
parpaṭān caṭanīścāpi kṣārikāḥ saṃskṛtānapi ।।5 1 ।।
miṣṭaphalāni ca tathā cārdrabījāni yāni ca ।
śimbikāśca tathā vallān gundrapākādikāँstathā ।। 52 ।।
kandapākān vicitrāँśca phalapākān gariṣṭakān ।
rājikārāddhamevāpi phalacūrṇāni yāni ca ।।53 ।।
vanyān kandān kṛṣikandān cā'kṛṣṭapacyakauṣadhīḥ ।
kalpapādapasañjātān bhakṣyabhojyān pramiṣṭakān ।।54 ।।
bubhujuśca papuścāpi pīyūṣāṇi viśeṣataḥ ।
tattallokīyabhojyāni tebhyo tebhyo dadau haraḥ ।। 55।।
tattajjātīyapeyāni tebhyo tebhyo dadau haraḥ ।
tāmcūlakāni ramyāṇi svādvantyānanaśodhikāḥ ।।56 ।।
vāṭikāśca dadau śrīmān śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
bubhujuśca mahīmānāstato'tithijanā api ।।57।।
bhikṣukāśca dīnajanā anāthā narayoṣitaḥ ।
karmacārāstathā bhṛtyā dāsā dāsyo'nugā'nugāḥ ।। 58।।
pārṣadā dvārapālāśca tathaiva pariveṣakāḥ ।
rakṣakā darśakāścāpi bubhujurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ । ।59 ।।
jaḍāśca cetanāścāpi īśā devāśca mānavāḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāsāśca mahīmānāśca ye'tra ca ।।2.287.6 0 ।।
sarve te pūrṇatṛptā vai jātā bhojanasattamaiḥ ।
sarve viśrāntimāpuśca mahīmānāstataḥ kṣaṇam ।। 61 ।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇo'sau jñātuṃ dārḍhya śivasya tu ।
bhūtvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpo'sau śiveśvaraḥ yayau drutam ।।6 2।।
rahasye śivadevaṃ tu gatvā prāha śṛṇu priya ।
putraḥ yogyaṃ ca vā'yogyaṃ kathayāmīha me śṛṇu ।। 63 ।।
bhavān jānātu yaṃ kaṃ vā jānāmyenaṃ vadāmi ca ।
patnīvratasya putro'yaṃ vipro vai bhikṣuko'sti hi ।।64।।
bālakṛṣṇo'sti vai nāmnā bālaśo dīnajanmavān ।
bhikṣukāya sutā naiva deyā rājñā kathaṃcana ।।65।।
videśasthāya tatrāpi naiva deyā kathaṃcana ।
jātyā samena kanyāyā pradānaṃ śobhate sukhaḥ ।।66।।
vijātinā tu loke'tra duḥkhaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।
anyaccāpi śarīreṇa kṛṣṇo'yaṃ dṛśyate'balaḥ ।।67।।
dhavalāyāstava putrā yaugalye śobhate'pi na ।
tathā'nyatte kathayāmi purāṇo'yaṃ vilokyate ।।68।।
kanyeyaṃ komalā svalpavarṣīyā dīyate katham ।
tathā'nyaccāpi rājendra kumārāya kumārikā ।।69।।
deyā cet sukhamicchethāḥ kanyāyāḥ śāśvataṃ tadā ।
bālakṛṣṇo'tra vai koṭivadhūbhiḥ saha cāgataḥ ।। 2.287.70।।
tatreyaṃ kiyatī bālā gaṇanāyāṃ bhaviṣyati ।
sapatnīnāṃ kalahastu viṣād vahnestu duḥsahaḥ ।।71 ।।
śṛṇu tvanyattathā cā'sya sarvabhakṣitvamasti hi ।
bhuṃkte sarvapradattaṃ ca hyekadharmo'sya nāstyāpi ।।72।।।
amāyī cāpi tu sadā nirguṇo'yaṃ pravidyate ।
kiṃ cā'yaṃ vartate nityaṃ munivṛttiparāyaṇaḥ ।।73।।।
rantuṃ naivā'pi jānāti kāmanāvarjito'sti ca ।
māyāmāro vidyate'sau māyāṃ kartuṃ na vetyasau ।।74।।
paśya gopālakarmā'sya pitā gopālasadṛśaḥ ।
gopālakṛṣṇanāmā'sti bhinnakarmasamāśritaḥ ।।75।।
kṣatriyeṇa na viprāya bhinnakarmakṛte sutā ।
deyeti sarvathā budhvā yatheṣṭaṃ te tathā kuru ।।76।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau śrīkṛṣṇo bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
viśveśvarastu pitaraṃ natvā prāha vicārya vai ।।77।।
pitaḥ putryā bhālarekhā sañcitaṃ ca tathā purā ।
vidyate viprarūpeṇa sākaṃ tatra pradānakam ।।78।।
patnīvrato mahāviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ pṛthvyāṃ hi vartate ।
jānāmi yogadṛṣṭyaiva tatputraṃ puruṣottamam ।।79।।
sadābhikṣākaraścāyaṃ bhaktānāṃ snehaśālinām ।
parabrahma svayaṃ cāste kathaṃ deyā na putrikā ।।2.287.80।।
dīnārthaṃ janmavānāste bālināṃ śaṃprado hariḥ ।
bālātmanāṃ nirmalānāṃ kṛṣiṃ mokṣaṃ karoti saḥ ।।81 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo hariścāste'kṣaradhāmādhipaḥ prabhuḥ ।
rājñā mayā mahārājñe bhikṣukāya tu śārṅgiṇe ।।82।।
pradātavyā sutā tatra yaśolābhodayo'sti hi ।
videśo'syā'kṣaraṃ brahma tasmai deyā kathaṃ na vai ।।83।।
jātyā samā mama putrī brahmaṇā brāhmaṇī tviyam ।
jātirna dehajā kvāpi guṇajā vidyate sadā ।।84।।
brāhmī lakṣmīrmama kanyā brahmaṇā saha yujyate ।
kṛṣṇo'yaṃ sārthakaścāste pāpasaṃkarṣaṇāt tathā ।।85।।
svadhāmanayanāccāpi kṛṣṇo'yaṃ ca yathā bhavān ।
purāṇo'yaṃ tu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ।।86।।
purāṇī me kanyakā nārāyaṇī puruṣottamī ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñasya tanvaḥ sarvāḥ prajā matāḥ ।।87।।
vadhvaḥ sarvā harestāśca samarthasya na dūṣaṇam ।
bāleyaṃ dṛśyate tvadya sugrāhyā tena śārṅgiṇā ।।88।।
sarvāsāmagragaṇyā ca gaṇanā sā mahottamā ।
sāpatnyaṃ nāsti kṛṣṇāgre rāgadveṣaharo hi saḥ ।।89।।
sarvabhakṣitvamevā'sya parātmano hi yujyate ।
bhūṣaṇaṃ dharmadharturvai sarvadharmātmanaḥ prabhoḥ ।।2.287.90।।
māyā vai bandhadā yatra nāsti santi na tadguṇāḥ ।
sādhuvartana evā'sau sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
nyāyavartana evā'sau vartate cāpyahiṃsakaḥ ।
munireva sadā cāste vedāḥ śvāsāstathā'sya ha ।।92।।
gāyanti suguṇān śaśvat maunaṃ cāsyaiva bhūṣaṇam ।
apūrṇasya pitaḥ sañjāyate vai kāmanā muhuḥ ।।93।।
sarvasampatprapūrṇasya sarvānandabhṛtasya ca ।
sarvātmakasya kṛṣṇasyā'kāmatvaṃ tu guṇo mahān ।।94।।
ramaṇaṃ viṣayotthaṃ vai nā'yaṃ jānāti yatparaḥ ।
putrī me'pi tathā cāste māyāparā ramātmikā ।।95।।
bandhadāyāśca prakṛternāśako'yaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
kuhakaṃ na karotyeva māyāparo hi so'sti ca ।।96 ।।
gopālastvaṃ pitā cāste gopālaḥ so'pi tatpitā ।
vaiśyayoḥ sahamelastu bhāgyādevā'tra saṃgataḥ ।। 97।।
viś praveśane'to veṣṭā cāntaryāmī prabhurhiṃ saḥ ।
lakṣmīḥ sṛṣṭitraye sarvapraviṣṭā'ntarniyāmikā ।।98।।
tayostu saṃgatiryogyā sarvadaiva praśasyate ।
kṣatriyaḥ sarvadā rakṣākaraḥ śaraṇavāsinām ।।99।।
bhagavān śrībālakṛṣṇaḥ kṣatriyo vai kathaṃ na hi ।
kṣatriyā mama putrī ca kṣatriyo bhagavānapi ।। 2.287.1 00।।
dvayoryogo'sti vai bhāgyād prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।
śubho me bhāti tasmātta pitaḥ śaṃkā na rocate ।। 101 ।।
ityuktavantaṃ śrutvaiva hṛdaye hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।
putraṃ tathāstvabhidhāya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prayayau tataḥ ।। 1 02।।
rādhike'tha tataścāpi bālakṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
śāṃbhavī cāpi vijñātuṃ strībhūtvā prayayau gṛham ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne caturthyāṃ prage kṛtaṃ maṃgalaṃ, kanyākṛtaṃ kuladevatāpūjanam, mahīmānānāṃ bhojanādi, bālakṛṣṇasya śrīkṛṣṇarūpasya śiveśvareṇa saha kanyā na deyetisaṃvādaḥ, taduttarāṇi, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 287 ।।



← adhyāyaḥ 287 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 288
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 289 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ca tataḥ śrīmadbālakṛṣṇastataḥ param ।
rādhārūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yayau śrīpārvatī gṛham ।। 1 ।।
tvāṃ sā snuṣā pārvatī ca vīkṣyotthāyā''sanaṃ dadau ।
rahasye'syai rādhikā provāca śṛṇu hitāvaham ।। 2 ।।
mātā sā kathyate putryāḥ śreyaskarī sadā bhavet ।
dānamātraṃ na draṣṭavyaṃ draṣṭavyo'syāstathā''yatiḥ ।। 3 ।।
uttare syāt sutā nityasukhinīti matā matiḥ ।
nārīvargeṣu duḥkhaṃ cet sāpatnyaṃ sarvato'dhikam ।। 4 ।।
mayā tvadya śrutaṃ tadvai yasmai pradīyate sutā ।
sa cāsti bālyato bhūmau patirvai koṭiyoṣitām ।। 5 ।।
yāstāḥ sarvāścāgatā vai pitrādibhiḥ samaṃ tviha ।
pratyakṣaṃ vartate tvetat putrī syāt tatra duḥkhitā ।। 6 ।।
mamā'sti tatra vaimatyaṃ tasmād deyā na pārvati! ।
bahustrīṇāṃ samavāye bhogā bhinno bhavanti hi ।। 7 ।।
sampadā ca vibhāgāḥ syuḥ paryāptāḥ syurna te tataḥ ।
bahunārīmataḥ puṃso nāryastṛptiṃ na yanti hi ।। 8 ।।
rājñāṃ saṃghaṭata sarvaṃ pṛthvīrājyavataḥ khalu ।
ayaṃ tu vidyate vipro jāmātā vaiśyakarmavān ।। 9 ।।
nāsti grāmo'sya vāṭī vā kṣetraṃ vā cāpaṇādikam ।
bhikṣā tvasyā'sti vṛttirvai kathaṃ syāt sukhinī sutā ।। 2.288.10 ।।
gṛhe nā'syā'sti vittaṃ vai darśayatyadhikaṃ bahiḥ ।
nāradoktyā'rpitā cāpi vāgdāne'pi viyujyate ।। 11 ।।
tasmād deyā na vai lakṣmīḥ susukhā duḥkhinī bhavet ।
vada snuṣe mataṃ te'tra mayoktaṃ tapatā hṛdā ।। 12।।
arogāya kumārāya suśīlāya suyogine ।
dhanavate'dvibhāryāya sutā deyā surūpiṇe ।। 13 ।।
kuṭumbine samasthāya godhanāya mahīmate ।
svabāhūpārjitasampadyuktāya guṇaśāline ।। 14 ।।
kīrtimate samarthāya kāmanāpūrakāya ca ।
patnīṃ tu devatāṃ matvā sukhadātre yaśasvine ।। 15।।
rāmāya dharmayuktāya kanyā deyā suvedine ।
anye guṇāstato vīkṣyā asāpatnyottaraṃ tadā ।। 16।।
sāpatnyaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tvāgryaṃ narakaṃ sarvadā gṛhe ।
apatyānāṃ mānyatā ca dhruvavannaiva syācca vā ।। 17।।
rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātaśca candrasyeva bhavettathā ।
virajāyāśca rādhāyā me yathā tu kaliḥ purā ।। 18।।
goloke'pyabhavattena duḥkhaṃ sāpatnyameva yat ।
mayoktaṃ me tu yadbhātaṃ snuṣe kuru yathocitam ।। 1 9।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! rādhāvākyaṃ śrutvā tu pārvatī ।
śiveśvarapriyā prāha pūjyā nirṇayamuttamam ।। 2.288.20 ।।
puṇyo'yaṃ bālakṛṣṇo'sti parabrahma sanātanaḥ ।
patiḥ pūrṇānandaśca sāgaraḥ saritāṃ yathā ।।2 1 ।।
pūrṇasmṛddhaḥ pūrṇavīryaḥ pūrṇaguṇo virājate ।
asmādeva samutpannaṃ sarvaṃ vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalam ।।22।।
rogaścintā ca sā nāsti pūrṇakāmasya vai prabhoḥ ।
kumāratvaṃ sadā cāste'viplutasyā'sya yoginaḥ ।। 23 ।।
śīlākhyaṃ ca vrataṃ tvasya gīyate śrutimūrdhasu ।
yogī cāyaṃ yogavettā nirodhavān sadā'sti ca ।।24।।
sarvaṃ dhanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena so'yaṃ vai śreṣṭhisattamaḥ ।
medinī ca kṛtā tena vasavastena nirmitāḥ ।। 25।।
kuberatvaṃ nirmitaṃ ca tenā'to dhanavattamaḥ ।
yāvatyo'sya bhaveyuśca bhāryāstāvattanūdharaḥ ।।26।।
bhāryāṃ bhāryāṃ pṛthag bhuṃkte vartate'pi pṛthak sadā ।
advibhāryastataścā'yaṃ candramovanna dūṣaṇam ।।27।।
rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūvā'yaṃ surūpavān ।
kuṭumbaṃ cā'kṣare dhāmni cā'saṃkhyaṃ yasya vidyate ।।28।।
yasyaiva pratibimbāni santyavatārakoṭayaḥ ।
īśvarā manavo rudrā lokapālāśca viṣṇavaḥ ।।29।।
asyaiva santyavatārā ādityāḥ ṛṣayo'malāḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ tvasya vidyate sārvabhaumaṃ mayā śrutam ।।2.288.3 0।।
sarvāsu samabhāvena tvāste'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
pratyutā'dhikabhāvena yāvat tṛptiḥ prajāyate ।। 3 1।।
samastho viṣamastho vā patnyāḥ sukhaprado'sti saḥ ।
godhanaṃ cāpi goloke śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ tvayā mayā ।।32।।
kāmadughāḥ sadā tvasya sevāyāṃ santi saṃśrutam ।
mahī cā'sya samagrā'sti rājānaḥ śvaśurā yataḥ ।।33 ।।
svabāhūpārjitā sampat sākṣādatra vilokyate ।
kāśīyātrā'sya vai cāste koṭisṛṣṭisamanvitā ।।34।।
asya mātā svayaṃ mahālakṣmīreva virājate ।
pitā cāsya mahāviṣṇurgopālo'sti virājakṛt ।।35।।
aṣṭau mahāguṇāścātra vidyante śrutibodhitāḥ ।
nityā apahatapāpmatvādayaḥ parameśvare ।।36।।
satyaṃ śaucaṃ tathā'nye ca navatriṃśadguṇāstathā ।
asaṃkhyāśca guṇāstvatra vidyante nityayoginaḥ ।।37।।
kīrtirvedeṣu cāsyā'sti dhāmasu ceśvareṣvapi ।
deveṣu mānave loke sarvapātālakeṣvapi ।।38।।
samartho'sti mokṣado'sti mokṣārthaṃ kanyakā mayā ।
dattā'sti dīyate cāpi kā tatra parivedanā ।।39।।
kāmanāpūrakaścā'yaṃ vidyate parameśvaraḥ ।
bhaktakāmaprapūro'sti sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ ।।2.288.40 ।।
patnīṃ svāṃ devatātulyāṃ manyate'sau sadīśvaraḥ ।
sukhadoyaṃ yaśoyukto rāmo ramaṇako hi saḥ ।।41 ।।
sarvadharmabharo'styeva vidvānasti purātanaḥ ।
asāpatnyaṃ sadā cātra bahubhāryayute'styapi ।।42।।
nātra nyūnaguṇaiśvaryaṃ yena vai dhruvavad bhavet ।
candravad vā ca golokavadvā nātra tu saṃbhavet ।।43।।
haste'sya santi cihnāni matsyadhvajadhanūँṣi ca ।
śaraśūlasvasticakradaṇḍādyāḥ pārameśvarāḥ ।।44।।
śarīre'sya bhavantyeva sāmudralakṣaṇānyapi ।
mayā śrutaṃ samastaṃ tannāradasya mukhāttataḥ ।।45।।
kanyā dattā sthale sthāne'rpaṇayogye pareśvare ।
tasmānmātaḥ suputrī me sukhinī bhāgyaśālinī ।।46।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ labdhvā varottamam ।
tayā tapaḥ purā bālye ghoraṃ taptaṃ himālaye ।।47।।
hanūmadāśrame tatra so'yaṃ divyarūpadhṛk ।
varaṃ lakṣmyai patitvena datvā cā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।48।।
tataḥ putrī gṛhaṃ yātā māmāha tamudantakam ।
tata ārabhya sā pratīkṣate dvādaśavarṣakam ।
svasyāḥ kṛṣṇasya tu varṣaṃ pūrṇaṃ coktaṃ caturdaśam ।।49।।
so'yaṃ vai vidyate śreṣṭhaḥ samayaḥ samupāgataḥ ।
mama gṛhe samāyāto bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।।2.288.50 ।।
kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmyadya pūjyo me puruṣottamaḥ ।
mahālakṣmīrvidhātryasyā vidyate bhāgyaśālinī ।।51 ।।
kṛtakṛtyā ca me putrī tava pautrī sadā''ryake ।
ityuktā rādhikā sā ca maunamāśritya cāśiṣā ।।52।।
samāyujya yayau naijālayaṃ sā'pi tiro'bhavat ।
bālakṛṣṇo dṛḍhaṃ jñātvā bhāvaṃ tu vṛddhayornije ।।53 ।।
mumude cātihṛṣṭaśca lakṣmīṃ prati yayau rahaḥ ।
viprarūpo bālakṛṣṇaḥ provāca hradayā'gamam ।।54।।
śṛṇu putri pradānaṃ te mayā śrutaṃ pravartate ।
rājaputrīṃ pariṇetumāgato'styapi bhūsuraḥ ।।55।।
bhikṣuko'sau rājyahīnaḥ śruto mayā'bdhitīragaḥ ।
dhīvaro hi yathā tadvad gopālo vartate'pyasau ।।56।।
nā'sya gṛhe'sti vai sampannā'yaṃ vadhūvrato'sti ca ।
paraṃ naiva kumāro'pi koṭinārīpatirhi saḥ ।।57।।
śruto mayaivaṃvidhiko nāryo'syā'pyāgatāstviha ।
vidyante hi samānārthaṃ tvayā saha sthitāstviha ।।58।।।
maṇḍape tvāgamiṣyanti bhramiṣyanti pradakṣiṇam ।
vahniṃ sākṣye'tra saṃsthāpya sapatnyaste hi kanyake ।।59।।
kimidaṃ rocate tubhyaṃ sapatnyastava maṇḍape ।
mā taṃ vṛṇu rājaputri bahunārīpatiṃ dvijam ।।2.288.60।।
rājānaṃ vṛṇu rājendri nārāyaṇāṃśameva ha ।
dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca garīyāṃsaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।।6 1 ।।
tvaṃ cāste sundarī ramyā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā ।
navayauvanasaṃveśā tejasojjvalitā satī ।।62।।
taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī ।
pativratā satyaśīlā śāntā śreṣṭhaguṇānvitā ।।63 ।।
indrāṇī varuṇānī ca rohiṇī ca kalāvatī ।
svāhā saṃjñā ca sāvitrī kuberāṇī ca vidyase ।।64।।
anyāsu śreṣṭhakāntāsu śreṣṭhatamā virājase ।
śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyā śaratkamalalocanā ।।65।।
mā vipraṃ vṛṇu rājendri bhikṣukaṃ dūravāsinam ।
śrutvaivaṃ kanyakā prāha viprarūpaṃ nijaṃ patim ।।66।।
vipro'si mama pūjyo'si mā'vocastadvacaḥ punaḥ ।
anyathā daṇḍapātraṃ syāḥ, yāhi tatrā''gato yataḥ ।।67।।
bhikṣuko yādṛśo vāpi tādṛśo vā bhavedapi ।
mayā parīkṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādaṃgīkṛto mama ।। 68।।
rājyaṃ yasyā'sti vai sārvabhaumaṃ sṛṣṭitrayātmakam ।
kṣīrābdhitīragaḥ so'yaṃ sarvajño dhīvaro patiḥ ।।69 ।।
gavāṃ ca tejasāṃ cāpi pālako'sau virājate ।
sarvāśca sampadastvasya ceśāvāsyamidaṃ yataḥ ।। 2.288.70 ।।
bhaktimatīvrato nityaṃ vartate hi priyāvrataḥ ।
koṭinārīpatiścāpi sadordhvasattvavānayam ।। 7 1 ।।
sadā kumārakaścāste jānāmyenaṃ purābhave ।
tathā vidito'styevā'khaṇḍordhvaretāḥ prayogavān ।।72 ।।
vipra nāryaḥ koṭisaṃkhyā yadi me maṇḍape tviha ।
mama pṛṣṭhe bhramiṣyanti tatra me gauravaṃ bhavet ।।।73 ।।
sapatnīnāṃ hi sarvāsāmagrapūjyā bhavāmi yat। ।
agnisākṣye mama sāmye bhavantu koṭiyoṣitaḥ ।।74।।
asya tato'pyadhikāśca bhavantu me'tra gauravam ।
paripūrṇo milennāthastadā'śaṃ vṛṇuyāddhi kā ।।76।।
yathā so'yaṃ dūravāsā tathā'haṃ dūravāsinī ।
dvayorvai melanaṃ yogyaṃ mā cintā vaha bhūsura । । 76।।
indrādyā yadvaśe santi brahmādyāśca vaśe'sya tu ।
vairājādyā vaśe cā'sya vyūhāścāsya vaśe'pi ca ।। 77 ।।
avatārā vaśe cāsya kā kanyā vṛṇuyānna tam ।
pūrvākhyānaṃ ca vedoktaṃ jānāsyeva na tacchruṇu ।। 78।।
kṛpayā bhagavān sākṣācchrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
uddhārārthaṃ hi lokānāṃ bhaktānāṃ cāpi sarvathā । ।79।।
bālakṛṣṇo'yamevā''ste paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ ।
kambharāśrīsakāśādvai gopālakṛṣṇasadgṛhe ।।2.288.8 0 ।।
jāto'sti parameśaḥ sa rādhāramāsatīpatiḥ ।
vidhātuśca vidhātā saḥ brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ ।।8 1 । ।
jyotiḥsvarūpo bhagavān paramātmā parātparaḥ ।
nirliptaśca nirīhaśca sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām । ।82 । ।
hṛdayasthaśca sarvasthastadarthaṃ cāhamāgatā ।
dhāmnaḥ pūrvaṃ tamevā'tra varayāmi na cetaram । ।83 । ।
samarpitā'haṃ tatraiva svātmanā paramātmani ।
vidhātrā likhitā rekhā tasyārthaṃ mama bhūsura । ।84। ।
paśya taṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।
dhyānānurodhahetuṃ ca nityadivyasurūpiṇam । ।85। ।
darśanāt kuru viprendra svajanmakarmakhaṇḍanam ।
yaṃ na jānanti catvāro vedāḥ santaśca devatāḥ ।।86।।
saddhendrāśca munīndrāśca devā brahmādayo hyapi ।
dhyāyante dhyānamagnāśca yogino'pi na yanti yam ।।87।।
sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā varṇane yasya jāyate ।
sahasravaktraḥ śeṣo'pi pañcavaktraḥ sadāśivaḥ ।।88 ।।
caturmukho jagaddhātā kumāraḥ kārtikastathā ।
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi bhaktāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ ।।89।।
akṣamāḥ stavane yasya dhyānā'sādhyaśca yoginām ।
bālikā'haṃ vipravarya! tadgaṇān kathayāmi kim ।।2.288.90।।
vṛtā'smi taṃ sadā vipra tadarthaṃ cāsmi bhāminī ।
kanyā cāpi tadarthā'haṃ viśveśvarasya putrikā ।।91 ।।
bhaktaputrīha sañjātā bhūmau bhagavadarthinī ।
pātivratyaṃ hi tannāma kanyātve yo hṛdi sthitaḥ ।।92।।
manasā ca dhṛto nāthaḥ sa eva jīvanaṃ sadā ।
hṛdayasya pradānaṃ vai hṛdayena prajāyate ।।93 ।।
sthūladehapradānaṃ tu paścātsthūlena jāyate ।
vyavahārapravāhārthaṃ loke'sti kalpitaḥ sthūlaḥ ।।94।।
so'yaṃ me'dya vijānīhi yāhi taddarśanaṃ kuru ।
yāvattvayā na dṛṣṭo'sti sarvakānto mahāprabhuḥ ।।95।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīprāṇavallabhaḥ ।
tāvadvai bhāṣase me'trā'śrāvyaṃ vipra kṣamāṃ vaha ।।96।।
ityukto bhagavānāha dārḍhyaṃ cedṛk tavā'sti cet ।
kṣantavyaṃ yanmayoktaṃ tat prayāmi paśya māṃ punaḥ ।।97।।
ityuktvā nijanāmāḍhyaṃ dadau svarṇāṃgulīyakam ।
darśanaṃ divyarūpaṃ ca dadau svaparicāyakam ।।98।।
hārakeyūrakaṭakakuṇḍalādyairvirājitam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapītāmbarādiśobhitam ।।99।।
lakṣmīrnāthaṃ dvijātmānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vīkṣya yathārthakam ।
pādayoḥ patitā śīghraṃ kṣaṇaṃ taṃ pariṣasvaje ।। 2.288.10 0।।
priye sāyaṃ samāyāmītyuktvā miṣṭaṃ vacaḥ priyam ।
tūrṇaṃ tirobabhūvaiva sā tvānandapariplutā ।। 10 1।।
viveda na kṣaṇaṃ tatrātmānaṃ tadgatamānasā ।
bhānamāsādya śanakaiḥ pramodānvitavigrahā ।। 1 02।।
dhanyabhāgyaṃ nijaṃ mene rādhike! ramaṇīvarā ।
gāmbhīryaṃ rakṣamāṇā sā novācedaṃ prakāśane ।। 1 03।।
ityevaṃ bhagavān bhāvaṃ vividā'nyatsvarūpadhṛk ।
ātmanivedibhaktānāṃ bhaktivaśyo'bhavaddhi saḥ ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya rādhārūpasya pārvatyā saha 'kanyā na deyeti'samvādaḥ, viprarūpasya 'mā vipraṃ bhikṣukaṃ vṛṇu' iti lakṣmyā saha saṃvādaḥ, taduttarāṇi, dārḍhyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 288 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 288 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 289
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 290 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
atha vai rādhike! tatra prahare tu tṛtīyake ।
kṛtadugdhajalapānaḥ śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 1 ।।
mahīmānaistathā śreṣṭhajanaiśca devatādibhiḥ ।
rājabhiḥ saha saubhāgyavatībhiḥ saha vai tadā ।। 2 ।।
sthāleṣu praviśāleṣu sauvarṇarājateṣvapi ।
sajjayāmāsa kanyārthaṃ divyaveṣāmbarāṇi ca ।। 3 ।।
ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi hārāँśca vividhāṃstathā ।
sarvasaubhāgyaratnāni saubhāgyopakarāṇi ca ।। 4 ।।
saubhāgyadravyagandhāni śatadhā vai navāni hi ।
miṣṭānnāni samastāni tāmbūlādīni yāni ca ।। 5 ।।
camatkṛtiprakāṇḍāni vastūnyapi śubhāni ca ।
svarṇapātreṣu ca nidhāpayāmāsottamāni ca ।। 6 ।।
suvarṇaghargharīḥ ramyāḥ śatadhā bhinnaraṃgikāḥ ।
vahniśuddhāḥ śāṭikāśca śatadhā svarṇabuṭṭikāḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhinnaraṃgā bhinnacitrāḥ kauśeyikāstathā'parāḥ ।
svarṇatārāvalīśobhāḥ svarṇaprāntāḥ sahīrakāḥ ।। 8 ।।
svarṇavarṇā raktavarṇāḥ kaṃcukīḥ ratnasaṃhitāḥ ।
kauśeyikāstārahārigranthigrathanaśobhanāḥ ।। 9 ।।
colikāśca tathā ramyāḥ śatadhā tārarājitāḥ ।
amūlyāśca keśalīnāḥ kucalīścāpyamūlyakāḥ ।। 2.289.1 0।।
caṭṭikāścāpyamūlyāśca svarṇaprāvaraṇāni ca ।
svarṇajā nāḍikāścāpi sauvarṇīrdehabandhikāḥ ।। 1 1।।
sagucchahīradorāṃśca keśabandhānamūlyakān ।
kucabandhān kaṭibandhāँścāntardhāryāṇi yāni ca ।। 12।।
kauśeyāni suvastrāṇi śatadhā kalpitāni ca ।
svarṇasthāleṣu vai nidhāpayāmāsa tadā pitā ।। 1 3।।
makhamallyau svarṇayujyau komale cāpyupānahau ।
rañjite sthalapadmābhe śatadhā ca nyadhāpayat ।। 14।।
keśasādhanakānyeva sarvāṇi śobhanānyapi ।
viṣṇutailāni cānyāni gandhasārāṇi vai tathā ।। 15।।
kastūrikādipaṃkāni cāndanādīni yāni ca ।
kajjalāni vividhāni raktadravyāṇi yāni ca ।। 16।।
kuṃkumāni ca sindūrakardamāni śubhāni ca ।
cañcanmūdupracūrṇāni navanītadravāṇi ca ।। 17।।
mārdanārhadravāँścāpi snānārhaguṭikāstathā ।
nakharañjanatattvāni talaraṃgadravāँstathā ।। 18।।
alaktādīni citrāṇi patrikārthadravāṇi ca ।
cañcaddhīrakacandrāँśca cañcaccūrṇāni yāni ca ।। 19।।
svarṇasthāleṣu sarvāṇi nyadhāpayattadā pitā ।
sthalapadmādipakvāni sugandhisalilāni ca ।।2.289.20 ।।
harikamaṇimāṇikyamauktikai ratnakaistathā ।
naddhāḥ suvarṇajā ramyā ūrmikāḥ śataśastathā ।।।21 ।।
bhramikāḥ kaṭikāścā'ṅgulīyakāni śubhāni ca ।
prakoṣṭhakaṭakāँścāpi vyaṃgiḍīḥ kānakīstathā ।।22।।
naddhahīrakaramyāँścāṃ'gadān sukaṭakottamān ।
bhujabandhān prasauvarṇān śṛṃkhalā bahuśobhanāḥ ।।23।।
patrikāḥ śṛṃkhalāyuktā rañjitāḥ phullapatrikāḥ ।
siṃhānanān suvalayān kaṃkaṇāni bahūni ca ।। 24।।
natthikāścibukīścāpi ṭibakīrbindukīstathā ।
satārāśca sucandro bahuragāँśca śobhanān ।। 25।।
kānakīḥ karṇamālāśca karṇikāḥ karṇaśṛṃkhalāḥ ।
sauvarṇān vardhakāँścāpi troṭikāḥ phullagranthikāḥ ।।26।।
sauvarṇastabakāँścāpi śiṃghoṭakān kadambakān ।
sauvarṇahīrakanaddhān ārāyakān subuṭṭikāḥ ।।27।।
vālikāstārikāścāpi kuṃcikā rūpyakānakīḥ ।
tantīṃ bhāgyamayīṃ cāndrīṃ candrapatrīṃ tathā'yatām ।।28।।
sauvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ cāpi svarṇamālāṃ suśobhanām ।
sauvarṇasūryaṃ śobhāḍhyaṃ bhāloparinivāsinam ।।29।।
keśacippikasūcīśca sauvarṇīṃ rājatīstathā ।
dhammilabandhavālīśca sauvarṇīḥ śṛṃkhalātmikāḥ ।।2.289.3 0।।
kabarīpārśvacandrāँśca vastrāvagūhavālikāḥ ।
oṣṭharañjanacūrṇaṃ ca kapolagaṇḍacūrṇakam ।।3 1 ।।
nyadhāpayaddhi pātreṣu kanyārthaṃ tatra cotsukaḥ ।
kaṇṭhahārān patrikāḍhyān phalagranthiprahārakān ।।32।।
śṛṃkhalāhārakāँścāpi plakṣapatraṃ suvarṇajam ।
maṃgalaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi mādalīṃ kānakīṃ tathā ।।33।।
svastikaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi cakraṃ vai kānakaṃ tathā ।
hastapadmaṃ kaṇṭhapadmaṃ kānakaṃ bhālapadmakam ।।34।।
galārthaṃ valayaṃ cāpi kānakaṃ siṃhikānanam ।
tilahārān mudgahārān māṣahārān sugaṭhṭhikān ।।35।।
sūkṣmapatrīprahārāँśca tārahārāँśca śobhanān ।
kucapuṭāँśca sauvarṇān kuntalān kuntaśobhitān ।।36।।
sūryamukhīṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ sauvarṇakalaśīstathā ।
svarṇapaṭṭān svarṇamālā mauktikahārasattamān ।।37।।
kaṭipāśāँśca sauvarṇān śṛṃkhalā raśanāstathā ।
kandūrikāśca sauvarṇīstrisarīḥ śobhanāstathā ।।38।।
nupūrān kiṃkiṇīyuktān jhaṃjharīḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ ।
kadalīḥ kambikāścāpi śṛṃgalā ghurghurāँstathā ।।39।।
sarvavidhāni saubhāgyā''bhūṣaṇāni navāni ca ।
tāmbūlapānadānīśca śūṭikāḥ kaṃkatīstathā ।।2.289.40।।
ādarśānnaktakāँścāpi karapoṣāँśca maujikān ।
ācchādakān śirastrāṇān harirajjūḥ suśobhitā ।।41।।
puṣpikāḥ kalikāścāpi sauvarṇīścaurṇapaṭṭikāḥ ।
pṛṣṭhapatrīṃ kaṭikatrīṃ dantapatrīṃ suśobhanām ।।।42।।
muktāhārān padmarāgamaṇimālāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।
mārakatīḥ srajaścāpi vaidūryamaṇimālikāḥ ।।43।।
indranīlasrajaścāpi puṣparāgādipatrikāḥ ।
karketanakṛtamālāḥ pulakasphaṭikasrajaḥ ।।44।।
vidrumanaddhapattrāṇi sthāleṣvapi nyadhāpayat ।
gālīcakāni ramyāṇi hārītakāni yāni ca ।।45।।
aurṇāni ca tathā kauśeyāni cāstaraṇāni ca ।
gulālāni ca raktāni kuṃkumāni śubhāni ca ।।46।।
akṣatāni sutīkṣṇāni yavamālāḥ śubhāstathā ।
puṣpahārāँśca pātrāṇi gandhadhānīśca kānakīḥ ।।47।।
ityevaṃ rādhike koṭikoṭyabjārbudamūlyakam ।
tato'bjamūlyakaṃ śṛṃgārakaṃ nyadhāpayat pitā ।।48।।
sthāleṣu sūryatulyeṣu nidhāpya kaṃbharāpatiḥ ।
vādyaghoṣairyutaḥ kanyāgītikābhiryutastathā ।।49।।
yayau kanyānivāsaṃ vai śivasvāmyālayaṃ tadā ।
kanyakāyāḥ kṛte sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāllabdhaṃ śivena ca ।।2.289.50।।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ svāgataṃ ca sammānaṃ svīkṛtiṃ tathā ।
vidhāya bahubhāvena jalapānaṃ harastadā ।।5 1 ।।
akārayacca miṣṭānnabhojanaṃ svalpamaṃgalam ।
tāmbūlakaṃ dadau cāpi bahu bahvityabhāṣata ।।52।।
hṛṣṭo gopālakṛṣṇaśca dadau sarvaṃ śivāya ha ।
ājñāmavāpya tūrṇaṃ vai svāvāsaṃ cāyayau tataḥ ।। 53
caturthe prahare tatra kanyāśṛṃgāramācaran ।
sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sumilitāḥ provāhocitamutsukāḥ ।।54।।
kṛṣṇasyāpi pitā sthāne śṛṃgāraṃ samakārayat ।
gajaṃ suvāhanaṃ caturdantaṃ sāmbālikaṃ śubham ।।55।।
pitā śṛṃgārayāmāsa dhavalaṃ sarvato'dhikam ।
sauvarṇacandrakūthena svarṇāmbālikayāyutam ।।56।।
śuṇḍāyāṃ citraśūlaṃ ca kapāle ca sudarśanam ।
karṇayorvyajane cāpi gaṇḍayoḥ sūryakau tathā ।।57।।
danteṣu svarṇavalayāḥ kaṇṭhe sauvarṇaghaṇṭikāḥ ।
pādeṣu pārṣadāścitrasvarūpāścodare gadā ।।58।।
pucche sauvarṇamālāśca niḥśreṇī pārśvake tathā ।
ityevaṃ ca gajaṃ śṛṃgārayāmāsa pitā tadā ।।59।।
bhūmisparśāni ca tadā mandavimānakāni ca ।
pitā śṛṃgārayāmāsa vāhinyarthaṃ tadā mudā ।।2.289.6 0।।
muktānāṃ sugajāścāpi garuḍāśca tadā'bhavan ।
smṛtamātrā āgatāśca śṛṃgāritāḥ suśobhitāḥ ।।61 ।।
aśvāścoṣṭrāstathā haṃsā menāśca cātakāstathā ।
vṛṣabhā gavayāścāpi mṛgāśca makarāstathā ।।62।।
geṇḍūkāśca tathā siṃhāḥ śārdūlāḥ śarabhāstathā ।
vāhanāni yathā yeṣāṃ smṛtāni kalpapādape ।।63।।
kāmadughānirmitāni tūrṇaṃ tatrā''gatāni ca ।
vyomayānāni ramyāṇi svalpāni bhūmigāni ca ।।64।।
śṛṃgāritāni sarvāṇi rathāśca rathikāstathā ।
śibikāstāpadānāni naravāhāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ।।65।।
dhvajaḍaṃkāniśānādivetrachatrāṇi yāni ca ।
śṛṃgāritāni sarvāṇi sajjīkṛtāni vai drutam ।।66।।
vāhinīsthā narā nāryaḥ śṛṃgāraśobhitāstadā ।
navacañcadvarṇaveṣā ābhūṣādivirājitāḥ ।।67।।
anyūnasarvaśṛṃgārā abhavan vai tadā mudā ।
vādyakārā nartakāśca naṭā dundubhinādakāḥ ।।68।।
sarvavāditravijñāśca veṣairbhinnairvibhūṣitāḥ ।
devā devyaḥ samastāśca sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ।।69।।
śṛṃgāritā abhavaँśca varayātrocitāstadā ।
lagnayātrocitāḥ kanyāścatuṣkoṭiprasaṃkhyikāḥ ।।2.289.70।।
tathā'nyāḥ koṭiśaścāpi koṭyavurdābjasaṃkhyikāḥ ।
pitrādibhiḥ sakhībhiśca śṛṃgāritāstadā'bhavan ।।7 1 ।।
kaṇṭhamālāyutāḥ sarvāḥ sarvā''bharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
vahneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ sarvāścehamānā harīcchayā ।।72।।
lomaśasya nideśena sarvā''bharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
dānayogyā abhavaँśca yathā lakṣmīstu kanyakā ।।73 ।।
caturthapraharasyā'nte kṛtvā śṛṃgāramadbhutam ।
suśubhe samaye śivapurād kṛṣṇo viniryayau ।। 74।।
koṭikoṭayabjajanatāsahito vardhito janaiḥ ।
pūjito vanditaścāpi phalapuṣpadhanārpaṇaiḥ ।। 75।।
vārāṇasyāṃ bhramitvaiva mahārājapathe tataḥ ।
devatādarśanaṃ kṛtvā viśveśvaraṃ praṇamya ca ।
gaṃgāvāri śubhaṃ pītvā sahasrāyutavāhanaḥ ।।76 ।।
lakṣavimānayuktaśca sarvastrīnaravardhitaḥ ।
yukto yāvanmahīmānaiścāyāti yogamaṇḍapam ।।77।।
varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye kāpiladhārikāsthale ।
viśāle sārarūpe vai kṣetre hyudyānaśobhite ।।78 ।।
śivasvāminaśca prāsādāgre kailāsarūpiṇam ।
śatayojanavistāraṃ kailāsātmakamaṇḍapam ।।79 ।।
yo vai kailāsarūpo'bhūt gagane svāgatārthakaḥ ।
sa eva nityakailāso maṇḍapo'tra virājate ।।2.289.8 0 ।।
tatra kā nyūnatā rādhe! yatra vai maṇḍape'bhitaḥ ।
samastaṃ śivanagaraṃ pārvatīnagaraṃ tathā ।।8 1 ।।
kāśīnagaraṃ cāpyantarbhāvamīyuḥ praśobhayā ।
tādṛśīmaṇḍape śobhā śaṃbhunā tatra nirmitā ।।8 2 ।।
gaṃgāgogarābhūbhāge vistṛto'bhūddhi maṇḍapaḥ ।
śatayojanavistāraḥ kuṇḍavedīpraśobhitaḥ ।।8 2 ।।
ucchraye yojanaścāpi divyatejo'bhisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
golokīyasamastābhiḥ sāmagrībhiśca pūritaḥ ।।84।।
siṃhāsanādibhiryukto maṇitejo'bhirājitaḥ ।
pārṣadaiḥ sarvataḥ sevāparāyaṇairgaṇairyutaḥ ।।85 ।।
kāmadhenusamastābhiḥ kalpalatābhivartitaḥ ।
rāsamaṇḍalaśobhāḍhyagopagopīvirājitaḥ ।।86 ।।
sarvalokanivāsānāṃ puttalairabhimaṇḍitaḥ ।
ghṛtakulyādadhikulyāmadhukulyābhirājitaḥ ।। 87 ।।
sarvā'sanaiśca mṛdubhirbṛsībhiḥ paṭṭikādibhiḥ ।
aurṇāstaraṇakauśeyāstaraṇaiśca talīkṛtaḥ ।।88 ।।
manohārisvarayuktagītibhiścābhikarṣitaḥ ।
nṛtyanāṭyakalājñābhirhāsyajñābhirvirājitaḥ ।।8 9 ।।
dūradṛśyadūraśrāvadūraspṛśaiśca nirmitaḥ ।
saṃkalpayānavāhādyaiḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe prasevitaḥ ।।2.289.90।।
śītairvidyutpravāhaiśca sarvathā tūjjvalīkṛtaḥ ।
sudhā'mṛtapravarṣibhistāraiḥ samantato'nvitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
staṃbheṣu toraṇeṣūrdhvabhāgeṣu tvāsanānvitaḥ ।
varakanyāvivāhasya pratibimbārthadarśanaḥ ।। 92।।
svarge tārāśca yāvatyastāvanto maṇayastviha ।
kailāse maṇḍape tatra rājante yogamaṇḍape ।।93 ।।
sṛṣṭipānāṃ tu yāvanti sabhāsthānāni santi hi ।
tāvanti maṇḍape tatra kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā ।।94।।
dānārhakanyakānāṃ cā''sanāni madhyagolake ।
kṛtāni kaṇṭhamālārthaṃ sannidhau viśvakarmaṇā ।।95।।
kailāsaḥ puruṣastatra rājate mūrtimānapi ।
sarvārhavastudānārthaṃ provāhe tatra vai mahe ।।96 ।।
na bhūto na bhaviṣyaँśca maṇḍapaścedṛśaḥ kvacit ।
ārapāradṛśā dṛśyo vidyate dhāmavat sthitaḥ ।।97।।
yūpakalaśadevādhivāsanaiḥ svastikādibhiḥ ।
adhiṣṭhito mahīmānaiḥ pārvatīnagarījanaiḥ ।। 98।।
kāśīnagarīlokaiśca sṛṣṭitrayanivāsibhiḥ ।
saṃkulito vadadbhiśca prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।।99।।
maṇḍapasyottame śreṣṭhe gopure maṃgalātmake ।
vīrabhadro'mbare vakti maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 2.289.1 00।।
vadanti vyomayantrāṇi samāyāntu mahotsave ।
paśyantu paramātmānaṃ pradānaṃ kṛṣṇayoriti ।। 101 ।।
sāmavedo mūrtimāँścā'mbare sthitvā'bhivandate ।
āgacchan śrīśarājo'sau harirvijayatetamām ।। 1 02।।।
ṛgvedaśca gopurāgre sthitaḥ paśyati vāhinīm ।
samāyāntīṃ mahādīrghāmasūcayacchivādikān ।। 1 03।।
satī śrīpārvatīdevī tūrdhvabhūmau gatā tadā ।
kiyatī kīdṛśī ceti vāhinīti pravikṣitum ।। 1 04।।
śivapurāt kāśikāṃ saṃgṛhya maṇḍapasannidhau ।
ātāṃ cātidīrghāṃ saṃvīkṣya stabdhā'bhavat kṣaṇam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kanyārthaṃ bhūṣā'mbaropakaraṇādipreṣaṇam, vāhinījanamahīmānakṛṣṇaśṛṃgārādi, śrīkṛṣṇasya maṇḍapaṃ prati niryāṇaṃ, maṇḍapaśobhā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 289 ।।
