adhyāyaḥ 290
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 291 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
pārvatīṃ cordhvagāṃ vīkṣya koṭiśo yoṣitastadā ।
kṛṣṇayānyā vilokārthaṃ cāruruhurnijālayān ।। 1 ।।
maṇḍapasyordhvaśālāsu tvāsthitā vīkṣaṇotsukāḥ ।
ṛgvedaṃ girijā prāha bṛhaspateḥ samīpataḥ ।। 2 ।।
dṛśyate tvagrataḥ kiṃ tat sāntaṃ me sannibodhaya ।
mama putryāḥ kṛte ke ke mahīmānā mamā'dya vai ।। 3 ।।
ke santi kīdṛśāścāpi sutāsvāmyapi kīdṛśaḥ ।
mahattamo'sti sarvaṃ tajjijñāse vada me'khilam ।। 4 ।।
sarvajñaḥ ṛgveda evaṃ pṛṣṭo harṣamavāpa ha ।
satīṃ śrīgirijāṃ vaktuṃ samārebhe kramātattaḥ ।। 5 ।।
paśya mātaḥ prathamaṃ vai maṃgalākhyo hi pārṣadaḥ ।
caturbhujaḥ satilakaḥ sarvā''bharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
maṃgalādevikāyuktaḥ sarvamāṃgalyakānvitaḥ ।
sāmamantrān pragāyan vai samāyāti śubhāvahaḥ ।। 7 ।।
svalpahaṃsasamārūḍhaḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitaḥ ।
tathāhaṃsasamārūḍhā maṃgalā ca sarasvatī ।। 8 ।।
śāradā ca samāyānti sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
etadvai darśanaṃ sarvamaṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam ।। 9 ।।
tato vaikuṇṭhavādyāni vādakairvāditāni vai ।
samāyānti trilokyāṃ yanninādāśca dhvananti hi ।। 2.290.1 0।।
paśya tataḥ samāyāti sadhvajaḥ śobhano gajaḥ ।
akṣarasyaiva mukto'sau mahādririva rājate ।। 1 1।।
paśya tataḥ samāyānti jayaśabdapravartakāḥ ।
brahmacaryaparāḥ pāresahasraṃ snātakā ime ।। 12।।
paśya tataḥ samāyāti ḍaṃkāniśānavān śubhaḥ ।
śyāmakarṇo dhavalāśvo'kṣaramukto hi vartate ।। 1 3।।।
paśya bherībhṛtaṃ paścād rathaṃ vṛṣabhavāhitam ।
sauvarṇaṃ svarṇakalaśadhvajā'varūthaśobhitam ।। 14।।
paśya tato'śvavārāँśca sahasraśaḥ sahetikān ।
paśya mātastataścoṣṭrasthitān nirṛtarākṣasān ।। 15।।
sarve śṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyān vaiṣṇavān viṣṇusevakān ।
paśya mātastato yakṣān padātīn dānakāriṇaḥ ।। 16।।
svarṇarūpyādivṛṣṭiṃ ca kurvato dhanasaṃbhṛtān ।
sahasraśo hi mukuṭairanvitān svarṇabhūṣaṇān ।। 17।।
paśya mātastato rāsakṛtān vai vaiṣṇavān janān ।
sahasraśaḥ savādyāँśca kīrtayaṃto harerguṇān।। 18।।
paśya mātastato nārīvaiṣṇavīrgītikāparāḥ ।
kṛṣṇakīrtanakartrīśca sahasraśo vibhūṣitāḥ ।। 19।।
paśya tataḥ śibikāsu narayāneṣu saṃsthitān ।
brahmadhyānaparān pūjyān maharṣīṃśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 2.290.20।।
paśya mātaḥ pitṛdevān aryamṇā sahitāँstataḥ ।
sauvarṇanarayāneṣu lakṣakanyāyutānapi ।। 21 ।।
paśya tataḥ siddhajanān sādhūn rathādyadhiṣṭhitān ।
pāresahasraṃ divyāँśca pāvanān lokapāvanān ।।22।।
paśya mātastato vaṃśīvādyayuktān hi komalān ।
pārṣadānnavayūnaśca divyaveṣavibhūṣitān ।।23।।
paśya mātaḥ śarabhasthān daityān pravaiṣṇavāँstataḥ ।
śṛṃgāritān jayanādān prakurvataḥ sahasraśaḥ ।24।।
paśya mātastato raudrān gaṇān vṛṣabhavāhanān ।
vaiṣṇavān bahuveṣāँśca rūpiṇaḥ śivasadṛśān ।।25।।
bhūtān pretān piśācāँśca paśya vaiṣṇavasevakān ।
paśya mātastato divyān gāndharvān vādyagāyakān ।।26।।
svarṇacampakavarṇābhān tālamānasamanvitān ।
paśya mātastataḥ sarvatīrthāni mūrtimanti ca ।। 27।।
pāvanāni samāyānti lakṣaśo divyabhāni ca ।
paśya mātastato devīḥ koṭiśo gītikāyutāḥ ।।28।।
vibhūṣitā divyaveṣā narayānasthitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
paśya mātastato vṛddhān saurāṣṭrīyān narān śubhān ।।29।।
paśya devān vāhanasthān chatracāmarabhūṣitān ।
lakṣaśo bhānuvarṇān vai dāsadāsīsamanvitān ।।2.290.3 0।।
svalpakalpavimānasthān sthalagān vyomagānapi ।
candravarṇān bhānuvarṇān vahnivarṇān surāँstathā ।।3 1।।
paśya mātastato yātān pātālasthān phaṇādharān ।
bahurūpān kāmarūpān koṭiśo'tra samāgatān ।।32।।।
paśya mātaḥ sūtalokān māgadhān kinnarāँstataḥ ।
kiṃpuṃsaḥ paśya vidyādhrān devavādyaninādakān ।।33।।
paśya mātastato viprān vedaghoṣakarān dvijān ।
paśya tato gajasthāँśca nṛpān bhūgolabhūpatīn ।।34।।
jummasemlanṛpaṃ hastisthitaṃ tathā'bhito'sya ca ।
sahasrakanyakā yānagatāḥ paśya hareḥ priyāḥ ।।35।।
paśya mātastato dakṣajavaṃgaraṃ nṛpaṃ gaje ।
śatādhikasahasrakanyakā yānagatāstathā ।।36।।
śibirājaṃ paśya mātargajasthaṃ śobhanaṃ nṛpam ।
narayānagatāḥ kanyāḥ śataṃ paśya vibhūṣitāḥ ।।37।।
tharkūṭasthaṃ mahārājaṃ pañcāśatkanyakāyutam ।
svarṇasiṃhāsanasthaṃ viṣṭiskandheṣu vilokaya ।।38।।
vīrajāramahārājaṃ śatakanyāyutaṃ tataḥ ।
narayānasthitaṃ paśya sarvābhūṣaṇaśobhitam ।।39।।
śaktyakṣinṛpatiṃ ṣaṣṭikanyakāsahitaṃ tathā ।
śatapiśācinīkanyāyutaṃ paśya suśobhitam ।।2.290.40।।
kālimāśaṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyāśatadvayānvitam ।
svarṇayānasthitaṃ sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃvibhūṣitam ।।41।।
ete nṛpā rāśiyānāḥ kiṃpuruṣaprajātikāḥ ।
devatulyāḥ pravidyante tava gṛhe samāgatāḥ ।।।42।।
atha vāditraninadān śṛṇu paśya navottamān ।
ketumālīyajātīँśca suśobhān yantravāditān ।।43।।
uralaketukaṃ paśya rājānaṃ svalpayānagam ।
triṃśatkanyāsahitaṃ ca venumālaprakhaṇḍagam ।।44।।
krathakaṃ paśya rājānaṃ pañcakanyāyutaṃ śubham ।
svalpayānasthitaṃ pṛthuṃ viṃśatikanyakāyutam ।।45।।
uṣṭrālarājakaṃ daśakanyānvitaṃ vilokaya ।
haṃkāraṃ paṃcakanyāsaṃyutaṃ yāne vilokaya ।।46 ।।
jayakāṣṭhalabhūpaṃ ca pañcakanyāsamanvitam ।
tīrāṇarājakaṃ mātaḥ paśya ṣaṭkanyakāyutam ।।47।।
alvīnaraṃ nṛpaṃ paśya saptakanyāsamanvitam ।
jīnavarddhinṛpaṃ paśya yānasthamekakanyakam ।।48।।
tataḥ paśya mahādevi rājñāṃ pṛṣṭhe ca maṇḍalam ।
kanyakānāṃ dviśatasahasradvayasuśobhitam ।।49।।
mahāvimānagaṃ sarvaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
vimānaṃ bhūtale yāti kalpalatāsuśobhitam ।।2.290.50।।
alpaketuṃ nṛpaṃ paśya saptakanyāsamanvitam ।
jayakṛṣṇavabhūpaṃ ca mātaḥ paśyaikakanyakam ।।51 ।।
parīśānaṃ nṛpaṃ paśya tvekaviṃśatikanyakam ।
svalpavimānagaṃ sarvaśobhābhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।।।52।।।
tataḥ paśya dvikanyaṃ ca nṛpamindurayaṃ śubham ।
mudrāṇḍaṃ nṛpatiṃ pañcadaśakanyāyutaṃ tataḥ ।।53 ।।
svalpavimānagaṃ paśya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
gaṇḍanṛpaṃ navakanyāyutaṃ paśya vimānagam ।।54।।
līnorṇaṃ ca nṛpaṃ paśya catuḥkanyā vimānagam ।
bṛhaccharaṃ nṛpamekādaśakanyāsamanvitam ।।55।।
balalīnaṃ tataḥ paśya catvāriṃśatsukanyakam ।
svalpavimānagaṃ sarvasāmagrīśobhitaṃ śubham ।।56।।
varasiṃhākhyarājānaṃ paśya vai pañcakanyakam।
rāyagāmalabhūpaṃ ca paśyā'ṣṭakanyakaṃ śubham ।।57।।
phenatantunṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayasamanvitam ।
stokahomaṃ tathā paśya kanyaikaṃ yānagaṃ śubham ।।58। ।
kāṣṭhayānanṛpaṃ paśya kanyaikaṃ kolakaṃ nṛpam ।
kanyaikaṃ ceti ketumālīyā nṛpā bhavanti te ।।59।।
ete sarve mahīmānāstava gṛhe nibodha me ।
atha vāditrakuśalān paśya garimadeśajān ।।2.290.60।।
hārītakān divyaveśān paśya mātaḥ kramācchubhān ।
paśya vimānagaṃ bhūpaṃ kanyādvayayutaṃ tataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
dinamānārkanṛpatiṃ svatantraṃ suvibhūṣitam ।
paśya mātastato yāntaṃ rāyakinnarabhūpatim ।।62।।
ekapañcāśatkanyakāyutaṃ svarṇavimānagam ।
kinnāṭakapradeśānāṃ nṛpaṃ cā'marikānvitam ।।63।।।
amarīdeśajān paśyottarakurunṛpānatha ।
bhūtalasparśisaṃvegamahāvimānagān śubhān ।।।64।।
rāyarokīśvaraṃ bhūpamekaviṃśatikanyakam ।
rāyaraṇajidbhūpaṃ ca viṃśatikanyakāyutam ।।65।।
rāyavākakṣakaṃ paśya trikanyaṃ suvimānagam ।
rāyamārīśabhūpaṃ ca trikanyaṃ ca vimānagam ।।66।।
rāyabāleśvaraṃ bhūpaṃ trikanyaṃ ca vimānagam ।
rāyalambārabhūpaṃ ca ṣaṭaknyaṃ vai vimānagam । ।67 ।।
rāyanavārkabhūpaṃ ca saptakanyaṃ vimānagam ।
rāyahūṇeśabhūpaṃ ca navakanyaṃ vimānagam ।।68।।
rāyakūpeśabhūpaṃ ca kanyaikaṃ svavimānagam ।
paśyaitān chatraśobhāḍhyān dāsadāsīsamanvitān ।।69।।
paśya mātastato vādyavādakān kṛṣṇaveṣakān ।
paśya mātastato bhūpān dakṣiṇakurudeśajān ।।2.290.70 ।।
kālamaṇḍalīnabhūpaṃ kanyācatuṣṭayānvitam ।
gajayānagataṃ paśya sarvaśobhāsamanvitam ।।7 1 ।।
vanajeleśabhūpaṃ ca pañcakanyāsamanvitam ।
gajayānagataṃ paśya mātaśchatrādiśobhitam ।।।72 ।।
pārāvārapibaṃ bhūpaṃ kanyātrayasamanvitam ।
gajayānagataṃ paśya sarvabhṛtyādisaṃyutam ।।73 ।।
koṭīśvaraṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayasamanvitam ।
gajayānagataṃ mātaḥ sarvabhṛtyasamanvitam ।।74।।
śrīsatīśanṛpatiṃ kanyātrayasamanvitam ।
tretākarkaśabhūpaṃ ca saptakanyāyutaṃ tathā ।।75।।
āṇḍajarānṛpaṃ paśya kanyācatuṣṭayānvitam।
bālyarajonṛpaṃ paśya kanyaikaṃ gajayānagam ।।76।।
rāyasomananṛpatiṃ śubhaṃ kanyātrayānvitam ।
urugavākṣabhūpaṃ ca paśya kanyādvayānvitam ।।77।।
parāṅavrataṃ nṛpaṃ paśya kanyādvayayutaṃ tataḥ ।
īśānapānabhūpaṃ ca mahāgajacatuṣṭaye ।।78।।
yāne sthitaṃ tvekacatvāriṃśatkanyāsamanvitam ।
paśya cāmarachatrādidāsīdāsasusevitam ।।79।।
rājārāyapatiṃ paśya trayastriṃśatsukanyakam ।
caturgajamahāyānasthitaṃ chatrādiśobhitam ।।2.290.80।।
pūrvadeśaprajāścāpi paśya mātarvimānagāḥ ।
koṭikanyāyutāḥ sarvāḥ koṭikumāraśobhitāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
ābālavṛddhasarvasvā dṛṣṭiryāsu na gacchati ।
viśālāṃ vāhinīṃ paśya tavā'ṅgaṇe hyupāgatām ।।8 2।।
mahābāleśvarān paśya suratīyān prapaśya ca ।
sāntapanīḥ prajāḥ paśya pañcasāhasrakanyakāḥ ।।83।।
sarvā vimānagāḥ śṛṃgāritāścābharaṇānvitāḥ ।
bhūgarbhasya nṛpasyāpi lakṣmaṇasya vimānakam ।।84।।
paśya mātardvisahasrakanyānvitaṃ viśālakam ।
śāvadīnasya kanyānāṃ sahasraṃ ca vimānagam ।।85।।
nāgakanyāvimānāni nāgārūḍhāni paśya ca ।
sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi paśyāṃgaṇe tavātra vai ।।86 ।।
paśya mātastato devān chatracāmaraśobhitān ।
narayānagatān naijavādyavetradharānvitān ।।87।।
kubero'yaṃ samāyāti vaiṣṇavaḥ pūrvakalpagaḥ ।
nijakuṭumbasahitaḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitaḥ ।।88।।
mahendro'yaṃ samāyāti paśya taṃ devatānvitam ।
mahāsiṃhāsanasthaṃ vai svargarājaṃ raviprabham ।।89।।
paśya mātastato vāyuṃ samāyāntaṃ surānvitam ।
rājādhirājaśobhaṃ ca paśya rudraṃ gaṇānvitam ।। 2.290.90 ।।
vahniṃ paśya tato yāntaṃ paśya sūryaṃ vimānagam ।
paśya candraṃ budhaṃ śukraṃ koṭidevaprasevitam ।।91 ।।
mahāvimānasaṃsthaṃ ca paśya mātarmunīśvaram ।
ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca koṭisatpuruṣānvitam ।।92।।
vāditrāṇi satyalokasthāni śṛṇu tato'pi ca ।
paśya mātarjanavāsipitṝn vai koṭikanyakān ।। 93।।
vimānasainyasaṃsthāँśca paśya viśvāvasuṃ tataḥ ।
kanyāśatatrayayutaṃ gāndharvagaṇasevitam ।।94।।
rasātalīyadaityāँśca paśya bhaktān samāgatān ।
prahlādādīnnṛpānatra pañcasāhasrakanyakān ।। 95।।
saṃvaraṇaṃ ca dharaṇiṃ koṭikanyāsamanvitām ।
paśya mātarbhūṣitāṃ ca vimānottamasaṃsthitām ।। 96।।
kāmadhenukuṭumbāni muktātmakāni paśya ca ।
koṭikulāni cāyānti tava gṛhaṃ sukhāśrayam ।। 97।।
paśya mātastato viṣṇuṃ koṭipārṣadasaṃyutam ।
vaikuṇṭhavādyaśobhāḍhyairjanaiścā'gre prayāyibhiḥ । । 98।।
jayanādairvardhitaṃ ca koṭidīpāvalīyutam ।
ārjantīśatayuktaṃ ca ramākoṭisamanvitam ।। 99।।
paśya mātastato yāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ।
diśāṃ pālairlokapālaiḥ koṭibhiścā'bhivardhitam ।। 2.290.100 ।।
sarasvatyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmasarobhiranvitam ।
dvāsaptatisahasrakanyakāyuktaṃ vimānagam ।। 101 ।।
aindrajālikakanyānāṃ sahasreṇāpi rājitam ।
paśya mātarlomaśaṃ ca maharṣikoṭisevitam ।। 102।।
mahāvimānasaṃsthaṃ ca guruṃ lakṣmīpateḥ prabhoḥ ।
paśya mātastasya pṛṣṭhe kanyāgaṇān hi koṭiśaḥ । । 103 ।।
vimānagān vanadevīkanyālakṣagaṇānapi ।
drumān stabakān kalpalatāḥ paśya sthāvaradehinaḥ ।। 1 04।।
mahīmānān śobhanān vai devasadṛśavigrahān ।
paśya mātastato lakṣakanyānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ param ।। 1 05।।
dāmanīnāṃ vimānasthaṃ saudāminīkulaṃ param ।
paśya mātastato'yutakaṃkatālīyakanyakāḥ ।। 106 ।।
vimānasthā bhūṣitāśca gītikātatparāstathā ।
sālamālīyakanyāśca vāsantikāśca kanyakāḥ ।। 1 07।।
paśya mātarvimānasthāḥ sahasrāṇi tathā'parāḥ ।
paśya mātaryamajāśca vāyujāḥ kanyakāstataḥ ।। 108 ।।
meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā'parāḥ ।
vārkṣyo raudryaśca khānijyaḥ sāṃvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ ।। 10 9।।
śrāvaṇyā vaiśvakarmyaśca prācīnyaśca piśaṃgikāḥ ।
rāśiyānyaśca romāṇyaḥ pāraśyaḥ kinnarīgaṇāḥ ।। 2.290.110 ।।
dhaivaryaścāpi parthaścā'maryo gauryaśca bhūṣitāḥ ।
hārityaścāpi vai svargyāḥ pātālyaścā''bririktajāḥ ।। 111 ।।
bhaumyaścāpi ca dānavyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
paśya mātastava putryā mānārthaṃ santi tāstviha । । 11 2।।
āyānti cotsukāḥ sarvā prodvāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।
paśya mātastato yāntaṃ sahasrakalaśānvite ।। 113 ।।
mahāvimānake śrīmadvairājaṃ puruṣaṃ param।
anekeśvarayuktaṃ ca sahasrabhujaśobhitam ।। 1 14।।
paśya mātastato yāntaṃ sahasravadanaṃ hyajam ।
brahmaṇaśca tathā viṣṇūn sahasravadanān śubhān ।। 1 15 ।।
paśya sarveśvarān mātarmahāviṣṇuṃ vilokaya ।
paśya mātarhi bhūmānaṃ pareśvaraṃ vimānagam ।। 116 ।।
koṭīśvarayutaṃ paśya pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam ।
paśya mātastathā vāsudevaṃ kuṭumbakānvitam ।। 11 7।।
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ paśya sarvatattvānvitaṃ tataḥ ।
paśya mātaśceśvarāṇāṃ vāditravādakāँstataḥ ।। 11 8।।
paśya mātaśceśvarāṇīmaṇḍalāni tataḥ param ।
vimānasthāni garuḍasthāni hastigatāni ca ।। 11 9।।
rathasthāni paśya mātaḥ pārṣadāṇīrvibhūṣitāḥ ।
aho mātastataḥ paśya bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 2.290.120 ।।
matsyarūpaṃ kūrmarūpaṃ tataḥ paśya nṛsiṃhakam ।
vārāhaṃ ca tataḥ paśya haṃsaṃ hariṃ vilokaya ।। 121 ।।
kapilaṃ ca tataḥ paśya pṛthuṃ paśya tataḥ param ।
dattātreyaṃ tataḥ paśya ṛṣabhaṃ paśya vāmanam ।। 122 ।।
parśurāmaṃ tataḥ paśya yajñaṃ paśya tataḥ param ।
rāmaṃ paśya tato mātarhayagrīvaṃ vilokaya ।। 123 ।।
nāradaṃ paśya mātarvai rājarājaṃ vilokaya ।
vyāsaṃ śvetaṃ paśya mātarbuddhaṃ paśyā'śvinīsutam ।। 1 24।।
dhanvantariṃ tataḥ paśya paśya nārāyaṇān bahūn ।
koṭivimānagān paśya pārṣadāँstatpriyāँstataḥ ।। 125 ।।
paśya mātastato muktān dhāmadhāmanivāsinaḥ ।
paśya mātarhi muktānīḥ sāṃkhyayogavatīstathā ।। 126 ।।
paśya mātarbrahmasakhīrbrahmapriyāstathā'parāḥ ।
catvāriṃśadūrdhvaśataṃ ṣaṭkaṃ paśya ca yoṣitām ।। 127 ।।
rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ ramāṃ padmāvatīṃ śrīṃ māṇikīṃ tathā ।
kārṣṇīḥ paśyaitā mātaste gṛhaṃ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ ।। 128 ।।
mādhavī suguṇā hāsā dayā śāntā sumā'mbikā ।
campā haimī muktikā devikā lalantikā jayā ।। 1 29।।।
anyāśca śataśo mātastvāgatāḥ paśya te gṛham ।
kṛṣṇākṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇajīvāstvatputrīsvasṛbhāvanāḥ ।। 2.290.130 ।।
mātaḥ paśya mahāntaṃ vai vimānaṃ gajavāhanam ।
yatra pitā ca mātā ca bhrātaraśca kuṭumbakam ।। 131 ।।
śrīharestu samāste vai koṭisūryasamaprabham ।
paśya mātastato divyaṃ sahasragajavāhitam ।। 13 2।।
vimānaṃ kalaśāḍhyaṃ vai sahasraśikharānvitam ।
sahasrāyutayānaiśca samantāt parivāritam ।। 132 ।।
koṭisaubhāgyavatībhirvardhitaṃ sevitaṃ tathā ।
vīkṣitaṃ divyaśobhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakāntaṃ vilokaya ।। 134।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vallabhaṃ sarvaṃ svāmiśrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇam ।। 1 35।।
bhrātṛjāyādibhiścāpi svasṛbhiścābhivardhitam ।
puruṣottamamevainaṃ sarvāvirbhāvakāraṇam ।। 1 36।।
aho mātastava bhāgyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।
kṛṣṇāyatī cedṛśī vai na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati ।। 1 37।।
paśyamātastataḥ kṛṣṇayātīsthamahīmānakān ।
sarvalokabhavān cāśvavārān paśya ca koṭiśaḥ ।। 1 38।।
paśya mātastato gītikāriṇīrvarayoṣitaḥ ।
bhaumī sarvā bhūṣitāśca paśya tataśca darśakān ।। 139 ।।
śrīgirijovāca-
aho me paramaṃ bhāgyaṃ cakṣurme bālakṛṣṇake ।
niruddhaṃ ṛk! na paśyāmi cetaraṃ vada mā nviha ।। 2.290.140।।
dhanyā putrī mama jātā yadarthaṃ tvīśvarā iha ।
yāmi śīghraṃ svāgatārthaṃ cāyāhi maṇḍapāntikam ।। 141 ।।
ityuktvā rādhikeḥ sā tu himajā tūrṇameva ha ।
sammānārthaṃ svāgatārthaṃ tvadhaścāvā'tarad gṛhe ।। 142।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śrīśāṃkarīdevyai ṛgvedena kṛṣṇayātīvarṇitamahīmānaparicayaḥ prakārita ityādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 290 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 291

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike! kṛṣṇavāhinyāṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tu koṭiśaḥ ।
strīgaṇāḥ mumuhuścāti yuvānaṃ parameśvaram ।। 1 ।।
koṭitejobhirāpūrṇaṃ koṭilāvaṇyaśobhanam ।
koṭyānandabharaṃ puṣṭaṃ koṭibhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 2 ।।
koṭisadguṇavāsaṃ ca koṭikāmabhṛtaṃ prabhum ।
vīkṣya vīkṣya navā nāryastallīnāḥ sthiradṛṣṭayaḥ ।। 3 ।।
yāvatyaḥ kanyakāścāpi saṃbabhūvuḥ samādhigāḥ ।
api narāśca lokāśceśvarāśca līnatāṃ gatāḥ ।। 4 ।।
devāḥ sarve'pi mumuhuryoṣitāṃ tatra kā kathā ।
sādhavo yoginaścāpi muktāśca pārṣadā api ।। 5 ।।
mumuhuryatayaścāpi muktānīnāṃ tu kā kathā ।
mahāmāyā pradhānaṃ ca prakṛtirdhāmayoṣitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
mohinyaścāpi mumuhurlaukikīnāṃ tu kā kathā ।
ājanābhyo yuvatyaśca kṛṭumbasahitā yayuḥ ।। 7 ।।
darśanārthaṃ sotsukā vai provāhaḥ kṛṣṇayoriti ।
tā api mumuhustatra pareśe paramātmani ।। 8 ।।
rājāno rājakanyāśca daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇayānyāgatāścāpi niścikyustaṃ nijeśvaram ।। 9 ।।
prajākanyāstathā tatra daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
niścikyuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇaṃ ceśaṃ naijaṃ vimohitāḥ ।। 2.291.10 ।।
tatparāśca samāsan vai kaṇṭhamālāḥ pragṛhya ca ।
vahnisākṣye bhaviṣyāmo dāsyaḥ kṛṣṇasya cārpitāḥ ।। 11
ityevaṃ koṭyarbudā vai kanyakāstatparāstadā ।
sarvasajjīkṛtā''veṣāḥ pratīkṣante tu maṃgalam ।। 12।
vidyādharyaḥ koṭiśaśca mumuhurvīkṣya mādhavam ।
apsarasaḥ koṭiśaśca mumuhurvīkṣya keśavam । ।13 ।।
gāndharvyaśca koṭiśo'pi mumuhurvīkṣya cācyutam ।
kinnaryaśca koṭiśo'pi samuhurvīkṣya kāmadam ।। 14।।
nartakyaḥ koṭiśaścāpi mumuhurvīkṣya māyinam ।
śilpinyo mumuhuścāpi vādinyo mumuhustathā ।। 1 5।।
puṣpiṇyo mumuhuścāpi yatinyaḥ koṭiśastathā ।
sādhvyaśca mumuhuścāpi sanyāsinyaśca koṭiśaḥ ।। 16 ।।
mumuhurbrahmacāriṇyo viprāṇyo mumuhustathā ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣya rādhe! mumoha sakalaṃ jagat ।। 17 ।।
kāściddhariṃ pravīkṣyaiva tvākṛṣṭāḥ keśavaṃ prati ।
kaścit tatkalagiṃ vīkṣya sauvarṇatāntavī sthirām ।। 18।।
piśaṃgīṃ kiraṇairvyāptāṃ sthirāstatraiva cā'bhavan ।
lakṣmyāśrayaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ sauvarṇaṃ koṭihīrakam ।। 19 ।।
naikaratnamaṇivyāptaṃ sūryavadbhāsvaraṃ śubham ।
vīkṣya kāścittatra lagnāḥ sthirā magnāstathā'bhavan ।। 2.291.20 ।।
kaścinmukuṭasaṃsthāँśca ratnahārān sumasrajaḥ ।
puṣpapaṃktīśca kalikāḥ śekharān puṣparājikāḥ ।। 21 ।।
pradānasūcakān vīkṣya mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ।
kāścitkeśān mañjulāँśca cākacikyaprabhānvitān ।। 22।।
kṛṣṇān vakrān bhaṅgikāḍhyān sūkṣmān netraharānśubhān ।
sugandhitailapānāँścā''karṇāgrakṛtatoraṇān ।। 23 ।।
paścabhāge chādakāँśca vīkṣya prakīrṇakasthitān ।
dantikābhiḥ saṃskṛtāँśca samīkṛtān samāntakān ।।।24।।
prāntapiśaṃgakān vīkṣya mumuhustatra susthirāḥ ।
kāścittejaḥparidhiṃ ca vīkṣya mahāntamujjvalam ।।25।।
antaḥparidhisāhasraṃ koṭikiraṇabhābhṛtam ।
bahuraṃgaṃ miṣṭakṛṣṭicamatkārabhṛtaṃ śubham ।।26 ।।
divyaṃ vīkṣya ca tatraiva mumuhuścā'bhavan sthirāḥ ।
kāścidbhālaṃ pravīkṣyaiva viśālaṃ tvardhacandravat ।।।27।।
ujjvalaṃ tvekarekhāḍhyaṃ prāntayoścandrabhābhṛtam ।
madhye sūryasamaṃ bhāsvat projjvalaṃ connataṃ matam ।।28।।
puṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ manohāri vīkṣya mugdhāḥ sthirāstadā ।
kāściccandraṃ kauṃkumaṃ ca madhye sthitaṃ suśobhanam ।।29।।
vālasūryasamaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyo'bhavan sthirāḥ ।
kāścid vīkṣya sutilakaṃ cordhvapuṇḍraṃ hi kānakam ।।2.291.3 0।।
svarṇavarṇaṃ cāndanaṃ ca kauṃkumaṃ miśritaṃ tanu ।
tatraiva mugdhā abhavan sthirānandabharāstadā ।।।3 1 ।।
kāścittu prāntayorvīkṣya patrike cāndanīkṛte ।
madhye kuṃkumasūkṣmālpabindvībāhulyaśobhite ।।32।।
tāsveva mumuhurnāryaḥ patryāṃ bindvīṣu ca sthirāḥ ।
kāścid bhrūyugale ramye kāmakammānikātmake ।।33।।
sūkṣmanīlā'ticañcatsadromāvalivirājite ।
prāntatanusūkṣmakāgre mugdhāstatrā'bhavan sthirāḥ ।।34।।
kāścid bhruvormadhyayoge śvetatejovirājite ।
cāndrapiṇḍasamaśobhe mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ।।35।।
kāścid bhrūnimnabhāge ca nāsāmūle manohare ।
cakṣuṣormadhyake dyotamāne mumuhuḥ susthirā ।। 36।।
kāścittilasumābhāṃ ca nāsikāṃ vīkṣya bhābhṛtām ।
namaṇīṃ ramaṇīṃ nimnāṃ tatra mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ ।।37।।
kāścid golakapolau ca raṃgaśobhau surañjitau ।
madhyonnatau sugolau ca cumbanārhau saratnakau ।। 38।।
hāsyabhṛtau connatau ca sūryacandrābhakāntikau ।
prapuṣṭau madavāhau ca vīkṣya mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ ।। 39।।
kāścinnetre cākarṇāntāyate madanavāsite ।
tīkṣṇakoṇe premavāhe ceṅgitasūcake bhare।।2.291.40।।
raktarekhe kajjalāḍhye śvetagole ca cañcale ।
kṛṣṇakanīnike ramye bhāvajñe bhāvabodhake ।।41 ।।
caikāntabodhake cāntaśceṣṭāpramāṇapūrite ।
ākarṣake mohabhṛte meṣonmeṣavirājite ।।42।।
sūkṣmaromāvalirājadrakṣikāchajjikāyute ।
jagatāṃ sarvasṛṣṭīnāṃ pratibimbāśraye śubhe ।।43।।
sāgarau premasaritāṃ nidhāne sarvatejasām ।
sarvapramāṇasaṃsthāne mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ।।44।।
kāścicca karṇayoḥ śaṣkulikāsaṃsthānayostadā ।
svarṇakuṇḍalasauvarṇaphullikāsvarṇacippibhiḥ ।।45।।
svarṇaśṛṃkhalikābhiśca ratnanaddhasthalaistathā ।
yuktayoścandrabhayośca mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ।।46।।
kāścittu buṭṭikāṃ vīkṣya svarṇasthalavirājitām ।
tatraiva mohamāpannāḥ sthirāstatrā'bhavan striyaḥ ।।47।।
kāścid vīkṣyordhvakauṣṭhasya pṛṣṭhaṃ sauvarṇakojjvalam ।
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaromāliṃ kāmasambodhakāriṇīm ।।48।।
śmaśrulekhāṃ piṃgavarṇāṃ mumuhustatra susthirāḥ ।
kāścidoṣṭhaṃ samasaṃsthānakaṃ dīrghaṃ yathocitam ।।49।।।
raktabhṛtaṃ pakvabimbaphalābhaṃ rasasaṃbhṛtam ।
cumbanārhaṃ cośyarasaṃ madhye dhanuṣyamadhyavat ।।2.291.50।।
prāntayordhanuṣaḥ prāntau yathā tathā sughaṭṭitam ।
sarveṣāṃ dhanuṣāṃ rūpaṃ dadhatpremanidhānakam ।।51 ।।
īṣatkuñcatpremabhāvabodhakaṃ hāsyamandiram ।
prasannatāśrayaṃ ramyaṃ tāmbūlarasarājitam ।।52।।
kvacit kvacicca dantaiśca kvacicca jihvayā tathā ।
kvaciccā'dharakauṣṭhena vidhāpita sucumbanam ।।53।।
madhyabindau nimnabhāgaṃ nāsā daṇḍikayā kṛtam ।
ūrdhvauṣṭhaṃ vīkṣya vai kāntā mumuhustatra ca sthirāḥ ।।54।।
sugandhasambhṛtaṃ śvāsaṃ cehamānaṃ striyo'parāḥ ।
prasarantaṃ sarvadikṣu sugandhayantamīśvarān ।।55।।
mādayantaṃ śāntayantaṃ ghrātvā mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ ।
adharauṣṭhaṃ raktavarṇaṃ tāmbūlarasavedinam ।।56 ।।
adharauṣṭhasakhāyaṃ taṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāḥ ।
cibukaṃ svarṇacibukapiṃgabinduvirājitam ।।57।।
śobhanaṃ samasaṃsthānaṃ yogyanimnatvaśobhanam ।
samanikāsahanusaṃśobhāvardhitasundaram ।।58।।
divyaṃ navanītakābhaṃ sthalapadmākṛti prabham ।
vīkṣya nāryo mumuhuśca kṛtvā hṛdyabhavan sthirāḥ ।।59।।।
kambukaṇṭhaṃ susvaraṃ ca hanvadhaḥ puṣṭapeśikāḥ ।
galaṃ puṣṭaṃ yathāghaṭṭaṃ mumuhurvīkṣya ca sthirāḥ ।।।2.291.60।।
siṃhaskandhau harervīkṣya puṣṭau balabhṛtau tathā ।
vīkṣya kāścittu mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrā'bhavaँstadā ।।6 1 ।।
kāścid vīkṣyonnataṃ puṣṭaṃ viśālaṃ vakṣa uttamam ।
dugdhacampakabhāvyāptaṃ sarvabalāśrayaṃ śubham ।।62।।
naratvā''vedakaṃ śūramanaḥkṣobhakaraṃ kṣaṇam ।
nāryabhivāñchitaṃ rādhāramā''śleṣavibhāvitam ।। 63 ।।
svarṇarekhāyutaṃ romṇāṃ dakṣāvartasamanvitam ।
śrīvātsalyabhṛtaṃ sūryacandrābhastanarājitam ।।64।।
āyataṃ cāpi vai dīrghaṃ dṛḍhabandhavibhāsitam ।
kukṣikomalatāyuktaṃ pārśvamārdavasuspṛśam ।। 65।।
pṛṣṭhavaṃśadṛḍhasthānaṃ bāhumūlātiśobhanam ।
evaṃvidhaṃ harervakṣaḥsthalaṃ sukhasthalaṃ param ।।66 ।।
sampatsaukhyasamīhāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya vai sundarīgaṇāḥ ।
mumuhuścāti tatraivā'bhavan magnāḥ sukhasthirāḥ ।।67।।
sauvarṇaṃ kaṇṭhalaṃ kaṇṭhe bhūṣaṇaṃ ratnaghaṭṭitam ।
tathā sauvarṇapatrīṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ kānakīṃ tathā ।।68 ।।
plakṣapatrīṃ ca sauvarṇīṃ pañcasarīṃ ca kānakīm ।
badarīmālikāṃ svarṇāṃ gokṣurāṇāṃ srajaṃ tathā ।।69 ।।
sauvarṇī sūkṣmapatrīṃ ca mālikāṃ mudgamālikām ।
yavamālāṃ kānakīṃ ca kānakīṃ rājamāṣikām ।।2.291.7 0 ।।
kānakaṃ pūrttalāyaṃ ca tvaṣṭakoṇamaṇisrajam ।
kaṇṭhikāṃ taulasīṃ svarṇasūkṣmamaṇiprakaṇṭhikām ।।7 1 ।।
mālikāṃ kānakīṃ cāpi pauṣpān hārān sugandhakān ।
sauvarṇabuṭṭakauśeyakañcukopari saṃsthitān ।।72 ।।
dhṛtān hārān maṇiratnahīrakādivirājitān ।
mauktikāँśca dhṛtān hārān kaustubhān vīkṣya vai striyaḥ ।। 73 ।।
candrakāntān sūryakāntān vahnikāntān maṇīn śubhān ।
vīkṣya kaṇṭhe dhṝtauṃstatra mumuhurvai surastriyaḥ ।।74।।
anyāḥ sarvāśca mumuduḥ kṣaṇaṃstatrā'bhavan sthirāḥ ।
bhujau pṛṣṭhau ca kadalīgarbhābhau śobhanaujjvalau । ।75 ।।
pūrtadravyau kaṭakāḍhyau śṛṃkhalābhivirājitau ।
siṃhānanabhujabandhābhūṣāvirājitau śubhau ।।76 ।।
vīkṣya nāryo hi mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrā'bhavan kṣaṇam ।
prakoṣṭhau kāmaphalakau svarṇaśṛṃkhalikānvitau ।।77 ।।
maṇimauktikaratnāḍhyamāṃgalyabhūṣaṇānvitam ।
puṣpaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāḥ ।।78।।
hastatale yāvakābhe nakhān raktabharāँstathā ।
hrasvacandranibhān vīkṣyāṅgulīścāṃgulikāsrajaḥ ।।79 ।।
yuktāstathā kānakāṅgulīyakairmaṇiratnajaiḥ ।
ūrmikābhiḥ śobhitāśca mṛduraktāgrikāḥ striyaḥ ।।2.291.8 0 ।।
suparvāḍhyāḥ sukhasparśā vīkṣya mugdhāstathā sthirāḥ ।
hastayoḥ pañcajau ramyau nīlabindvīsamanvitau ।।81 ।।
vīkṣya nāryo mumuhuśca sthirāstatra tadā'bhavan ।
dakṣe hastatale vīkṣya mīnaṃ dhvajaṃ triśūlakam ।।82।।
dhanurbāṇaṃ svastikaṃ ca vajraṃ daṇḍaṃ ca cakrakam ।
gadāṃ padmaṃ śaṃkhamasiṃ khaḍgaṃ sauvarṇaśobhitam ।।83।।
mumuhurvai striyaḥ sarvāḥ sthirāstatra tadā'bhavan ।
khaḍgādhānaṃ bhinnamaṇinaddhaṃ carma tathāvidham ।।84।।
vīkṣyā'pi mumuhuḥ sarvāḥ kaṇṭhe maṃgalasūtrakam ।
bhuje maṃgalatantuṃ ca vīkṣya mugdhāḥ surastriyaḥ ।।85।।।
jihvāṃ raktāṃ svādayogyāṃ sarvasvādabhṛtāṃ striyaḥ ।
viśālāṃ mohakāgrāṃ ca sthalapadmanibhā''bhikām ।।86।।
dantān hāsye kundadalīsamān dāḍimabījabhāna ।
śvetakāntiyutān cañcatprabhān vīkṣya ca mohitāḥ ।।87।।
spṛhāṃ cakrurhi labdhyarthaṃ sthirāstatrā'bhavaँstathā ।
trivalyā sahitaṃ ramyamudaraṃ projjvalaṃ śubham ।।88।।
śītalaṃ nimnanābhyā ca madhyavallyāḍhyayā yutam ।
vīkṣya tatra ca mumuhuḥ sthirāstatrā'bhavaṃstadā ।।89।।
ārdhabhedena ca dhṛtaṃ sauvarṇapaṭakaṃ gale ।
skandhe lambatprāntabhāgaṃ vīkṣya mugdhāḥ sthirāstadā ।।2.291.90 ।।
kāścid dhyātvā tu jaghanaṃ guptaṃ cāpi kaṭidvayam ।
śyāmalaṃ mumuhustatra kaṭyāṃ baddhe tathā'mbare ।।9 1 ।।
sauvarṇatārayukte ca bahumūlyakabuṭṭake ।
suravāle rājayogye kauśeyavaranirmite ।।92।।
koṭiratnāśrite svarṇabuṭṭimauktikayojite ।
phullaphummakikāyuktanāḍikā'bhipraveśite ।।93।।
dhṛte cāpādaramye ca mumuhuryuvatīstriyaḥ ।
sarvakāmāśraye kāmye tvantaraṃge'khilāḥ striyaḥ ।।94।।
sarvamohāśraye mugdhā vividurnetarat kṣaṇam ।
kammānikānibhe ramye pādaprakoṣṭhakāgrataḥ ।।951।।
pādayoḥ pañcajau bhāgau sūkṣmaromavirājitau ।
mṛdupānahsusaṃyuktau svarṇaśobhālisaṃvṛtau ।।96 ।।
rañjitau saṃpravīkṣyaiva mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sthirāstathā ।
sakthnoḥ sakthimūlamadhye'naṅge'timumuhuḥ striyaḥ ।।97।।
aṃgulikāḥ svarṇabhūṣormikā vīkṣya tathā striyaḥ ।
kiṃkiṇikāyutau vīkṣya sauvarṇau pādabhūṣaṇau ।
kaṭakau jhaṃjharīnālau troṭakau mumuhuḥ sthirāḥ ।।98।।
ājānulambahastau ca jaghane kariśuṇḍhavat ।
karabhau karagau karikaravad vīkṣya yoṣitaḥ ।। 99।।
mumuhustatra ca sthirā abhavan vai samādhigāḥ ।
gajavimānage svarṇasihāsane mṛdusthale ।। 2.291.100 ।।
āsīnaṃ rājarājeśarājarājaṃ varaṃ prabhum ।
vīkṣya mugdhāḥ striyaḥ sarvā āyāntaṃ gopuraṃ prati ।। 101 ।।
kuṃkumā'kṣatabindvāḍhyaṃ vīkṣya śrīparameśvaram ।
cakrurvai darśanaṃ lokā jayaśabdān jagustathā ।। 102।
evaṃ vai rādhike prāptā mahāntaṃ gopuraṃ prati ।
vādyanādeśca lokānāṃ manojñā yogayātrikā ।। 103 ।।
bhāvajño bhagavāँstatra yātrāyāṃ svāsane sthitaḥ ।
darśanaṃ pradadau tatra vibhinnaṃ śṛṇu rādhike ।। 1 04।।
puruṣottamarūpeṇa muktebhyo darśanaṃ dadau ।
gopebhyaḥ kṛṣṇarūpeṇa gopībhyo darśanaṃ dadau ।। 105 ।।
pārṣadebhyo darśanaṃ nārāyaṇātmatayā dadau ।
īśvarebhyo vāsudevarūpeṇa darśanaṃ dadau ।। 1 06।।
siddhasādhugaṇebhyaśca viṣṇurūpeṇa tad dadau ।
maharṣibhyastadā brahmātmanā svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।। 10 7।।
pitṛbhyaścāryamarūpātmanā svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।
surebhyaḥ kṣīranāthātmanā'pi svaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।। 108 ।।
mānavebhyo naranārāyaṇātmanā ca tad dadau ।
pātālavāsilokebhyaḥ śvetaprabhvātmanā dadau ।। 109 ।।
nārībhyaḥ kāmadevātmarūpeṇa darśanaṃ dadau ।
kanyābhyaḥ svāmirūpeṇa mālādhraṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।। 2.291.110 ।।
pūjyābhyo bālarūpeṇa kaumāraṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।
bhaktānāṃ bhagavadrūpaṃ mokṣadaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ।। 111 ।।
sarvāyudhaṃ caturhastaṃ ramāvṛndaniṣevitam ।
narebhyo darśanaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmanā dadau ।। 112।।
antarātmasvarūpaṃ cā''vedayaddhṛdi dehinām ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! śrīmadbālakṛpṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।। 113 ।।
vijñāto hyadhirājo'sau maṇḍapākhyapurasya ha ।
gopurāgre cāyayau saṃlebhe sthairyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।। 1 14।।
vāhinyapi samagrā ca kṣaṇaṃ tasthau prapūjitā ।
samīpe tvāgataiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ kṛṣṇabṛhaspatidvijaiḥ ।। 115 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne suveṣite śrībālakṛṣṇe pratyekāṃge naranārīṇāṃ vṛttyākarṣaṇena mugdhatā, divyadarśanaṃ, gopuraṃ prati prāgamanaṃ cetinirūpaṇa-
nāmaikanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 291 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 292
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 293 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
koṭibhirmunibhiḥ sākaṃ rādhike! śrībṛhaspatiḥ ।
saṃsthito'bhūdakṣatādipūjāpātrairhareḥ puraḥ ।। 1 ।।
maṇḍapākhyaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ pañcāśadyojanātmakam ।
abhivyāpyeśvararājadarśanārthaṃ sthitāḥ prajāḥ ।। 2 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra praṇanāma svayaṃ tvaham ।
brāhmaṇāḥ saṃpraṇemuśca vedamantrān jagustadā ।। 3 ।।
yavāṃkurān daduścāpi bālakṛṣṇakare tadā ।
puṣpagucchaṃ dadau kṛṣṇaḥ kare gale ca mālikām ।। 4 ।।
bṛhaspatiḥ puṣpahāraṃ kādambakaṃ dadau gale ।
sākṣatakuṃkumacandraṃ bhāle gurustathā'karot ।। 5 ।।
lājābhirvardhayāmāsurnāryaḥ kanyāprapakṣikāḥ ।
jalapānaṃ dadau tatreśvarāya ca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 6 ।।
puraṃ praveśayāmāsa bālakṛṣṇasya vāhinīm ।
sarvāṃ divyasvarūpāṃ ca dadṛśuḥ sarvathā prajāḥ ।। 7 ।।
devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
munikanyāśceśakanyāḥ prapaśyantīśvaraṃ harim ।। 8 ।।
paśyanti yoṣitaḥ sarvā nimeṣarahitena vai ।
śivasvāmī prapūjārthaṃ gopurāgre samāyayau ।। 9 ।।
prapūjya kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā prasannaṃ pracakāra ha ।
vasuṃ ca pitaraṃ cāpi tathā'nyānmahīmānakān ।। 2.292.10 ।।
mahīmānastriyo nemuḥ prapaśya parameśvaram ।
prasannavadanaṃ kāntaṃ manoharaṃ surūpiṇam ।। 11 ।।
sarvaśobhānvitaṃ pūjya sarveṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam ।
ratnendrasāraśobhāḍhyabhūvimānasthitaṃ prabhum ।। 12।
sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahagocaram ।
navīnacāndradhavalaṃ śobhitaṃ hārarājibhiḥ ।। 13 ।।
candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ bahumālāvibhūṣitam ।
ratnakeyūravalayaratnamālābhirujjvalam ।। 14।।
ratnakuṇḍalabhūṣābhirgaṇḍasthalīvirājitam ।
ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmaṃjirarañjitam ।। 15।।
sasmitaṃ gucchahastaṃ ca paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇam ।
muktaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiśchatrakena ca ।। 16 ।।
pārśve svataḥprakāśena mukhyeśvareṇa rājitam ।
navayauvanasampannaṃ śaratkamalalocanam ।। 17।।
śaratpūrṇendutulyāsyaṃ sarvānugrahakārakam ।
koṭikandarpasaundaryaṃ cākṣarātītamacyutam ।। 18।।
tīrthapūtaṃ kīrtipūtaṃ sureśvarādivanditam ।
paramāhlādakaṃ deveśvaraṃ saundaryaśevadhim ।। 1 9।।
dūrvayā paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kadalyāḥ sphuṭamañjarīm ।
dadhānaṃ ca pracūḍāyāṃ mālamālyābhimālikām ।।2.292.20 ।।
puṣpaṃ nārīpradattaṃ ca sugandhigucchamuttamam ।
etādṛśaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchāmāpuḥ striyastadā ।। 2 1।।
lakṣmyāstu jīvanaṃ dhanyaṃ ślāghyamityūcurīpsitam ।
himajā śrīḥ dadarśāpi tārakaṃ taṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 22।।
śiveśvaraḥ viprayuktaḥ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ।
samāgatya nanāmā'pi devadevaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।।23।।
vasvagre maṇḍape dīrghe kārayāmāsa nartanam ।
nartakānāṃ cātiramyaṃ gāndharvāṇāṃ ca gāyanam ।।24।।
gāyikānāṃ gītikāśca nartakīnāṃ ca nṛtyakam ।
vādyānāṃ śabdabhedāँśca kārayāmāsa vai puraḥ ।। 25।।
āsphoṭānāṃ sphoṭanāni vidyutkhelanakāni ca ।
yantrāṇāṃ sphoṭananādān dundubhīnāṃ sugarjanāḥ ।।26।।
kārayāmāsa vāhinyāścāgre tvagre śivastadā ।
vardhayāmāsurevā'pi prajāḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakam ।। 27।।
evaṃ tadā puṇyayātrā viśrāntigṛhamāyayau ।
kṛṣṇo vimānakāt samuttīrya gopuramāsthitaḥ ।। 28।।
pārvatyā vardhito duḥkhahāñjalibhiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
tīrthajalena caraṇau prakṣālitau harestu vai ।।29।।
candanākṣatapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjito maṃgaladravaiḥ ।
yavāṃkuraiśca dūrvābhiḥ pūjitaśca sugandhikaiḥ ।।2.292.3 0।।
lājābhiśca tathā nīrājanaiḥ sampūjitastadā ।
vipraiśca guruṇā cāśīrvākyaiḥ saṃvardhitastadā ।।3 1।।
prokṣitaśca tataḥ pārśve viśrāntimandire kṣaṇam ।
svarṇasihāsane nītvā sarvaśāntiprade śubhe ।।32।।
hariṃ niṣādayāmāsa tathā sarvāgryapūjyakān ।
pitarau śivadeveśca pupūja svāgatena ha ।।3 3 ।।
bhojanaṃ madhuparkākhyaṃ jalapānena saṃyutam ।
dadau tadā śivasvāmī śāntyarthaṃ vyāvahārikam ।।34।।
tadā kanyāḥ koṭiśo'pi naijaṃ śṛṃgāramādadhuḥ ।
yogayogyā'mbarabhūṣā dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।35।।
gandhasugandhadehāśca raṃgarāgayutāstathā ।
bindubindvīyutāścāpi sajjāstadā'bhavan sthitāḥ ।। 36 ।।
pratīkṣante yadā lakṣmyāḥ dānaṃ harirgrahīṣyati ।
tadā'smākaṃ karān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo grahīṣyati ।।37।।
iti lakṣmyāśca śṛṃgāraṃ sakhyastadā vyadhuḥ śubham ।
nakhān vai rañjayāmāsuḥ sthalapadmanibhān śubhān ।। 38।।
alaktakena karayoḥ pādayośca talānyapi ।
oṣṭhau raktena raṃgeṇa rañjayāmāsureva ca ।। 39 ।।
kuṃkumakardamenāpi kapolau dvau ca karṇakau ।
locane kajjalenā'pi tvañjayāmāsureva ha ।।2.292.40 ।।
lalāṭaṃ kaisareṇā'pi candanena suśobhitam ।
dehaṃ ca candanenāpi cakruḥ sugandhisaṃbhṛtam ।।4 1 ।।
gandhasāraistathā dehaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ vyadhuśca tāḥ ।
keśān prasādhayāmāsustailasāreṇa gandhinā ।।42।।
kabarīṃ ca pracakrustāḥ śobhanāmujjvalāṃ śubhām ।
dhammilaṃ bandhayāmāsuḥ sthalapadmasraganvitam ।।43।।
sukundakalikāhārayuktaṃ ca paritastathā ।
mālatīpuṣpasaṃyuktaṃ gumphitaṃ citratantubhiḥ ।।44।।
prānte ramyā'mbarakhaṇḍaṃ kauśeyaṃ citraśobhitam ।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ śekhareṇa virājitam ।।45 ।।
sauvarṇamaṇimālābhirgolāyitaṃ śubhāspadam ।
candrakāntamaṇiṃ tatra nyadhuḥ prakāśahetave ।।46 ।।
sūryakāntaṃ brahmarandhrasthale nyadhuśca taijasam ।
strīyogyaṃ sumukuṭaṃ tā nyadhuśca mastakopari ।।47।।
maṇihārakaratnāḍhyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ raṃgaraṃgitam ।
śekharāstatra lambante maṇimauktikapuṣpajāḥ ।।48 ।।
tantikā svarṇapārāṇāṃ bahuratnādigumphitā ।
bhāle tā dhārayāmāsuḥ kārayāmāsureva ca ।।49 ।।
madhye sucandrikābindvīṃ kāśmīreṇa draveṇa ha ।
sā'kṣatāṃ ca tathā viśālake bhāle ca kaisarīḥ ।। 2.292.50 ।।
rekhā vakrā vyadhuścordhvāḥ koṇavakrāḥ śubhāstadā ।
madhye madhye catuṣkyāṃ ca bindvīścakruśca kauṃkumīḥ ।। 51 ।।
cākacakyakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ manāg vikīritaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
puṣpahārān nidadhuśca dānayogyān hi maṃgale ।। 52।।
sauvarṇīṃ mauktikāḍhyāṃ ca natthikāṃ sumanoharām ।
dhārayāmāsurevāpi svalpāṃ ca śreṣṭhavālikām ।।53 ।।
cibukaṃ harikāḍhyaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ pradadustathā ।
bindvīṃ gāle daduścāpi karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale daduḥ ।।54।।
īrike'pi ca sauvarṇe hīrakādisamanvite ।
daduśca karṇayoḥ pañcasarike karṇaśṛṃkhale ।। 55।।
sūkṣmahīrakasannaddhe phullike patrike daduḥ ।
sauvarṇīṃ kaṇṭhahaṭhikāṃ maṇinaddhāṃ dadustadā ।।56।।
kauśeyīṃ kucabandhīṃ ca kauśeyakīṃ ca kaṃcukīm ।
svarṇabuṭṭāliśobhāḍhyāṃ svarṇatārālisaṃbhṛtām ।। 57 । ।
divyahīrakaratnādigumphitāṃ hīragranthitām ।
keśā'calī nidadhuśca skandhayościpikānvitām । ।558 । ।
sauvarṇarūpyakajanyāṃ śalākāṃ bandhikāṃ daduḥ ।
orṇīṃ sauvarṇatārāḍhyāṃ kārpaṭiko dadustathā । । 59 । ।
rañjitāṃ raktaśobhāḍhyāṃ kucayoḥ kuṃkumaṃ daduḥ ।
śāṭīṃ svarṇamayīṃ ramyāṃ sūkṣmahīrakasaṃbhṛtām । । 2.292.60 । ।
sūkṣmatāramayīṃ mṛdvīṃ dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
kaṃsadorakabandhādyairbandhayāmāsurambaram ।। 61 । ।
cippiṭaiḥ sūkṣmarūpābhiḥ śalākābhistathā''ntaram ।
bhujāntare tathā vakṣo'ntare kaṭyantare'mbaram ।। 62 । ।
bandhayāmāsurevā'pi daduścāntaraghargharīm ।
mahatīṃ ghargharīṃ cāpi sauvarṇatāragumphitām ।। 63 । ।
harikaiḥ svalpakā''darśairmaṇibhiḥ khacitāṃ śubhām ।
raktavarṇāṃ citrayuktāṃ prāntapiśaṃginīṃ tathā । । 6 4।।
kaṭyāṃ kaisarapaṭṭyāḍhyāṃ saṃhitahīranāḍikām ।
pādayośca daduḥ pattrāṇike makhamalātmike । । 65 । ।
komale sthalapadmābhe sauvarṇaratnagumphite ।
aṃgulīyakamevā'pi pratyaṃgulaṃ saśṛṃkhalam । । 66 । ।
paṃcāṃgulapraparyāptaṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca dadustadā ।
pañcajayoścordhvabhāge sauvarṇīṃ kacchapīṃ daduḥ ।। 67 । ।
ūrmikā api nidadhurhīrakādisamanvitāḥ ।
padmakaṃ hastake cāpi nupūre patprakoṣṭhayoḥ ।। 68 । ।
sauvarṇe siṃhaśobhāḍhye kiṃkiṇījālanādite ।
kāmbike ca tathā kaṭakike māṇikyasaṃyute । । 69 । ।
mañjīrake ca sauvarṇe daduḥ prakoṣṭhayoḥ śriyāḥ ।
raśanāṃ cāpi sauvarṇīṃ kaṭyāṃ daduḥ samauktikīm । । 2.292.70 । ।
kaṭake hīrakanaddhe vyaṃgiḍikāḥ suvarṇajāḥ ।
ratnahīrakasannaddhāḥ śṛṃgale tu prakoṣṭhayoḥ ।।7 1 । ।
padmakāḍhye kaṃkaṇe ca valayāni dadustathā ।
bhujabandhau kānakau ca maṃgale dalake daduḥ ।।72 ।।
sauvarṇe śubhakaṭake daduśca śṛṃkhale'pi ca ।
svastikaṃ kānakaṃ cāpi candrakaṃ bhujayordaduḥ । । 73 ।।
kaṇṭhe hemamayān hārān ratnahīrakaśobhitān ।
mudgamālāṃ yavamālāṃ jambūmālāṃ dadustathā । ।74 ।।
plakṣapatraṃ kānakaṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ mauktikamālikām ।
saptaśṛṃkhalikāhāraṃ sūkṣmapatrīṃ śubhāṃ nyadhuḥ ।।75 ।।
catuṣkikādalīṃ mālāṃ badrīmālāṃ ca māṣikām ।
hīrakaiḥ saṃbhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ koṭimūlyāṃ ca taijasīm ।।76 । ।
sarvaśobhākarīṃ netracaurīṃ paṭṭikakañcukīm ।
dhārayāmāsurevā'pi naktakaṃ karayordaduḥ ।।77 ।।
iti śṛṃgāritā kanyā lakṣmīrlakṣmīsakhījanaiḥ ।
sarvāḥ kanyāḥ koṭiśo'pi śṛṃgāritāstadā'bhavan ।।78।।
udvahiṣyati naḥ kṛṣṇo suyoge kṛṣṇayoriti ।
atha vādyānyavādyanta sarvāṇi vasuyātriṇām ।।79।।
āpte śubhe kṣaṇe śreṣṭhe nakṣatre maṃgalāvahe ।
sarvasaubhāgyade yoge māhendre sampadāṃ prade ।।2.292.80 ।।
mahānandaprade śreṣṭhodaye siddhisamanvite ।
lagneśānvitasaṃllagne prodvāhocitaśobhane ।।8 1 ।।
sadgrahāṇāṃ dṛṣṭiśuddhe cā'satāṃ dṛṣṭivarjite ।
candratārāśuddhiyukte vedhadoṣādivarjite ।।82।।
śalākādikahīne ca sadā sukhaprade kṣaṇe ।
dampatyoḥ sukhayogye ca samaye bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।83 ।।
āyayau śivadevasya kailāsamāḍapā'ṅgaṇam ।
bṛhaspatinā vipraiścarṣibhirniśyarthito hariḥ । ।84 ।।
lomaśādyaiśca sahito jñātibhirbāndhavaiḥ saha ।
pitrā mātrā nṛpaiḥ sārdhaṃ sambandhibhiḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ ।।85 ।।
suraiśca pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ sādhubhiryatibhiḥ saha ।
pārṣadaiśceśvarairmuktairbhaṭṭaiścāpi purohitaiḥ ।।86 ।।
sṛṣṭipālaiḥ samastaiśca vedīmaṇḍapamāyayau ।
raṃbhāstambhasahasraiśca svarṇapaṭṭavibhūṣitaiḥ ।।87।।
campakā'śokacūtānāṃ candanānāṃ ca toraṇaiḥ ।
sarvarūpāḍhyapuṣpāṇāṃ mālābhiḥ supariṣkṛtam ।।88 ।।
maṃgalasvarṇakalaśaiḥ phalapallavaśobhitaiḥ ।
kastūrikā'kṣatairlājādūrvākuṃkumapūjitaiḥ ।।89 । ।
puṣpaiḥ parṇaiścandanaiśca ratnairvastraiḥ samanvitaiḥ ।
parito bhrājamānaiśca maṇḍitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 2.292.90 ।।
śaṃbhorvai pakṣagaiḥ sarvairmahīmānaiśca veṣṭitam ।
pārṣadaiścā'vatāraiśca saṃkarṣaṇapurogamaiḥ ।। 91 ।।
īśvarairdaivatābhiścarṣibhirnṛpairdigīśvaraiḥ ।
kailāsavāsibhiścāpi sṛṣṭitrayanivāsibhiḥ ।। 92।।
purohitairbrāhmaṇaiśca yatibhiścā'vadhūtakaiḥ ।
gaṇaiśca yoginībhiśca kanyāpitṛbhirityapi ।। 93 ।।
ratnendrasāranirmāṇavedīyuktaṃ śubhāspadam ।
raṃgaiścāndanacūrṇaiśca kastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ ।। 94 ।।
sugandhisārakaiścāpi sugandhitaṃ suraṃgitam ।
nānāmaṇiprabhāvyāptaṃ dhūpasugandhavāsitam ।।95।।
citraśobhānvitaṃ ramyaṃ gāndharvīgītikāyutam ।
saṃgītanāditaṃ vidyādharīnṛtyasuśobhitam ।।96।।
parito yuvatībhiśca vīkṣitaṃ maṃgalāyanam ।
māṃgalikaṃ ghaṭaṃ dhṛtvā guruṇā ca purodhasā ।।97।।
śobhitaṃ kalpavallyādirājitaṃ dānamaṇḍapam ।
kuśahastena bhūpena dānārthaṃ copatiṣṭhatā ।।98।।
dānavastusahitena śobhitaṃ yajñamaṇḍapam ।
samantādūrdhvabhāgeṣu koṭyabjakanyakādibhiḥ ।।99।।
prodvāhyābhirbhūṣitābhiḥ pitrādikayutādibhiḥ ।
kṛtādhivāsaṃ ramyaṃ taṃ maṇḍapaṃ bālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 2.292.10 0।।
mukhyadvāraṃ tvājagāma pūjito vardhito dvijaiḥ ।
śiveśvarastatra cāgre pūjanārthaṃ samāyayau ।। 101 ।।
bālakṛṣṇo hi bhagavān samayaṃ prāpya satvaram ।
sarvā ājñāpayāmāsa kāntā yāḥ svasya tāstadā ।। 1 02।।
mayā'rpitāni vastrāṇi bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca ।
sarvāṇyudvāhayogyāni dhṛtvā''yāntu sumaṇḍape ।। 103 ।।
udvāho bhavatīnāṃ vai kāryo mayā śriyā saha ।
śrutvā sarvāḥ sajjībhūyā''yayurvṛdhyā'pi maṇḍape ।। 1 04।।
svasvapitrādisahitā dānārthaṃ samupasthitāḥ ।
śivasvāmikṛte naijakanyārthaṃ tu vidhau tadā ।। 1 05।।
sarvāsāṃ vidhirevāsmin vidhau tatrā'pyavartata ।
śṛṇvāścaryaṃ rādhike koṭyarbudābjādhiyoṣitām ।। 1 06।।
kṛte kṛṣṇo yaccamatkārādi tatra vyadarśayat ।
śiveśvaraḥ karmakāṇḍaṃ prāvartayaddhi sarvataḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne bālakṛṣṇasya gopure pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ, tadagre nartanaṃ cāsphoṭanaṃ, viśrāntimandire viśramaṇaṃ madhuparkadānaṃ, sarvakanyakānāṃ
lakṣmyāśca śṛṃgāraḥ, devasya tudānamaṇḍapamukhyadvāraṃ pratyāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 292 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 292 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 293
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 294 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śiveśvaro mahān bhakto mahimānaṃ vidan hareḥ ।
rādhike dhanyabhāgyaṃ svaṃ mene gṛṇannidaṃ tadā ।। 1 ।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma tvadya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ ।
adya me saphalaṃ sarvaṃ yadgṛhe puruṣottamaḥ ।। 2 ।।
adya me jīvanaṃ jātaṃ sarvaṃ suprajīvitam ।
yajjātaṃ janmakoṭīnāṃ karmamūlalayānvitam ।। 3 ।।
yatpādapadmaṃ munayo dhyāyanti satataṃ hṛdi ।
sarvaphalapradātā śrīharirme prāṃgaṇe'dya vai ।। 4 ।।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ ca me tvadya prāṃgaṇe tīrthakṛttamam ।
aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tīrthībhūtaṃ mamāṃgaṇam ।। 5 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
adṛśyaścakṣuṣāmadya dṛśyo me prāṃgaṇe hariḥ ।। 6 ।।
karmaṇāṃ phaladaṃ taṃ tvāṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।
antaḥsthitaṃ parātmānaṃ madātmānaṃ namāmyaham ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ stutvā rādhike ca śivastutaṃ smaran harim
pādyaṃ padmārcite pādapadme tatra mudā dadau ।। 8 ।।
arghyaṃ ca pradadau tatra dūrvāpuṣpaphalānvitam ।
madhuparkaṃ manāk cāpi dadau bhāle sucandrakam ।। 9 ।।
kuṃkumākṣatakastūrīkṛtaṃ c tilakaṃ dadau ।
cāndanaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca gandhasāraṃ dadau tanau ।। 2.293.1 0।।
pārijātasya mālāṃ ca svapriyāṃ tad gale dadau ।
ratnahāraṃ gale cāpi prakoṣṭhe maṇibhūṣaṇam ।। 11 ।।
vahniśuddhāṃśukedivye mukuṭaṃ bhāsvaraṃ dadau ।
kuṇḍale kaṭake cāpi śṛṃgalā cormikādikam ।। 1 2।।
ratnacāmarayugalaṃ chatraṃ sauvarṇamityapi ।
svahīrakahārāँśca kaustubhasragvibhūṣaṇam ।। 13 ।।
koṭikoṭisuvarṇāni nyadhād kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ ।
dhūpaṃ ratnapradīpaṃ ca tathā nīrājanaṃ dadau ।। 14।।
svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ dadau dāne harestu vai ।
saptatīrthodakaṃ cāpi madhuparkaṃ punastathā ।। 15।।
ācamanaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ jalapānaṃ sugandhi ca ।
śayyāṃ śreṣṭhatamāṃ cāpi bhūṣaṇāni dadau tadā ।। 16।।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadau cāpi nanāma pādayostathā ।
girijā cāpi taṃ putryāḥ kāntaṃ pupūja cādarāt ।। 17।।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ cakre lājābhiḥ samavardhayat ।
candanādyaiḥ pupūjāpi svarṇamudrādikaṃ dadau ।। 18।।
gṛhopakaraṇānyevottārayāmāsa mastakāt ।
kośasya kuñcikāṃ cāpi lekhinīṃ taravārikām ।। 19।।
mūśalaṃ tarkaṭīṃ cāpi mārjanīṃ vellaṇaṃ tathā ।
darvīṃ ca śṛṃkhalāṃ cāpi kīlakaṃ yaṣṭikāṃ tathā ।।2.293.20।।
triśūlaṃ cāpi śaṃkhaṃ ca cakraṃ gadāṃ ca carma ca ।
rajjūṃ kaṃgatikāṃ cāpi darpaṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā ।।21।।
sthālīṃ saubhāgyavaṭikāṃ dūrvāṃ kāṇḍaṃ ca vaṃśikām।
phalaṃ cānnaṃ jalaṃ śākaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ samidhaṃ tathā ।।।22 ।।
evamādīni sarvāṇyuttārayāmāsa mastakāt ।
kṛṣṇasyaiva tato nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā ca mastakāt ।।23 ।।

aṃgulīyakaramaṇaṃ raṃgapātrajale'bhavat।
tatra rādhe! kṛṣṇapatnīrlagnitāḥ śṛṇu mat tviha ।। 133।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne śiveśvarakṛtaṃ kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ, pārvatīdevīkṛtaṃ gṛhopakaraṇottāraṇe, kṛṣṇasya maṇḍapāsane niṣīdanaṃ, kanyāyāḥ kanyakānāṃ
cāgamaḥ kṛṣṇapūjā devapūjā, kāmaphalabandhanaṃ, kanyādānam, hastagrahe dānāni, koṭyarbudābjakanyākṛte kṛṣṇasya tāvadrūpadhāritvaṃ, sarvakanyākaragrahaḥ, sarvakaṇṭhamālādhṛtiḥ, sarvavahnipradakṣiṇam, gotrādividhinā'rpaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 293 ।।

śrīrādhikovāca--
me sarvāḥ kathayā'traiva kāḥ kāḥ pariṇatāḥ priyāḥ ।
yāsāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa māyāto mucyate janaḥ ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike bālakṛṣṇena saha vai tadā ।
yathā lakṣmīryathā ṣaṭakṃ rādhā lakṣmīśca māṇikī ।। 2 ।।
ramā padmāvatī śrīśca catvāriṃśadyutaṃ śatam ।
brahmapriyā mukhyakanyā aśanādyāḥ samarpitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakruḥ puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ ।
meghanādyaścaturdaśasahasrāṇi samarpitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
tathā ṣaṣṭhī manasā ca dīpāvalyaśca kanyakāḥ ।
koṭisaṃkhyā agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā samarpitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
talājā tvekalā kāmadhenvākhyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyikāḥ ।
ārjantyo vasumatyādyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāḥ samarpitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
śāṃbhavī krodhanā kanyā dharāputryaśca gahvarāḥ ।
koṭisaṃkhyā dharayā cārpitāstatra mudānvitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
vedhaḥputrī sucī vanadevīkanyāśca lakṣakam ।
vanadevyā'rpitā varamālāyuktāḥ sukhānvitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
dāmanyo rākṣasakanyā lakṣaṃ damanakā'rpitāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragtadāśritāḥ ।। 9 ।।
ṣaṭkanyāḥ kaṃkatālyaścā'yutaṃ ca kāṃkatālikāḥ ।
kaṃkatālārpitā vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 2.294.10 ।।
puṣpamālāyutā bālakṛṣṇena saṃnijīkṛtāḥ ।
pitṛkanyālakṣakaṃ cā'ryamṇā dattā nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 11 ।।
janapitṛkanyakāśca viṃśatiśca nijīkṛtāḥ ।
pitṛdāsyo daśasāhasraṃ ca tatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 12।।
rāsātalyaḥ pañcasāhasraṃ kanyā daityajāstathā ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ।। 13।।
vasantakāntāḥ kanyā vai ṣoḍaśā'pi nijīkṛtāḥ ।
vasantena tadā dattā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।। 14।।
sālamālīyadaityasya pañcaśataṃ ca kanyakāḥ ।
śatamātṛyutā daityārpitāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 15।।
svastikanāgakanyāśca viṃśatiścā'yutaṃ parāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ।। 16।।
śāvadīnanṛpakanyāḥ sahasraṃ sasumasrajaḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛpārpitā nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 17।।
aindrajālikakanyāśca śaṃbhujāḥ śaṃbhunā'rpitāḥ ।
sahasraṃ sapuṣpamālā vahnisākṣye nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 18।।
sarasvatī, caturdaśavidyāśca ṣaṣṭikanyakāḥ ।
brahmaṇā cārpitā vahnisākṣye sragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ ।। 19।।
bhūgarbhīyāśca lākṣmaṇyo dve sahasre hi kanyakāḥ ।
lakṣmaṇenā'rpitā vahnisākṣye tatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।।2.294.20।।
vedhaḥkanyā dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi tu nāḍikāḥ ।
vedhasā saṃpradattāśca vahnisākṣye nijīkṛtāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
gāndharvyastriśataṃ kanyā viśvāvasusamarpitāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ।।22।।
jummāsemalānṛpakanyāḥ sahasraṃ jummalā'rpitāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasragnijīkṛtāḥ ।।23 ।।
sāntapanyaśca rākṣasyaḥ pañcasahasrakanyakāḥ ।
sāntapanārpitā vahnisākṣye sragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ ।।24।।
sauratyaḥ śatamevāgniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ।
suratarṣyarpitāḥ kanyāḥ sapuṣpasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ ।।25।।
mahābāleśvarya eva trikanyā vahnisākṣikāḥ ।
baleśvarā'rpitāḥ puṣpamālāyuktā nijīkṛtāḥ ।।।26 ।।
ailavīlaikakanyā ca īlavilā'rpitā tadā ।
vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutā tatra nijīkṛtā ।।27।।
dakṣajavaṃgarabhūpakanyāḥ śataṃ sumasrajaḥ ।
prajākanyāsahasraṃ coṣṇālayasya nijīkṛtāḥ ।।28।।
agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamālāsamanvitāḥ ।
prācīnadeśakanyāśca nṛpajāśca prajodbhavāḥ ।।29।।
vahnisākṣye tajjanakairarpitāḥ koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ ।
piśaṃgarājadattāśca varasragbhirnijīkṛtāḥ ।।2.294.3 0।।
santāraṇadvijakanye dve puṣpamālikāyute ।
santāraṇā'rpite vahnisākṣye tatra nijīkṛte ।। 31 ।।
śibidevanṛpakanyāḥ śataṃ śibyarpitāstadā ।
vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutāstadā nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 32।।
tharkūṭasthanṛpakanyāḥ pañcāśadvahnisākṣikāḥ ।
tharkūṭasthā'rpitā puṣpasragyuktāḥ saṃnijīkṛtāḥ ।। 33 ।।
vīrajāranṛpakanyāḥ śataṃ vai vahnisākṣikāḥ ।
vīrajārārpitāḥ puṣpamālāyuktā nijīkṛtāḥ ।।34।।
śaktyakṣinṛpakanyāśca ṣaṣṭiśca vahnisākṣikāḥ ।
piśācinyaḥ śataṃ kanyāḥ śaktyakṣiṇā samarpitāḥ ।।35।।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ ।
kālimāśanṛpakanyāḥ śatadvayaṃ nṛpā'rpitāḥ ।।36।।
vahnisākṣye yogamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।
uralaketubhūpasya triṃśatkanyā nṛpā'rpitāḥ ।।37।।
vahnisākṣye yogamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।
krathakakṣmāpateḥ kanyāḥ pañca vai vahnisākṣikāḥ ।। 38।।
pitrā'rpitā yogamālāyuktāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।
pṛthurājena dattāḥ svakanyā viṃśatiragnikam ।। 39।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāyaiva sayogasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ]
uṣṭrālarājakanyāśca daśoṣṭrālena cārpitā ।।2.294.40 ।।
vahnisākṣye puṣpamālāyutāstatra nijīkṛtāḥ ।
haṃkāranṛpateḥ pañca jayakāṣṭhasya pañca ca ।।41 ।।
tīrāṇanṛpateḥ ṣaṭ ca alvīnarasya pañca ca ।
jīnavarddhinṛpasyā'pi saptā'nāthā tathaikalā ।।42।।
tattadrājā'rpitā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ hi tāḥ ।
yogamālāyutā bālakṛṣṇena saṃnijīkṛtāḥ ।।।43 ।।
prakīrṇikāḥ śate dve ca sahasraṃ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ।
rakṣoruddhā vahnisākṣye sasumasraṅnijīkṛtāḥ ।।44।।
alpaketo saptakanyā jayakṛṣṇavajaikalā ।
parīśānanṛpasyaikaviṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā ।।45।।
indurāyanṛpasyāpi kanye dve śobhane tadā ।
mudrāṇḍanṛpateḥ kanyā pañcadaśa vibhūṣitāḥ ।।46।।
gaṇḍabhūpasya ca nava līnorṇajācatuṣṭayam ।
bṛhaccharanṛpasyāpi tathaikādaśakanyakāḥ ।।47।।
catvāriṃśatkanyakāśca balalīnasya bhūpateḥ ।
varasiṃhasya pañcaiva rāyagāmalajāṣṭakam ।।48।।
phenatantunṛpasya dve stokahomasya caikalā ।
kāṣṭhayānanṛpasyaikā kolakasyāpi caikalā ।।49।।
dinamānanṛpasya dve kanyāḥ sayogamālikāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā svasvapitrā samarpitāḥ ।।2.294.50।।
rājabhirarpitā bālakṛṣṇena tā nijīkṛtāḥ ।
rāyakinnararājasyaikapañcāśatsuputrikāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
rāyakoṭīśvarasyaikaviṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā ।
rāyaraṇajidbhyasya viṃśatiḥ kanyakāstathā ।।।52
rāyavākakṣabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāstathā tadā ।
rāyamārīśabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāśca śobhanāḥ ।।53 ।।
rāyabaleśvarasyāpi tisraḥ kanyāstathā parāḥ ।
rāyalambārabhūpasya ṣaṭ kanyā yauvanānvitāḥ ।।54।।
rāyanavārkabhūpasya sapta kanyāḥ sumañjulāḥ ।
rāyahūṇḍeśabhūpasya nava kanyāḥ sukomalāḥ ।।55।।
rāyakūpeśabhūpasyaikalā putrī satī śubhā ।
kālīmaṇḍabhūpateśca catasraḥ kanyakāstathā ।।56।।
vanajeleśanṛpateḥ pañca kanyāḥ supāṇḍurāḥ ।
pārāvārapibasyāpi tisraḥ kanyāḥ suraktikāḥ ।।57।।
koṭīśvaranṛpasya dve tisraḥ satīśabhūpateḥ ।
tretākarkaśanṛpateḥ sapta kanyāḥ sugorikāḥ ।।58।।
āṇḍajarānṛpasyāpi catasraḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ।
bālyarajonṛpasyāpi kanyaikā dharmaśālinī ।।59।।
rāyasomanabhūpasya tisraḥ kanyāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।
ūrugavākṣanṛpataḥ kanye dve śobhane tathā ।।2.294.60 ।।
parāṅvratanṛpasya dve rājārāyasvasaikalā ।
īśānapānabhūpaikacatvāriṃśatsukanyakāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
rājārāyapatikṣmeśatrayastriṃśatsukanyakāḥ ।
etāḥ sarvāṃstadā tatra yogamālāvibhūṣitāḥ ।।62।।
rājaśṛṃgāraśobhāśca svasvapitrā samarpitāḥ ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ ।।63।।
triṃśatkanyā maṃgalādyā maharṣibhiḥ samarpitāḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ tā vibhinnānāṃ bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ ।।64।।
ājanābhapradeśānāṃ rājñāṃ kanyāḥ samujjvalāḥ ।
sahasrāṇi daśa tattatpitrādibhiḥ samarpitāḥ ।।65 ।।
prajākanyā daśasahasrāṇi prajābhirarpitāḥ ।
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā yogamālāvibhūṣitāḥ ।।66।।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bālakṛṣṇanijīkṛtāḥ ।
pṛthak pṛthak prakuṇḍeṣu pṛthag vahneḥ prasākṣikam ।।67।।
karagrahaṇametāsāṃ sarvāsāmabhavattadā ।
rādhike! ca tathā'nyāśca kauberyaśca sahasraśaḥ ।।68।।
sahasraśaśca māhendryo yamakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
vāyavyo vaiśvakarmyaśca vārkṣyo raudryaśca vahnijāḥ ।। 69 ।।
śrāvaṇyaścāpi khānijyaḥ sāṃvatsaryaśca gopikāḥ ।
prācīnyaśca piśaṃginyo rāśiyānyaśca koṭiśaḥ ।।2.294.7 0 । ।
raumāyanyaśca pāraśyo dhaivaryaśca sahasraśaḥ ।
kinnaryo'marya evāpi gauryaḥ paryaśca koṭiśaḥ ।। 71 ।।
ābriktyaścāpi hārityaḥ pātālyaḥ svargya ityapi ।
apsaraso brahmasaraso gāndharvyaḥ koṭiśo'pi ca ।।72 ।।
vidyunmaṇiścaḥ kuśalā yoginī, dve tathā'pare ।
bhaumyaścāpi ca dānavyaḥ koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 73 ।।
kaḥ kartuṃ tatra śakyet saṃkhyāṃ cārvāṃgadṛ'śirjanaḥ ।
tāḥ sarvāḥ smṛtapitrādyāḥ pitrupasthitisannidhau ।।74।।
vibhūṣitāḥ kṛtavastraprāntabandhāḥ suyauvanāḥ ।
yogamālāyutā vahniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā ।।76 ।।
tattatpitrādyarpitāśca karagrāheṇa vai tadā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenā'ṅgīkṛtāḥ pṛthak ।।76 ।।
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bālakṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।
udvāhitā vahnisākṣye sarvasākṣye samarpitāḥ ।।77।।
rādhike! te śrāvitāstāḥ sṛṣṭyādau paramātmanā ।
udvāhitā hi vidhinā sarvā brahmapriyā imāḥ ।।78 ।।
harermūrteḥ samutpannā hareḥ śaktaya eva tāḥ ।
haryarthaṃ cāgatāḥ pṛthvyāṃ sṛṣṭau sarvatra tatra ca ।।79 ।।
yatheṣṭaṃ saṃsthitāḥ kāle kṛṣṇakāntāśca sarvathā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kāśyāṃ samāśritāḥ ।।2.294.8 0 ।।
śiveśvarā'ṅgaṇe dattā kālo yāsu na jaṃbhate ।
śivaḥ kālasvarūpo vai tenā'rpitāstato'tigāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kālātītāḥ kṛpṇamūrtimayyaḥ sarvā hi mokṣadāḥ ।
saurāṣṭraṃ manmaṇerjātaṃ bālakṛṣṇo'tra rājate ।।।82 ।।
kāśyāṃ prodvāhamāpannaḥ sṛṣṭitraye prakāśate ।
pratīkṣamāṇāḥ sarvāstāḥ prodvāhaṃ prāpya cā'dya vai ।।8 3 ।।
kṛtakṛtyā babhūvuśca śāśvatānandasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
lakṣmīḥ prāptā nijaṃ kāntaṃ śiveśvarasutā kṣitau ।।84।।
diśāṃ putrī padmavatī sūryaputrī subhāsvarā ।
kalpadrumasutā śrīśca lakṣmīḥ kṣīrodaputrikā ।। 81 ।।
divyavibhūtiputrī ca māṇikyācākṣarīsatī ।
kamalādyāstathā cānyāḥ prāpya kāntaṃ hariṃ śubham ।।86।।
kṛtakṛtyo babhūvuśca sarvasaubhogyasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
sarvā udvāhitāstatra suyoge kṛṣṇayoḥ śubhe ।। 87। ।
śṛṇu rādhe tadā kāśīrājaśca śivachatrakaḥ ।
dhenupālastathā śiveśvarasyāpi subhaktarāṭ ।। 88 ।।
vīkṣyaiśvaryaṃ bālakṛṣṇe cānantaṃ pārameśvaram ।
tadaiva pradadau kāśīrājaḥ kanyā daśā'pi ca ।।8 9 । ।
dhenupālo dadau tisro vahnisākṣye tadantare ।
yogamālāyutāstāśca maṇḍape'tra najīkṛtāḥ ।। 2.294.90 । ।
yautakaṃ pradadau rājā tadā sauvarṇalakṣakam ।
narayānaṃ tathā dāsīśataṃ vibhūṣaṇāni ca । । 91 । ।
prajāścāpi dadustasmai bālakṛṣṇāya maṇḍape ।
dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ paścāttatkuṇḍe havanaṃ tadā । । 92 ।।
vahnau datvā gurūktāँśca gārhasthyasadvṛṣān varaḥ ।
aṃganāsahitastatrā'śṛṇot pālyān samantataḥ । । 93 । ।
saha dharmaṃ yugalasyā'bhinnaṃ pālaya mādhava ।
ardhāṃganāstava cemāstāḥ sarvāḥ paripālaya ।। 94।।
sukhe sukhaṃ tathā duḥkhe duḥkhaṃ paśya pareśvara ।
kāntā kānto na vai bhinnau dehayoraikyamāvaha । । 95।।
svātmavat sarvakāntāstvaṃ vibhāvaya pramodaya ।
kāntānāṃ cāntare dehe tava deho virājate ।। 96 ।।
mastake mastakaṃ mukhe mukhaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ hṛdi ।
udare udaraṃ madhye madhyaṃ pādau ca pādayoḥ । । 97।।
kāntādehaṃ svadehaṃ ca matvā tāḥ paripālaya ।
kuru dharmān sahaivā'tra vaṃśavardhanahetukān ।। 98 ।।
kāntābhiścāpi kāntaḥ svo mantavyaḥ prāṇa eva ha ।
prāṇasevā prakartavyā sarvathā ceśavat sadā । । 99 ।।
pātivratyaṃ sadā pālyaṃ kāntābhiḥ sukhahetave ।
ājñā prabhoḥ sadā pālyā prāṇairapi kriyādibhiḥ ।। 2.294.100 ।।
aikyabhāvena mantavyo bhajanīyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
ityevaṃ vīkṣya yugalairvartitavyaṃ nirantaram । । 101 ।।
sāpatnyaṃ na samudbhāvyaṃ parasparaṃ kadācana ।
sapatnībhiḥ svasṛvacca vartitavyaṃ nirantaram ।। 102 । ।
santoṣṭavyaṃ parasyai vai sukhaṃ datvā sadā sutāḥ ।
prabhoraṃśāḥ svāṃśakā vai mantavyā nānyathā kvacit । । 103 ।।
itimātre vṛṣe stheyaṃ svastyastu vaḥ sukhaṃ ca śam ।
ityuktvāṃ'kurasalilaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ cakraturgurū । । 10 4।।
dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau kṛṣṇo bhūyasīṃ kanyakāstathā ।
koṭiratnāni ca maṇīn koṭisaṃkhyaṃ suvarṇakam ।। 1 05।।
parihāraṃ tato gurū cakrāte yajñakarmaṇaḥ ।
devavisarjanaṃ cāpi sarvavisarjanaṃ tataḥ ।। 1 06।।
anekarūpavilayaṃ hariścakre'tha satvaram ।
etasminnantare devī girijā tūrṇamāgatā ।
patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiḥ sahitāgragā ।। 1 07।।
sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinyo mātaro'pi tadā''gatāḥ ।
sukṛtvā maṃgalaṃ sarvāstatra nirmañcchanādikam ।। 1 08।।
dampatirveśayāmāsuḥ ratnanirmāṇamandiram ।
koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ vāsārhaṃ dīpitaṃ yathā ।। 1 09।।
dvitīyamiva golokaṃ drāk kṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।
kailāsākhyasya muktasya sāhāyyena navīkṛtam ।। 2.294.11 0।।
ratnasiṃhāsaneṣveva vāsayāmāsureva ca ।
bhojayāmāsurevā'pi svāminā saha kanyakāḥ ।। 111 ।।
sakarpūraṃ satāmbūlaṃ pradadurvāsitaṃ jalam ।
sarasvatī tadovāca sarvāḥ sṛṣṭeśca mātaraḥ ।। 1 12।।
devyaḥ satyastathā sādhvyo nārāyaṇyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
kanyakāḥ saubhāgyavatyaḥ kurvantu maṃgalaṃ param ।। 1 13।।
yathā svāmī tathā kanyā yojitāḥ paramātmanā ।
vidagdhānāṃ vidagdhena bhavantu saṃgamāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 14।।
atha sarvān mahīmānān narānnārīḥ śivāpatiḥ ।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa sādaram ।। 1 15।।
khādyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ sveṣṭaṃ cūṣyatāṃ lihyatāṃ muhuḥ ।
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ cāpi gṛhyatāṃ tṛpyatāmiti ।। 1 16।।
pīyatāṃ svādyatāṃ ceti śabdo'navarato'bhavat ।
ghoṣo babhūva śālāsu vādyasaṃgītamaṃgalaiḥ ।। 1 17।।
evaṃ rātrau bhojanānte tāmbūle'pi nivartite ।
mahīmānāḥ parāṃ śānti viśrāntiṃ nidrikāṃ śubhām ।। 1 18।।
jagṛhuścobhayapakṣā viśāle klṛptapattane ।
dampatīmandire śrīmadbālakṛṣṇo'pyanantakaḥ ।। 11 9।।
yāvatyaḥ santi kāntaśca tāvadrūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tābhirmṛdvīṣu śayyāsu sevitaḥ sukhado'bhavat ।। 2.294.120 ।।
rādhike'nantasattvasyā'nantavīryasya yoginaḥ ।
koṭyarbudābjapatnyo'pi na vijetuṃ kṣamāḥ kvacit ।। 121 ।।
niśāyāṃ nṛtyakhelādyā mallānāṃ yuddhasatkalāḥ ।
vādyānāṃ ca samāśrāvā nāṭakānāṃ kalādṛśaḥ ।। 1 22।।
abhavannagare tatra prodvāhotsavalambitāḥ ।
rātryardhordhva tataḥ śāntaṃ sarvaṃ vai satyamaṇḍalam ।। 123 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne vahnisākṣye prodvāhitānāṃ nirdeśaḥ, gṛhadharmopadeśaḥ, prodvāhakāryaparihāraḥ, dampatībhojanam, sarvabhojanam, koṭyarbudābjarūpaparihāraḥ, sarvābhiḥ saha sarvarūpeṇa kṛṣṇasya dampatīmandire vihāraḥ, sarvaśayanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 294 ।।
