śrorādhikovāca-
kati kanyāstadā kāntāḥ prasaṃkhyātā ratigṛhe ।
yā vai pūrvaṃ sulabdhāśca tato labdhāśca vai kati ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
rādhike nijapitrādyairarpitā yāstu kanyakāḥ ।
tāstu kāntāścatuṣkoṭyaścaturlakṣāṇi vai tathā ।। 2 ।।
pañcapañcāśadapi ca sahasrāṇi tathā'dhikāḥ ।
ṣaṭ śatāni dvāviṃśatirnūtnakanyā nijīkṛtāḥ ।। 3 ।।
athā'nyāḥ kanyakāḥ kauberyādyāḥ sṛṣṭitrayā''gatāḥ ।
arbudaṃ tāḥ svāgatā vai tathā'bjaṃ sūkṣmavartikāḥ ।। 4 ।।
rādhike sakhya evaitā bālakṛṣṇasya mandire ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śayane'bhavan ।। 5 ।।
koṭyarbudā'bjāstāḥ sarvāḥ kāntā vai ratimandire ।
koṭyarbudābjaśayyāsu cāsan tāvadvarānvitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
atha prātastato jāte pañcamyāṃ śrīharistadā ।
maṃgalairgītikābhiśca suvādyānāṃ ninādanaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhāṭacāraṇabandīnāṃ yaśogānairdvijeritaiḥ ।
vedastotrasvarādyaiśca vetradhārapraśaṃsanaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
jajāgāra prabhuścāpi prabhvyaḥ sarvā jajāgaruḥ ।
kṛtasnānāhnikaḥ kṛtaśṛṃgāro bālakṛṣṇakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛtaśṛṃgāraśobhābhiḥ kāntābhiḥ sahitaḥ prage ।
vṛddhānpūjyāngurūnśreṣṭhānsatīḥ sādhvīḥ prapūjya ca ।। 2.295.10 ।।
vṛddhāśīrvādamādāya koṭistrīnaraśobhitaḥ ।
sajjo'bhavannagaryāṃ hi bhramaṇārthaṃ sayātrikaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yogayātrī tadā vṛddhanideśena yathāyatham ।
sajjā kṛtā saśobhā ca phullekārthā suśobhanā ।। 1 2।।
gajaśobhaṃ vimānaṃ svaṃ cādhiruroha saddhavaḥ ।
viśālaṃ bahuśobhaṃ ca viśvakartrā tadā kṛtam ।। 13 ।।
mārgayogyā''yataṃ cāpi dairghye tu bahuyojanam ।
koṭyarbudābjasaṃkhyasvanavoḍhābhiḥ susevitaḥ ।। 14।।
vyarājata vimāne bhūsparśe tasmin pareśvaraḥ ।
kailāsākhyaśivamuktapreritaṃ navasaṃsthakam ।। 15।।
raṃgagulālakāśmīrakastūrīgandhaśobhitam ।
puṣpāhārāvalirājatsarvavartulasundaram ।। 16।।
svarṇasiṃhāsanā'saṃkhyayutaṃ dṛśyaṃ manoharam ।
puṣpaprakṣepaṇadroṇīklṛptaṃ gulālakośavat ।। 17।।
mahīmānāgraṇībhiśca narairagre pravāsitam ।
mahīmānāgraṇīstrībhiḥ pṛṣṭhe gītyabhighoṣitam ।। 18।।
tathā vai dampatīsambandhibhiḥ pitrādibhiryutam ।
sarvāgre sarvavādyaiśca nināditaṃ sumānitam ।। 19।।
vimānaṃ śrīśaṃkarasya gṛhāṃgaṇe prapūjitam ।
phullagulālaprasṛtikṣepakṛddampatīśritam ।।2.295.20 ।।
śanaiścā'gre'prasaradvai mahānandapradarśakam ।
vāhinī sā śivaprāsādakādagre sasāra ha ।।2 1 ।।
vardhayanti yugalāni prajājanāḥ phalādibhiḥ ।
dravyairhārairhastadānaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śubhāśiṣā tadā ।।22।।
girijānagaraṃ sarvaṃ bhramitvā phullayātrikā ।
sarvapūjāṃ samagṛhya vardhayinīṃ prajākṛtām ।।23।।
kāśīpattanamevā'pi samastaṃ sāntamityatha ।
bhramitvā kuladevyāśca durgāyā darśanaṃ tathā ।।24।।
hanūmato darśanaṃ ca viśveśvarasya darśanam ।
annapūrṇādarśanaṃ ca gaṇeśasyāpi darśanam ।।25।।
pañcagaṃgātaṭe dharmadevasyāpi ca darśanam ।
pūjanaṃ ca dhanairdānaiḥ puṣpapatraphalādibhiḥ ।।26 ।।
kṛtvā sarvatra ca tato bindumādhavamāyayau ।
tatra śrīmādhavaṃ prārcya datvā dānāni dakṣiṇāḥ ।।27।।
vimānaṃ pāvanīgaṃgājalopari hyapāsarat ।
yogagranthiyatāḥ kāntāḥ kāntaścāpi nadījalam ।।28।।
ācamanaṃ pragṛhyaiva prapūjya tīrthamuttamam ।
kṣamāpya śrīmatīṃ gaṃgāṃ dīpadānaṃ pradāya ca ।।29।।
mukhe pradadurdānaṃ bahusvarṇaṃ samantrakam ।
sadgururlomaśastatra yogagranthīn vyamocayat ।। 2.295.30।।
tato nagaramadhye ca vimānena punaḥ prabhuḥ ।
mahārājapathenāpi nirgato vādyanādakaiḥ ।।3 1।।
narā nāryaśca vai draṣṭuṃ satvarāḥ sarvataḥ sthitāḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā kāntakāntāḥ kāntaṃ yogyaṃ susundaram ।।32।।
praśaśaṃsurhi bahudhā dampatīsukhamuttamam ।
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ tatra mugdhāḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।।33 ।।
ayameva caiti bhagavān kṛpānidhiḥ,
sakhi naḥ kadā sa ca miliṣyati prabhuḥ ।
bahukanyakābhiriha labdha īśvaraḥ,
kṛpayaiva naiva nijapuṇyasaṃgrahāt ।।34।।
iha mānavaṃ hi vapurā''pya durlabhaṃ,
sakhi cenna kṛṣṇabhagavānniṣevyate ।
bhavabandhanāni ca tadā na yānti śaṃ,
nijanetrakaiḥ prabhurayaṃ vilokyatām ।।35।।
paramā'kṣare'niśamanantapārṣadaiḥ,
sukhadābhirīśvarasatībhirarcitaḥ ।
bhuvanāntareṣvapi ca kanyakārcitaḥ,
sukhadaḥ samāgata iha prasecyatām ।।36।।
bahukoṭirūpadharaśaktiko hyayaṃ,
nikhilābhikāmarasapūrako hyayam ।
hṛdaye sthito'pi nijanetragocaro,
bhavatīha taṃ patitayā pragṛhyatām ।।37।।
śrutayaḥ purā'sya yaśasāṃ pragāyanai-
ratha kanyakātanudharā hyasevayan ।
surapatnikāśca nṛpakanyakādikāḥ saha,
yānagā harivatīrvipaśyata ।।38।।
nanu puṇyanāṇakadhanaiḥ sugamyakaṃ,
vayamatra tādṛśadhanena varjitāḥ ।
nahi labdhavatya iha yaḥ pare'kṣare,
bhajanena cāpi ca laye'pi ceṣyate ।।39।।
sakhi kāntakoṭiriha bhujyate yathā,
nijakarmaṇā'pi ca harirna labhyate ।
yadi labhyate'pi nahi bhujyate tviha,
svajanustadā'pi viphalaṃ vilokyate ।।2.295.40।।
vijayantu tasya sumamālikāyutā,
bahuvatsarāṇi ca sukhābdhimagnikāḥ ।
śatakoṭikāmavararūpaśobhanaṃ,
sukhayantu cāpi labhantu satsukham ।।41।।
api naḥ spṛhā'sya mukhapaṃkaje sakhi,
hyatijāyate kimiha labdhisādhanam ।
iyamarthanā'sti hṛdayasthito bhavān,
pradadātu tatra navasaṃgamaṃ hi naḥ ।।42।।
ayi vadhva! īśvarakṛtā'bhivandanāḥ,
praṇibhālayantu nijadāsikā hi naḥ ।
samaye kvacinnijapatiṃ ratisthale,
smaraṇaṃ dadhatviti hi no'rthanā'sti vai ।।43।।।
rādhike ceti tāḥ stutvā natvā dhṛtvā hariṃ hṛdi ।
puṣpādyairvardhayāmāsuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।44।।
śṛṇu rādhe parabrahma vilokya vārayoṣitaḥ ।
sahasraśaḥ pupūjuśca vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।45।।
mumuhuścā'kṣatāḥ kanyāstisraḥ catuḥśataṃ tathā ।
mātrājñayā tadā tāśca mārge mārge varaṃ prabhum ।।46।।
prapūjya puṣpamālāśca kaṇṭhe prabhostu vai nyadhuḥ ।
arpitāstāśca mātṛbhirvimānamadhyarohayan ।।47।।
kṛṣṇapatnyaśca tā jātā gāndharvyaḥ sevikāḥ sadā ।
evaṃ rādhe'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya patnikāḥ ।।48।।
catuḥkoṭyaścaturlakṣāṇyapi cāpi tato'dhikāḥ ।
ṣaṭapañcāśatsahasrāṇyabhavaँśca pūrvabṛṃhitāḥ ।404,56000 ।।49।।
koṭyarbudā'bjasaṃkhyāśca tadanyāśca nijīkṛtāḥ ।
tā etāḥ saha modante samarūpaiḥ samastakaiḥ ।
( koṭayaḥ, arbudāni, abjāni ca) ।।2.295.50 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaiḥ śrībālakṛṣṇakaiḥ ।
tretāyāṃ phullayātrīyā vāhinī ca tataḥ param ।।।51।।
śivasvāmipuraṃ yātā nijāvāsamanuttamam ।
phullayātrāparihārastato jātaḥ śubhāvahaḥ ।।52।।
śiveśvarādayo yātā nijāvāsaṃ samutsukāḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇādyāstato yātāḥ pārvatīpattanaṃ śubham ।।53।।
bhojanāni tataḥ sarvān mahīmānān hi śaṃkaraḥ ।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā bahumiṣṭānnakāni vai ।।54।।
pāyasāni vividhāni odanānyuttamānyapi ।
śākāni dvidalāścāpi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca ।।55।।
lehyacoṣyāṇi sarvāṇi miṣṭapānāni yāni ca ।
amṛtānyapi sarvāṇi bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।।56।।
mahīmānān samastāṃśca dampatīpakṣakānatha ।
grāmaprajā dīnabhikṣūn bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।।57।।
sarvasevakavargāśca tathā nāṭyādivargakān ।
sarvān stāvakavargāṃśca vādakān vai samastakān ।।58।।
vāhakāँśca samastāँśca rakṣakān gāyakāँstathā ।
karmacārān yatīn sādhūँścātithīn prasamāgatān ।।59।।
viprān sarvān gurūn sarvān brahmapriyāḥ prabhuṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇasya pitaraṃ bhrātṝn kuṭumbaṃ ca samastakam ।।2.295.60।।
bhojayāmāsa śivarāḍa jalapānāni saṃdadau ।
pātālavāsinaḥ sarvān sarvān pṛthivīvāsinaḥ ।।6 1।।
svargādivāsinaḥ sarvān sarvānaiśvaravāsinaḥ ।
bhojayāmāsa bahudhā sarvānakṣaravāsinaḥ ।।62।।
munīn sādhūn satīḥ sādhvīrbrahmacaryadhṛtāstathā ।
tyāgivargān yogivargān bhojayāmāsa ceśvarān ।।63!।
api kīṭapataṃgādīn paśūn pakṣigaṇāँstathā ।
svedajān jalajāँścāpi bhūjān sthāvarajaṃgamān ।।64।।।
tīrthāni parvatāँścāpi nadīnadāँśca sāgarān ।
kalpalatādikān sarvān devān caityān samastakān ।।65।।
bhūtapretapiśācādīn gāndharvān kinnarāँstathā ।
cāraṇān kāśikāvāsān bhojayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।।66।।
jalapānānyadāccāpi tāmbūlakāni sandadau ।
dakṣiṇā bhūyasīścāpi svarṇarūpyasumauktikīḥ ।।67।।
sauvarṇamudrikāścāpi bhūṣāmbarāṇi mālikāḥ ।
dadau tadā śivastatra koṭikoṭyarbudātmikāḥ ।।68।।
yautakaṃ pradadau paścāt koṭisauvarṇamudrikāḥ ।
kalpapeṭīṃ kalpapātraṃ cākṣayāṃ sthālikāṃ tathā ।।69।।
avyayaṃ kośamevāpi cā'vighnaṃ chatrakaṃ tathā ।
sarvarasāṃ pātrikāṃ ca sarvagandhāṃ suvallikām ।।2.295.70।।
sarvarūpāṃ puttalīṃ ca sthirayauvanikāṃ guṭīm ।
cāmaraṃ vyomagatidaṃ kavacaṃ kālavārakam ।।71 ।।
śayyāṃ cā''nandanidhikāṃ pāraśaṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā ।
cintāmaṇiṃ dadau cāpi bālakṛṣṇāya vai tadā ।।72।।
kāśīrājo dadau cāpi vimānaṃ sūryavarculam ।
hastiśataṃ sahasrāśvān kāmadhenusahasrakam ।।73 ।।
lakṣakaṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śyāmakarṇā'śvalakṣakam ।
dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraṃ vai ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tathā ।।74।।
mṛtyubhakṣāṃ mahāyaṣṭiṃ rogaghnīṃ vetrikāṃ tathā ।
ājanābhāśca rājāno pradaduryautakānyapi ।।75।।
ājanābhyaḥ prajāścāpi yautakāni tathā daduḥ ।
kanyānāṃ pitaraścāpi bhrātaraścāpi mātaraḥ ।।76।।
kanyādhanaṃ daduścāpi bhūṣāmbarādi śobhanam ।
ratnahīrakamālyāni hārān maṇikṛtāँstathā ।।77।।
sauvarṇarājataratnapātrāṇi mauktikāni ca ।
vimānāni suyānāni śayyāḥ paryaṃkaśobhitāḥ ।।78।।
muktāstatheśvarāścāpyavatārā īśvarīgaṇāḥ ।
devāśca pitaraścāpi maharṣayaśca mānavāḥ ।।79।।
sarve daduryautakāni yathāyogyāni sarvathā ।
yautakasya parihāre kṛto tato hariḥ svayam ।।2.295.80।।
dadau yathārhapātrebhyaḥ sauvarṇaṃ pāritoṣikam ।
dāsebhyo bhṛtyavargebhyaḥ sevakebhyo'yutā'yutam ।।8 1 ।।
sauvarṇānāṃ dadau cāpi karmacāribhya ityapi ।
gāyakebhyo nāpitebhyaḥ savāhakebhya ityapi ।।82।।
dehamardakalokebhyaḥ sevikābhyastathā hyapi ।
mārjikābhyaḥ kṣālikābhyo mañjikābhyo dadau dhanam ।।83।।
nartakībhyo vādinībhyo gāyikābhyo dadau dhanam ।
bhāṭacāraṇabandībhyo vidyādhrebhyo dadau dhanam ।।84।।
gāndharvebhyastathā śilpicitrakebhyo dadau dhanam ।
yānibhyo mārgadarśibhyo jayibhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ।।85।।
jalibhyaḥ pavanibhyaśca śamanibhyo dadau dhanam ।
śākaṭibhyo vimānibhyo rathibhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ।।86।।
patākibhyo vādakebhyo yantribhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ।
rakṣibhyaḥ sahayāyibhyo bhikṣukebhyo dadau dhanam ।।87।।
kanyakābhyaḥ kumārebhyaḥ satībhyaḥ pradadau dhanam ।
nālinībhyaḥ śodhinībhyastālinībhyo dadau dhanam ।।88।।
vaṃśinībhyo dvijebhyaśca tairthikebhyo dadau dhanam ।
darśakebhyo lambahastakebhyaścāpi dadau dhanam ।।89।।
manasā vāñcchakebhyo'pi dadau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
rājānaśca daduḥ svarṇaṃ rūpyakaṃ mudrikāstathā ।।2.295.90 ।।
pātrāmbarāṇi ca tathā pāritoṣātmakaṃ dhanam ।
sīvakebhyaśca mālibhyaḥ kārdamibhyo dadurdhanam ।।9 1।।
gandhasāribhya evāpi patribhyaśca dadurdhanam ।
kailāsāya maṇḍapāya mūrtimate hariḥ svayam ।।92।।
koṭyarbudābjamūlyāँśca sauvarṇamukuṭān dadau ।
gaṇebhyaścāpi sarvebhyaḥ sauvarṇaṃ pāritoṣikam ।।93।।
anādiśrībālakṛṣṇo dadau cānyebhya ityapi ।
bhaginīputrakebhyaśca putrībhyaḥ pāritoṣikam ।।94।।
bhūṣāmbarādikaṃ tatra dadau sauvarṇamuttamam ।
viśvakāryāya devāya dadau śrībālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।95।
kaṇṭhahāraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ koṭihīrakagumphitam ।
svarṇamaṇikṛtaṃ cāpi mukuṭaṃ śobhanaṃ tadā ।।96।
śiveśvarāya bhagavān parameśvarabhāvavān ।
dadau siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ cā'vikuṇṭhaṃ jagattraye ।।97।
śiveśvaro'pi ca dadau sarvasvaṃ paramātmane।
bṛhaspataye sarvasvaṃ haristadā tu sandadau ।।98।।
ityevaṃ pradadustatra pāritoṣaṃ yathārthakam ।
tataḥ svalpāṃ prāptavanto viśrāntiṃ madhyasūryake ।।99।।
atha tīrthe snānavāñcchā kṛtavān bhagavān punaḥ ।
sarvastrībhirmahīmānaiḥ saha gaṃgāṃ yayau punaḥ ।। 2.295.10 0।।
tīrthavidhiṃ cakārā'tha dānāni vividhāni vai ।
prāyaścittāni kṛtvaiva dadau sasnau punaḥ punaḥ ।। 101 ।।
sarvāḥ kāntā prasasnuśca dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
śaṃbhustatra vipraveṣaḥ samāyayau hi bhikṣukaḥ ।। 1 02।।
bhikṣāṃ yayāce bhagavān pradadau svarṇalakṣakam ।
punaryayāce ca tato dadau tulasīmālikām ।। 1 03।।
punaryayāce ca tato dadau mūrtiṃ nijāṃ hariḥ ।
kānakīṃ sarvarūpāḍhyāṃ svastītyuvāca śaṃkaraḥ ।। 1 04।।
punaryayāce vacanaṃ hariḥ prāha vadā'tra me ।
śaṃbhuryayāce gaṃgāyāṃ vāsaṃ tīrthārthameva ha ।। 1 05।।
varaṇāyāṃ tathā''vāsaṃ yayāce paramātmanaḥ ।
haristathāstviti prāha pañcagaṃgājale taṭe ।। 1 06।।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ mahātīrthaṃ kṛtvovāsa tato hariḥ ।
adṛśyadivyarūpeṇa sarvadā'nyena vartate ।। 1 07।।
mārgaśīrṣe śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ pañcamīdine ।
prativarṣaṃ samāyāti brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।। 1 08।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacandrakaḥ ।
tadā snānāttathā dānānmokṣātmakaṃ phalaṃ dhruvam ।। 109।।
atha snātvā sakāntaḥ śrīhariḥ śivapuraṃ yayau ।
dugdhapānādikaṃ kṛtvā lebhe viśrāntimacyutaḥ ।। 2.295.11 0।। iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne kāntānāṃ saṃkhyā, pañcamyāṃ prātaḥ llakayātrābhramaṇa, gaṃgāyāṃ granthimocanam, madhyāhnabhojanam, śivapure cāgatya viśrāntiḥ, pāritoṣikādyarpaṇam, gaṃgāyāṃ punastīrthasnānaṃ, bālakṛṣṇatīrthaṃ, paṃcagaṃgāyāṃ granthitīrtham, śaṃkarāya bhikṣādānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 295 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 295 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 296
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 297 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike yatra bhagavān samuvāha ca maṇḍape ।
kanyakāstatra vai tīrthamudvāhasaṃjñakaṃ sadā ।। 1 ।।
varaṇāyāṃ tathā koṭitīrthaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
koṭyarbudā'bjarūpeṇa bhagavāṃstā gṛhītavān ।। 2 ।।
tadā śivapuraṃ tīrthaṃ pārvatīpattanaṃ tathā ।
maṇḍapākhyaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ sārabhūtalamucyate ।। 3 ।।
paṃcamyāṃ tripraharānte vidāyaṃ śaṃkaro dadau ।
kṛṣṇapakṣasamastebhyo bahudravyāṇi sandadau ।। 4 ।।
kṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ cakre pituścāpi kṣamāpanam ।
mahīmānādivargāṇāṃ nyūnasevākṣamāpanam ।। 5 ।।
arthayāmāsa sagalatkaṇṭho vai śivarāṭ svayam ।
śivachatro'pi rājā'sau kṣamāṃ tadā''rthayanmuhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
bhojyapānādikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prapakvānnaṃ ghṛtāktakam ।
pātheyaṃ pradadau cāpi rakṣakaprāpakārthakam ।। 7 ।।
yautakaṃ ca nyadhāt sarvaṃ śreṣṭhe vimānake haraḥ ।
vaimānikaṃ dadau cāpi gaṇaṃ vimānavāhakam ।। 8 ।।
atha vādyānyavādyanta vidāyasūcakāni tu ।
yantraśabdā ajāyanta gītiśabdāḥ śubhāstadā ।। 9 ।।
śiveśvaro mimelā'pi gopālaṃ kṛṣṇakaṃ hṛdā ।
kṣamāpanīyaḥ sevāyāṃ nyūnatvehamuvāca ha ।। 2.296.1 0।।
āgantavyaṃ nijaṃ matvā gṛhaṃ māṃ ca kuṭumbakam ।
putrī ca bhavadīyeti matvā rakṣyā hi mānada ।। 1 1।।
kuśalaṃ lekhanīyaṃ ca prāpya kuṃkumavāpikām ।
tadbhātṛbhyo lakṣmiṇaśca kuṭumbijanatastathā ।। 12।।
bhāvavadbhyastathā bhrātṛputrebhyaḥ sakalo hariḥ ।
devamayasamastebhyaḥ kṣamāmayācateśvaraḥ ।। 1 3।।
akṣarānmuktavṛndāśca vāsudevāttathā kṣamām ।
pradyumnādaniruddhācca bhūnmaścāpi virājakāt ।।14।।
avatārasamastebhyo nārāyaṇānnarāttathā ।
viṣṇoścāpi mahāviṣṇorbrahmaṇaḥ śaṃkarāttathā ।। 15 ।।
aryamṇaśca sanatkumārādibhyaśca satastathā ।
munisādhudevadevīrnārībhyo'yācata kṣamām ।। 16।।
nṛpavipralokapāladikpāladevadhiṣṇyagāt ।
mānavebhyo bālakṛṣṇasambandhistrībhya ityapi ।। 17।।
kṣamāmayācatā'thā'pi yogyaṃ vidāyakaṃ dadau ।
nāgalokagatebhyaśca bhūsaṃsthasarvadehinaḥ ।। 18।।
saurāṣṭrīyanaranārībhyo'yācateśvaraḥ kṣamām ।
vidāyaṃ jalapānaṃ ca miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ sumasrajaḥ ।। 1 9।।
dadāvebhyaḥ śivasvāmī mimela vakṣasā ca tān ।
pūjyā''ryābhyāḥ kṣamāmayācata hastāñjalirharaḥ ।।2.296.20।।
śivā ca pārvatī devī sarvā mātṝstadā drutam ।
kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ namaskṛtya kṣamāṃ tābhyo'bhyayācata ।।21 ।।
anyā āryāḥ samarcyaiva natvā dīnasvabhāvinī ।
kṣamāmayācatā'bhyo vāgdoṣātmikāṃ ca sevane ।।22।।
vastudāne rakṣaṇe ca mānane svāgate tathā ।
bhojane svāpane pāne nyūne kṣamāmayācata ।।23 ।।
mama putrī tava putrī mātastāṃ tvaṃ prarakṣaya ।
vṛttāntaṃ ca kvacit hṛdyaṃ sampreṣaya suvatsale ।।24।।
vadhūṭībhyaḥ kṣamāmayācata rakṣata naijikīm ।
lakṣmīṃ ceti samuvāca vidāyaṃ tūcitaṃ dadau ।।।25।।
puṣpahārān dadau cāpi jalapānādikaṃ dadau ।
śivachatro'pi ca tadā kṣamāṃ varamayācata ।।26।।
śiveśvaro'pi ca tadā kṣamāṃ varamayācata ।
śaivachatrī nṛpī kṣamāṃ kambharāyā ayācata ।।27।।
kāntāḥ sarvā mātāpitṝn nemire cāśrulekṣaṇāḥ ।
jayādyāścandrapālādyāste'pi kṣamāmayācire ।।28।।। ।
jyeṣṭhā'śokā svasā lakṣmyāḥ nanāndṛtastadā drutam ।
santoṣāyā varasvasṛtaḥ kṣamāmapyayācata ।।29।।।
bhātṛjāyāḥ kṣamāmayācire striyo'parāstadā ।
evaṃ parasparaṃ nāryaḥ kṣemaṃ ca kuśalaṃ narāḥ ।।2.296.3 0।।
pṛṣṭvā datvā vidāyaṃ ca puṣpahārān dadurmithaḥ ।
kanyāpakṣā mahīmānā śrīkṛṣṇādyāstataḥ param ।।3 1।।
saṃkarṣaṇastathā rudraḥ śaṃkaraḥ śeṣa ityapi ।
mahākālo yamaścāpi yakṣeśo bhūtabhairavāḥ ।।32।।
skando gaṇeśo nandī ca vīrabhadrādayastathā ।
koṭikoṭyadhikāḥ sarve tathā caṇḍyādiśaktayaḥ ।।33 ।।
bālakṛṣṇāt kāṃbhareyāttathā gopālakṛṣṇataḥ ।
vāsudevādvyāsadevāt kapilācca narāyaṇāt ।।34।।
viṣṇordharmād virājācca kṣamāṃ tadā yayācire ।
kuśalaṃ ca sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ snehabhāvaṃ yayācire ।।35।।
rādhā lakṣmīḥ satī durgā sarasvatī narāyaṇī ।
kamalā ṛṣipatnyaśca devyaśca gaṇikāstathā ।।36।।
gaṇāśca sevakāścāpi kaṃbharāmātaraṃ tadā ।
mahālakṣmīṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ sāvitrīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā ।।37।।
sūryaṃ candraṃ vasūn sādhyān saṃjñāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ tathā ।
natvā''bhyo'yācan kṣamāṃ tu devīrdevyaḥ sukhaṃ ca śam ।।38।।
vidāyaṃ pradaduścāpi puṣpahārā'kṣatādikam ।
evaṃ sarve mahīmānāḥ sṛṣṭitrayanivāsinaḥ ।।39।।
narā nāryo militvaiva kṣamāṃ mitho yayācire ।
śrīharaye ca kāntābhyaścāśīrvādān dadustadā ।।2.296.40।।
sajjā babhūvuḥ sarve vai svasvapakṣā narāḥ striyaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaḥ kāntāścopaviṣṭuṃ yadā vimānamāyayuḥ ।।41 ।।
mātāpitṛpade nyasya mastakāni ca kanyakāḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ tu rodanaṃ cakrustadā snehaviyogajam ।।42।।
jānakyādyā mātaraśca kanyāḥ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।
mumucuścāśrūṇi caiva siṣicurnetrajairjalaiḥ ।।43।।
jīvāmaśca kathaṃ putryo vo vinā prāṇadurlabhāḥ ।
no gṛhācchrībālakṛṣṇagṛhaṃ yātha hi vatsikāḥ! ।।44।।
ityuktvā putrikā naijā nyaṣādayan vimānake ।
pitaro'pi tadā dhairyaṃ dadurnyaṣādayan sutāḥ ।।45।।
mumocā'pyaśrūṇi svāmī bālakṛṣṇo'pi māyayā ।
vimānaṃ cārohayāmāsa śrīgopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।।46।।
putraṃ kāntāḥ kuṭumbaṃ ca tadā śivādayaḥ khalu ।
viśiṣṭaṃ yautakaṃ cāpyarpayāmāsuḥ samutsukāḥ ।।47।।
gajāँśca turagān dāsīḥ kiṃkarāँśca suvarṇakam ।
ratnānyamūlyabhūṣāśca pātrāṇi surabhīstathā ।।48 ।।
ambarāṇyāsanopakaraṇānyapi śubhāni ca ।
sajjāḥ sarve nijapakṣāḥ puṣpahārādipūjitāḥ ।।49।।
āruruhurvimānāni naiko'pyatrā'vaśiṣyate ।
tatra bherīninādaśca gateraśrūyatottamaḥ ।।2.296.50।।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādairmiśrito vyaṅgulanādanaiḥ ।
jayārāvairvardhitaścā'vyāpnot samantatastadā ।।5 1 ।।
drutaṃ sarvāṇyapi vimānāni kāmagamāni vai ।
vyomnā yayuḥ sukhaṃ paścimāṃ diśaṃ vai sahasrakam ।।52।।
āgantavyaravāstatrā'jāyanta śivayoginām ।
śivasvāmī tadā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇāt pareśvarāt ।।53 ।।
aprārthayad drutaṃ naijāmantimāṃ janmamokṣikām ।
kadā nātha kṛpāsindho cāsmān sammokṣayiṣyase ।
jātismaro'smi deveśa lakṣmīrlabdhā tvayā tava ।।54।।
śrībālakṛṣṇa uvāca -
varṣottaraṃ mokṣayiṣye smara māṃ hṛdaye'nvaham ।
āmantrayāmi sarvāścā''gantavyaṃ me janurdine ।।55।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre corjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine ।
tato manorathaṃ śaṃbho pārayiṣye tavā'rthitam ।।56।।
ityuktvā bhagavānnaijaṃ vimānaṃ cairayattadā ।
śiveśvaraścā''prayāgaṃ naijavimānakena vai ।।57।।
kāśīrājastathā kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇādayo'pi ca ।
prahituṃ prayayuścāpi pītvā triveṇikājalam ।।58।।
nyavartanta tataḥ sarve prāvartanta puro'mbare ।
indraprasthavanaṃ vyomno dṛṣṭvā vīkṣya sarasvatīm ।।59।।
ānarttaṃ cāyayuḥ kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikā'kṣaram ।
sāyaṃ prāpuścā'śvapaṭṭasarastīraṃ viśālakam ।।2.296.60।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta jayaśabdāśca khe'bhavan ।
bhūtale janatāśabdā jayabodhāstadā'bhavan ।।61 ।।
śāvadīnā mahākālī kṣetrapā mumude tathā ।
vārinaraḥ kṣetrapālo mumude ca jagarja ca ।।।62।।।
jayanādān pracakruśca devāstīrthāni pādapāḥ ।
maṇḍapākhyastathā mukto bhūmipāśca samāgatāḥ।।63।।
prajā jayaninādāँśca pracakruścātiharṣitāḥ ।
yātrikā jayanādāँśca cakrustadā pravīkṣya kham ।।64।।
darśanārthaṃ prajāḥ sarvā dudruvurambaradṛśaḥ ।
hariṃ prasasmaruścāpi hariṇīḥ sasmarustathā ।।65।।
avaterurvimānāni sahasraṃ vyomamārgataḥ ।
yathāvakāśaṃ bhūmau tu harervimānamityapi ।।।66।।
paścime śobhane bhāge'vātatāra suśobhanam ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaścā'vatīrya sarvasaṃgataḥ ।।67।।
praviśya svapurīṃ ramyāṃ kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ।
vādyāni vādayāmāsa drutaṃ manoharāṇi vai ।।68।।
kambharā cāmarīdevyastathā'nyā yoṣitastadā ।
lakṣmīṃ tasyāḥ sakhīḥ sarvā vilokya satvaraṃ tadā ।।69।।
akṣarabrahmaṇā tatra svasmānnavaṃ vinirmitam ।
koṭyarbudābjakanyānāṃ kāntānāṃ bhinnaveśanam ।।2.296.70।।
brahmapriyāpattanaṃ ca prabhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram ।
catuḥkoṭicaturlakṣaṣaṭpañcāśatsahasrakāḥ ।।71 ।।
kāntāḥ praveśayāmāsurlakṣmīṃ cābhyudaye kṣaṇe ।
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsuḥ praveśavidhipūrvakam ।।72।।
gaṇeśādeḥ pūjanaṃ ca maṇḍapasya prapūjanam ।
gurośca pūjanaṃ yūpapūjanaṃ devatārcanam ।।73।।
viprādyaiḥ kārayāmāsurjalapānaṃ dadustataḥ ।
mahīmānā mahāmaṇḍapottame jagmureva ha ।।74।।
tato gopālakṛṣṇo vai bhojanāni niśāgame ।
kārayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mahīmānān prajā api ।।75 ।।
sarvān dāsān dāsikāśca kṣetrapān karmacāriṇaḥ ।
hariṇīrbālakṛṣṇaṃ ca bhojayāmāsa kaṃbharā ।।76।।
caturvidhaṃ bhojayitvā muktānīśān surādikān ।
mahīmānānnarānnārīrmunīnnṛpāँśca bāndhavān ।।77।।
sṛṣṭitrayanivāsāँśca viprān bhaṭṭān nijān parān ।
tāmbūlādi pradāyaiva parihāraṃ cakāra ha ।।78।।
dhanaṃ ca dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo dakṣiṇāstadā ।
suratnāni vicitrāṇi dhanānyapi bahūni ca ।।79।।
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa gopālaḥ kṛṣṇaraṃjanam ।
bhuktvā viśrāntimāpuśca prasvāpaṃ lebhire tataḥ ।।2.296.80 ।।
yuvatyo bālakṛṣṇasya pratistrīrūpayoginaḥ ।
pratigṛhaṃ pracakruśca sevanaṃ navaharṣitāḥ ।।8 1।।
aviplutamahāsattvamahāvīryaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
parabrahmanijānandaṃ dadau tābhyo hyasīmakam ।।82।।
mahānandasamādhau mūrchitāḥ kṣaṇena sadṛśīm ।
niśāṃ bubudhuḥ kāminyo kāntakṛtāṃ yugāyitām ।।83।।
rādhike rāsarātrirme tasyā agre lavāyate ।
pareśasya tu sāmarthyaṃ kenāpi naiva pāryate ।।84।।
atha śrīśivadevā'dyāḥ prayāgātprayayurgṛham ।
varṇayanto guṇān sveṣāṃ sambandhipārameśvarān ।।85।।
dhanyabhāgyānyamanyanta kṛṣṇādyā api mādhavāḥ ।
pārvatīpattanaṃ gatvā sarve'pi bubhujustataḥ ।।86।।
pānatāmbūlakaṃ labdhvā suṣvupuḥ sukhanidrayā ।
ṣaṣṭhyā prātarvinidrāścābhavan maṃgalavādyakaiḥ ।। 87।।
kṛtasnānārhaṇāḥ sarve dugdhapānaṃ vyayadhustataḥ ।
bhojanāni pracakruśca miṣṭānnapāyasāni ca ।।88।।
jalapānāni jagṛhustāmbūlakāni vai tathā ।
madhyāhne ca pralebhuste viśrāntiṃ ca tataḥ param ।।89।।
sammilitvā narā nāryaḥ sambandhinaḥ suhṛjjanāḥ ।
gopya īśānyaśca satyaḥ sādhvyo devyastathā''rṣikāḥ ।।2.296.90।।
mānavyaśca surāṇyaśca gaṇyaśca phaṇikāstathā ।
bhūtyaścāpi tathā'nyāśca gaṇāśca pārṣadāstathā ।।91 ।।
gopāśca kuśalaṃ kṣemaṃ nyūnasevākṣamāpanam ।
parasparaṃ samabhyarthya śiveśvaraśca pārvatī ।।92।।
kṣamāṃ tu mahīmānānāṃ yācitvā'tha vidāyakam ।
dadatuśca yathāyogyaṃ tathocatustadā khalu ।। 93।।
bhavatāṃ cāgamaiḥ sarvavidhiḥ suśobhano'bhavat ।
sarveṣāmupakāryo'smi kṣantavyo me'parādhakaḥ ।।94।।
girijā'pi satībhyaśca kṣamāmayācatā'pi vai ।
punaścāgantavyamatrā'pi kṛpā kāryā sadā mayi ।। 95।।
ityuvāca tato vidāyakaṃ dhanādikaṃ dadau ।
puruṣān vai śivasvāmī pūjayāmāsa hārakaiḥ ।।96।।
nārīvargān himaputrī tathā'śokakumārikā ।
pūjayāmāsatuścāpi vidāyaṃ dadatustathā ।।97।।
bhūṣāmbarāṇi pātrāṇi sādhanānyuttamānyapi ।
tataścakre parihāraṃ mahīmānāśca vai tataḥ ।।98।।
sajjā bhūtvā vimānāni cāruruhuḥ samastakāḥ ।
śrutvā gamanavādyānāṃ ghoṣān vyomni drutaṃ tadā ।।99।।
gamayāmāsa sahasā vimānāni samantataḥ ।
yathāmārgaṃ yayuḥ sarve śivarājastataḥ khalu ।। 2.296.10 0।।
ājñāpayāmāsa gaṇān cakruste parihārakam ।
śivapuraṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca pārvatyānagaraṃ tathā ।। 10 1।।
kailāsaṃ sahasā tiro'bhāvayannativegataḥ ।
śiveśvaraḥ śivachatraḥ pāritoṣikamuttamam ।। 1 02।।
karmacāribhya evāpi dadatuśca yathocitam ।
viśrāntiṃ cāvāyatuśca smarantau kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 1 03।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca bhejire sadā ।
rādhike lokarītyaiva lokeśāścācarantyapi ।। 1 04।।
pātheyāni cottamāni prārpitāni dināntare ।
prāghūṇikebhya evaite praśaṃsanto yayurgṛhān ।। 1 05।।
vidāyaṃ bahumānaṃ ca gṛhītvā yaśa uttamam ।
śivaśaktipreritāśca yayurnaijālayāniti ।। 1 06।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne prodvāhatīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ, mahīmānānāṃ vidāyaṃ, mithaḥ kṣamāyācanā, viyoge śokaḥ, vimānānāṃ pragamanaṃ, kuṃkumavāpikṣetrāgamo dānaṃ maṃgalaṃ gṛhapraveśo bhojanāni nāgarīṇāmānandavihārānidrādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 296 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 296 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 297
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 298 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike ṣaṣṭikāprātarjajāgaruḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ ।
vāditraninadaiḥ sarvāḥ sakṛṣṇā mahīmānakāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kṛṣṇagṛhe kṛtasnānasandhyāvandanapūjanāḥ ।
sopavītyaḥ sarvakāntāḥ svādhyāyaṃ cakrurutsukāḥ ।। 2 ।।
pauruṣaṃ sūktakaṃ nārāyaṇasūktaṃ tathā'param ।
viṣṇusūktaṃ ca śrīsūktaṃ lakṣmīsūktaṃ tathā ca vai ।। 3 ।।
devīsūktaṃ bṛhatsāma vācayāmāsureva ca ।
vahnau ca havanaṃ cakruḥ pañcayajñāṃśca saṃvyadhuḥ ।। 4 ।।
vṛddhapūjāṃ tathā cakruḥ patipūjāṃ tathā vyadhuḥ ।
śatarudrīyakaṃ lakṣmīrnityavacca papāṭha ha ।। 5 ।।
mālājapaṃ tathā cakruḥ 'oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇa' ।
'śrīkṛṣṇaśrīpatisvāmin svāmin gopālanandana' ।। 6 ।।
ityevaṃ rādhike nityaṃ kurvanti sma vidhānataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmiprapūjanam ।। 7 ।।
kurvantyamūlyopacārai patipādajalaṃ papuḥ ।
ātmanivedanamantraṃ dadau tābhyaḥ patiḥ svayam ।
'oṃ śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu mama sarvadā' ।। 8 ।।
ityevaṃ śaraṇaṃ mantraṃ dadau hariḥ pṛthak tataḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।। 9 ।।
enaṃ samarpaṇamantraṃ dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
'kālamāyāpāpakarmaśanuyāmyakuhṛdbhayāt ।। 2.297.1 0।।
śūlamīnadhvajadhanuścakrasvastikavānava' ।
enaṃ rakṣaṇamantraṃ ca dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 11 ।।
'brāhmyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktā'smi śāśvatī ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī patiśca me' ।। 12।।
enaṃ vai brāhmamantraṃ ca dadau tābhyaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
'bālakṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma mama vai śāśvataḥ patiḥ ।। 1 3।।
pitā bandhuḥ suhṛnmitraṃ rakṣakaḥ pālako'stu saḥ' ।
ātmanivedanamantramenaṃ dadau svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 14।।
'anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
kaṃbharāśrīnandanaḥ śrīgopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ।। 15।।
parabrahmā'kṣarātīto'vatārāṇāṃ svarūpadhṛk ।
antaryāmī sadā'smāsu bhagavān sarvakāraṇam ।। 16।।
sarvāntarātmā sarveśo nirlepo mokṣadaḥ sa hi ।
pāvanaḥ sevito bhuktimuktidaśca sadā'vatu' ।। 17।।
ityenaṃ jñānamantraṃ ca svayaṃ tābhyo dadau prabhuḥ ।
'kṛṣṇapriyāprabhaktā'haṃ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।। 18।।
'śrīkṛṣṇaśrīhariḥ śrīsvāmī sākṣāt śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
'śrīkṛṣṇadevo me svāmī śrīhariṃ śaraṇa mama' ।।1 9।।
etān śaraṇamantrāṃśca tādātmyabodhakān dadau ।
'brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca rādhālakṣmyādiyoṣitaḥ ।।2.297.20।।
parabrahmasvarūpāśca parabrahmārdhamūrtayaḥ ।
parabrahmārthasarvasvā divyā bhuktipramuktidāḥ ।।21 ।।
tatsambandhikriyāścāpi nirguṇā mokṣadāḥ sadā' ।
iti jñānamayaṃ mantraṃ tābhyaḥ svayaṃ dadau prabhuḥ ।।22।।
'yo yo yā yā bālakṛṣṇaṃ tatpriyāśca bhajanti vai ।
sa sa sā sā tatsvarūpā divyā mokṣapradāḥ sadā' ।।23।।
itijñānaṃ dadau cāpi nirguṇatvādidāyakam ।
ityevaṃ jñānamantrāḍhyāḥ sarvā vidyādharāḥ striyaḥ ।।24।।
siṣevire sadā rādhe svāmiśrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram ।
atha śrīkambharādevī prātaḥ kṛtāhnikā satī ।।25।।
sutā vilokayituṃ cāgatastrīṇāṃ sumānanam ।
vyadhād bhojanapānādyaistāmbūlādanasatkaraiḥ ।।26।।
praśaśaṃsustathā nāryo lakṣmīṃ sarvāstathā'parāḥ ।
kāntā vīkṣya surūpāśca daduścāśiṣa tā muhuḥ ।।27।।।
sukhinyaḥ śāśvatikāśca bhavantu kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।
putraputryādimatyaśca sadā saubhāgyasaṃyutāḥ ।।।28।।
datvaivamāśiṣo nāryo prāpya pūjāṃ yayurgṛhān ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca mahīmānān samastakān ।।29।।
kṛtasnānaprapūjāँśca bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ।
miṣṭānnāni vibhinnāni śākāni vividhānyapi ।।2.297.3 0।।
amṛtā''svādayuktāni pakvānnānyodanāni ca ।
sūpaḥ kvathikā ramyāśca dadhidugdhāni yāni ca ।।3 1 ।।
kesaraśarkarāyuktānyamblatiktā vaṭīstathā ।
jalapānāni miṣṭāni sugandhīni śubhāni ca ।।32।।
tāmbūlakāni divyāni dadau sarvebhya eva saḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpikāvāsiprajāḥ saurāṣṭravāsikāḥ ।।33।।
bhojayāmāsa ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai kṛṣṇotsavanimittataḥ ।
koṭiśo mānavā bubhujire śrīkambharā''laye ।।34।।
sarvāḥ putryastatra cakruḥ pariveṣaṇamutsukāḥ ।
āmadhyāhnaṃ protsavaḥ saḥ kṛto bhojanasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।।35।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre madhyāhnottaramuttamaḥ ।
nirjagmustāstato vanānyādraṣṭuṃ patisaṃyutāḥ ।।36।।।
mahīmānāstadā sarve viśaśramuḥ sukhālaye ।
kāntānāṃ ca harervimānakaṃ cottaradigbhavam ।।37।।
pradeśaṃ cābhilakṣyaiva prasasāra vihāyasā ।
tāśca śālavanaṃ bilvavanaṃ vīkṣyottare tataḥ ।।38।।
pālāśāraṇyamāvīkṣya vīkṣyā'pi cāndanaṃ vanam ।
devadāruvanaṃ vīkṣya tulasīvanamuttamam ।।39।।
campakānāṃ vanaṃ pūrvadiśi vṛndāvanaṃ tathā ।
candanānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya kaṇikānāṃ vanaṃ tathā ।।2.297.40।।
āmrāṇāṃ ca vanaṃ vīkṣya kundānāṃ sthalapadminām ।
aśokānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya ketakānāṃ vanaṃ tathā ।।41।।
kamalānāṃ pārijātādīnāṃ kadambaśākhinām ।
dakṣiṇe tvāśramān vīkṣya lomaśādiṛṣikṛtān ।।42।।
jambīranārikelādisamudyānaṃ vyalokayan ।
paścime cāmṛtānāṃ ca kadlīnāṃ vanāni ca ।।43 ।।
vīkṣya bhūmiṃ ramaṇīyāṃ badrīvanasuśobhitām ।
bakulānāṃ vanaṃ vīkṣya jambūvanaṃ pravīkṣya ca ।।44।।
gundravanaṃ tathā sītāphalavanaṃ vilokya ca ।
samāyayuścāśvapaṭṭasaro hṛṣṭā niśāmukhe ।।45।।
avatīrya vimānāttāḥ sandhyāvandanamācaran ।
tato yayurnijāvāsān bālakṛṣṇena saṃyutāḥ ।।46।।
bhojanaṃ cakrire sarvāstataḥ śṛṃgāramācaran ।
bālakṛṣṇo mahīmānānāṃ sevanārthaṃ yayau tadā ।।47।।
pitrā bhrātrādibhiḥ sākaṃ mahāmaṇḍapamandire ।
sarvān saṃbhojayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram ।।48।।
tāmbūlakādi pradadau dadau tatrā'pyapekṣitam ।
sarvaṃ cāste prapūrṇaṃ vai kiṃ nyūnaṃ mādhavīgṛhe ।।49।।
mahīmānāḥ prasannāścā'bhavan varavivekataḥ ।
viśrāntiṃ paramāṃ rātrau lebhire narayoṣitaḥ ।।2.297.50 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo mandiramāyayau ।
pratīkṣante navoḍhāstāḥ kāntaṃ sukhayituṃ tadā ।।51 ।।
sarvāsāṃ navapatnīnāṃ pūrayituṃ manorathān ।
koṭyarbudābjarūpāṇi dadhāra śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।52।।
pratyekasyāstu bhavane bhavane sa ratipradaḥ ।
pravartate niśāyāṃ sa mahāyogeśvareśvaraḥ ।।53 ।।
śṛṇu rādhe tadā tvekā kanyā divyā samāgatā ।
draṣṭuṃ praśaṃsitaṃ haṃsarūpadevairhi maṇḍapam ।।54।।
svalpaṃ cāpi mahāntaṃ ca vīkṣituṃ samupāgatā ।
sā tu pūrvaṃ mahāntaṃ vai maṇḍapaṃ koṭirūpiṇī ।।55 ।।
bhūtvā vyalokayat sarvaṃ mahāścaryaṃ gatā tadā ।
punaścālpaṃ maṇḍapaṃ ca vyalokayat sthiradṛśā ।।56 ।।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ pravīkṣyaiva mahāścaryaṃ punargatā ।
maṇḍapāya nama uktvā kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ sthitā'bhavat ।।।57।।
śrīrādhikovāca-
kā sā kanyā kathaṃ tatrāgatya punargatā kva sā ।
vada me bhagavan sarvaṃ śrāvyaṃ ced vidyate param ।।58।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike maṇḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā haṃsarūpā hi devatāḥ ।
svargaṃ gatvā praśaśaṃsurmaṇḍapaṃ bahuśobhanam ।।59।।
tacchrutvā dyauḥ svayaṃ draṣṭuṃ tadā mano'karod drutam ।
dyauḥ svayaṃ kanyakā bhūtvā''gatā kuṃkumavāpikām ।।2.297.6 0।।
sakuṇḍalā samukuṭā saśṛṃkhalā sabhūṣaṇā ।
sarvatejobhṛtā pūrṇā'mṛtapīyūṣasaṃbhṛtā ।।6 1 ।।
rūpānurūpāvayavā mohinīvā'parā yathā ।
rādhā vā kamalā vā cāpareva tatra cāgatā ।।62।।
adṛṣṭaṃ cā'śrutaṃ vāpi tayā pūrve kvacittu yat ।
tatsarvaṃ maṇḍape vīkṣya mahāścaryaṃ gatā satī ।।63।।
svalpe tu maṇḍape devī yūpapārśve sthitā'bhavat ।
namaskārayutādevyā maṇḍapaḥ svāgataṃ vyadhāt ।।64।।
samāgaccha svargadevi svāgataṃ karavāṇi te ।
pādyamarghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa bhojanaṃ jalam ।।65।।
ityuktvā pradadau tasyai siṃhāsanaṃ jalādikam ।
madhuparkaṃ dadau cāpi bhojanaṃ pradadau śubham ।।66।।
labdhvā sā maṇḍapaṃ prāha muktarāṭ maṇḍapa! śṛṇu ।
yasyā'yaṃ maṇḍapaścedṛg bālakṛṣṇasya vidyate ।।67।।
tatprāsādaḥ kīdṛśaḥ syāt kīdṛśyaśca samṛddhayaḥ ।
tadbhoktryaścāpi tatkāntāḥ kīdṛśyaḥ syuḥ sudivyakāḥ ।।68।।
kīdṛśaḥ syācca vai tāsāṃ kāntaścā'syā'pi vaibhavāḥ ।
kīdṛśāścāpi vai syuśca draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham ।।69।।
koṭyarbudābjakāntānāmeka eva patiḥ sa tu ।
śruto mayā'dya devānāṃ bṛhaspatermukhāditaḥ ।।2.297.70।।
kathaṃ sa sarvāsevyaḥ syād draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham ।
mayi devā nivasanti tebhyaścāyaṃ tu kiṃbalaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
kimaiśvaryaśca kiṃvīryaśca kiṃyogabalo'sti vā ।
kiṃrūpo vā vartate'dyaikalaḥ sarvapatirhi vai ।।72।।
indro'pi matpatirnedṛksamartho'stīti vai śrutam ।
sā'haṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātorvaśyā sampreritā satī ।।73।।
uktā ca devaguruṇā'sahamānā samāgatā ।
devaiścā'hamadhikṣiptā na tvaṃ maṇḍapasadṛśī ।।74।।
na tvaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasyaiśvaryakoṭyaṃśagā'pi vā ।
tadahaṃ tvāgatā cā'dya saṃdṛṣṭvā maṇḍapaṃ tviha ।।75।।
adṛṣṭaṃ cāśrutaṃ vāpi maṇiṃ ca dehalīsthitam ।
vigarvā'smi hi sañjātā draṣṭumicchāmi tacchriyaḥ ।।76।।
tatsmṛddhīstaṃ divyakāntaṃ tāśca koṭyabjayoṣitaḥ ।
viśeṣato navāṃ lakṣmīṃ draṣṭumicchāmi dyauraham ।।77।।
ityukto maṇḍapastūrṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva mandiram ।
gatvā lakṣmīgṛhadvāri vetradhāramajijñapat ।।78।।
vetradharo ratnayukto gatvā''jñāṃ samavāpya ca ।
dyāṃ tāṃ praveśayāmāsa kanyāṃ lakṣmīsumandiram ।।79।।
koṭyarbudābjarūpā dyaurbhūtvā vai samakālinī ।
praviveśa tu sarvāsāṃ gṛhāṇi vīkṣituṃ tadā ।।2.297.80।।
sā dadarśa divyarūpaṃ pratyekayā saha sthitam ।
vibhinnaceṣṭakaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ।।8 1 ।।
lakṣmyā gṛhe tu dolāyāṃ dolāyamānamacyutam ।
lakṣmyā sākaṃ dadarśainaṃ pupūja dyaurnanāma ha ।।82।।
māṇikyāstu gṛhe kṛṣṇaṃ bhuñjānaṃ sā dadarśa ha ।
padmāvatyā gṛhe kāntaṃ paryaṃkasthaṃ dadarśa sā ।।83।
ramāyāstu gṛhe dugdhaṃ pibantaṃ sā dadarśa ha ।
rādhāyāstu gṛhe śayyāsthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa sā ।।84।
śrīgṛhe tu śriyā sākaṃ ramantaṃ dyūtameva sā ।
dadarśa kuśalāsaudhe bhakṣayantaṃ hi tāmbulam ।।85।।
sarasvatīgṛhe taṃ ca gāyantaṃ vīṇayā sthitam ।
gaṃgāgṛhe gaṃgayā vai pādasaṃvāhitaṃ ca sā ।।।86।।
dadarśa virajāgehe viharantamitastataḥ ।
durgāgṛhe hasantaṃ ca narmavākyairdadarśa sā ।।89।.
śāradāmandire mālā japantaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha ।
kāśīrājasya putrīṇāṃ geheṣu kṛṣṇarūpiṇam ।।88।।
śṛṃgārayantaṃ vanitāḥ dadarśā''nandakāriṇam ।
ājanābhīgṛheṣvenaṃ dadarśa dyauḥ pṛthagvidham ।।89।।।
aitihāsikavārtāsthaṃ kalākauśalyavartinam ।
aśanāditriṃśadūrdhvaśatapatnīgṛhe tu tam ।।2.297.90।।
śayyāsuyogabhāvena ramantaṃ sā dadarśa ha ।
maṃgalādiyoṣitāṃ tu geheṣu keśasādhanam ।। 9 1।
prakurvantaṃ bālakṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa dyaustadā prabhum ।
auṣṇālayīyanārīṇāṃ gehe tābhiḥ pramarditam ।।92।
snapitaṃ tailasārādyairbhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ prabhum ।
dadarśā'tha ca prācīnīyakāntānāṃ tu mandire ।।93।।
alaktakādibhistābhiḥ rajyamānaṃ ca citritam ।
ramantaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca dadarśa dyauḥ subhāgyagā ।।94।।
rāśiyānīyakāntānāṃ gṛheṣu svāminaṃ harim ।
tattaddeśīyavṛttānte magnaṃ dadarśa śobhanam ।।95।
kiṃpuruṣīyapatnīnāṃ gṛheṣu kambharātmajam ।
saṃgītamagnaṃ sarvābhiḥ saha dadarśa sā tadā ।।96।
ketumālīyakāntānāṃ mandireṣu śukā'nujam ।
rājabhūṣā dhārayantaṃ dadarśa rājarītigam ।।97।
amarīṇāṃ gṛheṣvenaṃ nṛtyantaṃ tābhiranvitam ।
lalanābhiḥ saha dyauśca dadarśā''nandasaṃbhṛtam ।।98।।
hārītīnāṃ nivāseṣu sambandhijanasevitam ।
āsīnaṃ cāsane strībhirveṣṭitaṃ taṃ dadarśa ṣā ।।9 9 ।।
brāhmīlīnāṃ nivāseṣu devapūjāparāyaṇam ।
rātrau dadarśa taṃ dyauśca divyarūpadharaṃ prabhum ।। 2.297.1 00।।
ābriktīnāṃ mandireṣu gāyanaṃ vādyatālakaiḥ ।
rajobhāvabharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svamagnaṃ sandadarśa sā ।। 101 ।।
paitṛkīnāṃ gṛhe kṛṣṇaṃ śrāddhayuktaṃ dadarśa sā ।
devīnāṃ ratibhāvādyairyuktaṃ dadarśa mādhavam ।। 10 2।।
kutracinnāṭyakhelaṃ ca lokayantaṃ striyā saha ।
kutracit premabhāvena spṛśantaṃ taṃ dadarśa sā ।। 103 ।।
kutracidyogivaddhyāne magnaṃ dadarśa sā tadā ।
kutracit taṃ suptameva nidrāyāṃ sā dadarśa ha ।। 1 04।।
kutracidvai śikṣayantaṃ yoṣito brahmavedanam ।
kutracitpūrayantaṃ ca manāṃsi yoṣitāṃ tadā ।। 1 05।।
dadarśa kutracinmālāṃ grathnantaṃ puṣpajātibhiḥ ।
dyaurdadarśa taṃ gṛhāṅgaṇe sthitaṃ vai tadaikalam ।। 1 06।।
kutracittu samāyāntaṃ pārśvagṛhād gṛhāntaram ।
kutracid gṛhamadhye tu tapantaṃ vahninā ca tam ।। 1 07।।
dadarśa bahirevainaṃ dvāri vā kutracitprabhum ।
kutracid bhāryayā sākaṃ yāntaṃ dadarśa bhūṣitam ।। 1 08।।
kutracid darpaṇe naijāṃ patnīṃ mukhaṃ sacandrakam ।
darśayantaṃ ca kurvantaṃ candrakaṃ sā dadarśa ha ।। 1 09।।
kutracitpramadānetre'ñjayantaṃ kajjalaṃ ca tam ।
kutracit svapriyābhāle kurvantaṃ patrikāṃ tadā ।। 2.297.11 0।।
kutracit pādayoścāpi lepayantamalaktakam ।
kutraciccātitādātmyāt samāśliṣyantamityapi ।। 11 1।।
kutracittaṃ bhojayantaṃ kavalena nijāśritām ।
kutracittāmcūlarasa cārpayantaṃ mukhena ha ।। 11 2।।
dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dyaurvyajanānvitam ।
kvaciddadarśa taṃ rājādhirājaṃ tvāsanesthitam ।। 11 3।।
kvacicca marditaṃ saṃvāhitaṃ bahvībhireva tam ।
kvacinnetramiṣeṇāpi tvāhvayantaṃ nijāṃ priyām ।। 1 14।।
kvacillikhantaṃ patraṃ ca jñācinnigūḍhaceṣṭakam ।
evaṃ bhinnakriyaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibhum ।। 115
dadarśa dyauḥ sarvamandireṣu sarvāyutaṃ prabhum ।
pupūja parayā prītyā dampatī sā gṛhe gṛhe ।। 116
lakṣmyādyāścāpi tāṃ jñātvā dyāṃ mahīmānikāṃ nijām ।
svāgataṃ paramaṃ cakrurbhojayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।। 1 17।।
daduśca puṣpahārādīn pāritoṣikamuttamam ।
kāntalīlāsmaraṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ pradaduḥ striyaḥ ।। 1 18।।
smṛddhiṃ vilokayāmāsa dyaustu sarvotamottamām ।
yā na svarge na vai satye neśvareṣvapi santi ca ।। 1 19।।
tāstāḥ smṛddhīścāmbarāṇi vibhūṣāścāsanāni ca ।
paryaṃkān śayanārhāṃśca pātrāṇi maṇihīrakān ।। 2.297.1 20।।
kośān catuṣkikān yantrottamāni svarṇapeṭikāḥ ।
vimānāni vilokyāpi mahāścaryaṃ gatā'bhavat ।। 121 ।।
indragṛhe brahmasaudhe sūryagṛhe śaśigṛhe ।
dhruvālaye kuberasyā''laye smṛddhirna yā'sti tām ।। 122।।
vilokyaikagṛhe dyauḥ svagarvahīnā babhūva ha ।
āśiṣaṃ ca kṣamāṃ prāpyā''gatya vai maṇḍapaṃ tataḥ ।। 123।।
yayau svargaṃ bhāsayantī diśo daśa vihāyasā ।
ityevaṃ rādhike! śrīmad bālakṛṣṇasya ceṣṭitam ।। 124।।
koṭyaiśvaryasamāyuktaṃ koṭyarbudābjapatnikam ।
tāvatībhiḥ sahaśaśvat śṛṃgārabhāvasaṃbhṛtam ।। 125।।
divyameva hi mantavyaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham ।
nityamevaṃ sukhado vai bhagavān bhaktisevinām ।। 1 26।।
navoḍhānāṃ rātrisakhaḥ prasuṣvāpa sukhottaram ।
sarvakāmaprapūraḥ sa bhagavān bhāgyagocaraḥ ।। 1 27।।
atha dyauḥ rādhike! svargagatā'pi mohitā harau ।
patnīṃ bhavituṃ satataṃ ceyeṣāharniśaṃ tataḥ ।। 1 28।।
kadācit kāmabhogecchāvatyāyāt śrīhariṃ rahaḥ ।
tṛptāṃ cakre harirbhukttvā sā yayau muditā divam ।। 129।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prātaḥ kṛtāhnikāḥ kāntā mantrān jagṛhuḥ, mahīmānānāṃ bhojanam, yuvatīnāṃ vimānena vanāvalokanārthaṃ vyomaviharaṇam, rātribhojanam, līlāṃ draṣṭuḥ dyauḥ kanyā samāyātā, koṭyarbudābjayoṣitāṃ saudheṣu bhinnalīlaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya mugdhā dyauḥ svargaṃ gatā, harernidrā
cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 297 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 297 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 298
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 299 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
rādhike yugapad rātrau svāṃganānāṃ sukhapradaḥ ।
jajāgāra harirvādyairmaṃgalaiḥ stavanaiḥ prage ।।' 1 ।।
jajāgarurvidheyārthā brāhme muhūrtake tadā ।
hariḥ prāha ca sarvābhyo dhyāne tiṣṭhata me kṣaṇam ।। 2 ।।
mama yogena divyāḥ stho bhavatyaścā'dya yoṣitaḥ ।
muktā māyāvihīnāścā''varaṇādivivarjitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
ityuktā rādhike! sarvāḥ kṛṣṇamādhavayoṣitaḥ ।
pativratāḥ svakāntājñāṃ labdhvā dhyāne sthitāḥ kṣaṇam ।। 4 ।।
tāvadbhagavati sarvā nāḍīprāṇavaśāstadā ।
saṃhṛtya nāḍikāprāṇān samādhau hṛdaye yayuḥ ।। 5 ।।
vismṛtā dehabhānaṃ tā hṛdaye kāntasannidhau ।
dadṛśuḥ kāntamūrtisthaṃ brahmatejotibhāsuram ।। 6 ।।
tejasāṃ rāśayastatra mahārṇavā ivā'bhavan ।
tatra vyalokayan svargaṃ sarvadevālayāँstataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tato'gre svavimānena svāminā saha tatparam ।
yayuḥ pitṛpradeśāँścā''lokayan puṇyabhāsurān ।। 8 ।।
yayustato'pi cāgre vai kṛṣṇakāntena saṃyutāḥ ।
satyalokaṃ yayuḥ sarvāstannivāsaiśca satkṛtāḥ ।। 9 ।।
divyabhāvaṃ samāpannāḥ pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ dṛḍham ।
vibhidya prayayuḥ sarvāḥ salilāvaraṇaṃ tataḥ ।। 2.298.10 ।।
agre tā dṛṣṭavatyaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tejaso'ntikam ।
āvaraṇasya sandhau vai tatra śrīrāmasevikāḥ ।। 11 ।।
sītāramādyāstāsāṃ vai svāgataṃ saṃvyadhurmudā ।
rāmādityaścakārā'pi svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ ।। 12।।
tataścā'gre yayustatra marutpaṭaṃ vihāya ca ।
vyomapaṭaṃ tathā'haṃbhittikāṃ vihāya cordhvake ।। 13 ।।
mahattattvātmakaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ vihāya copari ।
yayuḥ kāntena sahitāḥ śubhaṃ vairājamandiram ।। 14।।
tatra tenā'rcitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
pūjitāśca hareḥ sarvā vairājyā rājayoṣitā ।। 15।।
tataścāgre yayuḥ sarvā hiraṇyagarbhamaṇḍalam ।
mahāviṣṇormahārājyaṃ yatra gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 1 6।।
nijeśvaraḥ śrīdevyā ca mahālakṣmyākhyayoṣitā ।
tathā śrīkambharādevyā saha tatra virājate ।। 1 7।।
tābhiśca pūjito devaḥ kāntapitā tataśca vai ।
kāntamātā pūjitā ca tābhyāṃ śriyaśca satkṛtāḥ ।। 18।।
bhojitā āśliṣya cāśīrvādaiḥ samyak prayojitāḥ ।
patiśca pūjitaścājñāmādāya cordhvake stare ।। 1 9।।
patiyuktā vimānasthā yayurbhūmno mahāsthalam ।
bhūmnyā devyā satkṛtāstā bhūmnā ca satkṛto hariḥ ।। 2.298.20।।
tadvibhūtīrvilokyā'gre vāsudevā''layaṃ yayuḥ ।
vāsudevī cakārā''sāṃ satkāraṃ bahubhāvitā ।।21 ।।
susatkāraṃ hareścakre vāsudevanarāyaṇaḥ ।
amṛtānāṃ prapānaṃ ca pīyūṣabhojanādikam ।।22।।
vāsudevyaḥ kārayāmāsuḥ prapūjāṃ vyadhustathā ।
athā'vatāradhāmāni pradarśya bhagavāँstataḥ ।। 23।।
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ nijaṃ jagāma vai hariḥ ।
brahmahrade snapayitvā niṣkāsyā'kṣaratejasi ।।24।।
nijamūrtau tato līnīkṛtya sarvāśca vai tadā ।
muktā divyāśca sārūpyānvitā vidhāya vai tadā ।।25।।
svena rūpeṇa niṣpannāḥ sarvāvaraṇavarjitāḥ ।
puruṣottamabhāvāśca parabrahmātmikāśca tāḥ ।।26।।
rūpadharmasvabhāvaiśca guṇaiḥ sarvātmanā hariḥ ।
svavad vyadhāt tadā cātra rādhe kiṃ vai vadāmi te ।। 27।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre śarīrāṇi svayoṣitām ।
dhāmayogyāni jātāni māyikatvaṃ layaṃ gatam ।। 28।।
caitanyaikarasānandātmakāni santi sarvadā ।
sārvajñyātmajñānapiṇḍavikāsāḍhyāni tāni hi ।।29।।
sampannānyabhiniṣpannānyeva dhāmagatāni vat ।
prajātāni tato brahmahrade snānāttato'pi ca ।।2.298.3 0।।
brāhmītanusvarūpāṇi muktātmakāni santi ca ।
akṣarabrahmarūpāṇi tejomayāni tāni vai ।।3 1 ।।
prajātānyatha mūrtisthitilābhato'dhikāni vai ।
bhagavadrūpaṃ prāptāni bhāgavatāni santi vai ।। 32।।
prajātānīti caitanyabrāhmabhāgavatāni hi ।
jñānatejaḥsusārūpyābhidhānāni bhavanti hi ।।33।।
tatrā'saṃkhyābhiretābhirmuktānībhiḥ prasevitaḥ ।
muktaiśca sevitaḥ śrīmān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।34।।
darśayāmāsa tābhyo vai sāmrājyaṃ tvakṣarātmakam ।
sārvabhaumaṃ mahārājyaṃ sṛṣṭitrayordhvasaṃsthitam ।।35।।
nijaiśvaryāṇi sarvāṇi vibhūtīḥ sakalā api ।
nityānandāni bhogyāni darśayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।।36।।
smṛddhīdivyāṃ maṇḍalāni muktānīnāṃ samantataḥ ।
muktānāṃ maṇḍalakoṭīrdarśayāmāsa kāntakaḥ ।।37।।
udyānāni vicitrāṇi mandirāṇi śubhāni ca ।
sarvāsāṃ nijavāsāँśca darśayāmāsa kṛṣṇakaḥ ।।38।।
sampadaḥ sarvadivyāśca sarvasaubhāgyakāni ca ।
sarveṣṭakalpamaṇikān darśayāmāsa kaustubhān ।।39।।
nijamūrteḥ kiraṇāni puṣṭidāni samantataḥ ।
tṛptidāni sukhāvāptipradānyānandadāni ca ।।2.298.40।।
ratiprītiharṣadāni kāmakalpapradāni ca ।
nityānandabhṛtānyeva darśayāmāsa vai patiḥ ।।41।।
sarvavidhāstathā śālāḥ sevāyogyā navā navāḥ ।
yatheṣṭā'vyāhatāścāpi vihārāṇāṃ sthalīḥ śubhāḥ ।।42।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavyāptā hyadarśayat ।
veṣabhūṣāmbaraśṛṃgārādīn divyānadarśayat ।।43।।
rahasyabhāvavāsāँśca śayyā ramyā adarśayat ।
tatratyaṃ sarvamevā''bhyo darśayitvā tataḥparam ।।44।।
parabrahmānandamayaṃ bhojanaṃ pānamuttamam ।
tāmbūlakaṃ dadau tābhyo vihāraṃ pradadau sukham ।।45।।
aikāntikaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi rahasyajaṃ dadau prabhuḥ ।
tato dhāmno mahāmuktakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ śubhocitām ।।46।।
jagrāha bhagavāँstāsāṃ sannidhau muktayoṣitām ।
muktānībhiśca muktaiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ ca tā api ।।47।।
jagṛhurdivyarūpāśca svāgataṃ mānanaṃ bahu ।
evaṃ nijaṃ gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ pradarśya bhagavān hariḥ ।।48।।
akṣarāt prayayau śrīmadgolokaṃ dhāma vai tataḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ tatra svāgataṃ paramātmanaḥ ।।49।।
rādhādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ tatra sammānaṃ hariyoṣitām ।
kāmadhenupayaḥpānaṃ dadū rādhādayastadā ।।2.298.50।।
pāyasānnāni bhojyāni śṛṃgārāṇi dadustathā ।
tataḥ śīghraṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yayau tābhiḥ saha prabhuḥ ।।51 ।।
tatra kṛtaṃ svāgataṃ ca lakṣmyā kamalayā tathā ।
bhārgavyā ca śriyā vikuṇṭhayā cānyābhirityapi ।।52।।
nārāyaṇena ca kṛtaṃ sanmānaṃ śrīharestadā ।
pūjanaṃ stavanaṃ cāpi prāpya pradarśya bhūtikāḥ ।।53।।
sādāśaivaṃ hri kailāsaṃ divyaṃ yayau svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
tatratyāśca samagrāśca vibhūtīrbhagavān priyāḥ ।।54।।
darśayāmāsa śaivīśca durgādyāścāpyapūjayan ।
gaṇāḥ sarve'pi vai tatra cakrurhareḥ prapūjanam ।।55।।
tato yayau sa tābhirvai sahitaḥ śrīhariḥ khalu ।
kautukārthaṃ mahāmāyādhāma māyāmayaṃ śubham ।।56।।
vyalokayan hareḥ kāntātulyāḥ kāntāśca koṭiśaḥ ।
sarvā brahmapriyāstatra sammānaṃ bahu lebhire ।।57।।
māyābhiśca vicitrābhiḥ kanyābhiścābhipūjitāḥ ।
sevitā bahudhā tatra māyikairvastusattamaiḥ ।।58।।
bhojyapānasubhogaiścāmbarabhūṣāprasādhanaiḥ ।
sarvottejakacūrṇaiśca śṛṃgārarasavardhakaiḥ ।। 99 ।।
sarvaveṣopakaraṇaiḥ sarvasaubhāgyavastubhiḥ ।
sarvānandapradairbhāvaiḥ sevitāḥ pūjitāḥ striyaḥ । । 2.298.60 ।।
mahāmāyā svayaṃ tatra pādasaṃvāhanaṃ hareḥ ।
cakāreti mahāścaryaṃ prāpuḥ sarvā haristriyaḥ । । 61 ।।
rājarājeśvarī sarveśvarī rājñīśvarī hi sā ।
svapatiṃ sevamānā vai sarvābhiravalokitā ।। 62 ।।
pradarśya ca harirmāyādhāma paścād drutaṃ tataḥ ।
viṣṇordhāma yayau tatra vaiṣṇavyo mānanaṃ vyadhuḥ । । 63 । ।
sarvāsāṃ svāgataṃ nīrājanaṃ prapūjanaṃ tathā ।
bhojanaṃ pānamiṣṭaṃ ca dadurvastrāmbarāṇi ca । । 64। ।
tataḥ śrībālakṛṣṇo'sau yayau priyābhirañjanaḥ ।
śatamastakaviṣṇośca sahasrānanaśārṅgiṇaḥ । । 65 ।।
lakṣānanasya viṣṇośca koṭyānanasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
abjanetrasya śaṃbhośca padmānanasya vedhasaḥ । । 66। ।
parārdhānanasaṃśobhadvedhaso'ṇḍāni vai hariḥ ।
darśayāmāsa sarvāṇi sṛṣṭyānantyamayāni hi ।। 67 । ।
taistaiḥ sampūjitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ priyonijaḥ ।
darśayāmāsa teṣāṃ ca vibhūtīḥ svasamarpitāḥ ।। 68 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitā vibhūtikāḥ ।
bhuñjate sarva evaite brahmapriyābhireva tat । । 69 । ।
vilokitaṃ hi sākṣādvai samādhau rādhike tadā ।
tatastā vai samādāya sūryacandrādikān grahān । ।2.298.7 0 ।।
darśayāmāsa lokasthān nirayātmakasaṃsthitān ।
tān vilokya tadā tāsāṃ mano lagnaṃ na tatra vai ।।7 1 ।।
śīghraṃ tā ānayāmāsa kṣetraṃ kuṃkumavāpikām ।
naije divyākṣarākhye vai maṇḍape bhavane śubhe ।। 7 2 ।।
ākṣareṇa same tatra manaḥ sthairyamavāpa ha ।
samādhitaśca tāḥ sarvā jajāgarustadā nijān ।।7 3 ।।
dehān dhāmagatān divyān prāptānamānavān parān ।
dadṛśuścāvaraṇabhāvavarjitānapyabhautikān ।। 74। ।
amāyikān sadā tvekarūpān kṣuttṛḍvivarjitān ।
māyāguṇairvihīnāँśca dhāmaiśvaryasamanvitān । ।75।।
sarvadhāmasvabhāvāँścā'kṣaratulyasukhātmakān ।
brahmānandabharāँścāpi divyaveṣābhiśobhitān ।। 76 ।।
patyanyūnasamaiśvaryān divyatāśevadhisthitīn ।
mahānandabharā jātāḥ samarthā bālakṛṣṇavat ।। 77 ।।
evamāsādya divyatvaṃ patiṃ prāpya ca tāstadā ।
sārvajñyaṃ lebhire patnyo vadhūṭayo'pyavadhūṭikāḥ ।।78 ।।
evaṃ dadau haristābhyo nijasāmyaṃ hi śāśvatam ।
rādhike tvaṃ mayā yadvat kṛtā svasāmyaśobhitā ।।79।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇenaivaṃ kṛtā vai nijayoṣitaḥ ।
pṛthivyāvaraṇaṃ bhittyāvaraṇaṃ ca gṛhāvṛtim ।।2.298.8 0 ।।
yāsāṃ na vidyate vyāghātaśca dvārapidhānake ।
jalamadhye samudrādau nadīpravāhaṇe hime ।।8 1 ।।
vṛṣṭyādyābhiḥ parābhūtiryāsāṃ dehe na vidyate ।
vahnidāho na cāsāṃ vai dāhaḥ sūryātapairna ca ।।82।।।
vāḍavānala evaitā vidyudvā na dahatyapi ।
sūrye candre grahānye ca svatantrā gantumeva tāḥ ।।8 2 ।।
śvāsādhīnā na caitāśca na vāyuḥ śoṣayatyapi ।
prāṇāyāmordhvabhāvāstā vidyante brahmayoṣitaḥ ।।84।।
tandrālasyagurutvāni vidyante naiva sarvathā ।
viṣeṇa vā naiva cāsāṃ parābhavo bhavatyapi ।।।85।।।
śastraghāto nāpi dehe bhedako jāyate kvacit ।
rogāḥ sthātuṃ na ca śaknuvanti tāsu ca māyikāḥ ।।86 ।।
dūraśravaṇasiddhiśca dūrapratyakṣasiddhikā ।
dūragrahaṇasiddhiśca dūrālāpādisiddhayaḥ ।। 87।।
manojavitvamevā''sāṃ sūkṣmabhāvitvamityapi ।
mahadbhāvitvamevā'pi sarvakāmāvasāyitā ।। 88 ।।
sarvasya vaśatā cāpi koṭirūpādidhāritā ।
brahmāṇḍāntaragamanaṃ śītoṣṇānabhibhūtatā ।।8 9 ।।
saṃkalpasṛṣṭikartṛtvaṃ siddhyaiśvaryāṇi yāni ca ।
tānyāsāṃ sampravartante bālakṛṣṇakṛpāvaśāt ।। 2.298.90 ।।
kalpalatāḥ kalpagāvaḥ kalpapātrāṇi yāni ca ।
kalpamaṇayaścāpyāsāṃ vartante kalpanāvaśāḥ ।। 91 ।।
ityevaṃvidhamaiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
tāsāmavartata rādhe! dadṛśurvyutthitāstadā ।। 92।।
śarīrāṇi dhāmamuktamayānītyavalokayan ।
prasannāścābhavan sarvā māyāgarvavivarjitāḥ ।। 93 ।।
tataḥ sarvāḥ samutthāya bālakṛṣṇaṃ nijeśvaram ।
divyarītyā'pyasevanta snānapūjanabhojanaiḥ ।। 94।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca bālakṛṣṇādayastathā ।
kṛtasnānāhnikebhyaśca mahīmānebhya ārpayan ।। 95 ।।
pūjanāni bhojanāni satkārāṇi dhanāni ca ।
tṛptāstāmbūlakānyāpya sarve gantuṃ nijān nijān ।। 96 ।।
deśān lokān mahīmānā arthayāmāsuracyutam ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca tathā śrīkambharāsatīm ।।97।।
hareḥ pitā kṣamāṃ tebhyo yayāce nyūnasevane ।
bhavatāmāgamenā'yaṃ protsavaḥ śobhano'bhavat ।।98।।
punarbhagavatāṃ yogo darśanaṃ vā kadā bhavet ।
avaśyamatrā''gantavyaṃ jñātvā naijaṃ vaśānugam ।। 99।।
ityuktvā praṇanāmā'pi vidāyaṃ pradadau bahu ।
pūjāṃ cakāra bahudhā dravyāṇi pradadau tathā ।। 2.298.10 0।।
svarṇarūpyakahīrakān pūjāyāṃ pradadau pitā ।
karmacāribhya evā'sau pāritoṣikakān dadau ।। 101 ।।
dīnā'nāthā'tithivargebhyaśca dadau yatheṣṭakam ।
dāsabhṛtyakalāvidbhyaḥ pradadau tuṣṭikṛddhanam ।। 1 02।।
rājabhyaścāpi sarvebhyo dadau sumukaṭāni vai ।'
devebhyaśceśvarebhyaśca kirīṭān pradadau prabhuḥ ।। 103 ।।
devībhyaścāpi nārībhyo veṣābhūṣādi sandadau ।
sarvebhyaḥ pradadau sveṣṭaṃ sarveṣṭaṃ pāritoṣikam ।। 1 04।।
avatārāstathā vyūhā bhūmādyāśca virājakāḥ ।
viṣṇavo'jāḥ pitaraśca surāḥ siddhā maharṣayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
mānavāstalavāsāśca tīrthādrisaritādikāḥ ।
sarve tuṣṭā avadaँśca santuṣṭāḥ sma sadā tava ।। 1 06।।
gopālakṛṣṇa! yāsyāmaḥ svastyastu te sutasya vai ।
kanyakānāṃ tathā svasti kuśalaṃ vo'stu sarvadā ।। 1 07।।
ityuktvā sajjabhāvāste sajjopakaraṇādikāḥ ।
vimānāni sajjayitvā'bhavan prasthānatatkṣaṇāḥ ।। 1 08।।
parasparaṃ mahīmānāḥ sambandhinaḥ suhṛjjanāḥ ।
mimilurvakṣasā vakṣo datvā nāryo'pi tattathā ।। 1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne saptamyāṃ prātaḥ sarvāsāṃ samādhau sṛṣṭitrayā'kṣaradhāmādipradarśanaṃ, tāsāṃ śāśvatadivyamuktasvabhāvīkaraṇam,
mahīmānabhojanapūjanadānakṣamāvidāyādi, kṣetradevapāritoṣikādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 298 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 298 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 299
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 300 →

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ rādhike! gantuṃ samaye sarvakanyakāḥ ।
mātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ parirabdhāḥ snehabhṛtāntarāḥ ।। 1 ।।
viyogā'śrūṇi saṃsrāvya maunaṃ vai jaḍavat sthitāḥ ।
divyāśca divyadehāśca pūrvato'bjaguṇoditāḥ ।। 2 ।।
vīkṣya sambandhināṃ cāsu snehaṃ cā'bhyadhivardhitam ।
soḍhuṃ teṣāṃ viyogaṃ cā'śaktā manāk tadā'bhavan ।। 3 ।।
tadā tanmātaraḥ putrīrvīkṣya viyogaduḥkhitāḥ ।
mugdhāstā arthayāmāsurmātaro bālakṛṣṇakam ।। 4 ।।
saha netuṃ nijāḥ putrīḥ svalpasamayameva ha ।
vilokayituṃ rāṣṭraṃ svaṃ kuṭumbinaḥ suhṛjjanān ।। 5 ।।
vīkṣārthā svasṛsahajā udāraṃ śrīhariṃ muhuḥ ।
prabho preṣaya naḥ putrīrnaḥ sukhārthahetave ।। 6 ।।
punaḥ śīghraṃ ca māsānte preṣayiṣyāma tāriha ।
sevāyāṃ tava bho kṛṣṇa kṛpālo'rthitamāvaha ।। 7 ।।
hariḥ prāha tathāstveva tāsāṃ vāpsalyahetave ।
sarvā ājñāpayāmāsa gantuṃ mātrādibhiḥ saha ।। 8 ।।
prasannāstāstadā sarvāḥ śrutvā prabhorudāratām ।
sahasā tāḥ hariṃ gatvā nemuḥ sasvajire prabhum ।। 9 ।।
drutaṃ samāgamiṣyāmaścetyuktvā'pyantasevanam ।
kṣaṇaṃ cakrustṛptidaṃ vai punarāgamanāya tāḥ ।। 2.299.10 ।।
svakāntaṃ tā muhuḥ saṃsevya ca sajjā vibhūṣitāḥ ।
śṛṃgāritā hyabhavaँśca pupūjuḥ parameśvaram ।। 11 ।।
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ viṣṇoḥ svasāraṃ pūjyayoṣitaḥ ।
sarvā vṛddhān kuṭumbasthān natvā''bhāṣya sukhāgatam ।। 12 ।।
sukhāyatiṃ prabhāṣyā'pi yogyocitāmbarānvitāḥ ।
yogyabhūṣā vimānānyāruruhuḥ svāminirdeśitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
āgantavyaṃ cetyuvāca sarvā vai bhagavāँstadā ।
mumocā'śrūṇi viśvātmā māyayā cā'pyamāyikaḥ ।। 14।।
tadā vādyānyavādyanta pūṣpākṣataiśca pūjanam ।
vimānānāmabhavacca kṛtaṃ saubhāgyikādibhiḥ ।। 15।।
ṛtavo dharmadevaśca naro devī ca pīṭhikā ।
mahī ca maṇḍapo mukto māṇikyastaṃbha ityapi ।। 16 ।।
sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ haro gaṇādhināyakaḥ ।
nava te darśanārthaṃ vai mātṝṇāṃ samupāyayuḥ ।। 1 7।।
kṛtavanto daṇḍavacca kṣantavyāḥ kṣetrapālakāḥ ।
ityuktvā sthitavantaśca tadā tebhyo haristathā ।। 18।।
haripriyāḥ samastāśca vāsudevādayo'pi ca ।
āśīrvādān pradaduśca daduśca pāritoṣikam ।। 1 9।।
ratnānyanekarūpāṇi hīrakādisrajastathā ।
mukuṭāni suramyāṇi pātrabhūṣāmbarāṇi ca ।। 2.299.20 ।।
nāmapaṭṭāni sauvarṇākṣarayuktāni vai tathā ।
dhanāni copakaraṇānyuttamāni śubhāni ca ।। 21 ।।
te saṃgṛhya sukhāpannāḥ sañjātāḥ kṣetradārakāḥ ।
vyaṃgulānāṃ tadā śabdā yantraśabdāstathā'bhavan ।।22।।
bherīśabdā jayaśabdāścābhavannambare'bhitaḥ ।
kanyakā harṣitāḥ pitṛvimāneṣu sthitāstadā ।। 23 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥkṣetre kāntaṃ vilokayantyapi ।
lomaśaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭyā ca praṇāmaiścāpyapūjayan ।।24।।
athā'mbare vimānāni gatimantyabhavaँstataḥ ।
koṭyarbudābjakanyāstāḥ sarvāḥ pitrādibhiḥ saha ।। 25।।
kāśīśvarīṃ vinā jagmunaiṃjān deśān samātṛkāḥ ।
ākṣarāṇyaśca muktānyo brāhmyastatra prabhuṃ vinā ।। 26।।
na gantavyamiti kṛtvā'vasan svakāntamandire ।
rādhike! bālakṛṣṇo'pi cāntarātmā saha sthitaḥ ।।27।।
ātmanivedinīstrībhiḥ sahā'dṛśyo yayau sahaḥ ।
sṛṣṭitrayasya kāntāstāḥ svasvalokaṃ gatāstadā ।।28।।
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyākhye śūnyamivā'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
haryājñayā tato mukto maṇḍapo'pi tiro'bhavat ।।29।।
susvalpo maṇḍapaścāpi śīghraṃ tatra tiro'bhavat ।
evaṃ jātaḥ parihāro bālakṛṣṇecchayā drutam ।। 2.299.30 ।।
yāratu sakhyo'vasan svāmisevāyāṃ kāśikāsutāḥ ।
tā asevanta śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mudā'niśam ।।3 1 ।।
divyā divyasvarūpā vai pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā dehena sevanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।32।।
lakṣmīrviśeṣabhāvena sevate parameśvaram ।
satsu dāsīsahasrāsu samānāsu satīṣvapi ।। 33 ।।
snapanaṃ vastradānaṃ cā'bhyaṃgaṃ prakeśasādhanam ।
veṣaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ ca dantadhāvanamityapi ।।34।।
kajjalaṃ mastake tailaṃ cāṃgamardanamityapi ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vāripānadānaṃ ca bhojanam ।।35।।
tāmbūlakaṃ vyajanena vāyudānaṃ ca naktakam ।
phaladānaṃ tathā śayyāstaraṇaṃ kalaśārpaṇam ।।36 ।।
yatkiṃcinnijatanvā syāt tatsarvaṃ svayamācarat ।
nijeśasya samastaṃ sevanaṃ pariparāyaṇā ।।37।।
lakṣmīrevā'sti lakṣmīrvai netarā tatsamā kvacit ।
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāṃ lakṣmyāṃ kṛṣṇasya vai kvacit ।।38।।
kṣatirna dṛśyate sevākṛte tadvai viśiṣyate ।
tathāpi samadṛk kṛṣṇaḥ sarvāsu samatāyutaḥ ।।39।।
vartate sukhadaścātisnehavānnatu pakṣavān ।
audāryaṃ parame kānte tadeva vartate sadā ।।2.299.40।।
sarvāsāṃ kāmapūratvaṃ tṛptidatvaṃ yatheṣṭakam ।
padmāvatyā ramāyāśca lakṣmyadhikaṃ hi sevanam ।
ābhyāṃ vismāritā lakṣmīḥ svāmyarthābhyāṃ sadā tvanu ।।41।।
atha rādhe vasante cotsavaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra ha ।
puṣpadolotsavaṃ cāpi pracakāra sukhāvaham ।
cāturmāsyotsavaṃ cāpi pracakāra vratātmakam ।।42।।
ūrjamāsaḥ samāyātaścā'ṣṭamī janmabodhikā ।
kārṣṇī samīpagā cāste ceti vicārya yoṣitaḥ ।।43।।
sarvāḥ pitṛgṛhāttūrṇamārūḍhāḥ suvimānakam ।
āyayuḥ śrībālakṛṣṇagṛhaṃ pitrādisaṃhitāḥ ।।44।।
svāmigṛhaṃ samāsādya sukhinyo vai tadā'bhavan ।
sarveṣāṃ vai mahīmānottamānāṃ sukhamānanam ।।45।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇo vai yathārthamakarottadā ।
rājāno'pi tathā cakruḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya prabhostabhā ।।46।।
pañcadaśe pūrṇavarṣe ṣoḍaśe janmasūtsave ।
sutānāṃ pitaraḥ sarve sarvasṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ।।47।।
samāyātāścākṣarākhye kṣetre vardhayituṃ harim ।
prātareva kṛtasnānaścāṣṭamyāṃ kṛtamaṃgalaḥ ।।48।।
kṛtaśṛṃgāraveṣaśca hariḥ saṃsadamāyayau ।
lomaśādyaiḥ pūjitaśca vardhito'pi śubhāśiṣā ।।49 ।।
pūjādānaiḥ pāvitaścā''nandito yaśasāṃ stavaiḥ ।
rājādhirājaśobhāḍhyaḥ śuśubhe parameśvaraḥ ।।2.299.50 ।।
prātaścaivaṃ vartamāne janmāhasumahotsave ।
dīyante tatra dānāni gajavājigavādayaḥ ।।51।।
gomahiṣīvṛṣabhoṣṭrayānavāhanakāni ca ।
gṛhakṣetrārāmavāṭīdhanasvarṇātmakāni ca ।।52।।
vādyante tatra vādyāni gīyante tadyaśāṃsi ca ।
parihāre tato jāte madhyāhne bhojanādikam ।।53 ।।
abhavat sarvalokānāṃ kāntānāṃ śreṣṭhameva ha ।
atithīnāṃ prasatkārā annavastrādibhiḥ kṛtāḥ ।।54।।
rātrau nāṭyaṃ cā'bhavattu tadā dṛśyaṃ manoharam ।
mallānāṃ khelanaṃ cāpi saṃgītānāṃ ravāstathā ।।55।।
kāvyāni kavivaryāṇāṃ nṛtyāni vārayoṣitām ।
upadeśāśca sādhūnāmabhavan janmasūtsave ।।56।।
etasminnutsave rādhe! ramāpadmāvatīpitā ।
nārāyaṇaḥsutaścārkodevaścā'kṣarakṣetrake ।।57।।
svayaṃ divyāvatāro yaḥ sūryāṃśaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ ।
kāśītaścāgatastatra saṃsmṛtvā vacanaṃ hareḥ ।।58।।
mokṣaṇārthaṃ svayaṃ jātismaraḥ śivo yato hi saḥ ।
mānavaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya śivabhāvaṃ samīhate ।।59।।
dhenupālo'pi svarājyaṃ datvā putrāya yogine ।
dharmapālāya ca tatastena sahāgato'bhavat ।।2.299.60।।
sarve te kṛtasaṃkalpā muktyarthaṃ tvaritāstadā ।
abhavaँste tu vai kṛtvā śubhaṃ janmotsavaṃ tataḥ ।
prārthayan paramātmānaṃ dehamocanahetave ।।6 1 ।।
hariḥ prāhottarāyaṇasthitaṃ sūryaṃ vilokya vai ।
gantavyaṃ mama dhāmā'tra stheyaṃ tāvad gṛhe'tra ca ।
ityāśāṃ śirasi dhṛtvā sarvaṃ kuṭumbakaṃ śriyāḥ ।।62।।
tasthau lakṣmyā gṛhe nityaṃ viśāle mandirāntare ।
śivaḥ svayaṃ hariṃ putrīpatiṃ papraccha sādhanam ।।6 3।।
mokṣasyaiva tadā kṛṣṇaḥ svapriyaṃ prajagāda tam ।
śṛṇu śaṃbho kathayāmi mokṣasādhanamuttamam ।।64।।
ye vai mokṣe sthitāḥ santo māyābhāvavivarjitāḥ ।
teṣāṃ samāgamāt prasevanānmokṣo'bhilabhyate ।।65।।
yo'haṃ mokṣe nivasāmi nivasāmi sadā''tmasu ।
taṃ māmupāsya satataṃ mokṣaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ।।66।।
mayā kālaḥ karma dharmo jñānaṃ me śaktayastvimāḥ ।
matvaivaṃ śaktimantaṃ māṃ yastvāśrayati mucyate ।।67।।
dehena karmaṇā vācā manasā svīyavastubhiḥ ।
sarvātmanā'rpito yaḥ syānmayi drāk sa pramucyate ।।68।।
māṃ paśyenmāṃ rasayecca māṃ sadā saṃprakīrtayet ।
māṃ jighrenmāṃ spṛśenyāṃ saṃśṛṇuyāccintayecca mām ।।69।।
māṃ gṛhṇīyāt praseveta saṃvāhayecca māṃ sadā ।
māmabhigacched rahasi cānandayecca māṃ hṛdi ।।2.299.70।।
sthāpayenmāṃ pramanvīta nirṇayenmāṃ hṛdantare ।
ahamayecca māṃ nityaṃ madyoge sarvadā vaset ।।71 ।।
māṃ dhyāyenmāṃ snehapūrṇaḥ samāśliṣyenmilecca mām ।
māmekīkṛtya cā''dadyād bhogyajātaṃ mayi kṣipet ।।72।।
māṃ pratyakṣaṃ nijīkṛtya ceṣṭāṃ kuryānmadarthikām ।
śivarājaivamāsādya madyogaṃ mokṣamāvrajet ।।73।।
ramaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ viharaṇaṃ ca nartanaṃ raṇam ।
jāgaraṇaṃ svapanaṃ ca pravartanaṃ nivartanam ।।74।।
ācaraṇaṃ vicaraṇaṃ sadācaraṇamīraṇam ।
sarvaṃ kuryānmadarthaṃ vai dhruvamokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।75।।
ityuktaḥ śivarājo'yaṃ rādhike śītajā tathā ।
jayaścandro dhenupālo'śokā ca harau sthirāḥ ।।76।।
sthiradhyānā abhavaँśca sthirasevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
divyabhāvaṃ samāpannāḥ sarvasvārpaṇasevinaḥ ।।77।।
uttarāyaṇage sūrye samutsukāśca te tataḥ ।
svaputrīṃ prasamāśliṣya lakṣmīṃ mokṣābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।।78।।
aśvapaṭṭasarasyeva snātvā kṛtvā'rhaṇaṃ hareḥ ।
dhenupālo'pi ca sutātrayamābhāṣya vai tadā ।।79।।
vṛttī sarvāḥ parāhṛtya dhyānamagnāstadā'bhavan ।
jñānadaḥ śrīkṛṣṇadevaḥ sarvasvāmī hṛdisthitaḥ ।।2.299.80।।
tathā pratyakṣavartī tān jñātvā nirvāṇamānasān ।
svāsaktān prati tūrṇaṃ sa divyavimānamāsthitaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
nijadivyasvarūpeṇa muktiṃ dātuṃ samāyayau ।
lakṣmīpatiharistebhyastaireva varṣmabhistadā ।।82।।
ārohayāmāsa divye vimāne paśyatāṃ satām ।
tadā dundubhayo nedurdevānāṃ sarvatodiśi ।।83।।
sadāśivaḥ paraṃ mokṣaṃ yāti nityakilāsakam ।
devādyairvardhitāḥ sarve yayuḥ kailāsamuttamam ।।84।।
pārṣadāśca yayurnityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṛṣṇikā tathā ।
lakṣmīstathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāryaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।85।।।
sarvaṃ kartuṃ samartho tau tenaiva varṣmaṇā hi tān ।
rādhe! mokṣaṃ nītavantau mahāścaryamidaṃ hyabhūt। ।।86 ।।
taduttaravidhiṃ tatra sveśena saha putrikā ।
cakre laukikadānāni śrāddhotsavādikāni ca ।।87।।
atha śrībālakṛṣṇo'pi dhenūnāmuttarāyaṇe ।
prapūjanaṃ vyadhāttatra puṇyakāryapravṛttaye ।।88।।
dhenubhyaḥ pradadau tvārdraghāsān sasyāni vai tadā ।
gūḍaṃ ca dhānyakhādyāni dāpayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।।89।।
dhenavaśca tadā sarvalokebhyo divyavigrahāḥ ।
bhaumasthāścāyayustūrṇaṃ tadā prasādalālasāḥ ।। 2.299.90।।
bhuktvā natvā hariṃ prāpya pūjāṃ svasvāśramān yayuḥ ।
atha dvijebhyo bhagavān dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
sadbhyo dadāvambarāṇi bhojanānyuttamāni ca ।
dīnā'nāthebhyaśca dadau bhikṣukebhyo'pi sarvathā ।।92।।
miṣṭānnāmbararūpyādi svarṇaṃ pātrāṇi vai tadā ।
evaṃ kṛtvā dānavidhiṃ saptadhānyānvitāṃ navām ।।93।।
taralāṃ randhitāṃ cāpi ghṛtānvitāṃ saparpaṭām ।
sudadhnā cāranālena samaṃ saṃbubhuje hariḥ ।।94।।
bhojayāmāsa sarvāśca kāntāḥ kṛśarasaṃjñitām ।
kvathikāsahitāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ svādavatīṃ sugandhinīm ।।95।।
ityevaṃ rādhike! kaṣṇakāntāryo hi mahotsavam ।
uttarāyanayogasya cakre gopālakṛṣṇajaḥ ।। 96 ।।
ṣoḍaśe vatsare tvevaṃ brahmapriyāsamanvitaḥ ।
bubhuje bahubhogāँśca sarvakalyāṇakārakaḥ ।। 97।।
rādhike! taṃ smaret kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ narāyaṇīḥ ।
līlāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣotthāḥ muktidāḥ śāntidā hareḥ ।। 98 ।।
sarvamokṣaphalaṃ tvāsāṃ śravaṇe jāyate'kṣayam ।
brahmapūjāphalaṃ tvāsāṃ śravaṇe jāyate'kṣayam ।। 99 ।।
puruṣottamayogo'yaṃ sarvayogottamottamaḥ ।
sarvāvatārayogo'yaṃ sarvajñānottamottamaḥ ।। 2.299.100 ।।
sarvalakṣmīpradaścāyaṃ sarvamuktipradastathā ।
sarvasaubhāgyadaścā'yaṃ tvevaṃ śrutvā ramāpitā ।। 101 ।।
śāśvataṃ cāpi mokṣaṃ svaṃ samīpsat tamamokṣayat ।
yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ so'sya kriyāṃ śrībhagavāँstathā ।। 102 ।।
sambandhinastataścakrurharisaṃlagnamānasāḥ ।
rādhike! śrīhareryogaḥ sarvamuktipradastvayam ।। 103 ।।
sarvasaubhāgyadaścāpi tretāsantānanāmakaḥ ।
sarvavratānāṃ yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām ।। 1 04।।
sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ dīkṣāyogānāṃ tyāgadharmaṇām ।
sanyāsadharmaṇāṃ cāpi bhaktīnāṃ ca phalapradaḥ ।। 105 ।।
sarvāśramāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ śravaṇātphalado mataḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā vai hṛdayaṃ hyayam ।। 106 ।।
prāṇānāṃ jīvana cāyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
sarvapratiṣṭhāphaladaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ ।। 1 07।।
sarvasevāphaladaśca sarvavidyāphalapradaḥ ।
satīdharmaphaladaśca pātivratyaphalapradaḥ ।। 108 ।।
sarvabhogapradaḥ sarvasmṛddhidaḥ śravaṇād dhruvam ।
divyatā''pādakaḥ sarvavāsanākṣayakārakaḥ ।। 10 9।।
sarveṣāṃ cātra pāpānāṃ prajvālakaḥ supuṇyadaḥ ।
niṣkāmakarma caitadvai yadasya śravaṇaṃ sadā ।। 2.299.110 ।।
pūjanaṃ cāsya vai tadvad dānaṃ cāsya mahatphalam ।
rakṣaṇaṃ gṛhamadhye'sya kālamāyādināśanam ।। 111 ।।
asya khaṇḍasya bhāvena śravaṇācchrīhariḥ svayam ।
lakṣmyādibrahmaśaktyāḍhyo dadyāt divyaṃ svadarśanam ।। 112 ।।
asya kathā kāraṇīyā puraścaraṇamityapi ।
agatīnāṃ bhavenmokṣo bhūtādīnāṃ pramokṣaṇam ।। 113 ।।
duḥkhadāridryanāśaśca lakṣmīkulakuṭumbakam ।
yatrāyaṃ vartate tatra sarvadā vāsamāpnuyāt ।। 1 14।।
vaṃśavṛddhirbhavet putradhanadārapatiśriyaḥ ।
bhavanti yatra khaṇḍo'yaṃ pūjyate paṭhyate'pi ca ।। 1 15।।
rādhike'sya kathā yatra tatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
brahmapriyāḥ samastāśca muktamaṇḍalamityapi ।। 1 16।।
ahaṃ kṛṣṇastathā nārāyaṇaḥ sarvasvamaṇḍalaḥ ।
vasāvastāṃ kathāṃ śrotuṃ sarvadeveśvarānvitau ।। 1 17।।
vācakasya prapūjā ca kāraṇīyā vidhānataḥ ।
naranārīvibhūṣāścāmbarāṇi dhanamityapi ।। 1 18।।
gṛhakṣetragrāmavāṭīgajāśvahīrakādikam ।
yathāśakti pradātavyaṃ vācakāya śravārthibhiḥ ।। 1 19।।
mokṣadāya hi sarvasvaṃ dātavyaṃ paramārthine ।
udyāpanaṃ kāraṇīyaṃ mahotsavaḥ śubhastathā ।। 2.299.120 ।।
sakṛcchravaṇe māyā vai naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
kalpalatā kalpavṛkṣaḥ kalpadhenustvayaṃ mataḥ ।। 121 ।।
kalpamaṇiḥ kalpapātraṃ tretākhaṇḍo hi rādhike! ।
śrīkṛṣṇo'haṃ vadāmyatra tretāsantānasevanāt ।। 1 22।।
nāryai rādhāpadaṃ dāsye viṣṇupadaṃ narāya vai ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya paramātmane ।। 123 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne cireṇa lomaśāśramasthitānāṃ kāntānāṃ pitrādibhiḥ saha svadeśagamanaṃ, maṇḍapādiparihāraḥ, lakṣmyādikāśikāṃ'ganā-
kṛtasevāprakāraḥ, ṣoḍaśajanmotsave ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ sarvajanānāmāgamanam, mahotsavaḥ, śiveśvarādīnāṃ mokṣopadeśānmokṣaḥ, ṣoḍaśe vatsare uttarāyaṇadānādi, saṃhitāyāstretāsantānasya māhātmyamiticetinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 299 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 299 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇḍaḥ 2 (tretāyugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 300
[[lekhakaḥ :|]]

śrīrādhikovāca-
kṛṣṇakānta! kathāḥ sarvāḥ saṃkṣepāt kathayā'sya me ।
tretākhaṇḍasya vai śāntiḥ śravaṇe me'tijāyate ।। 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca--
rādhike bhagavān śrīmallakṣmīnārāyaṇo'bhavat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmyā yuto yadā ।। 2 ।।
tamenaṃ paramātmānaṃ hṛdayekṣaṇavarjitāḥ ।
na jānanti yathārthaṃ vai parabrahma sanātanam ।। 3 ।।
so'yaṃ samāgataḥ pṛthvyāṃ kṛpayoddhārahetave।
bhaktānāṃ mānasapūrttyai narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।। 4 ।।
dhanyāstāstanavaścātra yābhiḥ prāpto hariḥ svayam ।
dhanyāni tānīndriyāṇi hareryogaṃ gatāni vai ।। 5 ।।
dhanyāstāḥ ṛddhyaścāpi dhanyā deśāśca te tathā ।
dhanyāḥ kuṭumbinaścāpi puruṣottamayoginaḥ ।। 6 ।।
yatra vai paṭhyate lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya saṃhitā ।
dhanyo deśaḥ sa evā'pi yatrā''ste puruṣottamaḥ ।। 7 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ khaṇḍe dvitīyake ।
tretāsantānake nāmnā proktamādyaṃ sumaṃgalam ।। 8 ।।
sārvabhaumaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ parabrahmaṇa īritam ।
tato hiraṇyamayāṇḍasya kośakūrcasamudbhavau ।। 9 ।।
hiraṇyakūrcahiraṇyāṇḍābhidhāvasurāvubhau ।
yuyudhāte saha saṃkarṣaṇena gadayā tataḥ ।। 2.300.1 0।।
merorbhāgā vyavacchinnā ye ye te tvabhavan grahāḥ ।
sarvadhāmyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prakaṭībhūya dhāmataḥ ।। 11 ।।
sevāṃ gṛhṇāti ca pṛthvyāṃ kambharāśrīgṛhe'pi ca ।
prādurbhāvajayantyāṃ cotsave dānastavādayaḥ ।। 1 2।।
devadevījananānivṛkṣavallyādiṣu kṣitau ।
daśame divase daityaiḥ prabhorapakṛtiḥ kṛtā ।। 13 ।।
ṣaṣṭhīsūtakaśeṣādyairbālakṛṣṇāvanaṃ kṛtam ।
sūtakasya samutpattiḥ sūtātmavaradānakam ।। 14।।
nāmakāryotsave sāṇāsuro vyāghrāsuro hatau ।
ekādaśe'hani preṃkhā''roho'nantasvarūpakaiḥ ।। 15।।
talājārākṣasīnāryā moho harau subhaktatā ।
lājā sa maṃgalakāryakarī jātā kṛpāvaśā ।। 16 ।।
dugdhapānadine naikarūpairdhenupayo'śanam ।
gorūparākṣasīnāṃ saprāṇastanyasya pānakam ।। 17।।
harerbhūmyupaveśākhyasaṃskāre siṃhikādarī ।
anyāścāpi bālakṛṣṇaṃ siṣevire hariṃ prabhum ।। 18।।
karṇavedhe'sya saṃskāre sūcyādyā devatā api ।
sevāṃ kṛtvā'bhajan kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ bahusvarūpiṇam ।। 19 ।।
annaprāśanasaṃskāre dadāvannāni bhūriśaḥ ।
oṣadhayo bhojayitvā kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prapedire ।।2.300.20 ।।
vṛttijñānāya vai dvātriṃśadvastūni sahaiva saḥ ।
tāvaddhastaiḥ prajagrāha divyatā'sya prakīrtitā ।।2 1 ।।
tato daityastriyo yuddhaṃ vidhavāḥ kartumāyayuḥ ।
rākṣasīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ tumulaṃ yuddhamābhavat ।।22।
kanyakānāṃ vijaye rākṣasīnāṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ ।
divyatā kanyakākārātmatā śrīhariṇā kṛtā ।। 23 ।।
tābhyaḥ śrīlomaśaḥ prāha sevāmokṣavṛṣāँstataḥ ।
āśramīyāḥ sarvakanyāḥ vrataṃ varṣāsu cakrire ।।24।।
śatrūñjayādrisaṃvāsāḥ kaṃkatālā hatā mṛdhe ।
kaṃkatālyaśca rākṣasyo yuddhe divyā haripriyāḥ ।।25।
abhavaँśca nyuṣurlomaśāśrame cātmavedikāḥ ।
pitṛkanyā hareḥ pūjāṃ cakrire pretamokṣaṇam ।।26 ।।
rāśibhiḥ kṛtapūjā ca kṛṣṇaprāsādavarṇanam ।
mahāmaṇḍapaśobhā ca hareḥ śṛṃgāravarṇanam ।।27।।
prahlādasya mṛdhaṃ nārāyaṇena bhaktito jayaḥ ।
dānavānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kanyānāṃ varaṇaṃ hareḥ ।।28।।
śrīhareścaulasaṃskāre romṇāṃ nārāyaṇātmatā ।
jīvānāṃ romarūpāṇi tvaghānīti prakīrtitam ।।29।।
sālamālāsuranāśastatstrīṇāṃ harisaṃgrahaḥ ।
yajñasūtrotsave daityā sālamālādijātayaḥ ।।2.300.3 0 ।।
vināśitāstathā mokṣadharmā lomaśavarṇitāḥ ।
sukeśinaḥ samākhyānam aśūnyaśayanavratam ।।3 1 ।।
devasvāpā bhinnabhinnatithiṣvapi ca pūjanam ।
pātāleśasya vai kāraṇḍavasya nāśanaṃ tataḥ ।।32।।
kanyakā rakṣitā lomaśālaye svastikasya vai ।

ārasamayitā, kanyādānagraho'tha rakṣaṇam ।

kṛtvā hariryayau parīśānarājyaṃ tato'bhramat ।

vāyūnānagarīyānam indirāvāriṇā hareḥ ।
snānaṃ tatra ca vetālānāṃ tu pramokṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ।। 151 ।।
rājñe caturbhujaṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ ca tataḥ param ।

vratopadeśanaṃ vāśīlāpurīṃ gamanaṃ tataḥ ।

dinamānārkarājarṣergarimāpṛthivītale ।

koṭīśvarakṣmeśarāṣṭre peyisthāyāṃ gatirhareḥ ।

bālāvittakarāṣṭre'gāt phānkalāśīpure hariḥ ।
āṇḍajarānṛparāṣṭre āntaḥprāgasthapattane ।। 175।।

rāyasomananṛpatervāyumānāpure'pi tat। ।
pātragonayarāṣṭrīyaprajābhya upadeśanam ।। 177।।

urogamanarāṣṭraṃ ca yayau śrībhagavāँstataḥ ।। 178।।

upadeśo'tha ca brāhmīlākhyarāṣṭre makhasthale ।

āhutidānamaṃtrā'thopadeśādi prakīrtitam ।

lāpalātrīpurīyānaṃ sāmudradaityanāśanam ।

trāsamānadvīpe vṛndārukādvīpe ca siṃhale ।

śaratpūrṇārāsakhelaḥ svāṃganābhirharestataḥ ।

divyasabhā'dbhutatāvarṇanaṃ mahaḥsamāpanam ।

aśvarūpadharasyā''śvalāyanarṣeḥ praśāpataḥ ।

annakūṭotsavaḥ proktastato haṃsasvarūpiṇā ।

haimakalginṛpāt proktaḥ parśurāmaparābhavaḥ ।

bhāṇavīryabhaktakathā rāmādityanimittajā ।

kṛtiruktā''khyānayuktā tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ ।।20 1 ।।
pārṣṇiradasya śūdrasya kṣayarogo nivāritaḥ ।
arkapurīśiturvipraśāpena sarpatā tataḥ ।। 202।।

harikṛṣṇanaranārāyaṇatīrthaṃ tathoditam ।

kanyaiśvaryaguṇadivyalakṣaṇānyāha nāradaḥ ।।।2.300.21 0 ।।
yogapatrī pratipatrī darśite guṇagarbhite ।

phalādeśānvitaṃ proktaṃ mahāmaṇḍapavarṇanam ।

kāśīyātrāsajjatā cā'saṃkhyakanyāsusajjatā ।

sammānaṃ kuśalapraśnāḥ kailāsasyā'vatāraṇam ।।21 6।।
śivapuryāmatha pūjā kuladevyāstathā hariḥ ।
kṛṣṇarūpeṇa ca rādhārūpeṇa ca parīkṣaṇam ।। 2 17।।
cakre kanyā na deyaiti bālakṛṣṇāya sarvathā ।
śivaśaṃbhupuro'thā'pi girijāyāḥ puro'pi ca ।।218।।
lakṣmyāḥ puro'pi hariṇā proktvā dārḍhyaṃ parīkṣitam ।
kanyārthā'mbarabhūṣādipreṣaṇaṃ samavarṇitam ।। 219।।
varṇanaṃ yogavāhinyā pārvatyai darśitaṃ ṛcā ।
mumuhurdarśakanāryaḥ kṛṣṇāṃgeṣu pravīkṣya tam ।। 2.300.220।।
viśrāntimandire kṛṣṇasyā'bhavanmadhuparkakaḥ ।
kanyakānāṃ suśṛṃgāro harermaṇḍapa āgamaḥ ।।221 ।।
koṭyarbudābjarūpaiśca hariḥ kanyāḥ samagrahīt ।

sarvābhiḥ saha śayane vihāre naikarūpataḥ ।। 223।।
prātaḥ phullakayātrā ca yogagranthivimocanam ।
gaṃgāyāṃ sarvavargebhyaḥ pāritoṣādikā'rpaṇam ।।224।।
pañcagaṃgātaṭe bālakṛṣṇābhidhasutīrthakam ।

dyauḥ kanyārūpiṇī līlāṃ koṭyarbudābjarūpiṇaḥ ।
kāntābhiḥ ramamāṇasya harerdṛṣṭvā mumoha sā ।। 228।।
atha sarvakanyakānāṃ samādhiṃ harirairayat ।
sṛṣṭitrayākṣaradhāmādikaṃ tvadarśayaddhariḥ ।।229।।
mahīmānavidāyaṃ ca mithaḥ kṣamādiyācanam ।
mātṛbhirbhikṣitāḥ kanyāḥ sarvāḥ śrīhṝiṇā'rpitāḥ ।।2.300.23 0।।

janmotsave ṣoḍaśe svasatīnāṃ punarāgamaḥ ।।23 1।।
śivaśaṃbhvādimokṣastretāsantānaśruteḥ phalam ।

rakṣaṇādvā gṛhe bhuktimuktiyuktā bhavanti hi ।। 236।।
kṛtādhyāyāḥ pañcaśataṃ navatiśceti saṃhitāḥ ।
tretādhyāyaiste'ṣṭaśataṃ navatiśca bhavanti hi ।।237।।
saptāśītisahasrāṇi ślokā bhavanti saṃhitāḥ ।
athottaraṃ tṛtīyo dvāparasantānakābhidhaḥ ।।238।।
khaṇḍaḥ sampatsyate rādhe! kṛṣṇanrāyaṇagocaraḥ ।
ṣoḍaśābdātmakāvasthakṛṣṇasvarūpavarṇanaḥ ।।।239।।
kṛṣṇakāntā yoṣitaśca narāḥ kṛṣṇasya sevakāḥ ।

svasti vo'stu parabrahma śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svasti vaḥ kriyāt ।
mātā pitā patiḥ patnī svasti vaṃśā bhavantu vaḥ ।।241 ।।
vācakāyā'sya sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ vyāsāya muktaye ।
smṛddhaye śraddhayā divyabuddhyā śrotṛbhiro namaḥ ।। 242।।
svarṇaṃ ratnāni śayyādi hīrakā mauktikāni ca ।
gajavājigavādīni vimānaṃ vāhanāni ca ।। 243 ।।

śrīkṛṣṇovallabhaḥsvāmisvarūpo vyāsa eva yat ।।244।।

brahmaprāptikaraṃ śāstraṃ sarvavidyāprasaṃbhṛtam ।

sarvaduḥkhavināśo'sya śravaṇād dānatastathā ।
sarvaśāntisamāyogaḥ sarvasiddhiprasaṃjanam ।।247।।
vidyābhūkanyakāsvarṇadānānāṃ phaladā śrutiḥ ।
mokṣadānaphaladā ca kṛṣṇasvāmyapradāyinī ।।248।।
omāryaḥ kambharābālaḥ sarvasvāmī satīśvaraḥ ।
satāṃ rūpaḥ paramātmā jayatyaharniśaṃ prabhuḥ ।।249।।
tasminneva pare brahmaṇyarpito'yaṃ dvitīyakaḥ ।
santānaḥ santanotvatra śaśvattvaṃ subhagaṃ va om ।।2.300.250।।
vai dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi dve śate ca śatārdhakam ।
catvāraśca bhavantyatra ślokāstretāsutānake ।।251 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīye tretāsantāne lakṣmī-
nārāyaṇamahimā, tretāsantānakhaṇḍasthaviṣayāṇāṃ saṃkṣiptanirdeśaḥ,
dvāparasantānaprastāvaḥ, āśīrvādāśceti nirūpaṇanāmā
triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 300 ।।
