oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpaṇamastu



śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ
dvitīyakhaṇḍasya tretāsantānasyā'nukramaṇikā

1. śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasvāminaḥ sārvabhaumamahimno varṇanam ।
2. akṣaraparadhāmādhipaterbahudhā vaṃśavistāre hiraṇyāṇḍakośakūrcajanyayorhiraṇyakūrcahiraṇyāṇḍayorasurayoḥ saṃkarṣaṇadvārā nāśaḥ, pṛthvīgolakasya tu merordakṣiṇakhaṇḍātmakasyaivā'vaśeṣatayā rādhikāyai śrīkṛṣṇasya
paricayadānamityādi । 4
3 śrīpuruṣottamanārāyaṇasya sarvasṛṣṭiṣu sumūrtatayā vartamānatā, saurāṣṭre ānartamahākṣetre (lomaśāśramakṣetre) kṛpayā prākaṭyaṃ cetyādi । 7
4. parameśvarasya prākaṭyadine'vatārā īśvarā lokapālāḥ prajāḥ samāgatāḥ, vividhadānāni cetyādi । 10
5. bālasvarūpaprabhoḥ ṣaṣṭhīkṛtarakṣaṇam, daityaiḥ kṛtaṃ pātāle sūtakapuruṣadvārā'paharaṇam, sūtakādyutpattiḥ, śeṣanārāyaṇakṛtaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ, sūtakasya bhaktatvaṃ
sūtatvaṃ cetyādi । 13
6. parameśvarasya nāmakaraṇasaṃskāravidhiḥ, sāṇāsurasya vyāghrarūpadharasya hariṃ hantumicchaścakreṇa vināśanaṃ śāntikaraṇamityādi । 17
7 śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabhoḥ preṃkhā''rohaṇotsave talaputryāstalājārākṣasyāḥ kāpaṭayenā''gatāyā apiharau mohitāyā muktyādidānamityādi । 2 0
8. śrībālakṛṣṇasyadvitīyamāsāraṃbhe kṣīrapānotsave naikarūpairdivyagavāṃ dugdhapānaṃ, gomahotsavaḥ,gorūpadhāriṇāṃ kapaṭināṃ rākṣasānāṃ patnīnāṃ gorūpāṇāṃ saprāṇadugdhadhāvanapāne nāśo muktiśca bhagavatā kṛteti।
9 śrībālakṛṣṇaprabhostṛtīye māsi śukladale gṛhādbahirniṣkramaṇasaṃskāre yoṣidbhiḥ kārite lālana- ramaṇe bahurūpatā, divyadarśanam, lomaśāśrame suraprabhā kṛṣṇakāntaṃ nītvā yayau, tatra krodhano'suraḥ krodhanā kanyā bhūtvā harimaharat, vyomni
sā hariṇā dagdhā taṃ mumoca, tāṃ divyāṃ trirūpāṃ kṛtvā lomaśāśrame, mokṣe, durvāsobhāvijanmani, ceti vyadhāt। । vidhudarśanam, camatkāraścetyādi । 26
10 śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhorbhūmyupaveśanasaṃskāre bhūmerayutaputrīṇāṃ siṃhikādikandarāṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptiścetyādi । 29
11. śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhoḥ karṇavedhasaṃskāraḥ, sūcyai camatkāradarśanam, aśvinīkumāratīrtham, annaprāśanasaṃskāraḥ, vanadevatākāritaprāśanam, vanadevatābhyo bahurūpaiścamatkāraḥ, kāntaprāptiḥ, harervṛttijñānārthaṃ purodhṛtavastraśastrādivastūni grahītuṃ
bahurūpatādivyatā cetyādi । 31
12. dakṣiṇodadhitthadamanakadaityasya kanyakā hartuṃ lomaśāśramamāgatasya lomaśena kṛto jaḍībhāvaḥ, bālakṛṣṇena sudarśanena kṛtaḥ sasainyasya dhvaṃso mokṣaścetyādi । 34
13. rākṣasīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ cā'śvapaṭṭasaraḥsannidhau tumulayuddhāraṃbha ityādi । 37
14. asaṃkhyakanyakābhiryuddhasamarthābhiḥ saha rākṣasīnāṃ yuddhe rākṣasīnāṃ vināśābhimukhaparājaye'nte śaraṇāgatiḥ, muktipadaṃ kanyakāpadaṃ ca bālakṛṣṇa-
kṛpayetyādi । 40
15. nūtnakanyakānāṃ lomaśadarśitaikādaśīvratapātivratyagogurvādisevanamāhātmyaprabhṛti । 44
16. āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śrībālakṛṣṇasyaprabhoḥ kanyakā- kṛtapūjanaṃ, bahusvarūpadhāraṇaṃ, vratāni, śatrūñjayaparvatasthakaṃkatālānāṃ daityānāṃ yuddhaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, śeṣāṇāṃ kanyārūpadhāriṇāṃ lomaśāśrame vāsaścetyādi । 46
17. kaṃkatāladaityapatnīnāṃ yuddhe lomaśakṣetre kṛṣṇakāntātvaṃ
lomaśakṛtabālakṛṣṇātmakaniveditopadeśaścetyādi । 49
18. pitṛpakṣe pitṛkanyākṛtaharipūjanaṃ, harikṛtapitṛtarpaṇādi, nārakāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, pitṛstrījātiparicayaḥ, pretānāṃ muktiścetyādi । 52
19. kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣāraṃbhotsave sarvalokeṣvāmantraṇapatrikāpreṣaṇaṃ rāśikṛtavastūpasthāpanamahāmaṇḍapanirmāṇaṃ cetyādi । 56
20. maṇḍapasya śobhāvarṇanaṃ, samājāsanāni, śrībāla- kṛṣṇasya prabhormūrtiśṛṃgārādi । 60
21. śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhordvitīyavarṣāraṃbhe mahotsave maṇḍape mahā''sanavarṇana, sarvakṛtapūjāśīrvādāścetyādi । 63
22. cyavanayogena prahlādasya rasātalāttīrthārthaṃ bhūmāvāgamanaṃ, naranārāyaṇena saha yuddhaṃ, bhaktyā nārāyaṇaparājayaḥ, prahlādacyavanayorlomaśāśramāgamaścetyādi । 66
23. rasātalādisthitadaśasāhasradānavānāṃ mokṣaṇam, pañcasāhasrakanyakānāṃ bālakṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ ceti । 69
24. śrībālakṛṣṇasya prabhoścaulasaṃskāre romasu pāpānāṃ kathānakam, hareḥ romṇāṃ tu nārāyaṇarūpatetyādi । 72
25. vasantavikāsaḥ, puṣpadolotsavaḥ, timiṃgilarūpasālamālāsurasya harināśārthamāgatasya harikṛtanāśaścetyādi । 75
26. śrāvaṇyāṃ sarastaṭe yajñasūtrotsave sālamālavaṃśīyadaityānāmāgamanaṃ, yuddhaṃ, prabhuṇā teṣāṃ vināśaḥ, mokṣadharmā lomaśopadiṣṭāścepyādi । 78
27. daityanārīṇāṃ dharmopadeśe sukeśisamākhyānam, aśūnyaśayanavrataśivapuṇyakavratādi, devānāṃ bhinnatithiṣu svāpāḥ, pūjā cetyādi 81
28. prabhoścaturthavarṣāraṃbhotsave pātālanāgasya svastikasya garuḍadvārā pātālarājamantriṇaḥ sumadhoḥ sakāśādāgatakaṣṭamokṣaṇaṃ; nāgakanyānāṃ lomaśā-
śramā''nayanaṃ cetyādi । 84
29. āraktadeśīyarājñā putrārthaṃ śāvadīnākālyai bālabalidānārthabaddhabālānāṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ śrīharestatra gamanaṃ, sahasrakanyakānāṃ harau snigdhatā cetyādi । 87
30. prabhoḥ rājakṛtadevīpaśusaṃskāraḥ, devyā rājādisaṃhāraḥ, badrīṃ kurukṣetraṃ lomaśāśramaṃ pratyāgamanam, bālakānāṃ tajjanakebhyo'rpaṇam, mātaṇāṃ mukti-
ścetyādi । 90
31. kanyakānāṃ payovrataṃ, purādharmatatve śvetaketukṛtamaryādā, saudāsapatnyāṃ vaśiṣṭhaputro'śmakaḥ, utathyabhāryā vṛhaspatispṛṣṭā, dīrghatamā balerdāsyāṃ
rājñyāṃ ca putrānutpādayāmāsa, tato maryādākaraṇaṃ cetyādi । 93
32. bālagrahādīnāṃ pūjane teṣāṃ pratyakṣāgamanaṃ, teṣāṃ nāmarūpādibhirvarṇanaṃ ceti । 96
33. gaurīpūjanavisarjane, vallīdīnākhyavyāghrāsurasya śatena vyāghrasiṃharūpadhāriṇā'suravrajena saha vināśanamityādi । 99
34. prabhoḥ pañcamābdike mahotsave vividhagandharvāṇāṃ gāyanāni, dālbhyabakādisahasrarṣīṇāṃ siṃhavyāghrādicarmabhyaḥ siṃhādīnāṃ sajīvīkaraṇam, aṃguṣṭhātta-
ttaccarmāvirbhāvaścetyādi । 102
35 kailāsīyā'rdhanārīśvaranāṭyamaṇḍalena lomaśakṣetrekṛtā'laukikanāṭayaiḥ prabhuḥ santuṣṭaḥ san śaṃkaragarvagaṃjano mokṣadaścā'bhavat, naṭanāṭyatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 105
36 prabhorvidyāraṃbhe sarvamūrtimadvidyānāmāgamaḥ, buddhiparīkṣā, bṛhaspatikṛto varāṭakadaityāya yatnaśīlatopadeśaḥ, daityataponirodhaścetyādi । 108
37. varāṭakākhyā'surasainyādiparājayadaṇḍādikaṃ, ḍaphpharajātīyamlecchanāśanaṃ cetyādi । 111
38. vanaspatinabhaspatisaraspatimaharṣīṇāṃ satīśāpād rākṣasatāmāpannānāṃ vāṭikāyāmupadravaḥ, prabhuṇāśāpamokṣaṇaṃ, nagnaśaṃkarasya tāpasāśrameṣu bhramaṇam,
ṛṣikṛtāparādhaḥ, liṃgapātanam, śāpakāraṇaṃ cetyādi । 114
39. prabhoḥ ṣaṣṭhavatsarāraṃbhe'ṣṭamyāṃ śrīrādhākṛṣṇāvatāra-vyūhadevamānavādikṛtamahotsavapūjanam, patnīsahitadevāyanadvijasya cāṇḍālayonita uddhāraścetyādi । 11
40. mārgaśīrṣe ūrjavratarṣikṛtāyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇa-
saṃhitākathāyāḥ śravaṇaprasaṃge prabhordivyadarśanam,
ṛṣīṇāṃ stavanāni, nivāsāttīrthāni cetyādi । 121
41 kaṃthādharanṛpasya śaṃkarabhaktyā kālayaṣṭiprāptiḥ, puṣkare sevayā vaśiṣṭhāśīrvādena cirajīvitā, vipraputrasya yamagṛhagatasyā''nayanaṃ svā''yurdānaṃ, yamarājaputryā hṛḍḍakāyinyā saha vivāhaḥ, tatprasaṃgena nāstikatā cetyādi । 124
42. kaṃthādharasya hṛḍḍakāyinīpatnīyogenā'tināstikyaṃ, vedakarmādinirodhenaiśvaryanāśe vane maraṇaṃ, mlecchajanma, putreṇa raṇaṃgamenā'śvapaṭṭasarastīrthe kṛtoddhāraścetyādi । - 127
43. raṇaṃgamakṛtayajñaḥ, prabhoḥ saptamo janmotsavaḥ, yakṣakanyayā saha raṇaṃgamasya vivāhaḥ, vimānādilābhaścetyādi । 130
44. raṇaṃgamasya dakṣiṇadhruvadarśanārthaṃ vimānena gatasyā'ntārkivartuladeśamadhye bhūvivare praviṣṭasya lakṣmaṇā''ryakṛtasvāgataṃ prabhordarśanaṃ, lakṣmaṇasya rājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya tadvimānena yātrārthaṃ pṛthvyāmāgamanaprayāṇaṃ cetyādi । 133
45. madhye rodhayato mātrāgaskararākṣasasya svastrīmātṛprabhṛtitāḍanātmakaduṣṭavṛttāntaḥ, māँjāmbikāyāḥ sasnuṣāyāḥ samudre kṣiptāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛtarakṣaṇaṃ cetyādi । 136
46. raṇaṃgamamātrāgaskarayoryuddhaṃ, raṇaṃgamasya vijayaḥ, lomaśāśramāgamanaṃ, prabhoḥ pūjanaṃ, prabhau lakṣmaṇasyasahasradvayakanyāśaraṇaṃ, ṣaṭpadāḥ cetyādi । 139
47. lakṣmaṇakanyakābhyo lomaśakṛtaputraputrīśiṣyapatnyādivivecanātmajñānādi । 142
48. vedhasastisraḥ putryaḥ suṣumṇeḍāpiṃgalāḥ, tā vimānenāgatya prabhuṃ natvā svīyaṃ matvā sampūjya yayurityādi । 145
49. suṣumṇādikā vimānena pṛthvīkhaṇḍān vilokya satyalokaṃ yayuḥ, punardvāsaptatisahasrakanyakā vyomnā vimānena śrīharidarśanārthaṃ prasthitāśce-
tyādi । 148
50. abriktadeśīyanṛpatinā svasainyādhipaiḥ sarvakāmavimānaṃ ruddhaṃ, dūtoktirnāradasya pratyuktiśca, tatra śukrā'rajādaṇḍānāṃ viśvakarmacitrāṃgadāsurathānāṃ kathā cetyādi । 151
51. abriktadeśeṣu brahmavimānena saha yodhināgaramlecchāścaikādaśakoṭayaścaikādaśalakṣasaṃkhyākāśca naṣṭā ityādi । 154
52 śrīkṛṣṇarādhikākṛtavivekādivijñānadarśanam । 158
53. kāpaṭyapūrvā daityānāṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ, śaṃkarādīnāṃ tadrājadhānīṃ prati gamanaṃ svāgataṃ, pṛṣṭhato vimāne yuddhaṃ cetyādi । 160
54. vimāne saptamabhūmikāyāṃ daityanārīkṛtayuddhaṃ, kalpavallyutthakṛtyākṛtadaityānīnāśaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanaṃ, rājñaḥ prārthanā, upadeśaścetyādi । 164
55. abriktadeśeṣu śrīharirvihṛtya tīrthāni kṛtvā mṛtānāmuddhāraṃ kṛtvā rājakuṭumbasya mokṣaṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ dvedhā vibhajya bhaktābhyāṃ dadāvityādinirūpaṇam । 166
56. maruddevānāṃ daityarūpeṇotpattiḥ punardevatvaprāptirjanmāntarādikathanam, abriktīyamukhyadaityajanma- vṛttānta ityādi । 169
57. yamarājadvārā raktabījādidaśasāhasradaityānāṃ vināśaḥ, aravākhyadūtāya rājyadānaṃ, bakadā- narṣirakṣā, āravavaṃśodbhavaścetyādi । 172
58. raktabījā''rabījādyasurotpattirdhundhudaityotpattirbīja- nāśātmakapātakamityādi । 175
59. bhādraikādaśyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovare śrāddhena pretānāṃ muktiḥ, pretavaṇiksaṃvādaścetyādi । 178
60. udayapattananṛpateścāturmāsye dhīravīrasarovarataṭasthitasya prabhordarśanaṃ, cātivṛṣṭyā jalamagnatvaṃ, prabhuṇā nāvā rakṣā kṛtetyādi । 181
61. jalamagnadviśatamanuṣyān nāvi gṛhītvā prabhurmahīnadīdvārā staṃbhā'khātasamudradvārā somanāthaṃ svarṇapuraṃ camatkāranagaraṃ ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya naukātmakavimānena kuṃkumavāpīkṣetramānināya, lomaśopadiṣṭarakṣāstotraṃ, krūrasiṃhasya rakṣaso vipradvārā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptyā muktiścetyādi । 184
62. jaloddhṛtajanakṛtastuti, rugṇavyaṃgaṣaṇḍhādīnāmaṣṭavatsarotsave svāsthyakaraṇaṃ, tatkṛtastavanam, āryāyanakṛtastotraṃ, jaloddhatānāṃ svadeśaprāpaṇam, udayanṛpasya mokṣaścetyādi । 187
63. candrodayapattanavāsino vasumedhaśreṣṭhino narmadādvārā naukayā tīrthārthaṃ saurāṣṭrasamudre yātasya jhaṃjhāvātena jalamagnasya sakuṭumbasyottāraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena kṛtaṃ, muktidānaṃ cetyādi । 190
64. gopanāthamāhātmye saurāṣṭre śrīkṛṣṇasya sarvādijanmatratīrthakṣetrādinirūpaṇam । 192
65. prabhoraṣṭame varṣe vaiśākhe yajñopavītamahotsave maṃgalā''mantraṇapatrikādvārā sarveṣāmāgamanādi । 194
66. śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya yajñopavītapradānavidhipūjādi । 197
67. mahīmānebhyo bhojanadānaṃ sabhāyojanā nāradoktaparāvidyopadeśaścetyādi । 200
68. mahīmānebhyaḥ pāritoṣikadānaṃ, prabhoḥ pūjanam, upadārpaṇam, divyadarśanaṃ parihāraścetyādi । 203
69. prabhoḥ sevārcanadānapūjādiphalamāhātmyādinirūpaṇam । 206
70. pūrvasvabhāvānuvarṇanaṃ jāḍyamaghadṛṣṭāntena ṣaḍbhirjanmabhirvivecitam । 209
71. jyāmaghanṛpaḥ svapatnyai dhanālasāyai bhagavatā indradyutiviprāya pūrvaṃ yaduktaṃ jñānaṃ taduktavān mokṣasādhanamityādi । 212
72 jyāmaghasya tatpatnyāśca lomaśakṣetre āpmaniveditabhaktyā mokṣaṇamipyādi । 215
73. āmodapattanavāstavyasudhanākhyabhaktasya varcakāyanimaharṣiyogena prāptabhāgavatabhāvasya caurebhyo rakṣā bhagavatkṛtā, prabhordiṃvyadarśanādi cetyādi । 218
74. kimanadyāstaṭe kuśāmbāpattanasthakauśikāmbarṣiyogenā'ntyajasya rogiṇaḥ tryaṣṭakāroḥ sastrīkasya prabhorbhaktyā muktipadalābha ityādi । 221
75 hiraṇyakeśarṣigurukulasthānāṃ ṣaṭśatabālānāṃ rākṣasairnāśe kṛte śrīhariṇā rakṣasāṃ nāśārthaṃ kṛtodyamayuddhādikam । 224
76. santāpanadaityamāritānāṃ hiraṇyakeśiśiṣyāṇāṃ sajīvīkaraṇam, daityānāṃ nāśaḥ, dakṣiṇādidiśāṃ nadīsarovarāṇāṃ tīrthīkaraṇaṃ cetyādi । 227
77. bṛhadvarconṛpāt tāpītīre gṛhītaghorapratigraheṇa kṛṣṇakadrūpatā gatānāṃ sahasraviprāṇāṃ suratāyanarṣiyoga ityādi । 228
78. suratāyanarṣikṛtopadeśaḥ, prabhoḥ prāvirbhāve''śvinīkumārayorāgamanaṃ viprāṇāṃ niṣkalmaṣīkaraṇaṃ sanyāsaspaṣṭatā cetyādi । 231
79. suratāyanādipañcasāhasraviprāṇāṃ lomaśatīrthāgamanaṃ, śubhopadeśaścetyādi । 234
80 baleśvararājñaḥ kapilabhagavadyogena paramabhāgavatatvaṃ tārakāyanamaharṣiyogena kārtikavrate parīkṣārthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vanecararūpeṇā''gamanaṃ, rājñaḥ
putraputrīstrīkuṭumbārpaṇena prabhordarśanaṃ cetyādi । 237
81. baleśvararājñaḥ sakuṭumbasya śrīharistutiḥ, dvedhā divyadehādiprāptiścetyādi । 240 82. jayadhvajasya rājño viśvāmitropadiṣṭaparabrahmopāsanābalād yajñe hariprāptiḥ, videharākṣasavināśaḥ, catuḥparvatānāmavabhṛthasnānādi ceti । 243
83. jayadhvajena pradattaṃ jñānaṃ droṇailanīlaśrīparvatānāṃ
kolāṭacilaśaṃbhalanārāyaṇasarasāṃ divyatīrthatā bhaktatā muktiśca, jayadhvajasya muktiścetyādi । 246

ladvīpamāgatya pampāsaraścāgatyā''śvinaśuklasaptamyāṃ sāyaṃpūrvaṃ śrīlomaśakṣetramavāpa, svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ bhojanaṃ śayanādikaṃ cetyādi । 681

234. śrīhareḥ pañcadaśajanmajayantyāmaṣṭamyāṃ divyamaṇḍapaśobhā''mantraṇamāmantritānāmāgamanaṃ śrībālakṛṣṇapūjanaṃ satkāraḥ sammānanamityādi । 687
235 maṇḍapasyopasaṃhāro mahīmānavidāyaṃ tāmasākṣināmakacāṇḍālabhaktasya sakuṭumbasya jalato rakṣaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi । 690
236. śrīhariṇā dhanatrayodaśyāṃ dhanalakṣmīpūjā brahmapriyāpūjā barburanṛpasya āśvalāyanarṣiśaptasya barburavṛkṣībhūtasya mokṣaṇaṃ pṛthutīrthasthānaṃ barburasya svargaṃ
pratipreṣaṇamityādi । 693
237. śrīhariṇā kālīcaturdarśyāṃ śaṃkaratadgaṇabhṛtyadāsadāsīnāṃ pūjā dīpāvalyāṃ śāradādipūjā pratipadi mahāmārīrogapīḍitasaṃparkanṛpatatsainyādīnāṃ dattātreyasvarūpeṇa rogo nāśito dattātreyatīrthaṃ ca kṛtamityādi । 696
238. śrīhariṇā'nnakūṭotsavo vihitaḥ sarvaprajānāṃ bhojanādi kāritaṃ cetyādi । 699
239. kārtikaikādaśīvratena puṇḍarīkanṛpaterhaṃsarūpahariṃ prāptasya mokṣaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi haṃsatīrtham, colarājñā'pi nṛsiṃhayogenā'śvapaṭṭasarastīre nṛsiṃhasthāpanaṃ nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 702
240. vītihotrayogeśvarāya ṛṣabharūpeṇa sahasrarūpaiśca harerdarśanadānam ṛṣabhatīrthakhyātirityādi । 705
241. patañjalicamasayoge'śvapaṭṭasarasaḥ pūrvataṭe vaivasvatakṛtaṃ saṃkarṣaṇapatañjaliśeṣādimandiraṃ jale ca saṃkarṣaṇapatañjaliśeṣāditīrthajātamityādi । 707
242. dākṣīdevīvāmadevayormānasaputrasya paṃkilarṣerjyeṣṭhapañcabhaginīsevālabhyāśīrvādaiḥ pañcakalpacirajīvitvaṃ yugaparyantamaśvapaṭṭasarovare samādhau sthitasya vāmana pādāṃguṣṭhāṃgulisparśena jāgratastasya vāmanamandiranirmāṇādi kāritaṃ vāmanāditīrthāni cetyādi । 710
243. vāmadevīyapañcakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇalabdhiḥ, haimakalginṛpasya bhaktyā harernityaṃ pratyakṣam, nṛpāt parśurāmaparābhavaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarasi parśurāmatīrthaṃ haimakalgitīrthaṃ cetyādi । 713
244. mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmaśvapaṭṭasarastīre'śvapāṭalanṛpatiḥ somayāgamārabdhavān, prathamadivasīyā'nuṣṭhānam, lomaśakṛtopadeśaścetyādi । 716
245 somayāge dvitīyadivasasya navamyāḥ kṛtyaṃ pravargyādikaṃ havanaṃ parihāraṃ bhojanam upadeśādikaṃ ca lomaśaḥ kṛtavānityādi । 719
246 tṛtīyadine daśamyāṃ somayāgakṛtyottaraṃ bhojanaṃ lomaśasyopadeśanaṃ cetyādi । 721
247. caturthadivase somayāgasyaikādaśyāṃ kṛtyam, jāgaraṇamudyāpanamupadeśanaṃ cetyādi । 724
248. pañcamadivase mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ somayāge prātaḥsavanaṃ mādhyandinasavanaṃ taduttarasavanaṃ pūrṇāhutiravabhṛtheṣṭirityādi । 727
249. lomaśagītāyām aśvapāṭalanṛpataye lomaśena śuddhopaniṣadamṛtaguptyādyupadiṣṭam । 730
250 lomaśagītāyām aśvapāṭalakṛtastyāgamārgasya pratyakṣaphalapraśno nirāmayatāpraśnastrivargeṣu kiṃśreṣṭhatāpraśno lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetyādi । 733
251. lomaśagītāyām ātmanaḥ pāpātmakatve puṇyātmakatve muktibhāve doṣavināśabhāve nṛpakṛtapraśnānāṃ lomaśadattottarāṇītyādi । 736
252. lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto'kṣaragatisādhanapraśnaḥ, sanyāsād gārhasthyādvā gatipraśnaḥ sṛṣṭitrayasargapraśnaḥ śreyaḥpraśna lomaśakṛtottarāṇi ceti । 739
253. gītāyāṃ nṛpakṛto'bhyudayapraśnaḥ śreyomūlādipraśno lomaśakṛtottarāṇi ca । 742
254. lomaśagītāyāṃ devādīnāṃ toṣaṇahetupraśno vivekopāsanāyogadharmagurubhiḥ kīdṛśī muktiritapraśnaḥ, lomaśoktottarāṇi cetyādi । 745
255. lomaśagītāyāṃ yogasya balābalapraśnaḥ kṣarā'kṣaralokapraśnaḥ, lomaśakṛtottarāṇi cetyādi । 748
256. lomaśagītāyāṃ nṛpakṛta ātmanaḥ kṣaramocanaṃ cā'kṣaramocanaṃkathaṃnetipraśnaḥ । lomaśakṛtaṃ tanmocanaṃ tadgatiścetyuttarāṇītyādi । 791
257. lomaśagītāyām ātmano dehādviniṣkramaṇe hetupradarśanaṃ, sanyastā'sannyastavicāre ānartanṛpakuśalāyoginīsamvādaśceti । 754
258. lomaśagītāyām ānarttarājena saha brahmaputrīkuśalāsādhvyā vivādaḥ, gārhasthye'pi tyāgāt sādhusamāgamadvārā muktirityādi । 767
259. lomaśagītāyāṃ brahmakallolaputrasya anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇopadeśajanyapāvanāvyayanaṃ mokṣasthitiścetyādi । 760
260. lomaśagītāyāṃ yogino'pi datteṣṭaguruśuśrūṣādiphalāvāptiryajñe harerdevatānāṃ bhāgāraṃbhakathetyādi । 763
261. lomaśagītāyāṃ lomaśakṛtam aśvapāṭalāyā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasākṣātparabrahmatvabodhadānaṃ parabrahmaparāyaṇadharmabodhadānaṃ ceti । 766
262 lomaśagītāyām aśvapāṭalanṛpo rāmādityatīrthaṃ prāpya bhāṇavīryabhaktakathāṃ śrutvā vidhinā snānadānādikaṃ cakāra, rājñormithaḥ saṃvādaścetyādi । 770
263. galatkuṣṭhina ūrjavratākhyakāyasthasya sūryopāsanayā nīrogitvaṃ muktiḥ sūryatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 772
264. nindakahiṃsakaśūdrasya godāvaryāṃ maraṇāddharmāraṇye mūkaviprajanma, tapasā dhūtapāpasya kuṃkumavāpyāmoṣadhivijñānaṃ mūkatānāśaḥ śārṅgadharasaṃhitākaraṇaṃ śārṅgadharatīrtham āśvaśirasatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 775
265. pārṣṇiradanāmakā'jāpālaśūdrasyā'śvapaṭṭasarovare snānādinā kṣayaroganivāraṇaṃ nāradatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 778
266. arkapurīnṛpasya dharmasumantuṛṣiśāpena sarpatā, viprasya sarpadaṃśaḥ, sarpamokṣaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarovare śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena viprapatnyāḥ satyā prārthanayā viprojīvitaḥ, śvetavyāsatīrthaṃ satītīrthaṃ cetyādi । 781
267. saurāṣṭre svarṇapattane nṛpasya rakṣāṃgārakasya malecchairhanane tatpatnyā rāṇikāsatyāḥ aśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe satītvaṃ satītīrthamāhātmyaṃ cetyādi । 784
268. amohākṣanṛpateḥ prabuddhagurorupadeśena śrīlomaśakṣetrā''game sākṣāt parabrahmaprāptirmokṣo buddhatīrthaṃ cāmohatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 787
269 abhayākṣanṛpaterbhaktirvairāgyaṃ makhaḥ, aśvapaṭṭasarastīre tyāgidīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇādidarśanaṃ mandiranirmāṇaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ nārāyaṇatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 790
270 devānīkakarṣukasya jale magnasya viṣṇunā rakṣitasya sthale viṣṇutīrthaṃ, bhadrāyanagrāmasya brahmastambaviprasya tapataḥ puruṣottamaprāpteḥ puruṣottamatīrthaṃ, devamūlakakanyayā'marīdevyā tapasā''rādhito mahāviṣṇurbhagavān tāṃ vidhinā
jagrāheti mahāviṣṇutīrthaṃ, kūpyavālakāṣṭhahārasya gajena dhṛtasya sanatkumāro rakṣāṃ kṛtavān, tatra tat sanatkumāratīrthaṃ cetyādi । 793
271. kuṃkumaviprakṛtaṃ kuṃkumeśvaratīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ satīśācāraṇīkṛtaṃ durgāsatītīrthaṃ vaṇikpatnīdhanyeśvarīkṛtaṃ lakṣmītīrthaṃ caityabrahmadvijakṛtaṃ śālagrāmatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 797
272 naranārāyaṇatīrthaṃ harikṛṣṇatīrthaṃ māṇikītīrthamaśvapaṭṭasaṃjñā'śvapāṭalaprāgvṛttāntaṃ sarvatīrthāgamo vairājastutyā parabrahmā'vataraṇamaśvapāṭalasya sādhudīkṣeti । 800
273. anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena sādhusādhvībhyo mantradīkṣājñānopadeśādi dattam, kāśītaḥ śiveśvarapreṣitayogapatrikāsahitasya bṛhaspaternāradena saha
lomaśakṣetramāgamanaṃ patrapradānaṃ svāgataṃ cetyādinirūpaṇam । 803
274. bṛhaspatipradattapatrikāyā lomaśakṛtasavidhipūjana-vācanādi, tato janasammānādi, nārado gopālakṛṣṇāya vividhaiśvaryaguṇadivyalakṣaṇānyāha bālakṛṣṇāya rahasyārthaṃ cāhetyādi । 806
275. śivāyai nāradoktaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamahimā, lakṣmī-mahimā, satāṃ samāgamalābhakāraṇāni nāradasammānanavṛttāntādi । 809
276. surahasyaṃ nārado bālakṛṣṇāya prāha tataḥ śrīkaṃbharādevyai prāhetyādiguṇavarṇanam । 812
277. amāyāṃ gopālakṛṣṇālaye trailokyayoṣitāṃ maṃgalagītayo gṛhe gṛhe mahotsavā vādyavādanāni bṛhaspateḥ sanmānam, patrikāprakāśanaṃ tatpratyuttaraṃ pragṛhya prapūjitabṛhaspateḥ kāśīṃ pratyāgamastrailokye kṛtā''mantraṇamityādi । 816
278. mārgaśuklapratipadi prātarmaṃgalāni kuṃkumavāpīsarasoḥ śobhā divyāṃganamaṇḍapaśobhā cetyādi । 819
279. maṇḍape māṇikyastaṃbhasya kalaśasya gaṇeśasya mātṛkāṇāṃ vāstorviṣṇoḥ kuladevatāyāśca sarvatobhadrasya ca pūjane phalamityādi । 822
280. mahāmuktakṛtamahāmaṇḍapadivyatāvarṇanamityādi । 825
281. patrikāyā lekhanaṃ pūjanaṃ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu preṣaṇaṃ, tāmbūlapūgīphaladānabhojanamahotsavaḥ, rātrau gāyana-nartanavādanamallayodhanatāṭyakaraṇakāvyaracanapāri-
toṣikapradānabhojanadānaparihārādyutsavāścetyādi । 828
282. dvitīyāyāḥ prātarmaṃgaladṛśyāni devapūjanāni bālakṛṣṇasya mahāsnānamardanaṃ snānaṃ śṛṃgāro mahīmānādīnāṃ bhojanādi, sṛṣṭitrayā''gamaḥ,
kṛṣṇayormaṃgalajanyotsāhalābhādiśceti । 831
283. mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ prātaḥkṛtyāni madhyāhne bhojanādīni, kāśīṃ pratiyātrārthaṃ sajjatā, śṛṃgāraḥ, māṃgalikakartavyāni, brahmapriyādikanyakānāṃ pitrādibhiḥ saha vimānādhirohaṇaṃ cetyādi । 834
284. mahīmānānāṃ saṃjñā kanyakādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca vimānā''rohaṇaṃ kṛṣṇayānyāḥ kāśīṃ pratigamanaṃ cetyādi । 837
285. yogayānīsammānārthaṃ śivakāritavādyaninadāḥ, ambarāt kāśyāḥ śivapurasya pārvatīpurasya ca vīkṣaṇam, puravarṇanam, mahīmānasahitaśiveśvareṇa kṛṣṇasvāgatārthamambare ghaṭikāsthāyi kailāsaṃ racitamityādi । 840
286. ākāśakailāse vāditraiḥ yogavāhinyāḥ śaṃkareṇa bahurūpaiḥ sammānaṃ svāgataṃ pūjanamabhivardhanaṃ ca kṛtam, miṣṭānnajalapānatāmbūladānaṃ ca kṛtam, narāṇāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ ca mithaḥ kuśalapraśnāḥ, kailāsasya tirobhāvaḥ, sarveṣāṃ śivapure'vataraṇam, bhojanādi rātrau viśrāntiścetyādi । 843
287 caturthyāṃ prātaḥ kṛtamaṃgalāni, kuladevatāpūjanam, mahīmānānāṃ madhyāhne bhojanādi, viśrāntiḥ, bālakṛṣṇasya śrīkṛṣṇarūpasya śiveśvareṇa sākaṃ vivādastaduttarāṇi ceti । 846
288. bālakṛṣṇasya rādhārūpasya girijayā saha samvādaḥ, viprarūpasya lakṣmyā saha samvādastaduttarāṇi dārḍhyaṃ cetyādi । 849
289. bhūṣāmbaropakaraṇādipreṣaṇam, vāhinīmahīmāna-śṛṃgārādi, maṇḍapaṃ prati niryāṇaṃ maṇḍapaśobhā cetyādi । 852
290. candraśālāyāṃ pārvatī devyai ṛgvedena kṛṣṇāyayatīsthamahīmānaparicayaḥ pradarśita iti ca । 855
291. suveṣite śrobālakṛṣṇe pratyekāṃ'ge naranārīṇāṃ vṛttyākarṣaṇena mugdhatā, divyadarśanaṃ gopuraṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ceti । 859
292. bālakṛṣṇasya gopure pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ, tadagre nartanaṃ yantrāṇāṃ cā''sphoṭanaṃ, viśrāntimandire viśramaṇaṃ madhuparkadānam, śṛṃgāraḥ, śrīkṛṣṇasya maṇḍapamukhyadvāraṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ceti । 862
293. śiveśvarakṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ, śivākṛtaṃ gṛhopakaraṇottāraṇaṃ, śrīhareḥ maṇḍapāsane niṣadanam, kanyakānāṃ cā''gamaḥ, pūjā, devatāpūjā, kāmaphalabandhanaṃ dānaṃ, haste dānāni, arbudarūpadhāraṇam, sarvakaragrahaḥ, sarva mālādhṛtiḥ, vahnipradakṣiṇam, gotrādiprakāśanavidhyarpaṇaṃ ceti । 865
294 vahnisākṣye nirdeśaḥ, gṛhadharmopadeśaḥ, karmaparihāraḥ, dampatībhojanam, sarvabhojanam, maṇḍape bahurūpa parihāraḥ, koṭyarbudābjadānottaraṃ dampatīmandire śayanamityādi । 869
295. dānasaṃkhyā, pañcamyāṃ prātaḥ phullakayātrābhramaṇaṃ, granthimocanaṃ madhyāhnabhojanāni śivapure viśrāntiḥ pāritoṣikādikam, gaṃgāyāṃ tīrthasnānaṃ dānaṃ pañcagaṃgāyāṃ yogatīrthaṃ, śaṃkarāya bhikṣādānaṃ śivapurāgamaścetyādi । 872
296. prodvāhatīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ, mahīmānānāṃ vidāyaṃ, mithaḥ kṣamāyācanā, viyoge śokaḥ, vimānānāṃ pragamanaṃ, lomaśakṣetrā''gamo dānaṃ maṃgalaṃ gṛha praveśo bhojanāni ānandavihārā nidrā cetyādi ।
297 ṣaṣṭhyā prātaḥ snānapūjādyuttaraṃ mantragrahaṇam, mahīmāna bhojanam, vimānena vanāvalokanārthaṃ viharaṇam, rātribhojanam, dyauḥ kanyārūpā līlāṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātā, koṭayarbudābjagṛheṣu bhinnalīlaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vīkṣya mugdhā prapūjya svargaṃ gatā, harernidrā ceti । 878
298. saptamyāṃ prātaḥ samādhau sṛṣṭitrayā'kṣaradhāmādi- pradarśanaṃ, tāsāṃ śāśvatadivyamuktasvabhāvīkaraṇam, mahīmānabhojanapūjanaṃ kṣamāvidāyādi, kṣetradeva- pāritoṣikādi ceti । 882
299. cireṇa lomaśāśramasthitānāṃ pitrādibhiḥ saha svadeśagamanaṃ, maṇḍapādiparihāraḥ, lakṣmyādikāśikā''tmajākṛtasevāprakāraḥ, ṣoḍaśajanmotsave kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ yāvatparigṛhāgamanam, maho- tsavaḥ, śivaśaṃmbhvādīnāṃ mokṣopadeśo mokṣaśca, ṣoḍaśe vatsare uttarāyaṇadānādi, saṃhitāyāstretā- yugasantānasya māhātmyamityādi 885
300. lakṣmīnārāyaṇamahimā, tretākhaṇḍasthakathānāṃ saṃkṣiptanirdeśaḥ dvāparasantānaprastāvaḥ, āśīrvādāśceti । 888

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāḥ tretāyugasantānātmakasya dvitīyakhaṇḍasya viṣayāṇām anukramaṇikā
